abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of Ce doped single-phase complex spinel, wherein a series of single-phase high-entropy spinel oxide (Ce  x Co (1‑x)/4 Ni (1‑x)/4 Mn (1‑x)/4 Fe (1‑x)/4 ) 3 O 4  (0.01-0.05) samples are prepared by controlling the doping proportion of rare earth element Ce, samples with different Ce contents show different structures and performance differences, in terms of structure, when the Ce content is lower (0.01-0.05), the samples show a single-phase spinel structure, ceO  2  particles appear in the samples with higher Ce content (x-0.1), and the single-phase high-entropy spinel oxide is a common spinel-cerium oxide composite structure, in terms of electrocatalysis, a small amount of doped Ce can improve the catalytic activity of a catalyst, and the performance of Ce  0.02 Co 0.245 Ni 0.245 Mn 0.245 Fe 0.245 ) 3 O 4  is optimal.

title_en: Method for producing sound insulation material
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for producing a sound-insulating material, in particular a floor mat and a luggage compartment mat for motor vehicles, wherein the sound-insulating material has a wear layer and a nonwoven layer with a surface layer and/or a visible surface layer, the mechanical and physical properties and the acoustic properties of which differ, preferably regionally and/or partly, on the surface of the sound-insulating material, the method comprising the steps of: positioning the nonwoven layer in a steam/vacuum apparatus as a blank; inserting a wear layer into the steam/vacuum apparatus in such a way that the fluid-tight side faces a nonwoven layer, wherein the nonwoven layer has a bonding component, in particular bonding fibers; shutting down the steam/vacuum apparatus; applying vacuum to the upper and/or lower apparatus to make it easier to shape the wear layer profile; applying steam or hot air to the underside of the nonwoven layer, which deforms the abrasion layer, activates the binder fibers in the nonwoven layer and binds the abrasion layer and the nonwoven layer together; the pressure of the steam or hot air is reduced, in particular by the lower pressure on the wear layer side than on the underside of the nonwoven layer.

title_en: Lubricating shuttle
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an advantageous method for lubricating the surface of a tubular element of a drug delivery device. The method comprises the following steps: moving the device relative to the tubular element of the drug delivery device; contacting the tubular element with a brush portion of the device; and depositing a lubricant on the surface of the tubular element to lubricate the surface of the tubular element.

title_en: Manufacturing system for composite aluminum foil film
abstract_en: The invention discloses a manufacturing system for a composite aluminum foil film, which at least comprises a substrate feeding roller for conveying a substrate layer, a pair of aluminum foil feeding rollers for conveying metal aluminum foils to two sides of the substrate layer and a pair of protection film feeding rollers for conveying rolling protection films to the outer sides of the metal aluminum foils, wherein at least one pair of rolling rollers are arranged on two sides of a film layer formed by compounding the substrate layer, the metal aluminum foils and the rolling protection films along the advancing direction of the film layer, a pair of die rollers for forming holes on two sides of the film layer are arranged on the downstream of the rolling rollers, and a material receiving roller for the composite aluminum foil film is arranged on the downstream of the die rollers. The manufacturing system can be used for continuously processing the composite aluminum foil film, can be used for preparing a composite aluminum foil film with low thickness which is rolled and stretched after being compounded, avoids the defect that the metal aluminum foil with low thickness is difficult to compound, can obtain thinner metal aluminum foil, and can ensure conductivity and strength.

title_en: Cigarette tipping paper compounding machine and compounding process
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cigarette production, in particular to a cigarette tipping paper compounding machine and compounding process, comprising a conveying mechanism, a filling mechanism, a compounding mechanism and a cleaning mechanism which are arranged on a frame, wherein the conveying mechanism comprises a carrying component arranged on the frame, an unreeling component arranged on the frame and used for tiling inner paper on the carrying component, and a pressing groove component arranged on the carrying component and used for pressing a strip-shaped sinking groove on the surface of the inner paper; the invention increases the gap between the outer layer of the tipping paper and the filter stick, improves the heat insulation effect of the tipping paper, avoids the filter stick from scalding the mouth, has rich and durable taste, improves the suction effect, and solves the technical problems that the traditional tipping paper has simple structure, no taste and poor heat insulation effect, the filter stick is easy to scald the mouth and influences the suction effect.

title_en: Device and method for realizing atomic-level film growth on powder surface
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of material plating, in particular to an atomic layer deposition technology, and more particularly relates to a device for realizing atomic-level film growth on the surface of powder, which comprises a reaction cavity, an exhaust mechanism and a powder supply device; a plurality of heating assemblies and a plurality of Laval nozzles are arranged on the side wall of the reaction cavity, and a stirring mechanism is arranged in the middle of the reaction cavity; under the dual reinforcement effect of high-speed jet flow and stirring formed by a plurality of Laval nozzles, agglomerated micro-nano particles in a reaction cavity are depolymerized, and meanwhile, the particles can be fully contacted with reaction gas and rapidly undergo deposition reaction, so that an atomic-level film with high shape retention is precisely formed on the surfaces of the particles. The technical problem that the high-viscosity micro-nano powder has poor atomic-level coating uniformity is solved. Based on this, a method for realizing the atomic-scale film growth on the surface of the powder is also proposed.

title_en: Composite packaging material, manufacturing method thereof and packaging container
abstract_en: The application discloses a composite packaging material, a manufacturing method thereof and a packaging container, and belongs to the technical field of packaging materials. The composite packaging material comprises a first paper layer, a first bonding layer, a second paper layer and a heat sealing layer which are sequentially laminated; wherein at least one of the first paper layer, the first adhesive layer and the second paper layer comprises lignin or derivatives thereof. The composite packaging material does not comprise aluminum foil, the treatment of the aluminum foil is not needed to be considered when the composite packaging material is recycled, the recycling efficiency is improved, and the first adhesive layer in the composite packaging material comprises lignin or derivatives thereof, so that the gas barrier property of the composite packaging material can be improved.

title_en: Cooling optimization method and cooling management system for metal surface
abstract_en: A cooling optimization method and a cooling management system for a metal surface relate to the field of metal surface cooling, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first metal layer cooling target and a second metal layer cooling target; determining a first metal layer optimal cooling curve and a second metal layer optimal cooling curve; drawing a first metal layer actual cooling curve and a second metal layer actual cooling curve; judging whether deviation exists between the actual cooling curve of the first metal layer and the actual cooling curve of the second metal layer; and if the optimal cooling curve of the first metal layer and/or the optimal cooling curve of the second metal layer exceed the preset deviation range, determining a corresponding cooling response strategy according to the actual cooling curve of the first metal layer and/or the actual cooling curve of the second metal layer. By implementing the method, the cooling method of the metal surface can be adjusted according to actual conditions, and the problem of product defects caused by improper cooling process is effectively solved, so that the cooling process is controlled more accurately.

title_en: Renewable energy ammonia production and energy recycling system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a renewable energy ammonia production and energy recycling system and method. The invention relates to a renewable energy ammonia production and energy recycling system, which comprises a power supply system, a hydrogen and nitrogen preparation system and a synthetic ammonia energy recycling system, wherein the power supply system is connected with the hydrogen and nitrogen preparation system and the synthetic ammonia energy recycling system, the hydrogen and nitrogen preparation system comprises an air separation device, an alkaline electrolytic tank and a synthetic compressor, the synthetic ammonia energy recycling system comprises a synthetic tower, a steam generator and a heat exchanger, the air separation device and the alkaline electrolytic tank are connected with the synthetic tower through the synthetic compressor, the synthetic tower is connected with the steam generator and the heat exchanger, a steam outlet of the steam generator is connected with a steam user and an absorption heat pump, the absorption heat pump is connected with an air conditioner cold and hot user, an ammonia outlet of the steam generator is connected with the heat exchanger, and the heat exchanger is connected with a domestic hot water user. The invention realizes combined supply of cold and hot electricity through cascade utilization of energy sources, and improves the utilization efficiency of the energy sources.

title_en: Recycling treatment method and application of etching waste liquid
abstract_en: The invention relates to a recycling treatment method and application of etching waste liquid, comprising the following steps: adjusting the pH value of the etching waste liquid to be treated to 6-9, adding an organic ligand, uniformly mixing, and after the reaction, carrying out solid-liquid separation and drying to obtain a solid phase substance; wherein the addition amount of the organic ligand is 1-20wt% of the etching waste liquid; mixing the solid phase substance with inorganic phosphorus salt according to the proportion of 1:1-5, calcining in inert atmosphere, and cooling to obtain copper phosphide/C composite material; wherein the inorganic phosphorus salt is sodium hypophosphite or hydrate thereof. The recycling treatment method has the advantages of simple operation, low cost, high safety coefficient and the like, the process is clean and efficient, no secondary pollutant is discharged, the produced copper phosphide/C composite material has uniform particles, good dispersibility and high purity, has good catalytic performance of electrolytic water cathode hydrogen evolution reaction, and has good electrocatalytic performance and high added value.

title_en: Defect-reducing paint film decals, articles, and methods
abstract_en: The in-situ polymerized polymer film helps to improve paint film decal and reduce defects. The paint film decal includes an in situ polymerized polymer film and at least one colored layer as carrier layers, the in situ polymerized polymer film and the at least one colored layer being assembled into a laminate, optionally the paint film decal further includes at least one top coat layer on one major surface of the laminate and an adhesive layer on the other major surface of the laminate.

title_en: Full spectrum frequency division photocatalysis and photoelectric water electrolysis hydrogen production integrated device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydrogen production, in particular to a full-spectrum frequency-division photocatalysis and photoelectric water electrolysis hydrogen production integrated device, which comprises: a frame; the photocatalysis hydrogen production module is used for preparing hydrogen through photocatalysis and absorbing sunlight in a short wave band, so that the sunlight in the long wave band is continuously transmitted through the photocatalysis hydrogen production module; the power generation module is used for receiving the long-wave-band sunlight and converting the sunlight into electric energy, and is positioned below the photocatalytic hydrogen production module; an electrolysis module for electrolyzing water to produce hydrogen; the hydrogen storage chamber is used for accommodating hydrogen, and the hydrogen storage chamber is arranged in a centralized way through the photocatalytic hydrogen production module, the power generation module, the electrolysis module and the hydrogen storage chamber, so that the space utilization rate is improved; the photocatalytic hydrogen production module is arranged above the power generation module, so that on one hand, the high-efficiency utilization of solar energy and the maximum hydrogen production under the same sunlight condition are realized, and the practicality is high and the operation is easy; on the other hand, the conversion of energy which cannot be utilized by the power generation module into heat energy can be reduced.

title_en: Electroplating equipment for surface treatment of high-voltage switching power supply
abstract_en: The application discloses electroplating equipment for surface treatment of a high-voltage switch power supply, which is characterized in that a supporting rod and a top plate are downwards extruded by a downwards-moving electrode frame, so that springs are compressed under pressure, limiting force on a partition plate connected with the top plate by a pull rope is weakened, all the partition plates start to downwards move, when the electrode frame upwards moves to be separated from an electroplating pool after electroplating is finished, the pressure on the supporting rod and the top plate gradually disappears, at the moment, the compressed springs push the supporting rod and the top plate to upwards lift, the top plate gradually upwards moves by pulling the pull rope to enable all the partition plates to be unfolded in the electroplating pool again, the partition plates reciprocate up and down in the electroplating pool, when the partition plates downwards move, electroplating liquid at the bottom of the extrusion electroplating pool upwards flows, when the partition plates upwards move, the electroplating liquid at the top of the extrusion electroplating pool downwards flows, so that an up-down stirring effect of the electroplating liquid in the electroplating pool is obtained in the up-down flowing process, and additives in the electroplating liquid are more uniform.

title_en: Easy-to-uncover system of composite paper can
abstract_en: The disclosed easy-to-uncover system of the composite paper tank comprises: the base layer of the inner film is coated with a first coated heat sealing layer, and the coating raw material of the first coated heat sealing layer comprises LDPE material and POP material, and the mass ratio of the LDPE material to the POP material is 4-5:1, a step of; a second film-spraying heat seal layer is coated on the base layer of the cover film, and the film-spraying raw material of the second film-spraying heat seal layer comprises PB material and POP material, and the PB material and the POP material are blended according to the mass ratio of 1:1-2; the edge of the first lamination heat seal layer is bonded and heat-sealed with the edge of the second lamination heat seal layer; the LDPE material is DOW  TM  LDPE 722, the POP material is AFFINITY  TM  POPT 1450G1, and the PB material is Basell PB 8340M. In the easy-to-uncover system, the first and second laminated heat sealing layers can obtain controllable heat sealing strength of 14.3-16.9N/15mm after heat sealing, the sealing strength of the inner film and the cover film and the uncovering force fluctuation are small, a controllable and stable uncovering effect can be formed, and the use experience of consumers is good; importantly, the uncovering surface after uncovering is smooth, and phenomena of napping and chipping falling do not occur.

title_en: Composite roof insulation board and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of building materials, and discloses a composite roof insulation board and a preparation method thereof, wherein the composite roof insulation board comprises the following component materials: 1 to 5 parts of modified graphite flame retardant, 20 to 40 parts of polymeric flexible waterproof material, 10 to 30 parts of crack-resistant waterproof mortar, 40 to 60 parts of heat insulation material and 5 to 15 parts of decorative material; the graphite flame retardant comprises graphite powder and a flame retardant, the adding ratio of the graphite powder to the flame retardant is 1:2, the flame retardant comprises aluminum hydroxide and a brominated flame retardant, the adding ratio of the aluminum hydroxide to the brominated flame retardant is 3:1, the polymeric flexible waterproof material comprises polyurethane and a flexible additive, and the adding ratio of the polyurethane to the flexible additive is 3:1. Through integrating waterproof, heat preservation and decoration function in a panel, realized jointless, have not connect limit, seamless overall structure, improved the wholeness ability of roofing, ensured long-term stability in use and reliability.

title_en: Anti-decoloring packaging box with anti-oxidation coating and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of coatings, and particularly discloses an anti-decoloring packaging box with an anti-oxidation coating and a preparation process thereof; the preparation process of the decoloring-proof packing box comprises the following steps: spraying an antioxidant coating on the surface of the packaging box, and drying at room temperature to obtain an antioxidant coating; spraying a crosslinking assisting solution; spraying a hydrophobic coating to obtain a hydrophobic coating; heating and solidifying to obtain a decoloration-preventing packaging box; the antioxidation coating comprises: epoxy resin, antioxidant, curing agent and solvent; the auxiliary crosslinking solution is a solution containing a curing agent; the hydrophobic coating comprises: epoxy resin, hydrophobic filler, curing agent and solvent; the thickness of the antioxidation coating is 25-35 mu m; the spraying amount of the auxiliary crosslinking solution is 15-20 g/m  2 ; the thickness of the hydrophobic coating is 8-12 mu m; the room temperature drying time is 1 to 1.5 hours; the curing process comprises the following steps: curing for 2-3 h at 80-90 ℃ and 4-6 h at 120-130 ℃.

title_en: Gluing and mounting process for notebook computer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of gluing and mounting of notebook computers, and discloses a gluing and mounting process for a notebook computer, which comprises the following steps of: preprocessing parts of the notebook computer, which need to be glued; applying an adhesive to a designated location of a notebook computer part; the notebook computer parts are applied to the surface to be bonded. According to the invention, the silica gel or UV (ultraviolet) glue is used as an adhesive of notebook computer parts, and the anti-seismic performance of the equipment is effectively improved by providing a mode of firm adhesion, impact absorption, long-term stability maintenance and the like, so that the protective effect of the notebook computer can be greatly improved for protecting expensive electronic components, especially screens and other vulnerable parts.

title_en: Nuclear power guide column chromium plating equipment and process
abstract_en: The invention provides nuclear power guide post chromium plating equipment and a nuclear power guide post chromium plating process, and belongs to the technical field of electroplating; the chromium plating device comprises a chromium plating transverse groove and two connecting parts arranged at two ends of a guide post, wherein an adjusting part is arranged on each connecting part, chromium bars coaxial with the guide post are arranged in the middle of each connecting part, and a plurality of supporting plates for supporting the chromium bars are arranged on each connecting part. According to the invention, the connecting part, the adjusting part and the supporting plate are arranged to build the installation guide channel of the chromium rod, so that the chromium rod is installed and guided and supported in the chromium plating process, the chromium rod is prevented from contacting the inner wall of the guide post in the process of transversely passing through the guide post, the inner wall of the guide post is prevented from being scratched, the chromium plating effect is influenced, the chromium rod is ensured to be coaxial with the guide post all the time in the inner hole chromium plating process of the guide post, the thickness of the chromium plating layer on the inner wall of the guide post is ensured to be uniform, the working stability of the chromium plating layer in the nuclear power reactor is improved, and the potential safety hazard of the nuclear power reactor in working is reduced.

title_en: Gas heating device, method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gas heating device, a gas heating method and application thereof in cold spraying. The gas heating device includes: the high-temperature-resistant heat-conducting nonmetal body is provided with an air inlet and an air outlet; one or more gas flow passages which are communicated with the gas inlet and the gas outlet are arranged in the high-temperature-resistant heat-conducting nonmetallic body; the high-temperature-resistant heat-conducting nonmetal body is provided with a sealing cavity filled with induction metal around the gas flow passage; the high-temperature resistant heat-conducting nonmetallic body can resist the high temperature of more than 2000 ℃ and can resist the pressure of more than 20 MPa; and the induction coil can inductively heat the induction metal filled in the sealed cavity. The gas heating method adopts the gas heating device; the gas to be heated enters the high-temperature-resistant heat-conducting nonmetallic body through the gas inlet, is heated when passing through the gas flow passage, and finally leaves from the gas outlet; the induction coil inductively heats the inductive metal filled in the sealed chamber and heat is transferred to the gas in the gas flow passage.

title_en: BiVO (binary organic acid)4Preparation method and application of nanocluster@MOF composite catalytic material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of BiVO  4  nanocluster@MOF composite catalytic material, which can be applied to electro-synthesis of urea under flue gas, and the preparation method comprises the steps of respectively dissolving AlCl  3 ·6H 2 O、NH 2  -BDC in DMF, mixing, continuously stirring at room temperature, adding polyacid V  10 , carrying out ultrasonic treatment, putting the obtained mixture into an autoclave, cooling at room temperature, carrying out ultrasonic treatment for 5min, carrying out centrifugal separation, washing and drying, collecting a final product V  10  @MOF, mixing with Bi (NO  3 ) 3 ·5H 2  O solution, stirring for reaction, carrying out ultrasonic bath treatment on the obtained mixed solution, washing with DMF and ethanol for three times, and finally carrying out vacuum drying at 60 ℃ to obtain the BiVO  4  nanocluster@MOF composite catalytic material.

title_en: Electronic paper display module and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of display panels, and discloses an electronic paper display module and a preparation method thereof, wherein the electronic paper display module comprises the following components: a drive back plate; the electronic ink film is arranged on the driving backboard; the water blocking film is arranged on the electronic ink film, and the orthographic projection of the water blocking film on the driving backboard covers the orthographic projection of the electronic ink film on the driving backboard; the periphery of the water blocking film is provided with a protruding part. According to the invention, the bulge is arranged on the periphery of the water-blocking film and is used as the reserved attaching position for pre-tearing and attaching the protective film, so that the adhesive position between the protective film on the surface of the water-blocking film and the pre-tearing and attaching is prevented from being polluted by glue, the pre-tearing and attaching position is not required to be manually peeled, the labor input cost can be reduced, and the product yield is increased.

title_en: Metal surface treatment process and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a metal surface treatment process and application thereof, wherein the metal surface treatment process comprises the following steps: cleaning working section: spraying, roller brushing, vacuum roller drying, baking and rolling, and interface treatment working section: a) Plasma treatment; b) And (3) interface activation: uncoiling, spraying, roller coating, baking and coiling, wherein the plasma treatment comprises normal pressure plasma treatment and low pressure plasma treatment, and the aqueous interface treatment formula in the spraying process comprises the following components: 0-50 parts of water, 0-50 parts of solvent, 0.5-5 parts of interface treating agent and 0.5-3 parts of auxiliary agent. The metal treated by the surface treatment process has high surface energy, low contact angle and high adhesive force with the coating, and compared with the high molecular compound primer, the metal has environmental protection performance and can be widely applied.

title_en: Shape memory-based self-repairing carbon fiber composite material
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of carbon fiber composite materials, and provides a self-repairing carbon fiber composite material based on shape memory, which comprises a composite material body, wherein the composite material body comprises a carbon fiber layer, a shape memory polymer base layer and a branch pipeline; the carbon fiber layer comprises a first carbon fiber bundle and a second carbon fiber bundle, the first carbon fiber bundle and the second carbon fiber bundle are woven in a warp-weft mode, the first carbon fiber bundle and the second carbon fiber bundle are staggered to form a micro-embedded structure, and a matrix material is embedded into the micro-embedded structure after the shape memory polymer base layer is molded; the branch pipeline comprises a central part and an extension part, and is arranged in the composite material body in a net structure; according to the invention, the shape memory polymer base layer and the carbon fiber layer are arranged, so that the stress can be more effectively transferred when the material is stressed, the overall strength of the composite material is enhanced, the self-repairing system is formed by the shape memory effect and the branch pipelines, the self-repairing is realized, the mechanical property and the function are recovered, and the service life is prolonged.

title_en: Environment-friendly prefabricated TPE plastic track material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environment-friendly prefabricated TPE plastic track material and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of plastic track materials, wherein the environment-friendly prefabricated TPE plastic track material comprises a weather-resistant wear-resistant embossing layer, an elastic supporting layer, an adhesive coating and a rubble layer; the environment-friendly prefabricated TPE plastic track material does not adopt glue during construction, only adopts cement to bond the crushed stone layer of the environment-friendly prefabricated TPE plastic track material with the road surface, is easy to construct, is safe and environment-friendly, has good wear resistance and long service life, and obviously improves the service quality of the plastic track and prolongs the service life of the plastic track.

title_en: Method for using thermal laser evaporation system and thermal laser evaporation system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method of using a Thermal Laser Evaporation (TLE) system (100), the system (100) comprising: a reaction chamber (10) that can be filled with a reaction atmosphere (14); one or more sources (30) disposed in the reaction chamber (10), each source (30) comprising a source material (32); and a laser source (50) for providing laser radiation (52) at a surface (34) of the source (30) and thereby evaporating the source material (32). Furthermore, the invention relates to a thermal laser evaporation system (100) comprising: a reaction chamber (10) that can be filled with a reaction atmosphere (14); one or more sources (30) disposed in the reaction chamber (10), each source comprising a source material (32); and coupling means (12) provided by the reaction chamber (10) for coupling laser radiation (52) into the reaction chamber (10) to impinge on the surface (34) of the source (30) and thereby evaporate the source material (32).

title_en: Metal section for photovoltaic module and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of photovoltaic coating, and provides a metal section for a photovoltaic module, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the metal section comprises a steel body, a zinc-aluminum-magnesium alloy plating layer and a single-component functional coating; the single-component functional coating used for the single-component functional coating comprises polyester resin, acrylic resin, fluorocarbon resin, pigment and filler, organic solvent, auxiliary agent and aliphatic isocyanate curing agent in specific parts by weight; the polyester resin, the acrylic resin and the fluorocarbon resin with specific viscosity and specific hydroxyl value are adopted; the auxiliary agent comprises a wetting leveling agent, a dispersing agent, a defoaming agent and an adhesion promoter in specific parts by weight. The metal section for the photovoltaic module only needs to be coated with a single-component functional coating, the construction is simple, the cost is low, and the single-component functional coating has more long-term excellent adhesive force, aging resistance, corrosion resistance, weather resistance and gloss retention on a zinc-aluminum-magnesium alloy coating.

title_en: Deuteration method of fluorinated aromatic ring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deuteration method of fluoro aromatic ring, belonging to the technical field of preparing carbocycle hydrocarbon by electrolysis, and mixing the fluoro aromatic ring, deuterium water, the first electrolyte and the first organic solvent to obtain a solution, and carrying out electrolysis to obtain a product of defluorination and deuterium reduction of the aromatic ring. The method can realize the full defluorination and the reduction of the deuteration of the aromatic ring under the conditions of no hydrogen and normal temperature and normal pressure, and simultaneously the deuterium source is easy to obtain, so that the method has low energy consumption and small pollution, is a very green and environment-friendly reaction method, has very good substrate applicability, scalability, wide economic value and application space, and has extremely outstanding innovation and advantage in the field of deuteration medicine synthesis.

title_en: Wheel body gluing equipment and production line
abstract_en: The invention provides wheel body gluing equipment and a production line, and relates to the field of gluing, wherein the wheel body gluing equipment comprises a supporting platform, a lifting translation device, a smearing mechanism, a glue storage mechanism, a fixing assembly and a glue scraping assembly; the lifting translation device drives the smearing mechanism to move between the glue storage mechanism and the fixing assembly, the fixing assembly is used for fixing the truckles, the glue storage mechanism is used for storing glue substances, the smearing mechanism smears the truckles after being stained with the glue substances, and the glue scraping assembly is used for removing the glue substances remained on the surface of the smearing mechanism. The invention has the effect that the cambered surface of the trundle can be fully coated with the adhesive substance with moderate thickness through the lifting translation assembly, the coating mechanism, the adhesive storage mechanism and the fixing assembly. The invention also discloses a wheel body production line.

title_en: ALD device and semiconductor equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides an ALD device and semiconductor equipment, and relates to the technical field of semiconductors. The ALD apparatus includes a tray and a shower panel. The tray is used for bearing the substrate, spray panel and the relative setting of tray, spray panel is provided with first air inlet region, second air inlet region and isolation region, isolation region is located between first air inlet region and the second air inlet region, first air inlet region is used for spraying the metal source to the substrate on the tray, second air inlet region is used for spraying the oxygen source to the substrate on the tray, isolation region is used for spraying the inert gas source to the substrate on the tray, can stop the CVD reaction that metal source and oxygen source produced at effective deposition region's direct contact, thereby film thickness homogeneity and rete quality when effectively improving ALD technology.

title_en: Large-size layered GeSb4Te7Single crystal and method for producing same
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of material preparation, and particularly relates to a large-size layered GeSb  4 Te 7  single crystal and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises (1) weighing Ge particles, sb particles and Te particles as raw materials; (2) placing raw material particles in a quartz crucible and vacuumizing; (3) Fixing the quartz crucible in a temperature gradient area of a hearth of a vertical furnace, and performing program temperature control to obtain a single crystal ingot body; (4) And adjusting the position of the quartz crucible for loading the single crystal ingot body to the range of 3cm areas above and below the thermocouple position of the vertical furnace, and carrying out annealing treatment to obtain the large-size layered GeSb  4 Te 7  single crystal.

title_en: Preparation method and system of titanium anode with titanium-based oxide coating
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of titanium anode preparation of a titanium-based oxide coating, in particular to a method and a system for preparing a titanium anode of a titanium-based oxide coating, which comprise the following steps: according to the branch length sequence and the branch relative angle sequence, performing primary branch growth, constructing branch leaves of the grown branches according to the performance index values to obtain an iterative growth tree, judging whether the preparation data are extracted, re-extracting the preparation data if the extraction is not completed, performing secondary branch growth on the first complete growth tree according to the requirement index values to obtain a second complete growth tree, identifying Wen Xulie on the second complete growth tree, and performing titanium anode preparation of the titanium-based oxide coating according to Wen Xulie during preparation. The invention can solve the problems of high manpower resource consumption and low optimization efficiency in the single index performance optimization process of the titanium anode with the titanium-based oxide coating.

title_en: Photosensitive resin composition, photosensitive element, printed wiring board, and method for producing printed wiring board
abstract_en: The invention provides a photosensitive resin composition, which contains (A) acid modified vinyl-containing resin, (B) photopolymerization initiator, (C) photopolymerization compound and (D) thermosetting resin, wherein (A) acid modified vinyl-containing resin contains a first resin with weight average molecular weight smaller than 4000 and a second resin with weight average molecular weight larger than 4000, the content of the first resin is more than 60 mass percent based on the total amount of (A) acid modified vinyl-containing resin, and the content of (A) acid modified vinyl-containing resin is less than 33 mass percent based on the total amount of solid components of the photosensitive resin composition.

title_en: Sweat-releasing breathable fire-fighting fabric and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a preparation method of a sweat-releasing and breathable fire-fighting fabric, which comprises the following steps of S1, providing a resin layer, depositing a first reflecting layer on the lower surface of the resin layer, depositing a second reflecting layer on the upper surface of the resin layer, S2, forming a hydrophobic surface on one side of the first reflecting layer, which is away from the resin layer, through hydrophobic treatment, forming a hydrophilic surface on one side of the second reflecting layer, which is away from the resin layer, through hydrophilic treatment, S3, providing a substrate layer, coating a connecting layer on one side of the substrate layer, and bonding and curing one side of the first reflecting layer, which is provided with the hydrophobic surface, with one side of the connecting layer, which is away from the substrate layer, so as to obtain the sweat-releasing and breathable fire-fighting fabric. The application also discloses the sweat-releasing breathable fire-fighting fabric prepared by the preparation method. The prepared sweat-releasing breathable fire-fighting fabric has good sweat-releasing and moisture-permeable properties, and can promote the comfort and safety of a wearer.

title_en: Environment-friendly halogen-free flame-retardant PP floor and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environment-friendly halogen-free flame retardant PP floor and a preparation method thereof, comprising a PP wear-resistant layer, a PP color film, a PP substrate layer and a PP balance layer, wherein the PP wear-resistant layer and the balance layer are prepared by adopting a phosphorus flame retardant as an auxiliary material, and the PP negative film/substrate layer is prepared by adopting a rare earth flame retardant as an auxiliary material. The invention starts from the two aspects of the wear-resistant layer and the substrate layer, is prepared by adopting flame retardants with different characteristics in an auxiliary way according to different requirements on flame retardant characteristics, has excellent flame retardant property and environment-friendly property, and the basic performance of the floor is not influenced. The invention adopts metal ions in rare earth, can accelerate the decomposition rate of aluminum hydroxide in the combustion process, and has good flame retardant effect. By adopting the rare earth flame retardant method, the fuming amount of the floor is very small, and in the processing temperature range, the appearance of the PP base material is smoother due to the lower aluminum hydroxide content.

title_en: Spraying cooling device for machining automobile plate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a spraying cooling device for processing automobile plates, which comprises a base, wherein universal wheels are fixedly arranged at four corners of the bottom end of the base, a vertical plate is fixedly connected to the rear side of the middle position of the top end of the base, a plurality of adjusting plates are uniformly and slidingly arranged on the vertical plate, a spray pipe is rotatably connected to the adjusting plates, spray nozzles are arranged on the spray pipes, cooling mechanisms are fixedly connected to two sides of the top end of the base, each cooling mechanism comprises a vent pipe, each vent pipe is fixedly connected with the base, a plurality of adjusting mechanisms are communicated with each vent pipe, blowing heads are respectively arranged on the plurality of adjusting mechanisms, blowing ports are uniformly arranged on the blowing heads, an air cooler is fixedly connected to the base through connecting pipes and communicated with the vent pipes, so that a sprayed coating is conveniently cooled, the cooling effect is improved, and the spraying efficiency of the automobile plates is improved.

title_en: Coating device and method for copper wire
abstract_en: The invention discloses a red copper wire coating device and method, comprising a liquid storage tank, wherein a control panel is arranged on the front surface of the liquid storage tank, an alarm is arranged at the top of the liquid storage tank, a liquid level sensor is arranged in the liquid storage tank, a plurality of supporting legs are arranged and are connected with the liquid storage tank, rotating guide wheels are arranged on the inner sides of the two supporting legs in a dismounting mode, a body fluid tank is arranged on the inner sides of the supporting legs, a positioning plate is arranged at the inner bottom of the body fluid tank, a coating sponge plate is arranged in the body fluid tank, and a positioning groove matched with the positioning plate is formed in the bottom of the coating sponge plate.

title_en: Preparation method of heterogeneous metal loaded carbon nano-box
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a heterogeneous metal loaded carbon nano box, which is realized by a one-pot method, wherein a mixture of transition metal salts is uniformly dispersed in deionized water, a functional carbon nano box is added, the mixture is stirred uniformly and then is freeze-dried to obtain a precursor, the precursor is subjected to low-temperature calcination in an argon atmosphere to obtain the heterogeneous metal loaded carbon nano box, and at least one transition metal is loaded in a single atom form and at least one other transition metal is loaded in an atomic cluster form. Solves the problems that the prior methods all adopt multi-step preparation and have no element universality. The invention adopts a one-step low-temperature calcination method, and is theoretically and universally applicable to all transition group metal elements.

title_en: Hydrogen bond donor-acceptor hybrid silicon dioxide particles, composite proton exchange membrane, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of proton exchange membranes, and particularly relates to hydrogen bond donor-acceptor hybrid silicon dioxide particles, a composite proton exchange membrane, and a preparation method and application thereof. The invention provides a hydrogen bond donor-acceptor hybrid silicon dioxide particle, which comprises a modified silicon dioxide particle, and polyimidazole and polyphenol grafted on the surface of the silicon dioxide particle, wherein the polyimidazole and the polyphenol are connected through hydrogen bonds, the modified silicon dioxide particle is prepared by modifying the silicon dioxide particle through a silane coupling agent, and the mass ratio of the modified silicon dioxide particle to the polyimidazole to the polyphenol is 87.39-94.29:5.71-12.61:3.55-15.72. The hydrogen bond acceptor density on the surface of the hydrogen bond donor-acceptor hybridization silicon dioxide particle is higher and controllable in a certain range, and can realize the regulation and control of a hydrogen bond network structure when being applied to a proton exchange membrane, thereby regulating and controlling the overall proton conductivity and mechanical stability of the composite proton exchange membrane.

title_en: Winding sheet for sintering joint
abstract_en: The winding sheet for sintering joint according to the present invention comprises a first base material and a layer for sintering joint laminated on the first base material, wherein the winding sheet for sintering joint is formed by winding a strip-shaped sheet for sintering joint along the length direction, the layer for sintering joint comprises an organic binder and contains conductive metal-containing sintering particles, the layer for sintering joint is directly laminated on the first base material or indirectly laminated on the first base material through a second base material, and the dimension L  1  of the first base material in the length direction is larger than the dimension L  S  of the layer for sintering joint in the length direction and the dimension L  2  of the second base material in the length direction.

title_en: Light beauty board
abstract_en: The invention discloses a light-weight beauty board, which relates to the technical field of building boards and comprises a structural bottom plate, wherein the top of the structural bottom plate is provided with a material extruding mechanism, the top of the material extruding mechanism is provided with a discharging mechanism, the outer side of the material extruding mechanism is provided with a heat preservation mechanism, the top of the structural bottom plate is provided with a die casting mechanism, and the inside of the die casting mechanism is provided with a beauty board body. The invention improves the structural strength of the plate and effectively lightens the whole quality of the plate through the use of the PET plate, the glass fiber net and the light quartz plate in the body of the American clean plate, thereby greatly improving the applicability of the device, leading the plate to meet different market demands, extruding PET raw materials into a die of a die casting mechanism for die casting molding through a blanking mechanism and an extruding mechanism, greatly improving the production efficiency of the plate, simplifying the production operation, and further effectively reducing the production cost.

title_en: Stripping and hanging method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a stripping and hanging method which is at least used for stripping and hanging a copper layer at a conductive clamping opening in water electroplating. The stripping method comprises a pretreatment step of pretreating a conductive clamp, a stripping step of placing the conductive clamp into stripping liquid and keeping the stripping liquid for a first preset time to remove a copper layer at the clamp opening of the conductive clamp, wherein the stripping liquid is an acidic solution, the acidic solution comprises an oxidant, strong acid and urotropine, the mass concentration of the oxidant is 100,200 g/L, the volume concentration of the strong acid is 50,100 mL/L, and the mass concentration of the urotropine is 0.1,0.5 g/L, and a post-treatment step of taking out the conductive clamp and carrying out post-treatment. The stripping and hanging method can solve the problem that the stripping and hanging method in the prior art has low efficiency when stripping and hanging the copper layer on the conductive clamp.

title_en: Application of cyclopropane compound in preventing and controlling forestry diseases and insects
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of cyclopropane compounds and application of nematicidal activity. The present invention uses an electrochemical process using inexpensive and readily available thioether to rapidly cyclopropanate a methylene compound. The synthesis method is simple, clean and efficient, has short reaction time, low energy consumption and low cost and is easy to obtain raw materials, and the cyclopropane compound has stronger activity of resisting pine wood nematode disease through activity test on mass preparation and better research, and the related research provides a good foundation for strong biological activity, anticancer, antibacterial and anti-inflammatory activities.

title_en: Metal medium reinforced reflecting film with wavelength of 3-5 mu m and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of optical films, and particularly discloses a metal medium reinforced reflecting film with a wavelength of 3-5 mu m and a preparation method thereof. The metal medium reinforced reflecting film with wavelength of 3-5 microns has the structure of Sub/aGbAcYdLeHfLgHhLiHjLkHlLmHnLoHpLqH/O, where Sub represents BK7 or K9 substrate, O represents air, G represents Cr layer, A represents Au layer, Y represents Y  2 O 3  layer, H represents ZnSe layer, L represents YF  3  layer, and a-q represents the coefficient of quarter reference wavelength optical thickness of each layer. The metal medium reinforced reflecting film with the wavelength of 3-5 mu m prepared by the application adopts K9/BK7 double-sided polished optical glass as a substrate, and a metal medium film is plated on the surface of the substrate, so that the metal medium reinforced reflecting film with excellent mechanical property and optical property is obtained, and the metal medium reinforced reflecting film is suitable for optical imaging of an infrared medium wave prism.

title_en: Preparation method of copper electrodeposition liquid and carrier copper foil
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to the technical field of carrier copper foil, in particular to copper electrodeposition liquid and a preparation method of the carrier copper foil. The copper electrodeposition liquid comprises 20 g/L-100 g/L phytic acid, 10 g/L-80 g/L copper carbonate, 0.1g/L tartaric acid additive and a solvent. The pH value of the copper electrodeposition liquid is 0.5-3. Through the cooperation of phytic acid, copper carbonate and tartaric acid additives with proper concentrations, copper grains with smaller size and uniform distribution can be obtained under the condition of pH value of 0.5-3, and the number of grain boundaries is increased. In the deformation process of the copper foil, the grain boundary can play a role in coordinating deformation, so that the material is easier to generate plastic deformation, and the elongation of the ultrathin copper is further improved.

title_en: Electroplating paint and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of electroplating paint, and particularly relates to electroplating paint and application thereof. The electroplating paint comprises, by mass, 50-70% of acrylic resin, 5-15% of amino resin, 0.5-3% of adhesion promoter, 0.1-1% of drier, 6-20% of ethylene glycol butyl ether, 0.5-3.5% of leveling agent and 3-15% of n-butyl alcohol. According to the invention, through the optimal design of the component formula of the electroplating coating paint, the binding force of the paint film and UV ink is improved under the condition that the appearance of the paint film is not affected, and the toughness, the wear resistance, the impact resistance, the scratch resistance and the corrosion resistance of the paint film are improved.

title_en: Controllable membrane electrode carbon carrier, catalyst and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of membrane electrode catalytic layers, and particularly relates to a controllable membrane electrode carbon carrier, a catalyst and a preparation method thereof, wherein on the basis of conventional potassium salt activation pore-forming, a novel carbon material precursor and a novel activation treatment mode are selected, and the unexpected discovery is that the modification method can be adopted to effectively control the size of a carbon material and the size of the internal pore diameter of the carbon material, so that the carbon carrier with a size-controllable multi-level pore structure and different types of catalysts are obtained. Different metal salts are adopted for activation, so that the carbon carrier can be introduced with oxygen-containing functional groups with different contents, and the hydrophilic and gas-repellent efficiency of the carbon carrier is improved; the carbon carrier has high specific surface area, hierarchical pore structure and low charge transfer resistance at different high temperature treatment temperatures, which shows that the mass transfer efficiency of the catalyst can be greatly improved, and the catalyst and the membrane electrode prepared by loading noble metal on the carbon carrier have excellent noble metal particle loading capacity, and have excellent cycle stability.

title_en: Corrosion prevention maintenance method and corrosion prevention maintenance structure for cable sheath damage and cable high-strength steel wire
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of bridge cable maintenance, and discloses an anti-corrosion maintenance method and an anti-corrosion maintenance structure for cable sheath damage and cable high-strength steel wires, which are used for solving the problems of complete sealing and corrosion prevention in the cable sheath repair process and durability of a repaired cable. A waterproof insulating coating material is coated on a damaged part of a cable sheath, then a solid electrolyte sealing material is filled at the damaged part of the sheath, the measuring ends of an auxiliary anode and a reference electrode are arranged inside the solid electrolyte sealing material, the auxiliary anode is connected with an electronic variable resistor, an automatic control rectifier or a potentiostat to form a conductive loop with a cathode access point positioned on a high-strength steel wire of the cable, and a physical anti-corrosion layer is used for wrapping the damaged part of the cable to form a closed anti-corrosion system at the damaged part of the sheath. The cable sheath damage and the corrosion-resistant maintenance method for the high-strength steel wire of the cable can maintain the partial damage of the sheath, enhance the inhibition of corrosion of the cable steel wire at the damage of the sheath, and lighten the influence of electrochemical corrosion on the service life of the cable, thereby greatly improving the service life of the cable.

title_en: Fe-doped SnS loaded on foam nickel2、SnO2Preparation method of heterojunction catalyst
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a Fe-doped SnS  2 、SnO 2  heterojunction catalyst loaded on foam nickel, and relates to the electrocatalytic material technology. The preparation method of the Fe-doped SnS  2 、SnO 2  heterojunction catalyst loaded on the foam nickel comprises the steps of S101 selecting SnCl  4 ·5H 2  O as a tin source, preparing a SnO  2  @NF precursor on a foam nickel substrate, S102 drying the obtained precursor, vulcanizing the precursor by a hydrothermal technology to obtain a nano sheet-shaped SnS  2 、SnO 2  heterojunction, and S103 immersing the dried heterojunction in ferric nitrate solution, and calcining the immersed heterojunction to obtain the Fe-doped SnS  2 、SnO 2  heterojunction catalyst. The invention relates to a multi-element heterogeneous metal material prepared by a specific method and application thereof, the multi-element heterogeneous nano material prepared by the method has simple and convenient process flow, can accurately control the morphology of the material, is easy to execute in the operation process, and has uniform size and higher specific surface area.

title_en: Comprehensive coating equipment and coating process for automobile bolt protective layer
abstract_en: The invention discloses comprehensive coating equipment and a coating process for an automobile bolt protective layer, which relate to the field of automobile bolt processing and comprise a preset base body and an internal motor, wherein the internal motor is arranged at the inner end of the preset base body, an external coating butt-joint brush piece is in butt joint with the output end of the internal motor, the external coating butt-joint brush piece is arranged at the upper end of the preset base body, a movable cam plate is fixedly connected to the outer side of the output end of the internal motor, and the movable cam plate is arranged at the inner side of the bottom of the preset base body. According to the comprehensive coating equipment and the coating process for the automobile bolt protective layer, multiple groups of automobile bolts on the outer side of the external positioning support piece are uniformly contacted with the external butt-joint brush piece in a comprehensive manner, so that the coating treatment of lubricating oil and the like without dead angles is performed in a self-adaptive manner, the coating range of the automobile bolt protective layer is improved, the defect of the traditional single bolt in the process of multiple operation is avoided, the contacted multiple groups of bolts are uniformly and rapidly coated in batches, and the processing efficiency of the whole device is improved.

title_en: Electrolyte additive, electrolyte, copper foil, preparation method and application of electrolyte additive and copper foil
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to an electrolyte additive, electrolyte, a copper foil, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the electrolyte additive comprises the following components in percentage by weight: sodium polydithio-dipropyl sulfonate, sodium alcohol thio-propane sulfonate, isothiourea propyl sulfate, high molecular rubber and thiourea compounds. The copper foil prepared by the electrolyte additive has high tensile strength and high elongation, the normal-temperature tensile strength is more than or equal to 640MPa, and the elongation is more than or equal to 5.0%, so that the defect that the high tensile strength and the high elongation are mutually limited is overcome, and the performance of the copper foil can be greatly improved when the copper foil is applied to lithium ion battery production.

title_en: Door and window processing is with equipment of gluing, bridge cut-off window production system and energy-conserving bridge cut-off window
abstract_en: The invention provides a gluing device for door and window processing, a bridge-cut-off window production system and an energy-saving bridge-cut-off window, wherein the gluing device for door and window processing comprises an installation table, a lifting mechanism, two rotating mechanisms, a glue injection mechanism, a conveying mechanism and a sucker fixing device, the bridge-cut-off window production system comprises a section bar processing module, a glass processing module, a heat insulation strip installation module, an assembly module and the gluing device for door and window processing, and the energy-saving bridge-cut-off window is manufactured by using the bridge-cut-off window production system. The glue injecting device for door and window processing finally realizes that two glue injecting mechanisms are synchronously realized in a rising and falling mode under the action of the lifting mechanism so as to facilitate synchronous glue injection of vertical faces of two adjacent hollow glass bodies, and glue injecting treatment of four faces of the hollow glass bodies can be continuously realized by using the two glue injecting mechanisms so as to facilitate batch continuous glue injecting treatment of a plurality of hollow glass bodies and improve production efficiency.

title_en: Fireproof heat-insulating glass and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to fireproof heat-insulating glass and a preparation process thereof, and relates to the field of fireproof heat-insulating materials, wherein the fireproof heat-insulating glass comprises a heat-insulating film layer I, a fireproof gel layer I, a glass substrate, a fireproof gel layer II and a heat-insulating film layer II, wherein the fireproof gel layer I and the fireproof gel layer II are prepared by adopting mixed gel solutions, and the preparation raw materials of the mixed gel solutions comprise, by mass, 80-100 parts of double-crosslinked gel monomers, 5-10 parts of cross-linking agents, 20-30 parts of composite flame retardants and 1-3 parts of initiators. The preparation process comprises the following steps of preparing a mixed gel solution, preparing a fireproof gel layer I and a fireproof gel layer II on the surface of a glass substrate, hot-pressing and bonding a heat-insulating film layer I to the surface of the fireproof gel layer I, and hot-pressing and bonding a heat-insulating film layer II to the surface of the fireproof gel layer II to obtain the fireproof heat-insulating glass. The application has the effect of improving the bonding force between the fireproof heat-insulating glass layers, and can improve the stability of the fireproof heat-insulating glass layers, thereby improving the fireproof heat-insulating performance.

title_en: Roller surface spraying device for textile machinery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a roller surface spraying device for textile machinery, which comprises a workbench, a spraying mechanism, a clamping mechanism, a drying mechanism, a collecting mechanism and a spraying mechanism, wherein a supporting frame is arranged at the bottom of the workbench, a first through hole is formed in the upper end of the workbench, a protective cover is arranged at the upper end of the workbench, one part of the spraying mechanism is arranged in the supporting frame, the other part of the spraying mechanism is arranged below the protective cover, the clamping mechanism is arranged on the inner wall of one side of the protective cover, the drying mechanism is arranged on the protective cover, the collecting mechanism is arranged in the supporting frame, the spraying mechanism is arranged at the outer end of one side of the supporting frame, the roller surface spraying device for textile machinery is provided with the spraying mechanism, the spraying mechanism comprises a bearing plate, a water tank, a water inlet, a drain pipe, a water pump and a spray pipe, and water in the water tank is washed on a slope on the workbench through the spray pipe by the water pump, and the water tank is convenient to clean.

title_en: Hydrogen fuel cell electrode plate dispensing and laminating device with continuous pressure maintaining function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydrogen fuel cell production equipment, in particular to a hydrogen fuel cell electrode plate dispensing bonding device with a continuous pressure maintaining function, which comprises a continuous pressure maintaining bonding table arranged beside a dispensing robot and a discharging robot, wherein the continuous pressure maintaining bonding table comprises a limiting template, a linear conveyor, a pressure maintaining limiting device, an unlocking adjusting device, a lifting pushing device, a pressure maintaining pushing device and a protective plate placing device; the limiting template is horizontally arranged on the frame; the linear conveyor is arranged below the limiting template; the invention can effectively improve the production efficiency and optimize the pressure maintaining effect.

title_en: Blackening treatment process for improving conductivity of lithium tantalate wafer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a blackening treatment process for conductivity of a lithium tantalate wafer, which belongs to the technical field of crystal materials and comprises the following steps of spreading a composite reducing agent at the bottom of a crucible to form a bottom reducing agent layer, placing the lithium tantalate wafer above the bottom reducing agent layer, spreading the composite reducing agent above the lithium tantalate wafer to form a top reducing agent layer, introducing nitrogen gas for heat treatment, and taking out to obtain the blackened lithium tantalate wafer, wherein the composite reducing agent comprises spherical copper powder, modified graphene and flaky copper powder with the mass ratio of (0.1-0.2) to (0.5-2). The blackening treatment process of the conductivity of the lithium tantalate wafer can remarkably reduce the resistivity of the lithium tantalate wafer and improve the conductivity of the lithium tantalate wafer, and has wide application prospects.

title_en: Corrugated carton and processing technology thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a corrugated case, which is provided with a corrugated case strength reinforcing structure. The invention also discloses a processing technology of the corrugated paper box, which comprises the steps of processing corrugated raw paper and face paper into single-sided corrugated boards through a single-sided machine, conveying the single-sided corrugated boards into a double-layer gluing machine through a conveying overpass, gluing the two single-sided corrugated boards into double-layer corrugated paper through the double-layer gluing machine, pressing lines, cutting edges of the double-layer gluing machine to form parting lines, conveying stacks, conveying the cut corrugated paper boards to the stacking machine through paper outlet rollers, stacking through conveying belts, folding the corrugated paper boards to form the corrugated paper boxes, conveying the folded corrugated paper boxes to a proper position, binding and jointing the paper boxes through a box nailing machine, detecting the paper boxes, and stacking the paper boxes. The invention strengthens the strength of the corrugated board and reduces the requirement on the precision of machine equipment. The cost is reduced, and the strength of the corrugated case is also ensured to be enhanced.

title_en: Noise-reducing sponge adhesive device and processing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of sponge processing, in particular to a noise-reducing sponge adhesive device and a processing method, wherein the noise-reducing sponge adhesive device comprises a bracket, a conveying mechanism arranged on the bracket, a gluing mechanism arranged above the conveying mechanism and a squeeze roller arranged on one side of the gluing mechanism, the conveying mechanism comprises a driving motor I, a driving wheel, a driven wheel and a conveying belt, a sponge to be adhered comprises an upper layer sponge and a lower layer sponge, the lower sponge is placed on the top of the conveying belt, the upper sponge is rotationally placed above the support, the conveying belt drives the lower sponge to move towards the extruding roller, the gluing mechanism comprises a glue solution cylinder, a glue spreading roller, a mounting rod and a smearing assembly, the glue spreading roller is used for coating glue solution on the top of the lower sponge in a rolling mode, and the smearing assembly is used for smearing the glue solution coated on the top of the lower sponge for the second time.

title_en: Optical filter and manufacturing method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of optical films. The invention provides a light filter and a manufacturing method and application thereof, wherein a back reduction and reflection film stack, a high-permeability film stack and a reflection reduction film stack which are formed according to different stacking structures are sequentially arranged on a substrate, and the three film stacks are respectively used for reducing the reflection of a substrate surface, ensuring the high transmittance in a working wavelength range of a laser radar and reducing the reflection of a film surface, so that the obtained near infrared light filter is double-sided black. When the anti-reflection film is used as a laser radar cover, the outside is observed to be black, and the anti-reflection film stack has low reflectivity and low transmittance to a visible light region, namely stray light, and has high transmittance to a near infrared region in the radar cover, so that the normal operation of a radar optical system can be ensured, and the influence of the internal stray light on the radar system can be effectively filtered.

title_en: Method for preparing quinine type anion exchange membrane by pre-irradiation grafting
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of anion exchange membranes, and discloses a method for preparing quinine type anion exchange membranes by pre-irradiation grafting, wherein linear carbon chain polymers are used as base materials, vinyl monomers are used as grafting monomers, the linear carbon chain polymers are pre-irradiated by an electron beam radiation source, and then, carrying out grafting reaction on the pre-irradiated base material in vinyl monomer solution, and carrying out quaternary ammonification reaction on the obtained grafted polymer and quinuclidine solution, thereby obtaining the quinine type anion exchange membrane. The quinine type anion exchange membrane prepared by the method has higher anion conductivity and better mechanical strength compared with the quinine type anion exchange membrane, and the quinine type anion exchange membrane prepared by the method has stronger chemical stability compared with the piperidine type anion exchange membrane and the trimethylamine type anion exchange membrane, so that the quinine type anion exchange membrane can be applied to the fields of fuel cells, electrolytic water, flow batteries and the like.

title_en: Electric heating alloy component pickling coating device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of processing of electrothermal alloy components and discloses an electrothermal alloy component pickling coating device which comprises a box body, wherein a box door is arranged on the outer side of the box body, a waste discharge pipe for discharging waste water in the box body is arranged on the outer side of the box door, a second support ring and a first support ring are driven to rotate through meshing of a first gear and a toothed ring, so that a limiting assembly and a workpiece are driven to synchronously rotate with the support ring, all directions of the workpiece are subjected to comprehensive pickling treatment, the workpiece is subjected to flushing treatment by using another group of spraying assemblies, a spraying pipe is driven to rotate on the outer side of the first support ring through meshing of the second gear and the toothed ring, limiting grooves are formed in the first support ring and the second support ring, limiting wheels roll in the limiting grooves, the spraying pipe is limited on the first support ring and the second support ring, stability of the spraying pipe in working is improved, and the workpiece is subjected to rotary spraying treatment after pickling by using the spraying pipe, so that the workpiece is sprayed more uniformly and comprehensively.

title_en: Junction box installation assembly line and installation process thereof
abstract_en: The junction box installation assembly line comprises a high-temperature adhesive tape tearing station, an adhesive dispensing station, an installation station and a feeding station, wherein the stations are sequentially connected in series through a photovoltaic module conveying mechanism, the high-temperature adhesive tape tearing module for tearing off a high Wen Jiaobu on a photovoltaic module is arranged at the high-temperature adhesive tape tearing station, the adhesive dispensing module for dispensing adhesive at the position of a high-temperature adhesive tape tearing area on the photovoltaic module is arranged at the adhesive dispensing station, the feeding station is provided with the feeding module for arranging and positioning the junction box on a junction box placing table, and the installation station is provided with the junction box installation module for taking the junction box from the junction box placing table and installing the junction box at the adhesive dispensing position of the photovoltaic module. According to the invention, the whole assembly line connects a plurality of installation devices in the prior art into a whole in series, the connection time between each process step is shortened, the process flow of installing the junction box is smoother, and the working beat is greatly improved.

title_en: Preparation and application of polyanthraquinone thiophene film
abstract_en: The invention discloses preparation and application of a poly-anthraquinone thiophene film, and the film material prepared by the preparation method can be used as a novel electrochromic material, belongs to the field of intelligent color change, and has the advantages of simple synthetic route, mild condition and low cost. The invention synthesizes a novel D-A type monomer by taking anthraquinone as an electron acceptor and thiophene derivatives as electron donors, and the monomer can prepare a polymer film through electrochemical polymerization.

title_en: Mask and support connection and method for manufacturing same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a mask-support-portion connector and a method for manufacturing the same. The connector of the mask and the supporting part is used for the OLED pixel forming process on the semiconductor wafer and comprises the supporting part and the mask, wherein the supporting part comprises an edge part and a grid part, the mask is connected to the supporting part and comprises a plurality of unit parts formed with mask patterns, and at least one part of the mask is distributed in a groove part formed by sinking in the supporting part.

title_en: Preparation process of L-fucose
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation process of L-fucose, and relates to the technical field of electrolytic production of organic compounds. The preparation process takes brown algae as a raw material, hydrolyzes the brown algae by a mixed acid solution of concentrated hydrochloric acid and concentrated phosphoric acid, adjusts the pH value, electrolyzes the hydrolysate, takes a graphite electrode as an anode and takes a silver electrode with the surface modified with sulfhydryl-beta-cyclodextrin as a cathode, elutes L-fucose after the electrolysis is completed, and performs column chromatography separation and recrystallization. Compared with the prior art, the method improves the extraction rate and the extraction efficiency of the L-fucose, simplifies the operation steps, and is favorable for industrialized large-scale obtaining of the L-fucose.

title_en: Resin composition, composite adhesive film, copper-clad plate and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a resin composition, which comprises thermosetting polyphenyl ether and modified filler, wherein the thermosetting polyphenyl ether is obtained by carrying out redistribution reaction and hydroxyl-terminated acrylation modification on thermoplastic polyphenyl ether, and the modified filler is obtained by carrying out surface modification on inorganic powder by adopting a double bond-containing silane coupling agent. The invention also discloses a composite adhesive film comprising the resin composition, a polyphenyl ether-based copper-clad plate and application thereof. The invention greatly improves the compatibility between the interfaces of the composite materials, improves the uniformity of the filler in the matrix, and the obtained product has excellent dielectric property and flexibility and good peel strength.

title_en: Impressed current cathodic protection device for corrosion prevention of oil and gas pipeline
abstract_en: The invention discloses an impressed current cathodic protection device for corrosion prevention of an oil gas pipeline, which comprises a driving assembly, a power supply, a rotary power generation assembly and a cathodic protection mechanism, wherein the driving assembly comprises a first branch pipe, a second branch pipe, a rotary sleeve and fan blades, the rotary power generation assembly is used for converting rotation of the rotary sleeve into electric energy and storing the electric energy into the power supply, and the cathodic protection mechanism comprises a discharge controller, an anode wire and a cathode wire. The invention has the beneficial effects that oil gas in the oil gas pipeline enters the rotating sleeve through the first branch pipe, the fan blades can drive the rotating sleeve to rotate, the rotating power generation assembly starts to work, the mechanical energy of the rotation of the rotating sleeve is converted into electric energy, the generated electric energy is stored in the power supply, an external current can form a protective electric field on the surface of the oil gas pipeline, the electric field can inhibit or slow down the corrosion process, the corrosion resistance of the oil gas pipeline can be effectively improved, and the long-term stable operation of the oil gas pipeline is ensured.

title_en: Intelligent hydrogen production system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent hydrogen production system and method, comprising a water supply device, a hydrogen production device, a purification device, a hydrogen delivery device, a pressure relief device, a system monitoring unit and a system control unit, wherein the invention detects the liquid level of a water tank through a first liquid level meter, detects the pure water temperature of the water tank through a first temperature sensor, detects the conductivity of water treated by a water machine through a first conductivity meter to judge the purity degree of the water, detecting the conductivity of the electrolyzed water entering the electrolytic tank through a second conductivity meter, detecting the temperature of the electrolyzed water in the electrolytic tank through a second temperature sensor, ensuring that the water quality and the water temperature in the electrolytic tank are within the electrolysis requirements, detecting the liquid level of the water separated out from the water-steam separator through a second liquid level meter, the dew point temperature of the hydrogen is detected by the dew point meter, and the actual output flow of the hydrogen flowing through the hydrogen outlet is detected by the flowmeter.

title_en: Surface treatment method and system for saw chain guide plate
