abstract_en: The invention discloses a surface treatment method and a system of a saw chain guide plate, and relates to the technical field of saw chain guide plates, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining a multi-layer composite coating of a target saw chain guide plate; the method comprises the steps of carrying out peeling probability analysis from an outer layer to an inner layer under a preset impact condition on a multi-layer composite coating to generate a plurality of peeling probabilities, determining a target coating with the peeling probability larger than a preset probability threshold value based on the peeling probabilities, carrying out interface reaction enhancement processing decision analysis on the target coating to generate a target interface reaction enhancement decision, and carrying out synchronous processing through the target interface reaction enhancement decision when the deposition of the target coating is carried out. The interlayer bonding property of the composite coating in the prior art is solved, so that the coating is peeled off and delaminated in the use process, and further the technical problems of low working efficiency and insufficient durability of the saw chain guide plate are solved, and the technical effects of improving the peeling resistance of the composite coating and the working efficiency and durability of the saw chain guide plate are achieved.

title_en: High-strength non-polyolefin breathable film and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of high polymer materials, in particular to a high-strength non-polyolefin breathable film, and a preparation method and application thereof. The non-polyolefin film comprises a base film and polyamide at least partially positioned at two sides of the base film, wherein the base film is made of non-polyolefin, and the average pore diameter of the non-polyolefin film is between 0.5 and 10 mu m. According to the method, the non-polyolefin is used as a substrate film, the two sides of the substrate film are coated with the polyamide casting film liquid with specific and proper concentration, and then the polyamide is solidified on the substrate film in the solidification bath, so that the non-polyolefin film with proper air permeability, good microbial barrier property and high strength can be obtained according to the method, and the non-polyolefin film is suitable for the field of medical packaging, greatly widens the source of the air permeable film used in the field of medical packaging, and has extremely high application value.

title_en: Low-haze polyamide composition, film, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a low-haze polyamide composition, a film, a preparation method and application thereof in the field of polyamide films. The low-haze polyamide composition comprises a component A and/or a component B, and a component C and a component D, wherein the component A is PA6, the component B is PA612, the component C is MXD6, the component D is a mixed olefin-maleic anhydride copolymerization microsphere, and when the component A, the component B, the component C and the component D are compounded in a specific content ratio, the obtained crystal regularity is low, and a polyamide biaxially oriented film with high light transmittance and low haze can be obtained at a lower stretching temperature.

title_en: Bearing boat and semiconductor process equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a bearing boat and semiconductor process equipment, and relates to the field of photovoltaics and semiconductors. The bearing boat comprises a supporting component and a plurality of heating plates, wherein the heating plates are arranged on the supporting component in a stacked mode, an accommodating space is reserved between two adjacent heating plates, the heating plates comprise at least one radio-frequency electrode plate and at least one grounding electrode plate, and the radio-frequency electrode plates and the grounding electrode plates are alternately arranged. The application can at least solve the problems of long preheating time, uneven preheating and the like.

title_en: TOPCon battery and preparation process of phosphorus-doped polysilicon thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a TOPCon battery and a preparation process of phosphorus doped polysilicon thereof, relating to the technical field of solar cells, comprising the following steps of: compared with the prior art, the preparation process of the phosphorus doped polysilicon of the TOPCon battery can effectively improve the winding plating problem and increase the phosphorus active doping concentration in the polysilicon on the premise of not increasing the phosphane flow, thereby improving the structure and efficiency of the TOPCon battery and solving the problem of reduced phosphorus activity after doping in the preparation of the Poly-Si layer on the silicon substrate by using the PECVD technology.

title_en: Chemical treatment method for improving surface finish of laser 3D printing titanium alloy
abstract_en: The invention relates to a chemical treatment method for improving the surface finish of a laser 3D printing titanium alloy, and belongs to the technical field of titanium alloy surface treatment. The chemical treatment method comprises the steps of preparing various surface treatment solutions, including a first surface treatment solution, a second surface treatment solution and a third surface treatment solution, placing a titanium alloy workpiece in the first surface treatment solution for first-stage soaking treatment until the surface roughness of the titanium alloy workpiece is reduced to 15-18 mu m, placing the titanium alloy workpiece in the second surface treatment solution for second-stage soaking treatment until the surface roughness of the titanium alloy workpiece is reduced to 8-10 mu m, placing the titanium alloy workpiece in the third surface treatment solution for third-stage soaking treatment until the surface roughness of the titanium alloy workpiece is reduced to below 5 mu m, wherein the viscosity of the first surface treatment solution, the second surface treatment solution and the third surface treatment solution is sequentially reduced, and the adsorption amount of surfactant is sequentially increased.

title_en: Cheng Lingjian surface coating device for railway construction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of railway engineering part processing equipment and discloses a railway construction tool Cheng Lingjian surface coating device which comprises a base, wherein the outer side of the top end of the base is fixedly connected with a workbench through a plurality of support rods, the front side of the upper surface of the workbench is provided with a feeding port, the rear side of the upper surface of the workbench is fixedly connected with a coating chamber, the middle part of the coating chamber is provided with a coating groove, four inner side walls of the coating groove are provided with coating cavities, the inner side walls of the coating cavities are movably provided with short shafts, the inner side ends of the short shafts are fixedly connected with cross brush plates, the right side of the upper surface of the workbench is fixedly provided with a drying chamber, the middle part of the drying chamber is provided with a drying groove, and the inner bottom of the drying chamber is fixedly provided with an electric heater. The invention can effectively clamp parts, can clean the surface and improve the painting quality, has uniform coating and uniform drying and heating, shortens the coating period by adopting a multi-station design, and improves the production efficiency.

title_en: Batch electroplating equipment for injection molding parts
abstract_en: The invention discloses injection molding batch electroplating equipment, which relates to the field of electroplating equipment and comprises an electroplating bath, wherein an electroplating cavity, a pressure cavity and a release and sustained cavity are sequentially arranged on one side of the inside of the electroplating bath from top to bottom, a recovery cavity is arranged on the other side of the inside of the electroplating bath, and the recovery cavity is communicated with the electroplating cavity through a recovery channel. According to the invention, under the condition that the movable sealing cover upwards opens the electroplating cavity, the electroplating solution in the pressure cavity is sealed, and when the movable sealing cover downwards seals the electroplating cavity, the electroplating solution in the pressure cavity can continuously enter the electroplating cavity, so that the electroplating process is basically kept in a sealed environment, the pollution to workshops is reduced, the influence on the health of personnel is also reduced, and the electroplating process is continuously carried out, so that the loss is reduced.

title_en: Al-Sc alloy and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an Al-Sc alloy and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the Al-Sc alloy comprises the following steps of (1) adding metal aluminum into molten scandium to perform smelting to obtain an Al-Sc alloy ingot, wherein the smelting mode is suspension smelting, the adding time of the metal aluminum is n & gt 1, (2) performing ultrasonic pulverization on the Al-Sc alloy ingot to obtain Al-Sc alloy powder, a crucible material adopted in the ultrasonic pulverization process is aluminum nitride, and (3) sequentially performing cold isostatic pressing and hot isostatic pressing sintering on the Al-Sc alloy powder to obtain the Al-Sc alloy. The Al-Sc alloy provided by the invention can cover the Sc content of 5at.% to 70at.%, and has the advantages of low oxygen content and high density.

title_en: High-strength corrosion-resistant aluminum alloy brazing sheet for power battery water cooling plate and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a high-strength corrosion-resistant aluminum alloy brazing sheet for a power battery water-cooling plate and a preparation method thereof, and discloses a high-strength corrosion-resistant aluminum alloy brazing sheet for a power battery water-cooling plate and a preparation method thereof, aiming at solving the problems that the water-cooling plate made of the existing 3003 aluminum alloy is limited by strength and corrosion resistance and is difficult to meet the use requirement of users. The high-strength corrosion-resistant aluminum alloy brazing sheet is made of a composite plate, the composite plate is formed by rolling and compounding a core material layer and a brazing layer, and the core material layer is composed of Si, fe, cu, M, zn, ti and Al. The preparation process comprises casting, homogenizing treatment, ingot casting treatment, brazing layer preparation, material cladding, preheating before rolling, hot rolling, cold rolling, finished product annealing, finishing and shearing. The high-strength corrosion-resistant aluminum alloy brazing sheet provided by the application has the advantages of high strength, good elongation, difficult cracking during forming, high strength after brazing and excellent corrosion resistance. The application is applied to the field of power battery water cooling plates.

title_en: Method for forming film by fluorination in equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for forming a film by fluorination in equipment, belonging to the technical field of metal corrosion prevention. Degreasing, namely filling alkali liquor into metal equipment, immersing the inside of the equipment in the alkali liquor completely, performing ultrasonic cleaning until no greasy dirt and grease are left in the inside of the equipment, draining, cleaning the residual alkali liquor with deionized water, drying, removing rust, polishing and removing rust in the equipment by using 600-mesh water-resistant sand, performing fluorinated film forming, namely introducing 3N pure 10-alkenyl undecyl trihydrosilane, 5-divinyl-2, 2-bipyridine/molybdenum complex, vinyl-1H-tetrazole, ethanol and Caster catalyst into the equipment, and preparing the 5, 5-divinyl-2, 2-bipyridine/molybdenum complex through 5, 5-divinyl-2, 2-bipyridine, molybdenum nitrate and ethanol.

title_en: Titanium and titanium alloy cutting tool coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a titanium and titanium alloy cutting tool coating and a preparation method thereof, comprising a coating matrix and a double-layer coating deposited on the matrix, the double-layer coating sequentially comprises a base layer and a functional layer from the side of the substrate to the surface side of the double-layer coating. The base layer is composed of a metal compound TiB  x , and the functional layer is composed of a metal compound TaSi  y . The titanium and titanium alloy cutting tool coating provided by the invention has higher wear resistance, high temperature resistance, oxidation resistance and anti-adhesion performance, and has good bonding strength between the coating and a matrix, simple production process and low production cost, and the cutting processing efficiency of titanium alloy can be effectively improved.

title_en: Film coating method of ZnS optical film and application of ZnS optical film in preparation of infrared detector chip
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of instrument engineering, in particular to a film coating method of a ZnS optical film and application of the ZnS optical film in preparing an infrared detector chip. According to the film coating method of the ZnS optical film, disclosed by the invention, after the substrate is cleaned by the high-energy ion source by controlling the screen electrode voltage of 650-700V, the evaporation-resistant film coating is carried out with the assistance of the high-ion source energy by controlling the screen electrode voltage of 700-900V, so that the ZnS optical film can be deposited on the wafer under the temperature condition of 110 ℃, the high-temperature resistance and the scratch-resistant property are realized, the film structure is simplified, the input cost of the optical film is reduced, the film coating method is suitable for plating the ZnS optical film on the wafer near 110 ℃, and the subsequent ZnS optical film needs to undergo the process flow of a high-temperature environment.

title_en: Thermal barrier coating surface modification method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of protective coatings, and particularly discloses a surface modification method of a thermal barrier coating, which comprises the following steps of sequentially forming an alloy layer and an aluminum layer on the surface of the thermal barrier coating to obtain the thermal barrier coating containing a modified coating; and carrying out heat treatment on the thermal barrier coating containing the modified coating, wherein the alloy layer contains aluminum and rare earth elements. According to the surface modification method of the thermal barrier coating, the rare earth element is introduced into the alloy layer, so that the in-situ reaction activity of the alloy layer and the surface of the thermal barrier coating is improved, a large number of Al  3  Zr intermediates with fine and uniform crystal grains are generated in the alloy layer, the interface energy caused by the in-situ reaction is reduced, complete cladding is formed on the surface of the thermal barrier coating, and the CMAS corrosion resistance of the coating is remarkably improved. In addition, the surface modification aspect of the invention is simple and easy to operate, and is suitable for mass popularization and application.

title_en: Y suitable for etching machine spare part2O3Preparation method of-BZO composite coating
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a Y  2 O 3  -BZO composite coating suitable for parts of an etching machine, which comprises the following steps of S1, cleaning a substrate, drying by blowing, and secondarily cleaning by a UV light cleaner, S2, placing the substrate in the step S1 in a magnetron sputtering coating machine, heating while vacuumizing, introducing argon after reaching background vacuum, pre-sputtering Y  2 O 3  and BZO targets, S3, opening a baffle after the pre-sputtering is finished, adjusting the cavity air pressure, starting formal sputtering, sputtering respectively sputtering Y  2 O 3  and BZO targets in an alternate sputtering mode to form a stacked composite coating, taking out the substrate after sputtering is finished, S4, carrying out vacuum annealing on the substrate in the step S3, and naturally cooling to obtain the Y  2 O 3  -BZO stacked composite coating. The composite coating is formed into a stacked composite coating in an alternate sputtering mode, has good etching resistance, can greatly prolong the service life of an etching machine, and reduces pollution to wafers.

title_en: Method for preparing acetic acid from CO
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for preparing acetic acid by CO. The cathode uses carbon monoxide (CO) as raw material, adopts electrolytic method to prepare acetate, and the anode is electrolyzed water for reaction. The electrolytically prepared acetate is further used for preparing pure acetic acid and KOH by bipolar membrane electrodialysis, the KOH is recycled, and the reaction hardly consumes KOH. The preparation method of the novel pure acetic acid is provided, only CO and water are consumed in the reaction process, and almost no other consumption is generated.

title_en: Preparation method of heterostructure medical bone implant based on additive manufacturing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a heterostructure medical bone implant based on additive manufacturing, which comprises the following steps of firstly preparing TC4 titanium alloy powder into a titanium alloy bracket with interconnection pores according to a proper printing strategy by utilizing a selective laser melting technology, secondly, placing the titanium alloy bracket into a chemical polishing solution for polishing, thirdly, taking the titanium alloy bracket after chemical polishing as a cathode, taking a pure iron sheet as an anode, immersing the pure iron sheet into an electroplating solution for electroplating, fourthly, casting zinc-based metal in a molten state into a square crucible with the titanium alloy-iron bracket, pressing a weight above, cooling and cutting, wherein after the formed titanium alloy-iron-zinc heterostructure medical bone implant is implanted into a human body, the zinc-based metal is gradually degraded along with the time, and meanwhile, the good biocompatibility of the surface forms new bone, so that the growth of cells is ensured, and the growth of bacteria is avoided.

title_en: Preparation method and application of one-step pyrolysis metal organic framework in-situ generation supported catalyst
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method and application of a one-step pyrolysis metal-organic framework in-situ generation supported catalyst. According to the method, MOFs precursors with regular morphology and uniform particle size distribution are synthesized by a prehydrolysis-hydrothermal method, and the supported noble metal catalyst based on the titanium oxide carrier is prepared in situ by impregnating and one-step pyrolysis of MOFs adsorption noble metal precursors. Wherein, the titanium oxide generated in situ by pyrolyzing Ti-based MOFs promotes the nucleation and growth of noble metal oxide on a titanium oxide carrier, and a uniform, compact and continuous noble metal oxide coating layer with the thickness of 5-30 nm is formed on the surface of the catalyst. The supported catalyst prepared by the method can obviously reduce the noble metal load in a proton exchange membrane electrolyzed water (PEMWE) anode catalytic layer, ensure electron transmission in the electrocatalytic reaction process, avoid deactivation of electric insulation of an active center caused by overlarge resistance of a catalytic layer and ensure the catalytic performance of the PEMWE anode.

title_en: Processing method of cerium-doped gadolinium aluminum gallium garnet wafer
abstract_en: The application provides a processing method of a cerium-doped gadolinium aluminum gallium garnet wafer, which comprises the following steps of (1) cutting the wafer into wafers, (2) laser drilling, wherein the drilling speed is 5-100 mm/s, the wafer is subjected to annealing treatment, the annealing treatment is carried out on the punched wafer, the temperature is raised to 1100-1400 ℃ at the heating rate of 10-40 ℃/h, the temperature is kept for 12-48 h, the temperature is reduced to room temperature at the cooling rate of 5-30 ℃/h, and (4) optical processing is carried out on the annealed wafer. The method for processing the cerium-doped gadolinium aluminum gallium garnet wafer can improve the processing yield of the wafer, and the processing yield of the wafer can reach more than 70%.

title_en: Porous oily polymer material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of lubrication, and provides a porous oil-containing polymer material, and a preparation method and application thereof. The porous oil-containing polymer material of the present invention comprises a porous polymer matrix, a solid lubricating film deposited on the porous polymer matrix, and a liquid lubricating oil stored in the pores of the porous polymer matrix deposited with the solid lubricating film. According to the invention, the solid lubricating film is deposited on the surface of the porous polymer matrix, and the liquid lubricating oil is adsorbed and stored, so that the solid-liquid cooperative lubrication is realized, and the porous oil-containing polymer material can still realize effective lubrication when the lubricating oil is not supplied enough and friction shearing action is carried out on the dual porous oil-containing polymer material, so that friction and abrasion are reduced. Meanwhile, the deposition of the solid lubricating film can not cause the blocking of the pore structure of the porous polymer matrix, can not influence the storage, release and suction of lubricating oil, and can obviously reduce the friction and abrasion of the polymer material of Kong Hanyou.

title_en: Aluminum-based ceramic hollow sphere sandwich structure for protecting space debris of spacecraft
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of spacecraft space debris protection, in particular to an aluminum-based ceramic hollow sphere sandwich structure for protecting spacecraft space debris. The aluminum-based ceramic hollow sphere sandwich structure provided by the invention can prevent the collision of aluminum spheres with the diameter of 3mm when being directly applied to a spacecraft load-bearing structure, has high space debris prevention capability, and has higher space debris prevention capability when being combined into a typical space debris prevention structure.

title_en: FeCoNiCuVZrAl target and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a FeCoNiCuVZrAl alloy target and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of metallurgy, comprising the following steps of S1, preparing alloy powder by gas atomization of alloy liquid; and S2, powder post-treatment, namely sieving and mixing alloy powder obtained by gas atomization to obtain mixed powder, S3, performing plasma sintering, namely pre-sintering the mixed powder obtained in the step S2 and then performing plasma sintering, and S4, machining, namely machining the blank processed in the step S3, and cleaning to obtain the FeCoNiCuVZrAl target material. The FeCoNiCuVZrAl alloy target material prepared by the method has high purity, high density, accurate component control and uniform and non-segregation structure.

title_en: Super twist spiral WS for second order nonlinear effect modulation2Crystal preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of photoelectric materials, and discloses a preparation method and application of a super-twisted spiral WS  2  crystal for second-order nonlinear effect modulation, comprising the following steps of placing WS  2  powder in a first porcelain boat, horizontally placing a substrate on a second porcelain boat, and placing deionized water in a third porcelain boat; the method comprises the steps of arranging a first porcelain boat in a middle heating area of a tube furnace, arranging a second porcelain boat on an air outlet side, arranging a third porcelain boat on an air inlet side, arranging a quartz glass cylinder between the first porcelain boat and the third porcelain boat, introducing carrier gas, heating to enable the heating temperature of the area where the first porcelain boat is located to be 1140-1160 ℃, continuously introducing the carrier gas, keeping the area where the first porcelain boat is located at a constant temperature, waiting for a carrier gas to carry an evaporated WS  2  source to send the carrier gas to a SiO  2  substrate sheet, and completing deposition to obtain the layered spiral WS  2  two-dimensional nanomaterial with a layered torsion angle. The second-order nonlinear magnetic susceptibility of the product obtained by the invention is large and adjustable, and can be widely applied to the optical field.

title_en: Laminate, packaging bag, and method for producing packaging bag
abstract_en: A laminate comprising at least a1 st resin layer and a2 nd resin layer, wherein the 1 st resin layer is provided so as to be peelable from the 2 nd resin layer, and the 1 st resin layer and the 2 nd resin layer have a peel strength of 1.0N/15mm or less, and the laminate satisfies the following condition (1) and/or (2). (1) The 2 nd resin layer is a sealant layer comprising at least a polyethylene layer having a density of 0.909g/cm  3  or less, the polyethylene layer in the 2 nd resin layer is in contact with the 1 st resin layer, and the 2 nd resin layer is a sealant layer containing polyolefin as a main component, wherein the content of polyolefin in the 2 nd resin layer is 82 mass% or more based on the mass of the 2 nd resin layer.

title_en: Intermittent battery steel shell machining barrel plating system and machining method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intermittent battery steel shell machining barrel plating system and a machining method, and belongs to the technical field of battery production equipment. The intermittent battery steel shell machining barrel plating system comprises an electroplating box, an electroplating roller, a feeding unit, a discharging unit, a blocking part and a lifting part, wherein the electroplating roller is obliquely arranged in the electroplating box, the feeding unit and the discharging unit are respectively arranged at two ends of the electroplating roller and higher than the discharging unit, driving parts are arranged on the feeding unit and the discharging unit and are connected with the electroplating roller, the blocking part is arranged on the discharging unit, and when a battery steel shell is electroplated in the electroplating roller, the blocking part closes a feeding hole of the discharging unit.

title_en: Production method of multifunctional low-static nylon membrane
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production method of a multifunctional low-static nylon membrane, which comprises a functional layer, an upper surface layer, a base layer and a lower surface layer which are distributed from top to bottom, wherein the functional layer is polyimide containing carborane units, the upper surface layer comprises PA66, diethyl aluminum hypophosphite, halloysite nanotubes and an antioxidant, the base layer comprises PA66 and an antistatic agent, and the lower surface layer comprises PA6 and organic quaternary phosphonium salt intercalation modified magadiite. The upper surface layer can play a role in synergistic flame retardation by adding a small amount of halloysite nanotubes into the PA 66/diethyl aluminum hypophosphite flame retardation system, the halloysite nanotubes play a role in slowing down degradation and promoting char formation, the diethyl aluminum hypophosphite-halloysite nanotube compound system can form a continuous compact carbon layer in combustion, a good barrier effect is achieved, diethyl aluminum hypophosphite has a gas phase and a condensed phase for flame retardation, and the introduction of the halloysite nanotubes can interact with ADP in the condensed phase to promote crosslinking char formation.

title_en: Phase-change double-layer composite film for thermal management and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a phase-change double-layer composite film for thermal management and a preparation method thereof, comprising the following steps that firstly, a proper amount of high-heat-conductivity material is added in the preparation process of hydrogel to obtain a mixed solution of the high-heat-conductivity material and hydrogel raw materials, and the mixed solution is dried to prepare a hydrogel substrate film containing the high-heat-conductivity material; step two, preparing a mixed solution of the high heat conduction material and the hydrogel raw material according to the method of the step two, adding the organic phase change material to obtain a mixed solution of the hydrogel/the organic phase change material/the high heat conduction material, and pouring the mixed solution obtained in the step two on the hydrogel substrate film prepared in the step one, and putting the hydrogel substrate film into a baking oven to dry to obtain the double-layer composite heat conduction film of the hydrogel/the organic phase change material/the high heat conduction material. The phase-change double-layer composite film prepared by the invention can effectively prevent the leakage of the phase-change material and improve the heat conductivity of the phase-change material, and is used for the heat management of electronic devices.

title_en: Ni-W bimetallic catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a Ni-W bimetallic catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of firstly, dissolving soluble nickel salt, soluble tungsten salt, urea and ammonium fluoride in water to form a precursor solution; secondly, taking carbon paper as a carrier, immersing the carbon paper into the precursor solution obtained in the first step, and carrying out hydrothermal reaction to enable the catalyst to grow on the carbon paper, thirdly, carrying out heat treatment on the catalyst-loaded carbon paper obtained in the second step under the nitrogen atmosphere to prepare the Ni-W bimetallic catalyst. The Ni-W bimetallic catalyst prepared by the method has the characteristics that the appearance of nanoflower is presented, more reactive sites are exposed, the adsorption effect on 5-hydroxymethylfurfural can be enhanced on the surface of the Ni-W bimetallic catalyst co-modified by single-atom tungsten and metal defects, the formation of more active sites is induced by a bulk phase consisting of Ni-W solid solution, the overall catalytic activity is greatly improved, and the high HMF conversion rate, the high 2, 5-furandicarboxylic acid yield and the high Faraday efficiency are realized.

title_en: Coating oven device and battery production system
abstract_en: The application provides a coating oven device and a battery production system, wherein the coating oven device comprises a box body, an infrared component and a cooling component, at least part of the infrared component is arranged in the box body, the cooling component comprises an air inlet pipeline and an air outlet pipeline, the air inlet pipeline and the air outlet pipeline are communicated with the interior of the infrared component, the box body is provided with a pole piece inlet and a pole piece outlet which are opposite, at least one of the pole piece inlet and the pole piece outlet is provided with a negative pressure cavity, and a first air outlet branch of the air outlet pipeline is communicated with the negative pressure cavity. By the mode, the risk that cold air sucked by the negative pressure cavity is mixed with high-temperature solvent (such as NMP) gas entering the negative pressure cavity from the pole piece inlet or the pole piece outlet to form condensate is reduced, and then the condensate (such as NMP) at the pole piece inlet or the pole piece outlet is reduced.

title_en: Deep sea pressure-resistant shell protective coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coating, and discloses a deep sea pressure-resistant shell protective coating and a preparation method thereof, wherein the protective coating comprises the following steps of treating a base material, sequentially adding epoxy resin modified polyurethane, reinforcing filler, anti-corrosion filler, curing agent and solvent in a preset proportion, uniformly mixing to prepare a primer, and spraying the primer on the base material; and then taking the isoxazole modified polyurea as a finish paint, and spraying the finish paint on one side of the primer, which is far away from the base material, to obtain the protective coating. The protective coating has excellent waterproof performance, impact resistance, abrasion resistance and biological adhesion preventing capability, and can effectively prevent water, various corrosion factors such as ions in seawater and various fouling organisms such as barnacles, mussels, oyster, sponge and the like in seawater from contacting the surface of a substrate.

title_en: Automatic gluing and pressing equipment for steel door processing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of steel door production, and discloses automatic gluing and pressing equipment for steel door processing, the bracket comprises a base, a bracket arranged on the base, a steel plate arranged on the bracket, vertical plates which are connected to the base in a sliding manner and are positioned on the front side and the rear side of the steel plate, and a top plate connected with the two vertical plates. The invention has the advantages that the half gear outside the rotating shaft is meshed with the rack plate on the base, so that the mounting frame rotates between the two vertical plates at the movable gluing component, at the moment, the glue outlet of the gluing component rotates to the side face from the bottom, the original right side of the mounting frame rotates to the bottom, then the other steel plate is placed above the steel plate coated with glue, the driving component is continuously started to drive the mounting frame on the inner side of the vertical plate to move left, the two steel plates are pressed, the gluing and pressing functions are integrated on one device, the automatic switching of the gluing and pressing functions can be realized, and the operation is more convenient while the resources are saved.

title_en: Preparation device and process for anti-fatigue metal composite material
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of composite material preparation, and discloses an anti-fatigue metal composite material preparation device and a process thereof, wherein the anti-fatigue metal composite material preparation device comprises a frame, a coaxial cladding head which moves forwards and backwards is arranged above the frame, the upper surface of the frame is vertically and symmetrically provided with two brackets, a driving mechanism is arranged between the two brackets and used for driving the coaxial cladding head to move, and a group of spray holes used for spraying cladding materials are circumferentially and equidistantly arranged on the bottom end surface of the coaxial cladding head. According to the invention, through the cooperation design of the driving mechanism, the coaxial cladding head, the spray holes and the recycling mechanism, the recycling of part of the scattered cladding materials is realized, the resource waste is reduced, the resource utilization rate is improved, the practicability of the device is improved, and the problems that a large amount of the scattered cladding materials are inconvenient to recycle, the resource is inconvenient to save and the waste of the cladding materials is inconvenient to reduce in the prior art are avoided.

title_en: Preparation method of multilayer aerogel felt and gluing device thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a multilayer aerogel felt and a gluing device thereof, comprising the following steps of S1 adding hot melt glue solution into a gluing device, wherein the gluing device comprises a glue spreading roller and a glue groove, the glue groove is used for Cheng Fangre melt glue solution, the glue spreading roller is partially immersed in the glue groove, S2 unreeling a first felt body through a first feeding mechanism, passing the first felt body through a gap between a glue amount adjusting component and the glue spreading component, and rolling the first felt body through the glue spreading roller to prepare a precoated felt, S3 attaching the precoated felt prepared in the step S2 with a second felt body conveyed by a second feeding mechanism to prepare a composite felt, S4 cooling and solidifying the composite felt in the step S3 to obtain the composite felt, cooling the composite felt at normal temperature, so that the hot melt glue between the first felt body and the second felt body is condensed and solidified, and the composite felt is not required to be solidified through heating the aerogel felt, thereby avoiding heat damage to the composite felt and ensuring the composite felt to have better heat insulation performance.

title_en: Preparation method of tellurium nanowire and tellurium nanowire
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of tellurium nanowires and tellurium nanowires, and relates to the technical field of semiconductors. The preparation method comprises the steps of S1 providing a clean substrate, S2 introducing the substrate in the step S1 into a molecular beam epitaxy MBE pretreatment chamber for degassing treatment, S3 introducing the substrate in the step S2 into a molecular beam epitaxy MBE growth chamber for deoxidization treatment, S4 cooling the substrate in the step S3 to a growth temperature, S5 adjusting tellurium source beam current to a growth value, and growing tellurium nanowires on the substrate in the step S4, wherein the steps S3-S5 are completed under high-energy electron diffraction monitoring, the substrates in the steps S3-S5 are in a rotating state, and the steps S1-S5 are carried out in a vacuum environment. The preparation method provided by the invention can realize the preparation of the tellurium nanowire array with large area, high purity and uniform molding.

title_en: Method for preparing vanadium dioxide flexible intelligent thermal control device by heat treatment of vanadium nitride
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for preparing a vanadium dioxide flexible intelligent thermal control device by heat treatment of vanadium nitride. The preparation method comprises the steps of sputtering a vanadium nitride film on the surface of a substrate made of a polymer film, a silicon wafer and the like by adopting magnetron sputtering and low-temperature heat treatment oxidation, transferring the vanadium nitride film into a low-pressure oxygen-containing atmosphere cavity for heating oxidation treatment, and converting the vanadium nitride film into a vanadium dioxide film to form the intelligent heat control device. The method disclosed by the invention has the advantages that the temperature adopted by the whole period of preparation of the intelligent thermal control device is not higher than 400 ℃, so that the method can prepare vanadium dioxide on the surface of the polymer substrate, and the heat treatment condition for converting vanadium nitride into vanadium dioxide is simple and easy to control. The method is suitable for preparing the flexible intelligent thermal control device of the vanadium dioxide.

title_en: Chemical vapor infiltration reactor
abstract_en: The invention provides a chemical vapor infiltration reactor, which comprises a vertical shell, wherein a reaction cavity is arranged in the shell, two or more input interfaces are arranged at the bottom of the shell and are communicated with the reaction cavity, a feed inlet and an exhaust outlet are arranged at the top of the shell, a heating zone for heating the reaction cavity is arranged outside the shell, the heating zone at least comprises a group of a plurality of heating devices for independently setting heating temperatures and a group of a plurality of heating devices for synchronously setting heating temperatures, the plurality of heating devices for independently setting the heating temperatures and the plurality of heating devices for synchronously setting the heating temperatures heat the reaction cavity at different heights of the shell, and upward air flows are formed in the reaction cavity by the input interfaces so as to balance particle gravity input by the feed inlet, so that particles are suspended.

title_en: Cooling water-free electrolytic hydrogen production system and control method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses an electrolytic hydrogen production system without cooling water and a control method thereof, and relates to the technical field of hydrogen energy. The cooling water-free electrolytic hydrogen production system comprises an electrolytic tank, a post-processing module and a power supply device, wherein the post-processing module is connected with the electrolytic tank, the electrolytic tank is used for producing hydrogen and oxygen through electrochemical reaction and outputting the hydrogen and the oxygen, the post-processing module comprises a gas-liquid separation unit, a gas washing unit and a gas filtering unit which are sequentially connected, the post-processing module is used for processing the hydrogen and the oxygen output by the electrolytic tank and outputting the hydrogen and the oxygen which meet the regulations, and the power supply device is used for providing electric energy for the electrolytic tank, wherein the heat consumed by the electrolytic tank and the post-processing module under the condition of no cooling water is the same as the total heat. Therefore, the method realizes the hydrogen production by the water electrolysis without cooling, effectively reduces energy consumption, reduces water resource waste, and improves the applicability and economic benefit of the hydrogen production system by the water electrolysis.

title_en: Preparation method of oxygen-free high-purity compact superfine crystal copper target material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an oxygen-free high-purity superfine crystal copper target blank, which comprises the steps of refining pure copper to obtain a copper melt, continuously casting the copper melt into a copper rod, sequentially carrying out secondary continuous extrusion on the copper rod to obtain a copper plate blank, sequentially carrying out reversing cold rolling and primary annealing treatment on the copper plate blank to obtain an annealing blank, and carrying out low-temperature rolling and secondary annealing treatment on the annealing blank to obtain the oxygen-free high-purity compact superfine crystal copper target material. The invention has the advantages of simple process and short flow, and the oxygen-free high-purity compact superfine crystal copper target material has the advantages of low oxygen, fine crystal, high plasticity, high hardness, easy welding, high conductivity and the like, and can be used for manufacturing various semiconductor targets.

title_en: Photovoltaic hydrogen production power supply with energy storage and current transformation capabilities
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic hydrogen production power supply with energy storage and conversion capability, which relates to the technical field of hydrogen production, wherein a first input end of the photovoltaic hydrogen production power supply is connected with a photovoltaic power generation system, a second input end of the photovoltaic hydrogen production power supply is connected with an energy storage module, an output end of the photovoltaic hydrogen production power supply is connected with an electrolytic tank, the photovoltaic power generation system supplies power to the electrolytic tank through the photovoltaic hydrogen production power supply, when an input voltage U  in  of the photovoltaic power generation system is larger than a preset voltage U  ref  and the energy storage capacity of the energy storage module is not full, the photovoltaic hydrogen production power supply controls the photovoltaic power generation system to charge the energy storage module so as to absorb surplus power of the photovoltaic power generation system, and when the energy storage module has the energy storage capacity, the photovoltaic hydrogen production power supply controls the energy storage module to supply power for the electrolytic tank. The photovoltaic hydrogen production power supply realizes energy cross-time allocation through energy storage and conversion, and improves the utilization rate of photovoltaic energy.

title_en: OER core-shell catalyst, preparation method and electrochemical device thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an OER core-shell catalyst, a preparation method and an electrochemical device thereof. The OER catalyst comprises a crystalline/amorphous Pt@RuIrO  x  ultrafine nanowire. According to the preparation method, the PtRuIr superfine nanowire with the surface rich in the aerophilic Ru or Ir elements is prepared by adopting a two-step liquid-phase direct reduction method, and the c/a-Pt@RuIrO  x  NWs with the surface containing an amorphous active shell layer is successfully prepared by combining with an in-situ oxidation induced amorphization strategy and optimizing components and reaction conditions, so that excellent OER catalytic activity and stability are shown. The electrochemical device assembled by the OER catalyst breaks through the limitation of low stability of the amorphous oxide material in OER electrocatalysis, opens up a new way for practical application of the low-dimensional amorphous nano material in the field of electrocatalysis, and shows remarkable advancement and innovation.

title_en: Solar cell back passivation film and preparation method thereof, solar cell and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a solar cell back passivation film and a preparation method thereof, and a solar cell and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method of the back passivation film comprises the steps of carrying out first film plating on the back surface of a silicon wafer by adopting a PECVD method, sequentially depositing an aluminum oxide film and a first silicon nitride film, carrying out second film plating on the surface of the first silicon nitride film by adopting the PECVD method, and depositing a second silicon nitride film to obtain the back passivation film, wherein the step of carrying out first film plating mainly comprises the steps of pre-ventilation by adopting protective gas and trimethylaluminum gas, depositing the aluminum oxide film by adopting an oxygen-containing precursor and trimethylaluminum gas, and depositing the first silicon nitride film, wherein the trimethylaluminum gas is obtained by converting liquid trimethylaluminum by adopting an evaporator, the temperature of the evaporator is 60-120 ℃, and the flow rate of the liquid trimethylaluminum when the liquid trimethylaluminum is introduced into the evaporator is 40-70 mg/min. The solar cell obtained by the preparation method can effectively reduce the local pollution of the EL and has high conversion efficiency.

title_en: LED lamp bead surface gluing method and gluing device
abstract_en: A glue spreading method and a glue spreading device for the surface of an LED lamp bead are provided, wherein S1 of the glue spreading method is used for preparing a preset number of openings in a screen plate, the size of the openings is the same as that of the LED lamp beads, S2 is used for placing an LED display module with the preset number of LED lamp beads on an operation table and positioning the LED lamp beads on the LED display module through a fixing clamp, the LED lamp beads on the LED display module correspond to the openings in the screen plate, S3 is used for enabling the screen plate and the LED lamp beads to keep a preset distance, S4 is used for pouring glue into one end of the screen plate, preset pressure is applied to a scraping plate, and therefore the scraping plate scrapes the glue on the screen plate into the openings, and the glue is further coated on the surface of the LED lamp beads. The invention has the advantages of reducing the equipment cost, simplifying the operation and improving the gluing efficiency.

title_en: Self-supporting molybdenum nitride/nickel sulfide composite catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-supporting molybdenum nitride/nickel sulfide composite catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the steps of arranging carbon in a mixed solution containing Mo salt and thiourea by a solvothermal method, carrying out solvothermal treatment to obtain self-supporting MoS  2  nano sheets growing on carbon cloth, then immersing the self-supporting MoS  2  nano sheets in a nickel acetate solution to form a MoS  2  precursor with Ni ions intercalated, drying, and nitriding in an ammonia atmosphere to obtain the two-dimensional Mo  5 N 6 /Ni 3 S 2  self-supporting composite catalyst growing on the carbon cloth. The in-situ coupling interface obviously enhances the interface electronic structure effect, thereby optimizing the adsorption and desorption of adsorbed hydrogen, obtaining enhanced hydrogen evolution dynamics, simultaneously being beneficial to exposing a large number of catalytic active sites by the self-supporting two-dimensional nano-sheet structure, further obtaining excellent hydrogen evolution performance, and the related preparation method is simpler, convenient to operate and suitable for popularization and application.

title_en: Enhancement layer for proton exchange membrane, proton exchange membrane containing enhancement layer and preparation method of enhancement layer
abstract_en: The invention provides a proton exchange membrane, which comprises a reinforcing layer, a dense reinforcing layer and a sparse and dense reinforcing layer. The enhancement layer is provided with a catalytic material and can be manufactured by electrostatic spinning or 3D printing, wherein the dense enhancement layer can effectively prevent puncture influence of anode titanium felt due to low porosity, and the enhancement layer can reduce hydrogen permeation and produce an enhancement effect on proton transportation due to pore structure and catalytic material distribution of the enhancement layer.

title_en: Single crystal resistivity control equipment for furnace cover doping
abstract_en: The invention relates to single crystal resistivity control equipment for furnace cover doping, which is structurally characterized in that the upper part of a furnace cover doping module is fixed on a frame, the bottom end of the furnace cover doping module is connected with a bottom sealing component positioned on a furnace cover, the moving end of the furnace cover doping module is connected with a top sealing component through a lifting carrier plate, a guide component is arranged between the upper part and the bottom end of the furnace cover doping module, the top sealing component is connected with the guide component in a sliding manner, the top sealing component is also connected with a drag chain, the drag chain is connected with the frame through a drag chain fixed sheet metal, the upper part of a seed chuck extension rod is sealed in the top sealing component and the bottom sealing component, the bottom end of the seed chuck extension rod extends to the lower part of the furnace cover and is connected with a seed chuck component, and the seed chuck component clamps a master alloy rod. The invention has the advantages that the stroke and the tightness of the master alloy rod in the doping process can be effectively controlled, the clamping stability is ensured, the master alloy rod can be regularly lowered into silicon liquid and melted, and the resistivity of the crystal rod is controlled by controlling the lowering distance and further controlling the melting weight.

title_en: Crystal inlaid floor and production process thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of home decoration materials, and relates to a crystal mosaic floor which comprises a wood floor blank, a mirror panel and an epoxy resin layer from bottom to top, wherein the upper surface and the lower surface of the mirror panel are respectively provided with an adhesive layer so as to fix all parts, the adhesive layer is quick-drying epoxy resin crystal glue, and crystal particles are mosaic in the adhesive layer positioned on the upper surface of the mirror panel. The invention also discloses a production process of the crystal inlaid floor. The invention uses the numerical control engraving machine to solve the problems of edge breakage, burrs and the like of the wood floor blank in the engraving process, reduces the labor cost, improves the refraction effect of crystal particles by the material of the mirror panel, makes the crystal particles flash more, effectively improves the wear resistance of the floor by the acrylic resin layer coated on the upper surface, makes the surface smoother and brighter, evenly spreads the surface of the coating by adding the flatting agent defoamer, and can eliminate bubbles generated on the surface of the coating.

title_en: Full-automatic self-adhesive label production and detection equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses full-automatic self-adhesive label production detection equipment, which relates to the technical field of label production detection and comprises a circulation box, an upper bin and an extension assembly, wherein the upper bin is fixedly arranged on the front surface of the outer wall of the circulation box, the back surface of the outer wall of the circulation box is fixedly provided with a return bin, the side surface of the inner wall of the upper bin is fixedly provided with a rotating shaft, a substrate paper roll is fixedly sleeved on the rotating shaft, cleaning cotton is fixedly arranged at the top and the bottom of the inner wall of the upper bin, and the extension assembly is fixedly arranged on the side surface of the inner wall of the circulation box. According to the invention, the extending assembly is arranged, so that the extending and spreading function of the label base material paper is realized, the conveying function is realized, the problem that the warping of the base material paper influences the label code spraying effect is solved, and the label code spraying efficiency and the label code spraying effect are improved.

title_en: Composite board, rail transit floor and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a composite board, a rail transit floor and a preparation method thereof, wherein the composite board comprises a core layer, at least one layer of honeycomb structure, thermoplastic foam and surface layers, wherein the honeycomb structure is made of thermoplastic resin, the thermoplastic foam is filled in the honeycomb structure, the surface layers are positioned on two opposite sides of the core layer and are adhered and fixed with the core layer, and the surface layers are made of metal. The composite board adopting the embodiment of the disclosure has good mechanical property and lighter weight, and has strong bonding force between interfaces, difficult layering and long service life.

title_en: High-strength metal plate and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-strength metal plate, which relates to the technical field of plate processing and comprises an upper plate layer, a transition layer, a reinforcing core, a protective layer and a lower plate layer, wherein the lower surface of the upper plate layer is fixedly connected with the upper surface of the transition layer, the lower surface of the transition layer is fixedly connected with the reinforcing core, the protective layer and the upper surface of the lower plate layer, the reinforcing core is fixedly connected with the protective layer, and the reinforcing core and the protective layer are both positioned in the lower plate layer. The invention also discloses a manufacturing method of the high-strength metal plate. The invention forms a multi-element strengthening system by collocating high-strength steel, dual-phase steel, various alloy elements, ceramic particles, carbon fibers and zinc, and has the advantages of synergistic performance of different materials, improvement of various properties of the plate, high strength, good toughness, abrasion resistance, corrosion resistance, universality and customizability, adjustment as required, protection of an external coating purification film, and guarantee of product quality through strength detection.

title_en: Fiber-reinforced resin material for vehicle body
abstract_en: A fiber-reinforced resin material (M) for a vehicle body is provided with a plurality of first reinforcing fiber layers (1) formed from undeveloped reinforcing fiber bundles, a second reinforcing fiber layer group (2) formed by continuously layering a plurality of second reinforcing fiber layers (2 a) formed from fiber-extended reinforcing fiber bundles, and a matrix resin which wets the first reinforcing fiber layers (1) and the second reinforcing fiber layers (2 a) and is reinforced by the first reinforcing fiber layers (1) and the second reinforcing fiber layers (2 a). When a load is generated in the in-plane direction by an external force (F) that bends the fiber-reinforced resin material (M) and a compressive force or a tensile force acts on the fiber-reinforced resin material (M), the region on the inside of the bend is defined as a compression-side region (CR) on which compressive stress acts and the region on the outside of the bend is defined as a tension-side region (TR) on which tensile stress acts with respect to the Center Plane (CP) of the thickness of the fiber-reinforced resin material (M). The second reinforcing fiber layer group (2) is disposed in the stretching-side region (TR).

title_en: Method for producing a coated object and coated object
abstract_en: A method for producing a coated object (10), wherein the method comprises the steps of providing a substrate (12) in a reaction chamber and depositing an anti-wear layer (16) on a surface (14) of the substrate (12) by physical vapor deposition, wherein a target is provided in the reaction chamber, the target containing at least a first transition metal Ma to produce a Ma  2  C phase in the anti-wear layer, the first transition metal being a transition metal from group v or group v of the periodic table, and wherein the proportion of Ma in the Ma  2  C phase in the anti-wear layer (16) is at least 60 atomic%, based on the total amount of transition metal in the anti-wear layer (16). Furthermore, a coated object (10) is indicated.

title_en: Food-grade high-barrier packaging bag and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of plastic products, in particular to a food-grade high-barrier packaging bag and a preparation method thereof, wherein the packaging bag sequentially comprises a barrier layer, a heat sealing layer and a reinforcing layer from inside to outside, and raw materials of the barrier layer, the heat sealing layer and the reinforcing layer are respectively added into three hoppers of a three-layer co-extruder for co-extrusion casting. By adjusting the interlayer structure, the invention realizes high-efficiency barrier to oxygen and water vapor on the premise of not obviously increasing the cost, provides a longer-acting fresh-keeping solution for prefabricated food, meat, baked food and the like, and has important practical application value.

title_en: Porous phonon crystal sandwich plate for inhibiting flutter and design method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a porous phonon crystal sandwich plate for inhibiting flutter and a design method thereof, belonging to the technical field of spacecraft structure vibration inhibition. The porous phonon crystal sandwich plate consists of a matrix sandwich plate and periodically embedded local resonance units, wherein the matrix sandwich plate consists of an upper aluminum skin, a lower aluminum skin and an aluminum honeycomb core layer, the local resonance units consist of an upper cladding layer, a lower cladding layer and a scatterer, and the local resonance units and the matrix sandwich plate form phonon crystals in a form of filling the honeycomb core. The invention adopts light flexible material to reduce the mass of the phonon crystal sandwich plate, and the local resonance unit is embedded into the honeycomb core layer without occupying extra cabin space, thus being applicable to the flutter inhibition of communication satellites. By designing a hole structure with a specific shape on the coating layer and the scattering body, the equivalent rigidity and mass distribution are regulated and controlled, the band gap range is optimized, and the inhibition performance of the sandwich plate on satellite flutter is remarkably improved by utilizing the band gap characteristics of the local resonance type phonon crystal.

title_en: Packaging material for battery
abstract_en: By using a specific lubricant in the heat-fusible resin layer of the battery packaging material, the slidability at the time of molding is improved, and deterioration of battery performance is suppressed. A packaging material for a battery 1 comprising, in order from the outside to the inside, at least a base material layer 13, a barrier layer 11, and a heat-fusible resin layer 15, wherein the heat-fusible resin layer 15 comprises a polyolefin resin and 1 or more kinds of lubricants, and at least 1 kind of lubricant is an N-substituted amide represented by the following formula (I). R1 is a hydrocarbon chain represented by C  m1 H n1 , and R2 is a hydrocarbon chain represented by C  m2 H n2 . [ chemical formula 4]

title_en: Rotary glue coating valve and glue coating equipment
abstract_en: The rotary glue coating valve comprises a valve body, a rotary sealing assembly and a sealing structure, wherein the valve body is provided with a plurality of valve body sealing surfaces with diameters reduced in sequence along a glue outlet direction, a valve core axis is provided with a first channel for glue outlet, the diameters of the valve core along the glue outlet direction are increased in sequence and the valve core comprises a first shaft section and a second shaft section, the rotary sealing assembly comprises a ring-shaped supporting body fixedly arranged on the valve body and a plurality of sealing ring groups corresponding to the valve body sealing surfaces one by one, one sealing ring group comprises a first sealing ring arranged on an inner ring of the supporting body and a second sealing ring arranged on an outer ring of the supporting body and in sealing connection with the valve body sealing surfaces, one first sealing ring in two adjacent sealing ring groups is in sealing connection with the first shaft section, a first buffer cavity is formed after the other first sealing ring is in sealing connection with the second shaft section, a first inlet communicated with the first channel is formed in the side wall of the first shaft section corresponding to the first buffer cavity, and a first glue inlet hole is formed in the valve body sealing surface with larger diameter corresponding to the first buffer cavity.

title_en: Flowable ceramic powder, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: According to the flowable ceramic powder, the oxide or the composite oxide is used as raw material powder, the ignition material is added into the raw material powder to form first powder, the first powder is placed in an induction smelting furnace to be heated and melted in an induction mode at the heating power of 60-150 kW, after the first powder is completely melted, an induction coil is moved at the speed of 30-100 mm/h to lift and crystallize a melt to homogenize the melt, ceramic crystals are obtained, the object ceramic powder with flowability is obtained through crushing and pulverization treatment, the obtained object ceramic powder has high compactness and is close to the theoretical density, the object ceramic powder is used as a spraying raw material, a thermal barrier coating with vertical longitudinal cracks can be prepared through a thermal spraying method, and the CMAS corrosion resistance of the coating is excellent.

title_en: Tyre with improved heat radiation performance
abstract_en: The invention provides a tire with improved heat dissipation performance, which relates to the technical field of tire rubber manufacturing methods, and comprises tread rubber, cushion rubber, triangular rubber and airtight layer rubber, wherein the tire comprises a rubber matrix, carbon black, an activating agent, a vulcanizing agent and iron powder; the airtight layer adhesive also comprises chlorosulfonated polyethylene rubber, nano clay, tackifying resin, plasticizer and a homogenizing agent. The invention solves the technical problems of poor heat dissipation performance and high temperature of the tire manufactured by the prior rubber composition in the prior art, and achieves the technical effect of rapidly radiating heat in the running process.

title_en: PI film composite microstructure and method for enhancing binding force with metal film
abstract_en: The invention relates to a PI film composite microstructure and a method for enhancing the binding force with a metal film, wherein the PI film composite microstructure is formed by compositing a nano lattice structure and a micro columnar structure formed on the PI film, the nano lattice structure is a square lattice array, the center of each lattice unit is provided with one micro columnar structure, the ratio of the column height to the diameter is controlled to be 1:1-2.5:1, and the method for enhancing the binding force between the PI film and the metal film is provided. In the method, the PI film composite microstructure is formed on the surface of the PI film. The invention can effectively improve the binding force between the PI film and the metal film, so that the metal film can be stably deposited on the complex surface, and the high requirements of the fields of high-performance electronic devices, frequency selective surfaces and the like on the material performance are met.

title_en: Coating device and coating method
abstract_en: A coating device (1A) for atomizing a coating material having a resistivity of 20MΩ & cm or less by the action of an electric field, wherein the coating device (1A) is provided with a nozzle (21) to which a voltage is applied, a flow path (23) through which the coating material flows, a measuring unit (42) for measuring the supplied current, and a control unit (5) for controlling the voltage applied to the nozzle (21) based on the measured value by the measuring unit.

title_en: Sealing coating, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sealing coating, a preparation method and application thereof. The sealing coating is adhered to an alloy substrate, the sealing coating comprises a metal bonding layer and a composite structure ceramic layer which are sequentially deposited on the alloy substrate, the composite structure ceramic layer comprises a columnar structure and particles filled in gaps of the columnar structure, the components of the columnar structure and the particles filled in the gaps of the columnar structure respectively and independently comprise one or more of YSZ and rare earth zirconate, and the porosity of the composite structure ceramic layer is 22% -40%. The provided sealing coating has higher porosity, lower surface Rockwell hardness and higher friction coefficient, which means that the provided sealing coating has more excellent wear resistance. The preparation method of the sealing coating adopts a plasma physical vapor deposition technology, and the process flow is simple.

title_en: Skin-adhered mobile phone shell and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a skinning mobile phone shell which comprises a supporting layer, an adhesive layer and a skinning layer which are sequentially and tightly bonded, wherein the skinning layer comprises a base cloth layer, a polyolefin substrate layer and a surface coating, the polyolefin substrate layer comprises 15-40 parts by weight of ethylene copolymer elastomer, 15-40 parts by weight of ethylene propylene diene monomer rubber and 20-70 parts by weight of filler, and the sum of the parts by weight of the ethylene copolymer elastomer, the ethylene propylene diene monomer rubber and the filler is 100 parts. The skinning mobile phone shell provided by the invention has the advantages of good mechanical, wear-resistant, heat-resistant, waterproof, shockproof, style diversity and the like, and is simple in process and low in cost.

title_en: Iridium-based catalyst with high surface area and high porosity and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: Iridium-based catalysts and methods of preparing the catalysts are described. The catalyst comprises a catalyst material comprising particles comprising iridium or a mixture of iridium and iridium oxide. The particles comprise an interconnected network of nanoparticles. The particles are in the range of 50nm to 1 μm and the nanoparticles are in the range of 2nm to 15 nm. It may have a BET surface area of 30m  2 /g or greater and a pore volume of at least 0.10 cc/g. The catalyst is prepared using an organic structure directing agent.

title_en: Gold nano pumpkin array, SERS sensor for detecting gastric precancerous lesion biomarker, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological detection, and particularly relates to a gold nano pumpkin array, a SERS sensor related to a gastric cancer precursor lesion biomarker, a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the gold nano pumpkin array (Au NPAs) comprises the steps of obtaining a PS single-layer template through a gas-liquid interface self-assembly technology, and sequentially carrying out plasma etching technology treatment, annealing treatment and ion sputtering treatment on the PS single-layer template to obtain the gold nano pumpkin array (Au NPAs). The SERS sensor and the SERS microarray chip constructed based on the gold nano pumpkin array show excellent chemical stability, high molecular specificity and excellent repeatability, realize ultra-trace detection of gastric cancer precursor biomarkers miR-196b and miR-221, and provide technical support for early detection, timely intervention and treatment of GC.

title_en: Efficient wide-temperature plate-type denitration catalyst, preparation device and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-efficiency wide-temperature plate-type denitration catalyst, a preparation device and application thereof, and in particular relates to a plate-type denitration catalyst. When the smoke passes along the single plates, a part of the smoke flows along the wavy parts, and passes through the vertical surfaces at two sides of the wavy parts, the smoke passes through the perforations to reach the hollow layer due to the inertia of the airflow flow direction, and the other part of the smoke enters along the hollow layer and is discharged from the perforations along with the inertia of the flow of the wavy parts, and enters between the two single plates, and when the smoke flows faster, the smoke discharged from the perforations and the smoke entering the perforations are more, the smoke is impacted and decelerated in a crossing way, so that the smoke is slowed down, the contact between the smoke and the hollow layer and the carrier layer on the surface of the single plates is increased, repeated reactions are carried out, and the capability of reducing the smoke is increased along with the increase of the smoke.

title_en: Double-material sliding block die
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dual-material sliding block mold, which relates to the technical field of molds and comprises a lower mold, an upper mold, a sliding block mechanism, a pouring pipe, a control mechanism, a mounting rod and a detection mechanism, wherein the upper mold is arranged at the top of the lower mold, the sliding block mechanism is connected in a sliding manner in the upper mold, the pouring pipe is fixedly connected to the front end and the rear end of the top of the upper mold, the left end of the pouring pipe is fixedly connected with a pressure sensor, a temperature sensor and a flow sensor, the control mechanism is fixedly connected to the lower part of the outer wall of the pouring pipe, the sliding block mechanism is arranged, the second knocking block drives the first knocking block to knock the bottom of a sliding block body, micro vibration is applied to the dual-material bonding surface, vibration is matched with a material melting state, molecular diffusion is promoted, meanwhile, the melt wettability of a dual-material interface is improved, and a compensation mechanism is arranged to improve mold closing precision and prevent melt leakage and air gap formation through a memory alloy compensation gap.

title_en: Paper with good stiffness and texture and manufacturing process thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides paper with good stiffness and texture and a manufacturing process thereof, comprising a surface layer, a core layer and a bottom layer, the surface layer is formed by compounding hardwood pulp and nanocellulose, the core layer is formed by high-yield pulp, and the bottom layer is formed by softwood pulp. The invention sets the paper into three layers, and improves the surface texture, stiffness and strength of the paper under the condition of not greatly improving the gram weight of the paper. The paper manufacturing process provided by the invention can enable adjacent fibers to form interlocking, improve the binding force of the fibers, improve the strength and the stiffness, eliminate the flocculation of the fibers and improve the smoothness of the paper.

title_en: Performance test method of two-dimensional GeSe film and preparation method of two-dimensional GeSe film
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a performance test method of a two-dimensional GeSe film and a preparation method of the two-dimensional GeSe film, and belongs to the technical field of photoelectric materials. The method comprises the steps of preparing two-dimensional GeSe films on different types of substrates by adopting a physical vapor deposition method, preparing electrodes on the two-dimensional GeSe films to construct samples to be tested, testing pre-constructed standardized indexes on each sample to be tested, and determining performance test results corresponding to the different types of substrates on the basis of the pre-constructed standardized indexes, wherein the standardized indexes can comprise composition and structure characterization, photoelectric response parameters, first principle calculation results and the like. According to the scheme, performance test results can be obtained on the two-dimensional GeSe films prepared on different types of substrates by adopting a physical vapor deposition method based on standardized indexes, the influence mechanism of the multi-type substrates on the performance of the two-dimensional GeSe films is comprehensively and accurately explored by the standardized indexes, and the characteristics of the two-dimensional GeSe films can be fully excavated, so that the selection of the substrates in the preparation process of the two-dimensional GeSe films is accurately and efficiently guided.

title_en: Ball supplementing module and ball supplementing machine thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of semiconductor manufacturing and packaging, in particular to a ball compensating module and a ball compensating machine thereof, wherein the ball compensating machine comprises a frame, a crystal carrying platform, a ball compensating module, a dispensing module and a ball removing module. The ball compensating module realizes accurate ball compensating through the ball compensating needle unit and the ball box unit, the ball box unit is provided with a unique suction port structure to ensure stable suction and release of the solder balls, the dispensing module adopts the dispensing needle unit to be matched with the glue supplying unit to realize high-precision dispensing operation, and the ball removing module is combined with the ball removing needle unit and the automatic detection unit to effectively remove bad solder balls and detect position offset. In addition, a wafer calibration fine-tuning system and a flattening system are further arranged, so that accurate positioning and flatness in the wafer processing process are ensured. The application achieves the technical effect of improving the ball repairing efficiency and accuracy of the wafer and reduces the defective rate.

title_en: Electrolysis system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an electrolysis system that suppresses unnecessary consumption of heat in a process of generating steam to be supplied to electrolysis by heating raw water via a refrigerant by exchanging heat between heat in a heat storage unit and the refrigerant.
