The electrolysis system comprises an electrolysis cell for generating hydrogen by high-temperature steam electrolysis, a steam generation unit having a refrigerant heat exchange unit for exchanging heat between heat of a heat storage unit and a refrigerant, wherein raw water is heated by the refrigerant heat exchanged by the refrigerant heat exchange unit to generate steam and the steam is supplied to the electrolysis cell, a heat storage supply unit having the heat storage unit and supplying the heat of the heat storage unit to the refrigerant heat exchange unit, and a control unit for controlling the heat storage supply unit so that the amount of heat input to the refrigerant heat exchange unit is reduced during system start-up or in a period of high Wen Daiji as compared with normal operation.

title_en: Multi-block dibenzofuran polyarylpiperidine anion exchange membrane containing hydrophobic chain segments and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a multiblock dibenzofuran type polyarylpiperidine polymer, which comprises a structural unit shown in a formula (I). The multi-block dibenzofuran polyarylpiperidine polymer is prepared into an anion exchange membrane polymeric material, has excellent anion transmission capacity and mechanical strength under alkaline conditions, shows excellent alkali resistance stability, can be used as an excellent membrane device of a water electrolysis hydrogen production reaction device, and has certain practical application potential. The preparation method is very simple and has short preparation flow. The invention provides a preparation method and a strategy for preparing the anion exchange membrane by adopting solid acid and solid super acid catalyst in a green way for the first time, the solid acid and the solid super acid catalyst used in the invention are easy to separate and recycle, can be repeatedly used for a plurality of times, and the technical route is green and environment-friendly.

title_en: Gallium-doped platinum-based ordered alloy catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of catalysis, and provides a gallium-doped platinum-based ordered alloy catalyst, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the gallium-doped platinum-based ordered alloy catalyst comprises a carbon carrier and active nano particles dispersed on the surface of the carbon carrier; the active nanoparticle comprises an intermetallic ordered alloy consisting of Pt and a transition metal M, and the intermetallic ordered alloy is further doped with Ga. According to the preparation method, the gallium element with smaller atomic radius is used for doping, so that the crystal lattice can be further contracted, the adsorption strength of the Pt surface on the intermediate of the oxygen reduction reaction is adjusted, the ORR performance of the catalyst is effectively improved, the catalyst is prepared by adopting a combination mode of an impregnation method, a ball milling method and a calcination method, the manual operation is less, the process is simple, the cost is easy to reduce, and the mass production is easy.

title_en: Side chain type polyaryl anion exchange membrane, preparation method and application thereof, and anion exchange membrane electrolytic tank
abstract_en: The invention relates to a side chain type polyaryl anion exchange membrane, a preparation method and application thereof, and an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell, belonging to the technical field of hydrogen energy. The preparation method of the side chain type polyaryl anion exchange membrane comprises the steps of reacting a side chain type polyaryl skeleton polymer with a quaternizing agent to obtain a side chain type polyaryl anion polymer, forming a film of the side chain type polyaryl anion polymer to obtain the side chain type polyaryl anion exchange membrane, wherein the main chain of the side chain type polyaryl anion exchange membrane is prepared by polymerizing a heteroaryl structure without hetero atoms through a Friedel-Crafts reaction catalyzed by super acid, the cation function group is a piperidine cation function group with excellent alkali stability, and the piperidine cation function group is connected with the main chain of the polyaryl through a long alkyl chain. The invention combines the polyaryl skeleton and the piperidine cation functional group by adopting the long alkyl chain, and improves the alkali stability and the dimensional stability and simultaneously remarkably improves the conductivity of hydroxide ions by constructing a hydrophilic/hydrophobic microphase separation structure in the membrane.

title_en: Fixing tool and fixing method for hexagram guide blade platinization
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of aeroengines and discloses a fixing tool and a fixing method for hexa-gang guide vane platinization, wherein the fixing tool comprises a bracket, the lower end of the bracket is transversely connected with a support plate for placing and fixing the hexa-gang guide vane, the upper end of the bracket is provided with a hook, the support plate is an arc plate, the left section and the right section are arc-shaped with the same radian and opposite opening directions, the upper end surface of the support plate is provided with a fixing groove, and the fixing groove is connected with a fixing block for fixing the hexa-gang guide vane; the lower part of support still is equipped with the mounting panel, the mounting panel is the arc and is used for installing auxiliary anode, the radian of mounting panel and the radian adaptation of backup pad, and the mounting panel is equipped with two and uses the midpoint of backup pad as symmetry point central symmetry. According to the invention, the auxiliary anode is extended to the shielding area, so that the thickness of the overall platinized film at each position of the six-connected guide blade is 5-8 mu m, and the current density at the tip can be reduced through shielding of the supporting plate.

title_en: Seawater initiation preparation method of metal wet gel and aerogel and application of seawater initiation preparation method in electrocatalysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a seawater initiation preparation method of metal wet gel and aerogel and an application of the method in electrocatalytic glycol oxidation. Comprises the steps of 1) firstly adding metal salt, sodium citrate and reducing agent into pure water in sequence, 2) adding seawater into the reaction solution to obtain wet gel, and 3) washing and drying the wet gel to obtain aerogel. The seawater can be used for replacing a large amount of expensive medicines used in a salting-out method and an excessive sodium borohydride method, so that the metal nanoparticle solution is destabilized, and the metal aerogel material is prepared, and the preparation cost of the metal aerogel is greatly reduced. The metal aerogel obtained by the invention has excellent catalytic performance in electrocatalytic glycol oxidation application.

title_en: Easily-dissociable bonding layer based on nanometer-thickness tungsten and high-diffusion metal, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an easily-released bonding layer based on nano-thickness tungsten and high-diffusion metal, and a preparation method and application thereof, and aims to overcome the defects of excessive warping of a wafer surface, insufficient bonding strength and the like caused by difficulty in controlling the flatness of an existing temporary bonding adhesive layer. The easy-to-detach bonding layer is formed by sandwiching a second metal film layer between two first metal film layers, wherein the first metal film layers are respectively deposited on the functional wafer and the temporary carrier wafer in a pre-bonding mode, the first metal film layers are made of tungsten, the second metal film layers are single-layer metal films or multi-layer metal films, and each metal film layer in the second metal film layers is made of simple-substance metal with the melting point smaller than that of tungsten. The transfer method adopts a wet chemical soaking method, and the nondestructive de-bonding of the chip epitaxial layer and the temporary slide glass can be realized through oxidation-reduction reaction of hydrogen peroxide and tungsten, so that the damage of laser and stress to the epitaxial layer film in the transfer process is effectively avoided, and meanwhile, the bonding layer has good bonding strength and high temperature resistance.

title_en: High-value conversion preparation method of waste micrometer silicon applied to lithium battery silicon-carbon negative electrode
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of lithium ion batteries, and particularly discloses a method for preparing a lithium battery silicon-carbon negative electrode by high-value conversion of waste micrometer silicon; according to the invention, the electrochemical in-situ intercalation is adopted to prepare the alkali metal silicon alloy, the alkali metal is used as a precursor to reduce carbon dioxide, in-situ replacement is carried out on the alkali metal, the silicon-carbon composite anode material with a high specific capacity and a mesoporous structure is generated, the silicon-carbon element proportion of the obtained material is controlled by controlling the voltage of the electrochemical alkali metal intercalation and the flow and time of carbon dioxide introduction, the specific capacity and electrochemical performance of the silicon-carbon composite material can be balanced, and the generated mesoporous structure can effectively relieve the problems of poor conductivity of the silicon material and poor circulation stability caused by larger volume expansion of lithium intercalation.

title_en: Wear-resistant and pressure-resistant laminated bamboo plywood and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wear-resistant and pressure-resistant laminated bamboo plywood and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of bamboo plywood. The preparation method comprises the following steps of braiding modified bamboo chips into a bamboo mat, then stacking 1 bamboo mat on 1 piece of film-coated paper, stacking 1 piece of film-coated paper on the bamboo mat, continuously stacking 2-4 pieces of bamboo mat and film-coated paper in sequence, carrying out hot pressing treatment, maintaining the pressure at 50-60 ℃, reducing the pressure, reducing the temperature, sanding, trimming to obtain the wear-resistant and anti-compression film-coated bamboo plywood, wherein the film-coated paper is prepared from imidazole, phytic acid and itaconic acid-based epoxy resin. The modified bamboo chips treated by the components such as sodium hydroxide, sodium sulfite, diammonium hydrogen phosphate, sodium silicate aqueous solution and the like effectively improve the wear resistance, compression resistance, flame retardance, mildew resistance and moisture resistance of the bamboo plywood, and the introduction of the coated paper further improves the wear resistance, compression resistance, flame retardance, mildew resistance and moisture resistance. Therefore, the invention has wider application prospect.

title_en: Method for preparing wettability patterning coating on magnesium alloy surface
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of metal surface engineering, and particularly discloses a method for preparing an infiltrative patterned coating on the surface of a magnesium alloy. And taking out the magnesium alloy after the reaction is finished, and naturally drying the magnesium alloy in air after deionized water is washed. And then, covering a mask on the surface of the dried magnesium alloy to distinguish covered areas from exposed areas. And controlling the width of the covering/exposing area in an alternating arrangement mode, and then depositing a gold film on the exposing area by adopting an ion sputtering technology to form an alternating arrangement gold film layer. And finally, immersing the magnesium alloy deposited with the gold film into an n-dodecyl mercaptan ethanol solution for self-assembly reaction, taking out the magnesium alloy after the reaction is finished, washing with ethanol, and drying to obtain the wettable patterned magnesium alloy surface. The method is simple and easy to implement, easy to repeat and low in cost, and can provide a new technical support for the wide application of the magnesium alloy.

title_en: High-wear-resistance super-hydrophobic conductive coating based on modified polyaniline and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a modified polyaniline-based high-wear-resistance super-hydrophobic conductive coating and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method specifically comprises the steps of dissolving aniline monomers in an acid solution, stirring, sequentially adding a first modifier, stirring, then adding a second modifier into a reaction system, reacting, dissolving an oxidant in deionized water, dropwise adding the reaction solution for reaction, carrying out suction filtration, washing with water to be neutral, and carrying out vacuum drying to obtain modified polyaniline, dispersing the modified polyaniline in an organic solvent system, adding a dispersing agent and an interface modifier, dispersing, pretreating a base material, forming a coating, and preparing the highly wear-resistant super-hydrophobic conductive coating based on the modified polyaniline. According to the invention, the contradiction between the electric conduction and the hydrophobic performance is solved through the molecular structure, the hydrophobic group is directionally grafted to the main chain of polyaniline by adopting a chemical bonding method, and the rigid group and pi-pi conjugated bi-component are combined to synergistically act, so that the contradiction between the hydrophobicity and the electric conduction performance is solved, and the wear resistance of the material is also increased.

title_en: Siliconized silicon carbide porous block, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a siliconized silicon carbide porous block, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the siliconized silicon carbide porous block comprises an intermediate and a silicon carbide layer coated on the surface of the intermediate, the intermediate comprises a porous silicon carbide block and silicon crystals positioned in the porous silicon carbide block, and the mass ratio of the silicon carbide block to the silicon crystals is 70-95:5-30. According to the invention, the siliconized silicon carbide porous block and the conventional silicon carbide powder are mixed according to a proportion, then the mixture is used for growing crystals, along with the decomposition of the initial mixture, the silicon carbide layer outside the siliconized silicon carbide block starts to decompose preferentially, and after the silicon carbide layer is grown in the middle and later stages, the silicon inside the porous block also starts to decompose along with the decomposition of the silicon carbide, so that the carbon-silicon ratio in the middle and later stage atmosphere is kept stable, and the quality of the silicon carbide crystal with higher thickness is improved.

title_en: Apparatus and method for heating tunability in a processing chamber
abstract_en: Embodiments herein generally relate to electronic device manufacturing, and more particularly to systems and methods for heating lamps in a thermal processing chamber. In one embodiment, a substrate processing chamber includes a lid, a base plate, and a processing volume between the lid and the base plate. The upper window is disposed between the lid and the processing volume, and the lower window is disposed between the bottom plate and the processing volume. The lamp cap is disposed between the lower window and the bottom plate or between the upper window and the cover. At least one lamp is disposed within the lamp head, and a lens is disposed between the lamp head and the process volume. In another embodiment, a plurality of lamps is disposed within the lamp head and includes at least one first lamp operating at a first wavelength and at least one second lamp operating at a second wavelength.

title_en: Transparent stuffing type cake accurate stuffing wrapping equipment and stuffing wrapping process
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cake production, and discloses a transparent stuffing type accurate cake stuffing equipment and a stuffing process, comprising an automatic stuffing machine, wherein a conveyor is arranged on the automatic stuffing machine, a discharge hole of the automatic stuffing machine is opposite to the conveyor, a partition plate is fixed on the conveyor and is used for providing support for a conveying belt of the conveyor, a cleaning assembly is arranged on the automatic stuffing machine and is used for cleaning the conveyor, the cleaning assembly is arranged below the conveyor, and the cleaning assembly comprises a rotating shaft and two scraping plates. The scraper blade is matched with the scraping blade, and the scraping blade can scrape the skin on the scraper blade, so that the skin is prevented from being reattached to the conveyor belt, and the cleaning effect is ensured.

title_en: Alkaline electrolytic water hydrogen production composite system with quaternized trifluoro acetophenone copolymer nonporous film loaded with high-activity cobalt manganese oxygen vacancy catalyst
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydrogen production by water electrolysis, in particular to a composite system based on a quaternized trifluoro acetophenone copolymer nonporous film and a cobalt manganese oxygen vacancy catalyst, which comprises the quaternized trifluoro acetophenone copolymer nonporous film and the cobalt manganese oxygen vacancy catalyst, wherein the catalyst is loaded on the surface of the film through hydrogen bonding, the loading capacity is 1.0-1.5mg/cm  2 , the repeating unit structure of the nonporous film is -[C 6 H 3 (CF 3 )-CO-C 6 H 4 -CH 2 -N + (CH 3 ) 3 ·OH ‑ ]- n ,, wherein n is 500-1000, the quaternary ammonium group content is 1.2-1.8mmol/g, the catalyst is spinel type Co  x Mn γ O 4‑  delta, x: y is 1:1-3:1, and the oxygen vacancy concentration delta is 0.1-0.3. Based on the copolymerization of trifluoroacetophenone and 4-vinylbenzyl chloride, a high-density quaternary ammonium group (1.2-1.8 mmol/g) is introduced through a quaternization reaction, and the problems of permeation and alkali resistance degradation of the traditional membrane electrolyte are solved by taking high ionic conductivity (85 mS/cm) and low swelling rate (5%).

title_en: CuCrZrTa alloy wire with nano oxide dispersion strengthening phase and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses CuCrZrTa alloy wire with nano oxide dispersion strengthening phase and a preparation method thereof, wherein the alloy wire comprises the following components ：Cr：0.6-1.0 wt％ 、Zr：0.08-0.12 wt％ 、Ta：0.03-0.08 wt ％、Y 2 O 3 ：0.2-0.4 wt ％、B：0.005-0.02 wt ％, in percentage by weight and the balance of Cu, and the phase structure of the wire comprises nano Cr as a precipitated phase, YTaO dispersed particles and B segregation grain boundaries. Coarsening is inhibited through Ta-Y  2 O 3  interlocking, B grain boundaries are biased to resist radiation, nanocrystalline is reserved through low-temperature sintering, and two-stage aging is used for accurately regulating and controlling precipitated phase distribution, so that the prepared wire has the characteristics of high strength, strong conductivity and excellent radiation resistance, and the extreme working condition requirements of a Tokamak magnet winding (needing high conductivity/radiation resistance) and a divertor cooling pipeline (needing high temperature resistance/creep resistance) are met.

title_en: High-pressure corrosion-resistant hard alloy material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a high-pressure corrosion-resistant hard alloy material, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of alloy materials. According to the application, the strength, toughness and corrosion resistance of the material are improved by constructing titanium boride, silicon carbide and chromium diboride hard phases, a multiphase composite binder consisting of aluminum-iron alloy, high-entropy alloy and cerium hexaboride is introduced to realize high-temperature compact coating, and an asymmetric gradient paving and sintering process is adopted to cooperate, so that a gradient structure with high surface hardness, high core toughness and a transition layer for relieving stress concentration is constructed, and meanwhile, the surface hardness and sealing property are enhanced by burying powder and calcining, so that the wear resistance, corrosion resistance and impact resistance of the material are comprehensively improved.

title_en: Method for repairing deformed steel nodes by laser material increase based on man-machine interaction
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for repairing deformed steel nodes by laser material increase based on man-machine interaction, which combines the man-machine interaction technology with the laser material increase repairing technology, and solves the problems of insufficient repairing precision, low repairing efficiency and the like of the traditional repairing method under a complex environment. The whole process covers three core links of damage identification and data acquisition, man-machine interaction and repair parameter optimization, program setting and laser cladding, and realizes efficient, accurate and intelligent repair operation. The application relates to the technical field of steel structure repair.

title_en: Multi-dimensional moisture-conducting breathable composite fabric and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-dimensional moisture-conductive breathable composite fabric and a preparation method thereof, the multi-dimensional moisture-conductive breathable composite fabric comprises an inner lining and an outer layer, linear or cross-connection areas are formed between the outer layer and the inner layer through suture lines or bonding, moisture-conductive pieces are contained between the areas, the moisture-conductive pieces are also contacted with the moisture-conductive pieces, the moisture-conductive pieces between the inner lining and the outer layer are vertically contacted with the moisture-conductive pieces and distributed in a staggered manner, and the moisture-conductive pieces are used for absorbing and guiding moisture into the moisture-conductive pieces. According to the multidimensional moisture-conducting breathable composite fabric and the preparation method thereof, the moisture-conducting structure between the inner layer and the outer layer is redesigned, on one hand, moisture can be absorbed and guided from multiple dimensions, on the other hand, the lining part of the fabric can be prevented from being influenced too much, and meanwhile, the moisture-conducting and water-absorbing composite fabric can be guided to deform simply and achieve the effect of assisting quick drying, and the effect is better.

title_en: Transition metal dichalcogenide patterning growth method based on ink-jet printing aqueous precursor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transition metal dichalcogenide patterning growth method based on an ink-jet printing aqueous precursor, which is characterized in that precursor ink containing molybdate or tungstate is prepared, a high-precision array precursor pattern is formed on a substrate by combining a sulfur source, a selenium source or a tellurium source by using an ink-jet printing technology, and in-situ growth of two-dimensional transition metal chalcogenides (such as MoS2, moSe2 and WTE 2) is realized through a high Wen Liuzu chemical reaction. The method can prepare the two-dimensional monocrystalline material with controllable thickness, good crystallinity and regular array structure by regulating and controlling the ink proportion, printing parameters and reaction conditions, and is suitable for the fields of flexible electronics, photoelectric detectors and integrated circuits. The invention has simple process, low cost and strong expandability, and solves the technical problem that the traditional chemical vapor deposition method is difficult to realize complex patterning integration.

title_en: Film forming method using atomic layer deposition
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for producing a thin film, wherein the method for producing a thin film comprises a step of vaporizing a raw material liquid containing a raw material compound in an evaporator, a step of introducing the vaporized raw material compound into a film formation chamber, and a step of forming a thin film on a substrate, and the method for producing a thin film comprises a step of discharging a gas phase portion of the evaporator.

title_en: Wafer supporting device and SiC epitaxial growth device
abstract_en: Provided is a wafer support device capable of suppressing damage during regeneration of a wafer guide. Has a support table, a wafer guiding portion, a first chamfering portion and a second chamfering portion. The support table has a support surface for supporting the wafer. The wafer guide portion is annular and surrounds the periphery of the wafer supported on the support surface with the center axis extending in the normal direction of the support surface as the center. The first chamfer connects the inner peripheral surface and the upper surface of the wafer guide portion, and extends in a direction toward the upper side as going from the inner peripheral surface toward the outer peripheral side. The second chamfer connects the upper surface and the outer peripheral surface of the wafer guide portion, and extends in a direction toward the upper side as going from the outer peripheral surface toward the inner peripheral side.

title_en: Device and method for removing impurities in hard chromium electroplating
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of hard chromium electroplating technology, and in particular relates to a device and a method for removing impurities in hard chromium electroplating, an anode component is arranged in the bath solution in the electrolytic bath at the front side and the rear side of the cathode component, and the whole electrolytic process is controlled by a pulse power supply and a control system, so that the impurity removal in the bath solution is promoted. The invention has the advantages of high efficiency impurity removal effect, strong corrosion resistance, simple operation, environmental protection and energy saving.

title_en: Operation and maintenance cabinet for monitoring and controlling outdoor electronic equipment and assembling equipment and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an operation and maintenance cabinet for monitoring and controlling outdoor electronic equipment, and equipment and a method for assembling the operation and maintenance cabinet, and belongs to the technical field of cabinets. The invention relates to an operation and maintenance cabinet for monitoring and controlling outdoor electronic equipment, which comprises a cabinet body, a rainwater sensor arranged on the outer side of the cabinet body, and further comprises two heat dissipation port groups, wherein the two heat dissipation port groups are respectively arranged on two sides of the cabinet body, each heat dissipation port group comprises an air inlet and an air outlet, each heat dissipation port group comprises a plurality of heat dissipation holes formed in the cabinet body, guide plates are connected with the cabinet body and are arranged on the outer side of the heat dissipation port group, and a guide space is formed between every two adjacent guide plates.

title_en: Large-size N-type silicon wafer for BC battery, preparation method thereof and BC battery
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of photovoltaic cells, in particular to a large-size N-type silicon wafer for a BC battery, a preparation method of the large-size N-type silicon wafer and the BC battery. The large-size N-type silicon wafer has the size of more than or equal to 230mm multiplied by 230mm and the thickness of 90-130 mu m, the edge of the large-size N-type silicon wafer is an arc chamfer, the edge is wrapped with a SiN  x  layer, the large-size N-type silicon wafer comprises a central area and an edge area surrounding the central area, the content of doped element antimony in the edge area is less than or equal to 1 multiplied by 10  15 atoms/cm 3 , and the content of doped element antimony in the central area is 1 multiplied by 10  16 ~5×10 16 atoms/cm 3 . Through setting up edge circular arc chamfer and parcel SiN  x  layer, edge low doping, can reduce the edge carrier complex when guaranteeing mechanical strength, reducing the piece rate, promote open circuit voltage, promote battery power output.

title_en: Medical consumable hydrophilic coating method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for coating a hydrophilic coating on medical consumable materials, which comprises the steps of arranging a clamping part, straightening and smoothening a product to be coated through the clamping part before coating the product, and clamping the product to be coated through a clamping head in the process of coating the product, so that the straightened and smoothened product can be smoothly immersed into a liquid pipe for coating, and the influence of the buoyancy of coating liquid in the liquid pipe on the product is overcome.

title_en: Friction-resistant high-entropy alloy composite coating and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an antifriction high-entropy alloy composite coating and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of metal surface modification. According to the invention, feCoCrNiMo  x  (x is more than or equal to 0.18 and less than or equal to 0.25) high-entropy alloy is used as a main component of composite powder, graphene is used as an additive phase, and a laser cladding method is adopted to prepare the FeCoCrNiMo  x  high-entropy alloy composite coating on the surface of a substrate. The graphene added into the composite powder can generate carbide in situ under the action of laser cladding, and second-phase strengthening, solid solution strengthening and fine-grain strengthening are generated, so that the friction resistance of the surface of the matrix is remarkably improved. The preparation method provided by the invention is simple to operate and low in cost, and the prepared composite coating has high bonding strength, good toughness and plasticity and excellent friction resistance, can effectively improve the surface performance of equipment, ensure the safe and stable operation of the equipment, prolong the service life of the equipment and reduce maintenance expenditure.

title_en: Slurry caching device and coating equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a slurry caching device and coating equipment, wherein the slurry caching device comprises a first caching structure and a vacuumizing structure. The first buffer structure comprises a first buffer shell, a first driving component and a first stirring component, wherein the first buffer shell is provided with a first storage cavity for storing coating slurry, the first buffer shell is provided with a first feeding port and a first discharging port which are respectively communicated with the first storage cavity, and the first stirring component is positioned in the first storage cavity and is in transmission fit with the first driving component, so that the first stirring component can rotate under the driving of the first driving component to stir the coating slurry, and the coating slurry is prevented from sedimentation and uneven density. Meanwhile, the first cache shell is further provided with a vacuumizing structure communicated with the first storage cavity so as to extract gas in the first storage cavity, so that bubbles of coating slurry are eliminated, the density of the coating slurry is uniform, and then the coating effect and the coating appearance are effectively improved.

title_en: Construction method and application of gas sensor for detecting plant volatile pheromone
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of plant volatile pheromone detection, in particular to a construction method and application of a gas sensor for plant volatile pheromone detection, comprising the following steps of coating UV glue on a blank area on an MEMS electrode, and irradiating under an ultraviolet lamp to completely solidify the UV glue to obtain the electrode; the method comprises the steps of placing a pure tungsten target in a magnetic control target system, placing an electrode on a sample table, depositing a W film for 0.5-2min in a sputtering time, keeping the rotating speed of 2r/min and the direct current power of 150W to obtain the electrode, placing the deposited electrode in a muffle furnace, annealing in an air atmosphere, and constructing a semiconductor sensor.

title_en: Phosphorus-free environment-friendly chemical agent applied to container cleaning and chemical formation and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of material surface treatment, and particularly discloses a phosphorus-free environment-friendly chemical agent applied to container cleaning and chemical formation and a use method thereof, wherein the phosphorus-free environment-friendly chemical agent comprises, by weight, 1% -15% of rare earth salt, 0.5% -5% of chelating factor, 0.1% -5% of slow release factor, 0.5% -10% of active agent and 0.5% -10% of additive, and the specific process steps of treatment are that the obtained two-in-one preparation is treated twice, and then water washing, pure water washing and electrophoretic coating/powder coating are carried out. The two-in-one preparation does not need to be cleaned and formed independently, the working procedure is saved, the production efficiency is improved, the whole treatment process is reduced to 10-20min from original 20-30min through field practice inspection, meanwhile, the multi-process wastewater is reduced to single-process wastewater, the comprehensive wastewater treatment cost is reduced by 20-40%, in addition, the two-in-one preparation does not contain phosphorus, is environment-friendly, has the cleaning effect and can form a denser anti-corrosion film layer, the corrosion resistance is good, the SST requirement of the product is met, and the single-side corrosion is less than 2 mm.

title_en: Preparation method of ion solvation membrane supported by porous substrate and ion solvation membrane
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of an ion solvation membrane supported by a porous substrate and the ion solvation membrane, and belongs to the technical field of hydrogen production by alkaline water electrolysis. The preparation method of the ion solvation membrane with the porous substrate support comprises the steps of S1, low-pressure plasma surface treatment, S2, grafting modification treatment and S3, interfacial polymerization treatment. The invention takes common polytetrafluoroethylene, polypropylene, polyether-ether-ketone, polyethylene or polyvinylidene fluoride and the like as a porous polymer substrate, and sequentially carries out low-pressure plasma surface treatment, grafting modification treatment and interfacial polymerization treatment, so that the prepared ion solvated membrane has good gas barrier property, lower surface resistance and relatively lower raw material cost, and has remarkable industrial application advantages.

title_en: Copper wire processing auxiliary assembly based on copper line production
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of copper wire processing assistance, in particular to copper wire processing auxiliary equipment based on copper wire production. The invention provides copper wire processing auxiliary equipment based on copper wire production, which comprises a base, wherein a soaking tank is arranged on the base, two push plates which are controlled to move are arranged on the soaking tank, the soaking tank and the push plates jointly form a box body with an open top, copper wires are placed in a pickling tank, pickling solution is poured into the soaking tank, and the effective volume in the tank is changed through synchronous opposite or reverse displacement of the push plates, so that the liquid level of the pickling solution is accurately controlled, the adaptive soaking of copper wires with different diameters is realized, and the consumption of the pickling solution is further saved.

title_en: Multi-functional integrated multistage scraper coating device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional integrated multistage scraper coating device which comprises a multistage scraper head, a heating vibration source, a vertical connecting rod, a transverse connecting rod, a liquid supplementing device and a driving block. When the substrate is coated by the scraper, the multistage scraper head can gradually decrease the scraping gap, so that the meniscus height at the front end of the scraper is gradually reduced, smaller and more stable liquid level height difference is formed with the liquid film at the rear end of the scraper, the fluctuation of the thickness of the liquid film caused by the change of the liquid level height difference before and after the scraper in the scraping process is reduced, and a more uniform photoresist film with ideal thickness is obtained. The heating vibration source can realize the temperature control of the substrate scraper head and the real-time control of the vibration mode state of the scraper. The heating of the cutter head can control the bottom area of the scraper to form a high-temperature environment, so that the viscosity of the high-viscosity solution is reduced, and the solution is uniformly spread below the scraper. The invention can control the bottom of the scraper to realize the complex motion trail of sine wave shape and the like by controlling the vibration mode of the vibrator in the heating vibration source.

title_en: Production process of solid transfer high-stripping base cloth
abstract_en: The invention relates to a production process of a solid transfer high-stripping base cloth, which comprises the following steps of quantitatively transferring a powder group to the base cloth through a powder group transfer device, preheating the base cloth in a preheating box to enable the powder group to be adhered to the base cloth after preliminary melting, scattering rubber powder to the powder group through a powder scattering machine to enable the surface of the melted powder group to be adhered with new rubber powder, blowing and sucking the rubber powder, absorbing excessive rubber powder on the base cloth through a blowing and sucking device, re-baking the rubber powder through a heating box to enable the rubber powder to be adhered to the base cloth, and cooling the fused base cloth through a cooling roller to cool and fix the base cloth.

title_en: Backwater dehydrogenation treatment method and backwater dehydrogenation treatment system for PEM water electrolysis hydrogen production equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a backwater dehydrogenation treatment method and a backwater dehydrogenation treatment system for PEM water electrolysis hydrogen production equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of decompressing high-pressure nitrogen into micro-positive pressure nitrogen with the gauge pressure of 0.1 Bar-0.2 Bar through a nitrogen busbar assembly, respectively and simultaneously introducing the micro-positive pressure nitrogen into the bottoms of an oxygen side drip barrel, a hydrogen side drip barrel and a total drip barrel, releasing the micro-positive pressure nitrogen into water in the barrels through the aeration pipes to form uniform small bubbles, stirring the water body, and wrapping hydrogen and oxygen entrained or dissolved in the water into a space above a liquid level in the water body turning process, and discharging the entrained or dissolved hydrogen and oxygen to the atmosphere through a top exhaust pipe. The application replaces the hydrogen and oxygen dissolved in the water, maintains the high purity of the secondary desalted water backwater, and prevents the generation of sediment and the like generated by the total trace metal ions of the water.

title_en: Device for driving baffle plate of beam source furnace to rotate on-off in linear driving mode
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of molecular beam source furnace baffles, in particular to a device for driving a beam source furnace baffle to rotate to switch in a linear driving mode, wherein the two sides of a flange plate are respectively an atmosphere side and a vacuum side, one end of a compression corrugated pipe is fixedly connected with the atmosphere side surface of the flange plate, the other end of the compression corrugated pipe is a free end, a linear motion cylinder is fixed on the atmosphere side surface of the flange plate, a transmission rod can be arranged on the flange plate in a penetrating manner in a relatively moving manner, one end of the transmission rod is connected with a power rod of the linear motion cylinder through a floating joint after penetrating out from the free end of the compression corrugated pipe, and one end of the transmission rod is fixedly connected with the free end of the compression corrugated pipe; the baffle support rod is fixedly connected to the vacuum side surface of the flange plate, one end of the connecting rod mechanism is connected with the other end of the transmission rod, the other end of the connecting rod mechanism is hinged to the baffle support rod, and the baffle assembly is arranged at the other end of the connecting rod mechanism. The invention has the characteristics of simple structure, convenient assembly, stable motion, accurate beam control, wide application range and the like.

title_en: Paint texture method applied to sports shoes and based on layered diluent tire removal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lacquer texture method based on layered stripping of diluents, which is applied to sports shoes and comprises the following steps of manufacturing texture layers, brushing diluents on the surfaces of moulds in a thin mode, covering paint on the diluents, forming a first texture layer after drying and solidifying, reversely carrying out lacquering on multiple layers, reversely carrying out lacquering on the first texture layer in a mode that the bottom layer is thick and the surface layer is thin after drying and solidifying, carrying out repeated reverse lacquering operation, carrying out stripping and ending, carrying out repeated reverse lacquering operation on the lacquer surfaces, and carrying out cloth mounting, demoulding, carving and surface treatment procedures to obtain a finished lacquer product. The application of the lacquer texture based on the layered de-molding of the diluent is mainly applied to the sports shoes, the lacquer is attached to the sports shoes, the adhesive force of the lacquer is improved by more than 30 percent, the lacquer is directly covered with the lacquer (replaces the traditional lacquer ash priming) in the non-dried state of the diluent, and the lacquer texture treatment method has the characteristics of no fading and no falling off when being applied to the shoes.

title_en: Wear-resistant coating, preparation method thereof and application thereof in gear manufacturing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wear-resistant coating, a preparation method and application thereof in gear manufacturing, wherein the raw materials for preparing the wear-resistant coating at least comprise polyimide resin and/or polyamide imide resin, a lubricating phase and an organic modified reinforcing phase, wherein the organic modified reinforcing phase is prepared by modifying reinforcing phase by an aminosilane coupling agent. The wear-resistant coating has the advantages of damping and buffering effects, excellent tribological performance, excellent mechanical performance and the like, can be used as a novel wear-resistant coating material with excellent performance, can be coated on the surface of a metal-based material (such as the surface of a gear), can improve the NVH performance and service life of the surface of the metal-based material, particularly the surface of the gear under the condition of high rotating speed, can reduce the processing precision requirement and the manufacturing cost of the metal-based material, has high use value and good application prospect, and has important promotion effect on promoting the faster development of new energy automobiles.

title_en: Heat shielding member, single crystal pulling apparatus, and method for producing single crystal silicon ingot
abstract_en: The invention provides a heat shielding member, a single crystal pulling apparatus and a method for manufacturing a single crystal silicon ingot using the same, which can expand the limit of the pulling speed of a crystal of single crystal silicon without defects. A heat shield member (1) is provided in a single crystal pulling apparatus for pulling a single crystal silicon ingot (I) from a silicon melt heated by a heater disposed around a quartz crucible and stored in the quartz crucible, the heat shield member (1) comprising a cylindrical tube portion (2) surrounding the outer peripheral surface of the single crystal silicon ingot and an annular ridge portion (3) at the lower portion of the tube portion (2), wherein the ridge portion (3) has an upper wall (3 a), a bottom wall (3 b) and 2 vertical walls (3 c,3 d), and a space surrounded by these walls has an annular heat insulating material (H), and a space is provided between the vertical wall (3 c) and the heat insulating material (H) on the side adjacent to the single crystal silicon ingot (I).

title_en: High-heat-insulation wave-absorbing plate and production method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-heat-insulation wave-absorbing plate and a production method thereof, belonging to the technical field of square cabins. The high-heat-insulation wave-absorbing plate comprises an outer skin, an inner skin and a honeycomb wave-absorbing heat-insulating layer, wherein the honeycomb wave-absorbing heat-insulating layer comprises a honeycomb wave-absorbing substrate and heat-insulation foaming filler, the honeycomb wave-absorbing substrate is of a platy honeycomb structure, each honeycomb cavity is filled with the heat-insulation foaming filler, one end of the honeycomb wave-absorbing substrate is fixed with the outer skin in an adhesive manner, and the other end of the honeycomb wave-absorbing substrate is fixed with the inner skin in an adhesive manner. When the high-heat-preservation wave-absorbing plate with the structure is used as a shelter cabin plate, the heat preservation, bearing and radar stealth requirements of the shelter can be met simultaneously on the premise that the space inside the shelter is not reduced.

title_en: Ceramic surface composite coating for resisting hard particle environment and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ceramic surface composite coating for resisting hard particle environment, and relates to the technical field of sealing materials, wherein the composite coating comprises a diamond-like bottom layer deposited on a substrate by taking acetylene as a carbon source and a diamond-like top layer deposited on the diamond-like bottom layer by taking methane as a carbon source, and the thickness ratio of the diamond-like bottom layer to the diamond-like top layer is 0.3-3:1. The invention also discloses a preparation method of the ceramic surface composite coating for resisting the hard particle environment. The invention can solve the problems of easy brittle peeling and easy abrasion of the existing coating in a hard particle environment, greatly improve the friction and abrasion performance of the ceramic sealing element, prolong the service life of the part and effectively reduce the risk of sealing failure in actual working conditions.

title_en: Dehumidifying/hydrogen-producing oxygen-producing device and method for coupling moisture collection and water vapor electrolysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dehumidifying/hydrogen-producing and oxygen-producing device and method for coupling moisture collection and water vapor electrolysis, and belongs to the technical field of environmental humidity regulation/collection and water vapor electrolysis. The device is formed by sequentially assembling an anode clamping plate, an anode electrode plate, a membrane electrode assembly, a cathode electrode plate and a cathode clamping plate, wherein the anode clamping plate is filled with a low regeneration temperature moisture absorption medium and is provided with an oxygen outlet, and the cathode clamping plate is provided with a hydrogen outlet. After the wet air is quickly dehumidified by the moisture absorption medium in the moisture collection unit, ohmic heat generated in the electrolysis process heats and separates out water vapor, the water vapor is electrolyzed by the PEM electrolyzer to generate hydrogen and oxygen at the cathode and the anode respectively, and in-situ regeneration of the moisture absorption medium is realized. The device is used for remarkably improving the dehumidification rate and durability, does not need to replace a hygroscopic agent, can also cooperatively produce hydrogen and oxygen by utilizing the environmental humidity, is suitable for a dampproof and humidity control scene of a precise instrument, and effectively solves the problems of limited capacity, complex regeneration and difficult reuse of humidity in the traditional desiccant technology.

title_en: Method for rapidly growing silicon carbide crystal and raw material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid growth method of silicon carbide crystals, which comprises the following steps of placing silicon carbide raw materials into a crucible, heating the crucible to sublimate the raw materials in the crucible, and then recrystallizing to obtain the silicon carbide crystals, wherein after the silicon carbide raw materials are placed into the crucible, gas or liquid or a mixture of the gas and the liquid is supplied from the bottom of the crucible, so that the raw materials in the crucible are in a floating state. The invention has the beneficial effects that the raw material for high-speed growth of silicon carbide crystals can be suspended conveniently by adopting the silicon carbide particles with the average particle diameter smaller than 5 mu m, so that the problem of reduction of sublimation speed and efficiency caused by overlarge bulk density in the whole sublimation process can be avoided, the sublimation quantity of silicon carbide is improved, and the purposes of improving the sublimation speed and efficiency are realized.

title_en: Ceramic/carbon composite structure film material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ceramic/carbon composite structure film material and a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of ceramic material preparation. A preparation method of a ceramic/carbon composite structure film material comprises the following steps of taking a ceramic material as a sputtering target material, performing magnetron sputtering on a substrate with a paraffin oil layer on the surface, forming a first composite film on the substrate, wherein the first composite film comprises a polymer gel film formed by crosslinking paraffin oil and a ceramic film positioned on the polymer gel film, immersing the substrate with the first composite film on the surface into petroleum ether, standing for 2-12 h, stripping the substrate to obtain a second composite film, and sintering the second composite film in an inert atmosphere to obtain the ceramic/carbon composite structure film material. The invention utilizes the polymer gel film to realize the limited-area sintering of ceramic material particles, refines grains, reduces sintering temperature and saves energy.

title_en: Composite explosion venting plate for treating five diseases and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of explosion venting plates for building materials, and mainly discloses a five-treatment composite explosion venting plate and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the composite explosion venting plate comprises fireproof heat preservation filling, and composite explosion venting back plates and honeycomb plates which are arranged at two sides of the fireproof heat preservation filling, the honeycomb plates comprise honeycomb cores, honeycomb back plates and composite explosion venting face plates which are arranged at two sides of the honeycomb cores, one side of each honeycomb back plate of each honeycomb plate is connected with the fireproof heat preservation filling, a first bending part is arranged at the side of each composite explosion venting back plate, the side of the compound explosion venting panel is provided with a second bending part, the joint of the first bending part and the second bending part is bonded through sealant, a frame is arranged at the peripheral edge of the honeycomb panel, and the compound explosion venting panel manufactured by the method solves the problems of poor sealing and waterproof effects and poor flatness, which are caused by the leakage of rock wool in the prior art, and meets the performance requirements of the existing metal explosion venting panel.

title_en: Transformer substation noise reduction device
abstract_en: The invention provides a transformer substation noise reduction device, which relates to the technical field of electric equipment and comprises a sound insulation shell covered outside a transformer substation body, a base mechanism arranged at the upper end and the lower end, and an inner sound insulation layer, wherein the sound insulation shell and the inner sound insulation layer form a double-layer sound insulation structure, sound waves are weakened through air damping of a sound insulation cavity, a honeycomb sound absorption layer is arranged on the inner wall of the inner sound insulation layer, sound energy is further dissipated, the base mechanism comprises a transverse frame part and a plurality of damping and noise reduction supporting parts, the supporting parts are elastically and slidably connected with the hollow supporting parts through connecting frames, and are provided with a reverse acting rotating unit and a deformation buffer plate.

title_en: Weather-resistant galvanization treatment device and treatment process for power cable support profile steel by blowing weakened zinc hammer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of steel section galvanization, in particular to a power cable bracket steel section weather resistance galvanization treatment device for blowing and weakening a zinc hammer and a treatment process thereof, comprising a bracket, a guide rail and a treatment pool, wherein the guide rail and the treatment pool are arranged on the bracket; the clamping regulation and control mechanism is arranged on the support plate, can control two clamping plates to execute alternative clamping actions on the profile steel through the movable rods, can ensure that the profile steel is always in a clamping state and the clamped position is galvanized equally under the condition of ensuring that the galvanized dead angle does not appear when the profile steel is galvanized.

title_en: High-vacuum in-situ rapid target changing device and method for pulse laser deposition system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high vacuum in-situ rapid target changing device and method for a pulse laser deposition system, which belong to the technical field of preparing high-performance superconducting films, wherein the device comprises a target bracket, a sample conveying rod and a target clamping seat which are integrated together, and the whole structure of the target bracket comprises an upper part and a lower part which are connected by two ends of a vertical plate; the lower part connected with the first end of the vertical plate comprises two extended branches, the two branches are of symmetrical structures and mutually matched to realize the bearing of the target clamping seat, and the upper part connected with the second end of the vertical plate is sequentially arranged from the vertical plate outwards, wherein the contact surface of the end face of the target bracket and the transmission rod, the second fixing pin of the transmission rod, and the target bracket of the target bracket and the first fixing pin of the transmission rod. The modularized vacuum isolated target conveying device has good expandability and applicability, and can meet the problem of high-efficiency and clean target conveying requirements of an industrial multi-chamber system.

title_en: Preparation method of metal doped amorphous carbon film for flexible piezoresistive sensor
abstract_en: A method for preparing metal doped amorphous carbon film used for flexible piezoresistance sensing includes such steps as 1) respectively installing and fixing pure graphite target and metal-graphite spliced target on two planar rectangular targets in vacuum chamber of octahedral structure film deposition equipment, connecting pure graphite target and metal-graphite spliced target to positive and negative poles of same power supply, sequentially fixing multiple cleaned flexible substrates on the corresponding positions of sample frame, installing sample frame on revolution support of vacuum chamber, 2) vacuumizing vacuum chamber until vacuum degree reaches 5×10  ‑4  Pa, 3) rotating sample frame in front of ion source by revolution support, etching flexible substrates by oxygen ion by regulating oxygen ion etching parameters, 4) after etching, rotating sample frame to the middle of two planar rectangular targets by revolution support, and controlling deposition of carbon ion and metal ion according to deposition parameters to form amorphous carbon film with different metal doping contents on each flexible substrate.

title_en: Intelligent laser cladding powder concentration regulation and control system based on ultrasonic vibration
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent laser cladding powder concentration regulating and controlling system based on ultrasonic vibration, which belongs to the technical field of industrial production and comprises a laser channel (1), a laser channel vibration prevention interlayer (2), a powder input channel (3), a powder transmission channel (4), a water cooling water inlet (5), a water cooling water outlet (6), a water cooling pipeline (7), an amplitude transformer (8), an ultrasonic vibration module shell (9), an ultrasonic vibration generator (10), an ultrasonic vibration transducer (11), a cable (12), a concentration detection device (13), an air injection device (14), an outer wall (15) and an automatic control system (16). The invention integrates ultrasonic vibration depth into the whole flow of powder homogenization and concentration regulation, constructs a co-efficient cladding quality improving system, and improves the cladding quality and the production efficiency as a whole.

title_en: Aluminum alloy polishing solution and polishing method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses an aluminum alloy polishing solution and a polishing method thereof, wherein the aluminum alloy polishing solution comprises, by mass, 30-40 parts of citric acid, 2-3 parts of phytic acid, 2-4 parts of sodium molybdate, 70-80 parts of an oxidant, 50-60 parts of nano SiO2 slurry, 3-5 parts of a nonionic surfactant, 0.1-0.2 part of a catalyst and 7-8 parts of a pH buffer, wherein the solid content of the nano SiO2 slurry is 10%, citric acid is used for gently chelating aluminum ions, the dissolution rate is controlled, 6 phosphoric acid groups contained in phytic acid form a compact multi-tooth chelating film with the aluminum surface, but micropores exist, moO 42-anions are generated after molybdate is dissolved and migrate to the pores or defects of the phytic acid film, the slow release effect is better achieved in a synergistic manner, and the surface is prevented from being unsmooth due to over-corrosion.

title_en: Magnetron device, upper electrode structure and semiconductor process equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a magnetron device, an upper electrode structure and semiconductor process equipment. The magnetron device comprises a driving assembly, a first transmission assembly, a swinging assembly and a magnetic control assembly, wherein the driving assembly drives the first transmission assembly to drive the magnetic control assembly and the swinging assembly to rotate around a first rotation axis along a first direction, meanwhile, the swinging assembly rotates around a second rotation axis along the first direction, at least two positions of different vertical distances exist between the outer peripheral surface of the swinging assembly and the second rotation axis, and the magnetic control assembly can swing reciprocally around a third rotation axis under the condition that the outer peripheral surface of the swinging assembly is in limit fit with the magnetic control assembly, and the first rotation axis, the second rotation axis and the first rotation axis are parallel to each other. The magnetic control assembly of the application rotates and regularly swings at a certain amplitude, thereby weakening the difference of corrosion speed on the target material, improving the corrosion uniformity of the target material and further improving the utilization rate of the target material.

title_en: Silicon carbide chemical vapor deposition reaction equipment and method
abstract_en: The application relates to and discloses silicon carbide chemical vapor deposition reaction equipment and a method. Relates to the technical field of semiconductor material molding. The crystal growth device comprises a flow guide cavity and a crystal growth cavity, wherein a first gas channel and a first heating piece are arranged in the flow guide cavity, the first gas channel extends in a bent shape, the first heating piece is uniformly distributed on the inner wall of the first gas channel, a second gas channel and a second heating piece are arranged in the crystal growth cavity, and the second heating piece is uniformly distributed on the inner wall of the second gas channel. The first gas channel is bent to extend, so that the time for the gas to flow through the first gas channel before reaction can be prolonged, the first heating pieces are uniformly distributed on the inner wall of the first gas channel, a uniform thermal field is generated in the first gas channel, the pyrolysis rate of reaction precursor gas is improved, the preparation efficiency of silicon carbide epitaxial layer crystals is further improved, and the preparation quality of the silicon carbide epitaxial layer crystals is improved.

title_en: Rosin solution coating equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses rosin solution coating equipment, and belongs to the field of coating equipment. The automatic cleaning device comprises a feeding assembly, a coating assembly, a smearing assembly and a supply assembly, wherein the coating assembly is arranged on one side of the feeding assembly, the smearing assembly is arranged between two groups of mounting frames, the supply assembly is arranged on a coating part, the supply assembly comprises a mounting part arranged on the side face of the coating part, the mounting part is provided with a first storage bottle for storing cleaning agents and a second storage bottle for storing rosin solutions, and one end of the mounting part is provided with a rotating part for realizing solution supply switching between the first storage bottle and the second storage bottle. According to the rosin solution coating equipment, the moving part drives the coating part to axially move along the coating roller, the pressing part and the driving part are matched to apply pressure, so that the rosin solution is uniformly coated on the roller surface, coating uniformity is improved, and when the equipment is stopped, the cleaning part, the switching part and the supply assembly are matched to switch to a cleaning mode, so that the equipment is comprehensively cleaned, efficiency is improved, rosin solution residues are avoided, and next coating quality is ensured.

title_en: High-moisture-absorption sweat-releasing polyester fabric and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-moisture-absorption sweat-releasing polyester fabric and a preparation method thereof, which relate to the technical field of polyester fabrics and comprise an outer layer fabric, a middle moisture-conducting layer and an inner layer hydrophilic layer, wherein the middle moisture-conducting layer is arranged between the outer layer fabric and the inner layer hydrophilic layer, the outer layer fabric, the middle moisture-conducting layer and the inner layer hydrophilic layer are fixedly connected through hot pressing, so that an integrated composite fabric is formed, the middle moisture-conducting layer is composed of a plurality of moisture-conducting groove strips which are arranged in parallel, the cross section of each moisture-conducting groove strip is of a V-shaped structure, and the notch faces the inner layer hydrophilic layer and is used for guiding sweat to be transmitted unidirectionally from inside to outside. According to the invention, through the cooperative design of the multilayer structure, the complete sweat-releasing chain with the advantages of rapid moisture absorption, high-efficiency moisture conduction and rapid evaporation is constructed, and the moisture absorption and sweat release performances and wearing dryness of the polyester fabric in a high-humidity environment are improved.

title_en: Washable medical fabric and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical textiles, in particular to a washable medical fabric and a preparation method thereof, the fabric comprises an antibacterial antistatic outer layer, a PTFE film and an antibacterial antistatic inner layer, the PTFE film is coated with conductive paste between the antibacterial antistatic outer layer and the antibacterial antistatic inner layer, the antibacterial antistatic inner layer is formed by blending and weaving antibacterial yarns and carbon nanotube conductive yarns, and the antibacterial antistatic outer layer is formed by blending and weaving antibacterial yarns and silver-plated conductive polyester yarns. The PTFE film allows air circulation, but can block liquid water such as sweat, liquid medicine and the like, and improves the protection and comfort of fabric wearing.

title_en: Shelter radiation shielding coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of radiation shielding coating preparation, and discloses a shelter radiation shielding coating and a preparation method thereof, which comprises the steps of periodically injecting reactive gas in pulse in a constant physical sputtering environment, triggering selective chemical reaction in situ at a coating growth interface to generate a microstructure with a hard phase and a nanometer toughening phase alternating, the invention improves the stress dissipation and crack inhibition capability for the high-density coating by the constructed periodic nanometer toughening layer, thereby solving the technical problem that the high-density and high-dynamic fatigue resistance of the traditional coating are mutually restricted.

title_en: Dampproof composite wallboard and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a moistureproof composite wallboard, which relates to the technical field of wallboards and comprises a gas guide layer, a moistureproof layer and a finish coat, wherein the gas guide layer, the moistureproof layer and the finish coat are sequentially bonded, the gas guide layer is made of metal, a plurality of gas guide through holes are formed in the gas guide layer, one end of each gas guide through hole, which is close to the moistureproof layer, is higher than the other end of each gas guide through hole, the material of the moistureproof layer is sheet molding compound, the finish coat comprises a substrate and a humidifying coating which is coated on the surface of the substrate and wraps the substrate, the substrate is made of a wood board, a plurality of ventilation holes are formed in the finish coat, one opening of each ventilation hole is positioned on one side, which is close to the moistureproof layer, of the other opening of each ventilation hole is filled with the humidifying coating, and part of the humidifying coating is positioned between the humidifying coating and the moistureproof layer. The preparation method comprises the steps of firstly preparing the air guide layer, the moisture-proof layer and the finish coat, and then sequentially bonding the air guide layer, the moisture-proof layer and the finish coat. The moisture-proof effect of the wallboard is improved.

title_en: Fluoride-salt-free nitrate-free steel plate enamel medium-temperature pearlescent glaze and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fluoride salt-free and nitrate-free steel plate enamel medium-temperature pearlescent glaze and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of enamel. The pearlescent glaze is composed of quartz, borax zero water, titanium dioxide, magnesium carbonate, sodium tripolyphosphate, potassium carbonate, lithium carbonate, potassium feldspar, zinc oxide and V-26 according to a specific mass ratio. The preparation method comprises the steps of raw material mixing, high-temperature melting under pure oxygen condition, wiredrawing detection, quenching and the like. The pearlescent glaze is completely free of fluoride and nitrate, the problems of fluoride emission and environmental protection equipment blockage are avoided from the source, the fluorine content of the product is not detected after detection, the product meets the requirements of European Union REACH regulations, and meanwhile, the pearlescent glaze has good porcelain surface, luster and medium-temperature firing adaptability, is suitable for a steel plate substrate, has the firing temperature of 800-830 ℃, and can be used for the production of environmental protection enamel products.

title_en: Green hydrogen coupled biomass ethylene preparation process system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a green hydrogen coupling biomass ethylene production process system and method, wherein the system comprises a wind-solar power generation subunit, a water electrolysis subunit, a reverse water gas conversion subunit, a methanol synthesis subunit, a methanol dehydration subunit, a dimethyl ether carbonylation unit, a methyl acetate hydrogenation unit and an ethanol dehydration unit which are sequentially connected, and also comprises a biomass combustion subunit and a carbon dioxide capturing unit which are connected, wherein the carbon dioxide output end of the carbon dioxide capturing unit is connected with the input end of the reverse water gas conversion subunit. The process system and the method for preparing ethylene by using the green hydrogen coupled biomass convert green hydrogen and biomass energy into high-value chemical ethylene, have high carbon yield in the whole process, and have the potential of carbon emission reduction and economy.

title_en: Method for preparing metal hafnium by reduction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rare metals and provides a method for preparing metal hafnium by reduction, which comprises the following steps of S1, mixing hafnium oxide, calcium and calcium chloride, and carrying out thermal reduction reaction under protective gas to obtain a solid mixture; S2, carrying out acid washing, water washing and drying on the solid mixture to obtain metal hafnium powder, S3, melting the metal hafnium powder under protective gas, and carrying out cold press molding to obtain the metal hafnium, wherein the calcium chloride consists of first calcium chloride and second calcium chloride, and the forms of the first calcium chloride and the second calcium chloride are different. Through the technical scheme, the problem of high oxygen content in the reduction preparation of the metal hafnium in the related technology is solved.

title_en: Non-woven fabric bag for water-based ink flexography and forming process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-woven fabric bag for water-based ink flexography and a forming process, and belongs to the technical field of non-woven fabric bags; the non-woven fabric bag comprises a non-woven fabric bag body, wherein the non-woven fabric bag body is of a multi-layer composite structure and sequentially comprises a printing layer, an adhesive layer, a bright light protection layer, a first bonding layer, a non-woven fabric substrate layer, a second bonding layer and a blocking layer from outside to inside; according to the invention, the water-based ink is adopted to replace the traditional oily ink, and the solvent-free composite process is matched, so that the whole process has no emission of toxic waste gas and waste liquid such as VOCs and the like, the environmental pollution and the occupational health risk of operators are completely eradicated from the source, and the environment-friendly production requirement is met; through the combined design of flexography and wear-resistant matte oil coating, the printed pattern has excellent scratch resistance, wear resistance and fading resistance, and meanwhile, the solvent-free compounding and full curing process ensures high peel strength of each layer, avoids layering phenomenon, and remarkably improves the durability of the product.

title_en: Coating film carrier
abstract_en: The invention provides a film plating carrier which comprises a carrier body, at least two rows of substrate bins and at least two layers of film plating layers, wherein the carrier body comprises a body bottom plate and body side plates, the body side plates are positioned on two sides of the body bottom plate, the substrate bins are arranged in the carrier body along the width direction and are used for stacking and placing substrates, and each row of substrate bins extending along the length direction is provided with an opening for exposing a substrate cutting surface. The coating carrier provided by the invention can improve the productivity and simultaneously meet the requirement that only the cutting surface of the substrate is coated with the coating and the passivation film is not deposited on other planes.

title_en: Preparation method of laser cladding alloy coating for hot galvanizing sink roll
abstract_en: The invention relates to a laser cladding alloy coating for a hot galvanizing sink roll and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of metal surface treatment. The method comprises the steps of preparing alloy powder, wherein the mass percentages of elements are 25-30% of Co, 18-24% of Cr, 10-30% of Fe, 5-20% of Ni, 8-12% of Mn, 1-3% of W, 1-2% of Mo, 1-2.5% of Si and 0-2% of B, controlling (Cr+Ni/2+Fe) =37.1-53.5%, pretreating and preheating a sink roll, preparing an alloy coating on the surface of a preheated substrate by adopting a laser cladding process, and finally carrying out heat treatment at 600-750 ℃. According to the method, the problem of cracks caused by mismatch of thermal expansion coefficients of the high alloy coating and the 316L stainless steel matrix is solved by controlling the content relation of chromium element, nickel element and iron element in the alloy powder and heat treatment, so that the hardness, the bonding strength and the service life of the coating are obviously improved.

title_en: Preparation method for improving uniformity of probe card film resistor
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method for improving uniformity of a thin film resistor of a probe card, which comprises the following steps of carrying out pretreatment on the top surface of a ceramic substrate, coating polyimide on the top surface of the ceramic substrate to form a polyimide layer, coating photoresist on the top surface of the polyimide layer to form a photoresist layer, exposing and developing to form a resistor circuit pattern, coating a film on the resistor circuit pattern to form a thin film resistor, and removing the photoresist layer, wherein the step 50 is carried out. The preparation method for improving the uniformity of the thin film resistor of the probe card can effectively improve the uniformity of the thin film resistor and the reliability of the probe card.

title_en: Quick forming process of valve core and valve sleeve of servo valve without matched grinding
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid forming process of a valve core and a valve sleeve of a servo valve without matched grinding, which relates to the technical field of servo valve processing and forming, and comprises the following steps of firstly, valve sleeve and valve core processing, secondly, material inspection, thirdly, surface treatment, fourthly, ultrasonic cleaning, fifth, part clamping, sixth, vacuumizing, seventh, argon ion bombardment cleaning, eighth, chromium deposition, ninth, gradient chromium carbide transition layer deposition, tenth, hydrogenated diamond-like carbon top layer deposition, eleventh, cooling and tapping. The rapid forming process of the valve core and the valve sleeve of the servo valve without the match grinding can shorten the processing period of a slide valve component by 30 percent, reduce the material cost by 80 percent and realize the interchangeability of the valve sleeve and the valve core in the slide valve component.

title_en: Co3S4/MnCo-LDH/MnCo2S4Nanocomposite material, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electrode materials, in particular to a Co  3 S 4 /MnCo-LDH/MnCo 2 S 4  nano composite material, a preparation method and application thereof.
