According to the preparation method, soluble manganese salt and soluble cobalt salt are used as raw materials, foam nickel is used as a carrier, hydrothermal reaction is carried out in an alkaline environment to obtain MnCo-LDH/NF, then the MnCo-LDH/NF is immersed in a precursor solution consisting of the soluble cobalt salt and 2-methylimidazole, coordination reaction is carried out to obtain MnCo-LDH@ZIF-67/NF, and finally thioacetamide is adopted to carry out incomplete vulcanization on the MnCo-LDH@ZIF-67/NF to obtain the Co  3 S 4 /MnCo-LDH/MnCo 2 S 4  nano composite material. The technical defects of MnCo  2 S 4  are overcome by Co  3 S 4  and MnCo-LDH.

title_en: Door pressing device with glue overflow removal function
abstract_en: The invention provides a door pressing device with glue overflow removal, which comprises a frame, wherein a pressing block installed through a bearing platform and a cylinder is arranged on the frame, removal units are arranged on the periphery of the bearing platform on the frame, each removal unit comprises a mounting frame arranged on the frame, a shell is arranged on the mounting frame in a lifting manner, a scraping mechanism in the shell is arranged on the shell, a driving mechanism for driving the scraping mechanism to intermittently move in a circumferential direction is arranged on the shell, a transmission mechanism connected with the shell is arranged on the mounting frame, the power of the driving mechanism is converted into power for driving the shell to intermittently lift through the transmission mechanism when the scraping mechanism does not move, and a cleaning mechanism connected with the scraping mechanism is also arranged in the shell. The device can effectively clear away the door plant excessive glue, reduces the door plant reworking that excessive glue remains to lead to, combines automatic operating characteristic, reduces cost of labor and production loss, avoids causing the pollution to operational environment, accords with the trade demand that the timber production improves quality and increases efficiency.

title_en: Disassembly-free composite heat preservation template and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disassembly-free composite heat preservation template and a construction method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of composite heat preservation templates. The composite heat-insulating layer is a modified polyurethane plate with gradient density, the density of the composite heat-insulating layer is gradually changed from 30kg/m < 3 > to 50kg/m < 3 >, and glass fiber reinforced plastic grids are embedded in the composite heat-insulating layer; according to the technical scheme, the composite heat-insulating layer made of the gradient density modified polyurethane board can give consideration to heat-insulating performance and structural strength, so that the contradiction that the high-strength template is too high in heat conductivity coefficient or the template is low in strength due to low heat conductivity coefficient is solved.

title_en: High-barrier light-enzyme double-response controllable degradation three-layer composite film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of film packaging, in particular to a high-barrier photo-enzyme double-response controllable degradation three-layer composite film and a preparation method thereof, wherein a base material layer and a functional layer are subjected to film blowing process by a double-layer co-extrusion film blowing machine to form a double-layer composite film, the surface of the double-layer composite film is coated with a barrier layer by a coating machine after cooling, the Gao Zuge light-enzyme double-response controllable degradation three-layer composite film is obtained after drying, and the preparation method of the high-barrier light-enzyme double-response controllable degradation three-layer composite film provided by the invention is simple, low in cost and high in barrier property, realizes rapid, illumination and enzymolysis double-signal triggering, realizes rapid and controllable degradation, and solves the industrial problem that environmental friendliness and functionality are difficult to be compatible.

title_en: Brushing device and brushing assembly
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wheel axle coating, and provides a brushing device and a brushing assembly, wherein the brushing device comprises a first brushing piece; the device comprises a first brushing piece, a second brushing piece, two bearing pieces, a first brushing piece, a second brushing piece and a second brushing piece, wherein the first brushing piece is arranged below the first brushing piece and the second brushing piece at intervals along a first direction, each bearing piece is used for bearing a single wheel shaft and driving the respective wheel shaft to rotate around an axis of the bearing piece and/or driving the respective wheel shaft to move along a second direction, the rotation axis of the wheel shaft is parallel to the third direction, the first direction, the second direction and the third direction are perpendicular to each other, the first brushing piece is used for brushing the wheel shaft positioned on one bearing piece, and the second brushing piece is used for brushing the wheel shaft positioned on the other bearing piece. By the technical scheme, the coating efficiency of the whole wheel axle is improved.

title_en: High-strength high-circulation-ratio steel cord and green manufacturing process
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of steel cord manufacturing, in particular to a high-strength high-circulation-ratio steel cord, which comprises ：C 0.7-0.96%,Si 0.2-0.35%,Mn 0.15-0.35%,Cr 0.03-0.1,V 0.01-0.02,Nb 0.01-0.02%,P≤0.01%,S≤0.08%,O≤0.0015%,N≤0.005%,Alt≤0.0008%,Ti≤0.0005%,Cu≤0.25%,Sn≤0.05%, of Fe according to mass percentage, wherein the molar ratio of Ca to O is defined as B, and B is more than or equal to 0.9 and less than or equal to 1.5, and alumina and spinel inclusion are converted into low-melting-point spherical calcium aluminate through the control of the parameter B so as to reduce the hot embrittlement risk in the drawing process and also be beneficial to improving the fatigue performance of the steel cord.

title_en: Preparation method of functional composite diaphragm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a functional composite diaphragm, and relates to the technical field of hydrogen production by water electrolysis. The preparation method comprises the steps of mixing a polymer with a solvent, heating and dispersing to prepare a uniform polymer solution, mixing zirconia and a coupling agent with the solvent, conducting ultrasonic dispersion to obtain an inorganic material dispersion liquid containing the coupling agent, adding the dispersion liquid into the polymer solution under the stirring condition, continuously stirring to obtain a uniform film casting solution, forming a base film, coating the film casting solution on a polyphenylene sulfide supporting net, standing at room temperature, placing in an oven and drying to obtain a composite base film, and carrying out surface modification, namely sequentially immersing the composite base film in a first organic alkali solution and a second organic alkali solution, washing with the solvent after each immersion, and obtaining the functional composite diaphragm after washing.

title_en: Erosion resistant coating for oil and gas conveying pipe fittings and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-erosion coating for oil and gas conveying pipes and a preparation method thereof, wherein the anti-erosion coating comprises 2% -20% of Ti  2 AlC5％～30％、Ti 2  AlN and the balance of Ni-based alloy. The invention adopts the strong toughness Ni-based alloy as a matrix to ensure the toughness and the wear resistance of the coating, selects ternary MAX phase Ti  2 AlC、Ti 2  AlN as a reinforcing phase, has the characteristics of metal bonds, covalent bonds and ionic bonds in the crystal structure of MAX ceramic phase, has the characteristics of metal and ceramic, has better combination property with the Ni-based alloy matrix, can improve the combination strength between the whole coating and between the coating and the surface of the matrix, has the advantages of high hardness, high strength, wear resistance and the like, and has good plasticity and toughness. The method effectively solves the problem that the hardness and the toughness of the conventional ceramic coating are difficult to coordinate, and has the advantages of simple preparation method, high efficiency, low cost and easy realization of batch production.

title_en: Composite sacrificial anode for impregnation and phosphating process and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composite sacrificial anode for an impregnation phosphating process and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of impregnation phosphating. The composite sacrificial anode comprises, by weight, 30% -40% of phosphated residue powder, 10% -20% of a binder, 10% -20% of carbon fibers, 8% -16% of a conductive agent, 0.2% -1% of a pore-forming agent and the balance of metal oxide powder. The electrochemical synergistic composite sacrificial anode dipping and phosphating process of the invention takes the composite sacrificial anode as an anode to be placed in phosphating solution of a phosphating tank, takes a metal lining and/or a heating pipe of the phosphating tank as a cathode, and carries out dipping and phosphating reaction on metal materials to be phosphating treated. The composite sacrificial anode is used for the electrochemical synergistic composite sacrificial anode dipping and phosphating process, so that the reutilization of the phosphating slag is realized, the components in the dipping and phosphating process are efficiently supplemented, the production of the phosphating slag is less, the process is stably operated, and the equipment maintenance frequency is reduced.

title_en: Fresnel film processing method, fresnel film, PPG module and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a processing method of a Fresnel film, which is characterized by comprising the steps of coating a surface crystallization agent on the surface of the Fresnel film to form a first area, wherein the surface crystallization agent is used for promoting the Fresnel film to absorb ultraviolet laser, irradiating the first area by using the ultraviolet laser to form a first groove body, the side wall of the first groove body comprises carbon black, the carbon black comprises carbon black generated by the reaction of the Fresnel film under the irradiation of the ultraviolet laser, and the position of the first groove body corresponds to the position of the first area. The method provided by the embodiment of the application can reduce the processing procedures of the Fresnel film and improve the processing efficiency.

title_en: Preparation method of high-entropy nitride erosion-resistant coating
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a high-entropy nitride erosion resistant coating, which comprises the steps of (1) polishing, cleaning and drying a sample in sequence, then placing the sample in a vacuum coating chamber, introducing argon Ar and adjusting the flow of the sample, performing ion bombardment cleaning on the surface of the sample, (2) obtaining the optical emission intensity of plasma after introducing the argon Ar and the optical emission intensity of plasma after introducing nitrogen N  2 , (3) depositing a high-entropy alloy transition layer on the surface of the sample, (4) depositing the high-entropy nitride erosion resistant coating on the surface of the sample, and (5) taking out the sample to finish the preparation of the coating on the surface of the sample. The invention adopts bipolar high-power pulse magnetron sputtering technology and an ion source to jointly construct a high-density plasma film forming environment to finish the preparation of the high-entropy nitride erosion resistant coating, can effectively inhibit the nitriding reaction on the surface of a target material, realizes that the characteristic peak intensity of plasma is kept unchanged, and ensures the stability of plasma components in the film forming process.

title_en: Method for producing a ceria-based multilayer ceramic scaffold with a dense layer and a porous layer
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for producing a doped ceria, preferably Gadolinium Doped Ceria (GDC), multilayer ceramic scaffold comprising a porous layer and a dense layer, wherein the porous layer is obtained from a suspension comprising at least two different pore formers. The invention also relates to a unit solid state battery (SOC) comprising the multilayer ceramic support. The invention also relates to the use of a doped ceria, preferably GDC ceramic suspension comprising at least two different pore formers for reducing shrinkage differences during co-sintering of the multilayer ceramic scaffold.

title_en: Brass/steel composite board prepared in situ by utilizing electric arc spraying and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method for preparing a brass/steel composite board in situ by utilizing electric arc spraying, which comprises the following steps: step S1, spraying a pure copper layer on the surface of a steel plate with a clean surface; step S2, spraying a zinc layer on the surface of the pure copper layer; step S3, obtaining a brass/steel composite board through heat treatment; compared with the prior art, the method adopts a mode of combining spraying and heat treatment to realize in-situ preparation of the brass coating through chemical reaction and in-situ synthesis, replaces the traditional mechanical pressing method and the like, and thus has breakthrough advantages in the aspects of shortening the flow, reducing the cost and creating new products; the prepared brass/steel composite plate has improved interfacial bonding strength and ductility and corrosion resistance of the final coating.

title_en: Tipping paper capable of reducing release amount of harmful ingredients in smoke and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses tipping paper capable of reducing the release amount of harmful ingredients in smoke and a preparation method thereof, wherein the tipping paper comprises modified cellulose fiber base paper and an upper layer and a lower layer of breathable tipping paper base paper, the modified cellulose fiber base paper is prepared by introducing a compound containing a plurality of amino groups on an alcohol hydroxyl group on a cellulose macromer for modification and then further doping calcium chloride and activated carbon powder, a first glue coating layer is arranged between the modified cellulose fiber base paper and the lower layer of breathable tipping paper base paper, a second glue coating layer is arranged between the modified cellulose fiber base paper and the upper layer of breathable tipping paper base paper, the first glue coating layer and the second glue coating layer do not completely cover the modified cellulose fiber base paper, and an uncovered area is used as a breathable area. The tipping paper can effectively reduce the release amount of various harmful components in the smoke, and obviously improves the reduction effect of ammonia, phenol and crotonaldehyde.

title_en: Article, method for producing article, foamable adhesive sheet, and adhesive composition
abstract_en: In the present disclosure, there is provided an article comprising a first member, a second member, and an adhesive member disposed between the first member and the second member, wherein the adhesive member has at least a cured adhesive layer, the cured adhesive layer is a foam layer containing a foamed cured product of an adhesive composition containing a curable adhesive and a foaming agent, the curable adhesive is a thermosetting adhesive, the foaming agent is a thermally expandable microcapsule, and the number of bubbles having a length in the thickness direction of the foam layer of a value of-6 μm or more in a cross section parallel to the thickness direction of the foam layer is less than 7 per 4mm in a direction perpendicular to the thickness direction of the foam layer.

title_en: Method for synthesizing N-oxo-phosphazone compound by electrochemical driving intermolecular addition of aryl phosphine oxide and diazo compound
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for synthesizing N-oxo-hydrazone compounds by electrochemical driving of intermolecular addition of aryl phosphine oxide and diazo compounds, which relates to the technical field of preparation of N-oxo-hydrazone compounds, wherein a compound 1 is used as a nitrogen-terminated electrophile, a compound 2, an electrolyte and a solvent are added into an electrochemical reaction tank, and then a constant current is introduced to drive the compound 2 and the compound 1 to synthesize a compound 3 by intermolecular nucleophilic addition; therefore, the preparation method realizes the intermolecular nucleophilic addition of aryl phosphine oxide to the diazonium compound through a green and efficient electrochemical synthesis way, efficiently constructs an N-oxo-phosphohydrazone skeleton, has mild reaction conditions, does not need to use heavy metal catalysis and an oxidant/reducer, ensures that the reaction flow is concise, the reagent is easy to obtain, and greatly reduces the operation complexity.

title_en: Manufacturing process and manufacturing system of easily-recycled packaging material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a manufacturing process and a manufacturing system of an easily-recycled packaging material, wherein the manufacturing process at least comprises S1, printing; S2, coating a protective layer, S3, die cutting, S4, first gluing, S5, second gluing, S6, third gluing, S7, preheating before compounding, S8, compounding and the like, and finally forming the packaging material. The preparation system is used for realizing the manufacturing process of the easily-recycled packaging material. The compounding process of the manufacturing process is carried out by adopting a pressing process, and the environment-friendly water-based heat-sealing glue is adopted for bonding, so that the odor of a production place is small, even no peculiar smell exists, the environment is protected, and only one side (the back side) of the paper is required to be heated before compounding, so that the process is simple and the cost is low. All the adhesive and the waterproof coating are made of environment-friendly water-based materials, and compared with the traditional plastic used as a protective layer and an adhesive, the waterproof coating has the advantages of environmental protection, no toxicity, small smell, simple preparation, simple components, satisfaction of food-grade use requirements and the like.

title_en: Wear-resistant woven fabric and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wear-resistant fabric and a preparation method thereof, relating to the technical field of silicon carbide fibers and fabrics thereof, wherein the fabric sequentially comprises a functional protective layer, an energy dissipation intermediate layer and a flexible bearing substrate layer from the surface to the inside, the concentrated punctiform stress is dispersed into planar stress, the initial puncture is resisted by utilizing the high rigidity of the punctiform stress, the stress is transferred to the middle energy dissipation layer, the high-strength high-modulus fiber skeleton conducts main load, the thermoplastic polyurethane elastic fiber wrapped on the three-dimensional network-shaped fiber skeleton is elastically deformed, the mechanical energy is converted into the internal friction heat energy of the material to be dissipated, the fiber instant breakage caused by local aggregation of the stress is avoided, and the residual weak stress is absorbed by the soft knitted substrate layer of the bottom layer.

title_en: Deplating liquid and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a deplating solution and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of metal surface treatment. The stripping solution comprises organic phosphonic acid, fluoride, an organic corrosion inhibitor and water, wherein the organic phosphonic acid has a plurality of phosphate groups in a molecular structure, can form extremely stable complex with zinc ions and nickel ions and has good water solubility, the metal ions of a plating layer are stripped from the surface of a workpiece and are stabilized in the solution, the fluoride ions have extremely small ionic radius and strong coordination capacity, can preferentially adsorb and penetrate through an oxide film to react with metal oxides in the fluoride ions to generate soluble oxyfluoride complex, a new metal layer is exposed for complexing dissolution of the organic phosphonic acid, the core function of the organic corrosion inhibitor is selective adsorption and protection, the organic corrosion inhibitor can be preferentially adsorbed on an active point of an exposed substrate to form a layer of compact single-molecule protective film, the corrosion reaction of the stripping solution on the substrate is inhibited, and meanwhile, the stripping solution is green and environment-friendly.

title_en: Explosion-proof gas tank pulse bag dust collector
abstract_en: The invention discloses an explosion-proof gas tank pulse bag type dust collector, which relates to the technical field of explosion-proof dust collectors and comprises a pulse bag, a fixed disk and an antistatic support frame, wherein the pulse bag comprises a conductive outer layer, a conductive middle layer and a conductive inner layer, the side surface of the outer wall of the conductive inner layer is provided with the conductive middle layer, the outer side of the conductive middle layer is provided with the conductive outer layer, the top ends of the outer walls of the conductive outer layer, the conductive middle layer and the conductive inner layer are connected to the bottom end of the outer wall of the fixed disk, the top end of the outer wall of the fixed disk is provided with the antistatic support frame, and the antistatic support frame is arranged inside the conductive inner layer. According to the invention, the conductive outer layer, the conductive middle layer, the conductive inner layer and the antistatic support frame are arranged, so that the graded filtration and three-layer three-dimensional static discharge are realized, the redundancy and reliability of equipment are improved, the full coverage and low-resistance conduction removal of a static generation source are realized, the risk source of igniting explosive dust by static discharge is fundamentally eliminated, and the stability and durability of an explosion-proof function are ensured.

title_en: Electrorefining equipment and electrorefining method suitable for online discharging
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to the technical field of electrolytic production, recovery or refining of metals by a molten liquid electrolytic method, in particular to electrolytic refining equipment and an electrolytic refining method suitable for online discharging, comprising an electrolytic heating device, a molten salt, a molten metal melting device and a molten metal melting device, wherein the electrolytic heating device is used for melting molten salt before the start of an electrolytic reaction; the mobile device is used for transferring the cathode and the anode basket, the cathode is used for providing an adhesion space for an electrolysis product generated by the electrolysis reaction, the anode basket is used for containing spent fuel, and the electrolysis product recovery device is used for carrying out online recovery on the electrolysis product on the cathode. The embodiment of the application can realize the purpose of online discharging, is beneficial to simplifying the space occupation of electrolytic refining equipment, simultaneously utilizes the second scraping component to scrape the electrolytic products on the removed cathode, and then utilizes the second retrieving component to collect the scraped electrolytic products, thereby being beneficial to separating out the electrolytic products by utilizing a plurality of cathodes in the same electrolytic reaction process, and further improving the treatment efficiency of spent fuel.

title_en: Conductive film material, preparation method thereof and electronic device
abstract_en: The application discloses a conductive film material, a preparation method thereof and an electronic device, wherein the conductive film material comprises a transparent substrate; the reflecting layer is arranged on one side of the transparent substrate and comprises silver and palladium, and the palladium content of one side, close to the transparent substrate, of the reflecting layer is smaller than that of one side, far away from the transparent substrate. The conductive film material has high conductivity, low light loss, good reflectivity and permeability, high stability, long service life and excellent overall performance, and is adjustable.

title_en: Couple production facility
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a hook production equipment, belonging to the technical field of hook production, comprising a first rotating disk, a second rotating disk, a plum blossom sheet feeding mechanism, a hook body feeding mechanism, a film feeding mechanism, and a hook plum blossom sheet transfer component. At the same time, the first rotating disk is provided with a coating component, and the second rotating disk is provided with an exhaust component, a curing component, and a hook body feeding component. The present invention can solve the technical problem of the prior art using linear layout, which leads to equipment redundancy and occupies a large amount of production space.

title_en: Pole changing method and device for changing anode of electrolytic aluminum
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pole changing method for changing an anode of electrolytic aluminum, which comprises the following steps of enabling a positioning mechanism and a clamping mechanism to descend to a preset position along an anode rod, enabling a clamping head of the clamping arm of the positioning mechanism to be aligned with a lifting hole of the anode rod by the aid of the positioning mechanism, driving the clamping head of the clamping arm to be inserted into the lifting hole of the anode rod, removing a bolt for locking the anode rod by a head screwing mechanism, and changing a new anode rod after removing the anode rod. The method also comprises a pole changing device capable of realizing the method. When the anode replacing device is used for replacing an anode, a large distance can be kept between the locating mechanism and the anode rod, the locating mechanism is driven to align the clamping arm relative to the anode rod, the clamping head of the clamping arm can be aligned to a lifting hole of the anode rod, the clamping head cannot collide with the anode rod when being inserted into the lifting hole, and finally the operation difficulty of operators can be reduced, and collision between the clamping head and the anode rod can be avoided.

title_en: Stainless steel product and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a stainless steel product and a manufacturing method thereof. The method for manufacturing the stainless steel product comprises the steps of reducing the iron content of the surface layer of the stainless steel molded product to obtain a treated stainless steel molded product, and placing the treated stainless steel molded product in a mixed gas with oxygen and steam for oxidation treatment to form a closed layer with chromium-containing oxide on the surface layer of the treated stainless steel molded product, so that the stainless steel product is obtained. According to the manufacturing method of the stainless steel product provided by the embodiment of the application, the stainless steel product with excellent temperature resistance, wear resistance and corrosion resistance can be obtained.

title_en: Wafer carrying device and semiconductor film forming device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wafer bearing device and a semiconductor film forming device, wherein the wafer bearing device comprises a rotary cylinder and a tray, the rotary cylinder comprises a body and an upper cover which are connected in a split mode, the body comprises a cylinder part and a bearing part which extends inwards in the radial direction of the cylinder part, the bearing part is positioned above the cylinder part, the bearing part comprises a bearing surface and an extending surface which surrounds the bearing surface, the tray is arranged on the bearing surface, the tray is used for bearing wafers, the upper cover is arranged around the tray, the upper cover and the tray are separated in space, the upper cover comprises an upper cover plate part and a side edge part which is connected with the upper cover plate part, the upper cover plate part at least partially covers the extending surface, the side edge part is arranged around the outside of the cylinder part, and the side edge part extends along the axial direction of the cylinder part. The invention can prolong the maintenance period of the semiconductor film forming device, reduce the use cost of equipment and improve the preparation efficiency of wafers.

title_en: Treating agent and application thereof as material for improving wettability of surface of coating
abstract_en: The invention provides a treating agent and an application thereof as a material for improving coating surface wettability, wherein the treating agent comprises 99-105 parts by volume of methanol, 0.2-1 part by volume of 1, 2-octanediol, 0.05-1 part by volume of alkylphenol ethoxylate and 0.05-1 part by volume of fatty alcohol ethoxylate. The technical problems that the strength is insufficient and the falling risk exists when an electroplated workpiece and other parts are adhered due to the fact that the wettability of the surface of a plating layer is reduced after the existing metal surface is electroplated are solved. The invention can be widely applied to the surface treatment of the metal plating layer.

title_en: High-efficient spraying equipment of rack pole
abstract_en: The application discloses high-efficiency spraying equipment for a grid rod, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a main support frame and a slave support frame capable of sliding left and right are fixed on the bottom plate, a grid rod transmission mechanism is arranged between the main support frame and the slave support frame, a spraying box and a drying mechanism are further arranged on the bottom plate sequentially through a first mounting frame and a second mounting frame, a loading cabin is fixed at the front end of the spraying box through a support piece, and a spraying assembly capable of moving back and forth is arranged in the spraying box. Compared with the prior art, the application has the advantages that the paint can be automatically sprayed on the surface of the net rack rod in the conveying process, the problems of uneven spraying and chromatic aberration of the net rack rod caused by manual spraying can be avoided, the spraying efficiency is high, the labor intensity is low, and the mass spraying production of the net rack rod can be satisfied.

title_en: MnCo for solid oxide fuel cell connector2O4/Co3O4Coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a MnCo  2 O 4 /Co 3 O 4  coating for a Solid Oxide Fuel Cell (SOFC) connector and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of SOFC key component coatings. The coating is of a double-layer oxide skin structure, the inner layer is a Cr  2 O 3  layer, the outer layer is a MnCo  2 O 4 /Co 3 O 4  composite layer, and the coating is prepared on the surface of the SUS 430 steel substrate through two-step electrodeposition combined with a high-temperature oxidation process. The preparation method comprises four steps of substrate pretreatment, first step of electrodeposition of MnO  2  nanometer sheets, second step of electrodeposition of Co layers and high-temperature oxidation conversion under 800 ℃ air atmosphere. The coating prepared by the method has the advantages of simple and controllable preparation process, low cost, suitability for large-scale production, and capability of being widely applied to the performance improvement of a medium-temperature SOFC connector, along with 800 ℃ and 5 weeks oxidation, wherein the specific surface resistance (ASR) is 4.97mΩ cm  2 , the oxidation parabolic rate constant k  p  is 0.0306mg  2 ·cm ‑4 ·week ‑1 , and the coating has excellent high-temperature oxidation resistance, high conductivity and Cr volatilization inhibition capability.

title_en: Flame-retardant wood-plastic wallboard capable of preventing heat accumulation fire and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wallboards, in particular to a flame-retardant wood-plastic wallboard for preventing heat-gathering fire and a preparation method thereof, comprising a surface plate, an inner layer plate, a heat-gathering fire prevention layer and a heat-gathering fire prevention layer, wherein one side of the surface plate is provided with an inner concave surface; the cooling device comprises a surface plate, a connecting pin, a connecting groove, a cooling component, a high-temperature triggering component and a high-temperature triggering component, wherein the connecting pin is fixed on one side of the surface plate, the connecting groove is formed in the other side of the surface plate, the cooling component is arranged between the surface plate and the inner plate and used for cooling the surface plate, and the high-temperature triggering component is arranged between the surface plate and the inner plate and used for recognizing the high temperature of the surface plate and triggering the cooling component in a high-temperature environment. This device is through the high temperature back of discernment surface plate surface, triggers the cooling subassembly under high temperature environment, and the cooling subassembly can start fast and cool down the wallboard of corresponding position to reduce the temperature of spotlight position, avoid spotlight position because the condition emergence of fire hazard is produced to the high temperature.

title_en: Film surface treatment system and method for solvent-resistant thermosensitive film
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of heat-sensitive material production, in particular to a film surface treatment system and a film surface treatment method of a solvent-resistant heat-sensitive film, comprising a coating machine and a coating die head, wherein one side of the coating machine is fixedly provided with the coating die head, the coating machine is internally provided with a hinged guide roller group, the hinged guide roller group is fixedly provided with a drying and curing unit through screws, one side of the hinged guide roller group, which is far away from the coating machine, is connected with a conveying mechanism, the inner side of the conveying mechanism is provided with a limiting roller group, the lower end of the hinged guide roller set is connected with a roller feeding frame in a clamping mode, the hinged guide roller set comprises a hinged frame, a distance adjusting groove is formed in the hinged frame, and a spherical contact roller is movably clamped in the distance adjusting groove.

title_en: Inorganic nano ceramic surface conversion coating treating agent, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an inorganic nano ceramic surface conversion coating treating agent and a preparation method thereof. The treating agent is an aqueous system composed of magnesium compound, aluminum compound, phosphoric acid and water in specific weight percentages. After dilution and pH adjustment, the inorganic nano ceramic film can be formed on the surfaces of metals, various plating layers and glass substrates through interface induction reaction. The film layer simultaneously meets the following performances under the submicron thickness that the pencil hardness is more than or equal to 9H, the corrosion resistance time of a neutral salt spray test exceeds 500 hours, and the film layer can pass a-40 ℃ low-temperature bending test and can bear 600 ℃ high temperature. The system is purely inorganic, environment-friendly and strong in process adaptability, and provides an innovative solution for surface protection in extreme environments.

title_en: Top sealing heat preservation device and method for thermal field of directional solidification single crystal furnace
abstract_en: The invention relates to a top sealing heat preservation device and a top sealing heat preservation method for a thermal field of a directional solidification single crystal furnace, belongs to the technical field of single crystal growth equipment, and solves the problems that in the prior art, the top sealing heat preservation device is low in strength, and particularly when used for a large-size single crystal furnace, deformation, fracture or collapse easily occurs under high temperature and self gravity, the reliability is low, the whole service life is short, and a graphite soft felt is easily pulverized. The graphite cylinder comprises an upper heat-insulating layer and a lower supporting layer, wherein the upper heat-insulating layer is in contact connection with the lower supporting layer, and the shape and the size of the upper heat-insulating layer and the shape and the size of the lower supporting layer are consistent with those of the graphite cylinder. The invention adopts a double-layer composite structure formed by the upper heat preservation layer and the lower support layer to carry out top sealing heat preservation on the thermal field of the single crystal furnace, and the lower support layer adopts a graphite plate with high strength and high temperature gas scouring resistance, so that the stability of the whole structure is obviously improved and the service life is prolonged.

title_en: Thermal tearing PET release film for transfer printing of pyrograph and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a thermal tearing PET release film for hot stamping transfer printing and a preparation method thereof, wherein the thermal tearing PET release film for hot stamping transfer printing comprises a PET layer and a release layer, the release layer is arranged on the surface of the PET layer, and raw materials of the release layer comprise, by mass, 20-35 parts of modified polyacrylate, 10-25 parts of organosilicon, 1-5 parts of fluorine modified silicon dioxide, 0.5-5 parts of an auxiliary agent and 10-30 parts of a solvent, wherein the modified polyacrylate is obtained by reacting vinyl polysiloxane, polyester resin, acrylic ester and styrene. The invention improves the hot tearing effect of the film layer, can be firmly attached to the surface of the ink absorbing layer, provides a protection effect, effectively improves the printing effect on textiles, and has good application prospect.

title_en: Chemical potential and thermodynamics cooperative regulation and control method for realizing controllable preparation of perovskite phase and non-perovskite phase according to needs
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of perovskite thin film or crystal growth, and particularly relates to a chemical potential and thermodynamics cooperative regulation and control method for realizing controllable preparation of perovskite phases and non-perovskite phases as required. The method comprises the steps of fixing the main stoichiometric ratio of A-site cations and B-site cations of perovskite, regulating and controlling the composition and content of two phases of precursor solution at normal temperature by regulating the content of halogen acid as a thermodynamic perturbation agent, adopting thermodynamic induction parameters of temperature T and time T to cooperatively induce phase inversion, separating particles and solution of obtained precipitated phases, and drying at low temperature to obtain a main perovskite phase and a non-perovskite second phase pure material. The pure material prepared by the two-phase conversion process can be used for manufacturing a detection device of a thin film or crystal perovskite, so that the defect density of the device is remarkably reduced, non-radiative recombination is inhibited, the energy band structure is optimized, and charge transport is promoted, thereby improving the performance of the device.

title_en: Dynamic control purification system and method for multi-process source hydrogen
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of gas separation, and particularly relates to a dynamic control purification system and a method thereof for multi-process source hydrogen, wherein the dynamic control purification system comprises a mixing and pretreatment unit, a multi-tower PSA separation unit, a product and waste gas collection unit and a control and execution unit; the mixing and preprocessing unit comprises a gas mixer, a preheater and a deaerator which are sequentially connected, the multi-tower PSA separation unit is connected between the mixing and preprocessing unit and the product and waste gas collecting unit through a pipeline and at least comprises four adsorption towers which are connected in parallel, and the control and execution unit comprises a control module, a first online analyzer and a second online analyzer. Compared with the prior art, the method solves the problem that the operation of a fixed time sequence program in the prior art cannot effectively cope with impurity fluctuation existing in the hydrogen with mixed sources. The scheme realizes that the tiny fluctuation of the product purity is maintained under the condition of larger fluctuation of the feeding concentration based on the dynamic regulation and control of the impurity concentration, and ensures the qualified output of the product.

title_en: PVC sheet floor for ship fire prevention and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of decorative materials, and provides a ship fireproof PVC sheet floor and a preparation method thereof. According to the invention, a double flame-retardant smoke-suppressing design of the ammonium octamolybdate-silicon dioxide core-shell composite particles (the thickness of the shell layer is 30-120nm, the D50 is 0.30-1.20 mu m) and the Mg-Al-CO  3  type layered double hydroxide (the molar ratio of Mg/Al is 2.0-4.0, the interlayer spacing is 0.70-1.00 nm) is adopted, a multilayer composite structure of a high inorganic filling substrate layer (100-200 parts of magnesium hydroxide and 180-250 parts of calcium carbonate) and a nano silicon dioxide/zinc stannate modified transparent wear-resistant layer is matched, and through a precisely controlled hot-press lamination process (the lamination temperature is 135-145 ℃, the pressure is 2.7-3.3MPa and the time is 27-33 min), the problems of more than or equal to 28% of oxygen index, the smoke density grade is less than or equal to 100, the excellent wear resistance and transparent appearance are solved, the problems of narrow processing window of a high filling PVC floor, poor surface layer flame-retardant system stability and insufficient interlayer bonding toughness are solved, and the application value of a ship cabin is wide.

title_en: Coating, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coating, a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of anti-corrosion coatings. The coating for forming the coating comprises 0.2-4wt% of lamellar filler, wherein the lamellar filler is added into the aqueous resin base material to obtain the coating, the filler in the coating forms a labyrinth-shaped three-dimensional structure, the coating is applied to the surfaces of heat transfer pipelines of a heat exchanger, particularly special-shaped pipelines such as semicircle pipes and the like, and the coating still has strong corrosion resistance when the thickness of a dry film of the coating is only 7-20 mu m. The special-shaped heat exchange pipeline in the heat exchanger is effectively protected under the thickness of the thin coating, and the coating provided by the invention has the advantages of simple preparation process, low cost and extremely high market application value.

title_en: Cold spraying system and control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cold spraying and discloses a cold spraying system and a control method, wherein the cold spraying system comprises a gas cylinder, an air flow adjusting device, a spray gun, a powder feeding device, a heating device, a water cooling device and a controller, an air pump and an air source are arranged in the gas cylinder, a first switch valve and a second switch valve are fixedly arranged in the air pump, the air flow adjusting device comprises a main air channel and a powder feeding air channel, two ends of the main air channel are respectively and fixedly connected with the inside of the air pump and the tail part of the spray gun, a main air proportional valve is fixedly arranged in the main air channel, and the input end of the main air proportional valve is electrically connected with the output end of the spray gun. The invention has the advantages that two different air sources can be selected for air supply by realizing the switching of the two different air sources, and the stability of spraying quality is realized by monitoring the air flow, the air temperature and the cooling water temperature, so that the failure rate is reduced, and the efficiency is improved.

title_en: CNS-FeNi2S4Composite NF electrocatalyst and its preparing process and application
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of electrocatalyst preparation and application, and in particular relates to a CNS-FeNi  2 S 4 /NF composite electrocatalyst and a preparation method and application thereof. According to the invention, a one-step hydrothermal method and a one-step solvothermal method are adopted, foam nickel is taken as a substrate, and FeNi  2 S 4  supported by cocatalysts with different contents in CNS is loaded on the foam nickel, so that the CNS-FeNi  2 S 4 /NF composite electrocatalyst is obtained. According to the invention, through optimizing the content of the cocatalyst CNS, the composite electrocatalyst with excellent oxygen evolution performance is obtained, the overpotential of the electrocatalyst is reduced, the electrochemical active surface area is increased, and the electrocatalyst is subjected to the electrocatalytic oxygen evolution reaction in an alkaline solution, so that the catalyst has high activity and good stability. The catalyst has the advantages of low cost, simple synthesis steps, green and pollution-free properties and the like.

title_en: Nanometer spraying process for motorcycle hub
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nano spraying process of a motorcycle wheel hub, which comprises the following steps of S1 pretreatment of a base material, namely sequentially carrying out degreasing cleaning, mechanical polishing and phosphating treatment on an aluminum alloy motorcycle wheel hub, removing surface greasy dirt, an oxide layer and impurities to obtain a clean pretreated wheel hub, S2 primer spraying and curing, namely spraying epoxy modified acrylic primer on the surface of the pretreated wheel hub, controlling the thickness of a primer dry film to be 15-30 mu m, carrying out curing treatment after spraying to obtain a primer cured wheel hub, S3 sensitization activation treatment, namely sequentially carrying out sensitization treatment and activation treatment on the primer cured wheel hub, and washing the treated primer cured wheel hub with ultrapure water to obtain an activated wheel hub, and S4 nano mirror spraying, namely synchronously spraying an A agent metal salt solution and a B agent reducing agent solution by adopting a double-head spray gun, wherein the A agent metal salt solution and the B agent reducing agent solution are mixed at a position 15-25cm away from the surface of the wheel hub, and depositing a metal crystal layer on the surface of the wheel hub.

title_en: Preparation method of wide-bandgap perovskite photoactive layer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a wide-bandgap perovskite photoactive layer, which comprises the following steps of S1, preparing lead iodide powder, cesium iodide powder and ytterbium bromide powder according to a mixing molar ratio, preparing an inorganic target material by adopting a hot-pressing sintering process, S2, preparing an organic target material by adopting a normal-temperature preparation process by preparing formamidine hydroiodinate powder and methyl ammonium bromide powder according to a mixing molar ratio, S3, placing a pretreated substrate on a magnetron sputtering sample table, respectively mounting the targets prepared in the steps S1 and S2 on corresponding radio-frequency sputtering targets, vacuumizing a magnetron sputtering system, S4, preparing a wide-bandgap perovskite film by taking high-purity argon as sputtering gas through magnetron co-sputtering, controlling the sputtering power of the inorganic target material prepared in the step S1, controlling the sputtering power of the organic target material prepared in the step S2, and controlling the film thickness, thereby realizing high-quality film preparation through a differentiated target material preparation process.

title_en: Preparation method and application of zinc anode coating with high bonding strength
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a zinc anode coating with high bonding strength, and aims to solve the problems of zinc dendrite on the surface of a zinc anode, hydrogen evolution reaction at an anode interface, insufficient bonding strength of the coating and the like. The preparation method comprises the steps of firstly polishing zinc foil, secondly installing a substrate in a vacuum cabin, vacuumizing, thirdly introducing argon for ion source cleaning, then carrying out bias cleaning, fourthly starting a bias power supply and a direct current pulse power supply for pre-deposition, fifthly, firstly carrying out magnetron sputtering deposition on a transition layer, then introducing reactive gas, carrying out magnetron sputtering deposition on a functional layer, and sixthly, carrying out in-situ heat treatment on the composite coating. The zinc anode coating prepared by the invention realizes uniform deposition of zinc ions, remarkably improves the cycle stability and electrochemical performance of the water-based zinc ion battery, can realize the cycle life of 720 hours under high current density of the assembled Ti/TiN@Zn symmetrical battery, and has the capacity retention rate of 96.6% after the assembled full battery is cycled for 1500 circles under high current density.

title_en: Mask storage device and film forming device
abstract_en: Provided are a mask storage device and a film forming device capable of reducing the space required for taking and placing a mask box. The mask storage chamber (100) is provided with a mask box (200) capable of storing a plurality of masks in a plurality of layers, a chamber main body (111) capable of storing the mask box (200), and a cover (120) capable of opening and closing an opening (111 a) of the chamber main body (111), and is characterized in that the mask storage chamber (100) is provided with a cover moving mechanism (125), the cover moving mechanism (125) enables the cover (120) to move between a first position where the cover (120) closes the opening (111 a) and a second position which is higher than the first position in the vertical direction, and the mask storage chamber (100) is configured in such a way that the mask box (200) moves along the horizontal direction and can move to a position between the opening (111 a) and the cover (120) in a state where the cover (120) moves to the second position.

title_en: Coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a coating and a preparation method of the coating. The coating comprises a first amorphous phase coating, a second amorphous phase coating, a third amorphous phase coating and a fourth amorphous phase coating which are sequentially arranged from a substrate. The method comprises the steps of forming a first amorphous phase coating on a substrate by adopting a first laser induced pulse arc source process, forming a second amorphous phase coating on the first amorphous phase coating by adopting a second laser induced pulse arc source process, forming a third crystalline phase coating on the second amorphous phase coating by adopting a direct current arc source process, and forming a fourth amorphous phase coating on the third crystalline phase coating by adopting a third laser induced pulse arc source process, wherein the first laser induced pulse arc source process, the second laser induced pulse arc source process and the third laser induced pulse arc source process all adopt laser induced pulse arc source processes.

title_en: Ozone preparation device and method based on condensed water electrolysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ozone preparation device and method based on condensed water electrolysis, wherein the ozone preparation device comprises an air pump, a closed humidifying tank, an electrolytic tank and a power supply; the air pump is used for preparing carrier gas and introducing the carrier gas into the closed humidifying tank; the electrolytic tank is used for condensing the high-humidity gas passing through the anode plate to form condensed water, the condensed water enters the membrane electrode assembly, direct-current voltage is applied through a power supply, and the condensed water undergoes electrochemical oxidation reaction in the anode catalytic layer to prepare ozone. The invention realizes the electrochemical ozone preparation of non-pure water under a membrane electrode system by adding carrier gas, transmitting high-humidity gas and condensing in an electrolytic cell. The evaporation and condensation process of the invention realizes in-situ distillation, provides relatively pure uniform condensation water film for the membrane electrode assembly, breaks through the limitation of water source purity, and provides continuous water source for electrolytic reaction in the membrane electrode assembly.

title_en: Transmission device for continuously coating film on filiform substrate
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of vacuum coating, and provides a transmission device for continuously coating a filiform substrate, which comprises a revolution disc, a first bracket, a second bracket, a first winding and unwinding roller, a second winding and unwinding roller and a driving mechanism, wherein the first bracket, the second bracket, the first winding and unwinding roller and the second winding and unwinding roller are arranged on the revolution disc; the first support and the second support are arranged in parallel, a first installation shaft is fixedly arranged on the first support, a plurality of first wire rollers are rotatably arranged on the first installation shaft, a second installation shaft is slidably arranged on the second support, a plurality of second wire rollers are rotatably arranged on the second installation shaft, an elastic tensioning piece for driving the second installation shaft to move away from the direction of the first installation shaft is arranged on the second support, the first wire winding and unwinding roller and the second wire winding and unwinding roller are driven by a driving mechanism to synchronously rotate, one end of a wire substrate is wound on the first wire winding and unwinding roller, then the wire winding and unwinding roller is staggered through the first wire rollers and the second wire winding roller, and the other end of the wire substrate is wound on the second wire winding and unwinding roller.

title_en: Aqueous polymer dispersion, coating material, primer composition, and laminate
abstract_en: Provided is an aqueous polymer dispersion which can form a coating film that can maintain adhesion to a substrate even when cleaned at high temperature and high pressure. An aqueous polymer dispersion in which an olefin polymer (A) and an acrylic polymer (B) are dispersed in an aqueous medium, wherein the acrylic polymer (B) has a glass transition temperature of 105 ℃ or higher. In some examples, the acrylic polymer (B) may contain structural units derived from isobornyl methacrylate, the olefin polymer (a) and the acrylic polymer (B) may form composite particles, and the olefin polymer (a) may have a reactive group.

title_en: Boron doped CuxO2Composite bismuth vanadate photoelectrode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a boron doped Cu  x O 2  composite bismuth vanadate photoelectrode, and belongs to the technical field of photoelectrochemical analysis. The preparation method of the boron doped Cu  x O 2  composite bismuth vanadate photoelectrode comprises the steps of adding potassium iodide and bismuth nitrate into a nitric acid solution to obtain a solution A, mixing the solution A with a p-benzoquinone solution to obtain an electrolyte A, carrying out primary electrochemical deposition on the surface of a working electrode to obtain a working electrode deposited with a BiOI film, coating a vanadyl acetylacetonate solution on the surface of the working electrode deposited with the BiOI film, carrying out primary annealing treatment, then carrying out alkaline washing to obtain the bismuth vanadate photoelectrode, adding copper nitrate into a potassium borate buffer solution to obtain an electrolyte B, carrying out secondary electrochemical deposition on the surface of the bismuth vanadate photoelectrode by using the electrolyte B as the electrolyte, and then carrying out secondary annealing treatment to complete the preparation.

title_en: Water-based enhanced antirust coating, application method and preparation process
abstract_en: A water-based reinforced antirust paint, an application method and a preparation process. The invention discloses a water-based reinforced antirust coating which comprises, by weight, 40-60 parts of an acrylic emulsion, 10-20 parts of an acrylic phosphate emulsion, 15-25 parts of nano compound zinc phosphomolybdate, 3-8 parts of nano graphene, 0.3-0.8 part of an organosilicon defoamer, 0.1-0.3 part of bentonite, 0.1-0.5 part of a viscosity regulator, 0.1-0.2 part of a pH value regulator, 1-3 parts of a high molecular polymer dispersing agent, 5-10 parts of a film-forming additive, 10-20 parts of deionized water, 3-5 parts of n-behenate coated benzotriazole phase-change microcapsules, 3-5 parts of n-twenty-four alkane coated benzotriazole phase-change microcapsules and 3-5 parts of n-twenty-eight-alkane coated benzotriazole phase-change microcapsules. The long-acting corrosion resistance and intelligent response capability of the coating are improved.

title_en: Method, device, equipment, medium and program product for determining resistance of circulating material
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a method, a device, equipment, a medium and a program product for determining the resistance of a circulating material. The method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining a first crystal bar diameter of a crystal bar and an actual weight of a circulating material, wherein the circulating material is silicon material obtained by recovering the crystal bar after the crystal bar is pulled by a single crystal furnace, then determining a first length subinterval corresponding to the circulating material according to the actual weight of the circulating material and the first crystal bar diameter, accurately determining a first phosphorus resistivity range of the circulating material according to the first length subinterval, and finally directly determining a target resistance of the circulating material according to the first phosphorus resistivity range. The method effectively solves the defects of low precision, low hit rate, limited recycle proportion of the recycled materials and the like caused by adopting an empirical value grading method, and realizes the accurate determination of the resistivity of the recycled materials.

title_en: Oleophobic coating and oleophobic coating for constructing hydrophilic environment by preparing multilayer composite micro-nano filler and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to a hydrophilic oleophobic coating constructed by preparing a multilayer composite micro-nano filler, an oleophobic coating and application thereof. The oleophobic coating at least comprises composite filler, wherein the composite filler is formed by etching micron-sized filler, hydrophilic macromolecule deposition and nanometer-sized filler compounding, and crushing the micron-nanometer filler with the particle size of 15-80 mu m. The composite filler has a multi-level micro-nano structure, the multi-level micro-nano structure can form multi-level protection, the coating formed by the coating still has a proper micro-structure after being subjected to mechanical damage through the multi-level protection, the water environment oleophobic effect is exerted, and meanwhile, the mechanical damage resistance of the coating is obviously enhanced.

title_en: New energy motor shell gluing equipment capable of achieving uniform coating
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of motor shell processing, and discloses a new energy motor shell gluing device with uniform coating, which comprises a glue injection pipe, a working platform and a mounting bracket, wherein the bottom of the glue injection pipe is connected with an extension pipe, the side wall of the rubber injection pipe is provided with a rubber delivery pipe, the top of the rubber injection pipe is provided with an electric telescopic rod, the bottom of the extension pipe is provided with a rubber injection head, the inside of the extension pipe is provided with a rubber pushing rod, and the inside of the cylindrical cavity is slidably provided with a rubber blocking ring. When the glue spreading is finished, the glue pushing rod rotates in the process of moving up and down to perform a glue throwing action, so that glue is prevented from sliding down due to the effects of viscosity and gravity, and in addition, the glue blocking ring moves upwards to drive the residual glue in the glue blocking ring to synchronously move upwards, so that the situation that the residual glue in the glue outlet slides downwards and wire drawing occurs is avoided.

title_en: BOPP high-barrier film and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a BOPP high-barrier film and a preparation method and application thereof. The BOPP high-barrier film sequentially comprises a BOPP substrate layer and a barrier functional layer from top to bottom, wherein the barrier functional layer comprises, by mass, 47-62% of an EVOH-g-TPU nanocomposite, 1.8-5% of a cross-linking agent, 2-8% of a plasticizer, 34-40% of an isopropanol aqueous solution and 0.1-0.3% of a foam inhibiting defoamer, and the EVOH-g-TPU nanocomposite is prepared by modifying EVOH and TPU through graft polymerization and then doping with nano silicon dioxide. The invention adopts the EVOH-g-TPU nanocomposite as the core component of the barrier functional layer, solves the problems of poor water resistance and poor processability of EVOH by TPU grafting modification, and simultaneously has the size effect of nano particles and the flexibility of a polymer matrix and excellent mechanical property.

title_en: Coating shielding jig, waveguide coating system and method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of coating, and discloses a coating shielding jig, a waveguide coating system and a method thereof. The coating shielding jig comprises a base, an overhead bracket and a shielding piece, wherein the base is provided with a bearing area and is used for bearing a product to be coated, the overhead bracket comprises a vertical support arranged on the base and a suspension frame arranged on the vertical support, the shielding piece is arranged at the bottom end of the suspension frame and is matched with the shielding area of the product to be coated in shape, and the shielding piece is close to the shielding area when the product to be coated is borne on the base. By implementing the scheme of the application, the effective bearing and positioning and the effective shielding of the middle area or the four-side non-leaning area of the product to be coated can be carried out, and the coating shielding effect and the coating effect are simultaneously considered, so that the related problems in the prior art are solved.

title_en: Back contact battery and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of back contact batteries, in particular to a back contact battery and a preparation method and application thereof. The back contact battery comprises a silicon substrate, a composite passivation layer arranged on the back surface of the silicon substrate, a composite seed layer arranged on the composite passivation layer and comprising a titanium layer, a nickel layer and a copper layer, an interdigital copper electrode arranged on the composite seed layer, and an oxidation-resistant protective layer arranged on the surface of the interdigital copper electrode and comprising a nickel protective layer and a tin protective layer. The back contact battery realizes excellent bonding strength between the seed layer and the passivation layer through the design of the composite seed layer directly contacted with the composite passivation layer and the anti-oxidation protective layer structure directly contacted with the nickel protective layer and the interdigital copper electrode, inhibits copper ion diffusion and electromigration phenomena, and the synergistic effect of the nickel protective layer and the tin protective layer not only improves the anti-oxidation performance of the electrode, but also obviously improves the welding compatibility with a brazing strip, thereby ensuring the long-term stability and reliability of the battery.

title_en: Graphene foam composite heat conduction gasket, preparation method and electronic device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of thermal interface materials, and particularly relates to a graphene foam composite heat-conducting gasket, a preparation method and an electronic device. The composite heat conduction gasket comprises a graphene foam core body, wherein the preparation process of the graphene foam core body comprises the steps of loading graphene foam with nano liquid metal particles, and then carrying out nano liquid metal vapor welding treatment in a closed space to enable nano liquid metal to form a metal welding spot in situ at a joint of graphene sheet layers. The three-dimensional graphene foam is used as a core body, nano liquid metal particles are loaded and subjected to metal vapor welding treatment in a closed space, so that a metal welding spot is formed in situ on a lap joint position of a graphene sheet layer by the nano liquid metal, the structural strength of the graphene foam is remarkably improved, and an integrated laminated structure is formed by adhesive coating, lamination and hot-pressing compounding. The heat-conducting gasket prepared by the invention meets the heat dissipation requirement of the high heat flux electronic device.

title_en: Composite modified filler reinforced multilayer co-extrusion winding film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of packaging materials, in particular to a composite modified filler reinforced multilayer co-extrusion winding film and a preparation method thereof; the composite modified filler reinforced multilayer co-extrusion winding film comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 40-48% gradient stress buffer composition, 30-36% phase change energy storage enhancing composition, 5-7.5% vldpe, 1.5-3% pib, 2-4% eva-g-MAH, 1-2.5% pib grafted tackifying masterbatch, 2.5-4.5% poe, 2-4% lldpe, 0.4-0.6% erucamide, 0.5-1.5% nano calcium carbonate masterbatch, 0.3-0.5% silane coupling agent KH-550, 0.3-0.6% oleamide, 0.2-0.5% zinc stearate, and 0.3-0.8% antioxidant; the invention solves the key problems that the multilayer coextrusion winding film has interlayer warping and layering, the holding adhesion is attenuated due to stretching heat softening, and the reinforcement and the toughening are difficult to be compatible under high filling, and provides a novel scheme of the stretching winding film with high rebound, low warping, long holding adhesion and strong process suitability for industrial logistics and bulk cargo packaging.

title_en: Multi-working-procedure collaborative simulation-based zinc hydrometallurgy digital twin system construction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a zinc hydrometallurgy digital twin system based on multi-station collaborative simulation. The method comprises the steps of firstly constructing a hybrid sub-model for coupling each process mechanism with data driving, connecting the hybrid sub-model with a virtual buffer mechanism through a standardized interface to form an interactive multi-agent collaborative digital twin body, introducing a multi-agent reinforcement learning framework on the basis, defining each process model as an agent, training a collaborative decision strategy in the multi-agent collaborative digital twin body to realize global optimization of the whole process production index, and finally, supporting real-time monitoring, forward-looking deduction and man-machine collaborative decision by the system, thereby realizing simulation, prediction and closed-loop optimization of the production process in a virtual space and providing intelligent support for quality improvement, synergy and collaborative control of zinc hydrometallurgy.

title_en: Novel composite steel pipe combining lining plastic and coating and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel composite steel pipe combining plastic lining and coating and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of composite material pipe manufacturing. The composite steel pipe comprises a steel pipe matrix, a polyethylene outer layer and an adhesive layer arranged between the steel pipe matrix and the polyethylene outer layer. The adhesive layer comprises a dynamic crosslinked polymer network formed by crosslinking epoxy resin and bis- (4-aminobenzyl) disulfide, wherein the addition amount of the bis- (4-aminobenzyl) disulfide is 18.5% -24.5% of the mass of the epoxy resin, and the epoxy resin and the aminohydro equivalent ratio of the epoxy resin to the aminohydro equivalent ratio is 0.9:1-1.1:1. The invention also discloses a preparation method of the active disulfide bond, which activates reversible exchange of dynamic disulfide bonds in a network through specific molding and high-temperature maintaining procedures. The invention utilizes a stress self-adaptive release mechanism of a dynamic covalent bond, is beneficial to relieving the aggregation of residual internal stress of an interface, and improves the interface bonding stability of the composite pipe under long-acting service and cold and hot circulation.

title_en: Integrated intelligent breeding device and breeding method for ventral hornet
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of breeding devices, in particular to an integrated intelligent breeding device and method for flat-abdomen bees, the device comprises a circulating conveying mechanism, an egg card feeding mechanism, an egg card glue brushing mechanism, an egg distribution mechanism, a code spraying mechanism and a bee egg breeding mechanism which are sequentially arranged along the conveying direction of the circulating conveying mechanism. The egg distribution mechanism comprises a bee egg sorting device and a bee egg uniform distribution device, the bee egg sorting device utilizes visual identification and air flow injection to realize automatic sorting of the bee eggs, and the bee egg uniform distribution device realizes accurate and uniform distribution of the bee eggs through quantitative screening and vibration spreading. According to the invention, through the integrated and automatic design, continuous production from automatic feeding, surface brushing and egg sorting layout to information marking of the flat-abdomen wasp breeding egg cards is realized, the consistency of production efficiency and product quality is greatly improved, and reliable equipment support is provided for large-scale standardized breeding of flat-abdomen wasps.

title_en: High-low melting point HDPE (high-density polyethylene) synergistic bonding composite prepreg tape and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-low melting point HDPE cooperative bonding composite prepreg tape, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the prepreg tape is of a three-layer composite structure and comprises a carbon fiber reinforced high-melting point high-density polyethylene middle layer and low-melting point high-density polyethylene film layers which are arranged on two sides of the carbon fiber reinforced high-melting point high-density polyethylene middle layer, the melting point of the high-melting point high-density polyethylene is 130-145 ℃, the melting point of the low-melting point high-density polyethylene is 105-125 ℃, and the preparation method comprises the steps of superposing three layers of materials, and quenching and annealing after twice hot pressing. According to the invention, the low-melting-point HDPE is introduced to two sides of the carbon fiber reinforced high-melting-point HDPE, and the synergic melting behaviors of the HDPE with different melting points are regulated and controlled through the two-step heating and quenching regulation and control process, so that the interface is fully wetted and the controllable construction of the crystalline structure is realized, the interlayer bonding performance and the gas barrier performance are both considered, the carbon fiber reinforced high-melting-point HDPE is used in a hydrogen transmission pipeline, and the mechanical bearing capacity and the hydrogen barrier performance of the pipeline are improved.

title_en: Spraying technology for improving adhesive force of sprayed coating
abstract_en: The invention discloses a spraying process for improving the adhesive force of a spraying coating, which comprises the steps of treating the surface of a substrate to form a concave-convex structure with pits and convex peaks, spraying slurry onto the surface of the substrate, controlling the spraying amount to enable the filling height of slurry in the pits to be 1/3-2/3 of the depth of the pits, forming a reserved space at the tops of the pits, cleaning the slurry before drying, removing slurry on the surfaces of the convex peaks to enable the tops of the slurry in the pits to be not higher than the tops of the convex peaks, horizontally standing to enable the slurry to naturally subside and discharge bubbles to form a compact anchoring body, spraying the slurry again to form a covering layer, enabling the slurry of the covering layer to enter the reserved space and be fused with the tops of the anchoring body into a continuous integrated structure, and solidifying to form the coating. According to the invention, through the combination of the two spraying processes and the process of intermediate cleaning and standing settlement, a bubble-free compact anchoring body is formed in the pit and is integrated with the covering layer, so that the bonding strength of the coating and the substrate is obviously improved.

title_en: Preparation method of high-strength tear-resistant fiber waterproof coiled material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a high-strength tear-resistant fiber waterproof coiled material, which comprises the following steps of S1, preparing a substrate layer, S2, preparing a reinforcing layer, S3, expanding glass fiber reticular cloth through an extrusion coating method to be compounded with a substrate layer sheet in a semi-molten state, and S4, cooling and solidifying the compound layer to obtain the waterproof coiled material. According to the invention, the strength of the waterproof coiled material is obviously improved by adding the aramid fiber nano-fibers and the modified cellulose fibers, a proper amount of the anti-tearing fibers are added into the base material, so that the waterproof coiled material can reach enough strength and toughness, and the tensile strength and anti-tearing performance of the waterproof coiled material are obviously improved, thereby enhancing the overall stability and reliability of the waterproof coiled material.

title_en: Belt pulley gluing equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a belt pulley gluing device which comprises a base, a gluing mechanism and an elastic piece, wherein the top of the base is sequentially provided with a supporting seat and a positioning seat, the outer wall of the positioning seat is used for being sleeved with the inner hole wall of a workpiece in a clearance mode, the supporting seat is used for supporting the workpiece, the gluing mechanism is arranged on the base and comprises a gluing piece embedded in the side wall of the positioning seat and used for adsorbing glue, a glue supplying device connected with the gluing piece and used for continuously supplying the glue, and the elastic piece arranged in the positioning seat, the elastic piece is used for elastically propping the gluing piece to be pressed to the inner hole wall after the inner hole wall of the workpiece is sleeved with the clearance, the glue adsorbed by the gluing piece is rotated, the inner hole wall is evenly smeared by the glue, and the recycling mechanism comprises a recycling groove concavely arranged at the top of the supporting seat and corresponding to the outer wall of the positioning seat and a recycling box communicated with the recycling groove, and the recycling groove is used for recycling the dropped glue. The gluing effect and the beat can be improved.
