title_en: Conductive connecting piece and multi-station process chamber
abstract_en: The invention provides a conductive connecting piece and a multi-station process chamber. The conductive connecting piece is arranged at the center of the multi-station process chamber and comprises a first conductive part, a second conductive part and a second conductive part, wherein the first end of the first conductive part is connected with the upper cover of the multi-station process chamber, the second end of the second conductive part is provided with a second magnetic part, the second end of the second conductive part is connected with the lower cover of the multi-station process chamber, at least one of the first magnetic part and the second magnetic part is a magnet, and the magnets are used for adsorbing each other in the process of performing a film deposition process so as to ensure contact connection between the second end of the first conductive part and the first end of the second conductive part.

title_en: Electrical steel sheet for electromagnetic wave shielding and method for manufacturing same
abstract_en: An electrical steel sheet for electromagnetic wave shielding according to one embodiment of the present invention comprises a steel sheet substrate and a coating film on the surface of the steel sheet substrate, wherein the coating film comprises 100 parts by weight of a metal phosphate containing one or more of Al, mg, co, ca, sr, ba, zn and Mn and an oxide containing two or more of Al, si, mg and Fe in an amount of 3 to 150 parts by weight in total, wherein the ratio (D2/D1) of the inscribed circle diameter (D2) to the circumscribed circle diameter (D1) is 70% by area or more, the average grain size in a surface portion from the surface of the steel sheet substrate to less than 1/4 of the steel sheet substrate is 80 to 500 [ mu ] m, and the average grain size in a central portion from 1/4 to 1/2 of the steel sheet substrate is 50 [ mu ] m.

title_en: Electroless copper plating solution, preparation method and application thereof, and electroless copper plating method
abstract_en: The application provides an electroless copper plating solution, a preparation method and application thereof, and an electroless copper plating method, belonging to the technical field of copper plating solutions. The electroless copper plating solution comprises the following components of 0.1-60.0 mg/L of adamantane derivative, 0.3-30.0 g/L of copper salt, 20-180 g/L of complexing agent, 0.5-80.0 g/L of reducing agent and 0.1-50.0 mg/L of stabilizer, wherein the adamantane derivative has a structure shown in a formula I, and the stabilizer comprises 2,2' -bipyridine and sodium dodecyl sulfate. The electroless copper plating solution of the application adopts the adamantane derivative shown in the formula I, the copper salt, the complexing agent, the reducing agent and the stabilizing agent, and controls the types of the adamantane derivative and the stabilizing agent and the concentration of each component, so that the electroless copper plating solution has higher deposition rate at low temperature and improves the crystallization morphology of a plating layer when the electroless copper plating treatment is carried out on a workpiece to be plated.

title_en: Film online detection system, wafer conveying equipment and online detection method
abstract_en: The invention provides a film online detection system, wafer conveying equipment and an online detection method, wherein an online temperature measurement unit obtains the initial temperature of a qualified film of a standard wafer and the cooling time for cooling the qualified film to a target temperature, obtains the initial temperature of the film of the process wafer and the cooling time for cooling the film to the target temperature in the conveying process, the higher the surface roughness of the film is, the lower the reflectivity is, the deviation of infrared temperature detection is caused, the initial temperature of the film of the process wafer is deviated from the initial temperature of the qualified film of the standard wafer, a comparison unit judges whether the film quality of the process wafer meets the process requirement according to the initial temperature of the film of the process wafer and the initial temperature of the qualified film of the standard wafer, and judges whether the cooling system is abnormal according to the cooling time for cooling the film of the process wafer to the target temperature and the cooling time for cooling the qualified film of the standard wafer, thereby realizing real-time online detection.

title_en: High dynamic current control method for electrolytic hydrogen production power supply
abstract_en: The invention provides a high dynamic current control method of an electrolytic hydrogen production power supply, which comprises the steps of initializing an electrolytic hydrogen production system, closing an electrolytic power supply loop, initializing a model predictive controller of the electrolytic power supply, detecting an electrolytic current value and a terminal voltage value in real time, waiting for control period interruption to trigger, entering a model predictive control algorithm to execute, constructing a limited candidate voltage control set based on a voltage regulation step length at each control moment, substituting each voltage option into an electrolytic current predictive model to calculate a predicted current value at the next moment, evaluating through a cost function, introducing a control item of the current change rate of the electrolytic to inhibit transient current impact by the cost function, selecting the voltage option with the minimum value of the cost function as the optimal output voltage of the power supply, and executing adjustment by a driving power supply, and self-adaptively adjusting the weight coefficient in the cost function when the current predictive error is greater than a threshold value. The invention realizes high dynamic response and overcurrent inhibition.

title_en: Acidic cleaning agent for removing magnesium crystals and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses an acidic cleaning agent for removing magnesium crystals, which comprises citric acid, glycolic acid, sodium gluconate, potassium citrate, triethanolamine, a defoaming agent and water. The application realizes high-efficiency descaling through multiple mechanisms of 'lattice embedding + interlayer cracking + surface complexing', and breaks down magnesium crystallization from the root instead of relying on acid corrosion. Experimental results show that under normal temperature, the acidic cleaning agent can completely dissolve magnesium crystals in 5-7 min, has corrosion rates to gray cast iron and spheroidal graphite cast iron as low as 0.00285 g/cm  2  & h and 0.00118 g/cm  2  & h, is suitable for removing magnesium hydroxide crystals or magnesium carbonate crystals on the surfaces of gray cast iron, spheroidal graphite cast iron or stainless steel, is simple and convenient to operate, can be used at room temperature, and has the advantages of controllable cost, low toxicity, high descaling speed, low corrosiveness, easy cleaning of residues after use, low wastewater treatment difficulty and meeting the green environmental protection requirement.

title_en: Comprehensive energy system low-carbon economic dispatching method for coal-containing hydrogen production-oxygen-enriched combustion power plant by considering information gap decision theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive energy system low-carbon economic dispatching method of a coal-containing hydrogen production-oxygen-enriched combustion power plant by considering an information gap decision theory, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a cooperative operation model, and organically combining the coal hydrogen production, the electrolytic hydrogen production and the oxygen-enriched combustion power plant through an oxygen-enriched combustion carbon capture technology; secondly, constructing a hydrogen energy multi-element utilization model consisting of electricity-gas conversion, hydrogen fuel cells, hydrogen-doped heat-electricity cogeneration and hydrogen energy storage, then introducing a stepped carbon transaction mechanism to restrict the carbon emission of the system, constructing two scheduling models of risk avoidance and opportunity seeking by utilizing an information gap decision theory aiming at the influence of source and load uncertainty on IES optimal scheduling, and discussing the influence of different risk preference and weight coefficients on a scheduling strategy by the system. The method effectively reduces the hydrogen production cost and the carbon emission of the comprehensive energy system by solving the CPLEX, helps a decision maker to formulate a corresponding scheduling scheme according to the risk preference, and improves the economy and the low carbon of the energy system.

title_en: Backpack type electrolyte fertilizer production spraying machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fertilizer spraying, and particularly discloses a knapsack type electrolyte fertilizer production spraying machine which comprises a knapsack, wherein a feed inlet is formed in the top of the knapsack, U-shaped plates are arranged in the knapsack, two ends of each U-shaped plate are fixed on the inner wall of the knapsack to divide the inside of the knapsack into an outer chamber and an inner chamber, a first supporting plate and a second supporting plate which are parallel to each other are fixed between the inner walls of the inner chambers, the inner chambers are sequentially divided into a liquid inlet chamber, a separation chamber and a fusion chamber from top to bottom, the separation chamber is divided into four chambers through a cation exchange membrane, air holes communicated with a storage box are formed in each chamber in a penetrating mode, electrode plates are arranged in each chamber, wherein the electrode plates are cathode electrode plates and anode electrode plates, and the two middle electrode plates are consistent and are used for solving the problems of huge volume and the fertilizer application process of existing electrolyte fertilizer production equipment.

title_en: Sealing nail compound equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of automatic processing equipment of fasteners and discloses sealing nail compounding equipment which comprises a machine table and a pre-compounding module, a re-compounding module and a ferrying module which are arranged on the machine table, wherein the pre-compounding module comprises a transfer sheet discharging module, a hot melt adhesive discharging module and a metal sheet discharging module, the re-compounding module comprises a concentricity detection module, a hot pressing module, a flatness detection module and a discharging module, the ferrying module comprises a compounding jig, a jig track and a jig ferrying module, the jig track is respectively arranged in the areas of the pre-compounding module and the re-compounding module, the pre-compounding module is used for primarily compounding sealing nails, the re-compounding module is used for finishing the sealing nails of the pre-compounding module, and the ferrying module is matched with the pre-compounding module to realize full-automatic processing of the sealing nails, so that the processing efficiency and the qualification rate of the sealing nails are improved.

title_en: Diaphragm for alkaline electrolytic cell and method for manufacturing the same
abstract_en: A separator for an alkaline electrolytic cell is provided, which separates the alkaline electrolytic cell containing an electrolyte into a cathode chamber and an anode chamber, and includes a substrate layer having a plurality of micropores, two polymer layers formed with pores respectively attached to opposite surfaces of the substrate layer, and two inorganic material coatings formed with pores respectively coated on surfaces of the two polymer layers remote from the substrate layer, wherein the plurality of micropores of the substrate layer are formed not to be perpendicular to both surfaces of the substrate layer to allow the electrolyte to pass through the plurality of micropores and to block hydrogen gas generated in the cathode chamber from transferring to the anode chamber through the plurality of micropores during operation of the alkaline electrolytic cell. A method of manufacturing a diaphragm for an alkaline cell is also presented. With the diaphragm and method, improved gas barrier performance is achieved, safety and reliability inside the alkaline cell are improved, and the thickness of the diaphragm is reduced.

title_en: Multiply wood hot press unit
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a hot press unit technical field, and a multiply wood hot press unit is disclosed, including putting the thing board, four are put welded connection and are had two connecting rods between the thing board, the equal welded connection of intermediate position of two connecting rod upper ends has the locating plate, welded connection has the bearing plate between two connecting rods, the upper end screw connection of bearing plate has two hydraulic lift, four are put and just are located hydraulic lift's upper end between the thing board and install the atress board, the equal welded connection in both sides of atress board has the fixed plate, the screw connection has three lifter plate between two fixed plates, four are put the upper end screw connection who just is located the lifter plate between the thing board and have three hot press. The utility model discloses a series of designs make the device can be simple process a plurality of multiply wood, great work load that has alleviateed operating personnel, and make that the device can be even heat the multiply wood, great promotion the effect of processing.

title_en: Damping plate production coating device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a damping plate production coating device. Damping plate production coating device includes: a belt conveyor; the two standing plates are respectively arranged on two sides of the belt conveyor; the first rotating rod is rotatably arranged on the two standing plates; the tape coiling roller is fixedly arranged on the first rotating rod; the second rotating rod is rotatably arranged on the two standing plates; the driving roller is fixedly arranged on the second rotating rod; and the movable rods are arranged on the two standing plates. The damping plate production coating device provided by the utility model can enable the glue to be evenly coated on the coating film by arranging the glue scraping plate, and simultaneously, the coating film can be in close contact with the damping plate under the action of the driving roller; set up four lead screws, can play the effect of correcting to the coating film off tracking.

title_en: Overflow type electroplating bath
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an overflow type electroplating bath, including electroplating the cell body and setting up left overflow launder, right overflow launder, two middle overflow launders, preceding overflow launder, back overflow launder and at least one leakage fluid dram on the electroplating cell body, two middle overflow launders set up along the front and back direction interval, every middle overflow launder all shares the first cell wall with left overflow launder, every middle overflow launder all shares the second cell wall with right overflow launder, two middle overflow launders locate preceding overflow launder, between the back overflow launder, the left and right both ends of preceding overflow launder, the left and right both ends of back overflow launder are equallyd and are respectively linked together with left overflow launder, when at least one leakage fluid dram is located same side with left overflow launder, at least; when the at least one liquid discharge port and the right overflow groove are positioned on the same side, the at least one liquid discharge port is communicated with the right overflow groove. The utility model discloses realize overflow all around, discharge tin-plating liquid floater fast, improve tin-plating product quality and production efficiency.

title_en: Novel plate structure of preapring for an unfavorable turn of events shape
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel anti-deformation plate structure, which comprises a decorative coating and a plate main body, wherein the decorative coating is arranged outside the outer wall of the plate main body, the left and right ends of the plate main body are respectively provided with a metal edge sealing, a built-in connection type anti-deformation device is additionally arranged inside the front and back ends of the anti-deformation plate, the novel built-in type anti-deformation device can play a secondary reinforcing role on the basis that the whole plate has anti-deformation capability through self material performance, the novel built-in type anti-deformation device can reinforce around the plate to generate the anti-deformation capability, so that the plate can be influenced by the reinforcing role of the built-in type anti-deformation device when the plate is disturbed by the bending strength in any direction, thereby preventing the plate from being deformed, not only prolonging the service life of the whole plate when in use, but also increasing the use strength of the whole plate, thereby enabling the panel to be more durable.

title_en: Hot galvanizing system with high operation efficiency

abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hollow mosaic glass with good sound insulation effect, which comprises annular glass, the annular glass is in a ring shape, both sides of the annular glass are provided with circular glass plates, the circular glass plates on both sides are distributed in a mirror image manner, a closed space is formed between the circular glass plates on both sides and the annular glass, the circular glass plates and the annular glass are fixedly connected, a decoration mechanism is arranged between the circular glass plates on both sides and the annular glass, a plurality of connection mechanisms distributed in a circumferential array are arranged between the decoration and the circular glass plates, the connection mechanisms comprise bases, through the way, the utility model can press a movable pin and press the movable pin into a groove when the decoration is installed, then insert an insert block into a rectangular frame, when the movable pin moves to a limiting groove in the rectangular frame, a contracted spring returns and drives the movable pin to move to the limiting groove, thereby installing the decoration between the two circular glass plates, the installation process is simple and convenient and saves working hours.

title_en: Stretch-proof antistatic protective film
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a stretch-proof antistatic protection film, including the main part membrane, the main part membrane is including thermoplastic seal coat, antistatic layer, insulating layer, fire-retardant layer, waterproof layer and stretch-proof layer, and the bottom of thermoplastic seal coat is equipped with the antistatic layer, the utility model discloses the beneficial effect who reaches is: the utility model discloses the practicality is strong, be favorable to improving the stability in use of protection film for the polypropylene film through setting up the thermoplastic seal, prevent the static resistance ability that the static film is favorable to improving the protection film for nanometer polyurethane through setting up the antistatic layer, be favorable to improving the waterproof and anticorrosive ability of protection film for the waterproof anti-corrosion material of condensation of polypropylene through setting up the waterproof layer, thereby improve the life of protection film, be favorable to improving the stretch-proofing ability of protection film for glass fiber material through setting up the stretch-proofing layer, in order to adapt to multiple operation requirement, the very big improvement of traditional protection film operating quality and availability factor, very big improvement the fixed stability of device and availability factor.

title_en: Rear cover structure for electronic product and home decoration
abstract_en: Rear cover structure that can be used to electronic product, home improvement relates to decorative structure technical field, and it includes the substrate layer, the upper surface of substrate layer is equipped with the texture layer, the texture layer is 3D line layer or leather texture layer, the lower surface of substrate layer is equipped with the printing layer, the printing layer is 3D printing layer or photochromic 3D printing layer or warm photochromic 3D printing layer. The utility model discloses can avoid because of leather or diaphragm laminate alone the bent limit that produces when the product and warp the scheduling problem, and the aesthetic property is better.

title_en: Bearing oil immersion machine with automatic slag and oil filtering functions
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bearing oil immersion machine capable of automatically removing slag and filtering oil, which comprises an oil immersion box body, a lifting rack, a lifting device and a control switch, wherein the lifting rack is movably arranged in the oil immersion box body in a matching way, the lifting device is arranged at the left and right outer sides of the oil immersion box body, the lifting device is in driving connection with the lifting rack, the lifting rack is driven to vertically lift and move along the upper and lower directions, and the control switch is in phase control connection with the lifting device; a deslagging device is further installed in a matched mode at the bottom of the lifting placement frame, the deslagging device comprises an installation frame body and a filter screen body, the installation frame body is fixedly installed at the bottom of the lifting placement frame in a matched mode, and the filter screen body is detachably installed on the installation frame body. The utility model discloses not only can realize the automatic oil strain deoiling function of bearing, solve the technical defect who remains a large amount of oil bodies on the bearing, can realize moreover that the live time of the oil body that soaks is improved to the self-cleaning scrubbing processing of the oil body, reduction processing manufacturing cost.

title_en: Optical crystal pulling furnace with flow guide mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an optical crystal pulling furnace with water conservancy diversion mechanism, the top including lower furnace body is provided with the furnace body, weld through the spliced pole between lower furnace body and the last furnace body, be provided with the exhaust opening between lower furnace body and the last furnace body, the inside of going up the furnace body is provided with guide cylinder, the top of going up guide cylinder is provided with the retainer plate, the bottom of going up guide cylinder is provided with the clamping ring, the inside of clamping ring corresponds exhaust opening's position and is provided with down the water conservancy diversion channel, the position that the inside of going up guide cylinder corresponds down the water conservancy diversion channel is provided with the water conservancy diversion channel, the bottom of clamping ring is provided with down guide cylinder, the bottom side cover of lower guide cylinder is equipped with high temperature resistant sealing washer, lower guide cylinder bottom symmetry is provided with spacing post, the inside bottom of lower furnace body is provided with the crucible, the bottom of crucible is provided with the heating plate. The optical crystal pulling furnace with the flow guide mechanism has the advantages that the flow guide assembly is convenient to disassemble and assemble, the working efficiency is improved, the sealing performance is good, and the quality of crystal bars is improved.

title_en: PVC wall paper convenient to rolling
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of wallpaper, in particular to PVC wallpaper convenient to roll, which comprises an acoustic cotton board, a framework layer and a PVC filling layer, wherein the PVC filling layer is fixed with a knurling layer through pressing on one side surface of the framework layer, a waterproof coating layer is fixed on one side surface of the knurling layer through spraying, a heat insulation rubber layer is fixed on one side surface of the acoustic cotton board different from the framework layer through bonding, and a waterproof rubber layer is fixed on one side surface of the heat insulation rubber layer different from the acoustic cotton board through bonding; the sound-absorbing cotton plate is additionally arranged inside the wallpaper, and the sound-absorbing cotton plate is convenient to absorb noise through the self structure, so that the indoor echo intensity is reduced, and the use experience of a user is improved; one side of the sound-absorbing cotton plate is paved with a framework layer, so that the strength of the wallpaper structure is further improved, and the wallpaper can be conveniently rolled; the waterproof rubber layer of inhaling cotton board side promotes wall paper waterproof performance, avoids the wall paper rainwater rotten, further promotes user's physical experience.

title_en: Compound various steel sheet glue dripping device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of color steel plate processing, in particular to a composite color steel plate glue dripping device, which solves the defects in the prior art and comprises a base, wherein one side of the base is provided with a sliding table in a sliding way, one side of the sliding table is provided with a lifting seat in a sliding way, one side of the lifting seat is fixed with a mounting seat through screws, the top of the mounting seat is fixed with a glue storage tank, one side of the glue storage tank is fixedly connected with a discharging pipe, the other end of the discharging pipe is fixedly connected with a hose, the bottom of the mounting seat is fixed with a connecting plate through screws, and through the arrangement of structures such as a sliding seat, a side plate, a curve groove, a push rod, a fixing frame and the like, the sliding table slides along the base to carry out glue dripping on a color steel plate, the side plate can drive the fixing frame to swing back and forth through the push rod, so that each glue dripping nozzle can rotate back and forth, and ensure that all parts of the color steel plate can receive even glue dripping effect, the quality of the product is improved.

title_en: Piezoelectric injection valve with quick-release flow channel function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a piezoelectric injection valve with a quick-release flow passage function, which comprises a valve body and a flow passage arranged at the lower end of the valve body, wherein the lower end of the valve body is provided with a lifting mechanism, the lifting mechanism is arranged at the upper end of the flow passage, the quick-release mechanism is arranged inside the flow passage, one side of the valve body is provided with a fixing mechanism, a knob is rotated to control the distance between a firing pin and a nozzle inside the valve body, the problem that the distance between the firing pin and the nozzle is not easy to adjust and the dispensing precision is influenced is solved, only a button needs to be pressed when the valve is installed and disassembled, the button drives a second connecting rod to move, one end of a stop block is provided with a spring, under the elastic action of the spring, the stop blocks connected with the second connecting rod are close to each other, then the button is released, thereby the dog resumes original position and blocks the buckle under the effort of spring, and it is very inconvenient to waste time and energy when the runner of solving piezoelectric injection valve is dismantled, influences the problem of efficiency of gluing.

title_en: Single crystal furnace
abstract_en: The utility model provides a single crystal furnace, which comprises a furnace barrel, a furnace cover, an auxiliary chamber and a locking mechanism. Wherein the furnace cover is arranged at the upper end of the furnace cylinder to open and close the furnace cylinder; the auxiliary chamber is arranged above a furnace cover of the single crystal furnace; the locking mechanism is used for connecting the furnace cover and the auxiliary chamber and comprises a hanging plate body, a driving piece and a locking part. Wherein, the hanging plate body is rotatably connected with the lower end of the auxiliary chamber; the driving piece is arranged on the outer side of the auxiliary chamber, is connected with the hanging plate body and is used for driving the hanging plate body to rotate between a first position and a second position; the locking portion is connected with the hanging plate body so as to connect the furnace cover and the auxiliary chamber through the hanging plate body, the corresponding hanging plate body is located at the first position when the locking portion is in an open state, and the corresponding hanging plate body is located at the second position when the locking portion is in a locked state. The utility model discloses a single crystal growing furnace to the driving piece replaces the manpower to promote the hitch plate rotatory, thereby has reduced the potential safety hazard of artifical work intensity and artifical closely operation.

title_en: Dazzle various cell-phone back cover
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a colorful mobile phone rear cover, which comprises a rear cover and is characterized in that: the rear cover comprises a base material layer, a colorful layer, a surface treatment layer and an HC layer which are sequentially compounded; the substrate layer comprises a carbon fiber layer, and hollow-out positions are formed in the carbon fiber layer; the hollow-out position corresponds to the position of the mobile phone signal equipment; a priming layer used for shielding the woven lines of the carbon fiber layer and the glass fiber layer in the substrate layer is further arranged between the substrate layer and the colorful layer; dazzle various layer including compound highlight colour layer, UV rendition layer and coating film layer in proper order. Effectively shielding the weaving lines of the glass fiber and the carbon fiber material and preventing electromagnetic shielding.

title_en: Tower machine standard festival subassembly with safeguard function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of tower crane installation, in particular to a standard knot component of a tower crane with a protection function, which comprises a standard knot, wherein the standard knot comprises a main body and a pin shaft arranged on the main body, an anti-rust layer is attached to the outer surface of the underground part of the main body, a solid glue layer is attached to the outer surface of the anti-rust layer, and a liquid glue layer is attached to the outer surface of the pin shaft of the underground part of the standard knot. The utility model provides a tower machine standard festival subassembly with safeguard function, when backfilling the operation, backfill the grit earlier with solid-state glue film and liquid glue film contact, and then greatly reduced tower machine standard festival be located the antirust coat of underground part surface and the scratch probability of the extexine of round pin axle, and then can make the surface of antirust coat and round pin axle rust-resistant anticorrosive effectively, slow down the corrosion speed of this position standard festival greatly, greatly increased its life, simultaneously greatly reduced the probability that causes the risk of tower collapse accident that has when extreme.

title_en: Heat-shrinkable label film with antibacterial function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a heat-shrinkable label film with an antibacterial function, which comprises a protective outer film, wherein a clamping groove is formed in the middle of one side of the outer wall of the protective outer film, a plastic sheet is fixedly arranged at the edge of one side of the inner wall of the clamping groove, a sealing film is fixedly arranged at the edge of one side of the outer wall of the protective outer film, a first back adhesive tape is fixedly arranged at the edge of one end of one side of the sealing film, and a second back adhesive tape is fixedly arranged at the edge of the other side of the outer wall of the protective outer film. According to the heat-shrinkable label film with the antibacterial function, when label paper is plugged into the internal clamping groove of the protective outer film, the protective outer film is kneaded, so that the plastic sheet in the clamping groove is bent, one side of the protective outer film is folded into a semi-arc shape during bending, at the moment, the label paper can be plugged into the clamping groove more easily, the sealing film with the first back adhesive tape is bent to be adhered with the second back adhesive tape, the label film is sealed, and therefore the working efficiency of workers is improved.

title_en: High-precision automatic lens gluing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of gluing equipment, in particular to high-precision automatic lens gluing equipment, which aims at solving the problems that most of the existing lens lenses are slow in gluing speed, inconvenient in glue dispensing at various positions of the lenses and poor in gluing effect, so that the gluing quality of the lenses is influenced, the automation degree is low, and the gluing efficiency of the lenses is low. The utility model can uniformly glue the lens, is convenient for gluing the lens after glue dispensing is finished, and has high automation degree and high gluing efficiency on the lens.

title_en: Non-woven fabrics that wet piece of cloth production used covers closes device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a non-woven fabric laminating device for producing wet tissues, which comprises a feeding roller, a folding assembly, a guide assembly, a laminating assembly and a conveying line, wherein the extending direction of the conveying line is consistent with the arrangement direction of a plurality of wet tissue base materials; the folding assembly comprises a fixed supporting rod and a fixed supporting frame, a plurality of folding rods sequentially corresponding to the plurality of wet tissue base materials are fixedly connected to the fixed supporting rod, and a plurality of folding plates sequentially corresponding to the plurality of wet tissue base materials are fixedly connected to the fixed supporting frame; the guide assembly consists of a plurality of guide groups; the laminating assembly includes a plurality of press rollers disposed above the conveyor line. The utility model has the following advantages: the folding uniformity and the covering levelness are ensured, the labor intensity is reduced, and the working efficiency is ensured.

title_en: Stamping part electrophoresis application equipment with waste residue filtration
abstract_en: The utility model discloses stamping part electrophoretic coating equipment with a waste residue filtering structure, which comprises an equipment main body, a filtering component and a fishing component, wherein the filtering component is arranged behind the lower end of the equipment main body; a fishing assembly disposed inside a lower end of the equipment body; and the drying assembly is arranged below the right end of the equipment main body. This stamping workpiece electrophoresis application equipment with waste residue filtration sets up the top surface top at the filter box through the pump body, can make the pump body with the electrophoresis liquid in the electrophoresis tank from first pipeline suction, enter into the filter box inside, then under the filtration of first filter plate, stop the waste residue in the electrophoresis liquid, prevent that the inside waste residue of electrophoresis liquid from influencing electrophoresis application's efficiency and quality, and can pass through the second pipeline with the electrophoresis liquid after filtering and re-enter into the electrophoresis tank inside, keep the clean degree of electrophoresis liquid, it concentrates recovery processing to the waste residue also to be convenient for through the filter box simultaneously.

title_en: Novel four-side elastic fabric
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel four-side elastic fabric which comprises a surface layer, a middle layer and an inner layer, wherein a plurality of sponge layers which are uniformly distributed are respectively paved on the surface layer and the inner layer, an elastic layer which is contacted with the sponge layers is paved on the surface layer, a wavy damping layer is paved on the elastic layer, and a plurality of rubber strips are uniformly distributed between the damping layer and the elastic layer. This novel four sides bullet surface fabric has guaranteed to carry out effectual protection to people's elbow or knee, has reduced the injury that the impact produced people's health.

title_en: Glue tank fixing mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a glue tank fixing mechanism which comprises a fixing plate and a plurality of clamps; the fixture can clamp one glue tank and comprises a fixed hoop, a turnover cover plate, a knob seat and a knob; the fixed hoop is in threaded connection with the fixed plate, and a knob seat is arranged on one side edge of the fixed hoop; one end of the turning cover plate is hinged with the other side edge of the fixed hoop; the knob is used for being in threaded connection with the knob seat to control the opening and closing of the clamp. According to the utility model, a plurality of clamps are arranged on the fixing plate, so that each glue tank is independently clamped by one clamp. When the glue tank needs to be replaced, only the knob on the corresponding clamp needs to be rotated, so that the flip cover plate can loosen the occlusion of the glue tank, and then the glue tank is replaced. And after the rubber tank is replaced, the knob is rotated reversely. The cover turning plate and the fixed hoop are closed again, and then the glue tank is occluded, so that the targeted quick replacement of the glue tank is realized.

title_en: Supporting tool for copper coloring
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a supporting tool for coloring based on copper, which belongs to the field of thermal coloring and comprises a supporting plate, wherein the top of the supporting plate is fixedly connected with an electric push rod, the top of the electric push rod is fixedly connected with a motor, the top of the motor is fixedly connected with a rotating plate, the top of the rotating plate is connected with a fixing mechanism, the outer part of the motor is fixedly sleeved with a stabilizing plate, the bottom of the stabilizing plate is fixedly connected with a stabilizing rod, one side of the top of the supporting plate is fixedly connected with a fixing frame, through arranging the electric push rod, the motor and the rotating plate, the height of the motor and the rotating plate can be driven to change by starting the electric push rod in the using process of the supporting tool for coloring based on copper, the problem that a coloring technician is inconvenient to thermally color a copper product due to the height problem in the coloring process is avoided, and the rotating plate can be conveniently rotated by starting the motor, the copper product is convenient for a coloring technician to carry out omnibearing thermal coloring on the copper product.

title_en: Electrophoresis tank device for electrophoresis coating of automobile parts
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electrophoresis tank device for electrophoretic coating of automobile parts, which comprises an electrophoresis tank main body, wherein a working tank is arranged on the left side in the electrophoresis tank main body, a separation block is arranged on the right side of the working tank, a motor is fixedly connected to the bottom in the separation block, a first gear is fixedly connected to the middle of the bottom end of the motor, a second gear is meshed and connected to the right side of the first gear, the second gear is fixedly connected to the middle lower part of the periphery of a first rotating shaft, and a second stirring blade is fixedly connected to the top end of the first rotating shaft through a separation plate. According to the electrophoresis device, the first gear can be driven by the motor through the combination of the two gears, so that the first rotating shaft and the second rotating shaft are driven to rotate through the second gear and the third gear, the first stirring blade and the second stirring blade rotate, the electrophoresis liquid in the device cannot be condensed, the industrial production is facilitated, the production efficiency is improved through phase change, and the electrophoresis device is worthy of great popularization.

title_en: Double-layer antibacterial super-absorbent towel
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a double-layer antibacterial super-absorbent towel which comprises an external edge layer and a cushion layer, wherein the external edge layer is fixedly connected to the outer side of the cushion layer. According to the double-layer antibacterial super-absorbent towel, after the wrapping layer is contacted with water, the absorption layer absorbs the water immediately to keep the absorption layer and the wrapping layer moist, meanwhile, the antibacterial net isolates bacteria and impurities in the water absorbed by the absorption layer, when the water is sufficient, the absorption layer transfers the water to the inside after absorbing sufficient water, the water is transferred to the absorption cotton layer through the softening layer, the water absorption holes in the absorption cotton layer help the absorption cotton layer to absorb the water quickly to keep the moist state of the absorption cotton layer, meanwhile, the built-in net isolates the bacteria and the impurities in the water again, and the double-layer antibacterial structure is adopted, so that the bacteria and the impurities are isolated while absorbing the water.

title_en: Wear-resistant flame-retardant composite vamp fabric
abstract_en: The utility model discloses wear-resistant flame-retardant composite vamp cloth which comprises a first wear-resistant layer, wherein a first stretch-resistant layer is fixedly arranged at the top of the first wear-resistant layer, a first sponge layer is fixedly arranged at the top of the first stretch-resistant layer, an antibacterial layer is fixedly arranged at the top of the first sponge layer, a second sponge layer is fixedly arranged at the top of the antibacterial layer, a barrier layer is fixedly arranged at the top of the second sponge layer, a flame-retardant layer is fixedly arranged at the top of the barrier layer, a second stretch-resistant layer is fixedly arranged at the top of the flame-retardant layer, and a second wear-resistant layer is fixedly arranged at the top of the second stretch-resistant layer. According to the utility model, the vamp cloth is composed of the first wear-resistant layer, the second wear-resistant layer, the first stretch-resistant layer, the second stretch-resistant layer, the bacteria inhibiting layer, the first sponge layer, the second sponge layer and the flame-retardant layer, so that the wear resistance and stretch resistance of the vamp cloth are improved, and the vamp cloth can realize fire prevention, sterilization, deodorization, moisture absorption, water and oil repellency.

title_en: Shielding device of crystal oscillator probe and crystal oscillator detection mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a shielding device of a crystal oscillator probe and a crystal oscillator detection mechanism, comprising: the shielding component comprises a plurality of blocking pieces, and the blocking pieces can be matched to form a shielding part for shielding the crystal oscillator piece; and the driving component is connected with the shielding component and drives the shielding component to move so as to control the opening and closing degree of the shielding part. The service life of the crystal oscillator probe can be prolonged, and the monitoring precision of the crystal oscillator probe is improved.

title_en: Graphite boat and coating equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a graphite boat which comprises a plurality of graphite boat pieces and a carrying rod, wherein the plurality of graphite boat pieces are arranged at intervals, a plurality of clamping points are arranged on the side surface of each graphite boat piece and used for positioning a silicon wafer, the carrying rod sequentially penetrates through each graphite boat piece along the arrangement direction of the graphite boat pieces, and the height of the carrying rod is lower than that of the clamping point at the lowest position. According to the graphite boat and the coating equipment, the carrying rod is arranged below the clamping point, so that the carrying rod carries the silicon wafer which is separated from the constraint of the clamping point, and the silicon wafer is prevented from falling to the furnace tube, so that the falling quantity of the silicon wafers in the graphite boat is reduced, the maintenance period of the graphite boat is prolonged, and the difficulty in later cleaning is reduced.

title_en: Device capable of simultaneously producing hydrogen-rich water and oxyhydrogen gas
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device capable of simultaneously generating hydrogen-rich water and oxyhydrogen gas, which comprises a constant current power supply, a PEM (proton exchange membrane) electrolytic cell, a first pure water tank, a second pure water tank and a drinking water tank, wherein a first steam-water separator is installed at one hydrogen end of the PEM electrolytic cell, a second steam-water separator is installed at the other hydrogen end of the PEM electrolytic cell, a third steam-water separator is installed at one side of the first pure water tank, a water pump is installed at one side of the drinking water tank, a hydrogen mixing pump is arranged at one end of the water pump, a first one-way valve and a second one-way valve are respectively connected at one ends of the second steam-water separator and the third steam-water separator, and an oxyhydrogen gas outlet is formed at one end of the first one-way valve and one end of the second one-way valve. Has the advantages that: the electrolysis aquatic products produce hydrogen, and hydrogen mixes the hydrogen mode through the physics and generates the higher hydrogen-rich water of safer and more reliable's concentration, can generate the oxyhydrogen gas simultaneously to supply to utilize, the function is various, has fine popularization effect.

title_en: Novel electroplating hook and hanger
abstract_en: The utility model provides a novel electroplating hook and a hanger, which comprises a hook, wherein the hook is used for hanging a pipe fitting during electroplating, the hook comprises a hook part, the hook part comprises a fixed section, an arc-shaped section and an extension section, the fixed section, the arc-shaped section and the extension section are connected to form a hook-shaped structure, the depth of the hook part is recorded as S2, the width is recorded as S1, the height of the hook part is not less than 1.8S1 and not more than S2 and not more than 2.2S1, the height of the pipe fitting is recorded as h, the length of the extension section is recorded as L, the L is less than h, the inclination angle of the hook is recorded as alpha, and the alpha is not more than 20 degrees. According to the utility model, the pipe fitting is in a two-point supporting position when being hung by setting the relationship among a plurality of sizes, the top end of the extension section cannot extend out of the pipe fitting, the accumulation of plating solution at the top end of the extension section is avoided, meanwhile, the plating solution brought out when the pipe fitting is taken out after the electroplating is finished is reduced, and the surface quality of the plating layer is improved.

title_en: Multi-wire parallel pretreatment system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a multi-wire parallel connection pretreatment system which comprises a wire rod, a pay-off rack and a descaling box, wherein the wire rod, the pay-off rack and the descaling box are in one-to-one correspondence to form a group of pretreatment parts, the pretreatment parts comprise a plurality of groups, and the system also comprises a pickling tank, a rinsing tank, a boron-coated tank and a drying box, wherein the pickling tank comprises an outer tank, an inner tank, a first chemical pump and a pump control device, the pump control device comprises a shield, a control part and a switch assembly, the control part comprises a roller shaft, a clamping plate and a rack, and the switch assembly comprises a conductive rod and two conductive elastic pieces; the utility model enables a plurality of drawing production lines to share one set of pretreatment system, the pretreatment system can simultaneously treat a plurality of wire rods, the production cost is saved, and each drawing production line can independently control acid washing in the pretreatment process, thereby avoiding the continuous corrosion of the wire rods when the drawing production lines are stopped.

title_en: High-strength corrosion-resistant electro-galvanized steel strip
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of electrogalvanized steel strip manufacturing, and particularly relates to a high-strength corrosion-resistant electrogalvanized steel strip which comprises a steel strip plate body, wherein through holes which are symmetrically distributed along the central line of the steel strip plate body are formed in the head end and the tail end of the steel strip plate body, a plastic pull plate is arranged on one side of the steel strip plate body, anti-skid lines are arranged on the surface of the steel strip plate body, a zinc layer for preventing corrosion of the steel strip is electroplated and covered on the outer surface of the steel strip plate body, and an anti-rust oil layer is arranged on the outer surface of the zinc layer. The utility model passivates the zinc layer by chromate solution, so that the zinc layer is not easy to react with the aqueous solution condensed by the gas components in the atmosphere on the surface of the zinc layer, the falling time of the zinc layer is prolonged, the zinc layer is further isolated from contacting with the aqueous solution condensed by the gas components in the atmosphere by soaking in solvent diluted solution, the purpose of further prolonging the service life of the steel strip is achieved, and the steel strip is not easy to slip by the anti-slip patterns which are arranged on the surface of the steel strip and distributed in a rectangular array.

title_en: Oiling device for railway line fastener
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a railway line fastener oiling device which comprises a rolling brush oiling device support, wherein a vertical connecting rod is fixed in the middle of the top of the rolling brush oiling device support through welding, nozzle fixing plates are arranged at the front and the rear of the vertical connecting rod and fixed on the rolling brush oiling device support through welding, flat nozzles are arranged on the nozzle fixing plates, steel shaft arranging holes are formed in the front and the rear ends of the left side and the right side of the rolling brush oiling device support, two brush hair arranging sleeves are arranged at the front and the rear of the inner side of the rolling brush oiling device support, steel shafts are fixed in the steel shaft arranging holes in a sleeved mode and are provided with three gears on the right side of the rolling brush oiling device support, the steel shafts are connected with the corresponding gears in a sleeved mode, and a motor connecting end plate is fixed above the right side of the rolling brush oiling device support in a welded mode; the oiling device for the railway line fastener has the advantages of standard oiling operation quality, saving, environmental protection, low physical loss, less labor demand and good operation quality controllability.

title_en: Egg card spreading machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an egg card glue spreader, which comprises a frame and a glue box, wherein mounting plates are fixedly mounted on two sides of one end of the frame, a driving motor is fixedly mounted on the inner side of one mounting plate, a rotating column is fixedly connected to the output end of the driving motor, one end of the rotating column, far away from the driving motor, is fixedly connected with the inner side of the other mounting plate, a first fixing rod and a second fixing rod are fixedly connected between the two mounting plates from top to bottom in sequence, a vacuum pump is fixedly mounted in the middle of the first fixing rod through a folded connecting plate, and a plurality of suction pipes are fixedly communicated with the air inlet end of the vacuum pump. The production cost is reduced, and the actual use requirement can be met.

title_en: Silica gel gun
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a silica gel gun, which comprises a rubber barrel, wherein a fixed handle is connected below the right end surface of the rubber barrel, swinging plates are movably attached to the front end surface and the rear end surface of the fixed handle, a connecting transverse plate is connected above the right end surface of the rubber barrel, a push plate assembly is arranged in an inner cavity of the rubber barrel, a spring member is arranged on a push rod, a pull plate is arranged on the right end surface of the push rod, and a sealing gun head is arranged on the left side of the rubber barrel. The silica gel gun is simple in structure and convenient to use, glass cement in the hollow conical cylinder body can be completely extruded when the silica gel gun is used, so that the waste caused by the fact that the glass cement in the hollow conical cylinder body cannot be completely extruded is avoided, meanwhile, the silica gel machine can seal the connecting gap between the rubber cylinder and the external lantern ring, and the waste of the glass cement caused by the fact that the glass cement leaks from the connecting gap between the rubber cylinder and the external lantern ring is avoided.

title_en: Composite non-woven fabric
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a composite non-woven fabric which comprises a base fabric, wherein a composite layer is arranged on the inner side surface of the base fabric, the composite layer comprises a pure cotton cloth pad, bamboo charcoal fiber yarns and Koran fiber yarns, the pure cotton cloth pad is fixedly connected to the inner side surface of the base fabric, the bamboo charcoal fiber yarns are blended inside the pure cotton cloth pad, and the Koran fiber yarns are woven on the outer side of the bamboo charcoal fiber yarns. This compound non-woven fabrics, cooperation through between base cloth and the composite bed, the base cloth makes the gauze mask and carries out during the use, when the inboard kazai gas liquefaction of base cloth produced water stain, the moisture major part can be filled up by pure cotton cloth and absorb, can obviously reduce the inside probability that ponding appears of base cloth, user's travelling comfort can obviously promote, and the bamboo charcoal fiber silk and the kanglun fiber silk of the inside blending of pure cotton cloth pad, can make the inside certain anti smelly antibacterial performance that possesses of base cloth, can further promote user's comfortable experience, the utilization is used widely.

title_en: Equipment fixing auxiliary device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an equipment installation auxiliary device which comprises an installation platform and an equipment moving mechanism to be installed, wherein the equipment moving mechanism is positioned above the installation platform. The utility model aims to provide an equipment installation auxiliary device which can install equipment to be installed more quickly and conveniently, reduce the working strength of workers during installation or maintenance and repair and eliminate potential safety hazards.

title_en: Self-heating carbon-carbon vapor deposition furnace
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of carbon-carbon composite material production, and discloses an self-heating carbon-carbon vapor deposition furnace; the carbon-carbon composite material deposition furnace comprises a furnace body and a deposition gas inlet pipe connected with the furnace body, wherein a tank body for placing a carbon-carbon prefabricated body is arranged in the furnace body, an upper conductive plate is arranged at the top of the tank body, a lower conductive plate is arranged at the bottom of the tank body, and the carbon-carbon prefabricated body is positioned between the upper conductive plate and the lower conductive plate and is in close contact with the upper conductive plate and the lower conductive plate; the upper and lower conductive plates are connected with electrodes; according to the utility model, the direct-current power supply is directly connected to the carbon-carbon preform, so that the carbon-carbon preform can generate stable heat, the rapid heating is realized, meanwhile, the deposition gas source can be decomposed only when contacting the high-temperature carbon preform, the deposition of the outer wall of the carbon-carbon preform in the deposition process is reduced through the self-heating of the carbon-carbon preform, and the utilization rate of the deposition gas is improved.

title_en: Crystal furnace with side door
abstract_en: A crystal furnace with a side door comprises a crystal furnace body and a side door positioned on one side of the crystal furnace body; the crystal furnace body is cylindrical, a lateral opening is formed in one side of the crystal furnace body along the chord direction, and a connecting frame is arranged on the outer side of the crystal furnace body in the circumferential direction of the lateral opening in a protruding mode; the side door comprises a side door body and a cavity part arranged in the middle of the side door, and an arc-shaped cavity is concavely arranged on one side of the cavity part facing the crystal furnace body; a plurality of connecting grooves are formed in the two sides of the connecting frame and the side door; a locking mechanism is movably located in the connecting groove and locks the side door to the connecting frame. A lateral opening is formed in one side of the crystal furnace body in the chord direction, a side door is arranged at the lateral opening and is locked through a locking mechanism, and therefore cleaning and washing are facilitated.

title_en: Movable copper line electroplating device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a movable copper wire electroplating device which comprises a box body, wherein an electromechanical box is arranged on the left side surface of the box body, a motor is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the electromechanical box, two first bearings are fixedly embedded in the inner wall of the box body, a threaded rod is fixedly connected to the inner walls of the two first bearings together, the left end of the threaded rod is fixedly connected with the output end of the motor, an adsorption device is connected to the outer surface of the threaded rod in a threaded mode, a through groove is formed in the back surface of the box body, a supporting plate is arranged below the through groove, an air pump is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the supporting plate, and the output end of the air pump is fixedly communicated with the upper surface of the adsorption device through a guide pipe. The electroplating device has a reasonable design structure, the sliding door can be arranged and can freely slide left and right, electroplating liquid splashes upwards in the electroplating process, and the sliding door can play a role in safe protection and putting in and avoid splashing on clothes of workers.

title_en: Automatic film tearing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic film tearing device which comprises a rack, a film tearing mechanism, an adhesive tape, a waste film recovery mechanism and an XYZ three-axis movement mechanism, wherein the rack is provided with a support; the X-axis and Y-axis three-axis movement mechanism is formed by sequentially connecting an X-axis movement mechanism, a Y-axis movement mechanism and a Z-axis movement mechanism in a linkage manner, a rack is vertically arranged at the movable end of the Z-axis movement mechanism, the rack is of a vertically arranged hollow cuboid structure, a film tearing mechanism is horizontally arranged at the position above the front surface of the rack, a waste film recycling mechanism is arranged on the left side of the position below the front surface of the rack, and the recycling end of the waste film recycling mechanism is connected with the output end of the film tearing mechanism in a linkage manner; the adhesive tape is in contact with a product through the film tearing mechanism to tear the film, and the waste film is recovered through the waste film recovery mechanism. The film tearing machine is simple in structure and convenient to operate, achieves an automatic film tearing effect, improves the film tearing efficiency, improves the yield, reduces the cost and reduces the expenditure of enterprises.

title_en: Electroplating processing is with electroplating piece belt cleaning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electroplate processing is with plated item belt cleaning device relates to plated item washing technical field, including purger, riser, stoving atomizer, activity roof and packing storehouse, fixedly connected with riser on the both sides surface of purger, fixedly connected with stoving atomizer on one side surface of riser, the activity overlap joint has movable roof on the surface of riser, the activity overlap joint has the packing storehouse on the surface of activity roof. The utility model discloses a fixed panel fixes the heating pipe, the cooperation heating pipe carries out thermal production in the inside of stoving atomizer, the heat can be piled up in the inside of stoving atomizer, produce the high atmospheric pressure, the cooperation atomising head sprays away to inside heat, the cooperation atomising head increases the scope of spraying, possessed and carried out the characteristics of high temperature drying to the article, solve remaining moisture on the surface, do not dry and can lead to the rusty problem of object to reach the effect of carrying out quick drying to the plated item after wasing.

title_en: Aluminum alloy passivation solution processing is with allotment treatment facility
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a blending treatment device for processing an aluminum alloy passivation solution, which comprises a tank body, wherein a plurality of supporting legs are uniformly fixed on the lower surface of the tank body through bolts, a feeding cylinder is communicated with the upper surface of the tank body, a discharging port is communicated with the lower surface of the tank body, a switch valve is arranged on the side surface of the discharging port, a cylinder cover is covered on the feeding cylinder, a stirring assembly extending into the tank body is arranged on the cylinder cover, and a blending assembly communicated with the tank body is arranged at the upper end of the outer side surface of the tank body. The utility model has the advantages that: can quantitatively add different liquid to the jar internal simultaneously and allocate, labour saving and time saving, efficiency is higher and the stirring degree of consistency is better.

title_en: Alloy target with high visible light absorption
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an alloy target with high visible light absorption, which comprises a glass tube, wherein an alloy target material is arranged on the surface of the glass tube, a first functional layer is arranged on the outer surface of the alloy target material, the first functional layer comprises a semi-alicyclic polyimide film and a zirconium oxide antireflection film, a second functional layer is arranged on the outer surface of the first functional layer, the second functional layer comprises a PE (polyethylene) anti-oxidation film and a UV (ultraviolet) anti-oxidation film, the alloy target material is made of copper, the semi-alicyclic polyimide film is arranged on the outer surface of the alloy target material, and the zirconium oxide antireflection film is arranged on the outer surface of the semi-alicyclic polyimide film. The utility model solves the problems that the existing alloy target does not have high visible light absorption performance and does not have oxidation resistance and low reflection performance simultaneously in the use process through the matching of the glass tube, the alloy target material, the first functional layer, the semi-alicyclic polyimide film, the zirconium oxide antireflection film, the second functional layer, the PE oxidation-resistant film and the UV oxidation-resistant film.

title_en: High-speed surface treatment device for continuous IC intelligent card carrier band
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-speed surface treatment device for a continuous IC smart card carrier tape, which comprises: the drainage device comprises a body, a drainage pipe and a drainage pipe, wherein the body is of a tubular structure, a plurality of drainage holes penetrating through the body along the wall thickness direction are formed in the body, and the drainage holes are uniformly formed along the circumferential direction; a plurality of sealing strips, a plurality of sealing strips are end to end in proper order, form the sealing ring, and the sealing ring cover is established on the body, has seted up a plurality of feed liquor holes that run through along the thickness direction on the sealing strip, and feed liquor hole and drainage hole are linked together, and the surface and the carrier band roll of sealing strip are pasted mutually, and the plating solution contacts with the carrier band behind drainage hole and feed liquor hole. The electroplating liquid drainage device is simple in structure, continuous treatment is realized by arranging the sealing strips on the body and enabling the carrier tape to be in rolling contact with the sealing strips, and local treatment on the surface of the carrier tape is realized by utilizing the drainage holes and the liquid inlet holes to conduct drainage on electroplating liquid, so that the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: New energy automobile rubber nanometer heat insulation composite material
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rubber nanometer heat-insulation composite material for a new energy automobile, and relates to the technical field of new energy automobile protection gaskets. The utility model comprises a wear-resistant layer, an upper material base layer, a lower material base layer, a heat-insulating layer and a waterproof layer. According to the utility model, the upper material base layer, the lower material base layer and the support pad form a plurality of filling areas for filling the heat insulation layer and the waterproof layer, so that after part of the area is damaged, the protective performance of other areas is not influenced, the material performance failure caused by the permeation of the whole material due to the partial damage of the material is avoided, and the effect of stopping damage is achieved; simultaneously, the upper material base layer and the lower material base layer are in interference connection through the matching of the clamping grooves and the clamping blocks, the upper material base layer and the lower material base layer are wrapped outside the waterproof layer and the waterproof layer to form a main body base material, the stability of the material is improved, and the heat and moisture generated on the periphery of the protective material are isolated through the heat insulation layer and the waterproof layer.

title_en: Prevent engineering hoist and mount bag cloth that punctures
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a puncture-preventing engineering lifting bag cloth, which relates to the technical field of lifting bag cloth and comprises a reinforcing cloth and a plurality of lifting cloths, wherein the reinforcing cloth is arranged in a groined shape, the lifting cloths are distributed in a rectangular array, the reinforcing cloth is connected with the edges of the lifting cloths in a sewing manner, each lifting cloth comprises an elastic layer, the lower surface of the elastic layer is connected with a first waterproof layer in an adhering manner, a first wear-resistant layer is arranged below the first waterproof layer, a glue layer is filled between the first waterproof layer and the first wear-resistant layer, and a plurality of uniformly-dispersed hard particles are embedded in the glue layer. According to the utility model, the reinforcing cloth is arranged in the shape of a Chinese character jing, and the plurality of hoisting cloth and the reinforcing cloth are connected into an integral fabric in a sewing way, so that when the hoisting cloth is punctured, the hoisting cloth can deform and the stressed force is uniformly dispersed to the surrounding reinforcing cloth, the puncturing force on the hoisting cloth is reduced, and the hoisting cloth is prevented from being punctured.

title_en: Automatic gluing device for building glass
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic gluing device for building glass, which comprises a rack, a bearing frame, a transmission case, a storage table and a control panel, wherein the storage table is arranged at the bottom of the rack, a glass body is placed at the central position of the top end of the storage table, the transmission case is arranged at the top of the rack, a strip-shaped groove is arranged at the central position of the bottom of the transmission case, the bottom end of the strip-shaped groove extends to the outside of the transmission case, a lead screw is arranged at the central position of the inside of the transmission case, one end of the lead screw is rotatably connected with the inner wall of the transmission case, a nut is in threaded connection with the central position of the surface of the lead screw, a bearing rod is fixed at the central position of the bottom end of the nut, and one end, far away from the nut, of the bearing rod penetrates through the strip-shaped groove and is fixed with the bearing frame. The utility model not only improves the convenience and the precision of the gluing device during use, but also ensures the integrity of the glass body of the gluing device during use.

title_en: Vacuum suction platform for removing bearing film
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a vacuum suction platform for removing a bearing film, which can comprise a base and a sealing cover assembly, wherein the base is provided with a vacuum chamber and a plurality of vacuumizing adapter ports communicated with the vacuum chamber, the vacuumizing adapter ports are used for connecting vacuum tubes communicated with a vacuum machine, the sealing cover assembly comprises a lower cover, an upper cover and a buffering honeycomb plate, the lower cover is hermetically arranged on the base, the bottom of the lower cover is provided with a plurality of through holes communicated with the vacuum chamber, the buffering honeycomb plate is embedded in the lower cover and is in fluid communication with the through holes, the upper cover is hermetically arranged on the lower cover, a wire mesh is arranged on the upper cover, the wire mesh is in fluid communication with the buffering honeycomb plate and is used for adsorbing a product, and the bearing film adhered to the back of the product faces upwards. Through this vacuum platform that inhales, when peeling off the carrier film, can ensure that the product can not warp along with the carrier film and form the crooked risk of product pincher trees.

title_en: Spraying device
abstract_en: A spray coating device comprising: the conveying assembly comprises a conveying component, and one end of the conveying component is provided with a driving component; the scraping and coating assembly is arranged on the conveying assembly and comprises a pair of upper extension rods arranged on two sides of the conveying assembly, first bearing seats are arranged at the upper ends of the upper extension rods, a plurality of guide rods are arranged between the first bearing seats, a lead screw is arranged between the first bearing seats, one end of the lead screw is connected with a first motor, the first motor is arranged on one of the first bearing seats, a moving seat is screwed on the lead screw, the guide rods penetrate through the moving seat, and a scraping plate is arranged on the moving seat in a downward extending manner; the gluing component is arranged on the moving seat. The utility model can uniformly coat the special glue or the liquid medicine on one side of the dry film, and can dry the dry film after coating, thereby reducing the moisture in the dry film, improving the quality of the dry film and having stronger practicability.

title_en: Antibacterial bath towel
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an antibacterial bath towel which comprises a bath towel body, wherein the bath towel body comprises an inner substrate layer, a first surface layer and a second surface layer which are arranged at the periphery, and further comprises a first antibacterial layer, an anti-mite layer and a second antibacterial layer which are arranged between the first surface layer and the substrate layer and between the second surface layer and the substrate layer, wherein the anti-mite layer is arranged between the first antibacterial layer and the second antibacterial layer, the first antibacterial layer and the second antibacterial layer are made of bamboo fiber fabrics, the anti-mite layer is made of bamboo fiber flax fabrics, the first surface layer is made of pure cotton, and the second surface layer is made of nylon. According to the bath towel, the first antibacterial layer, the anti-mite layer and the second antibacterial layer are arranged between the substrate layer and the first surface layer and between the substrate layer and the second surface layer, so that the antibacterial and anti-mite capabilities of the bath towel are improved, the generation of bacteria and mites can be effectively reduced, and the health of users is facilitated.

title_en: New energy automobile spare part processing application device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of new energy automobile part processing, in particular to a new energy automobile part processing and coating device, which adopts a working box and also comprises a driving mechanism; the driving mechanism comprises a fixed rack, a movable rack, a connecting rod and two gears; the fixed rack is arranged on the bottom surface of the inner part of the working box; the movable rack is arranged above the fixed rack in a horizontally movable manner and is connected with the paint spraying assembly; the two gears can be meshed with the fixed rack and the movable rack respectively, and clamps for clamping automobile parts are mounted on the two gears; the two gears are respectively and rotatably connected with the two ends of the connecting rod; the connecting rod can be horizontally arranged between the fixed rack and the movable rack in a reciprocating manner. The utility model has the advantages of uniform spraying and high efficiency.

title_en: Be used for boats and ships pipeline inner wall belt cleaning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cleaning device for the inner wall of a ship pipeline, which relates to the field of ship pipeline cleaning and comprises a supporting device, a flushing device, a water outlet device, a rotating device and a recovery device, wherein the supporting device comprises a bottom plate, a side plate and supporting legs, the flushing device comprises a liquid storage tank, the water outlet device comprises a water spray pipe and a high-pressure pump, the rotating device comprises a motor, a first gear, a second gear and a mounting plate, and the recovery device comprises a waste liquid tank and a filter screen. The utility model relates to a cleaning device for the inner wall of a ship pipeline, which is characterized in that a pipeline to be cleaned is placed on the surface of one side of a clamping disc, a high-pressure pump and a motor are started after the pipeline to be cleaned is fixed, the high-pressure pump pressurizes liquid in a liquid storage tank at the moment, the inner wall of the pipeline is cleaned, the motor rotates to enable the clamped pipeline to rotate, the purpose of cleaning the inside of the pipeline is achieved, a cleaning brush is arranged to clean the inner wall, and discharged liquid enters a waste liquid tank.

title_en: High-strength non-woven fabric
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of non-woven fabrics, and discloses a high-strength non-woven fabric which comprises a non-woven fabric body, wherein a polyester short fiber layer is fixedly connected to the bottom of the non-woven fabric body, an auxiliary agent layer is fixedly connected to the bottom of the polyester short fiber layer, an aromatic polyamide fiber layer is fixedly connected to the bottom of the auxiliary agent layer, permeation layers are respectively arranged at junctions of the auxiliary agent layer, the polyester short fiber layer and the aromatic polyamide fiber layer, rubber protrusions are fixedly connected to the bottom of the aromatic polyamide fiber layer, a reinforcing layer is arranged at the top of the non-woven fabric body, and a waterproof layer is arranged at the top of the reinforcing layer.
