This high strength non-woven fabrics crosses the setting on latticed glass fiber layer, polyvinyl alcohol fibrous layer, metal fiber layer, high strength long fiber layer, the thinner layer that set up, and the effectual intensity that improves the non-woven fabrics body through the shaping of abrasionproof ripple line at the attached layer surface of polyvinyl chloride, and the abrasionproof ripple line can improve the wear resistance of non-woven fabrics body.

title_en: Novel polyester fiber cotton composite heat-preservation sound-insulation coiled material
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel polyester fiber cotton composite heat-preservation sound-insulation coiled material which comprises an upper isolation layer, a polyester fiber cotton layer, a sound absorption layer, a heat preservation layer, a non-woven fabric layer, a polyester tire base fabric layer, a polymer self-oil-staining layer and a lower isolation layer which are arranged from top to bottom respectively, wherein a plurality of through holes are uniformly formed in the upper isolation layer at intervals, the bottoms of the through holes are abutted to the sound absorption layer, a plurality of honeycomb holes are uniformly formed in the sound absorption layer at intervals, the thicknesses of the upper isolation layer, the polyester fiber cotton layer, the heat preservation layer, the non-woven fabric layer, the polyester tire base fabric layer, the polymer self-oil-staining layer and the lower isolation layer are all 2mm, and the thickness of the sound absorption layer is 5 mm. The sound absorption layer is made of centrifugal glass wool, and the heat preservation layer is made of aluminum foil. The upper isolation layer and the lower isolation layer are both made of petroleum asphalt felt materials. The utility model has good sound absorption and heat preservation effects and strong practicability.

title_en: High-strength ventilating and light-transmitting type agricultural greenhouse film with good applicability
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a big-arch shelter membrane is used to agricultural that high strength ventilative printing opacity type suitability is good, including the basic unit, the top of basic unit is equipped with the HDPE rete, the HDPE rete with form confined space between the basic unit, the top of HDPE rete is equipped with the combined film, the top of PVC fibrous layer is equipped with the endurance layer, the top on endurance layer is equipped with fire-retardant layer, the top on fire-retardant layer is equipped with the photostabilization layer, the top on photostabilization layer is equipped with the tensile polypropylene thin layer. Has the advantages that: the intensity of this big-arch shelter membrane can greatly be strengthened, adopt alkene as the base film, can improve the light transmissivity of this big-arch shelter membrane, can fine satisfy operation requirement, and fill in the confined space heat absorbing substance or thermal-insulated gas, improve the heat absorption capacity in airtight space, further improve the thermal-insulated effect of rete, improve the growth rate of inside crop to improve farming's profit margin.

title_en: Glue and seal installation auxiliary structure for glue
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an installation auxiliary structure for sealing glue, which comprises a workbench, a positioning jig, a sealing glue steel mesh, a base and a scraper, wherein the sealing glue steel mesh is installed on one side of the base, the positioning jig is installed on the workbench, the workbench is arranged on the base, the scraper is arranged on one side of the base, a fixed shaft is arranged at the upper part of one end of the base, a rotating shaft is arranged on the fixed shaft, the rotating shaft is connected with one end of the sealing glue steel mesh, the sealing glue steel mesh is overlapped and contacted with the workbench when rotating to be vertical to the fixed shaft, namely, the mesh surface of the sealing glue steel mesh is tightly attached to the positioning jig, and the workbench is fixed to the base through bolts. The rotation axis passes through one side that fixing bolt connects and seals the glue steel mesh, seals through the design and glues with installation auxiliary structure, and it includes seals glue steel mesh and positioning jig, through positioning jig with the work piece location back, the rethread seals the glue steel mesh and carries out local frictioning, can solve the problem of difficult operation when sealing the glue to the work piece.

title_en: Combined crucible and growth furnace for preparing ultra-long crystal
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a combined crucible for preparing an ultra-long crystal, which comprises a crucible main body, wherein a stock bin sleeve is superposed on the top of the crucible main body, a crucible cover is arranged on the top of the stock bin sleeve, an inner cavity of the crucible main body is matched with the inner wall of the stock bin sleeve to form a growth bin, a bottom mold and an extension mold are arranged in the growth bin in a stacking manner from bottom to top, a growth groove is formed in the bottom mold, an extension growth hole matched with the growth groove is formed in the extension mold, and a raw material cavity is arranged in the stock bin sleeve between the extension mold and the crucible cover; also provides a growth furnace adopting the crucible. The utility model has convenient disassembly and assembly, high growth quality and can reduce the use cost.

title_en: Plate coating machine material transfer system based on coating amount accurate control and coating machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a plate coating machine material transfer system based on coating amount accurate control and a coating machine, and belongs to the field of coating machines. In the material transfer process, the position, which is contacted with the cloth roller body, on the coating roller surface of the coating roller body is a first line position, and the position, which is closest to the axis of the bearing roller body, on the coating roller surface of the coating roller body is a second line position; the first line position is lower than the highest end of the coating roller body; the second line is higher than the lowest end of the coating roller body; the first line is higher than the second line; the first line position and the second line position are located on the coating roller body and are far away from one side of a coating material feeding position, in the rotating direction of the coating roller body, the roller surface distance between the first line position and the second line position is greater than the roller surface distance between the first line position and the lowest end of the coating roller body, so that materials can be fully spread on the coating roller body, the uniformity of the materials on the coating roller body is improved, and further, the coating effect is good when the coating amount is large.

title_en: PVC coating roller coat device of adjustable thickness
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of roller coating equipment, in particular to a PVC coating roller coating device with adjustable thickness, which comprises a mounting plate, sliding grooves, two connecting seats, an adjusting mechanism, two gluing mechanisms and a single chip microcomputer, wherein the sliding grooves are respectively formed on the surfaces, close to two sides, of the mounting plate, and the two connecting seats are respectively and fixedly connected to the surfaces, corresponding to the right ends of the sliding grooves, of the mounting plate; adjustment mechanism contains sliding block, supporting shoe, adjustment lead screw, servo motor and connecting rod, two sliding blocks are a set of, the sliding block is provided with two sets ofly, and two sets of sliding blocks are sliding connection respectively in two sliding tray, the upper end of sliding block is provided with the supporting shoe, the both ends of adjustment lead screw respectively with the intermediate position threaded connection of every group sliding block, the screw thread opposite direction of adjustment lead screw intermediate position both sides, this application has can the automatic adjustment roller coat thickness, and the adjustment precision is high, the steady effect of operation process.

title_en: Cleaning and lubricating device for cable protection pipe
abstract_en: The utility model provides a cleaning and lubricating device for a cable protection pipe, which comprises: a transmission shaft is fixedly connected to an output shaft of the rotating motor, and a traction rope is arranged at one end of the rotating motor, which is far away from the output shaft; the first transmission drum is sleeved on the transmission shaft through a coupler, the first transmission drum is arranged close to the rotating motor, and the outer end face of the first transmission drum is provided with a steel wire brush; the second transmission cylinder is sleeved on the transmission shaft through the coupler and is arranged adjacent to the first transmission cylinder, and a sponge layer is arranged outside the second transmission cylinder; lubricating mechanism passes through the shaft coupling overcoat and on the transmission shaft, and lubricating mechanism and the adjacent setting of second driving barrel are equipped with a plurality of liquid holes in the lubricating mechanism, are equipped with the brush on the lubricating mechanism periphery, and the setting of liquid hole is kept away from to the brush, is equipped with lubricating liquid in the lubricating mechanism. The cable protection pipe can be cleaned up to protect the cable from being damaged, and the lubricant is smeared on the inner wall of the cable protection pipe, so that the laying construction quality and the working efficiency of the cable in the cable protection pipe are improved.

title_en: Lightweight reinforced corrugated carton
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of packaging products, and particularly relates to a lightweight reinforced corrugated carton which comprises a carton body, wherein a positioning support for positioning the appearance of the carton body is arranged on the inner side of the carton body, the positioning support comprises a frame body tightly attached to the inner wall of the carton body, and four vertical supporting plates integrally formed on the lower surface of the frame body, the lower ends of the four vertical supporting plates are respectively provided with a base, and the carton body comprises a paper base layer and a waterproof breathable film fixedly connected to the inner wall of the paper base layer. According to the utility model, the positioning support is arranged on the inner side of the corrugated case, and the reinforcing block is inserted and connected at the corner in the case, so that the strength of the corrugated case can be enhanced when the corrugated case is used, the protection effect is good, the use safety of the corrugated case is ensured, and meanwhile, the waterproof breathable film is fixedly connected on the inner wall of the corrugated case, and the problems of insufficient strength and poor moisture resistance of the corrugated case at the present stage are solved.

title_en: Connecting structure of diffuser and back plate and chemical vapor deposition device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a connecting structure of a diffuser and a backboard and a chemical vapor deposition device, wherein the connecting structure of the diffuser and the backboard comprises a plurality of connecting plates and blocking plates, a gap is formed between every two adjacent connecting plates at intervals, one end of each connecting plate is connected with the diffuser, and the other end of each connecting plate is connected with the backboard; the plugging plates are respectively connected with the two adjacent connecting plates in a sliding mode, and gaps between the two adjacent connecting plates can be plugged by the plugging plates. Through two connecting plate sliding connection with every corner of diffuser in the closure plate, for the diffuser supplies the inflation space, prevent that the welding point of two connecting plates of diffuser corner welded connection from warping or the fracture originally, the clearance that probably produces between two connecting plates can be shutoff to the closure plate simultaneously, even after the diffuser is heated the inflation, still can guarantee that the reactant can only get into the reacting chamber through the through-hole on the diffuser for the reactant diffusion is even, improves the coating film quality.

title_en: Uniform gluing device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of mechanical product assembly and gluing, and relates to a quantitative uniform gluing device. The glue solution can not be evenly coated on the surface to be coated with glue, and the coating amount is not easy to control. The utility model provides a uniform gluing device which comprises an external support and a gluing pen, wherein an internal support is fixed on the external support after rotating to an adaptive angle relative to the external support, a transmission gear set, a rotating rod and an electric motor are further arranged on the internal support, the electric motor transmits torque to the rotating rod through the transmission gear set, a clamp is arranged on the end of the rotating rod, which penetrates out of the internal support upwards, and a part/assembly is clamped on the clamp. The glue taking head has the advantages of being reasonable and stable in structure, simple and convenient to operate, and capable of supporting the requirements of quantitative uniform gluing of the zero/assembly of various structures and sizes, and ensuring that the glue taking amount is basically consistent under the conditions that the specifications of the glue taking head are fixed and the glue viscosity is fixed.

title_en: Flame-retardant polyester taffeta
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a flame-retardant polyester taffeta, relates to the technical field of textile fabrics, and aims to solve the problem that the traditional polyester taffeta fabric is poor in flame-retardant performance. The key points of the technical scheme are as follows: including the inlayer and the skin of reciprocal anchorage, inlayer and skin are woven by fire-retardant yarn longitude and latitude and are formed, and fire-retardant yarn includes fire-retardant yarn core, endocyst cladding, fire-retardant coating and the elasticity coating that sets gradually from inside to outside, and the elasticity coating compresses tightly one side of fire-retardant coating orientation fire-retardant yarn core and is formed with a plurality of concave parts. The flame-retardant polyester fiber is arranged in the flame-retardant polyester fiber, and the overall flame retardance of the structure is enhanced by utilizing the characteristic of good flame retardance of the novel material.

title_en: Compressive PVDC film with high tensile strength
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of PVDC films, in particular to a compression-resistant PVDC film with high tensile strength, which comprises the following components: the first pressure resistant layer and the second pressure resistant layer are both made of wood cellulose fibers, pressure resistant strips and pressure resistant strips are respectively arranged on the first pressure resistant layer and the second pressure resistant layer, the pressure resistant strips are connected with the pressure resistant strips through strip-shaped adhesive layers to form a circle, and when the first pressure resistant layer is subjected to pressure or the second pressure resistant layer is subjected to pressure, the pressure resistant strips and the pressure resistant strips are both pressed and extend to two sides; the compression resistant strips and the stretching strips are of wave structures with inclined angles, so that the compression resistant strips and the stretching strips have certain stretching force; the lower surface of the second pressure resistant layer is also provided with an adhesive layer with fiber yarns, and the tensile strength of the tear resistant layer is enhanced through the fiber yarns, so that the tensile strength of the anti-tear anti-.

title_en: High gloss contact ultraviolet curing device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a high-gloss contact type ultraviolet curing device which comprises a first roller set, a second roller set and a first ultraviolet light source. The first roller group comprises a first left roller, a first right roller and a first transparent film, two ends of the first transparent film are connected with each other and sleeved on the first left roller and the first right roller, and the surface of the first transparent film is a smooth flat surface. The first ultraviolet light source is arranged between the first left roller and the first right roller. The second roller group comprises a second left roller, a second right roller and a second transparent film, two ends of the second transparent film are connected with each other and sleeved on the second left roller and the second right roller, and the surface of the second transparent film is a smooth flat surface. A substrate is arranged between the first roller group and the second roller group, and the upper surface of the substrate is coated with ultraviolet curing coating.

title_en: A novel rectifier transformer device for electrolytic copper foil production
abstract_en: The utility model provides a novel rectifier transformer device for electrolytic copper foil production, which belongs to the technical field of electrolytic copper foil rectifier transformers and comprises a rectifier transformer body, wherein a connecting block is fixedly connected to one side end of the rectifier transformer body, three rectifying pipelines are fixedly connected to the inner walls of two sides of the rectifier transformer body, measuring ends are fixedly connected to the circumferential surfaces of the three rectifying pipelines, a line measuring pipe and a current measuring fixing box are fixedly connected to the circumferential surfaces of the three measuring ends, the current measuring fixing box is slidably connected to the front end of the connecting block, the clamping block can extrude a second spring to contract the second spring and extrude a sliding rod to slide leftwards on the circumferential inner wall of a second circular hole, and then a worker rotates a bolt to rotate in a first threaded hole and is in threaded connection with the rear end of the second threaded hole, thereby achieving the fixing effect.

title_en: Gear rust prevention device

title_en: Multilayer co-extrusion bubble vacuum standing bag film

The co-extrusion film produced by the utility model has stronger functionality and comprehensiveness, can realize stronger surface printing effect, vacuumizing and high tensile property, improves the low-temperature brittleness, the falling bag breaking rate and the like of the film produced by the co-extrusion process, and solves the problem that the rice, coarse cereals, cereals and other heavy packages adopt inner and outer matched packages.

title_en: Acupuncture rock wool blanket

title_en: Hydrogen generator with slow-release hydrogen production function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hydrogen generator with a slow-release hydrogen production function, which comprises a shell, an electrolytic separation tank and an adjusting mechanism communicated with the electrolytic separation tank, wherein the adjusting mechanism comprises an extraction cabin, a piston disc and a driving piece, the extraction cabin is communicated with the electrolytic separation tank, the inner wall of the extraction cabin is connected with the piston disc in a sliding mode, the piston disc is in transmission connection with the driving piece, and the proton membrane hydrogen production mechanism comprises a proton exchange membrane and a buoyancy switch. According to the utility model, pure water in the electrolytic separation tank is pumped into the extraction cabin, so that the water level of the electrolytic separation tank is reduced, the buoyancy switch on the proton exchange membrane away from the water body loses buoyancy brought by the water body and is disconnected, and the proton exchange membrane away from the water body stops supplying power; the proton exchange membrane leaked out of the water surface is prevented from being continuously electrified, so that the proton exchange membrane is prevented from being burnt; meanwhile, the proton exchange membrane stops supplying power, so that energy waste can be reduced when the slow release hydrogen production is realized.

The utility model discloses a cloth body, cloth body are from outer to interior outer contact layer, layer of ventilating, air bed and the inner liner of being equipped with in proper order, and outer contact layer and the layer activity butt of ventilating link to each other, are the rectangle array distribution on the outer contact layer and seted up the first draught hole of a plurality of groups, and the layer of ventilating is close to one side equidistant a plurality of groups recesses of having seted up of outer contact layer, every group all be equipped with a set of gasbag in the recess, every group the gasbag all is connected with outer contact layer transmission, is the rectangle rectification distribution on the layer of ventilating and has seted up a plurality of groups second draught hole, second draught hole and first draught hole dislocation set, and the gap and the second draught hole intercommunication of air bed are the rectangle array distribution on the inner liner and have seted up a plurality of groups third draught hole, the gap intercommunication of third draught hole and air bed. The utility model discloses a ventilation cooling and seal the function that keeps warm and change along with temperature variation, improved the compatibility of cloth.

title_en: Lithium scooping spoon for mechanical arm
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lithium spoon for arm belongs to metal smelting casting technical field. The method comprises the following steps: the material bearing disc is internally provided with a feed opening; the discharging angle is connected with one end of the material bearing disc; the hook is arranged in the width direction of the material bearing disc relatively. The utility model discloses can improve liquid metal lithium and molten salt electrolyte separation rate, reduce and take out the molten salt electrolyte and the lithium-containing sediment volume that forms, avoid polluting metal lithium, improve the purity of metal lithium spindle, reduction in production cost.

title_en: Digital balance locking valve
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a balanced locking valve of digit, the mounting panel comprises a mounting plate, the inboard fixed connection elasticity telescopic link at mounting panel top, the equal fixedly connected with fixed block in both sides at mounting panel top, the inner chamber of fixed block is pegged graft with elasticity telescopic link's flexible end, the surface of the flexible end of elasticity telescopic link is pegged graft and is had the riser, the top fixedly connected with valve body of riser, the valve body includes pipeline, fixed pipe, digital locking device, turning handle and pressure-measuring valve, the equal swing joint in both sides of pipeline surface has the thread bush. The utility model discloses a mounting panel, elastic telescopic rod, fixed block, riser, valve body, pipeline, fixed pipe, digital locking device, turning handle, pressure measuring valve, bearing, thread bush, connecting block, through-hole, first functional layer and the cooperation of second functional layer have solved current digital balance locking valve and need lead to dismantling loaded down with the help of the spanner when dismantling, and the problem that barrier propterty is poor moreover.

title_en: System for directly synthesizing green ammonia by electrolyzing water to produce hydrogen by using renewable energy sources
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a renewable energy electrolytic water hydrogen production direct synthesis green ammonia system belongs to energy technical field. The utility model provides a direct synthetic green ammonia system of renewable energy electrolytic water hydrogen manufacturing, including electrolytic water hydrogen manufacturing installation, synthetic ammonia device and nitrogen gas conveyor, be equipped with compressor arrangement between electrolytic water hydrogen manufacturing installation and the synthetic ammonia device, compressor arrangement includes first compressor and hydrogen high pressure storage tank, and the inlet end of first compressor is linked together with electrolytic water hydrogen manufacturing installation, and the end of giving vent to anger communicates with the inlet end of hydrogen high pressure storage tank mutually, and the end of giving vent to anger of hydrogen high pressure storage tank is linked together with the synthetic ammonia device, and nitrogen gas conveyor's the end of giving vent to anger is linked together with the synthetic ammonia device. The system combines the water electrolysis hydrogen production device with the synthetic ammonia device through the compression device, so that hydrogen generated by the water electrolysis hydrogen production device can be used as a raw material to directly synthesize green ammonia in the synthetic ammonia device, and not only can the localized effective consumption of new energy be realized, but also the system is an important way for green conversion in chemical industry.

title_en: Hydrogen fluoride electrolytic cell
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hydrogen fluoride electrolytic cell, which comprises a cell body, an anode end, an anode outlet pipe, a cathode end, a cathode outlet pipe, a separation mechanism, a cyclone separation mechanism, a tail gas treatment mechanism and a cooling mechanism; the anode end and the cathode end are respectively arranged in the tank body, the separation mechanism is arranged between the anode end and the cathode end, the separation mechanism separates the interior of the tank body into an anode cavity for containing the anode end and a cathode cavity for containing the cathode end, and the upper part of the anode cavity and the upper part of the cathode cavity are not communicated with each other; one end of the anode gas outlet pipe is communicated with the upper part of the anode cavity, and the other end of the anode gas outlet pipe is communicated with the gas inlet end of the cyclone separation mechanism; the utility model aims to provide a hydrogen fluoride electrolytic cell, which is additionally provided with a cyclone separation mechanism, can separate large-particle impurities and a small amount of liquid drops, and avoids the blockage of a gas circuit; and a cooling mechanism is arranged for cooling, so that the stable electrolysis state of the electrolyte is ensured, and the production efficiency of the fluorine gas is ensured.

title_en: Change into paper tinsel mill phosphoric acid tank field heat preservation system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a change into paper tinsel mill phosphoric acid tank district heat preservation system, includes inlet manifold, return water house steward and electrolysis trough, and the electrolysis trough passes through cooling pump and heat exchanger and inlet manifold and return water house steward intercommunication, still includes the heat-preserving container, and the phosphoric acid storage tank sets up in the heat-preserving container, arranges in proper order in the heat-preserving container and is equipped with a plurality of heating arrangements, and return water house steward both ends are arranged both ends through hot-water line and cold water pipe and each heating respectively, installs the circulating pump on the hot-water line. The utility model is used for solve and become the foil phosphoric acid jar district and prevent the phosphoric acid crystallization through steam heat preservation, and the higher problem of the cost of heating that leads to.

title_en: Nail beauty lamp convenient to disassemble
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a nail lamp convenient to disassemble, which comprises a shell, wherein a drying cavity is arranged in the shell; the lamp holder is arranged at the top of the shell, and the bottom of the lamp holder is fixedly provided with a UV lamp tube; the lamp holder is characterized in that fixing components are arranged on two sides of the lamp holder respectively and comprise telescopic supporting columns, return springs and protruding blocks, mounting holes are formed in two sides of the lamp holder respectively, and the telescopic supporting columns are fixedly arranged in the mounting holes. The utility model discloses can make the lug receive reset spring's elasticity move to the shell spacing downthehole in the in-process of installing the lighting fixture, thereby can fix the lighting fixture, the in-process that prevents to use makes the lighting fixture take place not hard up and drop, when needs are changed the UV fluorescent tube, only need hold between the fingers two plectrums with the hand and be close to each other and just can drive the slider and remove, thereby can extrude the lug from the mounting hole, then only need to lift the lighting fixture upwards with the hand and can take out the lighting fixture, be convenient for dismantle and change the fluorescent tube.

title_en: Device for preparing calcium sulfate whiskers and treating wastewater
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a device for preparing calcium sulfate whiskers and treating wastewater, which comprises a hydrothermal reaction kettle, a centrifugal machine, a liquid storage tank and a wastewater treatment system, wherein the discharge of the hydrothermal reaction kettle enters the centrifugal machine, the solid discharge of the centrifugal machine is collected as a product, and the liquid discharge of the centrifugal machine enters the liquid storage tank and is sent into the wastewater treatment system after being cooled; the wastewater treatment system comprises a precipitation zone, a filtering zone and an ion resin exchange zone, wherein the wastewater from the centrifuge is sent into the precipitation zone for precipitation, the supernatant of the precipitation zone enters the filtering zone, the effluent of the filtering zone is sent into the ion resin exchange zone, and the effluent of the ion resin exchange zone is treated new water. The beneficial effects of the utility model are that: the utility model provides a preparation calcium sulfate whisker and waste water treatment's device provides corresponding water treatment process for handling the waste liquid that causes because of hydrothermal reaction simultaneously, the utility model discloses waste water after the processing can become new water retrieval and utilization. The utility model discloses the small investment, running cost are low.

title_en: Extrusion coating gasket and coating machine
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of coating equipment, a extrusion coating gasket and coating machine is disclosed. The extrusion coating gasket comprises a gasket body, wherein the gasket body is of a frame-shaped structure with a discharge hole at the top; the inside bottom surface demountable installation of gasket body has at least one baffle, and the baffle extends to discharge gate department and separates into two at least sub-discharge gates with the discharge gate by gasket body bottom, and the top of baffle flushes with the top of discharge gate. This extrusion coating gasket simple structure has realized once coating out a plurality of function of scribbling the material area through the baffle that flushes with the discharge gate top, and the width size of these a plurality of coating areas is more accurate, the coating quality is higher, has improved coating efficiency and coating quality.

title_en: Rock wool color steel plate with anti-seismic structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a various steel sheet of rock wool with antidetonation structure, including various steel sheet body, the upper portion outside of various steel sheet body is equipped with various steel convex surface iron sheet, and the bottom of various steel sheet body is equipped with the bottom plate, and the one end of various steel sheet body is equipped with the fixture block, and the other end of various steel sheet body is equipped with the draw-in groove, and the inboard of various steel convex surface iron sheet is equipped with the antidetonation layer, is equipped with multiunit buffering subassembly in the antidetonation layer, and the buffering subassembly includes buffer seat, buffer spring, folded plate and base, and the folded plate is equipped with a set ofly, and the both sides at the base are established to the folded plate, the beneficial effects of the utility model reside in that: the utility model discloses, the equipment is convenient, and is used extensively, has increased the shock strength of this various steel sheet of rock wool, is difficult to the cracked condition to appear under the effect that receives the external force to this various steel sheet of rock wool is convenient the concatenation when using and is handled, can effectually prevent the condition that drops between the various steel sheet of two sets of rock wool, and the concatenation is effectual, has increased the convenience of using.

title_en: Double-layer double-edge opening elastic band
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a high polymer fiber material uses technical field, especially relates to a double-deck bilateral opening elastic cord, including the elastic cord body, the elastic cord body includes first layer elastic cord, sets up in the second layer elastic cord of first layer area below, sets up the middle level opening between first layer elastic cord and second layer elastic cord, and the first layer elastic cord is interweaved by first warp, first weft first elasticity package root, and the second layer elastic cord is interweaved by second warp, second weft, second elasticity package root, and first warp, second warp comprise two polyamide fibre high-elastic yarns; the utility model discloses can improve the bonding strength between elastic cord and the cloth widely, can avoid appearing the cloth and tear or the cracked condition of elastic cord, can prolong the life of product and realize energy saving and emission reduction, can be applicable to products such as climbing bag, saddlebag well.

title_en: Reflective warning sticker assembly
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a subassembly is pasted in reflection of light warning, which comprises a fixing plate and i, the fixed orifices has been seted up on the fixed plate, the surface mounting of fixed plate has the warning to paste the body, the back that the body was pasted in the warning is provided with the female subsides that the magic was pasted, the cooperation is provided with the son on the fixed plate and pastes, the box that evenly is provided with a plurality of son and mother and detain on the fixed plate, the back cooperation that the body was pasted in the warning is provided with the son and detains, the warning pastes the body and includes the basic unit, the outside of basic unit has set gradually the reflector layer, the outside of reflector layer is provided with the enhancement layer, the outside of enhancement layer and the inboard of basic unit all are provided with the surface protection layer, the outside of two sets of surface protection layers is provided with waterproof lockstitching, this impracticable novel convenient to detach and used repeatedly, reflection of light and waterproof wear-resistant effect are good simultaneously.

title_en: Device for producing bromine and caustic soda by electrolyzing sodium bromide through ion membrane
abstract_en: The utility model provides a device of ionic membrane electrolysis sodium bromide production bromine and caustic soda relates to electrolysis sodium bromide technical field, including the gas storage frame, the inside fixed mounting of gas storage frame has gas storage baroceptor, gas storage baroceptor and control mainboard signal connection, the one end fixed mounting of reactor has the rack, the inside fixed mounting of rack has adjustable division board, the one end threaded connection of rack has end cover, one side of rack is provided with the adjustable frame of deriving with reactor fixed mounting. The utility model has the advantages that: the method comprises the steps of setting an air pressure detection structure in a reactor to detect the air pressure in the reactor in real time, determining the reaction progress according to the air pressure before and after the reaction and the change of the air pressure in the reaction process, controlling the adding amount of chlorine according to the adding amount of sodium bromide to ensure that the added chlorine can be completely reacted, and leading out bromine gas after the air pressure in the reactor is not changed any more.

title_en: Automobile glass film containing photocatalyst
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of automobile accessories, in particular to an automobile glass film containing a photocatalyst, which comprises a photocatalyst carrier layer and an ETFE purifying layer, wherein nano photocatalyst particles are coated on the photocatalyst carrier layer, the photocatalyst carrier layer is arranged below the ETFE purifying layer and is in surface lamination, the photocatalyst carrier layer is in sealing connection with the edge of the ETFE purifying layer, the ETFE purifying layer consists of a first ETFE film and a second ETFE film with air holes, the air holes on the first ETFE film and the second ETFE film are arranged in a staggered mode, and an air-permeable gap is reserved between the first ETFE film and the second ETFE film. The utility model effectively protects the photocatalyst material on the glass film, so that the glass film has good scratch resistance, wear resistance and adhesiveness, thereby prolonging the service life of the photocatalyst material on the glass film, and the glass film has the advantages of novel structure, safety, environmental protection and high practicability and has higher popularization value.

title_en: Multipurpose precision experimental drum
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multipurpose precision experiment roller in the field of experiment rollers, which comprises a support frame and a roller body, wherein a first fixing pipe is fixedly connected to one side of the roller body, a second fixing pipe is fixedly connected to the other side of the roller body, the first fixing pipe and the second fixing pipe are coaxially arranged, and the roller body is obliquely and rotatably arranged at the lower part of the support frame through the first fixing pipe and the second fixing pipe. According to the utility model, the first fixed pipe is fixedly connected to one side of the roller body, the second fixed pipe is fixedly connected to the other side of the roller body, the first fixed pipe and the second fixed pipe are coaxially arranged, and the roller body is obliquely and rotatably arranged at the lower part of the supporting frame through the first fixed pipe and the second fixed pipe, so that a user can place a material to be electroplated in the roller body for electroplating operation, and the roller body can eccentrically rotate left and right, thereby solving the problems of uneven plating of products in the barrel and lamination of sheet-shaped parts.

title_en: Be used for quick cooling device before galvanized sheet material goes into zinc pot
abstract_en: The utility model provides a rapid cooling device for galvanized sheet materials before entering a zinc pot, which comprises a cooling box and a base arranged at four corners of the cooling box, wherein a first partition plate and a second partition plate are arranged in the cooling box, the first partition plate and the second partition plate divide the cooling box into a first cooling box, a second cooling box and a third cooling box from left to right, at least 2 tensioning rollers are arranged in the first cooling box, the tensioning rollers are symmetrically arranged, a cleaning roller set and a flushing roller set are arranged between the tensioning rollers, the cleaning roller set and the first cooling box are rotatably arranged, a water storage tank is arranged on the lower surface of the first cooling box, a water filtering plate is arranged on one side of the first partition plate in the second cooling box, a fan is arranged in the third cooling box, a plurality of vent holes are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the third cooling box, dust-proof cloth is arranged on the vent holes, and a rapid cooling mechanism is arranged on the upper surface of the first cooling box. The utility model can better realize the cooling effect.

title_en: Positioning mechanism
abstract_en: The present utility model provides a positioning mechanism, comprising: an X-axis positioning unit, a Y-axis positioning unit and a positioning table; the positioning table is provided with a plurality of bosses which are arranged at intervals, and each boss is provided with a flange extending in the X direction and a flange extending in the Y direction; the product on any boss can be pushed by the X-axis positioning unit and is propped against the flange extending in the X direction of the boss; the product on any boss can be pushed by the Y-axis positioning unit and is abutted against the Y-direction extending flange. According to the utility model, the mechanical positioning of the positioning mechanism replaces the visual positioning mode in the prior art, so that the quick positioning of the product can be realized, and the feeding efficiency of the product is improved. In addition, through the flexible positioning and vacuum adsorption mode of the product, the precise positioning is ensured, and meanwhile, multiple protection is provided for the product.

title_en: Polypropylene composite layer structure for automobile bottom guard board and automobile bottom guard board
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a polypropylene composite layer structure for an automobile bottom guard board and the automobile bottom guard board. According to the utility model, the flame-retardant and fireproof capabilities of the automobile bottom guard plate are effectively improved through the inner flame-retardant layer and the fireproof layer, fire can be prevented from spreading to a passenger room when an engine cabin of the automobile is ignited, the effects of protecting personnel and keeping enough escape time are achieved, the use safety coefficient is improved, the waterproof capability of the automobile bottom guard plate is effectively improved through the outer waterproof layer, external moisture is reduced or prevented from entering the inside of the automobile bottom guard plate, the strength and the sound absorbing capability of the automobile bottom guard plate are effectively improved through the glass fiber reinforced polypropylene layer, the blend fiber felt layer and the GMT material layer, noise generated by external hard object impact is remarkably reduced, the riding environment is more suitable, and the service life is long.

title_en: Device for improving sizing wettability of prepreg
abstract_en: The utility model provides a device for improving sizing wettability of a prepreg, which comprises a prepreg device, wherein the prepreg device comprises a prepreg groove and a hollow sizing guide roller, the hollow sizing guide roller is arranged in the prepreg groove and is provided with a hollow cavity, a plurality of glue outlet holes for sizing the prepreg are formed in the peripheral wall of the hollow sizing guide roller, and the glue outlet holes are communicated with the hollow cavity; comprises a main dipping tank and a glue solution circulating device. Thus, the glue flows with a certain pressure, and the wettability with the glass cloth is greatly improved; the productivity can be ensured, and other problems of the appearance of the PP can not occur due to the reduction of the viscosity of the main leaching tank; meanwhile, the glue can be reused, and the utilization efficiency of the glue is improved.

title_en: Sand spraying equipment with cleaning function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses sand spraying equipment with a cleaning function, which comprises two sand spraying rollers and a U-shaped mounting plate, wherein an L-shaped plate which is in sliding connection with the U-shaped mounting plate is sleeved on the side wall of the U-shaped mounting plate, the U-shaped mounting plate is connected with the L-shaped plate through an air cylinder, a vertical plate is connected onto the L-shaped plate in a sliding manner in the front-back direction, a vertical chute is formed in the side wall of one end, close to the U-shaped mounting plate, of the vertical plate, and a driving assembly which extends into the vertical chute and is in sliding connection with the vertical chute is fixedly connected with the side wall of the L-shaped plate. The utility model has reasonable structural design, and the two brush heads reciprocate along the extending direction of the sanding roller, so that the two brush heads can clean the two sanding rollers simultaneously, and meanwhile, the spring can push the telescopic sleeve and the brush heads to approach the sanding roller and attach to the sanding roller, thereby being convenient for cleaning the sanding roller with uneven thickness of adhering sand and scale, and guaranteeing the cleaning effect and the cleaning efficiency.

title_en: Antibacterial fuzzing fabric
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an antibacterial wool curling fabric. The utility model comprises the following steps: a base cloth layer and a furling layer. The hair rolling layer is arranged on the outer surface of the base cloth layer; the base cloth layer is elastic polyester fabric, an antibacterial fabric layer is arranged on one side, away from the hair winding layer, of the base cloth layer, and the antibacterial fabric layer is formed by weaving elastic core-spun yarns; the antibacterial fabric comprises an antibacterial fabric layer, and is characterized in that a skin-friendly inner liner layer is further arranged on the inner side of the antibacterial fabric layer, the skin-friendly inner liner layer is formed by weaving warp yarns and weft yarns, the warp yarns are polylactic acid filaments, and the weft yarns are formed by alternately weaving spandex yarns and skin-friendly cotton yarns. The fabric disclosed by the utility model uses the base cloth layer with the elastic effect as a substrate, and has the advantages of good elasticity and high strength; the antibacterial fabric layer is held, so that the fabric is endowed with good antibacterial property as a whole, the elasticity of the antibacterial fabric layer corresponds to that of the base fabric layer, and the antibacterial fabric has stable structure, excellent performance and stable antibacterial property when being compounded; and finally, the skin-friendly inner liner enhances the use experience and is comfortable to wear.

title_en: Spring surface treatment device with high-efficiency transmission mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a spring surface treatment device with a high-efficiency transmission mechanism, which relates to the technical field of spring surface treatment and comprises an electroplating pool, wherein a climbing ladder is welded on the side surface of the electroplating pool, a cantilever frame is welded on the side surface of the electroplating pool, a rope winding motor is connected with the cantilever frame in a sliding manner along the horizontal direction, a hanging lug is hung on the rope winding motor through a connecting rope, an upper connecting plate is welded at the bottom of the hanging lug, and accommodating columns are uniformly distributed at the bottom of the upper connecting plate. The utility model is provided with a plurality of groups of accommodating columns, the surfaces of the accommodating columns are provided with contact holes, a large number of springs can be placed in the accommodating columns, the plurality of groups of accommodating columns can be lifted and placed in the electroplating pool by utilizing the rope winding motor arranged on the cantilever mount, after the surface of the springs is treated, the rope winding motor can lift the large number of accommodating columns from the electroplating pool, the springs which finish the electroplating process are taken out from the electroplating pool at one time, and the blanking efficiency of the surface treatment of the springs is greatly improved.

title_en: Czochralski monocrystalline silicon oxygen reduction thermal field device and monocrystalline furnace
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a Czochralski monocrystalline silicon oxygen reduction thermal field device and a monocrystalline furnace. The utility model provides a straight pull monocrystalline silicon falls oxygen thermal field device, includes heat preservation section of thick bamboo, well heat preservation section of thick bamboo and lower heat preservation section of thick bamboo the bottom of heat preservation section of thick bamboo down sets up a bottom heat preservation section of thick bamboo, sets up the supporting ring between lower heat preservation section of thick bamboo and heat preservation section of thick bamboo for connect a heat preservation section of thick bamboo and well heat preservation section of thick bamboo down, the internal diameter of supporting ring is less than a heat preservation section of thick bamboo and well heat preservation section of thick bamboo down. The support ring has an inner diameter equal to the outer diameter of the crucible. The bottom heat preservation cylinder, the lower heat preservation cylinder and the upper heat preservation cylinder are respectively necked, and the inner diameters of the bottom heat preservation cylinder, the lower heat preservation cylinder and the upper heat preservation cylinder are smaller than the inner diameter of the middle heat preservation cylinder. The utility model can reduce the space at the bottom of the crucible, and keep the temperature of the thermal field stable, thereby reducing the convection of molten silicon in the crucible, reducing the convection of the liquid level of grown crystal, stabilizing the liquid level, and having higher success rate of grown crystal, and further having lower oxygen content in the monocrystalline silicon rod.

title_en: Electroplating assembly line equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of electroplating, in particular to electroplating assembly line equipment, which comprises an electroplating box, a clamping assembly and a driving assembly, wherein a plurality of groups of electroplating baths are arranged in the electroplating box, a movable frame is arranged at the upper end of the electroplating box and close to the back, a movable groove is arranged at the upper end of the movable frame, the clamping assembly and the driving assembly are connected in the movable groove, the clamping assembly consists of a first movable seat, a second movable seat, a lifting rod, a clamping hook, a connecting ring, a mounting plate, a sliding groove, a first electric linear sliding rail, an adjusting belt, a second electric linear sliding rail, a connecting frame, a winding drum, a winding motor and a third movable seat, the driving assembly consists of a driving motor, a first driving wheel, a second driving wheel, a third driving wheel and a case, the upper part of the inside of the case is connected with a first driving wheel, the lower end of the first driving wheel is connected with the second driving wheel, one end of the second driving wheel is connected with the third driving wheel, and one end of the first driving wheel is connected with the driving motor.

title_en: Positioning spraying tool for metal surface treatment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a positioning spraying tool for metal surface treatment, which relates to the technical field of metal surface treatment equipment and comprises a workbench, wherein an automatic rotating assembly is arranged in the workbench, a spraying assembly is arranged on the surface of the top wall of the workbench, and an air drying assembly is fixedly arranged on one side of the outer wall of the workbench; the automatic rotating assembly comprises a driving structure, a telescopic rod is connected to one side of the outer wall of the driving structure in a driving mode, a pressing linkage block is fixedly connected to the other side port of the telescopic rod, a spring is connected to the other side surface of the pressing linkage block, a fixing block is connected to one side port of the spring, a pressing rod is arranged in the spring, a shifting block is fixedly connected to the bottom side port of the pressing rod, a rotating piece is connected to the outer wall surface of one side of the shifting block in a laminating linkage mode, a clamping piece is sleeved on the top of the rotating piece, the problem that non-uniformity is caused to the metal surface by manual spraying is effectively solved, meanwhile, the spraying efficiency for metal surface treatment is further improved, and workload of workers is reduced.

title_en: Additive fluid infusion device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an additive liquid supplementing device, and belongs to the technical field of clean energy manufacturing. The front side of the electric control cabinet is provided with an inclined panel which is convenient to operate, the control panel is arranged on the panel, a partition board which divides the electric control cabinet into an electric appliance bin and a liquid storage bin is arranged in the electric control cabinet, the plc controller is arranged on the partition board, the two metering pumps are arranged on the partition board, and the two liquid storage barrels are arranged in the liquid storage bin; the additive solution with each proportion can be added into each metering pump through the control panel according to the requirements of the texturing process, so that quantitative liquid supplementing is ensured at the required liquid supplementing rate; the liquid storage barrels respectively store additives with different proportions, and respectively realize accurate liquid supplementing through the metering pump, so that the additives with different proportions can be respectively supplemented or combined to be supplemented according to the requirements, manual liquid supplementing is not needed, the operation is simple, time and labor are saved, and the production efficiency is improved; the additive solution amount can be accurately added during the wool making, so that the waste is avoided, and meanwhile, the wool making effect is ensured to be good.

title_en: Water pump body paint spraying apparatus with drying structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water pump body paint spraying device with a drying structure, which comprises a main body frame, a driving motor assembly and a drying assembly shell, wherein a supporting plate is fixedly connected below the inner side wall of the main body frame, a mounting shell is fixedly connected to the top end of the mounting plate, and an electric heating wire is arranged below a fan. According to the utility model, the clamping structure is arranged, after the water pump body is placed at the top end of the mounting shell, the opening of the inner cavity of the water pump body is downward, the arc-shaped inner lining plate is positioned at the inner side of the opening of the inner cavity of the water pump body, the bidirectional threaded rod is gradually rotated by rotating the adjusting handle, at the moment, the inner thread sleeve seat in threaded connection with the bidirectional threaded rod drives the arc-shaped inner lining plate to reversely move along the guide sliding groove, and the arc-shaped inner lining plate clamps and fastens the water pump body from the inner wall of the opening of the inner cavity of the water pump body, so that the water pump body is kept stable in the rotation and paint spraying processes, and stable clamping of the water pump body is realized.

title_en: Glue brushing device for package printing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a glue brushing device for package printing, which comprises a base, wherein supporting plates are fixed on the left side and the right side of the top surface of the base, top plates are fixed on the top surfaces of the two supporting plates, a glue brushing mechanism is arranged on the top plates, a fixing assembly is arranged on the base, the glue brushing mechanism comprises a driving motor, and the driving motor is fixedly arranged on the right side of the supporting plates on the right side. The device is provided with the glue brushing device, the threaded rod is driven to rotate by the driving motor, the movable block can be driven to move left and right by the rotation of the threaded rod, so that the position of horizontal glue brushing is adjusted, and meanwhile, the electric cylinder can be used for driving the glue brushing device body to move up and down, so that the glue brushing on packaging materials with different thicknesses is facilitated, the device is more practical and convenient, in addition, the device can also push the pressing plate to move downwards by the elastic potential energy of the spring on the fixing assembly in the glue brushing process, and the packaging materials are fixed, so that the glue brushing process is more stable.

title_en: Filter element paint remover
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a filter element paint remover, and relates to the technical field of paint removal devices. Comprises a liquid injection pipe, wherein one end of the outer part of the liquid injection pipe is fixed with a cleaning component; the cleaning assembly comprises a sleeve disc, one surface of the sleeve disc is inwards concave, a telescopic connecting piece is fixed between the other surface of the sleeve disc and the liquid injection pipe, a communication valve pipe is fixedly inserted in the sleeve disc, the communication valve pipe is matched with the liquid injection pipe, a paint scraping arm which is vertically placed is fixed at the top of one surface of the sleeve disc, a plurality of paint scraping arms are arranged, the circle center of the sleeve disc is used as a reference point, and the equal angles are uniformly distributed at the top of one surface of the sleeve disc. According to the utility model, the injection pipe is connected with the sleeve disc through the injection pipe, the injection pipe is communicated with the sleeve disc, and the plurality of paint scraping arms are arranged on one surface of the sleeve disc, so that the sleeve disc is driven to rotate by rotating the injection pipe when the device is in actual use, paint on the surface of the filter element is removed, and the removal rate of paint on the surface of the filter element is accelerated.

title_en: Double-sided flexible copper-clad plate and mobile electronic equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a double-sided flexible copper-clad plate and mobile electronic equipment, which comprise an insulating substrate layer, a dielectric layer and a conductive layer; the dielectric layer comprises a first dielectric layer and a second dielectric layer which are respectively arranged above and below the insulating substrate layer, and the first dielectric layer and the second dielectric layer are syndiotactic polystyrene resin; the conductive layer comprises a first conductive layer and a second conductive layer which are respectively arranged on the surfaces of the first dielectric layer and the second dielectric layer far away from the insulating substrate layer; by arranging the dielectric layer of the XPS film, the dielectric constant and dielectric loss of the whole product are reduced to the maximum extent, and the double-sided flexible copper-clad plate has good heat resistance and wet heat resistance and is suitable for flexible circuit boards under high-frequency conditions.

title_en: Cooling device after carpet pressing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cooling device after carpet pressing processing, wherein two grooves which are a group are arranged in the middle of the upper end of a processing table, a conveying mechanism is penetrated and installed in the grooves, a cooling cover is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the processing table, carpets are movably placed at the upper end of the processing table through the conveying mechanism, an inlet and an outlet are respectively arranged at the lower ends of the left side and the right side of the cooling cover, a cold air box is fixedly installed at the upper ends of the inlet and the outlet on the left inner wall and the right inner wall of the cooling cover, an exhaust pipe is vertically penetrated and installed at the inner top end of the cooling cover, a purifying box is fixedly placed at the outer side of the upper top end of the cooling cover, an observation window is embedded and installed at the middle of the front end of the cooling cover, a control panel is arranged at the right side of the front end of the cooling cover, and a monitor and a temperature controller are respectively installed on the rear inner wall of the cooling cover; the cooling cover and the cold air box realize double cooling to the carpet, improve the cooling efficiency to the carpet of pressfitting, filter tank and purifying box filter and purify the peculiar smell gas that produces when cooling.

title_en: Antistatic heat insulation layer in oil drying equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides an antistatic heat insulation layer in oil drying equipment, wherein the outer wall of the drying equipment is provided with the antistatic heat insulation layer, the antistatic heat insulation layer comprises mineral wool, a grounding plate and aluminum foils, the mineral wool is rectangular, one surface of the mineral wool is provided with the aluminum foils, the aluminum foils are identical to the mineral wool in shape, the grounding plate is arranged on the periphery of the aluminum foils, the grounding plate extends around the aluminum foils, and the grounding plate is rectangular.

title_en: Anti-cracking zirconia ceramic block
abstract_en: The utility model provides a zirconia ceramic block capable of resisting cracking, which relates to the technical field of zirconia ceramic blocks and comprises a zirconia ceramic block body, wherein an antioxidation layer is arranged in the zirconia ceramic block body, an anti-cracking layer is arranged in the zirconia ceramic block body and positioned in the antioxidation layer, a wear-resistant layer is arranged in the zirconia ceramic block body and positioned in the anti-cracking layer, and connecting rods are inlaid and inserted in the antioxidation layer, the anti-cracking layer and the wear-resistant layer. According to the utility model, the oxidation resistance layer, the cracking resistance layer and the adhesive layer are sequentially arranged from outside to inside in the zirconia ceramic block body, so that the effects of oxidation resistance and cracking resistance can be achieved, and meanwhile, if cracks are formed outside if the zirconia ceramic block is used for a long time, the cracks can be adhered through the adhesive layer, the effect of adhering the cracking part can be achieved, and the effect of preventing the cracking part from being eaten by mistake can be achieved.

title_en: Even smearing device for terrace construction
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a uniform smearing device for terrace construction, which comprises a base, wherein a side support frame is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the base, and a rotatable smearing roller is arranged at the bottom of the side support frame. The top of base has set firmly flourishing lacquer section of thick bamboo and charge pump, and arc spout has been seted up at the middle part of side strut, and slidable mounting has the lacquer storage bucket on the arc spout, and the brush board is installed to the bottom of lacquer storage bucket, is provided with the solenoid valve that is used for controlling opening and close on the brush board, and the lacquer spraying head is installed to the lateral wall of lacquer storage bucket. The utility model relates to the technical field of floor construction, in particular to a uniform coating device for floor construction.

title_en: Practical bonding tool for prisms on two sides of rectangular product
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rectangular product processing, in particular to a practical bonding tool for prisms on two sides of a rectangular product, which solves the problem that more time is likely to be spent on personnel in the condition that the adjusting operation mode of the bonding tool is complex in the bonding process of rectangular products with different sizes in a certain range in the prior art, so that the working efficiency of the personnel is reduced. A practical bonding tool for prisms on two sides of a rectangular product comprises a table plate and is characterized in that cross bars are arranged on two sides of the top of the table plate, and two sides of each cross bar are respectively connected with one side of an adjacent table plate in a sliding mode. The fixture prevents unstable phenomena such as displacement and shaking of rectangular products in the prism bonding process, can adapt to rectangular products with different sizes in a certain range to carry out prism bonding operation, is simple and quick in the adjusting process, and reduces the study and use cost of personnel.

title_en: Improved efficient curing drying chamber
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an improved efficient curing drying chamber which comprises a main box body and an auxiliary box body, wherein the main box body and the auxiliary box body are communicated, an air inlet door is arranged on one side of the top of the auxiliary box body, a moisture exhaust door is arranged on the other side of the top of the auxiliary box body, a heater is arranged on one side of the inside of the auxiliary box body, a circulating fan is arranged on the other side of the inside of the auxiliary box body, an air distribution screen I and an air distribution screen II are arranged on the inner wall of the main box body in a relative mode, an air distribution screen III is arranged between the air distribution screen I and the air distribution screen II, an atomized water device is arranged between the air distribution screen I and the inner wall of the main box body, and an inlet door and an outlet door are arranged on the front part of the main box body. The utility model effectively shortens the curing and drying time, ensures uniform air supply and improves the quality of the polar plate.

title_en: Internal bracing type pipe fitting fixing tool with sealing function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a sealed internal bracing type pipe fitting fixing tool which solves the technical problems of high manufacturing cost, complex and inconvenient operation process and poor practicability of a pipe fitting fixing and positioning device based on a clamping structure in the existing electroplating process. The utility model is widely used for supporting and positioning the pipe.

title_en: Environment-friendly full-automatic anodic oxidation production line
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of anodic oxidation production equipment and discloses an environment-friendly full-automatic anodic oxidation production line, which comprises a production equipment body and an oxidation tank, wherein a fixing plate is fixed on one side surface of the oxidation tank, a filter cabinet is arranged above the fixing plate, a first air pipe is connected to the upper surface of the filter cabinet, one end of the first air pipe is connected with an exhaust fan, and the air outlet end of the exhaust fan is connected with a second air pipe.

title_en: Thermo-sensitive film emulsion delivery structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a thermo-sensitive film emulsion delivery structure, which comprises an outer frame, wherein two guide rollers are symmetrically and rotatably arranged in the outer frame, a top roller is arranged between the two guide rollers, U-shaped frames are arranged on the upper side and the lower side of the outer frame, the top roller is rotatably arranged on one U-shaped frame, a scraping plate is arranged between the top roller and one guide roller, the scraping plate is fixedly arranged on the other U-shaped frame, the two U-shaped frames are fixedly arranged on the outer frame through a position control assembly, and the directions of the two U-shaped frames are opposite; the upper side of the top roller is correspondingly provided with a delivery roller, a cylindrical cavity is arranged in the delivery roller, a sealing cylinder is sleeved outside the delivery roller in a sealing and rotating mode, the lower side of the delivery roller is provided with a strip-shaped delivery port communicated with the inside, and a plurality of strip-shaped through ports matched with the strip-shaped delivery port are uniformly formed in the arc-shaped side wall of the sealing cylinder. The utility model can smear the emulsion on the thermo-sensitive film, and can precisely control and adjust the thickness of the emulsion smeared on the thermo-sensitive film.

title_en: Zinc pot crown block positioner for galvanization
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of zinc pot crown block positioning, in particular to a zinc pot crown block positioner for zinc plating, which aims at solving the problem that when a zinc pot is positioned, the positioning is unstable and the shaking of the zinc pot is easy to cause. The utility model has simple structure, can better ensure the stability of the zinc pot through the positioning of four directions, and is convenient for people to use.

title_en: Automobile part pickling device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of automobile industry and discloses an automobile part pickling device which comprises an oscillating pickling tank and object placing draining boards, wherein displacement vertical grooves are formed in the middle of the inner walls of the two sides of the oscillating pickling tank, lifting devices are arranged in the two side displacement vertical grooves, the oscillating pickling tank is fixedly connected with the object placing draining boards through the lifting devices on the two sides, symmetrical part fixing assemblies are arranged on the two sides of the outer wall of the top of the object placing draining board, the object placing draining boards are composed of a plurality of groups of parallel transverse bars which are spaced mutually and are hollow, after the automobile part is pickled by the pickling device, the lifting parts drain pickling liquid, contact between operators and the pickling liquid in pickling operation is reduced, and harm of the operators to hand corrosion by the pickling liquid is reduced.

title_en: Flame retardant device of flame retardant air filter paper
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a flame retardant device of flame retardant air filter paper, which comprises an air filter paper matrix, wherein the top of the air filter paper matrix is fixedly connected with a copolymerization flame retardant structure layer, and the copolymerization flame retardant structure layer comprises a flame retardant polyester fiber layer and a polyester durable flame retardant. According to the utility model, firstly, the flame-retardant polyester fiber layer and the polyester durable flame retardant in the copolymerization flame-retardant structure layer are used for carrying out the first step of flame retardance on the air filter paper substrate, then the flame-retardant acrylic fiber layer and the pure cotton flame retardant in the copolymerization flame-retardant reinforced structure layer are used for reinforcing the flame-retardant effect of the top of the air filter paper substrate, and finally the Nomex fiber layer, the polysulfonamide fiber layer and the polybenzimidazole fiber layer can form a multiple flame-retardant layer at the bottom of the air filter paper substrate, so that the air filter paper has the advantage of good flame-retardant effect, replaces the mode that the traditional air filter paper adopts the halogen flame retardant to form a flame-retardant layer on the surface of the air filter paper for carrying out flame retardance, and improves the flame-retardant effect of the air filter paper.

title_en: Aluminum electrolysis cell cooling device
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for the technical field of aluminum electrolysis cells, and particularly relates to an aluminum electrolysis cell cooling device, which comprises an aluminum electrolysis cell and a base, wherein a hollow tube is arranged at the inner bottom of the base, an air outlet hole is arranged at the upper end of the hollow tube, the air outlet hole is arranged towards the bottom of the aluminum electrolysis cell, drainage plates are arranged at two sides of the aluminum electrolysis cell, a reflux channel is formed among the drainage plates, the aluminum electrolysis cell and the base, and a circulating mechanism is arranged in the base and used for driving cold air to circularly flow in the circulating channel and the hollow tube; the device drives the cold air to circulate inside the reflux channel and the hollow tube through the circulating mechanism, and plays a role in cooling the aluminum electrolysis cell when the cold air is discharged from the air outlet at the upper end of the hollow tube, and meanwhile, the cold air can enter the hollow tube again under the action of the drainage plate and the circulating mechanism, so that the cyclic utilization of the cold air is realized, the cooling effect of the aluminum electrolysis cell is ensured, and meanwhile, the energy is also saved.

title_en: Cell culture dish stacks and falls frame
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cell culture dish stacking frame which comprises a shell, wherein a servo motor is fixedly arranged at the middle end of the top of the shell, a threaded rod is fixedly connected with the output end of the servo motor, a lifting groove is formed in the inner surface of the middle end of the shell, a lifting block is movably connected to the bottom of an inner cavity of the lifting groove, the lifting block is in threaded connection with the threaded rod, and lifting supporting plates are fixedly connected to the left side and the right side of the lifting block. According to the utility model, the servo motor is started to work through the external controller, the servo motor drives the threaded rod to rotate, the threaded rod drives the lifting block to move upwards in the inner cavity of the lifting groove, the lifting block drives the lifting supporting plate to move upwards, the lifting supporting plate drives the sliding block to move upwards in the inner cavity of the limiting groove, and the sliding block drives the cover plate to move upwards through the connecting rod, so that the purpose of high automation degree is achieved, and the problem that the existing stacking frame does not have the function of high automation degree, and therefore the use requirement of people cannot be met is solved.

title_en: Coating testing machine convenient for cleaning scraper
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a coating testing machine convenient for cleaning a scraper, which comprises a control box, a moving assembly arranged in the control box, a coating assembly arranged on the moving assembly, a coating table arranged at the top of the control box, a vacuum structure arranged on the coating table, and a PLC (programmable logic controller) arranged on the control box and connected with the moving assembly and the vacuum structure; the coating device is characterized in that a rotating structure connected with the coating assembly is arranged on the moving assembly. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the rotating structure, after the scraper finishes the coating of the coating material once, the scraper is driven to rotate, so that the distance between the tail end of the scraper and the coating table is increased, the scraper is convenient to check by a worker, residues are convenient to find, and the worker is convenient to clean, thereby improving the coating effect and improving the product quality.

title_en: Corrugated board with strong compression resistance
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a corrugated board with strong compression resistance, which belongs to the technical field of corrugated boards, and particularly relates to a corrugated board with strong compression resistance. According to the corrugated board, the transverse reinforcing ribs and the transverse longitudinal reinforcing ribs are staggered and woven to form the grid shape, so that the buffer layer has certain toughness from the whole, the triangular cavity has certain strength, and the filling strips filled in the cavity are added, so that the strength of the corrugated board is improved, and the corrugated board is prevented from being deformed easily.

title_en: Roller coater capable of realizing automatic lifting of coating plate unit along with thickness of material
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a roller coater capable of realizing automatic lifting of a coating plate unit along with the thickness of a material, wherein a supporting mechanism comprises a transverse plate, a threaded groove is formed in the transverse plate, a bolt is connected between the threaded groove and the threaded hole in a threaded manner, a sliding groove is formed in the top of the transverse plate, one side of a groove cavity of the sliding groove is provided with an opening, a connecting groove is formed in the transverse plate, the connecting groove is communicated with the sliding groove, a sliding plate is connected in the sliding groove in a sliding manner, and a clamping plate is fixedly connected to the sliding plate.
