This realize scribble roller coat machine that board unit goes up and down along with material thickness automatically through under diaphragm, screw thread groove, bolt, spout, spread groove, slide, cardboard and auxiliary mechanism's cooperation use, has solved current roller coat machine when carrying out the material loading, needs people to hold the material, slowly carries the material to the conveyer belt, uses inconvenient problem inadequately.

title_en: High polymer material stores pylon for spraying
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rack for spraying high polymer materials, which comprises a first fixing rod, a second fixing rod, a motor and a heating cylinder, wherein the second fixing rod is arranged on the same horizontal plane on the right side of the first fixing rod, a threaded rod is fixed at the lower end of the right surface of the first fixing rod, the motor is fixed at the upper end of the left surface of the first fixing rod, a positioning nut is arranged on the outer surface of a rotating shaft, suction pumps are fixed at the lower end of the rear surface of the first fixing rod, a gas blowing pipe is arranged at the upper end of the heating cylinder, a gas blowing hole is connected to the inner surface of the gas blowing pipe, and a mounting hole is formed in the middle of the upper surface of the connecting rod. This stores pylon is used in macromolecular material spraying is provided with aspirator pump, heating cylinder, gas-blowing pipe and gas pocket, through opening the aspirator pump, makes gaseous in the air get into the aspirator pump, then through the heating cylinder, heats gaseous, and the gas pocket on the rethread gas-blowing pipe blows to the macromolecular material after the spraying, the stoving of macromolecular material after the spraying of being convenient for.

title_en: Baking finish assembly line with movable housing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a baking varnish assembly line with a movable housing, which comprises a roller line; the movable baking unit slides on the roller line and comprises a housing, a centrifugal wind wheel and a quartz heating pipe; the housing comprises a top plate, and side plates vertically and downwardly extend from two sides of the top plate; the quartz heating pipes and the centrifugal wind wheels are fixed on the lower surface of the top plate, the quartz heating pipes and the centrifugal wind wheels are alternately arranged, the length direction of each quartz heating pipe is perpendicular to the extending direction of the roller line, and the axis of the centrifugal wind wheel is vertical; along the projection of the length direction of the roller line, the quartz heating pipe is overlapped with the centrifugal wind wheel; the length of the movable baking unit is smaller than the length of the roller line. The movable baking unit has low cost and flexibility, and the baked hot air is rapidly and uniformly diffused.

title_en: Local electroplating tool for through hole-shaped part
abstract_en: The utility model provides a local electroplating tooling of through-hole form part, includes screw cap, stopper, gag lever post, end cover and nut, screw cap center is provided with the through-hole, the screw cap passes through the through-hole setting on the gag lever post, the left end fixedly connected with stopper of gag lever post, the stopper is located the screw cap left side, the screw cap inner wall is provided with the internal thread, the right-hand member of gag lever post is connected with the end cover, screw cap one side is kept away from to the end cover is equipped with the nut, nut and gag lever post right-hand member threaded connection, the open end of screw cap sets up to nut one side. According to the through hole part local electroplating tool provided by the utility model, a special fixture protection mode is adopted to replace a paint protection mode, the through hole part is positioned on the limiting rod between the screw cover and the end cover, and the part to be protected is protected by the acting force of the nut.

title_en: High boron silicon double-curved toughened laminated glass
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of laminated glass, in particular to high-boron silicon hyperbolic toughened laminated glass, wherein an L-shaped fixing frame is symmetrically and slidingly arranged above a bearing plate, a glass component is arranged between the two L-shaped fixing frames, sleeve gaskets are symmetrically arranged at the lower ends of the glass component, sliding grooves are symmetrically formed in the upper surface of the bearing plate, sliding blocks which are slidingly connected with the sliding grooves are symmetrically arranged on the lower surfaces of the two L-shaped fixing frames, and sliding nuts are arranged at the middle sections of the lower surfaces of the two L-shaped fixing frames. The utility model has simple structure, the distance between the two opposite sliding nuts is adjusted through the screw rod, so that the positions of the two L-shaped fixing frames are adjusted, and then the equipment can be adapted to glass components with different specifications.

title_en: Hydrogen production equipment with liquid level detector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses hydrogen production equipment with a liquid level detector, which belongs to the technical field of hydrogen production equipment and comprises a mounting plate; an electrolytic tank and a liquid storage tank are arranged on the mounting plate; the electrolytic tank is internally provided with an SPE film and two groups of catalytic plates, the two groups of catalytic plates are respectively positioned at two sides of the SPE film, the inner cavity of the electrolytic tank is divided into a hydrogen production cavity and an oxygen production cavity by the SPE film, and collecting ports are respectively arranged at two sides of the top of the electrolytic tank; the liquid storage tank is provided with a pipeline communicated with the electrolytic tank, and the pipeline is provided with a liquid supplementing valve and a water stopping valve; set up fixed box on the electrolysis box to set up the sealing washer on fixed box, adorn the mount pad between the sealing washer, can avoid wire contact pure water, can avoid wire and liquid level detector junction to contact pure water, and then avoid influencing the waterproof of liquid level detector and wire junction.

title_en: Dispensing and gluing mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dispensing and gluing mechanism, wherein a bearing assembly is used for bearing an elastomer; the first driving assembly is positioned at the rear end part of the gluing assembly, and the front end part of the gluing assembly is transversely arranged relative to the elastomer on the bearing assembly; the second driving assembly is located at the lower end part of the gluing assembly, the rubber wheel is located at the upper part of the gear, the lower part of the gear is meshed with the rack, the rack realizes transverse linear motion through the external cylinder piece, the rubber wheel above the gear is synchronously driven to rotate, the rubber wheel is mutually attached to the periphery of the elastomer, and the elastomer is synchronously driven to rotate. The gluing stability and accuracy of the product are improved, and the flow rate of unqualified products is reduced. The novel glue smearing device has the advantages that the smearing speed is high, the smearing is stable and uniform due to the second driving assembly, the efficiency is high, the cost is low, the glue utilization rate is high, the safety is high, and the maintenance is easy.

title_en: Frame is put to coating machine rubber roll
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rubber roll placing frame of a coating machine, which comprises a placing frame, a supporting rod and a placing and positioning assembly, wherein the placing and positioning assembly comprises an elastic clamping piece, an electric push rod, a connecting block and a clamping block. The utility model belongs to the technical field of coating machines, and particularly relates to a coating machine rubber roll placing frame which is provided with a placing groove and capable of placing rubber rolls, wherein elastic clamping pieces are broken towards two sides through fingers penetrating through holes, so that two ends of the rubber rolls are placed conveniently, two ends of the rubber rolls can be clamped through contraction of an electric push rod, placing stability of the rubber rolls is guaranteed, and positioning effect is improved.

title_en: Flow coating system with fan-shaped flow coating spray head
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a flow coating system with a fan-shaped flow coating spray head, which comprises a stirring tank, a diaphragm pump, a workbench surface, the fan-shaped flow coating spray head, a connecting pipe and a flow outlet pipe, wherein the stirring tank is connected with the diaphragm pump; the stirring tank is provided with a connecting pipe, and the other end of the connecting pipe is connected with the diaphragm pump; a discharge pipe is arranged at a discharge hole D of the diaphragm pump; a switch is arranged on the outflow pipe, and the tail end of the outflow pipe is connected with a fan-shaped flow coating spray head; a return pipe with a filter screen is arranged on the workbench surface, and the tail end of the return pipe is connected with the stirring tank; the nozzle of the fan-shaped flow coating nozzle is of a flat rectangular caliber. According to the utility model, the stirring tank and the diaphragm pump are matched for use, and the paint stirring and the feeding of the flow coating system are combined, so that the frequent transfer of the paint is reduced, the flow coating operation flow is simplified, and the operation is simple; the fan-shaped flow coating spray head adopts straight rectangular caliber and has large caliber, so that the discharge amount of the coating is large when the flow coating operation is carried out, the operation efficiency of the flow coating is accelerated, and the spray head is not easy to be blocked due to the accumulation of the coating.

title_en: Electrophoresis tank for electrophoresis coating
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electrophoresis tank for electrophoresis coating, which comprises a bottom plate, an electrophoresis tank and a filter box body, wherein the top end of the bottom plate is provided with the electrophoresis tank, one side of the electrophoresis tank is provided with the filter box body, the top end of the bottom plate is provided with a water pump, the input end of the water pump is provided with a second water pipe penetrating through the electrophoresis tank, the output end of the water pump is provided with a first water pipe penetrating through the filter box body, the top end of the filter box body is provided with a first filter frame, one side of the electrophoresis tank is provided with a discharge pipe close to the filter box body, the top end of the electrophoresis tank is provided with a sliding rail, the inside of the sliding rail is provided with a sliding block, the inside of the sliding block is provided with a fixed shaft through a bearing, the outer wall of the fixed shaft is provided with a gear, the top end of the bottom plate is provided with a rack, the device drives the sliding block to slide in the sliding rail through pulling the fixed shaft, and simultaneously an arc-shaped positioning block at the sliding block is extruded on a reset spring, so that the reset spring is contracted, and the fixed shaft is fixed.

title_en: Sweat-absorbing quick-drying cotton fabric
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sweat-absorbent quick-drying cotton fabric, relates to the technical field of fabrics, and aims to solve the problem of discomfort in wearing of a traditional fabric after sweat and wet. The key points of the technical scheme are as follows: including mutual fixed quick-drying outer and ventilative inlayer, keep away from a plurality of first wet grooves that scatter of array distribution of integrated into one piece on the ventilative inlayer of quick-drying outer one side, be close to a plurality of second wet grooves that scatter wet groove dislocation set of integrated into one piece on the ventilative inlayer of quick-drying outer one side. The ramie fiber is arranged in the utility model, and the characteristics of moisture absorption, bacteriostasis, quick drying and good air permeability of the material are utilized to strengthen the air permeability and quick drying performance of the whole structure.

title_en: Improved electroplating pool
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of electroplating, in particular to an improved electroplating pool, which comprises a processing pool, a base and an auxiliary device, wherein the processing pool is placed on the upper surface of the base, the longitudinal section of the base is rectangular, the auxiliary device is arranged on the surface of the processing pool, the auxiliary device comprises a sliding plate, the sliding plate is placed on the surface of the processing pool, the cross section of the sliding plate is rectangular, the surface of the sliding plate is fixedly connected with a supporting plate, the longitudinal section of the supporting plate is rectangular, the lower surface of the sliding plate is fixedly connected with a supporting plate, the longitudinal section of the supporting plate is rectangular, and the upper surface of the supporting plate is fixedly connected with an air cylinder. According to the utility model, the auxiliary device is arranged to effectively assist in processing the electroplating pool, when the electroplating pool is used, the device is used, the air cylinder is started, the air cylinder is used for adjusting the adjusting rod, and the adjusting rod is used for adjusting the basket, so that workers are prevented from arranging materials one by one, the auxiliary property of the electroplating pool is improved, the processing efficiency of the electroplating pool is improved, and the practicability of the electroplating pool is reduced.

title_en: Ultraviolet lamp box
abstract_en: The utility model provides an ultraviolet lamp box. The utility model provides an ultraviolet lamp box, which comprises a box body, an ultraviolet lamp set and a mounting bracket, wherein the ultraviolet lamp set and the mounting bracket are arranged in the box body, the mounting bracket is connected with the box body, the mounting bracket is provided with a mounting part for mounting a piece to be irradiated, and the ultraviolet lamp set is connected to the box body in a way of facing the mounting part. The utility model has better irradiation effect.

title_en: Ultraviolet-resistant, antibacterial and deodorant bamboo charcoal fiber fabric
abstract_en: The utility model provides an ultraviolet-resistant, antibacterial and deodorant bamboo charcoal fiber fabric, and belongs to the technical field of fabrics. The uvioresistant, antibacterial and deodorant bamboo charcoal fiber fabric comprises a fabric main body and a side-connected fabric body. The side joint cloth body is bent to be U-shaped, two sides of the side joint cloth body are fixedly connected with the side wall of the fabric main body, and through holes are formed in the surface of the side joint cloth body. According to the utility model, the side-connected cloth body folded into the double layers is connected with the bolts or ropes used for installation, so that the side-connected cloth body and the fabric main body are fixed, and compared with single-layer fabrics, the side-connected cloth body folded into the double layers is not easy to drop due to abrasion, and is more stable after installation and more beneficial to use.

title_en: Dispensing mechanism and dispensing machine
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of dispensing equipment, and discloses a dispensing mechanism and a dispensing machine. The mounting piece is arranged on the bearing piece in a sliding manner along the first direction. The power piece is arranged on the bearing piece and is configured to adjust the position of the mounting piece on the bearing piece. The glue barrel and the glue dispensing valve are arranged on the mounting piece. The heating component is arranged on the mounting piece and is configured to heat the glue barrel and the glue dispensing valve. The detection assembly is configured to detect a dispensing area of the product. According to the utility model, the power piece drives the mounting piece to slide, namely, the accurate adjustment of the dispensing valve position can be realized, so that the accurate control of the gap between the dispensing valve and a product can be ensured, the requirement of the product on the dispensing valve position is met, and the dispensing precision is further improved.

title_en: Electrolytic tank cleaning device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of electrolytic tank cleaning equipment, and provides an electrolytic tank cleaning device, which comprises: the installation frame, set up lifting support mechanism in the installation frame downside, can adjust the clean mechanism height that sets up in the installation frame downside, make it clean the inside electrolysis trough of not co-altitude, and utilize lifting support mechanism bottom's brake wheel, conveniently remove whole device, make it can be simple quick switch the use between different electrolysis trough. The cleaning device is characterized in that a driving mechanism for moving the cleaning mechanism is arranged on the inner side of the mounting frame, a direction adjusting mechanism is arranged on the lower side of the driving mechanism, when the cleaning mechanism moves, the cleaning mechanism can simultaneously clean a pair of opposite side walls and the bottom of the electrolytic tank in a friction manner, after the cleaning is completed, the cleaning mechanism can rotate ninety degrees through the direction adjusting mechanism, the cleaning mechanism can clean the other opposite side wall, the operation is simple, the use is convenient, the cleaning efficiency is greatly improved, and the cleaning device has good practical performance.

title_en: Light guide plate is with dyestripping mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a film tearing mechanism for a light guide plate, which comprises a fixed box, wherein a fixed cavity is formed in the fixed box, a film clamping mechanism is arranged in the fixed cavity, and the film clamping mechanism comprises an L-shaped fixed plate, a turnover cylinder and an inverted L-shaped rotating plate, wherein one side of the turnover cylinder is connected with one side of the L-shaped fixed plate; the second cylinder drives the fixing plate to move downwards, and the fixing plate drives the sucker to move towards the surface of the light guide plate body so as to adsorb and fix the light guide plate body; the turning cylinder is started, the L-shaped rotating plate, the first cylinder and the clamping block are driven to rotate by 90 degrees through the rotating shaft, the film clamped by the clamping block is torn off from the surface of the light guide plate body, one end of the clamping block is moved to the top of the waste collection frame, the film falls into the waste collection frame, the situation that the film is placed in disorder is avoided, the waste film is prevented from being wound on the surface of the clamping block, and maintenance cost is further reduced.

title_en: Pole piece rolling infrared drying device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pole piece rolling infrared drying device, which comprises an unreeling mechanism, a rolling mechanism, an infrared drying mechanism, a cooling mechanism and a reeling mechanism, wherein a pole piece is output from the unreeling mechanism and sequentially transmitted to the rolling mechanism, the infrared drying mechanism and the cooling mechanism for rolling, drying and cooling, and the cooled pole piece is transmitted to the reeling mechanism for reeling; the infrared drying mechanism comprises a guide roller, an infrared heating pipe and an infrared cooling system, the guide roller is used for guiding and conveying when the pole piece is conveyed to the infrared drying mechanism, the infrared heating pipe provides heat for drying the pole piece, and the infrared cooling system is used for cooling the infrared heating pipe when the infrared heating pipe stops heating. The utility model automatically completes the rolling and drying of the pole piece, shortens the production time, improves the production efficiency, ensures that the pole piece releases thickness rebound in advance, and eliminates the harm of the increase of the thickness of the pole piece.

title_en: Steam oxidation furnace
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a steam oxidation furnace, which comprises a furnace body, wherein a cover plate is arranged at the top of the furnace body, a driving motor is arranged at the top of the cover plate, a rotating shaft is fixedly connected with an output shaft of the driving motor, a plurality of placing discs are arranged on one side of the rotating shaft extending into the furnace body in an array mode, a water tank is arranged at the bottom of the furnace body, a return pipe is sleeved between the water tank and the furnace body, a one-way valve is arranged on the return pipe, a steam channel is sleeved at the top of the water tank, two air blowing pipes positioned in the furnace body are arranged at the top of the steam channel, an air inlet assembly is arranged in the middle of the steam channel, and an electric heating wire connected with the inner wall of the water tank is arranged below the air inlet assembly. The utility model not only can reduce the laying of pipelines and the energy loss in the steam conveying process, but also can conveniently and timely recycle the cooling water, reduce the temperature difference of the cooling water affecting the steam in the furnace body, and is beneficial to the stability of the temperature in the furnace body.

title_en: Multifunctional automatic spraying electrophoresis tank
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of electrophoresis tanks and discloses a multifunctional automatic spraying electrophoresis tank which comprises a tank body, wherein a motor is fixedly connected to the lower surface of the tank body, a worm is fixedly connected to the output end of the motor, a worm wheel is connected in a meshed mode, a fixing rod is fixedly connected to the inside of the worm wheel, two ends of the fixing rod are rotatably connected to the inside of the tank body, a fixing block is rotatably connected to the middle of the outer wall of the fixing rod, and the lower surface of the fixing block is fixedly connected to the inside of the tank body. According to the utility model, the effect of up-and-down movement is achieved through the cooperation among the groove body, the motor, the worm wheel, the fixing rod, the fixing block, the first supporting plate, the rotating roller, the second supporting plate, the object placing plate and the sliding groove, the problem that the traditional electrophoresis tank is inconvenient to lift objects is solved, and the working efficiency of workers is improved.

title_en: Glue spreader
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a glue spreader, which is applied to the technical field of adhesive coating, and comprises: a work table; the two groups of glue spreading roller groups are arranged at intervals along the height direction of the workbench and are used for spreading glue on the plate to be coated which is placed between the two groups of glue spreading roller groups; each glue spreading roller group comprises a fixed roller and a movable roller which are horizontally arranged at intervals, the fixed roller is rotatably connected with the workbench, and the movable roller is slidably connected with the workbench and is rotatable relative to the workbench; and the quantitative device is connected with the movable roller and is used for adjusting the distance between the movable roller and the fixed roller to control the gluing amount. The workbench is provided with a plurality of glue spreading roller groups, one glue spreading roller group at least comprises a movable roller and a fixed roller, the movable roller can move relative to the fixed roller, and the displacement of the movable roller is controlled through the quantitative device to control the adhesive consumption, so that the adhesive allowance is accurately controlled.

title_en: Composite film with high puncture resistance
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model provides a composite film with high puncture resistance, which comprises the following components: a thin film substrate layer, a first layer disposed over the thin film substrate layer, a second layer disposed over the first layer, and a third layer disposed over the second layer; the thin film substrate layer is an insulating layer, the first layer is a high-hardness ceramic layer, the second layer is a metal alloy layer, and the third layer is a simple substance metal layer.

title_en: Vacuum chamber structure for pp film vacuum coating equipment of substrate
abstract_en: The utility model provides a vacuum chamber structure for a substrate pp film vacuum coating device, which relates to the technical field of vacuum coating and comprises a vacuum chamber, wherein a partition plate is arranged in the vacuum chamber, the vacuum chamber is divided into two sputtering chambers and a winding chamber by the partition plate, the two sputtering chambers are symmetrically arranged left and right, and the winding chamber is positioned between the two sputtering chambers; the outer wall of the vacuum chamber corresponding to the sputtering cavity is provided with a first vacuum component which is communicated with the sputtering cavity; the first vacuum components are symmetrically distributed in two groups; the outer wall of the vacuum chamber corresponding to the winding cavity is provided with a second vacuum component which is communicated with the winding cavity; the second vacuum components are symmetrically distributed.

title_en: High-efficiency flame-retardant TPU composite material
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-efficiency flame-retardant TPU composite material, which relates to the field of TPU composite material design and comprises a body, wherein a repair layer is arranged in the body, the bottom end of the repair layer is fixedly connected with a wear-resistant layer, the bottom end of the wear-resistant layer is provided with a first base layer, the bottom end of the first base layer is provided with a second base layer, and the bottom end of the second base layer is connected with a waterproof layer. According to the utility model, the waterproof layer is arranged, so that the waterproof performance of the film body can be improved, the film body is prevented from being inconvenient to use due to larger moisture permeability, the flame retardant performance of the film body can be improved due to the wear-resistant layer, the flame retardant performance of the film body can be improved due to the arrangement of the melamine cyanurate flame retardant layer, the film body can be matched with the polytetrafluoroethylene coating, the film body also has high temperature resistance and good corrosion resistance, polytetrafluoroethylene has the characteristics of acid resistance, alkali resistance and various organic solvents resistance, the polytetrafluoroethylene has the characteristic of high temperature resistance, the friction coefficient of the polytetrafluoroethylene is extremely low, and a better flame retardant effect can be realized when the film is arranged on the surface of the film body.

title_en: Reflection film with reflection layer not easy to fall off
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a reflecting film with a reflecting layer not easy to fall off, belonging to the technical field of reflecting films. Through the bond line that sets up, when using, the bond line that the accessible set up improves the holistic connection steadiness of reflector plate body and reflectance coating body, and subsequent PET basic unit can cooperate to improve the holistic intensity of reflectance coating body, can cooperate the bond line to prevent that the reflector plate body warp when using simultaneously, influences the whole result of use of reflectance coating body, has realized preventing the effect that the reflector plate drops, prevents that the occurrence of reflector plate body drops at long-time use, leads to the holistic reflection effect of reflectance coating body to receive the influence.

title_en: Anti-solidification glue conveying device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a glue conveying device for preventing solidification, which comprises: the hot water tank is provided with a glue disc for storing glue, and a liquid storage cavity for uniformly heating the glue is formed between the glue disc and the hot water tank; the electric heater is fixed at the inner side of the liquid storage cavity and is used for heating liquid at the inner side of the liquid storage cavity; the stirring mechanism is fixed on the glue tray and is used for stirring the inner side of the glue tray so as to improve the uniform heating of the glue; through being provided with stock solution chamber, electric heater and rabbling mechanism, be convenient for heat glue through the temperature, avoid glue to lead to mobility and adhesiveness to receive the influence because of the low temperature, this device can be fine guarantee glue is in suitable temperature down, reduces the influence that glue receives outside colder air, this device simple structure is convenient for remove the assigned position, intervenes glue production pipeline, has improved the result of use of device.

title_en: Improved sofa cloth
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an improved sofa cloth, and belongs to the technical field of sofa cloth. The inner cloth is provided with an outer cloth at intervals on the outer surface of the inner cloth, a storage bin is formed between the inner cloth and the outer cloth, heat conducting particles are filled in the storage bin, and the heat conducting particles are attached to the inner cloth and the outer cloth. The inside of the inner cloth is fixedly connected with smooth cloth. As the preferable mode of the utility model, the inner wall of the storage bin is fixedly connected with a moisture-proof layer fixedly connected with the outer cloth, and the moisture-proof layer is fixedly connected with the supporting net. According to the utility model, the heat source is prevented from being invaded inwards by blocking the heat source by the inner cloth and the outer cloth and uniformly distributing and dispersing the heat by the heat conducting particles, and compared with the existing sofa cloth without heat-resistant and heat-insulating functions, the device has the advantages of high efficiency, heat resistance and heat insulation, and can effectively protect the safety of the sofa core.

title_en: Steel member spraying paint-coating equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of steel paint spraying, in particular to steel member paint spraying and coating equipment, which comprises a mounting frame and a spraying mechanism, wherein the spraying mechanism is mounted on the mounting frame and further comprises a propping mechanism; the abutting mechanism comprises a driving end plug, a driven end plug, a rotating piece for driving the driving end plug to rotate and a sliding assembly for driving the driving end plug to be close to the driven end plug, and the driving end plug is connected with the sliding assembly through the rotating piece; the driven end plug is rotationally connected to the mounting frame, and the driving end plug and the driven end plug are opposite to each other. Compared with the fixation from the side wall, the fixation of the steel member from the end part of the steel member does not cause interference to the paint surface of the steel member, and the technical problem in the related art is properly perfected; simultaneously, the abutting mechanism is suitable for steel members such as angle steel, channel steel, I-steel, steel pipes and the like, and the applicability is greatly improved.

title_en: Environment-friendly crease-resistant antibacterial composite fabric
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an environment-friendly crease-resistant antibacterial composite fabric, which comprises the following components: the anti-wrinkling antibacterial fabric comprises a fabric lining layer, wherein an upper anti-wrinkling antibacterial composite coating is arranged at the upper end of the fabric lining layer, an upper fabric layer is arranged at the upper end of the upper anti-wrinkling antibacterial composite coating, and an upper fragrance pigment layer is arranged at the upper end of the upper fabric layer. The crease-resistant antibacterial composite coating is arranged between the lining layer and the fabric layer, so that the crease and deformation of the fabric can be effectively prevented, and the crease-resistant antibacterial property of the composite fabric is improved; the fragrance pigment layer is arranged on the outermost layer, so that the use comfort and the aesthetic degree of the composite fabric can be improved.

title_en: Printed fabric
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a printed fabric, which relates to the technical field of textile, and has the technical scheme that: the anti-static warp knitting machine comprises a warm-keeping layer and an anti-static layer, wherein the warm-keeping layer is a rib structure formed by knitting warm-keeping yarns, the anti-static layer is composed of a guide bar GB1 and a guide bar GB2, the guide bar GB1 is the anti-static yarns, the guide bar GB2 is the warm-keeping yarns, the guide bar GB1 and the guide bar GB2 are rib warp plain structures, and the anti-static yarns are also knitted on the warm-keeping layer to form a winding structure. According to the utility model, the antistatic yarn is used for weaving on the surface of the fabric, the nano silver fibers in the antistatic yarn have strong conductivity, static charge generated by friction can be absorbed and guided out of the fabric along the warp direction, so that an antistatic effect is realized, meanwhile, the outer wrapping yarn supported by the bamboo charcoal fibers in the antistatic yarn also has strong conductivity, the absorption of the static charge by the antistatic yarn is facilitated, and the bamboo charcoal fibers also have certain antibacterial property, so that the fabric also has certain antibacterial capability.

title_en: Electric motor car saddle that antiskid is effectual
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of electric vehicles, in particular to an electric vehicle saddle with good anti-skid effect, which comprises a comfortable layer, wherein an anti-skid mechanism is arranged at the top of the comfortable layer, the anti-skid mechanism comprises a wear-resistant layer and anti-skid bumps, the bottom of the wear-resistant layer is glued with the top of the comfortable layer, and the anti-skid bumps are processed at the top of the wear-resistant layer. The friction between the buttocks of the rider and the saddle of the electric vehicle is increased through the anti-slip convex blocks made of the nitrile rubber material, so that the buttocks of the rider can slide off from the top of the saddle of the electric vehicle when the rider is prevented from emergency braking, and the damage to the rider is reduced.

title_en: Pneumatic two-component foaming adhesive injecting device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a pneumatic double-component foaming glue injection device, wherein a long tube is respectively arranged in a first foaming glue barrel and a second foaming glue barrel; the air inlet end of the third pipeline is sequentially connected with a filter, a pneumatic dust blowing gun, a throttle valve, a first quick-insertion tee joint and a second quick-insertion tee joint; the first quick-insertion tee is also connected with a pressure relief valve; the ends of the first pipeline and the second pipeline are communicated through a third quick-plug tee joint, and the other ends of the first pipeline and the second pipeline are respectively connected with a board penetrating quick-plug connector; the board penetrating quick connector is used for being respectively connected with the long pipe in the first foaming glue barrel and the second foaming glue barrel or respectively connected with the second quick tee joint. The utility model has the advantages of less material consumption, simplicity and practicability; A. mixing the foaming glue in proportion uniformly; the power source is compressed air, and the power source is commonly used in factories; the cleaning is convenient, and this device uses the quick-connect fitting of air, only needs to pull out the trachea, inserts just can with pipeline clean up.

title_en: High vacuum winding type film plating machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-vacuum winding type film plating machine, which comprises a machine shell, wherein a film plating cavity is formed in the machine shell, and a film plating mechanism is arranged in the film plating cavity; the film plating machine further comprises a winding and unwinding mechanism which is arranged in the film plating cavity and used for winding and unwinding films; the winding and unwinding mechanism comprises: an unreeling roller for unreeling the film wound by the unreeling roller; the winding roller is used for winding the film released by the unreeling roller; the coating machine further comprises a positioning mechanism which is arranged in the coating cavity and is used for adjusting the height of the unreeling roller so that the bottom of the film wound by the winding roller is relatively flush with the bottom of the film unwound by the unreeling roller; the utility model can solve the problem that the metal ions sprayed by the evaporation source towards the film cannot be uniformly distributed on the film due to the inclined film between the unreeling roller and the reeling roller, and the film coating effect is affected.

title_en: Steel wire coil coating device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a steel wire coil coating device which comprises a control cabinet and a tank body, wherein a cover body is arranged above the tank body, the rear end of the cover body is rotationally connected with the rear side of the upper end of the tank body, an electric heating assembly is fixed in the tank body, a rotating shaft is transversely arranged at the rear side of the upper end of the tank body, the rear end of the cover body is fixed with the rotating shaft through two rotating arms which are symmetrically arranged left and right, two ends of the rotating shaft are rotationally connected with the rear side of the upper end of the tank body, a servo motor is fixed at the rear side of the tank body, a driving sprocket is fixed on an output shaft of the servo motor, a driven sprocket fixed with the rotating shaft is sleeved in the middle of the rotating shaft, and the driven sprocket is in transmission connection with the driving sprocket through a chain; a first limit structure is arranged between the cover body and the groove body; a second limiting structure is arranged between the rotating shaft and the groove body; by adopting the structure, the driving structure for driving the cover body to rotate relative to the groove body has the advantages of simple structure and small occupied space.

title_en: Laminate and lithographic stack for transferring graphene-metal bilayer to substrate
abstract_en: The present application relates to a laminate and a lithographic stack for transferring graphene-metal bilayers to a substrate. The laminate includes a substrate including one or more polymer layers; and a graphene-metal bilayer laminated over at least a portion of the substrate. The lithographic stack includes a graphene-metal bilayer; a first sacrificial layer on the graphene-metal bilayer; and a second sacrificial layer located under the graphene-metal bilayer. The first sacrificial layer comprises a first continuous polymer layer on the graphene layer of the graphene-metal bilayer; and a first discontinuous polymer layer on the first continuous polymer layer. The second sacrificial layer comprises a second continuous polymer layer underlying the metal layer of the graphene-metal bilayer, the first continuous polymer layer and the second continuous polymer layer of two different materials having a dedicated instability between at least two different etchants; and a second discontinuous polymer layer positioned below the second continuous polymer layer.

title_en: Passivation equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a passivation device, comprising: the upper end of the bottom plate is fixedly provided with a mounting frame, and the front end of the motor is fixedly connected with a rotating handle; the connecting rod is fixedly connected to the lower end of the connecting frame, the lower end of the connecting rod is connected with a connecting block, and the lower end of the connecting block is fixedly connected with a passivation box; the mounting block is fixedly arranged on the upper end face of the bottom plate, and a fixing rod is fixedly connected inside the mounting block; the ultrasonic generator is fixedly arranged on the left end face of the inside of the passivation box, and the right end of the ultrasonic generator is fixedly connected with a plastic soft board; the liquid discharging pipe is fixedly connected to the right side of the lower end of the passivation box, and an electromagnetic valve is fixedly connected to the inside of the liquid discharging pipe. The passivation equipment has the advantages of high reaction rate and high reaction efficiency, is convenient for moving the internal passivation metal, and solves the problem that the contact part of the object plate and the passivation metal of the conventional passivation equipment is difficult to effectively passivate.

title_en: Funnel type feeding device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model provides a funnel type feeding device, which comprises: the feeding device comprises a feeding body, a hopper module and a clamping module, wherein the feeding body comprises a cover body with a containing cavity, the hopper module and the clamping module, the clamping module is arranged in the cover body and movably connected with the cover body, and the clamping module is used for clamping a feed box containing silicon materials; the hopper module set up in the bottom of the cover body, just the feed inlet of hopper module with the holding chamber intercommunication of the cover body, the discharge gate of hopper module is used for interfacing with the nozzle of quartz capsule. Can promote reinforced convenience and efficiency, reduce manpower output.

title_en: Wear-resistant matte precoating film
abstract_en: The utility model is applicable to the technical field of precoating films, and provides a wear-resistant matte precoating film, which comprises a base film; the upper surface of the base film is adhered with a first adhesive layer by an adhesive in a pressurizing way; the upper surface of the first adhesive layer is adhered with a second adhesive layer by an adhesive in a pressurizing way; the first adhesive layer includes: the upper surface of the first plastic film is adhered with a decorative layer by pressure through an adhesive; the second adhesive layer includes: the upper surface of the second plastic film is pressed and stuck with a composite matte layer through an adhesive; the upper surface of the composite matte layer is adhered with a wear-resistant layer by pressure through an adhesive; the upper surface of the wear-resistant layer is provided with a plurality of protruding blocks; the surface of the protruding block is adhered with the wear-resistant light-transmitting layer through the adhesive in a pressurizing way, the device solves and can increase the overall wear resistance of the precoating film, a certain degree of matte effect is formed, static electricity is prevented from being generated in the use process of the precoating film, and the service life of the precoating film is prolonged.

title_en: High-precision adhesive dispensing device for electronic components
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-precision dispensing device for electronic components, which comprises a workbench, wherein a supporting plate is fixedly connected to the symmetrical position of the upper end face of the workbench, a threaded rod is rotatably connected between the two supporting plates, the right end of the threaded rod penetrates through the side wall of the supporting plate and is fixedly connected with a handle, one side, opposite to the two supporting plates, of the threaded rod is fixedly connected with a sliding rod, the surface of the threaded rod is in threaded connection with a sliding block, the other side of the sliding block is simultaneously and slidably connected to the surface of the sliding rod, the upper end face of the sliding block is fixedly connected with a storage box, and the front surface of the storage box is fixedly connected with a conveying pipe. Through setting up the second hydraulic stem, can adjust the height of dispensing machine, can make this device when carrying out the point to the electronic components body of multiple not co-altitude and glue, can also adjust the distance between dispensing machine and the electronic components body, the error that produces when reducing the glue whereabouts has improved the precision of point and has glued.

title_en: Fabric with bamboo fibers
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fabric with bamboo fibers, which relates to the technical field of fabrics and comprises a supporting layer, wherein the top end of the supporting layer is fixedly connected with transverse bamboo fiber threads, longitudinal bamboo fiber threads are inserted into the transverse bamboo fiber threads, the top end of the transverse bamboo fiber threads is fixedly connected with a protective layer, transverse reinforcing threads are arranged in the transverse bamboo fiber threads, longitudinal reinforcing threads are arranged in the longitudinal bamboo fiber threads, the transverse reinforcing threads and the longitudinal reinforcing threads are made of polyester, and the supporting layer is made of flax. According to the utility model, through arranging the structures such as the transverse bamboo fiber silk yarns, the longitudinal bamboo fiber silk yarns, the supporting layer, the protective layer and the like, the antibacterial property and the perspiration effect of the fabric can be effectively improved by mixing the bamboo fibers in the fabric, so that perspiration of a wearer can be quickly discharged and volatilized, bacterial breeding is avoided, and meanwhile, the fabric has a good wearing effect.

title_en: Continuous surface corrosion prevention device for copper alloy production
abstract_en: The utility model provides a continuous surface corrosion prevention device for copper alloy production, which comprises a corrosion prevention reaction tank and a support, wherein the two ends of the corrosion prevention reaction tank are connected with the support, the two sides of the upper end of the corrosion prevention reaction tank are provided with linear guide rails, a rotating device is arranged on the sliding blocks of the two linear guide rails, the sliding blocks of the linear guide rails on the two sides are connected with a supporting device, a cleaning device is arranged on the supporting device, the inner bottom end of the corrosion prevention reaction tank is provided with a filter plate, the two bottom ends of the two sides of the corrosion prevention reaction tank are provided with water outlets, and water stopping valves are arranged on the water outlets. According to the utility model, the cleaning device is designed, the generated metal sediment is washed by the water gun on the cleaning device through jetting high-pressure water flow from the booster pump to wash the sediment on the bottom surface of the anti-corrosion reaction tank, the cleaning device is driven to move back and forth through the linear guide rail on the box body, then the cleaning device is cleaned in multiple directions through meshing of the worm gear and the worm, and then large metal particles are filtered out through the filter plate, so that the automatic cleaning is realized, the working efficiency is higher, and the labor cost is saved.

title_en: Scaling powder coating device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of electronic product assembly, and particularly discloses a scaling powder coating device which comprises a container, a surge channel, an overflow box and a sealing cover, wherein the container is hollow, and scaling powder is stored in the container; the surge channel is arranged in the container; the bottom end of the surge channel is provided with a liquid pump, the top end of the surge channel is opened, and the overflow box is arranged at the top end of the surge channel; the sealing cover is matched with the top of the container and seals the open container, and the container and the sealing cover together form a closed space to provide an environment for storing the soldering flux; a moving rod is arranged on the side surface of the sealing cover; the utility model realizes that a stable soldering flux is immersed into the liquid level in the process of automatic soldering flux coating operation, thereby ensuring the stability and consistency of the coating quality of the soldering flux, facilitating the storage of the soldering flux, and overflowing the soldering flux to maintain the stable liquid level when in use.

title_en: Submersible pump processing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a submersible pump processing device which comprises a workbench, a sliding rail and a heating box, wherein the sliding rail is fixedly arranged on the workbench, a curing box and the heating box are movably connected on the sliding rail, a UV lamp is arranged in the curing box, a second sliding door is arranged on the right side surface of the curing box, a baffle plate, a heating rod and a guide column are arranged in the heating box, the heating rod and the guide column penetrate through the baffle plate, a first sliding door is arranged on the left side surface of the heating box, a first conveying belt and a second conveying belt are respectively arranged right above the curing box and the heating box, partition plates are respectively fixed on the front side wall and the rear side wall of the curing box and the side wall of the heating box, and the curing box and the heating box are respectively positioned on the left side and the right side of a fixed seat. According to the submersible pump processing device, the blocking mechanism is arranged, so that paint at two ends of a welding line is prevented from being lost during heating, the heating rod is inserted into the pump shell, and the paint at the welding line is uniformly heated.

title_en: A protection architecture that is used for vertical stripping of manganese flake to prevent splashing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a protection structure for vertically stripping and preventing splashing of manganese sheets, which comprises two cover bodies arranged on a manganese sheet stripping machine, wherein two cover body openings are oppositely arranged on two sides of the manganese sheet stripping machine respectively, the top of the cover body is hinged and matched with a top plate of the manganese sheet stripping machine through a first hinge piece, two sides of the cover body are provided with telescopic mechanisms, two ends of each telescopic mechanism are respectively hinged and matched with the side wall of the cover body and a frame of the manganese sheet stripping machine, the cover body is in supporting and matching with the frame through the telescopic mechanisms, a blowing mechanism is arranged in the cover body, the cover body is convenient to open and close, splashing is prevented when stripping is finished, the cover body is opened conveniently for maintenance after stripping is finished, and the blowing mechanism is used for assisting cleaning.

title_en: Bilateral gluing device for workpieces
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bilateral gluing device for workpieces, which relates to the gluing field and aims at solving the problems that the left side and the right side of the existing bilateral gluing device cannot be synchronously adjusted, so that the adjustment efficiency of the device is low, glue gluing lines on the two sides are asymmetric, and the glue dispensing quality of the workpieces is affected. The glue discharging devices on the two sides are synchronously adjusted, the adjusting efficiency is high, the glue spraying line is stable, and the follow-up installation is convenient.

title_en: Purification tank for high-purity copper production
abstract_en: The utility model provides a purification tank for producing high-purity copper, which relates to the technical field of electrolytic cell equipment and comprises a cell body, wherein the top of the cell body is movably connected with a closed end cover through a hinge, the inside of the cell body is fixedly connected with a negative electrode connecting plate, a plurality of groups of cathode disks are arranged in the cell body, the outer end surfaces of the cathode disks are movably connected with the negative electrode connecting plate, anode plates are arranged between adjacent cathode disks and fixedly connected with the cell body, and the opposite sides of the anode plates and the cathode disks are provided with diaphragms.

title_en: Flame-retardant composite antistatic film
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of antistatic films, in particular to a flame-retardant composite antistatic film which comprises a filled composite core layer main body, wherein an upper flame-retardant fiber main body is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of an upper wear-resistant resin layer, the lower flame-retardant composite layer main body comprises a lower aluminum foil coating layer, a lower wear-resistant resin layer is arranged at the top end of the lower aluminum foil coating layer, the lower flame-retardant fiber main body is arranged at the top of the lower wear-resistant resin layer, the upper flame-retardant fiber main body and the lower flame-retardant fiber main body both comprise polyester fiber fabric layers, and the top surface layer and the bottom surface layer of the polyester fiber fabric layers are respectively formed by spinning and interweaving flame-retardant fiber warps and flame-retardant fiber wefts.

title_en: Electrophoretic coating spraying mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electrophoretic coating spraying mechanism, which comprises a spraying box, a rotating part for cleaning a workpiece and a spraying part for spraying and cleaning the workpiece, wherein the rotating part comprises a support frame arranged at the top of the spraying box and used for sliding, a sliding through hole formed in one side of the support frame, and a first air cylinder arranged on one side of the spraying box and used for providing power.

title_en: Continuous production device for composite catalytic filter material
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a continuous production device of a composite catalytic filter material, which comprises a soaking mechanism, a crawler mechanism, a supporting table and a negative pressure suction device, wherein the soaking mechanism is arranged at the head end of the crawler mechanism; the filter material is dipped in the composite catalytic filter material through the dipping mechanism and is conveyed to move on the supporting table through the crawler mechanism, and the negative pressure suction device forms negative pressure on the lower side of the supporting table for sucking the filter material; the PTFE foam spraying device is used for extracting raw materials in the raw material tank and continuously spraying the raw materials on the filter materials above the crawler mechanism; the drying device is arranged at the rear of the crawler-type dipping suction device, and the sucked filter material enters the drying operation from the inlet of the drying device. The utility model can realize the industrialized continuous production of the composite catalytic filter material, and has high automation degree and high production efficiency. A PTFE foaming coating layer is sprayed on the surface of the filter material, so that the filter material has higher air permeability than a PTFE film coated by a conventional hot pressing method, and is beneficial to improving the activity of the composite catalytic filter material.

title_en: Coating device and optical film coater
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a coating device and an optical film coating machine, wherein the coating device is provided with a supporting seat which is vertically arranged, a middle separation layer is arranged on the supporting seat, a placing roller is fixedly arranged at the lower side of the middle separation layer, a coating bracket is fixedly arranged at the upper side of the middle separation layer, and a coating module is arranged on the coating bracket; the support seat is also provided with a plurality of guide rollers which are arranged at intervals and used for guiding the base material discharged by the unreeling roller to the coating module and then guiding the base material outwards from the support seat; the coating module is provided with a coating bottom roller, and the coating bottom roller, the unreeling roller and the guide roller are mutually parallel and set in position when leaving the factory; the optical film coating machine adopts the coating device, the machine is adjusted for unreeling and coating without repeating when the machine is used, the machine mounting time is saved, stable film running, no folds and tension fluctuation can be ensured, the coating front section is free from the influence of other unstable factors, and the coating quality is improved.

title_en: Steel wire rope oil immersion device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of steel wire rope processing, in particular to a steel wire rope oil immersion device, which aims at solving the problems that the existing oil immersion device is difficult to recover redundant grease after immersing steel wire ropes in oil and is difficult to immersing steel wire ropes with different thicknesses in oil. The oil immersion device can recover redundant grease after immersing the steel wire rope in oil, and can be used for immersing steel wire ropes with different thicknesses in oil.

title_en: Reverse osmosis membrane coating device with high precision
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a reverse osmosis membrane coating device with high precision, which relates to the technical field of reverse osmosis membrane coating and comprises a frame, guide rollers are rotatably arranged in the frame, a plurality of groups of guide rollers are arranged, a reverse osmosis membrane body is arranged on the outer wall of each guide roller, a scraping assembly, a rolling assembly and a heating assembly are arranged below each guide roller, each scraping assembly comprises an adjusting box, the adjusting boxes are fixedly arranged in the frame, a servo motor is arranged in each adjusting box, and the bottom ends of moving columns extend to the outer wall of a rotary cylinder and are connected with a scraping box. The utility model can scrape and collect paint through the scraping component, prevent waste caused by excessive paint, and can adjust the height of the scraping box, adapt to paint scraping with different thickness, the heating component can accelerate the forming of paint, and the rolling component can cut reverse osmosis membrane by downward movement of cutter through the acting force of spring after rolling to a certain thickness.

title_en: Novel thin strip steel chromium electroplating anode plate
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel thin strip steel chromium-plated anode plate, which relates to the technical field of chromium plating and comprises an anode plate body, wherein a transverse plate mechanism which is convenient for the anode plate body to use is used on the novel thin strip steel chromium-plated anode plate, the transverse plate mechanism comprises an insulating plate and a positioning plate, the upper end part of the anode plate body is fixedly provided with an arc-shaped protruding block, the upper end part of the insulating plate is provided with a closed tank, and the anode plate body is fixedly arranged on the inner side wall of the closed tank. According to the utility model, the anode plate body with adjustable positions is arranged, the distance between the anode plate body and the strip steel is manually adjusted according to the width of the strip steel, so that the anode plate body is suitable for the chromium plating production of strip steel with different width specifications, the anode plate body is connected with the electric wires of a power supply through the wire through holes on the guide rail rod, and meanwhile, the functions of position adjustment and electric conduction are realized, and the problems of electric leakage and unadjustable conductive copper bars of the existing anode plate body are solved.

title_en: Waterproof, oxygen-blocking and rust-proof bubble film
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of bubble films, in particular to a waterproof, oxygen-resistant and rust-proof bubble film. The anti-rust air bubble film comprises a first air bubble film layer, wherein a first anti-rust film layer is arranged on one side of the first air bubble film layer, a waterproof film layer is arranged on the other side of the first air bubble film layer, a high-density polyethylene layer is arranged on one side, close to the first air bubble film layer, of the waterproof film layer, and a first oxygen barrier layer is arranged between the high-density polyethylene layer and the first air bubble film layer; the first oxygen-blocking barrier layer is made of ethylene/vinyl alcohol copolymer. Aiming at the technical problem that the traditional bubble film cannot meet the use requirement, the utility model can isolate water vapor and oxygen and prevent the water vapor and the oxygen from penetrating into the inner side of the composite bubble film, thereby avoiding the rusting of metal products.

title_en: Electroplating carrier compatible with wafers with various thicknesses and equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electroplating carrier compatible with wafers with various thicknesses and equipment, wherein the electroplating carrier is provided with an annular conductive ring, bolts, elastic pieces for fixing the wafers and vacuum adsorption holes for adsorbing the wafers, a plurality of elastic pieces are annularly arranged at the edge of the electroplating carrier, the elastic pieces are connected with the annular conductive ring through the bolts, and the annular conductive ring is connected with a power supply negative electrode. The equipment comprises an electroplating carrier, an electroplating tank for containing electroplating liquid, a temperature control device for guaranteeing the process temperature, a circulating system for circulating and replenishing and discharging the electroplating liquid, a conveying mechanism for conveying the electroplating carrier, a wafer loading platform for taking and placing wafers and a clean and dry arm, wherein the conveying mechanism is connected with the electroplating carrier through the electroplating carrier arm. The electroplating carrier can adapt to wafers with various thicknesses, fragments and wafer back plating solution residues caused by the thickness change of the wafers are avoided, bubbles are not easy to generate on the surfaces of the wafers, and the electroplating quality of the wafers is improved. Meanwhile, the device can realize the automation of wafer electroplating and uniform electroplating.

title_en: Regenerated gilt flannelette and gilt printing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a regenerated gilt flannelette and a gilt printing device, which comprises a gilt flannelette main body, wherein a gilt layer is arranged at the top of the gilt flannelette main body, gilt patterns are arranged in the gilt layer, the gilt patterns are connected with the top of the gilt layer, a waterproof and breathable film is fixedly connected to the bottom of the gilt flannelette main body, meshes are arranged in the gilt flannelette main body, adsorption particles are arranged in the meshes, and the gilt flannelette main body adsorbs dust, dirt and the like through the adsorption particles and falls off during cleaning; the size of the gold stamping space is adjusted by selecting different rotary grooves; the second gear and the first gear with different sizes are engaged, and are driven by a motor to rotate for stamping.

title_en: Composite fire-resistant protection combined system for main cable of suspension bridge and multi-performance material
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a composite fire-resistant protection combined system of a main cable of a suspension bridge and a multi-performance material, and belongs to the technical field of fire resistance and corrosion resistance of bridges. The cable comprises a main cable, wherein a plurality of cable clamps are arranged on the main cable and are arranged at intervals along the length direction of the main cable; the outer surface of the main cable is provided with a fire-resistant anti-corrosion layer, and the fire-resistant anti-corrosion layer comprises a sealing inner layer, a fire-resistant protective layer and a sealing outer layer which are arranged from inside to outside; and a circular seam sealing layer is arranged at the joint of the main cable and the cable clamp. The fire-resistant protective layer comprises a heat-insulating flame-retardant layer, a reflective fire-resistant layer is arranged outside the heat-insulating flame-retardant layer, and a bonding layer is fixedly connected between the reflective fire-resistant layer and the heat-insulating flame-retardant layer. The utility model has good anti-corrosion performance, can greatly improve and ensure the fire resistance, is convenient to construct and has good economic performance, and the whole structural system has high efficiency, durability and good decoration, thereby having remarkable social and economic benefits.

title_en: Water-cooled rotary joint for furnace roller
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of annealing furnaces, in particular to a water-cooled rotary joint for a furnace roller. The joint comprises: the first pipe body is internally provided with a first pipeline, and one end of the first pipeline is communicated with the inner pipe of the furnace roller; the second pipe body is connected with the first pipe body in a surrounding manner, one end of the second pipe body is connected with the furnace roller, a second pipeline is arranged in the second pipe body, one end of the second pipeline is communicated with a channel between the outer pipe and the inner pipe of the furnace roller, and the water inlet elbow is communicated with the other end of the first pipeline; one end of the end cover is connected with the second pipe body, the other end of the end cover is connected with the water inlet elbow, the end cover is provided with a water outlet, and the other end of the second pipe is connected with the water outlet. According to the water-cooling rotary joint for the furnace roller, the second pipe body is connected with the first pipe body in a surrounding mode, namely, the first pipe body and the second pipe body are integrally arranged, so that when the second pipe body rotates along with the furnace roller, the first pipe body rotates along with the second pipe body, and therefore leakage of cooling water caused by slipping of the first pipe body can be avoided, and the cooling effect is guaranteed.

title_en: Adhesive deposite device for electronic components
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a circuit board processing technology field specifically discloses a device is glued to point for electronic components, the on-line screen storage device comprises a base, base top fixedly connected with portal frame installs the movable seat on the portal frame, installs the injecting glue head on the movable seat, and base top lies in portal frame below fixedly connected with slip rail, and sliding connection has the mobile station on the slip rail, is equipped with fixing device on the mobile station, and fixing device is fixed with the circuit board mould, mobile station both sides below fixedly connected with connecting rod, sliding connection has the ejector pin on the connecting rod. According to the utility model, the movable table is designed, the ejector rod in the movable table is enabled to ascend through one side of the limiting plate to push out the circuit board which completes the dispensing process in the circuit board die upwards, and the push plate can be enabled to rotate along with the continued movement of the movable table, so that the circuit board is pushed out from the movable table, the circuit which completes dispensing is subjected to blanking, the working efficiency of the dispensing device is improved, and the control cost and the fault probability are reduced.

title_en: Cleaning device for electrophoretic coating
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cleaning device for electrophoretic coating, which relates to the technical field of electrophoretic coating and comprises a shell, wherein a mounting plate is fixedly arranged at the top end of the shell, and a fixing assembly is arranged at the bottom end of the mounting plate; the fixing assembly comprises a mounting shaft, a connecting groove, a pressing plate, a notch and a moving plate, wherein the mounting shaft is rotatably mounted at the bottom end of the mounting plate, the connecting groove is formed in one end of the mounting shaft, the notch is formed in the center of one end of the pressing plate, the pressing plate is slidably mounted on the outer wall of the mounting shaft through the notch, and the moving plate is fixedly mounted on the groove wall of the notch; according to the technical scheme provided by the utility model, the pressing plate moves downwards to press the parts in the cleaning cylinder, the water is sprayed from the water inlet pipe, the first motor is started to drive the cleaning cylinder to rotate to flush the parts, the parts are fixed through the pressing plate when the parts are flushed, collision among the parts is reduced, and the parts can be well protected when the parts are flushed.

title_en: Processing equipment of sign
abstract_en: The utility model relates to processing equipment of a sign board, which comprises a base, a box body fixedly connected to the top of the base and a controller fixedly installed on the right side of the box body, wherein a drying mechanism extending to the inside of the box body is arranged outside the box body, a rotary clamping mechanism is arranged inside the box body, a paint spraying mechanism extending to the inside of the box body is arranged outside the box body, the drying mechanism comprises a drying fan fixedly installed on the right side of the box body and an installation pipe fixedly installed on the right side wall in the box body, the bottom of the drying fan is fixedly connected with a fan pipe penetrating through the box body and extending to the inside of the installation pipe, and one side, far away from the box body, of the installation pipe is fixedly connected with a drying spray head. This processing equipment of sign starts stoving fan through the controller, and stoving fan work is through fan pipe and installation pipe transport hot-blast, and finally through stoving shower nozzle blowout, the sign body after being convenient for spray paint carries out drying treatment, has reached the advantage of being convenient for dry.

title_en: Tin coating device for photovoltaic solder strip processing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a tin coating device for processing photovoltaic solder strips, which aims to solve the technical problem that the tin coating efficiency is low due to the fact that a plurality of solder strips cannot be coated at the same time at present.

title_en: Digital dry-type compounding machine rubber coating device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of dry compounding machines and discloses a gluing device of a digital dry compounding machine, which comprises a fixing frame, wherein a stirring cylinder is fixedly arranged at the top of the fixing frame, a first fixed magnet ring is fixedly arranged at the top of the stirring cylinder, and a second fixed magnet ring is adsorbed at the top of the first fixed magnet ring. This digital dry-type compounding machine rubber coating device uses through the cooperation of motor and bull stick, utilize the motor to drive the bull stick and rotate, thereby make the bull stick drive the puddler and rotate, and then utilize the puddler to stir inside the churn, and utilize the ultrasonic wave pole of roof bottom to carry out ultrasonic vibration to glue, thereby high-efficient supplementary glue, avoid glue to condense, and utilize water level detection sensor auxiliary device to detect the water level, thereby make the threaded rod drive the dead lever and shift up, and utilize the dead lever to drive the roof and shift up, thereby add glue to the churn inside, compare traditional device, this device is convenient for stable stirring.

title_en: Intelligent spraying cooling device for aluminum electrolysis cell
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of aluminum electrolysis cell cooling equipment, and particularly discloses an intelligent spraying cooling device for an aluminum electrolysis cell, which comprises a case, wherein a controller and a water tank are respectively arranged in the case, a first water inlet pipe and a water outlet pipe are respectively communicated with the water tank, the other end of the first water inlet pipe is communicated with a low-pressure circulating pump, one end of the low-pressure circulating pump, which is far away from the first water inlet pipe, is communicated with a second water inlet pipe, the second water inlet pipe penetrates through the water tank and stretches out of the water tank, a valve is arranged on the second water inlet pipe, a centrifugal pump is communicated with the water outlet pipe, a hose is communicated with the water outlet pipe, the end part of the hose is communicated with a spray head, an electromagnetic valve and a flow valve are arranged on the hose, a temperature sensor is arranged right above the spray head, a display screen is arranged outside the case, a mechanical arm support is fixedly connected to the case, and the hose is connected to the mechanical arm support. The device is through setting up temperature sensor and controller and cooling down the cell-shell, has avoided the staff unable in time to arrive and has triggered the problem of incident.

title_en: Self-adhesive label printing and sizing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a self-adhesive label printing and gluing device which comprises a shell and a base, wherein the front end face and the rear end face of the shell are respectively provided with a fourth bearing in a penetrating manner, glue applying rollers are respectively arranged in the two groups of fourth bearings in a penetrating manner, the rear end of the shell is provided with a motor, the output end of the motor is clamped with one end part of the glue applying rollers, one side of the shell is provided with a forward and reverse motor and a pump body, the other side of the shell is provided with an electric cabinet, both sides of the shell are respectively provided with a through groove, the bottoms of the shell are welded with four groups of supporting legs, one ends of the four groups of supporting legs are respectively clamped with the base, the interior of the shell is fixedly provided with a guide rod, and both sides of the shell are respectively provided with a first bearing in a penetrating manner. The beneficial effects are that: according to the utility model, the screw rod, the first electric telescopic rod and the negative pressure sucker are arranged, so that the installation of the self-adhesive tape is realized conveniently, and the practicability of the self-adhesive label printing and sizing device is improved.

title_en: Sealing equipment for processing low-radiation vacuum glass
abstract_en: The utility model discloses sealing equipment for processing low-radiation vacuum glass, which comprises a workbench, and a transfer mechanism and a sealing mechanism which are arranged on the workbench; the transfer mechanism comprises two transmission racks symmetrically arranged at the upper part of the workbench, the upper parts of the two transmission racks are provided with a movable table together, the movable table is symmetrically provided with two first motors, and driving shafts of the two first motors penetrate through the movable table and are respectively provided with transmission gears matched with the two transmission racks; the lifting platform comprises a lifting platform, a lifting cylinder, a second motor, a rotary table and a rotary table, wherein the lifting cylinder is fixedly arranged in the middle of the upper part of the lifting platform, the telescopic end of the lifting cylinder is fixedly connected with the horizontal part of the lifting platform, the section of the lifting platform is L-shaped, the second motor is fixedly arranged on the inner side of the vertical part of the lifting platform, and the rotary table is fixedly arranged at the free end of the driving shaft of the second motor, and the driving shaft of the second motor extends to the outer side of the lifting platform. The utility model can realize automatic glue spraying and sealing operation on vacuum glass, reduce manual operation and facilitate improvement of production efficiency.

title_en: Wear-resistant artificial board
