abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wear-resistant artificial board, which comprises: the wear-resistant frame comprises a surrounding frame, wherein a main board is fixedly arranged in the surrounding frame, a first fixing block is fixedly connected to the inside of the main board, and the surrounding frame comprises a wear-resistant frame body and a groove; the first composite core board is arranged above the main board, a first connecting hole is formed in the first composite core board, an epoxy floor paint board is arranged above the first composite core board, and a second connecting hole is formed in the epoxy floor paint board; the second composite core board is arranged below the main board, a third connecting hole is formed in the second composite core board, a bottom plate assembly is arranged below the second composite core board, and the bottom plate assembly comprises a base plate, a second fixing block and a second mounting hole. The wear-resistant artificial board is convenient to assemble and disassemble, has good connection stability, improves wear resistance, and solves the problem that the existing artificial board is mostly easy to wear.

title_en: Antistatic high-flame-retardant pearl cotton plate
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of pearl cotton plates, and discloses an antistatic high-flame-retardant-performance pearl cotton plate, which comprises a pearl cotton layer, two flame-retardant layers and two antistatic layers, wherein the two flame-retardant layers are respectively and fixedly connected to the upper surface and the lower surface of the pearl cotton layer, the two antistatic layers are respectively and fixedly connected to the surfaces of the two flame-retardant layers, which are far away from each other, the flame-retardant layers comprise a first perlite plate, a silicate foam plate and a second perlite plate, the second perlite plate is fixedly connected with the surface of the pearl cotton layer, the silicate foam plate is fixedly connected to the surface of the second perlite plate, which is far away from the pearl cotton layer, and the first perlite plate is fixedly connected to the surface of the silicate foam plate, which is far away from the second perlite plate. The utility model has the following advantages and effects: not only has high flame retardant property, but also effectively improves the antistatic property of the flame retardant, and can better meet the use requirement.

title_en: Low-pressure formation aluminum foil preparation system
abstract_en: The application provides a low-pressure formation aluminum foil preparation system which comprises a primary formation groove, a secondary formation groove, a tertiary formation groove and a quaternary formation groove which are sequentially arranged, wherein formation liquids are contained in the primary formation groove, the secondary formation groove, the tertiary formation groove and the quaternary formation groove. The preparation system further comprises a chemical liquid circulation system for circulating chemical liquid, and the chemical liquid circulation system comprises a first circulation pipeline, a second circulation pipeline, a third circulation pipeline and a fourth circulation pipeline. The low-pressure formation aluminum foil preparation system provided by the application can realize the circulation flow of formation liquid, can realize the temperature complementation of formation liquid in each formation tank, reduces the power consumption for heating and cooling, and reduces the evaporation capacity.

title_en: Novel broken line cavity for coating die head
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel broken line cavity for a coating die head, which comprises a feeding cavity and a discharging cavity, wherein the feeding cavity comprises a V-shaped part communicated with a feeding pipe of a die head body and broken line parts positioned at two ends of the V-shaped part, and the surfaces of the V-shaped part are parallel to the top surface of the die head body; the ejection of compact cavity is located the one side that the inlet pipe was kept away from to the feeding cavity, this kind of novel broken line cavity for coating die head replaces traditional cavity that is used for coating die head, has avoided the coating in the cavity to appear the problem that both sides are higher when the ejection of compact.

title_en: Compression roller installation mechanism and coating device
abstract_en: The application provides a press roller mounting mechanism, which comprises a frame, a press roller assembly and an auxiliary mounting assembly, wherein the press roller assembly is arranged on the frame; the compression roller assembly comprises a compression roller piece and a compression roller bearing piece, wherein the compression roller bearing piece is arranged on the frame and is provided with a compression roller bearing position, and the compression roller piece is detachably arranged at the compression roller bearing position; the auxiliary installation component is arranged on the frame, one end of the auxiliary installation component is close to the compression roller bearing position, and the other end extends towards the direction away from the compression roller piece; the pressing roller piece is supported and placed at the other end of the auxiliary installation assembly, the pressing roller piece is pushed to a pressing roller bearing position along the length direction of the auxiliary installation assembly, and the pressing roller piece is installed at the pressing roller bearing position; the application also provides a coating device. According to the application, through the arrangement of the auxiliary installation assembly, workers are not required to lift the compression roller all the time during installation, the installation difficulty is reduced, the workers are prevented from being injured in the installation process, and the installation efficiency and the safety are improved.

title_en: AR film
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an AR film, which comprises an ink layer, a substrate layer, a first niobium oxide layer and a first silicon oxide layer which are stacked. According to the AR film, the ink layer is coated on the back surface of the substrate in the conventional AR film, and the thicknesses of the ink layers with different transmittances are selected, so that the transmittance of the whole AR film is adjusted, the AR film has the advantages of low reflection and controllable transmittance, has privacy and heat insulation functions, is suitable for being used as an automobile central control screen film, can be used for being used for front windshields and side window glass of automobiles, and is suitable for being used as a screen film of various consumer electronic products.

title_en: Continuous type application production line
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of continuous coating, in particular to a continuous coating production line, which reduces the influence of impurities on the coating on the surface of a material in the material processing process by arranging a cleaning mechanism and a drying mechanism, improves the processing quality, and improves the processing efficiency by carrying out quick drying after coating the material; comprises a transportation mechanism; the device also comprises a cleaning mechanism, an air drying mechanism, a pressurizing mechanism, a paint dipping mechanism, a heating mechanism and a drying mechanism, wherein the cleaning mechanism is arranged on the conveying mechanism, the air drying mechanism is arranged at the right end of the conveying mechanism, the pressurizing mechanism is arranged on the cleaning mechanism, the paint dipping mechanism is arranged on the conveying mechanism, the heating mechanism is arranged at the right end of the conveying mechanism, and the drying mechanism is arranged on the conveying mechanism; the conveying mechanism conveys materials, the pressurizing mechanism pressurizes the cleaning mechanism, the paint dipping mechanism dips paint on the materials, the heating mechanism heats the materials, and the drying mechanism dries paint on the surfaces of the materials.

title_en: Baking finish box for furniture manufacturing
abstract_en: The utility model provides a varnish baking box for furniture manufacture, which comprises a box body, wherein a supporting piece is arranged in the box body, the supporting piece comprises a motor, a tray, a groove, a supporting disc and a protruding block, the motor is fixed at the bottom of the box body, the output end of the motor is fixedly connected with the tray, the protruding block is fixedly connected with the outer side of the supporting disc, an exhaust fan and a purifying piece are fixedly connected to the top of the box body, the exhaust fan is communicated with the purifying piece, the purifying piece comprises a fixing box, an active carbon plate and a filter cotton layer, the fixing box is fixed at the top of the box body, and the active carbon plate and the filter cotton layer are both arranged in the fixing box. The baking varnish box for furniture manufacturing solves the problems that the existing device can only fixedly bake the device, can not rotate an object, is easy to cause uneven baking, and does not purify gas generated during baking.

title_en: Composite structure of acrylic plate and hollowed-out metal plate
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of layered products using adhesives, in particular to a composite structure of an acrylic plate and a hollowed-out metal plate, which comprises the acrylic plate and the metal plate, wherein a plurality of hollowed-out holes are formed in the metal plate, the acrylic plate and the metal plate are connected through an adhesive layer, the hollowed-out holes are provided with an upper hole surface and a lower hole surface, the connecting lines of the upper hole surface and the lower hole surface form hole walls, the connecting lines are not perpendicular to the upper hole surface or the lower hole surface, the connecting lines are oblique lines, the oblique lines are inclined from the upper hole surface to the lower hole surface, or the connecting lines are oblique lines, the oblique lines are inclined from the lower hole surface to the upper hole surface, or the connecting lines are arc lines, the arc lines are convex towards one side far away from the center of the hollowed-out holes, or the connecting lines are arc lines, and the arc lines are convex towards one side of the center of the hollowed-out holes. The composite structure of the acrylic plate and the hollow metal plate is designed through irregular hollow holes, so that the holding force between the hollow metal plate and the acrylic plate is increased, the risk of cracking and stripping between metal and acrylic can be reduced, and the effect of connecting and fastening is better achieved.

title_en: Baffle box type filter circulation feeding system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a circulating feeding system of a baffle box type filter, which comprises a lifting unit, a carrying unit and a dispensing unit; the lifting unit comprises a frame and a lifting module; the carrying unit comprises a carrying base, a carrying Y-axis module and a carrying X-axis module; the dispensing unit comprises a dispensing vertical frame, a carrying Y-axis module, a carrying X-axis module, a carrying Z-axis module and a dispensing assembly. According to the utility model, through the cooperation of the lifting unit, the carrying unit and the dispensing unit, the filter to be processed can be subjected to dispensing treatment through the dispensing unit after the lifting treatment of the lifting unit on one side, and then the filter subjected to dispensing is carried to the lifting unit on the other side through the carrying unit, so that the production beat is relatively large, and the processing efficiency is relatively high.

title_en: Uniform gas distribution angle control device of vacuum equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a uniform gas distribution angle control device of vacuum equipment, which is used on vacuum coating equipment and comprises the following components: a mounting frame; a rotation mechanism mounted on the mounting frame; two multistage gas distribution pipelines symmetrically arranged on the rotating mechanism; the device comprises a mounting frame and a driving mechanism on the mounting frame or the device, wherein the driving mechanism is in transmission connection with two multistage gas distribution pipelines. The design of the utility model improves the directional controllability of gas distribution, can rotate 0-45 degrees, and improves the uniformity of gas distribution through the design of multistage disturbance. The design of the multi-layer gas mixing pipe realizes the sufficient and uniform diffusion of the gas flow, improves the mixing uniformity of the mixed gas, improves the gas distribution setting controllability of the vacuum coating equipment, and is beneficial to the debugging of the setting process.

title_en: Double-barrelled injecting glue mechanism with stability
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a double-pipe glue injection mechanism with stability, which comprises an alloy shell, wherein an adjusting mechanism is arranged below the alloy shell, the right side of the alloy shell is provided with a glue injection mechanism, the adjusting mechanism comprises a mounting shell, a worm with one end penetrating and extending to the outside is rotatably arranged in the mounting shell, a rotating rod with two ends penetrating and extending to the outside is rotatably arranged in the mounting shell, a worm wheel is fixedly arranged on the outer surface of the rotating rod, and the outer surface of the worm wheel is meshed with the outer surface of the worm. This double-barrelled injecting glue mechanism with stability through being provided with adjustment mechanism, has reached the purpose that keeps stable to the angle of injecting glue pipe, has reduced workman's intensity of labour, has satisfied user's user demand, through being provided with injecting glue mechanism, plays the extruded effect to group the angle glue, can carry out quick replacement to group the angle glue, has made things convenient for user's use.

title_en: Aluminum honeycomb core glue spreader
abstract_en: The utility model provides an aluminum honeycomb core glue spreader which comprises a bottom plate, a supporting rod, a longitudinal moving device, a transverse moving device, a connecting plate and an electric telescopic rod I, wherein a storage box is arranged at the bottom of the electric telescopic rod I, a nozzle is arranged at the bottom of the storage box, fixing plates are respectively arranged at the left side and the right side of the connecting plate, an electric telescopic rod II is respectively arranged at the bottoms of the two fixing plates, roller plates are arranged at the bottoms of the two electric telescopic rods II, roller shafts are rotatably arranged at the middle parts of the two roller plates, and wool felt is arranged on the surfaces of the roller shafts. According to the aluminum honeycomb core glue spreader disclosed by the utility model, not only can the materials be well and evenly spread, but also glue solutions with different thicknesses can be provided according to the thickness of the materials, and glue solutions with different amounts can be provided according to the distance between the spray head and the glue spreading roller, so that the single working period of the device is prolonged, and the overall use effect and the use efficiency of the device are further improved.

title_en: Gluing thickness regulator of coating machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gluing thickness regulator of a coating machine, which comprises a coating machine body and a liquid storage tank, wherein the liquid storage tank is fixedly arranged on the coating machine body, the upper end of a coating roller corresponding to the coating machine body is used for coating glue, a scraper plate seat is detachably arranged on the outer side wall of the liquid storage tank, a scraper plate is arranged in a sliding manner in the scraper plate seat, a regulator used for controlling the gluing thickness is arranged on the scraper plate seat, the installation of the scraper plate and the limitation of the scraper plate can be completed through screwing a screw rod through the regulator arranged between the scraper plate seat and the scraper plate, the approximate position of the scraper plate corresponding to the surface of the coating roller after a glue layer is required is regulated, and then the distance between the scraper plate and the surface of the coating roller is finely regulated according to the cooperation of a nut, an external thread ring and a limiting screw block, so that the thickness of the glue layer on the surface of the coating roller is scraped by the scraper plate is regulated, and the thickness of the coating glue layer on the surface of a protective film is conveniently controlled.

title_en: Cathode bus protection device
abstract_en: The application discloses a cathode bus protection device, which comprises: a protective cover and a cover plate; a through groove is arranged on the first side surface of the protective cover and is used for internally arranging a cathode bus of the electrolytic tank; the second side of safety cover is equipped with the rotation axis, and the one end of apron is equipped with the sleeve, and the apron passes through its telescopic connection on the rotation axis of safety cover, makes the apron can rotate around the rotation axis to cover the notch of logical groove. Therefore, the cathode bus is placed in the through groove arranged on the protective cover, and the cover plate connected with the rotating shaft covers the notch, so that abrasion of the cathode bus in use is reduced, and the service life of the cathode bus is prolonged.

title_en: Composite film for medicine packaging
abstract_en: The utility model provides a composite film that medicine packing was used, composite film includes from left to right the biaxially oriented polyester film layer that sets gradually, first compound glue layer, pure aluminum film layer, second compound glue layer, low density polyethylene film layer, first compound glue layer is located between biaxially oriented polyester film layer and the pure aluminum film layer, biaxially oriented polyester film layer and pure aluminum film layer bond through first compound glue layer and form semi-manufactured goods composite film, second compound glue layer is located between semi-manufactured goods composite film and the low density polyethylene film layer, bond through second compound glue layer between semi-manufactured goods composite film and the low density polyethylene film layer and form the composite film finished product. The composite membrane is formed by compounding a plurality of layers of thin film structures, has good stability, can avoid deformation, fracture or layering under the action of external force, can effectively improve the air tightness, barrier property and easy tearing property of the composite membrane, and can effectively protect and store medicines.

title_en: Circulation anti-oxidation tank body of foil producing machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of anti-skid oxidation tanks, in particular to a circulating anti-oxidation tank of a foil machine, which comprises an anti-oxidation tank, wherein the top end of the anti-oxidation tank is provided with a bracket, the top end of the bracket is provided with a shell, the inner cavity of the shell is provided with a lifting assembly, the bottom end of the lifting assembly is provided with a fixed frame, the inner cavity of the fixed frame is rotationally connected with a conveying roller through a bearing, the left side and the right side of the top end of the anti-oxidation tank are respectively provided with a fixed plate, and the top ends of the two fixed plates are respectively connected with a supporting roller through fixing frames. The circulating anti-oxidation tank body of the raw foil machine solves the problem that in the actual use process of the anti-oxidation tank, a user needs to manually pass one end of the copper foil through the lower part of the conveying roller to enable the copper foil to achieve the purpose of turning, the conveying roller is soaked in anti-oxidation liquid, the user needs to deeply penetrate hands into the anti-oxidation liquid to finish the operation, and certain damage is brought to the user due to contact of the skin and the anti-oxidation liquid.

title_en: Processing device of multifunctional composite fabric
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a processing device of a multifunctional composite fabric, and relates to the technical field of multifunctional composite fabric processing; the utility model comprises a bottom plate, wherein the top end of the bottom plate is fixedly provided with symmetrically-distributed brackets, the tops of the two brackets are jointly rotatably provided with a conveying roller, one side of the top end of the bottom plate, which is far away from the brackets, is fixedly provided with a cleaning box, one side of the inner wall of the cleaning box is rotatably penetrated with a rotating rod, the outer side of the rotating rod is fixedly sleeved with a first gear, the outer side of the first gear is in meshed connection with symmetrically-distributed second gears, the middle parts of the two second gears are fixedly penetrated with rotating shafts, and the rotating shafts are rotatably arranged on the inner wall of the cleaning box; according to the utility model, the first gear and the sector gear are arranged, so that the movable rod can ascend and descend, the beating plate is used for beating the top end and the bottom end of the fabric, dust at the bottom end of the fabric falls off, and the dust at the top end of the fabric can be ejected out of the gap, so that the subsequent flushing is facilitated, and the cleaning quality is improved.

title_en: Energy-saving device for electrolytic copper
abstract_en: The utility model is applicable to the technical field of electrolysis, and provides an energy-saving device for copper electrolysis, which comprises: the utility model provides an energy-saving device for electrolytic copper, which can change the connection mode of copper strips through the connecting device and the cooling device, enable the copper strips to be connected more tightly, reduce the phenomenon of poor heat contact, double the length of a cooling water pipe, increase ice water circulation, control the temperature rise problem, and simultaneously separate equipment air draft from environment air draft during operation of the device through the arranged air draft device, thereby meeting equipment air draft, reducing environment air draft and better treating redundant chlorine generated by an electrolytic tank.

title_en: Fibrilia helmet shaping device
abstract_en: Compared with the traditional steel carbon fiber plastic helmet material, the utility model has the advantages of portability, bacteria resistance, environmental protection, quick regeneration and the like, and comprises a helmet, an outer layer, a middle layer and a rear layer, wherein the outer layer is made of fine fibrilia, the middle layer is made of mixed fibrilia and fibrilia, the rear layer is made of mixed and stamped anti-vibration layer resin and adhesive, the outer layer is made of fine fibrilia, the middle layer is made of mixed fibrilia and fibrilia after being mixed and stamped by the outer layer, the rear layer is made of mixed and stamped by the adhesive, the rear layer is made of mixed and stamped by the fine fibrilia, the post-layer anti-vibration layer resin and the adhesive have high strength, the interweaving among fibers is tighter after the ecdysis and layering superposition treatment, the tensile strength and the compressive strength of the material are improved, the fibrilia has antibacterial property, the growth of bacteria can be effectively inhibited, and the sanitary performance of the helmet is improved.

title_en: Gluing equipment for door plate processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses glue spreading equipment for door plate processing, which belongs to the technical field of door plate processing and aims at the problems that glue coated on the surface of a substrate in the prior art is uneven in thickness and excessive glue overflows at will, and the glue spreading equipment comprises a glue spreader body, wherein a glue spreading mechanism is arranged in the glue spreader body; according to the utility model, through the scraping mechanism, the scraping knife which is positioned at a certain height above the base material can scrape redundant glue, the uniformity of the glue coating thickness is ensured, and the scraping knife with adjustable height can control the scraping thickness of the glue.

title_en: Glass structure with reinforced glass film
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a glass structure with a reinforced glass film, which relates to the technical field of glass processing and comprises a glass body, a top glass film layer arranged at the top of the glass body, a bottom glass film layer arranged at the bottom of the glass body, a fixed protection part arranged at one end of the glass body and positioned at one side of the top glass film layer, wherein the fixed protection part comprises a first guard plate arranged at the top of the top glass film layer, a second guard plate arranged at the bottom of the bottom glass film layer, a side support structure arranged at one end of the first guard plate and connected with one end of the second guard plate, and a plurality of pressure structures embedded in the inner wall of the bottom of the first guard plate and distributed linearly and uniformly. According to the utility model, the glass and the glass film layer are protected through the freely detachable protective frame.

title_en: Hardware processing pickling equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses hardware processing pickling equipment, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the upper end of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a pickling tank, a pickling cavity with an opening at the upper end is arranged in the pickling tank, a power plate fixedly connected to the upper end face of the bottom plate is arranged at the rear side of the pickling tank, the upper end of the power plate is fixedly connected with a mounting plate, two bilaterally symmetrical blowing mechanisms positioned at the upper side of the pickling tank are arranged in the mounting plate, parts are placed in or taken out through adjusting the distance between a thread dish and a fixed dish through threads, the parts are prevented from falling into the pickling cavity through the limitation of the thread dish and the fixed dish in the pickling process, the parts are rocked in the pickling process, and each surface of the parts is ensured to be in contact with acid liquor for pickling; the fan motor arranged in the blowing mechanism drives the fan shaft and the fan blade to rotate, so that blowing is carried out in the pickling cavity, and residual acid liquor on the parts, the fixed dish and the threaded dish is blown downwards to drop back into the pickling cavity, so that the acid liquor is prevented from being lost and the danger caused by acid liquor residue is avoided.

title_en: Vibration dispersing device for electroplated part
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vibration dispersing device for an electroplated part, which comprises a tray with an opening at the front end, wherein an L-shaped groove is formed in the inner bottom of the tray, a baffle is connected to the inner side of the L-shaped groove in a sliding manner, a handle is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the baffle, and an upper limiting plate for preventing the baffle from falling off the L-shaped groove is fixedly arranged on the side wall of the baffle; an elastic mechanism for the baffle plate to slide downwards is arranged between the baffle plate and the tray; the inner side of the tray is provided with a sliding cavity, and a fixing mechanism for fixing the baffle is arranged in the sliding cavity. According to the utility model, through the design of the baffle, the size of the discharge hole is increased, and the baffle can be moved downwards only by pressing the pressing plate, so that the opening of the tray is opened, and the rest products are conveniently cleaned.

title_en: Drying device of automatic coating production line
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of drying devices, in particular to a drying device of an automatic coating production line, which solves the defects of the drying device in the prior art and comprises a box body, wherein a base is fixedly connected to one side of the box body, a driving motor is arranged on one side of the base, a first rotating rod is rotationally driven by one side of the driving motor and is rotationally connected with the inside of the base, a turntable is fixedly connected to one end of the first rotating rod, a second rotating rod is rotationally connected to one side of the base, a rotating plate is fixedly connected to one surface of the second rotating rod, a fixing seat is fixedly connected to one side of the base, the second rotating rod is rotationally connected with the inside of the fixing seat, a turntable is fixedly connected to one surface of the turntable, and materials are arranged inside the fixing plates.

title_en: Novel stainless steel surface wire drawing layer structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of stainless steel, and discloses a novel stainless steel surface wiredrawing layer structure. Including stainless steel base plate, ageing resistance layer, inoxidizing coating, surface wire drawing layer, corrosion-resistant layer and scratch prevention layer, stainless steel base plate fixed connection is at the upper surface on ageing resistance layer, inoxidizing coating fixed connection is at the upper surface of stainless steel base plate, surface wire drawing layer sets up the top at the inoxidizing coating, corrosion-resistant layer sets up the upper surface on surface wire drawing layer, scratch prevention layer sets up the upper surface at corrosion-resistant layer. According to the utility model, when the surface wiredrawing layer is extruded and moved downwards, the buffer elastic rod can be pushed to bend and deform, meanwhile, the rubber particle blocks are extruded and deformed, a certain buffer force release effect can be achieved on the downwards-pressed pressure, and the protective layer is paved by adopting the rubber plate, so that abrasion between the buffer elastic rod and the stainless steel substrate can be prevented.

title_en: Vacuum coating machine that work efficiency is high
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vacuum coating machine with high working efficiency, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the right side of the top of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a vacuum coating machine body, the left side of the bottom of the vacuum coating machine body is fixedly connected with a heat dissipation box, the left side of the heat dissipation box is fixedly connected with a water tank, the left side of the water tank is provided with a semiconductor refrigerator in a penetrating way, and the right side of the semiconductor refrigerator is fixedly connected with a heat exchange plate. According to the utility model, through the matched use of the bottom plate, the vacuum coating machine body, the heat dissipation box, the water tank, the semiconductor refrigerator, the heat exchange plate, the water pump, the heat conduction pipe, the ventilation shell, the drying agent, the exhaust pipe, the first motor and the fan blades, the function of good heat dissipation effect is realized, and the problem that the service life of the vacuum coating machine is influenced because the heat dissipation structure is not arranged in the conventional vacuum coating machine, the vacuum coating machine generates heat due to long-time work in the use process, and the heat dissipation treatment is not timely performed is solved.

title_en: Heating device for CVD equipment and CVD equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a heating device for CVD equipment and the CVD equipment, and relates to the technical field of semiconductors. This a heating device for CVD equipment includes tray, heat conduction piece, swivelling joint spare and heating element, and the heat conduction piece encloses the lower surface of establishing at the tray along the edge of tray, and swivelling joint spare is fixed to be set up at the terminal surface that the tray was kept away from to the heat conduction piece, and swivelling joint spare is used for being connected with the driving piece of CVD equipment in order to drive the tray rotation through the heat conduction piece, and heating element sets up in the accommodation space that tray and heat conduction piece formed, and heating element is used for heating tray and heat conduction piece, and the area of contact between heat conduction piece and the tray is greater than the area of contact between heat conduction piece and the swivelling joint spare. The heating device for the CVD equipment and the CVD equipment can solve the problem that the temperature of the edge of the tray is lower than that of other areas due to the existence of edge support in the prior art, so that the temperature of the surface of the tray is uneven.

title_en: Building site steel pipe connecting piece rust cleaning structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of steel pipe connecting piece rust removal devices, and discloses a building site steel pipe connecting piece rust removal structure, which comprises a convex seat and a connecting plate, wherein a rotating rod is rotationally connected to the top outer surface of the convex seat, a first motor is fixedly arranged on the top outer surface of the convex seat, a driving gear is fixedly connected to the output end of the first motor, a driven gear is fixedly sleeved on the outer surface of the rotating rod, a rust removal box, a cleaning box and a drying box are arranged on the top outer surface of the convex seat, and a heating pipe is arranged on the inner surface of the drying box. This building site steel pipe connecting piece rust cleaning structure drives the driving gear through first motor and rotates, drives driven gear and rotates to make the bull stick rotate, rotate the blowing frame, rotate respectively to rust cleaning case, wash case and stoving incasement, reached can be after derusting the connecting piece, timely stoving to the connecting piece, improved work efficiency's effect.

title_en: H-shaped steel frame processing turning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a processing turning device for an H-shaped steel frame, and relates to the technical field of H-shaped steel frame processing. The utility model comprises a transverse frame rod, wherein a T-shaped sliding groove is formed in the transverse frame rod, a plurality of movable sliding blocks are slidably arranged in the T-shaped sliding groove, an electric hydraulic rod is fixedly arranged on one side of the movable sliding blocks, a connecting mechanism is fixedly arranged at one end of the electric hydraulic rod, a connecting rod is fixedly arranged at one end of the connecting mechanism, an arc-shaped block is fixedly arranged at one end of the connecting rod, and a clamping and pressing mechanism is rotatably arranged on the arc-shaped block. The utility model can facilitate the coating of the H-shaped steel frame by the staff, and the staff can push the H-shaped steel frame to turn over in the combined supporting round piece, thereby being further convenient for adding the coating, and then the distance between the two arc-shaped blocks can be adjusted by the arranged adjusting rod, thereby being further suitable for the H-shaped steel frames with different lengths.

title_en: Ground chain powder spraying drying tunnel curing assembly line
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a curing assembly line of a ground chain powder spraying drying tunnel, in particular to the technical field of assembly lines, which comprises a plurality of chain wheels, wherein the outer surface of the chain wheels is provided with a conveying chain, one side of the conveying chain is provided with a plurality of driving components, one side of the conveying chain is provided with a plurality of powder spraying rooms, and one side of the outer surface of the conveying chain is provided with a curing drying tunnel. In actual operation, the dust collector can suck redundant powder into the collecting drawer through the dust collection pipe and the flexible connecting pipe, the first motor drives the rotating plate to rotate, the connecting rod can drive the supporting block to reciprocate along with the rotation of the rotating plate, the dust collector can be driven to reciprocate to absorb the scattered powder in the powder spraying room, the second motor drives one of the rotating rods to rotate, and the two rotating rods can drive the two fan blades to rotate in cooperation with the belt, so that the workpiece sprayed with the powder can be cooled, and the scattered powder can be collected conveniently.

title_en: Energy-saving heating device for chromium plating processing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of chromeplating heating devices, and discloses an energy-saving heating device for chromeplating processing. The utility model comprises the following steps: the device comprises a chromium plating tank, a cover plate is fixedly arranged at the top of the chromium plating tank, an intelligent electric heating rod is fixedly arranged at the top of the cover plate, the heating rod of the intelligent electric heating rod extends into the chromium plating tank, a frame is fixedly arranged at the top of the cover plate, a rotating rod is rotatably arranged at the top of the frame, two screws are rotatably arranged on the frame and are in transmission connection with the rotating rod, internal thread barrels are sleeved on the two screws, the same top cover is fixedly arranged on the two internal thread barrels, a sliding frame is slidably arranged in the top cover, a plurality of hooks are fixedly arranged at the bottom of the sliding frame, and two turnover covers are rotatably arranged on the cover plate. According to the utility model, the heat preservation effect on the chromium plating liquid in the chromium plating tank is improved, so that the use frequency of the intelligent electric heating rod is reduced, and the energy-saving effect is achieved.

title_en: Processing device for acid and alkali resistant floor unit
abstract_en: A processing device of an acid and alkali resistant floor unit comprises: a suspended conveyor having a track and a plurality of hangers for hanging an acid and alkali resistant floor unit; a loading area, a spraying chamber, a baking chamber and a cooling area are sequentially arranged along the periphery of the track of the suspension conveying equipment; the predetermined temperature in the baking chamber may sinter the powder coating on the acid and alkali resistant floor unit.

title_en: Thermal field for single crystal furnace and single crystal furnace
abstract_en: The application relates to a thermal field for a single crystal furnace and the single crystal furnace, wherein the thermal field comprises a heater and a heat preservation device, the heat preservation device comprises a heat preservation ring and a fixing ring, the heat preservation ring is made of insulating high-temperature-resistant materials, the heat preservation ring is sleeved outside the heater, the inner side of the heat preservation ring is at least partially abutted against the outer side of the heater, the heat preservation ring comprises a plurality of heat preservation unit bodies, the plurality of heat preservation unit bodies are spliced along the circumferential direction, and the fixing ring is sleeved outside the heat preservation ring to lock and fix the plurality of heat preservation unit bodies. The application can splice a plurality of heat-insulating unit bodies into the heat-insulating ring, and can at least partially contact the inner side of the heat-insulating ring with the outer side of the heater, so that the application reduces or even eliminates the gap between the heat-insulating ring and the heater to further ensure the heat-insulating effect of the heat-insulating ring, and meanwhile, the heat-insulating ring is made of insulating high-temperature-resistant materials, so that the application can avoid sparking between the heat-insulating ring and the heater to further reduce the potential safety hazard.

title_en: UV glue curing device
abstract_en: The UV glue curing device comprises a workbench, a positioning mechanism, a bearing mechanism, a pressure maintaining mechanism and a light source mechanism, wherein the positioning mechanism is arranged on the workbench and used for bearing a workpiece and an assembly part arranged on the workpiece, UV glue is coated on one side of the assembly part facing the workpiece, the bearing mechanism is arranged on one side of the positioning mechanism, the pressure maintaining mechanism comprises a pressure maintaining driving piece and a light-transmitting pressure-resisting piece, the pressure maintaining driving piece is arranged on the bearing mechanism and connected with the light-transmitting pressure-resisting piece and used for driving the light-transmitting pressure-resisting piece to press the assembly part along a first direction, the light source mechanism is arranged on the bearing mechanism and above the positioning mechanism and used for emitting ultraviolet light when the light-transmitting pressure-resisting piece presses the assembly part, and the ultraviolet light is enabled to transmit the light-transmitting pressure-resisting piece to irradiate the UV glue so as to cure the UV glue. Among the above-mentioned UV glues solidification equipment, the pre-compaction of assembly part and the irradiation of UV glue go on in step, have improved the solidification efficiency of UV glue, and the UV is glued by the fixed relative work piece of assembly part's position in the solidification process to assembly precision of assembly part and work piece has been improved.

title_en: Metal material electroplating device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a metal material electroplating device, which relates to the field of electroplating and comprises a mounting seat, wherein a storage battery is arranged at the upper end of the mounting seat, a connecting wire is electrically connected to the upper end of the storage battery, a connector is arranged on the inner wall of the connecting wire, and a guide rod is arranged on the inner wall of the connector. According to the utility model, the electrolytic box is arranged to play a clamping and fixing role on the connecting wire, when the device is used, the electrolytic box and the connecting wire are arranged to be convenient for regulating the circuit of the device, the usability of the device is improved, the fixing rod is arranged to play a threaded fixing role on the falling-preventing frame, when the device is used, the falling-preventing frame is arranged to be convenient for taking out falling parts, the usability of the device is improved, the water tank is arranged to play a clamping and fixing role on the water baffle, and when the device is used, the water tank and the water baffle are arranged to be convenient for adding water to the device, so that the concentration of electroplating liquid is prevented from increasing, and the usability of the device is improved.

title_en: Cathodic protection potential detection device and cathodic protection potential detection system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of pipeline detection, and provides a cathodic protection potential detection device and a cathodic protection potential detection system, wherein the cathodic protection potential detection device comprises a first detection shoe, a second detection shoe and a host machine, and the first detection shoe is provided with a first reference electrode; the host computer is connected to the first detection shoe and the second detection shoe, is used for determining a first potential value of the first reference electrode and a second potential value of the second reference electrode, and is suitable for obtaining a calibration potential value by correcting the first potential value and the second potential value. According to the cathodic protection potential detection device, the calibration potential value is obtained by correcting the first potential value obtained by the first reference electrode and the second potential value obtained by the second reference electrode through the host, and the data measured by the reference electrode can be corrected in real time while the potential detection is completed, so that the accuracy of detecting the buried pipeline is greatly improved.

title_en: Rust removal device for hardware machining
abstract_en: The utility model provides a rust removing device for hardware processing, which relates to the technical field of hardware processing and comprises a liquid storage tank, wherein a transverse plate is fixedly arranged on one side of the liquid storage tank, a screw rod is rotatably arranged in the middle of the upper surface of the transverse plate, a lifting plate is arranged on one side of a screw rod body in a threaded manner, and two right-angle frames are fixedly arranged on one side, close to the liquid storage tank, of the lifting plate. According to the utility model, the first motor is started to drive the screw rod to rotate at the output shaft end, the rotating screw rod drives the lifting plate to descend in a threaded screwing mode, then a worker pours rust removing liquid into the liquid storage tank, then the worker controls the rotating shaft to rotate, the rotating shaft drives the roller to rotate, so that hardware in the roller rolls, the surface of the hardware can be fully contacted with the rust removing liquid which floods into the roller through the through hole, the rust removing liquid can fully remove rust from the hardware, and the rust removing effect is greatly enhanced.

title_en: Panel rubber coating device is used in panel processing
abstract_en: The utility model provides a panel rubber coating device for panel processing includes the frame, from left to right is equipped with panel flattening device and rubber coating device in proper order in the frame, flattening device includes the squeeze roll and is located the live-action roller of squeeze roll below, squeeze roll both ends are connected with first sliding block bearing, first sliding block is located the first sliding block inslot of both sides frame, the upper end in first sliding block groove is equipped with the first cylinder of inversion, the flexible end in first cylinder passes the upper wall in first sliding block groove and first sliding block fixed connection, the live-action roller passes through the output of the first motor in shaft coupling and the frame and is connected. The plate gluing device not only greatly improves the automation degree of gluing, but also remarkably improves the gluing efficiency and quality. The device realizes even rubber coating to panel through automatic mechanical structure.

title_en: Blank is stores pylon for coating
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hanger for coating a blank, which relates to the technical field of blanks and comprises a base, wherein a hot dry bin is fixedly connected to the top of the base, a coating frame is movably connected to the inner wall of the hot dry bin, and hangers are respectively and movably connected to the upper side and the lower side of the front end of the coating frame. According to the utility model, through the cooperation of the spring pull rods, the clamping plates, the coating frame motor placing bin, the coating frame motor and the hanging frame plate, the two spring pull rods are pulled, the spring pull rods drive the clamping plates to pull and adapt to the sizes of blank pieces while pulling, the blank pieces are placed after the inner walls of the clamping plates, the spring pull rods are loosened to tightly clamp the blank pieces, after all the blank pieces are fixed, the coating frame motor on the inner walls of the coating frame motor placing bin is started, the coating frame motor starts to drive the hanging frame plate to move to two sides, and the problem that two master racks are not beneficial to working on one hanging frame when the blank piece coating hanger is used for coating is solved.

title_en: Coating device for display screen panel
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a coating device for a display screen panel, which belongs to the technical field of coating equipment and comprises a working frame, a conveying mechanism, a supporting frame, a moving block, a positioning mechanism, a guiding mechanism and a coating mechanism; the conveying mechanism is rotatably arranged on the working frame, the supporting frame is arranged in the working frame, the moving frame is arranged on the supporting frame in a sliding mode, a first moving mechanism used for driving the moving frame to move is arranged on the supporting frame, the moving block is arranged on the moving frame in a sliding mode, a second moving mechanism used for driving the moving block to move is arranged on the moving frame, the positioning mechanism is arranged on the supporting frame in a sliding mode, the guiding mechanisms are arranged in a plurality of modes and are all rotatably arranged on the working frame, the coating mechanism is arranged on the working frame, and the output end of the coating mechanism is arranged on the moving block. The utility model automatically coats the display screen with high efficiency.

title_en: Canvas gum dipping tank for quantitatively supplementing liquid
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a canvas dipping tank for quantitatively supplementing liquid, in particular to the technical field of dipping tanks, which comprises a tank body for dipping canvas, wherein a liquid supplementing tank is arranged above one side of the top of the tank body, the liquid replenishing box is fixed at the top of the tank body through the support, glue solution for canvas processing is stored in the liquid replenishing box and the tank body, a liquid discharge pipe is fixedly penetrated at the bottom of the liquid replenishing box, and the top of the liquid discharge pipe is communicated with the inside of the liquid replenishing box. According to the liquid level detection device, the liquid level of the glue solution in the tank body and the liquid supplementing box is detected in real time through the liquid level meter, when liquid supplementing is needed, the electric push rod is used for driving the piston to move downwards into the liquid draining pipe, meanwhile, the motor is used for driving the rotary rod and the connecting block to drive the sealing plate to turn over and open, the piston pushes the glue solution in the liquid draining pipe to flow into the tank body rapidly, quantitative liquid supplementing of the tank body is completed, after the liquid supplementing is finished, the piston and the sealing plate reset for next liquid supplementing, the structure is simple, manual operation is not needed, and time and labor are saved when the liquid level detection device is used.

title_en: Flame-retardant basketball liner
abstract_en: The utility model provides a flame-retardant basketball liner, which comprises a liner main body and a fixing ring, wherein the outer surface of the liner main body is fixedly connected with a flame-retardant layer, the outer surface of the flame-retardant layer is symmetrically provided with embedded grooves, heat-conducting wires are fixedly connected in the embedded grooves, the outer surface of the flame-retardant layer is symmetrically connected with the fixing ring, an object groove is formed in the fixing ring, a flame retardant is fixedly connected in the object groove, through holes are symmetrically formed in the surface of the fixing ring, and the outer surface of the fixing ring is fixedly connected with a sealing layer. According to the utility model, the flame retardant effect of the inner main body can be effectively enhanced through the matching of the flame retardant layer, the fixing ring and the flame retardant, and the problem of local overheating of the inner liner main body can be avoided through the matching of the heat conducting wires, so that the probability of deformation explosion of the inner liner main body is reduced.

title_en: Auxiliary chamber cylinder for single crystal furnace and crystal taking system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of single crystal furnaces and provides a secondary chamber barrel and a crystal taking system for a single crystal furnace, wherein the secondary chamber barrel comprises a barrel body and a positioning device, the positioning device comprises an adjusting bracket and a positioning lamp, the positioning lamp emits rays to the lower part of the barrel body, the incident angle of the rays meets the condition that the intersection point of the rays and a reference surface below the positioning lamp is positioned on the central axis of the barrel body, the height difference between the reference surface and the barrel body is a preset height, the adjusting bracket comprises a fixed part and a movable part, the fixed part is fixed on the barrel body, the movable part is movably connected to the fixed part, the positioning lamp is arranged on the movable part, and the incident angle of the rays of the positioning lamp can be adjusted when the positioning lamp moves along with the movable part relative to the fixed part. According to the scheme, the positioning lamp is utilized for positioning, the crystal taking vehicle can be subjected to position calibration at the unscrewing initial stage of the auxiliary chamber barrel, personnel can be far away from the crystal taking vehicle for single crystal descending operation, potential safety hazards caused by the fact that the operating personnel are close to the crystal bar for position adjustment of the crystal taking vehicle are avoided, and safety is higher.

title_en: Anode guide rod residual carbon block pressure disengaging device for aluminum electrolysis
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of offline devices, in particular to an anode rod anode scrap carbon block offline device for aluminum electrolysis, which comprises a base, wherein one side of the top end part of the base is longitudinally provided with a support, the top of the support is provided with a movable frame capable of moving, the lower end surface of the movable frame is symmetrically provided with a plurality of sliding grooves, the two sides of the upper end surface of the movable frame are symmetrically provided with third telescopic components, the output end of the third telescopic components is provided with auxiliary clamping plates for clamping an anode rod, the two sides of the inside of the support are symmetrically provided with clamping blocks capable of transversely moving to fix an anode rod steel fork, and one side of each clamping block is provided with a plurality of limiting grooves matched with a steel fork main body.

title_en: Coating head for edge anti-overflow glue type micro-concave coating machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a coating head for an edge anti-overflow adhesive type micro-concave coating machine, which relates to the technical field of coating machines and comprises a tank body, wherein a controller is fixedly arranged at one end of the tank body, a feeding pipe is fixedly connected to the top of the tank body, a valve is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the tank body, the bottom of the valve is fixedly connected with a coating head body, a pipeline is fixedly arranged at the periphery of the tank body at the bottom of the controller, and a temperature control part is arranged at one side of the tank body. The temperature control part is used for adjusting the water temperature of water before flowing into the pipeline, and the temperature control part and the temperature sensor are matched with each other, so that the temperature of the adhesive in the tank body can be adjusted according to the requirement, the phenomenon that the adhesive overflows due to the fact that the adhesive is too high in temperature and the adhesive overflows due to the fact that the adhesive is too high in fluidity is avoided, the flow speed of the adhesive flowing into the coating head can be controlled through the arrangement of the adjusting part, and the phenomenon that the adhesive overflows due to the fact that the flow speed of the adhesive is too high is avoided.

title_en: Unpowered self-control feeding device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unpowered self-control feeding device which comprises a feeding box, wherein the upper part of the feeding box is of a cylindrical structure, the lower part of the feeding box is of a conical structure, a discharge hole is formed in the bottom of the conical structure of the feeding box, a material valve assembly is arranged at the discharge hole, the diameters of the upper part and the lower part of the material valve assembly are both larger than the diameter of the discharge hole, the diameter of the middle part of the material valve assembly is smaller than the diameter of the discharge hole, and the material valve assembly can move up and down at the discharge hole. The feeding device disclosed by the utility model does not need power control or manual assistance, can complete feeding operation only by lifting the feeding box by the crown block, reduces the labor intensity of operation, eliminates the potential safety hazard of personnel falling aloft, is simple and convenient to operate and high in reliability, shortens the whole operation time by about 1/3, and improves the operation efficiency.

title_en: Wafer bearing device and semiconductor process equipment using same
abstract_en: The application provides a wafer bearing device and semiconductor process equipment using the same, wherein the wafer bearing device comprises a wafer tray, a base, a first supporting part and a charge releasing part, wherein a first through hole exposing the wafer tray is arranged in the base, the charge releasing part comprises a conductive front end, a second supporting component, a second power supply component and a second driving component, when a film deposition process is finished, the second driving component drives the second supporting component to enable the conductive front end to be in contact with the wafer tray through the first through hole, and the second power supply component neutralizes residual charges in the wafer through the conductive front end, so that the wafer is effectively prevented from being adsorbed on the wafer tray due to the existence of the residual charges, and is broken when the wafer is taken. The semiconductor process equipment comprises the wafer bearing device.

title_en: Tungsten wire rope stress release device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tungsten wire rope stress release device which comprises a plurality of roller group discs arranged along the length direction, wherein each roller group disc comprises a base, roller groups arranged on the base and an adjusting device used for adjusting the distance between the roller groups, and at least two roller group discs are arranged, and the planes of the two roller group discs which are required to be matched are mutually perpendicular. The vertical roller set disc is matched with the horizontal roller set disc, so that the wound tungsten wire rope is stressed when passing through the roller set, the internal stress of the tungsten wire rope is released through conversion into rotation of the roller set, and the distance of the rollers is adjusted by the adjusting device, so that the device is suitable for different diameter requirements of the tungsten wire rope.

title_en: Polymer template easy to demould
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a macromolecule template easy to demould, which comprises a first wear-resistant layer, wherein a separation structure is arranged at the bottom end of the first wear-resistant layer, the separation structure comprises a macromolecule membrane layer, a reinforcing layer and a core layer, the macromolecule membrane layer is arranged at the bottom end of the first wear-resistant layer, a heat insulation structure is arranged at the top end of a second flame-retardant plate, a first flame-retardant plate is arranged at the top end of the heat insulation structure, and a second wear-resistant layer is arranged at the top end of the first flame-retardant plate. According to the utility model, the first splicing block on one side of the plate surface is internally provided with the clamping block, the second splicing block on the other side of the plate surface is internally provided with the clamping groove, and the clamping block and the clamping groove form a clamping structure, so that the clamping block can be clamped with the clamping groove, when the clamping block of one template is contacted with the clamping groove of the other template, the two templates can be spliced, and the template can be quickly disassembled when not used, so that the utilization rate of the template is improved, and the aim of conveniently assembling the template by the polymer template easy to demould is fulfilled.

title_en: Easily-torn-off adhesive structure for tearing off round corner polarizer protective film
abstract_en: The easy-to-tear-off structure for tearing off the round corner polaroid protective film comprises an easy-to-tear-off structure and a display module, wherein the polaroid protective film is arranged on the display module, the display module is fixed and limited through an iron frame on a liquid crystal module, and the easy-to-tear-off structure is arranged on the display module. The round-corner polaroid protective film is torn and easily stuck, so that the structure of the easy-to-tear patch is improved by the characteristic that the round-corner polaroid protective film is relatively weak against corner stress of the polaroid, and the efficiency of tearing and sticking the protective film is remarkably improved in the operation process.

title_en: Iron handicraft processing spraying equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of iron artware processing and discloses iron artware processing spraying equipment which comprises a base, wherein side plates are fixedly assembled at the tops of the two sides of the base, a circular plate is rotatably connected to the inner wall of the side plate, an adjusting wheel is rotatably connected to the inner wall of the circular plate, and a clamping threaded rod is fixedly assembled on the side face of the adjusting wheel. Through the cooperation use of regulating wheel and centre gripping threaded rod, rotate the regulating wheel to utilize the regulating wheel to drive the centre gripping threaded rod and rotate, and then utilize the centre gripping threaded rod to drive urceolus and grip block removal, and then utilize the side of grip block to carry out the centre gripping to the side of iron article handicraft body, afterwards utilize driving motor to drive the plectane and rotate, thereby utilize the plectane to drive iron article handicraft body and rotate, rotate after the required spraying angle, close driving motor, and utilize the air pump to promote the round bar in the inner wall of fixed frame, thereby utilize the side of round bar and the inner wall of round groove group to dock spacing.

title_en: Steel wire rope hot galvanizing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a steel wire rope hot galvanizing device which comprises a galvanizing box, wherein a cooling box mounting plate is arranged on the upper side of the galvanizing box, a cooling box is arranged on the upper side of the cooling box mounting plate, a polishing box is arranged on one side of the cooling box, a lower supporting roller is arranged in the galvanizing box, an upper supporting roller is arranged in the cooling box, radiating pipes are arranged on the side face of the upper supporting roller, a steel wire rope enters the galvanizing box for galvanizing twice, and is cooled after the first galvanization, then enters the galvanizing box again for galvanization, the galvanization effect is better and more comprehensive, the problem of plating omission is avoided, the radiating pipes are arranged, the steel wire rope passes through the radiating pipes, the radiating effect is improved, in addition, a fan is matched, the radiating effect is better, and burrs formed by the galvanization can be removed by arranging the polishing box, and the quality of the galvanized steel wire rope is improved.

title_en: Cold stamping forming aluminum with good light shielding property
abstract_en: The utility model discloses cold stamping forming aluminum with good light shielding performance, which comprises forming aluminum, wherein the forming aluminum comprises a light shielding outer layer, a base material and an inner aluminum strip, a plurality of light shielding grooves are formed in the top of the light shielding outer layer, auxiliary wires are arranged in the middle of the inside of the forming aluminum, clamping grooves are formed in the middle of the inside of the forming aluminum, the inner aluminum strip is slidably clamped on the inner wall of the clamping grooves, an invagination groove is formed in the bottom of the inner aluminum strip, a light shielding core layer is arranged at the bottom of the light shielding outer layer, a blocking aluminum layer is integrally formed on the outer wall of the bottom of the light shielding core layer, an adhesive layer is adhered to the top of the base material, outer side layers are uniformly formed on the outer walls of the two sides of the base material, and the light shielding outer layer is provided with the light shielding grooves, so that light can be reflected, the penetration of external light can be reduced, after the inner aluminum strip is pulled out from the forming aluminum, the forming aluminum is bent through the auxiliary wires, and the light shielding structure can be changed by the forming aluminum.

title_en: Non-pure water solution electrolysis device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a non-pure water solution electrolysis device, and relates to the technical field of electrolytic hydrogen production. The device comprises an anode, a cathode, an ion exchange membrane and permeable membrane layers, wherein the ion exchange membrane is arranged between the anode and the cathode, the permeable membrane layers are arranged on one side of the anode, far away from the ion exchange membrane, and one side of the cathode catalytic layer, far away from the ion exchange membrane, respectively, are configured into electrolyte chambers between the anode and the corresponding adjacent permeable membrane layers and between the cathode and the corresponding adjacent permeable membrane layers, and one side of each permeable membrane layer, far away from the ion exchange membrane, is configured into a non-pure water solution chamber. According to the utility model, the concentration difference of the electrolyte and the non-pure water solution is utilized by adding the permeable membrane layer, so that water molecules can spontaneously pass through the permeable membrane layer and other macromolecules, impurities and the like can not pass through the permeable membrane layer, pure water is continuously supplemented for the electrolyte, the purpose of directly electrolyzing the non-pure water solution is realized, and the self-driven process is realized without any external electric power, so that the cost is lower.

title_en: Hot melt adhesive applying device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hot melt adhesive device, which comprises a main frame assembly, and comprises a workbench, wherein a bracket is arranged on the upper side of the workbench, a top plate is arranged on the upper side of the bracket, after the hot melt adhesive device is used for coating materials, mounting blocks are arranged on two sides of two ends of the upper side of a supporting plate, a movable plate on the front side of the mounting blocks is pushed forwards by a telescopic rod on the front side of the mounting blocks, and the scraper on the front side of the movable plate starts to scrape and clean hot melt adhesive remained on the surface of a glue spreader along with the continuous forward movement of the scraper to the position of the glue spreader, so that the hot melt adhesive which is not cleaned in time on the glue spreader is prevented from being solidified on the surface to influence the next glue spreading work.

title_en: Big end gluing machine for corrugated pipe
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of automobile part production, in particular to a corrugated pipe large end gluing machine which comprises a frame, a wavy object, a pushing cylinder, a connecting plate, a plurality of pushing plates, a displacement assembly, a clamping assembly, a mounting plate, a motor, a rotating head and a gluing assembly, wherein the wavy object is fixedly connected with the frame and is provided with a plurality of through holes, a first V-shaped groove and a second V-shaped groove, the pushing cylinder is arranged on the frame, the output and the connecting plate fixed connection of pushing away material cylinder, polylith push pedal all with connecting plate fixed connection, and polylith push pedal respectively with corresponding through-hole sliding connection, displacement subassembly sets up in the frame, clamping assembly installs on displacement subassembly, mounting panel and frame fixed connection, the motor is installed on the mounting panel, the output and the rotating head fixed connection of motor, the rubber coating subassembly sets up on the mounting panel to this mode has replaced artifical rubber coating, and has realized continuous rubber coating, has promoted production efficiency.

title_en: Water electrolysis hydrogen production system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water electrolysis hydrogen production system. The water electrolysis hydrogen production system comprises an electrolytic tank, an oxygen separation device connected with the electrolytic tank, and a gas storage device connected with the oxygen separation device, wherein the oxygen separation device is used for separating oxygen from a gas-liquid mixture and outputting the oxygen, so that the oxygen output by the oxygen separation device can flow into the gas storage device, and the output end of the gas storage device can be connected with at least one pneumatic device of the water electrolysis hydrogen production system. According to the water electrolysis hydrogen production system provided by the embodiment of the utility model, when the water electrolysis hydrogen production system stably operates, the oxygen separation device can stably output oxygen, and the pneumatic equipment can be ensured to be supplied with a stable pneumatic air source, so that the dependence on the pneumatic air source generated by the air compressor is reduced, the electric energy consumption caused by continuously starting the air compressor is reduced, the oxygen output by the oxygen separation device is reused, and the economy is improved.

title_en: Package packing type large-size silicon single crystal growth furnace cooling device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cooling device of a sleeved large-size silicon single crystal growing furnace, which belongs to the technical field of silicon single crystal growing furnaces and adopts the technical scheme that the cooling device comprises a silicon single crystal growing furnace body, wherein a cooling mechanism is arranged on the surface of the silicon single crystal growing furnace body, a bottom plate is fixedly connected to the bottom of the silicon single crystal growing furnace body, a water storage ring is fixedly sleeved on the surface of the silicon single crystal growing furnace body, the cooling mechanism comprises a ring pipe, a water injection pipe and an annular drain pipe, the ring pipe is movably sleeved on the surface of the silicon single crystal growing furnace body, the problems that most of the existing sleeved large-size silicon single crystal growing furnaces only have an internal circulating water cooling structure, the surface of the furnace body is not provided with a cooling structure, the cooling efficiency of the furnace body is low, and workers can easily mistakenly touch the surface of the furnace body to cause scalding accidents when carrying out other related works outside the furnace body, so that a certain potential safety hazard exists, and the using effect is affected are solved.

title_en: Gluing device convenient to adjust
abstract_en: The utility model provides a glue spreading device convenient to adjust, which comprises a frame, a glue spreading mechanism, a glue feeding mechanism and an adjusting mechanism, wherein the glue spreading mechanism is arranged on the frame and comprises an upper glue spreading roller and a lower glue spreading roller which are rotatably arranged on the frame, the glue feeding mechanism is arranged on the frame and is used for feeding glue for the upper glue spreading roller and the lower glue spreading roller, and the adjusting mechanism comprises a transmission mechanism arranged at two ends of the upper glue spreading roller, a driving mechanism used for driving the transmission mechanism and a connecting rod with the driving mechanisms at two ends respectively. According to the utility model, the upper glue spreading roller is arranged in a mode of adjusting the distance between the upper glue spreading roller and the lower glue spreading roller, so that the refitting device can adapt to raw materials with more sizes to meet different production and processing requirements.

title_en: Long service life's compound plastics polyethylene metal warning area
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of metal warning belts and provides a composite plastic polyethylene metal warning belt with long service life, which comprises a first anti-corrosion layer, wherein the top of the first anti-corrosion layer is fixedly connected with a reinforcing layer, the top of the reinforcing layer is fixedly connected with a rebound layer, the top of the rebound layer is fixedly connected with a tensile layer, the top of the tensile layer is fixedly connected with a stabilizing layer, a plurality of detection wires are fixedly embedded in the stabilizing layer, the top of the stabilizing layer is fixedly connected with a second anti-corrosion layer, two wedge grooves are formed in the second anti-corrosion layer, wedge strips are arranged in the wedge grooves, and the top of the wedge strips is fixedly connected with easy-to-display strips. The device is provided with the copper wire detection structure, so that the warning belt has detectability, can monitor the distance from an embedded object to the ground after being embedded into the ground, has warning property for devices below the ground, is not easy to corrode in the ground, and can be used for a long time.

title_en: Threaded ceramic roller
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a threaded ceramic roller, and relates to the field of threaded ceramic roller devices. The threaded ceramic roller comprises a roller body, wherein a threaded sleeve is arranged on the peripheral wall of the roller body, the roller body is separated from the threaded sleeve, a limiting cylinder is mounted on one side outer wall of the roller body in a limiting mode, a first limiting part and a second limiting part are respectively arranged on two side outer walls of the limiting cylinder, and the first limiting part and the second limiting part are used for limiting the mounted limiting cylinder and the threaded sleeve respectively. This screw thread pottery roller is through constituteing screw thread club by club main part and screw thread sleeve to set up club main part and screw thread sleeve into the disconnect-type, in long-time use, be convenient for the purpose of changing it to the screw thread sleeve of damage, and then can improve the utilization ratio to club main part, simultaneously, under the cooperation of the power of spacing section of thick bamboo, installation section of thick bamboo and two sets of locating parts, be convenient for install the work of back locking to screw thread sleeve.

title_en: Extrusion die head structure of coating machine
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of coating machines, and provides an extrusion die head structure of a coating machine. Comprises a supporting seat, a first adjusting component, a second adjusting component and a die head body. The first adjusting component comprises a sliding table cylinder arranged on the supporting seat and a sliding bottom plate connected to the output end of the sliding table cylinder and capable of being driven by the sliding table cylinder, a linear rail with the extending direction perpendicular to the output direction of the sliding table cylinder is formed on the sliding bottom plate, the second adjusting component comprises a die head mounting plate connected to the linear rail in a sliding mode, a nut seat connected to the die head mounting plate and a screw rod connected to the nut seat in a threaded mode and parallel to the linear rail, and the die head body is connected to the die head mounting plate and forms a feeding hole connected with a glue supply pump and a discharging hole parallel to the output direction of the sliding table cylinder.

title_en: Double-sided light-heavy peeling force release film
