abstract_en: The utility model discloses a double-sided light-weight stripping force release film, which relates to the technical field of release films and comprises a double-sided release film body, a polyvinyl alcohol layer, a cellulose acetate layer, a hydrophobic and oleophobic layer and a PET substrate layer, wherein the polyvinyl alcohol layer is paved at the bottom of the double-sided release film body, the cellulose acetate layer is paved at the top of the double-sided release film body, the PET substrate layer is paved at the bottom of the cellulose acetate layer, an adhesive layer is paved at the bottom of the PET substrate layer, and a plurality of silica microsphere particles are arranged between the PET substrate layer and the adhesive layer.

title_en: Edge gluing and pasting equipment for composite drum paper
abstract_en: The utility model discloses edge gluing and pasting equipment for composite drum paper, which comprises a supporting main body with supporting legs, wherein the upper end surface of the supporting main body is rotatably connected with a supporting turntable, a gluing mechanism is arranged at the top of the supporting turntable, the lower end surface of the gluing mechanism is fixedly connected with the upper end surface of the supporting main body, the supporting turntable comprises a plurality of groups of connecting rods, the upper end surface of each connecting rod is provided with a sliding groove, a bearing assembly is slidably connected in each sliding groove, an adjusting assembly is connected with the top of each center seat in a threaded manner, and the adjusting assembly rotatably pushes the bearing assembly to slide in each sliding groove. According to the utility model, the glue spreading mechanism is arranged to adjust the glue wheel in the horizontal direction and the vertical direction, and the distance between each group of support bowls and the center seat is adjusted and fixed according to the size change in the preparation process of the composite drum paper, so that the stability in glue spreading is improved, and the rejection rate is reduced.

title_en: Cloth front and back coating equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cloth front and back coating device which is used for simultaneously depositing and coating on the front and back surfaces of cloth and comprises a coating device, a power supply, a pre-tightening device and a traction device, wherein the coating device comprises two PECVD mechanisms which are symmetrically arranged up and down, a deposition cavity for depositing and coating on the cloth is formed between the two PECVD mechanisms, the deposition cavity is provided with a through hole for the cloth to pass through, the power supply is respectively and correspondingly electrically connected with the two PECVD mechanisms and is used for ionizing process gas, the pre-tightening device is arranged in the coating device and provides pre-tightening tension for the transmission of the cloth in the process of coating on the whole deposition, and the traction device is arranged behind the coating device and provides traction power for the transmission of the cloth in the process of coating on the whole deposition. According to the utility model, through the cooperation of the components, a stable and uniform coating layer can be formed on the front side and the back side of the cloth, so that the cloth with the coating on the front side and the back side is formed.

title_en: Three-layer co-extrusion type cable intermediate joint
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cable connectors and discloses a three-layer co-extrusion type cable middle connector, wherein a second connector is arranged on the right side of a first connector, the left side of the second connector is in contact with the right side of the first connector, a fixing mechanism is arranged at the top of the first connector and comprises a threaded rod, the threaded rod is rotationally connected to the inner top of the first connector, a rotating disc is fixedly connected to the left side of the threaded rod, a supporting piece is fixedly connected to the right side of the rotating disc, a thread block is connected to the periphery of the threaded rod in a threaded manner, an arc-shaped plate is fixedly connected to the left side of the top of the thread block, a rotating plate is rotationally connected to the inner side of the arc-shaped plate, and an arc-shaped telescopic rod is fixedly connected to the bottom of the rotating plate. Through the flame retardant coating and the insulating layer that set up, make first joint with the second connect prevent fires with creep resistance, the influence of withstand potential stress, electrically conductive compensation performance to and the heat conductivity effect is better, through the wearing layer that sets up, make first joint with the wearing effect of second connect better, increase first joint and second joint life.

title_en: Four-side stretch fabric
abstract_en: The utility model provides a tetrahedral elastic fabric, which belongs to the technical field of textile fabrics and comprises an upper layer and a lower layer, wherein the upper layer is a tetrahedral elastic fabric layer knitted by hydrophilic wear-resistant composite yarns, the lower layer is a tetrahedral elastic fabric layer knitted by hydrophobic skin-friendly composite yarns, the fabric comprises the upper layer and the lower layer, the upper layer is knitted by hydrophilic wear-resistant composite yarns and has good hydrophilicity and wear resistance, the lower layer is knitted by hydrophobic skin-friendly composite yarns and has hydrophobicity and skin-friendly properties, the upper layer and the lower layer are respectively in hydrophilic and hydrophobic states, sweat generated by human skin can be rapidly guided to the upper layer of the fabric, the fabric has excellent moisture absorption and sweat discharge capacity, the skin of a human body can be kept dry, meanwhile, the upper layer is wear-resistant, the durability of the garment can be improved as an outer layer, the lower layer is skin-friendly, and the skin-friendly comfort of the garment can be improved as an inner layer.

title_en: High-temperature-resistant electric melting sleeve
abstract_en: The utility model provides a high-temperature-resistant electric melting sleeve which comprises an electric melting sleeve main body, wherein two ends of the electric melting sleeve main body are symmetrically connected with reinforcing strips, two sides of the outer surface of the electric melting sleeve main body are symmetrically connected with positioning rings, the electric melting sleeve main body consists of a hot melting layer, an electric melting net, a heat-resistant layer and a heat insulation layer, the outer surface of the hot melting layer is fixedly connected with the electric melting net through a heat conduction layer, the outer surface of the electric melting net is fixedly connected with the heat-resistant layer, the end face of the electric melting net is fixedly connected with copper wires, the outer surface of the heat-resistant layer is fixedly connected with the heat insulation layer, and the outer surface of the heat insulation layer is fixedly connected with a wear-resistant layer through a reinforcing layer. According to the utility model, the heat conducting layer, the heat-resistant layer and the heat insulating layer are matched, so that the electric melting sleeve main body has a good high-temperature resistant structure, the fault tolerance during operation can be effectively improved, and the damage probability of the electric melting sleeve main body is reduced.

title_en: Mold frame base oil coating equipment
abstract_en: The mold frame base oil coating equipment comprises a transmission device, an oiling device and an oil supply device, wherein the oil supply device is connected to the transmission device and used for supplying oil to an oiling part of the oiling device, a linear module is arranged side by side with the transmission device, the sliding direction of a sliding part of the linear module is consistent with the transmission direction of the transmission device, the oiling device comprises a support frame, a first lifting cylinder and an oiling component, the lower end of the support frame is fixedly connected to the sliding part of the linear module, the sliding part is used for driving the support frame to move along the transmission direction of the transmission device, the first lifting cylinder is fixedly connected to the top of the support frame, and the oiling component is connected to the telescopic end of the first lifting cylinder. The automatic oiling device has the advantages that the whole structure is simple, oiling rollers of different model specifications can be conveniently installed according to different mold frames, and meanwhile, oil taking and automatic oiling of the mold frames are automatically realized.

title_en: Badminton coloring machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a badminton coloring machine, which belongs to the technical field of badminton processing, and comprises a processing table, wherein a circulating guide rail is arranged at the top of the processing table, a moving block is arranged at the bottom of the circulating guide rail, an adsorption groove is formed at the bottom of the moving block, a dye box is fixedly arranged inside one side of the processing table, a plurality of first diversion hoppers are arranged at the top of the dye box, a second electric push rod is fixedly arranged at the bottom end inside the first diversion hoppers, an annular communicating pipe is arranged at the top of the second electric push rod, an outer spray head is arranged at the periphery of the annular communicating pipe, an inner spray head is fixedly arranged at the inner side of the annular communicating pipe, the outer spray head and the inner spray head are matched with the annular communicating pipe to realize the function of synchronously coloring the periphery and the inner wall of a badminton, the processing efficiency of the badminton is greatly improved, the outer baffle and the inner baffle are utilized to block dye spraying, the dye is prevented from splashing to the surface of a ball holder in the spraying process, the aesthetic property of the badminton after coloring is reduced, and the stability of the coloring effect is ensured.

title_en: Workpiece surface rust removing device with turnover structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a workpiece surface rust removing device with a turnover structure, which comprises a pickling tank, wherein a first speed reducing motor is arranged on one side of the pickling tank through a connecting plate and a screw, a second speed reducing motor is arranged on the other side of the pickling tank through a first L-shaped mounting plate and a screw, the output end of the second speed reducing motor is connected with a driving gear, a driven gear is arranged on one side of the second speed reducing motor, the driving gear is in meshed connection with the driven gear, a workpiece is arranged in the pickling tank, and a first mounting plate and a second mounting plate are respectively arranged on the inner side of the pickling tank and on two sides of the workpiece. The novel workpiece surface rust removal device has a structure for clamping the workpiece and turning the workpiece, and can enable the acid liquor to fully contact each part of the workpiece surface, so that the rust removal effect is effectively improved, and the novel workpiece surface rust removal device is suitable for being widely popularized and used.

title_en: Anti-carbonization structure of hot melt adhesive machine melt adhesive groove
abstract_en: The utility model provides an anti-carbonization structure of a hot melt adhesive machine melt adhesive groove, which relates to the technical field of anti-carbonization structures and comprises a machine body, wherein the melt adhesive groove is fixedly arranged in the machine body, an electric heating rod is arranged at the bottom end of the melt adhesive groove, a water inlet pipe is fixedly arranged at the rear end of the machine body, a discharge pipe is fixedly arranged at one end of the machine body, a motor is fixedly arranged at the other end of the machine body, and a rotating rod is fixedly arranged at the output end of the motor. According to the utility model, through the structures of the machine body, the melt adhesive tank, the electric heating rod, the water inlet pipe, the discharging pipe, the motor, the rotating rod, the first belt pulley, the top cover, the stirring rod, the placing groove and the like, the cleaning agent, the scraping plate and the nozzle are arranged, after the equipment is used, the stirring rod, the scraping plate and the nozzle are driven by the motor to move, so that the inner wall of the melt adhesive tank and the residual melt adhesive in the melt adhesive tank can be cleaned, carbonization is prevented, meanwhile, the equipment parts are prevented from being aged and damaged in a high-temperature environment for a long time, and the service life of the hot melt adhesive machine is prolonged.

title_en: Priming paint brushing device for production of anti-corrosion pipeline
abstract_en: The utility model provides a primer brushing device for producing an anti-corrosion pipeline, and belongs to the technical field of production of anti-corrosion pipelines. This kind of anticorrosive pipeline production's priming paint brush device, which comprises a main body, wiper mechanism and spraying mechanism, the main body includes the box, the collecting vessel is installed to inside one side of box, wiper mechanism includes the mounting bracket, the mounting bracket sets up in upper end one side of box, the up end center department of mounting bracket inlays and establishes and install the cleaning cylinder, the inside rotation of cleaning cylinder is connected with the fluted disc, electric telescopic handle is all installed to the inside both sides of fluted disc, the sand cardboard is all installed to electric telescopic handle's one end, the dust catcher is installed to upper end one side of mounting bracket, the input pot cover of dust catcher is equipped with the dust absorption pipe, and the dust absorption pipe bottom runs through the cleaning cylinder and extends to inside, the collecting box is installed to the bottom of cleaning cylinder, the feed opening has all been seted up to the bottom both sides of cleaning cylinder, this utility model, can effectively improve anticorrosive pipeline production's priming paint brush device's practicality, higher practical value has.

title_en: Passive system door
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a passive system door, which comprises a door frame and a door leaf, wherein the door frame comprises a side frame and an upper frame, the door leaf is hinged on one side frame of the door leaf, the door leaf comprises a main frame shell, a front panel and a rear panel of the main frame shell, an echo decompression layer and two layers of heat insulation and sound insulation cotton are arranged between the front panel and the rear panel, the inside of the edge of the main frame shell, and the door frame is internally provided with a sound insulation and heat insulation structure.

title_en: TPU hot melt film with multilayer structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a TPU (thermoplastic polyurethane) hot melt film with a multilayer structure, which relates to the technical field of TPU hot melt films and comprises a TPU composite layer, wherein a first elastic enhancement layer is arranged on the upper top surface of the TPU composite layer, an outer protection layer is arranged on the upper top surface of the first elastic enhancement layer, a second elastic enhancement layer is arranged on the lower bottom surface of the TPU composite layer, and an inner protection layer is arranged on the lower bottom surface of the second elastic enhancement layer.

title_en: Pressing and holding rotary tool
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pressing and rotating tool which comprises an air cylinder assembly, a pressing and holding arm and a pressure plate assembly, wherein the air cylinder assembly comprises a rotating shaft and a piston, a groove is formed in the wall surface of the rotating shaft, the piston is suitable for driving the rotating shaft to move along the groove under the driving of air pressure, one end of the pressing and holding arm is connected with the rotating shaft so as to drive the pressing and holding arm to synchronously move in a straight line or rotate through the rotating shaft, the pressure plate assembly is connected with the other end of the pressing and holding arm, the pressure plate assembly comprises a pressure plate, and the pressure plate is suitable for pressing and holding a product and rotates along with the product. According to the utility model, the piston is driven by air pressure, the piston is used for pushing the rotating shaft to linearly and rotationally displace, the possibility that the pressing arm stays at the original position and is easy to interfere with other structural members is avoided, in addition, the pressing arm is connected with the rotating shaft, and the linear motion and the rotary motion of the rotating shaft are integrally combined, so that two actions are completed by one air cylinder, and the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Electroplating clamp
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of electroplating clamps, in particular to an electroplating clamp which comprises a fixed clamp arm, wherein a movable clamp arm is vertically and movably connected to the fixed clamp arm, the bottom side of the fixed clamp arm is upwards bent to be in a horizontal state, a first lug is arranged on the fixed clamp arm, the first lug is in a convex arc shape with high middle and low two sides, the bottom side of the movable clamp arm is upwards bent to be in a horizontal state, a second lug matched with the first lug is arranged on the movable clamp arm, the second lug is in a concave arc shape with high middle and low two sides, a first silica gel sleeve is sleeved at the bottom end of the fixed clamp arm, and a second silica gel sleeve is sleeved at the bottom end of the movable clamp arm.

title_en: Internal winding type double-sided extrusion coating machine
abstract_en: The application discloses an internally-wound double-sided extrusion coating machine, which relates to the technical field of battery coating and comprises an unreeling coating device, a drying device and a reeling coating device which are sequentially arranged, wherein the unreeling coating device comprises an unreeling device and a first surface coating device, the drying device comprises a lower layer oven and an upper layer oven arranged above the lower layer oven, one side of the upper layer oven is provided with an upper layer turning-back device, one side of the lower layer oven is provided with a lower layer turning-back device, the reeling coating device comprises a reeling device and a second surface coating device, and a substrate released by the unreeling device is reeled by the reeling device after sequentially passing through the first surface coating device, the upper layer oven, the upper layer turning-back device, the upper layer oven, the second surface coating device, the lower layer oven, the lower layer turning-back device and the lower layer oven. The coating efficiency is improved, the occupation of the length of a factory building is reduced, and the convenience of material transfer is improved.

title_en: Wear-resistant rubber roller for steel mill
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wear-resistant rubber roller for a steel mill, and relates to the technical field of rubber rollers. The utility model comprises a rubber roller core and a fixing component, wherein the rubber roller core is formed by sliding and sleeving two groups of buffer round shells. According to the utility model, the rubber roller core, the fixing groove and the fixing assembly are arranged, the connecting column is inserted into the rubber roller core, then the connecting block is aligned with the fixing groove, the nut is matched in a rotating way, so that the nut drives the sliding sleeve rod to move, the linkage block is driven to move, the rotating shaft slides in the straight groove opening, the supporting plate drives the sliding rod to slide along the connecting block, one end of the sliding rod is inserted into the fixing groove, the rubber roller is fixed on the connecting column, the rubber roller is mounted, and meanwhile, the nut is matched in a reversing way, so that the clamping restriction of the sliding rod and the fixing groove can be relieved, the rubber roller is convenient to detach, the mounting and detaching efficiency of the rubber roller is improved, and the wear resistance of the rubber roller is improved through the arrangement of the wear-resistant rubber sleeve, the sand spraying layer, the compression layer, the adhesive layer and the short fiber rubber layer.

title_en: Suede leather coating device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a suede leather coating device which comprises a box body, a guide roller, a baffle, a spraying mechanism, an extruding mechanism and a drying mechanism, wherein a feed inlet and a discharge outlet are respectively formed in two ends of the box body, the guide roller is rotatably arranged at the positions of the feed inlet and the discharge outlet in the box body, the baffle is fixed in the box body, the upper side surface of the baffle is an inclined surface, two extruding mechanisms are fixed on the upper side surface of the inner part of the box body, the spraying mechanism is fixed in the inner part of the box body, two output ends of the spraying mechanism are arranged on the front side of the corresponding extruding mechanism, and the drying mechanism is fixed at the position, close to the discharge outlet, in the box body. The extrusion mechanism and the drying mechanism are arranged, so that the adhesion degree of the coating to the suede leather can be improved, and pollution and blockage of the gas transmission pipe caused by the coating dripped on the suede leather can be avoided in the process of drying the suede leather.

title_en: Air pipe plate veneering and pressing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of air duct plate processing, in particular to an air duct plate veneering pressing device, which comprises a sliding groove, wherein the sliding groove is formed in the surface of a T-shaped seat, two L-shaped plates are connected in a sliding manner in the sliding groove, a clamping plate is fixedly arranged at one end of the L-shaped plate, which is far away from the sliding groove, the surface of the T-shaped seat is provided with a groove, two sliding blocks are connected in the groove in a sliding manner, a connecting rod is fixedly arranged between the sliding blocks and the clamping plate, a strip-shaped groove is formed in the surface of the T-shaped seat, a displacement block is connected in the strip-shaped groove in a sliding manner, two hinge plates are hinged to the surface of the displacement block, a supporting plate is fixedly arranged on the surface of the T-shaped seat, and an electric telescopic rod is fixedly arranged on the surface of the supporting plate. The utility model solves the problem that the existing air duct plate veneering pressing device lacks a limiting fixing device, so that the air duct plate is easy to displace on a supporting plate in the pressing process of the pressing device on the air duct plate.

title_en: Automatic medicament adding device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic medicament adding device which comprises a water tank and a measuring cup which are arranged on a frame body, wherein a first liquid level sensor is arranged in the measuring cup, one end of a first liquid suction pipe on a first pump body is positioned in the water tank, one end of a first liquid discharge pipe on the first pump body is communicated with the measuring cup, one end of a second liquid suction pipe on a second pump body is communicated with the bottom of the measuring cup, one end of the second liquid discharge pipe on the second pump body is used for being connected with a working groove, and a control box is connected with the first liquid level sensor, the first pump body and the second pump body in a circuit mode. According to the utility model, the first pump body communicated with the water tank and the measuring cup is arranged on the frame body, the first pump body is controlled to pump the medicament into the measuring cup through the first liquid level sensor in the measuring cup, and then the medicament is pumped into the working groove through the second pump body, so that automatic medicament addition in a timed and quantitative manner can be realized, the uniformity and the timeliness of medicament addition are ensured, and the control of the production quality is facilitated.

title_en: High-carbon chromium bearing steel wire continuous phosphating device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of steel wire phosphating and discloses a high-carbon chromium bearing steel wire continuous phosphating device which comprises a phosphating tank, wherein a support is arranged on the side wall of the phosphating tank, a godet wheel is arranged on the side wall of the support, a lifting column is arranged on the rear side of the phosphating tank, a top plate is arranged at the top of the lifting column, a vertical plate is fixedly connected to the bottom of the top plate, and a soaking wheel is arranged on the side wall of the vertical plate.

title_en: Device for preventing anodic oxidation at blanking point of aluminum electrolysis production
abstract_en: The utility model provides a device for preventing anodic oxidation at a blanking point of aluminum electrolysis production, and relates to the technical field of aluminum electrolysis. The utility model provides a device that aluminium electroloysis production unloading point prevented anodic oxidation includes the trunk, the one end of trunk is connected with the handle, the other end of trunk is connected with the baffle, still be connected with the support on the trunk, the support with the baffle is located the same side of trunk, the baffle includes extension board I and extension board I I, extension board I with the contained angle of extension board I I is 120. The method can prevent anodic oxidation, prolong the service life of the anode, ensure the quality of raw aluminum, reduce the production cost and lighten the labor intensity.

title_en: Chitosan non-woven fabric production system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a chitosan non-woven fabric production system. The system comprises a gauze discharging device, a feeding device and a compounding device, wherein the gauze discharging device is arranged on one side of the feeding device, the compounding device is arranged on the other side of the feeding device, the gauze discharging device comprises a gauze discharging roller, a traction roller is arranged on one side of the gauze discharging roller, a stripping roller is arranged below the traction roller, the feeding device comprises a feed box, a first limit roller is arranged in the feed box, the compounding device comprises a compounding roller, a film covering roller is arranged below the compounding roller, and a receiving roller is arranged on one side of the compounding roller. According to the utility model, the loading capacity of the non-woven fabric base material to chitosan particles can be improved, and the three-dimensional loading mode can be more fully contacted with wound blood when the non-woven fabric base material is used.

title_en: Endoscope optical window rubberizing protection casing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of endoscope optical windows and discloses an endoscope optical window rubberizing protective cover which comprises an inner lens end seat, wherein a protective cover main body is arranged on the outer wall of the upper end of the inner lens end seat, a plurality of groups of annular rubberizing grooves are formed in the upper side surface of the protective cover main body, optical window glass and protective glass are arranged at the upper end of the inner lens end seat, the annular rubberizing grooves correspond to the positions of the optical window glass and the protective glass, after glue is only dripped into the annular rubberizing grooves by workers, the glue flows into the periphery of the optical window glass and the protective glass from the slope of the annular rubberizing grooves, a novice can perform rubberizing operation, after rubberizing is finished, the protective cover main body is gently pulled out upwards, the glue in the protective cover main body groove can be continuously reused after being wiped, and the illumination and imaging quality of the optical window glass surface can be guaranteed.

title_en: Low temperature resistant PVC film
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of PVC films, and discloses a low-temperature-resistant PVC film, wherein clamping grooves are formed in the top ends of two positioning frames, mounting plates are inserted into the inner walls of the clamping grooves, bolts are mounted on the inner walls of the two sides of the mounting plates, the bottom ends of the bolts are connected onto the inner walls of the bottoms of the clamping grooves in a threaded manner, rotating blocks are connected onto the inner walls of the mounting plates in a threaded manner, and limiting frames are mounted at the bottom ends of the rotating blocks. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the winding drum, the rotating block and the limiting frame, the rotating block in the mounting plate drives the limiting frame to move downwards to press the low-temperature-resistant PVC film on the winding drum, the two ends of the limiting frame are matched with the two sides of the winding drum, the two sides of the low-temperature-resistant PVC film can be effectively fixed, when the low-temperature-resistant PVC film on one side is fixed on the winding drum, the low-temperature-resistant PVC film on the other winding drum is influenced and fixed, and the structure can be adapted to the low-temperature-resistant PVC films with different thicknesses, so that the flexibility of the device is improved.

title_en: Chlorine-containing hydrochloric acid tail gas byproduct sodium hypochlorite system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of sodium hypochlorite preparation, in particular to a chlorine-containing hydrochloric acid tail gas byproduct sodium hypochlorite system which comprises a salt dissolving mechanism, a storage mechanism, a reaction mechanism, a feeding mechanism and a control mechanism, wherein the control mechanism is fixedly connected with the salt dissolving mechanism, the reaction mechanism is fixedly connected with the salt dissolving mechanism, the storage mechanism is fixedly connected with the salt dissolving mechanism, the feeding mechanism comprises a mounting frame, a feeding pipe and an electromagnetic valve, the currently arranged electromagnetic valve can be controlled in advance according to the requirements of users and actual production, and the opening and closing of the valve in the feeding pipe can be adjusted, so that the speed of entering the pretreatment device by tail gas and the stop of entering the tail gas are controlled.

title_en: Water quenching equipment temperature regulating device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a temperature regulating device of water quenching equipment, which comprises a temperature regulating interlayer, a reducing furnace, a heat exchanger, a cold flow inlet pipe, a flow outlet pipe and a reducing furnace, wherein the temperature regulating interlayer is provided with a first heat flow inlet, a first cold flow inlet and a first cold flow outlet, the heat exchanger is provided with a second heat flow inlet, a second cold flow inlet, a heat flow outlet and a cold flow outlet, the cold flow inlet pipe is connected with the first cold flow inlet, the flow outlet pipe is connected with the outlet pipe, the temperature regulating interlayer is positioned between the wall surface of the water quenching equipment and the wall of a silicon material conveying channel, the second heat flow inlet is connected with the reducing furnace, the heat flow outlet is connected with the first heat flow inlet, high-temperature circulating water in the reducing furnace is discharged into the temperature regulating interlayer after being cooled by the heat exchanger, so as to keep the temperature of the water quenching equipment in the reducing furnace at the time of stopping the furnace, the heating time of the water quenching equipment is shortened, the electric power cost is reduced, the heat recycling of the reducing furnace is realized, and when the equipment needs to be overhauled or maintained, low-temperature is discharged into the temperature regulating interlayer, the temperature reducing equipment is accelerated, and the use ratio of the equipment is improved.

title_en: Antifouling paint dip-coating device of nuclear power dirt blocking net
abstract_en: The utility model provides a device for dip-coating anti-fouling paint of a nuclear power dirt blocking net, which comprises a bearing rail, a soaking device, a recovery device and a traction device, wherein the bearing rail is used for bearing the dirt blocking net and comprises a plurality of bearing rollers which are arranged at intervals along the length direction of the bearing rail and can rotate, the bearing rail comprises a first rail and a second rail, the soaking device comprises a soaking tank arranged between the first rail and the second rail, a guide roller is arranged in the soaking tank, the recovery device comprises a recovery tank positioned below the second rail, and the traction device is used for pulling the dirt blocking net to move on the bearing rail.

title_en: Precise cladding device for outer wall of cylinder piston rod
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a precise cladding device for the outer wall of an oil cylinder piston rod, which comprises a fixed frame, wherein the inner end of the fixed frame is fixedly connected with a first support frame, the interior of the first support frame is in rolling connection with a roller, the outer end of the first support frame is provided with a material pipe, the material pipe penetrates through the first support frame and moves along one end of the roller, the outer end of the material pipe is fixedly connected with a moving block, the interior of the first support frame is provided with a moving block guide rail, the moving block moves along the moving block guide rail, a sliding groove is arranged in a machine body, a screw rod and the moving frame are used for positioning and fixing the oil cylinder piston rod, precise cladding can be performed on the outer wall of the oil cylinder piston rod with different lengths, meanwhile, the other end of the machine body is fixedly connected with a fixed cone rod, and the rocking rocker is used for pushing the fixed plug rod to axially move towards the oil cylinder piston rod so as to clamp the oil cylinder piston rod, and stability of the oil cylinder piston rod is ensured.

title_en: Electrode cooling assembly for PVD coating equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electrode cooling assembly for PVD coating equipment, which comprises a mounting box, wherein a cooling fan is fixedly arranged on one side of the mounting box, a gas reversing box is fixedly connected to one side of the cooling fan, and an L-shaped sliding bar is connected to one side of the inner wall of the gas reversing box in a sliding manner. According to the utility model, the cooling fan is started, the driving gear drives the driven gear to rotate, the pulling rod is pushed by the pulling rod to enable the L-shaped sliding bar to slide on the inner wall of the gas reversing box, when the pulling rod slides away from the pulling rod, the L-shaped sliding bar is reversely pushed by the reaction force of the reset spring, the L-shaped sliding bar slides back and forth on the inner wall of the gas reversing box, the L-shaped sliding bar slides and simultaneously pulls the pulling block to rotate the reversing blade, the direction of wind blown by the cooling fan is changed, high-efficiency heat dissipation is carried out on the evaporation source electrode in the mounting box, and the service life of the evaporation source electrode is prolonged.

title_en: Surface treatment device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a surface treatment device which comprises a conveying loop, a preheating furnace, a spraying mechanism, a polishing mechanism and a base, wherein the conveying loop is paved on the base, one end of the conveying loop penetrates through the preheating furnace, the spraying mechanism is arranged at positions adjacent to a discharge hole of the preheating furnace and positioned at two sides of the conveying loop, and the polishing mechanism is arranged at positions adjacent to a discharge end of the spraying mechanism and positioned at two sides of the conveying loop. The problem of inefficiency has been solved effectively, through setting up semi-automatic conveying return circuit, only needs the manual work to place the work piece, alright automatic all processing steps that realize the work piece at the device, easy operation has improved work efficiency.

title_en: Cloth bonding compounding machine with heating and instant cooling
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cloth bonding compounding machine with heating and instant cooling, which comprises a compounding machine body, wherein a motor is fixedly arranged on one side of the compounding machine body, an output shaft of the motor is fixedly provided with a rotating shaft which penetrates through and extends into the compounding machine body, a cooling mechanism is arranged in the compounding machine body and comprises a fixed shaft, a cooling roller, a belt pulley group and a gear, one side of the compounding machine body is rotatably connected with two fixed shafts, the fixed shafts penetrate through the outside of the compounding machine body, and the outer rings of the two fixed shafts positioned in the compounding machine body are fixedly provided with the cooling roller. Through the structure mutually supporting such as cooling body, motor and pivot, can drive two chill rolls and rotate when two fixed axles rotate, can carry out cooling treatment to the cloth after the heating bonding, can carry out mutual roll extrusion flattening to its surface simultaneously, avoid it to appear the fold phenomenon when the cooling, and improve its quality.

title_en: Spray plate leveling mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of vacuum coating equipment and discloses a spray plate leveling mechanism which comprises a connecting plate, a mounting plate, a plurality of adjusting screws, a spray plate and a connecting shaft, wherein the adjusting screws are uniformly distributed around the axis of the mounting plate, the bottoms of the adjusting screws are propped against the connecting plate, the tops of the adjusting screws penetrate through the mounting plate and are in threaded connection with the mounting plate, locking nuts are sleeved on the adjusting screws, the plurality of guide posts are uniformly distributed around the axis of the mounting plate, the bottoms of the guide posts are connected with the connecting plate, the tops of the guide posts penetrate through the mounting plate and are in sliding connection with the mounting plate, scales are arranged on the outer walls of the guide posts along the axial direction, the bottoms of the connecting shafts penetrate through the connecting plate and extend to the lower portion of the connecting plate, and the spray plate is fixedly connected with the bottoms of the connecting shafts. The leveling device has the beneficial effects of simplifying the structure, reducing the production cost, synchronously adjusting the levelness and the height of the spray disc, easily judging the leveling position of the spray disc and improving the leveling precision.

title_en: Cathode dust cover of film coater
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of auxiliary equipment of film coating machines, in particular to a cathode dust cover of a film coating machine, which comprises a base, a placing groove is arranged on the top surface of the base, the inner side surface of the placing groove is connected with a film coating machine body, the top surface of the base is provided with a mounting groove, and the inner side surface of the mounting groove is connected with one end of a dust cover body. According to the utility model, through the mutual matching among the base, the placing groove, the mounting groove, the dustproof cover body, the first sealing ring, the butterfly bolt, the limiting hole, the first fixing hole and the lifting handle, after the use of the film coater body is finished, the film coater can be placed into the placing groove of the base, and then the dustproof cover body is mounted, so that the dustproof cover body and the base can shield and protect the film coater, dust in the environment can be effectively prevented from drifting to the positions of a film coating bottom plate, a cathode part or a control panel of the film coater, the protection performance of the film coater is improved, and the service life of the film coater is ensured.

title_en: Tufted carpet covers end device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of carpet bottoming devices, and discloses a tufted carpet bottoming device, which comprises a supporting table, wherein an opening is formed in one side of the supporting table, a lifting mechanism for supporting and heating a bottom layer is arranged in the opening, a transmission rack is fixedly arranged on the supporting table, a mounting frame is fixedly arranged on the supporting table, a driving piece is fixedly arranged on the mounting frame, and a tightening mechanism which is in transmission with the transmission rack is arranged on a driving rod of the driving piece. The utility model provides a tufted carpet backing device, which can lift a bottom layer by arranging a lifting mechanism, place a tufted layer on the bottom layer, and facilitate rolling, tightening and laminating by matching a tightening mechanism, so that the quality after molding is improved.

title_en: Multilayer wafer cooling device of rapid annealing furnace
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multilayer wafer cooling device of a rapid annealing furnace, which belongs to the technical field of wafer cooling devices and comprises a bottom plate, wherein blowing plates are fixedly connected to two sides of the top of the bottom plate, air inlet assemblies are arranged at the tops of two groups of blowing plates, a plurality of groups of mounting plates can be fixedly arranged on the inner sides of the two groups of blowing plates through the arrangement of sliding connection assemblies so as to realize the purpose of cooling a plurality of groups of wafer bodies at one time, the wafer bodies can be stably supported above the mounting plates through the arrangement of supporting assemblies, cooling air can be introduced into the air inlet assemblies after the wafer bodies are fixed, and the surfaces of the wafer bodies are blown through air holes so as to cool the wafer bodies, and the device has the advantages of being capable of performing multilayer wafer cooling work at one time and being used for solving the problems of low production efficiency, complex structure, high cost, unstable operation and the like in the prior art.

title_en: Split type roll-over stand for coating machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a roll-over stand for a split type coating machine, and relates to the technical field of coating machines. This split type roll-over stand for coating machine through setting up clamping assembly, two-way lead screw, the movable block, the headstock, first bevel gear, second bevel gear and second motor, realized the fixed function of cloth centre gripping to different sizes, the second motor rotates through the connecting rod and takes the second bevel gear, the second bevel gear rotates through first bevel gear and takes two-way lead screw, two-way lead screw rotates and takes the movable block at both ends to remove, adjust the length that needs fixed cloth with the distance between two sets of movable blocks, the practicality of device has been strengthened, through setting up second cavity pole, first cavity pole, the belt pulley, the driving belt, driven gear, the driving gear, carousel and threaded rod, the function of adjusting device height has been realized, adjust the position of fixed box, the height that makes the fixed box highly the same with the coating machine, better carries out the coating to the cloth.

title_en: Full-automatic dispensing equipment of PCBA board
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of glue dispensing of PCBA boards, in particular to full-automatic glue dispensing equipment of PCBA boards, which comprises an equipment base, wherein U-shaped frames are arranged at two ends of the equipment base, an electric sliding table is fixedly arranged at the front side of the U-shaped frames, an electric sliding block is arranged at one side of the electric sliding table, an electric push rod is fixedly connected to the lower side of the electric sliding table, a fixed plate is connected to the lower side of the electric push rod, and rotating seats are rotatably connected to two ends of the fixed plate.

title_en: Degradable composite antirust film
abstract_en: The utility model provides a degradable composite antirust film, which relates to the field of composite antirust films and comprises an outer layer and an inner layer, wherein the outer layer is in composite connection with the inner layer, the outer layer comprises a first elastic layer and a second elastic layer, a base film layer is arranged between the first elastic layer and the second elastic layer, the inner layer comprises a loading layer, loading holes are formed in the inner side of the loading layer, nano-scale antirust particles are arranged in the loading layer, a polyurethane elastic film is arranged on the outer side of the loading layer, and a waterproof film is arranged on the outer side of the polyurethane elastic film. The utility model solves the problems that the existing degradable composite antirust film has thinner gasified molecular layer and metal adsorption surface and shorter gasified diffusion duration.

title_en: Various aluminum plate roller coat drying device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of drying devices, in particular to a roller coating drying device for a color aluminum plate, which comprises a workbench, wherein the upper surface of the workbench is fixedly connected with a drying box, a top cover is arranged above the drying box, the lower surface of the workbench is fixedly connected with a double-headed motor, the output end of the double-headed motor is fixedly connected with a first rotating shaft, one end of the first rotating shaft, which is far away from the double-headed motor, is fixedly connected with a first bevel gear, the lower surface of the workbench is fixedly connected with a first fixed block, the inner surface of the first fixed block is movably provided with a second rotating shaft, the side wall of the second rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a third bevel gear, and the outer surface of the second rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a second bevel gear. The utility model has reasonable structure, can finally control the lifting of the top cover through the work of the double-headed motor, thereby facilitating the maintenance or replacement of the heating strip by workers and being beneficial to the use of the drying equipment.

title_en: Hot melt adhesive coating and cooling device for medical adhesive tape cloth
abstract_en: The utility model provides a hot melt adhesive coating and cooling device for medical adhesive tape cloth, which belongs to the technical field of coating and comprises a fixing frame and a supporting plate fixedly connected to the top of the fixing frame, and a swinging mechanism, wherein the swinging mechanism comprises a first motor, a cam disc and a driving rod, the first motor is adaptively arranged on the outer side of the supporting plate, the cam disc is fixedly connected to the output end of the first motor through a coupler, and the driving rod is slidingly connected to the inner wall of the cam disc. The utility model drives the centrifugal fan to reciprocate and linearly move through the swinging mechanism, so that cold air can be uniformly dispersed on the surface of the hot melt adhesive, the cooling speed of each region of the hot melt adhesive is ensured to be consistent, the uniformity of the cooling effect is improved, the working range of the centrifugal fan can be flexibly adjusted according to medical adhesive tape cloth with different coating widths and thicknesses through the matching of all parts in the regulating and controlling assembly, and the adjusted working range can be fixed, so that the effects of adapting to more different production requirements and improving the application range of equipment are realized.

title_en: Automatic adjust gluing machine of gluing thickness
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a glue passing machine capable of automatically adjusting glue passing thickness, which comprises a glue passing machine main body, a glue storage bin and a heating plate, wherein the glue storage bin is arranged on one side of the inside of the glue passing machine main body, the heating plate is arranged in the glue storage bin, glue is contained in the glue storage bin, and a glue spreading mechanism is arranged on one side of the inside of the glue passing machine main body. According to the utility model, the glue is adhered to the glue homogenizing mechanism to glue the material passing through between the limit roller and the glue homogenizing mechanism, after the glue is adhered to the heating plate on the glue feeding roller, the glue feeding roller contacts with the glue homogenizing roller in the rotating process so as to more uniformly distribute the glue on the glue feeding roller, and through the contact with the glue feeding roller, the glue homogenizing roller can eliminate the problems of uneven thickness, bubbles or impurities and the like possibly existing on the glue feeding roller, so that the final glue spreading effect is smoother and more uniform, and the contact between the glue homogenizing roller and the glue feeding roller can also effectively control the glue spreading thickness.

title_en: Paint dipping device for industrial equipment accessories
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for the field of industrial equipment accessory processing and production, and provides a paint dipping device for industrial equipment accessories, which comprises a frame, a rotating assembly, a lifting assembly and a drying assembly, wherein the rotating assembly, the lifting assembly and the drying assembly are arranged in the frame, the frame comprises a mounting plate, a support column, an upright post and a top plate, the rotating assembly comprises a motor, a rotating disc and a paint can, the lifting assembly comprises a lifting rod and a clamping unit, the drying assembly comprises a heating plate and a fan, the industrial equipment accessories are clamped through the clamping unit, the accessories are immersed in the paint can through the lifting rod, the rotating disc is driven by the motor to rotate so as to drive the paint can to rotate, the full effect of accessory paint dipping can be improved, after the paint dipping is finished, the lifting rod is lifted to drain residual paint liquid on the surfaces of the accessories, meanwhile, the heating plate is started to heat air, and the fan is used for blowing hot air to the surfaces of the accessories, so that the drying speed of the paint liquid on the surfaces of the accessories is improved.

title_en: Touch heat-insulating packaging film and packaging bag
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a touch heat-insulating packaging film which comprises a printing film layer, a base film layer, a heat sealing film layer, a foaming ink layer and a gloss oil layer, wherein the base film layer is arranged between the printing film layer and the heat sealing film layer, the foaming ink layer is arranged on the printing film layer, the gloss oil layer is arranged on the foaming ink layer, the foaming ink layer is arranged between the gloss oil layer and the printing film layer, and the printing film layer is arranged between the foaming ink layer and the base film layer. The utility model also discloses a packaging bag prepared from the packaging film.

title_en: Circulation forced air cooling's multi-purpose stove of carburization
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a circulating air-cooled carburizing multipurpose furnace, which belongs to the technical field of carburizing furnaces and comprises a support frame, wherein a furnace chamber is arranged above the support frame, a push-pull component is arranged above the support frame and positioned at one side of the furnace chamber, a penetrating agent pipe component is arranged above the furnace chamber, and an exhaust pipe is arranged above the penetrating agent pipe component in an inclined manner; according to the utility model, by arranging the circulating air cooling device, a worker can perform circulating air cooling and cooling on the interior of the furnace chamber through the cooperation of the structures such as the fan and the radiating copper pipe when needed, so that the working requirements under different conditions are better met, and the working capacity of the multipurpose furnace is further improved.

title_en: Feeding anti-pinch mechanism of brush coating machine
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of production safety, specifically speaking is a tong mechanism is prevented in feeding of brush machine, the intelligent brush machine comprises an operation table, operation table top right side bottom fixedly connected with cylinder, cylinder output fixedly connected with keeps off the post, side fixedly connected with backup pad in the operation table top, operation table top left side is provided with conveying assembly; the utility model provides a tong mechanism is prevented in feeding of brushing machine, rise through driving the baffle through the cylinder before getting into brushing machine, and adjust suitable time frequency and prop up the adhesive tape upwards, replace manual operation, utilize prevent slow-witted method to prevent the tong and have apparent advantage, at first, it is through avoiding the operator maloperation or contact dangerous part by accident, show the operation security has been improved, the risk of the occurence of failure such as tong has been reduced, secondly, prevent slow-witted design can automated inspection and prevent potential safety problem, reduce human error, ensure the correctness of operation flow.

title_en: Device for stripping sheet release paper
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of sheet release paper stripping, and discloses a sheet release paper stripping device which comprises a mechanical arm, an upper protective film sucking mechanism, a lower release paper sucking mechanism and a sheet positioning mechanism, wherein the sheet positioning mechanism comprises a vertical frame, a pushing assembly and a positioning plate. By adopting the structure, the sheet positioning mechanism can conveniently position the sheet on the lower release paper suction mechanism, the difficulty of manual positioning is reduced, the sheet with cheap absorption positions of the upper protective film suction mechanism and the lower release paper suction mechanism can be prevented after positioning, the accuracy of sheet positioning is improved, the accurate determination of sheet attachment is improved, and the decline of protection force is avoided.

title_en: Curtain cloth with flame retardant structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses curtain cloth with a flame-retardant structure, which comprises a flame-retardant curtain body and a plurality of counterweight type straightening devices arranged at the bottom end of the flame-retardant curtain body, wherein the counterweight type straightening devices are equidistantly arranged, the flame-retardant curtain body is formed by a curtain cloth base layer, a flame-retardant layer, a heat-insulating layer, a waterproof layer and a decorative layer, the counterweight type straightening devices are additionally arranged at the bottom end of a finished flame-retardant curtain body for manufacturing the curtain, when air flow acts on the flame-retardant curtain body, the counterweight type straightening devices can play an important role, no matter natural wind or air flow generated by indoor air flow, the counterweight type straightening devices can keep the curtain cloth stable, and the gravity effect of metal counterweight balls can not easily drift or swing when the curtain cloth is impacted by the air flow, so that the curtain cloth can be ensured to be always kept at a set position, and the functions of indoor lighting, ventilation, privacy protection and the like are not influenced.

title_en: Vacuum glue injection equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to vacuum glue injection equipment which is used for injecting glue to a product and comprises a vacuumizing device, a first guide pipe, a second guide pipe and a glue raw stock bin, wherein a first valve is arranged on the first guide pipe, a second valve is arranged on the second guide pipe, two ends of the first guide pipe are respectively a first end of the first guide pipe and a second end of the first guide pipe, two ends of the second guide pipe are respectively a first end of the second guide pipe and a second end of the second guide pipe, the first end of the first guide pipe is connected with the vacuumizing device, the first end of the second guide pipe is connected with the glue raw stock bin, and the second end of the first guide pipe and the second end of the second guide pipe are used for being connected with the product when the glue is injected to the product. The utility model has simple structural design, low manufacturing cost, easy assembly, debugging and maintenance, relatively small volume and low requirements on use environment and space, thereby being applicable to more diversified application scenes.

title_en: Waterproof non-woven fabrics shopping bag
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a waterproof non-woven shopping bag, which relates to the technical field of shopping bags and comprises a shopping bag, wherein the inner layer, the middle layer, the outer layer, the ventilation layer and other components in the waterproof protection component are mutually matched, so that the inner layer can effectively prevent moisture from penetrating and prevent articles in the bag from being wet or polluted by liquid, whether the articles overflow in rainy days or liquid, the shopping bag can provide good protection for the articles, the waterproof inner layer can ensure that foods, electronic products or other articles in the bag are not influenced by the moisture, the articles can be effectively prevented from being damaged particularly when the shopping bag is used in a humid environment, the non-woven fabric layer has higher tensile strength and tear resistance, the integral structure of the bag is enhanced, the shopping bag is ensured not to be easily broken when the articles are loaded, and the polypropylene (PP) material of the middle layer is helpful for keeping the shape of the shopping bag, increasing the durability of the bag and enabling the bag to bear larger weight of the articles.

title_en: Noctilucent film for logistics packaging
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a noctilucent film for logistics packaging, which comprises a film layer I, wherein an aluminum foil layer is arranged on the outer side of the film layer I, a film layer II is arranged on the outer side of the aluminum foil layer, a fluorescent film layer is arranged on the outer side of the film layer II, a film layer III is arranged on the outer side of the fluorescent film layer, a decorative printing layer is arranged on the outer side of the film layer III, an anti-puncture layer I is arranged on the inner side of the film layer I, an anti-puncture layer II is arranged between the fluorescent film layer and the film layer II, the fluorescent film layer comprises a transparent base film I and a transparent base film II, the transparent base film I and the transparent base film II are connected through an adhesive layer mixed with fluorescent powder, the fluorescent film layer is arranged in the layer structure of the packaging film, and the fluorescent film layer can play a certain illumination role in the dark place, so that when goods are searched in the dark place, the goods information on the packaging can be seen more directly.

title_en: Double-sided automatic feeding device of hinge electroplating hanger
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a double-sided automatic feeding device of a hinge electroplating hanging frame, which comprises a frame, a hanging frame mechanism arranged on the frame and feeding mechanisms respectively arranged at two sides of the hanging frame mechanism, wherein the feeding mechanisms comprise a manipulator mechanism, an adsorption mechanism and a feeding mechanism, the adsorption mechanism is arranged on the manipulator mechanism, the feeding mechanism conveys a hinge to the adsorption mechanism, and the adsorption mechanism swings by the manipulator mechanism and is conveyed to the hanging frame mechanism to be hung after adsorbing the hinge. According to the utility model, in the hinge raw material electroplating process, the hinge is hung in the hanger production to replace manual operation, so that the operation is stable and the operation efficiency is high.

title_en: Inductance wire passing bead material selecting device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an inductance wire passing bead material selecting device which comprises a device body, wherein the device body comprises a base, a fixed block, small tin cylinders and enameled wires, the base is of a rectangular structure, the fixed block is arranged at the top of the base, the fixed block is of a rectangular structure, a group of symmetrically distributed mounting grooves are formed in the top of the fixed block, the mounting grooves are of a circular structure, the small tin cylinders are provided with a group, the small tin cylinders are respectively arranged in the mounting grooves, the top of the small tin cylinders is provided with the mounting block, the top of the mounting block is provided with a group of symmetrically distributed mounting clamping grooves, wire passing beads are respectively arranged in the mounting clamping grooves, clamping grooves are formed in the surfaces of the wire passing beads, and the enameled wires sequentially pass through the wire passing beads. The device can ensure the thickness and the surface finish of the tin coating, thereby being matched with a small tin cylinder to improve the tin coating quality of products, reducing unqualified products caused by poor tin coating and improving the production efficiency of companies.

title_en: Heating furnace
abstract_en: The utility model provides a heating furnace, which comprises a heat preservation chamber, a transmission device and at least one combustion chamber, wherein the combustion chamber is connected with the heat preservation chamber and is used for heating gas and inputting the gas into the heat preservation chamber, the transmission device is used for transferring materials into and out of the heat preservation chamber, the heating furnace further comprises an exhaust gas pipeline and an exhaust gas treatment device, the exhaust gas pipeline is connected between the heat preservation chamber and the exhaust gas treatment device, the exhaust gas treatment device comprises a purification bin and an adsorption material arranged in the purification bin, the air inlet end of the purification bin is connected with the exhaust gas pipeline, and the adsorption material is positioned between the air inlet end and the air outlet end of the purification bin. In the utility model, the waste gas treatment device is directly arranged at the same place as the heat preservation chamber, so that the waste gas transportation distance is shortened, thereby reducing the heat waste in the waste gas transportation process, improving the utilization rate of waste heat, further reducing the fuel cost of the spraying production line, and simultaneously saving the material cost of long-distance pipelines and the material and occupation cost of waste gas treatment equipment built elsewhere.

title_en: Packaging equipment of miniature endoscope module
abstract_en: The utility model relates to packaging equipment, and provides packaging equipment of a miniature endoscope module, which comprises a base, a shield, a control panel, a workbench, a tool and the like; the upper portion of the base is provided with a shield, the front portion of the shield is provided with a material conveying notch, one side of the front portion of the shield is provided with a control panel, the upper portion of the base is provided with a workbench, and the workbench is provided with a tool. According to the utility model, the air in the first tank body is pumped out through the vacuum pump, so that the formation of bubbles in the packaging material is reduced, meanwhile, the packaging material in the first tank body is slowly pumped out into the second tank body through the first negative pressure pump, so that the material is ensured to sufficiently discharge bubbles in a low-pressure environment, then, the material without bubbles is conveyed into the glue gun through the second negative pressure pump, the uniformity and compactness of the material in the filling and sealing process are ensured, the packaging quality of the endoscope module is effectively improved, and the air tightness and the insulating strength of packaging are enhanced.

title_en: Water tank and electrolytic hydrogen production equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a water tank, which comprises a first water tank and a second water tank, wherein a first liquid outlet is formed in the bottom of the first water tank, a first liquid inlet is formed in the top of the second water tank, the first liquid inlet is connected with the first liquid outlet through a first control valve, the first control valve is used for controlling the first liquid inlet to be communicated with or closed off from the first liquid outlet, a sprayer is arranged at the top of an inner cavity of the first water tank, and when the inner cavity of the first water tank is cleaned, the sprayer is opened to spray cleaning liquid to clean the inner cavity of the first water tank. According to the utility model, the water tank is cleaned by the sprayer, so that the cleaning is convenient and no manual work is required.

title_en: Quick drying device after conducting film coating
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of conductive film production and discloses a rapid drying device after conductive film coating, which comprises a supporting frame, wherein a coating mechanism is fixedly connected to the top end of the supporting frame, a drying cover is fixedly connected to the top end of the supporting frame, a drying cavity is formed in the middle of the drying cover, two air flow pipes are fixedly connected to the top end of the supporting frame, an air heater is arranged at the top end of each air flow pipe, a drainage pipe is fixedly connected to the outer part of each air flow pipe, two guide pipes are fixedly connected to the outer part of each drainage pipe, a taper pipe is fixedly connected to the inner part of each guide pipe, and an air inlet pipe is fixedly connected to one side, far away from each drainage pipe, of each guide pipe. According to the utility model, the jet flow generated by the injection structure can drive the ambient air to flow rapidly while saving the cost, so that the drying speed is increased, and in addition, the reduction of the number of waste products generated by offset and the reduction of the production cost are realized.

title_en: Fixing device for detecting reflecting plate by VCD mechanical arm of color film coating section of display panel
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fixing device for a detection reflecting plate of a VCD mechanical arm of a color film coating section of a display panel, which comprises a fixing seat arranged at the outer edge of VCD equipment, wherein the top of the fixing seat is provided with a mounting groove corresponding to the detection reflecting plate, and the depth of the mounting groove is larger than the height of the detection reflecting plate, so that the detection reflecting plate is hidden in the mounting groove. Through hiding the detection reflecting plate in the mounting groove, the problem that the detection reflecting plate is pressed and deformed during personnel operation can be prevented, the problems that the detection reflecting plate is abnormal, a coating machine is down and a product is bad and scrapped are avoided, and the utilization time of equipment is prolonged.

title_en: Gluing tool for metal doors and windows
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of metal door and window processing, and discloses a gluing tool for metal doors and windows, which comprises a bracket, wherein a limiting piece for bearing a metal frame is arranged at the top of the bracket, a jacking device is arranged on the bracket and used for lifting and supporting glass, a connecting frame is fixedly arranged on the bracket, a fixing component for fixing the metal frame is arranged on the connecting frame, and the metal frame can be accurately positioned and fixed by arranging the limiting piece and the fixing component, so that the metal frame is prevented from shifting or shaking in the gluing process, the gluing precision and efficiency are improved, and meanwhile, the jacking device is also arranged, so that the glass can be stably lifted and supported, and the smooth gluing operation is further ensured.

title_en: Molten tin copper removal system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a molten tin copper removal system, which comprises a cooling device for treating molten tin, a filtering device for treating the molten tin treated by the cooling device, and an electro-deposition device for performing electrochemical treatment on the molten tin treated by the filtering device to remove copper. The copper removal system removes elemental copper and ionic copper in the molten tin by a physical method and an electrochemical method, can ensure the purity of the molten tin, prolong the service life of the molten tin, reduce the use cost of the molten tin, lighten the difficulty of subsequent sewage treatment, improve the uniformity and quality stability of the molten tin process, improve the product quality, avoid pollution and diffusion caused by the fact that copper flows into subsequent processes along with the molten tin, and can intensively recycle the elemental copper separated and electrodeposited by the molten tin copper removal system, reduce the material waste and simultaneously generate economic benefits.

title_en: Chemical plating line storehouse ma immersion oil groove
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of chemical plating line reservoir-and-mar oil immersion devices, and provides a chemical plating line reservoir-and-mar oil immersion tank, which comprises a reservoir-and-mar tank, wherein a plurality of baffle plates are arranged on the reservoir-and-mar tank, guide grooves are respectively arranged on the reservoir-and-mar tank and the baffle plates, cotton ropes are arranged between the two baffle plates, two adsorption ends inserted into the reservoir-and-mar tank are arranged on the cotton ropes, and an oil immersion tank for immersing steel wires in oil is arranged between the two baffle plates positioned at the front end of the cotton ropes.

title_en: Anti-skid paint cup with double paint filtering structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an anti-skid paint cup with a double paint filtering structure, which comprises a cup body, wherein a paint filtering step surface is formed on the inner side wall of the cup body, a first paint filtering block is formed on the paint filtering step surface, a paint filtering channel is formed between the first paint filtering block and the inner side wall of the cup body, paint filtering strips are sequentially formed on the inner side wall of the cup body, and anti-skid grains are formed on the outer bottom wall of the cup body. The paint cup of this technical scheme has dual straining lacquer structure to impurity after straining the lacquer can be by effective filtering, and paint can evenly be attached to on the painting tool, is difficult for easily skidding under the action of intentional external force simultaneously, and the safety in utilization is high.

title_en: Roller coating mechanism of stator oil film coating device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a roller coating mechanism of a stator oil film coating device, which comprises a first connecting plate and a PLC (programmable logic controller) which are horizontally arranged, wherein a second connecting plate which is vertically arranged is arranged on the first connecting plate, the left side of the upper part of the second connecting plate is provided with a wide air claw, the wide air claw comprises two claws which are arranged up and down in parallel, the claws are respectively connected with a coating roller through air claw roller connecting pieces, when the wide air claw is in a clamping state, the upper coating roller is contacted with the inner peripheral side wall of a stator to be coated, and the lower coating roller is contacted with the outer peripheral side wall of the stator to be coated.

title_en: Antibacterial coating structure of return air filter
abstract_en: The utility model provides an antibacterial coating structure of a return air filter, which comprises a return air filter frame, wherein a base layer is arranged in the return air filter frame, a transition layer is fixedly arranged on the outer side of the base layer, an antibacterial layer is fixedly arranged on the outer side of the transition layer, an adhesive layer is fixedly arranged on the outer side of the antibacterial layer, and an inner protective layer is fixedly arranged on the outer side of the adhesive layer. This antibiotic coating structure of return air filter through basic unit, the setting of transition layer, antibiotic layer and tie coat, can effectively restrain the growth and the propagation of multiple bacterium at the filter surface, greatly reduced the possibility that the bacterium breeds and spreads in return air system, ensured the sanitary quality of air, when playing antibiotic effect, ensured that the return air filter can last steadily to filter the processing to the air, possess good stability, can last to keep antibiotic ability in long-term use, prolonged the life of return air filter, improved whole ventilation system's operating efficiency.

title_en: Discharging mechanism for assembling needle head of indwelling needle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a discharging mechanism for assembling a needle head of an indwelling needle, which relates to the technical field of indwelling needle processing and comprises a cabin, a rotating disk is rotatably arranged above the cabin, a fixed disk is arranged on the rotating disk and fixedly connected with the cabin, a PLC (programmable logic controller) is fixedly arranged above the fixed disk, a feeding mechanism, a rubberizing mechanism, a position adjusting mechanism, a drying mechanism and a discharging mechanism are respectively and fixedly arranged above the cabin, the feeding mechanism, the rubberizing mechanism, the position adjusting mechanism, the drying mechanism and the discharging mechanism are all electrically connected with the PLC, the discharging mechanism is arranged outside the cabin, a rack is arranged at the bottom of the discharging mechanism, the discharging mechanism comprises a grabbing component and a conveying component, the grabbing component is fixedly arranged above the cabin, and the conveying component is fixedly arranged above the rack.

title_en: Manual glue gun structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a manual glue gun structure, which relates to the field of glue guns and solves the problem that the conventional device is difficult to flexibly rotate a glue inlet pipe according to requirements under different environments so as to perform corresponding high-efficiency glue spraying; the manual glue gun structure is characterized in that the heating barrel is arranged on the inner side of the first shell, the connecting terminal is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the first shell, the glue inlet pipe and the wire harness are fixedly connected with the heating pipe through the connecting terminal, the arrangement of each component at the top end of the heating barrel on the inner side of the first shell is convenient for being matched with the limit steel ball, the rotary joint and the joint seat to freely drive the heating barrel to rotate, the glue inlet pipe and the wire harness connected with the bottom end can be synchronously driven to freely rotate, and therefore the positions of the glue inlet pipe and the wire harness can be flexibly adjusted under complex and various glue beating scenes, and convenience and high efficiency of glue beating operation can be ensured.

title_en: Continuous passivation pretreatment device for fluorocarbon color-coated aluminum coil
