abstract_en: The utility model relates to a continuous passivation pretreatment device for fluorocarbon color aluminum coil, which is applied to the field of fluorocarbon color aluminum coil production and processing, and comprises a treatment box, wherein a plurality of mounting rods are fixedly connected to the inner cavity of the treatment box, auxiliary rollers are sleeved on the outer surfaces of the mounting rods in a rotating manner, water outlet pipes are fixedly connected to the left end and the right end of the treatment box, movable notches are cut at the left end and the right end of the treatment box, a partition plate is fixedly connected to the inner bottom wall of the treatment box, a U-shaped mounting frame is fixedly connected to the left end of the partition plate, and when the color aluminum coil is subjected to passivation treatment, water and a small amount of impurities on the surface of the color aluminum coil are blown off by arranging an air knife, and then a plurality of infrared radiators are used for drying and heating the color aluminum coil quickly, so that the surface water of the color aluminum coil is greatly reduced, a large amount of water is brought into passivation solution by the color aluminum coil after water washing, and the passivation uniformity is effectively improved.

title_en: Glue outlet device for glue spraying machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a glue outlet device for a glue spraying machine, which belongs to the technical field of glue spraying machines and comprises a glue spraying machine support and a glue outlet assembly, wherein the top of the glue spraying machine support is provided with a glue conveying assembly, the top of the glue spraying machine support is fixedly connected with a frame, and the frame is provided with an adjusting assembly. When needs are glued, accessible adjusting part carries out the regulation of position to the packing element of beating, after the packing element position adjustment of beating, the inside that adds the gum pump will store up the inside glue solution of gum box and transmit the buffer block through the hose, with this is glued the article of needs beating through beating the packing element, can rotate the governing ball through the third motor when beating simultaneously, with this quantitative whereabouts that realizes the glue solution, after beating the glue completion, the inside of buffer block can be dripped to the inside of hose, accessible slide takes out the buffer block this moment, with this realization is to the clearance of buffer block, thereby avoid influencing the buffer block and beat the follow-up use of gluing machine.

title_en: Multilayer composite tab adhesive film
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a multilayer composite type tab adhesive film which comprises a battery aluminum plastic film, a battery cell, two battery metal strips and a tab adhesive film arranged between the battery aluminum plastic film and the battery metal strips, wherein the tab adhesive film comprises a tab adhesive core layer and heat sealing layers positioned on the upper side and the lower side of the tab adhesive core layer, the melting point of the heat sealing layers is lower than that of the tab adhesive core layer, the heat sealing layers are colorless layers, the tab adhesive core layer of at least one tab adhesive film on the two battery metal strips is a colored layer, and the heat sealing layers sequentially comprise a modification layer, a homo-polymerization layer and a copolymerization layer from outside to inside. According to the utility model, the heat sealing layer is a colorless layer, and the tab adhesive core layer of at least one tab adhesive film on the two battery metal strips is a structural arrangement of a colored layer, so that the positive and negative poles of the battery can be rapidly distinguished, the operation is simple, the use is convenient, and the influence on tab functions caused by tab processing is avoided.

title_en: ‌ Closed-loop control pouring sealant quantitative glue injection equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides ‌ closed-loop control pouring sealant quantitative glue injection equipment which comprises a frame component, a moving component and a glue injection component, wherein the glue injection component used for injecting glue to a DC power supply module is arranged on the upper side surface of the frame component through the moving component, the moving component comprises a frame body, a first sliding rail and a second sliding rail used for controlling the position of the glue injection component, the glue injection component comprises a moving part used for displacement, and a rotating part is arranged on the front side surface of the moving part.

title_en: Shock attenuation bubble cotton structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of damping foam, in particular to a damping foam structure, which comprises rubber PORON foam, wherein an antistatic PET silica gel protective film is arranged on one side of the rubber PORON foam, a PET release film is arranged on the other side of the rubber PORON foam, equidistant positioning inner hole groups are formed in the surfaces of the rubber PORON foam and the antistatic PET silica gel protective film, product handle hollow grooves are formed in one side of the positioning inner hole groups, die cutting positioning lines are arranged on the surfaces of the rubber PORON foam and the antistatic PET silica gel protective film, the die cutting positioning lines are sleeved on the outer sides of the positioning inner hole groups, a damping mechanism is arranged between the rubber PORON foam and the antistatic PET silica gel protective film, a first connecting surface and a damping part are arranged in the damping mechanism, the first connecting surface is formed in one side of the rubber PORON foam, the first connecting surface is of a wavy structure, and the damping part is adhered between the first connecting surface and the antistatic PET silica gel protective film. The damping effect is improved.

title_en: Adhesive tape coating, discharging and receiving adjusting device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of adhesive tape coating, and discloses an adhesive tape coating discharging and receiving adjusting device, which comprises a workbench, wherein two groups of mounting plates are fixedly connected to the top surface of the workbench. This sticky tape coating blowing material receiving adjusting device, when using through adjusting part's setting, overlap joint sticky tape on adjusting the pole, sticky tape can produce certain pressure to the adjusting lever when the rolling, adjust the pole and remove and drive the slider and remove, the slider removes and extrudees pressure sensor, pressure sensor is used for detecting the pressure that adjusts the pole and receives, and on transferring the controller with data, when the too big or undersize of pressure that detects, the controller control electric putter goes up and down, electric putter drives the pole and goes up and down, can control the height of adjusting the pole, and then adjust the tension size that the sticky tape receives, make it remain in the settlement within range all the time, avoid the sticky tape to lead to loose, fold because of tension is too little, or lead to tensile deformation even fracture because of tension is too big.

title_en: Even coating device of nylon membrane
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of nylon film production and discloses a nylon film uniform coating device which comprises a liquid storage tank, a feeding frame and a rolling frame, wherein the feeding frame is fixedly connected to the left side of the outside of the liquid storage tank, the rolling frame is arranged on the right side of the outside of the liquid storage tank, fixing rods are arranged in the feeding frame and the rolling frame, two-way screw rods and a hand wheel are rotatably connected to the inside of the two fixing rods, the hand wheel is fixedly connected to the bottoms of the two-way screw rods, two moving blocks and two connecting plates are in threaded connection with the two sides of the outside of the two-way screw rods, and the two connecting plates are rotatably connected to the outside of the two moving blocks. According to the utility model, the feeding operation of the nylon membrane reel is facilitated, the bolt is not required to be screwed or unscrewed during feeding, the operation is simple and convenient, time and labor are saved, and the coating efficiency of the nylon membrane is improved.

title_en: Insulating paint drying device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a drying device of insulating paint, which relates to the field of manufacturing of electrical equipment and comprises a drying box, wherein a pushing handle is fixedly arranged on the left side wall of the drying box, locking universal wheels are arranged at four corners of the bottom of the drying box, the front surface of the drying box is movably connected with a sealing door through a screw rod, the right side wall of the drying box is fixedly connected with a mounting plate, a drying mechanism is arranged on the mounting plate, and a limiting mechanism is fixedly arranged in an inner cavity of the drying box. The fan is matched with the tank body, the electric heating tube, the tank body temperature sensor and other parts, and can heat air to a proper temperature and then send the air into the drying box. The heated air is conveyed to the movable plate through the air outlet pipe and the hose and is evenly sprayed to insulating paint objects in the drying box through the drying pipes and the spray heads, so that the insulating paint can be evenly heated, and the drying effect and the drying efficiency are improved. The cylinder drives the movable plate to move up and down, so that the applicability of the drying device is improved.

title_en: Composite device for composite fabric production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of composite fabric production, in particular to a composite device for composite fabric production, which comprises a composite equipment rack for composite fabric production, wherein an automatic gluing box is fixedly arranged at the position, close to a feeding end, of the top surface of the composite equipment rack, an upper fabric roller is movably arranged at the top of the automatic gluing box through a bracket, a composite fabric press roller, an automatic curing box and an automatic clamping and winding mechanism are sequentially arranged at one side, close to a discharging end, of the automatic gluing box, the automatic clamping and winding mechanism comprises a first mounting frame and a second mounting frame which are fixedly arranged at two sides of the composite equipment rack, a winding roller is movably arranged between the first mounting frame and the second mounting frame through a driving motor, and comprises a lower roller body.

title_en: Electrochemical device and electrochemical apparatus
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electrochemical device and electrochemical equipment, wherein the electrochemical device comprises an electrolytic assembly and a supporting frame, the electrolytic assembly comprises a conductive bar, a connecting piece and a polar plate, the conductive bar is arranged at the top of the electrolytic tank, the first end of the connecting piece is connected with the conductive bar, the second end of the connecting piece is connected with the polar plate, the supporting frame comprises a frame body and a turbulent rib, the frame body is arranged in the electrolytic tank and is used for allowing the polar plate to extend in, the turbulent rib is arranged on the frame body in a first transverse extending mode, and the turbulent rib is used for shielding the second end of the connecting piece in a second transverse direction. The second end of connecting piece is connected with the polar plate, and the vortex rib shelters from the second end of connecting piece for the electrolyte that flows through the vortex rib changes under the barrier effect of vortex rib flow state, has effectively prevented the granule accumulation in the electrolyte at the second end of connecting piece, and then has prevented polar plate surface nodulation, knot grain, has improved the surface quality of cathode plate.

title_en: JP cabinet hoist and mount sign spraying frock
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a spraying frock related technical field, an embodiment of the disclosure provides a JP cabinet hoist and mount sign spraying frock, it includes mounting bracket and a pair of link, the link all sets up at the mounting bracket top, the mounting groove is seted up at the mounting bracket surface, fixed subassembly sets up on the mounting bracket, suction cleaning subassembly sets up in mounting bracket and mounting groove, drying subassembly sets up in the mounting bracket outside, fixed subassembly includes a plurality of supporting layer, the supporting layer all sets up at the mounting groove internal surface, a pair of opening has been seted up in the mounting groove, the mounting bracket surface is provided with a pair of connecting plate, be provided with a pair of round bar between the connecting plate, slip cap is connected with the bracket on the round bar. Through above-mentioned technical scheme, solved among the prior art in the spraying in-process unable effective part of volatilizing, be inconvenient for carrying out drying treatment and be inconvenient for fixed technical problem to the sign after the spraying.

title_en: Tin plating equipment for core support processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses tin plating equipment for core support processing, which relates to the technical field of tin plating equipment and comprises a hot-dip tank main body, wherein a tin plating cavity is formed in the hot-dip tank main body, an insulation board is arranged at the top of the tin plating cavity, a lifting assembly is arranged in the tin plating cavity, the lifting assembly comprises a movable cavity formed in the side wall of the tin plating cavity, a screw rod is longitudinally arranged in the movable cavity, the outer wall of the screw rod is in threaded connection with a T-shaped block, one end of the T-shaped block penetrates through and extends to the tin plating cavity, and a tin plating box main body is arranged at one end of the T-shaped block. According to the utility model, through adopting an aligning insertion design of the insertion block and the slot and matching with an automatic clamping mechanism of the trapezoidal clamping block driven by the spring, complex rotation, adjustment and other operations are not required, so that the cover plate can be quickly installed, and the cover plate can be quickly unlocked only by pulling the pull rod during disassembly, thereby greatly simplifying the loading and unloading process of the cover plate, remarkably improving the fixing efficiency and saving the time and energy of manual operation.

title_en: Bipolar plate for stamping forming electrolytic tank
abstract_en: The utility model provides a bipolar plate for a stamping forming electrolytic tank, which comprises a bipolar plate anode surface and a bipolar plate cathode surface, wherein an anode active area, an anode first distribution area and an anode second distribution area are arranged on the bipolar plate anode surface, the anode first distribution area and the anode second distribution area are arranged on the two sides of the bipolar plate anode surface, a cathode active area, a cathode first distribution area and a cathode second distribution area are arranged on the two sides of the bipolar plate cathode surface, water inlets/water outlets and second hydrogen outlets are arranged on the outer sides of the anode first distribution area and the cathode first distribution area, water outlets/water inlets and first hydrogen outlets are arranged on the outer sides of the anode first distribution area and the cathode second distribution area, bulges are formed on the outer sides of the anode first distribution area and the cathode first distribution area, the ends of the bulges are arranged between the water outlets and the first hydrogen outlets, and the ends of the bulges are arranged on the outer sides of the anode second distribution area and the cathode second distribution area. The bipolar plate has better supporting effect on the membrane electrode under the condition of back pressure, and can reduce the invasion of the membrane electrode to the distribution area.

title_en: Piston, rubber cylinder and rubber gun
abstract_en: The utility model provides a piston, a rubber cylinder and a rubber gun. The piston is limited to axially slide through the clamping part and the external equipment, radial offset is eliminated, directional stability is improved, rubber covers are interchangeably arranged at two ends of the rubber cylinder, and the piston is matched with bidirectional reciprocating motion, so that the recycling of the rubber cylinder is realized, and resource waste is reduced. The glue gun adopts the flexible glue containing bag and the concave structure to realize self-sealing extrusion, thereby solving the problems of poor environmental protection, low space utilization rate, high use cost and the like of the disposable glue gun.

title_en: Hanger and etching equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of etching, in particular to a hanger and etching equipment, which are used for fixing a workpiece, wherein the workpiece comprises a first to-be-etched surface and a second to-be-etched surface, the first to-be-etched surface faces a first cathode plate, the workpiece is further provided with a connecting through hole, the hanger comprises a mounting rod for receiving anode current, the mounting rod comprises a conductive rod main body and a connecting arm, the connecting arm is fixedly connected with the through hole to mount the workpiece on the connecting arm so that the second to-be-etched surface faces the conductive rod main body, the cathode assembly for receiving cathode current comprises a conductive frame and profiling pieces, the profiling pieces are mounted on two sides of the conductive frame along a first direction, the first direction is the direction in which the conductive rod main body and the second to-be-etched surface are oppositely arranged, the conductive frame is provided with a mounting cavity, the profiling pieces face the second to-be-etched surface, and projections of the profiling pieces along the first direction fall into the second to-be-etched surface. The hanger solves the problem that the size of the etching hole of the workpiece does not meet the requirement.

title_en: PEM electrolytic tank adapting to fluctuation power supply
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a PEM electrolysis trough of adaptation fluctuation power, including first end plate, a lateral wall of first rubber circle is contacted in laminating of first end plate lateral wall, another lateral wall of first rubber circle laminating contact anode plate, another lateral wall laminating contact first silica gel ring of anode plate a lateral wall, another lateral wall laminating contact first diffusion layer of first silica gel ring a lateral wall, another lateral wall laminating contact anode catalytic layer's of first diffusion layer a lateral wall, another lateral wall laminating contact proton membrane's of anode catalytic layer a lateral wall. The electrolytic tank can be constructed by the diffusion layer with the composite structure, the titanium mesh provides strong mechanical support and rigidity, and the bearing capacity to pressure fluctuation or vibration in the operation of the electrolytic tank and the deformation and damage of the diffusion layer material possibly caused by the pressure fluctuation or temperature change can be enhanced. The porous structure of the titanium felt can reduce brittle fracture caused by local stress variation.

title_en: Rehabilitation nursing exercise device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of nursing rehabilitation exercise, in particular to a rehabilitation nursing exercise device which comprises a shell, wherein an adjusting component is arranged in the shell, an elastic band is arranged on the adjusting component, a plurality of inner conical finger sleeves are arranged at the top end of the elastic band, the tail end of the elastic band is fixedly connected with the adjusting component, the adjusting component comprises an adjusting disc, the adjusting disc is fixedly connected with a first rotating shaft, a ratchet wheel is arranged on the first rotating shaft, the first rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a first gear, the first gear is meshed with a second gear, the second gear is fixedly connected with a second rotating shaft far away from the first gear, a roller is arranged on the second transmission shaft, the second rotating shaft is rotatably connected with a button, a plurality of springs are fixedly connected with the button, and one side, close to the adjusting disc, of the inner wall of the shell is fixedly connected with a fixing rod. The utility model has simple use method, the tension of the elastic band is controlled by the adjusting component, and the patient can adjust the device in time according to the self situation.

title_en: Compression roller mechanism and coating equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a press roller mechanism and coating equipment, wherein the press roller mechanism comprises at least one press roller structure, the press roller structure comprises a press roller, a first driving assembly, a second driving assembly and a first clutch, the press roller comprises a body, a first connecting shaft and a second connecting shaft, the first connecting shaft and the second connecting shaft are respectively arranged at two ends of the body, the driving end of the first driving assembly is connected with the first connecting shaft, the driving end of the second driving assembly is connected with the second connecting shaft, and the first clutch is connected with the driving end of the second driving assembly. According to the technical scheme provided by the utility model, the function of providing larger torque for the roller can be realized without arranging a motor with larger power and larger volume, so that the cost of the press roller mechanism can be reduced and the volume of the press roller mechanism can be reduced.

title_en: Cold work die steel surface strengthening treatment device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cold working die steel surface strengthening treatment device, which relates to the technical field of cold working die processing and comprises a nitriding furnace body, a port arranged at one end of the nitriding furnace body, a fixing ring arranged in the nitriding furnace body, a sealing component fixedly connected with one side of the fixing ring, a discharge pipe arranged at the top of the nitriding furnace body, a positioning sheet sleeved in the discharge pipe, a telescopic component fixedly connected with the top surface of the positioning sheet, the telescopic component comprising a telescopic spring, a piston and a positioning rod, and a sealing cover arranged on the surface of the positioning ring. According to the utility model, the dynamic sealing structure is formed by the arrangement of the fixing ring and the sealing component, so that gas leakage in the treatment process is effectively prevented, and the surface strengthening effect is prevented from being influenced by pressure fluctuation.

title_en: Glue dispensing device for paper rubbing wheel processing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of printer equipment and discloses a glue dispensing device for paper rubbing wheel processing, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a first support plate is fixedly connected to the top of the bottom plate, a second support plate is fixedly connected to the top of the bottom plate, a telescopic assembly is arranged on one side of the support plate, the telescopic assembly comprises an electric push rod, one end of the electric push rod is fixedly connected to one side of the support plate, a base plate is fixedly connected to the output end of the electric push rod, a first clamping plate is fixedly connected to one side of the base plate, one side of the first clamping plate is slidably connected to the top of the support plate, and an elastic plate is fixedly connected to one side of the first clamping plate. According to the utility model, the first clamping plate moves towards or away from the second clamping plate under the drive of the electric push rod, so that the effect of adjusting the distance between the clamping plates to adapt to the paper rubbing wheels with different sizes is achieved, the problem that the traditional adhesive dispensing device for the paper rubbing wheel processing cannot adapt to the adhesive dispensing operation of the paper rubbing wheels with different sizes is solved, and the adaptability of the adhesive dispensing device for the paper rubbing wheel processing is improved.

title_en: Rabbit shoes for pets
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pair of pet rabbit shoes, which are provided with vamps and soles and are characterized by comprising a sole and a vamp, wherein the vamp is fixed on the sole, the sole adopts an anti-skid waterproof shock-absorbing structure, and the sole comprises an anti-skid layer, a waterproof layer and a shock-absorbing layer. The utility model has the advantages of being easy for a rabbit owner to wear for the rabbit rear foot, effectively preventing the rabbit rear foot from being stabbed by foreign matters, preventing dirtying, better protecting the rabbit rear foot and relieving the callus of the rabbit rear foot.

title_en: Heating gear type metering device for glue spreader
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of gluing equipment, in particular to a heating gear type metering device for a gluing machine, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a coupler is positioned in a space surrounded by a protection plate and a connecting plate, a temperature sensor is used for collecting temperature data during the operation of the coupler in real time through an opening in the operation process of the coupler, an alarm can be arranged outside the gluing machine to enable the alarm to be electrically connected with the temperature sensor, a threshold value is set, when the temperature exceeds the set threshold value in the operation process of the coupler, the temperature sensor can transmit a signal to the alarm, the alarm immediately sends out sound or light warning to remind an operator to check and maintain the equipment in time, the coupler is prevented from being damaged due to the overhigh temperature, potential safety hazards of personnel contact are eliminated through physical isolation, double guarantee of personal safety and stable operation of the equipment of the operator is realized by means of temperature monitoring and early warning, and the occurrence of safety accidents and production loss is effectively avoided.

title_en: Masonry and reinforced concrete frame structure connection reinforcing structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a connection reinforcing structure of a masonry and a reinforced concrete frame structure, which relates to the technical field of building structure reinforcement, and comprises a wall body, wherein the wall body is provided with a damping component, the damping component comprises a cavity arranged in the wall body, notches penetrating through the upper side, the lower side, the left side and the right side of the wall body are formed in the periphery of the cavity, limiting blocks are arranged in the notches, a plurality of pouring through holes are formed in the limiting blocks, a plurality of elastic steel bars are inserted in the pouring through holes, the elastic steel bars and the pouring through holes are distributed in a staggered mode, one end of each elastic steel bar on each side, which is positioned in the cavity of the wall body, is vertically and fixedly connected with the elastic steel bars on the adjacent side, and a steel bar framework is arranged at the joint of the elastic steel bars.

title_en: Preparation method for and use of ptfe-based nano functional composite membrane
abstract_en: The disclosure discloses a preparation method of a polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE)-based nano functional composite membrane and use, and relates to the technical field of polymer composites. The PTFE-based nano functional composite membrane can be applied to prevention and resistance of icing of various types of wind turbine generator blades in winter and salt spray corrosion resistance of wind turbine blades, in the meantime, can improve the aerodynamic performance of wind turbine blade airfoils and enhance the whole surface strength of the blade and protect the blade from undergoing aging erosion, and is a new-generation multi-functional brand-new composite membrane material which can be directly explored and applied to the industrial fields of preventing adhesion and corrosion of marine fouling organisms on steel pipe piles of offshore wind power and offshore platforms, avoiding snowing and icing of high-voltage transmission towers and cables, protecting snowing and icing of bridges (stay cables and suspension cables) and the like.

title_en: Polyurethane coated heat-shrinkable film
abstract_en: A heat-shrinkable film which includes an ethylene-based polymer multilayer or monolayer film and a coating on an outer surface of the ethylene-based polymer film. The ethylene-based polymer film having a single layer or a multilayer structure formed from a first layer, a second layer, and at least one inner layer between the first and second layers. The coating including polyurethane which is the polymerized reaction product of: a polyol; and an aromatic isocyanate functional prepolymer. Further, a method of unitizing polymer wrapped primary packages is provided. The method includes wrapping one or more of the primary packages with the heat-shrinkable film with the coating disposed proximal the one or more primary packages and applying thermal energy to reduce the dimensions of the heat-shrinkable film to constrain the primary package within the heat-shrinkable film. The coating serving to alleviate sticking between the heat-shrinkable film and the polymer wrapped primary package.

title_en: Composition for skin packaging, sealant for skin packaging, and packaging body for skin packaging
abstract_en: A composition for a skin pack is provided, which includes: an ionomer (A) of an ethylene/unsaturated carboxylic acid copolymer having a melt flow rate (JIS K 7210-1999, 190°C, 2160 g load) of 6 g/10 min or more; and a polyolefin (B) having a melt flow rate (JIS K 7210-1999, 190°C, 2160 g load) of 6 g/10 min or less, in which a content of the polyolefin (B) is from 20% by mass to 50% by mass with respect to 100% by mass of resin components in the composition for a skin pack.

title_en: Carbon dioxide reduction system and carbon dioxide reduction method
abstract_en: A carbon dioxide reduction system includes: an absorption tower configured to bring a source gas containing carbon dioxide into contact with an absorption liquid composed of an aqueous solution containing at least one amine compound so that the carbon dioxide is absorbed in the absorption liquid; an electrolysis apparatus for electrolyzing the carbon dioxide absorbed in the absorption liquid in the absorption tower; and a circulation line for circulating the absorption liquid between the absorption tower and the electrolysis apparatus.

title_en: Decorative laminated sheet, structure including the decorative laminated sheet, and method of manufacturing the same
abstract_en: A decorative laminated sheet with excellent scratch resistance that is capable of adhering to a polyolefin-based resin substrate having polypropylene units, and that is a hardly adhesive material, through a vacuum-pressure molding method. The decorative laminated sheet includes a surface layer, a design layer, and an adhesive layer containing a polymer having a propylene unit of 85 mass% or more and having a melting point of higher than 100°C, in that order.

title_en: Hydrogen fueling system
abstract_en: A hydrogen fueling system for generating hydrogen on demand is described. The system includes an electrolyzer configured to generate at least a predetermined quantity of hydrogen in a predetermined time when operated at no less than a predetermined current density and provided with at least a predetermined electrical energy over the predetermined time, where the predetermined quantity of hydrogen is at least 1 kg of hydrogen, the predetermined time is no more than 30 minutes, and the predetermined current density is at least 5 A/cm 2 . The system may further include an electrical energy storage system electrically connected to the electrolyzer and capable of supplying at least 20% of the predetermined electrical energy over the predetermined time. The electrolyzer may include an anode including a plurality of acicular particles dispersed in an ionomer binder, where the acicular particles include iridium.

title_en: Thermal lensing electrode in thermoelectric generators for improved performance
abstract_en: Exemplary thermoelectric devices and methods are disclosed herein. Thermoelectric generator performance is increased by the shaping isothermal fields within the bulk of a thermoelectric pellet, resulting in an increase in power output of a thermoelectric generator module. In one embodiment, a thermoelectric device includes a pellet comprising a semiconductor material, a first metal layer surrounding a first portion of the pellet, and a second metal layer surrounding a second portion of the pellet. The first and second metal layers are configured proximate to one another about a perimeter of the pellet. The pellet is exposed at the perimeter. And the perimeter is configured at a sidewall height about the pellet to provide a non-linear effect on a power output of the thermoelectric device by modifying an isotherm surface curvature within the pellet. The device also includes a metal container thermally and electrically bonded to the pellet.

title_en: Insulated glass units with low cte center panes
abstract_en: An insulated glass unit includes a first pane, a second pane, and a third pane between the first and second panes, and a first sealed gap space between the first pane and the third pane and a second sealed gap space between the second pane and the third pane. The third pane comprises first glass sheet having a coefficient of thermal expansion (CTE) over a temperature range 0 to about 300°C of less than about 70 x 10 -7 /°C.

title_en: Electrical device for characterizing a deposition step such as atomic layer deposition (ald), and corresponding methods of fabricating and characterizing
abstract_en:
The invention concerns an electrical device for characterizing at least one deposition step, the device comprising a first electrical component (110A) and a second electrical component (110B) comprising respectively a first portion (103A) and a second portion (103B) of a conductive layer (102), 
the first electrical component comprising a first 3D structure (105A) comprising at least one first opening (107A) extending in a layer comprising an insulating material, 
the second electrical component comprising a second 3D structure (105B) comprising at least one second opening (107B) extending in a layer comprising an insulating material. 
     The two 3D structures have different shapes so as to allow characterizing the deposition step. 
     The invention also concerns a method of fabricating and a method of characterizing.

title_en: Double-sided metal-clad laminate and production method therefor, insulating film, and electronic circuit base board
abstract_en: A method of producing a double-sided metal-clad laminate comprises a supplying step of supplying an insulating film interposed between two metal foils continuously to between a pair of endless belts, a heat and pressure applying step of forming a laminate of the insulating film and the metal foils by heating and applying a pressure to the insulating film and the metal foils under predetermined condition while the insulating film is interposed by the two metal foils in between the endless belts, and a cooling step of cooling the laminate, wherein the insulating film has a thickness of 10 to 500 µm, a degree of planar orientation of 30% or more, an average coefficient of linear expansion in an MD direction of -40 to 0 ppm/K and an average coefficient of linear expansion in a TD direction of 0 to 120 ppm/K. A double-sided metal-clad produced by the method, an insulating film used for the method and an electric circuit board using the double-sided metal-clad are also provided.

title_en: Method of finishing a metallic surface
abstract_en: A method of finishing a metallic surface includes the steps of: disposing a mask layer onto an initial metallic surface of a substrate; etching at least a portion of the initial metallic surface with an etchant to provide an etched surface, and separating the etchant from the etched surface. The etched surface is smoother than the initial metallic surface. On a depth basis: the etchant etches said at least a portion of the mask layer and said at least a portion of the initial metallic surface at substantially the same rate; and/or the etchant penetrates said at least a portion of the mask layer and etches said at least a portion of the initial metallic surface at substantially the same rate. A substrate finished by the disclosed method and a kit for practicing the method are also disclosed.

title_en: Electronic component processing film and electronic component processing method
abstract_en: An electronic component processing film, comprising an adhesion layer and a substrate layer, and satisfying at least one of (1) the adhesion layer comprises a terephthalic acid ester and the substrate layer comprises a reaction product of an aliphatic dicarboxylic acid and a glycol; (2) having a tackiness of 40 gf or more and a SUS adhesion of 1.1 N/25 mm or more; or (3) the adhesion layer has a thickness of 12 µm or more.

title_en: Wrapper for aerosol generating article and method of manufacturing same
abstract_en: A method of manufacturing a wrapper for an aerosol generating article includes applying an adhesive to one surface of a metal layer and attaching a first paper layer thereto, applying the adhesive to the other surface of the metal layer and attaching thereto a second paper layer different from the first paper layer, and drying the adhesive applied between the metal layer and the first paper layer and the adhesive applied between the metal layer and the second paper layer.

title_en: Steel sheet and method for manufacturing same
abstract_en: This steel sheet has a predetermined chemical composition, the metallographic structure includes, by an area ratio, ferrite, bainite and pearlite: 0 to 10% in total, residual austenite: 1 to 15%, and a remainder that is martensite, and a proportion of martensite or residual austenite having a width of 50 nm to 2 µm present at a prior austenite grain boundary is 70% or more.

title_en: Electromagnetic steel sheet with insulation coating film
abstract_en: To provide an electrical steel sheet with an insulating coating that is excellent in adhesion strength to an anaerobic acrylic adhesive, corrosion resistance, and tension pad resistance. Disclosed is an electrical steel sheet with an insulating coating formed by applying a surface-treatment agent to at least one surface of the electrical steel sheet and drying the surface-treatment agent, wherein the surface-treatment agent contains: certain trialkoxysilane and/or dialkoxysilane (A); a silane coupling agent (B) that does not contain a polymerizable unsaturated group in its structure; plate-like silica (C); a polymerizable unsaturated-group-containing compound (D); and water, within a range satisfying the following conditions (1) to (3): (1) a mass ratio (A/B) of (A) to (B) is from 0.05 to 1.00; (2) a content of (C) is 2 mass% to 30 mass% with respect to a total mass of (A) to (D) in the surface-treatment agent; and (3) a content of (D) is 2 mass% to 18 mass% with respect to the total mass of (A) to (D) in the surface-treatment agent.

title_en: A packaging container comprising a container body and a base disc
abstract_en: A packaging container (1, 101, 201) comprising a container body (2, 201, 202) having a bottom end (4, 104, 204) and a top end (5, 105, 205). The container body (2, 102, 202) comprises a tubular container wall (3, 103, 203) The packaging container (1, 101, 201) is closed at the bottom end (4, 104, 204) by a base disc (9, 109, 209) which is attached to the inner surface (7, 107, 207) of the container body (2, 102, 202) at the bottom end (4, 4, 204)of the container body (2, 102, 202). The packaging container comprises a top end closure including a lid (16, 116, 216). The container body (2, 102, 202) comprises a laminate body sheet material (12) comprising a carton layer (12a) and a thermoplastic welding layer (12c) being arranged on an inner surface (7, 107, 207) of the container body (2, 102, 202). The base disc (9, 109, 209) comprises a laminate base sheet material (13) comprising a carton layer (13a) and an inner thermoplastic welding layer (13c) being arranged on a surface of the base disc (9, 109, 209) which is facing towards the interior of the container body (2, 102, 202). The inner thermoplastic welding layer (12c) of the laminate body sheet material (12) has a basis weight of from 12g/m  2  to 75 g/m  2 , such as from, 20g/m  2  to 70g/m  2 , such as from 35 g/m  2  to 65 g/m  2 , such as from 40 g/m  2  to 60 g/m  2 ,such as from 45 g/m  2  to 55 g/m  2  and a combined basis weight of said thermoplastic welding layer (12c) of said laminate body sheet material (12) and said thermoplastic welding layer (13c) of said base sheet material (13) is from 50 g/m  2  to 210g/m  2 , such as from 100 g/m  2  to 180 g/m  2 , such as from 110 g/m  2  to 170 g/m  2 ,or from 120 g/m  2  to 150 g/m  2 .

title_en: Apparatus for electroless metallization of a target surface of at least one workpiece, and method and diffuser plate for the purpose
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus (1) for electroless metallization of a target surface of at least one workpiece (5), having a vessel (10) to accommodate a metallizing solution having an inlet (15) and an outlet (16) for the metallizing solution, and a holder (20) which is for accommodating the at least one workpiece (5) and can be arranged within the vessel (10), wherein at least one diffuser plate (30) is provided between the at least one inlet (15) and the holder (20) and has a multitude of diffuser openings (35) spaced apart in the plane of a plate (E), and wherein a movement device (40) is provided, which can move the diffuser plate (30) in at least one spatial direction in the vessel (10). The present invention further relates to a process for electroless metallization of the target surface of the at least one workpiece (5).

title_en: Coated cutting tool
abstract_en: Provided is a coated cutting tool in which a surface of a substrate is coated with a hard coating film. The hard coating film includes: a layer (A) disposed on the surface of the substrate, and having a face-centered cubic lattice structure, in which the total content ratio of W and Ti is at least 85 atomic%, and which contains W as the most abundant element and Ti as the next most abundant element among metal (including metalloid) elements; and a layer (B) disposed on the layer (A) and having a face-centered cubic lattice structure, which is composed of nitrides or carbonitrides containing Al, Cr, and Si, and in which, among metal (including metalloid) elements, the Al content ratio is at least 50 atomic%, the total content ratio of Al and Cr is at least 85 atomic%, and the Si content ratio is 4 to 15 atomic%.

title_en: Surface treatment method for metal powder, and surface-passivated metal powder
abstract_en: Provided is a surface treatment method of metal powder and surface passivated metal powder. Herein, the surface treatment method uses passivation solution to treat the metal powder, to form a passivation film on the surface of the metal powder; the passivation solution passes through the metal powder by a flowing method; and the average particle size of the metal powder is 0.1~100 µm. A problem in the prior art that the metal powder is easily oxidized is solved, and it is suitable for the field of metal anti-oxidation.

title_en: Laminate and standing pouch
abstract_en: A laminate according to the present disclosure includes a substrate layer and a heat-sealing layer. A fold of the laminate produced by a weight of a 2 kg roller has a folding angle of 20 to 55°, and a content of polyethylene in the laminate is 90% by mass or more. The folding angle may be 25 to 55°. The substrate layer may contain high-density polyethylene. The substrate layer may be a uniaxially oriented linear low-density polyethylene film or an unstretched film made of polyethylene.

title_en: Electrode for electrolysis, laminate, wound body, electrolyzer, method for producing electrolyzer, method for renewing electrode, method for renewing laminate, and method for producing wound body
abstract_en: A method for producing a new electrolyzer by arranging an electrode for electrolysis or a laminate of the electrode for electrolysis and a new membrane in an existing electrolyzer comprising an anode, a cathode that is opposed to the anode, and a membrane that is arranged between the anode and the cathode, wherein the electrode for electrolysis or the laminate, being in a wound body form, is used.

title_en: Fire-rated structural osb panels with overlaid water-resistant barrier
abstract_en: A wood or engineered wood structural panel, such as, but not limited to, OSB ( "oriented strand board ") or plywood, that is both fire-resistant and water resistant. The panel is factory-coated with a product that provides fire resistance. The treatment gives it a Fire-Resistant (FR) performance (for use in a one- or two-hour rated assembly). The panel also is overlaid or coated in a factory setting with a weather/water resistive barrier (WRB). The structural panel thus combines a fire-resistant structural sheathing and WRB product in one integrated panel produced at a factory prior for installation at a job site.

title_en: Composite dispersant, preparation method therefor, mixed electroplating solution, and preparation method therefor
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the field of material technologies, and more particularly to a compound dispersant which is composed of distilled water, a nonionic surfactant, an anionic surfactant and a wetting agent. The nonionic surfactant is a Tween compound, and the anionic surfactant is hydrocarbyl sulfate salts; and the compound dispersant can block or slow down agglomeration of graphene in a dispersion solution. The present invention further relates to a preparation method of the compound dispersant, which is simple to operate. The present invention further relates to a mixed electroplating solution containing the compound dispersant, in which the graphene is dispersed uniformly and stably. The present invention further relates to a preparation method of the mixed electroplating solution, in which graphene is distributed uniformly and stably.

title_en: Plated steel material
abstract_en: A coated steel product including a base steel, and a coating layer containing a Zn-Al-Mg alloy layer disposed on a surface of the base steel, in which the coating layer has a predetermined chemical composition, the coated steel product including dendrite-shaped MgZn 2  phase having a surface roughness Sa of 50 nm or less on a surface of the Zn-Al-Mg alloy layer, an area ratio of the dendrite-shaped MgZn 2  phase having a surface roughness Sa of 50 nm or less being from 30% to 80% within a region of an observable field of view of 5 mm 2 , and among the dendrite-shaped MgZn 2  phase having a surface roughness Sa of 50 nm or less, a number of dendrite-shaped MgZn 2 , phase having an area of 0.1 mm 2  or more being from 5 to 100 within a region of an observable field of view of 25 mm 2 .

title_en: Die machine and drive member installed thereon
abstract_en: A drive member for driving a sheet of workpiece through a die machine including a backing layer comprising a first surface defined in a first dimension by a first width and defined in a second dimension by a first length and a padding layer comprising a first surface defined in the first dimension by a second width and defined in the second dimension by a second length, where the padding layer is composed of a compressible foam material. In an uncompressed state of the padding layer, the second length of the padding layer is longer than the first length of the backing layer, and in a compressed state of the padding layer, the padding layer is compressed along the second dimension to match the first length of the backing layer, and the first surface of the padding layer is bonded to the first surface of the backing layer.

title_en: Polypropylene film, laminate, packaging material, and packing body
abstract_en: The present invention addresses the problem of providing a polypropylene film which is structurally stable to heat in deposition when used for packaging, and has appropriate slipperiness without using an anti-blocking agent or particles, and thus has excellent water vapor barrier properties and oxygen barrier properties, in particular, when a transparent deposited layer is laminated. Moreover, the present invention provides a polypropylene film characterized by having at least two types of layers (A layer and B layer) containing a polypropylene-based resin as a main component, wherein the B layer contains a thermoplastic resin incompatible with a polypropylene-based resin, and when the skewnesses Ssk of the A layer and the B layer, as measured through three-dimensional noncontact surface shape measurement, are Ssk (A) and Ssk (B), respectively, the Ssk (B) is at least 5 and the Ssk (A) is less than 5.

title_en: Method and system for electroplating article with metal
abstract_en: The object of the present invention is to provide a method and system for electroplating without requiring ancillary facilities or anolyte control, while using an anode which can be relatively easily produced without requiring an expensive metal or special metal. When electroplating an article with metal, decomposition of an organic compound additive in a plating bath can be suppressed by using, as an anode, a conductive substrate having a layer comprising oxide or nitride of nickel and iron formed on a surface thereof.

title_en: Barrier film
abstract_en: A barrier film includes: a first layer including calcium carbonate; and a second layer on the first layer, the second layer including an ethylene vinyl alcohol copolymer. A container includes at least one side including a barrier film including: a first layer including calcium carbonate; and a second layer on the first layer, the second layer including an ethylene vinyl alcohol copolymer.

title_en: Surface modification sheet, laminate, surface modification member, painted object, surface modification member manufacturing method, and painted object manufacturing method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to: a surface-modifying sheet including a release sheet and a surface-modifying layer, wherein the surface-modifying layer has a 160°C storage modulus of 5.0×10 3  to 1.0×10 7  Pa and the surface-modifying layer has a surface tension of 38 mN/m or higher; a laminate; a surface-modified member and a coated article both produced using the surface-modifying sheet; a method for producing the surface-modified member; and a method for producing the coated article.

title_en: Electrochemical conversion of organic waste
abstract_en: The present disclosure refers to a method of electrochemical conversion of organic waste to organic acid and hydrogen, comprising the steps of: (i) subjecting organic waste to ball milling under alkaline or acidic conditions to obtain pre-treated organic waste; (ii) introducing the pre-treated organic waste to a first compartment of an electrochemical cell, wherein the electrochemical cell comprises: the first compartment containing a nickel-based anode, a second compartment containing a cathode, and an electrolyte; and (iii) applying an electrical potential between the anode and the cathode, thereby producing organic acid at the anode, and hydrogen at the cathode. The present disclosure also refers to an organic acid or hydrogen produced from the method disclosed herein.

title_en: Electrolysis cell, electrolysis device for chlor-alkali electrolysis and use of an electrolysis cell for chlor-alkali electrolysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to an electrolysis cell (1) for chlor-alkali electrolysis, comprising an anode chamber (2) for accommodating an anode (4) and for accommodating an electrolytic solution, wherein the anode chamber (2) comprises a circulation structure (5) for improving circulation of the electrolytic solution and at least one baffle plate (6) for improving horizontal homogeneity of the electrolytic solution, as well as to an electrolysis device including such an electrolysis cell (1) and the use of the electrolysis cell (1) for chlor-alkali electrolysis.

title_en: Activation of self-passivating metals using reagent coatings for low temperature nitrocarburization in the presence of oxygen-containing gas
abstract_en: A method for low-temperature interstitial case formation on a self-passivating metal workpiece includes exposing the workpiece in a heated gaseous environment comprising oxygen to pyrolysis products of a nonpolymeric reagent comprising nitrogen and carbon.

title_en: Roller for transporting a flexible substrate, vacuum processing apparatus, and method ofcooling a roller
abstract_en: A roller (100) for transporting a flexible substrate is described. The roller (100) includes a first coolant supply (110) for cooling a first part (101) of the roller (100) and a second coolant supply (120) for cooling a second part (102) and a third part (103) of the roller (100). The first part (101) is provided between the second part (102) and the third part (103). Additionally, a vacuum processing apparatus including a roller and a method of cooling a roller are described.

title_en: Electrolyzer for producing hydrogen and method for the production of hydrogen, and use of the electrolyser
abstract_en:
The present invention is related to an electrolyzer for producing hydrogen and to a method for the production of hydrogen, as well as to a use of the electrolyser. 
     The electrolyzer for producing hydrogen (210) comprises a plurality of electrolysis cells (1) arranged in a plurality of planes (2), each having at least one anode (10) and one cathode (11) and a proton exchange membrane (3) between the anode (10) and the cathode (11), the proton exchange membranes (3) forming respective active area regions (30), wherein at least one electrolysis cell (1) has a plurality of active area regions (30) arranged substantially in a plane (2).

title_en: Devices with improved antibacterial surface
abstract_en: A medical device includes a substrate structure with a surface. The surface is laser treated to define at least one protrusion and/or at least one void extending relative to the surface. A coating having antibacterial, antimicrobial and/or drug eluding properties is applied to the substrate structure such that the coating engages within or along a surface portion of one or more of the protrusions and/or voids.

title_en: Exterior material for home appliance and refrigerator comprising same
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to an exterior material for home appliances and a refrigerator including the same. In accordance with one embodiment, an exterior material for home appliances includes: a steel sheet whose yield strength is 350 to 410 MPa; a base coating layer provided on the steel sheet; and a clear coating layer provided on the base coating layer. Also, a depth of embossments may be 70 to 90 µm.

title_en: Multilayer films readily disintegrating in a marine environment
abstract_en: Multlayer films which are highly biodegradable in a marine environment and highly disintegratable in domestic composting comprising an aliphatic polyester, an aliphatic-aromatic polyester, one or more lactic acid polyesters and optionally an inorganic filler, a cross-linking agent and/or a chain extender.

title_en: Surface-smoothened metal member and method for manufacturing same
abstract_en: Provided are a surface-smoothened metal member and a method for easily and effectively manufacturing the same, said surface-smoothened metal member having been smoothened to such an extent that in a surface of a large metal member formed from titanium or a titanium alloy, a flat surface portion has a maximum height roughness (Rz) of 1.1 µm or less and a portion with a curvature radius of 0.05 to 2.5 mm has a maximum height roughness (Rz) of less than 2 µm. This method for manufacturing the surface-smoothened metal member is characterized in that an anodic oxide film is formed on a surface of a substrate formed from titanium or a titanium alloy by applying an anodization treatment to the substrate, and the surface of the substrate is smoothened by removing the anodic oxide film.

title_en: Pressure control system and electrolysis facility with pressure control system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pressure control system (1) for pressure control of at least two pressurized fluid systems (2, 3) comprising a duct (4, 5) for each fluid system (2, 3) having an inlet (6, 7) connectable to the respective fluid system (2, 3) and an outlet (8, 9), a pressure control valve (10, 11) arranged within each of the ducts (4, 5) to control the fluid flow from the inlet (6, 7) to the outlet (8, 9) of the duct (4, 5), wherein the pressure control valves (10, 11) are pilot-operated pressure relief valves having an inlet port (12, 13) for a pilot gas to affect a cracking pressure of the pressure control valves (10, 11), wherein the pressure control system (1) further comprises a common pilot gas buffer system (14), which is connected to each of the inlet ports (12, 13) of the pressure control valves (10, 11) for a simultaneous pressure control of the fluid systems (2, 3).

title_en: Droplet ejection device and adjustment method for multi-nozzle head
abstract_en: A droplet ejection device includes an ink supply unit configured to supply ink, a replaceable multi-nozzle head arranged away from the ink supply unit and having a plurality of droplet ejection nozzles configured to eject droplets including the ink by an electrostatic ejection method, a mounting unit configured to mount the multi-nozzle head, an inspection unit configured to inspect an inclination of the multi-nozzle head mounted on the mounting unit, and, an adjusting unit configured to adjust the inclination of the multi-nozzle head based on an inspection result of the multi-nozzle head.

title_en: Laminate and method for producing laminate
abstract_en: Provided are a laminate including a first resin layer, an inorganic layer, and a second resin layer, in which a mixed layer is provided between the first resin layer and the inorganic layer and between the second resin layer and the inorganic layer; and a manufacturing method of a laminate.

title_en: Paper-based multilayer packaging materials and methods
abstract_en: A multilayer packaging material includes a substrate formed of a cellulosic fiber-based material. The substrate has a first major surface and a second major surface opposite the first major surface. An oxygen barrier layer is formed of a PVOH material attached to the substrate, wherein the oxygen barrier layer is an innermost layer of the multilayer packaging material and further wherein the oxygen barrier layer is heat sealable. At least one moisture barrier layer is attached to the substrate, the moisture barrier layer selected from an inner moisture barrier layer disposed intermediate the substrate and the oxygen barrier layer and an outer moisture barrier layer disposed on the second major surface of the substrate. In further aspects, a packaging article, a method for making a multilayer packaging material, and a method for packaging a product are provided.

title_en: Cartridge assembly and method of assembling a cartridge assembly
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a cartridge assembly and to a method of assembling a cartridge assembly, such a cartridge assembly may comprise first and second cartridges for storing first and second materials; a head part arranged at a first outlet of the first cartridge, the head part forming at least a part of an outlet arrangement of the cartridge assembly; the outlet arrangement; a plug element arranged at a second outlet of the second cartridge and closing the second outlet of the second cartridge in a storage state, the plug element being configured to be introduced into the head part and to cooperate with a closure of the outlet arrangement, the closure being removable from and attachable to the first and second outlets of the first and second cartridges, wherein the plug element is removed from the second outlet on removal of said closure from the cartridge assembly and is insertable into said second outlet on replacement of the closure at the cartridge assembly.

title_en: Organo-titanates as adhesion promoter for anti-noise shim on brake pads, associated brake pad and method
abstract_en: For promoting adhesion of an anti-noise shim (6) to a surface (7) of a metallic support (2) of a braking element (1) normally painted with an epoxy resin and by means of gluing the anti-noise shim (6) to the surface by means of an acrylic glue, the surface (7) is pre-treated by applying a primer onto the epoxy resin paint layer (9), the primer consisting in an organo-titanate (10) diluted in an organic solvent, preferably an alcoholic polar solvent; the organo-titanate (10) is preferably a tetra-alkoxy titanium (IV) represented by the general formula Ti(OR)4.

title_en: Method of using a tle system and tle system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method of using a thermal laser evaporation (TLE) system (10), the TLE system (10) comprising a reaction chamber (12) fillable with a reaction atmosphere (14), a substrate (16) arranged in the reaction chamber (12), one or more sources (40) arranged in the reaction chamber (12), each source (40) comprising a source element (50) consisting of a source material (52), and a laser source (20) for providing a heating laser beam (22) impinging with a heating spot (24) on a top surface (60) of the source element (50) and thereby evaporating or sublimating the source material (52) from an active area (62) on the top surface (60) of the source element (50) for providing a flux (54) of evaporated or sublimated source material (52) for a deposition onto the substrate (16). Further, the invention relates to a thermal laser evaporation (TLE) system (10), the TLE system (10) comprising a reaction chamber (12) fillable with a reaction atmosphere (14), a substrate (16) arranged in the reaction chamber (12), one or more sources (40) arranged in the reaction chamber (12), each source (40) comprising a source element (50) consisting of a source material (52), and a laser source (20) for providing a heating laser beam (22) impinging with a heating spot (24) on a top surface (60) of the source element (50) and thereby evaporating or sublimating the source material (52) from an active area (62) on the top surface (60) of the source element (50) for providing a flux (54) of evaporated or sublimated source material (52) for a deposition onto the substrate (16).

title_en: Curable organopolysiloxane composition for transducers, cured product of same, and transducer and others each provided with said cured product
abstract_en: [Problem] To provide a curable organopolysiloxane composition that yields a organopolysiloxane cured product having viscoelastic properties (particularly, reversion characteristics after deformation due to external stress) that are particularly suitable for use as a dielectric layer or a transducer, and a method of use thereof. [Resolution Means] A curable organopolysiloxane composition for transducers, containing, (a) a chain organopolysiloxane or mixture thereof having a weight-average molecular weight (Mw(a)) of less than 8.0×10 4 , and (b1) a crosslinking agent, (b2) a chain length extender, and (c) a hydrosilylation reaction catalyst, wherein the molar quantity of Si-H (H b1 , H b2 ) in component (b1) and component (b2) and the molar quantity of curable reactive groups (Vi) in component (a), satisfy the following relationship: p x1  ={ H b1 / H b2 }/{(H b1 + H b2 )/Vi} and wherein the obtained by dividing Mw(a) by the value of p x1  (=Mw(a)/p x1 ) is in a range of 1,000 to 8,000.

title_en: Laminating device for laminating multilayer endless webs for producing energy cells
abstract_en: The invention relates to a laminating device for a multilayer endless web (3), which is made of at least one separator web (4, 6) and at least one electrode (5), for producing energy cells, comprising a press device which laminates the multilayer endless web (3) while exerting a compressive force. The press device has a press surface with at least one recess which is arranged such that when the compressive force is being exerted via the press surface, the recess overlaps with at least one of the edges (14, 15, 16, 17) of the electrodes (5, 7).

title_en: Cooling system for an electrochemical plant
abstract_en: The present disclosure advantageously provides an improved cooling system for an electrochemical plant. The configurations disclosed herein provide advantages and improvements in a cooling system for the electrochemical plant. The cooling system advantageously cools multiple subsystems within the plant using dry coolers, thereby easing maintenance and access to various components within the plant, minimizing or reducing the amount of process piping within the plant used to cool the multiple subsystems, and reducing the complexity of the overall plant.

title_en: High temperature control rods for light water reactors
abstract_en: A high temperature control rod (22) for a nuclear fuel assembly (10) is described herein that includes a neutron absorbing material (24) having a melting point greater than 1500 °C that does not form a eutectic with a melting point less than 1500 °C, and may further include a cladding material (30) having a melting point greater than 1500 °C. The cladding material (30) is selected from the group consisting of silicon carbide, zirconium, a zirconium alloy, tungsten, and molybdenum. The absorbing material (24) is selected from the group consisting of Gd 2 O 3 , Ir, B 4 C, Re, and Hf. The metal cladding (30) or the absorbing material (24) may be coated with an anti-oxidation coating (26) of Cr with or without a Nb intermediate layer (28).

title_en: Method for producing a packaging article and a packaging article
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for producing a packaging article, the method comprising the following steps: - supplying, in particular continuously supplying, a base material (1), the base material (1) being paper, in particular Kraft paper, having an stretch at break in machine direction (MD) of at least 5% according to ISO 1924-3:2005, - plastically deforming the base material (1 ) for providing a structured layer (2), wherein deforming is performed at a temperature of between 10°C and 40°C, and wherein the base material (1) during deforming has an absolute water content of between 5% and 20%, - joining the structured layer (2) on at least one side thereof with an essentially flat cover material (3), the cover material (3) being paper, in particular Kraft paper, such that a compound layer (4) is formed, - forming a packaging article (5) from the compound layer (4), said packaging article (5) having at least one interior space (6) for receiving the object to be packaged.

title_en: Electrode
abstract_en: An electrode according to an embodiment includes a support and a catalyst layer having a structure in which sheet layers and gap layers are laminated alternately. The gap layers comprise a first oxide comprising a first element which is one or more elements selected from the group consisting of Ti, Al, Ta, Nb, Hf, Zr, Zn, W, Bi, and Sb.

title_en: Easy tear laminates for food packaging
abstract_en: Described herein are multi-layer laminates and methods of manufacturing said laminates, including multi-layer laminates having improved tear resistance without compromising on other properties such as strength or processability. The disclosed multi-layer laminates include at least a first layer that is suitable for use in a food packaging article, and provides easy tearability (i.e., low or very low tear resistance). In embodiments, this easy tear layer may form the outermost layer of the food packaging article and thereby enable a consumer to tear the food packaging article without the use of a tool such as a knife or a pair of scissors.

title_en: Sic epitaxial wafer, method for manufacturing sic epitaxial wafer, and sic device
abstract_en: What is provided is a SiC epitaxial wafer and a SiC device having a SiC epitaxial layer in which a carrier lifetime can be estimated and a variation in a density of a Z 1/2  center in a depth direction is curbed. The SiC epitaxial wafer includes a substrate and a SiC epitaxial layer formed on a first surface of the substrate, wherein a uniformity of the density of the Z 1/2  centers in the depth direction in the SiC epitaxial layer is less than 0.5 (%/µm).

title_en: Multilayer body, method for producing same, packaging material, and coating agent
abstract_en: Disclosed is a multilayer body which sequentially has a base material 1, an adhesive layer, and a base material 2 in this order, and which additionally has a coating layer. The base material 1 and the base material 2 contain a polyolefin resin. The coating layer contains a resin (A) which has a glass transition point of 115°C or higher. When heat and pressure are applied to the multilayer body under the heating and pressurization conditions described below, the shrinkage ratio of the multilayer body expressed by (formula 1) is 30% by area or less. (Heating and pressurization conditions) Heating temperature: 145°C Pressurization: 2 kg/cm 2  Heating and pressurization time: 1 second (Formula 1): Shrinkage ratio (% by area) = (1 - (area after heating and pressurization)/(area before heating and pressurization)) × 100

title_en: Photocatalyst member and method for producing photocatalyst member
abstract_en: This photocatalyst member is a photocatalyst member containing, in the following order, a base material, an underlying layer, and a photocatalyst layer formed in contact with the underlying layer, in which the underlying layer is a composite oxide of cerium and zinc, and the photocatalyst layer contains titanium oxide.

title_en: A liquid dispensing device for activating an adhesive layer of a sheet and a method for using the liquid dispensing device
abstract_en: A liquid dispensing device (1) for activating an adhesive layer (4) of a sheet (2) comprises an inlet (3) configured to provide the sheet (2) having the adhesive layer (4). A liquid supply (5) for an activating liquid (6) is configured to be dispensed to a surface of the roller (7). The roller (7) for the activating liquid (6) is configured to dispense the liquid and activate the adhesive layer (4). The roller (7) comprises a perforated roller surface (71). Openings (72) of the perforated roller surface (71) are configured to define inactive areas (41) on the adhesive layer (4), causing the activated adhesive layer to be interspersed with inactiveareas (41).

title_en: Compostable material for a container, a container made thereof and a method for manufacturing compostable material for a container
abstract_en: The invention relates to compostable packaging material comprising a fibrous sheet and a coextruded coating of two or more layers of compostable polymer as well as a method for manufacturing and using such material.

title_en: Low-profile electrolytic copper foil for high-density interconnection circuit board
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the field of copper foil, and in particular to low-profile electrolytic copper foil for a high-density interconnection circuit board. The electrolytic copper foil sequentially comprises a copper foil layer, a roughening treatment layer, a protective barrier layer, a passivation layer and a silane coupling agent layer, wherein the copper foil layer has a thickness of 6-35μm, a weight per unit area of 50-305 g/m2 with a weight deviation per unit area less than 5%, a tensile strength more than or equal to 350 N/mm2 at 25°C, an elongation more than or equal to 4% at 25°C, a peeling strength more than or equal to 0.7 kg/cm, a roughness of a smooth surface Ra less than or equal to 0.43μm, and a roughness of a rough surface Rz less than or equal to 3.5μm. The electrolytic copper foil provided in the present invention has simple raw materials, is non-toxic and harmless, safe and environment-friendly, has an excellent room-temperature tensile strength and a high-temperature tensile strength, can endure a high temperature of 200°C and has both a good flatness and a low profile, is simple in terms of operation, can completely meet market requirements for electrolytic copper foil for a high-density interconnection circuit board, and has a high added value, a broad environmental applicability and remarkable market competitiveness.

title_en: Multi-material joint
abstract_en: A multimaterial component (figure 3) (e.g. an aircraft pylon) may have a nickel-based superalloy member at one end; a titanium alloy member at the other end; and a transition member 50 therebetween, to aid joining of the Ti & Ni members. The transition member 50 may comprise a layer 52 of aged Inconel (RTM) 718 or nickel; and a layer 54 containing titanium. The transition layers 52, 54 may be joined together via explosion welding, linear friction welding, or rotary friction welding. A tantalum or BAu4 (Goldbraze 8218) thin film diffusion barrier 56 may help prevent or reduce diffusion of material between the layers 52, 54. A transition member may comprise VC nanoparticles; a V/Cu bilayer; tantalum; or Goldbraze 8218. A member may comprise a lattice, or channels with a fluid coolant, to cool and reduce thermal transfer (figure 4). Lateral motion constraints (brackets) may reduce shear stress (figure 5).

title_en: Rare earth rotary target and preparation method therefor
abstract_en: A rare earth rotary target and a preparation method therefor. The rare earth rotary target comprises a back tube (1) and at least one rare earth target tube (A) welded outside the back tube (1). The back tube (1) and the rare earth target tube (A) are welded by means of an intermediate welding layer. The intermediate welding layer comprises a metal indium solder (3) and an aluminum sheet (2) arranged in the metal indium solder (3), the aluminum content of the intermediate welding layer being 3-10 wt.%. The back tube (1), the aluminum sheet (2) and the rare earth target tube (A) are concentric cylindrical structures. From the aspects of target welding, solder alloying, etc., by means of additionally arranging the aluminum sheet (2) in the middle of the welding layer and combining a thermal treatment process, the melting point of solder is improved, thus achieving the purpose of improving the sputtering power density and a target utilization rate of rare earth rotary targets, realizing low-temperature welding, and slowing down oxidation of rare earth targets.

title_en: Front paint mask for a wheel
abstract_en: A wheel mask (100, Fig. 1) comprising at least one spoke masking portion 104 having a wheel facing surface (308, Fig. 3) which is configured to compliment a spoke portion of one of a plurality of spokes 202 of a wheel, such that when the mask is arranged on the wheel a spray resistant barrier is formed. Optionally the mask further comprises a rim masking portion 102, at least one guide 108 configured to be inserted into a bolt hole of the wheel, a hub portion 106, a handle (110, Fig. 1), and/or the mask may be formed of metal such as aluminium. Also defined is a wheel painting system 200, method (Fig. 4), and a vehicle. Figure 2

title_en: Sealant-integrated backside protection sheet for solar battery module, and solar battery module arranged by use thereof
abstract_en: To provide a sealant-integrated backside protection sheet for a solar battery module, which is improved so as to avoid the wrinkling peculiar to a sealant-integrated backside protection sheet and caused in integration into a solar battery module.SOLUTION: A sealant-integrated backside protection sheet 10 for a solar battery module is arranged by laminating a sealing material layer 1 including an olefin-based resin as a base resin, and a backside protection layer 2 including a polyester-based resin layer. In the sealant-integrated backside protection sheet 10, the sealing material layer 1 has a multilayer structure including a core layer 11 including a low-density polyethylene having a melting point of 100-115°C as a base resin, and a skin layer 12 including a low-density polyethylene having a melting point under 100°C as a base resin. The difference between the base resin of the core layer 11, and the base resin of the skin layer 12 in melting point is 20°C or less.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Production method of hard carbon film
abstract_en: To provide a simple method for forming a hard carbon film.SOLUTION: In a production method of a hard carbon film, a power supply unit, a discharge electrode containing a carbon material, and a substrate having a surface on which a film is formed are prepared and electric discharge is repeated between the discharge electrode and the substrate by the power supply unit to form a film containing the hard carbon material on the surface. The atmosphere in which the electric discharge is produced is an atmosphere containing any one or some of a hydrogen atom, an oxygen atom, a water molecule, a carbon dioxide molecule, and an oxygen molecule.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Production method of curable film
