abstract_en: To provide a production method of a curable film in which a b* value hardly becomes high in an L*a*b* color system, the curable film having high light reflectance can be formed and further the curable film having high hardness can be formed.SOLUTION: A production method of a curable film includes a light irradiation process forming the curable film by irradiating a photocurable composition containing a photocurable compound, a photoinitiator and a white pigment with light. In the light irradiation process, light is irradiated so that an integrated luminous quantity measured by a 254 nm optical receiver is 1,800 mJ/cm2 or less, an integrated luminous quantity measured by a 365 nm optical receiver is 750 mJ/cm2 or more and 4,000 mJ/cm2 or less and the integrated luminous quantity measured by the 254 nm optical receiver is smaller than that measured by the 365 nm optical receiver.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Multilayer structure and packaging material containing the same
abstract_en: To provide a multilayer structure that suppresses migration of a compound having 30 or less carbon atoms and having an SP value lower than that of an ethylene-vinyl alcohol copolymer from a recycled resin layer, and that has excellent bending resistance.SOLUTION: There is provided a multilayer structure that at least comprises: a recycled resin layer (A) containing a recycled resin (a) as a main component; a layer (B) containing a polyolefin resin (b) as a main component; and two or more barrier layers (C) containing ethylene-vinyl alcohol copolymer resin (c) as a main component, in which the barrier layers (C) are arranged on outside and inside of the recycled resin layer (A), and the recycled resin layer(A) comprises a compound having 30 or less carbon atoms and having an SP value lower than that of the ethylene-vinyl alcohol copolymer resin (c).SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Tape winding pipe and method of producing the same
abstract_en: To provide a laminate capable of easily controlling a shape in a melt press molding, and a tape winding pipe having an excellent balance between flexural rigidity and compression rigidity.SOLUTION: There are provided: a laminate having a laminated structure of five or more layers wherein each layer is a fiber-reinforced resin composition layer in which fibers are oriented in one direction, the resin in the fiber-reinforced resin composition layer is an olefin-based polymer having a melting point or a glass-transition temperature of 50 to 300°C; and a tape winding pipe including the laminate.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Decorative sheet and decorative resin molding
abstract_en: To provide a decorative sheet which achieves both excellent touch feeling and designability.SOLUTION: A decorative sheet is formed of a laminate including at least a substrate layer, a first resin layer, a partially provided raised layer, and a partially provided second resin layer in this order. The first resin layer is provided on at least a part of the substrate layer. The raised layer is partially provided on the first resin layer. The second resin layer is provided on at least a part of the raised layer. In a plan view of the decorative sheet from the second resin layer side, a part of the surface of the first resin layer is exposed. The first resin layer and the second resin layer have different glosses.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Piezoelectric single crystal element, manufacturing method thereof, and application thereof
abstract_en: To provide a piezoelectric single crystal element capable of increasing the manufacturing yield of an applicable device and capable of improving the dielectric property and the piezoelectric property, a manufacturing method thereof, and an application thereof.SOLUTION: A piezoelectric single crystal element 1 includes electrodes on both main surfaces of a rectangular single crystal plate composed of a lead composite perovskite composition containing magnesium oxide, niobium oxide, and lead titanate, in the single crystal plate 2, the (001) plane is the main plane, and the (100) plane and the (010) plane are the side surfaces, and the ratio L/W of the length L of the (100) orientation to the width W of the (010) orientation is 4 to 20. The frequency constant N31 represented by the product of the resonance frequency fr in the lateral vibration mode orthogonal to the polarization direction and the length l in the vibration direction is 520 to 700 Hz m at 25°C.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Antireflection structure and manufacturing method therefor
abstract_en: To provide an antireflection structure in which a thin film and a columnar film composed of metal oxide are respectively arranged to the surface and hole space of a substrate composed of a nano-structure with which a random variation in the depth of recesses tends to occur at machining time, resulting in a decrease in the random variation of hole depth and in the excellence of antireflection optical characteristic.SOLUTION: Provided is an antireflection structure in which a hole (Hn), of which the cross section perpendicular to the vertical direction is U- or V-shaped, is formed in plurality on a flat surface (S) of a transparent substrate (B), the average diameter (m) of the opening of the hole (Hn) being 50-300 nm, the average interval (k) of respective center points between adjacent openings being 100-400 nm, each depth (dn), referenced to the surface (S), being in the range 80-250 nm, and, furthermore, metal oxide is arranged on the surface (S) of the transparent substrate (B) and metal oxide (M) is arranged, as a columnar film, in each space (Cn) in an upward direction from the bottom of each hole (Hn), with the result that a difference in depth (fn) between each hole (Hn) is reduced.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Vapor phase growth apparatus
abstract_en: To provide a vapor phase growth apparatus that suppresses contact between a wafer supported by a carrier and a susceptor on which the carrier is mounted, when the carrier supporting the wafer is mounted on the susceptor to form an epitaxial film.SOLUTION: In a vapor phase growth apparatus 1 including a reaction chamber 111 for forming a CVD film on a wafer WF by using a ring-like carrier C supporting an outer peripheral part of the wafer WF, the reaction chamber 111 has a susceptor 112 mounting thereon the carrier C supporting the wafer WF. An upper surface C12 supporting the outer peripheral part of the wafer WF of the carrier C and an opposite surface 112a of the susceptor 112 to the wafer WF respectively have counterbore surfaces Fc, Fs with a curvature corresponding to a warp occurring on the wafer WF during the formation of the CVD film. The counterbore surfaces Fc, Fs are formed as a series of surfaces along the upper surface C12 and the opposite surface.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Resin composition, film and multilayer structure
abstract_en: To provide a resin composition that has excellent gas barrier properties, especially oxygen barrier properties under high humidity conditions.SOLUTION: A resin composition contains a polyvinyl alcohol resin. When the resin composition is made into a film, a degree of oxygen permeation (cc 3 μm/m2 day atm) at 23°C and 80%RH satisfies the following formula (1): degree of oxygen permeation (cc 3 μm/m2 day atm)≤80.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Composite molded article
abstract_en: To provide a composite molded article having excellent adhesion to other materials such as sheet materials and a method for producing the same, and a laminate.SOLUTION: The present disclosure provides a composite molded article in which thermoplastic resin foam particles are bonded via a thermosetting resin binder, wherein the density of the composite molded article is 0.05-0.5 g/cm3, and the volume expansion coefficient of the composite molded article when heated for 20 minutes at 100°C is 15-200%.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Substrate processing apparatus
abstract_en: To provide a substrate processing apparatus capable of appropriately processing a substrate even when the viscosity of treatment liquid is high.SOLUTION: A coating unit 40 and a liquid feeding unit 32 are housed in a lower processing chamber 121. A space in the lower processing chamber 121 is divided into a lower space R1 and an upper space R2 by a partition wall 123. The liquid feeding unit 32 is arranged in the lower space R1 of the lower processing chamber 121, and the coating unit 40 is arranged in the upper space R2 of the lower processing chamber 121. Treatment liquid is sent to the coating unit 40 through a flow path by the liquid feeding unit 32. A substrate W is processed by the coating unit 40 using the treatment liquid by the liquid feeding unit 32.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Medical protective material with polytetrafluoroethylene as base material, production method of the same and medical protective wear
abstract_en: SOLUTION: A medical protective material with polytetrafluoroethylene as a base material, a production method of the material, and a medical protective wear are provided. The medical protective material with polytetrafluoroethylene as the base material includes: a polytetrafluoroethylene fiber fabric; and polytetrafluoroethylene fine porous films for covering one side or both sides of the polytetrafluoroethylene fiber fabric.EFFECT: The present invention includes polytetrafluoroethylene fiber fabric, uses a medical protective material with polytetrafluoroethylene as a base material and provides a colored sign tape and conductive fibers for the polytetrafluoroethylene fiber fabric. Thus, high strength is applied to medical protective wear, the wear can repetitively be used, characteristics of conductivity that does not change over time and easily recognizable performance can be obtained, and polytetrafluoroethylene fine porous films and melt-blown non-woven fabric are arranged. Thus, protective effect can effectively and safely be achieved, and medical workers can avoid cross infection due to virus, respiratory infection and the like.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Decorative sheet and decorative resin molding
abstract_en: To provide a decorative sheet having a rugged shape at a surface on an outside thereof, the decorative sheet having excellent chemical resistance, and capable of favorably maintaining the rugged shape even through molding.SOLUTION: A decorative sheet has a rugged shape at a surface on an outside thereof. The decorative sheet at least includes a first protective layer 1 composing the rugged shape and a second protective layer 2, sequentially from the outside. The first protective layer 1 is formed with a cured product of a resin composition containing an ionization radiation curable resin and a thermoplastic resin. The second protective layer 2 is formed with a cured product of an ionization radiation curable resin composition. In the second protective layer 2, a tensile elastic modulus at 23°C is 500 MPa or less and no thermal softening point exists at 200°C or lower.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Coating film drying apparatus and drying method
abstract_en: To provide a drying apparatus and a drying method which can suppress fluctuation in drying a coating film with a simple mechanism.SOLUTION: The present invention is directed to a drying apparatus for drying a coating film on a substrate conveyed in a predetermined conveyance direction. The drying apparatus has a plurality of drying furnaces disposed along the conveyance direction for drying a coating film by heating the substrate passing inside the furnaces, an inlet of the drying furnace disposed at the most upper stream side in the conveyance direction, and a plurality of blowing units disposed in the vicinity of a connection part of the adjacent drying furnace for making wind blowing in the conveyance direction of the substrate. Wind velocity of air stream generated by the blowing unit is 0.3 through 1.0 m/s.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method for manufacturing carbon rod and carbon rod
abstract_en: To provide a method for manufacturing a carbon rod which is applied in electrostatic atomization equipment and used as a discharge electrode for water storage and discharge applications, and to provide a structure thereof.SOLUTION: A method of the present invention includes: a step of processing the raw material by the granulation process to produce granulated powder; a step of forming a plurality of microstructures on the surface of the core material by pressing the granulated powder using a mold to form the core material; a step of forming a bar core, which is a porous structure, by sintering the core material; and a step of providing a conductive coating film layer having water absorbency, completely covering the bar core by a coating method such as coating, spray coating or brush coating, solidifying the bar core, and selecting and using a carbon composite mixed resin as the conductive coating film layer; as a result, the present invention can increase the amount of charge released by increasing the total surface area during use by using the plural microstructures on the surface of the rod core, and can promote water absorption by a conductive coating film layer having a porous structure and water absorbency of the rod core, thereby fulfilling the function of enhancing atomization effect and atomization efficiency.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Conductive film, and conductive film roll, electronic paper, touch panel and flat panel display using the same
abstract_en:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a conductive film further improving at least any of mechanical characteristics, electric characteristics and optical characteristics, while receiving the benefit of improvement in transparency by thinning of a thin metallic wire, and a conductive film roll, an electronic paper, a touch panel and a flat panel display using the conductive film. 
     SOLUTION: A conductive film according to the present invention, the conductive film includes a transparent base material and a conductive part formed of thin metallic wire patterns disposed on one side or both sides of the transparent base material. The thin metallic wire pattern is comprised of a thin metallic wire, and the thin metallic wire includes, besides a conductive metallic atom M, at least any atom of a silicon atom Si, an oxide atom O and a carbon atom C. In STEM-EDX analysis of a cross section of the thin metallic wire orthogonally crossing the extension direction of the thin metallic wire, when a maximum thickness of the thin metallic wire is T, the thin metallic wire contains a prescribed ratio of the at least one of silicon atom Si, oxide atom O and carbon atom C, in the thickness direction.

title_en: Reinforcing film, optical member and electronic member
abstract_en: To provide a reinforcing film that shows light peelability at first after stuck to an adherend and allows, thereafter, the adhesion to be increased greatly, and has flex recoverability and flex holding power.SOLUTION: A reinforcing film 100 has an adhesive layer 21 having: a polymer (B) that includes a monomer unit having a polyorganosiloxane skeleton and a (meth)acrylic monomer unit ; and a polymer (A), the adhesive layer 21 having a surface elastic modulus of 1-20 kPa at 23°C. The adhesive layer 21 has a bulk elastic modulus G' of 10-200 kPa at 23°C and a bulk elastic modulus G' of 5-100 kPa at 80°C, and has a tanδ of 0.10-0.60 at 80°C.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Metal-clad laminate
abstract_en: To provide a metal-clad laminate capable of suppressing increase of a transmission loss of a high frequency signal.SOLUTION: A metal-clad laminate 100 includes a substrate 10, and a metal layer 20. The metal layer 20 has a porous first metal layer 21 provided on the substrate 10, and having multiple voids, and a second metal layer 22 provided on the first metal layer 21. The first metal layer 21 has a porosity of 12% or less, and the porosity of the second metal layer 22 is smaller than the porosity of the first metal layer 21.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Film forming apparatus and method for manufacturing part having film containing silicon
abstract_en: To provide a technique to suppress oxidation and form a film, regarding a film forming apparatus, and a method for manufacturing a part having a film containing silicon.SOLUTION: An exhaust unit reduces the pressure in a chamber to a predetermined vacuum level. A holder is disposed in the chamber and holds a film forming target member P. A supply unit 30 supplies a film forming material containing silicon S1 to a surface of the film forming target member. A heat source can perform heating at the predetermined vacuum level to melt the supplied film forming material.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Film deposition apparatus
abstract_en: To provide a film deposition apparatus capable of obtaining the uniformity of thickness distribution while reducing the occurrence of a hillock.SOLUTION: A film deposition apparatus in the embodiment includes: a chamber 10; a turntable 30 for circulating and conveying a workpiece W along a circumferential conveying path L; a plurality of targets 42 formed to include a film deposition material and provided at positions having different distances in the radial direction from the center of rotation of the turntable 30; a shield member 90 forming a film deposition chamber surrounding a region having a scattered film deposition material and having an opening on the side facing the workpiece W circulated and conveyed; a sputtering gas introduction part for introducing sputtering gas into the film deposition chamber; a power supply unit for applying electric power to the targets 42; and a plasma generator for generating plasma in the sputtering gas in the film deposition chamber. The period of time in which the workpiece W is exposed to the film deposition material through the opening is shorter in a region facing the target 42A nearest to the center of rotation than in a region facing a target 42C furthest from the center of rotation.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Multilayer film and package
abstract_en: To provide a multilayer film capable of composing a skin pack package, with sufficiently high seal strength when heat-sealed onto a hard tray having polypropylene as a major constituent material as a seal surface, and capable of preventing a removal from the hard tray, and also to provide a package using the multilayer film.SOLUTION: A multilayer film 1 is provided. The multilayer film 1 includes an outer layer 12 containing polyethylene and a sealant layer 11 containing ethylene-vinyl acetate copolymer and tackifier. In a thermomechanical analysis of the multilayer film 1, the multilayer film 1 has a temperature 120°C or higher when showing a displacement of 2000 μm, or a gel fraction of the multilayer film 1 is 30% or more. A package includes the multilayer film 1.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method of manufacturing copper coat film

abstract_en: To provide a plasma CVD device that can solve the problem in which: forming a high-quality microcrystalline silicon film by plasma CVD at high speed involves using a VHF plasma CVD device using a highly hydrogen-diluted silane gas with ion bombardment suppressed or a plasma CVD device utilizing a hollow cathode effect; but a large-area substrate of substantially 1.4 mx1.1 m or more shows uneven thickness or an increase in the cost of electrode making.SOLUTION: The inventive plasma CVD device has such a configuration that: a first electrode having an exhaust hole, a silane gas injection hole and a through-hole, and a second electrode having a hydrogen gas injection hole are disposed in this order from the principal face of the substrate holder at predetermined intervals; the first electrode and the second electrode have a high-frequency voltage to be applied therebetween, to generate a hydrogen plasma; the through-hole is used to let the hydrogen plasma flow from the second electrode side to the substrate holder side; and the hydrogen plasma is mixed with the silane gas to form, on the substrate, a microcrystalline silicon film.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

The processing unit sets an amount of adhesive per unit area and/or select a type of the adhesive in both elements 2, 3 for excellent adhesion between the elements 2, 3 according to the data about the physical features such that the amount per unit area or the type of adhesive deposited on a surface of at least one of the elements to be bonded is different in different areas on the surface of the at least one of the elements to be bonded.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Manufacturing method of multilayer coating film
abstract_en: To provide a method for controlling flow properties of a first coating film and a second coating film in a method (3-coat 1-bake coating) including coating the first coating film, the second coating film and a clear coating followed by heat hardening in coating a plastic base material.SOLUTION: A manufacturing method of a multilayer coating film includes: in a 3-coat 1-bake coating method, coating a second coating composition on a first coating film formed by coating a first coating composition on a molded article followed by drying at 60°C for five minutes so as to control flow of the second coating composition; one minute thereafter, transferring a second coating film on a metal foil, and measuring a non-volatile content to obtain a non-volatile content A; coating the other second coating composition on the other metal foil, and one minute thereafter, measuring a non-volatile content to obtain a non-volatile content B; and when a difference between both non-volatile content A and non-volatile content B is represented by 100×(A-B)/B(%), adjusting so that the value is within 15%.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Conductive Film
abstract_en: To provide a conductive film having excellent specific resistance while capable of preventing outgas from an organic resin base material from contacting with a copper layer.SOLUTION: There is provided a conductive film 1 which has an organic resin base material 2, an inorganic layer 3 disposed on one side in the thickness direction of the organic resin base material 2 and a copper layer 4 directly disposed on one surface in the thickness direction of the inorganic layer, wherein in the copper layer 4 near the inorganic layer 3, the elemental concentration of O is 1.4 atom% or more and 15 atom% or less based on the sum of Cu, O and inorganic elements derived from the inorganic layer 3, as measured by energy dispersive X-ray analysis (EDX).SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Polyester Film Roll
abstract_en: To provide an environmentally friendly polyester film roll having excellent cutting properties when cutting the entire release film in a state where a green sheet is laminated.SOLUTION: There is provided a polyester film roll which is used as a support for a ceramic green sheet in the manufacturing process of a laminated ceramic capacitor and is obtained by winding a polyester film, wherein the polyester film contains a copolymerized polyester and the birefringence (Δn×103) at any position relative to the roll full width is 21.0 or less, for the polyester film, the integrated value of the chemiluminescence emission intensity from 50°C to 200°C is 400000 or more when the temperature is increased from 50°C at 10°C/minute and held at 200°C for 10 minutes under a nitrogen gas atmosphere.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Release film for transfer mold and method for manufacturing semiconductor chip encapsulation
abstract_en: To provide: a release film for a transfer mold which is capable of imparting excellent designability and has excellent moldability during molding process and excellent residual reduction after peeling off the release film; and a method for manufacturing a semiconductor chip encapsulation.SOLUTION: A release film for a semiconductor transfer mold is made up of a base material layer and a release layer, and includes the release layer on at least a surface of one side. The base material layer contains 0.1-30 mass% of particles.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Laminate and decorative sheet
abstract_en: To provide a decorative sheet having stable weather resistance.SOLUTION: A laminate contains, in a top coat layer 2 at the outermost surface side of a decorative sheet 1, a photo-stabilizer having a pKa of 4.0 to 7.0, and an ultraviolet absorber having a pKa of -4.5 to -5.5 when being irradiated with light.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Multilayered substrate
abstract_en: To provide a multilayered substrate in which in-plane non-uniformity of a Si concentration distribution in a GaN layer is suppressed.SOLUTION: A multilayered substrate includes an underlying substrate, and a gallium nitride layer epitaxially grown above the underlying substrate and comprising gallium nitride containing silicon. The gallium nitride layer has a top surface with a radius of 50 mm or more, and the gallium nitride layer has a thickness of 4 μm or more. A silicon concentration on the top surface of the gallium nitride layer has a distribution in which an outer circumferential silicon concentration at a radial position 10 mm from an edge of the top surface is higher than a central silicon concentration at a center of the top surface, the central silicon concentration is 4×1015 cm-3 or more and less than 2×1016 cm-3, and an outer circumferential silicon contamination concentration, which is an excess of the outer circumferential silicon concentration from the central silicon concentration, is 1.2×1015 cm-3 or less.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Biaxially oriented polypropylene film
abstract_en: To provide a polypropylene film which achieves all of the followings: stable film formation over a longer period of time; higher voltage resistance (especially, voltage resistance at high temperature); and a higher yield rate.SOLUTION: A biaxially oriented polypropylene film has a first surface and a second surface, where the average maximum length of substantially elliptical spots on the first surface is 3.0 mm or less, and where the difference between the average protruding peak height Rpk outside the spots and the average protruding peak height Rpk inside the spots is 0.040 μm or less.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Method of generating electrolyzed water, and device and apparatus for generating and spraying electrolyzed water
abstract_en: To provide an electrolytic water generation method and a device/apparatus for generating electrolytic water, which can be used at home because of a container having an improved inner bottom shape that makes it possible to control the convention of raw water.SOLUTION: A device 1 for generating and spraying electrolyzed water which is provided with: a container 4 that stores raw water 43; an electrode structure 2 for electrolyzing the raw water 43 in the container 4 to generate ozone water (electrolyzed) 42; and a spray mechanism 5 for spraying the electrolyzed water 42 that is fitted to a water inlet located above the inner bottom of the container 4, wherein the inner bottom surface 46 of the container 4 has a concave basin 48 that is concave downward, the concave basin 48 includes bottom surface 48a, and an electrode structure 2 is erected on the bottom surface of the concave basin 48a in the container 4. The raw water 43 flows down the concave basin 48 toward the bottom surface 48a, thereby creating a downward water flow that promotes convection of the raw water 43 in the container 4. This downward water flow supplies raw water 43 to the electrode structure 2 to promote the reaction for generating ozone water based on electrolysis, and increases the concentration of generated ozone water 42.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Deposition method of metallic film, and deposition apparatus therefor
abstract_en: To enable reduction of film formation failure of a metallic film caused by crystals adhered to a wall surface of a penetration part of a masking material.SOLUTION: A deposition apparatus 1 comprises: a container 15 in which a plating solution L is accommodated and is sealed with a polymer electrolyte 13; a linear actuator 70 for moving the container 15 against a substrate B; a pressing mechanism for pressing the substrate B through the polymer electrolyte 13 by applying the liquid pressure of the plating solution L in the container 15 to the polymer electrolyte 13; an anode 11 which is accommodated in the container 15 and is placed apart from the polymer electrolyte 13; a power supply 14 for applying a voltage between the anode 11 and the substrate B; an enclosure member 80A for enclosing a space S between the substrate B and the container 15 in a state in which the substrate B and the container 15 are separated from each other; and a humidification mechanism 80B for letting a humidified gas A flow into the space S enclosed by the enclosure member 80A toward the polymer electrolyte 13.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Structural color member and manufacturing method of the same
abstract_en: To provide a structural color member having a structural color and an excellent durability, and a manufacturing method of the same.SOLUTION: A structural color member 1 has a base material 2, and an oxide coating 3 made of a metal oxide and covering the base material 2. The oxide coating 3 has a porous layer 31 including multiple pores 311 and arranged on the base material 2, and a dense layer 32 not including the pores 311 and laminated on the porous layer 31. A thickness of the oxide coating layer 3 is 150 nm or more and 1,000 nm or less, and is in a range of 0.75 times or more and 1.25 times or less of an average thickness of the oxide coating 3.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method for growing nitrogen doped single crystal silicon ingot using continuous czochralski method, and single crystal silicon ingot grown by this method
abstract_en: To provide a method for growing a perfect silicon crystal.SOLUTION: A method for growing a single crystal silicon ingot by the continuous Czochralski method is disclosed. Melt depth and heat conditions are keeping a silicon melt constant during growth for continuously supplying the silicon melt while consuming the silicon melt and fixing a crucible position. A critical v/G is determined by a hot zone constitution; a continuous supplement of silicon to the melt during the growth can grow an ingot at a fixed pulling speed consistent with the critical v/G while growing the substantive part of an ingot main body; and the continuous supplement of silicon is achieved by periodical or continuous nitrogen addition producing a nitrogen doped ingot.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Support for thermal transfer image receiving sheet, thermal transfer image receiving sheet, manufacturing method of thermal transfer image receiving sheet, manufacturing method of support for thermal transfer image receiving sheet, and sheet laminator
abstract_en: To provide a thermal transfer image receiving sheet which can form a thermal transfer image with high quality while suppressing a manufacturing cost and also can form the thermal transfer image with a variety of expressions by selectively changing a state of an image surface.SOLUTION: A support for a thermal transfer image receiving sheet laminates a base material 11, a resin layer 12 and a film 20 in this order. At least either on a boundary between the base material 11 and the resin layer 12 or in the vicinity of the boundary, one or more cavities 30 are disposed, and the cavities 30 have a height of 0.5 μm or more and 15 μm or less in the laminating direction of the base material 11, the resin layer 12 and the film 20.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Undercoat material, and laminate formation method
abstract_en: To provide an undercoat material which is excellent in adhesion between a base material and a thermally foamable coating material, and secures excellent adhesion even in a case of being exposed to high temperature by fire or the like, and a laminate formation method.SOLUTION: There is provided an undercoat material for a thermally foamable coating material, wherein the undercoat material contains an epoxy resin (A), a polyamine compound (B), and a pigment (C), and the polyamine compound (B) contains an epoxy adduct modified matter.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Light transmissive conductive layer and light transmissive conductive film
abstract_en: To provide a light transmissive conductive layer low in resistance and excellent in after-heating transmissivity, and a light transmissive conductive film.SOLUTION: A light transmissive conductive layer 10 having a first main surface 21 and a second main surface 22 arranged on the side opposite to the first main surface 21 in the thickness direction extends in a surface direction orthogonal to the thickness direction. The light transmissive conductive layer 10 includes two or more first light transmissive conductive layers 11 containing conductive oxide and rare gas having an atomic number larger than that of argon. The ratio of the thickest first light transmissive conductive layer 11 in the plurality of first light transmissive conductive layers 11 to the total thickness of the plurality of first light transmissive conductive layers 11 is less than 50%.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Electron gun device for vapor deposition
abstract_en: To provide an electron gun device for vapor deposition that is suppressed in degradation in film deposition quality.SOLUTION: This electron gun device for vapor deposition includes: a device body provided with an electron beam source and installed laterally of a crucible that has an open top and in which an evaporation material to be vapor-deposited on a coating member is stored; and a pair of pole pieces guiding an electron beam emitted from the device body to a target area set in the crucible and including a base end part installed in the device body and a tip-end part disposed above the crucible and behind the target area as viewed from the device body; and a pair of reflected-electron deflection members extending in a direction separated from the device body from respective tip parts of the pair of pole pieces or a position in proximity to the tip parts to deflect a reflected-electron that is reflected from the target area in a predetermined direction.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Semiconductor device manufacturing method and manufacturing system
abstract_en: To reduce residue in an air gap.SOLUTION: A method for manufacturing a semiconductor device includes the steps a), b), and c). In the step a), a sacrificial material is embedded in a recess formed in a substrate. In the step b), the recess in which the sacrificial material is embedded is covered with a sealing film. In the step c), a process gas is turned into plasma outside the recess, and active species contained in the plasma are supplied to the sacrificial material through the sealing film, thereby decomposing the sacrificial material in the recess and removing the sacrificial material in the recess through the sealing film.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Metal magnesium production method
abstract_en: To provide a metal magnesium production method in which a high current efficiency can be realized by appropriately managing a bath surface level of a molten bath in a recovery chamber.SOLUTION: Provided is a metal magnesium production method for producing metal magnesium by subjecting magnesium chloride in a molten salt bath to molten salt electrolysis by using an electrolytic tank having an electrolytic chamber and a recovery chamber, and electrodes including anodes, bipoles, and cathodes arranged in the electrolytic chamber. At least one of the bipoles has a thick width section with an electrolytic-reaction generating surface and a thin width section arranged on the upper side of the thick width section, and maintains a height position of a bath surface of a molten bath in the recovery chamber within a range of 15 cm or more and 42 cm or less from an opening of the electrolytic tank in a depth direction in the molten salt electrolysis.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Control system, processing apparatus, and method of manufacturing semiconductor device
abstract_en: To provide a technology for supplying a raw material with a low vapor pressure to a process chamber while controlling the flow rate.SOLUTION: There is provided a technique that includes a flow-rate controller including a regulator configured to be capable of regulating a flow rate of a gas; and a controller configured to be capable of switching between a first mode of the flow-rate controller in which the flow rate of the gas is regulated to a predetermined flow rate through operation of the regulator, and a second mode of the flow-rate controller in which the regulator is set to be in a full open state.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Polyamide composition, polyamide molded article and composite
abstract_en: To provide a polyamide composition having high adhesive strength and excellent heat deformation resistance, heat aging resistance and rigidity and a composite having the polyamide composition.SOLUTION: There is provided a polyamide composition comprising a polyamide (A) and an epoxy resin (B), wherein the polyamide (A) comprises a dicarboxylic acid unit and a diamine unit, the dicarboxylic acid unit comprises 50 mol% or more of a structural unit derived from at least one selected from the group consisting of terephthalic acid and naphthalenedicarboxylic acid, based on 100 mol% of the total dicarboxylic acid units, the diamine unit comprises 60 mol% or more of an aliphatic diamine unit having 7 to 13 carbon atoms based on 100 mol%of the total diamine units, the softening point of the epoxy resin (B), obtained in accordance with JIS K 7196:2012, is 70°C or more and 110°C or less and the content of the epoxy resin (B) in the polyamide composition is more than 0 mass% and 20 mass% or less.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Anti-algae agent, anti-algae coating composition, laminate, structure, anti-algae resin composition, and molded article
abstract_en: To provide an anti-algae agent that exhibits superior compatibility with resins and high algae resistance, and that reduces adverse effects on the appearance of the object to which it is applied.SOLUTION: An anti-algae agent for preventing adhesion of terrestrial algae, the anti-algae agent comprising a fatty acid metal salt of a fatty acid having 1 to 22 carbon atoms and a metal, wherein the metal is copper, bismuth, zinc, magnesium, cobalt, or a rare earth element.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Electromagnetic wave absorbing member
abstract_en: To provide an electromagnetic wave absorbing member capable of suppressing deterioration of electromagnetic wave absorbing characteristics and impairment of adhesiveness.SOLUTION: The electromagnetic wave absorbing member includes a resistance layer (10) with a conductor pattern (12), an adhesive layer (20), a spacer layer (30), and a reflective layer (40) in that order. One surface (20a) of the adhesive layer (20) is in contact with a surface of the resistance layer (10) on which the conductor pattern (12) is arranged, the other surface (20b) of the adhesive layer (20) is in contact with the spacer layer (30), and the adhesive layer (20) has a holding power for the spacer layer (30) of at least 10000 seconds at 40°C.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Laminate and optical member
abstract_en: To provide a laminate capable of suppressing peeling of an adhesive under high-temperature and high-humidity conditions, and an optical member containing the laminate.SOLUTION: A laminate comprises a first base material and a second base material adhered through at least an adhesive layer, the first and second base materials each having a thickness of 0.6 to 20 mm, the first base material comprising a methacrylic resin composition, and a silane coupling agent layer being provided between the first base material and the adhesive layer and/or between the second base material and the adhesive layer. Also provided is an optical member that comprises the laminate.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Solid oxide type cell system
abstract_en: To provide a solid oxide type cell system capable of stabilizing a flow rate of an exhaust gas in an exhaust gas flow passage formed by a wall surface of a module case and appropriately performing heat exchange.SOLUTION: A solid oxide type cell system, which includes a module containing a solid oxide cell stack and performs heat exchange by an exhaust gas discharged from the module, comprises: a module case accommodating the module; an exhaust gas flow passage formed by an inner wall surface of the module case and an outer wall surface of the module, wherein the exhaust gas flows between wall surfaces opposing each other; and a protrusion provided to protrude from at least one of the wall surfaces forming the exhaust gas flow passage toward the wall surface opposing the at least one wall surface.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Substrate processing apparatus and article manufacturing method
abstract_en: To improve throughput of processing of drying a film of a substrate.SOLUTION: A substrate processing apparatus comprises: a chamber; a pressure reducing mechanism that reduces the pressure in an internal space of the chamber; a substrate holding part that holds a substrate having a film in the internal space; a baffle cover that covers the substrate held by the substrate holding part in the internal space; a gas analyzer that detects specific gas in a substrate housing space surrounded by the substrate holding part and the baffle cover; and a controller that determines the completion of drying of the film on the basis of output from the gas analyzer.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Showerhead assemblies, semiconductor processing systems including showerhead assemblies and associated methods
abstract_en: To provide showerhead assemblies and semiconductor processing systems including showerhead assemblies, and related methods.SOLUTION: A showerhead assembly and a semiconductor processing system including the showerhead assembly are disclosed. The disclosed showerhead assembly includes a lid, a showerhead plate, and an annular flow ring disposed between the lid and the showerhead plate. There is a method for regulating gas flow to and from a reaction chamber when performing a process. The disclosed method includes positioning the annular flow ring at a first position and a second position.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method for treating porous graphite substrate, treated substrate, and use thereof
abstract_en: To provide a method for treating a porous graphite substrate having improved corrosion resistance, and to provide a treated substrate.SOLUTION: A method for treating a porous graphite substrate includes: a) providing at least one film, the at least one film containing silicon particles and at least one binder; b) applying the at least one film to at least one surface of the porous graphite substrate; and c) subjecting at least one coating film to at least one heat treatment. During the heat treatment, the silicon particles are melted to form a melt, the melt partially penetrates into micropores of the porous graphite substrate, and silicon contained in the melt is converted, at least partially, into silicon carbide.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Gas barrier film, laminate and packaging bag
abstract_en: To provide a gas barrier film which can suppress flavor deterioration of contents after retort processing and can have good oxygen barrier properties even after retort processing.SOLUTION: There is provided a gas barrier film comprising a base film containing polypropylene and a vapor-deposited layer containing an inorganic oxide disposed on a first surface, which is one surface of the base film, wherein the base film comprises a second skin layer having a second surface, which is the surface of the base film opposite to the first surface and a core layer and the second skin layer contains silicon-containing particles at a ratio of 1500 mass ppm or more and 4000 mass ppm or less.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method for producing carbon electrode
abstract_en: To newly, simply and inexpensively manufacture a carbon electrode.SOLUTION: A method for manufacturing a carbon electrode, comprising the steps of: (1) passing a carbon fiber, a pencil lead and / or a pencil core through a glass tube and heating a central portion of the glass tube; and (2) pulling the glass tube in opposite directions to shrink the carbon fiber, the pencil lead and / or the pencil core in the glass tube.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Water electrolysis system
abstract_en: To detect abnormality of a water electrolysis stack while reducing efficiency deterioration of water electrolysis and deterioration of the water electrolysis stack.SOLUTION: The water electrolysis system includes a plurality of water electrolysis stacks, a power supply that supplies a direct current to each of the plurality of water electrolysis stacks, and a detection unit that detects an abnormality of each of the plurality of water electrolysis stacks. The detection unit generates a plurality of characteristic models by calculating, for each of the plurality of water electrolysis stacks, a characteristic model approximating a response characteristic of an output voltage with respect to a change in an input current of the water electrolysis stack for each predetermined period based on measured values of a current and a voltage of the water electrolysis stack, and estimates an abnormality of the water electrolysis stack based on a characteristic difference between at least two characteristic models among the plurality of characteristic models.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Surface treatment agent, surface-treated metal, and surface treatment method
abstract_en: To provide a surface treatment agent capable of improving adhesion to a coating film.SOLUTION: A surface treatment agent comprising at least one metal component (A) selected from the group consisting of zirconium, titanium, and hafnium, and an alkyldiallylamine polymer (C), wherein the content of the metal component (A) is 10 to 100,000 ppm by mass in terms of a metal element based on the total mass of the surface treatment agent, and the alkyldiallylamine polymer (C) has a segment having a heterocyclic structure represented by formula (1a) or (1b): SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Method for producing laminate, laminate, and packaging bag
abstract_en: To provide a method for manufacturing a laminate capable of enhancing manufacturing efficiency while reducing environmental load.SOLUTION: The method for producing a laminate includes a first adhesive coating step of applying a solventless adhesive containing an electron beam-curable (meth)acrylate resin to a base material layer to form an uncured first adhesive layer, a second adhesive coating step of applying an electron beam-curable (meth)acrylate resin to a first intermediate layer to form an uncured second adhesive layer, and an electron beam irradiation step of irradiating the laminate in which the base material layer, the first adhesive layer, the first intermediate layer, the second adhesive layer, and the sealant layer are laminated in this order with an electron beam having an acceleration voltage of 50 kV or more and 300 kV or less from the base material layer side.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Laminated structure
abstract_en: To provide a laminated structure capable of maintaining high bending rigidity.SOLUTION: The laminated structure 10 includes a hollow structure 20 having a core layer 40 in which a plurality of cells S are arranged in parallel, and an aluminum sheet 30 joined to the hollow structure 20, wherein the core layer 40 is formed by molding a thermoplastic resin core sheet, the modulus of elasticity of the core sheet is 1000 MPa or more, and the ratio of the modulus of elasticity of the aluminum sheet 30 to the modulus of elasticity of the core sheet is 20 or more and 80 or less.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method of formation copper plating with improved emissivity
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for forming copper plating with improved emissivity. According to the present invention, the method comprises: a first step of composing an electrolyte containing polyethylene glycol; a second step of putting the electrolyte into a beaker and immersing a copper electrode and a high-purity copper electrode in the electrolyte; a third step of connecting the copper electrode and the high-purity copper electrode to a rectifier, and applying a positive current to the copper electrode and a negative current to the high-purity copper electrode; a fourth step of generating a copper plating layer on the surface of the high-purity copper electrode; and a fifth step of heat-treating the high-purity copper electrode to form a copper oxide plating layer.

title_en: Play mat for removing scribbing and method of manufacturing the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a play mat capable of removing scribbles. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the play mat comprises: a lower mat manufactured by foam-molding polyvinyl chloride (PVC); an adhesive applied to an upper surface of the lower mat; a plasticizer barrier layer coupled to the lower mat through the adhesive; and an upper mat formed on an upper surface of the plasticizer barrier layer, having a specific color printed on a back side thereof, and manufactured by mixing a specific ratio of minerals. Therefore, in order to implement the matte characteristics and writing and erasing characteristics on the upper surface of the play mat, the present invention forms a matte UV curing coating layer containing a specific ratio of minerals, and thus it is possible to prevent the scribble components described on the upper surface from penetrating. Accordingly, the matt makes it possible to remove scribbles by using a wet tissue. The present invention relates to a play mat capable of removing scribbling by preventing scribbling material to penetrate a surface of a play mat and a method for manufacturing the same.

title_en: Method for hygienically waterproofing and repairing the kitchen floor
abstract_en: The objective of the present invention is to provide a waterproof repair method for a kitchen floor in which construction can be performed within a short time without generating odor during and after construction. According to the present invention, provided is a waterproof repair method for a kitchen floor comprising the steps of: pretreating the kitchen floor; coating and drying the pretreated kitchen floor with an elastic mortar composition; spraying and curing the dried kitchen floor with a urethane-based solvent-free primer coating agent for quick cleaning; coating and hardening high-hard urethane for waterproof reinforcement on the cured kitchen floor; first-coating the cured kitchen floor using a coating agent containing polyurea, and then coating it with silica sand during the second coating; and coating the coated kitchen floor using a non-yellowing coating agent.

title_en: Manufacturing method of metal tile for manhole with anti-slip function and color design
abstract_en: In accordance with the present invention, a method for manufacturing a non-slip metal tile for a manhole includes the following steps of: preparing a galvanized steel sheet/an aluminum-coated steel sheet/a cladding steel sheet by a thickness of 2 to 5 mm; enlarging the surface area of the upper surface of the galvanized steel sheet through a method of minimizing peeling and bending deformations of galvanized coatings through Grit Blasting standard conditions; buffer-coating or plating zinc, aluminum, or zinc-aluminum to prevent the corrosion of the galvanized steel sheet; spray-coating Al2O3 or stainless steel to create roughness and wear resistance functions; diluting epoxy to permeate the epoxy into a porous layer of a spray-coating film to prevent corrosion and improve adhesion with paint; generating a color design by performing color printing on the galvanized steel sheet using a UV inkjet printer; and forming a manhole cover by assembling and attaching a steel sheet onto a manhole body through bolt-coupling. Therefore, the present invention is capable of preventing a pedestrian from accidentally slipping and improving the beauty of a city.

title_en: Apparatus for foreign material remove of film paper
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for removing foreign substances from film paper. The apparatus for removing foreign substances from film paper comprises: a frame (100); a supply module (200); a discharge module (300); and a removal module (400). According to the present invention, foreign substances attached to the surface or back of film paper can be more efficiently removed, thereby increasing the recycling rate of film paper.

title_en: Cutting tools with hard coating
abstract_en: The objective of the present invention is to provide a hard coating film for a cutting tool that has improved abrasion resistance while maintaining chipping resistance at a certain level or higher. A cutting tool comprises: a hard base material; and a hard coating film formed on the hard base material, wherein the hard coating film includes a first coating film made of Al_aCr_bMe_(1-a-b)N_xO_y, where a, b, x, and y are atomic ratios, a+b<=1, 0. 5<=x<=1, 0<=y<=0. 5, x+y=1, and Me is one or more selected from a 4-group element, a 5-group element, a 6-group element, Si, B, and S.

title_en: Electrolyzer system including microbubble generator
abstract_en: Provided is an electrolytic cell system comprising: a gas generation unit (110) configured to stack a plurality of structures for generating oxygen gas and hydrogen gas through electrolysis; an etching plate (120) configured to have durability in an environment with a hydrogen ion concentration index (pH) of 0 to 11; a pair of end mounting parts (130) configured to inject water into the gas generation unit (110) while simultaneously separating and exhausting the oxygen and hydrogen generated from the gas generation unit (110); and a microbubble generation unit (140) configured to inject water into the pair of end mounting parts (130) while simultaneously injecting microbubbles. According to the electrolytic cell system of the present invention, a gas generation unit, an etching plate, a pair of end mounting parts, and a microbubble generation unit with a specific structure are provided to prevent damage caused by pressure from a titanium nonwoven fabric and a separator, and to increase the pressure resistance while preventing damage to the separator.

title_en: Atomizer for vaporization device for thin film deposition and droplet supply system including the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an atomizer for a vaporizing device for thin film deposition and a droplet supply system including the same, and is to provide an atomizer that minimizes the volume of dance and does not cause water leakage. According to the present invention, a droplet supply system comprises: a liquid supply unit supplying a liquid precursor; a gas supply unit supplying a carrier gas; an atomizer for a vaporizing device receiving the liquid precursor and the carrier gas from the liquid supply unit and the gas supply unit to form a droplet aerosol, wherein a piezo valve is positioned at a front end of a body flow path through which the liquid precursor supplied from the liquid supply unit moves, a shut-off valve is positioned at a rear end of the body flow path, and an orifice is inserted into a lower portion of the shut-off valve to adjust a flow rate of the liquid precursor; and a control unit controlling the liquid supply unit and the gas supply unit to adjust the supply of the liquid precursor and the carrier gas.

title_en: Planar speaker and using silk printing and etching and manufacturing method of the same
abstract_en: The present invention comprises: a first step of attaching a second board (12) to an upper surface of a first board (11) using an adhesive to form a board assembly (13); a second step of cutting the board assembly (13) formed in the first step into a preset reference width and reference length, respectively; a third step of silk-printing a preset reference pattern (20) on the upper surface of the second board (12) using a printer (15); a fourth step of irradiating ultraviolet rays to the reference pattern (20) formed in the third step with a metal lamp (30) for a preset reference time to cure the reference pattern (20); and a fifth step of etching the second board (12) using an etching solution (35) to melt and remove the second board (12) on which the reference pattern (20) is not formed on the upper surface to form a circuit pattern (40).

title_en: Temperature-controlled chemical delivery system and reactor system including same
abstract_en: A temperature control system for a chemical material delivery system (for example, included in a reactor system) comprises a temperature control shell which is coupled to and/or surrounds at least a portion of at least one component of the chemical material delivery system. The chemical material delivery system comprises filters, accumulators, and/or chemical material application lines that are fluidly coupled to each other in an optional suitable arrangement and/or configuration. The temperature control system for a chemical material delivery system comprises: a filter temperature control shell coupled to and/or surrounding at least a portion of a filter; an accumulator temperature control shell coupled to and/or surrounding at least a portion of an accumulator; and/or an application line temperature control shell coupled to and/or surrounding at least a portion of a chemical material application line.

title_en: Slot die coating device having air vent
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a slot die coating device for coating an electrode active material slurry on an electrode current collector and, more specifically, to a slot die coating device comprising: a coating roller; at least two or more dies; a discharge port through which the electrode active material slurry is discharged in a direction opposite to that of gravity; and an air vent installed in the die.

title_en: Antibacterial Module for Cushion Cosmetics
abstract_en: An antibacterial module for a cushion foundation according to the present invention comprises: an antibacterial layer which is capable of contacting a designated contact area of a cosmetic puff and includes an antibacterial material capable of inhibiting the bacterial growth in the contact area of the cosmetic puff; a base layer which is provided under the antibacterial layer or includes the antibacterial layer in the upper region thereof, and includes a fiber material having a non-woven fabric structure; and an adhesive layer which is provided under the base layer and includes an adhesive material capable of being adhered to the bottom surface of a container for storing the cosmetic puff.

title_en: Squeeze roll semi-automatic desorption apparatus
abstract_en: The present invention is to provide an electrodeposited copper foil cutting apparatus and an electrodeposited copper foil manufacturing apparatus capable of adjusting the cutting position for cutting a transport copper foil. The present invention relates to an electrodeposited copper foil manufacturing apparatus comprising: a support unit for supporting a transport copper foil being transported from an electrodeposition unit; a cutting unit for cutting the transport copper foil supported by the support unit so as to be separated into a wound copper foil to be wound on a winding part and a separated copper foil to be separated from the wound copper foil; a moving unit for moving the cutting unit so that the cutting position at which the cutting unit cuts the transport copper foil is adjusted; and a display unit for displaying the distance by which the moving unit has moved the cutting unit.

title_en: Pouch with enhanced oxygen gas barrier property and surface treatment method thereof, and pouch type secondary battery
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a packaging material for a secondary battery having increased oxygen barrier properties, a surface treatment method thereof, and a pouch-type secondary battery including the same, and more specifically, to a packaging material for a secondary battery having increased oxygen barrier properties by surface treatment of a metal layer, a surface treatment method thereof, and a pouch-type secondary battery including the same.

title_en: Optical film
abstract_en: The present invention is to provide an optical film excellent in suppression of light leakage in black display. An optical film having a first phase difference layer and a second phase difference layer, wherein the second phase difference layer has an optical property represented by Equation (3) and the optical film has optical properties represented by Equations (1), (2), and (30): wherein, Re(450) represents an in-plane phase difference value at a wavelength of 450 nm, Re(550) represents an in-plane phase difference value at a wavelength of 550 nm, Re(650) represents an in-plane phase difference value at a wavelength of 650 nm, nx represents a principal refractive index in a direction parallel to the film plane in an index ellipsoid formed by the phase difference layer, ny represents the refractive index in a direction parallel to the film plane and orthogonal to the direction of nx in an index ellipsoid formed by the phase difference layer, and nz represents the refractive index in a direction vertical to the film plane in an index ellipsoid formed by the phase difference layer.

title_en: Structure mount and removal tool and method of mounting and removing using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a mechanism for detaching a structure, and more specifically, to a mechanism for detaching a shower head and an insulating ring mounted on a top lid. An embodiment of a structure removing method according to the present invention is a method for removing, from a plate, a first structure with open upper and lower portions of a cylindrical shape, and a second structure with an open upper portion having a bottom portion and a side portion extending upward from the outer circumference of the bottom portion, wherein the first and second structures are sequentially mounted in a through hole of the plate with the through hole penetrated vertically. The method comprises the steps of: installing main guide brackets having a body and a shaft extending long above the body at opposite positions with the through hole of the plate interposed therebetween; disposing a structure fixing bar on the second structure by inserting the shaft into a shaft insertion hole formed in both sides of the structure fixing bar to which a second structure fixing bracket is coupled; moving the second structure fixing bracket in a longitudinal direction of the structure fixing bar, and bringing the second structure fixing bracket into contact with an upper surface of a side portion of the second structure and an inner circumferential surface of the side portion of the second structure; fixing, to the second structure, the second structure fixing bracket in contact with the upper surface of the side portion of the second structure and the inner circumferential surface of the side portion of the second structure; and removing the second structure by moving the structure fixing bar upward along the shaft to be separated from the shaft. Therefore, the present invention can easily separate the shower head with less force without damaging the insulating ring.

title_en: Gum tape reverse rotation prevention device applied to manual adhesive tape dispenser
abstract_en: A water application device applied to a manual adhesive tape dispenser is disclosed. An embodiment of the present invention provides a water application device applied to a manual adhesive tape dispenser, wherein the dispenser comprises: a main body in which a space is formed therein, an upper portion is open, a discharge port through which tape is drawn out is formed on the front surface, and a winding roller on which a tape roll is wound is formed in the internal space; a water supply unit coupled to the main body and supplying water; and the winding roller coupled to the inside of the main body to rotate and provided with the tape roll on which the tape is wound. The water application device includes: an application unit mounted in the main body while being mounted to be adjacent to the discharge port and being provided with a water reservoir bottle for applying water onto a back surface of the tape; and an upper support mounted on the upper part of the application unit and having an upper roller formed in external contact with an unwinding roller. Accordingly, the adhesive tape dispenser can attach the tape by reacting an adhesive, composed of an eco-friendly component, with water to activate an adhesive force for having the adhesive force without using a chemical adhesive.

title_en: Apparatus for processing substrate and method for depositing thin film using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a substrate processing apparatus and a thin film deposition method using the same, and more particularly, to a substrate processing apparatus for processing a substrate by activating a process gas using plasma and a thin film deposition method using the same. A substrate processing apparatus according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: a chamber providing a process space; a gas supply unit for supplying a process gas to the process space; a substrate support disposed facing the gas supply unit and having a seating surface for supporting a substrate provided in the process space; a lower antenna provided below the seating surface and generating a magnetic field to form plasma in the process space; and a first power source for supplying power to the lower antenna. It is possible to deposit high-quality thin films.

title_en: Laminating system
abstract_en: Disclosed is a laminating system for a display. The laminating system for a display according to one embodiment of the present invention comprises: a detach zone arranged on one side of a system main body, where a detachment process of detaching a release film from a protective film which will be laminated on a panel is performed; a stripping head arranged in the system main body to be adjacent to the detach zone and having a stripping roller where an adhesive tape is wound in order to strip the release film from the protective film; and a turret-type roller replacing instrument disposed in a lower area in a location of roller replacement for the stripping head and supplying a spare roller to the stripping head in a turret type in order to replace the stripping roller of the stripping head. Accordingly, adhesive performance of the adhesive tape wound on the stripping roller is prevented from disappearing to enhance a success rate of stripping the release film.

title_en: Insulation sheet for cooler bag storing fresh food
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an insulation sheet for a cooler bag that stores food, wherein the insulation sheet comprises: a foam resin layer; a first insulation sheet layer coupled to one surface of the foam resin layer, as a sheet wherein a plurality of air caps are disposed; and a second insulation sheet layer coupled to the other surface of the foam resin layer, as the sheet wherein the plurality of air caps are disposed. Therefore, the present invention is capable of having an effect of improving an insulation performance.

title_en: Nozzle cleaning apparatus, nozzle cleaning method and coating apparatus
abstract_en: The present invention includes: a deposit removing unit supported by a support member in a state where a nozzle abutting member is directed toward the lower end of a nozzle; a moving unit for moving the deposit removing unit in the extension direction of the discharge port in a state where the nozzle abutting member is brought into contact with the lower end of the nozzle; a collection unit collecting, from below the deposit removing unit, a coating liquid flowing downward via the deposit removing unit after being removed by the movement of the nozzle abutting member by the moving unit; and a discharge unit guiding and discharging the coating liquid collected from the collection unit to the outside of an application device. The collection unit is a structure having a bottom portion having an inner bottom surface inclined toward the discharge unit from below the deposit removing unit and a side wall erected from the edge of the bottom portion. The coating liquid flows toward the discharge unit along a collection area formed by the bottom portion and the side wall. The removed coating liquid can be smoothly discharged to the outside.

title_en: Composition for reducing metal precusor in ald process, and method of producing metal thin film using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a reductant composition including diethylamino borane and reducing a metal precursor used for atomic layer deposition (ALD), and a metal film forming method using the same. By using the reductant composition according to one embodiment of the present application, a ligand of a metal precursor not containing F elements can be effectively removed to reduce the metal precursor, and thus a high-purity metal film can be formed through an ALD process.

title_en: Mask and display apparatus using the same
abstract_en: The present invention is to provide a mask capable of forming uniform tension to prevent mask tearing, and a display device using the same. One aspect of the mask of the present invention includes a base part; one or more cell parts formed inside the base part; and a first area part formed around the cell parts and formed on one surface or the other surface of the base part.

title_en: Metal housing and electronic device including metal housing thereof
abstract_en: An electronic device according to various embodiments of the present disclosure includes: a metal housing; a porous oxide film layer including a plurality of fine micro-pores formed on the outer surface of the metal housing; and a functional polymer layer stacked adjacent to the outer side of the porous oxide film layer in which the plurality of micro-pores are formed, wherein an organic dye aqueous solution may be colored in the plurality of micro-pores. In addition to this, various embodiments identified through the specification are possible.

title_en: Hydrogen and oxygen generating supplying apparatus
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a hydrogen and oxygen supply device, and more specifically, to a hydrogen and oxygen supply device that generates and supplies hydrogen and oxygen by electrolysis of water and has a replaceable hydrogen and oxygen generation module that is a main part.

title_en: manufacturing method for propeller having plasma nano nitride layer
abstract_en: Provided is a method for manufacturing a propeller having a plasma nano nitride layer for improving corrosion resistance and wear resistance. The method for manufacturing a propeller having a plasma nano nitride layer includes: a first step of allowing a propeller body, which includes a rotation body unit connected to a power axis in the center thereof and a plurality of wing units radially extending in a circumferential direction on an outer circumferential surface of the rotation body unit, to be mounted on a jig provided inside a chamber, injecting nitrogen gas into the chamber to generate nitrogen ions inside the chamber, and heating the propeller body up to a first temperature; a second step of constantly heating the propeller body to the first temperature for a pre-set time, generating nitrogen ions by a plasma generated by applying a voltage to an electrode provided in the chamber, and stacking and forming a nano nitride layer on a surface of the propeller body; and a third step of finally forming the nano nitride layer on the surface of the propeller body as the propeller body is cooled from the first temperature to a second temperature lower than the first temperature.

title_en: Antimicrobial sheet including copper powder, manufacturing method thereof and sheet for board including the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an antimicrobial sheet comprising copper powder, a method for manufacturing the same, and a blackboard sheet. More specifically, the present invention relates to an antimicrobial sheet manufactured by mixing powder-type copper particles with a resin material for an antimicrobial function, a method for manufacturing the same, and a blackboard sheet. An antimicrobial sheet comprising copper powder according to the present invention comprises: an antimicrobial layer; at least one first hollow part formed on one surface of the antimicrobial layer; and at least one second hollow part formed on the other surface of the antimicrobial layer, wherein the antimicrobial layer comprises a resin material and the copper powder, and a diameter of the first hollow part is smaller than a diameter of the second hollow part, and a depth of the first hollow part is smaller than a depth of the second hollow part. According to the present invention, it is possible to provide a sufficient good antimicrobial function.

title_en: Method for synthesizing graphite on surface of aluminium oxide nanoparticles by thermal chemical vapor deposition
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for synthesizing an aluminum oxide surface graphite. The method for synthesizing the aluminum oxide surface graphite of the present invention comprises the following steps of: raising an interior temperature of a reactor to a synthesis temperature; positioning an aluminum oxide nanoparticle at the interior center of the reactor; maintaining the reactor interior at a set vacuum pressure by pumping a reactor interior air; injecting a reaction gas into the reactor and maintaining the same for a set synthesis time; and cooling the reactor interior to a room temperature after the synthesis time has elapsed. According to the present invention, graphite is effectively synthesized on the aluminum oxide nanoparticle surface.

title_en: Manufacturing method of manhole cover with non-slip function through ARC Spray thermal spraying
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a manufacturing method of a manhole cover with a non-slip function through ARC spraying. The manufacturing method of the manhole cover with the non-slip function through the ARC spraying according to the present invention comprises the following steps of: preparing a steel plate to a thickness of 2 to 35 mm to be coupled to a manhole body forming the manhole cover; roughening the steel plate to increase a surface area through upper surface processing; thermal spray coating using an ARC spray method to create high-hardness surface roughness; spraying a paint on the surface with high hardness and roughness; and forming the manhole cover by coupling the steel plate on the manhole body. An objective of the present invention is to provide the manufacturing method of the manhole cover coupled with the steel plate.

title_en: Device for manufacturing a semiconductor device and method for manufacturing a semiconductor device using the same
abstract_en: A device for manufacturing a semiconductor device is provided. The device for manufacturing a semiconductor device according to some embodiments comprises: a tube extending in a first direction and forming a reaction space inside which a boat accommodating a plurality of substrates is disposed; and first and second nozzles each extending in a first direction within the tube and spaced apart from each other on a plane perpendicular to the first direction and parallel to the upper surface of the substrate, wherein the first and second nozzles include a plurality of first and second injection holes that spray different gases toward the center of the reaction space. Based on the first direction, the second injection hole is disposed in an area between the plurality of first injection holes. Thus, the present invention can provide the device for manufacturing a semiconductor device capable of depositing various types of thin films by dividing the reaction space within an atomic layer deposition device.

title_en: Backing Plate for Sputtering Apparatus and Sputtering Apparatus
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a backing plate for a sputtering apparatus and a sputtering apparatus, which can reduce the risk of deformation of a target in the process of cooling the target. The backing plate for a sputtering apparatus is installed in a chamber of a sputtering apparatus to support a target of the sputtering apparatus and comprises: a backing plate body dividing the inside of the chamber into a processing space in which a sputtering process is carried out and a cooling space in which cooling fluid flows; and a cooling flow path to allow the cooling fluid to flow. The target is coupled to one surface of the backing plate body, and the other surface of the backing plate body is arranged to face the cooling space. The cooling flow path is formed on the other surface of the backing plate body to be exposed toward the cooling space to communicate with the cooling space. The cooling fluid supplied to the cooling space flows in the cooling flow path.

title_en: Window and display device including the same
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to prevent or minimize the reduction of visibility of a display device due to the reflection of external light. The present invention provides a window comprising: a window substrate; a first layer disposed on the window substrate and having a refractive index of 1.2 to 1.4; a second layer disposed on the first layer and including chromium oxide (Cr_2O_3); a third layer disposed on the second layer and having a refractive index of 1.4 to 1.6; and an anti-fingerprint layer disposed on the third layer and including perfluoropolyether (PFPE).

title_en: Apparatus and method for growing hexagonal crystals
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a hexagonal crystal growth device that uses the HVPE method, comprising: a raw material loading part in which a reaction boat is disposed on one side of a reaction tube and raw materials are loaded; and a crystal growth part that is disposed below the raw material loading part and has a growth frame of a predetermined shape concavely formed, wherein the raw material loading part comprises: at least one through-hole formed in a cylindrical bottom surface; a first loading area formed around the through-hole; and a second loading area formed around the first loading area. Aluminum is loaded in the first loading area of the raw material area part, and a main raw material of hexagonal crystal and gallium are loaded in the second loading area of the raw material loading part. In particular, the present invention relates to a device and method for growing bulk-structured hexagonal crystals using an Al-based nano absorber.
