title_en: Structures including metal carbide material, devices including the structures, and methods of forming same
abstract_en: A method for forming thin film structures comprising a metal carbide material, and structures and devices comprising the metal carbide material are disclosed. Exemplary structures include a metal carbide material formed using two or more different processes (e.g., two or more different precursors), so as to enable tuning of various metal carbide material properties including resistivity, current leakage and work function.

title_en: A thermosetting phenolic resin composition, a prepreg impregnated with the composition, and a composite material for manufacturing a rocket nozzle comprising the prepreg
abstract_en: The present invention provides a thermosetting phenolic resin composition comprising from 1.5 to 22 wt% of one or more oxide additives selected from hydrotalcite and zirconia. The thermosetting phenolic resin has excellent heat resistance and can be useful in the manufacture of rocket nozzles.

title_en: Pellet shaped anode feeding style metal-carbon dioxide battery and hydrogen generating and carbon dioxide storage system comprising the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a metal-carbon dioxide battery and a hydrogen generating and carbon dioxide storage system comprising the same, the metal-carbon dioxide battery comprising: a first plate; a second plate; a separating screen located between the first plate and the second plate; a first gasket which is located between the first plate and the separating screen, is provided in a frame shape having the hollow central portion, and supports the edge of the first plate to form a gap between the first plate and the separating screen; an anode material which is accommodated in the gap, and is provided as a pellet shape; and a cathode which is located between the second plate and the separating screen. Therefore, efficiency is increased.

title_en: electrochemical catalysts and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention provides an electrochemical catalyst and a method for preparing the same, wherein the electrochemical catalyst can be implemented as a two-dimensional metal nanosheet having a high specific surface area so that a metal catalyst material having excellent electrical conductivity can be sufficiently used, and at the same time, a manufacturing process is simple so that mass synthesis is easy, and an ultra-thin film and a large area can be implemented so that utilization of the catalyst can be maximized and platinum can be replaced.

title_en: A method of controlling the resistivity and stress of tungsten through PVD sputtering method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a tungsten (W) deposition method of the semiconductor device using a physical vapor deposition (PVD) sputtering method on a semiconductor substrate. The tungsten (W) deposition method comprises: a) a first deposition step of depositing a tungsten film on the semiconductor substrate by using magnetron sputtering of a power density less than 0.5 W/cm^2; b) a step of modifying the surface of deposited tungsten by performing RF bias processing under an inert gas atmosphere; and a second deposition step which additionally deposits the tungsten film by using the magnetron sputtering of the power density more than 0.5 W/cm^2 on the deposited tungsten film.

title_en: Substrate processing apparauts and processing method for substrate
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide a substrate processing apparatus and a substrate processing method for maintaining a continuous gas flow in a vaporizer and a pipe. The substrate processing apparatus comprises: a process chamber (100) in which gas is exhausted through an exhaust line (10); a source gas supply unit (200) for supplying source gas and carrier gas to the process chamber (100); a source gas supply line (300) for connecting the source gas supply unit (200) and the process chamber (100) and delivering the source gas and the carrier gas; and a bypass line (400) having one end connected to the source gas supply line (300) and the other end connected to the exhaust line (10), and allowing the carrier gas to move toward the exhaust line (10) during at least a portion of the time when the supply through the source gas supply line (300) is blocked. According to the present invention, it is possible to prevent source gas from remaining inside.

title_en: Polarizing plate
abstract_en: The present invention provides a novel polarizing plate capable of suppressing a decrease in transmittance under a high temperature environment. The polarizing plate comprises a polarizing element formed by adsorbing and orienting a dichroic dye on a polyvinyl alcohol-based resin layer, and a transparent protective film, wherein the polarizing element has a half width of a peak derived from a polyvinyl alcohol crystal measured by a wide-angle X-ray scattering method of 4.80 nm^(-1) or more. The polarizing element includes potassium ions and metal ions other than the potassium ions, and the content of the metal ions other than the potassium ions in the polarizing element has 0.05 wt% or more The polarizing element and the transparent protective film are bonded by an adhesive layer formed by a polyvinyl alcohol-based resin and a water-based adhesive containing cyclodextrin.

title_en: Thin film deposition apparatus
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a thin film deposition apparatus comprises: a chamber; a first stage and a second stage for supporting substrates in the chamber; an evaporation source assembly moving between a first stage area corresponding to the first stage and a second stage area corresponding to the second stage, and including a plurality of nozzles through which a source material is ejected; and an imaging assembly disposed between the first stage and the second stage to image the nozzles.

title_en: Substrate processing apparatus
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a substrate processing apparatus and, more specifically, to a substrate processing apparatus for performing substrate processing such as deposition, etching, and heat treatment on a substrate. According to the present invention, the substrate processing apparatus comprises: an inner tube (100) having a processing space (S1) in which a substrate (1) is accommodated to perform substrate processing, and an inner exhaust port (110) formed to exhaust the processing space (S1); an outer tube (200) having the inner tube (100) accommodated therein to form a separation space (S2) between the inner tube (100) and the outer tube (200), and having an outer exhaust port (210) accommodated in the processing space (S1) to discharge exhaust gas transmitted through the inner exhaust port (110) to the outside; an inner injection nozzle (300) installed in the processing space (S1) to inject process gas into the processing space (S1); and a gas blocking unit (400) installed in the separation space (S2) to prevent the exhaust gas from penetrating.

title_en: Method for producing iron oxide/graphene oxide composite from waste battery
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing an iron oxide/graphene oxide composite from a waste battery. the method for manufacturing the iron oxide/graphene oxide obtains iron and graphite from a waste lithium ion battery to manufacture graphene oxide having the same physical properties regardless of the degree of deterioration, thereby being applicable to various batteries, and being environmentally friendly in that the discarded lithium ion battery can be reused.

title_en: Multi-band stealth structure
abstract_en: The present invention provides a multi-band stealth structure that can implement excellent camouflage technology by reflecting and radiating a camouflage signal similar to a surrounding environment in a multi-wavelength band by simultaneously controlling reflectivity for an electromagnetic wave in a visible light wavelength band together with emissivity for the electromagnetic wave in an infrared wavelength band. The multiband stealth structure for the same comprises: a base part; and a detection target prevention part having a nano-protrusion part disposed in an upper part of the base part. At this time, the detection target prevention part reflects the electromagnetic wave of a first wavelength band incident from the outside with a first reflectance, and radiates the electromagnetic wave of a second wavelength band radiated to the outside with a first emissivity.

title_en: Manufacturing method of 3-base coated color steel sheet having high corrosion resistance using combined galvanizing and color coating line and manufacturing apparatus using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and an apparatus for manufacturing a high-corrosion-resistant ternary-based plated color steel sheet using a CGCL line. The method comprises: (a) a step (S10) of continuously supplying a metal coil; (b) a step (S20) of cleaning the metal coil; (c) a step (S30) of heat-treating and plating the metal coil; (d) a step (S40) of color-coating the plated metal coil; and (e) a step (S50) of winding the color-coated metal coil on a tension reel. The steps (S10) to (S50) are continuously performed in a single combined galvanizing and color coating line (CGCL). In the step (S30), a plating composition of a plating tank (50) includes 5-15 mass% of Al, 0.3-3 mass% of Mg, 0.05-1 mass% of Cr, and the balance of Zn and inevitable impurities.

title_en: Lane control sigh with vibration-proof and waterproof
abstract_en: A uv protection film, a printing sheet, an anti-vibration film, a lighting pcb, an anti-vibration film, and a protection film are successively laminated.a high vacuum is applied at the melting temperature of the anti-vibration film and the anti-vibration film is flatly laminated to be integrally bonded.the melted anti-vibration film permeates everywhere comprising the lighting pcb surface to enhance anti-vibration and waterproof effects. In particular, since eva or tpu is used as an anti-vibration film, the anti-vibration film can be safely used by being installed wherever vibration and waterproofing are required while having a thin thickness. In addition, since the light panel is configured to be assembled to the frame by changing the insertion direction of the light panel, any one direction selected from both directions can be displayed by using one lane guide display panel, and the light panel can be safely used by being easily hung and fixed to a workplace display panel erected and used in a stand type.

title_en: Layered perovskite air electrode material and Protonic ceramic electrolysis cell comprising the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a multi-layered perovskite air electrode material and a protonic ceramic water electrolysis cell including the same and, more specifically, to a multi-layered perovskite air electrode material having a perovskite structure capable of reducing polarization resistance of an air electrode, and a protonic ceramic water electrolysis cell including the same.

title_en: Catalyst for producing formic acid with high selectivity by electro-oxidizing glycerol and method for producing formic acid using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a catalyst for producing formic acid from glycerol and a method for producing formic acid using the same. More specifically, when glycerol is electrochemically converted using the Au/LaNiO_3 catalyst, there is an advantage that formic acid, a high-value compound, can be selectively produced.

title_en: Tin oxide semiconductor and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an Sn oxide semiconductor and a manufacturing method thereof. The method for manufacturing a p-type Sn oxide semiconductor according to the present invention can manufacture a p-type Sn oxide semiconductor, which has been difficult to form in the past, and can reduce manufacturing costs by using a tin (Sn) precursor, which is relatively cheaper than a metal precursor used in a conventional metal oxide semiconductor. In addition, since the p-type Sn oxide semiconductor according to the present invention corresponds to a metal oxide semiconductor, the p-type Sn oxide semiconductor exhibits uniform characteristics even in a large area, has high carrier mobility, has a wide band gap and low leakage current characteristics, and may be less toxic.

title_en: Apparatus for removing dross of galvanized bath and hot-dip galvanizing equipment including the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a dross removing device and a hot-dip galvanizing facility including the same. The dross removing device comprises: a scraper removing foreign substances attached to at least one of a sink roll immersing a steel sheet in a hot-dip galvanizing solution of a plating bath and a stabilizing roll disposed above the sink roll; and a filtering unit mounted on the scraper and removing dross floating in the hot-dip galvanizing solution in conjunction with the movement of the scraper.

title_en: Annular type optical curing apparatus
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an annular optical curing apparatus, which has a single annular surface irradiation structure to have a simple structure, thereby being manufacturable at low cost, and enables uniform light irradiation by the single annular surface irradiation structure, thereby preventing defects due to non-uniform curing of an adhesive in a camera manufacturing process.

title_en: Method for manufacturing low-cost silicon carbide ceramic bulletproof material
abstract_en: Conventional bulletproof materials are manufactured by bonding ceramic tiles to aramid fiber, high-density polyethylene fiber, carbon fiber, and glass fiber polymer composite plates, so that it is difficult to implement curved surfaces and complex shapes, manufacturing costs are high, and it is difficult to attach to and detach from vehicles and the like. On the other hand, according to the present invention, since wood flour obtained from nature is used as a raw material, the cost of the raw material is low, thereby reducing the manufacturing cost of the bulletproof material. In addition, since wood flour is used as a raw material, a bulletproof material having a curved surface or a complex shape and a bulletproof material of a large size can be easily manufactured by a press mold or a 3D printer.

title_en: Non-metallic Unbonded Fiber-Reinforced Composite Flexible Pipe and Manufacturing Method Thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a non-metallic unbonded fiber-reinforced composite flexible pipe and manufacturing method thereof. The pipe includes, from the inside to the outside: an inner liner layer, a first anti-internal-pressure reinforcement layer, a first anti-wear layer, a second anti-internal-pressure reinforcement layer, a second anti-wear layer, an anti- external-pressure reinforcement layer, an anti-permeation layer, a first anti-tensile reinforcement layer, a third anti-wear layer, a second anti-tensile reinforcement layer, and an outer protective layer. A Kevlar hybrid fiber-optic cable is embedded in the first anti- internal-pressure reinforcement layer. All structural layers are made of non-metallic materials, and adjacent layers are in unbonded contact. The pipe is lightweight, flexible, corrosion-resistant, impermeable, easy to manufacture, and exhibits excellent resistance to internal and external pressures. It also enables real-time monitoring of the pipe's working state, making it suitable for harsh marine environments and complex load conditions, such as subsea oil and gas pipelines and dynamic marine risers.

title_en: System for synthesising photoluminescent films oxicarbos of silicon.
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an HFCVD system for depositing SiCxOy films with highly photoluminescent properties, using low-cost precursors, such as fused quartz (solid source) and ethanol (liquid source) from the deposition of SRO films, incorporating carbon compounds into the reaction chamber from the bubbling of liquid ethanol with molecular hydrogen (carrying gas). The stripping process adds a certain percentage of ethanol vapor into a reaction chamber from the total flow of applied hydrogen. Also, a combination of vapor phase ethanol molecules C2H5OH and molecular hydrogen H2 enters the reaction chamber. The gaseous precursors of SiO and SiH4 are generated by the attack of atomic hydrogen on a quartz source. The carbon compounds C2H5OH are obtained from the decomposition of gaseous ethanol compounds. Said compounds react on a silicon substrate forming a film of silicon oxy-carbide and some other bonds derived from the reaction.

title_en: Pulsed cathodic arc deposition.
abstract_en: An assembly for cathodic arc deposition of a material onto an article. The assembly includes a chamber for receiving an article to be coated and a rotating target. The rotatable target has a surface from which a plasma material is ejected. An anode ring is positioned a first distance from the surface of the rotatable target. The anode ring has an opening with a central axis that is parallel to a rotational axis of the rotatable target and offset a second distance from the rotational axis. A spark device is disposed in the chamber for generating an arc on the surface of the rotatable target. The assembly configured to direct a stream of charged particles ejected from the surface of the target through the opening of the anode ring to the article to be coated.

title_en: Plated steel material.
abstract_en: A plated steel material is provided with a steel material and a plating layer arranged on a surface of the steel material, wherein the plating layer contains, in terms of % by mass, 5.00 to 35.00% of Al, 2.50 to 13.00% of Mg, 5.00 to 40.00% of Fe, 0 to 2.00% of Si and 0 to 2.00% of Ca, with the remainder made up by Zn and impurities, wherein the area ratio of a Zn-dissolved Fe<sub>2</sub>Al<sub>5</sub> phase in which 5% or more of Zn is dissolved as a solid solution is 10 to 60% and the area fraction of a MgZn<sub>2</sub> phase is 10 to 90% in a cross section of the plating layer.

title_en: Method and device for producing direct reduced, carburized metal.
abstract_en: Method and system for producing direct reduced metal material, comprising the steps: a) charging metal material to be reduced into a furnace space (120); b)evacuating an existing atmosphere from the furnace space to achieve a gas pressure of less than 1 bar therein, c) providing heat and hydrogen gas into the furnace space, so that heated hydrogen gas heats the charged metal material to a temperature high enough so that metal oxides present in the metal material are reduced, in turn causing water vapour to be formed, which hydrogen gas provision is performed so that a pressure of more than 1 bar builds up inside the furnace space; and d) before evacuating the built up overpressure, condensing and collecting the water vapour formed in step c in a condenser (160) below the charged metal material. The invention is characterised in that it further comprises the step e) before evacuating the build up overpressure, providing a carbon-containing gas to the furnace space, so that the heated and reduced metal material is carburized by said carbon- containing gas.

title_en: Deflatable inflatable web.
abstract_en: A protective packaging web is disclosed. The web includes a flexible inflatable web that includes inflatable chambers having inlets and configured for receiving a fluid from the inlets and sealing the fluid therein, the inflatable chambers being configured such that, when inflated, the inflatable web structure has a first contoured exterior surface including a plurality of peaks and valleys, and a flexible first outer ply affixed to the peaks and detached from the valleys of the first contoured surface, such that when the inflatable chambers are inflated, the first outer ply extends along a phantom first tangential surface, bridging the valleys of the first contoured surface, such that when the chambers are inflated the affixed first outer ply and the inflatable web cooperatively form a framed structure having significantly elevated bending stiffness compared to a bending stiffness resulting from the inflatable web structure absent the attached first outer ply.

title_en: Method for etching at least one surface of a plastic substrate.
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for etching at least one surface of a plastic substrate, the method comprising the steps (A) to (C), wherein step (C) is an etching step including a contacting with an etching composition. The etching composition comprises permanganate ions and phosphoric acid, each in specifically defined concentration ranges.

title_en: Lubricating film-coated zinc-plated steel sheet and method for manufacturing same.
abstract_en: The present invention provides a zinc-plated steel sheet that undergoes complex forming that is difficult to press form, in particular, a zinc-plated steel sheet provided with a lubricating film having excellent press forming characteristics on a steel sheet having a wide range of surface roughnesses, and a method for manufacturing the same.ã¿¿A film which contains at least 10 wt. % of polyolefin wax having a melting point between 120Â°C and 140Â°C, inclusive, and a mean particle diameter of 3.0 Âµm or less, and includes an organic resin which is at least one or more of an acrylic resin, an epoxy resin, a urethane resin, a phenol resin, a vinyl acetate resin, and a polyester resin is formed on the surface of a zinc-plated steel sheet having a metal zinc layer with an adhesion amount of at least 5 g/m<sup>2</sup>, such that the relationship between a film adhesion amount W (g/m<sup>2</sup>) per side and an arithmetic mean roughness Ra (Î¼m) of the metal zinc layer surface is within the range W â¿¥ 0.12 Ã¿ Ra<sup>2</sup> + 0.1.

title_en: Device for sealing parts of a workpiece for surface treatment of selected surfaces of the workpiece.
abstract_en: Device and method for holding a workpiece (1) during surface treatment of the workpiece (1) by using a fluid and/or a gaseous medium, the workpiece (1) comprising a treatable surface (2), a non-treatable surface (3) and an intermediate surface (10) in between of the treatable surface (2) and the non-treatable surface (3), the device comprising a covering component (7) for covering the non-treatable surface area (3) of the workpiece (1), said covering component (7) comprising a hollow chamber (8) and an opening (51) for receiving the non-treatable surface (3), wherein the covering component (7) comprising a sealing-acting surface (6) that is in contact with the intermediate surface (10) of the workpiece (1) when the non-treatable surface (3) is placed in the interior of the ho|low chamber (8), wherein the sealing-acting surface (6) of the covering component (7) is designed to fit the intermediate surface (10) of the workpiece (1) in such a manner that the interaction between the sealing-acting surface (6) and the intermediate surface (10) has a self-sealing effect, which results in sealing of the hollow chamber (8), so that penetration of the fluid and/or gaseous medium into the hollow chamber (8) is prevented, in this manner preventing contact of the fluid and/or gaseous medium with the non-treatable surface (3) of the workpiece (1) and allowing contact of the fluid and/or gaseous medium with the treatable surface (2) of the workpiece (1).

title_en: Barrier fabrics with desirable air permeability
abstract_en: A barrier web suitable as a backsheet for a lower layer configured for a low air loss bed, wherein the barrier web comprises a first nonwoven web including outermost spunbond layers and two or more nonwoven layers containing fine fibers, each of the nonwoven layers being treated with a non-fluorinated barrier coating (NFBC).

title_en: Compositions, systems, and methods for treating a substrate
abstract_en: The present disclosure is directed to cleaner-coater compositions comprising a Group IVB metal in an amount of 50 ppm to 8,000 ppm based on total weight of the cleaner-coater composition; an electropositive metal; a builder comprising a phosphonate and/or a sugar alcohol; and a cleaner-coater surfactant in an amount of 50 ppm to 20,000 ppm based on total weight of the cleaner-coater composition. The present disclosure is also directed to systems and methods for treating a substrate comprising any of the cleaner-coater compositions disclosed herein and an electrodepositable coating composition. The present disclosure is also directed to substrates treated by any of the cleaner-coater compositions, systems, and/or methods disclosed herein.

title_en: Thermally laminated tab liner
abstract_en: Liner having an induction heat sealable layer for sealing to a rim of a container, and a pull tab for ease of removal of the liner from the container rim. A folded insert disposed between multilayer upper and lower components, has a heat bondable polyolefin layer that is thermally laminated to polyolefin layers of the upper and lower components, forming a pull tab between the integrated polyolefin layers. The resulting composite resists delamination and can be formed in a single thermal lamination step, avoiding the multiple lamination steps, associated high equipment costs, and complex layer constructions of the prior art.

title_en: Two-ply channel liner, label, and roll
abstract_en: A two-ply liner-label and liner-label-roll are provided. A front side of a liner is coated with a release coating. The liner also includes a plurality of die cut tabs that at least partially align with a second die cut label in the label. The backside of the label is coated with an adhesive material and applied to the front side of the liner to form a liner-label roll. The tabs remain affixed to their corresponding individual labels when the labels are removed for placement on packaging; thereby, leaving holes in the liner as the liner is wound into a waste-liner roll within an auto applicator machine.

title_en: Brazing sheet
abstract_en: The invention concerns a brazing sheet comprising a core layer (5) and a braze cladding, said core layer (5) being aluminium or an aluminium alloy, said braze cladding comprising (a) a flux composite layer(2), which flux composite layer comprises a matrix of aluminium or an aluminium alloy, said matrix containing flux particles; (b) at least one filler alloy layer (1) not containing flux particles; and, (c) an aluminium or aluminium alloy layer (3) not containing flux particles, said layer forming the outermost surface of at least one side of the brazing sheet, wherein the flux composite layer (a) is positioned between said filler alloy layer (b) and said aluminium or aluminium alloy layer (c). The invention further concerns a method for its manufacturing, a cladding plate, use of the brazing sheet and a brazed heat exchanger.

title_en: Laminated packaging material, packaging containers manufactured therefrom and a method for manufacturing the laminate material
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a laminated liquid food packaging material, comprising a bulk layer of paper or carton or other cellulose-based material and outer layers of thermoplastic polymers on both sides, having a decorative print pattern arranged beneath one of the outer thermoplastic polymer layers. The invention further relates to the method for manufacturing the laminated packaging material and to a packaging container for liquid food packaging, comprising the laminated packaging material.

title_en: Microbubble electrolyzed water generation device and microbubble electrolyzed water generation method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fine bubble electrolyzed water generating apparatus and a method for generating fine bubble electrolyzed water, and more particularly to a fine bubble electrolyzed water generating apparatus and a method for generating fine bubble electrolyzed water, wherein electrolyzed water and gas that are generated by electrolysis are used to provide alkaline electrolyzed nanobubble water most suitable for use in the overall cleaning field, particularly, in the cleaning of industrial parts and commercial cleaning, and acidic electrolyzed nanobubble water suitable for use in commercial cleaning. title_en: Aqueous Surface Treatment Agent for Zinc Plated Steel Material or Zinc Based Alloy Plated Steel Material, Coating Method, and Coated Steel Material
abstract_en: AQUEOUS SURFACE TREATMENT AGENT FOR ZINC PLATED STEEL MATERIAL OR ZINC BASED ALLOY PLATED STEEL MATERIAL, COATING METHOD, AND COATED STEEL MATERIAL Provided are: an aqueous surface treatment agent for a zinc plated steel material or a zinc-based alloy plated steel material, the agent allowing for the formation of a coating which achieves satisfactory performance, such as corrosion resistance, corrosion resistance after degreasing, coating adhesion, coating adhesion after degreasing, blackening resistance, dew-condensation whitening resistance, treatment agent stability, (production) line-operability and the like, in addition to allowing for the formation of a coating with excellent stack whitening resistance and filament tape resistance; a coating method with the use of the treatment agent; and a coated steel material obtained by using the method.  The aqueous surface treatment agent for a zinc plated steel material or a zinc-based alloy plated steel material is obtained by blending a cationic polyurethane resin (A), a cationic phenol resin (B), a silane coupling agent (C), an acetylacetone complex of titanium (D), an olefinic wax (F), a vanadium compound (E), an acetic acid component (G), and a phosphoric acid component (H) in water.

title_en: Contact layer with a solid filler component
abstract_en: The invention is directed to a contact layer used in waterproofing and roofing applications. The contact layer comprises a solid filler component F and a thermoplastic polymer component P. The invention is also directed to a method for producing the contact layer, to a method for binding two substrates to each other, to a method for waterproofing a substrate, to a waterproofed structure, to a method for sealing a surface against water penetration, to a sealed construction for sealing a substrate against water penetration and to use of the contact layer as waterproofing membrane.

title_en: Liquid material ejection device
abstract_en: Problem: To provide a liquid material ejection device (1) in which a plunger can be efficiently accelerated, the center of gravity of the device can be positioned at a lower level, and satisfactory maintainability can be obtained, and an application apparatus incorporating the liquid material ejection device. Solution: The liquid material ejection device (1) includes a liquid chamber (74) communicating with an ejection port (75) and being supplied with a liquid material, a plunger (50) including a tip portion (52) that has a smaller diameter than the liquid chamber(74) and is moved back and forth in the liquid chamber, an elastic member (54) urging the plunger upward, an arm (30) disposed in a state extending in a substantially horizontal direction, an arm driver (20) serving as a driving source to operate the arm, and a base member (10) on which the arm driver is disposed, wherein the liquid material ejection device further includes a rocking mechanism unit (25) connected to the arm driver (20) and rockingly supporting the arm (30), the arm driver (20) includes a plurality of actuators (21, 22) disposed in a longitudinal direction of the arm, the arm (30) includes a pressing portion (34) pressing the plunger downward, the plunger (50) includes a contact portion (53) pressed by the pressing portion, and the plunger is linearly reciprocated with rocking motion of the arm. The application apparatus incorporates the liquid material ejection device.

title_en: Process for conversion of carbon dioxide and power into fuels and chemicals
abstract_en: The present invention describes a processes, systems, and catalysts for the conversion of carbon dioxide and water and electricity into low carbon or zero carbon high quality fuels and chemicals. In one aspect, the present invention provides an integrated process for the conversion of a feed stream comprising carbon dioxide to a product stream comprising hydrocarbons between 5 and 24 carbon atoms in length.

title_en: Method for manufacturing wet-laid nonwoven textile comprising lignocellulosic fibers
abstract_en: The present utility model relates to a method for manufacturing a nonwoven textile comprising the steps of: performing alkaline treatment on lignocellulosic fibers, wherein the alkaline treatment is one of scouring, bleaching, and a combination thereof; preparing the alkaline-treated lignocellulosic fibers; suspending the prepared lignocellulosic fibers in water with physical agitation, wherein physical agitation comprises at least one of sonication and mechanical stirring; depositing the alkaline-treated lignocellulosic fiber suspension on a thin sheet membrane to produce a nonwoven textile using one of a vacuum-assisted filtration assembly and a conventional wet-laid nonwoven equipment; and press drying the produced nonwoven textile to produce a dried nonwoven textile.

title_en: Method for regeneration of nitrate-ammonium solution of removing cadmium coatings
abstract_en:
FIELD: chemical industry.  
     SUBSTANCE: invention relates to a method for regenerating a nitrate-ammonium solution of removing cadmium coatings from parts by extracting cadmium ions from it using electrochemical treatment at a temperature of 20-45°C in an electrolyzer with a copper cathode and a platinized niobium anode or a platinized titanium anode. The method is characterized by the fact that the electrochemical treatment is carried out in two stages, and at the first stage, cadmium is electrodeposited directly from a nitrate-ammonium solution of removing cadmium coatings in an electrolyzer without separating the cathode and anode spaces at cathode current density of 10-30 A/dm 2  and anode current density of 2-10 A/dm 2 , and at the second stage, electrodeposition is carried out in a two-chamber electrolyzer with a cation-exchange membrane, in the cathode chamber of which there is a solution of ammonium sulfate with a concentration of 20-50 g/l, and in the anode chamber there is still water, in which the parts are washed after the first stage, while the cathode and anode current density is 2-15 A/dm 2 .  
     EFFECT: proposed method, in contrast to the known ones, eliminates the formation of liquid waste containing cadmium compounds, reduces energy consumption and equipment costs. It can be carried out on the cadmium plating section without any changes in the arrangement of the baths.

title_en: Method for manufacturing paperboard comprising a bulk ply
abstract_en: A method for manufacturing paperboard in a paper-making machine, the method comprising the step of:forming a bulk ply by applying a pulp suspension comprising at least 50 wt% (based on the total dry weight of the pulp suspension) of high-bulk softwood pulp and 0.01 -10 wt% (based on the total dry weight of the pulp suspension) of a strength enhancement agent selected from the group consisting of highly refined cellulose, microfibrillated cellulose (MFC), a cationic strength additive, an anionic strength additive, or a combination thereof, from a headbox onto a moving wire to form a wet web, at least partially dewatering the wet web on the wire to obtain an at least partially dewatered web, and drying the at least partially dewatered web to obtain the bulk ply;wherein the wire is provided with a wire shaker which shakes the wire at frequency of 100-600 strokes per minute and a stroke length of 5-35 mm.

title_en: Method for manufacturing a graphene-based thermal interface pad
abstract_en: Method for manufacturing a thermal interface film, the method comprising: providing (200) a stack (100) of graphene-based films (101); pressing (202) the stack of graphene-based films between a first mould (102, 402) and a second mould (104, 404) to form a compressed film (106), wherein at least one of the first and second mould has a profiled surface; infiltrating (204) a polymer (108) in the compressed film to form an infiltrated film (110); curing (206) the infiltrated film (110); and cutting (208) the cured infiltrated film in a direction perpendicular to the plane of the graphene-based films to form a graphene-enhanced thermal interface pad (116).

title_en: Copper alloy sheet, copper alloy sheet with plating film, and method of producing the same
abstract_en: A copper alloy plate which contains, at the thickness center thereof as observed in the plate thickness direction, 0.3 to 1.2% by mass inclusive of Mg and 0.001 to 0.2% by mass inclusive of P, with the remainder made up by Cu and unavoidable impurities, wherein the copper alloy plate has such a surface layer part that the Mg concentration in the plate surface is 30% or less of the bulk Mg concentration at the thickness center and the surface layer part has a depth at which the Mg concentration is 90% of the bulk Mg concentration as observed from the plate surface, and the Mg concentration in the surface layer part increases from the plate surface toward the thickness center at a concentration gradient of 1.8 to 50% by mass/[mu]m inclusive.

title_en: Control method of substrate treatment apparatus and substrate treatment apparatus
abstract_en: To provide a control method of a substrate treatment apparatus suitably controlling supply of heat transfer gas, and a substrate treatment apparatus. Provided is a control method of a substrate treatment apparatus including a stage for mounting a substrate in a main body vessel, an annular member, a gas introduction part, an exhaust part, and a heat transfer gas supply/exhaust part for supplying or exhausting heat transfer gas to a back space. The control method has a step in which the substrate is mounted on the stage, and the annular member is mounted on and pressed against the substrate, a step in which a pressure of heat transfer gas to be supplied to the back space is prepared in the heat transfer gas supply/exhaust part, a step in which heat transfer gas is supplied to the back space from the heat transfer gas supply/exhaust part, a step in which gas is introduced from the gas introduction part into the main body vessel to perform a treatment to the substrate, a first exhaust step in which heat transfer gas is exhausted from the back space via an orifice, a second exhaust step in which heat transfer gas is exhausted from the back space after the first exhaust step, and a step in which the annular member is removed from the substrate.

title_en: Curable silicone composition, its cured body and manufacturing process thereof
abstract_en: To provide a curable silicone composition or the like, which has hot melt properties and firmly adheres to a slightly adhesive base material, and a cured product of which obtained by over-mold forming or the like has especially excellent flexibility and toughness from room temperature to high temperatures around 150 DEG C, while being not susceptible to warping or breaking even if integrally molded with a lead frame or the like. A curable silicone composition which is characterized by containing (A) organopolysiloxane resin fine particles that contain at least 20% by mole of a siloxane unit represented by RSiO3/2 (wherein R represents a monovalent hydrocarbon group) in all siloxane units, (B) one or more adhesiveness imparting agents that are selected from among silatrane derivatives and carbasilatrane derivatives, (C) a curing agent and (D) a functional inorganic filler, with the content of component (D) being at least 50% by volume relative to the entire composition, and which is also characterized by being in a solid state at 25 DEG C, while having hot melt properties at a temperature of 200 DEG C or less; and use of this curable silicone composition.

title_en: Diamond substrate and method for manufacturing the same
abstract_en: A method for manufacturing diamond substrate of using source gas containing hydrocarbon gas and hydrogen gas to form diamond crystal on an underlying substrate by CVD method, to form a diamond crystal layer having nitrogen-vacancy centers in at least part of the diamond crystal, nitrogen or nitride gas is mixed in the source gas, wherein the source gas is: 0.005 volume % or more and 6.000 volume % or less of the hydrocarbon gas; 93.500 volume % or more and less than 99.995 volume % of the hydrogen gas; and 5.0*10<SP>-5</SP> volume % or more and 5.0*10<SP>-1</SP> volume % or less of the nitrogen gas or the nitride gas, and the diamond crystal layer having the nitrogen-vacancy centers is formed. A method for manufacturing a diamond substrate to form an underlying substrate, a diamond crystal having a dense nitrogen-vacancy centers (NVCs) with an orientation of NV axis by performing the CVD.

title_en: Anisotropic epitaxial growth
abstract_en: Generally, examples described herein relate to methods and semiconductor processing systems for anisotropically epitaxially growing a material on a silicon germanium(SiGe) surface. In an example, a surface of silicon germanium is formed on a substrate. Epitaxial silicon germanium is epitaxially grown on the surface of silicon germanium. A first growth rate of the epitaxial silicon germanium is in a first direction perpendicular to the surface of silicon germanium, and a second growth rate of the epitaxial silicon germanium is in a second direction perpendicular to the first direction. The first growth rate is at least 5 times greater than the second growth rate.

title_en: Pressure sensitive adhesive article
abstract_en:
Provided is a pressure sensitive adhesive article comprising
(a) a substrate (Sa)
(b) in contact with the substrate (Sa), a layer (Lb) of a presure sensitive composition (Cb) that comprises one or more acrylic polymer (POLb) having Tg of 20°C or lower, and
(c) in contact with the layer (Lb), a layer (Lc) that comprises,
(i) one or more acrylic polymer (POLc) having Tg of 20°C or lower, and
(ii) one or more olefin copolymer.
Also provided are a method of making the pressure sensitive adhesive article and a bonded article made by using the pressure sensitive adhesive article.

title_en: Pusher device capable of tilting pushing plate
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a pusher device, which comprises a pusher, and the pusher comprises a body frame, and the body frame is provided with a control board, a hydraulic motor, a hydraulic solenoid valve set, a battery, a wheel set, and an operation panel. A pushing rack set is assembled on the pusher. The pushing rack set is composed of at least two pushing frames that are composed of a pushing frame A and a pushing frame B. A sliding rail is disposed between the pushing frame A and the pushing frame B. The pushing frame A is provided with a pump, wherein the axle of the pump is assembled on the pushing frame B; and, a pushing head. The pushing head is assembled with the pushing frame B and is provided with a pushing plate. The pusher utilizes the pump and the axle to push the pushing frame B outward, so the pushing plate may push the contacted objects to achieve the purpose of bringing materials together.

title_en: Method of depositing epitaxial material, structure formed using the method, and system for performing the method
abstract_en: A method of depositing one or more epitaxial material layers, a device structure formed using the method and a system for performing the method are disclosed. Exemplary methods include coating a surface of a reaction chamber with a precoat material, processing a number of substrates, and then cleaning the reaction chamber.

title_en: Surface protection film, optical film and display device
abstract_en: A surface protection film provided by the present disclosure includes at least two laminated antibacterial layers. The surface protection film has a body region and a grip region disposed at a side of the body region. The grip region is configured to strip at least one of the antibacterial layers. An optical film provided by the present disclosure includes a polarizer and the surface protection film disposed on the polarizer. A display device including the surface protection film is further provided by the present disclosure.

title_en: Producing method of pd-adsorbed zno nanostructures
abstract_en: The present invention reveals a producing method of Pd-adsorbed ZnO nanostructures comprising: preparing an ITO substrate which comprising a plurality of Zinc oxide (ZnO) nanostructures; using a photochemical reaction method to adsorb a number of palladium (Pd) nanoparticles on the surface of ZnO nanostructures. Compare to the traditional away, such as E-beam Evaporator system or Thermal Evaporation Deposition system, the present invention by using a photochemical reaction method not only achieves the effects with simplifying the producing steps, down costing the price, but also improves the development of the field emission.

title_en: Method of forming cobalt layer on substrate
abstract_en: In one implementation, a method of forming a cobalt layer on a substrate is provided. The method comprises forming a barrier and/or liner layer on a substrate having a feature definition formed in a first surface of the substrate, wherein the barrier and/or liner layer is formed on a sidewall and bottom surface of the feature definition. The method further comprises exposing the substrate to a ruthenium precursor to form a ruthenium-containing layer on the barrier and/or liner layer. The method further comprises exposing the substrate to a cobalt precursor to form a cobalt seed layer atop the ruthenium-containing layer. The method further comprises forming a bulk cobalt layer on the cobalt seed layer to fill the feature definition.

title_en: System and methods for a radiant heat cap in a semiconductor wafer reactor
abstract_en: A reaction apparatus contacts a process gas on a semiconductor wafer during a wafering process. The semiconductor wafer defines a center region. The reaction apparatus includes an upper dome, a lower dome, a shaft, and a cap. The lower dome is attached to the upper dome, and the upper dome and the lower dome define a reaction chamber. The cap is positioned on the shaft within the reaction chamber for reducing heat absorbed by the center region of the semiconductor wafer. The cap is attached to a first end of the shaft. The cap includes a tube and a disc. The tube defines a tube diameter larger than a shaft diameter of the shaft. The tube circumscribes the first end of the shaft. The disc is attached to the tube and is positioned to block radiant heat from heating the center region of the semiconductor wafer.

title_en: Method for producing polyimide resin powder
abstract_en: A method for producing a polyimide resin powder, the method including a step of reacting a tetracarboxylic acid component (A) containing a tetracarboxylic dianhydride and a diamine component (B) containing an aliphatic diamine in the presence of a solvent (C) containing an alkylene glycol-based solvent represented by formula (1), the step comprising: a step of, separately preparing a solution (a) containing the tetracarboxylic component (A) in the solvent (C) and a solution (b) containing the diamine component (B) in the solvent (C), subsequently adding the solution (b) to the solution (a) or adding the solution (a) to the solution (b) to prepare a solution (c) containing a polyimide resin precursor containing a polyamic acid, and then imidizing the polyimide resin precursor containing the polyamic acid by heating the solution (c) and precipitating the polyimide resin powder from the solution, wherein the solid fraction concentration of the solution (c) is within a range from 15 to 25% by mass, and the average rate of temperature increase of the solution (c) when heating from 70 to 130 DEG C is within a range from 0.5 to 8 DEG C per minute. (Ra1 is a hydrogen atom or an alkyl group of 1 to 4 carbon atoms, Ra2 is a linear alkylene group of 2 to 6 carbon atoms, and n is an integer from 1 to 3.).

title_en: Nitrogen doping agent feeding device and method and manufacturing system of nitrogen-doped single crystal silicon rod
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a nitrogen doping agent feeding device and method and a manufacturing system of a nitrogen-doped single crystal silicon rod. The nitrogen doping agent feeding device comprises a bearing pipe with an opening formed in the bottom, wherein the bearing pipe is used for bearing silicon nitride to be molten; a heating device which surrounds the outer side of the bearing pipe and is used for heating the silicon nitride to be molten to enable the silicon nitride to be molten to be completely molten into a silicon nitride melt; a blocking device which is arranged in the bearing tube and can be attached to the bottom of the bearing tube to shield the opening, so that the silicon nitride to be molten is prevented from falling into the quartz crucible from the opening; a gap can be formed between the blocking device and the bottom of the bearing pipe to open the opening, so that the silicon nitride melt drops into the quartz crucible bearing the silicon melt containing boron atoms from the opening; and a lifting mechanism which is used for lifting or descending the blocking device.

title_en: Surface modification method, method for producing resin plating material, and electroless plating apparatus
abstract_en: The present invention provides a surface modification method which is capable of imparting the surface of a base material with adhesiveness by a method that has higher controllability than ever before, substantially without providing the surface of the base material with recesses and projections. This surface modification method comprises: a step (a) in which a base material that is formed of an insulating resin material is prepared; and a step (b) in which the surface of the base material is irradiated with ultraviolet light having a wavelength of 200 nm or less in an atmosphere that has an oxygen concentration of 0.01% by volume to 10% by volume, thereby modifying a region to be processed of the base material, the region to be processed including the surface, into a microporous layer that contains pores having a size of the order of nanometers.

title_en: Conformal metal dichalcogenides
abstract_en: Transition metal dichalcogenide films and methods for depositing transition metal dichalcogenide films on a substrate are described. Methods for converting transition metal oxide films to transition metal dichalcogenide films are also described. The substrate is exposed to a metal precursor and an oxidant to form a transition metal oxide film; the transition metal oxide film is exposed to a chalcogenide precursor to form the transition metal dichalcogenide film.

title_en: Optical filter and near-infrared cut filter
abstract_en: The present invention comprises a pair of translucent surfaces facing each other in a plate thickness direction, and an outer peripheral surface extending in the plate thickness direction from the pair of translucent surfaces. This optical filter comprises a glass plate and a protective film that covers the glass plate. The protective film forms the pair of translucent surfaces and the outer peripheral surface. A ridge-line part forming a boundary between the translucent surfaces and the outer peripheral surface has a curved surface shape. The ridge-line part has a plurality of dimples. The present invention is characterized in that the minimum value of the radius of curvature of bottom surfaces of dimples present on an arbitrary line segment having a length of 200 [mu]m along the outer periphery of the translucent surfaces in the ridge-line part is 5 [mu]m or greater.

title_en: Substrate holder
abstract_en: One object of this application is to provide an advanced substrate holder including a clamper. A substrate holder for holding a substrate by interposing the substrate between frames is disclosed. The substrate holder includes a front frame, a rear frame, and one or a plurality of clampers. Each of the clampers includes a hook portion including a hook base and a hook main body, and a plate including at least one claw. At least one of the clampers includes the plate including a first claw for a lock and a second claw for a semi-lock.

title_en: Sheet for forming first protective film, method for manufacturing semiconductor device and use of sheet
abstract_en: To provide a sheet for forming a first protective film 1 is used for forming a first protective film at least on a bumped surface of a semiconductor wafer, and the sheet for forming the first protective film 1 comprises a first base material 11, a buffer layer 12, an intermediate release layer 13, and a first-protective-film forming film 14, laminated in this order in a thickness direction, and the product (t.Gx') of the thickness (t) of the intermediate release layer 13 and the shear storage modulus (Gx') of the intermediate release layer 13 is less than 1.0*106 [mu]m.Pa.

title_en: Powder transfer roller device and powder transfer method
abstract_en: A powder transfer roller device includes a first roller having a raised portion provided in a part of the circumferential surface of the first roller; a second roller which is opposed to the first roller and which compacts, between the second roller and the raised portion of the first roller, powder supplied between the first roller and the second roller; and a powder supplying device configured to supply powder between the first roller and the second roller.

title_en: Method for crystal growth and wafer
abstract_en: A method for crystal growth includes providing a seed crystal in crystal growth furnace system. After multiple time points, a crystal is formed from the seed crystal and along the first direction, wherein the crystal includes multiple sub-crystals which are stacked along the first direction. During the multiple time points, each sub-crystal is formed corresponding to each time point. Those sub-crystals include multiple end surfaces which are away from the seed crystal. The maximum difference of temperature of either two of those end surfaces is equal or smaller than 20 degrees. A wafer is further mentioned.

title_en: Adhesive sheet and optical laminate
abstract_en: The present invention provides an adhesive sheet that is capable of suppressing corrosion of a conductive layer, especially a conductive layer containing a metal oxide such as ITO, and is suitable for adjusting the anchoring force with an optical film to a large value. The adhesive sheet 1 of the present invention is formed from an adhesive agent composition containing a monomer group and/or a polymer of the monomer group. The adhesive sheet 1 has a first surface 1a and a second surface 1b that are opposite to each other. In the adhesive sheet 1, the amount of carboxyl group-containing monomers blended in the adhesive agent composition and the element ratio R1 in the first surface 1a satisfy at least one selected from the group consisting of requirements (1) and (2).

title_en: Plated steel material
abstract_en: This plated steel material comprises a steel material and a plating layer disposed on the surface of the steel material, wherein: the average chemical composition of the plating layer is a prescribed composition; and a cross-section of the plating layer perpendicular to the surface of the steel material has a structure, as observed by a scanning electron microscope, in which, in terms of area proportions, an MgZn2 phase is 10% to 50%, the total of an Al phase, an Al-Zn phase, and a Zn-Al phase is 15% to 75%, and an Al/MgZn2/Zn ternary eutectic structure is 0% to 65%, with the remainder being 0% to 5.0%, and the total area ratio of the Al phase and the Zn-Al phase with respect to the Al-Zn phase ([Al]+[Zn-Al])/[Al-Zn]) is 0.8 or more.

title_en: A graphene-containing laminate
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method of forming a graphene-containing laminate, the method comprising: providing a first graphene layer structure on a substrate; forming a first metal oxide layer on the graphene layer structure by depositing and then oxidising a layer of metal; forming a second metal oxide layer on the first metal oxide layer; and forming a second graphene layer structure on the second metal oxide layer by CVD.

title_en: Composite body, catalytic ink, and method for manufacturing composite body
abstract_en: Provided is a composite body comprising molybdenum disulfide and molybdenum trioxide, in which the molybdenum disulfide contains a 3R crystal structure, the content of molybdenum in terms of a molybdenum trioxide (B) calculated from the molybdenum content determined by the XRF analysis of the composite body relative to the whole mass of the composite body is 5 to 90% by mass. Also provided is a catalytic ink comprising the composite body and a solvent. Also provided is a method for manufacturing the composite body, the method comprising a burning step for heating molybdenum trioxide at a temperature of 400 DEG C or lower in the presence of a sulfur source.

title_en: Backside metallization thin film structure and method for forming the same
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide a backside metallization thin film structure, including: a wafer, wherein a plurality of integrated circuit elements are formed on the front side of the wafer; and a metal nano-twinned thin film on the backside of the wafer, wherein the metal nano-twinned thin film includes silver, copper, gold, palladium or nickel, wherein the metal nano-twinned thin film has a transition layer near the wafer and a twin layer away from the wafer, the twin layer accounts for at least 70% of the thickness of the metal nano-twinned thin film, and has a parallel-arranged twin boundary, and the parallel-arranged twin boundary includes more than 50% (111) crystal orientation. The backside metallization thin film structure is formed by activating the wafer surface by ion beam bombardment, followed by performing an evaporation deposition process on the activated wafer surface with a simultaneous ion bombardment on the surface of deposited thin film.

title_en: Adhesive sheet, adhesion method, and wound body
abstract_en: Provided is an adhesive sheet with which winding misalignment is unlikely to occur during construction, and wrinkling after attachment is also unlikely to occur. This adhesive sheet includes a laminate in which a peeling layer, a base layer, and an adhesive layer are laminated in this order, and a release processing layer is formed on the surface of the peeling layer on the side opposite to the base layer. The adhesive sheet of the present invention makes winding misalignment unlikely to occur during construction, and also makes wrinkling after attachment unlikely to occur.

title_en: Antifouling coating composition, antifouling coating film, antifouling laminate, and methods for producing same
abstract_en: The antifouling coating composition of the present invention contains: a copolymer compound of a fluorinated alkyl alkoxysilane and a quaternary ammonium salt-type alkoxysilane; and an alkoxysilane having a perfluoropolyether structure.

title_en: Adhesive composition, adhesive film for circuit connection, connection structure, and method for producing connection structure
abstract_en: An adhesive composition according to the present invention contains a cationically polymerizable compound and a curing agent. The cationically polymerizable compound contains an epoxy compound having three or more functional groups and an epoxy equivalent weight of more than 100 g/eq to 250 g/eq. The curing agent contains a pyridinium salt, the pyridinium salt has a benzyl group at position 1 and an electron withdrawing group at position 2, and the benzyl group has an electron donating group. An adhesive film for circuit connection according to the present invention comprises an adhesive layer formed from the adhesive composition.

title_en: Ald deposition method and system
abstract_en: A method and system for depositing a material on one or more substrates by atomic layer deposition. The method comprising a step of performing a pulse (1) of a precursor of said material, wherein at least one of the average flow rate (f) and the average partial pressure (r) of said precursor over a first half (2) of the pulse (1) is higher than over a second half (3) of the pulse (1).

title_en: Hydrogen generator with extractable filter
abstract_en:
A hydrogen generator with extractable filter includes a water tank, an electrolysis module configured in the water tank, a filtering device coupled to the water tank, a humidifying module vertically configured above the water tank, an integrated passageway module vertically configured above the humidifying module, and a condenser configured on the integrated passageway module. The electrolysis module is configured to electrolyze water contained in the water tank to generate gas comprising hydrogen. The humidifying module includes a humidifying chamber and a gas passage isolated from the 
humidifying chamber. The filtering device is disposed in the gas passage to receive and filter the gas comprising hydrogen generated by the electrolysis module. The condenser is configured to condense the gas comprising hydrogen outputted by the filtering device. The integrated passageway module includes a gas input channel for guiding the gas comprising hydrogen outputted from the condenser into the humidifying chamber.

title_en: Electrolysis apparatus
abstract_en: There is provided an electrolysis apparatus capable of preventing a short circuit between an anode chamber assembly and a cathode chamber assembly. An electrolytic cell unit 4 of an electrolysis apparatus 2 includes an anode chamber assembly 6 and a cathode chamber assembly 8. The anode chamber assembly 6 includes a first partition wall 10, a first flange 12 provided at a peripheral edge of the first partition wall 10, and a first gasket 14 attached to the first flange 12. The cathode chamber assembly 8 includes a second partition wall 26, a second flange 28 provided at a peripheral edge of the second partition wall 26, and a second gasket 30 attached to the second flange 28. A short circuit preventing means is provided between the first flange 12 and the second flange 28 to prevent a short circuit therebetween.

title_en: WNiX sputtering target
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sputtering target, produced by powder metallurgy comprising tungsten (W), nickel (Ni) and one further metal X selected from the group consisting of group 5 or group 6 of the periodic table, as well as inevitable impurities, wherein the sputtering target has a two-phase microstructure, wherein one phase is pure W and the other phase is a mixed phase selected from the group of NiWX, NiW, NiX and mixtures thereof. The invention further relates to a process for producing a WNiX sputtering target via the powder-metallurgical route.

title_en: Method of depositing a tungsten containing layer
abstract_en: A method of forming a structure on a substrate includes forming an adhesion layer on a substrate. The method further includes forming a tungsten containing layer in-situ with the adhesion layer. The tungsten containing layer is formed by a one-time soak process including soaking the substrate once, and only once, in a first gas, purging the first gas, and soaking the substrate once, and only once, in a second gas. The method further includes removing the tungsten containing layer from the adhesion layer.

title_en: Thin film, in-situ measurement through transparent crystal and transparent substrate within processing chamber wall
abstract_en: A system includes a transparent crystal, at least part of which is embedded within a wall and a liner of a processing chamber. The transparent crystal has a proximal end and a distal end, the distal end having a distal surface exposed to an interior of the processing chamber. A transparent thin film is deposited on the distal surface and has chemical properties substantially matching those of the liner. A light coupling device is to: transmit light, from a light source, through the proximal end of the transparent crystal, and focus, into a spectrometer, light received reflected back from a combination of the distal surface, a surface of the transparent thin film, and a surface of a process film layer deposited on the transparent thin film. The spectrometer is to detect a first spectrum within the focused light that is representative of the process film layer.

title_en: Black film structure for optical sensing device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a black film structure for an optical sensing device. The structure includes a device substrate, a first section of metal absorption film, and a second section of reflective rate maintenance film. The first section of metal absorption film is stacked on top of the device substrate, and the second section of reflective rate maintenance film is stacked on top of the first section of metal absorption film. The first section of metal absorption film absorbs stray light in the incident light or does not require light source absorption, allowing only purer light to enter the optical sensing device. This effectively enhances the optical reflection efficiency and maintains a stable reflectance for the optical sensing device. This achieves the advantages of structural stability and improved functional effectiveness.

title_en: Foam sheet and adhesive tape
abstract_en: Disclosed is a foam sheet which has a tensile strength of 1 MPa to 9 MPa and a breaking strength of 3.5 MPa or less at the time of interlaminar strength measurement. This foam sheet does not break during the interlaminar strength measurement, and the thickness of the whole foam sheet is 0.05 mm to 0.9 mm.

title_en: Method for supplying raw material gas, device for supplying raw material gas, and device for forming film on substrate
abstract_en: This method for supplying a raw material gas includes: a step for supplying power to a heater provided to a raw material container storing a solid raw material, and heating the inside of the raw material container to sublimate the solid raw material; a step for supplying a carrier gas into the raw material container heated by the heater, mixing the carrier gas with the sublimated raw material, and supplying the mixed result as a raw material gas to a consumption area where a substrate is disposed; and a step for obtaining an index value having a correspondence relationship with the remaining amount of the solid raw material. When performing the step for sublimating the solid raw material, power corresponding to the index value when performing the step is supplied to the heater on the basis of a correspondence relationship between a preset index value and the power supplied to the heater.

title_en: Peald titanium nitride with direct microwave plasma
abstract_en: A method of depositing titanium nitride is disclosed. Some embodiments of the disclosure provide a PEALD process for depositing titanium nitride which utilizes a direct microwave plasma. In some embodiments, the direct microwave plasma has a high plasma density and low ion energy. In some embodiments, the plasma is generated directly above the substrate surface.

title_en: Adhesive composition, adhesive, primer layer, molded article, lamination molded article manufacturing method, use of primers
abstract_en: This adhesive composition comprises a cellulose derivative and a solvent component. The cellulose derivative has a degree of substitution with an acetyl group of 1.9-2.6. The solvent component comprises an organic solvent A having a boiling point of 100 DEG C or higher and an SP value of 18-30 (J1/2/cm3/2). The amount of the cellulose derivative is 15 mass% to 30 mass% inclusive with respect to the total amount of the cellulose derivative and the organic solvent A.

title_en: Recyclable polymer laminates
abstract_en:
A recyclable laminate including (a) at least one first polymer film layer, (b) at least one second polymer film layer, and (c) one or more adhesives. The first polymer film layer includes a first polymer selected from a polyester polymer, a polyamide polymer, or a first polyolefin polymer and the second polymer film layer includes a second polyolefin polymer. The adhesive includes a block polymer of polyolefin and polyester polyol cured with a polyaliphatic isocyanate and having a structure in accordance with:
         where X, Y, X
         1 , and Y
         1 are from 3 to 6; Z and Z
         1 are from 1 to 20; m, n, and h are from 1 to 12; and K is from 1 to 100. Further, the adhesive is disposed on the surface of at least one of the first or second polymer film layers for binding the first and second polymer film layers together.

title_en: Adhesive composition, and adhesive sheet, laminate and printed wiring board each containing same
abstract_en: The present invention provides: an adhesive composition that has excellent solder heat resistance and adhesive strength, and also has excellent dielectric characteristics with low relative permittivity and low loss tangent; and an adhesive sheet, a laminate, and a printed wiring board each containing the adhesive composition. The adhesive composition according to the present invention comprises a polyimide resin and an epoxy resin (E), and is characterized in that: the epoxy resin (E) includes an epoxy resin (A) represented by formula (I); and the content of a glycidyl ether-type epoxy resin (B) contained as the epoxy resin (E) is 5 parts by mass or less with respect to 100 parts by mass of the polyimide resin. In formula (I), R1 to R5 each independently represent a hydrogen atom or a C1-10 alkyl group.

title_en: Multizone gas distribution plate for trench profile optimization
abstract_en: A gas distribution device for a substrate processing system includes an upper plate including a first hole and a plurality of second holes and a lower plate. The lower plate includes a recessed region formed in one of an upper surface of the lower plate and a lower surface of the upper plate. The recessed region defines a plenum volume between the upper plate and the lower plate. The lower plate further includes a raised fence located within the recessed region. The fence separates the plenum volume into a first plenum and a second plenum, the first plenum is in fluid communication with the first hole, and the second plenum is in fluid communication with the plurality of second holes.

title_en: Optical laminate and image display apparatus using the optical laminate
abstract_en: There is provided a an optical laminate that includes liquid crystal alignment fixed layers, and suppresses deformation of each of the liquid crystal alignment fixed layers at the time of transfer thereof during production and can be produced with high productivity. The optical laminate includes: a polarizing plate including a polarizer; and a retardation layer laminated on the polarizing plate via an adhesion layer, wherein the retardation layer includes, in this order from a polarizing plate side, a first liquid crystal alignment fixed layer, and a second liquid crystal alignment fixed layer, wherein the retardation layer has one of a circular polarization function or an elliptical polarization function, and a relationship of Re(450)<Re(550)<Re(650) as a whole, and wherein the adhesion layer has a hardness of 50 MPa or more, a modulus of elasticity of 800 MPa or more, and an indentation load of 900 [mu]N or more.

title_en: Organic-to-inorganic bonding methods and structures
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are bonded structures and methods of forming the bonded structures. In some embodiments, the bonded structures include a first element having an inorganic dielectric surface, a second element having an organic dielectric surface, an interface layer between the first and second elements and bonded to the inorganic and organic dielectric surfaces. The method of forming the bonded structure includes providing the first and second elements, exposing the inorganic dielectric surface to a silane coupling agent to form the interface layer, contacting the organic dielectric surface to the interface layer, and heating the first element, second element, and interface layer to bond the first element to the second element.

title_en: Coating agent for lift-off process and manufacturing method for laminate that has excellent fine line reproducibility, immersion washability, printing adaptability, and temporal stability, and is used for a lift-off process including a pattern formation step that does not utilize exposure
abstract_en: The problem to be solved by the present invention is to provide a coating agent for a lift-off process that has excellent fine line reproducibility, immersion washability, printing adaptability, and temporal stability, and is used for a lift-off process including a pattern formation step that does not utilize exposure. A coating agent for a lift-off process is used for a lift-off process including a pattern formation step that does not utilize exposure, wherein the coating agent contains an aqueous resin having acidic groups and inorganic fine particles. In the coating agent, after treating a laminate having a coating layer with a film thickness of 1 [mu]m on a substrate formed using the coating agent under the following conditions, the residual rate of the coating layer represented by the following (Formula 1) is less than 80 mass%. (Treatment conditions) After immersing the laminate in ion-exchanged water at 40 DEG C for 10 minutes, it is dried in an oven at 80 DEG C for 1 minute. (Formula 1) Residual rate of coating layer (mass%) = (mass of coating layer after treatment)/(mass of coating layer before treatment)*100. The aqueous resin having acidic groups is a polyvinyl alcohol-based resin (A) having acidic groups. An aqueous resin having no acidic groups is also included in the coating agent. The mass ratio of the aqueous resin having acidic groups to the aqueous resin having no acidic groups is 9:1 to 1:9. The inorganic fine particles are at least one selected from the group consisting of calcium carbonate, barium sulfate, magnesium carbonate, silicon dioxide, titanium oxide, talc, montmorillonite, kaolin, and mica. The average particle diameter of the inorganic fine particles obtained by laser scattering method is 5 [mu]m or less. The mass ratio of the aqueous resin having acidic groups to the inorganic fine particles is 1:0.2 to 1:3. The coating agent further includes an alcoholic organic solvent. The alcoholic organic solvent is at least one selected from the group consisting of methanol, ethanol, isopropanol, and n-propanol.

title_en: Selective etching of alternating layers of silicon oxide and silicon nitride for high aspect ratio contacts
abstract_en: Exemplary semiconductor processing methods may include flowing a fluorine containing precursor into a processing region of a semiconductor processing chamber. A substrate may be positioned within the processing region. The substrate may include alternating layers of silicon nitride and silicon oxide. The methods may include forming plasma effluents of the fluorine-containing precursor. The methods may include contacting the substrate with the plasma effluents of the fluorine-containing precursor. The contacting may selectively etch an exposed portion of silicon nitride. The methods may include introducing a phosphorous-and fluorine-containing precursor into the processing region of the semiconductor processing chamber while maintaining a flow of the fluorine-containing precursor. The methods may include forming plasma effluents of the fluorine-containing precursor and the phosphorous-and fluorine-containing precursor. The methods may include contacting the substrate with the plasma effluents of the fluorine-containing precursor and the phosphorous-and-fluorine containing precursor. The contacting may selectively etch an exposed portion of silicon oxide.

title_en: Active divert pressure tuning
abstract_en: An apparatus for semiconductor processing including a junction point, a gas delivery system, a precursor delivery system, a divert valve, and a pressure regulator. The gas delivery system is fluidically connected with the junction point via a conduit and configured to supply at least one process gas to the junction point. The precursor delivery system is fluidically connected with the junction point and configured to supply at least one precursor to the junction point in a vapor and/or gaseous phase. The divert valve includes a first inlet fluidically connected with the precursor delivery system, a first outlet fluidically connected with the junction point, and a second outlet fluidically connected with an exhaust via another conduit. The pressure regulator is fluidically interposed between the second outlet and the exhaust, and configured to control pressure in at least a portion of the other conduit based on pressure in the conduit.

title_en: Ai automated pvd of micro led chips system
abstract_en: The present disclosure discloses an automated PVD of micro LED chips system in which an automated PVD inspection module, an automated PVD post-processing module which measures at least one parameter from an additional group of parameters that determines how well the parameters of said first and second group were running, and an automated PVD historical module which calculates a plurality of group parameters based upon parameters of the first group, second group, third group, and fourth group, and an automated PVD integration module to update the automated PVD processing module based upon the results of the automated PVD historical module.

title_en: Fireproof thermal insulator
abstract_en:
A fireproof thermal insulator is used to solve the issue of flashover that commonly occurs when the conventional thermal insulator is applied in high-temperature environments. The fireproof thermal insulator includes: a first insulation layer having a first surface and a second surface opposite the first surface, where the first insulation layer comprises 40-50 wt% of aerogel, 40-50 wt% of glass fiber, and greater than 0 but not more than 20 wt% of additives, with the density of the first insulation layer ranging from 160 to 240 kg/m
         3 ; and an air barrier layer having a first surface and a second surface opposite the first surface, where the first surface of the air barrier layer is bonded to the second surface of the first insulation layer. Accordingly, the present invention is able to enhance the insulation effectiveness and to reduce the fire risk.

title_en: Vacuum coating protection method of electronic component and application of vacuum coating protection method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the technical field of electronic components, and discloses a vacuum coating protection method of an electronic component and application thereof.
