By using the present application, the direction of flow of a process gas may change during the process of passing through the flow equalizing assembly, thus helping achieve equal gas discharge volumes from the gas outlets, improving the distribution uniformity of the process gas, which in turn improves the process uniformity and product yield.

title_en: Method for manufacturing laminated member
abstract_en: In this method for manufacturing a laminated member, a laminated member (1) that includes a printed layer (3) having a to-be-molded surface (3a) with a raised and recessed textured portion (31) and a to-be-printed surface (3b) on the reverse side from the to-be-molded surface (3a), and includes a printing layer (4) to be printed onto the to-be-printed surface (3b), is manufactured using a mold member (7) including a molding surface (7b) having a raised and recessed complementary textured portion (71) that is mold-symmetrical to the textured portion (31). This method for manufacturing a laminated member comprises a molding step for molding the to-be-molded surface (3a) by using the molding surface (7b), and a printing step for printing the printing layer (4) onto the to-be-printed surface (3b) while the to-be-molded surface (3a) is in close contact with the molding surface (7b).

title_en: Method for manufacturing polarizer
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing a polarizer, wherein zinc formate is introduced to at least one of a swelling step, a dyeing step, a cross-linking step, a complementary coloring step, and a washing step. According to the manufacturing method of the present invention, a high-heat-resistant polarizer having a small color change before and after heat-resistant treatment at a high temperature of 100℃ or higher can be produced.

title_en: Analyzed-image liquid-level sensor
abstract_en: In one embodiment, the disclosed subject-matter is a method for determining a level of a liquid in a container, which includes capturing multiple images of the liquid within the container and analyzing the multiple images to generate a liquid-level determination result. The analyzing includes differentiating components of the liquid including at least one component selected from components of foam and bubbles within the liquid. The analyzing further including at least one operation selected from operations of increasing the contrast of the components of the liquid, within the multiple images and increasing the edge detection of the components of the liquid within the multiple of images. Other apparatuses and systems are disclosed.

title_en: Method for preparing an active layer of an electrode based on fluorinated mos2 for electrochemical reduction reactions
abstract_en: Disclosed is a method for preparing a catalytic material of an electrode for electrochemical reduction reactions, the catalytic material comprising an active phase based on at least one group VIB metal and fluorine. The method consists in bringing a solid material based on at least one group VIB metal sulphide into contact with a gas comprising at least difluorine, at a temperature of between -50°C and 150°C, for a duration of between 15 seconds and 120 minutes, the gas having a difluorine concentration of between 0.1 and 100% by volume relative to the total volume of the gas, a pressure of between 0.001 and 0.2 MPa, and a PPH of between 0.01 and 200 h -1 .

title_en: Temperature regulating device and plasma processing device
abstract_en: This temperature regulating device for regulating the temperature of a substrate includes a stage, a storage tank, and a heat transfer member. The stage supports the substrate. The storage tank is provided below the stage and stores a heat transfer fluid. The heat transfer member is connected to the lower surface of the stage, is made of metal, and is at least partly immersed in the heat transfer fluid in the storage tank. Furthermore, the storage tank includes a tank main body, a supply port, a discharge port, and an agitating unit. The supply port supplies the heat transfer fluid into the tank main body. The discharge port discharges the heat transfer fluid from the tank main body. The agitating unit is configured to agitate the heat transfer fluid in the tank main body.

title_en: 420 mpa-grade marine atmospheric corrosion-resistant hot-rolled steel plate for building structure, and manufacturing method therefor
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a 420 MPa-grade marine atmospheric corrosion-resistant hot-rolled steel plate for a building structure, and a manufacturing method therefor. The hot-rolled steel plate comprises: a base layer, a corrosion-resistant layer on at least one side of the base layer, and an interfacial transition layer between the base layer and the corrosion-resistant layer. In addition to Fe and inevitable impurities, the base layer further contains the following chemical components in percentage by mass: C: 0.040-0.100%, Si: 0.15-0.25%, Mn: 1.00-1.50%, Cr: 0.10-0.35%, Ni: 0.050-0.100%, Al: 0.020-0.050%, Ti: 0.009-0.016%, Nb: 0.030-0.050%, and B: 0.00020-0.00040%; and the inevitable impurities comprise P and S, wherein the content of P is 0.0005-0.003%, and the content of S is 0.0005-0.01%. In addition to Fe and inevitable impurities, the corrosion-resistant layer further contains the following chemical components in percentage by mass: C: 0.010-0.040%, Si: 0.2-1.5%, Mn: 1.00-2.00%, Cr: 16.0-18.0%, Ni: 14.0-17.0%, Cu: 0.02-0.10%, N: 0.02-0.15%, and Mo: 2.0-3.0%; the inevitable impurities comprise P and S, wherein the content of P is 0.005-0.03%, and the content of S is 0.005-0.03%. The hot-rolled steel plate of the present invention has a thickness of 10-100 mm, a yield strength greater than or equal to 420 MPa, a tensile strength greater than or equal to 570 MPa, a yield ratio less than or equal to 0.78, an impact energy KV2 at -40°C greater than or equal to 190 J, a marine atmospheric corrosion resistance rate less than or equal to 0.004 mm/a, an interfacial transition layer thickness less than or equal to 10 μm, and an interfacial shear strength greater than or equal to 300 MPa.

title_en: Insulation pad for secondary battery and battery module including same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an insulation pad for a secondary battery and a battery module including same, the insulation pad comprising a support member and a foam layer formed on one surface of the support member, wherein the foam layer includes an edge part and a central part located inside the edge part, and the porosity of the edge part is smaller than the porosity of the central part. The edge part is reduced in porosity through thermocompression, and the pores in the edge part may be filled with a filler for preventing the penetration of moisture and gas.

title_en: Oxygen-evolving anode and method for producing same
abstract_en: Provided is an oxygen-evolving anode comprising a catalyst layer which, without using a precious metal, has low oxygen evolution overvoltage and is mechanically stable. An oxygen-evolving anode (10) comprises: a conductive base material (2) of which at least the surface is composed of nickel or a nickel-based alloy; and a catalyst layer (4) which is disposed on the surface of the base material (2) and has a porous structure formed using a nickel-iron alloy. In the nickel-iron alloy, the percentage of nickel is 35-95 mass%, the percentage of iron is 5-65 mass%, and the sum of the percentages of nickel and iron is 100 mass%.

title_en: High-strength hot-rolled steel sheet, member, and methods for producing same
abstract_en: Provided are: a high-strength hot-rolled steel sheet having high strength and high ductility, as well as excellent wrinkle-suppressing ability, high stretch-flangeability, and excellent surplus deformability; a member; and methods for producing said steel sheet and member.　The high-strength hot-rolled steel sheet has a prescribed component composition, and has a steel structure comprising, in terms of area ratio: more than 0% but no more than 98.5% of tempered martensite, and more than 0% but no more than 98.5% of lower bainite, wherein the total area ratio of the lower bainite and tempered martensite is 80.0-98.5%; 0-9.0% of fresh martensite; and 1.5-15.0% of retained austenite. In the steel structure, the average solid-solution carbon content in the retained austenite is 0.50-1.10%, the number density of hard phases having an area of 50.0 μm 2  or more is 500/mm 2  or less, and the solid-solution carbon content distribution balance of the retained austenite is 1.30 or more. The steel sheet has a tensile strength of 980 MPa or more.

title_en: Polyimide precursor composition, polyimide film, polyimide film/substrate layered product, flexible electronic device, and flexible electronic device substrate
abstract_en: This polyimide precursor composition contains: a polyimide precursor which contains a repeating unit represented by a formula (1) and satisfies a specific condition (for example, the condition that at least one of all X 1  moieties present in the polyimide precursor is a tetravalent aromatic group); and a specific silicon compound such as a silanol compound. [In formula (1), X 1  is a tetravalent aromatic group or the like, Y 1  is a divalent aromatic group or the like, and R 1  and R 2  are each independently a hydrogen atom or the like.]

title_en: Method for mixing etching solution for polycrystalline silicon, method for producing polycrystalline silicon, and apparatus for cleaning polycrystalline silicon
abstract_en: Provided is, inter alia, a method for mixing an etching solution, said method making it possible to reduce the amount of hydrofluoric anhydride required to be recovered from exhaust gas as much as possible while using hydrofluoric anhydride. The pressure and/or the temperature is controlled to bring the hydrofluoric anhydride into a liquid state (P1). Furthermore, the liquid-state hydrofluoric anhydride is mixed with an aqueous solution containing a mineral acid, a mixed aqueous solution containing a mineral acid and an organic acid, or an aqueous solution containing hydrogen peroxide, with the water content of the aqueous solution being 45 wt.% or less. In addition, the hydrofluoric anhydride is dissolved in the water of the aqueous solution containing the mineral acid, the water of the mixed aqueous solution containing the mineral acid and the organic acid, or the water of the aqueous solution containing the hydrogen peroxide (P2).

title_en: Multilayer film with uniform color distribution
abstract_en: The present invention is directed to a method for manufacturing a pigmented interlayer film by simultaneous extrusion of at least three sublayers, each comprising the same or a different polyvinyl acetal, at least one plasticiser and pigments characterised in a. providing a masterbatch, comprising at least one plasticiser and the pigments, b. providing at least three mixtures from the masterbatch and the polyvinyl acetals, c. extrusion of the mixtures into at least three sublayers which are combined into the interlayer film, wherein at least one sublayer has a different plasticiser and pigment content than the other sublayers.

title_en: Decorative sheet and production method thereof
abstract_en: A decorative sheet according to one embodiment of the present invention comprises: a base layer; a transparent layer provided on the base layer; and an ultraviolet cured coating layer provided on the transparent layer, wherein the ultraviolet cured coating layer comprises acrylic resin and an ultraviolet absorbent, and the rate of change of ultraviolet absorbent content in the ultraviolet cured coating layer is 10% or less under accelerated assessment using method 1.

title_en: Support plate for a decorative panel, and decorative panel comprising such a support plate, and method for producing a support plate
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a support plate for a decorative panel and to a decorative panel comprising such a support plate. The support plate according to the invention is based on a mineral-filled polymer matrix on the basis of thermoplastic elastomers, in particular polyolefin elastomers (POE), in particular on the basis of polypropylene (PP), polyethylene (PE), ethylene propylene diene rubber (EPDM), and copolymers thereof with one another and/or with further polymers, and mixtures of the aforementioned polymers and copolymers. In particular, the invention relates to support plates for decorative panels, wherein the support plates have a thickness ≤ 4.5 mm, in particular ≤ 4.0 mm, and are substantially flexible.

title_en: Air conditioning system, air conditioning method, and air conditioning room facility
abstract_en: An air conditioning system (10) comprises: a dehumidification device (1) that dehumidifies target air (TA) to be dehumidified, thereby producing dry air (DA) having an ultralow dew point; and a supply device (2) that supplies the target air (TA) to the dehumidification device (1). The dehumidification device (1) is provided with an electrolysis device (1A) for chemically decomposing moisture in the target air (TA). The electrolysis device (1A) is provided with: a pair of electrodes (1c1) with which the target air (TA) comes into contact and which generate hydrogen by electrolysis of water; and an electrolyte (1c2) which is sandwiched between the pair of electrodes (1c1) and which has ionic conductivity.

title_en: Anode catalyst layer
abstract_en: ANODE CATALYST LAYER According to the present invention there is provided an anode catalyst layer for a polymer electrolyte membrane electrolyser. The anode catalyst layer comprises an oxygen evolution reaction (OER) electrocatalyst and an ion-conducting polymer. The oxygen evolution reaction electrocatalyst comprises an iridium-containing material supported on an inorganic oxide support material. The anode catalyst layer comprises a loading of iridium of less than 0.60 mg Ir /cm 2 . The anode catalyst layer has a mean average cross-sectional thickness of ≥3.0 μm and ≤10 μm. The anode catalyst layer comprises pores having a total pore volume, wherein the pores comprise first pores having a pore diameter in a range of 50 nm to 500 nm, wherein the first pores have a pore volume of at least 30% of the total pore volume of the pores in the anode catalyst layer, as measured by mercury intrusion porosimetry.

title_en: Plated steel sheet and method for manufacturing same
abstract_en: Provided, according to exemplary embodiments of the present invention, may be a plated steel sheet having excellent appearance characteristics and a method for manufacturing same. Additionally, the present invention may provide a plated steel sheet having excellent plating adhesion and a method for manufacturing same.

title_en: Thermal spray powders for erosion resistant cmas coatings, erosion resistant cmas coatings and methods of fabricating the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to new and improved thermal barrier coating compositions that are also erosion resistant to CMAS attack at high temperatures. More specifically, this invention provides ceramic powder compositions which, when applied as thermal barriers in aviation-based or land-based turbine components, have improved erosion resistance, and also resistance to the attack by molten CMAS deposits. Currently used ceramic compositions based on Pyrochlores of the type Ln2Zr2O7 (where Ln= Gd, La, Sm, Nd, Eu and/or Yb) and/or high Yttria containing Zirconia powders/coatings (e.g., 38 wt% Yttria to 55 wt% Yttria) are improved by the addition of 0.1-10 wt% of graphene and or graphene oxide.

title_en: Systems, methods and apparatus for gas-liquid separation in electrolyser applications
abstract_en: A method for gas-water separation includes flowing a mixture of process water and oxygen from an anode of an electrolysis device to a gas-water separator, generating a water overflow from an outlet of the gas-water separator, and expelling at least a portion of the oxygen from the outlet of the gas-water separator.

title_en: Self assembled patterning using patterned Hydrophobic surfaces
abstract_en: Embodiments provided herewith are directed to self-assembled methods of preparing a patterned surface for sequencing applications including, for example, a patterned flow cell or a patterned surface for digital fluidic devices. The methods utilize photolithography to create a patterned surface with a plurality of microscale or nanoscale contours, separated by hydrophobic interstitial regions, without the need of oxygen plasma treatment during the photolithography process. In addition, the methods avoid the use of any chemical or mechanical polishing steps after the deposition of a gel material to the contours.

title_en: Nanoparticles for gene expression and uses thereof
abstract_en: Treatment protocols based on expression of therapeutic proteins by genetically-modified selected cell types in vivo are described. The treatment protocols can additionally utilize cell attractants to attract selected cell types to a treatment site and/or macrophage activation protocols at the treatment site.

title_en: Milliohm resistor for RQL circuits
abstract_en: A milliohm resistor is fabricated as a Josephson junction device that contains ferromagnetic or antiferromagnetic material (206, 210, 416) of sufficient thickness to render the device entirely resistive between terminals. The device can have a resistance on the order of milliohms and can consume a much smaller chip footprint than resistors of the same resistance fabricated using conventional resistive materials. Because the device can be fabricated without modification to processes used to fabricate reciprocal quantum logic (RQL) circuitry, it can easily be incorporated in RQL circuits to mitigate flux trapping or to perform other functions where very small resistances are needed. lii particular, the device can burn off circulating currents induced by trapped flux without affecting the transmission of SFQ pulses through RQL circuitry.

title_en: Carbon-carbon nanotube hybrid materials and methods of producing same
abstract_en: Carbon-carbon nanotube (CNT) hybrid materials, and methods of producing the hybrid materials. The hybrid materials include carbon particles and CNTs on the surface of the particles. The CNT comprises more than about 3.2 weight percent of the hybrid material.

title_en: Tetracycline photoelectrochemical aptasensor as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en:

analysis and discloses a tetracycline photoelectrochemical aptasensor as well as a 
preparation method and an application thereof. The tetracycline 
photoelectrochemical aptasensor takes CdS QDs/TiO2 NPs as a photoactive material 
and takes a tetracycline aptamer as a biological recognition element. The tetracycline 
may be specifically bound with the tetracycline aptamer and captured by an aptamer

enzyme-free electrochemical glucose sensor comprises synthesizing 
nitrogen, phosphorus co-doped carbon quantum dots (NPCQD) by using 
hydrothermal method; and preparing working electrodes by treating 
nitrogen, phosphorus co-doped carbon quantum dots over nickel foam for

title_en: Preparation method of graphene nanoribbon/single walled carbon nanotube intramolecular heterojunction
abstract_en:
The invention discloses a method for preparing a graphene nanoribbon/single-wall carbon 
nanotube intramolecular heterojunction, and belongs to the technical field of carbon 
nanomaterials. The preparation method includes the following steps: (1) adding single-walled 
carbon nanotubes and dopamine hydrochloride to Tris-HCl buffer, reacting in a dark 
environment, and filtering to obtain polydopamine-modified single-walled carbon nanotubes; 
(2) dispersing the poly-dopamine modified single-walled carbon nanotubes prepared in step 
(1) in concentrated sulfuric acid, adding phosphoric acid, heating, adding potassium 
permanganate, cooling to room temperature after the reaction is completed, adding hydrogen 
peroxide, filtering, and washing with water to neutrality to obtain the melted single-walled 
carbon nanotubes; (3) roasting the melted single-walled carbon nanotube obtained in the step 
(2), ultrasonically treating the roasted product with hydrochloric acid solution, filtering, adding 
hydrogen iodide solution for reduction reaction, and filtering after reaction to prepare the 
graphene nanoribbon/single-walled carbon nanotube intramolecular heterojunction.

title_en: Microparticles and nanoparticles having negative surface charges
abstract_en:
This invention provides methods for large scale producing a polymer particle which contains unusually high 
negative charges on the surface of the particle. Preferably, the polymer is pharmaceutically acceptable. The 
negative charges can be conferred by chemical groups such as carboxyl, sulfonate, nitrate, fluorate, 
chloride, iodide, persulfate, and many others, with carboxyl group being preferred. The invention also 
provides polymer particle produced by the methods of the invention.

coated by a polymer, wherein the polymer comprises charged

and the functionalised nanoparticle is conjugatable or can 
be functionalised to conjugate with a biomolecule.

title_en: Structure and methods for detection of sample analytes
abstract_en: Provided herein are structures and methods for detecting one or more analyte molecules present in a sample. In some embodiments, the one or more analyte molecules are detected using one or more supramolecular structures. In some embodiments, the one or more supramolecular structures are specifically designed to minimize cross-reactivity with each other. In some embodiments, the supramolecular structures are bi-stable, wherein the supramolecular structures shift from an unstable state to a stable state through interaction with one or more analyte molecules from the sample. In some embodiments, the stable state supramolecular structures are configured to provide a signal for analyte molecule detection and quantification. In some embodiments, the signal correlates to a DNA signal, such that detection and quantification of an analyte molecule comprises converting the presence of the analyte molecule into a DNA signal.

title_en: Composition and use of sirnas against vegfr2 and tgf-beta1 in combination therapy for cancer
abstract_en: The techniques of the present disclosure provide a method of inhibiting tumor growth in a tissue of a mammal. The method includes administering to the mammal a therapeutically effective amount of a composition comprising an siRNA molecule that binds to an mRNA that codes for TGF01 protein, an siRNA molecule that binds to an mRNA that codes for VEGFR2 protein, and a pharmaceutically acceptable carrier comprising a pharmaceutically acceptable polypeptide polymer. The techniques of the present disclosure also provide for additional methods for using this composition.

title_en: Methods and systems for production of doped carbon nanomaterials
abstract_en:
A system and process for producing doped carbon nanomaterials is disclosed. A 
carbonate electrolyte including a doping component is provided during the electrolysis between 
an anode and a cathode immersed in carbonate electrolyte contained in a cell. The carbonate 
electrolyte is heated to a molten state. An electrical current is applied to the anode, and cathode, 
to the molten carbonate electrolyte disposed between the anode and cathode. A morphology 
element maximizes carbon nanotubes, versus graphene versus carbon nano-onion versus hollow 
carbon nano-sphere nanomaterial product. The resulting carbon nanomaterial growth is collected 
from the cathode of the cell.

title_en: Sensor device and methods
abstract_en:
The invention provides a sensor device comprising an insect odorant receptor (OrX) in 
electrical communication with a substrate, wherein the sensor device is configured to 
5 detect a change in an electrical characteristic of the substrate. The invention also 
provides sensor device component comprising an insect odorant receptor (OrX) in 
electrical communication with a substrate. The invention also provides methods for 
manufacture and use of the sensor device and sensor device component. The invention 
also provides methods of use of the sensor to detect an analyte.

title_en: Measurement analysis
abstract_en: A system for analyzing measurements performed on a biological subject, the system including one or more processing devices configured to acquire subject data at least in part captured by a measurement system including at least one substrate including a plurality of microstructures configured to breach a functional barrier of the subject and a sensor operatively connected to at least one microstructure, the at least one sensor being configured to measure response signals from the at least one microstructure, and analyze the subject data using at least one model to determine an indicator at least partially indicative of a physiological state of the subject.

title_en: Mems tensioning structures and methods of manufacture
abstract_en: A microelectromechanical (MEM) device may comprise a first stage comprising a first stage reflective surface; a first frame pivotally coupled to the first stage; a second frame coupled to the first frame; and one or more of: second frame flexures positioned on the first frame and the second frame, or first stage flexures positioned on the first stage; and a tensioning structure. The tensioning structure may be coupled to the first frame to facilitate an amount of tension in one or more of the second frame flexures or the first stage flexures to prevent buckling of the one or more of the second frame flexures or the first stage flexures.

title_en: Systems, methods and devices for influencing operating states of quantum systems
abstract_en: In a method for influencing an operating state of a quantum system, the quantum system comprises at least one defect, defect complex or impurity in a host material. A transition between different energy levels of the at least one defect, defect complex or impurity is determined. The transition has a transition energy that is a function of an external electric field and/or external mechanical stress. The transition energy has a critical point. A bias electric field and/or a bias mechanical stress is determined for bringing the transition energy of the at least one defect, defect complex or impurity to or close to the critical point. The external electric field comprises the bias electric field and an environmental noise electric field. The external mechanical stress comprises the bias mechanical stress and an environmental noise mechanical stress. The determined bias electric field and/or mechanical stress is applied to the quantum system.

title_en: Protein/Oligonucleotide Core-Shell Nanoparticle Therapeutics
abstract_en:
The present disclosure is directed to core-shell nanoparticles, compositions comprising core
shell nanoparticles, and methods of their use.

title_en: Composition comprising nano-particulate fertilizer and process thereof for improved plant growth and yield
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a process of preparing composition comprising nano- particulate fertilizer which provides enhanced bioavailability to soil and plants via slow-release mechanism, enhanced utilization by the plants and crops.

title_en: Systems and methods for nanocrystal fabrication
abstract_en: Systems and methods are provided for the controlled growth of nanocrystals suitable for electron diffraction measurements for atomic structure determination. A fluidic support structure is contacted with a solution containing a nanocrystal forming material such that the solution is retained thereon. An energy beam, configured to locally induce nucleation and nanocrystal growth, is delivered to spatially-separated locations on the fluidic support structure, thereby forming spatially separated nanocrystals. The fluidic support structure is capable of retaining the solution with a sufficiently thin layer such that the nanocrystals have a submicron thickness suitable for analysis by electron diffraction, without needing transfer of the nanocrystals to a separate holder. The fluidic support structure may include lateral fluidic confinement structures defining a plurality of nanocrystal growth regions, such that each nanocrystal growth region is laterally confined on a submicron to micron scale to isolate growing nanocrystals to create conditions for homogenous nanocrystal growth.

title_en: Targeted lnp delivery
abstract_en: Disclosed are lipid nanoparticle (LNP) delivery systems that specifically target T cells. The LNP delivery system comprises antibodies conjugated to the surface of the LNP, e.g., via maleimide chemistry, that target at least two T cell surface proteins, e.g., CD3 and CD28. The LNP delivery system can have a single population of LNP conjugated to either a bispecific antiCD3/antiCD28 antibody, or two monospecific antiCD3 and antiCD28 antibodies, or two populations of LNP wherein each population comprises a monospecific antibody. The payload of the LNP delivery system can be, e.g., mRNA encoding chimeric antigen receptors (CAR), a linear DNA fragment or a plasmid encoding chimeric antigen receptors (CAR) or therapeutic proteins such as antibodies, components of a gene editing systems (e.g., CRISPR-Cas), small molecules, antibody-drug conjugates (ADC), and any combination thereof, either encapsulated in the LNP or attached to its surface (e.g., conjugated). Also provided are lipids, pharmaceutical compositions, kits, and methods of treatment.

title_en: Duplexing method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an improvement to cell-free, in vitro processes that involve the generation of single-stranded nucleic acid concatemers, where these concatemers favour folding into secondary structures due to the presence of stretches of self-complementary sequence. Single stranded concatemers may be produced via rolling circle amplification of a template nucleic acid under certain conditions. The self-annealing and folding of these single-stranded concatemers can frustrate the use of these concatemers for further isolation or product production, particularly where it is desired to make double stranded DNA. The present invention addresses this need by providing a simple and elegant way to ensure that the single stranded nucleic acid concatemer can effectively be duplexed, even if it forms complex self-annealed structures.

title_en: Complexes containing albumin-containing nanoparticles and antibodies to treat cancer
abstract_en: This document provides methods and materials related to treating cancer (e.g., skin cancer). For example, methods and materials relating to the use of a composition containing albumin-containing nanoparticle/antibody complexes (e.g., ABRAXANE®/anti-VEGF polypeptide antibody complexes) to treat cancer (e.g., skin cancer) are provided.

title_en: Nanothermometer
abstract_en: There is provided a semiconductor nanocrystal or quantum dot comprising a core made of a material and at least one shell made of another material. Also there is provided a composite comprising a plurality of such nanocrystals or quantum dots. Moreover, there is provided a method of measuring the temperature of an object or area, comprising using a temperature sensor comprising a semiconductor nanocrystal or quantum dot of the invention.

title_en: Microfluidic device having offset, high-shear seeding channels
abstract_en: A microfluidic device for determining a response of cells comprises a microchannel and a seeding channel. The microchannel is at least partially defined by a porous membrane having cells adhered thereto. The microchannel has a first cross-sectional area. The seeding channel delivers a working fluid to the cells within the microchannel. The seeding channel has a second cross-sectional area that is less than the first cross-sectional area such that a flow of the working fluid produces a substantially higher shear force within the seeding channel to inhibit the attachment of cells within the seeding channel. And when multiple seeding channels are used to deliver fluids to multiple microchannels that define an active cellular layer across the membrane, the seeding channels are spatially offset from each other such that fluid communication between the fluids occurs only at the active region via the membrane, not at the seeding channels.

title_en: Smart microfluidic mixing instrument and cartridges
abstract_en: A "smart" instrument for mixing (100), a microfluidic chip (50), and a system wherein they are used to prepare formulations is provided. The microfluidic chip comprises microchannels and a programmable data component. The system achieves optimal formulations for RNA, antisense, peptides and small molecules in the hands of even novice users.

title_en: Reduced dimensionality structured illumination microscopy with patterned arrays of nanowells
abstract_en: Techniques are described for reducing the number of angles needed in structured illumination imaging of biological samples through the use of patterned flowcells, where nanowells of the patterned flowcells are arranged in, e.g., a square array, or an asymmetrical array. Accordingly, the number of images needed to resolve details of the biological samples is reduced. Techniques are also described for combining structured illumination imaging with line scanning using the patterned flowcells.

title_en: Reduced graphene oxide/manganese(iv) oxide nanocomposite and electrode comprising same, method of manufacture of various graphene material/metal oxide nanocomposites
abstract_en: ABSTRACT OF THE DISCLOSURE A reduced graphene oxide/manganese(IV) oxide nanocomposite is provided. This nanocomposite comprises reduced graphene oxide flakes and manganese oxide nanoparticles distributed on the surface of the flakes.  Electrodes comprising this nanocomposite are also provided. Embodiments of such electrodes displayed broad voltage windows. A method for producing the nanocomposites as well as other nanocomposites is also provided. The method comprises the step of electrochemically exfoliating graphite in an exfoliation electrolyte comprising an intercalant and a precursor which is an oxometallate, a polyoxometalate, a thiometallate, or metal salt together with an acid. title_en: Apparatus and methods for high power led lights
abstract_en: A Light-Emitting Diode (LED) light system has a plurality of LED groups connected in parallel with each of the plurality of LED groups having one or more LEDs connected in series, a power circuit having a plurality of outputs with each output of the power circuit is electrically coupled to a respective one of the plurality of LED groups, and a control subsystem electrically coupled to the power circuit for individually controlling each output of the power circuit for controlling the operation of the corresponding LED group and adapting to the characteristics thereof. In some embodiments, at least one LED group may further have a switch and/or a light-angle controlling structure connected with the one or more LEDs in series and controlled by the control subsystem for selectively enabling or disabling the LED group and/or adjusting the light angle thereof.

title_en: Mixed coupling between a qubit and resonator
abstract_en: Quantum systems are provided, including a qubit and a transmission line resonator having an associated resonant wavelength. According to an embodiment, the quantum system comprises a transmission line resonator having an associated resonant wavelength and a plurality of qubits. According to an embodiment, a first qubit is inductively coupled to the transmission line via a first transformer and capacitively coupled to the transmission line resonator with a first capacitive coupling strength at a first location of the transmission line resonator. A second qubit is inductively coupled to the transmission line via a second transformer and capacitively coupled to the transmission line resonator with a second capacitive coupling strength at a second location of the tiansmission line resonator. According to the embodiment, the first location is different from the second location, and the first capacitive coupling strength is different from the second capacitive coupling strength.

title_en: Foam granulation method
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a foam granulation method comprising: a) preparing an aqueous mixture comprising nanocellulose and a foaming agent, b) foaming said mixture to obtain a foam, c) adding solid particles to said foam, d) mixing and drying said foam with added particles to obtain a granulate comprising the solid particles.

title_en: Dispersion of metal-coated fibers into battery electrodes for resistance reduction in a battery and battery materials
abstract_en: Electrical resistance of active cathodic and anodic films may be significantly reduced by dispersing conductive additives of micro-sized metal-coated fibers and/or nickel-filamentary branching structures within the cathode and/or anode of a battery system.  Decreasing resistance in the cathode and/or anode leads to easier electron transport through the battery, resulting in increases in power, capacity and rates while decreasing joules heating losses.

title_en: Microcapillary device, detection device, and methods related thereto
abstract_en: A microfluidic passive sample separation aevice tor passively separating a liquid sample, and optionally detecting an analyte in the separated liquid sample. The device includes a filter for filtering the liquid sample and for producing a filtrate; a plurality of capillaries configured to withdraw the filtrate from the filter by capillary force, a capillary micropump for receiving the filtrate and pumping the filtrate to the outlet.

title_en: High-resolution polarization-sensitive imaging and polarimetry apparatus and method thereof
abstract_en: A lens has an optical center and an optical axis passing through the optical center, and at least a first lens portion positioned at a distance away from the optical center for refracting light rays of a predefined polarization state impinging at right angle thereto from a first side towards the optical axis on a second side at a constant bending angle thereby defining a focal line on the second side along the optical axis.

title_en: Nanoparticle ink compositions, methods and uses
abstract_en: The present invention provides a conductive ink composition having a good balance between adhesion to a substrate, nanoparticle stability, sinterability at relatively low temperatures, and good conductivity. In one aspect, a conductive network prepared from a composition according to the present invention is provided. In certain aspects, such conductive networks are suitable for use in touch panel displays. In certain aspects, the present invention relates to methods of bonding nanosilver particles to non-metallic substrates. In certain aspects, the present invention relates to methods of improving the adhesion of nanosilver particle-filled formulations to non-metallic substrates.

title_en: Pesticide nanocapsule and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a pesticide nanocapsule and a preparation method thereof, wherein the pesticide nanocapsule is prepared from the following components in parts by weight: 0.1-80 parts of pesticide active ingredient, 0.1-40 parts of capsule wall material, 0.2-30 parts of emulsifying dispersant, 10-200 parts of organic solvent, 20-350 parts of water, 0.1-200 parts of excipient and 0-20 parts of adjuvant, wherein the ratio of the pesticide active ingredient to the capsule wall material is 0.1:1-10: 1. The pesticide nanocapsule provided by the invention has the advantages of small particle size, good particle dispersibility, excellent slow release performance, simple preparation process, easiness in operation and good repeatability.

title_en: Carbon-coated ion-doped manganese phosphate lithium electrode material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a carbon-coated ion-doped manganese phosphate lithium electrode material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the chemical formula of the electrode material is LiM x N y Mn 1‑x‑y PO 4 X is more than or equal to 0.05 and less than or equal to 0.25, y is more than or equal to 0.01 and less than or equal to 0.10, and the large-current charging performance and the discharging performance of the lithium ion battery are improved through effective doping of metal elements and carbon in-situ coating. Namely adding a type of material with oxidation-reduction potential lower than that of Mn 3+ /Mn 2+ The potential metal M is used for improving the discharge performance of the lithium ion battery; simultaneously adding a material with oxidation-reduction potential higher than that of Mn 3+ /Mn 2+ The potential metal N is used for improving the charging performance of the lithium ion battery; the manganese lithium phosphate body material is coated in situ by carbon, so that part or all of the carbon layer on the surface of the manganese lithium phosphate body material is coated, and the electronic conductivity of the material is improved. The invention effectively improves the specific capacity and the heavy current charge-discharge performance of the lithium ion battery, and has good application prospect in the fields of power and energy storage lithium ion batteries.

title_en: Piezoresistive MEMS temperature sensor and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a piezoresistive MEMS temperature sensor, which relates to the field of micro-electromechanical systems. The sensor mainly adopts a double-layer film structure and a Wheatstone bridge technology. And four resistors of the Wheatstone bridge are arranged at the same positions of the four cantilevers by adopting a piezoresistive cantilever structure, and are connected into the Wheatstone bridge through leads. The temperature measurement of the spot position can be directly performed in a narrow space.

title_en: Carbon nanotube aggregate and method for producing same
abstract_en: The carbon nanotube pellets according to the present invention are manufactured using only a small amount of solvent and have an increased apparent density. The present invention can improve the variation in content and safety problems caused by powder scattering by using carbon nanotubes in the form of pellets instead of carbon nanotubes in the form of powder in a composite material. Also, since the bulk form has a higher density than the powder form, transportation, transfer and improvement become easier. Therefore, it can be more effectively applied to the manufacture of composite materials.

title_en: High-performance start-stop negative plate lead paste and application thereof in negative plate of lead-acid battery
abstract_en: A high-performance start-stop negative plate lead plaster and an application thereof in a negative plate of a lead-acid battery. Comprises the following components in parts by weight: 8.5-10 parts of sulfuric acid; 0.13-0.35 parts of nano barium sulfate A; 0.3-0.45 part of nano barium sulfate B; 0.10-0.20 part of lignin; 0.05-0.15 part of short fibers; 0.10-0.25 part of carbon material; 0.05-0.15 parts of barium polyaspartate; 9-13 parts of deionized water; 74-80 parts of lead powder. The invention increases the charge acceptance and low-temperature performance of the battery on the basis of not adding high carbon and less content of the organic expanding agent, thereby prolonging the service life of the battery. And simultaneously, the problems of water loss and the like caused by a high-carbon formula of the lead-carbon battery are avoided.

title_en: Gold-zinc oxide heterojunction nanoparticle array and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gold-zinc oxide heterojunction nanoparticle array and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing gold nanospheres, zinc nitrate, sodium hydroxide and sodium borohydride in water to prepare a precursor mixed solution; and then placing the mixture at the temperature of 60-100 ℃ for reaction for 10-60 minutes to prepare gold-zinc oxide heterojunction nanoparticle colloidal solution, then carrying out centrifugal separation, dispersing the colloidal solution into n-butyl alcohol solution, carrying out treatment by adopting a gas-liquid interface self-assembly method, and fishing out the single-layer nanoparticle array floating on the liquid surface by using a substrate. The invention has strong absorption peaks in both ultraviolet and visible light regions, has high catalytic reaction efficiency, simple preparation process, low cost, environmental protection and no pollution, and is suitable for large-scale industrial production.

title_en: Workpiece temperature detection device and nanomaterial manufacturing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a work piece temperature detection device and nanometer material preparation equipment, connect the thermocouple terminal on work piece and the pivot in the vacuum chamber through the thermocouple, the thermocouple terminal is connected with movable terminal through the pivot, movable terminal and annular terminal dish movable contact, annular terminal dish is connected with temperature measuring instrument, so with the actual temperature conduction of work piece in the vacuum chamber to temperature measuring instrument on measuring, can accurately measure the actual temperature of work piece, obtain the best coating film temperature of different materials through the experiment and accurately control the actual temperature of work piece according to the best coating film temperature of different materials in production, in order to reach best coating film effect.

title_en: Upconversion fluorescent core-shell nanocrystal and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an upconversion fluorescence type core-shell nanocrystal with negative thermal quenching effect and capable of being used for temperature sensing, wherein the nanocrystal comprises Tm 3+ /Yb 3+ /Er 3+ :BaLn 2 (MoO 4 ) 4 ＠BaLn 2 (MoO 4 ) 4 (Ln = Gd, Y) and a crystal nucleus composition of Tm 3+ /Yb 3+ /Er 3+ :BaLn 2 (MoO 4 ) 4 (Ln = Gd, Y), the outer surface of the crystal nucleus is coated with homogeneous BaLn 2 (MoO 4 ) 4 (Ln = Gd, Y) outer shell. When the temperature is increased from room temperature to 300 ℃, under the excitation of 980nm laser, the up-conversion fluorescence intensity of blue light, green light and red light of the core-shell nanocrystal is kept enhanced along with the temperature increase, a negative fluorescence thermal quenching effect is presented, and the core-shell nanocrystal can be repeatedly used after being cooled. By using Er 3+ The temperature measurement can be realized by the relationship between the fluorescence intensity ratio of the ionic thermal coupling energy level transition and the temperature.

title_en: Fe-S-N co-doped graphene Pt-loaded catalyst for direct methanol fuel cell and preparation method of catalyst
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a Fe-S-N co-doped graphene Pt-loaded catalyst for a direct methanol fuel cell, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: 1) carrying out heat treatment on the sodium iron phthalocyanine tetrasulfonate functionalized graphene GR to prepare the Fe-S-N co-doped GR composite material in one step; 2) and then depositing vermicular Pt nano particles by taking the composite material prepared in the step 1) as a carrier to obtain the Fe-S-N co-doped GR Pt-loaded catalyst. The method has the advantages of simple process, mild and controllable operation conditions and good application prospect, and the Pt catalyst prepared by the method can enhance the synergistic coupling effect between the catalytic nanoparticles and the Fe-S-N CO-doped GR carrier, can improve the electrocatalytic activity of the catalyst on methanol oxidation and oxygen reduction reactions, and shows excellent electrochemical stability and CO poisoning resistance.

title_en: Manganese-titanium binary loaded nano zeolite composite catalytic material and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a manganese and titanium binary loaded nano zeolite composite catalytic material and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, preparing a nano zeolite material, then putting the nano zeolite material into a mixed solution of manganese nitrate and butyl titanate, carrying out hydrothermal reaction in a reaction kettle, and finally roasting to obtain the catalytic material. The manganese-titanium binary loaded nano zeolite composite catalytic material is particularly suitable for treating pharmaceutical wastewater, and tests show that the degradation efficiency is obviously improved, and the CODc is improved by more than 44% compared with the wet oxidative degradation effect of the material without the catalytic material under the same conditions; compared with the light degradation effect without adding catalyst under the same condition, the TOC improves more than 43 percent and has good practicability.

title_en: Superfine nano-silver wire dispersion liquid and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of superfine nano-silver wire dispersion liquid, which comprises the following steps: (1) preparing solution A, solution B, solution C and solution D; (2) preparing an AB mixed solution, an ABD mixed solution and an ABDC mixed solution in sequence; (3) and (3) pouring the ABDC mixed solution obtained in the step (2) into an autoclave, bubbling with argon, then sealing the autoclave, and placing the autoclave in a constant-temperature oven for heat preservation for a period of time to obtain the superfine nano silver wire dispersion liquid. According to the invention, by introducing water and DMF, the viscosity of the polyhydric alcohol is reduced, the solubility of the polyhydric alcohol to medicines is increased, and the difficulty in solution preparation is directly reduced; the introduction of the anionic surfactant reduces the surface activity of a solution system, so that the solution wettability is stronger.

title_en: Preparation method of bimetal oxide/carbon nitride/carbon nano tube compound
abstract_en: A preparation method of a bimetal oxide/carbon nitride/carbon nano tube compound belongs to the technical field of nano composite material preparation. Uniformly mixing two different metal salts, carboxylic acid or carboxylate in water to obtain a carboxylate radical complex metal ion solution; mixing carbon nano tubes and a nitrogen-containing polymer in a water-alcohol solution, and carrying out ultrasonic treatment to stabilize a suspension; mixing the two liquids, and performing ultrasonic treatment or stirring until the two liquids are uniformly dispersed; adding borohydride into the mixed solution to perform in-situ reaction, and generating and attaching a bimetallic oxide/carbon nitrogen structure on the surface of the carbon nano tube; and washing and drying to obtain the bimetal oxide/carbon nitride/carbon nano tube compound. The bimetallic oxide is in a sheet shape and is self-assembled to form a multi-layer assembly body structure, the assembly body is in a sheet layer shape, a cluster shape, a flower shape or a sea urchin shape and is attached to the surface of the carbon nano tube, and two metal elements, carbon element, nitrogen element and oxygen element in the assembly body are uniformly distributed.

title_en: Method for preparing hydrogen storage magnesium-nickel alloy nano powder based on polyol method
abstract_en: The invention provides hydrogen storage magnesium-nickel alloy nano powder prepared based on a polyol method and a method thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step 1: dissolving magnesium acetate tetrahydrate and nickel acetate tetrahydrate in ethylene glycol to obtain a solution I; step 2: dissolving polyvinylpyrrolidone in ethylene glycol to obtain a solution II; and step 3: mixing the solution I and the solution II, magnetically stirring, and refluxing; and 4, step 4: adding a solution containing PdCl 2 When the temperature of the ethylene glycol solution reaches 180 ℃, refluxing, washing and drying are carried out to finally generate the magnesium-nickel alloy nano powder. According to the method, the polyol method is used for preparing the nano magnesium-nickel alloy powder, so that the energy consumption is low, the cost is low, and the method is suitable for batch production; the process is simple, and the grain size of the prepared alloy powder can be controlled by changing the reaction temperature, the reaction time, the dosage and the concentration of the protective agent.

title_en: Conductive polymer coated silicon composite carbon nanotube negative electrode material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a conductive polymer coated silicon composite carbon nanotube negative electrode material, which comprises the steps of carrying out in-situ polymerization on the surface of a submicron or nanometer silicon without using an organic solvent and synchronously doping conductive polymer polyaniline, wherein the polyaniline coating effectively inhibits the volume expansion of the silicon and provides good conductive capability for the silicon, and then adding pre-dispersed carbon nanotubes by utilizing the pi-pi conjugation effect of the polyaniline and the carbon nanotubes so that polyaniline-coated silicon particles are uniformly dispersed and firmly fixed in a carbon nanotube dispersion system. The high-conductivity and high-elasticity carbon nano tube further provides stable expansion elastic space and conductive capacity for the polyaniline-coated silicon particles, and thoroughly solves the problem that the negative electrode is damaged by the volume expansion and pulverization of silicon. The finally prepared polyaniline-coated nano silicon composite carbon nano tube has the simple substance silicon content of 50 percent and the specific capacity of more than 1800mAh/g under the composite synergistic effect of three materials of silicon, polyaniline and carbon nano tube.

title_en: Method for synthesizing hollow gold nanoflowers with SERS activity by one-pot method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for synthesizing hollow gold nanoflowers with SERS activity by a one-pot method, which belongs to the technical field of nano material preparation and comprises the following specific steps: in water with the temperature of 25 ℃, chloroauric acid is added under the condition of stirring, and after the chloroauric acid is completely dissolved, a silane coupling agent is added; controlling the pH value to be 9.0-9.5, pre-reacting for 10 minutes, and then adding a reducing agent; and after the reduction reaction is carried out for 30 minutes, the hollow gold nanoflowers with good surface-enhanced Raman spectrum detection effect are finally obtained. The method has the advantages of high reaction process speed, mild conditions, relative environmental friendliness, uniform size of the synthesized hollow gold nanoflowers and excellent surface-enhanced Raman spectrum detection effect.

title_en: Preparation method of gold nano-star with excellent surface enhanced Raman characteristics
abstract_en: The invention relates toA preparation method of gold nano-star with excellent surface enhanced Raman characteristics comprises the following steps: preparing a first template: using polycarbonate film as mother plate and provided by Lanzhou heavy ion accelerator 129 Xe ions are uniformly irradiated in vacuum; after the irradiation is finished, carrying out ultraviolet photosensitization and chemical etching to obtain a heavy ion track template with the aperture of 60-80 nm; preparing sodium borohydride solutions with the concentrations of 0.1mol/L and 0.01mol/L respectively; thirdly, preparing gold sodium sulfite solutions with the concentrations of 0.1mol/L and 0.01mol/L respectively; preparing a gold nano star: fixing the heavy ion track template between two reaction tanks, firstly adding a sodium borohydride solution into the reaction tank on the smooth side of the heavy ion track template, then adding a sodium gold sulfite solution into the reaction tank on the rough side, removing bubbles on two sides of the template, standing for 10 minutes for reaction, and then taking out and washing the heavy ion track template to obtain the gold nanostar. The invention is simple, green, high efficient and low cost.

title_en: Method for producing nano rare earth oxide powder
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for producing nano rare earth oxide powder, which comprises the following steps: preparing a rare earth salt solution, adding an ammonium bicarbonate solution into the rare earth salt solution for precipitation reaction, carrying out crystal transformation on slurry obtained by the precipitation reaction under the conditions of 90-130 ℃ and 0.2-0.6 MPa, and roasting the obtained crystal to obtain the nano rare earth oxide powder. The method has the advantages of low requirement on process conditions, small equipment dependence and low cost, and is suitable for industrialization.

title_en: Microreactor, chemical production system, and method for producing microreactor
abstract_en: In order to achieve good mixing in the mixing of raw materials having different flow rates (volume ratios) (different flow rates), the mixing apparatus is characterized in that: the flow path has a high-flow-rate-side flow path (102) through which a high-flow-rate-side raw material among raw materials having different flow rates flows, a low-flow-rate-side flow path (103) through which a low-flow-rate-side raw material flows, branch flow paths (102a, 102b) through which the high-flow-rate-side flow path branches, and a retention flow path (104) which is a flow path in which the branch flow paths (102a, 102b) and the low-flow-rate-side flow path (103) merge with each other, and the branch flow path (102a) and the branch flow path (102b) merge with each other so as to sandwich the low-flow-rate-side flow path (103).

title_en: Preparation method of high-dispersity Pt-Cu alloy nanoparticles
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of high-dispersity Pt-Cu alloy nanoparticles. Belongs to the technical field of alloy nano material preparation. The preparation process comprises the following steps: preparing a precursor copper chloride solution, heating and stirring at 90-100 ℃, adding long-chain alkylamine, adding a reducing agent ascorbic acid, adding chloroplatinic acid, and heating for reacting for 20-30 minutes. In the preparation process: the addition of the long-chain alkylamine can not only improve the monodispersity of the Pt-Cu alloy nanoparticles, but also inhibit the generation of impurity phases by reducing the reaction rate. The chloroplatinic acid plays roles in providing a Pt source, promoting the conversion of bivalent Cu into zero-valent Cu and the like in the reaction. The method provided by the invention is simple to operate, green and environment-friendly, low in production cost and easy to realize preparation environment. The prepared Pt-Cu alloy has high dispersibility and clean surface. In the catalytic application of hydrogen evolution reaction, the Pt-Cu alloy has excellent catalytic stability.

title_en: Method for pulling out carbon nanotube net, method for manufacturing carbon nanotube yarn, method for manufacturing carbon nanotube sheet, and device for pulling out carbon nanotube net
abstract_en: A method for more uniformly drawing out a carbon nanotube network while suppressing the mixing of end chips is realized. The method for pulling out a carbon nanotube network is characterized in that the carbon nanotube network (10) is pulled out from the carbon nanotube array (1) in a state that contact members (20A) which are in contact with the carbon nanotube array (1) are arranged on both outer sides of both end portions of a boundary area between the carbon nanotube array (1) and the carbon nanotube network (10).

title_en: Novel rare earth nano bimodal developer and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel rare earth nano bimodal developer, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the developer is NaHoF 4 @CeO 2 Nanoparticles, the preparation of the imaging agent comprising the steps of: first, NaHoF 4 Preparation of nanoparticles, second, CeO 2 Preparation of nanoparticles in NaHoF 4 In which nano CeO is doped 2 To obtain NaHoF 4 @CeO 2 The imaging agent is used in CT and MRI bimodal imaging, physicochemical representation and toxicity experiments show that the nano particles have good biological safety, and in vitro experiments show that the nano particles have good CT and MRI bimodal imaging effects and simultaneously have radiotherapy sensitization effect on pancreatic cancer cells.

title_en: Preparation and application of covalent organic framework/titanium carbide nanosheet composite material
abstract_en: The invention relates to preparation and application of a covalent organic framework/titanium carbide nanosheet composite material, belongs to the technical field of development and research of new energy materials, and relates to preparation and application of a single-layer or few-layer Ti 3 C 2 Mixing the nanosheets, organic matter monomer and solid catalyst, sealing in a vacuumized quartz tube, and obtaining covalent organic framework/Ti by an ionothermal method 3 C 2 A nanosheet composite. Covalent organic framework/Ti 3 C 2 The nano-sheet composite material is coated on an aluminum sheet after being carried with sulfur and is used as a working electrode of a battery, a metal lithium sheet is used as a counter electrode and a reference electrode, an organic microporous membrane is used as a diaphragm, an organic solution is used as an electrolyte, and the button battery is assembled in a glove box filled with high-purity argon. Compared with the prior art, the invention can be used as a two-dimensional electrode material, is widely applied to the energy field of lithium-sulfur batteries and the like, and has excellent charge/discharge performance.

title_en: Preparation method of composite positive electrode material of lithium-sulfur battery with nanosheet layered structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a composite positive electrode material of a lithium-sulfur battery with a nanosheet layered structure, which comprises the steps of respectively adding nickel chloride and terephthalic acid into a N, N-dimethylformamide solution, stirring by a magnetic stirrer to be dispersed by combining an ultrasonic generator, then adding triethylamine, stirring at room temperature to form a turbid liquid, performing ultrasonic dispersion and centrifugal separation, drying, performing thermal treatment to obtain black powder, mixing the black powder with sulfur powder, roasting in an argon atmosphere, naturally cooling to room temperature, and grinding to obtain the composite positive electrode material of the lithium-sulfur battery with the nanosheet layered structure; the layered composite powder prepared by the invention has the advantages of small and uniform granularity, large specific surface area, good sulfur coating property, good conductivity and the like; the heating speed in the heat treatment process is low, the heat preservation time is short, the particles are uniform and fine, and the sulfur element can fully enter molecular gaps.

title_en: Solution organic light-emitting diode based on silver nanocube and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a silver nanocube-based solution organic light-emitting diode, which comprises an anode, a hole transport layer, a light-emitting layer containing silver nanocubes, an electron transport layer and a cathode which are sequentially stacked. The invention also discloses a preparation method of the solution organic light-emitting diode based on the silver nanocube, which comprises the following steps: the ITO glass substrate is thoroughly cleaned, a hole transport layer and a light-emitting layer containing silver nanocubes are prepared through spin coating, and then an electron transport layer and a metal electrode are sequentially prepared through evaporation in vacuum. The invention has the advantages that: the silver nanocubes are dispersed in the light-emitting layer, the light-emitting efficiency of the organic light-emitting diode is effectively improved by utilizing the plasma resonance effect of the silver nanocubes, and the preparation method is simple and easy to implement and has potential application value.

title_en: MEMS device and manufacturing method for MEMS device
abstract_en: According to one embodiment, the manufacturing method 100 for a dual film MEMS device 300 comprises the steps of: providing 120 a layer arrangement 200 on a carrier substrate 210, wherein the layer arrangement 200 has a first film structure 220 and a second film structure 230 spaced apart from each other and a counter electrode structure 240 arranged therebetween, wherein a sacrificial material 250 is arranged in an intermediate region 260 between the counter electrode structure 240 and the first film structure and the second film structure, respectively, spaced apart from the counter electrode structure, and wherein the first film structure 220 has an opening structure 270 facing the intermediate region 260 with the sacrificial material 250; the sacrificial material 250 is removed 140 from the middle region portion to obtain a mechanical connection structure 280 with the sacrificial material 250 between the first membrane structure and the second membrane structure, the mechanical connection structure being mechanically coupled between the first membrane structure and the second membrane structure and mechanically decoupled from the counter electrode structure.

title_en: Synthetic method of alcohol compound
abstract_en: The invention provides a synthesis method of an alcohol compound, which comprises the following steps: the carbon-coated nickel nano composite material is used as a catalyst to catalyze aldehyde compounds to carry out hydrogenation reduction reaction in a hydrogen atmosphere; the nano composite material comprises a core-shell structure with a shell layer and an inner core, wherein the shell layer is an oxygen-doped graphitized carbon layer, the inner core is nickel nano particles, and the pickling loss rate of the nano composite material is less than or equal to 60%. The method adopts the carbon-coated nickel nano composite material containing the core-shell structure as the catalyst, generates good catalytic effect, is beneficial to playing a role under more severe conditions, is used for synthesizing alcohol compounds by hydrogenation reduction of aldehyde compounds, and has excellent activity, selectivity and safety.

title_en: Protective coating on trench features of a wafer and method of making the same
abstract_en: A coating for protecting a wafer from moisture and debris resulting from dicing, dicing or processing the wafer is provided. A semiconductor sensor device includes: a wafer having a surface and at least one trench feature, and a protective coating covering the trench feature. The trench feature includes a plurality of walls and the plurality of walls are covered with the protective coating, wherein the plurality of walls of the trench feature are formed as part of the semiconductor sensor device. The semiconductor sensor device further includes a patterned mask formed on the wafer prior to forming the trench features, wherein the protective coating is formed directly to the trench features and the patterned mask. The semiconductor sensor device is selected from the group consisting of: MEMS die, sensor circuit die, pressure die, accelerometer, gyroscope, microphone, speaker, transducer, optical sensor, gas sensor, bolometer, giant magnetoresistive sensor (GMR), tunnel Magnetoresistive (TMR) sensor, environmental sensor, and temperature sensor.

title_en: Method for preparing two-sided nanoparticles
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of two-sided nanoparticles, which takes two types of nanoparticles with different components and functions as raw materials and an organic compound auxiliary agent as a bridge, and prepares the two-sided nanoparticles on a large scale by a method of forming an oil-in-water Pickering emulsion under the action of ultrasound and volatilizing a solvent. The method for preparing the two-sided nanoparticles provided by the invention is simple to operate, the preparation process is easy to control, mass production can be realized, the universality is realized, the obtained two-sided nanoparticles not only have good oil-water two-phase solvent dispersibility, but also have narrow size distribution, the respective advantages of different functions in the nanoparticles are revealed, and the limitation of the application of the nanoparticles with single function in multiple fields can be overcome.

title_en: Homogeneous and heterogeneous tungsten trioxide nanobelt photocatalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a homogeneous and heterogeneous tungsten trioxide nanobelt photocatalyst and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the photocatalyst is homogeneous two-phase WO 3 Nanoribbons of hexagonal phase WO 3 Quadrature phase WO 3 The mass ratio of two phases is hexagonal phase WO 3 Orthogonal phase WO 3 0.1 to 0.5; WO 3 The nano-belt has a length of 100 nm-1000 nm, a width of 18nm-40nm and a thickness of 1nm-10 nm; is a narrow band gap semiconductor WO 3 As starting point for the photocatalyst, WCl is used 6 And NH 4 SCN is used as a main raw material and is prepared by a hydrothermal method. Under the irradiation condition of visible light, the photocatalyst has a homogeneous heterogeneous structure at the joint of two phase surfaces, can effectively promote the separation of carriers, and has good catalytic performance on the degradation of organic pollution model substances; the method has the advantages of simple synthesis process and equipment, low cost, high efficiency, short reaction period, good repeatability and wide industrial application prospect.

title_en: Cuprous sulfide-tellurium nano material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a cuprous sulfide-tellurium nano material and a preparation method thereof, which comprises the steps of firstly, uniformly mixing a sulfur source precursor and a copper source precursor in high-purity water to obtain a precursor reaction precipitate; and then carrying out three-stage microwave heating on the precursor reaction precipitate, the magnetons, the organic solvent and the tellurium source precursor to obtain the cuprous sulfide-tellurium nano material. The cuprous sulfide-tellurium nano material shows excellent photo-thermal stability and has the advantages of low toxicity and high efficiency. Therefore, the material can be used as an excellent photothermal therapeutic agent in photothermal application, and has wide application value in the fields of photothermal therapy, photoacoustic imaging and the like.

title_en: Black phosphorus quantum dot/platinum hybrid mesoporous silica nanoparticle and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a black phosphorus quantum dot/platinum hybrid mesoporous silica nanoparticle and a preparation method and application thereof. According to the invention, the black scale quantum dot/platinum hybrid nanoparticle with the platinum nanoparticles loaded in the mesoporous is synthesized by a one-step hydrothermal method and an in-situ growth method, so that the solution stability of the black phosphorus quantum dot can be obviously improved, and meanwhile, hydrogen peroxide in a tumor microenvironment and the platinum nanoparticles are subjected to catalytic reaction to generate oxygen, thereby further enhancing the photodynamic treatment effect of the black phosphorus quantum dot on tumors, and having good biomedical application prospect.

title_en: MgO nanowire RRAM (resistive random access memory) with low leakage current and large resistance ratio and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of integrated circuit devices, in particular to a MgO nanowire RRAM with low leakage current and large resistance ratio and a manufacturing method thereof. In addition, the nanowires are grown in the limited cell area, so that the conducting paths among RRAM storage cells are distributed more uniformly, and the divergence of the characteristic parameters of the RRAM is further reduced. Therefore, the MgO nanowire RRAM with uniform resistance change parameters, low leakage current and large resistance ratio is designed and realized.

title_en: Method for recycling amphiphilic surface active pollutants in water
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for recycling amphiphilic surface active pollutants in water, which comprises the steps of adopting illumination treatment to carry out polymerization reaction on the amphiphilic surface active pollutants in water to form a polymerization product; the polymerization product is self-assembled and aggregated to form a fluorescent material, and a resource product is obtained by separation; according to the invention, through the illumination treatment of the amphiphilic surface active pollutants, the amphiphilic pollution in the wastewater can be recycled through one-step reaction, so that the amphiphilic surface active pollutants are converted into the available fluorescent material, the biotoxicity is greatly reduced, the obtained fluorescent material can be used as a recycling product, the fluorescent material is further applied to the fields of biological imaging and the like, the efficient conversion of organic carbon resources is realized while the pollutants are harmless, a new strategy is provided for the wastewater treatment and resource conversion, the win-win of economic benefits and environment friendliness in the field of amphiphilic organic pollution treatment is realized, and the application prospect is good.

title_en: Phosphorescent ferromagnetic granular preparation and nondestructive testing method using same
abstract_en: A dispersion of particles is provided, each particle comprising at least one ferromagnetic domain and at least one phosphor domain having an excitation wavelength, a luminescent persistence of at least 5 seconds, and a visible wavelength emission. A polymer resin transmissive for excitation wavelength emission and visible wavelength emission coats the ferromagnetic domains and the phosphor domains to define each particle size. Methods of non-destructive inspection of test articles apply a dispersion of these particles to the surface of the test article. A magnetic field is then induced that includes the test article. The surface of the test article is exposed to incident energy adapted to excite phosphorescence of the particle dispersion. The position of the particle dispersion on the surface of the test article is imaged as the incident energy exposure stops. An inspection system for non-destructive inspection of a test article is also provided.

title_en: Metal monoatomic/N-codoped 3D structure nanoporous carbon and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of metal monatomic/N-codoped 3D structure nano porous carbon, which is prepared by adopting a bottle-brush-shaped cellulose polyacrylonitrile block polymer as a template to adsorb metal ions, and comprises the following steps: dissolving cellulose in ionic liquid to form uniform solution, adding a halogenating reagent, and then carrying out heating reaction; dissolving a halogenated cellulose polymer in a polar organic solvent, and sequentially carrying out graft polymerization on an acrylonitrile monomer and a second monomer by adopting an atom transfer radical polymerization method; and adding the metal ion solution into the solution of the bottle brush-shaped cellulose polyacrylonitrile block polymer, fully adsorbing and carbonizing to obtain the metal monoatomic/N co-doped 3D structure nanoporous carbon. The 3D structure nano porous carbon prepared by the method has the advantages of high nitrogen content, controllable doping amount of the monatomic metal, large specific surface area and wide application prospect.

title_en: High-sensitivity capacitive flexible touch sensor based on three-dimensional porous microstructure composite dielectric layer and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-sensitivity capacitive flexible touch sensor based on a three-dimensional porous microstructure composite dielectric layer and a preparation method thereof. The capacitive flexible touch sensor has good flexibility, detection sensitivity and dynamic response characteristics, and provides an idea for designing a high-sensitivity flexible touch sensor for intelligent robot electronic skin application.

title_en: Porous channel submicron spherical FeS2Preparation method of (1)
abstract_en: The invention discloses a porous channel submicron spherical FeS 2 The method comprises the following steps: (1) dispersing prussian blue and a sulfur source compound in a solvent, and stirring for 30-60 minutes to obtain a suspension; (2) carrying out hydrothermal reaction on the suspension obtained in the step (1), naturally cooling to room temperature, centrifuging, washing and precipitating, and drying to obtain porous channel submicron spherical FeS 2 Black powder. The porous submicron spherical FeS prepared by the method 2 The Prussian blue is used as a precursor, is green and environment-friendly, has a simple process, is environment-friendly, is convenient to operate, has low preparation cost, and is suitable for large-scale industrial production.

title_en: Near-infrared fluorescence sensitization method for determining glucose
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of functional material preparation and application, and provides a near-infrared fluorescence sensitization method for measuring glucose in order to solve the problems of false positive and serious interference of a conventional fluorescence quenching method. According to the invention, a gold nano-glucose oxidase hybrid material is used as a near-infrared fluorescent probe, after glucose is added, the near-infrared fluorescence of gold nanoparticles is enhanced, and the enhancement degree of the fluorescence is in direct proportion to the concentration of the glucose, so that the detection of the glucose is realized.
