The detection method is simple and convenient to operate and quick in response, the maximum emission of the fluorescent probe is in a near infrared region, the interference of autofluorescence and Raman Rayleigh scattering and the like of coexisting substances, particularly biological samples, can be effectively avoided, and meanwhile, compared with a fluorescence quenching method, the fluorescence sensitization method has higher sensitivity and selectivity.

title_en: Semiconductor element and method for manufacturing semiconductor element
abstract_en: The application provides a method for manufacturing a semiconductor element. The method includes providing a housing. At least one semiconductor chip is arranged in the cavity of the housing. Furthermore, the electrical contacts of the semiconductor chip are connected to the electrical contacts of the housing by bonding wires. The method further comprises applying a protective material to the electrical contacts of the semiconductor chip and to the adjoining areas of the bond wires and the electrical contacts of the semiconductor chip and/or to the electrical contacts of the housing and to the adjoining areas of the bond wires and the electrical contacts of the housing. In addition, the method includes filling at least one sub-region of the cavity with a gel.

title_en: Polyethylene-zinc oxide micron nano multilevel structure composite microsphere material and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polyethylene-zinc oxide micron nano multilevel structure composite microsphere material and application thereof. And (3) placing the polyethylene microspheres with the zinc oxide on the surfaces into a mixed solution of zinc nitrate and hexamethyltetramine, stirring in a constant-temperature water bath at the temperature of 80-100 ℃, and after complete reaction, washing and drying to obtain the zinc oxide-free polyethylene microspheres. The microsphere has stable structure, uniform size, diameter of 150-400 μm, and length of zinc oxide nanorod of 10-50 nm. The microspheres are inoculated with human adipose-derived mesenchymal stem cells, so that the proliferation of the stem cells can be promoted, and the dryness of the stem cells can be maintained.

title_en: Preparation method and application of two-dimensional lead telluride nanosheet and nanomaterial
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of nano materials, in particular to a preparation method and application of a two-dimensional lead telluride nanosheet and a nano material. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: weighing reaction raw materials for growth of the two-dimensional lead telluride nanosheets; using a sheet material with an atomically smooth surface as a growth substrate; heating the reaction raw materials at constant temperature for vapor deposition after temperature programming in the gas flow of protective gas; and quenching the substrate after the deposition process is finished, namely obtaining the two-dimensional lead telluride nanosheet on the substrate. The thickness of the nano-sheet is 5nm-200nm, the width or length is 0.1-70 μm, and the nano-sheet has a single crystal structure. The nano sheet is of a face-centered cubic crystal structure, and the exposed crystal face of the nano sheet is a {100} crystal face group and has a sheet rectangular shape. The invention can obtain the large-area ultrathin two-dimensional lead telluride nanosheet with uniform orientation and appearance and high crystallinity by the Van der Waals epitaxial growth technology, and can be applied to the fields of infrared photoelectric detectors and the like.

title_en: Preparation method of manganese-doped zinc sulfide quantum dot embedded fluorescent composite film
abstract_en: The invention relates to and discloses a preparation method of a manganese-doped zinc sulfide quantum dot embedded fluorescent composite film, which comprises the following steps: dissolving manganese-doped zinc sulfide fluorescent quantum dots, a film-forming monomer, a cross-linking agent and an initiator in a solvent in sequence, and preparing a casting solution after ultrasonic dispersion and stirring; at room temperature, uniformly spreading the casting solution on a substrate material, covering the substrate material with polymethyl methacrylate, and heating in water bath under pressure to initiate polymerization; and after polymerization, placing the film into a hydrofluoric acid solution to etch and remove the matrix material, thus obtaining the fluorescent quantum dot embedded composite film. The method has the advantages of simple synthesis, strong fluorescence property, low biotoxicity and reusability, and the prepared embedded composite membrane has the advantages of good transparency, stable fluorescence, high mechanical strength and good self-cleaning capability, and has huge application potential in optical sensing, biochemical analysis, water pollution, food analysis and environmental protection.

title_en: MEMS structure and method of manufacturing the same
abstract_en: The application discloses a MEMS structure and a manufacturing method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: forming a cavity in a semiconductor substrate; forming a sensitive membrane for sealing the cavity on the first surface of the semiconductor substrate; forming a stop layer on the inner wall of the cavity; forming a channel reaching the stop layer on a second surface of the semiconductor substrate, wherein the second surface and the first surface are opposite to each other; and removing the stop layer via the via. According to the method, the stop layer is formed on the inner wall of the cavity and used for forming a channel communicated with the external environment, so that the pressure sensor with the single-chip structure can be formed.

title_en: Chemical substance concentrator and chemical substance detection device
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a chemical concentrator and a chemical detection device. The chemical concentrator concentrates chemicals contained in the gas sample. The chemical substance concentrator includes: a flow path which constitutes a hollow portion through which the gas sample flows; a first electrode and a second electrode provided on an inner wall of the flow path; an electrode wiring connected to the first electrode and the second electrode; a material layer disposed on the electrode wiring; and the adsorption piece is arranged on the material layer, adsorbs the chemical substances and enables the chemical substances to be separated. The chemical substance concentrator can efficiently desorb adsorbed chemical substances.

title_en: SnO (stannic oxide)2@ ZnO nano composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses SnO 2 The @ ZnO nano composite material comprises a ZnO nano body formed by a plurality of ZnO nano pyramids with the same sphere center as a growth point, and SnO is grown on the nonpolar surface of each ZnO nano pyramid 2 A nanorod; the length-diameter ratio of the ZnO nano pyramid is 4-5, and SnO 2 The length-diameter ratio of the nanorod is 6-10. Preparing ZnO single crystal nano pyramid with wurtzite structure by a microwave hydrothermal method, and then carrying out microwave hydrothermal growth on SnO with rutile structure on the ZnO single crystal nano pyramid 2 The single crystal nano rod does not need any template or catalyst in the microwave hydrothermal preparation process, has simple process, high yield and low cost, and is suitable for mass production to directly grow the secondary structure SnO on the nonpolar surface of the primary structure ZnO nano pyramid 2 The nano-rod prepared from the nano-composite material has uniform shape and tight coating, and can be used as radar infrared compatible stealth materials, photocatalysis, solar cells, gas sensors and lithium ion battery cathode materials.

title_en: TFT array substrate
abstract_en: The invention provides a TFT array substrate, which comprises a display device plate and a semiconductor layer arranged on the display device plate; wherein the thickness of the semiconductor layer is less than or equal to 35 nanometers. Has the advantages that: on the basis of saving the shading layer and reducing the production period and the cost of the TFT array substrate, the thickness of the semiconductor layer and the width of the active island are reduced, and meanwhile, the width of the ion lightly doped region is reduced to reduce photon-generated carriers, so that the backlight photon-generated leakage current is reduced, and the energy consumption of the display panel is reduced.

title_en: FeSmO3Hydrothermal preparation method of nano powder
abstract_en: FeSmO 3 A hydrothermal preparation method of nano powder, relating to a composite oxide material FeSmO 3 And (4) preparing. The invention takes samarium acetate and ammonium ferric oxalate as raw materials, and prepares FeSmO at a lower temperature by a hydrothermal method 3 ，FeSmO 3 Approximately spherical particles, the average grain diameter of the crystal grains is 20-30nm, and the visible light catalytic performance is excellent. The invention is FeSmO 3 The preparation of nano powder products develops new industry, achieves the aims of simple operation, high speed, high efficiency, low energy consumption and industrialized production of FeSmO 3 The purpose of the nano powder is.

title_en: Nano fluorescent probe with good biocompatibility and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nano fluorescent probe with good biocompatibility and a preparation method thereof, wherein the nano fluorescent probe comprises the following components: zn 1+x Ga 2‑2x Ge x O 4 :Cr t Nanocrystals and adsorption of said Zn 1+   x Ga 2‑2x Ge x O 4 :Cr t Chitosan oligosaccharide on the surface of the nano crystal; wherein x = 0.01-0.25, and t = 0.01-0.05. The invention adopts a hydrothermal method to prepare Zn 1+x Ga 2‑2x Ge x O 4 :Cr t The nano-crystal is modified by chitosan oligosaccharide to prepare the nano-fluorescent probe with good biocompatibility, and the material has good fluorescence property and has important potential application prospect in the fields of biomolecule detection and sensing, biomedical imaging, light treatment and the like.

title_en: MEMS device and method of manufacturing the same
abstract_en: The application discloses a MEMS device and a manufacturing method thereof. The manufacturing method comprises the following steps: forming a cavity in a semiconductor substrate; forming a structural layer over the cavity; forming at least one sense resistor in the structural layer; and forming a second opening reaching the cavity through the structural layer, wherein a part of the structural layer adjacent to the second opening forms a mass block, parts of the structural layer connected with the semiconductor substrate and the mass block form a cantilever respectively, and the induction resistor is positioned in the cantilever. The application forms the mass block and the cantilever through the structural layer above the cavity in the semiconductor substrate, thereby forming a movable structure, and senses the change of the cantilever caused by the movement of the mass block through forming the sensing resistor in the cantilever, thereby being applicable to manufacturing the acceleration sensor.

title_en: Batch preparation method of suspended nanowire manipulator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a batch preparation method of suspended nanowire manipulators, which comprises the following steps: preparing a nanowire array growing on the edge of a slope step defined by photoetching based on an IPSLS (Internet protocol Security language) growth mode, then spin-coating a layer of oxygen resin colloid on a substrate on which silicon nanowires grow, carrying out photoetching pattern operation, removing an amorphous silicon medium layer on the surface of the substrate by wet etching, enabling an epoxy resin colloid film sticking the nanowire array to suspend on the surface of a solution, fully replacing the epoxy resin colloid film with ethanol, and then utilizing a drying technology to prepare the self-assembled suspended nanowire manipulator array. The invention utilizes the transfer technology and the critical point drying technology to transfer the nanowire array to the photoetched self-supporting substrate, eliminates the influence of the surface tension of the solution, keeps the original appearance of the nanowire manipulator, and finally obtains the operable suspended nanowire manipulator array, which can be widely applied to various fields of nano robots, biomedical cell detection, biosensors and the like.

title_en: Preparation and application of gamma-MnOOH/SFC nano composite electrode material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a gamma-MnOOH/SFC nano composite electrode material. (1) Adding the sisal fiber carbon powder into deionized water, magnetically stirring, adding sulfamic acid, and magnetically stirring to form a black solution; (2) adding potassium permanganate into the black solution, and continuing to magnetically stir to form a purple black solution; (2) transferring the purple black solution into a high-pressure reaction kettle with a polytetrafluoroethylene lining for reaction; and respectively washing the product with deionized water and absolute ethyl alcohol for 3 times, and drying to obtain the gamma-MnOOH/SFC nano composite with the length of 220-500 nm and the diameter of 18-35 nm. The method has the advantages of mild reaction conditions, relatively low synthesis temperature, short time, easy control and low production cost; the prepared gamma-MnOOH/SFC nano composite is an excellent electrode material of a lithium ion battery and a super capacitor, and can also be used as a catalyst material and a heavy metal adsorption material in environmental protection.

title_en: Manufacturing process of grid type acoustic sensing structure and acoustic wave detection method
abstract_en: A manufacturing process and sound wave detection method of the grid type acoustic sensing structure, the manufacturing process is to prepare a photoresist mould of the grid groove on the substrate, blade coat carbon nanotube and polyvinyl alcohol on the photoresist mould, heat and shape and prepare the photoresist mould with grid type structure in the groove; then placing the photoresist mould in a solution capable of dissolving the photoresist, sacrificing the photoresist mould to obtain a grid-type structure without a substrate, and plating gold on the grid-type structure to obtain a grid-type sensing structure; the acoustic wave detection method of the grid type sensing structure comprises the steps of firstly creating a magnetic field environment, placing the grid type sensing structure in the magnetic field environment, leading the direction of magnetic sensing lines of the magnetic field environment to be approximately parallel to one side of the grid square of the grid type sensing structure, and leading out a lead along the other side of the grid square of the grid type sensing structure which is not parallel to the direction of the magnetic sensing lines to form a closed loop so as to obtain an induced current signal; the invention has simple manufacturing process and can detect weak acoustic wave transmission of air media.

title_en: Magnesium-zinc stannate nano composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a magnesium zinc stannate nano composite material and a preparation method thereof, wherein a certain amount of stannic chloride, zinc chloride, magnesium acetate and Cetyl Trimethyl Ammonium Bromide (CTAB) are dissolved in distilled water with a certain volume, then the distilled water is transferred to a magnetic stirrer to be stirred to obtain a mixture solution, then a proper amount of sodium hydroxide is added to adjust the pH value, the mixture solution is transferred to a high-pressure reaction kettle to carry out high-temperature high-pressure reaction, and a product after the reaction is washed, dried and then sintered in a muffle furnace to obtain the magnesium zinc stannate nano composite material. Electrochemical experiments prove that the composite material prepared by the method has wide application prospect as a lithium ion battery cathode material. The whole preparation process is simple to operate, low in raw material cost, low in equipment investment and suitable for batch production.

title_en: Gold @ manganese dioxide super nanoparticle and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gold @ manganese dioxide super nanoA rice grain and a preparation method thereof, comprising the following steps: (1) pretreating the gold nanoparticle stock solution to obtain gold nanoparticles; (2) dispersing gold nanoparticles into a sodium citrate solution, adding potassium permanganate in batches under a mixing condition, and reacting at 30-40 ℃. The method regulates and controls the surface environment of the gold nanoparticles by pretreating the gold nanoparticle stock solution, so that the manganese dioxide shells can be formed by in-situ self-assembly on the surfaces of the gold cores, the reaction conditions in the method are mild, the etching of potassium permanganate on the gold nanoparticle cores under the conditions of high temperature and strong acid can be avoided, and the diameters of the manganese dioxide core shells can be adjusted by adding the potassium permanganate in batches to obtain Au @ MnO shells of manganese dioxide shells with different diameters 2 A super nanoparticle.

title_en: MEMS sensor and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an MEMS sensor and electronic equipment, wherein a sensitive film layer comprises a sensitive part and a fixed part; the magnetic detection mechanism comprises a magnet arranged on the sensitive part and also comprises magnetic resistances arranged on the fixed part and respectively positioned at two opposite sides of the magnet in the X-axis direction; the distances from the centers of the two magnetic resistances to the center of the magnet are equal, and the sensing directions of the two magnetic resistances are the same and are in the X-axis direction; when the sensitive part vibrates in the Z-axis direction, the resistance value of one of the magnetic resistances is increased, the resistance value of the other magnetic resistance is decreased, the variation is the same, and the two magnetic resistances form a Wheatstone bridge. The sensor of the invention is easy to control the alignment process of the magnet and the magnetic resistance, and can make the magnet and the magnetic resistance smaller, thereby realizing the miniaturization development of the sensor and simultaneously being easy to improve the detection performance of the sensor.

title_en: Composite metal oxide nano-particles and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a composite metal oxide nanoparticle, which comprises a metal oxide nanoparticle, halide anions combined on the surface of the metal oxide nanoparticle, and an electropositive surface modifier combined with the halide anions. When the composite metal oxide nano-particles are used as a hole transport layer of a quantum dot light-emitting device, the optical characteristics of quantum dots contacted with the composite metal oxide nano-particles can be improved, and meanwhile, the stability and the charge conduction performance of the quantum dots are improved.

title_en: Preparation and detection method of inverse thixotropic nano calcium carbonate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of inverse thixotropic nano calcium carbonate, which comprises the following steps: s1, calcining limestone and anthracite to obtain quick lime and kiln gas; s2, slaking the quick lime in the S1 to prepare coarse lime emulsion, and aging for 24-48 h; s3, adjusting the concentration of the coarse lime emulsion in the S2 to 6.90% -7.00% of refined lime emulsion, pumping the refined lime emulsion into a normal-temperature intermittent bubbling carbonization tower, adding a crystal form control agent and a dispersing agent, and introducing kiln gas for carbonization; s4, removing impurities from the calcium carbonate slurry in the S3 by a rotary vibration sieve, and pumping the calcium carbonate slurry into an activation kettle to perform wet surface coating treatment to obtain activated slurry; and S5, performing plate-and-frame filter pressing on the activated slurry in the S4, drying, crushing and packaging to obtain the inverse thixotropic nano calcium carbonate. The inverse thixotropic nano calcium carbonate product has negative thixotropic property, good dispersion property and good intermiscibility with a high molecular compound, and can be suitable for occasions needing inverse thixotropic property.

title_en: Preparation method of nano gold island-shaped structure by taking PVP as guide and assembly
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a nano gold island-shaped structure by taking PVP as a guide and assembly, which comprises the following steps: (1) AgNO 3 Adding PVP solution into the solution, magnetically stirring at room temperature, and sequentially adding trisodium citrate solution and NaBH 4 Solution, quick addition of H when the solution immediately turns yellow in color 2 O 2 Continuously stirring the solution, and finally changing the color of the solution from light yellow, red and purple into blue after ten minutes; (2) taking the nano triangular solution, magnetically stirring, adding a PVP solution and ascorbic acid, quickly adding a chloroauric acid solution into the solution, reacting at room temperature for about 20min, finally centrifuging for 10min, and ultrasonically dispersing in an aqueous solution; the invention improves the heterogeneity of the silver surface and slows down the migration rate of the deposited gold atoms under the condition that PVP with stronger adsorption capacity is used as a ligand, thereby leading the PVP to be condensed together to form an island-shaped structure.

title_en: Micro-electromechanical piezoresistive pressure sensor with self-test capability and corresponding manufacturing method
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a microelectromechanical piezoresistive pressure sensor with self-test capability and a corresponding manufacturing method. The microelectromechanical pressure sensor includes a monolithic body of semiconductor material having a front surface. The sensing structure is integrated in the monolithic body and has a buried cavity that is completely contained within the monolithic body at the front surface. The sensing membrane is suspended over the buried cavity and is formed by a surface portion of the monolithic body. A piezoresistive type sensing element is arranged in the sensing membrane to detect deformation of the sensing membrane due to pressure. The pressure sensor is further provided with a self-test structure integrated within the monolithic body to cause application of a test deformation of the sensing membrane in order to verify correct operation of the sensing structure. The present disclosure also relates to an electronic device.

title_en: Quantum dot ink, preparation method thereof and quantum dot light-emitting device
abstract_en: The invention relates to quantum dot ink, a preparation method thereof and a quantum dot light-emitting device. Wherein, the quantum dot ink comprises 1-8% of quantum dots, 70-90% of solvent and 5-30% of additive by weight percentage; the solvent comprises at least one long-carbon-chain ester solvent and at least one long-carbon-chain alkane solvent, wherein the long-carbon-chain ester solvent is a straight-chain ester solvent with 8-30 carbon atoms, the long-carbon-chain alkane solvent is alkane with 9-16 carbon atoms, and the long-carbon-chain ester solvent accounts for 60-90% of the total weight of the solvent. The quantum dot ink provided by the invention is mild to HTL layers, has parameter requirements suitable for ink-jet printing, can stably discharge ink in ink-jet printing, and cannot cause nozzle blockage.

title_en: Copper nano-cluster synthesized by taking Cu-MOFs as precursor and synthesis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a copper nano-cluster synthesized by taking Cu-MOFs as a precursor and a synthesis method. The method is characterized in that Cu-MOFs is dissolved in water, ascorbic acid is added as a reducing agent, and a new copper nano cluster is synthesized under a hydrothermal condition. The Cu-MOFs are obtained by reacting copper chloride with 4, 4' -bipyridine. The copper nano cluster synthesized by the method has the characteristics of high quantum yield, good stability and the like, the emission wavelength of the copper nano cluster has adjustability, the emission wavelength is blue-shifted from 520nm to 455nm along with the increase of pH, the fluorescence response at 520nm is gradually reduced along with the increase of pH, and the fluorescence response at 455nm is gradually increased, so that the pH value of a reversible ratio fluorescence sensing determination solution can be constructed.

title_en: Scribing method for protecting sensitive structure of MEMS device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a scribing method for protecting a sensitive structure of a MEMS device. The scribing method comprises the following steps: adopting a silicon wafer with a protection structure as a protection sheet; matching the silicon wafer with the MEMS wafer to be scribed through the assembly structure arranged on the silicon wafer, and then scribing and cleaving in sequence to obtain a single MEMS device; when the silicon wafer is mated with the MEMS wafer, each MEMS device on the MEMS wafer is embedded within the protective structure of the silicon wafer. When the method is adopted, silicon chips generated by scribing are blocked by the wall of the protection chamber in the scribing and breaking processes; silicon debris generated by the cracking is blocked by the scribing grooves around the MEMS device. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that: the protection wafer is processed through one-step etching, the MEMS structure is protected, the process flow and the operation are simple, and the wafer can be repeatedly used; expensive scribing equipment is not needed, the method can be realized on the basis of the existing process equipment, and the cost is low; the method is suitable for various MEMS devices and has strong applicability.

title_en: Preparation method of colloid-sealed Ag nano-particle spherical efficient uniform SERS substrate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a spherical SERS substrate with fast curing glue-sealed Ag nanoparticles, which comprises the following steps: preparing Ag nano particles, adding deionized water into the Ag nano particles, performing ultrasonic treatment to uniformly disperse the Ag nano particles, adding epoxy resin AB glue, stirring, sucking 0.4-0.6mL of mixture by using a liquid transfer gun, slowly extruding to enable the mixture to be suspended under a gun head to form balls, enriching the silver nano particles to the lowest spherical position under the action of gravity, continuously keeping the solidification for 3-5min, and shearing the front end of the gun head to obtain the rapidly solidified spherical SERS substrate. The invention has the advantages that: the spherical SERS substrate is quickly cured, and the curing speed is high; the spherical SERS substrate has the highest point, so that the fixed-point detection effect can be achieved; the spherical SERS substrate can realize the solid-phase extraction function; in the process of suspending the silver nanoparticles into a spherical shape, the silver nanoparticles can be enriched at the top end of the sphere under the action of gravity, so that a better enhancement effect is provided for SERS detection; the SERS substrate signal is enhanced uniformly and stably; and the preparation method is simple and convenient.

title_en: MEMS device and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an MEMS device and a preparation method thereof, wherein an MEMS structure and a first bonding pad are formed on a first substrate, a second bonding pad and a side wall are formed on a second substrate, the side wall is positioned on the second bonding pad, the side wall is positioned at the edge of the second bonding pad and is in a closed shape, the first bonding pad on the first substrate is pressed and connected to the second bonding pad on the second substrate for bonding, the side wall surrounds the first bonding pad, the side wall can block the overflow of the first bonding pad in the bonding process, and the side wall is formed on the second substrate, so that the damage to the MEMS in the side wall forming process can be avoided, and the bonding efficiency is improved to a certain extent because no side wall residue exists on the first bonding pad.

title_en: Method for green preparation of nano-silver from aspergillus japonicus fermentation liquor and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing nano silver particles by Aspergillus japonicus PJ01 fermentation liquor, belonging to the field of nano materials. According to the invention, crude enzyme liquid produced by solid state fermentation is used as a reducing agent and a stabilizing agent, and simple magnetic stirring is used for assisting in synthesizing nano silver to obtain brown liquid. And centrifuging the liquid at a high speed, washing and drying to obtain the powdery silver nano particles. Under the ultraviolet spectrum scanning, the solution has a maximum absorption peak near 400 nm. The prepared silver nano particles are full spheres and have good dispersibility. In addition, the invention also provides application of the silver nanoparticles synthesized by the enzyme solution in the field of bacteriostasis. The invention has simple production process, is green and environment-friendly, and has wide prospect in the field of medicine bacteriostasis.

title_en: FeP/FeC double-layer heterogeneous interface electrode material in carbon confinement space and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ion battery cathode materials, and discloses a FeP/FeC double-layer heterogeneous interface electrode material in a carbon confinement space, and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the material has a carbon and FeC and FeP and FeC double-layer heterogeneous interface structure in the carbon confinement space, the particle size of particles is 20-90nm, and the mass fraction of carbon is 20-60%. The structure of the material is a double-layer heterogeneous interface in a carbon confinement space, namely a double-layer heterogeneous interface structure of carbon and FeC and FeP and FeC, the material is obtained by polymerizing ferric salt and an organic phosphine ligand serving as raw materials to obtain an iron-based organic phosphine framework structure and then processing the iron-based organic phosphine framework through a confinement pyrolysis technology, and when the material is applied to a lithium/sodium ion battery cathode, the material has the advantages of high first coulombic efficiency, high lithium/sodium storage capacity, excellent rate capability, good long cycle stability and the like; the preparation method is simple, pollution-free, low in cost and easy to realize industrial mass production.

title_en: Pore-diameter-adjustable iron-containing nitrogen-doped urea-formaldehyde resin-based carbon material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an iron-containing nitrogen-doped urea-formaldehyde resin-based carbon material with adjustable aperture and a preparation method thereof, which comprises the steps of adding a formaldehyde solution into a urea solution, uniformly stirring, adding an iron salt until the pH value of the solution is 2-4 to obtain a reaction solution, reacting the reaction solution to generate a precipitate, separating the precipitate, and performing post-treatment to obtain a Fe-UFC precursor; wherein the molar ratio of urea to formaldehyde is 1 (0.1-1.2); and calcining the Fe-UFC precursor for 2-3 h at the temperature of 700-1000 ℃ in a protective atmosphere to obtain the iron-containing nitrogen-doped urea-formaldehyde resin-based carbon material with adjustable aperture. The method successfully synthesizes the Fe-UFC composite material by adopting a direct carbonization method under the condition of not adding any surfactant, and has the advantages of simple experimental process, low cost, controllable iron content, high nitrogen content, adjustable product aperture and controllable appearance.

title_en: Sensor power ramping in MEMS devices
abstract_en: A microelectromechanical systems (MEMS) device includes at least one substrate, a cover, a MEMS component, a sensor, and a power supply. The lid is coupled to the base plate such that the base plate and the lid together define an interior cavity. The MEMS component is disposed within the internal cavity. The sensor is disposed within the lumen and arranged to detect a parameter of the lumen. The power supply provides current to the sensor. The power supply is configured to control a current during a ramp-up transition of the current and a ramp-down transition of the current such that the ramp-up transition and the ramp-down transition have attenuated high frequency components.

title_en: Preparation method of two-dimensional layered nano material MXene quantum dots
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a two-dimensional layered nano material MXene quantum dot, which comprises the following steps: s1: preparing a two-dimensional layered nano material MXene by an etching method; s2: dissolving the two-dimensional layered nano material MXene in deionized water or an organic solvent, and carrying out ablation reaction under femtosecond laser; s3: and (3) centrifugally separating the solution ablated by the femtosecond laser to obtain supernatant containing the MXene quantum dots serving as the two-dimensional layered nano material. The method for preparing the MXene quantum dots of the two-dimensional layered nano material by using the liquid-phase femtosecond laser ablation method has the advantages of simple and safe operation and low cost, environment pollution is reduced by selecting green solvents such as deionized water, the repeatability is high, the operation is easy, the large-scale production can be realized, and the particle size distribution of the MXene quantum dots of the two-dimensional layered nano material can be controlled by controlling the power of the femtosecond laser, so that the MXene quantum dots with good photoelectric properties can be obtained.

title_en: Zinc oxide-porous silicon composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a zinc oxide-porous silicon composite material and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: preparation of porous silicon: preparing a porous silicon structure on a monocrystalline silicon substrate by using an electrochemical anodic etching method; preparation of zinc oxide sol: preparing a sol capable of providing zinc ions; preparing a composite material: compounding a nano zinc oxide material on the surface of the porous silicon by utilizing a vacuum filtration and glue homogenizing method, and forming a zinc oxide-coated porous silicon/zinc oxide composite material, namely a zinc oxide-porous silicon composite material after heat treatment. The nano zinc oxide layer on the surface of the porous silicon is utilized to realize passivation on the surface of the porous silicon, the synergistic effect of the pseudocapacitance characteristic of the zinc oxide and the double electric layer characteristic of the porous silicon is utilized to greatly improve the capacitance characteristic, the charge-discharge characteristic and the electrochemical stability of the porous silicon, the problem of active chemical characteristics of the surface of the porous silicon is solved, and the application prospect of the porous silicon in the related fields of luminescent materials, devices and the like is widened.

title_en: Wafer low-temperature bonding method in vacuum environment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a wafer low-temperature bonding method in a vacuum environment, which comprises the following steps: step 1, exposing bonding interfaces corresponding to a first wafer and a second wafer in a vacuum environment of a vacuum chamber; step 2, activating the bonding interfaces corresponding to the first wafer and the second wafer by using the plasma of the working gas; step 3, closing the plasma source, and stopping introducing the working gas into the vacuum chamber so that the vacuum chamber can reach a required vacuum state; step 4, after the bonding interface of the first wafer and the bonding interface of the second wafer are attached and contacted for the required time, the first wafer and the second wafer can be bonded and fixed; and 5, opening the bonding fixture and taking out the first wafer and the second wafer after bonding connection. The invention adopts the method of physical bombardment activation of the surface of the wafer by surface plasma to promote the formation of dangling bonds on the surface of the wafer, thereby realizing the direct bonding of the wafer at low temperature even normal temperature in a vacuum environment.

title_en: Nano rod-shaped vanadium tetrasulfide powder and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing nano rod-shaped vanadium tetrasulfide powder, which comprises the following steps: (1) taking thioacetamide to dissolve in absolute ethyl alcohol, and stirring until the thioacetamide is completely dissolved to obtain a mixture A; (2) adding ammonium metavanadate into the mixture A, and stirring until the ammonium metavanadate is completely dissolved to obtain a mixture B; (3) dripping dilute hydrochloric acid into the mixture B under the stirring condition to form a transparent solution, so as to obtain a mixture C; (4) transferring the mixture C into a hydrothermal reaction kettle, and carrying out hydrothermal reaction for 24-25 h; (5) naturally cooling after the reaction is finished, centrifugally washing for a plurality of times, and drying in vacuum to obtain the nano rod-shaped vanadium tetrasulfide powder. The nano rod-shaped vanadium tetrasulfide prepared by the method has the advantages of higher specific capacity, excellent cycling stability, long service life and higher conductivity.

title_en: MEMS actuation system and method
abstract_en: A microelectromechanical systems (MEMS) device includes one or more slidable connection assemblies for releasably connecting the microelectromechanical systems (MEMS) device to a wafer from which the microelectromechanical systems (MEMS) device is fabricated.

title_en: GaN planar Gunn diode based on composite heat dissipation anode and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a GaN planar Gunn diode based on a composite heat dissipation anode and a preparation method thereof, wherein the planar Gunn diode comprises the following components: an AlGaN back barrier layer; a GaN channel layer on the AlGaN back barrier layer; an AlGaN barrier layer on the GaN channel layer; the ohmic contact anode and the ohmic contact cathode are respectively positioned at two ends of the AlGaN back barrier layer, the GaN channel layer and the AlGaN barrier layer; and the Schottky extension layer is positioned on the AlGaN barrier layer and covers the ohmic contact anode. The schottky extension layer of the planar gunn diode forms a depletion layer in the channel of the planar gunn diode, weakens the strength of a high-energy dipole domain, thereby dispersing the energy of an electron domain, reducing the impact ionization at the anode end of the planar gunn diode, buffering heat generation, further effectively inhibiting the self-heating effect of the device, and improving the negative resistance effect, power and frequency of the device.

title_en: Preparation method of flexible self-supporting silicon/ultra-long titanium dioxide nanotube electrode
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a flexible self-supporting silicon/ultra-long titanium dioxide nanotube electrode, belonging to the technical field of materials. The technical scheme is as follows: pouring the silicon spheres with the outer layer coated with the organic matters and the ultra-long titanate nanotubes into an absolute ethyl alcohol solution, ultrasonically mixing uniformly, obtaining a flexible self-supporting film through suction filtration or spin coating, and finally carbonizing to obtain the flexible self-supporting silicon/ultra-long titanium dioxide nanotube electrode. The invention has the beneficial effects that: realizes the preparation of the silicon nano-particles in TiO 2 Uniform dispersion in three-dimensional pores of nanotubes using TiO 2 The excellent mechanical property effectively relieves the stress change caused by the volume expansion of silicon, and TiO is utilized 2 The higher lithium intercalation potential can help to form a stable solid electrolyte interface film around the silicon spheres, and the problems of large height change of the whole electrode and unstable SEI film are solved.

title_en: Chlorophyll carbon dot, preparation method thereof and application thereof in time detection label
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of nano materials, and discloses a chlorophyll carbon dot, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in a time detection label. The preparation method comprises the following steps: cleaning spinach, picking off leaves, cutting 500g of spinach leaves into small blocks by using scissors, and soaking the small blocks in a mixed solution of ethanol and acetone with the volume ratio of 1:1 for extraction; filtering the obtained extractive solution with filter paper, rotary steaming at 50 deg.C to obtain 100mL concentrated chlorophyll solution, and freeze drying to obtain chlorophyll solid powder; weighing 0.1g of chlorophyll solid powder, and dissolving the chlorophyll solid powder in a PEI aqueous solution for reaction; the reacted solution was filtered through a 0.22 μ M microporous membrane and then dialyzed through a 3500 molecular weight dialysis bag for one day to obtain a purified chlorophyll carbon dot solution. The raw materials provided by the invention are easy to obtain, the preparation method is simple, green and environment-friendly, and the applicability is strong. Has better application prospect in the aspect of time detection.

title_en: Vacuum interconnection system for preparing nano powder and realizing in-situ ultrahigh pressure forming
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high vacuum interconnection device for realizing nano powder preparation and in-situ ultrahigh pressure forming, which comprises a sample transfer chamber, a powder preparation chamber, a first pressure chamber, a second pressure chamber, a vacuum interconnection pipeline, a vacuumizing device system, a plurality of transfer rods, a powder collection device and a sample transfer device. The system can pump each chamber to a high vacuum state by using a vacuum pumping device, collect nano powder in the powder making chamber by using a powder collecting device, transfer the powder to a pressure first chamber by using a transfer rod to be pressed into a sheet shape, and then transfer the sheet to a pressure second chamber by using a sample transfer device to be subjected to ultrahigh pressure forming. The invention realizes the in-situ ultrahigh pressure compression molding of the nano powder under the high vacuum condition, and avoids the problems of various pollution and oxidation of the nano powder in the traditional compression molding process.

title_en: Production process of secondary zinc oxide, zinc sulfate and nano zinc oxide
abstract_en: The invention provides a production process of zinc hypoxide, zinc sulfate and nano zinc oxide, belonging to the technical field of zinc oxide preparation, wherein the production process of the zinc hypoxide adopts a mixture of household garbage and a zinc-containing solid material as a raw material to carry out drying roasting in a rotary kiln; the production process of the zinc sulfate is characterized in that the zinc suboxide obtained by the production process of the zinc suboxide is produced; the production process of the nano zinc oxide is characterized in that the zinc sulfate solution prepared by the zinc sulfate production process is used for production. According to the invention, the domestic garbage is adopted to replace anthracite to produce the zinc hypoxide, so that not only are coal resources saved and the production cost reduced, but also the domestic garbage can be recycled, thereby achieving the effect of environmental management.

title_en: Porous spherical lithium iron phosphide ion battery cathode material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The porous spherical lithium iron phosphide ion battery cathode material is micro-nano particles with uniform size of 100-800 nm, wherein the ferrophosphorus is hexagonal phase Fe 2 P, which has a porous spherical structure and is surrounded by a carbon coating layer; the invention adopts a primary solvothermal method and a primary hydrothermal method to obtain a precursor, and then the precursor is roasted in a reducing atmosphere to obtain a porous spherical lithium iron phosphide ion battery cathode material; according to the porous spherical lithium iron phosphide ion battery cathode material, the porous spherical framework and the carbon coating layer are both beneficial to relieving volume expansion in the charge-discharge cycle process, so that the conductivity of the material is improved; the assembled lithium ion battery has good rate performance, good cycle stability and high ion transmission efficiency; the method has the advantages of simple operation, low cost and strong controllability.

title_en: Silver-molybdenum sulfide dimer colloid motor and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a silver-molybdenum sulfide dimer colloid motor and a preparation method thereof. The motor is formed by attaching silver nanoparticles on spherical molybdenum sulfide particles; wherein, the particle size of the spherical molybdenum sulfide particle is 130-280nm, the spherical molybdenum sulfide particle is composed of molybdenum sulfide nanosheets, and the particle size of the silver nanoparticle is 20-80 nm; the method comprises the steps of sequentially dispersing ammonium molybdate, thiourea and polyvinylpyrrolidone in deionized water, performing ultrasonic treatment, performing airtight reaction at 220 ℃ under 180 ℃ and then performing centrifugal cleaning on the obtained clear mixed solution, dispersing the obtained spherical molybdenum sulfide particles in the deionized water, stirring the spherical molybdenum sulfide particle dispersion liquid, the deionized water and the tris (hydroxymethyl) aminomethane, quickly injecting a silver nitrate solution into the mixture, continuously stirring, and finally performing solid-liquid separation on the obtained intermediate product to obtain the target product. The method has wide application range and small pushing force, and is very easy to be widely applied to the fields of medicine transportation, environmental purification, ion detection and the like in a commercialized way.

title_en: Metal chelating polystyrene nanosphere and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of high molecular polymers, and discloses a metal chelating polystyrene nanosphere and a preparation method and application thereof. The method comprises the following steps: 1) preparing carboxylated polystyrene nanospheres; 2) carboxyl activation is carried out on the carboxylated polystyrene nanosphere, and then a metal chelating agent is added for reaction to obtain a chelating agent modified nanosphere; reacting the nanospheres modified by the chelating agent with metal salt to obtain metal-chelated polystyrene nanospheres; the metal salt is water-soluble metal salt, and specifically comprises more than one of copper salt, zinc salt, cobalt salt or nickel salt. The method is simple, and the prepared metal chelating polystyrene nanosphere has large specific surface area and uniform particle size of about 100 nm; and the metal chelating polystyrene nanospheres can quickly separate and purify target protein from a complex biological system, and the separated target protein has high purity and large quantity. The metal chelating polystyrene nanosphere is used in the field of protein separation and purification.

title_en: Composite conductive film based on silver nanowires and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The silver nano conductive film protected by the ammonium tungstate comprises a silver nanowire layer and an ammonium tungstate layer, and is prepared by coating a silver nanowire film with the thickness of 100-400 nm on a substrate, and spraying an ammonium tungstate layer with the thickness of 10-100 nm on the surface of the silver nanowire film; the preparation temperature is low, the substrate is not selected, and the silver nanowire transparent conductive film can be prepared on various rigid and flexible substrates. The ammonium tungstate protective layer can increase the adhesive force and the scratch resistance of the film, prolong the service life of the conductive film, improve the conductive stability, improve the conductive performance, and ensure that the prepared conductive film has good uniformity, the light transmittance reaches 84-88%, and the square resistance is as low as 6-12 omega/□; when the buffer layer is used for preparing an organic thin film solar cell, the buffer layer can be directly used, and energy level matching can be realized without adding an additional buffer layer.

title_en: Lithium-sulfur battery positive electrode material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lithium-sulfur battery positive electrode material and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: providing a metal-organic framework material; dissolving a metal-organic framework material, a sulfur source and a polymer in a solvent, stirring for 1-12 h, and controlling the temperature at 0-30 ℃ to obtain a spinning solution; performing electrostatic spinning on the spinning solution to obtain a polymer/metal organic framework film; sequentially carrying out pre-oxidation, carbonization and acid solution treatment on the film to obtain sulfur and nitrogen co-doped porous carbon nanofiber; and mixing the porous carbon nanofiber and sulfur powder, and heating and preserving heat for 1-12 h in an inert atmosphere to obtain the lithium-sulfur battery positive electrode material. The sulfur and nitrogen co-doped porous carbon nanofiber prepared by the preparation method has a large specific surface area and a rich pore structure. After sulfur is loaded, the lithium sulfur battery anode is used as the anode of the lithium sulfur battery, so that the conductivity of a sulfur electrode is improved, the influence caused by volume expansion of sulfur is relieved, and the shuttle effect of sulfur can be effectively inhibited.

title_en: Room temperature preparation method of nano metal powder and conductive ink thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a room temperature preparation method of nano metal powder and conductive ink thereof, wherein the room temperature preparation method of the nano metal powder comprises the following steps: and injecting the solution B into the solution A at room temperature under an ultrasonic state to obtain a mixed solution, adding a washing solvent into the mixed solution, washing by centrifuging, and obtaining a precipitate which is nano metal powder after washing. The preparation method of the conductive ink by using the nano metal powder comprises the following steps: compared with the prior art, the nano metal conductive ink has the advantages that the particle size of the nano metal powder prepared by the method is 5-20nm, the nano metal conductive ink has high oxidation resistance, the nano metal powder is not oxidized after being stored in the air for more than one year, and the large-scale production can be realized at room temperature; the conductive ink has high conductivity, the resistivity of an electronic device after infrared sintering in the air is only 2-8 times that of the traditional gold and silver wires or about 20 times that of copper wires, and the resistivity can be kept unchanged after the conductive ink is placed in the air for a long time.

title_en: Nano crystal of supermolecule organic framework material based on dimeric tertiary alcohol and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dimeric tertiary alcohol-based nanocrystal of a supramolecular organic framework material, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the field of porous organic framework materials. The preparation method adopts a re-precipitation method to dissolve dimeric tertiary alcohol molecules in trichloromethane (CHCl) 3 ) Adding the organic nano-crystalline into a good solvent, quickly adding the organic nano-crystalline into poor solvent ethanol, and quickly stirring to promote the generation of the organic nano-crystalline material. The invention adopts a classic reprecipitation method, and has simple operation and low cost. The prepared nano tube has regular structural appearance and uniform size, realizes a macroporous-microporous hierarchical pore structure, and successfully loads Fe 3+ . The iron ion loading of the nanotubes can be observed by corresponding characterization means such as X-ray energy spectrum analysis (EDS). The potential application of the supramolecular organic framework material in the fields of ion recognition, catalysis and the like in the future is shown.

title_en: Method for controlling preparation of Prussian blue nano-particles through double-injection reaction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing Prussian blue nano-particles (PBNPs) by controlling double-injection reaction, which is based on the traditional preparation of Prussian blue nano-particlesLiquid phase precipitation of the granules by adjusting the mixture solution (Fe) of ferric chloride and citric acid  3+  CA) and simultaneously dripping the residual mixed solution and the potassium ferrocyanide solution into the reaction system at a constant speed (namely double injection), so that the size and the crystallinity of the obtained product are widely and accurately controlled. In addition, the method can effectively regulate and control the enzymatic activity of the prussian blue nano-particles as peroxidase-like enzyme (POD), and broadens the application prospect of the prussian blue nano-enzyme in the field of catalysis. Meanwhile, the preparation method has low toxicity, low cost and simple and convenient operation, and effectively overcomes some defects in the conventional Prussian blue nanoparticle size regulation method.

title_en: Preparation and application of folium artemisiae argyi carbon quantum dots (nanoparticles/nanoparticles)
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for extracting, separating and purifying quantum dots (nano particles/nano particles) from folium artemisiae argyi charcoal, which comprises the following steps: the folium artemisiae argyi charcoal is extracted or extracted by a solvent, and dialyzed by a dialysis bag with the molecular weight of more than 1000Da or ultrafiltered to obtain folium artemisiae argyi charcoal quantum dots, wherein the quantum dots are blue fluorescence under an ultraviolet lamp of 365nm, have the particle size of less than 100nm measured by a transmission electron microscope and mainly comprise C, H, O, N and other elements; the invention also relates to the application of the quantum dot in the field of medicine, which is used for resisting inflammation, improving the tolerance degree of the body to cold and the like after administration by injection, oral administration or external application and the like.

title_en: Two-dimensional MXene functionalized InxGa1-xN nano-pillar and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-dimensional MXene functionalized In  x Ga 1‑x  N nano-pillar, a preparation method and application thereof. The two-dimensional MXene functionalized In  x Ga 1‑x  N nano-pillar comprises a substrate, an MXene layer on the substrate and an In  x Ga 1‑x  N nano-pillar grown on the MXene layer, wherein x is more than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 1. The invention adopts two-dimensional MXene as the functional layer between the substrate and the In  x Ga 1‑x  N nano-pillar, not only widens the selection range of the substrate and reduces the cost, but also effectively reduces the interface impedance between the substrate and the nano-pillar, is beneficial to enhancing the carrier transport performance, greatly improves the photoelectric performance of the nano-pillar, simultaneously avoids the defect that the nano-pillar is easy to etch on the substrate, and improves the photoelectric stability of the nano-pillar. In a word, the two-dimensional MXene functionalized In  x Ga 1‑x  N nano-pillar has important application prospects In photoelectrolysis of water to prepare hydrogen, a photoelectric detector and a solar cell.

title_en: Ce-based amorphous alloy-based nanocomposite and preparation method thereof and application of nanocomposite in treatment of dye wastewater
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Ce-based amorphous alloy-based nanocomposite and a preparation method thereof and application of the Ce-based amorphous alloy-based nanocomposite in dye wastewater treatment. The nano composite material of the invention can be used in dark at normal temperature and normal pressure without adding any chemical (H) 2 O 2 PS/PMS or O 3 ) And under the condition of energy, the method has high-efficiency removal rate on the dye wastewater.

title_en: Preparation method of cobaltosic oxide nano material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of cobaltosic oxide nano material, which uses filter paper as a template to prepare porous flaky Co with special appearance through deposition, drying and sintering processes 3 O 4 The nano material has excellent electrochemical performance and has wide application prospect as a lithium ion battery cathode material. In the whole preparation process, the synthesis method is simple, easy to operate, easy to obtain raw materials, low in equipment investment and suitable for batch production.

title_en: Cobalt metaphosphate/nitrogen carbon oxygen reduction catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cobalt metaphosphate/nitrogen carbon oxygen reduction catalyst, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the field of catalyst materials. The catalyst is Co (PO) 3 ) 2 NC nanometer material, wherein NC is nitrogen-doped carbon material, and the method comprises the following steps: dropwise and slowly dropping ATMP water solution into methanol solution of cobalt nitrate, reacting for 15-120 minutes, centrifuging, washing, and drying to obtain precursor; calcining the precursor for 1-3 h at the temperature of 700-900 ℃ in the protective gas atmosphere to obtain the catalyst. The cobalt metaphosphate/carbon prepared by the method is formed by compactly and vertically crossing a plurality of ultrathin nanosheets, the thickness of the nanosheets is 20-50 nm, the length of the nanosheets is 0.5-2 mu m, a plurality of cobalt metaphosphate nanoparticles are loaded on the nanosheets, the size of the nanoparticles is about 10 nm, and the catalyst has high initial potential and half-wave potential, strong stability and strong methanol tolerance.

title_en: Single silver-palladium alloy nanowire electrode and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a single silver-palladium alloy nanowire electrode and a preparation method and application thereof. Moreover, the single silver-palladium alloy nanowire electrode prepared by the method is used for catalyzing methanol, the catalytic performance of the single nanowire can be observed from the perspective of the single nanowire, which is not possessed by most other methods, and the current density generated by the single silver-palladium alloy nanowire electrode prepared by the method is high. In addition, the single silver-palladium alloy nanowire electrode prepared by the invention has excellent catalytic performance, long-term stability, catalytic stability and carbon monoxide removal capability on methanol.

title_en: Vanadium pentoxide nanobelt and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of inorganic non-metal nano materials, in particular to a vanadium pentoxide nanobelt and a method thereof. The surface of the vanadium pentoxide nanoribbon is provided with a wrinkle structure, the width of the vanadium pentoxide nanoribbon is 20-50 nanometers, and the length of the vanadium pentoxide nanoribbon is 200-2000 nanometers. The preparation method comprises the following steps: soaking the alpha-V in water 2 O 5 And placing the powder particles in a dispersion medium, and carrying out ultrasonic-assisted stripping to obtain the vanadium pentoxide nanobelt with a folded structure.

title_en: Preparation method of flexible stress sensor based on composite multilayer conductive material
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a flexible stress sensor based on a composite multilayer conductive material, which comprises the following steps: s1), PEDOT: preparing a PSS cotton cloth fiber layer; s2), preparing conductive carbon cloth; s3), preparing a metal silver nanowire conductive film; s4), preparing a flexible stress sensor; by mixing PEDOT: the PSS cotton cloth fiber layer, the disordered conductive carbon cloth and the silver nanowire conductive film are packaged together; and from PEDOT: and respectively leading out a lead from the PSS cotton cloth fiber layer and the silver nanowire conductive film to obtain the flexible stress sensor. The silver nanowire, the conductive carbon cloth and the PEDOT of the invention are as follows: three different materials of PSS cotton cloth fibre electric conductivity match each other, make resistance variability abundanter, make between the layer contact node, have the gap that can press, make resistance variation range improve, have higher resistance change rate, have the sensing range and reach 70 kPa.

title_en: Thin single crystal flake silver powder synthesized by chemical method and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides thin single crystal flake silver powder synthesized by a chemical method and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of metal powder. The flake silver powder is triangular, elliptical or hexagonal, the size range of the flake diameter is 0.3-10 mu m, and the thickness of the flake silver powder is 20-100 nm. The preparation method comprises the following steps: adding inorganic salt into the silver salt aqueous solution, uniformly stirring, then adding high polymer, stirring and mixing, and finally adding ammonia water solution to prepare oxidation solution; preparing a crystal selective etching agent; stirring and mixing the obtained oxidizing solution and the obtained etching agent, dropwise adding a sodium hydroxide solution into the reaction solution to control the pH of the reaction solution, then adding a reducing agent for reaction, standing and precipitating after the reaction is finished, carrying out solid-liquid separation to obtain a precipitate, washing and drying the precipitate, and finally obtaining the thin monocrystal flake silver powder synthesized by a chemical method. The prepared silver flakes are high in purity, uniform in appearance and size, and simple in preparation process equipment.

title_en: Method for constructing oil-phase chiral colloidal semiconductor nanocrystal
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for constructing oil-phase chiral colloidal semiconductor nanocrystals, which comprises the following steps: dispersing the semiconductor nanocrystalline material in a nonpolar solvent to obtain a high-concentration colloidal solution; and dispersing chiral molecules in a nonpolar solvent to obtain a high-concentration chiral solution; dropwise adding the high-concentration colloidal solution into the high-concentration chiral solution to obtain an oil-phase chiral semiconductor colloidal solution; the invention selects the chiral nonpolar solvent, disperses the semiconductor nanocrystal into the solvent, and then generates the chiral colloidal semiconductor nanocrystal through the induction of the nonpolar solvent, thereby constructing the oil-soluble chiral colloidal semiconductor nanocrystal material with high optical activity.

title_en: Flexible electrode and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a flexible electrode, which comprises a flexible basal layer, and a polydopamine adhesive layer and a metal electrode layer which are sequentially laminated on the surface of the flexible basal layer, wherein the polydopamine adhesive layer is of a three-dimensional porous grid structure, the metal electrode layer is formed by intersecting metal nanowires, the polydopamine adhesive layer is connected with the hydroxylated flexible basal layer through covalent bonds, and metal atoms are chelated on the polydopamine adhesive layer at the interface of the polydopamine adhesive layer and the metal electrode layer. The adhesion between the metal electrode layer and the flexible basal layer is large, and the porous grid structure of the crossed metal nanowires and the dopamine adhesive layer reduces the electrical impedance of the flexible electrode to a great extent and improves the stretching function of the flexible electrode. The invention also provides a preparation method of the flexible electrode, which is simple and easy to operate.

title_en: Method for enhancing graphite phase carbon nitride defect state electrochemiluminescence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for enhancing graphite phase carbon nitride defect state electrochemiluminescence, which realizes local denitrification and recombination of common carbon nitride through high-temperature treatment so as to realize local graphitization; and then the strong oxidizing property of the concentrated nitric acid is utilized to destroy the formed local graphite structure, so that the graphite phase carbon nitride forms more surface defects. Compared with the common graphite phase carbon nitride material, the electrochemiluminescence activity of the graphite phase carbon nitride material obtained by the method is improved by 5-20 times, and the signal is more stable. Has better popularization value and application prospect.

title_en: Preparation method of nano-grade polymer electrolyte for flexible lithium battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a nanometer-level polymer electrolyte for a flexible lithium battery, which comprises the steps of synthesizing PS; PS-SO 2 The synthesis of Cl and the synthesis of PSTFSILi. The PSTFSILi prepared by the invention has high ionic conductivity, high thermal stability, best electrochemical stability and ideal chemical and mechanical properties, and can be used for flexible lithium batteries.

title_en: Method for removing manganese impurities in acidic solution by ozone
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of chemical demanganization, and particularly relates to a method for removing manganese impurities in an acidic solution by using ozone. The method comprises the following steps: and introducing ozone into the acidic solution to be subjected to manganese impurity removal for aeration, heating the aerated solution, and then filtering manganese dioxide precipitate to obtain the acidic solution subjected to manganese impurity removal. The method does not need to adjust the pH value of the solution, and Mn is aerated by introducing ozone under acidic conditions for aeration  2+  Direct oxidation to MnO  4   ‑  And then heated to accelerate peroxidation of the MnO  4   ‑  With the remainder of Mn  2+  After the neutralization reaction is carried out to generate manganese dioxide precipitate, the manganese impurities can be removed by filtering. The method can efficiently remove Mn under acidic conditions  2+  The process mainly relates to the energy consumption of the ozone generator, is far lower than the energy consumption of removing manganese impurities by concentration by a recrystallization method, is simple to operate, does not introduce new impurity metal elements, avoids secondary pollution, and is suitable for large-scale industrial production. The invention also relates to a preparation method of manganese dioxide.

title_en: Symmetrical thermoelectric MEMS microwave standing wave meter and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The symmetrical thermoelectric MEMS microwave standing wave meter of the invention forms a symmetrical directional coupler by symmetrically distributing signal lines of ACPS transmission lines at two ends on the upper and lower sides of a main transmission line, and respectively extracts incident and reflected microwave power to a coupling end and an isolation end of an upper branch and a lower branch; the tail ends of each CPW transmission line of the upper branch and the lower branch are respectively connected with a thermoelectric MEMS microwave power sensor to measure the microwave power of each port of the two branches, and the measured output hot voltage is averaged to obtain more accurate incident and reflected microwave power so as to obtain the size of the standing-wave ratio; if one branch stops working, the other branch can still work normally, namely the MEMS microwave standing wave meter can still measure, and the failure rate is reduced; the symmetrical thermoelectric MEMS microwave standing wave meter improves the reliability of the MEMS microwave standing wave meter, and adopts a fully passive structure, thereby having the characteristics of zero direct current power consumption and being compatible with a gallium arsenide monolithic microwave integrated circuit process.

title_en: Preparation method and application of polarization-sensitive and ultraviolet-erasure-resistant silver nanostructure
abstract_en: A preparation method and application of a polarization-sensitive and ultraviolet-erasure-resistant silver nanostructure relate to the technical field of holographic storage, solve the problem of requiring a light polarization-sensitive and ultraviolet-erasure-resistant silver/titanium dioxide film, and comprise the steps of preparing titanium dioxide precursor sol; preparing a titanium dioxide film on a glass substrate by adopting a dip-coating method, and sequentially performing aging and thermal annealing treatment to obtain an ordered mesoporous titanium dioxide film; preparing a silver nitrate solution, immersing the ordered mesoporous titanium dioxide film into the silver nitrate solution and irradiating by ultraviolet light, depositing silver nanoparticles on the ordered mesoporous titanium dioxide film to form silver cubes, and preparing the polarization-sensitive and ultraviolet-erasing-resistant silver nanostructure. The method avoids a complex chemical synthesis route, and obtains the silver nanostructure which is sensitive to polarization and resistant to ultraviolet erasure; the silver nanostructure prepared by the method has sensitive response to light polarization and has the characteristic of ultraviolet resistance and erasure resistance on the premise of not introducing other systems.

title_en: Formation of holes in a substrate
abstract_en: Methods for fabricating well-controlled solid-state nanopores and solid-state nanopore arrays are provided. In one aspect, methods for fabricating nanopores and nanopore arrays utilize physical seams. One or more etch pits are formed in the top side of the substrate, and one or more trenches aligned with the one or more etch pits are formed in the back side of the substrate. Forming an opening between the one or more etch pits and the one or more trenches. A dielectric material is then formed over the substrate to fill the opening. Contacts are then provided on the top side and the back side of the substrate, and a voltage is applied from the top side through the dielectric material to the back side, and vice versa, thereby forming nanopores. In another aspect, the nanopore is formed at or near the center of the opening at a seam formed in the dielectric material.

title_en: Integrated CMOS-MEMS device and method for fabricating the same
abstract_en: An integrated complementary metal oxide semiconductor-microelectromechanical system device includes a complementary metal oxide semiconductor structure, a cap structure, and a microelectromechanical system structure. The complementary metal oxide semiconductor structure is fabricated on the first substrate and includes at least one conductive layer. The cap structure includes a via through the cap structure and has an isolation layer deposited on a first side of the cap structure and has a conductive routing layer deposited on a second side of the cap structure. A microelectromechanical system structure is deposited between the first substrate and the cap structure. The integrated complementary metal oxide semiconductor-microelectromechanical systems device also includes a conductive connection that passes through one of the vias and through an opening in the isolation layer on the cap structure. The conductive connection electrically connects a conductive path in a conductive wiring layer on the cap structure with at least one conductive layer of the complementary metal oxide semiconductor structure.

title_en: Synthesis method of aromatic acid-assisted hydroxyapatite mesoporous nanorod
abstract_en: The invention relates to a synthesis method of an aromatic acid-assisted hydroxyapatite mesoporous nanorod, which comprises the following steps: (1) taking 20 parts of calcium salt-water-aromatic acid mixed solution; (2) Taking 20 parts of phosphorus source-sodium hydroxide-water-aromatic acid mixed solution; (3) Adding the mixed solution prepared in the step (2) into the reactor in the step (1), and carrying out reflux reaction for 1-4 hours; (4) Then heating the mixture obtained in the step (3) to 110-160 ℃, and carrying out hydrothermal reaction for 12-36 hours under autogenous pressure; (5) And standing the stock solution at room temperature, washing with water, washing with alcohol, centrifuging, and vacuum drying to obtain white powder which is mesoporous nano hydroxyapatite. The mesoporous nano hydroxyapatite obtained by the method has high purity and good crystallinity, and does not need a surfactant, a polymer and other templates.

title_en: Micromechanical device and method for producing a micromechanical device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a micromechanical device (1 a; 1 b; 1c) having a carrier substrate (2); a sensor device (3) which is arranged at the carrier substrate (2) at a distance from the surface section (4) of the carrier substrate (2) by means of a spring element (9) such that the sensor device (3) can vibrate relative to the surface section (4); and at least one stop element (51, 52) arranged at the surface section (4) of the sensor device (3) and/or the carrier substrate (2), which stop element limits a deflection of the sensor device (3) in the direction of the surface section (4).

title_en: Method for preparing efficient and stable composite nano-silver bacteriostatic agent by one-step method through lotus root extract
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of preparation of novel bacteriostatic agents, in particular to a preparation method of a biological-mediated composite nano-silver bacteriostatic agent. The method comprises the following steps: 1) cleaning lotus roots, slicing, and drying to constant weight to obtain dried lotus root slices; 2) crushing and grinding the dried lotus root slices into powder, mixing the powder with an extracting agent according to the mass ratio of 1: 1-100, performing 100-500W microwave treatment for 5-10min, heating, refluxing, centrifuging, taking supernatant, and placing the supernatant at 4 ℃ for later use; 3) weighing 0.1-3g of chitosan, adding the chitosan into 100mL of 1% glacial acid solution, and continuously stirring overnight to completely dissolve the chitosan for later use; 4) and adding the 1-10mL of chitosan solution into 30mL of double distilled water, adding a certain volume of silver nitrate solution, continuously stirring for 5min, then adding 0.1-10mL of lotus root extract, fixing the volume to 50mL, and heating and refluxing to obtain the composite nano-silver bacteriostatic agent. The invention fully exerts the synergistic bacteriostasis of the biological nano-silver and the chitosan, achieves obvious bacteriostasis effect, and the composite biological nano-silver preparation prepared by taking the chitosan as a carrier is more stable.

title_en: Quantum dot-embedded high-molecular fluorescent composite microsphere and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological medicines, relates to a high-molecular fluorescent composite microsphere, and a preparation method and application thereof, and particularly relates to a high-molecular composite microsphere which can be stably dispersed in a water phase and contains oil-soluble quantum dots, and a preparation method and application thereof. The microsphere containing the quantum dots adopts the amphiphilic polyarylether block copolymer as the quantum dot carrier, so that the stability of the quantum dots and the whole microsphere is improved, the risk of quantum dot leakage is reduced, and conditions are created for realizing the wide application of the quantum dots in the field of biomedicine. The microsphere can be applied to macrophage fluorescence imaging, and the phagocytosis capacity and the process of the macrophage can be more visually and scientifically evaluated dynamically.

title_en: Preparation method of high-performance ultra-fine grain molybdenum-lanthanum alloy
