abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a high-performance ultra-fine grain molybdenum-lanthanum alloy, which comprises the following steps: 1) spherical nano La 2 O 3 Preparing; 2) preparing molybdenum powder; 3) preparing mixed powder; 4) preparing a molybdenum alloy: after the mixed powder is weighted, SPS rapid sintering is carried out to obtain La 2 O 3 -Mo molybdenum alloy. The invention adopts a water bath method to prepare La 2 O 3 The second phase can achieve the purpose of controlling the size and appearance of the second phase by controlling the time length of the water bath and the cooling speed, thereby obtaining very fine spherical La 2 O 3 And the smaller the second phase particles are, the more uniform the second phase particles are, the easier the second phase particles enter the interior of the Mo alloy crystal grains, and the more obvious strengthening effect is achieved. Spherical La in the present invention 2 O 3 The strengthening effect is best, the possibility of microcrack generation is low due to the small stress concentration tendency, the fracture strength can be further improved, cracks deviate from the original main expansion direction to form dislocation loops, and therefore the tensile strength of the yield strength is improved.

title_en: Method for preparing nano zinc oxide by liquid cathode glow discharge plasma
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for preparing nano zinc oxide by utilizing liquid cathode glow discharge plasma, which takes a platinum needle point as an anode, takes liquid overflowing from the top end of a capillary tube as a cathode, and transmits electrolyte containing zinc nitrate to the top of the capillary tube under the drive of a peristaltic pump, and a graphite tube is connected with a power supply cathode. When enough high voltage is applied between the two electrodes, the electrolyte is excited by high-energy electrons to generate instant high temperature and local high pressure and accompanied with the phenomena of luminescence, heating and the like, plasma is generated at the same time, the generated turbid liquid flows into a collector along the groove of the graphite tube, centrifugal separation is carried out, distilled water is washed, vacuum drying is carried out until the weight is constant, and grinding is carried out, so that the milky-white nano ZnO particles are obtained. The preparation method has the advantages of simple equipment, easy operation, mild conditions, controllable process, no need of solvent, good shape of the synthesized nano ZnO, high product purity, no pollution, convenient separation of the product and the like; the liquid cathode glow discharge plasma is an environment-friendly new technology for preparing nano ZnO.

title_en: Preparation method and application of monatomic platinum-nitrogen-doped graphite foil self-supporting hydrogen evolution electrode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a monatomic platinum-aza graphite foil self-supporting hydrogen evolution electrode, which solve the problem that monatomic platinum catalyst in the prior art is difficult to keep high activity and stability under high current density because the monatomic platinum catalyst is usually powder and needs to be loaded on a working electrode by using a binder. The invention comprises the following steps: (S1) ultrasonically cleaning and drying the graphite foil; (S2) bombarding the dried graphite foil with nitrogen plasma to obtain a nitrogen-doped graphite foil; (S3) using a photoreduction method to load the monatomic platinum on the aza-graphite foil, thereby obtaining the monatomic platinum-aza-graphite foil self-supporting hydrogen evolution electrode. The invention obtains the platinum monoatomic-aza-graphite foil self-supporting hydrogen evolution electrode in a simple and environment-friendly way, realizes the regulation and control of the surface appearance and the doping elements of the substrate in one step, obtains the self-supporting hydrogen evolution electrode suitable for high current density, provides a good preposed foundation for the research of obtaining hydrogen energy by electrolyzing water, and is suitable for popularization and application.

title_en: Preparation and application of electrode containing tin array structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of an electrode with a high-performance tin-containing array structure for a sodium ion battery, which comprises the following steps: taking a cleaned copper substrate as a working electrode, taking a solution containing tin ions and a template agent as an electrolyte, and adopting a three-electrode system to perform constant-current electrodeposition so as to form a tin array structure on the surface of the copper substrate; and annealing the substrate subjected to the treatment in vacuum or non-oxidizing gas at the temperature of 80-230 ℃ to obtain the electrode with the tin-containing array structure. The preparation method has simple process and convenient operation, and the prepared electrode can be directly used for the cathode of the sodium-ion battery and shows higher specific capacity, good cycling stability and excellent rate charge-discharge characteristics.

title_en: Plant micro-mechanics detection device and detection method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a plant micro-mechanics detection device and a detection method thereof, wherein the device generates nanometer-level high-precision micro-displacement through a piezoelectric driver, so that the device is suitable for the research of micro-scale samples; performing compression and tension experiments on the micro-scale sample through two detachable sample clamping frames; obtaining stress information of the sample through a force sensor; the device main body is placed under a stereoscopic microscope, and the change condition of the microstructure is synchronously obtained in the test through a camera, so that real-time visual detection is realized; the device has high overall measurement precision, simple operation and accurate control, and provides a detection device with excellent performance for the exploration of micromechanics.

title_en: Image sensor and imaging method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses an image sensor, which comprises: the pixel sensor array and the F-P cavity reflection type filtering structure are positioned at the front end of the pixel sensor array; the F-P cavity reflection type optical filtering structure comprises a bottom layer reflecting mirror, an F-P cavity and a top layer reflecting mirror; the structure of the image sensor sequentially comprises a pixel sensor array, a bottom reflector, an F-P cavity and a top reflector from bottom to top; the structural properties and parameters of the F-P cavity reflective optical filtering structure can be adjusted. In addition, the embodiment of the invention also discloses a high dynamic range image imaging method. By adopting the image sensor and the imaging method, the problem of underexposure or overexposure of each wave band in the imaging process is solved, and the pixel utilization rate and the dynamic range of the photographed image are improved.

title_en: Preparation method of anhydrous iron phosphate nanoparticles
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of anhydrous iron phosphate nanoparticles, and belongs to the technical field of inorganic synthesis. The preparation method comprises the following steps: adding iron powder into phosphoric acid solution, heating to about 40 ℃, preserving heat, adding an oxidant, continuously preserving heat, and filtering to obtain a tan filtrate; adding an oxidant into the filtrate, and stirring at normal temperature; then filtering, washing and drying to obtain light yellow powder; and (3) treating the powder at a high temperature of 500-700 ℃ to obtain the anhydrous ferric phosphate nano-particles. In the preparation method, the oxidation of ferrous ions is finished at normal temperature, and the iron phosphate does not need to be crystallized and aged, so that the cost for preparing the iron phosphate is further reduced. In addition, the anhydrous ferric phosphate obtained by the preparation method is a micron secondary structure formed by agglomeration of nano particles, and the lithium iron phosphate obtained by lithiation of the anhydrous ferric phosphate with the morphology has large capacity and high compaction density.

title_en: Preparation method of cobalt tungstate/tungsten disulfide zinc air battery catalyst
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a cobalt tungstate/tungsten disulfide zinc air battery catalyst, which comprises a step A of preparing a solution: adding cobalt nitrate hexahydrate into methanol, and stirring to obtain a mixed solution; adding phosphotungstic acid into the mixed solution, and stirring vigorously at room temperature to obtain a solution A. Also includes preparing solution B: adding 2-methylimidazole into methanol, and stirring to dissolve to obtain a solution B. And adding the solution B into the solution A, washing the precipitate after reaction by using anhydrous methanol, and drying to obtain a precursor. Modifying the precursor with sulfur, and then calcining to obtain the catalyst. The electro-catalysis performance of the catalyst is high and stable.

title_en: Method for preparing variable-diameter nano structure
abstract_en: A method of making a variable diameter nanostructure, comprising the steps of: (1) performing a surface cleaning treatment on a substrate; (2) Spin-coating the substrate with resists having different sensitivities to form at least 2 resist layers, wherein the resist layers of adjacent layers have different sensitivities; (3) Performing pattern exposure, development and fixation on the substrate with the resist layer in the step (2) to form the resist layer with a pattern structure; (4) And (3) carrying out film deposition on the resist layer with the pattern structure formed in the step (3), and then removing the resist layer. The variable-diameter three-dimensional nano structure prepared by the method can contain any pattern and size which can be exposed, can be solid, can be hollow and can be formed by a plurality of materials which can be realized by atomic layer deposition. The variable-diameter three-dimensional nano structure prepared by the invention can be used in the fields of metamaterial surfaces, superlenses, photoelectric devices, sensors and the like.

title_en: Direct detector based on gallium oxide solar blind ultraviolet polarized light and polarization imaging device
abstract_en: A direct detector based on gallium oxide solar blind ultraviolet polarized light, a preparation method thereof and a polarization imaging device are provided, wherein the direct detector comprises an IC socket table board, and IC socket pins are arranged on the IC socket table board; a silicon wafer which is provided on the IC socket mesa and on which a silicon dioxide layer is attached; and the source electrode, the drain electrode and the semiconductor layer are all arranged on the silicon dioxide layer of the silicon chip, the semiconductor layer is positioned between the source electrode and the drain electrode, and the source electrode and the drain electrode are respectively connected with the pins of the IC socket through leads. The solar dead zone ultraviolet polarized light direct imaging based on the wide-bandgap semiconductor gallium oxide provided by the invention has the pixel of the nano-scale nanobelt and the photoresponse time of the gallium oxide in microsecond level, and can realize a high-resolution and quick scanning target.

title_en: Use of multifunctional ligands for improving performance and stability of quantum dot inks
abstract_en: The present invention provides nanostructured compositions and methods of making nanostructured compositions. The nanostructure composition comprises a population of nanostructures comprising a multifunctional poly (alkylene oxide) ligand. The present invention also provides a nanostructured film comprising the nanostructured composition and a method of making a nanostructured film using the nanostructured composition.

title_en: Large-particle titanium silicalite molecular sieve with excellent diffusivity performance and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a large-particle titanium silicalite molecular sieve TS-1 with excellent diffusivity, wherein the molecular sieve is cuboid in shape, and the longest side of the molecular sieve is 4-20 microns; the interior is a large number of spherical cavities with the diameter of 70-100 nm. The invention also provides a preparation method of the molecular sieve, carbonate is used as a hard template of a cavity structure, tetrapropylammonium bromide is used as a microporous template agent, and the molecular sieve is prepared by an acid treatment method. The hole structure of the molecular sieve prepared by the invention is more beneficial to the diffusion of larger molecules, so that the limitation of inherent microporous pore channels of the TS-1 molecular sieve on catalytic reaction is overcome, and the acid treatment can remove non-framework titanium and inhibit the removal of framework titanium. Therefore, compared with the conventional micropore TS-1, the titanium silicalite molecular sieve provided by the invention has higher catalytic activity for selective oxidation reaction of larger molecules and better stability for selective oxidation reaction of smaller molecules.

title_en: Miniature molecular optical tweezers based on graphene
abstract_en: A graphene-based micro-molecular optical tweezer, comprising: the light source converging unit is arranged above the molecular trapping unit and converges light incident from the outside to the solution pool of the molecular trapping unit below, the solution pool of the molecular trapping unit is internally provided with a molecular solution to be detected, the trapping unit is integrated with a microfluidic control, and the sample is convenient to use. The invention has the advantages that the high focusing of the light source is realized by utilizing the excellent photoelectric characteristic of the graphene, the nanoscale limitation of the light energy is realized by utilizing the local surface plasma optical effect of the graphene nanostructure, the trapping and the intrinsic resonance excitation of molecules are realized, the GHz intrinsic vibration of the molecules can be induced, and the measurement is performed by utilizing the radio frequency probe; through the graphene nano-electrode, high-frequency electromagnetic waves are externally added, the electromagnetic waves are guided to the molecule trapping point, interaction between the external high-frequency electromagnetic waves and molecules is realized, the vibration characteristics of the molecules are changed by utilizing the electromagnetic waves, and the biological characteristics of the molecules are changed.

title_en: Preparation of nitrogen-doped nanosheets or Fe-loaded nanoparticles 2 O 3 Method for graphite structure of nano-particles
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide an N-doped nano-sheet graphite structure or a surface loaded Fe  2  O  3  A process for preparing N-doped nano-sheet graphite structure of nanoparticles includes such steps as high-temp plasma arc evaporation to obtain high-purity graphite rod as cathode and high-purity Fe powder and high-purity graphite powder as anode, vacuumizing the arc furnace, introducing acetonitrile as carbon and nitrogen sources, and collecting the deposit on the inner surface of reaction cavity to obtain the folded N-doped nano-sheet graphite or uniformly dispersing Fe on it  2  O  3  A nanoparticle composite. The products can be prepared in a large scale by a simple and harmless high-temperature plasma arc evaporation method without any reaction gas, the nano-sheet graphite is disordered and full of a large number of defects due to the doping of the N element, and the nano-sheet graphite is induced to generate new performance, so that the nano-sheet graphite can be widely applied to various fields such as wave absorption and the like.

title_en: MnO of sandwich structure 2 @rGO@MnO 2 Composite nano sheet material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a MnO with a sandwich structure  2  @rGO@MnO  2  Composite nano sheet material, a preparation method thereof and a zinc ion battery belong to the technical field of batteries. MnO of the sandwich structure of the present invention  2  @rGO@MnO  2  The preparation method of the composite nano sheet material comprises the following steps: mixing graphene oxide, resorcinol and formaldehyde for reaction for 30-160min; adding oxalic acid, and reacting for 200-260min; separating solid from liquid, drying the solid, and carbonizing at 700-850 deg.C for 2-5 hr. The preparation method of the invention adopts the prepared composite material to react with potassium permanganate, and can be used as a zinc ion battery anode material. The method has simple process and low cost, and is suitable for large-scale production.

title_en: Preparation method of copper-loaded ternary nanobelt cathode material, product and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a copper-loaded ternary nanoribbon cathode material, a product and application thereof. Copper can improve the conductivity of the material, and the structure has a large specific surface area and can be fully contacted with electrolyte, so that the electrochemical performance of the material can be improved. The first discharge specific capacity is about 174 mAh/g under the multiplying power of 1C, and the discharge specific capacity is 138 mAh/g after 50 times of circulation. And the preparation method is simple, the process conditions are easy to realize, the energy consumption is low, and the preparation is pollution-free.

title_en: Preparation method of mildew-proof and moth-proof treating agent for rattan-woven furniture product
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for preparing mildew-proof and moth-proof treating agent for rattan furniture product, which takes n-butyl titanate and nano calcium carbonate powder as raw materials to prepare nano-scale multi-metal oxide crystal with the grain diameter between 15 and 18 nanometers, consists of two layers of titanium-oxygen octahedrons and one layer of calcium-oxygen octahedron structure, can be deposited in the cell cavity of the rattan furniture product, the invention develops the long-acting and lasting mildew and moth proofing treating agent by combining the nanotechnology and the plant components, the coating can not fall off after being attached to cell walls, belongs to a non-dissolution type preparation, does not decompose, can effectively inhibit the growth of microorganisms for a long time, prevents the metabolic reproduction activity of the microorganisms, has excellent mildew and moth prevention external functions and moisture resistance, does not influence the color, luster and hand feeling of the rattan woven material, and the method is efficient, nontoxic and environment-friendly, reduces the industrial production cost, and meets the requirements of people on the comfort and durability of the rattan woven product.

title_en: Method and device for improving signal-to-noise ratio of silicon nanowire sensor by utilizing optical modulation
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for improving the signal-to-noise ratio of a silicon nanowire sensor by utilizing optical modulation. The method comprises the steps of determining an optical excitation signal of the silicon nanowire sensor based on a carrier signal; acquiring a modulation signal of the silicon nanowire sensor to the measured object based on the optical excitation signal; and processing the carrier signal and the modulation signal by using a phase-locked amplifier to obtain a target response signal of the silicon nanowire sensor to the measured object. The method utilizes the phase-locked amplifier to transfer the signal frequency spectrum of the target object response signal of the silicon nanowire sensor to the frequency of the carrier signal, and then amplifies the signal frequency spectrum to avoid the interference of the noise of the silicon nanowire sensor. The signal-to-noise ratio of the silicon nanowire sensor can be greatly improved, and the anti-interference capability of the sensor is enhanced.

title_en: Fibrous Ti 3 C 2 MXene-based torsion angle sensor and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fibrous Ti  3  C  2  MXene-based torsion angle sensor and preparation method thereof. The sensor is made of Ti  3  C  2  The nano sheet is used as a strain sensitive material, and is assembled on the framework of the foam fiber, and the flexible polymer is used as a substrate for providing large deformation, so that the sensor with the torsional response characteristic is prepared. The fibrous torsion angle sensor can provide corresponding torsion angle values under different rotating speeds through real-time monitoring of electric signals under torsion deformation, has the characteristics of easy preparation, stable performance and repeated use in a circulating manner, and is characterized by novel two-dimensional nano material Ti  3  C  2  Has good conductivity and convenient synthesis, and can be directly deposited on the surface of the skeleton of the porous fiber in a self-assembly mode of immersion adsorption to obtain the Ti-based material  3  C  2  Flexible porous conductive fibers having a torsional angle response; the structure of the sensor is improved, the performance of the sensor is improved, the sensitivity is good, and the damage resistance is improved.

title_en: Method for manufacturing micro-electromechanical pump
abstract_en: A method of fabricating a microelectromechanical pump, comprising the steps of: providing a first substrate, wherein the first substrate is provided with a first surface and a second surface; forming a first oxide layer on the first substrate and forming an inflow hole; etching the first oxide layer to form a confluence chamber and a confluence channel; providing a second substrate, wherein the second substrate is provided with a third surface and a fourth surface; etching the third surface of the second substrate to form a through hole; etching through the through hole of the second substrate to form a vibration chamber in the second substrate; bonding a second substrate to the first substrate, wherein a third surface of the second substrate is attached to the first oxide layer; thinning the fourth surface of the second substrate to form a thinned surface opposite to the third surface; and stacking the piezoelectric element on the thinning surface.

title_en: Preparation method of platinum-cobalt alloy catalyst
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of new energy materials and application, and particularly relates to a preparation method of a platinum-cobalt alloy catalyst. The preparation method of the platinum-cobalt alloy catalyst comprises the following steps: preparing a catalyst precursor, reducing the precursor at high temperature, alloying the catalyst at high temperature, pickling the catalyst and washing the catalyst with water. The invention takes pure water as solvent, which is safe and environment-friendly; when the precursor is reduced at high temperature, the reducing agent is carbon in platinum carbon, and other reducing agents are not required to be additionally added, so that the safety and environmental protection problems caused by using explosive and toxic reagents such as sodium borohydride or hydrazine hydrate are avoided; the gel is used as a platinum-cobalt alloy precursor to prepare a platinum-cobalt alloy metal reduction catalyst, so that the synchronous reduction of platinum and cobalt is ensured; sodium salt and chloride ions are not added, so that the difficulty of post-treatment of the product is reduced; the invention uses ammonia water to adjust the pH value of the system, and the post-treatment step is simple; transition metal cobalt is added into the platinum-carbon catalyst, so that the platinum loading capacity of the catalyst is reduced while the performance of the catalyst is improved.

title_en: Ag-Co film/nano-particle/film catalyst and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A catalyst of Ag-Co film/nano-particle/film is prepared through preparing worm-shaped Ag particles on one surface of Mo-Ag alloy film, sputtering depositing a layer of Ag-Co alloy film on the surface of worm-shaped Ag particles, sputtering depositing Ag-Co alloy film on the surface of polyimide substrate to make the polyimide substrate in a suspension state with an included angle of 5-10 deg. to substrate table, and sputtering Mo-Ag alloy film in thickness of 100-200nm and Ag content of 22-29at%. The catalyst provided by the invention has the advantages that vermicular Ag particles are prepared on the surface of the Mo-Ag alloy film, and then the Ag-Co alloy film is sputtered and deposited, so that the synergistic catalytic effect of the film, the particles and the film is formed, and the catalytic performance is greatly improved.

title_en: Preparation method of paraffin nanosheet
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a paraffin nanosheet, which comprises the steps of melting paraffin in a liquid solvent to form a liquid state, then carrying out ultrasonic dispersion on the liquid paraffin in the liquid solvent, and cooling to obtain a colloidal solution of the paraffin nanosheet. The invention has the advantages of simple preparation process, short treatment flow and less chemical reagents.

title_en: Preparation method and application of tubular tin dioxide and carbon-coated tubular tin dioxide nanocomposite
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a tubular tin dioxide and carbon-coated tubular tin dioxide nano composite material; firstly, preparing a nano-scale rod-shaped copper hydroxystannate precursor, preparing a tin dioxide nanotube by hydrothermal reaction in an acid solution, and then coating the tin dioxide nanotube with dopamine; the tubular tin dioxide nano material can be used as a gas sensor, and when the tubular tin dioxide nano material is applied to the gas sensor, the hollow structure of the tubular tin dioxide nano material is favorable for diffusion and transmission of gas molecules in a sensitive film, so that the tubular tin dioxide nano material has high sensitive response to organic volatile gas in the air. The carbon-coated tubular tin dioxide nanocomposite can be used as a negative active material of a lithium ion battery, and when the carbon-coated tubular tin dioxide nanocomposite is applied to the lithium ion battery, the volume effect of tin dioxide in the charge-discharge process can be well buffered, the conductivity of the negative material is improved, and the cycle stability and the rate capability of the lithium battery are improved.

title_en: Inhalation preparation of iso-glycyrrhizic acid or salt thereof and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of medicines, relates to an inhalation preparation of isoglycyrrhizic acid or salt thereof, and particularly relates to an inhalation preparation of magnesium isoglycyrrhizinate and application thereof in preparing a medicine for treating respiratory diseases.

title_en: Method for preparing titanium niobate by using titanate as precursor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing titanium niobate by taking titanate as a precursor, which comprises the steps of taking P25 and sodium hydroxide as raw materials and ethanol-water solution as a solvent, carrying out hydrothermal reaction, washing and drying to prepare a hydrogen-type titanate precursor, then carrying out secondary hydrothermal reaction on the obtained hydrogen-type titanate precursor and niobium pentachloride in ethanol solution of hydrochloric acid to prepare a titanium niobate precursor, and finally calcining the titanium niobate precursor in an inert gas environment at high temperature to prepare the titanium niobate. The method has the advantages of simple process, low cost and good repeatability, and the obtained titanium niobate has good electrochemical performance.

title_en: Silicon dioxide combined material, application and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a silicon dioxide composite material, application and a preparation method thereof, wherein the silicon dioxide composite material is prepared by mixing water with an auxiliary material A in a certain proportion to prepare a homogeneous solution M, adding the homogeneous solution M into gas phase nano silicon dioxide to obtain a primary raw material, kneading the primary raw material at a certain rotating speed to obtain a mixed material, judging the state of the material, adjusting the proportion according to the state of the material, and discharging the mixed material which accords with the state of the material. Under the action of external forces such as shearing, impact and the like, the mixture can generate intelligent mechanical response, the material is changed from a fluid state to a solid state, and the strength and the hardness are increased; when external forces such as shearing, impact and the like are removed, intelligent mechanical response can occur again, the material is changed from a solid state to a fluid state, and the strength and the hardness can be weakened; the preparation material can effectively absorb impact force, can be applied to the fields of intelligent shock absorption, intelligent impact prevention, intelligent protection and the like, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Method for preparing polydopamine nanosphere by using organic base
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for preparing polydopamine nanospheres by using organic base. According to the method, an organic alkali solution is added into a mixed solution of ethanol and water, then a dopamine hydrochloride solution is added, and constant-temperature reaction is carried out, so that the polydopamine nanosphere is prepared. The method disclosed by the invention is environment-friendly, energy-saving and environment-friendly, the process is simple, the reaction conditions are mild, and the obtained polydopamine nanospheres are uniform in size and good in dispersibility and can be well applied in the biological direction.

title_en: Nanomaterial Fe 3 O 4 @MSN-g-C 3 N 4 Application of BTA in preparation of Alzheimer's disease medicine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a nano material Fe  3  O  4  @MSN‑g‑C  3  N  4  -application of BTA in preparation of Alzheimer disease drugs. Compared with the traditional metal chelating agent, the magnetic nano composite material for targeting the Abeta plaque, provided by the invention, has the advantages of particle size of 30-50nm, pore size of 2-10nm, good magnetism, high stability, good biological safety, controllable photothermal effect and fluorescent and nuclear magnetic bimodal imaging functions. Can enhance the aggregation of the nano material at the target site when an external magnetic field is applied, promote the nano composite material to penetrate the blood brain barrier and finally be metabolized by cells to be absorbedAnd (4) discharging. The pre-formed A beta fibril is dissociated by the locally enhanced photothermal effect, the cells are protected from A beta induced neurotoxicity and apoptosis, the memory disorder of APP/PS1 mice is improved, and the method can be used for preparing the Alzheimer disease medicine.

title_en: Silicon oxide coated nanometer zero-valent iron particle and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses silicon oxide coated nanometer zero-valent iron particles and a preparation method and application thereof. The particles take nano zero-valent iron as a core and silicon oxide as a coating layer, and NaBH is added into a mixed solution of ferric salt and inorganic silicate in an inert gas atmosphere 4 Or KBH 4 The reducing agent is prepared by one-step reaction. The preparation method comprises the following steps: adding ferric salt into inorganic silicate solution, and stirring under inert gas atmosphere to obtain mixed solution; dropwise adding a reducing agent NaBH 4 Or KBH 4 Stirring the solution under the atmosphere of inert gas for reaction to obtain a precipitate, separating, cleaning and drying in vacuum to obtain the product. The silicon oxide coated nano zero-valent iron is prepared by a one-step simple liquid phase reduction method, the process is simple, the raw materials are cheap and easy to obtain, and the nano zero-valent iron is non-toxic and harmless, and the obtained novel nano zero-valent iron particles have good dispersibility, small and uniform average particle size and strong oxidation resistance and are suitable for treating organic wastewater.

title_en: Composite high-temperature proton exchange membrane for fuel cell and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of proton exchange membrane fuel cells, and particularly relates to a composite high-temperature proton exchange membrane for a fuel cell and a preparation method thereof. The raw materials comprise PBI, a compound A @ B and phosphoric acid, wherein A is a nanoparticle with a free radical quenching function;b is a nano-sheet structure C 3 N 4 (ii) a The mass fraction of the compound A @ B is 0.05-2wt.%, and the mass ratio of A to B in the compound A @ B is 1: 1-1: 20. Preparing a compound A @ B, ultrasonically dispersing the A @ B by using a strong-polarity aprotic solvent to obtain a dispersion liquid S1, obtaining a PBI solution S2 by using the PBI strong-polarity aprotic solvent, uniformly mixing and stirring S1 and S2 to obtain a casting solution S3, casting the casting solution S3 on plate glass with a groove, drying, and soaking a membrane in phosphoric acid to obtain the composite membrane for the high-temperature proton fuel cell. The composite membrane has good mechanical properties and excellent conductivity, and shows good performance when applied to a fuel cell.

title_en: Photothermal response drug carrier based on nano titanium nitride and microcapsule and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photothermal response drug carrier based on nano titanium nitride and microcapsules and a preparation method thereof. Firstly, carboxylating the surface of a poly epsilon-caprolactone drug-loaded microcapsule by using an alkaline solution, and then modifying the surface of nano titanium nitride particles with amino; and finally compounding the carboxylated drug-loaded microspheres and the titanium nitride nanoparticles with the amino groups modified on the surface under the electrostatic action to obtain the titanium nitride-microcapsule composite drug carrier. The microsphere prepared by the method has higher drug loading rate, and the titanium nitride can directly convert light energy into heat energy after being irradiated by near infrared light, so that the composite microsphere is heated and melted, and the drug release efficiency is improved. The photothermal response drug carrier is simple in preparation process and strong in light irradiation heat production capacity, can realize remote, high-precision and high-efficiency release of drugs, and has wide application prospects in the fields of clinical treatment, anticorrosion coatings and the like.

title_en: Nano silver particles with different shapes and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides nano silver particles with different shapes and a preparation method thereof. According to the invention, silver salt, a stabilizer and an etchant are mixed, and then a reducing agent is added for reaction to obtain nano silver particles, and the nano silver particles with different shapes can be prepared by selecting a specific etchant and a stabilizer for synergistic action and regulating the proportion of the etchant and the stabilizer. The preparation method has simple process, short reaction time and easy popularization, and does not need heating in the reaction process.

title_en: Composite phthalocyanine microparticles and process for producing same
abstract_en: The present invention addresses the problem of providing composite phthalocyanine microparticles of nanometer order, preferably 100nm order, which are most suitable as coloring materials, and a method for producing the same. Provided is a method for producing composite phthalocyanine microparticles, which is characterized by comprising: a step (1) in which at least copper phthalocyanine and oxytitanium phthalocyanine and/or cobalt phthalocyanine as raw materials are dissolved in a1 st solvent to prepare a solution; a step (2) in which the solution obtained in the step (1) is mixed with a 2 nd solvent which is a poor solvent for the raw material to precipitate a composite phthalocyanine; and a step (3) in which the composite phthalocyanine obtained in the step (2) is allowed to act with an organic solvent. Also provided are composite phthalocyanine microparticles comprising at least copper phthalocyanine and oxytitanium phthalocyanine and/or cobalt phthalocyanine, wherein the aspect ratio is 1.1 to 2.5 and the particle diameter is 5 to 100 nm.

title_en: Preparation method and application of nano-carbon suspension injection
abstract_en: The invention provides a nano-carbon suspension injection, which comprises the following components in every 1000mL of nano-carbon suspension injection: 20-100 g of nano carbon, 17-30 g of suspending agent, 2-4 g of pH regulator, 8-10 g of sodium chloride and the balance of water for injection; the invention adopts poloxamer as suspending agent, overcomes the defects of hemolysis risk, complex process and poor product stability of the suspending agent in the prior art, further standardizes the use and pretreatment steps of the raw material of the nano carbon, and obtains the nano carbon injection with low heat source and good stability, thereby being beneficial to industrial production.

title_en: Manganese hydroxychloride nanomaterial and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a manganese hydroxychloride nanomaterial and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the field of preparation of VIIB family hydroxychloride materials. Taking manganese chloride crystal particles and manganese oxide powder as raw materials, firstly mixing the raw materials, and then grinding for 2-3 hours; then sealing and heating for 2-8 hours at 100-180 ℃, cooling to room temperature after the reaction is finished, and continuously grinding the product to obtain manganese hydroxychloride Mn 2 (OH) 3 And (3) Cl nano material. The hydroxyl manganese chloride nano material is a compound Mn consisting of manganese, hydroxyl and chlorine in a ratio of 2:3:1 in terms of the number of measurement 2 (OH) 3 And (4) Cl. The method is simple and easy to realize, has low cost and good repeatability, does not generate any by-product and harmful substance, and prepares the Mn 2 (OH) 3 The Cl crystal has the advantages of high yield, uniform distribution and the like.

title_en: Preparation method of cerium oxide with specific mixed valence state
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of inorganic material preparation, and particularly relates to a preparation method of cerium oxide with a specific mixed valence state, which comprises the following steps: (1) under the condition of continuously stirring, adding a complexing agent and a template agent into a trivalent cerium salt aqueous solution in sequence to obtain a mixed solution; then adding a pH value regulator into the mixed solution until the pH value of the mixed solution is 2-6; (2) continuously stirring for 10-60 minutes, carrying out solid-liquid separation, and drying to obtain a precursor of cerium oxide powder; (3) spray roasting the precursor of the cerium oxide powder at 200-500 ℃, and cooling the roasted product by adopting inert gas to obtain the cerium oxide powder with the mass content of trivalent cerium of 60% and tetravalent cerium of 40%. The invention can prepare cerium oxide with specific mixed valence state, and has better ultraviolet shielding effect.

title_en: Perovskite CsPbBr3Particle fusion method of colloidal quantum dots and application
abstract_en: The invention provides perovskite CsPbBr 3 A particle fusion method of colloidal quantum dots and application thereof. The particle size distribution and the internal interface atomic structure of the perovskite quantum dot particles capable of controlling the particles are obtained by the method, so that the method has guiding significance for defect control engineering of the quantum dot light-emitting diode, and has a wide application prospect in the fields of quantum dot light-emitting devices, perovskite solar cell films and the like.

title_en: Friction nanometer generator based on micro-channel and power generation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a friction nanometer generator based on a micro-channel and a power generation method, comprising a friction electrode, an induction electrode, a micro-channel, a protective layer and a conducting device, wherein each electrode layer is sequentially provided with the protective layer, a first metal electrode, a friction material layer, the micro-channel, a second metal electrode and a supporting platform from top to bottom, and the conducting device is led out from the two layers of metal electrodes to be connected with an external circuit so as to obtain output voltage. The invention utilizes the Archimedes spiral micro-channel, not only can relatively increase the macroscopic friction contact area to ensure that the micro-channel is in full contact friction with the paper sheet, but also utilizes the micro-fluid flow with a certain flow velocity in the micro-channel to realize the secondary friction power generation of the generator and further improve the power generation performance of the friction nano-generator. The invention has the characteristics of simple and easily realized manufacturing process and low cost, and is suitable for popularization and application.

title_en: Pressure module and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a pressure module and a manufacturing method thereof. The pressure module includes: the circuit board comprises a circuit substrate, an MEMS chip, an ASIC chip, a first packaging circuit board, a pouring sealant and a second packaging circuit board. According to the technical scheme provided by the invention, the MEMS chip and the ASIC chip are fused together and arranged in the cavity formed by the circuit substrate, the first packaging circuit board and the second packaging circuit board, and the pouring sealant is adopted for filling, so that the purpose of sealing the chip without leakage is realized, the MEMS chip and the ASIC chip are not damaged and the bonded part does not fall off under high pressure, the compactness of the whole structure is improved, in addition, the MEMS chip and the ASIC chip are only used as pressure sensing elements, the reliability and the stability of the product are improved, the cost of the pressure module and the assembly cost can be reduced, and the large-scale automatic production is realized.

title_en: Preparation method of zinc calcium silicate nano-array bioactive coating
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a zinc calcium silicate nano-array bioactive coating, which comprises the steps of firstly, preparing an anodic oxidation solution by taking deionized water as a solvent and sodium bicarbonate and sodium carbonate as solutes, and placing a polished zinc sheet in the solution to carry out anodic oxidation reaction to obtain a zinc oxide nanowire coating; then deionized water is used as a solvent, silicate is used as a solute, the zinc oxide nanowire coating obtained by anodic oxidation is placed in a solution for reaction by a solvothermal method, and Zn is obtained on the surface of the zinc alloy after the reaction is finished 2 SiO 4 Coating; finally, taking deionized water as a solvent and calcium hydroxide as a solute to react Zn 2 SiO 4 Placing the coated sample in a solution to react by a solvothermal method, and obtaining CaZn on the surface of the zinc alloy after the reaction is finished 2 Si 2 O 7 ·H 2 O nanometer array bioactive coating. The invention prepares the zinc calcium silicate nanorod coating with good bioactivity on the surface of the zinc alloy by using an anodic oxidation-hydrothermal composite method, saves the manufacturing cost and obtains a regular nano array.

title_en: Selective electrochemical etching method for cantilever beam type SOI-MEMS device
abstract_en: The invention provides a selective electrochemical etching method for a cantilever beam type SOI-MEMS device, which is a novel application of a four-electrode electrochemical etching method in the processing of the MEMS device and can solve the problems of release and adhesion in use of the cantilever beam. After the cantilever beam type SOI-MEMS device is released, the substrate layer is etched by adopting a selective electrochemical etching method, the device layer is not roughened, and the roughness of the electrochemical etching treatment layer can be increased by adopting a method of etching the buried oxide layer; after electrochemical corrosion, the switch substrate layer releases HF vapor, and the separation length and the gap between the movable part of the switch and the substrate are increased; as the roughness and gap increase, the pressure that causes the switch to adhere increases greatly. Selective electrochemical corrosion is effective in preventing sticking problems in the fabrication and use of cantilever switches or other SOI-MEMS devices.

title_en: Pressure sensor structure based on oxide nanowires and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A pressure sensor structure based on oxide nano wire and its preparation method, the pressure sensor structure includes the substrate; a bottom electrode disposed on the substrate; a seed layer disposed on the bottom electrode; the oxide nanowire is arranged on the seed layer; a support layer disposed on the oxide nanowires; and a top electrode disposed on the support layer. The pressure sensor provided by the invention has a simple process, and can be popularized to the manufacturing of various pressure sensors made of materials with pressure induction effects; the pressure sensor device of the invention has the characteristics of simple manufacture, low cost and low energy consumption.

title_en: Nano copper oxide and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of nano materials, and particularly relates to nano copper oxide and a preparation method and application thereof. The invention provides a preparation method of nano copper oxide, which comprises the following steps: and mixing the copper salt aqueous solution and the methanol solution of sodium hydroxide at normal temperature, and reacting to obtain the nano copper oxide. The preparation method provided by the invention can prepare the nano copper oxide under the condition of normal temperature without heating. The preparation method provided by the invention is simple and easy to operate, and can be used for large-scale production. The invention also provides the nano copper oxide prepared by the preparation method in the technical scheme, wherein methanol is adsorbed on the surface of the nano copper oxide; the average particle size of the nano copper oxide is 3-80 nm. The nano copper oxide provided by the invention has high-efficiency antibacterial property and methanol adsorption effect.

title_en: Preparation method of copper sulfide nano material
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a preparation method of a copper sulfide nano material, which comprises the following steps: dissolving sodium sulfide and copper chloride into a dilute hydrochloric acid solution simultaneously; putting the obtained product into a constant-temperature water bath kettle, carrying out heating reflux treatment, and continuously stirring in the heating reflux treatment process; transferring the obtained substance into a high-pressure hydrothermal reaction kettle, putting the high-pressure hydrothermal reaction kettle into an oven with the temperature of 130-; and taking the obtained product out of the high-pressure reaction kettle, washing the product for a plurality of times by absolute ethyl alcohol, then carrying out centrifugal separation, and finally drying the product to obtain the nano copper sulfide. According to the preparation method of the copper sulfide nano material, the crystallization process is directly controlled through the temperature difference, the process is simple and controllable, and the prepared copper sulfide nano rod is uniform in particle size and strong in stability.

title_en: Hydrophobic noble metal nano tracer liquid, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to a hydrophobic precious metal nanometer tracer solution, a preparation method and application, and relates to the technical field of shale oil gas development; wherein the tracer liquid comprises a hydrophobic dispersion and noble metal nanoparticles dispersed in the hydrophobic dispersion; the noble metal nano particles are dispersed and modified by adopting a hydrophobic solvent; the invention also discloses a preparation method and application of the tracer liquid. The tracer liquid adopts noble metal nanoparticles dispersed by a hydrophobic solvent as a tracer agent, and has a better affinity effect with a hydrophobic matrix such as organic matters in shale, so that the noble metal nanoparticles are uniformly retained in hydrocarbon wet pores of the shale and are clearly identified through a scanning electron microscope, and the migration information of fluid in the micro-nano pores of the shale is visually acquired.

title_en: Preparation method for quickly etching gold and silver nanocages by using sodium citrate in cooperation with hydrogen peroxide
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method for quickly etching gold and silver nanocages by using sodium citrate in cooperation with hydrogen peroxide, which comprises the following steps: (1) preparing a gold and silver nanocage: taking a polyvinylpyrrolidone aqueous solution, adding a silver nano cubic solution in a water bath environment, stirring, dropwise adding a chloroauric acid aqueous solution, stopping dropwise adding when the solution becomes purple, cooling a reaction liquid to room temperature, adding excessive sodium chloride, fully stirring, collecting a supernatant, washing with an ethanol aqueous solution, and fixing the volume of the supernatant with ethanol ultrapure water; (2) preparing an antibacterial gold and silver nano material: and (2) adding the gold and silver nanocages prepared in the step (1) into a sodium citrate solution, uniformly mixing, and then adding hydrogen peroxide. Under the action of sodium citrate, polyvinylpyrrolidone molecules on the surfaces of the gold and silver nanocages can be replaced, and then hydrogen peroxide is introduced, the high-load silver particles in the gold and silver nanocages can be quickly released, so that a remarkable sterilization effect is shown.

title_en: Preparation method of ZSM-5 molecular sieve nanosheet based on bi-quaternary phosphonium ionic liquid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of ZSM-5 molecular sieve nanosheets, which takes bis-quaternary phosphonium ionic liquid as a template agent and comprises the following steps: firstly, synthesizing long-chain bis-quaternary phosphonium ionic liquid by utilizing trialkyl phosphine and bis-halogenated alkane, then mixing the bis-quaternary phosphonium ionic liquid, an aluminum source, a silicon source, alkali and water according to a certain proportion, stirring to form gel, transferring to a hydrothermal kettle, crystallizing at a certain temperature, and then centrifuging, washing, drying and roasting the product to obtain the layered ZSM-5 molecular sieve. The molecular sieve prepared by the method has potential application value in the field of preparing low-carbon olefin by catalytic cracking of alkane.

title_en: Preparation method of carbon quantum dot/titanium dioxide/molybdenum disulfide composite photocatalyst
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a carbon quantum dot/titanium dioxide/molybdenum disulfide composite photocatalyst. The preparation method comprises the steps of preparing carbon quantum dots by a solvothermal method, preparing the titanium dioxide/molybdenum disulfide composite material by a microwave method, and then uniformly combining the carbon quantum dots on the surface of the titanium dioxide/molybdenum disulfide composite material by ultrasonic treatment, high-speed centrifugation and freeze drying treatment. The carbon quantum dot/titanium dioxide/molybdenum disulfide composite photocatalyst prepared by the invention has excellent photocatalytic hydrogen production performance and good photocatalytic stability, and can obtain high-efficiency hydrogen production without the assistance of a platinum-based catalyst.

title_en: Preparation method and application of nano carbon material
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of carbon material preparation, in particular to a preparation method and application of a nano carbon material. The invention provides a preparation method of a nano carbon material, which takes carbon chain polymer substances such as plastics and the like as raw materials and is prepared by three-stage microwave treatment under the action of a microwave catalyst; in the three-stage microwave treatment, the power of the first stage microwave treatment is more than or equal to 200W, the power of the second stage microwave treatment is improved by 20-40% compared with the power of the first stage microwave treatment, and the power of the third stage microwave treatment is improved by 45-65% compared with the power of the second stage microwave treatment. The preparation method has the advantages of low cost, high yield and high purity, is a safe, energy-saving, environment-friendly and efficient nano carbon material preparation process, and combustible gas rich in hydrogen, methane and other gases generated in the preparation process can be recycled, so that the resource utilization rate is greatly improved.

title_en: Preparation method of solid photoluminescence graphene quantum dots
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of solid photoluminescence graphene quantum dots, which comprises the following steps: uniformly mixing melamine, a precursor and a solvent to form a reaction solution; wherein the precursor is one or more of o-phenylenediamine, m-phenylenediamine, glucose and dimethylamino borane; and heating the reaction liquid to carry out hydrothermal reaction, cooling to room temperature, and finally filtering and drying to obtain the solid photoluminescence graphene quantum dots. The fluorescent material emits bright yellow-green fluorescence under the excitation of ultraviolet light in a room temperature environment; after the ultraviolet light excitation is stopped, the visible green phosphorescence or delayed fluorescence can be continuously emitted, the decay life can reach more than 500ms, and the visible time can reach more than 10 s.

title_en: Micro-electromechanical sensor and method for manufacturing the same
abstract_en: The invention discloses a micro-electromechanical sensor and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the micro-electromechanical sensor comprises: a buried layer including a plurality of first raised regions; a plurality of detection electrodes and a plurality of wiring electrodes on the buried layer, the plurality of detection electrodes covering the plurality of first elevated regions, respectively; the torsional swing arm is positioned above the plurality of detection electrodes and the plurality of wiring electrodes, and the torsional swing arm, the plurality of detection electrodes and the plurality of wiring electrodes are not contacted with each other; the torsional pendulum is positioned above the torsional pendulum arm, the movable torsional pendulum blocks are connected with the torsional pendulum through the torsional pendulum arm, and the movable torsional pendulum blocks and the torsional pendulum arm form a movable structure; a plurality of fixed electrodes positioned above the torsion pendulum arm; the buried layer is provided with a supporting wall and a protective wall, the supporting wall and the protective wall are arranged on the buried layer to form a cavity, and the movable structure, the torsion pendulum, the detection electrodes, the wiring electrodes and the fixed electrodes are arranged in the cavity. According to the embodiment of the invention, the sensitivity of the micro-electromechanical sensor is improved, and the problem that the movable structure is broken under impact is solved.

title_en: Micro-electromechanical sensor and method for manufacturing the same
abstract_en: Disclosed are a micro electro mechanical sensor and a method of manufacturing the same, the micro electro mechanical sensor including: a buried layer on the substrate, the buried layer having a plurality of detection electrodes and a plurality of wiring electrodes; the torsional swing arm is positioned above the plurality of detection electrodes and the plurality of wiring electrodes, and the torsional swing arm, the plurality of detection electrodes and the plurality of wiring electrodes are not contacted with each other; the torsional pendulum is positioned above the torsional pendulum arm, the movable torsional pendulum blocks are connected with the torsional pendulum through the torsional pendulum arm, and the movable torsional pendulum blocks and the torsional pendulum arm form a movable structure; a plurality of fixed electrodes positioned above the torsion pendulum arm; the buried layer is arranged on the substrate, the supporting wall is arranged on the buried layer, the protective wall is arranged on the supporting wall, a cavity is formed by the supporting wall and the protective wall in a surrounding mode, and the movable structure, the torsion pendulum, the detection electrodes, the wiring electrodes and the fixed electrodes are arranged in the cavity. According to the embodiment of the invention, the sensitivity of the micro-electromechanical sensor is improved, and the problem that the movable structure is broken under impact is solved.

title_en: Biological melanin/graphene composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a biological melanin/graphene composite material and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: 1) mixing biological melanin with N, N-dimethylacetamide and heating to obtain a biological melanin solution; 2) mixing and heating a biological melanin solution, carboxylated graphene and an acidic solution to obtain a first mixture; 3) carrying out microwave catalytic reaction on the first mixture to obtain a second mixture; 4) carrying out ultrasonic treatment on the second mixture to obtain a third mixture; 5) and centrifuging, washing and drying the third mixture to obtain the biological melanin/graphene nano composite material. The biological melanin/graphene nanocomposite is coated on one side of a load platform and dried to obtain a biological melanin/graphene modified electrode, and the biological melanin/graphene modified electrode is used as a cathode of a microbial fuel cell and applied to the microbial fuel cell, has high electricity generation efficiency and can stably run for a long time.

title_en: Self-repairing hydrogel, preparation method thereof and flexible self-repairing rechargeable battery
abstract_en: The invention provides a self-repairing hydrogel and a preparation method thereof, and a flexible self-repairing rechargeable battery, wherein vanadium salt is used as a raw material, thioacetamide is used as a sulfur source, and a hydrothermal reaction is carried out to synthesize a vanadium disulfide nano sheet growing on carbon cloth fibers as a battery anode; plating zinc on the carbon cloth by electrodeposition to serve as a battery cathode; zinc acetate and manganese acetate are used as electrolyte, are dissolved in water to form aqueous electrolyte, and then 1797 type polyvinyl alcohol is added to form hydrogel to be used as electrolyte. The manufactured battery solves the problem of poor safety faced by the current battery, and after the battery is damaged by bending, cutting and the like, the prepared hydrogel flexible zinc ion battery still can keep higher stability, and the material has the advantages of good cycle performance, safety and the like when being applied to the zinc ion battery.

title_en: Ultrahigh-strength nanocrystalline 20Mn2CrNbV structural steel and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of materials, in particular to ultrahigh-strength nanocrystalline 20Mn2CrNbV structural steel and a preparation method thereof. The chemical composition of the structural steel is as follows (weight percent): c is 0.12-0.28; 0.2 to 1.8 parts of Cr; 1.2-2.8 parts of Mn; 0.02 to 0.10 of Nb; v is 0.12 to 0.28; b is 0.001 to 0.003; 0.01 to 0.2 of Si; 0.01 to 0.03 percent of Ce; the balance being Fe. The preparation method of the structural steel comprises the following steps: (1) keeping the temperature at 820-900 ℃ for a period of time, and rapidly cooling to room temperature to obtain a nano-batten precursor; (2) for the nano-lath precursor, the temperature is 680-760 ℃, and the strain rate is 0.5-2 s ‑1 The total strain amount is more than or equal to 70 percent, so that the precursor of the nano-lath is converted into a nano-crystal structure; (3) tempering the nanocrystalline material at 200-250 ℃ for 1-2 h. The nanocrystalline structural steel prepared by the invention has ultrahigh strength and good plasticity and toughness, and can be widely used for preparing large-scale important parts such as various gears, connecting rods, aircraft engine shafts, aircraft landing gears and the like.

title_en: Electroluminescent device, preparation method thereof and display device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electroluminescent device which comprises a cathode layer, an electronic function layer, a light emitting layer and an anode layer, wherein the cathode layer and the anode layer are oppositely arranged, the electronic function layer is arranged between the cathode layer and the anode layer, and the light emitting layer is arranged between the electronic function layer and the anode layer. The invention also discloses a preparation method of the electroluminescent device. The invention also discloses a display device.

title_en: Nano-drug carrier for antitumor drugs
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nano-drug carrier for antitumor drugs, and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) adding beta-cyclodextrin, polylactic acid and distearoyl phosphatidylcholine into a mixed solution of dimethyl sulfoxide and isopropanol, and uniformly stirring and mixing to obtain a mixed solution; (2) adding calcium salt and phosphate into the mixed solution, and stirring and mixing uniformly; (3) adding water while stirring, adjusting the pH value to 10-12, stirring for 1-2h, standing for aging, cleaning and drying to obtain the nano-drug carrier for the antitumor drug. The nano-drug carrier has good biological safety, reduces the dosage and achieves the effect of slow release and long acting.

title_en: Decoupling etching method for introducing nano-pores into graphene
abstract_en: The invention provides a decoupling etching method for introducing a nanopore into graphene, which comprises the following steps: putting a graphene sample into a vacuum cavity of a plasma processor, and pumping the air pressure in the cavity to be below 1 Pa; introducing inert gas, controlling the gas pressure to be 10-300Pa through a mass flow meter, starting a plasma processor, controlling the starting power to be 0-100W, and controlling the processing time to be 0-300s to obtain a processed graphene sample; placing the processed graphene sample into a Faraday cage, placing the Faraday cage into a plasma processor, vacuumizing the background of the processor to below 1Pa, introducing etching gas, keeping the gas pressure at 10-200Pa, finally starting the plasma processor, controlling the glow starting power at 1-50W, and processing for 10-180 s to obtain the nanopore with the density of 1.3 x 10 12 cm ‑2 The pore diameter is distributed between 0.3nm and 1 nm.

title_en: Two-dimensional material electronic device and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electronic devices, in particular to a two-dimensional material electronic device, a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method provided by the invention comprises the following steps: sequentially preparing a two-dimensional material layer, an etching barrier layer and a graphene layer from bottom to top on the surface of an insulating substrate to obtain a first intermediate product; the areas of the etching barrier layers are respectively smaller than the areas of the two-dimensional material layer and the graphene layer, and the graphene layer completely covers the etching barrier layers; patterning the upper surface of the first intermediate product by taking the overlapping area of the two-dimensional material layer, the etching barrier layer and the graphene layer as a starting point, and preparing a metal electrode according to the obtained pattern to obtain a second intermediate product; and etching the two-dimensional material layer and the graphene layer in the second intermediate product by taking the metal electrode as a mask plate to obtain the two-dimensional material electronic device. According to the invention, the etching barrier layer is arranged to protect the two-dimensional material layer from being influenced by etching, so that the electrical performance of the electronic device is ensured.

title_en: Nitrogen-boron co-doped carbon quantum dot and application thereof in high-sensitivity detection of cadmium ions
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of quantum dots, in particular to a nitrogen and boron co-doped carbon quantum dot and application thereof in high-sensitivity detection of cadmium ions. The method selects proper carbon source, nitrogen source and boron source and proper proportion, and the nitrogen-boron co-doped carbon quantum dot prepared by a one-step hydrothermal method has proper fluorescence intensity and sensitive Cd 2+ Responsiveness and selectivity, can be used for Cd in solution 2+ And (4) detecting the concentration.

title_en: Micro-nano channel structure, sensor, preparation method of sensor and micro-fluid device
abstract_en: A micro-nano channel structure (20), a preparation method of the micro-nano channel structure (20), a sensor (2), a preparation method of the sensor (2) and a micro-fluid device (40). This micro-nano channel structure (20) includes: a substrate base plate (21); a base layer (22) that is provided on a substrate (21) and that includes a plurality of protrusions (26); the channel wall layer (23) is arranged on one side of the plurality of protrusions (26) far away from the substrate base plate (21), and the channel wall layer (23) is provided with micro-nano channels (24); a concave part (27) is arranged between adjacent protrusions (26) in the plurality of protrusions (26), and the orthographic projection of the micro-nano channel (24) on the substrate base plate (21) is located in the orthographic projection of the concave part (27) on the substrate base plate (21). The micro-nano channel (24) has high resolution or ultrahigh resolution and can have different sizes and shapes, so that the micro-nano channel can meet different requirements in practical application, saves process steps and saves production cost.

title_en: Compositions and methods for detecting and treating alzheimer's disease
abstract_en: The present invention provides microbubbles and/or nanodroplets labeled with a diagnostic and/or therapeutic ligand that can be used to detect and treat alzheimer's disease or related diseases and disorders, and methods of making and using the same.

title_en: Elsholtzia volatile oil nanoemulsion and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an elsholtzia volatile oil nanoemulsion and application thereof, relating to the technical field of medicine. The elsholtzia volatile oil nanoemulsion spray is characterized in that the elsholtzia volatile oil and other compatible plant extracts, a surfactant, a cosurfactant and distilled water are prepared into uniform and stable light yellow clear transparent nanoemulsion according to a certain proportion by adopting a nanoemulsion preparation technology. The weight ratio of each component is as follows, oil phase 2-14 parts, surface active agent 15-40 parts, cosurfactant 2-13 parts, water phase 45-80 parts. The spray of the invention has the droplet molecules less than 100nm, is easy to absorb, can be used for oral cavity or nasal cavity, and can also be used for disinfection of skin, environment and the like, has better curative effect on preventing infectious diseases, and has the advantages of safe use, rapid absorption, convenient carrying and the like.

title_en: Nitrogen-doped yellow carbon quantum dot and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nitrogen-doped yellow carbon quantum dot and a preparation method thereof, wherein the particle size range of the yellow carbon quantum dot fluorescent material is 3-6 nm. The yellow carbon quantum can emit bright yellow fluorescence under the excitation of light with the wavelength of 320-550 nm, and the fluorescence quantum efficiency can reach 38 percent at most. The preparation method takes 2,4,6-trihydroxybenzoic acid as a carbon source, m-phenylenediamine as a nitrogen source and tin salt as a catalyst, so that the synthesis time for synthesizing the yellow carbon quantum dots is greatly shortened, and the absolute fluorescence quantum efficiency of the synthesized yellow carbon quantum dots is high. The yellow carbon quantum dots prepared by the method have stable fluorescence performance in an ethanol solution, and no fluorescence intensity reduction is observed within 35 days. The preparation method greatly simplifies the synthesis process of synthesizing the yellow carbon quantum dots, improves the preparation efficiency and greatly reduces the preparation cost.

title_en: High-performance lithium ion battery diaphragm and preparation thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-performance lithium ion battery diaphragm and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of lithium battery diaphragm materials.

title_en: MEMS gas sensitive structure based on ink drop printing and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: An MEMS gas sensitive structure based on ink drop printing and a preparation method thereof are provided, the gas sensitive structure comprises a substrate, a metal electrode layer and a gas sensitive layer, the gas sensitive layer is a linear structure which is connected with the end part of a metal electrode at the overlapping part of each metal electrode on the substrate, and a gas sensitive material film is formed by dissolving a gas sensitive material and performing drip coating in a determined step length in the overlapping area of a positive electrode and a negative electrode through a precise printing spray head. The scheme of the invention can realize smaller structure line width and better sensitivity without depending on the distance between metal electrodes, and because the amount of ink drops, the position of printing ink jet and the moving step length of a spray head can be accurately controlled, a gas-sensitive layer with good repeatability and higher dimensional precision is manufactured based on the method, thereby being beneficial to the batch and low-cost preparation of the MEMS gas-sensitive structure.

title_en: Organic-inorganic composite proton exchange membrane and solid polymer fuel cell
abstract_en: The invention provides an organic-inorganic composite proton exchange membrane containing hydroxyapatite nanowires and a polyelectrolyte containing ionic groups, and a solid polymer fuel cell containing the proton exchange membrane. Compared with the prior art, the organic-inorganic composite proton exchange membrane not only is favorable for realizing good water retention performance, proton conductivity and size stability of the proton exchange membrane under the PEMFC working environment, but also can keep good toughness and service life, and solves the problems that the brittleness of the proton exchange membrane is greatly increased and the service life is influenced due to the existing inorganic composite. And the organic-inorganic composite proton exchange membrane can be prepared by simple steps and low-cost raw materials, so that the overall cost is greatly reduced, and the application prospect is more definite.

title_en: Preparation method of fuel cell cathode catalyst nano particle composite material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a fuel cell cathode catalyst nano particle composite material, which utilizes a carbon nano tube as a precursor under the hydrothermal condition and NiFe in the synthesis process 2 O 4 Nano particles are directly nucleated, uniformly grow and are anchored on the carbon nano tube, and simultaneously nitrogen is doped into the carbon nano tube framework structure, so that NiFe is realized 2 O 4 The uniform load of the nano particles on the nitrogen-doped Carbon Nano Tube (CNT) is adopted to prepare the NiFe 2 O 4 A/CNT nanocomposite material. The invention has the advantages that the hydrothermal method has simple preparation method, low reaction temperature and no need of subsequent treatment conditions, and the composite material has the function of oxygen reduction reactionExcellent catalytic activity and stability, NiFe prepared by said invention 2 O 4 the/CNT nano composite material can be used for a fuel cell cathode catalyst, and can also be applied to the fields of sensors, supercapacitors and the like.

title_en: Polyvinylidene fluoride based barium strontium titanate nanocomposite and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a polyvinylidene fluoride based barium strontium titanate nanocomposite and a preparation method thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps of 1, uniformly mixing oxalic acid dihydrate, deionized water, ethanol and tetrabutyl titanate, and then adjusting the pH value to 4.5-5.5; step 2, adding a mixed solution of barium nitrate and strontium nitrate for hydrothermal treatment, aging, filtering the precipitate, washing and drying to obtain a barium strontium titanate precursor; step 3, calcining at the temperature of 800-; and 4, performing normal-pressure drying after the composite is cast on the substrate by adopting a casting method, then performing vacuum drying to obtain a composite, performing quenching treatment on the composite in ice water, and then drying, wherein the polyvinylidene fluoride barium strontium titanate nano composite material formed on the substrate has high energy storage density when being applied to relatively low breakdown field intensity.

title_en: Near-infrared fluoride core-shell nanocrystalline scintillator
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of inorganic luminescent materials. Near-infrared fluoride core-shell nanocrystalline scintillator Ca 0.3 Ba 0.7 GdF 5 :Ce@BaGdF 5 :Nd@SrF 2 The preparation method sequentially comprises the following steps: adding calcium trifluoroacetate, barium trifluoroacetate, gadolinium trifluoroacetate, cerium trifluoroacetate, oleic acid and octadecene into a three-neck flask, and under the protection of nitrogen, at 110 DEG o And C, keeping the temperature for 1 hour, continuing to heat and keep the temperature, naturally cooling to room temperature, washing with a mixed solution of ethanol and cyclohexane to obtain the core nanocrystal, and then preparing the core-shell nanocrystal by a layer-by-layer epitaxial growth method. The method has the advantages of simple process, low cost, and high yieldThe product is characterized by showing high-efficiency near infrared luminescence excited by X rays.

title_en: MEMS capacitive acceleration sensor with spiral beam structure and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an MEMS capacitive acceleration sensor with a spiral beam structure and a manufacturing method thereof, belonging to the technical field of micro electro mechanical systems. The device comprises a superior plate layer, a superior plate electrode leading-out point, a superior plate anti-collision frame, a superior plate key ring, an superior plate golden ring, a superior plate anti-collision bump group, a quality layer electrode leading-out point, a quality layer upper key ring, a quality layer upper cantilever circular beam group, a quality block, a quality layer lower cantilever circular beam group, a quality layer lower key ring, a subordinate plate layer, a subordinate plate electrode leading-out point, a subordinate plate anti-collision frame, a subordinate plate key ring, a subordinate plate golden ring and a subordinate plate anti-collision bump group. The invention has adjustable working frequency, has the advantages of large effective area, high reliability, easy manufacture, high sensitivity and low cost, and can be used for picking up acceleration signals in different environments.

title_en: Composition comprising a metal oxide and a metal oxide
abstract_en: The present invention relates to compositions and methods of making compositions.

title_en: Liquid phase reaction prepared oxyselenide/sulfoselenide, method and application thereof
