abstract_en: The invention relates to an oxygen selenide/sulfur selenide prepared by liquid phase reaction, a method and application thereof.A liquid phase reaction is carried out by taking an oxygen-free organic solvent as a reaction medium, taking a metal chloride as a transition metal source, taking selenious acid as a selenium source and water as an oxygen source or thiourea as a sulfur source to obtain the oxygen/sulfur selenide with different components; the liquid phase reaction method overcomes the problem of very serious selenium/sulfur volatilization loss when corresponding oxygen/sulfur selenide is synthesized by directly using transition metal simple substance/oxide powder and simple substance selenium/sulfur powder through high-temperature solid/gas phase reaction, so that the oxygen/sulfur selenide with the expected molar ratio can be obtained, and when the prepared oxygen/sulfur selenide is used as a positive electrode material of a zinc ion battery, the specific capacity is higher than 350mAh/g, the voltage platform is high, and the cycle performance is good. The method can be prepared from easily obtained transition metal chloride by a process with high repeatability, simple process and less time consumption, and is suitable for industrial production.

title_en: Nano lithium iron phosphate composite spherical graphene electrode material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a nano lithium iron phosphate composite spherical graphene electrode material which is composed of nano lithium iron phosphate and spherical graphene, wherein the spherical graphene is coated on the surface of the nano lithium iron phosphate, the size of the nano lithium iron phosphate is 0.35-1.8 microns, the spherical graphene has a 3D porous network structure, and the nano lithium iron phosphate and the spherical graphene have the following mass ratios: 1: 80. 3: 40. 1: 8. 5: 1. the nano lithium iron phosphate composite spherical graphene can improve the stability of nano lithium iron phosphate while improving the conductivity, and the spherical graphene has higher mobility and good synergistic effect and can improve the electron transmission efficiency.

title_en: Quantum dot composite material, preparation method thereof, light-emitting film and display device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of display, and particularly relates to a quantum dot composite material, a preparation method thereof, a luminescent film and a display device. The preparation method of the quantum dot composite material provided by the invention comprises the following steps: obtaining a mixed solution containing a metal organic framework material, a sensitizer and quantum dots, wherein the metal organic framework material has a porous structure and unsaturated metal sites, and the sensitizer is at least partially connected with the unsaturated metal sites in a matching manner; and heating the mixed solution to enable the quantum dots to be at least partially loaded in the porous structure. The quantum dot composite material prepared by the method has good dispersibility, light stability, light-emitting performance and quantum efficiency. The method solves the problems that the prior quantum dots are easy to agglomerate and the luminous performance of the prior quantum dots is easy to be influenced by environmental change.

title_en: Manufacturing method of acoustic sensor packaging structure and acoustic sensor packaging structure
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a manufacturing method of a packaging structure of a sound-sensitive sensor and the packaging structure of the sound-sensitive sensor, which relate to the technical field of semiconductor manufacturing, and the manufacturing method of the packaging structure of the sound-sensitive sensor comprises the following steps: one side of the substrate is provided with an acoustic sensor chip; placing a cover body on one side of the substrate where the acoustic sensor chip is located, wherein the cover body comprises a sound inlet hole, the cover body is used for protecting the acoustic sensor chip, and the sound inlet hole is used for transmitting sound to the acoustic sensor chip; attaching a radio frequency chip to one side of the cover body far away from the side where the acoustic sensor chip is attached; selectively encapsulating the radio frequency chip to form a plastic package body, wherein the plastic package body does not cover the sound inlet hole; and manufacturing an antenna on the surface of the plastic package body to form a sound-sensitive sensor packaging structure, wherein the plastic package body can be used for realizing a stable sound-sensitive sensor packaging structure, and the radio frequency chip is used for realizing the diversification of the functions of the sound-sensitive sensor packaging structure.

title_en: Metal phthalocyanine loaded fluorescent carbon quantum dot and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a metal phthalocyanine loaded fluorescent carbon quantum dot and a preparation method and application thereof. The invention integrates the metal phthalocyanine with the catalytic function and the fluorescence signal induction group carbon quantum dot, when the supported carbon quantum dot catalyzes catecholamine oxidation, an electron transfer channel between CQDs and MPc is damaged, and the fluorescence of the carbon quantum dot is turned on, thereby realizing the simultaneous catalysis and detection of the catecholamine. The method has the advantages of convenience in use and operation, strong anti-interference capability, sensitive and reliable result, low detection limit, high response speed and good stability, can realize real-time online rapid and specific detection, and has good application prospect and potential application value.

title_en: Lithium ion battery cathode nanofiber composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lithium ion battery cathode nanofiber composite material and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: using a catalyst containing SnO 2 Preparing SnO (SnO) from second solution of/C nanosphere precursor and third solution containing nickel acetylacetonate through coaxial electrostatic spinning 2 a/C @ Ni nanofiber precursor; the SnO 2 SnO is obtained by oxidizing and carbonizing a/C @ Ni nanofiber precursor 2 a/C @ Ni nanofiber composite, namelyA negative electrode nano-fiber composite material of a lithium ion battery. SnO of the present invention 2 the/C @ Ni nanofiber composite material is used as a lithium ion battery cathode material, the conductivity and the structural stability are remarkably improved, and the composite material has good electrochemical stability and rate capability and commercial application value.

title_en: Preparation method of anatase titanium oxide polyhedral nano/micron photocatalyst with exposed high-index {114} surface
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a titanium oxide polyhedral nano/micron photocatalyst exposing high-index {114} surfaces. The preparation method mainly comprises the synthesis of the titanium oxide polyhedral mother crystal and the etching of the titanium oxide polyhedral mother crystal, and finally prepares the regular polyhedral TiO exposed with the high index {114} surface 2 . The invention combines two strategies of top-down and bottom-up and is used for regulating and controlling the appearance of the titanium oxide. Based on the twoThe favorable direction of the thermodynamics in the strategy controls the crystal growth, and anatase titanium oxide crystals with exposed {114} surfaces are obtained, and the obtained crystals are uniform in appearance. The exposure ratio of the 114 surface is adjustable, and the 114 surface shows excellent photocatalytic performance and photoelectrochemical performance due to the unique surface structure.

title_en: Black silicon plasmon auxiliary absorption thermopile chip and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a black silicon plasmon assisted absorption thermopile chip which comprises a silicon substrate, wherein a supporting layer is arranged on the silicon substrate, an air cavity is arranged in the middle of the silicon substrate, a thermocouple is arranged on the supporting layer, and two ends of the thermocouple are respectively provided with an electrode pressure welding point; the hot end area is covered with an absorption layer; the absorption layer comprises a black silicon micro-nano structure and metal nano particles, the metal nano particles grow on the black silicon micro-nano structure to form black silicon plasmons, and a protection passivation layer is arranged on the surface of each black silicon plasmon. According to the invention, the black silicon micro-nano structure and the metal plasmon are adopted as the thermopile absorption layer, so that the absorption rate is high, the absorption spectrum range is wide, the response speed is high, and the universality is good; the metal plasmon is discontinuous metal nanoparticles, the photo-thermal conversion efficiency is improved, and the sensitivity of the thermopile is high; the material is easy to obtain, and the requirement on a process platform is low.

title_en: Hairbrush-shaped carbon nanotube @ titanium dioxide nanowire gas-sensitive material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hairbrush-shaped carbon nanotube @ titanium dioxide nanowire gas-sensitive material and a preparation method thereof. The carbon nano tube is used as a carrier surface, a titanium dioxide nano wire array is radially grown, the material appearance is unique, and the material is in a hairbrush shape, and the preparation steps comprise: dispersing carbon nanotubes in isopropanol, adding titanic acid tetrafluoride aqueous solution, reacting, cleaning and drying, and then carrying out heat treatment; dispersing the obtained powder in a reaction solution consisting of hydrogen peroxide, nitric acid and melamine, adding excessive sponge titanium or metal titanium as a titanium source, reacting for 6-24 hours at 80 ℃, cleaning, drying and then carrying out heat treatment at 450 ℃ to obtain the core-shell structure carbon nanotube @ titanium dioxide nanowire. The method does not relate to high-temperature and high-pressure equipment, is simple and easy to implement, and the gas-sensitive performance test result shows that the gas-sensitive performance of the material is obviously superior to that of the carbon nano tube @ titanium dioxide nano particle.

title_en: Porous NiCo2O4Positive electrode material coated with lithium nickel cobalt aluminate and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of lithium ion batteries and discloses a porous NiCo 2 O 4 Nickel-cobalt lithium aluminate coated positive electrode material and LiNi with two-dimensional layered morphology 0.8 Co 0.15 Al 0.05 O 2 The nano-sheet has an ultra-high specific surface area, sites for electrochemical lithium removal and lithium intercalation are rich, hydroxyl and carbonate are released by hydrolysis of urea, the hydroxyl and the carbonate interact with cobalt ions and nickel ions to form a nano needle-like structure, and the nano needles self-assemble to form a nano sea urchin-like structure through an Oswald curing processPreparing a nano sea urchin-shaped double-metal carbonate hydroxide precursor, and performing high-temperature heat treatment to generate NiCo 2 O 4 In the process, carbon dioxide and water vapor are released to form a hollow and mesoporous structure, and the porous NiCo is obtained 2 O 4 Coated LiNi 0.8 Co 0.15 Al 0.05 O 2 Lamellar nanosheets, NiCo 2 O 4 The coating effect is beneficial to reducing LiNi 0.8 Co 0.15 Al 0.05 O 2 The capacity attenuation of the anode material improves the rate capability of the anode material, promotes the diffusion and transmission of electrons and lithium ions, and reduces the polarization effect of the electrode.

title_en: NaBH4Sponge and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses NaBH 4 Sponge and its preparation method, transition metal salt catalyst and NaBH 4 Mixing the materials, dissolving the materials in an amine organic solvent, uniformly mixing the materials, filling the mixture into a sponge, and obtaining NaBH after the solvent in the sponge is completely removed 4 Sponge, said NaBH 4 The material and the transition metal salt catalyst are uniformly mixed in the NaBH on the nano scale 4 Inside the sponge. To NaBH 4 When water is added to the sponge, NaBH 4 The hydrolysis reaction is rapidly carried out under the action of the catalyst, the water can be rapidly and effectively transmitted under the water absorption action of the sponge, and all parts in the system are uniformly contacted with the water, so that the hydrogen generation rate is more stable.

title_en: Wide-temperature-range self-lubricating nano-structure film material with long service life
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of hard coating material preparation, in particular to a wide-temperature-range self-lubricating nano-structure film material with long service life, wherein the related nano-structure film is of a multi-element multi-layer structure and consists of three modulation layers; a self-lubricating layer as a modulating layer with a nano-capsule structure, wherein the capsule core is C and Ag, and the capsule shell is amorphous Al 2 O 3 (ii) a The other modulation layer is a hard layer and is TiN with a face-centered cubic structure; the other modulation layer is a gradient layer which is arranged between the self-lubricating layer and the hard layer and is made of amorphous Al 2 O 3 And face centered cubic TiAnd N is formed. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the core of the lubricating component is wrapped by the amorphous oxide shell, and the nano capsule shell effectively avoids the excessive consumption of the lubricating component; in order to avoid interlayer peeling in the wide temperature range friction service process and improve the wear resistance of the film; the highest hardness of the film material can be 24GPa, the friction coefficient is approximately stabilized between 0.4 and 0.6 under the environment of room temperature to 900 ℃, and the film material can be repeatedly used for many times under the environment of room temperature to high temperature.

title_en: Method for chemically synthesizing silver nanowires by using molten salt
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for chemically synthesizing silver nanowires by using molten salt, which comprises the following specific steps: s1, uniformly mixing eutectic salt with low melting point according to the eutectic point proportion, and heating to the eutectic temperature to obtain molten salt; s2, adding polyvinylpyrrolidone into the molten salt obtained in the step S1, and stirring until the polyvinylpyrrolidone is completely dissolved; s3, adding silver salt and hydroxide into the product obtained in the step S2, continuously stirring, and naturally cooling after complete reaction; and S4, washing and separating the product obtained in the step S3 to obtain a silver nanowire product. The method has the advantages of simple process flow, convenient operation, good repeatability and easy large-scale production.

title_en: Carbon quantum dot/manganese dioxide nano composite material, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carbon quantum dot/manganese dioxide nano composite material, a preparation method and application thereof. According to the method, a potassium permanganate solution is slowly dripped into a carbon quantum dot solution by using an oxidation-reduction reaction between potassium permanganate with strong oxidizing property and the carbon quantum dot according to the mass ratio of the potassium permanganate to the carbon quantum dot of 1.8-7.2, and the carbon quantum dot/manganese dioxide nano composite material is prepared by reacting at 120 ℃ after the potassium permanganate solution and the carbon quantum dot are uniformly mixed. When the carbon quantum dot/manganese dioxide nano composite material prepared by the invention is used as an anode material of a water-based zinc ion battery, the specific capacity of the carbon quantum dot/manganese dioxide nano composite material is up to 480.0mAh/g under the current density of 100mA/g, and the specific capacity can be maintained to 337.2mAh/g under the current density of 1000mA/g, so that the carbon quantum dot/manganese dioxide nano composite material has excellent zinc ion storage performance and good rate capability.

title_en: In-situ growth TiO based on laser hole array2Multifunctional bionic titanium-based surface of nanowire and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an in-situ growth TiO based on a laser hole array 2 A multifunctional bionic titanium-based surface of a nanowire and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a periodic hole array pattern on the surface of a titanium alloy substrate by using a low-cost and high-efficiency nanosecond laser processing technology, and carrying out hydrothermal treatment on the surface by using an alkaline solution to grow uniform TiO in situ 2 Nano wires are used for obtaining a micro-nano composite structure surface with super-hydrophilic/underwater super-oleophobic characteristics, and after ultrasonic cleaning, fluorine-free low-surface-energy substances are used for chemical modification treatment, so that a surface with super-hydrophobic characteristics can be obtained; in addition, the super-hydrophobic surface can be further improved into a liquid injection type super-smooth surface by adopting a lubricating liquid filling mode. The preparation process is simple, economical and practical; the functionality of the surface of the sample is flexible and controllable, and an appropriate surface modification type can be selected according to the actual working condition, so that the method is suitable for a plurality of fields of aerospace, underwater equipment, medical instruments, pipeline transportation and the like.

title_en: Lithium ion battery cathode material, preparation method and application thereof, and lithium ion battery
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of lithium ion batteries, and discloses a lithium ion battery cathode material, a preparation method and application thereof, and a lithium ion battery.

title_en: Rare earth-organic framework nano fluorescent probe and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological detection, and discloses a rare earth-organic framework nano fluorescent probe and a preparation method and application thereof. The method for preparing the rare earth-organic framework nano material by ligand exchange can control the size of the nano material and avoid forming amorphous coordination polymer. The invention takes rare earth-organic framework nano material Ln-QPTCA as a fluorescent probe, utilizes ATP and ADP to have different quenching effects on the luminescence of the nano probe and uses target detection object kinase as converting enzyme of the ATP and the ADP to realize the detection of the kinase activity. The invention can be used for detecting the kinase activity in the standard solution, can further realize the detection of the kinase activity in the serum, has the advantages of simple and convenient operation, good anti-interference performance, rapidness, sensitivity, economy, practicality and the like, can provide theoretical basis and technical support for solving the problem of real-time monitoring of the kinase activity in a complex system, and has good clinical application potential.

title_en: Preparation of transition metal nano catalyst by electrodeposition method and application thereof in electrocatalysis of CO2Reduction of
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electrocatalyst preparation, relates to a method for preparing a transition metal nano catalyst, and particularly relates to an electrodeposition method for preparing a transition metal nano catalyst 2 SO 4 Or KHCO 3 Adding transition metal insoluble salt (namely a precursor) and oxide, a stabilizer polyvinylpyrrolidone (PVP) and ethanol into the solution to form a metastable mixed electrodeposition solution, then immersing a pure copper sheet or a carbon material serving as a carrier into the electrodeposition mixed solution, and carrying out electrodeposition in a constant voltage mode, wherein the transition metal electrodeposition precursor is sold in the market or subjected to double decomposition. The invention uses the electric field formed in electrodeposition to adsorb metal insoluble salt and oxide to form a metal nano structure, which is suitable for transition metal elements such as Cu, Ag, Au, Zn, Sn and the like. The preparation method is simple, the continuous electrodeposition can be realized only by adding a new electrodeposition precursor, the prepared catalyst has excellent performance, and CO can be reduced in electrocatalysis and photocatalysis 2 And has good application prospect in the aspect of oxygen reduction.

title_en: Electrode material composition and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an electrode material composition and a preparation method and application thereof, the electrode material composition comprises a silicon-carbon composite material with the content not less than 80 wt% and nano-silver with the content not more than 5 wt%, wherein the silicon-carbon composite material is a three-level coated silicon-carbon composite material and is obtained by the following steps: crushing and dealloying the silicon-based alloy to obtain micron silicon powder; dispersing micron silicon powder in a solution containing a first carbon source, and crushing to obtain primary coated nano silicon slurry; mixing the nano silicon slurry with a second carbon source, uniformly stirring, drying and roasting to obtain a secondary coated precursor; and carrying out chemical vapor deposition on the precursor in a third carbon source atmosphere to obtain the three-stage coated silicon-carbon composite material. By compounding nano silver and the silicon-carbon composite material with the three-layer carbon coating layer, the charging and discharging specific capacity of the battery is effectively improved, the utilization rate of the battery is improved, the cycling stability of the electrode material is improved to a certain extent, and the battery has good comprehensive performance.

title_en: Silicon-carbon composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a silicon-carbon composite material, which comprises the following steps: crushing and dealloying the silicon-based alloy to obtain micron silicon powder; dispersing micron silicon powder in a solution containing a first carbon source, and crushing to obtain primary coated nano silicon slurry; mixing the nano silicon slurry with a second carbon source, uniformly stirring, drying and roasting to obtain a secondary coated precursor; and carrying out chemical vapor deposition on the precursor in a third carbon source atmosphere to obtain the three-stage coated silicon-carbon composite material. The silicon-carbon composite material can be used as a good lithium ion battery cathode active material, and by constructing a multi-level buffer coating layer, the long cycle stability is effectively improved while the high capacity and the first coulombic efficiency of the battery are ensured, and meanwhile, the tap density can also be kept at a higher level, so that the silicon-carbon composite material has good comprehensive performance. The preparation method is simple, the cost is low, the preparation process is suitable for large-scale production, and the method has good industrial prospect.

title_en: Anti-freeze compositions comprising gold nanoparticles with peptides
abstract_en: The present invention provides a nanostructure comprising: a core comprising one or more planes configured to be in planar contact with at least one plane of an ice crystal; and an oligopeptide conjugated to at least one plane of the core and comprising (Thr)  n  ‑、(Ala)  n  ‑、(Ser)  n  -or (Gly)  n  -wherein the nanostructures are nanostructures in colloidal form present in water to control frozen polyhedral shape, and n is an integer from 2 to 7.

title_en: Preparation method of subminiature magnetic ferroferric oxide nanoparticles
abstract_en: A preparation method of subminiature magnetic ferroferric oxide nanoparticles with the size less than 8nm relates to the technical field of nano material preparation. In order to overcome the defect that the nucleation and growth processes of the subminiature magnetic ferroferric oxide nanoparticles prepared by the existing method are difficult to control, ferrihydrite with a nano structure is used as a precursor, and the subminiature magnetic ferroferric oxide nanoparticles with uniform size, controllable particle size, good crystallinity, high purity and easy water solubility are obtained by heating reaction in polyhydric alcohol. The preparation method comprises the following steps: 1) ferric salt and alkaline substances are reacted in aqueous solution to obtain ferrihydrite precipitate; 2) and mixing the ferrihydrite precipitate with polyhydric alcohol and heating to obtain the ultra-small magnetic ferroferric oxide nano particles. The method has the advantages of easily available raw materials, low cost, simple process and suitability for large-scale production, and the obtained subminiature magnetic ferroferric oxide nanoparticles have wide application in the field of biomedicine.

title_en: Device for carrying out gas-phase coating on aluminum oxide protective layer on lithium battery negative electrode material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for coating a lithium battery cathode material with an alumina protective layer in a gas phase, which belongs to the technical field of coating the surface of the lithium battery cathode material, and particularly relates to a device for coating the lithium battery cathode material with the alumina protective layer in the gas phase, which comprises a gas feeder and a coating reaction bin, wherein the gas feeder comprises a first gas feeder, a second gas feeder and a third gas feeder, the first gas feeder is connected with a first gas inlet pipe, the second gas feeder is connected with a second gas inlet pipe, the third gas feeder is connected with a third gas inlet pipe, the first gas inlet pipe, the second gas inlet pipe and the third gas inlet pipe are connected with the coating reaction bin, the bottom of the coating reaction bin is provided with a material collecting position, the first gas inlet pipe, the second gas inlet pipe and the third gas inlet pipe are all communicated with the material collecting position, and the outer side of the material collecting position is provided with a heater. Therefore, the first charge-discharge efficiency and the cycle times of the cathode material are greatly improved, and the service life of the lithium battery can be effectively prolonged.

title_en: Visible light response type nano composite particle catalyst and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a visible light response type nano composite particle catalyst and a preparation method thereof, and aims to provide a Cu-based composite particle catalyst 2 Adding distilled water and SnCl into O particles 2 Post-ultrasonic treatment, suction filtration and drying, wherein Cu 2 Fine particles of O and SnCl 2 The mass ratio of (A) to (B) is 1-5: 1. the catalyst has the advantages of simple preparation method, low cost, better utilization of sunlight, better stability, low probability of photo-induced electron-hole recombination and high photocatalytic activity.

title_en: Bi12O17Cl2/Bi2O2CO3Preparation method of composite nano material
abstract_en: The invention discloses Bi 12 O 17 Cl 2 /Bi 2 O 2 CO 3 The preparation method of the composite nano material comprises the following steps: 1) dissolving bismuth nitrate in ethylene glycol, and adjusting the concentration of a bismuth nitrate solution to be: 0.1-0.2 mol/L; 2) dissolving ammonium chloride in deionized water, and adjusting the concentration of the ammonium chloride solution as follows: 0.02-0.04 mol/L; 3) slowly pouring the obtained bismuth nitrate solution into an ammonium chloride solution, stirring, transferring into a high-pressure reaction kettle, and adjusting with deionized water to make the volume of the bismuth nitrate solution account for 2/3-4/5 of the volume of the reaction kettle; 4) sealing the reaction kettle with the reaction materials, and carrying out heat treatment at 120-140 ℃ for 8-24 hours; cooling to room temperature, removing supernatant, adding hydrochloric acid and potassium hydroxide to adjust pH, stirring to completely separate out a solid product, sequentially washing with deionized water and absolute ethyl alcohol, and drying to obtain Bi 12 O 17 Cl 2 Nano powder; 5) adding Bi 12 O 17 Cl 2 Transferring the nano powder into a ball milling tank, adding zirconia ball milling beads and ethylene glycol to enable the volume of the zirconia ball milling beads to be 2/3-3/4 of the volume of the reverse ball milling tank, carrying out ball milling, sequentially cleaning the obtained powder with deionized water and absolute ethyl alcohol, and drying to obtain Bi 12 O 17 Cl 2 /Bi 2 O 2 CO 3 A composite nanomaterial.

title_en: Method for cleaning microorganisms on surface of mural
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for cleaning microorganisms on the surface of a mural, which comprises the following steps: s1, preprocessing the surface of the mural, and determining the part of the mural surface damaged by microorganisms; s2, cleaning the part determined in the S1 by using 0.02-0.2% by mass of aqueous hydrogen peroxide; s3, after the mural is dried, cleaning the part cleaned in the S2 again by using a cleaning material; the cleaning material comprises the following raw materials in percentage by mass: 0.02-1% of dimethyl fumarate, 1-3% of benzalkonium bromide, 2-5% of mercuric chloride, 5-10% of ethyl acetate, 5-10% of nano bactericide and the balance of water; and S4, removing the residual cleaning materials on the surface of the mural by using distilled water. According to the invention, the microorganisms on the surface of the mural are treated and inhibited by the aqueous hydrogen peroxide solution and the cleaning material, so that the damage of the microorganisms on the surface of the mural is effectively reduced, and the cleaning method is simple and has a good use prospect.

title_en: Surface-enhanced Raman substrate based on silver pyramid-shaped nanoparticles and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a surface enhanced Raman substrate based on silver pyramid-shaped nano particles and a preparation method thereof; mixing silver salt solution, dispersant, reducer and propylamine in solvent and reacting; and after the reaction is finished, carrying out centrifugal treatment, sequentially washing the precipitate with water and alcohol, placing the precipitate on an inorganic substrate, and drying to obtain the surface enhanced Raman substrate based on the silver pyramid-shaped nanoparticles. The surface-enhanced Raman substrate prepared by utilizing the silver pyramid type nano particles has excellent enhancement effect, and can detect the lowest concentration of 10 dichlorodiphenyl trichloroethane ‑9  M。

title_en: Quantum dot light emitting device and electronic apparatus
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a quantum dot light emitting device and an electronic apparatus. The quantum dot light emitting device includes a first electrode and a second electrode, a quantum dot layer between the first electrode and the second electrode, and a first electron transport layer and a second electron transport layer disposed between the quantum dot layer and the second electrode. The second electron transport layer is disposed between the quantum dot layer and the first electron transport layer, wherein the first electron transport layer and the second electron transport layer each comprise an inorganic material. The lowest unoccupied molecular orbital energy level of the second electron transport layer is shallower than the lowest unoccupied molecular orbital energy level of the first electron transport layer, and the lowest unoccupied molecular orbital energy level of the quantum dot layer is shallower than the lowest unoccupied molecular orbital energy level of the second electron transport layer. An electronic device includes the quantum dot light emitting device.

title_en: Preparation method and application of flexible sulfur positive electrode of all-solid-state lithium sulfur battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a flexible sulfur positive electrode of an all-solid-state lithium sulfur battery, wherein the preparation of the flexible sulfur positive electrode mainly comprises the processes of preparing nano sulfur dispersion liquid, preparing carbon skeleton dispersion liquid, preparing carbon sulfur positive dispersion liquid, magnetically stirring, filtering a mixed solution, drying a filter cake layer and a filter membrane, removing the filter cake layer to obtain a carbon sulfur positive electrode film, preparing a polymer solid electrolyte solution, dripping an electrolyte solution on the carbon sulfur positive electrode film and drying to obtain a pretreated flexible sulfur positive electrode piece, performing hot-pressing treatment to obtain an all-solid-state battery flexible sulfur positive electrode piece and the like; according to the invention, the flexible conductive carbon material and the flexible polymer solid electrolyte are introduced to the sulfur anode simultaneously to form a uniform ion/electron conductive path, so that the flexibility of the electrode can be improved comprehensively, and the integral preparation method is simple, efficient and energy-saving and has more practical value.

title_en: Method for continuously producing graphene quantum dot slurry on large scale
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for continuously producing graphene quantum dot slurry on a large scale, which comprises the following steps: (1) mixing a solvent and a dispersant to obtain a dispersion liquid; (2) Mixing the expanded graphite with the dispersion liquid to obtain expanded graphite dispersion liquid; (3) Performing ball-milling, shearing, colliding and stripping on the expanded graphite dispersion liquid, and then performing shearing, crushing, stripping and crushing, wherein the ball-milling, shearing, colliding and stripping, the shearing and crushing, the stripping and crushing are sequentially and circularly processed for 2-6 times to obtain graphene slurry; (4) Drying the graphene slurry to obtain dry graphene powder, and then mixing and heating the dry graphene powder, perchloric acid and potassium dichromate to obtain graphene quantum dot precursor powder; (5) And adding the graphene quantum dot precursor powder into the new dispersion liquid for wetting, and then repeatedly treating for 2-5 times by using a micro-jet device to obtain the graphene quantum dot slurry. The method can be used for continuously producing the graphene quantum dot slurry on a large scale.

title_en: Selective laser melting forming nano TiB2Preparation method of reinforced aluminum-based composite material
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a nano TiB prepared by selective laser melting 2 A reinforced aluminum matrix composite and a method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: (1) selecting purity>99.9% of high-purity spherical AlSi10Mg powder with a particle size of 15-53 μm; purity of>99.9% of irregular knots with particle size of 50-100nmStructure of TiB 2 Powder; (2) the two powders are mechanically mixed and uniformly mixed under the condition of not damaging the original characteristics of the matrix powder; (3) and preparing a composite material forming sample with reinforcing phase particles uniform to the aluminum alloy matrix and high density by adopting a selective laser melting forming technology. By adding the nano reinforced particles into the aluminum alloy matrix, the comprehensive mechanical property of the aluminum alloy can be effectively improved under the synergistic strengthening effect of fine grain strengthening and dispersion strengthening.

title_en: Adjustable gold nanostructure and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an adjustable gold nano structure and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: adding a nano seed to the first solution containing 3-aminopropyltriethoxysilane; and then adding a growth solution containing a ligand, chloroauric acid and a reducing agent to enable the gold nanowires to grow on the surfaces of the nano seeds, and stopping the reaction to obtain the gold nanowires. The method has the advantages of simple and easily obtained raw materials, simple and safe operation process, capability of obtaining a plurality of complex composite nano structures, capability of providing potential catalysts for various catalytic reactions and strong practicability.

title_en: Titanium dioxide nano material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of titanium dioxide nano materials, and particularly relates to a titanium dioxide nano material which can be prepared by the following steps: s1, adding isopropyl titanate into the hydrochloric acid solution, and performing ultrasonic dispersion and dissolution to obtain a precursor solution; s2, adding anatase titanium dioxide particles into the precursor solution; s3, adding sodium chloride into the solution prepared in the step S2, transferring the solution into a high-pressure reaction kettle, and reacting at the temperature of 150-200 ℃, wherein the white precipitate generated by the reaction is the titanium dioxide nano material. The preparation method has the advantages of simple preparation process, environmental friendliness, controllability and the like, the product of the invention has larger specific surface area, and a novel nano material with a bionic structure is provided for the development of the fields of physical chemistry and the like.

title_en: Preparation method of cobalt magnetic metal nanowire with controllable size
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of synthesis of metal nano materials, and provides a preparation method of a cobalt magnetic metal nanowire with controllable size, which comprises the following steps: (a) adding cobalt metal salt, ammonium fluoride and urea into a uniformly mixed solvent consisting of alcohols and water according to a certain sequence, and ultrasonically stirring for 0-2h at room temperature to obtain a uniformly mixed solution; (b) reacting the solution for 9-80h under the condition of hydrothermal autogenous pressure at 60-220 ℃, and filtering, washing and drying to obtain a basic cobalt carbonate precursor; (c) the basic cobalt carbonate precursor is put in a tube furnace H 2 Reducing for 1-6h at the temperature of 650 ℃ under the atmosphere of/Ar mixed gas, and finally obtaining the cobalt magnetic metal nanowire. The synthesis equipment of the invention is easy to obtain,the reaction process is simple, the particle size is controllable, the operation mode and conditions are easy to control, the cost is low, and the large-scale production is easy.

title_en: Preparation method of electrospun carbon nanofiber/reduced graphene oxide/polyaniline/basic nickel carbonate composite electrode material
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of energy materials, and relates to a preparation method and application of an electrospun carbon nanofiber/reduced graphene oxide/polyaniline/basic nickel carbonate composite electrode material: the method comprises the following steps: firstly, preparing a polyacrylonitrile electrospun membrane by an electrostatic spinning method, and preparing electrospun carbon nanofibers/reduced graphene oxide by the steps of pre-oxidation, graphene oxide solution soaking, carbonization and the like; then, coating polyaniline successfully on the basis of the previous method by in-situ polymerization; finally, regulating and controlling the hydrothermal time and concentration through a hydrothermal reaction to obtain an electrospun carbon nanofiber/reduced graphene oxide/polyaniline/basic nickel carbonate composite electrode material; the composite electrode material prepared by the invention is not reported in documents, and the method is simple and convenient and is easy to operate; the obtained material has stable morphology, high specific surface area and conductivity, more active sites, excellent electrochemical energy storage performance, and good mechanical stability and electrochemical cycling stability.

title_en: Micro-mirror side wall processing method for etching by inductively coupled plasma and focused ion beam
abstract_en: The invention relates to a micromirror side wall processing method for etching inductively coupled plasma and focused ion beams. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, processing an optical switch by utilizing an Inductively Coupled Plasma (ICP) technology to obtain an optical switch sample; then, utilizing Focused Ion Beam (FIB) technique to make secondary etching processing on the sample side wall reflector mirror surface, and concretely making it include the following steps: a sample fixing step, fixing a sample to be processed on a sample table in a dual-beam system of a focused ion beam and an electron beam; selecting appropriate areas to be processed and experimental areas for touching the bottom, and then performing simulated processing on the experimental areas for touching the bottom to determine appropriate processing parameters; and a processing step, etching the mirror surface of the reflector by using the focused ion beam. The processing method based on the combination of the inductive coupling plasma technology and the focused ion beam technology can effectively improve the roughness of the mirror surface and improve the transmission efficiency of the optical path.

title_en: Optimized electronic configuration Co for efficient oxygen evolution reaction4Preparation method of N nanosheet
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimized electronic configuration Co for efficient oxygen evolution reaction 4 A method of making N nanoplates, comprising: synthesis of Co (CO) 3 ) 0.5 (OH)·0.11H 2 An O nanosheet precursor; synthesis of Co 3 O 4 Nanosheet precursor: mixing Co (CO) 3 ) 0.5 (OH)·0.11H 2 Calcining the O nano sheet precursor in air atmosphere, cooling to room temperature,to obtain Co 3 O 4 A precursor; synthesis of Co 4 N nanosheet: calcination of Co in Ammonia atmosphere 3 O 4 Precursor to obtain Co 4 N nanosheets; regulating Co 4 Electronic configuration of N nanoplate: by calcining Co in a mixed atmosphere of argon and hydrogen 4 N nanosheet to adjust Co 4 The nitrogen content of the N nanosheet, so that the purpose of regulating and controlling the electronic configuration of Co is achieved. By the invention to Co 4 Partial reduction is carried out on the N nano sheet to obtain defective Co with different nitrogen contents 4 N nano-sheet. Defective Co with different nitrogen contents 4 N nanosheets have different electronic configurations, with e of Co ions g The electronic filling number is also different, and the method has great use potential in the fields of catalysis, energy storage and the like.

title_en: Nanoscale double-gene delivery system with synergistic expression function and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nanoscale double-gene delivery system with a synergistic expression function, and a preparation method and application thereof. Compared with the prior art, the nanoscale double-gene delivery system with the synergistic expression function has nanoscale and moderate positive potential, is an optimized surface property for cell transfection, obviously improves the expression quantity of related mRNA and protein, realizes the synergistic effect of '1 +1 > 2', and enhances the effect of gene therapy.

title_en: Micro-electromechanical actuator with multiple freedom of movement
abstract_en: A microelectromechanical actuation device comprising: a substrate having a through cavity; an anchor body arranged on the substrate; a first frame disposed around the anchor; and an elastic support body connected between the first frame body and the anchor body and suspending the first frame body on the substrate, wherein: the through cavity has a first area; the first frame body has a second projection area on the substrate; and the first area and the second projection area have an overlapping part.

title_en: Quantum dot-polymer composite and display device including the same
abstract_en: Disclosed are a quantum dot-polymer composite, a method of manufacturing a core-shell quantum dot, and a display device including a light emitting element including the quantum dot-polymer composite, the quantum dot-polymer composite comprises a polymer matrix and core-shell quantum dots dispersed in the polymer matrix, wherein the core-shell quantum dot comprises a semiconductor nanocrystal core and a semiconductor nanocrystal shell disposed on the semiconductor nanocrystal core, the semiconductor nanocrystal core comprising indium, zinc, and phosphorus, the semiconductor nanocrystal shell comprising zinc, selenium, and sulfur, the core-shell quantum dot not comprising cadmium, the core-shell quantum dot configured to emit green light, the core-shell quantum dot having a molar ratio of phosphorus to indium greater than or equal to about 0.75:1, the core-shell quantum dot having a molar ratio of zinc to indium greater than or equal to about 35: 1.

title_en: Polypyrrole coated MoS2/C composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses polypyrrole-coated MoS 2 a/C composite material and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method of the composite material comprises the following steps: 1) dissolving sodium molybdate dihydrate and thiourea in ethanol, adding polyvinylpyrrolidone, stirring, placing in a high-pressure kettle, and reacting at 150 deg.C or higher to obtain the final product 2 C assembled hollow nanospheres; 2) get from MoS 2 And C, uniformly mixing the hollow nanospheres assembled by the/C and an oxidant, taking the obtained mixture as a raw material, taking pyrrole as a coating source, taking a high-pressure kettle as a reaction chamber, and carrying out heat preservation reaction under the condition that the mixture and the pyrrole are not in contact with each other under the heating condition or the non-heating condition to obtain the composite material. The composite material is in a hollow spherical shape and has excellent Li + Storage performance and reversible capacity, and the preparation method is simpler and more environment-friendly.

title_en: Preparation method of PEG/PEI modified magnetic nanoparticles
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of magnetic nanoparticles, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of S1, adding alcohol into vortex iron particles, and then dispersing the vortex iron particles by ultrasonic waves; s2, removing alcohol through magnetic adsorption separation; s3, adding PEG and/or PEI and water, and performing ultrasonic emulsification; and S4, after the supernatant is discarded, washing with water and alcohol respectively, collecting the precipitate, and drying to obtain the PEG and/or PEI modified magnetic nanoparticles. The nano carrier has low toxicity and good effect.

title_en: V-shaped groove3O5Preparation method of nano electrode material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a V 3 O 5 A preparation method of a nano electrode material. The vanadium-sulfur composite material is obtained by a solvothermal-calcination method, a vanadium source and a sulfur source are mixed for solvothermal reaction, and then the vanadium-sulfur mixture is calcined in a tubular furnace to obtain a final product. V provided by the invention 3 O 5 The structure is about 100nm of nano particles, the structure is uniform, the distribution is uniform, and the stability is good. Synthesis of V according to the invention 3 O 5 The particle size is reduced to be in a nanometer size range, and the electrochemical performance is good.

title_en: MEMS scanning mirror
abstract_en: The invention discloses a MEMS scanning mirror. One embodiment of the MEMS scanning mirror includes a mirror, a piezoelectric actuator for rotating the mirror about a rotation axis, and a mirror rotation angle sensing device, the mirror rotation angle sensing device being a piezoresistive pressure sensor, the sensor comprising: a first conductive type conductive semiconductor layer; forming a piezoresistive region and first to fourth electrode contact regions of a second conductivity type in the semiconductor layer, the piezoresistive region having a symmetrical shape, the first electrode contact region and the second electrode contact region being located at both ends of the piezoresistive region in a direction of a symmetry axis, the third electrode contact region and the fourth electrode contact region being located at both sides of the piezoresistive region and being symmetrically disposed about the symmetry axis; an annular protection region is formed in the semiconductor layer surrounding the piezoresistive region, the annular protection region being not in contact with the piezoresistive region, having the first conductivity type and having an impurity concentration greater than that of the semiconductor layer. This embodiment may improve sensing accuracy.

title_en: Preparation method of embedded three-dimensional interconnection structure based on nano metal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an embedded three-dimensional interconnection structure based on nano metal, which comprises the following steps of bonding a plurality of glass sheets with holes or cavities to form a substrate structure with a three-dimensional cavity; filling the three-dimensional cavity with the nano metal paste through a glue dispensing device; after filling, performing directional sintering molding on the nano metal in the three-dimensional cavity by using laser; and finally, carrying out wet cleaning on the substrate structure to remove the residual nano metal particles. The invention forms a substrate structure of a three-dimensional cavity, adopts nano metal to fill, and then forms an embedded three-dimensional interconnected conductor structure by sintering, and avoids environmental pollution by adopting a copper electroplating mode.

title_en: Electrode material, preparation method thereof and battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electrode material, a preparation method thereof and a battery, relates to the technical field of batteries, and is used for improving the cycling stability of the electrode material while keeping the electrode material to have high specific capacity. The preparation method of the electrode material comprises the following steps: mixing a carbon material, a graphene material, a binder and a silicon material together to obtain a precursor; and sintering the precursor in an inert environment to convert the carbon material contained in the precursor into the graphite carbon material with a lamellar structure, thereby obtaining the electrode material. The electrode material is prepared by the preparation method of the electrode material. The battery includes the electrode material. The electrode material, the preparation method thereof and the battery provided by the invention are used for improving the cycle performance and the specific capacity of the battery.

title_en: alpha-MnSe nanosheet and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of photoelectric materials, in particular to an alpha-MnSe nanosheet and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the alpha-MnSe nanosheet comprises the following steps: se and manganese sources are taken as raw materials and prepared by a chemical vapor deposition method; the manganese source is MnO 2 Or MnCl 2 . According to the invention, alpha-MnSe nanosheet is prepared on a mica substrate by selecting specific raw materials and using a Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD) method; the alpha-MnSe nanosheet is an antiferromagnetic wide band gap semiconductor. The preparation method provided by the invention has good controllability on the size and thickness of the alpha-MnSe nanosheet, and has the advantages of simple process, high synthesis speed, high crystal quality of the prepared alpha-MnSe nanosheet and good stability. The invention is suitable for two dimensionsMagnetic studies provide a good choice of materials; the alpha-MnSe nanosheet prepared by the method is applied to a photoelectric detection device, and has excellent photodetection performance.

title_en: Zn doped graded spherical Fe 2 O 3 Preparation method of material and energy storage application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Zn doped graded spherical Fe  2  O  3  Preparation method of material and energy storage application thereof, firstly obtaining sample by one-step hydrothermal method, and then annealing treatment to obtain nano-particle Zn doped Fe  2  O  3  A material. Zn doped Fe  2  O  3  The conductivity of the material can be improved after the material, the specific surface area of the material is increased by the nano-sized particles, the contact sites of the material and ions are increased, and the utilization rate of the material is further improved. In addition, the nano-sized particles reduce the volume change of the material in the oxidation-reduction reaction process, can improve the cycling stability of the material, and can be applied to nickel-iron battery materials or other energy storage devices.

title_en: Method for preparing two-dimensional CoS nanosheet based on chemical vapor deposition method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing a two-dimensional CoS nanosheet based on a chemical vapor deposition method, which comprises the following steps of: (1) respectively putting anhydrous cobalt chloride and thioacetamide into two clean porcelain boats; (2) placing the porcelain boat filled with anhydrous cobalt chloride in a single-temperature-zone tube furnace heating center, and placing a substrate in the center of the porcelain boat; placing the porcelain boat filled with thioacetamide at the upstream of the single-temperature-zone tube furnace; (3) ar and H are introduced into a single-temperature tube furnace 2 And heating the central temperature of the single-temperature-zone tubular furnace to 520-580 ℃, heating the upstream temperature of the porcelain boat containing thioacetamide from room temperature to 200-300 ℃, preserving the temperature for 10-30 minutes, cooling to room temperature, and taking out the substrate to obtain the two-dimensional layered CoS nanosheet. The CoS nanosheet material prepared on the substrate by the chemical vapor deposition method has the advantages of thin thickness and high purityAnd provides reliable raw materials for manufacturing micro devices and researching catalytic characteristics of CoS.

title_en: Automatic drying equipment for MEMS device wafer
abstract_en: An automatic drying device for MEMS device wafers comprises a control system, a bottom plate, an organic glass box body, a horizontal movement structure, a rotary movement structure and a vertical movement structure, the control system is positioned outside the organic glass box body and used for controlling the device to dry the MEMS device wafer, the organic glass box body is fixedly arranged on the bottom plate, the horizontal moving structure comprises a sliding groove and a sliding block, the rotary motion structure comprises a fixed disc and a rotary shaft, the vertical motion structure is positioned at one end of the horizontal motion structure and comprises a gas nozzle and a first sliding support rod, the MEMS device wafer is placed in a sealed organic glass box body for drying, so that the pollution of manual operation in an open environment to the microstructure of the MEMS device wafer is avoided, meanwhile, the invention realizes the automation of drying the MEMS device wafer by adopting a mechanical motion structure.

title_en: MEMS micromirror device and electrical apparatus
abstract_en: The invention relates to a MEMS micro-mirror based device and an electrical apparatus, comprising: the MEMS micro-mirror device module comprises an MEME micro-mirror group, a single body and a suspension membrane, and the electric device module comprises an image projection module and an image capture module. Compared with the prior art, the MEMS micro-reflector has the advantages that the support frame and the surrounding support area can be effectively isolated by adopting the insulation area, the minimum volume and the minimum power consumption can be realized by using the MEMS micro-reflector, the process is relatively simple, the reliability and the yield are high, and the cost of the device is effectively reduced.

title_en: Gold interdigital miniature electrochemical sensor and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a gold interdigital micro electrochemical sensor and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the gold interdigital micro electrochemical sensor comprises: the single crystal silicon substrate is of a first set thickness; a silicon dioxide layer with a second set thickness is arranged on the monocrystalline silicon substrate; the surface of the silicon dioxide layer is provided with interdigital electrode pairs, and the interdigital electrode pairs comprise a 10-20 nm nano titanium bonding layer and a 50-150 nm nano gold sensing layer from inside to outside. The manufacturing method adopts a manufacturing mode of integrated circuit micro-nano processing, takes silicon dioxide as an insulating substrate, and titanium/gold as a bonding layer/a sensing layer respectively, and is prepared by electron beam evaporation and metal stripping processes. And under the treatment of various organic reagent cleaning and vacuum low-temperature drying processes, gold interdigital micro electrochemical sensors with complete structural morphology and sensitive electrochemical characteristics are obtained in batches, the physical and chemical properties are more stable, the response is sensitive, and the gold interdigital micro electrochemical sensors can tolerate strong acid, strong alkali and various organic solutions.

title_en: Broadband response silicon micro-mechanical accelerometer with high vibration stability
abstract_en: The invention discloses a capacitance type silicon micro mechanical accelerometer structure with high vibration mode stability and wide frequency response characteristics, and belongs to the fields of inertia technology and Micro Electro Mechanical Systems (MEMS). The accelerometer comprises a substrate silicon body 3, anchor points 2 and a device layer 1 in sequence. The device layer 1 is suspended above the substrate silicon body 3 through the anchor points 2; the device layer 1 is composed of a frame type structure 4 and an elastic beam group 5; the frame type structure 4 is a square peripheral frame structure 4-2 and a structure which is in a shape like a Chinese character 'ri' and is formed by connecting a central beam 4-1. The accelerometer structure has the characteristics of easiness in processing, structural error immunity process error and the like, the structure with eight-claw configuration characteristics obviously improves the stability of in-plane vibration modes, the elastic beam and the anchor point of the inner frame restrain and inhibit out-of-plane vibration, the device structure can effectively compress useful vibration modes to first-order modes, a plurality of harmful vibration modes are squeezed to second-order and higher-order modes, the influence of the high-order harmful vibration modes on the first-order useful vibration modes is effectively isolated, the stability of the accelerometer structure in the high-frequency response range is obviously improved, and the device precision is improved.

title_en: Terbium ion doped up-conversion nano material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention belongs to the field of luminescent material technologyA red light-emitting terbium ion doped Ho 3+ A base up-conversion nano material and a preparation method thereof. The upconversion nano material is prepared by NaHoF 4 Is a core layer, and is coated with NaYF in turn 4 Tb shell layer, NaYbF 4 Tb shell and NaYF 4 Passivation layer, in turn using Tb 3+ : 5 D 4 Energy transfer between energy levels and Tb 3+ : 5 D 4 Energy level pair Ho 3+ : 5 S 2 / 5 F 4 Interfacial energy transfer of energy levels, transfer of excitation energy from the second shell layer to the core layer, and induce Ho 3+ Effect of cross relaxation between ions: ( 5 S 2 / 5 F 4 + 5 I 7 → 5 F 5 + 5 I 6 ) Finally, Ho is obtained 3+ The red light emission is converted on the basis. The up-conversion nano material has the advantages of simple preparation process, low equipment cost, easy operation and short preparation period, and is suitable for mass production.

title_en: Cathode active material with silicon carbide additive
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to cathode active materials having silicon carbide additives. The present disclosure relates to a lithium battery cathode material comprising a lithium transition metal based material selected from the group consisting of lithium transition metal oxides and lithium transition metal phosphates and crystalline silicon carbide residing at grain boundaries of the lithium transition metal based material forming conductive pathways along the grain boundaries, the crystalline silicon carbide being less than 10 wt% of the cathode material.

title_en: SnS2/Bi2O3Preparation method of composite photocatalyst
abstract_en: The invention discloses a SnS 2 /Bi 2 O 3 The preparation method of the composite photocatalyst comprises the step of preparing Bi 2 O 3 And supported on said Bi 2 O 3 Upper SnS 2 Nanoparticles of, in said catalyst, SnS 2 The mass percentage of the nano particles is 1-5%. The catalyst of the invention is SnS 2 /Bi 2 O 3 After compounding, as catalyst, in which SnS 2 The preparation method of the nano material is to prepare SnS by a vacuum hydrothermal method 2 The nano-particles are prepared by a simple method, tin chloride pentahydrate is used as a source substance, and the nano-particles are synthesized under the condition that sodium dodecyl benzene sulfonate and thioacetamide are used as a template agent and an auxiliary agent, so that the particles are uniformly distributed.

title_en: Preparation method of multi-wall fluorescent carbon nano tube
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a multi-walled fluorescent carbon nano tube, which is characterized in that diamine containing benzene rings and urea are used as raw materials and dissolved in a methyl chloride solvent, and the multi-walled carbon nano tube with fluorescent property is prepared through solvothermal reaction at 120-270 ℃. The chloromethane solution of the multi-wall fluorescent carbon nano tube prepared by the invention shows blue fluorescence property under the excitation of ultraviolet light, and an emission peak generates red shift along with the increase of excitation wavelength, thus showing obvious excitation dependence, and the fluorescence life of the multi-wall fluorescent carbon nano tube is about 16 ns; but the solid multi-wall fluorescent carbon nano-tube generates fluorescence quenching and does not emit light under various excitation wavelengths.

title_en: Method for extracting melanin from melanoma cells
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for extracting melanin from melanoma cells, which is to collect cell culture fluid for culturing the melanoma cells in vitro, firstly remove precipitates by centrifugation, then destroy vesicle structures secreted by the cells by a membrane lysis mode, purify other contents except melanin by an ultrafiltration centrifugation or dialysis method, and then dry to obtain melanin nano particles with good water solubility. The invention directly prepares the water-soluble small-size melanin nano-particles by the concept of 'waste utilization' and adopting a simple treatment process, has good biological histocompatibility and has wide application prospect in the aspect of medicines or medicine carriers.

title_en: Memory and forming method thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a memory and a forming method thereof, wherein the forming method comprises the following steps: providing a substrate, wherein the substrate is provided with a bit line structure; forming a first isolation layer on the side wall of the bit line structure; forming a sacrificial layer on the sidewall of the first isolation layer, wherein the first isolation layer is positioned between the sacrificial layer and the bit line structure, and the material of the sacrificial layer is a carbon-containing material; forming a second isolation layer on the side wall of the sacrificial layer, wherein the sacrificial layer is positioned between the second isolation layer and the first isolation layer; and removing the sacrificial layer by using an ashing process to form an air gap between the first isolation layer and the second isolation layer. The embodiment of the invention is beneficial to improving the performance of the formed memory.

title_en: Method for determining an optical system having a metasurface and associated product
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an optical system intended to be held by a frame and to be worn by a wearer, said optical system comprising a lens further comprising a metasurface formed by at least one set of nanostructures, at least said lens and said metasurface being designed to achieve an optical system transmission target optical function and an optical system reflection target optical function.

title_en: Flaky nano metallic nickel and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides flaky nano metallic nickel and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) mixing a blocking agent, a nickel salt, a reducing agent and a solvent to obtain a mixed solution; (2) and (2) carrying out solvothermal synthesis on the mixed solution obtained in the step (1) to obtain the flaky nano metal nickel, wherein the flaky nano metal nickel has a high specific surface area and a unique electronic structure, and has extremely high application value in the fields of light, electricity, magnetism, catalysis and the like.

title_en: Cap-less semiconductor package with micro-electro-mechanical system (MEMS)
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to a capless semiconductor package having a micro-electro-mechanical system (MEMS). A semiconductor package includes an Application Specific Integrated Circuit (ASIC) die and a micro-electromechanical systems (MEMS) die. The MEMS die and the ASIC die are coupled to a substrate that includes an opening that extends through the substrate and is in fluid communication with an air cavity that is positioned between and separates the MEMS die from the substrate. The opening exposes the air cavity to an external environment, and thereafter, the air cavity exposes the MEMS element of the MEMS die to the external environment. The air cavity separating the MEMS die from the substrate is formed using a manufacturing method that utilizes a thermally decomposable die attach material.

title_en: Catalyst for preferentially oxidizing CO in hydrogen-rich gas and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of catalyst materials, and particularly relates to a catalyst capable of preferentially oxidizing CO in hydrogen-rich gas, and further discloses a preparation method and application thereof. The catalyst for preferentially oxidizing carbon monoxide in hydrogen-rich gas takes a cerium source material and a zirconium source material as precursors, and a strong-base precipitator is used for preparing a cerium-zirconium solid solution as a carrier through a coprecipitation method; taking a chloroauric acid solution as a gold precursor, and preparing a catalyst loaded with trace gold by a deposition precipitation method by using a weakly alkaline precipitator; the catalyst can be applied to preferential oxidation of carbon monoxide in hydrogen-rich gas after reduction in hydrogen, has high catalytic activity under the condition of extremely small noble metal loading capacity, realizes high conversion rate of CO, can almost completely convert CO within the working temperature range of the PEMFC, has extremely high catalytic efficiency, good stability and is not easy to inactivate.

title_en: Circulating tumor cell biosensor based on PdIrBP mesoporous nanospheres and ketjen black
abstract_en: The detection and recovery of circulating tumor cells is of great clinical significance for monitoring the effects of metastasis and therapy. In this work we developed an integrated electrochemical sensing model based on nanomaterials to achieve highly sensitive detection and non-destructive collection of circulating tumor cells. The ketjen black and the gold nanoparticles are combined for the first time and used for modifying the surface of the gold electrode, thereby improving the conductivity and increasing the specific surface area of the electrode. PdIrBP mesoporous nanospheres and antibodies are combined together to form signaling probes, which are used as detection tags to amplify current signals. In addition, glycine hydrochloride was used as an antibody eluent, and captured circulating tumor cells could be released from the electrode and collected for further clinical studies. There is a good linear relationship between the electrochemical signal obtained and the target cell concentration in the range of 10/mL to 1X 10  6 /mL, with detection limits as low as 2/mL. Therefore, the novel cell sensor model has potential clinical application value and can be used for early diagnosis and prognosis monitoring of cancer patients.

title_en: Tolerogenic synthetic nanocarriers for antigen-specific deletion of effector T cells
abstract_en: The present application relates to tolerogenic synthetic nanocarriers for antigen-specific deletion of effector T cells. Disclosed herein are synthetic nanocarrier methods that comprise administering an immunosuppressive agent capable of producing a tolerogenic immune response (e.g., antigen-specific effector T cell depletion) and an MHC class I-restricted epitope and/or an MHC class II-restricted epitope, and related compositions.

title_en: Oxidation-resistant FeCo @ SiO2Core-shell structure material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an antioxidant FeCo @ SiO 2 The core-shell structure material is prepared by coating SiO on the surface of iron-cobalt alloy powder by sol-gel method with iron-cobalt alloy powder, ammonia water and tetraethyl orthosilicate as raw materials 2 To prepare FeCo @ SiO 2 A material. Compared with the prior art, the preparation method has the advantages of mild reaction, low cost, good repeatability and no pollution; preparing FeCo @ SiO 2 The material has an obvious core-shell structure, good dispersibility and good oxidation resistance.

title_en: Method for green synthesis of nanogold by using quercetin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for synthesizing nanogold by quercetin in a green way in the field of synthesis of nanomaterials, which adopts a tetrachloroaurate solution to add into a quercetin solution to prepare and synthesize quercetin-nanogold particles. The method takes water as a solvent, uses a renewable biological resource quercetin as a reducing agent and a stabilizing agent, and synthesizes the quercetin-gold nanoparticles by a one-step method. The synthesis method effectively avoids the harm to the environment, and the synthesized quercetin-nanogold particles have good biocompatibility, small particle size, good stability, short synthesis time and easy large-scale production. It can be applied to the fields of biological analysis and medicine research.

title_en: Carbon quantum dot using pepper as carbon source and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carbon quantum dot taking pepper as a carbon source and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the average particle size of the carbon quantum dot is 3-5 nm, the surface of the carbon quantum dot contains hydroxyl, amido, esters and alkenes, and the maximum excitation wavelength and the maximum emission wavelength are respectively 450 nm and 490 nm; the preparation method comprises the following steps of crushing the pepper, adding deionized water, stirring and dispersing, carrying out hydrothermal reaction, naturally cooling a reaction product, carrying out centrifugal separation, and filtering; and (4) carrying out vacuum freeze drying on the filtrate to obtain pepper powder serving as carbon source carbon quantum dots. The carbon quantum dots provided by the invention have stronger fluorescence and good biocompatibility, can enter cells and be uniformly distributed in HeLa cells, and have certain antibacterial performance.

title_en: Carbon point for detecting progesterone and progesterone detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carbon spot for detecting progesterone and a progesterone detection method, wherein the carbon spot is prepared by the following steps: 1) placing curcumin in a container, and heating to obtain an intermediate product; 2) cooling the intermediate product to room temperature, dissolving in ethanol, and centrifuging; 3) dialyzing the obtained centrifugate by using a dialysis bag, and freeze-drying the dialyzed product to obtain the carbon dots. The carbon dots prepared by the method have good stability, high luminous intensity, simple preparation and low cost, and the progesterone can specifically enhance fluorescence to the carbon dots; the progesterone detection method established by the carbon dots has the characteristics of low detection limit, accurate and reliable detection and high detection speed, can provide sensitive and accurate detection results, and has wide application prospects in the field of progesterone specificity detection.

title_en: Method for constructing maltose fuel cell by PdNPs/NiNPs/GO/AgNWs/electrode
abstract_en: A method for constructing a maltose fuel cell by PdNPs/NiNPs/GO/AgNWs/electrodes belongs to the field of fuel cells. The method comprises the steps of taking a PdNPs/NiNPs/GO/AgNWs/paper electrode as a working electrode, an Ag/AgCl electrode as a reference electrode and a platinum wire as an auxiliary electrode to form a three-electrode system, placing the three-electrode system in a maltose solution and a supporting electrolyte, setting the potential to be-0.2-1.3V, recording cyclic voltammetry curves of maltose with the concentrations of 1mmol/L, 3mmol/L, 4mmol/L and 5mmol/L, and analyzing the control process of the electrode electrocatalytic oxidation of the maltose solution by using a standard curve method. According to the invention, the electrode with high sensitivity to maltose is prepared by utilizing good flexibility of paper and combining good conductivity of silver nanowire graphene, and the electrode has the advantages of good catalytic effect, high sensitivity, good selectivity, stable structure and the like when maltose is used as a base liquid.

title_en: Mg-Li alloy nano powder and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses Mg-Li alloy nano powder and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the molar ratio of Li to Mg in the nano powder is less than 35%, and the particle size of the nano powder is less than 1 mu m. The method comprises the following steps: s1: preparing Mg-Li alloy ingots by using an induction furnace; s2: and preparing the Mg-Li alloy ingot in the S1 into Mg-Li alloy nano powder by adopting a hydrogen plasma arc instrument. The S1 includes the steps of: s1.1: placing Mg and Li in an induction furnace, and vacuumizing; s1.2: introducing inert gas into the induction furnace, smelting at the temperature of 800-. The Mg-Li alloy nano powder has excellent reversible hydrogen absorption and desorption capacity, is expected to meet DOE standard, and the preparation method of the alloy nano powder is simple to operate and suitable for large-scale production.

title_en: Sensor film structure and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a sensor film structure and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the structure comprises: a substrate, a first insulating layer, and a device layer. The substrate is provided with a first surface and a second surface opposite to the first surface, wherein a cavity is formed on the first surface, an opening is formed on the second surface, and the cavity is communicated with the opening. The cavity and the opening penetrate through the substrate along a direction perpendicular to the first surface. The first insulating layer is arranged on the first surface of the substrate. The device layer is disposed on the first insulating layer.

title_en: Preparation method of high-refractive-index all-dielectric nanosphere particles
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of high-refractive-index all-dielectric nanosphere particles. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of firstly forming a uniform nanosphere array on a substrate by means of gravity self-assembly, further adjusting the size of nanospheres in the array by means of dry etching according to actually required reflection or transmission wavelength, then immersing the nanosphere array into metal oxide sol, forming a high-refractive-index metal oxide coating layer on each nanosphere shell by taking the nanospheres as an inner core, wherein the formed all-dielectric nanosphere particles have remarkable Mie resonance characteristics.
