The invention can influence the electromagnetic resonance by adjusting the size, the distance and the arrangement mode of the nanospheres in the array, the thickness of the metal oxide coating layer and different crystal phases, thereby obtaining different reflection and transmission wavelengths. The prepared nanosphere particles have the advantages of high reflectivity, good stability and low cost, can be prepared in a large scale, and are expected to be applied to the fields of illumination display, optical detection, laser, solar cells, light emitting diodes and the like.

title_en: Preparation method and application of nanoflower array structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a nanoflower array structure, and relates to the technical field of micro-processing of nanocomposite materials, comprising the following preparation steps: (1) cleaning a silicon wafer; (2) Preparing a hexagonal close-packed polystyrene microsphere array structure by a self-assembly method; (3) Etching the hexagonal close-packed polystyrene microsphere array structure to obtain a sputtering substrate; (4) The nano flower array structure prepared by the invention has a petal structure with sharp top ends and sharp side edges by performing oblique and rotary magnetron sputtering on the surface of the sputtering substrate, the petal structure provides rich hot spots, and the distance between petals is smaller, so that the nano flower array structure is favorable for obtaining a very large local coupling field, and the SERS activity of the nano flower array structure is high.

title_en: Dynamic organic gadolinium nanoparticles and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic organic gadolinium nano-particle and application thereof, wherein the nano-particle is prepared by the following method: 1. respectively preparing 100 mu M gadolinium precursor aqueous solution and 4mM tris (2-carboxyethyl) phosphine aqueous solution; 2. mixing a gadolinium precursor aqueous solution and a tris (2-carboxyethyl) phosphine aqueous solution, wherein the molar ratio of the gadolinium precursor to the tris (2-carboxyethyl) phosphine is 25; 3. reacting gadolinium intermediate with Na  2  CO  3  And adjusting the pH value of the aqueous solution to 6.0, and stirring at room temperature to obtain the dynamic organic gadolinium nano-particles. The particle size of the nano-particles can be dynamically changed in different self-assembly stages and can be respectively used as T in different self-assembly stages  1  Contrast agent and T  2  The contrast agent can realize positive enhancement and negative enhancement effects of MRI signals by the same contrast agent, and can effectively improve the detection accuracy.

title_en: Nano particle with gold/silver/gold core-shell structure and synthesis method thereof
abstract_en: A method for synthesizing nano particles with gold/silver/gold core-shell structures comprises the following steps: synthesizing small-size gold nanoparticles; centrifuging the gold nanoparticles, removing large nanoparticles and small nanoparticles, and reducing the size distribution range of the gold nanoparticles to obtain gold seeds; diluting the purified seeds immediately and adding polyvinylpyrrolidone (MW 29000); hydroxylamine hydrochloride is used as a reducing agent, silver perchlorate is used as a silver source, and ammonia water is used for adjusting the acidity of the solution to generate gold/silver core-shell structure nano particles; taking hydroxylamine hydrochloride as a reducing agent, chloroauric acid as a gold source and bis (p-sulfophenyl) phenylphosphine dehydrated dipotassium as a protective agent, and growing a gold layer on the just synthesized gold/silver core-shell structure nanoparticles, namely the gold/silver/gold core-shell structure nanoparticles. The nano particles synthesized by the method have uniform properties and small size distribution range, have the advantages of difficult oxidation of the gold nano particles and sensitivity of the silver nano particles, and expand the application range of the nano particles in biological detection.

title_en: Hydrogen-electricity integrated device for continuous hydrogen production and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of hydrogen production devices, in particular to a hydrogen-electricity integrated device for continuously producing hydrogen, which comprises an anode, a cathode and electrolyte, wherein the anode is a continuous feeding metal material; the cathode is a hydrogen evolution catalyst; the electrolyte is an aqueous solution containing sodium chloride; the anode, the cathode and the electrolyte participate in the reaction, the product of the reaction is magnesium hydroxide, the magnesium hydroxide is filtered by a filtering or settling device, and the filtered or settled electrolyte is recycled and re-injected to participate in the reaction; the invention provides a hydrogen-electricity integrated device for continuously producing hydrogen, which keeps the stability of hydrogen production and power generation performance, can realize continuous hydrogen production and power generation, does not need to be stopped midway, and effectively saves manpower and production cost; the invention also provides the application of the hydrogen-electricity integrated device for continuously producing hydrogen, which not only can generate electricity, but also can prepare high value-added products of hydrogen and nano-scale magnesium hydroxide, thereby realizing the effective utilization of energy.

title_en: From Na2S2O3Preparation of carbon-supported nano MnO by medium2Oxygen reduction cathode and MFC
abstract_en: The invention relates to a compound of Na 2 S 2 O 3 Carbon-supported nano MnO prepared by medium 2 The oxygen reduction cathode and the MFC utilize carbon brushes, carbon felts, carbon cloths and carbon papers which are pretreatedA carbon-based material is subjected to nano MnO loading 2 (ii) a Load nano MnO 2 The treatment method of (1) Na in an amount of 0.01 to 0.1mol/L 2 S 2 O 3 In the solution medium, KMnO with the same volume and the concentration of 0.01-0.05mol/L is added by a peristaltic pump 4 A solution; 2) placing the pretreated carbon-based material in the mixed solution, heating to 50-90 deg.C, and loading Na on the carbon-based material 2 S 2 O 3 Reduction of KMnO 4 Generated nano MnO 2 . The invention uses carbon-based material and MnO 2 Not only overcomes the carbon-based material O 2 The defect of low catalytic reduction activity is overcome, and the advantage of high conductivity of the carbon-based material is also exerted; MnO 2 The particles with nanometer particle size exist and are highly dispersed, so that the cathode has higher O 2 Catalytic reduction activity.

title_en: Bispecific glycopeptide nano molecule and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a bispecific glycopeptide nano molecule, a preparation method and application thereof. The nano molecule comprises a target recognition unit, an enzyme hydrolysis substrate unit, a self-assembly unit and an immune recognition regulation unit, wherein the target recognition unit and the enzyme hydrolysis substrate unit are respectively connected with the self-assembly unit, and the immune recognition regulation unit is connected with the enzyme hydrolysis substrate unit. The bispecific glycopeptide nano-component can identify tumor cells in a targeted manner, self-assemble into nano-fibers at a tumor part, stay for a long time, block a signal path of a receptor for a long time, and in addition, the M2 type of tumor-related macrophages is re-polarized into M1 type, so that the anti-tumor immunity of T cells is enhanced, the tumor immunosuppression is improved, the tumor cell invasion capacity is inhibited, and the bottleneck that the tumors in cavity organs are easy to plant and relapse is broken through.

title_en: Core-shell structure FeP nano-chain, preparation method thereof and application thereof in battery
abstract_en: The invention provides a core-shell structure FeP nano-chain, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in a battery 2 Then FeOOH sheet-shaped nano-structure material is grown on the surface of the substrate, and the SiO in the substrate is treated by ammonia water 2 Removing the formed core-shell nanochain structure, and finally converting the core-shell nanochain structure and sodium hypophosphite into a core-shell FeP nanochain under calcination, wherein the one-dimensional core-shell structure has larger specific surface area and internal residual space, thereby effectively solving the problem that the volume structure of the material is greatly changed in the charging and discharging processThe core-shell structure can buffer the volume structure change in the charging and discharging process, and the cycle capacity and the stability of the battery are improved.

title_en: Nano silver wire purification device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nano silver wire purification device which comprises a box body, wherein an installation box is bolted to the top of the box body, a solvent box is bolted to the top of the installation box, a water pump is bolted to the right side of the top of the installation box, a water inlet of the water pump is communicated with a water inlet pipe, the left end of the water inlet pipe is communicated with the right side of the solvent box, and a water outlet of the water pump is communicated with a water outlet pipe. According to the invention, through the matching of the first motor, the first rotating shaft, the rotating plate, the first stirring shaft, the gear, the fixed disk and the first stirring blade, a user can conveniently and fully and rapidly mix the active agent and the nano silver wire solution, the addition of the active agent can obviously reduce the surface tension of the nano silver wire solution, so that the polyol of the nano silver wire solution can be easily removed, the mixing efficiency is greatly improved, and through the matching of the filter screen, the metal mesh screen and the filter membrane, the user can conveniently remove impurities and metal ions in the nano silver wire solution.

title_en: Preparation method and application of CuO-NiNPs/AgNWs/CNT/PDMS anode
abstract_en: A preparation method and application of a CuO-NiNPs/AgNWs/CNT/PDMS anode belong to the field of fuel cells. The invention takes polydimethylsiloxane as a flexible substrate, modifies a hydrophilic surface layer on the flexible substrate by using a mixed solution of polyvinyl alcohol and glycerol, uses silver nanowires doped with carbon nanotubes as a conducting layer, and deposits nano nickel-copper oxide particles on a base by using an electrochemical deposition method to prepare the nano nickel-copper oxide electrode. The invention utilizes the good conductivity of the silver wire doped carbon nano tube to prepare the electrode with high sensitivity to ethanol, and the electrode has the advantages of good catalytic effect, high sensitivity, good selectivity, stable structure and the like when the ethanol is used as a base liquid.

title_en: Fluorescent carbon quantum dot, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ion detection, and discloses a fluorescent carbon quantum dot, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of adding anhydrous citric acid, vitamin C and amino acid into a 50mL polytetrafluoroethylene reaction kettle, and adding 20mL ethanol for ultrasonic vibration to accelerate dissolution; placing the reaction kettle in an oven for heating, taking out the reaction kettle after heating, and cooling to room temperature; centrifuging the product in the reaction kettle, collecting supernatant, and filtering by using an oily filter head to collect filtrate; freeze drying, and dissolving in deionized water. The raw materials required by the preparation method disclosed by the invention can be obtained from nature, are low in price and easy to obtain, and the preparation method is simple and feasible and is suitable for large-scale production. When the light is excited by 400-500nm light, the emission wavelength is positioned at 500-600 nm; fluorescent quanta can be used for Cu 2+ Detecting; citric acid and vitamin C as raw materialsAmino acid, and the addition of the amino acid is found to improve the fluorescence quantum efficiency through comparison.

title_en: PdNPs/NiNPs/ITO electrode and method for constructing ethanol fuel cell by electrocatalytic oxidation of ethanol solution
abstract_en: The invention relates to a PdNPs/NiNPs/ITO electrode and a method for constructing an ethanol fuel cell by electrocatalytic oxidation of an ethanol solution. The method comprises the steps of taking a PdNPs/NiNPs/ITO electrode as a working electrode, an Ag/AgCl electrode as a reference electrode and a platinum wire as an auxiliary electrode to form a three-electrode system, placing the three-electrode system in an ethanol solution and a supporting electrolyte, setting the initial potential to be-0.2V, the termination potential to be 1.3V, recording cyclic voltammetry curves of ethanol with the concentrations of 20mmol/L, 40mmol/L, 60mmol/L, 80mmol/L and 100mmol/L, and analyzing the control process of the electrode in the electrocatalytic oxidation of the ethanol solution by using a standard curve method. The invention aims to develop a non-enzymatic fuel cell anode, which combines the advantages of nano materials to obtain a fuel cell anode with higher catalytic activity and stability, improve the conversion rate of chemical energy and promote the development of fuel cells.

title_en: Piezoelectric micro-mechanical actuator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a piezoelectric micro-mechanical actuator, which belongs to the technical field of piezoelectric micro-machines and solves the problem that the output displacement performance of the piezoelectric micro-mechanical actuator in the prior art is limited during working. The invention designs a three-stage displacement amplification mechanism with the mass block/displacement platform, the spring beam and the driving platform as cores, and improves the output performance of the piezoelectric micro-mechanical actuator.

title_en: Method for preparing carbon dots with different colors under same wavelength by using tobacco waste and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing carbon dots showing different colors under the same wavelength by utilizing tobacco waste and application thereof. The result shows that the tobacco derived carbon dots mainly comprise carbon, nitrogen and oxygen elements, the carbon dots have active groups such as amino groups and hydroxyl groups, and the carbon dots with different structures and different heteroatom doping can be obtained through the initial research on the biomass carbon dots prepared by taking tobacco as a carbon source, so that the possibility is provided for the diversified development of the structure and the property of the carbon dots.

title_en: Method for preparing nano crystal by oxidizing low-valent iodide or iodate
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for preparing nano crystals by oxidizing low-valent iodide or iodate, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: (1) preparing a reaction solution: 1-28g of potassium iodate or iodide was dissolved into 150mL of deionized water and the solution was adjusted to pH >7 with base: adding the reaction raw materials into the solution with the adjusted pH value, and uniformly stirring to prepare a reaction solution; (2) oxidizing the reaction solution, continuously stirring for 1-30d under the conditions of keeping out of the sun and normal temperature, stopping the reaction to obtain a solid in the reaction solution, and purifying the solid to obtain a nano crystal; the invention has mild reaction in the whole preparation process and avoids the generation of toxic and harmful products.

title_en: Preparation method of vertical nanowire array
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for preparing a vertical nanowire array, which adopts a double-self-aligned side wall transfer technology to form a nanoscale two-layer side wall cross array, utilizes the selection ratio of silicon oxide and silicon nitride and the Reactive Ion Etching (RIE) etching of the height difference of the cross position of the secondary side wall array to form a silicon nitride nanowire array, then uses the silicon nitride nanowire array as a mask to etch substrate silicon to form the vertical nanowire array, and finally uses an acidic solution to corrode the residual silicon nitride and silicon oxide to prepare the high-purity, nondestructive and orderly vertically arranged silicon nanowires.

title_en: Photo-thermal effect based super-hydrophobic surface modification method, surface super-hydrophobic material and application
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of material surface modification treatment, and relates to a super-hydrophobic surface modification method based on photo-thermal effect, a surface super-hydrophobic material and application, wherein the method comprises the following steps: (1) carrying out surface pretreatment on the base material; (2) fluorinating an epoxy resin curing agent, and simultaneously adding a photo-thermal material with a photo-thermal effect to prepare a super-hydrophobic coating material; (3) after simple transfer, thermal polymerization reaction of epoxy resin is initiated by infrared heat treatment, and super-hydrophobic modification of the surface of the base material is completed. The invention attaches the super-hydrophobic coating material with the photo-thermal material on the surface of the matrix material by simple coating, soaking and spraying methods, has simple preparation process, low equipment cost, uniform attachment and mild treatment conditions, can not damage the main body performance of various matrix materials, effectively improves the surface performance of the matrix materials, increases the light-irradiation heat-generating capacity by introducing the photo-thermal material, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Titanium dioxide nano material and application thereof
abstract_en: A titanium dioxide nano material and application thereof are disclosed, wherein the titanium dioxide nano material is prepared by a sol-gel method, and then a cold spraying process is selected to coat titanium dioxide nano powder on the surface of medical magnesium alloy, so as to obtain a magnesium alloy nano modified layer. Research shows that in the process of preparing the titanium dioxide nano material by the sol-gel method, the type of the surfactant can influence the particle size of the nano powder and further influence the corrosion resistance of the cold spraying modified layer, and when fatty glyceride is selected as the surfactant, the most excellent corrosion resistance modified layer can be obtained.

title_en: Melamine-formaldehyde resin coated vanadium dioxide photothermal response composite nano-particle and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a melamine-formaldehyde resin coated vanadium dioxide photothermal response composite nanoparticle and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of synthesis of nano polymer composite materials. The preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) vanadium dioxide (VO) 2 ) Surface modification; (2) preparing a prepolymer; (3) the modified VO 2 Dispersing into deionized water, and performing ultrasonic treatment; (4) adding the prepolymer prepared in the step (2) into the VO in the step (3) 2 Adjusting the pH value of the dispersion liquid, heating and stirring; (5) and introducing organic photoluminescence molecules, and performing post-treatment to obtain the vanadium dioxide photothermal response composite nano-particles coated by the melamine-formaldehyde resin. The preparation method of the composite nano-particles provided by the invention is simple, and can effectively improve VO 2 Easy agglomeration of nano-particles and poor weather resistance. VO can also be changed by introducing organic photoluminescent molecules 2 The color of the film improves the application range.

title_en: Method for manufacturing back cavity of micro-electromechanical sensor
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for manufacturing a back cavity of a micro-electromechanical sensor, which comprises the following steps: forming a recess in the substrate using a first Bosch process, the first Bosch process comprising alternately delivering an etching gas and a shielding gas to the substrate a plurality of times, the substrate having opposite front and back sides, the recess extending from the back side of the substrate into the substrate; and continuing to extend the recess to the front side of the substrate using a second Bosch process to form a back cavity through the substrate, the second Bosch process comprising alternating the delivery of the etching gas and the shielding gas to the substrate a plurality of times, wherein the etching rate of the first Bosch process to the substrate during the stage of delivering the etching gas to the substrate is higher than the etching rate of the second Bosch process to the substrate during the stage of delivering the etching gas to the substrate. According to the manufacturing method of the back cavity, the back cavity is formed through the two Bosch processes, and the etching rate in the first Bosch process is improved, so that the formation efficiency of the back cavity is improved.

title_en: Preparation method of green fluorescent carbon quantum dot hydrogel
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of green fluorescent carbon quantum dot hydrogel, belongs to the technical field of fluorescent nano material preparation, and can solve the problems of poor fluorescence, toxic raw materials, complex purification and high temperature of the existing preparation method of carbon quantum dots, and the preparation method of the green fluorescent carbon quantum dot hydrogel comprises the following steps: weighing polyvinylpyrrolidone, stirring and dissolving, adding ascorbic acid into the mixture, and reacting at 60-90 ℃ by a one-pot method for 10-20 h, wherein the quantum yield of the prepared carbon quantum dots is more than 30%; the prepared solution is heated to boiling, gel materials are weighed and dissolved, and the solution is poured into a mold for cooling to form the green fluorescent carbon quantum dot hydrogel.

title_en: Water-based organic nano ink applied to organic thin film device and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses water-based organic nano ink applied to an organic thin film device and a preparation method thereof, wherein the water-based organic nano ink comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 30-40 parts of silver nitrate, 15-20 parts of polyvinylpyrrolidone, 0.8-1.0 part of N, N-dimethylformamide solution, 6-8 parts of protective agent, 8-12 parts of reducing agent and 3-5 parts of dispersant. The water-based organic nano ink applied to the organic thin film device is characterized in that N, N-dimethylformamide is used as a reducing agent, and meanwhile, under the action of a surfactant polyvinylpyrrolidone, proper temperature and reaction time are set, so that silver nitrate is subjected to a reduction reaction to generate nano silver particles fully wrapped by the polyvinylpyrrolidone, the polyvinylpyrrolidone is used as the surfactant to well prevent the nano silver particles in a solution from agglomerating, the nano silver ink has good dispersibility and stability, and the modified polyacrylic acid is interacted with the silver surface through carboxyl, so that the agglomeration and the growth of the silver particles are prevented.

title_en: Titanium dioxide nanotube/molybdenum disulfide nanoflower compound and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of nano material preparation and antibiosis, and relates to a titanium dioxide nanotube/molybdenum disulfide nanoflower compound, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the titanium dioxide nanotube is placed in an ethanol mixed solution containing dibenzyl disulfide and sodium molybdate, and is prepared through solvothermal reaction; the molybdenum disulfide nanoflowers are loaded on the surface of the titanium dioxide nanotube, the average size of the titanium dioxide nanotube is 75+/-5 nm, and the average size of the molybdenum disulfide nanoflowers is 230+/-20 nm; because the compound has visible light photocatalysis and peroxidase-like activity, the compound is applied to antibiosis and promotion of wound healing based on the synergistic effect of the visible light photocatalysis and the peroxidase-like activity; the composite is a nano bionic material, the preparation method thereof has ingenious conception, simple preparation process, green and environment-friendly performance, rich raw materials and low cost; the antibacterial mode is novel, visible light is the main component of sunlight, and visible light is fully utilized to perform photocatalysis to enhance enzyme-like activity; the application environment and biocompatibility are good, and the market prospect is wide.

title_en: Ceramide dispersion composition
abstract_en: Disclosed is a method for stably dispersing a naturally-derived free ceramide having a long-chain fatty acid in a ceramide skeleton (particularly a naturally-derived human free ceramide) in an aqueous phase. More specifically, the ceramide dispersion composition contains a naturally-derived free ceramide, a nonionic surfactant, a phospholipid, and a diol having 2 to 6 carbon atoms, wherein the content mass ratio of the naturally-derived free ceramide to the diol is 1: 3 to 25, wherein the free ceramide contained in the naturally derived free ceramide is a free ceramide in which a fatty acid in a ceramide skeleton is a fatty acid having 20 or more carbon atoms.

title_en: Preparation method and application of nitrogen-doped carbon nanofiber composite hollow carbon shell film
abstract_en: A preparation method and application of a nitrogen-doped carbon nanofiber composite hollow carbon shell film relate to a preparation method and application of a battery cathode material. The invention aims to solve the problems of small electronic conductivity, poor capacity and rate capability and complex preparation of a negative electrode material pole piece of the conventional bimetallic alloy SbSn as a negative electrode material of a sodium-ion battery. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, preparing SiO 2 @SiO 2 a/RF material; secondly, preparing a hollow carbon shell; and thirdly, preparing the film in a compounding way. A nitrogen-doped carbon nanofiber composite hollow carbon shell film negative electrode material is used for preparing a sodium ion battery. The first-loop charging specific capacity of the sodium ion battery prepared by the invention can reach 1138 mAh.g ‑1 The specific discharge capacity of the first ring can reach 889 mAh.g ‑1 Coulombic efficiency can be maintained at 74.8%. The invention can obtain the nitrogen-doped carbon nanofiber composite hollow carbon shell film.

title_en: Biosensor system package and method of manufacturing the same
abstract_en: The biosensor system package includes: a transistor structure in a semiconductor layer having a front side and a back side, the transistor structure including a channel region; a multilayer interconnect (MLI) structure on the front side of the semiconductor layer, the transistor structure being electrically connected to the MLI structure; a carrier substrate on the MLI structure; a first through-substrate via (TSV) structure extending through the carrier substrate and configured to provide electrical connection between the MLI structure and the individual die; a Buried Oxide (BOX) layer on a backside of the semiconductor layer, wherein the buried oxide layer has an opening on the backside of the channel region and an interfacial layer covers the backside over the channel region; and a microfluidic channel cap structure attached to the buried oxide layer. Embodiments of the present application also relate to methods of manufacturing biosensor system packages.

title_en: Transition metal doped compound with metal-air battery autocatalysis activity
abstract_en: The invention relates to a transition metal doped compound with autocatalysis activity of a metal-air battery, wherein the chemical formula is expressed as M x N y O 2 Wherein M is a transition metal, N is a first or second main group metal, 0<x≤0.1,0.90≤y<1.00, the transition metal doped discharge product uniformly grows on the anode in situ in a nanosheet array form, and the metal M is uniformly dispersed in the peroxide of N. The invention synthesizes M in situ by means of cell reaction x N y O z The material and the self-catalyzed battery system are constructed to show excellent performance, so that the overpotential in the charge and discharge process is greatly reduced, and the battery is greatly improvedAnd (4) stability of operation. The lithium-air battery with the autocatalysis performance is simple to prepare, the substance with catalytic activity is the peroxide doped with Co generated in the charging and discharging processes of the battery, the independent preparation is not needed, the preparation can be completed by adopting the commercialized raw materials with low cost, and the lithium-air battery has industrial advantages.

title_en: Method for regulating and controlling semiconductor corrosion area
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for regulating and controlling a semiconductor corrosion area, which belongs to the technical field of nano semiconductor materials; comprising the following steps: mixing hydrofluoric acid and a metal salt solution to obtain a deposition solution; mixing hydrofluoric acid and an oxidant to obtain a corrosive liquid; immersing the semiconductor substrate into the deposition solution for deposition; processing the substrate obtained after deposition to ensure that the surface of the substrate has different wet states; and then carrying out corrosion to obtain the nano semiconductor material. The invention can ensure that the corrosion area is completely matched with the coverage area of the metal or the corrosion area is larger than the coverage area of the metal by regulating and controlling the surface infiltration state of the substrate after deposition, thereby ensuring that the nano semiconductor material has excellent photoelectric, thermoelectric and electrochemical properties according to different requirements. The results of the examples show that the etched area of the nano semiconductor material prepared after the drying treatment is completely matched with the covered area of the metal, and the nanowire array is compact and uniform.

title_en: Chitosan nanoparticles and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides chitosan nanoparticles and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of nano materials. Dissolving low-molecular-weight chitosan in a glacial acetic acid aqueous solution, and adjusting the pH of the solution to 4-5 to obtain a low-molecular-weight chitosan solution; and adding the sodium tripolyphosphate solution into the low-molecular-weight chitosan solution for reaction until a Tyndall effect is generated, thus obtaining the chitosan nanoparticles. The particle size of the chitosan nanoparticle prepared by the invention is 98-122nm, the preparation condition of the chitosan-based nanoparticle is optimized, and the chitosan nanoparticle with controllable particle size and good dispersibility can be prepared.

title_en: Au @ AgNRs nanorod as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of thiram detection, and particularly relates to an Au @ AgNRs nanorod as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The method comprises the steps of adding ascorbic acid, silver nitrate solution and sodium hydroxide solution into gold nanorods, obtaining silver-plated gold nanorods after primary silver plating, and obtaining Au @ AgNRs nanorods after chloroplatinic acid etching and secondary silver plating. The outer layer of the silver-plated gold nanorod is etched by chloroplatinic acid, a shell with a rough surface is formed, the surface of the outer layer becomes extremely irregular, after silver plating is performed again, the contact area of the core-shell structure is indirectly increased, more 'hot spots' occur, a stronger electromagnetic field is generated, the surface Raman effect of the nanorod is remarkably enhanced, and the nanorod can be better applied to Raman imaging or Raman sensing and other applications. The Au @ AgNRs nanorod prepared by the method can be used for qualitative or quantitative detection of thiram.

title_en: Fluorescent carbon quantum dot, preparation method thereof and application of fluorescent carbon quantum dot in preparation of antitumor drug sensitizer
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medicine, and relates to a biosafety anti-tumor drug sensitizer, and a preparation method and application thereof. The invention takes sugar as raw material and oil as reaction solvent to prepare the fluorescent carbon quantum dots by heating and stirring similar to the traditional cooking. Compared with the traditional carbon quantum dot preparation method, the preparation method provided by the invention is simple, time-saving, easy to implement, simple in preparation condition requirements, low in cost and capable of realizing large-scale preparation. The prepared fluorescent carbon quantum dots are uniform in size, stable and adjustable in fluorescence emission, high in water dispersibility, high in safety and good in biocompatibility. Meanwhile, the carbon quantum dot has the chemical structural characteristics similar to glucose, can competitively inhibit the glucose uptake of tumor cells, interfere the growth and proliferation of the tumor cells, improve the sensitivity of the tumor cells to various anti-tumor agents and improve the tumor treatment effect, is a sensitizer for widely enhancing the tumor treatment effect, and can be popularized and applied to the combined treatment of various tumors.

title_en: Novel anti-magnetic suspension voltage induction type micro-driver and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel anti-magnetic suspension voltage induction type micro-driver, which comprises: the permanent magnet array, the driving system and the suspension platform are sequentially arranged from bottom to top, the permanent magnet array comprises N rectangular magnets, N is an even number, and the permanent magnets are naturally attracted together and symmetrically arranged; the driving system comprises two-phase alternating current, four-phase parallel driving electrodes, two-phase parallel driving electrodes, a first induction electrode and a second induction electrode. The novel anti-magnetic suspension voltage induction type micro-driver solves the problem that the micro-driver is greatly influenced by friction force due to the reduction of size, and is driven under a silent condition, so that the performance and the stability of a micro-system are improved; the micro-driver can be controlled in a programmable mode, can be controlled accurately through digital control, and is high in reliability.

title_en: Method for preparing metal particle-loaded coal-based graphene through high-temperature thermal shock
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a method for preparing metal particle loaded coal-based graphene through high-temperature thermal shock, wherein nano metal particles are introduced into a carbon source through a dipping reduction method. According to the method, the carbon sources such as coal, coal pitch, coke and coal-based graphite are subjected to high-temperature thermal shock graphitization and metal salt thermal reduction by using the joule heat generated by capacitive discharge, and the coal-based graphene-loaded metal particles are generated in a short time. The metal used in the process of loading the metal nanoparticles is transition metal such as Fe, Co, Ni, Cu and the like, and the metal salt is chloride or hydrate thereof, acetate or hydrate thereof. The preparation method is simple, low in cost, high in product graphitization degree, excellent in performance, suitable for large-scale production and important in application value.

title_en: Salix purpurea carbonized nanoparticle, Salix purpurea carbonized nanoparticle reinforced composite material, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a red willow carbonized nanoparticle, a red willow carbonized nanoparticle reinforced composite material, and a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of composite materials. According to the salix purpurea carbonized nanoparticle reinforced composite material provided by the invention, the salix purpurea carbonized nanoparticles are added into the thermosetting resin, a discontinuous phase structure is formed between the thermosetting resin and the fibers by the salix purpurea carbonized nanoparticles and the mechanical characteristics of the salix purpurea carbonized nanoparticles are utilized, so that the strength and toughness of the composite material are obviously improved, and meanwhile, the cost of the composite material can be effectively reduced and the application range is expanded due to the low cost of the raw materials of the salix purpurea carbonized nanoparticles.

title_en: Preparation method of three-terminal three-dimensional artificial synapse electronic device based on P3HT nanowire
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a three-terminal three-dimensional artificial synapse electronic device based on a P3HT nanowire. The method comprises the following steps: spraying the carbon nano tube aqueous dispersion on the silicon oxide sheet stuck with the mask plate to obtain an electrode made of the carbon nano tube layer; taking down the mask plate, coating an ionic liquid solution on the silicon oxide wafer, drying, and removing the ionic glue to obtain an ionic glue substrate on which an electrode-shaped carbon nanotube layer is distributed; obtaining a P3HT nanowire on the surface of the ionic glue substrate on which the electrode-shaped carbon nanotube layer is distributed in an electrostatic spinning mode; and then, attaching the second ion glue layer on the material obtained in the previous step to obtain the three-terminal three-dimensional synapse electronic device. The electronic device obtained by the invention can sense stimulation in multiple directions such as positive and negative directions, realizes simulation of biological synapses in a real sense, and has great significance for large-scale integration and array application.

title_en: Tin-manganese stannate-nitrogen carbon composite material with hollow cubic structure and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tin-manganese stannate-nitrogen carbon composite material with a hollow cubic structure, and a preparation method and application thereof. The composite material is a hollow cubic structure, and the cubic structure can provide enough space to buffer volume expansion during charge and discharge, so that pulverization of an electrode is prevented. Meanwhile, the carbon layer wrapped by the outer layer of the composite material relieves the stress of the volume change of the electrode on one hand and improves the conductivity of the material on the other hand. Particularly, nitrogen atoms are doped, so that the carbon material has more defects, the electron/ion conductivity is increased, the electron/ion transmission is accelerated, and the specific capacity and the cycle performance of the material are improved.

title_en: High-purity cadmium stannate powder and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of photovoltaic power generation semiconductor conductive powder, in particular to high-purity cadmium stannate powder and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: mixing cadmium hydroxide powder, stannous oxide powder and oxalic acid solution, heating and drying to generate cadmium oxalate and stannic oxalate; and then placing the mixture into a reaction kettle, heating the mixture under a vacuum condition to generate cadmium stannate and cadmium stannous oxide, reacting oxalic acid with cadmium hydroxide to generate cadmium oxalate, introducing oxygen to continue heating, decomposing the cadmium oxalate to release heat, continuing generating the cadmium stannate and the cadmium stannous oxide, reacting the cadmium stannate with the oxygen to obtain the cadmium stannate, and cooling the cadmium stannate powder. The invention can reduce the reaction temperature, has no pollution to the environment, has complete reaction, generates the cadmium stannate with uniform color, high single-phase rate, has no caking problem, has excellent conductive performance, and obtains ideal single-phase micron-grade or nano-grade cadmium stannate powder.

title_en: High-purity cadmium stannate powder and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of photovoltaic power generation semiconductor conductive powder, in particular to high-purity cadmium stannate powder and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: mixing cadmium hydroxide powder, stannous oxide powder and oxalic acid solution, heating and drying to generate cadmium oxalate and stannic oxalate; and then placing the mixture into a reaction kettle, heating the mixture under a vacuum condition to generate cadmium stannate and cadmium stannous oxide, reacting oxalic acid with cadmium hydroxide to generate cadmium oxalate, introducing oxygen to continue heating the mixture, decomposing the cadmium oxalate to release heat, continuing to generate cadmium stannate and cadmium stannous oxide, reacting the cadmium stannate with the oxygen to obtain cadmium stannate, and cooling the cadmium stannate to obtain cadmium stannate powder. The invention can reduce the reaction temperature, has no pollution to the environment, has complete reaction, generates the cadmium stannate with uniform color, high single-phase rate, has no caking problem, has excellent conductive performance, and obtains ideal single-phase micron-grade or nano-grade cadmium stannate powder.

title_en: Preparation method of tungsten single crystal surface step confinement two-dimensional tungsten nitride
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of two-dimensional tungsten nitride of a step confinement on the surface of a tungsten single crystal, which mainly comprises the following steps: carrying out surface pretreatment on the single crystal W; heating the pretreated W substrate to 600-670 ℃, and introducing ammonia gas with the pressure of 1 x 10 ‑7 ～1×10 ‑6 And (3) performing real-time imaging through a surface imaging instrument, observing the growth of the tungsten nitride on the surface of the single crystal W in situ, and cooling in ammonia gas after the tungsten nitride reaches the required coverage degree to obtain the two-dimensional tungsten nitride. The preparation method for directly nitriding the substrate by modulating the temperature and the atmospheric pressure is simple and easy to implement, uses a surface imaging instrument to perform real-time imaging in the preparation process, enables the structure to be easily controlled, can be expanded to the controllable preparation of other transition metal nitrides, and lays a good foundation for the controllable preparation and application research of subsequent nitride film materials.

title_en: Preparation method of powder graphene with adjustable size
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of powder graphene, which regulates and controls the size of gas-phase graphene by controlling nucleation density and/or time of reaction atmosphere flowing through a reaction zone in the growth process. The method is simple and effective, realizes the size regulation of the graphene in the gas phase for the first time, and can control the appropriate increase or decrease of the size of the graphene. And the graphene quantum dots can be directly obtained in a gas phase, and compared with the traditional method, the method is simple and efficient, and the graphene is pure and has high crystallinity.

title_en: Electrochemical catalysis method for highly selective hydrogenation of carbon-carbon triple bonds
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of hydrogenation catalysis, and discloses an electrochemical catalytic method for highly selective hydrogenation of carbon-carbon triple bonds, which aims to solve the problems that hydrogen is required to be used as a raw material in a catalytic hydrogenation method of a carbon-carbon triple bond compound in the prior art, the carbon-carbon triple bond is easy to be hydrogenated to a carbon-carbon single bond, the selectivity is poor, the purity of a carbon-carbon double bond product is low, the content of a noble metal element in a used catalyst is high, and the cost is high, and the electrochemical catalytic method comprises the following steps: adding a reactant containing carbon-carbon triple bonds into the catholyte, adding a reducing agent into the anolyte, inserting a working electrode, a reference electrode and an auxiliary electrode which are prepared by coating a palladium-iron alloy catalyst on carbon paper into the electrolyte, and carrying out electrocatalytic reaction. The invention can control the hydrogenation reaction of the reactant with carbon-carbon triple bonds to be semi-hydrogenation instead of over-hydrogenation, has good selectivity and high catalytic efficiency, does not need to add hydrogen in the reaction, has safe reaction, high electron utilization rate and low energy consumption, and has simple and convenient preparation of the catalyst used in the reaction and lower cost.

title_en: Polyacrylonitrile antibacterial superfine fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of chemical synthesis and electrostatic spinning, and discloses a preparation method of polyacrylonitrile antibacterial superfine fiber, which comprises the following steps: step one, preparing high-melt-index polyacrylonitrile based on supercritical carbon dioxide: uniformly mixing an acrylonitrile monomer, a second monomer and a third monomer to obtain a mixed monomer, adding 5-30 wt% of the mixed monomer and an initiator into a supercritical carbon dioxide high-pressure reaction kettle for reaction, after reacting for 1-2 hours, injecting the rest of the mixed monomer into the reaction kettle, and continuing to react for 1-5 hours to obtain PAN resin; step two, preparing the antibacterial polyacrylonitrile superfine fiber: and uniformly mixing the PAN resin powder and the flow dispersing auxiliary agent, and adding the mixture into a melt differential electrostatic spinning feeding device for electrostatic spinning to obtain the superfine fiber.

title_en: Quick-charging lithium air battery with self-catalytic activity
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fast-charge lithium-air battery with self-catalytic activity, which comprises a positive electrode, a diaphragm, electrolyte and a negative electrode, wherein a transition metal doped discharge product in the form of a nano sheet array grows on the positive electrode in situ, and the chemical formula of the transition metal doped discharge product is expressed as M  x  Li  y  O  2  Wherein M is a transition metal, 0<x≤0.1,0.90≤y<1.00; the electrolyte is obtained by dissolving lithium salt in an ether organic solvent, wherein the ether organic solvent comprises fluorine-containing ether compounds. The discharge product with self-catalytic activity greatly reduces the overpotential in the charge and discharge process, and greatly improves the running stability of the battery. The lithium air battery with the self-catalytic performance is simple to prepare, the substance with the catalytic activity is the transition metal doped lithium peroxide generated in the charging and discharging process of the battery, the preparation can be completed without independent preparation, and the preparation can be completed by adopting commercial raw materials with low cost, so that the lithium air battery has industrial advantages.

title_en: Dendritic composite nanowire three-dimensional electrode material for hexavalent chromium-containing sewage treatment and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a dendritic composite nanowire three-dimensional electrode material for hexavalent chromium-containing sewage treatment, which comprises the following steps: growing a polypyrrole nanowire loaded three-dimensional electrode material on a three-dimensional anode; adding aniline into sulfuric acid, adding a polypyrrole nanowire loaded three-dimensional electrode material, uniformly stirring, and cooling to 4-5 ℃; adding ammonium persulfate into sulfuric acid at the temperature of 4-5 ℃, stirring, and immediately adding into the solution in S2 to obtain a mixed solution; and after stirring, standing and reacting for 24-25 hours in an environment of 4-5 ℃ to obtain the dendritic composite nanowire three-dimensional electrode material. The invention also discloses the dendritic composite nanowire three-dimensional electrode material and application thereof. The dendritic composite nanowire three-dimensional electrode material has larger specific surface area, can provide more reactive sites, improves the current efficiency and the reduction efficiency, and is suitable for high-flux and high-concentration treatment of large-scale industrial Cr (VI) sewage.

title_en: High-capacity cathode material nano Li 1.3 Mn 0.4 Ti 0.3 O 2 Preparation method of (1)
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-capacity anode material nano Li  1.3  Mn  0.4  Ti  0.3  O  2  The preparation method comprises the steps of ultrasonically dissolving tetrabutyl titanate and manganese acetate in a mixed solvent of deionized water and ethylene glycol, and dissolving 2-ethylhexane sodium sulfosuccinate in the deionized water and the ethylene glycol; heating in water bath to mix the two solutions; adjusting the pH value of the system to 7 to 9 by using ammonia water; transferring the solution into a stainless steel reaction kettle with a polytetrafluoroethylene lining for hydrothermal reaction; carrying out centrifugal suction filtration, washing and drying on the product to obtain precursor powder; presintering the precursor powder, cooling to obtain Ti-Mn oxide; mixing with lithium oxalate, adding absolute ethyl alcohol, fully grinding, and standing until the ethyl alcohol is completely volatilized; putting the obtained sample in a muffle furnace and introducing oxygen for calcination to obtain a target product Li  1.3  Mn  0.4  Ti  0.3  O  2  And (3) a positive electrode material. The invention has simple preparation process, is used for preparing the lithium ion battery and has higher charge-discharge specific capacity.

title_en: Silicon carbide pressure sensor chip with multilayer embossment and island film structure and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a silicon carbide pressure sensor chip with a multilayer relief and island film structure and a preparation method thereof, wherein the chip structure comprises a chip substrate, a silicon carbide relief layer, an insulating relief layer and a metal relief layer which are sequentially stacked from bottom to top; the silicon carbide relief layer is separated from the silicon carbide outer frame relief layer and the silicon carbide inner frame relief layer through narrow isolation channels, the structures of the insulating relief layer and the metal relief layer are both supported on the silicon carbide relief layer, the structure of the insulating relief layer is the same as that of the silicon carbide relief layer, and the structure of the metal relief layer is the same as that of the silicon carbide bridge relief layer. The insulating relief layer insulates and electrically isolates the silicon carbide relief layer and the metal relief layer in regions except for the contact ports, so that an electric signal can be conducted in the specified contact ports, and then the electric connection with the silicon carbide bridge relief layer is realized through the contact point metal layer.

title_en: Preparation method of high-flexibility integral nano carbon fiber membrane
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a high-flexibility integral nano carbon fiber membrane, which comprises the following steps: the coke powder is treated by the mixed acid solution of concentrated sulfuric acid and concentrated nitric acid in a refluxing way, and is washed and dried to obtain coke oxide powder, and the high-flexibility integral type carbon nanofiber membrane is prepared by electrostatic spinning, preoxidation and carbonization by taking the coke oxide powder as a raw material and PVB and/or PVP as a spinning aid and a pore-forming agent. The carbon nanofiber membrane prepared by the method has the characteristics of high flexibility, integral type, adjustable specific surface area, high conductivity and the like. The invention uses cheap and easily obtained coke as a carbon source to produce the flexible carbon nanofiber membrane, thereby realizing high-value utilization of the coke. Compared with the method for preparing the carbon nanofiber membrane by polyacrylonitrile electrostatic spinning, the method has the advantages of cheap and easily-obtained raw materials, good product flexibility, high specific surface area and the like. The high-flexibility integral nano carbon fiber membrane prepared by the method can be widely applied to the fields of electrochemical energy storage, adsorption separation, catalysis and the like.

title_en: Lithium-carbon dioxide battery anode catalyst and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electrochemistry and new energy, and relates to a lithium-carbon dioxide battery anode catalyst and a preparation method thereof. The material has simple and efficient preparation process, does not need special experimental equipment, is prepared into irregular three-dimensional nano structures in which iridium-copper nano cages are connected with one another to form a winding structure, has larger specific surface area and excellent conductivity, shows excellent cycling stability when being used as a high-efficiency catalyst for the anode of a lithium-carbon dioxide battery, and provides possibility for industrial production and practical application of the lithium-carbon dioxide battery.

title_en: Flow sensing device, method of manufacturing the same, and fluid characteristic measurement system
abstract_en: A flow sensing device, a method of manufacturing the same, and a fluid property measurement system are disclosed. Embodiments of coriolis force based flow sensing device and methods for manufacturing embodiments of coriolis force based flow sensing devices include the steps of: forming a driving electrode; forming a first sacrificial region on the driving electrode; forming a first structure portion in which a second sacrificial region is buried on the first sacrificial region; forming an opening for selectively etching the second sacrificial region; forming a porous layer having pores within the openings; removing the second sacrificial region through the pores of the porous layer to form a buried channel; growing a second structure portion on the porous layer and not within the buried channel, the second structure portion forming a structure with the first structure region; the first sacrificial region is selectively removed, thereby suspending the structure over the drive electrode.

title_en: Near infrared chemiluminescent emitter with aggregation-induced emission properties
abstract_en: Compounds exhibiting near infrared chemiluminescence comprising triphenylamine and luminol moieties, for use as active oxygen sensors, pharmaceutical compositions comprising the compounds, and methods of making and using the compounds.

title_en: Electrode catalyst layer for carbon dioxide electrolysis cell, electrolysis cell provided with same, and electrolysis device for carbon dioxide electrolysis
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an electrode catalyst layer for a carbon dioxide electrolysis cell, an electrolysis cell provided with the same, and an electrolysis device for carbon dioxide electrolysis. [ problem ] to]The invention provides a catalyst layer for a carbon dioxide reduction electrode, and a carbon dioxide electrolysis device, which exhibit a high local current density by controlling wettability and which are resistant to long-term operation. [ solution means ] to]The catalyst layer is a catalyst layer comprising a metal catalyst supported on a carbon material, an ion-conductive substance and a hydrophilic polymer, and the BET specific surface area (A) of the catalyst layer is determined by a nitrogen adsorption method N2 ) And BET specific surface area (A) determined by steam adsorption H2O ) Ratio of (A) H2O /A N2 ) Is 0.08 or less.

title_en: Patterned SiC fine structure and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a patterned SiC microstructure and application thereof. The patterned SiC microstructure is a SiC nanoneedle array grown on a patterned gold film on a 6H-SiC wafer substrate, and nanoneedles are vertical to the surface of the gold film and have a tapered bamboo-like geometric shape and a sharp tip. The nanoneedle has a length of 0.1-100 μm, a root diameter of about 180nm, and a tip diameter of about 10 nm. The patterned SiC fine structure is used as a terahertz wave-absorbing material. The patterned terahertz wave-absorbing material with the SiC fine structure has enhanced wave-absorbing performance and is insensitive to an incident angle.

title_en: Two-dimensional tungsten selenide nano material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a two-dimensional tungsten selenide nano material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: (a) sequentially carrying out ultrasonic cleaning on the substrate in acetone, isopropanol, absolute ethyl alcohol and deionized water, taking out the substrate, and drying the substrate by using nitrogen for later use; (b) respectively placing the substrate and the tungsten source into a slot of a sample table; the tungsten source is tungsten foil subjected to oxidation treatment; (c) filling selenium powder into a small quartz tube, then putting the small quartz tube and a sample table into a large quartz tube, vacuumizing the large quartz tube, and sealing the tube; (d) and (3) putting the large quartz tube into a tube furnace, and then growing at high temperature for 10-60min to obtain the material. The method does not need to introduce any carrier gas, the growth is completely carried out in a high vacuum environment, and the process controllability and the repeatability are strong; meanwhile, through equipment amplification, the preparation method can realize the preparation of the large-size high-yield two-dimensional nanosheet, and is suitable for large-scale industrial production.

title_en: Nano gene medicine transfer carrier
abstract_en: The invention relates to a nano gene drug transport carrier, in particular to a nano gene drug transport carrier with biodegradability and good biocompatibility, a unique loading mode and unique fluorescence performance, and can be used for microscopic imaging technology and visibility research. The invention firstly designs a preparation method of spherical calcium phosphate growing on crystal nucleus, and secondly introduces carbon quantum dots as the crystal nucleus to ensure that the obtained carrier obtains fluorescence property; and taking the gene and the drug as crystal nuclei again to prepare the spherical calcium phosphate nano gene vector drug carrier. In the synthesized calcium phosphate nano-gene drug carrier, crystal nuclei thereof comprise quantum dots, carbon quantum dots, drugs, nucleic acids and the like; the gene or the drug can be used as a crystal nucleus per se, and can be loaded on the crystal nucleus or on the outside of the spherical calcium phosphate in a mode of physical adsorption, covalent interaction, ionic bond interaction and the like.

title_en: Preparation method of monodisperse nano calcium fluoride transparent liquid phase dispersion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a monodisperse nano calcium fluoride transparent liquid phase dispersoid, which comprises the following steps: 1) dissolving calcium salt in an organic solvent to prepare a calcium salt solution; dissolving villiaumite in an organic solvent to prepare villiaumite solution; 2) mixing a calcium salt solution and a villiaumite solution, stirring the mixture to perform precipitation reaction, and then centrifugally washing the mixture to obtain a filter cake, and dispersing the filter cake in water to form a calcium fluoride water-phase dispersion; 3) adding a solvent and a modifier into the calcium fluoride aqueous phase dispersoid for modification to obtain modified nano calcium fluoride particles; 4) and centrifugally washing the modified nano calcium fluoride particles, and ultrasonically dispersing the modified nano calcium fluoride particles into a dispersing agent to obtain the monodisperse nano calcium fluoride transparent liquid-phase dispersion. The preparation method of the invention obtains monodisperse calcium fluoride nano-particles with controllable appearance, uniform arrangement, narrow particle size distribution and particle size of less than or equal to 10 nm; the method does not need high-temperature hydrothermal, and has simple preparation process and short reaction time; the method solves the problems of complex process, easy agglomeration of products, large particle size of particles and the like.

title_en: Composite material, preparation method thereof and quantum dot light-emitting diode
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of nano materials, and particularly relates to a composite material, a preparation method thereof and a quantum dot light-emitting diode. The composite material comprises a hole transport material and tellurium nanosheets dispersed among the hole transport material. The tellurium nanosheets are doped into the hole transport material, so that the hole transport rate of the hole transport material can be remarkably improved, and therefore, the composite material is used for a hole transport layer of a quantum dot light-emitting diode, the hole conductivity of the hole transport layer can be improved, the charge injection of a quantum dot light-emitting diode device is balanced, and finally the brightness, the light-emitting efficiency and the service life of the device are improved.

title_en: Battery cathode material, preparation method thereof, rechargeable battery and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a battery cathode material, a preparation method thereof, a rechargeable battery and an electronic device. The preparation method of the battery negative electrode material comprises the following steps: adding pyrrole monomers into a template reagent with a nanofiber structure to obtain a polypyrrole precursor with the nanofiber structure; heating the polypyrrole precursor to obtain a nitrogen-doped carbon material; and mixing molten metal sodium with the nitrogen-doped carbon material to obtain the battery negative electrode material. By the method in the embodiment of the disclosure, a nitrogen-doped carbon material which has a nanofiber structure and is mixed with sodium metal is formed as a battery negative electrode material by a template method. The battery cathode material is beneficial to the rapid transmission of sodium ions in the battery and has higher rate performance.

title_en: Valve device
abstract_en: The valve device is provided with a main body (51), a valve body (52), and a control valve member (Y1), wherein the control valve member (Y1) changes the pressure acting on pressure chambers (51 g, 58 a), and the pressure chambers (51 g, 58 a) generate control pressure for moving the valve body (52). The control valve member (Y1) has: a base (Y11, Y121, Y13) formed with a refrigerant chamber (Y19), a first refrigerant hole (Y16) communicating with the refrigerant chamber (Y19) and with the pressure chamber (51 g, 58 a), and a second refrigerant hole (Y17, Y18) communicating with the refrigerant chamber (Y19) and with a refrigerant passage (51 c, 51 k) outside the control valve member (Y1); a driving unit (Y123, Y124, Y125) that displaces when the temperature of the driving unit itself changes; amplifying units (Y126, Y127) that amplify the displacement of the driving units (Y123, Y124, Y125) caused by the change in temperature; and a movable part (Y128) which moves in the refrigerant chamber (Y19) by transmitting the displacement amplified by the amplifying parts (Y126, Y127), thereby adjusting the opening degree of the second refrigerant holes (Y17, Y18) relative to the refrigerant chamber (Y19).

title_en: Method for rapidly preparing superfine boron carbide powder at low temperature under assistance of current
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for quickly preparing superfine boron carbide powder at low temperature under the assistance of current, belonging to the technical field of boron materials. The method for rapidly preparing the superfine boron carbide powder at low temperature under the assistance of current comprises the following steps: s1, mixing and grinding a boron source and a carbon source to obtain mixed powder; s2, carrying out radiant heating on the mixed powder in an inert gas atmosphere to 1400-1600 ℃, and carrying out heat preservation; and S3, applying 50-500V initial voltage to two ends of the mixed powder while preserving heat, setting the current limit to be 0.5-2A, and entering a constant current mode after the current reaches the limit and maintaining for 5-30min to obtain the boron carbide powder. The invention also discloses the boron carbide powder prepared by the preparation method. The invention can prepare boron carbide powder with small granularity at lower temperature.

title_en: Preparation method and application of metal-based DNA thermotropic liquid crystal
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to the technical field of thermotropic liquid crystal preparation, in particular to a preparation method and application of a metal-based DNA thermotropic liquid crystal, which comprises the following steps: adding a metal-based solution into DNA serving as a template, uniformly mixing, adding a reducing agent, carrying out in-situ reduction to obtain metal nanoparticles, and carrying out self-assembly with positively charged vesicles to obtain the metal-based DNA thermotropic liquid crystal. The method can realize the preparation of the metal-based thermotropic liquid crystal without the participation of a solvent, and has the advantages of simple preparation method, high yield and universality.

title_en: Manufacturing method of low-frequency MEMS (micro-electromechanical systems) magnetoresistive sensor modulated by magnetoresistive motion
abstract_en: The invention relates to a manufacturing method of a low-frequency MEMS (micro-electromechanical systems) magnetoresistive sensor modulated by magnetoresistive motion, belongs to the field of magnetic field detection, and solves the technical problem of detection precision reduction caused by asynchronous motion of magnetic flux collectors on two sides of the existing MEMS magnetoresistive sensor. The sensor manufacturing method comprises the following steps: forming a T-shaped insulating layer A on a substrate; forming a magnetoresistive sensor MTJ at a top end of a longitudinal portion of the T-type insulating layer A; forming magnetic flux collectors on the substrate, wherein the magnetic flux collectors are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the MTJ; covering an insulating layer B on the MTJ and the insulating layer A, and covering an insulating layer C on the magnetic flux concentrator; forming a piezoelectric layer on a longitudinal portion of the insulating layer B; etching the insulating layer B to expose the MTJ and the electrode window of the piezoelectric layer; forming an electrode layer on the electrode window, the piezoelectric layer and the insulating layer B; and etching the substrate to form the piezoelectric cantilever. The problem that the motion of the magnetic flux concentrator is not synchronous is avoided through cantilever beam vibration, the magnetic field detection resolution ratio is improved, and the magnetic flux concentrator can be widely applied to detection of low-frequency weak magnetic fields.

title_en: Multi-emission carbon spot fluorescent probe with large Stokes displacement and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of ratio type fluorescent probes, and particularly relates to a multi-emission carbon spot fluorescent probe with large Stokes displacement, and a preparation method and application thereof. The ratiometric fluorescent probe compounds of the invention are novel multiple-emitting Carbon Spots (CDs) with large Stokes shifts, the CDs having a size of 3-7 nm. The invention prepares CDs by a simple one-step solvothermal method. The preparation method is simple and convenient, the materials are easy to obtain, and the prepared CDs have good dispersibility and high stability in aqueous solution and show excellent luminescence characteristics. The invention also provides the application of the CDs in zinc ion detection, which can effectively avoid the interference of the external environment on the detection result and has high sensitivity and selectivity. The ratiometric fluorescent probe successfully realizes the sensitive detection of zinc ions in a serum sample.

title_en: Thermal emitter with embedded heating element
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates generally to heat emitters with embedded heating elements. The heat emitter (1) comprises a separate membrane (2) supported by a substrate (3), wherein the separate membrane (2) comprises in lateral extension a central section (2-1), a conductive intermediate section (2-2) and a border section (2-3), wherein the conductive intermediate section (2-2) laterally surrounds the central section (2-1) and is electrically isolated from the central section (2-1), the conductive intermediate section (2-2) comprises a conductive semiconductor material encapsulated in an insulating material, and wherein the border section (2-3) at least partially surrounds the intermediate section (2-2) and is electrically isolated from the conductive intermediate section (2-1), wherein perforations (4) are formed through the border section (2-3).

title_en: Seawater power generation device and using method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a seawater power generation device and a using method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of photovoltaic power generation. The seawater power generation device provided by the invention uses the graphene doped raw wood chip as a power generation element, the graphene doped raw wood chip contains hydrophilic groups, which is beneficial to seawater permeation, under the natural seawater condition, as wood is composed of cellulose, hemicellulose and lignin and is rich in hydroxyl, when seawater permeates into the micro-nano pore channel of the graphene doped raw wood chip, the hydroxyl is hydrolyzed to generate negative charges, the negative charges can adsorb positive ions in seawater and repel the negative ions, and the positive ions flow upwards under the conduit capillary force and evaporation driving action of the graphene doped raw wood chip, so that a directional flow potential difference is formed at the upper end and the lower end in the micro-nano pore channel of the raw wood chip, and further, continuous and stable electric energy can be collected; in addition, the mode does not need external mechanical energy input or temperature and humidity excitation, is safe and efficient, and provides an effective mode for new energy conversion.

title_en: Preparation method of magnetic nano carrier material for reducing side effect of epirubicin
abstract_en: Hair brushBelongs to the field of application of magnetic nano materials to drug carriers, and discloses a preparation method of a magnetic nano carrier material for reducing side effects of epirubicin. The epirubicin is loaded on a magnetic ferroferric oxide/graphene nano material carrier (hereinafter referred to as Fe) 3 O 4 GO) with targeting function, which can make epirubicin directionally concentrate and release to specific tumor part, and greatly reduce its toxic side effect. Magnetic Fe 3 O 4 Compared with the produced carrier nano material, the/GO nano material has the advantages of high magnetic saturation, high stability, low cytotoxicity and low production cost. GO and Fe 3 O 4 The combination of (A) can achieve a great improvement in performance, and thus can produce magnetic Fe 3 O 4 the/GO nano material carrier is applied to reduce the side effect of epirubicin, thereby producing an ideal magnetic targeting drug carrier.

title_en: Method for preparing MEMS device based on wafer
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for preparing an MEMS device based on a wafer. By further arranging the protective layer between the mask layer and the second surface of the wafer, the protective layer can be used for protecting the wafer from being attacked by xenon fluoride after the mask layer is consumed, so that the edge of the wafer is prevented from being exposed prematurely and being corroded by the xenon fluoride, the integrity of MEMS devices positioned at the edge of the wafer is effectively ensured, and the yield of MEMS devices on the wafer is improved.

title_en: Preparation method of nano core-shell silica microspheres
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a nanometer core-shell silicon dioxide microsphere, which comprises the following steps: step (1): preparing cationic polymer microspheres by emulsion polymerization; step (2): coating a layer of silicon dioxide on the surface of the prepared polymer microsphere under alkaline conditions; step (3): and transferring the core-shell silica microspheres prepared under alkaline conditions to acidic conditions for secondary coating to form a compact silica layer. According to the invention, the acid is used as a catalyst, the surface of the polymer microsphere is coated to form a silica layer with thinner and denser thickness, the alkali is used as a catalyst, the surface of the microsphere is coated to form a silica layer with thicker thickness and easily adjustable thickness, the thickness of the core-shell silica and the stability of emulsion in an alcohol solvent can be effectively improved by combining the acid and the alkali, and furthermore, the stability of the nano core-shell silica prepared by combining the acid and the alkali in the alcohol solvent is better, so that the application range of the core-shell silica is enlarged.

title_en: Method for growing highly oriented transition metal chalcogenide nanoribbon
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for growing highly oriented transition metal chalcogenide nanoribbons, which comprises the following steps: 1) placing the gold foil on a tungsten foil, and obtaining a gold single crystal after melting and solidifying; 2) placing a transition metal oxide powder upstream of a gold/tungsten substrate; 3) placing a chalcogen upstream of the oxide powder; 4) and introducing argon, respectively heating the substrate, the oxide and the chalcogen elementary substance to different temperatures, keeping the temperature constant, and growing on the substrate after several minutes to obtain the highly-oriented transition metal chalcogenide nanoribbon array. The method takes the gold single crystal as a growth substrate to grow the transition metal chalcogenide nanoribbon, can realize the growth of the transition metal chalcogenide nanoribbon array by controlling the orientation of the transition metal chalcogenide nanoribbon, and is a method for realizing the growth of the highly oriented transition metal chalcogenide nanoribbon.

title_en: Carbon-silicon composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a preparation method of a carbon-silicon composite material, which comprises the steps of uniformly dispersing alkyl borane, nano-scale silicon powder and graphene, carrying out hydrothermal reaction at 100-200 ℃, drying a product, carbonizing the hydrothermal reaction product by using mixed gas of NH3 and inert gas, and introducing an inert gas-loaded conductive polymer monomer for reaction to obtain the carbon-silicon composite material. The composite material has a core-shell structure, the inner core is an aggregation forming body of nano-scale silicon powder, the inner core is doped with B element, and the shell is doped with N element and B element. According to the invention, boron is doped on the core nanoscale silicon powder in a hydrothermal mode to form a porous structure, so that the expansion of silicon in the charging and discharging processes can be reduced, the boron doping has the advantages of high uniformity, high consistency and the like, the specific capacity and the electronic conductivity of the material are improved, and a certain amount of boron and nitrogen are doped in the shell layer, so that the specific volume and the impedance of the composite material are improved.

title_en: nanoparticle-rhACE-2 compound for blocking coronavirus infection target cells, preparation method and application thereof
