abstract_en: The invention discloses a nanoparticle-rhACE-2 compound for blocking coronavirus infection target cells, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: s1, preparing and purifying the rhACE-2 protein; s2, marking rhACE-2 protein by biotin; s3, preparing a nanoparticle-rhACE-2 compound: and (3) washing the nanoparticles for three times by using PBS (phosphate buffer solution), specifically washing the nanoparticles by using 1ml of PBS for the first time, washing the nanoparticles twice by using PBS with the same amount as the sample, adding soluble rhACE-2 protein which is described in S2 according to different molar ratios, incubating for 30 minutes at 37 ℃ together to enable the rhACE-2 to be effectively combined to the surfaces of the nanoparticles, and then washing the nanoparticles for three times by using PBS, wherein the product is the nanoparticle-rhACE-2 compound. The invention uses the new coronavirus receptor angiotensin converting enzyme 2 as an antagonist, and uses nanoparticles as a carrier to block and neutralize virus particles so as to inhibit the infection of the virus to target cells.

title_en: Nano silicon composite material, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a nano silicon material, which has a secondary structure; the primary structure is a flaky nano silicon material, and the secondary structure is obtained by combining the primary structure through Van der Waals force. The nano silicon material provided by the invention has a primary lamellar nano structure, so that the volume expansion rate of the silicon cathode material is effectively reduced, and the service life of a lithium ion battery is prolonged.

title_en: Quantum dot-containing nanoparticles and method for manufacturing same
abstract_en: The present application relates to a quantum dot containing nanoparticle comprising: a core portion; a quantum dot portion bonded to a surface of the core portion; a shell portion for protecting the core portion and the quantum dot portion; and a support portion for supporting the combination of the core portion and the shell portion, wherein the nanoparticles exhibit a high footprint and stable binding, thereby exhibiting improved luminous efficiency and brightness when detecting biological samples (biomolecules).

title_en: Triaxial accelerometer
abstract_en: The invention provides a triaxial accelerometer which comprises a Z-axis accelerometer body, a Z-axis accelerometer anchor point and a torsion beam, wherein a first space, a second space and a third space are defined in the Z-axis accelerometer body, the Z-axis accelerometer body is positioned in the third space, the torsion beam is positioned in the third space and parallel to a Y-axis, the Z-axis accelerometer body is connected with the Z-axis accelerometer body, the mass of the Z-axis accelerometer body positioned on one side of the torsion beam is different from the mass of the Z-axis accelerometer body positioned on the other side of the torsion beam, so that the Z-axis accelerometer body moves like a seesaw by taking the torsion beam as an axis, the X-axis accelerometer body is positioned in the first space, and the Y-axis accelerometer body is positioned in the second space. Compared with the prior art, the triaxial accelerometer provided by the invention has a reasonable and compact overall architecture, can save the chip area and reduce the cost. In addition, the sensitivity of the Z-axis accelerometer with the same area and extended frame is high.

title_en: Preparation method of nano-scale hollow iron phosphide particles
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide a preparation method of nano-scale hollow iron phosphide particles, which comprises the following specific steps: firstly adopts a solvothermal method to prepareAnd (2) oxidizing iron particles, loading the iron oxide particles on carbon powder, and finally converting the iron oxide particles into iron phosphide particles by adopting a high-temperature gas-phase phosphating method. The preparation process has simple operation, easy control and low cost, and the iron phosphide particles prepared by the method are hollow spheres, have high hollow rate, reach nanometer level and uniform particle size and comprise FeP and FeP 4 The method can continuously, efficiently and stably catalyze the hydrogen evolution reaction.

title_en: Rare earth ion co-doped near infrared long afterglow luminescent nano material, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rare earth ion co-doped near infrared long afterglow luminescent nano material, a preparation method and application thereofThe method belongs to the technical field of near infrared long afterglow luminescent materials. The chemical expression of the long afterglow luminescent nano material is Zn  3  Ga  2  Sn  2  O  10  :xCr  3+  ,yEu  3+  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the Wherein Cr is  3+  And Eu  3+  X is more than 0% and less than or equal to 1%, and y is more than 0% and less than or equal to 0.5%. The catalyst is prepared by adopting a combustion method, and takes acetylacetone metal salt as a precursor, wherein the calcination temperature is 850 ℃ and the calcination time is 2 hours. The long afterglow material synthesized by the invention can be excited by a biological window, has the long afterglow material emitted by a near infrared region, and greatly enhances the afterglow performance emitted by the near infrared region by adjusting different proportions of doped ions.

title_en: Organic metal nano drug-loaded particles for targeted therapy of tumors and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides organic metal nano drug-loaded particles for targeted therapy of tumors and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of drug-loaded particle preparation. The organic metal nano drug-carrying particle is composed of a metal zinc nano framework, an oxygen-deficient activated prodrug, a sonosensitizer and a homologous tumor cell membrane, wherein the oxygen-deficient activated prodrug is tirapazamine, and the sonosensitizer is chlorin e 6. The invention utilizes the characteristic of wrapping homologous tumor cell membranes to deliver the nano drug-carrying system to the tumor part in a targeted manner. The organic metal nano framework is subjected to acid-responsive cracking at the tumor part to release the loaded medicine. After the ultrasonic chlorin e6 releases active oxygen, tumor cells are killed. Meanwhile, the hypoxia of the tumor environment is intensified, and tirapazamine is further induced to kill tumor cells, so that the tumor treatment effect is realized.

title_en: Preparation method of silicon-carbon composite material, silicon negative electrode piece and battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a silicon-carbon composite material, a silicon cathode pole piece and a battery, relates to the technical field of preparation of functional composite materials and batteries, and aims to overcome the defects of the conventional silicon cathode lithium ion battery at the same time, the preparation method of the silicon-carbon composite material provided by the invention comprises the following steps: uniformly mixing a silicon source and carbon black to obtain a silicon source mixture; mixing a silicon source mixture and porous carbon powder, performing ultrasonic dispersion, performing ball milling, and heating; introducing a reducing agent, and carrying out constant-temperature reduction reaction; removing impurities with hydrochloric acid solution, and drying to obtain the silicon-carbon composite material; the invention also provides a silicon negative pole piece and a battery prepared by using the material, and solves the problems that material particles are easy to break, particles and granules in the silicon negative pole piece and particles and current collectors are easy to fall off, and the overall cycle performance and energy density of the battery are further influenced, and the like, caused by the volume expansion of silicon materials in the traditional silicon negative pole battery.

title_en: Wafer level vacuum packaging for thermal imaging sensors
abstract_en: Complementary Metal Oxide Semiconductor (CMOS) devices that embed micro-electromechanical system (MEMS) components in the MEMS region. The MEMS component is, for example, an Infrared (IR) thermal sensor. The device is packaged with a CMOS compatible IR transparent cover to hermetically seal the device using wafer level vacuum packaging techniques.

title_en: Bismuth oxide/manganese oxide composite nanospheres, preparation method thereof and application thereof in psoriasis treatment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bismuth oxide/manganese oxide composite nanosphere, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in psoriasis treatment  2  S  3  Hollow nano-microsphere as precursor, and KMnO  4  Obtained by reaction in water. The bismuth oxide/manganese oxide composite nanospheres are synthesized in a mild aqueous solution for the first time, the synthesis method is simple, the reaction conditions are mild, the obtained product is uniform in appearance, the production cost is low, and the method is suitable for industrial large-scale production; the nanospheres obtained by the invention can interrupt the inflammatory loop of psoriasis, effectively prevent inflammatory recurrence and realize accurate, effective and long-term treatment of psoriasis.

title_en: PH/reduction double-sensitive calcium carbonate-silicon dioxide drug-loaded nano material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A pH/reduction double-sensitive calcium carbonate-silicon dioxide drug-loaded nano material and a preparation method thereof are provided, wherein calcium chloride dihydrate and dopamine hydrochloride are dissolved in absolute ethyl alcohol, and ammonia water solution is added to obtain solution A; dissolving an antitumor drug in absolute ethyl alcohol to obtain a solution B; dropwise adding the solution B into the solution A, and stirring under a dark condition to obtain a solution C; reacting the solution C with ammonium bicarbonate at 30-40 ℃ for 6-48h to obtain an antitumor drug-calcium carbonate nano-carrier; mixing an antitumor drug, namely a calcium carbonate carrier, absolute ethyl alcohol, deionized water and EDTA solution, performing ultrasonic treatment, dropwise adding ammonia water, performing ultrasonic treatment, and dropwise adding a mixture of tetraethoxysilane and a silane coupling agent containing cleavable disulfide bonds; stirring in dark to obtain the pH/reduction double-sensitive calcium carbonate-silicon dioxide drug-loaded nano material. The preparation method has mild preparation conditions, simple and easily obtained raw materials and can realize the purpose of continuously and effectively releasing the medicine at the tumor part.

title_en: Low-temperature preparation method of tin dioxide core-shell structure nanocrystalline and application of tin dioxide core-shell structure nanocrystalline in perovskite solar cell
abstract_en: The invention provides a tin dioxide core-shell structure nanocrystalline and a low-temperature preparation method, and a perovskite solar cell prepared from the core-shell structure nanocrystalline.

title_en: Conductive element electrically coupled to fluidic die
abstract_en: An example fluidic device may include a fluidic die and a support element coupled to the fluidic die. A fluid channel may be disposed within the support element and may define a fluid path through the support element and the fluid aperture of the fluid die. A conductive element may be disposed in the fluid path and separated from the fluid die. Conductive leads may provide an electrical coupling between the ground of the fluid die and the conductive element.

title_en: Corrosion-resistant pre-passivation film and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of metal corrosion prevention, and discloses a corrosion-resistant pre-passivation film and a preparation method and application thereof. The thickness of the pre-passivation film is 1.0-2.5 nm; the pre-passivation film contains an oxide, the size of the nucleation particles of the oxide being 30-80 nm. Compared with a naturally oxidized film, the corrosion potential of the pre-passivation film provided by the invention is improved by at least 30mV/SCE, the Cr content of the pre-passivation film is up to 63%, the corrosion resistance is obviously improved, and the general corrosion environment can be met; the pre-passivation film does not need high-temperature oxidation treatment, and has the advantages of simple preparation process, mild reaction conditions, low requirements on equipment and low preparation cost. The corrosion potential of the pre-passivation film provided by the invention is obviously improved under an acidic condition, and the self-healing performance of metal is enhanced. The passive film prepared by the method has excellent corrosion resistance.

title_en: MoS2/Ag2S hybrid nano material, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a MoS 2 /Ag 2 S hybrid nano material, preparation method and application, wherein the material is Ag 2 Anchoring of S nanoparticles to MoS 2 Hybrid nanostructures on the surface of nanoflowers. The method takes phosphomolybdic acid, thiourea/sodium sulfide and silver nitrate as a molybdenum source, a sulfur source and a silver source respectively, and synthesizes and obtains the MoS by comprehensively utilizing hydrothermal, high-temperature annealing and in-situ deposition methods 2 /Ag 2 S hybrid nanomaterial. The hybridizationThe nano material shows excellent electrocatalytic HER performance and has good application prospect in the field of full water splitting.

title_en: Heterojunction nano material and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heterojunction nano material and preparation and application thereof. The heterojunction nano material is CoFe 2 O 4 -yCoO isoThe material has y of 1-5, size of 100-300nm, thickness of 2-30nm, and specific surface area of 30-50m 2 (ii) in terms of/g. The reagent can effectively convert light energy into heat energy under the irradiation of near infrared light, kill cancer cells while realizing near infrared, photoacoustic imaging and magnetic resonance imaging, and achieve the effect of photothermal therapy. The method has the advantages of mild reaction conditions, easy operation and wide application prospect.

title_en: Bimetal nano particle for electrolyzing water and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a bimetallic nano particle for electrolyzing water and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the field of electrocatalytic nano materials. The technical points of the invention are as follows: 1) adding a FeCo bimetallic organic framework compound and dopamine hydrochloride into an alkaline solution, stirring for 24 hours, and carrying out solid-liquid separation to obtain MOF/PDA nano cubic blocks, wherein the alkaline solution is a Tris buffer solution with the pH value of 8.0; 2) annealing the MOF/PDA nano cubic blocks prepared in the step 1) in ammonia gas atmosphere at different temperatures; 3) further carbonizing the solid sample obtained in the step 2) at high temperature in the nitrogen atmosphere to obtain the product. The FeCo bimetallic nano-particles for electrolyzing water have the characteristics of large specific surface area, high conductivity, good stability, good catalytic activity and the like, and are a hydrogen evolution and oxygen evolution bifunctional full-hydrolysis catalyst with great application prospect.

title_en: Method for regulating and controlling piezoelectric performance of two-dimensional material based on substrate and irradiation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for regulating and controlling piezoelectric performance of a two-dimensional material based on a substrate and irradiation, which comprises the following steps: preparing or transferring a two-dimensional material onto different types of substrates, and regulating and controlling the piezoelectric property of the two-dimensional material by using the clamping effect of the two-dimensional material and the substrate interface; the two-dimensional material is exposed to an ion irradiation source, and the piezoelectric performance of the two-dimensional material nanosheet is further regulated and controlled based on an ion irradiation technology. The invention utilizes the substrate and irradiation to regulate the piezoelectric property of the two-dimensional material, and effectively obtains the piezoelectric constant of the two-dimensional material by obtaining the relationship among the thickness of the two-dimensional material, the applied voltage and the amplitude on different substrates. The piezoelectric performance of the two-dimensional material is regulated and controlled by using the substrate and the irradiation, the two-dimensional material is promoted to be applied to the field of thin electromechanical coupling devices, and the piezoelectric performance is regulated and controlled according to actual needs.

title_en: CO (carbon monoxide)2Method for preparing micro-nano calcium carbonate by mineralizing calcium-containing solid waste residues
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of solid waste residue resource utilization, and particularly relates to CO 2 A method for preparing micro-nano calcium carbonate by mineralizing calcium-containing solid waste residues. To solve CO 2 The invention prepares the nano calcium carbonate material with high added value together with the environmental pollution caused by calcium-containing solid waste residue, the calcium-containing solid waste residue with the granularity less than 60 meshes after grinding treatment and ammonium salt solution are pretreated and then immediately filtered, a structure control agent is added into calcium-containing filtrate, stirring is carried out, and normal pressure CO is introduced 2 And gas, after reaching the carbonization temperature, is dripped into an ammonia solution, and the reaction is stopped when the pH value reaches 7. And filtering the reaction system at normal temperature, and drying filter residues at 100 ℃ to obtain the product calcium carbonate. The method can convert more than 40 percent of calcium in the calcium-containing solid waste residue into calcium carbonate, the purity of the calcium carbonate is higher than 94 percent, the whiteness is higher than 92, and the appearance isSpherical, cubic, acicular, irregular, flower-like, etc.

title_en: Nanofluid cooling loop system suitable for pressurized water reactor nuclear power station
abstract_en: The invention relates to a nanofluid cooling loop system suitable for a pressurized water reactor nuclear power station, which belongs to the field of nuclear engineering application and comprises a nanofluid granularity detector, a nanofluid dispersion tank and loop pipeline equipment, wherein a sampling box is arranged at the front end of the nanofluid granularity detector; the inside of the nanofluid dispersion tank is provided with a high-frequency ultrasonic vibration disperser group, a stirrer and various devices of a filter screen, and the starting of the various devices is controlled by a controller. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the system provided by the invention can be used as a system (such as a loop cooling system, a key equipment cooling system and the like) of various cooling loops of a pressurized water reactor nuclear power station, and higher cooling efficiency is achieved by utilizing the enhanced heat transfer characteristic of the nanofluid.

title_en: Acceleration value recording device for penetration measurement based on fan-out technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to an acceleration value recording device for penetration measurement, which is manufactured based on the Fanout technology, wherein an amplifier bare chip (4), a filter bare chip, a processor bare chip (6), a power circuit bare chip and a memory bare chip are integrated in a plastic package forming body (7), led out through a BGA ball (5) and correspondingly connected with a circuit on a substrate (14); the MEMS accelerometer (11) is adhered to the substrate, and is connected with a circuit on the substrate through the BGA ball; the other side of the MEMS is adhered to the bottom of the tube shell (1) by using insulating glue (12); and hard glue (10) is adopted to protect and encapsulate the MEMS and the bottom of the tube shell, and soft glue (8) is adopted to protect and encapsulate the other surface of the substrate. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the method overcomes the defect that the penetration overload of the elastomer is evaluated by experimental or theoretical analysis at present, has the characteristic of accurate and rapid evaluation result, is beneficial to reducing the test cost and shortening the research period, and can be applied to the evaluation of the penetration overload and the design of the penetration experiment elastomer.

title_en: Preparation method of metal ion coordinated boron quantum dot composite carrier with multiple biomedical functions
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a metal ion coordination boron quantum dot composite carrier with various biomedical functions. In the presence of metal ions M, carrying out ultrasonic treatment on boron powder, stripping M-coordinated boron nano-sheets in a liquid phase, and preparing M-coordinated boron quantum dots M-BQDs through solvothermal treatment; adding aminated polyethylene glycol PEG into the M-BQDs dispersion liquid to prepare M-BQDs coated on the surface of the PEG; connecting PEG amino group with polypeptide chain cRGD carboxyl group to prepare M-BQDs/PEG/cRGD compound; adding a drug molecule 5-fluorouracil 5FU into the complex dispersion liquid to prepare a 5 FU-loaded complex, namely M-BQDs/PEG/cRGD/5FU carrier; and adding a photosensitizer molecule chlorin Ce6 into the carrier dispersion liquid to prepare the Ce 6-loaded M-BQDs/PEG/cRGD/5FU/Ce6 composite carrier.

title_en: Preparation method of fluorine substituted nucleic acid modified gold particles
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of fluorine substituted nucleic acid modified gold particles. The invention takes fluorine to replace nucleic acid FNA and gold particles as raw materials, and the FNA forms a layer of nucleic acid molecules on the gold particles through molecular electrostatic attraction, electron cloud change and hydrogen bond action. The FNA modified gold particle prepared by the invention has the advantages of simple and green method and low cost, and the FNA on the FNA modified gold particle retains the function of nucleic acid. Nucleic acids can hybridize to complementary sequences according to the base-complementary pairing rules. Meanwhile, the FNA modified gold particles can stably exist under high-salt conditions, and can resist the interference of biological thiol such as Glutathione (GSH) in organisms, so that a high-fidelity target signal is obtained, and the occurrence of false positive signals is avoided. Therefore, the invention is expected to provide theoretical and experimental technical support for preparing high-fidelity gold particle probes.

title_en: Method for preparing graphene oxide by stable electrolysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of graphene oxide preparation, in particular to a method for preparing graphene oxide by stable electrolysis. In the two-phase liquid which is incompatible with the isolation protection liquid and the electrolyte, the intercalated graphite electrode is soaked in the isolation protection liquid and then gradually enters the electrolyte, the counter electrode is placed in the electrolyte, voltage is applied between the intercalated graphite electrode and the counter electrode, and the intercalated graphite electrode is electrified, oxidized and peeled off. Then separating the material from incompatible two-phase liquid, and then carrying out shearing stripping, cleaning, acid removal and other procedures to obtain the graphene oxide product. The method has the characteristics of no metal impurities in the product, controllable oxidation degree of graphene, stable electrolysis process, no wetting of electrolyte, long-time continuous production and the like.

title_en: Near infrared two-region aggregation-induced emission molecule for multi-mode imaging and diagnosis and treatment and application thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the design of organic fluorescent materials, and in particular, to a class of molecules with polymerization-induced luminescence characteristics that have bright near infrared two-region emission, high active oxygen generating capability, and excellent photo-thermal conversion efficiency. The polymerization-induced luminescent molecules can fully utilize the excitation state energy, maintain perfect balance between radiation transition and non-radiation transition, meet the requirements of near infrared two-region fluorescence imaging (FLI)/photo-acoustic imaging (PAI)/photo-thermal imaging (PTI) three-mode imaging, and can realize anti-tumor cooperative therapy of photodynamic therapy (PDT)/photo-thermal therapy (PTT).

title_en: Nano spherical polypyrrole and preparation method thereof, nitrogen-doped carbon material and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of carbon materials, and particularly relates to nano spherical polypyrrole and a preparation method thereof, a nitrogen-doped carbon material and application thereof. The preparation method of the nano spherical polypyrrole comprises the following steps: adding propionic acid into a container, heating to 130-160 ℃, mixing pyrrole with propionic acid to obtain a pyrrole propionic acid solution, adding the pyrrole propionic acid solution into the propionic acid in the container heated to 130-160 ℃ under stirring, and reacting for at least 1.5h by using oxygen as an oxidant to obtain a black mixed solution; the product is washed and separated by ethanol and water, and finally dried to obtain the nano spherical polypyrrole. The invention directly utilizes oxygen in the air as an oxidant, does not need to add an additional oxidant, directly polymerizes pyrrole in a propionic acid solvent, synthesizes nanometer spherical polypyrrole, has uniform size, forms a nitrogen-doped carbon material through high-temperature calcination, has a spherical structure and a pore structure, and can be used as a metal capture agent to prepare an alloy catalyst.

title_en: Non-linear nano hybrid material of titanium carbide quantum dots and vanadium metal organic framework and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a nonlinear nanometer hybrid material of a metal organic framework of titanium carbide quantum dots and vanadium and a preparation method thereof, wherein the titanium carbide quantum dots are uniformly distributed on the surface of the metal organic framework material of vanadium; the inorganic organic nano hybrid functional material is prepared by a hydrothermal method, and is different from the traditional soluble metal salt, the metal source in the invention is from a layered solid material, and the effective help is provided for the two-dimensional space nucleation of the synthesized metal organic framework; the metal organic framework two-dimensional structure has stronger adsorbability, so that the titanium carbide quantum dots can be stably and uniformly distributed on the surface of the metal organic framework material, and the composite material with good structure is obtained. Compared with the prior art, the method can obviously improve the reverse saturation absorption performance under the nano laser test condition through the interaction between the titanium carbide quantum dots and the metal organic framework, provides possibility for preparing diversified nonlinear and other functional materials with wider application range, and has good application prospect.

title_en: Quaternary nanostructure based on bright silver
abstract_en: Nanostructures comprising Ag, in, ga, and S and a shell comprising Ag, ga, and S, wherein the nanostructures have a peak wavelength emission of 480-545nm and wherein at least about 80% of the emission is band-edge emission. Methods of making the nanostructures are also disclosed.

title_en: Three-degree-of-freedom bidirectional movement precision positioning platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-degree-of-freedom bidirectional movement precision positioning platform which comprises a fixed end of the platform, a bridge type amplification mechanism, a single parallel guide mechanism, a Z-shaped beam structure and a working platform, wherein the fixed end of the platform is arranged to be static, the fixed end of the platform comprises a four-side annular fixed end of an outer ring and fixed ends of four squares in the middle, and the bridge type amplification mechanism comprises four piezoelectric ceramics. The three-degree-of-freedom bidirectional movement precision positioning platform adopts the principle of bending deformation of a Z-shaped beam, and the Z-shaped beam is reversely arranged on an X axis and a Y axis by utilizing the principle of the two-degree-of-freedom precision positioning platform, so that the three-degree-of-freedom bidirectional movement is realized, and the three-degree-of-freedom bidirectional movement precision positioning platform has a larger stroke.

title_en: Photocatalyst for efficiently degrading antibiotics and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photocatalyst for efficiently degrading antibiotics, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) sequentially mixing nano zinc sulfide and nano composite material CuO @ Cu in a mass ratio of 0.25-4: 1 2 O @ Cu is uniformly dispersed in deionized water to form a mixed solution; (2) placing the mixed solution obtained in the step (1) in a microwave reactor for microwave irradiation reaction, naturally cooling to room temperature after the reaction is finished, and then filtering, washing and drying to obtain CuO @ Cu 2 O @ Cu-ZnO-CuS photocatalyst. The preparation method is simple, convenient to operate and good in repeatability, and the prepared photocatalyst can fully absorb visible light and ultraviolet light and efficiently and stably degrade antibiotics.

title_en: Preparation method of tau protein specific nano molecular chaperone and application of tau protein specific nano molecular chaperone in inhibition of tau aggregation
abstract_en: A preparation method of tau protein specific nanometer molecular chaperone and its application in inhibiting tau aggregation are provided. Firstly, respectively synthesizing VQIVYK-PEG-b-PCL/PCL-b-PAE, and then assembling the composite micelle formed by the VQIVYK-PEG-b-PCL/PCL-b-PAE to form Tau specific nano molecular chaperone, which is called Tau-nChap. Tau-nChap is provided with a hydrophobic micro-domain and a closed space similar to a natural molecular chaperone, can selectively capture pathological Tau but not normal Tau, and effectively inhibit the aggregation of the Tau and the normal Tau through the synergistic effect of a Tau recognition peptide and the hydrophobic micro-domain closed on the surface. The invention has the following advantages: the raw materials are simple and easy to obtain; the synthesis steps are simple, the yield is high, and the mass production is easy; the polymer micelle is stable, has low biological toxicity, has good effect of inhibiting tau protein aggregation, and is easy to popularize and apply.

title_en: Iron-doped nickel phosphide nano-particle and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an iron-doped nickel phosphide nanoparticle and a preparation method thereof, comprising the following steps: (1) Putting ferric nitrate, nickel nitrate, terephthalic acid and carbon nano tube slurry into 40 ml of N, N-dimethylformamide and 16 ml of ethanol, and magnetically stirring for 30 minutes; (2) Pouring the liquid into a 100 milliliter inner container of a hydrothermal reaction kettle; (3) Putting the hydrothermal reaction kettle into an oven, setting the temperature and the heat preservation time, and cooling to the room temperature; (4) Centrifuging, washing the product with water and ethanol, and drying. (5) And (3) putting a certain amount of precursor and sodium hypophosphite at two ends of a quartz boat, putting the quartz boat into a tube furnace, introducing gas, setting the temperature and the heating rate, and cooling to room temperature to obtain the iron-doped nickel phosphide nano particles. The iron-doped nickel phosphide prepared by the method has large specific surface area and more active sites, is simple to operate and good in repeatability, can be prepared on a large scale, and provides a reliable sample preparation method for the application of phosphide in the aspect of water electrolysis.

title_en: MOFs derivative PBA @ Co-Ni-S composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a MOFs derivative PBA @ Co-Ni-S composite material, which is characterized in that a nanocube with uniform size is formed by adopting a room temperature precipitation method, then a static adsorption method is carried out to load MOF nanosheets on the surfaces of the nanocube, and finally the MOF nanosheets are activated by solvothermal vulcanization to realize rapid and reversible Faraday reaction, so that the electrochemical performance of EC is improved. The Fe-Co-PBA provides a main appearance and has a stable structure; the MOF is coated on the surface of the Fe-Co-PBA subsequently, and the specific surface area of the whole material is improved due to the morphology of the nanosheets; and then, vulcanization treatment is carried out, so that the electronic structure of the outer MOF is further regulated and controlled, and the performance is improved. The preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing 1 Fe-Co-PBA; MOF nanosheets are loaded on the outer layer of the 2 Fe-Co-PBA; 3, carrying out vulcanization treatment by adopting a solvothermal method. The electrode material is applied to the super capacitor, the electrode material is charged and discharged in a range of-0.1-0.45V, and the specific capacitance is 1200-1300F/g when the discharge current density is 1A/g. Has excellent material stability and excellent ion transmission capacity.

title_en: Composite hydrogen storage material, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an MgH  2  ‑MnMoO  4  A composite hydrogen storage material, a preparation method and application thereof. The composite hydrogen storage material comprises MnMoO  4  Rod-shaped Nanopowder (NRs) and MgH  2  ，MnMoO  4  The powder accounts for 1-15% of the total mass of the hydrogen storage material by changing MnMoO  4  Powder doping ratio to improve MgH  2  Is a hydrogen storage property of the fuel cell. MgH provided by the invention  2  The composite material has good hydrogen absorption and desorption kinetic performance and higher hydrogen absorption and desorption amount, and the preparation method is simple, has low raw material cost, and can be applied to hydrogen energy fuel cells, hydrogen storage sources of portable power supply devices and the like.

title_en: Method for improving oil yield of oleaginous microorganism and preparation method of microbial oil
abstract_en: The invention relates to microbial oil, and discloses a method for improving the oil yield of oil-producing microorganisms and a preparation method of microbial oil. The method for improving the grease yield of oleaginous microorganisms comprises the following steps: under the illumination condition, quantum dots, an electron sacrificial agent and an electron transfer agent are added in the fermentation process of oleaginous microorganisms. The preparation method of the microbial oil comprises the following steps: fermenting oleaginous microorganisms by adopting the method to obtain fermentation liquor, and breaking the wall and extracting the fermentation liquor. The method provided by the invention can effectively promote the utilization of nutrient substances by oleaginous microorganisms and improve biomass and grease yield.

title_en: MEMS pressure sensor and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an MEMS pressure sensor and a preparation method thereof, comprising the following steps: a substrate comprising a first surface and a second surface opposite the first surface; the first pressure sensitive film is arranged on the first surface of the substrate at intervals; a vacuum chamber between the first pressure sensitive membrane and the first surface of the substrate; a recess disposed on a second surface of the substrate; a second pressure sensitive membrane interposed between the first surface of the substrate and the bottom of the groove; a first electrode disposed on a surface of the first pressure-sensitive membrane; and the second electrode is arranged on the surface of the groove. The problems of electrode extraction and reliability caused by the electrode extraction of the existing MEMS pressure sensor are solved, and the sensitivity of the sensor is improved.

title_en: Precipitated silica for green tire and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The applicationRelates to a precipitated silica for green tires and a method for preparing the same, comprising the steps of: adding ammonia water into the mixed solution of fluosilicic acid and sodium silicate for treatment to obtain first slurry; mixing the obtained first slurry with an ammonium salt solution for treatment to obtain a second slurry; and (3) mixing the obtained second slurry with ammonia water for treatment, wherein the pH value of the filtrate is adjusted to a preset pH value after the pH value is reduced by 0.2-0.5 for solid-liquid separation in the treatment, and continuing the treatment until no precipitate is formed, and mixing the solid phase obtained by the solid-liquid separation to obtain the precipitated silica for the green tire. The preparation of high-performance precipitated silica is realized by improving the composition of raw material liquid and adopting a mode of multiple treatments in the treatment process, and the wear resistance of the obtained precipitated silica is 0.18-0.3cm  3  1.6km, tear strength of 150-180kN/m.

title_en: Carbon dot-based room-temperature phosphorescent composite material capable of stably emitting afterglow and preparation method, application and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of new materials, in particular to a carbon dot-based room-temperature phosphorescent composite material capable of stably emitting afterglow, and a preparation method, application and use method thereof  x  The carbon dot-based room temperature phosphorescence composite material capable of stably emitting afterglow can be applied to manufacturing anti-counterfeiting products, sensing products, information encryption products, photoelectric device products or biological imaging products.

title_en: Surface treatment process before spraying operation of valve casting
abstract_en: The invention discloses a surface treatment process before spraying operation of a valve casting, which relates to the technical field of surface treatment of the valve casting, and specifically comprises the following steps: 1) taking a valve casting, and pretreating the valve casting to obtain a pretreated valve casting; 2) constructing a nano rod layer on the surface of the valve casting by using the pretreated valve casting as a matrix through a sol-gel and hydrothermal method; 3) carrying out ion exchange on the nanorod layer on the surface of the valve casting by adopting a sulfur-containing aqueous solution and a silver-containing aqueous solution, so that a composite nanorod deposition layer is formed on the surface of the valve casting; 4) and (4) immersing the valve casting into the impregnation liquid to form the nanotube composite nanorod deposition layer. According to the invention, the surface of the valve casting is treated before the spraying operation, so that the cracking resistance of the spraying layer is improved, the adhesive force of the spraying layer is improved, the coating is not easy to crack and fall off on the surface of the valve casting, and the long-acting protection of the valve casting can be realized by the spraying layer.

title_en: Preparation method of easily-formed nano composite zirconia powder
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of easily-formed nano composite zirconia powder, which comprises the steps of mixing 0.1-1mol/L zirconium oxychloride solution with sulfate, heating to 80-95 ℃, preserving heat for 2-10h, and cooling; adding a precipitant at a temperature lower than 65 ℃ and controlling the pH value to 9-13, dispersing the obtained slurry, heating to 112 ℃ at a speed of 2-5 ℃/min, heating to 112-150 ℃ at a speed of 0.2-1 ℃/min, preserving heat and curing for at least 8 hours, sampling and measuring the particle size distribution, cooling to a temperature lower than 65 ℃ after reaching a target value, adding yttrium salt solution, filtering and cleaning the slurry containing the nano-composite zirconia precursor until the conductivity is less than 100 mu S/cm, and drying, calcining, crushing and granulating to obtain nano-composite zirconia powder. The method realizes the control of the grain size distribution of the crystal grains, thereby obtaining the easily-formed nano composite zirconia powder, and further obtaining the zirconia ceramic with higher strength.

title_en: Laminated veneer lumber product and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation process of a laminated veneer lumber treated by microfibrillated cellulose. The invention also relates to an improved laminated veneer lumber product manufactured by using the process.

title_en: Nanometer suspension nasal spray for resisting anxiety and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a nano suspension nasal spray for resisting anxiety and a preparation method thereof. The nano suspension nasal spray comprises 0.002-0.007% of dexmedetomidine and 0.0004-0.007% of mu-opioid receptor agonist, and the average particle size of the nano suspension nasal spray is 100-600 nm; here, the nanosuspension nasal spray is a suspension comprising water. In addition, a method for preparing the nano-suspension nasal spray is also disclosed. The nanometer suspension nasal spray for resisting anxiety has the advantages of good stability, convenient administration and long acting time, and can meet the medication requirement of anxiety treatment.

title_en: Polyamine derivative modified quantum dot, preparation method and application of quantum dot as nano drug carrier
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of pharmaceutical chemistry, and particularly relates to a preparation method of a quantum dot modified by a polyamine derivative and an application of the quantum dot as a nano-drug carrier, wherein the quantum dot nano-drug carrier modified by the polyamine derivative has a structure shown in the following formula: . Wherein R is phenylalanine, tryptophan or cysteine residue, and QDs refers to quantum dot CdSe. The quantum dot modified by the polyamine derivative has the advantages of small particle size, good water solubility, uniform dispersion, good stability and the like, and has relatively low cytotoxicity to various cells. Therefore, the quantum dot modified by the polyamine derivative can be used as a better nano-drug carrier to be applied to the field of pharmaceutical chemistry, and can lay a foundation for better designing the nano-drug carrier.

title_en: Preparation method of nitrogen-doped carbon quantum dots in coffee grounds and method for detecting VB12 by fluorescence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of nitrogen-doped carbon quantum dots of coffee grounds and a method for detecting VB12 by fluorescence, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: removing impurities from waste coffee grounds, then placing the waste coffee grounds into a crucible to dry at 60 ℃, drying, then placing the waste coffee grounds into a muffle furnace to be carbonized, taking out the waste coffee grounds after cooling to room temperature, then grinding the carbonized coffee grounds into powder to obtain black charcoal powder, then adding the black charcoal powder into an ethanol solution, mixing the black charcoal powder and the ethanol solution, carrying out ultrasonic treatment, centrifuging, extracting supernate and filtering to obtain a solution of coffee grounds carbon quantum dots. The prepared nitrogen-doped carbon quantum dots of the coffee grounds can be used for detecting VB12 by fluorescence. The precursor of the carbon quantum dots is waste coffee grounds, is easy to obtain, has low cost and short analysis time, and can be used for rapid and mass detection. In the fluorescent detection of VB12, the pretreatment is simple, the detection accuracy can be ensured without better separation of VB12, the detection is not influenced by other coexisting vitamins, and the specificity to VB12 is strong.

title_en: Gold nano star colorimetric sensor and preparation method thereof and application of gold nano star colorimetric sensor in Co detection2+Method (2)
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gold nano-star colorimetric sensor which is prepared by the following method: adding proper amount of CTAB solution, KSCN solution and NaHCO into gold nano star particles 3 Mixing the solution to obtain CTAB/SCN ‑ /HCO 3   ‑ -GNSs colorimetric sensors. The invention provides a gold nano-star colorimetric sensor for detecting Co 2+ The method has the characteristics of high detection speed, strong selectivity, high sensitivity and the like. The invention also provides a preparation method of the gold nano-star colorimetric sensor; the invention also provides a method for detecting cobalt ions by using the gold nano-star colorimetric sensor, which comprises the following steps: construction of the CTAB/SCN ‑ /HCO 3   ‑ -GNSs colorimetric sensors; mixing the solution to be detected with CTAB/SCN ‑ /HCO 3   ‑ -GNSs colorimetric sensors are mixed to prepare a reaction system, and when the color of the reaction system changes, the solution to be detected is judged to contain cobalt ions; and calculating the cobalt ion content in the solution to be detected according to the wavelength change value delta lambda of the maximum absorption peak by measuring the ultraviolet-visible absorption spectrum of the reaction system.

title_en: Vacuum packaging device with electric/chemical active metal layer
abstract_en: A vacuum packaging device with an electric/chemical active metal layer is provided, wherein a sensor chip is formed by bonding an MEMS wafer and a CMOS wafer; two layers of getter metal enable the bonded cavity to be vacuum, the CMOS wafer is formed by a silicon substrate chip and an N well in the CMOS chip on a P-type substrate through ion implantation, and an active region is the main part of a CMOS device; a metal filling part is longitudinally arranged in the CMOS wafer after the back of the silicon substrate is punched, a crystal grain and a sensing or actuating part which are connected with a hole are arranged at the bottom of the metal filling part after the back of the silicon substrate is punched, a passivation layer and a metal layer are sequentially arranged above the CMOS wafer, a metal bonding point is arranged between the metal layer and the MEMS wafer, and an MEMS wafer cavity is arranged in the MEMS wafer. The invention has the advantages that: the thin film getter layer is eliminated, the metal getter layer is used for replacing the function of the thin film getter layer, the thin film getter layer has a conductive function, and the thin film getter layer can also be used as a vertical electrode, so that the process is simpler.

title_en: Iron/oligopeptide compound coated ferric hydroxide nano shuttle prepared in aqueous solution and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: An iron/oligopeptide compound coated ferric hydroxide nano shuttle prepared in aqueous solution and a preparation method thereof belong to the technical field of biomedical materials. The method is characterized in that water-soluble ferric salt and water-soluble amino acid react in aqueous solution to obtain a spindle-shaped nano material with water-phase dispersed, iron oxyhydroxide serving as a core and an iron/oligopeptide compound serving as a shell. The method uses biosafety ferric salt and amino acid as raw materials, the shell thickness of the iron/oligopeptide compound is adjustable, the types of the oligopeptides can be controlled through different types of amino acid, the experimental repeatability is good, and the method is suitable for batch production. The surface oligopeptide modified fusiform nanomaterial can be selectively ingested by tumor cells, and the uptake of normal cells is smaller. The compound nano shuttle can be disintegrated under the action of tumor microenvironment, release a large amount of iron ions in the structure, and inhibit the growth of tumors through an iron death action mechanism. In addition, the compound nano shuttle can be used as a carrier for further loading medicines and can be used as a magnetic resonance imaging contrast agent.

title_en: Ethylene-coated nano aluminum particle and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of preparation of organic-inorganic composite nanoparticles, and particularly relates to ethylene-coated aluminum nanoparticles and a preparation method and application thereof. The ethylene-coated nano aluminum particle provided by the invention comprises a nano aluminum particle and an ethylene coating layer coated on the surface of the nano aluminum particle. The ethylene-coated nano aluminum particle provided by the invention is provided with an ethylene coating layer coated on the surface of the nano aluminum particle, and ethylene molecules are adsorbed on the surface of the nano aluminum particle to form the ethylene coating layer. The ethylene is uniformly coated on the surface of the nano aluminum particles, so that the agglomeration of the nano aluminum particles can be reduced. Ethylene has good compatibility with the propellant component, can make ethylene cladding's nanometer aluminium granule have better processing nature, and in addition, the ethylene cladding plays isolated effect to the oxidizing atmosphere in the external environment, can slow down the oxidation of nanometer aluminium granule, and in addition, ethylene ignition temperature is low, and the burning generates gas, all has the promotion effect to the ignition and the combustion behavior of nanometer aluminite powder.

title_en: Micro-nano structure with spectral response
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of micro-nano structures, and particularly relates to a micro-nano structure with spectral response. The micro-nano structure comprises a substrate and a cantilever; one end of the cantilever is connected with the surface of the substrate, and the other end of the cantilever is not connected with the substrate; the shape of the cantilever is arc; the surface of the cantilever is provided with a micro-nano pattern; the surface of the substrate is provided with a rough structure; the cantilever is of a composite structure with at least two layers, the current layer number of the cantilever is obtained, a corresponding cantilever curvature radius calculation model is obtained based on the current layer number of the cantilever, and then the corresponding cantilever curvature radius is calculated according to the cantilever curvature radius calculation model; and calculating the bending height of the corresponding cantilever according to the included angle of the curvature radius of the cantilever and the curvature radius of the corresponding cantilever. The application provides a spectral response micro-nano structure, and tunable and multifunctional terahertz wave application can be realized by utilizing an electrothermal actuator array prepared based on a micro electro mechanical system technology.

title_en: Method for manufacturing semiconductor structure
abstract_en: The application discloses a manufacturing method of a semiconductor structure, which comprises the following steps: providing a substrate with an annular groove; forming a barrier layer on the upper surface of the substrate, wherein the annular groove is filled with the barrier layer; forming a functional layer over the barrier layer; the lower surface of the substrate is etched to form a cavity, until the functional layer is reached, the etching is stopped. The upper vertex angle of the cavity which can be obtained based on the method is close to 90 degrees, so that the consistency of the functional layer above the cavity is maintained. In addition, the cavity sizes of the middle area and the edge area of the wafer are relatively consistent, so that the consistency of each semiconductor structure of the wafer is improved.

title_en: Preparation method and application of organic-inorganic nano composite scintillator material
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of preparation of organic-inorganic nano composite films, and particularly discloses a preparation method and application of an organic-inorganic nano composite scintillator material, wherein the organic-inorganic nano composite film material comprises the following raw materials: lu (NO)  3  ·6H  2  O、Eu(NO)  3  ·6H  2  O, urea, polymethyl methacrylate and acetone. The invention is realized by combining spherical Lu  2  O  3  The organic-inorganic nano composite film is obtained by compounding the nano particles and PMMA organic solvent, has no pollution to the environment, is radiation-resistant, good in mechanical property, good in imaging quality and emission wavelength of Eu  3+  Has good matching with a CCD detector, and greatly reduces the dosage burden of patients. The preparation method is simple and easy to operate, and has low requirements on sintering temperature and the like.

title_en: Nylon/titanic acid nanosheet composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nylon/titanate nano-sheet composite material, which is prepared by uniformly mixing nylon and titanate nano-sheet powder according to a weight ratio of 1000: 1-1000: 10 and then extruding the mixture in a double-screw extruder; the titanium acid nano-sheet powder is prepared by taking potassium titanate whisker as a raw material through hydration and acid washing processes. The invention adopts a double-screw extruder to melt, blend and extrude the nylon/titanic acid nano-sheet composite material, so that the nano-sheets are uniformly dispersed in the nylon, thereby preparing the high-performance nano-composite material. The invention has simple operation, no need of organic amine intercalation agent, low production cost and excellent performance of the composite material.

title_en: N-doped carbon dot and preparation method thereof and Cu-doped carbon dot2+Applications in assays
abstract_en: The invention discloses an N-doped carbon dot, a preparation method thereof and a Cu-doped carbon dot 2+ Application in detection. Belongs to the technical field of carbon nano-materials and fluorescence detection. The preparation method of the N-doped carbon dots comprises the following steps: p-phenylene diisocyanate, N-dimethylformamide and ammonia water are used as raw materials, and the nitrogen-doped orange-red fluorescent carbon dots (N-CDs) are synthesized by a one-step solvothermal method. The particle size of N-CDs is about 8.77nm, and the optimal excitation peak and emission peak are respectively located at 483nm and 587 nm. Due to Cu 2+ Electron transfer effect with N-CDs, Cu 2+ Fluorescence that can efficiently quench N-CDsLight, N-CDs to Cu 2+ Has high selectivity and excellent anti-interference performance, and can be used as a fluorescent probe for detecting Cu in water 2+ 。

title_en: PH-responsive T1-T2 dual-activation nanoprobe and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pH-responsive T1-T2 double-activation nanoprobe and a preparation method and application thereof. The probe can simultaneously realize double activation of T1 and T2 signals under the acidic condition of a tumor microenvironment, and the activation effect is enhanced along with the increase of acidity and time, so that the imaging performance and accuracy can be obviously improved, and the diagnosis of early micrometastases and the detection of inflammatory lesions can be realized; meanwhile, the nano probe has good biocompatibility and biodegradability, and the preparation method is simple and is favorable for clinical conversion and application.

title_en: Preparation method of calcium carbonate nano-drug
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a calcium carbonate nano-drug, which comprises the following steps: uniformly mixing a calcium chloride aqueous solution and a protein medicine, pouring the obtained mixed solution into a dialysis bag A, then putting the dialysis bag A into a dialysis bag B which is larger than the dialysis bag A, filling deionized water between the dialysis bag A and the dialysis bag B, sealing, putting into a sodium carbonate aqueous solution, dialyzing under stirring, and carrying out aftertreatment on the obtained reaction solution to obtain the calcium carbonate nano medicine; the method for preparing the calcium carbonate nano-particles uses the double-layer dialysis bag to control ion diffusion, has simple preparation method and uniform particle size, does not use substances for controlling the growth of calcium carbonate crystal grains, such as a surfactant, a polymer and the like, and ensures the biocompatibility of the nano calcium carbonate to the greatest extent.

title_en: N-doped carbon-based platinum-cobalt alloy oxygen reduction catalyst, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an N-doped carbon-based platinum-cobalt alloy oxygen reduction catalyst, a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of inorganic nano material chemistry and electrochemistry. The preparation method comprises the steps of preparing a carbon substrate solution, dispersing raw materials and preparing the carbon substrate platinum-cobalt alloy oxygen reduction catalyst. The N-doped carbon-based platinum-cobalt alloy oxygen reduction catalyst prepared by the one-step solvothermal method has the characteristics of uniform dispersion and stability, has higher catalytic activity when being subjected to electrochemical test under an acidic condition, and is simple in process, low in cost and easy to prepare in batches.

title_en: Method for synthesizing gold nanorods by using catechol as reducing agent
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for synthesizing gold nanorods by using catechol as a reducing agent, which comprises the following steps: (1) preparing a seed solution; (2) preparing a growth solution; (3) and synthesizing the gold nanorods. According to the invention, CTAB and NaOL are used as double surfactants, catechol is used as a reducing agent, the gold nanorods with high purity and high yield can be efficiently synthesized, and the method has the advantages of simple reaction conditions, easiness in control and low cost.

title_en: High-molecular single-chain/nano-particle composite Janus material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-molecular single chain/inorganic nano particle composite Janus material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the Janus material comprises a high-molecular single chain and inorganic nano particles, the high-molecular single chain comprises a lipophilic end connected with the inorganic nano particles and a hydrophilic end far away from the inorganic nano particles, the lipophilic end comprises a lipophilic chain segment, and the hydrophilic end comprises a hydrophilic chain segment and/or a hydrophilic group. The Janus material disclosed by the invention has amphipathy, and can be used as a responsive solid emulsifier and the like.

title_en: Nano fiber composite proton exchange membrane and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nano-fiber composite proton exchange membrane and a preparation method thereof, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: s1, dissolving polystyrene by using a solvent, and preparing a nano-fibrosis polystyrene film in an electrostatic spinning mode; s2, cold pressing the polystyrene film, and then soaking the polystyrene film in excessive concentrated sulfuric acid for sulfonation at the temperature of 80-110 ℃ to obtain a sulfonated polystyrene film; s3, dissolving sulfonated polyether-ether-ketone by using a solvent to obtain a sulfonated polyether-ether-ketone solution, casting the sulfonated polyether-ether-ketone solution on a sulfonated polystyrene membrane by using a flow-extension method by using the sulfonated polystyrene membrane as a matrix, and drying to obtain the sulfonated polyether-ether-ketone solution. According to the invention, the sulfonated polystyrene nanofiber membrane is used as a matrix, and the sulfonated polyether ether ketone is uniformly coated on the surface of the sulfonated polystyrene matrix in a tape casting method, so that the sulfonated polystyrene nanofiber membrane enhances the proton conductivity of the proton exchange membrane, and simultaneously increases the migration rate of hydrogen ions, and enhances the mechanical property and the thermal stability of the membrane.

title_en: Piezoelectric micromechanical ultrasonic transducer and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: A piezoelectric micromachined ultrasonic transducer includes a substrate, a membrane layer, and a sacrificial layer. The substrate has a cavity penetrating through the substrate. The membrane is disposed over the cavity and includes a first piezoelectric layer, a bottom electrode, a top electrode, and a second piezoelectric layer. The first piezoelectric layer is disposed on the cavity and includes an anchor portion, wherein the anchor portion of the first piezoelectric layer directly contacts the substrate. A top electrode and a bottom electrode are disposed on the first piezoelectric layer. The second piezoelectric layer is disposed between the bottom electrode and the top electrode. The sacrificial layer is disposed between the substrate and the first piezoelectric layer, and a vertical projection of the sacrificial layer does not overlap a vertical projection of a portion of the membrane layer disposed directly above the cavity.

title_en: Method for preparing metal nanoparticle anchored molybdenum nitride with assistance of carbon quantum dots, product and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for preparing metal nanoparticle anchored molybdenum nitride by carbon quantum dot assistance, and a product and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of preparation of metal nanoparticle anchored molybdenum nitride. The invention discloses a method for preparing metal nanoparticle anchored molybdenum nitride by carbon quantum dot assistance, which mainly comprises the step of carrying out hydrothermal reaction on water-soluble metal salt, molybdate and carbon quantum dots rich in amino functional groups to obtain metal nanoparticle anchored molybdenum nitride with carbon-coated metal nanoparticles anchored on molybdenum nitride nanosheets. The preparation method is simple, easy to operate and environment-friendly, and the prepared nano-particle anchored molybdenum nitride has regular shape and good conductivity and has good catalytic activity and cycling stability in the hydrogen production reaction by catalytic electrolysis of water.

title_en: Tin-titanium-silicon molecular sieve and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a tin-titanium-silicon molecular sieve and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the electron binding energy of a framework tin active center in the tin-titanium-silicon molecular sieve is below 488.5eV, the molar ratio of titanium to silicon in the tin-titanium-silicon molecular sieve is 0.005-0.03, and the molar ratio of tin to silicon is 0.005-0.02. The tin-titanium-silicon molecular sieve has more catalytic active centers, lower electron binding energy of the framework tin active center and better catalytic performance.

title_en: Amorphous tin-silicon material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an amorphous tin-silicon material and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the volume of a mesopore with the aperture of 8-32nm of the amorphous tin-silicon material accounts for 75-95% of the total pore volume, and the ultraviolet spectrum of the amorphous tin-silicon material has the characteristic of skeleton tin at the position of 250-300nmPeak, the external specific surface area of the amorphous tin-silicon material is 320-600m 2 (ii)/g, total pore volume of 1-2cm 3 (ii) in terms of/g. The amorphous tin-silicon material has the advantages of large quantity of mesopores, large external specific surface area and total pore volume and good catalytic performance.

title_en: Manganese doped organic perovskite cluster material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of nano materials, in particular to a manganese doped organic perovskite cluster material and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: AX and PbX  2  Dissolving in a solvent to obtain a first mixed solution; wherein A is a monovalent organic cation, X is a halogen anion, pbX  2  Molar amounts greater than AX; adding organic carboxylic acid, organic amine and divalent manganese metal salt into the mixed solution to obtain a precursor solution; wherein a divalent manganese metal salt is mixed with PbX  2  The molar ratio of (2) is 0.05-0.65: 1, a step of; and mixing the precursor solution with an antisolvent, and then carrying out solid-liquid separation to obtain the manganese-doped organic perovskite cluster material. The preparation method has the characteristics of solution processing, rapid synthesis and low cost, and can obtain the perovskite cluster doped material with uniform size and excellent stability and optical property.

title_en: Method for qualitative identification of lipopolysaccharide or identification of strain sources based on solid-state nano-pore technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of molecular detection, in particular to a method for identifying lipopolysaccharide based on a solid-state nanopore technology and a method for judging sources of lipopolysaccharide strains and different subtypes of the same strains by using the method. The identification method of the lipopolysaccharide comprises the following steps: and testing the via time and/or via current amplitude and/or via current relative amplitude of the sample to be tested in the solid nano-pores under the applied voltage, and comparing the lipopolysaccharide in the sample to be tested for qualitative detection and/or quantitative detection. The method is simple and convenient to operate, low in cost, high in sensitivity and good in accuracy, and can judge the corresponding strain sources and different subtypes of the lipopolysaccharide by analyzing the characteristic data of the lipopolysaccharide penetrating through the nanopores.

title_en: Catalyst comprising an active nickel phase in the form of small particles and a nickel-copper alloy
abstract_en: A catalyst comprising nickel and copper and an alumina support, the proportion of nickel element being in the range 1% to 50% by weight relative to the total weight of the catalyst, the proportion of copper element being in the range 0.5% to 15% by weight relative to the total weight of the catalyst, said catalyst being characterized in that: -the molar ratio of nickel and copper is between 0.5 and 5 mol/mol; -at least a portion of the nickel and copper is in the form of a nickel-copper alloy; -nickel in the nickel-copper alloy in an amount of 0.5% to 15% by weight of nickel relative to the total weight of the catalyst; the size of the nickel particles in the catalyst is less than 7 nm.

title_en: Novel ligand assay
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the detection of ligands that bind to and activate steroid hormone receptors. In particular, the invention provides test kits and assays for selectively identifying steroid hormone receptor ligands from test samples. Importantly, the test kits and assays described herein are cell-free and enzyme-free and do not require expensive-to-manufacture nuclear extracts to enable their performance. In contrast, the test kits and assays described herein employ reporter constructs that include a hormone responsive element that changes a physical, mechanical, optical, photochemical, or electrochemical property of the reporter construct when bound by a ligand-activated steroid hormone receptor. Thus, the measured change in a physical, mechanical, optical, photochemical or electrochemical property (e.g., fluorescence reading) of the reporter construct can be used to determine the presence of the target ligand in the sample under investigation.

title_en: Antibacterial peptide WR and hyaluronic acid coating substance and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an antibacterial peptide WR and a hyaluronic acid coating and application thereof, wherein the sequence of the antibacterial peptide WR is shown as SEQID No. 1; simultaneously provides the application of the antibacterial peptide in preparing the medicine for treating gram-negative bacteria or/and gram-positive bacteria infectious diseases; adding anionic hyaluronic acid into the solution containing the antibacterial peptide WR with the self-assembled nano structure to perform electrostatic bonding to prepare the coating. Simultaneously provides the application of the coating material in preparing the medicine for treating the infectious diseases of gram-negative bacteria or/and gram-positive bacteria in the environment of protease. The antibacterial peptide has very low hemolytic activity and eukaryotic cytotoxicity, and the enzymatic stability of the antibacterial peptide coated with the anionic hyaluronic acid is detected, and the antibacterial peptide is not completely inactivated in the presence of 0.1mg/ml papain. In conclusion, the antibacterial peptide has higher application value and has the prospect of replacing feed antibiotics.

title_en: Tungsten bismuthate-iron bismuth chromate mesh nanowire heterojunction film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bismuth tungstate-iron bismuth chromate nano heterojunction film and a preparation method thereof 2 FeCrO 6 Bi having a network structure as a target 2 WO 6 Formed on a thin film, wherein Bi 2 WO 6 The film comprises a plurality of longitudinal nanowiresAnd a plurality of transverse nanowires, wherein the longitudinal nanowires and the transverse nanowires are mutually staggered and mutually stacked to form a net structure. The preparation method has universality, simple operation process and low price, and is beneficial to large-scale device engineering application. The prepared bismuthate tungstate-iron bismuth chromate nano heterojunction film shows outstanding photoelectric performance and has potential application prospects in ferroelectric photovoltaic devices or ferroelectric detection or ferroelectric regulation and control devices.

title_en: Equipment and method for preparing alloy nanoparticles by arc process
abstract_en: The upper part of the equipment is a vapor deposition chamber which is connected with a sealing chamber, the outer wall of the vapor deposition chamber is provided with a heater, the vapor deposition chamber is connected with a water-cooling anode and a water-cooling ventilation cathode, and the lower part of the vapor deposition chamber is inserted into a trapping chamber through a conical trapping tank. The vapor deposition chamber is connected with the molecular pump and the mechanical pump through valves, and the mechanical pump, the molecular pump and the heater are all connected with a power supply and a control cabinet. Alloy nanoparticles can be continuously prepared in large quantities; the arc shape is controllable, the particle size distribution of the powder is narrow, and the content of the generated alloy nano particles is controllable; the alloy nano-particles have novel structure and simple and effective operation; different elements can be prepared into the alloy nano-particles according to the theory.

title_en: Halide nanocrystalline dispersion glass and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to halide nanocrystalline dispersion glass and application thereof. The surface layer of the dispersion glass is a Cs ion exchange layer, the halide nanocrystals are distributed in the Cs ion exchange layer, and the halide nanocrystals comprise CsPbX 3 、Cs 4 PbX 6 CsX or KX, wherein X is one or the combination of more than two of Cl, Br and I. The invention adopts cation exchange to realize the controllable preparation of halide nanocrystals and cesium-lead halide perovskite nanocrystals in a certain depth range on the surface layer of the glass, and combines the glass composition design and the cation exchangeThe process adjustment is changed, and the controllable preparation of various cesium-lead halogen perovskite nanocrystals and halide nanocrystals in the surface layer of the glass can be realized. The cesium-lead-halogen perovskite nanocrystalline dispersion glass provided by the invention can be used for preparing cesium-lead-halogen perovskite nanocrystalline with controllable depth range, controllable crystal variety and adjustable absorption and light-emitting wave band in the surface layer of glass, and has application value in the fields of illumination, backlight source, information display and the like.

title_en: Temperature detection device and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of temperature detection, in particular to a temperature detection device and a use method thereof. In the invention, the environmental temperature changes the size of the thermal expansion layer, thereby changing the distance between the first carbon nano tube and the second carbon nano tube, further changing the chiral field in the chiral luminescent molecular layer, and finally causing the luminescence intensity of chiral molecules in the chiral luminescent molecular layer to change seriously, so the temperature detection sensitivity and the accuracy of the device are high. According to the invention, the light-emitting intensity difference of chiral molecules in the chiral light-emitting molecular layer is changed by changing the polarization direction of linearly polarized light, and is only caused by the intensity of chiral fields, so that the influence of other factors is eliminated, and therefore, the temperature detection accuracy is high.

title_en: Preparation method and detection method of tea polyphenol and component analysis electrochemical sensor thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and a detection method of tea polyphenol and a component analysis electrochemical sensor thereof, comprising the following steps: s1: preparing a carboxylated multiwall carbon nanotube/sodium lignin sulfonate composite material; s2: preparing a carboxylated multiwall carbon nanotube/sodium lignin sulfonate modified screen printing electrode; s3: preparing a nano-gold/carboxylated multiwall carbon nanotube/sodium lignin sulfonate modified working electrode; s4: placing the constructed sensor in standard solutions of epigallocatechin gallate or rutin with different concentrations, and drawing a working curve; s5: placing the constructed sensor in a citric acid buffer solution for detection; s6: recording the oxidation peak current value in the step S5, and measuring the concentration of total catechin, rutin and tea polyphenol in the sample according to the working curve of the step S4; the sensor prepared by the invention can simultaneously detect the content of catechin compounds and rutin, and complicated sample pretreatment is not needed during detection, and the sensor is simple to operate, short in detection time and low in cost.

title_en: Synthesis method of claviclike gold nanorods
abstract_en: The invention discloses a synthesis method of a gold nanorod in a stick bone shape, which comprises the following steps: (1) preparing a seed solution; (2) preparing a growth solution; (3) a gold nanorod in the shape of a bar bone. According to the invention, CTAC and oleylamine are used as double surfactants, 1,2,4 trihydroxybenzene is used as a reducing agent, the amount of required reactants is small, the cost is low, the reaction rate is extremely high, the reaction condition is easy to control, the obtained gold nanorods are good in dispersibility, longer in size, large at two ends and small in middle, are shaped like a rod bone, are more suitable to be used as a gold nanorod self-assembly material, and have wider application prospects in the aspect of medical fields.

title_en: MEMS locking system
abstract_en: A micro-electro-mechanical system (MEMS) actuator configured to provide multi-axis movement, the MEMS actuator comprising: a first portion, a second portion, and a locking assembly, wherein the first portion and the second portion are displaceable relative to each other, the locking assembly configured to releasably connect the first portion and the second portion to attenuate displacement between the first portion and the second portion.

title_en: Conductive paste and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to conductive paste and a preparation method thereof. The conductive paste comprises the following components in parts by mass: 16-32% of conductive filler, 68-84% of matrix; the conductive filler comprises graphene, silver nanoparticles and mercaptoethylamine, wherein carbon atoms on the mercaptoethylamine are connected with carbon atoms on the graphene, and sulfur atoms on the mercaptoethylamine are connected with silver atoms on the silver nanoparticles.
