According to the invention, mercaptoethylamine is connected with graphene and silver nanoparticles, mercaptoethylamine molecules are used as a bridge for charge transmission, so that the transmission of charges between the graphene and the silver nanoparticles is promoted, a good silver-graphene-silver conductive network is formed, and the conductivity of the conductive slurry is improved; the graphene replaces part of silver nanoparticles, so that the cost of the conductive paste is reduced; the graphene is compounded with the silver nanoparticles, so that the mechanical stability and the chemical stability of the conductive paste are improved.

title_en: Preparation method of amorphous hydrated nickel cobalt phosphate flexible electrode material
abstract_en: This patent relates to amorphous NiCo- (HPO) 4 ) 2 ·H 2 The preparation method of the O flexible electrode material aims at the product morphology of the figure 2 in the embodiment 1, the obtained electrode material has a spherical three-dimensional amorphous structure, the carbon cloth in-situ growth endows the electrode with flexibility, the three-dimensional structure increases the specific surface area of the electrode, and the surface of the disordered amorphous structure has a suspension bond and a looser atomic structure, so that the volume expansion in the charging and discharging process is favorably relieved. The electrochemical test result shows that the current density is 1 A.g ‑1 When the specific capacity of the single electrode reaches 1528.9F g ‑1 。

title_en: High-sintering-activity nano silver powder and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to high sintering activity nano silver powder and a preparation method thereof. Mixing silver nitrate and water to obtain silver source liquid, mixing sodium hydroxide, a dispersing agent, a reducing agent and water to obtain a reducing liquid, and adjusting the pH value of the reducing liquid to be 9-12. Then theAnd under the condition of stirring, quickly pouring the silver source liquid into the reducing liquid to carry out reduction reaction to obtain the nano-silver dispersion liquid. And (3) centrifugally separating the nano silver dispersion liquid, washing and purifying by using deionized water, and drying to obtain the nano silver powder. The preparation method has the advantages of simple process and equipment, low process cost, short reaction time and high efficiency, and can realize low-cost batch production. The obtained silver nanoparticles have good dispersibility, particle diameter of 10-50nm, and specific surface area of 30-50m 2 Between/g, a distinct sintering neck was observed at 180 ℃.

title_en: Anti-overload MEMS movable structure with strain self-offset function
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-overload MEMS movable structure with strain self-offset, comprising: the first movable mass block, the second movable mass block, the first structural unit, the second structural unit, the third structural unit, the fourth structural unit, the first overload-resistant fixed anchor area, the second overload-resistant fixed anchor area, the first overload-resistant strain beam, the second overload-resistant strain beam, the first overload-resistant support beam and the second overload-resistant support beam; the first structure unit, the second structure unit, the third structure unit and the fourth structure unit are identical in structure and respectively comprise mass block comb teeth, driving comb tooth anchor areas, rotating vibration beams, rotating adjustment beams, bending vibration beam fixing anchor areas, bending vibration beams and stress release beams. The invention avoids the structure fracture caused by overlarge structure displacement when the movable MEMS structure is subjected to large impact in the motion direction, can be applied to the structural design of the MEMS gyroscope, improves the overload resistance characteristic of the structure, improves the stability of the resonant frequency, and reduces the drive detection orthogonal coupling.

title_en: Fan-out packaging structure and forming method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fan-out packaging structure and a forming method thereof, and relates to the field of semiconductor packaging. The first through holes, the second through holes and the third through holes are formed in the sacrificial material layer, the first through holes of the first sacrificial material layer, the openings of the flexible interconnection pattern layers and the corresponding overlapping arrangement of the first conductive pads of the semiconductor chip are further arranged, and the electric connection of the multiple layers of flexible interconnection pattern layers and the first conductive pads of the semiconductor chip is further realized through the first conductive through holes.

title_en: MEMS infrared light source and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of infrared light sources, and particularly relates to an MEMS infrared light source and a manufacturing method thereof. The MEMS infrared light source introduces a reflecting layer with high reflectivity to infrared radiation at the back of the heating electrode layer and the supporting material (located in the substrate cavity area), so that the infrared radiation energy radiated by the heating electrode layer to the substrate cavity part through the supporting film is reflected back and radiated upwards through the heating electrode layer, the infrared radiation energy capable of being utilized by the infrared sensor is enhanced, the photoelectric conversion efficiency of the MEMS infrared light source is greatly improved, and the heating power consumption is reduced; and meanwhile, an ultrathin (thickness not more than 1 micron) infrared emission layer is introduced, so that the thermal mass of a heating electrode layer is greatly reduced while the high infrared emission capability of the MEMS infrared light source is ensured, the modulation frequency of the MEMS infrared light source is improved, and the heating power consumption is further reduced.

title_en: Heterogeneous semiconductor nanoparticle and method for preparing triboelectric thin film
abstract_en: The invention relates to a heterogeneous semiconductor nanoparticle and a method for preparing a triboelectric film, wherein the preparation method of the heterogeneous semiconductor nanoparticle comprises the following steps: dissolving copper acetate powder in absolute ethyl alcohol, adding TiO  2  powder, dispersing, stirring and defoaming to obtain a suspension A, heating the suspension A, and adding a glucose solution and a NaOH solution to obtain a suspension B; drying the suspension B by using a centrifugal dryer to obtain a precipitate, washing the precipitate by using absolute ethyl alcohol, and finally drying; the method for preparing the friction electrification film comprises the following steps: adding heterogeneous semiconductor nano particles into liquid polydimethylsiloxane, and then mixing with a curing agent to obtain a component B; weighing polydimethylsiloxane again, and adding a curing agent to obtain a component C; spin-coating the component C on the surface of an electrode, spin-coating the component B on the surface of the component C, and finally drying; the invention realizes the wide spectrum regulation of the surface charge density of the triboelectric thin film and improves the dielectric property of the triboelectric thin film.

title_en: Fabrication of full ring gate integrated circuit structures with spacer pre-deposition cut gates
abstract_en: A full gate-all-around integrated circuit structure with a spacer pre-deposition cut gate is described. For example, an integrated circuit structure includes a first vertical arrangement of horizontal nanowires and a second vertical arrangement of horizontal nanowires. The first gate stack is over a first vertical arrangement of horizontal nanowires, and the second gate stack is over a second vertical arrangement of horizontal nanowires. One end of the second gate stack is spaced apart from one end of the first gate stack by a gap. The integrated circuit structure also includes a dielectric structure having a first portion forming gate spacers along sidewalls of the first gate stack, a second portion forming gate spacers along sidewalls of the second gate stack, and a third portion completely filling the gap, the third portion being continuous with the first and second portions.

title_en: Small-diameter boron nitride nanotube and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a small-diameter boron nitride nanotube and a preparation method thereof. And step two, under the condition of introducing inert protective atmosphere, heating from the normal temperature, wherein the heating rate is 5-10 ℃/min, stopping introducing the inert protective atmosphere when the temperature is increased to 300-500 ℃, then introducing high-purity ammonia gas, keeping the temperature for 2-8 hours after the temperature is increased to 1250-1350 ℃, then stopping introducing the high-purity ammonia gas, introducing the inert protective atmosphere, naturally cooling to the room temperature, and obtaining a white substance, namely the small-diameter boron nitride nanotube in the container. The required raw materials are low in price, the equipment is simple, and the cost is low. The boron nitride nanotube prepared at a lower temperature through a simple ball milling annealing process has a diameter of about 10-15 nm and uniform size.

title_en: Surface polishing method for patterned metal layer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a surface polishing method of a patterned metal layer, belonging to the technical field of microwave components and parts, comprising the following steps: firstly, spin-coating photosensitive polyimide on the surface of a patterned metal layer on a silicon chip, and filling and covering the whole Au patterned metal layer; heating and curing the polyimide layer; coating a photoresist layer on the upper surface of the polyimide layer; etching and polishing the photoresist layer, and etching the photoresist layer completely to obtain a polyimide layer with a smooth surface; continuously etching the polyimide layer to enable the patterned metal layer pattern with higher thickness to leak out; polishing the metal layer pattern with the convex surface until the metal layer pattern is flush with the upper surface of the polyimide; removing the polyimide filled in the gaps of the metal layer patterns; the invention can obviously improve the flatness and the roughness of the Au microwave circuit pattern before the bonding of the silicon-based MEMS circulator/isolator, increase the strength of the bonding process, improve the structural strength of the device and improve the yield of each wafer.

title_en: Hexagonal boron nitride nanosheets and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a hexagonal boron nitride nano-sheet and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: pulping: mixing hexagonal boron nitride slices with a solvent containing water and performing ultrasonic treatment to obtain slurry; and (3) freezing: placing the slurry in a container, and freezing to obtain solid matters; and (3) stripping: ultrasonically thawing the solid into a suspension; and (3) centrifuging: and centrifuging the suspension to separate the suspension containing the hexagonal boron nitride nano-sheets. According to the preparation method of the invention, in the first aspect, a large number of hexagonal boron nitride nano-sheets below 10nm are obtained, and in particular, a large number of hexagonal boron nitride nano-sheets below 5nm can be obtained; in the second aspect, hexagonal boron nitride nano-sheets with target thickness are obtained through the steps of cyclic freezing, stripping and centrifugation; in the third aspect, the steps are simple and have strong operability, and batch production is realized; in the fourth aspect, hexagonal boron nitride nanoplatelets with good performance are obtained.

title_en: MEMS resonant acceleration sensor based on symmetrical homomodal temperature compensation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an MEMS resonant acceleration sensor based on symmetrical homomorphic temperature compensation, which is formed by connecting a resonator sensitive beam and a mass block through a lever mechanism and can convert external acceleration change into frequency offset so as to detect the external acceleration. The MEMS resonant acceleration sensor and the temperature-sensing oscillator are symmetrically distributed on two sides of the heating module, a heating beam of the heating module generates resistance heat through current, and the resistance heat is transmitted to the MEMS resonant acceleration sensor and the temperature-sensing oscillator through the symmetrical structure. The temperature sensing oscillator is used as a temperature sensing module, and the frequency of the temperature sensing oscillator is used for calibrating the temperature to realize the temperature control of the acceleration sensor.

title_en: Pressure sensor with micro multi-lead wire and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pressure sensor with micro multi-lead wires and a preparation method thereof, wherein the sensor comprises a plurality of lead wires and a pressure sensor chip which are mutually welded and fixed; a low-temperature glass sintering layer is arranged on the surface of the welding spot, and a silicon nitride structural layer is arranged on the surface of the low-temperature glass sintering layer; the thermal expansion coefficients of the materials of each layer show good thermal matching property in a wider temperature range, can be used in a range of-70-350 ℃, and ensure good biocompatibility and use stability; the preparation method comprises the following steps: forming a cracking structure at one end of the enameled wire; removing the outer skin to expose the lead terminals; fixing the lead terminal on the bonding pad by adopting a welding or pressing method; forming a low-temperature glass sintering layer on the connection point of the lead terminal and the bonding pad by adopting low-temperature glass powder; forming a silicon nitride packaging structure layer on the surface of the low-temperature glass sintering layer; all links in the preparation process are optimized, so that the whole preparation process is simple, and higher yield and production automation efficiency are achieved.

title_en: Multifunctional fluorine-containing copper sulfide nano probe and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional fluorine-containing copper sulfide nanoprobe and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the steps of ultrasonically mixing a dichloromethane solution of copper oleate, an amphiphilic polymer and perfluoro crown ether with an aqueous solution of sodium sulfide by an ultrasonic emulsification method to form an oil-in-water emulsion system, heating the oil-in-water emulsion system to generate copper sulfide nano particles in situ inside emulsion droplets, and embedding the copper sulfide nano particles into the perfluoro crown ether after the copper sulfide nano particles are self-assembled into nano particle aggregates to obtain the multifunctional fluorine-containing copper sulfide nano probe. The multifunctional fluorine-containing copper sulfide nanoprobe prepared by the invention has good photothermal performance, the plasma resonance absorption peak is positioned at 1064 nm, the penetration depth of light can be obviously improved in a transparent window of an organism, and the multifunctional fluorine-containing copper sulfide nanoprobe is suitable for photothermal imaging and photothermal treatment of deep tissues; and the fluorine element in the probe can be used for deep tissues of living bodies  19  F magnetic resonance imaging detection, almost without background interference, and can be directly used for  19  F magnetic resonance imaging and photothermal therapy of tumors.

title_en: Composite micron silicon material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composite micron silicon material and a preparation method and application thereof. The composite micron silicon material is of a multilayer core-shell structure and sequentially comprises a micron silicon core, a first coating layer, a cavity layer and a second coating layer from inside to outside; the first coating layer is mainly made of an elastic porous amorphous carbon material and a small amount of graphitized carbon material and is used for relieving the huge volume expansion effect of micron silicon; the second coating layer is a graphitized carbon layer with high mechanical strength and rigidity; meanwhile, a cavity layer is clamped between the two carbon cladding layers, and the three layers cooperate to maintain the structural integrity of the micron silicon particles. In the lithium embedding process of silicon, the first coating layer can be compressed firstly in the volume expansion process, most of the volume stress is absorbed by the first coating layer, when the first coating layer is compressed to the limit, the continued volume expansion is relieved by the cavity layer, and the volume stress is absorbed by the second coating layer after the cavity layer is completely consumed, so that the volume expansion of silicon is effectively inhibited, and the performance of the lithium battery is improved.

title_en: Bismuth sulfide-transition metal carbide nano material, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bismuth sulfide-transition metal carbide nano material, which comprises transition metal carbide and bismuth sulfide; the transition metal carbide is of a layered nanostructure or a flaky nanostructure, and the bismuth sulfide is of a rod-like nanostructure; bismuth ions in the bismuth sulfide and the transition metal carbide are adsorbed and combined through electrostatic force, and a heterogeneous interface is formed between the bismuth sulfide and the transition metal carbide; the transition metal carbide is titanium carbide, niobium carbide, vanadium carbide, tantalum carbide or molybdenum carbide. The invention also discloses a preparation method of the nano material, which comprises the steps of firstly, preparing transition metal carbide; and step two, preparing the bismuth sulfide-transition metal carbide nano material. Also provides the application of the bismuth sulfide-transition metal carbide nano material in antibacterial and bactericidal materials.

title_en: MEMS capacitive six-axis force sensor chip and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: A MEMS capacitive six-axis force sensor chip and a preparation process thereof are disclosed, wherein the chip comprises a high-resistance silicon device layer, a low-resistance silicon device layer and a glass device layer which are arranged from top to bottom, and a sandwich structure is formed by silicon-silicon bonding and silicon-glass bonding; the high-resistance silicon device layer comprises a first central rigid body and a load transmission structure; the low-resistance silicon device layer comprises a second central rigid body, the periphery of the second central rigid body and the electrode form a comb capacitor, and the second central rigid body is bonded with the first central rigid body into a whole on one hand and serves as a common electrode of a movable polar plate of the comb capacitor on the other hand; the glass device layer comprises a glass substrate, and metal layer structures such as a flat capacitor plate, an external bonding pad, an internal bonding pad and a metal lead on the glass substrate; the preparation process comprises a processing process of a silicon device layer, a processing process of a glass device layer, a silicon-glass bonding process and scribing; the invention realizes the decoupling output of six-axis force or moment and has the advantages of large measuring range, high sensitivity, small crosstalk error, miniaturization and the like.

title_en: Multi-range multi-sensitivity pressure MEMS chip
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-range multi-sensitivity pressure MEMS chip, which comprises a substrate, wherein a capacitive sensor component and a piezoresistive sensor component are arranged on the substrate; the capacitive sensor assembly comprises a capacitive upper polar plate and a capacitive lower polar plate which are arranged on the substrate, and an insulating gap is formed between the capacitive upper polar plate and the capacitive lower polar plate; and, the piezoresistive sensor assembly includes a piezoresistive unit disposed on the capacitive upper plate or the capacitive lower plate. The multi-range multi-sensitivity pressure MEMS chip provided by the invention can realize the measurement of capacitive small pressure and piezoresistive large pressure.

title_en: Polyacrylic resin modified adsorption drug carrier and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a polyacrylic resin modified adsorption drug carrier and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of carrier processing. The polyacrylic resin modified adsorption drug carrier is prepared from polyacrylic resin IV, chitosan, quaternary ammonium salt, modified carbon nano tubes, sucrose acetate isobutyrate, allyl pentaerythritol ether, hydroxyapatite, a cross-linking agent, an initiator, polyvinyl alcohol, polyethylene glycol, a thickening agent and other components in the steps of polyacrylic resin IV modification treatment, preparation of modified polyacrylic resin IV suspension, material mixing, mixed spinning and heating combination. The invention overcomes the defects of the prior art, can effectively and uniformly release the drug after the drug is absorbed and enters the stomach of a human body, achieves the effect of long-term action of the therapeutic components, reduces the hygroscopicity, ensures the storage time, prevents the abuse of the drug and improves the safety.

title_en: Surface-enhanced Raman spectrum substrate, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention provides a surface-enhanced Raman spectrum substrate, a preparation method and application; firstly, carrying out fine etching on a microsphere self-assembled monolayer film substrate or a microsphere self-assembled monolayer film glass slide to prepare a fine etching substrate; and then performing primary coating and secondary coating on the fine etching substrate to prepare a surface enhanced Raman spectrum substrate, wherein the gap between adjacent microspheres on the surface enhanced Raman spectrum substrate is 5-10 nm. According to the preparation method, the atomic layer deposition technology is used for preparing the surface-enhanced Raman spectrum substrate, and an inductive coupling plasma etching method and an electron beam evaporation method are combined, so that the signal enhancement effect of the surface-enhanced Raman spectrum substrate can be remarkably improved. The surface-enhanced Raman spectrum substrate can be applied to trace explosive detection.

title_en: Polysaccharide and virus antigen co-delivery nano vaccine, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a polysaccharide and virus antigen co-delivery nano vaccine, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the nano vaccine comprises polysaccharide, avian adenovirus-4 type Penton recombinant protein and vitamin E polyethylene glycol succinate, the mass ratio of the polysaccharide to the avian adenovirus-4 type Penton recombinant protein to the vitamin E polyethylene glycol succinate is 0.5:1:05-2:1:2, and the particle size of the nano vaccine is 1-100 nm. The co-delivery nano vaccine in the application obviously reduces the incidence rate and death rate of the avian adenovirus by preparing the vaccine and carrying out application detection of the avian adenovirus-4 type virus, can also stimulate the organism to quickly generate stronger immune response, maintain the higher level immune response of the organism, and can promote chickens to quickly expel toxin and relieve organ injury.

title_en: Low-temperature solid phase method for synthesizing perovskite type alkaline earth metal titanate
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide a preparation method for synthesizing a series of perovskite type alkaline earth metal titanates by a low-temperature solid-phase precursor method, which is based on a solid-phase precursor method, and the precursor is obtained by room-temperature solid-phase chemical reaction, and the series of alkaline earth metal titanates are further prepared under the air atmosphere and at a proper calcining temperature, such as: nano sheet CaTiO  3  Nanoparticulate SrTiO  3  Nanocube BaTiO  3  . The preparation method adopts cheap and easily available raw materials, has the characteristics of simple preparation method, high safety coefficient, environmental friendliness, easy realization of mass production and the like, and has extremely broad application prospect.

title_en: MXene-copper nanowire composite material for super capacitor and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an MXene-copper nanowire composite material for a super capacitor and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method of the MXene-copper nanowire composite material comprises the following steps: copper nanowires having an average diameter of about 30nm using a wet chemical method; preparing MXene nano material with a few-layer structure by using an etching method; uniformly mixing the copper nanowire and MXene by using an ultrasonic method, and performing vacuum filtration to obtain an MXene-copper nanowire composite film; and (3) placing the composite material film, the conductive agent and the binder in a mortar according to a certain mass ratio, grinding uniformly, spin-coating the slurry on the surface of the current collector, and testing the prepared electrode for the super-electric property. The introduction of the copper nanowire improves the interlayer spacing of MXene, so that the MXene has larger specific surface area and energy storage space, the resistance of MXene is reduced, and the conductivity, electrochemical performance and cycling stability of the MXene metal nanocomposite in practical application are improved.

title_en: Preparation method of needle-shaped nickel cobaltate/hydrophilic carbon cloth wave-absorbing composite material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a needle-shaped nickel cobaltate/hydrophilic carbon cloth wave-absorbing composite material, which comprises the following steps: dissolving nickel salt, cobalt salt and urea in deionized water to prepare a mixed solution, then immersing the hydrophilic carbon cloth in the mixed solution for full immersion, transferring the mixed solution and the carbon cloth to a hydrothermal kettle for heat preservation treatment, collecting reaction products, washing and drying the reaction products, and finally performing heat preservation treatment in a nitrogen atmosphere to obtain the needle-shaped nickel cobaltate/hydrophilic carbon cloth wave-absorbing composite material; the preparation method is simple and convenient, the synthesis process is environment-friendly, and the appearance is controllable; the material prepared by the invention has excellent wave-absorbing performance and market application potential.

title_en: MoS2Fluorescence quantum dot with @ organic polymer shell structure and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: MoS 2 The quantum dots have good compatibility with biomolecules, and fluorescent signals of the quantum dots are easily quenched by water molecules, so that the application of the quantum dots in aspects of biological imaging and the like is limited. The invention discloses a MoS 2 A preparation method of the @ organic polymer shell structure fluorescent quantum dot. MoS with core @ shell structure 2 The fluorescence property of the quantum dots in the aqueous solution is very stable, and the quantum dots can emit bright blue-green fluorescence under the excitation of ultraviolet light. With Na 2 MoO 4 Adding acetylacetone into the water phase, and adjusting pH of the solution to obtain the final productThe aqueous phase separated a tetraacetylacetonato molybdic oxygen oily liquid. Dissolving a certain amount of tetraacetylacetonato molybdenum oxide in tetrahydrofuran, taking thioacetamide as a sulfur source and hydrazine hydrate as a reducing agent to synthesize MoS 2 Quantum dot fluorescent material. MoS with a large number of acetylacetone molecules coordinated to the surface of the particles 2 The quantum dots can synthesize MoS under the solvothermal condition of more than 180 DEG C 2 @ organic polymer shell structure fluorescent quantum dots. The preparation method has simple synthesis conditions and low preparation cost.

title_en: MoS (MoS)2Fluorescent quantum dot of@organic polymer shell structure and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The MoS  2  quantum dot has good compatibility with biological molecules, and fluorescent signals of the MoS  2  quantum dot are easy to quench by water molecules, so that the application of the MoS  2  quantum dot in biological imaging and the like is limited. The invention discloses a preparation method of MoS  2  @organic polymer shell structure fluorescent quantum dots. The MoS  2  quantum dot with the core-shell structure has very stable fluorescence performance in aqueous solution, and emits bright blue-green fluorescence under the excitation of ultraviolet light. Molybdenum salts such as Na  2 MoO 4  are used as molybdenum sources, acetylacetone is added into the water phase, and the pH value of the solution is regulated, so that the oil-like liquid of molybdenum oxide tetra-acetylacetone can be separated from the water phase. And (3) dissolving a certain amount of molybdenum tetra-acetylacetonate in tetrahydrofuran, taking thioacetamide as a sulfur source, and taking hydrazine hydrate as a reducing agent to synthesize the MoS  2  quantum dot fluorescent material. MoS  2  quantum dots with a large number of acetylacetone molecules coordinated on the particle surface can be synthesized into the MoS  2  @organic polymer shell structure fluorescent quantum dots under the solvothermal condition of more than 180 ℃. The preparation method has simple synthesis conditions and low preparation cost.

title_en: Preparation method and application of tin/carbon composite nano material
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of energy storage materials, and discloses a preparation method and application of a tin/carbon composite nano material. The preparation method comprises the steps of firstly preparing nano Sn particles, then mixing the nano Sn particles with a carbon source, heating to form a polymer layer, and carbonizing the polymer layer to prepare the tin/carbon composite nano material. The nano Sn particles are prepared at room temperature by a chemical dealloying method, and the method is low in cost and simple to operate; the prepared nano Sn particles have smooth surfaces and uniform particle sizes; and the tin/carbon composite nano material prepared after the uniform coating and carbonization of the carbon source can inhibit the volume expansion in the circulation process, thereby avoiding the capacity attenuation caused by the crushing of Sn particles. The tin/carbon composite nano material is used as an electrode material of a sodium battery, and the battery shows good cycling stability and high capacity. The preparation method can be applied to the preparation of sodium batteries and the recovery of waste batteries.

title_en: Preparation method and application of sea urchin-shaped ternary metal nano enzyme
abstract_en: The application discloses a preparation method and application of sea urchin-shaped ternary metal nano enzyme, which utilizes Pd raw materials and Pt raw materials to synthesize sea urchin-shaped binary metal nano enzyme Pd-Pt; and heating the binary metal nano enzyme Pd-Pt, and adding an Ir raw material to synthesize the sea urchin-shaped ternary metal nano enzyme Pd-Pt-Ir. The advantages are: designs a simple and quick preparation method of the sea urchin-shaped ternary metal nano enzyme Pd-Pt-Ir, and realizes the preparation of ascorbic acid and H based on the sea urchin-shaped ternary metal nano enzyme Pd-Pt-Ir  2  O  2  The rapid detection of (2) and the construction of a rapid detection test strip are intended to detect ascorbic acid, provide reference basis for disease prevention and prognosis management, and have important clinical application value.

title_en: Aromatic ring and cyano co-doped carbon nitride nanosheet as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an aromatic ring and cyano co-doped carbon nitride nano-sheet, and a preparation method and application thereof, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) Dispersing the nitrogen-rich organic matter in an organic solvent to obtain a dispersion liquid; (2) And uniformly stirring the aromatic compound, and sequentially heating, washing with alcohol and drying to obtain the carbon nitride nano-sheet co-doped with the aromatic ring and the cyano. The present invention provides conjugated polymers by integrating aromatic compounds into a traditional carbon nitride synthesis route, i.e., by solvothermal polymerization of nitrogen-rich organics and aromatic compounds. The preparation method of the carbon nitride nano-sheet co-doped with the aromatic ring and the cyano group has the advantages of simplicity, low cost, high photocatalytic efficiency and good stability.

title_en: Nano metal film and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nano metal film and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: evaporating a second metal on the surface of the first metal film; carrying out corrosion treatment after heat treatment to obtain the nano metal film; the first metal film includes at least one of a nickel film, a cobalt film, a copper film, a silver film, a gold film, and a nickel-iron alloy film. The method for preparing the metal film with the nano structure by using the methods of high-temperature annealing and dealloying corrosion has the advantages of simple preparation process, low preparation process requirement, stable product structure and green and pollution-free process.

title_en: Preparation method of porous SiC@PANI core/shell nanowire quasi-array and application of porous SiC@PANI core/shell nanowire quasi-array in super capacitor
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a porous SiC@PANI core/shell nanowire quasi-array and application thereof in a super capacitor, and belongs to the technical field of energy manufacturing. The invention discloses a preparation method of a porous SiC@PANI core/shell nanowire quasi-array, which is characterized by comprising the steps of mixing polysilazane and melamine powder, placing the mixture in a crucible covered with a carbon substrate, loading SiC nanowires on the carbon substrate by a chemical vapor deposition method, taking the carbon substrate loaded with the SiC nanowires as an anode, taking a platinum sheet electrode as a cathode, taking an aniline acid solution as an electrolyte, and obtaining the porous SiC@PANI core/shell nanowire quasi-array by pulse electrodeposition. The invention also discloses a porous SiC@PANI core/shell nanowire quasi-array and application thereof in the super capacitor.

title_en: Preparation method and application of intelligent gold nanoparticles for realizing multi-modal therapy
abstract_en: Hair brushThe preparation method comprises the steps of adding a DNA1 solution into a gold nanoparticle solution, then adding a PBS solution and an SDS solution, carrying out salinization treatment to obtain a salinized solution, and cleaning to obtain SNA 1; adding DOX-DNA2 solution into gold nanoparticle solution, adding PBS solution and SDS solution, performing salinization treatment to obtain salinized solution, cleaning to obtain SNA 2- DOX (ii) a SNA1 and SNA2 are/is/are combined DOX And mixing to obtain the intelligent gold nanoparticles for realizing the multi-modal treatment. The intelligent gold nanoparticles prepared by the method have high tumor microenvironment selectivity, can be used for preparing antitumor drugs, have no killing effect on healthy cells and tissues, can realize accurate treatment, prolong the treatment effective period, and simultaneously realize efficient synergistic treatment including gene therapy, photothermal therapy and chemotherapy.

title_en: SOI wafer with asymmetric silicon nano-particle array structure and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an SOI wafer with an asymmetric silicon nano-particle array structure and a preparation method thereof, wherein the SOI wafer comprises a silicon substrate layer, a silicon dioxide buried layer and a silicon nano-particle array; the nanoparticle array is formed by periodically arranging even number of primitives, wherein each single primitive comprises two cuboid nanoparticles with different sizes in a parallel arrangement mode or a linear arrangement mode, the first cuboid nanoparticles are positioned on one side of the second cuboid nanoparticles in the parallel or linear arrangement mode, a connecting line of the central point of the first cuboid nanoparticles and the central point of the second cuboid nanoparticles is used as a symmetrical axis, and the first cuboid nanoparticles and the second cuboid nanoparticles are respectively and axially symmetrically arranged about the symmetrical axis. The asymmetric structure adopted by the silicon nanoparticle array enhances the local field intensity of an optical signal, and the nonlinear effect of the silicon nanoparticle array is further enhanced by the nonlinear combination of the silicon nanoparticle array and a silicon material, and the processing technology is simplified.

title_en: Two-dimensional BiCuSeO nanosheet, preparation method thereof and semiconductor device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-dimensional BiCuSeO nanosheet, a preparation method thereof and a semiconductor device, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: providing a reaction device, wherein the reaction device comprises a low-pressure reaction chamber, and the reaction chamber is provided with a first area and a second area which are sequentially arranged at intervals; placing a selenium-containing precursor in a first area, and placing a copper-containing precursor and an oxygen-containing precursor in a second area; the growth substrate is placed in the two areas and is reversely buckled above the copper-containing precursor and the oxygen-containing precursor; and (4) performing heat treatment, namely evaporating and reacting the selenium-containing precursor, the copper-containing precursor and the oxygen-containing precursor, and obtaining the BiCuSeO nano sheet on the surface of the growth substrate. The invention realizes the preparation of the two-dimensional BiCuOSe nanosheet with the minimum thickness of 7.6nm and the maximum transverse dimension of 270 mu m by a Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD) method.

title_en: Preparation method of perovskite quantum dot powder
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of perovskite quantum dot powder, which comprises the following steps: 1) Mixing and grinding aluminum hydroxide powder, a hole sealing agent, a pore expanding agent and a perovskite precursor to obtain a mixture; 2) Calcining the mixture obtained in the step 1) at a high temperature; 3) Naturally cooling the calcined product to room temperature, adding distilled water, stirring, centrifuging, and then putting into a vacuum oven for drying to obtain perovskite quantum dot powder. The perovskite quantum dot powder prepared by the preparation method disclosed by the invention has the advantages of stable luminescence wavelength, stable half-width, good high-temperature resistance, blue light resistance and water resistance, so that the LED lamp prepared by using the perovskite quantum dot powder has a good effect and can be used for a long time to keep good luminescence efficiency.

title_en: Preparation method of universal magnetic nano material for separating bacteria
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a universal magnetic nano material for separating bacteria, aims to provide a basis for better subsequent high-sensitivity detection of target bacteria, and relates to the field of material chemistry and the field of biotechnology. The method comprises the steps of coupling of magnetic nanoparticles and polyethylene glycol, coupling of ampicillin and polyethylene glycol to the magnetic nanoparticles, recognizing and capturing bacteria in a sample liquid by an ampicillin-polyethylene glycol-magnetic nanoparticle composite, enriching and separating the bacteria-ampicillin-polyethylene glycol-magnetic nanoparticle composite and the like. The target bacteria captured by magnetic separation can be directly subjected to subsequent analysis, and compared with the traditional bacteria magnetic separation method, the method can be used for carrying out magnetic separation on most of bacteria in the food matrix, so that the bacteria separation efficiency in the sample is improved, and the cost is reduced.

title_en: Aluminum hydroxide and method for preparing aluminum hydroxide by carbonization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing aluminum hydroxide by a carbonization method and the aluminum hydroxide obtained by the method. The method comprises the following steps: respectively feeding the sodium metaaluminate solution and the aqueous solution dissolved with carbon dioxide into a carbonization reactor, contacting the sodium metaaluminate with the carbon dioxide in a specific manner for reaction, and discharging the obtained product containing aluminum hydroxide from the bottom of the carbonization reactor; separating the product in a membrane filter to obtain a permeate and a retentate; enabling the permeate to enter a reverse osmosis desalination system for desalination treatment to obtain desalted water and reverse osmosis concentrated water; after the desalted water enters a heat exchanger and is subjected to heat exchange and cooling, part of the desalted water and carbon dioxide enter a dissolved air pump to be mixed, and then the mixed water is conveyed to the acid liquid feeding port; and aging, washing and drying the trapped fluid to obtain the aluminum hydroxide. The method realizes full liquid phase feeding by a carbonization method, can realize continuous and large-scale production, and has the advantages of large particle size, narrow distribution, good product quality and good stability of products in different batches.

title_en: Two-photon fluorescent nano probe for detecting microRNA-203 in tumor cells and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-photon fluorescence nanoprobe for detecting microRNA-203 in tumor cells and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the two-photon fluorescence nanoprobe comprises two-photon silicon nanoparticles, carboxyfluorescein and hairpin structure DNA, hairpin DNA1 is modified on the two-photon silicon nanoparticles, the carboxyfluorescein is modified on the hairpin DNA2, the two-photon silicon nanoparticles are used as energy donors, and the carboxyfluorescein is used as a fluorescence acceptor. The invention can realize the imaging and detection of microRNA-203 in cells by synthesizing a nucleic acid functionalized two-photon silicon nano probe and combining a catalysis hairpin self-assembly (CHA) signal amplification strategy and a Fluorescence Resonance Energy Transfer (FRET) method.

title_en: Method of fabricating multiple nanolayer transistors to enhance multi-stack CFET performance
abstract_en: A semiconductor device is provided. The semiconductor device has a first transistor pair formed over a substrate. The first transistor pair includes an n-type transistor and a p-type transistor stacked on top of each other. The n-type transistor has a first channel region including one or more first nanochannels having a first stress. The one or more first nanochannels extend laterally along the substrate, are stacked above the substrate, and are spaced apart from one another. The p-type transistor has a second channel region including one or more second nanochannels having a second stress. The one or more second nanochannels extend laterally along the substrate, are stacked over the substrate, and are spaced apart from one another. Each of the one or more first nanochannels in the first channel region and each of the one or more second nanochannels in the second channel region are respectively surrounded by a gate structure.

title_en: Hollow sheet carbonyl iron powder and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hollow flaky carbonyl iron powder and a preparation method thereof. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: coating an insulating film on the surface of the flaky carbonyl iron powder; the small hole corrosion is utilized to carry out concentrated corrosion on the surface of the flaky carbonyl iron powder and penetrate into the flaky carbonyl iron powder; and promoting the repassivation of the interior of the etching hole by controlling the condition of small hole corrosion, and stopping the growth of the etching hole to obtain the hollow flaky carbonyl iron powder. By applying the technical scheme of the invention, carbonyl iron powder is processed into a hollow sheet-shaped structure by an atomic layer deposition-small hole corrosion method, the density of a wave absorber is obviously reduced, the impedance matching property of the material is improved, meanwhile, holes formed in the inner cavity can carry out multiple reflection on electromagnetic waves, so that the absorption frequency point of the material is low-frequency and cheap, a certain absorption bandwidth is maintained, the wave absorbing performance of the material is integrally improved, and the method has large regulation space for electromagnetic parameters of the wave absorber and strong designability.

title_en: Lentinan ursolic acid self-assembly nanoparticles and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological materials, and particularly relates to lentinan ursolic acid self-assembly nanoparticles and a preparation method and application thereof. The invention takes ursolic acid and lentinan as raw materials, and utilizes the self-assembly of a large number of hydroxyl groups on a hydrophilic carrier lentinan and hydrophobic drug ursolic acid through hydrogen bond acting force to form the sphere-like nano compound. The LNT-UA nano-particle prepared by the invention can integrate various immune regulation and control molecules through a single dosage form, play various biological activity effects and also can cause immunogenic death of tumor cells; has certain immunoregulation effect, promotes the polarization of M0 type macrophage to M1 type macrophage, reduces the generation of M2 type cells, improves the immunosuppression of a tumor microenvironment, promotes the infiltration of immune effector cells, and fully activates the internal antitumor immune response of an organism.

title_en: Preparation method of graphene silver powder and graphene silver powder
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of graphene silver powder and the graphene silver powder, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: a step for preparing a graphene oxide dispersion; a step for preparing a PVP dispersion; a step for preparing a first silver nitrate solution; a step for preparing a VC solution; pouring the PVP dispersion liquid into the first silver nitrate solution, and stirring and mixing to obtain a silver nitrate-PVP mixed liquid; the VC solution is dripped into the graphene oxide loaded silver ion mixed solution, and is stirred and mixed to obtain graphene oxide loaded nanoparticle suspension; and heating the graphene oxide loaded nanoparticle suspension to 95 ℃, stirring, and keeping the temperature for 3 hours to obtain the nano-reduced graphene oxide silver powder. The preparation method of the graphene silver powder disclosed by the invention has the advantages of excellent conductivity, large specific surface area, high electron mobility and the like.

title_en: Treatment method of serpentine and asbestos tailings
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of hydrometallurgy, and particularly relates to a serpentine treatment method. Furthermore, the invention relates to a method for recovering serpentine from serpentine containing materials such as asbestos tailings using said treatment method. The method can realize effective separation of silicon and magnesium in the serpentine and can convert magnesium and silicon elements into products with economic value. In addition, the method has the advantages of short flow, low cost and high efficiency, and is beneficial to industrial use.

title_en: Preparation method of epoxy modified substrate, microarray chip and application of microarray chip
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an epoxy modified substrate, a microarray chip and application thereof. The epoxy substrate has low preparation cost, is simple and stable, is suitable for mass production of epoxy microarray biochips, has higher performance than the epoxy substrate subjected to soaking modification, and can provide excellent detection sensitivity.

title_en: Multilayer metal composite sheet with high peel strength and force-electric response and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multilayer metal composite sheet with high peel strength and force-electric response and a preparation method thereof. The multilayer metal composite sheet consists of an upper metal substrate, a lower metal substrate and a P (VDF-TrFE) layer, wherein ZnO nano rod arrays are grown on the surface layer in situ, and the P (VDF-TrFE) layer is arranged between the upper metal substrate and the lower metal substrate, so that the piezoelectric performance of the multilayer metal composite sheet is regulated and controlled by changing the density and the aspect ratio of the ZnO nano rods. The multilayer metal composite sheet with high peel strength and force-electric response provided by the invention has excellent overall force-electric response, and the P (VDF-TrFE) and ZnO nano rod array have good interface bonding strength. The preparation method of the multilayer metal composite sheet used in the invention is simple and easy to realize.

title_en: Atomic-level rough surface preparation process based on reverse order process
abstract_en: An atomic-level rough surface preparation process of a reverse order process comprises the following steps: a stacking step, namely arranging a sacrificial layer (2) on the surface of a first substrate (1), arranging an insulating layer (3) and a conducting wire layer (4) on the sacrificial layer (2), wherein the sacrificial layer (2) is arranged between the insulating layer (3) and the first substrate (1), and one side surface of the insulating layer (3) facing the sacrificial layer (2) is an atomically rough surface; a bonding step of bonding the second substrate (7) to the wiring layer (4) or the insulating layer (3); and a removal step of completely removing the first substrate (1) and the sacrificial layer (2).

title_en: Copper sulfide nano material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a copper sulfide nano material and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of material synthesis; wherein, the surface of the copper sulfide nano particle is loaded with amino, and the amino is grafted with TGF-beta 1 plasmid DNA; the copper sulfide nano material can be internalized into the mesenchymal stem cells and continuously plays a role in the cells, so that proliferation and chondrogenic differentiation of the mesenchymal stem cells are promoted, and the added copper sulfide nano particles, TGF-beta 1 plasmid DNA and phosphatidylcholine can synergistically increase the biological characteristics of proliferation, matrix degradation resistance and the like of the mesenchymal stem cells, and meanwhile, the chondrogenic differentiation function of the mesenchymal stem cells can be remarkably enhanced.

title_en: Ru/N-FeVO electrocatalyst and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method and application of an amorphous single-atom Ru/N-FeVO electrocatalyst. The preparation of the composite catalyst comprises the following specific steps: ammonium metavanadate (NH)  4  VO  3  ) And ferric nitrate nonahydrate (Fe (NO)  3  )  3  ·9H  2  O) dissolving, heating in water bath, cooling, centrifuging, washing and drying to obtain FeVO. And then annealing the prepared FeVO in ammonia gas to obtain the N-FeVO. Finally, N-FeVO is added in the mixture containing 0.06mmolRuCl  3  The amorphous single-atom Ru/N-FeVO electrocatalyst is obtained after the photo-deposition in the aqueous solution of (C). The invention has the advantages that: the preparation condition is mild, the process is simple, the surface of the catalyst presents an amorphous structure after Ru monoatoms are loaded on the carrier, and the amorphous structure increases the specific surface area of the catalyst and the number of active sites. The catalyst can be applied to the electro-catalytic decomposition of water to produce oxygen neighborhood, and has extremely low over-potential of electro-catalytic OER and current density of 50mA cm  ‑2  The overpotential is only 1.45V vs. RHE, exceeding RuO  2  And most catalysts reported in the literature.

title_en: Deep ultraviolet photoelectric detector and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a deep ultraviolet photoelectric detector, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of photoelectric detection. The invention provides a deep ultraviolet photoelectric detector, which comprises a dielectric insulating substrate, a photosensitive layer arranged on the surface of the dielectric insulating substrate, and two electrodes arranged at two opposite ends of the photosensitive layer; the photosensitive layer comprises a hexagonal boron nitride film and a surface plasmon structure attached to a part of the surface of the hexagonal boron nitride film, the hexagonal boron nitride film is in contact with the dielectric insulating substrate, one electrode is arranged on the surface of the hexagonal boron nitride film without the surface plasmon structure, and the other electrode is arranged on the surface of the hexagonal boron nitride film with the surface plasmon structure; the surface plasmon structure comprises a metal nanoparticle or a semiconductor nanostructure. The dark current of the deep ultraviolet photoelectric detector provided by the invention is extremely low, and the response to deep ultraviolet light is large.

title_en: Preparation method of vertical MXene array pole piece, vertical MXene array pole piece and application
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a vertical MXene array pole piece, and belongs to the technical field of batteries. The preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing MXene nano-sheets and preparing a vertical MXene array pole piece; dispersing MXene nanosheet powder to prepare a dispersion liquid to obtain an MXene dispersion liquid; cutting copper foil and placing on a freezing plate; placing MXene dispersion liquid on a copper foil and coating, wherein the coating thickness is 50-500 micrometers; and after coating is finished, freeze-drying to obtain the vertical MXene array pole piece. The preparation method provided by the invention designs the MXene nanosheets into a vertical three-dimensional structure by using an ice template method, can effectively utilize all MXenes, can form a uniform and vertical SEI layer on the surface of the vertical MXene in the reaction process with Li, effectively reduces the side reaction of metal lithium and electrolyte, and has good performance when being used as a lithium metal cathode.

title_en: Infrared thermopile array and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an infrared thermopile array and a preparation method thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps of providing an infrared thermocouple substrate with the front surface formed with array distribution; forming a patterned dielectric layer with an outer edge dielectric layer and an inner dielectric layer and a release slot etching window on the back of the substrate, forming a photoresist layer on the outer edge dielectric layer, etching the substrate with a first preset depth by deep reactive ion etching through the release slot etching window, removing the inner dielectric layer, and etching the substrate exposed in the outer edge dielectric layer by deep reactive ion etching to form bosses distributed in an array. In addition, the boss can conduct heat rapidly, so that the temperature of a cold junction area is kept consistent with the ambient temperature, and meanwhile, when the boss is formed by etching, only the side corrosion of the residual substrate is needed to be considered, so that the influence of the side corrosion on the boss is greatly reduced, the size of the boss is greatly reduced, and the improvement of the integration level of the array is facilitated.

title_en: Defective graphene/wave-transparent ceramic composite wave-absorbing material, method and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to a defective graphene/wave-transparent ceramic composite wave-absorbing material, a method and application, belonging to the field of wave-absorbing materials; the defect graphene is deposited in situ on the wave-transparent nanowire, the wave-transparent ceramic is deposited in situ on the defect graphene, a defect graphene/wave-transparent ceramic multilayer structure is formed in an alternate circulation mode, a multi-unit large-number nanoscale heterogeneous interface is constructed, rich interface polarization is generated under an alternating electric field, electromagnetic waves are attenuated and absorbed efficiently, and the requirements of severe application conditions on broadband wave absorption and high-temperature stability of materials are met. The method has simple and controllable process, and the thickness of each layer of material is in the nanoscale, so that the method has the advantages of short preparation period, low cost and capability of realizing large-scale production; the material does not basically change the original flexibility and strength of the nano wire, so the material can be made into special protective materials such as flexible wave-absorbing films, elastic wave-absorbing foams and the like, and has the beneficial effect of wide application.

title_en: Nickel disulfide/silicon composite material with core-shell structure and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a nickel disulfide/silicon composite material with a core-shell structure, and a preparation method and application thereof. In the composite material, the nano silicon core with the main lithium intercalation activity is sealed in the shell assembled by the nickel disulfide nanosheets, and a controllable space exists between the silicon core and the nickel disulfide shell, so that the volume expansion of silicon during lithium intercalation and deintercalation is greatly relieved. When the nickel disulfide formed by the nanosheets is used as a protective shell, the nickel disulfide not only can be used as a lithium storage active site, but also can relieve volume expansion. The two materials are combined with each other to improve the cycling stability and the rate capability of the nickel disulfide/silicon composite material when the nickel disulfide/silicon composite material is used as a lithium ion negative electrode material. When the charge-discharge current density of the composite material is 0.4A/g, the reversible specific capacity is maintained at 1948.5 mAh/g after 100 cycles; when the charging and discharging current is increased to 6.4A/g, the reversible specific capacity of 1105.1 mAh/g is still kept.

title_en: Silicon-based negative electrode composite material of lithium ion battery, preparation method and lithium ion battery
abstract_en: The invention provides a silicon-based negative electrode composite material of a lithium ion battery, which is a Si/SiO+M composite material, wherein the Si/SiO+M composite material takes silicon (Si) as an inner core, and silicon oxide (SiO) and nano metal (M) are attached to the surface of the silicon, so that a double-phase structure of the silicon oxide and the nano metal is formed on the surface of the silicon; wherein the metal oxide is M  x  O, x=1 or 2, and M is a transition metal. The invention also provides a preparation method of the silicon-based negative electrode composite material of the lithium ion battery and the lithium ion battery. The silicon-based negative electrode composite material can relieve the volume expansion of the silicon negative electrode material, has good electrochemical performance, and is environment-friendly in the preparation process.

title_en: Carbon nanodot delaying fluorescence and room-temperature phosphorescence emission and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carbon nanodot with delayed fluorescence and room temperature phosphorescence emission, a preparation method and an application thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step 1, dissolving boric acid, citric acid and diethanol amine in deionized water according to the proportion of (1-3 g) - (0.05-0.5 g) - (0.1-0.3 ml), heating and stirring to fully dissolve the boric acid, citric acid and diethanol amine to obtain a mixed solution A; step 2, placing the mixed solution A in a reaction kettle to carry out hydrothermal reaction at 180-200 ℃ to obtain a product B; and 3, cooling the product B, and fully grinding to obtain the carbon nanodots emitting delayed fluorescence and room-temperature phosphorescence. The carbon nano-dots prepared by the method are non-toxic and harmless, can be stored for a long time, have long afterglow life and high phosphorescence quantum yield, and can be used in the technical field of anti-counterfeiting.

title_en: Surface plasmon singular refraction and reflection regulation structure and design method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of surface plasmon regulation and control, and particularly relates to a surface plasmon singular refraction and reflection regulation and control structure and a design method thereof. The regulating structure is formed by butt joint of metal nano films with different plasma resonance frequencies. By means of electromagnetic coupling of SPPs on two sides of a metal film, two different SPP modes with positive group velocity and negative group velocity can be supported at the working frequency, and singular refraction and reflection phenomena are realized at the interface of the two metal films by butting with another metal film which only supports the positive group velocity SPP mode. In the prior art, people usually need to design a complex artificial sub-wavelength micro-nano structure to realize SPP singular reflection and refraction effects, the structure only needs to adopt a natural uniform metal material to prepare a nano film, and the structure has the advantages of simple design, easy preparation, rich effect and the like, and is expected to be applied to the micro-nano optical fields of optical sensing, optical super-resolution, interaction between enhanced light and substances and the like.

title_en: Molybdenum-based core-shell structure material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a molybdenum-based core-shell structure material and a preparation method and application thereof 3 Nano meterThe second step of hydrothermal treatment is to remove the MoO generated in the first step 3 The nano belt and thioacetamide are subjected to hydrothermal reaction to obtain MoO which can be used for a lithium ion battery cathode 3 @MoS 2 A core-shell structure material. The invention simplifies the preparation process of the existing lithium ion battery cathode material, solves the problem of volume expansion of the lithium ion battery molybdenum-based cathode material in the charging and discharging processes, and has excellent rate performance and cycle stability.

title_en: Application of copper ion-tannin co-assembled antibacterial nanosheet as antitumor drug carrier
abstract_en: The invention provides an application of a copper ion-tannic acid co-assembled antibacterial nano sheet as a carrier of an anti-tumor drug, which is characterized in that the antibacterial nano sheet is ultrasonically dispersed in deionized water, the anti-tumor drug is added, the anti-tumor drug is fully stirred under a dark condition to be loaded in the antibacterial nano sheet, and the antibacterial anti-tumor nano drug is obtained through centrifugation and drying. The antibacterial nanosheet has good antibacterial performance and biocompatibility, can efficiently load antitumor drugs through electrostatic interaction and complexing action, has a stable structure in a normal physiological environment, can efficiently release antitumor drugs and copper ions in a tumor micro-acid and high-content glutathione environment, plays a synergistic antitumor effect and excellent antibacterial performance, effectively avoids side effect risks caused by disordered leakage of metal ions in a traditional metal particle antibacterial material, is expected to solve the problem that a patient is easily infected by bacteria in the tumor treatment process, and can improve the treatment effect of chemotherapeutic drugs.

title_en: Preparation and application of nano gold shell particles with near-infrared two-region absorption
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of nano-gold shell particles with near-infrared two-region absorption, wherein the inner core of the nano-gold shell particles comprises UiO-66-NH 2 (ii) a The shell layer of the nano-gold shell particles is a gold nanoshell. The nano gold shell particles disclosed by the invention have narrow particle size distribution, and the thickness, the particle size and the infrared absorption peak of the shell are controllable; the preparation method of the nano gold shell particles has the advantages of simple process, simple operation, low equipment requirement, low cost and easy large-scale production; the nano gold shell particles have excellent photo-thermal treatment effect, have the advantages of good biocompatibility, high photo-thermal conversion efficiency and small cytotoxicity, and can be widely applied to photo-thermal treatment, CT imaging or photo-acoustic imaging.

title_en: Carbon nano tube surface coated amorphous or crystalline chromium oxide nano functional coating and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of nano composite functional coatings, and particularly discloses a nano functional coating with amorphous or crystalline chromium oxide coated on the surface of a carbon nano tube, and a preparation method and application thereof. The method can prepare a nano-structure composite functional body, and the CNTs are coated with amorphous continuous Cr 2 O 3 A nano-coating; the amorphous chromium oxide nano coating in the composite functional body can be efficiently converted into crystalline Cr through heat treatment 2 O 3 Nano coatings or nano particles, CNTs and Cr 2 O 3 Nano coating or Cr 2 O 3 Passing Cr between nano particles x C y The nanometer transition layer is connected, and the microstructure of the nanometer coating can be accurately regulated and controlled by regulating the coating process and the heat treatment temperature. The method can reduce the length-diameter ratio of the CNTs, improve the interface adaptability of the CNTs and substrates such as metal, ceramic, polymer and the like, and can greatly expand the application field of the CNTs as a reinforcement or functional additive.

title_en: Room-temperature water-phase multi-cycle synthesis and room-temperature welding method of nano silver
abstract_en: The invention relates to a room temperature water phase multi-round method synthesis and room temperature welding method of nano silver, which comprises the steps of firstly stirring an aqueous solution containing a low-concentration surfactant, and adding an ascorbic acid aqueous solution; adjusting the system to be neutral to alkaline by adopting a strong alkali aqueous solution, and improving the reducibility of the ascorbic acid aqueous solution; rapidly adding a silver nitrate water solution to obtain a nano-silver seed solution; the nano-silver aqueous solution with uniform size and larger size can be obtained through the growth of a multi-turn method; after the silver adhesive is processed into a pattern in a dispensing mode, normal-temperature welding of the nano particles is realized by a method of soaking an organic solvent, so that the silver adhesive pattern is conductive. The method can realize the large-scale synthesis of the nano-silver aqueous phase, the minimum size can reach 10 nm, the maximum size can reach more than 500 nm, the yield is high, the monodispersity is good, room-temperature welding can be realized only by adopting simple solvent soaking, the energy consumption is greatly reduced compared with the traditional high-temperature and high-pressure welding and other modes, and the method meets the requirements of industrial application.

title_en: Gas sensor substrate and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a gas sensor substrate, a preparation method and application thereof. According to the invention, the in-situ light source layer is introduced into the substrate of the gas sensor, so that the in-situ enhancement of the gas sensor is realized, the sensor has higher sensitivity at low temperature, high stability and good reproducibility, the light utilization rate of the substrate can be improved, the surface enhancement effect is better, the gas sensor meeting various requirements can be realized, the preparation process is simple, and the cost is low.

title_en: Nerve electrode structure and implantation method and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: A nerve electrode structure, an implanting method and a manufacturing method thereof are provided, the nerve electrode structure comprises: a flexible mesh portion and a flexible auxiliary implant portion connected to each other; the grid part comprises grid lines, the grid lines comprise data transmission grid lines, the data transmission grid lines comprise data signal lines and an insulating part, and the insulating part wraps part of the data signal lines; the data signal line includes an electrode site, and the insulating part exposes the electrode site; the auxiliary implantation part comprises a strip-shaped part, a first end of the strip-shaped part in the extending direction of the strip-shaped part is connected with the grid part, and a second end of the strip-shaped part, opposite to the first end of the strip-shaped part, is far away from the grid part.

title_en: Nanoparticle copper-manganese composite catalyst, preparation thereof and application thereof in electrocatalytic synthesis of urea
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of catalysts, and discloses a nano-particle copper-manganese composite catalyst, and preparation and application thereof in electrocatalytic urea synthesis. The method comprises the following steps: 1) Copper salt and manganese salt are dissolved in water to obtain a mixed solution; the copper salt is water-soluble copper salt, and the manganese salt is water-soluble manganese salt; 2) Adjusting the pH value of the mixed solution to be alkaline, heating, stirring and aging, and carrying out subsequent treatment to obtain powder; 3) And (3) calcining the powder at high temperature to obtain the nano-particle copper-manganese composite catalyst. The method is simple, and the prepared catalyst has excellent catalytic activity in electrocatalytic urea synthesis. The catalyst of the invention is used for electrocatalytic synthesis of urea.

title_en: Semiconductor MEMS packaging structure and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a semiconductor MEMS packaging structure, comprising: packaging structure main part, prevent falling exhaust assembly, packaging structure main part includes base plate, sensor group, the sealing cap body, and sensor group sets up on the base plate, and the sealing cap body sets up on the base plate and covers and establish on sensor group, is provided with the exhaust hole on the sealing cap body, prevents falling exhaust assembly and sets up on the base plate to the sealing cap body is located prevents falling exhaust assembly. When the semiconductor MEMS packaging structure is used, heat generated by the work of the sensor group can be exhausted to the outside through the exhaust hole, and then the heat is further exhausted to the outside in an accelerated manner through the anti-falling exhaust assembly, so that the semiconductor MEMS packaging structure has a good cooling effect, good working environment temperature can be kept, and the working efficiency and the life cycle of the semiconductor MEMS packaging structure are prevented from being affected by heating and scalding. The invention also discloses a packaging method of the semiconductor MEMS packaging structure, which avoids the influence of heat and scalding on the working efficiency and the life cycle of the semiconductor MEMS packaging structure.

title_en: Preparation method of spherical Zn-Mn metal compound
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a spherical Zn-Mn metal compound. The preparation method comprises the following steps: adding the metal ion solution into the meta-acid carbon point solution, and then adding a sodium carbonate aqueous solution into an oil bath while stirring to obtain the Zn-Mn metal carbonate compound with a spherical structure. The invention provides a novel preparation method of a Zn-Mn metal compound, which is characterized in that water or ethanol soluble carbon dots are used as a carrier and polyvinylpyrrolidone is used as a surfactant to prepare the Zn-Mn metal compound with a spherical structure, and the prepared material can be applied to lithium ion batteries and other application researches in the field of electrochemical energy or photocatalytic material synthesis.

title_en: Preparation method and application of carbon-coated nano-silicon composite material
abstract_en: The application discloses a preparation method and application of a carbon-coated nano silicon composite material, wherein a macromolecule and deionized water or distilled water are weighed according to a certain proportion, after ultrasonic dispersion, weak acid is adopted to adjust the PH of a solution to 5-6.5, then the solution is nano silicon powder, namely a surfactant is weighed according to a certain proportion, and then ultrasonic dispersion, heating, stirring and centrifugation are carried out; drying the centrifuged raw material solution, pouring the raw material into sulfuric acid with the concentration of 70% -98% for carbonization and shaping, pouring the carbonized and shaped raw material into a centrifuge tube for centrifugation on the centrifuge, and heating the centrifuged raw material to dry the raw material into a semi-finished product; and (5) carbonizing the semi-finished product in a furnace to obtain a carbon-coated nano silicon composite material finished product. The carbon-coated nano-silicon composite material prepared by the method has the advantages of good sphericity, relatively high capacity, high strength of coated graphite, good dispersibility of a coating, and relatively simple preparation process steps.

title_en: Nano composition containing hydrophobic substance and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a nano composition containing hydrophobic substances, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the nano composition containing the hydrophobic substances comprises an emulsifying layer which is an emulsified hydrophobic substance; and an outer layer containing alginic acid (alginate) and hyaluronic acid; wherein, the outer layer is coated on the outer side of the emulsifying layer. The nano composition containing the hydrophobic substance can be used for preparing a medicine composition for bladder perfusion.

title_en: Large-scale preparation method of high-temperature-resistant yellow-light carbon dots for LEDs
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of luminescent materials, and particularly relates to a large-scale preparation method of a high-temperature-resistant yellow-light carbon dot for an LED. The method comprises the following steps: (1) Grinding the raw materials uniformly by using citric acid as a carbon source and boric acid, silicic acid and urea as doping agents, and dissolving the raw materials in deionized water; (2) Pyrolyzing the mixture obtained in the step (1) at 200-250 ℃, and then grinding to obtain yellow carbon dots. The yellow carbon dots prepared by the preparation method disclosed by the invention are high in yield, stable in luminescence and free of quenching in a solid aggregation state of the prepared carbon dots, and have a good high-temperature resistance characteristic. The preparation of the yellow LED device with low cost, low color temperature and strong penetration capability can be realized, and the preparation method has great market prospect in the field of yellow LED devices.

title_en: Preparation method and application of nano composite material based on Au-PbS heterostructure
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method and application of a nano composite material based on an Au-PbS heterostructure. The Au-PbS nano-particles synthesized by the method have uniform particle size, good monodispersity, good crystal structure, adjustable near-infrared II-region fluorescence emission performance and good fluorescence quantum yield.
