The Au-PbS nano-particles provided by the invention not only have the performances of nano-gold particles and lead sulfide quantum dots, but also have more excellent near infrared light absorption under the synergistic action of the two nano-particles, so that the Au-PbS nano-particles have good photo-thermal effect, can be used as a photo-thermal conversion agent, and can be used for tumor photo-thermal imaging and photo-thermal treatment. In addition, the Au-PbS nano-particles can be used as a Computed Tomography (CT) imaging contrast agent for CT imaging due to the large X-ray attenuation coefficient of the Au-PbS nano-particles.

title_en: Three-dimensional hollow WS2/C composite electrode material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional hollow WS 2 A three-dimensional hollow carbon structure is constructed by utilizing a hard template method and ZIF-8 derived carbon, and then a three-dimensional hollow WS is synthesized by a solvothermal method 2 a/C composite material. WS obtainable by this process 2 The phase purity of the/C composite electrode material is high, and no other impurity phase exists; WS (WS) 2 the/C composite electrode material has a three-dimensional hollow composite structure,and prepared WS 2 the/C composite electrode material has good dispersibility and uniform size distribution; let WS be 2 the/C composite electrode material is applied to a sodium ion battery, on one hand, the volume expansion of the electrode in the charging and discharging process can be effectively improved through the three-dimensional hollow structure, and in addition, the high-speed migration of charges can be ensured through the three-dimensional hollow carbon layer structure and the nano structure, so that the excellent sodium storage performance is shown. The invention discloses a three-dimensional hollow WS 2 The preparation method of the/C composite electrode material has the advantages of simple experimental operation process, low raw material cost, easily controlled reaction temperature, short used time and large-scale preparation in a short time.

title_en: Preparation method of nano material macroscopic complex with substrate heating-solvent evaporation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for efficiently preparing a nano material macroscopic complex based on a substrate heating-solvent evaporation synergistic effect. Placing a substrate to prepare a reaction precursor solution required by synthesizing the nano material; uniformly dripping a small amount of precursor solution on/in a substrate; and (3) heating the substrate in a heating mode to generate high temperature and transferring heat to the precursor solution on/in the substrate, stopping heating the substrate after a period of time to finish synthesis, taking down the substrate and cleaning to obtain the corresponding nano material macroscopic composite. The invention explores a new preparation mode, and the preparation method synchronously combines the local high temperature generated on the surface/inside of the substrate and the evaporation concentration effect of a small amount of precursors on the surface of the substrate to synergistically promote the rapid nucleation and growth of the nano material, and finally prepares the composite device with excellent quality in an extremely high-efficiency mode.

title_en: Metal oxide with hollow netty nano cage structure and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a metal oxide with a hollow netlike nano cage structure, a preparation method and application thereof. The metal oxide with the hollow netlike nano-cage structure is particles with the hollow netlike nano-cage structure, and the composition components comprise Fe-Ni-Co ternary metal oxide. The preparation method of the metal oxide with the hollow netlike nano cage structure comprises the following steps: 1) Preparing template particles; 2) Preparing core-shell nanoparticles; 3) Preparing hollow particles; 4) Preparation of Co (OH)  2  Loaded hollow particles; 5) Co (OH)  2  And (3) placing the loaded hollow particles in an aerobic environment for calcination to obtain the metal oxide with the hollow netty nano-cage structure. The metal oxide with the hollow netlike nano cage structure has the advantages of excellent electromagnetic wave absorption performance, good impedance matching performance, good high-temperature thermal stability and the like, has good comprehensive performance and has good application prospect.

title_en: Platinum-based alloy catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a platinum-based alloy catalyst, which takes ordered-phase platinum-iron-iridium alloy nanowires as an active component and carbon black as a carbon carrier, wherein the platinum-iron-iridium alloy nanowires are uniformly dispersed on the surface of the carbon black. The catalyst has good structural stability and activity, strong oxidation resistance and strong acid resistance, and meanwhile, the catalyst has good catalytic performance of catalyzing oxygen to reduce to water. The invention also discloses a preparation method and application of the catalyst.

title_en: Diselenide bridge Lian Duo cetime dimer prodrug and self-assembled nanoparticles thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of new auxiliary materials and new dosage forms of pharmaceutical preparations, relates to a diselenide-bridged docetaxel dimer prodrug and self-assembled nanoparticles thereof, and in particular relates to synthesis of a diselenide-bridged docetaxel dimer prodrug, construction of self-assembled nanoparticles containing the dimer prodrug and application of the dimer prodrug in drug delivery. The redox double-sensitive small molecule prodrug containing blood circulation stable diselenide linkage bridging selects docetaxel as a simulated drug, selects (a) 4,4 '-diselenide dibutyric acid or (b) 3,3' -diselenide dipropionic acid or (C) 2,2 '-diselenide diacetic acid as chemical bridging, and connects two molecules of docetaxel together by forming ester bonds by chemically bridged carboxyl groups and C (2') hydroxyl groups of the docetaxel. The docetaxel dimer prodrug provides a new strategy and more choices for developing an intelligent response type drug delivery system in a tumor microenvironment, and meets the urgent need of high-efficiency low-toxicity chemotherapy preparations in clinic.

title_en: Controllable preparation method and application of visible light induced SiN nano net platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a controllable preparation method and application of a visible light induced SiN nano net platform. The method comprises the following steps: (1) focusing an electron beam of a transmission electron microscope on the SiNx film to prepare nano holes (2) with different diameters, placing the SiNx film with the nano holes in the step (1) in a solution A, and illuminating at room temperature for different times by using a high-uniformity xenon lamp to shrink the aperture; (3) placing the illuminated SiNx nano hole under a TEM (transmission electron microscope) to observe the change of the aperture, and determining the change rule of the aperture along with the illumination time; (4) and (4) realizing controllable preparation of the SiNx nano holes with the required aperture through the change rule of the step (3). According to the invention, the nano holes with different apertures are prepared by using the electron beam of the transmission electron microscope, and the SiNx shrinkage cavity is induced by using visible light, so that the method is simpler, the cost is lower, the prepared inorganic nano net has good structural stability and adjustable size, is easy to modify, can be recycled, and can be used for construction of an all-inorganic protein capture platform and protein structural analysis.

title_en: Hafnium oxide ceramic nanofiber and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hafnium oxide ceramic nanofiber and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, dissolving a high molecular material in a proper solvent to obtain a high molecular solution with certain viscosity; then adding a hafnium oxide precursor into the high molecular solution to obtain a spinning precursor mixed solution; spraying the precursor mixed solution onto a receiver by adopting a solution jet spinning method to obtain composite fibers; and finally, carrying out heat treatment on the obtained composite fiber at a certain temperature to obtain the hafnium oxide ceramic nanofiber. The hafnium oxide ceramic nanofiber prepared by the method has good flexibility and high temperature resistance, and has good application prospects in the fields of aerospace, high-temperature air filtration, catalyst carriers, fireproof clothing and the like.

title_en: Self-assembly ferritin-based nanoparticle for resisting influenza A (H1N 1) virus, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses self-assembly ferritin-based nano particles for resisting influenza A (H1N 1) subtype virus, and a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of genetic engineering. The nano-particles are formed by connecting a signal peptide-ST-FE fusion protein and a signal peptide-SC-HA-VHH fusion protein in vitro; the signal peptide-ST-FE fusion protein is composed of a peptide sequence shown as SEQ ID NO: 3, connecting a signal peptide-SpyTag shown in the specification to the N end of a ferritin monomer subunit to obtain the protein; the signal peptide-SC-HA-VHH fusion protein is formed by the N end of a nano antibody of an anti-subtype H1N1 influenza A virus hemagglutinin protein and a polypeptide sequence shown as SEQ ID NO: 4-SpyCatcher ligation. The nanoparticle for resisting the influenza A virus H1N1 subtype has great significance for monitoring, preventing and treating the influenza A virus H1N1 subtype.

title_en: Board-level system-in-package method and package structure
abstract_en: A board-level system-level packaging method and a packaging structure are provided, wherein the packaging method comprises the following steps: the circuit board is provided with a first surface and a second surface, the circuit board comprises a bonding area and a cutting area surrounding the bonding area, a plurality of first welding pads are formed on the surface of the circuit board, and the first welding pads are sunken on the first surface of the circuit board; a plurality of first chips are formed in the first device wafer, a second welding pad is formed on one surface of each first chip, and the second welding pad is sunken on the surface of each first chip; bonding the first surface of the circuit board on the first device wafer, wherein the first welding pad and the second welding pad oppositely enclose a first gap; forming a first conductive bump in the first gap by an electroplating process, wherein the first conductive bump is electrically connected with the first welding pad and the second welding pad; and after the first conductive bump is formed, cutting the cutting area in the circuit board from one side of the second surface to form a cutting groove penetrating through the circuit board. The invention improves the packaging efficiency of the board-level system-level packaging process and the compatibility with the chip forming process of the front section.

title_en: Preparation method of monodisperse ZnS colloidal microspheres with adjustable particle size
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of monodisperse ZnS colloidal microspheres with adjustable particle size, which comprises the following steps: preparing a zinc source solution, preparing a sulfur source solution, preparing a seed solution, preparing a growth solution, preparing monodisperse ZnS colloidal microspheres and carrying out post-treatment; compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that the ZnS seeds are prepared through the low-concentration reaction liquid, the obtained seeds are added into the high-concentration reaction liquid to guide the controllable growth of the ZnS colloidal microspheres, and the monodisperse ZnS colloidal microspheres with the particle size range of 50-500nm can be accurately prepared by regulating and controlling the concentration in the growth reaction liquid.

title_en: Preparation method of spray type bi-component composite Raman substrate
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide a preparation method of a spray type bi-component composite surface enhanced Raman substrate, belonging to the technical field of Raman substrate preparation. The method comprises the steps of respectively placing a gold nanorod solution and a silicon dioxide dielectric microsphere solution in two centrifuge tubes, controlling the spraying speed of the two substances by controlling the caliber of a spray gun, and distributing the mixture of the two substances on a substrate to be heated and dried to be used as an SERS substrate. The substrate manufacturing method is convenient and rapid, the storage method is simple, the detection limit is low, and the substrate can be produced in a large scale.

title_en: Preparation method of GaN-based multi-nano-channel high-electron-mobility transistor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a GaN-based multi-nano-channel high-electron-mobility transistor, and belongs to the technical field of microelectronic devices. The method adopts a high-temperature oxidation corrosion method and wet etching to form a nano-channel array structure. Because plasma is not introduced in the wet etching, the side surface of the nano channel array is not damaged; meanwhile, only the AlGaN material is oxidized and the GaN material is not oxidized in a certain temperature range, so that corrosion can be automatically stopped on the surface of GaN, consistency among channels and among devices is ensured, and the method is suitable for large-scale commercial production.

title_en: Drug-loaded ZIF-8 nanoparticle covered with TF-PEG-PLGA coating and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a drug-loaded ZIF-8 nanoparticle covering TF-PEG-PLGA coating, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the drug-loaded ZIF-8 nanoparticle comprises the following steps: adding a target drug, 2-methylimidazole and zinc nitrate into a methanol solution, mixing, carrying out a first reaction, purifying, and dissolving in methanol to obtain a drug-loaded ZIF-8 nanoparticle solution; activating COOH-PEG-PLGA, uniformly mixing with transferrin in PBS for a second reaction, purifying and dissolving in PBS to obtain transferrin-modified PEG-PLGA solution; and uniformly mixing the drug-loaded ZIF-8 nano-particle solution and the transferrin-modified PEG-PLGA solution to obtain the drug-loaded ZIF-8 nano-particles covering the TF-PEG-PLGA coating. The nanoparticle has the advantages of blood brain barrier permeability, tumor targeting property, targeting drug delivery for craniocerebral tumors, and providing an ideal carrier for efficient and targeted drug delivery for intracranial tumors.

title_en: Silicon-based heterojunction solar cell and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses silicon-based heterojunction solar cell and preparation method thereof, wherein, silicon-based heterojunction solar cell, including base, passivation layer, electron transport layer and the transparent conductive oxide layer that the stromatolite set up in proper order, electron transport layer is nanometer silicon oxide layer, be provided with n type doping amorphous silicon layer between nanometer silicon oxide layer and the transparent conductive oxide layer. The above scheme can improve the electrical properties of the electron transport layer.

title_en: Graphene composite silicon doped vanadium sodium phosphate composite material, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a graphene composite silicon doped vanadium sodium phosphate composite material. The invention also discloses a preparation method of the graphene composite silicon doped sodium vanadium phosphate composite material, which comprises the following steps: vanadium source and carbon sourceSequentially dissolving a sodium source, a silicon source and a phosphorus source in deionized water, preparing a precursor by a hydrothermal method, mixing the precursor with graphene, stirring, drying, grinding and calcining to obtain nanoscale Na  3  V  2  (PO  4  )  3‑x  (SiO  4  )  x  @ rGO (0.01 < x < 0.2). The graphene composite silicon doped sodium vanadium phosphate composite material prepared by the invention is in a nano-particle shape, shortens a path for sodium ion migration, increases the contact area of an electrode plate and an electrolyte, improves the conductivity of the material, enlarges an ion migration channel, enhances the stability of a battery by means of doping and compounding with graphene, and shows high capacity and long cycle life electrochemical performance in a battery test.

title_en: Super-hydrophobic SERS array sensor and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a super-hydrophobic SERS array sensor, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: cleaning and surface treatment of a substrate; preparing a PDMS chip with an array hole structure; bonding the substrate and the PDMS chip to form a substrate chip; and growing a carbon-doped Ag nano composite material in the array micro-hole of the SERS sensor substrate chip to form the super-hydrophobic SERS array sensor. The super-hydrophobic SERS array sensor prepared by the invention can be used for detecting melamine in food, has the advantages of novel preparation method, low cost, high detection sensitivity and good stability, and can simultaneously detect a plurality of samples and a plurality of substances.

title_en: Two-dimensional transition metal monatomic catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-dimensional transition metal monatomic catalyst, which takes a TiN/TiC heterostructure material as a carrier, and transition metal monatomics are uniformly dispersed on the surface of TiN/TiC. The invention also discloses a preparation method of the two-dimensional transition metal monatomic catalyst and application of the two-dimensional transition metal monatomic catalyst in a lithium-sulfur battery. According to the invention, a TiN/TiC heterostructure material is taken as a carrier, metal monoatomic atoms are uniformly dispersed on the surface of the carrier TiN/TiC, the load capacity of the metal monoatomic atoms (tungsten) on the surface of the carrier can reach 4.5%, the load capacity of the metal monoatomic atoms on a catalyst carrier is obviously improved, so that sufficient active sites are provided for the conversion and catalysis of polysulfide, and the conversion efficiency and the charge-discharge capacity are obviously improved; the lithium-sulfur battery anode material is applied to a lithium-sulfur battery, and the discharge specific capacity, the rate capability and the cycling stability of a sulfur anode are greatly improved.

title_en: High-sensitivity magnetic resonance nano probe and application thereof in siRNA delivery and stem cell marking
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of polymer chemistry and biomedical engineering, and discloses a high-sensitivity magnetic resonance nano probe and application thereof in siRNA delivery and stem cell labeling. Is obtained by loading superparamagnetic ferroferric oxide on PEG-PASp (DMA-AEE). The polymer has good biocompatibility, can efficiently load gene drug siRNA, and can simultaneously generate cation shedding in a slightly acidic (pH 5.5) environment, so that on one hand, the loaded gene drug can be rapidly and efficiently released to play a therapeutic role; on the other hand, the separation of the polymer and the SPIO is caused, and the hydrophobic SPIO is secondarily aggregated in cells, so that a stronger cluster magnetic resonance enhancement effect is caused, and the sensitivity of the MR imaging is increased. The MR visualization gene delivery technology is suitable for the magnetic resonance contrast agent marking of the stem cells in vitro and carries out real-time monitoring on the regression of the stem cells after in vivo application.

title_en: Improved method for ensuring high-quality cover pasting of MEMS
abstract_en: The invention relates to an improved method for ensuring high-quality MEMS cover pasting, which comprises the following steps: and (3) a briquetting correction process: pressing the substrate by using a pressing block, and baking the pressing block and the substrate in a high-temperature environment; laser marking: printing a laser mark on the periphery of each product unit on the substrate by using a high-precision laser printer; automatic glue drawing and automatic cover pasting: painting glue on the edge of the product unit by using a glue painting machine, and pasting a cover on the glue by using an automatic cover pasting machine; detection and correction: detecting the semi-finished product by using automatic optical detection equipment; laser printing: laser printing is carried out on the product unit according to the requirement so as to facilitate identification; cutting: the product units are cut by a cutting machine to form single finished products. The invention ensures that the products after being covered are all qualified, and solves the problem that the cutting process generates a cutting knife.

title_en: Preparation method of high-purity tin dioxide with controllable particle size
abstract_en: A preparation method of high-purity stannic oxide with controllable particle size comprises preparing stannous nitrate solution, adding dispersant and stirring uniformly; controlling the stirring speed, controlling the reaction temperature to be less than 65 ℃, and adding an oxidant to generate beta-stannic acid; standing the beta stannic acid for 5-180 min, filtering, removing impurities from the mother liquor, returning to prepare a stannous nitrate solution, washing and filtering the precipitated beta stannic acid, drying in vacuum at low temperature to obtain beta stannic acid particles with certain particle size, and calcining to obtain a stannic oxide product. The method adopts a nitric acid oxidation method and chemical precipitation normal pressure liquid phase co-oxidation, takes beta stannic acid as a stannic oxide precursor, controls the granularity of the beta stannic acid by controlling the chemical precipitation of stannous nitrate, and obtains the high-purity stannic oxide with controllable granularity by washing, impurity removal and calcination; the preparation method is simple, filtered mother liquor is removed of impurities and then returns to the preparation of stannous nitrate to realize cyclic utilization, and the discharge of waste water is reduced.

title_en: Environment-friendly copper-gallium-aluminum-sulfur zinc sulfide core-shell quantum dot and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environment-friendly copper-gallium-aluminum-sulfur zinc sulfide core-shell quantum dot as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and the method comprises the following steps: (1) mixing a gallium source, an aluminum source, a copper source and oleylamine, heating while purging with nitrogen, injecting 1-dodecyl mercaptan into the mixture, heating, degassing in an inert gas environment, heating, injecting a sulfur precursor solution into the mixture, heating again, performing water bath quenching and centrifugal collection to obtain CuGaAlS  2  A nuclear quantum dot; (2) mixing CuGaAlS  2  And (2) purifying the nuclear quantum dots, dissolving the nuclear quantum dots into 1-octadecene, degassing under nitrogen purging at room temperature, heating, dropwise injecting a zinc precursor solution, dropwise injecting a sulfur precursor solution, repeating the injection step for four times, heating, quenching in a water bath, and centrifugally collecting to obtain the nano-composite material. The copper-gallium-aluminum-sulfur @ zinc sulfide core-shell structure quantum dot effectively passivates the surface defects of the core layer, and improves the photoluminescence yield and stability.

title_en: Application of gold nano material in inhibiting coronavirus
abstract_en: The invention relates to the application of gold nano-material in inhibiting coronavirus, and specifically discloses the application of gold nano-material in preparing a medicament for treating or preventing diseases caused by coronavirus or a material for adhering or inhibiting coronavirus; the coronavirus is selected from one of HCoV-229E, HCoV-OC43, HCoV-NL63, HCoV-HKU1, SARS-CoV2 or MERS-CoV; the disease caused by coronavirus is a disease caused by coronavirus infection. The material disclosed by the invention is simple to prepare, high in biological safety and excellent in effect.

title_en: Micro-fluidic chip and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a micro-fluidic chip and a preparation method thereof, the micro-fluidic chip comprises a substrate, a cover plate and a micro-porous layer, wherein the micro-porous layer is arranged between the substrate and the cover plate; the microporous layer is formed by solidifying microporous gel liquid, and the microporous gel liquid comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: polyglutamic acid, water, a cross-linking agent, silver nanowires and a silk fibroin solution; the preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing a mold, pouring PMMA liquid on the surface of the mold, stripping the mold after curing, wherein the cured PMMA is a substrate and a cavity is formed in the substrate; preparing a template with micro-pipelines, punching through holes on the template, filling micro-pore gel liquid into a cavity formed by embedding the template and a substrate through the through holes, accommodating the micro-pipelines in the cavity on the substrate, solidifying the micro-pore gel liquid to form a micro-pore layer, and stripping the template to obtain a composite layer; the composite layer is bonded with the cover plate in a hot pressing way, and the through hole on the cover plate is communicated with the micro-pipeline channel to obtain a finished product; the method has the advantages of simple process and convenience in operation, and can realize the integration of the sample pretreatment function and the analysis and detection function.

title_en: Ultralow-temperature nano solid oxygen candle oxygen generator
abstract_en: The invention relates to a solid chemical oxygen source, in particular to an ultralow-temperature nano solid oxygen candle oxygen generator. The solid oxygen candle oxygen generator comprises: chlorate and nanocatalyst; wherein the mass ratio of the nano catalyst to the chlorate is (1-3): (97-99). The solid oxygen candle oxygen generator provided by the invention adopts a fuel-free formula, can realize continuous combustion in an environment of minus 40 ℃ until oxygen release is finished, and has the advantages of high safety, strong reliability, low heat generation, stable oxygen release and no chlorine in released gas.

title_en: One-dimensional metal-doped perovskite type niobate piezoelectric material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of inorganic material preparation, and discloses a one-dimensional metal-doped perovskite type niobate piezoelectric material and a preparation method thereof. The one-dimensional metal-doped perovskite type niobate piezoelectric material is rod-shaped, and the structural expression of the material is ABO  3  . The preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) mixing niobium pentoxide, a first alkali metal salt or alkaline earth metal salt and a first molten salt, and roasting to obtain one-dimensional non-perovskite niobate; (2) carrying out ion exchange reaction on the non-perovskite niobate and acid to obtain one-dimensional non-perovskite niobate containing hydronium ions; (3) carrying out thermal decomposition on the one-dimensional non-perovskite niobate containing hydronium ions to obtain one-dimensional rod-like Nb  2  O  5  (ii) a (4) Subjecting the one-dimensional rod-like Nb  2  O  5  AsAnd mixing the template with optional second transition metal oxide, second alkali metal salt or alkaline earth metal carbonate and second molten salt, and then roasting to obtain the one-dimensional metal-doped perovskite niobate piezoelectric material. The preparation method has the characteristics of environmental protection, simple process and low post-treatment temperature, and can obtain the one-dimensional metal-doped perovskite type niobate piezoelectric material with excellent performance.

title_en: Wafer-level integration method of multi-mode thin film sensor and electronic product
abstract_en: The application provides a wafer-level integration method of a multimode thin film sensor and an electronic product. The wafer-level integration method of the multimode thin film sensor comprises the following steps: providing a wafer (1), and preparing a dielectric layer (2) on the wafer (1); preparing a through silicon via (11) on the wafer (1), and filling a conductive medium in the through silicon via (11); arranging a back surface insulating layer (3) on one surface, which is not provided with the dielectric layer (2), of the wafer (1); and arranging a plurality of sensitive films (7) of different types and a plurality of external electrodes on the surface, provided with the dielectric layer (2), of the wafer (1), wherein the external electrodes are interconnected on the surface, not provided with the dielectric layer (2), of the wafer (1) through the silicon through holes (11). The electronic product comprises the multimode thin film sensor manufactured by the method.

title_en: Micromechanical detection structure with low noise and design method
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for designing a micro-mechanical detection structure with low noise, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps: respectively determining influence parameters influencing mechanical Brownian noise and sensitivity of a micro-mechanical detection structure; step two: selecting a change parameter needing to be changed and a change strategy aiming at the change parameter from the influence parameters on the principle of reducing mechanical Brownian noise and ensuring that the sensitivity is unchanged or increased; step three: and considering the influence of different processing technologies, and improving the processing technology according to the change strategy when the micro-mechanical detection structure is processed. The invention can carry out wafer packaging under normal pressure, avoids the complexity and high cost of vacuum packaging and improves the reliability of devices. In addition, the mechanical Brownian noise of the accelerometer can be greatly reduced on the premise of ensuring that important indexes such as sensitivity and the like are not changed, and the overall performance of the sensor is improved.

title_en: Application of purple phosphorus in tumor treatment and preparation of tumor inhibitor and tumor inhibitor
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of purple phosphorus in tumor treatment, wherein the purple phosphorus is a purple phosphorus nanosheet, in the application, the purple phosphorus nanosheet and a liquid suitable for tumor treatment are prepared into a purple phosphorus nanosheet solution, and then the purple phosphorus nanosheet solution is subjected to cold plasma treatment. The invention also discloses an application of the purple phosphorus in preparation of a tumor inhibitor and the tumor inhibitor. According to the invention, the purple phosphorus nanosheet solution treated by the cold plasma is applied to tumor treatment and preparation of a tumor inhibitor, and the tumor inhibitor obtained by the method can effectively inhibit and reduce tumors.

title_en: Nanocomposite and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a nanocomposite material, a preparation method and application thereof. The nanocomposite is provided with a core-shell structure taking the conversion nanoparticle as an inner core and taking a polymer as an outer shell, and a nucleic acid drug loaded on the surface of the polymer; the up-conversion nano-particles have the structural formula of NaGdF  4  :Yb,Er@NaGdF  4  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the The polymer is connected with a photosensitizer. According to the invention, through the coordination of the up-conversion nano particles, the photosensitizer and the nucleic acid medicine, the nano composite material can improve the escape efficiency of the nucleic acid medicine in an endosome under the excitation of 980nm near infrared light, enhance the gene silencing efficiency of the nucleic acid medicine, further enhance the treatment effect of the nucleic acid medicine, simultaneously, the apoptosis can be induced by the active oxygen generated by illumination, the tumor cells can be killed by photodynamic therapy, and the high-efficiency anti-tumor can be realized through the synergistic effect of the gene therapy and the photodynamic therapy.

title_en: Method for preparing hydrophobic wood and composition
abstract_en: The invention describes a method for performing hydrophobic treatment on the surface of a wooden substrate. The method is to use a hydrophobic treatment composition to be applied to the surface of the wood substrate by dip coating, spin coating, brush coating, curtain coating and spray coating so as to achieve the purpose of making the wood substrate hydrophobic. The contact between the treated wood and water can reach 140 degrees. The hydrophobic treatment composition is a core-shell type nano-particle, the core is alkyl halosilane or a mixture of a plurality of alkyl halosilanes, and the active nano-particle with a complex and fine structure is formed by self-assembly under the condition of partial hydrolysis. The shell is polyether modified polysiloxane. The core and shell are bound by non-covalent bond interactions. The core-shell nanoparticle structure has reactive functional groups, and can react with a wood substrate to generate covalent linkage.

title_en: Up-conversion Raman sensor and application
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses an up-conversion Raman sensor and application thereof. The sensor includes: a substrate; a first metal nanoparticle deposited on a substrate; a second metal nanoparticle, the metal nanoparticle movable to be close to the first metal nanoparticle; the method comprises the steps of fixing an analyte in or near a nanogap region between first metal nanoparticles and second metal nanoparticles, and simultaneously irradiating the analyte by adopting a Raman light source and an infrared light source based on a molecular vibration mode of the analyte so as to detect an up-conversion Raman signal of the analyte. The up-conversion Raman sensor provided by the invention not only can realize molecule specificity detection and stable signal, but also can be directly compatible with most of technical optimization based on the traditional Raman molecule sensing, and compared with the traditional Raman technology, the up-conversion Raman sensor can effectively separate background noise which often appears in the traditional Raman technology, and greatly improve the sensitivity and signal-to-noise ratio of molecular signals in the aspects of spectrum and imaging.

title_en: Mxene-optimized lithium-rich manganese-based composite positive electrode material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lithium-rich manganese-based composite anode material optimized by using Mxene, wherein the interlayer spacing of the few-layer Mxene is 10-16A. Ethanol is added during ultrasonic treatment of an etched Mxene precursor, a few-layer Mxene dispersion liquid is obtained through centrifugal treatment of the prepared multiple-layer Mxene dispersion liquid, and then the multi-layer Mxene dispersion liquid is compounded with a lithium-rich manganese-based positive electrode material, so that a few-layer Mxene modified lithium-rich manganese-based positive electrode material with an interlayer spacing of 10-16A is prepared, and a lithium insertion voltage platform can be provided at about 2.2V in a discharging process, so that the first coulombic efficiency can be effectively improved, the platform can be maintained for a long time in a long circulation process, the voltage attenuation and the capacity decline of the lithium-rich manganese-based material can be weakened, and the rate performance and the circulation performance can be obviously improved.

title_en: P-borophenylalanine nanocrystal, preparation method thereof and application of p-borophenylalanine nanocrystal in preparation of boron neutron capture tumor treatment medicine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of nanocrystalline. The invention provides a para-borophenylalanine nanocrystal, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in preparing a boron neutron capture tumor treatment drug, wherein a sodium hydroxide solution and a hydrochloric acid solution of para-borophenylalanine are mixed to obtain a para-borophenylalanine solution, and then the para-borophenylalanine solution is mixed with a polyvinylpyrrolidone solution to obtain the para-borophenylalanine nanocrystal; the preparation method provided by the invention has simple and convenient working procedures, the obtained boron phenylalanine nanocrystal has good water solubility, the nanocrystal is re-dissolved in water after being freeze-dried, the particle size is slightly increased after one month, and the stability is good; after the boron neutron capture and tumor treatment nano-crystal is applied to preparation of a boron neutron capture tumor treatment drug, compared with p-borophenylalanine, the boron concentration of the p-borophenylalanine nano-crystal in tumor cells is obviously increased under the conditions that the drug-added boron concentration is 80ug/mL, the incubation time is 6, 12 and 24 hours, and the application intensity is 2.88 multiplied by 10  11  /cm  2  The survival rate of tumor cells is obviously reduced after thermal neutron irradiation.

title_en: Two-dimensional material nano structure and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-dimensional material nanostructure and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps of S1 transferring a two-dimensional material onto a substrate, S2 spin-coating positive electron beam glue, obtaining the nanostructure of the two-dimensional material by using an electron beam exposure system according to a designed layout, S3 etching the nanostructure of the two-dimensional material in S2 by using a reactive ion beam, removing the positive electron beam glue in S2, S4 redesigning the layout, spin-coating positive photoresist, performing overlay by using a maskless photoetching technology, exposing the part outside the nanostructure of the two-dimensional material in S3 by developing after the overlay is finished, and S5 etching the exposed two-dimensional material in S4 by using oxygen plasma to remove the part outside the nanostructure of the two-dimensional material. The invention prepares the nano structure with a gap of 100-500 nm through an electron beam exposure system and a maskless lithography system.

title_en: Method for one-step synthesis of cobalt phosphide by molten salt mediation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for synthesizing cobalt phosphide by one step mediated by molten salt, which comprises the following steps: s1, mixing neutral salt, a phosphorus source and a cobalt source, and grinding uniformly to form a mixture; s2, annealing the mixture to obtain an intermediate product; s3, heating the intermediate product in an inert gas environment to obtain a precursor; and S4, dispersing the precursor, sequentially washing with acid and water, and drying to obtain the product. The method is a simple, convenient, efficient and cheap preparation method of non-noble metal catalyst cobalt phosphide, can realize efficient electrochemical catalytic degradation of water to prepare hydrogen, effectively relieves the current energy crisis, and improves a series of environmental problems.

title_en: Flaky silicon dioxide and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flaky silicon dioxide and a preparation method thereof, in particular to a method for preparing the flaky silicon dioxide with controllable size by a template method, and belongs to the technical field of powder preparation and powder morphology control. According to the method, graphene oxide is used as a template, tetraethyl orthosilicate is hydrolyzed to obtain silicon dioxide, and white fluffy silicon dioxide powder is obtained by high-temperature calcination; the thickness of the flaky silicon dioxide powder obtained by the invention is less than 50nm, and the average diameter-thickness ratio is large. The method for preparing the flaky silicon dioxide powder has the advantages of good appearance, adjustable diameter-thickness ratio, good powder uniformity, good dispersibility, simple process and capability of realizing large-scale production of the flaky silicon dioxide powder.

title_en: Organic silicon coated quantum dot material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of photoelectric display materials, in particular to an organosilicon-coated quantum dot material and a preparation method and application thereof. The organic silicon coated quantum dot material comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 0.01-1% of the quantum dot core is coated with an organic silicon polymer on the surface of the quantum dot core. The quantum dot material prepared by the method has excellent long-term preservation performance, avoids the loss phenomenon of the quantum dot material under the common condition, effectively isolates air and moisture, eliminates surface defects, greatly improves the chemical stability of the quantum dot material, has wider application range and application field, and is suitable for popularization in the photoluminescence field.

title_en: Magnesium alloy surface TiO2-MoS2Preparation method of two-dimensional film
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of new materials, and discloses a preparation method of a TiO  2 -MoS 2  two-dimensional film on the surface of a magnesium alloy, which comprises the steps of magnesium alloy pretreatment and TiO  2 -MoS 2  composite film material preparation, wherein the TiO  2 -MoS 2  composite film material preparation comprises the steps of preparing an electrophoretic solution, electrophoretic deposition and film cleaning. The TiO  2  -MoS2 two-dimensional film prepared by the electrophoresis method combines the respective characteristics and advantages of the two-dimensional materials TiO  2  and MoS  2  to form a novel multifunctional composite material, a layer of compact nano film is formed on the surface of the magnesium alloy, the medium is prevented from being contacted with the magnesium alloy through the film, the magnesium alloy is protected, the service life of the magnesium alloy is prolonged, and the magnesium alloy has great application potential in the fields of new material corrosion prevention and the like.

title_en: Catalyst-free synthesized tantalum carbide nano whisker and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a catalyst-free synthesized tantalum carbide nano whisker and a preparation method thereof. Meanwhile, the required production equipment is simple, the technological process is simple, the parameters are easy to control, the reliability and the repeatability are good, and the large-scale production is easy to realize. The TaC nano crystal whisker prepared by the process method has the obvious advantages of high purity and large length-diameter ratio (125-2000), so that the TaC nano crystal whisker has higher specific strength, can be used as an ideal nano reinforcement to be applied to various composite materials, and can obviously improve the strength and the thermal shock resistance of the materials and also improve the electrical conductivity of the materials.

title_en: Semiconductor structure and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a semiconductor structure and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the semiconductor structure comprises a first substrate and a second substrate, wherein the first substrate comprises a first contact structure positioned on a first bonding pad, and the first contact structure comprises a first metal base layer covered by a first nano-twin metal coating; and a second substrate comprising a second contact structure on a second pad, wherein the second contact structure comprises a second nano-twinned metal coating on the second pad, wherein the first contact structure is connected to the second contact structure, thereby forming a bonding interface between the first nano-twinned metal coating and the second nano-twinned metal coating.

title_en: Multicolor mixed Micro-LED chip and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of semiconductor light-emitting devices, and discloses a multicolor mixed Micro-LED chip and a preparation method thereof. The invention can solve the problems of complex preparation process and lower luminous efficiency of the multicolor mixed Micro-LED chip in the prior art, adopts a new structure to realize multicolor mixed light emission of the Micro-LED chip, reduces the complexity of the preparation process, improves the photoelectric efficiency of the Micro-LED chip and improves the device performance of the Micro-LED chip.

title_en: Silicon-microphone device packaging structure and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a silicon microphone device packaging structure and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of semiconductor packaging. First lead on the lateral wall of encapsulation lid including the sound hole sets up to avoided sound direct entering first cavity to contact with the silicon oatmeal, avoided the acoustic pressure to strike and lead to the silicon oatmeal damaged. In addition, be provided with the vibration glued membrane in first leading sound hole department to set up the wash port, realized the drainage, avoided steam and silicon wheat chip to contact, also avoided steam to gather in the second cavity, further guaranteed the reliability of product.

title_en: Lithium ion battery positive electrode material, preparation method thereof and lithium ion battery
abstract_en: The invention provides a lithium ion battery anode material, a preparation method thereof and a lithium ion battery. The positive electrode material comprises an inner core layer and a surface coating layer, wherein the surface coating layer is coated on the surface of the inner core layer, the inner core layer is used for providing lithium ions for the charge and discharge process of the lithium ion battery, and the surface coating layer is made of ion conducting materials coated by electronic conducting materials. The lithium ion battery anode material provided by the invention has higher specific discharge capacity and cycle stability. Meanwhile, the preparation method provided by the invention has the advantages of simple process, low cost and easiness in expanding production, and industrialization is realized.

title_en: Alkaline battery cathode material for marine environment and battery using same
abstract_en: The invention discloses an alkaline battery cathode material for a marine environment and a battery using the same, and belongs to the technical field of battery energy materials. The cathode material is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 70-105 parts of zinc powder, 20-40 parts of composite conductive emulsion, 50-80 parts of electrolyte and 6-10 parts of nano additive. Firstly, the invention introduces the formula of the composite conductive emulsion to improve the conductivity; and then, the nano additive is introduced, so that the internal resistance of the battery can be greatly reduced, and the high-power discharge performance and the long-term storage performance of the battery are improved. The battery prepared by the cathode material is suitable for various complex special environments, and has stable performance, simple raw materials, low cost and wide application prospect.

title_en: Lignin derived nickel-based catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a lignin-derived nickel-based catalyst. When the element doped lignin resin precursor is prepared, carboxymethyl reagent is adopted to carry out carboxymethyl modification on lignin; formaldehyde is selected as an additive, grafting reaction is carried out on the modifying reagent, and condensation reaction is carried out on the carboxymethylated lignin solution and the modifying reagent to obtain lignin resin precursors doped with different elements. And then preparing the lignin-nickel composite material by a self-assembly coprecipitation method through the element doped lignin resin precursor and nickel nitrate solution. The lignin-nickel composite material is dried and then calcined in different gas atmospheres to obtain the lignin-derived nickel-based catalyst, and the particle size of the lignin-nickel-based catalyst can reach 6-22nm. The lignin-derived nickel-based catalyst prepared by the method can be used for ethanol coupling reaction, the ethanol conversion rate can reach 81.8%, the higher alcohol yield can reach 35.3%, and the catalyst has excellent catalytic performance.

title_en: Preparation method of superfine copper nanowire and copper nanowire obtained by preparation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an ultrafine copper nanowire, which comprises the following steps: (a) adding a chloroauric acid solution into a mixed solution of a hexadecyltrimethylammonium chloride solution, a sodium hydroxide solution and a citric acid solution, uniformly stirring, injecting a sodium borohydride solution in 2s, stirring, carrying out water bath at 80-110 ℃, and carrying out aging growth to obtain gold nanocrystals; (b) mixing and stirring the hexadecylamine solution and the copper chloride solution uniformly at room temperature, adding the glucose solution, and continuously stirring uniformly to obtain a light blue mixed solution; (c) and (c) adding the gold nanocrystals obtained in the step (a) into the mixed solution obtained in the step (b), and carrying out oil bath reaction at 90-120 ℃ to obtain the superfine copper nanowires. The invention also discloses the superfine copper nanowire prepared by the method. The preparation method has the advantages of simple preparation conditions, mild conditions, low reaction temperature, strong operability and high purity of the obtained superfine copper nanowires, and the growth of the copper nanowires is guided by the small-size gold nanocrystals.

title_en: Cracking agent for hydrogen production, preparation method thereof and method for preparing hydrogen by using cracking agent
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cracking agent for hydrogen production and a preparation method thereof, wherein the cracking agent adopts common metals and alloys such as ferrocene, aluminum, metal chloride, molybdenum, manganese, potassium, calcium, tin, zinc, magnesium and the like as core components, has the advantages of convenient preparation, low cost, radioactivity equivalent to that of common soil and environmental protection. The invention also discloses a hydrogen production method using the cracking agent, which can reduce the oxide film formed in the hydrogen production process, increases the contact area through the adhesive or mesoporous silica, can ensure stable and controllable reaction, and finally greatly improves the hydrogen production ratio. The invention provides a solution for the energy-saving and environment-friendly reformation of the boiler and the popularization and application of the zero-carbon combustion technology, and provides a way for carbon neutralization.

title_en: Polyamino acid, preparation method thereof and nano vaccine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biology, and particularly discloses a polyamino acid, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in preparation of vaccine adjuvants. One end of the polyamino acid is hydrophobic amino acid, comprising tryptophan, phenylalanine, valine, leucine, isoleucine, alanine and methionine, and the other end is hydrophilic poly-D-lysine, poly-D-histidine or poly-D-arginine, and the amphiphilic polyamino acid with a hydrophilic chain segment and a hydrophobic chain segment can self-assemble in water to form nano-micelle. The result shows that the nano particles prepared by self-assembling the polyamino acid in water or an aqueous solvent can cause dendritic cell activation and enhanced antigen cross presentation capability and enhance adaptive immune response reaction, thereby achieving the effects of immune enhancement and treatment.

title_en: Preparation method of super-hydrophilic and super-oleophobic nanofiber membrane in air
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of preparation of nanofiber membranes, in particular to a preparation method of a super-hydrophilic and super-oleophobic nanofiber membrane in air. S1, adding polyvinyl butyral into a solvent to prepare an electrostatic spinning solution; s2, carrying out electrostatic spinning on the electrostatic spinning solution to obtain a fiber membrane; and S3, removing residual solvent on the surface of the fiber membrane to obtain the super-oleophobic and super-hydrophilic super-infiltrated nano-fiber membrane in the air. The purpose is to provide a nanofiber membrane which can have the characteristics of super-hydrophilicity and super-oleophobicity in air.

title_en: Bionic nano enzyme Hemin @ BSA @ ZIF-8 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of enzyme-linked immunoassay, and particularly relates to a bionic nano enzyme Hemin @ BSA @ ZIF-8 and application thereof. The invention synthesizes the bionic nano enzyme Hemin @ BSA @ ZIF-8 based on the metal organic framework material, and has high-efficiency peroxidase-like catalytic activity and good stability. The BPA antibody marker has a signal amplification effect, utilizes the specific recognition of antigen-antibody, adds a target substance, and further constructs an indirect competitive enzyme-linked immunoassay method through the competitive action of the target substance and the antigen. Can be used for detecting BPA in environmental samples. Hemin @ BSA @ ZIF-8 can amplify a detection signal, effectively avoid damage and influence of extreme reaction conditions such as environmental temperature, pH value, ionic strength and the like on the activity of natural enzyme, and improve the tolerance and stability of a complex sample in the detection process. The sensitivity is high, and the detection limit can reach 0.546 ng/mL; has the advantages of simple operation, strong stability, good accuracy, low cost and the like.

title_en: Polymer composition
abstract_en: A polymer composition comprising (i) at least 70wt% of a Low Density Polyethylene (LDPE) homopolymer or copolymer having a density of 905-935kg/m  3  (ISO 1183-2) and an MFR  2  of 0.1-10g/10min (ISO 1133,190 ℃,2.16 kg), (ii) 0.5-20wt% of a High Density Polyethylene (HDPE) having a density of 940kg/m  3  or more and an MFR  2  of 0.1-50g/10min, and (iii) 0.05-10wt% of an aliphatic functionalized inorganic nanoparticle filler, preferably an alkyl functionalized inorganic nanoparticle filler.

title_en: Activated near-infrared two-region fluorescent probe and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an activated near-infrared two-zone fluorescent probe and a preparation method and application thereof, and specifically relates to rare earth down-conversion nanoparticles DCNPs with a fluorescent function in a near-infrared two-zone and anoxic molybdenum oxide MoO with strong absorption near the near-infrared two-zone  3‑x  The water-soluble nanoprobes which can be used for the activation of the microenvironment of the near-infrared two-region fluorescent tumor are finally prepared by self-assembling together in a covalent mode of amino-carboxyl condensation reaction and modifying a targeting reagent HA on the surface of the water-soluble nanoprobes. The probe solves the problems that the nano material is poor in enrichment at a tumor part and cannot respond to a tumor microenvironment specifically, and realizes tumor-targeted near-infrared two-region fluorescence imaging.

title_en: Preparation method of layered hydroxyl copper pyrovanadate anode material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a layered hydroxyl copper pyrovanadate anode material, which comprises the following steps: step 1: adding a vanadium source into deionized water, heating and stirring at 90 +/-5 ℃ to dissolve, and obtaining a vanadium source solution; step 2: adding a copper source into deionized water, and uniformly stirring at room temperature to obtain a copper source solution; and step 3: adding the copper source solution into the vanadium source solution, and uniformly mixing to obtain a mixed solution; wherein the molar ratio of vanadium/copper atoms in the vanadium source and the copper source is 1 (1-4); and 4, step 4: and (3) magnetically stirring the mixed solution obtained in the step (3) to react to obtain a precipitate, and sequentially filtering, washing and drying to obtain the layered hydroxyl copper pyrovanadate anode material. The invention adopts a coprecipitation method, can realize the macro preparation of the hydroxyl pyroglutamic acid copper under the conditions of normal temperature and normal pressure, has simple and convenient preparation process and less condition limitation, is easy to realize large-scale popularization and application, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: High-entropy ceramic nano twin crystal particle dispersion reinforced tungsten alloy and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-entropy ceramic nano twin crystal particle dispersion reinforced tungsten alloy and a preparation method thereof, wherein the tungsten alloy consists of Zr (W) -O-C high-entropy ceramic nano twin crystal particles formed by zirconium, tungsten, oxygen and carbon and tungsten (W), and the content of the Zr (W) -O-C is 0.5-2.0% and the content of the W is 98.0-99.5% according to the weight percentage. According to the invention, by controlling raw tungsten powder and oxygen impurities in the preparation process, introducing a proper amount of ZrC nano particles, and utilizing the reaction of ZrC and impurity oxygen in tungsten, zr (W) -O-C high-entropy ceramic nano twin crystal particles are generated in situ, so that the embrittlement effect of impurity oxygen on tungsten is reduced, the low-temperature toughness of the alloy is improved, and the strength of the alloy is improved by utilizing nano Zr (W) -O-C particles to pin grain boundaries and dislocation. The tungsten alloy of the invention has excellent low-temperature toughness and tensile strength, and shows plasticity at room temperature, and the tensile strength is far higher than that of the pure tungsten and the conventional dispersion strengthening tungsten alloy reported at present. The tensile strength of the tungsten alloy of the invention is up to 1.65GPa at room temperature, and the elongation is more than 5%.

title_en: Method for preparing Pt-Cu nanocrystalline with open type porous hexagonal structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing Pt-Cu nano-crystals with open type porous hexagonal structures, which mainly obtains a Pt-Cu nano bimetal alloy with a special structure through oil bath synthesis and electrochemical treatment. The nanocrystalline can be applied to Oxygen Reduction Reaction (ORR) and carbon dioxide reduction reaction (CO) due to high surface area and abundant active sites  2  RR), Nitrogen reduction reaction (N)  2  RR), Methanol Oxidation Reaction (MOR), Ethanol Oxidation Reaction (EOR) and other electrochemical catalytic reactions, and can also be applied to surface diffusion kinetics and surface diffusion of high-curvature crystalsSurface science and nano science researches such as surface stress effect, high magnetic resistance effect and the like.

title_en: Preparation method of photocatalytic self-cleaning coating outer wall metal plate
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a photocatalytic self-cleaning coating outer wall metal plate, which comprises the following steps: ultrasonically cleaning and drying a metal plate in alkaline degreasing liquid; performing direct current glow cleaning on the titanium target; after the sputtering cleaning is stable, the direct current magnetron sputteringShooting a titanium target, and depositing a metal Ti film on the surface of the metal plate; carrying out anodic oxidation on the sputtered Ti-plated metal plate; and taking out after the anodic oxidation is finished, carrying out ultrasonic cleaning in a mixed solution of acetone and ethanol, and finally carrying out blow-drying to obtain the catalyst. The method prepares a Ti film on a metal plate by magnetron sputtering, and then carries out anodic oxidation to form TiO on the surface  2  The nano tube self-cleaning coating is compared with the traditional spraying self-cleaning coating, TiO is distributed on the whole surface of the metal plate subjected to anodic oxidation  2  Compared with a coating only doped, the nano tube has more photocatalytic active sites and high speed of decomposing organic matters.

title_en: Method for increasing surface activity of single crystal silver powder and reducing sintering temperature
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving the surface activity and reducing the sintering temperature of single crystal silver powder in the field of silver powder preparation, which comprises the steps of respectively placing a certain amount of silver nitrate and hydrazine hydrate into a container, adding a certain amount of distilled water, and stirring until the silver nitrate and the hydrazine hydrate are completely dissolved to respectively obtain a silver nitrate solution and a hydrazine hydrate solution; the method comprises the steps of weighing Span80, TritonX-100 and n-heptane in sequence according to a certain proportion, adding the container into a magnetic stirrer, stirring while keeping a constant temperature state, slowly dropwise adding n-ethanol into the container, preparing microemulsion of silver nitrate and hydrazine hydrate by using a microemulsion method and using Span80, TritonX-100 and n-heptane as a compatibilization microemulsion system, dropwise adding the microemulsion of hydrazine hydrate into the microemulsion of silver nitrate to react to generate nano-silver, and centrifuging by ultrasonic oscillation and matching with a centrifuge, so that nano-silver particle agglomeration is effectively avoided, the activity of the nano-silver paste is higher, and the sintering temperature is low.

title_en: Sensor packaging structure and method
abstract_en: The application relates to a sensor packaging structure and a method. The sensor package structure includes: the ceramic substrate comprises a bottom plate and side walls integrally formed on the bottom plate, wherein the bottom plate and the side walls enclose to form at least a first cavity and a second cavity; the first packaging chip is accommodated in the first cavity; the second packaging chip is arranged at intervals with the first packaging chip and is accommodated in the second cavity; and the protective layer covers the first packaging chip and the second packaging chip. Because two spaced cavities are enclosed by the bottom plate and the side walls, when the chip is packaged, the chip can be directly packaged in two packaging areas, the second chip is packaged without waiting for the solidification of the plastic package of the first chip, and the packaging process can be simplified by adopting the packaging structure in the application.

title_en: Zero-dimensional Cs 2 CuCl 4 Nanocrystalline, green light LED and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides zero-dimensional Cs  2  CuCl  4  Nanocrystalline, green light LED and preparation method thereof, and zero-dimensional Cs  2  CuCl  4  Preparing the nanocrystal by adopting a high-temperature thermal injection method, mixing cesium carbonate, oleic acid and octadecene, heating to 100 ℃, and maintaining for 2 hours under nitrogen to obtain cesium oleate precursor liquid; mixing copper chloride, octadecene, oleic acid and oleylamine, heating to 100 ℃, maintaining for 2 hours under nitrogen, and removing water in the mixture; then, at 100 ℃, the cesium oleate precursor solution is rapidly injected into the mixture, and after 5 minutes of reaction, an ice water bath is usedRapidly cooling the solution, and centrifugally purifying the cooled solution; mixing Cs  2  CuCl  4  And (3) taking the nanocrystalline as a light emitting layer to prepare a green light LED. Cs prepared by the present invention  2  CuCl  4  The nano-crystal has uniform size, the fluorescence quantum yield is up to 90%, the green light LED continuously and stably works in the atmospheric environment, and the working life of the green light LED reaches 9.7 hours under the driving voltage of 8V.

title_en: Colloidal quantum dot material, preparation method thereof and application thereof in colloidal quantum dot light detector and array
abstract_en: The invention relates to a colloid quantum dot material, which comprises colloid quantum dots and colloid quantum dot ligands, wherein the colloid quantum dots are wrapped in the colloid quantum dot ligands: the colloidal quantum dot ligand has the following structural formula (I): on one hand, the colloidal quantum dot ligand with the structure can help the colloidal quantum dots to disperse in the solution, thereby realizing solution processing; on the other hand, after the colloid quantum dot material is formed into a film, the colloid quantum dot ligand can be decomposed into a short-chain structure through a simple annealing process, so that the traditional process of ligand exchange and elution for many times is omitted. The colloid quantum dot photodetector array prepared based on the technical scheme of the invention has ideal external quantum efficiency.

title_en: Pharmaceutical composition and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a pharmaceutical composition comprising sulfated polysaccharide and a small molecule active substance, wherein the sulfated polysaccharide encapsulates the small molecule active substance. The composition can make sulfated polysaccharide and micromolecular active substances produce synergistic effect, enhance the bioactivity of the sulfated polysaccharide and micromolecular active substances, and provide support for research and development and application of novel micromolecular medicaments.

title_en: Preparation method and application of carbon dots with high yield and drag reduction function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of carbon dots with high yield and drag reduction function and application thereof, citric acid and urea are used as raw materials under high microwave power to prepare the carbon dots with very high drag reduction performance, and meanwhile, the carbon dots also have very strong high-temperature high-salt stability, low carbon cost, simple and quick preparation process, and are suitable for batch production, thereby having very good application prospects in the field of actual petroleum exploitation.

title_en: Terahertz microfluidic system-on-chip for liquid-phase biological detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a terahertz microfluidic system-on-chip for liquid-phase biological detection, which comprises the following components: and the terahertz photon chip and the microfluidic device are integrated. The terahertz photon chip comprises two continuously adjustable semiconductor lasers, a coupler and an optical mixer which are integrally arranged on a photon integrated chip substrate, wherein the output end of the laser is connected with the input end of the coupler and is used for generating two paths of lasers with different wavelengths; the output end of the coupler is connected with the input end of the optical mixer and is used for combining two paths of laser waves with different wavelengths; the terahertz antenna is integrated in the optical mixer and is used for beating the two paths of laser after combination and generating terahertz wave radiation to a sample detection area in the microfluidic device. The microfluidic device is used for injecting, transporting and discharging a liquid-phase biological sample to be tested. The system has the advantages of simple structure, small volume, low production cost and reduced terahertz wave propagation loss, and can directly acquire more comprehensive terahertz wave frequency spectrum.

title_en: Two-dimensional material suspension release device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-dimensional material suspension release device and a method, wherein the device comprises: the two-dimensional material sample height adjusting module is used for clamping the two-dimensional material sample to be suspended and released through the supporting material and adjusting the depth of the two-dimensional material sample immersed in the solution; the two-dimensional material suspension release solution replacement module is provided with a supporting material removal solvent and is used for removing the supporting material on the surface layer of the two-dimensional material; and the replacement solution injection module is used for injecting a support material removal solvent into the two-dimensional material suspension release solution replacement module and replacing the support material removal solvent with high surface tension by a replacement solution with low surface tension. The method is applied to the technical field of micro-nano systems, and can compensate the instability of the traditional method process through the solution replacement with low surface tension and the quantitative control of the immersion height of the two-dimensional material into the liquid level, remarkably reduce the damage rate of the two-dimensional material in the suspension release process, and be popularized to the batch preparation of two-dimensional material suspension devices.

title_en: Preparation method of layered double hydroxide hydrophobic silica composite aerogel
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a layered double hydroxide hydrophobic silica composite aerogel, which comprises the following steps of A, preparing silicon source hydrolysate; step B, forming gel; step C, solvent exchange; step D, hydrophobic modification; and step E, drying; the layered double hydroxide may be replaced with a layered double oxide obtained after calcination thereof. According to the method, the layered double hydroxide is introduced into the silica gel in a specific mode, so that the thermal stability of the silica gel is greatly improved while the basic properties such as high hydrophobicity, low density and low thermal conductivity are maintained, the combustion heat value of the silica gel is also reduced, and the thermal safety of the composite aerogel material is also enhanced.

title_en: Dispersing agent, quantum dot dispersion liquid and film preparation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a dispersant, a quantum dot dispersion liquid and a film preparation method, wherein the dispersant comprises the following components in parts by weight: a mixed first organic, second organic and third organic; wherein the first organic substance is used to separate the quantum dot multimer into individual quantum dots; the second organic matter is used for maintaining the electrical balance of the quantum dot colloidal particles; the third organic material is used for preventing the first organic material from reacting with the second organic material. According to the invention, the third organic matter prevents the first organic matter from reacting with the second organic matter, and the quantum dot polymer is separated into single quantum dots by using the first organic matter, so that the monodispersity of the quantum dot dispersion liquid is ensured; the second organic matter maintains the electrical balance of the quantum dot colloidal particles, so that the stability is ensured.

title_en: Application of selenium precursor in quantum dot synthesis
abstract_en: The invention relates to application of a selenium precursor in quantum dot synthesis, and belongs to the technical field of photoelectric sensors. The method comprises the steps of preparing infrared colloid quantum dots by taking selenium precursors with the following structural formula I and IIB metal salts in toluene according to LaMer model nucleation growth modes:  in the process of synthesizing the infrared colloidal quantum dots with the IIB metal salt, the selenium precursor provided by the invention not only can be well regulated and controlled in the feeding rate, but also can be well uniform in size of the finally synthesized colloidal quantum dots.

title_en: Na 2 Fe(SO 4 ) 2 Preparation method of/C as composite positive electrode material of sodium-ion battery
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of sodium ion battery preparation, and particularly relates to Na  2  Fe(SO  4  )  2  A preparation method of the composite positive electrode material of the sodium-ion battery; dispersing nano graphite in deionized water to obtain a mixed suspension; mixing sodium sulfate pentahydrate, ferrous sulfate heptahydrate and ascorbic acid according to a certain proportion, and spray-drying the nano graphite and Na  2  Fe(SO  4  )  2  ·2H  2  O is tightly combined, the electrochemical performance of the material is greatly improved, the composite material is well coated by using a spray drying method, the conductivity of the material is improved, a precursor is synthesized by using a one-step method, the nano graphite and the precursor are mixed and spray dried, a three-dimensional spherical structure with uniform size is formed after spray drying, and the used medicine has the advantages of rich raw materials, low price and simple synthesis method.

title_en: Composite negative electrode material, preparation method thereof and lithium ion battery
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of negative electrode materials, and provides a composite negative electrode material, a preparation method thereof and a lithium ion battery, wherein the composite negative electrode material comprises a core and a coating layer positioned on the surface of the core; wherein the inner core comprises primary particles and a nano particle layer positioned on the surface of the primary particles; the primary particle comprises a skeleton comprising a main skeleton located inside the primary particle and a plurality of branches extending from the main skeleton to a surface of the primary particle; the nanoparticle layer is formed with micropores and/or mesopores. The composite negative electrode material, the preparation method of the composite negative electrode material and the lithium ion battery can effectively inhibit the volume expansion of the negative electrode material and improve the cycle performance of the battery.

title_en: Preparation method and application of large-size conjugated polymer and inorganic hybrid two-dimensional material thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a large-size conjugated polymer and an inorganic hybridized two-dimensional material thereof, which comprises the following steps: and (3) freezing and vacuum drying the dispersion liquid of the raw materials containing the conjugated polymer to obtain the two-dimensional material. In the technical scheme of the invention, the conjugated polymer and the inorganic hybridized two-dimensional material thereof are prepared by utilizing pi-pi stacking of conjugated polymer molecular chains and an ice template formed by water solidification during freezing through a simple freeze drying process, and the method has the characteristic of being capable of being amplified. The invention also discloses the two-dimensional material prepared by the preparation method.

title_en: Method for preparing micro-nano device on surface of thin film lithium niobate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing a micro-nano device on the surface of thin film lithium niobate, which comprises the following steps: respectively forming chromium films on the upper surface and the lower surface of the cleaned and dried thin-film lithium niobate substrate, wherein the chromium films are used as a mask on the upper surface and a protective layer on the lower surface; transferring the pattern of the photoetching plate to an upper surface mask, and then putting the substrate into a proton exchange furnace for proton exchange; cooling the substrate after proton exchange, and sealing the periphery of the substrate by using a protective material; putting the sealed thin film lithium niobate substrate into a mixed solution of hydrofluoric acid and nitric acid for wet etching; and removing the mask on the upper surface, the protective layer on the lower surface and the peripheral seal, and carrying out end face treatment by using a chemical mechanical polishing process after the substrate is subjected to scribing and cleavage. According to the invention, a proton exchange process is combined with a wet process to etch the thin film lithium niobate material to prepare the micro-nano device, so that the etching rate of lithium niobate can be greatly increased, and the thin film lithium niobate-based micro-nano device with excellent performance and low surface roughness is obtained.

title_en: Preparation method and application of supported polycrystalline surface defect high-entropy alloy catalyst
