abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of alloy catalysts, and discloses a preparation method and application of a high-entropy alloy catalyst with supported polycrystalline surface defects, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, adding acetylacetone platinum into an oleylamine mixed solution of acetylacetone iron, acetylacetone cobalt and acetylacetone copper, adding a reducing agent borane tert-butylamine complex for reflux reaction for a period of time, cooling, washing and centrifuging a product, and performing ultrasonic stirring together with a carbon black n-hexane dispersion liquid to prepare a coralliform PtFeCoCu alloy loaded on carbon black; s2, carrying out ultrasonic cleaning, centrifuging and drying on the obtained PtFeCoCu alloy, and then annealing under hydrogen-argon mixed protective gas to prepare the supported catalyst with a specific structure. The coralline platinum-iron-cobalt-copper nano alloy catalyst with uniform dispersion and appearance is prepared by the invention, and the high-entropy alloy nano particles with special crystal face structures are obtained by further annealing and curing, and the obtained catalyst shows excellent oxygen reduction activity in an acid environment.

title_en: Zwitterionic covalent organic polymer/titanium dioxide nanocomposite and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a zwitterionic covalent organic polymer/titanium dioxide nanocomposite and a preparation method and application thereof. The application prepares porphyrin-based Covalent Organic Polymer (COP) through one-pot reaction, then modifies zwitterionic, and further, combines the zwitterionic porphyrin-based covalent organic polymer with black anatase phase titanium dioxide to assemble nano composite medicine. According to the application, the COP nano-carrier is modified by adopting the polyethylene glycol with excellent water solubility and the zwitterionic group, so that the hydrophilicity can be improved, and the COP antifouling performance is endowed. Meanwhile, the black anatase phase TiO prepared by the application  2‑x  Nanocrystals can improve the photoactivity of photosensitizers to broaden their optically responsive regions to visible, NIR, thereby enhancing absorption of long waves for deeper penetration and PDT efficacy. The nano composite medicine has the advantages of high loading rate, low dark toxicity, strong photodynamic effect, biodegradability after entering cells and the like.

title_en: Detection reagent and detection method for nucleic acid amplification product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a detection reagent and a detection method for a nucleic acid amplification product, wherein the detection reagent is prepared by the following method: 1) Preparing carbon quantum dots by using cellobiose and 1, 3-propanedithiol as carbon sources and adopting a hydrothermal method; 2) Modifying copper ions on the surface of the carbon quantum dot to obtain the detection reagent; when the byproduct pyrophosphate generated by the nucleic acid amplification reaction exists, the fluorescence of the carbon quantum dots is enhanced, so that the qualitative and/or quantitative detection of the nucleic acid amplification product is realized by performing fluorescence detection on the solution obtained after the detection reagent reacts with the nucleic acid amplification product. The invention provides a reagent and a method for detecting a nucleic acid amplification product, wherein the reagent capable of being used for detecting a nucleic acid amplification by-product pyrophosphate is prepared by using a copper ion modified carbon quantum dot, is successfully applied to the detection of the nucleic acid amplification product, can realize the qualitative and quantitative detection of the nucleic acid amplification product, and has the advantages of simplicity, convenience, rapidness, intuition, high preparation property and the like.

title_en: Characterization method and monitoring method of silver nanowire in-situ growth process and application of characterization method and monitoring method in controllable preparation of silver nanowire
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of nano materials, and particularly relates to a characterization method, a monitoring method and an application thereof in controllable preparation of silver nanowires in an in-situ growth process of silver nanowires, wherein the characterization method comprises the following steps of (1) establishing a silver nanowire reaction system; and (3) repeating the steps (1) - (2), summarizing the change rule of the conductivity in the in-situ growth process of the silver nanowires, establishing a conductivity change trend model, and representing the in-situ growth process of the silver nanowires. According to the method, the conductivity change trend model is established to represent the in-situ growth process of the silver nanowire, the conductivity of the silver nanowire reaction process can be monitored in real time by the representation method, the reaction process is further represented in real time on line, the operation is simple and quick, the result is accurate, the method is suitable for a conventional silver nanowire preparation system, and the method has good application value.

title_en: Packaging structure and method of MEMS pressure sensor
abstract_en: The application discloses packaging structure and method of MEMS pressure sensor, packaging structure of MEMS pressure sensor includes: the diaphragm and the base form a sealed cavity, sensing media and a pressure sensing chip are arranged in the sealed cavity, and when the external pressure is increased, the diaphragm bends towards the inner side of the sealed cavity so that the sealed cavity contracts and transmits pressure to the pressure sensing chip through the sensing media; the sealing cover is arranged on the base and is suspended on one side of the diaphragm, which is far away from the sealed cavity; the first electrode is connected with the diaphragm, the second electrode is connected with the sealing cover, and when the sealing cover and the diaphragm are connected with a voltage through the corresponding electrodes, an electrostatic attraction force for balancing overload pressure is generated between the sealing cover and the diaphragm. The application of the packaging structure can avoid damage to the sensing chip caused by transition contraction of the sealing cavity due to pressure overload, thereby realizing overload protection.

title_en: Preparation method and application of nano-drug for enhancing anti-tumor effect by synergistic starvation therapy/chemodynamic therapy
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological medicine, and provides self-sufficient O 2 And H 2 O 2 And the nano enzyme medicine can enhance the anti-tumor capability by cooperating with the hunger therapy/the chemical power therapy. Construction of nano-enzyme catalytic medicine ZnO by bottom-up method 2 @ Au @ ZIF-67, decomposed in a weakly acidic environment in tumors to release a catalyst Co 2+ Exposed ZnO 2 And H 2 Reaction of O to O 2 And H 2 O 2 Can relieve the hypoxia in the tumor and cooperate with the subminiature Au nano-particlesCatalyzing glucose to produce H 2 O 2 And the glucose consumption of the tumor cells is accelerated, so that the tumor cells are in a severe hunger state. At the same time, H is generated 2 O 2 Takes part in Fenton-like reaction again and is Co 2+ Catalyzes the production of highly toxic OH, thereby improving the chemokinetic treatment. The implementation of the nano-enzyme provides a rich reference experience for the synthesis of a subsequent series of nano-enzymes and the application of multi-mode synergistic treatment on cancer.

title_en: Noble metal-non-noble metal alloy nano material and synthesis method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a noble metal-non-noble metal alloy nano material and a synthesis method thereof, which belong to the field of nano material science, and by introducing an active hydrogen precursor, strong formation of a strong reducing species (active hydrogen) on the surface of nano metal is induced, heterogeneous nucleated supported and metal nano materials are prepared as nuclear noble metal-non-noble metal alloy nano materials, so that noble metal-non-noble metal interface co-reduction is realized, different kinds of metal ions are firstly diffused from a solution phase to the surface of nano metal and then reduced by the active hydrogen on the surface of nano metal, and the active hydrogen has extremely strong reducibility and metal salt reduction reaction is transferred from the traditional solution phase and localized on the surface of seed crystal.

title_en: Preparation method of stretchable flexible electronic device with zero-voltage resistance coefficient
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a flexible electronic device with a zero-voltage resistance coefficient, which comprises the steps of firstly designing a pattern of a conductive module unit on a temporary carrier plate, exposing and developing to obtain a region where the conductive module unit needs to grow, then carrying out patterning treatment on a growth site of a nano material on the surface of the temporary carrier plate, washing off photoresist on the surface of the temporary carrier plate, growing vertical gold nanowires on the designed pattern of the conductive module unit, enabling the domino-like conductive module unit to be assembled in an oriented order through capillary force, partially overlapping the conductive module unit after collapse to form a conductive network, transferring the orderly collapsed conductive domino network to a stretchable substrate, and forming a micro-nano structure capable of keeping stable resistivity when being stretched by external force, thereby preparing the flexible electronic sensor with the zero-voltage resistance coefficient, and solving the signal interference problem caused by the change of resistivity of the stretchable flexible electronic device when being stretched by external force.

title_en: Preparation method of silicon-carbon anode material of lithium ion battery
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a silicon-carbon negative electrode material of a lithium ion battery, which comprises the steps of mixing nano silicon with a modifier and solvent water according to a preset mixing proportion, performing high-pressure pulse homogenization treatment to form uniform nano silicon suspension, adding phenolic resin into the nano silicon suspension, dispersing or dissolving to form nano silicon-phenolic resin suspension, adding isocyanate auxiliary agent into the nano silicon-phenolic resin suspension, dispersing or dissolving to form nano silicon-phenolic resin-isocyanate precursor slurry, performing atomization drying and curing treatment on the nano silicon-phenolic resin-isocyanate precursor slurry to form nano silicon-phenolic resin composite powder, and performing high-temperature pyrolysis on the nano silicon-phenolic resin composite powder to obtain the silicon-carbon negative electrode material. The invention can solve the problems of complex process, high cost and the like in the existing preparation method of the negative electrode material of the lithium ion battery.

title_en: Preparation method of graphene/azure A composite material and application of graphene/azure A composite material as positive electrode material of lithium ion battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a graphene/azure A composite material and application of the graphene/azure A composite material as a lithium ion battery anode material. The preparation method is simple and low in cost, and the obtained product has a higher specific surface area and good conductivity, is beneficial to charge transfer, and has excellent long cycle life, rate capability and higher specific capacity when being applied to the anode of the lithium ion battery.

title_en: Micro-needle and flat cable reverse welding connection structure and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reverse welding connection structure of a microneedle and a flat cable and a preparation process thereof. According to the process, the reverse welding connection of the micro-needle and the flat cable is realized by preparing the reverse welding metal layer of the micro-needle, preparing the reverse welding metal layer of the flat cable and aligning the reverse welding metal layer of the micro-needle with the reverse welding metal layer of the flat cable and pressing the reverse welding metal layer to form reverse welding contact. The welding stability of the micro-needle and the flat cable which are connected by the process of the invention is higher than that of the micro-needle and the flat cable which are connected together and prepared by the traditional TSV process, the service life is longer, and the failure rate is obviously reduced; the resistance value of ohmic resistance generated by the electrical contact of the contact is obviously reduced, and the stability and the accuracy of signal transmission are obviously improved.

title_en: Preparation method of rare earth doped YSZ phosphor powder
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of phosphorescent powder, and provides a preparation method of rare earth doped YSZ phosphorescent powder. The method comprises the steps of dropwise adding a mixed metal ion solution and a mixed precipitant solution into an ammonium sulfate solution for coprecipitation reaction by adopting a co-dripping method, aging the obtained precipitate slurry, and then sequentially carrying out solid-liquid separation, washing and drying to obtain precursor powder; and calcining the obtained precursor powder to obtain the rare earth doped YSZ phosphor powder. According to the invention, the rare earth doped YSZ phosphor powder with uniform particle size, good dispersibility and good luminescence performance can be obtained by strictly controlling the conditions of a titration process, metal ion concentration, a surfactant, a precipitator and the like. The embodiment result shows that the average grain diameter of the rare earth doped YSZ phosphorescent powder prepared by the invention is 20nm, the dispersibility is good, the luminous intensity is improved by 2.24 times compared with the phosphorescent powder prepared by the traditional method, and the high-temperature luminous performance is good, so that the rare earth doped YSZ phosphorescent powder has good commercial value.

title_en: Nitrogen-doped carbon quantum dot solution and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for preparing nitrogen-doped carbon quantum dot solution, which comprises the following steps: dissolving a waste liquid and an organic amine in deionized water with a certain volume, and uniformly mixing to form a solution; pouring the solution into a polytetrafluoroethylene high-pressure reaction kettle, sealing, and placing the high-pressure reaction kettle in an air-blast drying oven for hydrothermal reaction; after the hydrothermal reaction is finished, cooling the high-pressure reaction kettle to room temperature, transferring the obtained black solution into a centrifugal tube, cleaning the high-pressure reaction kettle with deionized water, pouring cleaning liquid into the centrifugal tube, quantifying to 20ml, and carrying out ultrasonic treatment on the black solution for 10min to disperse particles; putting the black solution after ultrasonic dispersion into a centrifuge, and centrifuging for 10-20min; and (3) passing the supernatant through a filter membrane with the aperture of 0.22 mu m, and dialyzing for 12 hours by using a 3500D dialysis bag to finally obtain the carbon quantum dot solution.

title_en: Device and method for preparing multicolor spectrum carbon quantum dots
abstract_en: The invention provides a device for preparing multi-color spectrum carbon quantum dots, which comprises: the system comprises a reactant conveying module, an ultrasonic microreactor, a main control module and a collecting container; the method comprises the following steps of A, preparing a reactant, wherein the reactant comprises an A precursor solution and a B precursor solution, the A precursor solution is an ammonium citrate solution, and the B precursor solution is DMF; the invention also provides a method for preparing the multicolor spectrum carbon quantum dot, which comprises the following steps: preparing a precursor solution A and a precursor solution B, injecting the precursor solution A and the precursor solution B into an ultrasonic microreactor, and reacting under the conditions of high temperature and high pressure by utilizing ultrasonic cavitation provided by the ultrasonic microreactor to obtain the carbon quantum dots. The invention provides a device and a method for preparing multicolor spectrum carbon quantum dots, and solves the problem that the process for preparing the carbon quantum dots by a hydrothermal method and a solvothermal method is complicated and tedious.

title_en: Method for preparing nano magnesium hydroxide by taking salt lake brine as raw material
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for preparing nano magnesium hydroxide by taking salt lake brine as a raw material, belonging to the technical field of waste resource utilization and functional nano materials. The invention uses salt lake brine as a raw material to prepare nano magnesium hydroxide so as to improve the utilization rate of the salt lake brine, and adopts multi-effect evaporation crystallization to respectively obtain magnesium chloride hexahydrate and magnesium sulfate heptahydrate, and then prepare the ultra-pure nano magnesium hydroxide. The total yield of the magnesium element in the brine reaches over 90 percent, so that the utilization rate of the magnesium element in the salt lake brine is improved, the obtained magnesium hydroxide product is in a hexagonal crystal form with the thickness of 50-70 nm, the quality requirement of HG/T3821-2006 nanometer magnesium hydroxide is met, and the comprehensive problem of resource utilization of the salt lake brine is effectively solved.

title_en: Method for realizing non-contact rapid infiltration of nano holes by utilizing ultrasonic waves
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application method for realizing nano-pore infiltration by utilizing ultrasonic waves. Unlike traditional chemical surface treatment or high-voltage and high-current infiltration methods, the present invention can utilize lower power ultrasound (3W) to realize rapid (less than five minutes), nondestructive and contactless nanopore infiltration. The method is suitable for application scenes of the nanometer holes of the film materials (silicon nitride, zinc oxide and aluminum oxide) with different diameters and different types, and can realize the improvement of the infiltration speed exceeding two orders of magnitude. The infiltration method provided by the invention does not need to use complex equipment, has simple operation and high speed, and can be used for batch infiltration treatment of the nanopore sensor. Meanwhile, the method can be used for designing integrated small equipment for on-site, real-time and mobile infiltration treatment.

title_en: Pulse generation
abstract_en: Systems and techniques for pulse generation are provided. A classical computing device may receive program source code that includes quantum operations. The program source code may be compiled into a compiler that includes one or more quantum operations. A library of pulse shapes may be determined indicative of a pulse shape corresponding to each quantum operation. A pulse instruction may be generated that indicates one or more pulse shapes corresponding to each quantum operation based on a library of pulse shapes. Binary format instructions may be generated based on the pulse instructions. The binary format instructions may encode the pulse instructions into binary data packets using binary code of a Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) of the quantum computing device.

title_en: Preparation of palladium-phosphorus-sulfur micro-nano particles and application of palladium-phosphorus-sulfur micro-nano particles in photo-thermal field
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of photo-thermal technology, and particularly relates to preparation of palladium phosphorus sulfur micro-nano particles and application of the palladium phosphorus sulfur micro-nano particles in the photo-thermal field. In order to develop a high-performance palladium phosphorus sulfur micro-nano particle photothermal conversion material, palladium phosphorus sulfur (PdPS) crystal powder is used as a material, laser processing is carried out by adopting a laser liquid phase ablation technology, and a micro-nano particle structure is formed to prepare the palladium phosphorus sulfur micro-nano particle material. The palladium phosphorus sulfur micro-nano particle material prepared by the invention is a micro-nano material which has good biocompatibility, has very good electromagnetic wave absorption behavior in a very wide electromagnetic spectrum range (wavelength is 200nm-2000 nm), is in a black powder state in a macroscopic state, shows a photo-thermal conversion performance which is very close to that of a gold nano material in the photo-thermal conversion field, and can be applied to the photo-thermal technical field.

title_en: Quartz normal temperature bonding method
abstract_en: The invention provides a quartz normal-temperature bonding method which comprises the steps of S100, cleaning the surfaces of quartz plates, S200, depositing silicon dioxide on the two quartz plates to form a silicon dioxide bonding film on the surfaces of the quartz plates, S300, carrying out chemical mechanical polishing on the silicon dioxide bonding film, S400, cleaning the quartz plates by using hydrofluoric acid solution, and S500, enabling the silicon dioxide bonding films of the two quartz plates to be in contact with each other and bonding the quartz plates through a bonding machine. The bonding between quartz and quartz can be realized with high reliability at normal temperature.

title_en: Epitaxial wafer for deep ultraviolet LED, preparation method of epitaxial wafer and deep ultraviolet LED
abstract_en: The invention discloses an epitaxial wafer for a deep ultraviolet LED, a preparation method of the epitaxial wafer and the deep ultraviolet LED, and relates to the field of semiconductor photoelectric devices. The epitaxial wafer for the deep ultraviolet LED comprises a substrate, and a buffer layer, a non-doped AlGaN layer, an N-AlGaN layer, a multi-quantum well layer, an electron barrier layer, a P-AlGaN layer and a P-type contact layer which are sequentially deposited on the substrate; the P-type contact layer comprises a P-type AlGaN rough layer, a Mg quantum dot layer, a P-type AlInGaN nanocluster layer and a three-dimensional P-type AlInGaN nanocluster layer which are sequentially deposited on the P-AlGaN layer. By implementing the invention, the luminous efficiency of the deep ultraviolet LED can be effectively improved.

title_en: Stable aqueous dispersions of carbon
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a stable aqueous dispersion of carbon, wherein said carbon comprises between 75-85wt% activated carbon and 15-25wt% CNTs having a purity of at least 95wt%. The dispersion is surfactant free and stable for at least two weeks. The aqueous dispersion is suitable for the production of active layers for electrodes of supercapacitors. The invention relates to a supercapacitor cell having at least one electrode comprising a current collector and an active layer, wherein the active layer comprises activated carbon and high purity carbon nanotubes and is free of a binder. The active layer material is both porous and conductive to increase charge storage capability and reduce electrode resistance. Generally, the content of carbon nanotubes in the active layer is between 10 and 30wt% and the purity of the carbon nanotubes is at least 95wt%.

title_en: Preparation method of copper chromite for laser etching chemical plating aid
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of powder metallurgy, and particularly relates to a preparation method of copper chromite for a laser etching plating aid. In preparing the product of the invention, the method comprises the following steps: mixing a copper nitrate solution and a chromium nitrate solution according to a molar ratio of copper element to chromium element of 1:2.2-1:2.5, mixing, and adding an aluminum salt solution, wherein the using amount of the aluminum element is 5-10% of the molar weight of the copper element, so as to obtain a mixed solution; adding a chelating agent into the mixed solution, uniformly dispersing, then dropwise adding ammonia water to adjust the pH value to 8.8-9.0, and then carrying out hydrothermal stirring reaction; after the reaction is finished, concentrating under reduced pressure to 30-35% of the original volume of the material under the conditions that the pressure is 500-600mmHg and the temperature is 75-85 ℃, and then drying in vacuum to obtain a dry precursor; calcining the dried precursor, then ultrasonically dipping the calcined precursor by using a strong alkali solution, and then filtering, washing and drying the precursor to obtain the product.

title_en: High-fluorescence quantum yield sulfur quantum dot with simulated oxidase activity and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sulfur quantum dot with high fluorescence quantum yield and simulated oxidase activity, and a preparation method and an application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing sublimed sulfur, sodium hydroxide, polyethylene glycol 400 and water, addingHot reflux to obtain solution A; adding ferrate, mixing, and reacting at the same temperature to obtain solution B; taking the supernatant of the solution B, and recording the supernatant as solution C; take H  2  O  2  And mixing with the solution C, and etching by hydrogen peroxide to generate sulfur quantum dots with high fluorescence quantum yield and simulated oxidase activity, which are marked as SQDs. The invention solves the problems of therapeutic effect loss and pathogenic bacteria drug resistance formation caused by long-term use of antibiotics, and provides a new method for detecting folic acid, which is simple and quick and has high specificity. The SQDs of the invention have oxidase activity and show excellent inhibition capability on typical pathogenic multi-drug resistant escherichia coli and methicillin resistant staphylococcus aureus.

title_en: Stepwise intermittent lithium plating method based on vertical orientation multiwall carbon nanotube array
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of lithium metal batteries, and particularly discloses a stepwise intermittent lithium plating method based on a vertically oriented multiwall carbon nanotube array. The method comprises the following steps: s1, preprocessing a substrate; s2, adding the buffer layer and the catalyst layer to the substrate processed in the step S1; s3, growing a vertical orientation multiwall carbon nanotube array on the substrate in the step S2; s4, assembling an electrochemical cell by using the sample with the vertically oriented multiwall carbon nanotube array growing in the step S3 as a working electrode; and S5, performing electrochemical lithium plating on the working electrode by adopting a step-by-step intermittent electroplating method and using the battery assembled in the step S4. The single-step electroplating time, the electroplating current density, the total electroplating time and the single-step intermittent time are adjustable, the uniform deposition of metal coaxial with CNTs can be realized, the strength and the stability of VA-MWCNTs are enhanced, and the single-step electroplating method has great application potential in the fields of electrochemical electroplating, lithium metal batteries and the like.

title_en: Interconnection process of micron In and nano Cu @ Ag core-shell mixed material
abstract_en: The invention discloses an interconnection process of a micron In and nano Cu @ Ag core-shell mixed material, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps: preparing micron In and nano Cu @ Ag core-shell mixed soldering paste; step two: processing a substrate; step three: coating/printing of solder paste; step four: hot pressing/electromagnetic induction sintering. The micron In and the nanometer Cu @ Ag core shell can be matched with each other, so that the space is fully utilized, the porosity is reduced, the cost of raw materials can be greatly reduced, and great advantages are brought into play In industrial mass production. The invention can realize low-temperature connection and high-temperature service, not only reduces the interconnection temperature and interconnection conditions, but also effectively reduces pores and holes in formed joints, can interconnect the chip and the substrate under the low-temperature and non-pressure condition to complete the connection and packaging of semiconductor devices, and can be better applied to the fields of manufacturing of semiconductor devices, microelectronic packaging, power electronic packaging and the like.

title_en: Curable resin composition and display device
abstract_en: The invention provides a curable resin composition, which comprises quantum dots (A), a compound (B-1) with a1 st functional group and a2 nd functional group, a resin (C), a photopolymerization compound (D) and a photopolymerization initiator (E), wherein the 1 st functional group is carboxyl, and the 2 nd functional group is carboxyl or a thiol group.

title_en: Hydrogen bond organic framework nanosheet and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydrogen bond organic framework nanosheet and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of material science, environmental science and synthesis. The preparation method comprises the following steps: in a heat-resistant glass cuvette 1,2,4,5-tetrakis (4-carboxyphenyl) benzene (H)  4  TCPB) and N, N-Dimethylformamide (DMF), heating until the solid is dissolved, placing the small glass container in a heat-resistant large glass container filled with water, sealing the large glass container, standing in a constant-temperature oven for heating, performing suction filtration to obtain colorless crystals, drying to obtain a solid material, grinding the solid material, dispersing in a solvent, performing ultrasonic treatment under the ice-water bath condition, centrifuging, removing supernatant, and drying to obtain the hydrogen bond organic framework nanosheet. The nano fluorescent probe prepared from the hydrogen bond organic framework nanosheet has sensitive fluorescence quenching response on uranyl ions, and has wide application prospect in the aspect of rapid detection of low-concentration uranyl ions.

title_en: Nickel-cobalt bimetal phosphide nano composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a nickel-cobalt bimetallic phosphide nano composite material as well as a preparation method and application thereof. Firstly, adding foam metal into aqueous solution containing cobalt sulfate, ammonium fluoride, urea and polyvinylpyrrolidone to carry out hydrothermal reaction, taking out the foam metal, heating the foam metal to 200-250 ℃, and calcining the foam metal to obtain Co  3  O  4  /MF; then mixing Co  3  O  4  /MF is soaked in nickel nitrate water solution, and Ni (OH) is obtained through secondary hydrothermal reaction  2  @Co  3  O  4  /MF; finally mixing Ni (OH)  2  @Co  3  O  4  the/MF and the phosphate are respectively arranged in twoFeeding the quartz boats into a tube furnace together and calcining the quartz boats in a protective atmosphere to obtain a target product Ni  2  P @ CoP/MF. The invention prepares a novel core-shell nano-array, in which a large amount of tiny Ni is in the core-shell structure  2  The P nano-sheet is tightly wrapped on the CoP nano-wire to form a rich heterostructure interface, and the surface of the nano-wire becomes rough due to the phosphorization effect, and a plurality of tiny particles are attached on the surface of the nano-wire. The rough nanorod array core-shell structure can provide more electrochemical active sites and accelerate charge transfer.

title_en: Preparation method of platinum-carbon catalyst, platinum-carbon catalyst and catalyst coating film
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a platinum-carbon catalyst, the platinum-carbon catalyst and a catalyst coating film, which comprise the following steps: step 1, adding a dispersing auxiliary agent solution into a polyalcohol solution of a platinum precursor to perform a coordination reaction to obtain a first material; step 2, adding carbon carrier polyalcohol slurry into the first material obtained in the step 1, and uniformly mixing to obtain a second material; step 3, heating the second material obtained in the step 2 to 125-160 ℃, reacting for 1-5 h, carrying out reduction reaction, and cooling; then adding deionized water, and continuously stirring for 1-5 h to obtain a third material; and 4, concentrating the third material obtained in the step 3, and then drying and grinding to obtain the platinum-carbon catalyst. The method avoids introducing other harmful impurities, does not need washing, and has simple steps and low process cost; the platinum nano-particles can be uniformly dispersed on the carbon carrier, the agglomeration property is weak, and the platinum-carbon catalyst has high electrochemical active area and good stability.

title_en: Carbon quantum dot composite positive electrode conductive agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of preparation of carbon quantum dot materials, in particular to a carbon quantum dot composite positive electrode conductive agent and a preparation method thereof. The carbon quantum dot composite positive electrode conductive agent comprises, by weight, 80-180 parts of carbon quantum dots and 1-5 parts of carbon fibers, wherein the carbon quantum dots are prepared from, by weight, 80-160 parts of organic carbon, 8-18 parts of strong acid, 0.1-3 parts of an auxiliary agent, 370-470 parts of a first solvent and 0.1-0.8 part of a dispersing agent, and the carbon fibers comprise, by weight, 5-15 parts of acrylonitrile, 0.01-0.5 part of a comonomer, 0.01-0.5 part of an initiator and 50-80 parts of a second solvent. The positive electrode material and the lithium ion battery prepared by the carbon quantum dot composite positive electrode conductive agent can improve the conductive performance of the positive electrode material and the electrochemical activity of the lithium ion battery, and can also keep good cycling stability.

title_en: Preparation of mesoporous silica microcapsule for immobilization optimization based on steric hindrance
abstract_en: A preparation method of mesoporous silica microcapsules for immobilization optimization based on steric hindrance belongs to the technical field of capsules. Firstly, mesoporous silica is utilized to fix glucose oxidase and catalase, and then a layer of polymer network membrane with good permeability is formed on the surface of the mesoporous silica with immobilized double enzymes through room temperature polymerization, and finallyFinally forming positively charged enzyme complex nano-capsule Polymer protein SiO  2  . Not only ensures the stability of the enzyme, but also keeps the high-efficiency catalytic activity of the enzyme due to the microenvironment of the APM node group on the polymer, and has higher enzyme retention efficiency and stress resistance compared with the single physical adsorption of the mesoporous silica.

title_en: Heterojunction capable of dynamically adjusting photoluminescence of perovskite quantum dot thin film
abstract_en: The invention provides a heterojunction capable of dynamically adjusting the photoluminescence of a perovskite quantum dot film, which relates to the field of photonic crystals and quantum dot luminescence, and has a structure of CrPb (I/Br)  3  The quantum dot film is arranged on the upper surface of the reconfigurable three-dimensional inverse opal photonic crystal to form a heterojunction, the band gap of the reconfigurable three-dimensional inverse opal photonic crystal is adjusted and fixed by external force stretching and recovery after heating, and the reconfigurable three-dimensional inverse opal photonic crystals with different band gaps canTo enhance CrPb (I/Br) to varying degrees  3  Photoluminescence intensity of the quantum dot thin film. In addition, when the emission band of the quantum dot and the band gap of the reconfigurable three-dimensional inverse opal photonic crystal are overlapped, light emitted by the quantum dot film propagates along the direction opposite to the position of the photonic crystal in the heterojunction, namely the photonic crystal can be used as a back reflector of the quantum dot film.

title_en: Zinc oxide/zinc phosphate nanorod composite antibacterial coating and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a zinc oxide/zinc phosphate nanorod composite antibacterial coating as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the steps of firstly preparing a zinc oxide nanorod coating on the surface of a medical material; and then converting the zinc oxide in the zinc oxide nanorod coating into zinc phosphate by a water bath treatment method in phosphate or hydrogen phosphate solution, thereby preparing the zinc oxide/zinc phosphate nanorod composite antibacterial coating with the nano-morphology. The preparation method comprises the steps of firstly preparing the zinc oxide nanorod coating on the surface of the medical material, and then carrying out water bath treatment in phosphate or hydrogen phosphate solution to convert the zinc oxide part in the zinc oxide nanorod coating into zinc phosphate with lower degradation rate. The conversion ratio of the zinc phosphate can be regulated and controlled by regulating and controlling the parameters of the water bath treatment, so that the overall degradation rate of the coating is regulated and controlled. The coating can be uniformly and efficiently prepared on the surface of a medical material with a complex shape, has simple process and low cost, and is suitable for batch and industrial production.

title_en: Coal-based carbon quantum dot and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal-based carbon quantum dot and a preparation method thereof. The coal-based carbon quantum dot can obtain variable color fluorescence with different emission wavelengths under the excitation of different semiconductor lasers. The invention utilizes cheap and abundant coal resources, adopts a simple and efficient molten salt oxidation method, has low cost, is safe and controllable, and can prepare the carbon quantum dots with excitation sensitivity, adjustable luminous wavelength and pH sensitivity in a large scale.

title_en: Nano cobalt selenide@three-dimensional honeycomb carbon composite material and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nano cobalt selenide@three-dimensional honeycomb carbon composite material, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in preparing a lithium ion battery cathode. In the nano cobalt selenide@three-dimensional honeycomb carbon composite material, carbon is in a three-dimensional honeycomb pore structure, and cobalt selenide CoSe is tightly and uniformly grown on the inner surfaces of honeycomb pores of the honeycomb carbon in the form of nano particles. The preparation method comprises the steps of firstly synthesizing PS pellets, then slowly evaporating and drying the PS pellets and a solution dissolved with Co (NO)  2  and PVP, then calcining under a protective atmosphere, and finally selenizing by a gas phase method to obtain the nano cobalt selenide@three-dimensional honeycomb carbon composite material. The invention can obviously improve the specific capacity, the cycle performance and the multiplying power performance of cobalt selenide.

title_en: Tumor microenvironment acid response deep penetration nanogel and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides tumor microenvironment acid response deep penetration nanogel and application thereof. The acid response nanogel carrier is prepared by polymerizing double-bonded hyaluronic acid, double-bonded cyclodextrin and 2, 2-dimethyl acryloyloxy-1-ethoxypropane under the action of a free radical polymerization initiator, wherein the double-bonded hyaluronic acid is obtained by modifying the hyaluronic acid with an acrylic anhydride compound, and the double-bonded cyclodextrin is obtained by modifying the cyclodextrin compound with an olefin acyl chloride compound. Also disclosed is an active ingredient-loaded acid-responsive nanogel having the above-described acid-responsive nanogel carrier as an active ingredient carrier, and comprising the active ingredient in a doubly-linked cyclodextrin. The nanogel prepared by the invention has good acid response performance and drug loading capacity, and simultaneously has excellent tumor penetration capacity, thereby being beneficial to enhancing the anti-tumor effect of the drug or being used for detection.

title_en: Preparation method of two-component nano heterojunction material with coherent growth characteristic
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a two-component nano heterojunction material with coherent growth characteristics, which comprises the steps of synthesizing a ferrocenyl metal organic framework material through a simple solvothermal reaction, and then obtaining the two-component nano heterojunction material with coherent growth characteristics through chemical conversion; the synthesis method is simple, realizes the construction and structure optimization of various complex heterojunctions, and improves the oxygen production activity of electrocatalysis.

title_en: High-energy-density nano-wafer-shaped alpha nickel hydroxide, preparation method thereof, electrode and battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-energy density nano-wafer alpha nickel hydroxide, a preparation method thereof, an electrode and a battery; the preparation method of the alpha nickel hydroxide comprises the steps of mixing A, B two reaction liquids for reaction, controlling the final pH value of the reaction liquids to be 6.5-7, aging the reaction liquids and carrying out hydrothermal treatment to obtain the alpha nickel hydroxide, mixing the reaction liquids with a conductive agent, an additive and an adhesive to form slurry, coating the slurry on foam nickel, drying and carrying out hot press forming, controlling the thickness of an electrode, the surface density and the bulk density of an active substance, and carrying out electric polarization to obtain the alpha nickel hydroxide electrode with high energy density. Under the conditions of room temperature 9N potassium hydroxide electrolyte and 0.2-0.7C charge and discharge, the electrochemical discharge capacity of the alpha-phase nickel hydroxide powder can reach 390-420mAh/g, which is 30-45% higher than the theoretical value of beta-phase nickel hydroxide. The electrode has a mass specific capacity of 220-230mAh/g (including the weight of the foam nickel substrate and other inactive additives of the electrode), a volume specific capacity of 560mAh/cc, and good active material utilization rate and charge-discharge performance under higher multiplying power.

title_en: Self-dispersion nano-scale silver powder and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses self-dispersing nano-scale silver powder and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of preparation of noble metal powder materials. According to the preparation method disclosed by the invention, a shower type feeder is utilized, no dispersing agent is required to be added, alkali liquor is synchronously added in the stirring reduction process of a disc type impeller consisting of radial inclined sheets, and the primary soft agglomerated silver powder is dispersed in the reaction process; adding alkali liquor into the obtained silver paste liquid, dissociating the soft agglomerated silver powder until the solution is orange, sucking supernatant after the slurry is clarified, adding deionized water into a reaction kettle, washing and filtering until the conductivity of filtrate is less than or equal to 10 mu s cm, transferring the wet silver powder into the reaction kettle, adding a certain amount of deionized water and a coating agent into the reaction kettle, dehydrating the silver powder after coating at a fixed time and a fixed speed, and drying and crushing to obtain the self-dispersing nano-scale silver powder; the nano silver powder prepared by the invention has excellent dispersibility, wide market application prospect, simple preparation method, low production cost and easy batch production.

title_en: Carbon nano tube/cobalt/zinc cobaltate composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electromagnetic wave absorbing materials, and particularly relates to a carbon nano tube/cobalt/zinc cobaltate composite material, and a preparation method and application thereof. The method comprises the following steps: s1, dissolving soluble cobalt salt and soluble zinc salt in water to obtain a solution A, dissolving dimethylimidazole in water to obtain a solution B, and mixing the solution A and the solution B for reaction to obtain a CoZn-MOF precursor; s2, dispersing the CoZn-MOF precursor obtained in the S1 and melamine in a mixed solvent, and reacting to obtain CoZn-MOF@melamine; s3, pyrolyzing the CoZn-MOF@melamine obtained in the S2 to obtain the carbon nano tube/cobalt/zinc cobaltate composite material. According to the invention, through constructing a Co-Zn bimetallic MOFs precursor, carrying out melamine coating modification and pyrolysis, an in-situ grown carbon nano tube/cobalt/zinc cobaltate nanocomposite is obtained, and electromagnetic microwave absorption with excellent low-frequency C wave band is realized.

title_en: High-kappa layered bismuth oxyselenate dielectric material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-kappa layered Bi  2  SeO  5  A dielectric material and a method for preparing the same. The layered Bi  2  SeO  5  The preparation method of the dielectric material comprises the following steps: with Bi  2  O  3  Powder and SeO  2  Taking the powder as a raw material, carrying out high-temperature solid-phase reaction in a vacuumized quartz tube, and obtaining the layered Bi after the reaction is finished  2  SeO  5  High-purity powder. Bi obtained by the reaction  2  SeO  5  Taking out the powder, grinding, sealing in a quartz tube for the second time for chemical vapor transport, and obtaining the layered Bi after the reaction is finished  2  SeO  5  A single crystal bulk. The method is simple and easy to operate, and the obtained Bi  2  SeO  5  The dielectric material single crystal block is large in size and easy to cleave into large-area nanosheets, and has wide application prospects.

title_en: Preparation method of manganous-manganic oxide and nitrogen-doped honeycomb carbon composite negative electrode material
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of lithium ion batteries, and provides a preparation method of a manganous-manganic oxide and nitrogen-doped honeycomb carbon composite negative electrode material, which comprises the steps of dissolving polyacrylamide, urea and sodium chloride in deionized water, adding manganese acetate tetrahydrate under the stirring condition, and stirring in a water bath until the volume of a solution is 30mL; cooling the obtained solution by a refrigerator, freeze-drying, and calcining the dried precursor in an argon atmosphere; washing and filtering the obtained product with deionized water, and drying the washed sample in an oven to obtain the trimanganese tetroxide and nitrogen-doped honeycomb carbon composite negative electrode material. The manganous-manganic oxide and nitrogen-doped honeycomb carbon composite material prepared by the preparation method provided by the invention is used as a lithium ion battery cathode material, has excellent cycle stability and rate capability, is simple and controllable in synthesis method and low in cost, and is expected to become a conversion type cathode material for large-scale use.

title_en: Catalyst for activating dissolved oxygen and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a catalyst for activating dissolved oxygen and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of water treatment, wherein the catalyst is molybdenum-doped tin disulfide quantum dots, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: sequentially adding thioacetamide solution and alcoholic solution of mercaptosilane coupling agent into mixed aqueous solution of sodium citrate, sodium molybdate and stannic chloride, fully stirring and mixing, and then carrying out hydrothermal reaction to prepare molybdenum-doped stannic disulfide quantum dots; the catalyst has good effect of removing organic pollutants in water without additional input of energy or addition of an oxidant, and greatly saves the water treatment cost.

title_en: Nano silver-tin alloy, preparation method and preparation device thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nano silver-tin alloy which is prepared from the following raw materials in mass concentration, 50-500 g/L of silver-tin ion blending liquid, 200-2000 g/L of reducing agent, 10-100 g/L of protective agent and the balance of solvent; wherein the mass ratio of the silver ions to the tin ions in the silver-tin ion blending liquid is (1-9): 1; the reducing agent is one or more of sodium borohydride, citric acid, hydrazine hydrate, ferrous nitrate, ferrous chloride, ascorbic acid and soluble ferrous salt; the protective agent is one or more of sodium citrate, PVP, PVA and PEG. The nano silver-tin alloy particles prepared by the method have the advantages that the particle size is concentrated near 20nm, the discreteness is small, the particle size is uniform, the connection can be completed at the temperature of less than 200 ℃, the reliable work can be realized at the high temperature (300 ℃) environment, and the nano silver-tin alloy particles can be used for third-generation wide-bandgap semiconductor components.

title_en: Flocculation polymer based on magnetic nano particles, preparation method and application thereof, and method for treating oily sewage
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of flocculating agents, and discloses a flocculating polymer based on magnetic nano particles, a preparation method and application thereof, and a method for treating oily sewage. The flocculation polymer provided by the invention has the characteristics of strong adsorptivity, capability of efficiently removing oily substances and suspended matters in sewage, and the like. In addition, the flocculation polymer can achieve better flocculation oil removal effect by using a small amount of the flocculation polymer, and can be recycled by combining a magnetic separator. The method is applied to the treatment of oily sewage such as crude oil sewage and the like, and can realize efficient, low-cost and sustainable sewage treatment.

title_en: Colorimetric fluorescent double-signal nano-microsphere and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: Disclosure of the inventionA colorimetric fluorescent double-signal nano-microsphere, a preparation method and application thereof are provided. The colorimetric fluorescent double-signal nano-microsphere comprises an inner core, and a first positive electricity interlayer, a first shell layer, a second positive electricity interlayer and a second shell layer which are sequentially wrapped outside the inner core from inside to outside; the inner core is SiO  2  A nanoparticle; the first shell layer is a composite layer of gold nanoparticles and carboxylated quantum dots; the second shell layer is a carboxylated quantum dot layer. The colorimetric fluorescent double-signal nano-microsphere has the advantages of good dispersibility, adjustable particle size, strong colorimetric and fluorescent properties, easiness in batch preparation and the like, and the carboxyl sites on the surface of the quantum dot shell are easy for antibody modification, so that the colorimetric fluorescent double-signal nano-microsphere can be used for qualitative and high-sensitivity on-site rapid detection of novel coronavirus.

title_en: Preparation method and application of complex-phase ZnO/ZnS nano array film
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a complex phase ZnO/ZnS nano array film, and relates to the technical field of semiconductors. The specific process of the invention is as follows: the method comprises the steps of growing a ZnO seed crystal layer on the surface of an interdigital electrode by a simple vapor phase evaporation method of crystallized zinc acetate, growing a ZnO nano array film on the ZnO seed crystal by a liquid phase method by taking the crystallized zinc acetate, 1,2-dimethylimidazole, ethanol and water as reaction raw materials, wherein the film is uniform and compact, the ZnO nano array film is vertically grown on an interdigital electrode substrate, the thickness of the ZnO nano array film is 50-100nm and is firmly combined with the substrate material, and the interdigital electrode is subjected to in-situ vulcanization treatment by adopting a sodium sulfide solution to prepare the ZnO/ZnS nano array film.

title_en: Static calibration device of micro-nano film thermal sensor and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of sensor calibration, and relates to a static calibration device of a micro-nano film thermal sensor and a use method thereof, wherein the static calibration device comprises a fixed pipe sleeve, a rotary positioning chuck and a sensor test pipe for placing the sensor; the rotary positioning chuck is provided with an opening penetrating through the rotary positioning chuck, and the sensor testing tube is arranged in the opening and extends into the fixed sleeve after penetrating through the opening; and a handle is arranged on the outer positioning scale plate and used for rotating and adjusting the position of the sensor testing tube. The micro-nano film thermal sensor static calibration device is not only suitable for static calibration of non-standard and standard temperature sensors, but also can be used as a clamp for testing and calibrating a dry type calibration furnace, can obtain the axial and radial temperature uniformity in an effective temperature field of the dry type furnace or a constant temperature bath, is favorable for evaluating the temperature field stability of the dry type furnace or the constant temperature bath, and improves the precision of the constant temperature equipment in testing and calibrating the sensor and the convenience of the test.

title_en: Preparation method of tin quantum dot embedded nitrogen-doped carbon nanofiber negative electrode material
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of negative electrode materials of sodium ion batteries, in particular to a preparation method of a tin quantum dot embedded nitrogen-doped carbon nanofiber negative electrode material, which comprises the following steps: (1) Mixing polyacrylonitrile and polyvinylpyrrolidone, and adding an organic solvent to prepare a carbon source precursor solution; (2) Adding a tin source solution into the carbon source precursor solution, heating and stirring uniformly to form an electrostatic spinning solution, and carrying out electrostatic spinning to obtain an organic fiber felt precursor; (3) And drying and pre-oxidizing the organic fiber felt precursor, and carbonizing in a tubular furnace to obtain the tin quantum dot embedded nitrogen-doped carbon nanofiber negative electrode material. The diameter of tin nanoparticles embedded in the nitrogen-doped carbon nanofiber is 1.0-2.0 nm, the diameter of the carbon nanofiber is 50-100nm, and the tin quantum dot-embedded nitrogen-doped carbon nanofiber serving as a sodium battery negative electrode material has good cycling stability and rate capability.

title_en: Method for preparing manganese phosphate from divalent manganese
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for preparing manganese phosphate by using bivalent manganese, which comprises the steps of reacting pyrophosphoric acid, an oxidant and an oxide containing bivalent manganese to obtain a manganese pyrophosphate complex solution, and then decomplexing to obtain manganese phosphate precipitate, wherein the oxide containing bivalent manganese is selected from manganous oxide MnO and manganous manganic oxide Mn  3  O  4  . Further, the invention discloses a carbon-coated lithium iron manganese phosphate material prepared from the manganese phosphate obtained by the method, and the material is used as a lithium battery material.

title_en: Spinnable alumina-silica composite sol and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a spinnable alumina-silica composite sol and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the field of inorganic ceramic materials; the method comprises the following steps: mixing an aluminum source and a silicon source to obtain a mixed solution; reacting the mixed solution to perform polycondensation on an aluminum source and a silicon source to obtain an aluminum oxide-silicon oxide composite sol; concentrating and aging the alumina-silica composite sol to obtain spinnable alumina-silica composite sol; wherein the aluminum source is capable of hydrolyzing to produce aluminum hydroxyl groups; the silicon source can be hydrolyzed to generate silicon hydroxyl; an aluminum source and a silicon source are introduced at the initial stage of the reaction, the aluminum source is hydrolyzed to generate aluminum hydroxyl (Al-OH), the silicon source is hydrolyzed to generate silicon hydroxyl (Si-OH), and the aluminum source and the silicon source are subjected to polycondensation reaction, so that the prepared composite sol has uniform chemical components, the molecular level uniform mixing is achieved, and the problems that the alumina-silica composite sol is difficult to uniformly mix and is easy to layer and precipitate are solved.

title_en: Light emitting component
abstract_en: Light emitting components having superior performance and stability are described. The light emitting component comprises a first element 1 comprising first luminescent crystals 11 of perovskite crystal type embedded in a first polymer P1 and a second element 2 comprising a second solid polymer composition optionally comprising second luminescent crystals 12 embedded in a second polymer P2. The polymers P1 and P2 are different and are further specified in the claims. Methods of making such components and devices incorporating such components are also described.

title_en: System and method for quantum cache
abstract_en: An entangled quantum cache includes a quantum storage library receiving a plurality of quantum states and configured to store and order the plurality of quantum states and provide selected ones of the stored and ordered plurality of quantum states to a quantum data output at a first desired time. A fidelity system is configured to determine a fidelity of at least some of the plurality of quantum states. The classical store is coupled to the fidelity system and configured to store classical data that includes the determined fidelity information and an index that associates particular ones of the classical data with particular ones of the plurality of quantum states, and to supply at least some of the classical data to the classical data output at a second desired time. The processor is connected to the classic store and determines a first time based on the index.

title_en: Preparation method and application of bromelain-gold platinum nanocluster
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of gold-platinum nanocluster synthesis, in particular to a preparation method and application of bromelain-gold-platinum nanoclusters, which comprises the following specific steps: bromelain is taken as a template, and bromelain-gold platinum nanocluster stock solution is prepared under a specific pH condition. Under the excitation wavelength of 380nm, the gold platinum nanocluster presents red fluorescence, and has maximum emission peaks at 480nm and 650 nm; the gold platinum nanocluster serving as an effective environment-friendly fluorescent probe can be used for detecting tea polyphenol in a solution. The fluorescent gold platinum nanocluster prepared by the invention has stable optical properties, simple preparation and good biocompatibility, and the method for detecting tea polyphenol is simple, convenient and fast, has high detection sensitivity and small influence by the environment, and is an ideal fluorescent nano material applied to the fields of biology and medicine.

title_en: Preparation method and application of bromelain-gold platinum nanocluster
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of gold-platinum nanocluster synthesis, in particular to a preparation method and application of bromelain-gold-platinum nanocluster, which specifically comprises the following steps: and (3) preparing bromelain-gold platinum nanocluster stock solution under a specific pH condition by taking bromelain as a template. Under the excitation wavelength of 380nm, the gold-platinum nanoclusters show red fluorescence, and have maximum emission peaks at 480nm and 650 nm; the gold-platinum nanocluster can be used as an effective environment-friendly fluorescent probe for detecting tea polyphenol in a solution. The fluorescent gold platinum nanocluster prepared by the method has stable optical property, simple preparation, good biocompatibility, simple and convenient method for detecting tea polyphenol, high detection sensitivity and small influence from environment, and is an ideal fluorescent nanomaterial applied to the fields of biology and medicine.

title_en: Shigella rapid detection method based on up-conversion-gold nano fluorescence resonance energy transfer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for rapidly detecting shigella in food, and belongs to the field of rapid detection of microorganisms. The detection method comprises the following steps: amino modification and carboxyl of oil-soluble up-conversion fluorescent materialModifying, namely respectively modifying the shigella aptamer and the complementary strand on the surfaces of the gold nanoparticles and the upconversion fluorescent material, and constructing an upconversion-gold nanoparticle fluorescent detection system by utilizing the base complementary pairing effect between the aptamer and the complementary strand; the relation between the concentration of the shigella bacterial liquid and the fluorescence signal intensity is explored by utilizing the fluorescence resonance energy transfer effect between the up-conversion material and the gold nanoparticles. The detection system established by the invention has a wider detection range and a lower detection limit, wherein the linear detection range is 1.2 multiplied by 10  2  CFU/mL‑1.2×10  8  CFU/mL, the detection limit is 30CFU/mL, the sensitivity is higher, and shigella in food can be specifically detected.

title_en: Lithium ion battery negative electrode material, preparation method thereof and lithium ion battery
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of lithium ion batteries, and particularly relates to a lithium ion battery cathode material, a preparation method thereof and a lithium ion battery. According to the lithium ion battery cathode material, the Graphene Oxide (GO) and the cross-linking agent are reacted and reduced on the surface of the Si/C active material to obtain the self-adaptive layered material, so that the self-adaptive elastic buffer space is formed, and compared with the Si/C electrode material obtained by coating the traditional binder sodium carboxymethyl cellulose (CMC) on the copper foil, the Si/C electrode material can better relieve the capacity reduction caused by volume expansion of the Si/C electrode, so that the Si/C electrode material has a higher specific ratioThe lithium ion battery anode material of the preferred embodiment of the invention has the advantages of capacity and excellent cycle stability, and is applied at 0.5A g  ‑1  Circulating for 200 circles under the current density, and still maintaining 550mAh g  ‑1  The specific capacity of the material enables the material to have important application value in high-capacity energy storage devices.

title_en: Method for preparing metallic titanium and nano carbon material by molten salt electrolysis
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for preparing a metal titanium and nano carbon material by molten salt electrolysis, which comprises the steps of mixing a titanium-based raw material, a sulfur-based raw material and a carbon-based raw material, sequentially performing ball milling, briquetting and sintering to obtain Ti  2  SC powder, sequentially performing briquetting and sintering on the Ti  2  SC powder to obtain a block Ti  2  SC, and performing electrolytic reaction on the block Ti  2  SC serving as an anode in molten salt to obtain a preliminary metal titanium and a preliminary nano carbon material.

title_en: Electric connector, photovoltaic assembly and preparation method of photovoltaic assembly
abstract_en: The application provides an electric connector, a photovoltaic module and a preparation method of the photovoltaic module, wherein the electric connector comprises a substrate, at least two solder strips which are connected to one side surface of the substrate and are parallel to each other, and one ends of the solder strips extend out of the surface of the substrate to form free ends or are connected to the other substrate; and a nano silver wire film is also arranged on one side of the substrate facing the solder strip. The photovoltaic module comprises a battery string, wherein the battery string comprises a plurality of heterojunction batteries which are sequentially connected in series along a first direction and an electric connecting piece connected to the surfaces of the heterojunction batteries. According to the electric connector for the electric connection of the heterojunction battery, after the nano silver wire film is contacted with the surface of the heterojunction battery, the current collection and transmission performance of the surface of the battery can be improved, the silver paste consumption and the material cost are reduced, and the shading loss of a metal electrode is reduced; the substrate of the electrical connector also reduces the risk of abnormal damage to the heterojunction cell during assembly processes.

title_en: Perovskite quantum dot composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a perovskite quantum dot composite material and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the perovskite quantum dot composite particles comprise a coating material and perovskite quantum dot particles; the coating material coats the perovskite quantum dot composite particles; the coating material comprises a polymer with high water oxygen barrier rate; the perovskite quantum dot composite particles comprise perovskite quantum dots. According to the invention, the perovskite quantum dots are coated in situ by a spray drying method, so that the damage to the quantum dot material in the traditional liquid phase coating method is avoided, and the application range of the perovskite quantum dot composite material is widened; the preparation process is simple, the equipment cost is low, the repeatability is high, and the method is suitable for industrial large-scale production and popularization.

title_en: Preparation method of chondroitin sulfate/diglyceride nanoemulsion for promoting cartilage to efficiently secrete mucopolysaccharide
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of chondroitin sulfate/diglyceride nanoemulsion for promoting cartilage to efficiently secrete mucopolysaccharide. The nano emulsion of the chondroitin sulfate and the diglyceride is prepared, and can stimulate the chondrocyte to efficiently secrete mucopolysaccharide. The nanometer emulsion is obtained by mixing chondroitin sulfate serving as a raw material with diglyceride for modification, and the cartilage is obviously promoted to secrete mucopolysaccharide so as to solve the problems that the traditional cartilage repair material is poor in toughness and supporting performance, cannot effectively exert bearing/buffering in time after implantation and the like, and provides an experimental basis for application of the nanometer emulsion in cartilage tissue engineering.

title_en: Nano material for ultraviolet light catalytic degradation and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a nano material for ultraviolet light catalytic degradation and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of photocatalytic degradation. The preparation method comprises the following steps: s1, mixing absolute ethyl alcohol and tetrabutyl titanate to obtain a solution A; s2, mixing a precipitator and water to obtain a solution B, adding the solution A into the solution B, and adding an organic acid and an inhibitor to form a colloidal solution; s3, adding a zirconium source into the colloidal solution, then carrying out hydrothermal reaction, and cooling after the reaction is finished to obtain a mixed solution; and S4, adding a Tris solution of dopamine hydrochloride into the mixed solution, uniformly mixing, filtering, collecting a filter cake, washing with water, and drying to obtain the nano material for ultraviolet light catalytic degradation. The nanometer material for ultraviolet light catalytic degradation has high ammonia degradation rate and high ammonia degradation speed; the light capture efficiency of visible light is widened, and the utilization rate of a light source is improved.

title_en: Preparation method of magnetic carbon nano composite material
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of carbon materials, and particularly relates to a preparation method of a magnetic carbon nano composite material. The invention provides a gas phase synthesis method taking carbon-coated ferroferric oxide nano particles as main components, which can solve the problems of waste gas and water, complex process and the like generated in the production process of the current magnetic carbon material. The method mainly takes ferrocene as a raw material, and utilizes steam generated by volatilization of tellurium powder at high temperature to catalyze and promote the decomposition of gas-phase ferrocene molecules. The quality improvement and the efficiency enhancement of the magnetic nano carbon material based on the ferrocene raw material can be realized by simply regulating and controlling a temperature rise mechanism in an inert atmosphere. The method has the advantages of simple process route, low equipment requirement, no waste water and gas emission, and easy large-scale preparation and production.

title_en: Preparation method of large-size ultrathin kaolin nanosheets
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a large-size ultrathin kaolin nanosheet, which comprises the following steps: removing impurities from kaolin; interlayer intercalation pretreatment is carried out on the kaolin through an intercalating agent and deionized water, and the kaolin is stirred for a certain time at a certain temperature to obtain kaolin intercalation compound slurry; adding medium balls, dispersing agents and the like to carry out low-speed grinding, peeling and pre-dissociation on the slurry to obtain a kaolin intercalation compound; and (3) carrying out kaolin lamellar stripping through the dispersion action of a high shear flow field, and finally carrying out thermodynamic stability treatment on the powder through sedimentation and classification, centrifugation, washing and freeze drying treatment to obtain the large-size ultrathin kaolin nano lamellar crystal. The invention finally obtains the kaolin ultrathin nano-sheet with good universality, high diameter-thickness ratio (80-140), thin sheet thickness (6-12 nm), large sheet size and high specific surface area.

title_en: GPS deviation rectifying method and device based on aviation data standard
abstract_en: The invention relates to a GPS deviation rectifying method and device based on aviation data standard, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining flight data to be rectified, wherein the flight data comprise GPS data on two sides of an airplane and are stored in a general aviation basic file HDF 5. And analyzing the general aviation basic file HDF5 and extracting GPS data points on two sides of the airplane to acquire GPS data. And carrying out weighted average processing on the GPS data to realize a GPS data offset point detection algorithm, and filtering abnormal points according to the result of the GPS data offset point detection algorithm. And converting the filtered GPS data into a programming language by converting a geographic coordinate system through a pseudo code, and rectifying the GPS data to obtain rectified GPS data. According to the method, abnormal points are filtered through a targeted weighted average and offset point detection method, so that the correction efficiency and accuracy are improved, the conversion of a geographic coordinate system is realized through a pseudo code disclosure mode, a code-free irrelevant platform and language are avoided, and good universality is achieved.

title_en: Ordered integrated electrode with ultralow Pt loading and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integrated electrode with ultralow Pt loading capacity and a preparation method thereof, which are based on a composite nanowire ordered array and realize the functions of ordering the structure and simultaneously coupling electrons and protons; on the basis of the ordered composite carrier, binary or ternary active components of Pt and transition metal are prepared on the surface of the carrier by methods of adsorption reduction and underpotential deposition plus displacement reaction respectively to form an ordered integrated electrode with high catalytic activity; the electrode structure of the invention has improved degree of order, which is beneficial to realizing the high-efficiency transmission of electrode reaction substances; the proton and electron conduction functions are coupled at the same time, so that the electrode reaction efficiency can be effectively improved; active components such as noble metal Pt and the like can form an ultrathin film with the thickness of an atomic layer to be coated on the surface of the nanowire array, so that the using amount of the noble metal is obviously reduced, and the problem that the stability is influenced by agglomeration, dissolution and the like of the traditional nanoparticle catalyst in the using process is solved. The ordered integrated electrode has great application prospect in the aspects of fuel cells, water electrolysis and the like.

title_en: Micro-optical accelerometer with force balance feedback
abstract_en: The invention discloses a micro-optical accelerometer with force balance feedback, which consists of an MEMS sensitive unit, a grating unit, a detection unit and a plurality of ceramic substrates for encapsulation, wherein the MEMS sensitive unit consists of a plurality of groups of spring-mass block structures with reflectors and lower metal electrodes, the grating unit consists of a plurality of groups of triangular distribution gratings with metal electrodes, the detection unit consists of three groups of optical transceiver components distributed in a triangular manner, one group of optical transceiver components comprises a VCSEL laser and two PD detector chips, the ceramic substrates for encapsulation are used for assembling the units together according to required intervals, and metal pads are distributed on the ceramic substrates for realizing electrical connection with the outside. The micro-optical accelerometer integrates an electrostatic force feedback function and a plurality of groups of optical transceiver components, can work in a plurality of modes, effectively inhibits cross-axis crosstalk, and realizes ultra-high-precision acceleration measurement.

title_en: Application of biological nano zero-valent palladium material with high photo-thermal effect in preparation of heating product
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of a biological nanometer zero-valent palladium material with a high photo-thermal effect in preparing a heating product. The bacillus megaterium Y-4 is used for synthesizing biological nano palladium with high photo-thermal effect, and is used for heating or preparing heating products and the like. At power densities of 1.35, 2.56 and 3.14W/cm, respectively  2  Under the near infrared radiation, the final temperature of 20mg/L ultrasonic biological Pd-NPs reaches 55, 78 and 90 ℃ respectively, and the ultrasonic biological Pd-NPs has good heating performance.

title_en: Surface tension driven universal flexible electronic transfer printing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a general flexible electronic transfer printing method driven by surface tension, which utilizes a hollow tube/annular structure to generate surface active bubbles/films, and picks up and prints electronic devices to any complex curved surface receptor. The method can transfer thicker (submillimeter and micron-sized) rigid electronic devices and thinner (submillimeter and nanometer-sized) flexible electronic devices, and the surface active bubbles/films are easy to break, so that the transfer does not need an interface viscosity regulation strategy, and the method can print to an ultra-low interface viscosity matrix.
