The invention has the advantages of no need of introducing precompression and forming a tight contact surface, adaptability to three-dimensional, non-bearing electronic devices and sensitive and incompressible receptors, controllable volume and appearance of the surface active bubble/film, suitability for compact space small-size and large-breadth transfer printing and arbitrary curved surface transfer printing, transparency, clarity, easiness in transfer printing, accurate positioning, convenience in multilayer transfer printing and in-situ measurement effect formation, simple process, low requirements on electronic devices and receptor matrix materials and good universality.

title_en: Porous carbon loaded nano silicon material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of lithium ion battery materials, and particularly relates to a porous carbon-loaded nano silicon material and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method of the porous carbon-loaded nano silicon material comprises the following steps of (1) dispersing or dissolving a carbon source capable of forming a porous structure under a high-temperature roasting condition into a solvent; (2) Adding micron silica and alkali metal carbonate, mixing uniformly and drying to obtain a precursor; (3) Roasting the precursor at high temperature under the inert atmosphere or vacuum condition to obtain a composite of porous carbon loaded nano silicon and sodium silicate; (4) And cleaning the compound, removing sodium silicate, and then drying in vacuum to obtain the composite. The method has simple process, easy operation, no byproduct generation, no need of using dangerous reagents such as hydrofluoric acid and the like, and suitability for industrial popularization. The porous carbon loaded nano silicon material has good application prospect in lithium ion batteries.

title_en: Carbon-coated nickel nano carbon cage composite material and preparation method thereof, lithium sulfur battery positive electrode active material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of lithium sulfur battery positive electrode materials, and discloses a carbon-coated nickel nano carbon cage composite material and a preparation method thereof, a lithium sulfur battery positive electrode active material and a preparation method and application thereof. The composite material comprises carbon-coated nickel nano particles and a nano carbon cage, wherein the carbon-coated nickel nano particles comprise a metallic nickel core and a graphitized carbon layer shell coated on the surface of the metallic nickel core, the nano carbon cage comprises a nano carbon cage hollow core, and at least one mesoporous distribution peak exists in a pore size distribution curve of the composite material. The carbon-coated nickel nano carbon cage composite material has a rich mesoporous structure, is favorable for mass transfer and diffusion of reactants and products in a battery reaction, can anchor intermediate polysulfide through physical limiting function, can catalyze electrochemical conversion of sulfur-containing substances, provides active sites for electrochemical reaction, improves the utilization rate of active sulfur, and improves the charge-discharge specific capacity and the cycling stability of a lithium-sulfur battery.

title_en: Method for preparing solder in wafer-level vacuum packaging and wafer with solder
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of wafer-level vacuum packaging, and discloses a method for preparing solder in wafer-level vacuum packaging, which comprises the following steps: aligning the solder mask plate with the welding surface of the wafer to be bonded, and respectively aligning the through holes on the solder mask plate with the bonding metal areas on the welding surface; placing the prefabricated solder piece in the through hole to align the prefabricated solder piece with the bonding metal area; and welding the prefabricated solder sheet and the bonding metal area, and removing the solder mask to obtain the wafer with the solder. The prefabricated solder pieces are aligned with the bonding metal area of the wafer to be bonded through the solder mask, namely, the prefabricated solder pieces can be aligned through the solder mask at one time, the process difficulty is reduced, the manufacturing speed is increased, and the manufacturing cost is reduced. Moreover, the alignment of the prefabricated solder sheet single piece is not needed by optical alignment, the alignment precision is improved, the qualification rate of the wafer with the solder is improved, and the manufacturing cost can be reduced.

title_en: Method for preparing biological nano lead selenide quantum dots by using bacillus sp HZ3
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing biological nano lead selenide quantum dots by using bacillus sp HZ3, and particularly relates to the technical field of microorganism application. The bacillus sp HZ3 bred by the method can efficiently convert lead nitrate and sodium selenite to produce nano lead selenide PbSe. The preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) preparing a strain culture solution; (2) fermentation culture; (3) adding sodium selenite and lead nitrate; (4) adding an inducer; (5) inducing and synthesizing biological nano lead selenide; and (6) separating and extracting the lead selenide quantum dots. Has the advantages that: according to the characteristics of the bacillus sp.HZ3 for synthesizing the lead selenide, the inducer which is helpful for enhancing the synthesis effect of the nano lead selenide is added in the culture process, and the synthesis efficiency of the nano lead selenide is improved to the maximum extent by a method combining high-temperature culture, low-temperature induction culture and high-temperature culture.

title_en: Two-dimensional ultrathin amorphous PtTe2Nanosheets, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-dimensional ultrathin amorphous PtTe  2  nanometer sheet, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of preparing a bulk phase PtTe  2  crystal, slicing the bulk phase PtTe  2  crystal after slicing is adopted as a cathode, a platinum sheet electrode is adopted as an anode, and electrolytic stripping is carried out in a dimethyl sulfoxide solution of tetrabutylammonium tetrafluoroborate to obtain a two-dimensional ultrathin PtTe  2  nanometer sheet; and calcining the obtained two-dimensional ultrathin PtTe  2  nano sheet in air to obtain the two-dimensional ultrathin amorphous PtTe  2  nano sheet. According to the method, voltage is applied, and the bulk PtTe  2  crystals are sequentially intercalated, expanded and fallen in a solution to obtain a two-dimensional ultrathin crystalline PtTe  2  nano sheet, and the obtained two-dimensional ultrathin crystalline PtTe  2  nano sheet is subjected to calcination treatment in air to obtain the two-dimensional ultrathin amorphous PtTe  2  nano sheet.

title_en: Method for rapidly preparing silicon dioxide aerogel powder by mixed solvent system
abstract_en: A method for preparing silicon dioxide aerogel powder rapidly by a mixed solvent system relates to a preparation method of silicon dioxide aerogel powder, which comprises the steps of uniformly mixing a mixed solvent with water glass to obtain a mixed solution, adding an auxiliary silicon source and silicon dioxide nanowires, obtaining the mixed system by ultrasonic treatment, reacting for 1-3 days in an environment with a pH value of 8-14 and a reaction temperature of 30-80 ℃ to obtain silicon dioxide gel particle mixed solution, adding a silane surface modifier into the silicon dioxide gel particle mixed solution, uniformly stirring, regulating the pH value to 7-13 by a pH regulator, then reacting for 2-10 hours, and removing the solvent by normal pressure drying after the reaction is completed.

title_en: Lithium iron phosphate positive electrode material, preparation method and lithium ion battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lithium iron phosphate positive electrode material, a preparation method and a lithium ion battery, wherein the lithium iron phosphate positive electrode material is a carbon-coated lithium iron phosphate LiFePO  4 /C positive electrode material with a nano sheet structure, lithium iron phosphate in the carbon-coated lithium iron phosphate positive electrode material has a hollow sphere structure, and the preparation method comprises the following steps of preparing nano lithium phosphate and preparing the carbon-coated hollow lithium iron phosphate material. The carbon-coated hollow lithium iron phosphate material with the nano sheet structure is prepared by depositing ferrous ions on the surfaces of lithium phosphate particles and performing ion migration reaction at high temperature and high pressure, the hollow structure not only can accommodate more electrolyte to increase the electrochemical life of the material, but also can improve the tap density of the material, and in addition, the homogeneous carbon coating layer formed by directly coating the lithium iron phosphate particles by self-polymerization initiated by an organic monomer has good electronic conductivity and ionic conductivity.

title_en: Sodium ion battery and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sodium ion battery and a preparation method thereof, wherein the sodium ion battery comprises a positive electrode and a negative electrode, the positive electrode active substance is sodium vanadium phosphate, and the negative electrode active substance is an antimony sulfide-carbon nanohorn composite material; wherein the mass ratio of the antimony sulfide to the carbon nanohorns is (4-7) to 1; the conical carbon nanohorns in the antimony sulfide-carbon nanohorn composite material are aggregated flower-shaped spheres which mutually communicate antimony sulfide particles to form a conductive network structure; the invention uses the cathode material which effectively buffers the volume expansion generated in the sodium ion charging and discharging process, and meanwhile, the material has smaller particles, thereby effectively improving the cycle and rate performance of the sodium ion battery.

title_en: Preparation method of biomass carbon cloth and membrane electrode
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of biomass carbon cloth, which comprises the following steps of A) preprocessing biomass cotton cloth to obtain precursor biomass cotton cloth, B) soaking the precursor biomass cotton cloth in a transition metal salt solution, drying, C) carbonizing and annealing the biomass cotton cloth obtained in the step B), D) introducing carbon source gas into the biomass cotton cloth obtained in the step C) in an inert atmosphere, heating, and E) carrying out acid treatment on the carbon cloth obtained in the step D) to obtain the biomass carbon cloth. The biomass carbon cloth material provided by the invention can be used as a good fuel cell gas diffusion layer, has extremely high conductivity and porosity, is used as a fuel cell gas diffusion layer, has simple cost and preparation process, can reach the standard of commercial carbon cloth, can be used as a substitute of commercial carbon cloth aiming at the problem of high cost of the current fuel cell, and saves the cost of the battery.

title_en: Preparation method of platinum-cobalt-chromium alloy-loaded carbon catalyst for fuel cell
abstract_en: The preparation method of the platinum cobalt chromium alloy-loaded carbon catalyst for the fuel cell comprises the following steps: a first reduction step of adding an aqueous solution of chloroplatinic acid to a heated aqueous suspension of carbon powder containing L-ascorbic acid, and carrying platinum particles grown in a cluster form on the surface of the carbon powder to a nano-scale size, wherein ascorbic acid is used in a molar ratio of 2.33 to 3.17 times to the chloroplatinic acid used; and a second reduction step of adding L-ascorbic acid to the heated suspension after the first reduction step in an amount that allows all of the chloroplatinic acid remaining after the reduction step to be reduced, thereby reducing the chloroplatinic acid and causing platinum to precipitate on the surfaces of the platinum particles; platinum particles are deposited on the surface of the obtained carbon powder, and further a powder in which platinum particles having cobalt hydroxide and chromium hydroxide deposited on the platinum particles are carried in clusters is obtained, and the powder is subjected to heat treatment in an inert gas or nitrogen atmosphere.

title_en: Octahcalcium phosphate pentahydrate nanoflower and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a pentahydrate octacalcium phosphate nanoflower and a preparation method thereof, wherein dopamine and a divalent calcium salt solution are simultaneously added into a phosphoric acid buffer solution with the pH value of 7.5-7.8 to form a reaction solution, the reaction solution is uniformly mixed and then is subjected to standing reaction, dopamine polymerization and crystal growth are synchronized by controlling reaction conditions, and precipitates are separated after the reaction is finished to obtain the pentahydrate octacalcium phosphate nanoflower. The invention induces the crystal to continuously grow along the periphery of the crystal nucleus by controlling the synchronization of dopamine polymerization and crystal growth, thereby realizing the structure of the nanoflower. The invention has low cost, and the adopted raw materials only comprise phosphoric acid buffer solution, dopamine and divalent calcium salt solution, thereby having the advantage of higher raw material cost. The octahedral calcium phosphate pentahydrate nanoflower produced by the invention can be widely used as a human implant material, such as a filler for replacing bones or artificial implanted teeth. Has good reabsorbability and affinity, and contributes to human health.

title_en: Nano ZSM-5 molecular sieve and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of molecular sieve synthesis, and provides a nano ZSM-5 molecular sieve and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method of the nano ZSM-5 molecular sieve comprises the following steps: s1, mixing a template agent, an aluminum source, a silicon source, a dispersing agent, metal salt, alkali and water, and performing pre-crystallization to obtain a pre-crystallization liquid; s2, mixing an aluminum source, a silicon source, a guiding agent and water to obtain a homogeneous gel; s3, mixing the pre-crystallized liquid with the homogeneous gel, and crystallizing to obtain the nano ZSM-5 molecular sieve. The nanometer ZSM-5 molecular sieve is prepared by the method. By the technical scheme, the problems that the ZSM-5 molecular sieve in the prior art has low catalytic activity or weak shape selective cracking capability and can not improve the shape selective cracking and aromatization functions of the catalyst/auxiliary agent simultaneously are solved.

title_en: Preparation method of nano titanium oxide and nano titanium oxide prepared by same
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of nano titanium oxide and the prepared nano titanium oxide, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: dissolving a titanium-containing compound in water to prepare a solution with the concentration of 5-30%, adding a starch material in proportion, stirring uniformly, putting the mixture into a preparation device, heating to 80-120 ℃, keeping the temperature for 10-30 min to gelatinize starch molecules in the starch material to form a colloid of a reticular titanium-containing ion solution, and drying the obtained colloid at 60-80 ℃ to obtain a dry colloid; heating to 700-1200 ℃ at a speed of 1-10 ℃/min under the nitrogen atmosphere environment, and preserving the heat for 1-10 hours to obtain a carbon matrix containing titanium nitride; heating the carbon matrix containing titanium nitride to 550-900 ℃ in air atmosphere or oxygen atmosphere, preserving the heat for 1-12 hours to remove residual carbon in the carbon matrix containing titanium nitride, oxidizing the titanium nitride to form nano titanium oxide particles, and then washing, filtering and drying the sample to obtain the nano titanium oxide particles.

title_en: Differential calorimetric MEMS gas sensor and gas detection method
abstract_en: The application provides a differential calorimetric MEMS gas sensor and a gas detection method, wherein the sensor comprises a detection thermopile, a reference thermopile, an environmental resistor and a shielding ring, the detection thermopile and the reference thermopile comprise a monocrystalline silicon substrate, a heat insulation cavity, a plurality of monocrystalline silicon thermocouple pairs and a support film, the heat insulation cavity is positioned in the monocrystalline silicon substrate, the monocrystalline silicon thermocouple pairs are connected in series and supported by the support film to be suspended above the heat insulation cavity for realizing heat insulation, and the monocrystalline silicon thermocouple pairs comprise N-type monocrystalline silicon thermocouples and P-type monocrystalline silicon thermocouples which are connected in series, wherein the center of the detection thermopile is provided with a catalyst material. The sensor provided by the application is very sensitive to the catalytic absorption and release of trace gas, has high response and recovery speed and wide linear detection range of the concentration of the gas, and can be used for detecting the concentration of various gases based on the catalytic absorption and release of the heat. The detection method has good selectivity to the gas, and can realize the rapid and ultrasensitive detection of the target gas.

title_en: Preparation method and application of gold-silver alloy with hollow cubic structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a gold-silver alloy with a hollow cubic structure, relating to the technical field of nano gold-silver alloys, and the key points of the technical scheme are as follows: based on a one-pot method and a stepwise control method, silver chloride is used as a template, and sodium citrate with good biocompatibility and single reducing agent ascorbic acid are adopted to prepare the gold-silver alloy with the hollow cubic structure. The gold-silver alloy with the hollow cubic structure has excellent catalytic activity and can be applied to the field of catalysis. The preparation method is simple, the prepared hollow cubic gold-silver alloy structure has the characteristics of adjustable size and surface plasmon resonance peak position, and the gold-silver alloy with the hollow cubic structure has quite rapid catalytic reaction on a mode, thereby being beneficial to the application of the gold-silver alloy in a catalyst.

title_en: Method for preparing two-dimensional iron boride with antiferromagnetic and semiconductor characteristics
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of preparation of two-dimensional antiferromagnetic magnetic materials, and relates to a preparation method of a two-dimensional metal boride with antiferromagnetic and semiconductor characteristics, which comprises the following steps: step one, preparing a transition group metal boride block and preparing electrolyte; step two, electrochemical stripping of the transition metal boride; and step three, purifying and drying the two-dimensional metal boride. The invention discovers a preparation method of a two-dimensional metal boride with antiferromagnetic and semiconductor properties, a thin layer structure obtained by thinning a block has room temperature antiferromagnetic properties, the problem of metal to semiconductor conversion is solved, the formed two-dimensional metal boride has high phase-change temperature, and more varieties are provided for the development of the spintronics field in the future.

title_en: Cs0.32WO3/(m-t) -BiVO4 heterojunction and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The present invention provides a compound of Cs  0.32  WO  3  /(m‑t)‑BiVO  4  Heterojunction comprising a decahedral monoclinic m-BiVO with exposed (010) crystal planes, and method for its preparation and use  4  And a monoclinic phase m-BiVO in the shape of a decahedron  4  Tetragonal phase t-BiVO obtained by phase change of (110) crystal face  4  And loaded in tetragonal phase t-BiVO  4  Granular Cs of above  0.32  WO  3  Decahedral monoclinic phase m-BiVO  4  And tetragonal phase t-BiVO  4  Forming a Z-type heterojunction; tetragonal phase t-BiVO  4  With granular Cs  0.32  WO  3  Forming a Z-type heterojunction. Cs of the present invention  0.32  WO  3  /(m‑t)‑BiVO  4  The double Z-shaped heterojunction has enhanced oxidation-reduction capability under the full spectrum of ultraviolet-visible light-near infrared light, and the photo-thermal synergistic effect enhances the photocatalytic activity of the heterojunction.

title_en: Carbon nano-dot/perovskite composite material with four-mode emission and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of carbon nanomaterials, in particular to a carbon nanodot/perovskite composite material with four-modal emission and a preparation method and application thereof, the carbon nanodot/perovskite composite material with four emission modes is designed by a perovskite crystal closing strategy, the material has excellent FL emission capability in a solid state and UCPL (uniform photon emission) similar to solid FL emission, realizes high-efficiency PHOS emission, and radiates FL, UCPL, PHOS and CL simultaneously in different excitation modes; in addition, the neuromorphic device based on the programmable emission pattern of the material can be established to simulate the functions of biological neurons, realize molecular information processing and safety, develop a new information processing pattern by visualizing and digitizing various light-emitting patterns and utilizing the unique capability of the neuromorphic device in the aspects of information processing and logic calculation, and expand the application direction from multi-modal light emission to advanced molecular information processing and confidential communication.

title_en: Selenium disulfide nanosheets and application thereof in preparation of photothermal agents
abstract_en: The invention discloses a selenium sulfide nano-sheet and application thereof in preparation of a photo-thermal agent, wherein the nano-sheet is obtained by adopting an ultrasonic stripping method, and has a radial dimension of 50-400 nm and a thickness of 2-5 nm. The nano-sheet has good environmental stability and photo-thermal performance, and has the advantages of simple preparation method, mild reaction condition, controllable product size and good photo-thermal treatment application prospect.

title_en: Preparation method of strontium calcium zirconate titanate and nickel slurry for MLCC prepared by same
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of strontium calcium zirconate titanate and nickel slurry for MLCC prepared by the preparation method, belonging to the technical field of ceramic capacitor materials. The preparation method of the strontium calcium zirconate titanate comprises the following steps: adding a precipitant into an alcohol solution of titanate and zirconate to carry out complexation reaction, regulating the pH value of a reaction system to 2-4, then adding an aqueous solution of calcium salt and strontium salt to carry out reaction to obtain precipitate, and then carrying out ultrasonic treatment, drying and heat treatment to obtain the strontium calcium zirconate titanate. The preparation method of the strontium calcium zirconate titanate has the advantages of simple operation, short synthesis time, easy control of the synthesis process and good repeatability. The particle size range of the prepared strontium calcium zirconate titanate is 20-80 nm, and the strontium calcium zirconate titanate can be used as a co-material to be added into nickel slurry, so that good co-firing with a ceramic dielectric layer can be realized, internal stress generated by co-firing of the conventional high-frequency multilayer ceramic capacitor material is reduced, and the problems of cracking, layering and the like of an internal electrode and the dielectric layer are solved.

title_en: Six-branch dendritic Cu2Preparation method of O@Cu and application of O@Cu in formaldehyde sensing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of hexaplit dendritic Cu  2  O@Cu and application thereof in formaldehyde sensing, which comprises the following steps: firstly preparing six-branch dendritic Cu  2  O nanocrystalline by using a liquid phase method; dispersing the Cu  2  O nanocrystalline in a copper sulfate solution, and reducing the Cu  2  O nanocrystalline into elemental Cu by sodium borohydride to form six-branch dendritic Cu  2  O@Cu composite nanocrystalline; organic surfactant is not used in the whole synthesis process; correspondingly, the invention also discloses a formaldehyde solution concentration sensor prepared by modifying the working electrode by the hexadentate Cu  2  O@Cu rice particles, and the sensitivity of the prepared sensor is obviously better than that of a sensor formed by pure Cu  2  O because the conductivity of the hexadentate Cu  2  O is enhanced by the Cu nanocrystalline at the interface, and the enhancement coefficient can reach 1.38.

title_en: Mo-Si series metal silicide/ZrC nano composite powder and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses Mo-Si series metal silicide/ZrC nano composite powder and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of high-temperature and even ultra-high-temperature composite materials. The Mo-Si series metal silicide/ZrC nano composite powder has a multi-core-shell structure which takes ZrC as a core and takes Mo-Si series metal silicide as a shell which completely covers the core, and the molar ratio of Zr element in the core to Si element in the shell is 1:1. the Mo-Si series metal silicide/ZrC nano composite powder has a fully-coated multi-core-shell structure, can obviously improve the wettability and sintering property of zirconium carbide, improve the strength and toughness of a composite material, reduce the sintering densification temperature and improve the high-temperature oxidation resistance.

title_en: Non-combustible mixed refrigerant suitable for low-temperature system
abstract_en: The invention provides a nonflammable mixed refrigerant suitable for a low-temperature system, and belongs to the technical field of refrigerants. The composition comprises the following components: the first component comprises: difluoromethane, tetrafluoroethane; the second component: 2, 3-tetrafluoropropene; and a third component: n (N)  2  He; and a fourth component: 1,2, 3-heptafluoropropane 1,2,3, 4-nonafluorobutane 1,2, 3-pentafluoropropane; and a fifth component: monofluoroethane and dimethyl ether. The non-combustible mixed refrigerant composition suitable for the low-temperature system mainly adopts a non-combustible environment-friendly fluorine-containing compound component, has good heat transfer characteristic, low toxicity, safety, large evaporation latent heat, small density and good refrigeration effect, can effectively reduce cost through reasonable combination and proportion, is suitable for a low-temperature system of-50 to-130 ℃, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Chip sample preparation device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a chip sample preparation device and a method, wherein the method comprises the following steps: arranging a sample to be characterized on the imprinting film; aligning a sample to be characterized with an observation window on a characterization chip; moving the supporting structure to be close to the characterization chip until a sample to be characterized is pressed on the observation window; moving the support structure away from the characterization chip, and separating the sample to be characterized from the imprinted membrane to remain on the viewing window of the characterization chip. According to the invention, the sample to be characterized is transferred to the observation window of the characterization chip through the imprinting film, so that the suspension film and the observation window of the characterization chip can not be damaged, and the high-precision positioning of the sample on the observation window can be realized, so that the imprinting film is suitable for various characterization chips with complex thermal, force and electrical microstructures; meanwhile, the sample preparation equipment is portable, convenient to operate and low in cost, a solution is not needed in the sample preparation process, and a characterization chip is not polluted to influence characterization observation; in addition, one or more samples can be prepared one by one for a plurality of observation windows on the same characterization chip, so that the characterization cost is obviously reduced.

title_en: ZSM-5 molecular sieve and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ZSM-5 molecular sieve and a preparation method and application thereof. Wherein the ZSM-5 molecular sieve has a long plate shape, and the surface of the molecular sieve crystal is uniformly covered with a single-layer nano SiO  2  And (3) particles. The ZSM-5 molecular sieve is used in toluene methanol alkylation reaction, and has good activity and selectivity.

title_en: ZnO catalyst with self-assembled porous nano sheet structure and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ZnO catalyst with a self-assembled nano-sheet structure, and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the ZnO catalyst with the self-assembled nano sheet structure comprises the steps of fully dissolving zinc acetate in water to form zinc salt solution, dissolving a precipitator in the water to form alkali solution, dripping the alkali solution into the zinc salt solution, reacting for 14-16min at 70-75 ℃, standing for aging, and carrying out suction filtration, washing, drying and calcination after the aging is completed to obtain the ZnO catalyst with the self-assembled nano sheet structure. The ZnO catalyst with the nano-sheet structure is synthesized by a chemical precipitation method, has the advantages of simple preparation method, good repeatability and mass production, and in addition, the ZnO catalyst with the nano-sheet structure has good chemical stability and is easy to store.

title_en: Method for preparing boron nitride nanotube, nanomaterial, semiconductor device and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing boron nitride nanotubes, a nanomaterial, a semiconductor device and a device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the in-situ boron source implementation: forming an in-situ boron source on the surface of the metal substrate after cleaning and polishing, wherein the metal substrate is selected from the group consisting of a metal substrate with a melting point temperature higher than the growth temperature of the boron nitride nanotubes, and the in-situ boron source is obtained by adopting boronizing treatment; nanotube growth: preparing a catalyst solution, partially or fully coating the catalyst solution on a growth substrate to form a growth area, raising the temperature to 1200-1350 ℃ at a heating rate of 2-30 ℃/min in a protective gas atmosphere, introducing ammonia gas, preserving the temperature for 30-180 min, and cooling to room temperature along with a furnace. The invention has high preparation efficiency, good process condition and product controllability and good growth control.

title_en: Method and system for preparing white carbon black by using rice hulls
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for preparing white carbon black by utilizing rice hulls. Under the heating of a heat carrier, the rice hulls are subjected to pyrolysis reaction in a pyrolysis reactor to generate rice hull pyrolytic carbon; and (3) performing low-temperature combustion on the rice hull pyrolytic carbon in a low-temperature combustion reactor to obtain the rice hull white carbon black. The system comprises an airflow conveying pipe, a cyclone separator, a rice husk raw material bin, a pyrolysis reactor, a low-temperature combustion reactor, a carrier separator, a high-temperature blower, an oil-gas condensing unit, a gas induced draft fan, a circulating pump, a first heat exchanger, a cooling tower and a second heat exchanger. According to the invention, pyrolysis and combustion are carried out separately, so that the amorphous silicon dioxide form in the rice hull ash is maintained, the combustion temperature is precisely controlled, and the quality of white carbon black in the rice hull ash is ensured. By burning in the low-temperature burning reactor, the rice husk pyrolytic carbon is burnt in a dilute phase, so that high-temperature burning generated by the accumulation thickness of the rice husk pyrolytic carbon is avoided, and industrial continuous production is realized.

title_en: Lipid molecule and liposome for delivering mRNA, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lipid molecule and liposome for delivering mRNA, and a preparation method and application thereof. The structural formula of the lipid molecule is shown in a formula I, and the definition of each group in the formula I is shown in the specification. The ionizable lipid molecule provided by the invention can greatly regulate and control the protonation capability and the hydrophobicity by changing the types and the quantity of the cationic groups and the hydrophobic chain segments, and can fully meet the requirement of mRNA delivery. The invention enhances the electrostatic interaction with mRNA by protonating the ionizable lipid molecules under acidic conditions, thereby realizing efficient and stable entrapment of mRNA for delivery of mRNA for therapeutic purposes. In addition, the invention modifies one or more fatty chain on the skeleton of triethanolamine, and can modify the rest hydroxyl, and introduce one or two ionizable sites to realize the functions of RNA loading and delivery.

title_en: Preparation method of anti-human PDL1 nano antibody for blocking combination of PD1 and PDL1 and coding sequence thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-human PDL1 nanobody and a VHH chain thereof, which comprises a framework region FR and a complementarity determining region CDR region, wherein the framework region is selected from amino acid sequences of FR1-FR4, and the CDR region is selected from CDR1-CDR3 amino acid sequences. Also disclosed are gene sequences encoding the nanobodies and host cells expressing the nanobodies. The PDL1 nano antibody has small molecular weight and strong specificity. The nano antibody can be used for soluble expression of proteins in escherichia coli, and has the advantages of simple preparation method, low cost and good application prospect in the aspect of detection of human PDL1 and in anti-tumor drugs.

title_en: Metal doped carbon quantum dot, colorimetric sensing solution, colorimetric array sensor, preparation method of colorimetric array sensor and method for detecting biological mercaptan
abstract_en: The invention provides a metal doped carbon quantum dot, a colorimetric sensing solution, a colorimetric array sensor, a preparation method thereof and a method for detecting biological mercaptan; the preparation method of the metal doped carbon quantum dot comprises the following steps: taking a carbon source, a metal ion compound and a solvent as raw materials, and heating for reaction to obtain a reaction mixture; and purifying the reaction mixture to obtain the metal doped carbon quantum dots. The synthesized metal doped carbon quantum dot has higher peroxidase-like activity, the peroxidase-like activity is close to that of natural enzyme, and the metal doped carbon quantum dot has the advantages of good biocompatibility, simple and convenient synthesis method, low cost, stable property and the like, and is a suitable material for constructing a colorimetric array sensor for detecting biological mercaptan. The colorimetric sensing solution prepared by using the metal-doped carbon quantum dots can be used for effectively detecting and identifying biological mercaptan, has high detection sensitivity on the biological mercaptan, and is simple, convenient and quick in testing method.

title_en: In-situ interconnected sensing and storing integrated device and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an in-situ interconnected sensing and storing integrated device and a preparation method thereof. The in-situ interconnected sense and compute integrated device comprises: a substrate formed with first groove structures arranged at intervals; the nerve morphology device comprises a bottom electrode, a functional layer and a top electrode, wherein the bottom electrode, the functional layer and the top electrode are sequentially formed in a first groove structure, and a first isolation layer is formed on the top electrode of the nerve morphology device and is provided with a plurality of through holes which are distributed at intervals; a second isolation layer formed on the substrate surface between the first groove structures; a bottom electrode of the sensor device filling the through hole and covering a surface of the substrate between the first isolation layer and the second isolation layer; the second groove structures are arranged at intervals and are formed on the bottom electrode of the sensing device, and the positions of the second groove structures correspond to the positions of the through holes; the functional layer of the sensing device is formed at the bottom and the side wall of the second groove structure; and a top electrode of the photoelectric sensor, which is formed on the functional layer of the sensing device and fills the second groove structure.

title_en: Cr (chromium)5Si3Non-layered two-dimensional material, preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of preparation of non-lamellar two-dimensional materials, and particularly discloses a Cr  5 Si 3  non-lamellar two-dimensional material, and preparation and application thereof. The invention provides a brand new Cr  5 Si 3  non-lamellar two-dimensional material and a CVD preparation method, wherein the material has excellent air resistance, and in addition, has good magnetism and topological Hall effect.

title_en: Submicron alpha-Al with uniform nucleation 2 O 3 Preparation method of powder
abstract_en: The application provides a submicron alpha-Al with uniform nucleation  2  O  3  The preparation method of the powder comprises the steps of firstly, uniformly nucleating on the basis of a liquid phase precipitation method, and uniformly precipitating Al in supersaturated solution of aluminum salt by utilizing the slow release characteristic of urea  2  O  3  Precursor crystal nucleus, which can be performed under the auxiliary condition of microwave heating to quickly nucleate; and then, a large amount of sediment is quickly generated in the system by adding an alkaline pH regulator, so that the crystal nucleus is prevented from growing continuously due to overlong reaction time. Al prepared by the two-step nucleation mode  2  O  3  The precursor is calcined at a lower temperature (950-1150 ℃) and then converted into crystal grainsFine, uniformly dispersed alpha-Al  2  O  3  The alpha phase purity of the superfine powder is higher than 95 percent, and the grain diameter is between 100 and 300 nm. The method has the advantages of low production cost, environmental friendliness, high production efficiency, suitability for large-scale production and the like.

title_en: Nanometer long afterglow luminescent material for photodynamic therapy and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nano long afterglow luminescent material prepared by a mesoporous template method and capable of being used for photodynamic therapy, and a preparation method and application thereof. The nano long afterglow material has uniform particle size and good monodispersity, can continuously emit green afterglow after being excited by an ultraviolet lamp, and emits green light after being excited by X rays. Meanwhile, the invention enhances the rest brightness and the luminous brightness under the excitation of X rays by means of co-doping ions. The novel long afterglow nano-particles constructed by the method have the advantages of good chemical stability, good monodispersity, uniform size and mesoporous sphere morphology, can be loaded with drug molecules, and particularly can continuously generate singlet oxygen with cytotoxicity after being excited by ultraviolet light, so that the potential of the photodynamic therapeutic drug for tumors is provided.

title_en: Ratio type fluorescent intelligent tag for visually detecting freshness of meat and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ratio type fluorescent intelligent tag for visually detecting meat freshness and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the intelligent tag preparation method specifically comprises the following steps: firstly, preparing a ratio type fluorescent indicator of gold-copper bimetallic nanoclusters (indicators) with red fluorescence and double ligand gold nanoclusters (internal standards) with green fluorescence; adding a ratio type fluorescent indicator into a polyvinyl alcohol/polyethylene glycol solution by a solution doping method to prepare a ratio type fluorescent intelligent label; finally, a fluorescence color chart is manufactured based on the ratio type fluorescence intelligent tag, and the intelligent tag is combined with a smart phone to be applied to meat freshness grade and total volatile basic nitrogen content prediction. Compared with a colorimetric sensing indication film, the ratio type fluorescent intelligent label prepared by the invention has the characteristics of higher accuracy and sensitivity; the intelligent label is safe, good in biocompatibility, biodegradable, strong in mechanical property and capable of monitoring freshness of fresh meat and aquatic products in real time.

title_en: Preparation method and application of high-purity powder material and alloy strip
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a high-purity powder material. Firstly, preparing an alloy strip with a solidification structure composed of a matrix phase and a dispersion particle phase through melt solidification. During solidification of the alloy strip, the impurity elements are enriched into the matrix phase, thereby purifying the dispersed particulate phase. And removing the matrix phase in the alloy strip to obtain the high-purity target powder material consisting of the dispersed particle phase. The preparation method has the characteristics of simple process, easy operation and low cost, can prepare high-purity powder materials including nano-scale, submicron-scale, micron-scale and millimeter-scale, and has good application prospects in the fields of catalytic materials, powder metallurgy, composite materials, wave-absorbing materials, sterilization materials, magnetic materials, metal injection molding, 3D printing, coating and the like.

title_en: Antenna structure, light emitting device and method of designing antenna structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of antennas, and one example of the invention relates to an antenna structure (10) for guiding light-directed radiation. The antenna structure (10) comprises a reflector (12) having a reflecting surface (12 a), an annular dielectric grating (14) arranged on the reflecting surface (12 a) and extending concentrically along a central axis (100) perpendicular to the reflecting surface, and an omnidirectional reflector formed by a low refractive index central region (18) surrounded by the annular dielectric grating (14). The antenna structure (10) may be such that the projection efficiency η of light exiting the low refractive index central region (18) along the central axis (100) onto the dielectric grating (14) with respect to a gaussian beam reaches at least 65%. Other examples of the invention also relate to a light emitting device (22) and a method of designing an antenna structure (10).

title_en: Bismuth-based nano material, preparation method thereof and application thereof in preparation of photo-thermal transduction agent
abstract_en: The invention provides a bismuth-based nanomaterial, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in preparation of a photo-thermal transduction agent, and belongs to the field of photo-thermal treatment. The bismuth-based nano material provided by the invention is 1W/cm  2  Under the irradiation of 1064 and nm laser, the temperature can be raised to 92.6 ℃ in 5min, and the light-heat conversion efficiency is up to 83.125%. The bismuth-based nanomaterial is in NIR-II regionThe response can be quickly raised, the photo-thermal conversion efficiency is high, the photo-thermal stability is good, the bioavailability is high, the biological safety is good, and the preparation method has great clinical application potential in preparing the photo-thermal transduction agent for near infrared two-region window photo-thermal treatment.

title_en: Two-dimensional material transfer device and two-dimensional material transfer method
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of two-dimensional material processing and preparation, and particularly relates to a two-dimensional material transfer device and a two-dimensional material transfer method. The two-dimensional material transfer device comprises a two-dimensional material laminating module, wherein the two-dimensional material laminating module comprises a first positioning unit for placing a growth substrate and a second positioning unit for fixing a target substrate, the two-dimensional material transfer module is arranged adjacent to the two-dimensional material laminating module, the two-dimensional material transfer module is provided with a solution tank for storing a dissolving solution, the second positioning unit can move to a first station to enable the growth substrate to be laminated with the target substrate, and the second positioning unit can also move to a second station to immerse the growth substrate in the solution tank. The device can realize the combination of the growth substrate and the target substrate and the removal of the growth substrate on the same device, can automatically complete a plurality of steps of two-dimensional material transfer, and greatly improves the transfer efficiency. Meanwhile, large-area transfer of the two-dimensional material can be realized.

title_en: TiO (titanium dioxide)2Preparation method of CuO composite electrode material
abstract_en: A preparation method of a TiO  2 /CuO composite electrode material relates to a preparation method of an electrode material. The invention aims to solve the problems that the existing TiO  2  electrode material has low specific capacity and the cycling stability of the TiO  2 /CuO composite material is poor due to the volume expansion effect after the composite CuO material is compounded. The method comprises the steps of firstly, preprocessing, secondly, micro-arc oxidation, thirdly, preparing a TiO  2 /Cu precursor composite material, fourthly, placing the TiO  2 /Cu precursor composite material in an alkaline solution, and then performing a hydrothermal reaction to obtain the TiO  2 /CuO composite electrode material. The method can grow the CuO nano-sheet array on the surface of the TiO  2  in situ, can effectively improve the specific capacity of the TiO  2  material, and the pores among the nano-sheets in the CuO nano-sheet array can effectively reduce the volume expansion effect of the CuO material and improve the cycle stability of the TiO  2 /CuO composite material.

title_en: Deacidification method for gas-phase white carbon black
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gas phase white carbon black deacidification method. The method is used for removing hydrogen chloride and free chlorine on the surface of the gas-phase white carbon black, the pH index range of the gas-phase white carbon black is controlled to be 4.0-4.5, the moisture is less than or equal to 1.0%, the free chlorine is less than or equal to 200mg/kg, the deacidification effect can be obviously improved, and the product quality is improved. The invention improves stability in the deacidification process, can make gas-solid phases better contact, and the inner wall of the inner cylinder of the deacidification furnace is provided with the shoveling plate, so that the fluidity of the gas-phase white carbon black in rotation is enhanced. The fumed silica is fully mixed with the mixed gas, the deacidification time is quick, no additional water is needed, other impurities are not introduced, the resistance is not increased sharply compared with the existing deacidification furnace, the operation is safe and efficient, the free chlorine removal effect is good, the horizontal deacidification furnace is adopted, and the gas-solid two-phase contact in the deacidification furnace is sufficient.

title_en: Luminescent nanoparticle, method for detecting cell using same, method for treating animal, medical device, method for visualizing cell, and method for reducing cell damage
abstract_en: The present invention provides a luminescent nanoparticle. The luminescent nano particles have the advantages of luminescence stability, light resistance and low biotoxicity. The luminescent nanoparticle comprises a matrix material and a luminescent substance contained in the matrix material, wherein the matrix material contains at least one cationic element selected from the group consisting of Ti, si, ca, al and Zr, and at least one anionic element selected from the group consisting of O and P, and the concentration of the luminescent substance in the matrix material is such that the average distance between the luminescent substances is 1.2nm or more.

title_en: Preparation method and device of wafer-level alkali metal gas chamber
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method and a preparation device of a wafer-level alkali metal gas chamber. Preparing a pre-air chamber wafer unit, depositing alkali metal in a positive corresponding air chamber hole groove, and cooling the pre-air chamber wafer unit to normal temperature after depositing required alkali metal in the air chamber hole groove; providing an air chamber packaging wafer, and performing low-temperature pre-bonding on the air chamber packaging wafer and the pre-air chamber wafer unit cooled to normal temperature, so that after the low-temperature pre-bonding, an air chamber hole groove in the pre-air chamber wafer unit is sealed by the air chamber packaging wafer; and performing high-temperature anodic bonding on the low-temperature and bonded air chamber packaging wafer and the pre-air chamber wafer unit, wherein bonding air pressure is in a molecular pump background vacuum state during high-temperature anodic bonding. The invention can effectively realize the preparation of the alkali metal air chamber, avoid the escape of alkali metal caused by high temperature, ensure the bonding strength and improve the reliability of the prepared alkali metal air chamber.

title_en: Flexible electret sensor and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electret sensors, and discloses a flexible electret sensor, a preparation method and application thereof. The flexible electret sensor comprises a surface electrode, a flexible sensing layer, a bottom electrode and a wire; the flexible sensing layer is arranged between the surface electrode and the bottom electrode; the flexible sensing layer consists of a plurality of unit arrays of hemispherical microstructures and an electret material layer; the surface of the hemispherical microstructure layer of the flexible sensing layer is filled with bipolar charges with opposite electric potentials and equal electric charge amounts; and leads are led out from the surface electrode and the bottom electrode. The microstructure of the flexible electret sensor can store more charges and has better stability, the storage space of the microstructure can be regulated and controlled by regulating the size of the microstructure, and the charge storage capacity is regulated, the larger the charge density is, the higher the sensitivity is; the piezoelectric coefficient of the flexible electret sensor is tens times that of a commercial PVDF film.

title_en: Double-layer multi-drug infinite coordination polymer anti-tumor composite nano-particle and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a double-layer multi-drug infinite coordination polymer anti-tumor composite nanoparticle and a preparation method thereof, wherein a plurality of tumor therapeutic drug molecules are taken as ligands, transition metal ions are taken as coordination center atoms, metal ions and 2 ligands are respectively coordinated to prepare 2 different infinite coordination polymer nanoparticles, and then the 2 different infinite coordination polymer nanoparticles are assembled into the anti-tumor composite nanoparticle with a double-layer structure through electrostatic adsorption.

title_en: Antimony telluride-tungsten disulfide vertical heterojunction nano material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an antimony telluride-tungsten disulfide vertical heterojunction nano material and a preparation method thereof, wherein a chemical vapor deposition method is adopted to grow a single-layer WS on the surface of a substrate  2  Layer is then grown with WS  2  The layered substrate was again placed downstream of the tube furnace and Sb was added  2  Te  3  Placing the powder into a quartz boat, placing in a central temperature zone of a tube furnace, and performing secondary chemical vapor deposition to obtain Sb  2  Te  3  ‑WS  2  Vertical heterogeneous nanomaterial. The Sb is as follows  2  Te  3  ‑WS  2  The vertical heterogeneous nano material is verticalA vertical stacked layer structure, wherein the bottom layer is WS  2  Layer, bottom layer is stacked with Sb  2  Te  3  A layer; sb (Sb)  2  Te  3  Lower growth temperatures do not destroy species such as WS  2  The prepared heterojunction has extremely high quality and has important significance for researching nanoscale light-emitting devices and optoelectronic devices.

title_en: Inverse opal copper wool fine liquid suction core structure and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an inverse opal copper capillary liquid suction core structure and a manufacturing method, wherein the manufacturing method comprises the following steps that a plurality of microspheres are uniformly distributed on a copper substrate, sintering necks are formed among the microspheres through a sintering process, nano-scale copper particles are arranged in gaps of the microspheres, the nano-scale copper particles form a stable copper structure, the microspheres and the sintering necks on the copper substrate are removed, a plurality of spherical cavities and sintering neck cavities are formed in the copper structure, the spherical cavities and the sintering neck cavities are respectively matched with the microspheres and the sintering necks, and the spherical cavities are communicated through the sintering neck cavities. Firstly, uniformly and densely distributing a plurality of microspheres on a copper substrate, arranging nanoscale copper particles in gaps of the microspheres, enabling the nanoscale copper particles to form a stable copper structure, and forming a plurality of spherical cavities and sintering neck cavities in the copper structure after the microspheres and the sintering necks are removed. Under the synergistic effect of permeability and capillary force, the capillarity of the inverse opal copper capillary wick structure is further optimized.

title_en: Gold nano-particle array with strong stability and reusability and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a gold nanoparticle array preparation method with strong stability and reusability, which comprises the steps of firstly preparing gold nanoparticles with stable homocysteine, changing the interval between the gold nanoparticles by utilizing coulomb repulsion between the gold nanoparticles, then dripping gold nanoparticle solution onto the glass surface modified by gamma-glycidol ether oxypropyl trimethoxy silane for reaction to form stable covalent bonds, and obtaining the gold nanoparticle array with uniform distribution on the glass surface after the reaction. The preparation method does not need high temperature, is simple and convenient in experimental operation, can obtain gold nanoparticles which are orderly and tightly arranged, has higher detection sensitivity, has strong ultraviolet absorption capacity, good stability, reproducibility, reusability and salt tolerance, and low background interference, and can be reused. The method can be used for detecting and analyzing the sample with high salt content in the surface-assisted laser desorption ionization mass spectrum and rapidly analyzing the small molecular compound in the positive and negative ion double mode.

title_en: Flower-shaped molybdenum disulfide/carbon hollow microsphere lithium ion battery negative electrode composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flower-shaped molybdenum disulfide/carbon hollow microsphere lithium ion battery negative electrode composite material and a preparation method thereof. The electrode material has the advantages of simple preparation process, unique morphology and the like, and the prepared molybdenum disulfide/carbon hollow microsphere is of a micron order and has good cycle performance and rate capability. The hollow microsphere with micron order can solve the problems of easy particle aggregation, volume expansion and the like of the nano structure in the charge and discharge process, is beneficial to batch industrial application of sulfides and promotes the development of next-generation high-energy-density lithium ion batteries.

title_en: High-performance heat-cycle-resistant composite nano air electrode and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-performance heat-cycle-resistant composite nano air electrode and a preparation method thereof, wherein the composition of the composite nano air electrode is one or more of La  1‑   x Sr x CoO 3‑δ  and Co  3 O 4 、SrCO 3 、SrCoO 2.5 、LaSrCoO 4 . The preparation process includes the steps of (1) regulating pH value by ammonia water, dissolving La(NO 3 ) 3 ·6H 2 O、Sr(NO 3 ) 2 、Co(NO 3 ) 3 ·6H 2 O、 citric acid and ethylenediamine tetraacetic acid in deionized water, heating and stirring until gel is obtained, and drying and calcining the gel to obtain the composite nanometer air electrode powder. (2) Mixing the powder with binder to prepare electrode slurry, then printing on the electrolyte surface of the battery, and drying to obtain the composite nano air electrode with high performance and stable high thermal cycle. The invention can prepare the nanometer-sized composite air electrode with low cost, and has outstanding electrochemical performance and thermal cycling stability.

title_en: Flexible thermoelectric material for semiconductor device and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flexible thermoelectric material for a semiconductor device and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of thermoelectric materials, wherein the flexible thermoelectric material comprises silver-sulfur-based nano particles and poly-3, 4-ethylenedioxythiophene coated around the silver-sulfur-based nano particles, and the chemical formula of the silver-sulfur-based nano particles is Ag  x  TeS, wherein x=3.9-4.1; the poly-3, 4-ethylenedioxythiophene has delocalized large pi bond, so the poly-3, 4-ethylenedioxythiophene has certain conductive capability and can be used as an organic polymer semiconductor; the prepared silver-sulfur-based nano particles have better thermoelectric performance, so that the electric conductivity and the thermal conductivity achieve synergistic effect, and the effect of improving the thermoelectric conversion efficiency is realized; silver-sulfur-based nano particles are added into an organic framework of the poly 3, 4-ethylenedioxythiophene, so that the structure is compact, and the electron mobility is improved; the flexible thermoelectric material has high conductivity and Seebeck coefficient, thereby improving the materialThe power factor of the material.

title_en: Preparation method of trimer nano-particles based on lattice mismatch principle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of trimer nano particles based on a lattice mismatch principle. According to the method, fe  3 O 4  nanospheres are used as seeds, and sodium citrate is used for reducing chloroauric acid to prepare Au-Fe  3 O 4  dimer nano particles with one-to-one morphology. And then coating a layer of metal with low lattice matching degree with Au, such as Pt, pd, rh, ir, on the surface of the gold ball part of the dimer particle to construct a lattice mismatched surface, so that the interface energy is increased, the occurrence of an island growth mode is facilitated, and the region selective growth of the secondary metal is realized. Then carrying out secondary growth by taking AuM  1 -Fe 3 O 4  dimer nano-particles (M  1  =pt, pd, rh, ir) as seeds and using Au and Ag as subsequent metals, thus obtaining M  2 -AuM 1 -Fe 3 O 4  trimer nano-particles (M  1 ＝Pt,Pd,Rh,Ir;M 2  =ag, au). The method can further change the final structure of the nano particles by adjusting the addition amount of the lattice mismatched metal.

title_en: Two-dimensional iodoalkene nano material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a two-dimensional iodoalkene nanomaterial and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the two-dimensional iodoalkene nano material comprises the following steps: grinding the iodine simple substance crystal into powder in a mortar and preparing into water dispersion; then, carrying out ultrasonic crushing on the aqueous dispersion liquid of the iodine simple substance, and obtaining the two-dimensional iodine alkene nano material through mechanical stripping.

title_en: Preparation method of sorbic acid carbon quantum dots
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of carbon nano materials, in particular to a preparation method of sorbic acid carbon quantum dots, which comprises three processes of pretreatment, synthesis reaction and post-treatment: after the sorbic acid precursor is pretreated, the sorbic acid precursor is not matched with other compounds, and the carbon quantum dots with higher yield can be independently prepared. The synthetic reaction method is simpler, energy-saving and efficient. The post-treatment steps are simplified, so that the carbon sorbate quantum dots have higher purity and better physicochemical characteristics, and the performances of the carbon sorbate quantum dots are better than those of commercial titanium dioxide in the photocatalytic dynamics test. The novel carbon quantum dot prepared by the invention can be used for photocatalysis reaction, can efficiently degrade water pollutants, and has good application prospect in the photocatalysis field.

title_en: Preparation method of narrow-band green fluorescent powder of cesium lead bromine perovskite quantum dot embedded metal organic framework material ZIF-8
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of narrow-band green light fluorescent powder of a cesium lead bromine perovskite quantum dot embedded metal organic framework material ZIF-8. The preparation method of the fluorescent powder comprises the following steps: dissolving zinc source and dimethyl imidazole in N-N dimethylformamide, performing solvothermal reaction, centrifuging, washing and drying to obtain ZIF-8; fully dispersing ZIF-8 and cesium bromide in methanol, stirring at high temperature, washing, and drying to obtain CsBr@ZIF-8; and (3) fully dispersing CsBr@ZIF-8 in an N-N dimethylformamide solution of lead bromide, heating, evaporating, washing and drying to obtain the lead bromide. The preparation method is simple, high in efficiency, low in implementation difficulty, low in cost, safe and environment-friendly, and easy to realize large-scale development; in the obtained fluorescent powder, cesium lead bromine perovskite quantum dots are well dispersed in ZIF-8, and the fluorescent powder has the advantages of high fluorescence intensity, narrow half-peak width, high color purity, high stability, wide excitation range and the like.

title_en: Silver-graphene composite coating and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: A silver-graphene composite coating and a preparation method and application thereof belong to the technical field of electrical materials and overcome the defects of high contact resistance, corrosion resistance, heat dissipation and poor wear resistance in the prior art. The silver-graphene composite coating comprises a first nano silver layer, a silver-graphene layer and a second nano silver layer which are sequentially arranged on a substrate. The thermal conductivity coefficient of the silver-graphene composite coating provided by the invention is more than or equal to 330W/m.K, the hardness is more than or equal to 80HV, the surface contact resistance is less than 20 mu omega, the dynamic friction coefficient of the coating is less than or equal to 0.25, and the environmental corrosion resistance of the coating can be satisfied that the coating does not change color within 5h of a sulfur resistance test in a 1% Na  2  S solution and does not change color within 1h of a sulfur resistance test in a 5% Na  2  S solution.

title_en: Phosphorus-sulfur co-doped antimony-based carbon nanomaterial and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of nano materials, and particularly relates to a phosphorus-sulfur co-doped antimony-based carbon nano material, and a preparation method and application thereof. Adding antimony sulfide and sulfur powder into a triethylamine solution for hydrothermal reaction; drying to obtain a precursor; and placing the precursor in a porcelain boat, placing sodium dihydrogen hypophosphite in another porcelain boat, coating the two porcelain boats together, calcining, and cooling after the end. According to the invention, the antimony metal nano particles are loaded on the phosphorus-sulfur co-doped carbon nano material, so that the cost is low, and theoretical support and technical support are provided for the industrialized application of the porous carbon material in the electrochemical energy fields of energy storage materials and the like.

title_en: Perovskite quantum dot SiO 2 Preparation method of composite material
abstract_en: The invention provides perovskite quantum dot SiO  2  A method of preparing a composite material, the method comprising: (1) Mixing a lead source, a cesium source, a ligand and Lewis acid/Lewis base oxy silane with a solvent, and performing first heating and vacuumizing to obtain a first reaction system; (2) Replacing the first reaction system in the step (1) with a nitrogen environment, and performing second heating to obtain a second reaction system; (3) Injecting halogen acid solution into the second reaction system in the step (2) for reaction, cooling and separating after the reaction is finished to obtain perovskite quantum dot SiO  2  A composite material. Compared with the traditional quantum dot preparation method, the preparation method does not need an extra precursor preparation step, the halogen source is halogen acid aqueous solution which is not processed after purchase, and the synthesis method is efficient and simple, and can greatly improve the water-oxygen resistance of the quantum dot.

title_en: Nanometer material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a nano material and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps of S1, connecting a graphite molded body and a conductive object which are respectively connected with a positive electrode and a negative electrode of a direct current power supply, placing the graphite molded body and the conductive object in electrolyte containing organic alkali, electrolyzing for 1-10 days under the voltage of 25-50V to obtain a first mixture containing carbon points and the organic alkali, S2, mixing a silicon source and an active center source, carrying out hydrothermal reaction on the obtained mixture and the first mixture to obtain a second mixture, S3, cooling the obtained reaction product, carrying out solid-liquid separation to obtain a solid-phase product and a liquid-phase product, roasting the solid-phase product to obtain the nano material, and S4, enabling the liquid-phase product to be in contact with a porous material, wherein the pore size of the porous material is larger than that of the nano material. The nano material prepared by the method not only has better catalytic reaction activity, but also can directly discharge the wastewater generated in the preparation process.

title_en: Nano selenium with antioxidation effect and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses nano selenium with an antioxidant effect, and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the nano-selenium comprises the following steps: s1, adding a selenium dioxide solution into a solvent, uniformly mixing, then adding a glutathione solution, and stirring on a magnetic stirrer for reaction; s2, after the color of the solution is stable, adding the solution into an equal volume of sodium hyaluronate solution, and uniformly mixing by ultrasonic. The nano selenium prepared by the method has the size of about 100nm and is in a regular sphere shape. And on the level of zebra fish, the prepared nano selenium can remove free radicals induced by Lipoprotein (LPS), plays an antioxidant role, and has potential application prospects in preparing cosmetics with antioxidant effects.

title_en: Sodium-based heat-sensitive optical super-surface and heat-sensitive structural device with optical super-surface
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sodium-based heat-sensitive optical super-surface and an optical super-surface heat-sensitive structural device, and belongs to the technical field of metal surface plasmon materials. Heating solid metal sodium to 100-140 ℃ in an inert gas atmosphere to obtain liquid sodium; and placing the transparent medium substrate with the micro-nano structure on a spin coater with a sucker made of metal, and spin-coating liquid sodium on the transparent medium substrate after the liquid sodium stays in the air for 2-3 s to obtain the sodium-based thermosensitive photosensitive super surface. And covering one surface of the super surface which is not contacted with the transparent medium substrate by using a metal substrate preheated to 100-120 ℃, and sealing the periphery of the edge of the super surface contacted with the transparent medium substrate and the metal substrate to obtain the optical super surface heat-sensitive structure device. And as the liquid sodium is not fully infiltrated with the transparent medium substrate with the micro-nano structure in the cooling and solidification process, namely the micro-pore structure on the transparent medium substrate is not fully filled, the thermal melting dynamic response can be generated subsequently, and the plasmon resonance tuning of the sodium super surface is realized.

title_en: Manufacturing method of micro-nano structure on surface of optical element
abstract_en: The invention relates to a micro-nano structure manufacturing method, which is characterized in that a nano ball array with a periodic structure is firstly prepared on the surface of an element by utilizing a colloid ball self-assembly technology through improvement of a traditional reactive ion beam etching technology, colloid balls are etched by utilizing a wide beam ion source, and the process conditions such as working gas pressure, temperature, time, etching power and the like are controlled to adjust the duty ratio among the colloid balls. Then a film mask is plated between gaps of the colloid balls by using a low-temperature deposition method of the film, and then the colloid balls are removed by using a proportioning solution. And finally, etching the element by using a wide beam ion source, and transferring the pattern of the film mask to the element to finally obtain the micro-nano structural element. The invention can provide samples for experimental study or industrial production of a high-power laser window.

title_en: Semiconductor structure
abstract_en: A semiconductor structure includes a substrate, a seed layer, an epitaxially grown layer, and a superlattice structure. The seed layer is disposed on the substrate, the epitaxial growth layer is disposed over the seed layer, and the superlattice structure is disposed between the seed layer and the epitaxial growth layer. The superlattice structure comprises a plurality of superlattice units stacked in a staggered manner, and two adjacent superlattice units comprise a first superlattice unit and a second superlattice unit, wherein the first superlattice unit comprises a first superlattice layer and a second superlattice layer stacked on the first superlattice unit, the second superlattice unit comprises a third superlattice layer and a fourth superlattice layer stacked on the third superlattice layer, the first superlattice layer comprises a (1-1) th sublayer and a (1-2) th sublayer in a plurality of pairs, and the second superlattice layer comprises a (2-1) th sublayer and a (2-2) th sublayer in a plurality of pairs.

title_en: Ultraviolet-absorbing indoor coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an indoor coating capable of absorbing ultraviolet rays and a preparation method thereof, comprising the following steps: water, cellulose, bentonite, a dispersing agent, a wetting agent, a preservative, an antifreezing agent, a film forming auxiliary agent, a defoaming agent, heavy calcium carbonate, titanium pigment and graphite alkyne powder. The method also comprises the following steps: 1) Sequentially adding bentonite, cellulose, a dispersing agent, a wetting agent, a preservative, an antifreezing agent, a film forming auxiliary agent and a defoaming agent into water to obtain a mixed solution; 2) Mixing heavy calcium carbonate, nano titanium dioxide and graphite alkyne powder with the mixed solution to obtain a feed liquid; 3) Mixing water-based resin with the feed liquid to obtain a paint paddle; 4) And mixing a thickener with the paint to obtain the ultraviolet-absorbing indoor paint. The indoor coating capable of absorbing ultraviolet has excellent ultraviolet non-linear characteristic, can ensure that a proper amount of ultraviolet rays promote calcium absorption, and can prevent harm to human bodies caused by excessive ultraviolet rays.

title_en: Preparation method and application of vulcanized nano zero-valent iron doped biochar
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of aromatic hydrocarbon organic matter degradation in a saline-alkali environment, and relates to a preparation method and application of vulcanized nano zero-valent iron doped biochar. Comprises the steps of selecting a carbon-based material modifier, preparing a carbon-based material with a chemically modified surface and degrading target pollutants. The preparation method of the modified carbon-based material comprises the steps of (1) preparing biochar by carbonizing lotus leaf stalks and facility agriculture crop stalks at high temperature, (2) preparing vulcanized nano zero-valent iron particles by a modified borohydride reduction method under the condition of inert atmosphere, and (3) preparing vulcanized nano zero-valent iron doped biochar particles. The vulcanized nano zero-valent iron doped biochar particles are subjected to solid-liquid separation, vacuum drying and high-temperature calcination in a reducing atmosphere to obtain metal modified biochar nano particles. The material is used for activating persulfate to degrade aromatic hydrocarbon organic matters, and degrading target PAHs to generate non-condensed ring organic micromolecular compounds, and has the advantages of simple operation, obvious strengthening effect, obvious degradation effect and salt and alkali resistance.

title_en: Sandstone uranium ore strong oxidation leaching method adopting micro-nano bubbles
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of in-situ leaching uranium mining, in particular to a strong oxidation leaching method for sandstone uranium ores by adopting micro-nano bubbles. The method comprises the following steps: liquid CO  2  Liquid O  2  After vaporization and measurement of mass, gas dispersion is carried out to obtain gaseous dispersed CO  2  O and O  2  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the Gaseous dispersion of CO  2  O and O  2  Mixing with leaching solution; CO  2  The gas is mostly dissolved in the leaching solution, O  2  Less part is dissolved and most is O  2  In the form of bubbles, formed to contain millimeter-sized O  2  Weak acid leaching solutions of bubbles; said composition contains a large amount of millimeter-sized O  2  Micro-nano bubble treatment is carried out on weak acid leaching solution of bubbles, so that millimeter-level O in the weak acid leaching solution  2  The bubbles form micro-nano bubbles to obtain CO containing dissolved state  2  And O  2  A leaching agent of micro-nano bubbles; the CO containing dissolved state  2  And O  2  And the leaching agent of the micro-nano bubbles is injected into the ore layer to realize the leaching of uranium ores. The invention improves the utilization efficiency of oxygen and the oxidation effect of uranium deposit, and saves the cost.

title_en: Method and device for manufacturing amorphous/nanocrystalline material
