abstract_en: The invention discloses a manufacturing method and a manufacturing device of an amorphous/nanocrystalline material, and relates to the technical field of additive manufacturing. The method comprises the following steps of S1, transferring raw materials through a feeding mechanism, S2, enabling the raw materials to generate metal molten drops under the action of electric sparks or short electric arcs by a pulse power supply, S3, transferring the metal molten drops to the lower portion of a fly plate under the action of a transmission medium, S4, enabling an electromagnetic pulse coil on the fly plate to generate magnetic field force to drive the fly plate to impact the metal molten drops to the surface of a substrate to form compact amorphous/nanocrystalline materials, and S5, repeating S1-S4. The invention uses pulse power to make raw material generate metal molten drop under the action of electric spark or short electric arc, and moves under the fly plate under the action of transmission medium, electromagnetic pulse coil on the fly plate generates magnetic field force to drive the fly plate to impact the metal molten drop onto the surface of the substrate at high speed to form compact amorphous/nanocrystalline material.

title_en: Method for preparing two-dimensional graphite diyne by ball milling assisted reduction and elimination
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for preparing two-dimensional graphite diyne by ball milling assisted reduction and elimination, which comprises the following steps: step 1: ball milling process to prepare intermediate slurry of graphite alkyne; step 2: and (3) drying and calcining the intermediate slurry obtained in the step (1) to remove impurities, and performing ultrasonic assistance and strong acid washing reduction to remove the impurities to obtain the graphite diyne. The invention adopts tribromobenzene and hexabromobenzene as phenyl raw materials respectively to obtain corresponding structures, thereby widening the selection range of synthetic raw materials; the intermediate is reduced and eliminated by adopting ultrasonic assistance and strong acid washing to generate graphite diyne with a hierarchical nano-sheet structure, and the graphite diyne has larger specific surface area and excellent physical properties. The preparation process is simple, the cost is low, the efficiency is high, and a reliable research foundation is provided for the industrial production of graphite diyne. Meanwhile, the prepared sample has potential and important application prospect in the fields of energy, catalysis and photoelectricity.

title_en: Glucose-zinc gluconate carbonized polymer dot and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a glucose-zinc gluconate carbonized polymer dot and a preparation method and application thereof. The glucose-zinc gluconate carbonized polymer dot obtained by the invention has the advantages of oxidation resistance, fluorescent effect and excellent water solubility. The glucose-zinc gluconate carbonized polymer point obtained by the invention has excellent superoxide dismutase activity and can thoroughly remove superoxide anions. The glucose-zinc gluconate carbonized polymer is hopeful to become a novel antioxidant, and the preparation method is simple and convenient, the process is rapid, and the preparation method is easy to realize.

title_en: Silicon-carbon composite anode material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a preparation method of a silicon-carbon composite anode material, which comprises the following steps of carrying out nanocrystallization on a silicon material in a protective environment to obtain nano silicon, carrying out self-assembly on the nano silicon, a first carbon source and a high polymer, then adding a second carbon source to carry out self-assembly to obtain layered nano silicon, granulating the layered nano silicon to obtain a precursor, and sintering the precursor at a sintering temperature of 800-1200 ℃ to obtain the silicon-carbon composite anode material. The application also provides a silicon-carbon composite anode material and a battery comprising the same. The preparation method provided by the application has the advantages that the process is simple, the flow is easy to control, the method is suitable for industrial production, and the prepared silicon-carbon composite anode material can inhibit expansion and has improved conductivity and capacitance.

title_en: Positive electrode active material, preparation method thereof, positive electrode plate, secondary battery and power utilization device
abstract_en: The application provides an anode active material and a preparation method thereof, an anode plate, a secondary battery and an electric device. The positive electrode active material includes a material of the general formula Li  z  Fe  x  Mn  (1‑x‑y)  M  y  PO  4  At least one of the compounds shown in @ C, wherein z is more than or equal to 1 and less than or equal to 1.1,0.5, x is more than or equal to 1, and y is more than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 0.1; m is at least one of Ti, V and Mg; at least a part of the positive electrode active material comprises primary particles, and the particle size distribution of the primary particles with the primary particle size of more than 80nm and less than 180nm in the positive electrode active material is less than or equal to 10%; primary particles having a primary particle diameter of 1500nm or more are present in a cross section (250.+ -.5) μm cut after the positive electrode active material is prepared into a pole piece  2  The number of particles in the region is not more than 15. The primary particle size distribution concentration of the positive electrode active material is obviously improved, and the cycle performance of the battery is improved.

title_en: Green fluorescent infrared up-conversion mesoporous nanomaterial and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a green fluorescence infrared up-conversion mesoporous nano material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the material can maintain up-conversion characteristics while forming a mesoporous structure, and can excite green fluorescence emission under 980nm infrared light. The method adopts chemical solvothermal reaction, successfully synthesizes the up-conversion mesoporous material at 200 ℃, and the particles are 30nm. The mesoporous up-conversion particles synthesized by the simple chemical solvothermal reaction have the advantages of uniform morphology, monodispersity, uniform size distribution, good dispersibility, large mesoporous quantity, higher luminous efficiency, simple experimental operation, high yield and low cost investment.

title_en: VS (virtual switch)2Layered silicate nano composite catalyst and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a VS  2 /layered silicate nano composite catalyst, and preparation and application thereof. The VS  2 /layered silicate nano composite catalyst composition comprises a VS  2  two-dimensional nano sheet and a single layered silicate disc, wherein the layered silicate disc is in island composite distribution on a VS  2  nano sheet in structure, and the distance between the farthest side of the VS  2  nano sheet is far greater than the diameter of the silicate disc. The VS  2 /layered silicate nano composite catalyst obtained by the invention can be used for the reaction of preparing cyclohexene by partial hydrogenation of benzene. The invention solves the problems of low hydrophilicity and activity of the benzene water phase partial hydrogenation catalyst, realizes high hydrophilicity and high activity exposure of the catalyst in the reaction, and finally obtains high cyclohexene yield.

title_en: Nanocrystalline hafnium, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nanocrystalline hafnium, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the electron emission density of the nanocrystalline hafnium at 1000-1100 ℃ is 0.00134A/m  2  ‑0.01827A/m  2  . The nanocrystalline hafnium has excellent thermionic emission performance, thereby being airThe cathode material for the water vapor plasma torch and the control rod for the nuclear fission reactor provide a strong guarantee.

title_en: Method for preparing high-quality polyethylene terephthalate as nitrogen-doped carbon nano tube material and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing a nitrogen-doped carbon nano tube material from high-quality polyethylene terephthalate and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of sodium ion battery materials. The method for preparing the high-quality polyethylene terephthalate as the nitrogen-doped carbon nano tube material comprises the following steps of: mixing a nickel-containing compound and polyethylene terephthalate, and melting to obtain a mixed precursor; cracking the mixed precursor in a protective atmosphere to obtain an intermediate; mixing the intermediate with a nitric acid solution, and performing hydrothermal treatment to realize nitrogen doping to obtain a prefabricated nitrogen doped nanotube; calcining the prefabricated nano tube under a protective atmosphere to obtain the nitrogen-doped carbon nano tube. The preparation method provided by the invention is simple and efficient, clean and environment-friendly, low in cost, and extremely high in application value, and is suitable for further popularization.

title_en: Porous silicon material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a porous silicon material, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) Melt mixing a silicon source and a lithium source to obtain a melt mixture; (2) Carrying out lithium removal on the molten mixture to obtain a lithium removal product; (3) And carrying out heat treatment on the lithium removal product to obtain the porous silicon material. The invention provides a preparation method with low cost, simple process and low energy consumption, and the formed silicon nano-sheets can be radially arranged in honeycomb shape in all directions of particles through lithium attachment and lithium removal to form a controllable isotropic channelized porous silicon structure. The porous silicon material prepared based on the method not only can adapt to the volume change of silicon, but also can obviously promote the rapid transmission of lithium ions, so that the material utilization and capacity exertion are not limited by particle orientation, and the porous silicon material has high surface capacity, high rate performance and excellent cycling stability, has good industrial application prospect, and can realize large-scale production.

title_en: Polymer solid electrolyte additive, preparation and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to a polymer solid electrolyte additive, preparation and application, and relates to the technical field of lithium ion batteries. The lithiated copper phthalocyanine in the invention has a structure shown in a formula 1, and the preparation method comprises the steps of mixing a compound shown in a formula 2 with sulfuric acid solution, carrying out microwave reaction, and then adding LiOH solution to obtain the metal organic frame shown in the formula 1. The invention also includes the application of the lithiated copper phthalocyanine in solid electrolyte additives and in preparing solid lithium secondary batteries. The solid electrolyte added with the lithiated copper phthalocyanine additive has excellent conductivity and lithium ion migration number, high tensile strength, flame retardance, stability to lithium metal and excellent full cell performance.

title_en: Iron phthalocyanine nanotube material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of composite materials, and particularly relates to an iron phthalocyanine nanotube material, and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the material comprises the steps of putting terephthalonitrile, ferric acetate tetrahydrate and ammonium molybdate tetrahydrate into glycol solution, stirring, and pouring the solution into a hydrothermal reaction kettle for reaction. After natural cooling to ambient temperature, washing with dilute HCl, hot water, and ethanol multiple times to remove residual reagents. And drying the obtained nanocrystals in a vacuum oven to obtain the iron phthalocyanine nanotube material. The average length and diameter of the iron phthalocyanine nanotubes are in the range of 2-6 μm and 100-400nm, respectively. The method has the characteristics of low preparation cost, simple operation, low equipment requirement and recycling. The iron phthalocyanine nanotube prepared by the method can be used as a novel electrocatalyst for proton exchange membrane fuel cells, methanol fuel cells and the like.

title_en: Narrow-band luminescent quantum dot, preparation method, electroluminescent device and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a narrow band luminescent quantum dot, a preparation method, an electroluminescent device and a preparation method, which belong to the technical field of quantum dot synthesis, wherein an Ag source, a Ga source and a Zn source are preheated by a one-pot method, and then an S precursor solution is injected to heat to obtain Ag-Ga-Zn-S nanocrystalline; cleaning the glass substrate coated with indium tin oxide; spin coating PEDOT: PSS solution, hole transport layer solution, quantum dot solution and electron transport layer solution; and (5) evaporating an aluminum electrode, packaging by using an optical adhesive, and finishing the construction of the device. The quantum dot with narrow band blue light characteristic is synthesized, and has excellent crystallinity, dispersibility and luminescence characteristic; constructing a quantum dot light emitting diode to realize narrow-spectrum electroluminescence with full width at half maximum (FWHM) smaller than 50nm, and obtaining a cadmium-free QLED device with high color purity; the synthesis method is simple, the materials are cheap and easy to obtain, the raw materials are nontoxic and harmless, the reaction time is short, and the mass production is convenient.

title_en: SnS-based2And In2S3Heterojunction ammonia gas sensor, preparation process and application
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electronic components, and provides an ammonia gas sensor based on a heterojunction of SnS  2  and In  2 S 3 , a preparation process and application. The ammonia gas sensor based on the heterojunction of SnS  2  and In  2 S 3  consists of a gas-sensitive material and an interdigital electrode plate, wherein the gas-sensitive material is coated on the surface of the interdigital electrode plate. The gas-sensitive material is a nano material formed by compounding tin disulfide and indium trisulfide. The method has simple production process, and the obtained gas-sensitive material has higher sensitivity and quick response recovery to ammonia gas. As the sensitive materials of the traditional gas sensor are mostly metal oxides, the working temperature is too high, so that the energy consumption is increased, the performance of the element is easily reduced, and the service life is shortened. The invention can make the gas sensor work at room temperature, which provides a new scheme for the design and preparation of portable and wearable electronic hardware equipment.

title_en: Titanium silicide contact and low temperature, high germanium, high boron SIGE: B PEPI
abstract_en: The title of the disclosure is titanium silicide contact and low temperature, high germanium, high boron SIGE: B PEPI. A fully-around gate integrated circuit structure with limited epitaxial source or drain structures is described. For example, an integrated circuit structure includes a plurality of nanowires over a sub-fin. A gate stack is over the plurality of nanowires and the sub-fin. An epitaxial source or drain structure is on opposite ends of the plurality of nanowires. The epitaxial source or drain structure includes: i) A first PMOS epitaxial (pEPI) region of germanium and boron; ii) a second pEPI region of silicon, germanium and boron on the first pEPI region at the contact location; iii) Titanium silicide conductive contact material on the second pEPI region.

title_en: High-brightness reversed-polarity AlGaInP light-emitting diode and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a high-brightness reversed-polarity AlGaInP light-emitting diode. Evaporating a nano mask on the surface of the wafer, photoetching a cutting path pattern, forming a cutting path by using ICP etching, coarsening a light-emitting area, and removing the nano mask. The coarsening luminous area is finished simultaneously in the process of forming the cutting channel by utilizing ICP etching, only one etching is needed to finish two steps of processes simultaneously, the coarsening mask is not needed to be manufactured by a photoetching process, the preparation process is simplified, the process flow is greatly reduced, compared with the production period of the existing preparation method, the production period is reduced by 10-12%, the production efficiency is greatly improved, and meanwhile, the production cost is reduced because multiple photoetching and corrosion are not needed.

title_en: High-surface-capacity potassium ion battery anode material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a high-surface-capacity potassium ion battery anode material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: weighing cobalt chloride hexahydrate, tin tetrachloride pentahydrate, polyvinylpyrrolidone and polyacrylonitrile, adding into N-N dimethylformamide, and uniformly stirring to obtain a homogeneous spinning solution; adding the prepared homogeneous spinning solution into an injector, setting spinning parameters, and carrying out electrostatic spinning to obtain a composite fiber film; pre-oxidizing the prepared composite fiber film, calcining and carbonizing the fiber subjected to pre-oxidizing treatment in an argon atmosphere to obtain a cobalt-tin-based carbon fiber composite material; and (3) annealing the cobalt-tin-based carbon fiber composite material and the selenium powder at high temperature in an argon atmosphere to obtain the flexible bimetal selenide carbon fiber composite material, namely the potassium ion battery anode material. The potassium ion battery cathode material prepared by the application enhances electron transmission, promotes reaction kinetics, and ensures strong mechanical stability of the electrode.

title_en: Nanometer high-pressure lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nano high-pressure lithium cobalt oxide anode material and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the steps of: (1) Mixing alkali liquor and a cobalt source to obtain a nano precursor of lithium cobaltate; (2) And mixing the nano precursor with doped metal salt, and performing high-temperature solid-phase synthesis to obtain the nano high-pressure lithium cobalt oxide anode material. Compared with the traditional high-temperature solid-phase synthesis, the average particle size of the lithium cobalt oxide anode material synthesized by the method is nano-scale, the particle size distribution is more uniform, and the uniformity of the distribution of doping elements in the material is improved. The method improves the stability of the layered structure of the lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode material, and greatly improves the cycle performance and the multiplying power performance of the layered lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode material under the condition of high pressure of 4.6V. The invention has great application prospect in the industrialization of the layered lithium ion battery anode material.

title_en: Battery shell, manufacturing method thereof, lithium ion battery and electric equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a battery shell, a manufacturing method thereof, a lithium ion battery and electric equipment, and relates to the technical field of batteries. The lithium aluminum hydrotalcite is coated on the inner surface of the battery shell, can promote circulation of lithium, supplement the lacking lithium, can effectively adsorb a lithium source which is not embedded in a graphite interlayer in the reaction, and reduces generation of dendrite lithium. The lithium supplementing is realized through the battery shell, the applicability is wide, and the lithium supplementing can be realized through the lithium aluminum hydrotalcite with high lithium aluminum ratio. The manufacturing method of the battery shell is used for manufacturing the battery shell, the inside of the metal shell can be enabled to be more compact, the mechanical strength of the metal shell can be improved, lithium can be supplemented by lithium aluminum hydrotalcite, circulation of lithium is promoted, and balance inside the battery is maintained. The lithium ion battery provided by the application comprises the battery shell. The electric equipment comprises the lithium ion battery.

title_en: Method for exciting polariton to reverse Cerenkov radiation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for exciting polarized excimer reverse Cerenkov Radiation (CR), which relates to the technical field of nanometer light source and electronic excitation, and comprises the following steps that S1, a hyperbolic polarized excimer material or a hyperbolic polarized excimer heterojunction material supporting negative group velocity dispersion is prepared on a chip substrate; S2, based on the prepared hyperbolic polariton material, utilizing the moving charged particles to excite polariton reverse CR, S3, placing the moving charged particles on the surface of the hyperbolic polariton material or the surface of the hyperbolic polariton heterojunction material, and when the moving charged particle wave vector and the polariton meet the wave vector matching condition, generating reverse CR. The invention 1) uses charged particles of plasmon-imitated motion of the nanowire to effectively excite polariton reverse CR, and 2) can be further regulated in other heterostructures based on hyperbolic polariton materials.

title_en: Cationic sugarcane loaded nano silver composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cationized sugarcane loaded nano silver composite material and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of material synthesis. The cationized sugarcane load nano silver composite material is prepared by pretreating sugarcane by adopting a eutectic solvent synthesized by tetraethyl ammonium hydroxide and 1, 3-dimethyl urea, then adding a cationic agent of 2, 3-epoxypropyl trimethyl ammonium chloride for cationic modification, taking the obtained cationized sugarcane as a carrier, and reducing silver ions into silver nano particles by utilizing the reducibility of lignin components in the sugarcane to fix the silver nano particles on the surface of the carrier. The preparation method of the composite material has mild conditions, is green, nontoxic, degradable, renewable and simple and feasible in process, can effectively improve the absorption of visible light, can effectively adsorb and catalyze and remove congo red and methyl orange in dye wastewater, and has good economic value and application prospect.

title_en: Magnesium aluminum alkoxide nanowire and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: A magnesium aluminum alkoxide nanometer wire and its preparation method and application are provided. The invention belongs to the field of nano functional materials. The invention aims at the technical problems of harsh reaction conditions, complicated preparation steps and high operation difficulty of the existing preparation method of the metal nanowire. Cutting Mg-Al-Li alloy into blocks, adding the blocks into anhydrous isopropanol, and heating at a constant temperature of 65-75 ℃ for 22-24 hours. According to the invention, the Mg-Al-Li alloy is used as a reaction substrate, mg  17 Al 12  is formed by Mg-Al reaction, electron effect between metals accelerates electron transfer, in addition, a geometric effect is provided between magnesium-aluminum alloys, and a new active site can be formed at a two-phase interface between magnesium-aluminum metals, so that the reaction efficiency is remarkably improved, the reaction time is shortened, the magnesium isopropoxide and aluminum nanowires with high length-diameter ratio are efficiently synthesized at room temperature or lower temperature, and the direction for preparing the metal alkoxide nanowires is widened.

title_en: Preparation method of indium complex nano material, obtained material and application of obtained material
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of complex nano materials, in particular to a preparation method of an indium complex nano material, an obtained material and application thereof. The application firstly discloses a preparation method of an indium complex nanomaterial, which comprises the steps of adding inorganic indium salt and 5-bromoisophthalic acid into N, N-dimethylformamide, mixing to obtain transparent reaction liquid, carrying out solvothermal reaction on the reaction liquid in a reaction kettle, cooling the reaction kettle after the solvothermal reaction, separating to obtain a solid crude product, washing the solid crude product, and drying to obtain the indium complex nanomaterial. The application also discloses an indium complex nanomaterial prepared by the preparation method and application thereof in organic dye wastewater adsorption. The indium complex nanomaterial prepared by the method disclosed by the application has excellent adsorption performance on Congo red dye in water environment, has certain adsorption performance on rhodamine B and methyl orange, and has higher practical application value in the treatment of organic dye wastewater containing Congo red dye.

title_en: Ratio fluorescent probe for synchronously detecting PTK7 and miRNA-21, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a ratio fluorescent probe for synchronously detecting PTK7 and miRNA-21, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: step 1, preparing carboxylated ferroferric oxide nano particles; step 2, fe  3  O  4  Binding of MNPs to the complementary strand of the aminated aptamer; step 3, combining green fluorescent CdSe/ZnS quantum dots with the amination aptamer 1; step 4, combining red fluorescent CdSe/ZnS quantum dots with the aptamer 2; and 5, preparing a fluorescent probe. The invention constructs the fluorescent probe based on the carbon dots, the quantum dots and the magnetic nano particles for synchronous detection of double targets, and applies the fluorescent probe to detection of actual human serum samples, thereby improving the accuracy of detection results, and having simple synthesis, low cost and good sensitivity and selectivity.

title_en: Rare earth doped indium phosphide blue light quantum dot and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a rare earth doped indium phosphide blue light quantum dot and a preparation method thereof. On one hand, the application provides a rare earth doped indium phosphide blue light quantum dot, which adopts a core-shell structure formed on the basis of quantum dots and comprises indium phosphide crystal nucleus doped with neodymium element and an external zinc sulfide shell layer. On the other hand, the application also provides a preparation method of the rare earth doped indium phosphide blue light quantum dot. The rare earth doped indium phosphide blue light quantum dot has excellent optical performance, the light-emitting wavelength is tunable within the range of 470-520 nm, the preparation process is simple, the condition is mild, and the rare earth doped indium phosphide blue light quantum dot does not contain toxic elements of heavy metals.

title_en: Composite material for secondary lithium ion battery, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to a composite material for a secondary lithium ion battery, a preparation method and application thereof. The composite material for the secondary lithium ion battery comprises the following components: the inside is a spherical porous hard carbon material with hollow holes, and silicon-containing gas and one or more gaseous compounds containing C, N, B, P elements are deposited in the pores to decompose and deposit products, wherein the products comprise silicon nano particles; the porous hard carbon material is obtained by preparing a hard carbon matrix through solidification by a double emulsion method and then carbonizing the hard carbon matrix.

title_en: Lithium iron phosphate conductive agent, lithium iron phosphate positive plate using same and battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lithium iron phosphate conductive agent, which is characterized in that: the lithium iron phosphate conductive agent is a nitrogen-doped carbon nanotube, and in the nitrogen-doped carbon nanotube, nitrogen element accounts for 0.8-1.5 wt% of the total mass of the nitrogen-doped carbon nanotube. The nitrogen-doped carbon nanotube can effectively improve the defects of the structure of the lithium iron phosphate material, enhance the tap density of the lithium iron phosphate and the adhesiveness between particles, and improve the conductivity and the cycle performance of the lithium iron phosphate material.

title_en: Polypeptide nano material for targeted treatment of cornea neovascularization and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a polypeptide nanomaterial for targeted treatment of cornea neovascularization, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the polypeptide nanomaterial comprises a hydrophobic unit, an assembling unit, a hydrophilic unit and a targeting unit which are sequentially connected; the targeting unit includes a polypeptide sequence that targets neovascular endothelial cells and specifically binds to an integrin receptor. The targeting unit not only has targeting of the corneal neovascular endothelial cells, but also has ligand-receptor interaction with integrin receptor proteins on the corneal neovascular endothelial cells, and the receptor proteins induce the morphology of the nano materials to be transformed through the interaction, so that the nano fibers are formed. The nanofiber covers the surface of endothelial cells, inhibits the migration of endothelial cells by long-acting binding to integrin receptors, and simultaneously negatively regulates and controls a downstream signal pathway of inflammation, thereby finally realizing the treatment of the new blood vessels of the cornea and reducing the inflammatory response of focal parts.

title_en: Pomegranate-like high-entropy alloy/carbon nano hybrid material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pomegranate-like high-entropy alloy/carbon nano hybrid material and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of new material preparation and catalysis. According to the invention, potassium chloroaluminate, potassium tetrachloropalladate, potassium hexachloroplatinate, potassium hexachlororhodium and potassium hexachloroiridium are used as precursor salts of high-entropy alloy, carbon nano hybrid materials embedded with ultrafine AuPdPtRhIr high-entropy alloy nano particles are synthesized through a limited-domain carbonization strategy of polyvinyl alcohol, and the pomegranate-like nano hybrid structure can effectively inhibit intrinsic aggregation of the high-entropy alloy nano particles in the electrochemical reaction process, so that a large specific surface area and highly exposed active sites of an electrode are maintained. The preparation process of the pomegranate-like high-entropy alloy/carbon nano hybrid material is simple, and the material has excellent catalytic activity and Faraday efficiency in the field of electrocatalytic nitrogen oxidation, and has good commercialization prospect.

title_en: Processing method of pressure sensor and pressure sensor
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sensors, in particular to a processing method of a pressure sensor and the pressure sensor. The processing method of the pressure sensor comprises the following steps: s1, manufacturing a first groove on the lower surface of an upper layer, and reserving a boss in the first groove; s2, manufacturing a resonator structure in the middle layer; s3, enabling the upper surface of the middle layer to be aligned and bonded with the lower surface of the upper layer, and enabling the free end of the resonator structure to be bonded with a boss of the upper layer; s4, manufacturing a second groove on the upper surface of the lower layer; s5, under the vacuum condition, aligning and bonding the upper surface of the lower layer and the lower surface of the middle layer to form a sealing cavity, wherein bonding parts between the lower layer and the middle layer are connected in an insulating way; s6, manufacturing a pressure sensitive film on the upper surface of the upper layer; and S7, manufacturing electrodes on the upper layer, the middle layer and the lower layer respectively. The processing method can solve the problems of vacuum packaging and lead interconnection, improves packaging reliability, improves product performance and reduces process cost.

title_en: Silicon-based MEMS rectangular waveguide circulator and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application is applicable to the technical field of circulators, provides a silicon-based MEMS rectangular waveguide circulator and a preparation method thereof, the silicon-based MEMS rectangular waveguide circulator comprises: an upper multi-layer silicon structure, a lower multi-layer silicon structure the base plate, ferrite and permanent magnet; the lower surface of the upper multilayer silicon structure is provided with a first groove, the upper surface of the lower multilayer silicon structure is provided with a second groove, the shapes of the first groove and the second groove are the same, the surfaces of the upper multilayer silicon structure and the lower multilayer silicon structure with grooves are butted with each other to form a first accommodating cavity; the ferrite is fixed in the first accommodating cavity; the bottom plate is fixed on the lower surface of the lower multilayer silicon structure; permanent magnet fixing is fixed at the upper part an upper surface of the multi-layer silicon structure. The rectangular waveguide circulator with better electrical performance and miniaturized size is realized through the silicon-based MEMS technology.

title_en: Flower-cluster-shaped Ni3Fe/TiO2Composite material, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flower-shaped Ni  3 Fe/TiO 2  composite material, which consists of flower-shaped TiO  2  and Ni  3  Fe particles prepared on the surface of the flower-shaped TiO  2  in situ, wherein the flower-shaped TiO  2  is prepared into TiO  2 /SiO 2  firstly and then into hollow sphere-shaped hollow flower-shaped TiO  2 ;TiO 2 /SiO 2 , the micro-morphology of the flower-shaped TiO  2  is a hollow flower-shaped structure with the size of 200-500nm, and Ni  3  Fe particles with the size of 3-5 mu m are loaded on the surface of the flower-shaped TiO  2 .   the preparation method comprises the following steps of 1, preparing a TiO  2 /SiO 2  precursor, 2, preparing flower-cluster-shaped TiO  2  and 3, preparing a flower-cluster-shaped Ni  3 Fe/TiO 2  composite material.   The preparation process of MgH  2  base hydrogen storing material based on Ni  3 Fe/TiO 2  includes mixing Ni  3 Fe/TiO 2  and MgH  2  under argon condition and ball milling in reverse and forward directions.   The obtained MgH  2  -based hydrogen storage material based on Ni  3 Fe/TiO 2  is applied as hydrogen storage material, the doping amount of Ni  3 Fe/TiO 2  is 5wt%, the initial dehydrogenation temperature is 155-175 ℃, the dehydrogenation amount under 300 ℃ is 6.9-7.1wt%, the hydrogen absorption amount under 100 ℃ is 4.2-4.8wt%, and the retention rate after 15 cycles is 96-98%.

title_en: Solid perovskite quantum dot composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a solid perovskite quantum dot composite material, and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) Mixing a lead source, a cesium source and a ligand in a solvent, and reacting to obtain a perovskite quantum dot precursor solution; (2) Mixing the perovskite quantum dot precursor solution with a silane coupling agent containing halogen atoms, reacting, cooling and hydrolyzing to obtain the solid perovskite quantum dot composite material. According to the invention, the silane coupling agent containing halogen atoms is added as a halogen source in the synthesis process of the solid perovskite quantum dot composite material, so that not only can sufficient halogen sources be provided and stable multi-tooth ligands are formed to passivate halogen vacancy points of the perovskite quantum dots, but also a halogen-rich environment can be formed around the solid perovskite quantum dots, so that the water stability of the solid perovskite quantum dots is improved, and meanwhile, the thermal stability is further improved.

title_en: TiO without organic acid/alkali stabilizer 2 Preparation method and application of nanoparticle colloid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a TiO which does not contain an organic acid/alkali stabilizer  2  A preparation method and application of nanoparticle colloid. TiO (titanium dioxide)  2  The preparation method of the nanoparticle colloid comprises the following steps: s1, mixing low-amine, halogen acid and low-polyol to obtain a reactant A; s2, adding titanium salt into the reactant A to obtain the reactionA reactant B; s3, dripping deionized water into the reactant B, and fully stirring to obtain TiO  x  Precursor sol C; s4, placing the sol C in a reaction kettle, and performing hydrothermal reaction to obtain TiO  2  Nanoparticle colloids. TiO of the invention  2  The nano particles have uniform particle size and high crystallinity, the colloid does not contain acid, alkali and organic matters which are difficult to volatilize, the substrate is not damaged in the subsequent film forming and device preparation, and high-temperature annealing is not needed. TiO is mixed with  2  The nano particles are applied to perovskite solar cells as mesoporous electron transport layers, the photoelectric conversion efficiency of the rigid cells can be more than 22%, and the photoelectric conversion efficiency of the flexible cells can be more than 20%.

title_en: Doped and coated composite modified lithium nickel manganese oxide positive electrode material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a doped and coated composite modified lithium nickel manganese oxide positive electrode material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, preparing a composite modified carbon nano tube: s2, grafting iron, cerium and cobalt on the composite modified carbon nano tube to prepare a multi-metal grafted modified carbon nano tube; s3, preparing a lithium nickel manganese oxide anode material; s4, modifying the lithium nickel manganese oxide anode material by utilizing ethyl orthosilicate to prepare a surface modified anode material; s5, carrying out carbon nano tube doping and polyaniline coating composite modification treatment on the surface modified cathode material: and obtaining the doped and coated composite modified lithium nickel manganese oxide anode material. The doped and coated composite modified lithium nickel manganese oxide positive electrode material provided by the invention has higher specific discharge capacity and excellent capacity retention performance.

title_en: Chiral nickel oxide nanoparticle and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of material chemistry, in particular to a chiral nickel oxide nanoparticle and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of S1, preparing a transition metal nickel ion reaction precursor solution and an oxalate ion reaction precursor solution; S2, adding an oxalate ion reaction precursor solution into a transition metal nickel ion reaction precursor solution to obtain a mixed solution, S3, stirring and preserving heat in a water bath until a mixed turbid liquid is obtained, S4, centrifuging the mixed turbid liquid, centrifugally washing the centrifuged precipitate by using deionized water and ethanol to obtain a chiral nickel oxalate nano material, S5, calcining to obtain chiral nickel oxide nano particles. The method combines an inorganic compound and a chiral ligand to synthesize the chiral nickel oxalate precursor, and then calcines the chiral nickel oxalate precursor to obtain the chiral nickel oxide nano particles, and adopts a simple and efficient coprecipitation method and a calcination method, so that the reaction conditions are easy to realize, the process is simple, the cost is low, and the method has good universality.

title_en: Super-hydrophobic polydopamine core-shell nanoparticle and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a super-hydrophobic polydopamine core-shell nanoparticle and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein polydopamine particles with uniform particle size are prepared firstly, then the polydopamine particles are brominated, and a hydrophobic monomer is coated on the surfaces of the polydopamine particles to obtain modified particles; the preparation method has strong operability and easily obtained raw materials, and the super-hydrophobic polydopamine core-shell nanoparticle composite polysulfone three-dimensional porous material has good separation performance on different types of oil-water mixtures, and has wide application value in the aspects of oil-water separation, offshore oil spill treatment and the like.

title_en: Quantum dot, preparation method thereof, photoelectric device and display device
abstract_en: The application discloses a quantum dot, a preparation method thereof, a photoelectric device and a display device. The quantum dot comprises a core and a ZnS shell layer arranged outside the core, wherein the core comprises an indium phosphide shell core and a cerium compound. The cerium compound can passivate defects in the indium phosphide core, improve the luminous intensity of the quantum dots, improve the stability of the quantum dots, narrow half-peak width, and adjust absorption wavelength and emission wavelength by controlling the doping amount of the cerium compound.

title_en: Development method of targeted PLK1 nano-drug based on molecular prediction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biological information, in particular to a development method of a targeting PLK1 nano drug based on molecular prediction; the method selects a PBD structural domain unique to PLK1 as a targeting region, researches the interaction mode of nano material black phosphorus and PLK1 by a molecular dynamics simulation method, provides a new direction for rapid development of PLK1 targeting inhibitors, particularly selects black phosphorus nano materials with high biocompatibility and biodegradability for screening the inhibitors, inhibits PLK1-PBD activity by utilizing the degradable black phosphorus nano materials in different degradation periods through different binding modes, and provides a new angle for the degradable black phosphorus nano materials as cancer therapeutic drugs.

title_en: Binary/ternary nano heterojunction, one-step preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a binary/ternary nano heterojunction, a one-step preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: dissolving cupric salt, organic reducing agent and alkali in water, stirring and dropwise adding titanium source; sealing the stirred solution, and then heating for reaction; centrifuging, washing and drying the reaction product to obtain binary Cu  2  O/TiO  2  And/or ternary Cu/Cu  2  O/TiO  2  A nano heterojunction. The nano heterojunction applicationHydrogen production and CO reduction by photocatalytic decomposition of water under visible light  2  Is a kind of medium. Compared with the prior art, the preparation method has the advantages that under the condition of reducing production procedures, the prepared product has the shape and size of about 20nm, is uniformly distributed, is olive-shaped and has good crystallinity. Binary Cu  2  O/TiO  2  And ternary Cu/Cu  2  O/TiO  2  The nano heterojunction composite material can greatly improve the photocatalysis performance by forming a heterostructure.

title_en: Foam nickel-loaded cobalt-based oxide electrocatalyst and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical fields of electrocatalytic material preparation, carbohydrate biomass electrochemical oxidation and hydrogen evolution, in particular to a foam nickel-supported cobalt-based oxide electrocatalyst, and preparation and application thereof. Firstly, constructing cobalt-based hydroxide with a nano structure on the surface of foam nickel in situ, and then forming the cobalt-based oxide electrocatalyst through calcination in air atmosphere; the electrocatalyst can be used as an anode to construct a paired system for producing formic acid by oxidizing saccharide biomass and producing cathode hydrogen. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of simplicity and controllability, no need of high Wen Feishi and the like, the constructed paired system for the cooperation of the oxidization of the carbohydrate biomass and the hydrogen production has higher conversion efficiency, the atomic economy can be improved on the basis of fully utilizing energy, and the hydrogen production by combining the electrolyzed water can be realized while the high added value product is obtained from the carbohydrate biomass.

title_en: Carbon quantum dot catalyst, preparation method thereof and prepared carbon quantum dot
abstract_en: The invention provides a carbon quantum dot catalyst, a preparation method thereof and the prepared carbon quantum dot, and belongs to the technical field of photocatalytic materials. Soaking the mesoporous silica nanospheres modified by polydopamine in silk fibroin liquid, then adding the silk fibroin liquid into concentrated sulfuric acid for hydrothermal reaction, adding the silk fibroin liquid into alkali liquor for removing a silica template, dialyzing to obtain S-O-N hybrid carbon quantum dots, uniformly mixing the S-O-N hybrid carbon quantum dots with silver-copper ammonia complex ion solution and nano titanium dioxide, carrying out hydrothermal reaction, centrifuging, washing and drying to obtain the carbon quantum dot catalyst. The preparation method of the carbon quantum dot catalyst prepared by the invention is simple, the raw material sources are wide, the prepared carbon quantum dot catalyst can obviously improve the photocatalysis efficiency, the quantum efficiency and the sunlight utilization rate, and the different visible light absorption properties and photocatalysis capacities are improved, so that the high-performance photocatalysis material is prepared, and the high-performance photocatalysis material has wide application prospect.

title_en: Low-cost high-strength light high-entropy alloy and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-cost high-strength light-weight high-entropy alloy and a preparation method thereof, wherein the atomic ratio expression is Al  a CoCrFeNi b O c , a is more than or equal to 0.7 and less than or equal to 1.5,1.8, b is more than or equal to 2.4,0.001 and c is more than or equal to 0.05. The method comprises the steps of selecting a light high-entropy alloy system, calculating a first sex principle, calculating a phase diagram, designing alloy components and preparing an alloy ingot. The microstructure is characterized by comprising primary FCC dendrites and eutectic lamellar structures, wherein the eutectic lamellar structures comprise FCC phases and BCC phases, O element is in solid solution in the FCC phases in the primary FCC dendrites and the eutectic lamellar, and nano Al  2 O 3  phases are in dispersion distribution in the FCC phases in the primary FCC dendrites and the eutectic lamellar and phase interfaces thereof. The room temperature tensile strength of the alloy reaches 2GPa, the elongation reaches 5%, and the tensile strength is improved by nearly 1 time compared with the existing AlCoCrFeNi  2.1  alloy (in a deformed state).

title_en: Liquid chromatography array column chip and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of chemical separation, and particularly relates to a liquid chromatography array column chip and a preparation method and application thereof. The chromatographic column is directly processed on the chip, and the volume of the chromatographic column is small, the weight is light, the cost is low, and the volume of the chromatographic column is very small, so that the required sample and reagent amount are less; meanwhile, the chromatographic column chip can greatly reduce the existence of dead volume, reduce the column internal effect and the column external effect, and further improve the detection sensitivity; compared with the traditional packed column, the liquid chromatography array column chip provided by the invention has lower back pressure, and the requirements of the whole liquid chromatography system on driving pressure and compression strength are greatly reduced. The sulfonic acid group is chemically grafted on the separation column, so that the liquid chromatography column chip provided by the invention has a strong cation exchange function, can perform ion exchange chromatography separation, and can be used for efficiently separating amino acid, polypeptide, protein and protein derivatives.

title_en: Conductive polymer-siloxane composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a conductive polymer-siloxane composite material, a preparation method and application thereof. The conductive polymer-siloxene composite material mainly comprises siloxene nano-sheets and conductive polymers coated on the surfaces of the siloxene nano-sheets, and the preparation method comprises the step of etching CaSi by hydrochloric acid  2  Preparing a siloxane nano-sheet, mixing the siloxane nano-sheet, a doping agent and a conductive polymer monomer solution, dripping an oxidant, cleaning and drying to obtain a conductive polymer-siliconThe oxygen alkene composite material is used for preparing electrode materials of energy storage devices. The method has simple process and low cost, and the obtained conductive polymer-siloxane composite material has high conductivity and large specific surface area, can be used as an electrode material of an energy storage device and can show excellent electrochemical performance.

title_en: Battery diaphragm material for marine environment and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a battery diaphragm material for a marine environment, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of battery and battery pack related materials. According to the invention, the composite nano silicon dioxide and boron nitride are used for carrying out blending modification on polyethylene, and the battery diaphragm material is obtained through electrostatic spinning, so that the stability is good, the strength is remarkably improved, lithium ions can rapidly pass through, the requirements of a high-power lithium ion battery can be met, and the durability usability and the charge and discharge performance of the lithium battery are improved; the preparation process is simple, the obtained diaphragm material has strong usability, and the diaphragm material has wide prospect in the application field of high-rate lithium ion battery diaphragms and is suitable for large-scale industrial production.

title_en: Battery diaphragm material for marine environment and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a battery diaphragm material for a marine environment, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of battery and battery pack related materials. According to the invention, the composite nano silicon dioxide and boron nitride are used for carrying out blending modification on polyethylene, and the battery diaphragm material is obtained through electrostatic spinning, so that the stability is good, the strength is remarkably improved, lithium ions can rapidly pass through, the requirements of a high-power lithium ion battery can be met, and the durability usability and the charge and discharge performance of the lithium battery are improved; the preparation process is simple, the obtained diaphragm material has strong usability, and the diaphragm material has wide prospect in the application field of high-rate lithium ion battery diaphragms and is suitable for large-scale industrial production.

title_en: Glutathione-protected gold-platinum alloy nanocluster and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a glutathione-protected gold-platinum alloy nanocluster and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: providing a gold source, a platinum source, glutathione and a first solvent; and adding the gold source, the platinum source and the glutathione into a first solvent for reaction to obtain the glutathione-protected gold-platinum alloy nanocluster. Glutathione is used as a reducing agent and a protecting agent, and the glutathione-protected gold-platinum alloy nanocluster is prepared by one-step reaction of the glutathione, a gold source and a platinum source. The invention does not need to add extra reducing agent, has less raw materials, low cost and simple preparation method. In addition, the glutathione-protected gold-platinum alloy nanocluster prepared by the method has strong electrochemiluminescence performance and can be used for detecting alpha fetoprotein.

title_en: Device and method for patterning and constructing nanowire array
abstract_en: The invention relates to equipment and a construction method for patterning and constructing a nanowire array, comprising the following steps: the device comprises an argon bottle, a hydrogen bottle, a quartz tube, a quartz capsule, a vapor deposition raw sample and a substrate, wherein the quartz capsule, the vapor deposition raw sample and the substrate are placed in the quartz tube; the output pipeline of the injection needle cylinder is communicated with the argon bottle output pipeline, the movable electrode is positioned at the output ends of the combined pipeline of the injection needle cylinder output pipeline and the argon bottle output pipeline and is introduced into the quartz tube, the output end of the movable electrode is correspondingly positioned above the substrate, and the electrode movement controller is used for controlling the directional movement of the movable electrode. The invention assembles the capillary electrode capable of generating microplasma on the mobile probe capable of two-dimensional movement, thereby printing the nano noble metal catalyst on the surface of the material in one step rapidly, utilizing the guiding function of the recycled catalyst, and combining with the physical vapor deposition technology to grow the nanowire array in a patterning way.

title_en: CNTs/Ag/AgNWS/SiO2Combined SERS substrate, preparation method and pesticide detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a CNTs/Ag/AgNWS/SiO  2  combined SERS substrate which is formed by dripping CNTs/Ag/AgNWS solution onto a silicon dioxide glass sheet and drying, wherein the CNTs/Ag/AgNWS in the CNTs/Ag/AgNWS solution comprises 26-60% of silver nano particles, 30-55% of silver nano wires and 3-20% of multi-wall carbon nano tubes by mass percent. The invention enables Ag nano particles to be successfully attached to the multiwall carbon nano tube, and then enables silver nano wires to be staggered and overlapped on the multiwall carbon nano tube. Silver nano particles with strong electromagnetic enhancement capability are obtained, the silver nano particles are combined with carbon nano tubes, silver nano wires with different structural shapes are added, and the Raman signal is further enhanced by utilizing charge transfer of a semiconductor, so that the Raman signal can be greatly enhanced, the purpose of improving the detection limit is finally achieved, and a better effect is obtained by a simple structure.

title_en: Heterojunction solar cell and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a heterojunction solar cell and a preparation method thereof, in the heterojunction solar cell, a metal nanowire is embedded in a transparent conductive layer, compared with the transparent conductive layer, the metal nanowire has better conductivity, and the metal nanowire is embedded with the transparent conductive layer to realize full contact, so that the lap joint impedance between the metal nanowire and the transparent conductive layer can be reduced, the conductivity of the transparent conductive layer is improved, and the photoelectric conversion efficiency of the heterojunction solar cell is further improved.

title_en: Preparation method of amide-assisted nano hierarchical pore TS-1 molecular sieve
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an amide-assisted nano hierarchical pore TS-1 molecular sieve, which relates to a hierarchical pore molecular sieve preparation technologyThe field of surgery. The invention comprises the following steps: s1: mixing a structure directing agent with water, then adding a silicon source, and performing first mixing to obtain a mixture solution; s2: performing second mixing on a titanium source and the mixture solution to obtain a molecular sieve initial sol mixture; s3: thirdly mixing water-soluble organic small molecules with the molecular sieve initial sol mixture to obtain a molecular sieve sol mixture; s4: and (3) carrying out two-step standing crystallization, solid-liquid separation and calcination on the molecular sieve sol mixture to obtain the high-activity hierarchical pore molecular sieve. The invention has simple operation, strong controllability and low cost, and the TiO of the obtained molecular sieve  6  The catalyst has high active species content, small particle size, rich micropores and mesoporous structures, and high catalytic activity in olefin epoxidation and oxidative desulfurization.

title_en: Two-dimensional copper-based magnetic nano sheet and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of ternary chalcogenide preparation, and particularly discloses a two-dimensional copper-based magnetic chalcogenide nanosheet and a preparation method thereof, wherein the chalcogenide nanosheet comprises CuMX  2  The M is Cr or Fe, the X is S or Se, the crystal structure of the nano sheet is hexagonal crystal structure, and the CuMX  2  The nano sheet is hexagonal in shape, the diameter is 0.01-5 mu m, and the thickness is 4-120nm. The invention is mainly used for preparing the two-dimensional copper-based magnetic chalcogenide nanosheets, and solves the problem of synthesizing the two-dimensional CuCrX in the prior art  2  The operation steps of the nano-sheet are more, and the inconvenience is brought to operators.

title_en: High-temperature evaporation equipment for manufacturing nano metal powder
abstract_en: A high-temperature evaporation device for manufacturing nano metal powder comprises a water-cooled barrel shell, a water-cooled hemispherical shell, an evaporation chamber, a cooling water inlet A, an observation channel, a metal material input channel, a cooling water accumulation cavity A, a cooling water inlet C, a plasma cathode column, a cooling water inlet D, a plasma anode binding post, a crucible bottom, a cooling water outlet B, a hemispherical shell cooling water channel and a barrel shell cooling water channel (31), and is characterized in that the water-cooled barrel shell (1) is a barrel-shaped shell and consists of an inner metal wall and an outer metal wall, the hollow barrel shell cooling water channel is formed in the hollow barrel, the cooling water accumulation cavity B is arranged at the upper part of the barrel shell cooling water channel, and a cooling water outlet B communicated with the barrel shell cooling water channel and a pressure relief port penetrating through the inner metal barrel wall and the outer metal barrel wall isolating barrel shell cooling water channel are arranged at the bottom of the barrel shell.

title_en: Novel fluorescent turn-on fluorescent probe and application thereof to detection of copper ions in lake water
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel fluorescent turn-on fluorescent probe and application thereof to detection of copper ions in lake water, and relates to the technical field of detection of heavy metal residues in the environment; the invention includes the use of Zn (NO  3  )  2  、Mn(NO  3  )  2  High temperature reaction with concentrated nitric acid under neutral condition to prepare Mn-doped zinc germanate nano rod (Zn)  2  GeO  4  MnNRs), drying, reacting at normal temperature in ethanol-water system under alkaline condition, centrifuging, collecting precipitate, dispersing in water to obtain fluorescent probe, and irradiating with ultraviolet lamp to quench fluorescenceAfter the reaction with the solution containing copper ions, obvious color change occurs under an ultraviolet lamp, so that the method can be used for detecting the copper ions; the invention has the advantages of simple synthesis and preparation method, convenient carrying, no excessive secondary reaction, high sensitivity, quick response, good selectivity, strong anti-interference capability and the like.

title_en: C-SiO for lithium ion batteryxPreparation method of-Si composite anode material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a C-SiO  x  -Si composite anode material for a lithium ion battery, which comprises the following steps of preparing a S1 C@SiO  2  composite material, preparing a S2 C@Si  3 N 4  composite material and preparing a S3C-SiO  x  -Si composite material. The C-SiO  x  -Si composite anode material for the lithium ion battery, which is prepared by the method, integrates nano silicon-based particles, a porous structure and a uniform carbon coating layer, has higher content of silicon active substances, higher specific discharge capacity, coats the surface of the Si particles by the SiO  x  layer, and has better circulation stability by dispersing the nano silicon-based particles in the carbon coating layer.

title_en: Inorganic nano antibacterial mildew-proof spray and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an inorganic nano antibacterial mildew-proof spray and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method of the inorganic nano antibacterial mildew-proof spray adopts a centrifugal dispersing instrument, an auxiliary dispersing auxiliary agent and a related dispersing treatment process, so that the particle diameter D90 of doped ZnO nano particles, namely the particle diameter of 90 percent of ZnO nano particles is accumulated, the particle content of the particles smaller than the particle diameter accounts for 90 percent of all particles below 110nm and can be as low as 50nm at the lowest, agglomeration of nano particles is effectively avoided, and the doped nano particles have high dispersing efficiency, narrow particle diameter distribution and uniform particle distribution. The inorganic nano antibacterial mildew-proof spray prepared by the preparation method can still have the characteristics of high sterilization efficiency, wide sterilization range, high safety and the like under the condition of insufficient light, and has long-term effectiveness and non-migration nano scale.

title_en: In-situ oriented carbon nano tube/silicon nitride nano belt composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an in-situ oriented carbon nano tube/silicon nitride nano-belt composite material and a preparation method thereof, comprising the following steps of uniformly mixing methyltrimethoxysilane, dimethyldimethoxysilane, ethanol, water and nitric acid according to a certain proportion, stirring and drying to obtain a siloxane xerogel precursor; the invention relates to a method for preparing a carbon nano tube/silicon nitride nano belt composite material with light weight, flexibility and good electromagnetic shielding performance, which comprises the steps of growing a silicon nitride nano belt material on the surface of the silicon nitride nano belt material by using a floating CVD method, injecting a mixed solution of ethanol, ethylenediamine and ferrocene into a tube furnace under the high temperature condition, and growing carbon nano tubes on the surface of the silicon nitride nano belt to prepare the carbon nano tube/silicon nitride nano belt composite material with the in-situ orientation.

title_en: Chromium oxide-lithium perchlorate composite catalyst, preparation method thereof and application thereof in preparation of bisphenol F
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of organic synthesis, and particularly relates to a chromium oxide-lithium perchlorate composite catalyst, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in preparation of bisphenol F. The chromium oxide-lithium perchlorate composite catalyst provided by the invention has an affinity effect on an inorganic phase and an organic phase in a bisphenol F reaction system, can enable phosphoric acid to be better contacted with phenol and paraformaldehyde in the condensation reaction process, reduces surface tension and surface free energy, thereby improving the yield of bisphenol F, and combines carbon cations of formaldehyde with phosphoric acid to generate semiphosphorus ketal in an acidic medium, thereby increasing the steric hindrance effect and improving the selectivity of the condensation reaction, so that the chromium oxide-lithium perchlorate composite catalyst has stronger catalytic effect and better selectivity on the reaction process for preparing bisphenol F, can effectively reduce the content of byproducts in the bisphenol F resin synthesis process, and improves the product yield and the ratio of 4,4' -dihydroxydiphenyl methane.

title_en: Preparation method of nano beryllium oxide
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of nano beryllium oxide, which comprises the following steps: s1, preparing beryllium hydroxide suspension; s2, preparing beryllium hydroxide gel; s3, performing hydrothermal pretreatment on beryllium hydroxide gel; s4, performing hydrothermal treatment; s5, forming nano beryllium oxide. According to the invention, macromolecular compounds with different polymerization degrees are added in the S3 hydrothermal pretreatment step, so that nanoparticles with different scale ranges can be synthesized; meanwhile, the interface and the solubility are optimized by utilizing polymers with different polymerization degrees, so that the particle size adjustment and the uniformity regulation of the nano beryllium oxide particles are further facilitated.

title_en: Metal-organic framework loaded spiropyran photochromic dual-color material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a metal-organic framework loaded spiropyran photochromic dual-color-changing material and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the field of organic solid-state photochromic materials. According to the invention, the spiropyran is loaded into the luminescent metal organic framework CQDs@ZIF-8 coated with the carbon quantum dots, and the metal-organic framework provides enough space free volume for spiropyran molecules, so that the spiropyran has enough open-loop space in a solid state, and the color change performance of the spiropyran is improved. And the overlapping range of the fluorescence emission wavelength of the carbon quantum dots and the ultraviolet absorption wavelength of the spiropyran is large, so that energy transfer can occur between the carbon quantum dots and the spiropyran, dynamic change of the fluorescence color of the material is realized, and the method has wide application prospect in the anti-counterfeiting field.

title_en: ZnTe/TiO 2 Heterojunction material, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to ZnTe/TiO  2  Heterojunction materials, a preparation method and application thereof. The ZnTe/TiO  2  Heterojunction materials include TiO  2  Nanotube array, znTe nanoflower, wherein ZnTe nanoflower is supported on TiO  2  A nanotube array; znTe nanoflower and TiO  2  Heterojunction is constructed between the nanotube arrays. The ZnTe/TiO  2  The preparation method of the heterojunction material comprises the following steps: firstly, adopting an anodic oxidation method to obtain TiO  2  Nanotube array, and then TiO is prepared by low temperature hydrothermal method  2  ZnTe nanoflower is loaded on the nanotube array. The ZnTe/TiO  2  Heterojunction materials are used in the field of photo-generated cathode protection. ZnTe/TiO obtained by the invention  2  Heterojunction material ZnTe and TiO  2  An interface electric field is constructed between the heterojunction and the heterojunction is accelerated under the driving of the electric field in the interfaceSeparation of photogenerated electron-hole pairs and electron transfer from ZnTe to TiO  2  Is transferred from the first to the second transfer station. And pure TiO  2  In comparison, the ZnTe/TiO  2  The heterojunction material improves photoelectric conversion efficiency, reduces carrier recombination efficiency, and forms excellent photogenerated cathode protection.

title_en: Ultra-thin two-dimensional MOF nanosheet combining ball milling and cell crushing and ultrasonic stripping as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra-thin two-dimensional MOF nanosheet combining ball milling and cell crushing and ultrasonic stripping, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of membrane separation. The preparation method of the ultrathin two-dimensional MOF nanosheets comprises the following steps: (1) synthesizing a MOF bulk phase by a hydrothermal method; (2) And stripping the synthesized target product from top to bottom in a mode of combining ball milling and cell crushing and ultrasonic treatment to obtain the nano-sheet solution. The ultrathin two-dimensional MOF nano sheet film is obtained by dripping the nano sheet solution on a heating porous substrate at 35-270 ℃; and then, carrying out gas separation performance test on the prepared ultrathin two-dimensional MOF nano sheet membrane. The invention can obtain ultrathin nanosheets with monoatomic layer thickness, and the two-dimensional MOF nanosheet film prepared by the ultrathin nanosheets has higher selectivity and flux in the field of gas separation such as hydrogen and the like.

title_en: Synthesis method of C@MoSe2 (1-x) S2x@NMWCNT ternary heterojunction material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a C@MoSe serving as a negative electrode of a sodium ion battery  2(1‑x)  S  2x  The invention relates to a synthesis method of an NMWCNT composite nano heterojunction material, which takes molybdenum pentachloride, se, S, NMWCNT and ethylene glycol (polyethylene glycol) as raw materials, and synthesizes C@MoSe by ultrasonic dispersion and calcination methods  2(1‑x)  S  2x  Nano composite heterogeneous NMWCNTAnd (3) a junction material. S atoms of the same main group as Se are easily doped into MoSe  2  MoSe with few layers formed in the lattice  2(1‑x)  S  2x  And MoSe  2(1‑x)  S  2x  The interlayer spacing is enlarged and the MoSe is reduced  2(1‑x)  S  2x  Na in interlayer  +  The migration potential barrier and the migration capability of sodium ions are improved, so that the rate capability of the composite material serving as the electrode material of the sodium ion battery is improved. The method has the advantages of simplicity, low energy consumption, short preparation period, high repeatability, and MoSe  2(1‑x)  S  2x  NMWCNT has high dispersity, uniform morphology, multiple active sites, high active material utilization rate, and good cycling stability (current density of 100mA g)  ‑1  Time 440mA h g  ‑1  ) And good cycle stability (current density of 5A g  ‑1  240mA h g after 500 times of circulation  ‑1  180mA h g after 1900 cycles  ‑1  ) The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the Is beneficial to realizing large-scale production.

title_en: ITO layer preparation method for improving brightness of LED chip
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of LED chips, in particular to a preparation method of an ITO layer for improving the brightness of an LED chip, which comprises the following steps: placing the substrate and the ITO target material into an evaporation machine; s2: setting the vacuum pumping machine to vacuum pressure lower than 5.0E-4pa and setting the temperature of the vacuum pumping machineSetting the rotating speed of a plating pot of the evaporator to be 9-11RPM at 80-100 ℃; setting up the evaporation plating machine To make the substrate vapor deposited Is a layer of ITO of (C). The application has the beneficial effects that: in the preparation method of the ITO layer for improving the brightness of the LED chip, the pressure intensity, the temperature and the plating rate of the evaporator are set to enable the ITO to be fully oxidized with oxygen of air in the evaporation process. In the process of annealing the ITO layer, oxygen is introduced into the annealing furnace, so that oxygen atoms in the ITO layer can be combined with oxygen in the annealing furnace, and the reaction of SnO in the ITO layer into SnO is promoted  2  The resistivity of the ITO layer is reduced and the light transmittance is improved.

title_en: Self-healing alloyed silicon-based negative electrode, preparation method thereof and electrode
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of an alloyed silicon-based negative electrode with self-healing characteristics, which comprises the following steps: adding liquid Ga-In-Sn alloy and 3-mercaptopropionate into isopropanol for ultrasonic treatment; adding Si-Ge alloy with a three-dimensional porous structure into isopropanol solution with Ga-In-Sn nano particles, and carrying out ultrasonic treatment on the composite solution; and filtering the composite solution to remove excessive Ga-In-Sn alloy, and heating the obtained sample to obtain the Si-Ge anode material with self-healing property and nano-porous structure. The self-healing property alloyed silicon-based negative electrode comprises the Si-Ge negative electrode material prepared by the self-healing property alloyed silicon-based negative electrode preparation method. The cyclicity of the silicon-based negative electrode is improved by sacrificing part of energy density, and meanwhile, the Ga-In-Sn alloy is utilized to modify the silicon-based material so as to enable the silicon-based material to have a self-healing function. The invention further relates to an electrode comprising an alloyed silicon-based negative electrode of the above-mentioned self-healing character.

title_en: Modified lithium manganate positive electrode material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of lithium ion batteries, and particularly relates to a modified lithium manganate positive electrode material and a preparation method thereof. The invention provides a modified lithium manganate positive electrode material which comprises a lithium manganate core, and an oxygen vacancy layer and a metal oxide layer which are sequentially coated on the surface of the lithium manganate core; the chemical composition of the oxygen vacancy layer is LiMn  2  O  4‑δ  The value range of delta is more than or equal to 0.0001 and less than or equal to 0.02. In the invention, the oxygen vacancy layer plays roles in stabilizing a crystal structure, regulating ion migration and improving electron conductivity in the modified lithium manganate; the introduction of proper oxygen vacancies is helpful for inhibiting the irreversible oxygen on the surface of the material from being removed, so that the specific discharge capacity and the first coulomb efficiency of the positive electrode material can be improved; the metal oxide layer avoids the direct contact between the lithium manganate core and the electrolyte, reduces the side reaction on the surface of the material in the charge and discharge process, and can also avoid the filling of the oxygen vacancy layer by oxygen ions, thereby improving the cycle performance of the battery.

title_en: Negative electrode material, preparation method thereof, negative electrode plate and water-based magnesium ion battery
abstract_en: The invention provides a negative electrode material and a preparation method thereof, a negative electrode plate and a water-based magnesium ion battery, belongs to the technical field of new energy, and overcomes the defect of poor rate performance and cycle stability when iron-vanadium oxide in the prior art is used as the negative electrode material of the water-based magnesium ion battery. The anode material is multi-wall carbon nano tube doped iron-vanadium oxide, and the molar ratio of an iron source to a vanadium source in the raw materials is 1: (1.8-2.2). The cycling stability of the magnesium ion battery is improved while the rate performance is improved.

title_en: Vermicular nano silicon dioxide and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of worm-shaped nano silicon dioxide.
