Adopting sodium silicate solution with a certain concentration, adding organic acid or inorganic acid to adjust the pH value, hydrolyzing sodium silicate, adopting organic silicon to carry out surface modification, and then utilizing hydrothermal reaction to induce the surface melting and reassembling of nano particles to obtain the surface modified vermiform nano silicon dioxide; or adding organic silicon into a sodium silicate solution with a certain concentration, then adding organic acid or inorganic acid to adjust the pH value to hydrolyze the sodium silicate, and then inducing the surface melting and reassembling of the nano particles by utilizing a hydrothermal reaction to obtain the surface modified vermiform nano silicon dioxide; or adding an organic modifier for reaction during hydrothermal reaction, and then washing and drying to obtain the modified organic compound. The diameter of the worm-shaped silicon dioxide is adjustable between 5 nm and 100nm, and the worm-shaped silicon dioxide has good dispersibility and organic compatibility. The preparation method has simple process and low cost, and is suitable for large-scale production.

title_en: Semi-cyanine compound in near infrared two regions, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a near-infrared two-region hemicyanine compound, a preparation method and application thereof, which are based on the distorted intramolecular charge transfer effect to modify hemicyanine molecules to obtain three near-infrared two-region hemicyanine fluorescent molecules HCY-945, HCY-995 and HCY-1080. The synthesized molecules have near infrared two-region fluorescence emission, and HCY-995 and HCY-1080 also have high-efficiency photo-thermal conversion efficiency, so that living tumors can be imaged and treated at the same time.

title_en: Solid single-particle dispersed carbon dots, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a solid single-particle dispersed carbon dot, and a preparation method and application thereof. Dissolving citric acid and o-phenylenediamine in a solvent, carrying out ultrasonic treatment to uniformly mix, carrying out solvothermal treatment to obtain a mixed solution, dialyzing the mixed solution, regulating pH, carrying out re-dialysis, and drying to obtain carbon dot powder; mixing carbon dot powder with a calcium source solution, adding a surfactant, dripping a phosphorus source solution, adjusting pH, performing hydrothermal reaction to obtain a reaction product, washing, and drying to obtain solid single-particle dispersed carbon dots. The solid single-particle dispersed carbon dots of the invention have good thermal stability of solid fluorescence and exhibit afterglow properties after high temperature calcination. The solid, single particle dispersed carbon dots exhibit good performance in LED and tumor cell imaging applications. The carbon dots prepared by the method can keep a long-term single-particle dispersion state, solve the problem of aggregation and fluorescence quenching of the carbon dots, and expand the application of the carbon dots in the field of solid fluorescent materials.

title_en: Bottom gate MOS tube and manufacturing method
abstract_en: The application relates to a bottom gate MOS tube and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the bottom gate MOS tube sequentially comprises a substrate, an insulating medium layer, a semiconductor layer and a passivation layer; the semiconductor layer is provided with a channel, a source region and a drain region, and the passivation layer covers the channel; the source region is provided with a source electrode, and the drain region is provided with a drain electrode; the semiconductor layer is located at one side of the channel and is provided with a gate region notch, and the substrate is located at the gate region notch and is provided with a gate. The manufacturing process S1 comprises the following steps: providing a substrate; s2: setting an insulating medium layer; s3: providing a semiconductor layer; s4: forming a channel and a gate notch on the surface of the semiconductor layer, wherein the gate notch is positioned on one side of the channel; s5: setting a passivation layer; s6: forming three notches in the passivation layer; s7: doping, namely doping the semiconductor layers of the drain region and the source region; s8: a source electrode, a drain electrode and a gate electrode are arranged. The application has the effects of reducing the grid resistance of the MOS tube and the subthreshold swing of the MOS tube and improving the transconductance characteristic of the MOS tube.

title_en: VN-supported Ir cluster, preparation method thereof and application thereof in catalyst
abstract_en: The invention relates to a VN-supported Ir cluster, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in a catalyst, and belongs to the field of catalysts. The invention provides a preparation method of a catalyst, which comprises the following steps: dispersing vanadium salt and iridium salt in an alcohol solvent to obtain a clear solution, adding a nitrogen-containing substance into the solution, and stirring to dissolve the nitrogen-containing substance; adding conductive carbon material, stirring and mixing; then, standing, aging and complexing the obtained reaction system to obtain a mixture; heating the obtained mixture at 60-70 ℃ for 2-5 h to remove redundant solvent; then heating to 700-900 ℃ and keeping 2-5 h; finally cooling to room temperature to obtain the catalyst. The catalyst prepared by the invention shows excellent HER performance in a wide pH range, and meanwhile, the catalytic activity of HOR is superior to that of a commercial Pt/C catalyst under the condition of 0.1M KOH, so that the catalyst has excellent HOR catalytic activity.

title_en: Preparation method of ultra-smooth surface with mist and water collection function and micro-nano hierarchical structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of an ultra-smooth surface with a mist and water collecting function and a micro-nano hierarchical structure, belongs to the field of ultra-smooth material preparation, and can be applied to mist and water collection. The shape and the size of the micron-sized column structure are flexibly adjusted through laser etching, nanowires are uniformly grown on the micron-sized column and groove structure through ammonia etching, silicone oil is injected through a spin coating method, and the liquid drop injection surface with the micro-nano hierarchical structure is obtained. Under the synergistic effect of the micro-nano structure constructed by the method, the super-hydrophobic surface injected with lubricating oil shows high-efficiency liquid drop capturing, gathering and removing performances, so that the mist collecting efficiency is greatly improved. More importantly, the surface has excellent stability, high temperature resistance, ice resistance and acid and alkali resistance, and is expected to be used in various extreme environments.

title_en: Preparation method of metal-doped titanium dioxide nanowire/block copolymer composite nanoparticle
abstract_en: The invention provides a metal-doped titanium dioxide nanowire/block copolymer composite nanoparticle and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of composite materials. The invention carries out metal doping on the titanium dioxide nanowire, thereby improving the physical and chemical properties of the titanium dioxide nanowire and enhancing the compounding capability with the segmented copolymer. The invention adopts an ultraviolet polymerization induced self-assembly method, and under the ultraviolet condition, the poly 4-vinyl pyridine macromolecular chain transfer agent and the styrene monomer are co-assembled with the metal doped titanium dioxide nanowire in the in-situ polymerization process, so that the novel titanium dioxide nanowire/segmented copolymer composite nanoparticle is prepared. The method has the advantages of simple experimental operation, high yield, adjustable nano material size and the like, and can regulate and control the morphology of the composite nano particles through parameters such as ultraviolet intensity, metal doped titanium dioxide nanowire types, monomer usage amount, reaction time and the like in the one-step method in-situ polymerization process.

title_en: Micro-mirror structure adopting movable support and manufacturing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a micro-mirror structure adopting movable support and a manufacturing method, wherein the micro-mirror structure comprises: the micro-bridge structure comprises a support and electric connecting column and a micro-bridge deck movably supported on the support and electric connecting column; the micro-bridge deck is provided with a micro-mirror surface, an electric connection is formed between the micro-mirror surface and the supporting and electric connecting column, the supporting and electric connecting column is electrically connected with the substrate, and when the micro-mirror surface is driven, the micro-bridge deck is driven to deflect around a movable supporting position on the supporting and electric connecting column. The invention can obviously reduce the actuation voltage of the micromirror and reduce the working voltage of the device.

title_en: Ultra-small-size nano-dot capable of efficiently penetrating BBB and achieving double targeting and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention is disclosed inAn ultra-small size nano dot capable of penetrating BBB efficiently and having double targeting and resisting Alzheimer's Disease (AD) and a preparation method and application thereof are provided, and belong to the fields of nano material preparation and biomedical application. The ultra-small nano-dots are formed by protein molecules, penta-peptide and ferrous ions (Fe)  2+  ) The flavonoid medicine is obtained by a self-assembly method according to a certain proportion. The ultra-small nano-dot obtained by the invention has the capabilities of double targeting, high-efficiency penetration of BBB and multi-target treatment of AD. Meanwhile, the preparation method is simple, raw materials are easy to obtain, the biological safety is good, the stability is high, the treatment level is various, and the medicine can be rapidly metabolized in vivo, and has the potential of being used as a safe, efficient and multi-target-point AD-resistant therapeutic agent.

title_en: Nanometer titanium dioxide network composite mesoporous carbon coated lithium manganese iron phosphate and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of nano titanium dioxide network composite mesoporous carbon coated lithium manganese iron phosphate, which belongs to the field of lithium ion battery anode materials. The nano titanium dioxide network composite mesoporous carbon coated lithium manganese iron phosphate prepared by the invention has the characteristics of small particle size, uniform particle size distribution, high conductivity, large specific surface area and multiple active sites.

title_en: Preparation method of cathode material, application and lithium battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a cathode material, which comprises the following steps: s1: dissolving a carbon-coated LiFePO  4  composite material in absolute ethyl alcohol, and adding an oxidizing acid to form active points on the surface of LiFePO  4 ; s2: dropwise adding 0.1-0.5 mol/L CuCl  2  solution into the system obtained in the step S1, stirring in the dropwise adding process, filtering, washing and drying after the reaction, and heating in reducing gas to obtain the cathode material. The preparation method is simple in preparation process and suitable for industrial production. The cathode material obtained by the method comprises LiFePO  4 , a carbon layer wrapped on the outer side of LiFePO  4  and CuO used for repairing an incomplete carbon network in the carbon layer. The cathode material is applied to a lithium battery, and the introduced CuO can repair an incomplete carbon network and is used for improving the number of active site connection of the lithium iron phosphate material so as to improve the rate capability and the cycle life of the LFP battery.

title_en: Fluorescent detection chip based on vertical graphene and nano gold, preparation method thereof and application thereof in AD marker detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fluorescent detection chip based on vertical graphene and nano gold, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in AD marker detection, belonging to the technical field of biological detection, wherein the preparation process of the fluorescent detection chip is as follows: growing vertical graphene on the surface of a substrate by a CVD method, wherein the height of the vertical graphene is 0.5-5 mu m, etching the graphene into an origin array with the diameter of 0.5-5 mm by a laser etching method, taking the graphene as a working electrode, ag/AgCl as a reference electrode, taking 1 mmol-15 mmol/L chloroauric acid solution as electrolyte, and electrodepositing gold on the surface of the graphene by a constant voltage method for 50-1000 s, wherein the electric potential is applied to the surface of the graphene in the electrodeposition process, wherein the electric potential is-0.1-1.8V.

title_en: Underwater super-hydrophobic surface micro-nano composite structure resistant to condensation failure and preparation method
abstract_en: The utility model provides an anti-condensation failure's super hydrophobic surface micro-nano composite structure under water and preparation method, makes the preparation method of the super hydrophobic surface under water that condensate water can be initiatively and in time discharged through the synergism between micro-nano structure, and this super hydrophobic surface can last for a long time under water under the existence of temperature difference. The preparation method comprises the following steps of (1) preparation of a micrometer structure, (2) preparation of a nanometer structure, (3) coordinated preparation of a micro-nano composite structure, (4) preparation of a micro-nano composite super-hydrophobic structure, and (5) preparation of a hydrophilic and hydrophobic micro-nano composite structure surface. The invention reduces the adhesion of condensed liquid drops in a micro-cavity by compounding a conical or fractal nano structure in the micro-cavity, provides a stable gas-liquid interface and sufficient air pockets by utilizing a bionic continuous hydrophilic-hydrophobic micro-structure, prevents the surface super-hydrophobicity integral failure caused by the failure of a single cavity, and rapidly discharges the condensed water by utilizing the synergistic effect of the micro-cavity structure.

title_en: Semiconductor gas sensor based on two-way porous substrate
abstract_en: The invention relates to a semiconductor gas sensor based on a double-pass porous substrate, which at least comprises a first electrode, a second electrode and a sensing layer, wherein the first electrode is used for conducting electrical change during sensing reaction in an electrified state, the second electrode is used for forming a current path in cooperation with the first electrode, the sensing layer consists of the double-pass porous substrate, the surface of the double-pass porous substrate is deposited with a gas-sensitive material for detecting gas, and the double-pass porous substrate is formed by a plurality of nanotube arrays. The first electrodes and the second electrodes are respectively arranged on two sides of the sensing layer in a staggered manner in a non-overlapping manner in a crossing manner in the third direction, so that at least one pipe orifice of the nano-tube on the sensing layer can be communicated with the outside. The invention improves the sensing electrode, avoids the phenomenon that part of the nanopores cannot detect gas because the sensing electrode is arranged to cover the nanopores, and improves the detection efficiency of the semiconductor gas sensor.

title_en: Preparation method of bionic nano-enzyme fiber and application of bionic nano-enzyme fiber in cell therapy
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of cell therapy, and particularly relates to a preparation method of bionic nano-enzyme fibers and application of the bionic nano-enzyme fibers in cell therapy. The application provides a preparation method of bionic nano-enzyme fiber, which comprises the following steps: compounding and fiberizing antioxidant metallic nano enzyme and biodegradable high molecular polymer under the condition of solvent to prepare bionic nano enzyme fiber; wherein the antioxidant metal nano enzyme is loaded on the bionic nano enzyme fiber. The bionic nano-enzyme fiber can be transplanted in situ to damage solid organs so as to regulate the ROS steady state of the solid organs, can play a role in synergistically enhancing the cell treatment effect with the loaded functional cell medicine, and effectively solves the problem that the existing cell treatment medicine is easy to block by the lung after intravenous injection or is cleared by macrophages/phagocytes after transplantation.

title_en: Prunella spike seed oil nanoemulsion with anti-tumor effect and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses selfheal seed oil nanoemulsion with an anti-tumor effect and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of medicines. The selfheal seed oil nanoemulsion with an anti-tumor effect is prepared by selfheal seed oil, an emulsifying agent, a solubilizer, a flavoring agent, an isotonic regulator, essence, a preservative, an antioxidant, or a pH value regulator and water; the invention also discloses a selfheal seed oil for the first time, which is rich in triterpenes represented by ursolic acid and phenylpropanoid components represented by rosmarinic acid, and the antitumor effect of the selfheal seed oil is enhanced through the preparation of nanoemulsion. The method provided by the invention has the advantages of simple process flow and convenient operation, and is suitable for industrial production; the product has stable quality and convenient quality control, and can be used for medicines and foods.

title_en: Two-phase shearing nanoparticle dispersion method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of nano material processing and dispersing, and discloses a two-phase shearing nano particle dispersing method which mainly comprises the following steps of uniformly mixing nano materials to be dispersed, a liquid working medium and a dispersing agent, cooling a mixture filled in a tubular mold, and liquefying a small amount of the working medium in a contact surface area of the solid mixture and the outer surface of a friction plate to form an extremely thin liquid film, so that an extremely high shearing flow field is formed, and a strong agglomeration effect is formed on nano particles contained in the liquid film.

title_en: Fe (Fe)3O4Preparation method and application of@Pt composite material
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disease diagnosis, and particularly relates to a Fe  3 O 4  @Pt composite material and a preparation method and application thereof. And synthesizing Fe  3 O 4  nano particles by adopting a coprecipitation method, then depositing a layer of Pt simple substance on the surface of the Fe  3 O 4  nano particles by utilizing the reduction effect of sodium borohydride, and separating, washing and drying to obtain the Fe  3 O 4  @Pt core-shell composite material. Adding the nucleic acid probe with the terminal modified sulfhydryl group into a solution containing Fe  3 O 4  @Pt NP, uniformly mixing, freezing at low temperature, taking out and thawing to obtain the Fe  3 O 4  @Pt nanoparticle functionalized by the nucleic acid probe for liquid biopsy. The invention utilizes the inert metal Pt to protect Fe  3 O 4 , on one hand, the problem that the Fe  3 O 4  is easily damaged by reducing substances, oxidizing substances and the like in biological matrixes is solved, and the stability of Fe  3 O 4  in the biological matrixes is further improved. On the other hand, pt layer and functional groups such as nucleic acid and protein are utilized to form Pt-S bond, the Pt layer is stably anchored on the surface of Fe  3 O 4  @Pt, and the accuracy of the Fe  3 O 4  @Pt core-shell type composite material in biological system application is guaranteed.

title_en: Method for converting vertical graphene into diamond
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for converting vertical graphene into diamond, which adopts a direct current glow discharge plasma chemical vapor deposition method with molybdenum as an electrode to prepare vertical graphene sheets, and then carries out annealing treatment in a tube furnace to convert graphene into diamond. The method for converting the vertical graphene into the diamond has very important scientific significance and engineering value for developing a novel diamond preparation method.

title_en: MXees loaded superfine nano high-entropy alloy composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an MXenes loaded superfine nano high-entropy alloy composite material and a preparation method thereof. Sulfur-modified Ti for composite material prepared by the invention  3  C  2  T  X  The nano-sheet is used as a carrier, and the nano-high-entropy alloy is anchored on the nano-sheet through covalent bonds formed by the nano-high-entropy alloy and sulfur atoms. Meanwhile, the preparation method is simple, quick and efficient, has universality and can prepare a series of superfine nano high-entropy alloy composite materials.

title_en: Preparation method of sodium iron phosphate material and sodium iron phosphate material
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a sodium iron phosphate material and the sodium iron phosphate material, and the method comprises the steps of 1) dissolving a di/trivalent iron source in deionized water to prepare a solution A. 2) Dissolving alkaline substances in deionized water to prepare a solution B, dropwise adding the solution B into the solution A, stirring until the pH value of the solution is=4-8, centrifugally filtering to obtain slurry, 3) dissolving chloride, fluoride and phosphate in deionized water to prepare a solution C, dispersing the slurry obtained in the step 2) in the solution C, stirring for 0.5-24 h, filtering and drying to obtain the target product. The invention provides a novel method for efficiently preparing nano sodium iron phosphate by using a two-step granularity control method under a low-temperature condition. The invention realizes the room-temperature, rapid and efficient nano-preparation of the sodium iron phosphate product by utilizing the rapid nucleation of the precipitation reaction and the in-situ conversion of anion exchange.

title_en: Patterning method of suspended heterogeneous film and pressure sensor preparation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a patterning method of a suspended heterogeneous film and a pressure sensor preparation method, wherein all steps of the method are completely compatible with the current CMOS technology, large-scale flow sheet preparation and cost reduction of a suspended two-dimensional material structure can be realized on the basis of no need of additional custom equipment, and in the implementation process of the method, the two-dimensional material is supported and protected by a high polymer supporting material in the whole process, so that the damage of the two-dimensional material in the implementation process is effectively avoided.

title_en: Organic-inorganic hybrid microsphere and application thereof as electrolyte additive in zinc ion battery
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of water-based zinc ion batteries, and particularly relates to an organic-inorganic hybrid microsphere and application thereof as an electrolyte additive in a zinc ion battery. The invention provides an organic-inorganic hybrid microsphere as an additive, which is used as an electrolyte additive to be adsorbed on the surface of a zinc cathode in situ in the zinc metal deposition process to form a functional protective layer, wherein the functional protective layer can effectively inhibit hydrogen evolution reaction, induce zinc ions to uniformly nucleate, regulate the deposition orientation of the zinc cathode and inhibit the growth of zinc cathode dendrites in a water-based zinc ion battery, thereby improving the coulomb efficiency and the cycle life of the water-based zinc ion battery. In the water-based zinc ion battery, the electrolyte comprising the organic-inorganic hybrid microsphere is matched with a high-performance battery anode material and a zinc cathode, so that the industrialization of the propulsion water-based zinc ion battery is accelerated.

title_en: Self-calibration SOI-based MEMS three-dimensional force sensor and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-calibration SOI-based MEMS three-dimensional force sensor and a preparation process thereof. The invention comprises a MEMS device layer and a substrate bonded below the MEMS device layer; the MEMS device layer comprises a boss, an anchor point, an anchor area, a central plate, four L-shaped piezoelectric driving beams positioned around the central plate and twelve pads; the substrate includes a bonding region, a cavity, a conductive pad, and eight stationary metal electrodes. The invention adds the driving module and the multi-capacitance detection module for the sensitive element, thereby ensuring the accuracy of the measurement result and saving the extra calibration cost.

title_en: Micro-optical electro-mechanical system based on laser guidance
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of MEMS semiconductors and discloses a micro-optical-electro-mechanical system based on laser guidance, which comprises a four-channel operational amplifier, a convex lens and a four-quadrant photoelectric sensor, wherein the convex lens is arranged on one side of the middle part of the four-channel operational amplifier, the four-quadrant photoelectric sensor is arranged on the other side of the middle part of the four-channel operational amplifier, a channel for light transmission is arranged between the convex lens and the four-quadrant photoelectric sensor, and the four-channel operational amplifier, the convex lens and the four-quadrant photoelectric sensor jointly form a MOEMS chip. The invention can solve multiple functions such as optical perception, photoelectric conversion, signal processing and the like on one chip, further realizes the operation and control of spectrum, polarization and optical space properties, has the characteristics of microminiaturization and accuracy, and can bring the invention into play unique advantages in laser guidance. Besides the capability of remarkably improving the system performance, the cost can be greatly reduced.

title_en: High-sensitivity resistance type flexible strain sensor and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-sensitivity resistance type flexible strain sensor and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the resistance type flexible strain sensor comprises a conductive fabric substrate and an electrode; the electrodes are respectively arranged at two ends of the conductive fabric substrate and are connected with electrode leads; the conductive fabric substrate is a negative poisson ratio conductive fabric substrate. According to the invention, the knitted fabric with the negative poisson ratio is used as the fabric substrate of the resistance type flexible strain sensor, so that the synergistic effect of the increase of the tensile resistance and the increase of the contact resistance of the yarn is realized, the resistance change rate is improved, and finally the aim of improving the sensitivity of the resistance type flexible strain sensor is fulfilled.

title_en: Surface-enhanced Raman substrate based on DNA paper folding technology and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a surface-enhanced Raman substrate based on a DNA paper folding technology and a preparation method thereof, which comprises the following steps: designing a DNA paper folding frame pattern, designing a position and a sequence (a modified chain) containing gold nano-particles, and mixing and annealing long chains and short chains (containing the modified chain) contained in the pattern according to a certain proportion to form a DNA paper folding structure in ordered arrangement. The modified short chains with different lengths are orderly distributed at the bottom and the side surface of the paper folding structure, so as to play a role in connecting gold nanoparticles. Thiolating the gold nanoparticle surface to form a site for attachment to the oligonucleotide. And (3) treating the surface of the silicon wafer, and preparing a positively charged single-molecule film layer by using APTES so that the positively charged single-molecule film layer can adsorb a negatively charged DNA paper folding frame. And then mixing the thiolated gold nano particles with a DNA paper folding structure, and depositing the mixture on the surface of a silicon wafer to form a coupling structure of the gold nano particles and the paper folding structure. The surface was irradiated with a VUV lamp to decompose and remove DNA and APTES, exposing the hot spot structure of the gold nanoparticles. The advantages are that: the length of the modified chain is controlled, so that the distance between the nano particles is adjusted, and the minimum distance can reach 2 nanometers. Adding or removing a modifying chain enables arbitrarily shaped hotspot array creation.

title_en: Quantum dot composition, optical member, and electronic device
abstract_en: Quantum dot compositions, optical members, and electronic devices are provided. The quantum dot composition includes a first quantum dot and a second quantum dot, and each of the first quantum dot and the second quantum dot independently includes: a core; and a shell covering at least a portion of the core, the core of the first quantum dot including a first semiconductor compound, the core of the second quantum dot including a second semiconductor compound, the first semiconductor compound and the second semiconductor compound being different from each other, and a maximum emission wavelength of a Photoluminescence (PL) spectrum of the first quantum dot being greater than a maximum emission wavelength of a PL spectrum of the second quantum dot.

title_en: Carbon nanoflower coated carbon sphere material with core-shell structure, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carbon nanoflower coated carbon sphere material with a core-shell structure, a preparation method and application thereof. The carbon nanoflower@carbon sphere structure can effectively relieve the problems of strain, low electron/ion diffusion rate, polysulfide shuttling, poor conductivity and the like caused by sulfur volume expansion, so that the capacity exertion, the rate performance improvement and the cycle stability improvement of the high-performance lithium sulfur battery are realized.

title_en: P-Ov-In2O3Preparation method of nanospheres and application of nanospheres in lithium-sulfur battery diaphragm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of P-Ov-In2O3 nanospheres and application thereof In a lithium sulfur battery diaphragm, comprising the following steps of S1, adding In (NO  3 ) 3 ·2H 2  O, magnetically stirring until the solution is clear and transparent) into a glass bottle containing ethylene glycol, S2, placing the glass bottle containing the solution obtained In the step S1 In a reaction kettle lining containing hypophosphorous acid, placing the reaction kettle In a blast drying box for reaction to obtain P-Ov-In  2 O 3  NSs precipitate, S3, finally, washing the P-Ov-In  2 O 3  NSs precipitate by deionized water and absolute ethyl alcohol for 3 times, and drying for 24 hours In the blast drying box at 50 ℃ to obtain the P-Ov-In  2 O 3  NSs nanospheres.

title_en: NO electrochemical sensor based on platinum iridium mesoporous alloy and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: An NO electrochemical sensor based on platinum iridium mesoporous alloy and a preparation method thereof belong to the technical field of electrochemical sensors. Mesoporous platinum iridium alloy nano particles (Pt-Ir NPs) are generated on the surface of the electrode in situ by an electrochemical deposition technology, so that NO can be accurately and rapidly detected under physiological conditions. The mesopores are constructed by adding a cosurfactant to the electrolyte. In addition, the sensor has the advantages of wide linear range, high sensitivity, low detection limit, short response time, strong anti-interference capability and the like, is expected to play an important role in the field of biomedical analysis and detection, and has commercialized potential.

title_en: Preparation method of zinc oxide powder for heat conduction
abstract_en: According to the preparation method of the zinc oxide powder for heat conduction, the high-purity hexagonal zinc oxide with high dispersibility and controllable and uniform size can be obtained by adopting a simple hydrothermal synthesis method, complicated equipment or high-temperature and high-pressure conditions are not required, the process is simple, the cost is low, and the industrial production is easy. The invention uses zinc acetate dihydrate and hexamethylenetetramine as precursor solution, and the molar ratio of the zinc acetate dihydrate to the hexamethylenetetramine is 1:1 in deionized water to obtain a homogeneous solution; transferring the solution into an autoclave for reaction, performing hydrothermal reaction at a certain temperature and time, cooling the autoclave after the reaction is finished, and filtering the obtained white precipitate with deionized water for several times; and drying the obtained sample, and placing the dried precursor in a muffle furnace for roasting to obtain zinc oxide powder after roasting is completed. The method can prepare hexagonal zinc oxide powder with high purity, high crystallinity, high dispersibility and uniform size.

title_en: Magnetic fluorescent dual-functional composite material powder and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a magnetic fluorescent dual-functional composite material powder, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the composite material powder comprises a polymer, perovskite quantum dots and magnetic nano powder; the polymer coats the perovskite quantum dots and the magnetic nano powder; the perovskite quantum dots and the magnetic nano powder are dispersed within the polymer. The preparation method ensures that the perovskite quantum dots are synthesized in the drying process, thereby having the advantages of simple synthesis process and low preparation cost, the polymer in the composite material powder completely coats the magnetic nano powder and the perovskite quantum dots, the internal nano particles cannot contact with a target inspection object, the influence of toxicity is avoided, the microsphere surface can be further modified, the composite powder has excellent optical performance and stronger magnetism, and the material can rapidly respond to an externally-applied magnetic field, so the material has a certain application prospect in the fields of separation sensing, medical diagnosis, biological imaging and the like.

title_en: Novel biosensor based on carbon nano tube and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel biosensor based on carbon nano tubes and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing and ultrasonically treating a nafion ethanol solution with a specific proportion and concentration with a carbon nano tube dispersion liquid to obtain a matrix mixture, wherein the carbon nano tube dispersion liquid is obtained by adding carbon nano tubes into dimethylformamide; coating the matrix mixture on a working electrode to obtain a deposition electrode; depositing glutaraldehyde solution with specific concentration on the deposition electrode to obtain a sensor working electrode; and assembling the working electrode, the counter electrode and the reference electrode of the sensor to obtain the novel biosensor. The sensor obtained by the invention has simple and quick application, can realize high-sensitivity and real-time detection of biological macromolecules, and has strong detection specificity and strong capability of resisting disturbance of an object.

title_en: CoFe nanocapsule loaded magnetic carbon aerogel and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a CoFe nanocapsule-loaded magnetic carbon aerogel and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of composite materials. The preparation method comprises the steps of preparing an aqueous solution containing cobalt acetate and trisodium citrate dihydrate, adding an equal volume of TEMPO (TEMPO-potassium citrate) CNF-oxidized aqueous solution, uniformly mixing and naming the aqueous solution as a solution A, preparing an equal volume of TEMPO-oxidized aqueous solution as a solution B, mixing the solution A and the solution B, reacting at 70-100 ℃ to obtain a PBA-in-situ surface-grown CNF aqueous solution, unidirectional freezing, freeze-drying to obtain PBA-loaded CNF-based aerogel, and performing heat treatment to obtain the PBA-loaded CNF-based aerogel. The magnetic carbon aerogel has good mechanical flexibility, elasticity and fatigue resistance, excellent conductivity and electromagnetic wave absorption performance, excellent electric/magnetic sensing performance, good heat insulation performance and wide application prospect.

title_en: Method for preparing nano zinc oxide by using secondary zinc oxide
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of zinc smelting, and aims to provide a method for preparing nano zinc oxide by using secondary zinc oxide, which takes zinc-containing mining and metallurgy solid waste as a raw material, firstly purifies and removes impurities, then takes purified and removed zinc sulfate as a raw material, sodium oleate and sodium carbonate are added, basic zinc carbonate slurry is synthesized through a bubble liquid film method, basic zinc carbonate is obtained through ageing, filtering and washing, and nano zinc oxide is obtained through drying and roasting of the basic zinc carbonate, so that the environmental pollution risk of solid waste residues is solved, and the comprehensive utilization of solid waste resources is realized, and the method has remarkable economic benefit.

title_en: Silicon negative electrode sheet and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a silicon negative plate and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method is as follows: soaking a substrate in an amine substance solution containing a nano carbon material, taking out the substrate, and heating the substrate in an inactive atmosphere to obtain a substrate layer with a surface covered with a nitrogen-rich nano carbon layer; coating a first negative electrode active slurry containing amine substances on the surface of the obtained nitrogen-rich nano carbon layer, drying and rolling to obtain a first coating; and coating a second negative electrode active slurry which does not contain amine substances on the surface of the obtained first coating, drying and rolling to obtain a second coating, and thus obtaining the silicon negative electrode plate. According to the invention, the contact between the base material in the silicon negative plate, the nano carbon layer and the negative electrode material coating is enhanced, so that the peeling strength and the sheet resistance of the negative plate are improved, and the overall performance of the battery is further improved.

title_en: Method for preparing battery by using Co@CNFs composite material
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for preparing a battery by utilizing a Co@CNFs composite material. And then putting the ZIF-67@PAN fibers into a quartz tube furnace for burning to obtain the Co@CNFs composite material. The material has good conductivity and chemical stability, and also has good catalytic activity, and can obviously improve the photoelectric conversion efficiency, so that the PCE reaches 6.96%, and compared with pure cobalt, the photoelectric conversion efficiency is improved by 0.88%.

title_en: Preparation method of narrow band blue light Cu-Ga-S/ZnS nanocrystalline
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of narrow-band blue light Cu-Ga-S/ZnS nanocrystals, which belongs to the technical field of quantum dot synthesis, and is characterized in that the narrow-band blue light Cu-Ga-S/ZnS nanocrystals are prepared based on a thermal injection method, and medicines used for preparation are IB group metal salt, IIIA group metal salt, VIA group simple substance and compound; the full width at half maximum of the photoluminescence spectrum is less than 50nm, and the photoluminescence peak is located at 470-480nm. After the Cu-Ga-S nanocrystalline is coated by the ZnS shell layer, a gradient distribution zinc-rich alloy structure is formed on the surface of the quantum dot, obvious narrow-band photoluminescence peaks appear at 470-480nm, the full width at half maximum is 36-46nm, the narrow-band luminescence characteristic is realized, and the method has the prospect of constructing an electroluminescent device; the cadmium-free QLED device has excellent crystallinity, dispersibility and luminescence characteristics, and can be obtained by constructing an electroluminescent diode as a luminescence layer; the synthesis method is simple, the materials are cheap and easy to obtain, the raw materials are nontoxic and harmless, the reaction time is short, and the method is convenient for industrialized mass production.

title_en: Process for preparing active nano calcium carbonate from phosphogypsum and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a process for preparing active nano calcium carbonate by phosphogypsum, which comprises the following steps: s1, adding water-washed phosphogypsum into a phase transfer agent for phase transfer reaction to obtain a phase transfer liquid; s2, aging and separating the phase transfer liquid to obtain a mother liquid 1 and CaY precipitate; s3, adding deionized water into the CaY precipitate to obtain a CaY solution; sequentially adding NaOH and a compound crystal form control agent into the CaY solution to prepare a mixed solution; CO is introduced into  2  Performing carbonization reaction to obtain mother liquor 2 and nano CaCO  3  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the S4, modifying to obtain the active nano calcium carbonate. The application also discloses an application of the phosphogypsum in the process for preparing the active nano calcium carbonate. The application can obtain modified CaCO with higher purity by one-time carbonization  3  No acid leaching is needed, the process condition is mild, the equipment requirement is low, and the production efficiency is high.

title_en: Porous cerium oxide nano-sheet catalyst, preparation thereof and application thereof in photo-thermal synergistic carbon dioxide decomposition reaction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a porous cerium oxide nano-sheet catalyst with light response, a preparation method and a CO in photo-thermal synergy  2  Use in decomposition reactions. CeO obtained by the invention  2  The catalyst is prepared by constructing a sacrificial carbon template by utilizing a severe oxidation-reduction reaction between glucose and nitrate. The catalyst can effectively catalyze CO under the condition of low temperature ultraviolet and visible light  2  The CO decomposed into raw materials of hydrocarbon products has high stability and activity, and is favorable for degrading CO in the atmosphere  2  Has good application prospect.

title_en: Colloid Co 9 S 8 Method for preparing nanowire
abstract_en: The application provides a colloid Co  9  S  8  The preparation method of the nanowire comprises the steps of firstly mixing a silver source, a cobalt source, a sulfur source and an organic solvent, heating to reach a reaction temperature, and preserving heat for a period of time to obtain the Ag with adjustable diameter  2  S‑Co  9  S  8  A nanowire; subsequent removal of Ag using alkylphosphorus  2  S‑Co  9  S  8  Ag in nanowires  2  S end point, obtain colloid Co  9  S  8  A nanowire. The application realizes the colloidal Co with uniform size, adjustable diameter and no obvious defect by adjusting the reaction temperature based on the solution phase-solid phase catalytic growth method  9  S  8  And (5) synthesizing nanowires.

title_en: Lithium iron phosphate positive electrode material, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lithium iron phosphate positive electrode material, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method of the lithium iron phosphate positive electrode material comprises the steps of sintering a lithium iron phosphate precursor under protective gas to obtain the lithium iron phosphate positive electrode material; the lithium iron phosphate precursor is mainly prepared from a first mixture, wherein the first mixture comprises an iron source, a phosphorus source, a lithium source, a carbon source and flaky graphitized carbon nitride. The flaky graphitized carbon nitride is added in the precursor preparation step, so that a uniform coating layer is formed on the surface of the lithium iron phosphate, and the prepared lithium iron phosphate positive electrode material has small particle size, high compaction and higher charge-discharge specific capacity.

title_en: Alkali metal doped manganese dioxide nano material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application provides an alkali metal doped manganese dioxide nano material, a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) Firstly mixing ammonium persulfate and strong alkali in a first solvent to obtain a solution A, and secondly mixing manganese salt and alkali metal salt in a second solvent to obtain a solution B; (2) Dropwise adding the solution B obtained in the step (1) into the solution A for third mixing to obtain an alkali metal doped manganese dioxide nano material precursor; (3) And (3) carrying out hydrothermal reaction on the precursor of the alkali metal doped manganese dioxide nano material in the step (2) to obtain the alkali metal doped manganese dioxide nano material. The application prepares an alkali metal doped manganese dioxide material, and a zinc ion battery containing the alkali metal doped manganese dioxide material has more excellent multiplying power and cycle performance than manganese dioxide prepared by a conventional method.

title_en: Preparation method of bulk hydrofining catalyst containing rare earth
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a bulk phase hydrofining catalyst containing rare earth, which comprises the following steps: (1) Performing gel forming reaction on a first precipitator, a sodium molybdate solution and a Ni-Si-containing solution, adding an anionic surfactant in the reaction process, and performing first aging to obtain a first slurry; (2) Adding a solution containing Ni, al, a sodium tungstate solution, a second precipitant and the first slurry into water and grease liquid to carry out a second gel forming reaction, reducing the pH value in the reaction process in a plurality of times, adding a part of rare earth solution after the reduction times are equally divided, and carrying out second aging to generate a second slurry; (3) And (3) aging the second slurry, carrying out solid-liquid separation to obtain a formed product, and carrying out desalting treatment to obtain the catalyst. The method has the advantages of low cost, clean process, larger pore volume and pore diameter of the catalyst, better synergistic effect of the hydrogenation metal and the rare earth metal in the catalyst, improved hydrogen storage capacity, reduced carbon deposition of the catalyst and better activity stability when the inferior distillate oil raw material is treated.

title_en: Bulk phase hydrofining catalyst and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bulk phase hydrofining catalyst and a preparation method thereof. The bulk hydrofining catalyst of the present invention has core phase of amorphous composite oxide containing Mo, ni and Si and shell phase of amorphous composite oxide containing W, ni and Al. The preparation method comprises the steps of (1) carrying out a first gel forming reaction and first aging on a first precipitant, a sodium molybdate solution and a solution containing Ni and Si to obtain a first slurry containing Ni, si and Mo, (2) adding water and an oleaginous liquid into a reactor, then carrying out a second gel forming reaction and second aging on the solution containing Ni and Al, the sodium tungstate solution, a second precipitant and the first slurry to obtain a second slurry, (3) carrying out aging on the second slurry, forming, and (4) carrying out desalination treatment on the formed product to obtain the catalyst. The catalyst prepared by the method has larger pore volume and pore diameter, has higher hydrodesulfurization and hydrodenitrogenation reaction performances, can avoid excessive cracking of diesel oil fraction, has good raw material adaptability, and can treat poor-quality distillate oil raw materials.

title_en: D, d 11 PMUT unit driven by working mode and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of semiconductors, and particularly relates to a semiconductor device  11  The PMUT unit driven by the working mode and the preparation method thereof solve the technical problem of lower performance of the existing PMUT, and the method comprises the steps of preparing a piezoelectric layer on the upper surface of an SOI (silicon on insulator) sheet; manufacturing an upper electrode on the piezoelectric layer; depositing a silicon dioxide layer on the lower surface of the SOI sheet, and etching the lower surface of the silicon dioxide layer upwards to leak out of the buried layer of the SOI sheet; and corroding the silicon dioxide layer and the buried layer in the SOI sheet to obtain the cavity structure of the PMUT. The PMUT unit provided by the invention adopts a piezoelectric material surface transverse expansion working mode membrane thin piezoelectric layer to generate displacement difference with a vibration layer, realizes bending vibration, can be used for ultrasonic imaging, and can improve output voltage and corresponding sensitivity; the method avoids the problems of complex etching process and difficulty in the patterning process of the piezoelectric layer, is simple, and can be applied to the fields of medical treatment, industry, biological feature recognition and the like.

title_en: Uniform flaky nano gamma-alumina powder and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of uniform flaky nano gamma-alumina, which comprises the following steps: preparation of AlCl containing Urea  3  ·6H  2  And adding ammonia water into the aqueous solution while stirring, fully and uniformly stirring, transferring to a high-pressure reaction kettle for hydrothermal reaction, and filtering, washing, drying and roasting the precipitate after the reaction is finished to obtain the uniform flaky nano gamma-alumina. The method prepares the uniform nano flaky gamma-alumina under the condition of no need of adding a template agent, has simple and safe operation and low cost, and the obtained alumina has a uniform flaky structure and large specific surface area and pore volume, and can be used as a catalyst, a catalyst carrier and an adsorbent.

title_en: Method for preparing green light carbon quantum dots with ultrahigh fluorescence quantum yield by one-step hydrothermal method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing green light carbon quantum dots with ultrahigh fluorescence quantum yield by a one-step hydrothermal method and application thereof. Belongs to the field of nanometer material preparing technology and optoelectronics. The method comprises the steps of taking aqueous solution of rhodamine dye and strong alkali as precursors, transferring the precursor into a reaction kettle with para-polyphenol as a lining, carrying out hydrothermal reaction for a certain time at a certain temperature, and filtering the reaction product by a 0.22 mu m filter screen to obtain the green light carbon quantum dot with ultrahigh fluorescence quantum yield. The carbon quantum dot prepared by the invention has the fluorescence radiation center wavelength of 520nm and the particle size distribution of 3-5 nm, and has good stability and ultrahigh fluorescence quantum yield. The carbon quantum dot prepared by the method can be used as a laser gain medium to realize green laser radiation with a low threshold value, and can also be used as a probe molecule to realize detection of the pH value of a solution and heavy metal ions.

title_en: MEMS micro-mirror with high filling factor and manufacturing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a MEMS micro-mirror with high filling factor and a manufacturing method, wherein the micro-mirror comprises a micro-bridge structure arranged on a substrate, and the micro-bridge structure comprises a support and electric connecting column and a micro-bridge deck; the micro bridge deck is provided with a micro mirror surface, the micro mirror surface is electrically connected with the substrate through a supporting and electric connecting column, the supporting and electric connecting column is formed in a first groove, the first groove is formed in a first sacrificial layer, the first sacrificial layer is located between the substrate and the micro bridge deck, the supporting and electric connecting column comprises a conductor formed on part of the side wall surface of the first groove and a supporting body located on the inner side of the conductor, the micro mirror surface is electrically connected with the substrate through the conductor, the micro bridge deck is supported on the supporting body and the conductor, and the micro bridge structure is released through removing the first sacrificial layer. The invention can reduce the occupied area of the formed support and electric connection column in the micro mirror, thereby effectively increasing the area of the micro mirror surface and greatly improving the filling factor and the performance of the product.

title_en: Molybdenum heavy hammer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a molybdenum heavy hammer and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method sequentially comprises the following steps: step one: weighing a molybdenum source, a lanthanum source, an yttrium source and a cerium source according to a certain proportion, and carrying out mixing treatment and sieving treatment to obtain molybdenum alloy powder; step two: carrying out compression molding treatment on molybdenum alloy powder to obtain a pressed compact; step three: sintering the pressed compact at high temperature in a reducing atmosphere, an inert atmosphere or a vacuum condition to obtain a sintered compact; step four: and (3) carrying out lathe machining treatment on the sintered blank to obtain the molybdenum heavy hammer. Compared with the existing pure molybdenum heavy hammer, the molybdenum heavy hammer prepared by the method has fine and uniform crystal grains, high recrystallization temperature, high temperature strength and good deformation resistance.

title_en: Preparation method of metal nano-film electrode with high limiting working temperature
abstract_en: The application discloses a preparation method of a metal nano-film electrode with high limiting working temperature, which relates to the field of nano-film electrodes, the method prepares a metal nano-film with nano-scale thickness on the surface of a silicon wafer substrate by utilizing a multi-target electron beam evaporation coating instrument in a vacuum coating chamber, and then switching to an aluminum target material, and preparing an aluminum nano film with a preset nanoscale thickness on the surface of the metal nano film by utilizing the aluminum target material by utilizing a multi-target electron beam evaporation film plating instrument to prepare the metal nano film electrode. The aluminum nano film is stably adsorbed on the surface of the metal nano film at high temperature, and has controllable thickness, smooth surface and high bonding strength with the surface of the metal nano film. The aluminum oxide film formed by oxidizing the aluminum nano film in the air can effectively avoid high-temperature oxidation of the metal nano film, thereby being beneficial to improving the oxidation resistance of the metal nano film electrode and enabling the metal nano film electrode to have higher limiting working temperature.

title_en: Semiconductor structure and forming method thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides semiconductor structures and methods of forming the same. A semiconductor structure according to the present disclosure includes an active region having a channel region and a source/drain region, a gate structure over the channel region, a gate spacer layer disposed over the channel region and extending along sidewalls of the gate structure, an epitaxial source/drain feature over the source/drain region, a Contact Etch Stop Layer (CESL) disposed over the epitaxial source/drain feature and extending along sidewalls of the gate spacer layer, source/drain contacts disposed over the epitaxial drain/source feature, and a dielectric cap layer disposed over at least portions of the gate structure, the gate spacer layer, and the CESL. The sidewalls of the source/drain contacts are in direct contact with the sidewalls of the CESL.

title_en: Preparation method of semiconductor material supported nickel-based methanol electro-oxidation catalyst
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of electrocatalysts, and discloses a preparation method of a semiconductor material supported nickel-based methanol electro-oxidation catalyst, which comprises the following steps: the first step: with nickel nitrate hexahydrate (Ni- (NO)  3  )  2  ·6H  2  O) and terephthalic acid (1, 4-H)  2  BDC) is taken as a raw material to be dissolved in N, N-dimethylformamide, and uniformly dispersed small-particle Ni-MOF is synthesized by a hydrothermal method; and a second step of: takes melamine as raw material and is calcined in a muffle furnace to generate g-C  3  N  4  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the And a third step of: ni-MOF and g-C are taken out respectively  3  N  4  Adding ethanol for ultrasonic treatment, then adding Ni-MOF suspension into g-C3N4 solution for ultrasonic treatment,standing the ultrasonic suspension for one night to obtain upper liquid, extracting with dropper, drying the rest precipitate in vacuum oven, placing the dried powder into tube furnace, and calcining to obtain Ni-MOF-g-C  3  N  4  An electrocatalyst.

title_en: Preparation method of light-emitting device, light-emitting device and display device
abstract_en: The application discloses a preparation method of a light-emitting device, the light-emitting device and a display device, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of providing a prefabricated device, and applying a solution containing nano metal oxide on one side of the prefabricated device for forming an electron transport precursor layer; and in a preset time range, carrying out electrification treatment on the electron transport precursor layer so as to form an electron transport layer, thereby effectively improving the crystallinity, conductivity and stability of the sub-transport layer.

title_en: Method for preparing high-dispersion nano tin oxide powder by microwave method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tin oxide preparation, in particular to a method for preparing high-dispersion nano tin oxide powder by a microwave method. Which comprises the following steps: mixing stannic chloride with methanol to prepare a stannum solution, adding a stannum alloy into the stannum solution, and purifying to obtain a refined stannum product; heating and liquefying the refined tin product, heating by an electric arc to generate tin oxide steam, and cooling and crystallizing to obtain a granular product; adding the particle products into sodium hydroxide aqueous solution, stirring and mixing, and continuously heating by microwaves to obtain a sol intermediate; and performing ultrasonic dispersion on the sol intermediate, and performing gel drying and water removal on the sol intermediate to generate nano tin oxide powder. According to the invention, after refined tin is prepared, the tin oxide steam is prepared by an arc gasification reaction, and the microwave method is combined to rapidly heat in a short time, so that colloid particle agglomeration caused by long-time heating is avoided, and the agglomerated tin oxide particles can be shredded by combining ultrasonic dispersion, so that the tin oxide particles are uniformly dispersed.

title_en: Polyamine ligands for nanoparticle dissolution and ink compositions comprising nanoparticles capped with ligands
abstract_en: Ligand-terminated scattering nanoparticles, curable ink compositions comprising ligand-terminated scattering nanoparticles, and methods of forming films from the ink compositions are provided. Also provided are cured films formed by curing the ink compositions and photonic devices incorporating the films. The ligand bound to the inorganic scattering nanoparticle comprises a head group and a tail group. The head group includes a polyamine chain and binds the ligand to the nanoparticle surface. The tail group includes a polyalkylene oxide chain.

title_en: Ru-doped MoS for electrochemical synthesis of ammonia2Preparation method of base nano material
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of electrocatalytic energy storage, and aims to provide a preparation method of Ru-doped MoS  2  -based nano material for electrochemical ammonia synthesis. The method comprises the steps of adding ruthenium trichloride, sodium molybdate dihydrate and thioacetamide into a hydrothermal reaction kettle, uniformly mixing, reacting for 20 hours at 190 ℃, naturally cooling to room temperature, washing and drying reactants to obtain silver gray powder, namely the Ru doped MoS  2  -based nano material. The invention realizes the 2H phase-to-1T phase transformation of MoS  2  by doping Ru, optimizes the conductivity of the material, promotes the activation of N  2  and the bonding capability of NHx by the Ru-Mo-S coordination center, and further improves the activity of electrocatalytic reduction of N  2  into NH  3 . The Ru with the atomic-level dispersed atoms in the catalyst provided by the invention provides a large number of catalytic active sites, so that higher atom utilization rate is realized. The invention adopts a one-step hydrothermal method, and the precursor used has rich raw material reserves and low cost, and is suitable for large-scale industrialized production.

title_en: Carbon-based negative electrode current collector with lithium-philic limit structure, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: A carbon-based negative current collector with a lithium-philic limit structure, a preparation method and application thereof belong to the technical field of electrochemical energy. The preparation of the carbon-based negative electrode current collector comprises the following steps: cleaning the carbon substrate; heating in water bath in concentrated acid solution for activation; soaking in seed crystal source solution containing metal oxide and alkali, oven drying, and repeatedly soaking; immersing in a growth solution containing metal oxide and crystallization regulator, performing hydrothermal reaction to grow metal oxide on the carbon substrate, taking out, washing and drying; obtaining a metal oxide carbon substrate coated with a carbon precursor; carrying out pyrolysis treatment; and (3) acid etching part of the metal oxide to obtain the carbon-based negative electrode current collector with the lithium-philic limit domain structure. A battery assembled by adopting the three-dimensional carbon-based current collector is 1mA/cm  2  Is (1) the current of the (a)Density and 4mAh/cm  2  The average coulombic efficiency after 100 circles of circulation still can reach about 99.53 percent, and the circulation stability is better.

title_en: Nanometer pesticide and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of nano pesticides, and provides a nano pesticide and a preparation method thereof, wherein a small amount of lipoic acid modified fluorine-containing nonionic surfactant is added into the nano pesticide, so that the surface tension of the nano pesticide can be reduced to 24-36 mN/m, and high-efficiency cypermethrin is loaded in the nano pesticide, thereby overcoming the defect that the existing fluorine-containing surfactant cannot effectively load medicines, and ensuring that the encapsulation rate of the prepared nano pesticide reaches 90-96%, and the medicine loading rate reaches 10-22%, and having excellent slow release effect. The nano pesticide and the preparation method thereof provided by the application have the advantages of simple operation, short synthetic route, easy control of reaction conditions, easy industrial development and low cost, and add a new variety for selection in the fields of fluorine-containing surfactants and nano pesticides.

title_en: Mica nano-sheet slurry, preparation method thereof and mica nano-sheet
abstract_en: The invention relates to mica nano-sheet slurry, a preparation method thereof and mica nano-sheets. A process for preparing the mica nano-plate slurry includes such steps as mixing mica with polyhydroxy compound or polyhydroxy compound solution, ball grinding, ultrasonic and centrifugal. The mica nano-sheets in the mica nano-sheet slurry prepared by the preparation method have the effects of large sheet diameter, high quality and good dispersibility, and meanwhile, the preparation method is safe, simple, environment-friendly, low in cost, high in yield and easy for large-scale preparation.

title_en: Magnetic nanomaterial for targeted enrichment of proteins and protein sample processing method using magnetic nanomaterial
abstract_en: The application discloses a magnetic nanomaterial for targeted enrichment of proteins and a protein sample processing method using the magnetic nanomaterial, wherein the nanomaterial is of a shell-core structure, an inner core is a ferroferric oxide magnetic nanoparticle, namely a magnetic core, an outer shell is mesoporous titanium dioxide, the mesoporous titanium dioxide is coated on the surface of the magnetic core, the mesoporous titanium dioxide is provided with a plurality of nanopores and can be modified by molecular adhesives, the targeting proteins can be specifically combined, when a protein sample is processed, the magnetic nanomaterial is introduced into a complex biological sample containing proteins, nucleic acids and salts, the magnetic nanomaterial is selectively combined with target proteins, not only can the needed target proteins be separated, but also peptide fragments are obtained through digestion and elution, and the peptide fragments are used for acquisition and analysis of proteomics data.

title_en: Two-dimensional MEMS micro-mirror and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a two-dimensional MEMS micro-mirror and a preparation method thereof, wherein the two-dimensional MEMS micro-mirror comprises: a first SOI wafer; a second SOI wafer: etching annular movable teeth with a plurality of empty slots and torsion beams which are arranged in the empty slots and are vertically connected with the movable teeth on the second SOI wafer; the joint of the movable teeth and the torsion beam is provided with a round angle; third SOI wafer: etching upper static teeth with a plurality of second isolation grooves on the third SOI wafer; the second SOI wafer and the third SOI wafer are etched to form a micro-gap; bonding a first SOI wafer, a second S0I wafer and a third S0I wafer; the silicon device layer thickness of the first S0I wafer, the second SOI wafer and the third SOI wafer is 60 to 150 mu m; the invention realizes that three S0I bonding is adopted, the upper static teeth etched by the upper S0I are used for counteracting or relieving the self gravity of the micro mirror, the micro mirror can deflect strictly along a torsion shaft under the action of electrostatic force, and the micro mirror is designed into a round corner structure at the torsion beam position, so that the breakage of the torsion beam caused by stress concentration is prevented.

title_en: Fiber bundle loaded CuS nano-structure material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: A fiber bundle loaded CuS nano-structure material, a preparation method and application thereof, a, dissolving copper nitrate trihydrate and polyvinylpyrrolidone in absolute ethyl alcohol, and stirring uniformly to obtain a solution A; b. dissolving 1,3, 5-benzene tricarboxylic acid in anhydrous methanol, and uniformly stirring to obtain a solution B; c. slowly adding the solution B into the stirred solution A, continuously stirring for a certain time, standing at room temperature, cleaning the product with absolute methanol, and drying to obtain Cu-MOF; d. respectively dissolving Cu-MOF and thioacetamide in ethylene glycol, after ultrasonic treatment, mixing the two solutions, uniformly stirring, adding a certain amount of cetyltrimethylammonium bromide, ultrasonic treatment, transferring the solution and the base material into a stainless steel reaction kettle, taking out the base material after reaction, cleaning with ethanol, and drying to obtain the fiber bundle loaded CuS nano-structure material. According to the invention, the octahedral layered structure assembled by the CuS nanorods is constructed on the substrate, so that the electrochemical performance of the zinc ion battery is effectively improved.

title_en: Liposome-polymer nanoparticle loaded with melittin oncolytic peptide and adenosine A2AR receptor inhibitor, and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a liposome-polymer nanoparticle for co-carrying a bee venom oncolytic peptide and an adenosine A2AR receptor inhibitor, which is of a core-shell structure, wherein an amphiphilic cationic polymer is used as a carrier in an inner layer, the carrier is wrapped with the bee venom oncolytic peptide PalAno and the adenosine A2AR receptor inhibitor CPI-444, and a lipid bilayer connected with a CD44 targeting peptide A6 is used as an outer layer. The application also provides a preparation method of the liposome-polymer nanoparticle and application of the liposome-polymer nanoparticle in preparing medicaments for treating tumors. The application can specifically target triple negative breast cancer cells and melanoma cells, the bee venom oncolytic peptide PalAno can cause tumor cell lysis, activate the anti-tumor immune response of the organism, and CPI-444 is used for overcoming the immunosuppression caused by ATP metabolite adenosine in the oncolytic process. The application remodels the immunosuppression microenvironment while targeting oncolysis, thereby realizing the high-efficiency synergy of the two medicaments.

title_en: Preparation method and application of carbon quantum dot/reduced graphene oxide all-carbon material rich in topological defects
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of carbon material preparation, and relates to a preparation method and application of a carbon quantum dot/reduced graphene oxide all-carbon material rich in topological defects, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of (1) preparing carbon quantum dots rich in pentagon topological defects, (2) preparing carbon quantum dots/reduced graphene oxide aerogel rich in topological defects, and (3) preparing a carbon quantum dot/reduced graphene oxide all-carbon material rich in topological defects. The invention is thatThe prepared target material carbon quantum dot/reduced graphene oxide all-carbon material rich in topological defects has rich pentagonal topological defects, and the catalytic performance of undoped graphene can be effectively improved. In addition, the target material carbon quantum dot/reduced graphene oxide all-carbon material rich in topological defects shows higher I compared with a commercially available Pt electrode  3   ‑  The catalytic activity is a material with wide application prospect in the field of dye-sensitized solar cells.

title_en: Composite current collector and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of lithium ion batteries, in particular to a composite current collector, a preparation method and application thereof. The method can solve the problems that in the prior art, the peeling strength between a current collector and an anode membrane is not large, and the long-term cycle life of a battery is influenced, and can avoid the breakage of a metal layer of a pole piece in the rolling process.

title_en: Responsive tebuconazole nano-particles and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses response tebuconazole nano-particles, a preparation method and application thereof, and particularly relates to the technical field of pesticides. The preparation method comprises the following steps: dissolving tebuconazole and a segmented copolymer PDMAEMA-b-PCL into an organic solvent respectively to obtain a No. 1 stream; ultrapure water is used as a No. 2 stream; injecting the No. 1 stream and the No. 2 stream into a mixer at the same time to rapidly mix in a mixing cavity to obtain a mixed solution; dialyzing the mixed solution in ultrapure water for 24 hours to obtain the responsive tebuconazole nano-particles. The application of the tebuconazole nanoparticles is the application of the responsive tebuconazole nanoparticles in killing crop fungi. The application prepares the nano particles by encapsulating the active ingredient tebuconazole by using the segmented copolymer PDMAEMA-b-PCL, improves the water dispersibility and the light stability of the tebuconazole, and enhances the wettability and the adhesion capability to the blade due to the small-size effect, the high specific surface area and the electrostatic interaction of the tebuconazole nano particles.

title_en: Nanometer precipitated high-strength steel with excellent CSP production line forming performance and production method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production method of nano precipitated high-strength steel with excellent forming performance of a CSP production line, which is produced by a thin slab continuous casting and rolling process, and comprises the following specific steps of 1) smelting in a converter, then entering an LF furnace for single refining treatment, and alloying treatment in the refining process; 2) carrying out continuous casting and rolling production of a thin slab by molten steel, heating a casting blank in a soaking furnace, then rolling in a frame finishing mill, 3) carrying out laminar cooling, 4) coiling steel coils, adopting a head-tail U cooling process aiming at steel coils with thickness specification less than or equal to 2.5mm, and 5) carrying out concentrated stacking slow cooling in a steel coil warehouse after the steel coils are taken off line. The nano precipitated high-strength steel has the physical properties of yield strength of more than or equal to 700MPa, tensile strength of more than or equal to 785MPa, elongation of more than or equal to 20%, hole expansion rate of more than or equal to 60% and thickness of 1.2-4.5 mm, and has high strength and excellent forming property.

title_en: Method for growing MXene material by molten salt method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for growing an MXene material by a molten salt method and application thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps of mixing transition metal simple substance powder and X source powder with medium salt, heating the mixture until the medium salt is molten to form a molten mixture, reacting the molten mixture with gaseous raw materials at a preset reaction temperature to obtain the MXene material, wherein the gaseous raw materials comprise transition metal halide salt and/or halogen gas, the X source powder is one or more of carbon source, carbon-nitrogen source and nitrogen source, the carbon source is selected from carbon material, the carbon-nitrogen source is selected from carbon nitride, melamine, dicyandiamide and urea, the nitrogen source is boron nitride, and the medium salt is selected from alkali metal halide salt and/or alkaline earth metal halide salt. The method can be carried out at relatively reduced synthesis temperature in an open system, thereby reducing the reaction synthesis temperature, reducing the synthesis energy consumption, simplifying the vapor phase growth process and providing a new technical path for the efficient preparation of the MXene material.

title_en: Fluorescent carbon quantum dot probe based on seven-membered cucurbituril, and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fluorescent carbon quantum dot probe based on seven-membered cucurbituril, and preparation and application thereof. The fluorescent carbon quantum dot probe based on the seven-membered cucurbituril is prepared by taking the seven-membered cucurbituril and 2, 2-bis (hydroxymethyl) propionic acid as raw materials. The fluorescent carbon quantum dot probe can realize fluorescence identification of histamine, and has the characteristics of rapid detection, low equipment requirement, accurate detection result, strong selectivity and high sensitivity; in addition, the preparation method of the optical carbon quantum dot probe is simple and low in cost.

title_en: Method for preparing five-membered ring and eight-membered ring-containing graphene-like nanoribbon on surface
