abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing a graphene-like nanoribbon containing five-membered rings and eight-membered rings on the surface, which comprises the steps of carrying out circular argon etching annealing treatment on the surface of a metal single crystal to obtain a clean and flat surface, respectively depositing a certain amount of 2, 5-dibromo-3, 4-diphenyl thiophene molecules on the surface of the metal at room temperature to obtain a metal substrate with a partially debrominated organic metal dimer, carrying out multi-step annealing on the metal substrate, and finally annealing at a specific temperature to form the graphene-like nanoribbon containing the five-membered rings and the eight-membered rings. Compared with the pure six-membered ring graphene nanoribbon, the product has more special and complex electrical and magnetic properties, and the method shows an effective way for adjusting the electronic properties of the carbon-based nanostructure by embedding the non-six-membered ring so as to realize the required functions.

title_en: Nanoparticle, preparation method thereof, light-emitting diode and display device
abstract_en: The application discloses a preparation method of nano particles, which comprises the following steps: mixing unsaturated acid with an antioxidant to obtain an unsaturated acid solution; dissolving a metal compound in a first solvent to obtain a metal compound solution; mixing the unsaturated acid solution with the metal compound solution to obtain a metal precursor solution; and injecting an anion source precursor solution into the metal precursor solution, and curing to obtain a nanoparticle solution, wherein the nanoparticle solution comprises nanoparticles. In the preparation method of the nano particles, the unsaturated acid and the antioxidant are mixed to obtain the unsaturated acid solution, and then the unsaturated acid solution is added into the metal compound solution, so that the metal cations in the metal compound can be prevented from reducing the activity of the antioxidant, and the stability of the prepared nano particles is improved. In addition, the application also discloses a nanoparticle, a light emitting diode and a display device.

title_en: Color-adjustable nano rare earth anti-counterfeiting fluorescent powder and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a color-adjustable nano rare earth anti-counterfeiting fluorescent powder and a preparation method thereof, which are applied to the technical field of fluorescent powder preparation and comprise the following steps: s1, weighing quantitative terbium oxide, europium oxide and yttrium oxide, and placing the terbium oxide, the europium oxide and the yttrium oxide into a container 1:1, heating and stirring the solution A by using a constant-temperature magnetic stirrer until terbium oxide, europium oxide and yttrium oxide are completely dissolved, evaporating the nitric acid in the solution A, and waiting for the solution A to be cooled and crystallized into a reactant A.

title_en: Waterproof carbon quantum dot matrix composite phosphorescence material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a water-resistant carbon quantum dot matrix composite phosphorescent material and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of phosphorescent luminescent materials. The preparation method comprises the following steps: and mixing a carbon source with urea, performing hydrothermal reaction, and collecting solids after the reaction is finished to obtain the water-resistant carbon quantum dot matrix composite phosphorescence material. The carbon source is a compound obtained by substituting at least one hydrogen atom on a benzene ring with a boric acid group and a chromophoric group, and is preferably 3-aminophenylboric acid. The water-resistant carbon quantum dot matrix composite phosphorescence material prepared by the method can generate blue phosphorescence which lasts for about 40s after being irradiated by ultraviolet light of 275nm, the service life can reach more than 2s, cyanuric acid crystals are formed on the surface of a carbon dot material, molecular vibration of carbon dots can be restrained, quenching of dissolved oxygen in water is effectively isolated, and therefore good phosphorescence performance can be maintained in water.

title_en: Preparation method of immune electrochemical sensor for detecting content of di (2-ethylhexyl) phthalate
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of an immune electrochemical sensor for detecting the content of di (2-ethylhexyl) phthalate, which comprises the following steps: preparing a metal selenide by adopting a hydrothermal synthesis method, preparing a bimetal sandwich nano-box by adopting a two-step synthesis method, preparing a metal selenide/bimetal sandwich nano-box composite material by adopting an aminated metal selenide and bimetal sandwich nano-box by adopting a water bath shaking method, and modifying the prepared metal selenide/bimetal sandwich nano-box composite material and an artificial antigen on a gold electrode by covalent bonding to obtain a metal selenide/bimetal sandwich nano-box/artificial antigen/gold electrode; the method comprises the steps of preparing a two-dimensional prismatic metal material by adopting a seed-mediated growth method, growing bimetallic nano particles on the surface of the metal material in situ by utilizing a reducing agent to prepare bimetallic particles @ the two-dimensional prismatic metal material, preparing a signal probe by adopting a chemical bonding method by adopting a signal molecule, an artificial antibody and the bimetallic particles @ the two-dimensional prismatic metal material, incubating in vitro to obtain a mixed solution of the signal probe and a target object, and indicating the content of di (2-ethylhexyl) phthalate in a sample by response signal change of the signal molecule to obtain the immune electrochemical sensor for detecting the di (2-ethylhexyl) phthalate. Compared with other methods for detecting the content of the di (2-ethylhexyl) phthalate, the prepared immune electrochemical sensor has higher sensitivity and accuracy and good repeatability and selectivity.

title_en: Pharmaceutical carrier, preparation method thereof and application thereof in disease treatment
abstract_en: The invention provides a drug carrier capable of efficiently targeting macrophages, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in disease treatment. The drug carrier comprises bacterial biological vesicles, wherein drug macromolecules are loaded in the bacterial biological vesicles, and two targeting elements, namely an element for targeting and identifying tumor tissues and an element for targeting and identifying macrophages are modified on the surface of the drug carrier. In the process of producing the bacterial bio-vesicles through physical extrusion, the loading of the internal drug macromolecules and the modification process of the surface targeting elements are completed, so that the loading and delivery efficiency of the drugs is improved. Meanwhile, the yield of the bacterial biological vesicle is hundreds of times that of the bacterial exocrine vesicle under the same condition. Since the drug macromolecules are produced endogenously by bacteria, selection of the appropriate engineered bacteria will allow for continuous expression of the desired drug. The drug carrier provides a new choice for the current treatment of tumors, and can be used for treating malignant tumors including breast cancer and colorectal cancer.

title_en: Method for preparing extremely small ferric oxide nano particles rich in oxygen vacancies in batch
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing extremely small ferric oxide nano particles rich in oxygen vacancies in batches, which is based on a magneto-thermal loss mechanism of an iron target, combines water-cooling magneto-induced internal heating and a laser liquid phase ablation method, introduces a high-frequency alternating magnetic field effect in the laser liquid phase ablation process, so that iron atoms on the surface of the iron target are in a severe oscillation state, and iron vapor is easier to form under laser irradiation, thereby improving the yield of the nano particles.

title_en: High-quantum-yield tetraphenyl-phosphonium-based fluorescent nanocomposite, preparation method thereof and application thereof in white light LED lamp
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of high quantum yield tetraphenyl ethylene onium salt/polyoxometallate fluorescent nano material and application thereof in a white light LED lamp, and the novel fluorescent nano material with the characteristic of environmental friendliness is conveniently and rapidly prepared through self-assembly of a tetraphenyl ethylene derivative TPE-1 and polyoxometallate EuW  10  in an aqueous solution. The fluorescent material has good luminescence property, the fluorescence quantum yield is 39.88%, and the fluorescence quantum yield is improved by 2.18 times compared with the original TPE-1. And the fluorescent powder which emits white light at 365nm can be obtained by mixing the fluorescent powder with commercial fluorescent powder with low dosage, and can be used for manufacturing LED lamps.

title_en: Preparation method of chromium-doped graphene
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of graphene carbon materials, in particular to a preparation method of chromium-doped graphene. The invention provides a preparation method of chromium-doped graphene, which comprises the following steps: mixing a chromium source, a carbon source and magnesium to obtain a mixture; and in a protective atmosphere, carrying out combustion synthesis reaction on the mixture to obtain the chromium-doped graphene. The invention takes the chromium source as the raw material, realizes the low-cost mass preparation of the chromium doped graphene through the combustion synthesis method, and has the characteristics of simple operation, adjustable chromium doping amount, uniform chromium element distribution, easy batch production and high product quality.

title_en: K (K) 2-x Mn 8 O 16 Preparation method of superfine nanowire and zinc storage application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a K  2‑x  Mn  8  O  16  The preparation method of the superfine nanowire and the application of the superfine nanowire in zinc storage specifically comprise the following steps: step 1: adding manganese dioxide into deionized water, stirring, adding potassium carbonate, and continuously stirring to obtain a mixed solution; wherein, the mass ratio of the potassium carbonate to the manganese dioxide is 1: (5-10); step 2: transferring the mixed solution obtained in the step 1 into an autoclave, and reacting for 12-72 h at 200-300 ℃; step 3: and (3) cleaning the product obtained in the step (2) with water and ethanol, and drying to obtain the superfine nanowire. The method realizes the regulation and control of the morphology structure of the manganese-based anode material, so that the prepared material has better electrochemical zinc storage performance.

title_en: Bi-component nitrogen-phosphorus-potassium-calcium compound fertilizer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bi-component nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium and calcium compound fertilizer and a preparation method thereof, wherein the raw materials of the compound fertilizer comprise a solid phase component and a liquid phase component; the solid phase component comprises nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium and calcium precipitates, and the liquid phase component comprises phytic acid solution or phosphoric acid solution. The solid-liquid bi-component nitrogen-phosphorus-potassium-calcium compound fertilizer prepared by the invention has adjustable nitrogen-phosphorus-potassium-calcium element proportion, the solid phase component is micro-nano particles, and the solid phase component and the liquid phase component can be quickly and uniformly dispersed in water after being mixed, thereby being convenient for application and plant absorption and utilization.

title_en: Method for constructing chiral hierarchical porous nano structure containing triazine group on surface
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a chiral hierarchical porous nano structure containing triazine groups on the surface, which comprises the following steps: depositing TCT molecules on the clean Cu (111) surface at room temperature to obtain a metal substrate with TCT molecules; and carrying out heating annealing treatment on the metal substrate to obtain the chiral hierarchical porous nano structure with high coverage rate. The triazine group-containing chiral hierarchical porous nano structure obtained by controlling the annealing temperature has the advantages of large area and single product, and is a potential CO  2  The candidate material is trapped, and can be applied to the fields of environmental management and gas monitoring; in addition, the chiral molecule separation can be realized due to the chiral recognition functionTherefore, the method has wide application prospect in the chiral separation field. More importantly, the preparation process adopted by the method is simple and controllable, few in byproducts and high in reaction rate of reactants on the surface, and the waste of raw materials can be effectively reduced.

title_en: Electrode surface hydrophobic LED chip and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electrode surface hydrophobic LED chip and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of semiconductor devices, wherein the LED chip comprises a substrate, an N-type semiconductor layer, a light-emitting layer and a P-type semiconductor layer which are sequentially laminated on the substrate, an N-type electrode arranged on the N-type semiconductor layer, and a P-type electrode arranged on the P-type semiconductor layer; the surface of one side of the N-type electrode, which is far away from the N-type semiconductor layer, is provided with a first nano hydrophobic layer, one side of the P-type electrode, which is far away from the P-type semiconductor layer, is provided with a second nano hydrophobic layer, and the passivation layer is arranged on the surface of the LED chip and exposes the first nano hydrophobic layer and the second nano hydrophobic layer. The invention aims to improve the surface hydrophobicity of the electrode of the LED chip, so as to avoid metal migration on the surface of the electrode, prolong the service life of the LED chip and ensure the connection stability of the LED chip and a circuit board.

title_en: Photosensitizer and TNTP-rapamycin carrier-free self-assembled nano platform and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a photosensitizer and TNTP-rapamycin carrier-free self-assembled nano platform, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the photosensitizer TNTP is used as a novel photosensitizer for establishing a TNTP-rapamycin carrier-free self-assembled nano platform, TNTP and a small molecular anticancer drug rapamycin with poor water solubility are integrated into the same nano platform, so that the cooperation of PDT and chemotherapy is realized, the limitation of monotherapy is overcome, the method is a very promising combined treatment strategy, in vitro experiments prove that the photosensitizer can be taken by cells well, and compared with the single TNTP self-assembled nano platform, TNTP-Ra NPs combined photodynamic therapy and chemotherapy have enhanced anticancer effect.

title_en: Luminescent composite nano material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a luminescent composite nanomaterial and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the luminescent composite nanomaterial comprises carbon quantum dots with carboxyl modified surfaces and long afterglow nanoparticles with amino modified surfaces; the carbon quantum dots with carboxyl groups modified on the surfaces are connected with the long afterglow nano particles with amino groups modified on the surfaces through amide bonds; the saidThe molecular formula of the long afterglow nano particles is Zn  2  GeO  4  :Mn  2+  Wherein Zn  2+  With Mn  2+  The molar ratio of (3) is 95-99.5: 0.5-5; the mass ratio of the long afterglow nano particles with the amino groups modified on the surfaces to the carbon quantum dots with the carboxyl groups modified on the surfaces is 1 (1-3). According to the luminescent composite nanomaterial, under the excitation wavelength of 350-400 nm, 440-500 nm has a blue light emission peak; under the excitation wavelength of 250-260 nm, 530-560 nm has green light emission peak, can be applied to the fields of anti-counterfeiting, fluorescent imaging and temperature sensing, has simple preparation process and low cost, and is beneficial to realizing industrialized mass production.

title_en: Laser etched PVDF micro-nano structure ultrafiltration membrane and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a PVDF micro-nano structure ultrafiltration membrane etched by laser and a preparation method thereof, comprising the steps of reacting polyvinylidene fluoride with organic base to introduce conjugated double bonds, thus obtaining modified polyvinylidene fluoride; respectively adding modified polyvinylidene fluoride, carboxylated graphene oxide powder, a catalyst, a plasticizer and a pore-forming agent into dimethylacetamide solution, uniformly mixing to obtain composite base film casting solution, adding alcohol-water solution for phase conversion to obtain a modified polyvinylidene fluoride ultrafiltration film, performing laser etching, immersing the laser etched modified polyvinylidene fluoride ultrafiltration film into a hydrophilic solution, and/or spraying hydrophilic polymer on the surface of the laser etched modified polyvinylidene fluoride ultrafiltration film to obtain the target ultrafiltration film. Compared with the prior art, the method for preparing the PVDF ultrafiltration membrane by laser etching has obvious beneficial effects in the aspects of improving hydrophilicity, improving separation efficiency, increasing stability, reducing energy consumption, protecting environment and sustainability and the like, and brings remarkable innovation and progress to the technical field of membrane separation.

title_en: Anatase phase VTiO 4 Is prepared by the preparation method of (2)
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of lithium ion storage materials, and in particular relates to an anatase phase VTiO  4  Preparation method 1 of (a) and precursor VTiCT    x    Adding lithium fluoride into a hydrochloric acid aqueous solution to obtain a reactant, and adding VTiAlC powder into the reactant to react to obtain a reactant; 2. precursor VTiCT    x    Preparing nanosheet suspension, centrifugally washing reactants, sequentially using dilute hydrochloric acid solution, lithium chloride aqueous solution, ethanol solution and deionized water, centrifugally washing at high speed, and collecting the suspension at low speed to obtain VTiCT    x    Nanosheet suspension; 3. anatase phase VTiO  4  For VTiCT preparation    x    Concentrating the suspension by high-speed centrifugation, concentrating, preparing reactant in a reaction kettle, and vacuum drying to obtain the final productTitanium ore phase VTiO  4  . As a lithium ion storage electrode material, the lithium ion storage electrode material has the advantages of high mass specific capacitance, excellent rate performance, long cycle life and the like.

title_en: Preparation method of artificial hydrogenase and rapid hydrogen production process
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of artificial hydrogenase and a rapid hydrogen production process under the condition of no energy consumption. The preparation of NiFe with hydrogenase activity by nickel nitrate and ferric nitrate  2  S  4  Nanometer mimic enzyme or nickel nitrate and cobalt nitrate are adopted to prepare NiCo with hydrogenase activity  2  O  4  The nanometer mimic enzyme is used for simulating the natural hydrogenase to produce hydrogen. The prepared artificial hydrogenase is applied to catalyzing rapid hydrogen of aluminum and water reaction. The preparation method of the artificial hydrogenase provided by the invention is simple, and the provided hydrogen production technology has no energy consumption and does not need specific arrangementPreparing; after water is added, the reaction can be carried out spontaneously at normal temperature and normal pressure, and no extra energy source is needed to be provided; the reaction product is only hydrogen, the problem of separation and purification with oxygen which is difficult to realize is avoided, and the hydrogen production efficiency is high.

title_en: Method for preparing high-purity ultra-nano diamond coating
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for preparing a high-purity ultra-nano diamond coating, belonging to the technical field of metal processing. It solves the problem of low purity of the existing preparation of the ultra-nano diamond coating. The method for preparing the high-purity ultra-nano diamond coating comprises hot wires which are arranged in parallel at high density, wherein the growth process of the diamond coating on hot wire chemical vapor deposition equipment is divided into four sections, which are respectively as follows: generating the ultra-nano diamond in a short time by adopting a high-carbon argon-rich hydrogen-depleted condition; blowing and impacting the ultra-nano diamond generated in the first section by adopting pure hydrogen, and increasing secondary nucleation points; adding boron atoms outside the high-carbon argon-rich hydrogen-deficient condition to improve the secondary nucleation density, and forming a boronized ultra-nano diamond layer in the section; and the pure hydrogen is blown to impact the ultra-nano diamond generated in the third section, so that the secondary nucleation point is increased. The invention has the advantages of improving the purity and secondary nucleation rate of the ultra-nano diamond coating and preparing the ultra-nano diamond coating with high purity.

title_en: Fingerprint sensor with electrostatic protection
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fingerprint sensors, in particular to a fingerprint sensor with electrostatic protection, which is characterized by comprising the following components: the COG fingerprint chip comprises an induction chip and an IC chip, wherein the induction chip is used for collecting fingerprint signals, and the IC chip is used for processing the fingerprint signals collected by the induction chip; the circuit board is electrically connected with the COG fingerprint chip; the anti-static structure is arranged on the contact surface of the induction chip and consists of a continuous and uniform conductive network formed by single-wall carbon nanotubes and multi-wall carbon nanotubes, and the thickness of the anti-static structure is less than or equal to 500nm, and the square resistance is less than or equal to 500 omega/☐. The fingerprint sensor has strong electrostatic protection capability and high identification sensitivity.

title_en: High-sensitivity cholesterol quantitative detection method
abstract_en: The application discloses a high-sensitivity cholesterol quantitative detection method, which belongs to the technical field of nanopore sensing. Under the double-enzyme catalytic reaction, the product of the cholesterol is used for carrying out etching reaction on Jin Zhui nano particles, the surface morphology of the nano particles is regulated and controlled by the priority of the etching reaction, the single-particle level detection of the nano particle product with the size change is carried out through a solid nano pore sensor, and the quantitative detection of the cholesterol concentration by the nano pore sensor is realized by analyzing the difference of the characteristics of electric signals generated by nano particles with different morphologies; according to the characteristic of cholesterol, an enzyme cascade reaction system is designed, and the nano particles are combined to serve as amplifying carriers to convert the concentration change of cholesterol into the detection of the single-particle level morphology change of gold nano cones, so that the detection of cholesterol biological metabolism small molecules by large-size solid nano holes is realized; the quantitative determination of the cholesterol level in the serum sample can be realized without any labeling and complex sample treatment, and the kit has good specificity and extremely high sensitivity.

title_en: Hydrothermal directional doped MnCu x Composite oxide and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a hydrothermal directional doped MnCu  x  A composite oxide and a preparation method and application thereof belong to the technical field of inorganic synthetic chemistry. MnCu of the present invention  x  The structural formula of the composite oxide is shown as formula I: the invention also provides a hydrothermal directional doped MnCu  x  The preparation method of the composite oxide comprises the steps of reacting potassium permanganate with copper nitrate under the action of citric acid under the hydrothermal condition, and then heating and calcining to obtain MnCu  x  A composite oxide. The invention also provides the hydrothermal directional doped MnCu  x  The composite oxide is used as a catalyst. MnCu of the present invention  x  The composite oxide has high chemical and VOCs elimination activity, stability and reusability.

title_en: Low-alloying non-rare earth type high-strength magnesium alloy and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A low-alloying non-rare earth type high-strength magnesium alloy and a preparation method thereof are provided, wherein the mass percentages of the chemical components are as follows: 0.3-1.5wt% of Cu, 0.7-2.0wt% of Al, 0.1-0.7wt% of Ca, 0.2-0.8wt% of Mn, and the balance of Mg and unavoidable impurities. Through material preparation and smeltingPouring and introducing alloying element into magnesium, further heat-treating, cutting and deforming to obtain nano-scale Mg in situ  2  Cu, mgAlCu phase, mg  2  Ca phase, al-Mn phase and Mn particles, a large amount of ultrafine grain structures are regulated and controlled simultaneously, and a large amount of solute segregation structures are constructed at the grain boundary and subgrain boundary. The total content of alloy elements is not more than 5wt%, the yield strength can reach 518MPa, and meanwhile, the alloy has good plasticity, so that the non-rare earth type high-strength magnesium alloy with excellent mechanical properties is obtained.

title_en: Multifunctional sensor and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a multifunctional sensor and a preparation method thereof, wherein the sensor comprises a substrate, a peripheral circuit, a temperature-sensitive unit, a humidity-sensitive unit, a pressure-sensitive unit and a heating unit; the temperature-sensitive unit is arranged on the substrate and is electrically connected with the peripheral circuit through a first electrode group connected with the temperature-sensitive unit; the humidity-sensitive unit is arranged on the substrate and is electrically connected with the peripheral circuit through a second electrode group connected with the humidity-sensitive unit; the heating unit surrounds the humidity-sensitive unit and is arranged on the substrate, and is electrically connected with the peripheral circuit through a third electrode group connected with the heating unit; the pressure-sensitive unit surrounds the heating unit and is arranged on the substrate, and is electrically connected with the peripheral circuit through a fourth electrode group connected with the pressure-sensitive unit. The multifunctional sensor provided by the invention has the advantages that the humidity-sensitive unit can rapidly remove the condensed water under the low-temperature high-humidity condition, so that the normal operation of the sensor is ensured, and the response speed of the sensor is improved.

title_en: Metal oxide composite conductive film and application thereof in preparation of heterojunction solar cell
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of solar cells, and particularly discloses a metal oxide composite conductive film and application thereof in preparing heterojunction solar cells, wherein the metal oxide composite conductive film comprises a conductive layer, a metal oxide layer and a protective layer which are sequentially arranged; the conductive layer is a mixed layer of modified graphene, a phosphorus-doped silver nanowire solution and metal oxide; the chemical stability, the thermal stability, the electric conductivity and the photoelectric property of the composite conductive film can be effectively improved, wherein the modified graphene, the phosphorus-doped silver nanowire solution and the metal oxide form a compact conductive network, the dispersibility of the modified graphene and the phosphorus-doped silver nanowire solution in a system is good, the agglomeration phenomenon can not occur, the electric conductivity and the photoelectric property are further effectively improved, the photoelectric conversion efficiency is effectively improved, and the composite conductive film has a wide application prospect.

title_en: Molybdenum disulfide/europium composite fluorescent probe and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: A molybdenum disulfide/europium composite fluorescent probe and a preparation method and application thereof belong to the field of rare earth fluorescent materials and the field of oxytetracycline analysis and detection, and the specific scheme is as follows: the molybdenum disulfide/europium composite fluorescent probe is a molybdenum disulfide nanosheet europium-doped composite, and the composite shows that Eu  2 O 3  is uniformly coated on a sheet-shaped MoS  2  nanosheet on a microstructure. The preparation method comprises the steps of adding an L-cysteine aqueous solution into a Na  2 MoO 4  solution, performing ultrasonic dispersion to obtain a solution A, dispersing Eu  2 O 3  in water to obtain a solution B, mixing the solution A and the solution B, performing hydrothermal reaction, cooling, and centrifuging to obtain a supernatant which is the molybdenum disulfide/europium composite fluorescent probe. The probe has the advantages of simple preparation, good selectivity, low detection limit, wide linear range and the like, and can effectively overcome the interference of external environmental factors on detection results.

title_en: Ovalbumin loaded nitro-radical oxynitride nanocomposite and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ovalbumin-loaded nitro-radical nitrogen oxide nanocomposite and a preparation method and application thereof. Belonging to the technical field of material preparation. The nitro radical nitrogen oxide nano composite material has regular shape, average grain diameter of 100nm-150nm and good dispersivity. The preparation method comprises the following steps: dissolving chitosan and tetramethylpiperidine-nitrogen oxide in water and dichloromethane or dimethyl sulfoxide respectively, stirring to dissolve completely, mixing, dialyzing after the reaction is finished, washing with ultrapure water after the dialysis is finished, centrifuging, and dispersing in ultrapure water. In addition, the ovalbumin is loaded on the nitro radical nitroxide nanocomposite, so that the immunogenicity of the nanocomposite can be endowed. The material prepared by the method has a nuclear magnetic resonance imaging enhancement effect and potential as an immunoadjuvant.

title_en: Dual-mode nanocapsule and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A method for preparing a bimodal nanocapsule, comprising: preparing mesoporous silica and deionized water into a solution, adding chloroauric acid solution, stirring and mixing, and then adding sodium borohydride solution under ice bath stirring condition for reaction to obtain gold nanoparticle modified mesoporous silica; preparing a solvent by using ultrapure water as a solvent and gold nanoparticle modified mesoporous silica, and sequentially adding a fluorescence quenching agent, fluorescent molecules and 4-mercaptophenylboronic acid to react respectively to obtain a bimolecular modified nano probe; and mixing the adenosine-5' -triphosphate aptamer solution with a nano probe to react by taking ultrapure water as a solvent, so as to obtain the aptamer-encapsulated dual-mode nano capsule. The preparation method is simple, mild in reaction, environment-friendly and low in production cost. The dual-mode nanocapsule prepared by the invention can simultaneously monitor the content of hydrogen peroxide and adenosine 5' -triphosphate (ATP) in cells by utilizing fluorescence and Surface Enhanced Raman Scattering (SERS) technology, so as to be used for early disease monitoring.

title_en: Silicon oxide supported iridium catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a silicon oxide supported iridium catalyst, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the size of the catalyst is 50-500nm, the surface of the catalyst is iridium nano particles, and the electrical conductivity of the catalyst is 0.05-1S cm  ‑1  The mass of the iridium nanoparticles accounts for 10-60wt% of the total mass of the catalyst. The silicon oxide supported iridium catalyst has large specific surface areaThe anode has good conductivity and simple preparation method, and is particularly suitable for an anode oxygen evolution reaction system of an electrolytic water technology.

title_en: Calcium-sheet-shaped Cu 2 S-Ni 7 S 6 Composite anode material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a calcium tablet Cu  2  S‑Ni  7  S  6  The preparation method and application of the composite anode material comprise the following steps: putting foam nickel, foam copper and copper sheets into thiourea mixed solution prepared from absolute ethyl alcohol and deionized water, and performing solvothermal reaction to obtain foam nickel as a nickel source and foam copper and copper sheets as copper sources, wherein under thiourea etching, nickel ions and copper ions enter the solution to combine with sulfur ions to generate copper sheet-loaded calcium sheet-shaped Cu  2  S‑Ni  7  S  6  A complex. The composite has unique and novel three-dimensional layered composite structure, wherein the lower layer is a calcium sheet-shaped nano-belt array with rough surface, and the upper layer is coral-shaped morphology composed of a large number of particles. Due to Cu  2  S and Ni  7  S  6  Is a synergistic effect and heterojunction of the composite anode material at 10mA cm  ‑2  The time-area specific capacitance is as high as 22.18F cm  ‑2  At 100mA cm  ‑2  At 19.08F cm  ‑2  At a high current density of 100mA cm  ‑2  The lower cycle is 500 times, the initial capacitance value is maintained at 276%, the cycle stability is outstanding, and the method is expected to be widely applied to super capacitors and even other energy storage devices.

title_en: Method and device for coupling and increasing value and co-producing chlorine-containing plastic and red mud and fixing chlorine
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field related to solid waste treatment, and discloses a method for coupling and value-added co-production of chlorine-containing plastics and red mud and chlorine fixation, which comprises (i) a coupling pyrolysis step, wherein the chlorine-containing plastics and the red mud are subjected to co-pyrolysis and react to obtain solid residues and dechlorinated volatile matters; the method comprises the steps of (i) synthesizing a chlorine-resistant catalyst, wherein solid residues are used as a catalyst carrier, and synthesizing a catalyst with a chlorine-resistant effect, (ii) a value-added co-production step, wherein dechlorinated volatile components and the chlorine-resistant catalyst are jointly sent to a fluidized bed reactor, fully react and perform gas-solid separation, so that the value-added co-production of a final product comprising carbon nano tubes, hydrogen-rich gas, pyrolysis oil and ferric chloride is realized. The invention also discloses a corresponding device. The invention can effectively solve the problems of incomplete plastic degradation, low red mud recycling efficiency, chlorine and chloride pollution, high catalyst cost, easy inactivation, low product added value and the like, and realize the synergistic degradation and continuous value-increasing co-production.

title_en: Continuous synthesis method of copper sulfide nanosheets
abstract_en: The invention discloses a continuous synthesis method of copper sulfide nano-sheets, which belongs to the technical field of nano-material synthesis, and comprises the steps of respectively preparing copper salt-polyethylenimine mixed solution, ascorbic acid solution and sulfur-ethanol solution, simultaneously and continuously conveying the three solutions into a preheated continuous reactor which is filled with water and is stirred by a peristaltic pump, controlling the reaction time, finally obtaining copper sulfide nano-sheet suspension, and obtaining copper sulfide nano-sheet powder through centrifugal separation, deionized water and ethanol cleaning and drying. The copper sulfide nano-sheet synthesized by the method has the advantages of single appearance, uniform size, easy regulation and control and good dispersion. The method has the characteristics of simple operation, low requirement on equipment, short synthesis time, mild reaction conditions and the like, realizes continuous preparation of the copper sulfide nanosheets, and is beneficial to large-scale preparation.

title_en: Neodymium oxide and indium oxide composite porous nano rod material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a neodymium oxide and indium oxide composite porous nano rod material, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the neodymium oxide and indium oxide composite porous nano rod material comprises an indium oxide porous nano rod and a neodymium oxide layer loaded on the surface of the indium oxide porous nano rod; the indium oxide porous nanorods are assembled by indium oxide nanoparticles. The neodymium oxide indium oxide composite porous nano rod material prepared by the invention is formed by stacking a large number of nano particles, and the unique microscopic morphology characteristics of the indium oxide nano rod material are utilized to obviously increase the specific surface area and the gas diffusion path of the material, so that the sensitivity and the recognition capability of the material to H  2  S gas are improved.

title_en: Preparation method of three-dimensional architecture allyl carbon composite powder
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a three-dimensional architecture allyl carbon composite powder, which comprises the following steps: s1, mixing a catalyst and a carbon sphere precursor in hydrochloric acid to complete the configuration of a reaction solution; s2, stirring and mixing the reaction solution and graphene powder to obtain a mixed solution, and placing the mixed solution into an oven for reaction to obtain a carbon sphere-graphene combination; s3, carrying out suction filtration and cleaning on the reacted combination body by using deionized water until the pH value is 7-7.5, and drying; s4, mixing the dried carbon sphere-graphene combination with the additive, stirring into flocculent, and then placing the flocculent in a crucible; s5, pushing the crucible into a tube furnace, introducing reducing gas, carbon source gas and inert gas according to a set growth program to grow the carbon nano tube, cooling to room temperature after the program is finished, and taking out to obtain the target three-dimensional architecture allyl carbon composite powder material. The preparation method provided by the invention has the advantages of simple preparation process and obvious effect, can realize production on a certain scale, and is a novel method for preparing the allyl carbon framework composite material.

title_en: Crystallized pillared two-dimensional MFI molecular sieve and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crystallized pillared two-dimensional MFI molecular sieve, a preparation method and application thereof, and in particular relates to the technical field of molecular sieve modification. According to the preparation method of the crystallized columnar two-dimensional MFI molecular sieve, firstly, a silicon source is introduced between adjacent layers of the columnar two-dimensional MFI molecular sieve sheet layer for vapor phase pillaring, then a structure guiding agent is introduced for secondary crystallization, and crystallized columnar is formed between the adjacent layers of the two-dimensional MFI molecular sieve, so that not only is the structural stability of the two-dimensional sheet layer MFI molecular sieve improved, but also the catalytic performance of the MFI molecular sieve in alkylation reaction of phenol and tertiary butanol is improved, the service life of the catalyst is prolonged, and the regeneration performance is excellent.

title_en: Lithium iron phosphate material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lithium iron phosphate material and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the field of material synthesis. According to the method, the nano lithium iron phosphate material is constructed by a microwave-assisted solvothermal method, is in a loose structure of a hollow bowl, and is remarkably increased in contact area with electrolyte when applied to a lithium ion battery anode material, and the ion transmission rate is improved, so that the material further shows good rate capability and discharge specific capacity.

title_en: Method for preparing carbon dots by electrochemical coupling oxidant and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing carbon dots by using an electrochemical coupling oxidant and application thereof. The method prepares the carbon quantum dots by a method of electrolyzing a graphite rod in an electrolyte solution containing hydrogen peroxide. The carbon dot synthesized by the method has the characteristics of simple and economic synthesis process, high yield, good performance, high content of surface functional groups and the like, and can realize better phenol degradation effect in a wider pH range when being applied to the Fenton-like process.

title_en: High-conductivity graphene, preparation method thereof and obtained product
abstract_en: The invention provides high-conductivity graphene, a preparation method thereof and an obtained product, and belongs to the technical field of lithium ion batteries or sodium ion batteries. The high-conductivity graphene provided by the invention is prepared from needle coke as a raw material, the number of layers of the obtained graphene is 10-500, and the resistivity is (0.1-9) multiplied by 10  6  S·m  ‑1  . According to the preparation method provided by the invention, needle coke is used as a raw material, the graphene precursor is obtained through high-pressure stripping, and then the high-conductivity graphene is obtained through graphitization. The method does not undergo strong acid oxidation, the product has no defect and high conductivity, the preparation process is green and environment-friendly,the prepared high-conductivity graphene can be used as a conductive agent of a lithium ion battery and a sodium ion battery, so that the internal resistance of the battery is greatly reduced, and the cycle performance of the battery is improved.

title_en: Two-dimensional high-entropy Prussian blue analogue nanomaterial and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-dimensional high-entropy Prussian blue analog nanomaterial, which is formed by assembling high-entropy Prussian blue analog nano sol particles, wherein the high-entropy sol nano particles are obtained by coordination of five or more transition metal ions and ferricyanide or ferrocyanide. The invention also discloses a preparation method of the two-dimensional high-entropy nano material. The invention obviously improves the configurational entropy of Prussian blue analogues by coordinating five or more transition metal cations with ferrocyanide or ferricyanide, the high entropy effect is helpful for stabilizing the crystal structure, reducing the dissolution of transition metal in Prussian blue analogues, reducing the change of unit cell volume in the charge and discharge process and being beneficial to reversible deintercalation of sodium ions, and simultaneously, the high entropy sol nano particles are assembled into a two-dimensional nano material, so that the high entropy material is fully contacted with electrolyte, the diffusion path of ions in the electrode material is shortened, and the diffusion energy barrier is reduced, thereby improving the diffusion rate of sodium ions.

title_en: Prussian blue aqueous dispersion, preparation method thereof and Prussian blue film
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electrochromic, in particular to Prussian blue aqueous dispersion and a preparation method thereof, and a Prussian blue film, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing potassium ferrocyanide with water to obtain a first solution; mixing ferric salt with water to obtain a second solution; mixing the first solution and the second solution, centrifuging and drying to obtain Prussian blue powder; mixing Prussian blue powder with a dispersing agent and water to obtain a third solution; mixing a stabilizer with water to obtain a fourth solution; and mixing the third solution with the fourth solution to obtain Prussian blue aqueous dispersion. The invention utilizes the combination of the dispersing agent and the outer surface of the Prussian blue particles, can reduce the aggregation of the Prussian blue particles, so that the Prussian blue particles are stably dispersed in water, and then utilizes the fourth solution to assist in dispersing the Prussian blue particles, and can reduce the surface tension of the Prussian blue aqueous dispersion liquid, so that the Prussian blue aqueous dispersion liquid has better coating performance.

title_en: Silicon anode material, preparation method thereof and lithium ion battery
abstract_en: The invention provides a silicon anode material, a preparation method thereof and a lithium ion battery, belonging to the technical field of batteries, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: adding silicon particles into the carbon nano tube dispersion liquid, and mixing to obtain a first mixed liquid; adding the polyacrylonitrile solution into the first mixed solution, and mixing to obtain a second mixed solution; spray drying the second mixed solution to obtain composite particles; and carrying out heat treatment on the composite particles in an inert atmosphere to convert the polyacrylonitrile into cyclized polyacrylonitrile, thereby obtaining the silicon anode material. The preparation process is simple, the use efficiency of the carbon nano tube is improved, the capacity of the silicon anode material is favorably exerted, the silicon anode material is effectively prevented from generating a new active interface in the working process, and the circulation stability of the silicon anode material is enhanced.

title_en: Preparation method of aluminum nitride nano powder based on dual activation
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a preparation method of aluminum nitride nano powder based on dual activation, and relates to the technical field of preparation of nano aluminum nitride. The method comprises the following steps: 1. mixing an aluminum source, a carbon source and an in-situ activator according to the molar ratio of 1 (0-5) (0.1-5) to obtain a reaction precursor; the in-situ activator is melamine; 2. placing a reaction precursor in a first crucible, and placing the first crucible in a constant temperature section of a tubular heating furnace; placing an ex-situ activator melamine in a second crucible, wherein the second crucible is placed in a non-constant temperature section of one side of the tubular heating furnace, which is close to the air inlet; the mass ratio of the reaction precursor to the non-in-situ activator is 1: (0.5-5); carbon thermal reduction reaction is carried out in nitrogen atmosphere at 1000-1500 ℃ to obtain mixed powder; 3. decarburizing the mixed powder to obtain the aluminum nitride nano powder.

title_en: Preparation method and application of nano-cluster catalyst
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electrocatalysis, in particular to a preparation method and application of a nano cluster catalyst, comprising the following steps of A, selecting foam nickel for pretreatment for standby; B. weighing nickel nitrate hexahydrate, cobalt nitrate hexahydrate and urea, and uniformly mixing to prepare a hydrothermal reaction solution; C. placing the foam nickel in the step A into the hydrothermal reaction solution in the step B for reaction, taking out the foam nickel after the reaction, and cleaning, drying and annealing the foam nickel to obtain the foam nickel of the nickel cobaltate nano array; D. c, soaking the foam nickel of the nickel cobaltate nano array obtained in the step C in metal ink, taking out and drying, putting the foam nickel into a high-frequency alternating magnetic field heating device, introducing ammonia gas into the foam nickel, and carrying out heating reaction to obtain a nano cluster catalyst; the present application is for electrocatalytic moisture desorption of oxygen.

title_en: Full-automatic preparation device and preparation method for micro-nano sphere template
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of micro-nano automatic manufacturing, in particular to a full-automatic preparation device and a full-automatic preparation method of a micro-nano sphere template, wherein the full-automatic preparation device comprises the following steps: the culture dish positioning device comprises a base, a culture dish positioning table, an injection pump positioning table, a water pump, a culture dish, a first injection pump and a second injection pump, wherein the first injection pump is internally provided with a first injector, and the second injection pump is internally provided with a second injector; therefore, through full automation of the whole equipment, manual intervention is not needed, errors caused by errors or shaking, non-uniformity and the like during manual operation are fundamentally avoided, accurate parameters are set in the whole preparation process, each preparation can be accurately performed according to preset conditions, the accuracy and consistency of the prepared finished product are improved, the reproducibility is also realized, the production efficiency and the product yield are improved, and the method is high in adaptability and suitable for large-scale application.

title_en: Flexible supercapacitor electrode material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electronic information, in particular to a flexible electrode material mainly used in the fields of wearable flexible electronic equipment, new energy storage, mixed energy conversion and the like and a preparation method thereof. The invention relates to a flexible supercapacitor electrode material which consists of a foam nickel substrate and graphene oxide (active carbon, carbon fiber and carbon nano tube)/nickel-cobalt alloy composite slurry. The nickel-cobalt alloy is synthesized by a hydrothermal method, and the morphology of the substance can be adjusted by changing the relative proportion of nickel-cobalt elements, so that the electrochemical performance of the electrode material is further affected. When the ratio of the amounts of the nickel-cobalt species is 1:1, the flexible electrode material exhibits excellent specific capacitance and good stability.

title_en: Method for preventing thermal agglomeration of ultrathin oxide, composite material and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preventing thermal agglomeration of ultrathin oxides, a composite material and application thereof, and the method is used for preparing atomic thin SnO of a gas sensing material  2  Graphite phase C loaded on  3  N  4  Forming g-C  3  N  4  /a‑SnO  2  Composite material, a-SnO  2  g-C as a gas sensing material  3  N  4  As a protection against a-SnO at high temperatures  2  An agglomerated heat carrier. g-C in composite material  3  N  4  The loading ratio of (2) is 5-15wt%. The gas sensitive surface film of the sensor is prepared by the composite material, and the test use temperature of the gas sensitive surface film is 240-290 ℃. The invention uses stoneInk phase C  3  N  4  (g‑C  3  N  4  ) The skeleton is loaded with a-SnO  2  The MEMS sensor has high response value, quick response and ultra-low detection limit, and particularly has excellent thermal stability. The invention designs and prepares SnO with excellent thermal stability to formaldehyde gas  2  The composite material can resist thermal aggregation at the temperature of not lower than 300 ℃, has short response time for preparing the gas sensor, and is quick to recover, and enough to cope with practical application scenes.

title_en: Composition and application thereof, graphene quantum dot and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a raw material composition, a preparation method of graphene quantum dots and application thereof, wherein the composition comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 1-3wt% of organic carbon source, 0.3-0.8wt% of organic nitrogen source, 96-97.9wt% of water and 0.8-1.1wt% of sodium hydroxide. The graphene quantum dot prepared by using the composition disclosed by the invention can effectively regulate the electronic characteristics, the surface and the local chemical properties of the graphene quantum dot, can provide more active sites for the graphene quantum dot, improves the fluorescence quantum yield, and has the advantages of high detection selectivity, low detection limit, high sensitivity and good anti-interference performance.

title_en: Optical-mechanical integrated composite processing method for amorphous or nanocrystalline and amorphous or nanocrystalline component
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optical-mechanical integrated composite processing method for amorphous or nanocrystalline, which comprises the steps of carrying out laser processing on the surface of an amorphous or nanocrystalline chip, enabling the surface of the amorphous or nanocrystalline chip to form a track with a set pattern of a notch, aligning the edge of a die with a laser cutting line, and then carrying out die stamping to obtain an amorphous or nanocrystalline blanking piece. The processing method can reduce the loss of the die while keeping the amorphous and nanocrystalline tissue structure to the maximum extent and having excellent soft magnetic performance. The invention also discloses an amorphous or nanocrystalline component prepared by the optical-mechanical integrated composite processing method of amorphous or nanocrystalline.

title_en: Manganese cobalt phosphide double hydroxide double-functional nano-sheet array and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a manganese cobalt phosphide double hydroxide double-functional nano-sheet array, a preparation method and application thereof. The manganese cobalt double hydroxide (MnCo-LDH) nano-sheet array is synthesized on the foam nickel substrate in situ by a hydrothermal method, then the MnCo-LDH is partially phosphorylated by using hypophosphite as a phosphorus source by a gas-phase phosphating method, and finally the manganese cobalt double hydroxide double-functional nano-sheet array growing on the foam nickel in situ is obtained, wherein the manganese cobalt double hydroxide double-functional nano-sheet array is similar to the leaves of fly-swathes. The method provided by the invention avoids the use of expensive noble metal, is environment-friendly and simple in process, is convenient for large-scale production, and the prepared manganese cobalt phosphide double hydroxide nano sheet array has the double-function characteristics of excellent super capacitor energy storage performance and electrolytic water oxygen evolution catalytic performance.

title_en: Iron-carbon-based composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an iron-carbon-based composite material and a preparation method and application thereof. The chemical general formula of the iron-carbon-based composite material is (FeC)  x  ·(CeO  2  )  1‑x  C; wherein Fe represents an iron element, C represents a carbon element, ce represents a cerium element, and O represents an oxygen element; x and 1-x are molar coefficients, and x is 0.5-0.95. The iron-carbon-based composite material has good electromagnetic wave conversion performance under the X-wave band (8-12 GHz), and can be used in the fields of electromagnetic shielding, equipment stealth, human body safety protection, microwave darkroom and the like.

title_en: Vapor deposition of nano tellurium electronics on arbitrary surfaces at low temperature
abstract_en: The invention relates to a nanomaterial, and discloses a method for growing a semiconductor tellurium nano-network, which comprises the following steps: preparing a substrate, vaporizing tellurium powder at a first temperature, and growing a tellurium nanonet on the substrate using the vaporized tellurium powder at a second temperature. Wherein the first temperature is higher than the second temperature. The reasonably designed nanonet exhibits outstanding material properties such as micron-sized patterning capability, excellent field effect hole mobility, fast photo-response in the optical communication region, and controllable electron structure of the mixed-dimensional heterojunction.

title_en: Simplified MEMS device fabrication process
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method of manufacturing a MEMS device, comprising: etching into the substrate wafer material to form a plurality of holes in the substrate wafer; and etching the substrate wafer material through the plurality of holes, wherein etching the substrate wafer material through the plurality of holes removes the substrate wafer material under the MEMS device. By the present invention, the costs associated with MEMS device fabrication are reduced.

title_en: Monodisperse magnetic nanoparticle and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application belongs to the technical field of magnetic nano materials, and relates to a monodisperse magnetic nano particle and a preparation method thereof, wherein weak alkaline salt and polyethylene glycol are added into ethylene glycol, and uniformly mixed to prepare a solution A; dissolving soluble ferric salt in glycol to prepare solution B; mixing the solution A and the solution B, and performing ultrasonic operation to obtain a precursor solution; heating the precursor liquid for reaction, cooling the reaction product to room temperature, and pouring out supernatant to obtain the reaction product; washing and drying the reaction product to obtain the magnetic nano particles. The method can achieve the purpose of regulating and controlling the particle size of the product, the prepared magnetic nano particles are basically consistent in appearance and controllable in particle size, and meanwhile, the preparation method is simple, convenient and reliable, and mass production can be realized.

title_en: Polyphenylene sulfide composite material for integrated explosion-proof device of power battery, and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power batteries, and discloses a polyphenylene sulfide composite material for an integrally formed explosion-proof device of a power battery, and preparation and application thereof. The polyphenylene sulfide composite material comprises the following components in percentage by weight; 2-10% of polyamide, 5-20% of polyethersulfone, 0-10% of reactive toughening agent and 0-40% of glass fiber. According to the invention, the nano injection molding technology is used, the polyphenylene sulfide composite material is integrally formed on the metal cover plate in an injection molding mode, so that the explosion-proof structure is prepared, and the metal explosion-proof sheet is replaced by the polyphenylene sulfide composite material explosion-proof structure, so that good tightness can be realized, the electrolyte can be prevented from corroding the explosion-proof sheet, and the production and assembly processes of the explosion-proof device are greatly simplified. The problem that the sealing performance, electrolyte resistance and economy of the explosion-proof piece of the existing power battery cover plate cannot be considered is solved.

title_en: Up-conversion nano material with red light emission and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an up-conversion nano material with red light emission and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of luminescent materials. The up-conversion nano material with red light emission provided by the invention uses LiErF  4  0.5% Tm is the nuclear layer, and LiYF is coated outside the nuclear layer  4  50% Yb, x% Er, y% Ce shell and LiYF  4  A passivation layer; the chemical formula is LiErF  4  :0.5％Tm@LiYF  4  :50％Yb,x％Er,y％Ce@LiYF  4  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the Wherein x=0-15 and y=0-4. The invention dopes Er with proper concentration in the first shell layer  3+  ,Ce  3+  And Yb  3+  By Er  3+  As energy collector, ce is used  3+  And Er  3+  Is to be crossed with (a)Fork relaxation effect, er is improved  3+  For Yb  3+  The collection efficiency of spontaneous radiant energy and is achieved by Yb  3+  The energy is transferred back to the core layer, so that a pronounced red emission is obtained.

title_en: Efficient heat-insulating light transparent silica aerogel material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-efficiency heat-insulating light transparent silica aerogel material and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the steps of covering the upper surface of an amino acid aqueous solution with an incompatible organic solvent, adding organic silicon ester from the upper side of the covered organic solvent for interfacial reaction, adding a catalyst solution to the upper side of an obtained silica nanoparticle aqueous solution with the surface covered with the organic solvent for gel reaction, removing the organic solvent covered with the obtained silica hydrogel with the surface covered with the organic solvent, adding an amino acid aging mother solution for aging, and sequentially carrying out solvent replacement and supercritical drying on the obtained aging-enhanced silica hydrogel to obtain the high-efficiency heat-insulation light transparent silica aerogel material. The high-efficiency heat-insulation light transparent silica aerogel material prepared by the invention has small heat conductivity coefficient at room temperature and relatively high temperature, and realizes high-efficiency heat insulation in a relatively wide temperature range.

title_en: Cobalt-doped modified porous nitrogen-doped carbon nano sheet and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of catalyst materials, and particularly relates to a cobalt-doped modified porous nitrogen-doped carbon nano sheet, and a preparation method and application thereof. The method comprises the following steps: adding a dopamine solution into a cobalt hydroxide nanosheet solution, loading dopamine on the cobalt hydroxide nanosheets in a self-polymerization mode to obtain a mixture, and carrying out solid-liquid separation on the mixture to obtain a solid component; and (3) carrying out heat treatment on the solid component at 700-900 ℃ in a protective gas atmosphere, and sequentially carrying out acid leaching, water washing to neutrality and drying after the heat treatment is finished to obtain the cobalt-doped modified porous nitrogen-doped carbon nano sheet. According to the invention, the cobalt hydroxide nano-sheet is used as a carrier, and dopamine is polymerized on the surface of the cobalt hydroxide nano-sheet by a self-polymerization method to obtain a cobalt-doped modified porous nitrogen-doped carbon nano-sheet; on the premise of keeping high electrocatalytic oxygen reduction performance, the utilization rate of active sites in the electrocatalytic oxygen reduction process can be improved, and further, the catalytic efficiency is provided.

title_en: Graphene morphology control method, SERS film and detection application
abstract_en: The invention provides a graphene morphology control method, a SERS film and detection application, which comprises the steps of placing a substrate in a quartz tube, vacuumizing, introducing hydrogen and argon into the quartz tube, heating to T  1 , wherein the temperature of 600 ℃ is more than or equal to T  1  and is more than or equal to 500 ℃, stopping introducing hydrogen and argon into the quartz tube, starting a plasma source, starting introducing methane to grow on the substrate to obtain a graphene matrix, closing the plasma source, stopping introducing methane, heating the interior of the quartz tube to T  2 , wherein the temperature of 800 ℃ is more than or equal to T  2  and is more than or equal to 700 ℃, starting introducing methane and ammonia at the same time, starting the plasma source, and lifting the power to P, wherein the P is more than or equal to 200W, so that the graphene matrix is converted into flower-shaped graphene.

title_en: Preparation method of carbon quantum dot corrosion inhibitor suitable for inhibiting carbon steel corrosion under neutral and acidic conditions
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a carbon quantum dot corrosion inhibitor suitable for inhibiting carbon steel corrosion under neutral and acidic conditions, which comprises the following steps: step S100, mixing and grinding reaction precursors uniformly, and calcining in a muffle furnace at a certain temperature to obtain a crude product of the carbon quantum dots; and step S200, dissolving the crude product of the carbon quantum dots in ethanol, fully dialyzing by using a dialysis bag of 1kDa, and drying to obtain carbon quantum dot powder, wherein the carbon quantum dot powder is nitrogen-sulfur doped carbon quantum dots. The invention synthesizes the nitrogen-sulfur doped carbon quantum dot through high-temperature calcination, the carbon quantum dot is synthesized by taking diamine compounds and sulfur amino acids as precursors in one step under the high-temperature condition, the carbon quantum dot is purified by a dialysis method, and carbon quantum dot powder is obtained after drying.

title_en: In-situ vulcanized Ni9S8 nanorod/MXene composite anode material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an in-situ vulcanized Ni  9  S  8  The preparation method and application of the nanorod/MXene composite anode material belong to the technical field of electrode materials, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing nickel-containing compound with a few-layer MXene aqueous solution, and reacting under ultrasonic condition by electrostatic adsorption to obtain the final productAn intermediate product; dispersing the intermediate product and a vulcanizing agent in an organic solvent for in-situ vulcanization, washing and annealing the obtained product after the reaction is finished to obtain the Ni  9  S  8  nanorod/MXene composite anode material. The invention also discloses the composite anode material prepared by the preparation method and application of the composite anode material in an electrode material. The MXene nano-sheet and Ni in the composite anode material provided by the invention  9  S  8  The nanorods cooperate with each other and show good reversibility and circulation stability. In addition, the preparation method provided by the invention is simple and environment-friendly, and is beneficial to popularization and application.

title_en: Application of molybdenum-containing nano material as lipoxygenase
abstract_en: The invention relates to an application of molybdenum-containing nano material as lipoxygenase, belonging to the technical field of nano biology. The molybdenum-containing nano material is MoS  2  Is a two-dimensional nanosheet layer; the molybdenum-containing nano material has activity similar to LOX enzyme, and can catalyze polyunsaturated lipid to generate oxygenation reaction to generate peroxidized lipid which is the same as the biological enzyme LOX. Compared with protease, the molybdenum-containing nanomaterial enzyme has the advantages of mass preparation, low cost, repeated use, higher stability, easy modification and the like.

title_en: Preparation method of molybdenum oxide-based nanosheets for electrochemical uranium extraction and electrochemical uranium extraction device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a molybdenum oxide-based nano sheet for electrochemical uranium extraction and an electrochemical uranium extraction device, which comprise the following steps: synthesis of MoO by solvothermal process  x  A nanosheet; co loading on MoO  x  On the nanometer sheet, co-MoO is obtained  x  A nanosheet; the invention constructs metallic cobalt and MoO rich in oxygen vacancy  x  Composite nanoplatelets, co-MoO in simulated seawater containing 8ppm U (VI)  x  Nanoplatelets relative to MoO  x  The nano-sheet shows rapid adsorption kinetics, the extraction efficiency is 95.8% within 40min, and the maximum adsorption capacity reaches 1836.4mg/g. In natural seawater, through electrochemical extraction-desorption process, co-MoO  x  The extraction efficiency of the nano-sheet on uranium reaches 68%, and the extraction capacity is 4.48mg/g. The invention provides a new thought and strategy for the preparation of the efficient seawater uranium extraction electrode material and the economical practicability.

title_en: Method for measuring in-plane conductivity of limited-area ionic liquid composite membrane
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for measuring in-plane conductivity of a limited-area ionic liquid composite membrane, and belongs to the technical field of chemical membrane materials. The limiting ionic liquid composite membrane comprises a two-dimensional nano sheet assembled membrane and a porous substrate, wherein the limiting ionic liquid I is arranged in the two-dimensional nano sheet assembled membrane; the measuring method comprises the following steps: cutting the domain-limited ionic liquid composite membrane into strips, and immersing the strips into resin for curing; and opening two ends of the limiting ionic liquid composite membrane after solidification, pouring an ionic liquid II into the opening, respectively extending metal wires into the ionic liquid II at the two ends of the limiting ionic liquid composite membrane, and measuring the in-plane conductivity of the limiting ionic liquid composite membrane. According to the invention, the two-dimensional nano-sheet limited ionic liquid composite membrane is solidified in the resin to obtain the sample, the structure of the resin sample is more stable, the resin sample has a good stress and strain resistance effect, and the sample can be bent greatly without damaging the structure of the limited ionic liquid composite membrane.

title_en: Metal phthalocyanine-based mesoporous carbon composite material, zinc-air battery and aptamer sensor
abstract_en: The invention relates to a metal phthalocyanine-based mesoporous carbon composite material, a zinc-air battery and an aptamer sensor, and belongs to the field of electrocatalysts of batteries. The metal phthalocyanine-based mesoporous carbon composite material comprises mesoporous hollow carbon spheres and cobalt phthalocyanine pyrolyzate loaded on the mesoporous hollow carbon spheres, wherein the mass content of Co in the metal phthalocyanine-based mesoporous carbon composite material is 0.4-3.5%. The metal phthalocyanine-based mesoporous carbon composite material has excellent electrocatalytic activity, tolerance to methanol toxicity, good stability and rapid charge transfer capability.

title_en: Inertial sensor, preparation method thereof and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides an inertial sensor, a method for manufacturing the same, and an electronic device, which belong to the technical field of inertial micro-electromechanical systems, wherein the inertial sensor is divided into at least one device unit, and the device unit is provided with a functional area and a bonding area surrounding the functional area; the inertial sensor comprises a dielectric substrate, a cover plate and a device layer arranged between the dielectric substrate and the cover plate; the dielectric substrate is provided with a first surface and a second surface which are oppositely arranged along the thickness direction; the cover plate is provided with a third surface and a fourth surface which are oppositely arranged along the thickness direction; the second surface and the third surface are arranged oppositely; the dielectric substrate is provided with a first groove penetrating through part of the thickness of the dielectric substrate, and a first opening of the first groove is positioned on the first surface; the cover plate is provided with a second groove penetrating through part of the thickness of the cover plate, and a second opening of the second groove is positioned on the fourth surface; the first groove and the second groove are both positioned in the bonding area.

title_en: Preparation method and application of Au/MXene/BiOCl nanocomposite
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of mycotoxin detection, and discloses a preparation method and application of an Au/MXene/BiOCl nanocomposite. The preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) MXene aqueous solution and BiOCl nanoplatelet aqueous solution were prepared according to 1:2 to 10 volumeMixing, performing ultrasonic treatment to generate an MXene/BiOCl nano-sheet compound to obtain a mixed solution; (2) Adding HAuCl to the mixed solution  4  In-situ growing gold nanoparticles on the nano-sheet layer by utilizing the reducibility of MXene in the aqueous solution, and stirring for reaction; (3) Centrifuging to remove supernatant, taking a precipitation part, washing with deionized water and re-suspending to obtain the Au/MXene/BiOCl nanocomposite, and storing at 4 ℃. The invention realizes the preparation of aflatoxin B in solution based on the surface enhanced Raman spectrum principle  1  The detection limit is 1ppb, and the linear range is 5-100 ppb. The method can also realize photocatalytic degradation of various mycotoxins and avoid secondary pollution caused by residual mycotoxins after detection.

title_en: Preparation method of inorganic material superfine nano particles
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of inorganic material ultrafine nano particles, which comprises the steps of raw material pre-crushing treatment, grinding liquid preparation, ultrafine sanding treatment, desolventizing treatment and the like. The invention can obviously reduce the size of inorganic material nano particles through the application of micro powder grinding aids such as zirconia, silicon carbide and the like. The nano silicon powder prepared by the method has obviously reduced size, can shorten the diffusion and electron transmission distance of lithium ions, is favorable for fully infiltrating electrolyte and active substances, forms high lithium ion flux at an interface, and can also effectively relieve the stress change of Li-Si alloying and inhibit further pulverization of silicon particles, thereby improving the physical and chemical properties of nano silicon, being favorable for exerting the nano effect of superfine powder of inorganic materials, fully exerting the effective capacity of the materials, and improving the capacity and the first coulombic efficiency. The preparation method disclosed by the invention is simple, the process conditions are easy to control, the production cost is low, the safety and the environmental friendliness are realized, and the industrial production is easy to realize.

title_en: Core-shell structure nano catalyst, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a core-shell structure nano catalyst, a preparation method and application, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: dispersing a carbon carrier in a solution, adding a metal chelating agent, and then adding a non-noble metal precursor to load the non-noble metal precursor on the carbon carrier; step two, removing the solvent from the solution obtained in the step one, and performing primary thermal reduction to obtain a carbon carrier loaded with a non-noble metal core; dispersing the carbon carrier loaded with the non-noble metal core in a solution, and adding a platinum precursor; and step four, removing the solvent from the solution obtained in the step three, and performing secondary thermal reduction to obtain the core-shell structure nano catalyst with the platinum shell. The nano catalyst with the core-shell structure provided by the invention has excellent electrocatalytic oxygen reduction activity and stability.

title_en: Preparation method of copper-nickel-carbon ternary alloy nano material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a copper-nickel-carbon ternary alloy nanomaterial, which comprises the following steps: dissolving copper salt, nickel salt and soluble sugar in deionized water, uniformly stirring, and heating and evaporating to obtain a copper-nickel-carbon ternary alloy precursor; transferring the copper-nickel-carbon ternary alloy precursor into a tube furnace, introducing inert gas, roasting at high temperature, annealing and cooling to obtain the copper-nickel-carbon ternary alloy nanomaterial.
