The copper-nickel-carbon ternary alloy nano material is prepared by adopting a doping technology, and the prepared copper-nickel-carbon ternary alloy nano material not only has high oxidation resistance, but also has excellent conductivity. The invention has wide sources of raw materials, simple preparation process and good industrial application prospect.

title_en: Low-temperature activated high-capacity air suction film and production process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-capacity air suction film, which comprises an air suction layer, wherein additive substances are uniformly mixed in the air suction layer, the additive substances are formed by mixing calcium imide, nickel and rare earth, the air suction layer comprises a substrate, the air suction layer is made of a titanium-barium alloy film, the titanium-barium alloy film is a film produced by depositing titanium atoms and barium atoms on the surface of the substrate, the substrate of the air suction layer can be stainless steel, kovar, silicon, germanium and ceramic, and the air suction layer is prepared by a magnetron sputtering process.

title_en: Strong ultraviolet absorption diethyl ferulate carbon dot and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of nano materials, and discloses a strong ultraviolet absorption diethyl ferulate carbon dot, a preparation method and application thereof. The invention takes anhydrous sodium citrate, diethyl ferulate and ethylenediamine monohydrate as raw materials, and prepares carbon dots by a hydrothermal method. The prepared ferulic acid diethyl ester carbon point has strong absorption characteristic in an ultraviolet region and can keep high transparency in a visible light region, the invention prepares the ferulic acid diethyl ester with poor water solubility into the ferulic acid diethyl ester carbon point which is easy to dissolve in water, the problem of application limitation of the ferulic acid diethyl ester is solved, the preparation method of the carbon point disclosed by the invention is simple, has good biocompatibility and can be produced in batches, and the carbon point can be applied to the aspects of cosmetics, food packaging, ultraviolet filter materials, transparent ultraviolet-proof coatings of ultraviolet shielding glass and the like.

title_en: High-entropy hydroxide and electro-oxidation catalyst, and preparation methods and applications thereof
abstract_en: The high-entropy hydroxide comprises hydroxide transition metal elements of transition metal elements selected from at least four of iron, cobalt, nickel, copper, cadmium, magnesium, zinc, vanadium, manganese, cadmium, ruthenium, rhodium, molybdenum and tungsten; the agent has a two-dimensional layered nano structure; the size is 20-500 nm. The three-dimensional integral electrode has the conductive substrate with rich pore canal structures, can accelerate the charge mass transmission power in the electrode reaction process, and provides more active sites. The active component is a multi-element transition metal hydroxide, and a plurality of transition metals exist simultaneously, so that the multi-active site catalytic capability of the catalyst is endowed, and the reaction progress is accelerated. The structure is two-dimensional lamellar, which is beneficial to mass-charge transportation and exposure of active sites.

title_en: Preparation of layered two-dimensional sheet
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a layered two-dimensional sheet. The invention firstly carries out heating treatment on the mixture of potassium hydroxide, tetrahydrofuran and fluorophlogopite powder in a reaction kettle, then carries out centrifugal separation after carrying out ultrasonic treatment on the obtained reaction mixed solution, obtains supernatant fluid which is adjusted to be neutral, respectively adopts ethanol and deionized water to wash in sequence, and finally dries to obtain the target product. The method of the invention is used for successfully preparing the fluorophlogopite two-dimensional thin sheet with a few layers, and the number of layers is 1-6. The preparation method is simple, convenient for large-scale and large-area preparation, low in cost and potential for large-scale application.

title_en: Multifunctional seawater heterostructure catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional seawater heterostructure catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing a cobalt source, urea, ammonium fluoride and a solvent, and performing ultrasonic treatment to obtain a first solution; hydrothermal treatment is carried out on the first solution immersed with the substrate at 50-260 ℃ for 0.5-30 hours to obtain a sample, and the sample is washed and dried to obtain a precursor, wherein the substrate is made of foam nickel; and (3) in the air flow of nitrogen or inert gas atmosphere, placing the precursor at the downstream of a phosphorus source according to the passing sequence of the air flow, heating the phosphorus source at 200-600 ℃, simultaneously carrying out heat treatment on the precursor at 200-600 ℃, reacting for 0.5-12 h, and cooling to room temperature to obtain the multifunctional seawater heterostructure catalyst. The multifunctional seawater heterostructure catalyst has multifunction, and can be widely applied to cathodic hydrogen evolution reaction, anodic oxygen evolution reaction, hydrazine oxidation reaction, glucose oxidation reaction, methanol oxidation reaction and urea oxidation reaction.

title_en: Molybdenum sulfide-based nanocomposite, preparation method thereof, catalyst and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to a molybdenum sulfide-based nanocomposite, a preparation method, a catalyst and application thereof. The molybdenum sulfide-based nanocomposite comprises a molybdenum sulfide substrate and cuprous oxide nano particles loaded on the molybdenum sulfide substrate, wherein the molybdenum sulfide substrate has a microcosmic appearance of a layered nano sheet structure, and the thickness of each layer is 12-19 nm. The molybdenum sulfide-based nanocomposite material provided by the invention is used as a catalyst and has more abundant electrochemical active sites, so that the electrocatalytic performance of the molybdenum sulfide-based nanocomposite material is obviously improved.

title_en: Improvements in or relating to quantum computing
abstract_en: The invention provides a trapping ion processor comprising a DAC chamber, an ASIC, a digital control line between the DAC chamber and the ASIC, and an analog control line between the DAC chamber and the ASIC. The ASIC includes a plurality of channels, each channel including a DC electrode, a first analog memory cell, and a second analog memory cell. The DAC chamber includes a DAC configured to generate an analog signal; and a DAC controller configured to generate a timing control signal comprising one or more sampling timing signals for controlling when the analog signal is sampled as a voltage signal by one or more of the plurality of channels and one or more synchronization signals for controlling when the sampled voltage signals are applied to the respective DC electrodes. The analog control line transmits the analog signal from the DAC to the plurality of channels, and wherein the digital control line transmits the timing control signal from the DAC controller to the plurality of channels, the timing control signal controlling when the analog signal is sampled to a voltage by the first analog memory cell or the second analog memory cell of each of the plurality of channels and controlling when the sampled voltage signal is applied to the respective DC electrode of each of the plurality of channels.

title_en: Anti-adhesion film and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an anti-adhesion film, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation raw materials of the anti-adhesion film comprise magnetic starch nano particles. The invention adopts an emulsion method to prepare the porous gelatin anti-adhesion film, takes magnetic degradable nano particles as magnetic filler and gelatin as matrix, and prepares the porous gelatin anti-adhesion film. The obtained anti-adhesion membrane has uniform pore size distribution, has extremely strong water absorption performance and protein adsorption capacity, can effectively prevent the occurrence of postoperative tissue adhesion, and lays a foundation for the application of the anti-adhesion membrane in the postoperative tissue anti-adhesion field.

title_en: Multi-cavity type miniature atomic air chamber and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of atomic devices, and discloses a multi-cavity type micro-atomic air chamber and a preparation method thereof. The atomic gas chamber preparation method is a silicon-based MEMS process compatible with a CMOS platform, and comprises the following steps: etching an air source groove and at least two air chamber through holes on one surface of the wafer substrate; etching two ends of the other surface to form right-angle micro-channels respectively communicated with the air source grooves and the air chamber through holes; the right-angle micro-channel comprises a vertical channel and a horizontal channel which are perpendicular to the bottom surface of the air source groove; filling alkali metal azide, and bonding glass on two sides under vacuum condition to form an air source chamber and an atomic air chamber; exciting the alkali metal azide to decompose the azide; melting and plugging the vertical channel when the alkali metal vapor diffuses; and (3) dicing the wafer substrate to finish the separation of the gas source chamber and the atomic gas chamber. The invention seals the vertical channel and can realize long-term plugging. A plurality of atomic air chambers are formed in one batch, and all parameters are the same, so that the uniformity of the parameters is improved.

title_en: Nanometer material of phthalocyanine dye hybridized rare earth ion, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to a nano material of a phthalocyanine dye hybridized rare earth ion, a preparation method and application thereof. The nano material comprises a NaYF  4 ：Ce +4 ,Sm 3+ ,Nd 3+  nano UCNPs core-shell structure, and seven-methine phthalocyanine dye CYMB-S capable of enhancing infrared light absorption and other surface modification components capable of enhancing visible light absorption are modified on the surface of the material. The near-infrared dye/rare earth ion hybridized nano material with a certain morphology structure prepared by the invention causes energy conversion of corresponding rare earth ions and conversion of a luminous and color-developing mechanism thereof by illumination excitation of the near-infrared dye with the maximum absorption wavelength of 820nm, so as to obtain the visual nano rare earth material with larger absorption enhancement in a visible light region, and is applied to a treatment-free CTP printing plate.

title_en: Electrocatalytic material and preparation method thereof, and method for electrochemically reducing nitrate
abstract_en: The invention relates to an electrocatalytic material, a preparation method thereof and a method for electrochemically reducing nitrate. The electrocatalytic material provided by the invention comprises cobalt hydroxide nano-sheets and nano-copper particles loaded on the cobalt hydroxide nano-sheets. The preparation method of the electrocatalytic material comprises the steps of carrying out reduction reaction on a copper complex and a cobalt complex in the presence of a reducing agent to obtain a reaction product; the reaction product is subjected to hydrolysis treatment. The preparation method provided by the invention has the advantages of simple process, low consumption, environmental protection, environment friendliness and high efficiency, and the prepared electrocatalytic material has good catalytic performance for electrocatalytic nitrate reduction.

title_en: Method for preparing functionalized carbon dots by using waste cathode of electrolytic aluminum
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for preparing functionalized carbon dots by using waste cathodes of electrolytic aluminum, which comprises the following steps of ball milling and activating the waste cathodes of electrolytic aluminum and thiourea or L-cysteine to obtain activated mixed powder, adding the activated mixed powder into an alkali solution, then carrying out hydrothermal reaction in a sealed reaction container, carrying out solid-liquid separation to obtain co-doped electrolytic aluminum cathode carbon powder, adding the co-doped electrolytic aluminum cathode carbon powder into a mixed solution of concentrated nitric acid and concentrated sulfuric acid, carrying out hydrothermal reaction in the sealed reaction container, then carrying out solid-liquid separation, collecting first filtrate, neutralizing the first filtrate with a hot alkali solution, carrying out solid-liquid separation, collecting second filtrate, and then dialyzing and drying with a dialysis bag to obtain the functionalized carbon dots.

title_en: MEMS device with improved detection performance
abstract_en: The MEMS device is formed of a substrate and a movable structure suspended from the substrate. The movable structure has a first mass, a second mass, and a first elastic set mechanically coupled between the first mass and the second mass. The first elastic set is compliant in a first direction. The first mass is configured to move relative to the substrate in a first direction. The MEMS device further has: a second elastic set mechanically coupled between the substrate and the movable structure and compliant in the first direction; and an anchor control structure secured to the substrate, capacitively coupled to the second mass, and configured to apply an electrostatic force on the second mass in the first direction. The anchor control structure controls the MEMS device in a first operational state in which the second mass is free to move relative to the substrate in a first direction, and controls the MEMS device in a second operational state in which the anchor control structure exerts a pull-in force on the second mass that anchors the second mass to the anchor structure.

title_en: Bi-containing doped TiO2Light response nano material, reversible color-changing ink, reversible color-changing fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a light response nano material containing Bi doped TiO  2 , reversible color-changing ink, reversible color-changing fiber and a preparation method thereof, wherein the Bi doped TiO  2  nano material is adopted as a photocatalysis functional component and is uniformly mixed with a reversible color-changing indicator in a solvent to obtain the light response reversible color-changing ink containing Bi doped TiO  2 . And uniformly mixing the color-changing ink with a polyvinyl alcohol (PVA) -containing solution, and obtaining the light-response reversible color-changing fiber through a wet spinning technology. Compared with the prior art, the light response reversible color-changing ink and fiber containing the Bi-doped TiO  2  can change color under the illumination with the wavelength of 365-450nm, and then can be recoloured under the illumination with the wavelength of 600-900 nm. The color-changing ink and fiber prepared by the invention have quick response to 365nm and 808nm visible light, can be printed and erased remotely, and can be reused.

title_en: Gold nanoparticle and application thereof in tumor cell pyrosis induction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of biological medicine, and in particular discloses gold nanoparticles and application thereof in tumor cell apoptosis induction. The invention discovers that the luminescent gold nanoparticle (L-AuNP@TMT) can induce the rapid focal death of tumor cells under the action of two-photon photodynamics, thereby realizing the efficient killing of tumors. In conclusion, the developed TP-PDT treatment method of the L-AuNP@TMT is not influenced by the anoxic microenvironment of the tumor, can effectively induce organisms to generate an anti-tumor immunity effect mediated by cell apoptosis under the irradiation of two photons, realizes radical treatment of primary tumors and effectively prevents the recurrence and metastasis of the tumors, is a safe, efficient and ideal tumor treatment strategy, and has important application value in clinical treatment of the tumors.

title_en: Ga/Zn bimetal doped nitrogen-doped carbon quantum dot solution and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of carbon quantum dots, and particularly relates to a Ga/Zn bimetal doped nitrogen-doped carbon quantum dot solution and a preparation method thereof. According to the invention, three elements Ga/Zn/N are co-doped with CDs, the doping amount of N element is regulated to improve the quantum yield of CDs, and zinc and gallium ions with the ionic radius of 74 picometers and 62.5 picometers are co-doped with N-CDs, so that the regulation and control of the occupation of a plurality of molecules in the N-CDs are realized. In addition, in the preparation process of the carbon quantum dots, the use of traditional chemicals is avoided, but rice bran common in nature is adopted, hemicellulose in the rice bran is extracted, the rice bran hemicellulose is used as a carbon source precursor, and the preparation and doping of the carbon quantum dots are realized through a one-step hydrothermal method. The preparation method for the Ga/Zn co-doped N-CDs based on the green carbon source precursor is expected to realize the further application of CDs in the fields of photoelectricity and catalysis.

title_en: Microfluidic chip collaborative thermocompression bonding regulation and control method
abstract_en: The invention provides a microfluidic chip collaborative thermocompression bonding regulation and control method, which comprises the following steps: designing a micro-channel structure according to the functional requirement of the micro-fluidic chip; performing a micro-fluidic chip hot-press bonding pre-experiment; judging whether the hot-press bonding quality of the microfluidic chip meets the standard; counting the micro-channel deformation amount when the bonding strength reaches the standard; developing a compression creep experiment to construct a material constitutive model; constructing a hot-pressing simulation model to carry out simulation; analyzing the simulation result, and calculating the deformation quantity of the micro-channel when the bonding strength reaches the standard; judging whether the material constitutive model is accurate or not; compensating the deformation of the micro-channel or adding the energy-gathering rib microstructure; carrying out simulation, calculating and judging whether the micro-channel deformation after optimization meets the standard; and (5) preparing, performing hot-press bonding quality verification, and judging whether the bonding quality meets the standard. The invention can accurately predict the deformation of the micro-channel in the bonding process, can determine an effective mode to control and minimize the deformation, and ensures the high bonding strength and reliability of the micro-fluidic chip.

title_en: Method for rapidly and environmentally preparing nano silver by using gardenia extracting solution and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing nano silver rapidly and green by using a gardenia extracting solution and application thereof. The gardenia nano silver composite material has great application potential in bacteriostasis and aquaculture.

title_en: Low-energy consumption preparation of nano-confinement NaAlH capable of low-pressure circulation4Process for hydrogen storage material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a process method for preparing a low-energy-consumption cyclic nano-confined NaAlH  4  hydrogen storage material, which comprises the following preparation steps of (1) pretreating a selected two-dimensional carrier material, (2) placing aluminum powder, sodium, triethylaluminum and an organic solvent in a glove box filled with argon gas in a high-pressure reaction kettle, (3) dispersing the pretreated two-dimensional carrier material in the organic solvent, sealing the reaction kettle, (4) placing the reaction kettle in an ultrasonic machine for ultrasonic mixing and dispersing, (5) vacuumizing the reaction kettle, filling hydrogen into the reaction kettle, heating the reaction kettle according to a certain heating rate, and keeping for a period of time, (6) cooling the reaction kettle to room temperature after the reaction is finished, discharging residual hydrogen pressure, (7) placing the mixture in dynamic vacuum for solvent removal and drying to obtain the nano-confined NaAlH  4 .

title_en: Preparation method of nanoscale Ti-Co-beta molecular sieve
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a nano Ti-Co-beta molecular sieve, which uses tetraethyl orthosilicate or silica sol as a silicon source, titanium tetrachloride or titanium isopropoxide as a titanium source, cobalt chloride hexahydrate as a cobalt source, sodium hydroxide as an alkali source, tetraethyl ammonium hydroxide as a template agent, sodium acetate or sodium benzoate as a mineralizer, and the Na-type Ti-Co-beta molecular sieve is obtained by drying and roasting after a one-step hydrothermal method; and then carrying out ion exchange post-treatment on the molecular sieve to remove sodium ions, thus obtaining the nano-scale Ti-Co-beta molecular sieve. The method has the advantages of no need of adding fluoride, simple operation, good repeatability, low cost and easy industrialization, and the prepared Ti-Co-beta molecular sieve particles are nano-scale and have good crystallinity, ti and Co are uniformly distributed in the zeolite framework of the beta molecular sieve, have large specific surface area and rich metal active sites, are suitable for toluene hydroxylation reaction, have very good catalytic activity, and show high toluene conversion rate and phenol selectivity.

title_en: Hydrogen-substituted graphite alkyne bridged nickel metal organic framework and copper single atom/cluster composite nano array and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a hydrogen-substituted graphite alkyne bridged nickel metal organic framework and copper single atom/cluster two-dimensional ultrathin composite nano sheet array as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and solves the defect that the prior art cannot fully exert the synergistic catalysis between metal organic framework materials and metal single atoms/clusters. According to the invention, a two-dimensional ultrathin hydrogen-substituted graphite alkyne is used as a bridge, and a two-dimensional ultrathin nickel metal organic framework material with coordination unsaturated metal sites and copper single atoms/clusters are connected to form the nickel metal organic framework @ hydrogen-substituted graphite alkyne @ copper single atoms/clusters two-dimensional ultrathin composite nano-sheet array electrode with a series catalytic effect. On one hand, the high conjugated system of the hydrogen substituted graphite alkyne can be used as a conductive channel to improve the conductivity and stability of the nickel metal organic framework material; on the other hand, the rich diacetylene sites can effectively stabilize copper metal monoatoms/clusters with unsaturated coordination.

title_en: Silicon-based nanometer vacuum gauge and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a silicon-based nano vacuum gauge and a preparation method thereof, relates to the technical field of vacuum degree detection, and is used for providing a technical scheme of a polycrystalline silicon nanowire vacuum gauge which is low in cost, simple in process, compatible with a CMOS (complementary metal oxide semiconductor) process and easy to realize. The preparation method of the silicon-based nano vacuum gauge comprises the following steps: providing a silicon substrate, and sequentially forming an oxide layer and a polycrystalline silicon layer on the silicon substrate; doping treatment and annealing treatment are carried out on the polysilicon layer; etching the doped and annealed polysilicon layer by adopting an atomic layer-like etching technology to obtain a polysilicon nanowire structure; carrying out heat treatment on the polycrystalline silicon nanowire structure to obtain a polycrystalline silicon nanowire structure, wherein the polycrystalline silicon nanowire structure comprises at least two nanowires, and the at least two nanowires are arranged in parallel along the horizontal direction or the vertical direction; and forming an electrode structure on the polycrystalline silicon nanowire structure.

title_en: Preparation of biomass fluorescent carbon dot nanomaterial and application of biomass fluorescent carbon dot nanomaterial in latent fingerprint display
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a biomass fluorescent carbon dot nano material, which is characterized in that fluorescent carbon quantum dots dispersed in a solution are prepared from natural plant ophiopogon japonicus leaves by a solvothermal method, and solid fluorescent powder is obtained by drying. The fingerprint brushing is used for brushing and displaying the latent fingerprints on different objects by using a small amount of fluorescent carbon dot nanomaterial powder, clear fingerprint detail characteristics can be observed under ultraviolet light, and the fingerprint brushing device is suitable for fingerprint identification. The biomass fluorescent carbon dot nanomaterial provided by the invention is mainly prepared from natural plants, has the advantages of simple preparation process, low manufacturing cost, convenient operation, environmental protection, no toxicity, small injury to operators, good latent fingerprint display effect on the surfaces of different objects, suitability for industrial production and conventional fingerprint display work, and great promotion effect on the development of fingerprint display technology and great practical application value.

title_en: AlGaN nano-array photocathode and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an AlGaN nano-array photocathode, which comprises an Al  2 O 3  substrate layer, wherein an AlN buffer layer, an AlGaN intermediate layer and an AlGaN emission layer are sequentially arranged on the surface of the Al  2 O 3  substrate layer; the AlGaN emission layer comprises an AlGaN substrate and p-type AlGaN nanowires, and the p-type AlGaN nanowires are distributed on the surface of the AlGaN substrate in an array manner; the surface of the p-type AlGaN nanowire is adsorbed with a Cs/O activation layer. The invention also discloses a preparation method of the AlGaN nano array photocathode. According to the invention, the influence of each parameter on the quantum efficiency of the nano array is simulated by a software simulation method, and the better structural parameters are provided by combining the manufacturing process of the modern nano array photocathode, so that the light absorptivity and quantum efficiency of the photocathode in the solar blind wave band are improved by combining the simulation with reality; the corresponding cut-off wavelength of the composition can be changed by adjusting the Al composition.

title_en: Humidity sensor of protein-two-dimensional material film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a humidity sensor of a protein-two-dimensional material film and a preparation method thereof, wherein the sensor comprises a conductive substrate with a surface modified with the protein-two-dimensional material film; the conductive substrate of the surface modified protein-two-dimensional material film is obtained by drying a mixture of a protein nanoparticle solution and a two-dimensional material dispersion liquid on the surface of the conductive substrate. According to the invention, the protein nano particles and the two-dimensional material are cast on the conductive substrate to form the film, the detection of humidity is realized by measuring the current change of the protein-two-dimensional material film, and the result shows that the constructed sensor has the advantages of high sensitivity, quick response and stability, and can be used for real-time monitoring of human respiration and environmental humidity. Meanwhile, the composite film also improves the performance of the protein, and the detection performance of the constructed sensor on humidity after being stored for 3 months is basically equal to that of the initial detection performance, namely the sensor also has good storage stability.

title_en: Semiconductor packaging structure and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a semiconductor packaging structure and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of semiconductors. Due to the existence of the first alumina layer, the contact area between the first alumina layer and the second alumina layer can be increased in the process of forming the molding layer, the mechanical bonding force is increased, the preparation process is simple, and an additional etching process is not needed.

title_en: Anodic aluminum oxide template attaching device and anodic aluminum oxide template attaching method suitable for planar substrate
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of nanostructure preparation, and provides an anodic aluminum oxide template laminating device and method suitable for a planar substrate, wherein the anodic aluminum oxide template laminating device comprises: the female die is provided with a first blind hole, the orifice of the first blind hole is suitable for being covered by an anodic aluminum oxide template, the bottom of the first blind hole is provided with a second blind hole which is used for accommodating and positioning the substrate, and the depth of the second blind hole is smaller than the thickness of the substrate; the pipe body is used for stretching into the first blind hole and is in sliding fit with the first blind hole, and the pipe body is arranged to be sleeved on the outer side of the substrate. Cutting of the anodic aluminum oxide template is completed by shearing action generated by matching the pipe body and the first blind hole, the size precision and the shape precision of the anodic aluminum oxide template can be guaranteed through the size precision and the matching precision of the first blind hole and the pipe body, the influence of manual proficiency is small, and accordingly the suitability of the anodic aluminum oxide template and a substrate can be improved.

title_en: Seed coating agent with fluorescent nano material as active ingredient and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological agriculture, and particularly relates to a seed coating agent with fluorescent nano materials as active ingredients, and a preparation method and application thereof. According to the invention, the specific film forming agent component is selected, so that the carbon dot nano active component and the inactive component can be mixed and then stably exist on the surface of the seed; when the seeds are under the condition of salt stress, the seed coating agent on the surface can effectively remove active oxygen in the seeds, improve the activity of antioxidant enzyme and enhance the germination and growth performances of the seeds. Meanwhile, the seed coating agent has the advantages of simple synthesis method, small dosage, convenient transportation and operation, more mature and convenient technology compared with an initiator, and more acceptance by growers, and most of inactive ingredients are degradable, medical, sewage treatment and food raw materials, so that the seed coating agent is safe and environment-friendly.

title_en: Au-based multi-metal aerogel and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an Au-based multi-metal aerogel and a preparation method and application thereof, and the Au-based multi-metal aerogel comprises the following steps: 1. adding aqueous solution of tetrachloroauric acid trihydrate and metal salt precursor into pure water, and uniformly mixing to obtain mixed solution with metal concentration of 0.1-1 mmol/L; 2. adding a reducing agent into the mixed solution according to the mass ratio of metal ions to the reducing agent in the mixed solution of 1:50-500, and uniformly mixing at 10-40 ℃ to obtain a suspension; 3. continuously standing the suspension at the second temperature, assembling gel fragments to obtain hydrogel A, washing the hydrogel A with pure water for many times to remove residues, and then carrying out solvent exchange with tertiary butanol to obtain hydrogel B;4. and freeze-drying the hydrogel B to obtain the final product gel. The method has the characteristics of regulating and controlling the gel preparation rate and the gel characteristic size, and the gel prepared by the method has high activity and durability, and can effectively catalyze the electrochemical methanol oxidation reaction.

title_en: Lithium titanate negative electrode material for ultra-fast charging of lithium ion battery
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of lithium batteries, and provides a lithium titanate negative electrode material for ultra-fast charging of a lithium ion battery, which comprises the following components: mixing tetrabutyl titanate solution with polyvinylpyrrolidone solution, adding LiOH.H  2  O solution, and uniformly mixing to obtain mixed solution; carrying out solvothermal reaction on the mixed solution to obtain a Li  4 Ti 5 O 12  precursor; and calcining the Li  4 Ti 5 O 12  precursor to obtain the carbon-coated nano flaky spinel type Li  4 Ti 5 O 12 . The carbon-coated spinel type lithium titanate nano-sheet is synthesized, the conductivity of the material can be improved by a carbon-coated structure, and the circulation stability of the material can be improved by a dispersed nano-sheet structure, and the diffusion distance of lithium ions can be reduced, so that the lithium titanate negative electrode material prepared by the invention has the excellent performances of ultra-rapid charge and discharge and high-rate long-circulation stability.

title_en: Single-flux quantum pulse device and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of device preparation, and discloses a single magnetic flux quantum pulse device and a preparation method thereof, wherein the single magnetic flux quantum pulse device comprises a superconductive film manufactured on the surface of a nanowire; manufacturing a first patterned photoresist on the surface of the superconducting thin film; etching the superconducting film by taking the first patterned photoresist as a mask, exposing the nanowire, and forming an underdamped Josephson junction; preparing superconducting electrodes at two ends of the underdamped Josephson junction; the superconducting electrode is connected with the end part of the underdamped Josephson junction; preparing a superconducting connecting wire to form a single magnetic flux quantum pulse device; converting the underdamped type of Josephson junction into an overdamped type of Josephson junction by a first targeted approach; the first target means comprise applying an electrostatic field to adjust the critical current of the underdamped type of josephson junction, increasing the critical current of the temperature to adjust the underdamped type of josephson junction. The invention can simplify the manufacturing process without preparing the metal film with the thickness of nanometer level.

title_en: Corrosion inhibitor based on N, S co-doped melon seed shell carbon quantum dots, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention provides a corrosion inhibitor based on N, S co-doped melon seed shell carbon quantum dots, a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of corrosion inhibitors. The N, S co-doped melon seed shell carbon quantum dot corrosion inhibitor prepared by reacting melon seed shells with thiourea plays a good role in inhibiting copper corrosion in sulfuric acid, and mainly comprises hydrophilic groups and heteroatom groups, wherein the heteroatom groups can be combined with the metal surface to form a protective layer, so that the purpose of corrosion inhibition is achieved, the hydrophilic groups improve the hydrophilicity of the N, S co-doped melon seed shell carbon quantum dot corrosion inhibitor, and the N, S co-doped carbon quantum dot corrosion inhibitor can effectively inhibit copper corrosion in 0.5M sulfuric acid.

title_en: Flexible two-dimensional nano magnetic composite structure film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a flexible two-dimensional nano magnetic composite structure film and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of composite films. The flexible two-dimensional nano magnetic composite structure film comprises a magnetic inner core, a hydrophilic outer shell and a carrying layer, wherein the magnetic inner core is a magnetic nano particle containing Fe and/or Mn; the hydrophilic shell is a hydrophilic shell of a target molecule and comprises a modified end and a hydrophilic end, wherein the modified end and the carrying layer are in covalent bonding or van der Waals interaction; the loading layer is a lamellar two-dimensional material and is used for loading the magnetic core. According to the invention, the nanoparticles with MRI or CT contrast function are transferred to the surface of the non-particle sheet flexible two-dimensional nano substrate by a phase transfer technology, so that the two-dimensional magnetic composite structure nanomaterial with high performance and multiple functions is formed, and the recognition efficiency of the GMR biosensor is further improved.

title_en: Method for efficiently growing carbon nano tube
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for growing carbon nanotubes at high multiplying power, which relates to the technical field of novel carbon materials. According to the method, the metal nano particles are uniformly dispersed in the graphene aerogel porous structure, so that the catalytic activity is greatly improved, the growth multiplying power of the carbon nano tube exceeds 100, the purity is high, and further acidification and purification are not needed.

title_en: Preparation device, preparation method and application of silicon-based electrode material
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of lithium ion anode material preparation, in particular to a preparation device, a preparation method and application of a silicon-based electrode material, comprising a smelting unit and a granulating unit arranged below the smelting unit; the smelting unit comprises a smelting device, and the smelting device is provided with a discharge hole; the granulating unit comprises a granulating chamber, a turntable and at least two material spray heads, wherein the turntable and the at least two material spray heads are arranged in the granulating chamber, a feed inlet is formed in the upper part of the granulating chamber, and the feed inlet is formed in the upper part of the turntable; and the discharge port of the smelting device is connected with the feed port of the granulating chamber through a pipeline. The method can complete the pre-lithiation, nanocrystallization, oxidation, doping and/or cladding treatment in the same device, and obtain the silicon-based anode material applicable to the preparation of lithium ion batteries after necessary post-treatment of the collected materials, and has simple flow and operation, can realize batch production and has comprehensive advantages in production cost and performance.

title_en: Near infrared two-region photosensitive multifunctional nano probe, preparation process and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a near infrared two-region photosensitive multifunctional nano probe, a preparation process and application thereof, wherein the preparation process comprises the following steps: s1, dissolving soybean lecithin and cholesterol in a mixed organic solvent, and performing rotary steaming treatment to obtain a reaction raw material; s2, adding an ascorbic acid aqueous solution into the reaction raw materials to dissolve the reaction raw materials, centrifuging, and taking supernatant to obtain an intermediate reaction solution; s3, adding a tetrachloro-gold acid solution, stirring for reaction, and centrifuging, dialyzing and purifying after the reaction is finished to obtain hollow gold nano cage particles; s4, preparing a hollow gold nano cage particle aqueous solution, stirring, adding selenium dioxide and an ascorbic acid aqueous solution, and reacting to obtain an intermediate solution; s5, adding a copper sulfate pentahydrate solution and an ascorbic acid aqueous solution, standing for reaction, and taking precipitate for freeze-drying to obtain the GNF@CuSe nano probe. The nano probe of the invention enhances the strong absorption capacity of the near infrared two regions, so that the nano probe has the photo-thermal treatment and chemical power treatment capacity, and has the near infrared two region photo-acoustic imaging capacity.

title_en: Hollow SiO2Method for preparing nano particles
abstract_en: A method for preparing hollow SiO  2  nano-particles, which comprises the following steps: preparing a mixed solution containing an organic-inorganic hybrid SiO  2  inner layer nuclear structure by hydrolysis polymerization reaction by taking tetraethyl orthosilicate and N- [3- (trimethoxy silicon-based) propyl ] ethylenediamine as a silicon source, ammonia water as a catalyst and absolute ethyl alcohol as a solvent; adding a certain amount of tetraethyl orthosilicate into the mixed solution, forming a layer of SiO  2  shell structure on the surface of the organic-inorganic hybrid SiO  2  through hydrolysis polymerization reaction, centrifugally collecting solid silicon spheres by using ethanol and deionized water, and finally dispersing the obtained product into absolute ethanol; and (2) adding a certain amount of HF solution into the solution obtained in the step (S2), and stirring and etching the inner layer core structure to obtain the hollow SiO  2  nano-particles. According to the invention, the organic-inorganic hybrid SiO  2  is used as an inner layer core structure, the inorganic SiO  2  is used as an outer layer shell structure, the internal structure of the hollow SiO  2  nano-particles is etched by the HF solution, the preparation process is rapid and simple, and the hollow degree and the particle size can be accurately controlled.

title_en: System and method for co-producing hydrogen by producing carbon nano tube from waste plastic with continuous flow of catalyst
abstract_en: The invention relates to a system and a method for co-producing hydrogen by using waste plastics with continuous flow of catalyst, wherein the system comprises a melting feeding device, a pyrolysis device, a vapor deposition device, a cooling device, a supplementing chamber and a solid-phase product collecting chamber which are sequentially connected along the vertical direction, a lifting component and a vapor-phase product processing system; the vapor deposition device comprises a reaction cavity and a material changing cavity which are separated by a movable partition board, and a current reaction catalyst is arranged in the reaction cavity; the driving rod of the lifting assembly sequentially penetrates through the solid-phase product collecting chamber, the supplementing chamber, the cooling device and the material changing cavity from bottom to top along the vertical direction, and can drive the double-layer material plate to lift up and down; the double-layer material plate is provided with two placing positions for placing the current reaction catalyst with the carbon nano tube product attached after the reaction and the standby catalyst respectively; and a pushing mechanism is respectively arranged in the reaction cavity, the material changing cavity and the solid-phase product collecting chamber. The invention realizes the high-efficiency continuous operation of co-production of hydrogen by catalyzing and generating carbon products.

title_en: Preparation method of nickel-cobalt alloy nano particles based on supercapacitor electrode material
abstract_en: The invention provides a wet chemical synthesis method of nickel-cobalt alloy nano particles for super capacitors, which mainly comprises the following steps: (1) preparation of a precursor solution: nickel acetylacetonate and cobalt acetylacetonate were combined at 3:1 (or 1:1 or 1:3) molar ratio (0.8 mmol total) and 10mL oleylamine and 5mL oleic acid were added to a three-necked flask, and the hickory-technique apparatus was connected to vacuum at 60 ℃; (2) preparation of a reducing agent: while step (1) was ongoing, 0.5mmol of methyl-penane was dissolved in 0.5mL of oleylamine and treated with ultrasound and nitrogen degassing. (3) hot injection of reductant: and (3) adding the reducing agent prepared in the step (2) into the mixed solution obtained in the step (1) when the temperature is raised to 180 ℃, maintaining the temperature for 1 hour, and then rapidly cooling to room temperature by using a water bath. (4) ligand exchange: and (3) exchanging organic matters remained on the surfaces of the alloy nano-particles obtained in the step (3) by using a melamine solution so as to increase the specific capacitance of the alloy nano-material. The monodisperse nickel-cobalt alloy nano particles prepared by the method have uniform morphology, adjustable components and excellent supercapacitor properties, and solve the technical problems of low specific capacitance and poor long-term stability of transition metal serving as a supercapacitor.

title_en: Mesoporous nitrogen-doped carbon aerogel and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses mesoporous nitrogen-doped carbon aerogel and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of preparation of catalyst carrier materials in fuel cells. According to the invention, carbon aerogel is doped with nitrogen in different doping modes, the mass percentage of nitrogen element is 0.50-10.00 wt%, the specific surface area is 400-850 m  2 /g, and the pore diameter distribution is 2-40 nm. According to the invention, melamine is used as a nitrogen source, resorcinol, phloroglucinol and formaldehyde are used as carbon sources, processes such as freeze drying and activation are not needed to prepare the mesoporous nitrogen-doped carbon aerogel, the pore size structure is rich, the preparation process is simple, the catalyst does not contain impurity metal elements, and the influence of the impurity metal elements on the catalytic performance of the catalyst is avoided.

title_en: Carbon-point-loaded silicon dioxide ball with long service life and room-temperature phosphorescence as well as controllable preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carbon-supported silica sphere with long service life and room temperature phosphorescence, a controllable preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of multifunctional materials, wherein the preparation steps are as follows: in-situ loading amine or phenol precursors in the growth process of SiO  2 , and further calcining to obtain the CDs@SiO  2  luminescent material which grows in a limited area and is uniformly dispersed. The fluorescence property and phosphorescence property of CDs and the grain size of CDs@SiO  2  are regulated and controlled by in-situ loading precursors with different types and contents and different calcination temperatures. The method provided by the invention solves the problems of complicated preparation steps, large solvent consumption and the like of the traditional solid luminescent material, the reagents, equipment and methods used in the experiment are safe and simple, and the yellow-green room-temperature phosphorescent material which has long service life (4954.73 ms) and stable luminescence is obtained, so that the method is expected to realize large-scale production and industrial popularization.

title_en: Preparation method of single nanowire electron source cathode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a single nanowire electron source cathode, which comprises the following steps: preparing an electron source substrate having an end surface and a flat surface which are disposed perpendicularly to each other; depositing a gold particle layer on the flat surface; capturing and moving the nanowire dispersed in the solution through laser, so that one end of the nanowire is positioned on the gold particle layer, the other end of the nanowire is suspended outside the electron source matrix, and rotating the nanowire through the laser to enable the nanowire to be perpendicular to the end face of the electron source matrix; and irradiating the gold particle layer by using ultraviolet laser to enable the gold particle layer to be instantaneously melted, and fixing the nanowire on an electron source matrix to obtain a single nanowire electron source cathode. The nanowire is ensured to be parallel to the axial direction of the electron source matrix, namely the normal direction of the end face, the single nanowire electron source cathode is ensured to have better collimation, and the nanowire can be welded on any electron source matrix by adopting the fixation of the gold particle layer.

title_en: Micro-nano multi-stage composite SERS substrate and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of SERS substrate preparation and application, and particularly discloses a micro-nano multi-stage composite SERS substrate, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the micro-nano multi-stage composite SERS substrate is prepared based on the combination of nanoindentation, focused ion beam processing, nanoparticle coating and transfer printing; the prepared micro-nano multi-stage composite SERS substrate has good Raman enhancement effect, can be used as a Raman enhancement substrate, finally realizes detection of lung cancer cell exosomes, and provides a new means for detection of lung cancer cell exosomes.

title_en: Preparation of silver nanocube-based plasma enhanced fluorescence sensor and application of silver nanocube-based plasma enhanced fluorescence sensor in berberine hydrochloride detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a silver nanocube-based plasma enhanced fluorescence sensor and application thereof in berberine hydrochloride detection, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of reacting isopropanol, TEOS and ammonia water in a silver nanocube solution to obtain a silver nanocube with a silicon dioxide coating; reacting with APTMS to obtain an amino-modified silica coated silver nanocube, reacting cadmium chloride, sodium tellurite and thioglycollic acid in an aqueous solution to obtain cadmium telluride quantum dots, grafting the cadmium telluride quantum dots onto the surface of the amino-modified silica coated silver nanocube by adding EDC, and modifying an aptamer onto the surface of the cadmium telluride quantum dots by adding EDC to obtain the plasma enhanced fluorescence sensor. The fluorescence sensor of the plasma enhanced fluorescence prepared by the invention has good stability, strong specificity and high sensitivity, can be used for the quantitative detection of berberine hydrochloride, and is more efficient, cost-saving and more accurate.

title_en: Metal element doped luminous carbon dot and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a metal element doped luminescent carbon dot, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the metal element doped luminescent carbon dot comprises carbon dots, metal cations loaded on the surfaces of the carbon dots, and reduced metal cations dispersed in the inner cores of the carbon dots; the reduced metal cations are prepared from the metal cations by photoinduction; the reduced metal cations form a coordinated state energy level structure in the carbon dot core, and the energy level structure generates an enhanced near infrared two-region absorption band and has the enhanced photo-thermal conversion performance of the two-region band. The prepared light-induced metal element doped luminescent carbon dot and protein, polypeptide or amino acid molecule composite preparation has increased particle size, enhanced fluorescence luminescence property and excellent near infrared two-region photo-thermal conversion property, can be used as a fluorescence imaging preparation and a photo-thermal preparation, and is applied to the fields of biological fluorescence imaging, photo-acoustic imaging, photo-thermal treatment and the like.

title_en: 1300MPa grade steel for pressure equipment, manufacturing, forming and post heat treatment method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides 1300MPa grade steel for pressure equipment, a manufacturing method, a forming method and a post heat treatment method thereof, wherein the steel comprises the following ：C 0.18％～0.22％、Si 0.15％～0.35％、Mn0.95％～1.30％、P≤0.010％、S≤0.003％、Cr 1.00％～1.50％、Mo 0.40％～0.60％、Ni1.30％～1.55％、V 0.06％～0.09％、Alt 0.015％～0.045％, weight percent of Fe and unavoidable impurities as the rest. The manufacturing method comprises smelting, continuous casting, heating, rolling and tempering, wherein the mechanical property of the steel after the forming heat treatment is 980 MPa-  p0.2 ≤1110MPa、1300MPa≤R m  -1430 MP, 550 MPa-  p0.2  MPa at 400 ℃, and the impact power at 0 ℃ is KV  2  -120J, so that the use requirement of the high-strength pressure-bearing equipment is ensured.

title_en: Platinum-based intermetallic compound catalyst, preparation method, membrane electrode and fuel cell
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a platinum-based intermetallic compound catalyst precursor, which comprises the following steps: s1, preparing a metal complex precursor; s2, carrying out primary heat treatment on the metal complex precursor to obtain the platinum-based intermetallic compound catalyst precursor. A method for producing a platinum-based intermetallic compound catalyst, the platinum-based intermetallic compound catalyst precursor obtained by the aforementioned production method being subjected to the following steps in order: s3, acid treatment; s4, secondary heat treatment. The preparation method of the high-order platinum-based intermetallic compound catalyst by using the organic matter containing the mercapto as the complexing agent has high controllability, and solves the problems of uncontrollable preparation, large particle size, relatively low ordering degree and the like of the conventional platinum-based intermetallic compound catalyst.

title_en: Application of molybdenum nano-particles in preparation of medicine for treating psoriasis
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of biological medicine, and provides an application of molybdenum nanoparticles in preparing a medicament for treating psoriasis. Further, the medicament form of the molybdenum nano-particles is molybdenum nano-particle suspension. The invention discovers that the nano molybdenum particles can reduce erythema, scaling and thickening of skin lesions and reduce infiltration of inflammatory cells in the skin lesions and expression of related inflammatory mediators in a psoriasis mouse model. After the molybdenum nano-particles are applied, the level of phosphorylated p65 in-vitro and in-vivo models is obviously reduced, and the molybdenum nano-particles reduce the generation of inflammatory mediators and the proliferation of keratinocytes through ROS/NF- κB axes, so that psoriasis symptoms are improved.

title_en: HPMA modified gold nano-cage drug loading system and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of pharmaceutical preparations, and particularly relates to an HPMA modified gold nano-cage drug-loading system, and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the HPMA modified gold nano-cage drug-loading system comprises the following steps: dissolving HPMA, MA-GG-NHNH  2  and an initiator in an organic solvent 1 for stirring reaction, dissolving by using an organic solvent 2 after the reaction is finished, collecting a precipitate, dissolving the precipitate, and centrifuging to prepare HPMA-NH  2 ; adding a vulcanizing agent solution into the borate buffer solution of the HPMA-NH  2 , and stirring at room temperature under inert gas to react to prepare HPMA-SH; adding the Gem solution into GNCs solution, and stirring for reaction to obtain Gem-GNCs; and adding the HPMA-SH solution into the Gem-GNCs solution, and stirring the mixture in a dark place for reaction to prepare the HPMA modified gold nano-cage drug delivery system Gem-GNCs@HPMA.

title_en: Carbon nano tube reinforcing material and preparation method thereof, composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a carbon nano tube reinforcing material and a preparation method thereof, and a composite material and a preparation method thereof. The carbon nano tube reinforced material and the preparation method thereof, and the composite material and the preparation method thereof can give consideration to both high strength and high corrosion resistance.

title_en: Difunctional Janus nano silicon dioxide and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a difunctional Janus nano silicon dioxide and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of ultraviolet light curing coatings. According to the invention, a silicon source and a fluorosilane compound are adopted to design nano SiO  2  into Janus nano particles, so that in the prepared dual-function Janus nano silicon dioxide, one side of the dual-function Janus nano silicon dioxide is modified with a fluorine-containing organic functional group chain segment, and the other side is modified with a polymerizable unsaturated double bond chain segment, so that the dual-function Janus nano silicon dioxide can be polymerized with monomers and oligomers in a photo-curing coating, and the photo-curing coating is filled with Janus nano SiO  2  with the fluorine-containing chain segment and the crosslinkable curing chain segment, so that the development of a high-performance novel functional coating can be realized, and the requirements of the material on special performances such as high wear resistance, corrosion resistance, fingerprint resistance, radiation resistance and the like can be met.

title_en: O (O)p-Ag1In monoatomic alloy electrocatalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an O  p -Ag 1  In monoatomic alloy electrocatalyst and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of electrocatalytic materials. Dispersing In  2 O 3  In water, adding AgNO  3 , stirring for reaction, performing light reaction, washing reactants after the reaction is finished, and drying to obtain Ag  1 -In 2 O 3 ; dispersing Ag  1 -In 2 O 3 , carbon black and naphthol In ethanol, carrying out ultrasonic treatment to obtain ink, dripping the ink on hydrophobic carbon paper, drying, and carrying out reduction reaction under a negative voltage condition to obtain the O  p -Ag 1  In monoatomic alloy electrocatalyst. The preparation method is simple, pollution-free, rich In raw materials and low In price, and the prepared O  p -Ag 1  In monoatomic alloy raw electrocatalyst has higher formic acid production selectivity, higher formic acid yield and superior stability, and solves the problem of low yield of the formic acid prepared by catalyzing carbon dioxide with the In-based electrocatalyst.

title_en: Preparation method of layered double hydroxide nano-sheet and application of layered double hydroxide nano-sheet in removal of perfluoro or polyfluoroalkyl substances in water body
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of preparation of layered double hydroxide nano sheets, and particularly relates to a preparation method of layered double hydroxide nano sheets and application thereof in removing perfluoro or polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) in water. The invention mixes inorganic strong alkali, water-soluble aluminum salt, water-soluble divalent metal salt and water, and carries out coprecipitation reaction under the condition that the pH value is more than 10, and the obtained coprecipitation product is dispersed in water for hydrothermal crystallization treatment, thus obtaining the layered double hydroxide nano sheet. The invention only adopts water as a reaction solvent, prepares the layered double hydroxide nano-sheets by a coprecipitation assisted hydrothermal method, and the obtained layered double hydroxide nano-sheets have high purity and high yield, simultaneously reduce the production cost, are more environment-friendly and are suitable for industrial production. The layered double hydroxide nano-sheet provided by the invention has a rapid removal effect and an ultrahigh adsorption capacity on perfluoro or polyfluoroalkyl substances, and is an adsorbent with application prospect in repairing PFAS in water.

title_en: Superfine cerium oxide polishing powder and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses superfine cerium oxide polishing powder and a preparation process thereof, wherein the preparation process comprises the following steps: dissolving solid cerium chloride in water to obtain cerium chloride solution; adding glacial acetic acid under the first stirring condition, standing, filtering, washing, and performing first drying to obtain solid cerium acetate; dissolving the extract in ethanol, and adding citric acid under a second stirring condition to obtain a pre-gel solution; heating the solution to 78 ℃, and forming cerium ion complex gel in a constant-temperature water bath under a third stirring condition; and (3) after standing and aging, performing secondary drying at 100-120 ℃ and then calcining to obtain the cerium oxide polishing powder. The polishing powder prepared by the process has uniform particle size, good dispersibility and high purity, and is suitable for polishing high-precision optical devices and electronic elements. Compared with the prior art, the polishing powder disclosed by the invention can effectively reduce scratches and improve polishing efficiency and product quality.

title_en: Application of nickel phosphide in water electrolysis hydrogen production process
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of nickel phosphide in a water electrolysis hydrogen production process, which is prepared by dissolving nickel metal salt in water to prepare nickel metal salt water solution, heating tetrabutylammonium hydroxide to be molten to obtain tetrabutylammonium hydroxide melt, adding the nickel metal salt water solution into the tetrabutylammonium hydroxide melt to react under a heating condition to generate a flaky nickel-containing precursor, and carrying out a phosphating reaction on a phosphorus source and the flaky nickel-containing precursor under the protection of protective atmosphere to generate the nickel phosphide with a flaky structure.

title_en: Fence-type titanium mesh-based manganese dioxide gradient composite anode plate for nonferrous metal electrodeposition and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fence-type titanium mesh-based manganese dioxide gradient composite anode plate for nonferrous metal electrodeposition and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of nonferrous metal electrodeposition. The composite anode plate comprises a titanium-coated copper-tin alloy-coated stainless steel bar conductive beam, a transition titanium plate and a fence type double-base titanium mesh strip manganese dioxide gradient composite anode, wherein the fence type double-base titanium mesh strip manganese dioxide gradient composite anode consists of a plurality of double-base titanium mesh strip manganese dioxide gradient composite electrodes which are vertically arranged; the fence-type double-base titanium mesh strip manganese dioxide gradient composite electrode sequentially comprises a titanium mesh strip substrate, a TiO  2  nano tube composite film layer, a Sn-Co-Zn-ZrOx bottom layer, a nano Cu-doped coated PS/SiO  2  and nano SiC particle alpha-PbO  2  composite intermediate layer and a nano Nb  2 O 5  and molybdenum-cobalt doped gamma-MnO  2  composite active layer from inside to outside, wherein Cu-Ag alloy nanowires and Sn-Sb alloy nanowires are sequentially arranged on nano tubes in the TiO  2  nano tube composite film layer; the titanium-coated copper-tin Bao Gangbang conductive beam sequentially comprises a steel rod, a copper-tin alloy layer and a titanium layer from inside to outside.

title_en: Three-dimensional multifunctional TiN-MXene-Co@CNTs heterostructure material, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of battery materials, in particular to a three-dimensional multifunctional TiN-MXene-Co@CNTs heterostructure material, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein multilayer Ti  3 C 2 T x  MXenes precipitate is obtained through a LiF/HCl stripping strategy, the precipitate material and 40-60 mL of methanol solution are added into a beaker and stirred at room temperature, co (NO  3 ) 2 ·6H 2  O and 2-methylimidazole reagent) is added into the beaker, stirring is carried out for 20-30 h under argon atmosphere and room temperature, the MXene-ZIF-67 precursor is obtained through cooling and centrifugal drying, the MXene-ZIF-67 precursor and urea are heated for 3h at the temperature rising rate of 5 ℃/min, the carbon nano tube (namely, tiN-MXene-Co@CNTs heterostructure) with cobalt nano particles encapsulated on TiN-MXene nano sheets is obtained after cooling, the TiN-MXene-Co@CNTs heterostructure is applied to a positive electrode material of a lithium sulfur battery, and the high specific capacity, high rate performance and long cycle performance of the lithium sulfur battery can be realized.

title_en: CuO/TiO2Preparation method of composite photocatalyst
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a CuO/TiO  2  composite photocatalyst, which comprises the following steps: (S1) adding TiO  2  powder into a reactor filled with alkali liquor, uniformly dispersing, then heating and refluxing under the assistance of microwaves for reaction, washing, drying and calcining to obtain TiO  2  nano-tubes; (S2) under the ultrasonic condition, soaking the TiO  2  nano tube in an alcohol-water solution containing organic carboxylic acid copper and polyalcohol, after the soaking is finished, carrying out suction filtration, washing a solid phase, pre-sintering at 100-150 ℃, and then heating to 400-500 ℃ for calcination to obtain the CuO/TiO  2  composite photocatalyst. The invention uses copper organic carboxylate as copper source. The CuO/TiO  2  composite photocatalyst with excellent photocatalytic performance is prepared by taking the polyalcohol as a dispersing agent.

title_en: Carbon dot with photocatalysis sterilization and immunity induction functions, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of biological functional materials, and particularly relates to a carbon dot with photocatalysis sterilization and immunity induction functions, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein an aniline compound and amino acid are dissolved by deionized water, concentrated sulfuric acid is added, and after hydrothermal reaction, a green fluorescent carbon dot with the size smaller than 5nm is obtained. The carbon dot can generate various free radicals after being irradiated by ultraviolet light and visible light, has extremely strong oxidation characteristics, and can be applied to the preparation of bactericides and plant immunity inducers.

title_en: Method for producing diamond particles
abstract_en: Provided is a method for producing diamond particles, which can synthesize diamond particles in a solution by a simpler method. A step (S1) of preparing a mixed solution by mixing an inorganic salt such as a metal halide, a metal oxyhalide, a metal nitrate, a metal phosphate, or a metal sulfate with an organic solvent such as an alcohol-based solvent, a ketone-based solvent, an ester-based solvent, an amide-based solvent, a hydrocarbon-based solvent, an aromatic-based solvent, a cellosolve-based solvent, or a halogen-based solvent, which contains 10% by volume or more of carbon atoms; and a curing step (S2) of maintaining the mixed solution at an arbitrary temperature for a predetermined period of time to produce diamond particles in the solution.

title_en: Self-evolution double-emission long-afterglow-based nano probe, construction method and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation and application of a self-evolution double-emission long-afterglow-based nano probe, belonging to the technical fields of advanced functional materials and biological medicines. In particular to a double-emission nano probe based on a long-afterglow nano material with both 537nm and 700nm double-wavelength emission, which is used for imaging and treating lung metastasis. Acid-degradable green luminescent nanoparticles (ZGMC) with good afterglow and enhanced chemical kinetic therapy potential are synthesized and optimized, ZGMC is further coupled with ultra-small red luminescence PLNPs, and cell penetrating peptide is used for modification, so that a self-evolution probe ZGMC@ZGC-TAT is obtained. The nano probe integrates phosphorescence triggered by tumor microenvironment and size self-evolution, can realize tumor specificity ratio imaging, realizes the enhanced chemical power treatment performance released according to needs by consuming GSH, obviously reduces the size of the probe at a tumor part, ensures rapid metabolism, ensures accurate imaging and effective treatment of lung metastasis, and has wide prospect in the fields of biological imaging and treatment.

title_en: Red fluorescent silicon nanoparticle probe for detecting pH, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a red fluorescent silicon nanoparticle probe for detecting pH, which comprises the following steps: the invention takes 3-aminopropyl trimethoxy silane, 2-nitro-4-amino diphenylamine and dithiothreitol as raw materials, and generates a red fluorescent silicon nanoparticle probe through a microwave reaction method. The preparation method provided by the invention is extremely simple, and the prepared water-soluble silicon nano particles have remarkably enhanced fluorescence along with the reduction of pH, and have good fluorescence linear response and good reversibility at the pH of 3.0-9.0. The invention also discloses application of the red fluorescent silicon nanoparticle probe in pH detection in an aqueous solution and cancer cells.

title_en: Preparation method of titanium dioxide/N-doped carbon lithium-sulfur battery positive electrode material with pipe-in-pipe structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a titanium dioxide/N-doped carbon lithium-sulfur battery positive electrode material with a pipe sleeve structure. The method adopts cellulose as a frame template and a carbon source, and utilizes the partial disassembly and assembly behavior of cellulose, in-situ carbon coating and high-temperature N doping methods in the hydrothermal treatment process to prepare the titanium dioxide/N-doped carbon lithium-sulfur battery anode material with the pipe sleeve structure. The material has the following advantages: (1) the shape and structure of the material are adjustable. The number of layers of the pipe can be regulated and controlled by controlling the hydrothermal temperature (120-180 ℃) and the time (15 min-60 h). (2) The material has the dual characteristics of anatase, rutile two phases and nitrogen doped carbon, overcomes the defects of low conductivity of elemental sulfur and poor diffusion capability of lithium ions of the existing titanium dioxide, and has excellent cycling stability and high charge-discharge specific capacity; (3) The invention adopts cellulose as a structural frame and a carbon source, is low in cost and easy to obtain, has little pollution and low energy consumption, and is easy to realize large-scale production. (4) In the process of assembling the battery, the electrode plate is directly manufactured without adding any external conductive agent, so that the preparation process is simplified, and the electrode raw materials are saved. The prepared titanium dioxide/N-doped carbon material with the pipe-in-pipe structure can be used as a positive electrode material of a lithium-sulfur battery, and is expected to be widely applied to the fields of supercapacitors, photolytic water, dye-sensitized solar cells and the like.

title_en: Preparation and application of rod-shaped nano array composite copper material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a rod-shaped nano array composite copper material. The preparation method of the rod-shaped nano array composite copper material comprises the following steps: depositing nano copper on the surface of the carbon paper by adopting a timing current method; soaking the carbon paper deposited with the nano copper in an alkaline solution to convert the nano copper into copper hydroxide, and then pyrolyzing to obtain the cuprous oxide-loaded carbon paper; and (3) reconstructing cuprous oxide loaded on the surface of the carbon paper by adopting electrochemical in-situ reduction to obtain the carbon paper loaded with the rod-shaped nano array composite copper material. The stable coexistence of copper and oxidation state thereof in the rod-shaped nano array composite copper material endows the excellent nitrate reduction reaction (NO 3 RR) performance, and can effectively convert nitrate in water into ammonia, thus showing the great potential of the catalyst in the aspects of treating nitrate polluted water and efficiently producing ammonia.

title_en: Diode device based on single carbon nanotube structure and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a diode device based on a single carbon nano tube and a manufacturing method thereof. The schottky diode is formed by a metal terminal and a semiconductor terminal, the metal terminal is formed by axial cutting, the metal terminal has no band gap, the semiconductor terminal has a band gap larger than 0, and the metal terminal and the semiconductor terminal are contacted to form a schottky junction. The p-n junction diode forms a p-type region by doping boron at one end of the carbon nanotube, and the other end is cut and led with overhang electrons to form an n-type region, so that a p-n junction is formed at the contact position. The diode device and the manufacturing method thereof solve the problem of forming areas with different conductive properties on a single nanotube, break through the size limitation of the existing semiconductor technology, realize the nanoscale diode device with the diameter smaller than a few nanometers and even smaller than one nanometer, and provide a new scheme for miniaturized electronic devices.

title_en: Electric imprinting template for complex non-planar surface difficult to bear pressure, design and preparation method
abstract_en: An electric imprinting template for complex non-planar surfaces difficult to bear pressure, a design and a preparation method thereof, comprising a backing layer, a conductive layer, a discrete supporting layer and a structural layer which are sequentially arranged; firstly, carrying out surface analysis of a non-flat substrate, presetting voltage impression plate structure parameters, judging whether a discrete supporting layer fails or not under the parameters, and finally, carrying out voltage impression plate manufacturing; the preparation method comprises the steps of firstly preparing a backing layer, then preparing a conductive layer on the backing layer, then connecting a discrete supporting layer on the conductive layer, and finally connecting a structural layer on the discrete supporting layer; the invention is not only suitable for non-flat surfaces to realize the patterning of the substrate surface, thereby improving the substrate performance, but also reducing the load born by the substrate, reducing the template loss and improving the reuse rate of the template.

title_en: Method for preparing iodine-nitrogen doped carbon quantum dots based on solvent-free pyrolysis method, product and application
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for preparing iodine-nitrogen doped carbon quantum dots based on a solvent-free pyrolysis method, a product and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of carbon quantum dots. According to the invention, laver is ground into powder and then mixed with urea, the mixture is heated in an oil bath under magnetic stirring, then cooled to room temperature, deionized water is added to dissolve solid, and the solid is centrifuged, filtered and dialyzed to obtain the iodine-nitrogen doped carbon quantum dots. The invention prepares the I, N-CQDs with high stability and good water solubility by a solvent-free pyrolysis method, avoids the defects of high temperature, high pressure and a large amount of solvents required by the traditional hydrothermal method, and the obtained I, N-CQDs have good fluorescence stability and fluorescence performance and can be used for Fe  3+  determination in environmental samples.

title_en: Magnetically induced oriented titanium carbide ferrite composite film and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a magnetic induction oriented titanium carbide ferrite composite film, and a preparation method and application thereof.
