The invention solves the defects of single electromagnetic wave loss mode and lower electromagnetic shielding efficiency of the MXene titanium carbide material, and the developed magnetic induction orientation strategy can realize homopolar arrangement of the introduced ferrite nano-particle magnetic poles, enrich the pores of the MXene titanium carbide ferrite composite film in the nano-scale control material structure, and induce the orientation of the MXene titanium carbide sheets in the homopolar arrangement process of the ferrite magnetic poles. In the preparation process of ferrite nano particles, the dispersibility of ferrite in MXene titanium carbide gel is improved by loading citric acid groups on the surface of ferrite, and the interaction between ferrite and MXene titanium carbide is enhanced. The prepared magnetically induced oriented MXene titanium carbide ferrite composite film shows an electromagnetic shielding effectiveness of 62.8 dB on average and a Herman's orientation factor of 0.938 at most in the range of 2-18 GHz.

title_en: Method for batch preparation of surface-enhanced Raman spectrum substrate containing internal standard of silent region
abstract_en: A method for preparing surface-enhanced Raman spectrum substrates containing silence area internal standards in batches. The method comprises the steps of synthesizing Au@CN@Au nanoparticles, and assembling Au@CN@Au nanoparticle coated glass slides in batches by a centrifugal method to serve as a surface-enhanced Raman spectrum SERS substrate. The SERS is an ultrasensitive detection method, can provide a molecular fingerprint spectrum and perform quantitative analysis, and the existing substrate preparation method is complex, expensive, time-consuming and lacks detection reproducibility. The method has the advantages of simplicity, high efficiency, low cost, high sensitivity and good reproducibility, and can uniformly deposit the metal nano particles on the glass sheet only in 3 minutes to obtain a plurality of SERS reinforced substrates containing internal standard spectrum peaks in the silence area at one time. The substrates have good uniformity in the substrates and repeatability among the substrates, and can be applied to trace detection of chemical substances, label-free identification of clinical samples, tracking analysis of metabolites in the cell culture process and the like.

title_en: Preparation method of superfine uniform single-phase tungsten-rhenium powder
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of superfine uniform single-phase tungsten-rhenium alloy powder, which takes ammonium metatungstate and ammonium rhenate as raw materials, uniformly mixes the raw materials in a liquid-liquid mixing mode according to a proportion, evaporates the uniformly mixed liquid in a water bath kettle to obtain a colloidal mixture, dries the colloidal mixture in a blast drying oven to obtain precursor powder, calcines the precursor powder in a muffle furnace to obtain mixed oxide, and then carries out nitridation decomposition on the mixed oxide in a tube furnace to obtain nano tungsten-rhenium powder. The nano tungsten rhenium powder of the present invention has a single phase. The D50 of the nano tungsten-rhenium powder is 40-50nm, the D90 is 80-100nm, the oxygen content is not more than 800ppm, the rhenium content deviation is lower than 1.5%, and the XRD result is a single BCC W phase. The preparation method has the advantages of simple raw material acquisition and preparation process and low equipment requirement, and can realize batch production of superfine uniform single-phase tungsten-rhenium alloy powder.

title_en: Corrosion-resistant cleaning agent for electric mechanical equipment of motor car and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cleaning agents, in particular to an anti-corrosion cleaning agent for motor car electrical and mechanical equipment and a preparation method thereof, and the anti-corrosion cleaning agent comprises the following components in parts by weight: 15-25 parts of hydrocarbon, 12-16 parts of nonionic surfactant, 5-8 parts of bentonite, 5-8 parts of sodium carboxymethylcellulose, 3-6 parts of magnesium aluminum silicate, 4-6 parts of anti-corrosion material, 1-3 parts of dispersing agent, 2-6 parts of complexing agent, 1-3 parts of solubilizer and 40-50 parts of water. When the corrosion-resistant cleaning agent is used for wiping and cleaning the surface of mechanical equipment, a coating can be formed on the surface of metal to play a role in isolation, corrosion of corrosive media to a matrix is blocked, and composite nano materials and molybdenum disulfide nano sheets contained in the corrosion-resistant materials can move relatively to be embedded together to form a compact continuous lamellar structure, so that a more complete blocking effect on the external corrosive media is realized, a very strong corrosion-resistant effect is realized, and the mechanical equipment can be better used in a severe environment.

title_en: Electrostatic excitation sealing multi-unit micro-electromechanical actuator and production method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electrostatic excitation micro-electromechanical actuator and a manufacturing method thereof. The structure of the actuator includes a set of electrostatic capacitive elements that generate a localized torque when electrostatically energized. The peripherally fixed and excited cell structure deforms in a vertical direction in a range of several micrometers or tens of micrometers in a number of ways, allowing the functions of an AFM sensor or a microfluidic controller to be performed. The advantages of such peripheral clamping structures are higher operating frequencies, higher AFM imaging throughput, and higher output energy. Moreover, it is itself gas tight, making it less sensitive to contamination and less damping when the actuator is operated in liquid. All embodiments of the invention can be fabricated using CMOS compatible MEMS micromachining techniques based on wafer bonding and bulk micromachining processes.

title_en: Spherical porous silicon-carbon composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a spherical porous silicon-carbon composite material, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of lithium ion battery material preparation. The preparation method of the spherical porous silicon-carbon composite material comprises the steps of adding polystyrene microspheres into a resin solution, adding scandium-metal organic framework composite material, dispersing uniformly, carbonizing at 700-900 ℃ after drying, activating by 1050-1250 ℃ by water vapor to obtain a porous carbon material, transferring into a fluidized bed, heating to 400-600 ℃, introducing silane mixed gas, depositing for 30-300min under the negative pressure condition, introducing heteroatom gas for passivation, and depositing amorphous carbon by a vapor deposition method to obtain the silicon-carbon composite material. According to the invention, the compressive strength of the material is improved by utilizing the specific capacity of the internal scandium-doped lifting material and the porous structure formed after carbonization of the metal frame, so that the expansion is reduced, and the cycle performance is improved.

title_en: Graphitized mesoporous carbon carrier with adjustable pore diameter and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a graphitized mesoporous carbon carrier with an adjustable pore diameter and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the field of mesoporous carbon material preparation. The method comprises the following steps: (1) Adding metal acetate and magnesium salt into water, and performing ultrasonic dispersion to obtain a uniformly dispersed mixed solution; (2) Carrying out rotary steaming, stirring and drying on the obtained uniformly dispersed mixed solution to obtain a solid powder mixture; (3) Grinding the obtained solid powder mixture, and then placing the ground solid powder mixture into an inert atmosphere tube furnace for carbonization heat treatment to obtain a heat treatment product; (4) And (3) carrying out acid washing on the obtained heat treatment product, and then filtering and drying to obtain the graphitized mesoporous carbon carrier. According to the invention, the metal acetate is used as a carbon source and a graphitization catalyst, the magnesium salt is used as a template and a pore-forming agent, the prepared mesoporous carbon material carrier has the characteristics of graphitization and high specific surface area, the pore diameter is between 2 and 100nm, and the pore diameter of mesoporous carbon can be regulated by changing the preparation process conditions, so that the pore diameter is adjustable.

title_en: Nano nickel and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides nano nickel and a preparation method thereof, which relate to the technical field of preparation of nano crystal metal materials and comprise the following steps: dissolving NiSO  4 ·6H 2 O、NiCl 2 ·6H 2 O、H 3 BO 3  and sodium dodecyl sulfate in deionized water, stirring and dissolving, filtering with filter paper, and removing impurity atoms in the solution by preplating; then adding additives saccharin sodium and 1, 4-butynediol into the filtrate to obtain plating solution; and (3) performing electrodeposition: preparing nano nickel by adopting a direct current deposition method; wherein, the technological parameters of the direct current deposition are as follows: the current density is 1 to 5mA/cm  2 . According to the invention, by reducing the current density in the direct current deposition process, the bulk nano nickel with the thickness of hundreds of micrometers and the uniform grain size of less than 10nm can be prepared.

title_en: Nano-porous structure high-entropy sulfide and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electrocatalytic materials, and particularly relates to a nano-porous structure high-entropy sulfide catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof. Sulfide molecular formula (CoFeNiMnZn)  3 S 4 ; the high-entropy sulfide is of a single-phase structure, the diameter of a single particle is 100-200 nm, and the inside of the particle is rich in a porous structure. The invention uses organic micromolecule to chelate and anchor metal ions, so that a plurality of metal ions are uniformly and highly dispersed, and the single-phase nano porous high-entropy sulfide has good electrochemical performance by the process strengthening technology of dispersion-low temperature heat treatment-separation-secondary heat treatment.

title_en: Curved graphene and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides curved graphene and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of carbon material preparation. The preparation method of the curved graphene comprises the steps of providing a graphite carbon material, placing the graphite carbon material in pure water, bombarding the surface of the graphite carbon material by utilizing electron beams to form a colloidal suspension, and alternately emitting ultrasonic wave combinations of low frequency, medium frequency and high frequency into the colloidal suspension to obtain the curved graphene aqueous solution. The prepared curved graphene aqueous solution has good dispersibility.

title_en: CsPbBr3Preparation method of-Au heterogeneous superlattice
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a CsPbBr  3  -Au heterogeneous superlattice, and belongs to the technical field of material self-assembly. Mixing a metal source and a cover ligand mercaptan in benzene which is an organic solvent, adding a boron amine complex into the mixture, stirring until reduction is completed, concentrating and dissolving the mixture into benzene or toluene solvent, mixing CsPbBr  3  toluene solution and concentrated Au solution, blowing and mixing the mixture uniformly by a liquid-transfering gun, self-assembling, and drying to obtain the CsPbBr  3  -Au heterogeneous superlattice structure. According to the invention, thiol-coated Au nano particles are prepared, so that the thiol-coated Au nano particles are self-assembled and combined with oleic acid and oleylamine-coated CsPbBr  3  quantum dots to form a heterogeneous superlattice through electrostatic interaction, aggregation of the nano particles is prevented, and a more ordered heterogeneous superlattice structure is formed; the method realizes the self-assembly of two nano materials with different shapes and types into a heterogeneous superlattice, spherical Au nano particles are orderly arranged around the cubic CsPbBr  3  quantum dots, and the heterogeneous superlattice can be used for preparing photoelectric devices.

title_en: Tubular sandwich structure anode active material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of batteries, and particularly relates to a tubular sandwich structure anode active material, and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the tubular sandwich structure anode active material comprises the following steps: (1) preparation of tubular PPy; (2) Preparing the tubular sandwich structure anode active material by using the tubular PPy as a carrier through solvothermal reaction and an annealing process; the anode active material of the tubular sandwich structure is C@Fe  x Sn y  S/C. The tubular sandwich structure anode active material has high specific discharge capacity (the maximum specific discharge capacity at the first week can reach 1050.1 mAh/g under 200 mA/g current density), good cycling stability and excellent rate capability, and has large sodium ion diffusion coefficient and high pseudo-capacitance contribution rate.

title_en: Method for regulating particle size and crystalline phase of nano alumina by additive
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for regulating particle size and crystal phase of nano alumina by using an additive, and belongs to the technical field of regulation and control of crystal phase of nano Al  2 O 3 . The method comprises the steps of mixing hydrated aluminum hydroxide, an additive and a solvent according to the weight ratio of (10-20): 100: (1-5) mixing to obtain a mixed solution, and then calcining the mixed solution at 800-1200 ℃ to prepare nano alumina; the mass fraction and the types of the additives in the mixed solution are regulated, and the calcination temperature is controlled, so that the crystal phase and the grain size of the obtained nano alumina can be regulated and controlled. According to the method, the types and the contents of additives are regulated, the surface groups of boehmite particles are modified, the energy distribution is regulated, the energy of an electron field on the outer surface of the particles during roasting is promoted to be improved, the induced agglomeration of a thermal effect during the roasting is inhibited, and the process control of the preparation of the alumina nano particles is realized.

title_en: Directional growth sulfur-nickel-iron oxyhydroxide composite material, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a directional growth sulfur-nickel-iron oxyhydroxide composite material, a preparation method and application thereof, and the preparation method of the directional growth sulfur-nickel-iron oxyhydroxide composite material comprises the following steps: step 1, treating a substrate; step 2, synthesizing an S-NF material; step 3, synthesizing S-Ni, feOOH-M material: and (2) dissolving nickel salt, complexing agent and ferric salt in a predetermined proportion in water or saline solution, performing ultrasonic dissolution to form a homogeneous solution, placing the S-NF obtained in the step (2) in the homogeneous solution, performing electrodeposition in a magnetic field at a constant current density, and drying to obtain the directional growth sulfur-nickel-iron hydroxide composite material. The S-Ni, feOOH-M material disclosed by the invention utilizes chemical bond adsorption of FeOOH and NiOOH in an electrodeposition process, so that active metal sites are uniformly dispersed, the density of the active sites is improved, meanwhile, the active sites are ensured not to fall off in an OER reaction process, and the AEM+LOM path in an electrochemical process provides high activity and stability for integral water separation, so that the method is an effective means for realizing industrialized electrocatalytic hydrogen evolution.

title_en: Anti-analysis interference sensing coating based on reduced bovine serum albumin crosslinked nano gold
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-analysis interference sensing coating based on reduced bovine serum albumin crosslinked nano gold, and relates to the technical field of electrochemical detection. The invention also discloses a preparation method of the preparation method, which comprises the following steps: adding bovine serum albumin powder into ultrapure water to obtain bovine serum albumin solution; mixing sodium borohydride powder with ice water to obtain sodium borohydride solution; mixing a bovine serum albumin solution and a sodium borohydride solution, and reacting at room temperature to obtain a reduced bovine serum albumin solution; adding nano gold solution into the reduced bovine serum albumin solution, uniformly mixing, preparing a film on the surface of an electrode material by a drop casting method, and standing overnight to obtain the anti-analysis interference sensing coating based on the reduced bovine serum albumin crosslinked nano gold. The coating can effectively prevent nonspecific adsorption and improve the output of sensing signals of interfaces, has strong adhesive force, is simple, quick and efficient in preparation method, and is easy for large-scale production.

title_en: Carrier proximity mask and method for forming structure
abstract_en: A carrier proximity mask and a method of forming a structure. The carrier proximity mask and methods of assembling and using the same may include: a first carrier body, a second carrier body, and a set of one or more clamps are provided. The first carrier body may have one or more openings formed as a proximity mask for forming structures on the first side of the substrate. The first carrier body and the second carrier body may have one or more contact regions aligned with one or more contact regions on the first side and the second side of the substrate. The set of one or more clamps may clamp the substrate between the first carrier body and the second carrier body at the contact region to suspend a working region of the substrate between the first carrier body and the second carrier body. The opening is used to define an edge to convolve the beam to form a structure on the substrate.

title_en: Photovoltaic module surface self-cleaning anti-reflection coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a self-cleaning anti-reflection coating for the surface of a photovoltaic module and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the field of solar cells. According to the invention, firstly, the sol containing the silica hollow nano particles and the sol containing the titanium dioxide nano particles are prepared, the silica hollow nano particle sol, the titanium dioxide nano particle sol and the binder are sequentially formed into a composite coating on the surface of the photovoltaic glass in a certain film forming mode, and finally, the composite coating is calcined for a period of time at a certain temperature, so that the titanium dioxide is converted into an anatase crystal phase, and the self-cleaning effect is realized. The prepared coating nano particles are uniformly distributed, have good anti-reflection effect, super-hydrophilicity of the surface and photocatalytic activity, and also have good damp-heat resistance and wear resistance.

title_en: TADF guiding modification endoplasmic reticulum targeting photosensitizer and application thereof in tumor immunotherapy
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of tumor immunotherapy, and in particular relates to a TADF guiding modification endoplasmic reticulum targeting photosensitizer and application thereof in tumor immunotherapy. The photosensitizer has a structure shown in a formula I:  r is selected from H,  、 、 。

title_en: Fluorescence/colorimetric dual-mode biological sensing film and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fluorescence/colorimetric dual-mode biological sensing film and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the detection field, wherein the fluorescence/colorimetric dual-mode biological sensing film comprises a base film, a fixed layer and iron-doped carbon quantum dots loaded on the fixed layer are attached to the base film; wherein the fixing layer is a mixed coating formed on the base film by a compound containing phenol group and enzyme; the iron-doped carbon quantum dots are formed by organic carbon sources and iron ions on the fixed layer. The biological sensing film has strong interface coupling effect and excellent space three-dimensional configuration, and endows the biological sensing film with high sensitivity and quick response capability.

title_en: Manufacturing method of MEMS probe based on ion beam etching process
abstract_en: The application provides a manufacturing method of an MEMS probe based on an ion beam etching process, which is to manufacture the MEMS probe based on a subtraction process of the Ion Beam Etching (IBE) process, and bombard the surface of a substrate material by adopting ion beams with certain energy to cause the atoms of the substrate material to sputter, thereby achieving the etching purpose. Because the depth-to-width ratio of the probe structure is large, the resolution can be greatly improved by adopting ion beam etching, and meanwhile, the electroplating procedure in the traditional processing technology is avoided, and the influence of the internal stress introduced by electroplating on the deformation of the slender probe and the like can be avoided.

title_en: Flexible surface-enhanced Raman substrate and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flexible surface-enhanced Raman substrate and a preparation method thereof, wherein the surface of the substrate contains metal nano gaps arranged in an array, the width of each metal nano gap is 3-5 nm, and the effect of generating a local electromagnetic field is strong enough due to the fact that the width of each metal nano gap is small enough, and the substrate has excellent detection sensitivity. The preparation method of the substrate is very simple, and the substrate can be prepared by self-assembling deposited metal and molecules and then stripping and transferring, and has excellent repeatability in surface-enhanced Raman scattering spectrum research.

title_en: Manufacturing method of metal-free current collector lithium battery positive electrode plate and positive electrode plate
abstract_en: The manufacturing method of the metal-free current collector lithium battery positive electrode sheet comprises the steps of firstly coating positive electrode slurry on the front surface of a carbon nano tube film to obtain a single-sided blank, then drying the single-sided blank to obtain a single-sided electrode sheet, coating positive electrode slurry on the back surface of the carbon nano tube film to obtain a double-sided blank, and then drying the double-sided blank to obtain the double-sided electrode sheet, namely the positive electrode sheet; the preparation process of the carbon nanotube film and the preparation process of the positive electrode slurry all involve the cooperation of the excitation van der Waals force between the carbon nanotubes and NMP. The design can not only avoid the defects caused by the adoption of the metal current collector and the elimination of the aluminum foil current collector, but also ensure the conductivity of the final positive pole piece, increase the firmness and ensure the production efficiency to be high.

title_en: High-entropy alloy nano particle and monoatomic coexisting lithium-air battery catalyst as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-entropy alloy nanoparticle and monoatomic coexisting lithium-air battery catalyst as well as a preparation method and application thereof. According to the invention, a mild oil phase co-reduction method is utilized to synthesize six-element high-entropy alloy nano particles, the six-element high-entropy alloy nano particles are loaded on a carbon nano tube, then a dealloying solvent is used for selectively etching away surface non-noble metal elements, so that core-shell structure nano particles with amorphous Pt shell layers coated on HEA surfaces are formed, and meanwhile, partial fallen Pt single atoms can be captured by intrinsic defects on the carbon nano tube, so that a synergistic catalyst of HEA@Pt-Pt  SAs /CNTs is formed. The catalyst has the advantages of simple preparation method and low cost, and is suitable for large-scale production. The catalyst obtained by the invention can be directly applied to a lithium air battery anode catalyst, has extremely high catalytic activity, and the two active sites act cooperatively to optimize the morphology of a discharge product Li  2 O 2 , so that the electrochemical properties such as capacity, cycle performance and the like of the lithium air battery are greatly improved.

title_en: Preparation method of ginsenoside Rh4 lipid nanoparticle sustained-release preparation
abstract_en: The application discloses a preparation method of a ginsenoside Rh4 lipid nanoparticle sustained release preparation. In the preparation method, the PLGA-PEG-PLGA gel particles loaded with ginsenoside Rh4 are firstly prepared, then liposome encapsulation is carried out on the particles, and then high-pressure homogenization or ultrasonic disruption is carried out, so that the ginsenoside Rh4 lipid nano particles are formed. In the preparation of the ginsenoside Rh4 loaded PLGA-PEG-PLGA gel particles, triblock copolymer PLGA-PEG-PLGA is used as a gel material, and toxic and harmful organic solvents such as diethyl ether, acetone, ethanol, trichloromethane and the like are not used at all, so that the safety of the process and the product is improved. The ginsenoside Rh4 lipid nanoparticle has good stability, can effectively slow down the release speed of the drug, achieves the slow release effect, has wide application prospect, and has reference significance for the development of a drug slow release preparation.

title_en: Method for preparing functional material and organic fertilizer by synergy of anaerobic fermentation residues and application of functional material and organic fertilizer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing functional materials and organic fertilizers by synergy of anaerobic fermentation residues and application thereof. The method comprises the following steps: mixing biogas residues and biogas slurry according to a mass ratio of 1: (3-12) mixing, carrying out co-hydrothermal treatment for 3-6 h at 220-280 ℃ by using methane energy, and carrying out solid-liquid separation to obtain a liquid phase product and a solid phase product; the liquid phase product can be used for preparing liquid organic biogas fertilizer or nano carbon quantum dot material, and the solid phase product can be used for preparing solid organic biogas fertilizer or modified biochar material. The method fully utilizes the characteristics of the biogas slurry and the biogas residues and the advantages of the hydrothermal reaction, and the prepared organic fertilizer and functional material products are various in variety, wide in application range and high in economic value. The invention solves the industrial pain point of difficult digestion of the fermentation residues, realizes harmless, recycling and high-valued utilization of the anaerobic fermentation residues, and has remarkable economic and environmental benefits.

title_en: Preparation method and application of carbon dot modified composite membrane
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of packaging materials, and particularly discloses a preparation method and application of a carbon dot modified composite film, wherein the preparation process comprises the following steps: s1, preparing and separating carbon points: mixing rutin as a carbon source with ethylenediamine in deionized water to form a uniform solution, placing the uniform solution in a high-pressure reaction kettle for heating reaction, and after the reaction is finished, obtaining a rutin carbon point aqueous solution through centrifugation, filtration by a filter membrane and dialysis by a dialysis membrane; s2, preparing a composite membrane emulsion: mixing sodium carboxymethylcellulose water solution, starch, rutin carbon dots, glycerol, cera flava and soybean lecithin solution, heating and stirring to obtain gelatinized solution; s3, ultrasonic treatment: carrying out ultrasonic treatment on the gelatinized solution obtained in the step S2; s4, molding: and (3) taking the solution subjected to ultrasonic treatment in the step (S3) as a raw material to prepare a film, thereby obtaining the carbon point modified sodium carboxymethylcellulose/starch/beeswax composite film. The process is environment-friendly, and the prepared product has excellent mechanical property, water blocking property, and good antibacterial property and oxidation resistance.

title_en: Zwitterionic chemiluminescent active oxygen probe for removing through kidneys as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a zwitterionic chemiluminescent active oxygen probe for removing by kidneys and a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of ROS (reactive oxygen species) responsive fluorescent nano probe preparation. The preparation method comprises the following steps: s1, preparing a thiol ligand MSA protected MSa-auNPs by a chemical reduction method by taking NaBH  3  CN as a reducing agent; s2, preparing the nano probe ABEI-MSa-auNPs on the surface of the MSa-auNPs prepared in the step S1 through covalent bond chemical coupling. According to the zwitterionic chemiluminescent active oxygen probe for removing through the kidney, the preparation method and the application thereof, chemiluminescent molecules ABEI are chemically coupled on the surface of MSa-auNPs with near infrared fluorescence property through covalent bonds, the nano probe ABEI-MSa-auNPs is prepared, the protein adsorption of the nano probe in the body is effectively inhibited through the charge pairing induced zwitterionic effect, the clearance rate of the kidney to the nano probe is increased, and the ROS level of a disease part in the body can be rapidly and sensitively detected through double-channel ratio urine analysis.

title_en: Electrochemical auxiliary method for preparing graphene-like graphite material
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electrochemical auxiliary method for preparing a graphene-like graphite material, which comprises the following steps: immersing the first graphite electrode plate serving as an anode and a light metal plate serving as a cathode in electrolyte, and performing electrochemical reaction under 0.1-1 mA current by adopting a constant current discharge method until the electrochemical reaction is stopped when the voltage difference between the anode and the cathode is 0.01-0.1V to obtain a second graphite electrode plate; taking out the second graphite electrode plate from the electrolyte and placing the second graphite electrode plate in a water vapor environment with the temperature of 150-300 ℃ for 5 min-1 h to obtain a third graphite electrode plate; and washing, drying and crushing the third graphite electrode plate to obtain the graphene-like graphite material. The invention adopts an electrochemical auxiliary intercalation method and utilizes the heat energy of chemical reaction to finish the effective stripping of the graphite sheet, and the number of layers of the graphene-like graphite material can be effectively controlled through electrochemical auxiliary.

title_en: Method for improving water evaporation power generation performance based on surface plasmon effect and water evaporation power generation device
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a method for improving water evaporation power generation performance based on a surface plasmon effect and a water evaporation power generation device, and belongs to the technical field of green energy power generation. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining graphene oxide suspension; adding an ascorbic acid and deionized water mixed solution into the graphene oxide suspension, and performing heating treatment to obtain a reduced graphene oxide aqueous solution; carrying out suction filtration and drying treatment on the reduced graphene oxide aqueous solution to obtain a reduced graphene oxide/filter paper composite film; pouring the composite film into thermal evaporation equipment, and evaporating gold-plated nano particles on the reduced graphene oxide to obtain a gold/reduced graphene oxide/filter paper film; and installing conductive parts at two ends of the film to obtain the water evaporation power generation device. According to the method, a gold nanoparticle array is prepared on the reduced graphene oxide film by a thermal evaporation method, and the surface plasmon resonance effect of gold nanoparticles is utilized to improve the water evaporation power generation performance.

title_en: Packaging structure and packaging method of MEMS chip
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of semiconductor chip packaging, in particular to a packaging structure of an MEMS chip and a packaging method thereof, which comprises a packaging shell, wherein the middle part of the packaging shell is provided with a packaging cavity, the middle part of the inner wall of the packaging cavity is fixedly provided with a chip positioning structure for limiting the MEMS chip, guide chips are fixedly arranged on two sides of the inner wall of the packaging cavity, a top cover structure for sealing and packaging the MEMS chips is arranged at the top of the packaging cavity, and a plurality of reserved pin holes are formed on two sides of the packaging shell. According to the MEMS chip packaging structure, a detachable split type pin design is adopted, the pin assembly is directly contacted with the guide chip in a pressing mode, so that the conduction of the chip is completed, when the packaged MEMS chip is installed and used, once a certain pin is bent or damaged, the corresponding pin can be quickly and pointedly removed for replacement, and the replacement is simple and convenient, so that the fault rate of the chip during installation is reduced, and the service life is prolonged.

title_en: Quantum dot composition, light emitting device and electronic device prepared using the same
abstract_en: Embodiments provide quantum dot compositions, light emitting devices and electronic devices prepared using the quantum dot compositions. The quantum dot composition includes a quantum dot, a cross-linking agent including four or more than four moieties represented by formula a, and a mixed solvent including a first solvent, a second solvent, and a third solvent. The second solvent has a higher boiling point than the first solvent, the second solvent has a lower surface tension than the first solvent, and the third solvent includes a compound represented by formula 3. Formulas a and 3 are explained in the specification: [ A ] [ Formula 3] Ar  2 -R 2 .

title_en: Preparation method of bismuth nano polycrystalline catalyst rich in grain boundary and application of bismuth nano polycrystalline catalyst in reduction of carbon dioxide
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of bismuth nano polycrystalline catalyst rich in grain boundary and application of carbon dioxide reduction, belonging to the technical field of metal nano catalyst, firstly mixing bismuth metal salt with deionized water, and drying to obtain precursor powder; adding precursor powder after melting nitrite, preserving heat to obtain a reaction product, cooling to room temperature, washing, centrifuging and drying to obtain a catalyst precursor; preparing a precursor spraying liquid, spraying the precursor spraying liquid on carbon paper, and performing in-situ electroreduction under the CO  2  atmosphere to obtain the bismuth nano polycrystalline catalyst rich in grain boundary as a cathode of a three-electrode system. The bismuth nano polycrystalline catalyst with the surface rich in a large number of grain boundary defects can obviously improve the catalytic intrinsic activity of the bismuth-based catalyst, realize high single selectivity of electrocatalytic CO  2  for reducing formic acid, have excellent catalytic stability, mild preparation conditions and simple operation, and are suitable for large-scale subsequent production and commercial application.

title_en: For Fe3+Nanometer channel device for ion concentration detection and electrochemical detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nano channel device for detecting the concentration of Fe  3+  ions, which comprises a nano channel for containing an electrolyte solution to be detected, wherein functional molecules are modified on the inner surface of the nano channel, and the functional molecules are specifically combined by chelating, coordinating or electrostatic attraction with Fe  3+  ions, so that the ion current flowing through the nano channel changes under the applied voltage, and the concentration of Fe  3+  ions in the electrolyte solution to be detected is detected. The invention also discloses a detection method, which realizes quantitative detection of the concentration of Fe  3+  ions by establishing a standard curve, can rapidly, efficiently and quantitatively detect the concentration of Fe  3+  ions in an unknown water sample, and can be used for water quality assessment, health monitoring and other fields because the nano channel can be recycled and reused, thereby greatly reducing the detection cost.

title_en: Europium doped Cs3MnX5Method for producing luminous body
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a europium-doped Cs  3 MnX 5  luminophor, which comprises the following steps of S1, dissolving cesium halide, manganese halide and europium halide in a solvent, carrying out wet grinding to form a precursor solution, and then heating the precursor solution to volatilize the solvent to form a crude Cs  3 MnX 5  doped with Eu  2+ . According to the invention, eu  2+  with a band spectrum and relatively stable and fast attenuation is doped into the Cs  3 MnX 5  luminophor, so that Eu  2+  and Mn  2+  double ions can jointly emit light, and the luminous intensity and stability of the luminophor are improved.

title_en: Iron negative electrode material with excellent performance, and ultra-fast low-temperature synthesis method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an iron negative electrode material with excellent performance, which comprises an iron substrate, wherein the iron substrate is soaked on the surface of the iron substrate through a solution to generate a manganese and sulfur co-doped iron oxyhydroxide material in situ, and the solution comprises water, a high-valence manganese compound and thiosulfate. The iron negative electrode material has the characteristics of good electronic conductivity, high area capacity, excellent multiplying power performance, stable cycle life and the like. Aqueous alkaline batteries based on the iron negative electrode material have a high energy density and a long cycle life.

title_en: Preparation method and application of few-layer transition metal chalcogenide with sulfur vacancy point defect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of transition metal sulfide with sulfur vacancy point defects. The preparation method creatively adopts a step-by-step stripping technology, namely a secondary stripping technology, to prepare the few-layer two-dimensional material with sulfur vacancy point defects, and in the secondary shearing stripping process, the shearing stripping can realize the separation of material layers and the formation of the sulfur vacancy point defects on the premise of maintaining the crystal structure of the transition metal sulfide, and the prepared TMDs anode material with the point defects effectively promotes the diffusion of sodium ions and increases the storage sites of the sodium ions, so that the material presents excellent electrochemical performance in the assembled sodium ion battery. The method for preparing TMDs with point defects by adopting the shearing and stripping technology is simple and feasible, is suitable for large-scale production and preparation, and the prepared material has a large application prospect in the fields of power batteries and catalysis.

title_en: Preparation method and application of anode material prepared by silane deposition with porous carbon reinforced as carrier
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a negative electrode material prepared by silane deposition with a porous carbon reinforced carrier, which belong to the technical field of preparation methods of negative electrode materials, wherein a carbon borer or carbon nano tube reinforced porous carbon substrate prepared by a tube furnace high-temperature pyrolysis method is a porous complex material with a high specific surface area, can induce deposition of silane substances to form nano silicon, and simultaneously binds the cracked nano silicon through the complex pore frame material, so that a space for volume expansion of a silicon-based material is provided, and different channels are provided for transmission of lithium ions.

title_en: Efficient compiling method of multi-core quantum computer
abstract_en: A computationally economical compilation method is disclosed for improving quantum code execution on a multi-core quantum computing system by minimizing the amount of core quantum operations required for execution. The method comprises the following steps: dividing the complete program code into segments; identifying a set of contiguous segment sequences denoted Gc and a set of non-overlapping combinations of Gc members denoted Gnc; converting Gc members into corresponding graph groups; mapping the qubits to cores using a graph solver program, thereby obtaining a corresponding set of core quantum operations; calculating an operation amount associated with Gnc members accordingly; and selecting the Gc members of the map, i.e. the successive code portions of the map, which will result in the smallest total inter-core operation amount.

title_en: Nanometer mineral pigment for hand painting of cinnabar and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a nano mineral pigment for hand painting of cinnabar and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of pigment production. The nano mineral pigment for hand painting of cinnabar comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: 150-180 parts of pigment carrier, 2-5 parts of surface treating agent, 3-4 parts of silicon dioxide, 5-10 parts of zinc oxide, 8-12 parts of organic silicon resin, 3-8 parts of light stabilizer, 1-3 parts of antioxidant, 2-4 parts of antibacterial agent, 3-5 parts of metal chelating agent, 1-4 parts of emulsifying agent, 2-6 parts of dispersing agent and 2-5 parts of adhesive. The addition of the emulsifying agent and the dispersing agent in the raw materials can help the particles to disperse and keep a stable state, so that the mineral pigment can be better dispersed and dissolved in water or other solvents, and the dissolution and uniform distribution of the mineral pigment are promoted.

title_en: Strip steel with thickness of 0.8mm and production process thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a strip steel with the thickness of 0.8mm and a production process thereof, and belongs to the technical field of strip steel. The method comprises the steps of S1, taking a 50Mn hot rolled steel strip as a raw material, removing surface oxide skin through pickling, S2, carrying out hot rolling and high-pressure water dephosphorization on the treated steel strip, S3, carrying out intermediate annealing treatment, S4, carrying out cold rolling on the annealed steel strip to a thickness of 0.5-0.7mm, S5, carrying out hot dip galvanizing on the steel strip after removing grease on the surface, taking out, blowing and cooling, S6, carrying out finished product annealing, and S7, carrying out plate shape correction on the product to obtain the steel strip with the thickness of 0.8 mm. The production process method is simple, and the prepared strip steel has the advantages of good mechanical property, high hardness, good stability, oxidation resistance and processability, small thickness tolerance fluctuation, good flatness of the plate shape, stable surface quality and controllable batch preparation.

title_en: Synthesis and application of Pt monoatomic and Pt atomic cluster synergistic electrocatalytic material
abstract_en: The invention relates to synthesis and application of an electrocatalytic material with synergistic effect of Pt single atoms and Pt atomic clusters, wherein the Pt atomic clusters and the Pt single atoms are anchored by using porphyrin organic ligands with metal centers, and the carbon-based electrocatalytic material is prepared by calcining. The porphyrin organic ligand adopted by the invention is 5,10,15, 20-tetra (4-carboxyphenyl) porphyrin platinum (PtTCPP), which is doped into MOF (UIO-66) to be used as a precursor for preparing the electrocatalyst, and the preparation process is mature and is suitable for commercial production. In order to obtain high-performance Hydrogen Evolution Reaction (HER), a Pt atom cluster and a Pt single atom are co-embedded into an N-doped carbon material by adopting an in-situ strategy to obtain a composite electrocatalytic material (Pt  SA -Pt AC ), so that the composite electrocatalytic material has respective advantages and even synergistic effects, realizes the performance which can be compared with commercial Pt/C in the electrocatalytic hydrogen evolution aspect, and is suitable for industrial production.

title_en: Nanocomposite based on AIE molecule-rare earth inorganic nanocrystalline and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nanocomposite based on AIE molecules-rare earth inorganic nanocrystals and application thereof. The fluorescent composite material comprises aggregation-induced emission molecules and rare earth inorganic nanocrystals, wherein the aggregation-induced emission molecules are anchored on the surfaces of the rare earth inorganic nanocrystals; the aggregation-induced emission molecules and the rare earth inorganic nanocrystals form the nanocomposite by coordination. The invention constructs the color-rich nanocomposite material, improves the sensitivity of naked eyes to observe the change of fluorescent color, and provides a basis for further developing portable fluorescent visual sensing equipment. The method for detecting Fe  3+  ions by using the fluorescent probe has the advantages of simple and convenient detection process, high selectivity, high sensitivity, low detection limit and relatively simple and convenient operation.

title_en: Silicon carbide negative electrode material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a silicon carbide negative electrode material, which comprises silicon carbide particles, wherein single-wall carbon nanotubes in the silicon carbide particles are inserted and wound to form flexible network skeleton bound silicon carbide. The invention also discloses a preparation method of the silicon carbide anode material, which comprises the following steps: uniformly mixing the polydimethylsiloxane prepolymer and the single-walled carbon nanotube slurry; adding a curing agent into a vacuum oven with the vacuum degree less than or equal to-90 kPa, and curing for 3-5 hours at 80+/-5 ℃ after removing bubbles; reacting the obtained crosslinked polymer for 6-10 hours at the temperature of 450-600 ℃ and the vacuum degree of less than or equal to-90 kPa to obtain a polycarbosilane melt; and (3) carrying out melt spinning, sintering and granulating on the polycarbosilane melt under the negative pressure of 0.04-0.06 MPa in an inert atmosphere to obtain silicon carbide particles. According to the silicon carbide negative electrode material, the single-walled carbon nanotubes are inserted and wound to form the flexible network skeleton to bind the silicon carbide, so that the deformation is limited, and the volume expansion and shrinkage and the powder cracking are improved.

title_en: Surface-coated modified NCM92 ternary positive electrode material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of lithium ion batteries, and particularly relates to a surface-coated modified NCM92 ternary positive electrode material and a preparation method thereof. According to the invention, ATO is introduced to coat the NCM92 high-nickel material, so that the electrochemical performance is improved; the NCM92 ternary anode material coated by the electronic conductor oxidized nano tin antimony ATO is obtained by a one-time rotary furnace constant-temperature oxygen-enriched sintering process, the ATO coating layer provides a protection barrier, the corrosion resistance and the thermal stability of NCM92 are enhanced, the mixing and discharging phenomena of cations can be reduced by doping Sn and Sb surfaces, the structural stability of the material is enhanced, the lattice distortion and the particle breakage in the cyclic process are reduced when the material is applied, thereby inhibiting adverse interface side reaction and the expansion of microcracks, and improving the cyclic stability; in addition, the electronically conductive nature of ATO improves rate capability; the invention solves the problem that the prior nine-series NCM92 ternary positive electrode material is limited in application due to structural stability and thermal stability, and has simple process and low energy consumption.

title_en: Green preparation method of biomass carbon quantum dot capable of realizing rapid detection of hexavalent chromium ions in water
abstract_en: The invention discloses a green preparation method of modified carbon quantum dots capable of rapidly detecting hexavalent chromium ions in water. The method comprises the following steps of 1) preparing a pretreated biomass solution, 2) preparing a carbon quantum dot precursor solution doped with a modifier, 3) preparing biomass carbon quantum dots by a one-step method, and 4) detecting hexavalent chromium ions by the biomass carbon quantum dots. The biomass precursor can be used for recycling resources, and the prepared carbon quantum dots have good dispersibility, regular morphology and stable fluorescence performance, and the preparation process of the carbon quantum dots is simple and feasible, so that the biomass precursor can be used as a feasible scheme for conveniently and efficiently detecting hexavalent chromium ions in water.

title_en: Functionalized nano-pore membrane and application thereof in SUMO1 identification
abstract_en: The invention provides an application of a functionalized nano-pore membrane in recognition detection of a small ubiquitin-like modifier (SUMOs). By grafting CPs to the gold layer at the small pore end of the nano-pore canal. CPs can specifically interact with a key part (DG 12) of SUMO1, interaction forces drive CPs to change to different degrees, effective spaces in the nano pore channels are compressed to different degrees, and then the change of transmembrane ion current and Faraday current to different degrees can be detected by an electrochemical detection method, so that the detection of SUMO1 is realized.

title_en: Nasopharyngeal carcinoma resisting photosensitizer with photothermal and photodynamic effects and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of antitumor drugs, and discloses an anti-nasopharyngeal carcinoma photosensitizer with photothermal and photodynamic effects, which has a structure shown in a formula I; the invention also provides a preparation method of the anti-nasopharyngeal carcinoma photosensitizer with both photothermal and photodynamic effects, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: s1: 2-bromofluorene having a structure represented by formula a, N- (3-chloropropyl) morpholine having a structure represented by formula b, potassium tert-butoxide and tetrahydrofuran are mixed and reacted to obtain a compound having a structure represented by formula c. The photosensitizer provided by the invention has excellent photo-thermal conversion capability, meets the requirements of photo-thermal treatment on nasopharyngeal carcinoma, has good active oxygen generation capability, and can damage a lysosome membrane of nasopharyngeal carcinoma cells under the induction of laser irradiation, so that the treatment efficiency of resisting nasopharyngeal carcinoma is improved.

title_en: Preparation method of blue-light perovskite semiconductor quantum dot material
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of LEDs, in particular to a preparation method of a blue perovskite semiconductor quantum dot material, which comprises the following steps: 1) Weighing the following components in parts by weight: 5-30 parts of cesium bromide, 2-10 parts of cesium acetate, 5-15 parts of cesium carbonate, 15-50 parts of lead bromide and 10-60 parts of triethylamine hydrobromide, and sequentially adding into 100-200 parts of organic solvent, uniformly stirring by magnetic force, and sealing for later use; 2) Fully soaking the non-woven fabric in a saturated solution of monovalent metal normal salt, and airing; 3) Spreading the dried non-woven fabric in a vacuum box, uniformly coating the mixture by using a mechanical arm with a capillary brush, and timely pumping the volatilized solvent out of the vacuum box; 4) And (3) annealing the coated non-woven fabric, and removing the residual non-woven fabric after annealing. The method can improve the yield of the blue light semiconductor quantum dot material pair, and can also obtain blue light perovskite semiconductor quantum dot materials with different crystal forms and crystal sizes by controlling the volatilization of the solvent and the crystal orientation of the monovalent metal normal.

title_en: Hard carbon material with lamellar structure
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of batteries, in particular to a hard carbon material with a lamellar structure. The hard carbon material comprises a hard carbon matrix and a carbon layer coated on the surface of the hard carbon matrix; the hard carbon substrate comprises a chitin-based hard carbon material, the chitin-based hard carbon material has a laminated structure, and the chitin-based hard carbon material has a closed cell structure. The hard carbon material provided by the application has the advantage of high first efficiency (first coulombic efficiency).

title_en: Negative pole piece and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a negative pole piece, a preparation method and application thereof. The negative electrode plate comprises a current collector, and a first active layer, a conductive layer and a second active layer which are sequentially laminated on the surface of the current collector; the material of the first active layer includes a first active material including a carbon material; the material of the conductive layer comprises a conductive agent; the material of the second active layer includes a second active material including a sheet-like silicon-based material. The negative electrode plate can enable the battery to have higher specific capacity and cycle stability.

title_en: Palladium nanoparticle rich in high catalytic activity surface, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electrocatalyst preparation, and particularly relates to palladium nano-particles rich in high catalytic activity surfaces, and a preparation method and application thereof. Dissolving palladium salt in an organic solvent, stirring until the palladium salt is completely dissolved, adding a polyvinylpyrrolidone aqueous solution, and uniformly mixing; adding oleylamine into the system, stirring until the water phase is uniform and transparent and yellow, and the oil phase is colorless; and performing hydrothermal reaction, cooling after the reaction is finished, washing the obtained solid-liquid mixture, centrifuging and drying to obtain the catalyst. The palladium nano-particles have uniform size, good dispersibility, high specific surface area and high metal atom utilization rate, and can replace Pt; the catalyst has rich lattice mismatch, can effectively regulate and control the electronic structure of Pd, and optimizes the intrinsic activity of the catalyst. Meanwhile, part of high-index crystal faces are exposed, so that the refining activity of the catalyst is obviously improved; the edges of different crystal faces have a large number of atomic steps with high reactivity, and can be used as unsaturated catalytic active sites to further improve the catalytic activity.

title_en: Spherical nanostructures with anchoring layers
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a plurality of spherical nanostructures. Each nanostructure comprises a central portion comprising a polymer backbone of monomer residues according to {(OR 1 )(OR 2 )PO} 2 -(C){(CH 2 ) m Si(OR 3 ) 3 }{(CH 2 ) m Si(OR 3 ) 3 }, wherein each R  1  and R  2  is independently selected from the group consisting of negative charge and H; each R  3  is independently selected from the group consisting of negative charge, H, and a covalent bond to the polymer backbone; wherein at least 3R  3  are bonds to the polymer backbone; and m is an integer between 1 and 5; and wherein the central portion of the nanostructure has a volume average hydrodynamic diameter of 10nm to 90 nm; and an anchor layer surrounding the central portion, wherein the anchor layer comprises a polymer of monomer residues according to (RO)  3 Si–(CH 2 ) n –Si(OR) 3 , wherein each R is independently selected from the group consisting of a negative charge, H, and a covalent bond with a covalent bond, wherein at least two R are independently selected from the group consisting of a covalent bond with a monomer residue of the central portion and a covalent bond with a monomer residue of the anchor layer; wherein, -represents a covalent bond; n is 1 or 2; and wherein the anchoring layer has a thickness of 1nm-5 nm. The disclosure also relates to methods of preparing such nanostructures and uses of the nanostructures, and to pharmaceutical compositions comprising such nanostructures.

title_en: Preparation method of high-activity electrode material for all-vanadium redox flow battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a high-activity electrode material for an all-vanadium redox flow battery, which belongs to the technical field of electrode materials of redox flow batteries and comprises the following steps of grinding a core-shell nanoparticle enriched carbon precursor into powder, performing pre-oxidation and high-temperature carbonization treatment to obtain a modified porous carbon-based material, mixing nano bismuth-loaded graphene oxide with metal oxide to prepare composite aerogel, mixing the composite aerogel with a binder to form slurry, coating the slurry on the surface of the modified porous-based material, and drying, roll forming and cutting to obtain the high-activity electrode material. The polystyrene pyrolysis release nano particles on the surface of the core-shell nano particles are filled into the macroporous pores of the porous carbon-based material, so that the macropores are converted into a mesoporous structure, and the adsorption performance on vanadium ions is improved; the porous aerogel has excellent adsorption performance, improves the adsorption and storage performance of vanadium ions, and further improves the service life of the electrode material.

title_en: Nanometer radiating fin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nano radiating fin, which belongs to the technical field of heat radiation, and comprises a fixed substrate, wherein a plurality of radiating fins are fixed on the fixed substrate, a plurality of grooves are formed in the side face of each radiating fin, the grooves are arranged in parallel, the distance between the two grooves is 2-3mm, a resin layer is coated in each groove, and a uniformly dispersed nano radiating layer is adhered on the resin layer.

title_en: Tin oxide/potassium sodium niobate composite material, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention provides a tin oxide/potassium sodium niobate composite material, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of gas sensitive materials. The preparation method of the tin oxide/potassium sodium niobate composite material comprises the steps of preparing a precursor by taking a tin source compound, a niobium source compound, a potassium source compound and a sodium source compound as raw materials through a hydrothermal method, and calcining the precursor in air to obtain the tin oxide/potassium sodium niobate composite material. The method is simple to operate, low in equipment investment and low in power consumption, and is suitable for mass production. The composite material prepared by the method forms a micro-or nano-heterojunction between the tin oxide and the potassium sodium niobate, is sensitive to methane gas, has good selectivity, can effectively capture methane gas, can be used as a methane gas-sensitive material, and is used for preparing a methane gas sensor.

title_en: Three-dimensional TiO2Ag/AgCl composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional TiO  2  -Ag/AgCl composite material, a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the field of functional materials and Raman spectrum detection, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) Adding titanium isopropoxide into a mixed solution of ethylene glycol, concentrated hydrochloric acid and water, stirring, immersing Ag foil therein, and performing hydrothermal reaction to obtain a substrate; (2) Placing a substrate under a xenon lamp light source, controlling the light source current to irradiate the substrate, and enabling part of AgCl components in the substrate to generate photo-reduction to generate active simple substance Ag; (3) And (3) placing the substrate subjected to the light treatment in a protective atmosphere, controlling the heating temperature to be between 200 and 500 ℃ to enable the active simple substance Ag to be subjected to thermal migration by depending on the TiO  2  monomer, and preparing the three-dimensional TiO  2  -Ag/AgCl composite material. The composite material has good structural stability, adjustable structure and high and stable SERS activity, and can be used for high-sensitivity detection of water pollutants such as antibiotics.

title_en: Carbon dot, preparation method and application thereof in enhancing luminol luminous intensity
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of luminescence enhancers, and provides a preparation method of carbon dots, which comprises the following steps: (1) Dissolving a precursor in alcohol and performing ultrasonic treatment, wherein the precursor is benzene ring or a naphthalene ring with 1-2 substituent groups (including but not limited to, phenylenediamine, dimethylaniline, chloroaniline, bromoaniline, benzoquinone and the like); (2) Placing the completely dissolved raw materials in a high-temperature environment for reaction; (3) And (5) after the reaction is finished, carrying out centrifugal treatment, and taking supernatant to obtain carbon dots. The invention also provides a carbon dot which is prepared by the preparation method. The invention also provides an application of the carbon dots in enhancing luminol luminous intensity. The preparation method of the carbon dot provided by the invention is simple in preparation and low in cost, luminol can be oxidized into excited-state 3-aminophthalic acid by an oxidant under an alkaline condition, when excited-state 3-APA returns to a ground state, an optical signal is released at 425nm, and the carbon dot with positive charge has strong affinity to luminol, so that luminol chemiluminescence can be catalyzed efficiently.

title_en: Magnesium-based composite material containing in-situ authigenic core-shell structure particles and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a magnesium-based composite material containing in-situ authigenic core-shell structure particles and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the magnesium-based composite material. The magnesium-based composite material contains core-shell structure particles generated by in-situ autoxidation-reduction reaction of magnesium-rare earth alloy powder and precursor nano oxide particles; the volume percentage of the core-shell structure particles is 10% -25%; the size of the metal particles in the core is 20 nm-100 nm, and the thickness of the core is 20 nm-200 nm; the size of the ceramic particles in the shell is 20 nm-30 nm, and the thickness of the shell is 20 nm-50 nm; the precursor nano-oxide particles are 1-5 wt% of the total mass of the magnesium-rare earth alloy powder and the precursor nano-oxide particles. The magnesium-based composite material has good interface bonding, higher high-temperature strength and plasticity, can effectively prevent crack growth, and improves the deformation storage energy of the composite material. The preparation method is simple to operate, short in flow and low in cost.

title_en: Heat conduction and radiation integrated thermal control film for satellite
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-heat-conductivity heat-dissipation integrated composite thermal control film for satellites, which comprises a protective layer, a nano thermal control film and a graphite film. The nano thermal control film comprises a protective layer based on the film surface and a three-dimensional micro-nano structure, the graphite film is packaged by hot melt adhesive in a hot pressing way, and the graphite film and the nano thermal control film are adhered together through the hot melt adhesive to form the novel integrated composite thermal control film with high heat conduction and heat dissipation. The invention solves the problems of high heat flux density, complex illumination and rapid development of the low orbit satellite constellation in the future, remarkably reduces the production cost and is beneficial to the commercial mass production of the constellation satellite.

title_en: Carbon dot nano-enzyme, hydrogel loaded with carbon dot nano-enzyme and application of hydrogel in detecting freshness of product
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of carbon dot nanoenzymes, and in particular relates to a carbon dot nanoenzyme, a hydrogel loaded with the carbon dot nanoenzyme and application of the hydrogel in detecting freshness of a product. According to the application, ethylenediamine tetraacetic acid disodium salt, 2, 4-dihydroxybenzoic acid, an iron source, a cobalt source and a phosphorus source are used as raw materials, and the raw materials are heated for synthesis reaction, so that the green luminescent iron-cobalt-phosphorus co-doped carbon dot nanoenzyme is prepared, the preparation method is simple, the prepared carbon dot nanoenzyme has high quantum yield, the fluorescence color and fluorescence intensity of the prepared carbon dot nanoenzyme are sensitive to pH, and the prepared carbon dot nanoenzyme has excellent peroxidase simulation activity, and can be used for detecting pH and Hx. The application also provides the hydrogel loaded with the carbon dot nano enzyme with pH and Hx dual responsiveness, which can realize the food freshness, especially the visual monitoring of the aquatic product freshness through the form and color change, provides a new device for the detection of the aquatic product freshness, and has great innovation and application value in the field of food safety detection.

title_en: Wide-emission zinc telluride selenide quantum dot and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wide-emission zinc telluride quantum dot and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of luminescent materials. According to the invention, through artificially designed defect state emission, the emission wavelength of the zinc telluride selenide quantum dot is subjected to red shift and broadening under the conditions of not changing the particle size, absorption spectrum and crystal structure of the quantum dot, and the preparation method has the advantages of low preparation cost, simple process and high efficiency. The wide-emission zinc telluride quantum dot prepared by the invention has the characteristics of good fluorescence property, high quantum yield and wide spectrum emission, and has wide application prospect in the field of white light illumination when being used as a fluorescent emission material.

title_en: Small-size oxide semiconductor etching method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a small-size oxide semiconductor etching method, and belongs to the technical field of information materials and devices. The invention firstly obtains the nanowire material through a low-temperature process, and then further reduces the diameter of the nanowire through an autoxidation combined self-limiting etching method, thereby realizing self-alignment and high-precision etching of the oxide semiconductor on a small size. Compared with the traditional etching of other masks depending on the exposure precision of DUV, EUV and other equipment, the invention solves the problem of size miniaturization of the traditional oxide semiconductor device, can improve the density of an integrated circuit, greatly reduces the requirement on photoetching equipment and effectively reduces the process cost.

title_en: Microsphere driving method, mask preparation method and preparation method of microneedle array
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a microsphere driving method, a mask preparation method and a preparation method of a microneedle array, which comprise dispersing microspheres in a first liquid, wherein the first liquid is contained in a containing cavity, injecting a second liquid towards a local area of the containing cavity, wherein the surface energy of the second liquid is lower than that of the first liquid, and the concentration of the second liquid in the containing cavity is distributed in a gradient manner along with the diffusion of the second liquid from the local area to other areas of the containing cavity, and the microspheres move towards the direction of the concentration reduction of the second liquid under the driving of the surface energy difference generated by the concentration difference of the second liquid. The method realizes the driving of the microspheres to move by adopting a concentration gradient induction mode, so that a large-area microsphere etching mask and a microneedle array can be rapidly prepared, the preparation efficiency is high, and the preparation cost is low.

title_en: Copper-doped cordate houttuynia carbon dot nanomaterial and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a copper-doped houttuynia cordata carbon dot nanomaterial and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein natural plant houttuynia cordata is adopted as a raw material, natural carbon dots are extracted from houttuynia cordata and then copper simple substance is doped, so that the cost is saved, the performance is improved, and the prepared copper-doped houttuynia cordata carbon dot nanomaterial (Cu-CDs) has good oxidation resistance, anti-inflammatory and sterilization capability and is expected to be used for treating bacterial pneumonia induced by streptococcus pneumoniae.

title_en: Composite electrode material of sodium ion battery and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sodium ion battery composite electrode material and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of nano composite materials. According to the method disclosed by the invention, the sodium ion battery composite electrode material with the three-dimensional microsphere structure is formed by vertically interweaving ultrathin two-dimensional nano sheets, abundant pores among the nano sheets are beneficial to rapid infiltration of electrolyte, promote contact of active substances and sodium ions, and simultaneously are beneficial to removal of sodium ions, meanwhile, bimetal sulfide doping replaces partial sites of ZnO crystal lattice, improves the electron transmission rate of ZnO, and the surface redox reaction rate of ZnO, so that structural damage of the electrode material caused by volume change in the charging and discharging process is buffered, a layer of carbon nano cage is loaded on the surface of the ZnO nano sheets, the size of the carbon nano cage is about 100nm, the wall thickness is about 20nm, the effect of improving the transmission rate of electrons and ions is achieved, and the charging and discharging first coulomb efficiency of the ZnO anode material is effectively improved.

title_en: High specific surface area sphere-like nano tungsten oxide and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of nano tungsten oxide, in particular to a spherical nano tungsten oxide with high specific surface area and a preparation method thereof, wherein carbon black is added into ammonium tungstate solution, ethanol solution is added, the ethanol solution is used as dispersing agent to be dispersed into the ammonium tungstate solution to form uniform suspension, under the condition of continuous stirring and heating, and (3) promoting crystallization of Ammonium Paratungstate (APT) on the surface of the carbon black to form crystals of the ammonium paratungstate coated carbon black, placing the APT crystals coated with the carbon black in a muffle furnace, and performing high-temperature roasting treatment, wherein in the roasting process, the coated carbon black is converted into carbon dioxide to be discharged, and meanwhile, the APT crystal structure is destroyed and refined, so that the spherical-like nano tungsten oxide with controllable granularity and high specific surface area is finally obtained.

title_en: Wafer adsorption device, vacuum nano-imprinting equipment with same and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wafer adsorption device, vacuum nano imprinting equipment with the device and a method, wherein the wafer adsorption device comprises the following components: the pressing plate is connected with the pressing lifting driving mechanism in a transmission mode, the annular sucking disc mounting plate is sleeved on the outer side of the pressing plate, a plurality of sucking discs are mounted on the annular sucking disc mounting plate along the circumferential direction of the annular sucking disc mounting plate and used for sucking the edge position of a wafer to be stamped, the annular sucking disc mounting plate is connected with the sucking disc lifting driving mechanism in a transmission mode, the jacking block is connected with the jacking block lifting driving mechanism in a transmission mode, and the jacking block is used for enabling the central area of the wafer sucked by the sucking discs to be deformed through the through holes in the pressing plate to be pressed downwards. By adopting the method, the wafer is deformed, the central area of the wafer is firstly attached to the mother board, the edge of the wafer is then attached to the mother board, the generation of bubbles is prevented, and the nanoimprint effect is better.

title_en: Solid-phase extraction micro-column array chip based on 4D printing and construction method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a solid-phase extraction micro-column array chip based on 4D printing and a construction method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of separation and analysis detection. The micro-column array chip comprises a micro-extraction device, wherein the micro-extraction device comprises a magnetic response micro-column formed by connecting a plurality of magnetic flowers in series. The construction method of the micro-column array chip comprises the following steps of printing magnetic flowers, connecting a plurality of magnetic flowers in series to form micro-columns with magnetic responses, combining the micro-columns with a micro-column shell to obtain a micro-extraction device, and combining the plurality of micro-extraction devices with the array shell to obtain the micro-column array chip. The method of the invention introduces intellectualization, dynamics and real-time for the sample pretreatment process by integrating the magnetic response structure of 4D printing in the microfluidic channel, so as to realize dynamic regulation and control of the solid phase extraction process, has the advantages of high efficiency, high accuracy and high flexibility, and is suitable for solid phase extraction and morphological analysis of metal elements.

title_en: Negative electrode material and preparation method and application thereof
