abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to a negative electrode material, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of introducing mixed gas of first silicon source gas, nitrogen source gas and first protective gas into a vapor deposition furnace under inert atmosphere, enabling the first silicon source gas and the nitrogen source gas to carry out vapor deposition in a porous carbon matrix to obtain a first nitrogen doped silicon-carbon composite material, introducing mixed gas of second silicon source gas and second protective gas into the vapor deposition furnace, enabling the second silicon source gas to carry out deposition in the first nitrogen doped silicon-carbon composite material to obtain a second nitrogen doped silicon-carbon composite material, circulating the steps for a plurality of times, introducing mixed gas of third protective gas and carbon source gas into the vapor deposition furnace under inert atmosphere, carrying out passivation treatment on the second nitrogen doped silicon-carbon composite material to obtain a passivated silicon-carbon composite material, and carrying out carbon coating of nitrogen element to the passivated silicon-carbon composite material to form a nitrogen doped carbon coating layer to obtain the negative electrode material.

title_en: Optical sensor and electronic device
abstract_en: The invention provides an optical sensor and electronic equipment, which belong to the technical field of sensors, wherein the optical sensor comprises a bottom plate, a shell, an MEMS (micro electro mechanical System) chip and an upper optical module, the shell is covered on the bottom plate to form a containing cavity, an acoustic hole is formed in the bottom plate, the MEMS chip is arranged on the bottom plate and comprises a substrate, a sensitive film and an upper back plate, the sensitive film is arranged on one side of the upper back plate facing the acoustic hole at intervals; the upper back plate is provided with an upper grating, one side of the sensitive film facing the upper grating is provided with an upper reflecting layer, the upper optical module comprises an upper light source and an upper photoelectric detector, light rays emitted by the upper light source are incident to the upper reflecting layer through the upper grating, and the upper photoelectric detector is used for receiving the light rays reflected by the upper reflecting layer. The invention can reduce the interference of external light and has the advantages of high detection accuracy and low manufacturing difficulty.

title_en: Metal ion nano sheet calcium silicate and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses metal ion nano sheet calcium silicate and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of calcium silicate. The preparation method comprises the following steps of 1) weighing calcium salt and metal salt, adding the calcium salt and the metal salt into a first reaction bottle, adding water, dissolving the calcium salt and the metal salt to obtain a calcium salt aqueous solution containing the metal salt, 2) adding water and silicate into a second reaction bottle, stirring and dissolving to obtain a silicate aqueous solution, 3) placing the silicate aqueous solution into a constant-pressure dropping funnel, dropwise adding the silicate aqueous solution containing the metal salt, stirring and supplementing calcium salt solids, continuously generating precipitation until the silicate aqueous solution is dropwise added, and 4) centrifuging, washing, drying and grinding a precipitation product to obtain the metal ion nano flaky calcium silicate. The invention utilizes the metal ion nano flaky calcium silicate and the nano flaky alumina to prepare the organic silicon sealant together, and after high-temperature calcination, the organic silicon sealant can effectively block the diffusion of harmful gases and simultaneously maintain good strength.

title_en: Preparation method and application of metal precursor self-limiting domain type Ni single-atom electrocatalyst
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a metal precursor self-limiting domain type Ni single-atom electrocatalyst. The electrocatalyst presents a three-dimensional nano-sheet morphology and has a rich mesoporous structure, and mainly comprises Ni, N and C, wherein the Ni exists in a single atom form. The Ni loading of the catalyst is 1-2wt%, the specific surface area is 200-450 m  2 /g, and the average pore diameter is 5-10 nm. The preparation method comprises the following steps of 1) fully mixing a metal precursor NiZnAl LDHs with an ethanol solution of o-phenanthroline to form a solution A, fully mixing chitosan with an acetic acid aqueous solution to form a hydrosol B, and 2) mixing the solution A with the hydrosol B, and then obtaining the electrocatalyst through freeze drying, inert atmosphere heat treatment, air oxidation, acid etching and secondary inert atmosphere heat treatment. The catalyst is simple to operate, low in cost and controllable in process, and can be applied to electrocatalytic CO  2  reduction reaction, and high catalytic activity and product CO selectivity are shown.

title_en: MEMS technology-based self-driven one-way valve solid-state heat dissipation device without considering driving frequency
abstract_en: The invention relates to a self-driven one-way valve solid-state heat dissipation device based on MEMS technology without considering driving frequency, which belongs to the technical field of thermal function devices and comprises a packaging shell, a vibratable sheet and a machine Qu Quban, wherein an air inlet and an air outlet are formed in the packaging shell, the vibratable sheet is fixed at the middle position in the packaging shell, the vibratable sheet is a metal sheet with a right piezoelectric material on the surface, a mechanical buckling plate is fixed at the air outlet position in the packaging shell, and a mass block is arranged at the middle position of the mechanical buckling plate. The device of the invention further improves the heat dissipation efficiency and the system integration level through the optimized mechanical structure design while keeping low noise and high-efficiency heat dissipation capacity, and is particularly suitable for portable equipment with high requirements on battery endurance. The characteristics enable the device to be applicable to smart phones, be applied to portable equipment such as tablet computers and notebook computers, and provide a brand new solution for heat dissipation of electronic equipment.

title_en: Method for producing electrode catalyst and electrode catalyst
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for manufacturing a catalyst for an electrode and the catalyst for the electrode. A method for producing an electrode catalyst comprises a nanowire synthesis step in which metal nanowires (14) are synthesized, and a supporting step in which the metal nanowires (14) are supported by a carbon support (12), wherein the metal nanowires (14) are cut into short fibers having a particle diameter equal to or shorter than that of the carbon support (12) in a1 st suspension containing the carbon support (12) and the metal nanowires (14), and are attached to the carbon support (12). Accordingly, high catalyst activity can be achieved.

title_en: Method for synthesizing lead sulfide quantum dots by photocatalysis and application
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for synthesizing lead sulfide quantum dots by photocatalysis and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of preparation of lead sulfide quantum dots. According to the method, light is introduced into key steps of lead sulfide quantum dot synthesis, energy required by a cluster formation result of the lead sulfide quantum dot is reduced, adverse effects caused by overhigh or overlow temperature of a reaction system are avoided, growth of the lead sulfide quantum dot is accelerated, nucleation time of the lead sulfide quantum dot is greatly shortened, a monodisperse lead sulfide quantum dot material with uniform particle size and good surface passivation is obtained, and photon absorption spectrum peak-valley ratio of the prepared lead sulfide quantum dot material is high, so that excellent optical performance is reflected. The lead sulfide quantum dot material prepared by the method can be used for preparing optical devices such as photoelectric detectors, solar absorbers, optical switches and the like, and has wide application prospects.

title_en: Low-voltage Micro-LED epitaxial wafer and preparation method thereof, and Micro-LED
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-voltage Micro-LED epitaxial wafer and a preparation method thereof, and a Micro-LED, and relates to the field of semiconductor photoelectric devices. The low-voltage Micro-LED epitaxial wafer sequentially comprises a substrate, a buffer layer, an undoped GaN layer, an N-type GaN layer, a multiple quantum well layer, an electron blocking layer, a P-type GaN layer and a P-type contact layer, wherein the P-type contact layer comprises a porous AlInN layer, a two-dimensional P-type BGaN layer, an AlN roughening layer, a P-type BInGaN nanocluster layer and a P-type AlInGaN roughening layer which are sequentially laminated on the P-type GaN layer, the porous AlInN layer is prepared by etching the AlInN layer through H  2 , and the P-type AlInGaN roughening layer is prepared by roughening the P-type AlInGaN layer through N  2 . By implementing the invention, the working voltage can be reduced, the light extraction efficiency is improved, and the luminous efficiency is further improved.

title_en: Electrochemical luminescence nano probe based on Cas enzyme, sensor, detection method and detection kit
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a Pdots-based ECL nanoprobe, a sensor, a detection method, and a detection kit using Cas enzyme. The preparation method of the ECL nano-probe comprises the following steps of Pdots nano-particle synthesis, polymerization of conjugated polymer and copolymer molecules, synthesis of Pdots nano-particles and Pdots nano-particle modification, wherein the Pdots nano-particles are modified by using oligonucleotide chains with quencher molecule modification. The ECL detection method of the present invention may use a double cleavage system of Cas enzyme and exoenzyme, and the ECL sensor of the present invention may be a disposable detection chip. By the invention, ECL detection with high sensitivity, high accuracy and specificity and high flexibility without amplification can be realized.

title_en: Preparation method of wave-absorbing coating
abstract_en: A preparation method of an electromagnetic shielding wave-absorbing material is characterized in that cotton fibers are used as raw materials to prepare biomass-derived tubular carbon fibers, and then MoS  2  is deposited on the surface of the biomass-derived tubular carbon fibers in a hydrothermal mode to form a C/MoS  2  composite structure in which MoS  2  wraps the tubular carbon fibers. The material has excellent electromagnetic wave shielding performance, has a lower reflection loss value of-41.7 dB in a frequency range of 2-18 GHz after being prepared into the wave absorbing coating, can be applied to various equipment and products needing electromagnetic shielding in life and work, such as shale gas exploitation equipment, mining machinery equipment and the like, and medical instruments and aerospace equipment, so that the interference of electromagnetic waves on the normal work of the equipment is reduced, and the electromagnetic wave shielding material can be used in military equipment and realizes the shielding function by absorbing the electromagnetic waves.

title_en: Preparation method of hydrogel with photo-thermal and antibacterial functions
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of hydrogel with photo-thermal and antibacterial functions, belonging to the technical field of antibacterial drugs, comprising the following steps: synthesis of palladium nanoparticles: sequentially measuring 1mL of potassium chloropalladate solution, 2.5mL of cetyltrimethylammonium bromide solution and 17.5mL of secondary water, putting into a three-necked flask, heating in an oil bath for condensing reflux, slowly adding 160 mu L of ascorbic acid solution dropwise after heating for 10min, converting light into heat by utilizing the surface plasmon resonance of Ag@Pd, the method is applied to the photo-thermal antibacterial aspect, and simultaneously utilizes the combination of hydrogel and nano particles, so that the functionality of the Ag@Pd nano material is ensured, meanwhile, the nano particles are limited in situ to prevent unnecessary diffusion, the safety of the material is ensured, and the method has good targeting selectivity, broad-spectrum antibacterial property and biological safety.

title_en: Magnetic control fish pathogenic microorganism micro-fluidic chip detection platform with ultra-smooth surface and use method
abstract_en: The invention provides a magnetic control fish pathogenic microorganism micro-fluidic chip detection platform with an ultra-smooth surface and a use method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of microorganism detection. The microfluidic chip detection platform is an application of technical integration in three research directions of super-hydrophobic anti-bioadhesion materials, magnetic control separation and sorting and electrochemical microorganism Coulter counting detection sensors. The super-hydrophobic biological adhesion preventing material can improve the liquid flux and avoid sample residue, combines the immune nano magnetic beads with the magnetic control sorting function, improves the sorting efficiency, and realizes the quantitative detection of fish pathogenic microorganisms by adopting a Coulter counting technology of labeled fish pathogenic microorganisms and a Coulter counting method of instantaneous fluctuation pulse of current generated by conductivity change. Compared with the traditional laboratory incubation method, microscope counting method and the like, the method has the advantages of less sample detection dosage, short time consumption and the like.

title_en: High-stability transition metal phosphide hydrogen evolution catalyst and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-stability transition metal phosphide hydrogen evolution catalyst which consists of a phosphide active phase and a bifunctional metal phosphorus oxide protective layer. The invention also relates to a preparation method of the high-stability transition metal phosphide hydrogen evolution catalyst, which comprises the steps of firstly loading a metal precursor on foam nickel, phosphating to obtain a phosphide catalyst, and then carrying out surface treatment on the catalyst to obtain the phosphide hydrogen evolution catalyst with a phosphorus oxide protective layer. The protective layer on the surface of the phosphide catalyst is a 'double-function' protective layer with improved activity and stability, the protective layer with controllable and uniform thickness can be obtained through the regulation and control of surface treatment conditions in the preparation process, and the preparation process is simple, low in cost and important in industrial application value.

title_en: Three-dimensional porous silicon@carbon nanosphere structural material with lithium nitrate as template and lithium supplementing agent, preparation method of three-dimensional porous silicon@carbon nanosphere structural material, lithium ion battery cathode and battery
abstract_en: Compared with the prior art, the invention synthesizes SiO  2  pellets by using ethanol, deionized water, ammonia water and tetraethyl silicate, obtains porous Si by thermal reduction of SiO  2  pellets by magnesium powder, disperses the porous Si nanospheres and tris (hydroxymethyl) aminomethane in water, adjusts pH by hydrochloric acid solution, continuously adds dopamine hydrochloride, finally adds lithium nitrate, calcines and washes and dries to obtain the Si@C composite material with a three-dimensional porous structure. The template method further forms a porous structure on the surface of the carbon layer, so that the composite material can provide more active sites in the charging and discharging process, the porous structure effectively relieves the problem of volume expansion, meanwhile, the externally added lithium nitrate also serves as a lithium supplementing agent, and the battery has better stability due to the supplementing lithium ions in the charging and discharging process.

title_en: Intermetallic compound nano material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intermetallic compound nano material, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the intermetallic compound nano material is hexagonal prism-shaped and consists of three elements of Pt, pb and Sn, has PtPb phase structure, and shows catalytic activity and stability far superior to those of commercial Pd/C catalysts in alcohol oxidation reaction. The invention provides a preparation method of an intermetallic compound nanomaterial, which is efficient and simple, adopts a one-step solvothermal synthesis strategy, has simple process flow, can prepare the nanomaterial with high uniformity in size and excellent dispersibility, and is suitable for mass production.

title_en: Mesoporous CoNC fiber composite platinum-cobalt alloy catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field related to proton exchange membrane fuel cells, and discloses a mesoporous CoNC fiber composite platinum-cobalt alloy catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps of (1) uniformly mixing and dispersing organic polymers, co-doped ZIF8, oxide pore formers and N, N-dimethylformamide to obtain an electrostatic spinning solution, preparing CoNC fiber precursors through an electrostatic spinning machine, and carbonizing the CoNC fiber precursors to obtain CoNC fibers; and (3) dispersing the obtained mesoporous CoNC fiber in a solvent and loading platinum cobalt alloy nanocrystalline to obtain the mesoporous CoNC fiber composite platinum cobalt alloy catalyst. The invention can reduce the oxygen transmission resistance of the fuel cell under the condition of high current density, and the platinum-based nanocrystalline in the catalyst is loaded in the mesoporous of the carbon carrier, so that poisoning of the ionomer can be avoided.

title_en: Nanometer sheet electrocatalyst, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nano sheet-shaped electrocatalyst, a preparation method and application thereof in electrocatalytic nitrite reduction synthesis of ammonia, the preparation method comprises the following steps of (1) cutting foam metal to a fixed size, then placing the foam metal into a porcelain boat, (2) placing the porcelain boat filled with the foam metal into a muffle furnace, setting a heating rate, a heating temperature and a heat preservation time program, taking out the porcelain boat after the temperature is cooled to room temperature along with the furnace, obtaining a catalyst precursor CoO  x , and (3) placing the obtained catalyst precursor into a standard three-electrode system containing potassium hydroxide solution, and reducing the catalyst precursor for a certain time by a potentiostatic method, thus obtaining the nano sheet-shaped OD-Co electrocatalyst. The invention can develop a reform technology for simultaneously treating pollutants and producing high added value products, and gives consideration to energy conservation, environmental protection and stability, and provides a new strategy, thereby not only promoting energy utilization and improving the overall reaction rate, but also changing waste into valuables and harvesting the added value products.

title_en: Sodium ion battery anode material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a sodium ion battery anode material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the sodium ion battery anode material comprises sodium iron sulfate, carbon materials and a plurality of metal ions, the carbon materials are dispersed among the sodium iron sulfate, the metal ions are doped in the crystal structure of the sodium iron sulfate, the sodium ion battery anode material is prepared from an iron source, a layered oxide precursor by-product with sodium sulfate and the carbon materials, the layered oxide precursor by-product comprises the metal ions, and the metal ions comprise at least two of Ni  2+ 、Co 2+  and Mn  4+ . The dispersion of the carbon material and the doping of various metal ions can effectively improve the multiplying power performance and the cycle performance of the sodium ion battery anode material, and the sodium ion battery anode material is prepared by taking an iron source, a layered oxide precursor byproduct and the carbon material as raw materials, and the process waste is used for preparing the sodium ion battery anode material, so that the production cost of the sodium ion battery anode material is reduced, and the energy consumption and the environmental protection cost caused by processing the process waste are also saved.

title_en: Polyacid intercalated hydrotalcite aramid fiber coated lithium battery diaphragm and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of lithium ion battery materials, in particular to a polyacid intercalated hydrotalcite aramid fiber coated lithium battery diaphragm and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of adding hydrotalcite into formamide, vigorously stirring under the protection of inert gas to strip to obtain suspension, centrifuging the suspension to obtain a stripped hydrotalcite sheet, adding a polyacid aqueous solution into the stripped hydrotalcite sheet, stirring to self-assemble, and finally carrying out solid-liquid separation to obtain the polyacid intercalated hydrotalcite; and coating the polyacid intercalated hydrotalcite aramid fiber coating slurry on the surface of a base film, and drying after coagulating bath to obtain the polyacid intercalated hydrotalcite aramid fiber coated lithium battery diaphragm. The lithium battery diaphragm has higher thermal stability, and the preparation method is simple and has strong practicability.

title_en: Bionic liposome drug co-carried nano-particles and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses bionic liposome drug co-carried nano-particles, and a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of new-formulation drug preparations. Loading hydroxysafflor yellow A and statin drugs into a bilayer or core of a liposome, and adding a bionic membrane and phosphatilized hyaluronic acid on the outer layer of the liposome to modify to obtain bionic liposome drug-loaded nano particles with the particle size of 60-100 nm, wherein the liposome is prepared from lecithin and cholesterol, the bionic membrane is prepared from macrophage, and the phosphatilized hyaluronic acid is prepared from 1- (3-dimethylaminopropyl) -3-ethylcarbodiimide hydrochloride, N-hydroxysuccinimide, hyaluronic acid and phospholipid polyethylene glycol amino. The invention can load two medicines simultaneously and send the two medicines to the lesion area simultaneously.

title_en: Gold-TiO2Composite nano material, preparation method thereof and photocatalytic degradation application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gold-TiO  2  composite nano material, a preparation method and photocatalytic degradation application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of adopting magnetron sputtering to sequentially sputter Ti and Au on a substrate to obtain a Ti-Au film, and annealing the Ti-Au film to obtain the gold-TiO  2  composite nano material, wherein the annealing temperature is 300-800 ℃. The preparation method is simple and efficient, and the prepared gold-TiO  2  composite nano material has excellent photodegradation performance, excellent stability and strong absorption effect.

title_en: Preparation method and application of ultralow-palladium-supported cerium oxide cube electrocatalyst
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method and application of an ultralow-palladium-supported cerium oxide cube electrocatalyst, which comprises the following steps of 1) mixing a cerium source with a strong alkali solution, reacting, washing, drying and heat-treating a product to obtain a cerium oxide carrier, 2) mixing a palladium-containing solution with a cerium oxide carrier dispersion liquid, stirring, adjusting the pH to 9.5-10.5, aging, filtering to obtain powder, and 3) washing, drying and heat-treating the powder to obtain the ultralow-palladium-supported cerium oxide cube electrocatalyst. The electro-catalyst prepared by the method has low palladium content and low cost, and has excellent electro-catalytic oxygen evolution reaction performance and high electrochemical stability under alkaline conditions.

title_en: Galvanometer unit, preparation method thereof, scanning mirror and radar system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a galvanometer unit and a preparation method thereof, a scanning mirror and a radar system, wherein the galvanometer unit comprises a first substrate and a second substrate which are arranged in a bonding way, the second substrate comprises a galvanometer structure accommodated in a cavity structure, the galvanometer structure is provided with a rotating shaft, the first substrate comprises an electrostatic driving structure, a flat plate electrode is arranged facing the second substrate and is mutually insulated from the electrostatic driving structure, the electrostatic driving structure drives the flat plate electrode to reciprocate in a first direction, the flat plate electrode comprises a first main electrode and a second main electrode which are positioned at different sides of the rotating shaft, and in the process of driving the flat plate electrode to reciprocate by the electrostatic driving structure, the overlapping area of the first main electrode and the second main electrode and the galvanometer structure is changed, so that the electrostatic attractive force acting on the galvanometer structure is changed, and the galvanometer structure is driven to rotate along the rotating shaft.

title_en: Uniform nanoscale carbon coated graphite negative electrode material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a uniform nano-scale carbon coated graphite negative electrode material, which comprises the steps of firstly growing a thin and uniform silicon dioxide nano layer on the surface of graphite particles in a liquid phase, then carrying out carbon coating on the surface of the silicon dioxide coated graphite particles, and removing the silicon dioxide layer through alkaline etching, so that the nano-scale carbon coated graphite negative electrode material with uniform thickness can be obtained, and the volume expansion capacity of the material is improved.

title_en: High-purity silica sol and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of silica sol, and provides high-purity silica sol and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the steps of mixing a lithium source, silicon powder and a first part of water for initiating reaction, adding residual water after the initiating reaction is finished, performing polymerization reaction to obtain a first product, mixing the first product with an acid solution to obtain a mixed solution, filtering the mixed solution, and concentrating filtrate obtained by filtering to obtain high-purity silica sol. According to the invention, alkyl lithium or alkoxy lithium is used as an initiator, elemental silicon powder is used as a silicon source, silicic acid is generated by reaction with water, and the silicic acid is further polymerized and concentrated to prepare the sodium-free high-purity spherical silica sol with high added value. The mass fraction of silicon dioxide in the spherical silica sol is 25-40%, the specific gravity at 20 ℃ is 1.1-1.3 g/cm  3 , the viscosity at 25 ℃ is 10-50000 cP, and the particle size is 10-20 nm.

title_en: High modification density oligoA-TAILED DNA-nano gold material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biology, in particular to a high modification density oligoA-TAILED DNA-nano gold material and a preparation method thereof. The oligoA-TAILED DNA-nano gold material is AuNPs and/or AuNRs and modified oligoA-TAILED DNA, and the oligoA-TAILED DNA sequence is shown as SEQ ID No. 1. The preparation method is low in cost and easy to operate, can realize the high-density oligoA-TAILED DNA modification of the surface of the nano gold with different morphologies, and is high in stability.

title_en: Automobile exterior trim part capable of transmitting radar waves and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of surface treatment of automotive exterior trim parts, and particularly relates to an automotive exterior trim part capable of transmitting radar waves and a preparation method thereof. The automobile exterior trim part comprises an exterior trim part body and a radar wave-permeable film structure positioned on the upper surface of the exterior trim part body, wherein the radar wave-permeable film structure sequentially comprises a first indium oxide film layer, a metal indium film layer and a second indium oxide film layer. The invention adopts the structure of protecting the metal indium film layer by the double indium oxide film layers, thereby not only ensuring the white light penetrating effect of the automobile exterior trimming part, but also having the efficient radar wave penetrating function. The film structure realizes the high standard that the radar wave bidirectional transmission attenuation is less than 3dB, and perfectly fits the current trend of the automobile industry towards intelligent and networking development.

title_en: Two-dimensional ultrathin graphene nanosheets and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of inorganic nonmetallic materials, in particular to a two-dimensional ultrathin graphene nano sheet and a preparation method thereof. The two-dimensional ultrathin graphene nanosheets are prepared based on zinc-based metal organic framework materials. In the preparation method, the preparation from the bulk MOF material to the two-dimensional ultrathin graphene nanosheets is completed in one step based on the zinc-based metal organic framework material, the preparation steps are simple, the operation is simple, the purity of the obtained product is high, complicated post-treatment is not needed, and the production efficiency of the product is improved. The obtained two-dimensional ultrathin graphene nanosheet material has stable framework, ultrathin structure and rich pores, can be used as a firm carrier to provide a large number of exposed sites for loading catalytic active substances, has excellent performance in various catalytic reactions, and is easy to popularize and use.

title_en: Positive electrode material, preparation method thereof, positive electrode plate, secondary battery and power utilization device
abstract_en: The application provides a positive electrode material, a preparation method thereof, a positive electrode plate, a secondary battery and an electric device, wherein the positive electrode material comprises a first coating layer, a second coating layer, a lithium element and an X element, wherein the first coating layer is coated on at least part of the outer surface of the inner core, the second coating layer is coated on at least part of the outer surface of the inner core with the first coating layer, the first coating layer comprises the lithium element and the X element, and the second coating layer comprises the X element and the Z element. The lithium residue on the surface of the inner core can be eliminated by forming the first coating layer, meanwhile, the first coating layer has higher oxygen vacancy forming energy, the oxygen dissolution in the inner core can be reduced or even avoided, the side reaction between oxygen and electrolyte caused by the oxygen dissolution is reduced or even avoided, the cycle life and the safety of the secondary battery are improved, and the overflow of oxygen from the position which is not coated with the first coating layer is reduced or even avoided by forming the uniform protective film on the surface of the inner core coated with the first coating layer.

title_en: Method for inhibiting MEMS micro-mirror crosstalk
abstract_en: The application provides a method for inhibiting MEMS micro-mirror crosstalk. The method for inhibiting the crosstalk of the MEMS micro-mirror comprises the step of inhibiting the high-frequency mechanical resonance of the MEMS micro-mirror, wherein the mode of inhibiting the high-frequency resonance of the MEMS micro-mirror can effectively inhibit the crosstalk between double shafts by increasing the resonance frequency difference between the first actuator and the second actuator, deflection performance of the MEMS micro-mirror in each axial direction is ensured without sacrificing the deflection angle of the double shafts, and the mode of inhibiting the high-frequency mechanical resonance of the MEMS micro-mirror can also effectively filter high-frequency signal components in an excitation signal by filtering the excitation signal, so that the interference of the high-frequency resonance on the control of the MEMS micro-mirror is reduced, and the control precision of the MEMS micro-mirror is improved.

title_en: Method for depositing electron transport layer by alcohol-assisted chemical bath for perovskite solar cell and perovskite solar cell
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for depositing an electron transport layer by alcohol-assisted chemical bath for a perovskite solar cell and the perovskite solar cell, wherein the method comprises the steps of cleaning a substrate to obtain a clean conductive glass substrate; adding SnCl  2 ·2H 2  O into an isobutanol aqueous solution, adding urea, adding thioglycollic acid and concentrated hydrochloric acid to mix to prepare a chemical bath solution, soaking a clean substrate into the chemical bath solution, placing the substrate into an oven to perform a deposition reaction, and cleaning and annealing after the reaction is finished to finish depositing a SnO  2  electron transport layer on a conductive glass substrate. The SnO  2  electron transport layer deposited by the method for depositing the electron transport layer through the alcohol-assisted chemical bath has better uniformity, less agglomeration of nano particles and higher solar light transmittance, is beneficial to improving the solar light utilization rate of the perovskite solar cell, and improves and reduces the open-circuit voltage and short-circuit current density of the cell, thereby improving the photoelectric conversion efficiency of the perovskite solar cell.

title_en: Flexible stretchable alternating current electroluminescent device and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of flexible wearable electronic devices, and particularly relates to a flexible stretchable alternating current electroluminescent device and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps of firstly manufacturing a luminescent layer by using an electrostatic spinning method, then coating liquid metal on one surface of the luminescent layer, forming a patterned liquid metal bottom electrode according to requirements, then spraying a silver nanowire top electrode on the other surface of the luminescent layer, and finally packaging by using transparent PDMS (polydimethylsiloxane), thereby completing the manufacturing of the flexible wearable electroluminescent device on a fabric. The simplicity of the electrostatic spinning process and the optimization of the luminescent layer spinning solution ensure that the device has the traditional flexible function and stable tensile property. The invention omits the substrate of the ACEL device, ensures the stable operation of the device under the stretching condition, simultaneously greatly reduces the whole thickness of the device and saves materials.

title_en: SiO (silicon dioxide)XMicrocrystalline graphite anode material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a SiO  X /microcrystalline graphite anode material, a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of lithium battery anode materials. The preparation method comprises the steps of taking microcrystalline graphite as a matrix material, adopting a hydrothermal reaction method to grow nano silicon oxide particles in situ on the surface of the microcrystalline graphite and in gaps between sheets to form a SiO  X /microcrystalline graphite composite material, and coating a carbon coating layer with a complete carbon layer structure on the surface of the SiO  X /microcrystalline graphite composite material to finally form the SiO  X /microcrystalline graphite anode material with a core-shell structure. According to the technical scheme, the stress effect caused by silicon volume expansion in the charging and discharging process is counteracted and restrained by utilizing the disordered layer structure characteristics of the fine crystalline flake of the microcrystalline graphite, meanwhile, nano SiO  X  particles are filled in gaps of the microcrystalline graphite flake layer, the fine crystalline flake graphite constructs a three-dimensional conductive network structure, and the problem that the conductivity of SiO  X  particles is poor is solved.

title_en: Ruthenium-doped Prussian blue phosphide analog electrocatalyst, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ruthenium doped Prussian blue analogues electro-catalyst, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of firstly preparing NiFe PBA by taking nickel nitrate hexahydrate, sodium citrate and potassium ferricyanide as raw materials, then preparing Ru/NiFe PBA by Ru doping, and finally preparing Ru/NiFeP by phosphating. The prepared Ru/NiFeP has Ru, ni, fe and P contents of 10%, 19%, 18% and 53% respectively, is used for alkaline oxygen evolution reaction, has excellent catalytic activity and stability, has low overpotential, and has the overpotential at 10 mA cm  ‑2  as low as 264 mV.

title_en: Copper sub-nanocluster-metal organic framework composite catalyst, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of catalysts, in particular to a copper sub-nanocluster-metal organic framework composite catalyst, a preparation method and application thereof. The copper sub-nanocluster-metal organic framework composite catalyst comprises a substrate, wherein the substrate is a metal organic framework with a porous structure, and copper sub-nanoclusters are formed on the substrate. Compared with the prior art, the method takes the metal organic framework as a substrate, obtains the copper sub-nanocluster catalyst limited in the organic framework through an impregnation method and an in-situ electroreduction reaction, and can realize higher Faraday efficiency and yield when the catalyst is used in the reaction of preparing methane by electrocatalytic carbon dioxide reduction.

title_en: Dimethylamine gas catalytic luminescence sensing material, sensor, preparation and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dimethylamine gas catalytic luminescence sensing material, a sensor and preparation and application thereof, belonging to the field of gas catalytic luminescence sensors, wherein the material preparation steps comprise, dissolving zirconium oxychloride hydrate in water, adding a chelating agent and polyhydroxy alcohol, evaporating to dryness after dissolving, calcining at a specific temperature, and naturally cooling. The invention can rapidly prepare metastable tetragonal zirconia sensing material, has the particle diameter of about 10nm, relatively uniform particle size distribution, no agglomeration, large specific surface area, stable existence at room temperature, high sensitivity for rapidly detecting dimethylamine gas, good cycle performance, good consistency when being used for catalyzing a luminous sensor to continuously and repeatedly detect amine VOCs, high selectivity for detecting dimethylamine gas without being interfered by other gases, good reproducibility and stability, and can be used for monitoring dimethylamine gas for a long time, and has the advantages of high response speed, high accuracy and long service life.

title_en: Lead zirconate titanate film and low-temperature preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of piezoelectric materials, in particular to a lead zirconate titanate film, a low-temperature preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of taking Ti metal as a radio frequency target material to perform first sputtering deposition treatment on a substrate to form a Ti adhesion layer; forming a bottom electrode on the Ti adhesion layer, carrying out second sputtering deposition treatment on the bottom electrode by taking Pb  x Zr 0.52 Ti 0.48 O 3  ceramic as a radio frequency target material, forming a PZT seed layer by rapid heat treatment, carrying out third sputtering deposition treatment on the PZT seed layer by taking Pb  x Zr 0.52 Ti 0.48 O 3  ceramic as a radio frequency target material, and repeating the steps by rapid heat treatment to form the lead zirconate titanate film. The invention does not additionally heat the substrate tray in the process of sputtering and depositing the PZT film material, reduces the loss and volatilization of PbO, can effectively maintain the stability of film components, utilizes the PZT seed layer to provide more crystal nuclei, promotes the uniform crystallization of the PZT film, improves the crystallization quality and the electrical property of the PZT film, reduces the grain boundary defect, and enhances the adhesive force and the stability of the film and the substrate.

title_en: Preparation method and application of bi-ligand Co-based metal organic framework alkaline electrolysis water electrolysis catalysis electrode material
abstract_en: A preparation method and application of a bi-ligand Co-based metal organic framework alkaline electrolysis water electrolysis catalysis electrode material belong to the technical field of electrochemical energy storage materials. The preparation method comprises the steps of taking 2, 5-diphosphothiophene and 4,4' -bipyridine as double ligands, taking cobalt nitrate hexahydrate as metal salt, dissolving in a mixed solution of water and methanol, transferring the completely dissolved mixed solution into a reaction kettle, obliquely placing foam nickel into the reaction kettle, sealing, heating for reaction, naturally cooling to room temperature, taking out the foam nickel, repeatedly flushing with deionized water and methanol, and finally vacuum drying to obtain the Co-Tdp-Bpy catalyst loaded on the foam nickel. The method is simple to operate, does not need complicated high-temperature pyrolysis, gas phase reduction and other treatments, and is easy to prepare in a large scale. In a standard three-electrode system, the prepared electrocatalyst is used as a working electrode anode to perform an electrocatalytic reaction in a 1M KOH electrolysis system, and the electrocatalyst has excellent water decomposition activity and stability.

title_en: Broad spectrum integrated spectrometer based on coupling of waveguide grating and scattering array
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wide spectrum integrated spectrometer based on coupling of a waveguide grating and a scattering array. The CMOS detector is used for detecting the spatial distribution of scattered light intensity of the scattering array, and reconstructing an incident spectrum by using the light intensity distribution. The waveguide grating adopts a waveguide grating with a gradual change period, and the bloch modes of the incident light with different wavelengths are localized at different spatial positions of the waveguide grating. The scattering array comprises scattering units, the scattering units are distributed in an array, the scattering units are composed of nano-columns arranged in a 2x2 matrix, and the radius of each nano-column of the scattering array is gradually changed along the extending direction of the optical waveguide. The invention combines the Bulobz mode local area of the waveguide grating and the scattering array resonance of the nano-pillar array, overcomes the problem that the resolution precision of the traditional spectrometer is limited by volume, and realizes the integrated spectrometer with high resolution capability and wide spectral range.

title_en: Light-emitting diode capable of improving brightness and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a light emitting diode for improving brightness and a preparation method thereof, which belong to the technical field of photoelectron manufacturing. The light-emitting diode comprises an epitaxial layer, an ohmic contact film and a metal reflecting layer, wherein the ohmic contact film comprises a silver nano layer, the silver nano layer is positioned on the surface of the epitaxial layer, the metal reflecting layer is positioned on one side, far away from the epitaxial layer, of the silver nano layer, and the metal reflecting layer is connected with the silver nano layer. The light absorption of the transparent conductive layer can be avoided, and the brightness of the light emitting diode is improved.

title_en: Divalent manganese ion doped cadmium-based metal halide nanocrystalline scintillator material, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a divalent manganese ion doped cadmium-based metal halide nanocrystalline scintillator material, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein divalent manganese ions are doped in Cs  3 Cd 2 Cl 7  to form an all-inorganic cadmium-based halide scintillator nanocrystalline, so that conversion of green light to yellow light is realized, further high-efficiency yellow light emission with quantum efficiency of 20.6% is realized, and the fluorescence lifetime is 0.652 mu s. The invention also discloses a preparation method of the nanocrystalline scintillator material, which has the advantages of simple process, low cost, green and pollution-free performance and capability of realizing large-scale industrial production. The invention also discloses a scintillator film, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the scintillation intensity of the scintillator film is 1.3067 times of that of a commercial scintillator CsI: tl wafer, the minimum detection limit is 4.0138 mu Gy  air /s, the imaging resolution is about 16 lp/mm, and the scintillator film can be effectively applied to the fields of X-ray medical imaging, nondestructive testing, industrial flaw detection and the like.

title_en: Nanocomposite with good water dispersibility and X-ray radiation luminescence performance and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a nanocomposite with good water dispersibility and X-ray radiation luminescence performance and a preparation method thereof, wherein the nanocomposite utilizes condensation reaction of surface hydroxyl groups of halloysite nanotubes and carboxyl groups in disodium ethylenediamine tetraacetate (EDTA-2 Na), and anchors ethylenediamine tetraacetic acid groups in the surface structures of the halloysite nanotubes through one-step chemical reaction; and further mixing the EDTA modified halloysite nanotube with sodium nitrate, yttrium nitrate hexahydrate, praseodymium nitrate hexahydrate and ammonium fluoride through hydrothermal reaction, and growing nano particles with X-ray radiation luminescence performance on the surface of the halloysite nanotube in situ to prepare the nanocomposite. The nano composite material prepared by the invention has the advantages of good water dispersibility, nano-micro level size control, no Pd and other high-toxicity metal elements, and the like, and the whole preparation process adopts water as a reaction solvent, thereby being environment-friendly.

title_en: Lithium iron manganese phosphate positive electrode material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lithium iron manganese phosphate positive electrode material and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of lithium ion batteries, the lithium iron manganese phosphate positive electrode material comprises LiMn  (1‑X) Fe X PO 4  and an interception film material, wherein the interception film material comprises phenolic nanocellulose and SiO  2  -nanotubes, a carbon coating layer is arranged on the surface of LiMn  (1‑X) Fe X PO 4 , the interception film material is fixed on the surface of the carbon coating layer in a film mode, the mechanical strength of the carbon coating layer can be improved, further, the dissolution of manganese ions is prevented, the nanocellulose and the SiO  2  -nanotubes are porous structures with high specific surface area and porosity, therefore, the lithium iron manganese phosphate positive electrode material has good physical adsorption performance and chemical reaction activity, the free manganese ions can be adsorbed and fixed, the purpose of intercepting the dissolution of the manganese ions is achieved, the surface of the nanocellulose is grafted with BHA, the BHA contains a large amount of phenolic hydroxyl groups and tertiary butyl groups, the phenolic hydroxyl groups can reduce the negative effects of the battery caused by free radicals, the tertiary butyl groups can further block the approach of other groups or molecules, and further the electrochemical performance of the battery is further intercepted.

title_en: Gadolinium-containing carbon dot composite nano material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of composite biological materials and discloses a preparation method of a gadolinium-containing carbon dot composite nano material, which comprises the following steps of S1, dissolving gadolinium salt and o-phenylenediamine in deionized water to form a mixed solution, and stirring for 30-60 min at room temperature to uniformly mix the solution; and S2, adding the uniformly mixed solution into a polytetrafluoroethylene reaction kettle, heating the solution to react, naturally cooling the reacted solution to room temperature to obtain a product solution, S3, filtering the product solution by using a microporous filter membrane, dialyzing the product solution by using a dialysis bag to remove unreacted micromolecular substances, and performing freeze-drying treatment to obtain the brown yellow powdery gadolinium-containing carbon dots. The carbon nanodot has nuclear magnetic resonance/fluorescence bimodal imaging and multiple performances of promoting bone repair, and also has good biocompatibility.

title_en: Preparation method of water-soluble fluorescent carbon nano powder
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of water-soluble fluorescent carbon nano powder, which belongs to the technical field of fluorescent carbon nano materials and comprises the following steps of extracting lignin by ultrasonic-assisted ethanol, and mixing with red wine polyphenol to obtain a pretreated carbon material; combining the modified carbon material with the reinforced polymer, and then performing hydrothermal treatment to obtain the water-soluble fluorescent carbon nano powder. According to the technical scheme, lignin is extracted by ultrasonic-assisted ethanol, so that the extraction efficiency and yield of lignin can be improved, the pretreated carbon material is combined with the nitrogen-containing compound, the fluorescence intensity and stability of the fluorescent carbon nano powder can be improved, the modified carbon material is combined with the reinforced polymer, the water solubility and fluorescence performance of the fluorescent carbon nano powder can be better improved, the production cost can be reduced through simple hydrothermal treatment, and the comprehensive performance of the water-soluble fluorescent carbon nano powder is generally improved.

title_en: MEMS chip based on single-axis vibration sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a MEMS chip based on a single-axis vibration sensor, which relates to the technical field of semiconductor technology and comprises a substrate, wherein the substrate is provided with a front surface and a back surface which are opposite, the front surface is provided with a piezoelectric layer, the piezoelectric layer comprises a bottom electrode, a piezoelectric film and a top electrode which are sequentially laminated, the structure of the chip in a range corresponding to a longitudinal projection area of a back cavity is a vibrating diaphragm, the piezoelectric layer in the longitudinal projection area of the back cavity is the vibrating diaphragm, the piezoelectric film comprises a piezoelectric film main body in a non-vibrating diaphragm area, a center block in the vibrating diaphragm area, a plurality of cantilever beams and a plurality of fixed beams, the center block is positioned in the center of the vibrating diaphragm area, two ends of each fixed beam are respectively connected with the center block and the piezoelectric film main body, one end of each cantilever beam is connected with the center block, and the cantilever beams amplify received force. The invention improves the sensitivity by the action of the cantilever Liang Fangda and the stability of the chip by the fixing beam.

title_en: Leadless packaging structure of non-contact pressure sensor chip and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a leadless packaging structure of a non-contact pressure sensor chip and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of MEMS sensors. The packaging main body comprises a pressure sensor chip to be protected, a silicon carbide sealing plate and a transition plate which have the functions of sealing, surface circuit protection and connection, and a conductive paste is used for sintering the kovar alloy contact pin to provide mechanical support so as to ensure suspended connection and electrical connection. The upper part and the silicon carbide top plate and the lower part of the packaging main body are all spaced from the silicon carbide bottom plate. The non-contact leadless packaging improves the high temperature resistance of the silicon carbide pressure sensor, is beneficial to the release of thermal stress in the measuring process, and has the advantages of high material thermal adaptability, high measuring precision, good measuring stability and the like.

title_en: Preparation method of high-dispersion lamellar ZSM-5 molecular sieve
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a preparation method of a high-dispersion lamellar ZSM-5 molecular sieve, and relates to the field of molecular sieve preparation. S1, preparing seed crystal liquid, S2, mixing tetrapropylammonium hydroxide solution, deionized water, a silicon source and the seed crystal liquid prepared in the step S1 to obtain solution B, S3, adding an aluminum source into the deionized water to enable the aluminum source to be dissolved in the deionized water, S4, adding the deionized water with the aluminum source dissolved into the clear solution in the step S2 to stir to obtain white solution C, S5, adding an additive into the deionized water to enable the additive to be dissolved in the deionized water, S6, adding the deionized water with the additive dissolved into the solution C in the step S4 to stir, then filling the solution into a crystallization kettle to crystallize to obtain a crystallized sample, and S7, drying and roasting the crystallized sample to obtain the flaky ZSM-5 molecular sieve.

title_en: Monoatomic manganese doped carbon quantum dot and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monoatomic manganese doped carbon quantum dot, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the monoatomic manganese doped carbon quantum dot is prepared by carrying out hydrothermal reaction by taking water as a solvent and EDTA, tetrahydrated manganese chloride and ethylenediamine as raw materials, and the mass ratio of the tetrahydrated manganese chloride to the EDTA is 10:73. In the invention, EDTA is specifically used as a carbon source and a chelating agent, water is used as a solvent, manganese chloride tetrahydrate and Ethylenediamine (EDA) are used as raw materials for hydrothermal reaction to obtain the Mn-N  2  coordinated monoatomic manganese doped carbon quantum dot, and the Mn-N  2  coordinated monoatomic manganese doped carbon quantum dot has the advantages of small size, good water solubility, good fluorescence and near infrared imaging performance and high-efficiency peroxidase-like activity.

title_en: Molybdenum diselenide nano carbon material compound, preparation method thereof and hydrogen evolution catalytic electrode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a molybdenum diselenide nano-carbon material compound and a preparation method thereof, and a hydrogen evolution catalytic electrode, belonging to the field of hydrogen evolution catalysts, wherein the method comprises the steps of preparing and mixing a nano-carbon material dispersion liquid and a nano-molybdenum diselenide particle dispersion liquid, carrying out ultrasonic treatment, filtering and drying; the preparation method of the nano molybdenum diselenide particle dispersion liquid comprises the steps of dropwise adding a normal-temperature molybdenum precursor solution into a selenium precursor solution activated at a high temperature, performing heat treatment, and dispersing the product in a second solvent. According to the invention, the catalytic activity is maximized by controlling the size of the molybdenum diselenide particles, and the nano molybdenum diselenide particles are dispersed on the nano carbon material with excellent conductivity by utilizing ultrasonic waves, so that the problem that the activity and stability are reduced due to agglomeration when the nano molybdenum diselenide particles are singly used as a hydrogen evolution reaction catalyst can be solved, and the catalyst has more economical efficiency than a platinum catalyst, has excellent electronic performance, shows excellent catalytic activity in the hydrogen evolution reaction, and can be used as an effective catalyst for the hydrogen evolution reaction.

title_en: Nanoparticle material, functional film, preparation method of functional film and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a nanoparticle material, a functional film, a preparation method thereof and electronic equipment, wherein the nanoparticle material comprises a structure shown in the following formula (1): Among them, Is a nanosphere, M comprises functional particles, Z is a hydrophobic group, R comprises at least one of carboxyl, sulfhydryl and amino, a and b are integers greater than or equal to 1, and c is an integer greater than or equal to 0; the application can improve the patterning precision and efficiency of the nano particle material without damaging the performance of the nano particle material.

title_en: Method for preparing nano nickel powder by utilizing plasmas
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for preparing nano nickel powder by utilizing plasmas. The method comprises the steps of taking a nickel-containing material as an anode, carrying out arc discharge in a vacuum reaction chamber until the reaction is finished through plasma working gas, vacuumizing the reaction chamber, introducing passivation gas, and obtaining nano nickel powder after the passivation treatment is finished, wherein the plasma working gas is mixed gas consisting of oxygen, hydrogen and first gas, and the first gas is one or more of argon, nitrogen and helium. The nano nickel powder prepared by the method has good dispersibility and uniform granularity, and solves the problem of serious agglomeration of the nano nickel powder prepared by an original growth path.

title_en: TiB2Al-Cu alloy, method for producing same, and additive manufacturing use
abstract_en: The invention provides a TiB  2 /Al-Cu alloy, a preparation method and an additive manufacturing application thereof, wherein the TiB  2 /Al-Cu alloy is prepared by adopting a mixed salt in-situ autogenous method of magnetic field vibration assisted mechanical stirring, so that uniform dispersion of micro-nano TiB  2  particles formed in a material is facilitated, the heterogeneous nucleation and enhancement of the particles are exerted, the laser absorptivity of the alloy in the additive manufacturing process can be effectively improved, and the basic components of the TiB  2 /Al-Cu alloy comprise, by mass, 1-5% of Cu, 0.1-0.3% of Mn, 1-8% of TiB  2  and the balance of Al. Preferably, mn, zr/Y and other trace alloying elements are added in the smelting process, so that grains can be refined in the alloying process, and the mechanical property and corrosion resistance of the material are improved.

title_en: Gel-based nitrogen, phosphorus and sulfur co-doped carbon coated carbide electrocatalyst and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of catalytic materials, and in particular discloses a gel-based nitrogen, phosphorus and sulfur co-doped carbon coated carbide electrocatalyst and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of firstly taking heteropoly acid as a cross-linking agent, pyrrole or aniline as a monomer, and initiating reaction by using ammonium persulfate to prepare heteropoly acid crosslinked polymer gel; and then carrying out freeze drying treatment on the obtained gel, and carrying out high-temperature pyrolysis under the protection of inert gas to finally obtain the nitrogen, phosphorus and sulfur co-doped carbon coated carbide electrocatalyst. The electrocatalyst shows extremely high electrocatalytic hydrogen production activity and stability under an acidic condition, and the preparation method is simple and easy to operate, strong in controllability, short in production flow, low in risk and suitable for large-scale production and industrial water electrolysis hydrogen production.

title_en: Integrated MEMS chip and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses an integrated MEMS chip and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the manufacturing method comprises the steps of providing a first substrate and a second substrate, manufacturing an auxiliary open pore structure on the surface of the second substrate, arranging a first through hole on the auxiliary open pore structure, manufacturing a sensor structure on the surface of the first substrate provided with a movable groove, connecting the first substrate and the second substrate, arranging a movable interval between the surface of one side of each sensor structure, which is far away from the first substrate, and the surface of the second substrate provided with the auxiliary open pore structure, wherein the movable interval and the movable groove jointly form a deformation space of the corresponding sensor structure, and arranging a second through hole which is communicated with the first through hole in a one-to-one correspondence manner on the second substrate. According to the application, the air pressure of the corresponding deformation space can be adjusted through the communicated second vent hole and the first vent hole, and the first vent hole and the second vent hole are plugged after the air pressure is adjusted, so that the air pressure in the deformation space is maintained at the preset air pressure.

title_en: Narrow-band green delayed fluorescence carbon quantum frame with high quantum yield, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of fluorescent carbon nano materials, in particular to a narrow-band green delayed fluorescent carbon quantum frame with high quantum yield, and a preparation method and application thereof. 1-bromo-3-fluorobenzene and boron tribromide are used as carbon source precursors, a reaction catalyst is added into the carbon source precursor solution, the mixture is heated, and the reaction is carried out for 18-24 hours at 120-150 ℃ to obtain the carbon quantum frame solution. The narrow band delayed fluorescence carbon quantum frame prepared by the invention is formed by bonding four dibenzo [ fg, op ] tetraene units through symmetrical boron bridges, and has a rigid non-planar conjugated frame structure. The narrow band delayed fluorescence carbon quantum frame with the quantum yield of 98% has wide application prospect in the field of electroluminescence. The light-emitting material is applied to an electroluminescent diode, has the advantages of high external quantum efficiency, low efficiency roll-off and the like, and is expected to be used as a novel light-emitting material with low cost and environmental friendliness and applied to the field of next-generation display.

title_en: High-stability metal atom catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-stability metal atom catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof. The porous carbon nanotube is prepared by heat treatment based on commercial multi-wall carbon nanotubes by utilizing metal impurities contained in the carbon nanotubes. The metal atom catalyst with high stability can be obtained by a simple process, can catalyze electrochemical reaction efficiently, rapidly and stably, and is beneficial to industrial mass production and application.

title_en: PI nanofiber membrane for lithium battery and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a PI nanofiber membrane for a lithium battery and a preparation method thereof, wherein the PI nanofiber membrane comprises the following steps of selecting proper dianhydride monomers, diamine monomers and polar aprotic solvents; mixing diamine monomer and solvent under anhydrous condition to form solution, adding dianhydride monomer under low temperature condition, slowly raising temperature to make reaction be implemented so as to obtain polyamide acid solution for standby, adding the polyamide acid solution into DMAC solvent, fully mixing, assembling into ejector of electrostatic spinning device, spinning under high-pressure and pressure, receiving spinning by means of rotating drum, collecting for a period of time so as to obtain PAA nano fiber non-woven fabric film.

title_en: Graphene-based magnetic tunnel junction device with high magnetic resistance change rate and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a graphene-based magnetic tunnel junction device with high magnetic resistance change rate and a preparation method thereof, wherein the graphene-based magnetic tunnel junction device comprises a ferromagnetic substrate, a graphene layer and an insulating film layer which are sequentially arranged from top to bottom, the insulating film layer comprises a nanopore array, an upper ferromagnetic layer and a conductive metal film, the upper ferromagnetic layer is positioned in the nanopore array, the upper ferromagnetic layer is positioned between the graphene layer and the conductive metal film, the aperture size of the nanopore array is 10-200 nm, the thickness of the insulating film layer is 50-300 nm, the magnetic resistance change rate is high, the preparation process is simple, the preparation method of the graphene-based magnetic tunnel junction device can avoid the problem of short circuit of a nano junction region, and the magnetic resistance change rate of the graphene-based magnetic tunnel junction device is remarkably improved.

title_en: Self-starting pyro-death inducer and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The scheme discloses a self-starting scorch inducer and a preparation method and application thereof, the self-starting scorch inducer focuses on caspase-4/5/11 to realize scorch of tumor cells, provides a combination drug of manganese dioxide nano enzyme and outer membrane vesicles, coats the manganese dioxide nano enzyme by the outer membrane vesicles to prepare the self-starting scorch inducer, ensures that the self-starting scorch inducer can be decomposed in tumor cells with higher glutathione level to release manganese ions and lipopolysaccharide of the outer membrane vesicles, utilizes a series of reactions between the elevated GSH level of the tumor cells and the manganese ions to generate active oxygen to up-regulate the precursor expression of the caspase-4/5/11, activates the caspase-4/5/11 by the lipopolysaccharide of the outer membrane vesicles OMVs, generates a synergistic effect with the active oxygen generated by MnNZ, and efficiently induces scorch of the tumor cells.

title_en: N-doped modified MOFs (metal-organic frameworks) derived core-shell nano-reactor, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of material preparation and chemical engineering, and in particular relates to an N-doped modified MOFs (metal-organic frameworks) derived core-shell nano-reactor, a preparation method and application thereof. According to the application, cobalt is used as node metal, an N-doped modified MOFs material is synthesized through hydrothermal reaction with an organic ligand and a nitrogen source, porous silica is coated on the surface of the material, and the N-doped modified MOFs derivative core-shell nano-reactor is prepared through a two-step calcination method. The MOFs derivative core-shell nano-reactor prepared by the method has large specific surface area, rich pore structure, excellent catalytic activity and stability, and is used as a catalyst for transferring and hydrogenating alpha, beta-unsaturated aldehyde, high in catalytic activity and good in recycling stability, and is suitable for large-scale popularization and application.

title_en: Sensor module and assembly method
abstract_en: The invention provides a sensor module and an assembly method, wherein the sensor module comprises a circuit board and at least two sensor monomers with the same structure, the sensor monomers are packaged and arranged on the circuit board, the sensor monomers comprise a substrate, detection chips and pin pads, the detection chips and the pin pads are arranged on the substrate, the pin pads are exposed and distributed on two mutually perpendicular side walls of the sensor monomers and are used for being connected and conducted with the circuit board, and the position relation between the sensor monomers and the circuit board is adjusted by changing the arrangement direction of the sensor monomers so as to detect signals in different directions through different sensor monomers. The invention can respectively realize signal detection in different directions through a plurality of sensor monomers with the same structure.

title_en: Method for producing metal-containing film blanks
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for producing (Ω) metal-containing film blanks (1), wherein the method comprises the steps of applying (E1) a primer layer on a substrate, vapor depositing (E2) metal to form a multilayer composite structure comprising a metal film, placing (S  1 ) the structure (10) in a liquid (M  1 ), and breaking (S  2 ) the primer layer (101). According to the invention, the bottom layer (101) comprises copper. The film (100) contains a noble metal. The invention further relates to a coating method (ψ) for coating the blank (1) to a target carrier (2), and to the use of the target carrier.

title_en: Cutting tool with high-hardness self-lubricating coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coated cutters, and provides a cutting cutter with a high-hardness self-lubricating coating and a preparation method thereof, wherein the cutting cutter comprises a cutter matrix and a coating formed on the cutter matrix; the coating layer has a multi-layer structure and sequentially comprises a first sub-coating layer, a first gradient layer, a second sub-coating layer, a second gradient layer and a third sub-coating layer from inside to outside, wherein the content of Si in the first gradient layer is increased in a gradient manner along the direction from inside to outside and is not higher than the content of Si in the second sub-coating layer, and the content of B in the second gradient layer is increased in a gradient manner along the direction from inside to outside and is not higher than the content of B in the third sub-coating layer.

title_en: Bimetal nano assembly, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a bimetal nano assembly, a preparation method and application thereof. The method comprises the steps of A) mixing a phenolic polymer with a surfactant solution, B) mixing the solution obtained in the step A) with a hafnium chloride solution, C) mixing the solution obtained in the step B), a cross-linking agent and a copper sulfate solution, D) adjusting the pH value of the solution obtained in the step C) to 7-9, and centrifugally precipitating to obtain the Hf-Cu polyphenol nano assembly. The coordination-mediated bi-metal HfCu-polyphenol self-assembly method provided by the invention is simple and feasible, green and environment-friendly, low in price and good in biocompatibility, provides a synthesis strategy of a nuclide-labeled HfCu-bi-metal nano assembly structure capable of improving tumor hypoxia, and simultaneously provides a new idea for clinical internal and external radiotherapy type tumor diagnosis and treatment.

title_en: Long-time high-temperature-resistant lead sulfide colloid quantum dot film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a long-time high-temperature-resistant lead sulfide colloid quantum dot film and a preparation method thereof, wherein the lead sulfide colloid quantum dot film comprises the steps of obtaining a first PbS quantum dot solid, wherein a surface ligand of the first PbS quantum dot solid is a first ligand, and dissolving the first PbS quantum dot solid in a first nonpolar solvent to form a first PbS quantum dot solution; adding a mercaptan ligand into the first PbS quantum dot solution to obtain a second PbS quantum dot solid, wherein the surface of the quantum dot is the mercaptan ligand, dissolving the quantum dot with the surface of the mercaptan ligand in a second nonpolar solvent to obtain a second PbS quantum dot solution, spin-coating the second PbS quantum dot solution on a substrate to prepare a PbS colloid quantum dot film, and preparing the mercaptan ligand into one or more combinations of Mercaptoethanol (ME) or butanethiol. According to the embodiment of the invention, the Mercaptoethanol (ME) or the butanethiol is adopted as the solid ligand of the PbS quantum dot, and the high-temperature-resistant mercaptan ligand is utilized to replace the high-temperature-unstable metal halide ligand, so that the stability of the PbS quantum dot film at high temperature for a long time is greatly improved.

title_en: Method for detecting mercury ions and vitamin C
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting mercury ions and vitamin C, which takes aqueous solutions of citric acid and urea as raw materials, and prepares fluorescent carbon dots with the maximum fluorescence intensity under 340nm excitation within 300-400 nm by a microwave heating method, wherein the fluorescent carbon dots have selection specificity to Hg  2+  and Vc respectively. The fluorescent carbon dots are prepared by a microwave method, and the method is simple, and has the advantages of good water solubility, no toxicity, good fluorescent light stability and high sensitivity. The invention is based on the fluorescent response mode of the fluorescent carbon dots, uses the fluorescent carbon dots for detecting mercury ions and vitamin C, realizes qualitative/quantitative detection of Hg  2+  and/or Vc in the solution to be detected according to the change of the fluorescent intensity of the fluorescent carbon dot solution, and has the advantages of low detection limit, good selectivity, simplicity, rapidness, low cost, no limitation of experimental conditions and the like.

title_en: Paper-based chip for detecting cadmium ions by LIBS (laser induced breakdown spectroscopy), and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of substance detection, in particular to a paper-based chip for detecting cadmium ions by LIBS, and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the steps of 1) mixing and reacting a zinc salt solution and a sodium sulfide solution to obtain a ZnS nanoparticle solution, 2) mixing the ZnS nanoparticle solution, polyvinylpyrrolidone and an acid solution to obtain a ZnSNPs modified solution, 3) mixing and vibrating the ZnSNPs modified solution and a filter paper sheet, adding an alcohol solution, cleaning and drying. The paper-based chip provided by the invention can be used for efficiently enriching the heavy metal element cadmium in the water body so as to carry out LIBS detection, and the high-sensitivity rapid and efficient detection of the heavy metal Cd in the water body can be well realized by utilizing the LIBS technology and combining the provided paper-based chip.

title_en: Two-dimensional titanium hydroxide nanosheet and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a two-dimensional titanium hydroxide nano-sheet, a preparation method and application thereof. The two-dimensional titanium hydroxide nano-sheet is prepared by combining an alkali-assisted hydrolysis method with an ultrasonic-assisted liquid phase crushing method, wherein the transverse dimension of the two-dimensional titanium hydroxide nano-sheet is 10-200 nm, and the thickness of the two-dimensional titanium hydroxide nano-sheet is less than 10nm. The two-dimensional titanium hydroxide nano-sheet prepared by the invention has good catalytic oxidation resistance, biocompatibility and stability, and can be widely applied to the fields of catalysis and biomedicine.
