title_en: Doped tin dioxide nanocrystalline capable of being highly dispersed in any water-alcohol ratio and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a doped tin dioxide nanocrystalline capable of being highly dispersed in any water-alcohol ratio and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the steps of (1) adding trimethylamine oxide into an aqueous solution containing stannous halide to generate white precipitate, stirring, 2) carrying out hydrothermal reaction on the mixed solution obtained in the step (1) at 120-200 ℃ for 3-24 hours, carrying out solid-liquid phase separation after the reaction is finished, taking a solid phase to disperse in pure water, pure alcohol or a water-alcohol mixed solvent with any water-alcohol ratio to obtain a halogen in-situ doped stannic oxide dispersion liquid, and (3) adding an organic alkali stabilizer into the halogen in-situ doped stannic oxide dispersion liquid, and uniformly mixing to obtain halogen in-situ doped stannic oxide nanocrystalline which is highly dispersed in the pure water, the pure alcohol or the water-alcohol mixed solvent with any water-alcohol ratio. The preparation method is simple and convenient, has low cost, widens the application field of the tin dioxide, and has important application value.

title_en: C TYPE LECTIN protein nanoparticle based on African swine fever virus, fusion protein, preparation and application
abstract_en: The invention provides C TYPE LECTIN protein nano particles based on African swine fever virus, fusion protein, preparation and application, wherein Ferritin nano particles inserted with a Spytag tag are used as an exogenous antigen display carrier, the recombinant protein obtained after fusion of an extracellular domain of African swine fever virus C TYPE LECTIN and SPYCATCHER is subjected to covalent connection, and the connected nano particles are successfully purified by means of gel chromatography and the like. In animal immunity evaluation experiments, the level of C TYPE LECTIN specific antibody in the organism is obviously improved after C TYPE LECTIN extracellular domain is connected with Ferritin nano particles, and the animal immunity evaluation experiments are beneficial to increasing the T cell immune response of the organism.

title_en: Method for preparing nano-sheet array material and positive electrode sheet
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of lithium batteries and discloses a method for preparing a nano-sheet array material and a positive electrode sheet, which comprises the steps of mixing and heating an aliphatic amine solution and an intermediate solution to obtain an amide compound, wherein the intermediate solution comprises copper metal salt, dicarboxylic acid and an alcohol solvent; and mixing the carbon-containing compound with an iron metal salt aqueous solution to obtain the nano-sheet array material. The nano-sheet array material has a space structure with excellent conductivity and high specific area, and can optimize the movement of lithium ions in the lithium battery in the electrochemical process. The positive plate has excellent cycle performance.

title_en: Preparation method and application of Mn-Co@ZIF-11-950 oxygen reduction electrocatalyst
abstract_en: The invention relates to an electrocatalyst, in particular to a preparation method of an Mn-Co@ZIF-11-950 oxygen reduction electrocatalyst. The preparation method comprises the steps of dissolving benzimidazole and phthalocyanine with negative charges in a solvent I, adding a structure directing agent and ammonia water to obtain a solution A, dissolving zinc salt and phthalocyanine with positive charges in a solvent II to obtain a solution B, mixing the solution B with the solution A to obtain a Mn-Co@ZIF-11 precursor, and pyrolyzing the Mn-Co@ZIF-11 precursor in an inert atmosphere to obtain the Mn-Co@ZIF-11-950 oxygen reduction electrocatalyst. The electrocatalyst prepared by the invention has excellent oxygen reduction activity and durability.

title_en: Manufacturing process of SDB type silicon MEMS high-temperature pressure sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a manufacturing process of an SDB type silicon MEMS high-temperature pressure sensor, which relates to the technical field of pressure detection devices of micro-electromechanical systems and comprises the following steps of S1, preparation of SOI materials based on a silicon substrate, S2, photoetching of a resistor area, ion implantation, S3, photoetching of a corrosion protection area, S4, wet corrosion, S5, manufacturing of a lead hole and a metal lead, S6, metallization and passivation, and S7, photoetching of a back corrosion area. The SDB type silicon MEMS high-temperature pressure sensor has the advantages of no damage to the surface of the pressure sensitive resistor, and good uniformity and consistency.

title_en: Copper-based metal organic framework material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of preparation of metal organic framework materials, and discloses a copper-based metal organic framework material, a preparation method and application thereof. The copper-based metal-organic framework material has a nano lamellar morphology, wherein nano layers are distributed in a petal shape, metal elements in the metal-organic framework material are copper, and organic ligands in the metal-organic framework material are trimesic acid. The copper-based metal organic framework material provided by the invention is used for electrocatalytic reduction of carbon dioxide reaction, and has higher ethylene and ethanol Faraday efficiency.

title_en: Method for preparing antibacterial composite coating by filling micro-arc titanium oxide alloy plate micropores with nano Ag/ZSM-5 molecular sieve and antibacterial composite coating
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of antibacterial composite coatings, and discloses a method for preparing an antibacterial composite coating by filling micro-arc titanium oxide alloy plate micropores with a nano Ag/ZSM-5 molecular sieve and the antibacterial composite coating, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of preprocessing the surface of a titanium alloy plate by adopting a micro-arc oxidation technology, preparing nano ZSM-5 molecular sieve grains by adopting in-situ hydrothermal synthesis, loading Ag on the nano ZSM-5 molecular sieve by an ion exchange method to obtain nano Ag/ZSM-5 molecular sieve, filling the nano Ag/ZSM-5 molecular sieve in holes of the titanium alloy plate after micro-arc oxidation, sealing the holes of the titanium alloy plate by secondary hydrothermal treatment after filling to obtain a bacteriostatic composite coating, combining the micro-arc oxidation titanium alloy and the nano Ag/ZSM-5 molecular sieve to form the bacteriostatic composite coating, endowing the titanium alloy plate with functionalization, improving the wear resistance and corrosion resistance, further improving the performance of the titanium alloy plate, solving the problems of holes or microscopic cracks of a micro-arc oxidation film layer and serving as a convenient channel for penetration, transportation and diffusion of corrosive media in the environment.

title_en: Guanidine-derived ionizable lipid material, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention provides a guanidino-derived ionizable lipid material, which is a compound shown in a formula (I), a solvent crystal or an isomer or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt of the compound shown in the formula (I);  Wherein R  1  is a substituted or unsubstituted linear alkyl alcohol of C  2 -C 6 , R  2 、R 3 、R 4  and R  5  are each a substituted or unsubstituted alkyl, alkenyl or alkynyl of C  6 -C 18 , including or not including one or more hetero atoms, R  2 , R  3 , R  4  and R  5  are the same or different from each other, n is a positive integer from 3 to 18, and m is a positive integer from 3 to 18. The guanidino derivative ionizable lipid material has excellent biocompatibility, high-efficiency drug delivery performance, high-efficiency transfection efficiency, effective damage to the stability of an endosome membrane, targeting and drug release control, wide application potential, simple preparation and large-scale production.

title_en: In-situ generated high-stability nano metal particle dispersion-reinforced Mo alloy and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an in-situ generated high-stability nano metal particle dispersion reinforced Mo alloy and a preparation method thereof, wherein the Mo alloy is prepared by pressing and sintering by a powder metallurgy method, the Mo alloy comprises 0.4-0.7wt% of boride ceramic powder HfB  2  and 99.3-99.6wt% of metal Mo powder according to mass percentage, and the microstructure of the Mo alloy comprises Mo crystal grains and Hf particles with nano cubic structures uniformly distributed in the Mo crystal grains. According to the invention, the B source is introduced through boride ceramic powder HfB  2  to react with the impurity O in Mo to generate B  2 O 3  to purify the grain boundary and react in situ to generate Hf particles with nano cubic structures uniformly distributed in Mo grains, and most of the particles are uniformly distributed in the Mo grains, so that the problems that the conventional dispersion strengthening Mo alloy particles are easy to agglomerate in the grain boundary, the performance is reduced even become a crack source in the subsequent service process and the like are solved, and the toughness and strength of Mo are greatly improved.

title_en: Fe doped ZnIn2S4Photocatalyst, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of photocatalysis nano semiconductor material synthesis, and discloses a Fe doped ZnIn  2 S 4  photocatalyst, a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps of mixing a zinc source, an indium source, a sulfur source and a ferrous source with water, and performing hydrothermal reaction to obtain the Fe doped ZnIn  2 S 4  photocatalyst. Fe belongs to non-noble metal, the doping content of Fe is trace, and ZnIn  2 S 4  can be synthesized by a hydrothermal method under the condition of relatively mild and simple synthesis conditions. The non-noble metal doped ZnIn  2 S 4  prepared by the invention is used as a hydrogen-producing photocatalyst, a novel method is provided for solving the energy shortage and the environmental pollution, and other possibilities are provided for synthesizing the green, economical, efficient and universal photocatalyst.

title_en: Corrosion inhibitor based on N, S, P co-doped carbon quantum dots, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of corrosion inhibitors, in particular to a N, P, S co-doped carbon quantum dot-based corrosion inhibitor, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of taking hydrophilic ionic liquid as a solvent, mixing a nitrogen source, a sulfur source and a phosphorus source in the solvent, and obtaining N, S, P co-doped carbon quantum dot mixed suspension solution through pulse laser irradiation; and dialyzing and drying the N, S, P co-doped carbon quantum dot mixed suspension solution to obtain the N, S, P co-doped carbon quantum dot-based corrosion inhibitor. The corrosion inhibitor prepared by the invention contains hydrophilic groups and heteroatom groups, and the heteroatom groups are combined with the surface of carbon steel to form a protective layer in a corrosive medium, so that the aim of corrosion inhibition is fulfilled, the hydrophilic groups improve the hydrophilicity of the corrosion inhibitor, so that the corrosion inhibitor can be better dissolved in water.

title_en: Hollow structure TiO2Or TiO2Preparation method of ZnO heterojunction and application of ZnO heterojunction in ultraviolet detector
abstract_en: A preparation method of TiO  2  and TiO  2 /ZnO heterojunction based on a hollow structure and application thereof in an ultraviolet detector are provided, wherein the hollow structure TiO  2  is a TiO  2  hollow sphere, a TiO  2  hollow cube and a TiO  2  hollow dodecahedron, the hollow heterostructure consists of a hollow structure TiO  2  and a ZnO nano rod, the ZnO nano rod grows on the surface of the TiO  2  hollow structure, the whole body is in a hedgehog shape, the prepared hollow structure TiO  2  and TiO  2 /ZnO heterojunction are coated on a conductive surface of FTO conductive glass to prepare a working electrode, the working electrode is connected with a counter electrode through a heat sealing film, and electrolyte is injected into an inner cavity to obtain the ultraviolet detector with high detection performance, and the ultraviolet detector is suitable for the field of ultraviolet detection. The method has the advantages of simple operation, low cost and high universality, synthesizes TiO  2  and hedgehog-shaped TiO  2 /ZnO heterojunction with different hollow structures such as spheres, cubes and dodecahedrons, further prepares an ultraviolet detector with self-power supply characteristic, and expands the application of the TiO  2  nano material in the field of photoelectric detection.

title_en: Preparation method and application of novel bismuth nanocrystalline/nitrogen-rich graphite carbon electrocatalyst
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electrocatalysis, in particular to a preparation method and application of a novel bismuth nanocrystalline/nitrogen-rich graphite carbon electrocatalyst, comprising the following steps of S1, adding urea and ammonium chloride into water, stirring, freeze-drying and grinding to obtain a chelating ligand; S2, adding bismuth citrate into the chelating ligand to perform solid phase reaction to obtain a precursor, and S3, calcining the precursor under the protection of nitrogen to obtain the bismuth nanocrystalline/nitrogen-enriched graphite carbon electrocatalyst. Can solve the problems that reduction and reconstruction reactions are easy to occur in the electrocatalytic reduction process of catalytic CO  2 , and the recognition of active sites and the difficulty of performance regulation are increased.

title_en: In-situ preparation method of modified graphene quantum dot/ZnO gas-sensitive material
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of semiconductor gas-sensitive material preparation, and particularly relates to an in-situ preparation method of a modified graphene quantum dot/ZnO gas-sensitive material. The method comprises the steps of taking an Al  2 O 3  gas-sensitive ceramic tube pretreated by alkali liquor as a substrate, enabling ZnO crystal seeds to be loaded on the gas-sensitive ceramic tube, then taking the Al  2 O 3  gas-sensitive ceramic tube loaded with the ZnO crystal seeds as the substrate, carrying out hydrothermal reaction by taking zinc chloride, sodium carbonate and graphene quantum dots as main raw materials to obtain a graphene quantum dot/ZnO gas-sensitive material, and modifying the graphene quantum dot/ZnO gas-sensitive material by utilizing ammonia water through a solvothermal method. Compared with a pure ZnO gas sensor, the optimal working temperature of the modified graphene quantum dot/ZnO gas sensor is reduced by about 170 ℃, the sensitivity is obviously increased, the modified graphene quantum dot/ZnO gas sensor has excellent selectivity to ethanol in the atmosphere of ethanol, acetone, benzene, ammonia and methanol, and the response recovery time is also greatly shortened.

title_en: Four-layer core-shell structure up-conversion luminescent material mainly based on red light and capable of greatly improving red light emission and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a four-layer core-shell structure up-conversion luminescent material which mainly takes red light and greatly improves red light emission and a preparation method thereof, wherein the chemical formula of the material is NaEr  1‑x F 4 :xTm@NaYbF 4 @NaYF 4 @NaYF 4 , x=0-2%, the invention solves the fluorescence quenching problem caused by cross relaxation and surface quenching while increasing the absorption section of the up-conversion luminescent material, the material is prepared by a coprecipitation method, the particle size of the material is 20-25 nm, and main luminescence is positioned in a first biological imaging window (NIR-I), so that the material has wide application prospect in the fields of biological marking, imaging and the like.

title_en: Lithium ion battery negative electrode material, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a lithium ion battery anode material and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps of 1) mixing graphene powder with nano silicon dispersion liquid to obtain mixed liquid, 2) heating the mixed liquid to remove a solvent to obtain a nano silicon/graphene precursor compound, 3) mixing the nano silicon/graphene precursor compound with lithium salt to grind to obtain a mixture, 4) calcining the mixture to obtain a compound with the nano silicon surface coated with lithium silicate salt, and 5) mixing the compound with asphalt and then carbonizing and sintering to obtain the nano silicon/graphene silicon carbon composite anode material coated with lithium silicate. The silicon-carbon anode material with long cycle life and high rate performance is obtained by the application.

title_en: Amorphous ferric phosphate and preparation method thereof, and anhydrous ferric phosphate and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides amorphous ferric phosphate, wherein an X-ray diffraction spectrogram of the amorphous ferric phosphate is provided with a first diffraction peak theta 1 and a second diffraction peak theta 2 at 19-21 degrees and 28-30 degrees respectively, the ratio of the peak intensity I  1  of the first diffraction peak to the peak intensity I  2  of the second diffraction peak is 0.8-0.91, and the amorphous ferric phosphate is spherical or spheroid particles. The amorphous ferric phosphate has low ferric hydroxide content, uniform particle size distribution, small primary particle size and low agglomeration degree, and is favorable for preparing the ferric phosphate with high specific surface area, small primary particle size and low agglomeration subsequently. Also provided are methods of making the amorphous iron phosphate, and anhydrous iron phosphate made based on the amorphous iron phosphate.

title_en: Zirconium-titanium mixed coated perovskite quantum dot and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a perovskite quantum dot coated by zirconium-titanium mixture and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of adding a zirconium source, a titanium source and organic acid into an organic solvent in a normal temperature environment and fully mixing to obtain a first mixed solution; and in a normal temperature environment, adding perovskite quantum dots into the first mixed solution, reacting to obtain a first reaction solution, and separating from the first reaction solution to obtain the perovskite quantum dots coated by the zirconium-titanium mixture. According to the preparation method, the zirconium-titanium compound is used for double coating, and a coating layer is formed on the surface of the perovskite quantum dot, so that the ligand on the surface of the perovskite quantum dot is tightly combined, the effects of improving the luminous performance, stabilizing the crystal structure and improving the stability are achieved, and the preparation method for improving the polarity tolerance degree of the perovskite quantum dot in the adhesive film is provided.

title_en: Negative electrode material, preparation method thereof, negative electrode plate and battery
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to a negative electrode material and a preparation method thereof, a negative electrode plate and a battery, wherein the preparation method of the negative electrode material comprises the following steps of S1, uniformly mixing a single-layer MXene suspension and a resin prepolymer dispersion, adding perylene-2, 5,8, 11-tetracarboxylic acid, and uniformly stirring to obtain a precursor solution; and S2, carrying out hydrothermal reaction on the precursor solution to obtain a carbon precursor, and S3, carbonizing the carbon precursor in a protective gas atmosphere to obtain the anode material. So that the first effect, capacity performance and cycle performance of the anode material can be effectively improved.

title_en: Silicon-carbon negative electrode material, preparation method thereof and electrochemical device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of lithium ion battery cathode materials, in particular to a silicon-carbon cathode material, a preparation method thereof and an electrochemical device. The silicon-carbon negative electrode material comprises nano silicon slurry and organic carbon, wherein the mass ratio of the silicon slurry to the organic carbon is 1:0.1-1:2, the nano silicon slurry is prepared by wet grinding and comprises micron silicon powder, dispersion liquid, dispersing agent, antioxidant and ammonia-containing conditioning agent, and the mass ratio of the micron silicon powder to the dispersing liquid is 1-4:10-20:0-1:0-1. According to the nano silicon grinding formula and the preparation method of the silicon-carbon negative electrode material, disclosed by the invention, the ammonia-containing conditioning agent is added in the physical grinding process, so that the dispersibility of nano silicon in slurry is improved, the grinding efficiency is improved, the particle size of the nano silicon is reduced, the grinding energy consumption is remarkably reduced, the production cost is reduced, and the commercialization is promoted.

title_en: Sandglass type steam micro-thruster nozzle
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of micro-nano electronic devices, and particularly relates to an hourglass type steam micro-thruster nozzle. The device comprises an inlet chamber, an outlet chamber and a communication hole communicated with the inlet chamber and the outlet chamber, wherein the inlet chamber and the outlet chamber are of horn-shaped structures, the diameter of the inlet chamber is gradually reduced from the inlet to the communication hole, the wall of the inlet chamber is sequentially formed by a heating layer, an insulating silicon oxide layer and a silicon substrate layer from inside to outside, the diameter of the outlet chamber is gradually increased from the communication hole to the outlet, and the wall of the outlet chamber is sequentially formed by the insulating silicon oxide layer and the silicon substrate layer from inside to outside. The micro-nano metal film is adopted as a heating layer on the chamber wall of the inlet chamber, and the micro-nano metal film acts together with the inlet chamber with the diameter gradually reduced from the inlet to the communication hole, so that the vacuum boiling of deionized water is controlled to realize the micro-Newton-level thrust generation. The invention has the characteristics of high integration level, low power consumption and micro impulse, and the thrust generated by the invention is in the micro Newton level.

title_en: Zn/Fe co-doped SnO2Ultra-thin hollow-edge nano-cage super-structure composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Zn/Fe co-doped SnO  2  ultrathin hollow-edge nano cage super-structure composite material, a preparation method and application thereof; the preparation method comprises the steps of preparing a zinc-iron Prussian blue nano cubic precursor, dispersing the zinc-iron Prussian blue nano cubic precursor in deionized water, standing and precipitating to obtain a zinc-iron Prussian blue nano cage, dispersing the zinc-iron Prussian blue nano cubic precursor in the deionized water to form a suspension A, dissolving stannous salt in concentrated hydrochloric acid to form a solution B, pouring the solution B into the solution A under stirring, standing and reacting for 3-24 hours at 30-180 ℃ after stirring uniformly to obtain a tin-coated zinc-iron Prussian blue nano cage ultrathin hollow edge nano cage material, and annealing the tin-coated zinc-iron Prussian blue nano cage ultrathin hollow edge nano cage material at 280-550 ℃ for 1-5 hours.

title_en: Positive electrode lithium supplementing agent, preparation method thereof, positive electrode plate and lithium ion battery
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of lithium ion batteries, in particular to a positive electrode lithium supplementing agent and a preparation method thereof, a positive electrode plate and a lithium ion battery, wherein the preparation method of the positive electrode lithium supplementing agent comprises the following steps of S1, mixing g-C  3 N 4  nano-sheets, lithium salt and NH  4 HCO 3  in a solvent, and then carrying out solid-liquid separation to obtain a g-C  3 N 4  -LiOH precursor; S2, calcining the g-C  3 N 4  -LiOH precursor to obtain the positive electrode lithium supplementing agent. The positive electrode lithium supplementing agent provided by the invention can improve the first coulombic efficiency and the cycling stability of the lithium ion battery.

title_en: Manual bonding platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a manual bonding platform, and relates to the technical field of MEMS chip manufacturing. The device comprises a Z-direction electric lifting table, a Y-direction electric linear displacement sliding table, an X-direction electric linear displacement sliding table, a voltage source, a displacement table driver, a chip holder, a grid baffle plate, a supporting rod, a heat insulation plate and a heat source, wherein the Y-direction electric linear displacement sliding table is arranged on the Z-direction electric lifting table, the X-direction electric linear displacement sliding table is arranged on the Y-direction electric linear displacement sliding table, the heat insulation plate is arranged on the X-direction electric linear displacement sliding table, the heat source is arranged on the heat insulation plate, the lower chip is arranged on the heat source, the supporting rod is fixedly arranged on the table top, the grid baffle plate is fixedly connected with the chip holder and the supporting rod, the three-direction movable sliding tables are electrically connected with the displacement table driver, and the heat source is electrically connected with the voltage source. The invention realizes the small-area bonding of the chip and provides a new solution for the field of MEMS chip manufacturing, in particular to the chip bonding direction.

title_en: Injectable sustained release preparation and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological medicines and discloses an injectable sustained-release preparation and a preparation method thereof, wherein the injectable sustained-release preparation comprises an active medicine and amphiphilic phospholipid, the preparation method of the injectable sustained-release preparation comprises the steps of preparing active medicine colloid particles by a nanoparticle preparation method, dispersing the active medicine colloid particles in an organic solvent dissolved with the amphiphilic phospholipid, uniformly mixing, wherein the mass ratio of the active medicine to the amphiphilic phospholipid is 10:0.05-10:25, removing the organic solvent, dispersing in injection oil, and obtaining the injectable sustained-release preparation, the particle size of the injectable sustained-release preparation provided by the invention is 20-500 nm, the in-vitro release period is from one day to one month, the in-vitro release has no obvious burst release phenomenon, adverse reaction caused by overhigh blood concentration can be reduced, toxic and side effects are reduced, and the treatment effect is improved.

title_en: Carbon microsphere, preparation method thereof, positive electrode plate, secondary battery and power utilization device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a carbon microsphere, a preparation method thereof, a positive electrode plate, a secondary battery and an electric device, wherein the carbon microsphere is composed of sheet-shaped carbon nano sheets, each carbon nano sheet is composed of carbon nano cages, each carbon nano cage has a porous three-dimensional structure, and the specific surface area of the carbon microsphere is more than or equal to 1500m  2 /g. In addition, the carbon nano cage structure inside the carbon microsphere can be filled with electrolyte, more ion transmission channels can be provided in the circulation process, the cycle life of the battery is greatly prolonged, and the liquid retention capacity of the pole piece can be improved.

title_en: High-performance resistance type deep low-temperature sensor and manufacturing process thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-performance resistance type deep low temperature sensor and a manufacturing process thereof, and belongs to the technical field of deep low temperature sensors. The high-performance resistance type deep low-temperature sensor is of a laminated structure and comprises a device substrate, a sensitive layer film deposited on the device substrate, an electrode layer film deposited on the sensitive layer film, and an interdigital pattern formed by etching the electrode layer film, wherein the sensitive layer film is single nitride of transition metal hafnium or zirconium, the electrode layer film is also single nitride of transition metal hafnium or zirconium, and the two layers of films are made of the same material, but have different element contents and different phase systems. The invention can reduce the cracking and falling of the sensitive layer film and the electrode layer film, improve the service life and the reliability of the device and obviously improve the application stability of the device on the premise of ensuring that the temperature sensor has high sensitivity and precision, and can be widely popularized in the technical field of low-temperature sensors.

title_en: Synthesis method of carbon substrate-shaped magnetic nanoparticle aggregate
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of nano materials, and particularly discloses a method for synthesizing a carbon substrate-shaped magnetic nanoparticle aggregate. The method comprises the steps of preparing graphene by chemical vapor deposition and transferring the graphene to a target substrate, synthesizing an oleic acid iron precursor, preparing magnetic iron oxide nanoparticles with different morphologies, carrying out surface modification on the magnetic iron oxide nanoparticles by using sodium citrate, mixing the modified magnetic iron oxide nanoparticles with the graphene, and regulating the mixing time and the particle size to obtain the two-dimensional flexible magnetic aggregate. The technical problems of poor dispersibility, unstable magnetic strength and sensitivity to environmental factors existing in the existing synthesis method are solved.

title_en: High-heat-conductivity nano coating, preparation method, secondary battery and electricity utilization device
abstract_en: The application provides a high-heat-conductivity nano coating, a preparation method, a secondary battery and an electric device, wherein the high-heat-conductivity nano coating comprises, by mass, 5% -20% of few-layer graphene powder, 15% -30% of polycrystalline diamond powder, more than 2% of a bonding dispersing agent and the balance of a solvent based on the high-heat-conductivity nano coating. The thermal conductivity of the high-thermal-conductivity nano coating after film formation is 1200-2500W/(m.times.K). The application also provides a preparation method of the high-heat-conductivity nano coating, which has the characteristics of simple process and convenient processing. The application also provides a secondary battery and an electricity utilization device, the structure is simple, the heat conduction layer is formed by using the high heat conduction nano coating, the problem that the heat generated by the center of the battery core is fast and difficult to disperse in time is solved, the heat dissipation of the battery core is more uniform, and the cost of the secondary battery is saved.

title_en: PEGylated liposome carrying dimethyl curcumin and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biological medicines, in particular to a dimethyl curcumin-loaded polyethylene glycol liposome and a preparation method thereof. Firstly, reacting cholesterol with succinic anhydride to obtain succinic acid mono-cholesterol ester, and then coupling the succinic acid mono-cholesterol ester with polyethylene glycol through ester bonds to synthesize polyethylene glycol-cholesterol. Polyethylene glycol-cholesterol, polyethylene glycol monostearate and lecithin are used as main components, dimethyl curcumin is used as a model medicament, and a film hydration method is used for preparing the polyethylene glycol dimethyl curcumin liposome. The liposome has high encapsulation efficiency. The external simulation drug release experiment shows that the lipid can improve the slow release effect of the dimethyl curcumin. Cytotoxicity experiments also show that the PEGylated dimethyl curcumin liposome has better anti-tumor activity.

title_en: Micro-nano composite structure for enhancing boiling heat exchange of low-temperature fluid, processing method and application
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of micro-nano manufacturing and heat transfer application, and relates to a micro-nano composite structure for enhancing boiling heat exchange of low-temperature fluid, a processing method and application, wherein the micro-nano composite structure is manufactured by adopting a solid sheet material as a substrate and processing the solid sheet material on the surface of the substrate by femtosecond laser; the micro-nano composite structure is a lattice structure with similar longitudinal and transverse spacing formed on the surface of a substrate, the lattice structure forms a peak-valley structure from the outside to the inside along the surface of the substrate, the valley of the peak-valley structure is nearly circular, the diameter of ablation points of the valley is similar to the distance between adjacent points, nano-particle oxide powder formed in the process of laser ablation of the substrate is attached to the peak-valley structure, the principle of the method is simple and easy to realize, the preparation and use flow is simple, the structure has excellent temperature adaptability, and the method can be used for enhancing boiling heat exchange of extremely low-temperature fluids such as liquid nitrogen.

title_en: Perovskite quantum dot/PVDF (polyvinylidene fluoride) luminescent film and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a perovskite quantum dot/PVDF luminescent film, and a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the field of optoelectronic materials. The preparation method of the perovskite quantum dot/PVDF luminescent film comprises the steps of carrying out soaking treatment on the perovskite quantum dot/PVDF composite film, wherein the soaking treatment is carried out by soaking the perovskite quantum dot/PVDF composite film in an alkali solution with the pH value being more than 7. According to the invention, PVDF is subjected to HF removal reaction through soaking treatment of alkali solution to form a conjugated double bond structure, and F ions are utilized to passivate surface defects of perovskite quantum dots in situ, so that the luminous efficiency and long-term stability of the film are remarkably improved.

title_en: Hard carbon anode material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hard carbon anode material, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the particle size of the hard carbon anode material is 100-300 nm, the specific surface area is 80-100 m  2 /g, the hard carbon anode material is provided with a hierarchical porous structure, the pore diameter of the hierarchical porous structure is micropores and mesopores of 1.85-30 nm, the average closed pore diameter is 1.75-2.0 nm, the hard carbon anode material is provided with a short-range pseudo-graphite structure, the average transverse size is 3.38-3.50 nm, and the average longitudinal size is 0.82-0.84 nm. According to the invention, proper sodium salt and/or lithium salt and phenolic resin are selected to carry out dehydration condensation reaction and carbonization to obtain the hard carbon anode material, and the obtained hard carbon anode material simultaneously shows excellent initial effect, reversible capacity, rate capability and cycle stability.

title_en: Method for simultaneously detecting and adsorbing iron ions based on chitosan modified fluorescent carbon quantum dots
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for simultaneously detecting and adsorbing iron ions based on chitosan modified fluorescent carbon quantum dots, and belongs to the technical field of food safety detection. The preparation method of the chitosan modified carbon quantum dot comprises the steps of reacting a nitrogen source, a carbon source, chitosan and a solvent to obtain the chitosan modified carbon quantum dot. The method of the invention can not only rapidly, sensitively, accurately, stably and selectively detect the content of the iron ions with high selectivity, but also adsorb the iron ions.

title_en: Fluorapatite material with up-conversion fluorescence and photo-thermal conversion and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of luminescent materials and biomedical materials, and provides a fluorapatite material with up-conversion fluorescence and photothermal conversion and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the steps of (1) dissolving a Ca  2+  source, an Ln  1   3+  source and an Ln  2   3+  source in deionized water to obtain a solution A, dissolving a PO  4   3‑  source, an F  ‑  source and an MoO  4   2‑  source in the deionized water to obtain a solution B, (2) dropwise adding the solution B into the solution A, stirring for 1-2 h after the dropwise adding is completed to obtain a reaction precursor solution, (3) carrying out hydrothermal reaction on the reaction precursor solution, (4) carrying out thermal activation treatment on the obtained hydrothermal product, and (5) dispersing the obtained activated powder in an aqueous solution of Fe  3+ , and carrying out hydrothermal reaction, washing and drying to obtain the product. The invention can endow the up-conversion fluorescent material with good photo-thermal conversion performance on the basis of no need of a compound photo-thermal conversion agent, and simplifies the preparation method of the material with both up-conversion fluorescence and photo-thermal conversion performance.

title_en: EU-1 molecular sieve with high specific surface area and synthesis method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an EU-1 molecular sieve and a synthesis method thereof, which belong to the field of EU-1 molecular sieves, wherein the EU-1 molecular sieve has a specific surface area S  BET ≥400m 2 /g and a micropore specific surface area S  micro ≥300m 2 /g, the synthesis method of the EU-1 molecular sieve comprises the steps of mixing, ageing and sectionally crystallizing a silicon source, an aluminum source, an alkali source, a template agent and a solvent I to obtain the EU-1 molecular sieve, the silicon source is the silicon source containing structural units, the synthesis method of the EU-1 molecular sieve can modulate nucleation microcrystals induced by the EU-1 molecular sieve in a very wide range through controlling crystallization time and temperature, so that an EU-1 molecular sieve product with high specific surface area and high crystallinity is obtained, and EU-1 molecular sieve grains can be rapidly prepared by adopting the silicon source containing the structural units as the silicon source and regulating cations of a crystallization system.

title_en: Preparation method and application of fluorescence enhanced probe for rapidly detecting moxifloxacin and norfloxacin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a fluorescence enhanced probe for rapidly detecting moxifloxacin and norfloxacin, and belongs to the technical field of rapid detection of antibiotics. The fluorescence enhancement type probe is prepared from p-aminosalicylic acid and L-cysteine serving as raw materials by a hydrothermal method, wherein the optimal preparation process is that the aminosalicylic acid and the L-cysteine with the mass ratio of 4:1 are dissolved in absolute ethyl alcohol, and heated and reacted for 14 hours at 200 ℃. The moxifloxacin and the norfloxacin can obviously enhance the fluorescence intensity of the fluorescent probe at 520 nm and 460 nm respectively and have good linear relation with the concentration. The invention has the advantages of simple operation, low cost, rapid detection, high sensitivity, high selectivity, wide detection range, low detection limit and the like, and can realize the on-site rapid detection of moxifloxacin and norfloxacin in water and milk.

title_en: High-efficiency high-yield white light carbon point fluorescent powder, synthesis method and application
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of fluorescent materials, and particularly relates to high-efficiency high-yield white light carbon dot fluorescent powder, a synthesis method and application thereof. The synthesis method comprises the steps of dissolving melamine in DMF, fully dissolving by ultrasonic dispersion, transferring to a high-temperature reaction kettle for reaction, cooling to room temperature after the reaction is finished, filtering the mixed solution after the reaction, drying the solid product obtained by filtering, and cooling to room temperature to obtain the white light carbon point fluorescent powder. The white light carbon point fluorescent powder is synthesized through a melamine solvothermal method, and the obtained solid white light carbon point has good light stability and heat stability and long storage time. The yield of carbon dots reaches 75 percent, the quantum yield (37 percent), and the synthesis method is simple and easy for industrial production. Meanwhile, the fluorescent light has a wider fluorescence emission range, is applied to the field of lighting devices such as white light LEDs and the like, and has a higher color rendering index.

title_en: Positive electrode active material, preparation method thereof, positive electrode plate, battery and electric equipment
abstract_en: The application provides an anode active material, a preparation method thereof, an anode plate, a battery and electric equipment, wherein the anode active material comprises a matrix and a coating material, the coating material comprises a compound shown in a formula II, la  α Zr β M γ M' δ O ε  is shown in the formula II, M comprises at least one element in Li, na, ca, mg, ba, sr, M' comprises at least one element in Al, ti, sn, nb, ta, W, mo, 0< alpha is less than or equal to 3,0< beta is less than or equal to 2, 0< gamma is less than or equal to 0.5, 0< delta is less than or equal to 0.5,5 is less than or equal to 10, and the half-peak width of a diffraction peak (222) in an X-ray diffraction pattern of the coating material is FWHM  (222)  and meets the conditions that FWHM  (222)  is less than or equal to 0.3 and less than or equal to 0.53. Therefore, the thermal conductivity of the coating material is lower, physical isolation can be formed on the surface of the multi-element material, active oxygen separated from the high-delithiation state matrix material can be effectively adsorbed, side reaction between the matrix and electrolyte is reduced, the heat release peak value of the positive electrode active material is reduced, the heat stability and the cycle stability of the battery are further improved, and the safety performance of the battery is improved.

title_en: Composite phosphate positive electrode precursor and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of batteries, and particularly relates to a composite phosphate positive electrode precursor, and a preparation method and application thereof. The composite phosphate positive electrode precursor comprises at least two mutually mixed precursor sources, wherein each precursor source respectively and independently comprises main elements Li and P and Fe and/or Mn, and each precursor source comprises at least one of 1) different main element types, 2) different main element contents, 3) different doping element types and 4) different doping element contents. The application can effectively increase the compaction density of the composite phosphate positive electrode material and improve the electrochemical performance of the composite phosphate positive electrode material.

title_en: Zeolite imidazole ester skeleton fluorescent material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a zeolite imidazole ester skeleton fluorescent material, a preparation method and application thereof, which belong to the technical field of detection material preparation and environment, wherein quantum dots, a molecular imprinting technology and MOFs materials are combined, mg and N co-doped graphene quantum dots are compounded with ZIF-8 at first, imprinting is carried out on the surface of the ZIF-8 to obtain the zeolite imidazole ester skeleton fluorescent material based on MOFs, in the zeolite imidazole ester skeleton fluorescent material, the Mg and N co-doped graphene quantum dots have good fluorescence performance and can generate electron transfer with SDZ to form hydrogen-like bond acting force, imprinting holes similar to the size and shape of a target object are reserved on the surface of the imprinted material, the target object to be detected can be selectively identified, and the zeolite imidazole ester skeleton fluorescent material can be used for detecting sulfadiazine in the environment and has good practicability.

title_en: Semiconductor structure and forming method thereof
abstract_en: Semiconductor structures and methods of forming the same are provided. The semiconductor structure includes a plurality of first nanostructures positioned over the substrate and a plurality of second nanostructures adjacent to the first nanostructures. The semiconductor structure includes a protective layer over the first nanostructure and a first gate structure formed over the first nanostructure. The semiconductor structure includes a second gate structure formed over the second nanostructure. The semiconductor structure includes a first dielectric wall between the first gate structure and the second gate structure, and a top surface of the first dielectric wall is higher than a top surface of the protective layer.

title_en: Rare earth up-conversion nano-particle and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rare earth up-conversion nanoparticle and a preparation method thereof, wherein the rare earth up-conversion nanoparticle has a three-layer core-shell structure and sequentially comprises an inner core, an active shell and an inert shell from inside to outside, wherein the inner core is NaGdF  4  doped with Yb  3+  and Er  3+ , the active shell is NaYbF  4 , and the inert shell is NaLuF  4 . According to the invention, naGdF  4  is adopted as a matrix material, the lattice structure is optimized through the introduction of Gd  3+ , yb  3+  is adopted as a sensitized ion, er  3+  is adopted as an activated ion, the ultra-small luminescence up-conversion nano-particles of subten nanometers are synthesized as an inner core, an active shell layer is coated outside the inner core to improve the luminescence efficiency, and an inert shell layer is coated outside the active shell layer to reduce the energy loss, so that the ultra-small ultra-bright rare earth up-conversion nano-particles are obtained. Compared with the up-conversion nano-particles without the coated active shell layer and the inert shell layer in the prior art, the rare earth up-conversion nano-particles prepared by the invention can realize the luminescence enhancement of more than 2 orders of magnitude and have remarkable advantages.

title_en: Fluorescent composite nanomaterial for detecting triclosan and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fluorescent composite nano material for detecting triclosan, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of triclosan detection. The preparation method provided by the invention comprises the steps of uniformly mixing the Zn  2 GeO 4  nano particles modified with amino and doped with Mn  2+ , the CuInSe  2  quantum dots modified with carboxyl and doped with Zn, triclosan, citric acid, sodium salicylate, hexamethylenetetramine and yttrium chloride in a solvent, stirring for reaction, centrifuging the reacted solution, taking the precipitate, adding the mixed solution of methanol and acetic acid, stirring for a set time, centrifuging, and washing. The fluorescent composite luminescent nanomaterial prepared by the invention can realize the specific detection of triclosan, has high measurement stability, wide measurement range and short response time, can realize the on-site detection, is convenient and quick, and has low detection cost.

title_en: Method for preparing alloy material with high entropy effect by in-situ reduction of visible light in aqueous solution
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for preparing an alloy material with high entropy effect by in-situ reduction of visible light in aqueous solution, which comprises the steps of using an LED lamp simulating a visible light section in sunlight as an energy source, reducing a plurality of (such as more than three) metal salt precursors at normal temperature and pressure in the aqueous solution comprising organic dye fluorescein serving as a photosensitizer and triethanolamine serving as an electron sacrificial agent, and preparing the alloy material with high entropy effect. The method overcomes the defects of complex preparation process, high pollution, high energy consumption and the like of the traditional alloy material, and has the advantages of simple process, low energy consumption, low raw material cost and the like. The alloy material with the high entropy effect has wide application, can realize electrocatalytic nitrate reduction to synthesize ammonia, has obvious catalytic effect and excellent circulating catalytic stability, and provides application prospect for electrocatalytic nitrate reduction to synthesize ammonia.

title_en: Carbon-coated cobalt-based catalyst, preparation method thereof and application thereof in electrolyzed water
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carbon-coated cobalt-based catalyst, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in electrolysis of water. The preparation method of the carbon-coated cobalt-based catalyst comprises the following steps of S1 immersing foam nickel in a solution composed of a molybdenum source, a cobalt source, urea, a fluorine source and water, heating for hydrothermal reaction to obtain a foam nickel-supported Mo-Co LDH precursor, S2 annealing the product obtained in the step S1 under the protection of inert gas to obtain a foam nickel-supported Mo-Co LDH nanowire array, S3 adding the product obtained in the step S2 into a 2-methylimidazole solution for soaking treatment to load a metal organic frame material ZIF-67 on the foam nickel-supported Mo-Co LDH nanowire array, S4 pyrolyzing the product obtained in the step S3 and the phosphorus source together under the protection of inert gas to form the foam nickel-supported carbon-coated molybdenum-doped cobalt phosphide. The catalyst has excellent hydrogen evolution activity and stability, and the preparation method is environment-friendly, safe, low in energy consumption and suitable for large-scale preparation.

title_en: Curable resin composition
abstract_en: The present invention provides a curable resin composition containing quantum dots, wherein the curable resin composition is a mixture of a silsesquioxane polymer obtained by copolymerizing the quantum dots with silsesquioxane and a thermosetting resin. Thus, a curable resin composition containing highly reliable quantum dots can be provided in which the quantum dots are dispersed in a curable resin at a high concentration without aggregation.

title_en: Device and method for preparing nano powder by microwave plasma
abstract_en: The application relates to equipment and a method for preparing nano powder by microwave plasma. The plasma powder feeding device comprises a conductor tube and a gasification chamber, wherein the conductor tube comprises a quartz tube and a powder feeding tube arranged in the quartz tube, the quartz tube vertically penetrates through a plasma conveying pipeline, two ends of the quartz tube are both opened, a gas channel is formed at intervals between the powder feeding tube and the quartz tube, the powder feeding tube comprises a powder feeding layer, a liquid feeding layer and a liquid discharging layer which are sequentially arranged outwards from the center, the liquid feeding layer and the liquid discharging layer are communicated at the position close to the bottom of the powder feeding tube, the gasification chamber is arranged below the quartz tube, the lower end of the quartz tube and the lower end of the powder feeding tube are both positioned in the gasification chamber, the gasification chamber comprises a reaction chamber and a first liquid cooling layer which are sequentially arranged from inside to outside, and the reaction chamber comprises a first conical tube, a first round tube, a second conical tube and a second round tube which are sequentially connected from top to bottom. According to the application, the powder-making efficiency can be improved by designing the powder-feeding pipe with a three-layer structure, the gasification chamber with a first-expansion-then-aggregation structure and the quenching chamber with the delay layer, the second liquid cooling layer and the air cooling layer.

title_en: Heterostructure of diamond/hexagonal boron nitride film and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heterostructure of a diamond/hexagonal boron nitride film and a preparation method thereof, and discloses a method for growing the hexagonal boron nitride film by utilizing a magnetron sputtering method in a physical vapor deposition technology. According to the method, the hexagonal boron nitride film with high quality, stable performance and adjustable film thickness grows on the diamond substrate by accurately controlling parameters such as growth air pressure, sputtering power and the like, the thickness of the hexagonal boron nitride film is adjustable between 20nm and 600nm, the hexagonal boron nitride film shows an E  2g  Raman peak, and a covalent bond is formed between the hexagonal boron nitride film and the surface of the diamond substrate. The method has high growth speed and is controllable, the prepared film and the substrate are combined by covalent bonds, and a new strategy and thinking are provided for the synthesis and application of heterostructure materials.

title_en: Nanocomposite material, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of antibacterial materials, in particular to a nanocomposite and a preparation method and application thereof. The nano composite material comprises a nano-structure inorganic material and hydrophilic organic polymer molecules grafted on the surface of the nano-structure inorganic material, wherein the hydrophilic organic polymer molecules can induce capillary condensation phenomenon on the surface of the nano-structure inorganic material. The nanocomposite disclosed by the embodiment of the application realizes physical damage deformation to bacteria based on capillary condensation, so that the mechanical antibacterial process is accelerated, the capability of inactivating microorganisms in aerosol is enhanced, the drug resistance is not easy to generate, and the nanocomposite has the advantages of environmental friendliness, broad spectrum and high efficiency.

title_en: Hierarchical pore micro-nano structure lithium-rich manganese-based positive electrode material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a hierarchical pore micro-nano structured lithium-rich manganese-based positive electrode material and a preparation method thereof, wherein lithium nitrate, manganese nitrate, cobalt nitrate, nickel nitrate, organic fuel and an organic carbon source are dissolved in deionized water to obtain a uniform mixed solution, then the mixed solution is atomized to form carbon-containing mist drops, and nitrogen is used as protective gas and carrier gas to enable the carbon-containing mist drops to undergo self-propagating combustion reaction at a certain ignition temperature to obtain combustion product powder; the method comprises the steps of placing a combustion product in a crucible, calcining in an inert atmosphere to obtain calcined powder, placing the calcined powder in the crucible, calcining in an air atmosphere to remove carbon, and fully grinding the calcined product to obtain the lithium-rich manganese-based anode powder with the hierarchical pore micro-nano structure. The lithium-rich manganese-based positive electrode material with the microporous-mesoporous hierarchical pore micro-nano structure is obtained, and the cycling stability of the lithium-rich manganese-based positive electrode material can be effectively prolonged. The invention has simple process, low energy consumption, low price, high capacity preservation rate and better industrialized application prospect.

title_en: Electrocatalytic material based on solid waste of open pit coal mine and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of high-value utilization of solid wastes of an open pit coal mine, and discloses an electrocatalytic material based on the solid wastes of the open pit coal mine, and a preparation method and application thereof. The electrocatalytic material is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight through a hydrothermal reaction, wherein the raw materials comprise, by weight, 5-40 parts of modified solid waste powder slag of an opencast coal mine, 20-60 parts of tetrahydrated molybdenum amino acid, 10-25 parts of anhydrous glucose and 20-35 parts of water. The electrocatalytic material has stable performance and high-efficiency catalytic performance, and realizes the high-value utilization of solid wastes of the open pit coal mine.

title_en: Preparation method and application of preparing supported pyrroloquinoline quinone nano-microsphere by using solution containing PQQ
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for preparing a loaded pyrroloquinoline quinone nanoparticle by using a PQQ-containing aqueous solution and application thereof. The method comprises the steps of enriching a solution containing PQQ, preparing ultrasonic emulsion, preparing nano-microspheres and the like, so as to obtain the PQQ nano-microspheres. The PQQ nano microsphere has higher stability, slow release property and bioavailability, and can effectively solve the problems of low solubility and uneven distribution of the PQQ in water. The PQQ nano-microspheres are used as auxiliary materials to be added into the fertilizer, so that the volume weight of soil can be reduced, the void content of the soil can be increased, the soil property can be improved, the growth and development of crops can be promoted, and the yield of the crops can be improved. The PQQ nano microsphere disclosed by the invention can be suitable for different types of fertilizers and crops, has a wide application prospect, and provides powerful support for agricultural production.

title_en: Microsphere lens probe and two-dimensional material transfer and performance test method based on microsphere lens probe
abstract_en: A microsphere lens probe and a two-dimensional material transfer and performance test method based on the microsphere lens probe belong to the technical field of micro-nano operation and characterization. The invention aims at the problem that the existing two-dimensional material transfer mode can damage the material and the requirement of in-situ multi-parameter testing of the two-dimensional material. The two-dimensional material transfer method comprises the steps of fixing a two-dimensional material on a sample stage, enabling the sample stage to reach a preset temperature, operating the microsphere lens probe to approach the two-dimensional material, and utilizing the high-molecular soft substrate to realize Van der Waals force-assisted lossless pickup of the two-dimensional material to realize two-dimensional material transfer. The invention is used for the operation and test of two-dimensional materials.

title_en: Electroacoustic multifunctional module and electroacoustic communication system
abstract_en: An electroacoustic multifunctional module (100) is described, comprising a module body (1), which module body (1) has a first outer side (11) and a second outer side (12), on which first outer side (11) an electrical interface (13) is provided, and on which second outer side (12) an acoustic interface (14) is provided, wherein the multifunctional module (100) is constructed as a single unit which cannot be separated in normal operation and is designed such that it has a plurality of functionalities, which functionalities comprise at least data transmission and energy transmission and use on the transmitter side and on the receiver side, and one or more functionalities can be selected by means of an external connection of the electrical interface (13) which can be performed by a user. Furthermore, an electroacoustic communication system (1000) is described.

title_en: Preparation method and application method of water-induced room-temperature random-plasticity long afterglow material
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of preparation of phosphorescent nano materials, and discloses a preparation method and a use method of a water-induced room-temperature random-plasticity long afterglow material. Dissolving polyvinylpyrrolidone, boric acid and color-changing acid in water, stirring until the materials are completely dissolved, reacting in a microwave oven, and cooling to room temperature to obtain the long afterglow material. The material is softened by adding a proper amount of water, and has soft stretchability, and the shape of the material can be changed at random continuously at room temperature, and the material still has yellow-green afterglow visible for 3s when the water adding amount is 10 percent. After the dehydration again, the long afterglow for 15s can be restored again. After such 10 times of water-drying cycle operation, the afterglow time is not attenuated, and the afterglow strength is not attenuated. The afterglow lifetime is 1030.52ms and the phosphorescence quantum yield is 41.5%. The room temperature arbitrary plasticity fills the disadvantages of long afterglow, difficult processing and difficult shaping of the phosphorescent material in the later period, and greatly expands the application scene of the phosphorescent material in practical application.

title_en: Cascade resonator photon pair source
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a cascade resonator photon pair source. A photon source includes a bus waveguide, a photon source pump laser coupled to the bus waveguide, and a plurality of optical resonators coupled to the bus waveguide. Each of the plurality of optical resonators has a respective resonance linewidth and a respective resonance frequency, wherein a bandwidth of a resonance center frequency of the plurality of optical resonators is greater than a bandwidth of the photon source pump laser. The bus waveguide generates photons in response to receiving laser pulses from the pump laser.

title_en: Preparation equipment and method of nano titanium nitride powder
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of nano metal powder manufacturing, and discloses equipment and a method for preparing nano titanium nitride powder, the device comprises a reactor, a titanium evaporation component arranged in the reactor, a nitrogen gas inlet arranged at one end of the reactor, a powder discharge pipeline arranged at the other end of the reactor, a collector communicated with the powder discharge pipeline, and a powder collecting port arranged at the bottom of the collector. The titanium evaporation component changes a titanium source into titanium steam, and ionized nitrogen is directly contacted with the titanium steam at high temperature, so that nitriding reaction power is improved, and nanoscale titanium nitride powder is formed. The titanium nitride powder enters the collector along with nitrogen flow, the powder filter element in the collector realizes gas-solid separation, the nano-scale titanium nitride powder is produced stably and continuously, the particle size of the titanium nitride powder is small, the particle size distribution range is narrow, the product purity is high, the element conversion rate is high, and the process is simple.

title_en: Hollow core-shell MoS with electromagnetic wave absorption function2Nano flower of ZnS and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of hollow core-shell MoS  2  @ZnS nanoflower with an electromagnetic wave absorption function, which comprises the steps of dissolving a ZnO nanoflower template and TAA in H  2  O, carrying out hydrothermal reaction, centrifuging, washing and drying to obtain ZnO/ZnS nanoflower, mixing the ZnO/ZnS nanoflower with glacial acetic acid solution, stirring, centrifuging, washing and drying to obtain hollow ZnS nanoflower, mixing the hollow ZnS nanoflower, na  2 MoO 4 ·2H 2  O with TA, carrying out hydrothermal reaction, centrifuging, washing and drying to obtain hollow core-shell MoS  2  @ZnS nanoflower. The MoS2@ZnS nanoflower prepared by the method optimizes impedance matching through a multiple interface synergistic effect by combining ZnS and MoS2, and obviously improves the electromagnetic wave loss capacity of the composite material, so that the composite material has excellent performance in the field of broadband absorption.

title_en: Quantum dot and method for manufacturing same
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide a chalcopyrite quantum dot which does not contain Cd and has a narrow fluorescence half-width and a high fluorescence quantum yield. The quantum dot of the present invention is a quantum dot comprising an AgIn  x Ga 1‑x S y Se 1‑y  system or a ZnAgIn  x Ga 1‑x S y Se 1‑y  system (0≤x <1, 0≤y≤1), and is characterized by exhibiting fluorescence characteristics such that the half-width of fluorescence is 45nm or less and the fluorescence quantum yield is 35% or more in the green wavelength region to the red wavelength region.

title_en: B and N co-doped carbon nanotube supported copper-iron bimetallic oxide catalyst and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a B, N co-doped carbon nano tube loaded copper-iron bimetallic oxide catalyst and a preparation method and an application thereof, wherein the B, N co-doped carbon nano tube is prepared by a calcination method, metal ions are adsorbed on the surface of a carbon material by a soaking adsorption method, then placing the carbon material into a tube furnace, performing high-temperature pyrolysis in an argon atmosphere, and regulating the size density of metal active sites on the surface of the carbon material by regulating the concentration, proportion and temperature of metal ions to construct a bimetallic oxide cluster structure. The carbon nanotube material obtained by the invention not only maintains the complete structure of the carbon material, but also is provided with a large number of copper-iron bimetallic oxide clusters on the surface structure, and the prepared material can effectively promote electrocatalytic nitrate reduction to produce ammonia, can effectively increase the reduction performance of nitrate, obviously improves the yield, and can reach the ammonia production rate of 95.2 mgh  ‑1 mg cat   ‑1  and the Faraday efficiency of 91.3% under the potential of-0.8V  RHE .

title_en: Preparation method of microfluidic chip of multifunctional sensing system
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of microfluidic technology and sensors, and discloses a preparation method of a microfluidic chip of a multifunctional sensing system, which comprises the steps of carrying out laser cutting to obtain a circular PET film by using an ultraviolet laser marking machine and setting specific parameters, then pasting 3M glue, then carrying out laser cutting to prepare a microfluidic chip pressure relief valve layer, pasting a baffle plate cut by a PI film at a valve, then carrying out plasma cleaning, stripping the baffle plate after cleaning, pasting a 3M tape, cutting a channel main body, then scanning the prepared PI film by using the set laser parameters to obtain laser-induced graphene with high carbonization degree, finally carrying out personalized design and cutting on a laser-induced pattern by using C4D software of the ultraviolet laser cutting machine, selecting a proper pattern as a detection electrode of the microfluidic chip, finally carrying out PET packaging on the microfluidic chip pressure relief channel layer and the detection electrode prepared by the laser-induced graphene, and then carrying out overall packaging on each layer of the microfluidic chip to prepare the microfluidic chip.

title_en: Film, preparation method thereof, light-emitting device and display device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a film, a preparation method thereof, a light-emitting device and a display device. The preparation method of the film comprises the steps of providing a base film, wherein the base film comprises inorganic nano particles, and applying a treatment liquid to the base film to obtain the film, wherein the treatment liquid comprises acetic acid and a first solvent. The film prepared by the preparation method of the film contains less impurities, so that the transmission performance of the film can be improved, and the electrical performance of a light-emitting device containing the film can be improved.

title_en: Preparation method of nano WN powder material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a nano tungsten nitride powder material, and belongs to the technical field of preparation of transition metal nitride materials. The preparation method comprises the steps of taking tungsten powder as a tungsten source, taking sodium azide and melamine as nitrogen sources, grinding and mixing the tungsten powder and the sodium azide according to a mass ratio of 5:1, respectively tabletting the mixture and the melamine by a hydraulic press, wrapping two melamine sheets with a cylindrical sheet formed by pressing the mixture of the tungsten powder and the sodium azide into a cylindrical shape according to the size of a synthesis cavity, loading the cylindrical raw materials into a heating container, placing the heating container into the synthesis cavity, preserving heat and pressure for 10 minutes at the pressure of 3.0-5.0 GPa and the temperature of 1500-1800 ℃, cooling and releasing pressure, and finally placing a sample into dilute hydrochloric acid for cleaning to obtain the nano tungsten nitride powdery material. The invention has simple process flow, shortens the preparation period and sintering time, does not generate air pollution and resource waste, and the prepared nano powdery material has the characteristics of high purity, easy impurity removal and the like.

title_en: Cationic lipid compound, preparation method thereof, composition containing cationic lipid compound and application of cationic lipid compound
abstract_en: The invention provides a cationic lipid compound, a preparation method thereof, a composition containing the cationic lipid compound and application of the cationic lipid compound, and belongs to the technical field of biological medicines. The cationic lipid compound has a structure represented by formula (I):  One or more of R  1 、R 2 、R 3  are each independently selected from secondary or tertiary amines, the remainder each independently selected from C  3 ～C 30  straight or branched saturated or unsaturated hydrocarbyl; L  1 、L 2  are each independently selected from a single bond, or a C  1 ～C 20  saturated or unsaturated alkylene, the q methylene groups of L  1  and/or L  2  are each independently replaced by-O-, -C (O) -or-C (O) O-; the q methylene groups of L  1  and/or L  2  are each independently replaced by-O-, -C (O) -or-C (O) O-substitution.

title_en: Method for manufacturing through silicon via
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for manufacturing a through silicon via, which belongs to the technical field of semiconductor and MEMS manufacturing processes and comprises the steps of providing a silicon substrate, forming at least two stacked mask layers on a first surface of the silicon substrate, etching the mask layers to form openings, enabling each opening to at least penetrate through the mask layer where the opening is located, enabling the openings of different mask layers to have different CD values, enabling the openings of different mask layers to be at least partially communicated to expose the silicon substrate, etching the exposed portions of the silicon substrate through the openings by using a BOSCH process for one or more times to form at least two nested grooves, and thinning the second surface of the silicon substrate. The required grooves are defined through the patterns of different mask layers, grooves with different sizes are etched at the same time, and the grinding process is directly carried out on the second surface of the silicon substrate, so that deep silicon structures with different sizes from top to bottom can be produced on the same section through the single-side process of the silicon substrate.

title_en: Method for producing hydrogen by using platinum-based alloy catalyst
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of new energy sources for producing hydrogen by water electrolysis, and particularly relates to a method for producing hydrogen by using a platinum-based alloy catalyst; the method comprises the steps of uniformly mixing a platinum-based alloy catalyst and a solvent to form catalyst slurry, dripping the catalyst slurry on carbon paper to form a working electrode, taking silver chloride as a reference electrode and a carbon rod as a counter electrode, introducing a magnetic field, electrolyzing water in an acid condition electrolytic cell to release hydrogen, and continuing to electrolyze the water to release hydrogen after the magnetic field is closed. The method provided by the invention enables the platinum-based alloy catalyst to show better hydrogen evolution catalytic performance when the magnetic field test is conducted, and further improves the catalytic performance when the magnetic field test is turned off, and meanwhile, the catalytic performance is positively related to the strength of the magnetic field when the magnetic field test is conducted continuously increases. Therefore, the method has wide application prospect in the field of acidic hydrogen evolution by utilizing the ferromagnetism enhancement of the platinum-based alloy catalyst.

title_en: Soybean protein-thymol nano-composite and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of a soybean protein-thymol nano-composite in removing marine fouling algae. According to the invention, by utilizing the superior nano-conveying function of the soy isolate protein SPI, indissolvable thymol is loaded on soy isolate protein SPI particles through hydrophobic interaction to form a nano-composite, the water solubility of the thymol is greatly improved after the thymol is combined with the soy isolate protein SPI, and the thymol can be more fully and rapidly dispersed in water, so that the thymol fully contacts with target algae in the form of nano particles, thereby the growth and the spread of marine polluted algae can be rapidly and effectively controlled, and the algae removal effect is achieved.

title_en: Preparation method of nano tungsten-nickel-iron composite powder
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of nano tungsten-nickel-iron composite powder, which comprises the following steps of dissolving ammonium metatungstate, nickel chloride hexahydrate and ferric chloride hexahydrate in water and stirring to obtain a solution; spraying the solution into liquid nitrogen for prefreezing to obtain frozen particles, freeze-drying the frozen particles to obtain precursor composite powder, and sequentially roasting and reducing the precursor composite powder in a hydrogen atmosphere to obtain the nano tungsten-nickel-iron composite powder. According to the preparation method, the frozen particles containing tungsten, nickel and iron are obtained through pre-freezing, then solid ice of the frozen particles is sublimated into gas to be separated by adopting a freeze drying process, the nanoscale precursor composite powder is obtained, and the nanoscale tungsten-nickel-iron composite powder is prepared through roasting and reduction under the hydrogen atmosphere, so that the preparation method is suitable for the technical field of powder preparation engineering.

title_en: Binary contact curvature nano shield diaphragm and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a binary contact curvature nanometer shield diaphragm and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of alkali metal batteries, the invention dissolves polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and aluminum triflate in N, N-dimethylformamide to obtain precursor solution; and carrying out electrostatic spinning on the precursor solution through a side-by-side double needle head to obtain the binary contact curvature nano shield diaphragm.
