The novel structure forms a mechanically reinforced network that effectively redistributes local stresses and creates a strong physical barrier to prevent dendrite penetration, enhancing battery cycle life. The membrane can be applied to the field of alkali metal batteries and different electrolyte systems, has the advantages of simple and efficient preparation process, easy operation, low cost and the like, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: PH response mechanical property conversion nano gel and application thereof
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of functional nano materials, and in particular relates to a pH response mechanical property conversion nano gel and application thereof. The deformability of the nanogel is measured as the ratio S  D‑pH  of the diameter D  swollen  of the nanogel at a first temperature T1 below the critical phase transition temperature of the nanogel to the diameter D  deswollen  of the nanogel at a second temperature T2 above the critical phase transition temperature. The S  D‑pH1  of the nano gel is larger than the S  D‑pH2  of the nano gel at the pH of 1=4.5-6 and is larger than the S  D‑pH2  of the nano gel at the pH of 2=6.8-7.4, and the S  D‑pH1 /S D‑pH2  is more than or equal to 1.6. Compared with a control group, the nanogel has obvious mechanical property conversion effect of pH response and optimal active transcytosis efficiency, and has optimal deep penetration capacity of tumor parts and anti-tumor effect.

title_en: Positive electrode material, preparation method, pole piece and battery
abstract_en: The invention relates to a positive electrode material, a preparation method, a pole piece and a battery. The positive electrode material comprises a covered wire structure, wherein the covered wire structure comprises a core material and a shell layer which axially covers the core material, the core material comprises a sodium vanadium phosphate material, and the shell layer comprises a sodium ferric pyrophosphate phosphate material. The preparation method of the positive electrode material comprises the following steps of S1, carrying out coaxial electrostatic spinning on a sodium vanadium phosphate spinning solution and a sodium ferric phosphate spinning solution, wherein the sodium vanadium phosphate spinning solution is positioned at an inner layer, the sodium ferric phosphate spinning solution is positioned at an outer layer, and a precursor film is obtained, and S2, carrying out heat treatment on the precursor film under a protective atmosphere. According to the invention, the sodium ferric phosphate material is coated with the sodium vanadium phosphate material to prepare the one-dimensional nano-covered wire structure, and the one-dimensional nano-covered wire structure is used as a positive electrode material in a battery, so that the rate capability and the cycle performance of the battery are improved.

title_en: Nanocomposite, preparation method, use method and device thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a nanocomposite, a preparation method, a use method and a device thereof, and the nanocomposite is characterized by comprising first nano particles and second nano particles which are combined, wherein the first nano particles are transition metal nano particles, and the second nano particles are one or a combination of lithium nitride nano particles, lithium oxide nano particles, lithium phosphide nano particles, lithium selenide nano particles and lithium sulfide nano particles. The nanocomposite can be magnetically regulated and controlled under low voltage, and high-speed and high-density electron spin information storage is realized.

title_en: Composite coating for fruit corrosion prevention and fresh-keeping and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a composite coating for fruit corrosion and fresh-keeping and a preparation method and application thereof, belongs to the technical field of fruit corrosion and fresh-keeping, and particularly provides a composite coating for corrosion and fresh-keeping, which comprises lipopeptid, chitosan silver nanoparticles, polyvinyl alcohol and glycerol, wherein the lipopeptid is prepared by fermenting bacillus bailii CGMCC No.20398, and the prepared composite coating PVA/LP/Ag@CS has excellent physical properties and barrier properties and strong antibacterial and antioxidant capabilities.

title_en: Preparation method of two-dimensional alkyne-rich carbon/molybdenum sulfide heterostructure hydrogen production catalyst
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of nano material preparation, and provides a preparation method of a two-dimensional alkyne-rich carbon/molybdenum sulfide heterostructure hydrogen production catalyst, which comprises the following steps of adding molybdenum sulfide into a solution to prepare a suspension A; adding soluble monovalent copper salt into suspension A in inert atmosphere to obtain mixed solution B, adding alkynyl benzene into organic solvent to obtain mixed solution C, dropwise adding mixed solution C into mixed solution B under the condition of continuous stirring, reacting to obtain mixed solution D, centrifuging mixed solution D to obtain precursor E, washing precursor E, and vacuum drying to obtain the two-dimensional alkyne-rich carbon/molybdenum sulfide heterostructure hydrogen production catalyst. The preparation process of the invention does not need any additive, has high product purity, solves the problems existing in molybdenum sulfide by constructing a special two-dimensional heterostructure, and obviously improves the intrinsic activity and stability of the material. The preparation method has the advantages of easily available raw materials, simple and convenient process, low cost, environmental protection and suitability for industrial production.

title_en: Negative electrode material, preparation method thereof, secondary battery and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a negative electrode material and a preparation method thereof, a secondary battery and electronic equipment, wherein the negative electrode material comprises silicon-carbon particles, the oxygen content of the silicon-carbon particles is X%, X is more than or equal to 3 and less than or equal to 10, the silicon-carbon particles comprise an inner area and a surface area, the surface area refers to an area which is less than 20nm away from the surface of the silicon-carbon particles, the inner area refers to other areas except the surface area in the silicon-carbon particles, the oxygen content of the inner area is X1 percent, and X1 is more than or equal to 3 and less than or equal to 10. The negative electrode material provided by the application can improve the specific capacity and the first coulombic efficiency of the negative electrode material, and reduce the ITC cycle expansion of the secondary battery.

title_en: Pressure sensor module and method for manufacturing pressure sensor module
abstract_en: The invention provides a small-sized and high-precision pressure sensor module which can be arranged near a nozzle of a dispensing device and can measure tiny pressure changes of suction and ejection. The semiconductor device is characterized by comprising a flow path substrate having a flow path and a branch path branching from the flow path inside, a semiconductor chip having a piezoelectric resistor element and disposed so as to cover an opening of the branch path, and a lid body bonded to the semiconductor chip so as to cover the piezoelectric resistor element and having a cavity formed between the lid body and the semiconductor chip, wherein a vent path for communicating the cavity with the outside is formed in the lid body or a bonded portion between the lid body and the semiconductor chip, and the shape of the opening of the branch path is substantially similar to the shape of the cavity in a normal direction.

title_en: Polymer-based dispersing agent, and preparation process and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of dispersing agents, and discloses a polymer-based dispersing agent, a preparation process and application thereof; and then reducing nitro by sodium dithionite to obtain the polymer-based dispersing agent which contains polyethylene glycol molecular chains and has good complexing and stabilizing effects on silver ions, plays a role of dispersing agent, is beneficial to inhibiting agglomeration of nano silver and reduces particle size. The polymer-based dispersing agent contains hydroxyl-terminated reducing groups of polyethylene glycol, and meanwhile, a molecular chain side chain contains a large number of reducing anilino groups, so that the polymer-based dispersing agent plays a role of a reducing agent, can effectively reduce silver ions at a low temperature, and remarkably improves the yield of nano silver.

title_en: Polymer-based dispersing agent, and preparation process and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of dispersing agents, and discloses a polymer-based dispersing agent, a preparation process and application thereof; and then reducing nitro by sodium dithionite to obtain the polymer-based dispersing agent which contains polyethylene glycol molecular chains and has good complexing and stabilizing effects on silver ions, plays a role of dispersing agent, is beneficial to inhibiting agglomeration of nano silver and reduces particle size. The polymer-based dispersing agent contains hydroxyl-terminated reducing groups of polyethylene glycol, and meanwhile, a molecular chain side chain contains a large number of reducing anilino groups, so that the polymer-based dispersing agent plays a role of a reducing agent, can effectively reduce silver ions at a low temperature, and remarkably improves the yield of nano silver.

title_en: Specially vulcanized CoFe Prussian blue and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: Specially vulcanized CoFe Prussian blue and preparation and application thereof. The porous three-dimensional graded non-noble metal sulfide catalyst is prepared by taking cobalt iron Prussian blue analogues as templates through calcination treatment and vulcanization. The catalyst is in a cubic pore structure, has high porosity and good conductivity, and has excellent hydrogen evolution and oxygen evolution electrocatalytic activity in alkaline medium. The invention aims to provide a Prussian blue-like electrocatalyst subjected to special vulcanization, which is used as a working electrode for electrochemical test, and the result shows that the substance has good electrocatalytic activity, has OER overpotential as low as 237mV and HER overpotential as low as 156mV at 10mA cm  ‑2 , and also has good stability in alkaline solution.

title_en: Bismuth and bismuth sulfide nano-rod composite electrode material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a bismuth and bismuth sulfide nano-rod composite electrode material and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of (1) dissolving a bismuth source in an acid solution, then adding a sulfur source for reaction, filtering the reacted solution to obtain bismuth sulfide, (2) dissolving the bismuth sulfide and an intercalation agent in an organic solvent to obtain a mixed solution, then carrying out solvothermal reaction on the mixed solution, and controlling the mass ratio of the intercalation agent to the bismuth sulfide to be (10-50): 1, enabling the intercalation agent to be intercalated into the interlayer decomposition of the bismuth sulfide to generate metal bismuth, and filtering the reacted solution to obtain the nano-rod composite material of the bismuth and bismuth sulfide mixture. The nano-rod composite material of the bismuth and bismuth sulfide mixture is used as the negative electrode of the water-based sodium ion battery, so that the technical problems that the negative electrode material in the water-based sodium ion battery is limited in selection and low in actual discharge capacity can be solved.

title_en: Copper-based metal organic framework material derived copper-carbon composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The copper-based metal organic framework material-derived copper-carbon composite material is a hierarchical pore carbon carrier-loaded Cu and Cu  2  O nano particles which are derived from carbonization of the copper-based metal organic framework material, the copper-based metal organic framework material is of an octahedral cage structure, the specific surface area is 20-100 m  2 /g, the total pore volume is 0.3-0.6 cm  3 /g, the hierarchical pores comprise mesopores and micropores, wherein the micropores are 0-2 nm, the mesopores are 2-50nm, the mesopore volume accounts for 80-90% of the total pore volume, and the particle sizes of Cu and Cu  2  O nano particles are 5-10 nm. The three-dimensional through mesoporous structure of the copper-carbon composite material can effectively promote the diffusion of reactant molecules at the active site inside the material and accelerate the adsorption and activation of substrate molecules at the catalytic active site. Cu provides high conductivity to promote electron transfer, cu  2  O optimizes adsorption energy of furfural C=O bond through unoccupied d orbit, p-n junction formed at interface effectively regulates and controls charge distribution, and reduces hydrogenation energy barrier, so that cooperation of the two effectively improves activity of electrocatalytic furfuryl alcohol synthesized by furfural.

title_en: Layered structure sodium manganese phosphate positive electrode material of sodium ion battery and preparation process
abstract_en: The invention provides a layered structure sodium manganese phosphate positive electrode material of a sodium ion battery and a preparation process thereof, and relates to the technical field of preparation of positive electrode materials of sodium ion batteries, comprising the following steps of a) preparation of a precursor modified by a fluorine-containing silane coupling agent, b) gradient sintering and composite coating process, and c) graphene And d) a full-flow water control system. The invention has the beneficial effects that the contradiction between the high capacity and the high multiplying power performance of the traditional polyanion material is broken through by molecular scale hydrophobic modification, nanostructure regulation and control and process parameter optimization, and the invention provides a key material support for the application of the sodium ion battery in the fields of energy storage and power.

title_en: Silver-based quantum dot composite material based on nano-pore aluminum silicon glass and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a room-temperature gas-phase preparation method of nano-confined silver-based quantum dot glass, which adopts Al  2 O 3 -SiO 2  nano-pore glass to synthesize Ag  2  S and AgInS  2  quantum dots in a confined manner. The method comprises the steps of (1) mixing aluminum lactate, tetraethoxysilane and Ag  + /In 3+  precursor, preparing co-doped sol by a sol-gel method, (2) sintering at 600 ℃ after gradient drying to form nano-pore aluminum-silicon glass with the pore diameter of 2-5nm, and (3) introducing H  2  S gas at room temperature, and utilizing mesoporous confinement effect to grow quantum dots in situ. By introducing In  3+ , changing the aluminum-silicon ratio and the H  2  S reaction time, continuous adjustment of the Ag  2  S quantum dots In the 980-1070 nm near infrared and the AgInS  2  quantum dots In the 620-700 nm visible light wave band is respectively realized. The invention realizes the synthesis of the quantum dots under the room temperature condition, breaks through the limitation of the traditional high-temperature process, has the advantages of no heavy metal pollution (no Cd/Pb), simplified process and low cost, and provides a new way for the controllable low-temperature preparation of the silver-based quantum dot glass.

title_en: SU8 glue spreading equipment and glue spreading process
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of gluing, in particular to SU8 glue gluing equipment and a gluing process, which comprises a host, wherein a glue receiving pot is arranged on the host, a sheet support is connected in a rotating manner in the glue receiving pot, a sealing cover is arranged above the glue receiving pot, a glue adding tank is arranged at the center of the upper surface of the sealing cover, a flow hole is arranged at the center of the glue adding tank, a dropper opposite to the flow hole is arranged at the center of the lower surface of the sealing cover, and a plug for plugging the flow hole is vertically and slidably connected with the center of the glue adding tank. The wafer is placed on a wafer support, omnicoat is firstly dripped on the surface of the wafer, the wafer support rotates, and the Omnicoat is uniformly coated on the wafer. The operator adds SU8 glue to the glue tank. The plug moves up to open the orifice through which SU8 glue flows down into the drip tube. The SU8 glue is dripped on the wafer through a dropper, and the wafer is driven by a chip carrier to rotate so as to uniformly coat the SU8 glue on the Omnicoat layer. The Omnicoat layer enhances the bonding force between the SU8 glue and the bottom, and can be etched along with the SU8 glue, so that the bonding effect between the SU8 glue and the bottom is improved, and the falling of the SU8 glue is prevented.

title_en: Method and device for precisely controlling freezing printing temperature of three-dimensional graphene preform
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for precisely controlling the freezing and printing temperature of a three-dimensional graphene preform, belonging to the technical field of preparation of three-dimensional graphene preforms; the method comprises the steps of injecting a liquid medium into a liquid tank, carrying out hydrophilic treatment on the surface of a printing substrate, controlling the printing substrate to descend to an initial position in the liquid tank, enabling the bottom of the printing substrate to be immersed in the liquid medium, spraying graphene liquid drops layer by layer on the printing substrate through a printing nozzle, driving the printing substrate to descend after each layer of spraying is completed, enabling the solidified layer graphene to be partially immersed in the liquid medium until the temperature of the solidified layer graphene is consistent with a set temperature, and repeating the printing sinking step until the preset layer number of the three-dimensional graphene preform is completed. The invention has the core advantage of breaking through the problem of uncontrollable printing layer temperature caused by thermal resistance superposition in the traditional technology.

title_en: Ruthenium nano catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electrolytic catalysts, and particularly relates to a ruthenium nano-catalyst, a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the ruthenium nano catalyst comprises the following steps of (1) mixing a ruthenium chloride aqueous solution and a graphene oxide aqueous solution, uniformly stirring, and freeze-drying, and (2) placing the sample obtained in the step (1) between two pieces of carbon paper for Joule thermal flash annealing, wherein the black aerogel is the ruthenium nano catalyst. The invention provides a high-load superfine ruthenium nano catalyst, which comprises a reduced graphene oxide substrate and ruthenium nano particles which are loaded on the substrate and have the characteristics of high load and superfine. According to the invention, the reduced graphene oxide substrate is in a bulk shape, anchoring sites are provided for ruthenium nanoparticles, the nanoparticles are in a high density, are finely and uniformly dispersed on the substrate, and have a clear structure.

title_en: Multi-dimensional sensor and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a multi-dimensional sensor and a preparation method thereof, comprising the following steps of S100, providing a substrate; the method comprises the steps of S200, setting a first sensor on a substrate, S300, coating and forming a sacrificial layer on the substrate, S400, removing part of the sacrificial layer to form a plurality of isolation grooves, exposing part of the substrate by the isolation grooves, defining a first functional area and a second functional area, wherein the first sensor is positioned in the first functional area, S500, forming a functional layer on the substrate, wherein the part, positioned above the first functional area, of the functional layer is defined as an encapsulation layer, the part, positioned above the second functional area, of the functional layer is defined as a sensitive layer, S600, forming a release hole on the encapsulation layer and the sensitive layer, S700, removing the sacrificial layer covered by the encapsulation layer and the sensitive layer through the release hole to form an encapsulation cavity in the encapsulation layer and a movable cavity in the sensitive layer, S800, depositing an insulating material to form a second insulating layer, and forming a metal electrode on the sensitive layer.

title_en: Process and device for incinerating and disposing medium-temperature section flue gas oxynitride
abstract_en: The invention relates to a process and a device for incinerating and disposing medium-temperature section flue gas oxynitride, and belongs to the technical field of flue gas treatment. The invention adopts the carbon reduction technology to treat the oxynitride in the incineration flue gas, and overcomes the defects of low denitration efficiency, ammonia escape risk, high SCR equipment investment, high operation cost and the like of the existing SNCR technology. The modified carbon reducing agent provided by the invention has a plurality of advantages and remarkable progress in the process of incinerating and disposing medium-temperature flue gas oxynitride, and the advantages mainly comprise high-efficiency reducibility, high thermal stability, high safety, excellent poisoning resistance and good catalytic activity. The combined action of the advantages ensures that the modified carbon reducing agent can remove nitrogen oxides more efficiently in the flue gas denitration process, and simultaneously maintains longer service life and stable performance.

title_en: Nanometer flaky ZSM-5 molecular sieve and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a nano flaky ZSM-5 molecular sieve and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of molecular sieves. According to the invention, a microwave auxiliary heating mode is adopted, the consumption ratio of each raw material is controlled, ZSM-5 stock solution containing a large amount of high-order rudiments is prepared, the pH value is directly regulated to 4-7 without dialysis treatment, the high activity of the rudiments in the ZSM-5 stock solution and the auxiliary effect of a free template agent are achieved, and the ZSM-5 molecular sieve can be crystallized in pH=4-7 to prepare the nano flaky ZSM-5 molecular sieve. In addition, the preparation method provided by the invention has high economy of silicon atoms, and provides a feasible way for industrial production.

title_en: Manufacturing method of double-sided micro-nano structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a manufacturing method of a double-sided micro-nano structure, which can realize high absorptivity of a visible light wave band in a space environment based on the double-sided micro-nano structure, thereby enabling some structural components of a satellite and greatly improving the manufacturing efficiency of the ultra-black structural components of the satellite. The double-sided micro-nano structure is formed by combining three functional structure modules and comprises a nanoscale anti-reflection structure, a substrate and a microscale light trapping structure. The nano-scale anti-reflection structure is a dot matrix type nano cone structure, so that the interface reflectivity can be greatly reduced. The micron-scale light trapping structure is a lattice pyramid structure, and the absorption of light entering the double-sided micro-nano structure is increased through multiple reflections. The substrate provides an adhesion space for the nano anti-reflection structure and the micro light trapping structure, and provides mechanical strength for the whole double-sided micro-nano structure. The double-sided micro-nano structure is manufactured and molded integrally based on an imprinting process.

title_en: Ag (silver) alloy3PO4Preparation method of nanospheres and electrocatalytic CO2Reduction application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of silver phosphate (Ag  3 PO 4 ) nanospheres and application of the silver phosphate (Ag  3 PO 4 ) nanospheres in electrocatalytic carbon dioxide reduction reaction (ECO  2  RR). The catalyst is synthesized by adopting a simple complexation-precipitation method, has simple and convenient process and mild conditions, and is suitable for large-scale preparation. The Ag  3 PO 4  nanospheres obtained show excellent catalytic performance in the CO  2  electroreduction process, and the activity improvement is mainly attributed to the fact that silver phosphate promotes the generation of key intermediates COOH and COO-, and the adsorption capacity to the CO  2  -intermediates is remarkably enhanced, so that the reaction selectivity and catalytic efficiency are effectively improved. The method has remarkable advantages in improving the problem of poor reduction selectivity of the traditional Ag-based electrocatalyst CO  2 . Meanwhile, the technology is environment-friendly, the used raw materials are cheap and easy to obtain, the energy consumption in the synthesis process is low, and the technology has good practicability and wide application prospect.

title_en: Silicon carbon material, preparation method thereof, secondary battery and electronic device
abstract_en: The application provides a silicon-carbon material and a preparation method thereof, a secondary battery and an electronic device, wherein the silicon-carbon material comprises a carbon skeleton and silicon particles positioned in holes of the carbon skeleton, the silicon-carbon material comprises first silicon-carbon particles and second silicon-carbon particles, the silicon-carbon material with the particle size of R1 is the first silicon-carbon particles, R1 is more than or equal to 3 mu m and less than or equal to 6 mu m, the average elastic modulus of the first silicon-carbon particles is E1, E1 is more than or equal to 30GPa and less than or equal to 65GPa, the silicon-carbon material with the particle size of R2 is the second silicon-carbon particles, R2 is more than or equal to 6 mu m and less than or equal to 15 mu m, and the average elastic modulus of the second silicon-carbon particles is E2, E2 is more than or equal to 68GPa and less than or equal to 168GPa. The silicon-carbon material provided by the application can improve the cycle performance of the secondary battery and the expansion of the secondary battery.

title_en: Treatment method of thallium-containing flue gas
abstract_en: The invention provides a treatment method of thallium-containing flue gas, which comprises the steps of contacting thallium-containing flue gas with modified molybdenum disulfide, wherein the modified molybdenum disulfide adsorbs TlCl in the thallium-containing flue gas, the modified molybdenum disulfide is hydrothermal molybdenum disulfide and/or DMF intercalated molybdenum disulfide, and a plurality of lamellar cracks exist in a layered structure of hydrothermal MoS  2  and DMF-MoS  2 , so that the treatment method has a rich defect structure. The thallium adsorption effect in the thallium-containing flue gas is obviously optimized by utilizing the excellent reactivity and thermal stability of the modified molybdenum disulfide in the high-temperature sulfur-containing flue gas environment.

title_en: Nanometer calcium silicate hydrate modified waste graphite anode material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nano calcium silicate hydrate modified waste graphite anode material, a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the steps of mixing waste graphite powder, soluble calcium salt, soluble silicate and water for reaction, then drying to obtain nano calcium silicate hydrate modified waste graphite powder, and calcining the nano calcium silicate hydrate modified waste graphite powder to obtain the nano calcium silicate hydrate modified waste graphite anode material. According to the invention, the nano-scale hydrated calcium silicate gel is generated on the surface of the waste graphite in situ to carry out surface coating on the waste graphite, so that the surface defects of the waste graphite caused by various aging mechanisms in the long-time use process can be repaired, and the charge-discharge performance and the cycle performance of the waste graphite are obviously improved. The invention has simple process flow and mild reaction condition, does not need acid washing and alkali washing, and reduces the production cost.

title_en: Fault safety design method for MEMS safety device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault safety design method for an MEMS safety device, which is provided with a squat safety device serving as a first safety of the MEMS safety device, wherein a squat fault safety design lock hook is arranged at the side end, close to an explosion-proof slide block, of the squat safety device, can be matched with the explosion-proof slide block fault safety design lock hook arranged at the side end of the explosion-proof slide block, is used for limiting the freedom degree of movement of the explosion-proof slide block in the working direction and perpendicular to the working direction, and can move to an unlocking position to be locked with a substrate under the action of squat force. The invention realizes the strict time sequence control for releasing the isolation of the MEMS safety releasing device, and ensures the safety of the fuse MEMS and the safety of the isolation releasing device.

title_en: Polymer mediator catalyst, composite anode material and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high molecular medium catalyst, a composite anode material and application thereof, wherein the high molecular medium catalyst is prepared from an organic small molecular monomer with redox activity by a chemical or electrochemical polymerization method, and the composite anode material of a rechargeable metal-air battery or lithium-sulfur battery comprises the high molecular medium catalyst, a carbon material and a binder. The high molecular medium is prepared by polymerizing the organic micromolecule monomer by a chemical or electrochemical method, has multifunctional catalytic property, and forms a composite anode material with a synergistic effect by compositing the high molecular medium with a high-pore carbon material, thereby remarkably improving the charge and discharge efficiency, capacity and cycle stability of the battery.

title_en: Titanium dioxide/three-dimensional carbon composite material, preparation method thereof and sodium storage application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a titanium dioxide/three-dimensional carbon composite material, a preparation method thereof and sodium storage application, and belongs to the technical field of electrode materials. Preparing graphene oxide aqueous solution and water/ethanol mixed solution, adding tetrabutyl titanate into the water/ethanol mixed solution, stirring, hydrolyzing, performing hydrothermal reaction, preserving heat, cooling, centrifugally cleaning, and vacuum drying to obtain a titanium dioxide precursor, placing the precursor into the graphene oxide aqueous solution to prepare suspension, dipping melamine foam, freeze-drying, carbonizing in a nitrogen atmosphere of a tube furnace, preserving heat, soaking with deionized water, cleaning, and vacuum drying to obtain a target product. The preparation of the composite material is realized by limiting the parameters such as solution concentration, reaction temperature, reaction time, speed and the like, and the prepared composite material is used for preparing a sodium ion battery, so that the problem of insufficient chemical kinetics characteristics of the negative electrode material of the sodium ion battery of titanyl is solved, and the multiplying power performance and the cycle performance of an electrode plate (battery) are improved.

title_en: Attapulgite nano fluorescent probe for double-ion detection and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an attapulgite nano fluorescent probe for double-ion detection and a preparation method thereof, wherein a siloxane coupling agent is firstly used for introducing tertiary amine groups on the surface of attapulgite, then the modified attapulgite and 5-chloromethyl salicylaldehyde are subjected to quaternization reaction, pyridine formylhydrazine is grafted to obtain a salicylhydrazone functionalized attapulgite nano material through Schiff base condensation reaction, the salicylhydrazone groups on the surface of the material are taken as fluorescence response sites, a fluorescence enhancement effect is shown when the salicylhydrazone groups are combined with Al (III) in an aqueous medium, fluorescence quenching is realized when the salicylhydrazone groups are combined with Cu (II), and the fluorescence quenching has high selectivity on multiple coexisting ions, so that the probe material can be used for fluorescence detection of two metal ions of Al (III) and Cu (II) in water, and simultaneously, the target metal ions in the water can be synchronously removed through adsorption.

title_en: Two-dimensional material/silicon heterojunction photoelectric detector with semi-conformal structure and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-dimensional material/silicon heterojunction photoelectric detector with a semi-conformal structure and a preparation method thereof, the heterojunction photoelectric device comprises pyramid silicon, a silicon dioxide layer, a chromium/gold electrode, a single-layer two-dimensional material and an in-situ grown two-dimensional material. The preparation method comprises the specific steps of etching a silicon window on a silicon/silicon dioxide sheet by adopting photoetching and plasma etching technology, etching exposed silicon into pyramid-shaped silicon by utilizing an alkali etching method, depositing a top electrode on silicon dioxide around the pyramid silicon by adopting photoetching technology and thermal evaporation, transferring a single-layer two-dimensional material film onto a pyramid silicon structure by adopting wet transfer to form semi-conformal contact, and finally growing a large-area two-dimensional material on the single-layer two-dimensional material/silicon of the semi-conformal structure in situ. The invention has the advantages of high response rate, wide spectral response, ultra-large linear dynamic range and quick response capacity.

title_en: Light tungsten copper-infiltrated material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a light tungsten copper-infiltrated material and a preparation method thereof, wherein tungsten powder, molybdenum powder, titanium carbide powder and tungsten copper composite powder are mixed to obtain mixed powder, the mixed powder is pressed and molded to obtain a molded blank, the molded blank is sintered to obtain a ceramic reinforced tungsten skeleton, and the ceramic reinforced tungsten skeleton is subjected to copper infiltration treatment to obtain the tungsten copper-infiltrated material. In addition, in the process of sintering the ceramic reinforced tungsten framework, the superfine tungsten-copper composite powder is introduced, so that the sintering performance of the tungsten framework can be obviously improved, and the subsequent copper infiltration effect can be optimized, so that the tungsten infiltration material is uniform in composition organization, and the light ablation-resistant tungsten infiltration material is excellent in ablation resistance and greatly reduced in density compared with the existing tungsten infiltration material.

title_en: Micro-nano structure spray disk for semiconductor and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a micro-nano structure spray disk for a semiconductor and a manufacturing method thereof. The micro-nano structure spray disk for the semiconductor comprises a spray disk substrate, a roughening structure formed on the disk surface and a composite coating layer covered on the disk surface and the roughening structure. A plurality of spray holes are discretely distributed on the disk surface of the spray disk substrate. The coarsening structure comprises a plurality of diamond-shaped protrusions which are periodically distributed along the disk surface. The composite coating comprises an ultrathin aluminum oxide layer, an ultrathin aluminum-doped tin oxide layer, an ATO layer and a fluorine-doped tin oxide layer which are sequentially arranged along the direction far away from the disk surface, wherein the ultrathin aluminum-doped tin oxide layer is conformally deposited on the ultrathin aluminum oxide layer. The micro-nano structure spray disk for the semiconductor has the advantages of firm combination of the composite coating and the substrate, uniform heating and the like.

title_en: Hyaluronic acid microneedle loaded with gold nanorods and manganese dioxide nanoparticles, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a hyaluronic acid microneedle loaded with gold nanorods and manganese dioxide nanoparticles, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of medicine. The preparation method comprises the steps of preparing PEG-GNRs dispersion liquid, preparing BSA-MnO  2  NPs solution, and preparing the micropins from the PEG-GNRs dispersion liquid and the BSA-MnO  2  NPs solution. The application is that the microneedle is used for treating skin squamous carcinoma. The invention utilizes the synergistic enhancement of the radiotherapy effect by two nano materials and eliminates the negative influence of the tumor microenvironment on the treatment effect, combines the photo-thermal treatment of PEG-GNRs, thereby improving the treatment effect, integrates the two nano materials into the soluble micro-needle to construct a local minimally invasive drug delivery system, optimizes the treatment effect and reduces the toxic and side effects, and is expected to solve the limitation of the traditional treatment carrier on the drug delivery efficiency, thereby improving the effectiveness of local treatment.

title_en: Preparation method of high-entropy oxide aerogel nanowire
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of preparation technology of nano porous materials, and particularly relates to a preparation method of high-entropy oxide aerogel nanowires. The high-entropy oxide aerogel nanowire is generated in situ by utilizing the directional template, and the material is expected to meet the requirements of the fields of aerospace materials and the like at present. Meanwhile, the simple preparation method of the high-entropy oxide aerogel nanowire is beneficial to promoting the development of aerogel industrialization, and solves the problems of complex application process and the like of the existing high-entropy oxide aerogel nanowire.

title_en: Preparation method of core-shell quantum dot
abstract_en: The application provides a preparation method of core-shell quantum dots, which comprises the following steps of S1, mixing a dispersion liquid containing quantum dot cores, a first ligand, an additive, an etching agent and a first non-coordinating solvent in a container, reacting for a certain time at 150-200 ℃ to obtain an intermediate product system containing the quantum dot cores after surface etching, wherein the additive is selected from metallic zinc, metallic magnesium, sodium hydride, calcium hydride, potassium hydride, lithium aluminum hydride and sodium borohydride, The method comprises the steps of (1) preparing a core-shell quantum dot by adding a zinc precursor and an anion precursor into a container, and reacting for a certain time, wherein the anion precursor comprises at least one of a selenium precursor and a sulfur precursor, and the first temperature is 250-340 ℃. The preparation method can lead the size uniformity of the core-shell quantum dot after the shell layer is coated to be better, thereby narrowing the fluorescence half-peak width.

title_en: Device and method for manufacturing the same
abstract_en: The manufacturing method of the device is a method of manufacturing a device having a cavity, and includes a bonding step and an internal pressure adjusting step. In the bonding step, a cavity is formed by bonding 2 bonding objects, and a gas adsorbing member capable of adsorbing gas in the cavity under irradiation of light is sealed in the cavity. After the joining step, in an internal pressure adjusting step, the internal pressure of the cavity is adjusted by irradiating light to the gas adsorbing member.

title_en: MEMS pressure sensor, manufacturing method thereof and electronic device
abstract_en: A MEMS pressure sensor and a method of manufacturing the same, an electronic device are provided, the method including providing a substrate having a recess formed therein, forming a base layer in the recess with spaces between four sides of the base layer and sidewalls of the recess, forming four electrode material layers on the four sides of the base layer, respectively, with spaces between each electrode material layer and sidewalls of the recess, forming four second electrode layers on outer sides of the electrode material layers, with spaces between each second electrode layer and sidewalls of the recess, etching portions of the electrode material layers to form first electrode layers spaced apart from the second electrode layers, wherein the first electrode layers are located on sides of the base layer, providing a cap layer bonding the cap layer to the base layer, the first electrode layers, and the second electrode layers to form a cavity between the first electrode layers and the second electrode layers, and forming a dielectric layer filling the recess except for a region located between the second electrode layers and the sidewalls of the recess. According to the scheme provided by the invention, four capacitor structures formed by the first electrode layer and the second electrode layer are formed, and are respectively positioned on the four sides of the base layer, so that external pressure signals can be fully and completely sensed and transmitted, the measuring sensitivity and accuracy can be further improved, and the performance of the MEMS pressure sensor is improved.

title_en: Preparation method of clove Luo Letan point and application of clove Luo Letan point in antibacterial drugs and food preservation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of clove Luo Letan points and application of the clove Luo Letan points in antibacterial drugs and food preservation. The preparation method of flos Caryophylli Luo Letan comprises distilling folium Ocimi with steam to remove essential oil, drying in shade, pulverizing, extracting with ethanol solvent, filtering, concentrating, drying to obtain ethanol extract, dispersing the ethanol extract in distilled water, stirring and pyrolyzing on a heating table, diluting the pyrolyzed product with distilled water, centrifuging to obtain supernatant, filtering with a filter membrane, dialyzing, and lyophilizing to obtain carbon dots. The obtained carbon dots have a carbon dot-vesicle coexisting structure, and the average particle diameter is 5.732 + -0.5 nm. The carbon dot of the basil flos caryophylli prepared by the invention can be applied to the preparation of antibacterial drugs, particularly drugs for inhibiting the activities of bacillus cereus and listeria, and the field of food preservation, and has the advantages of wide raw material sources, simple preparation method, low cost, environmental friendliness and the like.

title_en: Iron sulfide nano-particle/nickel cobalt sulfide nano-sheet/multilayer graphene composite material, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses an iron sulfide nano particle/nickel cobalt sulfide nano sheet/multilayer graphene composite material, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein a layer of sheet nickel cobalt sulfide mainly comprises NiS and Ni  3 S 2 ,Co 3 S 4  phases and grows on the surface of multilayer graphene first. The nickel cobalt sulfide nano-sheet grows upwards on the surface of the multilayer graphene to form an array structure. Iron sulfide nanoparticles were then prepared on the surface of the nickel cobalt sulfide array. The iron sulfide nano particles are deposited on the surface of the flaky nickel cobalt sulfide and the surface of the interstitial multi-layer graphene. The composite structure increases the contact area between the active substance and the electrolyte, and increases the active sites. Meanwhile, a heterostructure is introduced, so that the activity of the catalyst is improved.

title_en: Preparation method of gallic acid carbon dot assisted by microwaves, carbon dot and application of carbon dot in tumor treatment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a gallic acid carbon dot assisted by microwaves, the carbon dot and application thereof in tumor treatment, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, dissolving gallic acid and arginine in ultrapure water, and uniformly mixing to obtain a mixed solution; S2, transferring the mixed solution into a reaction kettle, heating by microwaves, S3, dissolving the product obtained in the step S2 by pure water under the ultrasonic condition, centrifuging, filtering the supernatant, dialyzing the filtrate, and freeze-drying the dialyzate to obtain the gallic acid carbon dots. The invention discloses a method for synthesizing gallic acid carbon dots by utilizing a microwave-assisted method, wherein the average grain diameter of the synthesized carbon dots is smaller than 2nm, the method has the advantages of low toxicity, strong penetrating power and the like, and can also remarkably inhibit proliferation and migration of glioma cells.

title_en: Fluorescent nanomaterial Si-CDs@SiO2Preparation method of Protein A and method for specifically labeling cells
abstract_en: The invention designs a preparation method of a fluorescent nano material Si-CDs@SiO  2  @protein A and a method for specifically labeling cells. According to the invention, a one-pot hydrothermal method is adopted to prepare Si-CDs with the silicon doped carbon dots and the particle size of 2-5 nm, then Tetraethoxysilane (TEOS) is adopted to hydrolyze under alkaline conditions to coat the Si-CDs with silicon dioxide (SiO  2 ) to obtain a spherical nano material Si-CDs@SiO  2  with the particle size of about 10-50 nm and high fluorescence quantum yield, protein A is coupled after carboxylation is performed on the surface of the nano material, and the coupled Si-CDs@SiO  2  @protein A fluorescent nano material has good water solubility and can generate high-intensity fluorescence under ultraviolet excitation. The Si-CDs@SiO  2  @protein A and the antibody cooperate to carry out specific fluorescent labeling on cells for cell imaging, and the fluorescent nanomaterial is cheaper than commercial small molecule fluorescent dye, is simpler to prepare, has good photobleaching resistance and does not need to be strictly protected from light. Thus, the Si-CDs@SiO  2  @protein A fluorescent nanomaterial can be used as a fluorescent marker of cells.

title_en: Phosphoric acid column [5] arene modified nitrogen doped quantum dot, preparation method thereof and application thereof in p-nitrophenol detection
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of chemical detection, and particularly relates to a phosphoric acid column [5] arene modified nitrogen doped quantum dot, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in p-nitrophenol detection. The invention provides a phosphoric acid column [5] arene modified nitrogen-doped quantum dot, which comprises a nitrogen-doped carbon quantum dot and a phosphoric acid column [5] arene modified on the surface of the nitrogen-doped carbon quantum dot, wherein the structural formula of the phosphoric acid column [5] arene is shown as a formula 1. The P-CQDs@AO composite material can be constructed through Fluorescence Resonance Energy Transfer (FRET), so that the fluorescence detection of the P-nitrophenol can be realized, and meanwhile, the electrochemical detection of the P-nitrophenol can be realized through the electrochemical sensing electrode, so that the fluorescence and electrochemical double-channel detection of the P-nitrophenol can be realized, and the detection accuracy of the P-nitrophenol is remarkably improved.

title_en: High-temperature-resistant pressing plate for slab continuous casting flame cutting machine and preparation method
abstract_en: The application relates to a high-temperature-resistant pressing plate for a slab continuous casting flame cutting machine and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of special alloy materials and continuous casting equipment. The high-temperature-resistant pressing plate comprises the following chemical components in percentage by mass, wherein the chemical components of the high-temperature-resistant pressing plate are ：C：0.03％～0.04％,Si≤0.75％,Mn≤2.0％,P≤0.045％,S≤0.03％,Cr：16.5％～17.5％,Ni：12.5％～13.5％,Mo：2.8％～3.2％,Ti：0.4％～0.6％,B：0.003％～0.005％, and the balance of Fe and unavoidable impurities, and the mass ratio of Ti to C is 8-10. Through the optimization of components of the high-temperature-resistant pressing plate, the phase structure regulation and control and the synergistic effect of the preparation process, the high-temperature performance, stability and service life of the high-temperature-resistant pressing plate are obviously improved, and therefore the technical problems of high-temperature softening deformation, insufficient service life of materials and the like of the traditional pressing plate are solved.

title_en: Silicon oxide composite anode material based on photo-thermal synergistic modification, preparation method thereof and lithium ion battery
abstract_en: The invention provides a silicon oxide composite anode material based on photo-thermal synergistic modification, a preparation method thereof and a lithium ion battery. The preparation method comprises the steps of dissolving a metal precursor and a reducing carbon source in water, mixing to obtain a precursor solution, dispersing carbon nanotubes in water to obtain a carbon nanotube dispersion liquid, adding the precursor solution and the carbon nanotube dispersion liquid into a SiO  x  material, carrying out light treatment, then carrying out freeze drying to obtain powder, and carrying out heat treatment on the powder to obtain the silicon oxide composite anode material. The silicon oxide composite anode material provided by the invention can effectively relieve internal stress caused by volume change, and simultaneously promote electron conductivity and Li  +  diffusion rate in the circulation process, so that the obviously enhanced long-circulation stability is shown, and a new solution is provided for practical application of the SiO  x  material in lithium ion batteries.

title_en: Composite solid electrolyte with high ionic conductivity and mechanical strength and solid battery thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of composite solid-state electrolytes, and particularly discloses a composite solid-state electrolyte with high ionic conductivity and mechanical strength and a solid-state battery thereof. The method comprises the following steps of 1, preparing garnet type inorganic filler. 2. Acid treatment of garnet-type inorganic fillers. 3. And forming a modified structure of the boron nitride coated inorganic filler by utilizing the electrostatic adsorption effect of the garnet type inorganic filler subjected to acid treatment on the boron nitride nanosheets. 4. And mixing the boron nitride modified garnet type inorganic filler, a polymer, lithium salt and a solvent to prepare the composite electrolyte membrane. 5. The composite electrolyte membrane assembles a full cell. The preparation method of the boron nitride nano-sheet modified inorganic filler composite electrolyte provided by the research realizes the cooperative optimization of the mechanical property and the ion transmission property of the composite electrolyte through interface engineering and structural design. The technology is expected to provide a new idea for the development of solid-state battery key materials.

title_en: Nucleic acid dye and application thereof in nucleic acid detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nucleic acid dye and application thereof in nucleic acid detection, belonging to the technical field of nano materials and biology, the nucleic acid dye of the invention is liquorice derived carbon dots, the invention prepares the carbon dots based on the liquorice root or the liquorice component as the precursor for the first time and successfully applies the carbon dots to the field of nucleic acid detection. The liquorice derived carbon dots of the invention replace the traditional dye to be used in agarose gel electrophoresis, and can realize high-efficiency visual detection of DNA, RNA and plasmids.

title_en: Green low-energy-consumption low-expansion silicon-carbon negative electrode and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to a silicon-carbon negative electrode material of a lithium ion battery, and discloses a green low-energy-consumption low-expansion silicon-carbon negative electrode, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of adding an organic silicon source into an organic carbon source solution A, carrying out hydrolysis reaction, and drying to obtain a coprecipitate H  2 SiO 3  -C of colloidal silicic acid and the organic carbon source; and carrying out two-stage heat treatment on the coprecipitate H  2 SiO 3  -C, cooling and grinding to obtain a porous Si-C compound, and carrying out carbon coating on the Si-C compound, pyrolysis and cooling and grinding to obtain the low-expansion silicon-carbon negative electrode Si-C@C. The low-expansion silicon-carbon negative electrode prepared by the preparation method provided by the invention has the advantages of stable structure, excellent cycle performance, commercial application prospect and the like.

title_en: Preparation method of carbonization amorphous silicon dioxide with controllable structure and morphology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of carbonization amorphous silicon dioxide with controllable structure and morphology. Firstly, carbon dioxide, naHCO  3  solution and low-concentration water glass react at normal pressure to generate silicon dioxide cores, controlling the cationic chemical environment in the growth environment, controlling the gas-liquid flow field in a kettle through a self-suction gas redistributor under high pressure, controlling the temperature to 80-150 ℃, continuing carbonization until the pH value of a reaction system is reduced to be below 9.0, and under the condition, performing core-induced growth to form amorphous silicon dioxide with a specific structure, and performing solid-liquid separation, washing and drying to obtain amorphous silicon dioxide functional powder with adjustable specific surface area and pore volume. The invention can adjust the morphology and pore canal structure of the amorphous silica under the condition of no additive, avoid the problem of sodium sulfate wastewater discharge caused by the introduction of the structure regulating additive in the production process of the amorphous silica by the traditional sulfuric acid method, and improve the particle size distribution and the morphology of the powder of the silica.

title_en: NiNb (nickel-niobium) alloy2O6Preparation method and application of porous microsphere electrode material
abstract_en: A preparation method of the NiNb  2 O 6  porous microspheres comprises the steps of (1) completely dissolving soluble nickel salt and soluble niobium salt in deionized water to form a precursor solution, (2) carrying out spray granulation on the precursor solution in a spray drying unit, drying to obtain precursor powder, and (3) collecting the precursor powder and then sintering to obtain the NiNb  2 O 6  porous microspheres. The NiNb  2 O 6  porous microsphere prepared by the method has the advantages of high theoretical specific capacity, high reversible specific capacity, high safety performance, good multiplying power performance, excellent cycle performance and the like.

title_en: Lithium iron manganese phosphate positive electrode material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of lithium ion batteries, in particular to a lithium iron manganese phosphate positive electrode material, a preparation method and application thereof, which are used for solving the problems of low electrochemical performance, poor charge and discharge efficiency and short cycle life of the existing lithium iron manganese phosphate positive electrode material; the lithium manganese iron phosphate positive electrode material is prepared from silver-doped lithium manganese iron phosphate positive electrode material powder, conductive carbon black and polyvinylidene chloride, wherein divalent silver ions are doped in the silver-doped lithium manganese iron phosphate positive electrode material powder, and three-dimensional interconnection conductive carbon networks are coated on the interior and the surface of the silver-doped lithium manganese iron phosphate positive electrode material powder, so that the lithium manganese iron phosphate positive electrode material has the advantages of excellent electrochemical performance, high charge and discharge efficiency, long cycle life and the like, and can meet the requirements of high-performance lithium ion batteries.

title_en: MEMS device and method of manufacturing the same
abstract_en: The invention provides a MEMS device and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the manufacturing method of the MEMS device comprises the steps of providing a substrate, wherein a first semiconductor layer is formed on the substrate; forming a groove in a first semiconductor layer, forming a first release hole penetrating the first semiconductor layer at the bottom wall of the groove and a second release hole penetrating the first semiconductor layer at the periphery of the groove, wherein the width of the groove is larger than that of the first release hole, forming a first sacrificial layer on the first semiconductor layer, filling the groove with the first sacrificial layer, sealing the first release hole and the second release hole, etching the first sacrificial layer at the periphery of the second release hole, stopping etching in the first sacrificial layer in the groove and the first semiconductor layer at the periphery of the groove and the second release hole to form a plurality of contact holes, forming a second semiconductor layer on the first sacrificial layer, and filling the contact holes with the second semiconductor layer. The technical scheme of the invention can prevent the sealing part of the first release hole from being opened by over etching, thereby avoiding affecting the performance of the MEMS device.

title_en: Harmonic oscillator metallization manufacturing method adapting to outer spherical electrode
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of manufacturing of micro-electromechanical systems, in particular to a harmonic oscillator metallization manufacturing method for an adaptive outer spherical electrode, which comprises the following steps: and (3) processing an anchor point plane of the harmonic oscillator by adopting a wire forming process, corroding the harmonic oscillator by a wet process, forming a through hole in an anchor point processing area, and metallizing the outer surface of the harmonic oscillator, the through hole and the anchor point plane of the harmonic oscillator, so that the metallized outer surface of the harmonic oscillator is connected with the metallized anchor point plane through the metallized through hole. The invention adopts the wire forming and corrosion technology to manufacture the through hole on the anchor point plane, and realizes the interconnection of the outer surface film layer of the harmonic oscillator and the anchor point film layer through the through hole, without the need of metallizing the inner surface of the harmonic oscillator, thereby realizing the improvement of the quality factor of the harmonic oscillator and having the characteristic of batch manufacture.

title_en: Negative thermal expansion material, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of negative thermal expansion materials, and discloses a negative thermal expansion material, a preparation method and application thereof. The negative thermal expansion material is Cu  3 (MoO 4 ) 2 (OH) 2 . The nano flaky basic Cu  3 (MoO 4 ) 2 (OH) 2  with the negative thermal expansion characteristic can not only resist higher temperature, but also have wider NTE temperature range.

title_en: Preparation method of magnetic nano particles with high magnetocaloric conversion efficiency
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of magnetic NaNO particles with high magnetocaloric conversion efficiency, which adopts a jacket reactor, wherein an interlayer of the jacket reactor and an external water source form a circulating fluid, the jacket reactor is fixed at the center of an alternating magnetic field coil, and the preparation method specifically comprises the following steps of (1) adding a NaOH solution into the deoxidized jacket reactor, continuously stirring, adding a divalent ferric salt solution into the NaOH solution in a dropwise manner, pumping hot water into the interlayer of the jacket reactor after the dropwise addition is completed, keeping the temperature of the water in the interlayer at 80-90 ℃ all the time through the pumping speed, starting an alternating magnetic field, ensuring that the current is 30-40A, ensuring that the frequency is 307kHz, simultaneously dripping a NaNO  3  solution into the jacket reactor, curing after the dropwise addition is completed, and washing and centrifuging the obtained product after the reaction in the dropwise addition of an oxidant and the curing process under the alternating magnetic field to obtain the ferroferric oxide magnetic NaNO particles.

title_en: Sulfur-doped keggin type molybdenum polyacid and nickel sulfide heterojunction composite catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a sulfur-doped keggin type molybdenum polyacid and nickel sulfide heterojunction composite catalyst, and a preparation method and application thereof. The heterojunction composite catalyst is formed by compounding sulfur-doped keggin type molybdenum polyacid and nickel sulfide, and the heterostructure of the heterojunction composite catalyst is formed by MoS  2  and NiS. According to the invention, the nickel source is modified and synchronously vulcanized by using the keggin type molybdenum polyacid (HPMo  9 O 34 ] 8‑ ) as a multi-metal oxygen cluster skeleton, so that the synthesis of the heterojunction composite catalyst of the sulfur-doped keggin type molybdenum polyacid and nickel sulfide is realized, the heterojunction composite catalyst has excellent electrocatalytic performance and excellent electrochemical stability, and in an oxygen evolution reaction, the heterojunction composite catalyst shows lower overpotential, lower Tafil slope and excellent long-time operation stability, and a practical strategy is provided for developing OER materials with high performance, low cost and corrosion resistance.

title_en: Integrated circuit device
abstract_en: An integrated circuit device may include a nanoplatelet stack including a plurality of nanoplatelets, a gate line at least partially surrounding each nanoplatelet of the plurality of nanoplatelets, the gate line including a main gate portion and a sub-gate portion, a source/drain region in contact with the plurality of nanoplatelets, and an inter-insulating spacer between the sub-gate portion and the source/drain region, wherein a first sidewall and a second sidewall of the inter-insulating spacer each include a portion recessed toward an interior of the inter-insulating spacer, the first sidewall facing the source/drain region and the second sidewall being opposite the first sidewall in a first horizontal direction.

title_en: SiC/TiNNW ultraviolet photoelectric detector
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of semiconductor ultraviolet detection, and relates to a SiC/TiN NW ultraviolet photoelectric detector. The invention combines the metal nitride TiN with the SiC NW to prepare a single SiC/TiN NW ultraviolet photoelectric detector. Under 365nm illumination, the device has a dark current of 8.7nA at 5V, the on-off ratio is 546, the rising and decay time of the device is 0.372s and 0.367s respectively, the responsivity and the detection rate of the device are 2050A/W and 2.67×10  10  Jones respectively at the optical power density of 245mW/cm  2 , and the external quantum efficiency of the device reaches 7×10  5 %. Compared with an intrinsic SiC NW device, the performance of the SiC/TiN NW photoelectric detector is greatly improved, and the application field and range of the ultraviolet photoelectric detector are further expanded.

title_en: Preparation method of efficient gas sensor based on porous tin dioxide nanorod domain-limited isolated platinum atoms
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a high-efficiency gas sensor based on porous SnO  2  nanorod finite field isolated platinum atoms, which is characterized in that isolated Pt atoms are precisely deposited in a SnO  2  pore canal through an ALD technology, the working temperature (190 ℃) of the sensor is obviously reduced by utilizing the synergistic effect of a finite field effect and monoatomic catalysis, and the sensitivity (R  a /R g  =6.33@5ppm) to acetone, the response speed (9 seconds) and the stability (28-day attenuation rate 2.8%) are improved. The sensor has wide application prospect in the fields of medical diagnosis, environmental monitoring and the like.

title_en: Copper particulate dispersion
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a copper microparticle dispersion containing copper nanoparticles A having an average particle diameter of 50 to nm and 350 to nm, modified cellulose B having a content of 2500 mass ppm or less, which is an anionically modified cellulose fiber having a modification group of 1 or more selected from the group consisting of (a) a hydrocarbon group and (B) a polymer group, and a dispersion medium C, and a method for producing a joined body using the copper microparticle dispersion.

title_en: Oxide ceramic particles coated with aminated functional groups
abstract_en: The invention discloses an oxide ceramic particle coated with an aminated functional group, wherein the particle is a plurality of composite LLZO particles, the composite LLZO particles comprise a LLZO particle used for guiding and dispersing lithium ions passing through a positive electrode, a hydroxide ion layer is coated on the outer surface of the LLZO particle to form a secondary LLZO particle integrally, a dopamine layer is coated on the outer part of the secondary LLZO particle to form the composite LLZO particle, and the dopamine has a hydrophobic characteristic and can further protect the LLZO particle from being wetted. CTAB is mixed in the dopamine layer and the hydroxide ion layer, wherein the dopamine layer is also coated with a CTAB layer.

title_en: Electroactive material for metal-ion batteries
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a particulate electroactive material consisting of a plurality of composite particles, wherein the composite particles comprise (a) a porous carbon skeleton comprising micropores and mesopores, the total volume of the micropores and mesopores being from 0.5 to 1.5 cm  3 /g, and (b) a defined amount of silicon located at least within the micropores of the porous carbon skeleton relative to the volumes of the micropores and mesopores. At least 20 wt% of the silicon is characterized as surface silicon by thermogravimetric analysis.

title_en: ZnF (zinc-tin-fluoride) 3D (three-dimensional) printing2Preparation method and application of rGO micro-grid aerogel framework
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of new energy materials, and provides a preparation method and application of a 3D printing ZnF  2 /rGO micro-grid aerogel framework, wherein the method comprises the following steps of preparing 3D printing GO slurry; filling GO slurry into an injector, adopting direct-writing type 3D printing to obtain a three-dimensional GO three-dimensional micro-grid structure, then performing freeze drying, performing high-temperature annealing on the GO three-dimensional micro-grid structure in a tube furnace through reducing gas to obtain 3D printing rGO micro-grid aerogel, putting the 3D printing rGO micro-grid aerogel into magnetron sputtering, and depositing ZnF  2  nano particles at the bottom of a sample by utilizing the magnetron sputtering to obtain a ZnF  2 /rGO micro-grid aerogel framework. The ZnF  2 /rGO micro-grid aerogel framework has sodium-philic property, and sodium is induced to uniformly nucleate and deposit, so that dendrite growth is obviously inhibited, and the cycling stability of the sodium metal battery is improved. The method has the advantages of simple process, controllable structure, excellent performance and good industrialization prospect.

title_en: Preparation method of nanopore reinforced high-strength plastic low-density stainless steel
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of metal material preparation, and particularly relates to a preparation method of a nano-pore reinforced high-strength plastic low-density stainless steel. The nano-pore reinforced stainless steel has the advantages that 1) nano-pores are innovatively introduced into a stainless steel sintered felt, the strength of steel is successfully improved by utilizing interface reinforcement of the nano-pores, the density of the steel is reduced by volume loss caused by the pores, the specific strength of the steel is further improved, the excellent ductility of the steel is kept by excellent deformability of the pores, the strength is increased, the density is reduced, 2) the strength of the nano-pore reinforced stainless steel is improved by 2.5 times and the specific strength is improved by 2.78 times under the condition that the plasticity is not lost compared with that of the traditional compact stainless steel, the stainless steel has strong plasticity, the stainless steel has far better than the existing stainless steel, and the nano-pore reinforcing mechanism of the invention provides a new thought for the strong plastic design of steel materials.

title_en: Isomer-regulated SERS probes and their use in detection of multiple pathogens
abstract_en: The invention discloses an isomer-regulated SERS probe and application thereof in detection of various pathogens, and belongs to the technical field of biological detection. According to the invention, p-methoxy benzenethiol, m-methoxy benzenethiol, o-methoxy benzenethiol, p-fluorobenzene thiol, m-fluorobenzene thiol and o-fluorobenzene thiol with different Raman characteristic peaks are adopted as Raman reporter molecules, so that the overlapping of the Raman characteristic peaks can be avoided, and when six groups of probes (p-methoxy benzenethiol probe, m-methoxy benzenethiol probe, o-methoxy benzenethiol probe, p-fluorobenzene thiol probe, m-fluorobenzene thiol probe and o-fluorobenzene thiol probe) are subjected to pathogen antibody modification and mixing, the SERS probes can synchronously detect various pathogens, and meanwhile, the Raman reporter molecules have good enhancement effect, so that the simultaneous, rapid and accurate detection of various pathogens is facilitated, and therefore, the SERS probe has a good application prospect.

title_en: Self-emulsifying nano composite profile control agent for oil field and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of chemical flooding, and in particular discloses a self-emulsifying nano composite profile control agent for an oil field and a preparation process thereof. The self-emulsifying nano composite profile control agent for the oil field is prepared from the following raw materials, by mass, 100 parts of amphiphilic nano silicon dioxide 3-5 parts, 1-2 parts of a zwitterionic surfactant, 0.5-1 part of a nonionic surfactant and the balance of water, wherein the zwitterionic surfactant comprises hydroxysulfobetaines and imidazolines, and the nonionic surfactant is an ethoxy-propoxy block copolymer. The self-emulsifying nano composite profile control agent prepared by the application effectively realizes the balance of low interfacial tension and self-emulsifying efficiency.

title_en: Synthesis of FeNi nanocone structures for electrochemical filtering
abstract_en: The invention prepares the high-performance FeNi nano cone structure filtering super capacitor electrode material. And by utilizing an electrochemical deposition method, an FeNi nano cone array structure is deposited on a titanium sheet in situ, and FeNi nano cone arrays with different cone tip curvatures are prepared by changing three parameters of electrodeposition temperature, electrodeposition time and electrodeposition current density. The super capacitor based on the structure shows an area specific capacitance of 86.8 mu F/cm < 2 >, an equivalent series resistance of 0.68 omega and a high impedance phase angle of-79.4 degrees at 120Hz, meanwhile, after the FeNi nano cone super capacitor is circulated for 20000 times at a current density of 0.2mA cm < -2 >, the capacitor retention rate reaches 96%, and the super capacitor shows good AC-DC performance and a low ripple coefficient of 5.2% in an AC filtering test of 60Hz, and the FeNi nano cone array with a high curvature structure shows good filtering performance in an AC filtering performance test, and meanwhile, the FeNi nano cone is completely composed of metal, so the super capacitor has better conductivity compared with a carbon material. The invention provides possibility for the application of the metal nanostructure material in the alternating current filtering field.

title_en: Negative electrode of all-solid-state battery, preparation method of negative electrode and all-solid-state battery
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cathode of an all-solid-state battery, a preparation method of the cathode and the all-solid-state battery, belonging to the technical field of lithium battery production, wherein the cathode of the all-solid-state battery comprises a porous matrix, amorphous silicon and crystalline silicon, the amorphous silicon is accommodated in pores of the porous matrix, and the mass ratio of the amorphous silicon to the crystalline silicon is (1.5-9): 1. The invention adopts the amorphous silicon volume with small volume change as the main body contributing to the capacity of the negative electrode, the amorphous structure is easier to form a stable interface with the solid electrolyte, the side reaction of the interface is reduced, the continuous periodic lattice of the crystalline silicon can provide more coherent ion transmission channels besides contributing to the capacity, the function of constructing the lithium ion transmission channels in the negative electrode is achieved, and the lithium ion transmission rate in the negative electrode can be further improved.

title_en: Thermopile sensor based on monocrystalline silicon and super surface and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a thermopile sensor based on monocrystalline silicon and a super surface and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of cleaning and drying a silicon wafer on an insulating layer and etching the monocrystalline silicon on the top layer to form a strip-shaped thermocouple strip; and depositing a silicon dioxide layer on the upper layer of the thermocouple strip and etching to form an interconnection through hole, depositing a first metal layer, filling the interconnection through hole, etching and reserving a part which is interconnected with the thermocouple strip and a part which is positioned in a thermocouple area, sequentially depositing a passivation layer and a second metal layer on the first metal layer, etching the second metal layer to form a super surface, etching the passivation layer to form a local opening, and carrying out cavity etching on a silicon wafer under an insulating layer to obtain the thermopile sensor with the thermopile suspension film structure. According to the preparation method, the Seebeck coefficient is improved by preparing the monocrystalline silicon thermocouple structure, the infrared absorption efficiency is improved by preparing the super-surface structure, and the detected output voltage is improved while the chip size and the process complexity are not increased.

title_en: Resveratrol nanoparticle and preparation method thereof
