abstract_en: The invention relates to a resveratrol nanoparticle and a preparation method thereof, wherein the resveratrol nanoparticle consists of resveratrol, phosphatidylcholine and sophorolipid, the particle size of the resveratrol nanoparticle is less than or equal to 65nm, the polydispersity index (PDI) is less than 0.2, the absolute value of zeta potential is more than or equal to 15mV, the drug loading rate of resveratrol is more than or equal to 29 percent, the invention also provides a preparation method for preparing the resveratrol nanoparticle, the preparation method successfully prepares the resveratrol nanoparticle with high encapsulation rate, high stability and obviously improved safety by adopting a safe solvent system, a simple and efficient process, natural green auxiliary materials and a freeze-drying stabilization technology, and simultaneously solves the technical problem that the resveratrol is easy to be interfered by factors such as light, heat, oxygen and the like to lose biological activity.

title_en: Nitride LED epitaxial wafer and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a nitride LED epitaxial wafer and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the nitride LED epitaxial wafer comprises a substrate, a composite buffer layer, a nitride buffer layer, a first nitride semiconductor layer, a nitride luminous layer and a second nitride semiconductor layer which are arranged in a laminated mode, the composite buffer layer comprises n groups of composite buffer sublayers which are arranged in a laminated mode, the 1 st group of composite buffer sublayers to the (n-1) th group of composite buffer sublayers respectively comprise a modulation sublayer, a first covering sublayer, a composite structure sublayer and a second covering sublayer which are arranged in a laminated mode, the n groups of composite buffer sublayers comprise a modulation sublayer, a first covering sublayer and a composite structure sublayer which are arranged in a laminated mode, and n is more than or equal to 2, and the composite structure sublayers have nanometer pattern structures. By adopting the scheme provided by the invention, the dislocation or defect problem generated by lattice constant and thermal mismatch can be overcome, and the development of a multifunctional buffer technology is realized.

title_en: Preparation method of silicon tellurium heterojunction based on molecular beam epitaxial growth
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of growth and preparation of two-dimensional materials, and particularly relates to a preparation method of a silicon tellurium heterojunction based on molecular beam epitaxial growth. The method comprises the following steps of S1, sequentially carrying out argon ion etching and annealing treatment on a metal substrate, S2, depositing silicon atoms on the surface of the metal substrate to obtain a silicon nanobelt, wherein the deposition time is 16min, then carrying out annealing treatment, S3, depositing tellurium atoms on the surface of the silicon nanobelt by a molecular beam epitaxy method to obtain a silicon tellurium heterojunction, and the deposition time is 10min. The application builds a set of molecular beam epitaxy system, can precisely control the growth condition, realizes the controllable growth of the two-dimensional material, provides a guiding function for the growth of the silicon tellurium heterojunction by using the one-dimensional space of the silicon nanoribbon as a template, and promotes tellurium atoms to be orderly arranged along the silicon nanoribbon to form the silicon tellurium heterojunction with regular structure.

title_en: Lithium ion battery conductive agent, positive electrode slurry, positive electrode plate and battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lithium ion battery conductive agent, positive electrode slurry, a positive electrode plate and a battery, and relates to the technical field of lithium ion batteries. According to the invention, phosphoric acid modified polyacrylic acid obtained by doping phosphoric acid in the polymerization process of acrylic acid monomers is used as a matrix of the conductive agent, the carbon nano tube modified by nano silver is used as a conductive filler, and the conductive agent is cured under the action of the curing agent to obtain the lithium ion battery conductive agent.

title_en: Method for manufacturing silicon nanowire
abstract_en: The invention relates to a manufacturing method of a silicon nanowire, and belongs to the technical field of MEMS. The method comprises the steps of S1, providing an SOI substrate, S2, forming a mask layer on the SOI substrate, S3, patterning the mask layer to form an etching window, S4, isotropically etching the SOI substrate through the etching window to form a cavity and a silicon nano column, S5, oxidizing the silicon nano column to form an oxide layer and a silicon nano wire, and S6, removing the buried oxide layer and the oxide layer to obtain the suspended silicon nano wire. The invention solves the problems of complex preparation method, high equipment requirement and poor batch consistency of the silicon nanowires in the prior art.

title_en: Ultrahigh-strength 7085 aluminum alloy and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: An ultra-high strength 7085 aluminum alloy and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: A. selecting 7085 aluminum alloy bars with diameters of 30-120 mm and subjected to primary hot extrusion; B. semi-solid isothermal treatment is carried out on the 7085 aluminum alloy bar: heating to a semi-solid temperature range of 490-550 ℃, preserving heat for 0.1-2 h, and then rapidly cooling with water for quenching; C. performing secondary hot extrusion on the 7085 aluminum alloy bar: the extrusion temperature is 350-450 ℃, the extrusion speed is 0.1-5 mm/s, the extrusion ratio is 9-15:1, a flat die or a conical die is adopted, and air cooling or water cooling is carried out to room temperature after extrusion, so that an extrusion bar is obtained; D. grinding the extruded bar to remove oxide skin, and directly performing aging treatment or performing solution treatment first and then performing aging treatment to obtain the ultra-high strength 7085 aluminum alloy; the temperature of the solution treatment is 450-490 ℃, the time is 1-2.5 h, and the water cooling quenching is carried out after the solution treatment; the temperature of ageing treatment is 110-130 ℃, and time is 18-26 h, water-cooling quenching after ageing treatment. The 7085 aluminum alloy prepared by the invention has excellent tensile strength, yield strength and elongation.

title_en: Preparation method and application of bismuth nanoparticle material
abstract_en: The application provides a preparation method and application of bismuth nanoparticle material, which comprises the steps of dissolving bismuth nitrate pentahydrate in glycol to prepare a solution, adding nitric acid to accurately adjust the pH value of the solution to 1.0, dissolving sodium citrate in glycol to prepare a solution, mixing the two solutions uniformly, transferring the mixed solution into a microwave reaction kettle, carrying out radiation reaction at the temperature of 110-130 ℃ and the microwave power of 300-500W for 20-40 min, cooling to room temperature, centrifugally washing the obtained product with ethanol for many times, and drying to obtain black bismuth nanoparticles. According to the method, the acidic environment of the precursor solution is accurately regulated and controlled by nitric acid, and the Bi  3+  is rapidly and controllably reduced to elemental Bi under microwave radiation by utilizing the synergistic co-reduction effect of sodium citrate and ethylene glycol, so that the nano particles are formed. The application has outstanding advantages in the aspects of efficiency, controllability, environmental protection and cost.

title_en: Preparation method of microfluidic chip and forming die
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of microfluidic chip preparation, and particularly relates to a preparation method and a forming die of a microfluidic chip. The preparation method of the microfluidic chip comprises the steps of molding, preparing a molding die, wherein the molding die comprises at least two compensation gaskets, a female die and a male die, wherein the thickness of each compensation gasket is different, a containing through groove is formed in the female die and is fixedly arranged on the female die, the shape of the containing through groove is matched with that of the male die, one compensation gasket is arranged on one side of the female die and is positioned below the containing through groove, the male die is inserted into the containing through groove on the other side of the female die and is abutted against the compensation gasket, and the blank is placed at the exposed end of the male die and is subjected to compression molding, so that a micro-flow channel is machined on the blank by the male die. The invention can improve the demolding convenience of the microfluidic chip and improve the molding precision.

title_en: Preparation method of granularity-graded ferric phosphate and high-compaction type lithium iron phosphate
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of granularity-graded ferric phosphate and high-compaction type lithium iron phosphate. Removing impurities from the byproduct ferrous sulfate of titanium dioxide, filtering to obtain purified ferrous sulfate base solution, reacting phosphoric acid with ammonia water to prepare ammonium phosphate solutions with different reaction pH and phosphorus molar concentrations, respectively mixing the ammonium phosphate solutions with a certain amount of hydrogen peroxide, sequentially adding an iron source, a first phosphorus salt solution, a second phosphorus salt solution and a third phosphorus salt solution into a tubular reactor to react to obtain ferric phosphate slurry, and sequentially carrying out the processes of conversion, filtering, washing, drying and calcining on the completely reacted slurry to finally obtain the anhydrous ferric phosphate. The invention adopts a mode of controlling solution nucleation and growth, controls nucleation and growth rate by preparing phosphate solution with different concentrations, directly realizes the size grading of precursor particles in a synthesis reaction section, and further realizes slurry grading uniformity by aging crystal transformation. The lithium iron phosphate prepared from the iron phosphate precursor has high compacted density.

title_en: Sweat vitamin C electrochemical sensor and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electrochemical detection and discloses a sweat vitamin C electrochemical sensor and a preparation method thereof, wherein a clay method is adopted to prepare Ti  3 C 2 T x  nano-sheets, mixed solution of LiF and HCl is utilized to selectively etch an A atomic layer in MAX precursor to obtain Ti  3 C 2 T x  nano-sheet powder, polystyrene microspheres are used as templates, the templates are removed after compounding and calcining to obtain hollow Ti  3 C 2 T x  -MXene nanospheres with hollow spherical structures, the preparation of a sweat ascorbic acid sensor is carried out, the hollow Ti  3 C 2 T x  -MXene nanospheres are compounded with chitosan to form an electrode surface, an electrochemical sensing interface with high sensitivity and stable response to ascorbic acid in sweat is constructed, a CNN-LSTM model is constructed, a convolution layer is utilized as a characteristic extractor of original data, and the extracted characteristic data is output to a long-short-term memory network LSTM to generate a prediction result.

title_en: Antithrombotic drug derived carbon dot and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses an antithrombotic drug derived carbon dot and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the steps of selecting an antithrombotic drug as a precursor, performing gradient carbonization treatment on the precursor in a plurality of temperature areas, wherein the temperature areas comprise a low temperature area capable of retaining the pharmacophore, a medium temperature area capable of regulating and controlling the carbon hybridization ratio and a high temperature area doped with hetero atoms, and performing purification and drying treatment to obtain the antithrombotic drug derivative carbon point, wherein the molecular weight of the antithrombotic drug is 100-2000Da, the thermal stability decomposition temperature is greater than or equal to 200 ℃. The preparation method can obtain the derived carbon point of the antithrombotic drug with thrombolysis function and high safety, and can alleviate the problem of unbalanced curative effect and safety of the existing antithrombotic drug.

title_en: Integrated optical gyroscope and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integrated optical gyroscope and a preparation method thereof.A light signal enters a chip through an end face coupler, enters a lithium niobate modulation area through a beam splitter through a vertical adiabatic coupler for modulating the light signal, and enters a waveguide ring through a mode conversion structure after light modulation, wherein the mode conversion structure is arranged at an inlet and an outlet of the waveguide ring and is used for converting modes, so that light is transmitted in the waveguide ring for multiple times. The optical gyroscope has the advantages that the modulation speed and loss of the optical gyroscope are reduced by adopting the heterogeneous integrated structure, meanwhile, the waveguide ring is utilized for multiple times by adopting mode conversion, the effective length of the waveguide ring on the gyroscope chip is increased by different modes, and the sensitivity of the gyroscope is improved.

title_en: Triple targeting multicolor fluorescent probe based on single carbon point and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fluorescent probes, and particularly discloses a triple targeting multicolor fluorescent probe based on a single carbon point, and a preparation method and application thereof; sealing the reaction kettle, placing in a constant temperature oven, heating and maintaining for 6 hours, centrifuging the reaction mixture at high speed to remove precipitate, filtering, placing the filtrate in a dialysis bag, and dialyzing in deionized water for 24 hours to remove unreacted precursor and micromolecular impurities, thus obtaining the fluorescent probe. The single-carbon-point-based triple-targeting multicolor fluorescent probe, the preparation method and the application thereof are adopted, the carbon quantum dot fluorescent probe is prepared by adopting a one-step solvothermal method, and the fluorescent probe can be used for simultaneously and specifically targeting and marking lipid droplets, lysosomes and mitochondria in living cells, and can realize reliable differentiation of three organelles under multiband confocal fluorescent imaging.

title_en: Cobalt-tungsten co-doped ruthenium dioxide electrocatalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a cobalt and tungsten co-doped ruthenium dioxide electrocatalyst and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of hydrogen production by electrocatalytic water splitting. The electrocatalyst provided by the application comprises RuO  2  nano-particles, and tungsten atoms and cobalt atoms doped in the RuO  2  nano-particles. The complex (CoW-RuO  2 ) formed by doping tungsten atoms and cobalt atoms in the crystal lattice of RuO  2  nano-particles regulates and controls the electron transport capacity of the catalyst by introducing hetero atoms, so that the center of an O2 p band moves downwards, the formation of oxygen vacancies in CoW-RuO  2  can be obviously increased, and the generation of soluble high-valence Ru  x>4  is prevented. In addition, the preparation method provided by the application has the characteristics of simple process steps, safety, easiness in control, easiness in obtaining raw materials, small environmental pollution, mild experimental conditions, short time consumption, low cost and the like. The catalyst prepared by the application has wide application prospect in the electrolytic water oxygen evolution reaction under the acidic environment.

title_en: Method for synthesizing nano titanium niobate composite material by flash evaporation joule heating method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for synthesizing a nano titanium niobate composite material by a flash evaporation Joule heating method and application thereof, belonging to the field of lithium ion batteries. First, a titanium niobate precursor is prepared by mechanical mixing, in which a doped oxide is mixed. The prepared titanium niobate precursor is mechanically mixed with a carbon material, and the nano titanium niobate composite material is prepared by a flash evaporation Joule heating method. According to the preparation method, the traditional slow solid state reaction is converted into the fast liquid phase auxiliary reaction by the flash evaporation Joule heating method, the gradient substitution structure of doping atoms (niobium/titanium sites) is compounded with the carbon material, the lithium ion diffusion kinetics and the interfacial charge transmission are synergistically optimized, the multiplying power performance of the material is obviously improved, the comprehensive performance of the titanium niobate-based lithium ion battery is comprehensively improved, and the preparation method can be used in the field of high-power and high-specific energy titanium niobate-based lithium ion batteries.

title_en: Preparation method and application of carbon-coated hydroxyapatite-loaded zinc compound composite material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a carbon-coated hydroxyapatite-loaded zinc compound composite material, and belongs to the technical field of water-based zinc ion batteries. Mixing zinc source, organic ligand containing carboxyl and hydroxyl, sulfide and polar organic solvent, stirring and heating for reaction, adding hydroxyapatite into the mixed solution, transferring into a reaction kettle for sectional temperature control reaction, suction filtering and drying to obtain solid reactant with accordion-like structure, placing the carbon precursor and the solid reactant with accordion-like structure in different heating areas, and carrying out carbon deposition in argon atmosphere by adopting a double-temperature-area independent temperature control mode to obtain the carbon-coated hydroxyapatite-loaded zinc compound composite material. The invention prepares the accordion-like composite material by adopting the manners of sulfide regulation and control, hydroxyapatite connection and organic carbon deposition, and has excellent specific capacity and good cycle stability in the zinc ion battery.

title_en: Method for preparing nano zinc oxide by utilizing zinc chloride wastewater
abstract_en: A method for preparing nano zinc oxide by utilizing zinc chloride wastewater relates to the technical field of wastewater treatment and provides a method for preparing nano zinc oxide by utilizing zinc chloride wastewater, which has low input, high output, environmental benefit and economic benefit. The method comprises the following steps of S1, adjusting the PH value of zinc chloride wastewater to 4.6-4.9, adding the solution with the PH value adjusted to sodium carbonate solution, setting the reaction temperature to 45-90 ℃ and reacting to obtain precursor sediment, S2, filtering the mixture obtained in S1 to obtain a precursor filter cake, S3, cleaning the precursor filter cake and filtering cleaning slurry to obtain a clean filter cake, S4, crushing the clean filter cake to obtain precursor powder, S5, drying the powder obtained in S4 at the temperature of 85-120 ℃ for 2-4 hours, and S6, calcining the powder obtained in S5 at the temperature of 350-500 ℃ for 1-2 hours to obtain the nano zinc oxide.

title_en: Carbon quantum dot-ZIF-8 compound for sewage detection and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a carbon quantum dot-ZIF-8 compound for sewage detection, and a preparation method and application thereof. The ZIF-8 and the carbon quantum dot are matched, so that the carbon quantum dot-ZIF-8 compound is allowed to realize high-precision detection of tetracyclines by a double-peak ratio method.

title_en: Dyeing method for removing autofluorescence of single-cell sorting microfluidic chip and chip without autofluorescence
abstract_en: The application provides a dyeing method for removing autofluorescence of a single-cell sorting microfluidic chip and a chip without autofluorescence. The dyeing method comprises the steps of fully soaking a single-cell sorting microfluidic chip in a dye solution for dyeing until the top layer of the chip is dyed into an opaque black top layer, and obtaining the single-cell sorting microfluidic chip without autofluorescence, wherein the dye in the dye solution is black dye, and the single-cell sorting microfluidic chip at least comprises a photosensitive dry film serving as a flow channel layer. The dyeing method provided by the technical scheme of the application can effectively solve the problem of autofluorescence of the single-cell sorting microfluidic chip prepared by the traditional photosensitive dry film, so that when the dyed chip is applied to fluorescence activated cell sorting, the identification of automatically screening fluorescent cells is facilitated, the operation difficulty of fluorescence activated cell sorting is reduced, and the accuracy and reliability are improved.

title_en: Hollow spherical silicon-carbon material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of lithium ion battery cathode materials, and relates to a hollow spherical silicon-carbon material, a preparation method and application thereof. Through the stepwise slurry mixing and spray drying process, the invention realizes the efficient compounding of silicon, carbon nano tubes and graphene oxide, and forms a hollow spherical structure. The structure comprises an internal framework formed by interweaving gas-phase nano silicon and carbon nano tubes, and a graphene oxide layer wrapping the surface of the internal framework, wherein a reserved gap in the internal framework effectively buffers the volume expansion of silicon, meanwhile, the carbon nano tube framework provides a continuous conductive network, and the graphene oxide flexible wrapping layer enhances the interface stability, so that the technical problems of short cycle life, poor conductivity and unstable structure caused by the volume expansion in the charging and discharging process of the traditional silicon-based anode material are effectively solved.

title_en: CrCoNi alloy with dislocation-short-range ordered composite defect structure and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of metal material reinforcement and surface protection, and particularly relates to CrCoNi alloy with a dislocation-short-range ordered composite defect structure and a preparation method thereof. According to the invention, through carrying out high-pressure heat treatment on CrCoNi alloy and regulating and controlling high-pressure heat treatment process parameters, a high-density dislocation and short-range ordered composite defect structure is synchronously constructed in CrCoNi alloy, and CrCoNi alloy with a dislocation-short-range ordered composite defect structure is obtained. According to the invention, by introducing the high-density dislocation and short-range ordered composite defect structure into the CrCoNi entropy alloy, excellent synergy of strength, plasticity and corrosion resistance is realized, and engineering applicability and service reliability of the CrCoNi alloy in an extreme environment are remarkably improved. The preparation strategy has good universality, can be expanded to other metal structure material systems, and provides a new technical approach for collaborative optimization of various performances through composite defect engineering.

title_en: Preparation method and application of polyol-mediated tantalum-doped ruthenium dioxide
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of electrocatalytic material synthesis, and provides a preparation method and application of polyol-mediated tantalum-doped ruthenium dioxide, the method firstly adopts an isopropanol-glycerol polyol mixed solvent system, and realizes the uniform mixing of metal precursors through the dual effects of molecular-level dispersion and controllable reduction. And then PVP is introduced in the hydrothermal process as a difunctional regulator, so that the morphology guidance and the steric hindrance effect are synchronously exerted, and the grain aggregation is inhibited. And subsequent intermediate low temperature heat treatment at 300 ℃ is adopted, so that the crystallinity of the material is improved while the integrity of the nano structure is maintained. The method creatively solves the problems of contradictory relation between split phase, crystallinity and specific surface area and the like caused by uneven doping in the traditional method through the synergistic effect of solvent system design, surfactant regulation and control and low-temperature heat treatment process, has the advantages of simple process, controllable product structure and the like, and provides a new thought for preparing tantalum doped ruthenium dioxide.

title_en: Pixel-level packaging structure and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A pixel level package structure and a method for fabricating the same are provided. The pixel level package structure comprises a pixel structure and a package structure. The pixel structure comprises a readout circuit substrate and a focal plane pixel unit array, the focal plane pixel unit array comprises a thermosensitive layer and a bridge pier, the packaging structure comprises a packaging cap structure and a sealing reflection-increasing layer, the packaging cap structure comprises a lower cap and an upper cap, the lower cap is arranged on the readout circuit substrate and is provided with a lower release hole, the upper cap is arranged on the lower cap and is provided with an upper release hole, the upper release hole and the lower release hole are located above the bridge pier, the upper release hole and the lower release hole are completely staggered and communicated in the horizontal direction, the sealing reflection-increasing layer covers the upper cap and seals the upper release hole, one upper release hole and the lower release hole are in a corresponding relation with the bridge pier, and the upper release hole is located between the two lower release holes on the projection of the upper direction and the lower direction.

title_en: Preparation method of MEMS structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an MEMS structure, which comprises the steps of preparing a substrate, growing a piezoelectric layer on the front surface of the substrate, bonding a base on the surface of the piezoelectric layer far away from the substrate by adopting a temporary bonding process, reducing the thickness of the substrate by adopting a thinning process, preparing a substrate and penetrating the substrate to form a back cavity, connecting the substrate on the surface of the substrate far away from the piezoelectric layer, providing a vibration space for a vibrating diaphragm by the back cavity, and finally removing the base by adopting a de-bonding process. The method converts a wafer-level back cavity etching process with high difficulty into a relatively simple and flexible plate-level processing process. The method not only avoids the damage possibly caused by directly etching on the fragile substrate-piezoelectric layer structure, thereby improving the product yield, but also enables the processing of the back cavity to be independently and parallelly carried out, greatly shortens the whole production period and improves the manufacturing efficiency.

title_en: MXene/TiO2/ZnIn2S4Ternary integrated heterojunction, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of nano material heterojunction, and particularly relates to an MXene/TiO  2 /ZnIn 2 S 4  ternary integrated heterojunction, a preparation method and application thereof. The MXene/TiO  2 /ZnIn 2 S 4  ternary integration heterojunction comprises a substrate, an intermediate layer and an outer layer, wherein the substrate is a two-dimensional MXene nano-sheet, the intermediate layer is TiO  2  nano-particles, the outer layer is a ZnIn  2 S 4  nano-sheet, a metal-semiconductor interface is formed between the two-dimensional MXene nano-sheet and the TiO  2  nano-particles, and a semiconductor hetero-interface is formed between the TiO  2  nano-particles and the ZnIn  2 S 4  nano-sheet. The MXene/TiO  2 /ZnIn 2 S 4  heterojunction provided by the application has excellent gas selectivity to triethylamine, high response value, high recovery speed, excellent performance in long-term stability, moisture interference resistance and the like, and has wide application prospect in actual production.

title_en: Co-sputtering alloy film, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a co-sputtering alloy film, a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of extreme ultraviolet mask absorbing materials, and relates to a method for preparing a Pt-W alloy film by magnetron sputtering and related application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: designing a three-layer structure according to the combination capability and etching capability of the film, namely an upper layer of Pt, a middle layer of Pt-W alloy and a lower layer of W three-layer film system, and installing a Pt target and a W target on a magnetron sputtering system; and preparing a co-sputtering Pt-W alloy film on the substrate by adopting a double-target magnetron sputtering co-sputtering method, wherein the co-sputtering Pt-W alloy film is calculated to design the element proportion. The invention provides a scheme for developing a novel extreme ultraviolet mask absorption layer.

title_en: In SiO form2In-situ construction method of solid-state battery electrolyte layer with aerogel as matrix
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of solid-state battery electrolytes, in particular to an in-situ construction method of a solid-state battery electrolyte layer taking SiO  2  aerogel as a matrix. The preparation method comprises the steps of preparing a SiO  2  sol precursor solution from a silicon source, a solvent, deionized water and a catalyst, introducing the SiO  2  sol precursor solution onto a substrate to obtain a wet gel substrate, ageing and heat treating the wet gel substrate to form a SiO  2  aerogel three-dimensional solid framework in situ, laminating or winding to assemble a battery core, injecting lithium ion battery electrolyte, discharging air and performing infiltration treatment, and ageing the battery core at normal temperature to obtain a solid electrolyte layer. According to the invention, through liquid phase chemical synthesis in the battery electrode, the SiO  2  aerogel structure with the three-dimensional nano porous network is generated in situ, and is used as an electrolyte matrix, so that the interface contact between the electrode and the electrolyte is fundamentally improved, the interface impedance of the solid-state battery is reduced, and the cycling stability is improved.

title_en: Preparation method of oxygen-doped serrated graphene nanoribbon
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of an oxygen doped serrated graphene nanoribbon, and belongs to the technical field of nanomaterials. Preparing Jin Shanjing substrate, evaporating 1,5-dibromonaphthalene-2,6-diol precursor molecules and depositing on a gold monocrystal substrate to obtain the substrate and a two-dimensional DBNDO self-assembled network structure deposited on the substrate, controlling the temperature of the DBBPA self-assembled structure on the substrate and the gold monocrystal substrate to be 25-30 ℃ in the deposition process, heating the substrate and the DBNDO self-assembled network structure deposited on the substrate to a growth temperature for the first time, preserving heat, and annealing to obtain the products after the Ullmann reaction and dehydrocyclization reaction. The method provides a new idea for accurately preparing the oxygen-doped serrated graphene nanoribbon, and has high scientific research value and application potential.

title_en: Ru-NiCoP/NF self-supporting electrode and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a Ru-NiCoP/NF self-supporting electrode, a preparation method and application thereof. The Ru-NiCoP/NF self-supporting electrode takes foam nickel as a matrix, ruthenium-doped nickel cobalt phosphide loaded on the foam nickel as an active component, the ruthenium-doped nickel cobalt phosphide is a three-dimensional composite nano structure with sea urchin-shaped morphology, ru in the ruthenium-doped nickel cobalt phosphide comprises two valence states of Ru  3+  and Ru  0 , ni exists in the valence state of Ni  2+ , and Co comprises two valence states of Co  2+  and Co  3+ . The Ru-NiCoP/NF self-supporting electrode has good catalytic activity in the hydrogen evolution reaction and oxygen evolution reaction processes, and can be used for water electrolysis.

title_en: Full-solution inverted quantum dot light-emitting diode based on green light ZnSeTe quantum dot material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-solution inverted quantum dot light-emitting diode based on green light ZnSeTe quantum dot materials and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of quantum dot light-emitting diodes. The light-emitting diode is sequentially provided with an ITO cathode, a double-layer electron transmission layer, a quantum dot luminescent layer, a hole transmission layer and an anode in a lamination mode from bottom to top, wherein the quantum dot luminescent layer consists of green light ZnSeTe quantum dots, and the surfaces of the green light ZnSeTe quantum dots are combined with inorganic short-chain ligands NH  4 PF 6 . According to the invention, the green light ZnSeTe quantum dot is treated by adopting the inorganic short-chain ligand NH  4 PF 6  to serve as a quantum dot luminescent layer, and the luminescent layer is used for preparing the full-solution inverted quantum dot luminescent diode, so that the luminescent diode has excellent electroluminescent performance.

title_en: Method for preparing graphical atomic-scale nano structure with accurate positioning and minimum size by solution method with high flux and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing a precisely positioned graphical atomic-scale nano structure with extremely small size by a solution method with high flux and application thereof. The method comprises the step of printing on a substrate by adopting a solution method, wherein ink adopted in printing is a solution of a block copolymer, and the mass volume concentration of the solution of the block copolymer is 0.5 mg/mL-150 mg/mL. The high-flux prepared accurate positioning large-area, multi-class monolithic integration multi-dimensional nano oriented graphical atomic-scale nano structure has nano-scale precision and highly ordered structural arrangement. The short channel transistor constructed by the large-area multi-dimensional nano directional patterned atomic-scale nano junction has higher carrier mobility and lower threshold voltage, and provides a method for application scientific research and industrialization of the self-assembled advanced nano lithography.

title_en: System and method for measuring reaction rate of nano single particles based on optical surface wave dark field imaging
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of heterogeneous reaction kinetics research of nano-particles, in particular to a system and a method for measuring the reaction rate of nano-single particles based on optical surface wave dark field imaging. The method comprises the steps of preparing a nano single particle sample, adjusting the humidity of the environment where the nano single particle is located, starting heterogeneous reaction of the nano single particle, carrying out in-situ dark field imaging on the nano single particle in the reaction process, collecting scattered bright spot imaging data under different reaction times and different humidity, and inverting the reaction rate of the nano single particle based on the collected imaging data and a dynamics model. The invention can solve the defects existing in the existing nanoparticle reaction rate measurement technology, and can accurately measure and invert the reaction rate of single particles with the level as low as 50 nanometers in the heterogeneous reaction process under the condition of high humidity standard atmospheric pressure.

title_en: Carbon material, preparation method and application thereof, and sodium ion battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carbon material, a preparation method and application thereof and a sodium ion battery, the carbon material comprises a first matrix and a second carbon layer, wherein the first matrix is disordered carbon, and the second carbon layer is fibrous carbon. The preparation method of the carbon material comprises the steps of (1) carrying out activation treatment on petroleum coke, (2) carrying out treatment on an activation treatment product, drying to obtain a material A, (3) uniformly mixing the material A with hydrocarbon compounds, carrying out first heat treatment, separating, washing and drying to obtain a material B, and (4) carrying out second heat treatment on the material B to obtain the carbon material. The invention realizes that the carbon material which has high reversible specific capacity and high multiplying power performance and is suitable for being used as the negative electrode material of the sodium ion battery is obtained by taking the petroleum coke with low price as the raw material through a simple process.

title_en: Iron porphyrin microporous organic polymer loaded copper cluster composite material, synthesis method thereof and application thereof in detection of hydrogen sulfide and organophosphorus pesticides
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of chemical analysis and detection, and particularly relates to an iron porphyrin microporous organic polymer loaded copper cluster composite material, a synthesis method thereof and application thereof in detection of hydrogen sulfide and organophosphorus pesticides. Zinc nitrate hexahydrate, 2-methylimidazole, 1, 4-diiodobenzene, 5,10,15, 20-tetra (4-ethynylphenyl) porphyrin, ferric chloride hexahydrate, copper nitrate trihydrate, histidine, ascorbic Acid (AA), methanol and N, N-dimethylformamide are used as raw materials for reaction, and the iron porphyrin microporous organic polymer loaded copper cluster composite material is obtained. The method has the advantages of simplicity, low cost, universality and easiness in large-scale production.

title_en: Nitrogen-doped hard carbon negative electrode material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-activity nitrogen-doped hard carbon negative electrode material and a preparation method thereof, which are used for obtaining high specific capacity, solving the problem of low initial coulomb efficiency of the existing hard carbon, and the prepared product has good conductivity and high activity, is used as a lithium ion battery and has the characteristics of high ① specific capacity, 190-260 mAh/g and the initial coulomb efficiency of ③ being more than 80 percent.

title_en: Rare earth 1235 aluminum alloy material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rare earth 1235 aluminum alloy material and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of alloy materials. According to the invention, the Sc and Zr are added together to improve the strength and the elongation of the 1235 aluminum alloy, meanwhile, the 1235 aluminum alloy can keep higher strength at high temperature without softening, the problems of Sc/Zr segregation and coarse phases are solved by combining heat treatment and deformation treatment, the elements are homogenized and the coarse phases are dissolved by the heat treatment, the residual phases are crushed by the subsequent deformation treatment, defects of high-density dislocation and the like are introduced, and the defects provide diffuse nucleation points for the nanoscale Al  3  (Sc, zr) phase in final aging, so that a uniform, stable and tough microstructure is obtained, and the rare earth 1235 aluminum alloy material with excellent thermal stability and mechanical property is obtained.

title_en: Flexible touch sensor based on filling structure and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of bionic touch, in particular to a flexible touch sensor based on a filling structure and a preparation method thereof. The flexible touch sensor comprises a flexible layer, a liquid filler, an induction group and an encapsulation film, wherein the flexible layer is provided with a containing groove, the liquid filler is arranged in the containing groove, the induction group is arranged on the side wall of the containing groove and comprises a first fiber Bragg grating and a second fiber Bragg grating, the first fiber Bragg grating and the second fiber Bragg grating are symmetrically arranged on the two side walls of the containing groove, and the encapsulation film is used for encapsulating the liquid filler and the induction group. In the embodiment, the micro accommodating groove is arranged on the flexible layer for filling liquid, so that the flexibility and the sensor laminating performance can be improved, the fiber bragg gratings are symmetrically arranged in the accommodating groove, the lateral pressure is two opposite strains, the temperature influence is eliminated through differential treatment, and the constant cooling and the thermal diffusion stabilizing effect on the sensing cavity under the dynamic environment can be realized.

title_en: Intelligent micro-clamping system, construction method and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of micro-operation and intelligent sensing cross equipment, in particular to an intelligent micro-clamping system, a construction method and a control method thereof. The intelligent micro-clamping system comprises a liquid metal pressure sensor, a clamp holder, an electromagnetic driving device and a controller. The liquid metal pressure sensor is used for sensing the pressure of an object in real time. The holder includes a plurality of jaws. The electromagnetic drive is used to generate a directional magnetic field and provide a constant current. The clamp holder drives each clamping jaw to open outwards to a maximum angle through the shape memory compound under the action of the directional magnetic field, and drives each clamping jaw to bend inwards to close to the same point after the resistance wire is heated to a temperature higher than the glass transition temperature through constant current and the magnetic field is removed. The controller is used for controlling the clamp holder to execute clamping and releasing actions. The intelligent micro-clamping system provided by the invention can realize real-time sensing of the pressure born by the article and realize lossless clamping of the article as far as possible when clamping the article.

title_en: Method for preparing multilayer graphene film by double-sided rolling and multilayer graphene film
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a graphene film, in particular to a method for preparing a multilayer graphene film by double-sided rolling. The invention discloses a method for preparing a multilayer graphene film by double-sided rolling, which comprises the following steps of (1) alternately winding a metal substrate and a flexible porous isolation material around a winding core, (2) carrying out high-temperature annealing on the metal substrate/the flexible porous isolation material by using reducing gas, (3) synchronously carrying out primary layer graphene film growth on two sides of the metal substrate under the condition of low pressure by introducing carbon source gas/reducing gas mixed gas after the annealing is finished, (4) etching the graphene film on two sides of the metal substrate by introducing oxidizing gas after the primary layer graphene film growth is finished, (5) carrying out growth of the graphene film by introducing carbon source gas/reducing gas mixed gas after the etching is finished, and (6) repeating the steps (4) and (5) for N times to obtain the graphene film with an n+2 layer.

title_en: Cobalt/lanthanum hydroxide heterojunction-loaded porous carbon nanofiber electrocatalyst and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a porous carbon nanofiber electrocatalyst for loading cobalt/lanthanum hydroxide heterojunction and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of adding 4, 4-diaminodiphenyl ether and pyromellitic dianhydride into a solvent, and uniformly mixing to prepare polyamic acid precursor spinning solution; the preparation method comprises the steps of carrying out electrostatic spinning on the prepared polyamic acid precursor spinning solution to obtain polyamic acid nanofiber, immersing the prepared polyamic acid nanofiber in a mixed metal salt solution containing cobalt salt, lanthanum salt and zinc salt to obtain a polyamic acid nanofiber precursor loaded with metal ions, carrying out program heating heat treatment on the prepared polyamic acid nanofiber precursor loaded with metal ions in a protective atmosphere to obtain the porous carbon nanofiber electrocatalyst loaded with cobalt/lanthanum hydroxide heterojunction, wherein the prepared porous carbon nanofiber electrocatalyst loaded with cobalt/lanthanum hydroxide heterojunction has excellent electrochemical oxygen reduction reaction and oxygen precipitation reaction dual-function catalytic activity.

title_en: Integrated neutral atom regulation and control device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides an integrated neutral atom regulation and control device and method, comprising a vacuum cavity, a super-surface module and a light processing module, wherein the super-surface module is arranged at the inner side wall of the vacuum cavity, the light processing module is arranged at the lower end of the vacuum cavity, the light processing module is used for carrying out light splitting reflection on incident cooling light to obtain conical reflected light and providing a stepped magnetic field to generate cold atomic groups, the super-surface module is positioned at the same vertical height of a conical point of the conical reflected light, dipole trap light vertically incident on the outer side of the vacuum cavity is converted into an optical array after passing through the super-surface module, the cold atomic groups are captured through the optical array to obtain a captured atomic array, and atoms in the captured atomic array are regulated and controlled in position.

title_en: Composite silicon-carbon negative electrode material, negative electrode piece and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composite silicon-carbon negative electrode material, a negative electrode plate and a preparation method thereof, which belong to the technical field of lithium batteries, and the preparation method comprises the steps of firstly adopting graphene oxide and a secondary granulating silicon-carbon negative electrode material to disperse under the ice bath condition, then preparing a Si/C@GO composite material by spray drying, adding polyethylenimine and the like, stirring, cooling and centrifuging under the oil bath condition to obtain the Si/C@GO/HPEI composite material, and finally adding an adhesive ammonium polyacrylate and a conductive agent to coat and dry to obtain the composite material; according to the preparation method of the integrated negative electrode based on graphene oxide coating, polyethyleneimine grafting and binder in-situ crosslinking, the prepared composite silicon-carbon negative electrode material has the performances of high initial efficiency and long cycle life, the initial charge-discharge efficiency of the material is more than 90%, the initial reversible capacity of the material reaches 1550mAh/g, and the capacity retention rate of the material is 90% after the material is circulated for 200 circles under the current density of 3.0A/g.

title_en: Use of Cu-NPs as Alternaria solani bacteriostat
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of Cu-NPs as Alternaria solani bacteriostat. The concentration of the Cu-NPs is 100 mug.mL  ‑1 . The Cu-NPs of the invention have low production cost, safety and simple application and operation method, and experiments prove that the Cu-NPs have broad-spectrum inhibition activity on plant pathogenic fungi, the Cu-NPs have optimal antibacterial effect at the concentration of 100 mug.mL  ‑1 , and the antibacterial effect is superior to that of a broad-spectrum bactericide, namely thiophanate methyl. 100. The Cu-NPs solution of mug.mL  ‑1  has a bacteriostasis rate of 85% on Alternaria solani which is a pathogenic bacterium of the tomato early blight.

title_en: Drug-loaded nano-particle and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a drug-loaded nanoparticle and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the drug-loaded nanoparticle comprises an active ingredient and a carrier, the active ingredient comprises a hydrophobic small molecule inhibitor and PAEMA, the carrier comprises an amphiphilic polymer bonded with a photosensitizer, the amphiphilic polymer bonded with the photosensitizer is coated with the hydrophobic small molecule inhibitor and PAEMA, and the amphiphilic polymer bonded with the photosensitizer comprises the photosensitizer, a hydrophilic chain segment and a hydrophobic chain segment. The invention realizes accurate drug delivery through the characteristic transformation of the nano-carrier driven by tumor acidity, not only can clear M2 type macrophages and induce dendritic cells to mature, but also can kill tumor cells, thereby enhancing the synergistic anti-tumor effect of photodynamic therapy and immunotherapy. Furthermore, the invention can accurately deliver various medicines to target cells with different spatial distributions, thereby enhancing cell killing energy level and antigen presenting cell mediated immune activity.

title_en: Preparation method and application of uracil modified gold nanoconjugate
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of biological medicine, and provides a preparation method and application of uracil modified gold nanoconjugate, wherein the method comprises the following steps of slowly adding uracil ligand solution into gold precursor solution in the presence of a reducing agent for controlled reduction reaction to form gold nanoconjugate with average particle size less than or equal to 2 nm; and adding a sulfhydrylation uracil derivative into the dispersion liquid of the gold nano conjugate, and regulating the pH of a reaction system to be alkaline, so that the sulfhydrylation uracil derivative is combined on the surface of the gold nano conjugate through an Au-S bond to obtain the uracil modified gold nano conjugate. The material has the characteristics of ultra-small size, pH responsive surface and pathogenic bacteria selective uptake, can efficiently penetrate periodontal biological membranes, and can realize efficient removal and virulence blocking of periodontal pathogenic bacteria by interfering bacterial proton motive force and inhibiting virulence factor secretion.

title_en: Band gap film structure device and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a band gap thin film structure device and a preparation method thereof, wherein the band gap thin film structure device comprises a substrate; the silicon nitride device comprises a substrate, a first silicon nitride layer, a second silicon nitride layer and a third silicon nitride layer, wherein the first silicon nitride layer is formed on the first surface of the substrate, the first silicon nitride layer is formed on the sacrificial layer and is parallel to the substrate, the first silicon nitride layer is provided with a continuous and step-free plane, the first silicon nitride layer comprises a band gap film region and an outer periphery surrounding the band gap film region, the surface of the first silicon nitride layer is provided with band gap holes which are arranged periodically, release holes are formed around each band gap hole, the band gap holes and the release holes are distributed in the band gap film region, the band gap holes and the release holes are used for etching the sacrificial layer between the substrate and the band gap film region, the central area of the band gap film region is provided with a defect region, the defect region is not provided with the band gap holes, the second silicon nitride layer is formed on a second surface of the substrate opposite to the first surface, a cavity in which the band gap film region is suspended is formed between the band gap film region and the first surface, and the outer periphery is supported by an unetched part of the sacrificial layer.

title_en: High-purity nickel powder prepared by controlling flow in plant polyphenol field, system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses high-purity nickel powder prepared by controlling flow in a plant polyphenol field, a system and a method, wherein a biological base system of sulfonated tannic acid-gallic acid is used as a reduction-stabilizing agent, and green and efficient preparation of nickel nano powder is realized by the synergistic effect of a three-stage gradient continuous flow reactor and a double-frequency ultrasonic-pulse microwave-nitrogen bubbling multi-physical field. The total residence time of the reaction is 25.1-37.7min, mother liquor is recycled after salt separation treatment (nanofiltration desalination of a NiSO  4  system and ion exchange Cl-removal of a NiCl  2  system), the discharge amount of waste water is greatly reduced compared with that of the traditional process, the surface oxygen content of the product is less than or equal to 0.9wt percent, PDI is less than or equal to 0.15, tap density is less than or equal to 4.0g/cm  3 , the GB/T33828-2017 standard is met, and the method can be used in the high-end fields of lithium ion batteries and the like, and the green industrial production of nano nickel powder is realized from the source.

title_en: Hexagonal hydroxyapatite, synthesis method thereof and application of hexagonal hydroxyapatite in groundwater remediation
abstract_en: S1, preparing raw materials, namely taking high-calcium leaching solution as a calcium source, wherein the concentration of Ca  2+  in the leaching solution is more than or equal to 500mg/L, adding soluble phosphate into the leaching solution, and synthesizing a hydroxyapatite precursor through coprecipitation reaction; S2, regulating the magnetocaloric crystal form, namely uniformly mixing magnetic nano particles into the hydroxyapatite precursor, and heating the system to 40-80 ℃ by utilizing the magnetocaloric effect excited by an alternating magnetic field to obtain the hexagonal hydroxyapatite. The application prepares the hexagonal system hydroxyapatite by a high-efficiency low-cost synthesis method based on the magnetocaloric regulation of the crystal form of the hydroxyapatite, improves the capability of neutralizing acidic wastewater and adsorbing heavy metals of the hydroxyapatite, and realizes the in-situ restoration of mining area groundwater.

title_en: In (In)2O3-ZnIn2S4Nano heterogeneous composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an In  2 O 3 -ZnIn 2 S 4  nanometer heterogeneous composite material, a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the composite material comprises the steps of mixing an indium source and terephthalic acid In an organic solvent, heating In an oil bath, carrying out solid-liquid separation on a reaction mixture to obtain a solid phase, carrying out heating calcination on the dried solid phase In an inert atmosphere to obtain an In  2 O 3  sample, dissolving the obtained In  2 O 3  sample In water, adding a zinc source, the indium source and thioacetamide to obtain a mixed solution, heating In the oil bath, and carrying out solid-liquid separation on the reaction mixture to obtain the solid phase to obtain the In  2 O 3 -ZnIn 2 S 4  nano heterogeneous composite material. The unique heterogeneous interface construction accelerates the sodium ion transmission kinetics, and endows the material with reversible specific capacity (1000 mA/g) as high as 417.6 mAh/g. The three-dimensional nano-sheet network structure effectively buffers the volume expansion effect in the charge-discharge process, and the capacity retention rate reaches 95% after 160 cycles. The bimetal synergism optimizes the electron conduction path, and the specific capacity of 320.6mAh/g is still kept under the high current density of 8000 mA/g.

title_en: High-speed steel for continuous rolling roller, preparation method of high-speed steel and continuous rolling roller
abstract_en: The invention relates to high-speed steel for a continuous rolling roller, a preparation method thereof and the continuous rolling roller, in particular to the high-speed steel field, wherein the high-speed steel for the continuous rolling roller comprises, by mass, 1.5-2.2% of C, 0.4-1.2% of Si, 0.4-1.2% of Mn, 4-8% of Cr, less than or equal to 1% of Ni, 3-7% of Mo, 3-7% of V, less than or equal to 1.5% of W, less than or equal to 2.5% of Co, and the balance of iron and unavoidable impurities. The high-speed steel for the continuous rolling roller ensures that the roller material has excellent mechanical property and processing property by precisely controlling the content and proportion of the elements, so that when the high-speed steel is used as a roller, the roller has the advantages of high hardness, high wear resistance and high strength, the service life of the roller can be prolonged, the replacement frequency of the roller is reduced, the rolling efficiency is improved, and meanwhile, the quality and the precision of a rolled product are ensured.

title_en: Method for preparing palladium nano-film hydrogen sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing a palladium nano-film hydrogen sensor, and belongs to the field of sensor preparation. A method for preparing a palladium nano-film hydrogen sensor comprises the following steps of firstly, carrying out surface pretreatment on an aluminum sheet, secondly, carrying out electrochemical polishing on the aluminum sheet, thirdly, carrying out primary oxidation on the aluminum sheet, fourthly, carrying out secondary oxidation on the aluminum sheet, forming a regular porous alumina layer on the surface of the aluminum sheet, fifthly, carrying out reaming experiments on the porous alumina layer, sixthly, removing an aluminum substrate layer and a barrier layer and taking out a film, namely, carrying out film coating through electron beam evaporation equipment, and eighth, carrying out preparation of microelectrodes, and then completing electrical connection and encapsulation.

title_en: Method for preparing high-stability Pd-based flexible carbon nanofiber membrane catalyst by using femtosecond laser
abstract_en: A method for preparing a high-stability Pd-based flexible carbon nanofiber membrane catalyst by using femtosecond laser belongs to the technical field of nano material preparation. Firstly, carrying out acid leaching pretreatment on a carbon nanofiber membrane, then soaking the carbon nanofiber membrane in a solution containing Pd  2+ , and carrying out vacuum drying to obtain the Pd  2+  -loaded carbon nanofiber membrane. Finally, through quick scanning and direct writing of femtosecond laser, pd  2+  is reduced on the surface of the carbon nanofiber membrane in a nano particle form, and the Pd-based flexible carbon nanofiber membrane catalyst is obtained. The preparation method provided by the invention has the characteristics of simplicity in operation, high-efficiency processing, accurate control and the like. The Pd-based flexible carbon nanofiber membrane catalyst prepared by the method has excellent catalytic activity, greatly improves catalytic stability and durability in the application of ethanol catalytic oxidation reaction, and has potential application prospects in the fields of catalysis, energy storage and the like.

title_en: Pathological blood-brain barrier targeting nano-preparation for treating Alzheimer's disease and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pathological blood brain barrier targeting nano preparation for treating Alzheimer's disease and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of biological medicine, wherein nano particles formed by assembling amphiphilic block copolymers are used as carriers, RAP peptide and RGD peptide are co-modified on the surfaces of the nano preparation, and the RAP peptide can specifically identify and combine with RAGE receptors which are highly expressed by vascular endothelial cells in pathological states, thereby not only realizing accurate targeting, but also having the activity of blocking RAGE-AB pathological pathways; RGD peptide is used as an integrin binding motif, the endocytosis efficiency of nanoparticles can be obviously enhanced through the interaction with a cell surface integrin receptor, the transportation of the nanoparticles to lysosomes after endocytosis is promoted, and the nanoparticles can be efficiently targeted to diseased cerebrovascular endothelium expressing RAGE and can be effectively internalized and guided to lysosomes through the synergistic effect of two ligands, so that the degradation of RAGE proteins is enhanced by means of lysosome pathways while targeted drug delivery is realized, and the active intervention of key pathological pathways is realized.

title_en: Nitrogen-doped carbon nano tube material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nitrogen-doped carbon nanotube material and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the field of nitrogen-doped carbon nanotube materials, in particular to a preparation method of nitrogen-doped carbon nanotube material by using nitrogen-containing organic polymer polyurethane as a carbon source and adopting a chemical vapor deposition method and high-temperature catalysis of a catalyst; the carbon nanotube material prepared by the invention is multi-wall carbon nanotubes composed of coaxial tube walls, bamboo-like carbon nanotubes, squamous carbon nanotubes, branch-like carbon nanotubes and the like, wherein the centers of the bamboo-like carbon nanotubes are divided into closed cavities; can be used as reinforcing material, energy storage material, novel electronic probe, electronic device, sensor material, stealth material, catalyst carrier, etc.

title_en: Negative electrode material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a negative electrode material and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the negative electrode material comprises a nano silicon composite material and a carbon coating layer coated on the surface of the nano silicon composite material, the nano silicon composite material comprises a porous matrix and nano silicon particles deposited in pores of the porous matrix, the porous matrix is formed by compounding a high-temperature resistant polymer and a conductive material, the high-temperature resistant polymer is polybenzimidazole and derivatives thereof, the conductive material comprises one or more of graphene, carbon nano tubes, conductive carbon black, porous carbon, carbon nanohorns and nano diamonds, and the negative electrode material is used in a lithium ion battery.

title_en: Flaky NaY molecular sieve and synthesis method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a flaky NaY molecular sieve, wherein the number of flaky NaY molecular sieves accounts for 40% -99% based on 100% of the total number of octahedral crystal grains and flaky crystal grains of the NaY molecular sieve. The conventional NaY molecular sieve presents an octahedral morphology, has larger grain size and too long and narrow micropore channels, and has insufficient catalytic capability on macromolecular reactants. Compared with the prior art, the flaky NaY molecular sieve provided by the invention has a flaky structure, the external specific surface area and the pore volume are more abundant, and the NaY molecular sieve with the flaky structure has smaller grain size, particularly has extremely short diffusion paths in certain crystal face directions, so that the macromolecular reactant has good diffusion performance on the inner surface, large external specific surface area and more active sites distributed on the outer surface, and the active sites are easy to access, so that the molecular sieve has high catalytic efficiency, strong carbon deposition resistance and stable catalytic activity.

title_en: High-strength high-thermal-stability low-coercivity ultrafine-grain high-entropy alloy and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an ultrafine grain high-entropy alloy with high strength, high thermal stability and low coercivity and a preparation method thereof, wherein the ultrafine grain high-entropy alloy is Fe  x Co y Ni z Ta h B i , x is more than or equal to 20 and less than or equal to 40, y is more than or equal to 20 and less than or equal to 40, z is more than or equal to 20 and less than or equal to 50, h is more than or equal to 0<h and less than or equal to 10, i is more than or equal to 0<i and less than or equal to 10, x, y, z, h and i are atomic parts, the ultrafine grain high-entropy alloy comprises a first nano-sized precipitation phase and a second nano-sized precipitation phase, the first nano-sized precipitation phase is a magnetic precipitation phase, the size of the first nano-sized precipitation phase is 5-30 nm, the second nano-sized precipitation phase is a magnetic precipitation phase, and the size of the second nano-sized precipitation phase is 80-155 nm. The yield strength of the superfine crystal high-entropy alloy exceeds 1500MPa, the coercive force is lower than 600A/m, and the performance is stable after exposure at 600 ℃ for 100 hours. The invention can obtain the superfine crystal soft magnetic high-entropy alloy with high strength, high thermal stability and lower coercivity, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Efficient preparation method of nano silicon dioxide based on biomass power plant ash
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-efficiency preparation method of nano silicon dioxide based on biomass power plant ash. The method comprises the steps of firstly crushing, sieving and drying ash of a biomass power plant, then adding HCl solution with concentration not exceeding 5mol/L according to the solid-to-liquid ratio of 1:8-1:10, heating and refluxing at a constant temperature, performing suction filtration and drying to obtain acid pretreatment ash, mixing the acid pretreatment ash with NaOH solid according to the mass ratio of 1:0.6-1:1.4, activating at a high temperature to obtain alkali fusion ash, adding NaOH solution with concentration not exceeding 5mol/L into the alkali fusion ash according to the solid-to-liquid ratio of 1:8-1:10, heating and refluxing at a constant temperature, performing suction filtration to obtain water glass solution, finally, introducing CO  2  into the water glass solution in a constant-temperature water bath kettle for a period of time, aging for 0-72 hours under normal temperature, performing suction filtration and drying to obtain nano silicon dioxide. The invention takes the waste biomass ash as the raw material, has low cost and simple process, and the prepared nano silicon dioxide has high purity and high extraction rate, thereby realizing the utilization of waste resources and reducing the preparation cost of the nano silicon dioxide.

title_en: Silicon-based flexible semitransparent short-wave infrared photoelectric detector and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a silicon-based flexible semitransparent short-wave infrared photoelectric detector and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of photoelectric detection. The photoelectric detector comprises a bottom electrode layer, a silicon hole layer and a top metal film layer which are sequentially laminated, wherein the bottom electrode layer and the silicon hole layer form ohmic contact, the top metal film layer and the silicon hole layer form Schottky contact, and good flexibility is endowed to the photoelectric detector by controlling the thickness of the silicon hole layer, so that the photoelectric detector is suitable for flexible electronic applications such as bendable or attached surfaces. Meanwhile, through penetrating hole structures with different sizes and densities are introduced into the silicon film, so that the optical transmittance of the silicon layer is improved, the mechanical integrity of the silicon layer is not obviously weakened, and a feasible path is provided for constructing a transparent and flexible photoelectric device. In addition, by designing an unordered micro-nano structure on the surface of the silicon hole structure, the optical absorptivity and responsivity of the device can be effectively improved by promoting surface plasmon excitation.

title_en: System and method for preparing single-walled carbon nanotubes by magnetic field assisted plasma CVD, single-walled carbon nanotubes and battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for preparing single-walled carbon nanotubes by magnetic field assisted plasma CVD, the single-walled carbon nanotubes and a battery, and relates to the technical field of materials. The system comprises a plasma evaporation unit, a magnetic field screening unit and a CVD growth unit which are sequentially communicated, wherein the magnetic field screening unit comprises a magnetic field screening cavity, a temperature regulating and controlling component and a magnetic field generating component, the magnetic field screening unit is arranged between the plasma evaporation unit and the CVD growth unit, and is used for screening catalyst particles through magnetic field application and temperature control, the unit is used for selectively screening out large-particle-diameter catalyst particles, retaining small-particle-diameter catalyst particles, accurately regulating and controlling the particle size distribution of the catalyst particles, reducing the defect density and ash content of single-wall carbon nanotubes from the source, breaking through the bottleneck of the traditional process in the mass preparation of single-wall carbon nanotubes, and remarkably improving the purity and structural consistency of products.

title_en: In2S3Preparation and application of nanosheets
abstract_en: The invention discloses preparation and application of an In  2 S 3  nano sheet, and belongs to the field of thin film battery materials. The preparation method comprises the steps of dissolving thioacetamide and indium trichloride In a solvent to prepare an In  2 S 3  precursor solution, spin-coating a film on a TiO  2  nano particle film, performing heat treatment under the protection of inert gas to obtain an In  2 S 3  nano sheet array film, adding InCl  3 ·4H 2  O, cuI and thiourea into N, N-dimethylformamide, mixing and stirring, dropwise adding and spin-coating the InCl  3 ·4H 2  O, cuI and thiourea on the In  2 S 3  nano sheet array film to obtain a CuInS  2  precursor film, performing heat treatment on the CuInS  2  precursor film to obtain an In  2 S 3 /CuInS 2  inorganic heterojunction, spin-coating a Spiro-OMeTAD solution on the In  2 S 3 /CuInS 2  inorganic heterojunction, performing heat treatment to obtain a Spiro-OMeTAD film, and depositing a metal electrode on the Spiro-OMeTAD film by vapor deposition.

title_en: Preparation method of high-purity nano zinc oxide
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of solid waste recycling and nano material preparation, in particular to a preparation method of high-purity nano zinc oxide. Zinc is recovered by adopting a sulfuric acid-ascorbic acid system wet leaching process, and leaching efficiency is improved by an ultrasonic strengthening technology. On the basis of optimizing leaching conditions, a two-stage impurity removal strategy (H  2 O 2  oxidation-alkali precipitation+ammonium persulfate fine impurity removal) is adopted to remove iron, aluminum and manganese, so that a high-purity zinc sulfate solution is obtained. Then, preparing nano zinc oxide by using an ammonium bicarbonate precipitation method, and examining the influence of a roasting process on the quality of the product. Finally, the nano zinc oxide with the purity reaching 98.89 percent is prepared, the quality of the nano zinc oxide reaches the national standard, and an effective technical scheme is provided for the recycling of zinc-containing dust.

title_en: Flexible signal transmission structure
abstract_en: The application discloses a flexible signal transmission structure. The flexible signal transmission structure comprises a substrate and a micro-coaxial transmission structure, wherein the micro-coaxial transmission structure comprises an outer conductor, a support body and an inner conductor. According to the application, the plurality of first stress release grooves are formed in the substrate, the orthographic projection of the outer conductor of the micro-coaxial transmission structure on the substrate is overlapped with the orthographic projection of the plurality of first stress release grooves on the substrate, so that the outer conductor corresponds to the arrangement positions of the plurality of first stress release grooves, and meanwhile, the second stress release grooves are formed in the outer conductor of the micro-coaxial transmission structure, the consistency of the distribution directions of the two stress release grooves is ensured, and a multi-layer and synergistic stress dispersion system is constructed. The design ensures that the substrate and the micro coaxial transmission structure can synchronously and effectively absorb and disperse stress when bearing external deformation, thereby not only improving the durability and the reliability of the flexible signal transmission structure, but also ensuring the stability and the integrity of the flexible signal transmission structure in high-frequency signal transmission.

title_en: Boron and vanadium-containing composite microalloyed cold-rolled ultra-deep drawing high-strength steel and production method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of metal materials, and particularly relates to a boron and vanadium-containing composite microalloyed cold-rolled ultra-deep drawing high-strength steel and a production method thereof, wherein the steel comprises the following chemical components in percentage by mass of ：C：0.03%~0.08%;Si：0.1%～0.3%;Mn：1.2%～1.8%;P≤0.02%;S≤0.01%;Al：0.02%~0.06%;B：0.001%～0.005%;V：0.05%～0.15%;N≤0.005%;, V=0.0067-0.1, and the balance of Fe and unavoidable impurities. The method has the advantages that the method adopts the composite microalloying of boron and vanadium, the hardenability and the grain boundary strengthening effect of the steel are improved by the boron, and the fine dispersed carbonitride formed by the vanadium realizes precipitation strengthening and grain refinement, and the two are synergistic, so that the steel has high strength and good deep drawing performance.

title_en: Ultra-thick austenitic stainless steel plate for fusion reactor loop pipeline, manufacturing and welding method
abstract_en: An ultra-thick austenitic stainless steel plate for a fusion reactor loop pipeline, a manufacturing and welding method, comprises the following components in percentage by weight: c:0.05% -0.06%, si:1.6% -2.1%, mn:6.0% -7.0%, P is less than or equal to 0.015%, S is less than or equal to 0.002%, cr:11.5% -12.5%, ni:11.5% -12.5%, mo:4.0% -5.0%, V:0.15% -0.25%, nb:0.10% -0.15%, B:0.0015% -0.0025%, al:0.5% -1.5%, Y:0.3% -0.4%, zr:0.45% -0.55%, and the balance of Fe and unavoidable impurities. The production method of the steel plate comprises smelting, forging, heating, rolling and heat treatment; the welding method adopts pulse current to assist diffusion welding.

title_en: Low-carbon process for preparing nano silicon mortar based on photovoltaic silicon sludge one-step method
