abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-carbon process for preparing nano silicon mortar based on a photovoltaic silicon sludge one-step method, which comprises the following steps of S1, preparing raw materials, namely selecting the photovoltaic silicon sludge as the raw material, directly taking the photovoltaic silicon sludge as raw material slurry to be processed without drying and grinding pretreatment, S2, grinding the raw material slurry by wet stirring and grinding, S3, centrifugally classifying and screening, namely sending the ground mixed slurry into centrifugal classifying equipment, returning separated coarse particles to the wet stirring and grinding for regrinding, and enabling the fine particles to flow out to obtain the nano silicon mortar, S4, performing closed-loop circulation, namely realizing the circular grinding of the coarse particles through grinding-classifying linkage to form a slurry-slurry closed-loop system of the raw material slurry-mixed slurry-nano silicon mortar, wherein the energy consumption is reduced by 60% compared with the prior art by utilizing the self water-containing characteristic of the photovoltaic silicon sludge, and the whole process is carried out in a closed environment, and the wet grinding is free of dust pollution and the closed-loop system is free from material leakage.

title_en: Composite graphite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composite graphite material and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the composite graphite material comprises the following steps of sequentially carrying out carbonization treatment, depolymerization treatment and graphitization treatment on a mixture containing liquid-phase resin, coke powder and conductive carbon to obtain the composite graphite material. Under the condition of realizing uniform coating and granulation, the preparation method effectively regulates and controls the particle size distribution, the particle structure and the porosity of the obtained composite graphite material, and further can effectively improve the comprehensive properties such as quick charge property, cycle property and the like when being used for lithium ion batteries.

title_en: Single-atom manganese doped lipophilic carbon quantum dot and synthesis method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a synthesis method of a monoatomic manganese doped lipophilic carbon quantum dot, which belongs to the technical field of biomedical materials and comprises the following steps of 1) adding manganese chloride into PEG400, uniformly mixing to form uniform mixed solution A, 2) adding p-phenylenediamine into the mixed solution A obtained in the step 1), uniformly mixing to form uniform mixed solution B, 3) carrying out hydrothermal reaction on the mixed solution B obtained in the step 2), cooling to room temperature after the reaction is completed, washing, purifying and drying to obtain the monoatomic manganese doped lipophilic carbon quantum dot. Meanwhile, the Mn@lip-CDs can specifically target the cytoplasmic membrane, can obviously inhibit lipid peroxidation of the cytoplasmic membrane, has oxidation resistance better than that of a common lipid peroxidation inhibitor Trolox, and can be effectively used for treating iron death.

title_en: Zinc sulfide lead copper quaternary quantum dot loaded with gold monoatoms and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a zinc-lead-copper sulfide quaternary quantum dot loaded with gold atoms and a preparation method thereof, comprising the steps of preparing the zinc-lead-copper sulfide quaternary quantum dot; dispersing zinc-lead-copper sulfide quaternary quantum dots in an aqueous phase to form a quantum dot suspension, mixing the quantum dot suspension with an acid source and fixing the volume, pouring the mixture into an electrolytic cell for deoxidization treatment, adding a first copper source to prepare an electrolyte, depositing copper single atoms on the surface of the quantum dots in the electrolyte through underpotential deposition under a constant potential condition, adding a gold source mixed solution into the deposited electrolyte for chemical displacement reaction to obtain a gold single atom-loaded quantum dot suspension, and purifying and drying the gold single atom-loaded quantum dot suspension to obtain the gold single atom-loaded zinc-lead-copper sulfide quaternary quantum dots. The method realizes the high-efficiency load of gold single atoms by combining the under-potential deposition with the room-temperature aqueous phase electrochemical method of chemical replacement, has the advantages of high efficiency and low cost, and is suitable for industrialization.

title_en: Bismuth oxide core-shell nanoparticle modified porous defect-rich carbon nitride material, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a bismuth oxide core-shell nanoparticle modified porous defect-rich carbon nitride material, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps of calcining urea in an air atmosphere to obtain In (1) Under atmosphere to Calcining to obtain porous carbon nitride rich in defects At room temperature, glycol liquid, nitric acid solution, polyvinylpyrrolidone, Solid body Mixing to obtain a mixed solution, placing the mixed solution in a reaction kettle, heating in water bath to obtain precipitate ‌, filtering out the precipitate, and cleaning, drying and grinding the precipitate to obtain powder And (3) obtaining the bismuth oxide core-shell nano particle modified porous defect-rich carbon nitride material through the solid. Pairs of materials prepared according to the present disclosure And Has strong response capability.

title_en: Co-condensation silicon quantum dot oil displacement agent and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a co-condensation silicon quantum dot oil displacement agent and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of petrochemical industry. Dropwise adding dodecyl trimethoxy silane into an acidic water-ethanol mixed solution, stirring at normal temperature to perform prehydrolysis to obtain a silanol solution, mixing the silanol solution with 3-aminopropyl trimethoxy silane, heating under the protection of nitrogen to perform hydrothermal condensation reaction to form a silicon quantum dot oligomer, sequentially cooling, dialyzing and freeze-drying to obtain functionalized silicon quantum dot powder, dissolving the functionalized silicon quantum dot powder into deionized water, and performing ultrasonic treatment to obtain the co-condensed silicon quantum dot oil displacement agent. The oil displacement agent has excellent surface activity, the quantum dot has the characteristic of high temperature resistance, the quantum dot has good stability, raw materials are easy to obtain, and methanol generated by side reaction does not generate harmful gas, so the preparation method is an environment-friendly preparation scheme.

title_en: High-strength high-conductivity high-plasticity CuCoNiSi alloy and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of copper alloy, and discloses a CuCoNiSi-series alloy with high strength, high conductivity and high plasticity, wherein the conductivity is not lower than 50 percent IACS, the tensile strength is not lower than 700 MPa, and the strength-plastic product is not lower than 9.00 GPa percent. The invention also discloses a preparation method and application of the alloy, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of preparing CuCoNiSi series alloy cast ingots, and sequentially carrying out homogenization treatment, hot rolling treatment, solution treatment, first cold rolling treatment, first aging treatment, second cold rolling treatment, second aging treatment, third cold rolling treatment and third aging treatment to obtain CuCoNiSi series alloy. According to the invention, through the cooperative control of microalloying component design and a multistage deformation-grading aging process, a stable multi-scale precipitation structure is constructed in the Cu-Ni-Co-Si alloy, so that the nanoscale precipitation phase, the micron-scale precipitation phase and the deformation substructure cooperate, the problems of strain localization and early fracture are effectively relieved while the strength and the conductivity are improved, and the cooperative unification of high strength, high conductivity and high plasticity is realized.

title_en: Aquatic product freshness detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an aquatic product freshness detection method which comprises the following steps of 1) constructing a fluorescence sensing array label based on CDs with AIE characteristics, 2) collecting fluorescence sensing array label images and corresponding freshness data, 3) building a deep convolution neural network model, training the deep convolution neural network model based on historically collected fluorescence sensing array label images and corresponding freshness to obtain a trained deep convolution neural network model, and 4) inputting the fluorescent sensing array label images collected in real time into the trained deep convolution neural network model to output an aquatic product freshness classification result. The invention constructs a detection system based on the combination of the fluorescence sensing array label with the AIE characteristic and the lightweight deep convolutional neural network, can realize the visual real-time detection of the freshness of the aquatic products, has the advantages of simple operation, no damage to the aquatic products, rapid detection and the like, and is suitable for large-scale application.

title_en: Preparation method for preparing edge-rich Janus two-dimensional material through strain induction self-driving and application of edge-rich Janus two-dimensional material in electrocatalytic hydrogen evolution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method for preparing an edge-rich Janus two-dimensional material by strain induction self-driving and application thereof in electrocatalytic hydrogen evolution, wherein a two-dimensional transition metal sulfide is used as a precursor, and intrinsic tensile strain is introduced into an asymmetric material basal plane by utilizing radius differences among different substituted atoms through gas phase atomic layer substitution reaction; when strain builds up to the fracture threshold, the material spontaneously forms uniform penetrating nanocracking, resulting in an asymmetric material with an edge-rich structure. The method has simple process, realizes self-driven and controllable construction of the catalyst edge structure, and does not need complex treatments such as later etching and the like. The prepared material exposes a large number of high-activity edge sites due to the synergistic effect of a built-in electric field generated by a unique crack structure and an asymmetric structure, optimizes the free energy of hydrogen adsorption, and shows remarkably enhanced catalytic activity and stability in an electrolytic water hydrogen evolution reaction. The invention provides a new strategy for the design and preparation of the high-efficiency non-noble metal electrocatalyst.

title_en: MEMS ionization vacuum sensor based on magnetic field assistance and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a MEMS ionization vacuum sensor based on magnetic field assistance and a manufacturing method thereof, belonging to the technical field of microelectronics; the sensor comprises a glass substrate, an emitter electrode, a lead electrode, an electron emitter, a first insulating spacing layer, a grid electrode, a second insulating spacing layer, top glass, an ion deflection electrode, an ion collector, an annular electrode and a magnetic field generating component; the invention uses electric field-magnetic field composite field to obviously expand the electron motion track, combines ionization and collection area physical isolation design, solves the problems of weak ion flow and poor anti-interference capability of the existing sensor, has the advantages of small volume, high precision, good consistency and low cost, and is suitable for the fields of semiconductor manufacture and aerospace.

title_en: Silicon-dirac semi-metal heterojunction avalanche photodetector integrated with metal nano-filter structure and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of semiconductors and micro-nano photoelectrons, and particularly discloses a silicon-dirac semi-metal heterojunction avalanche photodetector integrated with a metal nano filter structure and a preparation method thereof. The photoelectric detector prepared by the invention realizes expansion of near infrared wave bands and enhancement of photoelectric response of visible light wave bands through the silicon-dirac semi-metal layer heterojunction. The metal nano structure realizes the response to the target narrow-band wave band of the incident light and has the advantages of selectable wavelength, miniaturization, easy integration and the like.

title_en: Bi (Bi)2+/Ln3+Co-doped CaSnO3Near-infrared long-afterglow luminescent material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a CaSnO  3  near-infrared long-afterglow luminescent material, a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of long-afterglow luminescent materials. By introducing Bi  2+ /Ln 3+  (Ln is at least one selected from Pr, nd, sm, dy, ho, er, tm, yb) co-doping, the multi-band tunable long afterglow luminescent material from near infrared I region to near infrared II region is obtained by utilizing high-efficiency energy transfer between Bi  2+  and Ln  3+  in CaSnO  3  matrix. The preparation method is simple, the raw materials are widely available and easy to obtain, the synthesis condition is easy to control, the obtained long afterglow material has excellent luminous performance and higher practicability, and the long afterglow material has wide application prospect in the aspects of deep tissue biological imaging, optical communication, night vision sensing, near infrared scintillators and the like.

title_en: Antioxidant nano-drug for relieving cisplatin ototoxicity and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an antioxidation nano-drug for relieving cisplatin ototoxicity and a preparation method thereof, wherein the antioxidation nano-drug is prepared from epigallocatechin gallate, D-methionine and formaldehyde through a Mannich condensation reaction in the presence of polyoxyethylene polyoxypropylene ether F127, and all components in the antioxidation nano-drug are uniformly distributed. The antioxidant nano-drug provided by the invention retains the antioxidant properties of EGCG and D-Met, has small and uniform size and strong stability, is favorable for entering cells to exert the effects of the antioxidant nano-drug, and in-vitro cell experiments prove that the antioxidant nano-drug has stronger effect of relieving cisplatin toxicity under equivalent concentration than a small molecular drug.

title_en: Method for directly manufacturing positive electrode particles with ceramic particles and glass phase composite layer by using precursor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for directly manufacturing positive electrode particles with ceramic particles and a glass phase composite layer by using precursors, which comprises the following steps of grinding a nickel source, a manganese source, a cobalt source and a dispersion liquid to form nickel cobalt manganese mixed slurry, then carrying out spray drying and sintering on the nickel cobalt manganese mixed slurry to form nickel cobalt manganese oxide precursors, mixing and grinding a lithium source, a glass phase precursor, an LLZO precursor and the dispersion liquid to form first precursor slurry, then mixing the nickel cobalt manganese precursor and the dispersion liquid and mixing the nickel cobalt manganese precursor and the dispersion liquid with the first precursor slurry to form third precursor slurry, then drying the third precursor slurry to obtain precursor powder, carrying out aerobic sintering on the precursor powder to form a plurality of nickel cobalt manganese particles and a plurality of LLZO particles, wherein the glass phase precursor can form a glass phase layer to cover the outer surfaces of the nickel cobalt manganese particles, and the plurality of LLZO particles can be distributed on the outer surfaces of the glass phase layers to form the whole positive electrode particles.

title_en: Hydrophobic nano carbon particles and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of nano materials, and discloses hydrophobic nano carbon particles, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of 1) carrying out primary pyrolysis carbonization on pulverized coal in a low-oxygen-content atmosphere, and then carrying out primary ball milling in an inert atmosphere to obtain first nano carbon particles; 2) carrying out surface oxidation treatment on the first nano carbon particles in wet air to obtain second nano carbon particles, 3) carrying out secondary pyrolysis on the second nano carbon particles in inert atmosphere to obtain third nano carbon particles, 4) carrying out fluorination modification on the third nano carbon particles, and then carrying out secondary ball milling in inert atmosphere to obtain the hydrophobic nano carbon particles. The invention takes coal as raw material, and the finally prepared nano carbon particles have strong hydrophobic property after a series of treatments, can be directly used as a collector for coal slime flotation, and provides an economic and efficient novel medicament solution for coal slime flotation.

title_en: High-strength steel material for mine roadway support and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of metal materials, in particular to a high-strength steel material for mine roadway support and a preparation method thereof, wherein the high-strength steel material comprises the following components in percentage by weight: 0.04 to 0.10 percent of C, 0.15 to 0.45 percent of Si, 1.20 to 1.80 percent of Mn, 0.20 to 0.50 percent of Cu, 0.15 to 0.40 percent of Cr, 0.10 to 0.35 percent of Ni, 0.08 to 0.25 percent of Mo, 0.015 to 0.045 percent of Nb, 0.03 to 0.08 percent of V, 0.008 to 0.025 percent of Ti, 0.005 to 0.020 percent of RE and the balance of Fe; the preparation method comprises the following steps: smelting refining, continuous casting, heating, rough rolling, finish rolling, sectional controlled cooling and medium temperature tempering (450-550 ℃), R More than or equal to 620MPa, A more than or equal to 18 percent, the yield ratio is less than or equal to 0.90,0 degrees CKV Not less than 100J, the method is suitable for deep well high-stress roadway support.

title_en: MOF-based nano positive electrode material and application thereof in water-based zinc ion battery
abstract_en: The invention provides a MOF-based nano positive electrode material and application thereof in a water-based zinc ion battery, and relates to the field of electrochemical energy storage devices, wherein the MOF-based nano positive electrode material comprises a bimetallic MOF formed by bimetallic cluster nodes consisting of divalent manganese ions and trivalent vanadium ions; the organic ligand is a multidentate carboxylic acid ligand containing a rigid aromatic ring structure, the organic ligand and the bimetallic cluster nodes are connected in a coordinated manner to form a three-dimensional framework structure, and the three-dimensional framework structure is provided with grading pore channels. According to the MOF-based nano positive electrode material, a three-dimensional continuous conductive coating layer is constructed on the surface of the bimetallic MOF by adopting nitrogen-doped carbon nano fibers, mn-N, V-N coordination bonds are formed at the interface, firm heterogeneous interface combination and a high-efficiency electronic transmission network are realized, the mechanical stress of electrode particles is effectively buffered in the circulation process, the cracking or falling of the conductive network is avoided, and the overall conductive continuity of the electrode is ensured.

title_en: Planar photon resonance motor structure
abstract_en: A photonic motor is described herein comprising a first optical waveguide means adapted to guide at least one optical mode and form a stator (12), and electromagnetic interaction means, which electromagnetically interacts with the optical mode and is configured for rotation and formation of a rotor (14), the electromagnetic interaction means comprising a plurality of optical resonators or a plurality of reflective metal structures or a combination thereof, the electromagnetic interaction means being concentrically positioned inside the first optical waveguide means and spaced from the first optical waveguide means by a predetermined lateral interaction distance adapted to establish evanescent coupling of the optical mode with a plurality of second optical resonators or to cause evanescent reflection of the optical mode by a plurality of reflective metal structures. The rotor comprises a circular frame (22) coaxial with the central hub (20) and comprising spokes (R) converging towards the central hub in a monolithic arrangement, adapted to support an area (24) for housing a plurality of second optical resonators or for housing a plurality of reflective metal structures in a peripheral area of the frame. The frame is separated from the central hub and is arranged above the base plate (S), on which the frame can be supported by a support structure (26) in a non-operating state, and can be lifted from the base plate in an operating state in which the light mode is guided in the first light waveguide arrangement of the stator.

title_en: Mn coating based on tumor cell membrane and liposome2+Immune nano-drug modified by graphene quantum dots and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photothermal immune nano-drug based on a tumor cell membrane and liposome coated manganese ion modified graphene quantum dot and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the field of nano-drugs. The preparation method comprises the steps of (1) preparing 4T1 cell membrane tm and liposome Lip, (2) preparing a hybrid nano drug GMP loaded with manganese ions and mPEG-NH  2 , and (3) preparing GMP@liptm. According to the invention, metabolizable graphene quantum dots are selected as the photothermal treatment nano platform, so that the preparation method has higher drug loading rate and photothermal conversion rate, and can effectively scald tumor cells. The encapsulation of mPEG-NH  2 , lip and tm can improve the tumor targeting of the nano-drug, and Mn  2+  activates the cgAs-STING signal channel so as to excite the immune response of the organism. According to the invention, the tumor cell membrane and the liposome are used for wrapping Mn  2+  modified graphene quantum dots for the first time, so that the synergistic treatment effect of photo-thermal ablation-immune activation-targeted delivery of breast cancer is realized, the design method is simple, the reaction condition is mild, and a new strategy is provided for the accurate treatment of breast cancer.

title_en: Nano silicon material, surface oxide removal method thereof, lithium ion battery and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nano silicon material, a surface oxide removal method thereof, a lithium ion battery and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of lithium ion battery materials, wherein the method comprises the following steps: after pretreating the nano silicon material containing the surface oxide layer, carrying out dispersion treatment on the nano silicon material and cellulose ether in a solvent, so that the cellulose ether is adsorbed on the particle surfaces of the nano silicon material, and the particle agglomeration is destroyed by a steric hindrance and electrostatic repulsion dual mechanism; and then removing the surface oxide layer and byproducts of the nano silicon material by acid washing, and washing and drying to obtain the nano silicon material. The method has simple process and safe operation, can obviously reduce the oxygen content of the nano silicon material to below 5%, improves the conductivity and activity of the silicon electrode, releases the high specific capacity of the silicon electrode, improves the cycle stability of the battery from 400 mAh g  ‑1  to 3500 mAh g  ‑1 , and is suitable for large-scale preparation of high-purity silicon anode materials.

title_en: Multilayer structure's enzyme immobilization and fluorescence bimodulus detects and uses Fe3O4@SiO2ZIF-8 compound and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of nano materials and biochemistry, in particular to an enzyme immobilization and fluorescence dual-mode detection Fe  3 O 4 @SiO 2  @ZIF-8 compound based on a space isolation structure and a preparation method thereof. The composite compound is of a multilayer structure which sequentially comprises a Fe  3 O 4  core, a SiO  2  isolation layer, a ZIF-8 shell layer and an outer carbon quantum dot from inside to outside, enzyme molecules are loaded in a pore canal of the ZIF-8 shell layer, wherein Fe  3 O 4  is magnetic nanoparticles, siO  2  is a continuous compact silicon dioxide layer coated on the surface of Fe  3 O 4 , ZIF-8 is a metal organic framework material formed by in-situ growth on the surface of SiO  2 , the carbon quantum dot is fixed on the outer surface of ZIF-8/SiO  2  through chemical bonding, and the enzyme is loaded in the ZIF-8 in a pore canal diffusion mode and is fixed through light crosslinking.

title_en: Construction method of three-dimensional laminated chiral nano composite structure based on DNA paper folding template
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide a construction method of a three-dimensional laminated chiral nano composite structure based on a DNA paper folding template, which comprises the steps of carrying out hydrophilic treatment on a silicon substrate by using a plasma cleaning machine, designing and synthesizing the DNA paper folding template which is provided with a plurality of symmetrically distributed capture sites, respectively adopting a DNA modified gold nano disc and a gold nano ball, spreading the DNA paper folding template on the surface of the treated substrate, firstly hybridizing the DNA modified gold nano disc with the template, fixing the DNA modified gold nano disc at the central position of the DNA paper folding, hybridizing the DNA modified gold nano ball with a DNA chain on the gold nano disc to form the three-dimensional laminated structure, and cleaning unbound nano particles to obtain the target composite structure. According to the invention, accurate positioning of the gold nano disc and the gold nano ball in a three-dimensional space and ordered stacking in the vertical direction are realized through the DNA paper folding template, and a chiral nano composite structure with a three-dimensional lamination effect is constructed.

title_en: Core-shell structure light conversion agent, photovoltaic glass light conversion coating liquid and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a core-shell structure light conversion agent, photovoltaic glass light conversion coating liquid and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of photovoltaic packaging. The core-shell structured light conversion agent comprises a core layer and a shell layer, wherein the core layer comprises a light conversion agent luminescent molecular material, the shell layer comprises a silicon dioxide material, the particle size of the core-shell structured light conversion agent is 20-200 nm, and the thickness of the shell layer is 10-50% of the particle size of the core-shell structured light conversion agent. According to the invention, by designing the core-shell structure with the inorganic silica shell layer, the light conversion agent molecules are effectively packaged, so that the ultraviolet stability of the light conversion film layer is improved while the high light transmittance is maintained, and the service life of the film coating layer in an outdoor environment is prolonged.

title_en: Curcumin-based carbon-point nano enzyme cascade catalytic system and application thereof in targeted anticariogenic bacteria
abstract_en: The invention discloses a curcumin-based carbon dot nano enzyme cascade catalytic system and application thereof in targeting anticariogenic bacteria, belonging to the technical field of biological medicine, wherein the catalytic system is prepared by mixing curcumin-based carbon dot nano enzymes Cur@Fe, mn/CDs and glucose oxidase GOx, performing ultrasound and incubating; the curcumin-based carbon point nano enzyme cascade catalytic system shows near infrared enhanced peroxidase-like activity and excellent photo-thermal performance, hydrogen peroxide generated by GOx oxidation of glucose is used as a substrate of peroxide mimic enzymes Cur@Fe, mn/CDs, high-toxicity hydroxyl free radicals are generated in an acidic environment, the positions of biological membranes are precisely positioned by positive charges on the surfaces of nano enzymes and GOx, and the nano enzymes can target and inhibit cariogenic bacteria of S.mutans and S.sanguinis, and hardly influence the normal oral cavity S.oralis.

title_en: Preparation method of Mg nano particles
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of Mg nano particles. The method comprises the steps of adding metal lithium and naphthalene into tetrahydrofuran, stirring to obtain a lithium naphthalene solution, adding an organic magnesium salt and 1, 4-dioxane into the lithium naphthalene solution, stirring for reaction, centrifuging and washing after the reaction is finished to obtain nano magnesium particles, and carrying out the whole process in an inert atmosphere. The invention has simple preparation process and low cost, and the size of Mg nano particles is successfully reduced by adding an organic solvent.

title_en: Nanometer ophthalmic gel preparation for treating corneal epithelial injury
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nanometer ophthalmic gel preparation for treating corneal epithelial injury, which comprises PIP nanometer gel as a main component, wherein the PIP nanometer gel is prepared by preparing cystamine dihydrochloride modified carboxymethyl cellulose through cystamine dihydrochloride modified carboxymethyl cellulose, loading a medicine component PIP under the action of electrostatic self-assembly by taking collagen as an auxiliary material, and synthesizing the PIP nanometer gel, and the hydration particle size of the synthesized PIP nanometer gel is 50-500 nm. The invention provides and successfully prepares the PIP nano gel which is in a spheroid-like shape and well dispersed, fills the blank that no PIP delivery system is suitable in the prior art, provides a new technical path for PIP in vivo application, and the prepared nano ophthalmic gel preparation can prolong the retention time of PIP eyes to more than 12 hours, so that the cornea repair speed is improved by more than 50 percent compared with a free PIP group, and the wound closure is accelerated.

title_en: Mo doped CoS2Preparation method and application of carbon cloth composite nano electrocatalyst
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electrocatalytic material preparation, in particular to a preparation method and application of a Mo-doped CoS  2 /carbon cloth composite nano electrocatalyst, which comprises the following steps: A Mo-CoS  2  @CF composite electrocatalyst with a 3D nanowire multilevel core-shell structure is constructed by a two-step in-situ hydrothermal method by taking carbon Cloth (CF) as a substrate and a carbon source, firstly, a molybdenum-based precursor is grown on the surface of the carbon cloth, and then, a cobalt source is introduced to carry out hydrothermal vulcanization reaction, so that a core-shell structure with Mo doped CoS  2  nanosheets vertically grown on the surface of carbon fibers is formed. The Mo-CoS  2  @CF composite electrocatalyst provided by the invention does not need a conductive substrate and an insulating polymer adhesive, can be directly used as a self-supporting electrode for electrocatalytic hydrogen evolution reaction, has the characteristics of high catalytic activity and fast reaction kinetics, has the overpotential of only 71.5 mV at the current density of 10 mAcm  ‑2 , has the Tafel slope as low as 27.59 mVdec  ‑1 , and has good practical application prospect in the field of water electrolysis hydrogen production.

title_en: W-based18O49/Ag2S S-schema heterostructure full spectrum sunlight activated gas sensor and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of gas sensors, and particularly discloses a full-spectrum solar light activated gas sensor based on a W  18 O 49 /Ag 2  S S-schema heterostructure, which comprises a gas sensor composed of a substrate with a plurality of interdigital fingers and a sensitive material on an interdigital electrode, wherein the sensitive material is a W  18 O 49 /Ag 2  S nanocomposite with a heterostructure, the W  18 O 49 /Ag 2  S nanocomposite comprises W  18 O 49  particles with a three-dimensional micro-flower structure and Ag  2  S nanoparticles modified on the surface of the W  18 O 49  particles, and under the activation of solar light, an S-schema heterojunction is formed between W  18 O 49  and Ag  2  S. According to the full-spectrum solar light activated gas sensor, the W  18 O 49 /Ag 2  S nano composite material with the S-schema heterostructure is used as a gas sensitive material, and the W  18 O 49  and Ag  2  S cooperate to enable the composite material to realize 300-2500 nm full-spectrum solar light absorption, so that the photon utilization rate is maximized. The W  18 O 49 /Ag 2  S nanocomposite gas sensor can realize detection of NO  2  under the room temperature working condition, and has the advantages of quick response/recovery time (5/3S), low detection limit of 50 ppb, high selectivity and long-term stability.

title_en: Purification method of carbon nano tube
abstract_en: The invention discloses a purification method of a carbon nano tube. The method comprises the steps of S1, grinding the carbon nano tube, mixing the ground carbon nano tube with an aqueous solution containing a dispersing agent, dispersing the mixture under the condition of ultrasonic vibration to obtain a mixture A, S2, carrying out solid-liquid separation, washing and drying on the mixture A to obtain a mixture B, S3, carrying out reduction reaction on the mixture B in a reducing gas atmosphere, then carrying out purging treatment on the mixture B by using inert gas to obtain a mixture C, S4, carrying out oxidation reaction on the mixture C in an oxidizing gas and inert gas atmosphere to obtain a mixture D, mixing the mixture D with an acid solution, carrying out reaction under the condition of heating and reflux, and then carrying out pH value adjustment, solid-liquid separation, washing and drying to obtain the purified carbon nano tube. The invention has the advantages of easy control of reaction conditions, simple and easy operation, low cost and the like, and can effectively reduce the residual quantity of metal in the carbon nano tube.

title_en: Carbon-coated Li5AlO4Preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses carbon-coated Li  5 AlO 4 , and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of lithium supplementing agents. The preparation method comprises the following steps of S1, mechanically and uniformly mixing a lithium source, an aluminum source and a carbon source to obtain a mixture, performing heat treatment on the mixture in an inert atmosphere to obtain a precursor, and S2, mechanically and uniformly mixing the precursor and the carbon source, and performing sintering in the inert atmosphere to obtain the carbon-coated Li  5 AlO 4 . The carbon source introduced in the Li  5 AlO 4  synthesis stage of the preparation method can effectively inhibit coarsening of particles in the crystal sintering process, and the existence of the carbon source in the precursor carbon coating process prevents grain boundary migration and particle agglomeration during high-temperature treatment. The dual carbon regulation and control mechanisms cooperate with each other, so that the invention can directly obtain the Li  5 AlO 4  product with small particles and uniformly coated carbon without depending on post-treatment processes such as ball milling or air current crushing.

title_en: Nitrogen-phosphorus co-doped composite carbon nanotube catalyst, and in-situ growth preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a nitrogen-phosphorus co-doped composite carbon nanotube catalyst, and an in-situ growth preparation method and application thereof. The in-situ growth preparation method comprises the following steps of immersing a conductive nickel-containing substrate with a three-dimensional porous structure in a precursor solution containing nitrogen and phosphorus elements, taking out and drying the substrate, placing the substrate in flame in a flammable atmosphere for burning reaction, enabling the precursor to burn and decompose on the surface of the substrate, reacting in situ, growing a nitrogen and phosphorus element doped carbon nano tube three-dimensional network structure embedded with nickel nano particles, and cooling to obtain the nitrogen and phosphorus co-doped composite carbon nano tube catalyst loaded on the substrate. Compared with the prior art, the invention can rapidly and cheaply prepare the non-noble metal catalyst which has high conductive network, abundant active sites and excellent stability on the conductive substrate in one step, and can be directly used for high-efficiency water electrolysis hydrogen production, thereby promoting the large-scale industrial application thereof.

title_en: PAN modified NiCoP/NF catalyst for urea-assisted seawater electrolysis and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electrocatalytic materials, and discloses a PAN modified NiCoP/NF catalyst for urea-assisted seawater electrolysis and a preparation method thereof. The method takes foam nickel as a carrier, synthesizes a NiCo precursor by a melting method, and is prepared by PAN solution impregnation and one-step phosphating treatment. The shape and structure of the catalyst can be optimized by regulating and controlling the PAN concentration, and the concentration is 0.05 g mL   1  When a preferred structure with fine nanorods (diameter 20-50 nm) composited with an appropriate amount of amorphous carbon layer is obtained. The material shows excellent hydrogen evolution activity in alkaline seawater electrolyte, 10 mA cm   2  The overpotential is 44 mV under the current density, and in the alkaline seawater-urea mixed electrolyte, the overpotential of the urea oxidation reaction is 1.32V under the same current density, and compared with the overpotential of the oxygen evolution reaction, the overpotential is obviously reduced by 180 mV, thus having the dual advantages of high efficiency, energy saving and waste water recycling. The invention has simple process and controllable structure, and has good application prospect in the field of water electrolysis hydrogen production and urea wastewater treatment.

title_en: Preparation method of three-dimensional graphene-COF interlocking material and application of three-dimensional graphene-COF interlocking material in zinc ion battery
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of micro-nano structure material design and battery energy storage, and relates to a preparation method of a three-dimensional graphene-COF interlocking material, which comprises the steps of firstly, performing controllable amination reduction on graphene oxide, and accurately constructing amino functional group distribution on the surface of the graphene oxide to serve as active sites for heterogeneous assembly; in the solution blending process, the enhanced multiple intermolecular force between an amino group and a COF precursor is utilized to drive a COF element to perform oriented adsorption and two-dimensional ordered preassembly on the surface of graphene to form a molecular-level anchor point array, then interfacial covalent condensation and pi-plane induced epitaxial growth are cooperatively realized through solvothermal reaction, a COF layer is crystallized and forms a strong coupling heterojunction with deep-reduced and structurally repaired graphene on a molecular level, and finally, freeze drying and shaping are carried out to obtain the bicontinuous conductive network carrier with a stable heterogeneous interface, a three-dimensional interlocking pore channel and an intrinsic built-in electric field.

title_en: Preparation method of thick film oxide film layer
abstract_en: The invention provides a thick film oxide film preparation method, which comprises the steps of preparing deep grooves and holes on a substrate, sequentially depositing a first oxide film layer with the thickness of 20000 angstroms, a second oxide film layer with the thickness of 10000 angstroms, a third oxide film layer with the thickness of 10000 angstroms and a fourth oxide film layer with the thickness of 10000 angstroms on the substrate after the deep grooves and the holes are prepared, and placing the substrate containing the oxide film layers in annealing equipment for annealing after the preparation of the oxide film layers each time. According to the invention, annealing treatment is carried out after each oxide film layer is generated, multiple times of annealing are beneficial to gradually releasing stress in the oxide film layer, so that the generated thick oxide film layer stress is in a receiving range, and multiple times of annealing and deposition of a multilayer film by using an LPTEOS process and a PETEOS process are beneficial to improving uniformity and compactness of the film and improving performance of a final device.

title_en: Packaging method for carbon nanotube film and film frame
abstract_en: The invention provides a packaging method for a carbon nano tube film, which comprises the steps of bearing the carbon nano tube film on a supporting layer material, manufacturing a packaging frame matched with the carbon nano tube film, attaching the carbon nano tube film to the packaging frame, carrying out energy irradiation on a bonding area of the carbon nano tube film and the packaging frame, and removing the supporting layer material from the irradiated carbon nano tube film. The invention realizes the powerful bonding between the carbon nanotube film and the packaging frame through the chemical bonding between materials, and improves the packaging reliability.

title_en: Negative electrode plate for rechargeable lithium battery and rechargeable lithium battery including the same
abstract_en: A negative electrode plate for a rechargeable lithium battery and a rechargeable lithium battery are provided. The negative electrode plate for a rechargeable lithium battery may include a negative electrode active substance, and the negative electrode active substance may include a first negative electrode active substance, a second negative electrode active substance, and a third negative electrode active substance. The first negative electrode active material may include natural graphite and a coating layer. The natural graphite may include secondary particles. The secondary particles may comprise aggregates of primary particles. The coating layer may include amorphous carbon and surround secondary particles of natural graphite. The first negative electrode active substance may have a degree of orientation of 90 or less, and may have a d002 in the range of about 3.356 a to about 3.360 a. The second negative electrode active material may include graphite. The third negative electrode active substance may have a sphericity of about 0.9 to about 1.0, and may include silicon nanoparticles and an amorphous carbon coating layer disposed on the surface of the silicon nanoparticles.

title_en: Vanadium-based composite positive electrode material, and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vanadium-based composite positive electrode material, and preparation and application thereof. The vanadium-based composite positive electrode material comprises micron-sized microspheres formed by gathering nanoscale primary particles, wherein the primary particles are composed of a Na and Zr doped V  2 O 5  material and an MXene material compounded on the material, and a heterogeneous interface is formed between the Na and Zr doped V  2 O 5  material and the MXene material. The preparation method comprises the steps of dissolving a vanadium source, a sodium source, a zirconium source, a surfactant and a complexing agent in a first solvent to obtain a first solution, carrying out hydrothermal reaction on the first solution, filtering a reaction product to obtain a precipitate, carrying out ball milling and mixing on the precipitate and an MXene material to obtain an intermediate substance, dispersing the intermediate substance in a water or alcohol solvent, carrying out spray drying to obtain precursor powder, and calcining the precursor powder to obtain the composite anode material. When the material is applied to the anode, the specific capacity of the water-based zinc ion battery and the cycling stability in the charging and discharging process can be effectively improved.

title_en: Flaky nano C-S-H crystal nucleus, preparation method, sprayed concrete and use method
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of tunnel engineering construction, and particularly relates to a flaky nano C-S-H crystal nucleus, a preparation method, sprayed concrete and a use method. Aiming at the problems that the existing high-ground-temperature tunnel sprayed concrete is abnormal in hydration, insufficient in early strength, high in rebound rate and poor in durability, and the existing C-S-H crystal nucleus is easy to agglomerate and low in nucleation activity, the application adopts calcium nitrate and sodium silicate as raw materials, and adopts a combined process of low-speed dropwise adding controllable precipitation, modification by an in-situ TPEG type polycarboxylic acid dispersing agent and low-temperature post-treatment to prepare the loose porous flaky C-S-H crystal nucleus with the granularity of 50-100 nm, the loose porous flaky C-S-H crystal nucleus is doped into the sprayed concrete according to 1.0% -1.5% of the total mass of a cementing material, and matched construction process of online mixing and high-ground-temperature aggregate precooling is carried out, so that the 8-3 d strength of the sprayed concrete is improved by more than 30%, the rebound rate is reduced to 8%, the 28d impervious grade reaches P15, the porous C-S-H crystal nucleus is adapted to the working conditions of the high-ground-temperature and high-corrosion tunnel at 35 ℃, the process is simple, the cost is controllable, and the method is suitable for large-scale engineering popularization and application.

title_en: 8-Hydroxyquinoline functional modified polypeptide molecule and preparation method and application of metal complex thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of an 8-hydroxyquinoline functional modified polypeptide molecule and a metal complex thereof, wherein HQ-FFGGRGD (HQD) is prepared by a solid-phase polypeptide synthesis method, 2-chlorotrityl chloride resin is used as a carrier, amino acid and 8-hydroxyquinoline-7-carboxylic acid are sequentially coupled, and the HQD molecule is obtained through cutting and purifying. The molecule can self-assemble to form a stable nano structure through coordination and multiple non-covalent interactions under the drive of transition metal ions, so as to obtain the HQD metal complex. The HQD metal complex can efficiently load chemotherapeutic drugs to form a drug-loaded nano system, has the characteristics of pH response and laser response drug release, and can remarkably promote intracellular drug uptake. The invention integrates chemical kinetics treatment, photothermal treatment, DNA damage and chemotherapy into a single nano platform, realizes multi-mode synergistic anti-tumor, and has the advantages of good biocompatibility, strong targeting, simple preparation, high treatment efficiency and the like.

title_en: Non-noble metal SERS substrate, preparation method and application thereof in trace pollutant detection
abstract_en: The invention provides a non-noble metal SERS substrate, a preparation method and application thereof in trace pollutant detection, wherein the non-noble metal SERS substrate comprises a metal substrate with a bottom layer and an organic coating covered on the surface of the metal substrate in the vertical direction, the metal substrate is provided with a nano-pillar array structure, nano-scale gaps are formed between nano-pillars, and the organic coating and the metal substrate below form a double-layer structure for synergistically enhancing SERS activity. The substrate has excellent SERS activity and signal uniformity, and can realize rapid, high-sensitivity and quantitative detection of microplastic and organic micromolecular pollutants in an environmental water sample through the combination with a portable Raman spectrometer. The invention is particularly suitable for on-site rapid detection, and solves the problems of strong dependence on noble metals, high cost, complex operation and the like in the prior art.

title_en: Paste composition for pressureless sintering bonding, bonding method using the same, and electronic component manufactured using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a paste composition for pressureless sintering joining, a joining method using the same, and an electronic component manufactured using the same, and more particularly, to a paste composition for pressureless sintering joining comprising silver nanoparticles, silver nanoparticle aggregates, and a mixed solvent comprising an alcohol solvent and an ether solvent, a joining method comprising the steps of applying the paste composition for pressureless sintering joining of the present invention to a joining surface, joining an object to be joined to the joining surface, and heating the joining surface at a temperature of 150 to 300 ℃ under a pressure of 1atm, and an electronic component manufactured using the paste composition for pressureless sintering joining of the present invention.

title_en: Method for extracting fullerene from waste coke of acetylene black conductive agent
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for extracting fullerene from waste coke of acetylene black conductive agent. A method for extracting fullerene from waste acetylene black conductive agent coke comprises the following steps of carrying out heat treatment on waste acetylene black conductive agent coke to obtain pretreated waste acetylene black conductive agent coke, carrying out ultrasonic extraction treatment on the pretreated waste acetylene black conductive agent coke by taking imidazole ionic liquid as an extracting agent under an ultrasonic condition, separating to obtain ionic liquid extract rich in fullerene and solid residues, and carrying out step cooling crystallization treatment on the ionic liquid extract rich in fullerene to obtain C  70  fullerene and C  60  fullerene. The invention realizes the recycling and recycling of the waste coke of the acetylene black conductive agent, solves the problems of potential safety hazard and environmental pollution existing in the existing fullerene extraction method, and solves the problems of complicated separation and purification steps, high energy consumption and long production period existing in the existing fullerene extraction method.

title_en: PDMS-based flexible pressure sensor and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pressure sensors, in particular to a flexible pressure sensor based on PDMS and a preparation method thereof, wherein the flexible pressure sensor based on PDMS comprises a flexible substrate, a bottom electrode and a top electrode which are arranged from bottom to top, and further comprises a PDMS dielectric layer, wherein the PDMS dielectric layer consists of two PDMS films with different surface microstructures, and the PDMS dielectric layer is positioned between or on two sides of the bottom electrode and the top electrode; on the other hand, a plurality of low-cost dies are specially arranged, so that PDMS with a large size and a series of microstructures can be obtained, and various applications of PDMS capacitive pressure sensors or resistive pressure sensors based on different sizes and microstructures in different scenes can be realized.

title_en: Development method of water vapor permeation path of temperature and humidity storage test of microelectronic device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of semiconductor performance detection, in particular to a developing method of a moisture permeation path of a temperature and humidity storage test of a microelectronic device, wherein before packaging the microelectronic device to be tested, fluorescent tracers are uniformly sprayed on a moisture permeation key interface of the microelectronic device to be tested, then the microelectronic device is packaged conventionally, the packaged microelectronic device is placed in a temperature and humidity test box with an internal ultraviolet light source and an image acquisition unit for temperature and humidity storage test, when the humidity reaches a preset threshold value in the temperature and humidity storage test process, the ultraviolet light source is lightened to excite the fluorescent tracers, the image acquisition unit is started, time sequence image acquisition is carried out on the moisture permeation key interface of the microelectronic device to be tested, and based on the fluorescent time sequence image, the diffusion track of the fluorescent tracers is captured, and a moisture permeation path distribution map is generated. The invention realizes the in-situ real-time visualization of the vapor permeation process of the microelectronic device, and accurately positions the microscopic permeation path, thereby accurately testing the seepage-proofing performance of the microelectronic device.

title_en: Phosphorus-oxygen doped carbon-loaded platinum catalyst for fuel cell anode and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fuel cells, and particularly discloses a phosphorus-oxygen doped carbon-loaded platinum catalyst for an anode of an anion exchange membrane fuel cell and a preparation method thereof. The invention prepares the phosphorus-oxygen doped carbon carrier by using a pyrolysis method and obtains the supported platinum catalyst by wet reduction. According to the method, phosphorus-oxygen doping is carried out on the carbon carrier, so that the growth process of metal platinum is effectively controlled, and uniform distribution of superfine platinum nano particles is realized. Meanwhile, the interface interaction between the phosphorus-oxygen doped carbon carrier and the metal platinum particles realizes the double promotion of the catalyst activity and the stability of the hydrogen oxidation reaction of the anode of the anion exchange membrane fuel cell. The phosphorus-doped carbon-loaded platinum catalyst has wide application potential in the field of fuel cells as a novel catalyst, is excellent in performance and stability, simple in preparation process, safe and green, and has further industrial application prospect.

title_en: Nanoscale sulfide solid electrolyte with surface coated with fluorine-containing lithium salt and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nanoscale sulfide solid electrolyte with a surface coated with fluorine-containing lithium salt and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of solid batteries. The method comprises the steps of dissolving fluorine-containing lithium salt in a coating auxiliary agent under the protection of inert gas to obtain a coating liquid A, adding the coating liquid A into a low-polarity solvent B, uniformly mixing to obtain a sanding solvent C, mixing sulfide solid electrolyte powder with the sanding solvent C, performing sanding refinement treatment to obtain mixture slurry, performing solid-liquid separation on the mixture slurry, and drying a solid to obtain the nano-scale sulfide solid electrolyte powder with the surface coated with the fluorine-containing lithium salt. According to the invention, the particle nanocrystallization of the sulfide electrolyte and the in-situ uniform coating of the fluorine-containing lithium salt are realized in one step through wet sanding, the coating layer is compact and has strong binding force, when the electrolyte is used for an all-solid-state battery, the interface side reaction can be effectively inhibited, the battery cycle stability is improved, and the preparation process is simple and easy to popularize in a large scale.

title_en: Method for activating failure perovskite, solar cell, assembly and photovoltaic system
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of photovoltaics, and provides a method for activating failure perovskite, which comprises the following steps of stirring and heating a mixture of oleic acid and octadecene to a first preset temperature, adding cesium carbonate, stirring and heating under a protective atmosphere condition to obtain cesium oleate solution, mixing and dissolving lead iodide and lead bromide in an N, N-dimethylformamide or dimethyl sulfoxide solvent, adding oleic acid and oleylamine as ligands to obtain lead halide solution, heating the lead halide solution to a second preset temperature, mixing with cesium oleate solution, quickly cooling to obtain a reaction solution of perovskite quantum dots, adding the reaction solution into a toluene solvent, centrifuging to remove unreacted raw materials and impurities, washing with methyl acetate or ethyl acetate to obtain a preparation solution of perovskite quantum dots dispersed in the toluene solvent, carrying out ion exchange on the failure perovskite light absorption layer and the preparation solution, and activating the failure perovskite light absorption layer. The proportion of each preparation is easy to operate and control, and the perovskite after activation is not damaged.

title_en: Asymmetric nickel oxide superconducting film, superconducting diode and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an asymmetric nickel oxide superconducting film, a superconducting diode and a preparation method thereof, wherein the asymmetric nickel oxide superconducting film comprises at least 3 nickel oxide layers with RP structures, which are sequentially stacked along the growth direction of the film, wherein the nickel oxide layers are formed by alternately stacking rare earth oxide layers and nickel oxide surface layers, the number of the nickel oxide surface layers in a single-layer nickel oxide is n, n values of all the nickel oxide layers are asymmetrically distributed along the growth direction of the film so as to break space inversion symmetry, and an intermediate layer section except the bottommost layer and the outermost layer in the film is defined as an intermediate layer region, and the intermediate layer region comprises at least 1 nickel oxide layer with n value of 2. The superconducting device has the advantages of being simple in structure, high in stability, convenient to popularize and apply in superconducting electronics devices, capable of enhancing the degree of freedom and the programmability of manual design of the devices, and capable of achieving high-performance superconducting nonreciprocal effect defined by the structure.

title_en: Carbon-antimony negative electrode material of lithium ion battery and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of negative electrode materials, in particular to a carbon-antimony negative electrode material of a lithium ion battery and a preparation method thereof, wherein Schiff base functionalized carbon quantum dots are prepared, the Schiff base functionalized carbon quantum dots are dispersed in deionized water to obtain dispersion liquid, the dispersion liquid is mixed with an absolute ethanol solution containing ethylene glycol antimony, and a product is collected after stirring reaction.

title_en: Pt nanoparticle CeO2Embedded composite anode material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Pt nano-particle CeO  2  embedded composite anode material, a preparation method and application. CeO  2  supported Pt catalyst was synthesized by Metal Organic Framework (MOF) template strategy. The method comprises the steps of synthesizing UiO-66 (Ce) by using a classical synthesis method, synthesizing a Pt nano-particle CeO  2  embedded composite catalytic material by using the UiO-66 (Ce) as a precursor, and preparing the composite catalytic material by a solvothermal method. The chemical formula of the material is Pt@CeO  2 , pt nano particles embedded in the material are uniformly dispersed, the particle size is distributed between 2 and 3 nm, and the Pt nano particles are partially embedded in CeO  2  crystal lattice to enhance the interaction between metal and carrier, promote efficient charge transfer, stabilize the Pt nano particles and prevent high-temperature sintering. The solid oxide fuel cell prepared by the material has good electrochemical performance under the hydrogen atmosphere and good structural stability under the hydrogen atmosphere. The material disclosed by the invention is simple to prepare, excellent in performance and good in application prospect.

title_en: Universal preparation method of morphology-controllable ordered alloy nanocrystalline based on unbalanced nano metallurgy strategy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a universal preparation method of morphology-controllable ordered alloy nanocrystalline based on an unbalanced nano metallurgical strategy, which comprises the steps of placing alloy nanocrystalline or supported alloy nanocrystalline in an unbalanced nano metallurgical platform, heating to the heat preservation temperature at a heating rate higher than the critical heating rate of the alloy, carrying out isothermal heat preservation, and cooling to room temperature to obtain the ordered alloy nanocrystalline with controllable morphology. The invention describes a nanoscale TTT phase diagram different from the traditional bulk alloy, finds an unreported atomic-level armor forming area, successfully prepares the controllable ordered compound gold nanocrystals with different particle sizes, different geometric shapes and different chemical components by adjusting the temperature and heating rate of the ordered alloy nanocrystals to the corresponding atomic-level armor forming area, solves the preparation difficulty of shape loss in the ordering process of the alloy nanocrystals at high temperature, and is simple and universal, thereby being suitable for large-scale production.

title_en: Nanometer twin crystal Cr with room temperature ferromagnetism2O3Film and method for producing the same
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of spin electronic devices, in particular to a nano twin crystal Cr  2 O 3  film with room-temperature ferrimagnetism and a preparation method thereof, which are suitable for spin electronic devices with non-volatile, low power consumption and high sensitivity. And (3) growing a Cr  2 O 3  epitaxial film on the SrTiO  3  (111) substrate by using a pulse laser deposition technology, and growing high-density nanometer twin crystals in the film by regulating and controlling a film growth process. Two twin crystal boundaries with different atomic structures are formed in the nano twin crystal thin film, wherein one twin crystal boundary is in ferromagnetic coupling and has a net magnetic moment, so that the nano twin crystal Cr  2 O 3  thin film presents room-temperature ferrimagnetism. The invention opens up an effective way for regulating and controlling the magnetic property of the thin film material by utilizing the nanometer twin crystals, thereby laying a foundation for the development of the high-performance nanometer twin crystal magnetic material.

title_en: Monodisperse silicon dioxide nanoparticle for photonic crystal and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of nano particles, and particularly relates to a monodisperse silicon dioxide nano particle for photonic crystals and a preparation method thereof. The method takes the organic siloxane as a precursor and the polyhydroxy organic amine mixture as a catalyst to prepare the monodisperse solid silica nanoparticles, and can realize the precise regulation and control of the particle size of the monodisperse silica nanoparticles between 25 and 86 nm by changing the addition amount of the silicon source precursor. The alkyl quaternary ammonium salt cationic surfactant is introduced on the basis, so that monodisperse mesoporous silica nanoparticles with adjustable particle size within the range of 100-300 nm can be prepared, and the nanoparticles after the suspension emulsion evaporation self-assembly are distributed in a close-packed hexagonal structure due to the monodisperse characteristic of the nano silica particles. The porous carbon material with the inverse opal structure is prepared by further using an isovolumetric impregnation method and using resol as a raw material through calcination and etching treatment, and the activated porous carbon material can be used as an electrode material for a supercapacitor.

title_en: Non-touch type motion sensor based on heterogeneous interface regulation and control and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a preparation method of a non-touch type motion sensor based on heterogeneous interface regulation, which comprises the steps of providing a heterogeneous interface flexible film material as a base material of the non-touch type motion sensor, detecting the heterogeneous interface flexible film material, constructing the non-touch type flexible motion sensor based on heterogeneous interface regulation by adopting the heterogeneous interface flexible film material with qualified detection, expanding the non-touch type flexible motion sensor based on heterogeneous interface regulation to a three-dimensional space, and verifying the direction identification capability of the non-touch type three-dimensional flexible motion sensor. The application aims to solve the problems of short service life of a device and poor stability of sensing performance of a touch sensor while pursuing high sensing performance, and solves the problems of high cost and complex structure of a sensor construction method with high sensing performance so as to meet the application requirements in the field of man-machine interaction of flexible touch sensors.

title_en: Selective antioxidant nano-enzyme and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a selective antioxidant nano-enzyme, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the selective antioxidant nano-enzyme is a Prussian blue analogue co-doped with zinc and copper, and zinc ions and copper ions are distributed in a lattice structure of the Prussian blue analogue. According to the invention, zinc ions and copper ions are doped in the lattice structure of the Prussian blue analog, so that the selective regulation and control of the same catalytic path are realized, and active oxygen is effectively removed, thereby showing good application prospects in treatment or prevention of radioactive heart diseases.

title_en: High-transmittance ultraviolet down-conversion film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-transmittance ultraviolet down-conversion film and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of photovoltaic glass. The film comprises a silicon dioxide bottom layer and a silicon oxide-cerium oxide composite surface layer which are arranged in a laminated mode, wherein cerium oxide exists in the form of CeO  2 @SiO 2  core-shell structure nano particles. According to the invention, through the cooperation of the functions of bottom layer antireflection and surface layer ultraviolet down conversion, the high transmittance of 94% in the visible light region is realized, the ultraviolet light is effectively absorbed and down-converted into visible light, and the transmittance of the ultraviolet UVB wave band is as low as 0.04%. The invention has the triple functions of ultraviolet protection, visible light anti-reflection and light energy compensation, can obviously reduce ultraviolet induced attenuation of the photovoltaic module, improves the sunlight utilization rate, and is suitable for surface modification of photovoltaic glass.

title_en: Piezoelectric monocrystal MEMS pressure sensor and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a piezoelectric monocrystalline MEMS pressure sensor and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of MEMS technology and piezoelectric materials. The sensor comprises an electrode layer, a piezoelectric layer, a structural layer and a load acting layer which are sequentially arranged from top to bottom. The electrode layer comprises interdigital electrodes and reflecting grids, the electrode layer is designed according to the wavelength lambda/4 of sound waves, the piezoelectric layer adopts piezoelectric monocrystalline materials as sensitive films, the structural layer comprises a closed cavity formed by etching, and the load acting layer is a flexible silicon substrate. According to the application, a force transmission path with back stress and front response is realized through a pneumatic coupling mechanism, and after external pressure acts on a load acting layer, the static pressure of air flow in a closed cavity is changed to be uniformly transmitted to a piezoelectric layer, so that the piezoelectric layer is driven to deform and cause the frequency deviation of the surface acoustic wave. The design abandons the traditional thimble type force transmission structure, avoids the problem of stress concentration, remarkably improves the sensitivity, linearity and integration of the device, and simultaneously expands the application in the field of air pressure detection.

title_en: Preparation process of high-carbon ferrochrome based on plasma spheroidization technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation process of high-carbon ferrochrome based on a plasma spheroidization technology, and belongs to the technical field of powder metallurgy. The process comprises the steps of crushing and ball-milling high-carbon ferrochrome blocks to obtain prefabricated powder, adding tannic acid, urea, nickel acetate tetrahydrate and citric acid for coating, spray-drying, pre-reducing and carbonizing in an argon-hydrogen atmosphere, then sending into a radio-frequency induction coupled plasma torch for spheroidizing, realizing in-situ nanostructure growth in an argon-hydrogen-acetylene mixed atmosphere, reducing nickel acetate into simple substance nickel nanoparticles with catalytic activity under the action of hydrogen and carbon monoxide, cooling, grading and inert packaging to obtain high-sphericity high-carbon ferrochrome-based core-shell structure spherical powder with low oxygen content. The process flow of the invention is continuous and controllable, can effectively improve the powder fluidity, bulk density, hardness and corrosion resistance, and is suitable for the fields of additive manufacturing, thermal spraying, powder metallurgy forming and the like.

title_en: Dye molecule for realizing NIR-II absorption and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dye molecule for realizing NIR-II absorption, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of near infrared two-region biological materials. The dye molecules disclosed in the invention pass through thiophene Triphenylamine is a strong electron donor, TQ is taken as an acceptor, indole is taken as an anchor point of B-N coordination, and B-N coordination based on TQ is constructed to obtain dye molecules, wherein the nano particles prepared by self-assembling the B-N coordination molecules based on TQ and amphiphilic polymer DSPE-PEG2000 show Gao Guangre conversion efficiency of 68% under the excitation of 1060 nm laser, can be used for photoacoustic imaging and photothermal treatment, and is used as novel NIR The II small molecular photothermal agent has good application prospect in accurate diagnosis and treatment of cancers.

title_en: PMMA composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a PMMA composite material, a preparation method and application thereof, which belongs to the technical field of high polymer materials, and the PMMA composite material is prepared by introducing carbon nano tubes, nano tungsten oxide particles and nano platinum particles with specific sizes into a PMMA matrix, when the light-emitting diode is applied to PMMA optical filters, lower spectral neutrality and photoaging stability can be realized under different light transmittance, meanwhile, the scratch resistance is excellent, and the comprehensive performance is good.

title_en: Microbridge structure, preparation method thereof and uncooled infrared microbolometer
abstract_en: The invention provides a micro-bridge structure, a preparation method thereof and an uncooled infrared micro-bolometer, and belongs to the technical field of micro-electromechanical systems and infrared detection. The micro-bridge structure comprises two anchor posts, two supporting bridge legs, a bridge deck and an umbrella surface which are diagonally arranged. Each supporting bridge leg is composed of a plurality of longitudinal sections and a plurality of transverse sections which are alternately connected and connected end to end, the extending direction of the longitudinal sections forms an included angle larger than 45 degrees relative to the horizontal plane, and the extending direction of the transverse sections is parallel to the horizontal plane. One end of the supporting bridge leg is connected with an anchor post, the other end is connected with the end part of the bridge deck to suspend the bridge deck. The design is characterized in that the long and thin characteristics of the bridge legs are maintained so as to ensure low heat conduction and high heat isolation performance, and meanwhile, the residual stress born by the bridge legs is obviously reduced by utilizing Gao Jiemian moment of inertia of the longitudinal section, so that the mechanical stability and the deformation resistance of the micro-bridge structure are improved, and the problem that the structural stability and the thermal performance of the traditional horizontal bridge legs are difficult to be compatible is solved. The invention also provides a corresponding preparation method.

title_en: High-sensitivity and quick-response hydrogen sensor based on palladium monoatomic doping and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of trace gas leakage detection, in particular to a high-sensitivity fast-response hydrogen sensor based on palladium monoatomic doping, and a preparation method and application thereof, and the high-sensitivity fast-response hydrogen sensor comprises the following steps: preparing an indium hydroxide material by utilizing indium ions, absolute ethyl alcohol, ammonia water and deionized water, doping palladium ions in the indium hydroxide solution to obtain a palladium ion doped indium hydroxide solution, reducing by utilizing sodium borohydride, centrifuging to obtain a palladium cluster doped indium hydroxide material, calcining the palladium cluster doped indium hydroxide composite material at a high temperature to obtain a palladium monoatomic doped indium oxide composite material, and finally transferring the palladium monoatomic doped indium oxide to the surface of an electrode substrate to obtain the hydrogen sensor. By improving the key process, the invention can effectively solve the problems of poor selectivity and slower response speed of the palladium nanoparticle doped hydrogen sensor when the pure indium oxide gas sensor detects hydrogen, and realize rapid and high-sensitivity trace detection of hydrogen.

title_en: Three-dimensional network structure metal complex crystal and method for determining molecular structure of organic compound using same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a novel metal complex crystal having pores arranged in a regular order, and an X-ray structural analysis sample can be formed by fixing an organic compound in the pores. The metal complex crystal of the present disclosure is composed of a metal ion and a ligand comprising a carboxylic acid ligand (c) and a pyridine ligand (p) in a combination selected from the group consisting of [ I ] compound (c 1) and compound (p 1), [ II ] compound (c 1) and compound (p 2), [ III ] compound (c 2) and compound (p 2), and [ IV ] compound (c 2) and compound (p 3).

title_en: Fork-chip device architecture in standard cells with backside gate strips
abstract_en: A fork-type transistor cell having a nanoplate (420) is disclosed, the shared gate (430 a,430 b) and source/drain regions of the fork-type transistor cell being separated by a dielectric wall (440). The cell includes backside contacts, namely backside gate strap contact (465A), backside through contact, and direct backside contact (BSC). The gate contacts only from outside the top (470, 475) and only on one side of the dielectric wall (440). The backside contacts overcome the gate and contact obstruction problems of conventional forked-plate cells.

title_en: Preparation and sepsis-resistant application of iron metabolism regulation carbon dot material
