abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a functionalized carbon dot material for regulating iron metabolism and application of the functionalized carbon dot material in resisting sepsis, wherein diethylenetriamine pentaacetic acid and spermidine are used as reaction precursors, and the solid functionalized carbon dot material rich in specific surface functional groups is obtained through 180 ℃ hydrothermal synthesis reaction and dialysis purification after being mixed in ultrapure water. The carbon dot material has high recognition specificity and stable chelating ability for iron ions in a complex physiological environment, and can induce methicillin-resistant staphylococcus aureus and escherichia coli to continuously lack iron by directly chelating iron ions in bacteria on one hand, inhibit normal growth and cause bacterial death by inhibiting the normal growth of the methicillin-resistant staphylococcus aureus and escherichia coli on the other hand, promote organism macrophages to be polarized from a pro-inflammatory phenotype to an anti-inflammatory phenotype in application of sepsis resistance. The invention realizes the synergistic effect of antibiosis and immunoregulation through iron metabolism regulation, obviously reduces the multi-organ inflammation injury caused by sepsis and reduces biochemical indexes.

title_en: Method for preparing MXene material by taking metal oxide as etchant
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for preparing an MXene material by taking metal oxide as an etchant, which belongs to the field of preparation of two-dimensional layered materials MXene, takes MAX phase as a precursor, and (3) taking bismuth trioxide as an etchant, and etching the A atomic layer in the MAX phase by utilizing Bi  3+  in the molten Bi  2 O 3  at a high temperature to finally prepare the MXene material. The MXene material prepared by the invention has rich surface-O functional groups, and has better adsorption capacity on polysulfide compared with common MXene, so that the MXene material has wide application prospect in the field of lithium-sulfur batteries.

title_en: Preparation method of small-size silica nanoparticles with different rigidities
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of nano biotechnology, and particularly relates to a preparation method of small-size silica nanoparticles with different rigidities. The method comprises the following steps of 1, modifying water of a soft template, namely wrapping the soft template by using a cationic surfactant solution to form nano emulsion, wherein the soft template is insoluble in water, and the cationic surfactant is a hydrophilic cationic surfactant. And 2, growing silicon, namely adding silane into the nano emulsion, reacting at the pH=7-8 and 25-30 ℃, and obtaining the silicon dioxide nano particles with different rigidities by adjusting the dosage of the silane and the dosage ratio of the cationic surfactant to the soft template. The invention reduces the particle size to below 60 nm by using a soft template method, and develops a series of small-size silica nanoparticles with different rigidities. The invention can effectively improve the blood brain barrier penetrating power of the nano particles and the effective accumulation of the nano particles in the brain by optimizing the hardness regulation and control.

title_en: Quantum dot nanoparticle with composite structure and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses quantum dot nano particles with a composite structure, a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of quantum dot materials. The invention utilizes the halogen ion of rare earth halide and the metal ion on the surface of the quantum dot to form coordination bond, the rare earth ion fills the electron defect on the surface of the quantum dot, realizes surface passivation, improves the quantum yield, forms a rare earth halide modification layer on the surface of the quantum dot, optimizes the interface compatibility of the quantum dot and a subsequent metal oxide coating layer, avoids the agglomeration and fluorescence quenching of the coating layer, and compactly coats the modified quantum dot through the metal oxide to form the quantum dot nano particle protected by the rare earth halide-metal oxide double layer. The two-step modification is carried out under mild conditions, the raw materials are easy to obtain, the operation is simple, the surface modification of the rare earth halide can obviously improve the solid quantum yield of the quantum dot, the metal oxide coating realizes high-efficiency water-oxygen barrier, the double-layer modification cooperatively improves the optical performance and the stability of the quantum dot, and the method is suitable for large-scale production.

title_en: Magneto-electric coupling test method with high sensitivity
abstract_en: A method for testing magneto-electric coupling with high sensitivity includes preparing multiple magneto-electric sensor units with basically same performance on single chip, connecting top electrode of one unit to bottom electrode of the next unit, applying alternating magnetic field and adjustable DC magnetic field, setting working point in linear response region of magneto-electric voltage coefficient by sweep frequency, carrying out phase-sensitive detection demodulation on serial output signal by phase-locked amplifier based on frequency of alternating magnetic field, calculating magneto-electric voltage coefficient and equivalent magnetic noise according to output voltage, alternating magnetic field and material thickness. The method fundamentally improves the signal-to-noise ratio, breaks the sensitivity bottleneck of the traditional method on weak signal detection, enhances the front-end signal, better realizes noise suppression, improves the application range and improves the practicability.

title_en: Microsensor with protective substance
abstract_en: The invention relates to a microsensor (10) for detecting a measurement variable, comprising a substrate (14) which is formed from a layer structure in a normal direction (12), at least one sensor element (18) and a carrier element (22) which detects a measurement variable, wherein the carrier element is at least largely released from the substrate (14) by means of a lateral free region (20) and comprises the sensor element (18), wherein a gel-like protective substance (28) is introduced above the sensor element (18) in the normal direction (12) and at least in the lateral free region (20), wherein the protective substance can expand into a further lower free region (30) and/or a further lateral free region (46), which is not filled in each case by the protective substance (28), and wherein the further lower free region is arranged below the carrier element (22) in the normal direction (12) and wherein the further lateral free region is introduced in a laterally offset manner relative to the lateral free region (20).

title_en: CO (carbon monoxide)2Method for preparing high-strength and high-toughness alumina aerogel by induction
abstract_en: The application provides a method for preparing high-strength and high-toughness alumina aerogel by CO  2  induction, belonging to the field of inorganic nano porous materials. The method comprises the steps of dissolving an aluminum source, a crystal form control agent and a crosslinking accelerator in a first anhydrous alcohol solvent to perform reflux reaction to obtain a first solution, mixing deionized water with a second anhydrous alcohol solvent to obtain a second solution, dropwise adding the second solution into the first solution under the stirring condition to obtain a composite precursor sol, performing supercritical CO  2  induction treatment on the composite precursor sol to obtain a wet gel blank, and drying the wet gel blank to obtain the high-strength alumina aerogel. According to the application, the synergistic combination of the crystal form control agent and the crosslinking accelerator is introduced into the precursor sol, and the supercritical CO  2  is adopted to induce the treatment to realize the crosslinking-crystallization coupling reaction in one step, so that two problems of slow gelation and network brittleness in the traditional process are fundamentally solved.

title_en: Quantum sensor chip packaging structure capable of realizing wafer-level plane co-packaging
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quantum sensor chip packaging structure capable of realizing wafer-level plane co-packaging, which comprises a micro-manufactured atomic gas chamber, a light source chip assembly and a light detection chip assembly, wherein a reflecting element is integrated in the micro-manufactured atomic gas chamber and is used for carrying out optical path adjustment on light beams entering the micro-manufactured atomic gas chamber, the light source chip assembly and the light detection chip assembly are supported on a packaging substrate through micro-bump assemblies and are respectively and directly electrically interconnected with the packaging substrate through the micro-bump assemblies, the micro-bump assemblies comprise a plurality of micro-bumps, the distribution mode of the micro-bumps is used for realizing the purposes of supporting the supporting function and the electrical interconnection, the sizes of the micro-bumps for supporting the micro-manufactured atomic gas chamber and/or the light source chip assembly and/or the light detection chip assembly are adjustable, and the optical paths of the micro-manufactured atomic gas chamber can be regulated and controlled through the combination of the micro-bumps with different sizes, so that the plane co-packaging of the micro-manufactured atomic gas chamber and other quantum sensor key components can be realized.

title_en: Silicon-carbon negative electrode material of lithium battery and production process thereof
abstract_en: The material is composed of silicon carbon particles, carbon nano tubes, a conductive agent, a modified PAA elastic binder and trace metal lithium, wherein a buffer layer is formed on the surfaces of the silicon carbon particles by winding the carbon nano tubes in situ through a dry method, si-N-C covalent bonds are formed between the carbon nano tubes and the silicon carbon particles through laser induction, and screening type pore channels are formed in the silicon carbon particles and load the metal lithium to realize in-situ prelithiation. The production process comprises the steps of dry winding, laser induction, pore canal preparation, in-situ prelithiation and mixed pulping, the invention synchronously solves the core problems of volume expansion, interface cracking and low initial efficiency of the existing silicon-carbon anode material, improves the cycle stability and energy density of the battery, simplifies the process, adapts to mass production, reduces the production cost and has good industrial application value.

title_en: Bionic nano synergistic medicine for treating atherosclerosis and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of pharmaceutical preparations, and in particular relates to a bionic nano-preparation, a preparation method thereof, a bionic nano-synergistic medicament for treating atherosclerosis and application thereof. The bionic nano preparation provided by the invention comprises nano particles formed by self-assembly of a dimer prodrug, wherein the dimer prodrug has a chemical structure shown in a formula (I), is formed by lysine-tyrosine-cysteine tripeptide (KYC) and an aryl thioketal small molecule linker (ATK), and realizes covalent connection by chemical reaction of two molecules of KYC and one molecule of ATK. The bionic nano preparation with vascular plaque targeted delivery and responsive drug release properties is constructed while the ultra-high drug loading self-assembly of the MPO inhibitor such as the hydrophilic short peptide KYC is realized, the neogenesis of the aging cells is effectively blocked, and the precise reversal of the plaque is realized by combining and co-carrying the aging cell lysis medicament and assisting in a neutrophil membrane carrier bionic strategy in a synergistic manner.

title_en: Passive wireless multi-parameter sensor, packaging structure and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of passive wireless sensors, and relates to a passive wireless multi-parameter sensor, a packaging structure and a preparation method thereof, wherein the passive wireless multi-parameter sensor comprises a piezoelectric base and a substrate; the invention discloses a piezoelectric sensor, which comprises a piezoelectric substrate, a gradient cantilever beam, a front acceleration measuring reflecting grating, a back acceleration reference grating, a gradient cantilever beam structure and a front acceleration reference grating, wherein the upper surface of the piezoelectric substrate is sequentially provided with a bidirectional IDT, the front acceleration measuring reflecting grating and the front acceleration reference grating from left to right, the substrate exposes the piezoelectric substrate below the front acceleration measuring reflecting grating and the front acceleration reference grating to form the cantilever beam, the cantilever beam is a gradient cantilever beam, the lower surface of the cantilever beam is sequentially provided with the back acceleration measuring reflecting grating and the back acceleration reference grating from left to right, the positions of the back acceleration measuring reflecting grating and the back acceleration reference grating are respectively symmetrical with the positions of the front acceleration measuring reflecting grating and the front acceleration reference grating relative to the cantilever beam, the width of the gradient cantilever beam structure is changed in a gradient manner along the length direction of the beam, and the whole sensitivity of the sensor is improved, and the front and back differential structure provides high-quality electrical signal processing capacity.

title_en: Lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode material, preparation method thereof, positive electrode plate, battery and power utilization device
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of batteries, and discloses an O2-phase lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode material, a preparation method thereof, a positive electrode plate, a battery and an electric device. The chemical formula of the lithium cobaltate positive electrode material is Li  a Na b Co 1‑c M c O 2‑d N d , wherein M is at least one of Al, la, ti, W, nb, zr, sb, Y, ni, mn, mg, mo, sn, in, ta, ir, si, B, ca, V, zn, sm, eu, er, P, N is at least one of F, S, cl, a is more than or equal to 0.9 and less than or equal to 1, b is more than or equal to 0.004, c is more than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 0.2, D is more than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 0.1, and the crystallite size D of the crystal face (002) of the lithium cobaltate positive electrode material is 64 nm-135 nm. The lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode material has excellent specific discharge capacity and cycle performance, and is beneficial to improving the electrochemical performance of a battery.

title_en: Electric field-thermal field synergistic optimization gallium oxide power device based on nanocrystalline diamond passivation and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric field-thermal field collaborative optimization gallium oxide power device based on nanocrystalline diamond passivation and a preparation method thereof, which mainly solve the problems of serious heat accumulation in a gate-drain region, concentrated surface electric field, single function of a top functional layer and influence on gate control characteristics of a large-area coverage structure of the traditional device. The device comprises a substrate, a buffer layer, a gallium oxide active layer, an MOS gate medium, a top P-type nanocrystalline diamond passivation heat expansion layer, a drain side interval region, a second passivation layer, a heat expansion metal layer and a metal electrode, wherein the MOS gate medium is reserved in a channel region, the contact top P-type nanocrystalline diamond passivation heat expansion layer is locally arranged on the surface of an n-drift region between the drain side of a gate and the drain, and the second passivation layer and the independent heat expansion metal layer are sequentially formed above the MOS gate medium. According to the invention, through the cooperative optimization of electric field regulation and thermal diffusion, electric field concentration and thermal accumulation are effectively inhibited, and the stability and reliability of the device are remarkably improved.

title_en: Long afterglow/nuclear magnetic nano probe for miRNA-21 signal amplification based on APE1 amplification and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an APE 1-based long-afterglow/nuclear magnetic nano probe for amplifying miRNA-21 signals, which is prepared by connecting the surface of long-afterglow nano particles with amino-modified DNA1 through an amide coupling reaction to obtain long-afterglow nano particles-DNA 1, modifying amino-substituted hydroquinone (HQ-N  3 ) on the surface of the magnetic nano particles, then carrying out click chemistry reaction with alkynyl-modified DNA2 to obtain magnetic nano particles@HQ-N  3  -DNA2, and assembling the long-afterglow nano particles-DNA 1 and the magnetic nano particles@HQ-N  3  -DNA2 through hybridization of two DNA, wherein the nucleotide sequence of the DNA1 is CGCCAGTTGT (SEQ ID NO. 1), and the nucleotide sequence of the DNA2 is GCGGTCAACATCA/dSpacer/GTCTGATA. The probe can be specifically triggered by miRNA-21 in a tumor microenvironment, realizes signal amplification through an APE1 enzyme-mediated mechanism, combines the high signal-to-noise ratio advantage of long afterglow imaging with the deep tissue imaging capability of nuclear magnetic resonance imaging, and realizes high-sensitivity, specific and real-time dynamic visual monitoring of miRNA-21.

title_en: Water-soluble fluorescent probe and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fluorescent sensing materials, in particular to a water-soluble fluorescent probe and a preparation method and application thereof. The fluorescent probe is formed by compounding water-soluble Perovskite Quantum Dots (PQDs) and zirconium-based metal organic framework materials (UIO-66). According to the invention, PQDs is loaded in a pore canal of UiO-66 by an in-situ growth method, and the aggregation of quantum dots is inhibited by utilizing the space domain-limiting effect of the UiO-66, so that the fluorescence intensity and the light stability are enhanced. The probe showed bright green fluorescence in aqueous solution, and had high sensitivity and high selectivity for ammonia (NH  3 ), dimethylamine (DMA) and Trimethylamine (TMA) detection at a concentration of 1 mg/mL at ph=5. The fluorescent probe prepared by the invention can be used for rapidly detecting the freshness of foods such as meat and the like, and has the advantages of low detection limit, high response speed, strong anti-interference capability and the like.

title_en: Back contact battery front plate, preparation method thereof and photovoltaic battery assembly
abstract_en: The application provides a back contact battery front plate, a preparation method thereof and a photovoltaic battery assembly. The back contact battery front plate comprises an antireflection layer, a substrate layer, a weather-resistant coating and a packaging adaptation layer which are sequentially stacked, wherein the material of the antireflection layer is selected from nanoscale inorganic oxides, the surface of one side of the antireflection layer, far away from the substrate layer, is provided with an array arrangement concave-convex structure, the reflectivity of the antireflection layer in the wavelength range of 400-1100 nm is less than or equal to 2%, the material of the substrate layer is selected from glass, the light transmittance of the substrate layer is more than or equal to 92% and the haze is less than or equal to 0.1%, the material of the weather-resistant coating comprises fluorine-containing polyurethane, an ultraviolet absorber and an antioxidant, and the material of the packaging adaptation layer is selected from silane grafted modified ethylene-vinyl acetate. The back contact battery front plate provided by the application has the advantages of high light utilization rate, good weather resistance and high packaging yield, and provides a key technical support for high-efficiency and stable high-power photovoltaic battery components.

title_en: Carbon dot for photothermal treatment of tumor and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The carbon dot is prepared by mixing citric acid as a carbon source and urea as a nitrogen source in a molar concentration ratio of 1:7 and performing hydrothermal reaction at 140 ℃ for 4 hours. The obtained carbon dots (NCDs-4) have obvious near infrared absorption near 610 nm, zeta potential is +19.04 mV to +21.12 mV, the photo-thermal conversion efficiency reaches 29.8% under 660 nm laser (1.0W/cm  2 ), and the performance is not attenuated after 5 times of photo-thermal circulation. 400. mu.g/mL of NCDs-4 solution can be warmed to about 35℃in 10 minutes with laser irradiation, whereas cell experiments show that dark toxicity is still very low (cell viability > 85%) at concentrations as high as 1000. Mu.g/mL. In a 4T1 breast cancer-bearing mouse model, after 2 mg/mL carbon dot solution is injected in tumor and 660 nm laser irradiation is combined for 5 minutes, the tumor can be completely ablated, the tumor inhibition rate reaches 100%, and the mouse body weight is normal in the treatment process, and no obvious toxic or side effect is generated. The carbon dot is simple and green to prepare, has high-efficiency photo-thermal conversion performance and excellent biosafety, and has good clinical application prospect in the field of tumor photo-thermal treatment.

title_en: Manganese oxide nano material obtained through phase change-phase reduction and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a manganese oxide nano material obtained through phase change-phase reduction, a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the steps of 1) oxidizing carbon fibers, 2) placing the oxidized carbon fibers in a potassium permanganate solution for hydrothermal reaction to grow manganese dioxide nano sheets to obtain electrode sheets, 3) placing the electrode sheets in a manganese acetate solution for hydrothermal reaction to grow manganese dioxide/trimanganese tetraoxide nanospheres, 4) carrying out charge-discharge circulation on the manganese dioxide/trimanganese tetraoxide nanospheres under 0-1.2V, and 5) carrying out charge-discharge circulation on the electrode obtained in the 4) under-1.0-0V to obtain the manganese dioxide/trimanganese tetraoxide nanosphere electrode material. The phase reduction method is simple, and the cycle performance of the electrode material is improved by 120% when the material is recycled in the use process of the battery after reversible cycle, so that the performance of the manganese oxide electrode material is improved after the cycle performance is reduced.

title_en: Composite solid electrolyte, preparation method thereof and lithium ion battery
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of lithium ion batteries, and discloses a composite solid electrolyte, a preparation method thereof and a lithium ion battery. The composite solid electrolyte comprises carboxylated polyimide nanofiber membrane, inorganic solid electrolyte, lithium salt and binder. Wherein the carboxylated polyimide nanofiber membrane contains a repeating unit A shown in a formula (1) and a repeating unit B shown in a formula (2). The composite solid electrolyte takes the carboxylated polyimide nanofiber membrane as a framework, and takes the inorganic solid electrolyte as a filling medium, so that the composite solid electrolyte has higher room-temperature ion conductivity and lithium ion migration number, and the obtained lithium ion battery has higher cycling stability.

title_en: Preparation method of two-dimensional selenene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of two-dimensional selen, and belongs to the technical field of two-dimensional material preparation. The method comprises the steps of mixing bismuth, selenium, tellurium and potassium chloride powder, grinding uniformly to obtain composite precursor powder, placing the composite precursor powder between two silicon wafers to form a sandwich structure, placing the sandwich structure in a stainless steel clamping plate for locking and sealing to form a limited-domain growth cavity, placing the limited-domain growth cavity in a tube furnace, heating to 680-720 ℃ in an argon atmosphere for 25 minutes, preserving heat for 30-40 minutes for limited-domain vapor phase growth, and naturally cooling to room temperature to obtain the two-dimensional selen on the surfaces of the silicon wafers. The two-dimensional selen prepared by the method is triangular monocrystal, has the transverse dimension of 60 mu m and the thinnest thickness of about 0.6nm, has high and uniform controllable crystal quality, and can be applied to the fields of microelectronic devices, photoelectric sensing, energy devices, flexible robot touch sensors and the like.

title_en: Preparation method of quantum dot material capable of accurately regulating and controlling layer number of shell layers
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of semiconductor nano material synthesis, provides a preparation method of quantum dot material capable of accurately regulating and controlling the layer number of shell layers, and precisely controls the injection rate and each injection volume of Cd-Se precursor by an injection pump through a layer-by-layer injection method, and epitaxially growing CdSe shell layers on the CdS quantum dot cores layer by layer, and realizing accurate regulation and control of the number of shell atom layers by controlling the injection times, so that the CdS/CdSe quantum dots with 10 layers and 20 layers of CdSe shell layers are successfully prepared. The method overcomes the technical problem that the shell thickness of the anti-I type CdS/CdSe quantum dot is limited in the prior art, has the advantages of accurate and controllable layer number, uniform size, wide tunable range of absorption spectrum, excellent crystallization quality, high process repeatability and the like, and has wide application prospects in the fields of photocatalysis hydrogen production, biological imaging, photoelectric detectors, solar cells and the like.

title_en: Solar cell, preparation method thereof, solar cell and electric device
abstract_en: The invention provides a solar cell and a preparation method thereof, a solar cell and electric equipment, and relates to the technical field of solar energy. The solar cell is characterized in that a microstructure surface for light capture is arranged on the solar cell, the microstructure surface is a velvet-shaped surface formed by distributing a plurality of single pyramid structures, and nanometer conical depressions are arranged in the single pyramid structures. The solar cell has the advantages that the nanometer conical concave is arranged in the pyramid structure, so that the reflectivity is effectively reduced, the photon capturing efficiency and the carrier transmission path length are improved, the deposition uniformity of the anti-reflection layer is improved, and the photoelectric conversion efficiency and the overall performance of the solar cell are remarkably improved.

title_en: ZIF-8 doped calcium alginate gel membrane and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a ZIF-8 doped calcium alginate gel membrane, belongs to the technical field of membrane separation, and aims to optimize the nanofiltration separation performance of an organic solvent of the calcium alginate gel membrane. The preparation method comprises the steps of respectively dissolving zinc nitrate hexahydrate and 2-methylimidazole in methanol, reacting, centrifuging, washing and drying to obtain ZIF-8 nano particles, firstly mixing the ZIF-8 nano particles with sodium alginate in a dry state, grinding, dispersing the mixture in water to obtain mixed casting solution, scraping the casting solution on the surface of a non-woven fabric, and crosslinking and solidifying the casting solution through a calcium chloride aqueous solution to obtain the ZIF-8 doped calcium alginate gel film. The membrane can improve the solvent permeability while keeping high dye retention rate, is soaked in ethanol and N, N-dimethylformamide for 30 days, and can keep the retention rate of Congo red in ethanol above 95%, and the change rate of the ethanol permeation flux is not more than 10%, so that the membrane can be used for nanofiltration separation of organic solvents.

title_en: Top sacrificial strap structure for fully-surrounding gate device architecture
abstract_en: A Field Effect Transistor (FET) structure and method of manufacturing the same are disclosed. In one aspect, a FET structure includes a vertical metal gate disposed between a first source/drain (S/D) Epitaxial (EPI) structure and a second S/D EPI structure, and having a set of vertically stacked horizontal channels, all but the top channel connecting the first S/D EPI structure and the second S/D EPI structure through the vertical metal gate. A high K dielectric material is disposed between the vertical metal gate and each of the horizontal channels, and a vertical spacer layer separates the vertical metal gate from the S/D EPI structure. A low K dielectric structure is disposed over a topmost portion of the vertical metal gate and fills a recess over the vertical metal gate and between the first vertical spacer layer and the second vertical spacer layer.

title_en: Toothpaste capable of diminishing inflammation, relieving, repairing and protecting tooth enamel and resisting sensitivity and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of oral care products, and discloses toothpaste for diminishing inflammation, relieving, repairing enamel and resisting sensitivity and a preparation method thereof. The toothpaste is formed by compounding a targeted anti-inflammatory and antibacterial unit, a precise enamel repairing and anti-sensitive unit and a mild auxiliary material system. The targeting anti-inflammatory and antibacterial unit is a nano liposome with double targeting ligands modified on the surface, the natural anti-inflammatory and antibacterial compound composition is embedded in the nano liposome, the targeting anti-inflammatory and antibacterial compound composition can act on cariogenic bacteria and gingival inflammation sites in a targeting way, the slow-release activity of the biological membrane is penetrated, the precise repairing unit is a biomimetic amino acid modified amorphous calcium phosphate nano cluster, the biomimetic amino acid modified amorphous calcium phosphate nano cluster can induce ordered mineralization in situ, the repair and long-acting anti-sensitivity of the enamel structure are realized, and the auxiliary material system adopts a low-irritation foaming agent and a low-abrasion friction agent and is adapted to sensitive and fragile oral environments. The invention realizes the full-link synergistic effects of bacteriostasis and anti-inflammation, enamel repair, sensitivity resistance and moth resistance, has excellent safety and storage stability, and the preparation process is compatible with the conventional paste preparation equipment, and is easy for industrial production.

title_en: Platinum-modified bismuth vanadate nanomaterial and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a platinum modified bismuth vanadate nanomaterial and a preparation method and application thereof. The nano material comprises bismuth vanadate (BiVO  4 ) nano particles, platinum (Pt) nano particles deposited on the surface of the bismuth vanadate and a surface functionalization system coated on the outermost layer. The nano material can not only directly induce tumor cell apoptosis through photodynamic therapy, but also trigger immunogenic cell death and release damage related molecular modes, thereby promoting dendritic cell maturation and activating systemic anti-tumor T cell immune response. The invention provides a new therapeutic strategy for solving the tumor hypoxia and immune activation deficiency.

title_en: Method for screening cholelithiasis treatment targets based on Mendelian randomization and preparing cyclopamine derived water-soluble carbon quantum dots
abstract_en: A method for screening cholelithiasis treatment targets and preparing cyclopamine derived water-soluble carbon quantum dots based on Mendelian randomization belongs to the field of cholelithiasis medicines. The invention aims to solve the technical problems that the traditional method mainly depends on differential expression analysis and literature report and is easy to be interfered by confounding factors in the field of drug target screening. The invention solves the problem that the application of cyclopamine is limited by poor water solubility. The screening method comprises the steps of obtaining cholelithiasis related gene expression profile and carrying out cluster analysis, screening risk genes by applying Mendelian randomization analysis, and predicting targeted small molecule drugs. The invention adds cyclopamine powder into ultrapure water, carries out ultrasonic dispersion, carries out hydrothermal reaction, cools to room temperature after the reaction is finished, and purifies to obtain the nano-drug, wherein the water solubility of the nano-drug is improved, and CCK-8 experiments show that the cytotoxicity of the compound at the concentration of 8-32 mug/mL is lower than that of free cyclopamine. The screening method can avoid the interference of confounding factors in the traditional observational study.

title_en: Seed auxiliary synthesis method for Pt-Ni hollow nano structure
abstract_en: Aspects of the present disclosure generally relate to methods of preparing nanocatalyst structures. More specifically, aspects of the present disclosure relate to the preparation of hollow nanocubes by a seed-assisted synthesis method. In some aspects, a method for preparing hollow nanostructures includes preparing a platinum (Pt) seed solution. The method further includes introducing a metal source comprising a metal compound into the Pt seed solution to form a solution of core-shell nanocubes. The core-shell nanocubes comprise a Pt-metal alloy. The method further includes etching an interior portion of at least one of the core-shell nanocubes to form a hollow nanocube structure.

title_en: Method for synthesizing short b-axis ZSM-5 nanosheets without template
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of molecular sieve synthesis, and discloses a method for synthesizing a short b-axis ZSM-5 nanosheet without a template agent. According to the invention, the growth dynamics of the crystal is regulated and controlled through an aluminum source and the alkalinity of a system, and the limited growth of the molecular sieve along the b-axis direction can be realized under the condition that a template agent is not added, so that the short b-axis lamellar ZSM 5 molecular sieve nanosheets are obtained. The ZSM-5 molecular sieve has the characteristics of 600-5000 nm of grain length, 150-500 nm of grain width and 100-300 nm of b-axis thickness, has high crystallinity and short b-axis, and effectively shortens the intra-crystal mass transfer distance. The method does not need an organic template agent, has low cost, is environment-friendly, simple and strong in process controllability, and is suitable for industrial preparation.

title_en: High-temperature radiation cooling micro-groove-micro-nano mastoid structure with top projection high reflection, manufacturing process and radiation cooling equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-temperature radiation cooling micro-groove-micro-nano mastoid structure with high reflection of top projection, a manufacturing process and radiation cooling equipment, belonging to the technical field of heat transfer, wherein the structure comprises a groove-shaped substrate, a high reflection coating and a micro-nano mastoid radiation structure; the groove-shaped substrate is a substrate with grooves on the surface, the grooves are arranged in an unidirectional comb-shaped array or an orthogonal array on the surface of the substrate, a high-reflection coating is arranged on the top projection surface of the grooves, a micro-nano mastoid radiation structure is arranged on the non-top projection surface of the grooves, and the micro-nano mastoid radiation structure comprises micro-scale core mastoids, micro-scale multi-level mastoids clustered on the surface of the core mastoids and nano-scale particles densely distributed on the surface of the multi-level mastoids. According to the invention, high reflection of solar radiation is realized through the high reflection coating on the top projection surface, the radiation emission of an infrared band is enhanced by utilizing the graded micro-nano mastoid radiation structure on the non-top projection surface, and the net radiation cooling power is obviously improved.

title_en: Nanometer silica flour apparatus for producing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a nanometer silicon powder production device, which relates to the technical field of powder production devices, and the key points of the technical proposal of the device comprise a plasma non-transfer arc torch group, a reaction kettle and a collector; the plasma non-transfer arc torch group is used for heating and evaporating the silicon powder raw material; the reaction kettle is used for cooling the heated and evaporated silicon powder raw material into nano silicon powder; the collector is used for collecting the nano silicon powder. The utility model adopts the coarse-grained silicon powder raw material, thereby achieving the purpose of reducing the raw material cost and avoiding the use and the generation of toxic and harmful gases in the production process; the prepared nano silicon powder has the effects of high purity, high controllability of particle size distribution, simple preparation process and high yield; and the purposes of large evaporation capacity of the silicon powder raw material, uniform distribution of the silicon powder raw material, avoidance of the problem of excessive anode loss caused by excessive power of a single plasma arc torch and increase of the heating interval to improve the evaporation rate of the silicon powder raw material are achieved by adopting a plurality of plasma arc torches.

title_en: Semiconductor device with composite passivation layer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a semiconductor device with a composite passivation layer, which comprises a semiconductor substrate, an electrode arranged on the semiconductor substrate and a composite passivation layer arranged on the semiconductor substrate and the electrode, wherein the composite passivation layer is provided with an opening exposing the electrode on the electrode; the composite passivation layer comprises a first nano deposition layer and a second nano deposition layer which are alternately arranged, wherein the growth rate of the first nano deposition layer is lower than that of the second nano deposition layer. The passivation layer with the nano composite structure is utilized to regulate and control the stress introduced by the device passivation process, and meanwhile, the passivation layer with the composite nano structure and high adhesiveness and coverage is adopted, so that the coverage of the passivation layer on the discontinuous area with the higher step is improved, and the reliability of the device is improved.

title_en: Electrolytic tank for producing high-purity nano alumina
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of electrolytic cells, and discloses an electrolytic cell for producing high-purity nano-alumina, which comprises a protection box body, wherein the protection box body is of a hollow structure with an open upper surface, the left side of the protection box body is fixedly connected with a power distribution controller, the right side of the protection box body is fixedly connected with a liquid discharge pipe, the outer side wall of the liquid discharge pipe is provided with a liquid discharge valve, the inner lower surface of the protection box body is fixedly connected with a fixed block, and the upper surface of the fixed block is fixedly connected with a cell body; the utility model discloses a set up simple structure, convenient to use can protect the cell body of reaction through the protection box that sets up, and is airtight with whole through the case lid simultaneously to and drive the puddler through the motor and rotate, the reaction material of be, can be before the reaction to abundant stirring, thereby make the reaction more complete.

title_en: High-purity nanometer selenium powder preparation system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a high-purity nanometer selenium powder preparation system, includes fluidized bed, high pure oxygen storage tank, defeated material and is responsible for, first atomizing device, second atomizing device, collection device and drying device, the fluidized bed is supporting to be provided with heating device, the fluidized bed bottom with high pure oxygen storage tank is connected, and the defeated material of fluidized bed top connection is responsible for, and the defeated material is responsible for transverse arrangement, first atomizing device and second atomizing device are followed defeated material direction interval arrangement that the defeated material was responsible for and all with the defeated material is responsible for the intercommunication, wherein first atomizing device is water atomizing device, and second atomizing device is reductant atomizing device, defeated material is responsible for end-to-end connection collection device, and drying device is connected to collection device's liquid outlet, and collection device's gas outlet is connected the high pure oxygen storage tank. The utility model relates to an uniqueness can obtain two kinds of products of red selenium or grey selenium as required to high pure oxygen can cyclic utilization, and easy operation is convenient, and resource utilization is high, and low in production cost is fit for using widely.

title_en: Novel snowflake-like micro-heating plate
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel snowflake-like micro-heating plate, the micro-heating plate constitute by basement, heating electrode, interdigital electrode and insulating layer. A heating electrode is arranged on the upper surface of the substrate; the lower surface of the heating electrode is in contact with the substrate, and the upper surface of the heating electrode is provided with an insulating layer; the lower surface of the insulating layer is in contact with the heating electrode, and the upper surface of the insulating layer is provided with an interdigital electrode. The width of the heating electrode is 10-30 mu m, and the thickness of the heating electrode is 200 nm. The utility model discloses a snowflake-like form heating electrode adopts the snowflake center sparse, and outside intensive structural feature has improved the temperature distribution homogeneity of the zone of heating, has reduced the difference in temperature, has reduced the influence of temperature environment factor to the gas sensor performance.

title_en: Wafer single-side corrosion protection clamp
abstract_en: The utility model provides a wafer single-side corrosion protection clamp which comprises an adsorption component and an anti-corrosion component, wherein the adsorption component comprises a vacuum chuck, an air guide groove fixedly formed in the outer edge surface of one side of the vacuum chuck, an air guide groove through hole and an air guide hole which respectively penetrate through the vacuum chuck, and the anti-corrosion component comprises a sealing clamping groove extending towards the peripheral direction along the geometric center of the air guide groove. The utility model effectively simplifies the operation process by a vacuum adsorption mode, is easy to realize automatic operation, completes the corrosion of a plurality of wafers at one time by a plurality of groups of vacuum chucks, and is suitable for the production and manufacture of large-scale MEMS devices.

title_en: Surface nanometer pattern wafer mould
abstract_en: The utility model provides a surface nano-pattern wafer die which comprises a 4-inch wafer and nano-columns arranged on the surface of the wafer, wherein the nano-columns are uniformly arranged in a square array, and the arrangement period of adjacent nano-columns is 1000 nm; compared with the prior art, the nano-pillar array which is uniformly arranged in the square array is adopted, and the period of the nano-pillars is set to be 1000nm, so that the nano-pillars are relatively close to the wavelength of visible light (400-.

title_en: Base material using nano fiber film as face film
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of facial masks, in particular to a base material of a facial mask made of a nanofiber membrane, which comprises nanofibers, wherein the outer wall of the opposite side of the nanofibers is fixedly connected with a non-woven fabric, the outer wall of one side of the nanofibers and two non-woven fabrics is provided with a first cut and two second cuts, the outer wall of the arc-shaped outer walls of the nanofibers and two non-woven fabrics is fixedly connected with a rubber ring, the outer wall of one side of the rubber ring is fixedly connected with a laminating adhesive, the outer wall of one side of the rubber ring is fixedly connected with an auxiliary seat, the utility model can pull a connecting shaft through a pull ring, drive a fixed rod to move through a connecting plate, drive an extrusion rod to be contacted with an extrusion plate through the fixed rod, drive the fixed plate to rotate around the rotating shaft for a certain angle under the action of the inclined plane of the extrusion plate, further realize the quick uncovering of the protective layer, and avoid the mutual contact and adhesion of the base material when uncovering the protective layer, the use experience of the user is improved.

title_en: Microphone chip, MEMS microphone and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The present application relates to a microphone chip, a MEMS microphone, and an electronic device. The microphone chip comprises a substrate, a diaphragm, a back plate and a protective layer; the substrate has first and second opposing surfaces; the protective layer is covered at one end of the first surface of the substrate, and the back plate and the vibrating diaphragm are sequentially arranged below the protective layer; at least two bonding pads are arranged on the protective layer; the back plate and the diaphragm are arranged at intervals to form a capacitor, and the back plate is provided with at least one first through hole. This application sets up the inoxidizing coating through one side at the backplate for the microphone is in encapsulation and use, and the foreign matter is difficult for falling into the clearance between backplate and the vibrating diaphragm through the through-hole on the backplate, has promoted the acoustic performance of microphone.

title_en: Efficient one-dimensional array micro-nano heterojunction wide-spectrum inorganic thin film solar cell
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-efficiency one-dimensional array micro-nano heterojunction broad spectrum inorganic thin film solar cell which comprises an FTO glass, wherein the top end of the FTO glass is fixedly connected with TiO 2 NAs, said TiO 2 External setting of Sb to NAs 2 S 3 Said Sb 2 S 3 The top end of the MEH-PPV is provided with a PEDOT/PSS, and the top end of the PEDOT/PSS is provided with an AU. The high-efficiency one-dimensional array micro-nanoThe heterojunction broad spectrum inorganic thin film solar cell is provided with Sb 2 S 3 And TiO 2 NAs, we prepared Sb-based using a solution-processed transition from amorphous to crystalline 2 S 3 /TiO 2 Inorganic solar cells of BHJs, in which Sb is 2 S 3 Being a bulk light absorbing layer of TiO 2 -NAs cuttage in body type Sb 2 S 3 In the layer, TiO as a direct transport channel for electrons 2 The nano rods and the nano wire arrays (NAs) are filled with appropriate inorganic light absorption materials to obtain high yield, the one-dimensional array micro-nano heterojunction high-efficiency inorganic thin film solar cell is obtained, high energy conversion efficiency is obtained, and the problem of low energy conversion efficiency is solved.

title_en: Airtight packaging structure of device with cavity
abstract_en: The utility model provides an airtight packaging structure with a cavity device, which comprises: a semiconductor component; a cover plate; a bonding layer located between the semiconductor component and the cover plate to bond the semiconductor component and the cover plate together; a first cavity located between the semiconductor component and the cover plate, surrounded by the bonding layer and completely sealed; the second cavity is positioned between the semiconductor component and the cover plate, positioned on one side of the first cavity and surrounded by the bonding layer and partially sealed; a communication hole communicating the second cavity and not completely sealed by the bonding layer; and a film layer for sealing the communication hole so that the second chamber is completely sealed. Compared with the prior art, the utility model can package MEMS devices with different working gas pressures and/or different gas composition requirements on the same wafer, thereby realizing the integration of multiple MEMS devices.

title_en: Three-dimensional film getter structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a three-dimensional film getter structure, which comprises a device layer, wherein the surface of the device layer comprises slope parts arranged in a wave shape, and a getter film layer is deposited on the surface along the slope parts. Compared with the traditional vertical structure surface film deposition process, the film getter with uniformity and strong adhesiveness is deposited more easily on the slope surface by depositing the film getter on the continuously fluctuant slope part, the effective area of the film getter is increased compared with the planar film deposition process, and the service life of a chip is prolonged.

title_en: Pressure sensor
abstract_en: The application provides a pressure sensor, has solved the not enough problem of pressure sensor's sensitivity and stability among the prior art. The embodiment of the application can prevent the piezoresistor unit from being influenced by the charges of the section of the piezoresistor unit or the surface charges accumulated to the sensor from the outside by arranging the shielding pattern above the piezoresistor unit. Meanwhile, the shielding pattern is connected to the substrate through the first through hole structure, so that charges can be introduced into the substrate (fixed potential), the influence of the charges on the piezoresistive region is reduced, and the stability of a detection result is improved.

title_en: MEMS micro-fluidic module device packaging structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an MEMS microfluidic module device packaging structure which comprises a resin organic substrate, a multi-channel upper cover and a lead protection part, wherein the resin organic substrate is provided with a front surface and a back surface which are opposite to each other, a chip assembly is connected to the front surface of the resin organic substrate, and the chip assembly is electrically connected with the resin organic substrate 1 through a lead. The scheme reduces the size of the packaging structure, further realizes miniaturization, and improves the integration level of chip packaging through packaging of various chip components and electronic elements.

title_en: Patterned substrate and epitaxial structure thereof
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a semiconductor field discloses a graphical substrate and epitaxial structure with micro-nano structure, have substrate body (1) of protruding structure (101) that micron order periodicity was arranged including the surface, it is adjacent have between protruding structure (101) keep apart slot (103) the whole surface of protruding structure (101) all distributes and has nanometer micro-structure (102) the same with its integrative structure and material. The micro-nano structure in the substrate is equivalent to increase the density of the protruding structure, the reflection surface area of the substrate is increased, and the light-emitting efficiency of the LED device is improved; the patterning proportion of the C surface of the substrate is increased, the lateral extension effect is improved, and the improvement of the internal quantum efficiency of an LED device is facilitated.

title_en: Hydrolysis hydrothermal reaction device for preparing nano zirconia
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hydrolysis hydrothermal reaction device for preparing nano zirconia, which comprises a reaction vessel, a heating control system and a pressure control system, wherein the reaction vessel is used for carrying out hydrolysis hydrothermal reaction to prepare the nano zirconia; the heating control system is connected with the reaction container and is used for heating the reaction container so as to control the temperature of the hydrolysis hydrothermal reaction; the pressure control system comprises an air inlet pipeline and an exhaust pipeline, the air inlet pipeline is connected with the reaction container and used for introducing gas into the reaction container, so that the gas can be used for bubbling and stirring materials in the reaction container, a gas-liquid-solid three-phase reaction interface can be formed, hydrogen chloride generated by reaction can be brought out, and the exhaust pipeline is connected with the reaction container and used for exhausting the gas in the reaction container. The utility model discloses can the effective control with improve reaction condition to promote nanometer zirconia's performance, accelerate reaction rate, shorten reaction time, improve preparation efficiency.

title_en: Energy-concerving and environment-protective nanometer silica apparatus for producing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an energy-concerving and environment-protective nanometer silica apparatus for producing, the device include the material storage tank, the material storage tank connect material feeding unit and plasma generator respectively. In the production of nano-scale silicon dioxide, the micro-scale SiO \8322isgasified by using high temperature of plasma, and sprayed into cold inert gas to be quenched to obtain 5-40 nm spherical SiO \8322particles, which are separated into products with different particle sizes by an air flow grading sieve. The device for producing silicon dioxide replaces the traditional gas phase method, sol-gel method and microemulsion method which have high energy consumption and complex process. The silicon dioxide is gasified by utilizing the inductively coupled electrodeless plasma technology, no pollution is caused, and the high-purity nano silicon dioxide is obtained.

title_en: Wafer level packaging structure and sensor
abstract_en: The application provides a wafer level packaging structure and a sensor, relates to the technical field of packaging of integrated circuits, and can improve the signal transmission precision of the wafer level sensor. The wafer level package structure includes a device wafer, a plurality of reference device regions, and a pad layer wafer. The reference device region is disposed on the device wafer and configured to dispose a reference device. The cushion layer wafer is arranged on the device wafer and comprises a plurality of cushion layer areas, and each cushion layer area comprises a first sub-part and a second sub-part; the second sub-portion is connected to the first sub-portion. One reference device area is arranged in the area defined by the first sub-portion, and the orthographic projection of the second sub-portion on the device wafer covers the reference device area. The wafer level packaging structure and the sensor are used for transmitting induction signals.

title_en: Silver nanowire heating window, camera module and shooting equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a silver-colored nano wire heating window, camera module and shooting equipment, silver-colored nano wire heating window includes: a window made of transparent material; the heating film is glued to the heating film of the window through optical cement, the heating film comprises a light-transmitting layer, a silver nanowire layer solidified on the light-transmitting layer and an electrode group coated on the silver nanowire layer, the end part of the electrode group is connected with a lead, and the optical cement is glued to the silver nanowire layer. And the transparent protective layer surrounds the heating film and is connected with the light transmission layer and the window in a curing manner. The heating film is fixed on the surface of the window, the heating area is large, and the heating is reliable. The silver nanowire layer is coated on the light transmission layer, and is attached to the window through the optical cement, so that the reliability is high, the thermal stability is good, and the service life is long. The transparent protective layer is fixedly connected with the euphotic layer and the window layer, and the whole size and specification are stable.

title_en: AlN ceramic-based four-cantilever bridged micro-hotplate gas sensor array
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an AlN ceramic-based four-cantilever bridge micro-hotplate gas sensor array, and aims to solve the problems of poor mechanical property, thermal interference and insufficient thermal stability of the conventional micro-hotplate sensor. The substrate in the AlN ceramic-based four-cantilever bridged micro-hotplate gas sensor array is provided with four cantilevers in a rectangular frame, the four cantilevers form a cross structure, the front face of each cantilever is provided with an interdigital signal electrode, the back face of each cantilever is provided with a heater electrode, the front face and the back face of each cantilever are symmetrically provided with the heater electrode and the signal electrode, a sensitive film is arranged between the electrodes of the signal electrodes to form a sensor array unit, wherein the heater electrode is of a serpentine structure, and the substrate is an AlN ceramic substrate. The heater electrode and the signal electrode are of platinum film structures, the positions of the heater electrode and the signal electrode are symmetrical in front and back, the pattern structure is realized through a double-sided flexible mechanical photoetching stripping process, and the AlN ceramic-based substrate has better mechanical property.

title_en: MEMS pressure sensor
abstract_en: The present utility model provides a MEMS pressure sensor comprising: a structural layer having a front side and a back side, the structural layer having formed thereon a sensitive structure, a strained thin film, a first conductive structure, and a second conductive structure; a third insulating layer disposed on the front surface of the structural layer; a plurality of conductive windows penetrating at least the third insulating layer from a side surface of the third insulating layer away from the structural layer to expose the second conductive structure; the conductive layer is filled in the conductive window and covers one side surface of the third insulating layer far away from the structural layer, the conductive layer is divided into a plurality of conductive channels which are spaced from each other at the periphery of the corresponding area of the conductive window, one end of each conductive channel is positioned in the corresponding conductive window and is electrically contacted with the exposed second conductive structure, and the other end of each conductive channel is electrically contacted with the corresponding metal electrode. Compared with the prior art, the utility model not only can improve the performance of the sensor, but also can reduce the difficulty of processing technology, improve the yield of products and reduce the cost of products.

title_en: Liquid phase synthesis equipment for nano material
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a liquid phase synthesis device for nano materials, which comprises the following components: a three-neck flask (1), wherein a left inclined opening (2) is communicated with a central control panel (5) through a first silicone tube (4) with a first switch valve (3), and then is communicated with a steel bottle air source (7) through an air delivery pipe (6), an indirect joint (8) is communicated with an injector (11) through a second silicone tube (10) with a second switch valve (9), the middle joint (8) is also connected to an anti-suck-back conical flask (14) through a third silicone tube (12) with a third switch valve (13), a right inclined opening (15) is communicated with a vacuum pump (18) through a fourth silicone tube (17) with a fourth switch valve (16), and the bottom of the three-neck flask (1) is surrounded by a heating jacket (19); the heating sleeve (19), the steel cylinder air source (7) and the continuous injector (11) are respectively connected to the central control panel (5) through a first lead (20), the air pipe (6) and a second lead (21); the anti-suck-back conical flask (14) and the purifying conical flask (22) are connected together through a fifth silicone tube (23), and the purifying conical flask (22) is also provided with an air outlet (24) for discharging purified gas.

title_en: MEMS pressure sensor
abstract_en: Disclosed is a MEMS pressure sensor, comprising: a substrate; a thermopile structure located on the substrate; a bonding layer on the substrate surrounding the thermopile structure; the transparent layer is positioned on the surface of the bonding layer, which is far away from the substrate, and a groove is formed in the surface of the transparent layer, which is close to the substrate, and a lens structure is arranged in the groove; the reflecting layer is positioned on the surface of the transparent layer far away from the bonding layer, and a through hole penetrating through the reflecting layer is formed in the reflecting layer; the position of the through hole corresponds to the position of the convex lens, and the through hole is used for receiving infrared light, so that the infrared light irradiates the transparent layer and then irradiates the thermopile structure through the lens structure.

title_en: Cover plate for protecting MEMS chip from scattered point pollution
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cover plate for protecting MEMS chips from being polluted by scattered points, which comprises an upper cover plate and a lower cover plate, wherein a glue spraying hole is formed in the upper cover plate, a protective baffle is arranged on one side of the inner wall of the glue spraying hole, the protective baffle is arranged above an MEMS chip area of a plastic package product, a glue spraying head is arranged on the upper side of an ASIC chip of the plastic package product, the glue spraying hole and the protective baffle are distributed in a rectangular array, a plurality of groups are arranged at the four corners of the upper cover plate, mounting holes are formed in the two sides of the mounting holes, and positioning holes are formed in the two sides of the mounting holes.

title_en: MEMS acoustic sensor chip packaging structure
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of packaging structures, and discloses a MEMS acoustic sensor chip packaging structure which comprises a packaging shell with two open ends, wherein the upper surface of the packaging shell is provided with a mounting groove, an upper cover for sealing the packaging shell is arranged in the mounting groove, a packaging substrate is arranged on the inner wall of the packaging shell, a limiting ring for limiting the packaging substrate is arranged on the inner wall of the packaging shell, a T-shaped bottom cover is arranged on the bottom surface of the packaging shell, a mounting groove is formed in the packaging substrate, an MEMS chip is arranged in the mounting groove, a glue injection hole communicated with the inner cavity of the packaging shell is formed in the side wall of the packaging shell, and a limiting assembly for limiting the MEMS chip is arranged on the packaging shell. The utility model has the effect of reducing the damage probability of the MEMS chip when the packaging structure is impacted by external force.

title_en: Micro-electromechanical system, micro-electromechanical system actuator and micro-mechanical arm array
abstract_en: A microelectromechanical system, microelectromechanical system actuator, and micromechanical arm array are provided. The micro-arm array comprises: a plurality of micro-mechanical arms spaced apart from each other in a first horizontal direction and extending in a second horizontal direction, wherein each micro-mechanical arm includes a protrusion located at a top of each micro-mechanical arm and protruding upward in a vertical direction; a plurality of protective films, each of the protective films encapsulating one of the plurality of micro-mechanical arms; and a metal connection structure extending along the first horizontal direction. The metal connection structure comprises: a plurality of engagement portions, each engagement portion corresponding to and surrounding a protrusion of one of the plurality of micro-robotic arms; and a plurality of connection portions extending in the first horizontal direction and connecting two adjacent joint portions.

title_en: Composite sheet, inner container and cooking utensil
abstract_en: The application discloses a composite sheet inner bag and cooking utensil. The composite sheet comprises a metal matrix and a coating film. The coating film is attached to the surface of the metal matrix through physical vapor deposition, wherein the coating film comprises a surface layer, and the surface layer is configured into a columnar nano crystal structure layer which is grown through physical vapor deposition. According to the composite sheet of the present application, a plated film having a columnar nanocrystalline surface structure is formed on a metal substrate by physical vapor deposition, and high surface hardness, high adhesion, high non-tackiness, and high cleanability can be simultaneously obtained.

title_en: Reaction furnace for preparing nano powder by solution combustion method
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a reaction furnace for preparing nano powder by a solution combustion method, which comprises a reaction furnace body, wherein a heating mechanism is arranged in the reaction furnace body and used for uniformly heating the temperature in the reaction furnace body. This a reacting furnace for solution combustion method preparation nanometer powder, the reaction platform that upper side heat conduction effect is better is fixedly connected in the inside of reacting furnace body, and the inside fixed connection fan of reaction platform, the circulation groove on through fan and ventilation pipe surface can guide the air to flow from outside to inside, the oxidizing gas when providing the nanometer powder and using solution combustion method to react, and then the entering of avoiding gas leads to the inside powder of reacting furnace body to splash, influence the preparation, the liquid inside the reaction platform can be realized the invariable of temperature in the reaction process through the heating of the solution around the reaction platform, ensure the stability of powder preparation.

title_en: Multi-combustion nozzle high-temperature hydrolysis reactor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-combustion nozzle high-temperature hydrolysis reactor, which comprises a hydrolysis bin and an adjusting mechanism; and (3) a hydrolysis bin: the lower end of the hydrolysis bin is provided with a support plate, the upper end of the support plate is provided with support columns which are uniformly distributed, the upper ends of the support columns are fixedly connected with the lower end of the same annular pipe, the right end of the annular pipe is provided with a feed pipe II, the center of the lower end of the hydrolysis bin is provided with a bottom nozzle, the lower end of the bottom nozzle is provided with a feed pipe I, and the upper end of the hydrolysis bin is provided with a discharge hole; an adjusting mechanism: the multi-combustion nozzle high-temperature hydrolysis reactor is arranged at the lower end of the hydrolysis bin, can be used by a single nozzle or multiple nozzles, can furthest increase productivity on the premise of investment and floor space fixation, can be randomly adjusted, effectively expands the application range of the multi-combustion nozzle high-temperature hydrolysis reactor, and greatly improves the hydrolysis efficiency of the multi-combustion nozzle high-temperature hydrolysis reactor.

title_en: Pretreatment device for deep processing of carbon nano tube
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a carbon nano tube deep processing pretreatment device which comprises a workbench, wherein the top surface of the left side of the workbench is fixedly connected with a supporting frame, the top end of the inner side surface of the supporting frame is fixedly connected with a storage bin, the bottom end of the storage bin is fixedly connected with a pneumatic butterfly valve, the bottom surface of the pneumatic butterfly valve is fixedly connected with a related fan, the middle part of the top surface of the workbench is provided with a pretreatment component, the pretreatment component is connected with a connecting pipe, the bottom end of the connecting pipe is fixedly connected with the left end of the top surface of a second spiral conveyor, the second spiral conveyor is fixedly connected with the right end of the top surface of the workbench, the middle part of the second spiral conveyor is provided with a cooling component, the right end of the second spiral conveyor is provided with a discharging component, and the front end of the top surface of the workbench is fixedly connected with a control panel. The pretreatment component is arranged, so that magnetic substances in the carbon nano tube powder are eliminated, and the carbon nano tube is convenient to be pickled in the later stage.

title_en: Piezoelectric sensor, arm ring and pressure sensing mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a piezoelectric sensor, which comprises a potassium sodium tantalum niobate composite material, wherein the potassium sodium tantalum niobate composite material comprises potassium sodium tantalum niobate nanowires, and the piezoelectric performance of the piezoelectric sensor is improved. The utility model also provides a pressure sensing mechanism comprising the piezoelectric sensor, wherein the pressure sensing mechanism is arranged on the ring body, the pressure sensing mechanism is used for recognizing gestures, when gestures move, the mechanical energy is converted into electric energy by using the ring as an energy acquisition device, the electric signal is output as active sensing of arm muscle movement of a human body, continuous real-time monitoring of the arm muscle movement is carried out without external energy supply, the sensitivity of the pressure sensing mechanism and the ring is improved by using the piezoelectric sensor, the problem that the sensitivity of the existing pressure sensing ring is not high enough by using piezoresistive sensing is solved, and the adaptability of the ring is effectively improved.

title_en: Frock for MEMS chip
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tool for MEMS chips, which relates to the technical field related to MEMS chip production and comprises a bottom supporting plate, wherein the top of the bottom supporting plate is movably lapped with a positioning plate, a plurality of positioning holes which are arranged in a rectangular array are arranged on the positioning plate, the positioning holes are all used for placing single MEMS chips, four assembly components are arranged between the positioning plate and the bottom supporting plate, the utility model can facilitate the assembly or the disassembly between the bottom supporting plate and the positioning plate by arranging the assembly components, and then make the dirt that exists in the locating hole can be convenient for clean up, avoid dirt ground to exist inconvenient clear, and pollute and place ground MEMS chip, secondly, through setting up detachable magnetism and inhale the subassembly, can be convenient for adsorb fixedly between top board and its bottom support plate, and make a plurality of chocks plug the locating hole to reach sealedly, and make the MEMS chip can prevent that the dust from getting into when placing in the locating hole.

title_en: Fan-out type wafer level packaging structure for realizing MEMS chip interconnection
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fan-out type wafer level packaging structure for realizing interconnection of MEMS chips, which comprises an eWLB-F chip and an MEMS chip which is inversely arranged on the eWLB-F chip, wherein the eWLB-F chip comprises a first chip, a plastic layer and a rewiring layer I, the plastic layer wraps the chip and exposes out a bonding area of the first chip, the rewiring layer I is arranged on the plastic layer, the rewiring layer is interconnected with the first chip, a bonding pad I and a bonding pad II are arranged on the surface of the rewiring layer I, solder balls are planted on the bonding pad I, the MEMS chip comprises a second chip and a second solder ball, and the second solder ball of the inversely arranged MEMS chip is interconnected with the bonding pad II of the rewiring layer I and is filled and solidified. The utility model adopts the flip-chip technology to interconnect the eWLB-F chip and the MEMS chip which are manufactured in advance independently, simplifies the packaging process, ensures the alignment precision and performs the underfill process, ensures the connection stability of the chip, and improves the reliability and performance of the product.

title_en: High-performance silicon carbide nano powder synthesizing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-performance silicon carbide nano powder synthesizing device which comprises a reaction chamber, wherein the upper end of the reaction chamber is fixedly connected with an air pressure adjusting mechanism and an air adding pipe, the bottom of the reaction chamber is fixedly connected with an inclined base, the upper surface of the left end of the inclined base is rotatably connected with a mounting plate, the surface of the mounting plate is provided with a limit groove, the inside of the limit groove is slidably connected with a scraping plate, the left surface of the reaction chamber is provided with an auxiliary pushing component, the front surface and the right surface of the reaction chamber are respectively fixedly connected with a fetching opening and a positioning opening, the inside of the positioning opening and the inside of the fetching opening are respectively slidably connected with a long plate and a door plate, the upper end of the long plate is fixedly connected with a contact plate, the upper surface of the contact plate is tightly contacted with the lower surface of the mounting plate, and the right end of the inclined base is provided with a containing groove. Through the structure, the convenience of recovering the finished product is improved, and the cost of the overhaul device is reduced.

title_en: Dual capacitance leveling system for cantilever beam
abstract_en: The utility model provides a double-capacitance leveling system for a cantilever beam, which comprises a piezoelectric area, a first capacitor, a diode and a second capacitor, wherein the piezoelectric area comprises a bottom electrode layer, a piezoelectric layer and a top electrode layer, the first capacitor comprises a bottom electrode layer, a first insulating film and a primary metal layer, the primary metal layer is electrically connected to the top electrode layer, the diode is electrically connected to the bottom electrode layer, and the second capacitor is positioned on the diode and comprises a second metal layer electrically connected with the diode, a second insulating film and a third metal layer electrically connected to the top electrode layer. MEMS elements that include dual capacitance leveling systems have a number of advantages. The position of the cantilever beam after the backside cavity is released may be determined on the wafer during wafer acceptance testing, rather than after the die is separated and packaged. The bias voltage to be included with the operating voltage may be determined algorithmically to ensure leveling during operation. Thus, a consistent cantilever beam position may be provided to prevent problems such as roll-off, operating voltage non-uniformity, and/or pressure loss that may affect sensor readings.

title_en: MEMS packaging structure
