The hydrotalcite material is a typical mesoporous material, has a nano scale (10-30 nm) and a larger specific surface area, exerts the size effect of the nano material, and improves the adsorption performance and the electrocatalytic OER performance of carbonate intercalated hydrotalcite. The hydrotalcite prepared by the invention has the advantages of easily available raw materials, low price, simple preparation, high efficiency, low consumption, rapidness, capability of realizing macro preparation and good water stability and chemical stability. When it is used as an adsorbent, 50 mg L of the adsorbent is used ‑1 The adsorption rate of the methyl orange solution is as high as 92%; when the catalyst is used as an electrocatalyst, the catalyst also has excellent electrocatalytic water oxidation performance in a strong alkaline environment, and the concentration of the catalyst is 20 mA cm ‑2 The corresponding overpotential is only 270 mV.

title_en: Portable automatic medicine grinding device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable automatic medicine grinding device, which comprises a frame, wherein a chassis is arranged on the frame, a fixed seat is arranged on the chassis, and the portable automatic medicine grinding device further comprises: the grinding mechanism comprises a rotating assembly, a lifting assembly and a grinding assembly, wherein the rotating assembly is used for driving the grinding assembly to eccentrically rotate, and the lifting assembly is used for driving the grinding assembly to move up and down; the disposable grinding cup is detachably arranged on the fixed seat, and the center line of the disposable grinding cup is overlapped with the rotation axis of the rotating assembly; and the control mechanism is respectively in communication connection with the rotating assembly and the lifting assembly. The invention has simple and convenient operation, realizes automatic and full grinding of the medicine, ensures that the medicine is fully ground by one person in the disposable grinding cup, saves the physical strength and time of nurses and improves the clinical work efficiency.

title_en: Preparation method and application of non-noble metal monatomic catalyst
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a non-noble metal monatomic catalyst, belonging to the technical field of chemistry, chemical engineering and material science. The invention adopts cheap raw materials and a simple method to prepare the monatomic catalyst. Essentially, under light conditions, the metal is anchored in the monatomic state on a light-absorbing support to form the monatomic catalyst of the present invention. The invention prepares the transition metal single atom catalyst by a photochemical synthesis route for the first time. The monatomic catalyst synthesized by the method is dispersed on the surface of the photoactive material. The nickel monoatomic catalyst is used as a cocatalyst for the hydrogen production reaction of photocatalytic decomposition of water, is low in price, greatly improves the catalytic efficiency, and has higher photocatalytic activity compared with other types of non-noble metal modified composite photocatalysts.

title_en: Red mud-based denitration catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: A red mud-based denitration catalyst, a preparation method and application thereof belong to the technical field of environmental catalytic materials and atmospheric pollution control. According to the invention, solid waste red mud is used as a main component, modification is carried out by adding Mn, Ce and Ti, the pore channel structure is improved by the synergistic effect of Mn, Ce, Ti and red mud, the catalyst is of a sheet structure, so that the catalyst has good denitration activity and a wide temperature window, and the airspeed is 5,5000h ‑1 In the process, the purification efficiency of the nitrogen oxide reaches more than 90 percent within the range of 275-450 ℃. The method not only realizes resource utilization of red mud which is a solid waste, but also greatly reduces the cost of the denitration catalyst, and realizes the treatment of wastes with processes of wastes against one another. The red mud-based denitration catalyst is suitable for controlling nitrogen oxides in fixed source flue gas and diesel vehicle tail gas.

title_en: Deburring machine and deburring method for gap of cool bamboo mat used in summer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cool bamboo mat processing, and discloses a deburring machine and a deburring method for a gap of a cool bamboo mat used in summer. According to the invention, four corners of the cool bamboo mat are fixed through the four position limiting mechanisms, the first electric push rod can pull the two bamboo strips apart, so that the deburring mechanism can remove burrs at the gaps of the cool bamboo mat, the cleaning liquid is pumped by the water pump and discharged from the water outlet pipe, dust in the gaps is removed while the burrs are removed, and the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Surrounding type recovery plant on chemical industry pharmacy waste liquid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a surrounding type recovery device for chemical and pharmaceutical waste liquid, which structurally comprises: the flocculating machine body, the recovery pipe barrel, the base, the primary treatment box, the liquid inlet pipe and the linking device, wherein the liquid inlet pipe is arranged on the left side of the primary treatment box and is locked with the primary treatment box, when the device is used, through the arranged surrounding type collecting mechanism, the device can avoid the problem that more scum flocculates are generated in the waste liquid recovery treatment of chemical pharmacy, the treatment barrel is generally of an integrated structure, the scum can be attached to the upper cover part for a long time, the service life of the treatment barrel can be influenced while the treatment efficiency is influenced, the problem that the treatment is inconvenient is solved, the device can be adjusted in multiple heights through the lifting frame, the device is suitable for different liquid level heights, and is more flexible, the scum flocculation is subjected to multi-stage filtration and collection treatment through the collecting barrel device, and the movable cover plate is matched to make the device more convenient.

title_en: Cleaning and protection integrated device, cleaning control method and system of laser radar
abstract_en: A cleaning and protection integrated device, a cleaning control method and a cleaning and protection integrated system of a laser radar are provided, wherein the cleaning and protection integrated device comprises: the protective support is arranged on the radar support base and comprises a protective plate structure positioned above the top of the laser radar; the radar support base is used for supporting a laser radar; the nozzle support is fixed below the protection plate structure and provided with a plurality of extension arms, and the extension arms are distributed on the top of the laser radar in a surrounding mode; and the nozzle is fixed at the end part of the extension arm, the inlet of the nozzle is connected with the water-gas through pipe, and the outlet of the nozzle faces the laser radar to spray gas or water-gas mixture. The integrated function of collection cleanness, protection and support has been realized, and the device structure is comparatively simple, and the practicality is strong to can satisfy simultaneously that multiple present uses extensive laser radar like the cleanness of cylinder formula and inclined plane formula laser radar etc. has promoted cleaning device's suitability greatly.

title_en: Catalyst for harmless treatment of highly toxic wastewater and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: A catalyst for harmless treatment of highly toxic wastewater is characterized in that: the graphene oxide/graphene oxide composite material comprises a complex of a specific transition metal and graphene oxide, wherein the specific transition metal is at least one of manganese, iron and zinc, and the weight of the specific transition metal in the complex is 1-10% calculated by oxide. The invention also discloses a preparation method and application of the catalyst. The catalyst of the invention is not poisoned by highly toxic substances, has high catalytic capability in highly toxic wastewater and good effect; the preparation method of the catalyst is simple and low in cost, and the catalyst forms uniform internal gaps by adding the nonionic surfactant, so that the catalytic activity and the catalytic effect are ensured; when the catalyst is applied to wastewater treatment, the catalyst is matched with an oxidant, so that highly toxic substances in wastewater can be effectively degraded, and organic pollutants in the wastewater can be degraded; the degradation effect is far higher than that of the corresponding graphene complex catalyst.

title_en: Method for preparing spiro indole derivative by basic ionic liquid one-pot method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing a spiro indole derivative by using an alkaline ionic liquid one-pot method, belonging to the technical field of chemical material preparation. The invention relates to a method for preparing a spiro indole derivative by a basic ionic liquid one-pot method, which takes thiochromanone, malononitrile and isatin as reaction raw materials, and catalyzes the one-pot method to prepare the spiro indole derivative under the catalysis of a basic ionic liquid catalyst, and comprises the following specific steps: adding each reaction raw material and a catalyst into a reaction container containing a reaction solvent respectively, carrying out heating reflux reaction, cooling to room temperature after the reaction is finished, crushing the precipitated solid, standing, carrying out suction filtration, washing filter residues, and drying in vacuum to obtain the spiro indole derivative. By adopting the preparation process, the catalyst can be recycled for multiple times without any treatment before recycling, and the product is simple to separate and purify, high in raw material utilization rate and high in greenization degree in the preparation process, so that the preparation process is convenient for industrial popularization and application.

title_en: Preparation method of nanofiber micro-water-content oil-water separation material with porous surface and lotus-root-shaped cross section
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a nanofiber micro-moisture oil-water separation material with a porous surface and a lotus-shaped cross section, which is prepared by adopting a coaxial electrostatic spinning method.

title_en: Microwave crystal oscillator drying device for zero emission of desulfurization wastewater
abstract_en: The invention relates to a microwave crystal oscillator drying device for zero emission of desulfurization wastewater, wherein the spray end of a rotary spray head faces downwards and stretches into a drying cylinder, a liquid inlet end is communicated with crystal slurry solution, an air inlet end is communicated with one end of a heat exchanger, and the other end of the heat exchanger is provided with an air suction inlet communicated with the heat exchanger; the drying cylinder body is vertically arranged, a spiral guide groove is formed in the inner wall of the drying cylinder body from top to bottom, and a finished product discharge hole is formed in the bottom of the drying cylinder body; a magnetron device for emitting microwaves to the center is arranged around the drying cylinder, a vertical nested vibrating screen tube corresponding to the magnetron device is arranged at the center of the drying cylinder, the outer ring of the nested vibrating screen tube piece is a microwave scattering surface with an air-permeable membrane clamped inside, the inner ring is a crystal oscillator element, and an air interlayer is reserved between the outer ring and the inner ring; the nested vibration sieve tube extends out of the drying cylinder body and is connected with a fan, and the fan is used for exhausting air outwards through an exhaust pipeline, the exhaust pipeline penetrates through a heat exchanger, and air sucked into the air suction inlet is heated through the heat exchanger.

title_en: Preparation method of plaster cloth
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of plaster cloth, which takes crescent elastic fiber as raw materials of warp yarn and weft yarn to carry out weaving and relaxation heat treatment to prepare the plaster cloth; the preparation process of the crescent elastic fiber comprises the following steps: in the process of preparing fibers from PTT according to the FDY process, cooling by circular blowing, and controlling the arrangement of spinneret orifices on a spinneret plate to meet certain conditions to prepare FDY filaments, namely crescent elastic fibers; the spinneret orifice is a crescent spinneret orifice, the cross section of the crescent spinneret orifice is surrounded by an outer arc line M and an inner arc line N, and two intersection points of the outer arc line M and the inner arc line N are respectively A and B; the certain conditions are as follows: by taking any crescent spinneret orifice as a reference, all other crescent spinneret orifices rotate for a certain angle relative to the reference, and the angles are randomly distributed within the range of 0-360 degrees. According to the invention, as the warp yarn and weft yarn raw materials have good three-dimensional curling performance, the prepared plaster cloth has good air permeability.

title_en: Simplified industrial oil purifying and separating filter
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of industrial oil treatment equipment, in particular to a simplified industrial oil purifying and separating filter which comprises a base and a separating filter body, wherein the upper end face of the base is fixedly connected with the separating filter body, the right end face of the separating filter body is fixedly connected with a control cabinet, a pretreatment device is fixedly connected above the front end face of the separating filter body, an impurity filtering pipe is fixedly connected in the center of the front end face of the separating filter body, a treatment device is arranged below the impurity filtering pipe, and the right end face of the treatment device is fixedly connected with the separating filter body.

title_en: Auxiliary drying equipment for ceramic clay 3D printing
abstract_en: The invention discloses auxiliary drying equipment for 3D printing of clay, which comprises a printing body and clamping plates, wherein sleeves are welded at the tops of the two groups of clamping plates, a first heating wire is arranged in a first shell, two ends of the first heating wire are respectively and electrically connected with a first positive and negative elastic piece through connecting wires, the first positive and negative elastic pieces are positioned in jacks, and the jacks are arranged at the top of the first shell. When the ceramic product is printed, the first shell is placed on the workbench, the ceramic product is surrounded, the first heating wire is connected with the power supply, the ceramic product is dried through heating, the second shell is stacked on the first shell after the ceramic product is gradually lifted, the insertion block at the bottom of the second shell is inserted into the insertion hole in the top of the first shell, the first positive and negative elastic pieces are connected with the second positive and negative elastic pieces, the second heating wire is enabled to generate heat, the ceramic product is dried while being printed, and the printing yield is improved.

title_en: Textile industry drying equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a drying device in textile industry, which comprises a box body, a moving device, a sliding door device, a feeding and discharging device and a drainage device, the lower end surface of the box body is fixedly provided with feet in an annular array, an inner cavity is arranged in the box body, a plurality of cross rods are fixedly arranged between the front end wall and the rear end wall of the inner cavity, the front end wall and the rear end wall of the inner cavity are internally communicated with a sliding cavity which is symmetrically arranged in front and rear, a moving device is arranged in the sliding cavity, the upper end surface of the box body is fixedly provided with a top box body, the inside of the top box body is provided with a sliding door device, and the right side of the top box body is provided with a mounting table, the invention has simple structure and convenient operation, the automation of the equipment is realized through the moving device, the sliding door device, the feeding and discharging device and the drainage device, the woven cloth is placed into the equipment and is efficiently dried, a large number of linkage structures are applied in the process, and the working efficiency of the equipment is improved.

title_en: Catalyst for dehydrogenation of light alkane
abstract_en: The invention discloses a catalyst for light alkane dehydrogenation, wherein the dispersion degree of Pt is 12-33%; the coating comprises the following components in parts by weight: a) 0.1 to 6.5 parts of Pt-Co nano particles or oxides thereof; b) 0.1-9.2 parts of M or an oxide thereof, wherein M is selected from Cs and/or La; c) 0.1 to 9.5 parts of Zn-Ga-O or Y-Ga-O binary metal oxide; d) 80-99 parts of carrier S, S is selected from at least one of alumina, silica and titanium oxide. The invention aims to solve the technical problem that the catalyst is easy to deactivate in the prior art, and the provided catalyst and the preparation method thereof have the advantage of difficult deactivation when being used in the reaction of preparing unsaturated hydrocarbon products by dehydrogenating light chain alkane and naphthene.

title_en: Gas dissolving system with double mixers
abstract_en: A gas dissolving system using a dual mixer to produce a liquid with a high gas concentration is disclosed. The gas dissolving system mainly comprises two gas mixers, a degassing device, a pressure valve, a check valve, a pressure sensor and a pump. The liquid flows through the mixer to introduce the gas, so that the liquid contains dissolved gas and undissolved gas. The liquid then flows into the degassing device, allowing undissolved gas to be released to the environment while dissolved gas remains in the liquid. The liquid containing dissolved gas is mixed with the untreated liquid, diluted to a desired gas concentration, and output as a liquid. Without mixing with the untreated liquid, the liquid flows through the mixer and after a number of cycles a liquid containing a high concentration of gas is obtained.

title_en: Mechanical clamping jaw for robot ring pipe part
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mechanical clamping jaw for a robot ring pipe part, which is characterized in that a fixed chuck is arranged on a main shell, one end of a communicating pipe is arranged on the main shell, the communicating pipe is positioned in the fixed chuck, the communicating pipe is communicated with the main shell, a plurality of cleaning air holes are formed on the main shell at equal angles, the bottom of the main shell is bent upwards and sunken, an annular outer inclined surface and an annular inner inclined surface are arranged on the edge of the bottom of the main shell, the annular outer inclined surface and the annular inner inclined surface are symmetrical, a plurality of avoidance grooves are formed on the main shell at equal angles, the avoidance grooves divide the main shell into a plurality of parts with equal size, and a plurality of groups of clamping arms are correspondingly arranged at the bottoms of the parts of the main shell one by one.

title_en: Cleaning method of chalcogenide glass lens
abstract_en: A cleaning method of chalcogenide glass lenses comprises the following steps: step 1, placing a lens: placing the chalcogenide glass lens on a cleaning jig; step 2, alkaline liquid medicine cleaning: putting the cleaning jig into a cleaning tank with alkaline liquid medicine, and soaking the chalcogenide glass lens by using the alkaline liquid medicine to soften the dirt on the surface of the chalcogenide glass lens; and step 3, spraying: putting the cleaning jig into a spraying tank, and spraying the chalcogenide glass lens by using pure water to remove alkaline liquid medicine on the surface of the chalcogenide glass lens and softened dirt; and 4, ultrasonic pure water cleaning: putting the cleaning jig into a cleaning tank with pure water, starting an ultrasonic cleaning machine, inputting ultrasonic waves to enable micro bubbles in the pure water to keep vibrating, and enabling the vibrating micro bubbles to cause the fatigue damage of dirt on the surface of the chalcogenide glass lens so as to enable the residual dirt to be separated; step 5, spin-drying: and (4) putting the cleaning jig into a spin dryer, and removing the moisture on the surface of the chalcogenide glass lens in a spin-drying manner.

title_en: Modified vanadium-silicon molecular sieve, preparation method thereof and thioether oxidation method
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a modified vanadium silicon molecular sieve, a preparation method thereof and a thioether oxidation method, wherein the modified vanadium silicon molecular sieve comprises: vanadium element, silicon element and oxygen element, wherein the modified vanadium silicon molecular sieve satisfies X  1‑1.8  /X  0.4‑0.9  ＝A，0.2<A<0.5, preferably 0.25<A<0.45，X  1‑1.8  The ratio of the micropore diameter of the molecular sieve in the range of 1-1.8nm to the total micropore diameter distribution quantity, X  0.4‑0.9  Is the proportion of the pore diameter of the micropores of the molecular sieve in the range of 0.4-0.9nm in the total pore diameter distribution. The modified vanadium-silicon molecular sieve provided by the disclosure has a special physicochemical characteristic structure, is used for thioether oxidation reaction, is favorable for improving thioether conversion rate, and is favorable for modulating the selectivity of a target product sulfone.

title_en: Multichannel Z-type winnowing machine
abstract_en: The invention provides a multichannel Z-shaped winnowing machine, and belongs to the technical field of environmental protection mechanical equipment. The multichannel Z-type winnowing machine comprises a frame, wherein a Z-type cavity is arranged in the frame, a receiving hopper communicated with the Z-type cavity is fixed above the frame, a discharging hopper communicated with the Z-type cavity is fixed below the frame, a plurality of first channels communicated with the Z-type cavity are formed in one side of the Z-type cavity, a label absorbing component capable of separating bottle flakes and miscellaneous materials in the Z-type cavity is arranged on the first channels, dust bags for absorbing the miscellaneous materials are communicated on the label absorbing component, a plurality of second channels communicated with the Z-type cavity are formed in the other side of the Z-type cavity, the first channels are correspondingly arranged with the second channels, and a damper adjusting mechanism capable of adjusting the air inlet quantity in the second channels is arranged on the second channels. According to the invention, through the design of multiple channels, air can fully contact materials, so that the impurity material carrying rate is improved.

title_en: Vegetables dehydration reducing mechanism
abstract_en: This specification provides a vegetables dehydration reducing mechanism, includes: the microwave oven comprises a main body, wherein microwave generators are embedded at four corners of the inner wall of the main body; the humidity sensor comprises a main body, a central column, an inner groove, a humidity sensor and a vacuum pump, wherein the central column is installed at the center of the bottom end inside the main body in a threaded mode, an inner groove is formed in the center of the top end of the central column, four air holes are uniformly formed in the central column on the periphery of the inner groove, a communication hole is formed in the inner groove on the periphery of the humidity sensor, and the vacuum pump is embedded in the central column in the middle of the communication hole; when using, the central column, the top cover and the corresponding cover body strengthen the combinability, the use is more flexible, the drying is carried out by vacuum and heating when using, and simultaneously the crushing blade is matched to crush vegetables, so that the crushing and dehydration of the whole vegetable are synchronously carried out when using, and the dehydration effect is also strengthened, thereby realizing the acceleration of the working efficiency.

title_en: Polymer brush type magnetic graphene oxide adsorption material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polymer brush type magnetic graphene oxide adsorption material and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the field of adsorption materials. The adsorption material comprises graphene oxide and magnetic Fe  3  O  4  Polydopamine and polymer brushes. The magnetic Fe  3  O  4  Dispersing the nano particles on the surface of the graphene oxide to form magnetic graphene oxide; the polydopamine coats the surface of the magnetic graphene oxide; the polymer brush is grafted on the polydopamine; the polymer brush comprises poly (sodium 4-vinylbenzenesulfonate-co-methacryloyloxyethyl trimethylammonium chloride). The polymer brush grafted on the surface of the adsorption material has characteristic functional groups, so that the adsorption selectivity is improved. The preparation method of the adsorption material takes graphene with large specific surface area as a matrix, and combines the SI-ATRP technology grafted polymer brush with high grafting characteristic, so that the grafting layer is uniform, the grafting density is high, the functional group density is effectively improved, and the adsorption capacity of the adsorption material is improved.

title_en: Stirring preparation process of foaming material
abstract_en: The invention relates to a stirring preparation process of a foaming material, which is mainly completed by matching a foaming stirring kettle, and specifically comprises the following steps: s1, quantitatively putting the foaming material to be processed into the foaming stirring kettle; s2, fully and uniformly stirring and processing the added foaming material to be processed through the foaming stirring kettle; s3, uniformly stirring the foaming material to be processed by the foaming stirring kettle to obtain a finished foaming material product, extracting the finished foaming material product from the foaming stirring kettle, and collecting the finished foaming material product; the foaming stirring kettle involved in the steps S1 to S3 comprises a fixing device, a stirring tank, a motor and a stirring device, and the foaming material attached to the wall of the tank is scraped by the scraping column, so that the mixing and stirring proportion of the foaming material is prevented from being influenced, and the quality of a finished product of the foaming material is improved.

title_en: Impregnating device and method for impregnating textile fabric for composite components
abstract_en: An impregnation apparatus and method for impregnating a textile fabric for a composite member is described. Wherein the matrix (2) can be applied to the textile fabric (1) in such a way that the textile fabric is at least partially and/or at least on one side penetrated by the matrix (2). First and second annular closing bands, each designed as a band loop, are provided for the impregnation device. The textile fabric (1) is guided between the first belt loop (4) and the second belt loop (5) on the mutually facing surfaces (6) of the belt loops and can be impregnated therein. In the respective belt loops (4, 5) of the respective endless closed belt, turning rollers (7) are provided on turning areas, in each of which turning rollers at least one roller is adjustable in direction towards the mutually facing surfaces (6) of the belt loops (4, 5). By adjusting the roller (8) in the y-direction, the wrap angle and thus the pressure exerted on the textile fabric during the impregnation process is controlled.

title_en: Reversible phase-change atomized liquid gel containing alkyl-amido-glycosyl-arylidene four-section glycosyl gelling agent and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reversible phase-change atomized liquid gel containing alkyl-amido-glycosyl-arylidene four-section glycosyl gelling agent, which comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 0.1-3.0wt% of sugar-based gelling agent; 97.0-99.9wt% of atomized liquid; the chemical structural formula of the glycosyl gelling agent is as follows: wherein: a is an aralkylene group or a heteroaralkylene group; r is a hydrocarbyl group. The atomized liquid gel has the thermal reversible and/or shear reversible phase change characteristics, the gel-sol phase change temperature is 145-220 ℃, and the gel-sol phase change critical shear stress is 60-560 Pa. Upon heating and/or shaking, the aerosolized liquid-gel changes from a gel state to a sol state, and the aerosol fixed in the gel is released to form an inhalable aerosol; when the heating and/or shaking is stopped, the sol gel rapidly returns to the gel state and the non-atomized nebulant is again immobilized in the gel network. The atomized liquid gel can solve the problems of smoke condensate after the suction is stopped and smoke liquid leakage of the atomizer caused by air pressure change or external force action in the transportation process.

title_en: Mountain road wide-angle lens device and cleaning method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traffic warning devices, in particular to a mountain road wide-angle lens device, and simultaneously discloses a cleaning method of the mountain road wide-angle lens device; the solar energy collecting box comprises a box body, wherein an opening is formed in the front end of the box body, a rack, a power supply and an air pump are arranged in the box body, a human eye type wide-angle reflecting mechanism is arranged in the front end opening of the box body, and a resin cover is movably covered on the outer side of a flexible wide-angle lens; the frame is provided with a turnover device which is matched and connected with the resin cover; an annular air pipe is arranged between the reflecting surface of the wide-angle lens and the resin cover; the power supply is respectively connected with the air pump and the turnover device; the invention has reasonable structure, and the wide-angle lens can be disassembled to adapt to the size requirements of different road sections; the flexible wide-angle lens is matched with the low-frequency low-amplitude vibrator and the blowing device, so that dust can be effectively removed and the mirror surface is not damaged; the resin cover device is driven by a servo motor, so that the resin cover device can be automatically opened at regular time, and manual maintenance is avoided; the solar panel collects energy and is provided with the storage battery to realize self-sufficiency of energy.

title_en: Application of vitamin E polyethylene glycol succinate
abstract_en: The invention relates to an application of vitamin E polyethylene glycol succinate, belonging to the technical field of gas chromatography. Using the vitamin E polyethylene glycol succinate as a gas chromatography stationary phase; the average molecular weight of the vitamin E succinic acid polyethylene glycol ester is more than or equal to 1000, and the stationary phase can not only perform pi-pi action, CH-pi action and van der Waals force action on nonpolar or weakly polar substances; but also hydrogen bonding, dipolar and van der waals forces with polar substances. The above-mentioned various molecular actions are beneficial to improving the chromatographic separation capability of fixing analytes with relatively different properties, and can realize high-selectivity separation of various analytes from non-polar to polar and isomers thereof.

title_en: Catalyst carrier, ammonia decomposition catalyst and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of catalytic materials, and particularly relates to a catalyst carrier, an ammonia decomposition catalyst and a preparation method thereof. The carrier is carbon modified boron nitride, wherein the doping amount of carbon is 1-8% of the total mass of the carrier. According to the carbon modified boron nitride carrier provided by the invention, a certain amount of carbon is doped in the boron nitride body, so that the electron distribution in the carrier can be improved, and the delocalization of electrons in the carrier is enhanced; when the catalyst is used as a carrier, the interaction strength between the active component and the carrier can be improved, the microstructure and the surface electronic property of the active component are improved, and the activity and the stability of the catalyst are further improved.

title_en: Horizontal double-shaft mud mixer
abstract_en: The utility model provides a horizontal biax mixes mud machine, includes that the longitudinal section is the muddy mud groove of U-shaped structure, muddy mud groove both ends wall is the level respectively and is provided with the driving shaft, muddy mud groove both ends wall still is the level respectively and is provided with the driven shaft, the driving shaft through first drive sprocket with the synchronous reverse rotation of driven shaft to the inboard, two be provided with a muddy mud axle between driving shaft and the two respectively, every on the muddy mud axle periphery wall all fixed be provided with two and be in the muddy mud paddle of shark fin shape in the coplanar, muddy mud axle both ends are respectively through flange joint mechanism and corresponding the driving shaft or driven shaft detachably fixed connection, every flange joint mechanism circumference equidistant be provided with more than three be used for the muddy mud paddle of scraping of mud groove inner end wall. The invention facilitates the loading, unloading and replacement of the mud mixing shaft, and reduces the mixing time of clay.

title_en: Prolinol rapid desulfurizing agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of environmental protection, in particular to a prolinol rapid desulfurizing agent and a preparation method thereof. The problems that the utilization rate of visible light is low, the point position requirements of various catalytic reactions are difficult to meet simultaneously, and simultaneously the photoproduction electron-hole pairs are easy to recombine and the quantum efficiency is low in the prior art are solved. The invention provides a prolinol rapid desulfurizing agent, which has a general formula as follows: wherein R is  1  ～R  5  ＝H，OCH  3  ，NO  2  ，X(F，Cl，Br)，COOH，CF  3  With R  1  ～R  5  Substituted phenylacetaldehyde is taken as a raw material and condensed with 2,3-dimethyl-2,3-dihydroxyaminobutane to form the substituted phenylacetaldehyde  1  ～R  5  Each independently selected from H, OCH  3  、NO  2  Halogen, COOH, CF  3  . The preparation method is simple, the raw materials are easy to obtain, the operation is easy, and the method is suitable for large-scale industrial production.

title_en: Magnetic separation equipment for quartz sand
abstract_en: The invention relates to magnetic separation equipment, in particular to magnetic separation equipment for quartz sand. The invention aims to solve the technical problem of how to provide a magnetic separation device for quartz sand, which has uniform blanking speed and can improve the magnetic separation effect. In order to solve the technical problem, the invention provides magnetic separation equipment for quartz sand, which comprises: the base frame is provided with a material receiving mechanism; receiving mechanism includes: the base frame is connected with a barrel body and a discharge hopper, and the barrel body is connected with the discharge hopper; the outer wall of the barrel body is connected with a plurality of fixing frames; the blanking mechanism is arranged between the fixed frames; the magnetic separation mechanism is arranged on the blanking mechanism. The sliding plug enters the discharging end of the storage barrel, so that the discharging area of the discharging end of the storage barrel can be reduced, quartz mortar in the storage barrel can slowly and uniformly flow out, and the effect of uniform blanking speed is achieved.

title_en: Supported transition metal carbide and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a supported transition metal carbide, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of catalysts. The preparation method of the supported transition metal carbide comprises the following steps: and dissolving a carbon source and transition metal salt in a solvent, performing solvothermal reaction to prepare a metal-organic framework precursor, and carbonizing. When the supported transition metal carbide is used as a catalyst for catalyzing the ozone oxidation reaction of organic matters in water, free radical reaction is initiated, the removal rate of the organic matters in sewage is high, the removal rate is high, the mineralization degree is high, and the method can be used for selectively catalyzing and oxidizing organic pollutants with complex types in the water; meanwhile, when the catalyst is used as a catalyst, the ozone oxidation reaction can be performed at room temperature, and the time consumption is short and the energy consumption is low; in addition, the preparation process of the supported transition metal carbide is simple and easy to mold. The supported transition metal carbide serving as a catalyst can relieve environmental and energy problems, has strong practicability and has good market prospect.

title_en: Pure cotton four-side stretch non-ironing fabric and manufacturing method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a pure cotton four-side elastic non-ironing fabric and a manufacturing method and application thereof, wherein the manufacturing method comprises the following steps: carrying out loose mercerization finishing on the singed and desized grey cloth, stacking the fabric Z type obtained after the loose mercerization finishing for a period of time, and keeping the fabric at a higher alkali carrying rate in the Z type stacking; and (3) carrying out loose liquid ammonia finishing on the fabric after Z-type stacking, and carrying out post-treatment on the fabric after the loose liquid ammonia finishing to obtain the pure cotton four-side stretch non-ironing fabric. The manufacturing method provided by the invention has a short processing flow, and can endow pure cotton fabric with warp and weft elasticity and make the pure cotton fabric have particularly soft and smooth hand feeling on the premise that the obtained pure cotton four-side elastic non-ironing fabric has high non-ironing appearance.

title_en: High ultrasonic cleaning equipment of security
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cleaning equipment, and discloses high-safety ultrasonic cleaning equipment, which comprises a box body, wherein the upper end of the box body is provided with an opening, the upper end of the box body is fixedly connected with a U-shaped plate, the upper side inside the U-shaped plate is provided with a baffle matched with the opening of the box body, the middle part of the upper end of the horizontal part of the U-shaped plate is fixedly provided with an electric push rod, the output end of the electric push rod penetrates through the upper end of the horizontal part of the U-shaped plate and is fixedly connected with the middle part of the upper end of the baffle, a horizontal supporting plate is arranged inside the opening of the box body, vertical connecting plates are symmetrically and fixedly connected between the left side and the right side of the upper end of the supporting plate and the lower end of. The invention not only has high safety and is convenient for taking articles, but also can automatically fix the articles to be cleaned.

title_en: Process for synthesizing nitro-diether by adopting narrow-distance parallel plate reactor
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of chemical industry, and discloses a process for synthesizing intermediate nitro diether of oxyfluorfen by adopting a narrow-distance parallel plate reactor, wherein 3, 4-dichloro benzotrifluoride and resorcinol are taken as raw materials, 1, 3-bis [ 2-chloro-4- (trifluoromethyl) phenoxy ] benzene is obtained through condensation, and the 1, 3-bis [ 2-chloro-4- (trifluoromethyl) phenoxy ] benzene and a nitrifying agent are subjected to nitration reaction in the narrow-distance parallel plate reactor to obtain the nitro diether. The application adopts continuous narrow-distance parallel plate reaction, and can quickly remove huge heat generated by the reaction; the reaction temperature can be controlled between 50 and 95 ℃, the reaction time is greatly shortened, and the molar equivalent of the reaction substance is extremely small in the reaction process, so that the reaction is intrinsically safe, the reaction risk is reduced, and the process safety is improved.

title_en: A freeze-drying device for amination graphite alkene production
abstract_en: The invention discloses a freeze-drying device for aminated graphene production, which comprises a sealing mechanism, a moving mechanism for driving the device to move, a storage mechanism and a fixing mechanism, wherein the moving mechanism is arranged on two sides of the sealing mechanism. According to the device, the recovery mechanism is arranged, the condensed water in the closed box enters the collection box through the water permeable hole and then enters the water tank through the sewer pipe, so that the condensed water can be recycled, the practicability of the device is improved, the contact area between the circulating pipe and the supporting table is increased by adopting the U-shaped structure through the cooling mechanism, the cooling effect of the device is effectively improved, the first motor and the second motor cooperate to drive the stirring rod to stir in a lifting mode through the stirring mechanism, the stirring rod can comprehensively stir the aminated graphene in the storage box, and the aminated graphene can be uniformly freeze-dried, so that the time required by completely freeze-drying the aminated graphene is shortened.

title_en: Static-free mask filtering membrane and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a static-free mask filtering membrane and a preparation method thereof, wherein superfine chemical fibers are subjected to fiber splitting and defibering, then the superfine chemical fibers, the defibered bicomponent composite bonding fibers and micro-nano cellulose fiber dispersion liquid are put into a slurry tank filled with water together, the slurry is stirred to form uniformly dispersed slurry, then the slurry is made into a wet membrane through an inclined net or a circular net former, and the wet membrane is prepared through vacuum dehydration, drying and shaping, flame retardant finishing and water repellent finishing. The mask filtering membrane has a uniformly distributed micropore structure, and can provide a lasting filtering effect; static electret is not needed, and wearing comfort is improved; the strength is higher, and the reliability of mask products is guaranteed; can be repeatedly used, and the material can be biologically degraded, and has no problem of environmental pollution.

title_en: Anti-fouling and antibacterial nanofiber filtering membrane and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an anti-fouling and antibacterial nanofiber filtering membrane and a preparation method thereof. Firstly, preparing polyvinyl alcohol-ethylene copolymer nano fibers with the diameter of 50-300 nm by adopting a melt blending phase separation method; then preparing a suspension and coating the suspension on the surface of a non-woven fabric substrate to obtain a nanofiber thin layer with the thickness of 2-10 mu m and the pore diameter of 90-130 nm; and adsorbing the grafting compound on the surface of the nano-fiber membrane, and treating the nano-fiber membrane by using plasma to form chemical bonding grafting, so as to obtain the nano-fiber membrane with the functions of resisting pollution and removing bacteria. According to the invention, the amphoteric compound and/or the compound simultaneously containing olefin double bonds and at least one group of carboxyl and sulfonic acid groups are/is grafted on the surface of the polyvinyl alcohol-ethylene copolymer nanofiber membrane, so that bacteria can be efficiently intercepted, the adsorption on BSA (bovine serum albumin) can be reduced, the adsorption growth of the bacteria on the surface of the membrane is further inhibited, and the anti-fouling capability of the membrane is obviously improved.

title_en: Metal section straightening machine
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of section straightening, and particularly relates to a metal section straightening machine which comprises a workbench and a stabilizing seat, wherein the stabilizing seat is fixedly connected with the end surface of the workbench, one end of the workbench, which is far away from the stabilizing seat, is provided with a straightening groove with two through ends, a clamping mechanism is arranged in the straightening groove, the inner wall of one end of the straightening groove is provided with an extruding mechanism used for matching with the clamping mechanism, two sides of the straightening groove are respectively provided with a cleaning mechanism and a heating mechanism, the opposite ends of the cleaning mechanism and the heating mechanism are fixedly connected with the end surface of the workbench, one end of the workbench, which is far away from the stabilizing seat, is fixedly connected with a traction mechanism, and one end of the traction mechanism penetrates through the heating mechanism and is fixedly connected with the clamping mechanism. Has the advantages that: the invention can quickly preheat various metal sections, improves the integral toughness of the metal sections, prevents the metal sections from being broken or cracked in the physical straightening process, and can effectively remove impurities on the surfaces of the metal sections, so that the metal sections have better straightening quality.

title_en: Sorting device for sorting out coins
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sorting device for sorting coins from bulk material, in particular from waste incineration slag and/or bulk metal, particularly preferably from bulk heavy metals and/or bulk non-ferrous metals, comprising at least one sorting gap (5) for coins, which is defined by at least one roller (2), which at least one roller (2) can be rotated about an axis of rotation (A) by means of an actuator (33) such that: objects, in particular non-ferrous metal objects (12), which cannot be transported through the sorting gap (5), are subjected to a force exerted by the rollers (2) in a direction away from the sorting gap (5), in particular also along the rotational axis (a) of the rollers, wherein a discharge hood (6), in particular for a vortex separation device (29), is provided, having a particularly adjustable rail separation unit (4) in a hood interior (7), wherein the at least one roller (2) is arranged in or on the discharge hood (6) relative to the rail separation unit (4) such that: the non-ferrous metal parts separated from the bulk material by the rail separation unit (4) are guided in the direction of the sorting gap (5) by the weight of the non-ferrous metal objects (12).

title_en: Environment-friendly garden construction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environment-friendly garden construction method, wherein a first loading cylinder is arranged at the end side of the top surface of a water tank, the middle part of the bottom surface of the first loading cylinder is fixedly provided with a driving motor, the output shaft of the driving motor is fixedly connected with a rotating shaft, the top surface of the rotating shaft is provided with a driving groove, an insertion column is embedded and connected in the driving groove, the top ends of the insertion column and the rotating shaft are movably provided with a second loading cylinder, the outer sides of the top ends of the rotating shaft and the insertion column are respectively fixedly sleeved with a driving rod in the first loading cylinder and the second loading cylinder, one end of the bottom surfaces of the first loading cylinder and, compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages that the conveying of the saplings can be completed in the sowing process, therefore, the purpose of planting a large number of saplings at one time is achieved, the saplings do not need to be placed at the sides of the tree pits in sequence by workers before planting, physical strength of the workers is saved, and meanwhile, the whole planting time can be shortened.

title_en: Watershed water pollutant collecting and detecting equipment based on hydraulic engineering
abstract_en: The invention provides watershed water pollutant collecting and detecting equipment based on hydraulic engineering, which relates to the field of water pollution prevention and control and comprises a box body and a crushing box body, wherein the crushing box body is arranged in the box body; a loading device is arranged in the crushing box body and fixed at the crushing box body; the left side of the driving device is provided with a separating device which is arranged in the box body, the separating device is connected to the driving device in a penetrating way to separate pollutants and water liquid, and the operation can avoid the problem of detection errors caused by the change of the pollutants along with the change of temperature and time and the change of shape in the water liquid.

title_en: Building material conveying and sorting device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building material conveying and sorting device, relating to the field of building machinery, comprising a sorting device, the sorting device comprises a sorting plate, one side of the sorting plate, which is close to the outer box of the device, penetrates through the opening of the outer box of the device through a connecting rod and is connected with a grooved wheel, the grooved pulley comprises two concave locking arcs which are both connected on a disc structure at the center of the grooved pulley, a sliding groove is arranged in the gap of the two concave locking arcs, a round pin is connected in the sliding groove in a sliding way, the circular sliding block on the rocker arm slides in the sliding chute rod and drives the sliding chute rod to reciprocate left and right by driving the rotating motor rocker arm, the gear meshed and connected with the cross rod is driven to rotate in a reciprocating manner, and the convex locking arc is driven to be matched with the grooved pulley, so that the left-right reciprocating swing of the sorting plate connected with the grooved pulley is realized, and the left-right sorting work is carried out on the crushed stone on the transmission belt.

title_en: Alkyl aromatic hydrocarbon isomerization catalyst and its preparation and application
abstract_en: An alkylaromatic isomerization catalyst comprises a composite carrier and 0.005-0.2 mass% of VIII group metal calculated by taking the composite carrier as a reference, wherein the composite carrier comprises 48-75 mass% of high-silicon pentasil zeolite, 0.5-3.0 mass% of molybdenum oxide and 24-50 mass% of macroporous alumina, the total pore volume of the catalyst is 0.4-1.5 mL/g, and the total specific surface area is 350-500 m 2 (ii) in terms of/g. The catalyst is used for aromatic hydrocarbon isomerization reaction, and can improve xylene isomerizationThe reaction activity of the side chain alkyl of the aromatic hydrocarbon is removed, and the selectivity of the isomerization reaction is improved.

title_en: Talc inhibitor and efficient flotation method of talc-containing molybdenum ore
abstract_en: The invention provides a talc inhibitor and a high-efficiency flotation method of talc-containing molybdenum ore. The talc inhibitor comprises components such as sulfate, polysaccharide, aluminum salt, dehydrogenase and the like, and can realize high-efficiency separation of talc and molybdenum ore. The method adopts a flotation process flow of removing talc and molybdenum in advance, and sequentially carries out ore grinding classification, removing talc by flotation, rough concentration of molybdenum and fine concentration of molybdenum on the talc-containing molybdenum raw ore to obtain molybdenum concentrate. According to the invention, the efficient talc inhibitor is selected in the molybdenum roughing and molybdenum concentrating processes, so that the problems of low molybdenum concentrate recovery rate and low grade caused by interference of talc on molybdenum ore flotation are effectively solved, and the tailing water can be directly returned to the ore grinding process, so that the problem that the tailing water cannot be directly recycled in the talc-molybdenum pre-removal flotation process is effectively solved. The method improves the grade of the molybdenum concentrate, improves the recovery rate of the molybdenum concentrate by 15-25 percent, and improves the utilization rate of molybdenum ore resources.

title_en: Method for purifying nickel sulfate
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for purifying nickel sulfate, which comprises the following steps: (1) After the pH value of the feed liquid is adjusted, an extracting agent A is used for carrying out extraction and impurity removal treatment on the feed liquid to obtain an extraction water phase 1 and a loaded organic phase 1; (2) Extracting and separating the raffinate water phase 1 by using an extracting agent B to obtain a loaded organic phase 2 and a raffinate water phase 2; (3) And washing and back-extracting the loaded organic phase 2 to obtain the battery-grade nickel sulfate solution. According to the method, the carboxylic acid extractant with a specific structure is used as the extractant A to purify the crude nickel sulfate liquid, the obtained nickel sulfate can meet the battery grade requirement, the nickel recovery rate is more than 97%, and compared with the traditional process, the method disclosed by the invention eliminates acid and alkali consumption caused by extraction of Ca and Mg, reduces the operation cost and reduces the environmental pollution.

title_en: Full-automatic grinding and screening integrated device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a full-automatic coal grinding and screening integrated device, wherein a feed inlet is formed in a feed hopper, a conveying belt A is arranged in the feed inlet, a crushing device is arranged below the feed hopper, a power rod is arranged at one end of the crushing device, a rectangular block is arranged at the other end of the crushing device, a small pick is arranged on the rectangular block, a polishing device is arranged below the crushing device and comprises a hollow round table and a solid round table, the solid round table is arranged in the hollow round table, a screening device is connected below the polishing device, a screening conveying belt is arranged in the screening device, a rotating baffle is arranged at the output top end of the screening conveying belt and is positioned at the upper side and the lower side of the screening conveying belt, the other end of the rotating baffle is positioned above a conveying belt D, a conveying belt C is arranged at the lower part of the screening; the invention has the advantages of convenient use, reasonable structure and good grinding and screening effects.

title_en: Traditional chinese medical science critical patients guardianship device
abstract_en: The invention provides a device for monitoring a critical patient in traditional Chinese medicine, which comprises a barrel body; the evaporation cavity is formed in the barrel; the air guide cavity is formed in the barrel and is positioned above the evaporation cavity; the transmission cavity is formed in the cylinder body and is positioned in the air guide cavity; the four universal wheels are fixedly arranged at the bottom of the barrel body and are distributed in a rectangular array; the liquid inlet pipe is fixedly arranged on the left side of the barrel and communicated with the evaporation cavity; and the liquid discharge pipe is fixedly arranged on the right side of the barrel body and is positioned on the evaporation cavity and communicated with the evaporation cavity. The traditional Chinese medicine critical patient monitoring device provided by the invention has the advantages that the auxiliary treatment can be carried out on the patient during the rest, the disease incidence rate is reduced, and the use of the camera is more flexible.

title_en: Intelligent spraying production line and spraying process for automobile wheel rim cover
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of intelligent spraying, in particular to an intelligent spraying production line and a spraying process for an automobile wheel rim cover. The production line comprises a first circular conveying production line and a second circular conveying production line, wherein a horizontal single-side coating magnetic control production line is arranged between the first circular conveying production line and the second circular conveying production line, a first loading area, a first cleaning device, a first dust removal device, a primer spraying device, a first leveling area, a first illumination area, a first drying area, a first cooling area and a first unloading area are sequentially arranged in the processing direction of the first circular conveying production line to form the production line, the second circular conveying production line is connected end to form circulation, and a magnetic control coating machine, a second cleaning device, a second dust removal device, a finish spraying device, a second leveling area, a second illumination area, a second drying area, a second cooling area and a second unloading area are sequentially arranged in the processing direction of the second circular conveying production line to form the production line.

title_en: High-speed detection device of paper packing article based on machine vision
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-speed detection device for paper packages based on machine vision, which comprises a workbench and a detection table, wherein a conveying device is arranged on the workbench, fixed plates are arranged on two sides of the conveying device on the workbench, a top plate is connected at the upper end of each fixed plate, a telescopic rod is arranged in the middle of the lower end of each top plate and connected with a height limiting plate, the detection table is arranged at the discharge end of the conveying device, a supporting plate is connected at the upper end of the detection table through a supporting block, a bearing assembly is arranged in the middle of the supporting plate, a second rotating rod penetrates through the bearing assembly, a material guide rotating disc is connected at the upper end of the second rotating rod, four groups of roller material guide devices are arranged at the upper end of the material guide rotating disc in an array manner, the invention ensures that deformed paper packages cannot pass through the height limiting plates on the conveying device, and, the detection efficiency is high, the high-speed paper packaging product production line can be adapted, and the yield of the production of paper packaging products is improved.

title_en: Electrostatic dust removal device for factory workshop
abstract_en: The utility model provides an electrostatic precipitator device is used in mill's workshop, includes hollow clean room, the installation cavity has been seted up in the clean room roof, the clean room lateral wall runs through fixedly connected with air-supply line, the lateral wall that the air-supply line one side was kept away from to the clean room runs through fixedly connected with and goes out the tuber pipe, the clean room is located the lateral wall that goes out tuber pipe department and is provided with the fan, the through-hole has been seted up to the clean room diapire, the clean room lower surface passes through flange fixedly connected with and receives the dirt box, the through-hole intercommunication clean room and dust collection box, two inside walls that the clean room is relative all inlayed and have had the permanent magnetism board, all be provided with charge generation device in the roof of air-. Has the advantages that: the dust removal device does not need a filter screen for dust removal, avoids the influence on the dust removal effect caused by the blockage of the filter screen due to the long-time dust removal by using the filter screen in the prior art, and can change the power of the motor according to the amount of dust in a workshop, thereby saving more energy.

title_en: Wet-type waste gas desulfurization system and waste gas desulfurization method based on gas distribution and liquid pushing technologies
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wet-type waste gas desulfurization system and a waste gas desulfurization method based on gas distribution and liquid pushing technologies, wherein the system comprises a main desulfurization container, an auxiliary desulfurization container and a sulfur dioxide detection unit; the side rotary seal of the main desulfurization container is penetrated with a waste gas inlet pipe, the output end of the waste gas inlet pipe is in butt joint with a turnover axial-movement composite gas distribution liquid pushing assembly, the turnover axial-movement composite gas distribution liquid pushing assembly comprises a turnover gas distribution liquid pushing piece, a telescopic connecting pipe, a turnover axial-movement gas distribution liquid pushing piece and a magnetic axial-movement driving piece, and the driving mechanism drives the waste gas inlet pipe to drive the turnover gas distribution liquid pushing piece, the telescopic connecting pipe and the turnover axial-movement gas distribution liquid pushing piece to synchronously rotate circumferentially, and the turnover axial-movement gas distribution liquid pushing piece moves axially relative to the turnover gas distribution liquid pushing piece under the magnetic drive of the magnetic axial-movement driving piece. The invention starts from the gas distribution and liquid pushing principles, so that the waste gas and the alkaline absorption liquid are thoroughly and fully mixed, and the desulfurization efficiency is greatly improved.

title_en: High-efficient drying device of water thorn non-woven fabrics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a spunlace non-woven fabric efficient drying device which comprises a dryer body and a support frame positioned at the bottom of the dryer body, wherein a dehydration mechanism, a drying mechanism and a dust removal mechanism are sequentially arranged in the dryer body along the length direction of the dryer body. The invention has the advantages that the water-jet non-woven fabric entering the dryer body can be firstly dehydrated through the dehydration mechanism positioned in the dryer body, the water in the water-jet non-woven fabric is beaten out by the rubber beating plate to facilitate the subsequent drying treatment, the drying mechanism can be used for drying the dehydrated water-jet non-woven fabric, the compression roller can be used for tensioning the water-jet non-woven fabric to prevent the water-jet non-woven fabric from deforming during drying, the heat in the dryer body can be recycled and reused by the circulating pipeline to achieve the double-sided drying of the water-jet non-woven fabric, the dust removal mechanism can be used for cleaning and absorbing impurities adhered to the surface of the water-jet non-woven fabric after drying, and the color and luster of.

title_en: Chinese herbal medicine crushing device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Chinese herbal medicine crushing device which comprises a box body, wherein a first conveying belt mechanism and a second conveying mechanism are respectively arranged at the upper end and the lower end of an inlet of the box body; the first conveying belt mechanism comprises a first roller, a second roller and a first connecting belt for connecting the first roller and the second roller, a driving motor is fixed in the box body, and the rotating head of the driving motor is coaxially connected with the first roller; a second roller in the first conveying mechanism is connected with a first roller in the second conveying mechanism through a second connecting belt; the box body is also internally provided with a first cutting disk and a second cutting disk which are respectively and rotatably arranged, and the second cutting disk is positioned below the first cutting disk, so that Chinese herbal medicine materials can be conveyed by the first conveying belt mechanism and the second conveying mechanism and enter the box body after being cut by the first cutting disk and the second cutting disk; the problem of current reducing mechanism smash not thoroughly, inhomogeneous is solved.

title_en: Breaker for building civil engineering
abstract_en: The invention provides a crushing device for building and civil engineering, wherein the crushing roller comprises a first crushing roller and a second crushing roller, the first crushing roller is arranged at the upper part of a shell and consists of a left roller and a right roller, and a partition is arranged between the left roller and the right roller; a baffle plate is arranged below the first crushing roller, a feed opening is formed in the baffle plate below the left roller and the right roller, and a second crushing roller is arranged below the baffle plate; the center of first crushing roller and second crushing roller all is equipped with the center pin, and the motor drives the center pin rotation of first crushing roller, still is equipped with the gear at the motor output end, is equipped with the linkage gear in the outer end of second crushing roller, and the gear passes through the chain and drives linkage gear rotation. The beneficial effects are as follows: according to the invention, two-stage crushing is adopted, so that the crushing effect is better and the efficiency is higher; first crushing roller sets up different broken heads, makes its better adaptation construction waste on the building site, and the construction waste of different specifications utilizes different rollers to carry out the breakage, has improved crushing efficiency.

title_en: A rotary wheel formula cleaning device for thermometer production
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rotating wheel type cleaning device for thermometer production, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a cleaning box is arranged on the upper side of the bottom plate, the lower end of the cleaning box is fixedly connected with the bottom plate through a plurality of supporting rods, a gear ring is fixedly connected to the inner top surface of the cleaning box, two vertically arranged rotating shafts are arranged on the inner side of the gear ring, planetary wheels are coaxially and fixedly sleeved on the rotating shafts, the two planetary wheels are mutually meshed with inner side teeth of the gear ring, the upper end and the lower end of the upper end of each rotating shaft are slidably connected to the inner wall of the cleaning box, cleaning rollers are fixedly sleeved on the two rotating shafts, a driving mechanism for driving the planetary wheels to rotate is arranged in the cleaning box, and an annular box is. According to the invention, the planet wheel is arranged, so that the cleaning effect is more comprehensive and complete when the thermometer on the outer side wall is cleaned; by providing a ring box, cleaning efficiency and the completeness of cleaning can be further enhanced in cooperation with the cleaning roller.

title_en: Preparation method of nano titanium dioxide loaded graphene high-activity catalyst
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of photocatalysts, in particular to a preparation method of a high-activity catalyst of nano titanium dioxide loaded graphene. Which comprises the following steps: a. mixing a titanium source with liquid carbon dioxide, reacting with water, and hydrolyzing to obtain titanium dioxide; b. adding a nickel-based catalyst into the reaction system, introducing hydrogen, heating to 900-. According to the method, firstly, titanium dioxide is synthesized in liquid carbon dioxide through hydrolysis of a titanium source, so that the titanium dioxide is uniformly distributed in the carbon dioxide. And then activating carbon dioxide by directly using a nickel-based catalyst, so that the carbon dioxide is used as a carbon source, and preparing the graphene by using a carbon dioxide hydrogenation reaction. So that the titanium dioxide and the graphene are uniformly combined to improve the catalytic performance of the titanium dioxide loaded graphene catalyst.

title_en: Processing apparatus who handles inside bubble of coal and evenly smash
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal treatment, in particular to a treatment device for treating bubbles in coal and uniformly crushing the bubbles, which comprises a machine body and a first transportation cavity which is positioned in the machine body and has an opening towards the right, wherein a dehydration device which is transported by four groups of transportation wheels which are symmetrical left and right and can rotate and dehydrate the surface of the coal is arranged in the first transportation cavity, the transportation wheels are in transmission connection through a first transportation belt, a sponge layer is fixedly arranged on the outer surface of the first transportation belt, the treatment device for treating the bubbles in the coal and uniformly crushing the coal is provided by the invention, the coal is in contact with a crushing roller when being crushed through the up-and-down slow movement of a lifting platform, the granularity of the coal is screened through a filter screen, the bubbles in the coal are extruded into blocks by using an extrusion wheel to be eliminated, and then the coal in the transportation is fully dried by using a dryer, the safety degree of the coal drying process is guaranteed.

title_en: Plate-shaped workpiece paint spraying equipment for machining
abstract_en: The invention discloses a plate-shaped workpiece paint spraying device for machining, which relates to the technical field of machining and comprises an installation base, lifting mechanisms, a moving mechanism, a fixed turnover mechanism, a paint spraying mechanism and a recycling box, wherein two groups of lifting mechanisms are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the installation base, the moving mechanism is arranged on the other side of the installation base, the two groups of fixed turnover mechanisms are respectively arranged on one group of lifting mechanisms, the paint spraying mechanism is arranged on the moving mechanism, the working end of the paint spraying mechanism is positioned above the fixed turnover mechanisms, the recycling box is arranged in the middle of the installation base, the recycling box corresponds to the working end of the paint spraying mechanism, and the plate-shaped workpiece to be painted can be subjected to comprehensive automatic multi-angle paint spraying operation without manual operation through the matching work of all the mechanisms, the paint spraying quality is improved while the working efficiency is improved, and the practicability is higher.

title_en: Animal husbandry production is with manual livestock nasal cavity cleaning device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a manual livestock nasal cavity cleaning device for animal husbandry production, relates to the technical field of animal husbandry production and breeding, and mainly solves the problems that the existing animal husbandry production and breeding cub nasal cavity cleaning efficiency is low and the cub survival rate is influenced; the device includes the annular circle, the annular circles and is connected with the straw, the both sides at the annular circle are installed to the straw symmetry, the end of straw is provided with the suction head, the end of suction head is the design of mouth of closing, the terminal radius angle of suction head is handled, the mid portion of straw is connected with flexible pipe, the inside of annular circle is provided with interior passageway, interior passageway symmetry sets up in the annular circle, be provided with the piston in the interior passageway, the piston links to each other with the arc pole, be provided with first spring between arc pole and the interior passageway, the inner circle of annular circle is provided with the support frame, be provided with on the support frame and indicate the annular ring, be provided with the installation axle on the support frame.

title_en: Flexible portable cleaning device is used to boats and ships
abstract_en: The invention discloses a telescopic movable cleaning device for a ship, which belongs to ship cleaning devices and comprises a main body, wherein a fan is arranged on the left side inside the main body, a positioning chute is formed in the right side inside the main body, a collecting bin is arranged inside the positioning chute, a connecting pipe is arranged on the right side of the collecting bin, a telescopic pipeline I is arranged at the lower end of the connecting pipe, an electric push rod is arranged on the left side of the main body, an adjusting rotating shaft is arranged at the upper end of the electric push rod, a fixed bin is arranged on the left side of the adjusting rotating shaft, a cleaning rolling shaft is arranged on the inner side of the fixed bin, the height of the fixed bin can be adjusted through the arranged electric push rod, the problem that the daily cleaning of the ship is influenced due to the fact that the height of a ship railing cannot be adjusted according to the difference of the height when the ship is used is avoided, and the angle, avoiding the practicability from influencing the subsequent use of the device.

title_en: High-efficient processing equipment of drum-type biological plasmid
abstract_en: The invention provides a roller type efficient processing device for biological plasmids, which comprises a main body and a rotating cavity, wherein a sealing cover which is connected with one side of the main body in an embedded manner is opened, then the biological plasmids are poured into the rotating cavity, a motor which is connected with one side of the main body in an embedded manner is in power connection with one side of the rotating cavity to drive the rotating cavity to rotate, and the rotating cavity is embedded and arranged in the main body to rotate so as to movably dry the biological plasmids; one end of the dispersing shaft penetrates through the inner wall of the rotating cavity and is connected to the surface of the inner wall of the main body in an inserting and embedding manner. This kind of high-efficient processing equipment of cylinder biological plasmid is provided with the dispersion axle, can be driven in rotatory chamber through the dispersion axle and encircle the displacement together, and can rotate when the dispersion axle encircles the displacement through the drive in rotatory chamber, and the rotation through the dispersion axle comes better drives its biological plasmid on every side and moves about and mix for its inside biological plasmid moves about more acutely when drying and improves its drying efficiency.

title_en: Broken stone sorting machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of buildings, in particular to a crushed stone separator. Can break stone; screening stone particles; cleaning the powder ash; the water circulation improves the stone breaking efficiency, reduces the environmental pollution and reduces the water consumption. Including frame main part, screening plant, perpendicular lifting device, jaw breaker, sand washing device, realized crushing stone material through the front and back extrusion motion of crushing tooth in the jaw breaker with control horizontal dislocation, washed the grit through the water washing of water pump, then the sewage reflux of sand washing advances the sedimentation tank, the water recirculation sand washing after the processing, the grit gets into and divides the sieve device sieve to fall into the stone of different granule sizes, has saved the water source, has saved electric power, has reduced the pollution.

title_en: 3D prints and uses raw materials reducing mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a raw material crushing device for 3D printing, which comprises a crushing box body, wherein a feeding hole is formed in the top end of the crushing box body, a second discharging hole is formed in the bottom end of the crushing box body, a filtering structure is arranged at the bottom end inside the crushing box body, a fourth motor is arranged at the top of a second gear, an extrusion rod is fixedly connected to the top of a rotating shaft, and a crushing disc is fixed on the outer surface of the extrusion rod. According to the invention, the collecting structures are arranged on two sides of the inner part of the crushing box body, the collecting structures can adsorb dust generated during shaking filtration to prevent the dust from flowing into the outside, the fan blades are driven to rotate by starting the second motor, and negative ion wind is generated, the adsorption pipeline connected with the bottom of the adsorption box body is close to the top of the shaking frame, so that the generated dust can be firstly sucked into the adsorption box body through the adsorption pipeline and then is conveyed into the adsorption tank to be adsorbed and stored again by the adsorption cotton in the adsorption tank, and the pollution of the dust to the surrounding air is reduced.
