title_en: Device for cleaning impurities on inner wall of petroleum pipeline
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pipeline cleaning, in particular to a device for cleaning impurities on the inner wall of a petroleum pipeline, which comprises a supporting mechanism, a shoveling mechanism, two groups of travelling mechanisms and a cleaning mechanism, wherein the shoveling mechanism is positioned at the front end of the supporting mechanism and is used for shoveling the impurities on the inner wall of the pipeline; the supporting mechanism comprises a box body and two inclined struts symmetrically distributed on two sides of the bottom of the box body, the inclined struts are fixedly connected with the bottom surface of the box body, and walking wheels capable of rolling along the inner wall of the pipeline are arranged on two sides of the bottom of each inclined strut. The invention utilizes the structures of the driving motor, the main shaft, the shoveling rod and the like to drive the shoveling sheets to rotate along the inner wall of the pipeline, thereby easily scraping impurities and scales on the inner wall of the pipeline and greatly reducing the labor intensity of workers.

title_en: Instrument disinfection cabinet for department of stomatology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an instrument disinfection cabinet for stomatology department, which relates to the field of oral science and technology and comprises a cabinet body, wherein a water tank is fixed in the cabinet body, an upright post is fixed at the bottom in a disinfection tank, and a flushing mechanism is connected between the upright post and a screen plate in a transmission way; the lifting mechanism can drive the screen plate to reciprocate in the vertical direction, so that the oral appliances on the screen plate can be fully shaken and dispersed, the disinfectant and the full washing effect of the disinfectant are promoted, the spraying mechanism and the washing mechanism respectively wash the appliances from top to bottom and from bottom to top, the full disinfection and cleaning effect of the appliances is promoted, the hollow brush roller can repeatedly wash the bottom of the screen plate in the vertical lifting process of the screen plate, the normal mesh of the screen plate is promoted, the smooth outflow of sewage is realized, and the full disinfection of the disinfectant on the appliances is guaranteed.

title_en: Device for ensuring stirring uniformity and discharging quality
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coating devices, and discloses a device for ensuring stirring uniformity and discharging quality, which comprises a shell, wherein a coil is rotatably arranged on the surface of the shell, a stirring rod is fixedly arranged at one end, close to the edge of the shell, of the coil, a heating resistance wire is fixedly arranged inside the stirring rod, a contact is slidably arranged on the surface of the heating resistance wire, an electromagnet is fixedly arranged at the top end of the contact, a magnetic block is fixedly arranged at one end, far away from the coil, of the stirring rod, connecting rods are movably arranged on the left side and the right side of the coil on the surface of the shell, and a speed limiting block is fixedly arranged at one. This guarantee device of stirring degree of consistency and ejection of compact quality controls inside temperature and stirs the coating in the equipment, and temperature size and stirring degree change along with current coating's thick degree of gluing, when needs spraying, according to the appropriate amount of coating of current stirring efficiency spraying, has guaranteed the quality of blowout coating.

title_en: Quick drying device after chemical fertilizer shaping
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of chemistry, and discloses a quick drying device after chemical fertilizer molding, which comprises a drying barrel, wherein a heat-insulating pad is fixedly connected to the outer surface of the drying barrel, a heating hole is formed in the upper end of the drying barrel, an electric heating tube is movably clamped in the heating hole, a sealing cover is arranged at the upper end of the drying barrel, supporting legs are fixedly connected to the lower end of the drying barrel, a motor is fixedly connected to the lower surface of the drying barrel, a discharge hole is formed in the outer surface of the drying barrel, and a blocking plate is arranged in the discharge hole. This quick drying device after fertilizer shaping turns about going on the inside fertilizer of stoving bucket, and then makes fertilizer can form the material curtain, and then the fertilizer that makes the bottom also can be even contacts with the heat, and then avoids fertilizer to pile up the caking phenomenon that the inhomogeneous causes of being heated that appears, and then improves its efficiency of being heated, and then accelerates the stoving speed, saves the stoving time, and then improves production efficiency.

title_en: Method for preparing TS-1 molecular sieve catalyst by taking MOFs as titanium source
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing a TS-1 molecular sieve catalyst by taking MOFs as a titanium source, belonging to the field of preparation of inorganic catalytic materials. The preparation method comprises the steps of directly taking Ti-based MOFs materials as a titanium source, synthesizing the Ti-based MOFs materials with ethyl orthosilicate, tetrapropylammonium hydroxide and other raw materials by a traditional hydrothermal method, and sequentially carrying out centrifugation, washing and drying on the Ti-based MOFs materials to obtain the TS-1 molecular sieve. The advantages are that: 1) firstly, the preparation of the TS-1 molecular sieve is carried out by taking MOFs containing Ti radicals as a titanium source through heterocrystal orientation; 2) the unstable characteristic of Ti-based MOFs under alkaline conditions and the existence of isolated titanium species are utilized to be used as a titanium source required by material synthesis, and anatase TiO caused by over-high hydrolysis rate of the Ti source can be avoided 2 Generating; 3) the process is simple to operate and mild in condition, and can be performed by adjusting the temperature, MOFs, the dosage of the template agent and the likeAnd regulating and controlling the Ti content and the micro-morphology of the final material.

title_en: Method, system and device for controlling fabric density in real time
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of textile printing and dyeing processes, and particularly relates to a method, a system and a device for controlling the density of a fabric in real time, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining and keeping the overfeed amount constant, determining and configuring the fabric density of the cloth feeding side of an upper overfeed roller to be a constant value P1, and adjusting the fabric density of the cloth feeding side of the upper overfeed roller to reach the constant value P1 in real time, wherein the real-time adjustment method comprises the steps of collecting the real-time fabric density P1 'of the cloth feeding side of the upper overfeed roller, and controlling to increase the cloth feeding speed of the cloth feeding side of the upper overfeed roller if P1' < P1; if P1 ' > P1, the cloth feeding speed of the cloth feeding side of the upper overfeed roller is controlled to be reduced until P1 ' is equal to P1 or the difference value of the P1 ' and the P1 is controlled to be within an error range. The invention can accurately and automatically adjust the fabric density of the cloth feeding side of the upper overfeed roller in real time, so that the density of the shaped fabric does not exceed the process density requirement, the integral level of the textile industry can be improved, and the industry competitiveness can be improved.

title_en: Movable sunflower seed sorting station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a movable sunflower seed sorting station, which comprises a container main body, wherein a feeding device, a winnowing machine and a vibrating screen which are sequentially connected are arranged in the container main body; the feeding end of the feeding device is arranged on the outer side of the container main body; and the discharge port of the vibrating screen is connected with a check device, and the discharge port of the check device is arranged on the side wall of the container body. Has the advantages that: the van truck using the standard is flexible and convenient to move, is suitable for field use, can adjust check equipment according to check requirements, is flexible and convenient in check function adjustment, can complete sunflower seed check in the field on site, and check sunflower seeds are directly conveyed to a production enterprise for deep processing production, so that the link of conveying the check sunflower seeds to the processing plant is saved, the packing, loading and unloading and transportation cost of the sunflower seeds when the sunflower seeds are packed and transported from the field to the processing plant for check is saved, the planting cost is reduced, and the income of farmers is improved.

title_en: Powder adding equipment for producing biomass solid fuel
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biomass fuel production, in particular to powder adding equipment for producing biomass solid fuel, which comprises a main material cylinder, a high-position travel switch, a low-position travel switch and a conveying belt, wherein the bottom of the main material cylinder is fixedly connected with a screen, a paddle type hairbrush is arranged above the screen, a driving assembly is fixedly connected above the paddle type hairbrush, a disc-shaped discharging baffle is fixedly connected inside the main material cylinder, a bin is fixedly connected above the disc-shaped discharging baffle, a fixing assembly is fixedly connected outside the bin, a supporting frame is fixedly connected on the outer wall of the main material cylinder, and the conveying belt is fixedly connected at the bottom of the supporting frame. According to the invention, the device is arranged on the conveying belt, so that powder addition of raw materials in the conveying process is realized, the uniformity of powder addition is ensured, and meanwhile, the powder is prevented from coagulating through loosening the assembly.

title_en: Preparation method of Pickering emulsion guanidino ionic liquid catalytic system for ester exchange reaction
abstract_en: The invention designs a preparation method of a Pickering emulsion guanidino ionic liquid catalyst for ester exchange reaction. The invention utilizes hydroxyl functionalized guanidino ionic liquid as a catalytic active group, is immobilized on the surface of silicon dioxide as a hydrophilic group, and is characterized in that trimethoxyalkyl (C6-C18) silane with a long carbon chain is immobilized on the surface of the silicon dioxide as a lipophilic group, so that the amphiphilic nano silicon ball is obtained. The Pickering emulsion with good stability is prepared in a heterogeneous system of oil such as soybean oil and methanol liquid-liquid by simple manual shaking. The guanidino ionic liquid prepared by the invention has good catalytic performance in the ester exchange reaction process and shows excellent emulsion stability.

title_en: Processing apparatus before garlic clove processing
abstract_en: The invention relates to a garlic clove processing pretreatment device, which comprises a cleaning part, wherein the cleaning part comprises a water tank, a conveying frame, a conveying assembly and a washing assembly; the feeding assembly comprises a feeding frame, a feeding box and a feeding pipe, wherein the bottom surface of the feeding box is provided with an inclined surface inclining downwards, and the bottom surface of the feeding box is also provided with a feeding hole communicated with the upper end of the feeding pipe; the sorting part comprises a supporting table, a workbench, a driving shaft, a driving motor a, a sorting assembly and a blanking assembly; the multi-station cutting part comprises an ordered output assembly and a circumferential rotating assembly, the circumferential rotating assembly is sequentially provided with a feeding station, a head removing station, a cutting station and an output station along the circumferential direction, and the cutting station is provided with a cutting assembly; the invention solves the technical problems that if the garlic is not subjected to specification screening, the size of the cut garlic is uneven, and the defective rate is low.

title_en: Dry ice decontamination equipment for nuclear power station
abstract_en: The invention discloses dry ice decontamination equipment for a nuclear power station, which comprises a base, wherein a cabinet body is fixed at the top end of the base, a tank body is fixed in an inner cavity of the cabinet body through a support column, a fixed frame is fixed at the top end of the inner cavity of the tank body, a speed reduction motor is fixed in the inner cavity of the fixed frame, an output shaft of the speed reduction motor is rotatably connected with a rotating shaft, the rotating shaft rotatably penetrates through the fixed frame, the fixed frame extends to the outer wall of the fixed frame, a first bevel gear is fixed at the tail end of the fixed frame, the first bevel gear is in meshing connection with a second bevel gear; the height of the breaker can be conveniently and rapidly adjusted through the arranged screw rod; through the fan blades, the speed reducing motor can also dissipate heat while working, and the safety of the speed reducing motor during operation is improved; through the shock mount that sets up, can cushion the vibrations of gear motor during operation, guarantee the stability of gear motor during operation.

title_en: UV continuous coating production line
abstract_en: The invention relates to a UV continuous coating production line, which comprises an uncoiler and a coiling machine, wherein the following components are sequentially arranged between the uncoiler and the coiling machine: cleaning unit, coating unit, color printing unit. The cleaning unit comprises a degreasing machine, a cleaning machine and a drying machine; the coating unit comprises a roller coater and a curing machine; the color printing unit comprises a color printing machine and a detector; a shearing unit is additionally arranged between the coating unit and the color printing unit, and comprises a shearing machine, a conveyor and a stacker; when the cutting and assembling unit operates, the color printing unit and the winding machine stop operating, and when the color printing unit and the winding machine operate, the cutting and assembling unit stops operating. The invention can realize the switching between the continuous coil production and the continuous shearing production of the whole production line, reduce the occupied area of equipment, reduce the labor of operators and ensure strong continuous work of the equipment. The invention can realize the coating of the reserved edge of the steel plate, and has the advantages of uniform coating, high production efficiency and reliable quality.

title_en: Plug-in device for producing and processing LED lamp chip and using method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of LED chip production, in particular to a plug-in device for LED chip production and processing and a use method thereof. The technical problem to be solved by the invention is that the prior art ignores the time delay of the control module, and does not mount a control mechanism to forcibly stop the work of the conveying plate when an accident occurs, thereby causing a plurality of inferior-quality products. In order to solve the technical problems, the invention provides a plug-in device for producing and processing an LED lamp chip and a using method thereof.

title_en: Efficient 5G base station heat dissipation system and heat dissipation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of 5G base station heat dissipation, and discloses an efficient 5G base station heat dissipation system and a heat dissipation method, wherein the efficient 5G base station heat dissipation system comprises a machine body, a rotating motor is fixedly mounted on one side of the machine body, an output shaft of the rotating motor extends into the machine body and is fixedly provided with a rotating rod, a first fan blade is fixedly mounted on the rotating rod, a heat conducting plate is fixedly mounted on the inner wall of the bottom end of the machine body, the bottom end of the heat conducting plate extends to the lower side of the machine body and is fixedly provided with a heat dissipation fin, the heat dissipation fin is provided with a heat dissipation hole, a cam is fixedly mounted on the rotating rod, a moving hole is. The fan is reasonable in design, the machine body can be comprehensively radiated through the rotation of the first fan blades and the rotation of the air guide plate, the radiating efficiency of the radiating fins can be improved through the reciprocating rotation of the second fan blades, and the first filter screen can be cleaned through the reciprocating movement of the brush.

title_en: Dense medium coal washing pretreatment system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dense medium coal washing pretreatment system which comprises a sieve plate and a cleaning device, wherein the sieve plate is provided with a raw coal receiving end and a raw coal discharging end, and the cleaning device is used for spraying water to the raw coal on the sieve plate and cleaning the raw coal; the screen holes of the screen plate can be used for allowing coal slime with set granularity to pass through, raw coal is screened, cleaned coal slime is washed and separated by water spraying, the screen plate screens and removes the coal slime with the set granularity and water at the same time, the screened coal slime is fine coal slime which has adverse effect on the working property of suspension, the remaining fine coal slime has favorable effect on the suspension, and meanwhile, the cleaning device can break up mud blocks to ensure the thoroughness of cleaning; finally, the content and the granularity of the coal slime in the raw coal can meet the requirements of heavy medium coal dressing, the dynamic stability and the fluidity of the suspension are ensured, the suspension has proper viscosity, the heavy medium recovery in the later period is facilitated, the working efficiency is improved, and the coal dressing cost is saved.

title_en: Air purifier for removing peculiar smell and gaseous pollutants
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air purifier for removing peculiar smell and gaseous pollutants, which structurally comprises a base, a placing door, a purifier, a top cover and a container, wherein the upper end of the base is connected to the lower end of the container in a welding manner, the rear end of the placing door is movably clamped at the front end of the container, the lower end of the purifier is fixedly embedded and connected to the upper end of the container, the lower end of the top cover is connected to the upper end of the purifier in a riveting manner, the placing door is opened, chemical residues are poured into the container to volatilize to form gas and floaters, the purifier is electrified to operate, a rotating machine in the purifier is rotated to adsorb the gas and the floaters into the purifier for purification, the floaters are isolated by a purification net, a connecting rod and a scraping block at the lower end of a cleaning block are driven by rotation of a rotating wheel to scrape the floaters which are filtered to form adhesion at the lower end of the purification net, so that the floaters are prevented from forming adhesion to the purification net under the mixture of pressure covering of suction force and water mist, resulting in the formation of lumps that clog the purification net and result in a reduction in the amount of gas purified by the purifier.

title_en: Flat-plate hanging bag loading and unloading centrifuge
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flat-plate punching bag loading and unloading centrifuge, which belongs to the technical field of centrifuges and comprises a casing, wherein a rotary drum driven by a driving part is arranged on the inner side of the casing, a transmission main shaft is arranged in the middle of the rotary drum, the driving part is in transmission connection with the transmission main shaft through a synchronous belt, the top of the casing is movably connected with a flip cover, the inner surface and the outer surface of the flip cover are both subjected to polishing treatment, a feeding pipe and a washing pipe are arranged on the flip cover, the feeding pipe and the washing pipe penetrate through the inner side of the flip cover, a liquid baffle plate is arranged at the bottom of the flip cover, and a liquid discharge; the centrifugal machine is simple in structure, reliable in performance, convenient to operate and maintain, the filtering time can be mastered at will, filter residues can be fully washed, solid-phase particles are not damaged, filter bags are convenient to clean, the inner surface and the outer surface of the flip cover are polished, and sanitary dead angles are effectively eliminated.

title_en: Intelligent screening device and method for deep processing of agricultural and sideline products
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent screening device for agricultural and sideline product deep processing, which comprises a drying structure, a screening structure, a cleaning structure and an external adjusting structure, wherein the external adjusting structure comprises a driving motor and a base, the base comprises a screw rod, a fixing block and a handle, the drying structure comprises a drying cylinder and a turnover plate, the invention also discloses a screening method adopting the intelligent screening device for agricultural and sideline product deep processing, and the screening method comprises the following steps: throwing agricultural and sideline products to be treated, and waiting for the completion of screening; starting the clearance structure, on prior art's basis, improving sieving mechanism's structure, utilizing the cooperation of screw rod, fixed block and handle for the clearance structure can remove, and then can effectively cooperate the sieving mechanism, thereby can not influence the use of sieving mechanism because of the reason of clearance structure.

title_en: EPP granulation extruder filter equipment with online cleaning function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a filtering device of an EPP (expanded polypropylene) granulation extruder with an online cleaning function, which comprises a filtering box arranged between a charging barrel and a machine head of the EPP granulation extruder, wherein a flow passage is arranged in the filtering box; a filter screen flushing device is arranged beside the filter box and comprises a basin bracket, a basin arranged on the basin bracket and an electric control spraying device arranged on one side of the basin bracket; the device also comprises a transfer driving mechanism which is arranged corresponding to each filter screen lifting driving device and is used for transferring the filter screen lifting driving devices together with the filter screens to the upper part of the counter basin so as to supply the power-controlled spraying device to spray and clean the filter screens. The device can automatically clean the filter screen, does not need to be stopped during cleaning, and can not improve the load of the flow channel, thereby having higher working efficiency and working reliability.

title_en: Solid waste treatment system with hazardous waste pretreatment process
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of waste treatment, in particular to a solid waste treatment system with a hazardous waste pretreatment process, which comprises a body, wherein an outer shell is arranged in the body, a plurality of first discharge holes are formed in the outer wall of the outer shell at equal intervals, an arc groove is formed in the inner wall of the top of the outer shell, a plurality of first positioning sheets are fixedly connected in the arc groove at equal intervals, a steel ring is arranged in the arc groove, the steel ring penetrates through the first positioning sheets and is fixedly connected with the first positioning sheets, and the inner wall of the outer shell is rotatably connected with an inner shell. According to the invention, the motor rotates to drive the first blade and the second blade to rotate reversely, so that the solid waste in the inner shell is subjected to rotary cutting and shearing cutting, the solid waste with high toughness can be sheared and cut into fragments, and the outer shell drives the inner shell to rotate at different rotating speeds of the motor, so that the compression degrees of the springs are different, and the specifications of the crushed solid waste discharged from the pores are different.

title_en: Industrial robot label buries equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of intelligent machinery, in particular to label embedding equipment for an industrial robot, and aims at solving the problems that the conventional label embedding equipment is inconvenient to replace a label tape, glue is easy to condense, the embedding stability of the label tape is reduced, the glue in a glue tank cannot be automatically added, and the intelligent degree is low. The label embedding equipment provided by the invention is convenient to replace the label tape, can stir glue, prevents the glue from being condensed, improves the embedding stability of the label tape, can automatically add the glue in the glue tank, removes dust for the label tape, and has high intelligent degree.

title_en: Rural domestic sewage buried treatment device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rural domestic sewage buried treatment device, which comprises a filter screen, a power assembly and a cleaning assembly, wherein the filter screen and the power assembly are fixedly arranged in the filter chamber, a power source can be provided for the cleaning assembly through the power assembly, the cleaning assembly is fixedly connected on the power assembly, and the filter screen can be cleaned through the cleaning assembly, the device has a scientific and reasonable structure and is safe and convenient to use, when impurities are accumulated on the filter screen, the slide block is adsorbed by a contraction hole and moves rightwards, the slide block can drive a telescopic rod and a hairbrush to move rightwards, so that the hairbrush can clean the filter screen, when the slide block touches a closing switch, a control valve is closed, the slide block moves leftwards transversely under the elastic force of a first spring, and the hairbrush can always move leftwards close to the filter screen through the elastic force of a second spring to perform secondary cleaning, when the slide block touches the opening switch, the control valve is opened, and the brush can circularly reciprocate to clean the filter screen.

title_en: Herbal pieces-drying-machine for department of traditional chinese medicine that drying efficiency is high
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traditional Chinese medicine decoction piece dryer with high drying efficiency for a traditional Chinese medicine department, which comprises a machine base and a machine cover, wherein a driving motor and a drying cylinder are arranged in the machine base, the driving motor drives the drying cylinder to rotate, fan blades are connected in the machine cover in a rotating mode, the machine cover is fixedly connected with a cover arm, a connecting shaft penetrates through the lower portion of the cover arm and is in transmission connection with the fan blades, a connecting shaft sleeve connected with the driving motor in a power mode is arranged at the top of the machine base, after the machine cover is covered on the top of the machine base in place, the connecting shaft and the connecting shaft sleeve are in up-and. In the drying operation, the driving motor drives the drying cylinder to rotate, so that the traditional Chinese medicine decoction pieces in the drying cylinder can be fully rotated to be heated, the drying efficiency is high, the drying cylinder and the fan blades share one driving motor, the structure is more compact, and the fan blades are positioned in the machine cover, so that the fan blades can be conveniently cleaned after being used for a long time.

title_en: Micro-extractor based on 3D printing technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a micro-extractor manufactured based on a 3D printing technology, which is made of inert metals such as stainless steel, titanium alloy and the like, and consists of an inlet connector, a fluid distribution area, an extraction area, a fluid polymerization area and an outlet connector, wherein a main body consists of N (N is more than or equal to 5) micro-channels, and the surfaces of the micro-channels are coated with a stationary phase for extraction. The microchannels may be etched to a roughened surface to increase surface area. The micro-extractor is integrally formed through 3D printing and comprises a connector connected with the inlet and outlet pipe, so that the use of an additional connector is avoided, and the dead volume is greatly reduced; the low heat capacity and high thermal conductivity of the metal material facilitate rapid and uniform thermal desorption; the micro-extractor with the structure has very low air resistance and large surface area, and can simultaneously obtain large adsorption capacity and high mass transfer rate by coating the extraction stationary phase with micron-sized thickness, thereby realizing rapid extraction-rapid thermal desorption.

title_en: Liquid transfer driving device and method of micro-fluidic chip and detection equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a liquid transfer driving device of a microfluidic chip, a liquid transfer driving method of the microfluidic chip and detection equipment. The invention can automatically stir the solution in the reaction chamber and extrude the stirred solution out of the reaction chamber, thereby replacing manual operation, improving the working efficiency and reducing the cost.

title_en: Quick production line of building stones
abstract_en: This scheme belongs to building stones production technical field, discloses a building stones fast production line. Including building stones production facility, building stones production facility includes jaw crusher and frame, jaw crusher establishes in the frame, it is equipped with the pivot to rotate in the frame, be equipped with first gear and second gear in the pivot, jaw crusher include the main part, with the main part articulated clamp plate and the actuating mechanism of drive clamp plate, be equipped with the first rack with first gear engaged with on the clamp plate, still be equipped with in the frame with jaw crusher discharge gate assorted mediation pole, be equipped with the second rack with second gear engaged with on the mediation pole. This scheme is dredged through the discharge gate that sets up dredging rod and will block up, prevents that the discharge gate from being stifled, has improved the production efficiency of building stones production line for the production of building stones.

title_en: Transfer device for ammeter lead sealing label capable of being stored in evenly-separated mode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transfer device for a lead sealing label of an electric meter, which can be stored in a uniformly-separated manner, and comprises a frame, a rotating rod and a storage box, wherein the outer wall of the frame is fixedly connected with a fixed seat, a first connecting block is arranged inside the fixed seat, the outer side of the first connecting block is fixedly connected with a push rod, the inner side of the first connecting block is connected with a movable rod, one side of the movable rod is provided with a rotating shaft, the rotating rod is arranged inside the frame, the bottom of the rotating rod is connected with a soft hairbrush, the bottom of the soft hairbrush is provided with a screening disc, the outer side of the screening disc is fixedly provided with a connecting seat, the bottom of the screening disc is provided with a first storage box, and the bottom of the. This ammeter that can evenly separate storage transfer device for lead sealing label can adjust suitable push rod height according to user's height, and can separate the storage to different ammeter lead sealing labels, has certain screening effect simultaneously.

title_en: Zero-valent iron-manganese composite modified activated carbon and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses zero-valent iron-manganese composite modified activated carbon and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the zero-valent iron-manganese composite modified activated carbon comprises the following steps: soaking activated carbon in HCL solution, washing, adding ammonia water to react, washing, drying to obtain activated carbon A, and adding high-concentration FeCl 3 Solution and MnSO 4 Soaking in the solution, filtering, drying to obtain activated carbon B, and mixing with FeCl 3 、MnSO 4 Mixing in a reaction solvent, adding NaBH 4 The solution is reacted, washed, soaked in pyruvic acid solution, filtered and dried to prepare the zero-valent iron-manganese composite modified activated carbon. The surface of the zero-valent iron-manganese composite modified nano activated carbon consists of loose and porous zero-valent iron and manganese, has large surface area, is rich in hydroxyl (Fe-O, Mn-O) active sites, can be formed by oxidation reaction with nitrate, has strong adaptability and can be used in various water body treatments; the adsorption is fast, and the removal efficiency is high; the material has no toxicity, no pollution and low by-product.

title_en: Hardware paint spraying processing surface treatment equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides hardware paint spraying processing surface treatment equipment which structurally comprises a base, a processing box, a heat dissipation end, an electric control table and a paint bucket, wherein the upper end of the base is attached to the lower end of the processing box, the heat dissipation end is embedded into the side edge of the processing box, and the electric control table is arranged on the side edge of the processing box Status.

title_en: Rice hull screening plant is used in rice processing production
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rice hull screening device for rice processing production, which relates to the technical field of rice processing equipment and comprises a shell, wherein a feeding hopper is installed at the top of the shell, circular grooves are formed in the front and the back of the shell, a rotating rod is rotatably connected to the inner wall of each circular groove, a first motor is fixedly connected to one end of each rotating rod, a first transmission wheel is fixedly connected to the other end of each rotating rod, a grinding wheel mill is fixedly connected to the surface of each rotating rod, and a grinding plate is movably connected to the surface of each grinding wheel mill. According to the invention, the husk box is arranged to collect the husk, the air outlet pipe of the air outlet pipe box is communicated with the husk box, the husk after winnowing directly enters the husk box, the filter plate is arranged on the inner wall of the air outlet pipe, and the air to be dusted is filtered and then discharged, so that the husk dust carried in the air is prevented from being sucked by a human body, and the effect of reducing the flying dust in the husk discharging process is achieved.

title_en: Corn grain impurity content detection device and detection method
abstract_en: The invention provides a device and a method for detecting the impurity content of corn kernels, which are used for detecting the impurity content in the corn kernel harvesting process. The detection device comprises a conveying pipe, a charging barrel, a first air inlet, a second air inlet, a third air inlet, a large impurity outlet, a corn seed outlet, a small impurity outlet, a first screening mechanism and a second screening mechanism; the interior of the charging barrel is communicated with a conveying pipe, and a first screening mechanism and a second screening mechanism are arranged in the charging barrel up and down; the conveying pipe, the first air inlet, the second air inlet, the third air inlet, the large impurity outlet, the corn seed outlet and the small impurity outlet are all provided with a closing mechanism. The detection method comprises the following steps: obtaining a sample; conveying a sample; respectively collecting impurities and clean corn grains by the corn grain impurity rate detection device, and weighing again; and calculating the numerical value according to a formula to obtain the impurity rate.

title_en: Intelligent solar car shed and automatic maintenance method thereof
abstract_en: An intelligent solar carport and an automatic maintenance method thereof relate to the technical field of sun-shading devices. The intelligent solar carport comprises a main body frame, a solar panel, a turnover lifting mechanism, a storage battery and a charging pile; the solar panels are movably arranged at the upper end of the main body frame through corresponding overturning lifting mechanisms respectively; the solar panel is driven by the overturning lifting device to overturn and/or lift; when the solar panel is turned over, the included angle formed by the light receiving surface and the horizontal plane is changed between 0 and 180 degrees, and when the solar panel is lifted, the solar panel and the adjacent solar panel are staggered in the horizontal height. The invention has the advantages that: 1. the solar panel spraying and cleaning device has the function of automatically spraying and cleaning the solar panel; 2. the solar panel has the function of automatically avoiding the damage of the solar panel caused by severe weather; 3. the solar energy tracking device has the function of automatically tracking the light of the solar panel; 4. the contradiction between the protective structure of the solar panel and the utilization rate of the area of the top of the car shed is considered.

title_en: Medicine sprinkler is used in navel orange planting
abstract_en: The invention relates to a spraying device, in particular to a medicine spraying device for navel orange planting. The invention aims to provide a medicine spraying device for navel orange planting, which can automatically mix pesticides and spray the pesticides. The utility model provides a medicine sprinkler is planted to navel orange, including: the number of the outer frames is one; the tire is rotatably arranged on the outer frame; the first fixing column is arranged on one side of the upper part of the outer frame; the stirring box is arranged on the first fixing column; and the second fixing columns are symmetrically arranged on one side, close to the first fixing columns, of the upper part of the outer frame. The invention can automatically mix the pesticide and can automatically spray the pesticide; move about through first clamp plate for the pesticide in the pressing box passes through the blowout of vaporific shower nozzle, so realize the automatic effect of spraying to the pesticide.

title_en: Pig farm sterilization equipment of taking a breath
abstract_en: The invention provides ventilation and sterilization equipment for a pig farm, which structurally comprises a fixing frame, a box body, a positioning plate, a distribution box and fixing frames, wherein the left outer wall of each fixing frame is fixedly attached to the outer walls of two ends of the box body, when the ventilation equipment is used, air in the pig farm is continuously ventilated for a long time, partial sludge in the pig farm can fall onto the surfaces of blades, the sludge can adsorb more dust, the surfaces of the blades are completely covered with the blades, when the sludge, the dust and the like completely fall onto the surfaces of the blades, the weight of the blades can be improved, after the weight of the blades is improved, the angles of the blades can deviate for a certain distance due to the weight, the vibration condition is generated, the contact area with the air is reduced through angle change, the surfaces are inclined, stains on the surfaces of the blades can be shaken off by vibration, the weight of the blades is reduced, and further the loss of torque force is reduced, further, the rotation speed is increased, and the dirt on the surface of the blade is removed by increasing the rotation speed.

title_en: Reverse osmosis filter element and end cover thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses reverse osmosis filter core and end cover thereof, wherein, be formed with first water inlet on the interior capping of end cover, be formed with the second water inlet on the interior capping of end cover or the outer terminal surface, be formed with the water course in the end cover, the intercommunication first water inlet with the second water inlet. Through set up a water course on the end cover, this water course can be used to the pure water discharge to set up this end cover in the reverse osmosis filter core, the pure water can also be followed the water course department of end cover and discharged except can discharging from the central rod position, the inboard pure water runner of reverse osmosis membrane shortens, when not losing the membrane area, guaranteeing the filter effect, effectively reduces runner length, thereby reduces because of the loss of pressure that the runner overlength brought, maintains higher pure water flow.

title_en: Optical coating material raw materials for production mixing arrangement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mixing device for production raw materials of an optical coating material, and relates to the technical field of optical part processing related equipment. The mixing tank comprises a mixing tank, wherein a concave conical plate is arranged inside the mixing tank, a feeding pipeline is fixed at the upper end of the concave conical plate, the upper end of the feeding pipeline penetrates through the top end of the mixing tank, a convex conical plate is arranged right below the concave conical plate, a measuring cylinder is fixed at the upper end of a mounting plate, a stirring rod is arranged inside the mixing tank below the convex conical plate, a stirring plate is fixed on the surface side wall of the stirring rod, and through holes are uniformly formed in the side wall of the stirring plate. According to the invention, the concave conical plate rotates on the convex conical plate, so that raw materials are ground, the mixing efficiency of the raw materials is improved, the volume of water is observed through the measuring cylinder, the stable proportion of water and the raw materials is ensured, and meanwhile, when the stirring plate is used for stirring and mixing, the raw materials and the water are exposed out of the through holes, the oscillation amplitude is improved, and the comprehensive mixing is ensured.

title_en: SIM card detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a SIM card detection method.A control unit drives a card bin structure, a taking and placing structure, a card chain mechanism, an SIM card information reading structure and a pressing mechanism to execute the following steps: driving the taking and placing structure to push the SIM card in the card bin structure in the non-filing area out of the first SIM card port; driving a card chain mechanism to move the SIM card to an SIM card reading position; driving an SIM card information reading structure to read data information on the SIM card, and simultaneously sending the data information to a control unit by the SIM card information reading structure; the driving card chain mechanism moves the SIM card to the lower part of a corresponding card bin structure in the filing area; the pressing mechanism is driven to press the pressing end of the card bin structure; the driving pick-and-place structure pushes the SIM card in the card chain mechanism upwards to the card bin structure in the filing area. According to the technical scheme, the card bin structure, the taking and placing structure, the card chain mechanism, the SIM card information reading structure and the pressing mechanism are matched with each other to improve the filing efficiency of the SIM card.

title_en: Leftover material recovery processing device for tailoring
abstract_en: The utility model provides a leftover bits recovery processing device for tailoring, including first box, there is the second box on first box right side, there is cylindrical cavity inside of first box, there is first pivot between the side wall around the cylindrical cavity, the board is dialled in the connection of first pivot outside, there is the feed port cylindrical cavity upside, there is the barrel around the second box between the side wall, first air exhaust device is connected to barrel one end center department, there is the second through-hole the barrel outside, there is first arc second through-hole outer end, second box rear side inner wall elasticity telescopic link, there is the wedge elasticity telescopic link outer end, there is collection device under the barrel. According to the invention, stacked and wound cloth is scattered through the shifting plate, a continuous negative pressure effect is achieved in the cylinder body, so that raised part of dust can be sucked, when the cloth passes through the upper side of the collecting device, the cloth can fall into the collecting device through the cooperation of the wedge-shaped block and the first arc-shaped plate, and the situation that leftover materials are too scattered and subsequent treatment is difficult to carry out is prevented.

title_en: Preparation method of 4-methyl-5- (2-acetoxyethyl) thiazole
abstract_en: Disclosed is a preparation method of 4-methyl-5- (2-acetoxyethyl) thiazole, which is obtained by reacting 3-halo-5-acetoxy-2-pentanone with thiocarbamide, wherein the reaction takes SBA-15 molecular sieve supported ionic liquid as a catalyst. The catalyst not only improves the reaction yield, but also improves the product purity.

title_en: Gantry type cladding robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of laser cladding, in particular to a gantry type cladding robot, which comprises an operation table, a bracket mechanism, an operation mechanism, a material conveying mechanism, a limiting mechanism and a cleaning mechanism, wherein the operation table is arranged on the operation table; when the feeding mechanism is used, the feeding mechanism is arranged at the top of the operating mechanism, so that cladding powder materials can be automatically and uniformly conveyed conveniently during operation, the addition amount of the cladding powder materials can be accurately controlled, and the waste of the cladding powder materials is avoided; the limiting mechanism is arranged at the top of the operating platform, and the corresponding gear chain transmission and screw rod transmission assemblies are used for conveniently and reasonably clamping and fixing the machined part during operation, so that the machined part is prevented from deviating in the machining process, and a good machining effect is ensured; the cleaning mechanism is arranged at the top of the operating platform, and the cleaning mechanism is convenient to clean dust and impurities attached to the operating platform after being used through the corresponding sliding block assembly and the corresponding spring clamping block assembly, so that the influence on subsequent processing is avoided.

title_en: Preparation method and application of supported catalyst for catalyzing dimethyl oxalate hydrogenation
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a supported catalyst for catalyzing dimethyl oxalate hydrogenation, which comprises the following steps: dissolving copper nitrate in deionized water a, and adding an ammonia water solution to obtain a precursor solution; dissolving soluble metal salt in deionized water b, and humidifying a carrier to obtain a suspension; and dropwise adding the precursor solution to the suspension, performing ion exchange, then evaporating ammonia, washing, drying and roasting to obtain the supported catalyst. Also provides application of the catalyst in preparing glycol by catalyzing dimethyl oxalate to hydrogenate under low temperature and low pressure. The invention uses wet carrier and controls the water content of the precursor, and improves the hydrogenation performance of the catalyst. Soluble metal salt is loaded on the surface of a wet carrier by a precipitation method, ion exchange is carried out firstly, then ammonia evaporation treatment is carried out, the incomplete drying of a precursor is ensured, the metal-carrier interaction on the surface of the carrier is changed, the defect of low load capacity of the ion exchange method is overcome, the hydrogenolysis capability and the catalytic performance of the supported catalyst are improved, and the dimethyl oxalate is efficiently catalyzed to be hydrogenated to prepare the ethylene glycol at low temperature and low pressure.

title_en: Preparation process of graphene modified polyester resin for track anticorrosive paint
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation process of graphene modified polyester resin for track anticorrosive paint, which comprises the following steps: s1, mixing the graphene and the polyester resin, and then putting the mixture into a crushing device for crushing; and S2, putting the crushed graphene and polyester resin into a stirring device, and mixing and stirring to obtain a blend. According to the invention, the driving cylindrical gear is driven to rotate forwards or backwards through the first driving motor, the driven cylindrical gear is driven to drive the transmission screw to rotate, the sliding blocks at two ends are driven to move away from or close to each other in the horizontal direction, the connecting plate is driven to reciprocate in the vertical direction under the action of the connecting rod, and then the rack is driven to move in the vertical direction through the sliding rod to drive the crushing roller to rotate, so that a graphene and polyester resin mixture at the meshing position of the crushing roller and the rack is crushed, the condition that materials fly out is improved, and the crushing quality is improved.

title_en: Glass fiber cloth impurity removing device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a glass fiber cloth impurity removing device which comprises an impurity removing cavity, wherein a metal impurity removing cavity and a non-metal impurity removing cavity are sequentially arranged in the impurity removing cavity, two ends of the impurity removing cavity are provided with feed rollers for conveying glass fiber cloth, two metal impurity adsorption devices are arranged in the metal impurity removing cavity, and the glass fiber cloth penetrates through a gap between the two metal impurity adsorption devices; be provided with the bar hole that supplies the glass fiber cloth to pass on the baffle, set up the negative pressure edulcoration device in the nonmetal edulcoration intracavity, the below of negative pressure edulcoration device is provided with the vibrating device of drive glass fiber cloth vibration, and the upper end and the lower extreme in bar hole all are provided with spacing roller, are provided with the clearance that supplies the glass fiber cloth to pass between two spacing rollers. The scheme is used for cleaning the produced glass fiber cloth, removing metal or non-metal impurities on the surface of the glass fiber cloth and ensuring the qualification rate of the produced copper-clad plate. In the whole process, the impurity removal effect of the glass fiber cloth is good, the residual degree of impurities on the surface of the glass fiber cloth is effectively reduced, and the quality of the produced copper-clad plate is ensured.

title_en: Method for removing phosphorus in water containing humic acid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for removing phosphorus in a water body containing humic acid, and relates to the field of water treatment. The method comprises the following steps: dissolving zirconium oxychloride in a mixed solvent of absolute ethyl alcohol and dimethylformamide, then adding P123 into the mixed solvent, and stirring; continuously adding polyvinylpyrrolidone, and stirring to obtain a spinning precursor; spinning to obtain an electrostatic spinning mesoporous zirconia nanofiber gel; carrying out heat treatment on the electrospun mesoporous zirconia nanofiber gel, and then naturally cooling to room temperature to obtain electrospun mesoporous zirconia nanofibers; and putting the mixture into a phosphorus solution containing humic acid to remove phosphorus.

title_en: Adjustable mixer
abstract_en: The invention discloses an adjustable stirrer which comprises an equipment main body, wherein the equipment main body comprises a lifting fixing component, a driving component connected with the lifting fixing component, an adjustable stirring fan blade component connected with the driving component, and a stirring barrel arranged below the adjustable stirring fan blade component. The fan blade assembly has the advantages that the existing fan blade assembly is improved, so that workers can quickly adjust the angle of the fan blade to meet requirements under different mixing conditions, the assembly and disassembly are convenient and quick, the transportation and the assembly are convenient, and the economic cost is reduced.

title_en: Metal-organic framework material ZIF-67 and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of metal-organic framework materials, and particularly discloses a metal-organic framework material ZIF-67 and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the steps of grinding and uniformly mixing cobalt hydroxide and 2-methylimidazole by a heat-assisted mechanochemical method to obtain mixed powder of the light purple cobalt hydroxide and the 2-methylimidazole, heating to 60-140 ℃ under a closed condition, keeping the temperature for 10-30min under normal pressure, then heating to 145-180 ℃ and keeping the temperature for 1-12h under a vacuum condition, and finally cooling to room temperature to obtain the metal-organic framework material ZIF-67. The preparation method has the advantages of no solvent, short preparation period, high yield, small size of the obtained metal-organic framework material ZIF-67, particle size of 100-200nm, and specific surface area of 1650-1800m 2 (ii) in terms of/g. Mixed matrix membrane pair C obtained by using the same as filler 3 H 6 /C 3 H 8 Has good separation performance.

title_en: Catalyst for hydrogenation reaction and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a catalyst for hydrogenation reaction of petroleum resin and a preparation method thereof. More particularly, the present invention relates to a nickel-based catalyst for hydrogenation reaction, which is added to a hydrogenation reaction for improving the color of petroleum resin, and which is a nickel powder catalyst containing nickel (Ni), copper (Cu), and sulfur (S). According to an embodiment of the present invention, there is provided a catalyst for hydrogenation reaction, comprising 40 to 80 parts by weight of nickel, 0.01 to 5 parts by weight of copper, 1 to 10 parts by weight of sulfur and 10 to 60 parts by weight of silica carrier, based on 100 parts by weight of the catalyst, based on the total dry weight of the carrier. Therefore, the quality of the petroleum resin is improved. In addition, unsaturated bonds of the petroleum resin are removed to provide a transparent water-white (water-white) petroleum resin which is colorless, odorless, and improved in heat resistance.

title_en: Wrapping type stone crusher
abstract_en: The invention provides a wrapping type stone crusher, and belongs to the technical field of civil engineering equipment. The device comprises a base, a feeding hopper and a stone crushing box body fixed on the base, wherein a plurality of stone crushing mechanisms positioned below the feeding hopper are transversely arranged in the stone crushing box body, each stone crushing mechanism comprises a drive plate and stone crushing components distributed on two sides of the drive plate, each stone crushing component comprises a spring column arranged on the drive plate, one end of each spring column is connected with the drive plate, the other end of each spring column is fixedly connected with the stone crushing box body, two ends of each spring column are respectively and fixedly provided with an extrusion block positioned in each spring column, the middle part of the stone crushing box body is transversely and slidably connected with a telescopic rod, one end of each telescopic rod is fixedly connected with a push rod of a hydraulic cylinder, and a cylinder body of each hydraulic cylinder is fixed on the outer wall surface of the stone crushing box body; from top to bottom, the spring post in each rubble subassembly faces the circle clearance and reduces gradually under the natural state. The invention has the advantages of controlling stone splashing and the like.

title_en: Intelligent sorting hand applied to customs clearance articles in nuclear radiation high-risk area
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent sorting hand applied to customs clearance articles in a nuclear radiation high-risk area, belonging to the technical field of sorting hands. According to the intelligent sorting hand, the bionic control mechanism part and the grabbing mechanical arm can be respectively placed in two different areas through the designed grabbing mechanism, so that a detection person can complete work in a safe area, the grabbing mechanical arm can smoothly place an article to be sorted into a sorting machine for sorting after learning, the detection person does not need to contact the detected article completely in the whole process, the detection person is enabled to well avoid the possibility of contacting nuclear radiation, and the requirements of grabbing and detecting different kinds of goods are met through learning control of the displacement of the grabbing mechanism through the potentiometer.

title_en: Test tube cleaning and sterilizing device for biological tissue culture
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test tube cleaning and disinfecting device for biological tissue culture, which comprises a box body, wherein a groove is formed in the box body, a plurality of disinfectant is arranged in the groove, a liquid pump is fixedly connected to the bottom of the groove, the groove is semicircular, a rotating shaft is rotatably connected to the circle center position of the groove and rotates in the box body, a rotating roller is coaxially welded and fixed on the rotating shaft, a plurality of cavities are formed in the rotating roller, electromagnetic push rods are arranged at the bottoms of the cavities, the rotating shaft and the box body are jointly connected with a rotating device, the rotating roller is connected with a fixing device, and the rotating roller is connected with a cleaning device. Has the advantages that: through the rotation that utilizes the second motor, it is rotatory to drive the washing axle to make the brush rotate, carry out thorough washing to test tube inside, the effectual influence of remaining to the experiment next time that has prevented reagent and cell.

title_en: Dispenser for dispensing a fluid
abstract_en: There is described a dispenser (1) for dispensing a fluid made of plastic material, comprising: -a ring nut (2) having a cylindrical inner wall (5) equipped with a partial groove (5 a); -an accordion-like deformable element (7) defining a return spring of the dispenser (1) and comprising a cylindrical lower projection (7a) equipped with a relative partial recess (7 b); -a ring (12) designed to define, with the ring nut (2), a locking system designed to define an operating configuration and a non-operating configuration of the dispenser (1), so as to pull the accordion-like deformable element (7) to align the partial grooves (5a, 7b) of the cylindrical wall (5) of the ring nut (2) and of the accordion-like deformable element (7).

title_en: Battery pack sorting method, apparatus, computer device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a battery pack sorting method, a battery pack sorting device, a computer device and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: respectively acquiring a first voltage value of each single battery; obtaining a plurality of first voltage difference values according to the plurality of first voltage values, wherein each first voltage difference value is a difference value between any two first voltage values; and outputting the information that the battery pack is to be disassembled when the first voltage difference is greater than or equal to the first difference threshold. By adopting the method, the retired battery pack can be sorted quickly and accurately.

title_en: Energy-concerving and environment-protective fallen leaves collecting box for degradation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a collecting box, in particular to an energy-saving and environment-friendly collecting box for fallen leaf degradation. The invention provides an energy-saving and environment-friendly collection box for fallen leaf degradation, which scientifically utilizes fallen leaf resources, automatically degrades fallen leaves and has higher degradation speed. An energy-concerving and environment-protective fallen leaves degradation is with collecting box includes: the upper part of the inner wall of the structure frame is provided with a fixed frame; the reaction box is arranged in the fixing frame; the blanking mechanism is arranged at the upper part of the structural frame; the top of the structural frame is provided with a wind power mechanism; the discharging mechanism is arranged on the lower side of the structure frame. According to the invention, the starting of the direct current motor is controlled by the remote controller, and after the direct current motor is started, the output shaft of the direct current motor rotates to drive the transmission shaft to rotate, so that the spiral blades are driven to rotate, and the fallen leaves are conveyed into the reaction box, thereby realizing the effect of blanking.

title_en: Violin panel paint spraying treatment device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of paint spraying devices, and discloses a violin panel paint spraying treatment device which comprises a device main body, wherein a paint spraying box is arranged inside the device main body, an air drying box is arranged on one side of the paint spraying box, a through groove is formed between the paint spraying box and the air drying box, a controller is arranged at the top of the device main body, a storage box is arranged outside the device main body, a first feeding pipe is arranged at the top of the storage box, a paint pump is arranged at one end of the first feeding pipe, a second feeding pipe is arranged at one end of the paint pump, an atomizing nozzle is arranged at one end of the second feeding pipe, a first motor is arranged at the top of the paint spraying box, a driving belt wheel is arranged at one end of the first motor, a threaded rod is arranged inside the device main body, and a driven belt wheel is arranged at one end of the threaded rod. This violin panel processing apparatus that sprays paint, it is effectual to spray paint, and it is efficient to spray paint, can reduce directly to discharge simultaneously through setting up exhaust gas purification device and cause the influence to workman's health and operational environment.

title_en: Anti-yellowing composite reverse osmosis membrane and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method and application of an anti-yellowing composite reverse osmosis membrane, wherein poly (ethylene glycol dimethacrylate (EGMA)/isobutoxy acrylamide (IBMA)/Acrylamide (AM)) ternary anti-yellowing copolymer particles are synthesized, the ternary anti-yellowing copolymer particles are fixed in an ultrafiltration membrane, IBMA is added in an interfacial polymerization process to form two anti-yellowing layers, and the IBMA can be crosslinked with polybasic acyl chloride or self to form a flexible network in the interfacial polymerization process to improve the stability of a desalting layer. The test result shows that compared with the existing reverse osmosis membrane, the anti-yellowing composite reverse osmosis membrane prepared by the invention has the advantages of excellent anti-yellowing performance, longer service life, higher flux and higher desalting performance.

title_en: Down feather recycling and cleaning device for garment processing factory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a down feather recycling and cleaning device for a garment processing factory, which comprises: a column; the base is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of one side of the upright post; the shell is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the other side of the base; the suction mechanism is arranged on one side of the upright post; the rotating mechanism is arranged at the top end of the base; and the recovery assembly is arranged in the inner cavity of the shell. This cleaning device is retrieved to eiderdown for tailoring factory, accessible connecting rod drive circular tube reciprocating motion from top to bottom, and the bar cover can follow and absorb down to the eiderdown on one's body of staff to carrying out comprehensive cleanness to the eiderdown on one's body of staff, can be clean to the whole body degree of going on of staff, and the clearance is simple, is convenient for carry out recovery processing to the eiderdown of collecting box, can avoid the eiderdown to cause the waste.

title_en: Crystallizer, crystallizer sealing method and sealing coating
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crystallizer, which comprises an inner pipe, wherein the inner pipe comprises a pipe body and a pipe sleeve, the pipe body is provided with an outlet, the pipe sleeve is provided with an inlet, one end of the pipe body, which is far away from the outlet, is welded and fixed with the end part, which is far away from the inlet, of the pipe sleeve, the inner pipe also comprises a sealing structure, the sealing structure comprises a graphite filling layer and an insulating paint bonding layer, the graphite filling layer is filled in cracks of the pipe body and the pipe sleeve, the insulating paint bonding layer is positioned between the pipe body and the pipe sleeve and bonds the pipe body and the pipe sleeve, the cracked inner pipe is repaired, and the service life of the crystallizer is prolonged.

title_en: High-grade quick cleaning device of digit control machine tool bearing
abstract_en: The invention discloses high-grade numerical control machine tool bearing rapid cleaning equipment, and particularly relates to the field of numerical control machine tools, which comprises a bearing profile plate mechanism, wherein a plurality of bearing ball circumference cleaning mechanisms are fixedly arranged in the bearing profile plate mechanism; the bearing type panel mechanism comprises a first corresponding bearing tray, and a second corresponding bearing tray is fixedly installed on one side of the first corresponding bearing tray. According to the invention, the bearing ball circumference cleaning mechanism is arranged, after the air pressure type liquid storage round bag is extruded, the air pressure type liquid storage round bag can penetrate into the anti-skidding rubber sleeve and the hairbrush type ball cleaning ball, and the hairbrush type ball cleaning ball penetrates into the outer wall of the ball of the bearing through the extrusion type liquid permeation pipeline, so that the convenience of cleaning the dead angle position of the bearing ball is relatively improved.

title_en: Adding device and method for coking by blending tar residue with coal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tar residue coal blending coking adding device and a method thereof, wherein the device comprises an electric cut-off valve (1), a feeding pipe (2), a circulating pipe (3), a nozzle (4), a distributing pipe (5) and a conveying pump (6); the circulating pipe is arranged above the coal tower chamber (7) and surrounds the periphery of the rotary distribution trolley (8), the feeding pipe is connected with the tar residue collecting tank (10) through a conveying pump, and the feeding pipe is communicated with the circulating pipe; a plurality of distribution pipes are communicated with the circulating pipe, penetrate through the coal tower chamber and are installed with nozzles; a plurality of electric cut-off valves interlocked with the rotary distributing trolley are arranged on a plurality of distributing pipes. The method can completely treat the tar residues in the coking production, avoid the pollution to the environment in the conveying and adding processes of the tar residues, reduce the complicated operation processes of lifting, dumping and the like, realize the recycling and utilization efficiency of production wastes, ensure the cleanness in the coking production process and improve the economic and social benefits of the coking unit.

title_en: Rotating bed equipment with packed plate module
abstract_en: The utility model provides a rotatory bed equipment of packing plate module, belong to the gas-liquid transmission equipment field, by the bed body, the air inlet, a sealed cylinder, the revolving bed, the rotation axis, the defroster, the gas outlet, the bearing frame, the bearing support, the inlet tube, the water-locator, a motor, the reduction gear, the delivery port, the packing plate module, screw rod etc. constitute, the revolving bed is welded squirrel cage structure, there is the locating hole of installation module on the concentric ring of support, the packing plate module is arranged in the lattice window of squirrel cage structure revolving bed support, fasten with locknut, form annular filler, the annular filler number is more than or equal to 1, can adapt to the requirement of various operating modes better, the mass transfer efficiency has been improved, the mass transfer process has been reinforceed, the sector plate module makes the installation maintenance of revolving bed filler more convenient, the parallel plate filler is difficult for blockking up, be particularly useful for the processing of the gas-liquid medium that solid particle content is more.

title_en: Ammonia-oxygen mixed feeding system and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ammonia-oxygen mixed feeding system and a working method thereof.A outlet of an ammonia source system is communicated with an inlet of an ammonia dissolver through a first-stage pressure reducer, an automatic pressure regulator and a second pressure transmitter; the automatic control system is connected with the delivery pump, the automatic pressure regulator, the first pressure transmitter, the second pressure transmitter and the automatic voltage stabilizer, the system and the working method thereof can meet the requirements of full working condition and full automatic operation of the thermal power generating unit, and the system has the characteristics of low cost, strong maintenance convenience and high space utilization rate.

title_en: Preparation method of ibuprofen suspension
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an ibuprofen suspension, wherein 100 mL of the ibuprofen suspension comprises the following components in percentage by weight: 1-4g of ibuprofen, 2-4g of pregelatinized starch, 1-3g of xanthan gum, 10-18g of glycerol, 10-30g of sucrose, 0.1-1g of citric acid, 0.1-0.6g of sodium benzoate, 800.1-1 g of polysorbate, 0.01-0.2g of lemon yellow, 0.1-0.6g of allura red, 0.1-0.4g of strawberry essence and the balance of pure water. The preparation method of the ibuprofen suspension provided by the invention can better maintain the quality stability of the ibuprofen suspension, ensure the stability of the sedimentation volume ratio, reduce the viscosity fluctuation and prevent agglomeration.

title_en: Anti-soil-sticking flat plate type tamping device for soil shoveling machine and implementation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ramming tools, in particular to a soil sticking prevention flat plate type ramming device for a shoveling machine and an implementation method thereof; the design of a turntable and a rotating wheel which rotate synchronously is adopted, wherein the outer edge of the turntable is in a major arc shape, and two ends of the major arc are connected through a chord; the rotating wheel is provided with a tip end, one side of the tip end is connected with a base circle of the rotating wheel along a smooth line, and the other side of the tip end is provided with a sudden change cliff; the turntable rotates and is matched with the bump to realize the lifting of the tamping flat plate, the position of the tamping flat plate is kept fixed for a certain time after the tamping flat plate is lifted, and the left and right movement of the earth scraping knife is completed through the matching of the rotating wheel and the earth scraping component within the fixed time period, wherein the left movement realizes the cleaning and scraping of the bottom surface of the tamping flat plate, and the right movement realizes the resetting and avoids the interference with the earth scraping knife when the subsequent tamping flat plate moves downwards; the actions are periodically repeated along with the rotation of the turntable and the rotating wheel, so that the bottom surface of the floor tamping flat plate is automatically scraped after the floor tamping flat plate is tamped every time, and the clay on the bottom surface of the floor tamping flat plate is avoided.

title_en: Yogurt-flavor microcapsule powder essence and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of essence, and particularly relates to a yoghurt-flavor microcapsule powder essence and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation comprises the following components in percentage by weight: 5-20% of yoghourt extract, 15-25% of maltodextrin, 0.025-0.5% of citric acid and salts thereof, 40-75% of water, 5-10% of yoghourt essence and 0.1-2% of glycerin fatty acid ester. The yoghurt flavor microcapsule powder essence solves the problem that the original mixing type yoghurt flavor powder essence cannot restore the vivid and smooth mouthfeel of yoghurt, has more complete flavor expression compared with the existing yoghurt powder product, has good fragrance stability and temperature resistance, and has moderate perfuming cost.

title_en: Mixing device with component distribution ratio mechanism for livestock feed preparation and implementation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mixing device with a component distribution ratio mechanism for livestock feed preparation in the technical field of livestock feed preparation and an implementation method, the mixing device comprises a stirring mechanism, a plurality of driving shafts, a first servo motor, a plurality of quantitative spiral conveying mechanisms, a power connection device and a proportioning system, different raw materials required by feed synthesis are contained by the quantitative spiral conveying mechanisms, a timing switch controls the working duration of the quantitative spiral conveying mechanisms to finish quantitative input into the proportioning system, a containing hopper is matched with a semicircular baffle to finish containing, the whole body is weighed by using a weighing sensor, a PLC controller controls a forward and reverse rotating motor to drive a bidirectional screw to finish semicircular baffle displacement after the quality meets the requirement, the raw materials flow into the stirring mechanism, different raw material components are added successively, and finally the mixing is carried out by the stirring mechanism, the device is convenient to operate and can intelligently finish proportioning, has market popularization value.

title_en: For H2Copper-based MOF adsorbent for removing S gas and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for H 2 A copper-based MOF adsorbent for removing S gas and a preparation method thereof relate to the field of catalyst design. The adsorbent is prepared by taking copper nitrate, sodium hydroxide and 2-aminobenzene dicarboxylic acid as reaction raw materials, taking water and DMF as solvents and reacting at room temperature, the invention adopts 2-aminobenzene dicarboxylic acid as a ligand to synthesize the amino-copper-based MOF adsorbent, so that the adsorption stability is greatly improved, and the adsorption effect is still high after the adsorbent is used for many times; the amino-copper-based MOF adsorbent has a stable structure, does not generate irreversible structural transformation, and has a stable pore structure and strong plasticity; and after grafting of the amino group, H 2 The adsorption capacity of S is remarkably improved.

title_en: Medical treatment cutter surface spraying device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medical cutter surface spraying device which comprises a support frame, wherein a through hole is formed in the side wall of the support frame, a double-head motor is fixedly connected in the through hole, a clamp used for clamping a medical cutter is arranged at one end of the double-head motor, a spraying mold is arranged at one end, away from the clamp, of the double-head motor, and a spraying assembly is arranged at the upper end of the support frame.
