According to the invention, by arranging the spraying assembly, when medical cutters with different specifications and sizes are sprayed, the linear motor is utilized to drive the cross rod to reciprocate, the control assembly and the spray gun are driven to respectively move on a clamp and a mould to be sprayed, when the control assembly senses the mould, the spray gun synchronously sprays, different spraying moulds can be replaced according to the cutters to be sprayed, automatic spraying on the medical cutters with different models is realized, and the spraying processing efficiency of the medical cutters is improved.

title_en: Interior decoration construction process for office building
abstract_en: The invention relates to an office building interior decoration construction process, which uses an office building interior decoration construction device, the office building interior decoration construction device comprises a spreading mechanism and a placement mechanism, the spreading mechanism is arranged at the left upper end of the placement mechanism, the lower end of the placement mechanism is connected with a base surface in a sliding way, the invention adopts the design concept of multiple compaction to lay the floor tiles in an office, the arranged spreading mechanism can facilitate constructors to quickly strike off the dry and hard mortar layer on the basis of laying the dry and hard mortar layer, thereby being beneficial to improving the efficiency of the overall laying of the base surface, the arranged placement mechanism can carry out elastic compaction treatment on the laid tiles to improve the effect of laying the tiles, and simultaneously can realize the storage of a plurality of tiles for continuous supply without the constructors to run back and forth for picking up the tiles for a plurality of times, thereby improving the overall efficiency of tile laying.

title_en: Particulate matter collecting structure and electrostatic dust collection device
abstract_en: The invention provides a particulate matter collecting structure and an electrostatic dust collector, which comprise a high-potential electrode plate and a low-potential electrode plate, wherein the high-potential electrode plate and the low-potential electrode plate respectively comprise a transparent electrode plate body, at least one of the high-potential electrode plate and the low-potential electrode plate comprises an insulating layer structure, the insulating layer structure is coated outside the transparent electrode plate body, the high-potential electrode plate and the low-potential electrode plate are vertically arranged, a trapping electric field is formed between the adjacent high-potential electrode plate and the low-potential electrode plate after electrification, UCNPs (crown fiber glass) material is adhered to the outer surface of the transparent insulating layer structure, and the UCNPs material can convert visible light with the wavelength range of 380 nm-780 nm into ultraviolet light with the wavelength of less than 380 nm. The particle collecting device has the advantage that the particle collecting structure can be irradiated by the external light source to play a role in sterilization.

title_en: Method for preparing triclopyr butoxyethyl ester by aqueous phase synthesis method
abstract_en: A method for preparing triclopyr butoxyethyl ester by a water phase synthesis method is characterized in that triclopyr sodium and chloracetyl chloride are used as raw materials to generate triclopyr acetyl chloride, and then the triclopyr acetyl chloride reacts with 2-butoxyethanol to generate triclopyr butoxyethyl ester, and all reactions are carried out in a water phase; the preparation method can improve the reaction efficiency, reduce side reactions, improve the product purity and improve the purity to 98.8-99.2%; the yield is improved to 99.2 to 99.5 percent; can also reduce the erosion of rainwater to the pesticide, and overcomes the defect that triclopyr butoxyethyl acetate can be effective only when no rainwater exists within 2 hours of using the pesticide.

title_en: Plant organ fully-integrated chip system based on resonance waveguide and detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a plant organ fully integrated chip system and a detection method based on a resonance waveguide in the fields of biosensing and micro-nano processing, wherein three cell temporary culture and detection cavities and a buffer cavity are sequentially connected through a main channel, the bottom of a central cavity of each cell temporary culture and detection cavity is provided with a micro-ring optical waveguide, an optical waveguide is respectively arranged below each micro-ring optical waveguide, the three optical waveguides are respectively connected with an infrared light source excitation device and an infrared spectrum analyzer through optical fiber hoses, root, stem and leaf cells are respectively injected into the corresponding three cell temporary culture and detection cavities, cell culture solution sequentially flows through the three cell temporary culture and detection cavities to obtain the concentration of inorganic salt ions absorbed by plant cells, and the types of the inorganic salt ions are distinguished; the invention imitates a system designed by a structure at the vein fine vein in a dicotyledonous plant leaf, integrates detection waveguides of three cell culture cavities into a near-infrared light source excitation device, ensures the rigidness of the detection process, and is convenient, fast and high in accuracy.

title_en: Enterostomy fluid separation device based on hydrophobic porous membrane
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical devices and materials, and discloses an enterostomy fluid separation device based on a hydrophobic porous membrane, which is used for selectively separating and discharging excrement, water and gas of an enterostomy (particularly small enterostomy) and reducing the damage of the excrement to skin around the enterostomy. Comprises a stoma fixing ring fixed on the skin around the intestinal stoma, and a hydrophobic porous membrane substrate, a self-supporting tube wall and an air guide catheter which are sequentially arranged outside the stoma fixing ring. The high-hydrophobicity porous membrane with larger aperture is combined with the stoma through the medical adhesive and the fixed structure, and the separated water and gas are discharged out of the body through the pipeline. Compared with the traditional ostomy bag, the invention can selectively discharge water and gas in the excrement, so that the solid excrement can be retained in the intestinal cavity for a longer time, and indirect control of excrement is realized; finally, because the water is discharged from the body, the tolerance of the patient to the stoma is greatly improved, and the quick social return of the patient is very favorable from the aspects of physiology and psychology.

title_en: Leather coating with fluorescent response to benzene-series VOCs and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a leather coating with fluorescence responsiveness to benzene-series VOCs (volatile organic compounds) and a preparation method thereof. The leather sample coated by the leather finishing agent with fluorescence responsiveness to the benzene-series VOCs prepared by the invention has fluorescence performance and fluorescence responsiveness, and the tensile strength, the tear strength and the bursting strength of the coated leather sample are respectively improved by 70%, 30.2% and 74.23%.

title_en: Moisture removing air pressure equipment for cooked meat
abstract_en: The invention discloses cooked meat moisture-removing pneumatic equipment which structurally comprises an air outlet, a drying box, a control box and a bottom frame, wherein the air outlet is fixedly embedded and connected to the left side of the front end of the drying box; the stoving case is by intercepting device, the air heater, the chamber door, collection device, the standing groove is constituteed, intercepting device activity block is closed between collection device, the air heater is located the intercepting device top, the chamber door is established at air heater right side lower extreme, standing groove horizontal connection is between collection device, contact block that steam can follow in intercepting device when ripe meat is dried converges, contact the sponge pad and be adsorbed by it and collect, and can hang down when the sponge pad reaches saturated condition and draw the fixture block to slide under the injecing of slide bar, extrude and will collect the moisture of inboard and discharge downwards, the continuous fixed plate outline in the department of converging of water droplet is along converging, flow in along sinking in the fringed edge, the sponge pad can expand again after the rivers discharge and restore and continue to adsorb.

title_en: Reverse osmosis membrane element, filter element and water purifier
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reverse osmosis membrane element, a filter element and a water purifier, wherein the reverse osmosis membrane element comprises: the membrane element body is coiled into a cylinder shape, the inner side surface of the membrane element body is provided with a pure water outlet, and the end surface of the membrane element body is provided with a raw water inlet and a waste water outlet; and the sealing layer is coated on the outer side surface of the membrane element body and seals the outer side surface of the membrane element body. The technical scheme of the invention can reduce the volume of the reverse osmosis membrane element.

title_en: Electric arc spraying device for cast ingot surface
abstract_en: The invention relates to an electric arc spraying device for the surface of an ingot, which comprises an outer bottom bracket, wherein the outer bottom bracket is fixedly arranged on one side of a furnace body, the furnace body is fixedly arranged on the ground, double tracks are arranged on the outer bottom bracket, a feeding frame is arranged on the double tracks, a trailer frame is arranged on the outer side of the feeding frame on the outer bottom bracket, and the outer bottom bracket is movably connected with the trailer frame. The device can realize the function of ingot casting surface automatic spraying in enclosure space, reduces artifical intensity of labour, improves production efficiency, simultaneously, through removing dust to enclosure space and purifying, has improved operational environment, improves operating quality.

title_en: Testing and sorting method for rectifier bridge stack
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test sorting method of a rectifier bridge stack, which comprises the following steps: testing the bending stiffness of the rectifier bridge stack; coating a cladding layer on the circumferential surface of the butt joint part of one sample and the other sample which are in end face butt joint so as to connect the one sample and the other sample, and stretching the one sample and the other sample to the butt joint surface part of the one sample and the other sample to break the cladding layer so as to obtain the bonding strength of the cladding layer; putting the rectifier bridge stack into a rectifier bridge stack testing device; and detecting non-static voltage data of the rectifier bridge stack. According to the testing and sorting method for the rectifier bridge stack, the software quality and the hardware quality of the rectifier bridge stack can be detected in multiple steps through bending stiffness of the testing rectifier bridge stack, bonding strength of the testing rectifier bridge stack and non-static voltage data of the testing rectifier bridge stack, detection of multiple steps is achieved, the defective rate of the rectifier bridge stack is greatly reduced, and production quality is improved.

title_en: Substrate processing apparatus
abstract_en: The invention provides a substrate processing apparatus, which can inhibit static electricity and improve the removal rate of pollutants. The substrate processing apparatus according to the embodiment includes: a placing table capable of rotating the substrate; a cooling unit configured to supply a cooling gas to a space between the placing table and the substrate; a1 st liquid supply unit configured to supply a1 st liquid to a surface of the substrate opposite to the placement stage; a 2 nd liquid supply unit capable of supplying a 2 nd liquid having a higher conductivity than the 1 st liquid to the surface of the substrate; and a control unit for controlling the rotation of the substrate, the supply of the cooling gas, the supply of the 1 st liquid, and the supply of the 2 nd liquid.

title_en: Cermet wear-resisting roller shell
abstract_en: The invention discloses a metal ceramic wear-resistant roller sleeve, which comprises a roller core, at least two connecting components and at least two hydraulic components.

title_en: Preparation method of modified poly (vinylidene fluoride-co-hexafluoropropylene) -grafted vinyl imidazole anion exchange membrane
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a modified poly (vinylidene fluoride-co-hexafluoropropylene) -grafted vinyl imidazole anion exchange membrane, which comprises the following steps: (1) fully stirring poly (vinylidene fluoride-co-hexafluoropropylene) and DMAc in a container to obtain a transparent solution A; (2) slowly adding a strong base alcohol solution into the solution A, and stirring to obtain a solution C; (3) slowly adding the solution C into excessive deionized water to obtain fibrous solid, washing the solid to be neutral by using the deionized water, and drying in vacuum to obtain solid D; (4) dissolving solid D, vinyl imidazole and benzoyl peroxide in NMP to obtain solution E; (5) and heating the solution E in a nitrogen atmosphere for reaction, adding 1, 4-dibromobutane, fully stirring, spreading the obtained solution on a clean glass plate, and drying in vacuum to obtain the modified poly (vinylidene fluoride-co-hexafluoropropylene) grafted vinyl imidazole anion exchange membrane. The membrane acid prepared by the invention has excellent concentration performance, good acid resistance and low swelling degree.

title_en: Novel energy-saving efficient vanadium-nitrogen alloy production equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses novel energy-saving and high-efficiency vanadium-nitrogen alloy production equipment, which comprises a preparation box, wherein the top of the preparation box is provided with a feeding port, one side of the preparation box is provided with a second motor, the inner wall of the preparation box is symmetrically and rotatably connected with rotating rods, gears are arranged outside the two rotating rods and inside the preparation box, the two gears are in meshing connection, and the output end of the second motor is fixedly connected with one end of one rotating rod; the invention has the beneficial effects that: improve to the problem of current vanadium nitrogen alloy preparation in-process inefficiency, integrate to the processing step who refines the in-process dispersion, provide a device that can prepare the integration, compounding, stirring, briquetting, calcination equal an organic whole, avoid leading to final finished product quality to deviate because of the process of transport is longer, and improve the single mode of calcining of traditional stove, carry out the multistage and calcine to the vanadium nitrogen alloy is refined to the efficient, the device easy operation, convenient and practical.

title_en: Electronic component quality detection screening plant
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electronic elements, and relates to an electronic element quality detection screening device which comprises a shell, wherein first fixing plates are fixedly connected to the opposite inner walls of the shell. The electronic component quality detection screening device has the advantages that by the arrangement of the first vibrating motor, the first motor, the second spring and the elliptical wheel, under the elastic action of the telescopic assembly, the first screening frame is driven by the first vibrating motor to vibrate, screening and classification of electronic components of different specifications are facilitated, the elliptical wheel is driven by the first motor to rotate, the elliptical wheel drives the clamping plate to move, the clamping plate drives the second fixing plate to move, the second fixing plate drives the sliding rod to move under the action of the second spring, the sliding rod drives the movable frame to move, the movable frame drives the second screening frame to move, the electronic components screened for the first time are facilitated to be screened again, and the electronic components of different specifications are facilitated to be screened.

title_en: Preparation method of cross-linked imidazole functionalized polyether sulphone anion exchange membrane containing benzimidazole structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a cross-linked imidazole functionalized polyarylether sulfone anion exchange membrane containing benzimidazole structure, which comprises the following steps: (1) preparing a difluorobenzene-benzimidazole monomer shown in a formula (I); (2) carrying out solvent copolycondensation on a difluorobenzene-benzimidazole monomer, a 4,4 ' -difluorodiphenyl sulfone monomer, a 2,2 ' -bis (4-hydroxyphenyl) hexafluoropropane monomer and a 2,2 ' -bis (3-amino-4-hydroxyphenyl) hexafluoropropane monomer to obtain polyarylether sulfone with a main chain containing a benzimidazole structure; (3) 1-bromo-6-imidazole salt hexane chain is reacted with main chain benzimidazole structure-containing polyarylether sulfone to prepare benzimidazole structure-containing imidazole functionalized polyarylether sulfone; (4) dissolving benzimidazole structure-containing functionalized polyarylethersulfone and benzimidazole structure-containing cross-linking agent shown in formula (III) in an organic solvent to obtain a casting solution, pouring the casting solution on a glass plate, and realizing in-situ cross-linking at 40-200 ℃ to obtain the anion-exchange membrane.

title_en: Catalytic cracking reactor for laboratory
abstract_en: The invention relates to a catalytic cracking reactor for a laboratory, which comprises a top sealing structure, a reactor main body, a product outlet pipe, a filter pipe, a top fluidizing pipe, a catalyst loading and unloading agent port, a raw material injection pipe and a distribution plate. The reactor main body comprises a settling section, a reaction section and a pre-distribution section; the distribution plate is positioned at the joint of the pre-distribution section and the reaction section; the raw material injection pipe enters the reaction section from the top sealing structure along the central axis; the top fluidizing pipe passes through the raw material injection pipe, passes through the distribution plate, is fixed under the action of a positioner at the lower part of the top fluidizing pipe and enters the pre-distribution section; the catalyst loading and unloading agent port is positioned on the side wall of the settling section. The laboratory catalytic cracking reactor has the characteristics of stable bed linear speed, full oil contact and accurate control of reaction temperature and oil contact time.

title_en: Pyridine and thiazole dual-functionalized conjugated microporous polymer and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of conjugated microporous polymersThe invention provides a pyridine and thiazole dual-functional conjugated microporous polymer and a preparation method and application thereof. The pyridine and thiazole dual-functionalized conjugated microporous polymer provided by the invention has a structural unit shown as the following formula. The pyridine and thiazole dual-functionalized conjugated microporous polymer provided by the invention widens the types of the conjugated microporous polymer. Meanwhile, the pyridine and thiazole difunctional conjugated microporous polymer provided by the invention contains a pyridine group and a benzothiazole group, so that the polymer possibly has the performance of photolyzing water to produce hydrogen.

title_en: Digital micro-fluidic chip
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of microfluidics, and discloses a digital microfluidic chip which comprises a chip substrate and a pixel electrode layer, wherein the pixel electrode layer is provided with a plurality of concentric circles, a plurality of first pixel electrodes are arranged in a ring formed by every two adjacent concentric circles, the area of each first pixel electrode is increased along with the increase of the distance from the ring to the circle center, a driving circuit is arranged in a corresponding area of each first pixel electrode on the chip substrate, and the driving circuits are respectively connected with the corresponding first pixel electrodes. The invention enables the liquid drop to move in the direction close to the circle center, promotes the sorting movement of the liquid drop to have stronger pertinence, does not need to match the microscope vision by moving the chip substrate, and improves the experimental efficiency.

title_en: Paint spraying device of household robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a paint spraying device of a household robot, wherein an air exhaust ventilation cavity is arranged in a casing, a paint spraying cavity is arranged in the right end wall of the air exhaust ventilation cavity, a sand blasting storage cavity is arranged in the right end wall of the paint spraying cavity, a sand blasting cavity is arranged in the lower end wall of the sand blasting storage cavity, a paint spraying installation base is fixedly connected to the front end surface of the paint spraying cavity, a paint storage cavity is arranged in the paint spraying installation base, an oil storage cavity is arranged in the front end wall of the paint spraying cavity, a paint spraying mechanism, a sand blasting mechanism and an exhaust gas treatment mechanism are arranged in the casing, a paint spraying nozzle is arranged on a clamp arranged on the paint spraying mechanism, paint spraying in multiple directions can be completed on a sweeping robot, a sand blasting block is arranged on the sand blasting mechanism, preliminary polishing can be performed on the sweeping robot, burrs left on the surface of the sweeping robot are reduced, a paint spraying plate and an air suction pump are arranged on the exhaust gas treatment mechanism, and the air suction pump ensures that the air flows inside.

title_en: Energy-saving traditional chinese medicine processing is with drying device who is convenient for to pellet upset integration
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy-saving drying device for processing traditional Chinese medicines and facilitating pill overturning and integration, which comprises a drying device, wherein a sealing door is arranged on the front surface of the drying device, a handle is arranged on the front surface of the sealing door, a pushing mechanism is arranged on the right side of the drying device, a first groove is formed in the drying device, an overturning and integrating mechanism is arranged on the upper side of the pushing mechanism, clamping mechanisms are arranged on two sides of the overturning and integrating mechanism, a rotating mechanism is arranged on the upper side of the overturning and integrating mechanism, and a heater is arranged on the upper side of the drying device. The pill drying device disclosed by the invention has the advantages that the pills are turned and integrated when being dried, so that the pills are heated more uniformly when being dried, the drying efficiency and the drying quality are improved, the drying time is saved, the pills are integrated after being dried, the subsequent treatment is simpler and more convenient, the treatment time is reduced, the energy capital investment is saved, the energy consumption is reduced, the energy utilization is more thorough, the heat distribution in the drying device is more uniform, and the economic benefit is improved.

title_en: Iron-loaded small pore aluminosilicate CHA zeolites and methods of making metal-loaded small pore aluminosilicate CHA zeolites
abstract_en: The present invention provides an iron-loaded aluminosilicate zeolite having a maximum pore opening defined by eight tetrahedral atoms and having a framework type CHA, AEI, AFX, ERI, or LTA, wherein iron (Fe) is present in a range from about 0.5 wt% to about 5.0 wt%, based on the total weight of the iron-loaded aluminosilicate zeolite, wherein the ultraviolet-visible absorption spectrum of the iron-loaded synthetic aluminosilicate zeolite comprises a band at about 280nm, wherein the ratio of the ultraviolet-visible absorbance signal fitted to an integrated peak measured in arbitrary units (a.u.) for the band at about 280nm to the ultraviolet-visible absorbance signal fitted to an integrated peak measured in arbitrary units (a.u.) for the band at about 340nm > about 2. The invention also provides a process for preparing a metal-loaded aluminosilicate zeolite having a largest pore opening defined by eight tetrahedral atoms from pre-existing aluminosilicate zeolite crystallites, wherein the metal is present in the range of 0.5 wt% to 5.0 wt%, based on the total weight of the metal-loaded aluminosilicate zeolite.

title_en: Mixing device is used in production of high new aluminium magnesium lithium light high strength alloy material
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mixing devices, and discloses a mixing device for producing a high-tech aluminum-magnesium-lithium light high-strength alloy material. The device is through the water pump that sets up, the filter screen, rotate motor b, the gear, the tooth piece and rotate the seat, when the box needs to wash, can directly start the water pump, take out the water in the inside lower left corner of box to the inside top side of box, need start simultaneously and rotate motor b, rotate the seat through the gear, make the opening that rotates the seat bottom rotate the upside to the filter screen, then make the water along rotating the seat and flowing to filter screen department, continue to wash the inside of box after the filtration of filter screen, thereby reach the purpose of reuse water, the practicality of prior art has effectively been improved.

title_en: Totally-enclosed intelligent accurate blending device for superfine fine powder
abstract_en: The invention discloses a totally-enclosed intelligent precise superfine powder mixing device which comprises a storage bin, a small powder feed feeder, a stirring tank, a fine object conveyor bin, a negative pressure packaging mechanism and a pipe fitting, wherein a laser emitter is arranged inside a quantitative atomization liquid feeding system, a receiver matched with the laser emitter is also arranged inside the quantitative atomization liquid feeding system, a floating bag is arranged at the outer end of the spraying tank, and floating liquid matched with the floating bag is filled inside the quantitative atomization liquid feeding system. According to the invention, firstly, in the whole process, the processing of fine materials is orderly carried out in a closed environment, so that the processing quality of the fine materials is improved, and the cleanness and sanitation in a workshop are ensured, secondly, the liquid material is fixed in a buoyancy sedimentation mode, so that the liquid material is more accurately fixed, and finally, the amount of floating liquid in the quantitative atomization liquid feeding system is controlled by the pump body, so that the regulation and control of the quantitative atomization of the liquid material are realized.

title_en: Preparation method of plasma resonance effect ternary nano sunlight catalytic material
abstract_en: The invention discloses Ag/AgBr/BiOBr/TiO with a plasma resonance effect 2 The ternary nanometer photocatalytic material is used in degrading organic pollutant in water. The photocatalytic material can efficiently utilize sunlight to degrade pollutants in a water body, can be used for treating surface water pollution, and belongs to the field of water pollution control. The method mainly comprisesModified TiO by utilizing plasma resonance effect of Ag/AgBr and higher visible light utilization efficiency of BiOBr 2 So that the final material can efficiently utilize sunlight to generate free radicals to realize the efficient degradation of water pollutants. The material prepared by the method has the following advantages: (1) the plasma resonance effect of Ag/AgBr can effectively inhibit the recombination of photo-generated electron-hole pairs (reduce energy loss) in the catalytic process, and the doped BiOBr can make up for TiO 2 The visible light utilization rate is low, so that the high-efficiency sunlight utilization rate is realized, and the organic pollutants in the water body are efficiently removed under the conditions of energy conservation and environmental protection; (2) the material has high stability in water, is easy to recover, and reduces the generation of secondary pollution.

title_en: Directly-heated high-temperature heat pump drying equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a directly-heated high-temperature heat pump drying device which structurally comprises a main body, two fans and two box doors, wherein the fans are arranged at the side end of the main body, the two box doors are respectively arranged at two sides of the front end of the main body, the main body comprises a drying cavity, a heating rod and a placing device, the placing device comprises a placing plate, a supporting rod, a liquid collecting frame, a cutting groove and a liquid guide pipe, the placing plate comprises a liquid collecting groove, a leveling device, a supporting column and a liquid discharge hole, the leveling device comprises a supporting plate, a ventilation groove, a sealing groove, a ventilation hole, a telescopic rod and a heat absorption layer, the telescopic rod comprises a leveling plate, a supporting rod and a sealing layer, the heat absorption layer is used for absorbing heat, so that the air pressure in the sealing groove is increased, the telescopic rod is extruded to move outwards, the ventilation hole can be pushed upwards by the telescopic rod, the drooping part of mango pulp can be leveled, and the pulp of the mango pulp can be kept smooth, the selling phase of the dried mangos is improved, and the installation is convenient.

title_en: Method for manufacturing spherical ceramic particles for filtering water and method for manufacturing filtering water device by using same
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of spherical ceramic particles for filtering water and a method for manufacturing a filtering water device by using the spherical ceramic particles, and relates to the technical field of ceramic filtering water devices. The preparation method of the spherical ceramic particles comprises the following steps: the first step is as follows: selecting high-quality ore; the second step is that: crushing the ore; the third step: grinding; the fourth step: granulating; the fifth step; and (4) sintering at a high temperature. The preparation method of the device for preparing the filtered water by utilizing the spherical ceramic particles comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps: screening spherical ceramic particles; step two: mixing the raw materials; step three: standing; step four: molding; pouring the mixture into a metal mold for molding; step five: pressing and fixing; step six: drying; step seven: and (4) sintering at a high temperature. The invention solves the problems of slow and blocked filtering and the like caused by adopting common ore powder particles in the traditional filtering water device, and improves the filtering efficiency and the product quality of the filtering water devices such as tea leaks, tea trays and the like.

title_en: Sand dust test device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of testing devices, in particular to a sand dust testing device; the device comprises a test box, a filter box, a dust discharging mechanism, a circulating mechanism, a driving shaft, a first filter screen, a driving gear, a first motor, a driven shaft, a second filter screen and a driven gear; pumping sand dust in the test box into the filter box through the circulating mechanism, filtering the sand dust through the first filter screen, and guiding the filtered sand dust into the test box through the dust discharging mechanism to test a product to be tested; the first motor can drive the driving shaft to rotate, the driving shaft drives the first filter screen and the driving gear to rotate, the driving gear drives the driven gear and the second filter screen to rotate, and at the moment, sand dust in the filter box is filtered by the second filter screen and then is pumped into the test box; because the first filter mesh number is different from the second filter mesh number, sand dust particles with different volumes can be filtered, and abrasion resistance and sealing performance of the product to be tested on the sand dust particles with different volumes can be tested.

title_en: Preparation method and antibacterial application of organic-inorganic hybrid two-dimensional photocatalytic composite material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and antibacterial application of an organic-inorganic hybrid two-dimensional photocatalytic composite material. The method firstly synthesizes Ti 3 C 2 T X And ZnTCPP flake-like precursor, howeverThen ZnTCPP and Ti are treated by ultrasonic 3 C 2 T X Fully and uniformly mixing, and finally grafting ZnTCPP on Ti through a chemical reaction by hydrothermal method 3 C 2 T X The surface of the composite material is dried by blast air to obtain the composite material ZnTCPP/Ti 3 C 2 T X . ZnTCPP/Ti is synthesized by a simple process 3 C 2 T X A schottky structure to enhance photocatalytic ability. Meanwhile, the composite material has a large number of hydrophilic groups (-OH, -COOH), so that ZnTCPP/Ti can be synthesized 3 C 2 T X Fully and uniformly dispersed in water, and simultaneously, because of the reduction of the energy gap, the generated active oxygen is more, so that the organic matters can be effectively degraded under the irradiation of visible light, and good antibacterial performance is also shown.

title_en: Zeolite adsorbents with a large external surface area, method for the production thereof and use thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a zeolitic adsorbent having a large external surface area, to a process for its preparation and to its use. The present invention relates to a zeolitic adsorbent based on agglomerated crystals of FAU zeolite, comprising barium and/or potassium and having a large external surface area, with optimal properties in terms of both selectivity and mechanical strength. These adsorbents find use in: separating the fraction of the C8 aromatic isomers and in particular xylene; separating isomers of substituted toluenes such as nitrotoluene, diethyltoluene or toluenediamine; and separating the cresols and polyols such as sugars.

title_en: Solid waste classification system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a solid waste classification treatment system, which comprises an installation outer sleeve arranged on the ground, wherein an inner sliding shell is arranged in the installation outer sleeve; the garbage sorting device is provided with the opening and closing block and the shifting fence, can automatically sort garbage when the garbage is detected, stores the sorted garbage in the corresponding garbage cavities, greatly improves the accuracy of garbage sorting, has the advantages of improving the sorting accuracy and improving the garbage recycling rate, is also provided with the rotating block and the pull rod, can respectively open different channels to respectively collect the garbage after the shell is pulled out, and has the advantages of convenience and resource saving.

title_en: Crawler self-propelled potato harvester traveling system and sorting device
abstract_en: The invention provides a crawler self-propelled potato harvester traveling system and a sorting device, which are characterized in that: the outer side surfaces of tracks hung on a driving wheel and a driven wheel which are arranged on a driving motor shaft are arranged on the ground, a hydraulic cylinder body is hinged on a cross beam I, a rack and an internal combustion engine are arranged on a driving frame, a hydraulic pump is arranged on one side of the rack, a control system is arranged on the rack, and operation seats are hinged on the two sides of the rack; a motor of the driving device drives a driving shaft provided with a plum blossom wheel through chain transmission, and a carrier roller I, a carrier roller II and a vibrating wheel are arranged on a sorting rack arranged on a rack; one end of a sorting sieve formed by fixing two ends of a plurality of sorting rods and stop rods in each group on an annular belt is hung on the plum blossom wheel, the other end of the sorting sieve is hung on a carrier roller I of the opposite-row digging and pre-sorting device, the upper section of the sorting sieve is supported on the carrier roller I, a vibrating wheel and a part of carrier rollers II, and the lower section of the sorting sieve is supported on other carrier rollers II. The invention has high operation efficiency, low damage rate to potato and low peel breaking rate, is flexible and is not limited by weather and soil conditions.

title_en: Cutting dust absorbing device for industrial cutting robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cutting dust absorption device for an industrial cutting robot, which relates to the field of industrial robots and comprises a fixed disc, a surrounding dust absorption part and a height adjusting part; the fixed disk is used for being connected with an industrial robot tail shaft flange, and one side, far away from the industrial robot tail shaft flange, of the fixed disk is connected with a first fixed seat and a second fixed seat. Through set up in industrial robot cutting head one side and encircle dust absorption part, the dust that produces when can the cutting head operation blocks the absorption, encircle dust absorption part simultaneously and can adjust according to how much and the size of diffusion scope that the dust produced, guarantee the absorption efficiency of dust, avoid the dust diffusion to cause the harm to peripheral equipment and personnel, set up altitude mixture control part simultaneously on encircleing dust absorption part, can be to highly adjusting of encircleing dust absorption part, thereby be convenient for encircle the cutting operation of dust absorption part adaptation cutting head different operating modes, guarantee to encircle dust absorption part's dust collection efficiency.

title_en: Double-hard-disk isolation encryption device and method based on single operating system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of computers, in particular to a double-hard-disk isolation encryption device and method based on a single operation system, aiming at the problems that a controller operated by a user and bottom hardware and a hard disk are easy to overheat during long-time use, so that the controller is unsmooth in operation and the use of people is influenced, the double-hard-disk isolation encryption device comprises a box body, wherein the controller is installed on the inner wall of the bottom of the box body, air inlet pipes are fixedly installed on two sides of the box body, an air inlet mechanism is arranged in each air inlet pipe, a same air guide pipe is fixedly connected between the two air inlet pipes, an adjusting pipe is rotatably sleeved on the outer side of each air guide pipe, a motor is fixedly installed at the top of the box body, a driving rod is fixedly installed on an output shaft of the motor, and an angle adjusting mechanism is arranged on each adjusting pipe. The air blowing and heat dissipating device is simple to operate and convenient to use, can facilitate air blowing and heat dissipation of different positions of the controller, can clean the controller and is convenient for people to use.

title_en: Agitating unit is used in plastic products production
abstract_en: The invention discloses a stirring device for plastic product production, which comprises a fixed base, a stirring tank and a mounting frame, wherein the mounting frame is of a hollow cylindrical structure with a closed upper end and an open lower end, the lower end surface of the mounting frame is fixedly connected with the upper end surface of the fixed base through a damping seat, the upper end surface of the mounting frame is provided with a first mounting hole, a first annular groove is formed in the inner side wall of the first mounting hole, a first annular limiting plate is arranged in the middle of the outer side wall of the stirring tank, the bottom of the stirring tank penetrates through the first mounting hole and then is positioned in the inner cavity of the hollow cylindrical structure, and the first annular limiting plate is inserted into the first annular groove; the agitator tank bottom is equipped with the pivot, and first motor is installed to the mounting bracket inside wall, and first motor is connected with the pivot transmission, and the second motor is installed at the agitator tank top, and the second motor is connected with the rabbling mechanism transmission of locating in the agitator tank. The invention greatly improves the material stirring effect and the stirring efficiency.

title_en: Heating crushing device and crushing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heating crushing device and a crushing method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of material crushing. The device comprises a shell, a driving mechanism arranged below the shell, and an inner cylinder which is detachably connected in the shell and is in driving connection with the driving mechanism; the heating mechanism is arranged on the side wall of the shell and is communicated with the cavity, the stirring mechanism is detachably arranged on the inner cylinder, and a sealed cavity is formed between the inner cylinder and the shell; the driving mechanism is used for driving the inner cylinder to rotate in the shell, and meanwhile, the stirring mechanism is used for crushing materials in the inner cylinder; the rotating direction of the stirring mechanism is opposite to that of the inner cylinder, and under the action of the heating mechanism, the temperature of the cavity is raised, and materials in the inner cylinder are heated to be uniformly crushed. The invention is matched with the heating mechanism to heat the materials in the inner barrel, thereby improving the efficiency of crushing the materials and ensuring that the materials are completely crushed in a short time.

title_en: Intelligent blood detection device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent blood detection device, which comprises: the detection device comprises a fixing frame and a detection head arranged on the fixing frame, wherein the fixing frame is connected with a fixing block through a mounting pipe, two symmetrically-arranged mounting plates are rotatably mounted on the fixing block, each mounting plate is connected with the fixing block through a torsion spring, the two mounting plates are arranged in a splayed shape, a cleaning sheet is fixedly mounted on each mounting plate, a sponge mat is arranged on the fixing block, a groove for mounting the sponge mat is formed in the fixing block, and cleaning cloth is arranged on the fixing block; and each extrusion rod is in sliding connection with the fixed block. The invention can clean the mirror surface of the detection head more thoroughly, and no dust is left on the mirror surface, thereby being beneficial to ensuring the definition of detection and ensuring the subsequent detection data to be more accurate.

title_en: Hydrocracking catalyst, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydrocracking catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: step 1, atomizing an acid substance solution into small droplets, and spraying the small droplets on a Y/ZSM-5/ASA composite material; step 2, heating the mixture obtained in the step 1 to perform chemical modification; and step 3, loading the chemical modification substance in the step 2 with an active component, and molding to obtain the hydrocracking catalyst. The method of the invention can not only promote the generation of secondary mesopores of the Y/ZSM-5/ASA composite material, promote the generation of strong acid sites thereof, and remove amorphous aluminum species in the molecular sieve pore channels; and the use amount of acidic substances in the modification process can be reduced, and the generation of acidic waste liquid is avoided.

title_en: Control method, system, device and equipment for pre-enriching ores based on surface type electrode
abstract_en: The control method comprises the steps of generating a uniform electric field by adopting parallel electrodes with a surface-type structure, fully utilizing high voltage to selectively crush uniformly mixed particles, namely selectively crushing useful ore particles without crushing gangue particles, and then collecting useful ore by adopting a screening device and discarding useless gangue particles to realize the pre-enrichment of the useful metal ore particles; the control method only carries out pulse crushing on the useful ore without damaging the gangue, thereby greatly reducing the unit energy consumption of high-voltage electricity and reducing the generation of tailings; the failure of the execution equipment caused by the crushing of the gangue particles is avoided, and the production efficiency is also improved. The method solves the technical problems of high failure rate of execution equipment, more generated tailings and low production efficiency in the conventional metal ore pre-enrichment manufacturing process.

title_en: Civil engineering house building waste treatment device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a civil engineering house construction waste treatment device, which comprises a container, wherein a settling area is arranged below the container, one side of the container is provided with a conveying pipe, and the other side of the container is provided with a separation port; the separation port is provided with a drainage groove, the drainage groove is provided with a drainage hole, the lower bottom surface of the drainage groove completely covers the drainage hole through an arranged filter flask, liquid is guided into an arranged water storage tank after being filtered by the filter flask, and then the liquid is pumped into the container again through a water pump arranged in the water storage tank, so that the circulating flow of the liquid is realized; the conveying pipe conveys the mixture of construction waste, such as wood chips, concrete slag, metal slag and the like to the container, after the mixture enters the container, heavier impurities are accumulated in the settling zone, lighter wood chips flow to the drainage groove along with the circularly flowing liquid, the wood chips are separated from the metal slag and the concrete slag, and the magnet is arranged outside the settling zone to separate the metal slag from the concrete slag.

title_en: Preparation device and preparation method for dimer fatty acid modified polyester resin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation device and a preparation method for a dimer fatty acid modified polyester resin, relates to the technical field of dimer fatty acid modified polyester resins, and aims to solve the problems that the existing preparation device for the dimer fatty acid modified polyester resin is low in mixing efficiency during production, uneven mixing is easy to occur, the special performance of a produced product is unstable, and the quality of the product is influenced. The hot melt tank is characterized in that a mixing supporting bracket is installed on one side of the upper end of the hot melt tank, a mixing tank is installed on the upper end of the mixing supporting bracket, a rotary driving bracket is installed inside the mixing tank, an anti-sticking stirring bracket is installed outside the rotary driving bracket, the anti-sticking stirring bracket is welded with the rotary driving bracket, a wear-resistant pad is installed inside the anti-sticking stirring bracket, a collision material dispersing barrel is installed outside the rotary driving bracket, and the collision material dispersing barrel is fixedly connected with the rotary driving bracket.

title_en: Self-adaptive visual imaging and sensing positioning multifunctional underwater patrol robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-adaptive visual imaging and sensing positioning multifunctional underwater patrol robot, which comprises an underwater propulsion mechanism, a core cabin, a mechanical arm and a dredging functional module, wherein the underwater propulsion mechanism is arranged in the core cabin; the underwater propulsion mechanism comprises a robot frame and a propeller, wherein the propeller is divided into a transverse propeller and a lifting propeller; a driving control module, a visual imaging module and an underwater positioning module are arranged in the core cabin; the invention utilizes raspberry vision imaging to identify underwater environment and transmit vision pictures in real time, and combines an attitude sensor to acquire real-time underwater data of the robot, thereby completing stable positioning, state analysis and information transmission of the underwater robot. The device uses an IMU inertial navigation positioning system, so that the underwater robot can stably and accurately synchronously transmit the underwater environment and position the robot, and a reliable substrate platform is provided for underwater operation; the dredging function module is used for clearing away foreign matters on the surface of the pipeline and clearing obstacles for visual imaging at the same time; all modules cooperate together to realize the functions of detecting and dredging the submarine pipeline.

title_en: Waxy refining stirring equipment for sustained-release amikacin pellets and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medicine production devices, in particular to waxy smelting stirring equipment of an ammonia-coffee yellow-sensitive slow-release pellet, which comprises a main body, wherein a supporting mechanism is arranged on the outer side of the main body, the bottom end of the main body is connected with an inlet and outlet mechanism, an adjusting mechanism is arranged on the inlet and outlet mechanism, a conveying mechanism is arranged on the inlet and outlet mechanism, and a stirring mechanism is arranged in the main body; the general inlet and outlet mechanism is convenient for feeding or taking materials into the main body, and the feeding and taking materials are all carried out in a sealed state, so that air is isolated, and the phenomenon that moxa gas is stimulated to flood a production workshop is avoided; the material can be conveyed better by the auxiliary conveying mechanism through the adjusting mechanism, the conveying direction is controlled, and the material leakage waste is avoided; the stirring mechanism is arranged to facilitate the stirring operation of the materials sufficiently and carefully, the stirring task is completed in the shortest time, and the efficiency of manufacturing medicines is improved.

title_en: SCR catalyst for purifying tail gas of diesel vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses an SCR catalyst for purifying tail gas of diesel vehicles, which efficiently and stably widens the temperature window of the SCR catalyst when the NOx conversion efficiency is 80% or 90%, and improves the NOx conversion efficiency.

title_en: Full-automatic sand blasting needle grinding machine
abstract_en: The application relates to a full-automatic sand blasting needle grinding machine, which comprises a sand blasting mechanism for performing sand blasting treatment on a needle head, wherein the sand blasting mechanism comprises a sand blasting seat, a sand blasting cavity is arranged in the sand blasting seat, a clamping assembly positioned in the sand blasting cavity is arranged on the sand blasting seat, and the clamping assembly is used for clamping the needle head which is finished with grinding; the sand blasting seat is also provided with a sand blasting assembly positioned on one side of the clamping assembly; be provided with on the sandblast seat and be used for supplying the syringe needle to send into the sandblast mouth to the sandblast intracavity, the sandblast mouth is just right with the centre gripping subassembly. This application has the cleanliness factor that improves the syringe needle surface, can also improve the mechanical properties on syringe needle surface simultaneously, improves the effect of the fatigue resistance of syringe needle.

title_en: BOG helium extraction system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a BOG helium extraction system and a helium extraction method. The BOG helium extraction system comprises a cryogenic rectification unit and a palladium membrane separation dehydrogenation unit, wherein the cryogenic rectification unit is used for separating a first-stage crude helium gas containing a small amount of nitrogen, hydrogen and a small amount of oxygen from BOG by a cryogenic method, and the palladium membrane separation dehydrogenation unit is used for removing the hydrogen in the first-stage crude helium gas by a palladium membrane separation method to obtain a second-stage crude helium gas. According to the invention, the hydrogen in BOG is separated and removed by the palladium membrane separation dehydrogenation unit, so that the dehydrogenation process is simplified, the control requirement in the dehydrogenation process is reduced, the potential safety hazard is eliminated, the hydrogen can be recycled, and the resource waste is avoided.

title_en: Household garbage resource recovery system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a household garbage resource recovery system, which comprises: the information extraction module is used for acquiring image information of garbage to be recovered, extracting characteristic points of the image information and generating a detection characteristic point set, wherein the image information comprises the color and the shape of the garbage to be recovered; the system comprises a sample database, a data processing module and a data processing module, wherein the sample database is internally provided with a plurality of sub-sample databases, the sub-sample databases correspond to different garbage types, and a sub-sample characteristic point set is generated by extracting characteristic points of sample data in the sub-sample databases, and the sample data is image information of different types of garbage in different states; and the comparison and classification module is used for comparing the detection feature point set with different sub-sample feature point sets and identifying the type of the garbage to be recovered. Through many comparison and analysis, the garbage types can be identified, and therefore subsequent garbage resources can be recycled.

title_en: Bearing capacity detection device for adjustable building detection
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of building plate detection, in particular to an adjustable bearing capacity detection device for building detection, which comprises a cylinder, a pressure plate and a pressure detection module, wherein the pressure detection module is used for detecting the pressure value when the pressure plate presses down a plate, the pressure plate is connected with a lifting device, support columns are arranged in the cylinder, the lifting device can drive the support columns to move up and down when being connected with the support columns, a block plate crushing device is arranged on the outer side of the support columns, the support columns can be connected with a driving device, and the driving device can drive the support columns to rotate; the embodiment tests the compressive strength and the whole compressive property of each position of the plate; simulating the strength of the plate under various conditions; the comprehensive overall quality evaluation of the building plate is carried out by a plurality of test means, and meanwhile, the device can carry out airtight recovery and reprocessing on the plate subjected to limit stress test and crushing.

title_en: Terminal processing point plastic equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a terminal processing point plastic device, wherein the cross section of a point plastic channel is a channel with a U-shaped groove shape, the tops of two sides of the U-shaped groove are provided with a baffle with an L-shaped section and a baffle with a long strip-shaped section, an inlet cylinder is arranged at the inlet of the point plastic channel to push a terminal to advance on the point plastic channel, an automatic paint spraying device, a camera shooting inspection device and a drying device are sequentially arranged on the right side of the point plastic channel from the inlet to the outlet of the point plastic channel, a paint spraying sensor is arranged at the position of the automatic paint spraying device on the right side of the point plastic channel, and a paint spraying cylinder is arranged on the left side of the point plastic channel and the position corresponding to the automatic paint spraying device; the invention sorts through the camera shooting inspection equipment to form flow process, and has simple integral structure and flexible layout. The automatic drying device can reasonably control the curing distance of the curing lamp, and avoids influencing products to be cured outside the range.

title_en: Method for continuously preparing drug-loaded nanoemulsion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for continuously preparing drug-loaded nanoemulsion, which comprises the steps of dissolving a drug into an organic solvent to serve as an oil phase, taking an aqueous solution of a surfactant as an aqueous phase, and emulsifying by a microfluidic device and a low-energy method to obtain the drug-loaded nanoemulsion; the microfluidic device comprises a T-shaped pipe, a water phase storage tank, an oil phase storage tank and a collecting tank, wherein the T-shaped pipe comprises a water phase inlet, an oil phase inlet and an outlet, the water phase inlet and the outlet are coaxial, the water phase storage tank is communicated with the water phase inlet through a high-precision injection pump and a PTFE pipe, the oil phase storage tank is communicated with the oil phase inlet through the high-precision injection pump and the PTFE pipe, the outlet of the T-shaped pipe is communicated with the PTFE pipe, the other end of the PTFE pipe is communicated with one end of a silica gel hose, and the other end of the silica gel hose is communicated with the collecting tank. The method can realize continuous production of nanoemulsion, reduce batch-to-batch difference, improve controllability of nanoemulsion preparation, reduce energy consumption, and improve stability of active ingredients loaded in nanoemulsion.

title_en: Automatic production and processing equipment for particulate matters
abstract_en: The invention discloses automatic particle production and processing equipment in the technical field of automation, which comprises a production mechanism, wherein the production mechanism consists of a stirring mechanism, a material guide mechanism, a granulation mechanism, a material conveying mechanism and an air drying mechanism, a blower is arranged on the left end wall of the air drying mechanism, air guide pipes are arranged on the upper part and the lower part of the outer end wall of the blower, and splicing heads are arranged at the outer ends of the air guide pipes; through the cooperation of rabbling mechanism, guide mechanism, granulation mechanism, biography material mechanism and air-dry mechanism material stirring, guide send, granulation, conveying and air-dry in proper order, full automatic production and processing need not manual operation, reduces the cost of labor, and convenient and fast effectively improves material production efficiency, satisfies producer's production demand.

title_en: Automatic USB female head assembling, detecting and packaging machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic USB female head assembling, detecting and packaging machine which comprises a frame, an iron shell discharging mechanism, an iron shell feeding mechanism, an iron shell cutting die, an iron shell sucking, rotating and conveying mechanism, a semi-finished product discharging, feeding, cutting, conveying, taking and removing belt mechanism, a large turntable mechanism, a semi-finished product and iron shell assembling mechanism, an iron shell bending and riveting mechanism, a semi-finished product taking mechanism, a small turntable mechanism, a testing mechanism, a turnover mechanism, a finished product conveying and defective discharging mechanism, a transfer assembly line, a CCD conveying mechanism, a CCD detecting mechanism, a product packaging mechanism, a package carrier belt discharging mechanism and a package carrier belt receiving mechanism, wherein the iron shell discharging mechanism, the iron shell feeding mechanism, the iron shell cutting die, the iron shell sucking, the rotary conveying mechanism, the semi-finished product discharging and the feeding/cutting, the conveying and taking and removing belt mechanism are arranged on the frame. The invention can realize automatic feeding, blanking, detecting, picking, packaging and receiving, greatly improves the productivity, effectively controls the rejection rate and the reject ratio of products, greatly saves the labor input cost, and has the advantages of reasonable and compact structure and small occupied area.

title_en: Preparation and application of ultrathin nanometer subunit assembled hollow indium sulfide nanorod
abstract_en: Hair brushThe preparation and application of the hollow indium sulfide nanorod assembled by ultrathin nanometer subunits belongs to the field of novel nanometer functional materials and photoelectrochemistry, and comprises the following steps: A. obtaining an MIL-68 nano rod; B. adding the MIL-68 nano rods into the solution, and dispersing to obtain a suspension; C. dissolving thiourea in the solution, adding the solution into the suspension, strongly stirring, and after stirring, putting the suspension into a reaction kettle for reaction to obtain light yellow precipitate; D. washing and drying the light yellow precipitate to obtain hollow In 2 S 3 And (4) nanorods. The preparation method can exert the size characteristic of the nano hollow material and the excellent performance of the ultrathin nanosheet, simultaneously omits the tedious step of removing the template, and has convenient operation and sensitive reaction. Prepared In 2 S 3 The hollow material has large specific surface area, high light conversion efficiency and thin shell and nanosheet, and can be used for photocatalytic degradation of CO 2 The method has extremely wide application potential in the fields of reduction, hydrogen production, photoelectric biosensing and the like.

title_en: Anti-freeze erosion canal lining construction method
abstract_en: The application relates to a freeze erosion resistant canal lining construction method, which relates to the field of canal construction and comprises the following processes of pouring and compacting concrete; leveling and absorbing water, and collecting the sucked water into a sewage treatment system for sewage treatment; vibrating and pulping again; re-vibrating and extracting the pulp; maintaining; and during maintenance, the channel lining is sprayed and maintained by using clear water after the sewage treatment system. This application has the effect of handling sewage, can realize the cyclic utilization effect of water resource, also can the environmental protection to the efficiency of construction is high.

title_en: Embossing roller surface defect detection device
abstract_en: The invention provides a device for detecting surface defects of an embossing roller, which relates to the technical field of surface defect detection of the embossing roller and comprises a base, wherein the main body of the base is of a rectangular structure, transverse grooves are formed in the front side and the rear side of the top end of the base, the transverse grooves are used for sliding a pedestal, a support is fixedly connected to the top end of the base, a spray box is further arranged on the top end surface of the support, a round hole is further formed in the center of the interior of the spray box and matched with an insertion pipe, a spray rack is further arranged at the bottom end of the insertion pipe, the problem that in the prior comparison process, due to the difference of the length and the diameter of the roller, the problem that the roller is easy to miss-detect due to observation difference is solved, a rack body driven by an electric push rod A is arranged at the top end of the base, and a driving wheel driven by a motor A arranged at the bottom end of the rack body can rapidly limit and drive rollers of different specifications after being matched with guide wheels arranged at the top end of the base body, and further, the self-adaptive detection of the printing roller is realized.

title_en: Milling machine with cutting fluid recovery function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a milling machine with a cutting fluid recovery function, and relates to the technical field of milling machines. The milling machine comprises a milling machine main body, wherein a workpiece table and an L-shaped shell are sequentially fixed on the front surface of the milling machine main body from top to bottom, a material guide device is arranged below the workpiece table, a recovery box is fixed at the bottom of the milling machine main body, the bottom of the L-shaped shell is communicated with the interior of the recovery box, a waste box penetrates through and is slidably mounted on the front surface of the L-shaped shell, a filter screen is fixed in the L-shaped shell, and an extrusion device is arranged above the filter screen. According to the invention, the cutting fluid and the scrap iron are filtered by the filter screen through the filter screen, and the cutting fluid passes through the filter screen and enters the recovery box, so that the purpose of recovering the cutting fluid is achieved, the problem that the cutting fluid contains more metal scrap and is difficult to recover after being used is solved, and the recovery efficiency of the cutting fluid is improved.

title_en: Method and device for controlling a centrifuge, centrifuge and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of centrifuge control, and discloses a method for controlling a centrifuge, which comprises the following steps: obtaining the current output current and the current output pulse width of the motor; determining a target control strategy of the motor according to the current output current and the current output pulse width; and controlling the motor to execute the target control strategy. Like this, through set up the device that is used for obtaining the output pulse width in centrifuge's electric motor rotor bottom, can be at centrifuge operation in-process, obtain the current output current of motor and current output pulse width, judge to the current top cap's of centrifuge the circumstances of blockking in order to combine the current output current that has obtained and current output pulse width, with the sensitivity of combining current detection and the accuracy of pulse width detection in the judgement that the top cap blockked the circumstances, and carry out the target control strategy that corresponds with the judgement result through the control motor, realize more accurate centrifuge and prevent tong protection. The application also discloses a device, a centrifuge and a storage medium for controlling the centrifuge.

title_en: Production equipment for preparing regenerated building material from building garbage
abstract_en: The invention provides production equipment for preparing regenerated building materials from building wastes, which comprises a grinding mechanism and a screening mechanism, wherein a discharging pipe is arranged at the bottom of the grinding mechanism: the screening mechanism comprises a rotating part, a pushing part, a working round table and a first driving part; the rotary part is provided with a plurality of filtering holes, the upper side of the rotary part is provided with a top cover, the inner side of the rotary part is provided with a blocking wall, the blocking wall is fixedly connected with the top cover, and the rotary part, the top cover and the blocking side wall form a sealed cavity; one end of each pushing component is arranged on the top cover, and the other end of each pushing component is arranged in the sealed cavity; the top of the working round table is fixedly provided with a cam; the first driving part can drive the working round table to rotate, so as to drive the rotating part to rotate; as the cam rotates, the cam can drive the plurality of pushing members toward the sealed cavity. The device can smash building rubbish and refine the processing through the cooperation of grinding mechanism and screening mechanism and form fine aggregate, helps the preparation that the fine aggregate after the processing was used for building fragment of brick.

title_en: Low energy consumption low pressure oxygen air separation plant
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-energy-consumption low-pressure oxygen air separation device, which belongs to the technical field of air separation devices and comprises a main heat exchanger, a hot-end pressurizing turboexpander pressurizing end, a cold-end pressurizing turboexpander pressurizing end, a first cooler, an oxygen pressurizer, a pressure tower, a subcooler, a low-pressure tower and a purified air pipeline, wherein the liquid air temperature of oxygen pressure pressurizing condensation is higher, and the cold fluid cold energy of the subcooler is recovered through the cooler, so that the liquefaction quantity of deoxidation pressure pressurizing heat source air is reduced, the influence on rectification and heat exchange is reduced, namely, the refrigeration quantity is increased, and the liquid yield is increased. The general energy consumption can be reduced by more than 8%.

title_en: Medical antibacterial plastic catheter extrusion molding equipment and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medical antibacterial plastic catheter extrusion molding device and a method, which are mainly used for: and extruding and molding the medical antibacterial plastic catheter. The extrusion molding equipment comprises a mandrel, a conveying device, a sterilizing device, a lubricating liquid pool, a spraying device, an antibacterial gas generating device, a curing device, a co-extrusion die, an extruder, a vacuum sizing sleeve, a cooling device, a cutting device, a discharging device, a coring device and a movable rack. The extrusion molding method comprises the following steps: s1 performing core shaft sterilization, lubrication and antibacterial coating treatment; the S2 mandrel is sent into a co-extrusion die and is extruded and molded together with the plastic base material produced by the extruder; s3, cutting and coring the medical antibacterial plastic catheter blank by the cutting device and the coring device. The method overcomes the defects of long process, high consumption of the antibacterial agent, poor binding force of the antibacterial layer and the like, has simple process flow and high processing efficiency, and can continuously and efficiently complete the extrusion molding processing of the medical antibacterial plastic conduit.

title_en: Infectious department nursing degassing unit
abstract_en: The nursing and disinfecting device for the infectious department comprises a supporting frame, wherein a supporting rod is fixed in the middle of the upper end of the supporting frame, a water tank is fixedly connected to the top end of the supporting rod, a heater is arranged in the middle of the water tank, fixing plates are arranged at the top ends of the water tank and the heater, two buckles are respectively arranged on the front side and the rear side of each fixing plate and clamped on the top end of the outer side of the water tank, handles are respectively and fixedly connected to the left side and the right side of each fixing plate, a frame is fixedly connected to the outer frame of each fixing plate, and filter screens are respectively arranged on the inner side of each frame and positioned at the upper end of the water tank. Through continuous heating water to device high temperature of rivers and steam, when vapor disinfects, slowly erode the surface through the water droplet, sewage separates sewage and device through the separation effect of filter screen at last, has realized treating the clear effect in disinfection device surface when disinfecting.

title_en: Device for electronically filtering particles
abstract_en: The invention relates to a collector stage (10) of an electronic filter device (30), wherein a potential plate (11) and/or a collector plate (12) is at least partially covered by an electrical insulator (13) at an air gap in order to limit the occurrence of corona effects during operation of the electronic filter device (30).

title_en: Anti-hardening dazomet preparation device and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of dazomet preparation, and discloses a hardening-resistant dazomet preparation device and a hardening-resistant dazomet preparation method, which comprises a shell, wherein two rotating shafts capable of rotating are arranged in the shell, a motor is fixedly arranged on the top wall surface of the shell and is connected with the two rotating shafts through a connecting device, a stirring device is arranged at one end of each rotating shaft positioned in the shell, and a discharge pipe is fixedly arranged on the outer wall surface of the shell.

title_en: Aseptic formula sample material grinds centrifugal screening device for bio-product technology research and development
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of technical research and development of biological products, and discloses a sterile sample material grinding centrifugal screening device for technical research and development of biological products. Drive driving motor through external power supply and rotate, drive driven runner then and rotate, driven runner rotates and drives the rotation of center drive pole, and the center drive pole rotates, carries out the meticulous grinding to the sample, and the screening board falls the sample piece to the different positions department of below when rotating, and the apotheca is located it under, and it cuts apart into different regions through the baffle, and the piece is categorised at its inside, can classify according to the difference of piece size when increasing grinding effect.

title_en: Mechanical part clamping device for mechanical engineering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mechanical accessory clamping device for mechanical engineering, and belongs to the technical field of clamping. A mechanical part clamping device for mechanical engineering comprises a base, wherein the outer wall of the base is fixedly connected with a box body, a driving mechanism and a gas collecting mechanism are arranged in the box body, the inner wall of the box body is fixedly connected with a partition plate and a stabilizer bar, a first avoidance groove is formed in the box body, a first screw rod and a second screw rod are rotationally connected to the box body, a first belt wheel and a second bevel gear are fixedly connected to the first screw rod, a second belt wheel and a third bevel gear are fixedly connected to the second screw rod, fixing blocks are in threaded connection with the first screw rod and the second screw rod, the fixing blocks are connected to the stabilizer bar in a sliding mode, the thread directions of the first screw rod and the second screw rod are opposite, and a clamping mechanism is arranged at the top of each fixing block; the automatic clamping device is simple to operate, can automatically clamp the accessories, can clean the accessories in the clamping and loosening processes, greatly saves labor and time, and improves production efficiency.

title_en: Robot arm of automatic pipetting system
abstract_en: A robotic arm for an automated pipetting system, comprising: a pipetting tip adapter; slide switch, it detects pipetting tip existence on the pipetting tip adapter, includes: first and second supports that slide relative to each other along an axis of motion between first and second positions; an electrically conductive contact pad disposed on the first support; an electrically conductive terminal, which is a resilient and inherently stable first wiper extending along the axis of motion when the support is in the first position, the first wiper being free from physical contact with the contact pad when the support is in the second position, an electrical current being able to flow between the first wiper and the contact pad when the support is in the first position, and the electrical current between the wiper and the contact pad being interrupted when the support is in the second position. Use of a robotic arm in an automated pipetting system, a slide switch detects the presence of a pipetting tip on a tip adapter. An automatic pipetting system includes a robotic arm that detects the presence of a pipetting tip on a tip adapter.

title_en: Microfluidic device for advanced cultivation of biological agents
