abstract_en: The present application relates to a microfluidic device for the cultivation of biological agents, comprising: a body (11) comprising at least a first hole (40) closed at the bottom; a separator (35); a membrane (36) fixed to the separator (35); a plug (15) closing the first hole (40); -said partition (35) is designed to be placed in said first hole (40); said partition (35) being removable from said first hole (40); the membrane (36) dividing the first aperture (40) into an upper half-chamber and a lower half-chamber; a pair of tubes (25) for filling said lower half-chamber; a pair of tubes (26) for irrigating said upper half-chamber; a first slide (22) placed centrally on the plug (15); a second slide (42) placed centrally in the first hole (40); a cylindrical body (41) rising from said first hole (40), said second slider (42) resting on top of said cylindrical body (41); the cylindrical body (41) has a second hole (43) coaxial with the cylindrical body (41).

title_en: High efficiency polymer fire retardant drying device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-efficiency high-molecular flame retardant drying device which comprises a drying frame body, wherein the top of the drying frame body is fixedly provided with a feeding hopper which is mutually communicated with the inside of the drying frame body, the inner top of the drying frame body is fixedly provided with two extrusion plates, two screening mechanisms are fixedly arranged in the drying frame body, the inner walls of the two screening mechanisms are respectively provided with a sliding chute, the two sliding chutes are respectively connected with a sliding block in a sliding manner, the front side walls of the two sliding blocks are respectively provided with a rolling mechanism, and the two rolling mechanisms respectively penetrate through the side walls of the drying frame body and are connected with the side walls in a sliding manner. The drying frame is reasonable in structural design, can screen out agglomerates in the high-molecular flame retardant to crush the agglomerates when the high-molecular flame retardant is dried, can clean water condensed on the top of the drying frame, avoids water from gathering at the top of the drying frame and dripping into the high-molecular flame retardant to be dried again, and improves drying efficiency.

title_en: Production method of high-precision new energy vehicle body aluminum profile
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of aluminum profile production, in particular to a production method of a high-precision new energy vehicle body aluminum profile. According to the invention, the cleaning water is poured into the cleaning box through the water pump, the hollow plate I, the filter plate and the hose are arranged, the water pump is started, the water pump sucks the water in the cleaning box through the hose, and then the bristles which are being cleaned are cleaned through the water outlet holes on the hollow plate I, so that the bristles are in a clean state when the aluminum alloy section bar is cleaned, the cleaning effect is improved, and meanwhile, when the cleaning water falls into the cleaning box again, the filter plate filters the cleaning water, so that the recycling can be realized, the input of the cleaning water is reduced, and the cost is reduced.

title_en: Ecological organic agricultural planting equipment and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to ecological organic agricultural planting equipment and a using method thereof, and relates to the technical field of ecological organic planting, the ecological organic agricultural planting equipment comprises a planting box, a sewer pipe, a second connecting pipe, a planting lifting mechanism arranged in the planting box, a fixing mechanism arranged between four sewer pipes and a water source circulating mechanism arranged between the planting box and the second connecting pipe.

title_en: Method for preparing synthesis gas by catalyzing propane carbon dioxide with cobalt-based catalyst
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing synthesis gas by catalyzing propane carbon dioxide with a cobalt-based catalyst, and particularly relates to perovskite LaCoO  3  Putting the precursor into acetic acid and H as a precursor  2  O  2  Standing, filtering, drying, heating to 590-690 ℃ in a nitrogen atmosphere, introducing argon containing 10% hydrogen by volume concentration for reduction for 1h to prepare a cobalt-based catalyst, introducing a mixed gas containing carbon dioxide and propane at 500-650 ℃ under normal pressure under the catalysis of the cobalt-based catalyst, and reacting to prepare a synthetic gas; the method is simple, easy to operate and suitable for industrial production and market popularization and application.

title_en: Novel corona virus waste sterilization equipment based on integrated double-substance non-difference fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel corona virus waste sterilization device based on integrated double-substance non-difference fusion, which comprises a bearing box, a support frame, a treatment box, a multi-shaft linkage type crushing mechanism, a medical waste discharge mechanism and a floating reduction type shrinkage sinking type residue-free sterilization mechanism, wherein the support frame is arranged on the upper wall of the bearing box, the treatment box is arranged on one side of the support frame, which is far away from the bearing box, the treatment box is a cavity with an opening at the upper end, the multi-shaft linkage type crushing mechanism is arranged on the inner wall of the top of the treatment box, and the medical waste discharge mechanism is arranged on the side wall of the treatment box. The invention belongs to the technical field of waste treatment of new coronavirus, and particularly relates to waste sterilization equipment based on integrated double-substance non-differential fusion type new coronavirus; the invention provides a novel corona virus waste sterilizing device based on integrated double-substance no-difference fusion, which can realize automatic sinking type whole body soaking sterilization of medical waste by adopting a water-to-liquid two-substance mode and can discharge used liquid harmlessly.

title_en: Fruit growing soil detects auxiliary device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fruit planting soil detection auxiliary device which comprises a treatment barrel, wherein an installation base is sleeved on the outer side of the treatment barrel, a pretreatment device is installed at the top of the treatment barrel, a fixed support frame is fixedly connected inside the pretreatment device, one end, far away from the pretreatment device, of the fixed support frame is fixedly connected with a top plate, the top of the top plate is fixedly connected with a driving motor, the output end of the driving motor is fixedly connected with a rotating shaft, the bottom of the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a dissolving device, a water inlet pipe is arranged at the bottom of the dissolving device, the bottom of the treatment barrel is communicated with a discharge pipe, the dissolving device comprises a material adding pipe, and the inner wall of the material adding pipe is communicated with a drain pipe. This fruit growing soil detects auxiliary device can assemble broken and dissolving the stirring an organic whole, avoids setting up the multiunit motor, saves the cost.

title_en: Automatic rotary stirring purifying slow filtering device for filtering material and using method
abstract_en: The automatic rotary stirring purifying slow filtering device for filtering material includes slow filtering tank, hydraulic elevating mechanism, stirring mechanism, photoelectronic control system and scraping device, and has support with stirring mechanism and scraping device, liquid draining pipe connected to the bottom of the slow filtering tank and with photoelectronic control system; when the device works, the photoelectric control system controls the hydraulic lifting mechanism to lift, the stirring mechanism and the scraping device can stir and scrape the filter material, the device integrates the functions of automatic lifting, timed rotary stirring and automatic spreading of the filter material, the problems of hardening and blocking of the filter material of the slow filter can be effectively solved, and the waste phenomenon that the filter material on the surface layer needs to be scraped after the filter is blocked in the past can be solved.

title_en: Double-deck refrigerating system and double-deck proof box
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a double-layer refrigeration system and a double-layer test box, wherein the double-layer refrigeration system comprises a first refrigeration system and a second refrigeration system; the first refrigerating system and the second refrigerating system respectively comprise a main refrigerating path and a branch refrigerating path, and further comprise a compressor, a condenser and an evaporator which are arranged in series; the inlet of the condenser is connected with the exhaust port of the compressor, and the condenser is used for liquefying the first refrigerating gas discharged by the compressor into refrigerating liquid; the inlet of the evaporator is connected with the outlet of the condenser, and the evaporator is used for evaporating the refrigerating liquid into second refrigerating gas; the air inlet of the compressor is connected with the outlet of the evaporator, and the compressor is used for receiving the second refrigerating gas; the refrigeration branch comprises a compressor, a refrigeration pipeline and an evaporator which are arranged in series, and the compressor transmits the discharged refrigeration gas to the evaporator through the refrigeration pipeline. By additionally arranging the refrigeration branch circuit on the basis of the refrigeration main circuit, the double circuit ensures the flow of the refrigeration liquid flowing into the evaporator and ensures the stability of the refrigeration system.

title_en: Magnetic COFs material, intermediate, sensor, preparation and application in mercury ion detection
abstract_en: The invention provides a magnetic COFs material, an intermediate, a sensor, preparation and application thereof in mercury ion detection. The preparation method of the sensor comprises the following steps: s31, mixing 2-aminothiophene with ethanol, and dropwise adding salicylaldehyde dissolved in the ethanol into the solution under stirring; cooling to room temperature after reflux reaction to obtain a yellow solid product, and recrystallizing the yellow solid product to obtain 2- { [ (2-sulfonylphenyl) imine ] methyl } ] phenol; s32, adding the magnetic COFs material of the 2- { [ (2-sulfonyl phenyl) imine ] methyl } phenol and the magnetic COFs material into a methanol solution, reacting under the vacuum condition of 55-65 ℃ until the ligand is saturated, removing the methanol by a rotary evaporator, and washing with warm water, drying and grinding into nano fine powder to prepare the magnetic COFs sensor loaded with the organic ligand.

title_en: Polyethyleneimine functionalized magnetic graphene oxide adsorbent and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of heavy metal ion-containing wastewater treatment, and discloses a polyethyleneimine functionalized magnetic graphene oxide adsorbent as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The method comprises the following steps: 1) uniformly mixing graphene oxide, ferrous chloride and ferric chloride in water, adding an ammonia water solution, and reacting to obtain magnetic graphene oxide; 2) reacting magnetic graphene oxide with 3-aminopropyltriethoxysilane in an organic solvent to obtain silanized magnetic graphene oxide; 3) dispersing silanized magnetic graphene oxide in water, adding polyethyleneimine and a formaldehyde solution, reacting, and performing subsequent treatment to obtain the polyethyleneimine-functionalized magnetic graphene oxide adsorbent. The method is simple, and the prepared adsorbent has selective adsorption to Hg (II), high adsorption capacity, easy separation and reusability. The adsorbent of the invention can effectively remove heavy metal ions. The adsorbent is used for removing heavy metal ions in water.

title_en: Method for removing carbon deposition in deactivated propylene titanium oxide silicon molecular sieve catalyst
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for removing carbon deposition in an inactivated propylene titanium oxide silicon molecular sieve catalyst, which specifically comprises the following steps: soaking the inactivated propylene titanium oxide silicon molecular sieve catalyst containing carbon deposition into a low-concentration hydrogen peroxide aqueous solution, dropwise adding an acetone solution of phenyl bis (2, 4, 6-trimethylbenzoyl) phosphine oxide at a lower temperature of not more than 50 ℃ under the irradiation of ultraviolet light of 360-405 nm, dissociating the phenyl bis (2, 4, 6-trimethylbenzoyl) phosphine oxide under the action of the ultraviolet light to generate free radicals, inducing the hydrogen peroxide to generate active hydroxyl free radicals, and oxidizing and degrading to remove the activated propylene titanium oxide silicon molecular sieve carbon deposition, so that the catalyst is recovered to activity. The method provided by the invention has the advantages that the hydrogen peroxide concentration is low, the treatment temperature is low, and the serious problems of waste gas pollution, potential safety hazard, high energy consumption and the like in the existing carbon deposit removal process by adopting the roasting technology and the high-concentration hydrogen peroxide oxidation technology are solved.

title_en: Blast pre-degreasing device for cold-rolled seamless stainless steel pipe
abstract_en: The invention provides a blast pre-degreasing device for a cold-rolled seamless stainless steel pipe, which relates to the technical field of seamless steel pipe processing and comprises the following components: a rotating shaft; six parallel connecting rods are connected to the outer side of the rotating shaft in a surrounding manner, the rotating shaft is connected with the degreasing blow-washing plate through the parallel connecting rods, and the three degreasing blow-washing plates surround the periphery of the rotating shaft in a surrounding manner; the liquid spraying head is communicated with the liquid guide pipe, the liquid guide pipe is connected with the rotary joint, and the rotary joint is sleeved on the outer side of the rotating shaft. The invention can adjust the applicability of the spacing distance of the three degreasing blow-washing plates according to the different inner diameters of the stainless steel pipes, so that the hard bristles at the outer sides of the degreasing blow-washing plates can be in contact with the inner walls of the stainless steel pipes, and the requirements of blow-washing and degreasing treatment of the stainless steel pipes with different inner diameters can be better met. The problem of traditional stainless steel pipe with blowing wash degrease device when using, its device is inside to blow wash the degrease component and be difficult to carry out the suitability according to the difference of stainless steel pipe internal diameter, the commonality is relatively poor is solved.

title_en: Nozzle monitoring device for a nozzle centrifuge, nozzle centrifuge and method for monitoring a nozzle of a nozzle centrifuge
abstract_en: The invention relates to a nozzle monitoring device (15) of a continuously operating nozzle centrifuge (1), in particular of a nozzle separator, comprising a housing (2), a bowl (3) which is arranged in the housing (2) so as to be rotatable about a vertical axis of rotation (3a) and which has a defined number of nozzles (8) on a circumference (3b) of the bowl (3), wherein the nozzle monitoring device (15) has at least one sensor and a control unit (24). The nozzle monitoring device (15) is designed as an optical nozzle monitor having at least one stroboscope (19) and at least one camera (20), the at least one camera (20) forming the at least one sensor. A nozzle centrifuge (1) having such a nozzle monitoring device (15) and a method for monitoring a nozzle (8) of a nozzle centrifuge (1) are provided.

title_en: Oxygenation membrane net and oxygenation subassembly
abstract_en: The invention relates to an oxygenated membrane net, which comprises a plurality of hollow fiber membrane filaments which are arranged in the same direction, the positions of the hollow fiber membrane filaments are relatively fixed, the outer diameter of the hollow fiber membrane filaments is set to d, the distance between the adjacent hollow fiber membrane filaments is set to L1, a hollow columnar efficient exchange area concentric with the cross section circle of the hollow fiber membrane filaments is formed outside the hollow fiber membrane filaments, the oxygen mass transfer rate in the efficient exchange area is at least 50mL/(min square meter) @400mL/min blood flow rate @400mL/min oxygen flow rate, a gas separation factor alpha (CO2/O2) is arranged between 1 and 4, the width of the minimum position of the efficient exchange area is set to w, and L1 is not more than 2(0.5d + w). The invention aims to provide an oxygenation membrane net with high gas exchange efficiency and an oxygenation assembly with high gas exchange efficiency.

title_en: Spraying device is used in production of glass glaze capacitor film
abstract_en: The invention discloses a spraying device for producing a glass glaze capacitor film, which comprises a shell, wherein the top end of the shell is fixedly connected with a top plate, the top of the top plate is provided with a capacitor shell limiting mechanism, one side of the shell is fixedly provided with a medium storage box, the other side of the shell is fixedly provided with a controller, the bottom wall of the shell is fixedly provided with a motor, one end of an output shaft of the motor is provided with a uniform spraying mechanism, and the top of the top plate is provided with a spraying groove. According to the invention, the uniform spraying of the surface of the capacitor to be sprayed with the glass glaze is realized through the uniform spraying mechanism, and meanwhile, the data obtained through the detection of the capacitor shell thickness detection mechanism is transmitted to the spraying adjustment mechanism to realize the opening of the capacitor adjustment spray valves with different diameters in different degrees, so that the uniform spraying is realized, the high-efficiency spraying of the glass glaze on the surface of the capacitor shell with different specifications and diameters can be realized, the automation degree is high, and the application prospect is good.

title_en: Belted steel production is with belted steel surface residual oil cleaning equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a strip steel surface residual oil cleaning device for strip steel production, which belongs to the field of strip steel production equipment and comprises a base and a belt, wherein a conveying box is fixedly arranged on the base, a cleaning box is fixedly arranged on the right side of the conveying box, a drying box is fixedly arranged on the right side of the cleaning box, a plurality of conveying rollers are rotatably connected in the conveying box, every two conveying rollers form a group, the top ends of the two conveying rollers in each group extend out of the conveying box, belt pulleys are fixedly arranged on the two conveying rollers, and the two belt pulleys are in transmission connection through the belt, and the strip steel surface residual oil cleaning device has the beneficial effects that: this kind of cleaning equipment convenient to use can carry out automation to belted steel and wash through above-mentioned subassembly, has avoided needing the manual work to wash in traditional cleaning process, wastes time and energy, and need consume a large amount of cost of labor's problem, can dry to belted steel after wasing simultaneously, saves the air-dry time to production efficiency has further been improved.

title_en: Preparation method of bacterial cellulose/ZIF-7 conductive gel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of bacterial cellulose/ZIF-7 conductive gel, which comprises the steps of dissolving sodium formate HCOONa and benzimidazole H-BIM in N-N dimethylformamide DMF to obtain solution A; dissolving zinc nitrate hexahydrate in deionized water to obtain solution B, slowly pouring the solution B into the solution A on a magnetic stirrer, and fully stirring to obtain a mixed solution; simultaneously adding the bacterial cellulose and the mixed solution into a high-pressure reaction kettle, moving the high-pressure reaction kettle into an oven for heating, cooling to room temperature, and taking the bacterial cellulose out of the oven; and opening the reaction kettle, and cleaning the product for multiple times to obtain the bacterial cellulose/ZIF-7 conductive gel. The method adopts a solvothermal method to prepare the bacterial cellulose/ZIF-7 conductive gel, the process is simple and easy to operate, and the prepared bacterial cellulose/ZIF-7 conductive gel has excellent mechanical properties and conductivity.

title_en: Sterile operating table
abstract_en: The invention provides a sterile operation table, which comprises an operation box body consisting of a left side wall, a right side wall, a rear wall, a top and an operation table top, wherein the left side wall, the right side wall and the front ends of the top, which correspond to the rear wall in position, are respectively provided with an air outlet, when the air outlets work, the sterile environment in the operation box body is not influenced by the outside of the operation box body, in addition, an air direction guide groove is arranged at the air outlet of the sterile operation table, and the air speed of air flow at the air outlet is controlled to be 2 m/s-3 m/s by an air speed control device arranged at the top. The sterile operating platform provided by the invention improves the convenience of the operating process on the premise of ensuring that the sterile environment in the operating box body is not influenced by the outside.

title_en: Photocatalysis and ozone catalysis dual-functional water treatment catalyst and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a photocatalysis and ozone catalysis dual-functional water treatment catalyst, which is prepared by stabilizing TiO with aluminum polymer  2  After the particles, mn is used for lattice doping to change TiO  2  The energy gap expands the absorption wavelength to the visible light region, and finally Fe is used for ion doping and colloid oxide loading, and finally the water treatment catalyst with the functions of photocatalyst and ozone catalysis is formed by calcining.

title_en: Sea cucumber seedling culture corrugated plate cleaning equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of holothurian culture, in particular to a cleaning device for a corrugated plate for holothurian seedling culture, which comprises a frame and a cleaning chamber, wherein a cleaning mechanism is arranged in the cleaning chamber, the cleaning mechanism comprises a cleaning roller rotating along the circumferential direction and a movable cleaning strip reciprocating axially along the cleaning roller, and the movable cleaning strip is matched with a columnar piece to realize axial reciprocating motion while rotating along the circumferential direction along with the cleaning roller; this scheme increases the removal cleaning strip that can follow cleaning roller axial motion on the basis of rotating the cleaning roller for rotate abluent use along the circumferencial direction at the cleaning roller, cooperation axial reciprocating motion's removal cleaning strip, with the dirt to the both sides clearance of buckled plate, reduced the probability of dirt accumulation, promoted the cleaning performance, and the mode of realization is comparatively simple, improve on original cleaning machine the cleaning roller can, need not to purchase new equipment again.

title_en: Prevent empting integrative cabinet of charging feed battery with self-cleaning function
abstract_en: The invention relates to an anti-toppling charging and feeding battery integrated cabinet with a self-cleaning function, which comprises a cabinet body, wherein a fixed base is arranged below the cabinet body, the bottoms of the front end and the rear end of the fixed base are respectively provided with a damping supporting mechanism which is symmetrically distributed, a counterweight mechanism is arranged inside the fixed base and comprises a counterweight cavity, the inner side wall of the counterweight cavity is rotationally connected with a first screw rod, the outer surface of the first screw rod is sleeved with a first threaded seat through threads, a bearing plate is fixed at the top of the first threaded seat, a counterweight block is arranged on the bearing plate, a dehumidifying mechanism is arranged on one side inside the cabinet body, and a dust removing mechanism is arranged on the other side inside the cabinet body; the problem that in the prior art, the charging cabinet is prone to toppling in the frequent use process, damage is caused to the charging cabinet, and casualties are prone to being caused at the same time is solved; and the cleaning of the interior of the charging cabinet is not in place, so that dust or moisture causes damage to electronic components in the charging cabinet and the like.

title_en: Fuel cell and thermal management system and coolant ion filtering device thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fuel cell, a thermal management system thereof and a coolant ion filtering device, wherein the coolant ion filtering device comprises an ion filtering device body and a filtering member, wherein the ion filtering device body comprises a coolant inlet and a coolant outlet, a filter element is arranged in an inner cavity of the ion filtering device body, resin for adsorbing free electrons in coolant is filled in the filter element, and the coolant inlet is communicated with the coolant outlet through the filter element; the filtering component is arranged on the ion filtering device body or the filter element to prevent the filter material of the filter element from leaking; the cooling liquid ion filtering device can effectively prevent the leakage of the resin filtering material in the filter element by adding the filtering component, thereby avoiding the phenomenon that the resin filtering material blocks the parts of the fuel cell and preventing the fuel cell from being damaged.

title_en: Defoaming method of printed circuit board developing solution, silicon-free defoaming agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a defoaming method of a printed circuit board developing solution, a silicon-free defoaming agent and a preparation method thereof, and the defoaming method of the printed circuit board developing solution is characterized in that the silicon-free defoaming agent is used for defoaming the developing solution; the silicon-free defoaming agent comprises the following components in mass concentration: 2% -5% of a polyether ester compound, 1% -3% of a dispersant, 0.5% -1.5% of a thickening agent, 0.3% -1.2% of an accelerator and 90% -96% of a water solvent. The invention can rapidly defoam the developing solution of the printed circuit board in a short time and effectively inhibit the foams.

title_en: ABS resin production process system containing internal circulation device and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of high polymer materials, and particularly relates to an ABS resin production process system containing an internal circulation device and a preparation method. The system comprises an internal circulation reactor, a plug flow reactor and a static mixing reactor which are sequentially connected in series through pipelines; the internal circulation reactor consists of 3 static mixers which are connected in series in sequence; the number of plug flow reactors was 3. The invention effectively solves the problems of poor operation stability, high energy consumption, wide molecular weight distribution of rubber particles, poor dispersibility and the like in the prior art, the internal circulation reactor pumps the rubber particles with smaller size and unreacted monomers back to the system for continuous reaction, thereby being beneficial to improving the rubber grafting rate and monomer conversion rate and stabilizing the product quality, the improved device has stable operation and low energy consumption, and the prepared ABS resin product has the characteristics of narrow molecular weight distribution of the rubber particles, uniform dispersion and high impact strength, and has good industrial production prospect and remarkable economic benefit.

title_en: System and method for roller-type grinding of ultrafine powder by using fine steel slag tailings
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for roller-type grinding of ultrafine powder by using fine steel slag tailings, which solve the problems of complex composition and more production nodes of the conventional production system. The system comprises steel slag feeding equipment, a disc type vertical mill, a coarse particle separator, a medium-fine powder separator, an ultra-fine powder collector and a hot air circulating system which are sequentially arranged from front to back, wherein a V-shaped cavity is formed inside the coarse particle separator, a blanking port, an air distribution port, a coarse material collecting pipe and an air outlet are formed in the coarse particle separator, and magnetic separation equipment is externally connected below the coarse material collecting pipe. The hot air circulating system comprises a hot air furnace and a hot air circulating pipeline. The redesigned superfine powder production system obtains two products of effective superfine powder and refined fine iron powder, wherein the refined fine iron powder can be used for steel making in a return circuit, and the superfine powder can be used for capital construction, cement manufacturing and the like. In the production process, waste solid is generated less, and hot air in the system can be recycled, so that the energy-saving effect is obvious.

title_en: Conveying belt type drying integrated machine for silicon powder processing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a conveyor belt type drying all-in-one machine for silicon powder processing, which comprises two support frames, wherein the front part and the rear part between the tops of the two support frames are fixedly connected with support plates. This conveyer belt all-in-one drying machine is used in silica flour processing, the dispersion pole removes about the drive of motor, pave accumulational silica flour, simultaneously under the drive of motor, the heat absorption pole rotates, silica flour to the stoving in-process stirs, make it be heated evenly, improve the stoving effect, and the heat absorption pole is at the extrusion of rotatory in-process to the gasbag, can make the heat discharge in the heat absorption pole, the dead lever is at rotatory in-process, its surperficial through-hole can also absorb the silica flour of raising, then filter through the collecting box and collect on the conveyer belt again, can not cause the waste of silica flour raw materials, and the heat of collecting can also continue to discharge and use in the box.

title_en: Full-automatic disinfection robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a full-automatic disinfection robot which comprises a base, wherein a connecting piece is placed on the upper surface of the base, a movable plate is movably connected to the front surface of the connecting piece, a main body is fixed on the upper surface of the connecting piece, a display screen is fixed on the upper surface of the main body, an inductor is fixed on the upper surface of the display screen, a disassembling and assembling mechanism is arranged inside the base, a disinfection mechanism is arranged inside the main body, and a stirring mechanism is arranged inside the main body. This full-automatic disinfection robot, be provided with disinfection mechanism, rabbling mechanism and dismouting mechanism, through disinfection mechanism, mutually support between each structure of rabbling mechanism and dismouting mechanism, enable disinfection robot when disinfecting for a certain place, can also disinfect for pedestrian's both hands of passing by, can also make the antiseptic solution of storage in disinfection robot stir, make the antiseptic solution can not deposit in disinfection robot, can also make disinfection robot split, so that disinfection robot is put in to appointed place.

title_en: Cleaning device for etching
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of etching, and discloses a cleaning device for etching, which comprises a box body and a lifting mechanism arranged at the top of the box body, wherein a spraying mechanism is fixedly connected at the moving end of the lifting mechanism, a discharging mechanism is fixedly connected at the bottom end of the spraying mechanism, moving mechanisms are transversely and symmetrically arranged at two sides of the box body, and a soaking mechanism is arranged in the box body; according to the invention, the lifting mechanism, the spraying mechanism and the trapezoidal partition plate are matched, so that the trapezoidal partition plate can be used for rapidly collecting the waste liquid sprayed by the spraying mechanism, the pollution of the waste liquid to the bottom of the box body is reduced, the workpiece to be cleaned can be subjected to secondary soaking through the matching of the lifting mechanism, the discharging mechanism and the soaking mechanism, and the workpiece to be cleaned can be turned over in the spraying and soaking processes, so that the workpiece can be cleaned in all directions, the cleaning is more thorough, the cleaning liquid at the bottom of the box body can be stirred, and the cleaning effect is better.

title_en: Capacitor protection device and capacitor
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of capacitors, in particular to a capacitor protection device and a capacitor, which comprise a protective shell with a protection function, wherein a dust removal mechanism with a dust removal function is arranged on the protective shell, a pre-tightening mechanism with a pre-tightening function is arranged on the protective shell, a fixing mechanism convenient for fixing a lead is arranged on the protective shell, and the dust removal mechanism drives the pre-tightening mechanism to work.

title_en: Automatic code scanning and classifying device for traditional Chinese medicine tracing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of code scanning, in particular to an automatic code scanning classification device for Chinese medicine tracing; the invention provides an automatic code scanning and classifying device for Chinese medicine tracing, which comprises a frame, wherein a first conveyor belt and first vertical plates are arranged on the upper surface of the frame, the first vertical plates are fixedly connected with the upper surface of the frame, curved sliding grooves are formed in the inner side surfaces of the two first vertical plates, a sliding block assembly is mounted in the curved sliding grooves in a matched manner, a code scanning device is arranged on the sliding block assembly, and can scan and identify identification codes on the outer side of a woven bag filled with Chinese medicinal materials.

title_en: Ultrahigh-pressure jet collision H-shaped homogenizing head and homogenizing method
abstract_en: An ultrahigh pressure jet flow colliding H-shaped homogenizing head and a homogenizing method are characterized in that: the homogenizing head comprises two high-pressure feeding channels (1), the inlet ends of the high-pressure feeding channels (1) are connected with the output ends of 300-400 MPa high-pressure pumps, the tail ends of the two high-pressure feeding channels (1) are communicated through collision pipes (2), the pipe diameters of the collision pipes (2) are 1/30-1/100 of the pipe diameters of the high-pressure feeding channels (1), media in the high-pressure feeding channels (1) are solid-liquid mixtures containing micron-sized solid raw materials less than 10%, and the pressure of the solid-liquid mixtures is 300-400 MPa; the middle of the collision tube (2) is connected with two flow guide tubes (3), and after the solid-liquid mixed liquid of the two high-pressure feeding channels (1) collides in the collision tube (2) at the speed of 800-1000 m/s, the micron-sized particle materials are crushed to reach the nanometer level due to mutual collision under the action of supersonic impact force. The invention has good homogenizing effect and high production efficiency, and can obtain nano-grade homogenizing effect.

title_en: Meat mincing equipment and meat mincing accessories
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides an apparatus for mincing meat, comprising: a driver, a meat mincing chamber, one or more blades, a drive shaft, a head, and a drive mechanism. Wherein the blade is positioned in the meat mincing chamber and is used for mincing the meat; the transmission shaft is used for rotating the blade; the head is positionable in a holding position at the outlet of the meat mincing chamber in which the drive shaft is held in the meat mincing chamber; the drive mechanism is used to couple the drive shaft to the driver. Wherein the transmission mechanism comprises at least two mutually repelling magnets, a first magnet coupled to the drive shaft and a second magnet coupled to the driver. The two magnets are arranged to decouple the drive shaft from the drive when the handpiece is removed from the holding position. A meat mincing accessory for attachment to a kitchen appliance having a motor is also provided.

title_en: Control method of water softener and water softener
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of water softening equipment, and discloses a control method of a water softener and the water softener. The water softener comprises at least two resin tanks connected in parallel for water outflow, and the control method of the water softener comprises the following steps: s1: obtaining the total water production amount of each resin tank; s2: when the difference value of the total water production amounts of any two resin tanks reaches a first preset value, closing the resin tank with the largest total water production amount, continuing water production of the rest resin tanks, and defining the total water production amount of the closed resin tanks as a target water production amount; s3: and obtaining the total water production amount of the rest resin tanks, and closing the resin tanks with the total water production amount reaching the target water production amount. Through detecting the difference of the total water production amount between the resin tanks, the resin tanks with higher ion resin exchange rate are suspended, the problem of unbalanced water inflow caused by the difference of the internal resistance of each resin tank can be solved, the uniform water inflow of each tank body is realized, the resin consumption is balanced, the softening effect is stable, and the waste of regenerated salt is avoided.

title_en: Cosmetic component spraying device
abstract_en: The cosmetic composition spraying device according to the present disclosure includes a mixture having a cosmetic composition and a base, and an air blowing device blowing air to the cosmetic composition. The cosmetic composition spray device according to the present disclosure includes a laser irradiation unit that irradiates the mixture with a laser beam, and a trapping electrode having the same polarity as that of the cosmetic composition. According to the cosmetic composition spray device of the present disclosure, the cosmetic composition can be appropriately fixed to the target site.

title_en: Anti-magnetic ring plate sticking device of butt joint magnetic ring spraying equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to an anti-magnetic ring sticking plate device of butt joint magnetic ring spraying equipment, which comprises a rack, a limiting frame, a supporting plate, a vibrator and a cooling device, wherein the limiting frame is arranged on the rack, and a side plate facing one side of the magnetic ring spraying equipment is driven to lift by a feeding side plate lifting driving device; the supporting plate is used for supporting a plate bearing a magnetic ring, and the vibrator is fixedly connected with the supporting plate; during operation, the supporting plate is positioned inside the limiting frame to vibrate, and the cooling device blows air towards the magnetic ring. Compared with the prior art, the vibrator can separate the magnetic ring of the uncured sticking plate of the surface coating from the iron ring by vibration when the vibrator is hot, meanwhile, the cooling device accelerates the curing of the surface coating of the magnetic ring when the magnetic ring and the iron plate repeatedly contact and separate, and effectively prevents the magnetic ring from being bonded with the iron plate in the conversion process from hot soft to cold hard of the coating between the magnetic ring and the iron plate, thereby greatly reducing the reject ratio of the magnetic ring sticking plate and improving the working efficiency.

title_en: Efficient production process of high-solubility product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-efficiency production process of a high-solubility product, which relates to the technical field of production processes of the high-solubility product, and is characterized in that on the basis of proportional and staged equivalent material control, a constant-temperature water circulating system is used for maintaining the temperature of a grinding part to stabilize the internal energy of the grinding part so as to prevent the internal energy from changing to change the dissolving form of xanthan gum and prevent the xanthan gum from generating paste, and the xanthan gum is deeply dissolved in constant-temperature water by carrying out layered multiple scouring mixing on the xanthan gum in a solution and carrying out single-rotation mixing on the solution, so that the product is more exquisite, better in quality and higher in dissolving efficiency.

title_en: Device and method for producing peppery green mustard
abstract_en: The application provides a wasabi production device and a wasabi production method, wherein the wasabi production device comprises a reaction kettle and a vacuum pumping module, the vacuum pumping module comprises a filtering device, a first dryer, a liquid collector, a second dryer and a vacuum pump, the inside of the reaction kettle is communicated with a vacuum pipeline, the vacuum pipeline is sequentially communicated with the filtering device, the first dryer, the liquid collector, the second dryer and the vacuum pump, the bottom of the liquid collector is communicated with the inside of the reaction kettle through a return pipeline, and electric valves are arranged on the vacuum pipeline and the return pipeline.

title_en: Device system capable of separating cannabinol and reducing content of tetrahydrocannabinol in cannabis sativa oil
abstract_en: The invention provides a device system capable of separating cannabinol and reducing the content of tetrahydrocannabinol in cannabis sativa oil, which relates to the technical field of chemistry and reduction of the content of tetrahydrocannabinol, and comprises the following components: the device comprises a cannabinol separation device main body, wherein a sealing buckle cover is arranged right above the cannabinol separation device main body, and a group of electromagnets communicated with a reciprocating sliding cavity are embedded in the right end face of a matching block; the reciprocating sliding cavity is internally and slidably provided with an extrusion block, after the specified normal reaction time is exceeded, the extrusion block is matched with the electromagnet in a magnetic attraction mode, the conical tip protruding out of the bottom end face of the sealing buckle cover and penetrating through the plastic film wrapping layer and the sealing cavity are enabled to be enabled to drop into the separation tank, the solution in the separation tank is damaged to enable the separation tank to be incapable of being continuously applied, the problem that the solution exceeding the normal reaction time cannot be judged, the problem that the application is insufficient is solved, and the solution exceeding the normal reaction time cannot be prevented from being continuously applied.

title_en: Pyromellitic acid continuous anhydride forming device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pyromellitic acid continuous anhydride forming device in the field of chemical production equipment, which comprises a horizontal shell, wherein a feed inlet for feeding pyromellitic acid raw materials is formed in one end of the upper side of the shell; a gas phase outlet is arranged at the middle position of the upper side of the shell, and a discharge hole for discharging pyromellitic dianhydride liquid is arranged at the lower side of the other end of the shell; the shell comprises an outer shell and an inner shell which are of a double-layer structure, a heating medium cavity is arranged between the outer shell and the inner shell, two main shafts which are parallel to each other are arranged in the shell, the axes of the two main shafts are positioned at the same horizontal position, outer spiral propelling blades with the same height are arranged on the two main shafts, the bottoms of the outer shell and the inner shell are in omega shapes matched with the shapes of the outer spiral propelling blades, and semicircular gas-phase cavities are reserved above the outer spiral propelling blades; and the gas-phase outlet is connected with a vacuum air extractor through a vacuum condenser. The method has low working energy consumption and less material residue, and provides technical support for large-scale industrial production of pyromellitic dianhydride.

title_en: Wood waste recycling and reprocessing equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses wood waste recycling and reprocessing equipment, and belongs to the technical field of wood processing equipment; a wood waste recycling and reprocessing apparatus comprising: a base and a control device; further comprising: the supporting plate is positioned on the bottom side of the output end of the crushing device, a plurality of groups of leak holes are vertically formed in the upper surface of the supporting plate, the diameters of the plurality of groups of leak holes are sequentially increased from the input end to the output end, and baffles are symmetrically and fixedly arranged on two sides of the upper surface of the supporting plate; the supporting components are in a plurality of groups; the pushing component comprises a support rod and a scraper, and the end part of the scraper is fixedly connected with the outer side of the support rod; the circulating component is used for driving the pushing component to repeatedly move on the upper side of the supporting plate; the invention effectively solves the problems that the existing equipment has single function, can not screen the cut and crushed waste wood, and is inconvenient for later use because tubers with different sizes are mixed together.

title_en: Method for transforming hydrothermal floor heating into electric floor heating
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for reforming a hydrothermal floor heating into an electric floor heating, which comprises the following steps: respectively connecting a water supply pipe of the floor heating pipeline and a water return pipe of the floor heating pipeline with a circulating pump, and judging whether the floor heating pipeline has a leakage condition; connecting a cleaning pump with any floor heating pipeline in the end parts of the water supply pipe and the water return pipe for cleaning; after the cleaning pump is detached, the air blower is connected with any floor heating pipeline in the end part of the water supply pipe and the end part of the water return pipe, and air cooling and drying are carried out; the heating wire penetrates into the floor heating pipeline and is fixed; and the superconducting liquid is filled into the floor heating pipeline and seals the floor heating pipeline, and the whole machine is operated and debugged after the heating wire is connected with each component. The invention is simple and easy to implement, and low in modification cost by modifying the original hydrothermal floor heating; the dual cleaning mode is adopted, so that the pipe wall is not damaged, and the requirement of practical application can be well met.

title_en: Be applied to broken milling equipment that useless glass fiber retrieved
abstract_en: The invention relates to a crushing and grinding device, in particular to a crushing and grinding device applied to waste glass fiber recovery. The utility model provides a can make broken and two actions of crocus go on simultaneously to easy operation's broken milling equipment of being applied to useless glass fiber recovery is provided. A crushing and grinding device applied to waste glass fiber recovery comprises a supporting base, a crushing bin, a grinding bin, a feeding hopper, a crushing mechanism and the like; support the base middle part and be connected with the crocus storehouse, crocus storehouse upside and broken storehouse downside are connected, and broken storehouse top is connected with the feeder hopper that is used for the feeding, is equipped with the broken mechanism that is used for broken useless glass fiber on the broken storehouse. According to the invention, through the cooperation between the motor and the first transmission assembly, two actions of crushing and grinding waste glass fibers can be simultaneously carried out, so that the speed of recovering the crushed and ground waste glass fibers is increased.

title_en: Air heating type calcium circulating energy storage system and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an air heating type calcium circulating energy storage system and an application method thereof, wherein the air heating type calcium circulating energy storage system comprises an air heating device, a rotary ball milling energy storage device, a circulating water device and a steam Rankine power generation device; the air heating device comprises an air filter, a fan, an air preheater and a heater; the rotary ball milling energy storage device comprises a CaO storage tank, a Ca (OH)  2  storage tank, a rotary ball milling reactor and a cyclone separator; the rotary ball milling reactor is provided with a solid particle feeding port, a solid particle discharging port, an air inlet and an air outlet; the circulating water device comprises a condensate pump, a water tank, a circulating water pump and a water processor; the steam Rankine power generation device comprises a steam Rankine turbine, a steam power generation heat exchanger, a steam power generation condenser, a steam power generation water pump and a steam power generation heater. According to the invention, air is used as a heating medium in the energy storage process, so that the method has the advantages of low cost, easiness in obtaining, simplicity and convenience in operation, and the energy utilization rate is improved, and the problem that the solar photo-thermal power station cannot continuously and efficiently run in power generation can be solved.

title_en: Spraying device
abstract_en: The present invention provides a spray device comprising: the spray stator assembly comprises a cylindrical spray stator, an air inlet joint and a water supply joint, and the spray rotor actuator comprises a spray rotor shaft core, a spray rotor lower cavity, an atomizing nozzle and a right-angle-shaped air injection joint; the first end of the spraying stator is fixedly connected with an external mechanism; the spraying rotor shaft core is sleeved in the spraying stator; the spray rotor shaft core is fixedly connected with a spray rotor lower cavity at the second end of the spray stator; an atomizing nozzle and an air injection joint are fixed on the side surface of the lower cavity of the atomizing rotor; the side of spraying stator is provided with air inlet joint and water supply joint, and air inlet joint passes through the air inlet pipe and is connected with the jet-propelled joint, and water supply joint passes through the feed liquor pipeline and is connected with atomizer. According to the invention, gas-liquid diversion is realized through the gas inlet pipeline and the liquid inlet pipeline in the spray rotor shaft core, mist disturbance is realized by spraying and jetting at the same time, and meanwhile, the spray can be rotated to accelerate the mist diffusion.

title_en: Pumpkin seed oil microcapsule and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a pumpkin seed oil microcapsule and a preparation method and application thereof. According to the invention, by screening the types and the compounding ratio of the wall materials, the synergistic effect of the components is fully exerted, the stability of the emulsion formed by mixing the wall materials and the core materials is improved, the embedding rate of the prepared microcapsule is improved, the peroxide value is reduced, and the quality guarantee period of the pumpkin seed oil is prolonged. The microencapsulated pumpkin seed oil has better water solubility, can effectively improve the bioavailability of the pumpkin seed oil, and can widen the application field of the pumpkin seed oil.

title_en: Processing method of neutral dyeing color fixing agent
abstract_en: The invention relates to a processing method of a neutral dyeing color fixing agent, which comprises a stirring unit and a pretreatment unit, wherein the upper end of the stirring unit is fixedly provided with the pretreatment unit, a diethylenetriamine aqueous solution is processed by the pretreatment unit, the feeding amount of epoxy chloropropane is controlled, a mixed solution of the diethylenetriamine aqueous solution and the epoxy chloropropane is stirred by the stirring unit, and in the whole stirring process, a telescopic inclined column moves and deforms in the vertical direction along with an arc-shaped block, so that the volume of the mixed solution driven by a shifting plate on the telescopic inclined column is increased, the mixed solution is uniformly stirred, the processing efficiency of a device is improved, and the stirring unit scrapes off liquid adhered to the inner wall of a glass cylinder to prevent the influence on the discharge amount of the device.

title_en: Education robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of education, in particular to an educational robot. The technical problem is as follows: the existing auxiliary education equipment cannot utilize some teaching auxiliary articles such as calligraphy and painting, charts and maps to assist teaching, and has great limitation. The technical scheme is as follows: an educational robot comprises a bottom plate, a box body and the like; the upper surface of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a box body. The invention realizes the limitation of different teaching and auxiliary products such as calligraphy and painting, charts, maps and the like, selects the corresponding teaching and auxiliary products according to the learning content through the display screen, effectively avoids the limitation of auxiliary teaching, then expands the selected teaching and auxiliary products to facilitate the learning, and protects the teaching and auxiliary products through the corresponding protective housing, thereby avoiding the phenomena of dampness, damage and oxidation of the teaching and auxiliary products, then automatically identifies the braille through the scanner when the blind people learn, and avoids the deviation of the scanner in the moving process, thereby improving the accuracy of the teaching and improving the teaching quality.

title_en: Corrugated steel plate back film bag concrete grouting equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of construction machinery, and particularly relates to corrugated steel plate back film bag concrete grouting equipment, which comprises a grouting machine; the end part of the grouting machine is fixedly connected with a screening barrel; a first filter screen plate is fixedly connected to the inner side wall of the screening barrel; filter the otter board through setting up No. one and filter the otter board and carry out the hierarchical screening to the different size granule stones in the concrete with No. two, avoid the big piece stone to block up the little shower nozzle of slip casting machine, cooperation shock dynamo vibrations, the screening effect of reinforcing No. one filter the otter board, utilize servo motor output to rotate and drive No. one scraper blade and No. two scraper blades respectively to the terminal surface and the bottom surface scraping of No. one filter the otter board, and join in marriage No. one rubber baffle and No. two rubber baffles and collect the inside at a scraper blade to the big piece stone is spacing, the reinforcing prevents blockking up the effect, utilize the hob to wash along with the concrete at last and rotate, drive and scrape the board and scrape the lateral wall scraping of No. three filter the otter boards, the inside collection storage effect to the big piece stone of No. one scraper blade of reinforcing.

title_en: Platinum-inlaid porous iron phosphide nanorod and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a platinum-inlaid porous iron phosphide nanorod as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and platinum ions can be adsorbed in a pore channel of MIL88B (Fe) by stirring MIL88B (Fe) and chloroplatinic acid together. When sodium hypophosphite is heated at high temperature, MIL88B (Fe) adsorbed with platinum ions will be gradually phosphated. By controlling the temperature and speed of the phosphorization process, the iron phosphide nano-rod with rich pore channels can be obtained; meanwhile, platinum ions can be gradually reduced into fine platinum nanoparticles in the reducing atmosphere and embedded in the porous iron phosphide nanorods. Compared with iron phosphide particles, the porous iron phosphide nanorod has a larger specific surface, and can increase the contact between a catalyst and a reaction substrate. According to the invention, by embedding the platinum nanoparticles on the transition metal phosphide, the high-efficiency catalytic hydrogen production capability of the metal platinum can be retained, and meanwhile, the excellent conductivity of the transition metal phosphide can be facilitated, and the performance of the composite material can be synergistically improved.

title_en: Diesel oil oxidation catalyst containing strontium and tungsten and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of emission control of diesel engines, and relates to a strontium and tungsten-containing diesel oxidation catalyst and a preparation method thereof. The catalyst specifically provided by the invention comprises a carrier and a catalyst layer coated on the surface of the carrier; the catalyst layer comprises a coating material, a noble metal, and metal assistants of strontium and tungsten. The catalyst has higher HC oxidation capacity and NO oxidation capacity than a pure noble metal oxidation catalyst, and can reduce the use amount of noble metal in DOC by 30 percent on the premise of the same catalytic performance.

title_en: Milk bottle belt cleaning device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a inhale milk bottle belt cleaning device, includes the box, is equipped with cleaning roller and base in the box, and the quantity of cleaning roller is two and parallel arrangement in the box, and the cleaning roller slidable ground is installed at the box inner wall, is equipped with a plurality of feeding bottle standing groove on the base, and the size of feeding bottle standing groove is greater than the size of inhaling the feeding bottle bottom, and the interior top of box is equipped with atomizer and sterilamp, is equipped with chucking mechanism in every feeding bottle standing groove. According to the milk bottle cleaning device provided by the invention, medical staff only need to place the milk bottles in the milk bottle placing grooves in sequence during cleaning, clean water is atomized and sprayed onto each milk bottle by using the atomizing nozzle in the box body, then the bottle body is cleaned from top to bottom by using the double cleaning rollers capable of sliding up and down, and finally the bottle body is sterilized by using the sterilizing lamp, and the cleaned water remained in the box body is discharged through the drainage valve. The invention has high cleaning efficiency, can clean a plurality of feeding bottles at one time and has good cleaning effect.

title_en: Distillation equipment and distillation process for preparing refined titanium tetrachloride in chlorination stage from titanium dioxide
abstract_en: The invention relates to distillation equipment and a distillation process for preparing refined titanium tetrachloride in a chlorination stage from titanium dioxide, and the distillation equipment comprises the following steps: the titanium liquid distillation device comprises a base, wherein a box body is arranged on the base, a distillation box is arranged in the box body, a turning component is arranged on the distillation box, and the turning component is used for containing the titanium liquid in the distillation box and pouring the titanium liquid back into the distillation box; the base is also provided with a pressurizing assembly, the pressurizing assembly is provided with a cover plate matched with the inner wall of the box body, the pressurizing assembly can drive the cover plate to lift, and the pressurizing assembly can drive the cover plate to lift in a threaded manner after the cover plate is separated from the box body; still the symmetry is provided with two sets of flexible plates in the box, and is two sets of flexible plate is in with the installation wind-guiding structure adaptation on the apron, wind-guiding structure is used for with two sets of hot steam between the flexible plate pump send to form in flexible plate with in the clearance between the box to accelerate the distillation rate.

title_en: Integrated intelligent water supply equipment with low energy consumption
abstract_en: The invention discloses integrated intelligent water supply equipment with low energy consumption, which comprises a water inlet barrel and a connector, wherein the bottom end of the water inlet barrel is fixedly provided with an underframe, one end of the water inlet barrel is communicated with a connecting pipe, one end of the connecting pipe is communicated with a booster pump, one end of the connector is in threaded connection with a communicating pipe, the top of the communicating pipe is communicated with a radiating pipe, one end of the radiating pipe is communicated with a connecting cylinder, and two ends of the connecting cylinder are both fixedly provided with fixing frames. Install on the booster pump surface through the cooling tube that sets up, after switch-on pipe and connecting pipe switch-on, rivers get into the inside of cooling tube, so that dispel the heat to the booster pump surface, reduce the consumption of unnecessary energy, thereby when having avoided using the booster pump to carry out the pressure boost to rivers, motor self heat of long-time during operation booster pump upper end is higher, when all ring edge borders temperature was too high, the inside temperature of booster pump is difficult to the discharge and easily causes the damage to the inside part of booster pump.

title_en: Useless brick recovery system
abstract_en: The invention provides a waste brick recovery system, comprising: a crusher; a grinder arranged at one side of the crusher; the waste bricks are crushed by the crusher and then ground into particles by the grinder, and the screening mechanism screens the particles and then the cleaning mechanism cleans a screen in the screening mechanism; the screening mechanism includes: a case; the screening components are arranged in the box body; and the switching component drives the two groups of screening components to be recycled. According to the invention, the waste bricks are placed into the crusher, the crushed materials are conveyed into the grinder through the conveying belt after being crushed by the crusher, the grinder grinds the waste brick crushed materials into particles, and the screening mechanism screens the particles, so that the automation of waste brick recovery is realized, time and labor are saved, and the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Lubricating oil additive and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of lubricant additive processing, and particularly relates to a lubricant additive and a preparation method thereof; the method comprises the steps of preparing a silicone oil solution, preparing a silicone oil mother solution, adding stearic acid, heating and stirring, adding sulphur-phosphorus polyisobutene barium salt, heating and stirring, emulsifying, detecting the viscosity of the silicone oil, reconfiguring the viscosity of the silicone oil, preparing the lubricating oil additive by using the lubricating oil additive preparation method, wherein the lubricating oil additive comprises kerosene, silicone oil, stearic acid and sulphur-phosphorus polyisobutene barium salt, the oil preparation device comprises a platform of a main body, a mixing tank and a dispersing tank which are communicated with each other are respectively arranged on two sides of the upper end of the platform through a bracket, the mixed oil flows back and forth between the mixing tank and the dispersing tank, cavitation generated in the oil emulsifying process is reduced, and the silicone oil with deviation in viscosity is conveniently reconfigured.

title_en: Logistics system
abstract_en: The application provides a logistics system, and relates to the technical field of logistics. The guide-in equipment is arranged between the package supply equipment and the sorting equipment of the logistics system, and the posture correcting mechanism of the guide-in equipment can adjust the posture of the received package to be an expected posture, so that the bearing surface of the trolley is fully utilized. Thus, the carts of the sorting apparatus may be designed with smaller bearing surfaces to increase the number of carts per unit length of the sorting loop of the sorting apparatus, thereby increasing the sorting efficiency of the sorting apparatus. Further, a first strategy for conveying the packages is formulated for the second buffer mechanism, so that the gesture correcting mechanism can continuously run in the process that the package is imported into the sorting equipment by the importing equipment, the efficiency is ensured, and meanwhile, the accuracy of gesture correction of the packages is improved.

title_en: Pretreatment method of concrete processing raw materials
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pretreatment of concrete processing raw materials, in particular to a pretreatment method of concrete processing raw materials, which adopts a fly ash treatment device comprising treatment rollers, a support frame, a conveyor belt and treatment mechanisms, wherein the front treatment roller and the rear treatment roller are matched with the treatment mechanisms to collect fly ash in a grading manner, the right treatment roller and the treatment mechanisms are matched with each other to carry out secondary collection treatment on iron and compounds in the fly ash, so that the recovery efficiency of the iron and the compounds in the fly ash is ensured, the conveyor belt drives the fly ash to move rightwards in the treatment mechanisms, and then an electrified cylindrical electromagnet can carry out adsorption treatment on the iron and the compounds in the fly ash, wherein an electric slide block is matched with a conductive rod through a Contraband type frame to drive the cylindrical electromagnet to shake in a reciprocating manner, so that the cylindrical electromagnet moving forwards and backwards can fully adsorb the iron and the compounds in the moving fly ash.

title_en: Marine oil cylinder piston rod dirt cleaning structure and dirt cleaning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a marine oil cylinder piston rod dirt cleaning structure, which is sleeved on a piston rod of an oil cylinder and moves relative to the piston rod; including the guide pin bushing, inlay and establish the spacing subassembly of elasticity at the guide pin bushing oral area, by the clean ring of spacing subassembly centre gripping of elasticity, spacing subassembly of elasticity includes: the elastic block is fixedly arranged at one side opening part of the guide sleeve, which is away from the cylinder body of the oil cylinder, the clamping gap is obliquely arranged on the elastic block, the oblique direction points to the piston rod, the cleaning ring is arranged in the clamping gap and comprises at least two ring bodies which are mutually attached, and the adjacent two ring bodies can be opened and closed. In the invention, marine organisms attached to the piston rod are scraped off in the reciprocating motion process of the piston rod. The cleaning ring has the function of slight elastic displacement in the scraping process; the elastic block timely compensates the abrasion loss of the dust-proof ring; the probability of part damage in the erasing process is reduced, and meanwhile, the tightness of the oil cylinder is not influenced.

title_en: MEMS micro-nano hydrogen sensor module safety protection device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of hydrogen sensors, in particular to a safety protection device of an MEMS micro-nano hydrogen sensor module, which is used for detecting and alarming hydrogen leakage in the fields of hydrogen energy automobiles and hydrogen fuel management (including hydrogen production, hydrogen transmission, hydrogen storage and hydrogenation). The invention provides a safety protection device for an MEMS micro-nano hydrogen sensor module, which comprises a protection shell and a protection cover, wherein the protection shell is a shell body which is not closed up and down, a protection cover is fixedly connected above the protection shell, a vent hole is formed in the protection cover, and a ventilation mechanism is connected on the protection shell and the protection cover and used for accelerating gas circulation. The ventilation mechanism accelerates the circulation of gas, reduces the time for waiting for the spontaneous diffusion of gas, and therefore reduces the possibility of potential safety hazards.

title_en: Mineral dressing auxiliary agent for high-sulfur copper-sulfur ore and mineral dressing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mineral dressing auxiliary agent for high-sulfur copper-sulfur ore and a mineral dressing method, and relates to the technical field of mineral dressing. The mineral dressing auxiliary agent for the high-sulfur copper-sulfur ore consists of a combination inhibitor DYS and a combination collector MYD, and provides a mineral dressing method by utilizing the mineral dressing auxiliary agent for the high-sulfur copper-sulfur ore, which adopts the technical idea of' the synergistic modification of a calcium component and chitosan under low alkalinity to preferentially select copper-acid wastewater to activate sulfur, the synergistic benefit of the combined inhibitor is fully exerted, the effective separation of copper and sulfur is realized, sulfuric acid and copper ions in the acid wastewater are fully utilized, the iron sulfide ore which is restrained in the copper selecting process is activated, and finally the recycling of the acid wastewater and the economical, efficient and clean development and utilization of the high-sulfur copper-sulfur ore are realized.

title_en: Supported copper-based catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of catalysts, and particularly relates to a supported copper-based catalyst, and a preparation method and application thereof. The invention provides a supported copper-based catalyst, which comprises a composite carrier and copper supported in the composite carrier, wherein the copper comprises a copper simple substance, positive monovalent copper and positive divalent copper; the composite carrier comprises nitrogen doped carbon and manganese aluminum composite oxide; the surface of the composite carrier contains oxygen vacancies. In the invention, the supported copper-based catalyst contains polyvalent copper and oxygen vacancies, so that the adsorption performance and activation performance of the catalyst on oxygen and reactant molecules are improved, and the performance of catalyzing the oxidation of cyclohexylbenzene to prepare hydrogen peroxide cyclohexylbenzene is improved; the nitrogen-doped carbon and manganese-aluminum composite oxide in the catalyst and the multivalent copper can enable the multivalent copper to exist stably through strong interface electron interaction, so that the stability of the catalyst is improved; meanwhile, the catalyst provided by the invention is solid and is easy to recycle.

title_en: Comprehensive sorting equipment based on multi-characteristic difference of materials and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a comprehensive sorting device based on material multi-feature difference and application thereof.A feeding unit introduces materials to be sorted, a primary sorting unit separates first light materials, a pre-separation unit pre-separates other light materials, a plurality of secondary sorting units separate second light materials, simultaneously third light materials are transferred and enriched to the lower layer of the materials, a final sorting unit separates the third light materials, and an output unit outputs the heavy materials and the light materials; the sorting chamber is matched with the feeding unit, the primary sorting unit, the pre-separation unit, the secondary sorting unit and the final sorting unit, and the settling chamber is arranged on the side of the sorting chamber and is communicated with the space; the feeding unit, the primary sorting unit, the pre-separation unit, the secondary sorting unit, the final sorting unit and the output unit are sequentially arranged from top to bottom. The invention uses the difference of the characteristics of light and heavy garbage in various aspects such as density, elasticity, inertia, friction, shape and the like to sort the garbage; realize that different materials select separately many times step by step, reduce single separation load, improve the separation precision.

title_en: Rolling dry granulation equipment with air negative pressure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rolling dry granulation device with air negative pressure, which has the technical scheme that: the device comprises a positioning block, wherein two supporting frames are fixedly mounted on the top surface of the positioning block, a fixing plate is arranged on the top surface of the positioning block, the bottom surface of the fixing plate is fixedly mounted with the top surfaces of the supporting frames, a plurality of supporting rods are fixedly mounted on the top surface of the fixing plate, an adding hopper is arranged on the top surface of the fixing plate, and four corners of the bottom surface of the adding hopper are fixedly mounted with the top ends of the supporting rods respectively; the transportation subassembly, the transportation subassembly sets up the top surface of locating piece for the granule that the transportation was made, through setting up the center pin, the center pin can be driven by servo motor pivoted rotation axis after servo motor starts and rotate in the inside of transmission band, thereby drives the transmission band at the inside activity of storage tank, and through setting up the connecting hole, servo motor can be stabilized in the position of locating piece one side to the connecting hole.

title_en: High efficiency kitchen garbage profit extraction element
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-efficiency kitchen waste oil-water extraction device in the field of kitchen waste treatment, which comprises a cutting box and a separation box which are arranged in a vertically corresponding mode, wherein the upper portion of the separation box is provided with a second communication hole corresponding to a first communication hole, a cutting and smashing mechanism is arranged in the cutting box, a separation mechanism is arranged in the separation box, an upper feeding hole is formed in the upper end of a rotary cylinder, a plurality of separation holes are formed in the periphery of the rotary cylinder in a full mode, an upper supporting mechanism and a lower supporting mechanism are respectively arranged at the upper end and the lower end of the rotary cylinder in the separation box, a rotary driving mechanism is arranged in the separation box corresponding to the rotary cylinder, the lower end of the rotary cylinder is provided with an openable discharge door, the lower portion of the separation box is provided with a discharge hole, the bottom of the separation box is provided with a plurality of support columns which are vertically supported on the ground, and a movable material receiving vehicle is arranged between the support columns on the ground. The invention can fully separate the oil-water mixture from the solid matters in the kitchen waste and improve the oil-water extraction efficiency.

title_en: Full-automatic multienzyme sequential microwave enzymolysis-liquid extraction combined device and application thereof
