abstract_en: The invention relates to a full-automatic multienzyme sequential microwave enzymolysis-liquid extraction combined device and application thereof, wherein the device comprises a mainframe box, a microwave emitter, an enzymolysis bottle, a chassis, a distribution disc, a first metering pump, a second metering pump, a first six-way valve, a second six-way valve, an enzyme liquid bottle, a collection bottle, a rotating motor and a PLC, wherein the microwave emitter, the enzymolysis bottle, the chassis, the distribution disc, the first metering pump, the second metering pump, the first six-way valve and the second six-way valve are arranged in the mainframe box; the enzymolysis bottle is arranged between the chassis and the distribution plate; the enzyme liquid bottle is connected with the first six-way valve through the liquid inlet pipe and then connected with the enzymolysis bottle, and the collection bottle is connected with the second six-way valve through the liquid outlet pipe and then connected with the enzymolysis bottle. The invention combines the enzymolysis technology and the microwave technology, not only can obtain the treatment fluid which is easy to filter and has clear filtrate, but also can greatly shorten the treatment time; a liquid-liquid interface sensor is arranged in an enzymolysis tube, the liquid-liquid interface is sensed through light refraction, the volume of two phases in a liquid-liquid extraction system is determined through direct sensing or calculation, and then organic-inorganic two-phase effective automatic separation is carried out.

title_en: Preparation method of supermolecule self-assembled iron phosphate hexagonal tubular carbon nitride
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of supermolecular self-assembled iron phosphate hexagonal tubular carbon nitride, which comprises the following steps: mixing 1g H  3  PO  4  Dissolving in 50mL of deionized water, and then dispersing 1g of melamine into a phosphoric acid solution to prepare a suspension; different amounts of Fe (NO)  3  )  3  ·9H  2  Dissolving O in 20mL of deionized water, transferring the solution into the suspension, stirring the suspension in a homogenizer at the speed of 10000rpm for 20min, placing the mixture in a 100mL polytetrafluoroethylene inner lining, placing the mixture in a stainless steel autoclave, reacting the mixture at 180 ℃ for 10h, cooling the reaction product to room temperature, washing and centrifuging the precipitate for 5 times by using deionized water, and drying the precipitate at 80 ℃ overnight; putting the dried precursor intoAnd (3) heating to 500 ℃ at a heating rate of 3 ℃/min in a tubular furnace under a nitrogen atmosphere, keeping for 4h, and naturally annealing to room temperature to obtain the product. The method can complete the load deposition of the iron phosphate while forming the hollow tubular carbon nitride in a supramolecular self-assembly mode, and can realize the degradation of the acetaminophen with higher efficiency and higher concentration.

title_en: A circuit board hardness detection device for electronic components production and processing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electronic components, in particular to a circuit board hardness detection device for electronic component production and processing, which comprises a workbench, wherein the top of the workbench is provided with a testing mechanism and a shifting mechanism, the testing mechanism is used for testing the hardness of a circuit board, the shifting mechanism is used for shifting and collecting the circuit board which is qualified in testing, the top of the workbench is provided with a placing groove, the bottom surface of the placing groove is provided with a through groove, the through groove penetrates through the workbench, the placing groove is used for placing the circuit board to be detected, and the device can horizontally push the circuit board which is unqualified in detection to the triangular inclined position and the collecting groove for collection through the arrangement of a reciprocating driving mechanism, so that the device can automatically classify and process the circuit board which is unqualified in detection.

title_en: Plant for the synthesis of melamine from off-gases recovered in an associated urea plant
abstract_en: Plant for the synthesis of melamine starting from urea, in which the synthesis of melamine generates a product containing NH  3  And CO  2  Is converted to urea in a dedicated urea plant.

title_en: Method for controlling total polymerization pressure and ethylene partial pressure of PE device by gas-phase fluidized bed method
abstract_en: The invention provides a control method for total pressure and ethylene partial pressure of polymerization reaction of a PE device by a gas-phase fluidized bed method, which comprises the steps of influencing ethylene partial pressure and total pressure by adjusting a catalyst, obtaining maximum and minimum values of the ethylene partial pressure in T1 time and maximum and minimum values of a filtering value of the total pressure in T2 time, predicting the change trend of the filtering value of the ethylene partial pressure and the total pressure, determining an adjusting strategy of the catalyst according to the change trend, and stabilizing the ethylene partial pressure and the total pressure according to the adjusting strategy under the condition of load change. The method can improve the robustness of total pressure and ethylene partial pressure control, greatly reduce the labor intensity of field operators, avoid a plurality of misoperation, effectively ensure the operation safety of the device, reduce overshoot caused by the accumulated addition of the catalyst, and effectively reduce the operation load of the system.

title_en: Playing device capable of rotatably playing multi-view video and live broadcast
abstract_en: The invention discloses a playing device capable of rotatably playing multi-view video and live broadcast, which belongs to the technical field of video playing and exhibition and comprises a shell and a display screen, wherein a dust suction barrel is fixedly connected to the shell, a cleaning assembly and a height adjusting assembly are arranged on the dust suction barrel, a playing mode switching assembly is arranged on the height adjusting assembly, a dust suction end head is arranged on the cleaning assembly and used for cleaning the playing mode switching assembly, a transposition gear is arranged on the height adjusting assembly and used for switching the power transmission direction so as to adjust the height and the rotating angle of the playing mode switching assembly, a plurality of display platforms, a lower pressing block and a fixed connecting rod are arranged on the playing mode switching assembly, the included angle between the two display platforms on the fixed connecting rod is changed through the displacement change of the lower pressing block, the display platforms are switched to playing modes according to the crowd dispersion state, and meanwhile, the dust raising and playing effects are guaranteed for the display screen.

title_en: High-strength ceramsite and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing high-strength ceramsite by sintering circulating fluidized bed fly ash and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of solid waste utilization. The high-strength ceramsite is prepared by mixing fly ash of a circulating fluidized bed which is difficult to recycle according to a certain proportion under the condition of controlling ignition loss, and then sintering the mixture into the ceramsite to realize resource utilization of the fly ash. The method of the invention realizes the resource utilization of the fly ash, avoids environmental pollution to the greatest extent, and the obtained high-strength ceramsite can be used as a water treatment filter material and a building material to replace sandstone in a high-strength concrete product, thereby reducing the exploitation of sandstone resources and lowering the production cost.

title_en: Synthesis method of propylene oxide
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for synthesizing propylene oxide, which comprises the steps of carrying out contact reaction on mixed gas containing propylene, oxygen and hydrogen and a catalyst to obtain propylene oxide; the catalyst comprises a modified silicon-titanium molecular sieve, nickel oxide and phosphorus pentoxide, wherein the nickel oxide and the phosphorus pentoxide are loaded on the modified silicon-titanium molecular sieve; the modified titanium silicalite molecular sieve is a titanium silicalite molecular sieve modified by sodium alkoxide and/or potassium alkoxide, wherein the silicon-titanium ratio of the modified titanium silicalite molecular sieve is 30-150. The catalyst Ni-P/TS-1 is used in the reaction of synthesizing propylene oxide by propylene gas-phase epoxidation, and the catalytic activity is higher.

title_en: Cable bridge with high compressive and bending strength
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cable bridge with high compressive bending strength, which belongs to the field of cable bridges, wherein the cable bridge with high compressive bending strength can swing left and right through the top end of a snow shaking component under the influence of wind power, so as to carry out reciprocating knocking on the cable bridge, avoid accumulating snow on the cable bridge, and simultaneously stir a drain hole under the reciprocating swinging of the bottom end of the snow shaking component, avoid the accumulated snow water from freezing at low temperature to block the drain hole.

title_en: Slime regulator in zinc oxide ore and ammonium sulfide flotation process and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slime regulator in the flotation process of zinc oxide ore and ammonium sulfide and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the field of flotation of nonferrous metal oxidized ores and comprising the following raw materials: metal salt solution, water glass solution, polyacrylic acid polymer solution and polymaleic acid. The preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) Stirring and mixing the metal salt solution and the water glass solution to obtain a solution A; (2) Stirring and mixing the polyacrylic acid solution or the sodium polyacrylate solution and polymaleic anhydride to obtain a solution B; (3) And mixing the solution A and the solution B, stirring, and performing ultrasonic dispersion to obtain the zinc oxide ore and amine sulfide flotation slime regulator. The conditioning agent provided by the invention has good adaptability, stable property and good dispersibility, can effectively eliminate adverse effects of slime in the flotation process of zinc oxide ores, reduces foam stability, ensures smooth flotation process, and greatly improves zinc recovery indexes.

title_en: Soft magnetic stainless steel product separation equipment
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide soft magnetic stainless steel product separation equipment which comprises an edge removing device, wherein the edge removing device comprises a trough, a first mounting rack, a belt, a first motor, a roller, a second mounting rack, a first spring and a polishing belt assembly, and soft magnetic stainless steel products can be preliminarily separated by polishing; the pulling device comprises a third mounting frame, a sliding groove, a second motor, a crankshaft, a first connecting plate, a first sliding rod, a first electromagnet, a third spring, a second connecting plate, a second sliding rod, a second electromagnet and a sliding sleeve, and soft magnetic stainless steel products can be separated by up-and-down magnetic force traction; the vibrating device comprises a first spring, a crankshaft, a limiting plate and a balancing weight, and can assist in separation of soft magnetic stainless steel products through vibration.

title_en: Pipeline paint spraying apparatus for architectural decoration engineering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pipeline paint spraying device for architectural decoration engineering, which comprises: the device comprises a base, a pipe clamping mechanism and a protection component; the pipe clamping mechanism comprises a first motor and a transmission rod, two threaded rods with different rotation directions are connected to the transmission rod, first sliding blocks are connected to the two threaded rods, a fixed rod is arranged on each first sliding block, and a clamping block is arranged on each fixed rod; the protection assembly comprises a protection cover sleeved on the outer ring of the clamping block, the protection cover is a rectangular box body with openings at two ends, the left side and the right side of the upper inner side wall and the right side of the lower inner side wall of the protection cover are respectively provided with a fixed plate, each fixed plate is also provided with a telescopic plate, the outer side walls of the two telescopic plates close to the transmission rod are provided with a first telescopic rod, the other end of the first telescopic rod is also connected with a second sliding block, and the two second sliding blocks are respectively in threaded connection with the two sections of external threads on the upper side of the transmission rod; the paint spraying equipment can clamp and spray paint on pipes with different diameters, and can effectively prevent paint mist from floating in the surrounding air.

title_en: Automatic assembling system and method for optical lens
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic optical lens assembling system and method, belonging to the technical field of head-up display optical lens assembling; the system comprises an automatic measuring system, an automatic sorting system, an automatic calculation auxiliary matching, a grabbing mechanism, a multi-axis motion system, a vision system, a control system and an upper computer system; the assembly method comprises the steps of automatically measuring the size parameters of a batch of parts by a grabbing system and a measuring system, then automatically selecting and calculating according to a mathematical model and an optimal algorithm to obtain the matching combination of the parts, automatically grabbing and assembling according to the combination by a multi-axis motion system, and finally automatically gluing and screwing. The system and the method can solve the problems of low efficiency and poor consistency caused by repeated trial assembly of the existing lens, and can reduce the risks of accidental scratches and redundant objects in the assembly process.

title_en: Preparation method of chlorofluoropyridine ester
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of chlorofluoropyridine ester, which does not need to use expensive palladium catalyst and toxic and environment-unfriendly phosphine ligand, adopts a novel copper catalyst system, and uses copper catalyst, N-containing ligand and phase transfer catalyst as a catalyst system, so that chlorofluoropyridine ester can be obtained in high yield and high purity, and can be amplified to kilogram level, thereby being more suitable for industrial production.

title_en: Preparation method of electrochemical self-cleaning conductive composite membrane and water treatment application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and water treatment application of an electrochemical self-cleaning conductive composite membrane, which comprises the following steps: preparing a precursor: dispersing the graphene quantum dots and the carbon nano material in a solvent, adding aniline and concentrated hydrochloric acid in an ice bath, slowly adding an ammonium persulfate-hydrochloric acid solution into the solution, reacting in an ice bath, and separating and drying to obtain precursor powder; (2) preparing a conductive composite film: dispersing precursor powder and sodium dodecyl benzene sulfonate in water to obtain precursor dispersion liquid; and carrying out suction filtration treatment on the surface of the organic base film, fixing the precursor and the cross-linking agent on the base film, then immersing the obtained film into a glutaraldehyde-hydrochloric acid solution for cross-linking, and finally taking out and drying to obtain the conductive composite film. The conductive composite membrane has higher non-Faraday capacitance, is favorable for improving electrostatic repulsion force to charged pollutants, and can be used for water treatment and other membrane separation/resource recovery applications.

title_en: Oxygen-enriched vacancy Bi12O17Cl2Ultrathin nanosheets, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an oxygen-enriched vacancy Bi  12 O 17 Cl 2  ultrathin nanosheet and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of inorganic functional materials. According to the invention, the Bi  12 O 17 Cl 2  material is constructed through the combined action of the bismuth-rich strategy and the defect engineering, so that the polarization electric field of the material is promoted to be increased, and active oxygen species are increased, and the Bi  12 O 17 Cl 2  material shows excellent photocatalytic performance. The preparation of the Bi  12 O 17 Cl 2  material specifically comprises the following steps: bismuth nitrate pentahydrate, polyvinylpyrrolidone and mannitol are dissolved in deionized water, then saturated sodium chloride solution and 1, 3-propylene diamine are added for hydrothermal reaction, and the obtained product is washed and freeze-dried to prepare the Bi  12 O 17 Cl 2  material. The Bi  12 O 17 Cl 2  material has good photocatalytic degradation performance and wide application range, has a degradation rate of 99.9% for methyl orange, cresol red, bromocresol green, methyl red and rhodamine B, has a degradation rate of 93.1% for bisphenol A, and has good practical application value.

title_en: High-temperature gas-solid in-situ sum frequency spectrum reaction tank
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-temperature gas-solid in-situ sum frequency spectrum reaction tank, which comprises a reaction tank body, a cover plate, a sample table and an integrated heating furnace, wherein the cover plate is arranged on the reaction tank body; the reaction tank body is provided with an opening; the cover plate covers the opening of the reaction tank body and encloses an inner space with the reaction tank body; the sample table is arranged in the reaction tank body and is used for fixing a sample; the integral heating furnace ring is arranged at the periphery of the sample table and is used for heating the sample; the integral heating furnace is externally connected with a temperature control box through a heating electrode interface, and the heating electrode interface is arranged on the reaction tank body. The high-temperature gas-solid in-situ sum frequency spectrum reaction tank is provided with the integrated heating furnace, so that a high-temperature environment can be provided for a sample, the sample can complete a high-temperature gas-solid phase catalytic reaction, in-situ characterization of a gas-solid two-phase interface under the high-temperature environment is realized, the normal-temperature test limitation of the existing in-situ reaction tank is broken through, and the application of the sum frequency spectrum in-situ characterization technology in gas-solid phase catalytic reaction research is widened.

title_en: Millstone fluidization device of medium-speed coal mill
abstract_en: The invention provides a millstone fluidization device of a medium-speed coal mill, which relates to the technical field of vulcanizing devices and comprises a device main body, a fluidization mechanism and a grinding mechanism, wherein a coal dropping pipe is vertically and rotatably connected to the middle position of the top of the device main body, a rotary joint is arranged at one end of a fluidization air pipe, which is close to a hot air blower, a screen is arranged in an inner cavity of the device main body, the coal dropping pipe penetrates through the center position of the screen, a collecting plate is fixedly connected to the outer side wall of the coal dropping pipe and is positioned above the screen, and a collecting box is arranged at the right end of the screen; and the grinding mechanism is designed, and the grinding roller is pushed to move along the inclined plane through the support rod by utilizing the rotation of the grinding pipe, so that the grinding effect is improved, more coal dust in the grinding groove can be blown up by the fluidization wind, and the integral fluidization effect is improved.

title_en: Industrial stacking robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of industrial production, in particular to an industrial stacking robot which comprises a conveying frame, wherein one end of the conveying frame is provided with an upper goods shelf, a conveying roller shaft is arranged in the conveying frame, two position correcting clamping plates are symmetrically arranged above the conveying roller shaft, the other surfaces of the position correcting clamping plates are provided with clamping springs, the other end of the conveying frame is provided with a position correcting frame, and telescopic columns are symmetrically arranged in the position correcting frame. This industry pile up neatly machine people can be when the material is in the position correcting frame, the flexible post of both sides can start, make the displacement of position correcting plate the same, near the axis of material calibration at the position correcting frame, the distancer measures its distance apart from two position correcting plates, the distance equals then must not recalibrate again, the distance varies then flexible post can recalibrate again, let the initial position of material the same, can not be different because of the initial position of material like this, the deviation appears in the final position that leads to the pile up neatly, the effect of pile up neatly has been influenced.

title_en: Kiwi fruit collecting device and method
abstract_en: A device and a method for the Chinese gooseberry all-in-one collection, wherein the device for the Chinese gooseberry all-in-one collection comprises: a frame; a controller; the shearing mechanism is arranged at the top of the rack and comprises a crank connecting rod, a cutter bar and a cutter knife, and the crank connecting rod is respectively connected with the cutter bar and the driving motor; the fruit combing mechanism is arranged below the shearing structure and comprises a connecting shaft and combing teeth, the connecting shaft is arranged on the rack, the combing teeth are correspondingly arranged below the cutting knife, and a fruit guiding groove is formed between every two adjacent combing teeth; the fruit collecting mechanism comprises an upper fruit collecting groove and a lower fruit collecting groove which are respectively provided with fruit sliding openings, the upper fruit collecting groove is arranged on the rack below the fruit combing mechanism, and the lower fruit collecting groove is obliquely arranged on the rack; the weighing sensor is arranged in the lower fruit collecting groove corresponding to the fruit sliding opening of the upper fruit collecting groove and is connected with the controller; the fruit unloading mechanism comprises a fruit groove and an electromagnetic fruit unloading door arranged at the bottom of the fruit groove; and the fruit box is arranged below the electromagnetic fruit unloading door. The invention also discloses a kiwi fruit collecting method.

title_en: Preparation method of mass lunar soil water ice samples for scientific load efficiency test
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a large-batch lunar soil water ice sample for scientific load efficiency test, and belongs to the field of space exploration. The problem that the traditional preparation method of the steam condensate ice can not eliminate the interference of water vapor factors in the air is solved. It comprises the following steps: s1: preparing a certain mass of raw materials of the plagioclase and the basalt according to mineral components of real lunar soil; s2: mixing the plagioclase and the basalt according to a certain proportion and uniformly mixing; s3: precooling the stirring equipment, exhausting gas in the stirring equipment, and drying the preparation raw materials; s4: checking whether the dried raw materials are completely dried; s5: cooling the completely dried raw materials to a certain temperature and introducing water vapor; s6: uniformly stirring the completely dried raw materials after cooling in a constant low temperature environment by using stirring equipment; s7: and pre-cooling the communicating cavity, introducing low-temperature atmosphere, and evacuating the communicating cavity to obtain the lunar soil water ice raw material with the corresponding water content. The method is mainly used for preparing the steam-condensed ice simulated lunar soil.

title_en: Preparation process of elastic folded fabric
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation process of elastic folded fabric, which comprises the following steps: sequentially preparing a prefabricated shrink film, a porous foaming shrink film and a heat-shrinkable fabric; adding the heat-shrinkable fabric into an oven at the temperature of 70-90 ℃ for heat preservation, then adding the heat-shrinkable fabric into a wrinkling machine for wrinkling in a rolling and wrinkling way, washing the heat-shrinkable fabric with water, keeping the moisture content of 8-15wt%, and sending the heat-shrinkable fabric into a setting machine preheated to 120-160 ℃ for setting; and clamping the shaped fabric in a mold, preheating a crumpling machine at the temperature of 180-200 ℃, crumpling, adding into a roller coating printing machine, and printing the surface of the treated fabric in a roller transfer printing mode to obtain the elastic crumpled fabric. According to the invention, the fabric is subjected to the wrinkle effect through the heat shrinkage treatment, the fancy wrinkle textures are formed on the surface, meanwhile, the water washing resistance of the wrinkle fabric is strong, the wrinkle pattern is still maintained after washing, and the quality of the wrinkle fabric is improved.

title_en: Water mark processing system and operation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of aluminum surface treatment equipment, in particular to a water mark treatment system and an operation method thereof, wherein the water mark treatment system comprises a cooling unit, a blowing-off unit, an excitation unit, a suction unit and a swing unit, the cooling unit can cool aluminum materials after high-temperature sealing, the blowing unit can blow off the water liquid on the aluminum material, the excitation unit can enable the hidden water liquid of the aluminum material to overflow through high-frequency vibration, the sucking unit can suck the water liquid on the aluminum material, and the swing unit can swing and move the aluminum material. The operation method comprises the steps of firstly cooling the aluminum material after high-temperature sealing, swinging and draining, forcefully blowing surface water liquid, overflowing hidden water liquid by high-frequency vibration, sucking residual water liquid by negative pressure suction, the invention can make the water liquid on the surface and inside of the sealed aluminum material overflow fully through the forced means and be removed by suction without manual subsequent treatment, thereby avoiding residual water mark of the sealed aluminum material and improving the product quality and the working efficiency.

title_en: Traditional chinese medicine decoction piece drying equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a traditional Chinese medicine decoction piece drying device, which relates to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicine decoction piece processing and comprises: a drying box; a control box is fixedly arranged on the side wall of the right end of the drying box; two blowers are embedded in the upper end of the drying box; the lower end of the drying box is transversely and fixedly provided with a draining and air exchanging box; and a reciprocating motor is fixedly arranged in the middle of the front end of the top plane of the drying box. The invention ensures the uniform drying degree of the medicinal material slices, reduces the problem of damage of the medicinal material slices caused by uneven drying, solves the problem that the storage of the traditional Chinese medicine decoction pieces is partially damaged due to uneven drying in the traditional Chinese medicine decoction piece drying process, and the uneven drying is caused by the fact that the contact surface of the traditional Chinese medicine decoction pieces cannot be dried, and meanwhile, the traditional Chinese medicine decoction pieces are usually placed in an oven in the drying process, are taken out after being dried once, are dried in the next batch, and are difficult to realize the quick drying operation of the assembly line and the problem of low drying efficiency.

title_en: Preparation method for rectifying and recycling waste liquid of cleaning agent
abstract_en: The preparation method comprises the steps of feeding a tower, wherein the top of the feeding tower is connected with the outer side surface of a first rectifying tower, a first connecting pipe is arranged on the outer side surface of the first rectifying tower, the bottom of the first rectifying tower is connected with a second rectifying tower and is provided with a second connecting pipe, the bottom of the second rectifying tower is connected with a third rectifying tower and is provided with a third connecting pipe, the bottom of the third rectifying tower is connected with a fourth rectifying tower and is provided with a fourth connecting pipe, and the bottom of the fourth rectifying tower is provided with a discharge pipe; according to the method, raw materials are guided into the feeding tower through the feeding pipe to conduct fine rectification operation in the mode, so that the product quality is guaranteed, and the operation efficiency is improved.

title_en: Burr-free aperture stop production device and production method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of optical facilities and processing methods thereof, and discloses a burr-free aperture production device and a burr-free aperture production method, which solve the problems that the aperture is directly placed in drying equipment for drying, the aperture is unevenly dried due to stacking together, so that the drying time is longer, the working efficiency is reduced, and the drying effect is poor; when the diaphragm is placed in a suspended mode, the diaphragm can rotate, so that all parts of the diaphragm are dried more uniformly, drying efficiency is improved, and drying time is shortened.

title_en: Energy-saving self-circulation water mountain pit spiral shell breeding system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy-saving self-circulation water mountain pit spiral cultivating system, which comprises a cultivating tail water treatment pool, a cultivating pool and a water pumping pool which are sequentially arranged from high to low and are sequentially communicated, wherein a water pump is arranged in the water pumping pool, and the output end of the water pump is communicated with the cultivating tail water treatment pool through a pipeline; the culture pond comprises a plurality of culture areas which are distributed longitudinally and/or transversely, the adjacent culture areas are separated by a separation belt, the separation belt is provided with water through holes, the bottom of the culture area is provided with an oxygenation pipe and a bottom layer, and the oxygenation pipe is used for being connected with an external oxygenation device. The cultivation tail water treatment pool, the cultivation pool and the water pumping pool which are sequentially connected from high to low in topography are arranged, the cultivation water is kept circulating among the cultivation tail water treatment pool, the cultivation pool and the water pumping pool by utilizing the water pumping pump, micro-flowing water required by healthy growth of the mountain pit snails is manufactured, and the requirement of the mountain pit snail growth on high-dissolved oxygen water quality is met.

title_en: Antibacterial comfortable graphene fabric and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fabric production, in particular to an antibacterial comfortable graphene fabric and a preparation method thereof; the graphene fabric is made of the following fiber materials in parts by weight: 30-45 parts of functional graphene fibers, 13-20 parts of cotton fibers, 15-23 parts of ramie fibers and 7-10 parts of silk fibers; the fabric prepared by the invention has good antistatic performance and antibacterial performance; in addition, functional graphene fibers, cotton fibers, ramie fibers and silk fibers are used as raw materials in the preparation method, so that the touch feeling and the comfort performance of the prepared graphene fabric are effectively guaranteed.

title_en: Water storage tank capable of changing water quality for vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a water storage container, in particular to a vehicular water storage tank capable of changing water quality. The invention provides a water storage tank for a vehicle, which can change water quality. The utility model provides a can change automobile-used storage water tank of quality of water, includes the storage water tank, and the lower right part of storage water tank is from taking the water valve, still includes filtering mechanism and rabbling mechanism, is equipped with filtering mechanism on the storage water tank, is equipped with rabbling mechanism on the filtering mechanism. According to the invention, the water in the water storage tank can be filtered through the upward movement of the filter screen, the purpose of changing the water quality is achieved, an external filter element is not needed, the operation is simple, meanwhile, the stirring frame rotates positively and negatively, the water above the filter screen can be stirred, and the filter screen is assisted to filter the water, so that the filtering effect is better.

title_en: Method for preparing carboxylic acid by oxidative cracking of olefin
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for preparing carboxylic acid by oxidizing and cracking olefin, which comprises the following steps of enabling an olefin compound to be in contact with a catalyst to carry out an oxidizing and cracking reaction under an oxygen condition, wherein the catalyst is a composite catalytic material, the composite catalytic material comprises a framework heteroatom molecular sieve and metal elements M dispersed in crystals of the molecular sieve, the framework heteroatom molecular sieve is a molecular sieve in which at least part of silicon in a framework of an all-silicon molecular sieve is replaced by heteroatom element Q, and the heteroatom element Q is one or more selected from titanium, boron, zirconium, tin, aluminum, phosphorus and germanium. The method uses the metal-containing hierarchical pore molecular sieve for the olefin oxygen oxidation cracking reaction process, and can obtain high olefin conversion rate and carboxylic acid (dicarboxylic acid) selectivity at a lower temperature.

title_en: Device for protecting circular flange machining surface of marine diesel engine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flange processing surface protection devices, and discloses a device for protecting a circular flange processing surface of a marine diesel engine, which comprises a flange body, wherein rubber sleeves are respectively arranged on two sides of the flange body, an M12 bolt is screwed on the middle part of the left side of the flange body in a threaded manner, an M12 bolt is screwed on the upper part and the lower part of the right side of the flange body in a threaded manner, and protection sheets are respectively arranged on the top ends of the M12 bolts in a threaded manner. The M12 bolts additionally arranged penetrate through the two protection sheets and are screwed up by the screw hole cylindrical blocks in the flange inner diameter holes, so that the protection sheets are tightly attached to the machining surfaces of the two flanges, the damage to the flanges can be reduced to the greatest extent by the installation mode, the procedures of cleaning paint and removing steel shots in the flange screw holes are eliminated on the basis that the assembly and welding of the parts are not affected and the size and roughness of the parts are guaranteed, and the product quality can be improved and the cost can be saved.

title_en: Ultraviolet curing light source convenient to quick heat dissipation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ultraviolet light sources, in particular to an ultraviolet curing light source convenient for rapid heat dissipation. The invention relates to an ultraviolet curing light source convenient for rapid heat dissipation, which comprises: the support frame is of a frame structure and is fixed above a production assembly line; the protection box is fixed at the upper end of the support frame, the interior of the protection box is hollow, the curing light source is fixed in the protection box, and the curing light source faces the production line; the two radiating parts are respectively fixed at two ends of the protection box, and the air outlets of the radiating parts face the outer wall of the curing light source; wherein the heat dissipation part is suitable for blowing air to the outer wall of the curing light source so as to dissipate heat of the curing light source; the movable end of the heat dissipation part moves circumferentially to clean dust on the outer wall of the heat dissipation part. Through the setting of radiating part, the radiating effect of fixed phone light source has been accelerated, dust on the filter screen can be cleared up simultaneously, the life of fixed phone light source has been improved.

title_en: Method for preparing epoxy cyclic hydrocarbon
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a process for the preparation of an epoxy-containing cyclic hydrocarbon, which process comprises: contacting a cycloolefin with an oxidant in the presence of a titanium-containing catalyst to perform an oxidation reaction; the titanium-containing catalyst is prepared by the following steps of (1) placing a first conductive object and a second conductive object in electrolyte containing inorganic acid, and electrolyzing for 2-10 days at a voltage of 30-100V to obtain electrolytic mixed solution; (2) Mixing the electrolytic mixed solution, the organosilicate and the block copolymer, and maintaining at 50-100 ℃ for 2-24 hours to obtain a first mixture; (3) Mixing the first mixture, the titanium source and hydrogen peroxide, maintaining at 60-90 ℃ for 1-10 hours, performing hydrothermal treatment on the obtained second mixture, taking out the solid, and drying and roasting. The titanium-containing catalyst prepared by the method has better reactivity, and can be used for the oxidation reaction of cycloolefin to improve the conversion rate of raw materials and the selectivity of target products.

title_en: Chemical material mixing device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a chemical material mixing device, which belongs to the technical field of chemical production and comprises a storage tank, wherein a feed pipe is arranged at the top of the storage tank, a discharge pipe is arranged at the bottom of the storage tank, a second mixing mechanism for heating and mixing materials is arranged at the bottom of the storage tank, a first mixing mechanism for heating and mixing materials and for driving the second mixing mechanism is arranged at the top of the storage tank, the first mixing mechanism comprises a hollow transmission pipe, a plurality of hollow mixing plates are arranged at the bottom of the hollow transmission pipe, and a protective shell corresponding to the storage tank is rotatably connected at the top of the hollow transmission pipe; the invention has simple structure and convenient use, and can quickly and fully mix materials without dead angles by mutually matching a plurality of structures when in use, so that the mixing effect of the mixing device on the materials is better.

title_en: Production method of safe and comfortable low-formaldehyde lining cloth
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production method of a safe and comfortable low-formaldehyde lining cloth, which comprises the following steps of S1: making lining cloth; s2: the lining cloth is pretreated, and the pretreatment process comprises the following steps: s3: shrink-proof finishing; s4, hot melt powder point coating: carrying out powder point coating on the lining cloth by adopting hot melt adhesive and through an engraving roller and an oil hot roller; the pretreatment process of the lining cloth, which comprises padding hot water padding, high-efficiency wide-temperature starch desizing enzyme, stacking for 24 hours at room temperature, high-temperature water washing at 90-95 ℃, padding scouring liquid, steaming at 100-102 ℃ for 70 minutes, and high-temperature water washing at 90-95 ℃, can achieve the treatment effects of desizing, refining thoroughly and high-wool effect, and is beneficial to the low formaldehyde resin to penetrate into the fiber and fully crosslink with the fiber; the padding cloth is padded by adopting the resin finishing liquid composed of the ultralow formaldehyde resin FIR, magnesium chloride, ethylene urea and JFC penetrating agent, and is matched with the subsequent hot melt powder point coating, so that the formaldehyde release amount of the padding cloth can be greatly reduced, and the safety and the comfort of the padding cloth are improved.

title_en: Online drying system for paperboard production
abstract_en: The invention discloses an online drying system for paperboard production, and relates to the technical field of paperboard production. The on-line drying system comprises a channel for passing through the paperboard, and a drying mechanism is arranged in the channel; the channel comprises two rectangular frames positioned at two ends, and an upper top plate and a lower bottom plate are arranged between the two rectangular frames; a pair of side plates are symmetrically arranged between the upper top plate and the lower bottom plate, and the side plates can move along the advancing direction of the vertical paper plate; the drying mechanism comprises a drying lamp A and/or a spray head A arranged on the inner wall of the channel. According to the invention, the channel for penetrating through the paperboard is arranged on the paperboard production line, and the drying mechanism comprising the drying lamp A and the spray head is arranged in the channel, so that the paperboard is dried by respectively illuminating and blowing by using the drying lamp A and the spray head when in use, and the online drying in the paperboard production process is realized.

title_en: Circular accelerator and particle beam therapy system
abstract_en: The invention provides a circular accelerator and a particle beam therapy system which can irradiate high-current and high-quality beams and have low cost. The circular accelerator accelerates a beam of charged particles circulating in a magnetic field so as to eccentrically form a closed-loop orbit of each energy of the beam, and is provided with a beam emission port from which beams of different energies are emitted from the closed-loop orbit, a first deflection electromagnet (21) and a second deflection electromagnet (22) for deflecting the beams emitted from the beam emission port, and a control unit (40 a) for controlling excitation amounts of the first deflection electromagnet and the second deflection electromagnet in accordance with the energy of the emitted beams, wherein the control unit (40 a) excites both the first deflection electromagnet (21) and the second deflection electromagnet (22) to deflect the beams when the energy of the emitted beams is the maximum energy of the circular accelerator (1) in terms of design.

title_en: Material mixing device
abstract_en: The invention provides a material mixing device, which relates to the technical field of material mixing, and comprises: support, outer barrel, interior barrel and transfer line are provided with conveying mechanism on the support, outer barrel installs on the support, outer barrel top opening, and the bottom is the toper structure, the relief valve is installed to the bottom, interior barrel installs inside outer barrel, restrict out first cavity between interior barrel and the outer barrel, first cavity top has the feed inlet, supply conveying mechanism to send into in the first cavity with the material, first cavity below has the discharge gate, the discharge gate communicates with outer barrel bottom, and the discharge gate has and opens and close two kinds of states, transfer line installs in interior barrel, restrict out the second cavity between interior barrel and the transfer line, still be provided with the auger in the transfer line. The invention has the beneficial effects that: can realize abundant mixing to the material, the device loading rate is high simultaneously, and the energy consumption is also lower.

title_en: Pomegranate threshing machine and threshing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pomegranate threshing machine and a threshing method, wherein the threshing machine comprises a feed inlet arranged at the uppermost layer, a notch which is used for aligning with a pomegranate rhizome is formed in the feed inlet, the notch can be clamped into the pomegranate rhizome and is convenient for fixing the direction of the pomegranate, the feed inlet is arranged on an upper layer cover plate, an upper layer pomegranate guide plate is arranged below the upper layer cover plate, a conveying and cutting device is arranged below the upper layer cover plate, the upper layer cover plate is connected with the conveying and cutting device through an upper layer supporting rod, a threshing and waste material treatment device is arranged below the conveying and cutting device, and a filtering and collecting device is arranged at the bottom of the threshing and waste material treatment device. The device combines a plurality of functions of cutting, threshing, waste treatment, pomegranate seed collection and the like of the pomegranates, does not need manual threshing by workers, reduces labor cost and shortens the threshing time of the pomegranates.

title_en: Titanium dioxide-bismuth tungstate heterojunction photocatalyst and application thereof in degradation of patulin in fruit juice
abstract_en: The invention discloses a titanium dioxide-bismuth tungstate heterojunction photocatalyst and application thereof in degrading patulin in fruit juice. Firstly, bismuth nitrate and sodium tungstate are reacted to form a bismuth tungstate precursor, and then titanium dioxide is added for compounding, so that bismuth tungstate grows on the surface of titanium dioxide in situ, and a titanium dioxide-bismuth tungstate heterojunction photocatalyst is formed. The invention uses a one-pot hydrothermal method, the process method is simple, and when the constructed heterojunction catalyst is used for degrading the patulin in the juice, compared with bismuth tungstate and titanium dioxide monomers, the photocatalytic activity of the composite catalyst is obviously improved.

title_en: Flaky porous iridium oxide catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a flaky porous iridium oxide catalyst, which comprises the following steps: mixing an iridium source and metal salt in an alcohol/water solution uniformly to obtain a mixed solution, removing a solvent, and then directly calcining at a high temperature to obtain a flaky porous iridium oxide nano material; the metal salt comprises one or more of carbonate and bicarbonate. The preparation method provided by the invention is simple and feasible, safe, green, high in yield, flexible in precursor selection and beneficial to industrial production; meanwhile, the synthesis method has high expansibility in preparing the flaky nano oxide material, and provides a new preparation way for the application of the nano oxide in the fields of catalysis, energy sources, environment and the like.

title_en: Cleaning method for range hood cleaning system
abstract_en: The invention provides a cleaning method for a range hood cleaning system, and belongs to the field of kitchen appliances. The cleaning method comprises the steps of detecting the water level of a water tank, starting a water inlet pump to draw water into the water tank when the water level does not reach a preset high water level, closing the water inlet pump when the water level reaches the preset high water level, introducing water of the water tank into a heater, opening a heating pipe, keeping a drainage pump closed to heat water in the heater, closing the heating pipe when a water temperature probe detects that the water temperature reaches a preset temperature value, introducing hot water into a range hood to clean, closing the drainage pump when the water level of the water tank is detected to be lower than a preset low water level, and repeating the steps until the water in a water storage device is used up. The cleaning method can produce hot water for cleaning according to the water level, namely, dry burning of a heating pipe is avoided, scale is not generated, the service life of the heater is greatly prolonged, and the high-temperature and high-pressure hot water can be generated for cleaning the range hood.

title_en: Section bar bending machine convenient to adapt to different sizes
abstract_en: The invention discloses a profile bending machine convenient to adapt to different sizes, which relates to the technical field of profile bending and comprises a profile bending mechanism, wherein the profile bending mechanism comprises a fixing plate, a profile bending device, a manufacturing plate, a collecting box, a first bending block and a second bending block, the inner top of the fixing plate is fixedly connected with the top of the profile bending device, the bottom of the fixing plate is fixedly connected with the collecting box, the inner wall of the fixing plate is fixedly connected with the bottom of the manufacturing plate, the outer wall of the manufacturing plate is fixedly connected with the two ends of the two second bending blocks, the profile bending device is fixedly connected with the top of the first bending block through the bottom of a telescopic rod, and the profile bending device is fixedly connected with an airflow flowing mechanism through the outer wall of the telescopic rod.

title_en: Celery seed extract, preparation method thereof and application thereof in uric acid reduction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a celery seed extract, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in uric acid reduction, wherein celery seed powder is subjected to enzymolysis by adopting enzyme, extraction auxiliary agents are added to obtain filter residues and filtrate, the filter residues are subjected to reflux extraction by adopting ethyl acetate, then ethanol aqueous solution is adopted to extract under alkaline environment, and finally the filtrate is subjected to macroporous resin, ethanol aqueous solution elution, concentration and drying to obtain the celery seed extract. Compared with the prior art, the celery seed extract prepared by the invention has better uric acid reducing effect under alkaline process conditions, can effectively control uric acid and reduce weight, and has low dosage and lower toxic and side effects under the same dosage.

title_en: Photovoltaic power station cleaning method and system based on transfer trolley
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic power station cleaning method and system based on a transfer vehicle, wherein the method comprises the steps of receiving a cleaning task sent by a background, driving the transfer vehicle to carry a cleaning machine to move to a target array position based on the cleaning task, sending a cleaning instruction to the cleaning machine, judging whether wireless communication connection between the transfer vehicle and the cleaning machine is normal or not, enabling a first approaching unit arranged on the cleaning machine to leave the transfer vehicle to start cleaning after receiving a cleaning signal through adjusting a first sensing structure arranged on the transfer vehicle if the wireless communication connection is abnormal, and sensing whether the cleaning machine returns to the transfer vehicle through a second approaching unit arranged on the transfer vehicle after the cleaning of the cleaning machine is finished, wherein the second sensing structure is arranged on the cleaning machine, and driving the transfer vehicle to travel to a next target array after determining that the cleaning machine returns. The invention can normally work when the transfer trolley and the cleaning machine are not smooth in communication.

title_en: Waste water treatment device for food processing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wastewater treatment devices, in particular to a wastewater treatment device for food processing, which comprises a wastewater treatment box, wherein two sunken grooves are formed in the upper end of one side of the wastewater treatment box, the two sunken grooves are symmetrically distributed at two ends of the wastewater treatment box, a residue collecting box is fixedly arranged on the other side of the wastewater treatment box opposite to the sunken grooves, when cleaning of a residue filter plate is required, an electric telescopic rod is started to drive the residue filter plate to move downwards until an oblique cambered surface inserting block is inserted into a connecting slot, a filter Kong Dingzhu is inserted into a filter hole at the moment to eject residues clamped in the filter hole, and then the electric telescopic rod is started to drive the residue filter plate to move upwards, so that a residue cleaning baffle is driven to move and the residues on the residue filter plate can be pushed to the residue collecting box to be collected, and manual cleaning of the residue filter plate is very convenient.

title_en: Uniform liquid mixing device and method for biological detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a liquid homogenizing and mixing device and method for biological detection, and relates to the field of liquid mixing, and the device comprises a base frame, a stirring barrel is arranged on the base frame, a liquid inlet port is arranged on a sealing cover, a liquid outlet port is arranged on the stirring barrel, a stirring mechanism is arranged inside the stirring barrel, the stirring frame rotates around a rotating shaft under the installation effect of a rotating shaft and a moving sleeve to realize primary rotation stirring, the stirring frame rotates around the rotating gear under the meshing connection effect of the rotating gear and a gear bar to realize secondary rotation stirring, the stirring frame moves up and down under the guiding effect of a guide groove to realize tertiary movement stirring, various detection liquids inside the stirring barrel are fully mixed and stirred, a closing plate is used for closing and opening a ventilation notch through the elastic force of a connecting strip and a spring to prevent the detection liquids from leaking, and the detection liquids are oxygenated and stirred and reinforced through a gas transmission pipe and the ventilation notch.

title_en: Logistics sorting coarse separation equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides logistics sorting coarse separation equipment, which relates to the field of logistics equipment and comprises a sorting table, wherein a conveying groove is formed in the top of the sorting table, a conveying belt is arranged on the left side of the sorting table, a first chute and a second chute are symmetrically arranged on the right side of the sorting table, and detection modules are arranged on the front side and the rear side of the conveying belt. This commodity circulation letter sorting coarse separation equipment sets up letter sorting platform, conveyer belt, detection module, is equipped with Y transportation groove on the letter sorting platform, separately transports glass cup goods, difficult fragile goods. Through arc pinion rack, motor half gear and gasbag cooperation, make the conveyer belt slightly vibrate, accept the sound of the slight collision of glass through audio monitoring module to discern the goods. Through the cooperation of the tension monitor, the elastic rope and the small electric push rod, the goods placement position is regulated and controlled. Thus, no staff is required to put the device deliberately. Through adapter sleeve, bull stick, buffer board, lug, spring coupling, the effect of buffering is played to fragile goods whereabouts.

title_en: Method for harmless recovery of copper and germanium from high-iron high-copper solution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for harmless recovery of copper and germanium from a high-iron high-copper solution, which comprises the following steps: the slag of the primary neutral leaching of the zinc hydrometallurgy zinc roasting ore is subjected to secondary low-acid leaching, the slag of the secondary low-acid leaching liquid-solid separation is subjected to tertiary high-temperature high-acid leaching to recover valuable metals zinc, copper and germanium, lead-silver concentrate is produced and sold to lead and silver, and the liquor after the tertiary high-temperature high-acid leaching contains sulfuric acid, iron, copper, zinc and germanium, the iron is mainly ferric iron, and the solution is a high-iron and high-copper solution. The invention is completed by one step of neutralizing acid and reducing ferric iron, realizes the selective reduction, displacement and separation of copper and germanium, and has high recovery rate of valuable metals and low cost. No new waste water, waste gas and waste residue are generated in the process, and green production can be realized.

title_en: Filtering method for rolling oil of battery aluminum foil rolling mill
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rolling oil filtration of aluminum foil rolling mills, and discloses a method for filtering rolling oil of a battery aluminum foil rolling mill. The method comprises the following steps: (1) Putting diatomite and activated clay into a stirring box, wherein the diatomite accounts for 55-60 parts by weight and the activated clay accounts for 40-45 parts by weight based on 100 parts by weight of the total weight of the diatomite and the activated clay; (2) Adding rolling oil into a stirring box, stirring and mixing the rolling oil, the diatomite and the activated clay, adopting a plate filter, setting parameters, and performing soil suction for 7-12 s with an intermediate interval of 12-21 s; (3) rolling, and replacing filter paper after 10-16 h. The adoption of the plate filter has the advantages that the soil sucking time is short, the middle interval time is long, the clay adsorption capacity is improved, the adsorption of trace elements of rolling oil is enhanced, and the defects of black strips and the like on the surface of an aluminum foil manufactured by rolling a lithium battery shell are effectively prevented.

title_en: Sigma phase catalyst and method for synthesizing single-walled carbon nanotubes with high selectivity
abstract_en: The invention provides a Sigma phase catalyst and a method for synthesizing single-walled carbon nanotubes with high selectivity, which relate to the technical field of nanomaterial synthesis and comprise the following steps: calcining basic magnesium carbonate to obtain magnesium oxide; dissolving magnesium oxide obtained by calcination in deionized water, respectively adding rhenium trichloride and manganese nitrate, and uniformly stirring; drying and grinding the uniformly stirred solution; calcining the ground powder to obtain a catalyst; catalytic growth of SWNTs by CVD using a catalyst; the magnesium oxide is used as a substrate and a catalyst carrier, has the advantages of easy preparation, low price, good thermal stability and large specific surface area, can be removed by reaction with hydrochloric acid with weaker acidity, and reduces the damage of SWNTs to the minimum.

title_en: Method for catalyzing and desulfurizing amphiphilic cobalt phthalocyanine and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for catalyzing and removing organic sulfur by using water/oil amphiphilic cobalt phthalocyanine and application thereof, wherein AEO-7 cobalt phthalocyanine is used as a catalyst, oxygen in air is used as an oxidant according to the structure and catalytic oxidation mechanism of substituted cobalt phthalocyanine, and thiophene in a simulated oil product is removed. The method comprises the following three steps: (1) synthesizing the AEO-7 cobalt phthalocyanine by a one-pot method. Firstly synthesizing a precursor of AEO-7 cobalt phthalocyanine in a reactor, then adding other raw materials to synthesize the AEO-7 cobalt phthalocyanine, and separating and purifying a product; (2) chromatography. Preparing a series of concentration solutions (c) of thiophene, measuring the integral area (S) of the thiophene under a set chromatographic condition, and making a relation curve of S and c to obtain a linear equation. (3) catalytic desulfurization. Adding catalytic amount of AEO-7 cobalt phthalocyanine into a certain volume of thiophene/normal hexane solution with a certain concentration, stirring at normal temperature, and carrying out catalytic desulfurization for 3 hours, wherein the removal rate of thiophene is more than 90%. The AEO-7 cobalt phthalocyanine is a novel catalytic material, has water/oil amphiphilicity, and has higher efficiency of catalyzing out thiophene.

title_en: Elastic power communication transmission network control system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power communication transmission networks, in particular to an elastic power communication transmission network control system which comprises a cabinet body, a dust collecting and utilizing mechanism, an ash removing mechanism, a winding mechanism and a driving mechanism, wherein the front surface of the cabinet body is hinged with a cabinet door, a plurality of supporting plates are fixed at the bottom of an inner cavity of the cabinet body, and a plurality of groups of dust collecting and utilizing mechanisms, a plurality of electrical elements and a plurality of winding mechanisms are respectively fixed at the tops of different supporting plates; in the cabinet body, a dust collecting and utilizing mechanism, a winding mechanism and an electric element are sequentially fixed on the inner wall of the cabinet body opposite to the cabinet door from the cabinet door; the bottom of the supporting plate of the fixed winding mechanism is fixed with a driving mechanism, static electricity generated by an electrical element is transmitted to the dust collecting and utilizing mechanism through a transmission wire, and when the dust collecting and utilizing mechanism adsorbs dust through static electricity, the dust can adsorb water vapor in air, so that the effects of dehumidifying and dedusting the inside of the cabinet are achieved.

title_en: Electrical equipment fault diagnosis robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electrical equipment fault diagnosis robot which comprises a base body, an anti-skid block, a controller, a supporting frame, an electric telescopic rod and a detection tool, wherein the anti-skid block is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the base body, the controller is fixedly arranged at the outer side of the base body, the supporting frame is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the base body, the electric telescopic rod is fixedly arranged at the inner side of the supporting frame, the detection tool is fixedly arranged at the output end of the electric telescopic rod, a storage plate is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the base body, and a servo motor is fixedly arranged at the inner side of the base body. This electrical equipment fault diagnosis robot drives the rotation of different direction threaded rod through the operation at base member inboard fixed mounting servo motor, and the rotation of different direction threaded rod can drive the bracing piece at both ends and remove in opposite directions to carry out the centre gripping through the splint in the bracing piece outside and fix the circuit motherboard of opposition thing board upper end, prevent to appear the position deviation when detecting the circuit motherboard, cause the diagnosis to appear the error.

title_en: Freeze dryer based on electronic expansion valve opening control
abstract_en: The invention relates to a freeze dryer based on electronic expansion valve opening control, and belongs to the technical field of biological medicine equipment. Comprises a compressor, a manual regulating valve, a condenser, an electronic expansion valve I, an electronic expansion valve II, a freeze dryer cylinder, an evaporating coil, a heating coil and a vacuum pump; an evaporation coil and a heating coil are arranged in the freeze dryer cylinder; the outlet of the compressor is connected with the inlet of the evaporation coil through a manual regulating valve, a condenser and an electronic expansion valve II in sequence, and the outlet of the evaporation coil is connected with the inlet of the compressor; the outlet of the heating coil is connected with a pipeline arranged between the manual regulating valve and the condenser through the first electronic expansion valve; the freeze dryer cylinder is connected with a vacuum pump. The invention provides the freeze dryer for realizing prefreezing, drying and defrosting based on the opening control of the electronic expansion valve, which has low equipment energy consumption; the defrosting and refrigerating share the same set of pipeline, so that the system structure is simplified, and the defrosting time is shortened.

title_en: Regeneration method of activated carbon for adsorbing VOCs
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regeneration method for adsorbing VOCs active carbon, which adopts an external heating type regeneration converter, wherein a plurality of material pipes are arranged in a furnace body, the active carbon to be treated in the material pipes is heated from a high position of a feed end to a low position of a discharge end and moves along with the furnace body in a rotating way, VOCs adsorbed on the active carbon are boiled and vaporized and desorbed from normal temperature to 300-500 ℃, the regenerated active carbon is discharged from the discharge end of the regeneration converter, desorbed VOCs gas and materials move in the same direction, the desorbed VOCs gas and materials are pumped into an incinerator through a pipeline at the discharge end to be completely incinerated and then enter a waste heat boiler and then enter an exhaust gas treatment device to be treated and then are discharged by an induced draft fan, the heated heat source gas is sent into a shell of the external heating type regeneration converter from a central pipe at the discharge end to heat the material pipes, and the low temperature gas after heat exchange of the material pipes is discharged into a chimney through the central pipe at the feed end and discharged by the exhaust fan at the regeneration furnace. The invention is suitable for industrialized batch repeated regeneration, and has the advantages of low process temperature, large treatment capacity, stable operation and long service life of equipment.

title_en: Low-temperature storage box for tea drying
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tea storage, in particular to a low-temperature storage box for tea drying. The tea storage drawer is used for containing tea, a refrigerator and a heater are arranged in the storage box, the temperature inside the storage box is adjusted by the refrigerator and the heater, an absorbing piece is arranged in the storage box and arranged on the upper side of the tea storage drawer, and the tea is scattered by the tea storage drawer. According to the invention, the tea leaves are placed in layers through the receiving net, so that the problem that the tea leaves are stacked together in a large amount and cannot be dispersed due to moisture is avoided, the normal drying of the tea leaves is ensured, meanwhile, the tea leaves are arranged in layers, the situation that part of the tea leaves are crushed due to stacking together of a large amount of tea leaves is avoided, and the integrity of the tea leaves is ensured.

title_en: Method, device and storage medium for monitoring service life of filter element of water purifier
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a device and a storage medium for monitoring the service life of a filter element of a water purifier, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, giving an initial value to a basic working parameter according to characteristic data of a target filter element; s2, determining a water production attenuation value based on a total water production value of the filter element and by collecting a flow velocity value of water produced by a target filter element in real time in a preset time period, determining a residual time attenuation value based on a total use time value of the filter element and an initial working time of the target filter element, and updating the residual quantity value of the filter element according to the water production attenuation value and the residual time attenuation value; and S3, confirming whether the updated filter element residual quantity value is larger than a preset residual quantity threshold value, returning to the step S2 under the condition that the filter element residual quantity value is larger than the residual quantity threshold value, and triggering early warning operation to send filter element life expiration reminding information to a user under the condition that the filter element residual quantity value is not larger than the residual quantity threshold value. The technical scheme disclosed by the application has the effect of accurately judging the service life of the filter element.

title_en: Deironing device is used in wheat flour production
abstract_en: The invention discloses an iron removing device for wheat flour production, which belongs to the technical field of flour production equipment and comprises an iron removing box, wherein a discharging mechanism and a slag discharging pipe are respectively arranged at two sides of the iron removing box, a feeding box inserted into the iron removing box is arranged at the top of the iron removing box, a screening mechanism is arranged in the feeding box, a magnetic conveying belt is rotatably arranged in the iron removing box, a scraper matched with the magnetic conveying belt is arranged on the inner wall of the iron removing box, and a guide plate arranged on the bottom of the inner wall of the iron removing box is arranged below the magnetic conveying belt. The invention can continuously carry out iron removal operation through the arrangement of the iron removal box, the charging box, the magnetic conveying belt, the scraping plate and the discharging mechanism, thereby accelerating the iron removal speed of flour, improving the production efficiency, and sieving larger impurities or agglomerated flour in the flour through the arrangement of the sieving mechanism.

title_en: Catheter nursing disinfection device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a catheter nursing and sterilizing device in the technical field of catheter cleaning, which comprises a main body mounting frame, a lower sterilizing shell and an upper sterilizing shell, and is characterized in that an inner mounting plate is fixedly arranged in each of the lower sterilizing shell and the upper sterilizing shell, a plurality of large mounting grooves are uniformly formed in the inner mounting plate, small mounting grooves are formed in positions, corresponding to the large mounting grooves, on the inner mounting plate, large positioning pipes are fixedly arranged on the large mounting grooves, small positioning pipes are fixedly arranged on the small mounting grooves, large limiting pipes are fixedly arranged below the large mounting grooves, small limiting pipes are fixedly arranged below the small mounting grooves, large cleaning balls are arranged in the large limiting pipes, small cleaning balls are arranged in the small limiting pipes, and fixing equipment is arranged at the upper ends of the large positioning pipes and the small positioning pipes.

title_en: CO (carbon monoxide)2Adsorption and desorption material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a CO2 adsorption and desorption material and a preparation method thereof, wherein allyl trimethyl ammonium chloride is firstly dissolved in ethanol, nitrogen is introduced into the solution, 3- (methacryloyloxy) propyl trimethoxy silane and azodiisobutyronitrile are added for condensation reaction, the solution is placed in an oil bath for magnetic stirring, tiO  2  is then added for reaction to obtain quaternized TiO  2 , quaternized TiO  2  and ion exchange resin powder are added into a solvent N, N-dimethylacetamide for ultrasonic dispersion, polyethylene powder is then added for oscillation in an air bath shaking table to obtain casting solution, and the casting solution is subjected to defoaming treatment, ultrasonic treatment, film scraping, drying and cooling in sequence to obtain a formed ion exchange membrane. The invention can collect the CO  2  discharged by the traffic tools such as automobiles, airplanes and the like, and solves the problems of huge quantity, wide distribution and the like of the distributed carbon sources.

title_en: Automatic battery sorting and recycling device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic battery sorting and recycling device which comprises a supporting seat, a feeding barrel, a first-stage sorting device, a second-stage sorting device and a third-stage sorting device, wherein the first-stage sorting device, the second-stage sorting device and the third-stage sorting device are identical in structure, the first-stage sorting device, the second-stage sorting device and the third-stage sorting device are sequentially fixed on the supporting seat, the feeding barrel is fixed on the first-stage sorting device, the supporting seat comprises a supporting seat body, a stabilizing plate is arranged on the bottom wall of the supporting seat body, a collecting box is movably arranged on the stabilizing plate, and a controller is fixedly arranged on the side wall of the supporting seat body. The invention belongs to the technical field of waste battery treatment, and particularly relates to an automatic battery sorting and recycling device which utilizes the principle of centrifugal force action, realizes classification and screening of batteries of the same type through different weights of a carbon battery and an alkaline battery and also realizes orderly automatic screening feeding by utilizing the action of centrifugal force, and has high operation accuracy and efficiency.

title_en: Accurate positioning system and method for machining holes of cast parts based on machine vision
abstract_en: The application provides a casting machining hole accurate positioning system and method based on machine vision, wherein the system comprises: the preprocessing image acquisition subsystem is used for acquiring a preprocessing image; the accurate positioning subsystem is used for controlling the manipulator to accurately position the processing hole of the casting piece according to the preprocessing image based on the machine vision technology; the cleaning subsystem is used for controlling the mechanical arm to clean and treat the processing hole of the casting piece; and the drying judgment subsystem is used for acquiring a process image of the mechanical arm for cleaning the processing hole of the casting piece and judging whether the processing hole of the casting piece is cleaned or not, and if yes, the corresponding casting piece is dried. According to the accurate positioning system and method for the casting machining hole based on the machine vision, the machine vision technology is introduced, the manipulator is controlled to accurately position the casting machining hole according to the acquired pretreatment image, the cleaning degree of the casting is judged by introducing the process image, burrs and greasy dirt in the casting machining hole are prevented from being left, and the production quality is improved.

title_en: Steel belt type oil-water separator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a steel belt type oil-water separator which comprises a frame, a steel belt, a first roller and a second roller, wherein the steel belt is prevented from shaking in the use process, and then a solution is stirred. The first roller is fixed on the frame, the second roller is installed on the frame through the tensioning mechanism, the second roller is stressed and is movable relative to the frame, then when the steel belt is clamped, the force can be transmitted to the second roller, the second roller is stressed and can move, and the steel belt can continue to drive in space. When the steel belt is relatively loosened, the force applied to the second roller is small, and the second roller moves under the action of the tensioning mechanism, so that the steel belt is tensioned. The steel belt is sleeved outside the first roller and the second roller, the steel belt is in a tensioning state, the steel belt part stretches into liquid to be separated, and grooves are formed in the surfaces of the first roller and the second roller. The contact surfaces of the first roller, the second roller and the steel belt are reduced, and lubricating liquid adhered to the surface of the steel belt is prevented from being extruded by the first roller and the second roller to fall off.

title_en: Dust collection and cooling device for silicon carbide ceramic finger production
