abstract_en: The application discloses a dust collection and cooling device for silicon carbide ceramic finger production, which belongs to the technical field of smelting and chemical industry and comprises a frame, a dust collection box and a fan, wherein the dust collection box and the fan are respectively and fixedly arranged on the frame, an output port is formed in the dust collection box, a port of the fan is communicated with the output port, a dust collection hopper is fixedly arranged on the frame, a detachable collecting barrel is arranged in the dust collection box, and one end of the collecting barrel is detachably connected with a filter plate; the dust removal box is far away from the through-hole has been seted up to the one end of fan, be provided with the connecting pipe on the dust absorption fill, connecting pipe sliding connection in the through-hole inner wall, fixedly provided with siphunculus on the collecting vessel, the connecting pipe with the siphunculus is linked together. The application has the effect of reducing the pollution of dust to the environment, thereby reducing the possibility of damaging the health of staff by the dust.

title_en: Water distributor for petroleum exploitation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of water distributors, and particularly relates to a water distributor for petroleum exploitation, which comprises a water distribution main body, a water nozzle anti-blocking mechanism, a permeable water injection auxiliary mechanism and a mixing and stirring mechanism, wherein the permeable water injection auxiliary mechanism is arranged in the water distribution main body; the invention provides a water distributor for petroleum exploitation, which can reduce the density and viscosity of water injection liquid, improve the fluidity, reduce the flow resistance and increase the injection quantity, can increase the compressibility of the water injection liquid, enable the water injection liquid to adapt to the pressure change of an oil layer, keep stable injection pressure, improve the permeability of the water injection liquid, enable the water injection liquid to be more uniformly distributed in the oil layer and improve the oil displacement efficiency through a permeability water injection auxiliary mechanism.

title_en: Flotation separation method for copper-molybdenum bulk concentrate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a copper-molybdenum bulk concentrate flotation separation method, which comprises the steps of removing chemicals from copper-molybdenum bulk concentrate obtained by flotation, adding an inhibitor I, then adding a foaming agent, and carrying out flotation impurity removal to obtain flotation foam A and a product B in a tank; adding an inhibitor II into the flotation froth A, and performing flotation to obtain copper-molybdenum mixed concentrate C and a product D in a tank; after mixing the product B in the tank with the copper-molybdenum bulk concentrate C, adding the inhibitor III and the collector B to float molybdenite to obtain molybdenum concentrate and copper concentrate.

title_en: Hydrogel reactor
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of reactors and discloses a hydrogel reactor which comprises a top plate, wherein a controller main body is fixedly arranged at the top of the top plate, upright posts are fixedly arranged on the outer walls of two sides of the bottom of the top plate, a supporting frame is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of each upright post, a telescopic device is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of one side of each supporting frame, which is close to the center of the top plate, a semicircular cover I is fixedly arranged at the lifting end of each telescopic device, a fixing seat is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of each upright post, a semicircular cover II is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of one side, which is close to the semicircular cover I, of each fixing seat, and a fixing frame is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of one side, which is far from the semicircular cover I, of each upright post. Setting up three sets of puddler, making the stirring efficiency of stirring storehouse inner chamber material realize increasing, through setting up the heating pipe at the inner chamber of puddler simultaneously, can realize heating effect when making equipment stir the material through the puddler, and then make equipment stirring and heating can go on simultaneously, make the efficiency realization of material preparation increase.

title_en: Preparation method of water-in-oil emulsified defoaming agent for shale gas exploitation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a water-in-oil emulsion type defoaming agent for shale gas exploitation, which comprises the steps of taking No. 32 industrial-grade white oil, adding the white oil into a beaker, adding microcrystalline wax yellow blocks, heating to 70 ℃ to dissolve microcrystalline wax, adding a span 80 after uniformly mixing and stirring, magnetically stirring at a constant temperature for 10min, keeping stirring at 70 ℃ for 30min, adding three-stage distilled water, continuously stirring for 60min, and finally adding 2g of 5% PVA aqueous solution to obtain the water-in-oil emulsion type defoaming agent for shale gas exploitation. The invention adopts the surfactant generated after starch modification to process surface groups, so that silane groups are attached to the wax surface with low surface energy, and the silane groups are wrapped on the outer surface of the raw material through hydrogen bonds or electrostatic force, thereby increasing the hydrophobicity of the raw material, reducing the surface tension and achieving the purpose of defoaming at a gas-liquid interface. The silicone grease material is compounded in the later stage, and the silicon-containing groups can be better adsorbed on the outermost layer of the raw materials, so that defoaming is facilitated, and the defoaming rate and the defoaming speed are improved.

title_en: Rainwater recycling integrated equipment
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of water treatment, in particular to rainwater recycling integrated equipment, which comprises a filter box, a liquid inlet and a liquid outlet, wherein the filter box is provided with a liquid inlet and a liquid outlet; the top of the filter box is provided with a liquid inlet; a liquid outlet is formed in the side wall of the filter box; step is through being equipped with rose box and filtration frame, can filter the solid impurity in the rainwater, and, through being equipped with the discharge gate, hollow floating box, first support frame and promote the strip, can follow the rose box inside with the solid impurity of filtration frame filtration and derive, reduce solid impurity and pile up the condition that leads to the fact filtration frame to block up at filtration frame top, promote this device through being equipped with the torsional spring, closure plate and first elastic cord to the filter effect of rainwater, can control the opening and close of liquid outlet, make the inside water level of rose box constantly change, make hollow floating box, first support frame and promote the strip, can be at the inside constant reciprocating of rose box, promote the cleaning effect to impurity is piled up at filtration frame top.

title_en: Corrosion prevention treatment equipment and technology for electrostatic spraying of metal surface
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of metal plate spraying, in particular to anti-corrosion treatment equipment and technology for electrostatic spraying of metal surfaces, an external powder feeder can be connected with an electrostatic spraying gun before spraying, at the moment, a running stepping motor drives a threaded rod to rotate, and as the thread surface of the threaded rod is matched with the size of a thread groove in a movable frame, the movable frame can drive the electrostatic spraying gun at the outer side to horizontally move and complete the spraying effect on the metal plate under the transmission of a screw rod; the air inclines from one side of the bent air duct and gathers to form a metal plate, so that the sprayed shell plate can receive the air blown from the periphery, and the rapid air drying is completed; under gear drive, two sets of drive shafts are rotated in opposite directions to drive the connecting arm to rotate, so that the clamping arm at the outermost side can be extruded to the opposite side along the hinged position of the hinged sleeve, the clamping of the metal plate is completed, the rotation of the inner clamping arm is completed under the drive of the driving motor, and the air drying efficiency is improved.

title_en: Multifunctional meter box mounting bracket
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional meter box mounting bracket, which relates to the technical field of meter box brackets and comprises two cross beams, wherein two positioning sleeves are sleeved outside the two cross beams in a sliding way, a connecting plate is arranged between the positioning sleeves on the two cross beams, a second mounting groove is formed in the front side of the cross beam, a first fixing bolt penetrates through the second mounting groove and is used for fixing the connecting plate, bottom plates are arranged at the lower ends of the two connecting plates, a third mounting groove is formed in the upper parts of the two bottom plates, and a rain shielding piece is sleeved between the upper parts of the two connecting plates in a sliding way. This multi-functional table case installing support, with the support mounting to the wall after, if need install the not equidimension table case, need not to dismantle the support for the installation that punches alone again, can the direct adjustment support the installation dimension to the convenience is installed different table cases, convenient and fast, and stability is high after the installation, and the table case is difficult for droing.

title_en: Efficient cooling device for electric auxiliary machine
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of power engineering and discloses a high-efficiency cooling device for an electric auxiliary machine, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein uniformly distributed leakage holes are formed in the bottom plate, a ring plate layer is arranged on the bottom plate and is formed by sleeving ring plates with continuously-increased uniformly distributed diameter values, uniformly distributed current conductors are arranged on the outer side walls of the ring plates, a motor is arranged at the center of the top end of the bottom plate, an eccentric wheel is arranged at the output end of the motor, and the outer side walls of the eccentric wheels are attached to the inner side walls of the ring plates close to the motor. According to the application, the space of the sliding hole is changed by extruding the ring plate through the eccentric wheel, when the space of the sliding hole is reduced, water in the sliding hole is gathered together and washes the inner wall of the sliding hole under extrusion force, so that the impurity is cleaned, and when the space of the sliding hole is increased, the input amount of cooling air flow is increased, the spreading area of the water is increased, and the heat dissipation efficiency of the water is improved.

title_en: Continuous ring-closing reaction device for preparing 2-amyl anthraquinone and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of 2-amyl anthraquinone production devices, in particular to a continuous ring-closing reaction device for preparing 2-amyl anthraquinone and a use method thereof, aiming at the problems of low preparation efficiency, overlong preparation time, high labor intensity of staff and easy pollution of released gas to air in the prior art, the invention provides the following scheme that: the gas-liquid mixing device comprises a workbench, wherein the top of the workbench is rotationally connected with a gas conversion box, the top of the gas conversion box is fixedly connected with a rotating disc, the outer wall of the rotating disc is fixedly connected with a plurality of connecting plates, and the top of each connecting plate is fixedly connected with a backing ring.

title_en: Medical disinfection equipment and disinfection drying control method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of disinfection equipment, in particular to medical disinfection equipment and a disinfection drying control method thereof, which comprises a base, wherein the base is used for supporting the whole device, and a vertical rod is fixedly arranged at the side of the base; the fixed cleaning barrel is fixedly arranged at the top of the base and used for cleaning and disinfecting objects to be disinfected, a control cavity is formed in the inner bottom of the fixed cleaning barrel, a plurality of fixed rod limiting rods are fixedly connected to the inner wall of the fixed cleaning barrel, and a humidity sensor, an air pressure sensor and a water quality sensor are arranged in the fixed cleaning barrel; the movable cleaning cylinder is connected to the top of the base in a sliding manner and is matched with the fixed cleaning cylinder. The application is convenient for omnibearing cleaning and disinfection and improving the efficiency by combining the disinfection equipment and the control method, so as to solve the problems of low efficiency, easy incomplete cleaning and inconvenience for intelligent control in the prior art.

title_en: Simple continuous fluid treatment equipment with high tightness
abstract_en: The invention discloses simple continuous fluid treatment equipment with high tightness, which belongs to the technical field of continuous fluid treatment equipment and comprises a rotary mounting seat, wherein one side of the rotary mounting seat is fixedly connected with a plurality of coupler connectors, and the other side of the coupler connectors is provided with a multichannel valve assembly. According to the invention, the rotary mounting seat drives the rotary valve plate to rotate through the coupler connecting piece, when the valve position is switched to be aligned, a straight-through flow channel is formed, meanwhile, under the pressurizing action of the pressurizing component, the sealing plate receives a larger pressing force to realize sealing, the pressurizing component is fixed at the upper end of the intermediate shaft by virtue of the fixed chuck, the tightness degree of the pressurizing component can be adjusted by the bolt, the sealing performance of the device in use is improved, the smoothness of fluid in the multichannel valve assembly is ensured, the connection conversion between different flow channels can be realized, and thus continuous flow work in the reaction containers which are sequentially arranged is realized.

title_en: Leakage-proof gas drainer free of steam purging and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of metallurgy, in particular to a steam-purging-free anti-leakage gas drainer and a steam-purging-free anti-leakage gas drainer body, wherein an inlet is communicated with a gas pipeline through a liquid return pipe, and an outlet is communicated with a subsurface empty tank; the ammonium sulfate mother liquor supply device comprises an ammonium sulfate mother liquor circulation formed by a full launder, a saturator and a mother liquor circulation pump, wherein a branch is led out from the ammonium sulfate mother liquor circulation and is communicated with a liquid return pipe and a tail gas pipeline so as to clean sediment blocked in the ammonium sulfate mother liquor circulation; the invention uses the ammonium sulfate mother liquor supply device to replace steam, thereby achieving the purpose of eliminating sediment and reducing the increase of water outside the system.

title_en: Disposable cutlery box raw material stirring feeding device and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tableware processing, in particular to a disposable cutlery box raw material stirring and feeding device and method. The invention provides a disposable cutlery box raw material stirring feeding device and method capable of preventing paper from being broken and piled up. The utility model provides a disposable cutlery box raw materials stirring feeding device, is including water tank, agitating unit, bracket and mould, and agitating unit is installed to the lower part in the water tank, and the last slidingtype of water tank is connected with the bracket, installs the mould on the bracket, still including crushing mechanism, extrusion mechanism and pushing equipment, the water tank right part is equipped with crushing mechanism, and the water tank right part is equipped with extrusion mechanism, is equipped with pushing equipment between water tank and the extrusion mechanism. The paper is minced through the blade, and the shredded paper falls into the roller loading chute, and the shredded paper in the roller loading chute is compacted through pushing away the frame, continuously loads, and the shredded paper is poured into the water tank through the roller, so, the shredded paper can be better quantitatively put into the water tank, and the pushing plate is used for pushing, so that the shredded paper is prevented from being accumulated on the right part of the water tank.

title_en: White spirit preparation device and process
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of stirring equipment, and particularly discloses a white spirit preparation device and a white spirit preparation process, wherein a feeding part is in sliding connection with a bracket, a conveying pipe is communicated with a feeding tank, a cutting part is arranged in the feeding tank, and the cutting part is movably connected with the feeding tank; the stirring shaft is arranged in the fermentation tank, the feeding member is fixedly connected with the transmission shaft, an outer sleeve is sleeved outside the stirring shaft, a first elastic member is arranged between the stirring shaft and the outer sleeve, one end of the stirring member is sequentially hinged with the stirring shaft and the outer sleeve, the other end of the stirring member abuts against the inner wall of the fermentation tank, the stirring member is provided with a discharge hole, a first shaft is sleeved in the stirring shaft and is sequentially meshed with the stirring members, and the first shaft is movably connected with the cutting member; the first driving piece is used for driving the outer sleeve to rotate, and the second driving piece is used for driving the transmission shaft to move. The white spirit preparation device and the white spirit preparation process are convenient for controlling the consumption of the distiller's yeast, avoid the problem of excessive or insufficient crushing of the distiller's yeast, and ensure the uniform mixing of fermentation materials.

title_en: Integrated treatment equipment for cleaning, drying and sterilizing artificial cochlea products
abstract_en: The application relates to an integrated treatment device for cleaning, drying and sterilizing cochlear implant products, which comprises: the upper part of the box body is provided with an upper cover matched with the box body, and a closed space is formed when the upper cover is covered; the water outlet pipe penetrates through the box body and is communicated with the closed space; a water inlet hose connected with the outer side of the upper cover; the spray header is connected with the water inlet hose through a pipeline which is opened in the upper cover in advance; the product fixing frame is arranged on the inner wall of the box body and used for fixing the artificial cochlea product; the ultraviolet sterilizing lamps are arranged at intervals on the inner side of the upper cover; and the heater is connected with the inner wall of the box body. Compared with the prior art, the application has the advantages of combining the original three procedures into one procedure, saving the carrying and transferring time and avoiding the damage of the midway products. And the integrated control effectively controls the technological parameters, is convenient to operate and greatly improves the product qualification rate.

title_en: Ultrasonic cleaning optimization method and system for fabric
abstract_en: The application discloses an ultrasonic cleaning optimization method and system for fabrics, and relates to the technical field of fabric cleaning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a structural parameter set of a target fabric; collecting attachment information of a target fabric; conveying the attachment information to a processor through a data transmission port to carry out cleaning scheme matching, and obtaining a first cleaning scheme sequence; the fault maintenance information of the ultrasonic rinsing machine is called to generate a first equipment coefficient; performing cleaning optimization analysis according to the structure parameter set and the first equipment coefficient to obtain a first optimization coefficient; obtaining a target optimized cleaning scheme sequence; and optimally cleaning the fabric according to the target optimal cleaning scheme sequence. The application solves the technical problems of poor cleaning effect and incomplete analysis when the fabric with a plurality of attachments is cleaned by ultrasonic waves in the prior art, and achieves the technical effects of cleaning and optimizing according to the conditions of the plurality of attachments of the fabric for ultrasonic cleaning and improving the cleaning quality.

title_en: Pyrazole ionic liquid and method for catalyzing Betti reaction by using pyrazole ionic liquid
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of synthesis of Betti alkali aminoalkylnaphthol, in particular to a pyrazole ionic liquid 1, 2-dibenzyl-3, 5-dimethylpyrazole hexafluorophosphate and a synthesis method thereof, and a method for catalyzing Betti reaction by using the same; at 70 ℃, using pyrazole ion liquid as a catalyst and a solvent, carrying out a three-component Betti reaction on aromatic aldehyde, pyrrolidine and beta-naphthol, and separating a product and the catalyst by using ethanol to obtain Betti alkali amino alkyl naphthol; through screening the types of the ionic liquid, the solvent, the material ratio of reactants, the dosage of the ionic liquid and the reaction temperature, a series of Betty bases with higher yield are obtained under the optimized conditions, the yield is 72% -94%, the used catalyst is green and effective, the thermal stability is good, the Betty bases can be catalyzed and synthesized in a short time, the product and the catalyst are easy to separate, the industrialization is facilitated, and the catalyst can be recycled for a plurality of times.

title_en: Drying device with self-adaptive adjusting function for health product production
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of drying, in particular to a drying device with a self-adaptive adjusting function for health-care product production. The utility model provides a health products production is with drying device who has self-adaptation regulatory function, includes the landing leg, the rigid coupling has the inner shell body on the landing leg, the inner shell body is provided with feed inlet, bin outlet, the gas vent and the circumference of installation filter screen distribute and install the air inlet of filter screen, the inner shell body rigid coupling has the shell body, the shell body rigid coupling has control terminal, the feed inlet with all be provided with in the bin outlet with the solenoid valve that control terminal electricity is connected, the shell body passes through the air inlet with communicate in the inner shell body, the outside rigid coupling of shell body and intercommunication have the communication shell of mirror image distribution. According to the invention, the materials are dried in all directions by the hot air uniformly introduced in the circumferential direction, so that the drying speed of the materials is improved, and the outer side and the middle of the materials are synchronously dried, so that the drying speed of the materials is further improved.

title_en: Seed paper tape packaging machine suitable for district breeding and working method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a seed paper tape packaging machine suitable for community breeding and a working method thereof, relates to the technical field of agricultural machinery, solves the problems of low efficiency and poor sowing precision of the existing community breeding mode, improves the breeding efficiency and precision, and adopts the following specific scheme: the seed metering mechanism comprises a seed charging assembly and an air suction type seed metering device which are sequentially connected, wherein a plurality of suction holes are formed in the outer wall of the seed metering device at equal intervals along the circumferential direction of the seed metering device, and a seed metering baffle plate is arranged at one side of the suction hole at the lowest point of the seed metering device, which faces the rotation direction of the seed metering device, so as to be used for blocking seeds and reducing the speed of the seeds in the horizontal direction to zero; the device comprises a paper tape release and collection mechanism, a paper tape sealing mechanism, a seed tape traction mechanism and a frame.

title_en: Microfluidic chip, use method thereof and microfluidic system
abstract_en: The microfluidic chip comprises a substrate layer, a cover plate layer, a solution containing space and a liquid inlet hole, a liquid outlet hole and a plurality of limiting grooves, wherein the substrate layer comprises a substrate and a driving electrode layer positioned on the substrate, the cover plate layer is opposite to the substrate layer, the space between the cover plate layer and the substrate layer forms the solution containing space, the cover plate layer comprises a liquid inlet hole, a liquid outlet hole and a plurality of limiting grooves which are arranged on one side of the cover plate layer facing the substrate layer in an array manner, the liquid inlet hole, the liquid outlet hole and the limiting grooves are communicated with the solution containing space, and the end face of the liquid inlet hole adjacent to the substrate layer, the end face of the liquid outlet hole adjacent to the substrate layer and the opening faces of the limiting grooves are approximately flush.

title_en: Method and system for recovering waste liquid of grinding slurry
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a method and a system for recycling grinding slurry waste liquid, wherein the system comprises a stirring tank and a filter. The system further comprises: a first pipeline for conveying the initial slurry waste liquid to a first inlet of the stirring tank; a second pipeline for conveying the slurry waste liquid from the stirring tank to the filter; a third pipeline for conveying the concentrated slurry waste liquid from the filter to the second inlet of the stirring tank; a first valve for opening and closing the first pipeline; a specific gravity meter for sensing the solid content of the slurry waste liquid; and a controller configured to control the first valve.

title_en: High-efficient environmental protection's black sediment processing apparatus
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-efficiency environment-friendly ink residue treatment device, which relates to the technical field of ink residue treatment, and the technical scheme is characterized by comprising a machine body, wherein a liquid storage cavity is formed in the machine body, a partition plate is fixedly connected to the interior of the liquid storage cavity, a first liquid storage interval and a second liquid storage interval are formed in the interior of the liquid storage cavity by separation of the partition plate, a liquid flowing hole is formed in the partition plate, and a control valve is arranged in the liquid flowing hole; the filter plate is movably connected to the inside of the second liquid storage section, a filter hole is formed in the filter plate, a first liquid pump is fixedly connected to the inside of the second liquid storage section, the liquid outlet end of the first liquid pump is communicated with an outflow pipe, and the outflow pipe is communicated with the first liquid storage section; the cleaning plate is movably connected above the partition plate; the cleaning plate has the effect that the cleaning plate can clean the ink residues on the upper surface of the partition plate in the moving process.

title_en: Sewage recycling device for multi-sequence linkage water environment treatment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sewage treatment, in particular to a sewage recycling device for multi-sequence linkage water environment treatment, which comprises a stirring barrel, wherein the upper end surface of the stirring barrel is fixedly provided with a water inlet, the inner side of the water inlet is rotatably provided with a blade, the inside of the stirring barrel is provided with a mixing device for stirring liquid medicine, the right end surface of the blade is provided with a connecting column, the mixing device can be driven to work through a first cone pulley, the left end surface of the stirring barrel is fixedly provided with a pumping mechanism for pumping the liquid medicine, the right end surface of the stirring barrel is fixedly provided with a connecting pipe, the inner side of the connecting pipe is slidably provided with a filter screen, the pumping column moves up and down continuously while pumping the liquid medicine from a liquid medicine box, an electromagnetic valve controls the mixing proportion of the liquid medicine and air, and the mixture of the air and the liquid medicine are finally mixed with sewage to achieve better reaction, and when the flow speed of the sewage is slow, and a clamping piece with the air cannot break loose the elasticity of a spring through inertia, the first motor can continuously provide power to enable the stirring device to continuously run.

title_en: Diamond finished product screening and detecting device and application method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of diamond production and discloses a diamond finished product screening and detecting device and a using method thereof. According to the diamond finished product screening and detecting device and the application method thereof, equipment replaces manual screening through the arrangement of the sorting mechanism, the conveying mechanism, the screening mechanism and the dispersing mechanism, the influence of factors such as fatigue is avoided, the screening efficiency is improved, and the identification error is reduced.

title_en: Procyanidine powder drying device that peanut red skin draws
abstract_en: The application discloses a procyanidine powder drying device for peanut skin extraction, in particular to the technical field of procyanidine powder processing for peanut skin extraction, which comprises the following steps: the drying box is characterized in that a dehumidifying circulation mechanism for filtering moisture in hot air flow and steam is arranged at the upper end of one side of the drying box, a discharging pipe is arranged at the middle end of the bottom of the drying box, a discharging mechanism for preventing procyanidine powder from being blocked is arranged in the discharging pipe, a charging hole is arranged at one end of the top of the drying box, a sealing mechanism for timely closing the charging hole is arranged in the charging hole, a placing disc is horizontally and fixedly connected to the upper end of the drying box, and an opening and closing mechanism for discharging is arranged on the placing disc.

title_en: Tentering system with automatic cloth correcting function based on images
abstract_en: The invention relates to a tentering system with an image-based cloth automatic correction function and a method thereof, wherein the tentering system with the image-based cloth automatic correction function comprises: a tenter frame; a cloth-input design pattern correction unit disposed behind the tenter for correcting a cloth-input design pattern of the cloth input to the tenter; a first scanning section arranged in front of the tenter for obtaining a design pattern image of the discharged cloth by scanning the design pattern of the discharged cloth discharged from the tenter; and a central processing unit for communicating with the input cloth design pattern correction unit and the first scanning unit.

title_en: Improved disc type vacuum filter
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of filters, and discloses an improved disc type vacuum filter which comprises a support, wherein a filter body is arranged at the top of the support, hollow shafts are rotatably arranged on the left side and the right side of the inner wall of the filter body, a vacuum pump assembly and a gear motor are respectively arranged on the left side and the right side of the filter body, a liquid inlet pipe is arranged on the front surface of the filter body, a filter disc is arranged on the outer surface of the hollow shaft, and an outer gear ring is fixedly arranged on the outer surface of the filter disc. According to the application, the inner gear ring, the planet carrier and the planet gears are utilized to transmit the lifted rotating speed to the cleaning rotary drum, at the moment, the cleaning rotary drum slides, rubs and scrapes the outer part of the filter bag contacted with the outer surface of the cleaning rotary drum through high-speed rotation, so that residues of filtering materials on the surface of the filter bag are thoroughly removed, and the same filtering capacity can be maintained when the filter bag enters the slurry liquid surface again.

title_en: Servo motor rotor punching sheet processing and forming device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of stator and rotor punching sheet processing, and discloses a servo motor rotor punching sheet processing and forming device which comprises a base, the device is used as a basic installation component of the whole device and is used for installing and assembling each matched use mechanism and a structural component of the matched use mechanism; the support column is arranged at the periphery of the middle part of the inner side of the base and is close to the edge and used for supporting the surface processing table of the base. Through continuous automatic feeding receiving mechanism's setting, not only can improve the production automation degree of whole device, can also continuously supply processing apparatus through automatic feeding mechanism in the course of working in addition, reduced artificial intervention in the course of working to realized the high automation and the integration of production process, simultaneously processed production through this kind of processing mode, still can improve the security of processing operation when having reduced the human input cost in the course of working, reduced the probability of incident emergence in the course of working.

title_en: Glue processing technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of glue processing, in particular to a glue processing technology, which comprises the following steps: step one: preparing liquid materials and powder materials required by glue processing; step two: adding the liquid material into a processing device for heating and stirring; step three: continuously adding powdery materials in the process of heating and stirring the liquid materials, so that the powdery materials and the liquid materials are mixed to form glue; step four: stopping adding powdery materials after the glue is formed; step five: scraping the coagulum adhered on the stirring shaft through a processing device; step six: collecting and treating the coagulum; step seven: heating the condensate and re-adding the condensate into the glue; step eight: filling and preserving the prepared glue; the invention can automatically clean the coagulum on the stirring shaft when the glue is processed, and reduces the labor intensity of workers.

title_en: Centrifugal rinsing device is used in calcium butyrate production
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of centrifugal rinsing devices, and provides a centrifugal rinsing device for calcium butyrate production, which comprises a bracket body, wherein a cleaning cylinder is fixed on the upper part of the bracket body, a centrifugal cylinder is rotatably connected inside the cleaning cylinder, a drying cylinder is rotatably connected outside the cleaning cylinder, the centrifugal cylinder is connected with the cleaning cylinder through a lifting assembly, an automatic material guiding mechanism is arranged between the centrifugal cylinder and the drying cylinder, and the centrifugal rinsing device further comprises a driving assembly for driving the drying cylinder to rotate relative to the cleaning cylinder and a power assembly for driving the centrifugal cylinder to rotate relative to the cleaning cylinder. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the cleaning cylinder is used for circulating cleaning water, the centrifugal cylinder is used for centrifugal rinsing of calcium butyrate, and the drying cylinder can guide the calcium butyrate in the centrifugal cylinder into the drying cylinder for drying through the automatic guide mechanism after centrifugal rinsing is finished, so that an effect of at least two purposes of one machine is formed, and the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Methyl octabromoether fire retardant preparation facilities
abstract_en: The invention discloses a methyl octabromoether flame retardant preparation device, which relates to the technical field of flame retardant preparation and comprises a dissolution reaction bin, a height adjusting component, an air compression top cover, an absorbent felt structure, a cold source base and a lifting type alternative cold and heat source, wherein a shell is welded at the top of the dissolution reaction bin. According to the invention, the air extrusion barrel capable of moving up and down is arranged at the top of the dissolution reaction chamber, the liquid level sensor is arranged at the bottom surface of the air extrusion barrel, the liquid level distance between the bottom surface of the air extrusion barrel and the liquid level of the reactant is indicated by the liquid level sensor, so that the bottom surface of the air extrusion barrel is just attached to the liquid level of the reactant, the air content in the dissolution reaction chamber is subjected to extreme compression, the contact volume between the tetrabromobisphenol A and the air in the dissolution reaction chamber is reduced, the oxidation volatilization amount of the tetrabromobisphenol A solvent is reduced, and the accuracy of the preparation quality of the intermediate product methyl tetrabromoether is improved by controlling the volatilization amount of the active ingredients of the reactant.

title_en: Protection device for biosensor
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of biosensors and discloses protection equipment for a biosensor, which comprises a protection tube, a sliding sleeve, a connecting contact and a detection contact, wherein a limiting block is integrally formed in the protection tube; according to the invention, the sliding sleeve is pressed by downward rotation, the movable block and the bottom detection contact slide in the sliding rail groove under the action of the positioning rod, and the detection contact extrudes the pressure spring between the positioning plate and the limiting block in the protection pipe, so that the detection contact can extend to the outer side from the protection pipe through the connecting pipe head, after the positioning rod slides into the connecting groove, the positioning rod can be abutted to the top of the inner wall of the connecting groove when the pressure spring is compressed to generate elasticity, the detection contact extends out of the opening at the bottom end of the connecting pipe head, the biological detection is conveniently carried out on the surface of a detected object at different depths, and the detection contact can be extended to a certain depth from the surface of the detected object while the detection contact on the biological sensor is protected, so that the detection range is improved.

title_en: Wafer cleaning device
abstract_en: The application relates to a wafer cleaning device, which relates to the technical field of semiconductors. The wafer cleaning device comprises a cleaning barrel, an ultrasonic generator and a mounting assembly; the cleaning cylinder is provided with a cleaning space, the inner cylinder wall of the cleaning cylinder is provided with a plurality of liquid spraying holes which are arranged at intervals, and each liquid spraying hole is communicated with the cleaning space and is used for spraying cleaning liquid to the cleaning space; the vibration tail end of the ultrasonic generator is arranged at the bottom of the cleaning cylinder; the installation component installs in wasing the space, and the installation component has the multilayer along wasing the mounting bracket that the cylinder axial was arranged, and arbitrary adjacent two mounting brackets are connected, and have the accommodation space that is used for placing the wafer between arbitrary adjacent two mounting brackets. Through setting up the multilayer mounting bracket in order to place a plurality of wafers, do benefit to a plurality of wafers and wash simultaneously to improve the abluent efficiency of wafer. The cleaning liquid is sprayed out of the liquid spraying hole to clean the wafer, so that the surface of the wafer is prevented from being damaged while the cleaning is realized.

title_en: Cleaning device of environment-friendly collecting box
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of environmental protection devices, in particular to a cleaning device of an environmental protection collecting box, which comprises the following components: the collecting device comprises a shell and a base, wherein the shell is fixedly connected with the base, and a collecting barrel is arranged on the inner side of the shell; the cleaning mechanism is connected with the shell and the base; wherein, the cleaning mechanism includes: the cleaning component is arranged on the inner side of the shell and is rotationally connected with the shell; the water guide assembly is arranged on the inner side of the base and is connected with the cleaning assembly; the dust collection assembly is arranged on the outer side of the shell and is connected with the cleaning assembly, the cleaning assembly is matched with the water guide assembly and the dust collection assembly through the cleaning mechanism, the shell and the collecting barrel can be cleaned automatically at the same time, workers are not required to clean manually, time and labor are saved, and the problems that the existing dustbin is required to be cleaned manually at regular time and the workload of workers is high are solved.

title_en: Drainage and dehumidification system for large-span cable-stayed bridge tower
abstract_en: The invention relates to a drainage and dehumidification system for a tower of a large-span cable-stayed bridge, which belongs to the technical field of large-span bridges and comprises a main tower and a cross beam, wherein the main tower is vertically arranged on the ground, the cross beam is connected with the main tower, a tower steel anchor box cavity is coaxially arranged in the main tower, a body cavity is arranged in the cross beam, a dehumidifier, an outlet pipe and a first dehumidification air pipe are arranged in the body cavity, one end of the outlet pipe is connected with the dehumidifier, the other end of the outlet pipe is arranged outside the cross beam, one end of the first dehumidification air pipe is connected with the dehumidifier, the other end of the first dehumidification air pipe extends into the bottom of the tower steel anchor box cavity, and by the dehumidifier, the humidity in the tower steel anchor box cavity can be reduced, so that the condition that corrosion phenomenon is easy to occur in the tower steel anchor box cavity due to humid weather is avoided, and the problem that the humidity of the inner cavity of the cable-stayed bridge is easy to occur due to humid weather is solved only by arranging a drainage groove in the existing cable-stayed bridge.

title_en: Waterway control valve
abstract_en: The invention discloses a waterway control valve, which comprises a valve core assembly and a flushing valve body with a first water inlet and a first water outlet, wherein a first water passing hole is formed between the first water inlet and the first water outlet, the valve core assembly comprises a first floating body for opening and closing the first water passing hole, the two sides of the first floating body are respectively a water inlet side and a balance cavity side, the first floating body is provided with a balance pore canal, a check piece with a one-way water passing function is arranged in the balance pore canal, and the check piece is movably arranged in the balance pore canal and is used for opening and closing the communication between the water inlet side and the balance cavity side. According to the invention, the check piece with the one-way water-through function is arranged in the balance pore canal, so that the valve has an anti-siphon function, and under the cooperation of the valve core assembly, the water of the first water inlet is discharged quickly, the maximum instantaneous flow can be achieved in a short time, and the valve can be flushed and can save water; meanwhile, the quick descent and slow closure can be realized, the generation of destructive water hammer can be prevented, and the noise is reduced; and simultaneously, the uniformity of high and low pressure flow is regulated.

title_en: Preparation method of sponge nickel-based heavy metal chromium ion adsorption material
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a sponge nickel-based heavy metal chromium ion adsorption material, which comprises the following steps in sequence: step [1] synthesizing WSe  2  nano-crystals on the wall surface of the carbon nano-tube to form a carbon nano-tube loaded with the WSe  2  nano-crystals; step [2] carrying out electrodeposition connection on the carbon nanotube loaded with the WSe  2  nano crystal on a sponge nickel matrix to obtain a sponge nickel-based carbon nanotube; step [3] carrying out Cu coating on the WSe  2  nano-crystal loaded on the sponge nickel-based carbon nano-tube, so that the carbon nano-tube is loaded with WSe  2  @Cu; and (4) carrying out sulfhydryl/amination on the sponge nickel-based carbon nano tube loaded with WSe  2  @Cu. The adsorption material prepared by the invention has excellent adsorption and removal performance of the heavy metal chromium ions in the wastewater, and is an ideal adsorption and removal material for the heavy metal in the wastewater.

title_en: Supported metal cluster and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of catalytic materials, and particularly relates to a supported metal cluster, and a preparation method and application thereof. The supported metal clusters are prepared by the following method: dipping the rigid carrier in noble metal salt solution, and drying to obtain a noble metal-loaded rigid carrier; carrying out heat treatment on a rigid carrier loaded with noble metals in a reducing atmosphere to obtain a loaded metal cluster; the supported metal clusters include a rigid support and metal clusters supported on the rigid support. The technical scheme can solve the technical problems that the size-controllable high-purity metal nanocluster is difficult to prepare and obtain by the prior art, and the catalytic performance of the metal nanocluster cannot meet the application requirements. The supported metal cluster prepared by the scheme can be used as a hydrogen oxidation catalyst and has an ideal catalytic effect. The preparation process and the product have high performance reproducibility, the product structure is easy to control, the industrialized popularization and application are easy to realize, and the catalyst has wide application prospect as a new-generation catalyst.

title_en: Automatic feeding device for cutting and drilling of aluminum frame strips
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of aluminum alloy processing, in particular to an automatic feeding device for cutting and drilling holes of aluminum frame strips, which comprises the following components: a bottom plate; the feeding device is arranged on the bottom plate and is used for automatically feeding aluminum alloy; the cleaning device is arranged on the bottom plate and used for cleaning crushed aggregates generated during processing; wherein, cleaning device includes: the power device is arranged on the bottom plate and used for providing power for the reciprocating device; the reciprocating device is arranged on the bottom plate and used for cleaning crushed aggregates falling from the through holes at the top of the box body, the motor is fixedly connected with the top of the supporting plate, the motor drives the rotating rod, the fixed rod, the movable rod and the cleaning block to reciprocate, meanwhile, the first sliding block at the back of the cleaning block slides on the inner wall of the first sliding groove to limit the moving track of the cleaning block, and meanwhile, the crushed aggregates falling from the through holes at the top of the box body are cleaned, so that the crushed aggregates are cleaned to the inner wall of the collecting box, and the crushed aggregates generated by automatic cleaning and processing are realized, so that the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Device and method for recycling natural gas and hydrogen by low-temperature method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for recycling natural gas and hydrogen by a low-temperature method, which belong to the technical field of waste gas recycling, and comprise a compressor, a purification assembly, a cold box, a first heat exchanger, a first water-gas separator, a second heat exchanger, a second water-gas separator and a PSA pressure swing adsorption system; the first heat exchanger, the first water-gas separator, the second heat exchanger and the second water-gas separator are all positioned in the cold box; by adopting the mode, the method provided by the invention adopts the low-temperature method to recycle the natural gas and hydrogen in the methane waste gas, and has the following advantages compared with the traditional membrane separation method: the purity of the product gas is high; the hydrogen mixed gas can be further purified and recycled, so that waste can be avoided; the separation efficiency is high.

title_en: Synthesis device and synthesis method of rare earth up-conversion nano material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a synthesizing device and a synthesizing method of rare earth up-conversion nano material, wherein the synthesizing device comprises: a reaction mechanism; a solid adding mechanism for adding solid powder to the reaction mechanism; a liquid adding mechanism for adding a liquid sample to the reaction mechanism; the gas adding mechanism is used for adding inert gas to the reaction mechanism and guiding out tail gas in the reaction mechanism; and the control mechanism is electrically connected with the reaction mechanism, the solid adding mechanism, the liquid adding mechanism and the gas adding mechanism so as to control the timing and quantitative addition of the solid powder, the liquid sample and the gas and control the reaction condition of the reaction mechanism. According to the synthesis device of the rare earth up-conversion nano material, disclosed by the invention, the reaction mechanism, the solid adding mechanism, the liquid adding mechanism and the gas adding mechanism are controlled by the control mechanism, so that the adding amount of solid powder and liquid samples and the reaction conditions can be accurately controlled, errors caused by manual operation are avoided, and the synthesis accuracy of the rare earth up-conversion nano material is improved.

title_en: Reciprocating type bi-directional wind cutting drying mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reciprocating type double-direction air-cutting drying mechanism, which comprises: the device comprises an air knife, guide rails, sliding seats, a rotating shaft, a turning plate, a reciprocating driving device and a first pin shaft seat, wherein the two guide rails are distributed at left and right sides at intervals in parallel, the sliding seats are slidably arranged above the guide rails, the rotating shaft is rotatably arranged between the sliding seats on two sides, the turning plate is arranged on the rotating shaft, the first pin shaft seat is arranged on the outer side of the turning plate, the air knife is arranged at the top or the bottom of the turning plate, one side of the turning plate, which faces the first pin shaft seat, is provided with a second pin shaft seat, the reciprocating driving device is arranged on the first pin shaft seat in a reversible manner, the tail end of the reciprocating driving device is movably connected with the second pin shaft seat, and a limiting rod positioned on two sides of the turning plate is arranged between the sliding seats on two sides. Through the mode, the reciprocating type double-direction air-cutting drying mechanism provided by the invention has the advantages that the direction of the air knife shell is changed in the reciprocating movement process, so that the air-cutting drying of the top surface and the two side surfaces of a workpiece is realized.

title_en: Method for continuously preparing 4-chloroacetoacetic acid ethyl ester in microchannel reactor
abstract_en: The present application relates to a process for continuously preparing ethyl 4-chloroacetoacetate in a microchannel reactor comprising: (1) Adding a catalyst into the diketene solution to obtain a feed A, precooling the feed A, and then sending the feed A into a chlorination reaction module of the microchannel reactor; (2) Chlorine is used as a feed B, and after precooling, the feed B is sent into a chlorination reaction module of a microchannel reactor to carry out chlorination reaction with the feed A, so as to obtain 4-chloroacetoacetyl chloride; (3) 4-chloracetyl chloride is continuously fed into an esterification reaction module of a micro-channel reactor after being subjected to a delayed reaction by a tubular reactor, and is subjected to an esterification reaction with pure ethanol serving as a feed C on line; and (4) after the esterification reaction, carrying out on-line quenching reaction in a quenching reaction module of the microchannel reactor by using water to obtain the 4-chloroacetoacetic acid ethyl ester. The method can obtain the ethyl 4-chloroacetoacetate with the purity of up to 99 percent without rectification, thereby avoiding rectification loss.

title_en: Exhaust gas deodorization purifier of pet food processing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of waste gas treatment in pet food factories, and discloses a waste gas deodorizing and purifying device for pet food processing. The utility model sets up the pretreatment unit, the dust filter plate carries on the prefilter treatment to the waste gas, process the dust in a large amount of waste gas, avoid the dust to cause phenomenon such as the filler is blocked while spraying the treatment, use the rotary cylinder brush to clean the dust filter plate surface in real time, avoid the situation that the dust filter plate is blocked, regulate the gear motor to drive a plurality of deep bead to rotate at the same time, regulate the rotation angle of the deep bead, and then regulate the waste gas amount entering and spraying the treatment unit, avoid the waste gas to treat the phenomenon not thoroughly because of the waste gas flow is too high, the utility model adds the air entraining part, distribute in the workshop and absorb the waste gas through a plurality of air suction components, the air suction storehouse in the air suction component can swing while working, further enlarge the scope to absorb waste gas, the effect to absorb waste gas is better.

title_en: Steel pipe rust cleaning device is used in steel pipe production
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of steel pipe production and discloses a steel pipe rust removing device for steel pipe production, which comprises a steel pipe body, a rolling frame, a fixing frame, a polishing rust removing device and a spraying rust removing device, wherein the fixing frame is welded and distributed at the top and the bottom of the rolling frame, the outer part of the rolling frame is of a square frame structure, and an inner ring of a circular structure is arranged in the rolling frame; the steel pipe body is connected with the inner ring in a penetrating way, and a rolling mechanism is distributed on one circle of the rolling frame in a penetrating way; the polishing rust removing device is arranged at the upper end and the lower end of the right fixing frame; the spraying rust removing device is arranged at the upper end and the lower end of the left fixing frame. This steel pipe rust cleaning device is used in steel pipe production, the automatic control steel pipe body of being convenient for reaches rotatory effect, and the effective control steel pipe body carries out all-round rust cleaning of polishing and rust cleaning with spray paint and handle, and dual operation makes the steel pipe rust cleaning more high-efficient, improves steel pipe production efficiency.

title_en: Washable process of silk fabric machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a machine washable process of a silk fabric, and belongs to the technical field of spun silk fabric preparation. The spun silk fabric mainly aims at the problem that the smoothness of spun silk cannot be improved in the existing spun silk fabric preparation process, and the technical scheme is provided, wherein the spun silk fabric preparation process comprises silk processing and silk weaving, the silk processing comprises lubricant mixing, and the silk processing comprises silk soaking. According to the invention, silk processing comprises silk soaking, primary drying, secondary soaking and secondary drying, and the yarn lubricant and the high polymer protein adhesive are adhered to the outer surface of the silk, so that the smoothness of the silk and the comfort of the silk are improved, and the machine washability of spun silk is ensured.

title_en: Laboratory environment detection monitoring device and monitoring method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a laboratory environment detection monitoring device and a monitoring method thereof, which belong to the technical field of environment detection and comprise a laboratory medicament storage cabinet, a guiding mechanism, a turnover self-material returning mechanism and a self-material changing mechanism. Through the first servo motor that sets up in guiding mechanism, under the 180 degrees rotation effect of its output, can make former upset from the material returning mechanism of orientation bottom upwards overturn, and after the upset because the effect of gravity, its inside active carbon that is used for adsorbing harmful substance can pour downwards, enter into from the circular cavity storehouse of material returning mechanism through the cavity case, because circular cavity storehouse is circular, and the centre separates through the revolving plate, through 180 degrees rotations, its revolving plate can accomodate the active carbon of pouring at its surface, and extrude the active carbon of other one side simultaneously and supply, the effectual problem that its detection monitoring device is used for purifying harmful gas's module can not accomplish automatic reloading among the prior art has been solved.

title_en: Automatic bar discharging device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of bar material blanking equipment, and particularly relates to an automatic bar material blanking device which comprises a sorting manipulator assembly, a weighing assembly, a material tailstock material line, a defective material line and a finished product line. The sorting manipulator assembly is used for grabbing bars to be sorted, which are output from the previous working procedure of the bar production line, and throwing the bars into the weighing assembly, the tailing stockline, the defective material stockline or the finished product stockline. According to the invention, the bar stock output from the last procedure of the master alloy bar stock production line can be grabbed by the sorting manipulator assembly, and weighed by the weighing assembly, so that automatic sorting of the bar stock is completed, finished products, defective products and tails of the bar stock can be automatically sorted, the sorting efficiency of the bar stock is improved, the sorting cost of the bar stock is reduced, and the device has the advantages of simple integral structure, simple control and reliable performance.

title_en: Paper bag machine for screening good and bad bags and control method
abstract_en: The invention provides a paper bag machine for screening good and bad bags and a control method thereof, wherein the paper bag machine is sequentially provided with a plurality of stations, the stations are correspondingly provided with a detection mechanism, a reference mechanism, a conveying mechanism and a rejecting mechanism, and the detection mechanism is arranged at a station of an initial section and used for detecting the good and bad of the paper bags entering the paper bag machine; the rejecting mechanism is arranged at the terminal station and used for rejecting the bad bags; the reference mechanism is arranged at each station between the detection mechanism and the rejection mechanism and used for executing corresponding actions, and the conveying mechanism is arranged at all stations and used for continuously conveying paper bags from the initial station to the final station. The detection mechanism arranged on the paper bag machine can detect bad bags such as a plurality of bags, empty bags, inclined bags and defective bags and reject the bad bags by the rejection mechanism, the detection mechanism adopts a plurality of electric eye combination schemes to complete detection and judgment, the hardware configuration is not high, the setting and using processes are simple and effective, and the screening effect of the bad bags is accurate and reliable.

title_en: Remaining needle treatment device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an indwelling needle treatment device, which relates to the technical field of waste crushing and comprises a fixed frame, wherein the fixed frame is rotationally connected with a first rotating shaft, the first rotating shaft is provided with a large crushing roller, a first filter screen is fixedly connected in the fixed frame, a second filter screen is fixedly connected in the fixed frame, a collecting frame is fixedly connected in the second filter screen, the first rotating shaft is rotationally connected with the collecting frame, the fixed frame is provided with a small crushing roller, the small crushing roller is fixedly connected with the large crushing roller, the fixed frame is rotationally connected with a rotary feeding disc, and the rotary feeding disc is fixedly connected with a bump. Preliminary smashing is carried out to keeping somewhere the needle through big crushing roller to send back big crushing roller through pivoted big crushing roller cooperation first filter screen with the fragment of leaving on first filter screen, smash repeatedly, carry out further smashing to the fragment through little crushing roller, so, keep somewhere needle volume reduction, reduce the area that occupies when retrieving.

title_en: Process for producing, separating and purifying bone polypeptide for treating arthritis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bone polypeptide production separation and purification process for treating arthritis, which comprises the following steps: step one, preparing materials; step two, curing, which comprises the following steps: placing animal cartilage in a preset temperature environment and an air pressure environment for cooking; step three, residue separation, which comprises: brushing the cured cartilage by a preset multi-brush-roller staggered brushing device; step four, high-pressure flushing, which comprises the following steps: a plurality of fine high-pressure water columns are distributed to flush the brushed cartilage; step five, PH adjustment; step six, enzymolysis, it includes: adding compound protease and papain into an enzymolysis container, and keeping the temperature at a first temperature for a period of time T2; step seven, enzyme deactivation treatment; step eight, filtering; step nine, drying and producing, which comprises the following steps: spray drying the concentrated final filtrate to obtain cartilage peptide powder. The method has the effect of improving the separation convenience and the processing efficiency of the peptide product.

title_en: High-performance activated carbon microsphere and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention prepares the activated carbon microsphere with high performance by using the waste cotton fabric as the raw material, and applies the activated carbon microsphere to adsorb the methylene blue in the printing and dyeing wastewater, thereby improving the adsorption and degradation effects on the methylene blue in the printing and dyeing wastewater. The invention takes the waste cotton fabrics as raw materials, has wide sources and low price, and can improve the recycling rate of the waste cotton fabrics; the invention utilizes ZnCl with certain concentration  2  The solution can be used as hydrothermal carbonization additive for reducingThe hydrothermal temperature of the formed activated carbon microspheres is low, and the specific surface area of the activated carbon microspheres can be increased; when the activated carbon is applied to adsorption and degradation of methylene blue, the microsphere structure and the high specific surface area of the activated carbon can obviously improve the adsorption and degradation effects; the preparation method has the advantages of simple operation, environmental protection, low energy consumption and the like, and can realize large-scale application and 'waste treatment by waste'.

title_en: Steel beam bridge assembly equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of steel beam machining, in particular to steel beam bridge assembly equipment, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a plurality of first sliding rails are fixedly connected to the upper end of the bottom plate, a first sliding table is slidably arranged at the upper end of each first sliding rail, a second sliding rail is fixedly connected to the upper end of each first sliding rail, a second sliding table is slidably connected to the upper end of each second sliding rail, an upright post is fixedly connected to the upper end of each second sliding table, a clamping assembly is respectively arranged at the upper end of each upright post, the clamping assembly comprises a U-shaped plate arranged above the upright post, two third rectangular plates are slidably connected to one side of each U-shaped plate respectively, the distance and the angle between steel beams to be welded are conveniently controlled by driving the first sliding tables to slide on the first sliding rails, the steel beams are clamped and fixed by the third rectangular plates, the problem that the joints of the welded steel beams possibly shake is solved, and the steel beam bridge assembly is suitable for welding of multiple lengths and angles.

title_en: Dust-proof soil-stone mixture screening device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dust-proof soil-stone mixture screening device in the technical field of screening equipment, which comprises a screening box, a dust collection assembly, a rotating groove and a screening groove, wherein a screen cylinder, a first sealing assembly and a gear ring are arranged on the rotating groove; the second driving component enables the material blocking component to open the left end of the screening groove, and the switching component enables the notch of the screening groove to be opened, so that the materials accumulated in the screening groove and the rotating groove are respectively discharged and collected; dust collection is carried out on dust and the like raised by screening through the dust collection assembly, and the dust is prevented from escaping into the external environment, so that the influence on the environment and staff is reduced.

title_en: Filter medium material for aviation jet fuel
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a filter medium material for aviation jet fuel, which comprises a first glass fiber layer, a synthetic fiber spacer mesh layer, a second glass fiber layer and a cellulose fiber layer which are sequentially stacked; wherein the first glass fiber layer has a first average pore size, the second glass fiber layer has a second average pore size, and the first average pore size is larger than the second average pore size; the synthetic fiber spacing net layer comprises a plurality of through holes and hole walls, and the aperture range of each through hole is 1-20 meshes. By arranging the synthetic fiber spacer mesh layer between the first glass fiber layer and the second glass fiber layer, the dirt storage space can be effectively increased, the glass fiber layer can be supported and protected, the pleating performance of the filter medium material is improved, the dirt containing capacity of the filter medium material for aviation jet fuel is greatly improved, the dirt containing capacity can be about 2 times that of the prior art, and the contradiction relation between the filtering precision and the dirt containing capacity is effectively balanced.

title_en: Spiral sand washer for building sand material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a spiral sand washer for building sand materials, which relates to the field of building equipment and comprises an inclined base, two spiral rods, a driving motor, a screening device, a water circulation device and a discharging device, wherein the two spiral rods are arranged in the inclined base in parallel in an inclined manner; the screening device comprises a feeding frame, a first screen mesh arranged in the feeding frame in an inclined mode, a movable door at one end, far away from the inclined base, of the feeding frame, and a first vibration part at one side of the feeding frame, for controlling the first screen mesh; the water circulation device comprises a filter box arranged on one side of the inclined base, a filter component arranged at the top end inside the filter box, and a spray component arranged at the top of the middle end of the inclined base; the invention relates to a spiral sand washer for building sand materials, which is high in feeding and discharging efficiency.

title_en: Online dredging device, system and method for rotary tunneling plug
abstract_en: The invention provides an online dredging device, a dredging system and a dredging method for a rotary tunneling plug, wherein the dredging device comprises the following components: the hand wheel is used for driving the screw rod to rotate; the rotary tunneling cylinder is fixedly connected with the second end of the screw rod and can move along the axial direction of the screw rod under the drive of the screw rod, and the rotary tunneling cylinder can enter the air outlet pipeline to dredge a blockage when moving, and can move out of the air outlet pipeline after dredging is completed; the sealing sleeve is fixedly connected with the air outlet pipeline and is used for ensuring the air tightness of the air outlet pipeline; the gland assembly is in threaded connection with the screw rod and is used for providing pushing force or pulling force for the screw rod, so that the screw rod can move along the axial direction of the screw rod while rotating; the first end of the screw rod is connected with the hand wheel, and the second end of the screw rod sequentially penetrates through the gland assembly and the sealing sleeve and is fixedly connected with the rotary tunneling cylinder. The invention can realize on-line dredging without interrupting the system operation, is universal to the valve body, and can synchronously remove the plug of the valve body section.

title_en: Catalyst for low-pressure mesohydrogenation light weight of heavy oil and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a catalyst for low-pressure mesoscopic hydrogenation and lightening of heavy oil, which is an iron-based supported catalyst taking carbon-based microspheres as a carrier, and comprises the carrier, an active component in-situ material and an additive, wherein the carrier is microsphere or microparticle carbon material, the base material of the active component in-situ material is metal ferric salt and molybdenum salt, the additive comprises a precipitator and deionized water, the deionized water is used for dissolving and diluting the active component in-situ material and the precipitator, and the mass percentages of the carrier, the active component in-situ material and the additive are 30-70wt% of the carrier, 30-50wt% of the active component in-situ material, 5-20wt% of the precipitator and the balance of the deionized water. The corresponding preparation method comprises the steps of dissolving quantitative carrier and active component raw materials in deionized water, loading the carrier solution in a form of preparing suspension, depositing active substances on the carrier solution in the form of in-situ forming or adding a precipitant, and oxidizing, filtering, washing, drying and grinding and screening the precipitate to prepare the catalyst.

title_en: Stop valve with valve core protection structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of stop valves, in particular to a stop valve with a valve core protection structure. The top of the valve body is provided with a sealing cover, the valve rod penetrates through the sealing cover in a sliding manner, and the valve rod is supported by the support column and the mounting plate. The bottom of the valve core is coaxially provided with a cylinder seat, a sliding rod is inserted at the periphery of the valve core, the sliding rod is provided with a scraping plate, the sliding rod is kept against the inner wall of the valve clack through a first top spring, and the service life of the valve clack is prolonged. The bottom of the sealing cover is coaxially provided with an isolation cover, and the semicircular guard plate is hinged to realize isolation sealing so as to protect the bottom of the valve core machine. The ejector rod is connected to the bottom of the sealing cover through an L-shaped hanging seat, a gear system is arranged at the top of the ejector rod, and lifting of the valve core is achieved through hand wheel operation. The bottom of the valve core is provided with a first groove which forms a seal with a second groove of the inner ring surface of the valve clack. The design of the stop valve has a reliable valve core protection structure, can be suitable for different industrial occasions, and ensures the safe and stable operation of a fluid system.

title_en: Crushing, dissolving and stirring equipment for solid chemical products
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of solid chemical products, in particular to solid chemical product crushing, dissolving and stirring equipment which comprises a crushing box and a dissolving box, wherein the crushing box and the dissolving box are integrally arranged; the crushing seat comprises a sliding block which is connected inside the sliding groove in a sliding way. The tension spring is changed into an extension state from a force storage state and drives the polygonal crushing column to move at a higher speed, so that not only can a large quantity of solid chemical products be subjected to high-speed crushing treatment, but also the chemical products adhered to the surface of the crushing column can be thrown out, the normal use of the crushing column is ensured, and excessive chemical products adhered to the surface of the crushing column are avoided.

title_en: Superoxide dismutase mimic and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of superoxide dismutase mimics, and discloses a superoxide dismutase mimic and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: dissolving histidine by using a mixed solution of water and acetone, and then regulating the solution to be alkaline; adding water-soluble cupric salt and divalent zinc salt into the obtained solution, fully reacting under heating and stirring, and then centrifuging and enriching the product to obtain the superoxide dismutase mimic. Realizes the low-temperature and rapid preparation effect, and the superoxide dismutase mimic prepared by the method has a spherical structure with excellent monodispersity.

title_en: Catalyst formula for improving purity of direct chlorination product of ethylene
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vinyl chloride chemical manufacturing, and discloses a catalyst formula for improving the purity of a direct chlorinated product of ethylene, wherein the catalyst comprises the following raw materials in parts by weight: iron trichloride 8.7% dichloroethane 91.3%.
