According to the invention, the catalyst has a certain storage space by adopting the charging tank, and is fully isolated from the reactor system, so that the splashing of liquid-phase materials in a pipeline of the reaction system during charging is effectively avoided, the charging safety is improved, and harmful substances are prevented from leaking into the atmosphere; the stirrer can effectively ensure that the catalyst is uniformly mixed according to the formula proportion to form suspension and prevent the suspension from caking, so that the catalyst is uniformly distributed after entering the reactor; the two catalyst feeding pumps adopt hydraulic double-diaphragm metering pumps, so that the catalyst can be added into the reactor according to the formula more accurately and regularly, and the beneficial effects that the catalyst formula enables the reaction rate to be optimal and the final product quality to be better are achieved.

title_en: Geological beach environment detection sampling equipment and sampling method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of environment detection, and particularly relates to geological beach environment detection sampling equipment and a sampling method, wherein the geological beach environment detection sampling equipment comprises a rotating shaft I, a drill bit fixedly connected with the bottom end of the rotating shaft I, and a sampling structure arranged on the outer wall of the rotating shaft I; the sampling structure comprises: the fixed sleeve is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the bottom end of the first rotating shaft, the inner wall of the outer side of the fixed sleeve is provided with a connecting groove, after the drill bit is driven to reach a proper area, the second control telescopic rod pushes the flip cover to be opened outwards by taking the installation shaft as the circle center, so that the arc-shaped scraping plate clings to the hole wall, the lifting rod is controlled to drive the drill bit to lift, and the soil on the hole wall is scraped by the arc-shaped scraping plate; the soil is conveyed to the collecting bottle through the connection between the connecting pipe and the connecting port after the collecting cover is gathered through the collecting cover connected with the bottom end of the collecting cover in the inclined flip cover, so that the soil mixing with other areas is avoided, and the subsequent detection quality is affected.

title_en: Technology for manufacturing fiber film with daytime passive radiation refrigeration function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fiber membrane manufacturing, and discloses a fiber membrane manufacturing technology with a daytime passive radiation refrigeration function, which comprises the following steps of S1, preparing a mixed spinning solution; the method comprises the steps of S11, adding solute into tetrahydrofuran solution to obtain mixed solution with a set value in mass fraction, S12, adding the mixed solution into a container, mixing for a set time at a set temperature to obtain mixed spinning solution, S2, preparing a fiber membrane through a spinning process according to the prepared mixed spinning solution, S3, carrying out patterning manufacturing through image processing, further preventing energy loss through weakening the burden of a traditional refrigerating system, improving the preparation condition of the traditional manufacturing process, having a harsh structure, a single fiber diameter, a low production speed and a high operation technology, manufacturing an electrode capable of being used for detecting human biological signals through a mask method, and improving the heat exposure capability of electronic skin.

title_en: Overspray-free robot spray system including clamp lifting, positioning and orienting robots
abstract_en: An overspray-free spray coating system comprising: a spray robot including a clear spray applicator; and a first gripper robot for lifting and orienting the gripper assembly relative to at least one of the spray robot and the overspray applicator, the gripper assembly configured to hold an object to be sprayed by the overspray applicator, the first gripper robot comprising a first gripper configured to grasp a first portion of the gripper assembly, the first gripper robot configured to lift and orient the gripper assembly via the first gripper.

title_en: Be used for clear climbing robot of boats and ships wall
abstract_en: The invention discloses a climbing robot for cleaning a ship wall surface, which belongs to the technical field of ship cleaning and comprises a cleaning disc and a travelling mechanism; the cleaning disc comprises a cleaning disc body; the cleaning disc body comprises a first shell and a second shell, and the first shell is connected with the second shell in a sealing way through a flexible folding assembly; a circle of rubber sealing gasket is arranged at the opening at the bottom end of the cleaning disc body, and a sealing brush is arranged at the bottom end of the rubber sealing gasket; the top ends of the first shell and the second shell are respectively provided with a rotary spray head; the left side and the right side of the cleaning disc body are provided with adjusting components; a walking adjusting assembly is arranged between the two walking wheel assemblies; when the adjusting assembly drives the second shell to descend relative to the first shell, the walking adjusting assembly drives the walking wheel to descend relative to the first shell. The invention can realize the self-adaptive fitting of the wall surface curvature, thereby reducing the probability of splashing of sewage between the cleaning disc body and the wall surface of the ship and the probability of unstable walking of the robot walking mechanism when the robot walking mechanism is separated from the wall surface of the ship.

title_en: Replacing system and resin storage device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of storage devices, in particular to a replacement system and a resin storage device, comprising a vertical plate and a placement groove arranged on the outer wall of the vertical plate; the supporting plate is in threaded connection with the outer wall of the vertical plate; and the exchange column is respectively arranged at the discharge end and the feed end at the two ends of the exchange column, and the end face of the discharge end is provided with the material distributing valve.

title_en: Automobile charging cable fixing device
abstract_en: The application discloses an automobile charging cable fixing device, and relates to the technical field of cable fixing. The application comprises the following steps: the charging device comprises a box body and a cable, wherein the cable is positioned in the box body, one end of the cable is connected with an external power supply, a through hole is formed in the box body, and the other end of the cable passes through the through hole to be positioned outside and is provided with a charging gun; the locking mechanism comprises two locking clamping plates arranged in the box body. According to the application, the cable can be fixed through the locking mechanism when the charging gun is used, so that the cable is not easy to be separated out due to running of an external vehicle and walking of pedestrians in the charging process of the electric car, the damage to the surface caused by the exposure of excessive cable skins is prevented, the stability and the continuity in charging are ensured, and the cable exposed outside can be retracted and cleaned through the wire collecting mechanism and the cleaning mechanism when the charging gun is not used, so that the cable skin exposed outside is cleaned, and the excessive impurities are prevented from adhering to the cable skin.

title_en: A composite set for production of sun-proof compound dacron surface fabric
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composite device for producing sun-proof composite polyester fabrics, which comprises a dip dyeing box and a drying box, wherein the drying box is fixedly connected to the right side of the dip dyeing box, two first guide rollers are symmetrically arranged in the top space of the dip dyeing box, two second guide rollers are symmetrically arranged in the bottom space of the dip dyeing box, a fabric body is jointly wound on the two second guide rollers and the two first guide rollers, a drying cavity and a rectangular cavity are arranged in the drying box, openings are formed in the inner walls of the left side and the right side of the drying cavity, and the right end of the fabric body penetrates through the two openings; and the drying disturbance mechanism comprises a rotating shaft which is rotatably connected between the front inner wall and the rear inner wall of the rectangular cavity. The advantages are that: the dyeing liquid flowing and redundant dye removing are promoted by utilizing one motor, and the fabric is dried, so that the drying efficiency is improved, and the dye waste is reduced.

title_en: Novel stirring device for wafer electroplating solution
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of wafer packaging wet processing, and provides a novel stirring device for wafer electroplating liquid, which comprises the following components: the top of the stirring box is provided with a clamping assembly for fixing the wafer, and the stirring box is also provided with a liquid inlet pipe and a liquid outlet pipe; the stirring assembly is arranged in the stirring box and comprises a stirring part and a turbulent flow part, and a reciprocating assembly for driving the turbulent flow part to work is further arranged on the stirring part; the auxiliary components are used for being matched with the stirring part to comprehensively stir the wafer plating solution in the stirring box, a plurality of groups of auxiliary components are arranged in the stirring box and are connected through the linkage component, one group of auxiliary components are connected with the stirring part through the transmission part, and the problems that most of the conventional stirring devices are simple in structure, poor in stirring effect, poor in turbulence effect on the plating solution on the surface of the wafer and difficult to improve the processing quality of products are avoided through the matching arrangement of the stirring component and the auxiliary components.

title_en: Preparation method of novel silica gel-based chromatographic medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a novel silica gel-based chromatographic medium, which comprises the following specific steps: (1) preparation of a solution: mixing a certain amount of monomer M1 and 0.01mmo L/L acetic acid, and stirring at 0 ℃ for 30-60min; (2) aging: pouring the mixed solution obtained in the step (1) into a die, vacuumizing, filling nitrogen for 3-5 times alternately, maintaining at 40 ℃ for 24 hours, and cleaning with ultrapure water; (3) reaming: circularly treating with ammonia water (0.01-2 mol/L) at 120deg.C for 9h; soaking the wet gel sample in 0.01-0.5 mol/L nitric acid solution, water and N, N-dimethylformamide for 3-8 hr, and drying the wet gel sample in a blast incubator at 60deg.C for 5-20 hr; (4) roasting: heating the monolithic column obtained in the step (3) to 700 ℃ at a heating rate of 1 ℃/min, and roasting for 2-5h; and (5) demolding: and (3) naturally cooling the calcined sample in the step (4) to room temperature, and demolding from the mold to obtain the silica gel integral bed. The silica gel monolithic column prepared by the method provided by the invention avoids the problems of cracking, deformation, bending and the like of the silica gel monolithic column bed in the calcination process, and has the advantages of good repeatability and batch stability.

title_en: Nut empty shell sorting equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides nut empty shell sorting equipment. This nut empty shell sorting facilities, including first rectangle metal box, the internal surface fixedly connected with fan of first rectangle metal box, the output fixedly connected with air outlet of fan, the internal surface fixedly connected with electric telescopic handle of first rectangle metal box, the output fixedly connected with division board of electric telescopic handle, the side surface fixedly connected with elastic sealing plate of division board, form the second between division board and the fan and adorn flourishing with the cavity. This nut shell sorting facilities through the rust-resistant separator of design slope and not the recess of equidimension, realizes classifying the shell of equidimension and the nut that contains the pulp, and at the time of the selection by winnowing, can avoid causing the empty shell of great nut and complete less nut weight phase difference less, can lead to the in-process of sorting to appear unusual, leads to the poor problem of effect of sorting, increases the effect of sorting.

title_en: Coptis root drying and whisker removing integrated equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coptis processing, in particular to coptis drying and whisker removing integrated equipment, which comprises a frame, a heating cover, a driving assembly and a whisker removing assembly, wherein the driving assembly comprises a motor, a first chain, a speed reducer, a second chain and a gear shaft, the motor provides power to drive the speed reducer to operate, the gear shaft is rotated through the second chain when the speed reducer operates, the gear shaft is connected with the whisker removing assembly to rotate, the steps of drying and whisker removing are completed in the whisker removing assembly, the drying degree of coptis can be different, all the works can be completed by using different gears, the machine body is smaller, the production efficiency is high, the three-gear speed is set to adapt to the change of the coptis moisture in the drying and whisker removing processes of different coptis, the uniformity of the coptis finished product moisture is ensured, and the device has sensitivity and variability.

title_en: Continuous operation device and method for solid-liquid phase synergistic treatment of ozone gas
abstract_en: The invention discloses a continuous operation device and a continuous operation method for solid-liquid phase synergistic treatment of ozone gas. The method of the invention firstly uses an ozone decomposition catalyst to carry out preliminary treatment on the gas containing high-concentration ozone in a solid phase, and then introduces the gas into a liquid phase treatment system to ensure the ultralow concentration of the final outlet ozone. In addition, the invention introduces an electrolysis process into a liquid phase treatment system, and achieves the dual purposes of absorbing ozone and reducing and regenerating the solid-phase ozonolysis catalyst simultaneously by adding different reducing agents with oxidation-reduction cycle characteristics into the electrolyte, wherein the oxidized reducing agents are reduced and regenerated through the cathode of an electrolytic cell. Finally, the device and the method provided by the invention realize the cyclic regeneration of the solid phase and the liquid phase while ensuring the high removal rate of the ozone, and achieve the effect of continuous operation of the high-concentration ozone gas treatment process.

title_en: Comprehensive efficient mixing device for beneficial elements, antagonistic bacteria and modifier
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive efficient mixing device for beneficial elements, antagonistic bacteria and an improver, which belongs to the technical field of mixing devices, wherein a user can fix equipment in a factory through a base part, then enter the beneficial elements, the antagonistic bacteria and the improver through an outer feed inlet and an inner feed outlet, wherein the outer feed inlet and the inner feed inlet are respectively provided with a door structure, the door on the inner feed inlet and the inner feed outlet is required to be opened firstly, then the door on the outer feed inlet and the outer feed outlet is opened to form a double-sealing protection function, and then the beneficial elements, the antagonistic bacteria and the improver are poured into the device, and then a first driving part is started to drive a first rotating part to rotate, so that a second rotating part is driven to rotate along with the first rotating part through the first rotating part, and meanwhile, a second driving part is started to drive the second rotating part to rotate.

title_en: Adjustable transformer convenient for dust removal and heat dissipation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an adjustable transformer convenient for dust removal and heat dissipation, which comprises a bottom plate for supporting and fixing, wherein a supporting piece and a protecting shell are arranged on the bottom plate, the protecting shell is arranged at the lower end of the supporting piece, a lifting assembly is movably clamped in the protecting shell, a transformer is arranged in the lifting assembly, the transformer is arranged in the protecting shell, a driving assembly is arranged on the upper wall of the supporting piece, the lower end of the driving assembly is connected with the upper end of the lifting assembly, centrifugal fan-shaped pieces are further arranged on the driving assembly, a plurality of groups of centrifugal fan-shaped pieces are arranged, the centrifugal fan-shaped pieces are uniformly arranged on the driving assembly at equal intervals, and the centrifugal fan-shaped pieces are arranged at the upper end of the transformer. The invention belongs to the technical field of transformers, and particularly relates to an adjustable transformer convenient for dust removal and heat dissipation, which can be used for carrying out heat dissipation treatment on the transformer, absorbing moisture in the surrounding environment of the transformer and adjusting the height of the transformer according to the situation.

title_en: Tightness detection device for joint of construction pipeline
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of construction pipelines, and provides a device for detecting tightness of a joint of a construction pipeline, which comprises a control box, a first pipeline, a second pipeline, a control pipe, a detection pipe, a one-way valve, an air bag, a protective cover, an inductor, an alarm and a plugging component, wherein the control pipe is vertically arranged at the center of the inside of the control box, a sealed cavity is formed in a space between the outer wall of the control pipe and the inner wall of the control box, the detection tube is vertically arranged at the top of the control box, the one-way valve is arranged on the outer wall of the detection tube, the air bag is communicated with the top end of the detection tube, the protection cover is arranged at the top of the control box, the sensor is arranged on the outer wall of the top end of the protective cover, the alarm is arranged on the outer wall of the control box, the plugging component is arranged on the outer wall of the control box, and one end of the plugging component is communicated with the sealing cavity. The invention can automatically prevent gas leakage, and avoid gas leakage dangerous situations from damaging personal safety during gas leakage at night.

title_en: Magnetic porous polymer microsphere with multilevel structure and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a magnetic porous polymer microsphere with a multilevel structure, and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of high polymer materials. The invention uses highly crosslinked porous polymer microsphere as a base material, adsorbs seed metal, reaction raw materials and nucleating agent after modification treatment, and then uses polyalcohol as a reducing agent to directly prepare the magnetic porous composite microsphere with a multilevel structure through in-situ solvothermal reduction in a hydrothermal kettle. The prepared magnetic composite microsphere has the advantages of porosity, magnetism, solvent resistance and the like, can be directly used for adsorbing and separating organic impurities, is convenient for magnetic separation and recovery, and is used in the fields of water treatment, magnetic sensors, targeted drug carriers and the like.

title_en: Juice extracting equipment for preparing beverage from sugarcane
abstract_en: The invention discloses juice extracting equipment for preparing beverages from sugarcanes, which comprises a main body, wherein two juice extracting wheel sets are arranged on the upper side of the inside of the main body, transmission shafts are arranged in the juice extracting wheel sets and are rotationally connected with the main body, a charging box is arranged below the juice extracting wheel sets, a second transmission cavity is formed in one side of the inside of the main body, a threaded rod is rotationally arranged at the upper end of the inside of the second transmission cavity, a moving block is connected to the external threads of the threaded rod, and a bearing is arranged in the moving block. This juice extractor for sugarcane preparation beverage need not the manual promotion of manual work, avoids producing danger, can realize the automatic input of sugarcane through the rotation of juice extraction wheelset to conveniently accomplish the feeding of sugarcane, when the motor breaks down and need wait for the maintenance, the user can carry out manual operation, has guaranteed juice extraction operation's continuity, and easy operation is convenient moreover, has improved juice extractor's emergency handling ability.

title_en: Intelligent nickel-based alloy tubular product ultrasonic wave deoiling device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of nickel-based alloy pipe oil removal, in particular to an intelligent nickel-based alloy pipe ultrasonic oil removal device which comprises a frame body and a discharging frame fixedly connected to the outer side surface of the frame body, wherein the discharging frame is used for discharging cleaned oil stains, a heating plate is fixedly connected to the outer bottom of the frame body, and an ultrasonic generator is arranged at the outer bottom of the frame body. According to the invention, a proper amount of cleaning liquid is poured into the frame body to be in contact with the nickel-based alloy pipe, then the heating plate and the ultrasonic generator are started to carry out oil removal treatment on the nickel-based alloy pipe, in the oil removal process, oil stains float on the cleaning liquid surface, when the nickel-based alloy pipe is removed, and the oil removal is completed, the servo motor is started to drive the belt assembly to rotate reversely, the belt assembly drives the scraper to move rightwards to push the oil stains floating on the cleaning liquid surface to the right side for aggregation, and then the nickel-based alloy pipe is not adhered with the oil stains when moving upwards to the outside of the frame body, so that the oil removal effect is improved.

title_en: Pneumatic crusher
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pneumatic crusher, which belongs to the technical field of crushers and comprises a main machine table, wherein side feeding hoppers are respectively fixed at the left side and the right side of the main machine table, a feed inlet communicated with the inside of the main machine table is formed in the bottom of the side feeding hoppers, two guide seats positioned at the feed inlet are fixed in the main machine table, a limiting clamping groove is formed between the two guide seats, a side-by-side pneumatic crushing mechanism moving along the inclined surface of the guide seats is slidably mounted on the guide seats, discharge holes are formed in the front side and the rear side of the bottom end of the main machine table, and an air pump machine is mounted above the outside of the main machine table. The invention is mainly used for crushing ores, the high-pressure gas can drive the side-by-side pneumatic crushing mechanism to continuously feed, the two side-by-side pneumatic crushing mechanisms which are arranged in a crossing way can continuously crush the ores in the feeding process, and the ores cannot run in the crushing process, so that each large-volume ore can be crushed, and the crushing effect is better.

title_en: Dry extrusion device of feed processing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of feed drying, in particular to a feed processing drying extrusion device, which comprises an extrusion mechanism, a guide mechanism arranged at the bottom of the extrusion mechanism and an alternate pressing mechanism arranged at the top of the extrusion mechanism, wherein a drying discharge mechanism is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the guide mechanism; according to the invention, the feed in the feed cylinder is alternately pressed and extruded through the alternate pressing mechanism, the single extrusion granulation amount of the feed is divided into two parts, the subsequent drying pressure is reduced, and half of the feed is blown by the high-pressure hot air flow to be scattered and dropped, and the scattered and dropped feed is divided into two parts again to be dropped into two material distribution bins, in addition, the feed is contacted and dried with the hot air flow in the scattered and dropped process, the problem of uneven dryness caused by accumulation of the feed is avoided, the blown hot air flow is matched with the external air to carry out secondary drying on the feed discharged from the spiral discharge groove, and the occupied area is reduced under the condition of ensuring the drying time.

title_en: Halloysite nanotube reinforced high-temperature-resistant nanofiltration membrane and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a halloysite nanotube reinforced high-temperature resistant nanofiltration membrane and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of membrane materials, wherein the preparation method of the high-temperature resistant nanofiltration membrane comprises the following steps: (1) Uniformly dispersing halloysite nanotubes, polyphenol, polyamine and laccase in a buffer solution to obtain a codeposition solution, and depositing the codeposition solution on a porous base film to obtain a deposition layer containing the halloysite nanotubes; (2) Utilizing an oil phase solution containing polybasic acyl chloride to perform interfacial polymerization reaction on a deposition layer containing halloysite nanotubes to form a separation layer, and curing and crosslinking to prepare the halloysite nanotube reinforced high-temperature-resistant nanofiltration membrane; the high temperature resistant nanofiltration membrane separation layer prepared by the method is uniform and compact, has strong electronegativity, and has excellent nanofiltration performance, high temperature resistance and long-term stability.

title_en: Powder coating equipment for packing of screening granule
abstract_en: The invention provides powder coating packaging equipment for screening particles, which comprises a hopper and a blanking ring cylinder mechanism, wherein the blanking ring cylinder mechanism comprises a stepped cylinder, an upper annular plate is arranged at the top of the stepped cylinder, a lower annular plate is arranged near the bottom of the stepped cylinder, a ring plate is arranged at the outer edge of the lower annular plate, a blanking channel is formed between the ring plate and the inner wall of the stepped cylinder, an upper ring tooth is arranged in the upper ring tooth, a plurality of upper adjusting holes are formed in the upper ring tooth, an upper spring is arranged in each upper adjusting hole, the blanking ring cylinder mechanism further comprises a lower ring tooth, a lower sieve ring is arranged in the lower ring tooth, the upper sieve ring, the lower ring tooth and the lower sieve ring are coaxial, a plurality of lower adjusting holes are formed in the lower sieve ring, a lower spring is arranged in each lower adjusting hole, each upper adjusting hole and the lower adjusting hole are connected through a sieve rod, the upper spring and the lower spring respectively abut against the sieve rod, and a sieve groove is formed in the gap between each adjacent sieve rods.

title_en: Energy-saving type purification device for sewage treatment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy-saving purification device for sewage treatment, and relates to the technical field of purification devices. This energy-saving purifier for sewage treatment, including the filter vat, the rear side of filter vat is provided with the sealing door, the transmission hole has been seted up at the middle part of filter vat, the inside in transmission hole is connected with the drain pipe through the bearing rotation. This energy-saving purifier for sewage treatment, through discharging sewage by the inlet tube when using, make it flow the middle part of sponge through the drain pipe to drive the rear end of drain pipe through external transmission device and make it high-speed rotatory, the drain pipe rotation can drive sponge, filter screen through the connecting rod and rotate, can make moisture ooze from sponge, filter screen owing to centrifugal force that rotatory inertia produced, by the left side discharge of filter vat, open after the use and seal the door with debris take out can, reach simple purpose with sewage treatment.

title_en: Determination method of liquid extraction distribution coefficient
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for measuring a liquid extraction distribution coefficient, and relates to the technical field of chemical industry. The method for measuring the liquid extraction distribution coefficient is odorless, nontoxic and harmless in the extraction experiment process, accords with the teaching concept of green chemistry, is simple and convenient to operate, can perform continuous feeding operation, and is convenient for drawing a distribution balance curve; compared with other methods for completing solute distribution in a constant temperature oscillating box and then sampling after taking out, the method can reduce the influence of the ambient temperature on the distribution coefficient measurement; the distribution balance experiments of different concentration gradients are completed in the same constant temperature kettle, the influence of an experimental instrument on data measurement can be reduced, odorless and nontoxic white oil is used for replacing kerosene harmful to a body, the method can be used for daily teaching of a chemical experiment of the family, and the distribution coefficient of a white oil-water-benzoic acid system is measured by a simple and easy-to-operate method so as to facilitate teaching and research of the system.

title_en: Method and device for controlling humidity of steaming and baking oven, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a method and a device for controlling humidity of an oven, computer equipment and a storage medium. The steaming and baking box comprises a steaming and baking box inner container, a dehumidifying component, a temperature sensor, a humidity sensor and a food probe, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining current state parameters aiming at the steaming and baking box inner container through the temperature sensor and the humidity sensor, wherein the current state parameters comprise current temperature data, current humidity data and food internal temperature; wherein the internal temperature of the food is obtained by a food probe; determining a target state range matched with the current state parameter in at least one preset state range; wherein, the preset food internal temperature in the preset state range is inversely proportional to the preset dehumidification power; and adjusting the working state of the dehumidifying component to a target dehumidifying state corresponding to the target state range. The method can effectively give consideration to the dehumidification effect of the steaming and baking oven and the food maturity.

title_en: Conveying device and method for processing street lamp lampshade
abstract_en: The invention discloses a conveying device and a method for processing a street lamp lampshade, wherein a second side plate is arranged on the right side of a first side plate, and shaft rods are rotatably arranged between the front parts and the rear parts of the first side plate and the second side plate. According to the conveying device and the method for processing the street lamp shade, through the cooperation of the conveying plate mechanism, the first rack, the second rack, the first convex frame mechanism and the second convex frame mechanism, air flow can be generated in the process of conveying the street lamp shade, the surface of the street lamp shade is purged by the air flow, dust and impurities on the surface of the street lamp shade are blown away, the street lamp shade with clean surface enters the position right below the surface defect detection mechanism so as to carry out surface scratch detection again, and when the street lamp shade after detection is overturned to the position below the chain, the conveying plate mechanism can be enabled to quickly loosen the clamping limit of the street lamp shade under the cooperation of the first convex frame mechanism and the second convex frame mechanism, so that automatic detachment is realized.

title_en: Method and apparatus for regenerating catalyst
abstract_en: A method and apparatus for regenerating a catalyst used in a hydrocarbon conversion process. The catalyst is separated into a bypass portion and an adsorption portion. The bypass portion is routed to a regeneration zone where coke can be removed. The effluent gas from the regeneration zone may include reactive additives, such as halogens, from the catalyst. The exhaust gas is sent to an adsorption zone that also receives the adsorption section. In the adsorption zone, the catalyst will contact and adsorb the active additive before being transferred to the regeneration zone. The amount of active additive in the effluent gas from the regeneration zone and the adsorption zone is reduced.

title_en: Dehydration method for chemical production
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dehydration method for chemical production, which belongs to the technical field of chemical production, and the dehydration method for chemical production is characterized in that a benzene/ethylbenzene double-tower intermodal transportation technology is adopted to combine a non-condensing line of a first reflux tank with a tank bottom discharge line and then send the two streams to a light component tower, so that the heating time of the light component tower is effectively reduced, the steam consumption in the material preheating process is reduced, on the other hand, the temperature of a distillate in the middle part of the tower is increased, the rectification efficiency is further improved, in the styrene production technology, free water in crude benzene is further removed according to an azeotropic principle by adding a filler type auxiliary dehydration tower device, the dehydration load of the light component tower is reduced, the benzene dehydration effect is improved, the abnormal accidents such as catalyst deactivation, tower temperature and tower pressure fluctuation caused by the introduction of free water are effectively avoided, the operation stability of the device is improved, and the technical problem of high energy consumption of intermodal transportation dehydration of the benzene tower/the light component tower in the styrene refining technology is mainly applied to the dehydration aspect of chemical production.

title_en: Method for removing pentavalent arsenic from colloidal iron hydroxide composite polymer in acidic environment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for removing pentavalent arsenic from a colloidal iron hydroxide composite polymer in an acidic environment. The colloidal iron hydroxide composite polymer is a polymer cluster composite structure formed by an acidic amino acid polymer and iron ions; the acidic amino acid polymer adsorbs iron ions through electrostatic attraction; the surface of the acidic amino acid polymer contains carboxyl, the carboxyl directly accelerates the formation of polycation clusters of iron ions under acidic conditions, and further promotes local electron migration, so that hydroxyl bridges (Fe-OH-Fe) in the iron ion clusters are converted into more stable oxidation bridges (Fe-O-Fe), and finally, the colloidal iron hydroxide and acidic polymer composite polymer is generated. The invention synthesizes stable colloidal material directly under acidic condition, and has high specific surface area and activity due to small colloidal particle size, and the colloidal material is dispersed in the pores of the quartz sand of the filling column, so that the material is fully contacted with the arsenic-containing acidic wastewater, and the high-efficiency removal of pentavalent arsenic is realized.

title_en: Cashmere anti-pilling process
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-pilling process for cashmere, which comprises the following steps: firstly, adding cashmere into water, adding a cleaning agent, cleaning at 35-45 ℃ for 10-20 min to obtain cleaned cashmere, and controlling the weight ratio of the cashmere to the cleaning agent to the water to be 1:0.1-0.2:10; removing greasy dirt on the surface of cashmere by washing with a cleaning agent; secondly, placing the cleaned cashmere into a treatment liquid for ultrasonic treatment for 15-25 min at the ultrasonic temperature of 35-45 ℃ to prepare the cashmere after anti-pilling treatment; the cleaning agent can quickly dissolve grease, so that the cleaning efficiency of oil stains on the surface of cashmere is improved, the cashmere is treated by the treatment liquid, an excellent anti-pilling effect can be achieved, meanwhile, the treated cashmere is harmless to a human body in the use process, and the treatment liquid can not cause pollution to the environment in the cashmere treatment process.

title_en: Coating device for building thermal insulation construction
abstract_en: The invention provides a coating device for building thermal insulation construction, which comprises a bearing plate, wherein two ends of the bottom of the bearing plate are rotatably provided with horizontal rotating rods, two ends of each rotating rod are fixedly provided with wheel bodies, the bottom of the bearing plate is rotatably provided with a motor I, and an output shaft of the motor I is connected with one of the rotating rods through a bevel gear assembly I; the top fixed mounting of loading board has the top to be the holding case of opening form, and it is used for storing heat preservation coating, and the top of loading board just is located one side fixed mounting who holds the case and has the connecting block, and the installation piece that is the horizontality is installed at the connecting block top, and the one end of installation piece extends to the loading board outside. The equipment is suitable for coating the heat-insulating paint on the wall surface of the high-rise building, replaces a mode that a safety belt is adopted to hang the staff on the outer side of the wall body or a climbing vehicle is adopted to support the staff, so that the heat-insulating paint coating on the wall surface is completed, the physical strength of the staff is saved, the working efficiency is improved, and the safety is improved.

title_en: Crushing and grading device for aluminum powder production and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of aluminum powder crushing and grading, in particular to a crushing and grading device for aluminum powder production and a use method thereof, the device comprises a base, a feeding treatment assembly is arranged at the left end of the top surface of the base, a feeding pipe is arranged on the feeding treatment assembly, the top surface of the feeding pipe is fixedly connected with a feeding hopper, the lower end of the feeding pipe is communicated with a ball mill body, the middle part of the top surface of the base is provided with a separation box, one end of the ball mill body is arranged on the separation box, a first conveying belt is arranged inside the separation box, one side of the inside of the first conveying belt is in friction contact with a conveying roller, one end of the conveying roller penetrates through the inner wall of the separation box to extend to the outside, and a first motor is arranged on the rear wall of the separation box through a mounting seat. Ensures that the aluminum powder material is fully extruded and crushed in the crushing process, reduces the residue of large-size particles, realizes the rapid separation of aluminum powder and impurities, improves the separation efficiency, reduces the residue of impurities, improves the purity and quality of the aluminum powder, and improves the classification screening precision.

title_en: Corrugated paper thickness detection device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of thickness detection, in particular to a corrugated paper thickness detection device, which comprises a paperboard moving table, a detection assembly and a diversion protection assembly, wherein a detection beam frame is horizontally arranged at the upper end of the paperboard moving table, a reference supporting table is horizontally arranged below the detection beam frame of the paperboard moving table, a thickness measurement module is arranged below the moving installation table through a first installation assembly, the thickness measurement module can be moved to a proper position according to the position of a paperboard to be detected, then the diversion protection assembly is matched during detection, the paperboard to be detected below can be pressed under air flow, so that the paperboard and the reference supporting table are stably attached, the problem of detection accuracy caused by suspension below the paperboard is avoided, heat generated by the operation of the thickness measurement module can be processed during air flow pressing, the heat influence of the operation of the thickness measurement module is avoided, and a transparent lens of the thickness measurement module can be cleaned by a cleaning assembly, so that the operation is simple and the use is convenient.

title_en: Magnesium oxide reducing mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of magnesium oxide production, in particular to a magnesium oxide crushing device, which comprises a crushing box, wherein a feeding channel is arranged at the top of the crushing box, a feeding hole is arranged at the top of the feeding channel, a discharging hole is arranged at the bottom of the crushing box, a crushing mechanism is arranged in the feeding channel, a grinding cylinder is arranged below the crushing mechanism, the section of the grinding cylinder is semicircular, the grinding cylinder is connected with a rotating mechanism, the rotating mechanism is used for driving the grinding cylinder to swing reciprocally, the grinding mechanism is arranged inside the grinding cylinder, a screen plate which is obliquely arranged is arranged below the grinding cylinder, the crushing box is provided with arc-shaped inner walls which are symmetrically distributed, two ends of the screen plate are respectively connected with the two arc-shaped inner walls in a sliding manner, the screen plate is connected with a swinging mechanism, and the swinging mechanism is used for driving the screen plate to swing reciprocally; the invention solves the problem that the grinding cylinder needs to be cleaned frequently by staff in the prior art, saves time and improves the grinding efficiency of magnesium oxide.

title_en: High-low temperature impact test equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses high-low temperature impact test equipment, which comprises a box body, wherein a hanging basket, an elastic pull rod and a sliding bin are arranged in the box body, and a group of clamping parts are respectively arranged in the middle of the upper end and the lower end of the hanging basket in a protruding mode; a group of test bins are respectively arranged above and below the hanging basket, and the opposite surfaces of the two groups of test bins are respectively provided with a first opening for the hanging basket to enter and exit; sealing plates for sealing the first opening are arranged in the two groups of test bins, and an elastic pull rod is connected between the two groups of sealing plates so as to simultaneously seal the two groups of test bins; an upper clamping unit and a lower clamping unit are arranged in the sliding bin and used for clamping the hanging basket; the clamping units comprise two groups of clamping blocks which can be horizontally and relatively slidably arranged in the sliding bin, clamping parts at two ends of the hanging basket are respectively clamped by the clamping units, wedge-shaped parts which can be in sliding contact with the outer wall of the test bin at the same side are arranged on the two groups of clamping blocks in each clamping unit, the two groups of test bins can be alternately opened and closed, the hanging basket can be moved between the two groups of test bins without air leakage, and the stability of the temperature in the test bin is facilitated.

title_en: Comprehensive utilization process of oxygen-sulfur mixed zinc concentrate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive utilization process of oxygen-sulfur mixed zinc concentrate. The comprehensive utilization process of the oxygen-sulfur mixed zinc concentrate comprises the steps of pretreatment, main reaction and post-treatment, and specifically comprises the following steps: mixing slurry of the oxygen-sulfur mixed concentrate to be treated and performing ultrasonic dispersion to obtain a material a; adding an oxygen-sulfur separating agent JH-3000 of the oxygen-sulfur mixed zinc concentrate into the material a for stirring reaction, and gradually scraping foam on the upper part of the solution in the reaction process to obtain foam b and slurry c; filtering the foam b in a solid-liquid way, separating the foam b in a solid-liquid way to obtain a zinc sulfide product and slurry d, and combining the slurry d and the slurry c to obtain the zinc oxide product; sizing the zinc oxide product; acid leaching is carried out after acid supplementing adjustment, and the leaching solution e is purified and electrodeposited to obtain zinc ingots; roasting and sulfuric acid leaching are carried out on the zinc sulfide product after ore matching, and leaching liquid g and leaching slag h are obtained through solid-liquid separation; purifying the leaching solution g and carrying out electrodeposition to obtain zinc ingots; and preparing sulfuric acid from the roasted flue gas by an acid preparation system.

title_en: Pigment disk cleaning device for art design and use method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pigment disk cleaning devices. The invention discloses a pigment plate cleaning device for art design and a use method thereof, comprising a box body, wherein a driving motor, a throwing pipe and a taking-out opening are respectively arranged at the top of the box body, rotating rollers are rotatably arranged at the left side and the right side of the interior of the box body, one rotating roller is in transmission connection with the output end of the driving motor through a belt pulley group, a crawler belt is sleeved on the rotating roller, a toothed ring and an outer frame are respectively symmetrically arranged at the two sides of the interior of the box body in the width direction, a pigment dissolving assembly is arranged between the toothed ring and the outer frame, a double-sided brushing assembly is arranged at the right side of the interior of the box body, and a plate overturning assembly is arranged below the interior of the box body close to the taking-out opening; the invention is convenient for softening the dry pigment, can quickly remove the pigment and shorten the brushing time in the brushing process, can also increase the contact degree of the brushing disc and the pigment disc, ensures that the residual pigment at the separation part of the pigment disc is cleaned, and further improves the cleaning effect of the pigment disc.

title_en: Method for treating port chemical wastewater
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of chemical wastewater, and discloses a method for treating port chemical wastewater, which comprises the following steps: carrying out Fenton oxidation, an MBR (membrane bioreactor) tank and an activated carbon adsorption tank on port chemical wastewater sequentially through a neutralization tank, a coagulating sedimentation tank, a filter and an oxidation tank; the membrane used in the MBR tank is a polyvinylidene fluoride/graphene oxide@Cr composite membrane; the chemical wastewater comprises benzene, styrene, dimethylbenzene and acrylonitrile, and the total concentration of the benzene, the styrene, the dimethylbenzene and the acrylonitrile in the port chemical wastewater is not lower than 7000mg/L. The treatment method is mainly aimed at port chemical wastewater which uses benzene, styrene, dimethylbenzene and acrylonitrile organic compounds as main pollutants, and the chemical wastewater treated by the treatment method can reach the emission standard, and has the advantages of high efficiency, simplicity and the like.

title_en: Grinding and extracting equipment and method for toothpaste production
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of grinding equipment, and discloses grinding and extracting equipment and a method for toothpaste production, wherein the grinding and extracting equipment comprises a grinding cylinder, a granularity adjusting mechanism and a cleaning assembly, wherein a grinding disc is arranged in the grinding cylinder, the granularity adjusting mechanism comprises a plurality of grinding press blocks and a central cylinder, the central cylinder is arranged at the center shaft of the grinding cylinder, the plurality of grinding press blocks are distributed in the grinding cylinder in a circumferential array, the cleaning assembly comprises an aggregate funnel and a plurality of cleaning plates which are obliquely arranged, the aggregate funnel is fixedly arranged in the grinding cylinder, and the cleaning plates are arranged above the aggregate funnel. According to the invention, materials with various sizes can be conveniently ground by controlling the distance between the grinding disc and the grinding press block, and the particle size adjusting mechanism can send the insufficiently ground materials back to the grinding disc for secondary grinding, so that the situation that the materials cannot be sufficiently ground due to the fact that grinding gaps exist between the grinding structures and the sizes of the raw materials are different is avoided.

title_en: Falling film evaporator and evaporator system
abstract_en: The application discloses a falling film evaporator and an evaporator system, which belong to the technical field of evaporators, wherein the falling film evaporator comprises: a heating chamber cylinder for providing a heating steam-producing zone; a separation chamber housing for providing a separation steam zone, the end of the heating chamber barrel extending into the interior of the separation chamber housing; the separation baffle ring structure is arranged at the end part of the heating chamber cylinder body in a surrounding manner, and forms a shielding at the outer side of the separation chamber cylinder body to shield a part of area between the heating chamber cylinder body and the separation chamber shell, so that the separation baffle ring structure can be contacted when steam is discharged from the end part of the heating chamber cylinder body and flows upwards; the evaporator system comprises the multi-effect falling film evaporators, and the multi-effect falling film evaporators are sequentially communicated. The application can quickly separate the alkali liquor from the steam-liquid mixture, effectively reduce the entrainment of the alkali liquor in condensed water in the operation of the falling film evaporator, and improve the alkali liquor removal efficiency.

title_en: Intelligent mixing system for preparing pavement asphalt concrete
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of concrete preparation and mixing, and particularly discloses an intelligent mixing system for preparing pavement asphalt concrete, which comprises a preparation mixing module, a mixing state monitoring module and a mixing adjustment judging module, wherein a mixing adjustment mode selecting module, a stirring mixing control module and a heating mixing control module are adopted, and a mixing dynamic control module is used for carrying out mixing state monitoring and mixing temperature distribution difference monitoring after mixing concrete aggregate and asphalt to form a mixture, so that a preferable mixing adjustment mode in a preferable mode is determined, and a mixing effect and mixing interference are monitored in real time when the mixing adjustment mode is adopted, and the energy consumption and the environmental influence can be furthest reduced on the basis of ensuring that the mixing quality reaches the standard according to the dynamic change adjustment mode, thereby realizing sustainable operation of mixing adjustment of the asphalt concrete, leading the whole preparation process to be more flexible and efficient and having higher practical value.

title_en: Centrifugal casting equipment for high-strength heat-resistant alloy
abstract_en: The invention discloses centrifugal casting equipment for high-strength heat-resistant alloy, which relates to the technical field of alloy casting equipment and comprises a frame, a rotating disc frame and a plurality of centrifuges, wherein a plurality of pouring cup mechanisms are arranged on the rotating disc frame, each pouring cup mechanism comprises a motor main body, an arc-shaped plate frame and a pouring cup main body, a bracket is arranged on the frame, two servo motors are arranged on the bracket, a fixed frame is arranged below each servo motor, a rope reel mechanism A and a rope reel mechanism B are arranged in the fixed frame, a plate spring is arranged at the end part of the rope reel mechanism B, a moving mechanism is also arranged in the fixed frame, a soft scraper is fixedly arranged at one end of the moving mechanism, slag on the inner wall of the pouring cup main body is cleaned by using the two soft scrapers, and a cleaning agent in the storage sleeve is sprayed onto the surface of the slag through the soft pipeline under the action of the storage sleeve and the soft pipeline, so that the soft scraper can process slag with high binding force.

title_en: Breathable oil-proof filter element, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ventilation and oil-proof filter element, which comprises the following steps: taking wool and viscose fibers, and needling the wool and the viscose fibers into single-layer filtering base cloth through a needling machine; compounding more than two layers of single-layer filter base cloth to prepare a rudiment base cloth of the filter element; flattening the filter element embryonic base cloth; preparing a three-proofing finishing solution, and then arranging the flattened filter element embryonic form base in the prepared three-proofing finishing solution for soaking; pressing, drying and shaping. The invention also discloses application of the breathable oil-proof filter element. The invention can solve the problems of blockage and oil leakage caused by the adhesion of oil mist to the automobile oil-related parts.

title_en: Continuous cloth spray-dyeing device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a continuous cloth spray-dyeing device, which belongs to the field of textile dyeing, can realize continuous spray-dyeing of cloth and reduce the problem of reduced spray-dyeing efficiency caused by scattering, and is characterized in that the cloth is wound on the outer side of a guide cylinder a in a transmission way, the outer end wall of the guide cylinder a is provided with a grid structure, the dye is sprayed on the guide cylinder a by the cooperation of the spray pipe a, so that the dye can be acted on cloth passing through the outer side of the guide cylinder a in a circular heat radiation range, the dye can be directly acted on the cloth under the action of pressure by forming a circular diffusion dye spraying mode, the action range is balanced and maximized, and the uniform and comprehensive coverage of the cloth in the spray dyeing process is improved.

title_en: Automatic straw forage grass baling device
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic straw forage grass baling device, belongs to the technical field of feed processing, and solves the problems that after straw is baled under the wet condition, the straw is easy to rot and mould in the stacking and storing process, so that livestock die and cause loss. The automatic straw forage grass baling device comprises a fixing plate, wherein two first support columns are fixed on the fixing plate, a crushing box is fixed on the support columns, two second support columns are fixed on the fixing plate, a first motor is fixed on the second support columns, a crushing mechanism is arranged between the first motor and the crushing box, the crushing box is communicated with the crushing box through an inclined connecting pipe, an air cylinder is fixed at the upper end of the crushing box, a pressing plate is connected in the sliding mode in the crushing box, a round groove is formed in the pressing plate, a plurality of heating rods are connected in the sliding mode in the round groove, and a pressing plate is connected at the lower end of the pressing plate in the sliding mode. The invention has the advantage of avoiding the straw from being baled under the moist condition.

title_en: Composite mechanical arm for separating single seed absorption spectrum activity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composite mechanical arm for separating absorption spectrum activity of single seeds, which comprises a mechanical steering platform, an integrated absorption excitation module and an optical signal collection detection module, wherein the integrated absorption excitation module is arranged on the mechanical steering platform and can adsorb seeds to be detected, the mechanical steering platform rotates the integrated absorption excitation module to the position right above the optical signal collection detection module, the seeds are excited by utilizing super-continuous light emitted from an absorption excitation port of the integrated absorption excitation module, the optical signal collection module can collect and detect the super-continuous light which is transmitted through the seeds, so that the activity information of the seeds is judged, the functions of absorption, spectrum detection and separation of the seeds can be realized through the scheme, and the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Circuit board drying device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a circuit board drying device, which relates to the technical field of circuit board drying and comprises a circuit board main body, wherein a wiping and drying mechanism is arranged in an outer frame structure, the wiping and drying mechanism comprises a fan, wiping cotton and water-absorbing cotton, the fan is rotationally connected in the frame body, the wiping cotton is arranged at the top end of the fan, the water-absorbing cotton is arranged in the frame body, the fan is used for generating wind force in the outer frame structure, the wiping cotton is used for wiping the surface of the circuit board main body, the water-absorbing cotton is used for drying the surface moisture of the circuit board main body, dust on the surface of the circuit board can be wiped through the arrangement of a limiting rod, a horizontal moving rod and the wiping cotton, the dust can cause the connection problem between circuits, the wiping can ensure the surface cleaning of the circuit board, the risk of circuit failure is reduced, and thus the electrical performance is improved.

title_en: Catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a catalyst, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of chemical industry. The catalyst comprises a carrier and an active component; the active component is metallic nickel, the carrier is silicon dioxide, and the nickel is loaded on the surface of the silicon dioxide; wherein the specific surface area of the silicon dioxide is 7-12 m  2 /g, and the total pore volume is 0.005-0.035 m  3 /g. The self-made silica carrier has the characteristics of small specific surface area and small pore volume, so that the reaction product is effectively prevented from further staying on the catalyst after being changed into hydroxylamine and is continuously hydrogenated to form aniline, the catalyst has a good inhibiting effect on hydrogenation depth, the reaction selectivity for synthesizing hydroxylamine by nitro hydrogenation has great advantages, the raw material conversion rate reaches 100%, the product selectivity reaches 98.5% -99%, and the catalyst can realize continuous production of the catalyst on a fixed bed by simple sheeting forming.

title_en: Screw shell grinding equipment, screw shell grinding method and feed processing technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses screw shell grinding equipment, a grinding method and a feed processing technology, and relates to the technical field of grinding equipment. The invention includes a housing. According to the screw shell grinding device, the driving assembly is started to drive the transmission assembly to drive the grinding assembly to rotate relatively, the second wedge block can be driven to rotate by matching with the mounting frame in the rotation process of the filtering assembly, the second wedge block is in intermittent contact with the first wedge block, the first wedge block is further intermittently pushed to move, the sliding block is matched with the sliding block to drive the impact block to move, when the second wedge block is separated from the first wedge block, the sliding block is pushed to move under the elastic force of the spring, the sliding block pushes the impact block to impact the filtering assembly, vibration can be further generated, qualified screw shell powder is screened, unqualified large particles are continuously ground, and the working efficiency of the screw shell grinding device is improved.

title_en: 3LPE (low-pressure polyethylene) anti-corrosion steel pipe winding device and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of steel pipe processing, in particular to a 3LPE anti-corrosion steel pipe winding device and a control method thereof, wherein the device comprises a base and a plurality of brackets, and further comprises: the movable frame is arranged on the base through the translation driving assembly so as to horizontally move on the base; the winding box body is fixed on the side wall of the movable frame, and an annular cavity is formed in the winding box body; the plurality of yielding support assemblies are arranged corresponding to the brackets and are jointly used for clamping and supporting the steel pipes, and when the winding box body passes through the yielding support assemblies, the corresponding yielding support assemblies are pushed to overturn and yield, so that the steel pipes do not need to move and vibrate; the device is arranged through the plurality of abdication supporting components, so that when the anti-corrosion winding processing is carried out on the slender steel pipe, the stable supporting can be realized on the slender steel pipe through the supporting of the linear array, and the condition that the anti-corrosion winding effect is influenced due to the bending of the steel pipe under the action of self gravity is reduced.

title_en: Automobile hub spraying equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hub spraying and discloses automobile hub spraying equipment, which comprises a base, wherein a shell is fixedly arranged at the top of the base, an organic cover is fixedly arranged at the top of the shell, an outer ring shell and an inner ring shell which are vertically symmetrically arranged are respectively and fixedly arranged at the top of the base, the upper outer ring shell and the lower outer ring shell are fixedly connected through fixing plates, a shaft rod A is movably arranged between the outer ring shell and the inner ring shell, a locking assembly is fixedly arranged at the top of the shaft rod A, a hub piece is sleeved at the top of the locking assembly, the hub piece is placed on a frustum, the weight of the hub piece can press a baffle plate and a pressing plate to move downwards, a slide rod A, a slide plate and a slide seat move downwards along the shaft rod B, the slide seat moves downwards to press a cross arm to be folded, then the clamping plate can expand outwards, and the clamping plate can be pressed against the inner wall of the hub piece, so that the hub piece is fixed in position, and the hub piece is prevented from shaking.

title_en: Circulation system of granular materials for workpiece polishing
abstract_en: The invention provides a granular material circulation system for workpiece polishing, which comprises a first support and a vibrating spring, wherein a screening plate is connected to the bottom of a vibrating support, a plurality of screening holes are formed in the screening plate, a first driving mechanism is used for driving the vibrating support to vibrate, two first supporting rollers are horizontally arranged on a second support in a rotating mode, a feed back belt is wound between the outer walls of the two first supporting rollers, a second supporting roller is rotatably arranged on the outer sides of two ends and a bending position of a third support in a rotating mode, two belt pressing rollers are rotatably arranged on the inner side of the bending position of the third support, a lifting belt is in an annular L shape, three second supporting rollers are attached to the inner wall of the lifting belt, the two belt pressing rollers are respectively abutted to the outer sides of the bending position of the lifting belt, a third driving mechanism is used for driving the second supporting rollers to rotate, and the lifting hopper is in a cover shape. The invention provides a novel circulating system of granular materials for workpiece polishing.

title_en: Reaction kettle for styrene-butadiene latex
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of reaction kettles, in particular to a reaction kettle for styrene-butadiene latex, which comprises a kettle body and a stirring shaft, wherein the stirring shaft is arranged in the kettle body, a driving motor is arranged on a kettle cover of the kettle body, the stirring shaft is arranged on a rotating shaft of the driving motor, the reaction kettle also comprises first connecting rings, second connecting rings, first connecting arms and second connecting arms, wherein the first connecting rings are vertically distributed and are arranged on the stirring shaft, each first connecting ring is provided with the first connecting arms which are symmetrically distributed, and the second connecting arms are respectively arranged on the first connecting rings and are inclined to the inner wall of the kettle body and are symmetrical with respect to the center of the axis of the stirring shaft. According to the invention, the inclined scraping plate is used for disturbing the material close to the inner wall of the kettle body, and guiding the material to flow continuously to the middle of the kettle body, namely to the position close to the stirring shaft, and the inclined scraping plate has smaller movement resistance.

title_en: Irradiation type energy-saving plant growth lamp
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of plant illumination, and discloses an irradiation type energy-saving plant growth lamp, which comprises a mounting bracket, wherein a plurality of lamp panels are arranged in the mounting bracket, a movable heat dissipation mechanism is arranged at the top of the mounting bracket, when the lamp panels are required to be effectively dissipated, a motor and a plurality of equipped heat dissipation fans are started by a user, the output end of the motor drives a screw rod to rotate, a movable support is enabled to move along a sliding rail through a sliding mechanism by the screw rod, the movement of the movable support drives a connecting plate to slide, the heat dissipation fans on the connecting plate can accelerate air circulation around the heat dissipation fins, so that the heat dissipation efficiency of the lamp panels is rapidly improved.

title_en: Be used for graphite alkene RFID antenna chip automatic weld device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic welding device for a graphene RFID antenna chip, which is applied to the technical field of antenna processing, and the automatic welding device comprises an automatic welding machine body and a positioning mechanism, wherein the automatic welding machine body can drive the positioning mechanism to move to a required welding position and weld, a suction component can suck air at a bearing component to generate negative pressure at the bearing component, an adjusting component can drive an adaptation component to rotate, the size that adaptation subassembly can change the air pumping along with adjusting part's drive, positioning module can carry out the temporary support and spacing to bearing assembly, and the suction subassembly can cooperate with adaptation subassembly, changes the size of interval between the adaptation subassembly through adjusting part to can adapt to different graphite alkene RFID antenna chip model sizes, further position graphite alkene RFID antenna chip, improved the flexibility when spacing to graphite alkene RFID antenna chip.

title_en: Particle bioelectrode based on metal-loaded sodium alginate carbon aerogel and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a particle bioelectrode based on metal-supported sodium alginate carbon aerogel, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of particle electrode preparation; the mass ratio of the three components is (6-8) to (1-3) to 1. According to the invention, the metal-supported sodium alginate carbon aerogel is used as a substrate, and is subjected to functional modification through starch and garden soil, so that the electrochemical performance and stability of the particle bioelectrode are improved; so that the catalyst can be used for various bioelectrochemical systems and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Biological fertilizer preparation equipment based on blue algae mud recycling and use method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a biological fertilizer preparation device based on blue algae mud recycling and a use method thereof, comprising a device bottom plate, a pretreatment tank, a preparation box body and a biological fertilizer integrated preparation mechanism, wherein the pretreatment tank is arranged on one side of the top of the device bottom plate, the preparation box body is arranged on the side surface of the pretreatment tank, the biological fertilizer integrated preparation mechanism is arranged in the pretreatment tank and the preparation box body, the blue algae mud is automatically prepared, and the preparation box body consists of a fermentation chamber at the top and a crushing chamber at the bottom. In the invention, the pretreatment, fermentation and crushing operation of the blue algae mud can be independently and synchronously carried out, so that the efficiency of preparing the biofertilizer from the blue algae mud is improved to the maximum extent.

title_en: Building water supply and drainage system
abstract_en: The application relates to a building water supply and drainage system, which relates to the technical field of building drainage and comprises a water collection top, wherein a water drain pipe communicated with the water collection top is fixed on the water collection top, a filtering device for filtering rainwater is arranged on the water drain pipe, the filtering device comprises a rotary table rotationally connected on the water drain pipe, a plurality of water drain channels penetrating through the rotary table are arranged on the rotary table, the water drain channels are uniformly distributed along the circumferential direction of the rotary table, the diameters of the water drain channels are gradually reduced from two ends to the middle, the inner diameter of the water drain pipe is larger than the maximum diameter of the water drain channel, a filtering mechanism for filtering rainwater is arranged in the middle position of the water drain channel, a water collecting bucket coaxial with the rotary table is fixed on the water drain pipe below the rotary table, the rotary table is rotationally connected on the water collecting bucket, and the water drain system further comprises a driving device for enabling the rotary table to automatically rotate and enabling adjacent water drain channels to be communicated with the water drain pipe. The application has the effect of conveniently filtering rainwater.

title_en: Method for improving nanofiltration membrane separation performance through alkali regulation and control and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving the separation performance of a nanofiltration membrane by alkali regulation and control and application thereof, comprising the steps of immersing a PAN membrane in NaOH solution, and wiping off superfluous NaOH solution on the surface of a base membrane to prepare an alkali-treated PAN membrane; immersing the PAN film in ferric chloride solution, taking out the film after the reaction is finished, thoroughly flushing with deionized water, adding TA solution to form a selective layer, flushing with deionized water, and drying. The invention provides a preparation method of a green convenient Gao Jieliu nanofiltration membrane, which takes TA and FeCl  3  as raw materials, adopts NaOH to pre-wet a basal membrane, concentrates iron ions, releases the ions in the coordination reaction process, prepares a metal-polyphenol complexed nanofiltration membrane on the surface of a PAN basal membrane so as to realize the efficient separation of inorganic salt and organic micromolecular substances, and ensures that the interception capacity of the Fe-TA-10 membrane on the inorganic salt reaches 96.37 percent and the interception rate of the Fe-TA-10 on various medicines with relative molecular masses ranging from 365.4 (amoxicillin) to 822.94 (rifampicin) reaches 98.96 percent at most.

title_en: Chemical raw material mixes uses mechanical grinding device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of grinding devices, and discloses a mechanical grinding device for mixing chemical raw materials, which comprises a grinding container, the internally mounted of grinding container has screening seat, screening seat's top is provided with the grinding subassembly, grinding subassembly and screening seat adaptation. When chemical raw materials are required to be input, the first rotating seat is rotated firstly, so that the material receiving hole on the first rotating seat corresponds to the material discharging hole of the material storage container, at the moment, the perforation on the second rotating seat is staggered with the material receiving hole, after the chemical raw materials enter the material receiving hole, the first rotating seat is rotated, so that the material receiving hole is staggered with the material storage container, at the moment, the second rotating seat is matched with rotation, so that the material receiving hole and the perforation are communicated when the material receiving hole is not communicated with the material discharging hole of the material storage container, and the chemical raw materials enter the grinding container through the perforation to finish grinding.

title_en: Natural gas proportion hydrogen-adding proportioning equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a natural gas proportion mixes hydrogen proportioning equipment, be provided with first governing valve and second governing valve, and make the pressure balance gas entry of first governing valve and the pressure balance gas entry of second governing valve pass through the pressure regulating pipeline and connect, through aerify to the pressure regulating inflation inlet, and finally make the elastic membrane upper and lower extreme of first governing valve and second governing valve maintain balance, thereby make the exit pressure of first governing valve and second governing valve the same, the output proportion of rethread proportional valve accurate regulation hydrogen, thereby accurate high-efficient completion natural gas and hydrogen mix.

title_en: Coal crushing equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses coal crushing equipment, which relates to the field of coal crushing and comprises the following components: the invention relates to a crushing box body and two symmetrically distributed crushing rollers rotatably arranged in the crushing box body, wherein the two ends of each crushing roller are fixedly sleeved with a transmission fluted disc, the transmission fluted disc is distributed outside the crushing box body, the two transmission fluted discs positioned on the same side are meshed with each other, and the two crushing rollers are driven by a motor to synchronously and reversely rotate, so that massive coal is crushed.

title_en: Ultrasonic cleaning system and cleaning method for sedimentation tank with obstacle avoidance function
