abstract_en: The invention relates to an ultrasonic cleaning system and a cleaning method for a sedimentation tank with an obstacle avoidance function, wherein the ultrasonic cleaning system comprises a fixing device, a lifting device, an ultrasonic cleaning device, an obstacle avoidance device and a control electric box; the sedimentation tank includes the open cell body in top, and the upper portion of cell body is equipped with the work bridge of following cell body circumference direction motion, and fixing device's upper portion detachably installs on the lateral wall of work bridge, and the inboard at the work bridge is installed to the control electronic box, and ultrasonic cleaning device corresponds to set up near each wall that the cell body needs clear, keeps away the barrier device and includes proximity switch and sensing element. The invention has the advantages of convenient disassembly and assembly, strong pool type adaptability, low vibration noise, long service life, low use cost, safety, reliability and the like.

title_en: Rare earth/alkaline earth metal composite ordered porous carbon material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rare earth/alkaline earth metal composite ordered porous carbon material, a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of composite materials, wherein the preparation method of the rare earth/alkaline earth metal composite ordered porous carbon material comprises (1) dispersing the ordered porous carbon material in a soluble calcium salt solution, and uniformly stirring to obtain a suspension; and (2) dropwise adding an alkaline hydrogen peroxide solution into the suspension, uniformly stirring, carrying out vacuum suction filtration, washing, decompressing and suction filtering to obtain a solid, and (3) placing the washed solid into a rare earth metal salt solution, adding alkali liquor, uniformly stirring, carrying out vacuum suction filtration, washing, decompressing and suction filtering to obtain the solid, and drying to obtain the rare earth/alkaline earth metal composite ordered porous carbon material. The preparation method is simple, has strong operability and reproducibility, and the composite material has the characteristics of stable performance, excellent effect, wide use conditions, environmental friendliness, good regeneration performance and the like.

title_en: Preparation method of Ru@Ir@Pt multilayer core-shell catalyst for ammoxidation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an Ru@Ir@Pt multilayer core-shell catalyst for ammoxidation, which comprises the steps of dissolving PVP and RuCl  3 ⋅3H 2  O in a mixed solution of HCHO and EG to obtain a dark brown solution, heating the obtained dark brown solution in a high-pressure reaction kettle to obtain black liquid, adding PVP and Ir (acac)  3  into the obtained black liquid and benzyl alcohol to obtain black solution, heating, washing and drying to obtain black powder, dissolving the obtained black powder, PVP and Pt (acac)  2  in benzyl alcohol to obtain black solution, and heating to obtain the Ru@Ir@Pt multilayer core-shell catalyst. The preparation method is characterized in that the Pt-based multi-layer core-shell catalyst for ammoxidation is synthesized for the first time by a simple solvothermal method by gradual heating. The invention not only has remarkable ammoxidation catalytic performance, but also has good stability, abundant raw materials, less consumption, low energy consumption and high yield, and can realize low-cost large-scale production and preparation.

title_en: Catalyst for phenol hydroxylation and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of molecular sieve preparation, and in particular relates to a catalyst for phenol hydroxylation, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the catalyst is an organic base modified TS-1 molecular sieve catalyst, and the preparation method comprises the following steps of dispersing an uncalcined TS-1 zeolite matrix in an organic alkali solution, then carrying out hydrothermal crystallization reaction, and carrying out aftertreatment and roasting to obtain the catalyst for phenol hydroxylation. Compared with the prior art, the invention adopts the alkali treatment method to modify the TS-1 molecular sieve, thereby improving the hydrophobicity and the diffusion performance, effectively regulating the distribution of titanium of the titanium-silicon molecular sieve catalyst, leading the catalyst to have better catalytic activity and selectivity in the phenol hydroxylation reaction, and improving the o-comparison of the selectivity of the benzene diphenol and the benzene diphenol on the basis of controlling the conversion rate of the phenol.

title_en: Method for recycling and co-producing high-throughput liquefied natural gas by multistage separation of ethane
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ethane recovery and natural gas liquefaction, in particular to a method for coproducing high-throughput liquefied natural gas by multistage separation ethane recovery. The natural gas liquefaction process and the ethane recovery process are mutually independent, and two independent refrigeration systems are used for recovering ethane first and then liquefying natural gas, so that the energy consumption ratio is large. In order to solve the problems, the invention provides a method for recycling and co-producing high-throughput liquefied natural gas by multistage separation ethane, which comprises a multistage separation ethane recycling unit, a liquefied natural gas unit, a mixed refrigerant refrigeration cycle unit and a propane refrigeration cycle unit, wherein the natural gas liquefaction process and the ethane recycling process, the mixed refrigerant refrigeration cycle unit and the propane refrigeration cycle unit share a set of device system, so that the ethane recycling can be realized, the natural gas liquefaction can be realized, the mixed refrigerant refrigeration cycle unit and the propane refrigeration cycle unit can be used in a combined way, the investment and operation and maintenance cost can be reduced, the adaptability of the device to the throughput and the gas quality can be improved, and the resource integration and the benefit maximization of the oil-gas field and the gas field upstream and downstream of the oil-gas treatment can be realized.

title_en: Motor with air inlet dust filtering function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ventilation motors, and discloses a motor with an air inlet dust filtering function, which comprises a double-shaft motor, wherein two ends of the double-shaft motor are respectively and fixedly connected with a rotating shaft, one end of the double-shaft motor is fixedly connected with a protective shell, the motor also comprises an air inlet dust filtering mechanism, the air inlet dust filtering mechanism comprises an air suction fan fixedly connected with the rotating shaft and close to the outer wall of one end of the protective shell, the rotating shaft is sleeved on the outer wall of one end of the rotating shaft and is fixedly connected with a rotating sleeve, the double-shaft motor is started, the rotating shaft drives the rotating shaft to drive the rotating shaft to rotate, the air suction fan generates suction force so as to ventilate, the air flow is filtered by the arrangement of a filter screen, the rotating shaft drives a square plate to rotate, the square plate drives a sponge plate to rotate, dust particles blocked at the filtering hole of the filter screen are cleaned in the rotation process of the sponge plate, the filtering hole of the filter screen is prevented from being blocked, and the dust filtering effect of the filter screen is enhanced.

title_en: Automatic cleaning device and method for intelligent photovoltaic panel
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic cleaning device for an intelligent photovoltaic panel, which comprises photovoltaic panel brackets for clamping and fixing four corners of the photovoltaic panel, a working gap is reserved between photovoltaic bracket plates at two ends of the same side, a cleaning vehicle moving along the length direction of the working gap below the photovoltaic panel, the cleaning vehicle comprises a moving base with driving wheels, the movable base is provided with parallel bosses along two sides of the length direction of the working gap, the bosses are provided with mounting grooves along the length direction of the working gap, the mounting grooves are internally provided with sliding rails and sliding seats along the length direction of the working gap, the sliding seats on two sides are provided with cleaning brushes and limiting heads, and the limiting heads are used for fixing the rotating ends of the cleaning brushes, so that the cleaning brushes span across the photovoltaic panel. The invention also provides an automatic cleaning method. The device provided by the invention can effectively clean dust and dirt on the surface of the photovoltaic panel.

title_en: Moon cake stuffing stirring equipment for moon cake production and processing
abstract_en: The application relates to moon cake stuffing stirring equipment for moon cake production and processing, which relates to the technical field related to moon cake processing, and comprises a stirring barrel, a central spindle, a sleeve piece, a sliding sleeve, a first connecting rod, a rotating component, a trigger piece, a stirring component and a turnover component, wherein the application can solve the problem that the uniformity of moon cake stuffing in the mixing process is not considered in the prior art, the moon cake stuffing is stirred through stirring blades with a single structure, the stirring mode of the structure is single and simple, in the whole stirring process, the stirring directions of the stirring blades are consistent all the time, and the stirring tracks are consistent, so that most of moon cake stuffing is in a specific area, but because the ingredients of the moon cake stuffing contain more than ten kinds and are different in sealing, the single stirring structures are difficult to mix with each other quickly, the situation of layering of raw materials is easy to occur, the stirring time is prolonged for improving the mixing uniformity, and the situation that local moon cake stuffing is likely to be agglomerated and the like is likely to occur along with the increase of time.

title_en: Device and method for producing 2-imidazolidinone through continuous kettle-type reaction
abstract_en: The invention provides a device and a method for producing 2-imidazolidinone by continuous kettle type reaction, belonging to the technical field of 2-imidazolidinone preparation. The device for producing 2-imidazolidinone by continuous kettle type reaction comprises a reaction material storage tank, N reaction kettles, a receiving kettle and a tail gas absorbing device, wherein the N reaction kettles are sequentially communicated, a feed inlet of a first reaction kettle is communicated with the reaction material storage tank, an air outlet of the reaction kettle is communicated with the tail gas absorbing device, the receiving kettle is communicated with an N reaction kettle, N is 3-5, and the reaction material storage tank comprises a urea solution storage tank and an ethylenediamine storage tank. By adopting the device, continuous stepwise reaction can be realized by controlling the reaction conditions, the reaction time for preparing the 2-imidazolidone is shortened from 10-20 hours to 4-8 hours, the reaction efficiency is greatly improved, and the occurrence of side reaction is effectively controlled.

title_en: Raw material crushing device for preparing composite soil remediation agent
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of crushing of soil restoration materials, and particularly provides a raw material crushing device for preparing a composite soil restoration, which comprises a conveying frame, a separation type primary crushing treatment assembly, a bidirectional cutting type crushing assembly and a pressing type crushing mechanism, wherein the separation type primary crushing treatment assembly is connected to the end part of the conveying direction of the conveying frame, the pressing type crushing mechanism is arranged at the upper part of the conveying frame, and the bidirectional cutting type crushing assembly is connected to one side of the separation type primary crushing treatment assembly far away from the pressing type crushing mechanism.

title_en: Bending machine for manufacturing ship
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of bending machines, in particular to a bending machine for manufacturing ships, which comprises a bending machine, wherein the bending machine comprises a sliding block, an upper die and a lower die, the upper die is arranged at the lower end of the sliding block, the lower die is arranged on a workbench of the bending machine, the upper die and the sliding block are quickly disassembled and assembled through a disassembly and assembly mechanism, the disassembly and assembly mechanism comprises a through groove arranged at the bottom of an inner cavity of the sliding block, and a positive motor and a negative motor are arranged outside the sliding block.

title_en: Automatic production unit of full-electric injection molding machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic production unit of an all-electric injection molding machine, which comprises the all-electric injection molding machine, a stub bar crushing device, a stub bar conveying device, a box conveying system, an intelligent sampling device and a manipulator, wherein a conveying pipe is arranged at the bottom of the all-electric injection molding machine, the stub bar crushing device is arranged at one side of the all-electric injection molding machine, the stub bar conveying device is fixed on the all-electric injection molding machine and is used for conveying stub bars into the stub bar crushing device, the box conveying system is fixed at the lower side of the all-electric injection molding machine, one side of the box conveying system is arranged at the lower end of the conveying pipe, the intelligent sampling device is arranged on the all-electric injection molding machine and is used for collecting defective products or samples, and the manipulator is fixed on the all-electric injection molding machine and is used for conveying finished products or grabbing the stub bars into the stub bar conveying device.

title_en: Diode heat dissipation and compression mounting structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of diode welding, in particular to a diode heat dissipation and pressure mounting structure, which comprises a welding gun head, wherein an assembly hole is formed upwards from the bottom end of the welding gun head, a heat conduction sleeve is filled in the assembly hole, a copper sleeve is fixed at the bottom end of the welding gun head, a buffer cavity which is vertically communicated with the assembly hole is arranged in the copper sleeve, a welding nozzle is arranged in the buffer cavity, the top end of the welding nozzle passes through the assembly hole to enter the heat conduction sleeve, the bottom end of the welding nozzle passes through the outside of the bottom end of the copper sleeve, a baffle plate which is slidingly assembled in the buffer cavity is fixed on the welding nozzle, a spring sleeved on the periphery of the welding nozzle is filled in the buffer cavity, and a diode body is pressed by a falling pressure cover during welding, so that the pin cannot be separated from a guide hole on a circuit board, the diode body cannot deviate, and the welding quality is improved.

title_en: Municipal administration sewage pipe network drainage purification treatment device
abstract_en: The application relates to a municipal sewage pipe network drainage purification treatment device, which relates to the field of municipal drainage purification, and comprises a mounting frame, a impurity removing cover plate, an interception grid frame, a self-supply interception mechanism, an odor-resistant purification mechanism and a deodorizing purification mechanism, wherein the mounting frame is used for being mounted on a drainage pipeline at the edge of a road, the impurity removing cover plate is hinged to the top of the mounting frame, the interception grid frame is connected to the mounting frame in a sliding manner, the self-supply interception mechanism is arranged between the mounting frame and the interception grid frame and used for controlling the interception grid frame to move to the outer side or the inner side of the drainage pipeline according to the rainfall and reminding a vehicle to pay attention to avoiding the interception grid frame, and the odor-resistant purification mechanism is arranged below the impurity removing cover plate and used for performing secondary filtration on impurities in rainwater and performing odor-resistant treatment on filtered impurities. The application has the effects of ensuring that the water outlet of the urban road is not easy to be blocked in stormwater, improving the efficiency of purifying, intercepting and draining garbage at the water outlet and reducing the adverse effects on urban drainage and traffic.

title_en: Hydraulic structure of ultra-deep rotary filter screen
abstract_en: Compared with the prior art, the hydraulic structure of the ultra-deep rotary filter screen has the advantages that sundries in water flow are filtered for the first time through the protective screen, meanwhile, the filter screen and the protective screen move reversely, the cleaning brush head on the protective screen brushes the filter screen to clean the filter screen, the filter screen is kept clean and unblocked, the filter screen is prevented from being blocked due to the fact that pollutants adhere to the filter screen, the middle and large-sized sundries on the protective screen are stirred or the speed of a double-output-shaft servo motor is controlled to be increased through the cleaning screw rod in the sundries cleaning device, the sundries are stirred up through the cleaning screw rod, finally, after the booster pump and the booster water jet are used for double boosting, the filter screen, the cleaning brush head and the protective screen are washed, the filter efficiency is prevented from being blocked, and the hydraulic structure is simple and practical and is not easy to damage.

title_en: A stirred tank for producing amino acid water-soluble fertilizer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of stirred tanks, in particular to a stirred tank for producing an amino acid water-soluble fertilizer, which comprises a stirred tank body, wherein a fixed cover is fixedly connected to the stirred tank body, a connecting pipe is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the fixed cover, a rotating frame is rotatably connected to the fixed cover, a plurality of containing covers are fixedly connected to the rotating frame, a stirring mechanism is arranged in the rotating connection of the containing covers, a flushing mechanism is arranged in the rotating connection of the containing covers, a water guide driving seat is fixedly connected to one side outer wall of the containing cover, a water guide frame is arranged on the containing cover in a sliding fit manner, when the stirred tank is used for producing the amino acid water-soluble fertilizer, different stirring modes are flexibly adjusted according to different material characteristics and process requirements, the mixing uniformity of materials is improved, the mass transfer rate of the materials is improved, the reaction rate is controlled, and the like, and the mixing uniformity, the quality stability and the high efficiency of the production process are ensured.

title_en: Track iron tooth gumming device and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of general processes for coating fluid on surfaces, provides a dipping process which has no special requirement on track iron teeth, can be used for dipping the track iron teeth in different shapes and sizes, has higher working efficiency and can double the number of dipped workpieces, and particularly relates to a dipping device for various track iron teeth and a working method thereof. The invention comprises a glue storage mechanism, a lifting mechanism, a transverse moving mechanism, a transmission frame, an upper frame and hooks. According to the invention, the automatic lifting and transverse moving mechanism is integrated to continuously carry out gum dipping treatment on the track iron teeth, more track iron teeth are treated at the same time, the production efficiency is improved, the number of hooks can be adjusted according to the production requirement, so that different quantities of track iron teeth are treated, if the yield is required to be increased, the quantity of hooks and liquid frames can be increased, and the expandability enables the device to adapt to different production scales and requirements.

title_en: Nanofiltration pipeline direct drinking water wastewater-free integrated equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a nanofiltration pipeline direct drinking water wastewater-free integrated device which comprises a controller, a basic pipeline, a raw water electric valve, a water purifying first tank, a water purifying pump, a biological activated carbon tank, a nanofiltration membrane device, a water purifying electric valve, a water purifying second tank and a water purifying pressurizing pump, wherein the nanofiltration membrane device comprises a shell and a hollow nanofiltration membrane pipe, a front water inlet, a circulating water outlet and a rear water purifying port are arranged on the shell, the front water inlet and the circulating water outlet are communicated with the inner cavity of the hollow nanofiltration membrane pipe, the rear water purifying port is communicated with the outer side of the hollow nanofiltration membrane pipe, a water producing circulating pipeline is connected to the water purifying first tank, and the inlet of the water producing circulating pipeline is connected with the circulating water outlet.

title_en: Drying equipment for ceramic heat insulation board forming
abstract_en: The application relates to drying equipment for ceramic heat insulation board forming, and relates to the technical field of ceramic product production, comprising a drying box, a mounting plate, a clamping assembly, a first adjusting assembly, a second adjusting assembly and a driving and fixing assembly; the drying box comprises a mounting plate, a clamping assembly, a first adjusting assembly, a second adjusting assembly and a driving and fixing assembly, wherein the mounting plate is arranged on the opening side of the drying box, the clamping assembly is arranged on the mounting plate and comprises a clamping plate, a clamping rod and a clamping head, one end of the clamping rod is connected to the mounting plate in a rotating mode, the clamping head is arranged on the clamping rod in a sliding mode, the first adjusting assembly is used for adjusting the rotating angle of the clamping rod, the second adjusting assembly is used for adjusting the sliding position of the clamping head, the driving and fixing assembly is used for driving the first adjusting assembly to adjust the clamping rod and driving the second adjusting assembly to adjust the clamping head, and the driving and fixing assembly is used for fixing the adjusted position of the clamping rod and the adjusted position of the clamping head. The application has the effect of meeting the installation requirements of ceramic heat insulation boards with different sizes on drying equipment.

title_en: Multifunctional adjustable breathing mask for plateau cold region
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical equipment, and particularly discloses a multifunctional adjustable breathing mask for a plateau cold region, which comprises a head integral protective cover and an adjustable breathing mask, wherein the adjustable breathing mask is fixedly arranged at the lower part of the front side of the inner wall of the head integral protective cover, a transparent ultraviolet-proof panel is fixedly arranged in an upper groove of the front side of the inner wall of the head integral protective cover, an installation shell with an opening at the rear side is correspondingly and fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the transparent ultraviolet-proof panel, two-way reciprocating assemblies are correspondingly and fixedly arranged between the left side and the right side of the inner wall of the installation shell, and moving rods are symmetrically and fixedly arranged at the bottoms of the left end and the right end of the two-way reciprocating assemblies, so that the multifunctional adjustable breathing mask for the plateau cold region has the advantages of reasonable and practical structure, diversified functions and convenient operation, has good automatic defogging and ultraviolet-proof functions, and well meets the use requirements of the plateau cold region.

title_en: Liquid preparation system convenient for switching feeding
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of liquid preparation and discloses a liquid preparation system convenient for switching and feeding, which comprises a mixing tank, wherein a plurality of evenly distributed raw material tanks are fixed on the outer wall of the top of the mixing tank through bolts, a feeding pipe is fixed on one side of each raw material tank through bolts, liquid outlets which are the same as the raw material tanks in number are formed in the top of the mixing tank, the liquid outlets are communicated with the bottom of the raw material tanks, a baffle is rotatably connected to the inner wall of the top of the mixing tank, and a limiting mechanism for assisting in fixing a rotating shaft is arranged on the outer wall of the top of the mixing tank.

title_en: Modularized fruit and vegetable grading and tracing equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of agricultural product processing, and discloses modularized fruit and vegetable grading and tracing equipment, which comprises a shell, wherein a feeding part is arranged at the top of the shell, a conveying channel for horizontally conveying fruits and vegetables along a preset path is formed at the top of the feeding part, two material guiding parts and a sorting part for detecting fruits and vegetables are arranged above the shell, the sorting part is arranged between the two material guiding parts, the sorting part and the two material guiding parts are arranged above the feeding part, a weighing sensor and an RFID (radio frequency identification) device are arranged below the feeding part, the weighing sensor is arranged below the feeding channel, and the RFID device is arranged below the discharging channel.

title_en: HIx phase purification process and system for thermochemical sulfur-iodine cyclic hydrogen production
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to the field of thermochemical sulfur-iodine cyclic decomposition of water to produce hydrogen, and in particular relates to a process and a system for purifying an HIx phase of thermochemical sulfur-iodine cyclic hydrogen, wherein the process comprises a Bunsen reaction, a sulfuric acid decomposition reaction and an HI decomposition reaction, and the HIx phase obtained by the Bunsen reaction flows into an HIx phase purification tower; the sulfuric acid impurity in HIx phase is cooled, depressurized and heated in tower to be converted into hydrogen sulfide, the hydrogen sulfide gas is separated out from solution and then enters into hydrogen sulfide burning tower, the hydrogen sulfide gas and oxygen generated by sulfuric acid decomposition are burnt into sulfur dioxide under oxygen-enriched condition, and sulfur returns to Bunsen reaction in the form of sulfur dioxide. The method adopts a side reaction path regulation strategy to completely convert sulfuric acid impurities in the HIx phase into sulfur dioxide, avoids the damage of the sulfuric acid impurities to the hydroiodic acid decomposition catalyst, does not introduce additional impurities in the whole purification process, does not need additional energy consumption investment, optimizes the system thermal management, and improves the thermal efficiency and the energy utilization rate of the whole system.

title_en: Silicon wafer waxing polishing process and polishing device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of silicon wafer processing, in particular to a silicon wafer waxed polishing process and a polishing device, comprising the following steps that S1, a polishing sheet is placed on a waxed polishing disc to carry out waxed paster, the silicon wafer is continuously rotated for 1-60S, and liquid wax is coated on the back surface of the silicon wafer under the action of centrifugal force; S2, cleaning by adopting a physical and chemical dual-combination cleaning mode, firstly cleaning the polishing disk under the combined action of a brush and a paraffin removal cleaning agent, and then putting the polishing disk into a cleaning machine with an ultrasonic device for secondary cleaning, and recycling the polishing disk after cleaning. In the silicon wafer waxed polishing process and the polishing device, the optimal rotating speed and the continuous rotating time are sought to obtain more uniform wax film thickness distribution, and the silicon polishing wafer is better in local flatness and higher in yield after chemical mechanical polishing. The polishing disk dewaxing cleaning method is improved, and can be used for better cleaning the polishing disk in the waxed polishing process.

title_en: Disinfection device for prosthesis and use method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sterilizing device for a prosthesis and a using method thereof, and relates to the technical field of prosthesis sterilization. The invention comprises a shell, wherein a baffle plate is arranged in the shell, a disinfection cavity is arranged above the baffle plate, a waste liquid collecting cavity is arranged below the baffle plate, a liquid leakage port is arranged at the top of the baffle plate, a disinfection mechanism is arranged at one side of the shell, sealing plates are in sliding fit with the two opposite sides of the shell, sliding rods are in sliding fit with the two sealing plates and are in rotating fit with the two sealing plates, fixing seats are arranged at the two opposite ends of the two sliding rods, which are positioned in the disinfection cavity, and a fixing mechanism is arranged in the fixing seats. According to the invention, the prosthesis is fixed between the two fixing seats through the fixing seat, and the two ends of the prosthesis can be respectively in running fit with the two fixing seats, so that the sliding rod can be pulled or rotated to adjust the position of the prosthesis or turn over the prosthesis, the use is flexible, and different surfaces of the prosthesis can be conveniently disinfected and cleaned.

title_en: New energy automobile of protection against electric shock fills electric pile
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric shock prevention new energy automobile charging pile, and relates to the technical field of new energy automobile charging piles. This new energy automobile of protection against electric shock fills electric pile through the setting of protection containing box and detection ring frame, can realize accomodating, the clearance operation to the wire that charges in the charging process and after the completion of charging, has promoted the life of wire that charges and the maintenance convenience of equipment, can detect the surface of wire that charges simultaneously in the use, avoids charging wire surface to appear damaging and appear the phenomenon of electric leakage, further prevents that operating personnel from appearing the condition emergence of electric shock, has promoted the operation security of equipment.

title_en: Heat preservation quilt folding and shaping equipment in greenhouse
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of folding equipment, in particular to thermal insulation quilt folding shaping equipment in a greenhouse, which comprises a supporting base, and a drying mechanism, wherein the drying mechanism comprises a drying box body, two air injection frames are arranged up and down in the drying box body, and after thermal insulation cotton is folded and shaped, the air injection frames positioned below stop injecting air, and the air injection frames positioned above continue injecting air. According to the invention, through the arranged arc-shaped support bar, after the equipment finishes winding the heat preservation quilt, the heat preservation quilt with continuously enlarged volume can extrude the arc-shaped support bar to enable the heat preservation quilt to turn downwards, so that the equipment can detect the winding process of the heat preservation quilt, the equipment can identify the heat preservation quilt to finish winding at the first time, and the arc-shaped support bar can be controlled to move upwards by matching with the motor and the transmission assembly, so that the equipment can realize the purpose of automatic stacking of the folded heat preservation quilt, and the equipment can have certain automation, and effectively improve the use efficiency.

title_en: Grain drying equipment of multistage stoving
abstract_en: The invention provides multi-stage drying grain drying equipment, which belongs to the field of grain drying equipment and comprises a secondary drying box, wherein an inclined frame is fixedly connected to the left side of the top of the secondary drying box, a feeding frame is fixedly connected to the right side of the top of the secondary drying box, and a discharging assembly comprises two connecting rods which are respectively and fixedly connected to the upper side and the lower side in the inclined frame, and the same screw rod is rotatably connected between the two connecting rods. According to the invention, through the arrangement of the discharging assembly and the spreading assembly, grains to be dried can be orderly paved in the primary drying frame, so that the grains to be dried are fully contacted with the heating base to be heated and dried, and then the grains subjected to primary drying are fed into the secondary drying box from the feeding frame to be subjected to secondary drying through the inclined primary drying frame, so that the grains are fully dried by uniform paving, and the drying effect and the drying uniformity are improved.

title_en: Mixed gas preparation device and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mixed gas preparation and discloses a mixed gas preparation device and a mixed gas preparation method, wherein the mixed gas preparation device comprises a mixing component, a dispersing component and an air inlet component, the mixing component is provided with a mixing cavity and a stirring cavity, the cross section of the mixing cavity is in a trapezoid shape, the larger end of the mixing cavity is the same as the stirring cavity in size and is communicated with the stirring cavity, the dispersing component comprises a mixing rod, a fan blade and stirring blades, the mixing rod is rotationally connected in the mixing cavity and is at least partially positioned in the stirring cavity, the stirring She Zhouxiang array is arranged on the surface of the mixing rod, which is positioned in the stirring cavity, and the fan blade is fixedly connected on the surface of the mixing rod, which is positioned in the mixing cavity, and is used for generating air flow when the mixing rod rotates, so that the air flows from the larger end of the mixing cavity to the smaller end. The preparation device and the preparation method of the mixed gas ensure that each component in the mixed gas is distributed more uniformly, effectively improve the mixing effect, ensure that the mixing is more sufficient, and simultaneously improve the mixing efficiency.

title_en: Battery detection device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of battery detection equipment, in particular to a battery detection device which comprises a detection component, a rotation component, a transportation component, a fixed frame, a motor, a half-cycle gear, a first gear, a second gear, a conveying hopper and a receiving hopper, wherein the detection component is fixedly connected with the fixed frame, one end of the fixed frame is fixedly connected with the conveying hopper, the other end of the fixed frame is fixedly connected with the receiving hopper, the motor is fixedly connected with the fixed frame, an output shaft of the motor is rotationally connected with the half-cycle gear, the invention rotates the battery 360 degrees through the rotating member, so that the appearance detector can completely detect the appearance of the battery, and the mechanical detection and transmission of a plurality of batteries can be realized through the material conveying member, thereby improving the detection efficiency of the appearance of the battery and meeting the requirement of batch production.

title_en: Method for preparing 2-acetylfuran by catalytic dehydrogenation of 1- (2-furyl) ethanol
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of organic synthesis, and particularly discloses a method for preparing 2-acetylfuran by catalytic dehydrogenation of 1- (2-furyl) ethanol, the method is characterized in that 1- (2-furyl) ethanol is used as a reaction raw material, a self-made copper-silicon catalyst is used as a catalyst, a fixed bed is used as a reactor, nitrogen is used as carrier gas, and catalytic dehydrogenation reaction is carried out to obtain the 2-acetyl furan. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that the self-made copper-silicon catalyst is used as a reaction catalyst, the catalyst catalysis efficiency is not reduced, the cost is reduced, sodium silicate and copper nitrate are used as catalyst raw materials, the cost is low, the catalyst is easy to obtain, the preparation method adopts a coprecipitation method, and compared with the common impregnation method for preparing the copper-silicon catalyst, the method has the advantages of simple process, easy control of preparation conditions, short synthesis period and simplicity and convenience in operation, and is suitable for industrial popularization and application. The method has the advantages of short synthetic route, high conversion rate and yield, simple operation, no corrosiveness to equipment by raw materials and products, and safety, economy and environmental protection.

title_en: A spout medicine device for plum tree
abstract_en: The application discloses a pesticide spraying device for plum trees, which relates to the technical field of fruit tree planting and comprises a bottom plate, a rotating seat, a fixed plate and a mounting frame, wherein a stirring mechanism is arranged on the inner side of a pesticide box, a water pump is fixedly connected on the inner side of the pesticide box, a vertical rod is fixedly connected on the upper side of the rotating seat, a lifting groove is formed in the inner side of the vertical rod, sliding grooves are formed in two sides of the lifting groove, the inner side of the lifting groove is slidingly connected with a lifting block, a sliding block is fixedly connected with the outer part of the lifting block, a pesticide spraying mechanism is arranged on the outer part of the sliding block, a lifting mechanism is arranged at the top of the vertical rod, a vertical plate is fixedly connected on the upper side of the bottom plate, a tension spring is fixedly connected between the fixed plate and the vertical plate, a convex plate is fixedly connected on the outer part of the tension spring, and a deflection mechanism is arranged on the outer part of the mounting frame.

title_en: Mold cleaning device and method for mold processing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the casting field, in particular to a die cleaning device and a die cleaning method for die processing, comprising a base and a pushing hand, wherein the pushing hand is fixedly connected to the right end of the base, universal wheels are arranged at four corners of the bottom of the base, and the die cleaning device further comprises a separating mechanism, a cleaning mechanism, a dust collecting pipe, a dust collecting gun and a polishing mechanism, wherein the separating mechanism is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the base; the cleaning mechanism is arranged on the upper surface of the separating mechanism, one end of the dust collecting pipe is arranged at the top of the cleaning mechanism, the dust collecting gun is arranged at the other end of the dust collecting pipe, the polishing mechanism is transversely arranged at the right end of the dust collecting gun, and the processing box is fixedly connected on the upper surface of the base. The die cavity comprehensive polishing device has the comprehensive polishing function of the die cavity, the die repair and cleaning are synchronously carried out, the die maintenance links are reduced, the labor intensity of workers is reduced, the die downtime is reduced, the separation of iron slag and sand particles is realized, the die cavity comprehensive polishing device can be used for multiple times, the materials are saved, and the use cost is reduced.

title_en: Dust collector for house construction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of construction dust removal, and discloses a dust removal device for building construction, which comprises a moving mechanism, a sedimentation mechanism, a pollution discharge mechanism, a collecting mechanism and a dust removal mechanism, wherein the moving mechanism is used for driving the whole equipment to move to different working positions for operation, the sedimentation mechanism is positioned at the top of the moving mechanism and used for enabling a mixture of water and mud to be sedimentated and separated in the sedimentation mechanism, the pollution discharge mechanism is used for discharging collected impurities such as cement and the like into the sedimentation mechanism for treatment, the collecting mechanism is arranged on the right side of the pollution discharge mechanism and used for collecting the cement mixture after dust fall, and the dust removal mechanism is arranged on the inner side of the collecting mechanism and used for treating air containing dust. Through combining collection and precipitation mechanism, effectively collect dust fall and cement mixture, precipitation mechanism realizes earth granule and separation of water through the design, promotes cyclic utilization, water economy resource, and precipitation tank top is equipped with the clearance mouth, and the maintenance of being convenient for, and fixed establishment passes through parts such as lead screw and ensures equipment stability, guarantee work safety.

title_en: Carbon nitride composite photocatalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of preparation of photocatalysts, and discloses a carbon nitride composite photocatalyst, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the carbon nitride composite photocatalyst is cobalt sulfide modified phosphorus and potassium Co-doped carbon nitride, the carbon nitride is a graphite phase, the doping proportion of each element in the carbon nitride composite photocatalyst is P1.33-21.7%, K3.94-41.2%, co 0.412-8.27%, S0.216-4.57%, g-C  3 N 4  is used as a light absorption active layer, and Co-doping is carried out through phosphorus and potassium elements, so that the electron structure of the catalyst is regulated, the band edge position is changed, the generation capacity and light absorption performance of an active oxygen intermediate are improved, conductivity is improved, and meanwhile, a cocatalyst CoS is introduced, and the special semiconductor heterojunction is formed together with the original phosphorus and potassium Co-doped catalyst, so that the diffusion and transmission of photo-generated electrons are promoted, the separation capacity of the photo-generated electrons and photo-generated holes are improved, and the service life of photo-generated carriers is prolonged.

title_en: Energy-saving multifunctional casting blank flame cleaning device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy-saving multifunctional casting blank flame cleaning device, wherein a fixed end piston and a floating end piston are additionally arranged in a cleaning oxygen cavity of an upper horizontal distributor piston cylinder assembly and a lower horizontal distributor piston cylinder assembly, the cleaning oxygen cavity is divided into a fixed end, a middle using section and a floating end, the section of a casting blank is divided into 8 optional cleaning areas, and the eight cleaning areas are all subjected to PID (proportion integration differentiation) adjustment by adopting independent valve stations, so that the 8 optional cleaning areas are combined in a multifunctional mode, the fixed area and the depth of the surface defect of the casting blank are cleaned, unnecessary area cleaning is reduced, metal loss is reduced, the yield of finished products is increased, and the cost and efficiency are reduced. Aiming at the hot blank, the oxygen pressure of the relatively low-temperature areas of the side parts such as the top fixed end, the top floating end, the bottom fixed end, the bottom floating end and the like is increased, so that the target cleaning depth is obtained, the hot blank hot feed rate is improved, the energy consumption is reduced, and the green metallurgy is assisted.

title_en: Power cable identification warning pile
abstract_en: The invention provides a power cable identification warning pile, which belongs to the technical field of power equipment and comprises a pile body, a warning lamp, a light transmission detection sensor, a first cleaning component and a controller, wherein a containing cavity is formed in the pile body, a warning window communicated with the containing cavity is formed in the outer side wall of the pile body, a lens is arranged on the warning window, the warning lamp and the light transmission detection sensor are both arranged in the containing cavity and correspond to the lens, the light transmission detection sensor is used for detecting the light transmission of the lens, the first cleaning component comprises a power component and an operation component, the power component is arranged in the containing cavity, the operation component is arranged on the warning window, the controller is arranged in the containing cavity, the controller is respectively and electrically connected with the light transmission detection sensor and the power component, the light transmission detection sensor sends signals to the controller, and the controller controls the power component to act according to the signals so as to drive the operation component to clean the lens. The power cable identification warning pile provided by the invention has self-cleaning capability, so that the warning effect is improved.

title_en: Food additive mixing production equipment and production process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses food additive mixing production equipment and a production process thereof, which belong to the technical field of raw material mixing and are characterized in that a stirring and mixing tank and a control machine are further arranged on a platform, the control machine controls actions of a cloth bag dust remover and the stirring and mixing tank, the stirring and mixing tank comprises a round platform tank, a pumping tank, a piston pipe and a ventilation pipe, the cloth bag dust remover is communicated with the round platform tank through an air pipe, a piston rod is arranged in the piston pipe, a ventilation valve is arranged on the ventilation pipe, a spiral pipe is arranged in the round platform tank, one end of the spiral pipe is provided with stirring blades, and the stirring blades are hollow. Solves the problems that the granular food additive stored for a long time can be agglomerated and needs to be crushed again, and scrap iron impurities in the granular food additive cannot be directly separated, and is mainly applied to the aspect of food additive mixing production.

title_en: Treatment device and treatment method for condensate conversion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a treatment device and a treatment method for condensate conversion, belonging to the technical field of condensate conversion treatment of synthetic ammonia, the device comprises a stripping system, a deacidification gas system and an ammonia evaporation system, wherein the stripping system is connected with the deacidification gas system through a pipeline, and the deacidification gas system is connected with the ammonia evaporation system. The invention adopts the treatment device and the treatment method for transforming condensate, the acid gas coming out from the top of the deacidification ammonia absorption tower is basically free of steam and ammonia gas after two sections of cooling and washing of the deacidification ammonia absorption tower, the acid gas can be sent to a sulfur recovery device for combustion and recovery treatment, and the crystallization blockage of pipelines and equipment is avoided.

title_en: Automatic dreg removing system of filter press and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic grain removing system of a filter press, which comprises a filter press (1) with a filter plate (12) and a grain removing device (6), and is characterized by further comprising a moving track (2), a moving chassis (3) which is movably arranged on the moving track (2) back and forth, a camera (4) which is used for shooting the surface of the filter plate (12), a mechanical arm (5) which is arranged on the moving chassis (3), the grain removing device (6) which is arranged at the driving end of the mechanical arm (5), and a processor which is used for identifying the area where the surface of the filter plate (12) is located according to the picture shot by the camera (4) and controlling the mechanical arm (5) to drive the grain removing device (6) to move to the area where the grain is located so as to perform grain removing operation. The invention also discloses a control method of the automatic dreg removing system of the filter press. Compared with the prior art, the invention can improve the filter residue removal efficiency and reduce the surface damage of the filter plate.

title_en: Cleaning equipment for operation and maintenance of power transmission line
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of operation and maintenance of a power transmission line, in particular to cleaning equipment for operation and maintenance of the power transmission line. The cleaning device comprises a supporting base which is used for being installed on a working vehicle, wherein a movable base is arranged on the supporting base, an upper top plate is arranged above the movable base, a U-shaped wire inlet is formed in the movable base, a cleaning mechanism is arranged in the movable base and used for cleaning the surface of a power transmission line, a cleaning block and a clamping plate I are installed on the lower surface of the upper top plate, and a cavity through which the power transmission line passes is formed by the wire inlet and the clamping plate I. Simultaneously, the electric telescopic rod drives the upper top plate to descend, so that the upper top plate presses down the movable rack, the clamping plate II which is slidably mounted in the side groove is pushed to extrude the cable under the action of the rotary gear, and meanwhile, the clamping plate I on the top plate is clamped with the cable from the upper part, and dust on the surface of the cable is cleaned through the cleaning block fixedly mounted on the upper top plate.

title_en: Medical instrument belt cleaning device with turn-over mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical instrument cleaning, in particular to a medical instrument cleaning device with a turn-over mechanism, which comprises a cleaning box body, a cover, a stirring mechanism, a floating mechanism, the turn-over mechanism and a collecting mechanism, wherein two salvaging frames distributed in a circumferential array are connected in a sliding manner in the cleaning box body, an installation disc is rotatably connected to the inner wall of the bottom of the cleaning box body, and stirring blades are fixedly connected to the outer wall of the top of the installation disc. According to the invention, the stirring mechanism is linked with the floating mechanism to drive the bearing frame to move up and down, so that the cleaning effect is improved, residues are promoted to fall off better, meanwhile, when the stirring mechanism controls a certain salvaging frame to extend out, residues and rust residues can be intercepted, and the collecting mechanism is linked, so that the partition plate closes the channel of the middle partition plate, the impurities on the interception plate are prevented from being scattered, the residues on the interception plate are collected after the interception plate rotates for half a circle, the residues such as the impurities are prevented from remaining in the cleaning liquid, the clarity of the cleaning liquid is maintained, and the cleaning effect is improved.

title_en: Rotary kiln is retrieved to old and useless lithium cell of broken function in area
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of waste lithium battery recovery, in particular to a waste lithium battery recovery rotary kiln with a crushing function, which comprises a crushing cylinder, a rotary kiln, a coarse filter screen, a crushing mechanism, a lifting mechanism and a driving mechanism, wherein the top of the crushing cylinder is communicated with a feed hopper, the rotary kiln is arranged below the crushing cylinder, an inlet of the rotary kiln is communicated with an outlet of the crushing cylinder, the coarse filter screen is arranged in the crushing cylinder and is used for screening materials entering the rotary kiln, the crushing mechanism is arranged in the crushing cylinder and is used for crushing the materials, the lifting mechanism is arranged on one side of the crushing cylinder, and an output end of the driving mechanism is in driving connection with the crushing mechanism and the lifting mechanism. According to the invention, through the cooperation arrangement between the coarse filter screen and the lifting mechanism, the battery fragment particles entering the rotary kiln are ensured to be relatively smaller, so that the heating efficiency of the battery rotary kiln on the battery fragments can be improved, the risk of blocking the rotary kiln can be reduced, and the running stability of the device can be improved.

title_en: Separation chip
abstract_en: A separation chip includes a substrate, a plurality of electrodes disposed on one surface of the substrate, an insulating film covering at least a part of one surface of the electrodes, and an introduction portion constituting member disposed on one side of the substrate, surrounding at least a part of the electrodes, and constituting an introduction portion into which a liquid containing dielectric particles is introduced. The one face of the electrode has a first region and a second region different from the first region. The thickness of the insulating film on the first region is smaller than the thickness of the insulating film on the second region.

title_en: Automatic stereoscopic warehouse for straw briquetting fuel
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic stereoscopic warehouse for straw briquetting fuel, which relates to the technical field of straw conveying and comprises a storage warehouse, wherein supporting legs are arranged in the storage warehouse, a conveying bin is fixedly arranged at the top of each supporting leg, a feeding device is arranged in the storage warehouse, a rotating motor is fixedly arranged on the surface of the conveying bin, the output end of the rotating motor rotates to penetrate through the inner wall and the outer wall of the conveying bin, a conveying roller is fixedly arranged on the surface of the output end of the rotating motor, a spiral plate is fixedly arranged on the circumferential surface of the conveying roller, a feeding pipe is fixedly arranged on the circumferential surface of the conveying bin, a discharging hole is formed in the bottom of the feeding pipe, the rotation of the output end of the rotating motor drives the conveying roller to rotate, the rotation of the conveying roller drives a spiral plate to drive straws to move and convey the straws after extrusion, and the automatic stereoscopic warehouse is high in working efficiency and high in practicability.

title_en: Road bridge construction marking device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of construction scribing, in particular to a road and bridge construction scribing device which comprises a device shell, wherein an inner mounting seat is fixedly connected to the outer side surface of the device shell, an installation shell is fixedly connected to the other side surface of the inner mounting seat, an angle adjusting mechanism is arranged on the outer side surface of the inner mounting seat, an interlocking input mechanism is arranged on the inner side surface of the installation shell, a spacing control mechanism is arranged on the inner side surface of the installation shell, a stroke control mechanism is arranged on the inner side surface of the installation shell, alternate scribing of a scribing device in the linear direction and the transverse direction is controlled through the arrangement of the interlocking input mechanism, the spacing control mechanism and the stroke control mechanism are driven in turn, the spacing control mechanism controls the scribing interval, the stroke control mechanism controls the length of transverse scribing, and the device can automatically alternate scribe according to different construction requirements and flexibly adjust the scribing angle, the spacing and the length.

title_en: High-efficient magnetic separation device of dolomite
abstract_en: The invention provides a dolomite high-efficiency magnetic separation device, which relates to the technical field of dolomite crushing and magnetic separation, and comprises an outer cylinder, an inner cylinder and swing arms, wherein the centers of the swing arms are in the outer cylinder and are rotationally connected with the centers of two ends of the outer cylinder, the centers of the two ends of the inner cylinder are rotationally connected with one ends of the two swing arms which are on the same horizontal line, the other ends of the swing arms are connected with shaft bodies penetrating from the inner cylinder to the outer cylinder, the two ends of the outer cylinder are provided with arc-shaped sliding grooves for guiding the shaft bodies to slide, the shaft bodies are connected with driving mechanisms, and the driving mechanisms can drive the inner cylinder to swing in the outer cylinder through the swing arms.

title_en: Intelligent demagnetizing dust-free feeding device and feeding method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent demagnetizing dust-free feeding device and a feeding method, which relate to the technical field of demagnetizing dust-free feeding tools, and comprise a storage device, wherein a cloth bag dust remover is arranged on the storage device, a storage box is arranged at the lower end of the cloth bag dust remover, a first material guiding sleeve is arranged at the outlet of the lower end of the storage box, two sides of the storage device are respectively connected with a screw conveyer and a pneumatic conveying device through pipelines, the upper ends of the screw conveyer and the pneumatic conveying device are respectively provided with a conveying hopper, the equal flange joint in top of transmission fill has except that magnetism rose box, and except that the side of magnetism rose box all is equipped with the delivery box, and the feeder hopper is installed to the pan feeding mouth department of delivery box, and belt conveyor is installed to the discharge gate department of delivery box, through screw conveyer and pneumatic conveyor's setting, can make the device store the material that powder or granule are less and the viscidity is great or massive material for the application scope of device improves.

title_en: Method for repairing erosion and sealing of ebullated bed reactor
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of erosion repair of the inner wall of a pressure vessel, and relates to a method for repairing erosion and sealing of a fluidized bed reactor, which comprises the following steps of S1, judging a region to be repaired of the inner wall of the reactor; the method comprises the steps of S2, repairing a region to be repaired by using an arc plate overlaying mode, S3, removing an original sealing structure of a reactor, S4, carrying out sealing treatment on the reactor again by using a multi-position plugging mode of compaction plugging, and carrying out sealing treatment on the position of the inner wall of the reactor, which is eroded and damaged, and then carrying out sealing treatment on the position between a distribution plate and the inner wall of the reactor again, so that the erosion and sealing repair of the reactor is realized, the inner wall of the reactor and the sealing structure of the reactor are restored, the uniform distribution of a reaction medium in the reactor is ensured, the sufficient contact and reaction of raw materials and hydrogen are promoted, the utilization rate of the raw materials and the product quality are improved, and meanwhile, the condition that the erosion and damage on the inner wall of the reactor is not existed after the sealing repair is completed is ensured, and the durability of the repairing effect is ensured.

title_en: Magnetic composite adsorbent for blood perfusion and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of medical instruments, and particularly discloses a magnetic composite adsorbent for blood perfusion and a preparation method and application thereof. The magnetic composite adsorbent takes magnetic nano particles as inner cores, and is connected with endotoxin affinity peptide through a cross-linking agent to form the composite adsorbent, wherein the amino acid sequence of the endotoxin affinity peptide is Lys-His-Arg-Asp-Cys-Lys-Trp-Leu-Lys-Arg-Cys-Trp. The magnetic composite adsorbent has specific affinity to endotoxin, and because the endotoxin affinity peptide is fixed on the surface of the magnetic nano particles through chemical bonds, the adsorbent is easily recovered through magnetic separation in the blood perfusion process, and the endotoxin affinity peptide is not easy to fall off and remain in blood, thereby being safer and more efficient.

title_en: Preparation method of ion exchange nanofiber membrane with high ion exchange capacity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an ion exchange nanofiber membrane with high ion exchange capacity, which comprises the steps of grinding and sieving a certain amount of strong acid cation exchange resin, adding the ground strong acid cation exchange resin into PVDF solution, mixing and stirring the mixture uniformly, and adopting an electrostatic spinning processing method to obtain a nano-scale heterogeneous PVDF cation exchange membrane. The heterogeneous PVDF cation exchange membrane has a large number of ion exchange resin particles dispersed inside and on the surface, and when the resin particles are in aqueous solution, sulfonic acid groups (HSO  3   2‑ ) in the resin exchange with ions in water, namely, a displacement reaction occurs, so that dissolved metal ions in water are removed. The ion exchange membrane prepared by the invention can remove alkali metal and alkaline earth metal ions in the aqueous solution, so that the total content of the alkali metal and the alkaline earth metal ions in the solution is lower than 300mg/L.

title_en: Diaphragm shadow detection device and detection method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a diaphragm shadow detection device and a detection method thereof, which relate to the technical fields of optical detection and machine vision and comprise a box body, wherein a feeding groove is formed in the left side of the box body, two connecting plates are fixedly arranged on the left side of the box body corresponding to the feeding groove, a conveying assembly is arranged between the two connecting plates, and a plurality of first reversing rods are rotatably arranged in the box body corresponding to the conveying assembly. According to the invention, the collecting assembly is arranged, the membrane is cut by a worker, meanwhile, the collecting pipe without materials is moved to a proper position by rotating the rotating shaft, the membrane is connected with the collecting pipe by the worker, then the top plate is pushed to enable the inserting rod to leave the inserting groove so as to replace the collecting pipe filled with materials, in the replacing process, the equipment does not need to be stopped, and when a large number of membranes are processed, the time required for production is reduced due to the fact that the stopping operation is not needed, and the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Robotic sealant dispensing and scraping applicator and process
abstract_en: A sealant dispensing tool for a robot. The tool includes a stem having a first end and a second end, the stem including a chamber extending from the first end to the second end. The tool also includes a scraper coupled to the first end of the rod, wherein the scraper includes an opening and a hollow portion in communication with the opening and the chamber in the rod. The tool also includes a dispensing nozzle positioned within an opening in the scraper, and an applicator coupled to the nozzle and extending through a hollow portion of the scraper and a chamber in the stem.

title_en: Sintered fuel particle size sorting system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sintered fuel granularity sorting system and a sintered fuel granularity sorting method, wherein the system comprises a fluidized bed body, a weighing feeder, a porous fluidized plate, a blower, a vibrating motor, a cyclone separator, a bag-type dust remover, a draught fan and a diffusing chimney, wherein one end of the fluidized bed body is provided with the weighing feeder, the other end of the fluidized bed body is provided with a finished product discharge hole, the fluidized bed is characterized in that a porous fluidization plate is arranged in the fluidized bed body, air supply through a blower is arranged below the fluidized bed body, a dust collecting cover for collecting dust removal air is arranged above the fluidized bed body, a dust collection pipeline is connected behind the dust collecting cover, the dust collection pipeline is connected with a cyclone separator, and the cyclone separator is connected with a cloth bag dust remover. The invention provides a method for sorting the granularity of sintered fuel, which sorts the fuel with too small granularity, and avoids the acceleration of the fuel combustion speed in a sintered material layer when the granularity of the fuel is too small, thereby influencing the strength and the yield of the sintered ore.

title_en: Treatment equipment and method for landscape water body repair
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of landscape water body restoration, in particular to a treatment device and a method for landscape water body restoration, wherein the treatment device for landscape water body restoration comprises an upper frame assembly, a driving assembly connected to the upper frame assembly, a pressing assembly connected to the upper frame assembly, a lower frame assembly movably connected to the upper frame assembly, a lifting injection assembly connected to the lower frame assembly, an adjusting assembly connected to the inner wall of the lower frame assembly and a mixing assembly movably connected to the adjusting assembly, and the upper frame assembly is used for acquiring wind power data around the device. According to the invention, the water body and the medicine are mixed in advance through the mixing component, and the water body stored in the mixing component is lifted through the lifting spraying component so as to drive the water body to move to the lifting spraying component and be sprayed in a spraying mode, so that the water body restoration efficiency of the whole treatment equipment can be greatly improved by spraying the atomized medicine water mixture around the equipment.

title_en: Preparation method of rosin derivative modified fluorescent double-shell isocyanate-based self-repairing microcapsule and application of rosin derivative modified fluorescent double-shell isocyanate-based self-repairing microcapsule in field of paint
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a rosin derivative modified fluorescent double-shell isocyanate-based self-repairing microcapsule and application thereof in the field of paint, wherein the preparation method adopts a biological-based rosin derivative as a microcapsule core material, the preparation method is environment-friendly, a coating material has a self-repairing function and a self-checking function through the introduced double-shell microcapsule, a damaged area and a damaged degree of the coating can be found through ultraviolet irradiation, the mechanical property of polyurethane is obviously enhanced through the introduced rigid rosin structure, the application field of the polyurethane is further expanded through blending modification of the double-shell microcapsule and other materials, and the common action of fluorine-silicon elements on the surface of the microcapsule also enhances the corrosion resistance of the coating.

title_en: Recovery crushing apparatus is used to tile production waste material
abstract_en: The invention discloses recycling and crushing equipment for tile production waste, which comprises a processing box, a grinding plate, crushing blades, a turning spiral sheet, a turning member and a rotating member, wherein a double-output-shaft motor drives a first driving shaft and a second driving shaft to rotate, the first driving shaft drives the crushing blades to rotate so as to crush the waste, the turning member drives the turning spiral sheet to revolve and simultaneously realize rotation, the crushing blades can drive the continuous turning of the waste at different positions in the crushing process of the waste, the turning member drives a feeding block to reciprocate, the waste falling in a feeding cylinder is continuously and slightly pushed into a blanking hole, a second power shaft drives the rotating member to rotate, the rotating member drives the grinding cylinder to rotate, the waste is thinned in the rotating process of the grinding plate, and a set regulating and controlling member can regulate the distance between the grinding plate and a cylindrical screen and correspondingly regulate the waste according to the particle size of the required waste, so that the practicability of the device is improved.

title_en: Solar panel adjusting device and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a solar panel adjusting device and a using method thereof, which belong to the technical field of solar panels and comprise a protective seat, wherein a solar panel is arranged in rotary connection with the protective seat, an adjusting mechanism is arranged in rotary connection with the protective seat, an I-shaped seat is arranged on one side of the bottom end of the protective seat in a sliding fit manner, a protective cover is arranged on the upper side of the I-shaped seat, a sand accumulation pushing mechanism is arranged in rotary connection with a mounting column, when the excessive wind power is monitored, the solar panel can be retracted into the protective seat by the aid of the adjusting mechanism, the protective cover is driven by the I-shaped seat, so that the protective cover covers the solar panel, sand particles in wind shielding can be effectively prevented from directly striking the surface of the solar panel, scraping and abrasion of the panel caused by the sand particles are avoided, the influence of sand dust accumulation on the power generation efficiency is reduced, the physical damage of the sand particles to the panel surface is reduced, the service life of the solar panel is prolonged, and the threat of the sand on the solar panel in a desert area can be effectively prevented.

title_en: Cotton grabbing mixing and packaging device and method capable of quantitatively adding auxiliary agent
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bale plucking mixing and packaging device and method capable of quantitatively adding an auxiliary agent, belonging to the technical field of short hemp processing, and comprising a bale plucker; the device comprises an oil spraying mechanism, a cleaning mechanism, an oxidizing agent spraying mechanism, a compression packing mechanism and an output port of the bale plucker, wherein the oil spraying mechanism is connected with the bale plucker to spray oil into the bale plucker, the cleaning mechanism is connected with the oil spraying mechanism to clean the oil spraying mechanism, the oxidizing agent spraying mechanism is connected with the bale plucker to spray oxidizing agent into the bale plucker, and the compression packing mechanism is connected with the output port of the bale plucker to compress and pack the gripped materials. The invention can finish a plurality of processing and production steps such as picking, compressing and packing the short hemp at one time, and the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Conveyer is used in coal production with automatically function of cleaning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of coal production, in particular to a conveying device with an automatic cleaning function for coal production. The invention provides a transportation device for coal production, which can automatically and horizontally send coal into and out of a carriage, reduce dust during loading and unloading of coal, and improve the transportation efficiency of coal. The utility model provides a conveyer for coal production with automatic cleaning function, includes tracked vehicle and driver's cabin etc. the left upper side of tracked vehicle is connected with the driver's cabin. According to the invention, the coal is conveyed onto the conveying belt, the conveying belt is started again, the conveying belt is rotated to convey the coal into the carriage, after the coal loading is completed, the crawler is used for conveying the coal to a designated place, and after the coal reaches the designated place, the conveying belt is rotated reversely to convey the coal out of the carriage, so that the effects of automatically and horizontally conveying the coal into and out of the carriage, reducing dust during the coal loading and unloading and improving the coal conveying efficiency are achieved.

title_en: Respiration training device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a respiration training device which comprises a base and a top plate, wherein a plurality of ventilation barrels are detachably arranged between the base and the top plate, ventilation passages communicated with the ventilation barrels are arranged in the base and the top plate, the ventilation passages are connected with air nozzles, filter cotton is arranged in the air nozzles, adsorption sheets are arranged in the ventilation passages, a plurality of first through holes are arranged on the top plate, the first through holes are in one-to-one correspondence with the ventilation barrels and are coaxially arranged, a top cover is detachably arranged on the first through holes, a connecting rod in plug-in fit with the first through holes is also arranged on the side face of the connecting rod, a cleaning head is arranged on the bottom end of the connecting rod, and an arc cleaning sheet is arranged on the bottom end of the connecting rod. The invention can improve the defects of the prior art, does not need to be disassembled and cleaned after each use, and is convenient for daily frequent use.

title_en: Automatic air spring assembly module and automatic assembly method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic air spring assembly module and an automatic air spring assembly method. The automatic air spring assembly module comprises a feeding unit, a transferring unit, a discharging unit and assembly equipment, wherein the feeding unit comprises a correction device, a retaining ring feeding device, an air bag feeding device and an auxiliary spring feeding device, the transferring unit comprises a robot, the discharging unit comprises a positioning device, an air spring discharging device and a waste discharging device, the correction device, one or more retaining ring feeding devices, one or more air bag feeding devices and waste discharging devices are arranged side by side according to any sequence and recorded as a material frame area, the surrounding layout is formed around the robot, and the auxiliary spring feeding devices, the material frame area, the assembly equipment, the positioning device and the air spring discharging device are sequentially arranged. The automatic assembly method of the air spring automatic assembly module comprises the steps of assembling an air bag and a retaining ring, flattening, assembling the air bag and an auxiliary spring, detecting, blanking and the like.

title_en: Distillation tower heat exchanger convenient to installation
