abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of distillation tower heat exchangers and discloses a distillation tower heat exchanger convenient to install, which comprises a base, wherein the top of the base is provided with an installation mechanism, the top of the base is provided with a balance mechanism, the front side of the installation mechanism is provided with a heat dissipation mechanism, the installation mechanism comprises an installation component and a protection component, the installation component is arranged at the top of the base, when the distillation tower heat exchanger body is required to be installed and operated, the distillation tower heat exchanger body drives a fixing frame and a fixing block to be in sliding connection with the inside of a bearing frame, in the sliding process of the fixing block, a first clamping block can extrude a second clamping block, the second clamping block drives a connecting rod and the connecting frame to move forwards to drive a first spring to deform, and when the first clamping block extrudes the second clamping block and the first clamping block is positioned at the top of the second clamping block, the first spring is reset, and the first clamping block can be limited under the action of the second clamping block.

title_en: Novel chip wastewater defluorination material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a novel chip wastewater defluorination material and a preparation method thereof, the preparation method comprises the steps of immersing acidized activated carbon in an aluminum chloride solution with the concentration of 0.8-1.4 mol/L for 22-26 hours, adjusting the pH value of an immersion system to 6-8, firing the obtained precipitate for 3-4 hours in a nitrogen atmosphere to obtain aluminum modified activated carbon, adding sodium hydroxide into a cerium chloride solution with the concentration of 0.2-0.7 mol/L, adjusting the pH value of the system to 6-8, adding the acidized aluminum modified activated carbon, and calcining the obtained reactant at the temperature of 220-260 ℃ for 22-26 hours to obtain the defluorination material. According to the application, aluminum and cerium double-modified activated carbon is selected during preparation, so that the active sites on the surface of the activated carbon are effectively modified, and aluminum ions and cerium ions are uniformly and fully loaded on the surface and in pores of the activated carbon, so that the adsorptivity to fluorine ions is enhanced, the fluorine removal effect is enhanced, the preparation cost is reduced, the preparation steps are simplified, and a green, efficient and economic-benefit-higher activated carbon modification preparation system is constructed.

title_en: Renewable alkane dehydrogenation catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a renewable alkane dehydrogenation catalyst, a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the catalyst adopts high-temperature heat treatment to activate the molecular sieve carrier, and the activated carrier, the active metal salt, the auxiliary metal salt and the alkali metal salt are mechanically and uniformly mixed, and finally high-temperature oxidation treatment is carried out. The high-temperature activation heat treatment enables the molecular sieve pore channel structure to reconstruct and introduce oxygen vacancies to form rich defect sites, thereby effectively anchoring active metals and optimizing metal-carrier interaction. Meanwhile, the additive metal and the alkali metal are added to perform synergistic effect, so that sintering agglomeration of the active metal is further inhibited, and high-temperature stability and recycling property of the catalyst are remarkably improved. The method has the advantages of simple process route, less wastewater discharge and low investment cost, the obtained catalyst is circulated for 50 times in the high-temperature reaction-regeneration of propane dehydrogenation without deactivation, long-time sustainable use and recycling can be realized, and a new technical reference is provided for the synthesis of industrial novel catalysts.

title_en: Large-scale electromagnetic slurry magnetic separator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large electromagnetic slurry magnetic separator, which belongs to the technical field of magnetic separation equipment and comprises a frame, wherein a magnetic separation assembly comprises a bottom plate and a plurality of nested positioning cylinders, magnetic media are filled between adjacent positioning cylinders, a plurality of first through holes are formed in the bottom plate, a plurality of second through holes are formed in the peripheral surface of each positioning cylinder, a pre-magnetizing cavity extends into an innermost positioning cylinder and is connected with a feed pipe and a water inlet pipe, a plurality of magnetic excitation rings are arranged in each pre-magnetizing cavity, a driving assembly can drive the magnetic separation assembly to rotate, the magnetic separation assembly is positioned in a material cylinder, a discharge pipeline is arranged at the bottom of the material cylinder, the magnetic excitation coils are arranged around the material cylinder, ore pulp enters the magnetic separation assembly through the pre-magnetizing cavity, the magnetic excitation rings can magnetize weak magnetic particles in ore pulp, the magnetized weak magnetic particles are easier to adsorb onto the magnetic media, and in an iron removal stage, the driving assembly drives the positive and negative rotation of the magnetic separation assembly, and the flushing water can thoroughly clean the magnetic particles adhered to the magnetic media, and periodic disassembly and cleaning are not needed.

title_en: Acid mesoporous resin for catalyzing alkylation of p-cresol as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an acid mesoporous resin for catalyzing alkylation of paracresol, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of S1, stirring divinylbenzene, azodiisobutylnitrile, tetrahydrofuran and water at room temperature to obtain a mixture; S2, performing hydrothermal treatment on the mixture in a hydrothermal kettle, volatilizing and evaporating the solvent at normal temperature to obtain a mesoporous polydivinylbenzene material, and S3, performing sulfonation treatment on the polydivinylbenzene mesoporous material to obtain the acidic mesoporous resin grafted with sulfonic acid groups. The catalyst has excellent catalytic activity and selectivity, is easy to separate from products, can be reused, greatly reduces the production cost, has simple preparation process and wide raw material sources, has no pollution to environment and equipment, and has higher industrial application value.

title_en: Method for synthesizing hole transport material Spiro-OMeTAD by nickel-based catalyst catalysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for synthesizing a hole transport material Spiro-OMeTAD by using a nickel-based catalyst, which is characterized in that under the catalysis of bis- (1, 5-cyclooctadiene) nickel and 1, 3-bis (2, 6-diisopropylphenyl) imidazole-2-alkene, sodium hydride is used as an alkaline dehydrogenation agent, and the Spiro-OMeTAD is directly synthesized by the reaction of 2,2', 7' -tetrabromo-9, 9 '-spirobifluorene and 4,4' -dimethoxy diphenylamine, zinc powder is added in the reaction process to promote the cyclic reaction, so that side reaction can be effectively inhibited, and the reaction safety, selectivity and yield are improved. In addition, phosphine ligand is not used in the method, the dehydrogenation agent is sodium hydride, the problems of high toxicity and the like in the catalytic process are overcome, and the burden on the environment is reduced.

title_en: Lung cancer atomization respiratory therapy device
abstract_en: The invention provides a lung cancer atomization respiratory therapy device, which relates to the technical field of medical instruments and comprises an atomizer body, wherein the top of the atomizer body is connected with a box cover through a hinge, the top of the box cover is fixedly connected with a stirring mechanism near the center, the top of the box cover is fixedly connected with proportioning mechanisms at two sides of the stirring mechanism, the stirring mechanism comprises a first protection box fixedly connected with the top of the box cover, a first driving motor is fixedly connected inside the first protection box, a first dustproof heat dissipation net is adaptively clamped at the position, near the top, of the first protection box, the bottom of the box cover is rotatably connected with a first stirring rod, and the output end of the first driving motor penetrates through the box cover and is fixedly connected with the top of the first stirring rod.

title_en: Pipeline painting equipment and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pipeline painting device and a method thereof, wherein the pipeline painting device comprises two protection boxes, a support, a first sliding seat, a clamping structure and a purifying device, wherein the first guide rail is paved at the bottom of the two protection boxes, the support is provided with the first sliding seat in a sliding manner, the support is arranged on the first sliding seat, the clamping structure is arranged in one protection box and comprises two bases arranged on two opposite sides of the first guide rail, a bearing platform is arranged on the base in a lifting manner, clamps are respectively and rotatably arranged on the opposite sides of the two bearing platforms, a driving piece is arranged on one bearing platform, a coating nozzle is arranged in one protection box, a second guide rail is arranged in the second guide rail in the length direction of a pipeline in a sliding manner, the coating nozzle is arranged on the second guide rail in a sliding manner, the coating nozzle is arranged on the second sliding seat, the drying device is arranged in the other protection box, and the purifying device comprises a suction air pipe and a liquid storage box, one end of the suction air pipe is connected to the protection box, and the other end of the suction air pipe extends into absorption liquid. The invention solves the problems of low working efficiency and environmental pollution existing in the process of manually spraying paint on pipelines.

title_en: Biological test tube ultrasonic cleaning device and cleaning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultrasonic cleaning device and a cleaning method for biological test tubes, comprising a base, wherein a frame is fixedly arranged on the base, a cleaning box is fixedly arranged on the frame, a bearing frame is movably clamped in the cleaning box, a plurality of mounting grooves for clamping the test tubes are arranged on the bearing frame, a first rotating shaft is rotatably arranged on the frame, a rotating shaft is rotatably arranged on the cleaning box, a rotating rod is fixedly arranged on the rotating shaft, a cleaning brush is fixedly arranged on the rotating rod, the rotating shaft is in transmission connection with the first rotating shaft through a gear transmission mechanism, and a second rotating shaft is rotatably arranged on the frame. The invention relates to the technical field of test tube cleaning devices, in particular to a biological test tube ultrasonic cleaning device and a cleaning method, which can be used for carrying out spin brushing cleaning treatment on the inner wall of a test tube in the ultrasonic cleaning process, effectively reducing the adhesion of dirt on the inner wall of the test tube, improving the effect of the test tube after cleaning and improving the efficiency of the test tube cleaning treatment.

title_en: Gas denitration system and method for rotary kiln
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gas denitration system and method for a rotary kiln, which belong to the technical field of denitration and comprise a denitration solution storage tank, wherein the denitration solution storage tank is connected with a denitration medicament dissolution tank through a first connecting pipe, a denitration dissolution pump is connected to the first connecting pipe, a first reactor is connected between a first connecting port of the first reactor and the denitration solution storage tank through a second connecting pipe, the second connecting port is connected with a first steam-water separator, a first denitration solution conveying pump is connected to the second connecting pipe, the second reactor is connected between the first connecting port of the second reactor and the denitration solution storage tank through a third connecting pipe, the second connecting port is connected with a second steam-water separator, a second denitration solution conveying pump is connected to the third connecting pipe, an inlet of the air mixer is respectively connected with an outlet of the first steam-water separator and an outlet of the second steam-water separator, and the outlet of the air mixer is connected with a kiln inlet through a pipeline connector.

title_en: High-pressure deaeration machine for processing display screen
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-pressure defoaming machine for processing a display screen, which comprises a high-pressure defoaming machine body, sliding rods arranged on two sides of the inner wall of the high-pressure defoaming machine body, sliding rings are connected to the two sliding rods in a sliding manner, the same bearing plate is fixed between the two sliding rings, a first rack is arranged on the inner wall of the bottom of the high-pressure defoaming machine body, and a driving assembly is arranged at one end of the outer wall of the bottom of the bearing plate. According to the high-pressure deaeration machine for processing the display screen, the driving assembly rotates to enable the bearing plate to extend out of the high-pressure deaeration machine body, so that the display screen can be conveniently moved to the bearing plate, the driven assembly is driven to rotate by the toothed belt when the driving assembly rotates, the second rack and the lifting plate are driven to descend, the elastic assembly is finally pressed on the ground, one end, extending outwards, of the bearing plate is supported, and the bearing plate is not easy to bend when extending outwards to bear load in a long-time use process.

title_en: Method for detecting content of triphenylmethane azide in olmesartan medoxomil
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for detecting the content of triphenylmethane azide in olmesartan medoxomil by adopting a high performance liquid chromatography, wherein a chromatographic column is an octadecylsilane chemically bonded silica gel column Gemini C18,3.0 mu m and 4.6X1150 mm, the column temperature is 30 ℃, the detection is carried out by adopting a liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry method, a mixed mobile phase is eluted in a gradient way, the mobile phase A is 0.1% formic acid solution, the mobile phase B is acetonitrile, and the flow rate is 0.6ml/min. Experiments prove that the method is accurate and reliable, and can meet the detection requirement of actual drug production.

title_en: Tandem devolatilization reaction system and application thereof in preparation of polyamide 6
abstract_en: The invention relates to a serial devolatilization reaction system and application thereof in preparation of polyamide 6, which mixes basic components such as caprolactam, water, molecular weight regulator and additive components in proportion, and sends the basic components to a VK tube reactor for hydrolysis ring-opening reaction after preheating to obtain polyamide 6 basic melt. And further conveying the basic melt into a serial devolatilization reaction system to remove monomers and partial cyclic oligomers, wherein the melt viscosity is obviously improved, and finally the polyamide 6 final polymer with the relative viscosity of 2.0-4.5, the monomer content of less than 0.1wt% and the cyclic oligomer content of less than 1.5wt%, wherein the cyclic dimer content is less than 0.1wt% and the hot water extractable content is less than 0.5wt% is prepared. Compared with the traditional single vertical falling film devolatilization reactor, the system has higher removal efficiency and better tackifying effect, and the final polymer can be directly spun, injection molded or blown to obtain polyamide 6 fiber, engineering plastic or film.

title_en: Multi-dimensional grain screening system and method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The application discloses a multidimensional grain screening system and method based on deep learning, relates to the technical field of agricultural product processing, and solves the technical problems that the accuracy and efficiency of a grain screening system are lower due to the fact that the quality of visual detection characteristics is reduced due to the fact that the influence of screening environments on visual detection parameters is lacked to be considered in the prior art; the method comprises the steps of generating equipment adjustment parameter values according to grain data and environment data, acquiring adjusted detection images and point cloud data based on the equipment adjustment parameter values and generating detection results by combining voiceprint data, generating alarm signals according to the detection results and screening, carrying out quality analysis on data of external defect detection, enabling the quality of the data to be improved through adaptively changing equipment parameters, carrying out step-by-step processing on the detection of the defects inside and outside the grains, improving screening speed and reducing resource consumption, and dynamically adjusting data combination weights according to the quality of the data during external defect detection, so that screening accuracy and screening efficiency are improved.

title_en: Material treatment device and method for recycling industrial solid waste
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of treatment devices, and discloses a material treatment device and a material treatment method for recycling industrial solid wastes, comprising a base, the upper surface symmetry fixed mounting of base has two backup pads, two the backup pad is installed in the rotation between the backup pad the cylinder, a plurality of filtration holes have evenly been seted up to the circumference surface of cylinder. According to the invention, the transfer wheel drives the square sliding cylinder to reciprocate back and forth through the driving groove and the driving column, the square sliding cylinder drives the arc-shaped pipe to reciprocate back and forth, the arc-shaped pipe swings back and forth within a certain angle under the cooperation of the guide post and the guide groove, and the turned and stacked tailing blocks can be scraped to be flat through the device, so that the thickness of the tailing blocks does not exceed the distance between the arc-shaped pipe and the roller, and when the tailing blocks are washed, the water spraying holes can wash soil on the surfaces of the tailing blocks in an omnibearing manner, so that the surfaces of the tailing blocks are sufficiently washed, and the subsequent use is facilitated.

title_en: Nitrogen charging maintenance system of shell-and-tube heat supply network heater and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of nitrogen filling maintenance of heating network heaters, and discloses a nitrogen filling maintenance system of a shell-and-tube heating network heater, which comprises a heating network heater, a nitrogen generator, a pipeline, a distribution connecting box, a valve, a pressure regulating device and a nitrogen filling maintenance method of the shell-and-tube heating network heater, wherein the nitrogen generator is used for generating nitrogen, the pipeline is connected with the nitrogen generator and the heating network heater, the distribution connecting box is arranged on the pipeline, the valve is used for controlling the on-off and flow of the nitrogen, the pressure regulating device is used for maintaining the nitrogen pressure in the heating network heater, and the nitrogen filling maintenance method of the shell-and-tube heating network heater comprises the following operation S1, pretreatment, namely 4 hours before stopping steam supply, the pH value of water supplied by a steam supply unit is improved to 9.5-10, or the pH value of heat supply steam is improved to 9.8-10 through an ammonia adding system.

title_en: Road solid waste treatment recovery plant
abstract_en: The application relates to road solid waste treatment and recovery equipment, and relates to the technical field of solid waste treatment and recovery, comprising a box body, a crushing assembly arranged in the box body, a feeding hole arranged on the top surface of the box body, and a feeding hopper; the feeding plate is obliquely arranged in the feeding hopper, the metering assembly is vertically arranged below the feeding plate, the first metering piece is arranged below the metering rod, the second metering piece is arranged right below the first metering piece and fixedly connected with the feeding hopper, a repulsive force exists between the second metering piece and the first metering piece, the sealing assembly is used for sealing a space between the bottom end of the feeding plate and the side wall of the feeding hopper, the communicating assembly is used for controlling the communicating state of the bottom of the feeding hopper and the outside, the transmission assembly comprises a first transmission part and a second transmission part, the first transmission part is used for adjusting the working state of the sealing assembly based on the extending length of the metering rod, and the second transmission part is used for adjusting the working state of the communicating assembly based on the working state of the sealing assembly. The application can improve the solid waste treatment efficiency.

title_en: Rubber glove gumming device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rubber glove gumming device, which relates to the technical field of rubber glove processing and comprises a conveying frame, wherein a drying box is arranged on the conveying frame, a dust suction mechanism is arranged on the drying box, a vibrating mechanism is arranged on the conveying frame, glove mounting mechanisms which are equidistantly arranged are arranged on the conveying frame, a gumming mechanism is arranged below the conveying frame, a separating mechanism is arranged on the conveying frame, and a collecting frame is arranged below the separating mechanism. This rubber glove gumming device shakes gloves on the gloves mould to shake off the dust on gloves surface, thereby avoided the dust on the gloves to influence the gum dipping quality of follow-up gloves, improved the processingquality of gloves, then absorbed by the suction hood, get into the sack, collect the dust, thereby avoided the dust of loss to the operational environment on every side to cause the pollution, influence the healthy condition of staff on every side, thereby improved the result of use of device.

title_en: Cavitation jet nozzle with inclined helical blade coupled with Helmholtz oscillation cavity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cavitation jet nozzle with a Helmholtz oscillation cavity coupled by an inclined spiral blade, and relates to the technical field of cavitation jet nozzles. The cavitation jet nozzle comprises a nozzle body, wherein an inlet section, a contraction section, an oscillation cavity and an outlet section are arranged on the nozzle body along the axial direction, adjacent components are communicated, a flow guiding part is arranged, the flow guiding part is composed of a first component and a second component, the first component is composed of a diagonal helical blade, the second component is composed of two diagonal helical blades, the first component and the second component are fixed in the inlet section, and a flow channel along the axial direction of the inlet section is formed between the first component and the second component. According to the invention, the inclined spiral blade structure in the flow guide part is matched with the Helmholtz type oscillating cavity, the inclined spiral blade structure is used for enabling the fluid to generate higher tangential flow velocity, and cavitation bubbles generated by the oscillating cavity are used for remarkably improving the cleaning effect of the fluid on the curved surface or the inner wall of the pipeline.

title_en: Automatic spraying equipment is used in production of decoration engineering wall
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of spraying equipment, and particularly relates to automatic spraying equipment for wall surface production in decoration engineering, which comprises a spraying equipment body, wherein the spraying equipment body comprises a movable frame, a spraying mechanism is arranged at the output end of a longitudinal moving component, the spraying mechanism comprises a mounting frame, a forward spraying component is arranged on the mounting frame, an extending spraying component is arranged above two sides of the mounting frame, the forward spraying component comprises a material guide pipe arranged in the mounting frame, a liquid inlet valve is arranged at one side of the material guide pipe, and an automatic control spray head with an on-off opening and closing function is arranged at the other side of the material guide pipe. The invention has reasonable design, simple structure and convenient processing, can realize breakpoint spraying at a processing area aiming at the spraying advancing process, reduces the possibility of waste of materials, saves cost, ensures smooth spraying work, ensures the spraying effect and effectively meets the use requirement.

title_en: Paint art movable shadow room
abstract_en: The invention discloses a paint art movable shadow room, which belongs to the field of paint art and comprises a shadow room main body, wherein a humidifier and a heater are respectively arranged on the front side of the inner top of the shadow room main body, two sides of the front side of the shadow room main body are hinged with a shadow room door, the front side of the shadow room door is fixedly connected with a control panel, and the inner surface of the shadow room main body is provided with a movable assembly for changing the position of a paint. Can realize mutually supporting through first gear and annular rack, first gear rotates in step when carrying out circumference to drive the lacquer ware that dismantles on the subassembly and carry out circular motion and rotation, make the lacquer ware surface be heated more evenly, avoided the lacquer ware to keep away from the region of humidifier and heater, heated temperature is different and humidity is different, and causes same lacquer ware different region drying rate different, causes lacquer ware surface appearance fine line, the phenomenon of crazing or uplift, improves the yield effectively.

title_en: Method and apparatus for oxidizing hydrazine and hydroxylamine in 1BP feed solution
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of nuclear fuel treatment, and discloses a method and equipment for oxidizing hydrazine and hydroxylamine in 1BP feed liquid, wherein on the premise of continuously introducing nitrogen oxides into a reaction container, the 1BP feed liquid is circulated in the reaction container at a required speed of 50%, so as to increase the reaction time of the nitrogen oxides and water in the 1BP feed liquid, further increase the generation amount of nitrous acid, enable the generated nitrous acid to completely oxidize the hydroxylamine and the hydrazine in the 1BP feed liquid, thereby releasing more heat to increase the temperature in the reaction container, and ensure that the hydroxylamine and the nitric acid in the 1BP feed liquid can undergo an autocatalytic reaction to generate nitrous acid after the temperature in the reaction container rises to 42 ℃ or exceeds 42 ℃ and is stabilized for 15 minutes. And then the 1BP feed liquid flows in the reaction container at a required speed of 100%, and under the temperature environment, hydroxylamine and nitric acid in the 1BP feed liquid undergo an autocatalytic reaction to generate nitrous acid, so that the nitrous acid in the reaction container is sufficient for completely oxidizing the hydroxylamine and hydrazine in the 1BP feed liquid.

title_en: Automobile bolt cutting device with fastening clamp
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cutting devices, in particular to an automobile bolt cutting device with a fastening clamp, which comprises a base, wherein the upper end of the base is fixedly connected with an operation table, the outer side of the operation table is provided with a plurality of groups of assembly holes, the inner side of each assembly hole is in threaded connection with a bolt main body, the outer side of each bolt main body is provided with anti-skid threads, the lower end of the operation table is provided with a first motor, an output shaft of the first motor is fixedly connected with a plurality of groups of connecting rods, the other end of each connecting rod is provided with a chamfering mechanism, the chamfering mechanism comprises an oil conveying pipe, the lower end of the oil conveying pipe is provided with an edge chamfering mechanism, the cutting plate clamps threads of the bolt main body through the mutual matching of an annular plate and a fourth rotating shaft, the threads on the outer side of the bolt main body are cut through the opposite rotation of the cutting plate, burrs and impurities on the outer side of the threads are comprehensively removed, and the quality of the bolt main body is improved, and the assembly effect in use is improved.

title_en: Sewage treatment equipment based on MPF technology and control system thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sewage treatment, and discloses sewage treatment equipment based on an MPF process and a control system thereof, which comprises a tank body and a filter layer arranged in the tank body for filtering sewage, the sewage treatment device also comprises a filling mechanism arranged in the tank body for removing sewage pollutants and an aerator arranged on the outer wall of the tank body for aerating the filling mechanism. According to the sewage treatment equipment based on the MPF process, organic matters in sewage are metabolized through the MPF filler body and are converted into harmless matters, meanwhile, the aeration operation is carried out on the sewage by utilizing the aerator, so that the organic matters in the sewage can be oxidatively decomposed into harmless matters such as carbon dioxide and water, direct and uniform aeration of the MPF filler body is realized through the arrangement, the oxygen transmission efficiency is greatly improved, the sufficient oxygen supply of a microbial community is ensured, the degradation process of organic pollutants is accelerated, and the sewage treatment efficiency is remarkably improved.

title_en: Multi-bag filter and filtering method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-bag filter and a filtering method thereof, and relates to the technical field of bag filters, comprising a tank body, a top opening, a bottom opening and a filter head, wherein a feed inlet and a discharge outlet are arranged outside the tank body; the tank cover is used for sealing or opening the top opening of the tank body; the semi-circular groove and the straight groove enable the tank cover to realize horizontal rotation and vertical lifting actions, the lifting actions are used for preventing the tank cover from colliding with the pressing plate and the locking rod when the tank cover rotates, the rotation speed of the pressing plate is higher than the lifting speed of the tank cover, the pressing plate is in contact with the top edge of the tank cover, the sealing performance is improved by pressing a plurality of positions of the edge of the tank cover through the pressing plates, the tank cover is controlled to automatically rotate horizontally to separate from the tank body, and the locking structure of the tank cover is automatically controlled to unlock one by one without manual work, so that the operation is simpler, more convenient and faster.

title_en: Extraction method of extracellular vesicles of probiotics source
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for extracting extracellular vesicles from probiotics, and belongs to the technical field of extracellular vesicle extraction. The method comprises adding inducer into culture medium, inoculating Lactobacillus plantarum and Lactobacillus rhamnosus, fermenting, culturing, filtering, collecting filtrate, adding adsorbent, filtering, adding solid into water, performing ultrasonic desorption, filtering, and lyophilizing filtrate to obtain extracellular vesicles of probiotic origin. The extraction method of the probiotics source extracellular vesicles has the advantages of simplicity, low cost, capability of obtaining the extracellular vesicles with high purity, capability of keeping the activity of the extracellular vesicles, good anti-inflammatory, antioxidant and cell proliferation promoting effects, and wide application prospect.

title_en: Harmless treatment and resource utilization process for heavy metal sludge
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of resource recycling, and particularly relates to a harmless treatment and resource utilization process of heavy metal sludge. The method comprises the following steps of preparing a magnetic colloid solution and a heavy metal adsorption colloid solution, coating magnetic particles by interpenetrating heavy metal adsorption colloid and PAA, preparing a sludge combustion rod and treating incineration ash. According to the invention, the incineration ash is subjected to acid leaching and then added with a magnetic heavy metal adsorbent to remove heavy metal ions, so that the influence on the purity and environmental protection performance of subsequent recycling products is avoided, then, the pH is sequentially adjusted to gradually separate out the effective components in the phosphorus-containing leaching solution, wherein the ferric phosphate can be further processed into lithium iron phosphate which is applied to preparing battery materials, and the solution further contains Ca, mg, K, P, na elements and ammonium chloride after the pH is neutral by adding ammonia water, so that the solution can be applied to fertilizer of strong chlorine-resistant plants after dilution.

title_en: Positive pressure filter capable of continuously switching air liquid supply and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a positive pressure filter capable of continuously switching air and liquid supply and a working method thereof, belonging to the technical field of positive pressure filters, comprising a main frame, wherein the top end of the main frame is fastened and fixed with a gas and liquid input cover, the gas and liquid input cover comprises a top cover frame, the top cap frame's top middle part is fixed with the admission valve pipe, one side of top cap frame is fixed with the air outlet valve pipe, the top of air outlet valve pipe is fixed with the manometer, the top surface opposite side of top cap frame is fixed with the feed liquor valve pipe. This positive pressure filter passes through the built-in feed liquor valve pipe of top cap frame and pumps machine and filters liquid pipeline etc. carrier intercommunication to the hose propelling movement in the cooperation feed liquor valve pipe reaches the liquid outlet of telescopic tube bottom, thereby accomplishes the input to the filtration liquid that needs, and the in-process need not to demolish the top cap frame body, forms the switching that supplies liquid and air pressure to supply through flexible regulation and control, promotes filtration treatment efficiency, avoids the complicated and external impurity of flow that the traditional mode of demolishing caused to mix the phenomenon in the cavity.

title_en: Aggregate non-magnetic manganese steel foreign matter discernment early warning device based on visual discernment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of identification and detection, and discloses an aggregate non-magnetic manganese steel foreign matter identification and early warning device based on visual identification, which comprises a vertical plate, wherein a mounting plate is arranged on the side surface of the vertical plate, a connecting plate is fixedly arranged on the surface of the mounting plate, a bracket is fixedly arranged at the top of the connecting plate, and a vertical plate is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the bracket; the device comprises a vertical plate, a mounting plate movably mounted at one end of the vertical plate, a detection device arranged at the other end of the mounting plate, and a bearing movably mounted in the vertical plate, wherein one end of the bearing is fixedly connected with the mounting plate. The device can ensure that the detection device aims at the target object or region, so that clearer and more accurate image or video data are captured, which is important for the subsequent target detection or recognition task, is beneficial to improving the accuracy and reliability of visual recognition, and can reduce the false detection and missing detection caused by improper angles.

title_en: Composite modified bentonite adsorption material and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of bentonite adsorption material preparation and discloses a composite modified bentonite adsorption material and a preparation process, wherein the preparation process comprises the following steps of S1, coarse crushing bentonite raw ore into particles, fine grinding, sieving with a 200-mesh sieve, and collecting undersize bentonite powder; the method comprises the steps of S2, adding bentonite powder and hydrochloric acid into a reaction kettle for stirring reaction, S3, washing acidified bentonite slurry with deionized water until the pH value of filtrate is=6.5-7.0 after pressure filtration, then drying a filter cake to obtain a pre-dried acidified bentonite filter cake, S4, passing the pre-dried filter cake through a rotary kiln, setting microwave heating in the rotary kiln to finally obtain heat activated bentonite, and S5, mixing the heat activated bentonite and CTAB at 70 ℃. According to the preparation process of the composite modified bentonite adsorption material, the comprehensive adsorption performance of bentonite is remarkably improved through the synergistic effect of acidification, microwave activation and organic intercalation, the microwave activation rapidly removes interlayer water and stabilizes a framework structure, and the risk of thermal collapse is avoided.

title_en: Sewage integrated treatment system for stone processing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of monitoring, in particular to a sewage comprehensive treatment system for stone processing, which comprises a base, a treatment tank, a feed pipe, a flow guide frame, a drainage seat, a fixing frame, a dewatering cylinder, an aeration assembly, an oil collecting tank, a transmission case, a control console, a self-cleaning mechanism, a dewatering mechanism and an oil skimming mechanism. According to the invention, the comprehensive treatment of sewage is realized through the structures such as the feeding pipe, the flow guide frame, the dewatering cylinder, the aeration assembly and the like, so that part of the device can separate and treat the sewage in stages, stone powder and oil slivers in the stone processing sewage are conveniently and synchronously separated, and the device can perform integrated separation treatment on the stone processing sewage through the dewatering mechanism and the oil skimming mechanism, so that water, oil and mud in the sewage can be stably and efficiently separated, and the high efficiency, convenience and stability of the device are improved.

title_en: Flotation separation collecting agent for associated phosphorus resources in vanadium titano-magnetite and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flotation separation collector for associated phosphorus resources in vanadium titano-magnetite and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of mineral processing. The flotation separation collector comprises, by mass, 40% -60% of a main collector, 20% -30% of an auxiliary collector, 10% -18% of a foaming agent and 5% -12% of a chelating agent, wherein the main collector contains phosphonic acid groups. The phosphonic acid group can be selectively adsorbed with Ca  2+  on the surface of the apatite to form a chelate bond to enhance the collection selectivity, the ultrafine-particle gangue can be selectively flocculated to optimize the flotation environment, the high dispersibility can be maintained at low temperature, the collection performance can be enhanced, the water solubility of each component is good, the efficient collection performance is realized, the dosage of the medicament is low, and the investment cost is reduced.

title_en: Production equipment and method for ultra-high density silicon carbide rod
abstract_en: The invention relates to ultra-high density silicon carbide rod production equipment and a method, wherein a silicon carbide rod extrusion die head is arranged at a discharge end of a horizontal extruder, a material receiving platform is arranged at the outer end of the silicon carbide rod extrusion die head, an integrated material receiving support is arranged on the material receiving platform, a material receiving groove with a triangular cross section is arranged at the top of the integrated material receiving support, a microwave drying box is arranged on the material receiving platform, a feed inlet matched with the integrated material receiving support is arranged on one side of the microwave drying box, facing the square discharge side of the silicon carbide rod extrusion die head, transfer ports are formed at the left end and the right end of the microwave drying box, a discharge transfer device is arranged at the bottom of the material receiving platform, manual participation is not needed in the whole discharge process, and manpower resources are saved.

title_en: Intelligent portable fruit and vegetable crusher and power-off coping control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fruit and vegetable sampling, and discloses an intelligent portable fruit and vegetable crusher and a power-off coping control method thereof. The power-off coping control method comprises the steps of responding to abnormal task interruption when the intelligent portable fruit and vegetable crusher breaks, recording power-off information according to interruption occurrence time and obtaining interrupt task records, judging whether a judging result of the interrupt task records exists according to a starting signal after power supply restoration is obtained by judging task abnormal interruption, judging whether task restorability information is obtained by task restoration if the interrupt task records exist, judging restoration selection according to the task restorability information and a confirmation instruction input by a user to obtain task continuing execution instructions, and completing follow-up breaking processing by performing continuous control of breaking tasks according to the task continuing execution instructions. The intelligent portable fruit and vegetable crusher and the power-off coping control method thereof have the advantages of power-off continuous connection and intelligent task recovery.

title_en: Online detection device for pollutant of air pollution source
abstract_en: The invention discloses an on-line detection device for atmospheric pollution source pollutants, which belongs to the field of pollution detection devices and comprises a supporting seat, a detection part, a cleaning part, a mounting cylinder and a supporting rod, wherein the mounting cylinder is mounted on the supporting seat through the supporting rod, the top of the mounting cylinder is connected with a blocking cover through the supporting rod, the detection part and the cleaning part are both arranged in the mounting cylinder, an air guide hopper is arranged in the mounting cylinder, and the detection part and the cleaning part are both arranged in the mounting cylinder. Through with the air suction to detect the incasement, the air passes through the detection sensor of detecting the incasement, and then the pollutant concentration in the real-time detection air, the pollution condition of convenient monitoring environment. The bottom cleaning brush and the side cleaning roller in the cleaning ring are driven to rotate by the driving piece to clean the detection sensor and the detection cylinder, and the adhered pollutants are cleaned, so that the accuracy of subsequent detection is improved, and the service life of the device is prolonged. In the cleaning process, the dust-separating cover shields the air inlet, so that the cleaning effect is prevented from being influenced by dust carried by the air inlet.

title_en: Tripentaerythritol efficient desalting refining equipment and tripentaerythritol efficient desalting refining method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of tripentaerythritol purification and discloses tripentaerythritol efficient desalting refining equipment which comprises a pulse electric field electrodialysis module, an ultrasonic induced crystallization module and an on-line sensor array, wherein the pulse electric field electrodialysis module is used for carrying out desalting treatment on mother liquor containing tripentaerythritol to obtain desalted feed liquor, the ultrasonic induced crystallization module is connected with a liquid outlet of the pulse electric field electrodialysis module and is used for receiving the desalted feed liquor, selectively inducing tripentaerythritol to crystallize and separate out through applying ultrasonic waves and simultaneously separating out tripentaerythritol crystallized out, and the on-line sensor array is arranged between the pulse electric field electrodialysis module and the ultrasonic induced crystallization module and is used for detecting physicochemical parameters of the desalted feed liquor. The continuous high flux and separation performance of the ion exchange membrane under the severe working condition are ensured through the cooperative working mechanism of the sound field and the pulsed electric field in the desalting module, and the technical bottleneck of the traditional electrodialysis technology applied to the feed liquid with high viscosity and high organic matter content is fundamentally overcome.

title_en: Carbon nitride modified carbon fiber composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a carbon nitride modified carbon fiber composite material and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the carbon nitride modified carbon fiber composite material consists of phosphorus doped tubular carbon nitride composite titanium dioxide and modified activated carbon fibers, the phosphorus doped tubular carbon nitride composite titanium dioxide is uniformly distributed on the surface of the modified activated carbon fibers, the carbon nitride modified carbon fiber composite material shows characteristic peaks at the positions of diffraction angles 2 theta of 25.37 degrees+/-0.20 degrees, 38.60 degrees+/-0.20 degrees, 48.07 degrees+/-0.20 degrees, 54.86 degrees+/-0.20 degrees and 62.58 degrees+/-0.20 degrees, the characteristic peaks correspond to crystal faces (001), (101), (112), (200), (211) and (204), the characteristic peaks indicate the high crystallization property of the titanium dioxide, and the carbon nitride modified carbon fiber composite material is used for degrading normal hexane in VOCs, and the degradation rate is more than or equal to 80.5 percent.

title_en: Multistage cold pressing equipment is used in camellia oil processing
abstract_en: The invention discloses multistage cold pressing equipment for camellia oil processing, which belongs to the technical field of camellia oil cold pressing, wherein a plurality of groups of symmetrical filling cavities are formed in a box body, filling pipes are fixedly connected to the tops of the filling cavities, cold pressing cavities are formed in the box body and located below the filling cavities, the filling cavities are communicated with the cold pressing cavities, material rings are arranged in each filling cavity, a moving assembly is arranged in the box body and used for driving the material rings to move between the filling cavities and the cold pressing cavities, a forming assembly is arranged in the box body and used for pressing raw materials injected into the inner sides of the material rings into cakes, and a pressing assembly is arranged at the bottom of the box body and used for pushing the cakes located in the cold pressing cavities to the middle positions of the cold pressing cavities for pressing. Compared with the traditional single-stage squeezing equipment, the multi-stage squeezing equipment has the advantages that the oil yield is effectively improved, the residual oil yield is reduced, the oil collecting and filtering system is optimized, and the equipment space utilization rate and the production efficiency are improved.

title_en: Blade battery coating equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of battery coating, in particular to blade battery coating equipment, which comprises a support, a moving mechanism, a first clamp, a supporting device, a coating mechanism, a cleaning device, a second clamp and an anti-slip pad, wherein the moving mechanism is arranged on the support, the first clamp is arranged on the moving end of the moving mechanism, the second clamp is arranged on the supporting device, the supporting device is used for driving the second clamp to move and adjust, the anti-slip pad is arranged on the clamping end of the second clamp, the coating mechanism is arranged on the right side of the second clamp and is used for coating, rolling and laminating the blade battery, cutting and conveying the blue film, the cleaning device is arranged on the left side of the second clamp and is used for cleaning the front surface of the blade battery coating, the quality of the blade battery coating is improved, the anti-slip effect on the blade battery clamping is improved, the processing efficiency of the equipment is improved, the running cost of the equipment is reduced, and the use convenience is improved.

title_en: Preparation method of 2,4, 6-tri (2-hydroxy 4-n-hexyloxy aryl) -1,3, 5-triazine
abstract_en: The application discloses a preparation method of 2,4, 6-tri (2-hydroxy-4-n-hexyloxy aryl) -1,3, 5-triazine, which belongs to the technical field of organic synthesis, and the preparation method comprises the steps of taking a benzenediol compound and chloro-n-hexane as raw materials, carrying out etherification reaction under the action of piperidine, and carrying out aftertreatment to obtain an intermediate, and carrying out Al2O 3-loaded ZnO catalyst on the intermediate and cyanuric chloride to generate 2,4, 6-tri (2-hydroxy-4-n-hexyloxy aryl) -1,3, 5-triazine; the synthesis route has the advantages of low cost, easy obtainment of raw materials, wide sources, effective reduction of industrial wastewater generation and waste acid reduction, thereby reducing production cost, high yield and few byproducts, and being beneficial to industrial production.

title_en: Purification method of low-impurity lithium carbonate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for purifying low-impurity lithium carbonate, which comprises seven steps of leaching, impurity removal, purification, evaporation concentration, lithium precipitation, centrifugal desalination and mother solution circulation. During leaching, the lithium-containing material is mixed with water and then subjected to supergravity treatment in a rotating packed bed, and the temperature is regulated and controlled in two sections to obtain the leaching solution. Li2S is added to remove heavy metals in the impurity removal procedure, and then deep impurity removal is carried out through a composite system of modified D751 chelating resin and free EDTA, wherein the modified D751 chelating resin is prepared by grafting EDTA groups and loading nano zirconium dioxide. The purification adopts two-stage treatment of gradient pore composite resin balls and double-layer ceramic membranes. According to the invention, through deep impurity removal of the modified D751 chelate resin, two-stage purification of the gradient pore composite resin balls and the double-layer ceramic membrane, and combination of mother liquor circulation, the purity of lithium carbonate, the impurity removal rate and the lithium recovery rate can be obviously improved, and the method is suitable for industrial production.

title_en: Preparation method of catalyst master batch and catalyst master batch thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of environment-friendly resource recycling, and particularly relates to a preparation method of a catalyst master batch and a catalyst master batch thereof, and more particularly relates to a preparation method of a catalyst master batch utilizing an FCC spent catalyst and a catalyst master batch prepared by the method. By using the method, two industrial solid wastes of the FCC dead catalyst and the red mud can be recycled, the preparation process is simple, a complex pretreatment process is not needed, and meanwhile, the prepared catalyst master batch is free of burning, high in strength, good in acid resistance and high in added value.

title_en: Shower handle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shower handle, which comprises a shell, a handle connected with the shell and used for holding, a valve core mechanism for controlling flow and an adjusting mechanism for adjusting the valve core, wherein the valve core mechanism is redesigned and the structure of the valve core mechanism is matched with that of the adjusting mechanism, under the transmission of a crank connecting rod, an operating piece is directly pushed to drive a valve plate to rotate when in use, the dislocation degree of an orifice I and a connecting hole on the valve plate is correspondingly adjusted, if the first orifice and the connecting hole on the valve plate are completely misplaced in the initial state, the first water delivery channel and the second water delivery channel are disconnected, and when the valve plate is used, the first orifice and the connecting hole are corresponding to each other by pushing the operating member, and the valve plate can be partially or completely corresponding to each other according to the needs.

title_en: Double-scale nanofiber membrane capable of removing oily and non-oily particles and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a double-scale nanofiber membrane capable of removing oily and non-oily particles, which is characterized in that acetone and DMF are used as solvents, and a cationic surfactant DTAC, an anionic surfactant SDS and cellulose acetate are added into the solvents to prepare a precursor solution. The addition of DTAC and SDS can increase the conductivity and viscosity of the dope and affect the cellulose acetate molecular chains. The spinning jet is easy to split under the action of electrostatic attraction to form superfine fibers, and the cellulose acetate double-scale nanofiber membrane is prepared by one-step method. The preparation process is simple and convenient to operate, and the prepared cellulose acetate double-scale nanofiber membrane has excellent filtering performance and can have good interception effect on oily PM  0.3  and non-oily PM  0.3 .

title_en: Method for efficiently deaminizing and recycling ammonia-containing calcium slag
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of solid waste treatment, and particularly relates to a method for efficiently deaminizing and recycling ammonia-containing calcium slag. The method comprises the following steps of S1, preheating ammonia-containing calcium slag by utilizing roasting flue gas, converting free ammonia from a liquid state to a gaseous state, removing the ammonia to obtain ammonia-containing calcium slag and ammonia-containing gas after ammonia removal, S2, water-cooling absorption, cooling and condensing the ammonia-containing gas into ammonia water through a heat exchanger, recycling the ammonia water for preparing a tungsten smelting desorbent, S3, roasting and converting, namely roasting the ammonia-containing calcium slag into quicklime, S4, adjusting the pH value, namely, using the quicklime prepared by conversion for adjusting the pH value of ammonia-containing wastewater, and returning the ammonia-containing calcium slag after filter pressing to the step S1 for recycling treatment. The method not only realizes the efficient removal and recycling of ammonia in the ammonia-containing calcium slag, but also converts the calcium slag into quicklime, builds a closed cycle utilization path, solves the common problem of high difficulty in the disposal and utilization of the ammonia-containing calcium slag, and has the advantages of energy conservation, environmental protection, low cost, simple and convenient operation and the like.

title_en: Continuous crushing device for organic garbage treatment
abstract_en: The application provides a continuous crushing device for organic garbage treatment, and belongs to the technical field of organic garbage treatment. The continuous crushing device for the organic garbage treatment comprises a crusher, a feed hopper and a filtering structure, wherein the crusher comprises a crushing box and a crushing roller, the crushing roller is rotatably arranged in the crushing box, a first motor used for driving the crushing roller to operate is fixed in the crushing box, a discharge hole of the feed hopper is communicated with the inside of the crushing box, the filtering structure comprises a screen frame and a screen plate, the screen plate is embedded in the screen frame, the screen frame is an annular frame, the screen frame is rotatably connected with the crushing box, and the screen plate comprises a plurality of filter plates which are distributed in an equidistant annular mode. The rotary design of the annular screen frame ensures that the screen plate is replaced without stopping, the replacement time of a single screen plate is greatly shortened, the continuous operation rate of the equipment is improved, and the annular screen frame is particularly suitable for municipal and catering scenes with larger garbage treatment capacity.

title_en: Purging method, control module, purging device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a purging method, a control module, purging equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining purging instructions comprising preset purging paths and purging modes, wherein the preset purging paths comprise a plurality of paths which are sequentially arranged, and each purging mode is associated with a preset purging direction; the method includes the steps of controlling a purge device to travel along a first path from a start point of a first path in a preset purge path and to perform a purge operation in a preset purge direction, controlling the purge device to perform a transfer operation corresponding to a purge mode to transfer the purge device to a start point of a next path in the preset purge path when an end point of the first path is reached, and controlling the purge device to travel along the preset purge path from the start point of the next path and to perform the purge operation in the preset purge direction. The invention improves the blowing effect and the intelligence of blowing operation.

title_en: Method for activating silver catalyst, catalyst and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of catalysts, and relates to a method for activating a silver catalyst, and a catalyst and application thereof. The method comprises the steps of (1) fully contacting an alpha-alumina carrier with a silver-containing impregnating solution, leaching to remove excessive impregnating solution to obtain a silver catalyst precursor, and (2) carrying out infrared radiation activation treatment on the silver catalyst precursor obtained in the step (1), wherein the condition of the infrared radiation activation treatment comprises that the air flow rate is 0-5000h  ‑1 , the irradiation temperature is 100-500 ℃, and the irradiation time is 1-50min. The activation method has advanced process, safety, environmental protection, simple operation and even distribution of the silver catalyst active ingredient and the cocatalyst, and the prepared catalyst has better activity and selectivity in olefin epoxidation reaction.

title_en: Quick desorption and regenerating unit of adsorption tower adsorbate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid desorption and regeneration device for adsorbates of an adsorption tower, which relates to the technical field of desorption and regeneration of adsorbates, and specifically comprises a bottom plate, wherein a base is fixed on the outer wall of the top of the bottom plate through bolts, a first fixing seat and a second fixing seat are respectively fixed on the outer walls of the two sides of the top of the base through bolts, one side of the first fixing seat is provided with a mounting hole, a vertical attaching mechanism is arranged in the mounting hole, one side of the second fixing seat is fixedly connected with a conducting bar, the lifting end of the vertical attaching mechanism is rotationally connected with an attaching plate, the attaching plate and the conducting bar form sliding fit, the outer walls of the two sides of the first fixing seat are fixedly connected with sliding bars, one side of the sliding bars is connected with a sliding block, the sliding block and the attaching plate are integrally formed, the outer walls of the two sides of the top of the base are provided with positioning mechanisms, and an adsorbent is clamped between the two positioning mechanisms. According to the invention, the distance between the heating plate and the adsorbent is adjusted by the height, so that more uniform heat conduction is realized, and the phenomenon of local overheating or supercooling is avoided, thereby improving the desorption efficiency.

title_en: Method for direct conversion of crude oil to light olefins and light aromatics by steam enhanced catalytic cracking over a core-shell cracking catalyst
abstract_en: A process for converting a hydrocarbon feedstock includes contacting the hydrocarbon feedstock with steam in the presence of a cracking catalyst under steam enhanced catalytic cracking conditions. Contacting a hydrocarbon feedstock with steam in the presence of a cracking catalyst causes at least a portion of the hydrocarbon feedstock to undergo a steam catalytic cracking reaction to produce a cracked effluent comprising C  2  to C  4  olefins, C  6  to C  10  aromatics, or both. The cracking catalyst is nano particles. The nanoparticle has a core and a shell. The core comprises at least one zeolite particle, wherein the at least one zeolite particle comprises a ZSM-5 zeolite, a beta zeolite, a Y-zeolite, or a combination of these zeolites. The shell is mesoporous and comprises silica (SiO  2 ), alumina (Al  2 O 3 ), or silica and alumina.

title_en: Welding device and positioning fixture
abstract_en: The invention provides a welding device and a positioning clamp, wherein the positioning clamp comprises two movable tables, the top of each movable table is provided with a top plate, the two movable tables are fixedly arranged on two sides of the bottom of a partition plate respectively, clamping assemblies are arranged on the top plates of the two movable tables, the output end of a rotary driving mechanism is connected with the center of the bottom of the partition plate, a material guiding inclined plate is fixedly arranged on the top plate of the movable table, the height of the top surface of the material guiding inclined plate is gradually reduced along the direction deviating from the partition plate, a knocking mechanism is used for knocking the material guiding inclined plate, the bottom surface of the material guiding inclined plate and the top surface of the top plate of the movable table enclose a separation cavity, and the knocking mechanism is arranged in the separation cavity. The welding device comprises a welding part, wherein the welding part is arranged on one side of the positioning clamp, and the welding part comprises a mechanical arm and a welding gun arranged at the tail end of the mechanical arm. The welding device has the advantages that the two groups of clamping assemblies are used alternately, the welding efficiency is improved, and the arrangement of the material guiding inclined plate and the knocking mechanism is convenient for automatically removing scraps on the table top.

title_en: Coated granular fertilizer
abstract_en: An embodiment of the present invention relates to a coated granular fertilizer comprising a granular fertilizer and a coating film coating the surface of the granular fertilizer, wherein the coating film comprises a biodegradable resin (a) and at least 1 wax (B) selected from the group consisting of a natural wax (B1) having an ester group and a modified product (B2) thereof, and the wax (B) is less than 80 mass% in 100 mass% of the coating film.

title_en: Solid phase extraction equipment for agricultural product detection
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of extraction equipment, in particular to solid-phase extraction equipment for agricultural product detection, which comprises an extraction instrument, a column tube positioned on the side surface of the extraction instrument, an infusion mechanism, a quantitative transfer mechanism and a transport disc, wherein the infusion mechanism is arranged on the side surface of the extraction instrument, the quantitative transfer mechanism is arranged at the top of the infusion mechanism, and a support ring is rotatably arranged on the outer side of the transport disc and is arranged on the infusion mechanism. According to the invention, through the arrangement of the infusion mechanism, the sliding plate is controlled to slide, the liquid outlet pipe can be quickly moved to the top of the column pipe to which the reagent needs to be added, the bottom of the liquid outlet pipe is controlled to be attached to the inner wall of the column pipe by the spring, so that the reagent can flow through the inner wall when being added, the shaking of the extraction liquid can not be caused, the full contact between the target compound and the extraction agent can be ensured, the extraction efficiency can be improved, meanwhile, the shaking can be avoided, the occurrence of the emulsification phenomenon can be reduced, and the extraction process is smoother.

title_en: Amidoxime group polymer adsorption material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of adsorbent materials, and particularly relates to an amidoxime polymer adsorbent material, a preparation method and application thereof. The invention takes tannic acid and tetrafluoro terephthalonitrile as raw materials, forms a precursor polymer with a three-dimensional network cross-linked structure through a cross-linking reaction, introduces amidoxime groups through amidoxime reaction, and obtains the amidoxime polymer adsorption material. The method realizes high-selectivity coordination capture of gold ions by introducing amidoxime groups, realizes in-situ reduction of gold ions by using phenolic hydroxyl groups of tannins, and endows the material with high stability under harsh environment by using a fluorine-containing rigid cross-linked framework. The material can directly finish gold selective adsorption, in-situ reduction and elemental gold recovery in one step from complex electronic waste leachate, omits elution and additional reduction steps in the traditional process, and has the advantages of simple flow, high efficiency, good selectivity, low cost, environmental protection and the like.

title_en: Courtyard greenhouse micro-spray irrigation system with temperature and humidity monitoring function
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of courtyard greenhouses, in particular to a courtyard greenhouse micro-spray irrigation system with temperature and humidity monitoring, which aims at the problems of single monitoring surface, single irrigation mode and complex system cost in the prior art, and provides the following scheme, wherein the system comprises an outer cover component, a planting box, a spray irrigation component and a layered monitoring component. The layering monitoring assembly is introduced, and the function of three-dimensional environment monitoring can be achieved by only one sensor. The design not only greatly reduces the system cost, but also promotes the stirring and mixing of each layer of air through air flow returning, effectively breaks through stable air layering in the greenhouse, improves the environmental uniformity and the representativeness of monitoring data, and provides a reliable technical foundation for accurate environmental regulation and control of the courtyard greenhouse.

title_en: Dewatering device for fresh kelp production and processing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of kelp processing and discloses a dewatering device for fresh kelp production and processing, which comprises a frame, wherein a drain seat is fixed on the top surface of the frame, a sewage tank is arranged on the frame, the drain seat is communicated with the sewage tank through a drain pipe, a fixing seat is fixed on the drain seat, a fixing cylinder is fixed on the top end of the fixing seat, an opening is formed in the peripheral surface of the fixing cylinder, a rotatable door plate is arranged on the fixing cylinder, the door plate is arranged opposite to the opening, and a plurality of drain holes are formed in the fixing cylinder. According to the invention, the water on the kelp is thrown out by utilizing the centrifugal force through the high-speed rotating dehydration plate, so that preliminary dehydration treatment is realized, meanwhile, the wringing mechanism is designed, when the dehydration plate rotates at a high speed, the wringing wheel applies pressure to the kelp under the combined action of the centrifugal force and the second elasticity of the spring, so that the water in the kelp is further extruded, the dehydration effect is remarkably enhanced by the double dehydration mode, the dehydration time is effectively shortened, and the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Soil heavy metal restoration equipment for environmental treatment
abstract_en: The invention discloses soil heavy metal restoration equipment for environmental treatment, and belongs to the technical field of environmental treatment. Soil heavy metal restoration equipment for environmental remediation, including running gear and the brace table of setting above that, the top of brace table is provided with the conveyer belt that is used for conveying the soil that waits to repair, and the both sides surface of conveyer belt is all fixed mounting has a plurality of wedge, and the surface middle part top of conveyer belt is provided with the mounting bracket, and the bottom surface of mounting bracket corresponds fixed mounting respectively has two first balladeur carriages, two second balladeur carriages and two third balladeur carriages. This soil heavy metal repair equipment for environmental remediation compares traditional partial soil repair equipment, and the device can realize the garrulous of inserting to the knot soil through inserting garrulous ware to soil after will inserting garrulous through the screed is leveled, guarantees that the repair liquid sprays more comprehensively on the soil surface, and then has improved the repair effect of soil repair equipment to soil.

title_en: Heat recovery device and method in carbon fiber precursor production
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heat recovery device and a heat recovery method in carbon fiber precursor production. The heat recovery device in carbon fiber precursor production comprises a monomer recovery tower, a heat exchanger, a fresh air preheater and a heat exchanger, wherein a liquid inlet of the heat exchanger is used for allowing mother liquid to enter, a vapor inlet of the heat exchanger is communicated with the monomer recovery tower and is used for exchanging heat between vapor and the mother liquid which are discharged from the monomer recovery tower so as to raise the temperature of the mother liquid, a liquid inlet of the fresh air preheater is communicated with the heat exchanger and is used for exchanging heat between the mother liquid after raising the temperature and fresh air which is applied to drying treatment so as to preheat the fresh air, and the heat of the vapor discharged from the monomer recovery tower is transferred to the mother liquid so as to raise the temperature of the mother liquid and the heat of the mother liquid after raising the temperature is transferred to the fresh air which is applied to drying treatment, so that the heat of the mother liquid and the heat of the vapor in the monomer recovery tower are fully recycled, and energy is saved.

title_en: Flotation system, flotation production line and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a flotation system, a flotation production line and uses thereof. A flotation line for treating ore particles suspended in a slurry, the flotation line (10) comprising a scavenger section (12) and a scavenger selection section (13), characterized in that the scavenger section or scavenger selection section comprises a flotation machine (200) with a jet pipe (4) for introducing a slurry feed (100) into the flotation machine, or the scavenger section or scavenger selection section is followed by a flotation machine with a jet pipe for introducing a slurry feed into the flotation machine.

title_en: Material automation equipment sorting device with goods arrangement mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sorting devices, in particular to a sorting device of material automation equipment with a goods sorting mechanism, which comprises two groups of sorting tables, wherein four groups of discharging side plates are arranged at the end, away from each other, of the outer surfaces of the two groups of sorting tables, one group of discharging side plates comprises two groups of side plates, a plurality of hollow discharging shafts are rotatably arranged on the outer surfaces of the two groups of side plates, which are close to each other, of the two sides of the two groups of side plates, a plurality of telescopic holes are uniformly formed in the outer surfaces of the discharging shafts, vent pipes are fixedly arranged at the two ends of the inner surfaces of the discharging shafts, a plurality of air bag rings are fixedly arranged on the outer surfaces of the vent pipes in a uniformly sleeved mode, a plurality of resistance blocks are fixedly arranged on the outer surfaces of the air bag rings in a uniformly sleeved mode, the other ends of the resistance blocks extend into the telescopic holes, and a goods sorting table is fixedly arranged on one side of the two groups of the sorting tables. The invention realizes the integrated operation flow of goods sorting and sorting, greatly reduces the requirement of on-line manual sorting, and reduces the labor cost while ensuring the sorting efficiency.

title_en: Target capsule convenient for replacing target and target replacement method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of isotope production equipment, in particular to a target capsule convenient for replacing a target and a target replacement method. The target capsule comprises a first shell, a second shell and a target material, wherein the first shell is provided with a first concave cavity, an opening of the first concave cavity is positioned on a first end face of the first shell, the second shell is provided with a second concave cavity, an opening of the second concave cavity is positioned on the first end face of the second shell, the target material is used for receiving bombardment of high-energy particles to produce isotopes, the first shell is embedded in the second concave cavity and is in threaded connection with the second shell, the target material is installed in the first concave cavity, and the bottom wall of the second concave cavity covers the opening of the first concave cavity. According to the invention, the sealing structure of the target capsule is optimized into the first shell and the second shell which are connected through the threaded structure, so that a worker can conveniently assemble, disassemble and replace the target capsule, the sealing structure can be reused, and the production efficiency of isotopes is improved.

title_en: Solid-liquid separation type filter for flow battery and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a solid-liquid separation type filter for a flow battery and a method thereof, belonging to the technical field of energy storage of the flow battery, wherein a liquid outlet pipe is arranged at the top end of a filter body, a liquid inlet pipe is arranged at the side surface of the filter body, a filter element is positioned in the filter body and is detachably connected with one end of the liquid outlet pipe, the liquid inlet pipe is flush with the top of the filter body, the filter body comprises first casing and second casing, the connection can be dismantled to first casing the second casing, and the funnel form baffle sets up inside the filter body and is located the bottom outside of filter core, sets up the hole on the funnel form baffle, and the solid impurity collecting vat can be dismantled the bottom that sets up at the filter body, and during the use, solid impurity is filtered by filter core to pass through the hole is deposited inside the solid impurity collecting vat. The invention can solve the problem that the filter element is blocked by solid impurities in the prior art.
