title_en: Matte brightening agent for providing leather surface protection and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of leather finishing, and particularly relates to a matte brightening agent for protecting the surface of leather and a preparation method thereof. The raw materials comprise 30-40 parts of the self-extinction type water-based polyurethane resin, 20-40 parts of the polyurethane resin, 0.2-0.8 part of the flatting agent and the like. The product is prepared by a gradient rotating speed mixing and stepwise feeding process, and the product has excellent ageing resistance and solvent resistance by utilizing the synergistic effect of the resin and the organosilicon modified microspheres, has 60-DEG glossiness of less than or equal to 1.0, has soft hand feeling and antibacterial function, can meet the requirements of high-end scenes such as automobile interior leather, solves the problems of higher glossiness, insufficient weather resistance and the like of the existing product, and is suitable for various leather substrates.

title_en: Steel member surface coating thickness control system based on machine vision
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of industrial coating engineering and automatic control, and relates to a steel member surface coating thickness control system based on machine vision, which is used for sensing electromagnetic characteristics of a liquid coating in real time through a dielectric parameter detection module, analyzing rheological and dynamic behaviors of the coating by utilizing a micro dynamics measurement module and combining impact force sensing and structured light imaging, merging direct measurement results of a machine vision module on the three-dimensional morphology of the coating, synchronously packaging the information and spray gun pose data into physical state vectors by virtue of a multi-source data fusion module, matching an optimal strategy through a collaborative decision control module, generating a control instruction, and finally forming a controlled fluid resonance perturbation field in jet flow so as to realize in-situ and self-adaptive regulation and control of a coating deposition process.

title_en: Frequency converter heat dissipation device and method for improving air suspension
abstract_en: The invention provides a frequency converter heat dissipation device and method for lifting air suspension, and relates to the field of frequency converter heat dissipation, wherein the frequency converter heat dissipation device comprises a positioning and mounting shell, a frequency converter main body, a water cooling heat dissipation plate, a cooling liquid flow guide pipe, spiral turbulent fins and a heat dissipation fan; the invention solves the problems that the inner wall of a water pipe is provided with scale and water pipe blockage is easy to cause after the water pipe is conveyed for a long time, and the invention avoids the blockage caused by scale deposition on the inner wall of the pipe, improves the heat dissipation efficiency of the frequency converter, reduces equipment faults caused by overheating, prolongs the overall service life of the frequency converter and an air suspension fan, ensures continuous and stable operation of the air suspension fan, and solves the problems that the inner wall of the water pipe is provided with scale and the water pipe is easy to be blocked after the water pipe is conveyed with cooling liquid for a long time.

title_en: Preparation method and application of strong electrophilic biochar
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of catalysts, and discloses a preparation method and application of strongly electrophilic biochar. Removing metal and other impurities in the agricultural straw by acid washing, performing heat treatment on the agricultural straw subjected to acid washing under the protection of inert gas to form biochar, and adjusting and controlling the flow of the inert gas, the heat treatment temperature, the heat treatment time and the heating rate during the heat treatment to remove nitrogen and oxygen-containing functional groups in the biochar, constructing vacancy defects for removing two carbon atoms in the biochar, and connecting pentagon topological defects on the edges of the carbon vacancy defects to prepare the strongly electrophilic biochar, so that the electron donating ability of the biochar is higher than that of the biochar, thereby inducing PAA oxidation to be a dominant reaction, and realizing 100% selective generation of CH  3  C (O) OO.. The strong electrophilic biochar prepared by the method has obviously improved catalytic performance, and the organic property of the activated peroxyacetic acid degradation is superior to that of the reported metal material and carbon material, and the commercial biochar.

title_en: Non-contact suspension stirring equipment and stirring method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses non-contact suspension stirring equipment and a stirring method thereof. The device is fixed at the bottom of the liquid container through the flange and the isolation sleeve, the motor is adjusted to a proper stirring speed through the speed reducer, the main shaft of the speed reducer drives the input shaft to rotate through the coupler, the driving rotor shell and the inner magnet thereof are driven to generate a rotating magnetic field, and the magnetic coupling of the inner magnet and the outer magnet is utilized to drive the suspension stirring mechanism to rotate. The suspension supporting system adopts homopolar repulsion principle to keep the stirring mechanism in suspension, and the sliding bearing is formed by the silicon carbide abrasion-resistant shaft sleeve, so that friction and abrasion are reduced. The non-contact power transmission between the main transmission component and the stirring mechanism is realized, the leakage and pollution of a mechanical seal are avoided, the non-contact power transmission device has the characteristics of wear resistance, low shear, low energy consumption, stable operation and the like, is suitable for occasions requiring sterile and low-shear stirring such as biological medicines, dairy products and beverages, and has wide industrial application value.

title_en: Composite material glass fiber reinforced plastic recovery device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composite material glass fiber reinforced plastic recovery device which comprises symmetrically arranged supporting frames, wherein a shredding mechanism is arranged between the two supporting frames, a hammer crusher is arranged below the shredding mechanism and fixed with the supporting frames at the two sides, a crushing mechanism is arranged on the right side of the supporting frames, the hammer crusher is arranged above the crushing mechanism, a material guide channel is communicated between the crushing mechanism and the hammer crusher, a discharging frame is arranged on the right side of the crushing mechanism, a driving mechanism is arranged on the outer side of the crushing mechanism, the crushing mechanism comprises a shell and a material guide cylinder, the material guide cylinder is communicated with the shell, a waste crushing cylinder for grinding and crushing glass fiber reinforced plastic waste is arranged in the shell, a supporting shaft is arranged in the discharging frame, and a screening component is arranged on the right end face of the supporting shaft. The invention can manufacture the massive glass fiber reinforced plastic waste into the recycling materials with different particle sizes, and can carry out classified collection according to different requirements, thereby facilitating the recycling of the glass fiber reinforced plastic waste.

title_en: Treatment equipment with metal plate
abstract_en: The invention provides a processing device with a metal plate, wherein a one-dimensional metal plate structure which is arranged on the opposite inner wall of a certain rectangular microwave feed port is adopted in a processing cavity, the axial direction of the metal plate is parallel to the long side of a rectangular microwave feed port under the precondition of limiting the distance between the upper inner wall and the lower inner wall of the processing cavity, the purpose of preventing microwaves from the microwave feed port from propagating along each horizontal direction is achieved, and the microwaves from the microwave feed port are limited near the microwave feed port and can be used for heating and processing various processed materials. The invention can form a microwave tunnel oven or a microwave drying oven, adopts microwaves to carry out various treatments on various materials, including heating, drying, enzyme deactivation, sterilization, peculiar smell removal and curing treatments on foods or medicinal materials, and can be also used in the fields of chemical industry, new material production, ceramic sintering, microwave powder metallurgy and the like.

title_en: Reaction device for preparing NiP binary alloy by carbothermal rapid reduction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reaction device for preparing NiP binary alloy by carbothermal rapid reduction, which relates to the field of carbothermal reduction devices and comprises a reaction tank, wherein a feeding pipeline is arranged in the reaction tank and distributed on the periphery of an inner ring of the reaction tank in a spiral structure, the upper end of the feeding pipeline is communicated with a feeding pipeline, a feeding main pipe is arranged on the feeding pipeline, and the feeding main pipe is used for being connected with a material pump for pumping mixed materials into the reaction tank. According to the invention, the feeding pipeline is in a spiral structure, the mixture is preheated along the spiral channel before entering the reaction tank, so that the efficiency of carbothermic reaction is further improved, the mixing degree of the mixture can be improved, and the temperature inside the reaction tank can be quickly increased to 800 ℃ by adopting the silicon carbide rod heating plate, so that the reaction time is obviously shortened.

title_en: Self-adaptive swing angle controllable operation mechanical arm, working method and robot
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of mechanical arms for robots, and relates to a self-adaptive swing angle controllable operation mechanical arm, a working method and a robot, wherein a telescopic component is arranged above a swing rod device and is used for driving the swing rod device and a directional transmission component to slide and stretch; the directional transmission assembly is arranged below the swing rod device, one end of the directional transmission assembly is connected with the power assembly, the other end of the directional transmission assembly is connected with the gap adjusting assembly and used for transmitting power from the power assembly to the operation module, the gap adjusting assembly is used for adjusting the distance between the operation module and the working surface, the operation module is arranged below the gap adjusting assembly, and the sensing system is arranged at the front end of the swing rod device. According to the invention, the swing angle power driving device is used for controlling the swing of the mechanical arm, the directional control device is used for controlling the angle adjustment of the spray head system, so that the synchronous linkage control of the swing of the mechanical arm and the angle of the spray head is realized, the uniformity of the coating is improved, the length of the mechanical arm can be flexibly adjusted, and the operation flexibility, the operation efficiency and the stability are improved.

title_en: Iodized drying system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an iodizing and drying system which comprises a barrel, an iodizing mechanism, a drying mechanism and a lifting mechanism, wherein a cavity is formed in the barrel, a feeding end communicated with the cavity is arranged at the top of the barrel, the iodizing mechanism comprises a spraying piece, the spraying piece is arranged on the barrel and positioned at the inner top of the cavity, the spraying piece can spray iodized liquid into the cavity, the drying mechanism is communicated with the cavity and can convey hot air flow into the cavity, the lifting mechanism is connected with the bottom of the barrel and penetrates through the cavity, salt at the bottom of the cavity can be lifted to the inner top of the cavity and discharged into the cavity by the lifting mechanism, and the salt in the cavity can be discharged to the outside of the barrel by the lifting mechanism. Solves the problems of the prior art that the iodine solution and the salt are not uniformly mixed and the drying efficiency of the moisture in the iodine solution is lower.

title_en: Flexible-cis full-freedom ultrasonic application and workpiece stress dynamic regulation and control system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flexible-cis full-freedom ultrasonic application and workpiece stress dynamic regulation and control modularized device and a method, which are used for improving the machining precision of complex workpieces, optimizing stress distribution, reducing local load and improving surface quality. The device comprises a flexible cis ultrasonic tool head, a multi-joint gesture control mechanism and a multi-source monitoring closed-loop control system, wherein the tool head realizes 360-degree rotation through an annular guide rail, and the multi-joint mechanism and the flexible connection structure adapt to complex curved surfaces to realize efficient coupling of vibration energy. The monitoring system collects force, acoustic emission and temperature signals in real time, and the closed-loop control module dynamically adjusts the ultrasonic direction, amplitude, frequency and position, so that local stress optimization and overall homogenization are realized. The method realizes single processing stress accurate control and deformation controllability through graded application, local stress optimization and integral stress homogenization treatment, and the modular design supports rapid switching, is suitable for batch production, remarkably improves processing stability, precision and surface quality, reduces material damage and energy consumption, and has wide industrial application prospect and economic benefit.

title_en: Portable acupuncture needle disinfection receiver
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of acupuncture needle disinfection storage, in particular to a portable acupuncture needle disinfection storage box, which comprises a box body, wherein a transparent observation plate is fixedly connected to the right side of the top of the box body, a needle placement opening is fixedly connected to the inner side of the transparent observation plate, a disinfection pond is arranged on the inner side of the box body, a flushing part is arranged on the inner side of the box body, the flushing part is arranged on the left side of the disinfection pond, a needle arrangement component is arranged on the left side of the flushing part, a needle distributing plate is arranged on the left side of the needle arrangement component, the disinfection pond comprises a dipping pond, a falling frame is arranged at the top of the dipping pond, and a plurality of through holes are formed in the bottom of the falling frame. The invention provides a portable acupuncture needle disinfection storage box, which has the advantages that the portable acupuncture needle disinfection storage box can be used for timely chemical soaking disinfection after being rapidly put in by personnel, is convenient for subsequent flushing, can be used for rapidly storing acupuncture needles according to the size after finishing disinfection treatment, and can be used for rapid taking by personnel when being used as a container.

title_en: Automatic integrated medicament adding equipment and automatic adding method
abstract_en: The invention discloses integrated automatic reagent feeding equipment and an automatic reagent feeding method, wherein the integrated automatic reagent feeding equipment comprises a water quality monitoring mechanism, a reagent mixing mechanism and a reagent feeding mechanism which are arranged in a sewage treatment tank, the water quality monitoring mechanism comprises a water quality monitoring supporting rod fixed in the sewage treatment tank, a plurality of water quality monitoring flow pipes are fixed on the water quality monitoring supporting rod, a plurality of water quality monitoring sensors are fixed on the inner side walls of the water quality monitoring flow pipes, the reagent mixing mechanism comprises a reagent mixing accommodating shell fixed at the top of the sewage treatment tank, a reagent storage ring shell is fixed on the outer side of the reagent mixing accommodating shell, a plurality of reagent storage tanks are fixed in the reagent storage ring shell, the lower ends of the reagent storage tanks are communicated with the inside of the reagent mixing accommodating shell through a reagent conveying pump, and the reagent feeding equipment can accurately control the reagent feeding amount according to various parameters of sewage, ensure that the proportion of the reagent and the sewage is always in a good state, so that the efficient treatment effect is achieved, and the waste or the shortage of reagent feeding is avoided.

title_en: Cigarette appearance detection device with cleaning function and detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cigarette appearance detection device with a cleaning function and a detection method, comprising a drum wheel, a detection device body and a cleaning assembly, wherein the drum wheel is rotatably arranged, an arc-shaped groove is formed in the circumferential surface of the drum wheel, a negative pressure adsorption hole is formed in the arc-shaped groove, the detection device body is positioned below the drum wheel, the detection device body comprises an industrial camera for collecting cigarette images and a white light source for providing a photomask, the cleaning assembly is arranged on the detection device body and comprises a support and a cleaning assembly, a lug is arranged on the support and provided with two screw holes, a connecting block is arranged at the lower part of the cleaning assembly, the screw holes of the lug are connected with the strip holes through screws, a hollow cavity is formed in the cleaning assembly, and an air nozzle and an air inlet pipe are arranged on the side surface of the cleaning assembly, so that the air nozzle faces to the lower part of the drum wheel. The invention aims to prevent the influence of spray or other sundries on the detection process in the detection process, thereby reducing the false detection rate.

title_en: Sewage treatment is with filtration subassembly of dismouting of being convenient for
abstract_en: The invention relates to a filter component convenient to assemble and disassemble for sewage treatment, belonging to the technical field of sewage filtration and aiming at solving the problems that when the traditional filter component is assembled and disassembled, the traditional filter component is more complicated, and a filter screen on the traditional filter component can not adjust the shape of the filter screen in real time according to the state of sewage, the installation frame is provided with the adjusting component towards the outer wall of one side of the filtering component, the output end of the adjusting component is movably connected with the filtering component through the plurality of supporting components, the dirt scraping component is rotatably arranged in the installation component, and the taper of the filter screen can be adjusted in real time according to the state of sewage.

title_en: Ultrasonic micro piezoelectric sensor chip, preparation method thereof and sound wave directional control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultrasonic micro piezoelectric sensor chip, a preparation method thereof and an acoustic wave directional control method, and relates to the technical field of chips, wherein the ultrasonic micro piezoelectric sensor chip comprises a first substrate, a second substrate, a first sensing unit and a second sensing unit; the first sensing unit comprises a first vibrating membrane, a first bottom electrode, a first piezoelectric layer and a first top electrode which are sequentially stacked, two sides of the first vibrating membrane are respectively connected with the first substrate and the second substrate, the second sensing unit comprises a second vibrating membrane, a second bottom electrode, a second piezoelectric layer and a second top electrode which are sequentially stacked, two sides of the second vibrating membrane are respectively connected with the first substrate and the second substrate, and the first substrate, the second substrate, the first vibrating membrane and the second vibrating membrane form a hollow cavity. The invention can ensure the efficient operation of the vibrating membranes at two sides, realize good electrical isolation and interconnection, and control the acoustic characteristics of the intermediate medium.

title_en: Secondary water supply tank and tank body automatic cleaning equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a secondary water supply tank and tank body automatic cleaning equipment, and relates to the field of water storage facility cleaning. The secondary water supply tank and tank body automatic cleaning equipment comprises a water storage facility and an automatic cleaning system. The automatic cleaning system comprises a driving mechanism, a height adjusting mechanism, an autorotation mechanism, a mounting bracket, an autorotation spray head mechanism and a liquid supply mechanism. This secondary water supply water tank and jar body self-cleaning equipment realizes revolution and rotation of rotation shower nozzle mechanism through actuating mechanism, carries out the realization and to the omnidirectional washing in the water storage facility to adjust rotation shower nozzle mechanism through high adjustment mechanism and keep the position of water storage facility top and bottom, make rotation shower nozzle mechanism also can hold sufficient washing dynamics to the washing of water storage facility top and bottom, improve rotation shower nozzle mechanism to the cleaning performance of water storage facility, and also can wash by each other to wash by scouring between the adjacent self-cleaning system, reduce the pollution and remain.

title_en: Mixing equipment for viscous liquid chemical medium and application method of mixing equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a viscous liquid chemical medium mixing device and a using method thereof, wherein the device comprises a bottom plate with a plurality of casters at the bottom, a clamping mechanism is arranged on the bottom plate, a door-shaped frame is fixedly connected to the top of the bottom plate, an L-shaped bracket is connected to the door-shaped frame through a lifting mechanism, a third motor is fixedly arranged on the L-shaped bracket, an output shaft of the third motor penetrates through the L-shaped bracket and then is detachably connected with a mixing mechanism, and the mixing mechanism is positioned right above the clamping mechanism.

title_en: Secondary aluminum ash hydrolysis denitrification treatment device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of secondary aluminum ash treatment, and discloses a secondary aluminum ash hydrolysis denitrification treatment device which comprises an outer cylinder, wherein two sides of the outer cylinder are connected with supporting pipes, and bearing seats are movably connected on the supporting pipes. According to the invention, by arranging the inner and outer grinding classification components formed by the inner cylinder and the outer cylinder, the precise classification treatment of materials is realized aiming at the characteristic of coexistence of coarse and fine particles in secondary aluminum ash, the inner cylinder is focused on carrying out high-strength grinding on the coarse particles to effectively destroy a compact coating on the surface of the coarse particles, the fine particles after preliminary grinding are separated to the outer cylinder for mild grinding, and the energy waste and aluminum resource loss caused by excessive grinding are avoided.

title_en: Efficient construction and catalysis application of novel ultrathin chiral metal organic nanosheets
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of nano materials, and particularly relates to a preparation method of an ultrathin chiral metal-organic framework Nano Sheet (CMONs) and application thereof in asymmetric catalytic reaction. Aiming at the defects of the existing asymmetric catalyst in terms of reducing the steps of product separation and purification, the invention designs a plurality of multifunctional organic ligands based on the excellent characteristics of CMONs and synthesizes different types of CMONs by adopting a reverse microemulsion finite field growth method. The CMONs prepared is applied to photocatalytic asymmetric alpha-alkylation reaction and the structural performance of the CMONs is characterized and analyzed. According to the invention, the chromophore, the catalytic site, the chiral center and other multifunctional groups are simultaneously constructed in the catalyst system, so that the spatial distribution and interaction among the functional groups are finely regulated, and the synergistic effect is driven. Finally, the asymmetric catalyst material with high catalytic activity and high product stereoselectivity is preferred, and an important theoretical and practical basis is provided for the development of novel chiral materials and the application of the novel chiral materials in asymmetric catalysis.

title_en: Integral reactor for ammonia synthesis
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integral reactor for ammonia synthesis, and relates to the technical field of ammonia synthesis equipment. The reactor comprises a catalytic layer and a heat exchange layer which are alternately stacked, and an interlayer sealing structure. The catalytic layer adopts a honeycomb integral ruthenium-based catalyst with the porosity of more than or equal to 70%, the pore section is regular hexagon, the diameter is 1-5mm, the heat exchange layer has a matched pore structure, and is made of a metal material with the heat conductivity coefficient of more than or equal to 16W/(m.K), and a corrugated microchannel network is arranged in the heat exchange layer. The interlayer sealing structure comprises a nickel-containing foil gasket and an annular clamp. Fresh raw material gas enters the preheating device through a first air inlet of the heat exchange layer, enters the catalytic layer through a first air outlet for reaction, and is discharged through a second air outlet after being cooled through an adjacent heat exchange layer, so that reaction-heat exchange deep coupling is realized. The invention improves the utilization rate of the catalyst to more than 85%, the axial temperature difference of the bed layer is less than or equal to 15 ℃ and the radial temperature difference is less than or equal to 10 ℃, the response time of flow fluctuation is shortened to within 10 minutes, and the energy consumption is reduced by 12% under the low pressure condition of 3-5MPa, thus being particularly suitable for the distributed green ammonia production.

title_en: Brake oil filtering device for wet front axle assembly and application method of brake oil filtering device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of wet front axle assemblies, in particular to a brake oil filtering device for a wet front axle assembly and a use method thereof, wherein the brake oil filtering device comprises a front axle body, a brake oil pipe is arranged on the surface of the front axle body, a filtering mechanism is arranged at the lower end of the brake oil pipe, and the filtering mechanism filters brake oil discharged by the brake oil pipe; the filter mechanism is internally provided with a collecting mechanism. According to the brake oil filtering device for the wet front axle assembly and the application method thereof, the filter mechanism is arranged on the surface of the brake oil pipe, the filter screen in the filter mechanism is utilized to filter impurities in the brake oil, the fishing net and the surface structure thereof are utilized to salvage the impurities on the surface of the filter screen, the surface blockage of the filter screen is avoided, the circulation of the brake oil is ensured, the filter mechanism is flat, the installation in a vehicle body is facilitated, and the heat dissipation area of the brake oil is increased, so that the filter mechanism has the characteristic of being convenient for filtering the brake oil.

title_en: High-efficient liquid-transfering plate making system
abstract_en: The application relates to a high-efficiency pipetting plate making system. The efficient pipetting system comprises a pipetting head module, pipetting device cleaning equipment, a pipetting arm and a logistics transmission interaction module. The pipetting head module comprises a pipetting mechanism, a pipetting liquid driving mechanism and pipetting liquid quick-changing equipment, wherein the pipetting mechanism is detachably connected with the pipetting liquid driving mechanism through the pipetting head quick-changing equipment, the pipetting device cleaning equipment comprises a plurality of mutually independent cleaning channels, the water inlet mechanism is connected with the cleaning channels to input cleaning liquid, the first water discharging mechanism is connected with the cleaning channels to discharge the cleaning liquid, each cleaning channel is at least provided for one pipetting head to extend in, the pipetting arm is in driving connection with the pipetting head module and is used for driving the pipetting head module to move to a preset working position, and the logistic transmission interaction module is used for transmitting consumable materials between the preset working positions. The high-efficiency pipetting plate making system disclosed by the application can be flexibly used in multiple fluxes, is high in consumable interaction efficiency and plate making efficiency, and is not easy to cause cross contamination.

title_en: Wheel type distance measuring device for road and bridge segmented construction and distance measuring method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of measurement, in particular to a wheel type distance measuring device for road and bridge sectional construction and a distance measuring method thereof, comprising wheels, a handle and a counter, wherein the counter is fixed on the handle, the wheels are connected with the handle through elastic components, the elastic components can adaptively adjust the distance between the wheels and the counter under the condition of uneven pavement, the wheels and the counter are matched through transmission components, the transmission components can rotate the wheels and the elastic components stretch out and draw back, the device is compact in integral structure, convenient to operate, capable of organically integrating elastic buffering, stable transmission and automatic cleaning functions, and capable of improving environmental adaptability and working reliability of the wheel type distance measuring device in road and bridge sectional construction scenes.

title_en: Old crowd remote monitoring is with warning device that falls down
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of alarm devices and discloses a fall alarm device for remote monitoring of old people, which comprises a driving mechanism, wherein the outer side wall of the driving mechanism is fixedly connected with a plurality of supporting and moving mechanisms, the top of the driving mechanism is fixedly connected with a lifting mechanism, the top of the lifting mechanism is fixedly connected with monitoring equipment, the top of the monitoring equipment is fixedly connected with a top plate, the bottom of the monitoring equipment is positioned at the outer side of the lifting mechanism and is rotationally connected with a bottom plate through a rotating shaft, the upper surface of the top plate is fixedly connected with a receiver, the bottom of the supporting and moving mechanism is fixedly connected with universal wheels, the driving mechanism can drive the device to move and is convenient for turning when an adjusting device moves, so that the monitoring equipment can move and monitor along with the old people indoors, the monitoring equipment can rotate a monitoring direction, and the monitoring is guaranteed to be more comprehensive.

title_en: Magnesium-iron LDH composite cerium oxide material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a magnesium-iron LDH composite cerium oxide material, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of solid adsorbents. The preparation method of the magnesium-iron LDH composite cerium oxide material comprises the steps of preparing mixed metal salt solution containing magnesium salt, ferric salt and cerium salt, preparing alkaline solution, conveying the mixed metal salt solution and the alkaline solution into a microchannel reactor for precipitation reaction to obtain solution containing flocculent products, collecting the flocculent product solution generated by the reaction, and carrying out post-treatment to obtain the magnesium-iron LDH composite cerium oxide material. The material has broad-spectrum heavy metal treatment capacity and is applied to treatment of wastewater containing heavy metal ions.

title_en: Preparation method of chiral propargyl substituted aldehyde compound
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of chiral propargyl substituted aldehyde compound in the technical field of organic synthesis, which comprises the steps of reacting propargyl acetate with aldehyde in the presence of a catalytic system of alkali, palladium catalyst and chiral ligand, and preparing a series of chiral propargyl substituted aldehyde compound in a tube sealing environment of inert argon. The reaction can be converted into a compound containing chiral propargyl substituted aldehydes in one step through continuous palladium catalytic oxidation addition, migration insertion and reduction elimination of olefin. The preparation method has the advantages of mild reaction conditions, wide substrate expansion range, simple preparation operation and the like, can be converted into a series of important heterocyclic compounds and chiral thiourea small-molecule catalysts with important significance, and can be further applied to asymmetric catalytic reaction and obtain excellent enantioselectivity.

title_en: Method for preparing catalyst, and method for capturing carbon dioxide
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of carbon capture, in particular to a preparation method of a catalyst, the catalyst and a carbon dioxide capture method. The preparation method of the catalyst comprises the steps of mixing a porous biomass material with oxygen-containing functional groups with a solution containing metal salt and nitrogen source, drying to prepare a loaded biomass material, and carrying out pyrolysis treatment on the loaded biomass material to prepare the metal-nitrogen-biomass-based carbon catalyst. The preparation method of the catalyst provided by the embodiment of the application enhances the interaction force between the active site in the metal-nitrogen-biomass-based carbon (M-N-C) catalyst and the biomass-based carbon carrier, improves the structural stability of the catalyst, inhibits the structural change in the CO  2  absorption-desorption cycle, reduces the agglomeration and migration phenomena of metal elements, further improves the service life of the catalyst, and ensures the exertion of the catalytic performance.

title_en: Integral UV spraying insulation treatment method and structure of battery module
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a structure for integrally performing UV spraying insulation treatment on a battery module, wherein the method comprises the steps of assembling a plurality of square shell battery cells with exposed metal surfaces or passivation layers with a module structural member to form a complete battery module, and jointly forming a surface to be treated by a plurality of battery cell top cover planes and assembly gaps between adjacent battery cells on the top surface of the assembled battery module; the method comprises the steps of carrying out surface cleaning treatment on a surface to be treated of a battery module and shielding a functional area, carrying out integral spraying on the surface to be treated according to a preset spraying path, adopting UV curing insulating protective paint to cover exposed areas of top covers of all battery cells and assembly gap areas between adjacent battery cells simultaneously, carrying out integral curing on the sprayed areas, and synchronously curing the UV curing insulating protective paint on the top surface of the whole battery module to form a continuous insulating protective coating covering the top surface of the battery module. The invention is suitable for mass production, and can improve the insulation safety and reliability of the module.

title_en: Metal part surface greasy dirt belt cleaning device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for cleaning greasy dirt on the surface of a metal part, and relates to the technical field of metal part cleaning. The cleaning device comprises a cleaning pool, a placing pedestal, a moving table, a rotating motor, a movable disc, a cleaning seat, a plurality of cleaning brushes and a cleaning rod, wherein the placing pedestal is arranged in the cleaning pool, the moving table is movably arranged on the top surface of the placing pedestal, the cleaning brush assemblies are arranged on two opposite sides of the placing pedestal, the moving table comprises a rotating motor embedded in the top surface of the placing pedestal, the output shaft of the rotating motor is provided with the movable disc, the cleaning brush assembly comprises a lifting cylinder arranged outside the placing pedestal, a piston rod of the lifting cylinder is provided with a turnover motor, the output shaft of the turnover motor is provided with the cleaning seat, and the cleaning seat is movably provided with the plurality of cleaning brushes. The invention has the advantages of being convenient for cleaning the surfaces of parts with various shapes, improving the applicability and the like.

title_en: Bismuth ferrite/bismuth vanadate photo-Fenton catalyst, preparation method and wastewater treatment device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bismuth ferrite/bismuth vanadate photo-Fenton catalyst, a preparation method and a wastewater treatment device, and belongs to the technical field of wastewater treatment. According to the invention, the bismuth ferrite/bismuth vanadate photo-Fenton catalyst is prepared by a sol-gel method, so that the technical problem that Fe  3+ /Fe 2+  circulation is blocked in the traditional Fenton technology can be solved, in addition, the photo-Fenton catalyst has the characteristic of selective degradation of wavelength, and different active species can be respectively generated aiming at the illumination condition with the wavelength of <450nm and the wavelength condition with the wavelength of >600nm, so that the sectional efficient removal of different types of pesticides such as imidacloprid, paraquat, carbofuran, methomyl and the like in wastewater is realized.

title_en: Fluid filtering assembly, system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fluid filtering component, a system and a method, which comprise a flexible filter membrane, a rigid flow guide surface opposite to the flexible filter membrane, a fluid flow channel formed between the rigid flow guide surface and the flexible filter membrane, and a flexible supporting layer positioned on one side of the flexible filter membrane opposite to the rigid flow guide surface, wherein the flexible filter membrane generates elastic concave-convex deformation under the operating pressure and generates turbulence in interaction with fluid flowing through the fluid flow channel. The invention has the beneficial effects that a fluid flow channel is formed between the rigid flow guide surface and the flexible filter membrane, the flexible filter membrane generates elastic concave-convex deformation under pressure, and turbulence is generated by interaction with fluid flowing through the fluid flow channel, so that the traditional flow guide net is replaced, full turbulence is generated under medium-high pressure to reduce membrane pollution, concentrate residue is reduced, and meanwhile, the problem of contact friction damage of the flow guide net and the membrane is avoided.

title_en: On-line drying of hollow fiber membranes
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a continuous process for preparing selectively permeable hollow fiber membranes suitable for use in hemodialysis, hemodiafiltration and hemofiltration of, for example, blood, comprising two-stage drying and tempering of the hollow fiber membranes. According to a further aspect, the present invention relates to a continuous process for the on-line drying of selectively permeable hollow fiber membranes. The invention also relates to an apparatus for on-line drying of selectively permeable hollow fiber membranes.

title_en: Sample container, detection system and detection method for detecting pathogens and/or cells within a sample
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sample container (10) for detecting pathogens and/or cells (11) in a sample, in particular a blood sample, comprising a sample processing unit (12), which comprises at least one receiving area (13) of the sample processing unit (12) for receiving the sample, at least one preparation area (14) of the sample processing unit (12) for preparing the sample, at least one mixing area (15) of the sample processing unit (12) for mixing the sample, wherein the mixing area (15) comprises a mixing structure (16), and at least one enrichment area (17) for enriching the pathogens and/or cells (11) contained in the sample. The invention also relates to a detection system (100) and a detection method (200) for detecting pathogens and/or cells (11) within a sample.

title_en: Shearing type rubber pulverizer and control system thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of rubber flour mills, in particular to a shearing type rubber flour mill and a control system thereof, which comprises a frame, wherein a flour milling box is fixedly connected to one side of the upper end of the frame, a blanking groove is arranged on one side of the bottom of the flour milling box, a feeding hopper is arranged at the upper end of the flour milling box, a feeding channel is arranged on one side of the feeding hopper, a driven shaft is rotatably arranged on one side of an inner cavity of the flour milling box, a flour milling shaft is fixedly connected to one end of the driven shaft, a plurality of movable cutter pressing plates are fixedly connected to the flour milling shaft along the circumferential direction, and movable cutters are arranged on one side of the movable cutter pressing plates through cutter adjusting bolts. According to the invention, the self-cleaning type metal impurity adsorption component is utilized, and metal impurities in rubber particles can be adsorbed in real time by utilizing the plurality of electromagnets II in the grinding process, so that the adsorbed metal impurities are not contacted with the cutter any more, and the situation that the cutter is damaged due to collision of the metal impurities and the cutter, and the service life of the cutter is further influenced is avoided.

title_en: Mixed material stirring pot for pickling peanuts
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mixing and stirring pots, and discloses a mixing and stirring pot for pickling peanuts, which comprises a stirring barrel, wherein a servo motor is fixedly connected to the top end of the stirring barrel, the output end of the servo motor is fixedly connected with a rotating shaft, the outer part of the rotating shaft is rotationally connected to the inside of the stirring barrel, a scraping plate is fixedly connected to the outer part of the rotating shaft, a flexible silica gel bulge is arranged on the inner side of the scraping plate, the outer part of the flexible silica gel bulge is arranged in the inside of the stirring barrel, a rotating block is rotationally connected to the inside of the rotating shaft, one end of the rotating block is fixedly connected with a stirring rod, the outer part of the rotating block is rotationally connected to the inside of the stirring barrel, and the outer part of the stirring rod is rotationally connected to the inside of the stirring barrel. The rotating shaft is driven by the servo motor to rotate with the scraping plate, the rotating block and the stirring rod, so that the effect of angle adjustment of the stirring rod is achieved, and the stirring rod can be automatically and finely adjusted in real time according to the quantity of peanuts, the viscosity of the materials and the peanut loading capacity.

title_en: System for be used for metal ion recovery in acidizing fluid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system for recovering metal ions in acid liquor. The system comprises a hydrogen sulfide preparation device, a purification treatment device and a solid-liquid separation device, wherein the hydrogen sulfide preparation device comprises a bioreactor and an environment regulation and control component, a reaction chamber is arranged in the bioreactor, the environment regulation and control component is used for regulating and controlling the conditions in the reaction chamber to maintain the activity of microorganisms and generate hydrogen sulfide gas, the purification treatment device comprises a gas-liquid contact reactor, acidic wastewater is conveyed to the gas-liquid contact reactor, the hydrogen sulfide-containing gas is contacted and mixed with the acidic wastewater, unreacted hydrogen sulfide-containing gas is returned to the bioreactor, the solid-liquid separation device comprises a precipitator, and the precipitator receives the mixed wastewater to separate generated metal sulfide precipitate in the wastewater from a liquid phase. The invention replaces outsourcing medicament with low-cost hydrogen sulfide prepared by on-site biology, and realizes selective recovery and recycling of valuable metals while efficiently and safely removing heavy metals in wastewater.

title_en: Method for degrading acetaminophen in water by utilizing axial oxygen coordination iron monoatomic catalyst to activate persulfate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for degrading acetaminophen in water by using axial oxygen coordination iron monoatomic catalyst to activate persulfate, which comprises the steps of using the axial oxygen coordination iron monoatomic catalyst as an activator to activate persulfate to degrade acetaminophen in water, the axial oxygen coordination iron monoatomic catalyst used comprises a carbon substrate and an iron monoatomic which is anchored in the carbon substrate in an Fe-N  4 O 1  coordination structure. According to the invention, the persulfate is activated by taking the axial oxygen coordination iron monoatomic catalyst as an activator, so that the persulfate can be efficiently activated, the efficient removal of acetaminophen in water can be realized, the complete removal of acetaminophen in water can be realized within 2min, and the method has the remarkable advantages of simple process, easiness in operation, high treatment efficiency, good removal effect, wide application range, no secondary pollution risk and the like, and has extremely high practical value and wide application prospect.

title_en: CuS/ZnO heterojunction hollow nanofiber material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of photocatalytic materials, in particular to a CuS/ZnO heterojunction hollow nanofiber material and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the steps of S1, preparing a shell spinning solution, S2, preparing a core layer spinning solution, S3, adopting a coaxial electrostatic spinning mode to form a fiber precursor, S4, carrying out heat treatment on the fiber precursor to obtain hollow nano fibers loaded with a ZnO seed layer, S5, immersing the hollow nano fibers in a growth solution to carry out crystallization reaction to form ZnO crystals, S6, immersing the hollow nano fibers in a solution containing S  2‑ , standing, transferring the solution into a solution containing Cu  2+ , standing and reacting to promote in-situ generation of CuS on the surfaces of the hollow nano fibers, and obtaining the CuS/ZnO heterojunction hollow nano fiber material. The preparation method is simple to operate and controllable in structure, and the prepared hollow nanofiber has high photocatalytic activity and good recycling performance.

title_en: Carbon-based fuel steam reforming integrated equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a chemical reaction device, in particular to the technical field of fuel catalytic reaction, and discloses carbon-based fuel steam reforming integrated equipment, which comprises a combustion bin, wherein a mixing part is arranged on the combustion bin, a reaction part is connected to the mixing part, a reforming gas separator is connected to the reaction part, a separation part is arranged on the reforming gas separator, a reformer burner is connected to the separation part, a utilization part is connected to the reformer burner, a cleaning part is arranged in the combustion bin, the mixing part comprises a reforming steam generator, the reforming steam generator is arranged in the combustion bin, a water adding port is arranged on the reforming steam generator, the integrated design is adopted, the heat dissipation loss of a pipeline of the split equipment is reduced, the waste heat of reformed gas is recovered through a heat exchange pipe, the waste heat of combustion waste gas is recovered through a spiral pipe group, the PSA tail gas is burned back and utilized, a complete energy closed loop is formed, and the heat efficiency of the system is reduced compared with that of the traditional equipment.

title_en: System device and method for improving bonding performance of acid etched zirconia material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system device and a method for improving bonding performance of acid-etched zirconia materials, wherein the system device comprises an external circulation hypergravity reactor, a circulation tank, a circulation pump and a valve, the external circulation hypergravity reactor comprises a shell, a liquid phase feed port, a liquid phase discharge port, a liquid distributor, a reactor inner member and a motor, the reactor inner member comprises a rotor and a plurality of layers of annular fillers, the motor is fixedly connected with the rotor through a transmission shaft, annular gaps capable of loading zirconia solid test pieces are arranged among the plurality of layers of annular fillers, the liquid distributor is arranged at the central cavity position of the reactor inner member, the liquid phase discharge port, the circulation tank, the circulation pump, the valve and the liquid phase feed port are sequentially communicated through pipelines, and the liquid phase feed port is communicated with the liquid distributor. The invention can greatly improve the liquid-solid mass transfer efficiency and increase the uniformity of liquid dispersion in the solid by etching the surface of the zirconia by the supergravity acid, thereby improving the bonding performance.

title_en: Photo-thermal adsorption coupling type air water taking material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photo-thermal adsorption coupling type air water taking material, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the material is a composite material of aluminum fumarate and MXene and is synthesized through hydrothermal synthesis. The invention utilizes the electrostatic dispersion effect generated by the negative charge on the surface of the MXene sheet layer to promote the uniform growth of the aluminum fumarate crystal on the MXene sheet layer, increases the specific surface area and the total pore volume of the composite material, exposes more active adsorption sites, and simultaneously effectively overcomes the defect that aluminum fumarate particles are easy to randomly agglomerate in conventional synthesis. The MXene is introduced to endow the composite material with high-efficiency photo-thermal conversion performance and surface hydrophilicity, so that the synergistic effect of moisture absorption and photo-thermal performance is realized, and the obtained material has high adsorption capacity and rapid solar desorption performance in a low-humidity environment and is suitable for solar-driven adsorption type atmospheric water collection.

title_en: Double-frequency ultrasonic-assisted vacuum freeze drying method, system and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of food processing, in particular to a double-frequency ultrasonic auxiliary vacuum freeze drying method, a system and application thereof. The double-frequency ultrasonic auxiliary vacuum freeze drying method comprises the steps of applying at least two ultrasonic waves with different frequencies to perform auxiliary treatment in vacuum freeze drying treatment, wherein the ultrasonic waves with the different frequencies comprise a low-frequency ultrasonic wave with the frequency of 20-40kHz and a medium-high-frequency ultrasonic wave with the frequency of 80kHz-1.2MHz. The method systematically solves the industrial pain points of the traditional freeze-drying technology and the single-frequency ultrasonic auxiliary technology from multiple layers of microstructure regulation and control, mass transfer efficiency improvement, nutrient component protection, process adaptability expansion and the like, and realizes synchronous improvement of freeze-drying efficiency, product quality and process flexibility.

title_en: Cable branch box capable of being maintained rapidly
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cable branch box capable of being rapidly maintained, which comprises a box body, wherein two sides of the box body are fixedly provided with a ventilation box, the middle part of a cavity of the ventilation box is provided with a first filter screen for separating the cavity of the ventilation box, one side, close to the box body, of the cavity of the ventilation box is provided with a fan assembly, two side walls of the cavity outside the ventilation box are paved with limit assemblies which are symmetrically arranged, a plurality of wind shielding assemblies are arranged between the limit assemblies from top to bottom, the lower end surface of the ventilation box is provided with a dust collecting opening, the lower end of the dust collecting opening is provided with a dust collecting assembly, the lower end of the dust collecting assembly is provided with a plurality of air channels, the lower end of the box is provided with an opening, the opening is provided with a second filter screen, the lower end of the second filter screen is provided with a cleaning device which is attached to the second filter screen, the lower end surface of the box is also provided with an air inlet assembly which is in transmission connection with the cleaning device, and the use is simple and the maintenance is more convenient.

title_en: Gas purifying and filtering mechanism based on traditional Chinese medicine fumigation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gas purifying and filtering mechanism based on traditional Chinese medicine fumigation, which relates to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicine gas purification and comprises a traditional Chinese medicine atomizing mechanism, a gas purifying mechanism, a impurity removing mechanism and a mixed pressurizing mechanism, wherein the traditional Chinese medicine atomizing mechanism comprises a medicine box, the medicine box is arranged at the left end of a box body, the gas purifying mechanism comprises an air purifying pipe, the air purifying pipe is arranged in the box body, and a high-efficiency filter and an activated carbon filter are arranged in the air purifying pipe. According to the invention, through the three-stage composite purification structure integrating the primary filter, the high-efficiency filter and the active carbon filter, large particle dust, tiny particles, bacterial viruses and peculiar smell volatile organic compounds in the outside air are sequentially removed, so that the cleanliness of the air entering the mixing cylinder is ensured, and meanwhile, the mixing stability of hydrogen and traditional Chinese medicine aerosol is prevented from being interfered by external pollutants.

title_en: Goaf slurry filling device for coal mine exploitation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a goaf slurry filling device for coal mine exploitation, which relates to the technical field of slurry filling tools, and comprises a stirring barrel and a high-speed slurry making machine which are connected through a blanking pipe, wherein a defoaming mechanism is arranged in the stirring barrel, a butt joint barrel for being matched with the blanking pipe for butt joint is arranged at a feed inlet of the stirring barrel, the defoaming mechanism comprises a transmission buffer assembly arranged in the butt joint barrel in a penetrating manner, a buffer defoaming assembly arranged on the outer side wall of the butt joint barrel in a sleeved manner and a reciprocating isolation assembly on the inner side wall of the stirring barrel, and through the cooperation of all the assemblies in the defoaming mechanism, the functions of effectively cleaning adhesive materials, breaking bubbles on the wall surface, avoiding adhesion of the barrel wall and avoiding overflow of the bubbles can be achieved, and the problem that the slurry content of the conventional goaf slurry filling device for coal mine is large is solved.

title_en: Zinc liquid separation recovery unit in zinc slag
abstract_en: The invention discloses a zinc liquid separation and recovery device in zinc slag, which relates to the technical field of zinc slag recovery treatment and comprises a furnace body fixedly arranged in the middle of the top surface of a bearing base, wherein a sealing top cover is arranged at the top end of the furnace body, a recovery cylinder is arranged in the furnace body, a separation mechanism is arranged below the sealing top cover, the separation mechanism comprises separation poking teeth, the separation poking teeth enter the inside of a separation sieve tray to realize contact type separation operation, a homogenization mechanism is arranged in the furnace body, and the homogenization mechanism of the zinc liquid separation and recovery device in zinc slag comprises a homogenization circular frame. The zinc liquid separating and recycling device in zinc slag realizes zinc slag loading through the lifting mechanism, the homogenizing mechanism ensures accurate positioning of the separating screen disc, the separating screen disc is matched with the separating shifting teeth for distributing and homogenizing to improve heating uniformity, the recycling cylinder collects molten zinc liquid, the heat-insulating lining and the electric heating assembly maintain temperature, high-efficiency and automatic recycling is realized, and zinc liquid residues and energy consumption are reduced.

title_en: Multi-layer blade low-speed stirrer with adjustable stirring depth
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-layer blade low-speed stirrer with adjustable stirring depth, and relates to the technical field of material mixing equipment. This adjustable stirring degree of depth's multilayer blade low-speed mixer through setting up three mount pad that the from-bottom size is progressively decreased in proper order in the pivot to supporting nested stirring rake installation piece that corresponds the specification, can assemble the stirring rake in a flexible way, integrated into one piece's oar form installation locating piece on the mount pad simultaneously, can directly act as miniature stirring rake when not installing the stirring rake installation piece, form the combination flow field of main stirring rake + supplementary miniature rake, need not extra adaptation part and can satisfy the stirring demand of different materials, it is flexible to drive electric putter through fixed electric cylinder body on the base, drive motor cabinet, motor and pivot synchronous lift, realized the online accurate regulation of stirring degree of depth, effectively promoted production efficiency, the flexible pillar of fixing on the base provides stable support for stirring jar base and stirring cylinder body simultaneously.

title_en: Device and method for detecting five secondary hypertension markers based on microfluidic chip

title_en: Process and system for quasi-continuous production of vinylene carbonate
abstract_en: The invention aims to overcome the defects of the existing intermittent production process and provide a quasi-continuous production process and an integrated system of vinylene carbonate, which are mild in reaction condition, easy to control, high in production efficiency, good in product purity and capable of realizing efficient recycling of triethylamine. The technology is briefly described as that a certain amount of TEA is introduced into a reaction kettle, CEC and TEA are introduced into the reaction kettle according to a certain proportion, the reaction temperature is controlled to be 20-45 ℃, the reaction time is controlled to be 10-16 hours, after the reaction is completed, mixed solution is introduced into three-in-one equipment for filtration washing and primary drying, the obtained filtrate and washing solution enter into a subsequent rectifying and crystallizing process for purification, filter residues are conveyed into a secondary dryer through a pipe chain, and the dried triethylamine hydrochloride enters into a triethylamine recovery process.

title_en: Intelligent integrated structure of electrostatic precipitator and monitoring system

The application can improve the dust removal efficiency of the electric dust remover and the energy saving level.

title_en: Raw peanut oil preparation method based on near infrared mildew sorting and low-oxygen temperature control squeezing

The method comprises the steps of obtaining carefully selected peanut kernels by combining near infrared spectrum detection with manual sorting and screening of mildewed particles, soaking the peanut kernels by using citric acid solution after gradient heating and baking, performing ultrasonic auxiliary treatment to remove impurities and inhibit enzyme activity, crushing the peanut kernels to a specific particle size by using a roller crusher with staggered triangular insections on the roller surface so as to optimize oil outlet efficiency, squeezing peanut crude oil by using a screw squeezer with sectional temperature and pressure control under the protection of nitrogen, and purifying grease by centrifugal separation and ceramic membrane filtration. The method effectively reduces oxidation side reaction by precisely controlling crushing parameters, squeezing temperature and inert gas environment, retains natural flavor and nutritional ingredients of peanut oil, and is suitable for producing high-quality, low-acid-value and high-stability raw peanut oil.

This application has the MBR membrane of washing, keeps sewage treatment efficiency's effect.

title_en: Production of reinforced concrete pipe is with mixing agitated vessel
abstract_en: The utility model discloses mixing and stirring equipment for producing a reinforced concrete pipe, which comprises an aggregate bin body, wherein supporting plates are fixedly connected to the bottoms of the two sides of the aggregate bin body, a first electric push rod fixedly mounted at the top of the supporting plate is arranged on the left side of the aggregate bin body, a second electric push rod fixedly mounted at the top of the supporting plate is arranged on the right side of the aggregate bin body, through holes are formed in the two sides of the aggregate bin body, and a first baffle is arranged on the left side of the aggregate bin body. According to the utility model, through the matched use of the aggregate bin body, the supporting plate, the electric push rod I, the electric push rod II, the through hole, the baffle I and the baffle II, the problems that aggregates fall onto the discharge door when the discharge door of the aggregate bin of the existing concrete mixing station is closed, the rotating pressure of the discharge door is increased, the abrasion of the discharge door during rotation is increased, and the discharge door is not easy to close quickly are solved.

title_en: Outdoor rainproof camera
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an outdoor rainproof camera and relates to the technical field of cameras. The utility model comprises the following steps: the utility model discloses a rain-wiping machine, including support ring, camera, the support ring week side cover is equipped with the pull ring, the pull ring lower extreme is equipped with scrapes the rain subassembly, support ring internal rotation cooperation has the awl ring gear, awl ring gear lower extreme is equipped with the translucent cover, and the camera is located the translucent cover, the support ring upper end is equipped with the lid, the lid lower extreme is equipped with movable assembly, movable assembly one side is equipped with the motor, the output of motor is equipped with bevel gear, and bevel gear and awl ring gear meshing, awl ring gear upper end is equipped with the spacing ring, and the spacing ring cross-section is the T font. According to the utility model, the conical tooth ring is rotationally matched in the support ring, the lower end of the conical tooth ring is provided with the transparent cover, the camera is positioned in the transparent cover, the transparent cover can conveniently rotate, the rain wiping component can wipe off rainwater on the transparent cover, and further the influence of the rainwater on the image acquisition of the camera is reduced.

title_en: Feed stirring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a feed stirring device, which relates to the technical field of feed processing equipment, and adopts the technical scheme that the feed stirring device comprises a support and a stirring tank arranged in the support, wherein the support comprises four supporting legs, and the tops of the supporting legs are provided with spraying mechanisms; the agitator tank top is provided with the feed inlet, and the agitator tank bottom sets up the discharge gate of seting up two mutual symmetries, and the socket has been seted up to discharge gate one side, and it has the baffler to peg graft in the socket, and a lateral wall of agitator tank inner chamber is rotated through the bearing and is connected with the (mixing) shaft, is provided with linear arrangement's puddler on the (mixing) shaft. The utility model has the beneficial effects that: this device motor one drives the (mixing) shaft respectively with motor two and rotates with the dwang, and the rotation opposite direction of (mixing) shaft and dwang, and the (mixing) shaft is provided with linear arrangement's puddler, dwang both sides fixedly connected with baffle for the fodder stirring is more abundant, and the spray gun can clear up the fodder residue of agitator tank inner chamber effectively, prevents that remaining fodder from going bad and going mouldy.

title_en: Spraying shielding device
abstract_en: The application relates to a spraying shielding device, which comprises a spraying shielding cover body; the spraying shielding cover body comprises an installation shell part and a spraying cover body part; the bottom opening of the installation shell part is provided with a slot, and the top of the spraying cover body part is provided with an insertion sheet matched with the slot; the spraying shielding cover body is connected to the bottom of the vertical supporting slide way, and a spraying head mounting frame extending along the length direction of the spraying shielding cover body is arranged inside the mounting shell; the spraying shielding device can restrict the liquid spraying range of the spraying heads, and has the practical performance of adjustable spraying range and spraying angle.

title_en: Quality inspection device of piezoelectric ceramic piece
abstract_en: The application discloses piezoceramics piece's quality testing device, including conveyer belt, detecting element and detaching element. The conveying belt is used for conveying the piezoelectric ceramic pieces; the detection unit comprises a thickness detection assembly, an electrical property detection assembly and a nondestructive detection assembly which are arranged along the conveying direction of the conveying belt; the separation unit comprises a separation component, the separation component and the detection unit are correspondingly arranged, and the separation component is used for separating the defective products of the piezoelectric ceramic pieces detected by the detection unit from the conveying belt. Through the arrangement of the piezoelectric ceramic piece detection device, the detection efficiency and the detection precision of the piezoelectric ceramic piece are improved.

title_en: Bioreactor for increasing oxygen content in liquid
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bioreactor for increasing the oxygen content in liquid, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein four support rods are fixedly connected to the upper surface of the bottom plate, the upper ends of the support rods are fixedly connected with the bottom of a fixed frame, and bearings I are clamped in the fixed frame and the bottom plate. The motor drives the screw rod to rotate, the screw rod can drive the inner gear ring and the brush barrel to move downwards through matching with the sliding rod, the sliding sleeve and the second fixing plate, the brush barrel is inserted into the sealed tank, the second motor drives the connecting plate to rotate, the connecting plate can drive the brush barrel to rotate while rotating in the circumferential direction through matching with the second bearing, the rotating shaft, the inner gear ring and the gear, accordingly, the effect of cleaning the sealed tank by the brush barrel can be improved, labor can be saved, oxygen can be conveyed into the sealed tank at any time through the oxygen aerator, microbial reactions in the sealed tank can be guaranteed to be carried out smoothly, and convenience in use of the device is improved.

title_en: Building sand shale shaker
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a building sandy soil vibrating screen which comprises a working box, wherein one side in the working box is fixedly connected with two limiting bases respectively, one side of each limiting base is rotatably connected with a crushing roller respectively, rotating rods are fixedly connected in the two crushing rollers respectively, one sides of the two rotating rods are fixedly connected with gears respectively, the two gears are meshed and connected, one side of the working box is fixedly connected with a motor box, one side in the motor box is fixedly connected with a second motor, the output end of the second motor is fixedly connected with a rotating rod, one side in the working box is fixedly connected with a fixed seat, the top end of the fixed seat is fixedly connected with a first motor, and the output end of the first motor is fixedly connected with a working block; therefore, the purposes of sand soil crushing and multiple screening are achieved, and the device is economical and practical, convenient to operate and small in occupied area.

title_en: Wheel type sand washer with opposite-flushing type material and water
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of sand washers, and discloses a material-water opposite-flushing type wheel type sand washer, which solves the problems that the bottom of the existing sand washer can settle a large amount of siltation after sand washing is finished, and cleaning is troublesome due to the large volume of the sand washer; through being provided with each subassembly such as brush roll and motor, can realize the stirring to mud in the base, realize that the mud after subsiding mixes with water and is convenient for derive through the drain, the setting of promotion roller one and promotion roller two has then accelerated the speed that muddy water flows, is convenient for realize the quick discharge of muddy water, when avoiding muddy water discharge, great particle impurity takes place once more and subsides, and overall design is reasonable, is convenient for realize the clearance of sand washer bottom dirt.

title_en: Belt cleaning device is used in production of screw with screening effect
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cleaning device with a screening function for screw production, and relates to the technical field of screw production equipment; the turntable is arranged in the box body above the adjusting frame; the poke rods are a plurality of and are respectively and vertically fixed on the bottom surface of the turntable, and the poke rods are all meshed with the tooth grooves; an output shaft of the driving motor passes through the top surface of the box body through a bearing in a rotating manner and is fixedly connected with the middle part of the turntable; the rotating ring is movably embedded on the peripheral wall of the rotating disc, and runners are arranged in the rotating disc and the poke rod and communicated with the spray head; the screen plate is arranged on the bottom surface of the supporting box; the upper end of the first electric push rod is hinged with the inner top surface of the groove, and the lower end of the first electric push rod is hinged with the upper side surface of the screen plate; the box door is rotatably arranged on the opening end of the right side wall of the box body through a hinge; automatic washing and screening operation, the operation is more simple and convenient, simultaneously, washs and the screening integration sets up, simple structure, and is small, and the practicality is stronger.

title_en: Hanger cleaning equipment for aluminum profile production
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of aluminum profile production, and particularly discloses hanger cleaning equipment for aluminum profile production, which comprises a rack, a hanger cleaning table and a beating unit for cleaning a hanger, wherein the beating unit comprises a hammer for beating the hanger, a rotating roller and a driving unit for driving the hammer to do arc motion, two vertical plates for rotatably connecting the rotating roller are fixedly connected to the top end of the rack, a hammer handle of the hammer is fixedly connected with the rotating roller, and the hanger cleaning table is positioned right below a hammer head. The utility model can improve the efficiency of cleaning the hanging tool, and can reduce the labor intensity of workers, so that the cleaning of the hanging tool is simpler and quicker.

title_en: Oven with rotatable oven rack
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of drying ovens, in particular to a drying oven with a rotatable drying oven rack, which comprises a base, wherein the right side of the base is provided with a power supply interface, a driving motor is arranged in the base, the top of the base is provided with a drying oven main body, the inside of the drying oven main body is sequentially provided with a first cavity and a second cavity from left to right, the upper sides of the insides of the first cavity and the second cavity are respectively provided with a limiting slide seat, the inner side of the limiting slide seat is provided with a limiting turntable through a pulley piece, the top of the limiting turntable is provided with a through hole, the bottom end of the limiting turntable is provided with a U-shaped drying rack, the inner side of the U-shaped drying rack is provided with a drawing drying basket through a slide rail component, the whole device has a simple structure, the double cavities are used for partially placing dried articles, and the drying rack structure with stable rotation is convenient for all-directional hot air drying, the hot air circulation structure is convenient and efficient to dry and use, and the stability and the practicability are high, so that the hot air circulation structure has certain popularization value.

title_en: Intelligent closestool washs water filter box device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent closestool cleaning water filter box device, which has the advantages of good filtering effect and convenient replacement and maintenance, and the technical scheme is that the intelligent closestool cleaning water filter box device comprises a box body and also comprises: the water passing structure is positioned in the box body; a filter also located within the housing; the water passing structure comprises a connector and a filtering connector which are sequentially and alternately connected, the connector is fixed in the box body, the filtering connector can be freely and rotatably connected to the connector, the filtering connector is also provided with a mounting hole, and the filter is mounted on the mounting hole.

title_en: Environment-friendly direct drinking water pipeline
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an environment-friendly direct drinking water pipeline which comprises a water pipe, wherein a first mounting ring is movably connected to the side surface of the water pipe, a limiting plate is connected to the side surface of the first mounting ring in a sliding mode, a second mounting ring is fixedly connected to the side surface of the limiting plate, sealing rings are arranged on the side surfaces of the first mounting ring and the second mounting ring, and a first protective cover is connected to the side surface of the water pipe above the first mounting ring in a sliding mode.
