According to the utility model, through the installed first protective cover, the second protective cover, the spring and the fixed frame, the space between the first protective cover and the second protective cover can be adjusted by utilizing the elasticity of the spring, so that the first protective cover and the second protective cover can be sleeved on the surface of a water pipe to protect the water pipe, and the fixed frame is installed in a transversely-longitudinally staggered manner, so that the rigidity between the first protective cover and the second protective cover can be increased, and the water pipe is not easily damaged by external factors when in use.

title_en: Structure for accelerating mixing of upper and lower materials by coating granulation cooling kettle stirring system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a structure for promoting the accelerated mixing of upper and lower materials by a stirring system of a coating granulation cooling kettle, which comprises a barrel, wherein an accelerated mixing stirring system is arranged in the barrel, the accelerated mixing stirring system comprises a main shaft, a plurality of pull rod shafts are arranged on the main shaft, the pull rod shafts are embedded on the main shaft, two adjacent pull rod shafts are vertically and crossly distributed, a left combined spiral belt and a right combined spiral belt are respectively arranged on the left side and the right side of the center of the main shaft, the left combined spiral belt and the right combined spiral belt are fixedly connected with the main shaft and the pull rod shafts, an accelerated upper and lower material mixing paddle blade is arranged between stretching rods at even positions from left to right of the main shaft, two adjacent accelerated upper and lower material mixing paddles are arranged on the two sides of the main shaft, a head scraper is arranged on the stretching rod close to the head of the barrel, and the head scraper is divided into a left head scraper and a right head scraper, they are arranged on both sides of the main shaft. The utility model has better mixing effect and reliable use.

title_en: Thermosetting powder coating anti-oxidation device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of powder coating production, and discloses a thermosetting powder coating anti-oxidation device which comprises a casing, wherein fans are fixedly arranged on the left side wall and the right side wall of the casing, the output end of each fan penetrates through the wall surface of the casing and is communicated with the inside of the casing, a first filter screen is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the casing at a position corresponding to the output end of each fan, a second filter screen is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the casing at a position corresponding to the upper end of the first filter screen, and a discharge temporary storage box is fixedly arranged at the front end of the casing at a position corresponding to the upper end of the second filter screen. According to the utility model, the motor is started, the motor drives the driving shaft and the grinding roller to grind the blocky powder coating into powder, the fan is started, the fan blows air upwards towards the interior of the machine shell in an inclined manner to blow up the powder coating meeting the conditions, and the powder coating not meeting the conditions is ground again in the machine, so that the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Special microbial agent applicator for flue-cured tobacco
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of applicators, in particular to a microbial agent applicator special for flue-cured tobacco. The special microbial agent applicator for flue-cured tobacco comprises: a traveling mechanism; the liquid storage box is fixed on the travelling mechanism and is suitable for storing microbial agent solution; the bracket is fixed on the travelling mechanism; at least two spray pipes which are positioned at the front side of the travelling mechanism, can be arranged on the bracket in a left-right sliding mode and are provided with locking pieces; the water pump is fixed on the travelling mechanism, one end of the water pump is communicated with the liquid storage tank, and the other end of the water pump is communicated with the spray pipe through a hose; and the spray head is arranged at the lower end of the spray pipe, and the spraying direction is downward. The special microbial agent applicator for flue-cured tobacco provided by the utility model can realize the adjustment of the spraying distance, can be suitable for spraying at various different distances, and increases the application range.

title_en: Cleaner suitable for air compressor machine air filter
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of filter element cleaning, in particular to a cleaner suitable for an air filter element of an air compressor, and provides the following scheme aiming at the problem of insufficient cleaning of the conventional filter element. The device comprises a base, wherein a treatment chamber is arranged on one side of the top of the base, two hydraulic cylinders are arranged on the other side of the top of the base through a supporting plate, a sliding plate which is in sliding connection with the base is arranged at one end, close to the treatment chamber, of each hydraulic cylinder, a driving mechanism is arranged on one side, close to the treatment chamber, of each sliding plate, each driving mechanism comprises a fixed shaft arranged on one side, close to the treatment chamber, of each sliding plate and a motor arranged on the other side of each sliding plate, and a first gear is sleeved outside an output shaft of each motor. The dust removing device is reasonable in structure and simple to operate, the problem of insufficient dust removal on the surface of the filter element is solved, the filter element cleaning efficiency is improved, and the problem that dust is blown out to affect the external environment is solved.

title_en: Building equipment clearance maintenance equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a building equipment cleaning and maintenance device, which comprises a building equipment cleaning and maintenance component for cleaning and maintaining a pipeline and a top clear water spraying component for uniformly spraying moisture, wherein the building equipment cleaning and maintenance component comprises a pipeline cleaning bin, the top end of the pipeline cleaning bin is provided with a top water storage bin, and the top end of a rotating support frame is provided with a support roller through a bearing. Greatly reducing the labor intensity of workers and improving the working efficiency of the workers.

title_en: Cleaning head, cleaning mechanism and cleaning equipment for attachments on inner wall of pipeline
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cleaning head, a cleaning mechanism and cleaning equipment for attachments on the inner wall of a pipeline, and mainly relates to the field of pipeline cleaning; the radial nozzle comprises a tubular main body, wherein a radial nozzle mounting seat is arranged on the outer wall of the front part of the tubular main body, a radial nozzle is mounted on the radial nozzle mounting seat, and the axial lead of the radial nozzle is vertical to the axial lead of the tubular main body; an axial nozzle mounting seat is arranged on the outer wall of the rear part of the tubular main body, and an axial nozzle is mounted on the axial nozzle mounting seat; the utility model adopts the thought of cleaning and cutting step by step, so that the cutting diameter is not limited by pressure and short cutting distance of the single nozzle, and the cleaned objects can completely fall off in blocks by utilizing a simple and flexible structure, thereby being beneficial to recovery, having high cleaning efficiency and huge application potential.

title_en: Water circulation mechanism for water-jet loom
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water circulation mechanism for a water jet loom, and relates to the field of water jet looms. Comprises a box body and an auxiliary mechanism, wherein an inclined plate is arranged in the box body, a fixing frame is arranged in the box body, two first supporting plates are fixedly connected in the box body, the top ends of the first supporting plates are mutually clamped with the bottom end of the fixing frame, a filter screen is fixedly connected at the bottom end of the fixing frame, the auxiliary mechanism is arranged at one end of the fixing frame and comprises a connecting block and a handle, the connecting block is sleeved in the box body, the back of the connecting block is fixedly connected with the back of the fixing frame, the handle is fixedly connected with the front of the connecting block, the utility model discloses an utilize complementary unit's design, conveniently take out the filter screen from the inside of box through complementary unit and clear up, avoided taking out from the port department of box and leaded to the filter screen slope, cause suspended particles on the filter screen and some fine and broken threads of knitting break etc. to fall into the aquatic of box, cause the phenomenon of water secondary pollution to take place.

title_en: Film rolling crease-resistant device of automatic packaging machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a film rolling crease-resistance device of an automatic packaging machine, which comprises a supporting plate, wherein one side of the supporting plate is fixedly connected with a supporting block, the top of the supporting block is provided with a sliding hole, a sliding rod is connected in the sliding hole in a sliding manner, one side of the supporting block is provided with a sliding groove, a sliding block is connected in the sliding groove in a sliding manner, the top of the sliding block is fixedly connected with one side of the sliding rod, one side of the sliding block is inserted with a limiting column, the top of the limiting column is fixedly connected with a limiting block, one side of the supporting block is fixedly connected with a fixing plate, one side of the fixing plate is provided with a plurality of limiting holes, the limiting column is inserted with the limiting holes, the bottom of the limiting column is fixedly connected with a supporting frame, and a compression roller is rotatably connected between the inner walls of the two sides of the supporting frame. The utility model can adjust the tension degree of the rolled film, can also clean dust adhered on the rolled film, improves the delivery quality of the rolled film, and can adjust the distance between the two limiting rings so as to adapt to the rolled films with different widths.

title_en: Funnel drying device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a funnel drying device which comprises a box body with an opening and a cover body capable of covering the opening, wherein the box body and the cover body enclose a closed drying cavity, a water absorbing piece for drying a funnel is arranged in the drying cavity, and a fixing device for fixing the funnel is arranged in the drying cavity. The funnel drying device has the advantages of good stability, high safety, high accuracy of experimental results, simple structure, convenience in use, wide application range and the like.

title_en: Powder drying device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a powder drying device, which comprises a support frame and a first drying chamber obliquely arranged on the support frame, wherein a conveying mechanism for conveying powder is arranged in the first drying chamber, a plurality of stirring shafts are uniformly arranged between the side walls at two opposite sides of the first drying chamber at intervals along the conveying direction of the conveying mechanism, and the stirring shaft at one end penetrates through the side wall of the first drying chamber, the distance between each stirring shaft and the bottom of the first drying chamber is consistent, two arc-shaped stirring sheets are arranged on the stirring shaft in the first drying chamber, the two arc-shaped stirring sheets are respectively positioned at the opposite sides of the stirring shaft, the openings of the two arc-shaped stirring sheets are opposite, the stirring shafts are driven by a driving mechanism, the driving direction of the driving mechanism is opposite to the conveying direction of the conveying mechanism, first heating rods are respectively arranged between the side walls of the first drying chamber between every two stirring shafts, the top surface of the high end of the first drying chamber is provided with a feeding hopper, and the side surface of the low end of the first drying chamber is provided with a discharging port; the device is even and thorough in drying, and improves the production efficiency.

title_en: Live pig manger with disinfection function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a live pig feed trough with a disinfection function in the technical field of feeding, which comprises a trough body, wherein a disinfection liquid trough is formed in the top of the trough body, a liquid discharge trough is formed below the disinfection liquid trough, a plurality of groups of uniform holes are communicated and arranged between the liquid discharge trough and the disinfection liquid trough, an upper sliding groove is formed in the inner side wall of the trough body, an upper sliding block is connected in the upper sliding groove in a sliding manner, a washing component is fixedly connected on the upper sliding block, a liquid discharge port is formed in the bottom of an inner cavity of the trough body, a containing groove is communicated and arranged on the side edge of the liquid discharge port, an opening is formed in the bottom of the trough body, a horizontal rod is arranged in the opening, and two symmetrical lower sliding blocks are fixedly connected at two ends of the horizontal rod. The trough body cleaning device is simple in structure and convenient to operate, and the trough body is conveniently disinfected and cleaned by matching the electric push rod with the cleaning component, so that the cleanliness of the trough body is improved, and the feeding safety is improved; through the cooperation of the liquid discharge groove and the disinfection liquid groove, and the cooperation of the slide block and the slide groove, the disinfection brushing sufficiency is improved, and the wide use is convenient.

title_en: Reusable household faucet filter
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a filter, in particular to a reusable household faucet filter. The technical problem is as follows: provides a household faucet filter which has long service life and a sewage discharge function and can be used for multiple times. The utility model provides a but repetitious usage's domestic tap filter, is equipped with the inlet tube including box, inlet tube, blow off pipe, end cap, screening subassembly and filtering component, box top rear side, and the bottom half left and right sides is equipped with the blow off pipe, and the end cap is established to blow off pipe bottom slidingtype, and box top front side is equipped with the screening subassembly, and box lower part front side is equipped with filtering component. According to the utility model, the faucet is closed, people pull the plug down again, so that silt is discharged through the drain pipe, and finally the plug is plugged up to the drain pipe, thereby achieving the effect of draining.

title_en: Garbage disposal device for ecological environment improvement
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a garbage disposal device for ecological environment management, which belongs to the technical field of ecological environment management and comprises a box body, wherein the top end of the box body is fixedly connected with a feeding pipe, the bottom end of the box body is fixedly provided with a self-locking universal wheel, the position of the top end of the box body, which corresponds to one side of the feeding pipe, is fixedly connected with a water tank, the inner wall of the bottom end of the box body is fixedly connected with a crushing barrel, and the position of the top end of the box body, which corresponds to the crushing barrel, is fixedly connected with a fixed cover. The efficiency of the device for treating the garbage is indirectly improved.

title_en: Paint spraying device with adjusting function for processing injection mold
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a paint spraying device with an adjusting function for processing an injection mold, which comprises an installation frame, wherein a fixed ring frame is fixedly arranged at the middle lower end of the periphery in the installation frame, a movable placing plate is fixedly arranged between the middle parts in the fixed ring frame, a motor is fixedly arranged at the bottom end in the installation frame through an installation seat, a rotating rod is fixedly arranged at the output end of the motor, the top end of the rotating rod is fixedly connected with the bottom end of the movable placing plate, and an electric filter frame is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the right side outside the installation frame. When the paint spraying operation is carried out, an object is placed at the upper end of the placing movable plate, the paint spraying mechanism is started through the control switch, paint liquid is conveyed into the paint spraying head through the connecting hose and then sprayed out to be in contact with the outside of the object, the rotating rod is driven to rotate through the control switch starting motor when the paint spraying process needs to be rotationally adjusted, and the placing movable plate is driven to rotate through the rotating rod so as to drive the object placed at the upper end of the placing movable plate to be rotationally adjusted.

title_en: Dust collecting equipment is used in cell-phone liquid crystal display maintenance
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of mobile phone screen dust removal, and discloses a dust removal device for mobile phone liquid crystal display screen maintenance. According to the utility model, the button is manually pressed, the piston is positioned on the inner wall of the second tank body and slides, so that the air pressure in the second tank body is increased, the alcohol in the first tank body is sprayed out through the second valve, the discharging pipe sprays the alcohol onto the screen, and the screen is cleaned in the moving process of the clamping block.

title_en: Heavy metal cleaning wastewater recycling equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a heavy metal cleaning wastewater recycling device, and belongs to the technical field of wastewater recycling treatment. The method comprises the following steps: the stirring device comprises a reaction tank, a motor mounting frame, a rotating shaft, a stirring paddle, a stirring transverse frame and a rotating brush rod, wherein the motor mounting frame is arranged at the top of the reaction tank; the stirring rake all wears to locate in the pivot with the horizontal frame of stirring, and the stirring rake with the horizontal frame interval distribution of stirring in the pivot, the both ends of the horizontal frame of two adjacent stirring are through rotatory brush-holder stud rotatable coupling, rotatory brush-holder stud is hollow structure, the rotatory brush-holder stud is close to the lateral wall setting of retort. A stirring mechanism is formed by the rotating shaft, the stirring paddle, the stirring transverse frame and the rotating brush rod, so that chemical agents in the reaction tank and the heavy metal cleaning wastewater are fully mixed, and the reaction speed is effectively accelerated; the hollow rotary brush rod effectively reduces the weight of the stirring mechanism and reduces the energy consumption of the motor.

title_en: Chemical production that can carry out multi-level stirring is with high-speed dispersion machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-speed dispersion machine capable of carrying out multi-level stirring for chemical production, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the left side of the top of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a base, the top of the base is movably connected with a stirring cylinder, the bottom of an inner cavity of the base is fixedly connected with a first motor, and the output end of the first motor is fixedly connected with a first screw rod. According to the utility model, through the matched use of the bottom plate, the base, the stirring cylinder, the first motor, the first screw rod, the first thread sleeve, the clamping plate, the side plate, the second motor, the second screw rod, the second thread sleeve, the transverse plate, the shell, the third motor, the rotary plate, the rocker, the movable plate, the fourth motor, the transmission rod, the stirring rod and the slide rod, the problems that the existing high-speed dispersing machine for chemical production is single in stirring mode, cannot stir different layers in a barrel, is easy to stir unevenly, is inconvenient to fix the barrel and is easy to shake the barrel during dispersion are solved.

title_en: Ash removal device for audio maintenance
abstract_en: The utility model provides an ash removal device for audio maintenance, which relates to the technical field of audio equipment and comprises a support plate, wherein the bottom of the support plate is provided with a mounting groove, a transverse plate is fixedly mounted at the position, close to the mounting groove, of the bottom of the support plate, a mounting plate is slidably mounted between the outer surface of the transverse plate and the inner wall of the mounting groove, a scraping block is fixedly mounted at the bottom of the mounting plate, extension plates are fixedly mounted on the outer surfaces of two sides of the mounting plate, and concave plates are fixedly mounted on the outer surfaces of two sides of the support plate. According to the utility model, after the installation is finished, the concave block is inserted into the inner wall of the sliding groove, finally the L-shaped block is inserted into the concave block to limit the concave block, at the moment, when the device is used for cleaning the concave block, the scraping block is contacted with the outer surface of an object to be cleaned, then dust on the outer surface of the object is scraped, and meanwhile, the dust collector is started to clean the dust, so that the effect of not needing secondary cleaning is achieved.

title_en: Cloth dyeing apparatus
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cloth dyeing device, which relates to the technical field of textile processing and is characterized in that: the dyeing machine comprises a rack, wherein a dye vat is arranged on the rack, a feeding table higher than the dye vat is arranged on one side of the rack, a drying box higher than the dye vat is arranged on the other side of the rack, two mutually matched feeding rollers are arranged on the feeding table, a plurality of mutually matched dyeing rollers are arranged in the dye vat, the dyeing rollers are arranged in an N shape, the lowest part of the dyeing rollers is immersed in the dye vat, a plurality of hot air blowers are arranged at the bottom of the drying box, drying rollers are arranged in the drying box, the drying rollers are arranged in an N shape, a discharge opening is formed in one side of the drying box, which is far away from the dye vat, a conveying roller matched with the drying rollers is arranged at the discharge opening of the drying box, and a storage box is arranged at the discharge opening of the rack; the utility model can realize automatic drying, reduce manpower participation and improve working efficiency.

title_en: High-efficiency heat-conduction vacuum rake dryer with adjustable rake teeth
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of vacuum rake dryers, and discloses a high-efficiency heat-conduction vacuum rake dryer with adjustable rake teeth. The shaft body and the rake type blades of the double-layer structure form a thermal fluid channel in a series connection mode, so that the thermal efficiency is improved, and the heat energy is saved; the shaft body with the double-layer structure enhances the rigidity, the bending resistance and the service life of the shaft body; the structure of the harrow-shaped blade reduces the material stirring resistance, improves the mechanical efficiency of the equipment and saves electric energy.

title_en: Iron slag filtering device in steel production wastewater
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of iron slag filtration, in particular to an iron slag filtering device in steel production wastewater, which comprises a shell and a filtering screen, wherein the filtering screen is arranged in the shell, a lifting mechanism is arranged on the outer side wall of one side of the shell, a slag removing mechanism is arranged on the outer side wall of the other side of the shell, a spring is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the shell, a base is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the spring, a driving mechanism is arranged at the top of the base, the driving mechanism comprises a bottom plate, a second T-shaped chute, a second T-shaped sliding block, teeth, a hinge rod, a motor base, a motor and an incomplete gear, when wastewater is filtered, the shell can be driven to ascend through the driving mechanism, the shell can be reset through the spring, the repeated operation is carried out, the vibration effect of the shell is realized, and the filtering screen can be prevented from being blocked by iron slag, the filter efficiency is improved, and the iron slag on the filter screen is conveniently cleaned through the slag removing mechanism.

title_en: Multi-layer filtering centrifugal column
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the centrifugation post, a multiple-layer filtering centrifugation post is disclosed, including inboard column casing and the top head that link up, a pair of spacing groove that is the symmetry and sets up, one of them are seted up to the inner wall of column casing be provided with short gag lever post, another in the spacing groove be provided with long gag lever post, the first sieve of bottom fixedly connected with of short gag lever post, the bottom fixedly connected with second sieve of long gag lever post. This application is rational in infrastructure, block through second snap ring and second spacing ring, the block of first spacing ring is remained to first snap ring, and two pull rods respectively with the block of first sieve and second sieve, guarantee the stability of first sieve and second sieve, it is abundant to guarantee to filter, through the bulge of first sieve and second sieve and the block of spacing groove, guarantee the condition that skew can not appear in first sieve and the second sieve take out the in-process, guarantee that there is not the impurity of crossing to filter and drop again in the centrifugal column.

title_en: High-speed dispenser of graphite emollient
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a graphite lubricant high-speed dispersion machine which comprises a stirring barrel, a fixing device and a stirring device, wherein the stirring barrel and the stirring device are arranged on the fixing device in a frame mode, the stirring device comprises an adjusting device and a stirrer, the adjusting device comprises a horizontal adjusting device and a vertical adjusting device, and the horizontal adjusting device is arranged on the vertical adjusting device. After the agitator is placed in place, the position of agitator is injectd through left side mount and right side mount, avoided the stirring in-process to have reasons such as vibrate and lead to the agitator displacement to remove at will, can the different (mixing) shaft of quick replacement through the connecting piece, thereby reach the demand that is suitable for different agitators, the practicality is improved, through horizontal adjusting device and vertical adjusting device, under adjust cylinder's effect, thereby the position of adjustment agitator, the cooperation is favorable to the graphite emollient to be broken up fast at the agitator, thereby improve the dispersion effect of graphite emollient.

title_en: Novel sorting structure is retrieved to abandonment chip
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel waste chip recycling and sorting structure, and relates to the technical field of chip recycling. Including dissolving case and broken case, broken case setting is at the top and the two inner space intercommunication of dissolving the case, the top of broken case is provided with the chip import, the inner chamber of broken case is from last to having set gradually crushing device and rolling machine down, the inner chamber of broken case is located rolling machine's below and is provided with the metal mesh board, rolling machine includes the mount, the roller rolls, the pneumatic cylinder sets up the one side at broken case, its delivery end runs through broken case and fixed connection is the mount of U-shaped, the internal rotation of mount is connected with three group at least roller rolls, the bottom of dissolving the case is provided with the bin outlet. This novel sorting structure is retrieved to abandonment chip through setting up reducing mechanism and rolling machine in advance, can be so that old and useless chip by abundant crushing, and then can be effectual by the magnetic material wherein of magnet adsorption to can be quick dissolve by chemical reagent in dissolving the case.

title_en: Separator for extracting active polypeptide from fish skin
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a separator for extracting active polypeptide from fish skin, which comprises a polypeptide separation assembly, a mounting frame, supporting legs, a centrifuge body and a centrifuge inner ring, wherein the mounting frame is arranged, the supporting legs are fixed on the bottom surface of the mounting frame, the centrifuge body is mounted on the top surface of the mounting frame, the centrifuge inner ring is mounted in the centrifuge body, the centrifuge assembly comprises a mounting disc arranged in the centrifuge inner ring, an arc-shaped groove formed around the mounting disc, a limiting column fixed at the center of the centrifuge inner ring, a centrifuge cylinder attached to the arc-shaped groove, a cover plate covering the top surface of the centrifuge cylinder, a restraining strip arranged on the side surface of the centrifuge cylinder and a limiting rod fixed on the top surface of the mounting disc. According to the utility model, through the mutual matching of the arranged polypeptide separation structure and the centrifugal structure, the effect that an operator can integrally take out a plurality of separation cylinders simultaneously according to the requirement is achieved, so that the efficiency of taking out polypeptide substances is higher, and the operator can also select to independently move out the separation cylinders, so that the applicability is higher.

title_en: Vacuum cleaning sterilizer
abstract_en: A vacuum cleaning sterilizer belongs to the technical field of pulsating vacuum cleaning sterilizer structures. The heating mode that vacuum sterilizer among the prior art adopted is steam heating, does not predetermine the steam pipe way in some hospitals, leads to unable the use to partly old hospital's drainage pipe way drainage flow is low, and the direct drainage speed of gravity is slow or the overflow phenomenon easily appears. The utility model utilizes a cleaning tank and a circulating heating system; a water inlet is arranged on the cleaning tank, and a drain hole is arranged at the bottom of the cleaning tank; the circulating heating system comprises a circulating pump, a circulating pipeline and an electric heater, the drain hole is communicated to the circulating pump, the circulating pump is respectively communicated with the drainage pipeline and the circulating pipeline, the electric heater is arranged in the circulating pipeline, and the circulating pipeline is communicated with the water inlet. The self-heating function of the vacuum cleaning sterilizer is realized, external steam is not needed, the drainage speed is accelerated, and meanwhile, overflow is avoided.

title_en: A waterproof construction for ecological building
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a waterproof structure for an ecological building, which comprises a waterproof structure body arranged on a roof, wherein the left side of the top of the roof is fixedly connected with a solar panel, the top of the roof is provided with a mounting groove, the inner wall of the bottom of the mounting groove is fixedly connected with a storage battery, the top of the storage battery is fixedly and electrically connected with an inverter, a plugging cover is fixedly arranged in the mounting groove, the inverter is electrically connected with the solar panel, and the waterproof structure body comprises a first through hole arranged on the right side of the roof. The rainwater collection device is convenient for filtering and collecting rainwater, the rainwater is filtered and matched with the waterproof plate, the risk of water seepage can be effectively reduced, the waterproof purpose is achieved, the waste of water resources can be effectively reduced by the rainwater collection mode, the automatic alarm is convenient for reminding personnel when the water level in the water storage tank is high, the personnel can conveniently and timely carry out drainage operation, filtered impurities can be taken out and cleaned, and the use requirement is met.

title_en: Universal coal mine cross-belt dust-flushing water diversion device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a universal coal mine cross-belt dust-flushing water diversion device, which belongs to the technical field of coal roadway flushing and comprises: the coal roadway, and a bracket and a rack rod which are arranged in the coal roadway; a support piece is arranged on the coal roadway wall, and a water pipe is arranged on the support piece; the bracket includes: a left sleeve and a right sleeve; a limiting part connected with the bottom of the coal roadway is arranged on the outer part of the lower end of the left sleeve, and a hydraulic rod is arranged in the left sleeve; the right sleeve is internally provided with internal threads, and the lower end of the outer part of the right sleeve is provided with a bearing; the lower end of the bearing is provided with a base, and the side surface of the base is also provided with a limiting piece connected with the bottom of the coal roadway; the hack lever includes: a left frame bar and a right frame bar; the left frame rod is sleeved in the left sleeve, and the lower end of the left frame rod is hinged with the hydraulic rod. The arrangement of the bracket and the frame rod can effectively support the dust flushing pipe, so that a user can conveniently clean the inner wall of the coal roadway.

title_en: Safety monitoring system for liquefied petroleum gas combustion
abstract_en: The application discloses a liquefied petroleum gas combustion safety monitoring system, which relates to the technical field of liquefied petroleum gas, and comprises a combustion box and a monitoring box, wherein the monitoring box is arranged at one side of the combustion box, when the liquefied petroleum gas is combusted in the combustion box, a detection rod can monitor the interior of the combustion box, a flame sensor can measure the combustion flame, a smoke sensor can measure the smoke concentration generated by the combustion of the liquefied petroleum gas, a temperature sensor can measure the temperature in the combustion box, a monitoring camera also can shoot and monitor the interior of the combustion box through fireproof heat-insulating glass, so that the interior of the combustion box can be measured and monitored in multiple directions, when the monitoring camera shoots and monitors the interior of the combustion box through the fireproof heat-insulating glass, a sponge layer can be wiped on the surface of the fireproof heat-insulating glass, when avoiding the inside burning of combustion box, the dust adhesion influences the shooting effect of surveillance camera head at fire prevention insulating glass's surface.

title_en: Safety arrangement for chemistry experiments
abstract_en: The utility model provides a safety protection device for a chemical experiment, which relates to the technical field of chemical experiments and comprises a device base and an operation platform, wherein the surface of the top of the device base is fixedly connected with the operation platform, the bottom end inside the device base is rotatably connected with a roller, and the left side and the right side of the operation platform are fixedly connected with a dry powder storage tank for extinguishing an open fire. In the experiment in the utility model when meeting accident, at first motor work drives the steel wire and drags out the fire prevention curtain from the device base to raise along operation platform's the left and right sides, thereby cover the experimental apparatus in glass covers, through the security of this kind of improvement experiment that sets up can be very big, thereby make the chemical substance of experiment can not further splash.

title_en: Construction rainfall drainage structures
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rainfall drainage structure for building construction, which belongs to the technical field of drainage for building construction and comprises an installation box, wherein a top plate is arranged at the top end of the installation box, a fixed box is arranged below the top plate, two symmetrical support rods are arranged at the bottom end of the fixed box, a first filter opening is formed in the middle of the top end of the top plate, a first filter screen is arranged in the first filter opening, a water storage mechanism is arranged below the first filter screen, a partition plate is arranged below the water storage mechanism, a second filter opening is formed in the middle of the top end of the partition plate, a second filter screen is arranged in the second filter opening, an opening and closing mechanism is arranged at the left end of the bottom in the fixed box, the right lower ends of the fixed box and the installation box are jointly connected with a drainage mechanism, and the installation box, the fixed box, the first filter screen, the water storage mechanism, the second filter screen, the opening and closing mechanism and the drainage mechanism are arranged, can avoid impurity to cause pipeline blocking and environmental pollution, and be convenient for this device to realize quick drainage.

title_en: Continuous purification device of methyl trimethoxy silane
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a continuous purification device of methyltrimethoxysilane, which belongs to the technical field of liquid purification devices and comprises a distillation flask, a neutralization liquid bottle and a filter assembly, wherein the lower end of the filter assembly is fixedly connected with the top end of the distillation flask, the upper end of the filter assembly is fixedly connected with the bottom end of the neutralization liquid bottle, the filter assembly comprises a connecting shaft, a rotating sleeve, three connecting plates and filter boxes, the rotating sleeve is positioned on the outer surface of the middle of the connecting shaft, the three connecting plates are uniformly distributed on the outer surface of the rotating sleeve, the three filter boxes are correspondingly welded and connected with the connecting plates, and the filter boxes are in a circular truncated cone shape. This setting has rotatable filter cartridge, and convenient clearance does not hinder the filtration process, easy operation, and the good function of gas tightness has reduced staff's work load.

title_en: Dust collector for construction site with prevent blockking up function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dust removal device with an anti-blocking function for a building construction site, which comprises: the shell is an external frame of the device, plays a role in fixing and supporting the device, and is internally provided with a supporting plate; the motor is arranged on the outer surface of the supporting plate, and the tail end of the motor penetrates from the inside of the shell to the outside; the water tank is arranged inside the shell, a partition plate is arranged inside the water tank, and a filter plate is arranged inside the water tank; the cavity, it sets up inside the casing, and cavity internally mounted has the spring. This dust collector for construction site with prevent blockking up function is provided with the dust screen at the lower extreme of sucking disc, can avoid inside the great impurity of volume etc. enters into the sucking disc to avoid the sucking disc to block up, and be connected for rotating between dust screen and the sucking disc, when not using, the user can unscrew the bolt of dust screen surface, makes dust screen and sucking disc separation, thereby the person of facilitating the use clears up and maintains the inside of dust screen.

title_en: Spray set for bathroom
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a spray device for a bathroom, which relates to the technical field of bathroom spray devices and comprises a bracket, wherein a fixing ring is arranged on the bracket, the fixing ring comprises a right half ring and a left half ring, the right half ring and the left half ring are rotatably arranged together, and a locking structure is arranged between the right half ring and the left half ring; has the advantages that: the operation rod drives the locking oblique block to move, the right half ring and the left half ring are separated and locked, the locking folding piece is clamped and unlocked through the second spring and the contact plate, the telescopic rod is arranged to guide the contact plate to a certain extent, the position of the contact plate is prevented from being changed at will, the right half ring and the left half ring are convenient to fix and adjust, the height of the handheld shower head is convenient to adjust according to the height of a user and the body type, and the practicability of the handheld shower head is further improved.

title_en: Screen frame for screening lithium battery materials
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a screen frame for screening lithium battery materials, which comprises an upper screen frame, a lower screen frame, bolts, a sealing ring and the like, wherein a screen is fixed by the bolts, so that compared with glue fixation, the cost of glue consumables is reduced, and the time cost of glue drying is saved; on the other hand, because the screen cloth that glue bonded does not have elasticity, the screen cloth is consolidated to the structure that novel reel had added the tongue and groove for the screen cloth is richer in elasticity in the screen cloth use, and the irreversible deformation more easily appears, and the screen cloth that glue bonded appears coating inhomogeneous very easily in addition, and the bolt-up screen cloth all directions atress of symmetrical arrangement is more even, and the screen cloth that novel reel was strutted is at the screening in-process, is difficult to appear tearing, damaged phenomenon, and the life of screen cloth is longer.

title_en: Valve block drilling machine tool with discharging cleaning function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a valve block drilling machine tool with a discharging and cleaning function, which comprises a processing table, a drilling mechanism, a hoisting mechanism and a spray gun, wherein the hoisting mechanism comprises a power assembly, a supporting part, a sliding assembly, a telescopic assembly and an electromagnetic assembly; the power assembly comprises a bottom sleeve and a power mechanism a, the supporting part is rotatably arranged in the bottom sleeve in a penetrating mode, the sliding assembly comprises a top sleeve and a sliding mechanism, the telescopic assembly at least comprises a telescopic mechanism a, a telescopic inner cylinder and a telescopic outer cylinder, the electromagnetic assembly comprises a support and an electromagnet, the support is of a frame structure and is fixed on the outer wall of the telescopic outer cylinder, and the electromagnet is a plurality of circular tube type electromagnets a and vertically arranged on the support in a penetrating mode and extends downwards.

title_en: Circuit board with anti-electromagnetic interference function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a circuit board with an anti-electromagnetic interference function, relates to the technical field of circuit boards, and aims to solve the problems that the existing circuit board is poor in anti-electromagnetic interference capability, does not have a protection function, is easy to damage a circuit board and reduces the service life of the circuit board when in use. The device not only can resist electromagnetic interference, improve the working efficiency of the circuit board, but also improves the heat dissipation effect of the circuit board, can also protect and absorb shock of the circuit board, and prolongs the service life of the circuit board.

title_en: Sealing device for cleaning equipment and cleaning equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a sealing device for cleaning equipment and the cleaning equipment, wherein the sealing device comprises: the guide rail is arranged on the cleaning equipment; and the shielding part can move along the guide rail to shield or expose an opening for feeding and/or discharging on the cleaning equipment. The utility model can reduce the influence of external environment fluctuation on the internal environment of the cleaning equipment, and is beneficial to improving the product quality and the stability of a production line.

title_en: Vacuum emulsification mixer convenient to clean
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vacuum emulsification mixer convenient to clean, which comprises a mixer body, wherein a bracket is fixed at the bottom of the mixer body, a motor is fixed at the end part of the bracket, an output shaft of the motor is connected with a rotating shaft, the end part of the rotating shaft penetrates through the interior of the machine body, a rotating rod is fixed on the surface of the rotating shaft and is positioned inside the machine body, a brush plate is arranged on the surface of the rotating rod, a fluted disc is fixed on the surface of the rotating shaft and is positioned inside the machine body, the vacuum emulsification mixer convenient to clean drives the brush plate to rotate and move through the parts such as the rotating rod when the motor runs through the mutual matching of the parts such as the bracket, the motor, the rotating shaft, the rotating rod, the brush plate, the fluted disc, the chain, the transverse plate, the pushing mechanism and the like, and then realize cleaning to the organism inner wall, solved the inconvenient organism that cleans of existing equipment, influenced follow-up use's problem.

title_en: Novel fodder silo
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a novel feed trough which comprises a trough body, wherein a moving structure is fixedly arranged in the trough body, a discharging structure is fixedly arranged on the outer surface of the trough body, and a trough box is fixedly arranged on the outer surface of the trough body. This novel fodder silo, through setting up the inside that the blowing pipe drops into the workbin with raw and other materials through the blowing pipe, then drive the puddler through starting No. two motors and rotate, the stirring leaf of puddler surface stirs raw and other materials and smashes, then drive the threaded rod through starting No. one motor and rotate, then the connecting block of thread bush surface can play spacing effect to the thread bush inside the spout, thereby the rotation of threaded rod can drive the thread bush and control in the frame of spout and remove, then the fodder that stirs can discharge through the discharging pipe, discharge the inside of silo case, whole process only needs the user to place raw and other materials in the inside of workbin.

title_en: Lubricating oil mixing kettle feeding device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of lubricating oil mixing kettles, and discloses a lubricating oil mixing kettle feeding device which comprises a conveying pipe and a mixing kettle, wherein a pressure feeding assembly is arranged at the right end of the conveying pipe, the pressure feeding assembly comprises a pressure feeding box, a motor, a rotating rod, a pressing plate, a limiting plate, an upright post and a sensor, the pressure feeding box is fixedly connected to the right end of the conveying pipe, the motor is fixedly connected to the top of the pressure feeding box, the rotating rod is arranged inside the pressure feeding box, the pressing plate is installed on the outer wall of the rotating rod, the limiting plate is fixedly connected to the bottom end of the rotating rod, the upright post is fixedly connected to the top of the inner wall of the pressure feeding box, and the sensor is installed at the bottom end of the upright post. This lubricating oil mixing kettle feeding device, when carrying out lubricating oil reinforced, operating personnel can be through controller starter motor, and the motor drives the bull stick and rotates, and the clamp plate just can descend this moment to the pressure-feed lubricating oil gets into the inside of pipeline, and carries to mixing kettle's inside, and easy operation is convenient.

title_en: Sorting assembly of screening machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a classification component of a screening machine, which comprises a bottom plate, a screening unit and a blanking unit, wherein the screening unit is arranged on the bottom plate; the upper end of the bottom plate is connected with the lower end of the screening drum; the screening unit comprises guide sliding strips, classification inclined plates, oblique sliding strips, screening nets and driven connecting strips, wherein the two guide sliding strips are installed at the rear end inside the screening cylinder, the rear ends of the two classification inclined plates are both connected with the two guide sliding strips in a sliding mode, the oblique sliding strips are installed at the front ends of the two classification inclined plates, the left end and the right end of each oblique sliding strip are respectively connected with the left end and the right end of the front side of the screening cylinder in a sliding mode, the screening nets are installed at the upper ends of the two classification inclined plates, the middle parts of the rear ends of the two classification inclined plates are connected through the driven connecting strips, and driven holes are formed in the upper ends of the driven connecting strips; this sorting unit of sieve separator can rock the object of joining etc. and improve its classification effect, accomplishes the back ejection of compact and convenient and fast more in classification, more can satisfy the demand of using.

title_en: Automatic device for cleaning G5 glass
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic device for cleaning G5 glass, belonging to the technical field of glass cleaning devices, the automatic glass cleaning device comprises a fixed base, a glass fixed plate and a movable plate, the glass fixed plate is rotatably and fixedly connected on the fixed base, the movable plate is slidably connected on the fixed base, a linkage gear and a gear belt are arranged in the fixed base, one end of the linkage gear is fixedly connected at the bottom end of the glass fixed plate, a cleaning plate is arranged on the movable plate, the cleaning plate is slidably connected on the movable plate, the automatic glass cleaning device can automatically and omnidirectionally clean the G5 glass by arranging the linkage gear and the gear belt in the automatic glass cleaning device and by a threaded sliding connection structure of the movable plate and the cleaning plate, and simultaneously, the labor and the time are effectively saved, effectively improving the cleaning efficiency of the automatic glass cleaning device.

title_en: Feed or feed raw material processing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a processing device for feed or feed raw materials, belongs to the technical field of feed processing, and solves the problem of inconsistent grain size in the feed raw material processing process. The processing device comprises a seat frame, wherein a machine body shell is arranged on the seat frame, a feed hopper is arranged at one end of the machine body shell, a discharge hopper is arranged at the other end of the machine body shell, a shaft fixing ring is arranged at one end of the machine body shell, a first cutter is arranged at the other end of the machine body shell, a cutter is arranged in the machine body shell, two ends of the cutter are respectively rotatably connected with the shaft fixing ring and the first cutter, a motor is arranged on the periphery of the machine body shell, and the output end of the motor is connected with the cutter. The processing device for the feed or the feed raw materials can crush the raw materials with different shapes and sizes into uniform particles, improves the production quality of the feed, and has the characteristics of wide application range and strong practicability.

title_en: Breaker for afforestation
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of crushers, in particular to a crusher for landscaping, which aims at the problems that the existing crusher has no drying function, branches and leaves contain moisture and are easy to adhere to crushing equipment when in use, and the utility model provides a scheme that the crusher comprises a moving seat, wherein the top of the moving seat is fixedly provided with a crushing box, one side of the crushing box is fixedly communicated with a feed hopper, the other side of the crushing box is fixedly provided with a mounting box, one side of the crushing box is rotatably provided with a rotating shaft, the outer side of the rotating shaft is fixedly provided with a crushing blade positioned in the crushing box, the inner wall of the top of the crushing box is provided with an air blowing opening, the inner wall of the top of the air blowing opening is fixedly communicated with an air blowing cover, a heating wire is arranged in the air blowing cover, the top of the crushing box is fixedly provided with an L-shaped plate, and the L-shaped plate is provided with a rotating air blowing mechanism, and the utility model has a drying function, meanwhile, the motor can be cooled, and the structure is simple and the use is convenient.

title_en: Processing equipment for hemp and cotton blended knitted fabric
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a processing device of hemp and cotton blended knitted fabric, which comprises a processing device main body, wherein a fabric unwinding frame is fixedly arranged on one side of the processing device main body, a clamping crease-preventing mechanism is fixedly arranged on one side of the top of the processing device main body, the clamping crease-preventing mechanism comprises two clamping guide stand columns, a first clamping roller and a second clamping roller, the bottoms of one sides of the two clamping guide stand columns are respectively and rotatably connected with the second clamping roller, and lifting clamping chutes are respectively formed in the tops of one sides of the two clamping guide stand columns. The production efficiency of the fabric is improved to a certain extent.

title_en: Dry production reactor for mineral source nitro humic acid
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a reactor is produced to mineral resources nitro humic acid dry process relates to humic acid production and equips technical field. Mineral source nitro humic acid dry process production reactor, including retort, feed arrangement, inlet means, breather pipe, top cap and play hopper, the retort jar body is formed with the cavity, and the cavity internal fixation has the spiral plate, and cavity one side intercommunication has cooling device, and retort top one side is connected with purifier, and the spout has been seted up to retort bottom inner tank, and retort jar body bottom is provided with strutting arrangement, and strutting arrangement includes the bearing and fixes a plurality of backup pads on the bearing axis body, backup pad one side and spout swing joint, swing joint has a first agitating unit between bearing and the top cap, and a agitating unit includes the (mixing) shaft, is fixed with a plurality of horizontal poles on the (mixing) shaft axis body. The utility model discloses be provided with purifier, the waste gas that produces among the reaction sequence purifies the back through purifier and discharges, can reduce the pollution to the environment.

title_en: Be used for prosthetic floater fishing device of marine ecological environment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a floater fishing device for repairing marine ecological environment, which relates to the technical field of marine management and comprises a ship body, wherein a mounting plate is fixedly arranged on one side of the top end of the ship body, a fishing assembly and a repairing assembly are arranged on the mounting plate, the fishing assembly comprises a first steering engine and a fishing pocket, the first steering engine is fixedly arranged in the middle of one side of the top end of the mounting plate, the fishing pocket is movably arranged on one side of the bottom of the mounting plate, a fixed rod is fixedly arranged at the top of the other side of the fishing pocket, and the side edge of the top end of the fixed rod is fixedly connected with a steering wheel of the first steering engine through a connecting plate, so that the floater fishing device has the beneficial effects that: the first steering engine arranged in the salvaging assembly drives the connecting plate to enable the fixed rod to drive the salvaging pocket to salvage, so that a part of floating objects floating on the sea surface are salvaged, manual salvaging operation is not needed, the salvaging efficiency is improved, and the manual burden is reduced; through the restoration subassembly that sets up, the floater is salvaged to multiple mode of being convenient for, improves the restoration effect.

title_en: Mixing and stirring equipment for processing coating
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of paint stirring, and discloses mixing and stirring equipment for processing paint. According to the utility model, the first stirring mechanism is arranged in the barrel, the second stirring mechanism is arranged at the bottom end of the first stirring mechanism, the first motor box is arranged on the upper surface of the barrel, the first motor connected with the first stirring rotating shaft is fixed in the first motor box, the second motor box is arranged on the lower surface of the barrel, the second motor connected with the second stirring rotating shaft is fixed in the second motor box, and the first stirring mechanism and the second stirring mechanism are respectively used for clockwise stirring and anticlockwise stirring through the driving of the first motor and the second motor, so that the coating stirring effect and the coating stirring efficiency are improved.

title_en: Purification and impurity removal device for preparing nano zinc oxide antibacterial material
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of material preparation, in particular to a purification and impurity removal device for preparing a nano zinc oxide antibacterial material, which improves the mixing reaction efficiency of the device, improves the stirring stability of the device and increases the purification and impurity removal efficiency of the device; the device comprises a reaction box, wherein the top end and the bottom end of the reaction box are respectively provided with an adding port and a discharge valve; the stirring device also comprises a first bearing, a hollow shaft, a connecting mechanism, a driving mechanism and a stirring mechanism, wherein the connecting mechanism is respectively connected with the hollow shaft and the driving mechanism, and the stirring mechanism is connected with the connecting mechanism; the connecting mechanism comprises a second bearing, a transmission shaft, a driving gear, a third bearing, a connecting shaft, a driving gear, a driven gear and a transmission gear, the transmission shaft is coaxially installed in an inner cavity of the hollow shaft through the second bearing, the driving gear is coaxially installed at the top of the transmission shaft, the driving gear and the driven gear are respectively in coaxial fit with the connecting shaft to be connected with the driven gear in a meshed mode, and the driving mechanism is in fit connection with the transmission shaft.

title_en: Dyeing cup
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dyeing cup, comprising: a cup body; the cup cover is detachably connected with the cup body, a first cylindrical part penetrating along the vertical direction is arranged on the cup cover, a second cylindrical part is arranged on the periphery of the first cylindrical part, the second cylindrical part extends downwards from the bottom of the cup cover, and a plurality of openings are formed in the side wall of the second cylindrical part; the first sealing ring is sleeved on the abutting block and abutted against the bottom opening of the first cylindrical part, the abutting position is lower than the position of an opening on the side wall of the second cylindrical part, and an accommodating space is formed between the abutting position and the opening position. The steam is sprayed out from the upper accommodating space to the lower abutting position, the spraying speed is reduced, the dye and the auxiliary agent are less taken out, and the dyeing effect is improved.

title_en: Centrifuge abrasionproof decreases structure and centrifuge equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of centrifuges, in particular to an anti-abrasion structure of a centrifuge and centrifuge equipment. Centrifuge abrasionproof decreases structure for with centrifuge's rotary drum, little end cover and collecting box cooperation, including rectangular scraper, rectangular scraper and rotary drum cooperation to make the rotary drum drive rectangular scraper and collecting box relative motion in order to strike off the mud cake on the collecting box inner wall. So can strike off the mud cake of collecting box inner wall high-efficiently, swiftly to improve the wearing and tearing of mud cake to centrifuge.

title_en: Angle-adjustable detachable wall washer
abstract_en: The utility model provides a detachable wall washer lamp with an adjustable angle, belongs to the technical field of wall washers, and aims to solve the problems that the irradiation direction of light of the existing wall washer lamp needs to be adjusted according to the height of a building, but the wall washer lamp is inconvenient to adjust the inclination angle, and the wall washer lamp comprises a support frame; two groups of support frames are symmetrically arranged, the upper ends of the support frames are of a circular structure, the lower ends of the support frames are provided with bottom plates, and fixing grooves are formed in the middle positions of the bottom plates; wash the pinup main part, wash the up end of pinup main part and install two sets of tailgates, wash the pinup main part and rotate with the support frame through the pivot at both ends and be connected. According to the wall washer, the two ends of the wall washer body are rotatably connected with the support frame, so that a worker can rotate the wall washer body according to the height of a building, and then the worker can fix the guide plate by penetrating the locking screw through the through hole and the rail groove, and the operation is simple.

title_en: Municipal street lamp based on solar power generation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a municipal street lamp based on solar power generation, which comprises a fixed rod, wherein the right side of the top of the fixed rod is fixedly connected with an installation bottom plate through a rivet, the right side of the installation bottom plate is fixedly connected with a support frame, the right end of the support frame is fixedly connected with a street lamp, a rotating sleeve is sleeved on the top of the fixed rod, a threaded clamping plate is fixedly connected to the bottom end of the rotating sleeve, a limiting nut is sleeved on the outer surface of the threaded clamping plate, first fixed plates are symmetrically and fixedly connected to the front side and the rear side of the top of the rotating sleeve, first rolling shafts are rotatably connected to the opposite sides of the front fixed plate and the rear fixed plate, and a second fixed plate is sleeved in the middle of each first rolling shaft. This municipal street lamp based on solar energy power generation, through the cooperation of the rotation cover that sets up and screw thread splint, limit nut, can conveniently adjust solar panel's orientation, get into convenient operation, can conveniently change supporting baseplate and solar panel simultaneously.

title_en: Vacuum breaker valve
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a vacuum breaker valve which comprises a vacuum breaker valve, a filter box and a conveying pipe, wherein impurity removing components are arranged on the filter box and the conveying pipe respectively, each impurity removing component comprises a mounting plate fixedly mounted in the inner cavity of the filter box, a transmission component penetrating through the mounting plate is fixedly mounted in the inner cavity of the filter box, a suction machine is fixedly connected to the outside of the transmission component, a scraping plate in contact with the filter plate is fixedly connected to the top of the suction machine, a drain pipe located on the left side of the scraping plate is communicated with the top of the suction machine, and a collecting box fixedly mounted on the top of the conveying pipe is communicated with the other end of the drain pipe. This vacuum break valve through having set up the edulcoration subassembly, makes its user can drive the suction machine through the drive of motor and reciprocates, through scraper and filter screen contact, will adsorb impurity on the filter screen and scrape down and absorb through the suction machine, then carry the collecting box in through the blow off pipe, make it collect impurity, has solved the trouble of artifical indefinite clearance.

title_en: Internal and external power-up fast switching device of spraying reciprocating engine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a quick switching device for internal and external power supply of a spraying reciprocating machine, and belongs to the technical field of spraying reciprocating machines. The device comprises a conversion tower, wherein the conversion tower is provided with a fixed end and a switching end, the fixed end is connected with a spraying end of a spraying reciprocating machine, the fixed end is provided with a plurality of inserting pipes, and the fixed end is provided with an internal power circuit and an external circuit; the switching end is provided with a plug hole, the fixed end is close to the side wall of the switching end, three switching marks are arranged along the circumferential direction, the switching end is provided with an identification mark matched with the switching marks, and when the switching end is plugged into the fixed end and the identification mark is respectively matched with the switching marks, three states of communicating an internal power circuit, an external power circuit and a non-power circuit are respectively switched. The switching tower has guaranteed the security, realizes the fast switch-over through the simple action of fast-assembling structure singleness, and insulation system is simple reliable, provides the uniqueness simultaneously and switches over the guide, has avoided the maloperation.

title_en: Thin steel wire straightening and cutting device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a thin steel wire straightening and cutting device, belonging to the technical field of steel wire processing, and the technical scheme is characterized by comprising a device body, wherein a fixed box is fixedly connected inside the device body, a moving mechanism is fixedly connected inside the fixed box, a heat dissipation mechanism is fixedly connected at the top of the moving mechanism, a first motor is fixedly connected on the right side of the inner wall of the device body, and the right side of the moving mechanism extends into the fixed box and is fixedly connected with the output end of the first motor, so that the problems that the temperature of a straightening block rises due to severe friction between the straightening block and a steel wire when the straightening block rotates around the steel wire and the temperature of the straightening block rises due to severe friction when the straightening block rotates around the steel wire, the long-time high temperature easily causes damage to the straightening block, the service life of the straightening block is shortened, and the straightening effect of the steel wire is easily deteriorated are solved, thereby affecting the use effect.

title_en: Frequency-conversion speed-regulation centrifugal oil purifier
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of oil purifiers, and discloses a variable-frequency speed-regulating centrifugal oil purifier which comprises a placing table, wherein a supporting table is fixedly arranged on the left side of the placing table, four corners of the lower surface of the placing table are fixedly connected with supporting legs, fixing rods are fixedly connected to two sides above the right side of the supporting table, a sound-insulating barrel is fixedly arranged on the inner side of each fixing rod, an oil outlet pipe is arranged in the middle of the lower portion of the right side of the sound-insulating barrel, and a centrifugal mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the sound-insulating barrel. This centrifugal oil purifier of variable frequency speed governing through the standing groove in the clearance mechanism, and the standing groove is seted up in the inside of placing the pipe, and the inside of accomodating the pipe is used for collecting the impurity that the centrifugation bucket produced to oil centrifugation in-process, and impurity falls through the inside of accomodating the pipe to the greatest extent under the effect of gravity, and the pull rod runs through in the middle part of sealed lid, opens sealed lid, can take out the accomodating pipe through the pull rod to can reach the effect that the impurity that conveniently goes out with centrifugal filtration cleared up.

title_en: A exhaust treatment device for stainless steel cold rolling processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a waste gas treatment device for stainless steel cold rolling processing, which comprises a treatment box, an operation panel and a microprocessor, wherein the operation panel is arranged on one side wall of the treatment box, and the microprocessor is arranged on the operation panel. The beneficial effects are that: according to the utility model, through the arranged photoionization detector, the warning lamp and the microprocessor, the purification effect of the purification liquid can be displayed by detecting the concentration content of the waste gas in the liquid collecting tank, and the warning lamp is turned on when the concentration content of the waste gas is higher, so that a worker is reminded to replace the purification liquid in time, thereby ensuring the waste gas treatment effect of the device.

title_en: Surface cleaning device after production of knitted elastic band
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device for cleaning the surface of a woven elastic band after production, which comprises a supporting device, wherein a transmission device is fixedly connected to the side end of the supporting device, an auxiliary device is inserted into the supporting device in a sliding manner, the transmission device comprises a motor, a transmission belt, a rotating wheel, a limiting ring, a first gear, a cleaning strip and a second gear, the transmission belt is fixedly connected to the side end of the motor, the second gear is fixedly connected to one end of the side surface of the transmission belt, the rotating wheel is fixedly connected to the other end of the side surface of the transmission belt, the limiting ring is inserted onto the side end of the rotating wheel in a threaded manner, the first gear is meshed with the bottom end of the second gear, the cleaning strip is fixedly connected to the side ends of the first gear and the second gear at equal intervals, and the auxiliary device comprises a sliding clamping plate, a limiting screw and a contact wheel. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the transmission device and the auxiliary device, the cleaning work of impurities and scraps on the surface of the elastic belt can be completed.

title_en: Water cooling device for waste nylon yarns
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a nylon waste silk water cooling device, which relates to the technical field of nylon waste silk processing technology and comprises a bearing platform for processing waste silk, wherein a primary filter screen is arranged between a filter liquid box and a water cooling box, a water inlet pipe is arranged at the water inlet end of a water pump machine, the bottom end of the water inlet pipe extends into a cooling water tank, a water outlet pipe is arranged at the water outlet end of the water pump machine, an atomizing spray head is arranged at the bottom end of the water outlet pipe, and a waste silk clamping structure is detachably arranged in the inner cavity of the water cooling box. This application the system can fix the waste silk in waste silk clamping structure earlier before cooling off the waste silk, avoids when the cooling, and the waste silk takes place to drop, evenly sprays the cooling water to the waste silk surface through outlet pipe and atomizer, realizes quick water-cooling, and can also lead to the water-cooling tank through atomizer spun cooling water in, treats that the cooling water in the water-cooling tank gathers to certain degree of depth after, the submergence that the waste silk can be whole in the cooling water, and the cooling effect is better.

title_en: Airing rack for dried bean processing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of bean product processing, in particular to an airing rack for bean curd stick processing, which comprises a base and a cross frame; two sides of the transverse frame are fixedly arranged on the base through the upright posts; the lower end face of the transverse frame is provided with a plurality of inserting parts which are distributed at equal intervals along the length direction of the transverse frame, and the lower end face of the transverse frame is provided with an inserting port which is matched with each inserting part; the bottom of grafting portion is provided with the link that is used for the sunning dried bean, and this application mutually supports through grafting portion and interface, can be quick dismantle the link, and the link that makes things convenient for long-time to use washs.

title_en: Mushroom-type traditional Chinese medicine extracting tank easy to slag
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mushroom-type traditional Chinese medicine extraction tank easy to remove dregs, which comprises a tank body and a discharge hole, wherein a heat insulation structure is arranged outside the tank body, a pressure relief structure is arranged on one side of the top end of the tank body, a feed inlet is arranged on the other side of the top end of the tank body, the discharge hole is arranged at the bottom end of the tank body, a dreg removal mechanism is arranged at the bottom end of the discharge hole and comprises a first electric push rod, a hinge piece, a cover frame, a connecting cover, a positioning bolt and a second electric push rod, the first electric push rod is arranged at the bottom end of one side of the tank body, and the hinge piece is hinged to the bottom end of the first electric push rod. According to the utility model, the slag discharging mechanism is arranged, when slag is discharged, the positioning bolt is disassembled from the bottom of the second electric push rod and one side of the cover frame, the cover frame is turned towards the bottom, the cover frame drives the connecting cover to be opened from the bottom of the discharge hole, and at the moment, dregs of a decoction can be discharged outwards through the discharge hole, so that the function of easy slag discharging is realized.

title_en: Surface cleaning device for stamping die machining
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a surface cleaning device for processing a stamping die, which comprises an installation box, an installation frame and an installation disc, wherein the top of the installation box is fixedly connected with the installation frame, a chute is arranged in the installation frame, a sliding plate is connected in the chute in a sliding way, an electric telescopic rod is fixedly connected at the top of the installation frame, the bottom end of the electric telescopic rod extends into the chute and is fixedly connected with the top of the sliding plate, the surface cleaning device has a compact structure, a hollow shaft is rotatably connected in the sliding plate, the bottom end of the hollow shaft penetrates through the sliding plate and is fixedly connected with the installation disc, the operation is simple and convenient, the practicability is strong, a hairbrush can be driven to rotate and the height of the hairbrush can be adjusted by matching the electric telescopic rod with a motor, the flexibility and the range of the use of the device can be improved, meanwhile, a water spraying hole arranged on the installation disc is matched with the hairbrush for cleaning dust after cleaning in time, thereby ensuring the cleaning quality of the grinding tool and being beneficial to improving the use effect of the equipment.
