title_en: Fertilizer drying tower
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an organic fertilizer drying tower, which comprises a drying tower main body and a hot air mixer arranged on the inner side of the bottom of the drying tower main body, wherein a feed inlet and an air outlet are formed in the top of the drying tower main body, a plurality of transmission heating devices distributed in a staggered manner are arranged in the drying tower main body in parallel, a rotating mechanism and a crushing mechanism are arranged between the upper transmission heating device and the lower transmission heating device, materials drop onto the rotating mechanism in the process of being transmitted among the transmission heating devices of each layer and then are in contact with a first arc-shaped plate in advance, the first arc-shaped plate contracts inwards after being pressed due to the larger gravity of the caking materials, so that each row of ejector pins extend out to puncture the caking materials, the caking materials are crushed into small particles, the second arc-shaped plate contracts inwards under the impact of the large blocks of the materials by the reactive force of a spring to extrude an elastic bandage, and the elastic bandage is pressed and bent into a compression groove, and the impact force of the agglomerated materials is buffered to be overlarge, so that the particles are crushed into powder.

title_en: Clean wiping arrangement that uses of building engineering aluminium veneer production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of aluminum veneer production, in particular to a wiping device for cleaning production of aluminum veneers in constructional engineering. The technical scheme comprises the following steps: power pack, first disc and second disc, power pack one side is fixed with first machine box, first machine box rotates in the middle of the one side of power pack back of the body and installs first transmission shaft, the one end that first transmission shaft deviates from first machine box is through the spliced pole butt joint in the middle of first anchor clamps and first disc one side, the laminating of first disc opposite side is fixed with futilely clean pad, the power pack opposite side is fixed with second machine box, the second machine box rotates in the middle of the one side that deviates from the power pack and installs the second transmission shaft, the one end that the second transmission shaft deviates from the second machine box is through the spliced pole butt joint in the middle of second anchor clamps and second disc one side, the laminating of second disc opposite side is fixed with wet clean pad. The utility model has the advantages of being capable of switching between dry cleaning pad and wet cleaning pad for use and convenient to operate.

title_en: Cold mound forming device of dysmorphism stud
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cold-heading forming device for a special-shaped stud bolt, which comprises a base, wherein the top of the base is fixedly connected with four vertical rods, the tops of the vertical rods are fixedly connected with an upper frame, the bottom of the upper frame is fixedly connected with a hydraulic device, the bottom of the hydraulic device is fixedly connected with an upper die holder, the bottom of the upper die holder is movably connected with a cold-heading seat, and the top of the base is movably connected with a lower die plate. Through the hydraulic means extension that sets up to make cold mound seat close on the lower bolster, accomplish the cold mound processing of bolt, and in hydraulic means up-and-down motion, can drive rack up-and-down motion, thereby transmit two air blast structures, make air blast structure operation, to cold mound seat and lower bolster air blast, thereby cool down cold mound seat and lower bolster, can blow off the piece of lower bolster inside simultaneously, thereby avoid influencing the quality of product.

title_en: Improved novel all-cotton fabric printing and forming system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an improved novel all-cotton fabric printing and forming system which comprises a machine body and a conveying belt arranged on the machine body, wherein the machine body is connected with a fixing frame and a drying chamber in a welding mode, a dye box, a fan and a motor are respectively fixed on the top wall and the side wall of the fixing frame through bolts, a printing roller and an ironing plate are arranged in the fixing frame, a cavity is formed in the inner wall of the top end of the drying chamber, a hot air spray hole is formed in the wall body of the drying chamber at the bottom of the cavity, a dye pump is fixed on the outer wall of the dye box through bolts, the feed end and the discharge end of the dye pump are respectively connected with a first communicating pipe and a second communicating pipe flange in a sealing mode, and the top end of the first communicating pipe is inserted into the dye box. This novel all cotton surface fabric stamp of improvement formula and forming system are whole to be provided with ironing board, and then can smooth the fold on surface fabric surface for surface fabric surfacing, and then guaranteed subsequent stamp shaping quality.

title_en: Utilize biological waste material production industrial grade rectifying column for miscella purification
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rectifying tower for producing industrial-grade mixed oil by utilizing biological waste, which relates to the technical field of rectifying towers and comprises a lower tower body, wherein the top end of the lower tower body is connected with an upper tower body, a fixing device is connected between the lower tower body and the upper tower body, a plurality of packing boxes are uniformly connected inside the lower tower body and the upper tower body, the lower tower body and the upper tower body of the rectifying tower are connected through a first connecting ring and a second connecting ring, the first connecting ring is rotationally connected with a connecting spring on the outer surface of the first connecting ring and a clamping groove on the surface of a connecting block and a limiting rod on the outer surface of the second connecting ring, and a sealing rubber ring is connected at the top end of the second connecting ring, so that the sealing performance of the connecting part is ensured, the disassembly and the assembly of the upper tower body and the lower tower body are convenient, the maintenance is more convenient and efficient, the disassembly and the assembly of a material storage box body are convenient, and the cleaning of the material storage box body is convenient, the purification effect is prevented from being influenced by blockage.

title_en: Automatic intelligent manufacturing livestock-raising water supply device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic intelligent manufacturing livestock-raising water supply device, which relates to the technical field of livestock-raising and comprises a water tank, wherein one end of the water tank is fixedly connected with a filter tank, the inside of the filter tank is fixedly connected with a first fixed block, the upper end of the first fixed block is movably connected with a screen, the bottom end of the filter tank is fixedly connected with a first pipeline, the other end of the water tank is fixedly connected with a main body, the inside of the main body is fixedly connected with a filter box, and the other end of the first pipeline penetrates through the main body and is fixedly connected with the filter box. According to the utility model, the first fixing block in the filter tank at one end of the water tank can support the screen, the water flowing through the filter tank can be preliminarily filtered through the screen, and weeds and other foreign matters mixed in the water can be screened out, so that the forage can be prevented from being soaked in the water for a long time and rotting and breeding bacteria, and diseases of livestock can be easily caused after the forage is used by the livestock.

title_en: Asphalt sizing material filtering device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of asphalt filtering devices, in particular to an asphalt sizing material filtering device, which comprises a shell, wherein the top of the shell is provided with an opening, the asphalt sizing material filtering device also comprises a cover plate covering the opening, the shell is sleeved with a jacket, the asphalt sizing material filtering device is also provided with a feeding pipeline and a discharging pipeline, the jacket is provided with an oil inlet for heat conduction oil to enter and an oil outlet for heat conduction oil to be led out, and the asphalt sizing material filtering device also comprises: a filter, a shearing device and a driving device. When the filter is used, the filter area is increased, the production efficiency is improved, and meanwhile, the shearing device is arranged, so that the generation of particles is reduced, and the condition that the particles are easy to block is further reduced.

title_en: Mixing arrangement with flavor powder essence is prevented scurrying by removable structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a mixing device of anti-channeling powder essence with a replaceable structure, which comprises: the device comprises a fixed seat, a base and a stirring motor; the bottom end of the fixed seat is provided with a base, and the fixed seat is fixedly connected with the base in a welding mode; the stirring motor is arranged at the lower part in the fixed seat, and the stirring motor is fixedly connected with the fixed seat through a bearing in a penetrating way; the limiting groove is positioned on the inner wall of one side of the fixing seat, and the limiting groove and the fixing seat are of an integrated structure; the mixing chamber sets up in the inside of fixing base, and mixing chamber and fixing base cup joint through clearance fit mode. Through the improvement structurally, have removable structure and prevent scurrying the flavor function, improve the mixed effect of powder essence greatly to change convenient operation, improve its practical performance and practical value advantage such as greatly, thereby the effectual problem and the not enough that appear in having solved current device.

title_en: Multistage continuous crushing's breaker
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a multistage continuous crushing crusher which comprises a shell, wherein a feed hopper is arranged on the outer side of the top end of the shell, a connecting pipe is vertically arranged between the feed hopper and the top end of the shell, the bottom of the connecting pipe is communicated with the inside of the shell, a primary crushing mechanism is arranged in a pipeline of the connecting pipe, a circulating moving plate is arranged in the shell, and one end of the circulating moving plate penetrates through the side wall of the shell in a sliding mode and is provided with a limiting plate. According to the utility model, the first-stage crushing mechanism, the second-stage crushing mechanism and the third-stage crushing mechanism provided with the crushing teeth II and the crushing balls are arranged in the shell, so that the problem of single crushing process is solved, the shaking assembly is arranged, the smooth feeding of crushed materials is facilitated, the problem that continuous multi-stage crushing treatment cannot be realized is solved, the crushing effect of the blocky materials is ensured, and the crushing efficiency is improved.

title_en: Photovoltaic module belt cleaning device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a cleaning device, in particular to a cleaning device for a photovoltaic module. The technical problem to be solved is as follows: the cleaning device for the photovoltaic module can reduce manual operation steps and is integrated with wiping and spraying. The technical scheme is as follows: the utility model provides a photovoltaic module belt cleaning device, includes shell, protecting crust, slider, biax motor and first axis of rotation etc. and the shell front side is provided with the protecting crust, and both ends all are provided with the slider about the protecting crust, and both ends also all are provided with the slider about the shell rear side, and the bottom front side is provided with the biax motor in the shell, and the rotary type is provided with first axis of rotation between two sliders in front side. According to the utility model, the output shaft at the front side of the double-shaft motor drives the first bevel gear set to rotate, so that the rotary drum drives the bristles to rotate, an integrated spraying and cleaning effect is achieved, and manual operation steps are greatly reduced.

title_en: Hydrolysis device for producing (S) -2, 6-diamino-4, 5,6, 7-tetrahydrobenzothiazole
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a (S) -2, 6-diamino-4, 5,6, 7-tetrahydrobenzothiazole production hydrolysis device, which comprises an installation rack, wherein a feeding mechanism is arranged on one side of the installation rack, a supporting rod is fixedly arranged on the surface of the installation rack, a hydrolysis tank is fixedly arranged on the top of the supporting rod, one side of the top end of the hydrolysis tank is connected with a feeding pipe, a stirring mechanism is fixedly arranged in the middle of the top end of the hydrolysis tank, and a spraying mechanism is fixedly arranged in the hydrolysis tank: through the feed mechanism who is equipped with, put into the hopper with tetrahydrobenzothiazole inside, control driving motor rotates the auger that drives the inside material loading pipe and rotates, and the auger rotates the inside material from the material loading pipe of drive hopper to the inlet pipe with the hydrolysis tank intercommunication, inside final material gets into the hydrolysis tank, hopper surface mounting's filter screen can filter the material, prevent that impurity from entering into the hydrolysis tank inside, cause the influence to hydrolysising, replaced traditional artifical material loading.

title_en: Cleaning device with quick drying structure for mechanical evaporation protection piece
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cleaning device with a quick drying structure for a mechanical evaporation protection piece, which relates to the technical field of cleaning of the mechanical evaporation protection piece and comprises a hollow support plate and a cleaning box, wherein the top end of the hollow support plate is provided with the cleaning box, the top end connected with a mover is provided with a drying plate, one side of the drying plate is connected inside a slot in a sliding manner, the top end and the bottom end inside the cleaning box are both provided with water spray holes, the protection piece is placed inside the cleaning box, a rubber pad is pushed to clamp the protection piece by pushing a clamping plate, the protection piece is cleaned by utilizing the water spray holes, after the cleaning is finished, a motor is started to enable a connecting shaft to drive a connecting gear to rotate, triangular teeth meshed with the outer surface of the connecting gear drive an L-shaped moving plate to move towards the inside of the hollow support plate, when the protection piece is moved, the outer surface of the protection piece is cleaned by the air spray holes, hot air is filled into the drying plate by utilizing through hot holes, the spraying through the air spraying hole is achieved, the outer surface of the protection piece can be dried, and the use is convenient.

title_en: Sodium carboxymethylcellulose production and filtration device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sodium carboxymethylcellulose production filtering device which comprises an outer collecting barrel and an inner filtering barrel arranged in the outer collecting barrel, wherein the top of the inner filtering barrel extends out of the outer collecting barrel, a feeding channel communicated with the inner filtering barrel is arranged on one side of the inner filtering barrel, an opening and closing filter plate is arranged at the bottom of the inner filtering barrel, and an extrusion component is arranged in the inner filtering barrel.

title_en: Fixed bed reactor for preparing mordenite molecular sieve catalyst
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fixed bed reactor for preparing a mordenite molecular sieve catalyst, which comprises an upper kettle body, wherein a lower kettle body is movably arranged at the bottom end of the upper kettle body, an upper kettle body assembly plate is fixedly arranged on the surface of the bottom end of the upper kettle body, a lower kettle body assembly plate is fixedly arranged on the surface of the top end of the lower kettle body, two lower kettle body top grooves are formed in the surface of the top end of the lower kettle body assembly plate, and lower kettle body limiting grooves are formed in the inner parts of the lower kettle body top grooves. According to the utility model, through the matching of the bottom buckle of the upper kettle body and the limiting buckle of the upper kettle body, when the device is used, the limiting buckle of the upper kettle body can rotate in the limiting groove of the lower kettle body by rotating the upper kettle body, so that the limiting buckle of the upper kettle body rotates to the outer side of the limiting groove of the lower kettle body, and then the upper kettle body can be pulled out upwards, so that the upper kettle body and the lower kettle body are separated, and further, the maintenance treatment can be carried out on parts in the upper kettle body and the lower kettle body, and the use efficiency of the device is improved.

title_en: Fireproof paint spray gun with spraying and anti-blocking functions
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a spray gun technical field specifically discloses a fire retardant coating spray gun that function is prevented blockking up in possesses spraying, including the body of a gun, the bottom of the body of a gun is equipped with the pipeline, the right side of the body of a gun is equipped with adjust knob, adjust knob's surface cover is equipped with the trigger, the left side of the body of a gun is equipped with the connector, the left side cover of connector is equipped with the shower nozzle, the draw-in groove has all been seted up on the right side of shower nozzle top and bottom, the right side of connector top and bottom all is equipped with the card case, the right side cover of card incasement chamber is equipped with the screw rod. The utility model discloses rotate and change the board, drive the screw rod through changeing the board and rotate, rotate through loose axle cooperation screw rod, drive the swivel nut through the screw rod and remove, drive the connecting rod through the swivel nut and remove, drive the sliding sleeve through the connecting rod and remove, remove through slide bar cooperation sliding sleeve, drive the movable plate through the sliding sleeve and remove, drive the fixture block through the movable plate and remove.

title_en: Cleaning device for fabric printing and dyeing production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cleaning device is used in surface fabric printing and dyeing production relates to surface fabric printing and dyeing technical field. The cleaning device for the fabric printing and dyeing production comprises a main body, wherein a uniform moving device is arranged on the inner wall of the main body, by arranging the uniform moving device, the adjustable drying device reciprocates along the threaded rod A, so that the cloth comes to the top of the main body, the guide rod stops rotating at first, then the adjustable drying device carries out reciprocating motion along the threaded rod A to fully and uniformly dry each section of cloth, then the guide roller is started to lead the cloth to leave the inner wall of the main body along the discharge hole, one side of the movable block is provided with an adjustable drying device, by arranging the adjustable drying device, the distance between the drying fan and the cloth is adjusted according to the temperature required to be dried by the working personnel, so that the drying temperature is adjusted differently to be more suitable for the working environment, set up two sets of drying fan simultaneously and carry out the while of drying increase drying efficiency to the two sides of cloth, make the effect of drying better.

title_en: Make things convenient for rainwater recycle's drainage device for construction
abstract_en: The utility model provides a make things convenient for rainwater recycle's drainage device for construction, include: a treatment tank; the drainage assembly is fixedly arranged on the top of the inner surface of the treatment tank, and one end of the drainage assembly penetrates through the treatment tank and extends to the outside of the treatment tank; the rectangle frame, two rectangle frame fixed mounting in handle the upper and lower both sides of the internal surface of case, two the inside of rectangle frame is provided with filter screen and active carbon board respectively. The utility model provides a make things convenient for rainwater recycle's drainage device for construction through rotating at processing roof portion and connecting the clearance subassembly, takes out the rainwater at the drainage subassembly and delivers to processing incasement portion and filter the back, and the clearance subassembly receives the impact of water and rotates, and the scraper blade alright carries out the scarfing cinder to the filter screen surface, and the mud sediment of avoiding in the rainwater is too much, blocks up the filter screen mesh, and then influences the filtration treatment to the rainwater.

title_en: Drying device capable of drying from multiple surfaces for processing release film
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a but from drying device that type membrane processing was dried with multiaspect, include organism, connection structure and from the type membrane, the upper portion that is close to air inlet trompil side of organism is provided with dehumidification structure, the inside swing joint of organism has connection structure, and connection structure's outer wall laminating has from the type membrane, connection structure is including connecting axle, static roller and side fixed disk, and the outer wall of connecting axle has cup jointed the static roller, the side fixed disk has been cup jointed with the junction both ends of connecting axle to the static roller. This from drying device that type membrane processing was dried with multiaspect, whole air filter and molecular sieve are as the moisture absorption system of bottom, and its molecular sieve moisture absorption ability is extremely strong (consequently by extensive as the drier), for gaseous purification treatment, molecular sieve surface laminating has air filter simultaneously, can further filter the air in the workshop, guarantees that the workshop air gets into the back from the bottom, fully filters, reduces air water molecule content, guarantees that it is low to leave type membrane outer wall humidity.

title_en: Self-cleaning meat grinder
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a self-cleaning meat grinder, which relates to the technical field of food processing meat grinders and comprises a base, wherein a meat grinder body is fixedly arranged on the base, a feeding pipe is fixedly arranged on the upper wall surface of the meat grinder body, and a first motor is fixedly arranged on the base and positioned on one side of the meat grinder body. Improve the sanitation of stuffing processed by a meat grinder.

title_en: Non-woven fabric drying and shaping device with good adaptability
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a non-woven fabric drying and shaping device with good adaptability, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the middle part of the upper surface of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a drying box, two side surfaces of the drying box are respectively provided with a feeding hole, the top and the bottom of the drying box are vertically and fixedly connected with an electric telescopic rod, and one end of the electric telescopic rod, which is close to the drying box, can movably extend to an inner cavity of the drying box. This dry setting device of non-woven fabrics that suitability is good through carrying the cloth to the inner chamber of drying cabinet after through the feed inlet, can carry out dry design processing to the cloth through infrared heating pipe work, at the in-process of processing, through fan work, carry the vapor that produces in the drying process to the inside that holds the case to avoid the dyestuff to condense on the inner wall of drying cabinet, improve the protection to the cloth drying process, improve cloth drying quality.

title_en: Paint stirring and color mixing device with cleaning device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of paint color mixing, in particular to a paint stirring color mixing device with a cleaning device, which comprises a color mixing box, wherein the top of the color mixing box is provided with two visible windows, the top of the color mixing box is provided with an oil inlet, an oil inlet pipe is arranged above the color mixing box, the outer surface of the oil inlet pipe is inserted into the oil inlet, and one side of the color mixing box is provided with a first fixing hole. abstract_en: The utility model discloses a building engineering concrete intensity intelligent detector relates to building engineering technical field, including measuring base and two first hinges, the top of measuring the base is equipped with determine module, measures the equal fixedly connected with curb plate in both sides of base, the first magnetic stripe of the positive fixedly connected with of one of them curb plate, the positive top of another curb plate and positive bottom all are connected with the guard gate through first hinge rotation, the fixed second magnetic stripe that is equipped with in one side at the guard gate back, the fixed handle that is equipped with in middle part of the positive one side of guard gate, the bottom fixedly connected with operation panel of one of them curb plate one side, the top fixedly connected with control cabinet of operation panel, the beneficial effects of the utility model are that: when the detection assembly detects, the protective door can prevent the slag from splashing and protect the site; the slope of bearing plate can be so that the disintegrating slag slips into the frame that gathers materials, carries out the secondary clearance through the clearance subassembly to remaining disintegrating slag, saves the procedure of artifical clearance.

title_en: Rust remover for machine parts
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a deruster for machine parts relates to mechanical rust cleaning technical field, comprising a base plate, the last fixed surface of bottom plate is connected with the spring, the one end fixedly connected with mounting panel of bottom plate is kept away from to the spring, the last fixed surface of mounting panel is connected with the supporting leg, the one end fixedly connected with fixed plate of mounting panel is kept away from to the supporting leg, the outer fixed surface of fixed plate is connected with the rust cleaning bucket, the last fixed surface of fixed plate is connected with the bracing piece. The utility model relates to a rational in infrastructure, it can be through the cooperation between spring, laser rust remover, spacing sleeve, control mechanism and the rabbling mechanism, has solved current machine parts deruster, appears the dead angle easily when the rust cleaning to anomalous machine parts, and when utilizing the laser rust cleaning, can not realize simultaneously the rust cleaning to a plurality of machine parts, influences rust cleaning efficiency, and the rust cleaning in-process overturns the accessory, extravagant a large amount of operating time's problem.

title_en: Fastener for lithium battery anode material ultrasonic vibration sieve
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fastener for a lithium battery anode material ultrasonic vibration screen, which comprises a first half-fastening ring and a second half-fastening ring, wherein a first connecting piece is arranged at the outer side of two ends of the first half-fastening ring, an adjustable wrench is movably arranged at one side of the first connecting piece far away from the first half-fastening ring through a pin shaft, a buckle is movably arranged at one end of the adjustable wrench through a pin shaft, a second connecting piece is arranged at the outer side of two ends of the second half-fastening ring, a mounting piece is arranged at one side of the second connecting piece far away from the second half-fastening ring, a clamping hook is arranged at one end of the mounting piece, and the clamping hook and the buckle are connected in a matched mode. The utility model aims at the defects of inconvenient disassembly and assembly, easy locking and metal foreign matter generation of the original connecting structure of the binding ring, and improves and designs a novel connecting structure on the basis. One end of the screw rod is connected with the screw rod in a traditional bolt and nut connection mode, and the other end of the screw rod is connected with the screw rod in a quick clamping and T-shaped mode.

title_en: Automatic feeding equipment for minced meat stuffing
abstract_en: The application discloses automatic feeding equipment of mashed with earth filling relates to the filling preparation field for automatic stir-fry and arrange of filling give, including stir-fry jar, stir-fry jar top level is fixed with the diaphragm, the pivot is installed in the vertical rotation of diaphragm bottom, and stirring leaf is installed to the pivot bottom, the first motor that can drive the pivot is installed at diaphragm top; be provided with the bin outlet mechanism on the jar lateral wall of stir-fry, the bin outlet mechanism includes: the first discharge cylinder is horizontally arranged at the bottom of the side wall of the frying cylinder and is communicated with the interior of the frying cylinder; the second discharge cylinder is vertically fixed at the bottom of the first discharge cylinder and is communicated with the first discharge cylinder, and a discharge pipe is arranged at the bottom of the side wall of the second discharge cylinder; the bull stick in the second row feed cylinder is installed in vertical rotation, be provided with helical blade on the bull stick lateral wall, the second motor that can drive the bull stick is installed to second row feed cylinder bottom. The automatic stir-frying and discharging device can realize automatic stir-frying and discharging supply of the minced meat stuffing.

title_en: Lubricating oil spraying device for driving shaft
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of spraying devices, in particular to a lubricating oil spraying device for a driving shaft, which comprises a base, a driving shaft fixing module, a spraying module and a recovery module, wherein the driving shaft fixing module comprises a supporting rod, a first telescopic rod, a first motor and a positioning rotating head, the supporting rod is fixed above the base, the upper end of the first telescopic rod is connected with the supporting rod, and the lower end of the first telescopic rod is provided with the first motor and is connected with the positioning rotating head; the spraying module comprises a linear driving guide rail, an oil tank, a second telescopic rod and a spray head, wherein the linear driving guide rail is arranged on the supporting rod in an erected mode, the oil tank is arranged on the linear driving guide rail, and the second telescopic rod is connected with the oil tank and the spray head; the recovery module comprises a second motor, a scraping plate track and an oil storage tank, wherein the scraping plate track is arranged on the inner side wall of the base, the second motor and the scraping plate are fixed on the scraping plate track, and the oil storage tank is connected with the oil drain hole and the oil tank through a hose. The utility model is used for spraying the lubricating oil of the driving shaft, and can effectively reduce the waste caused by wall hanging of the lubricating oil.

title_en: Fecal sample processing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of medical examination devices and discloses a fecal sample processing device which comprises an outer frame, wherein an electric sealing door is arranged at the front end of the inner surface of the outer frame in a sliding manner, a first electric push rod is fixedly arranged at the front side of the upper end of the inner surface of the outer frame, a feeding mechanism is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the first electric push rod, the feeding mechanism comprises a lifting frame, a bearing is embedded in the middle of the upper end of the inner surface of the outer frame, a connecting rod is fixedly arranged in the inner ring of the bearing, a rotating frame is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the connecting rod, a plurality of storage mechanisms are arranged in the rotating frame in a penetrating sliding manner, a separation frame is fixedly arranged at the position close to the rear of the upper end of the inner surface of the outer frame, and a servo motor is fixedly arranged in the separation frame. According to the utility model, the excrement sample arranged in the storage mechanism can be pressed into the collecting test tube through the impact column arranged above, so that the direct contact between the device and the excrement sample is reduced, and pollution is avoided.

title_en: Mixing device for adding cord blood hematopoietic stem cell cryopreservation protective agent at low temperature
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mixing device for adding a cord blood hematopoietic stem cell cryopreservation protective agent at low temperature, which comprises a basket, an A-frame and a shaking table, wherein the basket is connected with the shaking table through the A-frame, the A-frame comprises a first support plate, a second support plate and a third support plate, the first support plate is fixedly connected with the second support plate in a mutually vertical manner, one end of the third support plate is connected with the middle part of the first support plate, the other end of the third support plate is connected with the upper part of the second support plate, the second support plate is connected with the basket, and the first support plate is connected with the shaking table. According to the utility model, the triangular bracket is used for establishing stable connection between the basket and the shaking table, the shaking table is used for driving the basket to horizontally reciprocate with the same amplitude and frequency, and the whole mixing device is arranged in a low-temperature air-cooled refrigerator to work, so that the uniform mixing of batched cell suspension bags in a low-temperature environment is realized.

title_en: Mashing device for black pepper processing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of mashing devices and discloses a mashing device for black pepper processing, which comprises a tank body, wherein a supporting leg is fixedly arranged on the lower side of the tank body, a discharging pipe is fixedly connected to the lower wall of the tank body, a feeding port is formed in the side wall of the tank body, two fixing strips are fixedly arranged on the upper side of the tank body, a fixing plate is fixedly arranged on the upper side of the two fixing strips, lifting drive is fixedly arranged on the upper side of the fixing plate, the black pepper to be mashed is placed in the tank body, and then the lifting drive is started, so that the lifting plate can be driven to move up and down, mashed fragments can be driven to move up and down, the mashed fragments can float to some extent through the elasticity of a pressure spring, and the situation that the mashed fragments can not move down to the black pepper position is avoided, and meanwhile damage to the device caused by the fact that the mashed fragments squeeze the black pepper to the side wall of the tank body is extruded by more black pepper can be avoided.

title_en: Zirconia powder screening machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of sieving machines, in particular to a zirconia powder sieving machine which realizes multi-stage sieving of zirconia powder, does not need to configure and replace a plurality of sieving hoppers, simplifies operation and has high practicability; comprises a screening box, wherein a hopper is arranged on the screening box; the air compressor is characterized by further comprising a plurality of receiving tanks, a plurality of discharging pipes, a plurality of flashboards, an air compressor, an air filter, a plurality of air ejector pipes and an air supply pipeline, wherein the output pipe of the hopper is arranged as a flat square pipe, the bottom of the screening box is provided with the plurality of receiving tanks, the bottoms of the plurality of receiving tanks are all provided with the discharging pipes, the plurality of flashboards are respectively movably inserted on the output ports of the plurality of discharging pipes, the air compressor is arranged on the screening box, the air filter is arranged in the screening box, the air compressor is provided with the plurality of air ejector pipes through the air supply pipeline, the plurality of air ejector pipes are horizontally arranged into a row, and the output ends of the plurality of air ejector pipes extend into one side, close to the hopper, of the screening cavity of the screening box and are positioned below the output end of the hopper.

title_en: Pearl powder round raw material mixer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pearl powder round raw material stirrer which comprises a stirring barrel, a stirrer and a bracket, wherein the stirring barrel is vertically and slidably arranged on the bracket, the stirrer is arranged at the top of the bracket and stretches into the stirring barrel, a rotating ring is rotatably arranged at the opening of the stirring barrel, a cross rod is fixedly arranged at the inner side of the rotating ring, a mounting sliding block is slidably arranged on the cross rod, a scraping ring is arranged at the lower side of the mounting sliding block through a spherical joint, the scraping ring is slidably arranged on a stirring screw rod, when the stirrer rotates in the stirring barrel, the scraping ring can rotate along with the stirrer, the normal stirring procedure is not affected, the stirrer and the stirring barrel are separated through a hydraulic press after stirring, in the separation process, the scraping ring can slide along the stirrer through the inclination of the stirrer, so that dough adhered to the stirrer is scraped, and meanwhile, the stirrer is separated into a space for the stirring barrel, so that raw materials in the stirring barrel can be taken and placed.

title_en: Resin coating constant temperature reaction device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a resin coating constant temperature reaction device which comprises a device body and a clamping piece, wherein the clamping piece with a circular ring-shaped structure is fixedly welded at the middle of the outer side of the device body, the device body is connected with a mounting assembly through the clamping piece, a base is arranged right below the mounting assembly, and a plurality of universal wheels which are relatively arranged in parallel are fixedly connected with the bottom end of the base; the mounting assembly comprises a fixing piece, supporting legs, a screw rod, a bolt, a supporting plate, a sliding rod and a limiting piece, and the base is connected with the supporting plate through a push rod. Through the design of installation component, be convenient for install the device body on the base, the universal wheel is installed to the base bottom, through the design of universal wheel, the device body of being convenient for wholly removes, and the motor drives the threaded rod and rotates, through the screw thread fit of threaded rod and push pedal to make the push pedal pass through the push rod and can promote the backup pad and do upward movement, and then can adjust the height of device body, thereby make the device body can use in a flexible way.

title_en: Quenching device for hardware product processing
abstract_en: The utility model provides a quenching device for processing hardware products, which relates to the technical field of processing hardware products and comprises a quenching chassis, wherein the upper end of the quenching chassis is fixedly connected with a quenching bin, and one side of the quenching bin is fixedly communicated with a side expanding bin. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the mounting clamping frames and the clamping side grooves, the quenching bin is expanded through the side unfolding bin, a plurality of mounting clamping frames are adopted, when the scraps on the filter screen are required to be cleaned, one of the mounting clamping frames is taken out, and the filter screen in the other mounting clamping frames can be used for filtering the quenching liquid continuously, so that the scraps can be cleaned without stopping quenching, the quenching efficiency is improved, meanwhile, the mounting clamping frames are mounted in a sliding clamping manner, and the mounting clamping frames are exposed outside, and the mounting clamping frames can be disassembled Fang Baini, so that the scraps can be cleaned conveniently.

title_en: Visual on-line measuring silver contact cold heading equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a vision on-line measuring silver contact cold heading equipment, including fixing the mount that sets up in the frame, liftable be provided with the lifter on the mount, slide on the lifter and be provided with the bracing piece, the bracing piece sets up along the length direction of perpendicular to lifter, and the one end of bracing piece extends to the top in punching press groove, rotate on the bracing piece and be provided with the rotation seat, rotate on the rotation seat and be provided with the CCD camera, be provided with on the bracing piece and be used for driving the rotation seat and rotate to make the CCD camera carry out real-time detection to the impact process of drift impact on the mould's rotating assembly, be provided with the adjusting part who is used for adjusting the detection angle of CCD camera on the rotation seat, still be provided with the lifting part that is used for driving the relative frame of lifter on the mount. The automatic identification device has the advantages that defective products of silver contacts generated in the stamping process are automatically identified, labor intensity of workers is reduced, detection efficiency is improved, and the effect of finished product quality is guaranteed.

title_en: Device for analyzing and measuring components in cosmetics
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device for analyzing and measuring components in cosmetics, and belongs to the technical field of analysis of components in cosmetics. The utility model provides a composition analysis survey device in cosmetics, includes the detection jar body and installs the analytical instrument that detects jar body bottom, still includes: the threaded rod is in threaded connection with the detection tank body, a cavity is formed in the threaded rod, and a spray pipe and a hollow channel are communicated with the threaded rod; when the device is used for analyzing and measuring the components of cosmetics, the spraying pipe and the hollow channel can continuously stir the cosmetics in the detection tank body so as to improve the accuracy of analysis and measurement results, and high-pressure cleaning liquid can be introduced into the cavity of the threaded rod through the cleaning pipe after the analysis and measurement are finished, so that the inner wall of the detection tank body is cleaned by spraying the cleaning liquid through the spraying pipe and the cleaning pad, and the detection tank body can be cleaned sufficiently and effectively so as to ensure the accuracy of analyzing and measuring the components of the cosmetics next time by using the device.

title_en: Movable multipurpose gas-soluble spraying and covering device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a movable multipurpose gas-soluble spraying and covering device which comprises a case, wherein a damping device is arranged on the bottom surface of the inside of the case, an air pump is arranged on the damping device, the air pump is communicated with an air inlet positioned at the center of the bottom of a micron-sized gas-liquid atomizing nozzle positioned at the front side of the top of the case through an air outlet pipeline, a liquid medicine tank is arranged at the middle rear part of the upper part of the case, and a bottom outlet of the liquid medicine tank is communicated with a liquid inlet on the side surface of the bottom of the micron-sized gas-liquid atomizing nozzle through a liquid outlet pipeline. The device can carry out diffuse scattering coverage through the micron-sized fine atomized aerosol which is rapidly formed, the gas pipeline and the liquid pipeline of the device are opened to the outlet of the nozzle, the middle is not opened and closed, and the pipeline is not pressurized; the air pump has no idling dry burning phenomenon, and even if the liquid is emptied, the air pump does not influence the air discharging work, and the air pump can be turned off immediately.

title_en: Abandonment agricultural film retrieves reducing mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a waste agricultural film recycling and crushing device which comprises a box body and a rolling blade, wherein an inclined feed inlet is formed in the top of the box body, a discharge channel is connected to the bottom of the box body, a first motor and a second motor are connected to the side wall of the box body, a crushing roller I is connected to the output shaft of the first motor, a crushing roller II which is horizontal to the crushing roller I is arranged in the box body, a driving wheel is connected to the output shaft of the second motor, one end of the driving wheel is connected with a rotating shaft, the rotating shaft is arranged in the discharge channel, a spiral blade is connected to the surface of the rotating shaft, one end of the crushing roller II penetrates through the side wall of the box body and is connected with a driven wheel outside the box body, a belt is connected between the driving wheel and the driven wheel, a first water inlet pipe is arranged at the top of the box body, and one end of the first water inlet pipe is connected with a plurality of spray heads. According to the utility model, the feed inlet is arranged in an inclined manner, so that the agricultural film fragments are prevented from splashing in the crushing process, and the agricultural film and dust are further prevented from splashing under the action of the spray head, and the crushing of the agricultural film is facilitated.

title_en: Cold air isolation structure of mesh belt type dryer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cold air isolation structure of a mesh belt type dryer, which comprises a mesh belt type dryer body, wherein the mesh belt type dryer body is provided with a feed inlet and a discharge outlet, a feed conveying device is arranged at the feed inlet, and the feed conveying device is used for conveying materials to be dried into the mesh belt type dryer body; the feeding conveying device at least comprises a first sealing plate, a second sealing plate and a roller, and the first sealing plate and the second sealing plate are in sealing connection with the dryer body; the two rollers are rotatably arranged between the first sealing plate and the second sealing plate, a conveyor belt is sleeved on the two rollers, the two rollers are connected with a driving device, and the driving device can drive the two rollers to rotate at the same speed; a plurality of material blocking bulges are arranged on the conveyor belt, and an installation area is formed between the conveyor belts sleeved on the two rollers. The utility model aims to solve the problems of low drying efficiency and poor drying effect of a mesh belt type dryer in the prior art.

title_en: Stoving mechanism of light filter
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a drying mechanism of an optical filter, which comprises a box body, wherein a circulating drying mechanism is arranged in the box body, a cooling assembly is arranged at the top of the box body, the circulating drying mechanism comprises a filter screen fixedly connected with the box body, a drying plate is inserted into the front surface of the box body, a heating plate is inserted into the box body, three transverse plates are connected into the box body in a sliding manner, a tray is fixedly connected to the top of the transverse plates, a limiting block is arranged at the top of the tray, an air pump is connected to the left side of the box body in a threaded manner, and a dryer in threaded connection with the box body is fixedly connected to the input end of the air pump. This stoving mechanism of light filter through setting up circulation stoving mechanism, carries out circulation stoving, makes the light filter be heated more evenly, has increased the efficiency of stoving, has saved the cost of stoving, has solved because simple structure causes the inhomogeneous that is heated easily, influences the efficiency of stoving, causes extravagant, increases the problem of stoving cost.

title_en: Directional moxibustion device that discharges fume
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a directional smoke exhaust moxibustion device which comprises a moxibustion component, a moxa-incense component arranged at the top of the moxibustion component, a fixing sleeve sleeved on the surface of the moxibustion component, a smoke collecting cover sleeved on the top of the surface of the moxa-incense component, a smoke inlet pipe communicated with the bottom of the surface of the smoke collecting cover, one side of the smoke inlet pipe far away from the smoke collecting cover communicated with the moxibustion component, a convex plate fixedly connected with the surface of the fixing sleeve, a vertical plate fixedly connected with the top of the convex plate, a sliding plate connected with the bottom of the inner side of the vertical plate in a sliding manner, connecting plates fixedly connected with the two sides of the sliding plate, a vertical rod fixedly connected with the top of the connecting plate, and a blocking plate fixedly connected with the top of the vertical rod. The moxibustion device changes the mode that the traditional moxa smoke floats upwards in an irregular mode, adopts a directional smoke discharging mode, can not float the smoke in an irregular mode, and simultaneously increases the treatment experience of treatment staff.

title_en: Mixing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mixing device, which comprises a supporting table, wherein the top of the supporting table is fixedly connected with a filtering shell, one end of the filtering shell is provided with a hydraulic cylinder, the output end of the hydraulic cylinder is connected with a piston head, the piston head is slidably connected in the filtering shell, the other end of the filtering shell is provided with a discharging pipe, the filtering shell is provided with a lifting adjusting structure, the lifting adjusting structure comprises a connecting frame, a rotating handle, a screw rod, a lifting block and a mounting frame, the bottom of the connecting frame is connected with a detachable filter screen, the top of the filtering shell is fixedly connected with a stirring box body, the top of the stirring box body is provided with a servo motor, and after pesticide is stirred and mixed, the hydraulic cylinder drives the piston head to push, so that mixed liquid can be filtered by the filter of the detachable filter screen and impurities in the liquid, and the subsequent processing of the pesticide is facilitated.

title_en: High-efficiency energy-saving jet mill
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-efficiency energy-saving jet mill, belonging to the technical field of jet mills and aiming at solving the problems that the existing jet mill cannot crush for many times and adjust the distance between blades.

title_en: Oscillating screen for pharmaceutical processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an oscillating screen for pharmaceutical processing, which comprises a fixed ring and a fixed plate, wherein one side of the fixed ring is fixedly connected with a first connecting arm, the first connecting arm is in sliding connection with a first through groove, the other side of the fixed ring is provided with a second connecting arm, the second connecting arm is in sliding connection with a second through groove, the fixed ring is connected with a filter cartridge through a clamping mechanism, the filter cartridge is matched with the fixed ring, the fixed plate is fixedly connected to a shell, the fixed plate is connected with a supporting arm through a driving mechanism, the supporting arm is movably connected with the second connecting arm, and the two supporting arms are arranged.

title_en: Drying equipment is used in fertilizer production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses drying equipment for fertilizer production, which comprises a drying box, an air heater and a driving motor, wherein a feed inlet is formed in the middle of the upper part of the drying box, the air heater is arranged at the left end and the right end of the upper part of the drying box, a blanking plate is arranged in the drying box, the driving motor is fixedly arranged below the right side of the drying box, the output end of the driving motor is connected with the right end of a rotating shaft, a discharge opening is arranged at the left end of the lower part of the drying box, a vibration rod is arranged on the surface of the rotating shaft, and grooves are formed in the left end and the right end of the drying box. This drying equipment is used in fertilizer production can be through the use of the unloading board that the inclination is opposite for the use of the air heater of copper material's unloading board cooperation stoving case top makes things convenient for making heat dry its fertilizer on surface through the unloading board, conveniently improves the stoving effect of fertilizer, improves the result of use of device.

title_en: Novel kitchen oily water oil skimming device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a novel kitchen oily water skimming device, which comprises: the treatment barrel is characterized in that the end face of the treatment barrel is provided with a groove, an iron sheet is embedded in the inner wall of the groove, a diversion funnel is arranged above the treatment barrel, one surface of the diversion funnel close to the treatment barrel is fixedly connected with a fixing mechanism, a sealing block is arranged on the surface of the diversion funnel, and the inner surface of the diversion funnel is fixedly connected with a waterproof shell. The utility model has reasonable structure, and the electric push rod is used for enabling the guide rod to move in linkage with the sealing block, so as to adjust the distance between the sealing block and the guide funnel, thereby realizing the sealing of the treatment barrel, avoiding the emission of peculiar smell in the oil sewage.

title_en: Exhaust outlet muffler
abstract_en: The utility model provides a smoke exhaust outlet muffler, which comprises an air duct, wherein a fan is arranged in the air duct, one surface of the air duct, which is away from an end cover, is fixedly connected with a circular cover communicated with the air duct, one surface of the circular cover, which is away from the air duct, is fixedly connected with a straight cylinder communicated with the circular cover, the straight cylinder is inserted in an outer cylinder, the inner surface of the outer cylinder is provided with sound absorbing cotton with a detachable cross section in a circular shape, one surface of the outer cylinder, which is away from the circular cover, is uniformly provided with a plurality of air outlets, the lower part of the surface of the outer cylinder, which is away from the circular cover, is provided with a horizontally arranged guide hole, a connecting pipe is inserted in the guide hole, one end of the connecting pipe, which is positioned in the outer cylinder, is communicated with an annular pipe, and one end of the connecting pipe, which is positioned outside the outer cylinder, is provided with a stop valve for connecting a tap water pipe, and the smoke exhaust outlet muffler has the following advantages: the noise generated during the operation of the fire-fighting smoke exhaust fan is reduced, and the fire fighters can communicate with each other around the fire-fighting smoke exhaust fan conveniently.

title_en: Tea leaf fixation device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tea enzyme deactivating device which comprises a machine body, wherein a supporting frame is fixedly connected to the outer surface of the lower end of the machine body, a discharge hole is formed in the outer surface of the front end of the machine body, a feed inlet is formed in the outer surface of the upper end of the machine body, a fixing assembly is fixedly connected to the outer surface of the front end of the machine body, and a material receiving filter assembly is detachably connected to the inner wall of the fixing assembly. According to the tea enzyme deactivating device, through the receiving hopper assembly and the filtering assembly, when tea leaves enter the receiving hopper assembly after being processed, the tea leaves are directly screened and processed to obtain tea leaves, so that the working time for selecting the tea leaves is saved, the whole working efficiency of tea processing is improved, the filtering assembly is quite simple in replacement and disassembly during cleaning, and the process of installing and disassembling the receiving filtering assembly is simplified through the receiving filtering assembly and the fixing assembly, and certain stability is ensured.

title_en: Blending tank capable of accurately metering

The utility model slows down the sliding speed of melon seeds, so that more time can be provided for color selection, the seeds with different colors can be color-selected, the efficiency of color selection of the seeds is improved, and the secondary or tertiary color selection times are reduced.

title_en: Synthetic organosilicon sediment thick liquid processing apparatus
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a synthetic organosilicon slurry treatment device which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the top end of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a box body, the top end of the box body is communicated with a feeding pipe, a feeding valve is arranged on the feeding pipe, a scale observation window is arranged on the box body, and a stirring assembly is arranged in the inner cavity of the box body. Through rotating assembly and the stirring subassembly that sets up, the stirring subassembly can stir the inside synthetic organosilicon sediment thick liquid of box, rotating assembly can drive the box and rotate to can make the inside synthetic organosilicon sediment thick liquid of box mix efficiency, reduce the time that synthetic organosilicon sediment thick liquid handled needs, produce harmful gas's absorption in stirring of synthetic organosilicon sediment thick liquid and the heating process through gas collecting channel and guide duct, and adsorb the purification through spraying mode and filter screen to harmful gas, improve air environmental quality, through setting up the clearance subassembly, be convenient for to the box clearance after the mixing finishes, be convenient for use next time.

title_en: Maintenance equipment used on electric wire tower
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of maintenance of electric wire towers, and particularly relates to maintenance equipment used on an electric wire tower, which comprises an engineering vehicle, a mechanical arm and a cleaning execution assembly, wherein the cleaning execution assembly is arranged on the engineering vehicle through the mechanical arm with multiple degrees of freedom; when the insulator is cleaned, the shape of the bristle mounting plate can ensure that the front surface of the insulator faces one side of the bristle mounting plate, the insulator is half-wrapped by the rotating bristle mounting plate, and one side of the front surface of the insulator facing the bristle mounting plate can be cleaned by bristles on the bristle mounting plate; when the other side is cleaned, the first motor is controlled to work, so that the mounting screw rod drives the cleaning unit to rotate 180 degrees around the axis of the rotating ring, and the front surface of the rotating bristle mounting plate faces the cleaned surface on the other side; the cleaning execution assembly does not need to be reinstalled, and the use is convenient.

title_en: Raw silicone rubber feeding device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of organic silicon, in particular to a raw silicone rubber feeding device which comprises a feeding device body and a cutting mechanism extrusion mechanism; the material cutting mechanism is arranged at the material feeding end of the material feeding device; the extrusion mechanism is arranged at the feeding end of the feeding device; the cutting mechanism comprises a motor A, a turntable, an L-shaped rod, a grid baffle, a sliding rail, a knife carrying plate, a double-sided knife and a transmission rod; the feeding device comprises a feeding device body, a motor A, a rotary table, a transmission rod, a cutter carrying plate, a double-sided cutter, a slide rail and a cutter carrying plate, wherein the motor A is fixedly arranged on the feeding device body, the rotary table is arranged at the output end of the motor A, one end of the L-shaped rod is rotatably arranged on the rotary table, one end of the transmission rod is rotatably arranged at the other end of the L-shaped rod, the cutter carrying plate is vertically and fixedly arranged at the other end of the transmission rod, the double-sided cutter is fixedly arranged at the output end of the cutter carrying plate, and the slide rail fixedly arranged at the end part of the grid type baffle is in sliding connection with the connecting end of the cutter carrying plate.

title_en: Vertical disc type continuous dryer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vertical disc type continuous dryer, which comprises: the drying barrel, drying barrel up end central point puts and rotates and be connected with the dwang, dwang side fixedly connected with evenly distributed's puddler, the dwang is located the puddler below and rotates and be connected with the division flitch, divide flitch and drying barrel fixed connection, divide flitch and puddler sliding connection, the equal fixedly connected with lateral wall of puddler up end scrapes the pole, the lateral wall is scraped the pole and is all with dividing flitch sliding connection, the lateral wall is scraped the pole and is kept away from the one side of dwang with the puddler and is the arc surface. Through above-mentioned structure, through the setting of dividing the flitch, make the material can be under stirring of stirring rod even follow dry barrel interior flow out, secondly, the setting of piece is scraped to the lateral wall scraping rod of rethread stirring rod up end fixed connection and dwang side fixed connection's bottom, prevents that the material adhesion from being unable to follow the discharge gate in dry barrel from discharging, leads to the material to take place to block up in dry barrel.

title_en: Computer wind scooper
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a computer wind scooper, which comprises a scooper body, wherein a plurality of ventilation holes are formed in two opposite side surfaces of the scooper body, the outer surface of the scooper body is symmetrically and fixedly connected with a connecting plate, the upper end of the connecting plate is provided with an upper clamping plate, the lower end of the connecting plate is provided with a lower clamping plate, and the connecting plate is used for connecting the scooper body and a host computer of a computer together; the cover body is internally provided with a rotating shaft in a rotating way, the upper end and the lower end of the rotating shaft are fixedly connected with connecting shafts, a plurality of air deflectors are arranged between the two connecting shafts, and the cover body is provided with a driving mechanism which is used for driving each air deflector to rotate. When the host is closed by people, the mounting block and the power-on spring are powered off at the same time, the cover body is in a relatively closed state, and when the host is not used, external dust cannot enter the interior through the rear of the host, so that the condition of the dust in the interior is effectively controlled.

title_en: Straw processor for agriculture
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for the technical field of agricultural machinery, and provides an agricultural straw processor, which comprises an arc-shaped cover, wherein a stirring box is fixedly arranged between adjacent support rods and transverse plates, and a stirring mechanism is also rotatably arranged on the stirring box; the crushing mechanism is slidably arranged on the supporting rod, and is also in transmission connection with the stirring mechanism and used for crushing the turned-up straws; one end of the guiding mechanism is connected with the crushing mechanism, and the other end of the guiding mechanism is also in transmission connection with the stirring mechanism; the screening mechanism is arranged at the top end of the stirring box, and one end of the screening mechanism is rotationally connected with the crushing mechanism; this application can dig out the straw from the field to smash the screening to it, cooperation rabbling mechanism carries out intensive mixing with straw, fertilizer or medicament, and evenly spill it in the field, guarantees soil fertility, in order to follow-up planting of carrying out other crops, and when smashing, still change its height through the guiding mechanism who sets up, prevent that root deep part from appearing remaining, thereby improve its utilization ratio.

title_en: Injection molding machine for automobile switch panel
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an injection molding machine for an automobile switch panel, which comprises an injection molding mechanism, a first cooling mechanism for cooling a product, and a second cooling mechanism for cooling liquid passing through a liquid conveying pipe, wherein the first cooling mechanism is arranged below the injection molding mechanism, and the second cooling mechanism is arranged on the side face of the first cooling mechanism. According to the utility model, the air extractor extracts high-temperature gas above the liquid storage tank by arranging the second cooling mechanism, negative pressure is generated in the liquid storage tank, external gas enters the fixed shell after being filtered by the filter screen under the action of the negative pressure, the gas in the fixed shell enters the liquid storage tank, and the gas passing through the fixed shell can cool the cooling liquid passing through the infusion tube, so that the temperature of the cooling liquid is effectively reduced, and the subsequent cooling effect is not influenced.

title_en: High-rise green building door and window
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-rise green building door window, which comprises a frame body, wherein glass is fixedly connected between the top and the bottom of an inner cavity of the frame body, a liquid storage box is fixedly connected to the top on the right side of the frame body, a water inlet pipe is communicated with the axle center of the top of the liquid storage box, a protective shell is fixedly connected to the bottom of the liquid storage box, a pressure pump is fixedly connected to the left side of the inner cavity of the protective shell, a guide pipe is communicated to the top of the pressure pump, and the top of the guide pipe is communicated with the liquid storage box. According to the utility model, through the coordination of the frame body, the glass, the liquid storage box, the water inlet pipe, the protective shell, the pressure pump, the guide pipe, the water outlet pipe, the water storage tank, the guide hole, the groove, the rotating rod, the driving wheel, the driven wheel, the threaded rod, the threaded sleeve, the movable rod, the connecting plate, the sponge cushion, the handle, the clamping groove and the clamping block, rainwater can be collected and sprayed on the back surface of the glass, and the back surface of the glass is wiped clean by coordinating with the movement of the sponge cushion, so that the glass is convenient for people to use.

title_en: Multistage automatic filtration device based on stem cell supernatant
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multistage automatic filtering device based on stem cell supernatant, which comprises at least three stages of filters arranged in series, wherein each filter comprises a suction filtration container and a cover body arranged above the suction filtration container, an upper container and a rotary membrane group are arranged on the cover body, a liquid inlet is formed in the upper container, the rotary membrane group is rotatably arranged on the cover body, at least two groups of filtering membranes are arranged on the rotary membrane group, a filtrate port, a suction filtration port and a servo motor are arranged on the suction filtration container, the servo motor is connected onto the cover body in a telescopic manner, and the upper container, the filtering membranes and the filtrate port are sequentially arranged from top to bottom and are connected through shrinkage of the servo motor to form a filtering channel. The utility model can realize the sectional screening of protein substances in the supernatant of the stem cells, reduce the blockage of the filter membrane caused by the filtrate, avoid the tedious process of manually replacing the filter membrane by automatic replacement of the filter membrane, and effectively improve the filtering efficiency of the supernatant of the stem cells.

title_en: Building construction reinforcing bar cutter
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of building construction, in particular to a building construction steel bar cutting machine, which comprises: a base; the limiting mechanism is connected with the base and is used for being matched with the base to fix the reinforcing steel bars; the cutting mechanism is arranged on the outer side of the limiting mechanism, connected with the base and used for being matched with the limiting mechanism to cut the reinforcing steel bars; wherein, stop gear includes: the fixing component is connected with the base and is used for being matched with the base to fix the reinforcing steel bars; the limiting assembly is arranged on the outer side of the base and is connected with the fixing assembly, the fixing assembly is matched with the limiting assembly to fix the reinforcing steel bars in multiple ends, so that the stability of the reinforcing steel bars in cutting is greatly improved, and the machining quality is guaranteed.

title_en: Catch basin is used in industrial factory building construction
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water collecting tank for industrial factory building construction, relates to the technical field of water collecting tanks, and solves the technical problems that a filtering effect of a filtering plate arranged at present is affected to a certain extent along with long-time filtering and increase of years in the long-time filtering process, and the filtering plate cannot be disassembled and replaced in time to affect the water collecting effect; the device comprises a tank body, wherein both sides of the inner wall of the tank body are respectively and slidably connected with a fallen leaf filter screen and a filter plate through a sliding plate, a support frame is fixedly arranged in the middle of the bottom end of the fallen leaf filter screen, a clamping block is fixedly arranged in the middle of the top end of the filter plate, the support frame is connected with the clamping block in a clamping way, a fixed block is fixedly arranged at the bottom of one side of the support frame, a limiting assembly is arranged in the fixed block, and the limiting assembly comprises a limiting rod, a limiting plate, a spring and a pull ring, and the limiting rod is slidably connected in the fixed block; the utility model is convenient to detach and replace the arranged filter plate, and improves the filtering effect and the water collecting effect.

title_en: Backflushing flow regulating valve of siphon filter tank
abstract_en: The utility model provides a backwash flow control valve of a siphon filter tank, and relates to the technical field of flow control valves. The back flush flow regulating valve of the siphon filter tank comprises: a filter operation platform; the valve control main body is positioned on the filter operation platform and comprises a valve placing seat, the valve placing seat is fixedly arranged on the valve placing seat through a first fixing bolt, the valve placing seat is fixedly provided with a valve fixing support through a second fixing bolt, and the valve fixing support is provided with a valve hoist. The backflushing flow regulating valve of the siphon filter provided by the utility model has the advantage of regulating backflushing strength.

title_en: Energy-conserving heat sink of mill with dust fall function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of factory dust fall, and discloses an energy-saving cooling device with a dust fall function for a factory. This mill's energy-conserving heat sink with dust fall function, through the dust fall mechanism that sets up, the starter motor work, the output shaft of motor can drive first gear and rotate, first gear can drive the second gear and rotate, the second gear can drive the worm and rotate, the worm can drive the connecting pipe through the transmission of worm wheel and rotate, the connecting pipe drives the shower head and rotates, stop the motor work after adjusting suitable position can, thereby realize spraying the nimble purpose of adjusting in position, further reinforcing device's flexible performance, and also be convenient for the staff to operate and use.

title_en: Filter convenient to clearance
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a filter convenient to clean, which comprises a filter box, wherein the upper end of the filter box is connected with a box cover through threads, a filter cover is arranged in the filter box through a bearing, a filter screen is fixedly connected in the filter cover, a servo motor is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the box cover, a spray head frame is fixedly connected in the filter box, a high-pressure water pump is fixedly connected to the outer side of the filter box, and a sealing door is hinged to the outer side of the filter box. According to the utility model, the sealing door, the sealing gasket, the limiting frame and other structures are additionally arranged on the outer side of the filter box, the limiting frame can be driven by the elastic force of the spring to limit the sealing door in the use process, and when the interior of the filter box needs to be cleaned, the interior of the filter box can be cleaned through the sealing door after the limiting frame is separated from the sealing door, so that the box cover can be prevented from being opened for cleaning, and the device is more convenient for cleaning.

title_en: Environment-friendly construction waste recycling device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a green construction waste recycling device which comprises a recycling hopper and a crushing cutter set, wherein the recycling hopper is arranged on a crushing box, a driving device is arranged on the surface of the crushing box, the crushing cutter set is arranged in the crushing box, the lower end of the crushing box is connected with a material conveying box, the inside of the material conveying box is connected with a conveying belt, the lower end of the conveying belt is connected with a fixed base, and the upper end of the fixed base is provided with a high-pressure water spraying device. According to the utility model, the cutting and crushing cutter set for concrete is designed, waste concrete, soil blocks and sand stone can be crushed and separated, wherein separated metal substances are adsorbed on the magnetic iron-absorbing rod, fine sand is filtered through the sand stone filter screen, and then the steel bars and small metal are collected by the separating box.

title_en: Cooler with noise reduction function
abstract_en: The utility model provides a cooler with a noise reduction function, which relates to the technical field of coolers, wherein an electric push rod is arranged in a transverse groove formed in a base, a movable seat is also connected in the transverse groove in a sliding manner, the electric push rod is connected with the movable seat, the inner sides of the two movable seats are fixedly connected with supporting frames, the problem that the existing cooling fan needs to be continuously started when the cooling fan is used for cooling due to the lack of an effective rapid temperature control structure, the continuous starting of the cooling fan not only causes energy waste, but also can generate noise to influence the surrounding environment is solved, the fan arranged at the front end of the supporting frame is started to blow external cold air to a cooling pipe for rapid air cooling by utilizing an air hole formed at the rear side of the supporting frame, the energy loss can be effectively reduced through intelligent air cooling, the noise can be effectively reduced, and the aim of being more practical is achieved.

title_en: Multistage filtration impurity removing device
