abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multistage filtering impurity removing device which comprises a fixing component, wherein the fixing component comprises a box body and a bracket, two sides of the box body are provided with a feeding and discharging component, the feeding and discharging component comprises a feeding pipe and a discharging pipe, the inner side of the box body is provided with a multistage filtering mechanism, the multistage filtering mechanism comprises a filter screen, a cleaning component is arranged on the filter screen, the cleaning component comprises a main shaft and a scraping plate, the top of the box body is provided with an impurity collecting component, the multistage filtering impurity removing device can automatically clean impurities filtered on the filter screen, ensure the filtering efficiency of the filter screen, stop the filter screen cleaning work is not needed, the labor consumption is reduced, the amount of impurities attached to the filter screen can be automatically detected, the cleaning work of the impurities is automatically carried out when the impurities on the filter screen are more, the scraping plate is prevented from rotating all the time, the abrasion to the filter screen is increased, the service life of the filter screen is ensured, and the multistage filtering impurity removing device is suitable for the filtering impurity removing and fixing use of aqueous emulsion.

title_en: Facial beauty instrument with cleaning function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a facial beauty apparatus with a cleaning function, which comprises a handle, wherein a limiting bulge is arranged at the end part of the handle, a working cavity is arranged at the bottom of the limiting bulge, a storage cavity is arranged at the bottom of the working cavity, a storage plate is arranged at the inner side of the bottom of the storage cavity, a cleaning ball is arranged in the storage cavity, a driving motor for controlling the cleaning ball to rotate is arranged in the working cavity, and a buffer mechanism is arranged between the cleaning ball and the storage cavity. Compared with the existing beauty instrument, the utility model has the advantages that the storage plate is arranged on the inner wall of the storage cavity, skin dirt cleaned by the cleaning ball can be extruded on the storage plate, dirt can be prevented from scattering on the face, the buffer mechanism is arranged between the cleaning ball and the top of the storage cavity, so that the cleaning ball is not in hard contact with the skin, and the skin can be protected.

title_en: Medicine grinding equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of display grinding equipment, and discloses medicine grinding equipment, which comprises a sealing cover and a grinding chamber detachably connected with the sealing cover, wherein a discharging part is arranged at the bottom of the grinding chamber in a conducting way, a grinding paddle extending into the grinding chamber is arranged in the sealing cover, and the grinding paddle is in clamping connection with a bearing disc rotatably arranged in the grinding chamber; a plurality of discharging holes are formed in the bearing plate at intervals, and a sealing plate for sealing the discharging holes is rotatably arranged at the bottom of the bearing plate; in the initial state, the sealing plate is in a state of plugging the discharge hole, and continuously plugging or opening the discharge hole is realized by the sealing plate along with the forward or reverse conversion rotation of the grinding paddles; according to the utility model, through the optimized arrangement of the structure, the discharging position and the discharging mode are adjusted, so that smooth discharging of the ground powder is ensured, and the situation that powder materials are scattered during discharging is avoided.

title_en: Tea cleaning and drying integrated equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses tea cleaning and drying integrated equipment which comprises a mechanical box body, wherein a lifting device is movably arranged in the mechanical box body, drying devices are fixedly arranged at two ends of the lifting device, and a rotating device is fixedly arranged in the mechanical box body. Above-mentioned scheme places the fixed plate in the inside of sealing the frame, through the effect of joint spring, with joint bolt joint in the inside of sealing the frame, the side that will clear water pass through the functional box simultaneously, will wash the pond and annotate fully, at this moment, the clear water overflows the bottom of rolling the net section of thick bamboo, through starting rotary drive, make the surface of the inside tealeaves of rolling the net section of thick bamboo drive in aqueous rotate the washing, start fan subassembly and resistance heating wire, make drying device exhaust hot-blast, dry the both ends of rolling the net section of thick bamboo, after the stoving, take out the tealeaves of drying, wash stoving an organic wholely, when saving occupation space, the process of reduction personnel operation, save time and manpower, the practicality of improvement equipment.

title_en: Fine brewing beer filtering and precipitating machine
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of beer brewing, and particularly relates to a refined beer filtering and precipitating machine, which comprises a container, wherein a pollution storage box is arranged on the container, a liquid inlet pipe is fixedly connected to the container, a liquid outlet is formed in the container, a supporting block is fixedly connected to the container, a supporting frame is fixedly connected to the supporting block, a motor is fixedly connected to the supporting frame, a rotating rod is fixedly connected to the output end of the motor, a disassembling and assembling mechanism is arranged on the rotating rod, and a scraping mechanism is arranged on the container.

title_en: Novel continuous temperature control water diversion device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel continuous temperature control water diversion device which comprises a temperature control water diversion device body, an impurity collection mechanism and a filtering mechanism, wherein a plurality of water diversion pipes are arranged at the upper end of the temperature control Wen Fenshui device body, the filtering mechanism is arranged in the water diversion pipes, the lower end of the temperature control water diversion device body is communicated with the impurity collection mechanism, and a cleaning mechanism is arranged in the temperature control water diversion device body. When the temperature-control water separator is used, when the temperature-control water separator body is used for separating water, the filter screen frame is arranged in the water separation pipe, so that the separated water can be filtered, impurities in the water are prevented from entering the water separation pipe, when the filter screen frame needs to be replaced, the two pull blocks are pulled to drive the limiting block to move backwards, the limiting block compresses the second spring, and therefore the filter screen frame is convenient to detach and replace due to the fact that the installation block is separated from the positioning block.

title_en: Silicon carbide sealing member raw materials mixing apparatus
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of production of silicon carbide sealing elements, and provides silicon carbide sealing element raw material mixing equipment which comprises a support, a mixing box and a discharge port, wherein a main gear is arranged at the bottom end of one side of the support, a driving motor is arranged at one side of the main gear, the mixing box is arranged in the support, a stirring mechanism is arranged in the mixing box, a feed inlet is arranged at the top end of the mixing box, a dust removing mechanism is arranged at the top end of one side of the mixing box, the dust removing mechanism comprises a dust removing box, a fan, a dust collecting box, a chute, a sliding block and a dust collecting pipe, the dust removing box is arranged at the top end of one side of the mixing box, the dust collecting pipe is arranged at the top end of the dust removing box, and the fan is arranged at the bottom end of the inside the dust removing box. According to the utility model, the fan is arranged at the top end of one side of the mixing box, and is started, so that dust in the mixing box can be sucked into the dust collecting box, the dust collecting box is pulled out from the inside of the dust collecting box, and the dust collecting box is cleaned in a concentrated manner.

title_en: Double-station spraying device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a double-station spraying device which comprises a spraying device main body, wherein a spraying component is arranged at the inner bottom of the spraying device main body, a groove is formed in one side of the inner top of the spraying device main body, an air drying component is arranged in the groove, two groups of material containing boxes are fixedly connected to the other side of the inner top of the spraying device main body, spray heads are fixedly connected to the lower ends of the two groups of material containing boxes, and the two groups of spray heads are communicated with the material containing boxes.

title_en: Steel length measuring equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses steel length measuring equipment belongs to steel sheet processing technology field. The steel plate detection device mainly comprises a conveying component, the conveying component is used for conveying a steel plate, a detection support is arranged on the conveying component, a mounting frame is arranged on the detection support in a rotating mode, a detection wheel is connected to one end of the mounting frame through a detection wheel bearing, an encoder is arranged on the mounting frame, the shaft end of the encoder is connected with the shaft end of the detection wheel in a transmission mode, a cleaning component is arranged on the front side of the detection wheel and is used for cleaning impurities on the steel plate on the front side of the detection wheel, the number of turns of the detection wheel on the steel plate is recorded through the encoder, the circumference of the detection wheel is matched with the circumference of the detection wheel, the length of the steel plate is calculated, and the front side of the detection wheel is cleaned on the surface of the steel plate to be contacted through the cleaning component, so that the detection accuracy of the detection wheel is improved. The steel length measuring equipment solves the problem that the surface defects of the steel plate affect the length measuring precision.

title_en: Automatic pesticide spraying machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of pesticide spraying, in particular to an automatic pesticide spraying machine, which comprises: the pesticide spraying device comprises a bottom plate, wherein a pesticide box is arranged at the top of the bottom plate, an inlet is formed in the top of the pesticide box, a uniformly mixing mechanism for uniformly mixing pesticide and water is arranged in the pesticide box, an angle adjusting mechanism for adjusting the spraying angle is arranged on one side of the top of the bottom plate, two nozzles are connected to one side of the angle adjusting mechanism, and flexible hoses are communicated with the two nozzles. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the mixing mechanism, the pesticide and the water are added into the pesticide box together, the connecting rod is driven by the driving motor to enable the plurality of blades to rotate, and the pesticide and the water are stirred, so that the pesticide and the water are mixed more uniformly, and the effect of the liquid medicine is improved; according to the utility model, through the arrangement of the angle adjusting mechanism, the electric cylinder drives the racks to move up and down, and simultaneously drives the two racks to rotate, so that the two nozzles can simultaneously adjust the spraying angle, and the spraying range is increased.

title_en: Wheat bran extraction device for Antrodia camphorate planting
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wheat bran extraction device for planting Antrodia camphorate, which comprises a storage barrel, wherein a limiting block is fixedly arranged in an inner cavity of the storage barrel, a filter screen is movably arranged at the top of the limiting block, a pair of stretching components are detachably connected to the top of the filter screen, a driving cavity is formed in the bottom of the storage barrel, a stirring mechanism is arranged in the inner cavity of the storage barrel and the driving cavity in a matched mode, a barrel cover is hinged to the top of the storage barrel, clamping seats are symmetrically arranged at the tops of the barrel covers, clamping components are arranged in the inner cavities of the clamping seats, a liquid inlet is formed in the tops of the barrel covers, a first handle is arranged on the side wall of the barrel cover, a second handle is symmetrically arranged on the side wall of the storage barrel, a liquid outlet is formed in the side wall of the storage barrel, the filter screen can be synchronously opened and closed through the cooperation of the filter screen, the stretching components and the clamping components, the filter screen is prevented from being dismounted when the extraction device is used each time, the use efficiency of the device is greatly improved, the wheat bran and the alcohol can be slightly stirred through the arrangement of the stirring mechanism, the materials are accelerated, and the soaking effect is improved.

title_en: Building rubbish recycled aggregate wind selector
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of construction waste treatment, in particular to a construction waste recycled aggregate winnowing device, which comprises a mounting frame, wherein a screening box is arranged above the inner side of the mounting frame, the bottom of the screening box is provided with a filter screen plate, the front side of the bottom of the screening box is provided with a discharging leakage pipe, the edges of the left side and the right side of the bottom of the filter screen plate are provided with vibrating motors, the back of the screening box is provided with a screening fan, the set filter screen plate, the vibrating motors and the discharging leakage pipe can screen the construction waste recycled aggregate through vibration, sand and stone in the screening fan and the dust discharging pipe can be cleaned, and the screening fan and the dust discharging pipe are designed comprehensively, so that dust and sand in the construction waste recycled aggregate can be conveniently treated through a wind blowing mode and a vibrating mode, and the effect of the device on the treatment of the construction waste recycled aggregate is better.

title_en: Clean goods of circulation drenches room
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of cargo showers, and particularly relates to a circulating clean cargo shower, which comprises the following components: a cargo shower body; a clean room arranged in the cargo shower body; the air shower nozzles are arranged on the inner walls of the two sides of the clean room and are distributed in rectangular arrays on the two sides of the clean room respectively; a collecting cover installed at the top of the clean room; according to the utility model, the clean circulation mechanism can realize the recycling of air in the clean room, dust in the air is collected in the dust collecting box through the collecting cover in the circulation process, and filtered through the filtering block, the filtered air is stored in the air storage tank through the compression pump, and gas is sprayed into the clean room through the air shower nozzle, so that the clean room always maintains a dust-free environment, and the problem that the conventional goods shower room is not provided with the clean circulation device, so that goods are secondarily polluted is solved.

title_en: Quick thread end cutting device for trousers
abstract_en: The utility model provides a rapid thread end cutting device for trousers, which comprises: the device comprises a table, a bracket, a U-shaped supporting plate, an automatic rail and a self-priming thread end shearing device; the support is vertically arranged on the platform, and the U-shaped supporting plate is arranged on the support; the automatic rail is fixed on the bracket, and the shearing end of the self-priming thread end shearing device is arranged on the automatic rail and can move along the side edge of the U-shaped supporting plate through the automatic rail. According to the self-suction thread end shearing device, the automatic track is arranged on the side edge of the supporting plate to control the self-suction thread end shearing device to run along the running path of trousers, so that the shearing of the thread ends of the trousers can be automatically completed, the sheared thread ends are absorbed, the product quality is ensured, and the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Adhesive smearing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of adhesive coating, in particular to an adhesive coating device. The adhesive smearing device comprises a fixed base, two groups of first fixed blocks are fixedly connected to the bottom of the fixed base through bolts, the inner cavity side walls of the first fixed blocks are rotationally connected with a smearing roller through a rotating shaft, the two groups of inner cavity tops of the first fixed blocks are fixedly connected with a fixed scraping plate through bolts, a threaded fixing groove is formed in the top of the fixed base, an extruding rubber cylinder is connected to the inner cavity side wall of the threaded fixing groove through threads, a limiting fixing ring is fixedly connected to the top of the extruding rubber cylinder, and an extruding rubber pipe is fixedly connected to the bottom of the extruding rubber cylinder. The adhesive smearing device provided by the utility model has the advantages of stable structure, simplicity and convenience in operation, capability of quantitatively controlling the extrusion of the adhesive, uniformity in smearing, capability of greatly improving the actual working efficiency and good practicability and flexibility.

title_en: Powder mixing device and powder mixing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a powder mixing device and powder mixing equipment. The powder mixing device comprises a frame and a pipeline static mixer, wherein the pipeline static mixer is elastically connected to the frame, a feed inlet of the pipeline static mixer is arranged up and down with a discharge outlet of the pipeline static mixer, the powder mixing device further comprises a vibration component, the vibration component is connected to the pipeline static mixer, and the vibration component is used for vibrating the pipeline static mixer. Because the pipeline static mixer does not need to use a stirring motor and other motors with larger power, the weight of the powder mixing device is lighter, so that the transportation convenience of the pipeline static mixer is higher, and the maintenance and repair frequency of the powder mixing device is lower.

title_en: Fly ash processingequipment for cement processing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cement processing equipment, and discloses a fly ash processing device for cement processing, which comprises a first box body, wherein the bottom of the first box body is communicated with a second box body; according to the utility model, the first rotating wheel is driven to rotate by one motor under the transmission of the belt, the two second rotating rods are driven to rotate under the action of the second gear, and the two first rotating rods can be driven to rotate under the action of the first gear by the cooperation of the second rotating wheels and the belt, so that compared with the existing multiple motors, the novel fly ash feeding device is more energy-saving, the energy consumption of production is reduced, the dust guard is added in the feed hopper, the reset spring is sleeved on the surface of the third rotating rod on the dust guard, and when the fly ash enters into the first box under the action of gravity, the two dust guards are reset and buckled together after the feeding is finished, so that the dust guard is realized.

title_en: Oil pressing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of oil extraction, and discloses an oil extraction device which solves the problem that the oil extraction amount is influenced because the existing oil extraction device cannot fully crush raw materials, and the oil extraction device comprises a support base, wherein a shell is fixedly arranged at the middle position of the top end of the support base, a feed hopper is arranged at the top end of the shell, a driver is arranged on the front surface of the shell, a first crushing groove is arranged at the top end of the inside of the shell, a first crushing roller which is matched and connected with the driver is arranged in the first crushing groove, a second crushing groove is arranged at the middle position of the inside of the shell, a second crushing roller which is matched and connected with the driver is arranged in the second crushing groove, an oil extraction component is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the inside of the shell, and a controller is arranged at one end of the top of the support base; through this device of pressing oil can realize fully smashing the raw materials to can improve the oil yield.

title_en: Novel concrete quality detects device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a novel concrete quality detection device which comprises a base, wherein fixing rods are fixedly arranged at four corners of the top of the base, a top plate is fixedly arranged at the top of each fixing rod, a mounting plate is sleeved on the surface of each fixing rod, a dust removal component is arranged on one side of the top of each mounting plate, a protection component is arranged at the bottom of each mounting plate, and a mounting groove is formed in the middle of the top of the base. The utility model comprises the following steps: the dust that will detect the process and produce is sent into the mounting box from the dust absorption pipe through dust absorption pump cooperation suction hood, then discharges after the cartridge filter to will avoid opening behind the protection casing dust influence staff's health, drive the surface movement of mounting panel at a plurality of dead lever through two electric telescopic handle, the mounting panel cooperation connecting block drives protection casing downwardly moving, until blotter and base contact, pneumatic cylinder cooperation hydraulic stem drives extrusion head downwardly moving, the extrusion head detects the concrete in the detection dish, the atress seat of detection dish cooperation bottom extrudes pressure sensor.

title_en: Fill electric pile fire control automatic spray device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire control and extinguishment and discloses a charging pile fire control automatic spraying device which comprises a spraying pipe and a plurality of spraying heads uniformly arranged at the lower end of the spraying pipe, wherein one end of the spraying pipe is fixedly connected with a mixing pipe, a group of buckles are arranged on the outer side of the spraying pipe, a lifting frame is arranged at the upper end of each buckle, a filter is arranged at one end of the mixing pipe, a second metal hose is fixedly connected at one end of the filter, and an air pipe is arranged at one end of a second rotary joint. According to the utility model, the electric cylinder is regulated to enable the spray pipe and the spray head to swing in the front-back direction, so that the spray range of the spray head is increased, the electric cylinder is contracted to regulate the heights of the spray pipe and the spray head, spray fire extinguishment at different heights is realized, and the fire extinguishment efficiency is improved; the impurity in the high-pressure water can be filtered through the filter, so that the spray head is effectively prevented from being blocked, and the poor fire extinguishing effect is avoided.

title_en: Online membrane flushing device for sewage treatment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an online membrane flushing device for sewage treatment, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the bottom of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a plurality of groups of support rods, one side of the top of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a water agent barrel, the other side of the top of the bottom plate is provided with a water pump, the right side of the bottom plate is provided with a membrane frame, a plurality of groups of membrane wire assemblies are arranged between the upper end and the lower end of the inside of the membrane frame, and the top of the water agent barrel is provided with a chemical mechanism convenient for rapid mixing. This an online membrane washing unit for sewage treatment is through being provided with lid, servo motor, charge mouth, impeller and transmission shaft, during the use, drops into sodium hypochlorite powder along the charge mouth on the lid according to the proportion, starts servo motor this moment, and servo motor drives the high-speed rotation of transmission shaft, and the impeller of transmission shaft bottom then begins stirring the water, accelerates the powder and dissolves, has realized accelerating the function of dissolving the solution, and the problem that the device does not possess accelerating the function of dissolving the solution is solved.

title_en: Fodder unloader with prevent fodder structure that splashes
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a feed discharging device with a feed splashing prevention structure, and relates to the technical field of feed processing. This kind of fodder unloader with prevent fodder structure that splashes, through the rocking mechanism that sets up, at the rotating electrical machines during operation, the output of rotating electrical machines drives pivot, cam and rotates, because the one end of splash guard rotates through articulated seat with the hopper body down and is connected, and first connecting plate passes through reset spring elastic connection with the second connecting plate for the splash guard can do the reciprocal deflection of taking articulated seat as the axle center, rock, thereby can make the fodder be in motion all the time, and then can prevent to make the fodder appear the condition of jam in hopper body department under when the unloading is too much, make the fodder can normally discharge.

title_en: Water filtering equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of filters, in particular to water filtering equipment, which comprises a connector assembly and a filter body, wherein the connector assembly is used for being connected to a pipeline, and the filter body is detachably connected to the connector assembly; the connector assembly comprises a connector body, a mounting port is formed in the connector body, a mounting head is arranged on the filter body, and the mounting head is detachably connected in the mounting port; the connector body is internally provided with a shaft hole along the left-right direction, the shaft hole is rotationally connected with a mandrel, and the front end of the connector body is provided with a first water inlet hole and a first water outlet hole which are communicated with the shaft hole; the outer side of the mandrel is provided with a first cutting groove communicated with the first water inlet hole and a second cutting groove communicated with the first water outlet hole; the connector body is internally provided with a communication hole. The filter body in the water filtering equipment is convenient to replace and effectively ensures that no water is cut off at the first water outlet.

title_en: Magnetic frame for separating magnetic particles in EP (EP) pipe
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a magnetic rack for separating magnetic particles in an EP (EP) pipe, which comprises a magnetic rack base, wherein a plurality of magnetic assemblies are arranged at the top end of the magnetic rack base, pipe body assemblies are arranged at positions, close to the magnetic assemblies, of the top end of the magnetic rack base, the pipe body assemblies are used for containing liquid to be separated, and an introduction assembly is arranged at the top end of the magnetic assembly; the introducing assembly is used for simultaneously introducing the liquid into the plurality of pipe body assemblies; according to the utility model, the guide-in rod is matched with the guide-in hoses, so that when a worker injects liquid into the EP pipes, the EP pipes can be simultaneously injected, the problem that the efficiency of injecting liquid into one pipe of the worker is relatively low is solved, and the separation efficiency of the worker on magnetic particles in the liquid is effectively improved.

title_en: Nitrogen making equipment with high-purity oxygen product
abstract_en: The utility model relates to nitrogen production equipment with high-purity oxygen products, which comprises a rectifying upper tower, a high-purity oxygen tower and a high-purity oxygen tower evaporator; the high-purity oxygen tower is provided with a liquid oxygen-enriched inlet, an oxygen-enriched gas outlet, a liquid oxygen outlet and a high-purity liquid oxygen outlet; the high-purity oxygen tower evaporator is provided with an oxygen-enriched gas inlet and a liquid oxygen-enriched outlet; the upper rectifying tower is provided with an oxygen-enriched gas outlet and an oxygen-enriched liquid outlet; the oxygen-enriched gas outlet of the upper rectifying tower is connected with the oxygen-enriched gas inlet of the high-purity oxygen tower evaporator, the liquid oxygen-enriched outlet of the high-purity oxygen tower evaporator is connected with the liquid oxygen-enriched inlet of the high-purity oxygen tower, the oxygen-enriched liquid outlet of the upper rectifying tower is connected with the liquid oxygen-enriched inlet of the high-purity oxygen tower, the oxygen-enriched gas outlet of the high-purity oxygen tower outputs oxygen-enriched gas, the liquid oxygen outlet outputs liquid oxygen products, and the high-purity liquid oxygen outlet of the high-purity oxygen tower outputs high-purity oxygen products. The utility model can produce high-purity oxygen product at the same time of nitrogen production, improves the utilization rate of air source, reduces the waste of air source components and improves the economic benefit.

title_en: Grinding and powder removing machine and battery pole piece recycling system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of grinding and powder removing of battery pole pieces, in particular to a grinding and powder removing machine and a battery pole piece recycling system. According to the utility model, due to the limiting effect of the filter screen on the materials, the materials can only pass through the filter screen and can be output to the discharge port through the discharge cavity when the materials are ground into the particle size meeting the requirements in the grinding cavity, so that the size of the discharged particle size of the materials can be controlled through the arrangement of the filter screen, further the control on the grinding precision is realized, the materials are ensured to be sufficiently ground, and the grinding device has the advantages of simple structure, small size and low cost.

title_en: Raw material proportioning device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a raw material proportioning device, which relates to the technical field of mixed fertilizer production and comprises a shell, wherein a plurality of proportioning mechanisms are arranged on the outer side of the shell, each proportioning mechanism comprises a proportioning shell connected with the outer side of the shell, a round rod is arranged at the bottom of each proportioning shell, and a connecting plate is connected at the bottom of each round rod. The inside at the ratio shell is placed with the batching of kind difference through proportioning mechanism, the telescopic link extension, the stock of installing telescopic link top is upwards moved for the plectane of stock bottom installation upwards moves, makes the inside batching of ratio shell upwards move, when the batching reachs unloading hole department, the batching can the landing in the inside of shell, according to the ration volume of required batching, the extension length of control telescopic link, through the extension height of the telescopic link on every proportioning mechanism of control, the batching quantity of control injection, the inside of pushing the shell with the batching volume of needs, accomplish the ratio to the batching.

title_en: Material mixing device suitable for micro powder detects usefulness
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of diamond micropowder detection, in particular to a material mixing device suitable for micropowder detection, which comprises a mounting plate, a rotating assembly and a box cover, wherein two vertical plates are arranged on the mounting plate; the middle part of the rotating ring is provided with a limiting ring, and the inner walls of the upper side and the lower side of the rotating ring are provided with threads I; the inside puddler that is provided with of blending bunker, blending bunker one end is sealed, and the blending bunker other end forms connecting portion, and the connecting portion outside is provided with screw thread two. According to the utility model, the sample is placed in the mixing bin, and then the rotating ring and the mixing bin are driven to rotate by the handle, so that the sample in the mixing bin is uniformly mixed.

title_en: Flour mixer with mould proof function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a flour mixer with a mildew-proof function, which comprises a mixing drum, wherein a mildew-proof mechanism is arranged above the mixing drum, the mildew-proof mechanism comprises a rotary table, an electric telescopic rod, a pushing frame, a hairbrush and the like, the mixing drum is internally provided with a mixing mechanism, and a blanking mechanism is arranged below the mixing drum; the electric telescopic rod is arranged, the push frame is driven to lift by extension of the electric telescopic rod, the hairbrush is arranged, the push frame drives the hairbrush to clean flour adhered to the blades in time, the flour is prevented from being mildewed, and the quality of the flour is ensured; through the arrangement of the motor, the motor drives the blades to rotate through the turntable, and additives such as vitamins, minerals and the like are automatically stirred, so that the mixing efficiency is ensured, and the flour production efficiency is improved; through being provided with the scraper blade, the scraper blade is edible rubber material, scrapes the clearance to the inner wall of churn when the stirring, has enriched the functionality of device.

title_en: Gradient-adjustable concentrating table
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gradient-adjustable concentrating table, which has the technical scheme that: the movable plate comprises a workbench, wherein a movable plate is arranged at the top of the workbench, a bed body is arranged at the top of the movable plate, two supporting blocks are fixedly connected to the top of the movable plate, a first rotating shaft is fixedly connected to the inner sides of the two supporting blocks, a convex strip is sleeved outside the first rotating shaft, and the convex strip is fixedly connected to the bottom of the bed body: the piston II moves leftwards under the design of the pipeline II and the pipeline I to enable air in the box II to enter the box I, so that the two pistons I move upwards, the two ejector rods move upwards, the rear side of the bed body can be slightly jacked, the bed body is further enabled to rotate by taking the rotating shaft I as a rotating shaft, the inclination angle of the bed body can be adjusted, and the inclination angle of the bed body can be properly adjusted according to the size of ore particles during ore dressing, so that the ore dressing efficiency can be increased.

title_en: Adjustable cleaning basket
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of semiconductor cleaning, in particular to an adjustable cleaning basket which comprises two frame components, wherein a plurality of adjusting plates are fixedly connected between the two frame components, two fixing plates are arranged, a plurality of connecting columns are fixedly connected between the two fixing plates, a first handle is fixedly connected between the two fixing plates, a second handle is fixedly connected between the two fixing plates, and a plurality of holes are formed in the upper ends of the fixing plates. This adjustable washing basket, four rectangular shape adjustment tank have been seted up to the longeron, and the hole groove that sets up with the fixed plate is corresponding, can be according to the size of wasing the product, and the adjustment tank of selecting to connect corresponding, and the adjustable effect of rectangular shape adjustment tank can be connected through the bolt locking with two hole grooves when being connected with the fixed plate, and fixed effect is good, and non-deformable, different products can use same washing basket, and use cost reduces, has reduced management cost.

title_en: River mud cleaning equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of river channel cleaning equipment, and discloses river channel sludge cleaning equipment, which comprises a cleaning mechanism, wherein an adjusting mechanism is arranged outside the cleaning mechanism; the cleaning mechanism comprises a slurry pump body, wherein the lower end of the slurry pump body is fixedly communicated with an extraction pipe, the lower end of the extraction pipe is fixedly communicated with an extraction port, and the extraction port is fixedly connected with a protective pore plate. This drying device is used in cotton production of pearl is through placing the extraction port at the river bottom, the slush pump body makes the extraction pipe lower extreme produce suction, make river course silt get into from the extraction port, and discharge from slush pump body upper end, thereby clear up river course silt, rotate through step motor drive live-rollers, the live-rollers drive a plurality of poking plates rotate, make pivoted poking plate drive device bottom remove in the river course bottom, make extraction port and extraction pipe lower extreme remove, be convenient for carry out the extraction clearance to the silt of the large tracts of land of river course bottom, the operation of being convenient for, improve the efficiency of river course silt clearance.

title_en: Device for cutting, refining and layered filtering of ocular fat
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device for cutting, refining and layering filtering of eye fat, and relates to the field of medical auxiliary equipment. The utility model comprises a material pipe with two ends communicated, wherein one end of the material pipe is communicated with a material discharging pipe, the other end of the material pipe is provided with a working rod in a sliding manner, one end of the working rod is arranged in the material pipe in a sliding manner, and the working rod comprises a cutter head rod and a pushing rod; the outer diameter of the rod of the cutter head rod is smaller than the inner diameter of the material pipe, and the outer diameter of the rod of the pushing rod is the same as the inner diameter of the material pipe; the discharge end of the discharge pipe is also communicated with a filtering mechanism; so as to achieve the purposes of conveniently cutting and refining fat and outputting fat particles with uniform particle size.

title_en: Spool paper waste water recycle processing apparatus
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bobbin paper wastewater recycling treatment device, which relates to the technical field of wastewater treatment and comprises a box body, wherein supporting columns are arranged at two ends of the bottom of the box body, a baffle plate is arranged in the inner cavity of the box body, a through hole is formed in the upper end of the baffle plate, a pretreatment bin is arranged on the left side of the baffle plate, the top of the pretreatment bin is connected with a water inlet pipe, a catalytic bin is arranged on the right side of the baffle plate, a filtering component is arranged in the inner cavity of the pretreatment bin, and the top of the filtering component extends out of the pretreatment bin and is provided with a pull plate. According to the utility model, through the cooperation of the filtering component and the pretreatment bin, particles contained in the wastewater are adsorbed and filtered, and through the cooperation of the stirring component, the catalytic bin, the driving component and the liquid inlet, the wastewater can be subjected to dosing treatment, and through the cooperation of the exhaust pipe, the negative pressure fan, the purifying box, the activated carbon adsorption net and the connecting pipe, the gas generated during wastewater treatment can be adsorbed and purified, so that the wastewater treatment area is more thorough.

title_en: Dry type paint spraying equipment
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of dry paint spraying, and discloses dry paint spraying equipment, which comprises an equipment body, wherein a filtering mechanism is arranged above the equipment body, a spray head is arranged below the filtering mechanism, and an electric clamping jaw is arranged below the spray head; the motor is positioned below the equipment body, and a heating pipe is arranged above the motor; and the disassembly and assembly mechanism is positioned above the filtering mechanism. According to the dry type paint spraying equipment, the filtering mechanism is arranged above the equipment, so that the filtered air is safe and nontoxic, and the filtering mechanism is arranged above the equipment through simple disassembly and assembly, so that the disassembly, the cleaning and the maintenance are convenient; the active carbon layer is fixed above the filter screen of the filter mechanism through the disassembly and assembly mechanism, so that the active carbon layer is conveniently replaced regularly, the filtering efficiency is ensured, the disassembly and assembly mode is simple and quick, the disassembly and assembly time is saved, the operation is convenient, and the safety of equipment processing is improved.

title_en: Insect pest prevention and control insecticidal lamp
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of pest killing lamps, and discloses a pest control pest killing lamp, which comprises a pest trapping lamp system, an electric pest wire frame system arranged on the pest trapping lamp system, and a cleaning poking frame system, wherein a lantern ring with a scraper connected to the lower end is movably sleeved on a connecting end post at the upper end of the pest trapping lamp body, the lower end of the scraper is connected with a poking rod piece, the sloping plate part of the poking rod piece is attached to the inclined bottom of a tray of a lower tray, when the pest control pest killing lamp is cleaned, the cleaning poking frame system rotates by poking a poking head exposed from a poking notch, the scraper scrapes pest corpses adhered to the pest trapping lamp body, the sloping plate part scrapes and collects the pest corpses falling into the lower tray, and the pest corpses fall into a pest outlet along the sloping plate edge of the lower tray during scraping, so that the pest corpses are conveniently collected.

title_en: Sea buckthorn leaf extraction tank capable of conveniently discharging slag
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sea-buckthorn leaf extraction tank capable of conveniently discharging slag, which belongs to the technical field of sea-buckthorn leaf extraction, and aims to solve the problems that sea-buckthorn leaves in the prior art contain a large amount of plant fibers, the sea-buckthorn leaves cannot be dissolved in water, the sea-buckthorn leaves can be adhered to the inner wall of a tank body, too many plant fibers are thrown in at one time, a discharge port is blocked, and slag discharge is relatively inconvenient.

title_en: Dedicated oil-water separation system of idesia oil production line
abstract_en: The utility model provides a special oil-water separation system for idesia oil production lines, which comprises an oil storage tank arranged on a rack, wherein a feed inlet is arranged on the oil storage tank, a water storage box is arranged on one side of the oil storage tank, and an oil storage box is arranged on the other side of the oil storage tank; a partition plate is arranged between the oil storage tank and the water storage box, and a water outlet channel is formed between the oil storage tank and the water storage box through an opening at the lower end of the partition plate; an adjusting flashboard with variable height is arranged between the oil storage tank and the oil storage box, and the upper edge of the adjusting flashboard is lower than the upper edge of the partition board; the water storage box is connected with a drainage pipeline, and the oil storage box is connected with an oil drainage pipeline. The system can separate oil from water of the primary phase oil obtained by the idesia oil production line, and has the technical advantages of high separation efficiency and low production cost.

title_en: Agitating unit is used in production of alkali-reducing corrosion and scale inhibitor convenient to temperature regulation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a stirring device convenient for temperature regulation and used for producing alkali-reducing corrosion and scale inhibitor, which relates to the field of scale inhibitor processing equipment. According to the utility model, a driving source is provided by the motor, and then the stirring shaft and the stirring blades rotate at a high speed to uniformly fuse the stock solutions, and meanwhile, the temperature control mechanism heats the inside of the stirring box, so that the stock solutions of the scale and corrosion inhibitor can be uniformly mixed and fully reacted when the scale and corrosion inhibitor is used in a low-temperature environment, and the quality of a finished product of the scale and corrosion inhibitor is ensured.

title_en: Raw material discharging primary mixing device for proportioning bins
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a raw material blanking primary mixing device for a proportioning bin, which relates to the technical field of refractory brick processing and comprises a mixing bucket, wherein a blanking hopper is arranged on the upper surface of one side of the mixing bucket, a first motor is arranged on the upper surface of a first supporting plate, a first rotating shaft and a second rotating shaft are rotatably connected to the inner side surface of the lower part of the blanking hopper through bearings, a discharging hopper is arranged on the lower surface of the other side of the mixing bucket, a fourth rotating shaft is rotatably connected to the inner side surface of the lower part of the discharging hopper through bearings, a third rotating shaft is rotatably connected to the inner side of the mixing bucket through bearings, through holes are formed in the upper surface of the mixing bucket, and the through holes are equidistantly distributed on the upper surface of the mixing bucket.

title_en: Valve stuffing box inner wall cleaning tool
abstract_en: The utility model provides a tool for cleaning the inner wall of a valve stuffing box, which comprises the following steps: split shaft sleeve, spring piece and cleaning piece; at least two split type shaft sleeves are mutually connected to form a sealing space and are used for being sleeved on the outer circumferential surface of a valve rod of a valve, spring pieces are arranged on the outer circumference of the bottom of the split type shaft sleeve at intervals, cleaning pieces are arranged on the outer sides of the spring pieces, and at least two split type shaft sleeves rotate on the outer sides of the valve rod of the valve and can drive the cleaning pieces to clean the inner wall of a stuffing box of the valve. According to the utility model, the valve rod of the valve can be wrapped by interconnecting the split type shaft sleeves, the bottom of the split type shaft sleeve can enter the valve packing box, the cleaning piece can be completely attached to the inner wall of the valve packing box through the elastic action of the spring piece, and the inner wall of the valve packing box can be comprehensively cleaned by repeatedly rotating the split type shaft sleeve, so that the cleaning efficiency is effectively improved.

title_en: Integrated arrangement equipment of ophthalmology medical data
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ophthalmic medical data integration and arrangement device which comprises a bottom box body, wherein the top of the bottom box body is fixedly connected with a top box body, one side of the bottom of the front end of the top box body is fixedly connected with a code scanning opening, a touch display screen is arranged at the middle position of the front end of the top box body, a printer paper outlet is arranged at the front end of the bottom box body, and a screen cleaning and anti-fouling mechanism is arranged at the middle position of the bottom of the front end of the top box body. This integrated arrangement equipment of ophthalmic medical data is through being provided with triangle casing, air outlet and fan, during the use, under daily use condition, the fan continuously blows air in the triangle casing, and the pressure constantly increases in the triangle casing, and the air current of high pressure is discharged along the air outlet, blows the touch-control display screen surface, prevents the dust adhesion, has realized the clean function of preventing being stained with of screen, and the problem that the device does not possess the clean function of preventing being stained with of screen is solved.

title_en: Automatic door structure suitable for large-scale furnace body
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic door structure suitable for a large furnace body, which comprises at least two side-by-side furnace doors, a first linear motion mechanism for driving the furnace doors to translate back and forth and a second linear motion mechanism for driving the furnace doors to translate left and right in the direction of the adjacent furnace doors, wherein an upper guide groove base is arranged above the furnace doors, an upper switch door guide groove and an upper translation guide groove are arranged at the bottom of the upper guide groove base, the upper switch door guide groove is mutually vertical and communicated with the upper translation guide groove, an upper guide wheel is arranged at the top of the furnace door, a floating translation guide groove and a lower translation guide groove are arranged below the furnace door, the first linear motion mechanism is connected with the floating translation guide groove, and a lower guide wheel and a translation wheel are arranged at the bottom of the furnace door. According to the automatic door structure provided by the utility model, the first linear motion mechanism and the second linear motion mechanism can open the furnace door only by overcoming friction force, so that the difficulty in opening and closing the furnace door is greatly reduced, and the condition of falling the furnace door in the power-off and gas-off maintenance state is avoided.

title_en: Nystatin reaction device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a nystatin reaction device, which relates to the technical field of nystatin reaction, and comprises a base and two driven bevel gears, wherein four supporting components are arranged at the top end of the base, a double-output-shaft motor is fixedly connected at the top end of the base, connecting rods are fixedly connected with transmission shafts at two ends of the double-output-shaft motor, one ends of the two connecting rods are fixedly connected with driving bevel gears, the two driven bevel gears are respectively meshed with the two driving bevel gears, and connecting screw rods are fixedly connected with the inner sides of the two driven bevel gears, so that the nystatin reaction device has the beneficial effects that: through initiative bevel gear and driven bevel gear transmission, be convenient for drive two screw connection lead screws rotation that screw thread opposite direction is convenient for drive the cauldron body and shift up or shift down the adjustment position, be convenient for carry out further support for the cauldron body through two accessory plates and auxiliary rod, be convenient for promote the stability that the cauldron body was adjusted, need not to manually adjust, labour saving and time saving and easy and simple to handle.

title_en: Vibration device for chemical reaction kettle
abstract_en: The utility model provides a vibrating device for a chemical reaction kettle, which relates to the technical field of reaction kettles and comprises a reaction kettle body and a reaction kettle upper cover, wherein a mixing barrel is arranged in the reaction kettle body, two vibrating devices are symmetrically arranged at the bottom end of the mixing barrel, each vibrating device comprises a shell, a motor, a rotating rod and a top plate, a base is fixedly arranged in the shell, and two limiting barrels are fixedly connected to the top end of the base and near the edge of one end of the base. According to the utility model, the vibration device is arranged at the bottom end of the mixing barrel, so that the phenomenon that the reaction kettle body vibrates together during vibration to cause each externally connected pipeline to fall off is avoided, the normal operation of the chemical reaction kettle is ensured, the practicability of the device is improved, the chemical raw materials in the mixing barrel can be fully mixed by arranging the vibration device, and the production efficiency of the chemical reaction kettle is improved.

title_en: Feeding and impurity removing device for clean raw materials
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a feeding and impurity removing device for clean raw materials, which relates to the technical field of impurity removing of clean raw materials and comprises a feeding and impurity removing device main body, wherein an impurity removing and filtering device is movably arranged at the upper end of the inner part of the feeding and impurity removing device main body, and a secondary impurity removing device is fixedly arranged at the outer part of the right side of the feeding and impurity removing device main body. According to the utility model, through installing the impurity removal filter device, raw materials can be better filtered through vibration, the spring is arranged on the second clamping block plate, protection can be given when the machine is vibrated, damage of the machine shell is lightened, in addition, the first filtering net is clamped with the second clamping block through the first clamping block, the first filtering net is convenient to replace, the second impurity removal device is installed, raw materials after the two-time filtration can be secondarily removed through the conveying pipe, the motor, the rotating column and the dragon conveying sheet, cleanliness of the raw materials is guaranteed, after the two-time impurity removal, the pushing plate is pushed to move through the starting cylinder, the raw materials after the impurity removal are pushed out, and the discharging is convenient.

title_en: Support jig for spraying automobile parts
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a supporting jig for spraying automobile parts, which comprises a wire body turntable, wherein a plurality of mounting seats are uniformly distributed on the circumference of the outer edge of the wire body turntable, and jig bodies are arranged on the mounting seats; the jig body comprises a fixing seat, the fixing seat is sleeved on the mounting seat, a vertical screw rod is fixedly arranged at the top of the fixing seat, a plurality of horizontal plates are arranged on the vertical screw rod, a U-shaped supporting frame is fixedly arranged in the middle of one end face of each horizontal plate, a horizontal supporting rod is arranged at the bottom of each U-shaped supporting frame, and adjusting nuts are screwed on the upper surface and the lower surface of each horizontal plate on the vertical screw rod. The mount pad includes the base, and the bilateral symmetry of base upper surface one end is equipped with the cardboard, and the base upper surface is equipped with the spliced eye. The mounting groove has been seted up to the fixing base bottom, and the welding has "the shape fastener of the U in the mounting groove, and the horizontal pole joint of" the shape fastener of the U "is between two cardboard, and the vertical pole of" the shape fastener of the U inserts inside the spliced eye. The utility model has simple structure, convenient installation, adjustability, high adaptability and good spraying supporting effect.

title_en: Casting die fixing device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of casting molds, in particular to a casting mold fixing device, which comprises a base, wherein a mold body is arranged at the top of the base; the top of the base is fixedly connected with a pair of fixed columns; the pair of fixing columns are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the base; when using, drive the screw rod through rotating the carousel and rotate, first telescopic link then can carry out concertina movement, at this moment under the inclined plane effect of limiting plate, can promote the middle part of mould body to splint, later be close to each other to mould body centre gripping through both sides splint, this in-process, thereby it is fixed to reduce in the tradition at cast in-process needs, it is difficult to fix to lead to, fixed effect is not good, cause the casting in-process to take place to remove, at this moment be close to each other through splint, and then increase the fixed action of mould body in the base top, simultaneously through the limiting plate of both sides, and then increase the limiting action when holding the mould body.

title_en: Resin wastewater treatment device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a resin wastewater treatment device which comprises a machine kettle, a first electromagnetic valve, a second electromagnetic valve, a filter bag, a rotary driving mechanism and a controller, wherein the machine kettle comprises a kettle body and a kettle cover, a partition plate is arranged in a kettle cavity of the kettle body and separates the kettle cavity into an upper cavity and a lower cavity, a material distributing connector which can be communicated with the upper cavity and the lower cavity is arranged on the partition plate, a discharging connector which can be communicated with the outside and the lower cavity is arranged at the bottom of the kettle body, the kettle cover detachably seals an opening at the top of the kettle body and is provided with a feeding connector which can be communicated with the outside and the upper cavity, the material distributing connector and the discharging connector are respectively opened and closed by the first electromagnetic valve and the second electromagnetic valve, a side opening which can be communicated with the lower cavity and the outside is detachably sealed by a kettle door, and the filter bag is arranged at the material distributing connector and driven by the rotary driving mechanism and can be used for accelerating the solid-liquid separation of a mixed liquid.

title_en: Raymond mill discharging device for fluorite powder processing
abstract_en: The utility model provides a Raymond mill discharging device for fluorite powder processing, which relates to the technical field of fluorite powder production, and comprises a discharging box, wherein a feed bin pipe is inserted at the top of the discharging box, a slot is formed in the side wall of the discharging box, a material receiving box is connected in a sliding manner in the slot, a dust removing tank is arranged on one side of the discharging box, a connecting pipe is arranged between the dust removing tank and the discharging box, a dust absorbing component for absorbing dust is arranged in the connecting pipe, and a filter screen is arranged on the side wall of the dust removing tank; the material bin pipe is communicated with the Raymond mill bin, the processed fluorite powder is discharged to the inside of the discharge box through the bin pipe, the fluorite powder is received by the receiving box, the insertion groove is closed through the receiving box while the fluorite powder is discharged, the raised material dust cannot diffuse to the outside of the equipment, and the dust is sucked into the dust collection tank through the dust collection assembly by the connecting pipe.

title_en: Tail gas recycling system generated in carbonate production process
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tail gas recycling system generated in a carbonate production process, which comprises a cooling condensing unit, a compressing unit, a carbon dioxide recycling unit and an epoxy compound recycling unit. The utility model can recycle the effective components in the tail gas of the device, realize the purposes of recycling the tail gas and reducing the emission of carbon dioxide, and improve the overall economic benefit of the device.

title_en: Gas desulfurizing tower
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of gas desulfurization, in particular to a gas desulfurization tower, which comprises a tower body, wherein a separation cavity for gas desulfurization is arranged in the tower body, at least one separation seat is arranged in the separation cavity, and circumferentially distributed vent holes are arranged on the separation seat, wherein one end of each vent hole is positioned below the separation seat and is used for communicating the separation cavity, and the other end of each vent hole extends to the inner side of the separation seat and is used for communicating with desulfurization liquid in the separation seat.

title_en: Uniform dryer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a uniform dryer which comprises a box body, wherein a first rotary rod and a first fixed rod are respectively arranged on the box body, a first disc is arranged at the free end of the first rotary rod, a second disc is arranged at the free end of the first fixed rod, meshing teeth which are meshed with each other are arranged on the first disc and the second disc, a second fixed rod is arranged on the first disc, a first fixed piece is clamped on the outer side wall of the second fixed rod, a second fixed piece is clamped on the second disc, a plurality of heating sources are arranged on the inner side wall of the box body, and a driving piece for driving the first rotary rod to rotate is arranged on the box body; the utility model can improve the drying efficiency and also can dry articles with different degrees of hardness.

title_en: Turbid liquid weakening and separating device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a turbid liquid weakening and separating device, which comprises a base, wherein the upper end of the base is fixedly connected with a fixed block, the upper end of the fixed block is fixedly connected with a clamping plate, a chute is formed in the clamping plate, the upper end of the base is fixedly connected with a connecting rod, one side of the connecting rod is fixedly connected with a deflection sheet III, an extrusion mechanism for turbid liquid solid-liquid separation is arranged between the clamping plates, the extrusion mechanism comprises a telescopic cylinder, the lower end of the telescopic cylinder is fixedly connected with a sleeve block, the lower end of the sleeve block is fixedly connected with a sleeve, the lower end of the telescopic cylinder is telescopically connected with a telescopic column, the lower end of the telescopic column is fixedly connected with an extrusion plate, and the outer side of the sleeve block is fixedly connected with a deflection sheet I. According to the utility model, the chute structure on the clamping plate is utilized, so that the separating cylinder structure can be inclined, when the separating cylinder is inclined, the telescopic movement travel distance of the telescopic column can be increased, the liquid quantity of single separation is improved, and compared with the structure of the traditional extrusion type separating device, the structure has adjustability.

title_en: Rice clearance integrated device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rice cleaning integrated device, which relates to the technical field of rice cleaning integrated devices and comprises a box body, wherein a first fixing frame is fixedly connected to the top of the box body, a second fixing frame is fixedly connected to the top of the box body, a sliding groove is formed in the top of the box body, a first rotating plate is hinged to the inside of the first fixing frame, and a limiting hole is formed in the inside of the first rotating plate. According to the utility model, rice is poured into the box body through the rice inlet, the second rotating plate is driven to rotate through the output end of the first motor, the other end of the second rotating plate slides in the limiting hole to drive the first rotating plate to rotate, the top of the first rotating plate drives the third rotating plate to slide in the sliding groove, the screening box swings in the box body, impurities in the rice are discharged into the impurity collecting box through the impurity outlet while the screening box swings, the position of the impurity collecting box is fixed by the base, and the quality of the rice is conveniently improved by sliding the sliding door out of the bottom of the screening box.

title_en: Movable supporting plate structure of coal and gangue sorting combined device
abstract_en: A movable supporting plate structure of a coal and gangue sorting combined device comprises a receiving plate, a supporting pipe, a position form holding bin, a connecting plate and a shell. Wherein the support tube plays a key role in supporting the upper material receiving plate and connecting a power source, and the position shape keeps the position and the movement track of the support tube constrained by the bin. Wherein, the material receiving plate and the supporting tube are hollow structures, which not only ensures the strength, but also lightens the mass and greatly improves the reciprocating speed.

title_en: Drying device for copper foil surface treatment machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of copper foil treatment devices, and discloses a drying device for a copper foil surface treatment machine, which comprises a treatment box, wherein supporting legs are fixedly arranged at the bottom of the treatment box, a fixed roller is rotatably arranged in the treatment box, a guide roller is rotatably arranged in the treatment box, a surface treatment mechanism is arranged in the treatment box, and heating and drying mechanisms are arranged at the top and the bottom of the treatment box. This drying device for copper foil surface treatment machine, through the surface treatment mechanism who sets up, in the use, evenly spray water on the both sides surface of copper foil through the water spray subassembly that sets up, scrape the both sides surface of copper foil through two scrapers that set up afterwards, make the scraper blade strike off impurity and the drop of water on copper foil surface, and collect the inside of collecting the box in a concentrated way, discharge impurity through the blow off pipe afterwards, and will carry out the secondary cleaning to copper foil surface through the clean hair roller that sets up, improve clean effect.

title_en: Mutton processing is with hanging belt cleaning device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a hanging and cleaning device for mutton processing, which comprises a collecting box body, wherein the top of the collecting box body is in a grid shape, a spray pipe is fixedly arranged at the top of the collecting box body through a supporting rod, a plurality of nozzles are communicated with the inner side of the spray pipe, a driving motor is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the supporting rod through a mounting plate, one end of the driving motor is fixedly provided with a horizontal suspender through a connecting rod, a plurality of hooks are fixedly arranged on the horizontal suspender, when the hanging and cleaning device is used, the spray pipe is communicated with a water storage tank, mutton to be cleaned is hung on each hook, the spray pipe sprays water to the mutton through each nozzle, and simultaneously, the driving motor is started to drive the horizontal suspender to rotate, so as to drive the mutton to spray and clean the mutton while rotating, so that the effect of all-round cleaning of the mutton can be achieved, sewage can flow into the collecting box body, residues can be filtered at the top of the collecting box body, so that the cleaning efficiency can be improved, the cleaning effect can be ensured, residues can be cleaned uniformly after the cleaning is finished, and the electromagnetic control valve can be opened to discharge sewage in the collecting box body.

title_en: Anti-blocking device for blow-down pipe of gas-liquid separator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-blocking device for a blow-down pipe of a gas-liquid separator, which belongs to the technical field of anti-blocking devices and comprises the following components: the anti-blocking device comprises an anti-blocking shell, wherein a programmable controller is fixedly connected in the middle of the outer wall of the anti-blocking shell, two heating assembly grooves are symmetrically formed in the two sides of the outer wall of the anti-blocking shell along the central axis of the programmable controller, and a plurality of electric heating pipes are fixedly connected in the heating assembly grooves at equal intervals; the two ends of the device are respectively provided with the threaded ring blocks, the emptying pipe is divided into the emptying inlet pipe and the emptying outlet pipe, the ends of the emptying inlet pipe and the emptying outlet pipe, which are close to the device, are respectively provided with the threaded ring grooves, the emptying inlet pipe and the emptying outlet pipe are fixedly connected with the device through the threaded connection of the threaded ring blocks and the threaded ring grooves, and meanwhile, the device is provided with the heating mechanism and the two-end telescopic scraping mechanism.

title_en: Novel high-efficient cooling device for aluminum profile production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cooling devices, in particular to a novel efficient cooling device for aluminum profile production. The technical proposal comprises: the cold water box, be provided with the installation platen in the cold water box, the installation platen top is provided with the motor, the output of motor is connected with main rotor roll, main rotor roll and follow the outer lane of rotor roll are provided with two sets of stable risers, the installation platen top is provided with water-cooling storehouse and air-dry storehouse respectively, water-cooling storehouse one side is provided with the water pump, the top in air-dry storehouse is provided with the fan. The utility model has simple integral structure and convenient operation, can rapidly cool the aluminum profile for a plurality of times, and can simultaneously carry out wind drying treatment on the aluminum profile after water spraying and cooling, thereby improving the efficiency of producing and processing the aluminum profile, and simultaneously the cooling and drying treatment is convenient for secondary processing of the aluminum profile.

title_en: Powder making device for graphite processing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of graphite production and processing, in particular to a powder preparation device for graphite processing, which comprises a main body box, a crushing box and a supporting seat, wherein the lower end of a hydraulic cylinder is fixedly connected with a supporting plate, the lower end of the supporting plate is fixedly provided with a plurality of crushing hammers, the crushing hammers are fixedly connected through reinforcing rods, the top end of the inside of the crushing box is fixedly provided with a screening net, and the crushing hammers are movably connected with the screening net. This powder process device for graphite processing is to smashing the intracavity portion and throw into massive graphite piece through the material throwing hole, smash the hammer and smash down on massive graphite piece, strike the suitable fritter of pore size with the graphite piece, then the graphite of fritter will get into the crushing case downwards along the screening net and smash further smashing, has avoided smashing the roller and has become too direct the smashing with graphite and lead to the condition that the blade cutting is not in place, has finally improved the crushing effect of powder process device for graphite processing.

title_en: CPP film aluminizing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a CPP film aluminizing device which comprises an aluminizing device body, wherein an observation window is arranged on the front surface of the aluminizing device body, and supporting legs are fixedly arranged on two sides of the bottom of the aluminizing device body. When the film extends into the aluminum plating device body to start processing, the pull rod is loosened, the connecting plate is sprung downwards under the action of the extrusion spring, so that the dust dipping roller is in contact with the film, the film drives the dust dipping roller to rotate along with the movement of the film, the dust dipping roller adheres dust on the surface of the film, the dust adheres to the surface of the dust dipping roller, the film is further cleaned, the suction nozzle and the hose are used for sucking air under the action of the suction pump, the dust on the surface of the film is discharged along with air, and the problem that dust possibly exists on the surface of the film before aluminum plating of the CPP film is solved.

title_en: Curtain wall waterproof device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a curtain wall waterproof device, which belongs to the technical field of green building structures and comprises a curtain wall body, wherein a waterproof layer is fixedly connected to the inner side wall of one side of the curtain wall body, a heat preservation layer is fixedly connected to the inner side wall of one side of the curtain wall body, which is far away from the waterproof layer, a water pipe is arranged between the waterproof layer and the heat preservation layer, a water room is fixedly connected to the bottom of the water pipe, a heating room is fixedly connected to the bottom of the water room, a heating block is fixedly connected to the bottom of the water room, the heating block is positioned in the heating room, and a temperature sensor is fixedly connected to one end of the heating block. According to the utility model, the waterproof layer, the water pipe, the heat insulation layer, the water room, the heating block and the temperature sensor are arranged, heat flow guidance in summer is realized through the cooperation of the water pipe and the water room, heat insulation in winter is realized through the cooperation of the water pipe, the water room, the heating block and the temperature sensor, and energy conservation and protection of the green curtain wall waterproof device are realized, so that the stability of the green curtain wall waterproof device is improved.

title_en: Rice polishing waxing mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a rice polishing and waxing mechanism, which comprises a polishing machine body, wherein a material conveying mechanism is arranged on the left side of the polishing machine body, a dust collecting mechanism is arranged on the right side of the polishing machine body, the material conveying mechanism comprises a material conveying pipe, the right side of the material conveying pipe is fixedly connected with the left side of the polishing machine body, a shell is fixedly arranged at the top of the material conveying pipe, a motor is fixedly arranged on the inner top wall of the shell, an output shaft of the motor is fixedly connected with a rotating shaft, one end of the rotating shaft penetrates through and extends to the inside of the material conveying pipe, a spiral blade is fixedly arranged on the outer surface of the rotating shaft, and a slag discharging pipe is fixedly arranged on the inner surface of the material conveying pipe. This rice polishing waxing mechanism through being provided with defeated material mechanism, has reached the purpose of carrying out the material to rice, can clear away broken rice in the rice, bran piece and dust simultaneously, has satisfied user's user demand.

title_en: Feeding mechanism of boiling granulator
