abstract_en: The utility model discloses a feeding mechanism of a boiling granulator, which comprises a workbench, wherein a storage box is arranged on one side of the upper end surface of the workbench, a partition plate is arranged in the storage box, stirring rods for stirring materials are arranged on two sides of the partition plate, a loosening box is arranged on the other side of the workbench, a conveying pipe is arranged on the upper part of the inner wall of the loosening box, one end of the conveying pipe is communicated with the storage box, a conveying auger is arranged in the conveying pipe, a blanking pipe is arranged on the lower part of one end of the conveying pipe, supporting plates are arranged on two sides of the upper part of the inner wall of the loosening box, and a material vibrating screen mechanism is arranged between the supporting plates on two sides. The material is placed into a storage box through a discharging hopper, the two stirring rods are driven to break up the knotted material through controlling a first motor, then the broken material is discharged into a vibrating screen grate through a conveying auger, and an operating rod is driven by a second motor to push the vibrating screen grate to vibrate and screen, so that the material is kept in a loose state and enters a granulating operation performed in a boiling granulator.

title_en: Antibacterial test tube storage box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an antibacterial test tube storage box which comprises a storage box body, a rotating cover, a partition plate, a gear disc and a placement frame, wherein the rotating cover is arranged on the outer surface of the top end of the storage box body, and a transparent sheet is arranged in the middle of the inner part of the rotating cover. This case is deposited to antibacterial experiment test tube, the device is whole when using, through the rotation of dwang, the meshing of cooperation drive gear and conflict rack is connected simultaneously, thereby make conflict rack can wholly rise, the rotation of cooperation worm wheel and worm simultaneously, thereby make the sealing block rotate, thereby make spacing hole and take out the hole alignment, thereby make conflict rack directly support single test tube, thereby make whole when getting at single test tube put, need not to open the rotation lid is whole, can singly get and put, thereby make wholly reduce the likelihood that breeds the bacterium with the outside air contact in the box when using, guarantee holistic result of use.

title_en: Guiding lifting type electronic product accessory cleaning and drying device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of electronic product accessories and discloses a guiding lifting type electronic product accessory cleaning and drying device which comprises a cleaning box, wherein a heater is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the front side of the cleaning box, the middle side of the top of the heater is fixedly connected with a pump body through a connecting pipe, the output end of the pump body is fixedly connected with a shunt pipe, a plurality of air nozzles are fixedly connected to the close sides of the shunt pipe on two sides, and the air nozzles on two sides are horizontally arranged in parallel. According to the utility model, through the matching arrangement of the heater, the pump body, the shunt pipe and the air nozzle, the electronic product accessory keeps rotating and staying in mid-air after being cleaned, at the moment, hot air generated by the heater is conveyed into the air nozzle through the shunt pipe by the pump body through the connecting pipe, and is sprayed out to the electronic product accessory through the air nozzle, and the electronic product accessory is in a rotating state at the moment, so that the electronic product accessory can be uniformly heated and dried.

title_en: Raw material cleaning device for nut oatmeal processing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of oatmeal processing, and discloses a raw material cleaning device for nut oatmeal processing, which comprises a cleaning box, wherein an observation window is fixedly arranged on the front surface of the cleaning box, a power supply box is fixedly arranged on one side of the cleaning box, a servo motor is fixedly arranged on one side of the power supply box, and the output end of the servo motor is in spline connection with a first transmission rod. This raw materials cleaning device is used in nut oatmeal processing sets up through the cooperation of power pack and hot plate, carries out electric connection through power pack and hot plate during the use to played the effect of drying inside raw materials, made the work efficiency of the device improved, set up through the cooperation of motor, second transfer line and second screw conveyer pole, drive the second transfer line through the external power of motor and rotate during the use, and then drive the second screw conveyer pole through the second transfer line and rotate, thereby played the effect that prevents the discharge jam.

title_en: Water quality sulfide acidification blowing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an acidification blowing device for water quality sulfides, and relates to the technical field of acidification blowing instruments. This water quality sulfide acidizing gas blowing device, including acidizing gas appearance body and fixture, the inboard bottom fixed mounting of acidizing gas appearance body has the rack, and the outer wall of rack is inserted and is equipped with the sleeve, and telescopic outside fixed cover is equipped with the color development pipe support, and fixture is including setting up drive assembly, clamping assembly and the mixed subassembly on the rack, and clamping assembly and mixed subassembly all are connected with drive assembly, and drive assembly can blow to the inside of clamping assembly and mixed subassembly. This quality of water sulphide acidizing gas blowing device uses through the cooperation of supporting groove, cavity board A, L shaped plate, piston, connecting plate, rubber bent plate, inflating pump, U-shaped pipe, cavity board B, blast pipe and L pipe, can carry out the centre gripping to four groups of reaction bottles simultaneously, need not operating personnel and carries out fixing one by one.

title_en: Building water supply and drainage pipeline dredging device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dredging device for a water supply and drainage pipeline of a building, which belongs to the technical field of pipeline dredging and comprises a motor and a dredging box, wherein a rotating column is rotatably arranged at the output end of the motor, one side of the motor is fixedly provided with the dredging box, the dredging box is communicated with the dredging box, the steering column penetrates through the dredging box, extension plates are slidably arranged in the two sides of the rotating column, one ends of the extension plates are clamped with pipe brushes, mud suction channels are respectively arranged in the upper end and the lower end of the rotating column, the mud suction channels are communicated with the dredging box, one end of the rotating column is rotatably provided with a rotating rod, one end of the rotating rod is fixedly connected with a planar bearing, and one end of the planar bearing is rotatably connected with a drill bit.

title_en: Roof rainwater collecting and processing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rainwater treatment, and discloses a roof rainwater collecting and treating device, which comprises: the top end of the main body is fixedly provided with a water inlet; the right end of the main body is fixedly provided with a fixed box filtering mechanism which is arranged in the main body; the driving mechanism is arranged in the fixed box, and the first motor is fixedly arranged at the top end of the fixed box. According to the utility model, the sliding block moves in the circular ring, the circular ring can be pushed in the sliding block moving process, the circular ring drives the pushing rod to move, the pushing rod drives the pushing plate to move, the pushing plate drives the filter box to move in the first moving groove, the filter box moves out of the main body, then the filter box is pulled out of the main body by an operator, and finally the filter box can be quickly taken out by driving the pushing plate to move, so that the phenomenon that the bolt is fixed by a bolt, rust is caused, and the bolt slides is avoided.

title_en: Water purification system with pre-filter
abstract_en: The utility model provides a water purification system with pre-filter, including pre-filter, the water heater, go out water installation and water equipment, the water source is connected to pre-filter's water inlet, pre-filter's delivery port is connected water heater respectively, go out water installation, water equipment, pre-filter includes the booster pump, compound filter core, controller and rivers pressure detection device, pre-filter's water inlet, the booster pump, compound filter core and pre-filter's delivery port communicate in proper order, be provided with the first timing module that is used for taking notes booster pump operating time and the second timing module that is used for taking notes pre-filter deposit time on the pre-filter, the controller communicates respectively and connects the booster pump, compound filter core, rivers pressure detection device, first timing module, the second timing module. The water purifying system provided by the utility model can be used for effectively filtering impurities such as rust, sediment and the like, meets various water demands of a whole house, has a supercharging effect, and has a filter element service life detection function.

title_en: Novel trimming device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of hub finishing and discloses a novel finishing device which comprises a polishing device, wherein a motor is arranged on the polishing device, a driving shaft is rotatably assembled on the polishing device and is in transmission connection with an output shaft of the motor, a cover body is rotatably assembled on the polishing device, sliding baffles capable of sliding are arranged on two sides of the cover body, and two fixing frames are fixed on the cover body. When the polishing device provided by the utility model is used, under the cooperation of the air supply assembly and the air injection assembly, the box body can continuously supply air into the air injection pipe, so that the air is injected towards the surface of the wheel hub through the plurality of air injection holes, and therefore, the residual liquid attached to the surface of the wheel hub can be blown off by the air flow injected by the plurality of air injection holes, the surface of the wheel hub is blown dry and cleaned, the wheel hub is not required to be cleaned manually, and the practicability of the device is improved.

title_en: Mortar mixer
abstract_en: The utility model provides a mortar mixer, which comprises a base, a charging basket arranged at the top of the base and used for containing materials, and a stirring mechanism arranged at the top of the base and used for stirring the materials, wherein an annular chute is formed at the top of the charging basket, the annular chute is arranged along the axial direction of the charging basket, a baffle ring is arranged at the top of the charging basket and is slidingly connected in the annular chute, an upper floating ring is arranged at the top of the baffle ring, and the inner diameter of the upper floating ring is gradually reduced from bottom to top. In the process of stirring materials by using the stirring mechanism, the material gradually rising at the edge is applied with acting force to the upper floating ring, so that the upper floating ring and the baffle ring gradually rise to block the material, the material is not easy to overflow from the opening of the charging basket, and the material is not easy to waste. The inner diameter of the upper floating ring is gradually reduced from bottom to top and can be used for further blocking materials, so that the materials are not easy to overflow from the opening of the charging basket and are not easy to waste.

title_en: Cutting fluid clarification plant
abstract_en: The utility model discloses cutting fluid purifying equipment which comprises a pretreatment frame and a sedimentation tank body, wherein a door plate is arranged on the outer surface of the pretreatment frame, a controller is arranged on the outer side of the side face of the pretreatment frame, a feed inlet is arranged on the upper end surface of the middle part of the pretreatment frame, a limiting block is arranged at the lower end of the interior of the pretreatment frame, a sterilization component is arranged in the four ends of the pretreatment frame, the sedimentation tank body is arranged at the lower end of the pretreatment frame, the lower end of a connecting pipe is connected with the sedimentation tank body, an observation window is arranged on the outer side surface of the sedimentation tank body, an oil outlet is arranged at the upper end of the side face of the sedimentation tank body, and a water outlet is arranged at the lower end of the side face of the sedimentation tank body. This cutting fluid clarification plant through the pretreatment frame that sets up, can carry out preliminary treatment to the cutting fluid to the use of filter element can filter the impurity in the cutting fluid, and the degerming subassembly of secondly using can play the bactericidal action to the cutting fluid, is accomplishing oil water separating's effect at last, improves the purification performance of the device.

title_en: Energy-saving durable distillation kettle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an energy-saving durable distillation still which comprises a bottom frame, wherein buffer springs are fixedly connected to the bottom of an inner cavity of the bottom frame, dampers are arranged in the inner cavity of the buffer springs, a still body is fixedly connected to the top of the buffer springs, a motor is fixedly connected to the top of the still body, and an output shaft of the motor penetrates through the still body and is fixedly connected with a transmission rod. According to the utility model, the liquid in the distillation kettle can be heated through the heating block, the heating block is subjected to heat conduction through the annular guide shell, the heating block can be protected, then the motor is started to drive the transmission rod to rotate, the transmission rod drives the L-shaped rod, the scraping plate and the stirring rod to rotate, the stirring rod is arranged, the liquid can be stirred, the evaporation efficiency is increased, meanwhile, the L-shaped rod and the scraping plate rotate, the scraping plate is contacted with the inner wall of the distillation kettle, and then the scraping plate is used for scraping and brushing the inner wall of the distillation kettle, so that adhered residues are effectively cleaned, and the cleaning effect is improved.

title_en: Emission sedimentation equipment for aircraft fuelling vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of discharge equipment, in particular to discharge precipitation equipment for an aircraft fuelling vehicle. The utility model provides an aircraft tank wagon discharges sedimentation equipment, includes the staving the top of staving is provided with the inside funnel of intercommunication staving, is equipped with base and installation piece in the bottom of staving, the both ends of base are connected with the bottom of installation piece through hinge and hasp respectively, are equipped with the mounting groove on the top surface of installation piece, the mounting groove cooperates with the staving, is equipped with movable groove on the cell wall of mounting groove be equipped with the lead screw in the movable groove, the bottom and the blind end rotation of movable groove of lead screw are connected, and the top surface of installation piece is passed on the top of top, and the cover is equipped with the connecting block on the lead screw, connecting block and lead screw threaded connection, the side and the staving fixed connection of connecting block. The utility model can ensure that the funnel is matched with the oil discharge pipe by controlling the screw rod on the mounting block, thereby ensuring that the sediment in the oil tank can be completely discharged.

title_en: Quick liquid filtering device of dehydration spiral shell stacking machine
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of screw stacking machines, and particularly relates to a rapid liquid filtering device of a dewatering screw stacking machine, which comprises a frame, wherein the top of the frame is fixedly connected with a controller, a filter plate is arranged, before sewage enters the inside of a screw stacking machine body for processing, the sewage firstly passes through the filter plate, impurities in the sewage can be filtered by the filter plate, the screw stacking machine body is more convenient for processing the sewage, when the filter plate needs to be replaced, a screw rod only needs to be screwed, because the surface of the screw rod is provided with two groups of screw grooves with opposite rotation directions, when the screw rod rotates, two groups of transmission plates meshed with the screw rod are driven to be mutually far away, then the transmission plates can drive an inserting plate to synchronously move, because the inserting plate is inserted in the connecting plate, when the inserting plate moves, the inserting plate slides out of the connecting plate, and the connecting plate loses the clamping force of the inserting plate, so that the filter plate can be taken out from the inside of the water inlet pipe.

title_en: Automatic change detection screening sorting device
abstract_en: The utility model provides an automatic detection screening and sorting device which comprises an automatic sorting machine, wherein a main driving belt is arranged on the upper surface of the automatic sorting machine, a vertical plate is arranged on one side surface of the automatic sorting machine, a supporting frame is fixedly connected with the lower surface of the vertical plate, an adjusting mechanism is arranged on the upper surface of the vertical plate, and a splicing mechanism is arranged on one side surface of the vertical plate. This automatic change detection screening sorting device, through constant head tank, the T-shaped groove, the locating hole, the T-shaped piece, the fixed block, the fixed slot, spring and locating pin's setting, when needs installation auxiliary conveyor belt, make the T-shaped piece get into the constant head tank in, afterwards transversely promote auxiliary conveyor belt, make the T-shaped piece get into the T-shaped inslot, press the locating pin, extrude the spring, make the locating pin get into the fixed slot in, and follow auxiliary conveyor belt and continue to remove, loosen the hand when the locating pin is pushed down to the riser, and when the T-shaped piece removes suitable position, the spring is restoreed and is jacked the locating pin into the locating hole in, and then it is fixed with the T-shaped piece.

title_en: Food moisture tester
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a food moisture tester, which comprises a moisture tester body, a mounting seat, a charging barrel and a rotating rod, wherein a supporting circular plate fixedly connected with the upper end of the mounting seat through the mounting rod is arranged at the upper end of the mounting seat, a sliding circular plate is arranged at the upper end of the supporting circular plate, a material guiding circular ring which is in sliding connection with the inside of the charging barrel is fixedly connected to the outer end surface of the sliding circular plate, four sealing holes which are uniformly distributed in circumference are formed in the upper end surface of the supporting circular plate, and rubber clamping columns which are tightly sleeved and connected with the sealing holes and fixedly connected with the lower end of the sliding circular plate are arranged in the sealing holes. According to the food moisture analyzer, food residues falling during cleaning can fall on the upper end of the sliding circular plate to be collected, so that cleaning by subsequent workers is facilitated, and the trouble of cleaning by subsequent workers caused by the fact that the food residues directly fall on the upper end surface of the mounting seat is avoided.

title_en: Water-oil phase mixing system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a water-oil phase mixing system which comprises a water-oil phase mixing device, an oil phase liquid inlet pipeline and a water phase liquid inlet pipeline, wherein the water-oil phase mixing device comprises a mixing cavity arranged at the bottom of the water-oil phase mixing device and a mixed liquid outlet arranged at the top of the water-oil phase mixing device; the oil phase liquid inlet pipeline is communicated with the mixing cavity in a first liquid inlet direction, the water phase liquid inlet pipeline is communicated with the mixing cavity in a second liquid inlet direction, the first liquid inlet direction and the second liquid inlet direction are arranged at a preset included angle, and the oil phase entering the mixing cavity continuously shears and impacts the water phase to generate oil-in-water colostrum; the mixed colostrum flows out from the mixed liquid outlet at the top; the water-oil phase mixing system provided by the utility model does not need a shearing machine, is not easy to block, and is convenient for on-line CIP/SIP.

title_en: Airing device of bamboo strip raw materials is used in processing of bamboo article
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bamboo strip raw material airing device for bamboo product processing, which comprises two support side plates, wherein the front and the back of each support side plate are respectively inserted with a telescopic support plate in a sliding manner. This bamboo article processing is with sunning device of bamboo strip raw materials, flexible displacement around the inside of clamp plate strip cover through flexible clamp plate strip, make it can adjust the flexible backup pad at its support curb plate both ends according to the bamboo strip volume of sunning outwards extend for enlarge the face to the sunning of bamboo strip raw materials, adjust the flexible displacement of outside draw-out plate in the inside of transverse connection sleeve plate at any time, make it drive the interval between two support curb plates and adjust to the support length, simultaneously through utilizing the controllable rotation of two axis of rotation spare around, press the bamboo strip raw materials that it put through clamp plate strip cover and flexible clamp plate strip, thereby reached and made it can be according to the length of bamboo strip raw materials and the effect of the corresponding support sunning of the volume fast adjustment of sunning, then reached and made its bamboo strip raw materials sunning more smooth and easy.

title_en: Concrete configuration device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a concrete configuration device, which comprises a tank body, wherein a stirring mechanism is rotatably arranged at the central position of the inside of the tank body, the stirring mechanism comprises a stirring shaft, the stirring shaft is rotatably arranged in the tank body, a clamping frame can be extruded by the adjusting screw through a fixed block and a ball through rotating a hand wheel and an adjusting screw, a clamping frame stretches a spring and is clamped into the inside of a clamping groove, and the stirring shaft can be connected with a U-shaped frame through adjusting the adjusting mechanism, so that the U-shaped frame can be rotated through the adjusting mechanism when the stirring shaft rotates, and residual concrete on the inner wall of the tank body can be cleaned conveniently through the U-shaped frame, and the concrete configuration device is convenient to use; the servo motor drives the stirring shaft and the stirring blade to rotate, the stirring blade at the top extrudes the cross rod through the arc-shaped block, the cross rod can drive the F-shaped frame and compress the spring, and the concrete stirring efficiency can be improved through the cooperation of the cross rod, the F-shaped frame and the stirring blade.

title_en: Wash abundant electroplated nickel water washing case
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electroplated nickel washing box with sufficient washing, which comprises a bottom plate, a washing frame, an electric telescopic rod and a first connecting pipe, wherein the upper end of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a box body, and a partition plate is embedded and connected in the middle position inside the box body; the cleaning frame is placed at the left end of the inside of the box body, and an adjusting mechanism is arranged on the upper side of the cleaning frame and comprises a mounting bar, an adjusting frame, a first gear, a motor, a second gear and a connecting bar; the electric telescopic rod is connected with the upper end of the bottom plate through bolts which are bilaterally symmetrical, and the upper end of the electric telescopic rod is arranged at the lower end of the bearing plate; the first connecting pipe is connected to the right rear end of the box body through bolts, the rear end of the first connecting pipe is arranged at the left end of the water pump, and the second connecting pipe is arranged at the upper end of the water pump. The nickel electroplating washing box with sufficient washing is convenient for full washing, can easily recycle water resources, and is convenient for draining products.

title_en: Multi-camera mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-camera mechanism, which comprises an outer shell, wherein the top end of the outer shell is fixedly connected with a bottom plate, the top end of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with two groups of vertical plates, the top end of each vertical plate is fixedly connected with a top plate, the bottom end of each top plate is provided with a first motor, the output end of each first motor is fixedly connected with a second rotating tooth, one end of each second rotating tooth is in meshed connection with a first rotating tooth, the interior of each first rotating tooth is fixedly connected with a first rotating screw rod, the bottom end of each first rotating screw rod is connected with the outer shell, and the interior of the outer shell is provided with two groups of telescopic rods. According to the utility model, the telescopic rod, the connecting block, the electric telescopic rod and the cleaning sponge plate are arranged to clean the meeting product on the surface of the camera, so that the blurring of the camera due to excessive dust accumulation of the camera is reduced, the clarity of the camera is increased, and the use efficiency of the camera is improved.

title_en: Reinforcing bar straightening machine with cooling function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a reinforcing steel bar straightening machine with a cooling function, which comprises a machining plate body and a second regulating block, wherein one end of the upper surface of the machining plate body is provided with a drying assembly, the drying assembly comprises a main body drying box, the middle part of the upper end of the machining plate body is provided with a cooling assembly, the cooling assembly comprises a main body fixing support, the other end of the upper surface of the machining plate body is provided with a straightening assembly, the straightening assembly comprises a first regulating block, one side of the upper surface of the machining plate body is provided with a main body supporting plate, one end of the upper surface of the machining plate body is provided with a main body drying box, and both sides of the middle part of the main body drying box are provided with dryers. The device has the advantages that the device can automatically straighten the steel bars, indirectly strengthen the integral straightening efficiency of the steel bars, rapidly cool and shape the straightened steel bars, and air-dry and dehumidify the cooled and shaped steel bars.

title_en: Nitrogen conveying system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a nitrogen conveying system, and belongs to the technical field of coal grinding. The nitrogen conveying system comprises a system for supplying nitrogen to a coal grinding system, wherein a coal mill is connected with a bag type powder collector through a first pipeline, and an air outlet of a hot blast stove is connected with the coal mill through a second pipeline; the air outlet end of the circulating fan is connected with a heat exchanger through a third pipeline, and the air outlet end of the circulating fan is also connected with the air inlet end of the hot blast stove through a fourth pipeline; a heating nitrogen conveying pipeline is further connected between the heat exchanger and the raw coal bin, and is connected to a second pipeline through a first branch pipeline, so that the second pipeline can supply heating nitrogen or cold nitrogen; the heated nitrogen delivery line is also connected to the first line by a second branch line. The nitrogen conveying system is used after nitrogen is heated by the heat exchanger, so that condensation water drops generated in the running process of the system are effectively avoided, hardening phenomenon in the pulverized coal conveying process is effectively avoided, the service life of the cloth bag is prolonged, and long-period running of the system is facilitated.

title_en: River course is administered desilting device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of river management and discloses a river management dredging device, which comprises a separation assembly, a sediment pump, wherein a beating assembly is arranged at the bottom of the separation assembly, a moving assembly is arranged at the left side of the separation assembly, a fixing assembly is connected to the top of the moving assembly, a reciprocating threaded rod is fixedly connected to an output shaft of a translation motor, a moving block is sleeved on the outer side thread of the reciprocating threaded rod, a bidirectional threaded rod is fixedly connected to an output shaft of the fixing motor, first threads and second threads are respectively arranged on the front surface and the back surface of the outer side of the bidirectional threaded rod, a moving plate is sleeved on the outer side of each of the first threads and the second threads, a fixed frame is fixedly connected to the inner side of the moving plate, sand and sediment pumped by the sediment pump can be uniformly sprayed on the surface of a separation net through the moving assembly, the separation net can separate sediment from water, the utilization rate of the separation net is improved, and the efficiency of sediment and water separation is improved.

title_en: Distillation frame capable of fixing distillation bottles of different sizes
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of distillation frames, and discloses a distillation frame capable of fixing distillation bottles of different sizes, which comprises a bench, wherein a threaded rod is meshed with the right end of a rotating rod, a rotary drum is movably connected with the inside of a fixed block, a first limiting plate is arranged inside a clamping block, and a second limiting plate is arranged inside a placing plate. This but not distillation frame of equidimension distillation flask is placed the locating plate with the distillation flask earlier on, rotate No. three screw thread dwang respectively earlier, it is spacing to the bottle end to carry out the centre gripping through the centre gripping interval of adjusting No. two limiting plates, do not rotate No. three screw thread dwang respectively, it is fixed to the bottleneck position centre gripping through the centre gripping interval of adjusting No. one limiting plates, then loosen the fixed of limiting ring to the rotary drum, rotate the knob and make the rotary drum carry out the angle fine setting, then rotate the regulation to the outside grip block of rotary drum and the angle of locating the board, thereby realized the effect that distillation frame regulation clamping angle and centre gripping size are in a wide range.

title_en: Dust extraction and battery production facility
abstract_en: The utility model provides a dust collection device and battery production equipment, and relates to the technical field of battery production. The dust collection device comprises a mounting seat, a first dust collection mechanism and a second dust collection mechanism, wherein the mounting seat is provided with a channel for a pole piece to pass through; the first dust collection mechanism comprises a first cutter and a first dust collection box, the first cutter and the first dust collection box are both arranged on the mounting seat and at least partially positioned in the channel, and the first dust collection box is used for adsorbing towards the channel; the second dust absorption mechanism comprises a second cutter and a second dust absorption box, the second cutter and the second dust absorption box are movably arranged on the mounting seat, the second cutter and the second dust absorption box synchronously move to enter or exit the channel simultaneously, and the second dust absorption box is used for absorbing towards the second cutter, so that the dust absorption effect can be remarkably improved, the pole piece cutting efficiency and the pole piece cutting quality are effectively improved, and the cutting yield is improved.

title_en: Soil detection mechanism for cotton before planting
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a soil detection mechanism for cotton before planting, and relates to the technical field of soil detection. The utility model comprises the following steps: the movable block, the movable block top is provided with the detector, the movable block below is provided with the inserted bar, movable block bottom center department fixedly connected with motor, the inserted bar surface is provided with the scraper blade, the movable block left and right sides is provided with draws the handle, the inside swivel that is provided with of movable block, swivel internal surface fixedly connected with solid fixed ring, swivel top and bottom fixedly connected with slider. According to the utility model, the cleaning block is arranged and drives the swivel to rotate by starting the motor, the fixed ring on the swivel drives the cleaning block to rotate so as to clean the outer surface of the inserted rod, the movable block is pushed downwards, the scraping plate can scrape and clean soil on the inserted rod for the first time, the cleaning block is cleaned for the second time, the cleaning effect is improved, and the influence of the detector on detection results when detecting other soil is avoided.

title_en: Multi-level screening device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-level screening device which comprises a screening box, a connecting frame and screening grooves, wherein the tops of the connecting frame are symmetrically provided with sliding grooves, limiting devices are respectively and slidably arranged in the two sliding grooves, the tops of the two limiting devices are fixedly provided with surplus material grooves, the limiting devices comprise a first connecting block, springs and a second connecting block, the first connecting block is provided with a mounting groove, a plurality of springs are fixedly arranged in the mounting groove, the other end of each spring, which is far away from the mounting groove, is fixedly provided with the second connecting block, the inner wall of the screening box is uniformly distributed with a plurality of partition plates, the plurality of partition plates are respectively provided with a plurality of hole grooves, and the bottoms of the screening grooves are fixedly provided with a plurality of mounting blocks.

title_en: Grinding equipment for biomass fuel processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses grinding equipment for processing biomass fuel, wherein a grinding disc is arranged at the side end of a transmission rod, a grinding column is clamped at the bottom end of the transmission rod, a blanking pushing disc is arranged at the bottom end of a plurality of blanking electric pushing rods, a fixed clamping plate is arranged at one end of a reset spring, raw materials cut into sections are placed at the position of a blanking hole, the reset spring drives the fixed clamping plate to clamp and limit the raw materials, the blanking pushing disc is driven by the blanking electric pushing disc to push the raw materials to press down, so that the raw materials can be fixedly limited during grinding, the effect and the speed of grinding and crushing are prevented from being influenced by the back and forth swing of the raw materials, the transmission motor drives the transmission rod, the grinding disc and the grinding column to grind and crush the raw materials, and particles are dispersed through the centrifugal force of the grinding disc, so that the raw materials can be uniformly operated during retreatment, the speed and the treatment effect of single blanking are prevented, the crushing sufficiency is ensured, and the raw materials can be effectively treated.

title_en: Coal injection device for cement calcination
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cement production, in particular to a coal injection device for cement calcination, which comprises a connecting channel, gears and a conveying pipe, wherein the gears are symmetrically arranged on one side of the connecting channel, an S-bend is arranged on the other side of the connecting channel, and the conveying pipe is arranged on one side of the S-bend. The utility model has the functions of refining materials and physical pressurization, solves the problems of lack of refining materials and physical pressurization in the existing cement calcination spraying device, causes lack of pressure in material throwing, and influences the spraying effect of a spray head.

title_en: Sorting system for EtherCAT bus control balance wheels
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of logistics equipment, and discloses a sorting system of an EtherCAT bus control balance wheel, wherein a processing device is arranged on a sorting device and is connected with the sorting device through the EtherCAT bus; the processing device comprises: the system comprises a sensor module, a detection module, an alarm module, a positioning module, a communication module and a control module; the sensor module is connected with the detection module, and the detection module receives detection signals of the sensor module; the detection module is connected with the alarm module, and the alarm module receives an alarm signal generated by the detection module according to the detection signal; the communication module is connected with the alarm module, the communication module transmits alarm information according to the alarm signal; the detection module is also connected with the positioning module, and the positioning module generates a positioning signal according to the detection signal; the control module is connected with the positioning module and controls the sorting device to sort according to the positioning signal. The instant messaging and instant response effect of the sorting system is achieved.

title_en: Universal joint processing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of universal joint production and processing, and discloses universal joint processing equipment, which comprises an acid washing box, wherein a supporting leg is arranged at the bottom of the acid washing box, and a drain valve is arranged at the bottom of the acid washing box; the washing assembly is installed near the opening position on the inner wall of the pickling tank and comprises an electric push rod and a pickling frame, and the transmission output end of the electric push rod is connected with a rubber seat. The cleaning component of pickling tank inner wall includes electric putter and pickling frame, places the universal joint inside the pickling frame, drives the pickling frame through electric putter and descends to pickling liquid level below position, and after the pickling was accomplished, electric putter drove the pickling frame and risen to the liquid level top, starts vibrating motor through external control equipment, under the auxiliary effect of rubber seat, the pickling frame takes place to vibrate, and the residual liquid on universal joint surface accelerates to drop, reduces pickling liquid's residue, conveniently gets the material, reduces pickling liquid's waste, keeps operational environment's clean and tidy.

title_en: Multistage screening device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of screening devices, in particular to a multi-stage screening device which comprises a box body, wherein one side of the box body is provided with a chute a and a chute b, and the inclination angle of the chute a and the chute b is the same as that of a screening structure a and a screening structure b; the screening structure a and the screening structure b are obliquely arranged in the box body; the connecting frame is positioned at the outer side of the box body; the two groups of cleaning plates are arranged on the connecting frame; the hairbrush is embedded into the mounting groove and is contacted with the screening structure a and the screening structure b; the motor is arranged on the motor frame, and an output shaft of the motor is connected with the threaded rod. According to the polishing powder screening device, the cleaning plates and the hairbrushes are arranged above the screening structure a and the screening structure b, the hairbrushes are driven by the power assembly to contact the screening structure a and the screening structure b to move back and forth, screening of polishing powder is accelerated, and meanwhile the polishing powder can be prevented from being blocked in the screening structure a and the screening structure b.

title_en: Air drying device is used in chicken goods processing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an air drying device for chicken product processing, which comprises a box body, wherein a rotating device, a collecting device and an air blowing device are arranged on the box body, the rotating device comprises a motor, a rotating shaft, a rotating frame and a hook, the motor is arranged at the top of the box body, an output shaft of the motor penetrates through the box body and is connected with the top of the rotating shaft, two ends of the rotating shaft are both rotationally connected with the box body, a plurality of rotating frames are fixedly sleeved outside the rotating shaft, a plurality of hooks are arranged and are respectively arranged on the lower surfaces of the rotating frames, and the collecting device comprises a first water receiving disc, a second water receiving disc, a third water receiving disc and a fourth water receiving disc.

title_en: Assembly line for circuit board processing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a circuit board processing assembly line, which comprises an assembly line body, wherein a box body is arranged on the assembly line body, an inlet and an outlet are formed in two side walls of the box body, a baking mechanism I is arranged in the box body above the assembly line body, a baking mechanism II is arranged in the box body below the assembly line body, and the baking mechanism I and the baking mechanism II have the same structure. According to the utility model, the upper end face and the lower end face of the product on the production line are simultaneously heated and dried by hot air flow generated by the baking mechanism I and the baking mechanism II, so that the drying efficiency and the drying effect of the product are improved, and meanwhile, the space in the box body is changed, so that the interior of the box body can be quickly heated or heat loss is prevented, and the product can be dried conveniently.

title_en: Catalyst mixing device for ammonia-doped three-dimensional carbon nanotube preparation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of stirring equipment and discloses a catalyst mixing device for preparing an ammonia-doped three-dimensional carbon nanotube, which comprises a shell and an assembly cover, wherein a lifting mechanism is arranged on the inner bottom surface of the shell and the inner part of the assembly cover in a penetrating manner, driving rods are movably assembled on the periphery of the lifting mechanism through lifting grooves, stirring blades are arranged on the periphery of the two groups of driving rods, a driving disc is arranged on the top of the lifting mechanism above, a driving shaft is movably assembled in the lifting mechanism above and the driving disc above through the packaging grooves, and a first motor in driving connection with the driving shaft is arranged on the top of the driving disc.

title_en: Environment-friendly rice processing is with edulcoration device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of screening, in particular to an environment-friendly impurity removing device for rice processing, which comprises a bracket and a filtering component; the filter assembly comprises a first filter screen, a second filter screen, a shell, a feed hopper, a collecting box, a vibrating mechanism and a guide plate; when using, start vibration mechanism, drive first filter screen and second filter screen and begin to make a round trip to slide, pour into rice from the feeder hopper, when first filter screen, dust and small granule impurity fall into the collection box, the rice flows to the second filter screen along the baffle, the rice passes the second filter screen and falls down, big granule impurity is intercepted, fall down from the opposite side along the second filter screen, filter respectively small granule impurity, dust and big granule impurity through first filter screen and second filter screen, thereby solve the not good enough problem of current edulcoration device edulcoration effect.

title_en: Organic D-selenoglycose biological regulator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an organic D-selenoprotein phosphate polysaccharide biological regulator, which comprises a regulating tank, wherein a screw rod is arranged in the regulating tank, a connecting sleeve is arranged on the outer side wall of the screw rod, a guide wheel is arranged on the front surface of the connecting sleeve and movably connected in a guide rail, and the guide rail is arranged on the inner side wall of the regulating tank.

title_en: Novel minced steak meat cutting machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel meat mincing and cutting machine, which comprises a machine body, a meat mincing and cutting mechanism and a motor, wherein the meat mincing and cutting mechanism is arranged in the machine body, the meat mincing and cutting mechanism comprises a meat mincing component and a meat cutting component, the meat mincing component is arranged right below a meat mincing inlet, the meat cutting component is arranged right below the meat mincing inlet, a meat mincing outlet is communicated with the meat mincing component, the novel meat mincing and cutting machine further comprises an elastic mechanism, a driving wheel is further arranged in the machine body and is in transmission connection with the motor through a belt, the driving wheel transmits power to the meat mincing component and the meat mincing component, the bottom of the machine body is provided with a mounting plate for mounting the motor, one side edge of the mounting plate is hinged with the machine body, and the opposite hinged side edge of the mounting plate and the machine body is connected with the machine body through the elastic mechanism. The belt tightening mechanism can continuously ensure that the belt is in a tightening state, ensure effective transmission of power and avoid the situation of slipping between the belt wheel and the belt.

title_en: High-practicability neodymium iron boron graphite magazine drying box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-practicability neodymium iron boron graphite material box drying box which comprises a shell, wherein one side of a first block body is fixedly connected with the inner side of the shell, a sliding block is movably connected with the inner side of the first block body, a square shell is fixedly connected with one side of the sliding block, a limiting block is movably connected with a groove at the bottom of the square shell, a bending plate is fixedly connected with the bottom of the limiting block, a heating plate is arranged above the bending plate, and a screen plate is arranged below the square shell. The utility model relates to the technical field of drying equipment for neodymium iron boron graphite material boxes, and by matching a square shell, a first block body and a heating plate, a screen plate can avoid water accumulation in the square shell, ensure uniform heating of each material box, realize rapid drying of the material boxes, and solve the problems that the existing device is single in air outlet position, so that the internal graphite material boxes are heated unevenly, and the drying time is prolonged.

title_en: Rainwater collection structure for water-saving irrigation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a rainwater collection structure for water-saving irrigation, which comprises a water-saving irrigation tank and a collection bucket, wherein a cleaning mechanism is arranged on the outer surface of the collection bucket, the cleaning mechanism comprises a mounting frame, the mounting frame is fixedly arranged on the outer surface of the collection bucket, a screw rod with one end penetrating through and extending to the outer part is rotatably arranged on the right side wall of an inner cavity of the mounting frame, and a mounting plate is connected with the outer surface of the screw rod in a threaded manner. This water-saving irrigation's rainwater collection structure through being provided with clearance mechanism, has realized utilizing lifting unit control clearance board and the top contact of filter screen, then utilizes the motor as the actuating source and through mechanical transmission control lead screw rotation for lead screw surface threaded connection's mounting panel drives clearance board and moves to the right side, and then makes the clearance board that removes clear up the debris on filter screen surface, has realized the purpose of automatic clearance filter screen, and then has ensured the efficiency of collecting the nature rainwater of fighting.

title_en: Table tennis bat capable of holding table tennis
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of sports goods, and discloses a table tennis bat capable of containing table tennis, which comprises an equipment box body, wherein a bat is inserted into one side of the equipment box body, and a bolt A, a bat handle, a telescopic box and a cleaning wheel are penetrated through threads on one side of the bat. The utility model has reasonable structure, can conveniently collect the table tennis balls and also can rapidly take out the table tennis balls through the racket handle, the spring and the positioning shaft, avoids the problem that the table tennis balls cannot be taken out at the innermost part of the racket handle, can conveniently cover and press down the table tennis balls, avoids the problem that the table tennis balls leak out due to severe shaking, increases the use ratio of the table tennis racket and the rate of losing table tennis balls, and facilitates the automatic sensing of the problem that the table tennis racket is put into the box body of the equipment and cleaned through the sliding block, the inductor and the cleaning wheel, and also facilitates the more comprehensive cleaning of the table tennis racket, and avoids the problem that the table tennis racket cannot be cleaned due to different positions when being cleaned.

title_en: Asphalt processing drying equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses asphalt processing and drying equipment which comprises a movable seat, wherein the bottom of the movable seat is rotationally connected with a mounting plate, the top of the movable seat is fixedly connected with an adapting plate, the top of the mounting plate is provided with a lifting plate, and the inner surface of the adapting plate is fixedly connected with a feeding pipe. According to the utility model, the feeding pipe is fed through the feeding component, so that asphalt enters the drying cylinder, and then the drying cylinder is driven to rotate through the rotating component, so that the asphalt is rotationally dried, the asphalt drying efficiency is improved, the asphalt is prevented from being attached to the inside of the drying cylinder through the cleaning component, the lifting plate is driven to move downwards through the screw rod, the installation shaft is driven to move downwards, the drying cylinder is driven to rotate, and the dried asphalt is convenient to discharge.

title_en: Flash evaporator for water supplementing
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of feed processing equipment, and particularly relates to a flash evaporator for water supplementing. The utility model provides a flash evaporator for water supplementing, which comprises a conditioner, a steam box, a water tank and a filter box, wherein a feed inlet is formed in one side above the conditioner, a discharge outlet is formed in the bottom of the conditioner, a plurality of obliquely arranged guide plates are arranged below the feed inlet in a staggered manner in the conditioner, a plurality of through holes are formed in the guide plates, a filter plate is arranged at the bottom of the conditioner, the discharge outlet is communicated with the bottom of the filter plate, one side of the bottom of the conditioner is communicated with the filter box through a first water guide pipe, one side of the filter box is communicated with the water tank through a second water guide pipe, one side of the water tank is communicated with the steam box through a third water guide pipe, one side of the steam box is communicated with the interior of the conditioner through a first air guide pipe, the steam box is connected with an air suction pump through a second air guide pipe, and the seal cover is communicated with the interior of the steam box through the third air guide pipe.

title_en: Feeding mechanism for stirring reaction kettle
abstract_en: The utility model provides a feeding mechanism for a stirring reaction kettle, belongs to the field of reaction kettle operation, and solves the technical problems that the reaction efficiency is affected when the conventional device directly adds auxiliary materials at room temperature into the reaction kettle. This feeding mechanism for stirred tank reactor, including reation kettle, reation kettle upside intercommunication has main feed inlet and vice feed inlet, is provided with coupling assembling on the vice feed inlet, is connected with at least one first conveying pipe on the coupling assembling, and first conveying pipe other end is connected with the valve, and the valve other end intercommunication has the storage box, fixedly connected with baffle in the storage box, and the baffle separates storage box into installation cavity and storage cavity, is provided with heating device in the installation cavity, and storage box upside intercommunication has the storage inlet. The utility model has the advantages of preheating the reaction raw materials during the preparation period, shortening the subsequent reaction time and improving the reaction efficiency.

title_en: Protection casing with heat dissipation function for data processing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a protection casing for data processing equipment with a heat dissipation function, which comprises a protection casing body, wherein two supporting frames are symmetrically arranged on two sides of a base, a heat dissipation fan is arranged on the inner side of the casing, two rotating plates are symmetrically arranged on the inner side of the protection casing body, four dust collection cylinders are uniformly and fixedly connected to one side of each rotating plate, and a first motor is arranged on the other side of each rotating plate. Through the structure, four dust absorption barrels of even fixedly connected with in rotor plate one side, a plurality of dust absorption points of even fixedly connected with of dust absorption barrel outer wall, dust absorption barrel opposite side fixedly connected with absorbs a section of thick bamboo, absorbs a section of thick bamboo inboard and is provided with the absorption fan for it can rotate the inside dust of absorbing device, and locking bolt one side is provided with the screw hole, and the screw hole sets up in the base both sides, four support columns of even fixedly connected with of base lower extreme and supporting shoe, can be with the universal wheel dismouting, makes the device be convenient for remove and support.

title_en: Profiling temperature control decontamination device for large-sized motor rotor
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of motor cleaning, in particular to a profiling temperature control decontamination device for a large-sized motor rotor, which comprises a decontamination cylinder, wherein the bottom end of the decontamination cylinder is coaxially and fixedly provided with a limit cylinder, the top end of the limit cylinder is communicated with the inside of the decontamination cylinder, the inner wall of the decontamination cylinder is coaxially provided with a supporting baffle plate, the lower side of the decontamination cylinder is provided with a decontamination module, and the decontamination module is positioned between the bottom end of the inner wall of the decontamination cylinder and the supporting baffle plate; the profiling temperature control decontamination device for the large motor rotor can support the motor rotor in a profiling way, soak, heat and decontaminate the motor rotor, reduce the liquid amount used for soaking the rotor, simultaneously control the liquid temperature in real time, effectively slow down the heat loss speed, avoid overlarge energy consumption caused by cyclic reheating in the decontamination process, and further save the economic cost.

title_en: Automatic batching canning device for water-based paint
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic water-based paint batching and canning device which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a sub-packaging structure is fixedly connected to the center of the top of the bottom plate, support columns are respectively arranged on two sides of the rear part of the sub-packaging structure, stirring structures are arranged at the tops of the two support columns, a transmission belt matched with sub-packaging is arranged on one side of the sub-packaging structure, a discharge hole is arranged at the bottom of the stirring structure, a discharge hopper is arranged at the bottom of the discharge hole, and an infrared sensor is fixedly connected to one side of the bottom end of the discharge hopper. According to the utility model, the stirring shell is transversely arranged, the stirred coating is discharged and split-packed through the discharge hole by matching the stirring rod and the filter screen, and the stirring of the coating which is not stirred is continued in the stirring shell, so that the stirring uniformity of the coating is ensured, the quality of the coating is greatly improved, and the efficiency of production line production is greatly improved by matching the intermittent motion of the split-packed structure and the infrared sensor without manual monitoring.

title_en: Photovoltaic type underground well drinking water heating system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a photovoltaic type underground water well drinking and heating system, which relates to the technical field of water pipeline systems, and particularly relates to a photovoltaic type underground water well drinking and heating system. This photovoltaic formula groundwater well drinks water heating system, through filter screen cylinder, the fixed block, the round bar, the turbine, the disc, the cooperation piece, reset spring, branch, striking piece and baffle's setting, make this photovoltaic formula groundwater well drinks water heating system possess and have avoided the effect of impurity by the water pump extraction when extracting groundwater, play filterable effect through the filter screen cylinder, and when extracting groundwater, drive the turbine through the impact force of rivers and rotate, play the effect of vibrating the sieve through the striking piece, avoid the filter screen cylinder to be stopped up, conveniently extract groundwater, the purpose of improving the practicality has been reached.

title_en: Industrial wastewater sediment classification treatment device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an industrial wastewater sediment classifying and treating device which comprises a feed hopper, a treatment box body and a transmission belt, wherein the feed hopper is arranged at one end of the transmission belt, the transmission belt penetrates through the treatment box body, a draining roller is arranged on the transmission belt, the draining roller is positioned at the bottom of the feed hopper, a drying assembly is arranged in the treatment box body, a vibrator for loosening wastewater sediment is arranged in the treatment box body, the vibrator is positioned between the draining roller and the drying assembly, a compaction roller for compacting the dried sediment is arranged on the transmission belt, and a dividing roller for dividing the compacted sediment is arranged on the transmission belt; from this, this application is through carrying out roll-in waterlogging caused by excessive rainfall to the precipitate, and the precipitate through the electromagnetic shaker will drain the moisture is loose, conveniently dries, and the precipitate after the stoving carries out the roll-in compaction again, cuts apart, lightens the volume and the weight of precipitate, makes things convenient for the precipitate to store and transport.

title_en: System for prolonging service life of concentration membrane
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a system for prolonging the service life of a concentration membrane, which comprises a raw material tank, a concentrate tank and at least two circulating membrane groups, wherein the concentration membrane is respectively arranged in each circulating membrane group and is used for concentrating low-concentration feed liquid flowing through the circulating membrane groups to obtain high-concentration concentrate, a proportional regulating valve is arranged on a return pipeline, a first pneumatic regulating valve is arranged on the return pipeline between a return port of the raw material tank and the proportional regulating valve, a second pneumatic regulating valve is arranged on the concentrate pipeline, and a refraction on-line detector is arranged on a discharge pipeline. The refraction on-line detector is respectively interlocked with control signals of the first pneumatic regulating valve and the second pneumatic regulating valve, and respectively controls the opening degrees of the first pneumatic regulating valve and the second pneumatic regulating valve. The utility model stabilizes the feeding concentration by means of linkage between the feeding concentration and the discharging direction, reduces the osmotic pressure of the concentration membrane, prolongs the service life of the concentration membrane and reduces the production cost.

title_en: Raw material crushing device for processing probiotics
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a raw material crushing device for processing probiotics, and particularly relates to the field of processing of the probiotics, comprising a base, wherein an electric guide rail is fixedly connected to the top of the base, a transfer box is slidably connected to the inner wall of the electric guide rail through a sliding chute, a support frame is fixedly connected to the top of the electric guide rail, a gear motor is fixedly connected to the outer side wall of the support frame, a connecting shaft is fixedly connected to an output shaft of the gear motor through a shaft coupling, a crushing cylinder assembly for crushing the raw materials of the probiotics is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the connecting shaft, and a cylinder body fixed on the outer wall of the connecting shaft is arranged in the crushing cylinder assembly. According to the utility model, the probiotic powder in the unloading process is conveniently collected below through the transfer box, and the electric guide rail drives the transfer box to slide and transfer after the probiotic powder is collected, so that the bottom can be continuously stored, repeated processing is convenient, and the working time of manual transportation is shortened.

title_en: Cleaning mechanism for beverage bottle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of plastic bottle cleaning, in particular to a cleaning mechanism for beverage bottles. Including backup pad, spacing subassembly, washing subassembly, the backup pad is connected with the roof through electric hydraulic push rod, there is motor one in the roof, motor one's output shaft has the rotary disk, spacing subassembly includes motor two and gag lever post, motor two's output shaft has two-way screw rod, the both ends of two-way screw rod all overlap and are equipped with the removal frame, it is fixed with beverage bottle spacing mould to remove frame one side, electric hydraulic push rod one side has the otter board, there is the fixed plate in the otter board, washing subassembly includes wash pipe and close button, wash the intraductal shower nozzle that is equipped with of interpolation, wash the pipe box and be equipped with sleeve board one and sleeve board two, through a plurality of spring coupling between sleeve board two and the fixed plate, this utility model provides one kind and can take up an area little, and the bottleneck washs thoroughly a wiper mechanism for beverage bottle downwards.

title_en: Detection device for pesticide residue of medicinal materials
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of pesticide residue detection, in particular to a detection device for pesticide residue of medicinal materials, which comprises a detection box body; a detection port is formed in the detection box body, and a scale suction pipe is arranged on the surface of the detection box body; the crowded board can extrude the spring and produce elasticity when stirring the cup and put, press from both sides stirring cup tightly, prevent rocking when stirring, also can carry out the adaptation to the stirring cup of different diameters simultaneously, improve the practicality of equipment, then continue to install stirring cup, with the base card at the motor output shaft, it rotates to drive the bull stick through the motor output shaft rotation, the bull stick rotates and whips the rod through centrifugal force when, make the rod mix the medicinal material in the stirring cup with detecting the liquid medicine, hinged's stirring rod can be after the stirring is accomplished, withdraw under the action of gravity, conveniently use the scale straw to draw the extract, inhale the test tube with the extract through the scale straw at last, carry out pesticide residue detection through detecting the mouth.

title_en: Water quality circulating filter device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a water quality circulating filter device, which comprises a centrifugal component, a filter component, a mounting cylinder and a support plate, wherein the centrifugal component is arranged in the mounting cylinder; the filtering component and the centrifugal component are used for realizing the filtering effect. The utility model has the advantages that firstly, the water quality is introduced into the filter assembly for the first stage of filtration, larger solid particles suspended in the water quality are filtered, then the water quality is filtered for the second time by the high-speed rotation of the centrifugal assembly through the centrifugal assembly, the water quality is thrown out into the installation cylinder under the action of the centrifugal force and finally discharged, the multistage filtration is realized, and the work load of the centrifugal assembly is lightened. The working efficiency is improved, and the brush cleans the inner wall of the centrifugal cylinder when the centrifugal cylinder rotates, so that the permeability of the net surface is maintained, and the filtering efficiency of water is improved.

title_en: Stirring device for paint
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of stirring devices, and discloses a stirring device for paint. This kind of a agitating unit for coating sets up two grip blocks that can be close to each other through the upper surface at stirring base, can carry out the centre gripping to the lower extreme of agitator when two grip blocks are close to each other and then make the agitator when its inside coating is stirred can stop on the activity rack, avoid it to produce when stirring its inside coating of stirring main part and empty, and the protective component who sets up on the grip block can seal its up end when the agitator stirs, avoid outside dust to get into inside the agitator, also can avoid the inside coating spill agitator of agitator outside.

title_en: Separation device for waste oil and water
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a waste oil-water separation device, which relates to the technical field of waste oil-water separation and recovery and comprises a filtering device, wherein the filtering device comprises a workbench, the workbench is rotationally connected with a chassis, a first motor is arranged in the workbench, a rotating shaft of the first motor is fixedly connected with the chassis, an arc-shaped container is fixedly connected onto the chassis, a plurality of layers of frames are slidably connected onto the arc-shaped plate, a filter screen is arranged in each frame, a first feeding hole is arranged at the top of the arc-shaped container, an opening is arranged at one side of the arc-shaped container, a first discharging hole is fixedly connected to the bottom of the surface of the other side of the arc-shaped container, a valve is arranged at the first discharging hole, a second feeding hole is sleeved on the first discharging hole, a centrifugal device is fixedly connected to the second feeding hole, the filtering treatment of waste oil-water is accelerated, the time before waste oil-water separation is shortened, and the waste oil-water separation efficiency is improved.

title_en: Low-power-consumption energy-saving magnetic separator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a low-power-consumption energy-saving magnetic separator which comprises a magnetic separator main body, wherein supporting legs are arranged on the left side and the right side of the bottom end of the magnetic separator main body, a base is arranged on the left side of the magnetic separator main body, a fixing rod is fixedly connected between the base and the magnetic separator main body, a base is arranged at the top end of the base, through holes are formed in the outer wall of the base from left to right, heat dissipation holes are formed in the outer wall of the base, a heat dissipation fan is assembled in an inner cavity of the base, and a motor is connected with the top end of the base through screws. This energy-saving magnet separator of low-power consumption not only can carry out the heat dissipation to the motor and handle, avoids the high influence equipment operation of temperature, reduces the load volume, reduces the consumption, moreover, can also cooperate the impurity scale on the pivoted barrel automatic outer wall to clear up, guarantees the work efficiency and the energy efficiency of equipment, and easy operation is convenient, and degree of automation is high, uses in a flexible way, and the practicality is strong, satisfies the user demand on the current market.

title_en: Winnowing rice husk edulcoration device for grain processing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of grain processing, and discloses a winnowing rice hull impurity removing device for grain processing, which comprises a case, wherein a feeding pipe is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the case, a rice grain box is fixedly connected to the bottom end of the left side surface of the case, a rice hull box is fixedly connected to the bottom end of the right side surface of the case, an outer support is fixedly connected to the upper end of the left side of the case, a fan is fixedly connected to the top end of the outer support, an air supply pipe is fixedly connected to the output end of the fan, a triangular inclined table is fixedly connected to the inner bottom surface of the case, a left inclined plane is arranged on the left side of the upper surface of the triangular inclined table, and a right inclined plane is arranged on the right side of the upper surface of the triangular inclined table. This selection by winnowing rice husk edulcoration device for grain processing can pour the corn into quick-witted case through the inlet pipe to can blow the selection by winnowing to pounding the drum through the blast pipe, and can disperse it at corn movable valve in-process, so that more even more thorough selection by winnowing with the corn.

title_en: Belt cleaning device convenient to impurity separation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a cleaning device convenient for impurity separation, which comprises a box body, wherein a feed hopper is fixedly arranged at the top of the box body, a movable door is movably arranged on the front surface of the box body, a cleaning mechanism is arranged in the box body, a stirring mechanism is arranged in the box body, a solid plate is fixedly arranged in the box body, a filter plate is fixedly arranged in the box body, and a collecting frame is arranged on the inner bottom wall of the box body. This belt cleaning device convenient to impurity separation, through setting up the feeder hopper, cooperation between wiper mechanism and the rabbling mechanism when clearing up the donkey-hide gelatin raw materials, can be with in the donkey-hide gelatin raw materials from the feeder hopper when carrying the box, start rotating electrical machines and water pump simultaneously, the start of rotating electrical machines can drive bull stick and puddler rotation, and the water pump can take out the inside water of water tank, spouts through high-pressure nozzle, realizes the purpose of flushing the limit stirring to the donkey-hide gelatin raw materials.

title_en: Auto-parts belt cleaning device that can automatic stoving
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an auto part cleaning device capable of automatically drying, which comprises a cleaning box and a base, wherein the base is fixedly arranged on the bottom surface of the cleaning box; the sealing door is arranged on the front side surface of the cleaning box; the liquid inlet pipe is fixedly communicated with the upper end of the left side wall of the cleaning box; the drain pipe is fixedly communicated with the lower end of the left side wall of the cleaning box; the rotating mechanism is arranged on the inner bottom surface of the base; the stirring mechanism is connected with the rotating mechanism; and the drying mechanism is connected with the stirring mechanism. This auto-parts belt cleaning device that can automatic drying can be convenient for through brushing the washing to auto-parts, improves the cleaning performance to auto-parts to improve cleaning efficiency, can wash the back to auto-parts automatic drying simultaneously, improve auto-parts and wash the work efficiency of stoving, easy and simple to handle nimble, the practicality is strong.

title_en: Magnetic reaction kettle for producing flame retardant
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of magnetic reaction kettles, and discloses a magnetic reaction kettle for producing a flame retardant, which comprises supporting legs, wherein kettle bodies are arranged on the supporting legs, a feeding pipe is arranged at the top of each kettle body, a discharging pipe is arranged at the bottom of each kettle body, a first motor is fixedly arranged at the top of each kettle body, a rotating shaft of the first motor penetrates through the top of each kettle body, extends into the kettle body and is fixedly provided with a rotating rod through a coupler, and a stirring part is arranged on each rotating rod; the landing leg is last fixed mounting has the bottom plate, and fixed mounting has the pneumatic cylinder on the bottom plate, and fixed mounting has the mounting panel on the flexible end of pneumatic cylinder, installs the defeated material part that is used for carrying the fire retardant on the mounting panel. The stirring part can solve the problem that the flame retardant at the inner bottom of the kettle body cannot be sufficiently stirred, the quality of the flame retardant is improved, the flame retardant is effectively prevented from being blocked when discharged through the material conveying part, and the discharging efficiency is improved.

title_en: Grinder is used in medicine processing
