abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of medicine grinding, and discloses a grinding device for medicine processing, which comprises a supporting table, wherein a grinding barrel is arranged on the upper surface of the supporting table, a rotating assembly is rotationally connected to the periphery of the outer wall of the grinding barrel, supporting rods are fixedly connected to the periphery of the bottom end of the rotating assembly, a filter screen is arranged at the bottom end of the grinding barrel, portal frames are fixedly arranged on two sides of the upper surface of the supporting table, an air cylinder is fixedly arranged in the middle of the top end of each portal frame, and an extension rod is movably connected to the bottom end of each air cylinder. Through setting up of locating sleeve, spacing collar, slide motor and adapter sleeve, fixed mutually with the grinding barrel through the adapter sleeve, utilize slide motor to drive adapter sleeve and grinding barrel and rotate in the spacing collar, make the inside powder of its grinding barrel mix more evenly, can avoid slide motor to drop when rotatory through the spacing collar, can prevent to bond and gather together when the quantity that the medicine was ground is great, mix more evenly to improve the efficiency that the medicine was ground.

title_en: Carbonization kettle drainage device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of carbonization kettles, in particular to a drainage device of a carbonization kettle, which comprises a drainage mechanism for draining water of the carbonization kettle, wherein the middle part of the outer end of the drainage mechanism is movably arranged on a filtering mechanism; the filtering mechanism comprises a drain pipe, connectors are fixedly arranged at the upper end and the lower end of the drain pipe, a control valve is fixedly arranged in the middle of the upper end of the drain pipe, a filtering pipe is arranged at the lower end of the drain pipe in a threaded manner, and a filter screen is fixedly arranged below the inner end of the filtering pipe; through setting up the inner of filter tube into the funnel-shaped structure, the filter screen is installed to its inside below, and the funnel is great from top to bottom, and is less in the centre, consequently in the drainage, can filter rivers to avoid rubbish after the filtration can return to the inner wall of drain tank because of the impact of rivers, drain pipe and filter tube are threaded connection simultaneously, both be swing joint, have also increased the convenience to filter tube maintenance.

title_en: Concrete mixer
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of concrete stirring, and discloses a concrete stirrer, which comprises: a stirring tank; the top end of the stirring box is provided with a feed inlet, and a partition plate is arranged in the stirring box; the water pumping mechanism is arranged at the rear end of the stirring box; the stirring mechanism is arranged in the stirring box and comprises a first motor. According to the utility model, the stirring paddles are driven to rotate by the rotating shaft at the right end, the driving wheel II rotates along with the rotation of the rotating shaft at the right end, then the driving wheel II rotates by the driving belt, the driving belt drives the rotating shafts at the first driving wheel and the left end and the stirring paddles to rotate, and then the two stirring paddles stir raw materials in the stirring box, so that the raw materials are changed into concrete, and finally, the concrete raw materials are divided into two parts and then stirred, so that the stirring of the two stirring paddles is more uniform, and the working efficiency is further improved.

title_en: Drying device is used in rubber tyre production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a drying device for rubber tire production, which relates to the technical field of tire production and comprises a drying box, wherein a conveyor belt is fixedly arranged on the bottom surface of the drying box. According to the utility model, the motor I, the bidirectional threaded rod, the bevel gear I and the bevel gear II are matched, the clamping device I and the clamping device II move in opposite directions until the tire is clamped, the phenomenon that a large amount of time is required to be consumed for adjusting the clamp when the clamp of the traditional device faces tires of different sizes is avoided, the clamping efficiency of the clamp is improved, the telescopic arm, the clamping rotating device and the clamp are matched, the telescopic arm is used for lifting the tire after the clamps on two sides of the tire clamp the tire, the motor III drives the bevel gear III to rotate through the rotating shaft III, the connecting arm is rotated through the bevel gear IV, the tire rotates in the drying process, the wind is more uniform, and the air drying efficiency is improved.

title_en: Mine is with automatically cleaning security protection information camera
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of mine security and protection, and discloses a self-cleaning security and protection information camera for a mine, which comprises a camera body, wherein a cleaning box is fixed on the outer wall of the camera body, two driving motors are fixed on the top surface of the cleaning box, one end of a driving shaft of each driving motor penetrates through the top surface of the cleaning box and extends into the cleaning box, a winding roller is fixed on one end of the driving shaft of each driving motor, a film is wound on the outer wall of one winding roller, and one end of the film is fixed with the outer wall of the other winding roller. According to the utility model, the movable film is adopted to cover the observation port, so that dust can be prevented from polluting the camera body lens under the condition of not affecting the normal monitoring of the camera body, and when the film is cleaned, the polluted film of the observation port is directly replaced, and the brush is adopted to clean the polluted film, so that the camera body is not shielded while self-cleaning is finished, and the monitoring effect of the camera body is ensured.

title_en: Resin product washing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses resin product washing equipment, wherein a round table type washing tank is arranged below a washing tank, and the washing tank is communicated with the washing tank; a grid plate is arranged at one side in the upper end of the washing tank, a plurality of friction plates are arranged above the washing tank and higher than the grid plate, a driving rod is arranged between the friction plates, a movable through hole capable of accommodating the driving rod is arranged on one side surface of the washing tank, and driving equipment for driving the driving rod to move is arranged outside the washing tank; the lower part of the friction plate is abutted on the upper part of the grid plate; a spray assembly for spraying water to the friction plate is arranged on the washing tank; the bottom surface rotates in the washing case has the pivot, is equipped with the backup pad above the pivot, is equipped with the rectangle slot above the backup pad, is equipped with the basket in the washing case, is equipped with the rectangle inserted block that can insert the rectangle slot below the basket, and the pivot extends to be equipped with driving motor below the washing case, and the bottom surface is equipped with the enhancement cleaning assembly in the basket. The advantages are that: the cleaning efficiency is improved, and the cleaned resin is easy to take out from the cleaning machine body.

title_en: Concrete pouring device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a concrete pouring device. The concrete watering device includes the storage tank, wears to establish rather than inside stirring piece, the pan feeding mouth has been seted up on the top of storage tank, the bottom intercommunication of storage tank has row material pipe, still includes: the bottom plate is clamped on the outer wall of the storage tank, universal wheels are arranged on the periphery of the bottom surface of the bottom plate, and a pushing handle is fixed on the top surface of the bottom plate; the screw thread of the rotating piece penetrates through the bottom plate; the scraping plate is rotationally connected to the bottom end of the rotating piece and is in limiting sliding connection with the bottom plate, the scraping plate is U-shaped, and the outer protruding surface faces the discharging pipe; the backflow piece is detachably connected to the top surface of the bottom plate, the material drawing end of the backflow piece is symmetrically fixed to the outer wall of the scraping plate, and the material returning end of the backflow piece is communicated to the top end of the storage tank. The utility model is beneficial to saving labor cost, improving trowelling efficiency and recycling the redundant concrete.

title_en: Building raw material stirring device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of stirring devices and discloses a building raw material stirring device which comprises a stirring barrel base, wherein an equipment box is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the stirring barrel base close to the right side, an angle adjusting power device is arranged in the equipment box, a first fixing plate is fixedly arranged on the left side of the upper surface of the stirring barrel base, a first rotating shaft is rotatably arranged on the first fixing plate close to the middle position of the top, a second rotating shaft is rotatably arranged on the equipment box corresponding to the first rotating shaft, one end of the second rotating shaft penetrates through the equipment box to extend, a stirring barrel is fixedly arranged at the opposite ends of the first rotating shaft and the second rotating shaft, the stirring barrel is inclined to enable a worker on the surface of the stirring barrel to clean, sewage in the inner wall of the stirring barrel is continuously inclined after the cleaning is finished, so that the working intensity of the worker is reduced, the waste of raw materials is prevented through the stirring device, the stirring effect is improved, and the cost of a decorator is reduced to a certain extent.

title_en: Quick temperature change damp-heat test box
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of temperature change tests, in particular to a rapid temperature change damp-heat test box which comprises a cabinet body, wherein an air plate is arranged on the upper surface of the inner wall of the cabinet body, the air plate is fixedly connected with the cabinet body, a heat dissipation fan is arranged on the lower surface of the air plate, the heat dissipation fan is fixedly connected with the air plate, a flow distribution plate is arranged below the air plate, the flow distribution plate is fixedly connected with the air plate, air inlets are arranged on the lower surface of the flow distribution plate, and temperature sensors are arranged on the lower surface and the rear surface of the interior of the cabinet body.

title_en: Screening plant is used in opencut coal mine production
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of coal mine production, and discloses a screening device for open pit coal mine production, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a supporting rod is fixedly arranged on the right side of the top of the bottom plate, a fixing ring is hinged to the top of the supporting rod, a screen barrel is connected to the inner ring of the fixing ring through a bearing, the fixing ring is also connected to the left side of the outer wall of the screen barrel through a bearing, a supporting plate is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the left fixing ring, a hydraulic rod is fixedly arranged on the left side of the top of the bottom plate, the hydraulic rod is started to extend to drive the supporting plate to jack the fixing ring on the left side of the outer side of the screen barrel, the screen barrel is further kept in an inclined state of the left side and the right side, a second motor is started to drive the screen barrel to rotate through a gear mesh toothed ring, finally, coal mine is fed into the left side of an inner cavity of the screen barrel through a coal feeding pipe, fine particles meeting requirements are leaked onto a first conveyor belt through conical sieve holes under continuous rotation of the screen barrel, coarse particles continue to move rightwards until falling onto a second conveyor belt, and screening work is completed.

title_en: High-voltage switch cabinet for plateau area
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-voltage switch cabinet for a plateau region, which comprises a cabinet body, a mounting box and a filter screen, wherein mounting sliding grooves are symmetrically formed in the inner wall of the cabinet body, mounting sliding plates are symmetrically welded on the side walls of the mounting box, the mounting sliding plates are embedded and mounted in the mounting sliding grooves, a fixed plate is fixedly mounted on the top surface of the mounting box, a servo motor is mounted on one side of the fixed plate, the output end of the servo motor is connected with a driving shaft, a driving gear is fixedly mounted at one end of the driving shaft, a hollowed mounting plate is fixedly mounted on one side of the mounting box, and a plurality of fan shafts are uniformly mounted on the hollowed mounting plate. The beneficial effects are that: according to the utility model, one servo motor can be utilized to drive a plurality of groups of ventilation fan blades to rotate, so that the air convection effect in the cabinet body is accelerated, the heat dissipation efficiency is improved, the filter screen can be simultaneously driven to vibrate, excessive dust and dust are prevented from accumulating on the filter screen, and therefore, the manufacturing cost and the power consumption in use are reduced, and the practicability is higher.

title_en: Rolling pin with cleaning function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rolling pin with a cleaning function, and relates to a rolling pin which comprises a rolling pin body and a cleaning part, wherein the rolling pin body is a conventional rolling pin in the prior market, a hollow cylindrical groove with an opening at the upper part is formed in one side surface of the rolling pin body, an internal thread is formed in the opening of the cylindrical groove, the cleaning part consists of a scraping plate and a handle, the scraping plate is of a trapezoid structure, the maximum width and the length of the scraping plate are smaller than the diameter and the height of the cylindrical groove, a handle is glued at the bottom of the scraping plate, the handle is of a cylindrical structure matched with the diameter of the rolling pin body, and an external thread is formed at the lower end of the outer side wall of the handle, so that the scraping plate can be inserted into the cylindrical groove, and the handle is screwed in the cylindrical groove. The utility model is convenient for people to take down the cleaning part to clean the flour blocks on the rolling plate, thereby meeting the use requirements of people.

title_en: Lard residue liquid impurity filtering device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lard residue liquid impurity filtering device, which comprises a filtering box, wherein an opening is formed in the filtering box, a bottom plate is arranged in the opening, the top of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a top plate through filter cloth, a absorbent cotton layer is arranged between the bottom plate and the top plate and positioned in the filter cloth, a plurality of oil filtering holes are formed in the top plate and the bottom plate, two slots are formed in the opening, clamping grooves are formed in the two slots, a sealing assembly is arranged in the opening, an extrusion assembly is arranged in the filtering box, a plurality of leakage holes are formed in the bottom of the inner wall of the filtering box, and a funnel is fixedly connected to the bottom of the filtering box. When the pig oil residue liquid is filtered, impurities in the pig oil residue liquid are filtered more finely through the absorbent cotton layer, so that the situation that holes are blocked by impurities and fine impurities pass through the holes when the filter plates with the finer holes are used is avoided.

title_en: Heavy hydrocarbon removal system of coalbed methane cold box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a heavy hydrocarbon removal system of a coal bed gas cooler bin, which belongs to the field of coal bed gas production and comprises a cold separator, wherein the cold separator is connected with an outlet end of a flow passage A2 of the cooler bin through a first pipeline; the top outlet of the cold separator is connected with the first branch flow pipe; the bottom outlet of the cold separator is connected with a second pipeline, and one end of the second pipeline, which is far away from the cold separator, is connected with a first branch and a second branch; the first branch is connected with the heavy hydrocarbon removal tower, and the second branch is connected with the condensing agent inlet end of the cold box. The utility model converts part of coal bed gas into condensing agent, and the condensing agent is conveyed to a cold box and a heavy hydrocarbon removing tower through a cold liquid pump, thereby reducing equipment investment and energy consumption, and having important significance for safe and efficient production of factories, improving economic benefit, saving resources and the like.

title_en: Fluid mixing equipment for chemical industry
abstract_en: The utility model discloses chemical fluid mixing equipment which comprises a base, wherein the top end of the base is fixedly connected with a limiting base, one side of the top end of the base is fixedly connected with a protective sleeve, and the inside of the protective sleeve is movably connected with a threaded rod. This fluid mixing equipment for chemical industry is through being provided with driven gear, protective sleeve and apron, rotate the twist grip, it drives drive gear through the connecting rod and rotates, because drive gear and driven gear mutually support and threaded rod and thread bush mutually support, so drive gear rotates and can make the threaded rod rotate, threaded rod rotates then can make the thread bush drive the apron decline, the apron descends the top of mixing box can prevent that fluid can splash the mixing box when stirring the fluid, the stirring subassembly descends the inside of mixing box and can make the fluid mix fast, it is inconvenient to make apron and stirring subassembly go up and down to solve, inconvenient clearance and the inside problem of liquid easy splash mixing box.

title_en: Gas-phase oxidation reactor convenient to add
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gas-phase oxidation reactor convenient for feeding, which comprises a reaction furnace body, wherein the top end of the reaction furnace body is provided with a reaction furnace cover, the top end of the reaction furnace cover is fixedly connected with a driving motor, the driving motor is connected with a cross-shaped stirring fan through a transmission structure, the outer wall of the reaction furnace body is fixedly connected with an air pump, the air pump is provided with an air inlet pipe through a gas-phase oxidation structure, the bottom of the reaction furnace body is provided with a discharge pipe, and the discharge pipe is connected with a spherical valve through a valve structure. When the utility model is used, reactants can be filled into the furnace body through devices such as the air inlet pipe, the air pump, the air outlet pipe, the vertical air pipe, the annular air pipe, the feeding pipe and the like, so that the reactants are subjected to oxidation reaction in the furnace body, the air inlet pipe is used for placing the air into the vertical air pipe and the annular air pipe, then the air enters the air pump from the air outlet pipe, circulation is completed, and the air can be placed into the furnace by opening the simple cover, so that the use efficiency of the reactor is improved.

title_en: Constant temperature test box with protective structure
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of constant temperature test boxes, and particularly discloses a constant temperature test box with a protection structure. This constant temperature test case with protective structure, through the choke mechanism can make wet-dressing fibreboard intermittent type nature block the vent in the use, and wet-dressing fibreboard has its certain moisture adsorption capacity, and its in the inboard round trip movement's of vent process is similar to the action of wiping, and this process can be with the moisture in the vent wiping, clear away, and the cotton pad that absorbs water can absorb the moisture of gathering in vent department to effectively reduce the accumulation of moisture and the gathering of steam, play certain dehumidification effect.

title_en: Broken collection device of discarded object
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a waste crushing and collecting device, which relates to the technical field of waste crushing and collecting, and comprises a hollow pipeline and a crushing box, wherein the hollow pipeline is fixedly connected with the crushing box, a transmission mechanism is arranged in the hollow pipeline, a first fixed block is slidingly connected in the crushing box and close to one side of the hollow pipeline, a plurality of cutting pieces are fixedly arranged at the bottom of the first fixed block, and a second fixed block is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the crushing box and positioned below the first fixed block, so that the waste crushing and collecting device has the beneficial effects that: through mutually supporting between drive mechanism, baffle, first fixed block, cutting piece, second fixed block, lead screw, slider, second motor, belt pulley and the driving belt, effectively practiced thrift manpower resources's consumption, improved work efficiency to effectively cut the different discarded object of size, thereby be convenient for carry out broken processing to it, reduced the possibility of discarded object card inside breaker.

title_en: Multistage screening machine capable of removing impurities
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of screening and discloses a multistage screening machine capable of removing impurities, which comprises a working box, wherein a driving mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the working box, a vibrating box is arranged in the working box, a first screen plate is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the vibrating box, a cleaning box is arranged on one side of the working box, a mounting frame is fixedly arranged on one side of the cleaning box, a second mounting seat is fixedly arranged at the top of one side of the mounting frame, a second sliding groove is arranged in the second mounting seat, a second sliding block is arranged in the second sliding groove in a sliding manner, a second screw rod is arranged in the second sliding groove and penetrates through the second sliding block, the second sliding block is in threaded connection with the second screw rod, a second motor is fixedly arranged at the top of one side of the mounting frame, and the output end of the second motor penetrates through the mounting frame; the utility model prevents the screen plate from being blocked, thereby influencing the subsequent screening work.

title_en: Trough cleaning structure for sheep breeding
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of sheep cultivation, and discloses a feeding groove cleaning structure for sheep cultivation, which comprises a telescopic rod, wherein a first sliding groove is formed in the telescopic rod, a sliding rod is connected to the inner wall of the telescopic rod in a sliding mode, the sliding rod is connected to the inner wall of the first sliding groove in a sliding mode, a U-shaped groove is formed in the sliding rod, a fixing pipe is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the telescopic rod, a cavity is formed in the fixing pipe, a rotating shaft is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the fixing pipe, and the rotating shaft is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the cavity. According to the utility model, the sliding rod is pulled out from the telescopic rod, the sliding block is driven to move in the first sliding groove, the sliding block moves to drive the supporting frame and the cleaning roller to move outwards, when the width is adjusted to a required width, the convex spanner on the fixed pipe is moved to rotate, the pressing block is pressed into the U-shaped groove to fix the positions of the sliding rod and the telescopic rod, and the width of the cleaning structure can be adjusted quickly according to the size of the food groove.

title_en: Automatic scraping plate structure of felt wiping machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an automatic scraping plate structure of a felt wiping machine, which comprises a lower transverse plate, wherein an upper transverse plate is arranged above the lower transverse plate, two vertical cylinders and a hydraulic telescopic rod are symmetrically and fixedly arranged between the lower transverse plate and the upper transverse plate, the two vertical cylinders are symmetrically arranged, the output end of the hydraulic telescopic rod penetrates through the upper transverse plate and is fixedly provided with an upper inserting rod, the bottom of a connecting plate is symmetrically and fixedly provided with two upper inserting rods, the two upper inserting rods are respectively inserted into the two vertical cylinders, and the bottom of each vertical cylinder is movably inserted with a lower inserting rod; according to the scheme, the lower inserted link can be pressed down under the action of the first spring, the scraping plate can wipe the upper surface of the felt, sundries and floating burrs are scraped, the hydraulic telescopic link is started to enable the hydraulic telescopic link to shrink, the first spring is pressed downwards by the upper inserted link, the lower inserted link is enabled to continue to move downwards by a certain distance, the force of the scraping plate in contact with the felt can be adjusted according to the requirement, and the felt and the scraping plate can be buffered.

title_en: Drying device is used in sodium nitrite production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of drying devices for sodium nitrite production, and discloses a drying device for sodium nitrite production, which comprises a bearing device, a material conveying device and a drying box, wherein a first fixing column and a second fixing column are fixedly arranged at one end of the bearing device, a bearing block is fixedly arranged at one end of the bearing device, which is far away from the first fixing column, the material conveying device is fixedly arranged above the first fixing column, the material conveying device comprises a pushing machine, the drying box is arranged above the bearing block, the drying box comprises a low-temperature drying box and a cooling box, and conveying plates are arranged at the bottoms of the low-temperature drying box and the cooling box. According to the utility model, the pusher is added in the material conveying device, the rolling sheet in the pusher can scatter materials and uniformly push the materials into the temperature regulating box, so that the phenomenon of caking caused by accumulation of the materials is avoided, and the materials are conveniently dried on a part of a job by adding the conveying plate at the bottom of the drying box.

title_en: Medical treatment detection reagent bottle belt cleaning device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of reagent bottle cleaning devices, and discloses a medical detection reagent bottle cleaning device which comprises a reservoir and a bracket which is lifted on the reservoir, wherein a mounting plate is fixedly connected in the reservoir, a cleaning assembly and a cleaning mechanism are arranged on the mounting plate, and a driving mechanism and a plurality of rotating shafts are rotatably connected on the bracket. According to the utility model, the reagent bottle is sleeved on the positioning cylinder and fixed through the clamping assembly, then the operation of the second electric push rod is controlled to enable the connecting rod to ascend, the sleeve frame is enabled to push the push-pull plate upwards, the contact between the telescopic brush plate and the inner wall of the reagent bottle is realized, water washes the inner wall of the reagent bottle through the spray head, meanwhile, the driving mechanism can enable the rotating shaft to drive the rotation of the reagent bottle, the reciprocating movement of the first electric push rod is started again, the reagent bottle moves up and down on the surface of the positioning cylinder, the telescopic brush plate is comprehensively used for cleaning the inner wall of the reagent bottle, and the reagent bottle is also comprehensively washed.

title_en: Environment monitoring hydrogeology testing arrangement
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of environmental monitoring and discloses an environmental monitoring hydrogeologic testing device which comprises a base, wherein the front part of the upper end and the rear part of the upper end of the base are fixedly connected with fixing mechanisms in a penetrating way, the four corners of the lower end of the base are fixedly connected with universal wheels, the middle part of the upper end of the base is fixedly connected with a filter box, the lower part of the left end of the filter box is fixedly connected with a storage box, the upper part of the front end of the filter box is fixedly connected with a controller, the right part of the upper end of the base is fixedly connected with a testing groove, and the lower parts of the right groove wall of the testing groove and the lower part of the right groove wall of the filter box are fixedly connected with drain pipes in a penetrating way. According to the environmental monitoring hydrogeology testing device, the fixing mechanism and the ground inserting mechanism are arranged, so that the device can be firmly fixed with the ground, the stability of the device is improved, and the water can be uniformly sprayed on the filter screen by arranging the filter box and the shunt pipe, so that the filtering efficiency is improved, and the device is suitable for wide use.

title_en: Air filter box and tent type biosafety laboratory
abstract_en: The utility model provides an air filtering box and a tent type biosafety laboratory, and relates to the technical field of microorganism chambers; one end of the air duct is connected with the sealing component, the sealing component is used for clamping the lining of the tent at the edge of the air duct, the other end of the air duct is detachably connected with one end of the sealing valve, and the other end of the sealing valve is connected with the filter box body; the filter box body is internally provided with a plurality of pieces of glass fiber filter paper, a plurality of V-shaped filter pleat channels which are arranged side by side are formed between any two adjacent pieces of glass fiber filter paper, the filter box body is provided with a test port and an upstream concentration sampling port, and the filter box body is also provided with a downstream concentration sampling port and an air outlet. The air filtering box provided by the utility model has the advantages of no need of frequently replacing filter paper, long service life, capability of providing safe and reliable experimental environment, convenience in installing the air duct and the like.

title_en: Glue spreader for hollow glass production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a glue spreader for hollow glass production, which belongs to the technical field of glass production and processing and aims at solving the problem that dust and impurities are easy to adhere to glass and the glue spreading quality of the glass in the prior art; according to the utility model, through the arrangement of the structures such as the driving motor, the reciprocating screw rod, the sliding block, the sliding chute and the cleaning roller, the effect of cleaning the surface of glass is realized, the attachment of dust and impurities is reduced, and meanwhile, the arrangement of the connecting shaft, the gear and the rack enables the cleaning roller to rotate and clean while moving, so that the cleaning effect of the cleaning roller is further improved, the gluing quality of the glass is further improved, and the cleaning roller is convenient to assemble, disassemble and replace through the arrangement of the limiting bolts, the clamping seats and the clamping grooves.

title_en: Waste lithium battery lithium element recycling device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to a waste lithium battery lithium element recycling device in the technical field of waste lithium battery lithium element recycling. The roasting kiln (1) is connected with the conveyor (2), the conveyor (2) is connected with the superfine powder grinding component (3), the superfine powder grinding component (3) is connected with the dissolving and pressure filtering component (4), the dissolving and pressure filtering component (4) is connected with the evaporating and crystallizing component (5), the evaporating and crystallizing component (5) is connected with the ultrafiltration component (6), the ultrafiltration component (6) is connected with the secondary pressure filtering component (8), and the secondary pressure filtering component (8) is connected with the drying component (7). The waste lithium battery lithium element recovery processing device provided by the utility model has reliable performance, and can effectively remove impurities in a solution in the lithium element recovery process, so that lithium carbonate is ensured to be remained in the solution, the content of the finally separated lithium carbonate impurities is lower than a standard required value, and the quality improvement of lithium carbonate is realized.

title_en: Ball mill with feed mechanism
abstract_en: The application relates to a ball mill with a feeding mechanism, which comprises a frame and a ball mill main body, wherein a storage box, a horizontal conveying assembly and a lifting conveying assembly are sequentially arranged on the frame along the conveying direction of raw materials, the ball mill main body is positioned at the tail end of the lifting conveying assembly, a linkage assembly is arranged between the horizontal conveying assembly and the lifting conveying assembly, a first material blocking device is arranged on the frame and comprises two material blocking plates, the upper ends of the two material blocking plates are positioned right above the horizontal conveying assembly, and a second material blocking device for blocking the raw materials on the lifting conveying assembly from falling along the width direction of the lifting conveying assembly is arranged on the frame. According to the application, the stop plate and the second stop device are blocked in the width direction of the horizontal conveying assembly and the lifting conveying assembly, so that the possibility that raw materials fall off in the conveying process is reduced, and the feeding effect of the raw materials is further affected.

title_en: Movable high-fine crusher with upper cavity and lower cavity
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a movable upper and lower cavity high-fine crusher, which comprises a movable base and a crushing mechanism; and (3) moving a base: the left side of the upper end of the movable base is provided with a power generation roller, the front end of an output shaft of the power generation roller is provided with a belt pulley II, the right side of the upper end of the movable base is provided with a mounting frame, the upper side of the inside of the mounting frame is provided with a plate feeder, the right side of the lower end of the movable base is respectively connected with a bearing walking wheel through a bearing in a rotating way, and the left side of the lower end of the movable base is respectively provided with a traction universal wheel; crushing mechanism: the crushing mechanism is arranged at the upper end of the movable base, the crushing mechanism is positioned at the right side of the power generation roller, and the crushing mechanism is positioned at the lower side of the mounting frame; wherein: still include electrical control cabinet, this high fine breaker in portable upper and lower chamber, at the in-process that carries out the breakage to the raw materials, can generate electricity through generating drum, need not power cable, it is convenient to remove the transition, and the raw materials after smashing is handled and is reached the demand, need not secondary operation, has improved work efficiency.

title_en: Smoothing and compacting device of joint cutter
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a leveling and pressing device of a joint cutter, which relates to the technical field of joint cutters and comprises the following components: the water spray device comprises a bottom plate, wherein a heating plate structure is fixedly arranged on the upper wall surface of the bottom plate, a lifting frame structure is fixedly arranged on the upper wall surface of the heating plate structure, an elastic support structure is fixedly arranged on the lower wall surface of the lifting frame structure, a smoothing roller structure is fixedly arranged on the lower wall surface of the elastic support structure, and a water spray structure is fixedly arranged on the upper wall surface of the bottom plate; the heating plate structure includes: a low temperature heating plate and two heating support columns; the two heating support columns are respectively and fixedly arranged on the upper wall surface of the bottom plate. The utility model improves the product qualification rate of the joint cutter by smoothing the raw materials of the woven bag, and can be directly matched with the existing joint cutter for use, thereby reducing the improvement cost of the joint cutter and improving the application range of the joint cutter to a certain extent.

title_en: Anti-blocking type screen
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an anti-blocking type screen, comprising: the device comprises a cover body, a conical leakage net, a storage piece and a separation net; the toper leaks the net and is installed in the lid in umbelliform to filter, screen the material, the storage piece is installed in toper leaks the net bottom, in order to supply to collect the material that rolls in filtering through the toper leaks the net, separate the net and install in toper leaks the net top, in order to isolate great material, the storage piece includes first storage and leaks a section of thick bamboo and second storage and leak a section of thick bamboo, first storage leaks a section of thick bamboo and second storage and leaks a section of thick bamboo around installing in toper leaks the net perisporium, separate the net including first fender net, second fender net and connecting plate, first fender net and second fender net are installed in connecting plate both ends respectively. This prevent blockking up formula screen cloth through the setting of storage spare and screen cloth, and the storage spare can be loaded the material of toper screen cloth landing in filtering, separates the screen cloth and can separate great material, can reduce great material and fall the storage spare and cause it to block up, has guaranteed the efficiency of toper screen cloth in filtering, conveniently collects the material.

title_en: Prevent yellow medicine throw isolated plant that material is unrestrained of material in-process dust diffusion
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a special device for preventing dust from diffusing and materials from scattering in the process of feeding xanthate, which relates to the technical field of material feeding. Therefore, firstly, the sealed feeding mechanism enables the xanthate to only enter the reaction kettle along the sealed bin in the flowing process, so that diffusion cannot occur, and pollution to the outside is avoided. And secondly, the air draft mechanism enables the xanthate diffused to the feeding end to be transferred to the feeding end, so that the xanthate is prevented from reaching the outside through the feeding end. Thirdly, the cutting mechanism omits manual cutting of the ton bag by workers, and further avoids contact between the workers and xanthate.

title_en: Centrifugal device for extracting antiviral factors for aquaculture
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a centrifugal device for extracting antiviral factors for aquaculture, which belongs to the technical field of Chinese herbal medicine extraction, and comprises a tank body, wherein a centrifugal barrel is arranged on the inner side of the tank body, a shaft sleeve penetrating through the bottom of the tank body is welded at the bottom of the centrifugal barrel, the shaft sleeve is rotationally connected with the bottom of the tank body, a conveying barrel is fixedly connected to the top of the centrifugal barrel through a bracket, chinese herbal medicines can be smashed through a blade arranged at the top end of a shaft rod, effective components containing the antiviral factors can be effectively separated, then the Chinese herbal medicines are conveyed to the inner side of the centrifugal barrel through the conveying barrel, liquid components containing the antiviral factors in the medicinal materials are separated through a through hole through centrifugal force of the centrifugal barrel in the rotation process, and solid matters of the medicinal materials are trapped on the inner side of the centrifugal barrel through filter cotton, so that solid-liquid separation is more thorough, and the separation efficiency is improved.

title_en: Pharmacy medicine extraction equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pharmaceutical agent extraction device, in particular to the field of agent extraction, which comprises a device main body, wherein an embedded thread connecting groove is fixedly connected to the bottom of the device main body; the internal movable connection of embedded threaded connection groove has external extraction cylinder. The utility model is convenient for the later cleaning operation when the external extraction cylinder is assembled and disassembled by the embedded threaded connecting groove during use, the upper half part of the external extraction cylinder is provided with the filter screen plate, the medicine filter assembly and the active carbon filter screen to form the full purity of the filtered and extracted medicine liquid, the condition of medicine residues is avoided, the plugging end at the top is controlled, the lower half part surface of the threaded connecting rod is nested with the cylinder body to be arranged on the branch stirring shaft to form stirring of medicine residues in the device, the accumulation extrusion state of the medicine residues is relaxed, the elastic shaft has a certain rebound buffering effect when the elastic shaft and the extrusion plate are extruded from top to bottom, and the auxiliary force application effect of extrusion is formed.

title_en: Cement stirring device for building engineering
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of stirring devices, and discloses a cement stirring device for building engineering, which comprises: the stirring box body, the bottom of stirring box body is equipped with the discharge gate, the inside upper end fixed mounting of stirring box body has the connecting plate, the pivot is installed in the middle part rotation of connecting plate. The utility model is provided with the stirring box body, the discharge hole, the screw conveying rod and other parts, the bottom of the stirring box body is provided with the conical concave surface, so that the cement in the stirring box body is conveniently emptied, caking and blocking of the discharge hole are avoided, in addition, when the stirring box body is cleaned, the waste water is conveniently and thoroughly discharged, the screw conveying rod slowly rotates, the cement is stably discharged, when the servo motor is closed, the screw conveying rod stops rotating to push the cement in the stirring box body to push, and when the discharge valve is closed, the discharge valve does not splash slurry to cause pollution to the surrounding environment.

title_en: Veterinary medicine liquid filling machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a veterinary medicine liquid filling machine, which comprises a filling machine body, wherein a supporting leg is fixedly connected to the bottom of the filling machine body, a protective door is movably connected to the front surface of the filling machine body, an observation window is arranged on the front surface of the protective door, a door handle is arranged on the front surface of the protective door, a liquid inlet is arranged on the top of the filling machine body, a motor is connected to the right side of the liquid inlet, and the motor, a rotating shaft and a stirring rod are arranged.

title_en: Insoluble particle automatic checkout device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of insoluble particle detection, in particular to an automatic insoluble particle detection device, which comprises a base, wherein a box body is arranged on the base, a transducer is arranged on the bottom wall of a first placing groove, a placing plate is fixedly connected to the transducer, a first liquid storage bottle is placed on the placing plate, the first liquid storage bottle is placed in the first placing groove, an ultrasonic generator is fixedly arranged on the front wall of a bottom plate of the box body, a control panel is arranged on the front wall of a top plate of the box body, the ultrasonic generator is respectively connected with the transducer and the control panel through an internal circuit, and is transmitted to a detection solution through ultrasonic waves, gas dissolved in the liquid is sucked in the bubbles when the bubbles expand until the bubbles reach enough buoyancy and float on the liquid, the gas trapped in the prior is released to the environment, the degassing of the detection solution is realized, the influence of small bubbles on the detection result is avoided, and the detection accuracy is beneficial to improvement.

title_en: Device for drying and grading russula
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device for drying and grading russula vinosa, which comprises a drying box and a feeding structure; the feeding structure comprises a first conveying belt and a second conveying belt; the part of the first conveying belt and the second conveying belt, which are positioned in the drying box, is guided and bent through a plurality of guide wheels positioned on two sides of the first conveying belt and the second conveying belt respectively, a snakelike russet mushroom feeding space is formed between the first conveying belt and the second conveying belt, and a plurality of ventilation holes are uniformly distributed on the first conveying belt and the second conveying belt. The utility model can realize automatic feeding and discharging of russula in the drying box, realizes continuous production, saves time for manual feeding and discharging, and improves production efficiency.

title_en: Shearing emulsifying device for producing pesticide emulsifiable concentrate
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a shearing and emulsifying device for producing pesticide emulsifiable concentrates, which comprises an emulsifying tank and a sealing cover, wherein the sealing cover is detachably arranged above the emulsifying tank, a rotating shaft is rotatably arranged in the center of the inner top end of the sealing cover, a shearing cylinder is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the rotating shaft, a treatment box is fixedly arranged at the top end of the sealing cover, a driving motor is fixedly arranged at the top end of the sealing cover, an output shaft of the driving motor is coaxially and fixedly connected with the rotating shaft, a discharging pipe is communicated with the bottom end of the emulsifying tank, and a feed inlet communicated into the emulsifying tank is arranged on the sealing cover. According to the utility model, the crushing rotary knife is arranged to crush the pesticide raw material, so that larger crystals or particles in the pesticide raw material are prevented from being crushed in subsequent shearing stirring, the later use effect is influenced, the turbulence effect in the emulsifying tank is enhanced by arranging the shearing cylinder, the shearing blade, the connecting rod and the vertical scraping strip, and the processing effect of shearing stirring is improved.

title_en: Cast integrated mud stirring blade
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cast integrated mud stirring blade, which structurally comprises a shaft sleeve and a mud stirring blade, wherein the mud stirring blade is provided with a plurality of mud stirring blades and is connected around the shaft sleeve, and the cast integrated mud stirring blade is characterized in that: be equipped with joint mouth, axle mouth on the axle sleeve, the axle mouth set up in the central point of axle sleeve put, the joint mouth set up in on the axle mouth, the screw hole has still been seted up to the axle sleeve upper surface, be connected with the screw thread head on stirring the mud leaf, stir the mud leaf through screw thread head threaded connection in on the screw hole, through being equipped with first stirring mud leaf and second stirring mud leaf, the second stirs mud leaf and first stirring mud leaf and has certain contained angle to make stirring more even, stirring mud leaf and axle sleeve adopt threaded connection's mode to be connected, thereby make when the maintenance, can dismantle, more firm when being connected with the axle sleeve in order to guarantee stirring mud leaf, through addding screw hole and screw, can further make stirring mud leaf and axle sleeve's connection more firm.

title_en: Self-operated pressure regulating valve with dustproof effect
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a self-operated pressure regulating valve with dustproof effect, comprising: the valve body, the lower base, the top at the valve body is installed to the lower base, the ejector pin is all installed to the left and right sides at lower base top, two the top of ejector pin is through last base fixed connection, connects dustproof mechanism, connect dustproof mechanism setting in the position between lower base and last base, connect dustproof mechanism including dustproof frame, the quantity of dustproof frame is two and sets up the position between lower base and last base respectively. According to the utility model, the dustproof frame, the connecting block, the rubber block, the fixed groove, the moving block, the clamping groove, the fixed block, the fixed rod, the pull block and the elastic piece are mutually matched, so that the effect of dustproof at the valve rod of the self-operated pressure regulating valve is achieved, the adhesion of dust is reduced, the dustproof frame can be detached according to the requirement, and the valve rod and other parts on the self-operated pressure regulating valve are convenient to overhaul.

title_en: Submersible mixer and mounting structure thereof
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a submersible mixer and an installation structure thereof, the submersible mixer comprises a protective shell, a tank body is arranged on one side of the protective shell, a processing component is arranged on one side of the protective shell, a part of the processing component extends from one side of the protective shell to the inside of the protective shell, an installation component is arranged on one side of the protective shell and is arranged at one end of the tank body, sewage at different heights can be stirred, and the efficiency of sewage treatment can be ensured by arranging two stirring blades which rotate oppositely, meanwhile, the problem of blockage possibly occurring in a single blade can be avoided, the design can also drive the mixer to move left and right, so that the sewage treatment range is further enlarged, the limitation of the stirring movement range is avoided, in addition, the fixation of submersible mixing is more convenient, and the equipment is easier to install and maintain. The design can indeed improve the efficiency and the range of sewage treatment, and is convenient in fixation of diving stirring.

title_en: Ferric trichloride medicament conveying mechanism with safety protection
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of etching and discloses a ferric chloride medicament conveying mechanism with safety protection, which comprises a base, wherein a stock solution storage tank is fixedly connected to the upper side of the base, a limiting cylinder is communicated to the lower side of the stock solution storage tank, a reverse heart turbine blade is rotationally connected to the upper end of the inner part of the limiting cylinder, a forward heart turbine blade is rotationally connected to the lower end of the inner part of the limiting cylinder, a medicament heating mechanism for heating ferric chloride medicament solution is arranged on the inner side of the stock solution storage tank, and a medicament soaking mechanism for circulating stirring is arranged on the outer side of the stock solution storage tank.

title_en: PVD carrier plate surface treatment device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of PVD carrier plate cleaning, and discloses a surface treatment device for a PVD carrier plate, which comprises a cleaning box and a vibrating plate, wherein the vibrating plate is transversely fixed below the inside of the cleaning box, a plurality of ultrasonic transducers are uniformly arranged on the bottom surface of the vibrating plate, side plates are vertically fixed at the front end and the rear end above the cleaning box, a rotating rod is longitudinally and rotatably arranged between the side plates at the front end and the rear end, four placing frames are arranged on the outer side of the rotating rod, and the placing frames are fixedly connected with the surfaces of the rotating rod through a plurality of connecting rods. According to the technical scheme, the rotatable rotating rod is arranged above the cleaning box, so that the four placing frames can be driven to rotate, further PVD carrier plates can be placed in the placing frames in sequence, and finally the PVD carrier plates are enabled to rotate and dip into chemical solution in the cleaning box, and a coating layer is cleaned and removed under the effects of corrosion, ultrasonic cleaning and shaking of the solution, so that the cleaning effect is better and the cleaning efficiency is better.

title_en: Adjustable cost table display device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an adjustable cost meter display device, which belongs to the technical field of engineering facilities and comprises a base, wherein the upper surface of the base is fixedly connected with a fixing frame, a first machine cabin is arranged in the fixing frame, a double-shaft motor is fixedly connected in the first machine cabin, a first conical tooth is fixedly connected on the surface of an output shaft of the double-shaft motor, the adjustable cost meter display device is provided with the double-shaft motor, the first conical tooth, the second conical tooth, a first threaded rod and a fixing plate, when the height of a display plate body is adjusted, people control the double-shaft motor to operate through a control switch, further drive the first conical tooth and the second conical tooth to rotate, and simultaneously drive the first threaded rod to rotate, so that the fixing plate and the display plate body are driven to move up and down to the designated height, and the height of the display plate body is more convenient for people to adjust under the actions of the double-shaft motor, the first conical tooth, the second conical tooth, the first threaded rod and the fixing plate.

title_en: Three-stage spraying vacuum system of polymerization device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a three-stage spray vacuum system of a polymerization device, which comprises a reaction device, wherein one side of the reaction device is provided with a pump body, one side of the pump body is provided with a first plate heat exchanger and a second plate heat exchanger, the output ends of the first plate heat exchanger and the second plate heat exchanger are respectively provided with a first glycol pipeline and a second glycol pipeline, and a branch is arranged on the second glycol pipeline; the device also comprises a spraying device, one side of the spraying device is provided with a flowmeter, a mounting hole is formed in a pipeline at the rear end of the flowmeter, and a branch is connected with the mounting hole. The utility model is to reform the existing three-stage spray vacuum system of the polymerization device, open holes on the glycol outlet pipeline in the original system, draw out a pipeline to connect to the open holes behind three spray flow meters respectively, raise the spray quantity, make the spray temperature of each stage drop obviously, the condensation effect is improved, the vacuum degree of the polycondensation reaction kettle is restored to the normal value.

title_en: Gangue crushing and conveying equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses coal gangue crushing and conveying equipment, which relates to the field of coal gangue crushing and conveying equipment, and comprises a raking machine, an arc-shaped bottom plate, a machine shell and a motor, wherein the arc-shaped bottom plate is fixed on one side of the interior of the raking machine; the screen mechanism comprises a first gear, a pull rod, a wheel disc, a screen, a connecting pin and a center pin. According to the utility model, the screen mechanism and the conveying mechanism are arranged, so that the quick screening of the gangue crushed stones can be realized, and meanwhile, the conveying of the fine gangue powder crushed stones at the screening part is realized, so that the quick screening and conveying of the gangue powder crushed stones are facilitated, the waste of conveying resources and crusher resources is reduced, and the conveying efficiency is effectively improved.

title_en: Raw material pretreatment device for preparing nano titanium oxide
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of raw material pretreatment, and discloses a raw material pretreatment device for preparing nano titanium oxide, which comprises a base, wherein a water storage cylinder is fixedly connected to the right side of the top of the base, a sliding groove is formed in the front side of the water storage cylinder, a pulling ring is connected to the inside of the sliding groove in a sliding manner, a filter plate is arranged in the pulling ring, an active carbon plate I is fixedly connected to the inside of the water storage cylinder, a mounting plate is fixedly connected to the front side of the base, two sliding rods are connected to the top of the mounting plate in a sliding manner, springs are sleeved outside the two sliding rods, a limiting block is fixedly connected to the top of the two sliding rods, a supporting component is fixedly connected to the left side of the top of the base, a stirring cylinder is fixedly connected to the inside of the supporting component, and a limiting component is fixedly connected to the bottom of the stirring cylinder. According to the utility model, the filter plate can be quickly replaced by pulling the ring to match with the limiting block, so that the service life of the device is prolonged.

title_en: Ultrasonic vibration filter bag cleaning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ultrasonic vibration filter bag cleaning device, which relates to the technical field of cleaning devices, and particularly relates to an ultrasonic vibration filter bag cleaning device. This ultrasonic vibration filter bag belt cleaning device through setting up expandable supporting mechanism, when supporting the filter bag of equidimension not, upwards slide movable sleeve can make the outwards support of diagonal brace outwards prop up the supporting rod to make the arc frame outwards prop up the filter bag, can support the filter bag of equidimension not, the opening of filter bag bottom can be cliied to the spring clamp on the disc simultaneously, makes the filter bag keep open the state, improves abluent effect.

title_en: Decompression suction filter convenient to heat dissipation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a decompression suction filter convenient for heat dissipation, and relates to the technical field of decompression suction filters. The automatic feeding device comprises a fixed support, wherein a Buchner funnel is fixedly connected to the fixed support, a suction filtration bottle body connected with the Buchner funnel is fixedly connected to the bottom of the suction filtration bottle body, a discharging valve used for discharging is fixedly connected to the bottom of the suction filtration bottle body, connecting pipes are fixedly connected to one ends of the suction filtration bottle body and the Buchner funnel, and the two connecting pipes are in sealing connection; the heat dissipation assembly is connected with the connecting pipe, and the first curved plate, the second curved plate, the air duct, the heat dissipation fins and the heat dissipation fan which are made of metal materials are arranged; the radiating fins are contacted with the connecting pipes, the radiating fins absorb heat on the surfaces of the connecting pipes and disperse, and wind blows to the radiating fins when flowing in the air duct, so that heat dissipation is facilitated.

title_en: Pentane gasification mixing tank distribution bin
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pentane gasification mixing tank distribution bin, which comprises a distribution bin at the upper bottom of the mixing tank, wherein a distribution net with the center protruding upwards is fixedly arranged in the distribution bin, a plurality of hanging rods are fixedly connected below the distribution net, hanging nets are fixedly arranged below each hanging rod, an air flow guiding net positioned below the distribution net is fixedly arranged in the distribution bin, the air flow guiding net is of a net structure with the center recessed downwards, and an air entraining hopper positioned below the air flow guiding net is fixedly arranged in the distribution bin. According to the utility model, the hanging net, the air flow guiding net and the air entraining hopper are arranged below the distribution net and in the distribution bin, the hanging net further distributes the mixed gas which is preliminarily distributed by the distribution net, the air flow guiding net further distributes the mixed gas, the meshes of the distribution net, the hanging net and the air flow guiding net are gradually reduced, and the dispersing effect of the mixed gas is greatly improved through the design of the multi-stage net plate.

title_en: Outdoor ultrasonic atomizing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field related to atomization devices, in particular to an outdoor ultrasonic atomization device which comprises a water storage tank, wherein a tank cover is connected to the upper surface of the water storage tank in a threaded mode, an atomization mechanism is arranged on the outer side surface of the water storage tank, a sealing mechanism is arranged on the inner side surface of the tank cover, and a storage battery is arranged on one side surface of the water storage tank. The fan is connected with the ultrasonic atomizing head to be used for converting liquid into mist, then the valve is opened, the mist is sprayed out from the mist outlet hole formed in the surface of the water outlet pipe through the fan, the size of the mist can be adjusted through the voltage regulator above the mounting plate, then the connection point between the tank cover and the water storage tank can be sealed through the sealing ring inside the placing groove, and the sealing cover and the sealing gasket are arranged, so that the water outlet pipe is not influenced by threaded connection of the sealing cover during use, and the mist outlet hole is better sealed.

title_en: Steel piece clearance mechanism of polishing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a steel polishing debris cleaning mechanism which comprises a lower frame body, wherein the upper surface of the lower frame body is fixedly connected with an upper frame body, the upper surface of the upper frame body is fixedly connected with a guide rail, the outer side of the guide rail is provided with a linear motor, the two ends of the linear motor are fixedly connected with connecting rods, the upper surface of the upper frame body is provided with two clearance grooves, connecting columns are arranged in the two clearance grooves, the connecting columns are fixed with the connecting rods, the bottom ends of the connecting columns are fixedly connected with a mounting frame, and the two sides of the mounting frame are provided with scrapers. The utility model not only can scrape and clean the waste on the lower frame body, avoid the waste from wearing the surface of the steel, improve the steel polishing effect, but also can facilitate the disassembly and replacement of the scraper by a worker, improve the convenience of replacing the scraper by a cleaning mechanism, and also can avoid the collection of the waste by the worker, reduce the labor capacity of the worker and improve the use convenience of the cleaning mechanism.

title_en: Sewage treatment defoaming device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sewage treatment defoaming device, which comprises a treatment tank, three flow baffle plates, at least two spray heads and at least two ventilation caps, wherein the three flow baffle plates are arranged on the treatment tank; the treatment tank is closed and both ends are respectively communicated with a water inlet pipe and a water outlet pipe with valves, three baffle plates are arranged in the treatment tank along the water outlet direction at intervals, the treatment tank is divided into four treatment cavities, the four treatment cavities are mutually communicated to form a curve channel, a plurality of holes are formed in the baffle plates in the middle, porous spherical suspended fillers can be filled in the holes, and at least two spray heads and at least two ventilation caps are arranged at intervals at the top of the treatment tank. The utility model can ensure the breaking means of the bubble surface by spraying the spray head and the hydraulic energy dissipation means of sewage energy dissipation by the flow baffle plate, and the whole device can ensure the basic contact disinfection effect of the treatment tank.

title_en: Building plastering and slurry throwing device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of building construction tools, and particularly relates to a plastering and slurry throwing device for a building, which comprises a moving part, wherein the moving part comprises a bottom plate, the top of the bottom plate is provided with a swinging part, the swinging part comprises a bearing seat, the bearing seat is horizontally arranged on the top surface of the bottom plate, the inside of the bearing seat is vertically and fixedly connected with a rotating shaft, the circumferential surface of the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a gear, the top surface of the bottom plate is provided with a T-shaped chute, the inside of the T-shaped chute is vertically provided with a T-shaped slide bar, and the inside of the T-shaped chute is horizontally and fixedly connected with a first electric push rod. According to the utility model, the swing part is arranged, so that the slurry throwing part deflects at a certain angle under the telescopic action of the output end of the first electric push rod, the slurry throwing area of the wall surface is enlarged, the moving distance of the utility model is reduced, the time and the labor are saved, and the use is more convenient; through setting up the thick liquid part that throws away, not only can adapt to the wall body of different co-altitude through the barrel lift to be convenient for carry out dismouting to the barrel, improved maintenance efficiency.

title_en: Fodder fermentation mixing arrangement
abstract_en: The utility model provides a feed fermentation mixing device, which relates to the technical field of feed fermentation mixing and comprises the following components: the equipment box is provided with a stirring box at one side, and a rotary clamping groove is formed at one side of the equipment box; the stirring assembly is arranged between the equipment box and the stirring box and is used for improving the stirring efficiency of the feed; and the heating component is arranged in the stirring box and is used for heating the feed and scraping the feed adhered to the inner wall of the stirring box. This kind of device can reduce fodder fermentation mixing time through the setting of stirring subassembly, improves the mixing effect of fodder, reduces the consumption of energy to through heating element's setting, can carry out heating treatment to the fodder, also can scrape the fodder of adhesion at the agitator tank inner wall after the fodder discharge agitator tank moreover, reduce the waste of fodder.

title_en: Quantitative liquid fertilizer applicator
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of agricultural equipment, in particular to a liquid fertilizer quantitative fertilizer applicator, which comprises a base, wherein a box body is arranged above the base, a first motor and a second motor are arranged on one side of the box body, a partition plate is fixed on the inner side of the box body, the box body is divided into two spaces by the partition plate, one of the spaces is a stirring chamber, the other is a liquid quantitative chamber, the partition plate comprises a thin plate on the upper part and a chamber with an inverted U-shaped lower part, a first liquid outlet is formed in one side of the chamber, far away from the first motor, of the chamber, a second slider for blocking the first liquid outlet is slidingly connected in the chamber, a feeding pipe communicated with the stirring chamber is arranged on the upper part of the box body, a second liquid outlet is formed in one side of the liquid quantitative chamber, an inner switch for controlling the first motor is arranged on one side, an outer switch for controlling the first motor is arranged on the outer side of the box body, the liquid outlet quantity of the liquid fertilizer is controlled by controlling the time of one-time reciprocation of the slider, and the quantitative liquid outlet of the liquid fertilizer is realized.

title_en: Artificial leather raw material stirring machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of artificial leather production, in particular to an artificial leather raw material stirring machine, which comprises a frame, and a stirring cylinder and a conveying cylinder which are arranged on the frame; the inside rotation of churn is installed and is installed installation axle A, install a plurality of (mixing) shafts on the installation axle A, installation axle A's upper and lower extreme is connected with integral key shaft A and integral key shaft B respectively, the top of churn and bottom are rotated respectively and are installed integral key sleeve A and integral key sleeve B, integral key shaft A and integral key shaft B slidable mounting respectively on integral key sleeve A and integral key sleeve B, be connected with the doctor-bar on the integral key sleeve B, install on the churn and be used for driving integral key sleeve A pivoted power component A, install on the churn be used for driving integral key shaft A reciprocating motion's power component B from top to bottom, carry the inside of barrel through installation axle B rotation install the auger, the transmission is connected with drive mechanism A between auger and the integral key sleeve A. The stirring device can uniformly stir raw materials, and has good stirring effect and strong practicability.

title_en: Cosmetic bottle belt cleaning device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a cosmetic bottle cleaning device, and relates to the technical field of cosmetic bottle cleaning. This cosmetics bottle belt cleaning device, including backup pad and support column, backup pad top fixedly connected with connects the water tank, backup pad lower surface array connection has four supporting legs, backup pad rear end fixedly connected with diaphragm, diaphragm top fixedly connected with water pump, water pump right-hand member fixedly connected with water suction pipe, water suction pipe left end fixedly connected with shunt tubes, shunt tubes front end fixedly connected with shower nozzle. When the cosmetic bottle cleaning device is used, the spray head sprays water into the cosmetic bottle through the water pump, the water repairing pipe and the shunt pipe, the servo motor drives the rotary rod to rotate, the rotary rod drives the second rotary gear to rotate, the second rotary gear drives the first rotary gear to rotate, the first rotary gear drives the rotary rod to rotate, the rotary rod drives the driving gear to rotate, the driving gear drives the conveying belt to rotate, the conveying belt drives the clamping plate to move, the telescopic rod withdraws the first rotary gear, and the rotary rod stops rotating.

title_en: Fruit sorting device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of fruit sorting, in particular to a fruit sorting device which comprises a base, wherein a support is fixedly arranged at the right end of the base, a sorting device seat is fixedly arranged on the support, a motor seat is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the base, a sorting assembly is arranged on the motor seat, and the sorting assembly and the sorting device seat are sleeved and arranged. When the fruit sorting machine is used, the rotating motor is turned on, the conical screw piece on the limiting wheel disc is driven by the rotating motor to rotate on the support, and as the conical screw piece is sleeved on the sorting cone and is matched with the inner cavity of the flexible rubber band plate to limit, fruits can only be placed in the inner cavity, so that the conical screw piece drives the fruits to move back and forth in the inner cavity, when the fruits are gradually placed on the multi-stage sorting openings, the fruits with different shapes are sorted through the multi-stage sorting openings with different diameters, and the fruits are continuously sorted through the multi-stage pipes and the large fruit channels, so that the sorting efficiency is improved.

title_en: Cutting segmentation equipment convenient to fix steel
abstract_en: The utility model discloses cutting and segmenting equipment convenient for fixing steel, and particularly relates to the technical field of steel. According to the utility model, the rotating rod is arranged on the groove, the turntable is arranged at one end of the rotating rod, the first movable plate is arranged on the outer wall of the turntable, and the second movable plate is arranged at one end of the first movable plate, so that the clamping head in the equipment is convenient to replace. According to the utility model, when steel is cut, the cutting segmentation equipment is used for cutting the steel, when most of the cutting segmentation equipment is used for processing the steel, the position of the steel is limited by using the clamp, then the steel is cut by the subsequent cutting disc, when the steel with different shapes is continuously cut, the clamp needs to be replaced adaptively considering the position fixing stability of the steel, and the clamping head of the equipment can be replaced adaptively and quickly, so that the fixing position of the subsequent steel is convenient.

title_en: Continuous filtering system for glycine alcohol precipitation liquid
abstract_en: The utility model provides a continuous filtering system for glycine alcohol precipitation liquid, relates to the technical field of glycine production and preparation, and aims to solve the technical problem that a filtering process of glycine alcohol precipitation liquid cannot be operated continuously. The filtering system comprises a main pipe, wherein the main pipe comprises a glycine alcohol liquid separating main pipe, a tail gas collecting main pipe, a compressed air main pipe, a protective gas main pipe, a methanol water solution main pipe and a filtrate main pipe; a plurality of continuous centrifuges arranged in parallel; the main pipe is connected with the continuous centrifugal machine through a glycine alcohol precipitation liquid branch pipe, a tail gas collecting branch pipe, a protective gas branch pipe, a methanol aqueous solution branch pipe and a filtrate branch pipe in sequence; the pneumatic box is respectively connected with the compressed air main pipe and the continuous centrifugal machine. The filtering system can perform continuous and automatic operation, eliminate the difference between product batches, improve the product quality, effectively improve the filtering efficiency and the production efficiency, and remarkably improve the economic benefit of product production.

title_en: Mixer is used in cereal processing convenient to guarantee stirring quality
