abstract_en: The utility model discloses a grain processing stirrer convenient for ensuring stirring quality, which comprises a device body, wherein the device body comprises a stirring barrel, a cover plate is arranged at the upper end of the stirring barrel, a limiting frame is sleeved outside the stirring barrel, a feeding pipe and a first motor are arranged at the upper end of the cover plate, a rotating shaft is connected below the first motor, a connecting rod is arranged below the rotating shaft, a second motor is arranged in one side of the connecting rod, a diagonal rod is connected below the second motor, a stirring blade is sleeved on the diagonal rod, a discharging pipe is arranged below the diagonal rod, a supporting leg is arranged below the limiting frame, a mounting hole is formed in the limiting frame, an electric push rod is arranged in the mounting hole, grains entering the device can be sufficiently and uniformly stirred, the stirring quality of the grains is ensured, the device can be moved according to the needs of a user, the practicability and convenience of the device are improved, and the safety of the grains during stirring is ensured.

title_en: Soil detection workbench
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of soil detection, in particular to a soil detection workbench, which comprises a workbench base, wherein a protective cover is arranged at the top of the workbench base, a mounting bracket is fixedly arranged on the right side of the top of the workbench base, an upper grinding bowl and a lower grinding bowl are fixedly sleeved on the front surface of the mounting bracket, a driving assembly is fixedly arranged at the top of the mounting bracket, a connecting rod is fixedly connected to an output shaft of the driving assembly, a transmission shaft is arranged on the connecting rod, and an upper grinding disc and a lower grinding disc are fixedly sleeved outside the transmission shaft. This soil detection workstation, throw into the soil in the last alms bowl to drive transmission shaft and last mill dish, mill the mill dish down through drive assembly, through two sets of mill dishes and mill the alms bowl cooperation, can realize the multistage mill to soil, improve the effect of milling, and the soil can directly fall into down in the alms bowl along the ejection of compact mouth of bottom after milling in last alms bowl, need not to be manual to transporting soil.

title_en: Deacidification tower for hazardous waste incineration
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of deacidification towers, in particular to a deacidification tower for hazardous waste incineration, which solves the problems that in the prior art, the contact of flue gas and sprayed neutralization water is less, and the deacidification effect of the flue gas is affected. The deacidification tower includes deacidification tower body and spray assembly, and this internal portion of deacidification tower is neutralization pond and sprays the chamber, sprays the intracavity and is equipped with the spiral plate, sprays the shower head setting of assembly at the lower surface of spiral plate. The utility model has the beneficial effects that: the spiral plate forms a spiral channel in the spray cavity, smoke rises in the spiral channel in a spiral way, and the passing path of the smoke in the spray cavity is increased, so that spray water is contacted with the smoke for a longer time; in the process, the spray header on the lower surface of the spiral plate sprays neutralizing water, and the neutralizing water is fully contacted with the flue gas, so that the deacidification treatment effect of the flue gas is ensured.

title_en: Developing device for photosensitive resin plate
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of processing of photosensitive resin plates, and particularly relates to a flushing device for a photosensitive resin plate, which comprises a box body, wherein a storage box is fixedly arranged on the upper side of the box body, a square cavity is formed in the box body, a spray rod is arranged on the upper side of the square cavity, a motor-controlled bidirectional screw rod is rotatably arranged in the square cavity, two support rods controlled by the bidirectional screw rod are slidably arranged in the box body, L-shaped plates are arranged on the front sides of the two support rods, clamping plates are rotatably arranged on the right sides of the two L-shaped plates, and a rotating piece matched with a clamping component is arranged on the box body; two bracing pieces are adjusted to proper positions through the bidirectional screw rod, then the clamping plate and the L-shaped plate are used for clamping and fixing the resin plate, the rotating piece is controlled to rotate the resin plate in clamping, the surface of the resin plate can be in full contact with the solution, the resin plate is rotated through the rotating piece after processing is finished, residual solution on the surface of the resin plate is spin-dried, the drying time of the resin plate is shortened, and the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Scrap collecting mechanism for metal product processing
abstract_en: The utility model provides a scrap collecting mechanism for metal product processing. The scrap collecting mechanism for metal product processing comprises: two fixing frames; the protective cover is fixedly arranged between the two fixing frames; the separation box is rotatably arranged on the protective cover; the two separation boxes are divided into a first screening cavity, a second screening cavity and a third screening cavity by the two separation plates; the fixed shaft is fixedly arranged on the separation box and is rotationally connected with the fixed frame and the protective cover; the rotating motor is fixedly arranged on the fixing frame, and an output shaft of the rotating motor is fixedly connected with the fixing shaft. The scrap collecting mechanism for metal product processing provided by the utility model has the advantages of convenience in separation, improvement of resource utilization rate and convenience in transportation.

title_en: High-purity oxygen generator
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a high-purity oxygen generator, and belongs to the technical field of air separation equipment. Including the oxygen generator main part, connect in the outlet duct of oxygen generator main part end of giving vent to anger, set up in valve body in the outlet duct, the valve body including fixed connection in the outlet duct inner wall is close to the through-flow plate of oxygen generator main part one end, sliding connection in just be located in the outlet duct the through-flow plate keep away from the piston of oxygen generator main part one side, set up in be used for the drive in the outlet duct the piston orientation the elastic component of through-flow plate direction motion, the piston is kept away from the connecting hole along its axial extension has been seted up to the terminal surface of oxygen generator main part, the sliding tray around its annular extension has been seted up to the connecting hole inner wall, sliding connection has the spacing ring in the sliding tray. The utility model solves the problem that the oxygen release rate cannot be regulated in the prior art.

title_en: Coating heating device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a paint heating device which comprises a mounting frame, wherein a heating box body and a water tank are arranged on the mounting frame, a heating plate is arranged on the inner wall of the heating box body, a motor is arranged at the top of the outer wall of the heating box body, a stirring paddle is arranged in the heating box body, a shaft rod of the motor penetrates through the heating box body and is connected with the stirring paddle, a feeding pipe, a discharging pipe and a water inlet pipe are communicated with the heating box body, a filter screen is arranged in the feeding pipe, electromagnetic valves are arranged on the discharging pipe and the water inlet pipe, a spraying pipe is arranged in the heating box body, one end of the spraying pipe is communicated with the water pipe, the other end of the spraying pipe is closed, and a plurality of first high-pressure spray heads are communicated with the spraying pipe.

title_en: Caking cement fine crusher
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a caking cement fine crusher, which comprises an intermediate bin, wherein a crushing bin is fixedly arranged at the top of the intermediate bin, an upper bin is fixedly arranged at the top of the crushing bin, supporting legs are respectively and fixedly arranged at four corners of the bottom of the intermediate bin, a lower bin is arranged at the bottom of the intermediate bin and is positioned among four supporting legs, a moving mechanism is fixedly arranged at the bottom of each supporting leg, a driving motor is fixedly arranged at one side of the outer wall of the crushing bin through a mounting frame, a semicircular plate is arranged at the upper end in the intermediate bin, a plurality of blanking holes are uniformly formed in the side wall of the semicircular plate, the blanking holes allow qualified cement blocks to pass through, and a crushing roller mechanism is arranged in the intermediate bin and is matched with the semicircular plate.

title_en: Environment-friendly basalt fiber production device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an environment-friendly basalt fiber production device, which comprises: the cleaning box and the crushing device are connected with the crushing device in a sliding manner, the crushing device comprises a crushing box, crushing rollers are connected in the crushing box in a rotating manner, crushing motors are fixedly connected to the right side of the crushing box, the output ends of the two crushing motors are respectively and fixedly connected with the crushing rollers, the crushing rollers on the two sides rotate along the directions close to each other, a conveying structure is arranged at the bottom in the crushing box, the conveying structure consists of a conveying belt, a rotating shaft and a motor, and an outlet is formed at one end, close to the cleaning box, of the crushing box; through above-mentioned structure, reduce the space and occupy, reduce the volume simultaneously, practice thrift the cost, it is cleaner simultaneously to the building stones washs, the effect is better.

title_en: Quick-heating type water molecule heating electrode boiler
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of boilers and discloses a fast-heating type water molecule hot electrode boiler, which comprises a boiler and a filter box, wherein a replacement assembly is arranged at the lower part of the boiler, a main air port is fixedly connected to one side of the upper part of the boiler, an inlet is fixedly connected to one side of the lower part of the boiler, a fixing buckle is fixedly connected to the periphery of the inlet, two fixing cylinders are fixedly connected to the opposite side of the fixing buckle, inserting strips are slidably connected to the inner parts of the two fixing cylinders, and two fixing blocks are fixedly connected to the opposite side of the fixing buckle. According to the utility model, the fixing and adjusting mechanism is used for realizing the fixing and adjusting of the main air port and the inlet when the main air port and the inlet are connected, so that the connecting device can be fixed in different sizes when heat energy is supplied, heat supply is better, the water supply device is fixed in different sizes when water is fed, and the replacement mechanism is used for realizing the circulating filtration of water in the boiler and the excessive replacement of the filtered filter screen.

title_en: Freeze-drying device for freeze-drying pet food
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a freeze drying device for freeze-drying pet food, which comprises a freeze dryer, wherein a plurality of trays are rotationally arranged in the freeze dryer, each tray comprises a lower support and a cover plate, a receiving net is movably sleeved in the lower support, a pressing net is fixedly arranged in the cover plate, connecting shafts are fixedly arranged on two sides of the lower support, one ends of the connecting shafts positioned on the same side penetrate through the freeze dryer and are fixedly sleeved with synchronous wheels, synchronous belts are sleeved on the outer walls of the synchronous wheels positioned at the upper position and the lower position, the synchronous wheels and the synchronous belts are meshed, a sealing door is rotationally arranged at the front end of the freeze dryer, a window is fixedly arranged on the sealing door, and the cover plate is rotationally connected to the upper end of the lower support. The freeze drying device for freeze-drying pet food can effectively improve the food drying efficiency and has practicability.

title_en: Electrophoresis drying device for mower blade
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mower blade electrophoresis drying device which comprises an electrophoresis dryer body, wherein two sides of the electrophoresis dryer body are fixedly adhered with installation side plates, an electric telescopic rod is arranged at the center of each installation side plate, and two limit baffles are fixedly arranged on two sides of the top end of the electrophoresis dryer body. According to the utility model, the lifting transverse plate is driven to move downwards by the electric telescopic rod, so that the blades on the balance clamping plate and the blades on the adjusting screw rod are immersed into the electrophoresis dryer body, and then the shielding connecting plate is pushed to slide in the connecting clamping ring by the pull ring, so that the top end of the electrophoresis dryer body is shielded, electrophoresis drying coating of the mower blades is facilitated, after the mower blades are coated, the lifting transverse plate can be lifted by the electric telescopic rod, so that the mower blades immersed in the electrophoresis dryer body are lifted after the lifting transverse plate is lifted, and subsequent mower blade treatment is facilitated.

title_en: Radar level gauge antenna with good blowing effect and long service life
abstract_en: The radar level gauge antenna with the good purging effect and long service life comprises an antenna main body, wherein a semi-convex lens is arranged on the inner side of the lower part of the antenna main body, the bottom surface of the semi-convex lens is of a planar structure, a purging connecting ring is arranged on the outer side of the lower part of the antenna main body, and a blowing nozzle is arranged on the purging connecting ring; in summary, the radar level gauge antenna is of a split type structure, mainly comprises an antenna main body, a semi-convex lens, a purging connecting ring and other parts, is flexible to assemble, and has a planar bottom surface, so that the radar level gauge antenna is not easy to damage due to air flow purging; in addition, the lower part of the step hole enables the air passage to be larger, so that the purging effect is improved; the plurality of groups of the purging channels are arranged in an annular array around the center of the bottom surface of the purging connecting ring, and the purging channels and the radial direction of the purging connecting ring form included angles, so that the purging airflow enters into the ring to form rotation, and the purging effect is better; the whole structure has reasonable design, good blowing effect and strong durability.

title_en: Automatic stirring and cleaning device for rubber cylinder
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic stirring and cleaning device for a rubber cylinder, which comprises a box body, wherein the inner space of the box body is divided into an upper bin body and a lower bin body by a partition plate, the front surface of the box body is provided with a box door, a plurality of triaxial clamps are respectively arranged in the upper bin body and the lower bin body, each triaxial clamp is rotationally connected with the backboard of the box body through a rotating shaft, each rotating shaft penetrates through the backboard of the box body, a chain wheel is fixedly arranged at one end of each rotating shaft positioned outside the box body, and a driving device is arranged on the outer wall of one end of the box body and connected with all the chain wheels through a chain. The utility model can realize automatic cleaning of the rubber cylinder without manual operation and has the advantages of good cleaning effect and high cleaning efficiency.

title_en: Grid machine for sewage treatment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a grid machine for sewage treatment, which belongs to the technical field of grid machines and comprises a fixed baffle plate frame and a box body, wherein a protective box is arranged on the top of the box body, a first driving motor is arranged in the top of the protective box, a driving disc is arranged at the driving end of the first driving motor, a driving column is arranged at the bottom of the driving disc near the edge, a supporting shaft is arranged at the position of the box body near one end of the top of the fixed baffle plate frame, a moving pipe is arranged on the outer edge of the supporting shaft, a plurality of raised strips are uniformly distributed between the outer edge of the supporting shaft and the inner wall of the moving pipe, a connecting block is arranged on one side of the outer edge of the moving pipe, a fixed side plate is arranged on the end part of the connecting block, a plurality of rubber brush strips are uniformly distributed on one side of the fixed side plate, and the moving pipe is provided with a driving frame on the other side opposite to the connecting block. According to the utility model, through the matched use of the moving pipe, the supporting shaft and other parts, the fixed side plate can be conveniently driven to move, and the rubber brush strip is convenient to maintain.

title_en: Hydrogen peroxide solution oxidation tail gas recycle system
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of waste gas separation, and particularly relates to a hydrogen peroxide oxidation tail gas recycling system, which comprises an oxidation tail gas pipeline, a cooler, an organic solvent storage tank and an active carbon adsorption tank which are sequentially connected; the cooler consists of a condensation cylinder and a collecting tank, wherein the condensation cylinder is provided with a condenser coil, the collecting tank is provided with a spray header, and the spray header is communicated with the condenser coil; a baffle plate is obliquely arranged in the collecting tank, the side wall of the collecting tank is connected with the main pipe of the exhaust pipeline, and the bottom end of the collecting tank is connected with the organic solvent storage tank; the top of the organic solvent storage tank is connected with the active carbon adsorption tank through an exhaust pipeline main pipe; the outside of the activated carbon adsorption tank is provided with a steam jacket, the inside of the activated carbon adsorption tank is provided with an activated carbon adsorption plate, the bottom of the activated carbon adsorption tank is connected with a collecting tank, and the activated carbon adsorption tank is provided with an emptying pipeline. According to the utility model, aromatic hydrocarbons in the oxidized tail gas are recycled in a multistage cooling and separation adsorption mode, so that the environmental pollution is reduced, and the aromatic hydrocarbon utilization rate is improved.

title_en: Vibrating CBN compounding device
abstract_en: The application relates to a vibrating CBN mixing device, which comprises: the first charging bucket is internally provided with a wetting agent and a CBN abrasive; the second charging bucket is internally accommodated with a bonding agent; the vibration assembly comprises a vibration cylinder and a vibration base, and the first charging bucket and the second charging bucket are communicated with the vibration cylinder, so that a wetting agent in the first charging bucket, a CBN abrasive and a bonding agent in the second charging bucket are sent into the vibration cylinder; the vibration base is internally provided with a vibration motor, the vibration cylinder is connected to the vibration base, and the vibration motor drives the vibration cylinder to vibrate, so that the wetting agent, the CBN abrasive and the bonding agent in the vibration cylinder are mixed with each other. The bonding agent particles are in a flutter state through mechanical vibration acting force, bonding agent agglomeration is destroyed, the bonding agent agglomeration is enabled to be as close to an ideal distribution state as possible, the bonding agent agglomeration is evenly distributed and wrapped on the surface of CBN abrasive particles, and the uniformity of mixing is high.

title_en: Mixed reaction kettle structure of chemical fertilizer anti-caking agent
abstract_en: The utility model provides a mixing reaction kettle structure of a chemical fertilizer anti-caking agent, which belongs to the field of chemical fertilizer processing equipment and comprises a support column, wherein a steel plate is arranged above the support column, one side of the steel plate is provided with a reaction cylinder, the bottom of the reaction cylinder is provided with a support plate, a variable-temperature jacket is arranged above the support plate, a discharge chute is arranged below the variable-temperature jacket, a rotary notch is arranged above the variable-temperature jacket, a cylinder cover is arranged above the rotary notch, an electric valve is arranged on the side surface of the reaction cylinder, a chemical fertilizer feeding pipe is arranged on one side of the electric valve, a chemical fertilizer feeding pipe is arranged on the adjacent side of the chemical fertilizer feeding pipe, the chemical fertilizer and the anti-caking agent can enter the variable-temperature jacket by starting the electric valve, a motor is started to drive a stirring shaft to stir the chemical fertilizer and the anti-caking agent in the variable-temperature jacket through a coupler, steam and a water inlet pipe enter a condensate water collocation thermometer and a pressure gauge to control the temperature in the variable-temperature jacket, and then the chemical fertilizer is mixed to react, and the electric valve of the discharge pipe is opened after the chemical fertilizer reaction is completed.

title_en: Wafer photoetching mask plate
abstract_en: The utility model provides a wafer photoetching mask, which belongs to the technical field of semiconductor manufacturing and aims to solve the problems that the mask needs to be cleaned regularly, the mask is frequently cleaned and the use of the mask is easy to be influenced in the prior art, and the wafer photoetching mask comprises a mask frame, a mask main body, a mask dustproof slide block, a protection support rack, a protection fixing piece, a dustproof protection mechanism and an anti-falling protection mechanism; the mask plate main body is fixedly connected to the middle position of the mask plate frame; the protection support racks are respectively and slidably connected to four corners of the mask frame; the protection fixing pieces are of semicircular rubber structures, and the four groups of protection fixing pieces are respectively and fixedly connected to the upper ends of the protection support racks; the dustproof protection mechanism is arranged in the mask frame; the anti-falling protection mechanism is arranged on the outer side of the mask frame, so that the cleaning times of the mask are reduced, the damage to the mask is reduced, and the service life of the mask is prolonged.

title_en: Refractory material processing crushing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses refractory material processing crushing equipment, which relates to the technical field of refractory material processing and comprises a box body, wherein a feeding hole is formed in the upper side of the box body, a feeding pipe is arranged in the feeding hole, a cutting assembly is slidably arranged on the surface of the feeding pipe, the cutting assembly comprises a movable block, the movable block is slidably arranged on the surface of the feeding pipe, a plurality of cutting blades are arranged on the lower side of the movable block, a driving unit is arranged on one side of the movable block, a first conveying roller is arranged on the inner wall of the box body.

title_en: Milk product processing agitator tank
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a milk product processing agitator tank, which relates to the technical field of agitator tanks and comprises: a tank body; the whole tank body is arranged on the supporting component; the rotary ring, the whole rotation of rotary ring is installed in jar mouth department of jar body, the both sides of rotary ring are fixed with the diaphragm jointly, the rectangle mouth has all been seted up to the top both sides of diaphragm, the inside of rectangle mouth is provided with the movable plate, the inside of rectangle mouth is provided with the direction subassembly, the movable plate carries out rectilinear movement through the direction subassembly, first rotation hole has been seted up at the top of movable plate, the dwang is installed in the internal rotation of dwang, the lateral wall of dwang is fixed with a plurality of stirring boards, the top of dwang is fixed with the drive gear rather than coaxial setting. The utility model enables a plurality of stirring modes to be synchronously carried out, thereby improving the stirring mixing degree, namely improving the stirring efficiency.

title_en: A dispersion section device for paint produce
abstract_en: The utility model provides a dispersion section device for paint produce, the on-line screen storage device comprises a base, dispersion slicer main part, the support subassembly, agitator and screening part, dispersion slicer main part sets up on the base, the agitator is through being connected with the support subassembly, have screening part in the agitator, form first stirring region and second stirring region in the messenger's agitator, dispersion slicer main part has rabbling mechanism, rabbling mechanism includes the axostylus axostyle, dispersion dish part and branch material subassembly, when the part of axostylus axostyle is located the agitator, the dispersion dish part is located first stirring region, the branch material subassembly is located the second stirring region, the coating raw materials of pouring in the agitator is blocked by the screening part, make it be located first stirring region, and stir the operation by the dispersion dish part, later get into the second stirring region through the screening part, again by the branch material subassembly carries out secondary stirring operation, avoid the coating raw materials to exist great granule and impurity unable the condition of getting rid of after the stirring is accomplished.

title_en: Rice seed soaking equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a rice seed soaking device for rice planting without airing, in particular to a rice seed soaking device which comprises an insulation box, wherein the inner wall of the insulation box is connected with a draining bucket in a sliding manner, the lower surface of the draining bucket is provided with a turnover assembly, the left side surface of the insulation box is fixedly connected with a waste collection box, the right side surface of the insulation box is fixedly connected with a water tank, the upper surface of the inner wall of the water tank is provided with a heating pipe, the upper surface of the water tank is provided with a water supply assembly, rice seeds are drained through meshes in the draining bucket, a fan is used for airing the rice seeds in the draining bucket, an underwater motor drives a stirring paddle to rotate so as to turn over the rice seeds soaked in the draining bucket, so that the problem that rice seeds are accumulated and heated in the prior art, the rice seeds are required to be dried in a cool and ventilated place, and the problem that the rice seeds are required to be turned over from time to time is avoided.

title_en: Gelatin liquid precipitation type self-separating canning device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a gelatin liquid precipitation type self-separating canning device which comprises an operation table and a separating tank main body, wherein the separating tank main body is vertically and penetratingly arranged on the operation table, a sealing cover is arranged at the top of the operation table, a mounting frame is arranged on the top surface of the sealing cover, a threaded sleeve is arranged at one end of the mounting frame, a screw is vertically and movably arranged at the top of the operation table, and a stepping motor is connected with the bottom end of the screw penetrating through the surface of the operation table. The utility model is convenient to discharge the gelatin after the precipitation work of the separating tank main body is finished by arranging the driving motor, the main shaft, the second cleaning plate and the scraping plate, and then starts the driving motor when the separating tank main body is cleaned, and then the driving motor drives the second cleaning plate through the main shaft to scrape and clean the inner wall of the separating tank main body by the scraping plate.

title_en: Compound prilling granulator of functional compound fertilizer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a functional compound fertilizer compound granulating device, which relates to the technical field of a granulator, and comprises a bracket and a manufacturing disc, wherein a collecting assembly for collecting prepared and formed granules is assembled at the center of the manufacturing disc, a power assembly for providing rotary power for the manufacturing disc is also assembled at one side of the bracket, the manufacturing disc is driven to rotate by the power assembly to form granules by the raw materials, the granules fall into a granule receiving pipe and a granule taking pipe after contacting a baffle, a granule feeding roller is driven to rotate by a second motor to send the granules to a granule outlet, and some granules which do not reach a qualified size and powder can fall into the manufacturing disc again along with the influence of gravity from a return opening.

title_en: Ball milling device is used in expanded graphite production
abstract_en: The utility model provides a ball milling device for producing expanded graphite, and belongs to the technical field of expanded graphite ball milling. The ball milling device for producing the expanded graphite comprises an installing table, wherein the ball milling mechanism comprises a motor, the motor is arranged above the installing table, the motor, the fixed rod, the main gear, the crushing cylinder, the installing block and the groove are matched with each other, firstly, the motor can be started to drive the crushing cylinder to rotate, the crushing cylinder drives the iron ball to move upwards, after the lifting force of the iron ball, which is moved to the cylinder wall, is insufficient to drive the iron ball to move upwards continuously, the iron ball is thrown downwards and is smashed on the expanded graphite to be crushed, so that the iron ball crushes the expanded graphite, at the moment, part of the iron ball falls into the groove, thereby increasing the contact surface between the cylinder wall and the iron ball through the groove, further increasing the friction force, enabling the cylinder wall to continuously and normally lift the iron ball, and then throwing down, thereby improving the friction force between the crushing cylinder and the iron ball and improving the effect on the expanded graphite.

title_en: Granule screening device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a granule screening device which comprises a screening component and a cleaning component, wherein the screening component comprises a box body, an inclined plate, a screen and a vibration source, the inclined plate is fixedly connected with the box body and is obliquely arranged, the screen is arranged at a hollowed-out part formed on the inclined plate, the vibration source is connected with the box body or the inclined plate, the cleaning component comprises a water diversion box, the water diversion box is arranged at the bottom of the inclined plate, is in sliding connection with the box body along the inclined direction of the inclined plate and can slide to a position which is opposite to the screen or is staggered with the screen along the vertical direction, the water diversion box is provided with a water diversion cavity which is externally connected with a high-pressure water source, and a plurality of water outlets which are communicated with the water diversion cavity are formed on one side of the water diversion box, which is close to the inclined plate; the water diversion box is externally connected with a high-pressure water source, the water diversion box is moved to a position which is opposite to the screen, the high-pressure water source is sprayed out from the water outlet through the water diversion cavity, and the blocked granules in the screen holes are impacted, so that the granules are separated from the screen holes, and the cleaning process is realized.

title_en: Spraying range adjustable spouts medicine device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of medicine spraying devices, in particular to a medicine spraying device with an adjustable spraying range, wherein a tank body is positioned at the upper end of a base, a bottom cover is arranged at the lower end of the tank body, a discharging pipe and a first motor are arranged at the lower end of the bottom cover, a stirring rod is arranged in the tank body, the output end of the first motor is connected with the bottom end of the stirring rod, a top cover is arranged at the upper end of the tank body, the first motor is started, the stirring rod can rotate in the tank body, a mixing effect can be provided for medicines in the tank body, the medicines are prevented from depositing at the bottom of the tank body, the medicine spraying quality of the structure in use can be improved, a second motor is started, a driving shaft can drive a liquid outlet box angle, the angle of a spray head can be adjusted, and the medicine spraying range of the spray head can be adjusted conveniently.

title_en: Crushing device for processing heavy calcium carbonate fine powder
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a crushing device for processing fine ground calcium carbonate, which comprises a box body, wherein a screening and crushing device is arranged outside the box body, the screening and crushing device comprises an equipment box, a rotating shaft, a screen plate and a crushing box, the bottom of the box body is fixedly provided with the equipment box, the rotating shaft is rotatably connected to the inside of the equipment box, the screen plate is fixedly arranged on the outer surface of the rotating shaft, and the crushing box is fixedly arranged on the inner bottom wall of the equipment box. This a breaker for fine ground calcium carbonate processing, the calcium carbonate granule after preliminary breakage can fall into on the sieve, and qualified granule can pass the sieve and get into storage incasement and store, and unqualified can leave on the sieve, opens second motor cooperation ejector pin, can let the sieve produce vibrations, and unqualified can fall into broken incasement under the vibrations of sieve and be broken the processing by the secondary to reach and need not the manual work and carry out the mesh of screening, just can carry out the secondary reduction to unqualified calcium carbonate granule.

title_en: Steel slag screening table
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of steel slag screening shaking tables and discloses a steel slag screening shaking table which comprises a shaking table body, wherein a feeding mechanism is arranged at the top of the shaking table body, a collecting tank is arranged at the top of the shaking table body, a pushing mechanism is arranged in the collecting tank, the feeding mechanism comprises a feeding hopper, a collecting box, fixing blocks, a pulling plate and a hydraulic rod, the feeding hopper is fixed at the top of the shaking table body, the collecting box is arranged in the feeding hopper, the fixing blocks are fixed on two sides of the inner wall of the feeding hopper, and the steel slag screening shaking table has the beneficial effects that the feeding mechanism is arranged to add steel slag into the collecting box in the feeding hopper, the output end of the hydraulic rod drives the collecting box to move upwards, and after moving to a proper position, the pulling plate is blocked, the steel slag can fall into the collecting tank, so that the feeding of a user is avoided due to higher feeding effort of the feeding hopper, and convenience is brought to the feeding of the user.

title_en: Dryer drain hole structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of mechanical equipment and discloses a discharging port structure of a dryer, which comprises an equipment main body, wherein the equipment main body is used for drying a put-in material, one side of the equipment main body is provided with a power component used for driving the inside of the equipment to operate, one side of the equipment main body is provided with a discharging pipe used for discharging water, the equipment main body is connected with a discharging component used for putting the material to be dried, and the discharging component is positioned on one side of the discharging pipe.

title_en: Water storage type water purifier with circulating filtration function
abstract_en: The utility model provides a water storage type water purifier with circulating filtration, in particular to the technical field of water storage type water purifiers, which comprises a frame, a barrel cover, a barrel body, a connecting mechanism and a supporting mechanism, wherein the barrel cover is fixedly connected to the inner side surface of the frame, the outer side surface of the barrel cover is communicated with a water inlet pipe, the water storage type water purifier with circulating filtration is characterized in that the barrel body is in butt joint with the barrel cover, then a clamping plate is pulled, the clamping plate drives a second protruding block on the connecting plate to be matched with a first protruding block on a fixing frame to squeeze a first spring, so that the clamping plate is pulled, then the protrusions of the clamping plate are clamped at the bottom of a fixing block on the barrel body, then the first spring rebounds, so that the barrel body is fixed, the barrel body is more conveniently in butt joint and pre-fixed, then a threaded rod is screwed, the threaded rod pushes a supporting plate and stretches the second spring, so that the supporting plate is in butt joint with the bottom of the barrel body, and when the barrel body is detached, the second spring rebounds, so that the barrel body is more convenient to install.

title_en: Manufacturing equipment of biological type expanding agent
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of swelling agent production and processing auxiliary devices, in particular to a biological swelling agent manufacturing device, which can enable staff to quickly take out a mixed and stirred agent, thereby improving the working efficiency and effect of the production and processing swelling agent and enhancing the practicability; including the device main part, still include two sets of installation pieces, two sets of first sliders, the fixed plate, the clamp plate, the second slider, the agitator, the mounting panel, the mounting bracket, the backup pad, first screw rod, first motor, two sets of third sliders, the apron, stirring subassembly, the agitator motor, fixed subassembly, spacing subassembly and resilience subassembly, device main part top left end and right-hand member are connected with a set of installation piece bottom respectively, two sets of installation piece one end are provided with a set of spout respectively, two sets of first slider one end respectively with installation piece spout sliding connection, and two sets of first slider other ends are connected with fixed plate one end respectively, the agitator bottom is hugged closely with fixed plate recess bottom.

title_en: Horizontal centrifuge for barium chloride production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of production and processing of barium chloride, and discloses a horizontal centrifuge for producing the barium chloride, which comprises a base, wherein supporting feet are arranged at four corners of the bottom of the base, a fixed plate is arranged on one side of the top end of the base, a centrifugal motor is arranged on one side of the fixed plate, a cylinder body is arranged on one side of the fixed plate, a centrifugal cavity is arranged in the cylinder body, a rotating shaft driven by the centrifugal motor is arranged in the centrifugal cavity, rotating blades are arranged on the rotating shaft, a plurality of filtering holes are arranged on the centrifugal cavity, a filter screen is arranged in each filtering hole, a drain pipe is arranged at the bottom end of the cylinder body, a first collecting box which is in sliding connection is arranged on the base, and an L-shaped drain pipe extending out of the cylinder body is arranged on one side of the centrifugal cavity. Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the advantages that: not only be convenient for carry out unified collection and empting respectively to liquid and solid after the centrifugation, can prevent moreover that solid barium chloride from piling up when the ejection of compact, ejection of compact efficiency is high.

title_en: Gluing structure for paper product processing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of paper product sizing, in particular to a paper product processing sizing structure, which at least comprises a positioning component, wherein the positioning component is sleeved on a finger and can be used as one side stressed when glue is extruded for locking; the movable assembly is arranged on one side of the movable assembly, which is used for applying force when extruding glue, slides to one side of the positioning assembly to extrude the glue, has a turnover function and is convenient for installing the glue, and is specific: the movable assembly comprises a clamping plate, a spring is arranged on the right side of the clamping plate, a rotating shaft is arranged at the top of the clamping plate, and a rotating plate is connected to the top of the rotating shaft in a rotating mode. Can even extrusion glue, reduce the circumstances that the glue is extravagant and glue disposable extrusion is too much and take place, can get rid of the residue of glue opening part simultaneously, prevent that residue tissue glue from evenly extruding, glue is more convenient when follow-up use like this.

title_en: Rhizoma polygonati soaking device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a sealwort soak device, relate to sealwort processing technology field, it includes soaks the case, the upper portion front side of soaking the case is equipped with the discharge gate, inside slope is equipped with the filter, and the upper side board of filter sets up towards the top before soaking the case, still including the power supply that can drive the vertical removal of filter, when the power supply drive filter vertically removes, the filter drives the sealwort that soaks the incasement and upwards moves, still including vertically locating the soaking incasement portion, and with filter sliding fit's scraper blade, at least one side of soaking the case is equipped with scraper blade side complex spout, and the scraper blade sets up to can be along vertical removal, and can follow the filter back-and-forth slip, and then can push out the sealwort outside the discharge gate from the filter, along with the upwards movement of filter, the scraper blade can push out the sealwort outside the discharge gate from the filter, in order to make things convenient for the collection of sealwort and the processing of soaking water, whole process need not artifical the participation, it is very convenient.

title_en: Variable output mute fog machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a variable output mute fog machine; belongs to the technical field; the technical key point of the device comprises a case, wherein a heating atomization assembly is arranged in the case, the heating atomization assembly is connected with an oil tank through an oil pump, and the heating atomization assembly is connected with an air pump; a control main board connected with the heating atomization component is arranged in the case, and a solid-state relay connected with the air pump is arranged on the control main board; a spraying port matched with the spraying end of the heating atomization assembly is arranged on the case, a fan is arranged in the case at the spraying port, and the fan is connected with the control main board through an electromagnetic filter; the utility model aims to provide a variable output mute fog machine which has a simple structure and can control the air quantity and the smoke quantity; is used for producing smoke in stage light show.

title_en: Sorting device for gangue
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sorting device for gangue, relates to the technical field of kaolin sorting, and aims to solve the problems of at least one of poor accuracy and low sorting precision of kaolin sorting in the prior art. The device comprises a screening component, a conveying component, a blowing component, a true color camera, an X-ray detector, a waste chute and a kaolin chute; the discharging end of the screening component is connected with the feeding end of the conveying component; the true color camera and the X-ray detector are sequentially arranged on a gangue conveying path of the conveying assembly along the running direction of gangue particles, and the X-ray detector is positioned right above the discharge end of the conveying assembly; the blowing subassembly, waste material chute and kaolin chute are located the below of conveying assembly discharge end and set gradually along keeping away from the discharge end. The utility model can be used for sorting gangue.

title_en: Pulp cleaning device and pulp molding machine
abstract_en: The application discloses a pulp cleaning device and a pulp molding machine, comprising: the device comprises a bracket, a spraying mechanism and a translation mechanism; the spray mechanism comprises a spray pipe, a plurality of first nozzles and second nozzles are alternately arranged on the spray pipe from left to right, an arc-shaped water outlet groove extending from left to right is formed in the bottom of the first nozzles, two ends of the arc-shaped water outlet groove are bent upwards, the second nozzles comprise a body, a second water outlet and a guide part, the second water outlet and the guide part are respectively arranged at the bottom of the body, the guide part comprises a first guide surface and a second guide surface which are sequentially connected below the body, a vertical surface passing through a connecting line of the first nozzles and the second nozzles is parallel to the first guide surface, the first guide surface is arranged at the front side of the second water outlet, and the second guide surface is inclined from top to bottom to the rear side and is positioned on a water outlet path of the second water outlet; the translation mechanism is arranged on the bracket, is connected with the spraying mechanism and is used for driving the spraying mechanism to move along the front-back direction. The pulp cleaning device can automatically and comprehensively clean the die.

title_en: Anti-splashing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of splash-proof devices, and provides an outward splash-proof device for blocking mud splash of a triaxial stirring pile machine, which comprises a frame module, a traction module and a shielding module, the frame module is fixed in triaxial stirring stake machine through traction module, and the frame module is trilateral to be embraced in triaxial stirring stake machine pile driving position, shelters from the module to install in the frame module and encircle triaxial stirring stake machine pile driving position. The device is simple to install, convenient to detach and operate, extremely low in cost, convenient to clean and capable of effectively preventing cement paste from being sputtered to the periphery; meanwhile, the frame module is fixed through the traction module, so that the structure is stable, and the frame module is not easy to incline.

title_en: Compound modified asphalt mixture preparation facilities
abstract_en: The utility model provides a preparation device of a composite modified asphalt mixture, which relates to the technical field of asphalt and comprises the following components: the utility model provides a barrel, the top of staving is provided with the top cap, the bottom welding of top cap has the skeleton, four auxiliary rotating shafts are inserted to the bottom activity of skeleton, four the equal fixed cover of exterior wall of auxiliary rotating shafts is equipped with a plurality of auxiliary stirring rake, four auxiliary motors are inserted to the top of skeleton, and the output of four auxiliary motors respectively with the top fixed connection of four auxiliary rotating shafts, the bottom activity of skeleton is inserted and is equipped with main pivot, the exterior wall fixed cover of main pivot is equipped with a plurality of main stirring rake, for current device, the device is from improving the inside heating of pitch heap to pitch heap outside heating originally, can let pitch heap inside evenly mixing to the even effect of pitch heap heating has been improved.

title_en: Filter convenient to dismantle abluent
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of filters, in particular to a filter convenient to detach and clean, which comprises a shell; a cover plate at the top of the housing; the number of the filter plates is three, and the three filter plates are fixedly arranged at the bottom of the cover plate; the two pipe bodies are fixedly arranged on the left side and the right side of the shell respectively; the positioning mechanism is matched with the cover plate and the control mechanism respectively; the quantity of docking mechanism is two sets of, and docking mechanism includes: the utility model relates to a fixing frame and a rotating frame, in which: through pulling the handle on the apron, the handle just can drive the unblock frame and slide on the apron, and the unblock frame just can control two rotating frames and rotate, and two rotating frames then can break away from with the mount, come to the apron unblock, just can dismantle apron and filter plate, conveniently changes the filter plate, and is swift and convenient.

title_en: Grease spraying mechanism for fish feed production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a grease spraying mechanism for fish feed production, which belongs to the field of spraying mechanisms and comprises a bottom plate, wherein a discharge hopper is movably arranged on the bottom plate, a feed hopper is fixedly connected to the discharge hopper, clamping plates are fixedly clamped at the side positions of the feed hopper, clamping grooves are formed in the discharge hopper at the two sides of the clamping plates, a front supporting rod is fixedly connected to the front position of the bottom plate, a rear supporting frame is fixedly arranged at the rear position of the bottom plate, the thickness of feed is limited by the clamping plates moving in the clamping grooves, so that the thickness of the feed at the bottom surface of the discharge hopper is thinner, the grease and feed particles are convenient to fully contact, the grease spraying effect is better, an eccentric wheel pushes the discharge hopper up and down, the discharge hopper vibrates, the feed particles pass through the space between the clamping plates and the discharge hopper more smoothly, and the feed particles are difficult to adhere to the inner wall of the discharge hopper under the effect of grease vibration after the feed particles are wetted by the grease, and the feed particles are easier to roll down.

title_en: Water-based waterproof paint stirring device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a water-based waterproof paint stirring device, which belongs to the technical field of paint stirring devices and comprises a working frame, a supporting frame, a lifting plate, a stirring mechanism, a stirring cover and a stirring barrel; the supporting frame is arranged on the working frame; the lifting plate is arranged on the supporting frame in a sliding way; the supporting frame is provided with a lifting mechanism for driving the lifting plate to lift; the stirring mechanism is rotatably arranged on the lifting plate; the stirring cover is arranged at the lower end of the lifting plate; the stirring barrels are arranged at two positions and are arranged above the working frame; the working frame is provided with a rotating mechanism for driving the stirring barrel to rotate; the stirring cover is connected with the stirring barrel in a clamping way and is detachably connected. According to the utility model, the stirring work and the loading and unloading work can be simultaneously carried out through the rotating mechanism, so that the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Screening structure for crushing machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a screening structure for a crusher, which belongs to the technical field of crushers, and adopts the technical scheme that the screening structure comprises a crusher body, a transmission box and a crushing box, wherein a screening mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the crusher body, and a placing frame is arranged at the bottom of the screening mechanism; screening mechanism includes reel, screen cloth, motor and fixed plate, the rear side of motor and the front side fixed connection of fixed plate, the screen cloth is inlayed in the inside of reel, the fixed plate sets up the rear side at the reel, the equal fixedly connected with branch in both sides of fixed plate front side, the bottom of reel contacts with the top of branch, the equal fixedly connected with stopper in front side and the rear side of reel both sides has solved the discharge gate department of current most crushed aggregates machine bottom and has not possessed screening structure, and inconvenient direct size classification is carried out to the discharged material after smashing, leads to inconvenient carrying out the next step to the material after smashing to influence the problem of result of use.

title_en: Quick screening device for gravel soil particle composition in engineering geological environment investigation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of quick screening devices for forming broken stone soil particles, in particular to a quick screening device for forming broken stone soil particles in engineering geological environment investigation, which comprises a base, wherein the upper end face of the base is provided with a screening device, the screening device comprises a U-shaped frame, the inside of the U-shaped frame is movably connected with a screening bucket through a bearing, the lower end face of the U-shaped frame is fixedly connected with a first L-shaped rack, the upper end face of the base is fixedly connected with a supporting plate, the right end face of the supporting plate is provided with a cylinder, the output end of the cylinder penetrates through the supporting plate and is fixedly connected with a second rack, the outer wall of the second rack is connected with a gear in a meshed manner, broken stone particles with different specifications can be screened through the cooperation of the cylinder, the first rack, the gear, the second rack, the U-shaped frame and the screening bucket, and broken stone with different specifications can be poured into different collecting bins through the cooperation of a motor drainage plate and a guide plate, and therefore the purpose of conveniently and thoroughly screening broken stone is achieved.

title_en: Running gear that photovoltaic board dust removal robot was used
abstract_en: The application discloses a travelling mechanism for a photovoltaic panel dust removal robot, and relates to the technical field of photovoltaic panel dust removal. The application relates to a travelling mechanism for a photovoltaic panel dust removing robot, which comprises travelling wheels, wherein the travelling wheels are arranged in a hollow mode and are internally provided with a driving part, a plurality of first transmission parts and a second transmission part, the driving part and the travelling wheels are coaxially arranged, the driving part can rotate around the axis direction of the driving part, one end parts of the first transmission parts encircle the periphery of the driving part and are in transmission connection with the driving part, the other end parts of the first transmission parts penetrate through the second transmission parts and are in transmission connection with the second transmission parts, and the second transmission parts are coaxially connected with the travelling wheels. According to the travelling mechanism, travelling wheels can walk under the cooperation of the driving part, the first transmission parts and the second transmission parts, and the driving force of the driving part can be effectively amplified by the first transmission parts, so that the driving part is only connected with a low-power motor, and the overall cost of the travelling mechanism is greatly reduced.

title_en: Road construction grinds flat device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of road construction leveling devices, and discloses a road construction leveling device, which comprises a fixed rod, wherein the surface of the fixed rod is fixedly connected with a fixed sleeve, one side of the surface of the fixed rod is fixedly connected with a baffle plate, one end of the fixed rod is fixedly connected with a protective shell, the top of the protective shell is sleeved with a spraying component, the other side of the surface of the fixed rod is fixedly connected with a telescopic component, the other end of the fixed rod is connected with a fixed column in a sliding manner, the middle of the surface of the fixed column is fixedly connected with a handle, the road construction leveling device is connected with an external power supply through the arrangement of the spraying component, the water pump is started, water in a water tank is pumped out through a water inlet pipe and then conveyed to a water outlet pipe, and a spray head sprays water by utilizing water pressure so as to achieve the effects of water mist and dust collision, so as to prevent the water mist from sinking.

title_en: Hydraulic impact crusher with efficient damping structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hydraulic impact crusher with a high-efficiency damping structure, which relates to the technical field of crushing damping of crushers, and aims to solve the problems that the existing crushers lack a damping structure at the fixing position of an impact plate and the overall damping performance is to be improved, and the inside of every slide hole is all slidable mounting has a gag lever post, the one end fixedly connected with movable mounting seat of gag lever post, fixedly connected with a plurality of electromagnetism mount pads on the upper surface of mount, the internally mounted of electromagnetism mount pad has electromagnetic mechanism, the one end of electromagnetism mount pad is provided with powerful permanent magnet steel, powerful permanent magnet steel is installed on the upper surface of movable mounting seat. The impact force transmitted on the impact plate can be absorbed efficiently, and the efficient damping operation effect is achieved.

title_en: High-efficient sedimentation tank scarfing cinder system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a slag removing system of a high-efficiency sedimentation tank, which comprises a tank body, wherein a mud scraper is arranged at the bottom of the tank body, a skimming machine is also arranged in the tank body, the skimming machine is arranged close to any side wall of the tank body, at least one slag brushing mechanism is arranged at the upper part of the tank body, the slag brushing mechanism comprises a plurality of jet nozzles, air outlets of the jet nozzles are obliquely downwards arranged, air outlets of the jet nozzles face the direction of the skimming machine, and an inlet of the jet nozzles is connected with a fluid source. The utility model has the remarkable effects that the pipeline with the directional jet nozzle is arranged at the upper part of the high-efficiency sedimentation tank, and the flow of the floating mud and the scum to the skimming machine can be accelerated by directional jet flow to the surface of the water body, thereby improving the efficiency of deslagging and skimming and reducing the drainage of the skimming machine.

title_en: Ultrasonic cleaner for oil stains on chain production surface
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ultrasonic cleaner for oil stains on the surface of chain production, which comprises a cleaning mechanism, wherein the cleaning mechanism comprises a cleaning pool, an ultrasonic generator and a mounting plate, the ultrasonic generator is fixed at the bottom of the cleaning pool, the mounting plate is arranged above the cleaning pool, a movable mechanism and a drying mechanism are arranged above the ultrasonic generator, the movable mechanism comprises a cleaning cylinder, a plurality of water outlets are formed in the surface of the cleaning cylinder, a box door is hinged to the surface of the cleaning cylinder, a motor is arranged above the cleaning cylinder, an output shaft of the motor penetrates through the mounting plate and is fixedly provided with a transmission shaft, two sides of the cleaning cylinder are fixedly provided with a linkage shaft, and the drying mechanism comprises a hot air blower. The utility model has the advantages of enabling the chain to move during cleaning and rapidly drying the chain, and solves the problems that the cleaning effect of the chain is poor and the rapid drying is difficult to realize in the cleaning process of the existing chain.

title_en: Heat-insulating anti-slip cosmetic bottle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cosmetic bottles, in particular to a heat-insulating anti-skid cosmetic bottle, which comprises a base, wherein the inner wall of the base is fixedly connected with the outer wall of a pressing pump, the inner wall of the pressing pump is fixedly connected with the outer wall of a blocking piece, the bottle is placed on a flat surface when in use, a rubber ring is contacted with the flat surface, the rubber ring is pressed, air between the rubber ring and the contact surface is discharged through an exhaust hole when in pressing, a sliding ring is used for blocking the exhaust hole, a closed space is formed between the rubber ring and the contact surface, negative pressure is formed between the rubber ring and the contact surface through the rebound resilience of the rubber ring, the rubber ring is adsorbed, the bottle is fixed, the sliding ring is slid upwards when the bottle needs to be taken down, the sliding ring drives the blocking piece to be pulled out from the exhaust hole, and the negative pressure of the air entering between the rubber ring and the contact surface can be taken down, so that the bottle is prevented from falling down due to accidental collision, and convenience is brought to the use of people.

title_en: Improved generation reation kettle oxygen conveyor
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of reaction kettles, in particular to an improved reaction kettle oxygen conveying device which comprises a device body and an air inlet pipe, wherein the interior of the device body is connected with the air inlet pipe, the interior of the device body is connected with an air outlet pipe, the end part of the air outlet pipe is connected with a flange plate, a placing groove is processed in the flange plate, and the outer wall of the device body is fixedly connected with a motor. The roller in the control device drives the sliding groove to rotate, the sliding groove drives the sliding block to move, the sliding block drives the vertical plate to move, the vertical plate drives the connecting block to move, the connecting block slides in the sliding way, the vertical plate drives the through hole to move, the corresponding through hole moves to the position of the air outlet pipe to control the flow of oxygen, the oxygen conveying device is arranged to control the flow of oxygen conveying through the control device when the oxygen is conveyed to the inside of the reaction kettle, and the conveying effect of the oxygen conveying device is improved.

title_en: Environment-friendly cleaning machine for textile fabric processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an environment-friendly cleaning machine for processing textile fabrics, which belongs to the technical field of textile fabric processing, and adopts the technical scheme that the cleaning machine comprises a cleaning tank, wherein a flushing component is fixedly connected inside the cleaning tank, a throwing component is fixedly connected at the top of the cleaning tank, an extrusion component is fixedly connected at the top of the cleaning tank, the working position of the flushing component is firstly fixed through the cleaning tank, the effect of flushing the fabrics is achieved through the flushing component, then the working position of subassembly is put in through the fixed throwing component of washing pond to reach the effect of being convenient for put in the washing liquid through throwing component, finally extrude the washing liquid in the surface fabric through the extrusion subassembly, be convenient for carry out the follow-up rinsing, fixed pipe working position is fixed through the washing pond, then the working position of fixed pipe fixing water pipe, and pass through the fixed pipe of raceway intercommunication and shower nozzle, thereby be convenient for the shower nozzle sprays the washing liquid to the surface fabric, washs the surface fabric.

title_en: Irrigation district channel dredging equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses irrigation area channel dredging equipment, which belongs to the technical field of channel dredging and aims at solving the problems of unsmooth drainage, even blockage and poor water source fluidity in a channel, and comprises a channel body, wherein the channel body further comprises a mounting frame, the mounting frame is fixed on one side wall of the channel body, a water inlet pipe is fixed on one side wall of the mounting frame, two symmetrically distributed mounting plates are fixed on the inner side wall of the channel body, grid plates are connected with the adjacent side walls of the two mounting plates in a sliding manner, and a dredging assembly is arranged on one side of the channel body; according to the utility model, the water source can be treated through the arrangement of the dredging assembly, so that special requirements in water quality of the irrigation area are effectively met, the situation that the water source is blocked by impurities such as pasture and water is prevented, the water quality requirement of the water source of the irrigation area can be met, the utilization rate of channel dredging equipment of the irrigation area is improved, and the long-term dredging operation of the water source of the irrigation area is effectively realized.

title_en: Total station with protective structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a total station with a protection structure, which comprises a total station body, wherein extension blocks are arranged on two sides of the total station body, positioning grooves are formed in the tops of the extension blocks, protection plates are arranged outside the total station body, fixed blocks are arranged on two sides inside the protection plates, positioning blocks are arranged at the bottoms of the fixed blocks, the positioning blocks are matched with the positioning grooves, sliding rods penetrate through the tops of the protection plates in a sliding mode, pressing plates and mounting frames are respectively arranged at two ends of the sliding rods, reset springs are arranged between the pressing plates and the protection plates, cleaning rollers are rotatably arranged inside the mounting frames, and cleaning sponge is sleeved outside the cleaning rollers. According to the utility model, the total station body can be protected through the protection plate, so that the influence of outdoor rainy and snowy weather on the total station work is avoided, the lens of the total station body is cleaned through the cleaning roller, and the working cleanliness of the lens is ensured.

title_en: Magnetic float level meter
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a magnetic float liquid level meter which comprises a liquid level shell, wherein a detection magnetic float is arranged on the inner side of the liquid level shell, a scale magnetic plate is connected to the outer side of the detection magnetic float, a vacuum cover is arranged on the outer side of the liquid level shell, and the vacuum cover is arranged on the outer side of the scale magnetic plate. The utility model has the advantages of good protection effect and capability of cleaning the surface of the scale, the first mounting plate and the second mounting plate can be connected to the outer side of the liquid inlet pipe through the clamping connection between the clamping blocks and the clamping grooves, the first protection plate and the second protection plate are driven to move to the side close to each other through the rotation of the bidirectional screw rod, the protection of the liquid level shell and the vacuum cover is realized after the first protection plate and the second protection plate move to a certain distance, and meanwhile, the impact force caused by the impact of an external object or staff on the liquid level shell and the vacuum cover is effectively reduced through the vacuum cover and the protection pad, so that the protection effect on the liquid level shell and the vacuum cover is realized.

title_en: Spraying winding insulating tube processingequipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a spraying winding insulating pipe processing device which comprises a turntable, wherein a bearing mechanism is arranged in the turntable and used for fixing the insulating pipe during spraying winding, the bearing mechanism comprises a clamping unit, and the clamping unit is arranged in the turntable and used for supporting and fixing the insulating pipe. This spraying winding insulating tube processingequipment, through having the joint board in the draw-in groove, the joint board surface has the rack, the backup pad is connected with the tooth, the spout has been seted up on the surface of backup pad, the main gear respectively with tooth and rack's surface engagement, it is mostly fixed size to have solved insulating tube and have carried out spraying winding fixing device, this just makes the insulating tube of different pipe diameters can't satisfy fixed operation when producing, need professional demolish fixing device, then again jin ning installation and long-time calibration operation, can occupy a large amount of time, waste time and energy, improve workman intensity of labour, influence the problem of production duration.

title_en: Silicone resin synthesizer
abstract_en: The present utility model provides a silicone resin synthesizing device, comprising: compared with the prior art, the utility model has the advantages that the silicon resin is synthesized by using the tank body, the upper connecting seat and the lower connecting seat are mutually clamped and locked by using the locking part, the tank body and the cover body are ensured to be in sealing fit, the silicone resin in the synthesis cavity is synthesized and stirred by using the stirring blade, the joint of the upper connecting seat and the lower connecting seat is reinforced by using the reinforcing strip, the internal temperature of the synthesis cavity is increased by using the heating coil, and meanwhile, the pressure in the synthesis cavity is regulated by using the pressurizing tube, so that the precise synthesis is performed.

title_en: High concentration COD effluent treatment plant convenient to operation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-concentration COD wastewater treatment device convenient to operate, which comprises a wastewater tank, wherein the inner wall of the top of the wastewater tank is connected with a main stirring frame in a centering and rotating way, a medicine supply assembly is arranged outside the main stirring frame, the medicine supply assembly comprises a temporary storage chamber fixedly sleeved with a rotating shaft of the main stirring frame, a plurality of groups of spray heads distributed equidistantly are arranged on the outer wall of the bottom of the temporary storage chamber, a rotating disc is slidably sleeved on the outer wall of the circumference of the main stirring frame, the rotating disc rotates the inner wall of the circumference of the temporary storage chamber which is connected, a connecting pipe is fixedly inserted on the outer wall of the top of the rotating disc, and one end of the connecting pipe penetrates the top of the wastewater tank and extends outwards.

title_en: Amino silicone oil conveying device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an amino silicone oil conveying device which comprises a feeding pipe (1) and a discharging pipe (2), wherein a suction pump (3) is arranged on the feeding pipe (1) or the discharging pipe (2), a filter for separating crystals from amino silicone oil is arranged between the feeding pipe (1) and the discharging pipe (2), an ablation mechanism for the crystals is arranged on the filter, the filter comprises a vertical pipe (4), the upper end of the vertical pipe (4) is connected with the feeding pipe (1), a sealing plate (5) is arranged at the lower end of the vertical pipe (4), a transverse pipe (6) is arranged on the side wall of the vertical pipe (4), a filter plate (7) is arranged at the joint of the transverse pipe (6) and the vertical pipe (4), and the outer side end of the transverse pipe (6) is connected with the discharging pipe (2). The utility model has the advantage of improving the production efficiency of the amino silicone oil emulsion on the basis of ensuring the quality of the amino silicone oil emulsion.

title_en: Reaction bottle stoving rack
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a reaction bottle drying rack, and relates to the technical field of reaction bottle drying. The utility model relates to a reaction bottle drying rack, which comprises a drying table, wherein a connecting box is arranged at the lower end of the drying table, a hot air dryer is arranged below the connecting box, the hot air dryer is communicated with the connecting box through an air pipe, a plurality of drying pipes and electric telescopic rods are equidistantly arranged on the drying table, the electric telescopic rods are staggered with the drying pipes, the drying pipes are communicated with the connecting box, double-opening fixing boxes are fixedly connected to the telescopic ends of every two adjacent electric telescopic rods between the drying pipes, and single-opening fixing boxes are arranged on the telescopic ends of the two electric telescopic rods at the outermost side.

title_en: Silver paste configuration device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of silver paste configuration devices and discloses a silver paste configuration device which comprises a base, wherein a support is fixedly arranged at the top of the base, a tank body is fixedly sleeved in the support, and a bottom plate is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the tank body. According to the utility model, by arranging the push-pull rod, the first motor, the disc and the round block, when an operator needs to discharge silver paste, the first motor is started, so that the rotating shaft can drive the disc to rotate, and the round block can squeeze and push the inner surface of the push-pull rod, so that the push-pull rod rotates around the round rod as an axis, and the round block can continuously drive the push-pull rod to move along with the continuous rotation of the disc, so that the push-pull rod can continuously push the discharge pipe to move, the discharge pipe can vibrate, the discharge speed of silver paste can be accelerated, and the production efficiency of silver paste is improved.

title_en: Drum-type three-dimensional emulsifier raw materials preparation storage bucket
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of auxiliary equipment for emulsifier production, and discloses a drum-type stereoscopic emulsifier raw material preparation charging basket, which comprises a frame, wherein a barrel body is fixedly arranged in the center of the frame, the novel water tank is characterized in that a discharging pipe is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the tank body, a tank cover is fixedly arranged at the top of the tank body, a feeding pipe and a liquid inlet pipe are fixedly arranged inside the tank cover, a rotating assembly is arranged on the frame, and the rotating assembly comprises a bracket. This cylinder type three-dimensional emulsifier raw materials preparation storage bucket, in order to prepare the emulsifier raw materials better, through being provided with the rotation subassembly, the servo asynchronous motor in the start support outside to cooperation pivot, fixed block, stirring tooth, short column, arc oar and toper cover make stirring mixing effect better, cooperate major axis, drive assembly and auger oar simultaneously, can further promote stirring effect, can prepare the emulsifier raw materials better then.

title_en: Stirring device capable of preventing sundries from entering
