abstract_en: The utility model provides a stirring device for preventing sundries from entering, which relates to the technical field of stirring devices and comprises a cover body and a blocking mechanism, wherein the blocking mechanism is arranged at the top end of the cover body, the blocking mechanism is used for blocking the sundries from entering a stirring process, the damage of the sundries to equipment is prevented, the service life of the device is prolonged, a filter screen is used for blocking the sundries with larger volume, a closed channel is formed by a closed plate support frame so as to facilitate the inflow of mixed water, the closed plate is abutted against a separation preventing position by an abutting plate, the abutting plate is rotated to separate from the limit of the closed plate, the closed plate is rotated to be opened, a control gear is used for driving a rotating rod to rotate, so that a filter screen is turned over, a C-shaped frame provides a guiding function for sundries to slide down, the sundries of the filter screen are reduced, a driving motor is used for driving a fan blade to stir the mixed water, the mixed water is accommodated by a barrel body, and the stirred mixed water is guided out by a liquid discharging valve.

title_en: Volatile oil extraction collector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a volatile oil extraction collector, which comprises a reaction tank, wherein two sides of the upper end of the front surface of the reaction tank are respectively provided with a liquid inlet and a liquid inlet, one end of a mixing and crushing assembly arranged in the middle of the lower end inside the reaction tank is connected with the output end of a driving motor, the middle of the upper end of the reaction tank is connected with the middle of the lower end of the separation tank through a connecting pipe, a first one-way valve is arranged on the connecting pipe, meanwhile, an oil-water separation assembly is arranged inside the separation tank, one side of the separation tank is provided with a water drain pipe and an oil drain pipe, the other end of the water drain pipe is connected with one side of the reaction tank, and the other end of the oil drain pipe is connected with the upper end of a collection tank. The volatile oil extraction collector is provided with the mixing and crushing assembly and the driving motor, the mixing and crushing assembly is driven by the driving motor to rotate in the reaction tank, and liquid and spice plant fragments are stirred and mixed while larger spice plant fragments are crushed, so that the extraction efficiency is improved.

title_en: Bean grinder
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a bean grinder, which aims at solving the technical problem that discharged soybeans are easy to splash outwards and fall outside due to a bean baffle plate due to a gap generated by the height difference between a current discharging pipe and a collecting cylinder, and comprises a discharging tank, a discharging pipe, a connecting structure and the collecting cylinder; the soybean milk collecting device comprises a discharging tank, a collecting cylinder, a discharging pipe, a connecting structure and a collecting cylinder, wherein the discharging pipe is arranged on the top wall of an inner cavity of the discharging tank, the connecting structure is arranged at the bottom of the discharging pipe, the collecting cylinder is arranged on the bottom wall of the inner cavity of the discharging tank, the connecting structure comprises a connecting ring plate A, a corrugated pipe, a connecting ring plate B and an annular inserting plate, the connecting ring plate A is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the discharging pipe, the top end of the corrugated pipe is connected with the bottom side of the connecting ring plate A, the connecting ring plate B is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the corrugated pipe, the annular inserting plate is fixedly arranged at the bottom side of the connecting ring plate B, the connecting ring plate B is pulled to move downwards, the corrugated pipe extends, the annular inserting plate is correspondingly inserted into an opening of the collecting cylinder, and discharged soybean milk is fully introduced into the collecting cylinder along the corrugated pipe.

title_en: Drilling fluid online monitoring system with automatic cleaning function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a drilling fluid online monitoring system with an automatic cleaning function, which belongs to the technical field of drilling fluid monitoring and comprises a medium input and output module, an ion concentration measuring module and a rheological property measuring module. Through the mode, the utility model discloses an integrated drilling fluid performance monitoring device comprising functions of drilling fluid extraction, drilling fluid performance parameter measurement, clear water flushing, air flushing and the like, wherein the system automatic cleaning function comprises the step of performing full-aspect water flushing and air flushing on a pipeline through which the drilling fluid flows and a measuring device contact surface contacted with the drilling fluid, so that system errors caused by solidification of the drilling fluid after the drilling fluid is attached to a pipeline and a sensor measuring point are avoided, and the problems of imperfect functions of parameter measurement, cleaning and the like, poor system operation efficiency, poor system robustness, increased system errors caused by multiple operation of a system and the like of the conventional drilling fluid on-line monitoring device are effectively solved.

title_en: I0T thing networking security protection detector alarm device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of security alarm equipment, and discloses an I0T (internet of things) security detector alarm device which comprises an alarm, wherein a protective shell is arranged at the bottom of the alarm, a driving motor is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the alarm, and a driving disc is fixedly arranged on the power output shaft of the driving motor. This I0T thing networking security protection detector alarm device to through the driving motor that sets up on the outer wall of siren to and the connecting rod that sets up on driving motor's outer wall, in long-term use, clear up the advance cigarette hole regularly, only need under driving motor's drive for the driving disk drives the connecting rod and do reciprocating motion, thereby in connecting rod's reciprocating motion in-process, can drive the clearance board and reciprocate, can clear up advance the cigarette hole under the effect of clearance pole this moment, guarantee advance the cigarette hole and can advance cigarette normally, avoid advancing the condition that the cigarette hole appears blocking, make equipment carry out security protection alarm work better.

title_en: Semi-automatic preserved fruit soaking and screening production line
abstract_en: The semi-automatic preserved fruit soaking and screening production line is characterized by comprising a preserved fruit soaking tank, an inclined preserved fruit dragging and delivering device and a preserved fruit screening table, wherein the inclined preserved fruit dragging and delivering device comprises a frame, a reciprocating chain conveying mechanism and at least one dragging basket, the dragging basket is arranged on the reciprocating chain conveying mechanism, the preserved fruit screening table is positioned below an outlet of the inclined preserved fruit dragging and delivering device, a syrup reflux tank is arranged on the frame, the syrup reflux tank is positioned below the reciprocating chain conveying mechanism, and a syrup reflux tank outlet is positioned at the bottom of an inner cavity of the preserved fruit soaking tank. Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the beneficial effects that the inclined preserved fruit picking and delivering device and the preserved fruit screening table are arranged, so that the picking and delivering of the preserved fruit can be automatically completed, the preserved fruit screening device is convenient for operators to screen the preserved fruit, the structure is simple, the working efficiency is high, the syrup can be effectively recovered, and the leakage of the syrup to pollute the environment is effectively avoided.

title_en: Medical precision drill bit cleaning tool
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a medical precision drill bit cleaning tool, which relates to the technical field of medical equipment and comprises a device main body, a sealing gasket, a rotating shaft and a sliding plate, wherein the sealing gasket is adhered to the bottom of the device main body, a bottom bin is arranged at the bottom of the sealing gasket, a control device is arranged at one end side surface of the device main body, a water outlet is welded at the other side of the device main body and the bottom bin, a mounting plate is welded at the other end of the device main body, the rotating shaft is driven by a driving motor to rotate, the rotating shaft is driven by the rotating shaft to rotate, the rotating shaft can drive the roller at the bottom of a drill bit to rotate in the same direction, the roller can drive the drill bit to rotate, the drill bit can rotate while flushing, the surface can be uniformly flushed, dead angles are avoided in the flushing process, and the device can simultaneously clean the drill bits with different specifications and sizes, so that the convenience of cleaning the drill bit is improved.

title_en: Waterway plate and water purifying equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of water treatment equipment, and discloses a waterway plate and water purification equipment. The water channel pipeline is arranged on the fixed plate and comprises a pure water pipeline and a backflow pipeline, the pure water pipeline comprises a pure water inlet, the backflow pipeline comprises a backflow inlet and a backflow outlet, and the pure water pipeline is communicated with the backflow pipeline. Pure water can be led into the return pipe, so that the pure water enters the filter element through the return pipe to flush and clean the filter element. The flow of pure water can take away dirt, sediment and impurity on the filter element and discharge the dirt and impurity through the waste water gap, thereby recovering the filtering effect of the filter element.

title_en: Raw material vibration distributor for calcium carbonate production
abstract_en: The utility model provides a raw material vibration distributor for calcium carbonate production, which comprises a supporting substrate, a flexible supporting structure, a shaking base, a vibration motor, an auxiliary spring, a distributing bin, a discharging port and a powder discharging pipe, wherein the flexible supporting structure is fixedly arranged between the supporting substrate and the shaking base and between the supporting substrate and the distributing bin respectively, the shaking base is fixedly arranged at the top of the flexible supporting structure, the vibration motor is fixedly arranged in the shaking base, the auxiliary spring is fixedly arranged between the shaking base and the distributing bin, the distributing bin is fixedly arranged above the auxiliary spring, the discharging port is fixedly arranged at one end of the distributing bin, the powder discharging pipe is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the discharging port, and the flexible supporting structure and the distributing bin are arranged so that vibration can effectively generate to enable calcium carbonate raw materials to be screened, and powder can not fly in disorder after equipment is opened.

title_en: Ultrasonic cleaner with elevation structure
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of textile cleaning, and particularly relates to an ultrasonic cleaning machine with a lifting structure, which comprises a cleaning tank and two compression rollers, wherein the cleaning tank is used for cleaning textile cloth, two ultrasonic transducers are fixedly connected to the inner wall of the bottom of the cleaning tank, four supporting plates are fixedly connected to the top of the cleaning tank, two conveying rollers are rotatably connected between the two supporting plates positioned on the same side, and a portal frame is fixedly connected to the top of the cleaning tank. The device has reasonable structural design, the heights of the two press rolls can be adjusted, so that the depth of the woven cloth pressed into water can be adjusted through the press rolls, the cleaning time of the woven cloth can be adjusted according to the cleaning requirement, the practicability of the device is improved, the woven cloth can be better cleaned, the cleaning effect is improved, after cleaning, the water in the woven cloth can be extruded firstly, and then the woven cloth is dried, so that the drying efficiency is improved.

title_en: Compound microecological ferment reducing mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of microbial fermentation, and provides a composite microecological fermented product crushing device which comprises a crushing tank, wherein supporting legs distributed at equal intervals are welded on the outer walls of the periphery of the crushing tank, and the top of the crushing tank is provided with an annular limiting groove, an arc-shaped sliding block is slidably arranged in the annular limiting groove, and a toothed ring is fixed at the top of the arc-shaped sliding block. When the semi-solid substrate is crushed, the detachable hemispherical screen mesh is firstly utilized to separate the semi-solid substrate, after the solid is reserved, the impact of the telescopic cylinder is utilized to be matched with the extrusion of the hemispherical crushing block, the solid can be extruded and crushed, the solid is discharged from the hemispherical screen mesh, the extruded hemispherical screen mesh with proper aperture can be selected according to actual needs, the operation is convenient, the application range is wide, and in the extrusion crushing process, the hemispherical crushing block is driven to rotate by the servo motor, so that the crushing effect can be improved.

title_en: Multimode entrance guard's equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-mode access control device which comprises a mounting plate, wherein a fixing plate is fixedly arranged on the front surface of the mounting plate, a limiting groove is formed in the front surface of the fixing plate, an adjusting screw rod is rotatably arranged in the limiting groove, and a motor is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the fixing plate. The multi-mode access control equipment is characterized in that the mounting plate, the fixing plate, the access control body, the adjusting screw rod, the limiting groove, the electric telescopic rod, the adjusting block, the fixing frame, the motor, the connecting plate, the fingerprint identification module, the access control card reader module, the iris camera and the face camera are matched for use, and the effect of vertical adjustment of the access control body is achieved through driving of the motor, so that when people using different heights use the access control body, the face of the user and the identification part on the access control body are positioned on the same horizontal line through adjusting the vertical position of the access control body.

title_en: Masterbatch production waste collection device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of masterbatch production waste treatment, and particularly relates to a masterbatch production waste collection device which comprises a trolley, wherein a collection box is fixedly connected to the top of the trolley, a first feed port is communicated with the top of the collection box, a first crushing roller is rotatably connected to the inner side wall of the collection box, a second crushing roller is rotatably connected to the inner side wall of the collection box, a first straight gear is rotatably connected to one side wall of the collection box, one end of the first crushing roller is connected with the first straight gear, a second straight gear is rotatably connected to one side wall of the collection box, waste is added into a fixed cylinder through the second feed port, a first output motor is started to drive a spiral impeller to rotate, and in the rotating process of the spiral impeller, the waste can be conveyed into a discharge pipe, and the waste enters the collection box through the first feed port, so that the effect of collecting the waste can be achieved, the working efficiency of the waste collection is improved, and the labor intensity of workers is reduced.

title_en: Anti-pollution environmental waste water treatment mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wastewater treatment mechanism for anti-pollution environment, which relates to the technical field of environmental engineering, and comprises a treatment frame, wherein one side of the bottom end of the treatment frame is communicated with a liquid outlet pipe, a valve matched with the liquid outlet pipe is fixedly arranged on the liquid outlet pipe, one end of the liquid outlet pipe, which is close to the treatment frame, is fixedly inserted with a filter disc matched with the liquid outlet pipe, the upper end of one side of the treatment frame is fixedly provided with a separation mechanism, the inner side of the treatment frame is provided with a mixing mechanism matched with the separation mechanism, the separation mechanism is used for effectively intercepting large-particle impurities in wastewater, and after a period of time of interception, a separation net barrel with the large-particle impurities is turned to a state with an opening obliquely downward, and the other separation net barrel is turned to the uppermost end, so that a user can conveniently and effectively clean the large-particle impurities intercepted in the corresponding separation net barrel, the cleaning and the wastewater filtering operation are synchronously carried out, and the wastewater treatment efficiency is effectively improved.

title_en: Dust screen for building engineering
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of constructional engineering and discloses a dust screen for constructional engineering, which comprises a main body mechanism and an auxiliary supporting mechanism, wherein the auxiliary supporting mechanism is positioned above the main body mechanism, the main body mechanism comprises a supporting base and a dust screen body, the dust screen body is positioned above the supporting base, the main body mechanism also comprises a winding motor, a winding roller and a bearing seat, the winding motor is fixedly arranged at the left end inside the supporting base, the winding roller is fixedly arranged at the transmission end at the right end of the winding motor, and the dust screen body is positioned at the outer end of the winding roller. This dust screen for building engineering, through installing main part mechanism, when having realized this dust screen and carrying out the dustproof operation of building engineering, the staff can be through the operation to the rolling motor, carries out quick rolling to the dust screen to reduce the volume of dust screen, be convenient for the staff to transport or accomodate the operation to it, improved convenience and the practicality that this dust screen used.

title_en: Turning auxiliary device for concrete filling vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a turning auxiliary device for a concrete filling vehicle, which comprises a positioning rail, wherein a protective box is arranged on the side surface of the positioning rail, a driving assembly is arranged in the protective box, a monitoring assembly is arranged on the side surface of the protective box, a steering assembly for driving the monitoring assembly to steer is arranged on the side surface of the protective box, a mounting plate is arranged at the driving end of the steering assembly, the monitoring assembly is mounted on the side surface of the mounting plate, and a protective cover for protecting the monitoring assembly is arranged on the side surface of the mounting plate. This concrete filling car is with auxiliary device that turns around, the monitoring component position is adjustable setting, can assist the driver master to monitor vehicle surrounding environment when the concrete filling car backs a car or turns around, and the driver master of being convenient for carries out the safety judgement to the vehicle blind area, is provided with the clearance subassembly that is used for monitoring the clearance of the outside foreign matter of subassembly simultaneously, prevents that foreign matter such as concrete mud, dust from adhering to and causing the influence to its use in monitoring component position department.

title_en: Transfer device for machinery
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a transfer device for machinery, which comprises a box body, wherein a through hole is formed in one side of the box body, a push rod is fixedly arranged on the other side of the box body, a base is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the box body, supporting legs are fixedly arranged at the bottom of the base, pulleys are arranged at the bottoms of the supporting legs, a protection mechanism is arranged on one side of the box body, the protection mechanism comprises a supporting plate, a sliding rail, a protection plate, a mounting block, a sliding block, a supporting plate, a mounting plate and a handle, the supporting plate is fixedly arranged on one side of the box body, the sliding rail is fixedly arranged on one side of the supporting plate, the protection plate is arranged on one side of the box body, and the mounting block is fixedly arranged on the front surface of the protection plate. Through being provided with protection machanism and having played the effect that one side of the box of being convenient for opens and closes, can open one side of box when making the bearing need take out from the box, be favorable to reducing the operation degree of difficulty and improve work efficiency.

title_en: Cooling device of forging for deep sea petroleum exploitation equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of forge piece cooling for deep sea petroleum exploitation equipment, in particular to a forge piece cooling device for deep sea petroleum exploitation equipment, which comprises a cooling table, wherein a first motor is fixedly connected to the center of the bottom end of the cooling table, a support column is fixedly connected to the top end of the cooling table, a horizontally arranged fixing table is fixedly connected to the output end of the first motor, an annular groove is formed in the bottom end of the fixing table, a vertical plate is fixedly connected to the top end of the fixing table, and a screw rod in threaded connection with the vertical plate passes through the vertical plate.

title_en: Dampproofing equipment for packing of combination fireworks surface
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a combined firework outer surface moistureproof packaging device, which belongs to the technical field of firework packaging and comprises a supporting table, a moistureproof air-drying assembly, a dustproof assembly and an auxiliary assembly, wherein the moistureproof air-drying assembly is fixedly arranged at the top end of the supporting table, the dustproof assembly is arranged on the moistureproof air-drying assembly, the auxiliary assembly is in sliding connection with the moistureproof air-drying assembly, and the combined firework outer surface moistureproof packaging device can be used for rapidly air-drying an adhesive for packaging the combined firework outer surface, so that the combined firework is prevented from being wetted due to long-term non-drying by the adhesive, dust particles on the outer surface of the combined firework can be sucked, the cleaning effect is improved, and meanwhile, the combined firework can be fixedly placed in an auxiliary manner, and the combined firework packaging device is convenient to use.

title_en: Minced fillet processing rotary screen
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a surimi processing rotary screen, which comprises an outer screening cylinder and an inner screening cylinder, wherein the inner screening cylinder is positioned in the outer screening cylinder, the outer screening cylinder and the inner screening cylinder are coaxial, a first screen is arranged on the outer surface of the outer screening cylinder, a first gear is fixedly connected with one end of the outer surface of the outer screening cylinder, the utility model has the beneficial effects that materials can be input into the inner screening cylinder through a set feed hopper, then through the power unit who sets up screening section of thick bamboo and outer screening section of thick bamboo rotation in the simultaneous driving, wherein, the second gear that power unit set up, second belt pulley, first gear, first belt pulley and drive belt are mutually supported and are connected to can make outer screening section of thick bamboo and interior screening section of thick bamboo rotate in opposite direction, then can carry out the screening that rotates to the material, can improve the effect of material screening.

title_en: Laboratory is with high-efficient desorption device that absorbs
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of desorption, in particular to a high-efficiency adsorption and desorption device for a laboratory, which comprises a base, wherein a protection box is arranged above the base, a removable adsorption and desorption structure is arranged in the protection box in a sliding manner, the removable adsorption and desorption structure comprises an active carbon storage box, a plurality of placing plates arranged in the active carbon storage box, and a hollow sealing door connected to the side opening of the active carbon storage box, a plurality of ventilation grooves are formed in the placing plates in a penetrating manner, and a sealing door is arranged at the side opening of the protection box. According to the utility model, the adsorption and desorption of impurities are not required to be completed in the adsorption and desorption structure cavity through the removable adsorption and desorption structure, so that the activated carbon with saturated adsorption can be replaced from the adsorption and desorption structure cavity, thorough and efficient desorption is facilitated, and meanwhile, the activated carbon can achieve a better regeneration purpose, and the re-adsorption effect of the activated carbon is not influenced.

title_en: Batch production device based on 3D prints sand casting technique
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mass production device based on a 3D printing sand casting technology, which comprises a support frame, a conveying mechanism, a detection assembly and a pushing assembly, wherein the conveying mechanism is arranged on the upper end face of the support frame, the detection assembly is arranged above the support frame, the pushing assembly is arranged on the upper end face of the support frame, and the conveying mechanism comprises a main transmission assembly and a secondary transmission assembly. The device is installed the output at 3D printing apparatus with main transmission subassembly when using, the casting model is transported through transport mechanism, detect the specific casting model shape of subassembly detection, pushing away material subassembly pushes the casting model in different inferior transmission subassemblies, when the one-machine multi-purpose of 3D printing apparatus, when printing different casting models, so that follow-up pouring to the casting model, be convenient for batch production 3D prints sand mould casting model, and when removing, avoid moving equipment or damage casting model when snatching equipment, prevent to influence follow-up casting to the casting model.

title_en: Sewage filtering device for environmental protection engineering
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of environmental protection engineering, and discloses a sewage filtering device used in the environmental protection engineering, which comprises a bracket, wherein a filter cartridge is fixedly arranged on the top surface of the bracket in a penetrating way, a sealing top cover is arranged on the top surface of the filter cartridge, a liquid inlet pipe is fixedly arranged on the outer surface of the filter cartridge, a motor drives a rotating shaft and a scraping rod to rotate, so that sundries and particles on a conical filter plate are rotationally moved, when the moved sundries and particles pass through a discharge pipe, the moved sundries and particles can enter the interior of a material collecting box body through the discharge pipe and fall on the filter plate under the continuous flushing of sewage water flow, and when personnel observe that the sundries and the particles in the interior of the material collecting box body are more through transparent glass, the sealing plate can be opened to clean the sundries in the material collecting box body, the sundries and the particles can be effectively prevented from being blocked by discharging the sundries and the particles from the conical filter plate, and meanwhile, the sundries and the particles can be conveniently cleaned and the particles by opening the material collecting box body by personnel.

title_en: Metering and batching system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a metering and batching system in the technical field of PTFE coating batching processing, wherein an opening and closing device comprises an opening and closing component I which is movably connected with the inner wall of a bin cavity of a collecting bin, the right side of the opening and closing component I is provided with an opening and closing component II which is used for being matched with the opening and closing component I to meter and convey raw materials in the collecting bin into a batching box, a driving device comprises an adjusting component II which is used for controlling the opening and closing component I to open and close, the right side of the adjusting component II is provided with an adjusting component I which is used for controlling the opening and closing component II to open and close, and the front side of the collecting bin is provided with a driving component which is used for controlling the adjusting component I and the adjusting component II to move left and right. The screw rod can be driven to rotate through the hand wheel, the first moving plate and the second moving plate can be driven to move in opposite directions, and the special-shaped teeth are meshed with the second rack, so that the first opening and closing component and the second opening and closing component can control raw materials in the aggregate bin to be conveyed into the batching box, and the batching box can be metered and conveyed.

title_en: Powder anti-segregation discharging device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a powder segregation-preventing discharging device which comprises a mixer and a lifting platform, wherein the lifting platform is positioned below a discharging opening of the mixer, the discharging opening of the mixer is provided with a discharging pipe, a valve is arranged on the discharging pipe, a material level sensor is arranged on the outer wall of the discharging pipe, the material level sensor is electrically connected with a controller of the lifting platform, an electronic scale is arranged on the lifting platform, and a weight sensor of the electronic scale is electrically connected with the controller of the valve. In the material distribution process, the material level sensor senses the material level in the ton bag in real time, and the distance between the port of the material discharging pipe and the powder is judged, so that the lifting platform is controlled to descend to prevent powder segregation, sensing is more accurate, personnel operation is reduced, and bagging efficiency is improved. Be equipped with the electronic scale on the lift platform and weigh the powder in real time, when reaching the settlement threshold value, the weight sensor control star discharge valve of electronic scale stops the unloading, realizes automatic charging, reduces personnel's operation, has improved bagging-off efficiency.

title_en: Sedimentation device of box sewage treatment equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of sewage treatment, in particular to a sedimentation device of box sewage treatment equipment, which comprises a box body, an inclined plate and a rotating shaft, wherein the box body is of a rectangular shell structure with a funnel-shaped lower part, the upper connecting rod is fixed on the inner walls of the front side and the rear side of the box body through screws, the upper end of the inclined plate is inserted into a rotating device with the upper connecting rod, the lower end of the inclined plate is inserted into a rotating device with the lower connecting rod, the lower end of the swinging rod is clamped with one end of the lower connecting rod, which is close to a partition plate, and the upper end of the swinging rod is fixedly connected with the rotating shaft.

title_en: Freeze-dried powder grinding device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a freeze-dried powder grinding device, which relates to the technical field of freeze-dried powder processing and comprises a charging barrel and a rotating rod arranged at the axial center of the charging barrel through an axle seat, wherein the axle seat is arranged above a fixed seat, the fixed seat is fixedly connected with a collecting barrel through a bolt, and a sieve barrel is arranged in the collecting barrel. According to the utility model, the rotating rod is arranged in the charging barrel in a rotating way, under the action of meshed connection between the lower part of the rotating rod and the inner wall of the fixed seat, the rotating rod and the fixed seat can grind freeze-drying efficiently and stably, and under the action of penetrating the through hole in the bottom shell, the ground freeze-dried powder can circulate downwards stably, so that the moving effect of the freeze-dried powder is ensured, and meanwhile, under the flexible installation action of the sieve barrel, a user can screen the freeze-dried powder with different particle sizes according to requirements, so that the grinding quality and the grinding accuracy of the device are ensured, and the device has the advantages of compact structure, simplicity and convenience in operation and low later maintenance cost.

title_en: A belt cleaning device for tealeaves processing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of tea cleaning equipment, in particular to a cleaning device for tea processing, which comprises a machine body, wherein a cleaning tank is formed by inwards concave top of the machine body, an annular partition plate and a cleaning frame assembly which is arranged in the middle of the annular partition plate and provided with a partition net are arranged in the cleaning tank, a cleaning cavity with an upward opening is arranged in the cleaning frame assembly, a plurality of poking plates are arranged on the outer side of the cleaning frame assembly, a sewage draining groove is formed between the annular partition plate and the groove wall of the cleaning tank, a sewage draining pipe communicated with the sewage draining groove is arranged on the machine body, a motor is arranged at the bottom of the machine body, and the output end of the motor rotates to pass through the cleaning tank and is connected with an stirring assembly arranged in the cleaning cavity, so that the problem that broken leaves or small tea leaves exist in the tea leaves are removed in a manual selecting mode in the cleaning process of the tea leaves, and the problem of low tea cleaning efficiency is solved.

title_en: Monitoring equipment with locking, tracking and adjusting functions
abstract_en: The utility model discloses monitoring equipment with a locking, tracking and adjusting function, which comprises a mounting seat, wherein a monitoring camera is arranged below the mounting seat through a connecting seat, a fixed bottom plate is fixedly connected below the monitoring camera, a driving mechanism is arranged on the surface of the fixed bottom plate, an extrusion mechanism is fixedly arranged at the end of the driving mechanism, a cleaning mechanism is fixedly connected at the end of the extrusion mechanism, a driving motor can be conveniently and fixedly supported through the fixed bottom plate, at the moment, a rotating shaft is driven to rotate through the driving motor, two groups of mounting rods can be conveniently driven by a connecting rod to rotate along the surface of the monitoring camera, and a cleaning scraping strip can clean a lens on the surface of the monitoring camera through the movement of the mounting rods, so that dust and dirt are prevented from adhering to the surface of the lens to influence the monitoring effect.

title_en: Parallel rotary evaporation system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a parallel rotary evaporation system which comprises a circulating pump and at least two groups of rotary evaporators, wherein the circulating pump is provided with an input port and an output port, each group of rotary evaporators at least comprises a condensing structure, the condensing structure is at least provided with a lower inlet and an upper outlet which are communicated, the lower inlet of the condensing structure of each group of rotary evaporators is connected in parallel to the output port of the circulating pump through a pipeline, and the upper outlet of the condensing structure of each group of rotary evaporators is connected in parallel to the input port of the circulating pump through a pipeline.

title_en: Flocking of car bill box spouts gluey special frock
abstract_en: The application discloses a special flocking glue spraying tool for an automobile bill box, which comprises a base, a pressing piece and a pressing piece, wherein the base is provided with a positioning part, the positioning part is provided with an insert clamped with a buckle groove, the pressing piece is connected to the base, the base is further provided with a limiting groove, the pressing piece is provided with a pressing part clamped with the limiting groove, and the pressing part and the part clamped with the limiting groove extend into an installation area to be abutted against the outer edge of the bill box. The positioning groove is formed in the base to combine the insert, so that the bill box can be initially limited when being connected with the base, meanwhile, the pressing of the pressing piece to the bill box is combined to realize positioning and installation of the bill box in the tool, the follow-up glue spraying operation can be realized rapidly on the flocking surface of the bill box through equipment after the positioning is installed, and the overall production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Waste heat recovery device for briquette production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a waste heat recovery device for molded coal production, which comprises a recovery assembly, wherein the recovery assembly comprises a heat exchange box, a heat exchange tube, a dehumidifying box, a sealing plate, two positioning holes, a ventilation box, a rotating seat, a sliding column, a spring, two mounting seats, a pressing column, an air distribution plate and two guide rails. The utility model guides the hot gas discharged by the molded coal dryer into the heat exchange tube through the hot gas inlet tube, at the moment, heat exchange can be carried out, moisture in the hot gas is adsorbed through the silica gel particles in the ventilation box, dehumidification of the hot gas can be realized, the dehumidified hot gas flows into the air inlet tube of the molded coal dryer, the air inlet temperature of the molded coal dryer is further improved, heat waste is avoided, the power consumption of the molded coal dryer can be reduced, the whole structure is simple, and the ventilation box can be taken out by pulling the rotating seat upwards to enable the compression column to be moved out of the positioning hole, so that the inside silica gel particles are dried or replaced.

title_en: Medical intermediate rectifying equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to medical intermediate rectifying equipment which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a rectifying cylinder is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the bottom plate, a condensing cylinder is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the bottom plate, an electric heating cover is arranged on the outer surface of the rectifying cylinder, a servo motor is fixedly arranged on the bottom surface of the rectifying cylinder, and a sealing bearing is fixedly embedded on the inner bottom wall of the rectifying cylinder. The device drives the dwang and a plurality of puddlers through the servo motor that sets up and rotate to under the cooperation with the electric heating cover, can stir when heating the raw materials then, can reduce the time of raw materials vaporization, improved the rectification efficiency to the raw materials, under the cooperation of condenser and two condensing plates that utilize the setting, can be quick change the raw materials into liquid from the gaseous state, through the cooperation of the pump body that sets up, first inlet pipe and first discharging pipe, thereby can carry out the secondary rectification processing in the raw materials suction rectification section of thick bamboo after rectifying, improved the rectification quality of raw materials.

title_en: High-speed jet gas-liquid mixing reactor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-speed jet gas-liquid mixing reactor, which comprises a reaction tank, wherein the top of the reaction tank is fixedly connected with a top plate, a stirring rod is arranged in the reaction tank, side walls at two sides of the stirring rod are uniformly and fixedly connected with support arms, the outer walls of the support arms are uniformly and fixedly connected with exhaust columns, the stirring rod and the support arms are hollow structures, the interior of the stirring rod is communicated with the interior of the support arms, the support arms are communicated with the interior of the exhaust columns, the side walls at the bottom end of the reaction tank are fixedly connected with exhaust pipes, and valves are detachably connected on the exhaust pipes.

title_en: Novel antimony crystal recovery device
abstract_en: The invention provides a novel antimony crystallization recovery device, which is a hollow closed container, wherein antimony solution to be crystallized is filled in the hollow closed container, a rotating motor drives a vertical connecting rod to horizontally rotate after penetrating through the wall surface of the hollow closed container, a horizontal stirring rod is connected with the vertical connecting rod and stretches into the lower part of the liquid level, an aeration disc is arranged below the coaxial part of the vertical connecting rod, one end of the aeration disc is supported by and communicated with one end of an aeration pipe stretching from the bottom of the device, the other end of the aeration pipe penetrates out of the device and is communicated with an air outlet of a water-air dual-purpose pump, one end of a residual liquid return pipe is communicated with a residual liquid outlet, the other end of the residual liquid return pipe is communicated with a residual liquid inlet, the residual liquid return pipe is also communicated with a water inlet and a water outlet of the water-air dual-purpose pump, and a plurality of aeration holes are arranged on the vertical side wall of the aeration disc. The horizontal stirring rod of the device increases the horizontal transverse fluidization process through horizontal stirring and horizontal transverse aeration of the aeration air disc, and improves crystallization efficiency, so as to solve the problem of insufficient reaction in the longitudinal fluidization process of the traditional fluidization device.

title_en: Drying device for waterproof material
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of waterproof materials, in particular to a drying device for the waterproof materials, which is simple to operate by arranging the device, can heat and dry the waterproof materials and improves the drying efficiency, and comprises a frame body, eight groups of first fixing seats, four groups of baffles, a fan cover plate, a transverse adjusting device, a longitudinal adjusting device, a rotating mechanism and a telescopic device, wherein the eight groups of first fixing seats are symmetrically arranged at the upper sides of the front end, the rear end, the left end and the right end of the frame body, the four groups of baffles are respectively and rotatably arranged on each two corresponding groups of first fixing seats, the fan cover plate is covered at the top end of the frame body, a fan is arranged in the middle of the bottom end of the fan cover plate, the transverse adjusting device is arranged at the bottom of the frame body, the longitudinal adjusting device is arranged on the transverse adjusting device, the rotating mechanism is arranged at the top end of the fan cover plate, and the telescopic device is arranged on the rotating mechanism.

title_en: Natural plant extract deodorization tank
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of extract processing, and discloses a natural plant extract deodorizing tank, which comprises a tank body, wherein a base plate is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the tank body, a shaft lever is arranged in the tank body, and a gear motor for driving the shaft lever to rotate is fixedly arranged at the top of the tank body. According to the utility model, plant extract powder is added into the tank body, air is blown into the filter box through the air pump, air enters the ventilation cavity through the air inlet after being filtered and dried through the filter element, then is sprayed to the surface of the extract from the air outlet, and finally is discharged from the blow-down pipe, so that the purpose of deodorizing the extract is realized, in the use process of the filter element, the threaded rod is driven by the servo motor to rotate, the connecting plate can be driven to move in the storage box, the position of the core groove is adjusted, the purpose of quickly replacing the filter element is realized, the time delay caused by manually replacing the filter element is reduced, and the deodorizing processing efficiency of the extract is ensured.

title_en: Kitchen waste material masher
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a kitchen waste masher which comprises a box body, a first mashing cabin and a second mashing cabin, wherein an inner frame is further arranged in the box body, a first surface is arranged in the inner frame, a first hole is formed in the first surface, the second mashing cabin inclines relative to the inner frame, a hatch is detachably matched with the first hole, a hatch cover is detachably arranged at the hatch position of the second mashing cabin, a buckling handle part is formed by extending the outer side of the hatch cover along the radial direction, a first concave part which can be matched with the buckling handle part is arranged on the first surface, the masher further comprises a first induction piece and a second induction piece, the first induction piece is arranged on a second surface, far away from the first surface, of the inner frame, and the second induction piece is arranged on the buckling handle part. The second sensing piece cooperates with the first sensing piece to identify whether the current hatch cover is installed in place or not through sensing, and the phenomenon that the kitchen waste masher is started to splash waste in the hatch due to the fact that the hatch cover is not installed in place is avoided.

title_en: A multistage screening plant for organic fertilizer production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multistage screening device for producing organic fertilizer, which belongs to the technical field of organic fertilizer production and comprises a base, wherein a fixing seat, a first support column, a limiting block and a second support column are arranged at the top of the base, a bottom box is arranged on the base, a first screening box and a second screening box are arranged on the first support column, a crushing box is arranged on the second support column, a feed box and a discharge pipe are arranged on the crushing box, the multistage screening device for producing organic fertilizer drives a turntable at two ends of a guide rod to rotate by starting a second motor, the rotation of the turntable enables a linkage block to slide in the limiting block through a linkage rod, the linkage block is respectively hinged on the first screening box and the second screening box through a pin shaft, and the first screening box and the second screening box are spliced on the first support column through a plug rod, so that the first screening box and the second screening box shake, and the screening efficiency of organic raw materials is greatly improved.

title_en: Automatic reaction acid mixing device for glyphosate
abstract_en: The utility model provides an automatic glyphosate reaction acid mixing device, which is characterized in that a coil pipe is arranged in a synthesis kettle, an external jacket is arranged on the inside of the synthesis kettle, a glycine feeding bin, a methanol feeding pipe, a depolymerization liquid feeding pipe, a triethylamine pipeline feeding pipe and a dimethyl phosphite feeding pipe are connected to the upper part of the synthesis kettle, a synthesis liquid discharging pipe is connected to the lower part of the synthesis kettle, the synthesis liquid discharging pipe is divided into two branches of a synthesis liquid circulating pipe and a synthesis liquid extracting pipe through a synthesis liquid transfer pump and a discharging flow score, the synthesis liquid extracting pipe is connected with a mixer, the upper end of the mixer is connected with a hydrochloric acid metering tank, the right side of the mixer is connected with an acid mixing kettle through a mixed liquid discharging pipe, an acidolysis liquid discharging pipe I and an acidolysis liquid discharging pump are sequentially arranged below the acid mixing kettle, and the acidolysis liquid discharging pump is connected with an acidolysis liquid storage tank through an acidolysis liquid discharging pipe II.

title_en: Anticorrosive spraying stoving processing apparatus in precision casting foundry goods surface
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a precise casting surface corrosion-resistant spraying and drying treatment device which comprises a box body, a feeding hole, a discharging hole, a track, a hoisting mechanism, a drying mechanism, a heat dissipation fan and a control board, wherein the feeding hole and the discharging hole are respectively positioned at two ends of the box body, sealing doors are respectively arranged at the feeding hole and the discharging hole, the track is fixed at the top of the box body, a plurality of track traveling cranes are arranged on the track, the hoisting mechanism is arranged on the track traveling cranes, the drying mechanism is provided with two groups and is symmetrically fixed on the inner side wall of the box body, the heat dissipation fan and the control board are respectively arranged on the outer side walls of the two ends of the box body, two ends of a lead screw are rotatably connected to the box body through bearings, a pair of guide rods are respectively fixed on the inner walls of the box body at the two ends of the lead screw, a motor I is fixed on the bottom of the box body, the output end of the motor I is connected with one end of the lead screw, and the connecting board passes through the guide rods and is connected with the lead screw through threads. The utility model can carry out uniform spraying and drying treatment on different castings, thereby preventing the castings from being oxidized and rusted.

title_en: Stearate stoving updraft ventilator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a stearate drying and air-extracting device in the technical field of stearate drying, which comprises a box body, wherein a first rotary column and a second rotary column are rotatably connected in the box body, gears are arranged on the first rotary column and the second rotary column, the two gears are in meshed connection, a feed box is arranged at one end of the first rotary column, a plurality of air holes are formed in the feed box, a third rotary column is rotatably connected in the box body, the third rotary column is in transmission connection with the second rotary column, a rotating sleeve is rotatably connected on the third rotary column, the rotating sleeve is fixedly connected on the box body, a cleaning mechanism is arranged on the rotating sleeve, the cleaning mechanism is movably connected with the air holes, a stirring mechanism is arranged on a cover plate, the stirring mechanism is in transmission connection with the third rotary column, and a driving motor is arranged on the first rotary column, so that the induced air drying efficiency of equipment is effectively improved, the efficiency of the equipment is higher in working, and the situation of blocking during drying is prevented.

title_en: Heat abstractor for computer lab block terminal
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of distribution boxes and discloses a heat dissipation device for a machine room distribution box, which comprises a box body and further comprises a heat dissipation box arranged on one side of the box body, wherein the top of the heat dissipation box is provided with vent holes, the top of the heat dissipation box is fixedly connected with two groups of mounting frames, the inner walls of the mounting frames are in sliding connection with first dustproof nets for preventing the vent holes, and the inside of the heat dissipation box is respectively provided with a refrigerator and a first cooling fan.

title_en: Vibration device and electronic apparatus
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a vibration device and an electronic apparatus. The vibration device includes a circuit board and at least two piezoelectric bodies. The circuit board comprises a control circuit, the piezoelectric main bodies are respectively arranged in different areas of the circuit board, and the piezoelectric main bodies are respectively connected with the control circuit in a conductive manner. The vibration device comprises the circuit board and at least two piezoelectric main bodies, has a simple structure and small occupied space, and is favorable for improving the thinness and thinness of the vibration device and electronic equipment using the vibration device. The piezoelectric main body is arranged in different areas of the circuit board, energy and control signals can be transmitted through the conductive connection of the piezoelectric main body and the control circuit of the circuit board, so that multi-position and multi-layer vibration effects are obtained, and man-machine interaction experience is improved.

title_en: Silicon carbide micro powder drying and recycling device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of chemical production and discloses a silicon carbide micro powder drying and recycling device which comprises a drying chamber, wherein a support column is fixedly connected to the bottom of the drying chamber, a base is fixedly connected to the bottom of the support column, a screen is connected to the inner wall of the base in a sliding manner, a recycling bin is connected to the inner wall of the base in a sliding manner, a motor is fixedly connected to the top of the drying chamber, a heater is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the drying chamber, a feed hopper penetrates through and is fixedly connected to the top of the drying chamber, an automatic closing mechanism is arranged on the feed hopper and comprises a cylinder, the outer wall of the cylinder is fixedly connected with the inner wall of the feed hopper, and a turnover plate is rotatably connected to the outer wall of the cylinder. According to the utility model, when a worker adds the silicon carbide micro powder, the square rod on the stirrer is driven to contact with the automatic closing device when the motor is started to stir, so that the purpose that the feeding hopper is closed by rotating the inner turnover plate of the feeding hopper is achieved, the discharging hopper can be automatically closed, manual closing of the worker is not needed, and the operation is simpler and more convenient.

title_en: Quick preparation facilities of material decontaminates
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rapid preparation device of decontaminating materials, which belongs to the technical field of decontaminating material preparation, and comprises a preparation vehicle and two raw material storage tanks fixed in the preparation vehicle, wherein pneumatic pumps are arranged at the top ends of the two raw material storage tanks, the pneumatic pumps are communicated with the bottom of the raw material storage tanks through connecting pipes, two sides of the top end surface of each pneumatic pump are respectively connected with a compressed gas cylinder and a release pipe, a first ball valve is arranged at the top end of each connecting pipe, and a proportional mixing pipe is arranged at the bottom end of each connecting pipe.

title_en: Mixing mechanism for processing gel candy
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mixing mechanism for processing gel candies, which relates to the technical field of food processing equipment and comprises a heating water tank, wherein one side of the heating water tank is provided with a concave seat, a rotating shaft is rotatably connected to the concave seat, a rotating shaft is arranged on the rotating shaft, the other side of the rotating shaft is provided with a sealing cover, a stirring box is arranged between the heating water tank and the stirring box, two sides of the interior of the stirring box are rotatably connected with a rotating seat, a detachable structure is arranged between a stirring assembly and the stirring box, when the stirring box is cleaned, a limiting rod is removed, the stirring assembly is lifted, so that the stirring assembly is separated from the rotating seat, and when the stirring box is prevented from being cleaned, the bottom of the stirring box is provided with a cleaning dead angle due to the blocking of the stirring assembly, and further, a stirring roller, a movable rod and a connecting frame are of a detachable structure, and the structure is more convenient and has the effect of cleaning the stirring assembly.

title_en: Automatic medium feeding device for coal preparation plant
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of coal processing, in particular to an automatic medium feeding device for a coal preparation plant. The utility model provides an automatic medium feeding device for a coal preparation plant, which can automatically feed and simultaneously carry out stirring, prevent magnetite powder from accumulating at one place, improve the mixing efficiency of heavy media and water and improve the working efficiency. The automatic medium feeding device for coal preparation plant includes washing and selecting barrel, connecting frame, connecting pipe, etc. the left side of the washing and selecting barrel is connected with the connecting frame, and the connecting pipe is connected with the upper part of the connecting frame. According to the utility model, the discharging spray head moves downwards to enable the telescopic pipe to extend, the rotating rod rotates to enable the valve to be opened, the electric push rod drives the connecting piece to move, the material guide plate rotates to enable the lower magnetite powder to be scattered into the washing and selecting barrel, so that the feeding can be automatically carried out while the discharging is carried out, the magnetite powder is prevented from accumulating at one place, the mixing efficiency of heavy media and water is improved, and the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Cleaning device for detecting biotoxin in food
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of food detection and discloses a cleaning device for detecting biotoxin in food, which comprises a cleaning box, wherein the right end of the cleaning box is fixedly connected with a motor, the driving end of the motor penetrates through the cleaning box and is fixedly connected with a rotating column, one end of the rotating column, which is far away from the motor, is fixedly connected with a filter cartridge, the outer walls of the left end and the right end of the filter cartridge are respectively and rotatably connected with a fixed ring, the front end and the rear end of the fixed ring at both sides are respectively and fixedly connected with supporting blocks, and one end of the supporting blocks, which is far away from the fixed ring, at both sides is respectively and fixedly connected with the inner wall of the cleaning box. According to the utility model, the rotating block, the connecting rod and the limiting block rotate in the through groove, the limiting block is separated from the limiting groove, and the spring and the pressing plate are matched, so that the effect of convenient disassembly between the cylinder cover and the filter cylinder is realized, the workload of operators is reduced, and the effect of improving the cleaning efficiency is realized.

title_en: Solar panel support maintenance equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of support maintenance equipment, in particular to solar panel support maintenance equipment which comprises a paint spray gun body, wherein a trigger switch is rotatably connected to the paint spray gun body, a first spring is abutted against the paint spray gun body, a slide rod is slidably connected to the paint spray gun body, a first guide groove is formed in the slide rod, a clamping block is slidably connected to the trigger switch, a first guide shaft is fixedly connected to the clamping block, the first guide shaft extends to the inside of the first guide groove and is slidably connected with the slide rod, two clamping grooves are formed in the paint spray gun body, one end of the clamping block extends to the inside of one clamping groove, a second spring is fixedly connected between the slide rod and the trigger switch, and the trigger switch can be prevented from rotating due to false touch when paint is not sprayed, so that the stability of use is effectively improved, the trigger switch can be prevented from being held for a long time when paint is sprayed, and the comfort of operation is effectively improved.

title_en: Screening plant is used in bacterial manure production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a screening device for bacterial manure production, and relates to the technical field of bacterial manure production. The utility model comprises a shell with a feed inlet at the upper end, wherein a vibrating mechanism is arranged in the shell, at least one stage of material screening plate is arranged in the shell, the vibrating mechanism is characterized in that a downward inclined material guiding plate is arranged at the upper part of the shell, a feed inlet is formed between the lower end of the shell and the shell, the material screening plate is positioned below the material guiding plate and the feed inlet and is inclined downwards from the feed inlet, a discharge outlet is arranged on the shell at the lower end of the material screening plate, a group of parallel and vertical material carding plates are arranged on the material screening plate, the inclined directions of the material carding plates are consistent with those of the material screening plate, the lower bottom surface of each material carding plate can be matched with the upper surface of the material screening plate, and the material carding plates are arranged on the shell. The utility model is provided with the material screening plate, the lower end of the material screening plate is provided with the vibrating machine, so that raw materials can vibrate in the screening process, and the raw materials collide with the material combing plate through vibration when passing through the material combing plate, so that the raw materials are scattered.

title_en: Four-mouth bottle cleaning device
abstract_en: A four-mouth bottle cleaning device is used for solving the problem that part of the existing cleaning device is fixed only through a spring and can possibly deviate during cleaning, so that the cleaning cannot be thoroughly performed, and the cleaning effect is affected. Including wasing the case and locating the door plant on the washing case, but there is a vertical movable's placement tank in the washing case, place the case top and have two curved standing grooves, four mouthful bottles locate the standing groove in, there is drive assembly in the placement tank, there are four curved butt pieces that can relative four mouthful bottles sliding butt or keep away from on the drive assembly, it has two washing poles downwards and be located the placement tank top to wash the incasement rotation, two washing poles correspondingly are relative with two standing grooves, have the play water subassembly that is used for washing four mouthful bottle inner walls on the washing pole, and the washing pole is used for wearing to locate four mouthful bottle inner walls rotation scrubbing after four mouthful bottles are vertical upward motion along with placement tank, be equipped with transparent observation window on the door plant. The utility model has simple structure and is used for cleaning four-mouth bottles.

title_en: Automatic sweep sign indicating number and defective products and reject integrated device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of logistics, in particular to an automatic code scanning and defective product removing integrated device which comprises a base, wherein the top of the base is rotationally connected with a code scanning conveyor belt, a code scanning box is fixedly arranged on one side of the top of the base, a screening component is fixedly connected to the top of the other side of the base, a removing component is fixedly connected to the middle of the base, the screening component is fixedly connected to the top of the base and is used for screening products which do not accord with weight on the code scanning box, and the removing component is fixedly connected to the middle of the base and is used for removing overweight products on the code scanning box.

title_en: Reaction mixer with self-cleaning function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a reaction stirrer with a self-cleaning function, which comprises a support frame, wherein a connecting block is fixedly connected in the support frame at equal intervals, a lantern ring is fixedly connected to one side of the connecting block, a stirrer body is arranged in the lantern ring, a feed inlet and a discharge outlet are respectively arranged at the top and the bottom of the stirrer body, a rotating rod is rotatably connected in the stirrer body, a motor is arranged at the top of the support frame, a first gear is fixedly connected to the outer side of an output shaft of the motor, a second gear is fixedly connected to the outer side of the rotating rod, the first gear is meshed with the second gear, and a stirring assembly is arranged on the outer side of the rotating rod. According to the reaction stirrer with the self-cleaning function, through the linkage operation of clockwise stirring and anticlockwise scraping, not only is the good stirring effect achieved, but also materials remained on the inner wall of the stirring barrel can be effectively cleaned, the inner wall is kept clean, and a clean working environment is provided for the next use of the stirrer.

title_en: Perilla oil raw material screening machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a perilla oil raw material screening machine which is characterized by comprising a box body with an opening at the top, wherein a screening cavity is arranged in the box body, a first screening disc group and a plurality of fine screening discs are sequentially arranged in the screening cavity from top to bottom and fixedly connected with a rotating shaft, the first screening disc group comprises a guide disc which is inclined from inside to outside by taking the rotating shaft as a circle center, a coarse screening area, a soil removing area and a blanking area are sequentially arranged on the guide disc along the radial direction of the guide disc, the coarse screening area is provided with a plurality of convex rods, when materials pass through the convex rods, bigger stem leaves are blocked by the convex rods and stay above the guide disc, smaller perilla seeds enter the guide disc along gaps of the convex rods, the problem of blockage does not exist, a plurality of filtering holes are formed in the soil removing area, the soil can fall into a dust collecting box through the filtering holes, separation of the perilla seeds and soil is realized, the separation of the soil is realized on the first layer without passing through the fine screening disc, and finally the perilla seeds of the coarse screening can enter the fine screening disc through the blanking opening at the edge of the guide disc.

title_en: Tea leaf drying hot-blast stove
abstract_en: The utility model provides a tealeaves stoving hot-blast furnace, including the furnace body, be equipped with heat exchanger in the furnace body, heat exchanger includes the heat exchange tube that is S type arrangement that constitutes by a plurality of return strokes, the heat exchange tube is equipped with the exhaust port that communicates in furnace body new trend import, the heat exchange tube that is S type arrangement can prolong the operating time of high temperature flue gas in the furnace body, thereby the extension is to the heating time of air in the furnace body, the exhaust port communicates in new trend import, utilize the waste heat of high temperature flue gas to preheat the air that gets into by new trend import, improve the heat utilization efficiency of flue gas, realize thermal recovery and utilization.

title_en: Agricultural product detector with crushing juicing cylinder
abstract_en: The present utility model provides an agricultural product detector equipped with a crushing juicer cartridge, comprising: the detection assembly and the processing assembly are movably arranged on the right side of the detection assembly, the detection assembly comprises the detector body and the workbench, and compared with the prior art, the detection assembly has the advantages that through the arrangement of the processing assembly, a user does not need to additionally find equipment to cut up and squeeze juice of agricultural products, the difficulty of detection operation is greatly reduced, the efficiency of agricultural product detection is improved, the auger rod and the crushing cutter set are integrated together, the juice is squeezed by utilizing the force of continuously pushing the auger rod and the crushing cutter set, the whole structure is simpler, the processing links of crushing and juice squeezing can be completed without using additional more equipment, the detection labor intensity of detection personnel is reduced, and the detection of a large number of agricultural products to be detected is particularly apparent.

title_en: Filter appliance convenient to dismantle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a filter appliance convenient to detach, which belongs to the technical field of medical appliances and comprises a filter cartridge, wherein a first reinforcing ring and a second reinforcing ring are sleeved on the outer side of the filter cartridge from top to bottom respectively, a first square plate is fixedly connected above the filter cartridge, a second square plate is installed above the first square plate, a sealing cover is arranged in the middle of the upper part of the second square plate, screws are connected with the inner sides of the first reinforcing ring and the second reinforcing ring in a threaded manner, a first connector is fixedly connected above the sealing cover, a second connector is arranged at the bottom of the filter cartridge, a filter element is installed on the inner side of the filter cartridge, the second square plate is connected with the first square plate by means of four groups of mounting bolts, and four sliding rails on the outer side of the filter element are respectively and slidably connected with sliding grooves on the inner side wall of the filter cartridge.

title_en: Shading cloth surface cleaning equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cloth surface cleaning equipment and discloses shading cloth surface cleaning equipment, which comprises a cleaning tank, wherein the top of the right end of the cleaning tank is fixedly connected with a moving tank, the right end of the moving tank is fixedly connected with an air drying tank, the top of the left end of the cleaning tank is fixedly connected with a purifying tank, the lower parts of the tops of the front end and the rear end of the cleaning tank are fixedly connected with guide rails, the top ends of the guide rails are slidably connected with a hoisting frame, the middle part of the bottom end of the hoisting frame is fixedly connected with a hoisting machine, and a hoisting cable is wound on the inner side of the hoisting machine.

title_en: Chlorine radical washing equipment aiming at superfine rare earth oxide water
abstract_en: The utility model provides a device for washing out chlorine roots by water aiming at superfine rare earth oxides, which is used for adding water, mixing and stirring slurry in a water washing tank and comprises a stirring shaft, stirring blades, an external motor, a temperature control water tank, a water inlet pipe and a bracket. The stirring blade is designed into a flat-plate-shaped cavity, the temperature control water tank is used for supplying water to the cavity, when the stirring blade rotates, the slurry can be stirred rotationally and water can be synchronously added into the slurry, and the possible damage of hot water to operators in the water washing process is effectively avoided. Meanwhile, the whole support is movably designed relative to the frame of the filter plate, so that the stirring blades can reciprocate and transversely move in the axial direction of the stirring shaft while rotating and stirring relative to the stirring shaft, and the uniformity of water washing, stirring and mixing is further improved.

title_en: Food additive agitating unit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a food additive stirring device in the technical field of food additive processing, which comprises a stirring barrel, wherein fixed rods are arranged at one ends of connecting blocks, which are far away from the stirring barrel, through holes are transversely formed in the positions, which correspond to the connecting blocks, of the fixed rods, threaded holes matched with the through holes are formed in one ends of the connecting blocks, which are far away from the stirring barrel, of the connecting blocks, firstly, a stirring motor is used for stirring raw materials through the transmission rods and the stirring rods, a servo motor is used for driving a gear to positively and negatively rotate through a motor shaft in the process, and the gear is used for driving an arc-shaped rod to move forwards and backwards through meshed teeth in the process of positively and negatively rotating, so that the arc-shaped rod which moves forwards and backwards can drive the whole stirring barrel to swing forwards and backwards through the cooperation of the arc-shaped bottom surface, the stirring state inside the stirring barrel can be changed, vortex phenomenon can be avoided in the stirring process, and the stirring effect can be increased.

title_en: Fertilizer granulator
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fertilizer granulators, in particular to a fertilizer granulator, which comprises a support frame, wherein the surface of the support frame is fixedly connected with a fixing frame, the surface of the support frame is provided with a motor, an output shaft of the motor is fixedly connected with a rotary table, the surface of the fixing frame is fixedly connected with a support rod, the outer surface of the support rod is fixedly connected with a fixing rod, and the surface of the fixing rod is fixedly connected with a water spraying pipe. The utility model realizes the control effect of the elastic sliding of the adjusting rod in the spray pipe through the connection function of the supporting spring, completes the control operation of the water yield of the spray head, adopts a mechanical mode to control, reduces the use of electronic elements, improves the reliability of use, and under the connection of the air bag and the connecting pipe, the connecting pipe is connected with the passage of the rubber ring, thereby facilitating the gas in the air bag to enter the rubber ring, changing the action volume of the rubber ring and improving the connection sealing performance and effect of the spray pipe and the water supply pipeline.

title_en: Semiconductor material's hierarchical oscillation device
