abstract_en: The utility model discloses a grading oscillation device for semiconductor materials, which comprises a screening box, wherein a screening mechanism is arranged in an inner cavity of the screening box and comprises two sliding plates which are arranged left and right, two brushing mechanisms are connected between the two sliding plates and comprise sliding rods, the left side and the right side of each sliding rod are fixedly connected with the sliding plates, sliding blocks are sleeved on outer rings of the sliding rods, a plurality of bristles are uniformly arranged at the tops of the sliding blocks, supporting legs are arranged at four corners of the bottom of the screening box, supporting plates are connected between the four supporting legs, an oscillation mechanism is arranged at the tops of the supporting plates, and bottom wheels are arranged at the bottoms of the supporting legs. The device is when classifying screening, and screening mechanism rotates, and the slider can be on the slide bar side-to-side sliding, drives the brush hair side-to-side motion simultaneously, and the brush hair can dredge first sieve mesh and second sieve mesh, brushes out the semiconductor material of jam in it to guarantee the normal screening of first sieve and second sieve, so can accelerate semiconductor material's screening efficiency.

title_en: Mechanical part machining workbench convenient for chip removal
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a machining workbench for mechanical parts convenient for chip removal, and relates to the technical field of part machining devices. The utility model comprises an operation table and a supporting foot rest, wherein the supporting foot rest is fixedly connected to the bottom of the operation table, a chip removing device is arranged on the side face of the operation table, and the chip removing device comprises a hollow plate. According to the utility model, through the driving force of the motor, the components such as the rack, the hollow bar, the sliding block, the connecting plate, the connecting block and the fixing plate are driven to be mutually matched, the motor fixed at the top of the sliding block is started to rotate positively, so that the gear fixed at the tail end of the output shaft is driven to rotate, meanwhile, the gear is meshed with the rack, the sliding block slides at the bottom of the inner wall of the hollow bar along with the rotation of the gear, so that the connecting plate fixed at the rear side of the motor is driven to move, and after the processing of parts is completed, the scraps on the surface of the operating platform are not required to be removed manually, so that the time and the labor are saved, and the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Portable automatic cleaning device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of turbidity meter cleaning, and aims to solve the problems that in the prior art, sludge impurities cannot be washed away and accumulated easily cause the misalignment of output signals of a turbidity meter and water quality detection data; the rotary telescopic thrust small motor is characterized in that one end of the rotary telescopic thrust small motor is provided with a rotary telescopic rod, the rotary telescopic rod is connected with a chuck, a cleaning brush is clamped on the chuck, the other end of the rotary telescopic thrust small motor is sequentially provided with a miniature self-priming pump and a battery, the battery is respectively and electrically connected with the rotary telescopic thrust small motor and the miniature self-priming pump, the tail end of the battery is provided with a switch, a water suction port and a nozzle are arranged near the rotary telescopic rod, the end part of the miniature self-priming pump is provided with a water inlet joint and a water outlet joint, the water suction port is communicated with the water inlet joint, and the nozzle is communicated with the water outlet joint. The utility model has the advantages of compact structure, stability, reliability, simple operation, low labor cost and improvement of the accuracy of the water quality detection data of the turbidity meter.

title_en: Heat pump air conditioner
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a heat pump air conditioning device which comprises a shell, wherein a heat pump unit is arranged in the shell, a first dust removing chamber, an air inlet chamber, a constant pressure chamber, an air mixing chamber and an air outlet chamber which are sequentially communicated are arranged in the shell, an air return opening is arranged on the shell of the first dust removing chamber, the first dust removing chamber is communicated with the air inlet chamber through a first air vent, the air inlet chamber is communicated with the constant pressure chamber through a second air vent, an evaporator is arranged on the second air vent, a compressor is arranged in the constant pressure chamber, an air outlet is arranged on the shell of the constant pressure chamber, the constant pressure chamber is communicated with the air mixing chamber through a third air vent, the air mixing chamber is communicated with the air outlet chamber through a fourth air vent, a condenser is arranged on the fourth air vent, and an air supplementing pipe is connected to the air mixing chamber. The heat pump air conditioning device is free from the influence of the ambient temperature, and can keep energy balance of the whole heat pump drying system.

title_en: Water collecting pipe assembly of curtain type membrane
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water collecting pipe assembly of a curtain type membrane, which comprises a water collecting pipe main body, wherein a plurality of connecting pipes are arranged on the water collecting pipe main body and are communicated with the inside of the water collecting pipe main body, each connecting pipe comprises a first straight section, a corrugated section and a second straight section, the first straight section and the water collecting pipe main body are fixed into a whole through hot melting, and a port of the second straight section is a connecting interface. According to the utility model, the flexible connecting pipe is fixed on the water collecting pipe through hot melting, the corrugated section is arranged on the connecting pipe, the connecting pipe can be bent at any angle and is communicated with the membrane pipe of the membrane, and when the connecting pipe is installed, only the connecting pipe and the membrane pipe are needed to be installed, so that the installation step is greatly simplified, the installation efficiency is improved, and the hidden danger of water leakage is greatly reduced after the connecting point of the pipeline is reduced.

title_en: Cooling device for compound fertilizer production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cooling device for compound fertilizer production, which relates to the technical field of compound fertilizer production and comprises a cooling box, wherein a feed port is formed in the top of the cooling box, a screening box is arranged above one side of the feed port, a screening mechanism is arranged in the screening box, the screening mechanism comprises a screen plate, a rotating shaft is rotatably arranged on the screen plate, a cold air pipe is arranged at the upper end of the cooling box, one end of the cold air pipe is communicated with the interior of the cooling box, the other end of the cold air pipe is communicated with a cold air source, a plurality of ventilation holes are formed in the back of the cooling box, and air cooling components for cooling compound fertilizer particles are fixedly connected to the inner walls of the ventilation holes. The cooling device provided by the utility model comprises the cooling box and the screening box positioned above the cooling box, so that the compound fertilizer granular materials can be screened through the screening box, and the screened compound fertilizer granular materials enter the cooling box for cooling, so that the screening and cooling of the compound fertilizer granular materials can be performed in the same device.

title_en: Water-reducing agent sulfonation device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water reducer sulfonation device, which relates to the technical field of water reducer production and comprises a reaction kettle body, wherein a heating cavity and a reactor are arranged in the reaction kettle body, a driving gear is further rotatably arranged in the reaction kettle body above the reactor, a spring stirring shaft on the reactor is provided with a spiral stirring blade, a filtering sleeve is arranged on the reactor through an air outlet pipe, a water tank is arranged on the outer wall of the left side of the reaction kettle body through a fixing plate, a spraying plate is arranged on the inner wall of the upper part of the reactor, and a feeding pipe and a discharging pipe are arranged on the reaction kettle body. According to the utility model, under the action of the driving gear, the driven gear, the stirring shaft and the spiral stirring blade, the efficient mixing of the reaction raw materials is realized, the uniform sulfonation reaction is ensured, and meanwhile, the heating cavity is matched for use, so that the reaction process can be performed under a proper and uniform temperature condition, and harmful gas generated in the reaction process is effectively filtered under the action of the air outlet pipe and the filtering sleeve.

title_en: Air flow mill device
abstract_en: The application provides an air flow grinding device, and relates to the technical field of magnet production. The air flow mill device comprises an air flow mill body, an air flow mill assembly, a classifier and a material output assembly, wherein the air flow mill assembly is arranged in the air flow mill body and used for processing materials, the classifier is arranged in the air flow mill body and communicated with the air flow mill assembly and used for screening the materials, and the material output assembly comprises a pipe body and a separation protection piece, and the separation protection piece covers the inner wall of the pipe body. According to the application, the separation protection piece is arranged on the inner wall of the pipe body in the material output assembly, so that the inner wall of the pipe body is separated from the material, the abrasion to the inner wall of the pipe body during high-speed material discharge is avoided, the service life of the material output assembly is prolonged, and the maintenance and replacement cost is reduced. And meanwhile, the phenomenon that the material is adsorbed or accumulated on the inner wall of the pipe body to form oxide skin in the conveying process to cause blockage is further reduced, the stability of the internal pressure of the jet mill body is conveniently maintained, and the granularity consistency of the material powder after the processing is finished is improved.

title_en: Magnetic stirring screening device for detecting mud content of fine aggregate
abstract_en: The utility model provides a magnetic stirring and screening device for detecting the mud content of fine aggregate, and belongs to the technical field of detection of the mud content of fine aggregate. The utility model provides a fine aggregate mud content detects with magnetic stirring screening plant, includes base, cup, stirring, inlet tube, drain pipe and V type square hole sieve, wherein, install motor and magnetic rotor in the base, the cup is located the top of base, the stirring is located in the cup, the inlet tube is vertical setting, just the bottom of inlet tube is connected the bottom of cup side, the one end of drain pipe is connected the cup side, the other end of drain pipe is slope downward setting, V type square hole sieve sets up in the cup, just the height of drain pipe is greater than the height of V type square hole sieve. The utility model has the advantage of improving the detection efficiency of the mud content of the fine aggregate.

title_en: Mixing and stirring device for forsterite deep processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mixing and stirring device for forsterite deep processing, which belongs to the technical field of forsterite processing and comprises a supporting plate, wherein two vertical beams are fixedly connected to the upper surface of the supporting plate, a first bearing is fixedly embedded in one side surface of each vertical beam, which is close to each other, a rotating rod is fixedly connected to the inner ring of each first bearing, a forsterite stirring tank is fixedly connected to the front end of one rotating rod, symmetrical second bearings are fixedly embedded in the inner wall of the forsterite stirring tank, and the forsterite stirring tank, the rotating rod, the forsterite stirring tank, a round rod, stirring blades, a rotating motor, a connecting column, a first gear, a driving motor, a fixing column, a round plate, a second gear and a crushing cutter are matched, so that the forsterite stirring tank and the stirring blades can rotate in different directions, the mixing efficiency of equipment on the forsterite and additives is improved, and the forsterite and the additives can be mixed more uniformly.

title_en: Quenching equipment for crankshaft production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of crankshaft quenching and discloses crankshaft production quenching equipment which comprises an equipment main body, wherein a filter plate is inserted into the equipment main body, the front end of the equipment main body is fixedly connected with an opening and closing door, the left end and the right end of the opening and closing door are fixedly connected with bolts, the upper end of the equipment main body is fixedly connected with a chute, a second hole is formed in the side surface of the equipment main body, a plug is inserted into the second hole, a fixing plate is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the equipment main body, and a chute is formed in one side, close to the filter plate, of the fixing plate. According to the utility model, the push-pull device in the air pressure box is controlled by the air pump to automatically control the cleaning roller to be attached to the mechanical arm for cleaning, so that dangerous cleaning possibly occurring in manual cleaning of workers is avoided, the safety of the workers is protected, residues attached to the surface of the mechanical arm are treated through friction between the mechanical arm and the cleaning roller, and the cleaning roller is returned to the original position by closing the air pump, so that the residues on the surface of a workpiece can be cleaned conveniently.

title_en: Dangerous waste treatment device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a hazardous waste treatment device which comprises a crushing box, wherein a fixed box is fixedly connected to the outer side of the crushing box, a motor box is fixedly connected to the left side of the crushing box, a motor is fixedly connected to the inner side of the motor box, a movable shaft is fixedly connected to an output shaft of the motor, a power gear is fixedly connected to the outer side of the movable shaft, a transmission gear is meshed to the outer side of the power gear, a connecting shaft is fixedly connected to the inner side of the transmission gear, and crushing rollers are fixedly connected to the outer sides of the connecting shaft and the movable shaft. This hazardous waste processing apparatus, overall structure is simple, has realized the purpose that hazardous waste is convenient for compress tightly, and processing apparatus can flatten after smashing hazardous waste, can guarantee processing apparatus to the quantity and the effect that hazardous waste smashed and collect, does not need frequent clearance of staff, has alleviateed staff's intensity of labour, has improved processing apparatus to the kibbling efficiency of hazardous waste.

title_en: Durable flat panel array film
abstract_en: The application relates to a durable flat array membrane, which belongs to the technical field of flat array membranes and comprises a first membrane plate and a second membrane plate, wherein sealing frames are fixed on the outer surfaces of the first membrane plate and the second membrane plate, a supporting component for supporting the first membrane plate and the second membrane plate is arranged on one side of the first membrane plate opposite to the second membrane plate, and the supporting component comprises two supporting strips, two groups of retaining plates, elastic gaskets fixedly arranged on the left wall and the right wall of the supporting strips, and transverse blocks fixedly arranged on the opposite walls of the upper retaining plate and the lower retaining plate. This dull and stereotyped array membrane that can last long-term use through being provided with supporting component, can produce certain interval between first lamina membranacea and the second lamina membranacea, can effectively reduce the phenomenon that first lamina membranacea and second lamina membranacea appear the adhesion, has ensured filtration efficiency and the effect of dull and stereotyped array membrane to prolonged the life of board array membrane, the support bar can the joint be fixed in on first lamina membranacea and the second lamina membranacea, can strengthen the steadiness of support bar between first lamina membranacea and the second lamina membranacea.

title_en: Novel play useless device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel waste kicking device which comprises a bracket, a driving device and a waste kicking device, wherein the bracket comprises an upper supporting plate and a lower supporting plate which are arranged in parallel, the upper supporting plate and the lower supporting plate are fixedly connected through two guide rods, the waste kicking device comprises a moving plate, a top plate and a baffle plate, the moving plate is connected with the guide rods in a sliding mode, the top plate is fixedly connected to the lower portion of the moving plate, a gap for a material to pass through is reserved between the top plate and the moving plate, the baffle plate is fixedly connected to the lower portion of the top plate, the driving device comprises an electric cylinder and a magnetic rod, the electric cylinder is fixedly connected to the upper supporting plate, one end of the magnetic rod is inserted into the electric cylinder, the other end of the magnetic rod is fixedly connected to the moving plate, the magnetic rod is adsorbed through the electric cylinder to drive the waste kicking device to move upwards, and the waste kicking device moves downwards through self gravity when the electric cylinder is powered off, so that the quick movement of the waste kicking device meets production requirements.

title_en: Vamp and sole on-line spraying transmission device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an on-line spraying and conveying device for shoe uppers and soles, which comprises 2 conveying mechanisms, a material moving conveying belt, a lifting mechanism and a total conveying mechanism, wherein the 2 conveying mechanisms are arranged up and down, the material moving conveying belt is positioned between the 2 conveying mechanisms and the total conveying mechanism, the conveying mechanism comprises a conveying belt, a material ejection cylinder and a first induction piece, two ends of the material moving conveying belt are respectively provided with a second induction piece, and the lifting mechanism comprises a frame, a connecting frame and a lifting cylinder. The utility model has the advantages that the material is transmitted by alternately gathering the vamp and the sole in pairs, and the requirement of on-line transmission after independent paint spraying of the vamp and the sole is met.

title_en: Color sorter slideway maintenance assembly
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a look selection machine slide maintains subassembly, including the slide, the both sides of slide are equipped with the backplate, and the top surface of backplate has arranged the spout along backplate extending direction, movable mounting has the mount pad in the spout, has arranged dust removal subassembly between two mount pads level; the sliding groove is also internally provided with a driving component for driving the mounting seat to reciprocate; this application not only will clean the structure setting to rotatory structure, but also be equipped with the dust absorption pipe in its both sides, can increase the contact frequency between brush hair and the slide surface through rotatory mode like this, can also increase the brush hair and cut the dynamics of rubbing for a large amount of adhesion are raised at the dust on slide surface, then cooperate the dust absorption pipe of both sides to accomodate fast, have improved the device cleaning effect greatly, can also prevent that the dust from influencing its surrounding environment simultaneously, and it is more convenient to use.

title_en: Hydraulic pipeline cleaning device for hydraulic engineering
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water conservancy pipeline cleaning device for water conservancy projects, which belongs to the technical field of pipeline cleaning equipment and comprises a bottom plate, wherein brake wheels are arranged at four corners of the bottom plate, a plurality of brake wheels are specifically universal wheels with self-locking mechanisms, a cleaning assembly is arranged at the top end of the bottom plate, the cleaning assembly comprises a driving motor, a driving rod and a transmission rod, one end of the driving rod is fixedly connected to the output end of the driving motor, and the other end of the driving rod is fixedly connected to one end of the transmission rod. In the actual use process, the utility model can be suitable for pipelines with different pipe diameters in various hydraulic engineering, reduces the requirements on various special cleaning equipment, reduces the equipment purchasing and management cost, can effectively clean the pipeline in time no matter how the diameter of the pipeline changes, avoids the hydraulic system faults caused by pipeline blockage or pollution, and ensures the stable supply and efficient utilization of water resources.

title_en: Automatic conveying device for raw materials for producing organic fertilizer
abstract_en: The application discloses a raw material automatic conveying device for producing organic fertilizer, which belongs to the field of organic fertilizer production and comprises conveying equipment, wherein a cylinder body is arranged above the conveying equipment, a sliding rod is fixedly connected to the front surface and the back surface of the cylinder body, a sliding sleeve is movably sleeved on the outer surface of the sliding rod, a supporting plate is fixedly connected below the sliding sleeve, the supporting plate is fixedly connected with the upper part of the conveying equipment, a screening assembly is arranged on the inner surface of the conveying equipment, the screening assembly comprises a power bin, the power bin is fixedly connected with the left side of the cylinder body, and a double-shaft motor is fixedly connected to the inner surface of the power bin. According to the application, the screening assembly is arranged to screen the raw materials in the cylinder above the conveying equipment, and the screening assembly can simultaneously divide the raw materials in the cylinder, so that the raw materials are prevented from being fully accumulated on the screen in the screening bin, and the high-quality raw materials can be conveniently screened out for conveying.

title_en: Odorless pretreatment water purification equipment based on carbon-electricity constraint
abstract_en: The utility model relates to odorless pretreatment water purification equipment based on carbon-electricity constraint, which relates to the technical field of sewage treatment and comprises a box body, wherein a water inlet is formed in the top of the box body, a drain pipe is arranged on the side wall of the box body in a communicated manner, an electromagnetic control valve is arranged on the drain pipe, a treatment box, a filter box and an aeration box are fixedly arranged in the box body, an input port is formed in the top of the treatment box, the input port is positioned below the water inlet, the treatment box is communicated with the filter box, a plurality of filter holes are formed in the bottom of the filter box, the filter box is positioned above the aeration box, and the aeration box is communicated with the drain pipe. The utility model has the effects of reducing carbon ions and electric ions contained in sewage and improving the sewage pretreatment effect.

title_en: Photovoltaic power generation panel's belt cleaning device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of photovoltaic product cleaning and discloses a cleaning device for a photovoltaic power generation panel, which comprises a moving vehicle, a supporting mechanism, a cleaning mechanism and an air drying mechanism, wherein the supporting mechanism comprises a mechanical arm and a supporting component, one end of the mechanical arm is rotatably arranged on the moving vehicle, the supporting component is rotatably connected with the other end of the mechanical arm so that the mechanical arm drives the supporting component to rotate and adjust an angle, the cleaning mechanism comprises a cleaning piece, a water supply component arranged on the moving vehicle and a water supply component communicated with the water supply component, the cleaning piece and the water supply component are both arranged on the supporting component, the air drying mechanism comprises a fan arranged on the moving vehicle and an air supply component communicated with the fan, and the air supply component is arranged on the supporting component so as to air-dry the cleaned photovoltaic power generation panel. This belt cleaning device can dash to drench, clear up and weather photovoltaic power generation panel to waterproof stain remains, and belt cleaning device's use is more convenient, and the cleaning operation is also more nimble, so can improve cleaning performance greatly.

title_en: Material separator
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a material separator which comprises a cylindrical sealing tube, wherein a waste paper feeding tube and a waste paper discharging tube are symmetrically arranged at the upper end and the lower end of the sealing tube, the waste paper feeding tube is in through connection with a storage bin, a carrying roller which carries waste paper and transfers the waste paper from the waste paper feeding tube to the waste paper discharging tube is rotatably arranged in the sealing tube, the carrying roller is in rotary sealing connection with the inner wall of the sealing tube, after the waste paper enters the sealing tube from the waste paper feeding tube, the carrying roller moves the waste paper in the direction of the waste paper discharging tube, and because the carrying roller is in a sealing state with the inner wall of the sealing tube in the rotary process, air cannot pass through the waste paper feeding tube from a gap between the carrying roller and the inner wall of the sealing tube to enter the storage bin, so that the air flow in the storage bin is prevented from being too large, the waste paper in the storage bin is prevented from being always in a floating state and being unable to fall into the waste paper feeding tube, and meanwhile, the working efficiency of dust removing equipment is improved.

title_en: Photovoltaic solder strip quick-drying device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of photovoltaic solder strips, in particular to a photovoltaic solder strip quick-drying device, which comprises a quick-drying box, wherein a sliding rod is fixedly connected to the inside of the quick-drying box, a water removing mechanism which is convenient for quick water and air drying of the photovoltaic solder strips is arranged in the quick-drying box, a water removing plate is arranged in the quick-drying box, a water scraping inclined plate is fixedly connected to the bottom of the water removing plate, a rear water scraping plate is fixedly connected to the bottom of the water removing plate, a ventilation groove penetrates through the bottom of the water removing plate, connecting plates are fixedly connected to two sides of the water removing plate, a connecting groove is formed in the bottom of the connecting plate, a connecting rod is slidably inserted into the connecting groove, and a spring is sleeved on the connecting rod. This photovoltaic solder strip rapid-curing cutback device is connected with the dewatering board through on the connecting rod of rapid-curing cutback case inner wall connection, and runs through when dewatering board bottom connection scrapes water swash plate and rear-mounted wiper board and has seted up the ventilation groove to scrape solder strip surface moisture.

title_en: Caking screening equipment before potato starch packing
abstract_en: The utility model provides a potato starch pre-packaging caking screening device, which relates to the technical field of potato starch screening devices and comprises a bottom frame and a screening mechanism, wherein the screening mechanism is arranged above the bottom frame and comprises a mounting component, a separating component, a power component and a rotating component, the mounting component is arranged on the upper side of the bottom frame, the separating component is arranged on the outer side of the mounting component, the power component is arranged in the mounting component, potato starch can be crushed in advance through the arrangement of the crushing component, the potato starch screening efficiency and quality are ensured, the use of a user is facilitated, the potato starch is subjected to vibration screening by the cooperation of the mounting component and the separating component, the potato starch is subjected to rotation screening by the cooperation of the power component and the rotating component, impurities can be discharged, the practicability of the caking screening device is improved, and the use requirement of a user is met.

title_en: Mobile phase bottle device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mobile phase bottle device, which relates to the technical field of material detection and comprises a bottle, a bottle cap, a pipeline structure, a movable support structure, a fixed support structure and a locking structure, wherein the bottle is of a structure with a large upper part and a small lower part, the bottle cap is arranged on the bottle, the pipeline structure is arranged on the bottle cap, the bottle is positioned on the movable support structure, the fixed support structure is arranged on the movable support structure, the locking structure is used for limiting the relative movement of the movable support structure relative to the fixed support structure, and the bottle adopts the structure with the large upper part and the small lower part, so that a small amount of mobile phase can have a proper height in the bottle, the height is enough to meet the follow-up experiment, the waste of the mobile phase is effectively avoided, and the cost control is facilitated. The movable support structure is provided with the rollers, so that a worker can conveniently rotate and move the movable support structure, and the required bottle can be rotated or moved to a proper position for the worker to use, and the work efficiency is guaranteed.

title_en: Wisdom dosing system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent dosing system, which relates to an aquaculture dosing system, and comprises a box body and a detection unit, wherein the detection unit is arranged in the middle of an inner cavity of the box body and is used for detecting the condition of water quality; a refrigerating unit for refrigerating the reagent required by the detecting unit; and the waste liquid collecting unit is used for collecting the detected waste liquid. The utility model can calculate accurate medicine throwing amount according to the ammonia nitrogen content in a water sample by designing the detection unit, the liquid containing barrel and the weighing device, and can more accurately control the medicine amount so as to reduce the influence on aquatic products caused by excessive medicines.

title_en: Automatic cover opening device with safety interlocking mechanism for dye vat pressure vessel
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic cover opening device with a safety interlocking mechanism for a dye vat pressure vessel, and relates to the field of pressure vessels. The dye vat comprises a dye vat main body, wherein a container cover is arranged at the top of the feed inlet, an extension plate is arranged at the bottom of the container cover, a water collecting tank is arranged at the bottom of the extension plate, and water absorbing strips are embedded in the water collecting tank, the water mist or the water vapor layer can be hung on the lengthened plate and finally flows into the water collecting tank at the bottom of the lengthened plate, and the water absorbing strips embedded in the water collecting tank can absorb the water vapor and the water mist, so that the water vapor and the water mist are effectively prevented from dripping into the dye vat, the adverse effect on the dyeing effect is caused, the use convenience of the automatic cover opening device of the dye vat pressure vessel with the safety interlocking mechanism is improved, and the smooth proceeding of the dyeing process is ensured.

title_en: High test machine of condenser
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of capacitor processing, in particular to a capacitor height testing machine which comprises a base, wherein two side plates are fixed on the top of the base, notches are formed in the tops of the side plates, racks capable of horizontally moving are meshed above the gears, connecting seats are fixed on the tops of the racks, pushing blocks inserted into the notches on the rear sides are arranged at the front ends of the connecting seats, a plurality of capacitors are conveyed through a conveying belt, when the capacitors move to the notches, the capacitors are stopped to move, a laser ranging sensor is used for detecting the heights of the capacitors, the design is convenient for testing the heights of the capacitors, the convenience of detection is improved, and through a pushing mechanism, when the heights of the capacitors are unqualified, the unqualified capacitors can be directly pushed away from the grooves by the pushing blocks, so that the unqualified capacitors can be conveniently and automatically sent out of the conveying belt.

title_en: Nozzle for semiconductor equipment purifying device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of semiconductor purifying devices, in particular to a nozzle for a purifying device of semiconductor equipment, which comprises a connecting arm, a fixed ring, a lock catch and a spray head, the fixed ring sets up in the front end middle part of linking arm, and the hasp sets up in the upper end surface of linking arm, and the shower nozzle sets up in the below of fixed ring. According to the utility model, the rotary adjusting ring, the inner gear ring, the positioning gear, the flow blocking sheet and the receiving ring are arranged, when the structure is used as the nozzle of the semiconductor purifying device, an operator can install the structure at the tail end of the high-pressure cleaning device through the connecting column, when water flow is conveyed into the structure, the operator can drive the rotary adjusting ring in a stirring mode, and the movement of the flow blocking sheet in the structure can be finely controlled through the cooperation of the positioning gear, the inner gear ring and the rotary adjusting ring.

title_en: Photovoltaic cleaning robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides a photovoltaic cleaning robot, which relates to the technical field of photovoltaic panel dust removal devices and comprises two travelling devices, a driving part, a cleaning device and an anti-drop assembly, wherein the travelling devices comprise a main travelling wheel set and an auxiliary travelling wheel set which are arranged at positions close to the bottom, the cleaning device is arranged between the two travelling devices, the driving part is at least arranged on one travelling device to drive the travelling devices and the cleaning device to move, the anti-drop assembly is arranged at the bottom of the travelling devices and provided with at least two anti-drop wheels which are positioned at the lower side of the bottom surface of a photovoltaic panel and extend from the edge of the photovoltaic panel to the center direction, and the two anti-drop wheels at the outer sides are positioned at the two outer sides of the main travelling wheel set and/or the auxiliary travelling wheel set in the travelling device moving direction. Therefore, the lifting device has the advantages of avoiding overlarge tilting angle of the travelling device and being not easy to fall from the bridge frame.

title_en: A washing device for zinc sand culture processing production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of washing equipment, and discloses a washing device for zinc sand culture processing production, which comprises a pre-washing box, wherein an output end at one side of the pre-washing box is fixedly connected with a washing box, an output end at the top of the pre-washing box is movably connected with a pre-washing grinding wheel, an outer wall at one end of the pre-washing box is fixedly connected with a transmission device, a washing device is clamped at one side of the top of the washing box, and a discharging device is fixedly connected with an outer wall at one side of the washing box, which is far away from the pre-washing box.

title_en: Evaporate and press air entrainment building block raw materials reducing mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model provides an autoclaved aerated block raw material crushing device, which relates to the technical field of autoclaved aerated block raw material crushing, and comprises a support frame, a crushing box, a crushing roller, crushing teeth, gears, a speed reducer, a motor and a feeding box, wherein a pressing plate is arranged in the feeding box, one end of the pressing plate is rotationally connected with the feeding box, a side rod is arranged at the other end of the feeding box, an arc-shaped groove for the side rod to move is formed in the outer surface of the feeding box, the pressing teeth are uniformly arranged on the lower surface of the pressing plate, an air cylinder is arranged on the support frame, a sliding block in sliding connection with the support frame is arranged at the output end of the air cylinder, and the autoclaved aerated block raw material crushing device further comprises a connecting rod, and two ends of the connecting rod are respectively rotationally connected with the side rod and the sliding block.

title_en: High-pressure micro-mist dust suppression spray device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-pressure micro-mist dust suppression spray device, which relates to the technical field of dust suppression spray devices and comprises an inner support, a support plate and a jet flow pipeline, wherein the support plate is welded on the outer wall of the inner support, and the outer support is welded on one side of the outer wall of the support plate. This little fog of high pressure presses down dirt spray set when using, be "back" word through making atomizer and distribute, and then make tiny droplet can more evenly distribute at the target area, and the design of just returning shape helps controlling the flight orbit of droplet, reduce the drift of droplet in the air, promote the spraying homogeneity then, and take off atomizer through assist mechanism, later clear up or change atomizer again, and then need not to use special extracting tool to rotate multiunit screw repeatedly, can accomplish atomizer's change, save time and energy, thereby when little fog presses down dirt spray set of high pressure uses, play the shower nozzle of being convenient for change and even effect.

title_en: Vegetable cultivation culture solution stirring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vegetable cultivation culture solution stirring device, which belongs to the technical field of vegetable cultivation, and aims at the problem that the quality of the cultivation solution is affected due to the fact that insoluble impurities such as sediment, particles and the like are contained in the culture solution when the culture solution is blended with water; according to the utility model, by arranging the filtering mechanism, insoluble particles in the culture solution raw material are conveniently filtered, the clarity degree of the culture solution is improved, the use quality of the culture solution is further improved, and the filtered substances are conveniently cleaned.

title_en: Desulfurization waste water treatment equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to desulfurization wastewater treatment equipment, which comprises a treatment tank, a stirring device, a circulating device and a precipitation collecting box, wherein the stirring device is arranged at the bottom of the treatment tank and is used for stirring solution in the treatment tank, the precipitation collecting box is arranged in the treatment tank and is close to the top, the bottom and the surface of the precipitation collecting box are both provided with fine holes, a sealing cover is arranged at the top of the treatment tank, the center of the sealing cover is fixedly connected with a fixed pipe, the top end of the fixed pipe extends to the outside of the sealing cover, the bottom end of the fixed pipe extends to the inside of the precipitation collecting box, the circulating device is arranged at the outer side of the treatment tank, and the solution in the treatment tank is communicated with the top end of the fixed pipe to form a circulating loop.

title_en: Raw material cleaning device for polyolefin foaming building material production and processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a raw material cleaning device for polyolefin foam building material production and processing, which comprises a flushing cylinder, wherein the rear end of the flushing cylinder is provided with a plurality of water inlet connectors, the water inlet connectors are connected through a guide ring, the middle part of the guide ring is provided with a bent pipe, the bent pipe is communicated with the guide ring through a plurality of ventilation pipes, the rear end of the flushing cylinder is provided with a booster pump, the water outlet end of the booster pump is connected with the bent pipe, one end, close to the booster pump, of the side surface of the flushing cylinder is provided with a conveying cylinder, the conveying cylinder is internally provided with a conveying screw rod, the conveying screw rod is rotationally connected with the conveying cylinder, one end, which is not connected with the flushing cylinder, of the conveying cylinder is provided with a motor, and the output end of the motor is connected with the conveying screw rod. The utility model is characterized in that the side surface of the flushing cylinder is connected with the conveying cylinder, raw materials to be cleaned are injected into the flushing cylinder through the conveying cylinder, then water flows into the flushing cylinder through the booster pump, and the pressurized water flows can flush crushed polyethylene fragments with extremely high water pressure.

title_en: Cell-phone toughened glass surface cleaning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mobile phone toughened glass surface cleaning device, and relates to the technical field of mobile phone toughened glass cleaning. The utility model provides a mobile phone toughened glass surface cleaning device which comprises a supporting base, wherein the top end of the supporting base is fixedly connected with a mounting frame, partition plates which are distributed at equal intervals are fixedly connected in the mounting frame, the partition plates divide the interior of the mounting frame into a plurality of independent spaces, an ultrasonic cleaning frame is fixedly connected in each space in the mounting frame, a drainage pipe rack is communicated between the bottom ends of the ultrasonic cleaning frames, and vertical sliding rods are further arranged. When ultrasonic cleaning is carried out, the cam rotates to drive the matching frame to do circular motion, and then the supporting bracket and the placing frame are driven to moderately shake in the cleaning liquid, the extra action is helpful for enhancing the flow of the cleaning liquid, promoting the separation of stains and the surface of the toughened glass of the mobile phone, and enabling ultrasonic energy to be more uniformly distributed in all areas to be treated, thereby remarkably improving the overall cleaning effect.

title_en: Feed pellet cooling screening integration equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses feed pellet cooling and screening integrated equipment which comprises a main body box, wherein the top of the main body box is communicated with a feed pipe. According to the utility model, the motor is started, the vibrating rod is driven to vibrate up and down through the eccentric wheel, the vibrating rod drives the spring to vibrate up and down, the first sieve plate and the discharging plate are driven by the elastic force of the spring to vibrate at high frequency, the cooling fan is started at the moment, feed is placed into the main body box from the feed pipe, the feed is cooled through the cooling fan and is screened through the first sieve plate, the primarily screened feed particles fall on the surface of the second sieve plate to be screened continuously, the screened feed can be output to other equipment through the discharging port to be reprocessed, the efficient screening has the advantage that uneven particles are not accumulated on the surface of the sieve plate after being vibrated by the vibrating mechanism, and the feed dispersed by the vibrating mechanism is screened step by step after being uniformly cooled, so that the service efficiency of cooling screening equipment is improved.

title_en: Raw material cleaning equipment for polyethylene film production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of polyethylene cleaning, and discloses raw material cleaning equipment for polyethylene film production, which comprises a fixed seat and a cleaning box, wherein an installation seat is fixed on the wall surface of the inner cavity of the cleaning box, a placing frame is placed in the installation seat, a compression spring is fixed on the inner wall of the installation seat, a first jack and a second jack are respectively formed in the side wall surfaces of the cleaning box and the installation seat, push rods are slidably arranged in the first jack and the second jack, push plates are fixed on the push rods, a protection frame and a water tank are respectively fixed on two sides of the cleaning box, a second motor is fixed in the protection frame, a cam is fixed on an output shaft of the second motor, and a rotating shaft and the first motor are respectively arranged on the opposite wall surfaces of the fixed seat. Through placing the cooperation of frame and second motor and cam, place the frame and promote right to place the polyethylene raw materials sieve in the frame and move to drive through first motor and wash the case and rotate, cooperate first water pump with the water in the water tank through the cooperation of first connecting pipe and collection pipe finally from the shower nozzle blowout, make the cleaning performance better.

title_en: Organic heat carrier boiler with heat conduction oil thermal expansion compensation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an organic heat carrier boiler with heat conduction oil thermal expansion compensation, which comprises a boiler component, wherein the boiler component is communicated with an expansion compensation structure and a waste heat recovery structure, the waste heat recovery structure is positioned at the left side of the expansion compensation structure, the boiler component comprises an organic heat carrier boiler body, the lower side of the organic heat carrier boiler body is communicated with an oil inlet pipe, the upper side of the organic heat carrier boiler body is communicated with a first oil outlet pipe, the right side of the organic heat carrier boiler body is inlaid with a heater body, the left end of the upper side of the organic heat carrier boiler body is penetrated with a smoke exhaust pipe, the organic heat carrier boiler with the heat conduction oil thermal expansion compensation is provided with the waste heat recovery structure, impurities in smoke are preprocessed under the auxiliary effect of a uniform air plate, and tap water in the water is heated by high-temperature smoke gas, so that the waste heat of the organic heat carrier boiler is recycled, the waste of resources is avoided, the bottom of the uniform air plate is automatically cleaned through the arrangement of a connecting rod and a cleaning brush, and the cleaning effect is ensured.

title_en: Spraying device convenient to retrieve waste material
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a spraying device convenient for recycling waste materials, which relates to the technical field of spraying devices and comprises a spraying device body, wherein the spraying device body comprises a recycling mechanism, a positioning mechanism and a spraying mechanism, the recycling mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the positioning mechanism, the spraying mechanism is arranged at the top end of the positioning mechanism, the recycling mechanism comprises a recycling box, the bottom surface of an inner cavity of the recycling box is fixedly connected with a guide rail, the surface of the guide rail is slidably connected with a recycling box, and the right side of the top surface of the recycling box is provided with a through groove. According to the utility model, the sprayed waste is collected through the guide plate, falls into the filter box through the through groove, the coarse screen is used for carrying out preliminary filtration on the waste, the curved plate can enable the waste to flow uniformly, the waste finally falls into the recovery box after being filtered again through the fine screen, the recovery box is withdrawn after spraying, the waste is recovered after the recovery box is withdrawn, the guide rail is arranged to facilitate the withdrawal of the recovery box, the recovery efficiency of the paint is improved, and resources are saved.

title_en: Medicine enrichment facility
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a medicine concentration device which comprises a concentration tank, wherein the top end of the concentration tank is provided with a tank cover, the rear side of the concentration tank is provided with a hydraulic cylinder, the front side of an output shaft of the hydraulic cylinder is arranged at the top end of the tank cover, the top end of the tank cover is provided with a driving motor, the inner wall of the tank cover is provided with a limit component, the inner side of the limit component is provided with a filter plate, the lower side of the right end of the concentration tank is provided with a liquid discharge pipe, the upper side of the concentration tank, which is close to the liquid discharge pipe, is provided with an air inlet pipe, the top end of the tank cover is provided with an air outlet pipe, and the inner wall of the concentration tank is provided with a stirring component. According to the utility model, through the matched use of the driving motor, the tank cover and the stirring assembly, the stirring rod I and the stirring rod II in the stirring assembly are driven by the driving motor to rotate in opposite directions, so that the medicines are uniformly mixed and fully treated in the concentration tank, the stirring effect of the medicines is improved, and the concentration efficiency is improved.

title_en: Flattening device for roadway repair
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a roadway repair shakeouts device, including the mounting bracket, the mounting bracket front and back end both sides are equipped with preceding landing leg and back landing leg respectively downwards, and the walking wheel is installed through the wheel carrier to preceding landing leg below, rotates through the pivot between the back landing leg and connects the compression roller, compression roller bottom end face and walking wheel bottom end face parallel and level, and mounting bracket middle part both sides are equipped with the mounting panel downwards, connect the clear car box through the connecting rod on the mounting panel, and clear car box rear end sets up the opening of downward sloping and opening bottom and connects the spiller, and spiller cutting edge slope upwards with compression roller surface contact. The installation rack is arranged to install the compression roller, the scraper knife is arranged at the front end of the compression roller to scrape off broken stones and clods adhered to the surface of the compression roller, and the broken stones and clods are removed by matching with the box body of the clearing and transporting vehicle, so that the compression roller is beneficial to leveling the ground, and the compacting effect is improved.

title_en: Material beating machine for food processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a material beating machine for food processing, which relates to the field of food processing machinery and comprises a workbench, wherein a fixed block is fixedly arranged at the top of the workbench, a blowing structure is fixedly arranged at the inner bottom of a first protection barrel, and a filter hole matched with the blowing structure is formed at the outer side of the inner barrel. According to the utility model, through the mutual matching between the stirring rod and the blades driven by the first motor, the materials can be cut up uniformly and quickly, meanwhile, the noise generated in the process of the material beating machine can be subjected to a certain silencing effect through the sound absorbing cotton in the first protection barrel, the second protection barrel and the third protection barrel, and the disturbance of the materials in the inner barrel can be enhanced through the blowing structure at the inner bottom of the first protection barrel, so that the materials can be better matched with the blades to be contacted to achieve the crushing effect, and the drying effect can be achieved through wind energy, the materials are prevented from being adhered in the inner barrel and are difficult to clean, and the structure is beneficial to improving the practicability and flexibility of the whole material beating machine for food processing.

title_en: Biological extraction centrifugal separator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a biological extraction centrifugal separator, which comprises a casing main body and a motor, wherein a flip cover is arranged at the top of the casing main body, an inner barrel is arranged at the upper part of the casing main body, a vertical rotating head assembly is arranged in the inner barrel, the rotating head assembly comprises a rotating shaft and a cross-shaped rotor frame, four symmetrical hanging cups are hinged at the outer side of the rotor frame, an eight-edge column head is arranged at the upper end of the rotating shaft, the eight-edge column head axially penetrates through the middle part of the rotor frame and is circumferentially fixed with the middle part of the rotor frame, a hanging hook is hinged at the inner side of the hanging cup, an annular locating plate is clamped at the upper end of the eight-edge column head, four evenly distributed support arms are arranged at the outer side of the locating plate, jacks penetrating up and down are arranged at the outer ends of the support arms, when the hanging hooks are hooked with the jacks in a one-to-one correspondence, the upper ends of the hanging cups are inclined towards the axis, the locating plate is positioned above the rotor frame, and a gland is arranged at the upper end of the eight-edge column head, and two different separation requirements are met by one instrument, and purchasing investment can be greatly reduced.

title_en: Self-cleaning device for cleaning roller screen
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cleaning treatment, and particularly discloses a self-cleaning device for cleaning a roller screen, which comprises a gas transmission mechanism and a roller screen, wherein the roller screen comprises a first supporting table, a roller screen shell and the roller screen, the roller screen shell is fixedly arranged on the first supporting table, the roller screen is positioned in the roller screen shell, a gap is reserved between the roller screen and the roller screen shell, the self-cleaning device further comprises a rotary cleaning mechanism, the rotary cleaning mechanism comprises a plurality of motors, a plurality of couplers and driven empty pipes, the motors are arranged on the first supporting table, one end of each coupler is connected with the motor, the other end of each coupler is connected with the driven empty pipe, the driven empty pipe penetrates through the gap, the driven empty pipe is communicated with the gas transmission mechanism, and a plurality of air spraying holes are formed in the driven empty pipe, and the air spraying directions of the air spraying holes face the roller screen. The utility model can reduce the manual cleaning cost.

title_en: Automatic packaging machine for packaging solid beverage
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of solid beverage packaging and discloses an automatic packaging machine for solid beverage packaging, which comprises a conveying device, wherein the top of the conveying device is fixedly connected with a packaging mechanism, the top of the packaging mechanism is fixedly connected with a pouring mechanism, the packaging mechanism comprises a sealing assembly and a pushing assembly, the pushing assembly is arranged at the bottom of the sealing assembly, the sealing assembly comprises a supporting table, the top of the supporting table is fixedly connected with a first electric push rod, one end of the first electric push rod is fixedly connected with hot frit, and two ends of one side of the hot frit are respectively and fixedly connected with a limiting rod. This automatic packaging machine for solid beverage packing to drive the horizontal rack and remove and drive the diaphragm outwards remove, and finally drive the holder and open and put in the beverage packaging bag that seals on conveyer and carry out corresponding transmission, thereby can carry out the automatic packing operation to solid beverage, and be convenient for carry out the automatic transport operation after the packing is accomplished.

title_en: Tea-oil camellia raw materials sieve separator is used in health milk production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of oil tea processing, and discloses an oil tea raw material screening machine for body milk production, which comprises a box body, wherein water tanks are fixedly connected to two sides of the outer wall of the box body, an ear plate is arranged on the top surface of the inner wall of the box body, a supporting frame is fixedly connected to the bottom of the ear plate, a filter screen is fixedly connected to the bottom of the supporting frame, the bottom of one side of the supporting frame is rotatably connected to one side of the top surface of the water tank on one side, a motor is fixedly connected to the middle part of the outer part of the supporting frame, a threaded rod is fixedly connected to the output end of the motor, the bottom of the scraping plate is positioned at the inner top of the box body, and the top surface of the scraping plate is slidably connected to the top surface of the inner wall of the supporting frame. According to the utility model, the shrunken tea tree seeds and the saline water are poured into the box body, so that the shrunken tea tree seeds can float, the scraping plates are driven by the driving motor to move left and right, and the shrunken tea tree seeds can be scraped into the water tanks on the two sides, so that the phenomenon that the shrunken tea tree seeds cannot be cleaned due to the floating of the shrunken tea tree seeds can be avoided.

title_en: Oiling station is used in waterproofing membrane production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an oiling device for waterproof coiled material production, which relates to the technical field of waterproof coiled material processing, and comprises a cleaning mechanism for cleaning the surface of a waterproof coiled material base cloth; the oil immersion tank is internally provided with an oil immersion roller and a guide roller in a rotating way; the squeeze roll comprises a fixed squeeze roll and a movable squeeze roll, and the scraping plate comprises a fixed scraping plate and a movable scraping plate. The utility model particularly provides an oiling device for producing waterproof coiled materials, which can remove dust on the surface of a waterproof coiled material base cloth and can meet extrusion and strickling of the waterproof coiled materials with different thicknesses after oiling.

title_en: Refractory raw material roller screening machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a refractory raw material roller screening machine, which comprises a screening machine frame and a screening roller which is arranged on the screening machine frame in a rolling way, wherein the screening machine frame is connected with a mounting rod, and the mounting rod is connected with a sieve pore plectrum through a spring; 2) the sieve pore shifting sheet is arranged on a rotatable mounting rod, and the blocking condition of screening rotation is detected by a blocking detection device, and under the condition that no blocking occurs, the mounting rod can separate the sieve pore shifting sheet from the surface of the screening roller through rotation, so that the loss caused by direct friction of the sieve pore shifting sheet and the screening roller when the screening roller is not blocked is reduced.

title_en: Ultrasonic generator of ultrasonic cleaner
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ultrasonic generator of an ultrasonic cleaner, which comprises an ultrasonic power supply, wherein a first wiring hole is arranged at the rear end of the ultrasonic power supply, a first wiring line is inserted into the first wiring hole, a second wiring hole is arranged at the rear end of the ultrasonic power supply, a second connecting line is inserted into the second wiring hole, and a fixing structure is arranged between the first wiring line and the second connecting line. When the first connecting wire is inserted into the first wiring hole, the frame-shaped clamping plate on the T-shaped rod is clamped into the frame-shaped groove, and when the second connecting wire is inserted into the second wiring hole, the U-shaped clamping plate on the T-shaped rod is clamped into the U-shaped groove, so that the first connecting wire is inserted into the first wiring hole and the second connecting wire is inserted into the second wiring hole more firmly, the phenomenon of unrealistic wiring caused by false touch and falling is avoided, the ultrasonic power supply is electrified, and the stable work of the external ultrasonic cleaner is controlled.

title_en: Novel steam sweeps structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel steam purging structure, which comprises a body, wherein the body comprises flanges arranged at two ends, connecting pipes are arranged on the inner sides of the flanges, a steam drum is connected between the connecting pipes at two sides, a plurality of through holes are formed in the side wall of the steam drum, and a V-shaped cover plate is welded at each through hole of the steam drum. According to the utility model, through the V-shaped cover plate arranged on the side wall, jet air flow is formed when steam passes through the V-shaped cover plate, so that dust accumulated on the lower part of the cone shell can be effectively removed, the cleaning is cleaner, and the equipment damage is avoided.

title_en: Dust collector is used in pneumatic component processing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of pneumatic element processing, and discloses a dust removing device for pneumatic element processing, which comprises an underframe, wherein the top of the underframe is fixedly connected with a supporting frame, the bottom of the supporting frame is fixedly connected with two electric push rods, the bottoms of the two electric push rods are fixedly connected with the top of a mounting plate, the top of the mounting plate is fixedly connected with a first motor, the outer side of an output shaft of the first motor is fixedly connected with a protection box which is rotationally connected with the mounting plate, the inner side of the protection box is fixedly connected with a second motor, the outer side of the output shaft of the second motor is fixedly connected with a threaded rod which is rotationally connected with the inner side of the protection box, and the outer side of the threaded rod is connected with a first transmission block through thread transmission. The dust removing device for processing the pneumatic element has the advantages of being capable of adapting to tubular pneumatic elements with different sizes and cleaning the inner wall of the tubular pneumatic element.

title_en: Accurate separating funnel that organic solution detected
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a precise separating funnel for detecting organic solution, which relates to the field of precise separating funnels and comprises a plate surface, wherein the upper end of the plate surface is fixedly connected with a bracket, the outer sides of the bracket are fixedly connected with shaking assemblies, the inner sides of the shaking assemblies are fixedly connected with mounting plates, and the upper ends of the mounting plates are fixedly connected with fixing assemblies. According to the utility model, the structure is adopted, the driving gear is rotated under the rotation of the reciprocating motor by controlling the reciprocating motor, the driving gears on two sides of the support are rotated under the action of the connecting shaft, the driven gears are driven to rotate by the rotation of the driving gears, the fixing frame is driven to rotate under the rotation of the driven gears, the mounting plate is driven to rotate under the rotation of the fixing frame, the funnel body can be subjected to shaking effect under the rotation of the mounting plate, and therefore the fusion effect inside liquid is increased, and the detection accuracy is improved.

title_en: Cyclopropylamine stripping tower
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cyclopropylamine stripping tower, which comprises a stripping tower main body, wherein a plurality of packing layers are arranged in the stripping tower main body at intervals, a liquid inlet pipe is arranged above the packing layer at the top, the liquid inlet pipe is divided into an inlet and an outlet, the inlet is positioned outside the stripping tower, the outlet is positioned inside the stripping tower, an air inlet pipe is arranged below the packing layer at the bottom, a liquid outlet pipe is arranged at the bottom of the stripping tower, an air outlet pipe is arranged at the top of the stripping tower, an air exhaust plate is arranged between every two packing layers, the air exhaust plate comprises a rotary table rotatably arranged in the stripping tower, a fixed disc fixedly arranged in the stripping tower and a driving part, the rotary table is rotatably arranged on the fixed disc, corresponding through holes are formed in the rotary table and the fixed disc, the size of the ventilation holes is changed in a rotating mode, and the use flexibility is improved.

title_en: Split type suspension solid-liquid separation device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a split suspension solid-liquid separation device which comprises a machine shell, wherein a separation shell is fixedly communicated with the top of the machine shell, a sealing cover is hinged to the surface of the separation shell, a hydraulic cylinder is fixedly arranged at the top of the machine shell, a connecting plate is fixedly arranged at the top of the hydraulic cylinder, a bearing ring is fixedly arranged on the surface of the connecting plate, a centrifugal cylinder is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the bearing ring, a cleaning door is hinged to the surface of the centrifugal cylinder, a plurality of sieve holes are formed in the surfaces of the centrifugal cylinder and the cleaning door, a connecting rod is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the connecting plate, a supporting frame is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the connecting rod, and a driving motor is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the supporting frame, and an output shaft of the driving motor penetrates through the supporting frame and is fixedly connected with the bottom of the centrifugal cylinder. According to the centrifugal barrel, the centrifugal barrel is split, so that the centrifugal barrel can be taken out from the separation shell, and the front side of the centrifugal barrel can be unfolded, so that the centrifugal barrel can be cleaned more conveniently, and the blocking condition is reduced.

title_en: A portable device for homemade day moxibustion is pasted
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable device for self-made moxibustion plaster, which comprises a base, a storage part, a sealing extrusion cover and a stirring part, wherein a driving motor is arranged in the middle of the base, a storage cavity is arranged in the storage part and used for storing moxibustion plaster to be processed, the upper end of the storage part is formed into an opening and is communicated with the storage cavity, the lower end of the storage part is a closed end, the lower end of the storage part is detachably connected to the base, the bottom end of the storage part is provided with a medicine outlet nozzle, the medicine outlet nozzle is communicated with the storage cavity, the sealing extrusion cover is detachably arranged in the opening of the storage part and used for sealing the opening and extruding the plaster in the storage part from the medicine outlet nozzle, the stirring part is arranged in the storage cavity, the upper end of the stirring part is detachably connected with the sealing extrusion cover, and the lower end of the stirring part is connected with the driving motor so as to drive the stirring part to rotate through the driving motor.

title_en: Surface spraying device convenient to remove for large-scale steel construction
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a surface spraying device for a large steel structure, which is convenient to move, and comprises a spraying device body and a built-in driving rotating motor arranged in the spraying device body, wherein an inner connecting adjustable pipe is arranged in the middle of an outer connecting pipe, an inner decoration connecting thread moving column is arranged at the bottom of the inner connecting adjustable pipe, a poking installation knob cylinder is connected to a side stirring cross rod through thread rotation, the outer connecting pipe generates outward force to contact the inner wall of the spraying device body through the rotation of a vertical shaft rod, and the telescopic inner connecting column can be stretched and reset under the action of a telescopic reset spring after power is lost.

title_en: Fruit vegetables antistaling agent sprinkler
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fruit and vegetable preservative spraying device which comprises a box body, wherein fruit and vegetable preservative is injected into the box body, a feeding hole is formed in the right side of the box body, a discharging hole is formed in the left side of the box body, a first conveying belt, a material turning plate and a second conveying belt are sequentially and fixedly arranged in the box body from right to left, and the material turning plate is of an arc-shaped structure and is located between the first conveying belt and the second conveying belt. In the utility model, fruits and vegetables enter the box body through the feed inlet, are pushed to the second conveying belt by the turning plate and are sent out by the discharge outlet, the preservative is sprayed to the surfaces of the fruits and vegetables by the atomizing spray heads, the automatic conveying and spraying of the preservative are carried out on the fruits and vegetables, time and labor are saved, the efficiency is improved, the fruits and vegetables are low, when the fruits and vegetables pass through the turning plate in the conveying process, the fruits and vegetables are turned over under the combined action of the turning plate and the spraying plate, and the atomizing spray heads on the spraying plate continuously spray the preservative to the surfaces of the fruits and vegetables, so that the preservative can be uniformly and comprehensively sprayed to the surfaces of the fruits and vegetables.

title_en: Centrifuging tube support convenient to it is clean
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a centrifuge tube support convenient to clean, which comprises support legs, wherein anti-slip pads are adhered to the bottom ends of the support legs, bases are connected to the top ends of the support legs in a clamping mode, lifting structures are connected to the top ends of the bases in a clamping mode, and supporting plates are connected to the top ends of the lifting structures in a clamping mode. According to the centrifuge tube rack, the plurality of large jacks, the plurality of medium jacks and the plurality of small jacks are uniformly formed in the perforation plane and the support plate, the smaller holes are formed in the corresponding positions of the base, so that a user can conveniently select jacks with proper sizes according to the thickness of a centrifuge tube to be used, the centrifuge tube can be placed more stably, rubber rings are arranged on the inner sides of the large jacks, the medium jacks and the small jacks, and the marking plates are arranged on the top ends of the perforation plane, so that the centrifuge tube can be prevented from being damaged when the centrifuge tube collides with the rack, and the stability of the rack when the rack is moved is ensured, and the aim that the centrifuge tube rack can adapt to centrifuge tubes with various types is fulfilled.

title_en: Vacuum roller with cleaning mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vacuum roller with a cleaning mechanism, which comprises a vacuum roller body, wherein mounting plates are arranged on two sides of the vacuum roller body, a dust collection opening is formed in the outer side of the vacuum roller body along the length direction of the vacuum roller body, two ends of the dust collection opening are fixed on the mounting plates, and a cleaning brush is arranged on the inner side of the dust collection opening. According to the utility model, the dust collection opening and the cleaning brush are arranged on the outer side of the vacuum roller body, so that the vacuum roller body can be automatically cleaned in real time in the working process without stopping operation, and the working efficiency is remarkably improved. The cleaning brush can effectively remove the relatively intractable impurities on the surface of the vacuum roller body, and the dust collection port synchronously sucks away floating dust and the brushed impurities, so that the continuous and stable operation of the vacuum roller body is ensured, and the smooth and unimpeded production flow is ensured.

title_en: Efficient processing device for trimming burrs and chamfer of edges of copper-aluminum composite plates
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of burr chamfer trimming, and discloses a high-efficiency processing device for trimming a burr chamfer at the edge of a copper-aluminum composite plate, which comprises a workbench, wherein a motor is fixedly connected inside the workbench, the output end of the motor is fixedly connected with a connecting block, the outer wall of the connecting block is provided with a transmission assembly, the transmission assembly is used for driving the connecting blocks at two sides to synchronously rotate, a sliding sleeve is connected inside the workbench in a sliding manner, a bearing is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the sliding sleeve, and a grinding wheel is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the bearing. According to the utility model, the problems that the deburring efficiency of the device is low, the trimming effect is unstable, the chamfering angle of the cutter is difficult to accurately adjust, and the flexible adjusting function is lacking are solved, the efficient deburring is achieved, the smooth edge of a material can be ensured, the overall quality and appearance of a product are improved, and meanwhile, the adjustable chamfering angle can adapt to different plate strips, so that the flexibility of production is improved.

title_en: Sliding chute type high-temperature oven for denitration catalyst
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a chute type high-temperature oven for a denitration catalyst, which relates to the field of ovens and comprises an oven main body, wherein a plurality of installation chutes are symmetrically arranged on the inner walls of the left side and the right side of the oven main body in pairs, a material bearing slide plate is slidably arranged on the two symmetrically arranged installation chutes, an installation connecting frame is fixedly arranged at the front end of the material bearing slide plate and consists of installation base blocks and installation guide rods, the installation guide rods are symmetrically and fixedly arranged at the left end and the right end of the installation base blocks, two connecting rods are slidably arranged on the plurality of installation connecting frames, and the front ends of the material bearing slide plates are provided with the installation connecting frames.

title_en: Feed production dosing unit of steerable ratio
