abstract_en: The utility model discloses a feed production proportioning device capable of controlling proportioning, which comprises a proportioning machine shell and a driving disc arranged at the bottom of a base, wherein a feed cylinder is arranged on the driving disc, a supporting rod is arranged on the right side of the base, and two groups of stirring rods are arranged on the supporting rod. Through installing the feed cylinder on the driving disk of proportioning machine casing to be provided with two sets of puddlers in the feed cylinder, let two sets of puddlers carry out intensive mixing to the fodder in the feed cylinder at feed cylinder rotation in-process, the rotatable dish of placing is installed on the rethread in the base top, can let servo motor drive gear and rotate, make driven gear can drive the change cover under drive gear's effect and place the dish and rotate along the bull stick, the flow control pump on the start-up feed cylinder lets the flow control pump with the batching in the storage box follow discharge gate accurate spout feed cylinder inside, thereby the use quantity of accurate control batching has improved the accuracy of device when the fodder ratio.

title_en: Dissolving device for polyacrylamide dry powder assembly
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of dissolving devices, in particular to a dissolving device for polyacrylamide dry powder assembly, which comprises a dissolving tank, a storage box and a discharging assembly, wherein a sliding plate is arranged on the inner wall of the storage box in a sliding manner, a plurality of springs are fixedly connected to the lower end of the sliding plate, the other ends of the springs are fixedly connected to the bottom of the inner wall of the storage box, an induction switch is fixedly connected to the center of the bottom of the inner wall of the storage box, two mounting plates are fixedly connected to the lower end of an upper cover, a first motor is fixedly connected to the right end of each mounting plate, and an output shaft of the first motor penetrates through the right end of each mounting plate and is fixedly connected with a first rotating rod. According to the utility model, after a certain amount of dry powder is accumulated, the sliding plate slides downwards under the action of gravity, contacts the inductive switch and triggers the first motor, the first rotating rod drives the storage box to rotate, the dry powder in the storage box is poured into the dissolving tank, and then the storage box is reset, so that quantitative feeding is performed reciprocally, and the problem that the dry powder is not completely dissolved in the dissolving process and thus a clot or caking is formed due to excessive dry powder feeding is solved.

title_en: Filter equipment is used in filtrate reducer production water
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a filtering device for fluid loss agent production water, which belongs to the field of fluid loss agent production and comprises a filtering box and a mixing box, wherein a water outlet of the filtering box is fixedly connected with a connecting valve, a water delivery pipe is fixedly connected with a water outlet end of the connecting valve, the bottom end of the water delivery pipe is fixedly connected with a water inlet of the mixing box, a mixing structure for mixing a medicament with water is arranged on the right side of the mixing box, and the mixing structure comprises a servo motor fixedly connected to the right side of the mixing box, a transmission rod fixedly connected to an output shaft of the servo motor, a transmission wheel fixedly connected to the outer side of the transmission rod, a transmission belt connected to the outer surface of the transmission wheel in a transmission way, and a driven wheel connected to the bottom end of the transmission belt in a transmission way. The filtering device for the filtrate reducer production water can remove large-particle impurities, tiny metal particles, tiny particles, organic matters, peculiar smell and other harmful substances in water, ensure that the water quality reaches higher purity standard, and provide a good foundation for subsequent medicament mixing.

title_en: Paint spraying device for electric tricycle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a paint spraying device of an electric tricycle, which comprises a bottom plate, a supporting component, a paint spraying component, two translation components, two clamping components and two retaining plates, wherein moving grooves are respectively formed in two sides of the bottom plate, the supporting component is arranged on the bottom plate, the paint spraying component is arranged on the supporting component, the two translation components are respectively arranged on the bottom plate and are positioned on the outer side of the moving grooves, the translation components comprise a vertical frame, a driving motor, an elliptic piece, a deflector rod and a torsion spring, the vertical frame is arranged on one side of the moving grooves, the driving motor is arranged on the vertical frame, an output shaft of the driving motor is connected with the elliptic piece through the vertical frame, the deflector rod is connected with the bottom of the elliptic piece, the torsion spring is arranged at a connecting position between the deflector rod and the elliptic piece, and the clamping components are arranged in the bottom plate. Therefore, the uniformity and consistency of paint spraying of the electric tricycle can be improved. The color is uniform and has no chromatic aberration, and the visual effect of the whole vehicle is improved. The paint layer can effectively resist the invasion of environmental factors such as ultraviolet rays, rainwater and the like, and the overall durability is improved.

title_en: Bamboo fiber granule water supply circulating device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a bamboo fiber granule water supply circulating device which comprises an extruder and a slitting cylinder, wherein one end of the slitting cylinder is connected with an outlet of the extruder, an extrusion plate is vertically arranged at the joint of the slitting cylinder, a gear box is arranged at the other end of the slitting cylinder, a transmission shaft of the gear box is connected with a slitting shaft in the slitting cylinder, a slitting disc is arranged on the slitting shaft, a water supply pipe is connected to the bottom of the slitting cylinder, a mixing pipe is connected to the top of the slitting cylinder, the outlet of the mixing pipe is connected with a separation box, and a grain guide plate is arranged on the separation box. The structure is reasonable after the scheme is adopted, the using effect is good, and particles are not easy to adhere.

title_en: High-efficient heated air circulation electric heat drying cabinet
abstract_en: The application provides a high-efficiency hot air circulation electric heating drying oven, and belongs to the technical field of drying oven equipment. This high-efficient heated air circulation electric heat drying cabinet, including drying structure and fixed knot constructs, drying structure includes electric heat drying cabinet main part, chamber door, circulation subassembly, rose box, filter screen, dehumidification board, two stoppers, L type fixture block and draw-in groove, the chamber door with the electric heat drying cabinet main part is articulated, circulation subassembly with electric heat drying cabinet main part intercommunication, circulation subassembly with the rose box intercommunication, the filter screen with the dehumidification board all set up in the rose box, the stopper both sides all are provided with L type fixture block, the draw-in groove with the rose box is connected, L type fixture block with draw-in groove joint. According to the application, the efficient hot air circulation electric heating drying box is convenient for disassembling and assembling the filter screen and the dehumidifying board, so that the working efficiency is improved, meanwhile, the board is convenient to disassemble and assemble quickly, and the practicability of the device is improved.

title_en: Washing and filtering device for crude polypeptide
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a washing and filtering device for a crude polypeptide, and relates to the field of polypeptide production and preparation. The washing and filtering device for the polypeptide crude product comprises a washing box, wherein a partition plate is fixedly connected to the lower part of the inside of the washing box, through holes are formed in two sides of the upper end of the partition plate, a filter screen is fixedly connected to the inside of each through hole, a sealing plate is arranged at the lower end of each through hole, a shell is fixedly connected to the lower end of the inside of the washing box, a mixing assembly and a sealing assembly are arranged on the washing box, the mixing assembly is used for washing polypeptide raw materials in the washing box, the sealing assembly is arranged in the shell, and the sealing assembly is used for driving the sealing plate to move up and down. The technical problems that the existing washing and filtering device is inconvenient for solid-liquid separation, crude polypeptide raw materials cannot be rapidly separated from liquid when people use the washing and filtering device, daily use requirements cannot be met, and the use of people is inconvenient are solved.

title_en: Centrifugal separation device and separation system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of separation devices, in particular to a centrifugal separation device and a separation system. The application discloses a centrifugal separation device which comprises a centrifugal extractor, wherein a feed inlet of the centrifugal extractor is connected to a raffinate acid storage tank, an acid outlet of the centrifugal extractor is connected to a refined phosphoric acid tank, and an oil outlet of the centrifugal extractor is connected to an extractant tank. According to the centrifugal separation device, the mixed liquid in the raffinate acid storage tank is led into the centrifugal extractor for centrifugal extraction separation, so that high-purity raffinate acid and extractant can be obtained, and the problem that trace extractant entrained in the raffinate acid is difficult to completely remove in a natural standing separation mode and adverse effect is caused on a subsequent production process is solved.

title_en: Fertilizer processing screening plant
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of fertilizer processing and discloses a fertilizer processing and screening device, which comprises a base and a screening cylinder, wherein the lower half part of the screening cylinder is fixedly arranged into an integrated semicircular arc screen plate body, two groups of vertical beam plates are fixedly arranged at two end sides of the top of the base, the screening cylinder is transversely arranged right above the base through four groups of vertical beam plates at the top of the base, the fertilizer processing and screening device further comprises an elastic connection structure arranged between two ends of the screening cylinder and the vertical beam plates at two sides of the base, and an intermittent lifting structure arranged at two corners of opposite angles on the base, wherein the intermittent lifting structure is matched with the elastic connection structure and used for intermittently lifting the screening cylinder to vibrate the screening cylinder up and down, and a rolling structure arranged inside the screening cylinder is used for driving fertilizer inside the screening cylinder to roll through the semicircular arc screen plate body for multiple times to screen materials.

title_en: Lithium ion battery washs and drying device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lithium ion battery cleaning and drying device which comprises a cleaning box, a transfer assembly for loading lithium ion batteries, a conveying mechanism and a drying mechanism, wherein cleaning liquid is arranged in the cleaning box, the transfer assembly is arranged on the conveying mechanism, the conveying mechanism is arranged in the cleaning box, the transfer assembly is conveyed to pass through the cleaning liquid in the cleaning box and is conveyed to the drying mechanism, and the drying mechanism is arranged above the cleaning box and is used for drying the lithium ion batteries passing through the cleaning liquid. Can be more smooth and easy let hot-blast each surface that reaches lithium ion battery, and then need not turn lithium ion battery, can carry out thorough stoving processing to lithium ion battery's surface, improved the efficiency of stoving, prevented to produce collision or drop between the lithium ion battery, improved yield and security.

title_en: Construction waste crushing, sorting and automatic pressing forming integrated machine
abstract_en: The utility model provides an integrated machine for crushing, sorting and automatic compression molding of construction waste, which relates to the technical field of construction waste recovery, and comprises a protection side plate, wherein a support frame is arranged at the bottom of the protection side plate; the bottom of the supporting frame is provided with a collecting box, the top of the protection side plate is also provided with a supporting plate, a servo motor is arranged in the middle of the top of the supporting plate, two sides of the top of the supporting plate are rotatably provided with positioning rods, the top of each positioning rod is connected with the output end of the servo motor at the top of the supporting plate through a chain group, and one end of the protection side plate is provided with a collecting cover. The stirring plate can be driven to rotate through the driving action of the driving motor to form stirring operation, so that the concrete attached to the surface of the metal material can be effectively turned over to fall off, the cleanliness of the metal material is improved, the problem that the surface of the metal material can be covered by broken concrete particles, a large amount of impurities are mixed in the metal material, and the recycling quality of the metal material is affected is solved.

title_en: Energy-saving nitrogen centrifugal unit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a nitrogen centrifugal unit capable of saving energy consumption, relates to the technical field of nitrogen centrifugal unit structures, and aims to solve the problem that the existing nitrogen centrifugal unit is easy to cause energy consumption waste when nitrogen is introduced. The sealed lid is installed to centrifugal unit's top, the motor is installed to centrifugal unit's top, one side of motor is provided with the feeding seat, the opposite side of motor is provided with the seat that admits air, the welding seat is installed to one side of seat that admits air, the rotation mount pad is installed to centrifugal unit's one end, one side of centrifugal unit is provided with the rotation supporting seat, the cylinder is installed to the top of rotating the supporting seat, the control box is installed to one side of rotating the supporting seat, centrifugal unit's lower extreme is provided with the discharge seat, one side of centrifugal unit lower extreme is provided with the exhaust seat, the supporting legs is installed to the below of stabilizing the seat, the support frame is installed to the below of supporting legs.

title_en: Panel conveyor and gypsum board production facility
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a board conveying device and gypsum board production equipment, which comprises a board placing system, a pre-storing system and a control device, wherein the board placing system is used for sequentially discharging boards to a downstream system, the pre-storing system comprises a plurality of board placing systems which are sequentially connected along the conveying direction of the boards, the first board placing system in the plurality of pre-storing systems is arranged to be matched with a dryer, the last pre-storing system in the plurality of pre-storing systems is arranged to be matched with the board placing device, and the control device is connected with the board placing system and the pre-storing system.

title_en: Paper detection device
abstract_en: The application discloses a paper detection device, which belongs to the field of paper making and comprises a security rotating platform, wherein four limiting mechanisms are arranged at the top of the security rotating platform, the four limiting mechanisms are symmetrically distributed at the top of the security rotating platform, a supporting frame is arranged between the four limiting mechanisms, the supporting frame is fixedly connected with the security rotating platform, a tension adjusting mechanism is arranged in the supporting frame and comprises supporting rollers, the two supporting rollers are symmetrically arranged in the supporting frame, the paper is supported by the supporting rollers, a locating rack and a regulating roller are arranged, the locating rack is driven to move by the telescopic end of the second electric push rod, the regulating roller is driven to move by the locating rack, and the tension of the paper is regulated by the regulating roller.

title_en: Clean system based on glycine is prepared to full aqueous phase method
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cleaning system for preparing glycine based on an all-aqueous phase method, and belongs to the technical field of glycine cleaning production. The cleaning system comprises a chlorination reaction kettle, an ammonification reaction kettle, a crystallization kettle, a filter I, a pulping device, a filter II, a drying device, an electrodialysis membrane device, a bipolar membrane device and the like which are sequentially connected, wherein the specific positions and the connection arrangement of all the devices are used for effectively recycling glycine in filtration mother liquor generated in the glycine preparation process and applying the glycine with urotropine as a catalyst, so that the single-pass yield of the glycine is improved, and the consumption of urotropine as a catalyst is reduced; in addition, the tail gas is treated in a targeted way, and the recovered raw material is recycled, so that the utilization rate of the raw material is improved, and the environment is friendly.

title_en: High-precision multilayer hydrocyclone sand removal device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-precision multilayer hydrocyclone sand removing device which comprises a concrete tank body and a water inlet, wherein the water inlet is positioned in the concrete tank body, one end of the water inlet is fixedly connected with a water diversion opening, one end of the water diversion opening, which is far away from the water inlet, is fixedly connected with a stacking disc, the stacking discs are connected through a stacking disc fixing piece, one side, which is far away from the stacking disc, of the stacking disc fixing piece is connected with a mounting frame, the top end of the mounting frame is fixedly connected with a mounting bracket, a flushing system is arranged on the mounting frame, the bottom of the mounting bracket is connected with the whole sand removing device, 4 mounting support legs are arranged on the periphery of the mounting bracket and are connected with a concrete tank wall, the mounting support can realize + -8 cm of adjusting space for adapting to the shape of the concrete tank wall, and 180-degree angle adjustment between the mounting support legs and the mounting bracket can be realized.

title_en: Spray head driving assembly and spray device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a spray head driving assembly and a spray device, wherein the spray head driving assembly comprises a shaft seat and a water passing shaft, the water passing shaft is movably arranged in the shaft seat, the output end of the water passing shaft is positioned outside the shaft seat, and a water passing hole penetrating to the output end of the water passing shaft along the axial direction is formed in the water passing shaft. In the spray head driving assembly provided by the utility model, the blades of the water passing shaft can stir water flow when the water passing shaft rotates, so that the water flow is promoted to enter the water passing holes in the water passing shaft, and the path from the water inlet of the shaft seat to the output end of the water passing shaft is smoother, thereby ensuring that the water flow with stable flow speed is supplied to the spray head, and further ensuring the effect of fountain performance.

title_en: Low-temperature crushing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses low-temperature crushing equipment which comprises a crushing tank, wherein a feed inlet is formed and fixed on the left side of the top of the crushing tank, a motor is arranged at the middle position of the top of the crushing tank, a discharge port is formed and fixed on the bottom of the crushing tank, a crushing roller and a rotating column are connected inside the crushing tank, the top of the rotating column extends out of the upper surface of the crushing tank, the top of the rotating column is fixedly connected with the output end of the motor, a laminating block is fixedly connected at the middle position of the top of the inner wall of the crushing tank, and a guide rod is fixed on the outer side of the upper end of the crushing roller. This low temperature crushing apparatus rotates post and crushing roller high-speed rotation through motor drive, can smash the agar raw materials in the crushing jar and handle, simultaneously under guide bar, laminating piece and reset spring's cooperation for the crushing roller reciprocates from top to bottom, can fully smash the agar raw materials of each position in the crushing jar, thereby improves crushing effect.

title_en: Fixing device for dust-binding paper roll
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of dust-binding paper rolls, in particular to a fixing device for the dust-binding paper roll, which comprises a base, an adjusting device and a clamping device, wherein a supporting plate is fixedly arranged at one end of the top wall of the base, a moving plate is arranged at the other end of the top wall of the base through the adjusting device, the clamping device is arranged on one side wall corresponding to the supporting plate and the moving plate, a first motor is arranged on the side wall of the supporting plate, a second motor rotates a rotating shaft connected with the supporting plate, further, power is transmitted to a rack through a gear system, the rack moves along a sliding groove, further, the sliding bar is driven to slide outwards, and finally, the clamping arc plates arranged at the tail ends of the sliding bar are outwards expanded, and due to the meshing effect of a tooth groove ring and gears, all gears can be ensured to synchronously rotate, so that the clamping arc plates in four directions uniformly apply force to the center, and the situation that the dust-binding paper roll cannot deviate or loose in the use process is ensured.

title_en: Mixing stirring device for M recycling in CBS synthesis of rubber accelerator
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of stirring equipment, which comprises a stirring kettle, wherein a filter cylinder is arranged in the stirring kettle, a feeding pipe is arranged at the top of the filter cylinder, a rotating rod is arranged in the filter cylinder, a crushing cutter is arranged on the rotating rod, the upper end of the rotating rod is fixedly connected with a connecting rod, the connecting rod stretches into the feeding pipe and is fixedly connected with the inner wall of the feeding pipe through a fixing rod, a first conical gear is fixedly arranged on the feeding pipe positioned outside the stirring kettle, a second conical gear is meshed with the first conical gear, the second conical gear is connected with a motor, the bottom of the filter cylinder is connected with a supporting rod, the lower end of the supporting rod is connected with the inner wall of the reaction kettle, the filter cylinder is rotationally connected with the feeding pipe through a bearing, and the stirring rod is connected with the feeding pipe in the stirring kettle. The utility model has reasonable structure and simple use, can crush and break up the materials entering the filter cylinder and stir the materials in the stirring tank at the same time, thereby improving the mixing efficiency and the mixing effect.

title_en: Charging control assembly and biomass gas production reaction kettle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of reaction kettles and discloses a feeding control assembly and a biomass gas production reaction kettle, which comprises a base, a reaction kettle, a feed inlet, a discharge outlet, an inner container assembly, a stirring assembly and a cleaning assembly, wherein the reaction kettle is arranged on the base, the feed inlet is arranged at the top of the reaction kettle, the discharge outlet is arranged at the bottom of the base, the inner container assembly is fixedly arranged in the reaction kettle, the stirring assembly is arranged in the inner container assembly, and the cleaning assembly is arranged on the inner container assembly.

title_en: Multistage filtering device for water quality monitoring
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multistage filtering device for water quality monitoring, which comprises a water purifying tank and a multistage filtering mechanism arranged at the upper end of the water purifying tank, wherein first filter screens are fixedly arranged at the edges of one sides of the inner walls of two mounting clamping rings of the multistage filtering mechanism, connecting frames are fixedly arranged at the output ends of two electric push rods, rolling wheels are rotatably connected to the bottoms of the two connecting frames, a water purifying tank is fixedly arranged at one end of each arc-shaped connecting bar, and a fixing frame is connected to the inner wall of the water purifying tank in an inserted manner.

title_en: Movable stone material surface cleaning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a movable stone surface cleaning device, which is suitable for cleaning stone slabs with different thicknesses, and comprises the following components: the device comprises a conveying frame, two groups of clamping feeding mechanisms, a fixing frame, a brushing mechanism and a spraying mechanism. According to the utility model, according to the plates with different thicknesses, the pressing force applied to the stone plate is regulated through the regulating knob, the roller brush is downwards pressed by combining the buffer spring, the cleaning friction force between the roller brush and the stone plate is kept, the stubborn stains on the surface of the stone plate can be effectively erased, meanwhile, the plates with different thicknesses are cleaned, the application range is wide, the roller brush is driven to rotate through the roller brush speed reducing motor, the stone plate surface can be cleaned through the rotation of the roller brush, the spraying moving seat is driven to circularly move left and right through the spraying seat driving motor, the cleaning spray head is driven to reciprocally move to wash the surface of the stone plate, the dirt between the roller brush and the stone plate can be effectively washed away, and the cleaning efficiency is high.

title_en: Energy-saving and carbon-reduction contract energy management power saving device for air conditioner room
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an energy-saving and carbon-reduction contract energy management air conditioner room power saving device which comprises a room body, wherein a filter plate is fixedly arranged on one side of the room body, a shell is fixedly connected to one side of the room body and positioned at the top of the filter plate, an electric push rod is fixedly connected to the right side of an inner cavity of the shell, a push plate is fixedly connected to the left side of the electric push rod, a fixed rod is fixedly connected to the bottom of the push plate, and a cleaning shell is fixedly connected to the bottom of the fixed rod through the outside of the shell.

title_en: Multi-stage ball milling crusher for fine iron powder
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of iron fine powder ball grinding and crushing machines, and discloses an iron fine powder multi-stage ball grinding and crushing machine which comprises a bearing plate, wherein a first fixing support is fixedly arranged above the bearing plate, a discharging groove is fixedly arranged above the first fixing support, a fixing plate is fixedly arranged on the side face of the discharging groove, a first motor support is fixedly arranged above the fixing plate, a first motor is fixedly arranged on the inner side of the first motor support, and a second fixing support is fixedly arranged above the fixing plate. Compared with the traditional device, the device can uniformly disperse the transported iron concentrate raw material ore, so that the iron concentrate raw material ore sequentially enters the communicating pipe through the discharging groove, a large amount of iron concentrate is effectively prevented from gathering and rushing in, the communicating pipe is prevented from being blocked, the uniformity and the high efficiency in the subsequent grinding process are ensured, and the overall quality of products is improved.

title_en: Vertical resin catcher of thermal power plant's water treatment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vertical resin catcher for water treatment of a thermal power plant, which relates to the technical field of resin catching, and comprises a main body frame, wherein a filter screen is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the main body frame, resin filtered by the surface of a filter belt is conveyed rightwards through the rotation of the filter belt by a filter assembly, the side wall of a conveying belt is attached to the surface of the filter belt, so that a first movable cleaning brush scrapes and takes away the resin filtered by the surface of the filter belt, the resin filtered by the filter belt is conveniently and automatically cleaned in time, the surface of the filter belt keeps a good filtering effect, the phenomenon that the resin is mutually extruded to pass through the surface of the filter belt to block the surface of the filter screen is avoided, and the resin scraped by the surface of the first cleaning brush is conveniently and intensively collected in the interior of a collecting box through the plurality of scraping brush grooves arranged when the conveying belt continuously rotates.

title_en: Construction site dust fall device for urban rail engineering construction
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of engineering construction auxiliary facilities, and discloses a construction site dust fall device for urban rail engineering construction, which comprises a platform, wherein a height adjusting component is arranged at the top of the platform, a hydraulic lifting rod is fixedly arranged at the top of the platform, a pitching adjusting component is arranged at the tops of the height adjusting component and the hydraulic lifting rod, the pitching adjusting component comprises a mounting seat, a horizontal adjusting component is arranged at the top of the mounting seat, a water tank component is fixedly arranged at the top of the platform, a first connecting pipe is fixedly arranged at the rear side of a water tank body, a water pump is fixedly arranged at the other end of the first connecting pipe, an electromagnetic valve is fixedly arranged at the top of the water pump, a connecting hose is fixedly arranged at the front side of the water pump, the other end of the connecting hose is fixedly connected with a spraying machine, the common adjusting structure of the height adjusting component, the pitching adjusting component and the horizontal adjusting component can adapt to dust raising areas with different heights such as a foundation pit, a high platform and the like, and meanwhile, dust raising areas with different distances near and no dead angles can be covered.

title_en: Leaf and dust separating device for tea production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a leaf dust separating device for tea production, which comprises a box body, wherein a feeding pipe and a dust removing structure are fixedly connected to the upper side of the box body, four springs are fixedly connected to the upper side of the inside of the box body, square pipe blocks are fixedly connected to the lower sides of the springs, a filtering structure is arranged on the inner sides of the square pipe blocks, a box door is rotatably connected to the front side of the box body, a handle is fixedly connected to the front side of the box door, the handle is U-shaped, the filtering structure comprises square grooves, the square grooves are formed in the front sides of the square pipe blocks, and a mouth-shaped block is arranged in the square grooves. Compared with the prior art, the filter structure is arranged, when a worker needs to detach the screen for cleaning, the worker can detach the screen without tools, so that time and labor are saved, convenience and quickness are realized, and the workload of the worker is reduced.

title_en: Cooling water tower
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cooling water tower, which comprises a tower body, wherein one side of the tower body is fixedly connected with a water inlet pipe, the top of the tower body is provided with a tower cover, the top of the tower cover is provided with a cleaning component, the water inlet pipe is internally provided with a cleaning component, the cleaning component comprises a first motor fixedly connected with the top of the tower cover, a stirring shaft fixedly connected with the bottom of the first motor, a fixed block fixedly connected with the bottom of the stirring shaft, slots respectively arranged at two sides of the fixed block, an inserting block arranged in the slots and a cleaning plate fixedly connected with one side of the inserting block.

title_en: Online dredging device suitable for tundish stopper rod air blowing hole
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of continuous casting, in particular to an on-line dredging device for a tundish stopper rod blowhole. The device comprises a frame, a driving device and a rotating device, wherein the frame is an upright post fixed on a tundish cover, the rotating device comprises a hydraulic motor fixed at the top end of the upright post, a speed reducer is connected to the upper side of the hydraulic motor, an output shaft of the speed reducer is fixed with a cross beam through a cross beam connecting sleeve, the driving device comprises a lifting hydraulic cylinder fixed at the tail end of the cross beam, a push rod of the lifting hydraulic cylinder penetrates through the cross beam downwards, a slag poking rod is fixed at the tail end of the push rod, a slag poking needle is fixed at the lower end of the slag poking rod, and the lifting hydraulic cylinder is connected with a hydraulic valve table. An annular upper limiting plate is fixed on the push rod, a plurality of limiting rods are welded on the lower side of the cross beam and beside the push rod, an annular lower limiting plate is fixed at the lower end of the limiting rods, a central hole is formed in the lower limiting plate, the push rod penetrates through the central hole, and the limiting device is formed by the above structures. The advantages are that: on-line dredging reduces the labor intensity of workers.

title_en: Combined DC arc plasma powder making device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a combined direct current arc plasma powder making device, which belongs to the technical field of plasma application and comprises a plasma torch, a plasma power supply, a powder inlet section and an atomization reactor which are sequentially arranged, wherein the upper part of the atomization reactor is conical, a plurality of supersonic plasma spray guns are arranged along the normal direction of a conical surface, and generate high-temperature and high-speed plasma jet flow to secondarily heat and crush powder particles which enter the plasma torch from the powder inlet section and are melted to prepare superfine spherical powder materials. The device has simple structure, the plasma torch, the supersonic plasma spray gun and the powder feeding system are mutually independent, the controllability is good, and the preparation of the powder with small particle size, uniform distribution and high sphericity is realized.

title_en: Wastewater treatment device based on reverse osmosis membrane
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a reverse osmosis membrane-based wastewater treatment device, which relates to the technical field of wastewater treatment and specifically comprises a reverse osmosis membrane assembly, a high-pressure pump, a cleaning pump, a concentrated water pumping pump and a pure water pumping pump, wherein a plurality of reverse osmosis membrane pipes and a compensation reverse osmosis membrane pipe are arranged in an inner cavity of the reverse osmosis membrane assembly, the structure of the reverse osmosis membrane pipes is the same as that of the compensation reverse osmosis membrane pipe, one end of each reverse osmosis membrane pipe is provided with a main inlet pipe and a first branch pipe, and the top end of the main inlet pipe is fixedly provided with the first branch pipe, a second branch pipe and a third branch pipe. This wastewater treatment device based on reverse osmosis membrane, through the setting of reverse osmosis membrane subassembly, reverse osmosis membrane pipe in the reverse osmosis membrane subassembly can wash in proper order, and reverse osmosis membrane pipe can not influence this wastewater treatment device's use in the cleaning process, has improved this wastewater treatment device's work efficiency.

title_en: Cleaning machine for food processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cleaning machine for food processing, which relates to the technical field of food processing and comprises a main body unit, a containing unit and a cleaning unit which are arranged in the main body unit, a clamping unit which is arranged between the containing unit and the main body unit, and a pollution discharge unit which is arranged on the side part of the main body unit, wherein the containing unit comprises a supporting seat which is arranged on the inner wall of the main body unit, a filter bucket which is arranged in the supporting seat, and a connecting enclosure seat which is arranged on the side wall of the filter bucket, and the cleaning unit comprises a telescopic piece which is arranged in the main body unit, a cleaning rod which is arranged at the top of the telescopic piece, a transmission piece which is arranged in the main body unit and is positioned below the telescopic piece, and a driving motor which is arranged at the input end of the transmission piece. The utility model relates to a cleaning machine for food processing, which prevents sludge from adhering to a filter hole through a containing unit and a cleaning unit, and ensures the cleaning effect.

title_en: Safety relief device for chemical production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a safety release device for chemical production, which belongs to the technical field of chemical production and comprises a chemical production tank, wherein the outer end of the chemical production tank is fixedly connected with an L-shaped release pipe, the upper side of the vertical end of the L-shaped release pipe is fixedly connected with a sealing plate, the inner wall of the vertical end of the L-shaped release pipe is provided with a plurality of release holes, the inner side of the vertical end of the L-shaped release pipe is slidably connected with a stress push plate, the upper end of the stress push plate is embedded with a magnetic attraction piece, the lower end of the sealing plate is fixedly connected with an electromagnetic block, the lower end of the sealing plate is fixedly connected with a touch switch, and the touch switch is positioned at the outer end of the electromagnetic block.

title_en: Cleaning device for inside of container
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of container cleaning, in particular to a container internal cleaning device which comprises a handle, an adjustable rod piece connected with the handle, a magnetic attraction piece connected with the adjustable rod piece, and a protective sleeve arranged on the magnetic attraction piece, wherein the protective sleeve is fully or semi-wrapped on the magnetic attraction piece, and the adjustable rod piece comprises a telescopic adjusting structure and a bending adjusting structure. The adjustable rod piece is arranged to enable the device to have the functions of stretching or bending, so that the magnetic attraction piece can extend to the bottom of the container to attract scrap iron impurities, the possible block-shaped rust on the side wall of the container is also convenient to scrape and attract away, the upper body of an operator is also prevented from penetrating into the container, the operation safety of the operator is ensured, the protective sleeve is further arranged to prevent the magnetic attraction piece from being broken during operation, broken magnet blocks are prevented from being adsorbed into impurities in the container, and the using effect of the device is ensured.

title_en: Rubber sealing plug surface dust collector
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rubber sealing plug production equipment, and discloses a dust removing device for the surface of a rubber sealing plug, which comprises a supporting frame, wherein the outer wall of the supporting frame is fixedly connected with a dust removing box, the inner wall of the dust removing box is in rolling connection with a cleaning roller through a plurality of rollers, one end of the cleaning roller is provided with a feed inlet, the other end of the cleaning roller is provided with a discharge outlet, the inner wall of the cleaning roller is fixedly connected with a plurality of spiral belts, and a dust removing mechanism is arranged in the cleaning roller.

title_en: Electronic-grade hydrogen peroxide closed sampling device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electronic-grade hydrogen peroxide closed sampling device which comprises a sampling cabinet, wherein a cleaning table and a sampling table are arranged in the sampling cabinet, a back-off cleaning assembly is arranged on the cleaning table, an elastic pressing piece for fixing a sampling bottle is arranged in the sampling cabinet and above the back-off cleaning assembly, and a sampling liquid outlet head communicated with a hydrogen peroxide storage tank is arranged in the sampling cabinet and above the sampling table. According to the utility model, the cleaning and sampling are integrated into a whole and arranged in the sampling cabinet, and the sampling bottle is reversely buckled on the reversely buckled cleaning assembly during sampling, so that the reversely buckled cleaning assembly can extend into the sampling bottle to comprehensively clean the interior of the sampling bottle, the condition that the sampling bottle is cleaned to shake is avoided, and the bottle bottom of the sampling bottle is elastically pressed and fixed through the elastic pressing piece, so that the sampling bottle can be prevented from sliding upwards due to the impact of water flow, and the cleaning of the sampling bottle in place is ensured.

title_en: Continuous cracking reaction system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a continuous cracking reaction system which comprises a storage device, wherein the output end of the storage device is connected with the input end of a gasifier through a first pipeline to heat materials to gasify, the output end of the gasifier is connected with the reaction device through a second pipeline to crack the materials and output the materials to a subsequent process, and the continuous cracking system is used for cracking liquid tetrafluoroethylmethyl ether to prepare difluoroacetyl fluoride, so that the obtained difluoroacetyl fluoride is directly used for the next reaction, production and use can be realized, temporary storage of difluoroacetyl fluoride in the workshop production process is reduced, and workshop production is safer.

title_en: Ferrous metal smelting material conveying equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of metal smelting material conveying equipment, and discloses ferrous metal smelting material conveying equipment which comprises a conveying box, wherein a first conveyor is arranged on the bottom surface of the conveying box, a second conveyor is arranged on the right side of the conveying box, a screening component for screening and conveying materials is arranged in the conveying box, and the screening component comprises a V-shaped screen mesh arranged in the middle position in the conveying box. According to the utility model, the conveying box is arranged, and the V-shaped screen is arranged in the conveying box, so that the metal smelting materials are guided to the two sides of the V-shaped screen through the separating plate and screened in the conveying process, the large and small particles in the metal smelting materials are separated and respectively transported to meet the production requirement, and the materials are normally conveyed on the other side of the V-shaped screen when being screened on one side of the V-shaped screen, and vice versa, so that the materials can be screened on the V-shaped screen for a sufficient time, the screening effect is improved, and meanwhile, the normal conveying of the materials is not influenced.

title_en: Flax yarn floats and boils mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a linen yarn bleaching and boiling mechanism, which belongs to the technical field of linen yarn processing and comprises a bottom plate and a bleaching and boiling pot arranged on the bottom plate, wherein a support is fixedly connected to the bottom plate, a hydraulic cylinder is fixedly arranged at the upper end part of the support, a supporting piece positioned at the output end of the hydraulic cylinder is arranged at the inner side of the support, the supporting piece comprises a sleeve fixedly connected to the output end of the hydraulic cylinder, and a connecting cylinder and a mounting disc are respectively and slidably connected to the inner side of the sleeve. According to the yarn bleaching and boiling device, in the process of starting the servo motor to drive the supporting column to lift, the hinging rod can push and pull the placing plate to rotate, so that an operator can conveniently place coiled yarns on the placing plate, and the yarns after bleaching and boiling are brought out to drain and cool, meanwhile, the yarns can be extruded by the bleaching and boiling pot when the yarns are bleached and boiled by the sleeve in cooperation with the extruding disc on the sleeve, so that the yarns can be soaked by bleaching and boiling liquid more fully, and the bleaching and boiling efficiency and the bleaching and boiling effect of the yarns are improved.

title_en: Clean dead angle-free sieving device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a clean dead-angle-free sieving device which comprises a sieving bottom frame and a detachable sieving connecting frame arranged on the sieving bottom frame, wherein a sieve mesh and a supporting frame which are mutually inserted and matched are sequentially arranged between the sieving bottom frame and the sieving connecting frame along the sieving direction of materials. The structure adopts a screen structure without bolt connection, and the supporting frame consists of arc supporting bars and a central reinforcing ring which are distributed in a star shape, and forms a convex curved surface screening working surface with the screen. The structure has the advantages of no dead angle, convenient disassembly and assembly, high supporting strength, high screening efficiency and the like.

title_en: Microbial fertilizer mixing arrangement
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a microorganism fungus fertilizer mixing arrangement belongs to agricultural microorganism fertilizer production facility technical field, including base and controller, the equal fixedly connected with fixed plate in base upper end middle part both sides, symmetry fixed plate opposite side fixedly connected with a plurality of retainer plates, equal fixedly connected with in retainer plate middle part is in mixing the storehouse surface, just mixing storehouse upper and lower extreme and being semi-circular or toper respectively, just mixing storehouse upper end middle part fixedly connected with mount, just mount upper end middle part fixedly connected with motor or air pump, the main shaft of motor runs through and sliding connection in mixing the storehouse inside through the speed reducer, main shaft upper end external surface installs a plurality of stirring rake, just main shaft lower part external surface installs helical blade, upper strata the stirring rake is radially distributed's multiunit paddle of bending, and the lower floor helical blade is continuous spiral structure, main shaft bottom external surface fixedly connected with flitch.

title_en: Edible fungus culture material stirring scraping device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of edible fungus culture material preparation, in particular to an edible fungus culture material stirring scraping device, which aims to solve the technical problem that materials are easy to be hidden in a safety gap of a stirring tank and do not participate in stirring in the prior art, and comprises a tank body of the stirring tank and a stirrer, and is characterized in that the stirrer comprises a stirring shaft arranged in the tank body, a stirring plate arranged on the peripheral side of the stirring shaft, a plurality of support rods fixedly connected between the stirring shaft and the stirring plate, a plurality of pneumatic scrapers arranged on one side of the stirring plate, and a gas distribution mechanism for driving the pneumatic scrapers to pop out; the utility model ensures that the scraping surface of the scraping plate or the movable column is in sliding contact with the inner wall of the tank body through a plurality of pneumatic scraping devices arranged on one side of the stirring plate and the air distribution mechanism for driving the scraping plate or the movable column to pop up, thereby effectively scraping and stirring the materials remained in the safety gap, and greatly reducing the waste of raw materials.

title_en: Novel vertical stirring barrel for filling
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel vertical stirring barrel for filling, and belongs to the technical field of filling stirring equipment. The stirring barrel mainly aims at the problem that the structure of an existing product is complex, and the technical scheme is provided. According to the utility model, the movable mechanism is arranged, so that the screen frame at the discharge hole can be moved and shaken at high frequency, the materials can be uniformly dispersed and fall, dust dissipation is reduced, the spraying mechanism is arranged, water mist can be sprayed in the discharging process, the water mist can adhere fine dust particles, the dust dissipation is further reduced, the spraying direction of the spraying mechanism is not fixed, the spraying range of the water mist is enlarged, the adhesion effect on dust is improved, finally, the replacement of screens with different inclined angles can be rapidly realized, and the obliquely arranged screens can prolong the retention time and further reduce the dust dissipation when aiming at high-dust materials.

title_en: Smashing device for plastic recycling
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a plastic recycling smashing device, which relates to the technical field of plastic smashing, and comprises a base, wherein two second fixing plates are fixedly arranged on the base, supporting rings are fixedly arranged at the tops of the two second fixing plates, a screen drum is rotatably arranged between the two supporting rings, a smashing mechanism is arranged between the two first fixing plates, the smashing mechanism comprises a first rotating shaft and a second rotating shaft, smashing rollers are fixedly arranged on the first rotating shaft and the second rotating shaft, a motor is fixedly arranged on the outer side wall of the first fixing plate, protruding blocks are fixedly arranged at the tops of the two first fixing plates, a supporting shaft is rotatably arranged between the two protruding blocks, a driving wheel is fixedly arranged at one end of the second rotating shaft, and a driven wheel is fixedly arranged at one end of the supporting shaft. The plurality of baffles are driven to rotate through the screen cylinder, and the plastic at the bottom of the screen cylinder is upwards turned over through the plurality of baffles, so that the plastic enters between the two crushing rollers to be crushed for multiple times, the plastic crushing effect is good, the plastic is crushed uniformly, and the plastic is recycled.

title_en: High strength candle formula fuse-element
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-strength candle type melt filter element, which comprises a central column, wherein a solution flowing through hole is formed in the central column, a plurality of solution filtering holes are uniformly distributed in the solution flowing through hole, the solution filtering holes are communicated with the outer wall of the central column, the outer wall of the central column is connected with a metal filter screen, and the metal filter screen is connected with a reinforcing component. The reinforcing assembly comprises a plurality of first stainless steel round bars and a plurality of second stainless steel round bars, the metal filter material net is of a corrugated structure, the first stainless steel round bars are respectively connected to a plurality of wave crests of the metal filter material net, and the second stainless steel round bars are respectively connected to a plurality of wave troughs of the metal filter material net. The utility model aims to overcome the defects of the prior art and provide the high-strength candle type melt filter element, so that the deformation resistance and the fracture resistance of the filter element are improved, and the filtering quality and the filtering efficiency of melt are ensured.

title_en: Water quality detection stirring device with anti-overflow function
abstract_en: The utility model provides a water quality detection stirring device with an anti-overflow function, which relates to the technical field of stirring devices and comprises a stirring barrel, wherein a supporting frame is fixedly connected to the bottom of the stirring barrel, a connecting frame is fixedly connected to the top of the supporting frame, a motor is fixedly connected to the top of the connecting frame, a stirring rod is rotatably inserted into the bottom of one side of the connecting frame, the motor and the stirring rod are connected together through a bearing, a limiting device is arranged at the top of the stirring barrel, a moving device is arranged at the bottom of the stirring barrel, and when the limiting device is used, an arc plate is manually controlled to rotate on the surface of the rotating rod, so that the arc plate is arranged at the top of the stirring barrel, water can be prevented from overflowing due to stirring to a certain extent, and a detection head of the water quality detection device can be inserted into water, so that the arc plate is far away from the top of the stirring barrel when water is required to be discharged, and the water can not be influenced.

title_en: High-temperature wastewater thermal mass recovery device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-temperature wastewater heat and mass recovery device which comprises a box body, wherein two sides of the box body are fixedly connected with a feed inlet, the top of the box body is provided with a top plate, a cleaning assembly is arranged on the top plate, a driving assembly is arranged on the top plate, a stirring assembly is arranged in the box body, one side of the box body is provided with a recovery assembly, and a filtering assembly is arranged on the feed inlet. Through the filtering component, suspended matters, particulate matters and other impurities in the wastewater are filtered out, so that the subsequent influence on the use of the heat exchanger is avoided; the ion in the high-temperature wastewater is neutralized by adding a scale remover and a neutralizing solution into the box body through the feeding pipe, so that ion impurities in the high-temperature wastewater are precipitated in the box body in advance, the wastewater passes through the water pump and enters the inner pipe of the heat exchanger by controlling the rotation of the rotating plate through the third motor, and a water source is added into the heat exchanger through the water inlet and the water outlet on the heat exchanger, so that the device can recycle waste heat of the high-temperature wastewater, the recycling efficiency is improved, and the cost in industrial production is reduced.

title_en: Be used for uropoiesis surgery auxiliary device for operation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an auxiliary device for urinary surgery, which comprises a disc, a plurality of circular grooves uniformly arranged on the circumference of the disc, a plurality of cylinders respectively connected in the circular grooves in a sliding mode, a limiting ring fixed at the bottom end of each cylinder, a spring sleeved on the periphery of the cylinder above the limiting ring, a circular ring arranged at the end part of the cylinder extending out of the disc, a plurality of inserted posts arranged on the lower surface of the circular ring in a circumferential array, a rotating shaft rotationally connected to the middle part of the top end of the disc, a liquid receiving hopper fixed at the top end of the rotating shaft, a liquid discharge pipe arranged at one side of the bottom of the liquid receiving hopper, and a control valve arranged on the liquid discharge pipe, wherein a guide surface is obliquely arranged in the liquid receiving hopper.

title_en: 8 Inch silicon chip pickling device
abstract_en: The utility model provides an 8 inch silicon chip pickling device, includes pickling tank and the fixed supersonic generator who sets up inside the pickling tank, the fixed mounting box that is provided with a plurality of silicon chip boxes that can support in the pickling tank, and the top of mounting box has been seted up and has been corresponded with the silicon chip box to the water conservancy diversion hole, and the side water conservancy diversion hole has been seted up to the lateral part of mounting box, and the bottom of mounting box is provided with first motor, and first motor drive is connected with first impeller, and first impeller is arranged in introducing the mounting box with the liquid in the pickling tank through last water conservancy diversion hole to export through the water conservancy diversion hole. The utility model provides an 8-inch silicon wafer pickling device, which can enable liquid in a pickling tank to circularly flow, further disperse impurities cleaned from the surface of a silicon wafer into the pickling tank, prevent the impurities from being gathered in a narrow gap between two silicon wafers, further prevent the impurities from being adhered to the silicon wafers again in the process of taking out a silicon wafer box after the cleaning is finished, and ensure the cleaning of the silicon wafers.

title_en: Independent four-way weighing separator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an independent four-way weighing separator, which relates to the technical field of weighing equipment and comprises an electronic scale, a turnover mechanism and a rotating mechanism, wherein the rotating mechanism comprises a rotating motor and a rotating frame, the rotating motor is arranged at the bottom of the rotating frame and is connected with the rotating frame through a first connecting piece and used for driving the rotating frame to rotate, the turnover mechanism comprises a turnover motor and a turnover frame, the turnover motor is fixedly arranged on the rotating frame and is connected with the turnover frame through a second connecting piece and used for driving the turnover frame to turn, and the electronic scale is fixedly arranged on the turnover frame. The utility model has simple structure and small occupied space, is convenient to carry and is particularly suitable for small household farms.

title_en: Air heat source heat pump fruit and vegetable dryer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an air heat source heat pump fruit and vegetable dryer, which relates to the technical field of drying equipment and comprises a shell, a hot air pipeline system and a plurality of layers of vertically arranged drawer-type bearing plates, wherein the bottom of each layer of bearing plate is provided with grid holes, and a pulse turning-over device is correspondingly arranged below each layer of bearing plate. The pulse turning device adopts the air circuit layout of the main air pipe and the branch air pipe, periodically releases compressed air through the pulse valve, flows into the venturi tube to accelerate after being guided by the one-way valve, forms high-speed jet to penetrate through the grid holes to drive the material to turn, and effectively solves the technical problem of local overheating and uneven drying of the material in the traditional drying equipment.

title_en: Color matching device for publication printing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a color mixing device for publication printing, which belongs to the technical field of printing color mixing. The color mixing barrel is provided with a barrel cover, a stirring part is arranged in the color mixing barrel, the color mixing barrel can be detachably arranged on a fixing frame, the fixing frame is rotatably arranged on a bracket, and the synchronous mechanism comprises a bevel gear set and a transmission set which are connected through a third rotating shaft. The utility model has the advantages that the bevel gear set is driven by the motor to engage the third rotating shaft to rotate, so that the stirring part in the color mixing barrel is driven to synchronously drive the transmission set to rotate while the fixing frame rotates on the bracket, and the raw materials such as color mixing pigment, ink and the like are more uniform and labor-saving in color mixing. The color mixing efficiency is improved.

title_en: Continuous production device for EDTA condensation reaction
abstract_en: The utility model provides a continuous production device for EDTA condensation reaction, which belongs to the technical field of chemical equipment and comprises a reaction deamination tower, a first heat exchanger, a second heat exchanger and a mixer, wherein a tubular heat exchanger is arranged at the top of the reaction deamination tower, an ammonia gas discharge pipe is arranged at the top of the tubular heat exchanger, a material subjected to heat exchange by the second heat exchanger and a material subjected to heat exchange by the first heat exchanger are mixed in a mixer, and the mixer is communicated with the reaction deamination tower through a mixture feed pipe. The bottom of the reaction deamination tower is provided with a discharge pipe, a beating circulation pump on the discharge pipe is used for extracting high-temperature reaction liquid from the bottom of the reaction deamination tower, part of the reaction liquid enters a first heat exchanger and a second heat exchanger for heat exchange, and the other part of the reaction liquid enters a mixer through a circulation communicating pipe for material mixing. By utilizing the device, the ammonia removal effect and the timeliness of ammonia removal can be improved, the product quality after EDTA condensation reaction can be improved, the land can be saved, and the production cost, the energy consumption and the labor intensity can be reduced.

title_en: Foam board blows and drenches dust collector
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of dust removal and ash removal of foam boards, in particular to a foam board blowing and spraying dust removal device. Adopts a transverse pipe, and a plurality of air nozzles are arranged on the transverse pipe. The stability of whole device is ensured to the stand that sets up the fixing, sets up telescopic connection in addition in the telescopic column of stand top, and the violently pipe setting is at the top of telescopic column, therefore violently the pipe height is adjustable for this device can adapt to the one-tenth of various heights and pile the cystosepiment. The horizontal pipe is arranged to be rotatable, and the air jet is fixedly arranged on the horizontal pipe, so that the air jet direction of the air jet can be adjusted by rotating the horizontal pipe, and then the blowing angle is adjusted, thereby being convenient for workers to clean up dust better.

title_en: Welding tool for metal support
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a welding tool for a metal bracket, which comprises a fixed table, a welding platform and a plurality of clamping mechanisms, wherein the top end of the fixed table is fixedly connected with two vertical seats, the clamping mechanisms are respectively arranged on the two vertical seats, a notch is arranged at a position corresponding to the vertical seats on the fixed table, the welding platform is positioned in the notch, a fixed plate is fixedly connected to the fixed table, a plurality of electric cylinders are arranged on the fixed plate, telescopic rods of the electric cylinders are fixedly connected with the bottom end of the welding platform, a blanking groove is formed between the fixed tables of the welding platform, a cleaning plate is arranged in the blanking groove, the bottom end of the cleaning plate is fixedly connected with a cleaning brush, and smoke exhausting mechanisms are slidably arranged at the top ends of the two vertical seats, so that the welding platform and the clamping mechanisms are conveniently separated, welding slag on the welding platform is conveniently cleaned completely, the flatness of the metal bracket on the welding platform is prevented from being influenced, and the production quality of the welding bracket can be ensured.

title_en: Cell culture dish shakes even device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cell culture dish shaking device, and relates to the technical field of cell culture equipment. The utility model comprises a box body, wherein a tray is arranged at the top of the box body, a clamping mechanism is movably connected to the top of the tray, and a shaking mechanism is fixedly connected to an inner cavity of the box body. The clamping mechanism adopts the design that the magnetic clamping blocks are matched with the clamping grooves and the magnetic attraction blocks are adsorbed, an experimenter can quickly complete the installation by only aligning the magnetic clamping blocks of the expansion plate with the clamping grooves on the tray when replacing the expansion plate, any tool is not required to be used, and when the clamping mechanism is detached, the expansion plate and the tray can be separated by only applying external force slightly larger than the magnetic force, so that the experiment preparation and cleaning time is greatly saved, the experiment operation efficiency is improved, and the expanding plates with different specifications and shapes can be replaced to adapt to cell culture dishes with different sizes and diversified experiment containers such as flasks, deep-hole plates and the like, so that the adaptability of the device to different experiment demands is greatly enhanced.

title_en: Multistage drying device is used in agricultural product production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of agricultural product production and discloses a multistage drying device for agricultural product production, which comprises a drying box, wherein an air outlet pipe is fixedly arranged on the outer side wall of the drying box, a preheating box is fixedly arranged at one end of the air outlet pipe, a first heat exchange pipe and a second heat exchange pipe are fixedly arranged in the preheating box, the upper end of the first heat exchange pipe is connected with the bottom end of the second heat exchange pipe, the bottom end of the first heat exchange pipe extends to the outer side wall of the preheating box, and the upper end of the second heat exchange pipe extends to the outer side wall of the upper end of the preheating box.

title_en: Winding motor structure with built-in collecting ring
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a winding motor structure with a built-in collecting ring, which comprises a shell, wherein a rotating shaft is rotationally inserted in the shell along the extending direction of the shell, a rotor, a collecting ring and fan blades are sequentially and fixedly sleeved on the surface of the rotating shaft along the axial direction of the rotating shaft, a stator is fixedly arranged in the shell and positioned outside the rotor, and the rotor can rotate relative to the stator.

title_en: Automobile steering booster pump with stable flow
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of booster pumps, and discloses an automobile steering booster pump with stable flow, which comprises a booster pump main body, wherein a driving end of the booster pump main body is fixedly connected with a belt pulley, an oil inlet pipe is fixedly connected with an oil inlet end of the booster pump main body, an oil discharge pipe communicated with a steering system is fixedly connected with an oil discharge end of the booster pump main body, and because oil enters the steering system after passing through the booster pump main body and then returns to an oil tank by the steering system for recycling, in the recycling process, metal scraps can move along with the oil, when the oil with the metal scraps enters the interior of a filter cylinder, larger impurities are blocked by a fine filter screen, and the metal scraps are adsorbed by a magnet through the fine filter screen, and because the metal scraps are washed down for a long time, the other side of the magnet is provided with a leakage-proof filter screen, the washed-down metal scraps can be blocked, and the metal scraps can be prevented from entering the interior of the booster pump main body again.

title_en: Crushing and granulating machine with low dust leakage
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of particle sizing machines, and discloses a crushing particle sizing machine with low dust leakage. This smash whole grain machine of low dust leakage, the user is through carrying out clearance or change with first dust absorption pad, and the user passes through the pivot with first clamp splice and rotates, makes first clamp splice and first extension piece untie to be connected, lets the user shift out the inside of first support case from first workstation, clears up or changes first dust collection bucket, collects the filtration through the powder that produces after the material is smashed to first dust absorption pad, can effectively catch and filter the tiny powder granule that produces after smashing, ensures that the dust can not leak in the operational environment, greatly reduced dust pollution's risk. The design not only improves the cleanliness of the production environment and ensures the health of operators, but also reduces the waste of materials and improves the production efficiency of the device.

title_en: Integrated double-material premixing coating spray head
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an integrated double-material pre-mixing coating spray head applied to the technical field of coating equipment, which is used for placing two material liquids into a storage vat, then sealing a barrel cover by threads, starting a second servo motor through a controller to drive a rotating shaft to drive a mixing paddle and a scraping plate to rotate, mixing the two materials by the rotation of the mixing paddle, simultaneously enabling the scraping plate to be in contact with the inner wall of the storage vat, scraping the materials adhered on the inner wall, avoiding uneven mixing, starting a micro suction pump after uniform mixing, conveying the mixed materials into a liquid collecting cavity through a first conveying pipe, spraying the materials from a plurality of spray heads, spraying the materials on cloth, simultaneously starting a first servo motor to drive a lead screw to drive a sliding block to horizontally move back and forth, driving the spray heads to move back and forth to uniformly spray the surface of the cloth, and pre-mixing the two materials by arranging the storage vat above the spray heads, thereby avoiding the problem of uneven double-material spraying.

title_en: Die lip cleaning mechanism of coating die head
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of battery pole piece production equipment and discloses a die lip cleaning mechanism of a coating die head, which comprises the coating die head and a cleaning mechanism, wherein the cleaning mechanism is connected with the coating die head through an adapter plate, the cleaning mechanism comprises a traversing assembly, a telescoping assembly and a cleaning part, the traversing assembly is connected with the coating die head through the adapter plate, the moving section of the traversing assembly covers the die lip length of the coating die head, the telescoping assembly is arranged on the traversing assembly, the traversing assembly drives the telescoping assembly to move along the die lip direction of the coating die head, the telescoping assembly is connected with the cleaning part, and the telescoping assembly drives the cleaning part to be close to the die lip and contact with the die lip. According to the scheme, the telescopic component drives the cleaning part to be close to the die lip, and after the cleaning part contacts with the die lip, the telescopic component and the cleaning part are driven to transversely move through the transverse moving component, so that the die lip is automatically cleaned and wiped, and the problem that the middle position of the coating die head cannot be manually cleaned when the die lip is coated in a wide range is solved.

title_en: Tenter with accurate width adjustment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of tentering machines, and discloses a tentering machine with accurate width adjustment, which comprises a workbench, wherein first upright posts are fixedly connected to the front and rear ends of the left side of the top of the workbench, an adjusting roller is rotationally connected between the first upright posts, adjusting discs are slidingly connected to the front and rear sides of the outer parts of the adjusting roller, adjusting screw rods are in threaded connection with the outer sides of the first upright posts, and adjacent ends of the two adjusting screw rods are respectively rotationally connected to the outer sides of the two adjusting discs. According to the utility model, the adjusting screw rod is rotated to axially move, the adjusting disc is driven to slide on the adjusting roller, the auxiliary sleeve rod limits circumferential rotation of the adjusting disc, preliminary limitation of cloth width is realized, and the effects of accurately adjusting and stably shaping the cloth width are realized. The width can be flexibly adjusted according to different cloth demands, the cooling retraction deformation is avoided, the dimensional stability is ensured, the method is suitable for processing cloth with various specifications, and the processing precision and the applicability of a stenter are improved.

title_en: Pepper breeding skin and seed separating equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of pepper breeding and discloses pepper breeding peel and seed separation equipment, which comprises a barrel, a crushing mechanism, a peel and seed separation mechanism and a receiving mechanism, wherein a flushing mechanism is arranged on the crushing mechanism, and a discharging channel is arranged on the outer wall of the barrel. Through the cooperation of extrusion strip I with extrusion strip II among the breaker mechanism, put into the barrel in the hot pepper, realize the extrusion breakage to the hot pepper, isolate partial hot pepper seed, and under the impact of flushing mechanism spun rivers, further increase the drop of hot pepper seed, then the hot pepper falls on skin seed separating mechanism, rotatory striking board bumps with the hot pepper, and strike the hot pepper, further make hot pepper seed and hot pepper skin break away from, and under the cooperation of discharge channel and receiving mechanism, realize skin seed separation and collection, through crushing, rivers washing, and striking, can make the hot pepper seed drop from the main and collateral channels completely, make hot pepper skin seed separation more thoroughly.

title_en: Double-die-head cloth grinding machine for water-based polyester microfiber flannelette
