abstract_en: The double-die-head cloth grinding machine for the water-based polyester microfiber flannelette belongs to the field of cloth grinding machines, and structurally comprises a base, two upright posts, a material conveying assembly and a cloth grinding assembly, wherein the two upright posts are respectively and vertically arranged at the left and right parts of the upper end face of the base, the material conveying assembly is horizontally arranged between the two upright posts in a rotating mode to convey cloth, the cloth grinding assembly is arranged at the rear part of the base to grind cloth conveyed by the material conveying assembly, two sliding frames are in a top-to-bottom state, a cloth grinding roller of the sliding frame positioned at the lowest part is in contact with the cloth, the cloth grinding operation is carried out under the driving of a first motor, when different fluff densities are needed, gears are driven to rotate by a second motor, the two sliding frames meshed with each other are simultaneously driven to change the top-to-bottom positions of the two sliding frames, the cloth grinding roller contacted with the cloth is correspondingly changed, and the structure is changed rapidly and the efficiency of the cloth grinding operation is effectively improved.

title_en: A high-efficient boiling dryer for pharmaceutical production processing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of medicine production and processing, and discloses a high-efficiency boiling dryer for medicine production and processing, which comprises a base, wherein a supporting frame is fixedly arranged at the top of the base, a boiling main machine box is fixedly arranged on the inner side of the supporting frame, a fluidized bed is fixedly arranged at the top of the boiling main machine box, a boiling tank is fixedly arranged at the top of the fluidized bed, a crushing assembly is arranged at the top of the boiling tank, and the crushing assembly comprises a crushing box. This a high-efficient boiling dryer for pharmaceutical production processing through starting the second motor, and the output of second motor drives the driving gear and rotates, and the driven gear rotates through tooth meshing's effect when driving gear rotates, and the crushing roller of crushing incasement side is driven through the pivot and is rotated when driving gear and driven gear rotate, smashes the medicine, guarantees that the medicine size is unanimous, ensures that the material evenly disperses, improves drying efficiency and product quality.

title_en: Prevent deposit coating storage tank agitating unit
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of storage tank stirring devices and discloses an anti-sedimentation coating storage tank stirring device which comprises a box body, wherein a feed inlet is formed in the top of the box body, a discharge outlet is formed in the bottom of the box body, a motor is fixed at the top of the box body, the bottom of an output shaft of the motor penetrates through the box body, an output shaft of the motor is rotationally connected with the box body, a rotating shaft is rotationally connected to the top of the inner wall of the box body, the top of the rotating shaft is fixed at the bottom of the output shaft of the motor, the anti-sedimentation coating storage tank stirring device is started by a mixing assembly, the rotating plate can be rotated, the inner wall of an arc groove continuously abuts against the outer surface of a round rod, the round rod, a fixed block, the fixed rod and a movable plate are driven to move towards the inner wall of the box body and compress a spring, and after the round rod is separated from the highest point of the arc groove, the spring releases elasticity, the movable plate is pulled towards the stirring rod, so that coating is brought back to a central area, insufficient mixing is avoided, and stirring efficiency is improved.

title_en: Photovoltaic board surface detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a photovoltaic panel surface detection device, which relates to the technical field of photovoltaic panel detection and comprises a detection table, wherein the detection table is in an arc-shaped arrangement, three rectangular holes are formed in the upper end face of the detection table at equal intervals around the axis of the detection table, fixing boxes are fixedly arranged at positions, corresponding to the three rectangular holes, of the lower end face of the detection table, the fixing boxes are communicated with the inside of the rectangular holes, support plates for supporting a photovoltaic panel are arranged in the fixing boxes in a lifting mode, and a motor is fixedly arranged at the axis of the upper end face of the detection table. The electric push rod is lifted to enable the uppermost layer photovoltaic plate to be aligned with the detection table, after the detection camera scans, the motor drives the connecting plate to drive the rectangular frame to rotate, qualified products are transferred to the left rectangular hole, defective products are transferred to the right rectangular hole, and the electric push rod synchronously adjusts the height of the support plate. The automatic sorting device has the advantages that efficient sorting is achieved through mechanical linkage, detection efficiency is improved, and the sorting action accuracy is guaranteed through stepped lifting of the electric push rod and reversible rotation of the motor.

title_en: Air pipe cleaning equipment of leaf wetting machine
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of cigarette equipment, and discloses air pipe cleaning equipment of a leaf wetting machine. Comprises a guide rail component, a travelling trolley, a driving mechanism and a cleaning component. When the cleaning device is used for cleaning, the guide rail assembly is placed in the air pipe, the travelling trolley is placed on the guide rail assembly, the nozzle faces the inner wall of the air pipe, cleaning liquid is transmitted to the rotary spray head through the transmission pipeline and is sprayed to the inner wall of the air pipe through pressure, and the driving mechanism drives the travelling trolley to axially move along the air pipe so as to drive the cleaning assembly to axially move along the air pipe, so that different positions of the air pipe are gradually cleaned. The rotary spray head can rotate in the cleaning process, so that the inner wall of the air pipe is comprehensively cleaned, the dead angle is avoided, and the rotary spray head is suitable for cleaning air pipes with various shapes, such as air pipes with circular or rectangular cross sections. Furthermore, the driving mechanism drives the traveling trolley to drive the cleaning assembly to move on the track, so that automatic cleaning can be realized, and the cleaning efficiency is high.

title_en: Horizontal composite glue automatic production equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses horizontal compound glue automatic production equipment which comprises a mixing barrel arranged on a bearing seat in a rolling way, wherein a stirring device is arranged in the mixing barrel, two ends of a stirring shaft of the stirring device extend out of the mixing barrel, one end of the stirring shaft positioned at the left side is connected with a stirring motor arranged at the side part of the bearing seat, a driving motor is further arranged at the top of the bearing seat, a driving gear is arranged on a motor shaft of the driving motor, and the driving gear is in transmission connection with a gear transmission part at the outer side of the mixing barrel. The utility model has reasonable design, firmness, durability, convenient control and use, high mixing efficiency and good product quality.

title_en: Novel double-deck sieve separator
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of screening machines and discloses a novel double-layer screening machine which comprises an underframe, wherein a first support is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the underframe, a first transmission belt is arranged above the first support, a supporting rod is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the first support, a second support is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the supporting rod, a second transmission belt is arranged on the upper surface of the second support, a third support is fixedly connected to one side of the upper surface of the second support, and a screening mechanism comprises a fourth support fixedly connected to one side of the third support, and a feeding hopper is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the fourth support. In the utility model, after the materials are separated according to the size by a screen, the undersize materials immediately enter a wind selection area, and impurities are removed according to the density by utilizing air flow. The method solves the problem that the prior art needs to use two independent devices of a vibrating screen and a winnowing machine for step-by-step operation, obviously reduces the occupied area of the devices, reduces the cost, and greatly improves the comprehensive treatment efficiency and the separation precision due to the continuity of the flow.

title_en: Water tap
abstract_en: The utility model provides a faucet, and belongs to the technical field of faucets. It has solved current tap filter equipment and has dismantled inconvenient problem. The faucet comprises a faucet body, wherein a valve core is arranged in the faucet body, the valve core is connected with a valve rod, a fixing part is arranged on the faucet body, a water outlet pipeline is arranged on the fixing part, a water outlet part for discharging water is arranged at the front end part of the water outlet part, a filtering piece for filtering is arranged in the water outlet part, a water passing hole is formed in the filtering piece, a filter screen is arranged on the filtering piece and opposite to the water passing hole, a sliding part capable of sliding up and down is arranged on the outer side of the water outlet part, a plurality of balls are arranged in the water outlet part, a clamping groove I matched with the corresponding balls is formed in the inner wall of the sliding part, and a clamping groove II matched with the corresponding balls is formed in the outer wall of the filtering piece. The utility model has the advantages of filtering function and convenient disassembly and assembly.

title_en: Air conditioner water accumulation disk blockage removing device and air conditioner
abstract_en: The utility model provides an air conditioner water accumulation disc blocking removing device and an air conditioner, wherein the air conditioner water accumulation disc blocking removing device comprises a bracket arranged on the inner side of an air conditioner water accumulation disc, a motor arranged on the bracket, a bevel gear I connected with an output shaft of the motor, a bevel gear II meshed with the bevel gear I, a stirring wire connected with the bevel gear II and a drain pipe communicated with a drain outlet of the air conditioner water accumulation disc, the bevel gear I and the bevel gear II are mutually perpendicular in the axial direction, and the stirring wire stretches into the drain pipe from the drain outlet. The air conditioner water accumulation disc blocking removing device provided by the utility model realizes the full automatic blocking removing of the air conditioner water accumulation disc, does not need manual work even if the air conditioner water accumulation disc is operated for a long time in an environment with larger dust, improves the operation and maintenance efficiency of the air conditioner, has a simple structure, and is easy to be installed on any air conditioner with the water accumulation disc.

title_en: Slag blowing device inside furnace nose skirt
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a slag blowing device in a furnace nose skirt, which comprises a slag blowing pipe, a skirt body, an aluminum pot body and an aluminum pot working liquid level, wherein the slag blowing pipe is externally connected with an air inlet, the skirt body is arranged outside the skirt, the aluminum pot body is used as a basic container and is used for containing high-temperature aluminum liquid, the aluminum pot body is a core area with steel hot dip aluminum plating and is in a pool shape, an opening is upward, the skirt body belongs to a component part of furnace nose equipment, is positioned above the aluminum pot body and is provided with a gap with the edge of the opening of the aluminum pot body, and the aluminum pot working liquid level is the upper surface of the aluminum liquid in the aluminum pot body and also comprises a slag blowing pipe connected with the outside of the skirt and a slag blowing outlet with an elbow at the tail end. The stability and the production efficiency of the hot dip aluminum plating process of the strip steel are effectively improved, and the surface quality and the yield of the strip steel are greatly improved. The device has a light and compact integral structure, can be installed without large-scale transformation of the furnace nose skirt edge, does not influence the normal production flow, and provides reliable guarantee for continuous and high-quality production of high-temperature metallurgical processes such as hot dip aluminizing and the like.

title_en: Full-automatic rotary shower device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of blowing and showering devices, in particular to a full-automatic rotary blowing and showering device which comprises a blowing and showering mechanism used for cleaning the surface of an object, wherein the blowing and showering mechanism comprises a blowing and showering chamber which is of a cavity structure with hollow inside and two open sides, the openings on the two sides of the blowing and showering chamber are respectively and rotatably connected with a chamber door, a rotating mechanism used for placing the object and arranged in the blowing and showering mechanism, the rotating mechanism comprises a turntable, two first support posts are arranged on one side of the turntable, two second support posts are arranged on the other side of the turntable, the tops of the two first support posts and the two second support posts are respectively connected with a holding rod, and a driving mechanism used for driving the object to rotate is arranged under the rotating mechanism and comprises a limiting ring. The utility model has the advantages of simple structure, reasonable design, full-automatic rotation, improvement of the purifying and sterilizing effects of the protective clothing on the body of the personnel, and great popularization and application are worth.

title_en: Electrolytic mud-water separator
abstract_en: The utility model provides an electrolytic mud-water separation device, which comprises an electrolytic tank, an anode plate, a cathode plate, an electricity-connecting female end and a cleaning mechanism, wherein the cleaning mechanism comprises an electric turntable, a rotating plate, a power box, a cross rod, a vertical rod, a first electric push rod, an electricity-connecting male end and a spring wire, mud-containing sewage can be introduced into the electrolytic tank, flocs and scum are generated under the electrolytic action of the anode plate and the cathode plate, so that mud-water separation is realized, when passivation layers are generated on the anode plate and the cathode plate, the electric turntable and the first electric push rod can be started, the first electric push rod pulls the electricity-connecting male end out of the electricity-connecting female end, the power box is driven by the rotating plate to rotate, and the electricity-connecting male end is driven by the cross rod and the vertical rod to be connected with the electricity-connecting female end above in a short time, so that the passivation layers can be stripped by hydrogen generated by the water body, the passivation layers can be removed, the electrolytic function can be recovered, and mud-water separation efficiency can be improved.

title_en: NMN enzyme catalytic surface active agent high-efficient dispersion devices
abstract_en: The application discloses an efficient dispersing device for an NMN enzyme catalytic surfactant, which belongs to the field of surfactant dispersion and comprises a tank body, wherein a cavity is arranged in the tank body and is used for dispersing a reagent, a supporting structure is fixedly connected to the bottom of the tank body and is used for fixedly placing the tank body and a tank body cover, the tank body cover is fixedly arranged at the top of the tank body, the cover body is used for sealing the tank body, and a stirring unit is arranged in the tank body and is used for uniformly and slowly releasing and dispersing the surfactant. According to the application, through wedging of the inner cylinder and the outer cylinder, when the rotating shaft of the rotating motor drives the outer cylinder and the stirring paddle to rotate, the inner hole and the outer hole are overlapped, so that the surfactant is dispersed in the solution.

title_en: Stone washer for calcium carbonate production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a stone washer for calcium carbonate production, which comprises a bracket, a roller and a vibrating screen, wherein the roller is rotationally connected with the bracket, the vibrating screen is arranged below the roller, a shaftless screw is arranged in the roller, the outer edge of the shaftless screw is fixedly connected with the roller, a plurality of water lifting plates which are arranged in a circumferential array are fixedly connected between the coils of the shaftless screw, and water draining holes which are arranged in the circumferential array are formed in the roller right above the vibrating screen. According to the stone washer for calcium carbonate production, a water immersion space of stone is formed between the coils of the shaftless screw in the roller, water and the stone are stirred by the water lifting plate when the roller rotates, the contact area and the cleaning time of the water and the stone are increased, and the cleaning effect of the stone is improved.

title_en: Ultrasonic cleaner
abstract_en: The utility model provides an ultrasonic cleaner, and relates to the technical field of ultrasonic cleaning equipment. The ultrasonic cleaning machine comprises a hardware shell, wherein a hardware inner groove is formed in the hardware shell, a control panel is embedded on the surface of the hardware shell, toughened glass is covered on the control panel, the edge of the toughened glass is in sealing connection with the hardware shell through acid-alkali resistant plastic firmware, the transducer is arranged at the bottom of the hardware inner groove, toughened glass is covered on the control panel, and is in sealing connection treatment with the hardware shell through acid-alkali resistant plastic firmware, so that the control panel is protected, and the situation that an existing ultrasonic cleaning machine panel is corroded due to solution, and the control system is malfunctioned or damaged and an internal power supply driving system of the control system is damaged is avoided. The control panel adopts the latest capacitive touch technology, and has the characteristics of strong interference resistance and strong sensitivity.

title_en: Desalination type circulating water side filtering system and circulating water system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a desalination type circulating water side filtering system and a circulating water system, wherein the desalination type circulating water side filtering system comprises a filtering mechanism, a water outlet and a water inlet, wherein the filtering mechanism is configured to filter circulating water to be treated; and the ultrafiltration-reverse osmosis pry block is communicated with the water outlet of the filtering mechanism and is configured to sequentially carry out ultrafiltration treatment and reverse osmosis treatment on the circulating water treated by the filtering mechanism, and the ultrafiltration-reverse osmosis pry block is provided with a fresh water outlet. The filter mechanism can carry out preliminary filtration treatment on the circulating water to be treated, remove suspended matters, particulate matters and other impurities in the circulating water, remove organic matters, suspended matters, bacteria and the like in the circulating water through ultrafiltration treatment, and finally remove inorganic salts, bacteria and other impurities through reverse osmosis treatment, so that the obtained fresh water can circularly enter the circulating water system, the content of the organic matters, inorganic salts and other impurities in the circulating water is obviously reduced, and the step of manually carrying out sewage discharge on the circulating water system is omitted.

title_en: Sealed fermentation tank for fermentation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sealed fermentation tank for fermentation, which comprises a fermentation tank, wherein a top cover is arranged at the top end of the fermentation tank, a driving mechanism is arranged on the upper side of the top cover, a stirring mechanism is arranged in the fermentation tank, a sealing mechanism is arranged between the fermentation tank and the top cover, the driving mechanism comprises a motor seat, the motor seat is fixedly connected to the top end of the top cover, one side of the motor seat is connected with a servo motor, the output end of the servo motor is fixedly connected with a driving wheel, one side of the driving wheel is provided with a driven wheel in a meshed manner, the sealing mechanism comprises a sealing ring, the sealing ring is arranged at the junction of the fermentation tank and the top cover, two arc-shaped guide rings are placed outside the sealing ring, and the two arc-shaped guide rings are connected through bolts. Compared with the prior art, the sealed fermentation tank for fermentation has the advantages that the sealed fermentation tank for fermentation is provided, so that the problems of poor sealing performance, uneven stirring, difficult inner wall cleaning and the like of the existing fermentation tank are solved.

title_en: Deodorizing device of chicken manure fertilizer preparation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of poultry cultivation, in particular to a deodorizing device for chicken manure organic fertilizer preparation, which comprises a deodorizing frame, wherein three air inlets are formed in the top of the deodorizing frame, an air inlet pipe is clamped on the air inlets, an air collecting frame is arranged at the right end of the air inlet pipe, three sliding frames are connected in the deodorizing frame in a sliding mode, the positions of the sliding frames correspond to the air inlets, three filtering pieces are arranged in the sliding frames, three sliding baffles are connected to the rear side in the deodorizing frame in a sliding mode, guide rods are connected to the rear side of the sliding baffles in a penetrating mode, and springs are arranged between the guide rods and the deodorizing frame. According to the utility model, the efficient collection and distribution of the odor are realized through the three-way air inlet air collecting frame, the L-shaped sliding baffle, the spring and the guide rod form a linkage sealing system, and the linkage sealing system is automatically pushed out and forms elastic sealing when the sliding frame is pulled out for maintenance, so that odor dissipation in operation is stopped, and the comprehensive effects of improving the deodorizing efficiency, enhancing the maintenance convenience, optimizing the sealing safety and prolonging the service life of equipment are integrally realized.

title_en: Valve inner sphere thermal spraying device capable of spraying evenly
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of thermal spraying of valve inner spheres and discloses a thermal spraying device for uniformly spraying valve inner spheres, which comprises a workbench, wherein an L-shaped electric guide rail is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the workbench, two sliding seats are slidably connected to the outer surface of the L-shaped electric guide rail, a driving seat is fixedly connected to the outer surface of each sliding seat, a main spray head is fixedly connected to the outer surface of each driving seat, an atomization assembly is arranged in the main spray head, a recovery assembly is arranged outside the workbench, the atomization assembly comprises two feeding pipes, the feeding pipes are fixedly connected to the inner part of the main spray head, and the feeding pipes are spiral. According to the utility model, the spiral feeding pipe is used for enabling raw materials to form a rotary air flow, and then the raw materials are fully impacted and atomized in the material arranging groove, so that the sprayed raw materials uniformly cover the surface of the sphere, the uniformity and quality of the coating are effectively improved, and the problem of coating defects caused by uneven spraying is avoided.

title_en: Centrifugal device is used in alkyd lacquer diluent production
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for the technical field of alkyd paint diluent production, and provides a centrifugal device for alkyd paint diluent production, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the top surface of the bottom plate is provided with a base, the top surface of the base is provided with a column in a penetrating manner, the column is sequentially sleeved with a cover plate, a sleeve plate and a carrier plate from top to bottom in a spacing manner, the sleeve plate and the carrier plate are fixedly connected with the column, the cover plate is in sliding connection with the column, the top surface of the carrier plate is provided with a plurality of inserting grooves, the top surface of the sleeve plate is provided with a plurality of through grooves in a penetrating manner, and the bottom surface of the cover plate is provided with a plurality of clamping grooves. This scheme is fixed the centrifuging tube through loading board, cover plate and apron mutually supporting, waits after the centrifugation, can directly observe centrifugal effect, if centrifugal effect is poor, can carry out the centrifugation of secondary immediately, need not general centrifuge apron and observe, also need not to lock centrifuge apron again, has saved equipment materials moreover, the cost is reduced.

title_en: Leak protection structure of milling machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a leakage-proof structure of a pulverizer, which comprises guide grooves arranged on two side walls of an abrasive box, wherein the guide grooves are obliquely arranged at a feed opening of a feed mechanism, the feed mechanism comprises a first feed bottom plate and a second feed bottom plate, a gap is reserved between the first feed bottom plate and the second feed bottom plate to form the feed opening, the feed mechanism is arranged above the abrasive box, the feed opening is arranged between two grinding rollers of the abrasive box, the first feed bottom plate is arranged close to the abrasive box, a material blocking piece is further arranged on the first feed bottom plate, and the material blocking piece vertically extends towards the direction close to the grinding rollers. The utility model effectively prevents materials such as wheat from leaking from the two sides of the grinding roller and from jumping out from the inner side, and effectively solves the problem of material leakage of the pulverizer caused by the reduction of the diameter of the grinding roller.

title_en: Tractor for laying power cable
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cable laying and discloses a traction machine for power cable laying, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the top end of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a control seat, the left side of the control seat is fixedly connected with a fixed seat, the inside of the fixed seat is movably connected with a bidirectional threaded rod, the outer side of a handle is in threaded connection with two groups of threaded blocks, the top ends of the two groups of threaded blocks are fixedly connected with two groups of mounting plates, the left side of the two groups of mounting plates is provided with an adjustable quick cleaning structure, after the traction machine works for a certain time, a large amount of dust is arranged on a traction belt, the movable plate is manually pushed to move rightwards, two groups of movable rods on the same side move rightwards in a movable groove, when a cleaning brush is tightly attached to the traction belt, the movable plate is pulled leftwards to clean the surface dust of the traction belt, and the friction of the cleaning brush on the traction belt is avoided when the cleaning is not needed.

title_en: Continuous esterification reaction device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of esterification reaction equipment, in particular to a continuous esterification reaction device which comprises a reaction kettle body, a preheating box and a preheating device, wherein a discharge pipe is arranged at the bottom of the reaction kettle body, the preheating box is arranged above the reaction kettle body and is used for mixing castor oil and polyol according to a certain proportion and preheating the castor oil, a feed inlet is formed in the top surface of the preheating box, a discharge pipe is communicated between the preheating box and the reaction kettle body, and the bottom surface of the preheating box is fixedly connected with the top surface of the reaction kettle body through supporting legs. According to the utility model, the hollow rod is rotationally connected in the reaction kettle body, the outer wall of the hollow rod, which is positioned in the reaction kettle body, is provided with the plurality of round holes, and the positions, which correspond to the round holes, of the outer wall of the hollow rod are provided with the atomizing spray heads, so that when the mixture in the reaction kettle body is stirred, the catalyst can be directly sprayed into the reaction mixture in a mist form, the dispersing effect of the catalyst is obviously improved, and the reaction efficiency and the product quality are improved.

title_en: Integrated pet food particle processing, screening and drying equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of pet food screening processing equipment, and discloses integrated pet food particle processing, screening and drying equipment, which comprises a drying and sieving box, wherein a vibrating screen is arranged on the right side of the drying and sieving box, an air heater is arranged on the right side of the drying and sieving box, a supporting leg is fixedly connected to the bottom of the drying and sieving box, a feeding box is fixedly connected to the top of the drying and sieving box, a discharging frame is fixedly connected to the left side of the drying and sieving box, a movable feeding and discharging mechanism is arranged outside the discharging frame, an auxiliary dust removing mechanism is arranged at the top of the drying and sieving box, and in the use process, the position of a feeding hopper is conveniently adjusted through a hydraulic rod, so that dust scattering in the subsequent drying process is avoided when feeding pet food particles in the feeding hopper is met, the baffle angle is conveniently adjusted through motor operation, the discharging angle of the discharging frame is adjusted, and the front and back reciprocating movement of a guide plate is conveniently realized through electric telescopic rod operation.

title_en: Multifunctional field management machine integrating fertilization and soil loosening
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional garden management machine integrating fertilization and soil loosening, which comprises a machine body, wherein rollers are rotatably connected to two sides of the bottom of the machine body, the front end of the machine body is fixedly connected with a mounting seat, two sides of the bottom of the mounting seat are fixedly connected with fixing frames, a rotating shaft is penetrated and rotatably connected between the two fixing frames, a soil loosening blade which is uniformly distributed is fixedly connected with an outer ring of the rotating shaft, a storage box is fixedly connected to the left side of the top of the mounting seat, a stirring rod is penetrated and rotatably connected in the storage box, and stirring blades which are uniformly distributed are fixedly connected with an outer ring of the stirring rod. According to the utility model, the first motor drives the rotating shaft to rotate, so that the soil loosening blade on the outer ring of the rotating shaft is driven to rotate, soil loosening operation is carried out on soil, meanwhile, liquid fertilizer is pumped out through the pump body and sprayed out through the fertilizer spraying nozzle, and the effect of loosening soil and simultaneously carrying out fertilizer application is realized.

title_en: Multifunctional medicine feeding device for child nursing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of medical treatment and discloses a multifunctional medicine feeding device for child care, which comprises a water cup, wherein a partition plate is fixedly connected to the middle upper part of the inner wall of the water cup, a partition net is arranged at the top of the partition plate, a rotating column is rotatably connected to the bottom of the inner wall of the partition net, a plurality of stirring blades are arranged on the left side and the right side of the outer wall of the rotating column, a butt joint hole is formed in the top end of the rotating column, a cap is arranged at the top end of the water cup, the bottom end of the cap is in threaded connection with the top end of the inner wall of the water cup, a miniature motor is fixedly connected to the top part of the inner wall of the cap, and the output end of the miniature motor penetrates through the bottom end of the cap and is fixedly connected with a butt joint block. According to the utility model, larger particles can be filtered through the separation net, discomfort caused by entering the mouth of a child is prevented, and meanwhile, the bottom of the separation net is rotationally connected with the rotating column and the stirring blades on the left side and the right side of the outer wall of the rotating column, so that liquid medicine can be stirred under the drive of the miniature motor.

title_en: Portable hosepipe storage device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable water hose storage device, which comprises a hand-push type bearing frame and a rolling assembly arranged on the hand-push type bearing frame through bolts, wherein the hand-push type bearing frame comprises armrests, side rods, cross rods, auxiliary rods, supporting columns, rollers and auxiliary positioning movable forks, the armrests are respectively provided with two groups and are respectively connected with the two groups of side rods, the auxiliary rods and the cross rods are respectively fixed at the middle parts and the front ends between the two groups of side rods, the supporting columns are respectively provided with three groups, one group of supporting columns is vertically arranged at the middle part of the auxiliary rods, the other two groups of supporting columns are symmetrically arranged at the two ends of the cross rods, the rollers are respectively provided with three groups and are respectively arranged at the lower ends of the three groups of supporting columns, the auxiliary positioning movable forks are respectively provided with two groups and are respectively arranged on the two groups of supporting columns at the front side, and the rolling assembly comprises brackets, dismounting seats, handles and rolling wheels.

title_en: Temperature and humidity environment detection room
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a temperature and humidity environment detection chamber which comprises a detection chamber main body, a water collecting tank and a self-sealing drain pipe, wherein the inner surface of the top wall of the detection chamber main body is configured to be a diversion surface capable of guiding condensed water to the side part of the detection chamber main body, the water collecting tank is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the detection chamber main body and corresponds to the tail end of the diversion surface and is used for collecting the condensed water guided by the diversion surface, the self-sealing drain pipe is arranged in the detection chamber main body, one end of the self-sealing drain pipe is fixedly communicated with the bottom of the water collecting tank, and the other end of the self-sealing drain pipe extends to the outside of the detection chamber main body. According to the utility model, the active guide of the top wall condensed water is realized through the guide surface, unordered dripping of the condensed water is avoided, the automatic discharging of the condensed water is realized and the reliable isolation of the atmosphere inside and outside the detection chamber main body is ensured under the condition that external power and control are not needed through the self-sealing drain pipe, so that the temperature and humidity environment detection chamber solves the problem of a condensed water dripping interference test, and the tightness of the detection chamber main body and the stability of a temperature and humidity field are ensured.

title_en: Chip sorting structure with multistage screening precision adjustment function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of multistage screening chips and discloses a chip sorting structure with multistage screening precision adjustment, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the top of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a conveying belt, the top of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a collecting mechanism, the top of the conveying belt is fixedly connected with a deviation rectifying mechanism, the top of the conveying belt is fixedly connected with a detection assembly, the top of the conveying belt is fixedly connected with a pushing mechanism, the pushing mechanism comprises a shell, the bottom of the shell is fixedly connected with the top of the conveying belt, and the inside of the shell is fixedly connected with a motor. According to the utility model, by means of the quick response characteristic of mechanical transmission, the instant action of the pushing plate can be realized, the sorting requirement of a high-speed transmission line is met, the ejection force and direction can be stably controlled through the spring force and the eccentric wheel design, and the chip is effectively protected from damage.

title_en: Panel cleaning equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of plate cleaning, in particular to plate cleaning equipment which comprises a dust removing cavity, a dust blowing component and a dust sucking component, wherein two opposite sides of the dust removing cavity are respectively provided with a feed inlet and a discharge outlet, the dust blowing component comprises at least one group of dust blowing units arranged near the discharge outlet and used for spraying air flow to the surface of a plate passing through the discharge outlet, the dust sucking component is communicated with the dust removing cavity and used for sucking dust in the cavity, and the guide component is arranged in the dust removing cavity and comprises a guide piece positioned between the feed inlet and the discharge outlet and used for supporting the plate. According to the application, the dust diffusion is prevented by the arrangement of the closed dust removing cavity, the movable baffle plate dynamic seal, the dust removing assembly and the air outlet nozzle extending to the discharge port.

title_en: High-nitrate water recovery device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-nitrate water recovery device, and belongs to the technical field of high-nitrate water recovery treatment. The device comprises a reaction kettle, an installation pipe and a filter screen, and is characterized in that a disassembly mechanism for fixing and disassembling the filter screen is arranged. The disassembly mechanism is provided with a support frame fixed on the installation tube, a mounting frame, a fixing frame, a rotating plate and a connecting component of an internal spring, and can be linked with the fixing frame to move by operating the rotating plate, so that the fixing frame and the support frame are quickly separated or clamped by utilizing the elastic action of the spring, and the filter screen is conveniently replaced. In addition, the bottom of the supporting column of the device is also provided with a vibration reduction mechanism consisting of a rubber vibration-proof pad and a damper. The utility model aims to solve the problems of complex disassembly and easy damage of the filter screen, has the advantages of convenient operation and capability of avoiding consumable waste, and improves the stability of equipment operation through effective vibration reduction.

title_en: Scaling powder cleaning device
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of scaling powder cleaning devices, in particular to a scaling powder cleaning device which comprises a cleaning tank, wherein an installation seat is arranged in the cleaning tank, a liquid storage cavity is arranged on the lower side of the installation seat, the installation seat is provided with a liquid leakage hole communicated with the liquid storage cavity, the installation seat is used for arranging a plurality of substrates, a spray head is arranged in the cleaning tank and is provided with a connecting pipe connected to the upper top wall of the cleaning tank, the installation seat is provided with a limiting structure for fixing the substrates, the limiting structure comprises a collision rod which is connected to the installation seat in a sliding mode along the vertical direction, and the collision rod is used for abutting the edges of the substrates so as to limit the substrates. The application has the following effects that the spray-washing mode can enable the sprayed cleaning agent to enter the liquid storage cavity through the liquid leakage hole, so that the possibility that the welding spot is soaked in the cleaning agent is reduced as much as possible, and the effect of protecting the welding spot is achieved.

title_en: Rainwater collecting and recycling device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rainwater collecting and recycling device which comprises a filter box, wherein a collecting pipe is arranged on the filter box, a collecting box is arranged on the collecting pipe, a fixing frame is arranged at the top of the collecting box, a connecting device and a collecting filter screen are arranged on the fixing frame, a fixing plate is arranged in the filter box, a fixing rod is arranged on the fixing plate in a sliding mode, a floating ball is arranged at the bottom of the fixing rod, a first water outlet pipe is arranged at the bottom of the filter box, one side of the filter box is communicated with a communicating pipe and a sterilizing box, a plurality of lamp holders are arranged on the sterilizing box in an array mode, ultraviolet lamps are arranged on the lamp holders, threaded sleeves are arranged on the lamp holders, a threaded lampshade matched with the threaded sleeves is arranged on the outer sides of the ultraviolet lamps, a second water outlet pipe is arranged on one side of the sterilizing box, rainwater subjected to multistage filtration is partially supplied to low water quality demand scenes such as greening irrigation directly through the first water outlet pipe, and the other part enters the sterilizing box, the sterilizing box is sterilized and the cleanliness is improved through the ultraviolet lamps, and then the scene with high water quality demand is supplied through the second water outlet pipe.

title_en: Intelligent closestool module of intaking
abstract_en: The utility model provides an intelligent closestool water inlet module which comprises a water inlet filter, a pressure stabilizing electromagnetic valve, an anti-siphon device and a heater which are connected in sequence. The water inlet filter is provided with a tap water inlet interface for abutting against a water source, the heater is provided with a water outlet interface, the anti-siphon device is provided with an overflow water tank, the overflow water tank is provided with an overflow port, and the tap water inlet interface and the water outlet interface are downward. The anti-siphon device is fixed with the pressure stabilizing electromagnetic valve and the heater through screws, mounting lugs are arranged on the periphery of the water inlet filter, the periphery of the pressure stabilizing electromagnetic valve and the periphery of the heater, and screw mounting holes in the vertical direction are formed in the mounting lugs. According to the intelligent closestool water inlet module, modularized parts are formed through direct fixed assembly, so that the assembly steps and the complicated degree of the intelligent closestool water inlet module in a closestool mounting cavity can be reduced, a connecting pipe is omitted, and the conditions of messy connecting pipes and connecting errors in the closestool mounting cavity are avoided.

title_en: Environment-friendly energy-saving building rainwater cyclic utilization device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of building rainwater recycling devices, and discloses an environment-friendly energy-saving building rainwater recycling device which comprises a water inlet hopper, a filter cartridge, a water storage tank, a first connecting pipe and a second connecting pipe, wherein the two ends of the filter cartridge are respectively provided with a water inlet pipe and a water outlet pipe, the bottom end of the water inlet hopper is connected with the water inlet pipe of the filter cartridge through a flange, the second connecting pipe is arranged at the top of one end of the water storage tank, one end of the second connecting pipe, which is far away from the water storage tank, is connected with the water outlet pipe through the flange, and the inner wall of the filter cartridge is provided with an inclined support ring. According to the design scheme, the inclined filter cylinder with the inclined top is designed in the filter cylinder, then the limit of the lifting handle is realized through the sealing cover, rainwater flows into the filter cylinder from the water inlet pipe, is filtered by the inclined filter cylinder and enters a cavity formed between the inclined filter cylinder and the filter cylinder, and is discharged through the water outlet pipe, and the wall and the bottom of the inclined filter cylinder can filter the rainwater.

title_en: Insect protection and collection device of outdoor mobile house
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an insect protection and collection device of an outdoor mobile house, which comprises a shell, wherein a baking and collection assembly is arranged below the shell and used for baking electrocuted mosquitoes, the baking and collection assembly comprises a bottom box and a drawing box, the bottom box is fixedly arranged below the shell, the drawing box is slidably arranged in the bottom box, a cavity is formed in the bottom box, a gas blowing hole is formed in the side wall of the bottom box and the side wall of the drawing box, the gas blowing hole is communicated with the cavity, and the baking and collection assembly, a disinfection assembly, a spring piece and a clamping plate are used for conducting high-temperature baking treatment on the collected electrocuted mosquitoes, preventing the accumulated bacteria and viruses of the electrocuted mosquitoes from damaging human bodies, protecting living environments near the collection device, and simultaneously conducting sufficient disinfection treatment on the inside of the used bottom box and drawing box, thereby being beneficial to improving the sanitary cleaning effect of the collection device and being convenient to use.

title_en: System for preparing aviation kerosene from methanol
abstract_en: The utility model provides a system for preparing aviation kerosene from methanol, belongs to the technical field of chemical industry, and solves the problems that oligomerization is seriously affected by incomplete separation of light olefins in the early stage in the prior art, and further the yield and selectivity of products are affected. The methanol-free methanol separation device comprises a methanol reactor, wherein the methanol reactor is connected with a washing tower, the washing tower is connected with a compressor unit, the compressor unit is connected with a demethanizer, the demethanizer is connected with a deethanizer, the deethanizer is connected with an ethylene rectifying tower, the ethylene rectifying tower is connected with an oligomerization reactor, the oligomerization reactor is connected with a hydrogenation reactor, and the hydrogenation reactor is connected with a product separation tower. The materials at the bottom of the demethanizer enter the deethanizer for separation, the separated light components are separated into ethylene and ethane by the ethylene rectifying tower, the ethylene is used as the feed of the oligomerization reactor, the ethane is used as a byproduct, the low-carbon olefin is more beneficial to oligomerization reaction, the yield of aviation kerosene is improved, and meanwhile, the byproduct ethane has high purity.

title_en: Catalyst for purifying exhaust gas
abstract_en: The present invention provides an exhaust gas purification catalyst having excellent removal performance of methane, which is chemically stable. An exhaust gas purification catalyst 5 according to the present invention includes a substrate 10 that divides cells 12 through which an exhaust gas flows and a catalyst layer 20 that is provided on a surface of the substrate 10. The catalyst layer 20 includes a palladium layer 21 containing palladium that extends from a first end part 10a which is an end part on the side of the cells 12 into which an exhaust gas flows to a second end part 10b which is an end part on the side from which an exhaust gas flows out, a platinum layer 22 containing platinum that extends from the second end part 10b to the first end part 10a, and a rhodium layer 23 containing rhodium that is laminated on both the palladium layer 21 and the platinum layer 22. The Pd layer 21 contains an alkaline earth metal at a content of 0.04 mol or more and 0.16 mol or less per 100 g of the Pd layer. In the Pt layer 22, an alkaline earth metal content per 100 g of the Pt layer is limited to 0.03 mol or less.

title_en: Process for preparing nanoparticles in the form of a powder comprising a bio-resorbable polyester
abstract_en: The invention is concerned with a process for preparing nanoparticles, comprising at least one bio-resorbable polyester, in the form of a powder with a Z-Average particle size D z  in the range of 1 to 450 nm, with a polydispersity index PDI in the range of 0.01 to 0.5, by emulsion-solvent extraction or emulsion-solvent evaporation and application of ultrasonic sound.

title_en: Push-pump for dispensing soap or other liquids
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are arrangements of a manually operated liquid dispenser. In any arrangements disclosed herein, the dispenser can include a housing with a volume of space therein, the volume of space having a first end and a second end, a pump sleeve extending into the space of the housing and nearly to a bottom, inside surface of the space, a pump head, a push rod coupled with the pump head and configured to be axially movable within an axial opening extending through the pump sleeve, a passageway extending through at least the pump head and the push rod, the passageway being in fluid communication with the axial opening extending through the pump sleeve and with the volume of space within the housing, and a first valve configured to control a passage of a liquid substance within the volume of space in the housing through a passageway.

title_en: Methods and apparatuses for sealing mechanisms for realizing adhesive connections with additively manufactured components
abstract_en: A node may be additively manufactured. The node may include a first surface and a second surface, and the second surface may bound a recess of the node. A structure may be inserted into the recess. A sealing member extend away from the second surface and contact the structure, such that a sealed space may be created between the node and the structure. An adhesive may be applied in the sealed space to at least partially attach the structure to the node.

title_en: Method and device for sorting plastic objects
abstract_en: The invention relates to various systems and methods for sorting plastics and for producing plastic material on the basis of sorted recycling material. According to one aspect, a type of plastic object (200) is determined by detecting the intensities of reflected light in the infrared range at different wavelengths, and then the plastic objects (200) are sorted according to the types in question. According to another aspect, a concentration of a marker in a plastic material made from recycled plastic raw material is determined and, on the basis thereof, a suitable quantity of additional markers is introduced in order to obtain a constant marker concentration.

title_en: Curing catalyst and resin composition
abstract_en: The present invention provides a curing catalyst which promotes a reaction between a hydroxyalkyl amide-based curing agent and a carboxy group-containing resin, especially curing of a carboxy group-containing resin-based powder coating material using a hydroxyalkyl amide-based curing agent, and in particular, curing of a polyester resin-based powder coating material. A curing catalyst which promotes a reaction between a carboxy group-containing resin and a compound that has a β-hydroxyalkyl amide group, said curing catalyst containing a compound that contains, as a metal atom, at least one element selected from the group consisting of Mo, Cr, V, Fe, Co, Ni, Ga, Zr, In, Ba, Ce and Bi. It is preferable that the metal atom is an Mo atom. An Al atom may be included as the metal atom.

title_en: Secure reconstitution device
abstract_en: A reconstitution device comprising a cartridge (212) containing a first substance, the cartridge having a plunger (238) at one end and a piercable septum (222) at a second end, a vial (218) containing a second substance, the vial having a piercable septum (224), a housing (210), a cartridge needle hub (226), the cartridge needle hub (226) having a needle (228) protruding therefrom, a vial needle hub (229), the vial needle hub having a needle (222) protruding therefrom, the vial needle hub (229) and the cartridge needle hub (226) being releasably securable together, cartridge latches (240) holding the cartridge needle hub (226) within the housing, vial needle hub latches (231) extending to engage the housing, and a plunger rod (232), the plunger rod having an inner portion (234) engageable with the plunger (238) of the cartridge, the plunger rod (232) having an outer portion (236) which is adapted to engage the vial needle hub latches (240) to release the vial needle hub (229) from engagement with the cartridge needle hub (226), whereby the vial (218) and the vial needle hub (229) may be released from the housing.

title_en: System for continuous manufacture of biomolecules
abstract_en: The invention relates to a system (1) for continuous manufacture of biomolecules comprising feed tanks (2) suitable for storing products and a reaction chamber (4) designed to be fed with products from said feed tanks which form in the reaction chamber a reaction phase, said reaction chamber being designed to manufacture said biomolecules from said reaction phase. The system of the invention comprises a scale tank (6) in fluid communication to the reaction chamber and suitable for storing an immiscible phase and a monitoring and control unit (2) set to control the injection flow rate of the immiscible phase into the reaction chamber in order to keep constant a certain filling level of the reaction chamber according to the amount of reaction phase to be injected into the reaction chamber to manufacture a certain amount of biomolecules.

title_en: Microfluidic chip and method for manufacturing microfluidic microchip
abstract_en: There is provided a microfluidic chip and a method of producing the microfluidic chip, which can suppress poor bonding between a resin layer forming a channel and a lid component, and can suppress deformation of the channel. A microfluidic chip (1) includes a substrate (10), a partition layer (11) configured by a resin material and provided on the substrate (10) to form a channel, and a cover layer (12) provided on the surface of the partition layer (11) facing away from the substrate (10), wherein the partition layer (11) has an elastic modulus in the range of 1 MPa or more and 10 GPa or less.

title_en: Transition metal incorporated alumina for improved three way catalysts
abstract_en: Provided is a catalyst article comprising a substrate and a catalyst composition disposed on the substrate, the catalyst composition comprising a support material having supported thereon: one or more platinum group metals (PGMs); and a Ta-polyoxometalate (POM).

title_en: Ultrasonic transducer and method for manufacturing the same
abstract_en: An ultrasonic transducer (1) of this invention includes a rigid substrate (10) with opening parts (15) extending between bottom and top surfaces, a flexible resin film (20) fixed to the top surface of the substrate (10) to cover the opening parts (15), and piezoelectric elements (30) fixed to a top surface of the resin film (20) so as to overlap in a plan view with the opening parts (15), respectively. An arrangement pitch of the piezoelectric elements (30) is preferably set to be equal to or less than 4.3 mm, and the piezoelectric element (30) may have a rectangular shape in the plan view having longitudinal and lateral dimensions in the plan view with a maximum value of 4.0 mm or less, a circular shape in the plan view having a diameter of 4.0 mm or less, or an elliptical shape in the plan view having a major axis of 4.0 mm or less.

title_en: Device for processing a surface of a workpiece using a combination of atmospheric plasma beam and laser beam
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device (2, 302, 402, 502, 602, 802) for processing a surface (4) of a workpiece (6) using a laser beam (8, 8'), having a laser system (12, 12') for providing the laser beam (8, 8') and a plasma nozzle (14, 14'), which is designed to generate an atmospheric plasma beam (16, 16'), wherein: the plasma nozzle (14, 14') has a nozzle head (22, 22') from which a plasma beam (16, 16') generated in the plasma nozzle (14, 14') exits during operation; the laser system (12, 12') and the plasma nozzle (14, 14') are arranged with respect to each other and designed such that the laser beam (8, 8') exits the nozzle head (22, 22') of the plasma nozzle (14, 14') during operation; and the nozzle head (22, 22') can rotate about an axis of rotation (R), which extends obliquely and/or in an offset manner with respect to the plasma beam (16, 16') exiting the nozzle head (22, 22') during operation and/or with respect to the laser beam (8, 8') exiting the nozzle head (22, 22') during operation. The invention further relates to a method for operating a device of this kind.

title_en: Hydrogen generation device and method to produce hydrogen
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a hydrogen generation device. The hydrogen generation device includes: a plurality of cylinders; a plurality of combustion units disposed in each of the plurality of cylinders to combust a fuel; a distribution unit configured to deliver the fuel supplied from the fuel supply unit to each of the plurality of combustion units by distributing the fuel in a uniform quantity; a plurality of reaction units disposed in the plurality of cylinders, respectively, to generate hydrogen by a reforming reaction of a feed supplied from a feed supply unit while the reaction units are heated by a combustion heat transmitted from the combustion unit; and a metering unit disposed between the distribution unit and the combustion unit respectively in each of the cylinders to adjust an amount of the fuel delivered from the distribution unit to the combustion unit in a fixed quantity.

title_en: Filter member
abstract_en: Provided is a filter member having a filter that exhibits a long filter life and that can maintain a particle concentration in a particle-containing liquid being filtered. The filter member has a filter that has an opening diameter that is smaller than the diameter of the filtration target contained in the particle-containing liquid. This filter is formed by a carbodiimide compound-treated fiber from an amide-based fiber that contains the amide bond and has a carboxyl group and/or amino group functional group.

title_en: Method and device for filter residue treatment
abstract_en: The present invention provides to a filter residue treatment device, comprising a means for supplying a pressurized fluid, a housing comprising a) a first inlet for the introduction of a medium different from the pressurized fluid and comprising a filter residue and b) a second inlet for the introduction of the pressurized fluid and an inflatable or flexible means comprised in the housing and configured and arranged for being operated by the pressurized fluid such that in an inflated or flexed state it pushes the filter residue comprised in the medium introduced through the inlet towards a filter means.

title_en: Multi-well systems and methods for sorting sperm
abstract_en: Provided herein are systems and methods for sorting sperm that in illustrative embodiments include two or more separation channels each connected to a collection chamber. In some embodiments, at least one of the separation channels is attached to a filter chamber, which is also connected to an introduction channel. Some embodiments include a plurality of separation channels and connected collection chambers. Furthermore, in some embodiments the separation channels and connected collection chambers are arranged in parallel, in serial, or a combination thereof. Some embodiments, herein include a pre-filter zone that can be a straight channel, or can be other than a straight channel, including a number of different disclosed configurations.

title_en: Telescopic nebulizer lance
abstract_en: Outdoor and/or indoor nebulizer (1) comprising a delivery mouth (2), a nebulization nozzle (3) for dispensing a mist of nebulized working liquid, and a conduit (4) therebetween; said conduit (4) being extensible within a contracted rest configuration and an extended operating configuration to change the distance of the nebulization nozzle (3) from the delivery mouth (2). The nebulizer further comprises a drain valve (6) arranged upstream of the conduit (4) to act as an anti-drip device and simultaneously eliminate residual overpressures in the body of the nebulizer (1).

title_en: Catalyst for olefin acetoxylation
abstract_en: Disclosed herein is a catalyst and a process for the acetoxylation of olefins in a gaseous reaction stream containing an olefin, acetic acid, and an oxygen-containing gas using the catalyst. The catalyst may comprise a support material and a catalytic layer disposed on an external surface of the support material. The catalytic layer may comprise palladium and gold. The catalyst may comprise from 7 to 10 g/L palladium and from 3 to 8 g/L gold.

title_en: Filter for hydraulic fluids for hydraulic circuits
abstract_en: A filter (1) for hydraulic fluids for hydraulic circuits comprising a filter body (2) inside which a filtering cartridge (6) is housed, said filter body (2) comprises at least one hydraulic fluid inlet (4) in communication with a supply chamber (10) located upstream of said filtering cartridge (6), said filter (1) comprising a plurality of through openings (5) of hydraulic fluid outlet distributed along a predetermined longitudinal section of said side wall (3a), said through openings (5) being closer to said supply chamber (10) and having smaller dimensions than the through openings (5) that are more distal from said supply chamber (10).

title_en: Method for producing unsaturated aldehyde, and apparatus for producing unsaturated aldehyde
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for producing an unsaturated aldehyde corresponding to an alkene including partially oxidizing the alkene using a fixed-bed multitubular reactor. The fixed-bed multitubular reactor includes multiple reaction tubes and a reaction bath for adjusting temperature of the multiple reaction tubes. The reaction tube is provided with two or more catalyst layers in a gas flow direction. When a reaction bath temperature at which a yield of the unsaturated aldehyde is the highest is defined as A (°C), and reaction bath temperatures at which the yield is 1.0% lower than the highest value are defined as A1 (°C) and A2 (°C), following formulae (1) and (2) hold:      A   1   <   A   <   A   2        and        A   2   −   A   1     ≥   10

title_en: Carrier apparatus and sequencing system
abstract_en: The present application discloses a carrier apparatus and a sequencing system. The carrier apparatus according to the embodiments of the present disclosure includes a carrier platform, a fluid connecting assembly, and a movement mechanism. The carrier platform includes a table surface, the table surface being detachably connected to a flow cell assembly; the flow cell assembly includes a flow cell, with a fluid inlet and a fluid outlet being respectively formed at both ends of the flow cell. The fluid connecting assembly includes a manifold arranged in correspondence with the fluid inlet and the fluid outlet. The movement mechanism drives the fluid connecting assembly to move, including: when the fluid connecting assembly is located at a first position, the fluid connecting assembly and the flow cell assembly form a fluid communication through the manifold with the fluid inlet and the fluid outlet; and when the fluid connecting assembly is located at a second position, communication between the fluid connecting assembly and the flow cell assembly is cut off. In the carrier apparatus according to the embodiments of the present disclosure, the fluid connecting assembly is driven by the movement mechanism to move relative to the flow cell assembly, such that the communication between the fluid connecting assembly and the flow cell assembly can be achieved or cut off. The carrier apparatus is simple in structure and convenient to operate.

title_en: Heterogeneous catalysts
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure are directed towards a heterogenous catalyst composition of formed from using a crystalline porous metal-organic framework (MOF) which reacts in an inverse electron-demand Diels-Alder reaction with a phosphorous ligand to produce a heterogeneous catalyst precursor. The heterogeneous catalyst precursor then reacts with a Group VIII transition metal catalyst precursor compound to form the heterogeneous catalyst composition that can be used for the hydroformylation of olefins, among other reactions.

title_en: Method for producing mineral water, and method for suppressing propagation of microorganisms
abstract_en: The object of the invention is to provide delicious and safe mineral water in a stable manner for prolonged periods, and to inhibit proliferation of microorganisms in a water purification system or product (for example, a packaged drinking water, food or beverage product). Provided is a method for producing mineral water, the method comprising a step of providing a mineral solution, a step of filtering tap water to provide purified water, and a step of mixing the mineral solution with the purified water to a potassium ion concentration of 20 ppm or greater in the mineral water.

title_en: Fluid path system, mixing system, method for manufacturing a mixture, and use of a fluid path system and of a mixing system
abstract_en: The invention provides a fluid path system, in particular for aseptic processing of at least a first fluid and a second fluid, the fluid path system comprising at least a first tubing unit and a second tubing unit, wherein the first tubing unit is configured to receive the first fluid from a first reservoir and the second tubing unit is configured to receive the second fluid from a second reservoir, a mixing element configured to combine the first fluid and the second fluid to provide a mixture of the first fluid and the second fluid and to discharge the mixture of the first fluid and the second fluid, where filling and emptying the tubes is obtained by modification of the air or gas pressure inside the tubings by gas-filled syringes which are connected to the tubings through sterile filters, such that only sterile air or gas will come into connection with the fluids in the tubings. Furthermore, a mixing system and a corresponding method for mixing of at least two fluids is provided. The invention allows for an aseptic and precise mixing of fluids or fluid phases, in particular of two or more fluids or fluid phases.

title_en: Cascading, recirculating water deionization systems
abstract_en: Water deionization systems based on electrochemical water desalination or softening using a capacitive or intercalative deionization devices including a stack of electrochemical cells. Each cell includes first and second electrodes and an ion exchange membrane. Each cell includes inlet and outlet channels with control valves that control the separation of the source water into brine (e.g., concentration) and clean water (e.g., purification) streams. The deionization device or module may include multiple electrochemical cells connected electrically in series, parallel or a combination of both. The cells may also be in serial, parallel, or combined fluid communication. The output water of one or more streams from each cell or collection of cells may be recirculated and combined with one or more input water streams to improve the electrochemical energy efficiency of the cells. The electrochemical cells at different rows may have varying electrode thickness, area and loading of the active material.

title_en: Automated nail polish mixer
abstract_en: It is applied in the field of cosmetics, it is used in beauty centres, hair salons, in one's own home, wherever deemed appropriate. The invention relates to an innovative automated nail polish mixer to create customised nail polishes, or, thanks to a spectrophotometer, to make them identical to the one the person has at that moment, with the possibility of making even single-dose polishes (for one application at a time). The system allows to precisely mix coloured pigments with a transparent or opaque base, creating customised polishes based on the user preferences. The machine is integrated with advanced software provided with artificial intelligence and a colour scanning system that can detect and faithfully reproduce existing colours or modify them. The system also provides the possibility of integrating an automatic polish applicator, making the entire creation and application process fully automated. The machine is also provided with an automated cleaning system to ensure maximum hygiene between production cycles.

title_en: Method for preparing 2,5-dimethylfuran by biomass conversion
abstract_en: The present disclosure is directed to a method for preparing 2,5-dimethylfuran by biomass conversion. The method comprises: (1) in an organic solvent, subjecting a biomass feedstock to a reaction in the presence of a solid acid catalyst to obtain a reaction product liquid containing 5-hydroxymethylfurfural and 5-(C2-C5 alkoxymethyl)furfural, wherein the molar ratio of 5-hydroxymethylfurfural to 5-(C2-C5 alkoxymethyl)furfural is in a range of 0.5-1.5; (2) subjecting the reaction product liquid obtained in step (1) and hydrogen to a reaction in the presence of a hydrogenolysis catalyst to prepare 2,5-dimethylfuran. The method has the advantages of high product selectivity, good catalyst stability, and easy product separation, achieving a green and efficient conversion of biomass to 2,5-dimethylfuran.

title_en: Lateral flow test systems and methods
abstract_en: Lateral flow test device comprises: a test strip comprising: a membrane having a first capturing reagent 206 for capturing an analyte 205 in a liquid sample disposed at a test position; a sample pad disposed on the first surface at a first end of the membrane; and a conjugate pad on the first surface between the sample pad and the test position, the conjugate pad having deposited thereon a catalytic labelling reagent 203 for chemically binding to the analyte 205; an activation layer 201 disposed over the membrane arranged to contact the first surface upon activation, the activation layer having deposited thereon a catalyst substrate 202 for chemically reacting with the catalytic labelling reagent upon activation (figure 2B); and a support structure configured, when the device is in an inactive state (figure 2A), to affix the test strip and the activation layer such that the activation layer is separated from the membrane. The activation layer may comprise an electrode array 201 to apply an electrical potential across the first surface upon activation and upon the catalyst substrate reacting with the catalytic labelling reagent produces an electrochemically detectable product.

title_en: Controlled release nutraceutical carrier and its manufacturing
abstract_en: A manufacturing process comprising vacuum assisted extraction coupled to ultrasound treatment of food by-products to obtain a controlled release agent comprising polysaccharides and polysaccharide bonded phenols is provided. A manufacturing process for food by-products comprising 3 cycles of vacuum instantaneous expansion, 15 minutes of ultrasound assisted extraction and pH of 1.5 to obtain polysaccharides with an increased range of antioxidant activity and a decreased zeta potential is also provided. A controlled release medicine comprising the controlled release agent obtained from the manufacturing processes is provided wherein the controlled release medicine comprises an active substance or beneficial microorganisms. The active agent may be selected from analgesics, antihistamines, digestives, antibiotics, anti-inflammatory agents, polyphenolic extracts, carotenoids, cannabinoids, and vitamins. The beneficial microorganism may be selected from Lactobacillus, Saccharomyces, Bifidobacterium, Streptococcus or Akkermansia. The bonded phenols may be gallic acid or polyphenols. The polysaccharide may be cellulose and hemicellulose. The food by-product is preferable persimmon (Diospyros kaki Thunb). [Fig: None]

title_en: Dispersion method of conductive particle, and electrostatic adsorption apparatus
abstract_en: To provide a dispersion method of conductive particles capable of two-dimensionally arranging conductive particles distantly from each other on a substrate.SOLUTION: An electrostatic adsorption apparatus 1 is equipped with a first electrode 4 including an arrangement part 2 having electrostatic diffusibility or electrical conductivity on which particles are arranged and a second electrode 7 including an adsorption part 5 having electrostatic diffusibility or electrical conductivity that faces the arrangement part 2. A dispersion method of conductive particles includes a step for forming an electric field between the first electrode 4 and the second electrode 7 of the electrostatic adsorption apparatus 1 and thus moving reciprocally compound particles P formed by adsorbing conductive particles of a smaller size than carrier particles to the carrier particles and arranged on the arrangement part 2 between the arrangement part 2 and the adsorption part 5 to adsorb the conductive particles to the adsorption part 5.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Concentration system
abstract_en: To provide a portable concentrator using an advanced concentrator such as Brine Concentration (BC).SOLUTION: There is provided a portable concentration system with at least one advanced concentrator selected from the group consisting of semipermeable membrane modules, electrodialysis machines, disc-type reverse osmosis membrane modules, and ultrahigh pressure reverse osmosis membrane modules. The semipermeable membrane module has a semipermeable membrane and chambers 1 and 2 partitioned by the semipermeable membrane, and by flowing a first target liquid into the first chamber at a predetermined pressure and a second target liquid into the second chamber at a pressure lower than the predetermined pressure, water contained in the first target liquid in the first chamber is transferred to the second target liquid in the second chamber through the semipermeable membrane, then, a concentrated liquid is discharged from the first chamber, and a diluted liquid is discharged from the second chamber.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Structure, vibration device and body sensation acoustic unit
abstract_en: To provide a structure capable of amplifying or attenuating vibration of a vibration source and having static rigidity required for supporting an assumed load.SOLUTION: A structure 100 comprises: a vibration part 110 holding a vibrator; a housing 120 for storing at least partially, the vibration part; and support parts 130SR, 130SL for supporting the vibration part and coupling the vibration part and the housing. The support parts have a kinetic rigidity for amplifying or attenuating transmission of vibration in a prescribed frequency, out of vibration generated in at least one direction by the vibration part in a state of holding the vibrator, and have static rigidity for supporting the vibration part in a state of holding the vibrator. A system including the structure and vibrator has a property in which, as the frequency of vibration in the vibration in the at least one direction becomes greater, a vibration transmission ratio is reduced progressively, after expression of the vibration mode which is excited and in which the vibration transmission ratio becomes greater.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Gas transfer type ultrasonic spring-out fine particle quantitative supply system, and, gas transfer type ultrasonic spring-out fine particle quantitative supply method
