abstract_en: To provide a gas transfer type ultrasonic spring-out fine particle quantitative supply method capable of quantitatively and stably transporting and supplying fine particles with extremely light mass and a system.SOLUTION: According to the present invention, at least part of an ultrasonic vibration spring-out part 102 is in contact with a fine powder surface Z of a surface layer of the fine powder a contained in the fine powder container 11, and ultrasonically vibrates the fine powder. The fine powder that springs-out from the surface of the fine particles onto the ultrasonic vibration spring-out portion though a passage area of the ultrasonic vibration spring-out portion is taken in from a powder suction port of the supply nozzle 15 together with the carrier gas.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Fine particle discharger
abstract_en: To provide a fine particle discharger capable of lessening the possibility of fine particle bridge generation.SOLUTION: A fine particle discharger includes a container in which fine particles can be stored and a first through hole is provided on a bottom part, a pipe connected to the bottom part and communicating with the first through hole, and a rotary table housed in the container and rotatable while contacting the bottom part. The rotary table has a first face contacting the bottom part and a second face of a side opposite to the first face, and at least one second through hole connecting the first face to the second one is provided on the rotary table. The second through hole is provided at a position communicable with the first through hole when the rotary table rotates, and the fine particle stored in the container is discharged through the above pipe when the rotary table is rotated and the second through hole communicates with the first through hole.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Jaw crusher and method of adjusting gap width thereof
abstract_en: To provide a jaw crusher which is capable of highly accurately adjusting a gap width between an anchor tooth and a movable tooth, and which can be downsized.SOLUTION: A jaw crusher 2 comprises: an anchor tooth 8; a movable tooth 20 which oscillates against the anchor tooth 8 to crush a crushing object in between itself and the anchor tooth 8; a gap adjustor 22 having wedges 36 for adjusting a gap width D between the anchor tooth 8 and the movable tooth 20; and an actuator 24 for moving the gap adjustor 22 to modify the gap width D. Preferably, the actuator 24 has a pressing abutter 42 for energizing and moving the gap adjustor 22, and the pressing abutter 42 can be moved to a standby position away from the gap adjustor 22.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Filtration membrane for trapping microparticles, method for manufacturing the same, and method for measuring microparticle count
abstract_en: To provide a filtration membrane for trapping microparticles in which a size of an individual area that enables water to pass on an outermost surface of a filtration surface is smaller than, for example, 10 nm and which can be produced while achieving a high yield.SOLUTION: A filtration membrane 1 for trapping microparticles comprises: a base membrane 10 which has communication holes 18 to 20 formed therein; and a skin layer 30 which is formed having communication holes 31 on one surface of the base membrane 10 and in which the communication holes 31 are opened. The communication holes 31 in the skin layer 30 are in communication with the corresponding communication holes 18 in the base layer 10. A flow channel diameter of the communication hole 31 in the skin layer 30 which communicates with the communication hole 18 is smaller than a bore diameter of the communication hole 18 in the base membrane 10.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Distillation apparatus and furnace body
abstract_en: To provide a distillation apparatus which can easily determine whether distillation is completed or not.SOLUTION: A distillation apparatus comprises: a furnace body which includes a side wall part, and a bottom plate part on which an object to be distilled is placed and which is supported by the side wall part through an elastic support member whose extension amount is varied according to weight of the object to be distilled; a weight measurement part which is arranged to be capable of measuring weight of the object to be distilled placed on the bottom plate part; and a determination part which determines that distillation of the object to be distilled is completed when weight of the object to be distilled measured by the weight measurement part during distillation becomes target weight set in advance. The elastic support member is formed of fluorine-contained rubber. An inner peripheral wall of the furnace body is formed of a stainless plate. The object to be distilled is a battery, and the furnace evaporates electrolyte solvent in the battery.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Large space temperature decreasing device
abstract_en: To provide a large space temperature decreasing device which can effectively decrease a temperature in a large space, such as a factory, a warehouse, and a large scale commercial facility, at low costs.SOLUTION: A large space temperature decreasing device 1 according to the invention includes: a ceiling fan 3 which is attached to a ceiling or the like of a space whose temperature is decreased (a temperature decreasing space), causes rotary vanes 9 to rotate to stir air in the temperature decreasing space; and a mist sprayer 4 which makes water into mist to spray the mist from nozzles 17. The nozzle 17 is arranged so that a position of a jet port is located at the outer side relative to an outer diameter of the rotary vane 9 in a plan view.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Plasma irradiation device
abstract_en: To provide a plasma irradiation device that can suppress an increase in a leakage current flowing through a plasma irradiation target.SOLUTION: A plasma irradiation device 100 includes a discharge unit 53 that generates a plasma discharge, a power supply unit 80 that supplies power from a power source to the discharge unit 53, and a control unit 71 that controls the power supply unit 80. The control unit 71 controls the power supply unit 80 to suppress the power supplied to the discharge unit 53 when a determination value corresponding to a current supplied from the power supply unit 80 exceeds an upper limit value.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Analysis device
abstract_en: To provide an analysis device that maintains good measurement sensitivity even after long-term storage, and can obtain a proper electric potential for selected ions.SOLUTION: An analysis device is provided, which has a porous base material, an electrode formed inside the porous base material, on a surface thereof, or from the inside up to the surface thereof, an ion selection film covering the electrode, and a protective layer. The ion selection film includes a plasticizer. The protective layer is formed inside the porous base material in proximity to at least part of the ion selection film, and includes a component inhibiting penetration of the plasticizer.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1A

title_en: Sprayer for chemical solution
abstract_en: To provide a sprayer that is capable of spraying in a converging manner, changing a mist diameter, and making a full use of a chemical solution.SOLUTION: A sprayer comprises: a chemical solution bottle attachment part 10 which enables a chemical solution bottle 100 containing a chemical solution to be attached with an opening 101 thereof facing down; a chemical solution storage tank 20 which is provided below the chemical solution bottle attachment part 10; a plurality of ultrasonic oscillators 30 which include a mesh 31 and a piezoelectric element 32 through which the chemical solution passes, are provided so as to penetrate a wall surface of the chemical solution storage tank 20 and generate mist from the stored chemical solution; a nozzle front chamber 40 which accommodates the generated mist and has a nozzle 41 for jetting the mist; and a blower fan 50 which blows air to the mist accommodated in the nozzle front chamber 40 and jets out the mist from the nozzle 41. The plurality of ultrasonic oscillators 30 differ in mesh sizes which results in different diameters of the generated mist, and any of the ultrasonic oscillators 30 is selectively actuated.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Distillation apparatus and distillation method
abstract_en: To provide a distillation apparatus that can efficiently separate a low-boiling solvent.SOLUTION: A distillation apparatus, which separates a low-boiling solvent from mixed liquid including the low-boiling solvent, a high-boiling solvent and salt, is provided with: a distillation tower in which the low-boiling solvent is evaporated from the mixed liquid and concentrated liquid in which concentration of the high-boiling solvent increases is stored in a lower part thereof; a condensing line having a capacitor which flows out vapor of the low-boiling solvent from an upper side of the distillation tower and condenses the vapor of the low-boiling solvent; a first reheating line which has a first extraction pump that extracts the concentrated liquid from the distillation tower and a first heat exchanger that heats the concentrated liquid extracted by the first extraction pump without evaporating the low-boiling solvent, through which the concentrated liquid heated by the first heat exchanger is refluxed to the distillation tower; and a second reheating line which has a second extraction pump that extracts the concentrated liquid from the distillation tower and a second heat exchanger that heats the concentrated liquid extracted by the second extraction pump to evaporate the low-boiling solvent, through which the concentrated liquid condensed by the second heat exchanger and the vapor of the low-boiling solvent is refluxed to the distillation tower.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Gas adsorption separation membrane and method for producing gas adsorption separation membrane
abstract_en: To provide a gas adsorption separation membrane which can reduce energy consumption required for a gas separation process, and is excellent in gas separation performance, and a method for producing a gas adsorption separation membrane.SOLUTION: A gas adsorption separation membrane has an impermeable sheet which is spirally wound, and an ion exchange resin which is fixed to one surface or both surfaces of the impermeable sheet.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Information providing system, provided information generating device, and information providing method
abstract_en: To simplify sorting work.SOLUTION: An information providing system includes an imaging device that images one or more objects to be sorted, a provided information generating device that generates sorting information, which is information for facilitating sorting work of the one or more objects, based on image data obtained by imaging by the imaging device, and a projection device that projects the sorting information generated by the provided information generating device onto the one or more objects.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Dispenser system, test kit, and method of adding reagent using the dispenser system
abstract_en: To provide a dispenser system capable of adding a small amount of reagent for point-of-care testing (POCT).SOLUTION: A dispenser system (1) provided herein allows a reagent or sample to be introduced into an introduction section (2) having an internal space (22) facing open upper ends of capillary parts (10), and a loading section (27), loaded with a fiber product (70) capable of absorbing excess reagent or sample remaining in the internal space (22) when a reagent or sample is sucked into the capillary parts (10), is provided on the outside of the internal space (22) in the introduction section (2).SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Mixing device and mixing paddle thereof
abstract_en: To provide a mixing device capable of effectively improving the mixing and kneading effect of a slurry and changing the quality of the slurry, and a mixing paddle thereof.SOLUTION: The mixing paddle 113 includes a dispersion disk 116 including a central portion and a plurality of paddle block portions provided around the central portion, a plurality of dispersion columns 117 provided in the paddle block portions, and a guide cone 118 provided in an upper portion of the central portion and having a first discharge surface, wherein the central portion is centrosymmetric with respect to a central axis, and the paddle block portions have a positive guide surface and a negative guide surface. Wherein a guide channel is formed between a positive guide surface of one paddle block and a negative guide surface of the other paddle block, the guide channel extending obliquely in the axial direction and being open in the radial direction, so that a portion of the slurry is guided to the bottom of the dispersing disk when the dispersing disk is rotated.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9

title_en: Organic waste fermentation reduction treatment device for continuous storage of microbial medium and the organic waste fermentation reduction treatment system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a microbial medium continuous storage type organic waste reduced fermentation treatment device and to an organic waste reduced fermentation system thereof. The present invention is provided with a partition wall provided inside a stirring tank, and by installing screw conveyors on both sides of an upper side of the range that does not interfere with the rotation radius of stirring blades, the screw conveyors on both sides are operated in opposite directions, so that an organic waste that overflows beyond the rotation radius of the stirring blade is rotated through the screw conveyors on both sides to increase the stirring efficiency. In addition, instead of discharging all organic wastes, novel organic wastes are added in a state where a certain amount of agitated organic wastes (microbial medium, moisture content of 35% or less) are always kept in the stirring tank, regardless of the moisture content of the inputted organic wastes, that is, it is to ensure that stable stirring can be continuously performed no matter what state of organic waste is input.

title_en: Drying apparatus for agricultural products
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an agricultural and marine product drying apparatus for quick and quality drying of a large amount of agricultural products such as dried daikon slice, dried radish green, and chili, marine products such as seaweed and kelp, or forest products such as bracken, wild vegetable, and mushroom. According to the present invention, heat recovered during cooling for moisture removal is reused for heating, and thus heat loss minimization and energy cost reduction can be achieved. In addition, air is circulated during tornado-form rotating airflow formation in a drying chamber, and thus hot air can be passed even to corners of the agricultural or marine product in the drying chamber. In addition, the heat generated by the planar heating element on the wall is moved to the center. As a result, the quality of the dried agricultural or marine product can be kept uniform.

title_en: Method for separating isotope mixture using flexible metal organic frameworks
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for separating an isotope using a flexible metal organic framework. One aspect of the present invention provides a method for separating an isotope using a flexible metal organic framework, including the steps of: injecting two or more types of isotope molecules into a porous flexible metal organic framework; and selectively collecting some gas molecules among the isotope molecules by changing the pore size of the metal organic framework, wherein the pore size of the metal organic framework is selectively changed only for some gas molecules among the isotope molecules.

title_en: A method for preparing zinc oxide or nickel oxide powder with controlled particle size by a continuous wet process
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing zinc oxide and nickel oxide powder having a controlled particle size, and more particularly, to a method for manufacturing zinc oxide and nickel oxide having a controlled particle size through a continuous wet process from waste. The manufacturing process includes the following steps: manufacturing a nickel salt or zinc salt from industrial waste through a hydrometallurgical process; manufacturing a zinc salt powder or a nickel salt powder by performing a continuous neutralization process on the zinc salt or nickel salt; and performing a firing process on the zinc salt powder or nickel salt powder to manufacture zinc oxide or nickel oxide.

title_en: Metal surface treatment device using barrel and ultrasonic and metal surface treatment method using the same
abstract_en: The disclosed content relates to a workpiece surface treatment device using a barrel and ultrasound and a workpiece surface treatment method using the same to remove burrs formed on a workpiece (e.g., small components such as battery electrode terminals for secondary batteries) and eliminate residual foreign substances from the surface. The disclosed content is applied to the workpiece surface treatment device using a barrel and ultrasound to polish a workpiece and remove residual foreign substances. The workpiece surface treatment device comprises: a first ultrasonic washer which includes a plurality of washing tanks to remove residual oil from a workpiece; a barrel polisher, in which the workpiece and a predetermined abrasive are placed in a barrel having an openable entrance, and which polishes the workpiece through rotation; a separator which separates the workpiece and the abrasive of the mixed state polished by the barrel through vibration; a second ultrasonic washer which includes a plurality of washing tanks filled with cleaning liquid, and when the workpiece separated from the separator is put in the washing tank, induces foreign substances, which are detached from the workpiece by air bubbles generated by ultrasonic oscillation, to the surface of the cleaning liquid; a dryer which dehydrates the workpiece cleaned in the secondary ultrasonic washer by rotating the workpiece to remove moisture from the workpiece by wind supplied from a blower; trays which are individually accommodated in lattice-shaped cells to prevent overlapping between workpieces placed in the ultrasonic washer and the drier and allow cleaning liquid and wind to reach the cleaning surface of the workpieces.

title_en: Preventing fire system using infrared camera
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a fire extinguishing system using a thermal imaging camera that can effectively prevent fires by detecting fires before they spread and then immediately spraying extinguishing water. The fire extinguishing system using an infrared camera includes: first and second rails (20) (20') supported in the air by a plurality of first and second posts (10) (10') installed around a fire vulnerable source (F); first and second movers (30) (30') running along the first and second rails (20) (20'); first and second water cannons (40) (40') spraying extinguishing water at high pressure during transport; first and second fire extinguishing water supply units (50) (50') supplying extinguishing water; first and second infrared cameras (70) (70') transported while photographing the fire vulnerable source (F); first and second fire detection units (80)(80') that detect the presence and location of fire through captured infrared images; and fire linkage control unit (90) that controls the waterproof cover (40)(40').

title_en: Mobile vacuum suction dredging device
abstract_en: A transportable vacuum suction type dredging apparatus comprises: a negative pressure tank accepting the inhaled dredging material; a collecting unit in which the water is filled; a discharge pipe discharging the air to the outside of the negative pressure tank; a first three-way valve in which a route is converted according to the kind of the dredging material; a cyclone; a negative pressure pump outputting the negative pressure; a second induction pipe ejecting the air passing through the discharge pipe into the water; a third induction pipe guiding the air of the upper part of the water surface of the collecting unit to the outside of the collecting unit; a dust sensor sensing the dust concentration; a second three-way valve in which the route is converted; a bag filter guiding the air to the cyclone after purifying the air; and a bypass pipe connecting the second three-way valve and the fourth induction pipe. According to the present invention, both dry and wet dredging are possible, and foreign substances in the sucked air are completely removed during dry dredging, so the load of the back filter is small.

title_en: Apparatus for cleaning bee queen cups
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for cleaning bee queen cups. The apparatus for cleaning bee queen cups of the present invention is configured by comprising: a rod part which is detachably coupled to an external rotational force generating device forming rotational force; and a cleaning part which has the upper end coupled to the lower end of the rod part. The cleaning part has a twisted structure in which a plate-shaped member elongated in the vertical direction is twisted to form a screw.

title_en: A crushing apparatus
abstract_en: Disclosed is a grinding device including: a grinding chamber having a cylindrical structure and having an upper wall, a lower wall and a circular side wall; a grinding object supply unit for supplying a grinding object through the side wall of the grinding chamber; a compressed air supply unit for supplying jet air through the side wall of the grinding chamber; and a discharge unit connected to the center of the upper wall of the grinding chamber to discharge a ground material from the grinding chamber, wherein a space between the upper wall and the lower wall of the grinding chamber is constant from the center to an edge.

title_en: Non-heating Typed Sesame Container for Preventing Carbonization by Using Air Suction Before Stone Separating
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a non-heating type sesame storage device for preventing carbonization using air suction before stone picking. The non-heating type sesame storage device for preventing carbonization using air suction before stone picking, according to the present invention, comprises: a body part which stores sesame transferred through a specified transfer system after being roasted in a roasting pot before supplying the sesame to a stone picking device, wherein the body part stores, in an unheated state, the sesame transferred after being roasted at a specified completion temperature through the roasting pot; a suction module including a suction mesh net structure part for forcibly sucking in air between the stored sesame at a specified suction pressure so as to rapidly cool, for a predetermined time period, the sesame stored in the body part from a high temperature above a specified carbonization possible temperature in which sesame husk contained in the sesame can be carbonized to a low temperature below the carbonization possible temperature; a suction pressure unit which generates the specified suction pressure for forced suction of air between the sesame through the suction module and provides the generated suction pressure to the suction module; a discharge unit which transfers the air sucked in through the suction module and discharges the air to the outside; and a supply unit which supplies the cooled sesame to the stone picking device.

title_en: Water splitting catalyst electrode and manufacturing method for the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a water splitting catalyst electrode including porous metal foam, metal nanowires formed on the surface of the porous metal foam, and a metal double layer hydroxide formed on the surface of the metal nanowires. The present invention can reduce the overall cost of a system.

title_en: Method for preparing dry reforming catalysts by using topotactic ion exchange reaction, catalysts prepared thereby, and solid oxide fuel cell
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for preparing a catalyst for dry reforming of methane, which comprises: (a) providing a perovskite crystal structure material comprising a first transition metal and a second transition metal; and (b) depositing a precursor containing a third transition metal on the perovskite crystal structure material, wherein At least a portion of the third transition metal enters the crystal structure of the perovskite by topotactic ion exchange with the second transition metal and at least a portion of the second transition metal is eluted to form binary alloy particles of the third transition metal and the second transition metal on a surface of the crystal structure material. According to the method for preparing, a large number of catalysts for dry reforming can be easily produced with a higher individual density. The catalyst prepared according to the present invention has high catalytic activity and catalytic stability and is useful as a catalyst for producing syn gas in a dry reforming process using methane and carbon dioxide, or as a material for an anode in a solid oxide fuel cell.

title_en: Jig for blocking contaminated liquid dispersion when saniterixing stand type airconditioner
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a wastewater holding jig for cleaning a stand-type air conditioner. To prevent wastewater, which is generated during cleaning of a heavy stand-type air conditioner, from flowing onto and contaminating the floor of a house or an office, the present invention developed a wastewater holding jig for cleaning a stand-type air conditioner, which comprises: a space securing tool which includes a spacer inserted between the bottom of the stand-type air conditioner and a chassis of the bottom surface on which the stand-type air conditioner is installed, and a handle installed on the top surface of the spacer; and a secondary space securing tool which, after the space securing tool is inserted into the bottom surface of the stand-type air conditioner, is inserted from another direction under the stand-type air conditioner to secure a space between the ground and the bottom surface of an air conditioner stand. By the above development, a worker could install a wastewater scattering prevention mat regardless of the size, form, capacity, narrowness of an installation location, or irregularity of the floor.

title_en: Sterilizer apparatus with multi-channel
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a multi-channel and multi-stage sterilization device and, more specifically, to a multi-channel and multi-stage sterilization device having a concise and simple structure and capable of sterilizing fluids to be sterilized in multiple stages, sterilizing different fluids through a plurality of channels, or selectively controlling a sterilization time. The multi-channel and multi-stage sterilization device, according to the present invention, comprises: a chamber main body having an inlet and an outlet through which fluids are introduced and discharged and an accommodation space formed therein; a flow path partition means for partitioning the accommodation space into a plurality of flow paths; and a light generation unit arranged inside the chamber main body, generating sterilizing light, and irradiating the sterilizing light to the outside. The flow path partition means comprises: a plurality of connection flow path partition walls installed to be spaced apart inside the chamber main body to form flow paths connected to each other; and a channel formation partition wall installed to cross the plurality of connection flow path partition walls and partitions a channel into a plurality of channels. Each of the plurality of channels independently includes a plurality of inlets and a plurality of outlets so that the fluids are introduced and discharged therethrough.

title_en: Airless Pump Type Cosmetic Container
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an airless pump-type cosmetic container which includes: a container; a sliding plunger; a shoulder; a pump mechanism; and a button. The airless pump-type cosmetic container according to the present invention guarantees accurate pumping operation and discharge operation without using a metal spring, check valve, or check ball, and thus, useful effects that can increase the reliability of products are expected.

title_en: Substrate processing apparatus
abstract_en: A coating device includes: a stage device and a nozzle device. In the stage device, a substrate is held on a plate member. The nozzle device has a slit-shaped discharge port and is installed above the stage device. The nozzle device moves above the stage device while a coating liquid is discharged from the discharge port of the nozzle device to supply the coating liquid to the entire upper surface of the substrate. In the stage device or the nozzle device, the temperature of the coating liquid is adjusted based on the position where the coating liquid is applied to the substrate. Therefore, a coated film with improved film thickness uniformity can be formed on the substrate.

title_en: Exhaust gas treatment apparatus
abstract_en: The present invention is to improve carbon dioxide reduction performance by utilizing waste liquid treated with exhaust gas. To this end, according to an embodiment of the present invention, an exhaust gas treatment apparatus may comprise: a gas-liquid reactor which brings exhaust gas into contact with treatment liquid and absorbs the emission regulated gas contained in the exhaust gas into the treatment liquid; a treatment liquid supply tank which supplies the treatment liquid to the gas-liquid reactor; a gas-liquid separation unit which separates the emission regulated gas from the treatment liquid, which absorbs the emission regulated gas drained from the gas-liquid reactor, and regenerates the treatment liquid; and an ion separation unit which ionizes the treatment liquid regenerated in the gas-liquid separation unit and supplies the treatment liquid enriched in negative ions to the gas-liquid separation unit, and supplies the treatment liquid enriched in positive ions to the treatment liquid supply tank.

title_en: Two-axis tracking support structure of solar panel and solar power generation method using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for reducing foam from discharged water and a method for reducing foam from discharged water using the same. According to the present invention, the system for reducing foam from discharged water to reduce foam generated when discharging fluid toward an external fluid (2). The system comprises: a cylindrical main body (100) provided with an internal space (110); an inlet (120) formed on the upper part of the main body (100) and through which fluid is eccentrically introduced into the internal space (110); an outlet (130) through which the fluid in the internal space (110) is discharged to the outside; and a porous plate (200) installed between the inlet (120) and the outlet (130) according to a direction of fluid flowing in the internal space (110). Accordingly, a small-sized system capable of being applied to marine plants, etc., where large-capacity multi-stage dropping systems cannot be applied, can be implemented and the discharge speed of discharged water is minimized, thereby providing an effect of preventing the generated bubbles from being discharged together and automating removal and discharge of the generated bubbles.

title_en: Measuring apparatus of pipe forming dimension
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, an apparatus for measuring a processing dimension of a pipe comprises: a transfer unit loading and transferring a pipe for a vehicle; a gripping unit gripping the pipe supplied through the transfer unit; a loading unit receiving and accommodating the pipe gripped by the gripping unit; and a vision inspection unit positioned adjacent to an end of the pipe accommodated in the loading unit.

title_en: Electrostatic filter for pathogen inactivation, and method of fabricating the same
abstract_en: The present invention aims to provide an electrostatic filter that maintains a large area of charge and exhibits a high sterilizing effect even in high-temperature and high-humidity environments. The electrostatic filter for pathogen elimination comprises: an insulating layer on a substrate; a monolayer graphene layer on the insulating layer; and a structure that stores charge between the graphene layer and the insulating layer using a metal foil. The filter is characterized by being configured to locally store charge through a bias voltage and friction.

title_en: Polymer electrolyte membrane with improved selectivity
abstract_en: In a polymer electrolyte membrane for maximizing selectivity by lowering hydrogen gas permeability while increasing hydrogen ion conductivity, provided is a polymer electrolyte membrane in which the slope of a straight line connecting a first peak upper point (a) and a second peak upper point (b) on a curve obtained through small angle x-ray scattering (saxs) analysis for the polymer electrolyte membrane is a negative number of less than 0. According to the present invention, conditions for maximizing the selectivity of the polymer electrolyte membrane can be presented by quantifying or quantifying the relative development degree of the ion channel and the amorphous region through saxs analysis.

title_en: Apparatus for Measuring Plasma Energy based on Diamagnetic Loop having High Signal-to-Noise Ratio and Method thereof
abstract_en: Disclosed is an apparatus for measuring plasma energy based on a diamagnetic loop having a high signal-to-noise ratio. The apparatus comprises: a first cylindrical tube case surrounding plasma inside; and first two diamagnetic loops wound around the first cylindrical tube case in an azimuthal direction and measuring a magnetic flux inside the first cylindrical tube case, respectively. The apparatus further includes a second cylindrical tube case surrounding the first cylindrical tube case, and second two diamagnetic loops wound around the second cylindrical tube case in an azimuthal direction and each measuring a magnetic flux inside the second cylindrical tube case. The apparatus further includes a data collection module connected to the first two diamagnetic loops and the second two diamagnetic loops, respectively, to calculate plasma energy based on magnetic flux measured through the first two diamagnetic loops and the second two diamagnetic loops, respectively. The first two diamagnetic loops are connected to the data collection module to have opposite polarities, and the second two diamagnetic loops are also connected to the data collection module to have opposite polarities.

title_en: Manufacturing method of hollow nanoparticles and film including the hollow nanoparticles manufactured thereby
abstract_en: A method for manufacturing hollow nanoparticles according to an embodiment of the present invention includes the steps of: forming a core based on a mixed solution including a polymer and a solvent; forming a core-shell particle by forming a first shell on the core; and removing the core from the core-shell particle, wherein the solvent includes an organic solvent and water.

title_en: a spring-carrying umbrella holder that uses a spring to pluck rainwater
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a portable umbrella holder using a spring for removing rainwater, which includes: a folding/portable handle strap (1) formed of Velcro, which can be hung on a bag and is combined with the Velcro (6) described below to form the configuration shown in (4); a microfiber material (2) for absorbing water from an umbrella; an umbrella support (3) configured to support the umbrella when shaking off water therefrom by means of the elastic force of a spring (7); an overall folded portable configuration (4); a snap button (5) for opening and closing an umbrella inlet; Velcro (6) connected to the folding/portable handle strap (1) to form the overall configuration (4); a spring (7) for shaking off water from the umbrella using elastic force; and Velcro (8) for fixing and detaching the microfiber material for reuse. Accordingly, the present invention provides an effect in which rainwater on a wet umbrella can be easily removed by anyone by applying the elastic force of the spring and the frictional force of the microfiber to the umbrella. In particular, a notable aspect of the present invention is that it provides an innovative moisture removal technique utilizing the elastic force of the spring and the frictional force of the microfiber, along with enhanced portability that maximizes user convenience, thereby resolving inconveniences associated with conventional use.

title_en: Environmental protection dust recovery device for construction sites
abstract_en: The present invention discloses an environmental protection dust recovery device for construction sites, comprising a base. A wastewater treatment tank is fixedly connected above the base. One end of the wastewater treatment tank is provided with a pipeline for conveying to the inside of a spray cover plate. A dust temporary storage box is arranged below the spray cover plate. The side surface of the dust temporary storage box is fixedly connected with a filter cover frame. A cleaning strip for cleaning dust on the surface of the filter screen is arranged inside the filter cover frame. The cleaning strip is fixed on one side of an elliptical ring. The dust is first filtered by the filter screen, and then cleverly slides down along the slope below the filter screen, not only guiding the dust to quickly leave the filter screen area, but also avoiding a large accumulation of dust near the air inlet. The half-side gear rotates and sequentially meshes with the first and second racks, driving the elliptical ring to move up and down. The cleaning strip fixed on the side surface of the elliptical ring then performs periodic cleaning of the filter screen surface. The dust temporary storage box will regularly start the spraying system, which can reduce the concentration of dust dispersion and fundamentally reduce the possibility of explosions caused by ignition sources.

title_en: A natural gas hydrate experimental mixing tank and a method for storing natural gas hydrate
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a mixing tank for natural gas hydrate experiments and a method for storing natural gas hydrates, relating to the technical field of hydrates. The present invention includes a hydrate mixing tank body, inside which a first stirring roller is rotatably fitted, and two second stirring rollers are rotatably and slidably fitted inside the hydrate mixing tank body, with the two second stirring rollers located on either side of the first stirring roller; a motor connected to the first stirring roller is installed on the upper side of the hydrate mixing tank body. The present invention, through the arranged reciprocating assembly, can drive the two second stirring rollers to rotate while the motor starts and drives the first stirring roller to rotate. The motor also drives the reciprocating assembly to operate through a transmission assembly, enabling the two second stirring rollers to rotate inside the hydrate mixing tank body while moving up and down reciprocally, thereby thoroughly mixing the hydrate powder and other substances inside the hydrate mixing tank body.

title_en: Device, system and method for direct electrical measurement of enzyme activity.
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a device, system and method for sensing functional motions of a single protein molecule via direct attachment of one or more electrodes to the molecule. The present disclosure also relates to an array, a system comprising an array and method for sequencing a biopolymer using an array.

title_en: Portable system for the production of oxygen.
abstract_en: A portable oxygen generating system is provided that comprises a reaction chamber, a feed system for providing and controlling hydrogen peroxide solution to the reaction chamber, and a cooling/condensing system for cooling the hot oxygen and water vapor leaving the reactor and condensing and removing water. The portable chemical oxygen generation system produces humidified, breathable oxygen, that is substantially free of hydrogen peroxide and other contaminants, at a controlled flow and temperature over an extended period of time.

title_en: Pressing pump capable of preventing actuator from being rotatably unlocked
abstract_en: Disclosed in the present invention is a pressing pump capable of preventing an actuator from being rotatably unlocked. The pressing pump comprises: a body, wherein a floating member capable of moving up and down is provided in the body, and the floating member has a first height position and a second height position relative to the body; a pump core assembly, movably arranged on the floating member, wherein the upper end of the pump core assembly is connected to the actuator extending out of the body; elastic members, provided between the floating member and the actuator and used for driving the actuator to extend upwards; and a linkage locking mechanism, provided between the body and the floating member and capable of stabilizing the floating member at the first height position or the second height position. When the pressing pump is transported or stored, the floating member is located at the first height position, the actuator can only idle when rotated and does not have a downward travel position when pressed, thereby avoiding liquid overflow; and when liquid discharge is required, the linkage locking mechanism drives the floating member to switch to the second height position, the pump core assembly and the actuator move upwards by a certain distance along with the floating member, and the actuator can move downwards relative to the floating member and the body to achieve liquid discharge.

title_en: Irrigation apparatus for restoring herbaceous vegetation in mine wasteland
abstract_en: The present utility model discloses an irrigation apparatus for restoring herbaceous vegetation in mine wasteland. The irrigation apparatus includes an irrigation apparatus 5 body, a base, a square block, a positioning groove and a positioning block. The base is arranged at the bottom of the irrigation apparatus body, a side of the square block close to the base is ﬁxedly connected with the base, the positioning groove is formed in the top of the square block, and the positioning block is arranged in an inner cavity of the positioning groove. Through the cooperation among the irrigation apparatus body, the base, the square 10 block, the positioning groove, the positioning block, a square groove and a ﬁxing mechanism, high convenience in use is realized, and the following problem is solved: in an existing irrigation apparatus for restoring herbaceous vegetation, since a sprinkler head is equipped with no anti-sliding apparatus, the sprinkler head will inevitably become loose after long-term use and will drop when used again, so that the user needs to perform 15 secondary assembly, causing waste of user's time and unnecessary troubles to the user.

title_en: Method and apparatus for reducing sodium content in cultivation water for plants and cultivation system comprising said apparatus
abstract_en: A method is presented for reducing sodium content of cultivation water for plants. This method comprising the steps of: contacting cultivation water with a nanofiltration membrane configured to soften water, resulting in a retentate E and a filtrate F which respectively have an increased and a decreased concentration ratio of divalent cations versus monovalent cations compared to the cultivation water; contacting the filtrate F with a cation exchange resin configured to capture at least sodium ions, resulting in an effluent F*; contacting an aqueous solution 8 with the cation exchange resin to remove sodium ions from the cation exchange resin, resulting in an effluent 8* comprising sodium ions, the aqueous solution 8 comprising cations not being sodium ions and anions soluble in water with the cations; discharging the effluent 8*; contacting an aqueous solution R with the cation exchange resin to regenerate the cation exchange resin, resulting in an effluent R*, the aqueous solution R comprising an acid; and recirculating at least one of the retentate E, the effluent F* and the effluent R* for use for plants. Further, an apparatus suitable for implementing said method is presented as well as a cultivation system for plants comprising said apparatus.

title_en: Method for obtaining a CH4-enriched gas fraction
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for obtaining a CH4-enriched gas fraction from a gas mixture comprising C02 and CH4, an aluminum phyllosilicate material for use in the 5 same, and an adsorbent comprising the aluminum phyllosilicate material. The aluminum phyllosilicate material is characterized by the intercalating moieties and basal spacing, allowing the selectivity in adsorption. 36

title_en: Method for drying the inner surfaces of shell apparatuses
abstract_en:
FIELD: drying. 
     SUBSTANCE: invention relates to the technology for drying cavities of various shell equipment and can be used in power engineering, the chemical, petroleum, gas, petroleum and gas processing, and other industries. A method for drying the cavity of shell apparatuses, based on simultaneous evacuation of each individual cavity, characterised by the fact that in order to ensure heat supply, UHF emission is supplied to each cavity, used to heat and evaporates the water remaining in the cavity, wherein the frequency and power of UHF emission are determined based on the parameters of the cavity according to the calculating formulas of the UHF energy absorbed by water until the predetermined value of the residual humidity of the pumped air is reached. 
     EFFECT: reduction in the energy intensity and reduction in the duration of drying of the apparatus. 
     2 cl, 2 dwg

title_en: Active carbon for adsorbing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl compounds in water sample
abstract_en: To provide: an active carbon for adsorbing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl compounds in a water sample, said active carbon having a high collection rate of water-sample-borne perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl compounds; and a filter body using the active carbon. The present active carbon for adsorbing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl compounds in a water sample comprises an active carbon adsorbent wherein: the BET specific surface area is 800 m2/g or greater or the surface oxide content is 0.20 meq/g or less, or the BET specific surface area is 800 m2/g or greater and the surface oxide content is 0.50 meq/g or less; and the sum (Vmic) of 1 nm-or-less micropore volumes thereof is 0.30 cm3/g or greater. Said active carbon is for adsorbing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl compounds in a water sample such that it is possible to desorb said compounds.

title_en: Method of fabricating high-efficiency composite photoelectrode of sol-gel metal oxide
abstract_en: A method is provided for fabricating a photocatalyst-composite-film electrode. The electrode is used in producing hydrogen through a photoelectrochemical reaction or is used in a fuel reactor. Therein, the present invention can be applied to produce fuel; an anode layer is fabricated to be used in a photoelectrochemical reactor for producing hydrogen; the anode layer is made of sol-gel; and the sol-gel is a photocatalyst slurry of titanium oxide, which has nano-scale particles of a uniform size. Thus, a photocatalyst-nanotube-film electrode is fabricated. The electrode comprises a carbonaceous or conductively supported electrode substrate (titanium foil); and a photocatalyst layer of titanium oxide coated on the carbonaceous or conductively supported electrode substrate. Meanwhile, the titanium-oxide photocatalyst layer contained within is made by uniformly coating a mixed photocatalyst slurry on the electrode substrate. The slurry is made of a nano-scale photocatalyst powder, a water-soluble surfactant, an ion binder, and a conductive carbon powder. In this way, the photocatalyst, originally hard to be coated and adhered, can be made into an electrode to be used in a photoelectrochemical reactor. The electrode photocatalyst layer is easily fabricated and is adjustable. The light conversion efficiency and the application effectiveness are further improved.

title_en: Debris collection device
abstract_en: A debris collection device is disposed between a panel cutting machine and a vacuum cleaner, and includes a box, a debris collection case and a filter. The box has a first opening connected to the panel cutting machine and a second opening connected to the vacuum cleaner. The debris collection case is disposed in the box and located below the first opening. The filter is disposed in the box body and is close to the second opening. When the vacuum cleaner sucks panel dusts from the panel cutting machine, the filter blocks debris mixed in the panel dust and makes the debris fall into the debris collection case. The debris collection device of the present invention is able to directly separate the debris from the dust while the vacuum cleaner is working.

title_en: Glass cloth, prepregs, and printed circuit boards Capable of imparting a prepreg excellent in insulation reliability, and a prepreg and a printed circuit board using the low-dielectric glass cloth
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide a low-dielectric glass cloth capable of imparting a prepreg excellent in insulation reliability, and a prepreg and a printed circuit board using the low-dielectric glass cloth. The glass cloth of the present invention is composed of glass yarns containing a plurality of glass filaments as warps and wefts, and in the following formula (1), the weight reduction ratio derived from the glass component in the heat treatment at 380DEG C. for 2 hours The weight reduction coefficient obtained by multiplying the product with the average radius of the glass monofilament is 0.38 or more and 0.9 or less, and the whiteness is 95 or more. Weight reduction factor = the above weight reduction ratio (%) * the average radius of the above glass filaments ([mu]m)...(1).

title_en: Faucet
abstract_en: A faucet (100) includes a base (10), an outlet pipe (20), and an ultrasonic generator (30). The base (10) has a receiving groove (11), wherein the receiving groove (11) has an opening formed on an outer surface of the base (10). The outlet pipe (20) is engaged with the base (10), and the outlet pipe (20) has an inlet end (20a) and an outlet end (20b). The ultrasonic generator (30) is detachably disposed in the receiving groove (11) and could be taken out via the opening. The engaging structure of the ultrasonic generator (30) and the base (10) of the faucet of the present invention could facilitate the storage of the ultrasonic generator (30) and increase the convenience of using the ultrasonic generator (30).

title_en: Electrostatic precipitator, flashover detection circuit, flashover monitoring method, computer program product, and computer readable medium
abstract_en: An electrostatic precipitator, flashover detection circuit, flashover warning method, computer program product, and computer readable medium are disclosed. The flashover detection circuit includes a voltage dividing module, a current amplifier, a rectifier, a reference voltage generator, a comparator, and a post-processing unit. The voltage dividing module is electrically connected to a high-voltage generator. The current amplifier is electrically connected to the voltage dividing module. The rectifier is electrically connected to the current amplifier. The reference voltage generator is electrically connected to the rectifier. The comparator is electrically connected to the current amplifier, the rectifier, the reference voltage generator, and the post-processing unit. Thus, the flashover detection circuit can provide a flashover frequency according to dust electrical characteristics.

title_en: Nitrogen doping agent feeding device and method and manufacturing system of nitrogen-doped single crystal silicon rod
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a nitrogen doping agent feeding device and method and a manufacturing system of a nitrogen-doped single crystal silicon rod. The nitrogen doping agent feeding device comprises a bearing pipe with an opening formed in the bottom, wherein the bearing pipe is used for bearing silicon nitride to be molten; a heating device which surrounds the outer side of the bearing pipe and is used for heating the silicon nitride to be molten to enable the silicon nitride to be molten to be completely molten into a silicon nitride melt; a blocking device which is arranged in the bearing tube and can be attached to the bottom of the bearing tube to shield the opening, so that the silicon nitride to be molten is prevented from falling into the quartz crucible from the opening; a gap can be formed between the blocking device and the bottom of the bearing pipe to open the opening, so that the silicon nitride melt drops into the quartz crucible bearing the silicon melt containing boron atoms from the opening; and a lifting mechanism which is used for lifting or descending the blocking device.

title_en: Production of hydrogen and lithium hydroxide in basic media
abstract_en: The invention relates to the electrochemical production of hydrogen and lithium hydroxide from Li+-containing water with the aid of an LiSICon membrane. It addresses the problem of specifying a process that can be operated economically on an industrial scale too. In particular, the process should have good energy efficiency and achieve a high membrane lifetime even when the employed feed contains impurities that are harmful to LiSICon materials. A particular aspect of the process is that the selective separation of lithium by the membrane and an electrolysis of water take place simultaneously in the cell. A key aspect of the process is that the electrochemical process is carried out in basic media, more precisely at pH 9 to 13. The pH is adjusted by adding a basic compound to the feed.

title_en: Quantum chemical high-energy molecular water-tight cement manufacturing method
abstract_en: The present invention provides a quantum chemical high-energy molecular water-tight cement manufacturing method, which includes carbonizing and ionizing organic matter to obtain a carbon particle and then micronizing the carbon particle to make the particle size consistent, the carbon particle and After the water is treated by an electromagnetic kinetic energy device, quantum carbon particles and high-oxygen water are formed. Quantum carbon particles, high-oxygen water and Portland cement are mixed and stirred to obtain quantum chemical high-energy molecular water-tight cement. The cement can increase the corrosion resistance and durability of concrete, greatly enhance the waterproof function of cement, significantly reduce the water consumption of concrete and improve water tightness and concrete strength.

title_en: Plasma generating method
abstract_en: In a method of an embodiment, radio-frequency power is supplied to an electrode via a matching device from a radio-frequency power supply in order to generate plasma within a chamber. During the supply of the radio-frequency power, it is determined whether or not plasma is generated within the chamber from one or more parameters reflecting plasma generation within the chamber. When it is determined that plasma is not generated, a frequency of the radio-frequency power output from the radio-frequency power supply is adjusted to set the load side reactance of the radio-frequency power supply to zero or to bring the load side reactance close to zero.

title_en: Precursor delivery systems, precursor supply packages, and related methods
abstract_en: Some embodiments relate to precursor delivery systems for producing gas precursors. The precursor delivery system may include one or more precursor supply packages containing a solid precursor material. The one or more precursor supply packages may be configured to heat the solid precursor material to a temperature sufficient to result in thermal decomposition of the solid precursor material. The thermal decomposition of the solid precursor material may produce a gas precursor. The gas precursor may be supplied to a gas precursor-utilizing process. Further embodiments relate to precursor supply packages and related methods.

title_en: Micro bubbles device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a microbubble machine, including: a pump, including a water inlet pipeline and a water outlet pipeline; and a microbubble device, connected to the water inlet pipeline, including an axial hole and an air inlet channel, the axial hole including an inlet and an outlet, and a port of the air inlet channel connected to the axial hole between the inlet and the outlet. Thereby, regardless of whether the water outlet pipeline is additionally connected to a nozzle (or other spraying device) or whether the water outlet is reduced, the gas (such as oxygen, ozone, air or other gas) will not be affected by the pressure change (back pressure) in the water outlet pipeline, and can effectively and smoothly enter the axial hole from the air inlet channel, and the gas can be fully and evenly mixed in the liquid.

title_en: Controlling wetting for magnetohydrodynamic metal manufacturing
abstract_en: Devices, systems, and methods are directed to applying magnetohydrodynamic forces to liquid metal to eject liquid metal along a controlled pattern, such as a controlled three-dimensional pattern as part of additive manufacturing of an object. Nozzles associated with these devices, systems, and methods include one or more non-wetting surfaces in the vicinity of a discharge orifice of the nozzle. Such non-wetting surfaces can reduce the likelihood that wetting of the liquid metal in the vicinity of a discharge orifice of a nozzle will interfere with ejection of liquid metal droplets from the discharge orifice and, thus, can facilitate delivering droplets with accuracy suitable for commercially viable manufacturing using liquid metal to fabricate objects.

title_en: Method for sample separation and collection
abstract_en: A centrifuge device and method for use are presented. The centrifuge device includes a housing, a chamber, a channel, and a cover. The housing includes a first port and a vent opening and is designed to rotate about an axis passing through a center of the housing. The chamber is defined within the housing and is coupled to the first port. A first portion of the chamber has a width that tapers between a first width at a first position and a second width at a second position within the chamber, the first width being greater than the second width. The channel is coupled to the second position of the chamber and arranged such that a path exists for gas to travel from the channel to the vent opening. The cover provides a wall that seals the chamber.

title_en: Digital sampling to control resonator frequency and phase in a LINAC
abstract_en: A system for measuring and controlling the phase of an incoming analog waveform is disclosed. The system comprises an analog to digital converter to convert the incoming analog waveform to a digital representation. The system also includes a clock delay generator, which allows a programmable amount of delay to be introduced into the sample clock for the ADC. The system further comprises a controller to manipulate the delay used by the clock delay generator and store the outputs from the ADC. The controller can then use the digitized representation to determine the frequency of the incoming analog waveform, its phase drift and its phase relative to a master clock. The controller can then modify the output of a RF generator in response to these determinations.

title_en: Linear vibration motor having elastic pieces provided with vibration arms
abstract_en: A linear vibration motor having elastic pieces provided with vibration arms comprises housing, a mass block, and elastic pieces. The elastic pieces connect the mass block and the housing to provide an elastic force in Z axis direction such that the mass block performs a movement up and down. The elastic pieces are provided with two vibration arms, and the two vibration arms are symmetrical about the X axis when rotating 180 degrees around the X axis. The elastic pieces are S-shaped or inverted Z-shaped, or formed by the combination of two V-shaped vibration arms. The elastic pieces have two or four elastic pieces, and disposed on symmetrical two sides of the mass block.

title_en: Method and system for control of pressure washer functions
abstract_en: Methods and systems for controlling pressure washer devices are provided. Pressure washers comprising at least one control unit and the ability to regulate functions of at least an engine of a pressure washer are disclosed. A control unit receives inputs from a user or various sensors provided in communication with the control unit, and is further capable of outputting a signal based on the inputs, the output signal operative to maintain or control the operating functions of an engine, pump, or motor.

title_en: Fluid separating element and telescoping prevention plate
abstract_en: This fluid separating element comprises: a spiral wound body formed by winding a separating membrane and a raw water flow passage material in a spiral shape; an outside shell provided on an outer periphery of the spiral wound body; and telescoping prevention plates provided at both ends of the spiral wound body and the outside shell, wherein the telescoping prevention plate comprises at least a second annular portion capable of holding the outside shell, and a third annular portion which is formed on an axially outer side of the second annular portion and comprises an annulus having a greater outer diameter than that of the second annular portion, and at least one depression is provided in a side surface on the spiral wound body side of the third annular portion.

title_en: Metal-loaded zeolite catalysts for the halogen-free conversion of dimethyl ether to methyl acetate
abstract_en: A catalyst for the carbonylation of dimethyl ether to methyl acetate. The catalyst comprises a zeolite, such as a mordenite zeolite, at least one Group IB metal, such as copper, and/or at least one Group VIII metal, such as iron, and at least one Group IIB metal, such as zinc. Such a catalyst with combined metals provides enhanced catalytic activity, improved stability, and improved selectivity to methyl acetate, and does not require a halogen promoter, as compared to a metal-free or copper only zeolite.

title_en: Component of a device, a device, and a method for purifying and testing biomolecules from biological samples
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to, inter alia, an easy-to-operate, fully closed component, which can be part of an instrument, for purification of biomolecules from biological samples, and subsequent transfer, and testing of the biomolecules, as well as an instrument comprising the component, and a method for using the component.

title_en: System for the production of carbon nanotubes from carbon matter, preferably, plastic waste and solar energy; method of production
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for the production of carbon nanotubes from carbonaceous matter, preferably, plastic waste and solar energy; Method of production.

title_en: Catalyst for converting alkylaromatic hydrocarbon and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: Disclosed are a bifunctional catalyst and a preparation method therefor, the bifunctional catalyst being suitable to produce high-value aromatic hydrocarbons by subjecting alkylaromatic hydrocarbons to a disproportionation/transalkylation/dealkylation reaction while suppressing aromatic loss or subjecting C8 aromatic hydrocarbons to an isomerization reaction while suppressing xylene loss.

title_en: Methods and devices for separation of blood components
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to methods and devices for the separation of blood components including separation by rapid sedimentation, including in an automated fashion.

title_en: Method and system for detecting target components by utilizing mobile terminal
abstract_en: A method and system for detecting a target component by using a mobile terminal, and a detection method for simultaneously screening multiple target objects. The method for detecting a target component by using a mobile terminal comprises: detecting a target component by using test strips ( 100 ) to obtain chromogenic test strips ( 100 ); arranging the test strips ( 100 ) around a same circle center at equal angles to obtain an arrangement ring of test strips ( 100 ), positioning identifiers being provided on an area outside the test strips ( 100 ) on the arrangement ring of the test strips ( 100 ); performing image acquisition on the arrangement ring of the test strips ( 100 ) by using a mobile terminal, and uploading an acquired image to a data processing center, correcting the acquired image according to the positioning identifiers; determining the positions of a personalized mark area and a result display area of each test strip ( 100 ) in the image; performing segmentation to obtain images of the personalized mark area and the result display area of each test strip ( 100 ); calculating a chromogenic result of the result display area, and obtaining a test result of the target component; and outputting the test result of the target component and displaying the test result on the mobile terminal.

title_en: Non-discharge backwash filter system
abstract_en: A backwash filtration system comprising a backwash discharge port, a sedimentation collection and separation system, and a final filtration chamber. The backwash discharge port is coupled with a pool filter system and is configured to pass backwashed water from the pool filter system to the sedimentation collection and separation system. The sedimentation collection and separation system has a plurality of sedimentation chambers that are vertically stacked and a plurality of baffles configured to reduce the migration of sediment within the sedimentation chambers. A path for water flow passes down sequentially through each of the sedimentation chambers. The final filtration chamber receives the backwashed water from the sedimentation collection and separation system, filters the backwashed water through a final filtration medium, and passes the filtered water to a water return line of the pool filter system or to a pool of water.

title_en: Pellet grill
abstract_en: A solid pellet fueled apparatus having a duel auger system and multi/high speed auger motor is disclosed. The duel auger may include first and second auger blades mounted on a single auger shaft having blade pitches configured to convey solid fuel in opposite directions towards a central burn pot. Each auger blade may service a separate solid fuel compartment provided in a single hopper. The auger motor may have a high-speed setting that may be selected for solid fuel clean out.

title_en: Ultrafine bubble generating method, ultrafine bubble-containing liquid manufacturing apparatus and manufacturing method, and ultrafine bubble-containing liquid
abstract_en: Ultrafine bubbles with a diameter of less than 1.0 μm are generated in liquid by causing film boiling in liquid by means of a heater.

title_en: Oxidation catalyst for a compression ignition engine
abstract_en: An oxidation catalyst for treating an exhaust gas from a compression ignition engine, which oxidation catalyst comprises: a substrate; a first washcoat region comprising palladium (Pd) and a first support material comprising cerium oxide; and a second washcoat region comprising platinum (Pt) and a second support material.

title_en: Palladium fixing and low fresh oxygen storage capacity using tannic acid as a complexing and reducing agent
abstract_en: A method of manufacturing a catalyst article, the method comprising: providing a complex of a polyphenol and a PGM, the polyphenol comprising an ester functional group, the PGM comprising palladium; providing a support material; applying the complex to the support material to form a loaded support material; disposing the loaded support material on a substrate; and heating the loaded support material to form nanoparticles of the PGM on the support material.

title_en: Packing material and method for producing the same, and column for size exclusion chromatography
abstract_en: A packing material, wherein to a porous organic polymer carrier including 60 to 95 mol % of a repeating unit derived from glycidyl methacrylate and 5 to 40 mol % of a repeating unit derived from a polyfunctional monomer, one end of at least one alkylene group selected from a linear alkylene group, a cycloalkylene group, and a linear alkylcycloalkylene group, having 4 to 9 carbon atoms is bonded by a glycidyl group derived from glycidyl methacrylate, and an other end of the alkylene group is bonded to any one end of a polyol via an ether bond.

title_en: Process and system for catalytic cracking of hydrocarbon oils
abstract_en: A process for catalytic cracking of hydrocarbon oils includes the step of contacting a hydrocarbon oil feedstock with a catalytic cracking catalyst in a reactor comprising a dilute-phase transport fluidized bed and a fast fluidized bed connected in series for reaction. In the fast fluidized bed, the axial solid fraction ε of the catalyst is controlled within the range of about 0.1 to about 0.2. When used for catalytic cracking of hydrocarbon oil feedstocks, particularly heavy feedstock oils, the process and system show lower yields of dry gas and coke, and good product distribution.

title_en: Plasma processing apparatus and plasma processing method
abstract_en: There is provided a plasma processing apparatus including: a chamber having a processing space in which a plasma processing is performed on a substrate and a synthetic space in which electromagnetic waves are synthesized; a dielectric window configured to partition the processing space and the synthetic space; an antenna unit including a plurality of antennas configured to radiate the electromagnetic waves to the synthetic space; an electromagnetic wave output part configured to output the electromagnetic waves to the antenna unit; and a controller configured to control the antenna unit to function as the phased array antenna, wherein the plurality of antennas are helical antennas.

title_en: Nanoparticles of co complexes of zero-valent metals that can be used as hydrosilylation and dehydrogenative silylation catalysts
abstract_en: Nanoparticles that can be used as hydrosilylation and dehydrogenative silylation catalysts. The nanoparticles have at least one transition metal with an oxidation state of 0, chosen from the metals of columns 8, 9 and 10 of the periodic table, and at least one carbonyl ligand, preferably a silicide.

title_en: Multi-path cooling system and cooling system for eco-friendly vehicle applying the same
abstract_en: A multi path cooling system is provided that includes a first cooling path in which a refrigerant is circulated by a first pump and a second cooling path in which the refrigerant is circulated by a second pump. A reservoir tank is provided through which the refrigerant circulating through the first cooling path enters or exits. An air separator is disposed on the second cooling path to separate air from the passing refrigerant when the refrigerant circulating through the second cooling path passes. The reservoir tank and the air separator communicate with each other.

title_en: Apparatuses for purification of gel droplets supporting biological tissue
abstract_en: Method and apparatuses for forming gel droplets including biological tissue (e.g., cells), and in particular, methods and apparatuses for removing oil from the gel droplets comprising dissociated cells (including micro-organospheres) are described herein. Although it is beneficial to use oil in the formation of these gel droplets, and particularly micro-organospheres, oil may inhibit growth and survival of the cells within the gel droplets. The methods and apparatuses described herein may permit the removal of oil and may enhance survival and quality of the resulting gel droplets.

title_en: Graphene-based dielectrophoresis sensor and method
abstract_en: A dielectrophoretic (DEP) sensor includes a graphene electrode adjacent a channel for confining a target particle in a liquid, a surface probe attached to a surface of the graphene electrode, the surface probe having a selective reaction with the target particle, and a voltage source electrically connected to the graphene electrode and configured to apply a voltage to the graphene electrode to cause DEP trapping of the target particle at the graphene electrode.

title_en: Sample transfer device
abstract_en: A device for collecting and transferring liquid samples having a detachable sample collecting portion includes an elongated body with a liquid collecting portion disposed at one end and a handling portion disposed at the other end separated by a frangible portion. The sample collecting portion includes an inner surface configured to be wetted by the sample. After collection, the sample is transferred into a separate housing by inserting the sample collecting portion filled with sample into a confining cavity and subsequently breaking the sample transfer device along the frangible portion. The liquid sample is extracted from the collecting portion using known means to drive and control flow in fluidic devices including rotation, capillary pressure or pneumatics. The separate housing may be part of a device capable to process the liquid sample to provide for a system for handling liquid samples.

title_en: Refractory filter
abstract_en: A refractory filter suitable for filtering molten metal, such as steel, and a method and powdered composition for producing the filter. The filter comprises refractory material, the refractory material comprising: 60-90 wt % alumina; 8-30 wt % zirconia; and 3-20 wt % magnesia. The powdered composition comprises: 60-90 wt % alumina; 8-30 wt % zirconia; and 3-20 wt % magnesia, wherein the powdered composition comprises less than 12.5 wt % reactive alumina, calcined alumina or a mixture thereof, and wherein the remainder of the alumina is tabular alumina. The method comprises: providing a powdered composition in accordance with the invention; forming a filter precursor from the powdered composition and a liquid component; and firing the filter precursor to form a refractory filter.

title_en: Scaling-resistant and yellowing-resistant reverse osmosis composite membrane and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a scaling-resistant and yellowing-resistant composite reverse osmosis membrane and a preparation method thereof. By modifying the stability and yellowing of a coating of the reverse osmosis membrane, and grafting 2-(methacryloyloxy)ethyl)dimethyl-3-sulphoproyl) ammonium hydroxide (MEDSAH) and ethylene glycol methacrylate (EGMA) as amphoteric monomers and N-(isobutoxymethyl)acrylamide (IBMA) as yellowing-resistant particles on a surface of the reverse osmosis membrane using active polymerization, the present disclosure forms a three-network high-performance PMEDSAH/PEGMA/PIBMA composite coating. By active regulation of a polyamide (PA) layer through the three systems, the reverse osmosis membrane has high compatibility due to PMEDSAH, and stability, high hydrophilicity and anti-protein fouling property due to PEGMA, as well as yellowing-resistant property by coating PIBMA on the surface. The test results show that the reverse osmosis membrane prepared by the present disclosure has excellent stability and yellowing-resistant property. And the flux and salt rejection are also higher than those of the existing reverse osmosis membranes.

title_en: Methods and apparatuses for drying electronic devices
abstract_en: Methods and apparatuses for drying electronic devices are disclosed. An exemplary method comprises: initiating a drying operation in a drying apparatus comprising: generating a first air flow through a first air channel, routing, a moisture from an electronic device to a moisture-absorbing apparatus, absorbing, using the moisture-absorbing apparatus, the moisture from the electronic device, determining a first humidity and a second humidity, executing, based on the first humidity and the second humidity, a first computing operation, exhausting the first air flow to an exterior of the drying apparatus, determining a third humidity, and executing, based on the third humidity, a second computing operation.

title_en: Reactor sparger assembly
abstract_en: A reactor system includes a reactor vessel configured to contain a process fluid, and a sparger assembly that operably coupled to the reactor vessel and configured to supply a mixture of a gas and a recirculated process fluid to the reactor vessel. The sparger assembly includes a plurality of sparger chambers. Each sparger chamber includes a process fluid conduit fluidly coupled to a process fluid return of the reactor vessel via a process fluid inlet, wherein the process fluid inlet has a first block and bleed valve assembly. Each sparger chamber includes a sparger conduit fluidly coupled to the process fluid conduit and a sparger disposed within the sparger conduit and fluidly coupled to a gas source via a gas inlet. Each sparger chamber also includes a process fluid-gas mixture outlet that fluidly couples the sparger conduit to a sparger outlet of the reactor vessel.

title_en: Methods and systems of clean-up for a fracturing fluid
abstract_en: Methods and systems are disclosed herein. A method may include emulsifying a first emulsion, wherein the first emulsion includes a first aqueous phase, a first hydrocarbon phase, and a first surfactant. The method may include pumping the first emulsion into the subterranean region of interest. The method may include emulsifying a second emulsion, wherein the second emulsion includes a second aqueous phase, a second hydrocarbon phase, and a second surfactant. The method may include pumping the second emulsion into the subterranean region of interest after a pre-determined time, wherein heat and a gas are generated from a reaction of mixing the first emulsion and the second emulsion, wherein the first emulsion is destabilized by the heat of the reaction, and wherein the gas reduces hydrostatic pressure to facilitate flowback of the first emulsion.

title_en: Rack for surgical instrument cleaning
