abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid evaporation system for high-salinity wastewater, which comprises a feeding pump, an electromagnetic processor, an ultrasonic atomizer, an ultrasonic short-range evaporation chamber, a steam-water and material separator, an air dehumidifier, a dry air conveyor, an ultrasonic spiral guide plate and a slag extractor, wherein the feeding pump is connected with the electromagnetic processor; the ultrasonic spiral guide plate comprises a spiral guide plate and a first ultrasonic transducer, the spiral guide plate is arranged in the middle of the ultrasonic short-distance evaporation chamber, and the first ultrasonic transducer is arranged on the outer wall of the ultrasonic short-distance evaporation chamber and connected with the spiral guide plate; the electromagnetic processor is arranged above the spiral guide plate and comprises a titanium alloy pipeline which is longitudinally arranged. Correspondingly, the invention also provides a rapid evaporation method for the high-salinity wastewater. The invention can overcome the problems of poor fluidity and easy scaling of the high-salinity wastewater, continuously and efficiently dry the high-salinity wastewater to the moisture content suitable for combustion treatment at one time, and thoroughly eliminate the harm of the high-salinity wastewater.

title_en: Solid-liquid separation system for animal manure
abstract_en: A solid-liquid separation system for animal manure belongs to poultry equipment field. The invention comprises a filtering device and a drying device; the filtering device comprises a hollowed-out guide frame, a filtering disc in transmission connection with the hollowed-out guide frame, a plurality of sprayers arranged above the hollowed-out guide frame and a water collecting tank arranged below the hollowed-out guide frame; the hollowed-out guide frame is divided into a front bracket, a middle bracket and a rear bracket; the front bracket and the rear bracket are both horizontally arranged, and the setting height of the front bracket is higher than that of the rear bracket; the middle bracket is obliquely connected with the front bracket and the rear bracket; the plurality of sprayers are arranged above the front support, and a vibrating screen disc and a vibrator are arranged at the bottom of the rear support; and the animal manure is filtered by the filtering device and then dried by the drying device. According to the invention, 80% -90% of liquid feces mixed in animal solid feces are separated in a flushing and filtering mode; and then, drying is utilized to evaporate the residual 10% -20% of liquid manure in the animal solid manure, so that the environment of a farm is improved, and the emission of harmful gases is reduced.

title_en: Quick detach formula is collected dust collector fast
abstract_en: The application discloses a quick-dismantling type quick collecting and dedusting device, which comprises a dedusting box, a collecting box and a lifting device, wherein the periphery of the dedusting box is supported by supporting legs, the collecting box is detachably sleeved outside the lower end of the dedusting box, and the lifting device is positioned below the collecting box and used for lifting the collecting box to be sleeved with the dedusting box; the collecting box is sleeved with a dust collecting bag with the edge exposed out of the dust removing box. The detachable collecting box is arranged below the dust removing device, powder of the dust removing box can be collected in an express way, the sealing performance is good, and secondary pollution and dust overflow caused when the dust removing box discharges dust are completely avoided.

title_en: Pickling waste liquid treatment and resource utilization device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pickling waste liquid treatment and resource utilization device and a pickling waste liquid treatment and resource utilization method. Because the COD content of the pickling waste liquid is high, the conventional oxidation method is not easy to treat the pickling waste liquid to be qualified. The method comprises the steps of conveying pickling waste liquid in a waste liquid tank to a waste liquid tank by using a submersible pump, and enabling the pickling waste liquid to sequentially flow through a self-cleaning filter, an ultrafiltration membrane group and a reverse osmosis membrane group; the concentrated water obtained after concentration by the reverse osmosis membrane group is discharged to a concentrated water tank, is fed into a waste liquid tank again after iron removal treatment, then passes through the ultrafiltration membrane group and the reverse osmosis membrane group, is discharged to a concentrated water tank, and then enters a drying crystallizer to produce crystalline salt for recycling, and fresh water obtained after concentration by the reverse osmosis membrane group is recycled; and (5) adding the medicament into the concentrated water tank through a medicament adding device. The invention realizes the treatment and resource utilization of the pickling waste liquid, has less consumption of chemical agents and less solid sediment, and generates certain economic and environmental benefits.

title_en: Method for realizing partial shortcut nitrification-Anammox/denitrification of sewage by utilizing sludge fermentation product
abstract_en: A method for realizing partial short-cut nitrification-Anammox/denitrification of sewage by utilizing sludge fermentation products belongs to the field of sewage sludge treatment. The device includes: raw water tank, SBR reactor, sludge fermentation storage tank, surplus sludge fermentation tank. The method comprises the following steps: the residual sludge fermentation product and the domestic sewage are mixed for treatment, and the sludge fermentation product is utilized to inhibit nitrite oxidizing bacteria far more than ammonia oxidizing bacteria so as to realize short-cut nitrification. Specifically, phosphorus is released by anaerobic section phosphorus accumulating bacteria by using sludge fermentation products and a carbon source in raw water, an internal carbon source is stored, partial shortcut nitrification is realized by DO and pH real-time control in an aerobic section, ammonia nitrogen and nitrite nitrogen are converted into nitrogen and nitrate nitrogen by anaerobic ammonia oxidizing bacteria in an anoxic stage, and residual nitrite nitrogen and generated nitrate nitrogen are reduced into nitrogen by heterotrophic bacteria by using the internal carbon source. The invention not only saves the aeration quantity, but also realizes the deep denitrification of the domestic sewage with low C/N ratio and the reduction of exogenous sludge.

title_en: Special miniature extinguishing device of new energy automobile
abstract_en: The invention discloses a special miniature fire extinguishing device for a new energy automobile, which comprises an outer shell, an inner cavity, pressure relief devices, a monitoring module and a fire extinguishing agent transition pipe, wherein the inner cavity is positioned inside the outer shell; the pressure relief device is connected with a fire extinguishing agent output pipe, and a nozzle structure is arranged at the end part of the fire extinguishing agent output pipe. Has the advantages that: according to the invention, through the design of the handle arranged on the outer shell, when in use, the handle can be held by hand, and the hand is shielded through the outer shell, so that the hand of a user can be prevented from being burnt by flame; the pressure relief handle is designed on the inner side of the handle, so that no protrusion is arranged on the surface of the outer shell, and the storage and carrying of equipment are facilitated.

title_en: Method and device for treating tail gas of ammoniacal tank of coking plant
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for treating tail gas of an ammonia tank of a coking plant, which are used for directly producing the tail gas of each ammonia tank of the coking plant after being treated by a regeneration tower, wherein the device comprises a tail gas collecting port, a fan, a water-soluble ammonia gas collecting tank, a gas compressor and a high-pressure storage tank which are sequentially connected, the bottom of the water-soluble ammonia gas collecting tank is provided with a gas inlet which is connected with the fan, the tail gas is led into the bottom of the water-soluble ammonia gas collecting tank through the fan and a pipeline I to remove ammonia in a water-soluble manner, the upper part of the water-soluble ammonia gas collecting tank is provided with a gas collector, the water of the water-soluble ammonia gas collecting tank is used for mixing the gas released after the water-soluble ammonia of the tail gas into the gas collector and air, and then is connected with the gas compressor through a pipeline II, and the gas compressor compresses the gas into the high-pressure storage tank to store the gas to replace an air-pressure station for supplying gas to the regeneration tower.

title_en: Robot-based garbage management method and system
abstract_en: A robot-based garbage management method and system are provided, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the robot positions and obtains the position information of the robot; the robot is provided with a cargo carrying platform; the intelligent garbage can acquires first identity information corresponding to a garbage throwing user, and opens a corresponding intelligent lock according to the first identity information; the intelligent garbage can records garbage throwing time and detects the weight information of thrown garbage thrown into the box body; the server acquires and stores the position information and a garbage throwing record of a garbage throwing user; the intelligent garbage can generates a garbage transportation instruction; the robot moves to a target garbage throwing area; the robot loads the target intelligent garbage can onto a cargo carrying platform; the robot moves to a garbage management area, and unloads the loaded intelligent garbage can to the garbage management area. The invention solves the sanitation problem in the garbage transportation process. And (4) supervising and controlling the garbage distribution link so as to trace responsibility in the following process. The garbage is not required to be conveyed manually, and the labor cost is reduced.

title_en: Water purifier
abstract_en: The application discloses a water purifier, which comprises a filter element assembly, a filtering water outlet pipe connected with the water outlet end of the filtering assembly and a filter element cleaning device for back flushing the filter element assembly, wherein the filter element cleaning device comprises a control valve and a water storage barrel for conveying water to the filtering assembly, the control valve comprises a first control valve arranged on the filtering water outlet pipe and a second control valve arranged at the water outlet end of a water storage tank, the water inlet end of the water storage tank is connected with a water inlet through a back flushing water inlet pipe, and the water inlet end of the back flushing water inlet pipe is positioned at the upstream of the first control valve along the water purification flow direction. In the water purifier provided by the application, after the water is stored in the water storage tank, the filter element assembly is backwashed, so that impurities on the surface of the filter element assembly are washed, the service time of the filter element is prolonged, and the use cost of the water purifier is reduced.

title_en: Desulfurization wastewater treatment system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a desulfurization wastewater treatment system and a desulfurization wastewater treatment method. The treatment system comprises a high-temperature flue gas pipeline, a dynamic wave scrubber and a washing tower, wherein an outlet of the high-temperature flue gas pipeline is communicated with a gas phase inlet of the dynamic wave scrubber, a gas phase outlet of the dynamic wave scrubber is communicated with a gas inlet of the washing tower, a sewage draining outlet of the dynamic wave scrubber is communicated with the high-temperature flue gas pipeline through a circulating pump, and a desulfurization wastewater inlet is further arranged as a liquid phase inlet. The treatment system realizes the purpose of concentration by using the circulating heat and mass transfer exchange of the high-temperature flue gas and the desulfurization wastewater in the dynamic wave scrubber, has the advantages of short treatment flow, low equipment cost, recovery of flue gas heat to reduce the operation cost, no wastewater scaling and the like, and solves the problems of long process flow, high operation difficulty and very high investment and operation cost in the prior art.

title_en: Preparation method of composite fiber with surface embedded with metal organic framework nanofiber
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a composite fiber with a surface embedded with metal organic framework nanofibers, and belongs to the technical field of fiber materials. The method comprises the steps of mixing metal salt and an organic ligand to prepare metal organic framework nano-fiber, placing the metal organic framework nano-fiber in a high polymer stock solution coagulating bath to obtain a mixed coagulating bath, and soaking a high polymer stock solution trickle in the mixed coagulating bath to prepare the composite fiber with the metal organic framework nano-fiber embedded on the surface through a solution spinning technology. The composite fiber designed by the invention not only has excellent mechanical properties of micron fiber, but also has the characteristics of more active sites on the surface of the metal organic framework nanofiber and large specific surface area, so that the composite fiber can be used for manufacturing yarns and fabrics with the functions of moisture permeability, sweat releasing, detoxification, antibiosis and fluorescence sensing.

title_en: Continuous production method of hydrolyzed polymaleic anhydride
abstract_en: The invention discloses a continuous production method of hydrolyzed polymaleic acid. Adding maleic anhydride, a special catalyst, deionized water and concentrated sulfuric acid into a mixing kettle according to a certain mass ratio, and uniformly stirring and mixing for later use; and (2) simultaneously and continuously pumping the mixed material and hydrogen peroxide into a first-stage reaction kettle according to a set flow rate, automatically overflowing the reaction material into a next-stage series reaction kettle after the reaction material reaches a set liquid level, simultaneously starting a hydrogen peroxide dropping pump connected with the first-stage reaction kettle, continuously pumping the hydrogen peroxide according to the set flow rate, and repeating until reaching a last-stage series reaction kettle, wherein the overflowing material of the last-stage series reaction kettle is subjected to heat preservation and qualified through a buffer kettle to obtain a finished product of the hydrolyzed polymaleic anhydride. The invention adopts a continuous production method, effectively utilizes the heat of polymerization reaction, improves the production efficiency and the utilization rate of equipment, and has stable product quality; easy to realize automatic control and large-scale industrial production, and the production process is safe and environment-friendly.

title_en: Bimetal wind wave resistant phosphorus locking material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bimetal wind wave resistant phosphorus locking material which is prepared by the following method: and (2) granulating powdery dolomite attapulgite clay, performing high-temperature heat treatment to obtain a semi-finished product, then soaking the semi-finished product into a mixed solution of lanthanum chloride and aluminum chloride for loading, then performing stabilization treatment at a low temperature, and cleaning and drying to obtain the bimetal wind wave resistant phosphorus locking material. The material has large phosphorus fixation capacity and remarkable wind wave resistance, and can realize the phosphorus fixation function conversion of lanthanum and aluminum elements in different water environment pH value changes, thereby realizing comprehensive phosphorus fixation. The material has the advantages of wide material source, low price, naturalness, no toxicity, high ecological safety and wide application prospect.

title_en: Novel energy-saving environment-friendly RTO device for thermal oxidation furnace
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel energy-saving environment-friendly thermal oxidation furnace RTO device, which comprises an upper furnace body and a lower furnace body, wherein the upper furnace body comprises an upper furnace body shell, a heat storage ceramic is arranged at the lower part of the upper furnace body, and a honeycomb heat storage body is arranged below the heat storage ceramic; the lower furnace body comprises a lifting valve arranged at the upper part of the lower furnace body, the lifting valve comprises an annular valve seat, the annular valve seat is provided with an inner side wall and an outer side wall which are perpendicular to the supporting plate, an annular elastic sealing ring is arranged between the inner side wall and the outer side wall, and the elastic sealing ring is extruded when the valve plate is pressed down and simultaneously contacts with the upper end of the outer side wall of the annular valve seat; the cross section of the honeycomb heat accumulator is octagonal, a plurality of punched bulges are arranged on the surface of the honeycomb heat accumulator, and the bulges on the surface of the honeycomb heat accumulator are arranged in a staggered manner; the heat accumulating ceramic comprises a saddle-shaped ceramic bottom and a plurality of ceramic branches uniformly distributed on the saddle-shaped ceramic bottom, wherein the ceramic branches are divided into 3 sections; the device has the advantages of heat storage efficiency up to 96%, good practicality and convenient operation.

title_en: Enthalpy difference filter for laboratory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a filter for an enthalpy difference laboratory, which belongs to the field of enthalpy difference laboratories and comprises a shell, wherein a filter screen is arranged in the shell; the filter screen comprises an outer ring, an inner ring and reinforcing ribs, the outer ring is matched with the inner wall of the shell, a guide groove is formed in the inner wall of the shell, and a guide bulge is formed in the outer ring; the pull rod is coaxially arranged in the inner ring in a penetrating mode, the pull rod is provided with a locking bulge, one part of the outer edge of the locking bulge is gradually enlarged in the circumferential direction of the pull rod, the inner wall of the inner ring is provided with an annular accommodating groove, and the end face of the inner ring is provided with a notch communicated with the annular accommodating groove; through holes are formed in the inner ring and the outer ring, the two through holes are opposite, and the through holes in the inner ring are communicated with the annular accommodating groove; a slide bar penetrates through the through hole, a fixing hole matched with the outer end of the slide bar is formed in the inner wall of the shell, and a reset spring is sleeved on the slide bar. The invention not only facilitates the disassembly and assembly of the filter screen, but also has the function of facilitating the cleaning of the filter.

title_en: Ecological restoration method for layered coverage of gold mine tailings
abstract_en: The invention provides an ecological restoration method for layered coverage of gold mine tailings, and relates to the technical field of mine ecological restoration. The repairing method provided by the invention comprises the following steps: (1) covering a heavy metal composite passivator on the surface layer of the gold mine tailings, turning over, and spraying 0.8-1.2% of water-soluble carboxymethyl chitosan solution to obtain a heavy metal passivation restoration; (2) and (2) sequentially covering a barrier, a biological organic fertilizer and soil on the heavy metal passivation restoration obtained in the step (1) to realize ecological restoration of the gold mine tailings. The ecological restoration method provided by the invention belongs to a physical-chemical-biological combined restoration method, can continuously and deeply restore the heavy metal pollution problem of the gold mine tailings, and breaks through the limitations of secondary environmental pollution, low restoration efficiency, long restoration period and incapability of continuously and deeply restoring the heavy metal pollution in the tailings in the existing gold mine tailing restoration method.

title_en: Sled dress formula black and odorous water body filtration liquid integrated reaction equipment based on photocatalyst
abstract_en: The invention provides photocatalyst-based skid-mounted black and odorous water body leachate integrated reaction equipment, which comprises a skid body, wherein a liquid storage tank is arranged at the bottom of the skid body; the inside of the pry body is provided with a plurality of layers of aeration components, and a bionic filter unit is arranged above the uppermost layer of aeration components; the water body in the liquid storage tank is conveyed to the top end of the pry body through the liquid supply assembly and flows through the bionic filtering unit; the bionic filtering unit comprises a carrier and a filler in the carrier, wherein the filler is used for capturing gas after aeration reaction; a purification reaction cavity is formed between two adjacent aeration assemblies, and between the uppermost aeration assembly and the lung bionic filter unit; ventilation is carried out to the microporous cloth bag through the air supply assembly, and bubbles are formed in the catalytic reaction cavity; and two adjacent purification reaction chambers are arranged between each two adjacent purification reaction chambers. In the invention, the aeration depth is improved by layered aeration in the limited space in the pry body, the specific surface area of aeration is increased, the energy is saved, the movement is realized, the efficiency is improved, and the energy consumption is reduced.

title_en: A high-efficient type bag collector for industrial waste gas purification handles
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-efficiency bag type dust collector for purifying industrial waste gas, which comprises a base, a controller, a shell, an air inlet pipe, an air outlet pipe, a pulse valve, a dustproof mechanism and a plurality of support legs, wherein a flow guide mechanism, two connecting pipes and two filter bags are arranged in the shell, the dustproof mechanism comprises a water tank, a water pump, a water conveying pipe, a water spray pipe, a frame, a return pipe, filter cloth and a plurality of spray heads, the flow guide mechanism comprises a flow guide plate, a slide rail and a lifting component, the high-efficiency bag type dust collector for purifying and treating industrial waste gas keeps the filter cloth in a moist state through the dustproof mechanism, is convenient for absorbing dust, prevents the filter bag from being blocked due to flying dust, and not only does the high-efficiency bag type dust collector for purifying and treating industrial waste gas keep the filter cloth in a moist state, the guide plate is driven to lift through the flow guide mechanism, the dust suspended in the shell is close to the wet filter cloth, the dust adsorbed on the surface of the filter bag is reduced, and the air circulation is favorably kept, so that the dust removal efficiency and the practicability of the equipment are improved.

title_en: Honeycomb type denitration catalyst and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: Disclosure of the inventionWeighing mineral fibers, placing the mineral fibers in 0.5-5 mol/L inorganic acid solution, adding a nonionic surfactant, stirring and refluxing at 50-90 ℃, filtering and drying after 1-8 h of treatment, and roasting at 400-600 ℃ for 1-5 h; mixing the calcined mineral fiber with TiO 2 Mixing, adding deionized water, a binder, an ammonium metavanadate solution, an ammonium metatungstate solution and a forming aid, uniformly mixing to form a paste, extruding, drying, and calcining at 400-600 ℃ for 1-6 hours to obtain the honeycomb denitration catalyst. The honeycomb denitration catalyst prepared by the preparation method has high denitration activity. And has excellent mechanical performance and anti-poisoning performance. The catalyst has strong industrial applicability and long service life.

title_en: Concentration tank in salt lake surface brine lake water area
abstract_en: A concentration pool in a salt lake surface brine lake water area is built in a near-lake-shore shallow water area without an external fresh water supply source or with a small external fresh water supply source in a salt lake, and is a relatively independent space isolated in the salt lake water area by building isolation and permeation composite type dams. The concentrated pool can reduce the construction of lake-bank impervious salt field, reduce engineering investment and reduce project construction land.

title_en: Pulse signal counting method, pulse signal reconstruction method and chip
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a counting method, a reconstruction method and a chip of pulse signals. The counting method may include the steps of: the N comparators respectively compare the amplitude of the acquired pulse signal with N corresponding preset amplitude thresholds and send a level signal indicating a comparison result to the encoder; the encoder encodes the level signals sent by the N comparators in M clock cycles according to a preset encoding mode to obtain M encoding values; the processing unit sequentially determines a target code value among the M code values in a time sequence of obtaining the M code values from the encoder, and controls a corresponding counter to count according to the target code value. The technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the application can realize the identification and recovery of the pulse stacking event and improve the counting accuracy of the pulse signal.

title_en: Rope-shaped filler for sewage treatment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rope-shaped filler for sewage treatment, belonging to the technical field of sewage treatment. The device mainly comprises rope-shaped fillers, two mounting frames and a fixed buckling piece, wherein the two mounting frames are arranged oppositely, and each mounting frame comprises a mounting tube, a mounting rod and a fixed lifting rod; the packing has larger specific surface area and increases the water treatment effect through the external shape of the rope-shaped packing; the rope-shaped filler is made of PVDF, the PVDF has the characteristics of pollution resistance, high mechanical strength, stable chemical property and excellent heat resistance, the service life of the rope-shaped filler is prolonged, the installation quantity of the rope-shaped filler is increased through the arrangement of a plurality of installation rods which are mutually obliquely and crossly connected, and the sewage treatment efficiency is improved; the invention has the advantages of large specific surface area, high sewage treatment efficiency and convenient installation, and is suitable for mass popularization.

title_en: Integrated dust removal system suitable for mixing station, and control system and control method thereof
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of mixing station smoke and dust waste gas treatment, and discloses an integrated dust removal system suitable for a mixing station, which comprises a dust remover and a plurality of smoke and dust collecting units connected with the dust remover through pipelines respectively, wherein the dust collection units are integrated in a set of dust removal system for unified treatment, so that the treatment cost and the process difficulty of asphalt smoke are greatly reduced, the overall smoke and dust waste gas treatment emission of the mixing station meets the environmental protection standard, smoke and dust collectors can be effectively recycled in a stable soil layer of a roadbed, the zero emission of waste is realized, the secondary pollution is avoided, the environmental protection cost is effectively reduced, the energy is saved, the economy and the environmental protection are realized, the control system and the method effectively realize automatic intelligent control, the control units and the modules are cooperatively matched, the frequency conversion control and the automatic adjustment of the wind pressure, the wind speed and the wind quantity of the operation of equipment are realized according to the state of a dust source point, the effective collection and the cleaning of the smoke and dust waste gas are ensured, the operation cost of the equipment is effectively reduced, and the competitiveness of the equipment is improved.

title_en: Indoor and outdoor large-scale efficient haze purifier
abstract_en: The invention aims to overcome the defects of the prior art, provides two types of indoor and outdoor large-scale efficient haze purifiers, utilizes a dense structure of household stainless steel wire cleaning balls, adopts the depth of a honeycomb stainless steel cylinder of 3 meters, utilizes spray water to permeate and wet from top to bottom, and enables haze air to pass through a filtering area from bottom to top under the forced action of an axial flow fan to form a wet filter, PM2.5 is adsorbed by surface water of steel wires and descends along with water, and meanwhile, the stainless steel wires are also purified. The upper part of the outdoor unit is additionally provided with a device for separating small water drops to form the indoor unit.

title_en: Preparation method of metal-organic framework/polypyrrole hybrid conductive electrode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a metal-organic framework/polypyrrole hybrid conductive electrode, belonging to the field of preparation of capacitive desalting electrode materials. The method comprises the following steps: dispersing metal salt into the polypyrrole nanotube solution to obtain a polypyrrole nanotube metal salt mixed solution; and mixing the polypyrrole nanotube metal salt mixed solution with an organic ligand solution, and standing to obtain the electrode material. The preparation method provided by the invention has the advantages of simple and feasible process and mild conditions, and can be used for large-scale production.

title_en: Preparation and application of nano hybrid material
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method and application of a nano hybrid material, belonging to the technical field of water treatment, wherein the preparation method of the nano hybrid material comprises the following steps: modifying GO with 3-O-methyl gallic acid to obtain rGO; MnFe is prepared by chemical coprecipitation method 2 O 4 Coating the composite material on the rGO sheet layer to obtain a rGO-based composite material; and mixing the rGO-based composite material with the fiber raw material, and performing electrostatic spinning to obtain the nano hybrid material. The nano hybrid material can be used for sewage treatment. According to the preparation method of the nano hybrid material, the GO is reduced, meanwhile, the graphene is modified by the gallic acid, so that the nano particles are uniformly dispersed on the surface of the rGO and coated on the rGO sheet layer, the antioxidant activity and the stability are good, the prepared nano hybrid material can effectively adsorb heavy metal ions in sewage, has strong pollution resistance, and can avoid organic pollution and biological pollution.

title_en: Catalyst for electrochemically reducing carbon dioxide into carbon monoxide and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: Provides a preparation method of a catalyst for electrochemically reducing carbon dioxide into carbon monoxide, and the general formula of the catalyst is Ag x Ni y ，0<x is less than or equal to 1, y is less than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 0.5, and x + y is 1, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: s1, weighing soluble silver salt and nickel salt according to the molar ratio of silver to nickel, and dissolving the soluble silver salt and the nickel salt in water to form precursor solution; s2, introducing a reducing gas containing hydrogen to the liquid surface or the liquid surface of the precursor solution, and simultaneously dropwise adding an alkali solution into the precursor solution to react completely; s3, filtering the mixed solution after reaction, separating solid particles, washing, vacuum drying and grinding; when y is more than 0, the method also comprises S4, and the dried solid particles obtained in the S3 step are roasted in a reducing atmosphere. The preparation method comprises the steps of hydrogen reduction and roasting reduction, and has the advantages of simple and easily-controlled process, high yield and easy process amplification. The catalyst provided by the invention has the particle size reaching the nanometer level and is used for CO 2 Electrocatalytic reduction with high catalytic activity and CO 2 And (4) selectivity.

title_en: Integrated boiler system and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an integrated boiler system and a control method. The integrated boiler system comprises a boiler system, a heat-moisture exchange subsystem and a waste heat recovery heat pump subsystem. The efficiency of the fuel low-calorific-value boiler is more than 100%, the exhaust temperature is lower than 20 ℃, the heat of the fuel high-calorific-value boiler supplies heat to heat users, the tail flue gas of the boiler is directly discharged in treatment, and meanwhile, the flue gas is subjected to dust removal, desulfurization, denitration and white removal treatment, so that the ultralow emission of the biomass boiler is realized. The whole system forms an integrated device, has small occupied area, low initial investment and more compactness and concentration, and plays a positive pushing role in sustainable development of biomass boiler industry.

title_en: Selective catalytic reduction catalyst
abstract_en: For converting Nitrogen Oxides (NO) in exhaust gases using nitrogenous reducing agents  x  ) The selective catalytic reduction catalyst composition of (a), comprising a mixture of a first component and a second component, wherein the first component is a mixture of an H-type aluminosilicate Mordenite (MOR) and an iron-promoted aluminosilicate MFI zeolite; and the second component is vanadium oxide supported on a metal oxide support which is titania, silica-stabilized titania, or a mixture of titania and silica-stabilized titania, wherein the weight ratio of the first component to the second component is from 10:90 to 25: 75.

title_en: Environmental protection is with abluent automobile exhaust emission filter equipment of convenient to detach
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environment-friendly automobile exhaust emission filtering device convenient to disassemble and clean, which comprises a protective box, wherein a rubber cushion is fixedly installed on the upper side of the protective box, installation blocks are fixedly arranged at four corners of the protective box, a first filtering pipe is fixedly installed inside the protective box through screws, one end of the first filtering pipe is fixedly connected with an air inlet pipe, one end of the air inlet pipe is inserted into a pipe sleeve, a connecting flange is installed on the pipe sleeve, a shifting mechanism and a filtering net are arranged inside the first filtering pipe, a storage bin is arranged on the lower side of the first filtering pipe, the other end of the first filtering pipe is connected with a second filtering pipe through a first connecting pipe, a water storage bin is arranged at the lower end of the second filtering pipe, and a water filling port is formed in the water storage bin. According to the tail gas filter device, tail gas is filtered through a triple structure, so that the tail gas filtering effect is greatly improved, and meanwhile, the tail gas filter device is convenient to disassemble and maintain, so that the filtering effect of the device is ensured.

title_en: Method for producing a silencer structure assembly and silencer structure assembly
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for producing a silencer structure assembly and a silencer structure assembly, said method having the following measures: a) providing a muffler comprising a muffler housing including a peripheral wall elongated in a direction of a housing longitudinal axis; b) providing a housing wrap for the muffler housing, the housing wrap having a wrap contour adapted to the peripheral contour of the peripheral wall and a connecting edge (46) for connecting the housing wrap (26) to the peripheral wall; c) arranging the housing wrap (26) in a connecting position partially surrounding a peripheral wall of the muffler housing such that the connecting edge (46) abuts against the peripheral wall; d) a connecting edge (46) of the housing wrap (26) is fixedly connected to the peripheral wall of the muffler housing.

title_en: Particle beam monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The proposed system and method facilitate efficient and effective monitoring of the particle beam. In some embodiments, a system comprises: a primary particle beam generator that generates a primary particle beam; and a monitoring section that monitors the primary particle beam. The monitoring component includes: a reaction component that is impacted by the primary particle beam, wherein a result of the impact includes generating secondary photons; a detection means that detects a characteristic of the secondary photon; and a primary particle beam characteristic determining section that determines a characteristic of the primary particle beam based on the characteristic of the secondary photon. The characteristics of the primary particle beam can include radiation dose measurements and dose rates. The reaction member can comprise a foil member. A resolving time of less than one nanosecond can be associated with detecting the secondary photon characteristic.

title_en: Active carbon adsorption device
abstract_en: The invention provides an activated carbon adsorption device. The active carbon adsorption device includes shell structure, shell structure includes the casing and locates division board in the casing, the division board will the inner chamber of casing separates to establish to first cavity and second cavity, be equipped with first active carbon adsorption layer in the first cavity, first active carbon adsorption layer will first cavity separates to establish to first water cavity and second water cavity, first water cavity can communicate with the external world, be equipped with second active carbon adsorption layer in the second cavity, second active carbon adsorption layer will the second cavity separates to establish to first gas cavity and second gas cavity, first gas cavity can communicate with the external world. The active carbon adsorption device can not only purify air, but also purify water, and improves the use experience of users.

title_en: System for cyclically regenerating DPF by using NTP and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a control method for regenerating DPF (diesel particulate filter) by utilizing NTP (network time protocol) cycle, which relate to the field of tail gas treatment, wherein the system comprises an ECU (electronic control Unit), a post-treatment device, an NTP generation module, a cycle temperature control module and a control module; after the diesel engine is shut down, the exhaust waste heat provides the temperature required by the regeneration process; in the process of DPF regeneration, the temperature in the DPF is regulated by the circulating temperature control module; the NTP generation module can select different gas sources to generate NTP, and PM deposited in the DPF is removed through oxidation; the NTP generation module comprises a circulating air inlet pipe controlled by a circulating air inlet valve, and a circulating passage is formed timely to enable unreacted NTP to be recycled; the control module timely opens or closes the circulation passage by controlling the opening and closing of the electromagnetic valve, so that the conversion among three working modes, namely a common regeneration mode, a pressurization preparation mode and a pressurization circulation mode, is realized. The invention can effectively improve the utilization rate of NTP, save the gas supplied by a gas source, reduce the regeneration cost and improve the regeneration efficiency.

title_en: Ultrahigh-flux nanofiber filtering membrane and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra-high-flux nanofiber filtering membrane and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of nanofiber filtering membranes. The invention relates to a preparation method of a nano fiber filtering membrane with ultrahigh flux, which comprises the steps of adding additive mixed liquor into spinning stock solution, uniformly mixing to obtain spinning solution, carrying out electrostatic spinning on the spinning solution to obtain a crude nano fiber filtering membrane, placing the crude nano fiber filtering membrane in a tenter for post-treatment to obtain the nano fiber filtering membrane with ultrahigh flux, wherein the gas filtering flux of the nano fiber filtering membrane prepared by the method is 2-3 times of that of the nano fiber filtering membrane in normal spinning, and the filtering efficiency is more than 99.5%.

title_en: Pond system for water quality circulation purification
abstract_en: The invention provides a fishpond system for circularly purifying water quality, which comprises an aeration dissolved oxygen unit, a culture water tank, a microbial degradation tank unit and a natural purification ecological tank; the aeration oxygen dissolving unit forms directional water flow in the cultivation water tank; a sewage suction tank is arranged at the downstream of the cultivation water tank; the microbial degradation tank unit comprises a sewage pump, a sedimentation zone, an aerobic wet area, an anoxic wet area, a leaching tank and an aerobic microbial degradation tank; the sewage pump conveys the wastewater at the bottom of the sewage suction tank to a sedimentation area for sedimentation and aeration; part of the effluent of the sedimentation zone flows through an aerobic wet area to carry out aerobic decomposition and nitrification of organic matters, and the other part of the effluent is used for supplementing a carbon source in the water body through leaching liquid of a leaching pond; after the water flowing out of the aerobic wet area and the leaching tank is mixed, the mixed water flows through the anoxic wet area to carry out denitrification; the water flowing out of the anoxic wet area flows into an aerobic microorganism degradation pool to further degrade organic matters; the effluent of the aerobic microbial degradation tank enters a natural purification ecological tank. The invention is used for water body circulation and purification, and is ecologically friendly.

title_en: Preparation method and application of magnetic reduction microorganism flocculating agent
abstract_en: A preparation method and application of a magnetic reduction microorganism flocculant, relating to a preparation method and application of a microorganism flocculant. Aims to solve the problem of heavy reduction of microbial flocculantThe metal efficiency is low. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, preparing Fe 3 O 4 Particles; secondly, preparing a microbial flocculant MFX solution; thirdly, preparing a magnetic microbial flocculant; and fourthly, loading the generated zero-valent iron on the magnetic microbial flocculant by adopting a liquid phase reduction method to obtain the magnetic reduction microbial flocculant. The flocculant has the advantages of high efficiency, suitability for treating low-concentration heavy metal wastewater and the like, has the characteristics of magnetic separation and high reduction adsorption, is easy to separate and recover, has high flocculation efficiency and high reduction adsorption efficiency, and avoids secondary pollution; and the preparation process is simple, easy to recover and easy to amplify, and the flocculation use amount is reduced. The invention is suitable for the preparation of flocculant and the removal of heavy metal.

title_en: Continuous feeding full-mixing type biological drying equipment and method without heating period
abstract_en: The invention discloses full-mixing type biological drying equipment and method with continuous feeding in a non-heating period, wherein the equipment comprises a box body, a stirring screw and an aeration spray head; the box body adopts a U-shaped reaction bin as a biological drying reaction bin, and a stirring screw and an aeration nozzle are arranged in the box body to perform turning stirring and ventilation aeration; the stirring screw adopts a helical blade to avoid plastic winding and stirring dead angles; the aeration spray head is designed to prevent blockage; the method comprises a starting scheme and an operating scheme, wherein the fresh perishable garbage and the decomposed materials are completely mixed, microorganisms and moisture are reasonably distributed, so that extremely high microbial quantity and microbial activity are obtained, a long heating period (microbial growth period) is skipped in the fermentation process, the residence time is shortened, the occupied area is reduced, and the investment cost and the operation and maintenance cost are reduced.

title_en: Engine for vehicle
abstract_en: The engine (1) is provided with an exhaust gas purification system (70) and an EGR passage (52), wherein a GPF device (73) for purifying exhaust gas is housed in the exhaust gas purification system (70), the EGR passage (52) is connected to a portion of the exhaust gas purification system located downstream of the GPF device, and the engine (1) is configured to be mounted in an engine room (R) defined in the front portion of a vehicle body. The exhaust gas purification system is located in front of a dash panel (103) constituting an engine room and is provided so as to extend toward a tunnel section (T) of the dash panel. An upstream end portion (52c) of the EGR passage is connected to a lower portion of the exhaust gas purification system in the vehicle vertical direction.

title_en: Kitchen waste treatment device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a kitchen waste treatment device which comprises a drying and stirring mechanism for drying and stirring kitchen waste synchronously, a crushing mechanism for crushing the kitchen waste after drying and stirring, a material leakage mechanism for controlling the amount of the kitchen waste entering the crushing mechanism and a deodorizing mechanism for deodorizing gas with peculiar smell generated by the kitchen waste, wherein the top and the bottom of the drying and stirring mechanism are respectively provided with a residue inlet and a residue outlet, the top and the bottom of the crushing mechanism are respectively provided with a residue inlet and a crushed residue outlet, the residue inlet of the drying and stirring mechanism is connected with the deodorizing mechanism, the material outlet of the drying and stirring mechanism is connected with the residue inlet of the crushing mechanism, the material leakage mechanism is arranged between the drying and stirring mechanism and the crushing mechanism so as to control the amount of the kitchen waste entering the crushing mechanism, and a collecting bin is arranged below the crushed residue outlet of the crushing mechanism. The invention solves the technical problems that kitchen waste cannot be fully treated and collected and is easy to pollute the environment.

title_en: Charcoal-based immobilized polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon efficient degradation microbial inoculum and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-efficiency degrading microbial inoculum for fixed polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon based on biochar, which comprises a biochar-based material and a bacterial strain adsorbed on the biochar-based material. The biochar curing microbial inoculum is used for degrading polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon. According to the invention, the biochar curing microbial inoculum with the maximum attached microbial biomass and the best removal effect is prepared by optimizing the curing culture medium and the curing time, and the removal rates of the 2 microbial inocula for 16h to phenanthrene can respectively reach 93.08% and 66.36%; compared with free bacteria which basically lose activity after 7 days at room temperature, the biochar solidifying microbial inoculum still has a good removal effect, the removal rate of phenanthrene can still reach 71.78% and 40.72% respectively, and obviously, the biochar can keep the activity of the bacteria and prolong the survival time of microorganisms.

title_en: Deaerator water supply reflux system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a deaerator water supply reflux system which comprises a water supply preheater, a water supply pump, a deaerator, a boiler water supply pump, an economizer and a boiler which are sequentially connected, wherein the water supply preheater is circularly connected with a circulating pump, a heat exchanger and a condensate tank through bypass pipelines, and the heat exchanger heats cold water into domestic hot water. Compared with the prior art, the invention can avoid water hammer or air resistance of water flowing from the water supply preheater to the deaerator, thereby improving the running safety of the boiler and improving the heat utilization rate.

title_en: Bidirectional air draft type dust removal device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of dust removing equipment, in particular to a bidirectional air-draft type dust removing device which comprises a horizontally arranged moving mounting plate, wherein four corners of the moving mounting plate are vertically provided with steering mounting grooves, steering rotating shafts are arranged in the steering mounting grooves in a matching mode and extend downwards out of the steering mounting grooves, the lower ends of the steering rotating shafts are provided with steering mounting frames, the lower ends of the steering mounting frames are provided with moving guide wheels through rotating shafts, a lifting mounting cylinder is vertically arranged right above the moving mounting plate, the middle position of the lifting mounting cylinder is downwards provided with a conical surface filter plate, the air draft and flow guide efficiency of the device are high through bidirectional synchronous air draft, the device is matched with various filter structures, the dust removing process of the device is high in precision and efficiency, fine particles of screened air are adsorbed through porous aeration, the dust removing effect is improved, and the device also has the capabilities of moving operation and independent operation, meanwhile, the height of the device can be adjusted, and the practicability of the device is obviously improved.

title_en: Flexible subregion fire extinguishing systems of free cellular-type
abstract_en: The invention discloses a free-separation type flexible zoned fire-fighting system, which relates to the technical field of fire-fighting facilities and comprises a plurality of fire detectors and a plurality of air bag assemblies which are arranged in a building to form/form a free-separation type flexible zoned fire-fighting space, wherein the fire detectors are connected with the air bag assemblies through wires or a control device; the airbag module includes: a housing; an air bag made of high temperature resistant material and placed in the interior of the shell body; an expansion device for receiving signals from the fire detector or control device to rapidly expand the airbag.

title_en: High-precision timing silicon photomultiplier system capable of resisting signal accumulation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of photoelectric detectors, and particularly relates to a high-precision timing silicon photomultiplier diode system capable of resisting signal accumulation q And parasitic capacitance C q Forming a plurality of diode pixels, grounding the anode output ports of the diodes, and passing the fast output ports of the diodes through a coupling capacitor C f And each diode pixel is connected to form a signal output port which is connected to the time signal processing unit and the energy signal processing unit to output a time processing signal and an energy processing signal respectively. The high-precision timing silicon photomultiplier system capable of resisting signal accumulation fully utilizes the precise time performance of the fast precise pulse of the fast output port, lightens or solves the problems of accumulation and baseline fluctuation of a charge measurement channel, and can reduce signal connection to only one port.

title_en: Combined process and treatment system for treating high ammonia nitrogen wastewater
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combined process for treating high ammonia nitrogen wastewater, which comprises the following steps: solid-liquid separation → biological rotating disc pretreatment → biological contact oxidation advanced treatment → coagulating sedimentation, the biological rotating disc pretreatment unit of the treatment system adopted in the process adopts a plurality of rotating discs supported on the same rotating shaft, each rotating disc is driven to rotate by a planet row reduction box with different transmission ratios, the rotating speed of the rotating discs is gradually reduced from the water inlet end to the water outlet end, the biological rotating disc pretreatment unit also adopts a blast aeration device to adjust the dissolved oxygen concentration of the high ammonia nitrogen waste liquid, so that the pretreatment system has higher pollutant load, a plurality of contact oxidation fillers are arranged in the biological contact oxidation advanced treatment unit, the denitrification and dephosphorization efficiency of the system is enhanced by depending on the electrolysis and biomembrane degradation characteristics of the combination of iron-carbon microelectrolysis-active carbon fiber, and particularly, the serious imbalance of the C/N ratio in the biogas slurry is overcome when the low-carbon high ammonia nitrogen waste water (biogas slurry) is treated, the treatment efficiency of the high ammonia nitrogen wastewater is improved.

title_en: Zero emission treatment system and technology for volatile phenol in salt-containing wastewater
abstract_en: The invention discloses a zero emission treatment system for volatile phenol in salt-containing wastewater, wherein a second material outlet of a first preheating heat exchanger is communicated with an upper feed inlet of a first supercritical reactor, a first material outlet of a multi-flow heat exchanger is communicated with the upper feed inlet of the second supercritical reactor through a second pipeline, and a medium outlet of the multi-flow heat exchanger is communicated with the lower feed inlet of the first supercritical reactor and the lower feed inlet of the second supercritical reactor. The invention also provides a zero-emission treatment process for the volatile phenol in the salt-containing wastewater. In the invention, an air floatation tank is used for pretreatment, volatile phenol in wastewater is partially removed after pretreatment, and phenol-free wastewater and phenol-containing wastewater are subjected to quality-divided oxidation treatment by utilizing a multi-effect evaporator, so that the phenol-containing water is circularly oxidized in a system without discharge. The micro-discharge of the strong brine end can also achieve that the discharge concentration is not higher than one ten thousandth or one ten thousandth of the inlet water.

title_en: Soot blower and soot blowing system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a soot blower and a soot blowing system. The soot blower comprises an air duct, a chassis and a vortex structure, wherein the vortex structure covers the chassis to form a cavity, one end of the air duct penetrates through the chassis and is positioned in the cavity, and a plurality of soot blowing holes communicated with the cavity are uniformly formed in the vortex structure. The air flow enters the air flow cover and flows back to be sprayed from the jet hole below, and compressed air is sucked and sprayed from the soot blowing hole to continuously clean dust in the soot blower, so that the purpose of cleaning dust deposit in the soot blower is achieved, and the problem of blockage caused by the dust entering the soot blower can be effectively avoided. The soot blowing system has good cleaning effect and high working efficiency.

title_en: Ecological dry toilet
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological dry toilet. The automatic water-saving device comprises a toilet, a liquid storage barrel, pressure flushing equipment, a composting chamber, a urine purifying chamber, a storage box and an automatic feeding and stirring system; the toilet bowl is characterized in that a cover plate a is arranged on a toilet bowl opening, a movable baffle is arranged at the lower part of a feces outlet at the bottom, and the cover plate a is connected with the movable baffle through a steel wire rope so as to be opened and closed simultaneously; the composting room is used for composting the excrement; the urine purifying chamber is arranged at the bottom of the composting chamber and is connected with holes on the composting plate with holes; the spiral feeding port of the storage box is connected with the coverage material feeding port of the composting chamber; the automatic feeding and stirring system comprises an automatic feeder arranged in the storage box and a stirrer arranged in the composting chamber; the automatic feeder is connected with one end of the stirrer through a chain with a driven gear and a driving gear so as to be simultaneously linked. The invention can separate the excrement and urine, purify the urine, improve the efficiency of decomposing the excrement, obstruct and reduce the odor; recycling water in the recovered urine.

title_en: Electric power equipment manufacturing waste liquid treatment nanofiltration device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nanofiltration device for treating waste liquid generated in power equipment production and manufacturing, which comprises a host and supporting legs arranged at the bottom of the host, wherein the host comprises a pretreatment component, a degradation component, a precipitation water storage tank, a filtration component and a water outlet; through the dispersion subassembly that sets up, realize that the rotary wing rotates and stir sewage, can make impurity in the sewage more even fall on the biodegradable board, can effectively increase the speed of degradation.

title_en: Intelligent indoor fire hydrant box and monitoring system thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of fire hydrant boxes, in particular to an intelligent indoor fire hydrant box and a monitoring system thereof, wherein the intelligent indoor fire hydrant box comprises a box body and a fire-fighting tool arranged in the box body, a connecting plug is arranged on the fire-fighting tool, a connecting socket is arranged in the box body, and the connecting plug is in inserting fit with the connecting socket; a data carrier is arranged in the connecting plug, and a sensing module is arranged in the connecting socket; perception module and high in the clouds intercommunications, through radio wave communication between data carrier and the perception module, the equipment problem of patrolling personnel regularly or according to periodic patrol discovery, there is the time leak and for the manual operation neglect the scheduling problem, this application has and enables indoor fire hydrant case body through internet of things, this internal equipment quantity of real-time supervision and type, equipment leaves body distance and time, automatic alarm to management center and managers, carry out relevant processing immediately, reduce the effect of the conflagration risk that the facility equipment disappearance caused.

title_en: Fenton-fluidized bed sewage treatment plant
abstract_en: The invention provides a Fenton-fluidized bed sewage treatment device which specifically comprises a fluidized bed area, a reaction area at the lower end of the fluidized bed area and an overflow area at the upper end of the fluidized bed area. The fluidized bed area is provided with a magnetite heterogeneous catalyst taking gelatin as a substrate; the reaction zone is provided with a water inlet pipe and a hydrogen peroxide and ferrous sulfate medicine inlet pipe; the overflow area is provided with a water outlet pipe. And a circulating pump is arranged between the reaction area and the overflow area to form a continuous operation treatment procedure. A distribution plate is arranged between the fluidized bed area and the reaction area, circular openings are arranged on the distribution plate in an array mode, a certain annular gap exists between the circular openings and the inner side wall of the fluidized bed area, fluid flowing and mass transfer performance of the tank body is good, and catalytic activity of the heterogeneous catalyst and homogeneous dispersibility of hydrogen peroxide and ferrous sulfate are guaranteed. On the premise of maintaining the same high-efficiency treatment effect, the input amount of ferrous salt can be effectively and greatly reduced, and the generation of excessive chemical sludge is avoided.

title_en: Artificial aquatic plant water purifying device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water ecological restoration, in particular to an artificial aquatic plant water purification device which comprises a plurality of artificial aquatic plants, wherein the artificial aquatic plants are fixed on the surfaces of the artificial aquatic plants by arranging a fixing piece, the shape of the artificial aquatic plants is kept, the artificial aquatic plants are fixed and distributed on the fixing frame by vertically installing a plurality of fixing pieces on the same fixing frame together, the artificial aquatic plants are distributed on the fixing frame in a matrix manner, and compound oxygen is provided for microorganisms by arranging sustained-release oxygen agent balls filled with sustained-release oxygen agents on the fixing piece. The invention effectively combines the advantages of the artificial aquatic weeds and the slow-release oxygen agent, simultaneously solves the defects of the artificial aquatic weeds and the slow-release oxygen agent when being used independently, and has better water inlet effect.

title_en: Adjustable rotating member
abstract_en: A connector assembly (100) for fluidly coupling a fluid flow device to a fluid source is disclosed, including a receptacle (20) having a fluid inlet (22) configured to be fluidly coupled to the fluid source and an interior surface for defining a receiving chamber (24) fluidly coupled to the fluid inlet; a swivel member (30) disposed in the receiving chamber of the receiver, the swivel member having a connection port (32) configured to be coupled to the fluid flow device and an outer surface (36) comprising a substantially spherical outer surface portion in contact with the inner surface of the receiver; and a constraining member (40) coupled to the receiver such that the swivel member is positioned between the receiver and the constraining member. The constraining member has a surface geometry that defines a channel (48) through which the fluid flow device may extend, and the surface geometry limits rotation of the swivel member within the receptacle.

title_en: Pharmacy is with vibrating screening installation
abstract_en: The invention discloses vibration screening equipment for pharmacy, which belongs to the field of pharmacy and comprises a bottom plate, wherein a connecting box body is hinged on the bottom plate, a screening box body for screening pharmacy raw materials is arranged in the connecting box body, a plurality of inclined planes which are inclined upwards are arranged on the bottom wall of the screening box body, the screening box body screens large particles of medicine raw materials poured into the screening box body through the inclined planes in a vibration mode, the screening frequency is reduced, fine screening is directly carried out at one time, large particle raw materials in screening can be directly discharged, large particle raw materials can be conveniently ground again, the screening efficiency can also be increased, small particle raw materials in screening can rapidly enter a collecting area and cannot be blocked by a screen in a mode of increasing negative pressure and a vibration source, the generation of dust in screening is reduced, and the screened small particle raw materials can be rapidly settled, And the air is collected, so that the influence on the air is reduced.

title_en: Support material for NO oxidation catalyst, NO oxidation catalyst and method for catalytic oxidation of NO
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a support material for an NO oxidation catalyst, an NO oxidation catalyst and a method of catalytically oxidizing NO. The carrier material contains silicon dioxide and magnesium elements, and has a mesoporous structure; the specific surface area of the carrier material is 300m  2  More than g, and the average pore diameter is 2.5-25 nm. The carrier material disclosed by the invention can improve the sulfur poisoning resistance of the NO oxidation catalyst, avoid active center poisoning and ensure that the NO oxidation catalyst also has better NO oxidation performance under the condition of containing sulfur in flue gas.

title_en: Biochemical treatment method for wastewater generated in production of hydrogen peroxide by anthraquinone process based on composite microbial inoculum
abstract_en: The invention discloses a biochemical treatment method for wastewater generated in hydrogen peroxide production by an anthraquinone process based on a complex microbial inoculum. The biochemical treatment method for the wastewater produced by the anthraquinone method and based on the composite microbial inoculum is stable in effect and free of adverse effect on the whole wastewater treatment system.

title_en: Reciprocating type flocculation basin gallery optimization method for reducing flow resistance and obtained flocculation basin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for reducing flow resistanceThe reciprocating flocculation basin gallery optimization method and the flocculation basin obtained by the method. The return flow and vortex phenomena can occur at the gallery bending part of the reciprocating flocculation tank, and the kinetic energy of the fluid is greatly lost. The invention is as follows: firstly, selecting a streamline from a flow field at a gallery bending part as a baseline; sequentially taking n discrete points P on the base line according to the fluid flow direction i . Two, respectively pass through n discrete points P i N normals N for making a base line i (ii) a Three, N normal lines N i And selecting a plurality of outer wall characteristic points and inner wall characteristic points. Fourthly, according to the characteristic points B of the outer walls i Forming an outer optimized wall surface connected with the original outer wall surface of the gallery bending part; according to each inner wall characteristic point B' i And forming an inner optimized wall surface connected with the original inner side wall surface of the gallery bending part to complete the shape optimization of the gallery bending part. The invention reduces the flow resistance and kinetic energy loss of the fluid at the bent position.

title_en: Intelligent server cooling board room
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent high-efficiency server cooling board room, relates to the field of server cooling, and solves the problems that in the prior art, when the server needs to be carried, the server is difficult to carry quickly, and if a fire hazard occurs, the server can only be extinguished through a fire-fighting nozzle, so that the server is scrapped. The technical characteristics are that the device comprises a base, a heat dissipation mechanism arranged on the base, a dust removal mechanism and a fire extinguishing mechanism; the heat dissipation mechanism comprises a plurality of exhaust fans, a pair of compression refrigerators, a pair of cold air channels, a plurality of vent holes and an intelligent sensing part; the last surface mounting of base has the board house, and be equipped with the portion of depositing on just being located the base in the board house, a plurality of fans of airing exhaust set up in the portion of depositing, and a pair of cold wind passageway is seted up in the inside on board house both sides surface, and a plurality of ventilation holes are seted up in the board house relative both sides surface, and communicate with each other with a pair of cold wind passageway, and a pair of compression refrigerating machine sets up the lower surface at the base, installs the pipe on the compression refrigerating machine, and the distal end of pipe links to each other with the cold wind passageway.

title_en: System and method for preparing composite water purifying agent by using salt in desulfurization wastewater
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for preparing a compound water purifying agent by using salt in desulfurization wastewater. The system comprises a low-temperature flue gas waste heat concentration system, a reaction system and a product collection system. The invention adopts the low-temperature flue gas waste heat to concentrate the desulfurized wastewater, so that Cl is contained in the wastewater  ‑  The concentrated high-concentration-ratio high-chlorine wastewater is concentrated into high-chlorine wastewater, and the concentrated low-pH high-chlorine wastewater is reacted with red mud and waste acid to prepare the polyferric sulfate and polyferric sulfate compound water purifying agent. The preparation system and the preparation method of the invention fully utilize Cl in the desulfurization wastewater  ‑  The method meets the concept of changing waste into valuable and recycling salt with solid waste red mud advocated by the state at present, breaks through the technical problem that the chlorine salt recycling cannot be really realized in coal-fired power plants, and obtains valuable compound water purifying agent products at the same time.

title_en: Domestic sewage treatment device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a domestic sewage treatment device which comprises a rack, a sewage treatment barrel, a first filter element, a second filter element and a filter screen, wherein a support plate is welded on the rack, a through groove matched with the sewage treatment barrel is formed in the support plate, the sewage treatment barrel is clamped in the through groove, the top end of the sewage treatment barrel is in sealed fit with a barrel cover, a water inlet pipe is in threaded fit at the middle position of the barrel cover, a spray head is in threaded fit at the lower end of the water inlet pipe, an inverted triangular guide plate is fixed on the inner wall of the sewage treatment barrel at the lower part of the filter screen, a connecting water pipe is in threaded fit at the lower end of the guide plate, a first fixing frame and a second fixing frame are welded in the sewage treatment barrel at the lower part of the guide plate, the first filter element is clamped on the first fixing frame, the second filter element is. It is fixed firm, with low costs, sewage treatment is effectual, installation and dismantlement are convenient.

title_en: System, method and medium for treating heavy metal sludge of sewage treatment plant by using earthworms
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of sludge treatment, and discloses a system, a method and a medium for treating heavy metal sludge of a sewage treatment plant by using earthworms, which are used for obtaining the heavy metal sludge discharged by the sewage treatment plant; the obtained heavy metal sludge is spread in a wide-mouth tank; averagely dividing heavy metal sludge contained in the wide-mouth tank into a plurality of areas; acquiring related parameters of the weight and the total weight of sludge in each region, the temperature of the sludge in each region, the humidity of the sludge in each region, the sedimentation ratio and the pH value by using a sensor or other equipment; and controlling a sludge component analysis module to respectively select sludge samples from the divided areas by using a controller or a singlechip and carrying out component analysis. The invention utilizes the earthworms to treat the sludge, which not only can reduce the concentration of toxic and harmful substances such as heavy metal, pathogenic bacteria and the like in the sludge, but also can not carry out treatment such as incineration and the like in the whole treatment process and can not cause secondary pollution to the environment.

title_en: Solid waste treatment device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a solid waste treatment device, and relates to the field of environmental protection; the device comprises an incineration chamber; the device comprises a burning chamber, a collecting box, a scraper, a driving wheel connecting rod, a conveying belt, an iron scraping block and a driving wheel, wherein a discharge port of the burning chamber is connected with an iron removing chamber through a connecting pipeline, the iron removing chamber is internally provided with the iron removing mechanism, the iron removing mechanism is respectively arranged on the inner walls of the two sides of the iron removing chamber and is installed in a staggered and overlapped mode, the iron removing mechanism comprises the collecting box, the scraper, the driving wheel connecting rod, the conveying belt, the iron scraping block and the driving wheel, the conveying belt is placed in an inclined mode, the two ends of the conveying belt are respectively connected through the driving wheel connecting rod, the two sides of the two driving wheels are rotatably connected with the iron removing chamber through the driving wheel connecting rod, a magnet is arranged; the magnet adsorbed on the conveying belt is scraped under the action of the scraping iron block, and the magnet falls into the collecting box to be collected uniformly.

title_en: Ozone degradation device based on high-speed airflow and catalyst gas-solid coupling
abstract_en: The invention provides an ozone degradation device based on gas-solid coupling of high-speed gas flow and a catalyst, which comprises an air inlet channel, an annular reaction cavity, an annular reaction ramp, a shaking device and an eccentric wheel, wherein the air inlet channel is used as a pipeline for inputting gas flow, the annular reaction cavity is an ozone decomposition closed space, the catalyst for decomposing ozone is placed in the annular reaction cavity and comprises an inlet connected with the air inlet channel, an annular guide ramp extending along the inlet channel, an outlet for discharging purified gas flow is arranged on the guide ramp, the shaking device is used for preventing the catalyst from being discharged from the outlet and comprises a supporting structure arranged outside the outlet, a filter screen sleeved on the supporting structure, and the eccentric wheel connected with the supporting structure is used for driving the eccentric wheel to shake off a vibration motor adhered to the catalyst on the filter screen through a vibration motor. According to the invention, the high-power fan enables ozone air flow to enter the annular reaction cavity at a high speed, the ozone activation energy is reduced by utilizing the effect of high-speed impact of the air flow, the contact rate of the catalyst and the ozone air flow is improved, and the low-cost and high-efficiency degradation of ozone is realized.

title_en: Method for extracting rubidium chloride from rubidium-containing high-salt brine in short process
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of separation and purification of rubidium, and particularly discloses a method for extracting rubidium chloride from rubidium-containing high-salt brine in a short process. Firstly, adding inorganic base to rubidium-containing high-salt brine in stages to precipitate metal ion impurities such as copper, lead, zinc, magnesium and the like, and adjusting the pH value of the high-salt brine to 13-14; and then, using 4-tert-butyl-2- (alpha-methylbenzyl) phenol as an extracting agent and sulfonated kerosene as a diluent to perform extraction-washing-reverse osmosis-back extraction treatment on the high-salt brine to obtain a back extraction solution containing rubidium chloride, and sequentially performing precipitation, calcination and recrystallization treatment on the obtained back extraction solution to obtain a high-purity rubidium chloride product. The method of the invention utilizes the short extraction process to separate and purify rubidium from the high-salinity brine, shortens the extraction process on the premise of ensuring the separation effect and the recovery rate of rubidium, realizes the partial circulation of washing water, reduces the production of raffinate, and reduces the subsequent treatment cost of the brine.

title_en: Amino acid drying device
