abstract_en: The invention discloses an amino acid drying device which comprises a drying cylinder, wherein a discharging cover is arranged at the lower end of the drying cylinder, a sealing cover and a bearing cover are arranged at the upper end of the drying cylinder, the hollow structure in the drying cylinder is a stirring bin, a spiral steam pipe is arranged in the stirring bin, the spiral steam pipe consists of a spiral pipeline, an air inlet connecting pipe and an air outlet connecting pipe, the lower pipe orifice of the spiral pipeline is connected with the air inlet connecting pipe, the air inlet connecting pipe penetrates through the drying cylinder and extends out of the drying cylinder, the upper pipe orifice of the spiral pipeline is connected with the air outlet connecting pipe, and the air outlet connecting pipe penetrates through the drying cylinder and extends out of the drying cylinder. According to the amino acid drying device, the filtering of amino acid particles carried in water vapor is realized through the filter cartridge, the loss caused in the amino acid drying process is prevented, the contact area between the spiral pipeline and the amino acid can be increased, and the amino acid drying treatment is facilitated.

title_en: Dry dust remover of deashing exempts from to dismantle
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of dust removers, and discloses a disassembly-free dust remover, which comprises a cylinder body, wherein a rotary disc rotating around the axis of the rotary disc is arranged in the cylinder body, the side wall of the rotary disc is attached to the inner wall of the cylinder body, so that the inner cavity of the cylinder body is divided into an upper inner cavity and a lower inner cavity, through opening ports are formed in the rotary disc, the opening ports are arranged on the rotary disc in an annular array manner, and communicated filter cylinders are arranged at the lower ends of the opening ports; the air inlet is communicated with the lower inner cavity of the cylinder body; the air outlet is communicated with the lower inner cavity of the cylinder body; the cylinder body is internally provided with at least one air tap; the rotating structure is driven to drive the filter cylinder to rotate, so that the arranged high-pressure air nozzle can clean dust on the filter cylinder; the dust remover does not need to be disassembled and cleaned, and the use is simple and convenient.

title_en: Garbage disposal equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of garbage treatment, and discloses garbage treatment equipment, which comprises a pre-crushing device, a secondary crushing device, a first conveying device, a second conveying device and a reaction bin device, wherein the pre-crushing device is arranged on the front end of the reaction bin device; the wet garbage is pretreated by the first crushing device, and the materials with large volume are crushed into materials with smaller volume, so that the crushing difficulty of the next procedure can be reduced; the pretreated materials are conveyed to a secondary crushing device through a first conveying device, and meanwhile, waste water generated in the wet garbage conveying process can be recovered; the materials are secondarily crushed by the secondary crushing device, so that the subsequent dehydration and desalination treatment of the materials are facilitated; through the second conveyer with the material after the secondary crushing stir, dewater and the desalination after export carry out wet refuse treatment in reacting the storehouse device, and can retrieve the waste water that produces among wet refuse stirring, dehydration and the desalination course, reduce the waste water recovery degree of difficulty, solve waste water unrestrained and cause the problem of pollution to ground and air.

title_en: Distillation type water purifying device and water purifying method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of distillation type water purifying devices, in particular to a distillation type water purifying device and a water purifying method, wherein the distillation type water purifying device comprises a heating box, a distillation box and a water collecting box, a plurality of heating rods are uniformly arranged in the heating box, the distillation box is positioned in the heating box, the bottom side of the right end of the heating box is connected with a sludge discharge pipe communicated with the interior of the distillation box, a sludge suction pump is arranged on the sludge discharge pipe, the right end of the distillation box is positioned above the heating box and is connected with a water adding pipe, and the right side of the interior of the distillation box is fixedly connected with a first liquid level sensor and a second liquid level sensor; it can carry out twice cooling to sewage distillation back steam, has improved its refrigerated effect, improves the efficiency of sewage distillation purification, can carry out the reutilization to the heat, has reduced the time of heating of the sewage of heating rod in to the distillation case, has improved the speed of distillation, has improved the efficiency of distillation purification, has practiced thrift the energy, carries out make full use of to the energy, has improved the practicality of its use.

title_en: Fly ash multistage sorting system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal ash multistage separation system which comprises an original ash storage, a blower, a main pipeline, a granularity separator, a coarse ash storage, an ultrafine separator, a II-grade ash storage, an ultrafine ash storage, a steam jet milling device, an I-grade ash storage, an efficient bag-type dust collector and an ultrafine ash storage.

title_en: Biological deodorant and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a biological deodorant and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the biological deodorant comprises an adsorbent, a composite microbial inoculum, a binder, modified starch, a humectant and a penetrating agent; wherein the compound microbial inoculum is prepared by mixing saccharomycetes, lactic acid bacteria, bacillus coagulans, acetic acid bacteria and sulfur bacteria; utilize the metabolism of microorganism fungus to reach deodorant effect, and load the microorganism fungus on the active carbon surface, the active carbon plays absorbent effect to the stink molecule, the stink molecule adsorbed in the active carbon is fast by the microorganism fungus digestion decomposition of loading on it reaches good deodorization effect and avoids the jam of adsorbent simultaneously, guarantee life, and add film forming element in the component, the deodorant forms firm deodorization membrane on the rubbish surface after spraying, restrain the diffusion of stink molecule, assist the treatment of a large amount of adsorption decomposition of active carbon, reach high efficiency's deodorization effect, have higher practical application meaning.

title_en: Remote online monitoring and optimizing method for SCR efficiency of diesel engine
abstract_en: A remote online monitoring and optimizing method for SCR efficiency of a diesel engine comprises the processes of acquisition of SCR efficiency measurement signals and monitoring and optimization of the signals, wherein a signal acquisition part adopts TBOX remote terminal equipment to connect an ECU (electronic control Unit) with a cloud, and the variable configuration is well set and transmitted to the TBOX at the cloud to acquire the measurement signals; uploading data to a cloud end, and monitoring, analyzing and optimizing the data: 1) continuously recording and storing basic variables of the rotating speed, the oil mass, the torque, the vehicle speed, the ambient temperature, the water temperature, the air inflow and the SCR efficiency real-time value, and outputting an SCR efficiency real-time value graph in real time for online monitoring; meanwhile, SCR efficiency cloud data are used for feedback optimization rack calibration; 2) and continuously recording and storing the variables for SCR efficiency diagnosis including the SCR temperature, the SCR upstream NOx value, the SCR downstream NOx value, the upstream and downstream NOx release states, the exhaust gas flow rate, the urea injection amount, the stored NH3 value, the engine running mode, the SCR efficiency measured value and the SCR efficiency limit value, and automatically outputting the robustness graph after the SCR efficiency diagnosis enabling condition is met.

title_en: Municipal construction is with concrete road surface demolishs breaker
abstract_en: The invention discloses a concrete pavement overhauling and crushing device for municipal construction, which comprises a supporting plate, wherein a sleeving part vertically penetrates through the supporting plate, the crushing part is sleeved in the sleeving part in a sliding manner, and a lifting mechanism connected with the crushing part is arranged on the supporting plate; a water tank for containing water is fixedly arranged on the supporting plate, and a pumping assembly for pumping water from the water tank is arranged on the outer wall of the water tank; when the lifting mechanism works, the crushing piece is driven to move upwards, the lifting mechanism is separated from the crushing piece after the crushing piece moves to the high point of the stroke, at the moment, the crushing piece is driven to freely fall to the ground along the sleeving piece under the action of the gravity of the crushing piece, the fixing cylinder and the balancing weight in the fixing cylinder, the ground concrete pavement is crushed, and the impact force of the free falling body of the crushing piece can be improved by increasing the number of the balancing weight; and when the lifting mechanism acts, the pumping component is driven to continuously feed the water liquid in the water tank to the atomizing nozzle.

title_en: Radiation monitoring device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a radiation monitoring device, comprising: the radiation source comprises a plurality of detectors, a plurality of radiation detectors and a plurality of control units, wherein the detectors are arranged in the moving direction of the radiation source, the visual field range of the detectors is divided into two-dimensional plane grids at the position of the radiation source, and rays emitted by the radiation source are detected by at least one of the plurality of detectors in unit time intervals; a data acquisition module that acquires a signal detected by at least one of the plurality of detectors; and the data processing module is used for converting the signals acquired by the data acquisition module into digital signals with position information so as to determine the position of the radiation source. The device can position the position of the radiation source through the change of the dynamic data of the detector, give a two-dimensional image by combining an optical camera, and simultaneously identify and determine the carrier, thereby realizing early warning.

title_en: Tail gas purification and waste heat utilization method and device of hot blast stove for active carbon desorption
abstract_en: A tail gas purification and waste heat utilization method of a hot blast stove for active carbon desorption comprises the following steps: 1) conveying the multi-pollutant flue gas to an adsorption tower through a raw flue gas pipeline; 2) the method comprises the following steps that hot blast stove tail gas generated during active carbon desorption enters a first flue gas pipeline, an atomizer and a dust remover are sequentially arranged on the first flue gas pipeline, waste water is atomized through the atomizer, the atomized waste water absorbs pollutants in the hot blast stove tail gas in the first flue gas pipeline, and the hot blast stove tail gas evaporates the waste water to form flue gas containing crystallized salt; dedusting the flue gas containing the crystallized salt to obtain crystallized salt and flue gas containing ammonia; 3) the first flue gas pipeline is merged to the original flue gas pipeline, the ammonia-containing flue gas in the first flue gas pipeline is mixed with the flue gas in the original flue gas pipeline and then enters the adsorption tower, and the mixture is adsorbed and purified by the active carbon in the adsorption tower and then is discharged. The invention carries out reasonable design aiming at the respective characteristics of the hot blast stove tail gas and the acidic washing wastewater, and realizes the high-efficiency utilization of the waste heat of the hot blast stove tail gas and the zero discharge of the wastewater.

title_en: Laboratory garbage treatment device and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a laboratory garbage treatment device and a using method thereof, and the laboratory garbage treatment device comprises a laboratory table, a solid treatment box, a liquid treatment box, a first gas treatment box and a second gas treatment box, wherein a baffle is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the laboratory table, a liquid garbage treatment hopper is arranged on the laboratory table, a mixed garbage treatment hopper is arranged on the right side of the liquid garbage treatment hopper, a cross rod is arranged above a first filter plate, a material pumping pump is arranged at the right end of the collection box, and a material conveying pipe is arranged at the lower end of the material pumping pump. This laboratory refuse treatment device and application method thereof not only collects experiment rubbish, handles experiment rubbish moreover, prevents that experiment rubbish from causing secondary pollution, and separately handles experiment rubbish, prevents to cause the mutual reaction between the rubbish to reduce the remaining of experiment rubbish, make the cleaner of handling.

title_en: Power-saving protection socket special for mobile phone charging
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power-saving protection socket special for charging a mobile phone, which comprises a plug, an inserting piece, a fixed seat and a slot, wherein a permanent magnet and an electromagnet are respectively arranged at the joint of the plug and the fixed seat, the electromagnet is arranged on the fixed seat, the permanent magnet is arranged on the plug and is in homopolar opposition with the electromagnet, a first conducting layer connected with the inserting piece is arranged at the bottom of the slot and is connected with an external power supply circuit, a dust removing channel is communicated and arranged in each jack of the slot, the dust removing channel is communicated with the outside and the joint with the outside is hermetically connected with a filter screen, and a one-way valve is hermetically connected in the dust removing channel. Has the advantages that: after the plug-in sheet is fully charged, the plug-in sheet is disconnected from the slot and connected with the charging circuit, and meanwhile, external gas is input into the slot and discharged, so that the dust in the slot can be effectively removed.

title_en: Biological treatment device for organic garbage
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of garbage treatment, and particularly relates to a biological treatment device for organic garbage, which comprises a solid-liquid separation device, a fermentation device and a collection device, wherein the solid-liquid separation device comprises a filtering bin, and liquid in the garbage is discharged after the garbage passes through the filtering bin; the fermentation device comprises a stirring roller with two open ends, and the inner wall of the stirring roller is provided with a helical blade; the device is provided with a driving device for driving the stirring roller to rotate, and when the stirring roller rotates, the garbage rolls in the barrel under the action of the helical blades; the collecting device comprises a residue box, and the residue box is positioned below the outlet of the stirring roller. The device can carry out solid-liquid separation to rubbish, can not appear rubbish in the processing procedure of solid part and block up the problem of equipment, and the cooperation microorganism makes solid waste decomposed, and can clear away the stink that the decomposition process produced, avoids the processing procedure can influence the air quality, can also realize the automatic continuous operation of device, greatly promotes refuse treatment's efficiency.

title_en: Utilize wind-force driven city haze to administer auxiliary assembly with increasing humidity
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of clean energy utilization, and discloses auxiliary equipment for increasing humidity for urban haze treatment by utilizing wind power transmission, which comprises a mounting seat, the outer part of the mounting seat is movably connected with a rotating fan blade, the front end of the rotating fan blade is movably connected with a turning rod, the right side of the turning rod is movably connected with a rotating shaft, the outside of the rotating shaft is movably connected with a sliding seat, the right side of the sliding seat is movably connected with a return spring, the top of the sliding seat is movably connected with a push rod, the air flow generated by the running of the automobile can drive the rotating fan blades to rotate when in use, thereby driving the extrusion plate to extrude the cleaning spring to deform and then driving the push rod to move, thereby compressing the cleaning spring to deform and then driving the cleaning rod to move to extrude the liquid storage bag, so that the water flow stored in the liquid storage bag is sprayed into the liquid outlet groove, thereby reached the air current that produces when utilizing the car to travel and removed the effect of haze to air all around.

title_en: Municipal garden rainwater collection and treatment device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of garden water collection, and particularly relates to a municipal garden rainwater collection and treatment device which comprises a box body, wherein the bottom of the inner wall of the box body is fixedly connected with a first partition plate and a second partition plate, the box body is divided into a sedimentation cavity, a purification cavity and a water storage cavity by the first partition plate and the second partition plate, one side of the sedimentation cavity is communicated with a feeding pipe, and the top of the feeding pipe is in threaded connection with a pipe cover. According to the invention, rainwater is stored through the combined action of the water storage plate, the support plate, the first water inlet pipe, the second water inlet pipe, the sedimentation cavity, the purification cavity and the water storage cavity, the filter plate has a certain inclination angle through the combined action of the water storage plate, the support plate, the side plate and the filter plate, so that the filter plate can filter external sundries, and under the action of the inclination angle, the sundries falling onto the filter plate are washed away from the filter plate and fall off due to the gravity of the sundries and the washing of the rainwater, so that the filter plate is prevented from being blocked due to the accumulation of the sundries on the filter plate.

title_en: Counterflow rotary kiln incinerator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a counter-current rotary kiln incinerator which comprises a rotary kiln, a kiln head cover, a feeding pipeline, a secondary combustion chamber and a cooling water jacket, wherein a kiln body is provided with a feeding end part and a discharging end part, the feeding end part is provided with a feeding hole, and the discharging end part is provided with a first discharging hole; the kiln head cover is sleeved on the feeding end part and is provided with a first flue gas outlet; one part of the feeding pipeline extends into the kiln head cover, and the other part of the feeding pipeline is matched with the feeding hole; the kiln tail cover is sleeved on the discharge end part and is provided with a slag hole, and the slag hole is communicated with the first discharge hole of the kiln body; the cooling water jacket is sleeved on the feeding end part; the material is fully combusted in the countercurrent rotary kiln incinerator, the smoke is fully combusted due to the arrangement of the secondary combustion chamber, so that the emission standard of the smoke can be met, in addition, the arrangement of the cooling water jacket can effectively cool the rotary kiln incinerator, and the material is prevented from blocking a feed inlet.

title_en: Composite filter element and water purifier
abstract_en: The invention relates to a composite filter element and a water purifier with the same. The composite filter element of the invention comprises: the filter element shell assembly comprises a first shell and a second shell, wherein the first shell is provided with a first containing cavity, a raw water port and a water outlet, the raw water port and the water outlet are communicated with the first containing cavity, the second shell is linked with the first shell, the second shell is provided with a second containing cavity, a clean water port, a waste water port and a pure water port, the clean water port, the waste water port and the pure water port are communicated with the second containing cavity, and the raw water port, the water outlet, the clean water port, the waste water port and the pure water port are in the same direction; the preposed filtering component is arranged in the first accommodating cavity and is positioned between the raw water port and the water outlet; a reverse osmosis filtration assembly disposed within the second receiving cavity between the clean water port and the waste water port and between the clean water port and the clean water port.

title_en: Cement-based electroflocculation cathode material and preparation and application methods thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cement-based electroflocculation cathode material and a preparation and application method thereof, which comprises the steps of doping 0.25-1.5 parts by mass of carbon fibers subjected to dispersion treatment and 7.5-27.5 parts by mass of conductive filler into 100 parts by mass of cement, carrying out pore-forming by adopting a foaming agent and 0.5-3 parts by mass of microcrystalline cellulose, and forming a porous conductive material serving as a cathode material in an electroflocculation reaction system. When the electric flocculation reaction system is used, the carbon fiber tows embedded in the cathode material in advance can be used as leads to be connected with the negative electrode of a power supply, the positive electrode of the power supply is connected with an aluminum plate, and the electric flocculation reaction system is constructed. The cement-based electroflocculation cathode material prepared by the invention has the advantages of low cost, simple preparation process, good conductivity, good alkali resistance, reusability and the like.

title_en: Treatment device with automatic sewage flocculation effect adjustment function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water treatment environment-friendly equipment, and discloses a treatment device with an automatic sewage flocculation adjusting effect. This processing apparatus with automatically regulated sewage flocculation effect, thereby it rotates to drive the actuating lever to drive through the driving-disc drive gear, inhale the branch flow membrane upper end with the mixture of the sewage of frame top and flocculating agent when the actuating lever downswing, receive the influence of attached to the flocculate that the outer wall increases gradually, the inflow in the branch flow membrane reduces, the rotational speed of water wheels reduces the rotational speed that makes the material loading cylinder and reduces, the addition of flocculating agent reduces gradually, the mesh of practicing thrift the flocculating agent has also been realized when reaching better flocculation effect.

title_en: Equipment capable of purifying and treating acid waste gas
abstract_en: The invention relates to the relevant field of waste gas purification, in particular to equipment capable of purifying and treating acidic waste gas, which comprises a machine body, wherein a vent hole is formed in the machine body in a left-right through manner, a sliding cavity with an upward opening is formed in the lower end wall of the vent hole, an air pressure plate is arranged in the sliding cavity in a vertically sliding manner, a spring is fixedly arranged between the lower end wall of the air pressure plate and the lower end wall of the sliding cavity, relay blocks are respectively and fixedly arranged between the lower end wall of the air pressure plate and the lower end wall of the sliding cavity, a recycling device is arranged on the right side of a pushing device, the recycling device can judge whether the acid waste gas can be reused according to the concentration of a neutralized neutralizing agent, so that the utilization efficiency of the neutralizing agent is improved.

title_en: Preparation method of low-temperature denitration filter material based on water quenching method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of industrial boiler flue gas purification, in particular to a preparation method of a low-temperature denitration filter material based on a water quenching method. Firstly, mixing and stirring vanadium pentoxide powder, an organic modifier and cerous nitrate hexahydrate powder uniformly to prepare low-temperature denitration catalyst precursor emulsion; adding the low-temperature denitration catalyst precursor emulsion into a reaction kettle, and placing the filter cloth into the reaction kettle to be soaked in vacuum; finally, drying the soaked filter cloth, and calcining at a medium temperature to obtain a low-temperature denitration filter material; adding deionized water into a reaction kettle, heating and melting vanadium pentoxide powder, quickly pouring the heated and melted vanadium pentoxide powder into the deionized water, and ultrasonically stirring and dissolving; adding an organic modifier into the solution, fully stirring and uniformly mixing to obtain a stable vanadium pentoxide emulsion; and finally, adding cerous nitrate hexahydrate powder into the solution, and stirring until the cerous nitrate hexahydrate powder is completely dissolved to obtain the low-temperature denitration catalyst precursor emulsion.

title_en: Device for drawing dustproof part on side surface of case
abstract_en: The invention provides a device for drawing a dustproof part on the side surface of a case, which comprises: a drawing opening is formed in one side face of the case, and a mounting opening is formed in the front face of the case; the air inlet panel is fixedly arranged at the mounting opening and is provided with an air inlet hole; the dustproof component is connected to the drawing opening in a sliding manner; when the dustproof part slides into the drawing opening, the dustproof part is adjacent to the air inlet panel and can cover the air inlet hole. The invention has the advantages that: the dustproof part is replaced in a drawing mode, the air inlet panel does not need to be detached, the air inlet panel and the case can be designed as a whole, the operation is convenient, the assembly time is reduced, and the simplicity of the whole appearance is improved.

title_en: IT equipment fire extinguishing auxiliary device, data center micromodule and server
abstract_en: The invention provides an IT equipment fire extinguishing auxiliary device, a data center micromodule and a server, wherein the fire extinguishing auxiliary device comprises: the middle of the bracket is provided with an opening, and the lower part of the bracket is provided with a mounting structure for mounting on equipment; a flip louver having a shape and size matching the opening, the flip louver pivotally connected to the bracket to flip relative to the bracket; and the blowing devices are arranged on the side edges of the turnover skylight and are configured to move downwards along with the turnover skylight turned around the rotating shaft. By using the scheme of the invention, the fire extinguishing agent can be assisted to be rapidly diffused in the equipment, the fire extinguishing speed is effectively increased, and the safety factor of the equipment is improved.

title_en: Resin tank and water softener thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a resin tank and a water softener. The resin tank comprises a tank body, a water collecting pipe and a resin extrusion piece, wherein the water collecting pipe is arranged in the tank body, the resin extrusion piece is arranged on the water collecting pipe in an up-down sliding mode, a resin storage area is arranged in the tank body, the lower end of the water collecting pipe stretches into the resin storage area, a first water distributor positioned above a plurality of resins is arranged at the upper end of the water collecting pipe, the resin extrusion piece is positioned below the first water distributor, the resin extrusion piece can slide downwards into the resin storage area, a plurality of first water holes are formed in the resin extrusion piece, and the aperture of each first water hole is smaller than the particle size of the resin. The resin extrusion part of the resin tank can downwards extrude the resin, so that the porosity among the resins is reduced, the hardness of initial produced water is more than 0ppm, the utilization load of the initial stage of the resin is reduced, the increase of the whole machine period water production amount under the same salt consumption condition can be realized, and the interval between two regeneration periods is prolonged, so that the regeneration times can be reduced in the same time, and the effects of saving salt and water can be achieved.

title_en: Livestock and poultry manure humidity control conveying system and application method
abstract_en: The application discloses a livestock and poultry manure humidity control conveying system, which relates to the technical field of livestock and poultry manure, and comprises a dehydration conveying belt, an air pump, an air heating box and an air dryer; the dewatering conveyor belt comprises a heat-insulating outer cover covered outside the conveyor belt assembly; a plurality of hot air outlet pipes are distributed in the heat preservation outer cover, two ends of each hot air outlet pipe are fixed on the side wall of the heat preservation outer cover, and one end of each hot air outlet pipe is communicated with an air inlet main pipe; a plurality of air return suction heads are also distributed on the inner side of the conveyor belt; the air suction header pipe is communicated with the air inlet of the air dryer through the outer pipe, and the drying air outlet of the air dryer is communicated with the air inlet of the air pump; the air outlet of the air pump is communicated with the air inlet of the air heating box; and an air outlet of the air heating box is communicated with the air inlet main pipe. The application has the advantages of remarkably improving the humidity control effect of the livestock and poultry manure raw material, improving the production efficiency and the like.

title_en: Method for dechlorinating dried ash
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for removing chlorine from dried ash, which comprises the following steps: step 1, washing and dechlorinating the dried ash to obtain a washing slag phase and a liquid phase; step 2, grinding and mixing the slag phase obtained by suction filtration in the step 1 and a dechlorinating agent to obtain a ground and mixed dried ash slag; the dechlorinating agent is added, and the chlorine removal can be promoted more effectively under the condition of uniform grinding and mixing. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the invention provides an efficient and simple dechlorination method which can remove soluble chlorine, insoluble chlorine and chloride existing in organic matters in dried ash. Insoluble chloride in the dried ash and chloride in organic matters can be decomposed and converted into soluble chloride, and the total chlorine content and heavy metal content in the dried ash are greatly reduced in a short time. The method has simple process, overcomes the problem of low removal efficiency of insoluble chlorine in the washing process, and promotes the high-efficiency resource utilization of the dried ash.

title_en: Automatic packing and collecting device for kitchen waste
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic kitchen waste packaging and collecting device, which relates to the field of kitchen waste treatment and comprises a main collecting box, wherein a non-slip mat is horizontally and fixedly bonded on the bottom surface of the main collecting box, a control key is connected with one side edge of the main collecting box through a bolt, a main power line is inserted into the side edge of the main collecting box in an inserting mode, a plug is fixedly sleeved at one end, far away from the main collecting box, of the main power line, a feeding port is horizontally formed in the top surface of the main collecting box, L-shaped grooves are horizontally and symmetrically formed in one side edge of the main collecting box, U-shaped loop bars are horizontally inserted into the inner side edge of each L-shaped groove, a loop box is connected with one side edge of the main collecting. The device has a simple design structure, is convenient and quick to operate, adopts an automatic design to realize the whole sealing process from the bag body placement to the bag body sealing, saves labor and is safer and more sanitary.

title_en: Denitration system and process adopting staged combustion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a denitration system and a denitration process adopting staged combustion, which belong to the technical field of cement production. The invention adopts the decomposing furnace in a staged combustion mode, increases the retention time of gas in a reduction zone by adjusting the air inlet amount of a tertiary air pipe and increasing the reduction zone of the decomposing furnace, realizes the control of the generation amount of nitrogen oxide in the production process under the support of introducing secondary fuel into a first furnace inlet pipeline and a second furnace inlet pipeline in the decomposing furnace, meets the ultra-low emission requirement and reduces the pollution to the atmospheric environment.

title_en: Electrical control cabinet
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electrical control cabinet which comprises an electrical control cabinet body, wherein an air outlet is formed in the inner wall of the right side of the electrical control cabinet body, a dustproof net is movably sleeved in the air outlet, the dustproof net is fixed on the right side of the electrical control cabinet body in a threaded mode, a V-shaped protection plate is arranged above the electrical control cabinet body, a fixed block is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the V-shaped protection plate, a rectangular pipe is fixedly arranged at the top of the electrical control cabinet body, and the rectangular pipe is sleeved on the fixed block in a sliding mode. The electric control cabinet is reasonable in design, the heat dissipation fan is conveniently and automatically started to dissipate heat when the temperature in the electric control cabinet body is higher than the preset temperature, the heat dissipation efficiency is improved, the dust guard plate is convenient to vibrate left and right in a continuous circulation mode during heat dissipation, dust particles attached to the right side of the dust guard plate can be effectively shaken down by matching with the inclined arrangement mode of the dust guard plate, the blocking phenomenon is relieved, normal and stable air entering is guaranteed, the dust guard plate can be taken out to be cleaned, and the use requirement is met.

title_en: Air inlet system of garbage disposal equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of garbage disposal, and discloses an air inlet system of garbage disposal equipment, which comprises: the air treatment device is used for pressurizing and heating air; one end of the air supply main pipe is communicated with the air outlet of the air treatment device, the other end of the air supply main pipe is arranged in a closed manner, and a plurality of air exhaust ports are arranged on the air supply main pipe; the quantity of dispersion pipe equals with the quantity of gas vent, and a plurality of dispersion pipes set up with a plurality of gas vents one-to-one, and the air inlet of dispersion pipe is connected on the gas vent, and the gas outlet of dispersion pipe sets up towards the material in the material storehouse, and the dispersion pipe is arranged in being arranged in with air water conservancy diversion to the material. Through the structure, the air inlet system of the garbage disposal equipment can uniformly introduce high-temperature air into the material, so that the evaporation of the material can be ensured, and microorganisms can not be killed.

title_en: Production process of organic contaminated soil improvement particles
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of organic contaminated soil, and discloses a production process of organic contaminated soil improvement particles, which has higher production efficiency, is simpler, saves relatively cost and is more convenient for operators by adopting a preparation mode compared with the existing production process of the organic contaminated soil improvement particles, and the production process of the organic contaminated soil improvement particles has the advantages that after materials are put into a storage tank according to uniform proportion, the storage pipe needs to be opened regularly to watch the internal condition when the storage pipe is kept still, when obvious precipitation is found to be generated in the storage tank, a part of water in the storage tank needs to be taken out by a vessel, and then stirring equipment is utilized to mix the water, so that the materials are prevented from being not viscous enough to cause unsmooth subsequent forming process, resulting in the need for rework and waste.

title_en: Embedded utilize electrostatic adsorption to purify automobile exhaust's device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an embedded device for purifying automobile exhaust by electrostatic adsorption, which comprises an exhaust pipe, wherein an exhaust cavity which is communicated up and down is arranged in the exhaust pipe, a sliding belt is connected between the front wall and the rear wall of the exhaust cavity in a sliding way, a light weight embedding shaft, a transmission shaft and two annular shafts are rotatably connected between the front wall and the rear wall of the exhaust cavity, a light weight wheel is fixedly connected on the outer peripheral surface of the light weight embedding shaft, and four rotating rods are fixedly connected on the outer peripheral surface of the light weight wheel.

title_en: RTO waste gas efficient removal system and removal method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an RTO waste gas high-efficiency removal system, which comprises a main control machine, wherein the main control machine is connected with a waste gas conveying subsystem, a waste gas detection subsystem, a preheating processing subsystem, a waste gas processing subsystem, a tail gas detection and discharge subsystem and a backflow processing subsystem through a serial communication line, the concentration of waste gas can be detected and adjusted before the waste gas is processed through the arrangement of the waste gas detection subsystem, so that the possibility of explosion of combustible gas in the waste gas is reduced, the safety and the reliability in the processing process are improved, the waste gas can be preheated through the preheating processing subsystem before the waste gas is subjected to combustion processing, the energy consumption in the waste gas heating process is reduced, the utilization efficiency of energy is improved, the waste gas processing effect can be effectively improved through the tail gas detection and discharge subsystem and the backflow processing subsystem, and the waste gas residue is reduced, avoiding secondary pollution to the environment.

title_en: Nitrogen non-transferred arc plasma ship solid waste heat treatment method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the relevant technical field of waste disposal, and discloses a nitrogen non-transferred arc plasma ship solid waste heat disposal method and a system, wherein the system comprises a garbage storage tank, a primary crusher, a sundries separator, a secondary grinder, a plasma cracking furnace, a secondary combustion chamber, an electrostatic separator, an ash deposition chamber and a packaging and packing device which are sequentially connected, and a liquid cooling device, an air supply device, an oxygen generation device and a flue gas treatment device are sequentially connected; the flue gas treatment equipment is connected with the electrostatic separator, the liquid cooling device is connected with the plasma cracking furnace, and the air supply device is connected with the secondary combustion chamber; the nitrogen generating device is respectively connected with the inlet of the sundries separator, the plasma cracking furnace, the secondary grinding machine and the sundries separator; the electrostatic separator is connected with the inlet of the secondary grinding machine, and the sundries separator is connected with the packaging and packaging device. The system has simple structure, no pollution and high volume reduction.

title_en: Ozone injection device for ozone denitration
abstract_en: The invention provides an ozone injection device for ozone denitration, which relates to the technical field of flue gas purification and comprises a main pipe, a plurality of mutually parallel branch pipes which are communicated with the main pipe and are arranged at equal intervals, a first fixed frame and a plurality of baffles arranged on the first fixed frame, wherein a plurality of injection pipes are vertically arranged on any branch pipe in the axial direction, and the baffles are in one-to-one correspondence with the positions and the number of the injection pipes; the nozzle of the injection pipe faces the baffle plate, and the injection direction of the nozzle is the same as the inflow direction of the flue gas; after the ozone is sprayed out of the nozzle, the device is blocked by the baffle to form strong disturbance, so that the ozone and the flue gas are fully mixed, the flue gas is fully treated, and the efficiency of ozone denitration is improved.

title_en: Flying saucer type deep ultraviolet LED sterilizing device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flying saucer type deep ultraviolet LED sterilization device which comprises LED sterilization lamp beads, an LED sterilization main body panel, an LED sterilization surface cover, a switch decoration ring and a rubber laminating disc, wherein the LED sterilization main body panel, the switch decoration ring and the LED sterilization surface cover are combined into an LED sterilization box, the LED sterilization main body panel and the LED sterilization surface cover are buckled together to form a flying saucer type structure, the LED sterilization main body panel is positioned on the LED sterilization surface cover, and switch decoration parts are arranged on the upper edge of the LED sterilization main body panel and the lower edge of the LED sterilization surface cover. The invention has simple structure and convenient operation, not only overcomes the technical defects in the prior art, but also has great application value in the field of sterilization of kitchenware and medical instruments.

title_en: Demisting method and device based on rotary screen drum
abstract_en: The invention discloses a defogging method and a defogging device based on a rotary screen drum. Flue gas flows and is inhaled into a sieve section of thick bamboo defroster by rotatory sieve section of thick bamboo defroster entrainment, under inertial separation and centrifugal separation's dual function, the effectual defogging dust collection efficiency who improves the flue gas. When the operation condition of the desulfurization system changes, the rotating speed of the worm gear mechanism is adjusted to adjust the rotating angle of the demister of the screen drum to adapt to the flowing conditions of different flue gases. And washing the demister of the screen drum through the annular washing water demisting system and the scraper. This device combines together inertial separation, centrifugal separation and coagulation dust removal, adopts worm gear mechanism to realize that the surface of full operating mode sieve section of thick bamboo is clean, has that defogging dust removal efficiency is high, the flue gas flow resistance is little, the washing water yield is few and do not have dead angle, the energy consumption is low, operating mode adaptability is wide etc. characteristics, can effectual reduction "gypsum rain" form.

title_en: Deep sea water intake development and comprehensive utilization ocean platform and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a deep sea water intake development and comprehensive utilization ocean platform, wherein a platform main body comprises an upper deck and a buoyancy tank of which the plane view angle is profiled, the upper deck comprises a central area and three extending parts which extend from the central area to the periphery and are arranged at equal angles, and the lower parts of the extending parts are fixedly connected with the buoyancy tank through corner upright posts; the center part of the platform main body between the upper deck and the buoyancy tank is provided with a center upright post for storing deep sea water and increasing the waterline area; a deep sea water utilization facility is arranged in a central area above the upper deck; the deep sea water utilizing facility is connected with a plurality of deep sea water intake pipes, surface sea water intake pipes and mixed sea water drain pipes, and the deep sea water intake pipes, the surface sea water intake pipes and the mixed sea water drain pipes extend downwards into sea water through the upper deck.

title_en: Treatment system and treatment method for melamine impregnated paper production wastewater
abstract_en: The invention provides a system and a method for treating wastewater generated in melamine impregnated paper production, which comprises the following steps: the bottom discharge port of the polycondensation reactor is connected with the inlet of the polycondensation sludge filter press through a pipeline; the filtrate outlet of the polycondensation sludge filter press is connected with the water inlet of the oxidation coagulation reactor through a pipeline; the bottom discharge hole of the oxidation coagulation reactor is connected with the inlet of the oxidation sludge filter press through a pipeline; the filtrate outlet of the oxidation sludge filter press is connected with the water inlet of the high-efficiency biological denitrification pool through a pipeline; the upper part of the high-efficiency biological denitrification tank is provided with a backwater discharge port which is communicated with a discharge water tank through a pipeline. The invention has simple structure and convenient operation, the COD of the wastewater after biochemical treatment can be reduced to be below 100mg/L, the ammonia nitrogen can be reduced to be below 10mg/L, the total nitrogen can be reduced to be below 20mg/L, and the formaldehyde can be reduced to be below 1 mg/L.

title_en: Novel energy-saving environment-friendly continuous charcoal making process for palm shells
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel energy-saving environment-friendly continuous charcoal making process for palm shells, which comprises the following steps: firstly, drying the palm shell raw material, then carrying out a preheating test of a carbonizing machine, carbonizing the palm shell raw material, and finally carrying out treatment on a carbonized product. In discharging into the filter through the vapor that will dry the production, through the effect of filter screen, play the filter effect to it, and through the effect of flabellum for the flow of vapor can drive the flabellum and rotate and then drive the filter screen and rotate, can prevent that water from leading to the fact the jam of filter screen on attached to the filter screen, and the water of throwing away on the filter screen can be stayed in the filter, and the accessible outlet is with its discharge.

title_en: Integrated seawater wet desulphurization washing tower for ship
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integrated seawater wet-generation desulfurization washing tower for ships, which comprises a tower body, an air inlet mechanism, a washing mechanism and a discharging mechanism, wherein a liquid inlet pipe is arranged on the outer side surface of one side of the tower body, a plurality of liquid guide pipes are arranged on the side surface of one side of the liquid inlet pipe, the air inlet mechanism is arranged on the tower body, and the air inlet mechanism consists of a first mounting plate, an air compressor, an air guide pipe, a mixing box, a spiral pipe, an air inlet pipe and a connecting pipe. The invention has simple structure, the waste gas can be uniformly and fully mixed with the introduced oxygen, the CaSO3 is ensured to be oxidized into CaSO4 (gypsum), the subsequent washing effect is improved, the slurry is washed quantitatively and in multiple stages during washing, the mixed gas is fully contacted with the slurry by matching with mixing and stirring, the desulfurization efficiency and the utilization rate of a slurry absorbent are higher, the increase of subsequent treatment cost caused by the generation of more waste water is avoided, and meanwhile, the precipitate separated from CaSO4 crystal can be scraped out by matching with the rotation in the mixing and stirring process, so that the blockage in the device is prevented.

title_en: Waste water treatment device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wastewater treatment device, comprising: the separator comprises a waste water storage area, a distillate storage area and a concentrated solution area; the condenser is used for introducing steam subjected to heat exchange by the heater, condensing the steam and conveying the steam to the distillate storage area, and meanwhile, utilizing the steam to perform heat exchange preheating on the wastewater and conveying the wastewater to the wastewater storage area; the heater is used for introducing steam and wastewater, heating the wastewater by using the steam, discharging the wastewater to the wastewater storage area to form wastewater steam, and introducing the steam after heat exchange into the condenser; the demister is arranged in the separator and used for intercepting and demisting the waste water steam generated by the heater and conveying the intercepted substances to the concentrated solution area. The waste water treatment device of the invention not only has small floor area and low cost, but also is especially suitable for waste water which has small treatment capacity and needs concentration treatment. The pipeline is simple, the installation is convenient, only need put through a small amount of pipelines and install the completion, improves installation effectiveness and installation rate of accuracy.

title_en: Sewage treatment device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sewage treatment, and discloses a sewage treatment device, which comprises a tank body and a plurality of grid barrels arranged in the tank body; wherein, the upper part of the tank body is provided with a water inlet and a water outlet; each grid barrel comprises a barrel body, an upper fixed grid and a lower fixed grid which are arranged in the barrel body at intervals up and down, a packing layer is arranged between the upper fixed grid and the lower fixed grid, and an aeration pipe is arranged below the lower fixed grid; the multiple cell barrels are sequentially communicated through the water guide pipe, the first end of the water guide pipe is located at the bottom of one cell barrel, and the second end of the water guide pipe is located at the top of the adjacent cell barrel. According to the sewage treatment device provided by the embodiment of the invention, the plurality of grid barrels are arranged in the tank body to sequentially treat sewage, so that microorganisms in the sewage can be trained to form a hierarchical food chain relation, and the sewage can be discharged up to the standard without personnel on-site maintenance and operation and unattended operation.

title_en: Deep well aeration wastewater treatment device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of wastewater treatment, and particularly relates to a deep well aeration wastewater treatment device which comprises a deep well and a top tank, wherein the top of the deep well is communicated with the bottom of the top tank; the deep well comprises an inner cylinder and an outer cylinder, and the inner cylinder and the outer cylinder are of concentric circle structures; the top of the inner cylinder body is in a sealed state, and the bottom of the inner cylinder body is communicated with the outer cylinder body; the top of the inner cylinder is provided with a sewage pipe and a sludge pipe which are communicated with the inner cylinder; a first mixing module is arranged in the inner cylinder body; the first mixing module comprises a fixing plate, a motor, a waterproof box, a rotating disc and a snake-shaped plate; the fixed plate is positioned in the inner cylinder and is fixed on the inner wall of the inner cylinder along the radial direction of the inner cylinder; the fixed plate is fixedly connected with a waterproof box; a motor is arranged in the waterproof box and is fixed at the bottom of the waterproof box through a motor bracket; the deep well aeration device is mainly used for solving the problem that the deep well aeration device in the prior art is low in aeration efficiency and further affects oxygen transfer level.

title_en: Method for waste energy storage coupling purification of eutrophic water body
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for purifying and coupling eutrophic water body with waste energy storage, which utilizes waste wind, light and electricity to provide energy to place the eutrophic water body in a reservoir arranged at a high place in advance, and converts the waste energy into gravitational potential energy for storage; the water in the reservoir is controlled from high to low by the grid under the action of gravity, the flow velocity of the water is controlled by the grid, the eutrophic sewage is purified and utilized by utilizing the action of the root system of the plant, and the resource utilization rate can be further improved by hydroelectric generation when the water is in a plateau area; compared with the traditional method for treating eutrophic sewage, the method fully utilizes the waste energy generated by the rapid development of new energy in China at present, treats the sewage, effectively utilizes the waste energy, effectively utilizes nitrogen and phosphorus resources in the eutrophic water body, saves the use of fertilizer, reduces the harm of the fertilizer to the environment, and has multiple effects of economic benefit, social benefit and ecological benefit.

title_en: Method for treating waste gas pollutants of sugar manufacturing enterprise
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure disclose methods for treating exhaust gas pollutants of sugar manufacturing enterprises. One embodiment of the method comprises: determining the waste gas pollutant information of a target enterprise; determining the exhaust gas pollutant emission amount corresponding to the exhaust gas pollutant information by adopting a corresponding accounting method according to the determined exhaust gas pollutant information; and treating the exhaust pollutants according to the determined exhaust pollutant information and the determined exhaust pollutant discharge amount, wherein the mode for treating the exhaust pollutants comprises at least one of the following modes: spraying absorption tower treatment, low-temperature plasma waste gas treatment equipment treatment and purification absorption tower treatment. The embodiment realizes the improvement of the accuracy of the accounting result and the targeted treatment of the exhaust gas pollutants.

title_en: Method for increasing source searching distance based on cross-correlation technology
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of radioactive sources, in particular to a method for improving a source searching distance based on a cross-correlation technology, which comprises the following steps: step 1, arranging two or more than two nuclear radiation detectors; step 2, preprocessing the detected signal through a signal preprocessing circuit; step 3, counting pulse signals of the signals processed in the step 2 through a counter or sampling voltage signals through an analog-to-digital converter; step 4, acquiring data signals through a signal acquisition and cross-correlation calculation module, and performing cross-correlation calculation on the data signals; and 5, when the cross-correlation calculation result has a local maximum value, determining that the radioactive source exists. The method adopts a cross-correlation algorithm, can obviously eliminate the interference of the nuclear radiation background of the natural environment on the measured data, can improve the source searching distance by 1.5 times to 2.5 times compared with the conventional source searching system, obviously improves the distance for searching the radioactive source, finds the radioactive source in time and reduces the probability of radiation accidents.

title_en: Micro optical fiber coupling light source system for photocatalytic reaction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a micro optical fiber coupling light source system for photocatalytic reaction, which comprises a photocatalytic reaction module and a reaction medium, wherein the photocatalytic reaction optical fiber module is specifically a light transmitting beam, a first end face of the light transmitting beam is a coupling surface, the second end face of the light transmitting beam is provided with the reaction medium, the reaction medium consists of a plurality of hollow micro optical fiber bundles, and the area of the first end face of the light transmitting beam is smaller than that of the second end face of the light transmitting beam; the invention provides a micro optical fiber structure for realizing photocatalysis, wherein the light transmitting beam is composed of a light transmitting beam and a hollow micro optical fiber bundle, the catalytic reaction of a plurality of optical fiber bundles can be completed in batches, the catalytic efficiency is improved, meanwhile, the light transmitting beam is coupled by adopting a large-area array structure, the light sources coupled into the micro optical fiber bundle can be ensured to enter at 0 degree, different divergence angles can not exist, and the uniformity of the catalysis is ensured.

title_en: Lean burn engine aftertreatment system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lean burn engine aftertreatment system, comprising: a multi-catalyst base comprising an APC catalyst housing, an SCR catalyst housing surrounding the APC catalyst housing, and a CUC housing surrounding the SCR catalyst housing; a first housing enclosing the multiple catalyst base; a sleeve comprising a first tube connected to a forward end of the APC catalyst housing and a rearward end of the TWC housing and a second tube surrounding the first tube and connected to the first housing; and an exhaust gas treatment unit connected to a rear end of the CUC housing. At least one perforation is formed in an inner surface and an outer surface of each of the first tube, the APC catalyst housing and the SCR catalyst housing, and an inner surface of the CUC housing.

title_en: Method for purifying salt mother liquor slurry by flue gas method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of salt making, and particularly relates to a method for purifying salt making mother liquor slurry by a flue gas method, wherein a flue gas pipeline reactor is adopted to convey the mother liquor slurry mixed with solid and liquid salt and nitrate to be mixed with unsaturated crude halogen, pressurized flue gas is introduced, a carbonization reaction is simultaneously carried out in the pipeline in a circulating manner, the pH value is 8.5-9.0, the mixture is stopped, gas-liquid separation is carried out, then the mixture is filtered by an ultrafiltration membrane, and filtrate is recycled to a vacuum salt making triple-effect evaporation tank to prepare liquid salt by connecting nitrate and salt or a nanofiltration membrane; the filtered and solidified salty mud is applied to purifying flue gas through pretreatment, and the purified flue gas is applied to mother liquor slurry purification after being secondarily purified by a water circulation compressor. The method utilizes the pressurized flue gas pipeline to convey the mother liquor slurry and simultaneously carry out carbonization reaction, simplifies the purification process and obviously improves the carbonization reaction rate; adopting unsaturated original halogen to utilize two alkalis in the mother liquor slurry and dissolve solid salt and nitre in the mother liquor slurry; the salty mud is applied to purifying flue gas through pretreatment, and impurity gas and smoke dust particles in the flue gas are removed.

title_en: Courtyard rainwater collecting and utilizing system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a courtyard rainwater collecting and utilizing system and a courtyard rainwater collecting and utilizing method. The water collecting system comprises a water collecting tank and a first water level sensor, and a third valve is further arranged at the bottom of the water collecting tank; the initial rainwater collecting system comprises an initial water storage tank, the initial water storage tank is connected with a third valve through a drain pipe, a fourth valve is arranged in the initial water storage tank and divides the initial water storage tank into an upper-layer water storage tank and a lower-layer water storage tank, a second water level sensor is arranged in the lower-layer water storage tank, a fifth valve is further arranged at the bottom of the lower-layer water storage tank and is connected with a filtering system through a drain pipe; the water storage system comprises a water storage tank and a third water level sensor. Handle the initial stage rainwater according to the actual conditions, the maximize carries out courtyard rainwater and collects the utilization, utilizes the rainwater of cistern to clean for the primary screen device, prevents that the silt and the impurity that accumulate from hindering the circulation of rainwater.

title_en: Aerial fog mixed flow air curtain smoke protection device
abstract_en: The utility model provides an aerial fog mixed flow air curtain smoke protection device, which comprises an outer shell, the shell front side is equipped with the air intake, the shell bottom is equipped with the storage water tank, the inside mixing chamber that is used for aerial fog to mix that is equipped with of shell, inside fixed ann first motor and impeller of mixing chamber, the mixing chamber downside is equipped with the cistern, the cistern is connected with the storage water tank through automatic water supply valve, be equipped with into fog mouth between mixing chamber and the cistern, mixing chamber and air discharge chamber intercommunication, inside fixed mounting second motor of air discharge chamber and fan impeller, the air discharge chamber downside is equipped with the air outlet, shell side fixed mounting control box. The smoke-proof device can generate an air curtain of mixed flow of aerial fog, and the gas flow which traverses the jet flow surface is stopped by the difference of the internal pressure and the external pressure of the curtain to block the diffusion of the flue gas. The water mist particles can be combined with and adhered to smoke dust particles in the air, and absorb the heat of a fire scene, so that the smoke prevention efficiency of the gas mist mixed flow air curtain is greatly improved.

title_en: Catalyst for removing formaldehyde and carbon monoxide by catalysis and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a catalyst for removing formaldehyde and carbon monoxide by catalysis and a preparation method thereof, wherein the general formula of the catalyst is A/Ce-TiO 2 (ii)/g-C3N 4; wherein A is one of Pt, Pd and Au, and A is a noble metal; wherein the loading amount of A is 0.1-1 wt%, and the balance is Ce-TiO 2 /g‑C3N4；Ce/TiO 2 The mass ratio of (A) to (B) is 0.3-3%; TiO 2 2 The mass ratio of/g-C3N 4 is 0.1-2. The catalyst of the invention is Ce-TiO assisted by visible light 2 the/g-C3N 4 composite carrier has high photocatalytic efficiency, and the existence of proper amount of Ce remarkably promotes double active sites to generate active oxygen species with high oxidizability for the oxidative decomposition of indoor formaldehyde and CO, thereby obtaining high formaldehyde and CO decomposition rate and high catalytic stability; the catalyst has extremely high catalytic efficiency even under the condition of high airflow speed.

title_en: Ecological landscape floating island
abstract_en: The ecological landscape floating island comprises a submerged tank, an air circulation device, a water circulation device, a lifting mechanism and a PLC (programmable logic controller), wherein the submerged tank comprises a tank body, a cultivation platform, a lifting mechanism, a sealing top cover, a back-image cover and a driving motor, the tank body comprises an air inlet, an air outlet, a water inlet, a water outlet and a display opening on the vertical top surface, the cultivation platform is arranged in the tank body and is in sliding fit in the vertical direction, the cultivation platform comprises a planting layer and a water channel positioned vertically below the planting layer, the lifting mechanism drives the cultivation platform to lift to the display opening or to be contained in the tank body, the water circulation device, the water channel, the water inlet and the water outlet are in sealing connection through corrugated pipes, the sealing top cover is in rotary unsealing fit with the display opening of the tank body, the back-image cover is arranged on one side of the landscape floating island facing the bank and is hinged with the tank body, and the driving motor drives the sealing top cover and the back-image cover to turn over, and the lifting mechanism drives the submerged tank to move up and down relative to the water surface.

title_en: Regenerated type electric adsorption desalting system for wastewater treatment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regenerated electro-adsorption desalting system for wastewater treatment, which relates to the technical field of wastewater treatment and comprises an electro-adsorption desalting box, a mounting rack, a connecting shaft, a sealing plate, an activated carbon electrode, a sealing groove, a first mounting groove, a first sealing gasket, a slot and a cutting. According to the invention, the sealing effect of the electro-adsorption desalting box can be effectively enhanced, the stability and the sealing performance of the electro-adsorption desalting box during the rotation of the mounting frame can be effectively ensured, when the active carbon electrode is switched, the surface of the active carbon electrode is tightly adhered by the first sealing gasket, the active carbon electrode can be switched without stopping, the cleaning operation of the active carbon electrode is convenient and quick, the working efficiency is high, the outer wall of the sealing plate is tightly pressed by the second sealing gasket, the sealing connection effect of the sealing plate and the sealing groove can be further enhanced, the sealing performance of the electro-adsorption desalting box is better, the connecting block and the sealing plate are tightly pressed by the torsion spring, and the sealing performance of the electro-adsorption desalting box can be further enhanced.

title_en: Line lamp control transformer with automatic dustproof mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable lamp control transformer with an automatic dustproof mechanism, which comprises a connecting seat, a dustproof mechanism, a rotor barrel, a dust removal plate, a coil, a dust collection box, a portable lamp control transformer and a heat dissipation plate, wherein the dustproof mechanism is arranged at the top end of the connecting seat, the rotor barrel is arranged in the dustproof mechanism, the dust removal plate is arranged on the dustproof mechanism, the coil is arranged in the rotor barrel, the dust collection box is arranged at the bottom end of the dustproof mechanism, the portable lamp control transformer is arranged at the bottom end of the connecting seat, and the heat dissipation plate is arranged at the top of the dustproof mechanism. The dustproof structure is arranged, so that dust in the portable lamp control transformer can be cleaned in time, the stable operation of the machine body is ensured, and the service life of the portable lamp control transformer can be prolonged.

title_en: Radiation imaging apparatus, method for manufacturing radiation imaging apparatus, and method for repairing radiation imaging apparatus
abstract_en: A radiation imaging device according to an embodiment includes: a radiation detection panel having a1 st surface on which a detection region is formed and an electrode pad is formed outside the detection region, and a 2 nd surface on the opposite side of the 1 st surface; a base substrate having a support surface which faces the 2 nd surface of the radiation detection panel and supports the radiation detection panel; and a flexible circuit board connected to the electrode pad via a connection member; the end of the base substrate is located at a position closer to the inner side than the inner side end of the connecting region where the electrode pad, the connecting member and the flexible circuit substrate overlap, as viewed in the Z direction orthogonal to the supporting surface.

title_en: Dustbin with automatic opening and closing box cover
abstract_en: A dustbin with a dustbin cover capable of being automatically opened and closed comprises a dustbin body and a dustbin cover, wherein the dustbin cover is connected to the dustbin body through a pivot mechanism, an opening button and a closing button are arranged at the lower part of the dustbin body, a mounting table is arranged at the top of one side face of the dustbin body, and the pivot mechanism is mounted on the mounting table; the electric control board is fixed on the box body, the electric control board comprises a control circuit and is used for carrying out program control on the action sequence of the electric appliance parts, and the on button and the off button are electrically connected with the electric control board; the end part of the box cover is provided with a connecting part which is connected with the two ends of the pivot, and the box cover is driven to rotate through the rotation of the pivot so as to realize opening or closing. The invention is suitable for household use and community use at the same time, and only the volume is required to be changed; the opening button of the box cover is arranged at the lower part of the box body, so that the bending operation of a garbage placer is avoided, and meanwhile, the box cover is arranged and is driven to rotate by the driving motor, so that the box cover is opened stably, and the overturning condition is avoided.

title_en: Water ecological restoration method based on microscopic habitat improvement
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of water ecological restoration. The invention provides a water ecological restoration method based on microscopic habitat improvement, which comprises the steps of water body improvement, sediment improvement, interface dissolved oxygen improvement and aquatic plant reconstruction; the passing mass concentration of the water body for improving is 0.05-1 kg/m 3 The water quality purifying material is used for realizing; the improvement of the bottom mud is 0.5-4 kg/m through mass concentration 2 The bottom mud repairing material is adopted; the mass concentration of the dissolved oxygen at the interface is 0.5-1 kg/m 2 The interfacial dissolved oxygen regulating material of (1); the reconstitution of the aquatic plant is effected by an aquatic plant seed, propagule or aquatic plant. The invention obviously improves the transparency of the water body, the water quality index and the interface microenvironment by improving the water, soil and gas three-phase microcosmic environment of the polluted rivers and lakes in situ, and is an aquatic plantThe good habitat foundation is laid for the growth, the planting and the propagation.

title_en: Low-temperature section dryer
abstract_en: A low-temperature section dryer comprises a closed box body and belt type wet material conveying mechanisms, wherein the conveying mechanisms comprise conveying belts and belt pulleys, at least an upper layer conveying mechanism and a lower layer conveying mechanism are arranged in the box body, a flow guiding inclined plate is arranged between the upper layer conveying mechanism and the lower layer conveying mechanism, a wet material or sludge feeding port is arranged at the top of the box body and corresponds to the starting end of the upper layer conveying mechanism, a wet material or sludge discharging port is arranged at the bottom of the box body and corresponds to the tail end of the lower layer conveying mechanism, a waste gas/smoke circulation channel parallel to the lower layer conveying mechanism along the length direction is arranged below each layer conveying mechanism, one end of the upper layer circulation channel and one end of the lower layer circulation channel are connected and communicated through a communicating pipe to form a U shape, a waste gas/smoke gas outlet and a waste gas/smoke gas inlet are arranged at the other end of the upper layer circulation channel, a U-shaped hot air medium channel is formed in a space above the upper layer circulation channel and a lower layer circulation channel in the box body, a hot air outlet is formed in the upper layer of the box body, a hot air inlet is formed in the lower layer of the box body, and a steam cavity is formed in the top surface of the box body. The temperature and the water content of the outlet air of the dryer are increased, and the drying capacity and the drying efficiency of unit drying media (air) are improved.

title_en: Structure and system for adjusting flue gas conditioning agent
abstract_en: The invention provides a structure for adjusting a flue gas conditioning agent and a system thereof, wherein the structure comprises: the smoke dust specific resistance tester is electrically connected with the tempering solution control box, the smoke dust flow tester is electrically connected with the tempering solution control box, the tempering solution control box is used for regulating and controlling the flow of a tempering agent and the flow of demineralized water, and the tempering agent solution is prepared by regulating and controlling the flow of the tempering agent and the flow of the demineralized water; the conditioning agent solution is convenient to prepare, the fly ash specific resistance in the smoke dust can be reduced, and the dust removal efficiency is improved.

title_en: Clothes drying equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of clothes drying, and aims to solve the problems that the filtering and collecting modes of the traditional clothes drying equipment are poor and the use experience of a user is affected. The invention provides clothes drying equipment, which comprises a box body assembly, a clothes drying cylinder and a filtering device, wherein the box body assembly comprises a front panel and a front supporting mechanism, a clothes throwing port communicated with the inside of the clothes drying cylinder is formed in the front panel, the filtering device comprises an annular filtering member, a thread scrap cleaning member and a thread scrap collecting member, the annular filtering member is arranged between the front supporting mechanism and the clothes drying cylinder, the thread scrap cleaning member and the thread scrap collecting member are both arranged on the front supporting mechanism, the annular filtering member can rotate along with the clothes drying cylinder, and in the rotating process of the annular filtering member, the thread scrap cleaning member can clean thread scraps on the annular filtering member and the thread scrap collecting member can collect the cleaned thread scraps. The invention can improve the filings filtering effect of the clothes drying equipment and is convenient for users to use.

title_en: Comprehensive utilization device for rainwater on top of building
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water resource utilization, in particular to a comprehensive utilization device for rainwater on the top of a building, which comprises a building main body, wherein a rainwater collecting seat is fixedly installed on the top of the building main body, a power generation filtering component is installed on the inner side of the rainwater collecting seat, a water delivery pump communicated with the bottom of the lower side space of the power generation filtering component is installed on the outer side of the rainwater collecting seat, and a rainwater output pipeline is connected to the outlet of the water delivery pump; the top of the rain collecting seat is also provided with a plurality of adjustable power generation rain assemblies in a circumferential distribution manner, and the adjustable power generation rain assemblies are communicated with the upper side space of the power generation filtering assembly through water conveying pipes.
