The solar rainwater collecting and utilizing device can perform solar power generation and rainwater collection and utilization, is energy-saving and environment-friendly, and has high popularization and application values.

title_en: Flame-retardant nano filter cylinder
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flame-retardant nano filter cylinder, which comprises nano fiber filter paper, wherein the microstructure of the nano fiber filter paper is in a bird nest hollow structure, a hot melt adhesive component is mixed in the nano fiber filter paper, the nano fiber filter paper is folded into a continuous V shape, the folded continuous V-shaped nano fiber filter paper is connected end to form a filter cylinder, at least the inner wall of the filter cylinder is provided with a support net, two ends of the filter cylinder are provided with end support rings, the filter cylinder and/or the support net are heated, so that the continuous V-shaped nano fiber filter paper is shaped and is bonded with the support net into an integral structure, and at least one surface of the nano fiber filter paper is attached with a flame-retardant coating. The nano filter cartridge can intercept 99.99% (more than micron-sized) dust particles in air, and has the characteristics of high back-blowing wind pressure resistance, multiple times, long service life, easiness in processing and manufacturing, low cost and the like.

title_en: Method for removing sulfadimidine in wastewater
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for removing sulfadimidine in wastewater. The method comprises the steps of filtering the wastewater, removing insoluble substances in the wastewater, adjusting the pH value of the wastewater, adding persulfate into the wastewater, uniformly mixing, adding ion exchange resin into the wastewater treated in the previous step, standing after reaction, adjusting the pH value of the wastewater, discharging supernatant, and recovering precipitates. The method for removing the sulfamethazine from the wastewater adopts the cheap and easily-obtained strong oxidant sodium persulfate, and generates sulfate radicals and hydroxyl radicals with strong oxidability after catalytic activation, compared with other common strong oxidants such as Cl 2 、ClO 2 、ClO ‑ Etc. ofStronger oxidizing ability, less chemical reagent adding amount, economy and high removal rate.

title_en: Lozenge for purifying organic pollution of water body and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lozenge for purifying organic pollution of water and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises mixing the above materials, adjusting water content to 8%, pressing into lozenge with mold, oven drying, packaging, and storing. The lozenge breaks through innovation in material formula integration, and solves the problem of the integration of blue-green algae burst or odor generation caused by anoxia of the water body and continuous oxygenation due to the fact that the water body is in fluidity or the fluctuation of the water body is large in rainy season when the microorganism or biological enzyme is domesticated, propagated and grown in the water body.

title_en: Papermaking wastewater treating agent and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a papermaking sewage treatment agent, which comprises a flocculating agent, wherein the flocculating agent comprises the following components in parts by weight: 5-10 parts of polymeric ferric sulfate, 10-15 parts of polysilicate iron, 10-15 parts of chitosan, 20-30 parts of sodium alginate, 5-10 parts of hydrated lime and polypropylene5-10 parts of enamide, 1-2 parts of acetic acid and 5-10 parts of a coagulant aid, wherein the coagulant aid comprises one or more of activated silicic acid, activated water glass and sodium silicate. The flocculant adopted by the invention is added with chitosan and sodium alginate, has strong adsorption performance on heavy metal ions, especially on Ag + 、Cd 2+ The method has good removal rate, can obtain the effect which cannot be obtained by singly using the sodium alginate and the chitosan by jointly treating the heavy metal ions with the sodium alginate and the chitosan, can enable the metal ions to form obvious precipitates to be deposited at the bottom of the solution, and is convenient for further layered cleaning.

title_en: Process and equipment for treating CNBB (carbon nano tube) by waste water in process of extracting plant active ingredients by alcohol
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wastewater treatment, and discloses a wastewater treatment CNBB process and equipment in the process of extracting plant active ingredients by alcohol. Compared with the prior art, the invention does not use coagulant for coagulating sedimentation, does not need to continuously add nutrients, saves cost, reduces the production amount of sludge, reduces aeration biological filter equipment and shortens the process route; the treatment sequence of the AOPS advanced oxidation process is adjusted, and a screening type bioreactor is added in the DSBB bacteria device, so that the long-time operation stability of facilities is further fully ensured, and the effect stability and standard discharge of the effluent quality are ensured.

title_en: Drainage pipeline overflow sewage treatment system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a drainage pipeline overflow sewage treatment system and method, and relates to the technical field of sewage treatment equipment. Solves the technical problem that the sewage treatment facility in the prior art has poor adaptability to the overflow pollution of the drainage pipeline. This system stores concentrated structure and controller including monitoring devices that intakes, charge device, mixed flocculation structure, particle separation structure, collection drainage structure, collection sludge discharge structure, granule, and intelligent control intakes, adds medicine, drainage and sludge discharge through the quality of water volume that online perception came water, and make full use of space condition practices thrift land and medicine and throws and throw, has improved system purification efficiency, and furthest holds the purification drainage pipe overflow pollutant, cuts down the pollution load who receives the water through drainage pipe overflow discharge. The treatment system can be used independently or in parallel, and can be combined with the pretreatment and deep treatment units in series to meet the requirements of different treatment scales and treatment standards, thereby improving the flexibility of application.

title_en: Automatic sludge dewatering and squeezing equipment and method
abstract_en: An automatic sludge dewatering and squeezing device and method, the device comprises a guide oil cylinder module, a squeezing oil cylinder module, an upper squeezing module, a lower squeezing module, a mud pushing module and a mud sucking module which are arranged on a frame; the lower squeezing module is positioned below the upper squeezing module and comprises a water filtering bag with a downward opening, a squeezing oil cylinder module is connected with the upper squeezing module and drives the upper squeezing module to move up and down, a guide oil cylinder module is connected with the lower squeezing module and drives the lower squeezing module to move up and down, the squeezing oil cylinder module pushes the upper squeezing module downwards and then contacts with the water filtering bag in the lower squeezing module, and the upper squeezing module continues to move downwards to dewater sludge in the water filtering bag; the mud pushing module is fixed on the side face of the rack, the mud pushing module comprises a push plate and an oil cylinder, the mud sucking module is installed at the bottom of the rack, and the mud sucking module comprises a one-way electromagnetic valve, a mud sucking pipe and a mud sucking pump. The invention can realize automatic dehydration of sludge, and has simple structure, low cost and high dehydration efficiency.

title_en: Fire extinguishing control method for fire truck
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire extinguishing control method for a fire engine, relates to the technical field of high-altitude fire fighting, and aims to improve the high-rise fire extinguishing capability of the fire engine. The method comprises the following steps: judging whether the fire extinguishing condition of the coupling unmanned aerial vehicle is met; unlocking the unmanned aerial vehicle from a support platform of the fire fighting truck if a condition for coupling the unmanned aerial vehicle to extinguish the fire is met; driving the unmanned aerial vehicle to take off from the supporting platform together with the water belt; and conveying the fire extinguishing agent to the water hose, and enabling the unmanned aerial vehicle to fly to a position to be extinguished with the water hose filled with the fire extinguishing agent so as to realize the extinguishment of the unmanned aerial vehicle. The fire fighting truck fire extinguishing control method provided by the technical scheme realizes high-altitude fire extinguishing with higher height. And, under the same requirement of putting out a fire, the hosepipe length that unmanned aerial vehicle dragged is shorter, and unmanned aerial vehicle's load is littleer, so can adopt large-traffic fire extinguishing agent to put out a fire, and fire extinguishing capacity can obtain improving.

title_en: Low-salt EOW (Ethernet over coax) electrolytic tank, low-salt EOW electrolytic device and low-salt EOW preparation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of EOW preparation, in particular to a low-salt EOW electrolytic cell, a low-salt EOW electrolytic device and a low-salt EOW preparation method. The low-salt EOW electrolysis device comprises an electrolysis tank, the electrolysis tank comprises a tank body, a nonpolar diaphragm, a cathode and an anode, the tank body is provided with a cavity, the nonpolar diaphragm is positioned in the cavity, the cavity is divided to form a cathode cavity and an anode cavity, a first liquid inlet and a first liquid outlet which are communicated with the cathode cavity are formed in the tank body, a second liquid inlet and a second liquid outlet which are communicated with the anode cavity are also formed in the tank body, the first liquid inlet and the second liquid inlet are used for injecting electrolyte, the first liquid outlet and the second liquid outlet are used for flowing out electrolyzed liquid, the cathode is positioned in the cathode cavity, and the anode is positioned in the anode cavity. Because the metal cations in the anode cavity move to the cathode cavity through the nonpolar diaphragm, the residual amount of the metal cations in the generated EOW is less, the preparation of low-salt EOW is realized, and the good sterilization effect of the prepared EOW is ensured.

title_en: Device for treating organic nitrogen sewage through automatic catalytic oxidation and working method
abstract_en: An automatic catalytic oxidation device for treating organic nitrogen sewage and a working method thereof, wherein an alkali liquid tank is connected with an inlet of an alkali liquid pump through a pipeline, an outlet of the alkali liquid pump is connected with a mixer through a pipeline, a hydrogen peroxide tank is connected with an inlet of the hydrogen peroxide pump through a pipeline, an outlet of the alkali liquid pump is connected with the mixer through a pipeline, the mixer is respectively connected with an inlet of a liquid inlet circulating pump and an outlet of an adjusting tank through pipelines, the liquid inlet circulating pump and the adjusting tank are connected with a three-way valve through pipelines, a pressure relief valve is arranged above a reaction kettle, the inlet and the outlet at the bottom of the reaction kettle are connected with the three-way valve through pipelines, a water flow disperser is arranged in the bottom of the reaction kettle, an electric heater is arranged above the water flow disperser, bearing porous partition plates are arranged above the electric heater in the reaction kettle in rows, the ultraviolet lamp penetrates through each partition plate with the bearing holes. The device can rapidly degrade the DMF wastewater, has high precision and good industrial prospect.

title_en: Reverse-push type efficient denitrification and aerobic MBR (membrane bioreactor) process for treating dispersive sewage
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sewage treatment, in particular to a reverse-push type efficient denitrification and aerobic MBR process for treating dispersive sewage, which comprises the following steps: s1, collecting and treating sewage to obtain primary filtered sewage; s2, adjusting water quantity, and homogenizing water quality to obtain neutralized sewage; s3, degrading and denitrifying to obtain denitrified sewage; s4, removing organic matters, and realizing nitrogen and phosphorus removal to obtain treated water; s5, disinfecting and sterilizing, and then putting into a clean water tank to discharge after reaching the standard; s6, connecting the water utilization equipment with the rear section of the reuse device by a pipeline valve to realize the reuse of the reclaimed water; the invention has mature technical process, simple flow and convenient management, and the whole set of sewage treatment process can be designed into an overground structure form, thereby saving the construction cost and facilitating the overhaul and the subsequent maintenance; also can bury main part equipment underground, reduce area, not only adaptable multiple construction mode, still be adapted to different dispersibility sewage treatment scenes, have wide adaptability.

title_en: Cotton carbon fiber monolithic catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cotton carbon fiber monolithic catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof. The invention is characterized in that cotton is used as a raw material, a catalyst precursor is obtained after treatment of a metal salt solution, and the carbon fiber monolithic catalyst loaded with metal or metal oxide is obtained by calcination under protective gas. The metal or metal oxide supported carbon fiber monolithic catalyst prepared by the invention has the advantages that catalyst particles are uniformly dispersed on the surface of carbon fibers, and higher catalytic activity and stability are shown. The method has the advantages of environmental friendliness, simple process, easiness in operation and the like, and the obtained catalyst has a good application prospect in the field of water treatment.

title_en: Catalyst for catalytic oxidation of volatile organic compounds by ozone and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a catalyst for catalytic oxidation of volatile organic compounds by ozone and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of catalytic ozonation of VOCs, wherein the catalyst comprises zeolite and metal oxide, and the metal oxide is loaded on the zeolite; the zeolite used for preparing the catalyst is Y zeolite, and the silicon-aluminum ratio in the Y zeolite is not less than 5; the specific surface area of the catalyst is 500-800 m 2 g ‑1 (ii) a The particle size of the catalyst is 200 nm-300 nm; the catalyst has high dispersion degree of active components on the surface of the carrier, a plurality of catalytic active sites and high catalytic efficiency.

title_en: Filtration formula flue gas dust collector
abstract_en: The invention discloses a filtering type flue gas dust removal device, which comprises a mixed flow box body, wherein an ash collecting hopper is formed at the bottom of the mixed flow box body, and an ash discharging opening is formed at the bottom of the ash collecting hopper; the two sides of the mixed flow box body are respectively provided with a dust removal box body, and the top of the dust removal box body is provided with an exhaust box body; the dust removal box body is of a trapezoidal structure, openings are formed in two ends of the dust removal box body of the trapezoidal structure, the wide opening end of the dust removal box body of the trapezoidal structure is communicated with the mixed flow box body, and the narrow opening end of the dust removal box body of the trapezoidal structure is communicated with an external smoke feeding pipeline; a plurality of ceramic fiber filter tubes are vertically arranged in the dust removal box body with the trapezoidal structure, the ceramic fiber filter tubes are arranged in a trapezoidal array, and two adjacent rows of ceramic fiber filter tubes are arranged in a staggered manner; the top air outlet end of the ceramic fiber filter tube is positioned in the exhaust box body; the invention ensures that the flow channel of the flue gas is more reasonable, the flue gas around the ceramic fiber filter tube has better fluidity, the flue gas can be fully contacted with the ceramic fiber filter tube, and the filtering efficiency and the filtering effect of the ceramic fiber filter tube are improved.

title_en: Finned tube end automatic grinding device with cooling structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic grinding device for the end part of a finned tube with a cooling structure, and relates to the technical field of finned tube processing; the grinding machine comprises a workbench, supporting legs and a grinding machine body, wherein the supporting legs are fixed at four corners of the lower surface of the workbench, the grinding machine body is arranged on one side of the upper surface of the workbench, and the grinding machine body is fixed on the upper surface of the workbench through a supporting seat; the polishing machine also comprises a fixing mechanism and a cooling mechanism, wherein the fixing mechanism is arranged on one side of the upper surface of the workbench, the fixing mechanism is arranged on one side of the polishing machine body, and the cooling mechanism is arranged between the polishing machine body and the fixing mechanism; the finned tube can be machined, and the generated heat can be cooled in the polishing process, so that the influence of a large amount of heat on the fin is avoided, the quality of the finned tube is improved, and the finned tube has the advantages of reasonable arrangement, low manufacturing cost and the like.

title_en: Microbial flocculant and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a microbial flocculant and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of microbial flocculants. The method utilizes Aspergillus nomius z4 to convert bamboo powder hydrolysate and ferment to prepare the microbial flocculant. The method firstly puts forward the method for producing the microbial flocculant by using the bamboo powder hydrolysate, so that the resource utilization of bamboo wastes can be realized, and the environmental pollution is reduced; has the advantages of simple operation, cheap raw materials, high flocculation activity of the obtained microbial flocculant and good flocculation effect. The microbial flocculant prepared by the method has a remarkable flocculation effect on kaolin suspension, has a flocculation rate as high as 96.85%, and has a good application prospect.

title_en: Acid mist tower wastewater treatment method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for treating acid mist tower wastewater, and aims to solve the problems of high COD (chemical oxygen demand) and high chroma in the wastewater caused by the fact that a large amount of sulfide ions and nitrate ions are contained in the wastewater after the acid mist tower wastewater is treated in the prior art. The processing method comprises the following steps: the first stage reaction: adding an acid agent into the acid mist tower wastewater to oxidize sulfur ions into elemental sulfur; and (3) second-stage reaction: adding a coagulant and a flocculant into the wastewater after the first-stage reaction to capture elemental sulfur; and (3) filtering: filtering the wastewater after the second-stage reaction to remove sulfur in the wastewater; and (3) third-stage reaction: and adding an oxidant into the filtered wastewater to oxidize the wastewater so as to reduce COD of the wastewater. The treatment system comprises a first-stage reaction tank, a second-stage reaction tank, a filtering device and a third-stage reaction tank which respectively correspond to the treatment method. Based on the disclosure, the treated acid mist tower wastewater has lower nitrate ions, sulfide ions and COD compared with the prior art, and the water quality and color are clearer; the treatment effect is better.

title_en: Skid-mounted soil remediation scrubbing production line
abstract_en: The invention provides a skid-mounted soil remediation scrubbing production line, wherein soil to be remediated firstly enters a feeder and is conveyed into a stirring feeder through a feeding conveyor, a feed opening of the stirring feeder is connected with a feed opening of a scrubbing machine, two hydraulic vibrating screens are arranged at the rear part of the scrubbing machine, a discharge opening of the scrubbing machine is positioned above a first hydraulic vibrating screen, the two hydraulic vibrating screens are positioned at one sides of the first hydraulic vibrating screen, the first hydraulic vibrating screen is connected with the upper part of a stirring tank through a pipeline, a second hydraulic vibrating screen is also connected with the stirring tank, a slurry bin at the lower part of the first hydraulic vibrating screen is connected with the stirring tank through a pipeline, the stirring tank is connected with a hydraulic cyclone on the second hydraulic vibrating screen, a slurry bin at the lower part of the second hydraulic vibrating screen is connected with a deep cone concentration tank, and the deep cone concentration tank is connected with a filter press through a pipeline. The beneficial effects are as follows: the invention has reasonable overall design, and the cleaned mud is treated by adding chemicals and then filtered by a filter press, so that the polluted soil can reach the emission standard after being repaired.

title_en: Ecological treatment facility suitable for non-point source pollution is stored and is handled
abstract_en: The invention relates to an ecological treatment facility suitable for non-point source pollution storage and treatment, which comprises a floating body frame arranged in a river channel, a water storage tank arranged at the middle lower part of the floating body frame, a water inlet pipe connected with the water storage tank and a treatment module arranged at the upper part of the floating body frame, wherein incoming water is stored in the water storage tank through the water inlet pipe, and water in the water storage tank is pumped to the treatment module for treatment through a water supply module arranged on the water storage tank. Through set up the body frame in the river course and set up processing module and water storage tank in the body frame, can realize storing and handling the water that comes of face source pollution, do not occupy the land of river lake bank limit simultaneously, accomplish storage at same facade both, accomplish again and handle, compromise environmental benefit and land economic cost.

title_en: Self-locking filter element assembly and water purifier with same
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-locking filter element assembly and a water purifier using the same, wherein the self-locking filter element assembly comprises a self-locking rod, a thrust elastic element, a reset elastic element, a base and a filter element arranged on the base, wherein a joint is formed on the filter element; the self-locking motion guide rail groove comprises an ascending rail groove, an entering locking rail groove, a locking rail groove, an unlocking rail groove and a descending rail groove which are sequentially communicated in an intersecting manner, wherein the leading-out end of the entering locking rail groove is reversely intersected with the leading-in end of the unlocking rail groove, the intersection part forms the locking rail groove, the bottom of the locking rail groove forms a locking position of a fixed clamping hook, the leading-in end of the descending rail groove is reversely intersected with the leading-out end of the unlocking rail groove, the leading-in end of the descending rail groove is smoothly connected with the leading-out end of the unlocking rail groove, and the leading-out end of the descending rail groove is provided with a guide rail outlet for sliding out of the clamping hook. The present case is pressed and can be realized auto-lock and unblock, improves the installation convenience of filter core greatly, reduces use cost.

title_en: Be used for coking desulfurization tail gas processing system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tail gas treatment devices, in particular to a coking desulfurization tail gas treatment system which comprises a desulfurization tank, wherein a smoke exhaust pipe is welded on the upper surface of the desulfurization tank in a penetrating manner, an air inlet pipe is welded at the lower end of the outer surface of one side of the desulfurization tank in a penetrating manner, a support frame is welded on the lower surface of the desulfurization tank, a slag discharging structure is installed at the lower end of the desulfurization tank in a penetrating manner, one end of the upper surface of the support frame is provided with the support frame, the upper surface of the support frame is provided with a mixing tank, a lime powder box is installed above the mixing tank, the lower surface of the support frame is provided with a control box, the upper end inside the desulfurization tank is provided with a spray pipe, and the upper end inside the desulfurization tank is provided with a vibration ring. The invention adopts a spray drying method to carry out desulfurization, is provided with the mixing tank, improves the mixing uniformity of powder and water liquid in the mixing tank, plays a role in increasing the pressure of the sprayed material, ensures the desulfurization efficiency, and is provided with a dust removal and internal cleaning structure.

title_en: Sewage treatment and reuse method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sewage treatment and recycling method, which specifically comprises the following steps: s1, S2, S3 and S4. The invention realizes the classification treatment and filtration of the milky liquid sewage by the three-dimensional demulsification device, the low-pressure oil gathering device and the filter screen technology with variable aperture of the electrostatic spinning device, the three-dimensional demulsification device reduces the failure rate and improves the demulsification efficiency, the low-pressure oil gathering device carries out oil-water separation, the electrostatic spinning filter device adopts the new technology of nano synthetic fiber and novel adsorption material and can quickly adsorb fine particles in alkali liquor, and has the effect of changing the aperture by cutting off the power and washing the filter screen on the front side, ensures the residue on the front side to be cleaned, meanwhile, the cleaning efficiency is improved by adopting the combination of compressed gas and high-pressure water for washing, the cleaning water is saved to the maximum extent, a single group or a plurality of groups of membrane groups can be used for connecting the devices in parallel, the filtering effect is not influenced, and the mutual cooperation of waste oil enrichment facility and waste residue enrichment facility is handled waste oil and waste residue centralized processing, avoids causing the pollution to the environment.

title_en: Heat shield system and method
abstract_en: An internal combustion engine (100) includes a cylinder housing (102) forming a plurality of coolant outlets, and an exhaust pipe structure (115) disposed on the cylinder housing (102) and including inner and outer walls (204) defining a coolant jacket (208) therebetween, a plurality of coolant inlets extending through the outer wall (204) and fluidly connected to the coolant jacket (208), and a plurality of transfer cases. Each transfer housing (244) includes an inner housing wall (264) forming a gas passageway; an outer housing (244) wall disposed an offset distance from a circumference of the inner housing wall such that a cooling passage (246) is defined in a space between the inner housing wall and the outer housing (244) wall; and a coolant inlet and coolant outlet (226) in fluid communication with the cooling passage (246). The plurality of coolant inlets are fluidly connected to the plurality of coolant outlets via cooling passages (318) in the plurality of transfer housings.

title_en: Electric rain shielding device for dangerous waste rigid landfill
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric rain shielding device for a rigid landfill site of hazardous wastes, which is arranged on rails at two sides of the landfill site, and comprises: the crane span structure, the crane span structure top is installed with the canopy board, the wheel is installed to crane span structure bottom both sides, the wheel passes through motor drive, the wheel sets up on the track. The problem of current hazardous waste rigidity landfill yard rain-proof effect is not good enough at the landfill in-process is solved.

title_en: Logistics express anti-peeling type pulp recovery device and recovery method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of logistics, in particular to a logistics express reverse peeling type pulp recovery device and a logistics express reverse peeling type pulp recovery method. The technical problem is as follows: the utility model provides a reverse peeling type pulp recovery device for logistics express delivery and a recovery method thereof. The technical scheme of the invention is as follows: a logistics express anti-peeling type pulp recovery device comprises a carton supporting and positioning system, a placing table, a control screen, a carton inward-contraction and stretching system and a carton pulling and separating system; the carton supporting and positioning system is fixedly connected with the placing table. The express box wetting device realizes the fixation wetting of express boxes with different specifications and the separation of the cross-shaped adhesive tape; in the separation process, the paper box and the adhesive tape can be torn mutually; the efficiency of separation can be improved greatly, the problem that current processing can follow sticky tape and paper pulp and take away is reduced.

title_en: Intelligent community garbage identification and classification system
abstract_en: The invention discloses the technical field of intelligent garbage classification equipment, in particular to an intelligent community garbage identification and classification system, which comprises an unrecoverable bin, wherein the surface of the unrecoverable bin is provided with a first feeding port, the invention can collect unreusable garbage through a burning box connected with the unrecoverable bin, the garbage can be burnt through a flame nozzle, the condition that workers need to recover the garbage every day in the past is changed, the labor cost is reduced, the garbage buried treatment method is changed, the land pollution is not caused, the garbage can be timely treated, the device can not only recover the reusable garbage, but also recover and treat the unreusable garbage, the burnt flue gas can be introduced into a filter box through an air guide pump, the flue gas can be filtered once through water circulation spraying, and harmful particles in the flue gas can be filtered for many times by matching with an air filter net and an active carbon net, the device can be prevented from causing air pollution.

title_en: Ferric salt sludge treatment process and treatment system
abstract_en: The invention provides a ferric salt sludge treatment process and a treatment system, wherein the ferric salt sludge treatment process comprises the following steps: material pretreatment, ultrasonic treatment, hydraulic dehydration, crushing, drying, disc grinding, granulation, calcination and magnetic separation; the material pretreatment: introducing the materials into a pretreatment tank, and adding degrading microorganisms for degradation; the ultrasonic treatment comprises the following steps: carrying out ultrasonic treatment on the pretreated ferric salt sludge, wherein the ultrasonic frequency is 18-20 kHz, and the ultrasonic treatment is carried out for 2-4 min; and (3) calcining: the calcination temperature is 480-520 ℃; the method is used for treating Fenton sludge, ferric sulfate flocculation precipitation sludge or sludge generated by iron-carbon micro-electrolysis, and the prepared iron ore powder has high content of ferric oxide, low impurity content, simple process and low energy consumption.

title_en: Diversified biomass utilization device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a biomass diversified utilization device, which belongs to the technical field of biomass utilization and comprises a feeding assembly, a combustion assembly, a closing assembly, a discharging assembly, a drying box and an air supply pump, wherein the feeding assembly is arranged beside the combustion assembly, the combustion assembly comprises a combustion furnace and a stirring structure, the drying box is arranged beside the combustion furnace, an air inlet of the air supply pump is fixedly connected with the combustion furnace, and an air outlet of the air supply pump is fixedly connected with the drying box. According to the biomass drying device, the biomass fuel is conveyed into the combustion assembly through the through hole of the feeding assembly, the stirring structure of the combustion assembly stirs the biomass fuel, so that the biomass fuel is continuously rolled and combusted in the combustion furnace, the biomass fuel is more fully combusted in the combustion furnace, the air feeding pump works to convey hot air generated by the combustion chamber into the drying box, articles in the drying box are dried by utilizing the combustion of the biomass fuel, and the use efficiency and the drying efficiency of the biomass fuel are improved.

title_en: Upper air supply-side air return supply control and processing system applied to breeding room
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air supply-side return control and processing system applied to a culture room, which is characterized in that an air supply system and an air processing system which are matched with each other are respectively designed, the air supply system with the air supply-side return enables the flow path of air flow in the culture room to be longer and the flow range to be larger, so that the air flow in the culture room is frequent, the ventilation effect of each position and each culture frame is good, the air flow dead angle is eliminated to a certain extent, and the problem of poor air flowability is solved; a plurality of air supply outlets are formed through the airflow distribution unit, so that air is uniformly supplied to the culture room, and the aim of uniform air flow of the whole culture room is fulfilled. The air treatment system controls the environment of the culture room in real time, so that the culture room can be basically kept in a constant-temperature, constant-humidity, dust-free and sterile state. The air treatment system adjusts and maintains the environment in the breeding room in real time through the air supply process, so that the breeding room is always kept in the optimal environment state suitable for the growth of the silkworm, and the efficiency and the effect of industrial breeding are improved.

title_en: Fire monitor hybrid control system and control method based on machine vision
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire monitor hybrid control system based on machine vision and a working method, and belongs to the technical field of fire fighting. The system comprises a fire monitor, a binocular vision system, a first angle sensor, a second angle sensor and a control system, wherein the binocular vision system comprises a first camera, a second camera, a third angle sensor and a bracket; the control method of the system comprises a position-based servo control method and an image-based servo control method, the position-based servo control method enables the jet flow and the falling point of the fire monitor to quickly approach to a fire scene or even hit the fire scene, the image-based servo control method enables the jet flow falling point of the fire monitor to accurately hit a target fire scene, and whether the falling point deviates from the target fire scene or not is monitored in real time and the attitude of the fire monitor is adjusted in time. The intelligent fire extinguishing device realizes accurate and continuous fire extinguishing of the fire monitor, improves the fire extinguishing efficiency and achieves the purpose of intelligent fire extinguishing.

title_en: Microbial inoculum for treating organic garbage and preparation and use methods thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a microbial inoculum for treating organic garbage, which comprises 30-60 parts of salt-tolerant bacillus, 30-60 parts of bacillus licheniformis, 30-60 parts of bacillus natto, 10-40 parts of azotobacter chroococcum and 5-15 parts of pichia pastoris. The invention also discloses a preparation method and a use method of the microbial inoculum. The microbial inoculum is suitable for high, medium and low temperature aerobic fermentation processes, can effectively treat organic perishable garbage, and realizes harmlessness, reduction and recycling. Meanwhile, the treatment process is simple and effective, the fermentation period is short, the treatment cost is low, the method is environment-friendly, and no secondary pollution is caused.

title_en: Solar power membrane aeration biomembrane reactor and method for water body remediation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a solar power membrane aeration biomembrane reactor and a method for water body remediation, belonging to the technical field of water treatment. The device comprises a floating device, a solar aeration system and a membrane aeration biomembrane reactor system; the solar aeration system is fixed on the upper part of the floating device and is positioned above the water surface, and the membrane aeration biomembrane reactor system is fixed on the lower part of the floating device and is positioned below the water surface and comprises an upper gas distribution chamber, a lower gas distribution chamber and a plurality of membrane components; two ends of the membrane component are respectively communicated with the upper gas distribution chamber and the lower gas distribution chamber, and the joint of the two ends is sealed; an air pump for providing oxygen into the lower gas distribution chamber; the upper gas distribution chamber is provided with an exhaust port which can be opened periodically to remove the exhaust gas. The membrane component is convenient to replace, the oxygen utilization rate is high, the construction cost is low, the nitrification and denitrification can be synchronously performed, a power supply circuit does not need to be laid, and the application scene is wide.

title_en: Fire-fighting linkage control device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting linkage control device, which comprises a fire-fighting system applied to ship fire extinguishment, wherein the fire-fighting system comprises a fire detection unit, a control unit, a water pump and a water spraying system, the fire detection unit is in signal connection with the control unit, the control unit is in signal connection with the water pump, the water spraying system comprises a lifting rod, a water distribution pipe and a connecting rope, the water pump supplies water to the water distribution pipe, the lifting rod is arranged on a ship body, the water distribution pipe is arranged at the top of the lifting rod and surrounds the periphery of the ship body, a plurality of first water outlets are arranged at the bottom of the water distribution pipe, a plurality of second water outlets are arranged at one side of the water distribution pipe, facing the ship body, the bottom of each first water outlet is provided with the connecting rope, the lower end of each connecting rope is connected with a retractor arranged at the periphery of the ship body, and water sprayed from the first water outlets flows along the connecting rope to form a water curtain surrounding the ship body. The invention can block sea wind, is easy to store, can not sweep air into the cabin when a ship shakes, and also solves the problem that the temperature of the ship is too high after blocking the air.

title_en: Method for producing haloamines and haloamine solutions
abstract_en: A method of producing a haloamine solution having a reduced amount of halooxyanions, comprising: (a) generating a halogen-containing oxidizing agent, e.g., a solution, in situ, and (b) reacting the halogen-containing oxidizing agent with a nitrogen source in situ, thereby producing a haloamine solution.

title_en: Method for monitoring an exhaust gas aftertreatment device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method of monitoring an exhaust gas aftertreatment device, in particular to a method of operating an exhaust line system comprising at least one exhaust gas aftertreatment device. The control unit receives temperature signals from a pair of temperature sensors disposed respectively upstream and downstream of the exhaust gas treatment device. The control unit runs a temperature model to estimate a temperature of the exhaust gas treatment device, the temperature model taking into account a thermal inertia of the exhaust gas treatment device and receiving as input an inlet temperature determined by the upstream temperature sensor. The thermal model uses a nominal inertia corrected by a correction factor determined by a learning process based on a deviation between simulated and measured outlet temperatures during a transient operating phase of the engine.

title_en: 3D printing mechanical lock for end cover packaging
abstract_en: A filter (300, 900) comprising a first endcap (902) and a filter media (800), the first endcap (902) defining a polar coordinate system, the polar coordinate system comprising a radial direction (R900), a circumferential direction (C900), and a Z-axis (Z900); the filter media (800) includes a plurality of layers (306, 306') of cured material and defines a first end (804) disposed along a Z-axis (Z900) and a second end (806) disposed along the Z-axis (Z900); wherein the first end (804) defines a first cavity (808) that defines a first undercut (810) configured to prevent the first endcap (902) from moving relative to the filter media (800) along the Z-axis (Z900).

title_en: Method for enriching beneficial elements in deep seawater
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of element enrichment of deep seawater, in particular to a method for enriching beneficial elements in deep seawater, wherein the beneficial elements are non-monovalent metal elements in deep seawater, the deep seawater is seawater with the depth of more than 200 m, and the method specifically comprises the following steps of filtering deep seawater by a nanofiltration membrane to obtain concentrated solution and percolate, wherein the concentrated solution is enriched with the beneficial elements, and the percolate is enriched with monovalent metal elements; when the pH value of the deep seawater is 7-8, the surface of the nanofiltration membrane is nearly electrically neutral, and the molecular weight cutoff is 400-600 Da. The invention realizes the enrichment and separation of beneficial elements in the deep seawater by using a nanofiltration technology, and has important significance for the development and utilization of the multivalent value of the deep seawater.

title_en: Modularized multifunctional robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a modularized multifunctional robot, which comprises a robot body, wherein the robot body comprises a bottom basic function control module, a middle special function control module and an upper sensing and interaction module which are sequentially arranged from bottom to top, the bottom basic function control module comprises a first bottom shell, a first shell and a motion control assembly, the first shell and the motion control assembly are arranged on the first bottom shell, the middle special function control module comprises a second bottom shell arranged at the top of the first shell, a second shell arranged on the second bottom shell, a program controller and a plurality of functional components, and the upper sensing and interaction module comprises a third bottom shell arranged at the top of the second shell, a sealing cover, a third shell arranged between the third bottom shell and the sealing cover and a plurality of interaction components. Compared with the prior art, the robot has the advantages that the function of the robot is more flexibly exerted, the production universality of the robot is improved, the production cost and the research and development difficulty of a production enterprise are reduced conveniently, and the maintenance and replacement cost of a consumer is reduced conveniently.

title_en: Method for purifying flue gas by ion exchange fiber and simultaneously partially regenerating
abstract_en: The application relates to a method for purifying flue gas by ion exchange fibers and simultaneously regenerating part of the flue gas, which comprises the steps of flue gas pretreatment, fiber oxidation, desulfurization and denitrification and solution recycling, wherein an oxidant is utilized to convert common ion exchange fibers into a form with an oxidation group, so that the common ion exchange fibers have an ion exchange function and strong oxidability, and the method can realize the oxidation, the exchange and the partial regeneration of the exchange fibers without shutdown and stopping production by intermittently spraying the regenerant, and has high-efficiency desulfurization and denitrification performances.

title_en: Hydrolysis adsorbent, blast furnace gas desulfurization method and desulfurization equipment
abstract_en: Hair brushThe hydrolysis adsorbent mainly comprises a catalyst and an adsorbent, and the mass ratio of the catalyst to the adsorbent is 1: (0.1-5); the catalyst comprises ZnNiAl, znNiFe and La-SnO  2  、CeO  2  Hydrotalcite oxide of NiAl, activated carbon of Fe, cu, ce, and Al  2  O  3  -K-one or a mixture of several of coal based activated carbon; the adsorbent comprises one or more of metal oxide, modified zeolite material and modified activated carbon, wherein the metal oxide comprises ZnO and Fe  2  O  3  The modified zeolite material comprises Ca-LTA, zn-LTA, ca-X, ce-Y and Cu-Y zeolite materials. The hydrolysis adsorbent has good catalytic performance and adsorption performance, and can remarkably improve the treatment effect of blast furnace gas.

title_en: Treatment method of oily wastewater
abstract_en: A method for treating oily wastewater comprises an oil separation tank, wherein most of coking oil is separated and removed through a screen; the device comprises an adjusting tank for adjusting the pH value of the oily wastewater treated by the oil separation tank, and a demulsification air flotation tank for quickly separating oil and water in an emulsified oil-water mixed solution. Comprises a biological contact oxidation tank for removing large particle impurities suspended in the demulsified sewage. Comprises a secondary sedimentation tank for further sedimentation of sewage, and a plate-frame filtering device for purifying clear liquid obtained by the secondary sedimentation tank through a microporous filter membrane. Comprises an ultrafiltration device, and clear liquid obtained after filtration of a plate-frame filtration device is filtered and recovered by a plurality of membrane groups for further recycling. The effect is as follows: the dosage of the demulsifier is greatly reduced, the cost is saved, the oil content of the wastewater is greatly reduced, and the treatment time and the cost of the subsequent process are reduced. The treatment quality of the oily wastewater is improved, and the oily wastewater has high safety performance and high use value.

title_en: Automatic unloading system and compression vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic discharging system and a compression vehicle. When the compression vehicle carries out unloading operation, the hydraulic control reversing valve component controls the first reversing valve and the second reversing valve to be positioned on the right, pressure oil enters a rodless cavity of the oil cylinder of the filler, the filler is lifted, the push shovel oil cylinder is in a retraction state, and pressure oil in the rod cavity is suppressed. When the filler is lifted to the right position, the first hydraulic signaling device pushes the hydraulic control reversing valve assembly to control the second reversing valve to be in the left position, pressure oil enters a rodless cavity of the push shovel oil cylinder, the push shovel oil cylinder extends out for discharging, the second hydraulic signaling device pushes the hydraulic control reversing valve assembly to control the first reversing valve to be in the left position, the pressure oil enters a rod cavity of the filler oil cylinder, and the filler is placed for lowering operation. The loader lifts and transfers and pushes away the linkage of shovel unloading, has improved the work efficiency of the operation of unloading.

title_en: Oil field sludge dispersion treatment device capable of dissociating petroleum
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of sludge treatment, in particular to an oil field sludge dispersion treatment device capable of dissociating petroleum. The technical problems of the invention are as follows: most of the prior art is sticky jelly, which is difficult to separate the oil inside the oil sand cluster. The technical implementation scheme of the invention is as follows: an oil field sludge dispersing treatment device capable of dissociating petroleum comprises a supporting underframe, a mounting frame plate, a mounting machine bed plate, a pumping component, a transmission pipe, a sharing system, a balance separation system, a first fixed frame and a second fixed frame; one side of the top of the supporting underframe is connected with an installing frame plate through a bolt. The oil sand separation device realizes the decentralized treatment of oil sand in an oil field, and utilizes the difference of resistance force between the radial groove area and the non-diameter groove area, under the same centrifugal force, the oil sand flow speed of the two areas is different, so that the oil sand separation speed is accelerated, and the clay particles are filtered and separated.

title_en: Easily degradable solid deodorant and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of solid deodorizers, in particular to an easily degradable solid deodorizer which is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: the deodorant comprises, by weight, 25-40 parts of bentonite, 18-30 parts of plant source bactericide particles, 15-20 parts of polyvinyl alcohol, 25-42 parts of 1, 3-butanediol, 5-8 parts of ferment, 1-3 parts of sodium lignosulfonate and 2-4 parts of citric acid.

title_en: Preparation method of modified fiber ball and application of modified fiber ball in absorbing Congo red
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of modified fiber balls, which comprises the following steps: s1, putting an alkali solution with the concentration of 8% -11% in a container, soaking the polyester fiber balls in the alkali solution in the container, and soaking the polyester fiber balls in the alkali solution for 3.5h-4.5h at the temperature of 25-40 ℃; and S2, taking the polyester fiber balls out of the alkali solution and washing the polyester fiber balls for three times by pure water. The invention also provides application of the Congo red absorbed by the modified fiber balls. In the invention, the polyester fiber ball is subjected to soaking pretreatment by using the alkali solution, so that pollutants on the surface of the polyester fiber ball are removed, and the surface of the polyester fiber ball treated by the alkali solution is smoother. And then the polyester fiber balls are reacted with beta-CD and a silane coupling agent to realize effective composition of the beta-CD and the silane coupling agent and the polyester fiber balls, the polyester fiber balls containing the beta-CD and the silane coupling agent enhance the electron supply capability of the fiber balls, and the removal effect of the dye is improved.

title_en: Method and device for treating mine wastewater and producing methane by using microbial electrochemical coupling system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mine wastewater treatment method and a device, in particular to a method and a device for treating mine acidic wastewater and producing methane by using a microbial electrochemical coupling system. The method and the device are used for removing harmful substances in the acid mine wastewater, and have good economic benefit and environmental protection benefit.

title_en: Device system and method for preventing amine from escaping in carbon dioxide amine method trapping process
abstract_en: The invention provides a device system and a method for preventing amine from escaping in a carbon dioxide amine method trapping process, wherein the device system comprises an absorption tower system, an amine liquid system and an analysis tower system which are connected in sequence; the upper part of the absorption tower system is provided with a tube bundle liquid drop removing device. The device system is simple in structure and easy to operate and regulate. The method adopts the tube bundle liquid drop removing device to remove the amine-containing liquid drops carried in the air flow discharged from the absorption tower, prevents environmental pollution and a large amount of loss of the amine liquid, has low treatment cost, has high efficiency of removing the amine-containing liquid drops in the air flow, and has good economic benefit and environmental benefit.

title_en: Photocatalytic heating driven VOCs catalytic degradation device and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photocatalytic heating driven VOCs catalytic degradation device and application thereof, comprising a top rotating mechanism, a first connecting shaft, an upper bracket, a cavity, a bracket and a base, wherein the top rotating mechanism is connected with the upper bracket through the first connecting shaft, the cavity is arranged between the upper bracket and the base, and the bracket connected with the base is arranged in the cavity; the catalyst is disposed on the carrier and the cavity is shaped to facilitate converging light rays onto the carrier. The invention can solve the problems that the traditional VOCs degradation means only can adsorb/degrade VOCs molecules to the surface of degradation substances by diffusing the VOCs molecules to the surface of degradation substances, the application range is limited, and the efficiency is poor, and the heat generated by sunlight improves the catalytic degradation reaction efficiency on one hand, and promotes the gas flow on the other hand, so that the VOCs molecules in a larger range are more quickly close to the surface of the catalyst, and the degradation efficiency is improved.

title_en: Water-cooling grate type biomass gasification furnace
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biomass gasification, and discloses a water-cooled grate type biomass gasification furnace which comprises an ash passing channel, wherein a water tank is fixedly installed at the bottom of the ash passing channel, an ash discharging hopper is fixedly installed at the upper end of the ash passing channel, an energy reducing device is arranged on the inner side wall of the ash passing channel, and a rotary table is fixedly installed in the middle of the energy reducing device. The energy reducing device is arranged in the ash passing channel, the gravitational potential energy of ash is used as the power for the rotation of the fan blades to reduce the gravitational potential energy of the ash, meanwhile, the contact area of the fan blades and the ash is increased by using the fan blades and the through holes of the fan blades, so that the heat of the ash is used for the expansion of gas in the air containing cavity through the eccentric rod and the heat conducting ring to reduce the initial temperature of the ash, the potential energy of downward impact of the ash and the temperature are reduced to reduce the temperature of water impact, and the generation of impact in the water tank is reduced.

title_en: Air environment-friendly waste incineration device with flue gas washing and purifying functions
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air environment-friendly waste incineration device with a flue gas washing and purifying function, which belongs to the technical field of flue gas treatment devices and comprises an incineration chamber, a hot water cylinder, a cleaning box, a water tank and a flue gas treatment shell, wherein the hot water cylinder is arranged in the incineration chamber and made of heat-conducting metal, the hot water cylinder penetrates through the left side surface of the incineration chamber, the left side surface of the hot water cylinder is communicated with a water feeding pipe, and the outer surface of the water feeding pipe is provided with a valve. According to the invention, the hot water cylinder is arranged and made of the heat-conducting metal material, so that heat generated when the incineration chamber works can be directly absorbed by the hot water cylinder, hot water in the hot water cylinder is effectively heated, heat in flue gas can be collected through heat exchange, heat waste is avoided, the influence of high-temperature flue gas on the surrounding environment is avoided, the temperature of the hot water in the hot water cylinder can be effectively known through the thermometer, the heat exchange efficiency can be maximally improved, and the utilization rate of energy is effectively improved.

title_en: CuWO4/Bi2WO6Composite and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of environmental pollution remediation, and particularly discloses CuWO 4 /Bi 2 WO 6 A compound and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method is that Bi (NO) is firstly used 3 ) 3 ·5H 2 O、Na 2 WO 4 ·2H 2 O、Cu(NO 3 ) 2 ·3H 2 O and citric acid are used as raw materials, and a hydrothermal method is adopted to synthesize CuWO in one pot 4 /Bi 2 WO 6 And (3) carrying out compound, then, combining ultrasonic and adding potassium persulfate to degrade the tetracycline in the water, and controlling the experimental conditions to be that the adding amount of the catalyst is 1g/L, the initial concentration of the tetracycline is 20mg/L, the adding amount of the potassium persulfate is 10mmol/L, and the ultrasonic time is 60 min. CuWO prepared by the method 4 /Bi 2 WO 6 Composite pairThe degradation rate of the tetracycline in the water can reach 98.3 +/-0.39%.

title_en: Preparation method of ultrathin nano wafer-shaped BiOBr high-activity photocatalyst
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of an ultrathin nanometer disk-shaped BiOBr high-activity photocatalyst, which comprises the following steps: firstly, at room temperature, Bi is added 3+ Adding the mixture into ethylene glycol, fully dissolving the mixture by magnetic stirring, adding aniline and stirring again to obtain a uniform and transparent mixed solution; secondly, adding Br into the mixed solution slowly and dropwise ‑ Fully stirring the aqueous solution until the aqueous solution is uniformly dispersed to obtain a BiOBr precursor solution; thirdly, transferring the precursor solution to a stainless steel hydrothermal reaction kettle with a polytetrafluoroethylene lining for reaction, then cooling to room temperature, and separating to obtain an off-white solid product; and fourthly, washing the off-white solid product for several times by using a polar solvent, and freeze-drying to obtain the ultrathin nano disc-shaped BiOBr high-activity photocatalyst. The method has the advantages of simple process, easily available raw materials, low cost, green and environment-friendly whole preparation process, safety and reliability. The obtained photocatalyst has the advantages of multiple photocatalytic active sites, large specific surface area, greenness, no toxicity and the like.

title_en: Method for preparing semiconductor coupling composite photocatalyst for treating refractory wastewater
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing a semiconductor coupling composite photocatalyst for treating refractory wastewater, wherein the semiconductor coupling composite photocatalyst is PPy/Ag/g-C 3 N 4 The preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) nano-layered g-C 3 N 4 Preparing; (2) Ag/g-C 3 N 4 Preparing; (3) semiconductor coupling composite photocatalyst PPy/Ag/g-C 3 N 4 And (4) preparing. The invention has the advantages that the nano-layered g-C is finished by one-step calcination of urea 3 N 4 Preparation of (A) havingThe preparation method has the advantages that the specific surface area is higher, the integral photocatalytic activity is improved, the introduction of ppy is realized through sodium dodecyl benzene sulfonate and ferric trichloride subsequently, the preparation method is simple, the cost of raw materials is low, and the purity of the finished product obtained subsequently is high.

title_en: Unpowered town sewage treatment equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides unpowered town sewage treatment equipment, which structurally comprises a machine body, a control panel, a maintenance panel and a drain pipe, wherein the inner side of the control panel is fixedly connected with the outer side of the front end of the machine body in an embedding manner, the inner side of the left end of the maintenance panel is hinged and connected with the outer side of the front end of the machine body, the inner side of the left end of the drain pipe is connected with the outer side of the lower end of the machine body in a connecting manner, the machine body comprises a water inlet pipe, a Y-shaped filter, a sealing wall, a drain pipe and a disinfection box, the right side of the water inlet pipe is fixedly connected with the left side of the Y-shaped filter, the lower end of the Y-shaped filter is connected with the upper end of the disinfection box in a flange manner, disinfection cotton wool in sewage is disinfected through a filter plate arranged in the Y-shaped filter, a fixing plate perpendicular to a mounting block is arranged in the filter plate in a cutting manner, so that the filter screen is divided into two large areas, when the left side is blocked, the sewage discharge pressure enters from the right side, the cotton cleaning device is pressed by the sewage discharge pressure, so that the cotton cleaning device rotates to wipe off the cotton wool on the filter screen, can effectively prevent the phenomenon of filter screen blockage.

title_en: Treatment method of EDTA-Ni-containing wastewater
abstract_en: The invention discloses a treatment method of EDTA-Ni-containing wastewater, which comprises the following steps: s1, adjusting the pH value of the EDTA-Ni wastewater to 2.5-3.5, adding ferrous sulfate into the wastewater, and stirring; s2, adding a chelating agent into the reactant of S1 to carry out a chelating reaction; s3, adding a flocculating agent into the reactant of S2 for flocculation and precipitation, and filtering. Compared with the traditional Fenton oxidation complex breaking, the invention adopts replacement complex breaking without adding hydrogen peroxide, thereby saving the medicament; in addition, the chelating agent has the advantages of high removal depth, stable removal effect and small sludge amount, and the generated chelating precipitate is more stable than the traditional nickel hydroxide precipitate, is not easy to decompose in the stacking or transportation process, and cannot cause the problem of secondary pollution.

title_en: Coupling device and system for solar power generation and seawater desalination
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of energy utilization, and discloses a coupling device and a coupling system for solar power generation and seawater desalination. The coupling device comprises a photovoltaic cell, a thermal connecting layer, a heat insulating layer, a base platform and a water storage device; the water storage device comprises a ceiling and a reflux tank which are respectively connected with the base platform; the thermal connection layer is positioned between the ceiling and the base platform, the photovoltaic cell is embedded on the upper surface of the thermal connection layer, and the lower surface of the thermal connection layer is in contact with the heat preservation layer; the thermal connection layer is used for absorbing seawater and infrared light, absorbing heat generated in the power generation process of the photovoltaic cell and evaporating seawater to obtain water vapor; the heat insulation layer is used for preserving heat required by seawater evaporation; the ceiling is used for condensing the water vapor into condensed water; the reflux groove is used for collecting condensed water. The coupling system includes a plurality of coupling devices. The invention well couples solar power generation and seawater desalination, and has the advantages of energy saving, environmental protection, low cost, safety, reliability and higher efficiency.

title_en: Perchloric acid Lei Bashi strain and application thereof in chloramphenicol and cadmium ion removal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a strain of perchloric acid Lei Bashi bacteria and application thereof in chloramphenicol and cadmium ion removal. The strain is named as perch Lei Bashi strain (Klebsiella variicola) YB1, and the preservation number is GDMCCNO:61696 the strain was deposited at 5.27 of 2021 at Guangdong province microorganism strain collection of No. 5 building of No. 59 of No. 5 of 100 university of Mitsui, guangzhou City. The metamorphic perch Lei Bashi strain YB1 can remove chloramphenicol in a co-metabolism mode, and can also raise the pH value in a system to precipitate cadmium ions, so that the metamorphic perch Lei Bashi strain YB1 can be used for removing or reducing chloramphenicol and cadmium ions residues in the environment.

title_en: Construction waste classification processing apparatus
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction waste classification treatment device, and relates to the technical field of construction waste treatment.A screening cam is movably arranged in a cam abdicating hole formed in the back surface of an equipment shell; the guide rails are symmetrically fixed on the left inner wall and the right inner wall of the equipment shell from top to bottom; the waste brick cutting and containing sieve is arranged between the left guide rail and the right guide rail on the uppermost layer in a sliding mode through the sliding blocks, the rear side wall of the waste brick cutting and containing sieve is movably abutted to the screening cam located behind the rear side wall, the waste brick cutting and containing sieve is connected with the sliding blocks far away from one side of the cleaning door in a rotating mode through the pin shaft, and the rear side wall of the waste brick cutting and containing sieve is connected with the sieving buffer spring between the equipment shell. It can be with building waste brick, grit etc. when sieving categorised, can also effectively shovel the concrete residue on the waste brick, need not manual operation, saves hand labor power, improves categorised recovery efficiency.

title_en: Oil washing dust removal tank and thermal desorption high-temperature tail gas dust removal and condensation system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides an oil washing dust removal tank and a thermal desorption high-temperature tail gas dust removal condensation system and method, wherein the oil washing dust removal tank comprises an oil washing dust removal tank body, the bottom of the tank body is provided with a cleaning oil storage area for storing cleaning oil, and the cleaning oil storage area is provided with a cleaning oil outlet; a filling cylinder with two open ends is arranged in the tank body on the cleaning oil storage area, a plugging end plate is arranged between the top of the filling cylinder and the tank body, and a purified desorption gas area is formed at the top of the tank body through the plugging end plate; a filler bed layer is arranged at the bottom of the filler cylinder, a demister is arranged at an opening at the top end of the filler cylinder, an oil injector is arranged between the filler bed layer and the demister, and a cleaning oil outlet is communicated with the oil injector through a circulating oil pump through a pipeline; an annular channel is formed between the outer side wall of the filling cylinder and the inner side wall of the tank body; an air inlet pipe is arranged at the upper part of the tank body so as to send the high-temperature desorption tail gas to be treated into the annular channel; the top of the tank body is provided with an exhaust pipe in a purified desorption gas area.

title_en: Sewage advanced treatment system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sewage advanced treatment system, which comprises a high-efficiency sedimentation tank, a PAM (polyacrylamide) medicine tank and a PAC (polyaluminium chloride) medicine tank, wherein the PAC medicine tank is communicated with a medicine spraying pipe in a mixing sub-tank of the high-efficiency sedimentation tank through an adding pipeline, the PAM medicine tank is communicated with a medicine spraying pipe in a reaction sub-tank of the high-efficiency sedimentation tank through an adding pipeline, a water outlet of the high-efficiency sedimentation tank is provided with a total phosphorus online monitor and a suspended solid online monitor, a medicine pump, a solenoid valve and a flowmeter are sequentially arranged on the adding pipeline, the total phosphorus online monitor, the suspended solid online monitor, the solenoid valve and the flowmeter are all electrically connected with a PIC (peripheral interface controller) in a central control room, a control panel and a display are arranged in the central control room, the control panel and the display are all electrically connected with the PIC controller, the system can detect the conditions of Total Phosphorus (TP) and Suspended Solid (SS) at the water outlet in real time, and a PLC adjusts and controls the PAM medicine tank according to feedback data, The dosage of PAC medicine tank.

title_en: Electric heating starting drive and fire extinguisher
abstract_en: The invention relates to an electric heating starting device and a fire extinguisher. The electric heating starting device comprises: the shell comprises a shell body and an electric heating element arranged in the shell body, wherein the electric heating element divides an inner cavity of the shell body into a first cavity and a second cavity; one end of the power cord is electrically connected with one side of the electric heating element facing the second cavity, and the other end of the power cord is led out of the second cavity and is electrically connected with a power supply; and the fuse is positioned in the second cavity, one end of the fuse is connected with one side of the electric heating element facing the second cavity, and the other end of the fuse is used for extending to the gas generating agent.

title_en: Method for promoting heat treatment and restoration of heavy petroleum polluted soil
abstract_en: The method for promoting the heat treatment and repair of the heavy petroleum polluted soil comprises the steps of air-drying, crushing and removing impurities from the heavy petroleum polluted soil to obtain pretreated heavy petroleum polluted soil; fully mixing the pretreated heavy petroleum polluted soil with a reinforcing agent, wherein the reinforcing agent can be combined with hetero atoms in heavy petroleum hydrocarbon molecules, so that the chemical bond energy between the carbon atoms and the hetero atoms in the heavy petroleum hydrocarbon molecules is weakened; carrying out heat treatment on the mixture of the pretreated heavy petroleum polluted soil and the reinforcing agent in a nitrogen atmosphere; and cooling the soil after heat treatment to room temperature, condensing and recovering tail gas generated by heat treatment, and adsorbing by activated carbon to remove uncondensed tail gas. The method has the advantages of simple technical process, energy conservation, consumption reduction and high-efficiency restoration, the concentration of petroleum hydrocarbon in the restored soil is lower than the soil quality risk management and control value, the reclamation value is realized, and the tail gas treatment cost can be reduced.

title_en: Preparation method and application of coated artificial humic acid/amorphous iron mineral composite material
abstract_en: A preparation method and application of a coated artificial humic acid/amorphous iron mineral composite material relate to a preparation method of an amorphous iron mineral composite material. The invention aims to solve the problems that the existing amorphous iron mineral composite material is easy to agglomerate and aggregate, single in component composition and limited in application value. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, preparing artificial humic acid; secondly, preparing amorphous iron minerals; and thirdly, coating to obtain the coated artificial humic acid/amorphous iron mineral composite material. A coated artificial humic acid/amorphous iron mineral composite material is used for removing phosphate in eutrophic water. The maximum adsorption capacity of the coated artificial humic acid/amorphous iron mineral composite material for removing P, which is prepared by the invention, is up to 12.898 mg/g. The invention can obtain a coated artificial humic acid/amorphous iron mineral composite material for removing phosphate in eutrophic water.

title_en: Cigar curing room monitoring system with gas component monitoring function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cigar curing room monitoring system with gas component monitoring, which belongs to the field of cigar processing, wherein a remote control system is used for driving an air extractor to extract gas, the gas is enabled to enter through an air inlet and then to be discharged through a three-way pipe, the air circulation of a curing intermediate is kept, a monitoring ball body is used for monitoring the gas released by cigars, when green miscellaneous gas released by the monitoring ball body flows through the inside of the monitoring ball body, the green miscellaneous gas reacts with purple litmus solution, the purple litmus solution is observed to turn blue through a monitoring camera, the observed information is uploaded to a cloud end, the gas analysis result is fed back to a remote control system through a data analysis system, the remote control system drives an exhaust one-way valve to be closed, a purification one-way valve is opened, the air extractor extracts the gas and guides the gas into a purification box, the green miscellaneous gas reacts with an ammonia degradation agent in the purification ball to be degraded and purified, avoids influencing the quality of the cigars and simultaneously prevents the direct discharge from influencing the environment.

title_en: Sewage treatment system based on solar energy combined energy supply
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sewage treatment system based on solar energy combined energy supply, which comprises an energy supply module, a sewage treatment module, a sludge treatment module and a waste gas treatment module, wherein the sewage treatment module, the sludge treatment module and the waste gas treatment module are all connected with the energy supply module, the energy supply module comprises a power supply assembly, a heat supply assembly, a control assembly, an electric energy conversion assembly and a circulating water tank, the power supply assembly is connected with the electric energy conversion assembly, the heat supply assembly is connected with the circulating water tank, the power supply assembly comprises a photovoltaic power generation system, a wind power generation system and a hydroelectric power generation system, the heat supply assembly comprises a solar energy heat supply system, an air energy heat supply system and an electric energy heat supply system, and the electric energy conversion assembly is connected with the electric energy heat supply system. The method mainly uses solar energy and combines various energy sources, realizes all-weather non-stop pollution-free sewage treatment, reasonably utilizes the energy sources, realizes zero emission and realizes energy conservation and environmental protection in the true sense.

title_en: Method for directionally and cleanly recovering phosphorus in sludge through alkali heat treatment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for directionally and cleanly recovering phosphorus in sludge through alkali heat treatment, which comprises the following steps: (1) adding calcium oxide or calcium hydroxide into the sludge and then carrying out hydrothermal treatment; (2) carrying out solid-liquid separation on the sludge subjected to alkali heat treatment, wherein supernatant is concentrated and prepared into liquid fertilizer for recycling; (3) adjusting the pH value of the residual sludge in the step (2) to 2.5-3 by using acid, and cleanly extracting phosphorus in the sludge; (4) collecting the supernatant rich in phosphorus in (3), adjusting the pH value, and recovering the calcium phosphate precipitate.
