Compared with the prior art, the invention ensures that phosphorus in the sludge is directionally converted into calcium-phosphorus precipitates by adding calcium salt for alkali heat treatment, realizes the efficient and clean release of the phosphorus in the sludge when the pH value is more than 2, and can directly carry out calcium-phosphorus precipitation recovery on the released phosphorus.

title_en: Intelligent fireproof distribution box
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the field of distribution boxes, and provides an intelligent fireproof distribution box which comprises a distribution box body, wherein a box body is provided with a plurality of exhaust ports, and a dry powder ejection mechanism is arranged above an exhaust fan; the dry powder ejection mechanism comprises a support frame sleeved outside the rotating shaft; the support frame is fixedly connected to the upper end inside the distribution box body; the periphery of the support frame is annularly provided with an elastic membrane support; an elastic membrane is arranged in the elastic membrane bracket; an elastic driving component is arranged in the supporting frame; and each air outlet is provided with a sealing mechanism. Therefore, the interior of the distribution box body can be sealed through the sealing mechanism, meanwhile, dry powder for fire extinguishing is diffused into the box body through the elastic membrane, the concentration of air in the closed box body is reduced through the continuously diffused dry powder, and finally, flame is enabled to lose combustion supporting of the air, so that the fire extinguishing effect is achieved.

title_en: Intelligent recycling box
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of recycling boxes, and provides an intelligent recycling box which comprises an outer box, wherein an expansion inner box body used for loading recycled objects is arranged in the outer box, and the recycling box also comprises: the elastic bearing assembly is connected between the bottom of the expansion inner box body and the bottom wall of the outer box body; the conversion assembly is used for converting the change quantity of gravitational potential energy generated by the downward pressing or the upward lifting of the expansion inner box body loaded with the recycled materials into the work quantity for expanding or retracting the expansion inner box body; the intelligent recycling bin provided by the invention can automatically expand and adjust according to the quantity of recycled objects, is beneficial to saving space, reducing floor area, and is convenient for classified recycling, and has strong intelligence.

title_en: Synchronous corrosion prevention and phosphorus removal device and method for integrated sewage treatment equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a synchronous corrosion prevention and phosphorus removal device for integrated sewage treatment equipment, which comprises an insulating shell and an electrode plate, wherein a water through hole is formed in the insulating shell, the electrode plate comprises a cathode electrode plate and an anode electrode plate, and the anode electrode plate and the cathode electrode plate are both externally connected with a power supply module through wires; the anode electrode slice is arranged in the insulating shell and is arranged on the inner wall of one side of the insulating shell; the cathode electrode plate penetrates through the side face, opposite to or adjacent to the side where the anode electrode plate is installed, of the insulating shell, one part of the cathode electrode plate is located in the insulating shell and corresponds to the anode electrode plate, and the other part of the cathode electrode plate is located outside the insulating shell and is used for being connected with the conductive inner wall of the integrated sewage treatment equipment. The application develops a device for synchronous corrosion prevention and phosphorus removal of integrated sewage treatment equipment, can be inserted into the integrated equipment at will for use, can ensure that the material of the shell of the integrated equipment is never corroded in the use process, and can also remove the total phosphorus in the wastewater with high efficiency.

title_en: Solar energy storage system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a solar energy storage system, which comprises a heliostat, a concentrating solar energy receiver, a heat exchanger and a storage tank, wherein the heliostat is arranged on the concentrating solar energy receiver; the heat exchanger comprises a heat exchange outer pipe and a heat exchange inner pipe, the heat exchange outer pipe is fixedly connected to the bottom end of the concentrating solar receiver, the storage tank is fixedly connected to the bottom end of the heat exchange outer pipe, and the concentrating solar receiver is communicated with the storage tank through the heat exchange outer pipe; the heat exchange inner pipe is fixedly connected in the heat exchange outer pipe, the outer diameter of the heat exchange inner pipe is smaller than the inner diameter of the heat exchange outer pipe, one end of the heat exchange inner pipe extends into the concentrating solar receiver, and the other end of the heat exchange inner pipe extends into the storage tank; calcium carbonate particles are filled in the storage tank; the bottom end of the storage tank is communicated with a carbon dioxide supply mechanism and an air blowing mechanism, and the top of the storage tank is communicated with an energy consumption mechanism. The method has the advantages of simple and easily understood process and easy realization, and the calcium oxide storing the solar energy can be applied to other reactions or production processes, thereby improving the use efficiency of the solar energy and simultaneously expanding the use range of the solar energy.

title_en: Lifting mechanism for buried garbage collection device
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of buried garbage cans, and provides a lifting mechanism for a buried garbage collecting device, which comprises an outer framework arranged in a pit, wherein an inner framework for placing a garbage can is arranged in the outer framework, a plurality of lifting parts for driving the inner framework to lift are arranged around the outer framework, the lifting parts comprise a hydraulic part and a pulling part, the pulling part is arranged at the upper end of the hydraulic part, and the pulling part is fixedly connected with the bottom of the inner framework through an iron chain; hydraulic pressure spare and pulling piece through lift portion divide and do twice, follow the inside lifting of outer skeleton to subaerial to can not expose under the external circumstances in whole lift portion, with inner frame lifting to subaerial, avoid the dangerous condition that lift portion may produce, reduce the danger coefficient, make whole more safety of burying formula garbage bin all the time.

title_en: Filter screen reset display method and system and filter screen reset display equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a filter screen resetting display method, a system and filter screen resetting display equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps of; receiving an operation instruction of resetting a filter screen from a user; an operation instruction for resetting the filter screen is sent to the controller; receiving a reset feedback signal sent by the controller, wherein the reset feedback signal is a reply signal generated after the controller resets the state of the filter screen based on an operation instruction; based on the reset feedback signal, the successful display of the filter screen reset is performed. Therefore, the operation instruction of resetting the filter screen of a user is forwarded to the controller, and the filter screen is successfully displayed after the receiving end controller sends a reply signal, so that the problems that the filter screen resetting display displays a filter screen service life resetting success prompt and the controller calculates service life inconsistency caused by abnormal communication between the filter screen resetting display and the controller are avoided, the filter screen resetting success display is ensured to be the actual resetting success of the controller, the phenomenon of complaint of the user caused by misjudgment is avoided, and the use experience of the user is greatly improved.

title_en: Unmanned fire pump truck and control system thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned fire pump truck and a control system thereof, which comprise a truck body, an unmanned aerial vehicle and a driving center, wherein a control system device and an unmanned aerial vehicle device are installed on the interior of the truck body, a camera is installed in front of the upper part of the truck body, an infrared thermal imager, a laser range finder and a temperature measuring instrument are installed on the upper top surface of the truck body, a wheel device is installed on the lower side of the truck body, a bracket is movably connected to the upper top surface of the truck body, a fire pump is installed on the bracket, an operator controls the fire pump truck to walk through a cab, and through the combination of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the fire pump truck, professionals can find a fire early and can go deep into the fire, and the fire pump can be conveniently moved under a complex environment.

title_en: Method and system for self-induced separation of fluorine and chlorine
abstract_en: A method for self-induced separation of fluorochloros, the method comprising the steps of: 1) obtaining a saturated chlorine-containing solution: chlorine is added into the fluorine-chlorine wastewater for treatment, the concentration of chloride ions in the fluorine-chlorine wastewater is increased until the chloride ions are supersaturated, all fluoride ions and part of the chloride ions in the wastewater are crystallized and separated out to obtain fluorine-chlorine mixture crystals, and the liquid phase is a saturated chlorine-containing solution; 2) obtaining chloride crystal salt: crystallizing the saturated chlorine-containing solution obtained in the step 1) to obtain chloride crystal salt; 3) separating to obtain fluoride crystals: dissolving the fluorine-chlorine mixture obtained in the step 1) for crystallization to obtain a fluorine-chlorine-containing mixed solution, dissolving and adding fluoride for many times, and separating to obtain fluoride crystals. According to the technical scheme provided by the application, the use of auxiliary additives can be reduced in the process of treating the fluorine-chlorine wastewater, and the purity of the fluorine-chlorine wastewater is improved; can effectively and accurately separate the fluorine element from the chlorine element and improve the treatment quality of the fluorine-chlorine wastewater.

title_en: Water treatment device and method suitable for distributed users
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of water treatment, and provides a water treatment device and a water treatment method suitable for distributed users. The water treatment device suitable for distributed users comprises a first barrel, wherein a first reaction part is arranged in the first barrel, and a water inlet is formed in the first barrel; the second barrel is arranged in the first barrel, a second reaction part is arranged in the second barrel, and a water outlet and a dripping hole communicated with the first barrel are also arranged on the second barrel; the first reaction part and the second reaction part are filled with solid fillers, the solid fillers are filled in a plurality of mutually independent first containing structures, and a plurality of first containing structures are provided with first meshes; and the circulating assembly is arranged in the first barrel so as to introduce the sewage in the first barrel into the second barrel. The water treatment device suitable for the distributed users can save the step of building a complete set of sewage pipe network system aiming at the distributed farmers, and reduces the sewage treatment cost. Also has the advantages of safety, environmental protection, simple structure, low energy consumption and the like.

title_en: Face recognition entrance guard's device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of entrance guard equipment, in particular to a face recognition entrance guard device, which is connected with a shell through a water tank, a cleaning plate is connected with the shell, a scraping plate is connected with the shell, a first motor is connected with the shell, a rotating shaft is connected with the first motor, a mounting plate is connected with the rotating shaft, a cleaning sponge is connected with the mounting plate, a camera is connected with an external fixing device, a recognition module is connected with the shell, the camera is connected with the recognition module, the first motor drives the rotating shaft to drive the mounting plate to rotate, so that the cleaning sponge on the mounting plate leaves the water tank to clean the camera and then enters the water tank again, the cleaning sponge passes through the cleaning plate in the water tank to clean impurities on the cleaning sponge from the upper part of the camera under the action of water, then the cleaning sponge passes through the scraping plate to scrape excessive water, the camera can be cleaned again, and the problem that dust is easy to adhere to the surface of the camera of a recognition mechanism is solved, thereby influencing the acquisition effect of the human face.

title_en: Pneumoperitoneum air purifier
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pneumoperitoneum air purifier which comprises a sleeve and a first cavity cylinder, wherein the top end inside the sleeve is fixedly connected with the first cavity cylinder, the bottom end of the sleeve is provided with a second cavity cylinder, the top end of the second cavity cylinder is fixedly connected with a baffle, and the top end of the baffle is fixedly connected with an installation cylinder. This pneumoperitoneum air purifier is through being provided with first active carbon filler, after connecting the device, the inside that the second active carbon filler leaked into the gas vent or the inside of installation section of thick bamboo can effectively be prevented to the first filter screen and the second filter screen at second active carbon filler both ends, and the third filter screen and the second filter screen at first active carbon filler both ends also can prevent that first active carbon filler from spilling, and the first chamber section of thick bamboo on top can be fixed the second filter screen of bottom through extrusion silica gel packing ring, thereby make all fillers at both ends fixed, can not produce the flow along with rocking, what solve is that unable convenient carries out the problem of fixing to the material of purification.

title_en: Compression injection combined type heat pump sewage treatment system and operation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a compression and ejection combined type heat pump sewage treatment system which comprises a flash evaporator, a first vapor compressor, a second vapor compressor, an ejector, an overheat eliminator, a water pump, a heat pump compressor, a heat pump condenser, a heat pump evaporator, a water evaporator, post-treatment equipment and a condensate water tank. The steam outlet of the flash evaporator is connected to the first steam compressor, one path of the outlet of the first steam compressor is connected to the second steam compressor through the heat eliminator, the other path of the outlet of the first steam compressor is connected to the ejector, the outlet of the ejector is connected to the heat pump evaporator, the industrial wastewater is connected to the inlet of the flash evaporator through the heat pump condenser, the water outlet of the flash evaporator is connected to the water evaporator through the water pump, and the condensed water at the outlet of the heat pump evaporator is connected to the injected port of the ejector through the throttle valve and the water evaporator. The invention simultaneously utilizes heat pump and injection type refrigeration technology, realizes the concentration treatment of the waste water while recovering the waste heat of the medium-low temperature industrial waste water, obtains the condensed water which can be recycled industrially, and can also output high-temperature high-pressure heat source steam outwards.

title_en: Integrated kitchen waste treatment equipment based on household kitchen sink lower cabinet
abstract_en: The invention discloses integrated kitchen waste treatment equipment based on a household kitchen sink lower cabinet, which comprises a sink (1) and a sink lower cabinet (2), wherein a centrifugal chopping device (3) is arranged below the sink (1), a transmission device (4) is arranged below the centrifugal chopping device (3), a compression device (5) communicated with the centrifugal chopping device (3) is arranged on the side part of the transmission device (4), and the compression device (5) and the centrifugal chopping device (3) are connected with the transmission device (4); the transmission device (4) comprises a transmission shell (6) positioned at the bottom of the sink lower cabinet (2), a driving motor (7) is arranged in the transmission shell (6), a driving shaft (8) is arranged at the output end of the driving motor (7), and a driving gear (9) is arranged on the driving shaft (8); the invention can cut up, dehydrate and compress kitchen garbage, realizes the pretreatment before recycling, and has the characteristics of convenient use and high treatment efficiency.

title_en: Water purifier under kitchen
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water purifier under kitchen, comprising: the bottom plate comprises a bottom plate body, wherein one end of the bottom plate body is provided with a clamping part; the water channel plate is detachably arranged on the bottom plate body and is provided with a water channel; the bottom cover assembly is arranged on one side of the bottom plate body and is detachably connected with the buckling part; the middle shell is detachably arranged on the water circuit board, one side of the middle shell is provided with a power supply mounting groove and a circuit board mounting groove, the middle part of the middle shell is provided with a filter element mounting cylinder, and the filter element mounting cylinder is communicated with a water channel of the water circuit board; the upper cover plate is detachably arranged on the middle shell, a filter element mounting hole is formed in the middle of the upper cover plate, and the filter element mounting hole corresponds to the filter element mounting cylinder in position; the sound-proof cover is arranged on the other side of the middle shell opposite to the power supply mounting groove, a pump mounting position is formed between the sound-proof cover and the middle shell, and the upper end and the lower end of the sound-proof cover are respectively connected with the upper cover plate and the bottom cover assembly; the shell covers the middle shell and the sound-proof cover.

title_en: Water treatment facilities and water purification unit
abstract_en: The invention provides a water treatment device and water purification equipment, wherein the water treatment device comprises: a process chamber set comprising: the plasma processing device comprises at least one first processing chamber and at least one second processing chamber, wherein the first processing chamber and the second processing chamber are arranged at intervals, and the ion concentration of fluid in the adjacent first processing chamber and the adjacent second processing chamber is different; the first electrode cavity and the second electrode cavity are respectively arranged at two sides of the processing cavity group and are respectively provided with a first electrode and a second electrode with different polarities; the water inlet pipe group comprises a first water inlet pipe and a second water inlet pipe which are independent, the first water inlet pipe is communicated to the first electrode cavity and the second electrode cavity respectively, and the second water inlet pipe is communicated to the first treatment chamber and the second treatment chamber respectively. According to the technical scheme, the independent first water inlet pipe and the independent second water inlet pipe are arranged, so that a water path flowing into the electrode and a water path flowing to the treatment chamber can be independently isolated, and the possibility that the electrode material is precipitated or falls off to influence water quality due to long-time use can be reduced.

title_en: Recovery method of flavor component
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a process for the recovery of flavour components. The invention also relates to the flavor component recovered by the recovery method and flavor oil containing the flavor component. The method for recovering flavor components is characterized by comprising the following adsorption steps: in the frying process and/or the squeezing process of the oil-making raw material, absorbing the flavor components by an absorption medium; a desorption step: desorbing the adsorption medium with the flavor components to obtain the flavor components. By the method for recovering the flavor components, good flavor can be reserved in the oil, the flavor intensity and the preference degree of the flavor oil are improved, and the pollution to the environment is reduced.

title_en: 1T/2H MoSe 2 /Bi 2 WO 6 Application of piezoelectric-optical composite catalyst
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of piezoelectric photocatalysts, and in particular relates to a mixed phase 1T/2H MoSe  2  /Bi  2  WO  6  Application of (1T/2H MS/BWO) composite catalyst. A1T/2H MS/BWO composite catalyst is synthesized by a simple impregnation method, and the rhodamine B is subjected to piezoelectro-optic catalytic degradation under the synergistic effect of solar light irradiation and ultrasonic vibration. The invention has the characteristics of simple synthesis, green pollution-free performance, strong operability, rich active sites, excellent stability, no secondary pollution and the like.

title_en: Industrial sludge and coal cooperative treatment and resource utilization device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a device and a method for cooperative treatment and resource utilization of industrial sludge and coal. After being pretreated, materials (industrial sludge and coal) are pneumatically conveyed and pyrolyzed in an external heating type pyrolysis pneumatic mixing conveyor through a screw feeder by high-pressure synthesis gas, and the generated pyrolysis gas and solid products directly enter a high-temperature entrained flow gasifier for high-temperature gasification and melting to generate synthesis gas and molten slag; the synthesis gas enters a heat exchange jacket of an external heating type pyrolysis pneumatic mixing conveyor and a sludge drying device after high-temperature dust removal, a heat source is provided for pyrolysis and drying, the synthesis gas after heat exchange is deaminated and desulfurized to obtain purified dry synthesis gas, wherein one part of the synthesis gas serving as conveying gas enters the external heating type pyrolysis pneumatic mixing conveyor through a pressurizing device; and the high-temperature slag is chilled by a molten slag water quenching tank to form vitreous slag. The method is clean, low-carbon, efficient and safe, and can realize harmless deep treatment and resource utilization of large-scale industrial sludge.

title_en: Hand-held type commodity circulation carton sticky tape remove device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of logistics, in particular to a handheld logistics carton adhesive tape removing device which comprises a shell, wherein a flowing cavity for air to flow is arranged in the shell, the flowing cavity comprises an air inlet and an air outlet, a scraper knife is arranged at the bottom of the air inlet and is positioned at the lower end of the air inlet, and an airflow control mechanism is arranged in the shell; the air flow control mechanism enables air to flow in the shell in a relatively directional manner, the air heater quickly heats the air, the heated air is sprayed onto the adhesive tape of the carton, and after the adhesive tape is heated, the adhesive tape loses viscosity and is easier to remove; the heated adhesive tape is removed by a scraper knife, the removed adhesive tape is sucked into the shell by an airflow control mechanism, and the adhesive tape is cut by a cutting piece to prevent blockage; prevent through the filter that the sticky tape from getting into the air current control mechanism in, strike off the sticky tape that the mechanism scraped on with the filter and strike off, prevent that the filter from blockking up.

title_en: Construction site dust device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction site dust suppression device, which relates to the field of construction dust suppression, and comprises a fixing plate and also comprises: the dynamic spraying dust-settling device comprises a plurality of fixing frames, a water supply assembly and a driving assembly, and the movable adjusting mechanism adjusts a fixing plate, an adjusting fixing seat, a pushing driving piece and a plurality of movable connecting components; the driving assembly comprises a rotating mounting seat which is rotatably mounted on the adjusting fixing plate, the dust-settling device is simple in structure, the whole device can be adjusted according to actual conditions in the practical application process, the spraying dust-settling range of the whole device is effectively controlled, dynamic spraying can be realized in the working process of the whole device, the purpose of saving water resources can be achieved, the spraying dust-settling effect can be further improved, and compared with the traditional dust-settling device, the dust-settling device is better in dust-settling effect and higher in applicability.

title_en: Construction waste treatment device and treatment method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction waste treatment device and a treatment method thereof, belonging to the technical field of waste treatment, wherein the construction waste treatment device comprises a frame body, a first crusher and a second crusher, and further comprises: the tank body is fixedly connected to the top of the frame body; the screening shafts are connected to the side wall of the frame body and are symmetrically designed, and the included angle between the two screening shafts can be adjusted through an adjusting mechanism; through setting up the screening axle that two downward sloping just have certain contained angles above first breaker and second breaker, can sieve the size of concrete piece before the breakage, then the concrete piece is broken in the breaker of the automatic different specifications that gets into of size, and crushing efficiency improves greatly, simultaneously, through the luffing motion of screening axle and the swing of eccentric wheel, still can overturn the epaxial building rubbish of screening, improves the screening quality.

title_en: Exhaust pipe integrated structure and automobile
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of automobiles, in particular to an exhaust pipe mounting structure and an automobile. According to the battery cell module, the exhaust pipe mounting part and the battery mounting part are integrated, so that the battery cell module can be accommodated, the exhaust pipe can be accommodated, the utilization rate of the bottom space is improved, and the protection strength of parts such as the exhaust pipe is improved.

title_en: Building drainage structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building drainage structure, which relates to the technical field of building drainage, and comprises a gutter, a downpipe, a drainage ditch, a water storage tank, a three-way pipe, a transverse pipe, sealing blocks and driving parts, wherein the two downpipes are arranged at intervals up and down, and the back ends of the downpipes are respectively communicated with the gutter and the drainage ditch; the three-way pipe is respectively communicated with two opposite ends of the downpipe and the water inlet end of the transverse pipe, the water outlet end of the transverse pipe is communicated with a water storage tank, and the water storage tank is used by residents; the sealing block is used for sealing the vertical channel of the three-way pipe and opening the transverse channel of the three-way pipe, and the driving piece is used for driving the sealing block to open the vertical channel of the three-way pipe and sealing the transverse channel of the three-way pipe. The vertical channel of the three-way pipe is plugged by the sealing block, the rainwater runoff is introduced into the water storage tank for residents to use, the rear driving piece drives the sealing block to open the vertical channel of the three-way pipe, and the rainwater is discharged into the drainage ditch. The application has the effect of collecting and utilizing the rainwater runoff.

title_en: Waterproof type equipment dustbin
abstract_en: The invention relates to a waterproof assembled dustbin, wherein a dustbin body comprises a plurality of branch plates, and each branch plate comprises a main body, a first positioning plate and a second positioning plate, wherein the first positioning plate and the second positioning plate are arranged at the edges of two sides of the main body; the first positioning plate comprises a first vertical part and a first bent part, the second positioning plate comprises a second vertical part and a second bent part, and the first vertical part and the second vertical part are respectively vertical to the main body; the first vertical part of each sub-plate is attached to the second vertical part of the other adjacent sub-plate, and meanwhile, the first bent part of each sub-plate and the second bent part of the other adjacent sub-plate are bent towards the same direction and attached and fixed, so that the side edges of the two adjacent sub-plates are attached and sealed with each other. Adopt a plurality of minute boards to assemble into the box structure, conveniently deposit and transport, can be at the on-the-spot direct assembly shaping, adjacent minute board is closely laminated fixedly through first locating plate and second locating plate, makes the side edge of two adjacent minute boards laminate each other, simplifies assembly process, and the equipment is more convenient, and waterproof seal.

title_en: Device for enriching rhodobacter and method for treating wastewater by using device
abstract_en: A device for enriching rhodobacter and a method for treating wastewater by using the device relate to the technical field of sewage treatment. The invention aims to solve the problems of long starting time of anammox and slow growth of anammox bacteria in the anammox technology. The method comprises the following steps: starting an air pump, aerating the mixed wastewater through an aerator, adjusting the concentration of dissolved oxygen in the mixed wastewater to be 0.5-1.5 mg/L, and closing the air pump; the concentration of organic matters in the mixed wastewater is measured by the PLC-controlled substrate concentration measuring device, when the ratio of nitrite ions to ammonium ions is lower than 1.1, the PLC automatically controls the nutrient substance adding port to add nutrient substances into the reaction tank, the operation is continued, and after the anaerobic ammonia oxidation reaction in the reaction tank is finished, the motor is turned off. The invention can obtain a device for enriching rhodobacter and a method for treating wastewater by using the device.

title_en: System for utilize exhaust-gas treatment waste heat to promote low-grade steam grade
abstract_en: The invention relates to a system for improving the grade of low-grade steam by utilizing waste heat of waste gas treatment, which comprises an RTO device, a superheater, a waste heat boiler and a preheater, wherein the inlet of a water channel of the preheater is connected with a water storage tank, the inlet of a steam channel of the preheater is connected with a low-pressure steam inlet pipe, and the outlet of the steam channel is connected with a condensate water return pipe; the outlet of the water channel of the preheater is communicated with the water channel of the waste heat boiler, and the outlet of the water channel of the waste heat boiler is communicated with the inlet of the steam channel of the superheater; the inlet of a flue gas channel of the superheater is communicated with the upper box body at the tail end of the RTO device, the outlet of the flue gas channel of the superheater is communicated with an exhaust gas channel of the waste heat boiler, and the outlet of the exhaust gas channel of the waste heat boiler is communicated to the middle box body of the RTO device. According to the invention, the waste heat of the waste gas in the RTO device is utilized to condense and recover the low-grade steam generated in other production processes and then convert the low-grade steam into high-grade steam to meet the requirement of high-grade steam of an enterprise, so that the waste of the low-grade steam is avoided, and meanwhile, the high-efficiency utilization of the waste heat of the waste gas is realized.

title_en: Photocatalyst prepared by doping titanium dioxide with nano material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photocatalyst prepared by doping titanium dioxide with a nano material and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of photocatalysis; nano material doped TiO 2 Photocatalyst of (1), comprising TiO 2 And the nano material is at least one of graphene, a carbon nano tube and ZIF-8. In the invention, TiO is used 2 Taking graphene and carbon nanotubes as a carbon source, and taking ZIF-8 as an adsorption enhancement material; by utilizing the excellent catalytic performance of graphene and carbon nano tubes and the excellent adsorption performance of ZIF-8, the photocatalyst provided by the invention has excellent sewageAnd (5) treatment effect.

title_en: Landfill leachate treatment system and method based on combination of electrolytic denitrification and biological membrane
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of environmental engineering, and discloses a garbage percolation treatment system and a treatment method based on combination of electrolytic denitrification and a biological membrane. When the garbage leachate is treated by the garbage leachate treatment system provided by the invention, a large amount of solid particles, more than 95% of heavy metal ions, part of CODCr, BOD5 and chromaticity of the garbage leachate are removed by a coagulating sedimentation device, and the filtrate after coagulating sedimentation and hardness removal passes through a primary electrolytic denitrification device, a biological membrane treatment device, a secondary electrolytic purification device and a secondary coagulating sedimentation device, so that the discharge standard of the table 2 of the municipal solid waste landfill pollutant control standard (GB16889-2008) is completely met, and no concentrated solution exists.

title_en: Gas inhibitor injection amount determination method, gas inhibitor injection amount determination device, computer equipment and medium
abstract_en: The present application relates to the field of computer technology, and in particular, to a method and an apparatus for injecting a gas inhibitor, a method for controlling exhaust of a battery case, a computer device, and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring detection data corresponding to a flow channel to be detected; determining thermal runaway air pressure data of the thermal runaway battery module flowing to the runner to be detected based on the detection data; and determining the injection amount of the inhibitor for diluting the thermal runaway gas in the runner to be detected according to the runner gas pressure data of the runner to be detected in the detection data and the thermal runaway gas pressure data of the thermal runaway battery module flowing to the runner to be detected. The method can accurately control the injection amount of the inhibitor injected into the exhaust gas flow passage.

title_en: Gas absorption device and collection method of gas to be detected
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gas absorption device and a collection method of gas to be detected. The gas absorption device includes: the absorption device main body is used for containing absorption liquid and containing gas to be detected; a main opening disposed at a top of the absorber body; a plug for closing the main opening; a first side opening and a second side opening each provided on a side wall of the absorption device main body; one end of the spiral pipe is connected with the first side opening, and the other end of the spiral pipe is close to the bottom of the absorption device main body; the part of the spiral pipe close to the other end is provided with a plurality of open pores. The method is suitable for the near-surface oil gas geochemical exploration field, is suitable for extracting the aromatic hydrocarbon component in the crude oil tank top gas and the free gas in the soil, can obtain a true and effective result, and meets the requirements of scientific research and production.

title_en: High-pressure-resistant polyamide membrane and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-pressure-resistant polyamide membrane and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) Mixing polyaspartic acid or salt thereof, m-phenylenediamine and water to prepare aqueous phase solution, coating the aqueous phase solution on the surface of a base film, and then separating and removing liquid on the surface of the film; (2) Preparing an oil phase solution of trimesoyl chloride, coating the oil phase solution on the surface of the base film treated in the step (1), performing interfacial polymerization reaction, and separating and removing liquid on the surface of the film to obtain the high-pressure resistant polyamide film. The method disclosed by the invention is simple in process and easy to operate, and the obtained polyamide membrane not only has higher salt interception rate and boron removal rate, but also has obvious high-pressure resistance.

title_en: Water hammer effect eliminating system and method for counter-current regeneration EDI device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water hammer effect eliminating system and method of a countercurrent regeneration EDI device, which comprises a water inlet, a water producing port, a concentrated water inlet, an extreme water outlet and a concentrated water outlet, wherein EDI modules can be arranged in a modular design, and the bottom marks of an arch bridge pipeline of a water producing main pipe, an arch bridge pipeline of an extreme water main pipe and an arch bridge pipeline of a concentrated water outlet main pipe are higher than the highest point of the EDI device, so that all EDI modules are always in a full water state, and the water break of the modules and the sudden change of water flow due to inertia are avoided. The manual diaphragm valve of the water production main pipe is positioned on the water production main pipe before the automatic valve is discharged by unqualified produced water and the automatic valve is discharged by qualified produced water, the flow of the qualified produced water and the flow of the unqualified produced water are controlled and kept consistent, the possibility of sudden change of the flow is reduced at the limit, the pressure stabilizing protection effect is realized, and the influence of the water hammer effect is avoided. And the configuration modes of a system pressure gauge and a flowmeter are improved, the operation of a black box is avoided, and the data and visualization level of the system is improved.

title_en: Construction method for backfilling, cleaning and filtering tailings of open pit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method for backfilling, cleaning and filtering tailings of open pit mining, and relates to the technical field of metal mines. The construction method for backfilling, cleaning and filtering the tailings of the open pit comprises the following specific operations: s1, backfilling the open pit by adopting tailings or tailings cementation in stages, wherein the backfilling height in each stage is 5-15 m, constructing a water collecting cofferdam by using broken stones or tailings mould bags at the tail end in the tailing discharging direction, arranging a water collecting tank outside the cofferdam, S2 arranging a reverse filter layer consisting of a gravel layer and filament non-woven geotextile on the outer slope of the cofferdam, arranging water filter pipes at intervals in the length direction and the height direction of the cofferdam, arranging valves on the sides of the water filter pipes close to the water collecting tank, and wrapping the non-woven geotextile at the head ends. According to the construction method for backfilling clean water filtration of the tailings of the open pit, the water collection cofferdam is subjected to front precipitation and water filtration of the filter pipe, the discharge requirement that the solid content of the filtered water entering the water collection tank is less than 100mg/L can be controlled, the water quality of the drained water is improved, secondary precipitation treatment is not needed for the filtered water drained from the open pit, and the cost of water filtration treatment is reduced.

title_en: Multistage separation sewage disposal system for air compressor
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of blow-down valves, and particularly relates to a multistage separation blow-down system for an air compressor. The separating and discharging assembly comprises a first-stage separating and discharging assembly, a last-stage separating and discharging assembly and a middle-stage separating and discharging assembly, wherein each stage of separating and discharging assembly comprises a liquid-gas separator, a discharging valve and a filter which are connected in series, and the discharging ends of the separating and discharging assemblies are communicated with sewage collecting equipment; the liquid-gas separator at the first-stage separation sewage disposal assembly adopts a baffle plate type separation structure, the liquid-gas separator at the middle-stage separation sewage disposal assembly adopts a microporous separation structure, and the liquid-gas separator at the final-stage separation sewage disposal assembly adopts a filler type separation structure. The invention can independently have the pollution discharge function matched with the air compressor according to different compressed air outlets of the air compressor, so that each stage of separation pollution discharge assembly can work in an optimal working state, and the compression effect and compression efficiency of the air compressor can be effectively improved.

title_en: Steel heat-insulation fireproof door
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fireproof doors, and particularly relates to a steel heat-insulation fireproof door which comprises a door frame, a door plate, a water pumping unit, a water pipe and a sprayer; the water pumping unit comprises a water pumping handle and a water pumping barrel; the side wall of the water pumping barrel is fixedly connected with the side wall of the groove; the top end of the water pumping barrel and the upper end of the piston are fixedly connected with a hinge block; the top of the water pumping barrel is provided with a hole; one side of the water pumping barrel is provided with a water drainage pipe which is communicated with the water pipe; the bottom of the water pumping barrel is communicated with an external water source; a water pumping handle is arranged on one side of the water pumping barrel away from the water drainage pipe; the water pumping unit enters the water pipe through the water discharging pipe, and water cools the door frame in the flowing process of the water pipe, so that the fireproof time of the fireproof door is prolonged, and the survival time of trapped people is prolonged; the shower that sets up on the water logical pipe is outwards spout, under the condition of no electric drive, utilizes the unit of drawing water to prolong the time of preventing fire door fire, has further improved stranded personnel's time of living, has improved stranded personnel's survival rate in the conflagration.

title_en: Silencing device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a silencer, and belongs to the technical field of silencers. The purpose is to treat and reduce noise generated by the engine, and reduce noise pollution. The technical scheme is that the silencer comprises an outer shell, wherein a first baffle, a second baffle, a third baffle, a fourth baffle and a fifth baffle are sequentially arranged between one end and the other end in the outer shell, the outer shell is divided into a first silencing chamber, a second silencing chamber, a third silencing chamber, a fourth silencing chamber, a fifth silencing chamber and a sixth silencing chamber, an air inlet is formed in the outer shell located in the third silencing chamber, and an air outlet is formed in the outer shell located in the sixth silencing chamber.

title_en: Signal reading circuit, signal reading device, and signal reading method for photodetection element
abstract_en: A signal reading circuit (11) is a circuit for reading a signal from a photodetection element (7) having a plurality of photodetection pixels (71) that generate detection signals in accordance with the incidence of light, and includes N light incidence detection units (13) that input detection signals from each of N photodetection pixels (71) (N is an integer of 2 or more) and output signals indicating the incidence of light, and a total value detection unit (14) that detects the total value of output signals from the N light incidence detection units (13). Each light incidence detection unit (13) outputs a signal weighted differently in correspondence with each light detection pixel (71). The weight is set so that the total value is different for all combination patterns of the photo detection pixels (71) and the photo detection pixels (71). Thus, a signal reading circuit, a signal reading device, and a signal reading method of a photodetecting element capable of detecting light beams separately even when light beams are simultaneously incident at a plurality of positions while suppressing an increase in the circuit scale are realized.

title_en: Industrial wastewater heavy metal ion capture agent, preparation method and wastewater treatment method
abstract_en: An industrial wastewater heavy metal ion trapping agent, a preparation method and a wastewater treatment method relate to the technical field of industrial wastewater treatment. Consists of 0.5 to 5 weight percent of chelating agent, 0.01 to 2 weight percent of inorganic sulfur, 0 to 2 weight percent of complexing agent, 0 to 2 weight percent of cosolvent, 0 to 2 weight percent of stabilizer and the balance of deionized water. Taking corresponding heavy metal wastewater, adjusting the pH value of the wastewater, adding a capture agent and stirring, then dropwise adding a flocculating agent and a coagulant aid and stirring, and finally sampling and detecting the concentration of heavy metal ions. The heavy metal ion chelating agent achieves the removal effect through the chelation between the heavy metal ion chelating agent and the heavy metal ions, and is a green heavy metal wastewater treatment agent with strong trapping capacity, small actual dosage, low cost and simple operation. The heavy metal ion trapping agent has a good trapping effect on various heavy metal ions such as nickel, copper, zinc, chromium, mercury, aluminum, manganese, iron and the like, and the removal rate reaches over 98.5 percent and reaches the national emission standard.

title_en: Water purification equipment, and water purification effect representation method and device of water purification equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water purifying device, and a water purifying effect representation method and device of the water purifying device. The water purification effect characterization method comprises the following steps: acquiring a raw water TOC value at an inlet of a filtering device of the water purifying equipment; acquiring a pure water TOC value at an outlet of a filtering device of the water purifying equipment; and representing the water purification effect according to the difference value of the pure water TOC value and the raw water TCO value. The water purification unit includes: filter equipment, the TOC obtains the module, the sign module, the TOC obtains the module and is used for acquireing the raw water TOC value of the filter equipment's of water purification unit's import department and still is used for acquireing the pure water TOC value in water purification unit's the exit, the sign module is used for according to the difference sign water purification effect of pure water TOC value and raw water TCO value, adopt the TOC to replace traditional TDS, come the sign filter effect, more scientific and reliable, can really guarantee that the user drinks water healthily.

title_en: Shallow layer algae bed reactor for deep nitrogen and phosphorus removal and working method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shallow layer algae bed reactor for deep nitrogen and phosphorus removal and a working method, belonging to the field of water treatment application, and comprising an algae bed reaction part, wherein the algae bed reaction part comprises a reactor, sewage is introduced into the reactor through a water inlet pipe, and the sewage is discharged through a water outlet weir plate after being subjected to nitrogen and phosphorus removal in the reactor; an aeration device and a temperature control device are arranged at the lower part in the reactor, wherein the aeration device and the temperature control device are respectively used for providing oxygen and proper temperature required by the growth of algae; and a lighting device is arranged above the reactor and used for providing lighting for the growth of algae. The invention utilizes the microalgae denitrification and dephosphorization technology to carry out advanced treatment on the effluent of the secondary sedimentation tank of the sewage plant, on one hand, the nitrogen and the phosphorus in the tail water can be efficiently removed, on the other hand, the bacterial amount in the sewage can be reduced, the comprehensive treatment effect is good, secondary pollution can not be generated, the microalgae generated after the sewage treatment can also be used for oil production or other resource utilization, and the invention has good economic benefit.

title_en: Mixed solution, preparation method thereof and application thereof in absorbing hydrogen sulfide
abstract_en: The application discloses a mixed solution, a preparation method thereof and application of the mixed solution in absorbing hydrogen sulfide. Containing Fe  3+  Ions, fe  2+  Ion, VO  2+  Ions, acid ions and water; said Fe  3+  The concentration is 0.1-2 mol/L, fe  2+  The concentration is 0.1-0.5 mol/L; VO (vacuum vapor volume)  2+  VO with the concentration of 0.01-2 mol/L  +  The concentration is 0.01-0.5 mol/L. The mixed solution provided by the application has high hydrogen sulfide absorption rate and absorption rate as absorption liquid, high sulfur purity and stable chemical property, and can be used as anolyte or catholyte for electrolytic treatment of hydrogen sulfide to prepare hydrogen and sulfur.

title_en: Preparation method of high-hydrophobicity ozonolysis catalyst
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a high-hydrophobicity ozonolysis catalyst, which comprises the following steps: A. mixing materials; a1, firstly, selecting manganese sulfate, ferric nitrate, copper nitrate and silver nitrate, then mixing the materials with ionized water, and then drying the mixture; a2, drying the mixed material by a dryer to obtain a solid material, then roasting, and finally grinding by a grinder to obtain the supported molecular sieve powder. According to the invention, the activity of the catalyst is improved through manganese sulfate, ferric nitrate, copper nitrate and silver nitrate, the hydrophobicity of aerogel is further improved by treating the powder loaded with the molecular sieve and the surface of gel with trimethylchlorosilane, so that the condition that water vapor is condensed on the surface of the catalyst is avoided, and the problem that the catalyst used in a catalytic decomposition method is easy to adsorb moisture in high-humidity tail gas, so that the performance of the catalyst is reduced and even loses efficacy is solved.

title_en: Preparation device and preparation method of high-quality low-sulfur biodiesel
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biodiesel preparation devices and preparation methods, in particular to a high-quality low-sulfur biodiesel preparation device and a preparation method, wherein the device comprises the following components: the device comprises a waste oil tank, a fatty acid reactor, a transesterification reactor, a separation device, a deodorizing device, a distillation device and a diesel oil collecting tank, wherein the waste oil tank is connected with the fatty acid reactor through an oil pipe, the fatty acid reactor is connected with the transesterification reactor through the oil pipe, the transesterification reactor is connected with the separation device through the oil pipe, the separation device is connected with the deodorizing device through the oil pipe, the deodorizing device is connected with the distillation device through the oil pipe, and the distillation device is connected with the diesel oil collecting tank through the oil pipe. The high-quality biodiesel is obtained by high-efficiency separation and deodorization through the separation device and the deodorization device.

title_en: Adhesive-free air filter element and production method thereof
abstract_en: An air filter element of an air filter without adhesive and a production method thereof belong to the technical field of filter elements and aim to solve the problems that the prior air filter element is inconvenient for multi-stage filtration, so that the filtering effect is not high and the service life is not long; according to the invention, air is introduced into the air inlet pipe, enters the annular groove through the air inlet cavity, the communicating groove and the air inlet groove, enters the lower end part of the inner part of the second inner cavity after being subjected to multiple filtration by the filtering component, then enters the fourth inner cavity through the first annular filter screen and the second annular filter screen at the same horizontal position of the first annular filter screen, is filtered by the activated carbon filter screen, eliminates the peculiar smell attached to the gas, the gas with the peculiar smell filtered enters the central cylinder through the third annular filter screen, the central cylinder is communicated with the inner part of the air outlet cavity, and finally the gas subjected to multiple-stage filtration is transmitted to the inner part of the air outlet pipe through the air outlet cavity; the invention realizes the effect of facilitating multi-stage filtration of the filter element of the air filter.

title_en: Low-carbon-nitrogen-ratio high-ammonia-nitrogen wastewater treatment device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a device and a method for treating wastewater with low carbon-nitrogen ratio and high ammonia nitrogen, wherein the wastewater with low C/N and high ammonia nitrogen firstly enters a half-short-cut nitrification reactor, and half of ammonia nitrogen in the inlet water is oxidized into nitrite nitrogen; the effluent of the semi-shortcut nitrification reactor enters an anaerobic ammonia oxidation reactor to synchronously remove ammonia nitrogen and nitrite nitrogen through anaerobic ammonia oxidation; the anaerobic ammonia oxidation effluent containing nitrate nitrogen and the other part of low-C/N high ammonia nitrogen wastewater simultaneously enter a heterotrophic nitrification aerobic denitrification reactor, and the ammonia nitrogen and the nitrate nitrogen in the wastewater are converted into N through the heterotrophic nitrification aerobic denitrification reaction 2 O and N 2 And the denitrification rate of the system is improved. The method provides a novel biological denitrification process for treating the low-C/N high-ammonia nitrogen wastewater, and solves the problems of low denitrification efficiency and high energy consumption; the process is easy to regulate and is suitable for deep removal of low-C/N high-ammonia nitrogen wastewater.

title_en: Water-flow-resistant pneumatic oxygen supply type ecological floating island
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological management, in particular to a water flow resistant pneumatic oxygen supply type ecological floating island, which comprises: a floating bed floating on the water surface of the river channel; and at least part of the structure is inserted into the river bottom sludge and used for fixing the position of the floating bed; the submerged planting bed is positioned below the floating bed and is fixed on the fixed pile; and a protective platform arranged along the circumferential direction of the floating bed; and the gas supply device and the wind power generation device are arranged on the floating bed, and the wind power generation device provides electric energy for the gas supply device. The invention increases the stability of the floating bed through the protective platform and the fixing pile, reduces the impact force of water flow on the floating bed, effectively avoids the phenomenon of side turning of the floating bed, ensures the mutual fusion of the upper part and the lower part of the water body through the arrangement of the wind power generation device and the gas supply device, increases the oxygen content in the water, and further improves the water quality of a deep water area through planting aquatic plants in the deep water planting bed.

title_en: Fire-fighting remote emergency control method for energy storage station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote emergency control method for fire fighting of an energy storage station, which has the key point that when a fire occurs and the conventional response measures of a prefabricated cabin energy storage fire fighting system to the fire fail, the control method can be supplemented and perfected in time, so that the reliability, stability and timeliness of the fire fighting system of the energy storage system are improved, and further, the purposes of avoiding harm, reducing harm and avoiding fire accidents are achieved. The property safety protection is more in place. Meanwhile, the equipment supports of the method can be reasonably arranged in one standard cabinet, so that the system configuration of the method is easy to access to a fire-fighting operation and maintenance platform, great convenience can be provided for the operation of a power station, and risks can be reduced to the maximum extent.

title_en: Water purifier with double TDS probes
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water purifier with double TDS probes, which is characterized in that waste water flows back to the front of a first reverse osmosis filter element through a pipeline, is mixed with tap water and then enters the first reverse osmosis filter element again for secondary filtration. The method can greatly reduce the discharge of waste water while ensuring the performance and the service life of the first reverse osmosis filter element; meanwhile, the waste water is connected with an original tap water faucet of a household kitchen of a user, the waste water discharge is completed when the tap water faucet is opened, and meanwhile, the waste water is secondarily utilized, so that the requirement of ecological environment protection is met. In addition, a TDS probe and a waste water direct discharge pipeline are added for directly discharging waste water when the pure water effluent desalination rate is not qualified.

title_en: Nitrifying liquid reflux pulse water distribution device and wastewater biochemical treatment unit comprising same
abstract_en: The invention relates to a nitrified liquid reflux pulse water distribution device, which comprises: the box body is connected with a nitrifying liquid backflow water inlet pipe, a main water inlet pipe and a water outlet pipe; the pipe orifice of the water outlet pipe is positioned at the bottom of the box body; the pulse control unit comprises a floating ball, a guide rod, a floating valve and a connecting rod. This application through set up the floater, with the control to going out water is realized to floater response motion's connecting rod and float valve, especially will through connecting rope and lever the floater with the back is connected to the connecting rod, can realize the pulse control of going out water has solved the inhomogeneous problem of water distribution in the biological pond.

title_en: Membrane bioreactor and sewage purification method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a membrane bioreactor, which relates to the technical field of sewage treatment by utilizing membrane bioreaction, and comprises a first membrane reaction box, wherein a solar device for receiving solar heat is arranged on one side above the first membrane reaction box, a partition plate is fixedly welded in the middle position in the first membrane reaction box and divides the first membrane reaction box into a sewage treatment cavity and a heat temporary storage cavity, a heat temporary storage cavity is internally provided with a heat concentration box, the heat generated by solar energy is utilized for primary treatment during sewage treatment, most of precipitable particles and non-precipitable particles in the treated sewage are precipitated and collected, and then the sewage is conveyed into a second membrane reaction box for treatment, so that the cost of sewage treatment is reduced, the loss is lower, and the treatment effect is good.

title_en: Medical waste self-cleaning sterilization barrel
abstract_en: The invention relates to a medical waste self-cleaning sterilization barrel, which comprises a barrel body for loading medical waste and a barrel cover for sealing the barrel body, wherein the barrel cover comprises a barrel cover frame, two half plates and two turning plates, the two half plates are arranged on two sides of the barrel cover frame, the two turning plates are arranged between the two half plates, a turning rotating shaft is arranged in the middle of each turning plate, two ends of each turning rotating shaft are respectively connected to the two half plates so that the turning plates rotate, a limiting stopper is further arranged on each central shaft, cleaning grooves are respectively formed in two ends of each turning plate, a cleaning rotating shaft is arranged in each cleaning groove, and crushing extrusion rollers are arranged outside the cleaning shafts; through two broken squeeze rolls cooperations of turning over on the board and using, thereby puncture and breakage the medical waste who gets into in the bucket and make the medical waste in the bucket expose great surface area to expose the inside bacterium of medical waste and virus, get into better being destroyed in the sterilization bucket, on the other hand has avoided the illegal use of medical waste of lawless persons with the medical waste breakage.

title_en: Medical wastewater treatment system and medical wastewater odorless treatment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medical wastewater treatment system and a medical wastewater odorless treatment method, and the technical scheme is as follows: the device comprises a bottom plate, wherein a sewage treatment box is fixedly connected to the top of the bottom plate, a rotating rod is rotatably connected to the inner cavity of the sewage treatment box, an installation shell is fixedly connected to the top of the sewage treatment box, a servo motor for driving the rotating rod to rotate is fixedly installed in the inner cavity of the installation shell, a plurality of fixed sleeves are fixedly connected to the rotating rod, stirring blades are fixedly connected to two sides of each fixed sleeve respectively, a dosing mechanism is arranged at the top of the sewage treatment box and comprises a dosing pipe communicated and fixed with the sewage treatment box, a dosing hopper is fixedly communicated with the top of the dosing pipe, and a dosing pipe is fixedly communicated with the top of the dosing hopper; the system can achieve the purpose of fully mixing the sewage and the purifying liquid medicine, has thorough reaction and excellent purifying treatment effect.

title_en: Pulse control method for dust collector of powder tank
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pulse control of dust collectors, in particular to a pulse control method of a dust collector of a powder tank, which comprises the following steps: s1, uniformly powering on the intelligent pulse dust collector, enabling the dust removal fan and the pulser to be in a working mode, starting the dust removal fan and the pulser before feeding the powder tank, not starting the dust removal fan in the early stage, and only powering on the pulser to thoroughly clean the filter bag; s2, when the powder tank starts to feed, the dust removal fan is started to accelerate the dust filtering speed and keep the pressure difference in the powder tank balanced, and at the moment, the pulser is powered off and does not work; s3, after the powder tank finishes feeding, stopping the dust removal fan, electrifying the pulser again, and fully and thoroughly cleaning the filter element of the dust remover by pulse; and S4, after a standard working period is finished, the intelligent pulse dust collector control box automatically stops running. The invention not only can reduce uncertain factors caused by manual operation, but also can effectively save energy and reduce consumption, and improve economic benefit.

title_en: RTO heat accumulation formula incinerator tail gas treatment equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an RTO heat accumulating type incinerator tail gas treatment device which comprises four support columns, a box body, a gas inlet pipe, a gas outlet pipe, a driving motor, a second rotating rod and a cooling mechanism, wherein the box body is arranged at the tops of the four support columns, the box body is provided with a box door convenient to overhaul, the gas inlet pipe is sleeved with one side of the box body, the gas outlet pipe is sleeved at one side of the box body, which is far away from the gas inlet pipe, the driving motor is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the top of the box body, the output end of the driving motor is fixedly connected with the second rotating rod, and the cooling mechanism is arranged at one side of the box body, which is close to the gas inlet pipe; the cooling mechanism further comprises a water tank, a first supporting plate, a first rotating rod, a stirring blade, a hollow box, a fourth connecting pipe, an atomizing spray head, a filter box, a sponge, a filter screen, a sleeve barrel, a box cover, a hose, a triangular block, a movable connector, a water pump, a second connecting pipe and a first connecting pipe, wherein the water tank is fixedly connected to one side, close to the air inlet pipe, of the top of the box body.

title_en: Air purifying agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air purifying agent and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of air purification, and comprising 30-50 parts of seaweed extract, 0.5-2 parts of ethylene urea, 5-10 parts of tourmaline powder, 0.5-1 part of potassium sorbate, 1-2 parts of sodium dodecyl benzene sulfonate, 0.3-1 part of wetting agent and 60-70 parts of water. The air purifying agent provided by the invention is convenient to use, can be kept for a long time after being sprayed on wall surfaces or indoor and vehicle objects, firstly adsorbs and gathers harmful gases such as formaldehyde, benzene and the like released by indoor objects, building or decoration materials when purifying air, and then converts the harmful substances into harmless substances through chemical reaction with the harmful substances, thereby achieving the purpose of purifying air.

title_en: Low-temperature and low-power carbon-containing material microwave treatment process
abstract_en: The invention relates to a microwave treatment process, in particular to a low-temperature and low-power microwave treatment process for carbon-containing materials. The microwave treatment process of the carbon-containing material provided by the invention adopts a microwave reaction device with an automatic protection unit and a PLC control unit to realize microwave pyrolysis; meanwhile, real-time online monitoring and control of input power are realized through a linkage mechanism of the automatic protection unit and the PLC control unit. The microwave treatment process can greatly improve the microwave energy density and the microwave utilization efficiency, the temperature of the generated hot spot is low and uniform, the high-efficiency decomposition of the carbon-containing material within the temperature range of 50-350 ℃ is realized, and the microwave input power required by the reaction can be maintained to be as low as 10W, so that the high-efficiency decomposition of the carbon-containing material at lower power and lower temperature is realized, and the problems of overlarge microwave input power, overhigh reaction and hot spot temperatures, shorter service life of a microwave reactor and lower microwave power linearity in the conventional microwave pyrolysis process are solved.

title_en: Electric power tunnel inspection equipment based on intelligent data management platform
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the related technical field of inspection equipment, and provides power tunnel inspection equipment based on an intelligent data management platform, which comprises: the device comprises a mounting frame, a patrol instrument main body, a communication module and a guide rail; the connecting assembly is used for connecting the mounting frame and the guide rail; the expansion mechanism is positioned on the installation frame; the expansion mechanism comprises a sliding piece, a second supporting piece, a first expansion assembly, a second expansion assembly and an adjusting bin, wherein the second supporting piece is arranged on the mounting frame, and the sliding piece is used for connecting the patrol instrument main body with the second supporting piece; and at least one emergency assembly comprising emergency parts arranged on the first expansion assembly and the second expansion assembly. According to the invention, the equipment inspection range is effectively improved through the matched arrangement of the expansion mechanism.

title_en: Preparation method of hydrophilic positively charged emulsion separation material
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a hydrophilic positively charged emulsion separation material, belonging to a preparation method of a polyurethane foam material. The polyurethane emulsion comprises 25-50 g of hydrophilic polyurethane, 50-100 g of chitosan, 5-10 g of surfactant, 25-35 g of cross-linking agent and 500-1000 mL of acidic aqueous solution; under the acidic condition, hydrophilic polyurethane is used for absorbing chitosan aqueous solution, and the chitosan aqueous solution and a cross-linking agent are subjected to curing cross-linking reaction in the presence of a surfactant, so that the secondary curing cross-linked polyurethane foam material is obtained. The preparation method has the advantages that the prepared hydrophilic polyurethane porous foam material has the characteristics of good emulsion separation performance, large separation flux and the like, and meanwhile, compared with other foam materials, the preparation method of the whole material has the characteristics of mild reaction conditions, simplicity, convenience and practicability, low cost and short preparation period, so that the preparation method is easy to amplify.

title_en: Functionalized graphene-polyurethane composite microsphere, and synthesis method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pollutant adsorption and discloses a functionalized graphene-polyurethane composite microsphere, which has a unique microporous structure and is grafted on the surface of graphene in situ, the graphene and the graphene form a three-dimensional covalent network, the specific surface area of the formed space structure is larger, the adsorption sites are more, the graphene contains rich carboxyl and aryl quaternary ammonium salt active structures, pi-pi bond interaction can be generated between aromatic rings in the aryl quaternary ammonium salt and aromatic rings of phenol, phenol is easy to ionize to lose proton hydrogen to form phenolic hydroxyl negative ions which are electronegative, aryl quaternary ammonium salt has electropositivity, electrostatic interaction can be generated between the phenol and the aryl quaternary ammonium salt, thereby leading the functionalized graphene-polyurethane composite microspheres to have excellent adsorption effect on phenol pollutants, and the contained carboxyl and quaternary ammonium salt have good hydrogen bond acting force and electrostatic adsorption effect on methyl orange.

title_en: Building materials wholesale transfer device convenient to material loading
abstract_en: The invention relates to a transfer device, in particular to a building material wholesale transfer device convenient for feeding. The invention aims to provide a building material wholesale transfer device which is convenient to move and feed. The invention provides a building material wholesale transferring device convenient for feeding, which comprises a placing frame, rollers, supporting rods and the like, wherein the placing frame is used for storing building materials, the rollers are symmetrically arranged at the lower parts of the front side and the rear side of the placing frame in a left-right rotating mode, and the supporting rods are symmetrically arranged at the front part and the rear part of the middle part of the left side of the placing frame. The conveying device can drive the support frame to rotate rightwards to be opened by taking the first motor as a driving force, then drive the conveying belt and the push block to rotate by taking the second motor as a driving force, the push block can push building materials leftwards into the placing frame, and then the pull rod is pulled to pull the device to move, so that the conveying work of the building materials is completed.

title_en: Preparation method of impregnation-modified flexible hydrophobic spherical silicon-based aerogel adsorbent
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a dipping modified flexible hydrophobic spherical silicon-based aerogel adsorbent. Preparing a silicon source, aldehyde, a silane coupling agent, a pore structure regulator and a solvent into flexible silicon-based sol, and combining a ball drop method and dipping modification to prepare the flexible hydrophobic spherical silicon-based aerogel adsorbent. The preparation process adopted by the invention is simple, the particle size of the obtained spherical silicon-based aerogel adsorbent is controllable, the performance is excellent, and the quantitative production can be realized. The prepared spherical silicon-based aerogel adsorbent can adsorb 89-162 times of crude oil by weight, and is an ideal high-performance adsorption material.

title_en: Treatment method of antibiotic pharmaceutical wastewater
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for treating antibiotic pharmaceutical wastewater, and belongs to the technical field of wastewater treatment and environmental protection. The treatment method is a combined process of a plurality of units, and mainly comprises the following steps: an oxidation flocculation precipitation unit, an electrochemistry-microorganism synergetic degradation unit, a biochemical improvement and improvement unit, a microorganism reinforced advanced treatment unit and a filtration purification discharge unit. The invention has reasonable process combination, low energy consumption, high efficiency and stable operation effect, and is suitable for treating the wastewater generated in the processes of biological fermentation and chemical synthesis antibiotics pharmacy.

title_en: Paper-making middle-stage sewage treatment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for treating papermaking middle-stage sewage, which comprises the steps of firstly, preliminarily filtering the sewage containing papermaking middle-stage water to remove impurities; then adding H 2 O 2 Carrying out Fenton-like reaction with the pickling waste liquid containing Fe2+ by jet aeration mixing; continuously adding polyaluminum chloride (PAC) and anionic Polyacrylamide (PAM) for flocculation purification, concentrating the precipitate, adding a sludge dewatering flocculant, performing filter pressing treatment on the sludge to obtain a sludge block, transporting the sludge block outwards, and performing subsequent advanced treatment on the supernatant; then, carrying out chemical reaction by using an SPR technology to separate out organic pollutants; flocculation purification by physical adsorption method, flocculate precipitation to become sludge, and aeration and biochemical treatment of supernatant; finally obtaining the purified water meeting the standard. The invention solves the problems of high chroma of the paper-making middle section water and difficult degradation of COD residue in the prior art.

title_en: SCR catalyst and preparation method thereof
