abstract_en: A method of preparing a Selective Catalytic Reduction (SCR) catalyst includes a first step of preparing a synthesis mother liquor including a supply source of silica and alumina including zeolite A and silica, a structure inducing material, a complexing material, and a solvent, a second step of reacting the synthesis mother liquor to prepare CHA zeolite, and a third step of ion-exchanging the prepared CHA zeolite with a transition metal.

title_en: Preparation method of lanthanum-manganese composite oxide catalyst
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a lanthanum-manganese composite oxide catalyst with high activity, which contains a composite oxide of lanthanum, manganese and sodium, wherein the molar ratio of lanthanum to manganese is 1: 1, the molar weight of sodium is 2-30% of the total amount of lanthanum and manganese, water-soluble lanthanum salt and water-soluble manganese salt are dissolved in water to prepare a lanthanum-manganese ion mixed solution, a sodium hydroxide aqueous solution is dropwise added until the pH value is = 9-11, the mixture is continuously stirred, then the mixture is stood for aging, filtered, washed until the washing solution is neutral, precipitate is added into the sodium hydroxide aqueous solution, and the precipitate is heated to dryness under stirring, heated to 550-650 ℃ at the speed of 80-100 ℃/hour, kept warm for 2 hours, cooled and ball-milled to obtain the catalyst. The passive regeneration temperature of the CDPF may be further reduced.

title_en: Double-deck vortex sludge dewatering mummification device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-layer vortex sludge dewatering and drying device, which belongs to the technical field of sludge treatment equipment and comprises an inner cylinder body and an outer cylinder body, wherein a stirring device is arranged in the inner cylinder body; the top of the outer cylinder is provided with a wet sludge inlet, the top of the inner cylinder is provided with a sludge inlet which is axially arranged at a distance from the wet sludge inlet, the lower part of one end of the inner cylinder, which is far away from the sludge inlet, is provided with a sludge outlet, the outer wall of the inner cylinder is provided with a heating layer, and a guide slope which inclines towards the sludge inlet is arranged between the heating layer and the stirring blade; two chambers are formed between the inner cylinder and the outer cylinder, so that secondary treatment can be performed on sludge, and the application range is wider; the heating layer between the inner cylinder and the outer cylinder can heat both chambers at the same time, so that energy is fully utilized; and the top of interior barrel is equipped with the direction slope, can guide mud to the import of mud and remove to improve the effective efficiency that mud got into.

title_en: Device for detecting leaked gas in chemical industry
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device for detecting leaked gas in chemical industry, which comprises a front cover, a rear back plate, a pull-insert type detection test paper, a power supply connecting wire and a front dust filter, wherein the rear back plate is fixed on the rear side surface of the front cover through a special bolt, the front dust filter is fixed on the front side surface of the front cover through a short bolt, the pull-insert type detection test paper is inserted on the side surface of the front cover, the inner side end of the pull-insert type detection test paper is inserted in the front cover, and the power supply connecting wire is connected with the inner bottom side of the front cover. The invention optimizes the arrangement of the chemical gas detection device, changes the traditional chemical gas sampling mode, improves the mode into real-time uninterrupted detection equipment, has compact structure, can be installed in any work site, can not influence normal production and ecological environment, effectively protects the safety of chemical production, adopts replaceable sampling type detection test paper in the structure, can be replaced and used after alarming, can also adopt different sampling type detection test paper according to different to-be-detected gases, has wide application range and is suitable for popularization and use.

title_en: Spherical Fe with strong dispersibility3O4Preparation method and application of @ ZSM-5 composite material
abstract_en: The invention discloses spherical Fe with strong dispersibility 3 O 4 The preparation method and the application of the @ ZSM-5 composite material comprise the following steps: s1, adding FeCl 3 ·6H 2 Dispersing O into glycol to be fully dissolved; adding ZSM-5 into the solution and stirring; then adding a reducing agent to partially reduce iron ions; s2, transferring the suspension obtained in the step S1 to a polytetrafluoroethylene tank for heating reaction to prepare Fe 3 O 4 @ ZSM-5 solution; s3, centrifuging, washing, drying and grinding the solution obtained in the step S2 to obtain gray powder Fe 3 O 4 @ ZSM-5 composite material. The preparation method is simple, good in catalytic performance, strong in degradation capability and easy to implementHas high recycling rate, can play a key role in an Advanced Oxidation Process (AOPS), and can be widely applied to a water treatment process.

title_en: Lead removing equipment for lead storage battery wastewater
abstract_en: The invention relates to lead removing equipment for lead storage battery wastewater, which comprises a reaction mechanism, wherein the reaction mechanism comprises a reaction chamber, a crushing mechanism is arranged on one side above the reaction mechanism, the crushing mechanism comprises a crushing chamber fixed with the top of the reaction chamber, a feeding chamber is fixed on the top of the crushing chamber, two crushing rollers which are symmetrically distributed are arranged in the crushing chamber, an impurity removing mechanism is arranged on the other side above the reaction mechanism, a heating mechanism is arranged above the reaction mechanism, and the heating mechanism is positioned between the crushing mechanism and the impurity removing mechanism; the method solves the problems that in the prior art, before the lead removal operation is carried out on the wastewater, the wastewater is often directly reacted with the alkali stone, and the wastewater is not subjected to impurity filtering and other treatments, so that the reaction process is influenced due to the existence of impurities, and the lead removal effect is reduced; in the prior art, the contact area between the wastewater and the alkali stone and the reaction temperature can not be controlled, so that the reaction rate is slow, the lead removal efficiency is reduced, and the like.

title_en: Large-spiral oil-water separation automatic slag discharging system and purification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large spiral oil-water separation automatic slag discharging system and a purification method, wherein the large spiral oil-water separation automatic slag discharging system comprises a machine shell, the top of the machine shell is provided with a shell cover, the bottom end of the shell cover is provided with an inner container, the top of the shell cover is provided with a fixed disc, the bottom end of the fixed disc is provided with a cleaning mechanism, the cleaning mechanism is provided with an adjusting mechanism and a dismounting mechanism, and the outer part of the machine shell is provided with a mounting rack; the invention relates to the field of oil-water separation devices. This domestic waste high concentration sewage treatment and recycle equipment and application method, through the adjustment mechanism who sets up, make to promote the piece and remove and produce the extrusion force on the inclined plane of the trapezoidal piece that corresponds, under the effect of extrusion force, two trapezoidal pieces remove to the direction of keeping away from each other, the trapezoidal piece drives the riser that corresponds and removes, second connecting rod slides in being located first T type groove with first stopper simultaneously, make the riser drive the scraper to advance the dirt and clear up the inner bag inner wall, the cleaning performance is improved, the person of facilitating the use uses.

title_en: Adsorption device and oil smoke clarifier
abstract_en: The invention provides an adsorption device and an oil fume purifier, relating to the technical field of purification equipment, wherein the adsorption device provided by the invention comprises: the heat collecting cover assembly, the shell and the heat exchange assembly; the heat collecting cover assembly is arranged at two ends of the shell, the heat exchange assembly is arranged inside the shell, the heat collecting cover assembly is provided with a heat flow side inlet and a heat flow side outlet which are communicated with the heat exchange assembly through a heat flow channel, the shell is provided with a cold flow side inlet and a cold flow side outlet which are communicated through a cold flow channel, and an adsorption unit is arranged in the cold flow channel. The invention solves the technical problems that the adsorption component needs to be replaced frequently, the material consumption cost is high, the solid waste maintenance cost is high and the environmental pollution is easily caused in the related technology.

title_en: Waste gas treatment equipment with activated carbon adsorption device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of waste gas treatment, in particular to waste gas treatment equipment with an activated carbon adsorption device, which comprises a shell, a conveying pipeline, a one-way valve, a mounting plate, an adsorption cavity and a treatment cavity, wherein the adsorption cavity and the treatment cavity are arranged in the shell; when handling waste gas, drive assembly through the operation of drive reciprocating mechanism and then drive the slider reciprocal slip in the admission line, and then with waste gas ration inhale behind the admission line rethread pipeline enter into and adsorb the chamber, install and to adsorb some dust particles in the chamber can with waste gas get rid of filtering piece, the setting is after the preliminary treatment is done to waste gas to the active carbon in the absorption chamber, gas passes through the pipe and enters into the treatment cavity, the treatment fluid in the treatment cavity can get rid of harmful gas, promote the quality to exhaust-gas treatment.

title_en: Garbage smashing device capable of achieving continuous discharging
abstract_en: The invention discloses a garbage smashing device capable of continuously discharging, belonging to the technical field of organic garbage treatment, and the device comprises: the upper portion is equipped with the first box of second box, be equipped with broken subassembly in the second box, locate first box below and with the third box of first bottom half intercommunication, locate the fourth box of third box below, third box below is through conveying body and fourth box upper portion intercommunication, be equipped with the stirring subassembly in the fourth box, the discharge opening has been seted up to fourth box side, the stirring subassembly is including setting up the second (mixing) shaft in the fourth box, the interval is provided with the axle sleeve on the second (mixing) shaft, be equipped with first acanthus leaf on the axle sleeve, first acanthus leaf dislocation set on each axle sleeve, be connected with the stiffener between the first acanthus leaf, first acanthus leaf end connection has the second acanthus leaf, the second acanthus leaf is set square and the setting of bending. The invention provides a multistage crushing scheme, which solves the problem that the existing garbage treatment process is easy to block, can continuously work and has high working efficiency.

title_en: Intelligent power distribution cabinet
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the field of power distribution cabinets, and provides an intelligent power distribution cabinet which comprises a cabinet body, a linkage mechanism and an element installation unit, wherein a cabinet door which is rotatably hinged is arranged on the cabinet body; the component mounting unit comprises a mounting rack positioned in the cabinet body, the linkage mechanism comprises a plurality of first straight pipes which are fixed on the inner wall of the cabinet body and correspond to the mounting rack in position, and a second straight pipe which is arranged on the side face of the cabinet body, the first straight pipes and the second straight pipes are communicated through a pipeline, piston pieces are arranged in the first straight pipes and the second straight pipes, the piston pieces in the first straight pipes are connected with the mounting rack, a connecting mechanism is fixed on the cabinet door, the piston pieces in the second straight pipes are connected with the connecting mechanism, and liquid media are filled in the first straight pipes, the second straight pipes and the pipeline. The beneficial effects are as follows: this device is effectual utilizes the cabinet door to open drive power when closing, and the mounting bracket that makes can remove, takes out the electric elements of inside, makes things convenient for daily maintenance work.

title_en: Mixed-dimension S-doped g-C3N4Base van der waals heterojunction photocatalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mixed dimension S-doped g-C 3 N 4 A base van der Waals heterojunction photocatalyst, a preparation method and an application thereof belong to the technical field of material preparation. Dissolving melamine and cyanuric acid by dimethyl sulfoxide respectively to obtain clear solutions; the solution of melamine acid was added dropwise to the melamine solution to give as g-C 3 N 4 White precipitate of the basic van der waals heterojunction photocatalyst precursor; mixing the white precipitate precursor with trithiocyanuric acid, and calcining the mixed substance in a muffle furnace to obtain mixed dimension S-doped g-C 3 N 4 A base van der waals heterojunction photocatalyst. The catalyst can be applied to the field of photocatalysis, and the method can be obtained by changing reaction conditionsg-C doped with S in different proportions 3 N 4 The van der waals heterojunction photocatalyst has the advantages of simple process operation, stable structure and high repeatability, and can meet the requirements of laboratories and industries.

title_en: Titanium modified manganese-based catalyst and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a titanium modified manganese-based catalyst and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of formaldehyde catalytic oxidation. The titanium modified manganese-based catalyst adopts gamma-Al prepared by adopting an anodic oxidation technology 2 O 3 Al is used as a carrier, and non-noble metal is used as a load; wherein the non-noble metal is manganese or a titanium-manganese mixture. The process is safe and simple, has lower cost, has stable combination of the active component of the catalyst and the carrier, is not easy to fall off, and can be used for industrialized mass production; has an integrated structure convenient for replacement, can be applied to an air purifier filter element, can reduce the formaldehyde concentration from 0.9ppm to below 0.04ppm within 48min by using the manganese-titanium catalyst, and has the formaldehyde residual concentration lower than that of indoor places specified by the national standard so farMaximum limit for formaldehyde concentration: (<0.07mg/m 3 ) The moisture resistance and formaldehyde treatment capacity of the catalyst are improved to a certain extent.

title_en: Ion exchanger
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ion exchanger, which comprises a box body, a cover plate and ion exchange resin arranged in the box body, wherein a water inlet and a water outlet are formed in the box body, a filter positioned at the water inlet and the water outlet is respectively arranged in the box body, a flow passage formed by a plurality of raised partition plates is arranged at the bottom in the box body, ball valves positioned at the water inlet and the water outlet are respectively arranged outside the box body, a pagoda joint is arranged at the other end of each ball valve, an automatic exhaust valve and a temperature sensor are respectively arranged on the cover plate close to the water inlet, a conductivity sensor and a conductivity probe filter are respectively arranged on the cover plate close to the water outlet, and a sealing strip and a sealing ring are arranged between the cover plate and the box body; compared with the existing ion exchanger, the invention reduces the volume by more than two thirds under the same water quality purification condition, simultaneously improves the integration level and the maintainability of the ion exchanger, and has important economic benefit and social benefit.

title_en: Immersed tube tunnel convenient to evenly discharge fume and personnel flee
abstract_en: The invention relates to a immersed tube tunnel convenient for uniform smoke discharge and personnel escape, wherein an escape channel and a smoke discharge channel are arranged between two lanes, one side of the two lanes, which is close to each other, is provided with a plurality of first smoke discharge ports which are communicated with the smoke discharge channel, the first smoke discharge ports are internally provided with smoke discharge components used for discharging smoke, the inner wall of the bottom of the escape channel is provided with a plurality of groups of moving components used for enabling people suffering from a disaster to quickly escape from a fire scene, the inner wall of one side of the lane, which is close to the escape channel, is provided with a plurality of groups of escape components used for escaping, the inner wall of the top of the lane is equidistantly provided with a plurality of flame detectors, temperature-sensitive fire detectors and jet fans, the smoke discharge channel is longitudinally and rotatably connected with a plurality of groups of symmetrical two rotating shafts, and the inner wall of the top of the smoke discharge channel is equidistantly provided with a plurality of smoke discharge fans; the problem of among the prior art discharge fume volume unbalance lead to the smoke inefficiency, can't make the personnel in disaster escape from current tunnel fast, influence the personnel in the tunnel rescue effect is solved.

title_en: Constant-current direct-drive LED switching power supply
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of LED (light emitting diode) switching power supplies, in particular to a constant-current direct-drive LED switching power supply. The constant-current direct-drive LED switch power supply comprises a shell and a cover plate movably mounted on the shell, wherein the cover plate is L-shaped and is clamped with the shell through a clamping component; the air bag strips are provided with two groups and are respectively fixedly embedded in the inner parts of the two sides of the shell, and the air bag strips are filled with sufficient heptafluoropropane; and the puncturing part is positioned on the inner wall of the shell and is used for puncturing the air bag strip to extinguish the fire in the shell. The constant-current direct-drive LED switch power supply provided by the invention has the advantages that the constant-current direct-drive LED switch power supply can be quickly and effectively protected, further, the elements in the shell are subjected to fire extinguishing treatment, manual monitoring and control are not needed, and the constant-current direct-drive LED switch power supply is simple and convenient.

title_en: Preparation method and application of carboxylated multiwall carbon nanotube doped adsorptive ultrafiltration composite membrane
abstract_en: A preparation method and application of an adsorption ultrafiltration composite membrane doped with carboxylated multiwall carbon nanotubes relate to a preparation method and application of an ultrafiltration composite membrane. The invention aims to solve the technical problem that the existing polymer ultrafiltration membrane is difficult to improve the permeability while improving the rejection rate of the membrane due to the trade-off effect between the permeability and the rejection rate. According to the invention, the nano material carboxylated multiwall carbon nanotube is embedded in the process of preparing the traditional ultrafiltration membrane, and the UF membrane is modified by utilizing the nano channel and negative charge of the nano material, so that the permeation path of pure water is regulated, and the permeation of the membrane to water in wastewater is influenced. Meanwhile, the composite membrane is used for treating Ag in wastewater  +  The retention rate is up to 100%, the maximum adsorption reduction of the silver element is realized, and the Ag in the wastewater can be fully retained  +  At the same time canThe pure water permeation flux of the membrane is improved, and the maximum water flux is 81.21L/(m) at the pressure of 3bar  2  ·h)。

title_en: Method and device for low-temperature fractional condensation and deep recycling of medical waste liquid
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for low-temperature fractional condensation and deep recycling of medical waste liquid. The device comprises a low-temperature evaporation tank, wherein a collection unit for collecting effective components in the medical waste liquid in a grading manner is arranged in the low-temperature evaporation tank, the collection unit comprises a distillation box, a plurality of groups of distillation boxes are arranged in the low-temperature evaporation tank from top to bottom, and a temporary storage box for storing the medical waste liquid before entering the distillation box group above is arranged on one side of the low-temperature evaporation tank; according to the invention, through low-temperature condensation, fractional collection and deep distillation recycling, organic solvents, distilled water and the like in the medical waste liquid can be deeply collected and recycled, the purpose of reducing the amount of the medical waste liquid from the source is realized, and the problems of high difficulty in processing medical waste liquid entrusted hazardous waste, high cost and great environmental pollution are solved.

title_en: Low-resistance air filter
abstract_en: An air cleaner system includes a housing having a first housing end with an opening, a second housing end, and an inlet proximate the second housing end. The air cleaner system also includes a filter element removably mounted within the housing through the opening, the filter element including filter media, a first endplate coupled to the filter media at a first filter end, an open second endplate coupled to the filter media at a second filter end, and an annular protrusion extending axially from the open second endplate, the annular protrusion sealing against the housing and creating an axial gap between the filter element and the housing.

title_en: Manganese copper ore material and application thereof in room temperature carbon monoxide removal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a manganese copper ore material and application thereof in removing carbon monoxide (CO) at room temperature. The manganese copper ore material has a regular crystal structure and is prepared from MnO  6  The octahedron is formed by stacking layers after being connected with O-Cu-O bonds through an oxygen bridge, and can rapidly and stably completely oxidize dry CO into CO at room temperature  2  And H  2  O, the cost is lower than that of the noble metal catalyst, the preparation method is simple, the operation is convenient, and the catalyst is suitable for removing CO pollution with environmental humidity at room temperature after being combined with a drying agent.

title_en: Method and device for breaking impervious layer of saline-alkali soil to realize salt and alkali discharge
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for breaking a impervious bed of saline-alkali soil to realize salt and alkali removal, and relates to the technical field of saline-alkali soil treatment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring the position coordinates of at least one ground white spot and the image of the ground white spot in a preset area, and determining the drilling position of each water permeable hole according to the position coordinates of each ground white spot; acquiring the single sheet distribution area of a water-proof layer and the water guide radiation area of a water-permeable hole; determining the drilling depth of each water permeable hole according to the upper edge burial depth and the lower edge burial depth of the impervious layer; determining the sand filling amount of each water permeable hole according to the water guide radiation area of each water permeable hole and the drilling depth of each water permeable hole; and (4) detecting whether the content of the salt and alkali at the ground white spot after sand filling treatment reaches the standard or not at intervals of preset time according to an image fusion technology. The method can solve the problem of unsmooth salt and alkali discharge caused by the fact that the impervious layer blocks water and salt from moving downwards.

title_en: Exhaust silencer for pneumatic tool
abstract_en: The invention relates to an exhaust silencer for a pneumatic tool, which comprises an exhaust pipe and an exhaust silencer assembly, wherein the exhaust silencer assembly comprises a first shell and a second shell, the first shell and the second shell are arranged on the peripheral surface of a perforated section of the exhaust silencer, the peripheral surfaces of the first shell and the second shell are jointly provided with a disassembling assembly, and the inner wall of the first shell is provided with a sealing assembly. The present invention relates to the field of pneumatic tool equipment. When the sound-absorbing material needs to be replaced, the bolt on the clamp is unscrewed, the limiting block is pressed, and the sound-absorbing material is pulled away from the second shell in the direction away from the first shell, so that the purpose of detaching the exhaust silencer and replacing the sound-absorbing material can be achieved.

title_en: Preparation method of polydimethylsiloxane/ethyl cellulose sponge body with organic solvent as template
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of polydimethylsiloxane/ethyl cellulose sponge by taking an organic solvent as a template. According to the invention, ethyl cellulose and amino-terminated polydimethylsiloxane are crosslinked, then the crosslinked material is swelled in a 1, 4-dioxane organic solvent, and the three-dimensional porous sponge is obtained by freeze drying. The obtained porous sponge has hydrophobicity and rebound resilience, can selectively adsorb oil in water, can realize repeated cyclic regeneration by a physical compression method, and has good application prospect in the field of oil-water separation.

title_en: Environment-friendly dust fall device for building demolition
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of building construction, in particular to an environment-friendly dust fall device for building demolition. The application has the effects of improving the dust falling effect, expanding the dust falling range of the tower crane and facilitating the dust falling of the building.

title_en: Sediment separation device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sediment separation device and a sediment separation method. The invention provides a sediment separation device, which comprises a main shell, a deposition piece and a stripping assembly; the inside of the main shell encloses a reaction chamber, the side wall of the main shell is provided with a plurality of water injection ports for injecting liquid to be treated, and the bottom of the main shell is provided with a water outlet which can be opened and closed; the deposition part is movably suspended in the reaction chamber to deposit sediment in the liquid to be treated; the stripping assembly includes an impeller rotatably disposed below the depositing member, and the impeller is configured to rotate under the impact of water flow from the water inlet and to impinge on the depositing member to strip sediment deposited on the depositing member from the surface of the depositing member. The invention provides a sediment separation device and a sediment separation method, which can save cost.

title_en: Sewage treatment system and method based on vortex separation
abstract_en: A sewage treatment system and method based on vortex separation comprises a biochemical tank, a centrifugal separation device, a secondary sedimentation tank and a drainage device, wherein the centrifugal separation device is used for centrifugally separating materials guided by the drainage device into activated sludge with light specific gravity and sludge particles with large specific gravity, the particle size distribution of the sludge particles is 50-500 microns, the centrifugal separation device comprises a rotary driving part, a rotary connecting piece, a curved surface centrifugal blade and a cyclone cylinder body with a cylinder inner cavity, a first end of the rotary connecting piece extends into the cyclone cylinder body to be connected with a first side of the curved surface centrifugal blade, and a second end of the rotary connecting piece is connected with the rotary driving part. According to the sewage treatment system based on vortex separation, sludge particles are intercepted at the front end of the secondary sedimentation tank, so that the microbial biomass of the biochemical tank is improved; the method has the advantages that all sludge particles are prevented from entering the secondary sedimentation tank, the actual operation load of the secondary sedimentation tank is reduced, the processing capacity of the secondary sedimentation tank is improved, the sludge particles are recycled, and the cyclic utilization rate of the functional carrier is improved.

title_en: Method for regulating and controlling magnetic properties of chromium-containing spinel synthesized in external magnetic field reinforced wastewater
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for synthesizing chromium-containing spinel in wastewater strengthened by regulating and controlling an external magnetic field. Firstly, adjusting the pH value of the chromium-containing wastewater, adding ferrous ions into the wastewater, and mechanically stirring to convert hexavalent chromium in the wastewater into trivalent chromium. Then transferring into a reaction tank capable of regulating and controlling an external magnetic field, adding ferrous ions into the solution to regulate the pH of the solution, introducing compressed air or oxygen, simultaneously carrying out aeration or mechanical stirring, concentrating the reacted solution, discharging the supernatant up to the standard, carrying out magnetic separation treatment on the concentrated underflow, and recovering the chromium-containing spinel with good magnetic separation. The invention adopts the method of regulating and controlling the intensity and the direction of the external magnetic field, improves the magnetic performance of the synthesized chromium-containing spinel, promotes the separation and the recovery of the chromium-containing spinel, improves the phenomenon of weaker magnetism of the synthesized product of the conventional ferrite method, and synchronously realizes the purification and the recycling of the chromium-containing wastewater. The method has the advantages of simple and convenient operation, low cost, environmental protection and good industrial application prospect.

title_en: Cation exchanger, method for producing same, use thereof and polymer
abstract_en: The present invention relates to cation exchangers, to a process for their production, to their use and to polymers.

title_en: Intelligent fire fighting system and automatic inspection method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent fire fighting system and an automatic inspection method thereof, wherein the intelligent fire fighting system comprises: the system comprises a collecting end, a multi-end inspection device and a real-time warning information acquiring and processing end, wherein the collecting end is used for collecting inspection information in an inspection range based on the multi-end inspection device, receiving warning information in the inspection range and acquiring real-time warning information based on the inspection information and the warning information; the prediction end is used for carrying out multi-dimensional analysis prediction on the routing inspection information to obtain a corresponding prediction result; the generating end is used for generating a corresponding latest disaster memory spool based on the real-time alarm information and generating a corresponding latest inspection plan based on the latest disaster memory spool and the prediction result; the inspection end is used for controlling the corresponding inspection device to perform inspection based on the latest inspection plan; the multi-dimensional analysis based on the inspection information and the historical inspection information can generate an efficient inspection plan, and the automatic inspection mode of fixing the crash of the traditional intelligent fire-fighting system is improved.

title_en: Steam boiler system for combusting yellow phosphorus tail gas and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a steam boiler system for combusting yellow phosphorus tail gas and a method thereof, wherein the steam boiler system comprises a yellow phosphorus combustion area, a first radiation heat transfer area, a second radiation heat transfer area, a variable cross-section connecting flue, a first evaporator, a superheater, a second evaporator, a waste heat steam boiler and an induced draft fan which are sequentially connected; which comprises the following steps: step S1: when the detected first smoke pressure and the second smoke pressure are larger than the preset smoke pressure value, adjusting the induced draft fan to operate at a first rotating speed; step S2: when the detected first smoke pressure and the detected second smoke pressure are smaller than the preset smoke pressure value, adjusting the induced draft fan to operate at a fourth rotating speed; step S3: when the detected first smoke pressure or the detected second smoke pressure is larger than the preset smoke pressure value, adjusting the induced draft fan to operate at a second rotating speed; step S4: when the detected first smoke pressure or the detected second smoke pressure is smaller than the preset smoke pressure value, adjusting the induced draft fan to operate at a third rotating speed; wherein, the rotating speed relation is as follows: the first rotating speed is larger than the second rotating speed, the third rotating speed is larger than the fourth rotating speed. The invention can improve the heat exchange sufficiency of the flue gas, thereby improving the utilization rate of the heat value of the yellow phosphorus tail gas.

title_en: Titanium salt coagulant and direct oxidation preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a titanium salt coagulant and a direct oxidation preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of environment and chemistry. Firstly, dripping titanium tetrachloride into a mixed solution of alcohol and acetylacetone, stirring until the titanium tetrachloride is completely dissolved to obtain a mixed solution of titanium tetrachloride, acetylacetone and methanol, and stirring a certain amount of H  2  O  2  Adding dropwise into the mixed solution of titanium tetrachloride, acetylacetone and methanol, stirring until the solution is completely mixed, adding H  2  O  2  And placing the mixed solution in air, drying to constant weight, and grinding to obtain the titanium salt coagulant powder. The coagulant prepared by the method has the advantages of high stability, strong adsorption bridging capability on colloidal substances, excellent coagulation effect, small pH change of effluent, easy treatment of coagulation byproducts, less metal ions which are harmful to human bodies and are remained in water bodies and the like, and has good water treatment effect when being applied to water supply and wastewater treatment.

title_en: Automatic nitrogen and phosphorus recovery equipment and method for low-concentration aquaculture wastewater
abstract_en: The invention discloses automatic nitrogen and phosphorus recovery equipment for low-concentration aquaculture wastewater, which relates to the technical field of sewage treatment and comprises a reactor; a water inlet device comprising a first vessel in communication with the reactor; the alkali adding device comprises a second container, and the second container is communicated with the first container; a magnesium salt addition device comprising a third vessel in communication with the reactor; an aeration device; and the struvite collecting device comprises a struvite pumping pipe, a pump body connected to the struvite pumping pipe and a fourth container used for collecting struvite. The invention not only improves the purity of the struvite and ensures the recovery of nitrogen and phosphorus in the sewage, but also realizes the automatic collection of the struvite, avoids the problem that the reactor needs to be stopped for the traditional gravity collection of the struvite, realizes the continuous operation of the reactor and improves the working efficiency.

title_en: Photocatalyst containing Schiff base structure covalent organic framework, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention provides a photocatalyst containing a covalent organic framework with a Schiff base structure, a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the field of photocatalysts with covalent organic frameworks. The method takes 2,4, 6-tri (4-aldehyde phenyl) -1,3, 5-triazine and 4,4 '-bithiazole-2, 2' -diamine as raw materials, and synthesizes the covalent organic framework material bridged by carbon-nitrogen double bonds through heating reaction. The covalent organic framework material obtained by the method has good thermal stability, rich pore channel structure and good photocatalytic activity.

title_en: Semiconductor vacuum tubing, cleaning method and semiconductor manufacturing equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a semiconductor vacuum piping, a cleaning method and semiconductor manufacturing equipment, belongs to the technical field of semiconductors, and solves the problem that powder in the vacuum piping in the prior art cannot be sufficiently removed. The semiconductor vacuum tubing comprises a vacuum tubing body and a plasma processing module; one end of the vacuum tubing body is connected with the process chamber, and the other end of the vacuum tubing body is connected with the vacuum pump; the plasma processing module is fixedly arranged in the gas channel of the vacuum piping body and used for generating plasma and burning and removing powder or tail gas existing in the gas channel of the vacuum piping body. The invention is suitable for removing powder in the vacuum pipe.

title_en: Composite material odor decomposing agent, odor-free artificial board and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial boards, and discloses a composite material odor decomposing agent, an odor-free artificial board and a preparation method thereof, wherein the composite material odor decomposing agent comprises isopropanol, citric acid, calcium chloride, sodium cocoanut alcohol sulfate, polyvinylpyrrolidone, an aromatic Chinese wolfberry leaf extract, sodium persulfate and ferrous sulfate; the preparation method of the artificial board without peculiar smell comprises the following steps: s1, mixing the composite material odor decomposition agent of claim 1 with pure water to prepare artificial board odor removal mixed liquor S2, and baking the artificial board; s3, dipping the artificial board processed by the S2; s4 repeating the steps S2 and S3 for a plurality of times, standing and stacking to obtain the artificial board without peculiar smell. Through the combined action of all components in the composite material odor decomposer, the odor of styrene, dibenzofuran, hexanal and the like generated by the artificial board can be rapidly captured and oxidized and decomposed.

title_en: Graphene oxide/sodium alginate composite nanofiltration membrane with controllable water flux or retention rate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a graphene oxide/sodium alginate composite nanofiltration membrane with controllable water flux or retention rate, which is formed by stacking a graphene oxide sodium alginate stable structure GO-SA prepared by modifying the surface of sodium alginate SA as a spacer of a graphene oxide GO sheet layer and the graphene oxide sheet layer by layer. The composite nanofiltration membrane has undulation and folds on the surface, the section is of a layer stacking structure, and a stable structure GO-SA is embedded between graphene oxide nano layers in the stacking structure. Experiments prove that the composite nanofiltration membrane has higher water flux than a pure graphene oxide membrane, the water flux can be increased along with the increase of the addition amount of GO-SA, the composite nanofiltration membrane also has outstanding performance in terms of separating dyes, has excellent interception performance on the tested Evan blue, and is indicated to be widely applied to preparation of water flux and filtration performance equipment and textile dye wastewater treatment equipment.

title_en: Ozone decomposition catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an ozone decomposition catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) mixing insoluble manganese salt and soluble zirconium salt with a solvent, stirring, and drying to obtain a mixed material; (2) the ozone decomposition catalyst is obtained after roasting treatment is carried out on the mixed material obtained in the step (1), and a small amount of zirconium is doped in the manganese oxide, so that the stability and the catalytic performance of the catalyst can be obviously improved, and the water resistance of the catalyst is improved.

title_en: Preparation method and application of mesoporous carbon nanosphere with polyurethane sponge-supported yolk core-shell structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method and application of a polyurethane sponge loaded yolk core-shell structure mesoporous carbon nanosphere. The method utilizes the skeleton advantage of the polyurethane sponge, solves the problem that the traditional mesoporous carbon nanospheres are easy to agglomerate in practical application, realizes heavy metal passivation and material recovery, avoids secondary pollution of the traditional carbon nanospheres to the environment, provides a new idea for the existing water pollution, soil remediation and bare mine remediation technologies, and has high practical value.

title_en: Blood station is with machine blood platelet waste liquid storage device of adopting
abstract_en: The invention discloses a machine-collected platelet waste liquid storage device for a blood station, which relates to the technical field of blood collection and comprises a base, wherein the left side and the right side of the upper surface of the base are fixedly connected with supporting vertical plates. According to the invention, the sealing effect on the upper end opening of the liquid containing bottle can be realized through the arranged adjusting sealing mechanism, the condition that waste liquid in the liquid containing bottle is exposed in the air for a long time to cause environmental pollution is avoided, the adjusting sealing mechanism can be driven to move leftwards through the mutual matching among the arranged electric push rod, the supporting block and the supporting rod II, the process that a liquid drainage pipeline arranged on a mechanical mining instrument is inserted into the liquid containing bottle is further avoided being influenced, the clamping and fixing effect on the liquid drainage pipeline arranged on the mechanical mining instrument can be realized through the mutual matching among the arranged rotary disc I, the threaded rod I, the L-shaped plate and the arc-shaped clamping block II, and the stability of the liquid drainage pipeline in the process of discharging the waste liquid into the liquid containing bottle is further ensured.

title_en: Fire emergency elevator device for hospital
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire emergency elevator device for a hospital, and belongs to the field of elevators. The utility model provides a hospital is with emergent elevator device of conflagration, includes the car of installation in elevator well and the elevator well, still includes: the air suction groove is arranged on the side wall of the inner bottom of the lift car, a first filter plate is arranged in a port of the air suction groove, an air inlet hole is formed in the top of the lift car, and a second filter plate is arranged in a port of the air inlet hole; the side wall of the vertical plate is rotatably provided with a roller wheel through a rotating shaft, the circumferential outer wall of the roller wheel abuts against the inner wall of an elevator shaft, the side wall of the vertical plate is fixedly connected with an annular plate, and an air suction group connected with an air suction groove is arranged in the annular plate; the invention can effectively ensure the air in the lift car to be fresh, prevent the smoke in the lift car from influencing users, and reduce the smoke of fire from entering the lift car, thereby enabling the functions of the elevator to be more extensive.

title_en: Treatment system and treatment method for phosphogypsum leachate and washing water in phosphorus chemical industry
abstract_en: The invention discloses a treatment system and a treatment method for phosphogypsum leachate and washing water in the phosphorus chemical industry, wherein the system comprises a neutralization tank, an ultrafiltration membrane pretreatment device, an ultrafiltration water production tank, a reverse osmosis membrane concentration device, a reverse osmosis water production tank, a crystallization reactor, a solid slag dehydration device and a solid-liquid separation ultrafiltration membrane device; the homogenizing pool is used for fully mixing the phosphogypsum slag field leachate with gypsum washing water to obtain inlet water of the ultrafiltration membrane pretreatment device with relatively stable water quality; the water production outlet of the ultrafiltration membrane pretreatment device is connected with the reverse osmosis membrane concentration device through the ultrafiltration water production tank, and the backwashing water outlet of the ultrafiltration membrane pretreatment device is connected with the crystallization reaction tank; the concentrated water outlet of the reverse osmosis membrane concentration device is also connected with the crystallization reaction tank, and the clear liquid outlet of the reverse osmosis membrane concentration device is connected with the reverse osmosis water production tank. The invention can obtain high-quality produced water, and concentrated water can also return to a production system, so that resources are recycled.

title_en: Oxidation ditch vertical backflow sewage treatment device and sewage treatment method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sewage treatment equipment, in particular to an oxidation ditch vertical backflow sewage treatment device and a sewage treatment method, wherein the oxidation ditch vertical backflow sewage treatment device comprises a treatment tank and a water inlet pipe, the treatment tank comprises a third area, a first area and a second area, the third area is arranged below the treatment tank, the first area is arranged above the third area, and the second area is wrapped outside the third area and the first area; the water inlet pipe is communicated with a third area, the third area is communicated with the first area, and the second area is communicated with the third area; the sewage treatment device is characterized in that a lifting mechanism is arranged in the first region, sewage in the first region enters the second region through the lifting mechanism, a settling zone is arranged at the upper part of the treatment tank and communicated with the second region, and a water outlet pipe is arranged on the settling zone. Aim at makes the water in the device through hoisting device, produces natural reflux state to through the sediment of sedimentation tank, make the sewage after the processing finally discharge up to standard.

title_en: Hydrophilic-hydrophobic switchable flocculant and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydrophilic-hydrophobic switchable flocculant and application thereof, which are prepared by taking isopropyl acrylamide and polyhydroxy guar gum as main raw materials, adopting a polymerization-first-grafting-last method, accurately controlling the dosage of a chain transfer polymerization agent, introducing the poly isopropyl acrylamide active short chain into guar gum molecules after preparing the poly isopropyl acrylamide active short chain, and assembling a temperature-controlled hydrophilic-hydrophobic micro-block structure and guar gum macromolecules; finally, a microwave initiation technology is adopted to carry out graft copolymerization with acrylamide and acryloyloxyethyl trimethyl ammonium chloride, and a high positive charge and hydrophilic and hydrophobic polymer flocculant with controllable temperature is prepared. The flocculant can rapidly adsorb and capture hydrophobic pollution particles through hydrophobic effect, and simultaneously maintains electropositivity, so as to capture electronegative pollutants in water environment. The method has the characteristics of wide application range, low addition amount, high efficiency and excellent floccule performance, and has good application prospect.

title_en: Method and system for pretreating and strengthening dust removal of flue gas of sintering machine head
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for pretreating and strengthening dust removal of flue gas of a sintering machine head, wherein the system comprises a coarse particle slideway capturing unit, a particulate matter sound wave agglomeration unit and a coarse particle negative pressure dust removal unit; the coarse particle slideway capturing unit comprises an upstream flue, the inner cavity of the upstream flue is provided with a plurality of slideways along the flowing direction of flue gas, and a slideway groove capturing groove is formed between every two adjacent slideways; the particulate matter acoustic agglomeration unit comprises a downstream flue, the downstream flue is communicated with the upstream flue, and a plurality of groups of acoustic wave amplification assemblies are arranged on the downstream flue; the coarse particle negative pressure dust exhaust unit comprises a negative pressure main pipe, and the negative pressure main pipe is communicated with a slide way groove collecting groove of the upstream flue through a plurality of negative pressure branch pipes; the outlet end of the negative pressure main pipe is connected with the inlet end of the particulate matter acoustic agglomeration unit through a negative pressure fan. The method for pre-treating and strengthening dust removal of the flue gas of the sintering machine head has the advantages of small pressure loss, no difficulty in dust removal and ash conveying of a dust remover, and no introduction of new elements.

title_en: Device and method for synchronously monitoring oxygen and CO on cross section of tail flue of boiler
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device and a method for synchronously monitoring oxygen and CO in the section of a tail flue of a boiler, wherein the device comprises a sampling device, a sampling mixing module, a condensing module, an air pump, a filtering module, an oxygen analyzer and a CO analyzer which are sequentially connected, the sampling device carries out multi-point sampling on smoke in the section of the tail flue of the boiler and transmits the smoke to the sampling mixing module, the sampling mixing module controls the sampling amount of the sampling device, mixes the smoke and transmits the mixed smoke to the condensing module for condensation and water removal, the air pump is used for providing power for the whole device for smoke flowing, the smoke in the condensing module is transmitted to the filtering module through the air pump to filter the smoke, and the output end of the filtering module is respectively connected with the oxygen analyzer and the CO analyzer so as to monitor the oxygen and CO contents in the section of the tail flue of the boiler; the technical scheme of the invention adopts a multipoint mode to measure, thereby more comprehensively knowing the oxygen content and CO distribution condition of the cross section of the flue and ensuring that the air volume adjusting range is more accurate.

title_en: VOCs waste gas linkage treatment system and treatment method
abstract_en: The invention provides a VOCs waste gas linkage treatment system and a treatment method, which relate to the field of VOCs waste gas treatment and sequentially comprise a pretreatment subsystem, a recovery subsystem, a purification subsystem and a discharge tower, wherein the recovery subsystem adopts a combined treatment mode of recovery and treatment, the recovery subsystem fully utilizes hot air and cold air generated when a refrigerant works, so that temperature difference condensation and VOCs waste gas collection are effectively realized, and the purification subsystem of the invention not only enables the VOCs waste gas to be fully sprayed and reacted, but also enables the VOCs waste gas to realize variable-speed flow and prolongs illumination time through a plurality of groups of treatment units arranged in a hierarchical manner due to the diameter reduction design of a gas channel; through detecting VOCs numerical value in retrieving subsystem processing and purifying subsystem exhaust VOCs waste gas, when detecting numerical value and surpassing the threshold value, then retrieve subsystem and purifying subsystem exhaust VOCs waste gas backward flow and carry out the repetitive processing to corresponding subsystem, and then the dynamic processing of reinforcing VOCs waste gas.

title_en: Method for removing triclosan in water by using nano zero-valent iron-ferroferric oxide composite material
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of water treatment, and particularly relates to a method for removing triclosan in water by using a nano zero-valent iron-ferroferric oxide composite material. Adding ferroferric oxide and ferric sulfate heptahydrate into water, slowly dropwise adding a sodium borohydride solution into the water, and carrying out reduction reaction under stirring to obtain the nano zero-valent iron-ferroferric oxide composite material nZVI-Fe  3  O  4  (ii) a Adding the nano zero-valent iron-ferroferric oxide composite material into water containing triclosan, and reacting to remove the triclosan. Mixing nZVI with Fe  3  O  4  The prepared composite material can prevent the oxidation and passivation of zero-valent iron in the reaction process and provide a new way for the transfer of electrons. At the same time, the user can select the desired position,Fe  3  O  4  has good magnetic response to external magnetic field, and is convenient for repeated utilization. The method adopts the nano zero-valent iron-ferroferric oxide composite material to remove the triclosan in the water for the first time, and can efficiently and completely remove the triclosan in the water in an environment-friendly way. Meanwhile, the recycling agent has a high-efficiency recycling rate convenient to recycle, has excellent economic benefits and has a wide application prospect.

title_en: Photoelectric integrated heat dissipation method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a photoelectric integrated heat dissipation method and device, and belongs to the technical field of energy conservation. The invention comprises the following steps: the photovoltaic module is installed on the electric cabinet, the power output end of the photovoltaic module is connected with the power input end of the heat dissipation module of the electric cabinet, the power output end of the photovoltaic module and the power supply of the electric cabinet to the heat dissipation module are connected in parallel, and electric energy generated by the photovoltaic module is used for supplying power to the heat dissipation module of the electric cabinet. The photovoltaic power generation is utilized to supplement power for the heat dissipation equipment of the electrical cabinet, and the power is supplied by the original power supply when the light intensity is insufficient, so that the inward transfer of light and heat is reduced, and a part of electric energy for heat dissipation is saved, thus the electric energy can be saved, the working load of the electrical cabinet is reduced, and the sunlight directly irradiating the electrical cabinet can be partially converted into electric energy, so that the light and heat effect is reduced, the heat dissipation is facilitated, and the carbon emission is reduced.

title_en: Method for driving hexavalent chromium to be instantaneously reduced by virtue of limited domain system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of environmental water treatment, and particularly relates to a method for driving instantaneous reduction of hexavalent chromium by a limited-area system. In order to solve the problems of low performance, high energy consumption, poor interference resistance, poor low-concentration removal effect, complex process and the like in the prior art, the invention provides a simple, high-efficiency, pollution-free, energy-consumption-free, strong interference resistance and waste treatment by waste, and the method can realize the synchronous removal of hexavalent chromium wastewater and oxalic acid wastewater, and can reduce and remove Cr (VI) in a water body in a very short time at high and low concentrations.

title_en: Biological complexing agent for efficiently degrading organic pollutants in sewage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a biological complexing agent for efficiently degrading organic pollutants in sewage, which comprises a shell; the shell is provided with a plurality of honeycomb-shaped holes; biological capsules are arranged in the honeycomb holes; the biological capsule is filled with a microbial agent for degrading organic pollutants. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages that the sewage is treated in a mode of combining the chemical agent and the microbial agent, the relative suitability of the environment where the microbial agent is positioned is ensured, and the activity intensity and the decomposition efficiency of the microbial agent are improved.

title_en: Targeting method water quality upgrading process system
abstract_en: The invention provides a targeting method water quality upgrading process system, which comprises a targeting biological adsorption and degradation device, a targeting micro-electrolysis reaction device, a targeting adsorption and filtration device and a targeting adsorption and denitrification device, wherein the devices are sequentially connected through a water pump and a pipeline; the device removes CODcr and BOD contained in the tail water through targeted adsorption degradation and filtration  5  Target pollutants such as ammonia nitrogen, total phosphorus and the like. The invention can be directly installed in the effluent of a sewage treatment plantThe treated water can be recycled or directly conveyed to nearby rivers, lakes and seas, so that the problem of water environment pollution is solved, the ecological flow of the rivers and lakes needing water supplement is solved, and the problem that the construction of an emergency waste reservoir pond occupies agricultural land is solved. The process system disclosed by the invention is simple in structure and convenient to operate in the working process, greatly reduces the preparation cost and the pollution control cost, and brings a new idea for a sewage treatment technology.

title_en: Device and process for recovering and extracting furfural from process wastewater
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a process for recovering and extracting furfural from process wastewater; the dehydration deacidification tower in the former process is connected with an inlet of a process wastewater storage tank, an outlet of the process wastewater storage tank is connected with a process wastewater feed pump, an outlet of the process wastewater feed pump is connected with an inlet of a preheater, an outlet of the preheater is connected with an inlet of a light component removal rectifying tower, a liquid phase of a tower bottom of the light component removal rectifying tower is connected with an inlet of a recovery distilling tower, a gas phase at the top of the recovery distilling tower is connected with an inlet of a recovery condenser, the recovery condenser is connected with an inlet of an aldehyde separating tank, and an outlet at the lower part of the aldehyde separating tank is connected with an inlet of a crude furfural removing storage tank; and the vapor phase at the top of the light component removal rectifying tower is connected with the inlet of a light component removal condenser, the outlet of the light component removal condenser is connected with the inlet of a liquid separation tank, the outlet of the liquid separation tank is connected with the inlet of a light component storage tank, and the outlet of the light component storage tank is connected with a light component delivery pump. The distillation in the tower is carried out in a stable temperature range, the technological process of recovering and extracting furfural from waste water is realized, the refining yield can be improved by 3-6 percent, and the relative economic benefit is improved by 3-5 percent.

title_en: In-situ dewatering system for sludge storage yard
abstract_en: The invention discloses an in-situ dewatering system for a sludge storage yard, which comprises the following components: offer the annular seal groove at soil body global, establish a plurality of drain bars in the soil body interpolation, the top of a plurality of drain bars is located the soil body top, and the top intercommunication of a plurality of drain bars is provided with the intercommunication device, is located a plurality of intercommunication devices of same line and communicates the setting in proper order, and the intercommunication device that is located soil body one side is closed the setting, and the intercommunication device intercommunication that is located the soil body opposite side is provided with vacuum apparatus, and the soil body top is provided with cladding device, and cladding device's edge setting is sealed in annular seal groove and through the earthing, and cladding device and intercommunication device intercommunication are run through to vacuum apparatus's output. According to the invention, on the basis of vacuum preloading, a storage yard in-situ dehydration technology is adopted, so that the transportation weight is greatly reduced, and the transportation cost is reduced.

title_en: Hydrogen-doped gas unit efficiency improving control system and method based on standard emission
abstract_en: The invention provides an efficiency control system and method for a hydrogen-doped gas unit based on standard emission, which can improve the front temperature of a turbine of a gas turbine to a certain extent by doping hydrogen in the safety margin range of the gas unit as the combustion temperature of hydrogen is higher than that of common natural gas (the main component is natural gas), and can improve the efficiency of the unit to the maximum extent by adjusting systems such as SCR denitration and the like at the standard emission of nitrogen oxides.

title_en: Multi-filter-element air filtering unit
abstract_en: A filter assembly, comprising: an inner filter element; an outer filter element; the filter element flange end cover comprises a base peripheral flange and a cylindrical raised base positioned in the center; a cartridge flange top cap including an annular portion defining an opening, a peripheral flange; whereby one end of the inner cartridge is secured around said centrally located cylindrical boss base and the other end of the inner cartridge is received by said opening in said cartridge flange top cap; and one end of the outer cartridge engages the inner wall of the base peripheral flange and the other end of the outer cartridge engages the inner wall of the peripheral flange.

title_en: Heating system and method for heating primary air and low-temperature flue gas by using economizer water supply
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ultralow emission processes of flue gas in a waste incineration power plant, and particularly relates to a heating system and a heating method for heating primary air and low-temperature flue gas by using water supplied by an economizer, wherein the heating system comprises a deaerator, a water supply pump, the economizer, at least one air preheater, a flue gas purification system, a primary air circulation heating system and a low-temperature flue gas heating system, the water supply pump generates first high-pressure water, the first high-pressure water is introduced into the economizer, the economizer outputs undersaturated water, and the undersaturated water output by the economizer is introduced into the flue gas purification system and the air preheater for heating low-temperature flue gas and primary air; the high-temperature flue gas passes through the economizer, and the flue gas output by the economizer is introduced into a flue gas purification system, and the flue gas purification system heats the low-temperature flue gas by utilizing the flue gas output by the economizer and undersaturated water output by the economizer. The invention solves the problems of high energy consumption and complex system caused by adopting high-quality steam to heat a primary air and low-temperature flue gas system by the air preheater and a flue gas heater before SCR.

title_en: Reduction furnace system for producing lithium ferrous fluoride sulfate
abstract_en: The invention provides a reducing furnace system for producing lithium ferrous fluoride sulfate, which belongs to the technical field of lithium ferrous fluoride sulfate production equipment and comprises a reducing furnace body and a flocculation impurity removal tank communicated with the reducing furnace body, wherein a stirring tank is communicated between the reducing furnace body and the flocculation impurity removal tank; the reducing furnace body comprises a power bin and a reaction bin, a stirring mechanism and an automatic discharging mechanism are arranged in the reaction bin, and the automatic discharging mechanism comprises a power floating ring and a sealing discharging assembly matched with the power floating ring; the flocculation impurity removal tank comprises a sedimentation tank, a filter plate is arranged in the sedimentation tank, a reciprocating power mechanism for driving the filter plate to move forwards and backwards is arranged on one side of an upper port of the sedimentation tank, and a guide turnover mechanism which is matched with the reciprocating power mechanism for guiding and driving the filter plate to turn over is arranged on the other side of the sedimentation tank; the reducing furnace body is skillfully matched with the sealed discharging assembly through the dynamic floating ring to realize quantitative discharging, and the flocculation impurity removing pond communicated with the reducing furnace body can continuously remove flocculation sediments, so that the effect is improved.

title_en: Layer house excrement purification treatment equipment and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a layer farm excrement purification treatment device and a use method thereof, and the device comprises a feeding device, wherein a separation device is arranged at the bottom of the feeding device, a gas storage device is fixedly connected to the left side of the separation device, the feeding device comprises a collecting device, and the device relates to the technical field of cultivation.

title_en: Dust collecting device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a dust collecting device, comprising: the device comprises a box body, an electric control unit, a dust collecting unit, a filtering unit, a blowing unit and a dust collecting box; the electric control unit is electrically connected with the dust collecting unit, the dust collecting unit is arranged on the box body and communicated with the box body, and the box body is provided with an air inlet; the electric control unit sends a dust collection control signal to the dust collection unit, and the dust collection unit extracts air outside the box body into the box body through the air inlet in a first time period according to the dust collection control signal; the filtering unit is arranged in the box body and is used for filtering dust in the air extracted into the box body; the electronic control unit is electrically connected with the blowing unit, after a first time period, the electronic control unit sends a blowing control signal to the blowing unit, and the blowing unit blows dust attached to the filtering unit down into the dust collecting box in a second time period according to the blowing control signal.

title_en: Organic waste aerobic fermentation equipment and process
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of organic waste treatment, in particular to an organic waste aerobic fermentation device and a process.

title_en: Anti-vulcanization thick film chip type fixed resistor and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vulcanization-resistant thick film sheet type fixed resistor and a use method thereof, relating to the related field of thick film sheet type fixed resistors and aiming at solving the problem that the prior thick film sheet type fixed resistor is easy to cause internal heat accumulation phenomenon of the fixed resistor when the sulfur-resistant operation is carried out in the prior art.

title_en: Slaughter wastewater treatment and self-checking treatment tank based on internet of things technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slaughter wastewater treatment and self-inspection treatment pool based on the technology of Internet of things, which comprises a treatment box body, a first water inlet pipe, a grid separation box and a main water inlet pipe, wherein the first water inlet pipe is installed at the top end of the treatment box body, one end of the first water inlet pipe, which is far away from the treatment box body, is connected with the grid separation box, the top end of the grid separation box is connected with the main water inlet pipe, and the slaughter wastewater treatment and self-inspection treatment pool further comprises: the first filter screen is arranged inside the processing box body; and the second filter screen is arranged below the first filter screen. This slaughter waste water treatment and self-checking treatment pond based on internet of things, the inside of disinfect box is provided with the rotary rod and connects the blade, and the top of disinfect box is provided with the second inlet tube, the exit end of second inlet tube is the vertical state with connecting the blade, and then when the second inlet tube goes out water, can drive and connect the blade and rotate, drive the mounting panel and rotate together, stir between disinfectant and the waste water for the disinfection progress of waste water.

title_en: Bag filter blowback system that has on-line monitoring function
abstract_en: The invention provides a bag filter back-flushing system with an online monitoring function, which can increase the detection precision of the difference between the internal pressure and the external pressure of a filter bag by reasonably setting the position of a pressure sensor, thereby improving the accuracy of the online monitoring function of the bag filter and more accurately triggering the back-flushing system; the ash removal efficiency of a back flushing system can be improved by adding the filter bag shaking device; the hot air blowing device arranged on the side wall of the box body can further enhance the dust cleaning capability of the back blowing system under the condition of higher humidity.

title_en: System and method for directly capturing air carbon by ascending air flow tower
abstract_en: The application provides a system and a method for capturing direct air carbon in an updraft tower. Wherein, updraft tower direct air carbon capture system includes: the device comprises a carbon capturing unit, an updraft tower, a desorption medium conveying pump, a desorption medium heater, a vacuum pump and a carbon dioxide storage unit. The carbon capturing unit is used for absorbing carbon dioxide in the original air and desorbing the absorbed carbon dioxide under the action of a desorption medium; the rising airflow tower is used for providing power for the raw air entering the carbon capturing unit, heating the clean air adsorbed by the carbon dioxide based on the energy of sunlight, and discharging the heated clean air; a desorption medium heater for heating the desorption medium based on the heated clean air; the desorption medium heater is positioned in the updraft tower; a vacuum pump for discharging the captured carbon dioxide; and a carbon dioxide storage unit for storing the captured carbon dioxide gas.

title_en: Sewage treatment device and process compatible with multiple denitrification paths
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sewage denitrification, in particular to a sewage treatment device compatible with multiple denitrification paths and a process, wherein the device comprises a ventilation mechanism, a stirring tank, a first aeration/stirring alternating tank, a second aeration/stirring alternating tank, an oxygenation tank, a mud-water separation mechanism, a gas diffusion mechanism and a structure for installing biological fillers, wherein the stirring tank, the first aeration/stirring alternating tank, the second aeration/stirring alternating tank, the oxygenation tank and the mud-water separation mechanism are sequentially arranged along the sewage flow direction; the device also comprises a first backflow channel and a second backflow channel, wherein two ends of the first backflow channel are respectively communicated with the stirring tank and the second aeration/stirring alternating tank, and two ends of the second backflow channel are respectively communicated with the stirring tank and the mud-water separator mechanism. The invention can combine multiple denitrification paths, is applicable to continuous treatment of urban sewage with low ammonia nitrogen concentration and large load change through lower energy consumption, and realizes synergistic effect of high-efficiency denitrification and carbon emission reduction.

title_en: Assembled plant wall with air purification function
abstract_en: The invention discloses an assembled plant wall with an air purification function, which belongs to the technical field of plant walls and comprises an over-assembled supporting mechanism, wherein the assembled supporting mechanism comprises a base and three supporting pieces, the three supporting pieces are positioned on the upper surface of the outer wall of the base, the intervals between every two supporting pieces are the same, a watering purification mechanism is arranged on the base and comprises a fish culture tank body and a pump body, the fish culture tank body is arranged on the horizontal part of the outer wall of the base, and the pump body is arranged on one side of the upper surface of an inner cavity of the base through bolts.

title_en: Method for accelerating anaerobic ammonia oxidation by using organic waste liquid
abstract_en: According to the invention, the preparation of ammonia nitrogen and instant solution slurry is realized by building a two-stage series anaerobic ammonia oxidation low-temperature plasma accelerator and using aluminum chloride and organic waste liquid in a cascade manner, the starting acceleration of the ammoxidation process is realized, and the total nitrogen removal rate of the anaerobic ammonia oxidation system can reach 84% as high as 30 days after starting, and is far higher than the total nitrogen removal rate of the original anaerobic ammonia oxidation system after starting under the same test conditions for 30 days.

title_en: Green intelligent dirty oil recovery device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of dirty oil recovery, in particular to a green electricity intelligent dirty oil recovery device, which comprises a filter pressing separation system; the filter pressing separation system comprises a filter box with an open top surface, two filter hole areas are oppositely arranged on the bottom surface of the filter box, and the lower parts of the two filter hole areas are connected with the two evaporation separation systems; middle fixing of bottom surface of filter box a discharge pipe mechanism is arranged; the filter box is internally and movably connected with a filter pressing mechanism which is connected with a driving system connected outside the filter box; drive system and two vapor separations the system is electrically connected with a green energy power supply system. The driving system can drive and control the filter pressing mechanism to squeeze and filter the dirty oil sludge, so that the dirty oil sludge can be scraped and treated in the filter hole area, the blocking probability of the filter hole area is reduced, and the dirty oil sludge can be squeezed and treated, so that sewage, dirty oil and sludge are separated to a certain extent.

title_en: Method for removing fluorine from copper smelting wastewater gypsum filtrate
