abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wastewater treatment, in particular to a method for removing fluorine from a gypsum filtrate of copper smelting wastewater. Adding a defluorination reagent A and a defluorination reagent B into gypsum filtrate according to a certain proportion, fully mixing, and uniformly stirring to obtain a mixed solution; adding soluble hydroxide into the mixed solution, fully mixing, uniformly stirring, and adjusting the pH value of a reaction system; adding coagulant aid into the mixed solution according to a certain proportion, fully mixing, uniformly stirring, standing, and obtaining precipitate and filtrate by using a filtering mode. The method can remove most of fluoride ions and heavy metal pollutants in the gypsum filtrate, can reduce the concentration of the fluoride ions in the gypsum filtrate to be below 5mg/l, can meet GB 25467-2010 emission standard of industrial pollutants of copper, cobalt and nickel, and greatly improves the environmental protection benefit of enterprises.

title_en: Retractable water drawing structure of seaplane under high-speed large-load condition
abstract_en: The structure comprises a water drawing bucket shell, a bucket body, a hydraulic actuator, a rotating shaft and a rocker arm, wherein the rotating shaft is connected with the water drawing bucket shell through a bearing; the bucket body and the rocker arm are fixedly connected with the rotating shaft; hydraulic actuator's one end and the bearing hinged joint of rocking arm, hydraulic actuator drives the pivot through the drive rocking arm and rotates with the bucket body and make the bucket body pack up or put down, this simple structure, the quality is light, and the function is reliable, and the security is high, satisfies the seaworthiness clause requirement.

title_en: Flexible assembled river lake water body in-situ purification system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of river and lake water body purification, and relates to a flexible assembly type river and lake water body in-situ purification system, which comprises a floating body device, a water quality purification unit, a biological membrane collection and treatment device and a solar panel; a water inlet is arranged on the floating body device, and a water outlet is arranged at the bottom of the biomembrane collecting and processing device; the water quality purification unit and the biomembrane collection and treatment device are sequentially arranged on the floating body device from front to back; the water quality purification unit is communicated with the water inlet; the water inlet is communicated with the water outlet through the water quality purification unit and the biomembrane collection and treatment device; the solar panel provides energy output for the water quality purification unit and the biological film collection and treatment device respectively. The invention provides a flexible assembly type river and lake water body in-situ purification system which is provided with assembly type units, has high purification efficiency, can change corresponding shapes according to different river channels, and has simple and practical process.

title_en: Biochar and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of new material preparation, and particularly relates to a biochar as well as a preparation method and application thereof. According to the invention, the algae residues and the potassium hydroxide are pyrolyzed in one step to prepare the biochar, the potassium hydroxide and the algae residues are mixed to promote the release of organic components in the algae residues, so that the potassium hydroxide and the algae residues are in full contact in the subsequent pyrolysis stage, and the potassium hydroxide is used as a support body during pyrolysis to promote the biochar to form a rich pore structure, so that the prepared biochar is more fluffy in structure, the lamellar structure in the microstructure is obviously increased, the particles are uniformly dispersed, the specific surface area is greatly increased, and the adsorption performance is further improved. The biochar prepared by the method has large adsorption capacity on organic pollutants in simulated wastewater, has good effect on different pollutants, and has the adsorption capacity on anionic dye methyl orange of 244.63mg/g and the adsorption capacity on cationic dye methylene blue of 485.43mg/g.

title_en: Process for treating garbage leachate by combining biological treatment and membrane assembly
abstract_en: The invention relates to a technology for treating landfill leachate by combining biological treatment and a membrane component, which belongs to the technical field of landfill leachate treatment, and the technology comprises the steps of adopting MBR biological membrane treatment after two-stage nitrification-denitrification, adopting indirect aeration in the MBR treatment process, and controlling the time of A/O (anaerobic/anoxic/oxic) to continuously generate nitrification-denitrification and shortcut nitrification in an MBR system, so that the total nitrogen in the landfill leachate is effectively reduced, and the influence of insufficient carbon quantity in the existing landfill leachate on denitrification is solved; the invention adopts the intermittent aeration type MBR treatment process, and can fully reduce the total nitrogen content in the landfill leachate by controlling the process conditions.

title_en: Sodium ion removing material CoMoO 4 @CQDs-NCNTs and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides aSodium ion removal material CoMoO  4  The preparation method and application of the @ CQDs-NCNTs comprise the following steps: heating anhydrous citric acid, cooling, adjusting to neutrality, filtering carbon particles, dialyzing, and drying at low temperature to obtain carbon quantum dot solid; adding methyl orange into water, ice-bath, stirring, adding anhydrous ferric chloride, ice-bath, stirring, adding pyrrole monomer, ice-bath, stirring, filtering, cleaning, soaking, centrifuging, cleaning, and suction-filtering to obtain polypyrrole film; weighing cobalt nitrate, adding the cobalt nitrate into deionized water, stirring, adding sodium molybdate and carbon quantum dot solids, stirring, putting a polypyrrole film into the mixture, cleaning the mixture, and drying the mixture in vacuum; heating and heating; the surface of the carbon quantum dot obtained by high-temperature pyrolysis of citric acid contains a large number of oxygen-containing functional groups, can be used as a structure guiding agent for nucleation growth, can effectively adsorb cobalt ions, and can successfully grow supported cobalt molybdate on the surface of polypyrrole under a hydrothermal condition.

title_en: Reduction treatment system and method for heavy metal-containing wastewater
abstract_en: The invention relates to a heavy metal-containing wastewater reduction treatment system and a heavy metal-containing wastewater reduction treatment method. The first reduction module and the permeation module are arranged in series in backflow in the flowing direction of incoming water to form a step reduction structure. According to the invention, the first reducing module and the second reducing module jointly form a reducing system, so that the quality of the reduced produced water reaches the requirement of entering the ultra-pure water preparation device under the condition of ensuring the normal operation of the reverse osmosis device, and the investment of reducing treatment can be reduced, the reducing efficiency is improved, the wastewater treatment capacity in unit time is increased, the high reduction of wastewater is realized, and the water recovery rate is increased.

title_en: Recycling system of nitrogen in cryogenic system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of nitrogen recycling, and discloses a nitrogen recycling system in a cryogenic system, which comprises a pressure swing adsorption device and a nitrogen buffer device, wherein the pressure swing adsorption device comprises a pressure swing adsorption device body and a nitrogen buffer device; the pressure swing adsorption device comprises an air inlet and an air outlet; the air outlet is communicated with an inlet of the nitrogen buffer device; the outlet of the nitrogen buffer device is communicated with the cryogenic system; the pressure swing adsorption device is loaded with a modified activated carbon adsorbent; after the gas in the pressure swing adsorption device is subjected to pressure swing adsorption by the modified activated carbon adsorbent, the unadsorbed gas is introduced into the nitrogen buffer device to be compressed and then is directly used in the reaction system. The method improves the recycling efficiency of the nitrogen by adsorbing and removing impurities through the adsorbent, obtains the nitrogen with high yield and high purity, has simple operation, and can directly reuse the nitrogen as the nitrogen protection gas for reaction.

title_en: Silicon-manganese slag resource utilization production method
abstract_en: The application discloses a silicomanganese slag resource utilization production method and a device, wherein the silicomanganese slag resource utilization production method comprises the following steps of acid leaching treatment: adding the silicomanganese slag into a solution containing ammonium sulfate, and adding sulfuric acid to leach to obtain an acid leaching solution and silicocalcium slag; calcium leaching treatment: leaching the calcium silicate slag by using a calcium-poor solution containing an ultra-solvent, adding ammonia water in the reaction process to dissolve gypsum in the solution, and then filtering and separating to obtain a calcium-rich solution and silicon dioxide; gypsum crystallization treatment: and (3) discharging ammonia and redundant water in the solution by the calcium-rich liquid through evaporation, concentrating the calcium-rich liquid to convert gypsum into precipitate again, separating to obtain a gypsum product and a calcium-poor liquid, and performing calcium-leaching treatment on the calcium-poor liquid again. The invention also provides a device suitable for the method.

title_en: Double-network polyvinyl butyral sponge and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a double-network polyvinyl butyral sponge and a preparation method and application thereof. Under the high temperature and acidic condition, the polyvinyl alcohol and the butyraldehyde are condensed to form a cross-linked network structure, and simultaneously, the olefin unsaturated monomer containing sulfonic acid groups or carboxyl groups is initiated to be polymerized in situ to form a polymer network which penetrates through the acetal network structure, so that the polyvinyl butyral sponge with an interpenetrating double-network structure is obtained. The dual-network polyvinyl butyral sponge prepared by the application avoids using formaldehyde with higher toxicity, has high dry infiltration rate and excellent mechanical property, remarkably improves the adsorption performance of cationic dye on the basis of keeping the self adsorption capacity of the sponge, and can be used circularly by desorption of a desorption agent; has better application prospect in the field of cationic dye in adsorption wastewater.

title_en: Porous film and composite film
abstract_en: The present invention provides a porous membrane having an uneven structure having convex portions and concave portions on at least one surface, and having a cross-sectional area of 0.01 [ mu ] m in a plane having a height of 50nm from a reference surface of the surface  2  ~0.10μm  2  The average number density of the projections is 4.0 pieces/. Mu.m  2  Hereinafter, the cross-sectional area in a plane having a height of 20nm from the reference surface of the aforementioned surface is 0.01 μm  2  ~0.10μm  2  The average number density of the projections is 1.0 pieces/. Mu.m  2  The above.

title_en: Fire-fighting and rescuing device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire fighting and rescue, and provides a fire fighting and rescue device which comprises a mobile unit, a fire fighting aerial ladder and a rescue mechanism, wherein the two ends of the fire fighting aerial ladder are respectively connected with the mobile unit and the rescue mechanism, the rescue mechanism comprises a rescue platform, and a fire fighting mechanism and a telescopic rescue ladder which are arranged on the rescue platform, the telescopic rescue ladder comprises a driving telescopic cylinder, a plurality of treading pieces and telescopic sleeves, the heads and the tails of the telescopic sleeves are sequentially sleeved, the pipe diameters of the telescopic sleeves are gradually reduced, the telescopic sleeve at the tail end is arranged on the rescue platform, the two ends of the driving telescopic cylinder are respectively connected to two telescopic sleeves at the tail end and the head end, the telescopic sleeves are arranged in pairs and symmetrically, and one treading piece is connected between every two opposite telescopic sleeves. Through the technical scheme, the problem that the wounded person is difficult to transfer to the scaling ladder in high altitude in the prior art is solved.

title_en: Micro-rotating floating oil and water removal and purification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a micro-rotating floating oil removal and water purification method.A circular orifice plate with a plurality of orifice pipes at the lower part is arranged on the horizontal section in a circular cylinder, and an air-entrapping pipe orifice is additionally arranged on the cylinder wall below the welding circumferential line of the circular orifice plate and the cylinder wall; when the gas-liquid surface falls to the lower outlet of the pore pipe, the gas is continuously dissolved into each micro-cyclone water flow, and oil in water adhered to micro-bubbles is dissolved into the micro-bubbles and moves to the micro-cyclone center under the action of centrifugal force; the water rises and floats to a micro-vortex floating surface through a negative pressure channel at the center of the micro-vortex under the double actions of micro-bubble expansion and buoyancy; then the slightly-swirled oil gas is circularly transferred into the tank by the large-swirl centrifugal force in the tank; the oil gas collected in the inner circle floats to the tank top under the buoyancy action of gas and is discharged and recovered from the oil collecting pipe opening, so that the oil storage in the outer space of the hole pipe is eliminated, and the micro-vortex oil removing and water purifying effect is improved.

title_en: Integrated circulating water purifier
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water purifiers and discloses an integrated circulating water purifier which comprises a box body, wherein a settling tank is fixedly connected to the inner top end of the box body, a filter tank is attached to the bottom end of the settling tank, a connecting pipe is communicated with the side wall of the settling tank and the top end of the filter tank, the filter tank is fixedly connected with the inner wall of the box body, a box body is slidably connected to the inner bottom end of the settling tank, a group of reset components are arranged on the inner wall of the box body, the box body is matched with a baffle through the reset components, the baffle is hinged to the inner bottom end of the box body, the baffle is attached to the inner wall of the settling tank, a slide rod is slidably connected to the inner wall of the settling tank, a slide plate is fixedly connected to the bottom end of the slide rod, and a plurality of fine springs are fixedly connected between the slide rod and the inner top end of the settling tank, so that the problems that impurities or sludge in water and the like need to enter the cavity manually to be cleaned, the problems that the impurities or the sludge and the impurities or the sludge in the water and the water need to consume various electric power and are not environment-friendly and convenient are caused are solved.

title_en: Lead-antimony coating titanium anode plate with intermediate layer and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a lead-antimony coating titanium anode plate with an intermediate layer, which comprises a titanium substrate, a tin-antimony intermediate layer and a lead-antimony active layer, wherein the tin-antimony intermediate layer is positioned on the titanium substrate and the lead-antimony active layer, and antimony is dispersed in tin dioxide in the tin-antimony intermediate layer; the components of the lead-antimony active layer comprise lead-antimony oxide. The lead-antimony coating titanium anode plate prepared by the sol-gel method has the advantages that the surface is compact and uniform, the coverage is complete, the lead-antimony coating titanium anode plate with the regular cellular micropore morphology structure can be obtained through doping modification of antimony elements in the active layer and effective regulation and control of preparation conditions, the specific surface area and the stability of the material are greatly increased, the catalytic activity point position is increased, the electrocatalytic performance and the stability of the electrode are obviously improved, and the service life of the electrode is obviously prolonged.

title_en: Safe type power communication equipment box
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety type electric power communication equipment box which structurally comprises a top cover, a box door, an adding port and a communication mainframe box, wherein the top cover is fixedly arranged at the top of the communication mainframe box, the box door is arranged at the front end of the communication mainframe box, when spontaneous combustion of electric power equipment in the box body occurs due to strong outdoor illumination, flame and heat generated by the spontaneous combustion extrude a hot pressing plate upwards, the hot pressing plate drives an extrusion plate to extrude in a powder box, air pressure in the powder box shrinks, dry powder is sprayed out from a nozzle, short circuit caused by contact between the electric power equipment in the box body and water is effectively avoided, the safety of the box body and the electric power equipment is kept to the maximum extent, explosion is prevented, after heat is discharged, a spring shaft drives an opening and closing piece to reset automatically, external dust is prevented from entering the inside of a heat dissipation pore plate, blockage in the heat dissipation pore plate is prevented, and the temperature in the box body is reduced due to the heat dissipation effect.

title_en: Water container with manual dispensing valve
abstract_en: A water dispenser (1), the water dispenser (1) comprising: a container (5), the container (5) having an outlet channel (15) at its bottom (3); and a manually operated valve device (14), the valve device (14) having a valve member (19) which is elastically prestressed towards a closed state.

title_en: Power monitoring system for railway freight diesel locomotive
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power monitoring and intelligent management of railway freight diesel locomotives, and particularly relates to a power monitoring system of a railway diesel locomotive, which comprises a temperature sensor, a pressure sensor, a liquid level sensor, a water pressure impact sensor, an RS485 integrator, a data processing end, a cloud server and a mobile client, wherein the temperature sensor is used for measuring a waste gas temperature signal of the internal combustion engine, the pressure sensor is used for measuring the air pressure in a supercharger and a voltage stabilizer of the internal combustion engine, the liquid level sensor is used for monitoring a water level signal of an expansion water tank, the water pressure sensor is used for monitoring the outlet pressure of a cold water pump and a high-temperature water pump of the internal combustion engine, the measurement signal of each sensor is collected by the RS485 integrator and then sent to the data processing end, the data processing end packages the data and sends the data to the cloud server, and the cloud server stores the data remotely and sends the data to the mobile client.

title_en: High-resolution imaging asymmetric cone beam detection method for aeroengine closed inner cavity
abstract_en: The invention discloses an asymmetric cone beam detection method for high-resolution imaging of an aeroengine closed inner cavity, which comprises the steps of preparing a mixture of radioactive nuclide and aviation kerosene, injecting the mixture into the aeroengine closed inner cavity, installing and fixing the aeroengine on a fixed detection table in a positron emission tomography scanner, arranging a rotary drum on the periphery of the fixed detection table in the positron emission tomography scanner, arranging a first detector array formed by a plurality of rows of gamma photon detection crystals arranged in a circular arc shape and a second detector array formed by the gamma photon detection crystals arranged in the circular arc shape and opposite to the first detector array in the same row number, carrying out real-time data acquisition on gamma photon pairs generated by annihilation of the aviation kerosene mixture marked by the nuclide in the aeroengine closed inner cavity by the first detector array and the second detector array, and carrying out three-dimensional image reconstruction on detected gamma photon fan beam data to obtain high-resolution imaging.

title_en: Preparation method of low-odor low-VOC composite skin
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a low-odor low-VOC composite skin, which mainly solves the problems of large odor and high VOC of the composite skin for automobile interior decoration in the prior art. The invention discloses a preparation method of a low-odor low-VOC composite skin, which comprises the following steps: 1) The gas and the air are dried and then respectively enter a gas buffer tank and an air buffer tank; 2) The gas coming out of the gas buffer tank enters a mixer after pressure control; 3) The air from the air buffer tank enters a mixer after pressure control; 4) Controlling the volume ratio of the fuel gas to the air in the fuel gas and air flow adjusting mixer to obtain uniform mixed gas; 5) The mixed gas enters a gas purification device filled with molecular sieve adsorbents to obtain purified mixed gas; 6) The purified mixed gas enters a flame compounding machine for flame compounding to obtain the low-odor low-VOC compound skin, so that the problem is well solved, and the method can be used in industrial production of the automotive interior compound skin.

title_en: Rear-loading garbage compression mechanism for classified loading and unloading adjustable volume vehicle
abstract_en: The vehicular after-loading garbage compressing mechanism includes carriage, two-station garbage collecting box, garbage compressing mechanism and winding mechanism. The key technology is that (1) the carriage is divided into two sections by upper and lower layers, the middle interlayer is divided into two sections, the rear section is a fixed interlayer and is connected with the carriage body into a whole, the other section is a section with one end of the front section interlayer hinged with the fixed interlayer and capable of rotating up and down, the other end of the front section is fixed with a steel wire rope, and the upper and lower layer volume changes can be realized by the up-and-down swing of the front section through a winch outside the front wall of the carriage. (2) The compressing mechanisms of the garbage are designed on the box body, the two sets of compressing mechanisms are distributed up and down to realize respective collection and respectively compress, the compressing mechanism scraping plate on the upper layer is opened to realize the unloading of the garbage on the upper layer when unloading, and the compressing mechanism scraping plate on the lower layer is opened to realize the unloading of the garbage on the lower layer when unloading, so that the classified collection and the classified unloading are realized. (3) The movable arc-shaped part in the two-station collecting box can move up and down, when the movable arc-shaped part is in butt joint with the upper layer of the box body, garbage poured into the box body from the garbage turning mechanism is in the upper layer space, the compression mechanism on the upper layer is started to press the garbage into the upper layer of the box body, when the movable arc-shaped part is in butt joint with the lower layer (the upper compression mechanism is in a compression state), the garbage poured into the box body from the garbage turning mechanism is in the lower layer space, the compression mechanism on the lower layer is started, and the garbage is pressed into the lower layer of the box body. The mechanism can realize classified collection, classified transportation and classified unloading for classified garbage, and has greater economic benefit compared with the existing collection and transportation mode.

title_en: Sludge drying circulation structure and sludge drying system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sludge drying circulation structure which comprises a supporting seat, wherein the side wall of the supporting seat is rotationally connected with a drying cylinder, the inner wall of the drying cylinder is provided with a feed inlet, an opening and closing door is arranged in the feed inlet, the side wall of the supporting seat is provided with a hot air groove, the inner wall of the hot air groove is provided with an air inlet, electric heating equipment is arranged in the hot air groove, and an axial flow fan is arranged in the hot air groove. The invention can synchronously drive the drying cylinder to rotate when the axial flow fan conveys the hot air flow to the flow guide pipe by arranging the drying cylinder, the baffle plate, the flow guide pipe, the pipe network and other parts, thus the sludge can be continuously conveyed to the top and then freely falls down, the sludge can be unfolded in a larger area and fully contacted with the discharged hot air flow, and the drying efficiency of the sludge can be greatly improved.

title_en: System and method for monitoring and controlling medical radioactive wastewater in real time
abstract_en: The application relates to a system and a method for monitoring and controlling medical radioactive wastewater in real time, which comprises a decay tank body, wherein the top of the side wall of the decay tank body is communicated with a water inlet pipe, and the bottom of the side wall of the decay tank body is communicated with a water outlet pipe; the real-time monitoring and control system further comprises: the ionization detector is used for monitoring the radioactivity of the waste water in the decay Chi Ben body in real time and outputting a monitoring signal; the first controller is connected with the ionization detector and receives the monitoring signal, and if the radiometric value of the monitoring signal is smaller than the reference radiometric value of the first controller, the first controller outputs a discharge signal; if the radiometric value of the monitoring signal is not less than the reference radiometric value of the first controller, the first controller outputs a closing signal; and the electromagnetic valve opens the drain pipe when receiving the discharge signal and closes the drain pipe when receiving the closing signal. This application has and to carry out real-time supervision to the radioactivity of waste water in the decay pond to can realize the discharged effect of waste water according to the monitoring numerical value is automatic.

title_en: Salvia officinalis, application and culture method thereof and method for degrading plastics
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of microorganism application, in particular to a sage, an application and culture method thereof and a method for degrading plastics. The present invention provides a mouse tail bacterium (A) Muricauda olearia ) The preservation number is CGMCC No.26018, has a plastic degradation function, can degrade polyethylene in seawater, and has high degradation efficiency. Experiments show that the invention is extracted from Hainan provinceThe sage MYA14 is successfully separated and screened from the mangrove forest bottom mud near the estuary of the river, the polyethylene plastic film treated by the sage MYA14 for 20 days is degraded, and the degradation rate is 1.05 +/-0.4 g/(d.m)  3  ) And the surface of the polyethylene plastic film which is not treated by the rat tail MYA14 has no corrosion mark and no quality change.

title_en: Transformer shell and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of transformer shells and discloses a transformer shell which comprises a shell body, wherein lateral heat dissipation plates are fixedly arranged on two sides of the shell body, and heat dissipation ports are formed in the front side and the back side of the shell body. According to the invention, the movable plate is sleeved in the first heat dissipation frame, the movable plate is connected with the movable plate by the spring, the storage cylinder is arranged on the front surface of the shell, pressure oil is stored in the storage cylinder, the push plate in the storage cylinder is matched, when the push rod is manually pushed, the push plate is driven to extrude the pressure oil into the first heat dissipation frame through the bent pipe and the first distribution sleeve, the movable plate is enabled to move in a reciprocating manner in the process of repeatedly pushing and releasing, hot air in the shell is blown out and sucked into ambient air when the movable plate moves in a reciprocating manner, and the mixing and cooling of the hot air in the shell are repeatedly realized, so that the forced cooling is completed, the cooling efficiency is greatly improved, when the maintenance is required, the quick cooling can be manually realized, the subsequent maintenance operation is convenient, the maintenance efficiency is improved, and the use effect is good.

title_en: Nanoparticle multistage separation device for preventing and treating pneumoconiosis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nanoparticle multistage separation device for preventing and treating pneumoconiosis, which relates to the technical field of pneumoconiosis prevention and treatment and comprises the following components: particle filtration unit, induction type trigger structure and intelligent switching unit, particle filtration unit are arranged in separating the filtration to the nanoparticle in the gas to when the induction type trigger structure perception particle filtration unit goes up impurity more, can drive intelligent switching unit and switch particle filtration unit. The invention has the effect of multistage treatment, can uniformly separate and filter impurities, bacteria, peculiar smell and particles contained in gas, can automatically detect a structure for treatment, and can automatically switch the part of structures out and move the parts of structures into a new structure when the separation efficiency is reduced so as to achieve the effects of reducing the downtime and ensuring the treatment effect.

title_en: TOC removal process in cobalt chloride production process
abstract_en: The invention relates to a TOC removal process in a cobalt chloride production process, and belongs to the technical field of cobalt chloride production wastewater treatment. The invention provides a TOC removal process in a cobalt chloride production process, which can effectively reduce the concentration of TOC of wastewater in the cobalt chloride production process by adjusting the pH value of oily wastewater, filtering and adsorbing with microbead resin, desorbing and regenerating resin by ethanol, distilling regenerated liquid to recycle ethanol, adding dilute ammonia water into enriched liquid to stir and regenerate and recycle organic phase, and carrying out biochemical treatment on COD enriched in water phase, thereby reducing environmental pollution and reducing the treatment difficulty of subsequent procedures; in addition, the TOC removal process also provides a microbead resin, which has higher specific surface area than common resin, is easier to reach saturated adsorption balance and has better adsorption capacity.

title_en: Water inlet device and high-speed mixed bed
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water inlet device and a high-speed mixing bed, wherein the water inlet device comprises a water inlet pipe, an exhaust pipe, a filtering device and a water distribution device, the water inlet pipe is used for being connected with a water inlet of the high-speed mixing bed, and a water inlet valve is arranged on the water inlet pipe; the water inlet pipe is also connected with a mounting pipe, the exhaust pipe is connected above the mounting pipe, and an exhaust valve is arranged on the exhaust pipe; the filtering device is positioned in the installation pipe and is used for filtering the resin entering the water inlet pipe; the water distribution device is arranged in the high-speed mixed bed and is provided with a plurality of water distribution holes which are uniformly distributed. Therefore, the filtering device is moved out of the tank body of the high-speed mixing bed, the problem that the water distribution plate is prone to serious deformation is solved with low cost, normal use of the high-speed mixing bed is guaranteed, water supply quality of a power station boiler is guaranteed, and safe and stable operation of a unit is guaranteed.

title_en: Ozone disinfection treatment box for mineral water
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of mineral water sterilization, in particular to an ozone disinfection treatment box for mineral water. The invention provides an ozone disinfection treatment box for mineral water, which can remove ozone in the mineral water. An ozone disinfection treatment box for mineral water comprises a water tank and a water inlet pipe, wherein the upper right side of the water tank is connected with the water inlet pipe; the water outlet pipe is connected with the left lower side of the water tank; the filtering mechanism is arranged in the water inlet pipe and used for filtering ozone in mineral water; the convection strengthening mechanism is arranged at the front part of the water tank and used for discharging ozone in the water tank. According to the invention, the extrusion block is controlled by the waterproof motor to drive the adsorption carbon plate to move left and right, so that the contact area between the adsorption carbon plate and mineral water can be increased, the ozone adsorption effect of the adsorption carbon plate on ozone is improved, ozone in the water tank is discharged by the blower, the ozone can be prevented from reentering the mineral water, and thus, the ozone removal effect in the mineral water can be improved.

title_en: Preparation method and application of Nb-Ce-W denitration catalyst for SCR degradation
abstract_en: The invention discloses Nb-Ce-W/TiO for SCR degradation  2  A denitration catalyst and application thereof belong to the fields of atmospheric pollution treatment and environment-friendly catalysis environment. The catalyst is TiO  2  The catalyst is used as a carrier, nb is used as a main active component, and metals Ce and W are used as auxiliary agents, and the catalyst is prepared by adopting an impregnation method. Firstly, weighing C in a metering ratio  10  H  5  NbO  20  ·xH  2  O、(NH  4  )  6  W  12  O  39  ·xH  2  O and Ce (NO)  3  )  3  ·  6  H  2  Dissolving O in deionized water, magnetically stirring to dissolve, and adding TiO as carrier  2  And then the mixture is soaked in a water bath under magnetic stirring, and then the mixture is stirred in the water bath until the water is completely evaporated. The obtained powder was dried overnight in a drying oven and calcined at 500 deg.C5h, naturally cooling to obtain Nb-Ce-W/TiO for degrading NO by SCR  2  A catalyst. Nb-Ce-W/TiO of the invention  2  The catalyst has high capability of degrading NO by SCR. Meanwhile, the auxiliaries Ce and W and the active component Nb can play a good role in concerted catalysis, so that the medium-high temperature activity of the catalyst is improved, and the operating temperature window of the catalyst is widened.

title_en: Pressure applying equipment of high-pressure vertical filter-pressing electrophoresis and electromagnetic vacuum drying equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of filter pressing equipment, in particular to a pressing device of high-pressure vertical filter pressing electrophoresis and electromagnetic vacuum drying equipment. For solving the deficiency of the prior art, it is necessary to provide a filter-pressing integration device which has high integration level, good automation degree, intelligent cleaning of filter belt, low energy consumption and simple operation, and is more efficient and lower in cost when applied to the treatment of filter-pressing objects. The invention relates to a pressing device of high-pressure vertical filter-pressing electrophoresis and electromagnetic vacuum drying equipment, which comprises a hydraulic cylinder, a hydraulic cylinder fixing frame and an external hydraulic system, wherein an oil inlet and an oil outlet of the hydraulic cylinder are connected with the hydraulic system through a high-pressure pipe.

title_en: Formula industrial sewage edulcoration device is inhaled to magnetism
abstract_en: The invention relates to an impurity removal device, in particular to a magnetic type industrial sewage impurity removal device. The invention provides a magnetic type industrial sewage impurity removal device capable of automatically cleaning impurities. The invention provides a magnetic suction type industrial sewage impurity removal device which comprises a supporting seat, a first water inlet pipe, an electromagnet and an installation sleeve, wherein the first water inlet pipe is fixedly arranged in the middle of the supporting seat, the electromagnet capable of adsorbing metal waste is arranged on the upper portion of the supporting seat in an embedded mode, the installation sleeve is fixedly arranged in the middle of the first water inlet pipe and penetrates through the upper portion of the supporting seat. The electro-magnet function produces magnetic force for metal waste residue in the industrial waste water is adsorbed in first inlet tube upper portion, and then has realized carrying out magnetism to sewage and has inhaled the formula edulcoration, and the water pump function is concentrated in the metal waste suction of collecting in with first inlet tube upper portion to the collecting vessel through the inlet pipe and is collected, thereby has reached and has carried out the purpose of automatic clearance to metal waste.

title_en: Efficient clarification tank adopting sound wave level mechanical waves to assist cleaning and effect improvement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-efficiency clarification tank adopting acoustic-wave-level mechanical waves to assist cleaning and efficiency improvement, belonging to the technical field of high-efficiency clarification tanks; a high-efficiency clarification tank adopting sound wave level mechanical wave for auxiliary cleaning and effect improvement comprises a high-efficiency clarification tank body, wherein inclined tube filler is arranged on the inner side of the high-efficiency clarification tank body, an auxiliary cleaning device is arranged above the inclined tube filler, the auxiliary cleaning device comprises a mechanical wave cleaning machine which reciprocates above the inclined tube filler, and the emission frequency of the mechanical wave cleaning machine is less than 18KHz; the cleaning device has the advantages of more thorough cleaning of the inclined tube filler and suitability for inclined tube fillers made of different materials.

title_en: Online unmanned aerial vehicle device that charges
abstract_en: The invention discloses an online charging unmanned aerial vehicle device, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body (100) and a walking electricity taking device (200) positioned on the unmanned aerial vehicle body (100), wherein the walking electricity taking device (200) can walk along a power transmission line and can be charged online. The online charging unmanned aerial vehicle device and the control method can realize online charging of the unmanned aerial vehicle body.

title_en: Automatic exhaust smoke purification device and system and automatic exhaust smoke purification control method
abstract_en: The invention provides a device and a system for automatically purifying exhaust smoke and a control method for automatically purifying exhaust smoke, which comprises the following steps: the air speed acquisition unit is used for acquiring the current air speed value of the oil smoke gas passing through the purified ventilation pipeline; the electrostatic purification control unit is used for determining the current required purification air volume according to the pipeline parameters of the purification ventilation pipeline and the current air speed value, and determining the electrostatic generation amount of the electrostatic purification unit based on the purification air volume so as to control the electrostatic purification unit to generate an electrostatic field according to the electrostatic generation amount; the electrostatic purification unit is used for generating an electrostatic field to adsorb particulate matters in the lampblack gas; and the fan control unit is used for comparing the purified air quantity with the corresponding preset ideal air quantity under the current working condition and determining the running air quantity of the fan according to the comparison result. In the mode, the actual wind speed in the wind pipe is collected in real time by arranging the wind speed sensor, so that the oil smoke wind volume needing to be purified is calculated in real time, the static electricity generation amount of the static electricity purification unit is accurately controlled, and the generation of ozone is reduced.

title_en: Semi-coke wastewater oil removal pretreatment system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a semi-coke wastewater oil removal pretreatment system and a method thereof, belonging to the technical field of wastewater treatment. According to the invention, a multi-stage combined gradient oil removal process is adopted, and through the specific structural design of the tank-in-tank cyclone separator and the multi-stage oil removal filter device, the oil content of the semi-coke wastewater after treatment is greatly reduced, and the petroleum index of the treated wastewater can be reduced by more than 95%, so that the treatment efficiency is improved, the problem of pipeline blockage by oil is solved, and the maximum recovery value of light and heavy oil resources is realized.

title_en: Moisture-proof adapter and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a moisture-proof adapter which comprises an upper shell, a lower shell, a circuit board and an electrical plug connector, wherein the upper shell and the lower shell are connected in a buckling manner; the moisture-proof mechanism comprises a hollow box body, an inner filter net box, a drying agent block, a box cover, an air inlet, a filter net, a mounting hole and an exhaust fan, the hollow box body is mounted on the upper end surface of the circuit board, and the inner filter net box is fixedly connected to the center of the interior of the hollow box body. According to the invention, by arranging the dismounting assembly, the upper shell and the lower shell are only required to be pulled by the lapping block when needing to be dismounted, and then the limiting insertion rod is pulled out of the limiting insertion slot; and the later stage needs the installation, also can be the same, then let T type butt-joint plate peg graft between two recess pieces alright accomplish quick installation to the maintenance work in later stage has been made things convenient for by a wide margin.

title_en: Method for producing functionalized organic molecules and use thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for producing functionalized organic molecules having 1 to 3 carbon atoms, comprising the steps of: -contacting carbon dioxide as the only gas or a gas mixture comprising or consisting of carbon dioxide and methane with a catalyst comprising or consisting of permanently polarized hydroxyapatite in the presence of water. Further, the invention relates to the use of said method.

title_en: Barite crusher with dust removal and material collection functions
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of barite crushing, in particular to a barite crusher with dust removal and material collection functions, which comprises a crusher body, a bearing and material conveying frame and a material collection assembly, wherein the crusher body is arranged on the bearing and material conveying frame, a feed hopper and a discharge hopper are fixedly arranged on a feed end and a discharge end of the crusher body respectively, part of the discharge hopper is positioned inside the bearing and material conveying frame, and a dust removal and material collection box is arranged on the bearing and material conveying frame.

title_en: Container fire-fighting system and control method
abstract_en: The invention provides a container fire fighting system and a control method, wherein the container fire fighting system comprises a container main body and an equipment room arranged in the container main body, the front side of the equipment room and the front side of the container main body are arranged at intervals to form a first channel in an enclosing manner, and the rear side of the equipment room and the rear side of the container main body are arranged at intervals to form a second channel in an enclosing manner; the equipment room comprises two groups of equipment cabinets arranged in parallel and a top plate connected to the tops of the two groups of equipment cabinets, and a third channel is formed by the two groups of equipment cabinets and the top plate in a surrounding manner; the equipment room further comprises at least one fire-fighting assembly, the fire-fighting assembly is arranged in the object placing space and comprises a front nozzle and a rear nozzle, one of the nozzles is communicated with the third channel, and the other nozzle is communicated with the first channel or the second channel. The container fire-fighting system and the control method provided by the invention can realize rapid fire extinguishing.

title_en: Automatic slurry supply control method for desulfurization island based on DCS control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a desulfurization island automatic slurry supply control method based on a DCS control system, which comprises the following steps: performing feedforward calculation by using the unit smoke volume, the unit inlet SO  2  concentration and the actual circulating volume of the slurry to obtain a reference slurry supply volume and an initial target set value of the pH value for slurry supply control, and then throwing the reference slurry supply volume and the initial target set value of the pH value for slurry supply control into PID control; during PID control, the pH value is used as a main adjustment parameter, the slurry supply adjustment quantity except the reference slurry supply quantity is determined according to the difference value between the actual pH value and the target pH value, and the actual total slurry supply flow is adjusted by controlling the opening of the slurry supply adjustment valve, so that the control of the slurry quantity of the desulfurization island is realized. The invention can realize the online optimization adjustment of the pH value and the slurry supply flow by the configuration logic establishment of the DCS system, and realize the precise control of the concentration of SO  2  in the clean flue gas.

title_en: High-performance platinum-cerium-tin cluster catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-performance platinum-cerium-tin cluster catalyst, and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of environmental protection catalysis. The preparation method of the high-performance platinum cerium tin cluster catalyst comprises the steps of loading platinum nitrate on a high-performance cerium tin solid solution by an isometric impregnation method, finally roasting to prepare a platinum cerium tin monatomic catalyst precursor, and then reducing in a reducing atmosphere to prepare the high-performance platinum cerium tin cluster catalyst. The catalyst prepared by the method has the advantages of excellent catalytic performance, high thermal stability, cheap and easily-obtained required raw materials, rich resources, simple and convenient preparation process, no special requirements on equipment, low energy consumption, little pollution, environmental friendliness, large-scale production, great cost reduction and good industrial application prospect.

title_en: Immersed membrane separation system and immersed membrane separation method
abstract_en: The utility model provides an immersion membrane separation system and separation method, separation system includes membrane tank, membrane module and play basin, and wherein the upper edge of play basin is on same horizontal plane with the upper edge of membrane tank, and the membrane module is installed inside the membrane tank and submergence in the water of waiting in the membrane tank, and the catchment pipe of membrane module lets in the play basin and its port is located the minimum allowable water level of play basin, and the membrane module is not directly in communication with the water pump. Under normal working condition, the system keeps the external water supply amount of the water outlet tank constant and is lower than the injection flow of the water inlet pipe (101) of the membrane tank (1), so that the water level of the membrane tank is constant, and the water level of the water outlet tank is changed in real time along with the filtering process and is self-regulated.

title_en: Switchable heating surface system of waste incineration waste heat boiler
abstract_en: The invention relates to a switchable heating surface system of a waste incineration waste heat boiler, belonging to the technical field of boiler manufacturing. The invention comprises a low-temperature superheater heating surface, a three-level economizer heating surface and a switchable heating surface, wherein the low-temperature superheater heating surface, the three-level economizer heating surface and the switchable heating surface are arranged in a flue. The invention can switch the heating surface to be merged into the heating surface of the low-temperature superheater or into the heating surface of the three-stage economizer by opening and closing the control valve according to the load of the waste heat boiler and the condition of dust deposition and coking on the heating surface, thereby solving the technical problems that the exhaust gas temperature of the waste heat boiler is overhigh under high heat load and the degree of the main steam superheater is lower under low heat load in the prior art.

title_en: 5G communication equipment and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses 5G communication equipment which comprises a movable plate, a ventilation box and a box body, wherein the top of the movable plate is provided with the ventilation box through a bolt, a suction fan is arranged inside the ventilation box, the output end of the suction fan is provided with a blowing pipe, the blowing pipe penetrates through the inner wall of one side of the ventilation box, one end of the blowing pipe is provided with a heating chamber, the heating chamber is arranged at the top of the movable plate through a bolt, one side of the heating chamber is fixedly connected with one side of the box body through a connecting pipe, the top of the box body is arranged at the top of the movable plate through a bolt, the inner side of the rear wall of the box body is provided with an installation plate through a bolt, the inner wall of one side of the box body is provided with a placing box, and the top of the box body is provided with an electric control box through a bolt. According to the invention, the moisture in the air is adsorbed by the moisture-proof agent in the storage box, and the air is circulated through the circulating plate, so that the air is conveniently dehumidified, and the drying of the environment is ensured.

title_en: Preparation method and application of modified polyaluminium sulfate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of modified polyaluminium sulfate: taking aluminum sulfate as a main material, ti  4+ 、Fe 3+  as a modifier, sodium glycolate as a complexing agent, reacting under the action of sodium hydroxide to prepare Fe  3+ /Ti 4+  modified polyaluminium sulfate, and further spraying an immobilized enzyme solution on the surface; the modified polyaluminium sulfate is applied to sewage treatment agents. The invention utilizes Fe  3+ 、Ti 4+  to dope to form copolymerization type modified polyaluminium sulfate, improves the stability of polyaluminium sulfate, has compact growth, large volume, quick sedimentation speed and better effluent chromaticity, and further sprays immobilized enzyme on the surface, and simultaneously improves the stability of complex enzyme and Fe  3+ /Ti 4+  modified polyaluminium sulfate, so that the complex enzyme and the Fe  3+ /Ti 4+  modified polyaluminium sulfate exert synergistic effect for a long time.

title_en: Method for recycling rock wool waste residues through electric melting method and cooperatively treating VOCs (volatile organic compounds) in electric furnace
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy-saving building materials, in particular to a method for recycling rock wool waste residues by an electric melting method and cooperatively treating VOCs (volatile organic compounds) in electric furnace smoke. The method comprises the following steps: melting a mineral raw material by an electric furnace to form a melt, so that the melt is fibrillated by a centrifugal machine and collected by a cotton collecting machine; delivering the flue gas generated by the electric furnace into a combustor for combustion, and delivering the combusted flue gas into a filter chamber for filtration after passing through a drying furnace; wherein, the flue gas generated by the electric furnace contains VOCs; delivering the waste residues which are not collected by the cotton collecting machine into the drying furnace for drying; wherein the heat of the drying furnace is from the burnt flue gas; mixing and proportioning the dried waste residues and mineral raw materials, and feeding the materials after mixing and proportioning into the electric furnace. The scheme of the invention realizes the utilization of solid waste, the green treatment of flue gas and the energy-saving utilization of waste heat, and can reduce the production cost and protect the ecological environment.

title_en: Soil restoration device for farmland in soil irrigation area and restoration method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a soil remediation device for a soil remediation area and a remediation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of farmland soil remediation, and comprising a workbench, wherein a water tank is arranged at one side of the upper end surface of the workbench, a discharge pipe is arranged at one side of the lower end surface of the water tank, a smashing mechanism is arranged at the middle position of the lower end surface of the workbench, and an adjusting mechanism is arranged at the upper end of the smashing mechanism; the breaking mechanism comprises a slide bar, a motor, a rotating shaft, a cam, a connecting plate, a moving rod, a fixing plate and a breaking rod, wherein the fixing plate is fixedly connected to the lower end face of the slide bar, the breaking rod is fixedly connected to the lower end face of the fixing plate, the connecting plate is sleeved on the outer portion of the slide bar in a sliding mode, the moving rod is fixedly connected to the lower end face of the connecting plate, the moving rod penetrates through the inner portion of the fixing plate in a sliding mode, and can be subjected to pesticide spraying restoration treatment when soil is loosened, the operating efficiency is high, and the breaking mechanism can be adjusted in an adaptive mode according to restoration soil, so that the breaking mechanism is convenient and fast to operate and is practical.

title_en: Air-lift type physicochemical treatment device for aquaculture
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gas stripping type physicochemical treatment device for aquaculture, which belongs to the technical field of aquaculture and comprises a culture pond, a pollution discharge filter and a water float, wherein the culture pond, the pollution discharge filter and the water float are sequentially arranged, a first gas lift assembly is arranged in the culture pond in a surrounding manner, any one of the first gas lift assemblies comprises a gas outlet pipe and a gas flow plate, any one of the gas outlet pipes is communicated with a plurality of PV pipes, gas stones are arranged on the PV pipes in an array manner, the culture pond is communicated with the pollution discharge filter, the pollution discharge filter comprises an outer shell, an inner cylinder and a filter screen, an auxiliary sedimentation piece is arranged at the inner bottom of the outer shell, the pollution discharge filter is communicated with the bottom of the water float, the water float comprises a plurality of slow flow columns, a filter layer and a filter plate, and the water float is communicated with a water inlet pipe positioned above the inside of the culture pond. According to the invention, the filtering and circulation of the culture water are realized through the sewage filter and the water floating device, and the oxygen content of the water in the culture pond is increased through the first air lifting assembly, so that the life activity of the cultured organisms is improved, and the economic value is improved.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for processing scintillation pulse
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for processing scintillation pulses. The method comprises the following steps: presetting two trigger thresholds, and respectively carrying out multi-threshold sampling on at least two scintillation pulses based on the two trigger thresholds to obtain first sampling data; determining one or more valid scintillation pulses from the at least two scintillation pulses based on the first sampling data; superposing the effective scintillation pulse to obtain a target scintillation pulse; presetting a plurality of sampling thresholds, and performing multi-threshold sampling on the target scintillation pulse based on the plurality of sampling thresholds to acquire second sampling data; determining whether the target scintillation pulse corresponds to a real single event based on the second sampling data; if yes, determining event information of a real single event based on the first sampling data and the second sampling data. The method and the device can limit the time information and the energy amplitude of the real single event through the double-threshold duration time, are high in reliability and avoid sampling errors.

title_en: Drilling equipment for geological investigation of solid mineral products
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological exploration, in particular to drilling equipment for geological exploration of solid mineral products, which comprises a working platform and further comprises the following components: the fixed-point sampling assembly comprises a drill rod, a rotary table is arranged on the end face of the drill rod, a drill bit is arranged on the end face of the rotary table, an outer cylinder is arranged on the surface of the rotary table in a sliding sleeve joint mode, the rotary table is arranged in a sealing sliding contact mode, lubricating grease is smeared between the rotary table and the outer cylinder, a spiral knife is arranged on the outer surface of the outer cylinder, a knife edge is arranged at the end portion of the outer cylinder, a lifting notch is arranged on one side of the drill rod, a lifting guide rod is arranged at a position, corresponding to the lifting notch, of the inner side of the outer cylinder, and the lifting guide rod is movably inserted and arranged in the lifting notch; lifting plate is installed to one side of biax bi-directional motor, slidable mounting has spacing slide bar between lifting plate and the work platform, and the top fixed mounting of spacing slide bar has the mounting panel, and the cylinder is installed to one side of mounting panel, and the side slidable mounting of lifting plate has the slide.

title_en: Outdoor cabinet heat dissipation and dust removal system and control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of communication cabinets, in particular to a heat dissipation and dust removal system of an outdoor cabinet and a control method, wherein the heat dissipation and dust removal systemThe device comprises a heat dissipation and dust removal module, wherein the heat dissipation and dust removal module is used for adjusting a heat dissipation mode of the cabinet, the heat dissipation and dust removal module comprises a driving module and a flow guide module, the driving module is used for driving a heat dissipation medium to flow, and the flow guide module is used for changing the flow direction of the heat dissipation medium; the control method comprises when the first temperature parameter T  1  When the temperature exceeds a first preset value, the cabinet is adjusted to be in a first heat dissipation mode, and when a first temperature parameter T is  1  When the temperature exceeds a second preset value, the cabinet is adjusted to be in a second heat dissipation mode, and when a second temperature parameter T is adopted  2  And when the third preset value is exceeded, adjusting the cabinet to be in a second heat dissipation mode. According to the outdoor cabinet heat dissipation and dust removal system and the control method, the heat dissipation mode can be adjusted according to the temperature in the cabinet and the external temperature, so that the cabinet can be quickly cooled and the filter screen can be cleaned, and the normal operation of the cabinet is ensured.

title_en: Manganese-loaded silver-loaded catalytic adsorbent for flue gas mercury removal and denitration as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a manganese-loaded silver-loaded catalytic adsorbent for flue gas mercury removal and denitration, and a preparation method and application thereof. The catalytic adsorbent comprises a carrier, an active component and silver nano particles, wherein the active component and the silver nano particles are loaded on the carrier; wherein the carrier comprises EVS-10 molecular sieve and the active component comprises manganese oxide. The manganese oxide active component and the nano silver particles are simultaneously loaded on the EVS-10 molecular sieve, so that the catalyst can adsorb and catalyze Hg  0 , catalyze and reduce NOx, and realize the synergistic removal of Hg  0  and NOx; the dispersity of the manganese oxide active component on the carrier is high, and the size of the nano silver particles is controllable; the catalytic adsorbent has excellent mercury removal efficiency and higher denitration efficiency, can cooperatively remove elemental mercury and nitrogen oxides in the coal-fired flue gas, and reduces equipment installation and use cost; the catalyst adsorbent is relatively simple to synthesize, can be recycled, greatly reduces the comprehensive cost, and is suitable for industrial production.

title_en: Muffler air flow automatic regulating apparatus, muffler and motorcycle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a muffler air flow automatic regulating device, a muffler and a motorcycle, wherein the muffler air flow automatic regulating device comprises a rotating speed acquisition unit, a control unit and a regulating mechanism; the rotating speed acquisition unit is used for acquiring the rotating speed of the engine and comprises a throttle position sensor for detecting the throttle opening of the engine, and is in signal connection with the control unit; the control unit is used for receiving the data of the rotating speed acquisition unit and controlling the adjusting mechanism according to the data; the adjusting mechanism comprises a stepping motor and a valve for adjusting the air flow in the tail pipe; the stepping motor is in signal connection with the control unit, a rotating shaft of the stepping motor is rotatably arranged on two side walls of the tail cover and the tail pipe in a penetrating mode, the valve is fixedly arranged on the rotating shaft, and the valve is arranged in the tail pipe. The control unit correspondingly adjusts the opening and closing angles of the valves according to the opening of the throttle valve to ensure that the exhaust of the engine is smooth, so that the output power and torque of the engine are improved, the oil consumption of the engine is reduced, and the noise pollution is reduced.

title_en: Negative pressure cloth bag dust remover for synchronous desulfurization and denitrification of industrial silicon flue gas and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a negative pressure cloth bag dust remover for synchronous desulfurization and denitrification of industrial silicon flue gas and a method thereof, which belong to the technical field of cloth bag dust removers and comprise a dust remover shell, wherein two symmetrical sides of the dust remover shell are respectively provided with a lower air inlet and an upper air outlet, the bottom end of the dust remover shell is provided with an ash discharging pipe, the dust remover shell is supported by a bracket, and a dust removing component, a negative pressure component and a desulfurization and denitrification component are arranged in the dust remover shell. According to the negative pressure bag-type dust collector and the method for synchronous desulfurization and denitrification of industrial silicon flue gas, provided by the invention, the gas in the dust collector shell is extracted and discharged from the upper exhaust port through the positive rotation of the fan shaft, so that the rising of the flue gas is facilitated, and the vibration part is separated from contact with the hanging bracket when rising. The fan shaft is reversed, the vibration part descends to be in contact with the hanging frame and is used for shaking off dust on the filter cloth bag, the shaking-off dust can be restrained from ascending when the filter cloth bag is shaken, and the two functions are matched with each other and can be mutually assisted.

title_en: Tubular carbon fiber textile gas diffusion cathode and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tubular carbon fiber textile gas diffusion cathode and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the field of sewage treatment. The invention provides a preparation method of a tubular carbon fiber textile gas diffusion cathode, which solves the problem of tubular carbon fiber textile forming, improves the gas mass transfer efficiency and the space utilization rate of a reactor, simultaneously can protect the performance, solves the oxygen mass transfer problem in the traditional electro-Fenton system, and improves the current efficiency. In addition, the electro-Fenton sewage treatment reaction device of the invention circulates through the peristaltic pump, turbulent flow is formed in the reactor of the device, and the cathode can generate hydrogen peroxide, hydrogen peroxide and Fe by utilizing the oxygen introduced by aeration to a greater extent due to the accelerated mass transfer rate  2+  More fully reacts to generate more hydroxyl radicals to react with sewageThe organic pollutants in the water-based organic fertilizer are fully contacted, so that the water-based organic fertilizer is fully mineralized and degraded.

title_en: Anion exchange resin-duckweed coupling treatment system and method capable of rapidly denitrifying and dephosphorizing water body
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anion exchange resin-duckweed coupling treatment system and a treatment method capable of rapidly denitrifying and dephosphorizing a water body, wherein the system comprises a water quality purification reactor and a resin regeneration reactor which are connected with each other, wherein stirring paddles and anion exchange resin are arranged in the two reactors, duckweed is positioned on the water surfaces of the two reactors, and an inclined plate is arranged between the duckweed and the resin; the anion exchange resin can be mutually conveyed in the water quality purifying reactor and the resin regenerating reactor. According to the invention, the anion exchange resin and the duckweed are the purification main bodies of the system, the nitrogen and phosphorus removal is enhanced through the coupling system of the resin and the duckweed, the purpose of water quality evolution is achieved, meanwhile, the regeneration of the resin is realized through the desorption of low-concentration brine and the absorption of nitrogen and phosphorus by the duckweed in the resin regeneration reaction, and the regenerated resin is returned to the water quality purification reactor for reuse, so that the recycling of the resin is realized. The invention realizes the efficient removal of nitrogen, phosphorus and organic matters in the eutrophic water body.

title_en: Fire-fighting water pipe water pressure detection device and detection method
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire-fighting water pipe water pressure detection device and a detection method, and relates to the field of water pressure detection. The fire-fighting water pipe water pressure detection device comprises a water pressure detector shell, wherein a first connecting pipe and a second connecting pipe are respectively and fixedly arranged at two ends of the water pressure detector shell, at least two first mounting grooves are formed in the surface of the first connecting pipe, the at least two first mounting grooves are distributed in an array by the axis of the first connecting pipe, at least two second mounting grooves are formed in the surface of the second connecting pipe, the axis of the at least two second connecting pipes is distributed in an array by the at least two second mounting grooves, and external clamping mechanisms are arranged in the first mounting grooves and the second mounting grooves and used for connecting the whole device with a fire-fighting water pipe to be detected; the end part of the first connecting pipe is fixedly provided with a first adjusting pipe which is in a round table shape. The problem of current fire hose water pressure detection device mostly all install through welded mode to lead to installing and be inconvenient for dismantling is solved.

title_en: Anti-blocking pulse bag type dust collector
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-blocking pulse bag type dust collector which comprises a dust removing mechanism, wherein a cleaning mechanism is arranged in the dust removing mechanism, a cooling mechanism is arranged on the lower side of the outer wall of the dust removing mechanism, a pulse blowing mechanism is arranged on the upper side of the outer wall of the dust removing mechanism, the cleaning mechanism comprises two servo motors, four connecting blocks, a synchronous controller and a first controller, single-head threaded rods are fixed at the output ends of the two servo motors, rectangular plates are sleeved on the outer surfaces of the two single-head threaded rods in a threaded manner, and two limit posts are fixed on each connecting block.

title_en: Automatic powder processing system of metal powder paving 3D printer
abstract_en: The invention provides a powder automatic processing system of a metal powder paving 3D printer, which belongs to the technical field of auxiliary machines of 3D printers and comprises a box body, wherein a gas circulation purifying system is arranged in the box body, a powder automatic processing system is arranged in the box body, the gas circulation purifying system is used for carrying out circulation filtration on gas, processing inert gas containing smoke dust, and filtering dust in the inert gas containing the smoke dust to enable the inert gas containing the smoke dust to be reused. The invention solves the problems that only screening components are listed in the prior art, feeding conveying, blanking returning and gas circulation purifying are not described, powder which is used for sintering except a printing workpiece in a printer forming cylinder is sucked into a box body of an automatic processing system after printing is completed, screening processing and other works are performed, and a powder and gas processing system is imperfect.

title_en: Heavy metal passivation material prepared from biological domestication industrial iron mud and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of heavy metal contaminated soil remediation, and discloses a heavy metal passivation material prepared from biological domestication industrial iron mud and application thereof. According to the method, anaerobic granular sludge is placed in a reactor, artificial simulated wastewater and industrial iron sludge are added to perform interaction, and the heavy metal passivation material is obtained after the anaerobic granular sludge is fully cultured, domesticated and matured and then subjected to freeze drying treatment. The method takes the waste industrial iron mud as the raw material, improves the special adsorption capacity of the industrial iron mud to heavy metals in a biological domestication mode, and can improve the heavy metal removal effect in the water phase; meanwhile, the industrial iron mud generates a bacteria-iron complex under the action of the microorganism of the granular sludge, which is used for immobilizing heavy metals in soil and forming stable secondary minerals, so that the effective state of the heavy metals is reduced. The passivation material is applied to the restoration of heavy metal contaminated soil, and has remarkable passivation effect.

title_en: Preparation method of composite catalyst for degrading rhodamine B in organic dye
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a composite catalyst for degrading rhodamine B in an organic dye, relates to a preparation method of a composite catalyst for degrading pollutants in an organic dye, and discloses Cu  3  (MoO  4  )  2  (OH)  2  /CaMoO  4  A composite catalyst and a preparation method thereof, and the catalyst can be used for degrading an organic dye rhodamine B (Rh B) by ultrasonic catalysis. With CuCl  2  ·2H  2  O、CaCl  2  And Na (Na)  2  MoO  4  ·2H  2  O is used as a raw material, deionized water is used as a solvent, and a hydrothermal synthesis method is adopted to prepare Cu  3  (MoO  4  )  2  (OH)  2  /CaMoO  4  A complex. The best experimental conditions are obtained through experiments, 30mg of Cu  3  (MoO  4  )  2  (OH)  2  /CaMoO  4  The initial concentration of the composite catalyst combined with the sonocatalytic degradation is 4mg/L of the organic dye Rh B, and the removal rate can reach 97.10 +/-2.10%. The composite catalyst prepared by the invention has good organic matter degradation pollution effect, no toxicity or harm, high safety and repeated utilization, effectively solves the water pollution of rhodamine B in organic dye, and has good application prospect.

title_en: Method for increasing molecular sieve particle surface adhesion
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for increasing the surface adhesion of molecular sieve particles, which comprises the steps of coating an oxide layer and/or a hydroxide layer on the outer surface of a Cu-SSZ-13 molecular sieve by an atomic layer deposition method; the oxide layer comprises one or more of silicon oxide, aluminum oxide, titanium oxide, zirconium oxide and rare earth oxide; the hydroxide layer comprises one or more of hydroxide of silicon, hydroxide of aluminum, hydroxide of titanium, hydroxide of zirconium and hydroxide of rare earth. Aiming at the defects of small surface adhesion of the molecular sieve catalyst and easy falling after coating, the invention coats the oxide layer and/or the hydroxide layer on the molecular sieve to improve the surface adhesion of the molecular sieve. The high-activity temperature window of the molecular sieve catalyst is not affected, the falling risk of the molecular sieve catalyst is reduced, the service life of the catalyst is prolonged, and the catalyst has good application value.

title_en: Blowing device for PE film processing and blowing process thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of blow molding facilities, in particular to a blow molding device for PE film processing and a blow molding process thereof, comprising an extruder and a right-angle machine head fixedly arranged at the extrusion end of the extruder, wherein an air pump is arranged in front of the extruder, the air outlet end of the air pump is vertically communicated with an air pipe, the air pipe penetrates out of the right-angle machine head, two clamping rollers are symmetrically arranged right above the right-angle machine head, a guide roller is arranged behind the clamping rollers, the outer side of the guide roller and the upper end part of the right-angle machine head are covered with glass covers, and the air inlet end of the air pump is communicated with a heating dust removing piece.

title_en: Method for preparing ordered mesoporous carbon from saccharide-derived humic acid without cross-linking agent
