abstract_en: A method for preparing ordered mesoporous carbon by using saccharide derived humic acid without cross-linking agent belongs to the technical field of environment-friendly materials. A variety of carbohydrate compounds can be derivatized by the hydrothermal and acid catalyzed processes of this specification to alcohol soluble humic acids having similar molecular weights and functionalities. The obtained humic acid is used as a carbon precursor, F127 is used as a template agent, the humic acid can be self-assembled into a microscopic ordered structure through a classical solvent volatilization method, the intermolecular self-condensation reaction of the humic acid is used for replacing externally added aldehydes or metal cross-linking agents, the further solidification of the ordered structure is realized, and a highly ordered mesoporous carbon material is obtained after the carbonization of a program, and can be used as an adsorbent to realize the selective adsorption of cationic dyes. The method provides a simpler and universal strategy for preparing the ordered mesoporous carbon by the saccharide compound, and is expected to reduce the preparation cost of the ordered mesoporous material and reduce the environmental pollution caused by the preparation process.

title_en: Low-temperature fungus bacillus mycoides 21 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a low-temperature bacillus mycoides 21 and application thereof. The class of the bacillus mycoides 21 is named as bacillus mycoides Bacillus mycoides, the preservation number of the strain is CGMCC No.25259, and the strain has the characteristic of producing protease under the low-temperature condition and can be applied to the fields of aquaculture and the like. The microbial preparation provided by the invention can effectively reduce the protein content and COD content in the aquaculture water, effectively reduce the organic pollution of the water, and play a role in improving the water quality.

title_en: Method for cooperatively treating fly ash in Yili region by utilizing Yili converter slag
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for cooperatively treating fly ash in Yi-plow regions by utilizing Yi-steel converter slag, which comprises the steps of firstly, pulling blast furnace gas ash to a fly ash storage region of a waste incineration plant in Yi-Ning city for later use; the waste tundish coating produced by Yi-plow steel iron limited company is transported to fly ash storage area of Yi-Ning municipal waste incineration plant for standby; uniformly mixing fly ash, blast furnace gas ash and waste tundish coating according to the mass percentage of 75:15:10, and pressing into pellets with the diameter of 30-50mm by adopting a high-pressure dry powder ball pressing machine, wherein the pellets are added into a slag pot along with slag flow when a converter is used for slag discharge, and the addition amount is 50-150kg of ton slag; standing the slag pot for 60-90min, and then treating according to a normal hot slag splashing treatment process; after the steel slag treatment is finished, the granulated iron rich in Fe, cr, cd, ni, cu, pb, zn is recovered in a steel slag magnetic separation production line and is used as a raw material for steelmaking for recycling.

title_en: Sustainable soil pollution restoration method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of soil remediation and discloses a sustainable soil pollution remediation method. According to the invention, a phytoremediation mode is adopted to rotate Liu Shengchao accumulated plants with both heavy metal enrichment effect and economic value, soil is improved before planting, so that the capability of the super accumulated plants for enriching heavy metal elements in heavy metal contaminated soil is optimal, heavy metal pollutants are removed after being absorbed, converted and accumulated by the plants, the harvested plants are sold according with heavy metal limit indexes, harmless treatment is carried out without meeting the heavy metal limit indexes, and heavy metal is prevented from returning to the soil. The method has low cost; the site structure is not damaged; the method is suitable for large-area application; the restored soil can be used for crop planting without secondary pollution, thereby achieving the final aim of restoring the heavy metal polluted soil and realizing sustainable restoration of soil pollution.

title_en: Evaporation and pyrolysis integrated equipment and evaporation and pyrolysis method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses evaporation and pyrolysis integrated equipment and an evaporation and pyrolysis method thereof, and relates to the technical field of industrial wastewater treatment, wherein the evaporation and pyrolysis integrated equipment comprises a water distribution area, an evaporation area and a pyrolysis area; the water distribution area is used for introducing wastewater and distributing the wastewater to the evaporation area; the evaporation zone is used for evaporating moisture in the wastewater and enabling residues after the moisture evaporation to fall into the pyrolysis zone; the pyrolysis zone is provided with pyrolysis subassembly, and pyrolysis subassembly includes the heat-conducting plate and is connected with the heating structure of heat-conducting plate, has offered the weeping mouth on the heat-conducting plate, and the edge of weeping mouth border and heat-conducting plate is provided with the cofferdam, and the region that the cofferdam encloses forms the pre-buried district of granule material, and pre-buried district top is provided with scrapes the flitch, scrapes the material orbit of flitch and passes through weeping mouth top. According to the invention, the water distribution area, the evaporation area and the pyrolysis area are sequentially arranged from top to bottom, the pre-buried particles in the pre-buried area are utilized, and pyrolysis residues on the pre-buried area are scraped by the scraping plate, so that the evaporation and pyrolysis integrated continuous working equipment can be formed, and the equipment investment and the occupied area are reduced.

title_en: Real-time supervision's transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transformer substation with real-time monitoring, which relates to the technical field of transformer substations and comprises a base plate, wherein a shell is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the top of the base plate, two sides of the shell are respectively provided with a positive opposite air inlet and air outlet, and the transformer substation also comprises an air inlet box and a metal heat exchange block; the air inlet box is fixed in the air inlet, the air outlet box is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the air outlet, a pair of tensioning rollers are rotatably arranged in the shell and at the top of the shell, filter screen cloth is sleeved on the two pairs of tensioning rollers, strip-shaped notches are formed in the upper side and the lower side of the air inlet box and at the top of the shell, and a plurality of filter screen cloth penetrates through the strip-shaped notches; when the dust hood generates negative pressure, the suction hood can be matched with the built-in brush rod to perform a suction brushing function on the filter screen cloth, so that the surface of the filter screen cloth is clean, the filtering effect of the filter screen cloth on air is ensured, the filter screen cloth is not required to be disassembled, the surface is clean, and the convenience of the transformer substation in use is improved.

title_en: Industrial sewage electrochemical treatment equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses industrial sewage electrochemical treatment equipment, which comprises a magnetic heating system, a magnetic electrolysis system and a water outlet magnetic recovery system which are sequentially distributed, wherein the magnetic heating system comprises a steam heating area and a first magnetic stirrer arranged below the steam heating area, the magnetic electrolysis system comprises a second magnetic stirrer, a cathode, an anode and a power supply, and the water outlet magnetic recovery system comprises a magnetic powder recovery filter element and a magnetic powder reflux pump. The industrial sewage electrochemical treatment equipment adopting the structure can effectively improve the electrolysis efficiency, prevent the electrode from being blocked, and can be widely used for pretreatment and advanced treatment of industrial sewage.

title_en: Catalyst for catalytic combustion degradation of CVOCs, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of degradation of chlorine-containing volatile organic compounds, discloses a catalyst for degrading CVOCs by catalytic combustion, and a preparation method and application thereof, and solves the technical problems of low catalyst activity and poor stability. The catalyst comprises a carrier and an active component loaded on the carrier, wherein the carrier contains SiO  2  、Al  2  O  3  And an organic amine cationic zeolite, the active component being an oxide of Ce. The preparation method comprises the following steps: obtaining a first reaction liquid, wherein the first reaction liquid comprises soluble cerium salt and water; obtaining a second reaction liquid, wherein the second reaction liquid comprises soluble aluminum salt and water; wherein the first reaction liquid and/or the second reaction liquidThe organic amine source is also contained in the water; the first reaction liquid and/or the second reaction liquid also contains pure silicalite; mixing the first reaction solution and the second reaction solution to obtain a third reaction solution; carrying out hydrothermal reaction on the third reaction liquid to obtain a precursor; and (5) performing heat treatment on the precursor in air to obtain the catalyst.

title_en: Contaminated soil restoration equipment for garden construction
abstract_en: The application relates to contaminated soil remediation equipment for garden construction, which comprises a kettle body, wherein the side wall of the kettle body is provided with a feed inlet, the bottom of the kettle body is provided with a discharge outlet, a stirring mechanism is arranged in the kettle body and comprises a main stirring shaft driven by a motor and an eccentric rim fixed on the main stirring shaft, an auxiliary stirring shaft is fixed at the bottom of the eccentric rim at intervals, a plurality of supporting rods are fixed between the eccentric rim and the main stirring shaft at intervals, and a driven stirring shaft is fixed at the bottom of the supporting rods at intervals. According to the application, the eccentric wheel rim fixed on the main stirring shaft rotates by taking the main stirring shaft as the axis, so that a stirring range larger than the rotation of the main stirring shaft can be covered, the support rod supports the stable fixation of the eccentric wheel rim, and the stirring uniformity is further improved by distributing the auxiliary stirring shaft and the driven stirring shaft at intervals, so that the volume of the soil remediation equipment can be improved on the premise of not affecting the stirring uniformity, the soil quantity of single remediation is increased, and the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Application method of supported iron-based catalyst in integrated removal of flue gas of coal-fired power plant
abstract_en: An application method of a supported iron-based catalyst in integrated removal of flue gas in a coal-fired power plant. The prior art only removes one pollutant, and the classification treatment has large occupied area, high input cost and complex system. The invention adopts a liquid impregnation method and a borohydride reduction method in the preparation of the supported iron-based catalyst, and adopts a liquid impregnation method and a borohydride reduction method to prepare the novel nano supported iron-based Fe/ZSM-5 catalyst, and adopts a multi-pollutant integrated removal technology to oxidize indissolvable NO into soluble NO  2  And sum SO  2  Are taken off togetherPlacing and absorbing; realize SO  2  The method is environment-friendly, small in occupied area and low in investment cost, and the desulfurization product (NH)  4  )  2  SO  4  And denitration product (NH)  4  )  2  NO  3  Can be used as agricultural fertilizer and has the effects of energy conservation and environmental protection. The invention relates to an application method of a supported iron-based catalyst in integrated removal of flue gas in a coal-fired power plant.

title_en: Medical waste material handles and carries and uses robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical waste treatment and transportation, in particular to a medical waste treatment and transportation robot which comprises a transportation pipeline arranged on a ceiling of a medical institution, a waste treatment box arranged in a sewage room of the medical institution, an electric hoist car and an electric winch. The medical waste treatment and conveying robot disclosed by the invention integrates medical waste treatment and conveying into a whole by combining the conveying pipeline arranged on the ceiling of a medical institution with the waste treatment box arranged in the dirt room of the medical institution, so that the functionality is greatly enhanced; the safety is greatly improved by adopting direct treatment and then internal extrusion conveying and conveying in a top sealing mode; the whole treatment and conveying process does not need manual contact and intervention, so that time and labor are saved, and the efficiency is greatly improved; the electric hoist car is installed by adopting the internal guide rail of the conveying pipeline, so that the electric hoist car can be conveyed inside dirt rooms of different medical institutions, the conveying range is wider, and the electric hoist car is more convenient to arrange.

title_en: N-methylmorpholine wastewater treatment process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a treatment process of N-methylmorpholine wastewater, which belongs to the field of water treatment, and the system of the invention sequentially comprises a salt tolerant bacteria biochemical system, a membrane bioreactor (MBR reaction device) and an ozone catalytic oxidation unit; the salt-tolerant bacteria biochemical system comprises a salt-tolerant bacteria SBR device, a salt-tolerant bacteria facultative device and a salt-tolerant bacteria aerobic device in sequence; the invention combines the technologies of salt-tolerant bacteria biochemical system, membrane bioreactor, ozone catalytic oxidation and the like, has simple operation, utilizes the high-efficiency compound salt-tolerant bacteria to carry out biochemical treatment on the wastewater, does not need to carry out physical and chemical pretreatment and large-multiple dilution on the wastewater, reduces the treatment water quantity and the running cost, and realizes the high-efficiency treatment of the N-methylmorpholine (NMMO) wastewater.

title_en: Sectional type heat exchanger for chemical industry
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a sectional type heat exchanger for chemical industry relates to shell and tube heat exchanger technical field. This sectional type heat exchanger for chemical industry includes: the device comprises a heat exchanger main body mechanism, a heat exchanger sectioning mechanism and a filtering self-cleaning mechanism. The main body mechanism of the heat exchanger comprises a shell, a first end cover shell, a second end cover shell, heat exchange tubes, end cover plates and connecting tubes, wherein the two end cover plates are respectively fixedly arranged at two ends of the shell, a plurality of heat exchange tubes are positioned inside the shell, two ends of each heat exchange tube respectively penetrate through the two end cover plates, a refrigerant liquid inlet tube and a refrigerant liquid outlet tube are respectively arranged at the outer side of the shell, and the second end cover shell is arranged at one end of the shell. According to the application, the heating medium fluid enters the first end cover shell from the heating liquid inlet pipe, and then passes through the filter screen plate and enters the hollow inside of the inner cylinder. The filter screen plate can filter out impurities in the heating medium, so that the impurities are reduced to be attached to the inner wall of the heat exchange tube, and the heat exchange tube is ensured to be in an efficient heat exchange state for a long time.

title_en: Deep denitrification wetland purification bed system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a deep denitrification wetland purification bed system which comprises a water inlet channel, an aeration zone, a filler denitrification zone and a water collecting channel, wherein the water inlet channel, the aeration zone, the filler denitrification zone and the water collecting channel are sequentially arranged along the water flow direction, a floating island is arranged at the top of the aeration zone, a filler is arranged at the bottom of the floating island, an aeration device is arranged in the aeration zone, different denitrification fillers are arranged in the filler denitrification zone, and deep denitrification is carried out along the water flow direction. The system combines the traditional biochemical treatment and the artificial wetland ecological treatment technology, the denitrification efficiency can be improved to more than 80%, the deep denitrification is realized, and the system has the characteristics of high integration degree, high volume load and strong adaptability, and can be used for the water quality improvement and ecological restoration of polluted river channels.

title_en: Dry flue gas deacidification reaction device and working method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flue gas purification, in particular to a dry flue gas deacidification reaction device and a working method. The middle-upper part in the device is provided with a vertical flue gas baffle plate, the flue gas baffle plate divides the middle-upper part of the inner cavity of the dry flue gas deacidification reaction device into a first channel and a second channel, 3-6 flue gas inlets are formed in the wall surface of the upper part of the first channel, the upper part of the second channel is a flue gas outlet, and the lower end of the first channel and the lower end of the second channel are communicated with the bottom of the device; the top of the first channel is provided with a deacidification agent injection port; all the smoke inlets are circumferentially and uniformly distributed on the same horizontal plane, the central lines of all the smoke inlets form a certain included angle with the wall surface of the first channel, and the smoke inlets are internally matched in the first channel to form an inscribed circle; a plurality of baffle plates are arranged in the dry flue gas deacidification reaction device; the lower part of the dry flue gas deacidification reaction device is uniformly provided with fluidization air inlets, a plurality of guide plates are arranged at the turning part in the second channel, and a material returning opening is arranged on the side wall of the lower part of the second channel.

title_en: Soil screening device for soil remediation and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a soil screening device for soil remediation and a use method thereof, comprising a base, wherein the base is fixedly connected with a residual material box, the base is rotationally connected with a material ramming groove, the base is slidingly connected with a material storage box, the material storage box is rotationally connected with a screen, and the screen is arranged between the residual material box and the material ramming groove; the base is connected with a sliding rod in a sliding manner, the sliding rod is connected with the base through a first tension spring, the bottom end of the sliding rod is fixedly connected with a rammer, and the rammer is arranged above the ramming chute; the base is fixedly connected with a hopper, a discharge hole is formed in the bottom end of the hopper, a switch plate is slidably connected to the discharge hole, the switch plate is connected with the hopper through a second tension spring, and the discharge hole is arranged above the tamping groove. The device is convenient to operate, high in automation degree, capable of realizing automatic feeding of soil, automatic crushing and automatic screening, and therefore the efficiency and quality of soil screening can be effectively improved.

title_en: Big data processing's controllable pressure fire hydrant
abstract_en: The invention provides a big data processing controllable pressure fire hydrant, which relates to the field of fire control and comprises an installation mechanism: the main body is of a cylindrical structure; the moving piece is arranged at the bottom end of the bottom of the main body; the positioning piece is arranged in the positioning groove through the spherical bulge; the fixing piece is arranged at the top of the top piece; the clamping piece is arranged in the clamping groove through a triangular bulge; when moving downwards, through the spherical protruding screens on the setting element inside the constant head tank to can play the effect of location to the setting element, and drive setting element undercut through the top, make the screens piece insert the screens inslot portion, it is spacing to the screens piece through the screens groove, can block up the main part bottom, prevent to appear the skew after receiving the striking, cause the waste of water resource, when having solved current fire hydrant when using, outdoor fire hydrant is installed and is received the striking of vehicle easily at the part at road edge, cause the waste of water resource, can't be more firm problem of shutoff to the fire hydrant bottom.

title_en: Intelligent fire hydrant based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent fire hydrant based on the technical field of fire safety, in particular to an intelligent fire hydrant based on the Internet of things, which comprises a fire hydrant and a fire hydrant box used for placing the fire hydrant, wherein a fire water pipe used for conveying water is also placed in the fire hydrant box, the intelligent fire hydrant also comprises a connecting structure arranged between the fire water pipe and the fire hydrant and a mounting structure used for connecting the fire water pipe and an output end of the fire hydrant through the connecting structure.

title_en: Supported heterogeneous Fenton catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a supported heterogeneous Fenton catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the supported heterogeneous Fenton catalyst mainly comprises a carrier, a PDA (polydopamine) layer deposited on the carrier and alpha-FeOOH particles deposited on the PDA layer; the preparation method comprises the following steps: immersing a carrier with a PDA layer deposited on the surface in a solution containing ferric salt and ferrous salt at the same time to perform in-situ reaction to generate alpha-FeOOH, thus obtaining a supported heterogeneous Fenton catalyst; the supported heterogeneous Fenton catalyst, hydrogen peroxide and water form a Fenton system and are used for catalyzing and degrading dye wastewater. The supported heterogeneous Fenton catalyst prepared by the invention can be applied to catalytic degradation of dye wastewater, has excellent catalytic degradation activity on cationic and anionic dyes, can realize effective degradation in a wider pH range, and solves the problem of severe pH requirement when the homogeneous Fenton catalyst in the prior art is applied.

title_en: Multistage pond serial-parallel rainwater efficient treatment system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multistage pond serial-parallel rainwater efficient treatment system which comprises a primary sedimentation tank, a pretreatment pond, an adjusting tank, an ecological pond and a strengthening pond, wherein the primary sedimentation tank is communicated with the adjusting tank through the pretreatment pond, the adjusting tank is respectively communicated with the ecological pond and the strengthening pond, and the ecological pond is externally connected with a multistage ecological filter belt through the strengthening pond and is communicated with an artificial lake. The invention adopts the technical route of the multistage pond combined control series-parallel connection reinforced constructed wetland to purify rainwater, can meet the requirement of purifying the rainwater, and the purified rainwater is used for supplementing the reservoir capacity of the artificial lake, so as to construct a composite ecological system integrating ecological purification and ecological civilization, finally realize the harmony and symbiosis of people and nature, effectively remove pollutants carried after the rainwater washes the earth surface, achieve the purpose of purifying the rainwater, reduce the pollution load of natural water bodies and avoid the pollution of receiving receptors. The invention has low construction cost, good purification effect and good economic benefit.

title_en: Tail gas catalyst for gasoline generating set and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a gasoline generator set tail gas catalyst and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: weighing cerium nitrate hydrate capable of theoretically generating 50-70 g of cerium oxide, adding the cerium nitrate hydrate into deionized water, and regulating pH by using carboxylic acid to obtain a mixed solution; weighing ferric nitrate hydrate capable of theoretically generating 5-20 g of ferric oxide, adding the ferric nitrate hydrate into deionized water, and dripping a platinum nitrate solution capable of theoretically generating 0.1-2 g of platinum oxide to obtain a mixed solution; mixing the two mixed solutions, regulating the pH with ammonia water, and adding alcohol compounds; drying and roasting the mixed slurry, and then crushing and ball-milling to obtain finished slurry; and (3) coating the slurry on a carrier, and drying and roasting to obtain the catalyst. The catalyst disclosed by the invention has the advantages of simple preparation process, high CO conversion rate, good high-temperature resistance and long service life, and is prepared by only adopting noble metal Pt as a catalytic active component, so that the preparation cost is low.

title_en: Fireproof protection structure of hot-cast anchor node
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of building cable structures, and discloses a fireproof protection structure of a hot-cast anchor node, which comprises an embedded part, wherein a plurality of groups of connectors are equidistantly arranged at the outer end of a hoop, the side surface of the embedded part is connected with a steel pipe sleeve, the steel pipe sleeve is installed in a plurality of sections, through bolts at the positions corresponding to the connectors are connected with the connectors, a plurality of groups of depressions are formed at the positions, corresponding to the bolts, of the outer end surface of the steel pipe sleeve, the surface of a cover plate is horizontal to the outer end surface of the steel pipe sleeve, and a fireproof layer is arranged at the outer end of the steel pipe sleeve. This fire protection structure of hot-cast anchor node under the circumstances that the conflagration took place, expansion type fire-retardant coating expansion foaming presents endothermic reaction, heat when consuming the burning, and foam layer texture that forms simultaneously is loose, can delay the speed of heat transfer, and after the fire-retardant coating became invalid, when the node was risen to the early warning value, started intelligent water pump, and the inside water of water tank is drawn towards the inside heat of steel pipe cover that can absorb of metal pipe around, later spouts from the fire control shower nozzle of delivery port to play further fire prevention effect.

title_en: Absorption tower slurry density measuring method and system based on operation parameter correlation
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of absorption tower slurry density measurement, in particular to an absorption tower slurry density measurement method and system based on correlation of operation parameters. The method comprises the steps of obtaining operation parameters of the absorption tower system and a slurry density detection value in the absorption tower in the same time period, obtaining an absorption tower slurry density prediction model through training by fitting the operation parameters and the slurry density detection value, and obtaining the absorption tower slurry density by using the absorption tower slurry density prediction model. The wet desulfurization slurry density measurement method based on the soft measurement of the important parameters of the key equipment of the circulating pump of the absorption tower can effectively solve the difficult problem that the online gypsum slurry densimeter of the absorption tower is difficult to accurately measure.

title_en: Hydrocarbon recovery device and cleaning device
abstract_en: The invention provides a hydrocarbon recovery device capable of inhibiting the reduction of the capability of removing hydrocarbon from a hydrocarbon-containing treated gas. A hydrocarbon recovery apparatus for removing and recovering hydrocarbons contained in a gas to be treated, comprising: a treatment tank having an adsorbent housing space in which an adsorbent capable of adsorbing hydrocarbons is housed, and a treated gas introduction valve provided in the treated gas introduction pipe connected to the treatment tank; the treated gas exhaust valve is a valve arranged on a treated gas exhaust pipe connected with the treatment tank; the air suction port of the vacuum pump is connected with the treatment tank through a vacuum suction pipe; a hydrocarbon liquefying part connected with an exhaust port of the vacuum pump; the vacuum suction valve is a valve arranged on the vacuum suction pipe; an atmospheric pressure opening valve for opening the treatment tank to the atmosphere; a valve control part for performing a gas treatment operation; suction pair operation; and (3) an adsorbent regeneration operation.

title_en: Sewage treatment filtration purification equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sewage treatment, in particular to sewage treatment, filtration and purification equipment, which comprises: a housing; the water inlet pipe is fixedly connected with the shell; the dust removing mechanism is arranged on the inner side of the shell; wherein, dust removal mechanism includes: the filter assembly is arranged on the inner side of the shell; the disinfection component is arranged on the inner side of the shell and is connected with the filtering component; the driving assembly is arranged between the shell and the disinfection assembly; the transmission assembly is arranged between the driving assembly and the filtering assembly, and the dust removing mechanism is arranged, so that the disinfection assembly and the filtering assembly are matched with the driving assembly and the transmission assembly, not only can sewage be effectively purified, but also disinfectant and sewage can be fully mixed, the purification effect is greatly improved, the automatic cleaning of the filtering assembly can be realized, and the stability of the equipment in operation is ensured.

title_en: Method for treating pollutants by special microorganism reinforced microbial fuel cell
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for treating pollutants by a special microorganism reinforced microbial fuel cell, belonging to the field of wastewater treatment. The invention provides a single-chamber microbial fuel cell, which comprises an anode electrode material, a cathode electrode material and an inoculating liquid; the inoculation liquid is as follows: the method comprises the steps of (1) mixing a micro acidophilic stenotrophomonas liquid, a nutrient solution, a phosphate buffer solution and activated sludge according to a volume ratio of 1-5: 1 to 5:1 to 3: 2-4, and preparing an inoculation liquid after mixing; immersing the electrode material connected with the cathode and the anode by using metal wires in an inoculating liquid, adding edible oil or engine oil, standing, degrading activated sludge and oil by using bacterial liquid and generating electrons and protons, wherein the electrons pass through an external circuit from the anode material to the cathode electrode material, and form a current loop with the protons to generate electricity. The method for treating the oil pollutants by utilizing the micro-acidophilic stenotrophomonas microbial fuel cell is beneficial to sustainable development of ecological environment.

title_en: Plate type dust removing filter element
abstract_en: The invention provides a plate type dust removal filter element, and belongs to the field of dust removal filter elements. In particular to a filter element which is arranged in a combined way and is internally provided with a capsule cavity structure for separating and storing dust in large capacity. Comprising the following steps: the main body fixing frame is of a rectangular frame body structure, and two end opening parts are correspondingly provided with step structures so as to carry out installation limit; two groups of filter plates are correspondingly arranged on the main body fixing frame, and are correspondingly embedded and fixed on the steps; the main body fixing frame is provided with a compression frame for installing and clamping filter plates and an inner filter core which is uniformly filled in the main body fixing frame and is correspondingly arranged between the filter plates; the filter plate is characterized in that the outer side wall of the main body fixing frame is provided with a clamping groove structure, a bag structure for storing foreign matters is arranged on the filter plate, the filter plate is quickly replaced through a combined arrangement structure, two groups of filter plates are arranged, an interlayer for filling an inner filter core is arranged in the middle of the filter plate, and a sandwich filter arrangement is formed.

title_en: Air purifying composition for removing peculiar smell and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an odor-removing air purification composition which is characterized by comprising the following components in parts by mass: 1-6 parts of modified filler, 1-3 parts of modified titanium dioxide, 10-30 parts of active carbon, 1-6 parts of auxiliary agent, 10-30 parts of acrylic emulsion and solvent; wherein the modified filler is a filler subjected to hydroxylation treatment; the modified titanium dioxide is obtained by reacting 2- [2- (2-methoxyethoxy) ethoxy ] acetic acid with titanium dioxide. The peculiar smell-removing air purification composition adopts the alkyl acid derivative modified titanium dioxide with the main chain containing oxygen atoms as a component, and is compounded with components such as modified filler, acrylic emulsion, active carbon, auxiliary agent and the like, so that the stability of the material is effectively improved, the adsorption and degradation performances of the composition are greatly enhanced, the air purification composition has an excellent air purification effect, and the defects in the prior art are overcome.

title_en: Method for preliminary separation of dimethyl oxalate in preparation of ethylene glycol from synthesis gas
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for preliminary separation of glycol dimethyl oxalate from synthesis gas, which comprises a dimethyl oxalate synthesis reactor, an absorption tower and a condenser arranged at the top of the absorption tower, wherein a filler, a gas distributor and a liquid distributor are arranged in the absorption tower, gas phase and liquid methanol in the absorption tower are fully contacted in the filler, the temperature of the gas phase is reduced after heat exchange, the gas phase without dimethyl oxalate and DMC is discharged outwards through an air outlet of the condenser after the temperature of the gas phase is reduced, the dimethyl oxalate and DMC form liquid after being cooled, the liquid flows down to the bottom of the absorption tower and then is sent to an external rectification section for further purification, and the liquid methanol is changed into gas phase after absorbing heat and enters the condenser along with circulating gas phase for condensation, so that the excessive low crystallization of DMO temperature is prevented from being solid, and equipment and pipelines are blocked. Solves the problem that dimethyl oxalate is difficult to separate in a gas phase, and avoids the condition that the crystallization blocks a pipeline and equipment caused by using circulating water to condense the dimethyl oxalate.

title_en: Interlayer modified hectorite diatomite composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of an interlayer modified hectorite diatomite composite material, which comprises the following steps of (1) adding a magnesium-containing compound, a lithium-containing compound and a corresponding amount of diatomite into deionized water, fully and uniformly mixing, putting into a reaction kettle for reaction, cooling to room temperature after the reaction is finished, washing, collecting and drying to obtain a hectorite diatomite precursor, and (2) adding the hectorite diatomite precursor, cetyltrimethylammonium bromide and a certain amount of ethanol solution into the reaction kettle, washing, collecting and drying after the reaction is finished and cooling to room temperature to obtain the modified hectorite diatomite, and then heating in nitrogen gas flow to obtain the interlayer modified hectorite diatomite composite material. The invention also provides application of the composite material prepared by the preparation method in treating dye wastewater, and the new material prepared by the preparation method has good adsorptivity to anionic and cationic dyes, thereby realizing the innovative idea of treating environmental pollution by using clay materials.

title_en: Industrial separation method for removing fluoride hazardous waste in secondary aluminum ash through volatilization and condensation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for industrially separating dangerous fluoride wastes from secondary aluminum ash by volatilizing and condensing, which comprises the steps of quickly heating by gas-solid two-phase heat exchange of the secondary aluminum ash suspension, enriching volatile salts and fluoride in the secondary aluminum ash, classifying and collecting the volatile salts and fluoride in the secondary aluminum ash, calcining at high temperature and the like.

title_en: Exhaust gas heat exchanger pipeline ash removal method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pipeline ash removal, and discloses a method and a device for ash removal of a pipeline of a spent gas heat exchanger, wherein the ash removal device is placed in a pipeline through which spent gas passes, so that a cleaning part in the ash removal device is propped against the inner wall of the pipeline; when the exhaust gas is transported in the pipeline, the cleaning part in the ash removing device is pushed to move in the pipeline, and the cleaning part can be pushed to move relative to the inner wall of the pipeline, so that ash residues on the inner wall of the pipeline are scraped; and discharging the scraped ash through an ash discharging part in the ash removing device. According to the exhaust gas heat exchanger pipeline ash removal method and device, the ash removal device is pushed to move in the pipeline by utilizing the power of transportation air in the pipeline, opportunistic caking on the pipe wall in the pipeline is removed, normal passing of exhaust gas is not affected, dust content entering the pipeline is reduced, and meanwhile, the filtering part is automatically cleaned.

title_en: Water treatment sterilization and disinfection device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a water treatment sterilization and disinfection device in the technical field of water treatment, which comprises a disinfection box, wherein one end of the disinfection box is provided with a liquid discharge pipe, the disinfection box comprises a water tank, one side of the upper end surface of the water tank is provided with an opening correspondingly communicated with the water inlet end of a sewage tank, the lower end of the water tank is open, and the inner cavity of the water tank is provided with a water turbine component and a liquid discharge structure communicated with the liquid discharge pipe; the inner cavity of the disinfection box is in sealing sliding fit with the push plate, the inner cavity of the disinfection box is positioned on one side of the push plate, which is away from the liquid discharge pipe, of the power assembly, and the power assembly is in transmission connection with the water turbine assembly. The sterilizing and disinfecting device can add disinfectant into flowing sewage in the process that the sewage enters the sewage tank, so that the function of comprehensively disinfecting the sewage in the sewage tank is realized; the sterilizing and disinfecting device can adjust the amount of disinfectant which is infused into sewage in real time according to the flow of the sewage in unit time entering the sewage pool, and the situation that the disinfectant is excessively or excessively added can not occur.

title_en: Regeneration method of arsenic-poisoned SCR denitration catalyst
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regeneration method of an arsenic-poisoned SCR denitration catalyst; the method comprises the following steps: 1. crushing and grinding regenerated SCR denitration catalystSieving to obtain catalyst powder. 2. Soaking and cleaning catalyst powder in alkaline solution; and introducing mixed gas of ozone, oxygen and nitrogen. 3. The solid product obtained in step 2 is washed and dried. 4. And (3) immersing the solid product obtained in the step (3) in a regeneration liquid. 5. And (3) calcining the solid product obtained in the step (4). The invention adopts a mode of coupling advanced oxidation technology with weak alkali washing to regenerate the arsenic-poisoned SCR denitration catalyst; o of the input weakly alkaline solution  3  With OH in weakly alkaline environment  ‑  Ion reaction to form HO  2   ‑  With O  2  ；HO  2   ‑  Hydrolysis to form OH and active O atoms, thereby utilizing the strong oxidizing property of the OH and active O atoms to poison most As on the surface of the catalyst  2  O  3  Oxidation to As  2  O  5  。

title_en: Novel process for preparing whisker and recycling magnesium salt by using white mud
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel process for preparing whisker recovery magnesium salt by using white mud, which comprises the steps of leaching and separating the white mud by sulfuric acid to obtain high-whiteness gypsum and a magnesium sulfate solution containing calcium ions, then carrying out carbonate decalcification treatment on the magnesium sulfate solution containing the calcium ions to obtain a high-purity magnesium sulfate solution, preparing high-purity Shui Liusuan magnesium from the magnesium sulfate solution by a thermal crystallization method, preparing magnesium carbonate or magnesium bicarbonate by a carbonization process, preparing high-purity magnesium oxide by calcining, and preparing high-whiteness nano-grade calcium sulfate fibers and high-strength gypsum products from the high-whiteness gypsum by a hydrothermal method technology. The invention not only changes waste into valuable, but also realizes the recycling, cleaning and high-value utilization of the white mud in the rare earth production industry.

title_en: Anaerobic ammoxidation reactor
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anaerobic ammonia oxidation reactor, which relates to the technical field of water treatment, and comprises the following systems: the device comprises a reactor body, a water outlet pipeline, a low-level gas stripping pipeline, a gas-liquid separator, an internal circulation pipeline and an exhaust pipeline; the reactor body is sequentially provided with an anoxic-anaerobic ammonia oxidation reaction zone, a middle aeration zone, an aerobic-anaerobic ammonia oxidation reaction zone, a mixing reaction zone, a gas-liquid separation zone and a clarification zone from bottom to top. Structurally, the height space is fully utilized, the occupied area is saved, and the land cost is reduced, so that the capital construction and running cost is reduced; in terms of technology, by coupling a filler technology, a granular sludge technology, a biological film technology, a gas stripping circulation technology, a middle aeration technology and a gas-liquid separation technology in a reactor body, the system has the advantages of high sludge sedimentation speed, high organic load impact resistance, high denitrification load, no need of adding an additional carbon source for removing total nitrogen, and high denitrification efficiency and low energy consumption are realized.

title_en: Filtering and purifying device for glove box and glove box thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a filtering and purifying device for a glove box and the glove box thereof, comprising a tank body, wherein a filtering structure is arranged in the tank body, a limiting structure is arranged on the filtering structure, a supporting structure is arranged on the filtering structure, a mounting structure is arranged on the tank body, a sealing structure and a fixing structure are arranged on the mounting structure, and a gas replacement device is arranged on one side of the tank body. According to the invention, air entering the tank body can be filtered and purified through the filtering structure, the tank body can be kept sealed when the air is filtered through the adsorption material in the tank body through the cooperation of the limiting structure and the abutting structure, the gas leakage is avoided, the adsorption material is convenient to replace when the adsorption material is saturated, and the tank body and the gas pipe on the glove box can be rapidly detached and installed through the installation structure.

title_en: Fixed oxygenation device of river course water
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water oxygenation, in particular to a river water fixed type oxygenation device. The invention provides a river water body fixed type oxygenation device capable of oxygenation in a large area. The utility model provides a fixed oxygenation device of river course water, includes installed part, floats mounting, oxygenation mechanism and swing mechanism, and the downside of installed part is connected with and floats the mounting, floats and is equipped with the oxygenation mechanism that is used for carrying out oxygenation to the river course water on the mounting, is equipped with the swing mechanism that is used for expanding oxygenation scope on the oxygenation mechanism. According to the invention, the control box controls the air inlet cylinder to suck air, and the air outlet cylinder is used for discharging, so that oxygen is injected into the water body, the water pumping pipe is controlled to pump water, then the water is sprayed out through the spray pipe, and the water sprayed out by the spray pipe is sprayed out from the spray head through the hose, so that the water body can be dispersed, the contact area with the air is increased, and the oxygenation effect is good.

title_en: Bubbling system for wet deacidification and dust removal of hazardous waste incineration flue gas
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of incineration flue gas treatment, in particular to a bubbling system for wet deacidification and dust removal of hazardous waste incineration flue gas, which comprises an absorption device filled with alkaline slurry, an inlet flue and an outlet flue, wherein the inlet flue is connected with the absorption device and comprises an inlet flue front section and a rear section which are connected by a dust removal cooling device, the inlet flue front section is connected with the outlet flue by an external circulation flue, the tail end of the inlet flue is connected with a bubbling disc immersed in the alkaline slurry, and a plurality of circles of openings are uniformly distributed on the circumferential side wall and the bottom of the bubbling disc and are connected with a spraying small pipe. The bubbling system has strong adaptability to the treatment of the flue gas, the components are controlled in a linkage way, the bubbling size can be ensured to be stabilized in a certain range, the bubbling system fully reacts with slurry to coagulate and nucleate, the bubbling system is not easy to block, the system resistance is low, and the energy efficiency is high.

title_en: Long-term stable solar evaporator with automatic salt removal function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a long-term stable solar evaporator with an automatic salt removal function, which comprises a basswood evaporator, wherein water to be treated is arranged on the outer wall of the basswood evaporator, when the long-term stable solar evaporator is prepared, firstly, lignin is removed from wood, 10mmol of copper acetate and 10mmol of dimethyl tin dichloride are dissolved in 100mL of DMF solvent, basswood is placed in the uniform solution, cu & lt2+ & gt and Sn & lt2+ & gt ions fully replace Na & lt+ & gt remained in wood, 10mmol of PTA is added into the solution for soaking the wood, 10mL of acetic acid is added, the mixture is fully stirred and then transferred into a stainless steel reaction kettle with a 200mL polytetrafluoroethylene substrate, the reaction is carried out for 24 hours at 120 ℃, wood blocks are washed three times by DMF and then are soaked by ethanol for 30 minutes, sulfur powder is placed at the upstream, the temperature is raised to 600 ℃ in N2 atmosphere, 8 hours are kept, two ends of carbonized materials are respectively ground to obtain the basswood evaporator, and finally, a collection container is used for collection, and the long-term stable solar evaporator with the automatic salt removal function is completed.

title_en: Protective type industrial electrical control equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides protective industrial electrical control equipment, which comprises a fire extinguishing assembly and a flame-proof assembly, wherein the fire extinguishing assembly is arranged at the inner top of a cabinet body and comprises a containing body, an S-shaped hot aerosol fire extinguishing agent, a first flame detector, a fire extinguishing controller, an igniter, a first through hole and a second through hole; the flame-proof subassembly is located the outer top of the cabinet body. The first flame detector detects the internal combustion phenomenon of the cabinet and transmits combustion signals to the fire extinguishing controller, the fire extinguishing controller controls the igniter to start igniting the S-shaped hot aerosol fire extinguishing agent, aerosol gas generated by the reaction of the S-shaped hot aerosol fire extinguishing agent is flushed into the lower containing cavity of the containing body through the first through hole and is emitted to the internal parts of the cabinet, such as the main control switch, the electric control connector, the control system box and the like, to extinguish the fire through automatic monitoring and starting, so that the internal fire of the cabinet can be effectively extinguished in time, and the safety and stability of the control equipment are improved.

title_en: Folding type soil scraping machine for soil heavy metal pollution treatment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a folding type scraper for soil heavy metal pollution treatment, in particular to the field of soil heavy metal pollution treatment, which comprises a scraper main body, wherein two stabilizing frames are symmetrically welded on one side of the upper surface of the scraper main body along the center, a cleaning assembly is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of each stabilizing frame, and a mounting block is fixedly arranged on one side of the lower surface of the scraper main body. According to the invention, the dust settling device is arranged, when the folding type scraper works, dust is generated, at the moment, the centrifugal pump in the dust settling device is electrified to work, then the centrifugal pump can convey liquid stored in the liquid storage tank to the first connecting bent pipe through the second connecting bent pipe, then the first connecting bent pipe can convey the liquid to the rectangular pipe, finally the conveyed liquid is sprayed out by the atomizing nozzle to perform dust settling on the scattered dust, so that the scattered dust is prevented from being absorbed by staff, and potential safety hazards of the device are avoided.

title_en: Betel nut baking production system and betel nut baking production process
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of betel nut processing, and discloses a betel nut baking production system and a betel nut baking production process, wherein the betel nut baking production system comprises a plurality of baking rooms arranged in an array manner, and further comprises a tail gas treatment device and a feeding device arranged corresponding to each baking room, wherein the feeding device comprises a storage bin and a conveyor, a gate is arranged at a discharge hole below the storage bin, and a moving wheel is arranged at the bottom of a frame body; every roast room one side is provided with the gate, the gate below sets up the access door, roast room top face sets up louvre, lifting machine and exhaust pipe are located the louvre both sides, the roast room inner wall of gate downside articulates there is the carrier plate, the carrier plate level sets up, gate one end is kept away from to the carrier plate is connected with the lifting machine, roast room is kept away from gate one side and is set up the combustion chamber, combustion chamber upper end one side and roast room intercommunication. The invention reduces the bearing of the curing barn, is convenient for adjusting the suction speed of the flue gas, and is convenient and efficient.

title_en: Low-carbon emission factory air filtering device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-carbon emission factory air filtering device which comprises a water storage tank and a filter box, wherein a cooling sedimentation chamber, a heat exchange chamber and a filter chamber are arranged in the filter box, a distribution chamber is arranged in the water storage tank, a mounting frame is arranged in the middle of the cooling sedimentation chamber, a filter screen is arranged in the mounting frame, a rack is welded on one side of the cooling sedimentation chamber, a gear is meshed with the bottom of the rack, a brush roller is welded on the side face of the gear, a moving mechanism is arranged outside the cooling sedimentation chamber, a spray head is arranged at the top of the cooling sedimentation chamber, a coil pipe is fixedly arranged in the heat exchange chamber, a water suction pump is arranged at the bottom of the cooling sedimentation chamber, a heat conducting plate is arranged in the heat exchange chamber, the top end of the heat conducting plate stretches into the water storage tank, and the heat conducting plates are alternately arranged on the inner walls of the two sides of the heat exchange chamber. The invention utilizes a plurality of working procedures to cool and absorb heat to the gas, thereby avoiding a large amount of heat from being directly discharged and increasing the utilization rate of resources; the impurity on filter screen surface clearance more thoroughly, impurity direct clearance is outside to the rose box, avoids piling up in inside and is difficult to clear.

title_en: Waste power battery recycling and separating equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disassembling equipment, and discloses waste power battery recycling and disassembling equipment, which comprises a main body mechanism, a vibration disassembling mechanism and a convenient supporting mechanism, wherein the vibration disassembling mechanism is positioned at the upper end of the main body mechanism, the convenient supporting mechanism is positioned at the lower end of the main body mechanism, the main body mechanism comprises a workbench, a hydraulic cylinder and a hydraulic push rod, the hydraulic cylinder is fixedly arranged at the left end and the right end of the upper end of the workbench, the hydraulic push rod is fixedly arranged at the transmission end of the upper end of the hydraulic cylinder, and the main body mechanism further comprises a supporting plate, a circular sawing machine and a clamping assembly. According to the waste power battery recycling and splitting equipment, the clamping and splitting capacity is improved by installing and improving the main body mechanism, the waste power battery can be clamped and placed in a portable mode according to the use requirement in the actual use process, the waste power battery recycling and splitting equipment is convenient to split and cut for use, and the use efficiency of the waste power battery recycling and splitting equipment is improved.

title_en: Waste gas treatment device for automobile window film processing process
abstract_en: The application discloses an exhaust gas treatment device in the automobile window film processing process, which belongs to the technical field of exhaust gas treatment devices and comprises a reaction furnace for oxidizing exhaust gas at high temperature, wherein the exhaust gas enters through a first air inlet box connected with the bottom end of the reaction furnace, air enters from a second air inlet box connected with the top end of the reaction furnace, one side of the reaction furnace is provided with a heat exchange box, the reaction furnace is communicated with the heat exchange box through a first air supply pipeline, heat in the heat exchange box is conducted into the reaction furnace through a heat exchange assembly, and the reaction furnace comprises a preheating cavity, a reaction chamber, a heat accumulator, a first air storage cavity, a second air supply pipeline and a hollow pipeline. According to the application, the air entering the reaction furnace is preheated by utilizing heat generated in the high-temperature oxidation process of the VOC waste gas and the oxygen, and the VO waste gas is heated by the heat accumulator, so that the initial temperature of the contact of the air and the VOC waste gas is higher, and the time for reaching the high-temperature oxidation temperature is greatly shortened.

title_en: Textile product uniform heating drying device
abstract_en: The invention provides a uniform heating and drying device for textile products, which belongs to the technical field of textile equipment and comprises a drying table, wherein a water removing mechanism is arranged on one side of the top of the drying table, and comprises an extrusion shaft roller; the invention relates to a drying machine, which comprises a drying table, wherein a drying mechanism is arranged on the other side of the top of the drying table, the drying mechanism comprises a steam plate, a steam generator is arranged on one side of the drying table, a steam delivery pipe connected with the steam plate is arranged at a steam outlet of the steam generator.

title_en: Cleaning device, method for cleaning filtration membrane, and filtration system
abstract_en: The cleaning device is used for cleaning a filter membrane in a filter assembly, one end of the filter assembly is provided with a filter water inlet, and the other end of the filter assembly is provided with a wastewater outlet; the cleaning device includes: a cleaning tank for storing cleaning liquid; the cleaning box comprises a water inlet end and a water outlet end; the cleaning pipe is connected with the water outlet end of the cleaning box and the filtering water inlet; a return pipe connected with the wastewater outlet and the water inlet end of the cleaning box; the first control valve assembly is arranged at one end of the cleaning pipe connected with the filtering water inlet; the second control valve assembly is arranged at one end of the water return pipe connected with the wastewater outlet. The embodiment of the invention is beneficial to reducing the cost of cleaning the filtering membrane.

title_en: Industrial purified water system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water treatment, in particular to an industrial pure water system and method, comprising a treatment box, wherein a partition plate is arranged in the treatment box and is divided into a tap water treatment bin and a waste water treatment bin, a purification component for purifying tap water is arranged in the tap water treatment bin, and a coarse filtration component, a fine filtration component, an adsorption component and a disinfection component which are used for sequentially treating waste water and are communicated by connecting pipes are arranged in the waste water treatment bin. According to the invention, the tap water treatment bin and the wastewater treatment bin are arranged to respectively carry out purification treatment on tap water and treatment on purified water after detergent production is used, so that on one hand, water in the detergent production process is conveniently ensured, on the other hand, the waste of water resources can be effectively reduced, and wastewater treated by the wastewater treatment bin can be reused.

title_en: Treatment method of sewage treatment system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of sewage treatment, in particular to a sewage treatment system. Comprises a pipeline, a pump mechanism, a collecting tank, a mixing mechanism, a processor and a regulating mechanism. Wherein, the pipeline is used for sewage to flow into the system from the outside and circulate among all devices in the system; the pump mechanism is connected with the pipeline and used for driving sewage to circulate; the collecting tank stores sewage collected from a sewage source; the mixing mechanism is communicated with the collecting tank; the processor is used for sewage treatment and is in bidirectional communication with the collecting tank and the mixing mechanism; the regulating mechanism is used for regulating the equipment to switch among a plurality of treatment modes according to the chemical oxygen demand of the sewage, and comprises a detection unit and a control unit, wherein the detection unit is arranged on the mixing mechanism. According to the invention, the regulation and control mechanism is arranged in the sewage treatment system, and the treatment mode is intelligently distributed by detecting information such as the incoming amount of sewage and the chemical oxygen demand concentration, so that the water inlet condition of the treatment machine is kept stable, and the stable water outlet quality is further obtained.

title_en: Incinerator with waste gas treatment function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of carbon black production, and discloses an incineration device with an exhaust gas treatment function, which comprises an incinerator, wherein a through groove is formed in the upper surface of the incinerator, a crushing pool is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the incinerator, sliding grooves are formed in the side walls of two ends of the crushing pool, a plurality of groups of feeding holes are formed in the upper surface of the crushing pool, a plurality of groups of discharging holes are formed in the lower surface of the crushing pool, the discharging holes are communicated with the incinerator, and the incineration device with the exhaust gas treatment function is started to cooperate with a roller shaft and a crushing rod to crush raw materials, so that the incineration effect of the raw materials is improved.

title_en: Intelligent sweeping robot charging device and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent sweeping robot charging device which comprises a shell, a connecting sheet, a supporting box and a first sliding rod, wherein the supporting box is arranged on the inner wall of the shell, the first sliding rod is arranged on the inner wall of the shell, the connecting sheet is arranged on the outer wall of the supporting box, and the sliding barrel is arranged on the outer wall of the first sliding rod. According to the intelligent sweeping robot, the first spring, the friction pad and the support are arranged, the effect of preventing the intelligent sweeping robot from moving out accidentally during charging of the intelligent sweeping robot is achieved, the first spring moves to enable the pressing plate to drive the support to move, the support moves to drive the sliding cylinder to move, the sliding cylinder moves to enable the pressing plate to drive the friction pad to move to open the second opening, the intelligent sweeping robot enters the charging device through the second opening to charge, at the moment, the first motor is reversed, the friction pad is contacted with the top of the intelligent sweeping robot through the elastic force of the first spring to enable the friction pad to be fixed, and the function of preventing the intelligent sweeping robot from moving out accidentally during charging of the intelligent sweeping robot is achieved.

title_en: Mine CO 2 Sealing and gas waterpower cooperative treatment method
abstract_en: Mine coal seam CO  2  The sealing and gas waterpower cooperative treatment method comprises the following steps: perforation-pre-injection-hole plugging-fracturing-water injection. According to the invention, mine hot alkaline water is introduced into the coal seam pores which are pre-injected with sufficient carbon dioxide, and partial macropore plugging is realized by utilizing generated precipitate particles; realizing the treatment and recycling of mine wastewater; the plugged macropores are utilized to improve the water injection pressure in the coal bed, increase the permeability of the coal body, improve the gas extraction effect of the coal bed, recover high-concentration gas and reduce the gas content in mine air discharged into the atmosphere; the coal body is slowly wetted through the small pores which are not plugged, the dust content in mine air discharged into the atmosphere is reduced, and a mineral green resource utilization and environmental protection technology system is constructed.

title_en: Preparation method and application of modified silicon dioxide particles as triboelectric catalyst
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of modified silicon dioxide particles as a triboelectric catalyst. The invention aims to solve the problem that the traditional piezoelectric water disinfection material has low disinfection rate and the solar energy material is limited by seasons. According to the invention, a part of hydrophilic groups are connected to the surface of hydrophobic silicon dioxide, so that the hydrophobic material can be contacted with water effectively to conduct ROS effectively while generating electron transfer by friction with water, thus obtaining a material A, then gold nanoparticles are further loaded on the basis of the material A, so that the fermi level of the material is regulated, and the electron transfer rate of the material B on the basis of the material A is further improved. The two-step modification ensures that the material can transfer electrons between water and the material by utilizing mechanical energy on one hand and has ultrahigh electron utilization efficiency on the other hand, thereby effectively combining the advantages of the existing water disinfection material and obtaining the material which has high-efficiency sterilization and wide energy sources and is not limited by seasons.

title_en: Frego's bacterium L17, microbial inoculum and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to a Freund's bacterium L17, a microbial inoculum and application, comprising the Freund's bacterium L17, wherein the preservation number is CCTCC M20221102; a microbial agent comprising L17 of Freund's disease; the application of the Freund's bacterium L17 and the microbial inoculum in aniline blue decolorization, alkali lignin degradation and/or lignin degradation and wheat straw degradation. The method has the advantages that the Freund's Geranium L17 has obvious decoloring effect on aniline blue and has stronger oxidizing capability; the Freund's fungus L17 can generate lignin degrading enzyme, can effectively degrade lignin, has good degradation effect on lignin in alkali lignin and wheat straw, can be used for developing and utilizing biomass resources, and has great application value.

title_en: Nonmetal sound barrier with sound absorption effect, impact resistance and difficult fault resistance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nonmetal sound barrier with sound absorption effect, impact resistance and difficult fault, which relates to the technical field of nonmetal sound barriers, and aims to solve the technical problems that the nonmetal sound barrier is easy to fault under the impact of external force, has poor surface tension and toughness and short service life in the prior art, and comprises panel meshes; wherein, panel net piece lower extreme fixedly connected with first concrete layer in proper order, the net cloth, the sound absorbing layer, backplate net piece and second concrete layer, the second concrete layer rear side is seted up flutedly, second concrete layer front side fixedly connected with and recess assorted lug, the drainage sound absorbing hole that rectangle equidistance was distributed has been seted up to panel net piece and first concrete layer upper end, this nonmetal sound barrier utilizes panel net piece and backplate net piece to improve nonmetal sound barrier's impact resistance, ensure nonmetal sound barrier be difficult for the fault when using, add the short fiber in the mixture and stir pulling force and toughness that can strengthen cement, the net cloth increases panel pulling force.

title_en: Porous bismuth diiodoxide semiconductor photocatalyst, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of photocatalyst preparation, and discloses a porous Bi  5 O 7  I semiconductor photocatalyst, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein a Bi-containing polymer is dissolved in distilled water, inorganic salt containing I is added, the mixture is stirred uniformly and then transferred into an autoclave for hydrothermal treatment, a hydrothermal reaction product is centrifuged and dried to obtain powder, and the powder is ground and calcined at a high temperature to obtain the porous Bi  5 O 7  I semiconductor photocatalyst. The semiconductor photocatalyst 'porous Bi  5 O 7  I' prepared by the method has a complete and stable Bi  5 O 7  I crystal structure, and the electron-rich Bi  (3‑x)+  formed on the surface of the semiconductor photocatalyst Bi  5 O 7  I obtained in the special mode is beneficial to CO  2  activation, improves the photocatalytic performance, has excellent product selectivity, shows good photocatalytic stability under long-period test, promotes efficient and stable conversion of CO  2  to CO, and is suitable for wide popularization and use.

title_en: Automatic spraying treatment system and method for soil remediation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic spraying treatment system and method for soil remediation, and belongs to the technical field of soil remediation. Including first support frame, still include: the mixing box is fixedly connected to the surface of the first supporting frame, the inner wall of the mixing box is fixedly connected with a suction pump, and the outlet end of the suction pump is fixedly connected with a first discharging pipe; the bottom of the distributing pipe is rotationally connected with a rotary pipe, the bottom of the rotary pipe is fixedly connected with a spray head, and the spray head is provided with spray holes; the first motor of fixed connection at first support frame surface, the output fixedly connected with first bull stick of first motor, the transmission is connected with first chain between first bull stick and the commentaries on classics pipe, rotates through starting first motor drive shower nozzle, can effectively control the centrifugal force size of the mixed solution that flows out from orifice department through the rotational speed of control first motor to control the spraying scope of mixed solution, improved and sprayed the degree of consistency, improved soil remediation effect.

title_en: Mine plant dust removal purifier for environmental protection equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of air purification, in particular to a dust-removing purifier for an environmental protection device, which comprises a filter device, wherein the lower surface of the filter device is fixedly connected with a pressurizing base, the front surface of the filter device is provided with parallel external rotating shafts, the outer surfaces of the parallel external rotating shafts are in rolling connection with a control transmission belt, the left side and the right side of the inner wall of the control transmission belt are symmetrically provided with baffle plates, one side, close to the filter device, of the outer surface of each baffle plate is fixedly connected with a rotor motor, the filter device comprises a protective shell, and the inner wall of the protective shell is uniformly provided with a through plate. The device filter rotary drum is at filterable in-process, because can take place the rotation, and the filtration hole after the rotation can receive reverse appeal effect, so compare with general filter equipment, the probability that the filtration hole of filtering the rotary drum blockked up reduces by a wide margin, so can continuous operation longer time, the frequency of clear up also can reduce, accords with the user demand of ore plant more.

title_en: Carbon monoxide adsorbent with core-shell structure and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a carbon monoxide adsorbent with a core-shell structure, which takes microspheres with high specific heat capacity and a non-porous structure as a core and takes a molecular sieve loaded with cuprous salt as a shell, wherein the composite adsorbent comprises the following raw materials, by mass, 5-10 parts of microspheres with high specific heat capacity and a non-porous structure, 70-90 parts of a molecular sieve loaded with the cuprous salt, 5-10 parts of an adhesive and 1-2 parts of an auxiliary adhesive. The invention has the beneficial effects that the microsphere with high specific heat capacity and a non-porous structure is adopted as the inert core of the adsorbent, so that the specific heat capacity of the adsorbent can be improved, thereby controlling the unfavorable temperature gradient generated during adsorption and desorption, on one hand, the dynamic adsorption capacity of the adsorbent is increased, and on the other hand, the mass transfer coefficient is improved, so that the adsorbent has excellent mass transfer performance, higher stability and physical strength, can stably work under severe environments such as high temperature, high pressure and the like, and has longer service life.

title_en: Active carbon fiber supported polymerized metal phthalocyanine composite catalytic fiber and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an active carbon fiber supported polymerized metal phthalocyanine composite catalytic fiber and a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of catalysts. According to the invention, the Metal Phthalocyanine Polymer (MPPC) is used as an active component, and the MPPC is loaded on the activated carbon fiber carrier, so that the pi-electron conjugated system of the MPc is enlarged, and the active center is increased; meanwhile, the agglomeration easily caused by stronger pi-pi interaction among MPPC molecules is avoided, so that the central metal of the active component is fully exposed, and the catalytic activity and stability of the catalyst are obviously improved; in addition, the activated carbon fiber can effectively adsorb organic pollutants to promote the catalytic degradation of the organic pollutants, and can also provide electrons for MPPC so as to improve the catalytic activity of the MPPC, thereby efficiently degrading the organic pollutants such as antibiotics in high-salt wastewater, reducing the biotoxicity of the organic pollutants and providing a new method for controlling the pollution of the antibiotics.

title_en: Car washing wastewater treatment system based on pressure energy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a car washing wastewater treatment system based on pressure energy, which comprises a pressure energy unit, a filtering unit and an aeration unit, wherein the pressure energy unit is used for converting mechanical energy generated by a vehicle into pressure energy, the filtering unit is used for filtering car washing wastewater to remove solids in the car washing wastewater, the aeration unit is used for aerating the filtered car washing wastewater to improve the dissolved oxygen in the car washing wastewater so as to accelerate degradation of organic matters in the wastewater, and the aeration unit is connected with the pressure energy unit so as to drive the aeration unit to aerate by using the pressure energy generated by the pressure energy unit. The invention can convert mechanical energy generated by vehicle running into pressure energy, and treat the vehicle washing wastewater by utilizing the pressure energy, thereby effectively reducing energy consumption and running cost.

title_en: Acidic soil foundation treatment system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a system and a method for treating an acid soil foundation.
