The treatment system comprises a water injection pool, a neutralization pool and a cement soil retaining wall which is arranged in the range of an acidic soil foundation to be treated in a surrounding mode, wherein a pumping well and a pressure well are drilled in the region of the acidic soil foundation to be treated, a pumping filter tube and a pumping pump are arranged in the pumping well, a gravel layer is backfilled between the filter tube and the pumping well, the pumping pump is communicated with the neutralization pool through the pumping tube, a permeable tube is arranged in the pressure well, a water pressing device is arranged in the permeable tube, gravel is filled between the middle lower portion of the permeable tube and a soil layer well wall, clay is filled at the upper portion of the permeable tube, the water pressing device comprises a piston for sealing the permeable tube, a clear water and a neutralization liquid injection port is arranged on the piston, the clear water injection port is communicated with the water injection pool, and the neutralization liquid injection port is communicated with the neutralization pool. The invention effectively solves the problem of corrosion of the ground water and the acid soil in the acid polluted area to the foundation, and improves the PH value of the ground water and the soil in the acid polluted area.

title_en: Device and method for treating and recycling manure of high-bed dry-raised muscovy ducks
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for treating and recycling the manure of high-bed dry-raising muscovy ducks, comprising a base, a bearing plate and a cleaning assembly, wherein one end of the bearing plate is rotationally connected with the base, the other end of the bearing plate is hinged through a hydraulic telescopic rod, sliding rails are fixedly arranged at two ends of the bearing plate, sliding seats are slidably arranged on the sliding rails, the cleaning assembly is fixedly arranged between the two sliding seats, the cleaning assembly comprises a water storage cavity, a throwing and grabbing mechanism and an auxiliary scraping plate, the water storage cavity is fixedly arranged between the two sliding seats, the throwing and grabbing mechanism is slidably arranged at the front end of the water storage cavity, a plurality of water spray ports are fixedly and obliquely arranged at the bottom of the water storage cavity, and the auxiliary scraping plate is fixedly arranged at the rear end of the water storage cavity.

title_en: Multi-path radiation detection energy spectrum analysis method and system based on pulse width measurement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-path radiation detection energy spectrum analysis method and a system based on pulse width measurement, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting nuclear radiation signals and obtaining complete energy spectrum; carrying out coincidence measurement on the nuclear radiation signal to obtain a coincidence energy spectrum; judging the nuclide uniqueness according to the complete energy spectrum, and outputting nuclide types when the nuclide is unique; otherwise, comparing the coincidence energy spectrum with a nuclide database and outputting nuclide types; the system comprises: the first detection unit is used for collecting nuclear radiation signals and measuring a complete energy spectrum; the second detection unit is used for collecting nuclear radiation signals and measuring coincidence energy spectrum; the energy spectrum analysis unit is used for judging the nuclide uniqueness according to the complete energy spectrum, and outputting nuclide types when the nuclide uniqueness is achieved; otherwise, comparing the coincidence energy spectrum with a nuclide database and outputting nuclide types; the invention screens the specific energy of the nuclide by utilizing the cascade attenuation property of the decaying nuclide to obtain a relatively simplified coincidence energy spectrum for nuclide identification, improves the measurement precision and finally achieves the purpose of reducing the detection limit.

title_en: Water purifying equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of water purification equipment, in particular to water purification equipment which comprises a centrifugal filtering mechanism, a filter pressing mechanism and a medicine purification mechanism, wherein water is sequentially purified through the centrifugal filtering mechanism, the filter pressing mechanism and the medicine purification mechanism, and the medicine purification mechanism comprises a medicine box, a stirring assembly arranged in the medicine box and a driving assembly for driving the stirring assembly to move in the medicine box along the length direction of the medicine box; the centrifugal filtering mechanism comprises a barrel body arranged at the top of the medicine box, a centrifugal barrel with an opening at the top is rotationally arranged in the barrel body, and a plurality of filtering holes are formed in the centrifugal barrel; according to the application, through the arrangement of the stirring assembly and the driving assembly, the driving assembly can drive the stirring assembly to move in the medicine box along the length direction of the medicine box, so that stirring is realized while the stirring assembly moves, the stirring range of the stirring mechanism can be enlarged, and medicines in the medicine box can be stirred and mixed more uniformly, thereby enhancing water quality.

title_en: Manual-automatic integrated fire extinguisher valve
abstract_en: The application discloses a manual-automatic integrated fire extinguisher valve, which comprises a valve body, wherein a first valve cavity and a valve core are arranged in the valve body, the valve core is slidably connected in the first valve cavity, the valve core divides the first valve cavity into a power cavity and an air inlet valve cavity, a first elastic piece is arranged between the lower end part of the valve core and a connector, an air pressure channel is axially arranged on the valve core, one end of the air pressure channel is communicated with the air inlet valve cavity, the other end of the air pressure channel is communicated with the power cavity, and an electromagnetic valve for controlling the on-off of the air pressure channel and the air inlet valve cavity is arranged on the valve body; the valve body is provided with a mounting valve cavity communicated with the air inlet valve cavity, the valve body is provided with a first channel communicated with the mounting valve cavity and the power cavity, a manual switch is arranged in the mounting valve cavity, and the air inlet valve cavity and the first channel are communicated or cut off through the manual switch, so that the power cavity and the air inlet valve cavity are communicated or cut off. The application realizes the manual and automatic opening and closing of the valve.

title_en: Monocrystalline powder catalytic material, aerogel composite catalytic material, heterojunction composite catalytic material, and preparation methods and applications thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of catalyst materials, and discloses a single crystal powder catalytic material, an aerogel composite catalytic material, a heterojunction composite catalytic material, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the single crystal powder catalytic material is ZrGeWO  7  The aerogel composite porous nano catalytic material is ZrGeWO  7  ‑SiO  2  And the heterojunction composite catalytic material is ZrGeWO  7  ‑ZnSb  2  O  6  . The invention prepares the single crystal catalyst ZrGeWO  7  The degradation removal rate of bisphenol A in the degradation chemical wastewater reaches about 100 percent; meanwhile, zrGeWO is irradiated by visible light  7  ‑SiO  2  The degradation and removal rate of the compound photocatalyst to norfloxacin in pharmaceutical wastewater also reaches 100%; zr prepared by the prior art under the irradiation of visible light  2  WO  7  The powder is catalyst for degrading bisphenol A in chemical wastewater under irradiation of visible light, and the removal rate of bisphenol A is only 31.9%; therefore, the visible light response type photocatalytic material with high catalytic activity can obtain huge economic benefit, environmental benefit and social benefit.

title_en: Soil remediation in-situ thermal desorption extraction device and control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a soil remediation in-situ thermal desorption extraction device and a control method, which belong to the technical field of soil remediation devices, wherein the extraction device comprises an extraction mechanism, a medicament matching mechanism and a moving mechanism, the extraction mechanism at least comprises a pollutant detection sensor, and pollutant information in the soil is acquired through the pollutant detection sensor, so that the polluted soil with the preset depth is repaired. According to the invention, pollutant information in soil is obtained by arranging the pollutant detection sensor, so that the repair agent is selected through the matching mechanism according to the pollutant information in the soil, the repair agent is adjusted according to pollution characteristics, the matched catalyst can be selected according to local conditions according to different pollution situations, the magnetocaloric activation temperature condition is adjusted, the activity, efficiency and targeting of the oxidation agent are fully improved, and the use of catalyst raw materials and the use of heat energy sources are greatly saved.

title_en: Water quality purifier with protection machanism for aquatic bird breed
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water quality purifying device with a protection mechanism for aquatic bird breeding, which belongs to the technical field of aquatic bird breeding devices and is used for solving the technical problems that the water quality purifying device in the prior art has small pumping area, causes limitation and unilateral purification, and even needs external equipment or manual auxiliary stirring and diversion breeding water collection; the invention comprises a bottom frame, wherein a plurality of groups of aeration pipes are arranged on the inner wall of the bottom frame, and triangular frames are symmetrically arranged at the tops of two sides of the bottom frame; the invention not only can help the quick impurity separation of the raising water, but also utilizes intermittent water flow impact and vibration linkage of the filter screen frame to promote the intercepted impurities to wash into the slag chute, thus forming an automatic slag removing structure, and also forms auxiliary rotation of the water wheel body, promotes water flow mixing and stirring in the bottom frame area, combines multiple aeration mixing and stirring raising water, forms a multiple raising water mixing and stirring structure around the bottom frame, and realizes partition protection of the bottom of the water wheel body, thereby avoiding accidental contact of waterfowl.

title_en: Treatment process for purifying graphite production wastewater by hydrofluoric acid method
abstract_en: The application provides a treatment process for purifying graphite production wastewater by a hydrofluoric acid method, which relates to the technical field of purifying graphite by the hydrofluoric acid method, and comprises the following steps: concentrating the first-stage washing wastewater, and separating to obtain mixed concentrated acid and fresh water; the mixed concentrated acid is recycled to a primary acid washing section of a production line for purifying graphite by a hydrofluoric acid method after being regulated to a preset concentration, or the mixed concentrated acid is directly recycled to the primary acid washing section of the production line for purifying graphite by the hydrofluoric acid method; and (5) treating the fresh water to reach the standard and discharging. The primary washing wastewater is concentrated and separated to obtain mixed concentrated acid and fresh water, and the mixed concentrated acid can be used as primary acid washing acid to be recycled to the primary acid washing section after the concentration of the mixed concentrated acid is regulated according to production requirements, so that the amount of hydrochloric acid, nitric acid and hydrofluoric acid added into the primary washing wastewater can be reduced in the process, and the input cost of the primary acid washing section to the acid is saved.

title_en: Dam foundation protection device for hydropower engineering and protection method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydroelectric engineering, in particular to a dam foundation protection device for hydroelectric engineering and a protection method thereof, comprising a mounting plate, wherein four corners of the front end surface of the mounting plate are fixedly connected with sleeves, the inner cavity wall of each sleeve is slidably connected with a buffer rod, each buffer rod is sleeved with a spring, the front end surface of each collecting frame is fixedly connected with a second grid mesh, the left and right end surfaces of the lower side of the inner cavity wall of each collecting frame are fixedly connected with a first grid mesh, and the left and right upper parts of each collecting frame are provided with a puncturing mechanism for performing solid-liquid separation on garbage; the dam foundation can be impacted by impact force to achieve a high-efficiency slow-down effect, and the damage of the dam foundation under the beating of water waves is avoided.

title_en: High-rejection PE reverse osmosis membrane and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-rejection PE reverse osmosis membrane and a preparation process thereof, and belongs to the technical field of filter membrane materials. The preparation process of the PE reverse osmosis membrane with high rejection rate comprises the following steps of 1, mixing polyethylene and plasticizer according to the mass ratio of (2-4) to (6-8), and obtaining the polyethylene-based membrane through melt wet biaxial stretching; step 2, dipping the polyethylene-based film; step 3, carrying out low-temperature treatment on the polyethylene-based film subjected to the dipping treatment; step 4, soaking the polyethylene-based film subjected to low-temperature treatment in aqueous phase solution, and then removing superfluous aqueous phase solution on the surface; step 5, immersing the polyethylene-based film treated in the step 4 into the oil phase solution for interfacial polymerization reaction, removing superfluous oil phase solution on the surface, and drying to obtain the nascent reverse osmosis film with the polyamide desalting layer on the surface; and step 6, contacting the nascent reverse osmosis membrane with tea polyphenol, and obtaining the PE reverse osmosis membrane with high rejection rate after the reaction is finished.

title_en: Heavy metal ion adsorbent and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a heavy metal ion adsorbent, the heavy metal ion adsorbent and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the steps of obtaining a mixture of steel slag and red mud, adding water into the mixture of the steel slag and the red mud obtained in the steps, performing wet grinding by using a ball mill to obtain slurry 1, introducing CO  2  gas into the slurry 1 under stirring to carbonize modified porous framework particles in the slurry 1 to obtain slurry 2, filtering the slurry 2 to obtain a solid, washing the solid to be neutral in pH, and drying to obtain the heavy metal ion adsorbent. According to the invention, two industrial solid wastes, namely steel slag and red mud, are used as reaction raw materials, the cost is low, the porous adsorption material loaded with nano calcium carbonate is prepared under the condition of room temperature, the adsorption efficiency is high, and the high additional value utilization of the steel slag and the red mud and the treatment of wastewater are realized.

title_en: Hazardous waste incineration flue gas purification equipment and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses dangerous waste incineration flue gas purification equipment and a use method thereof, the dangerous waste incineration flue gas purification equipment comprises a desulfurizing tower device, a first air inlet is formed in the inner wall of the desulfurizing tower device, a first air outlet is formed in the inner wall of the desulfurizing tower device, a first exhaust fan is arranged on one side of the desulfurizing tower device, the air inlet end of the first exhaust fan is fixedly connected with the first air outlet through a first pipeline, the problems of damage to filter bags caused by uneven vibration and labor are solved through the desulfurizing tower device, an activated carbon adsorption box, a mounting frame, a treatment box, a conical guide box, a sewage outlet, a rotating seat, a dust removing cloth bag assembly, a cleaning assembly and a chimney tower, the cloth bag dust removing is realized by adopting a manual beating method, and dust falling on each filter bag of the cloth bag dust remover is beaten by manpower to remove dust deposited on the filter bags.

title_en: Industrial waste acid with deoiling function and rapid separation process of metal salt thereof
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of industrial hazardous waste treatment, in particular to a rapid separation process of industrial waste acid with a deoiling function and metal salt thereof, which comprises the following steps: loading the waste acid and the salt-containing waste liquid to a solid particle filter bed from bottom to top through a high-pressure pump to remove solid particles in the waste acid and the salt-containing waste liquid; continuously flowing the effluent liquid in the step one from bottom to top through an oil removal bed; loading deoiled waste acid and salt-containing waste liquid obtained in the second step into a chromatographic packing chromatographic column through a high-pressure pump, and collecting outlet liquid at the upper end of the chromatographic packing chromatographic column; stopping collecting when the pH value of the outlet liquid in the third step is less than 2, and flushing the chromatographic packing chromatographic column with deionized water from top to bottom through a high-pressure pump; the application utilizes the solid particle filter bed to firstly remove solid insoluble matters in the waste acid and the salt-containing waste liquid, reduce the solid blockage of pipelines in the waste acid and the salt-containing waste liquid, and secondly avoid the damage of the solid particles and insoluble matters in the waste acid and the salt-containing waste liquid to the core chromatographic packing chromatographic column.

title_en: Environment-friendly catalytic reaction generating device
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of sewage treatment, in particular to an environment-friendly catalytic reaction generating device; the device comprises a base, wherein a cylindrical container is arranged at the upper part of the base through a bracket, a horizontal sewage port is arranged at the upper part of one side of the container, the outer side of the sewage port is connected with a sewage inlet pipeline through a first valve, a water outlet is arranged at the bottom of one side of the container, the outer end of the water outlet is connected with a sewage discharge pipeline through a second valve, a vertical pipe coaxial with the water outlet is arranged in the container, the lower end of the vertical pipe is connected with an ozone supply assembly, a plurality of mixing and crushing assemblies which are communicated with the inside and are uniformly distributed in a ring shape are fixedly arranged at the lower part of the vertical pipe, and the mixing and crushing assemblies smash ozone which is introduced into the inner side of the vertical pipe to make the ozone fully contact with the sewage; according to the application, ozone and sewage are distributed and mixed, the rolling ball and the bulge are subjected to high-frequency irregular vibration in the process of rotating and horizontally moving the elastic rod through the process of moving the roller along the wavy annular groove, and the contact area of the ozone and the sewage is increased.

title_en: Electronic grade hydrogen fluoride production and preparation device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydrogen fluoride production and discloses an electronic grade hydrogen fluoride production and preparation device, which comprises a gas stripping reaction kettle and a coarse and fine integrated purification tower, wherein one side of the gas stripping reaction kettle is connected with an exhaust pipe, the exhaust pipe is connected with the gas stripping reaction kettle, an anti-blocking screening mechanism is arranged in the coarse and fine integrated purification tower, the anti-blocking screening mechanism comprises a transverse screening component and a longitudinal screening component, the transverse screening component comprises an upper rectangular frame and transverse screening wires, and a plurality of transverse screening wires are uniformly distributed at the top of the upper rectangular frame along the length direction of the upper rectangular frame; the vertical screening subassembly includes rectangle frame and vertical screen silk down, goes up rectangle frame and rectangle frame down and all have the degree of freedom that removes along thick smart integration purifying column direction of height down, and the top of rectangle frame down is provided with a plurality of vertical screen silk along self width direction equidistant, and a plurality of vertical screen silk contacts form the coarse filter screen of net formula if many horizontal screen silk for solve current purifying column and block up the problem unable mediation easily in the preliminary treatment in-process.

title_en: Double-precipitation sewage treatment device for sewage with high ammonia nitrogen and low carbon nitrogen ratio
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-precipitation sewage treatment device for high-ammonia nitrogen low-carbon nitrogen ratio sewage, which comprises a biochemical reaction unit, a solid-liquid separation unit and equipment, wherein the biochemical reaction unit comprises an anaerobic reaction zone, an anoxic reaction zone 1, an aerobic reaction zone and an anoxic reaction zone 2 which are sequentially connected, a nitrifying liquid return pipeline penetrates through the aerobic reaction zone, the anoxic reaction zone 1 and the anaerobic reaction zone and is positioned at the upper part of each reaction zone, the solid-liquid separation unit comprises a solid-liquid separation zone 1 and a solid-liquid separation zone 2 positioned above the solid-liquid separation zone 1, and a sludge return pipeline penetrates through the solid-liquid separation zone 1, the anoxic reaction zone 2, the aerobic reaction zone, the anoxic reaction zone 1 and the anaerobic reaction zone and is positioned at the lower part of the solid-liquid separation zone 1. The system has the advantages of high integration, small occupied area and high automation degree, can effectively reduce the impact of water quantity change on a sewage treatment system, and has excellent treatment effect on domestic sewage with high ammonia nitrogen and low carbon nitrogen ratio and larger flow change coefficient.

title_en: Oil removal material for treating coking residual ammonia water and preparation and use methods thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation and use method of an oil removal material for treating coking residual ammonia water, belonging to the field of water treatment technology and environmental protection. The oil removing material is prepared by fully stirring sulfide, coke powder and asphalt prepared by directly reacting sulfur and edible oil at 140-180 ℃ for 20-40 minutes. The oil removing material prepared by the invention has the characteristics of high surface area and low specific gravity, has affinity to tar in coking residual ammonia water, has good oil removing effect at 60-80 ℃, and meets the use requirement of treating coking residual ammonia water in factories; the oil removal material has the advantages of simple and convenient use method, easy regeneration and lower running cost; the used oil removing material can be regenerated by being placed in the regenerating liquid and can be repeatedly used.

title_en: Solid waste treatment equipment for environmental engineering
abstract_en: The invention discloses solid waste treatment equipment for environmental engineering, which comprises a shell, wherein a feed inlet, a first-layer treatment bin, a second-layer treatment bin and three-layer treatment bin are arranged in the shell from top to bottom, a plastic solid waste treatment device is arranged in the shell, the plastic solid waste treatment device comprises extrusion parts arranged at two ends of the first-layer treatment bin, sliding parts arranged at the top and the bottom of the first-layer treatment bin, hole punching parts arranged in the first-layer treatment bin and positioned below the feed inlet, grinding parts arranged in the middle of the second-layer treatment bin, a material adding part arranged at one end of the second-layer treatment bin, a material stirring part arranged at the other end of the second-layer treatment bin, a transmission part arranged at the bottom of the second-layer treatment bin, a material pushing part arranged at one end of the three-layer treatment bin and a magnetic attraction part arranged at the other end of the three-layer treatment bin. The invention relates to a solid waste treatment device for carrying out exhaust post-treatment on aerated plastic solid waste.

title_en: Nano cobalt functionalized acrylic fiber and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of wastewater treatment, and relates to a nano cobalt functionalized acrylic fiber and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: 1) Synthesis of amine ligand modified functionalized acrylic fiber PAN  A  F, performing the process; 2) Nanometer cobalt functionalized acrylic fiber PAN prepared by adopting stepwise method  A  F-Co. The nanometer cobalt functionalized acrylic fiber PAN prepared by the invention  A  F-Co has the advantages of simple preparation, high stability, good recycling and cyclic utilizationThe method has the advantages of being friendly to the environment, capable of efficiently degrading the organic phosphorus, and the like.

title_en: Exhaust throttle valve of split type structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses an exhaust throttle valve with a split structure, which relates to the technical field of automobile accessories and comprises a valve body, a valve plate, a bracket and a mounting seat; the valve plate is movably arranged in the valve body, the mounting seat is fixedly arranged on the outer surface of the valve body, and a positioning piece is arranged between the mounting seat and the bracket, wherein the positioning end of the positioning piece penetrates through the mounting section of the bracket to lock the positioning piece on the mounting seat; compared with the original structure, the blank casting process is better, the blank casting process is not easy to deform, the machining process is better, the production efficiency is higher, and the product quality is more stable; compared with the original structure, the structure not only has the product performance of an integral structure, but also reduces the manufacturing cost of the exhaust throttle valve while meeting the connection strength, thereby being beneficial to mass production.

title_en: System and method for separating and purifying mercury-containing material microwave-photooxidation cooperated mercury flue gas
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of flue gas purification, in particular to a mercury-containing material microwave-photooxidation synergistic mercury flue gas separation and purification system and method, wherein the system comprises a material conveying system, a microwave heating system is arranged on the material conveying system, and the microwave heating system is connected with the flue gas photooxidation purification system; the microwave heating system comprises a reaction device shell, wherein a microwave preheating cavity, a microwave roasting cavity and a material cooling cavity are arranged in the reaction device shell; the flue gas photooxidation purification system comprises a photooxidation purification bin, wherein adsorption cotton is arranged in the photooxidation purification bin, photooxidizing agent is coated on the adsorption cotton, and a xenon lamp is fixedly arranged in the photooxidation purification bin; the method effectively promotes the release of mercury vapor in the mercury-containing metallurgical materials through the steps of microwave preheating and roasting, and the flue gas permeates through the adsorption cotton containing the photooxidant, and recovers HgO through the dust removal cloth bag, so that the oxidation and removal of mercury are realized.

title_en: Method for treating nitrogen oxides by using oxygen stress resistant double-layer heterotrophic denitrification biological membrane
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for treating nitrogen oxides by using an oxygen stress resistant double-layer heterotrophic denitrification biological film, which is characterized in that a biotrickling filter filled with a double-layer heterotrophic denitrification biological film filler is used for treating waste gas containing NOx, the double-layer heterotrophic denitrification biological film is an inner layer heterotrophic denitrification biological film formed by inoculating heterotrophic denitrification bacteria domesticated in an anoxic environment on the surface of the filler, and an outer layer oxygen resistant heterotrophic denitrification biological film is formed by inoculating oxygen resistant heterotrophic denitrification bacteria domesticated in an aerobic environment on the surface of the inner layer heterotrophic denitrification biological film. The method of the invention relieves the inhibition of the denitration efficiency by oxygen through the construction of the double-layer heterotrophic denitrification biological film, solves the problem of low denitration efficiency under the stress of oxygen, and has the advantages of stronger functional pertinence, faster process and time cost reduction due to independent domestication of the anaerobic heterotrophic denitrifying bacteria of the inner layer biological film and the oxygen-resistant heterotrophic denitrifying bacteria of the outer layer biological film.

title_en: Efficient olefin trap based on cucurbituril composite material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-efficiency olefin trap based on a cucurbituril composite material, which comprises a trap protection outer cover and a trap well body, wherein the trap protection outer cover is arranged on the outer side of the trap well body, one end of the trap well body is integrally positioned with an input port for material to enter, the other end of the trap well body is integrally positioned with an output port for material to output, the position of the input port is connected with a composite box for material input, and the composite box is connected with a silver nitrate box, a diatomite box and a cucurbituril box. According to the efficient olefin trap based on the cucurbituril composite material, diatomite, cucurbituril and silver nitrate are introduced into the trap well body, the diatomite with the particle size of 0.30-0.18 mm is loaded with the cucurbituril, then silver nitrate is further loaded, and the trap well body with the particle size of 200mm is dried and then loaded into the trap well body with the particle size of 3mm, and a cucurbituril port can coordinate with silver ions, so that an effect site can be increased, and the aim of improving the adsorption efficiency is fulfilled.

title_en: Ruthenium-poly 2, 6-diaminopyridine catalytic material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a ruthenium-poly 2, 6-diaminopyridine (Ru-PDAP) catalytic material, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of water treatment. The Ru-PDAP catalytic material provided by the invention comprises porous poly-2, 6-diaminopyridine (PDAP) and ruthenium nanoparticles (Ru) loaded on the surface and internal pores of PDAP. The Ru-PDAP catalytic material provided by the invention has a good hole structure, PDAP is used as an electron donor to provide an activation site for periodate, and the interconversion of various valence states (0, 2+,3+,4+,6+, 8+) of Ru can provide more electrons for the oxidative degradation of organic matters by periodate, so that the catalytic material has a good catalytic effect on periodate/hydrogen peroxide degradation antibiotics.

title_en: Method for in-situ growth of nano titanium dioxide on cloth surface
abstract_en: The method for in-situ growth of nano titanium dioxide on the surface of cloth comprises the following steps of putting the cloth into hydrogen peroxide water solution, and heating at 70-90 ℃ for 2-3 hours; adding copper acetate into the solution, wherein the copper acetate accounts for one ten per million to one per million of the mass of the solution, heating the solution at 70-90 ℃ for 1 hour after adding the copper acetate, taking out and drying the cloth, immersing the dried cloth in a titanic acid solution for 1-2 hours at 40-50 ℃, taking out the cloth immersed in the titanic acid solution, extruding the cloth immersed in the titanic acid solution to obtain a titanic acid solution cloth containing fifty-eighty percent of the mass of the titanic acid solution, and carrying out heat treatment on the extruded cloth containing the titanic acid solution under a sealing condition to obtain the cloth material with nano titanium dioxide growing on the surface in situ.

title_en: Method and device for killing parasite hydroxyl free radicals in industrial cultured animals
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for killing parasite hydroxyl free radicals in industrial farmed animals. The device is provided with hydroxyl free radical (OH) solution generating equipment, an OH solution jet micro-jet device, a mixing tank, a mariculture pond, a micro-filter/protein separator/biological filter, a sand filter-reservoir, a real-time online detection system and an intelligent control center. The oxygen active particles are used for efficiently generating an OH solution through a gas-liquid mixer and a mixing tank, the OH solution water pipe is used for spraying the OH solution and cavitation bubbles to an OH solution treatment culture pond through a star-shaped OH solution micro-jet spraying device, 100% killing of parasites and other disease-causing microorganisms in a plurality of culture ponds is synchronously or intermittently realized, and organic matters and inorganic nitrogen oxides in the culture ponds are mineralized. The method is automatic, efficient, green and safe, does not generate disinfection byproducts, purifies the culture water, and ensures the growth health and marine ecological safety of the cultured animals.

title_en: Hydrazine hydrate tail gas treatment method
abstract_en: The application provides a hydrazine hydrate tail gas treatment method, which is characterized in that a tail gas treatment device is used for treatment, the tail gas treatment device comprises a first reaction kettle and a second reaction kettle, the hydrazine hydrate tail gas is introduced into the first reaction kettle and is mixed with hydrochloric acid solution in the first reaction kettle, the hydrochloric acid solution and the hydrazine hydrate tail gas react to obtain hydrazine hydrochloride solution, urea solution and the hydrazine hydrochloride solution are introduced into the second reaction kettle and are mixed in the second reaction kettle, and urea solution and the hydrazine hydrochloride solution react to obtain biurea slurry. According to the technical scheme provided by the application, the problems of high treatment cost and environmental protection of hydrazine hydrate evaporation tail gas in the related technology can be solved.

title_en: Multifunctional membrane assembly and membrane assembly system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional membrane assembly and a membrane assembly system, wherein the multifunctional membrane assembly comprises a filtering assembly and a suspension assembly, the filtering assembly comprises a water collecting frame and a plurality of purifying pieces arranged in the water collecting frame, a fluid channel is arranged in the water collecting frame, each purifying piece is communicated with the fluid channel, a water producing pipe is fixed on the water collecting frame and communicated with the fluid channel, a bearing head is also fixed on the water collecting frame and communicated with the fluid channel, the suspension assembly is of a hollow structure and is provided with a hoisting structure, the suspension assembly is detachably connected with the water collecting frame, the water producing pipe and the bearing head are oppositely arranged at two sides of the water collecting frame, and the water producing pipe can be in bearing connection with the bearing head of another multifunctional membrane assembly. The multifunctional membrane component can be switched between two states of immersing use and floating use through the dismounting suspension component, and the water production pipe and the receiving head can realize the relative fixation of a plurality of multifunctional membrane components and simultaneously collect, convey and filter water.

title_en: Garbage recycling device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of garbage recovery, in particular to a garbage recovery treatment device. The technical problems of the invention are as follows: a large amount of greasy dirt exists in kitchen waste, but black soldier flies can not digest the greasy dirt well, and excessive accumulation of the greasy dirt can influence the survival rate of the black soldier flies, and then influence the conversion efficiency of kitchen waste. The technical scheme of the invention is as follows: a garbage recycling device comprises a box body, a first DD motor, a second DD motor, a felt and the like; the left side of the box body is provided with a feeding port, and the right side of the box body is provided with a discharge port; a first DD motor is fixedly connected in the box body; a second DD motor is fixedly connected on the fixing frame in the box body; the rotating part of the first DD motor and the rotating part of the second DD motor are detachably connected with a felt, and the felt is obliquely arranged. Through driving the both ends of oil blanket to rotate with opposite direction, and then with oil blanket deformation shrink, extrude inside kitchen garbage, extrude away the greasy dirt in the kitchen garbage.

title_en: TNT nitrobenzene explosive wastewater treatment device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a TNT nitrobenzene explosive wastewater treatment device, which comprises: the device comprises a wastewater collection tank, a wastewater treatment device, an electrolysis power supply and a clean water tank, wherein a water inlet pump and a pipeline dosing device are connected between the wastewater collection tank and the wastewater treatment device, the top of the wastewater treatment device is connected with the clean water tank, a filter screen and a water passing filter plate are arranged in the wastewater treatment device, the filter screen and the water passing filter plate divide the interior of the wastewater treatment device into a wastewater pretreatment area and a BDD reaction treatment area, and an iron rod cathode and a BDD anode are arranged in the BDD reaction treatment area; the BDD material is different from other electrode materials, has excellent physical properties such as abrasion resistance, corrosion resistance and the like, has longer service life, is prepared from waste resources, has good environment-friendly property, has high reaction speed in treating TNT nitrobenzene explosive wastewater, has stable treatment performance, and is suitable for treating TNT nitrobenzene explosive wastewater.

title_en: Preparation method of sodium zirconium silicate ZS-9
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of sodium zirconium silicate ZS-9, and belongs to the technical field of pharmacy. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, mixing a sodium silicate solution and an alkali solution, dropwise adding a zirconium-containing solution, transferring to a high-pressure reaction kettle, and adding ZS-9 seed crystals to obtain a mixed solution; heating the obtained mixed solution, and performing heat preservation and pressure maintaining reaction; after the reaction is finished, cooling and regulating the pH value; filtering to obtain the crystal form ZS-9 of sodium zirconium silicate. The preparation method overcomes the special process conditions of the traditional high temperature and high pressure, does not need reaction equipment with a specially modified internal structure, is more suitable for industrial production, and the potassium ion exchange capacity of the obtained sodium zirconium silicate can meet the medicinal requirement.

title_en: Leachate heat treatment system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a leachate heat treatment system, which comprises: the top of the closed evaporation container is provided with a vapor outlet, and the side part of the closed evaporation container is provided with a sewage inlet; a heater for heating the evaporation vessel; a temperature sensor for sensing a temperature within the vaporization container; the water flow sensor is used for sensing whether the sewage inlet has water flow flowing into the evaporation container or not; the intelligent control module is used for receiving water flow information of the water flow sensor and temperature information of the temperature sensor, when water flow exists, the intelligent control module controls the heater to heat, after the water flow stops, the intelligent control module is combined with the temperature information to judge whether the temperature in the evaporation container reaches the preset evaporation temperature, and when the temperature reaches the preset evaporation temperature, the intelligent control module controls the heater to stop heating. The water in the sewage can be evaporated, the residual dry sediment is small in volume and convenient to transport to a treatment place for centralized scientific treatment, and the water can be recycled when being treated in a centralized way in the place, so that the cost of centralized treatment is reduced.

title_en: Wet dust removal device for industrial waste gas treatment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of industrial waste gas treatment, in particular to a wet dust removal device for industrial waste gas treatment. The invention provides a wet dust removal device for industrial waste gas treatment, which is used for removing an oil film on the inner wall. The wet dust collector for industrial waste gas treatment includes waste gas tower, high pressure nozzle, air inlet pipe, cylinder, annular scraper, collecting ring and guide rod. The annular scraping plate moves upwards to scrape the oil film on the inner wall of the waste gas tower, the scraped oil film falls into the collecting ring to be cleaned, when the annular scraping plate moves downwards and reaches the extension limit of the reset spring, the rubber clamping block is separated from the annular scraping plate, and the filter plate moves to reset under the action of the reset spring, so that vibration is formed to shake off the oil stains attached to the filter plate.

title_en: High-strength high-separation-performance carbon molecular sieve hollow fiber membrane and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-strength high-separation-performance carbon molecular sieve hollow fiber membrane and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) Mixing cellulose acetate, cellulose, an organic solvent and an ionic liquid to prepare a casting solution, and stirring and heating the casting solution; (2) Vacuumizing the casting solution to remove bubbles, and preparing the hollow fiber cellulose acetate membrane by a dry-wet spinning method; (3) Drying hollow fiber cellulose acetate membrane, and lifting under protective atmosphereAnd (3) carbonizing at a temperature to obtain the high-strength high-separation-performance carbon molecular sieve hollow fiber membrane. Compared with the prior art, the carbon molecular sieve hollow fiber membrane has good gas separation performance and high strength. The carbon molecular sieve membrane is used for He/CH  4  Separation, has higher He permeability and He/CH  4  The separation factor has good gas separation performance under high pressure, and provides a new choice for the helium stripping membrane material of natural gas.

title_en: Nitrogen-doped catalyst for removing organic sulfur from metallurgical gas and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a nitrogen-doped catalyst for removing organic sulfur from metallurgical gas, and a preparation method and application thereof, and the nitrogen-doped catalyst comprises the following steps: preparing a mixed solution by taking soluble aluminum salt as a carrier and a nitrogen source compound with a certain proportion, then precipitating completely in an alkaline environment, stirring, ageing, drying, and calcining at a high temperature to obtain nitrogen-doped Al  2  O  3  A catalyst. The catalyst has more nitrogen sites and stronger nitrogen doping capability, so that the basic center of the catalyst is increased, the catalytic activity of catalyzing and eliminating carbonyl sulfide is improved, and H is reduced  2  S adsorption, H is improved  2  S yield, reduced sulfur formation, ensured catalyst activity and stability, and prolonged catalyst life.

title_en: Recovery and disassembly system and method for waste photovoltaic modules
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of waste recovery, in particular to a recovery and disassembly system and method for waste photovoltaic modules, and the technical scheme is characterized by comprising a feeding module, a disassembly module, a transmission module, a high-pressure water cutting module, a low-temperature grinding module, a pyrolysis module and a blanking module; the feeding module is used for moving the photovoltaic module onto the transmission module, the disassembling module is used for separating the junction box, the aluminum alloy frame and the photovoltaic laminated piece of the photovoltaic module, the high-pressure water cutting module is used for cutting the photovoltaic laminated piece and the aluminum alloy frame, the low-temperature grinding module is used for removing the organic silica gel film on the aluminum alloy frame and the backboard of the photovoltaic laminated piece, the pyrolysis module is used for decomposing and removing the photovoltaic laminated piece of the backboard, the adhesive film and the plastic of the junction box, copper materials, silicon chips and glass of the junction box are reserved, and the blanking module is used for classifying the aluminum alloy frame, the copper materials, the silicon chips and the glass.

title_en: Polyaluminium chloride water treatment flocculant and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polyaluminium chloride water treatment flocculant and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of water treatment agents, wherein raw materials comprise polyaluminium chloride, amide modified cellulose, polyacrylamide and activated silicic acid; the polyaluminium chloride is used as a main component, the water quality can be effectively purified, suspended matters in water can be removed, the amide modified cellulose has good bridging and adsorption effects, the complexing of heavy metal ions and the promotion of sedimentation of pollutants are facilitated, the polyacrylamide is further used for increasing flocculation effect, the activated silicic acid is used for improving flocculation effect and the sedimentation performance and compactness of flocs, sulfuric acid half-ester groups are firstly introduced into the amide modified cellulose through sulfuric acid esterification treatment in the preparation process, so that the dispersibility of the cellulose is improved, alkyl phosphate groups are grafted in the subsequent treatment process, the complexing capacity of the amide modified cellulose on heavy metal ions is provided, and finally the removal efficiency of the polyaluminium chloride water treatment flocculant on heavy metal ions in sewage is higher.

title_en: Fire-resistant cable
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-resistant cable, which relates to the technical field of cables, wherein a fire-resistant supporting component is arranged on the outer side of an inner lead, reinforcing wires are arranged in a wrapping layer at two sides of the inner lead in a penetrating manner, a cross pipe is uniformly sleeved in the middle of a central line, an inner insulating layer is wrapped on the outer side of a shielding layer, a spiral pipe is wound on the outer side of the inner insulating layer, a vent hole is formed in the position, close to the end part of the cross pipe, of an inner spiral sheet, and a sealing protection component is arranged on the outer side of the outer insulating layer.

title_en: Intelligent water quality monitoring system and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a water quality intelligent monitoring system and a control method thereof, wherein the water quality intelligent monitoring system can monitor the water quality and the drug concentration of circulating water of the system by communicating a water heat exchange system with a water circulation pipeline and arranging a first water quality monitoring module on the water circulation pipeline; a dosing barrel is arranged, and a dosing flow pump is arranged on the dosing pipeline, so that the drugs can be added according to the quality of the circulating water and the concentration of the drugs; dirt in water can be discharged by arranging a blow-down pipeline and a blow-down valve; the water softener is communicated with the water circulation pipeline through a water inlet pipeline, and a second water quality monitoring module is arranged on the water inlet pipeline, so that the water quality of the inlet water can be detected and improved, and the water quantity of the inlet water is kept stable; the controller can control the working states of the dosing flow pump and the blow-down valve, and control the water supplementing state of the water inlet pipeline according to the monitoring data of the second water quality monitoring module, so that medicine waste is avoided, and the quality of circulating water and the water supply of the system are guaranteed.

title_en: Inductor with dampproofing function
abstract_en: The invention discloses an inductor with a dampproof function, which aims to solve the technical problems that the inside air can circulate through a fan in the use process to achieve the radiating effect, dust and liquid can be filtered through a filter screen in the air inlet process, but the dust can remain on the surface and inside of the filter screen after being filtered, the inside of the filter screen can be blocked by moist air quickly, the fan can not normally exhaust after being blocked for a long time, the performance of the inductor can be reduced due to overheating of the inductor, the filter screen can be more troublesome to clean and the technical problem that the inductor cannot be used in the cleaning process can be solved at the moment.

title_en: A take fire-retardant fire prevention of liquid cooling to fill electric pile cable soon for electric automobile charges
abstract_en: The invention discloses a liquid cooling flame-retardant fireproof quick-charging pile cable for charging an electric automobile, which relates to the technical field of electric automobiles and comprises supporting feet, wherein an auxiliary mechanism is fixedly connected to the opposite side of the top end of each supporting foot, a wire reel is rotatably connected to the opposite side of each auxiliary mechanism, a handle is fixedly connected to one end of each wire reel, a wire is wound on the inner wall of each wire reel, and a charging head is fixedly connected to one end of each wire. After the fire extinguishing liquid is injected into the cavity through the liquid injection groove, at the moment, after short circuit fire is encountered at the butt joint position of the lead and the charging head, the inflammable partition board is firstly melted by the fire point, at the moment, the liquid in the cavity gradually leaks into the opposite sides of the lead and the protective pipe, and meanwhile, the first spring also gradually extends along with the reduction of the fire extinguishing liquid, so that the fire extinguishing liquid in the cavity is pushed into the opposite sides of the protective pipe and the lead from the partition board, and the fire is extinguished and flame-retardant.

title_en: High-density complex for long-acting bottom-modifying disinfection of water body and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-density complex for long-acting bottom-changing disinfection of a water body and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of aquaculture, wherein the high-density complex for long-acting bottom-changing disinfection of the water body is prepared from the following raw materials: small powder premix, potassium hydrogen persulfate, sodium chloride, gelatinized starch, bentonite powder, attapulgite, cement, calcium carbonate, titanate coupling agent, purified water and molasses. The invention also discloses a preparation method of the high-density complex for long-acting bottom-changing disinfection of the water body. The high-density complex for long-acting bottom-modifying disinfection of the water body has the advantages of long duration time, good stability, simple preparation method, low production cost, easiness in large-scale production and the like, fills up the blank of a bottom-modifying product of the slow release, and solves the problems that the slow release rate is difficult to control, the preparation method is complex, the production cost is high, the large-scale production is difficult to realize and the like in the conventional slow release bottom-modifying technology.

title_en: Citronellol pseudomonas strain and application thereof in degradation of mesosulfuron methyl
abstract_en: The invention relates to a citronellol pseudomonas strain D161, wherein the taxonomic name of the citronellol pseudomonas strain D161 is Pseudomonas citronellolis The citronellol pseudomonas D161 has a deposit number of China center for type culture collection: cctccc No: m20232225. The citronellol pseudomonas strain D161 obtained by screening of the invention Pseudomonas    citronellolis D161 The microbial strain has good degradation performance on the mesosulfuron, has important significance on the biological improvement research of the mesosulfuron in the soil, and can provide new strain resources and theoretical basis for improving the residual soil of the mesosulfuron Long Gao by applying microorganisms in the later period. Meanwhile, the citronellol pseudomonas strain D161 is used in the field of fungus and grass and agricultureHas good application potential in the aspect of industrial development and can also be used as a strain of a novel microbial fertilizer.

title_en: Energy storage assembly, control method thereof and refrigeration equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides an energy storage assembly, a control method thereof and refrigeration equipment. The energy storage assembly comprises a shell, wherein an energy storage cavity is formed in the shell; the energy storage unit is arranged in the energy storage cavity; the moisture absorption structure is movably arranged in the energy storage cavity, and the moisture absorption structure and the energy storage unit are mutually attached. According to the energy storage component, the control method thereof and the refrigeration equipment, the moisture absorption structure is utilized to wipe and absorb the condensation in the energy storage unit and the energy storage cavity, so that the condensation is prevented from staying on the energy storage unit and/or in the energy storage cavity, the corrosion of the condensation to the energy storage unit and the energy storage cavity is reduced, the service life of the energy storage component is prolonged, the short circuit caused by the fact that the condensation drops to the wiring end of the energy storage unit and the like can be avoided, and the reliability of the energy storage component and the refrigeration equipment is effectively improved.

title_en: Road surface roll forming device for highway construction
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of highway construction, and discloses a pavement rolling forming device for highway construction, which comprises a vehicle body, wherein one side of the vehicle body is fixedly connected with a mounting frame, one side of the mounting frame is fixedly provided with a cleaning brush, the middle part of the mounting frame is provided with a connecting shaft, the outer side of the connecting shaft is provided with a rolling wheel body and a connecting assembly, and the top of the mounting frame is fixedly provided with a mounting cover. According to the invention, through the cooperation of the structures such as the moving part and the mounting rod, the effect of controlling the flying dust is realized, the driving gear drives the driven gear to rotate, the driven gear drives the first connecting rod, the second connecting rod and the connecting piece to move, the connecting piece drives the mounting rod to move, moisture in the moving part flows down through the through hole of the fixing plate, and the water of the moving part is mixed with the flying dust sucked into the inner cavity of the fixing box, so that the flying dust is pressed down, and the flying dust is prevented from accumulating on the surface of the visible glass of the vehicle body and damaging the body of an operator.

title_en: N for CO selective catalytic reduction 2 Monolithic catalyst of O and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for CO selective catalytic reduction of N  2  The monolithic catalyst of O and the preparation method thereof comprise the following components in parts by weight: titanium dioxide 8-10 parts, beta molecular sieve 6-8 parts, cuO  X  、FeO  X  5-7 parts of oxide active powder, 3-5 parts of attapulgite clay, 4-6 parts of glass fiber, 2-4 parts of silica sol, 1-2 parts of oxalic acid, 1-2 parts of stearic acid, 2-3 parts of hydroxypropyl methylcellulose, 1-2 parts of PEO, 2-3 parts of glycerol, 1-2 parts of propylene glycol and 1-2 parts of alkyl polymethylsiloxane. The invention not only has the processingThe method has the technical advantages of low temperature, low use cost, reliable treatment process and the like, and the integral catalyst adopts the honeycomb catalyst process of extrusion molding, has the characteristics of simple production process, long service life, good reaction activity, low pressure drop, large treated flue gas air quantity and the like, and can effectively treat the catalyst containing N  2  And removing O smoke.

title_en: Method for improving the application of catalytically active coating to honeycomb bodies
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for producing a device for exhaust gas aftertreatment and for applying a catalytically active surface coating to a honeycomb body (1) arranged in the device, wherein the honeycomb body (1) is formed from a plurality of at least partially structured metal foils which are stacked on top of one another and wound such that the honeycomb body forms a plurality of flow channels which can flow through in a main flow direction, the honeycomb body is received in an inner jacket (2) and permanently connected thereto, the inner jacket (2) is arranged in an outer jacket (6) serving as a housing and permanently connected thereto, and one or more interspaces (7) formed between the outer jacket (6) and components arranged in the outer jacket are filled with a filling material (8) before the catalytically active coating is applied to the flow channels formed by the honeycomb body (1).

title_en: Dynamic water balance monitoring system for water system in power industry
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic water balance monitoring system for a water system in the power industry, which relates to the technical field of the water system in the power industry.

title_en: Condensation separator, tail water removal system, control method and fuel cell vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a condensation separator, a tail drainage water removal system, a control method and a fuel cell vehicle, wherein the condensation separator comprises a condensation shell, an inlet and an outlet are arranged at the upper end of the condensation shell along the height direction, a liquid collecting tank and a liquid outlet communicated with the liquid collecting tank are arranged at the lower end of the condensation shell along the height direction, a descending condensation pipeline and an ascending condensation pipeline are fixedly arranged on the condensation shell, the descending condensation pipeline and the ascending condensation pipeline are distributed between the inlet and the liquid collecting tank along the height direction of the condensation shell, and the inlet, the descending condensation pipeline, the liquid collecting tank, the ascending condensation pipeline and the outlet are sequentially communicated; the speed that the tail gas flowed through the decline condensation pipeline can be adjusted to the velocity of flow speed adjustment structure and tail gas flow through the ascending condensation pipeline be different. The condensation separator has good effect of condensing and separating water and high efficiency of condensing and separating water.

title_en: High-efficient whirl spray type industrial waste gas treatment equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of waste gas treatment, in particular to high-efficiency rotational flow spraying type industrial waste gas treatment equipment which comprises a plurality of supporting feet, a treatment box, a circulating assembly, a spraying assembly and a filtering mechanism, wherein the filtering mechanism comprises a filtering box, a treatment plate, a handle and two groups of sliding assemblies, each group of sliding assemblies comprises a sliding rail and two sliding blocks, the filtering box is arranged above the circulating assembly, the treatment plate is movably connected with the filtering box, the two groups of sliding assemblies are symmetrically arranged in the filtering box, the sliding rails are fixedly connected with the filtering box, the two sliding blocks are movably connected with the sliding rails, the treatment plate is fixedly connected with the two sliding blocks, and the handle is fixedly connected with the treatment plate.

title_en: Efficient solid atmospheric carbon capturing material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a high-efficiency solid atmospheric carbon capture material, which comprises the following steps: firstly, adding titanate cross-linking agents into an organic solvent to obtain impregnating solution; secondly, adding the zirconium dioxide carrier into the impregnating solution for full impregnation, and drying, roasting and grinding to obtain a first product; and finally, adding the first product into an aqueous solution of potassium carbonate for full impregnation, and then drying, roasting, grinding and screening to obtain the high-efficiency solid atmospheric carbon capture material. The high-efficiency solid atmospheric carbon capture material prepared by the invention has the advantages of stable structure, uniform component dispersion, large adsorption capacity, strong carbon dioxide selectivity, good cycle stability and the like, can be used for directly capturing carbon dioxide in air, reduces the adsorption temperature and the desorption temperature of a potassium-based adsorbent, and meets the requirement of low energy consumption for air capture. The carbon capturing material also has the advantages of simple preparation method, low raw material and preparation cost, easy mass production and the like, and has wide popularization and application prospects.

title_en: Self-cleaning wastewater treatment device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wastewater treatment, in particular to a self-cleaning wastewater treatment device which comprises a barrel, a driving mechanism, a water conveying pipeline, a smoke conveying pipeline and an outlet pipeline, wherein the driving mechanism is used for driving the barrel to rotate, the water conveying pipeline is used for conveying water into the barrel, the smoke conveying pipeline is used for introducing smoke into the barrel through an inlet of the barrel, the outlet pipeline is connected with an outlet of the barrel, a plurality of wing-shaped blades are arranged in the outlet pipeline, and abrasive materials are arranged in the barrel. By utilizing the self-cleaning wastewater treatment device, in practical application, the treatment efficiency of high-salt wastewater can be effectively improved through the combined action of the cylinder body, the driving mechanism, the water conveying pipeline, the smoke conveying pipeline and the outlet pipeline, and the inside of the cylinder body and the wing-shaped blades cannot be scaled, so that the wastewater treatment device can be ensured to continuously carry out high-efficiency treatment on the wastewater.

title_en: Initial rainwater treatment system and use method
abstract_en: The invention provides an initial rainwater treatment system and a use method thereof, and relates to the field of sewage treatment. This initial rainwater processing system, including intelligent vatch basin, there is high-efficient quick filter A type intelligent vatch basin through the pipe connection, the one end that intelligent vatch basin was kept away from to high-efficient quick filter A type has sponge clean system through the pipe connection, sponge clean system keeps away from the one end of high-efficient quick filter A type and has high-efficient quick filter B type through the pipe connection, the one end that sponge clean system was kept away from to high-efficient quick filter B type has river course purification corridor through the pipe connection, the other end of river course purification corridor is through drainage pipe connection river course. Through rainy period and non-rainy period, handle different operation modes of rainwater and river course water, improve the utilization ratio of handling facilities on the one hand. On the other hand, the purification effect of the existing ecological restoration method is improved, so that the purification effect of the polluted water body is comprehensively improved, and various costs are reduced.

title_en: Ditch detection dredging equipment for hydraulic engineering
abstract_en: The invention discloses ditch detection dredging equipment for hydraulic engineering, which comprises a dredging device, a movable base and a rolling device, wherein the rolling device is fixedly arranged on the outer surface of the upper end of the movable base, and the dredging device is movably arranged at the lower part of the front end of the movable base; the dredging device comprises a middle casing and two groups of telescopic covers, wherein the telescopic covers are movably arranged on the inner sides of two ends of the middle casing, the inner sides of the front ends of the middle casing are obliquely arranged in a V shape, and the inner sides of the telescopic covers are fixedly provided with filter plates; the inside of the roller press is movably provided with a conveying belt and two groups of roller press cylinders, the two groups of roller press cylinders are movably arranged on the outer surface of the upper end of the conveying belt, and the whole conveying belt is obliquely arranged; the device has a downward detection type river dredging structure, so that the device can finish dredging operation of the ditch under the condition that the device does not enter the ditch, the operation difficulty is reduced, meanwhile, the device can be correspondingly adjusted according to the width of the ditch, the single dredging effect is improved, and the residue of sludge is reduced.

title_en: Intelligent sampling system in chemical reaction process
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent sampling system in a chemical reaction process, and belongs to the technical field of sampling. The system disclosed by the invention comprises a polymerization unit, a viscosity measurement unit, a sampling unit, a receiving and tail gas treatment unit, a control system and a purging and cleaning unit, can realize sampling detection of sampling materials with different viscosity ranges in the sampling unit, can directly sample according to different viscosity feedback signals of the control system in the polymerization reaction process, has an intelligent control system integrating viscosity measurement, sampling, cleaning and purging, can sample materials with wide viscosity range and is applicable to materials with viscosity of 1-100000 centipoise, avoids the phenomena of material blockage and cooling solidification which occur easily in the existing sampling system, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Intelligent SCR denitration wind control system for cement kiln
abstract_en: The application relates to an intelligent SCR denitration accuse wind system for cement kiln, flue gas velocity and temperature distribution's uniformity degree control around according to the SCR reactor guide layer, automatically regulated gets into flue gas flow and temperature distribution in each region of reactor catalyst, improves the accuse wind system of flue gas distribution uniformity, and the intelligent SCR denitration accuse wind system that this application provided can be according to actual condition intelligent regulation, improves flow field and temperature uniformity in the SCR reactor, improves denitration efficiency.

title_en: Physical oil removal and impurity removal general treatment process
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wastewater treatment, in particular to a physical degreasing and impurity removal universal treatment process, wherein treatment equipment adopted by the treatment process comprises a degreasing and impurity removal device, the degreasing and impurity removal device comprises a coarse filtration water inlet unit, a horizontal sewage tank, a degreasing and water purification unit, a buffer tank and an aeration unit connected with the horizontal sewage tank, which are sequentially arranged from left to right.

title_en: Sectional spheroidizing furnace for producing spherical alumina powder
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sectional spheroidizing furnace for producing spherical alumina powder, belonging to the technical field of alumina powder manufacturing, and comprising a spheroidizing annealing furnace. According to the scheme, through the cooperation of the memory alloy wire and the brush plate, water vapor can pass through the memory alloy wire and heat the memory alloy wire near the first belt pulley in the process of passing through the exhaust holes, the heated memory alloy wire has a tendency of stretching rapidly, but the first belt pulley and the second belt pulley have a constraint function on the memory alloy wire, then the memory alloy wire can be enabled to rotate under the constraint function, namely, the memory alloy wire can drive the first belt pulley to rotate in the process of passing through the exhaust holes by the water vapor, then the brush is driven to rotate by the rotating rod and the brush plate in the process of rotating the first belt pulley and clean dust particles on the surface of the filter screen, and a user does not need to frequently replace the filter screen, so that the cooling efficiency is improved.

title_en: Device for removing sulfur-containing dust of boiler
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for removing sulfur-containing dust from a boiler, which comprises a purifying box, wherein a spraying mechanism is arranged in the purifying box, a dust removing mechanism is arranged on the left side of the purifying box, an adjusting mechanism is arranged on the right side of the purifying box, and a circulating mechanism is arranged above the purifying box; the spraying mechanism comprises a spraying part and a stirring part; the spraying part is positioned above the stirring part; the spray part comprises a water tank, a vent pipe, a water outlet pipe, a water spraying pipe and a spray head, wherein the top surface of the water tank is provided with a water inlet in a penetrating way, the bottom surface of the water tank is fixedly connected with the top surface of the purifying tank, and the water outlet pipe is positioned in the water tank. The invention has the characteristics of strong practicability, detecting the PH of the used solution by arranging the adjusting mechanism, adjusting the PH of the used solution to achieve the effect of secondary utilization, fully mixing and stirring the solution in the adjusting box, and facilitating secondary use of the mixed solution.

title_en: Energy-saving electrical equipment cabinet
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electrical equipment, in particular to an energy-saving electrical equipment cabinet which comprises a double-layer clamping plate, a top plate, a single-layer plate, a rear plate, a door and a bottom plate, wherein the double-layer clamping plate, the top plate, the single-layer plate, the rear plate, the door and the bottom plate are combined to form an equipment cabinet body; the double-layer clamping plate is divided into an inner plate and an outer plate, the top of one side of the inner plate far away from the outer plate is fixedly connected with a top plate, the bottom of one end of the top plate far away from the inner plate is fixedly connected with a single-layer plate, the top of one side of the single-layer plate close to the inner plate is fixedly connected with a cross beam, the other end of the cross beam is fixedly connected with the inner plate, one end of the double-layer clamping plate is fixedly connected with a rear plate, the other end of the double-layer clamping plate is movably connected with a door, and the bottom of the double-layer clamping plate is fixedly connected with a bottom plate.

title_en: Water production automatic control system based on ultrafiltration membrane
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultrafiltration membrane-based automatic water production control system, which comprises a water inlet pipeline, a membrane tank, a backwash water tank and a clean water tank, wherein the water inlet pipeline is connected with the membrane tank; the water production automatic control system includes: the collecting unit is used for collecting the real-time flow of the water inlet pipeline, the first liquid level information of the membrane tank, the second liquid level information of the clean water tank, the third liquid level information of the backwash water tank and the real-time pressure of the backwash pipeline; the constant-flow water inlet unit is used for controlling the water inlet amount of the water inlet pipeline according to the real-time flow and the first liquid level information; the constant liquid level water purifying unit is used for controlling the water discharge of the membrane pool according to the first liquid level information, the second liquid level information and the third liquid level information; the back flushing unit is used for automatically cleaning the ultrafiltration membrane in the automatic water production control system according to the real-time pressure. The invention can realize high-efficiency stable water purification by the automatic water production control system, and can reduce the energy consumption for cleaning the ultrafiltration membrane and shorten the cleaning time on the premise of not influencing the water purification effect and ensuring the flux of the ultrafiltration membrane.

title_en: Water treatment method and water treatment system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of water treatment, discloses a water treatment method and a water treatment system, and solves the technical problems of longer process and higher energy consumption in wastewater hydrogen production. The method comprises the following steps: pretreating the wastewater to obtain electrolyte with solid content, salt content and pH meeting electrolysis requirements; and (3) introducing the electrolyte into an electrolytic tank of the electrolytic hydrogen production device for electrolytic treatment, and decomposing organic matters in the electrolyte and generating hydrogen. The system comprises: the pretreatment unit is used for pretreating the wastewater to obtain electrolyte with solid content, salt content and pH meeting electrolysis requirements; the electrolytic hydrogen production unit is used for carrying out electrolytic treatment on the electrolyte to decompose organic matters in the electrolyte and generate hydrogen; the electrolytic hydrogen production unit comprises an electrolytic hydrogen production device, and the electrolytic hydrogen production device comprises an electrolytic tank shell, an anode and a cathode; the cathode adopts a sintered metal porous material, and the metal elements of the sintered metal porous material are composed of Ni and V, and the metal elements mainly exist as intermetallic compounds.
