title_en: For CO2Mineral composition with antimicrobial properties for mineralization and oxidation of volatile compounds
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition comprising a mixture of mineral components selected from mineral silicates and igneous rocks, metal oxides and hydroxides having a specific composition. The invention also relates to a building product, article or element comprising said composition, the use of said building composition, product, article or element for mineralization of carbon dioxide and/or oxidation of volatile compounds under ambient temperature and pressure conditions, and the use of said building composition, product, article or element for preventing, reducing or eliminating the presence and/or activity of microorganisms in a substrate. Furthermore, the invention relates to a method for producing said building composition, product, article or element, and a method for mineralizing carbon dioxide and/or oxidizing volatile compounds under ambient temperature and pressure conditions.

title_en: Kitchen waste-household garbage treatment plant biogas power generation waste heat utilization system and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biogas power generation waste heat utilization, and particularly relates to a system and a method for utilizing biogas power generation waste heat of a kitchen waste-household garbage treatment plant. The technical proposal is as follows: the kitchen waste-household garbage treatment plant biogas power generation waste heat utilization system comprises a biogas purification unit, a double-film biogas storage cabinet, a booster fan and a biogas generating set which are sequentially connected, wherein a flue gas pipeline of the biogas generating set is respectively connected with a first flue gas heat exchanger and a second flue gas heat exchanger, a primary air flue gas pipeline of the first flue gas heat exchanger is connected with a primary air flue gas-air preheater, and a kitchen slurry pipeline of the second flue gas heat exchanger is connected with a kitchen slurry heating tank; and a cylinder sleeve water pipeline of the biogas generator set is connected with a cylinder sleeve water heat exchanger, and a condensation water pipeline of the cylinder sleeve water heat exchanger is connected with a condensation water low-pressure heater. The invention provides a biogas power generation waste heat utilization system and method for a kitchen waste-household waste co-treatment plant.

title_en: Quaternary phosphonium ionic eutectic solvent for absorbing acid gas
abstract_en: The invention relates to a quaternary phosphonium ionic eutectic solvent for absorbing acid gas, belonging to the technical field of gas separation and purification. The quaternary phosphonium ionic eutectic solvent is a mixture composed of the quaternary phosphonium nitrogen heterocyclic ionic liquid and the quaternary phosphonium halide ionic liquid which are solid at room temperature, so that the solidifying point and viscosity of the single ionic liquid are obviously reduced, and the problems of poor flowability, high gas absorption mass transfer resistance and the like of the solid quaternary phosphonium nitrogen heterocyclic ionic liquid with good thermal stability are solved. The eutectic solvent has the characteristics of good thermal stability, low toxicity, high absorption, excellent desorption performance and the like. The invention provides a new thought for the development of the acid gas absorbent and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Polyaniline/titanium carbide/graphene oxide ternary nanocomposite and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of heavy metal pollution treatment, in particular to a polyaniline/titanium carbide/graphene oxide ternary nanocomposite and a preparation method and application thereof. Adding titanium carbide colloid solution into graphene oxide dispersion liquid, uniformly mixing, adding aniline into graphene oxide-titanium carbide mixed solution under the condition of stirring, reacting at room temperature, soaking and drying the obtained solid after the reaction is completed, thus obtaining the polyaniline/titanium carbide/graphene oxide ternary nanocomposite. According to the invention, polyaniline is utilized to modify titanium carbide and graphene oxide, and the polyaniline/titanium carbide/graphene oxide ternary nanocomposite is prepared by an electrostatic self-assembly method. The surface of the polyaniline modified nanocomposite material has positive charges under the defined pH condition, so that the adsorption capacity of hexavalent chromium anions is improved, and the hexavalent chromium anions are removed.

title_en: Solid waste processing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a processing and treating method of solid waste, which relates to the technical field of solid waste treatment and aims to solve the problem of lower incineration efficiency caused by excessive moisture in the prior solid waste incineration process, and the technical scheme is as follows: s1, compressing, namely compressing the classified solid waste into a rectangular solid briquette with a central hole on the surface through a compressing device, and reducing the water content in the solid waste through compression; s2, preheating, and enabling the compressed solid briquettes to fall into a drying box for preheating, so that the temperature of the solid briquettes is increased, and the moisture contained in the solid briquettes is further reduced.

title_en: Multistage sewage treatment system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multistage sewage treatment system which comprises a main body unit, wherein the main body unit comprises a filter box, a disinfection box is arranged on the lower side of the filter box, a flocculating agent box is arranged on one side of the disinfection box, a stirring box is arranged on the upper side of the flocculating agent box, a sewage injection pipe is arranged on the upper side surface of the stirring box, a water inlet pipe matched with the stirring box is arranged on one side of the filter box, and a control panel is arranged on one side of the flocculating agent box. According to the invention, the rotating shaft and the first gear are driven to rotate by the slow motor, and dirt in sewage is carried up by matching with the grooves of the filter tube, so that the brush roller cleans dirt adhered to the inner wall of the filter tube, the outer ring rack plate meshed with the inner ring rack plate is fixedly connected to the surface of the first rotating plate, and then three groups of brush rollers can be rotated and replaced, thus not only is the cleaning effect of the dirt effectively improved, but also the brush roller has self-cleaning capability, and the service life of the brush roller is prolonged.

title_en: Oil gas recovery processing system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of oil gas recovery, in particular to an oil gas recovery treatment system; the device comprises a base plate and an annular shell which is rotationally and hermetically connected in an annular groove on the upper surface of the base plate; the opening of the annular shell faces downwards; the center of the base plate is fixedly connected with a motor; the motor output shaft is fixedly connected with the annular shell through a connecting rod; the inside of the annular shell is divided into a plurality of recovery cavities by evenly distributed partition plates; the side wall of the base plate is fixedly connected with an air inlet pipe communicated with the bottom of the annular groove; the bottom wall of the base plate is fixedly connected with a vacuum desorption tank; the liquid inlet pipe and the return pipe of the vacuum desorption tank are communicated with the bottom of the annular groove, and span of a plurality of recovery cavities is formed; according to the invention, the mixed liquid and the waste gas in the recovery cavity are completely discharged, so that the absorbent and the oil gas are injected, and the oil gas recovery efficiency in the recovery cavity is greatly improved under the condition that the absorbent is in mixed contact with the oil gas under the matching quantity and only the absorbent and the oil gas are in the recovery cavity.

title_en: Battery device for reducing operating temperature
abstract_en: The invention relates to a battery device for reducing working temperature, which comprises a shell, a battery module, a fan device, an inner connecting pipe and an outer connecting pipe. The shell comprises an accommodating space for accommodating the battery module, the fan device and the inner and outer connecting pipes, and at least one interval space is formed between the battery module and the shell. The outer connecting pipe is arranged outside the inner connecting pipe, and an air guide channel is formed between the outer connecting pipe and the inner connecting pipe. One end of the connecting tube faces the driving part of the fan device, and the other end is connected with the battery module. One end of the air guide channel faces to the blade part of the fan device, and the other end is connected with the spacing space. The cooling air flow generated by the fan device is conveyed to the interval space through the air guide channel and takes away heat generated by the battery module so as to reduce the temperature of the battery equipment.

title_en: Method for removing sulfate radical in wastewater by bipolar membrane electrodialysis membrane stack
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of wastewater treatment, and relates to a method for removing sulfate radical in wastewater by using a bipolar membrane electrodialysis membrane stack, wherein a bipolar membrane electrodialysis device with a three-compartment structure is adopted, the membrane stack comprises an acid chamber, a middle chamber and a mixing chamber which are formed by 2 bipolar membranes and 2 anion exchange membranes at intervals, and an electrode plate and bipolar membranes at two sides of the membrane stack form an electrode liquid chamber; each compartment is connected with a corresponding container through a pump respectively; introducing wastewater into a mixing chamber of a bipolar membrane electrodialysis device, wherein an acid chamber and an intermediate chamber of the bipolar membrane electrodialysis device are deionized water, the polar liquid of a polar liquid chamber is 0.05-0.25 mol/L sulfate solution, the operating voltage is 9-15V, and the flow rate is 1.5 mL-5.5 mL/s; opening a peristaltic pump to set a flow rate value; starting a direct current power supply, setting target voltage, and operating the bipolar membrane electrodialysis device; in the process, monitoring a current value and conductivity; and when the current value is unchanged, changing the sulfate wastewater in the mixing chamber. Compared with the existing bipolar membrane electrodialysis membrane stack, the current efficiency is improved, the desalination rate is improved, and the energy consumption is reduced.

title_en: Wastewater treatment device for livestock breeding
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sewage treatment, in particular to a wastewater treatment device for livestock cultivation, which comprises a wastewater sedimentation tank, a support frame, a rotating sleeve, a synchronizing ring, a power rod and a suction assembly, wherein the support frame is arranged at the top of the wastewater sedimentation tank, and specifically, the support frame is horizontally arranged left and right, and two ends of the support frame are respectively and correspondingly fixedly connected with the left and right inner side walls of the wastewater sedimentation tank. The invention is provided with the suction component, the flow of wastewater flow is influenced by the reciprocating suction of the suction component, so that power is generated to drive the rotating sleeve to rotate, the rotating speed of the rotating sleeve is inversely related to the solid matter amount in wastewater, when the solid matter amount in wastewater is large, the rotating sleeve rotates at a low speed, generated flocculates are prevented from being scattered, when the solid matter amount in wastewater is small, the rotating speed of the rotating sleeve is increased, and the flocculant is promoted to contact with the solid matters through the rapid rotation of the rotating sleeve, so that the generation of the flocculates is promoted, and meanwhile, the purification rate of the wastewater is improved.

title_en: Spectrum stabilization method, apparatus, electronic device and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of ray detection, and particularly discloses a spectrum stabilization method, a spectrum stabilization device, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium. The spectrum stabilization method comprises the following steps: obtaining a standard energy spectrum; detecting a target object through a detector and collecting pulse signals to obtain an energy spectrum to be corrected; acquiring the association degree of a standard energy spectrum and an energy spectrum to be corrected; and if the association degree does not meet the preset condition, adjusting the working parameters of the detector, and returning to the step of collecting the pulse signals until the association degree meets the preset condition. The correlation degree of the energy spectrum to be corrected and the standard energy spectrum is used as a judgment standard of the stable spectrum, and the characteristic peak of the energy spectrum to be corrected is not required to be relied on for carrying out the stable spectrum, so that the spectrum stabilizing effect of the energy spectrum without obvious characteristic peak is improved, and the energy spectrum stabilizing method is also suitable for the energy spectrum with obvious characteristic peak.

title_en: Method for rapidly starting anaerobic ammonia oxidation by using biological induction crystallization strategy
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of wastewater treatment, and provides a method for rapidly starting anaerobic ammonia oxidation by utilizing a biological induction crystallization strategy, which comprises the following steps: inoculating anaerobic digestion granular sludge and anaerobic ammonia oxidation granular sludge with the volume ratio of 1-3:1-3 in an anaerobic internal circulation reactor, and starting an anaerobic ammonia oxidation process by adopting an artificial wastewater synthesizing mode for inflow. The invention not only provides a new method for the rapid start of the anaerobic ammonia oxidation process, but also provides a new way for the denitrification and the phosphorus recovery of autotrophs.

title_en: DIN binding post's looped netowrk cabinet can be dismantled to split type of high voltage insulation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power equipment and discloses a ring main unit with a high-voltage insulation split type detachable DIN wiring terminal. The invention realizes better shock absorption and buffering, solves the problems that when vibration occurs in the using process, the shock absorption and buffering cannot be performed, so that electronic element joints inside the ring main unit are easy to loosen, and poor line contact is caused, and the dust screen can be cleaned while the shock absorption and buffering are performed, so that the dust screen is effectively prevented from being blocked, the working efficiency of the ring main unit is improved, and a buffering mechanism can be locked in the process of installing electronic elements or maintaining, so that the ring main unit can work better, and the convenience is improved.

title_en: Magnetic control recyclable oil collecting device and method based on hydrophobic oleophilic magnetic particles
abstract_en: The invention discloses a magnetic control recyclable oil collecting device and method based on hydrophobic oleophilic magnetic particles, relates to the technical field of oil-water separation, and solves the problem that the existing oil collecting mode of throwing oil absorbing materials in a large area is high in cost and easy to cause secondary pollution. The invention comprises an oil collecting tank, a plurality of magnets and a plurality of adsorption separation discs, wherein a floating module is arranged outside the oil collecting tank, and two raw material throwing areas are symmetrically arranged at two ends inside the oil collecting tank; two adsorption areas and two desorption separation areas are symmetrically arranged in the center of the middle of the two raw material throwing areas; the magnet is arranged above the adsorption separation disc, and the magnetic oleophilic particles are adsorbed on the lower surface of the adsorption separation disc through the magnet. According to the invention, the magnet is used for circulating the magnetic oleophylic particles in the adsorption area and the desorption separation area, so that oil-water separation is directly finished from the water surface, and automatic collection of oil is realized; meanwhile, the oil collecting device floats on the water surface and can realize large-range oil collection along with the flow of water.

title_en: Biological filter membrane hanging method applied to seawater circulating aquaculture system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a biological filter membrane hanging method applied to a seawater circulating water culture system, which is characterized in that a nutrient source is reasonably supplemented and a strain is added to the seawater circulating water culture system, and ammonium bicarbonate is added according to the total alkalinity of a water body; the ammonia nitrogen and nitrite concentration in the water body is monitored at regular time so as to adjust the feed addition at any time, and the concentration of NO  2   ‑  -N is reduced to less than or equal to 0.5mg/L by matching with corresponding temperature and duration control, so that the biological filter membrane hanging is successful; on the premise that the water temperature is kept at 26 ℃, the time for film formation is 16-20 days; then gradually connecting the culture pond into a water treatment system to participate in circulating water culture; and then according to the concentration of NO  2   ‑  -N in the water body, the culture ponds are connected into the seawater circulating aquaculture system one by one until the culture ponds are completely integrated to participate in circulating aquaculture. The invention is particularly suitable for a seawater circulating water culture system, realizes a film forming technology with the characteristics of simplicity and short period, improves the combination degree of culture production and improves the culture efficiency.

title_en: Quick radiating lithium cell
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of lithium batteries, in particular to a lithium battery capable of rapidly radiating, which comprises a battery shell, wherein a blade battery is arranged in the battery shell, a mounting mechanism is arranged on the battery shell, a protection mechanism is arranged on the mounting mechanism, a radiating mechanism is arranged on the battery shell, a flow guiding mechanism is arranged in the battery shell, a filtering mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the battery shell, and a supporting mechanism is arranged on one side of the battery shell; through installation mechanism and cooling mechanism cooperation, do benefit to and install the protection to a plurality of equidistance distribution's blade battery to dispel the heat to blade battery, drive protection mechanism through installation mechanism, make installation mechanism locking control, do benefit to the fine derivation with the heat through guiding mechanism, reduced thermal accumulation and influenced the radiating effect.

title_en: Textile fabric processing spraying dust suppression device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a spraying dust suppression device for textile fabric processing, which belongs to the technical field of dust removal equipment of textile workshops and aims to solve the problems that the dust suppression and humidification effects are affected by water pressure reduction, and the spraying dust suppression effect is poor when water leakage occurs at the joint of a spray head and a pipeline.

title_en: Ordered mesoporous structure framework domain-limited rare earth-based denitration catalyst and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ordered mesoporous structure framework domain-limited rare earth-based denitration catalyst and a preparation method thereof. The catalyst has a regular ordered mesoporous structure, the specific surface area is 100-500 m  2 /g, the aperture is 2-12 nm, the particle size of the rare earth nano particles is 2-20 nm and is uniformly distributed in an ordered mesoporous TiO  2  framework, and the agglomeration growth phenomenon is not generated after high-temperature calcination. The catalyst comprises the following components in percentage by mass: ceO  2 （0.5-20 wt.%）,WO 3 （0-8 wt.%）,SnO 2 （0-8 wt.%）,TiO 2  (64-99.5 wt.%). Compared with the existing rare earth-based denitration catalyst, the ordered mesoporous structure framework domain-limited rare earth-based denitration catalyst prepared by the invention has the characteristics of low working temperature (180-420 ℃), high denitration efficiency (> 80%), strong sulfur resistance, no secondary environmental pollution and the like, and has good application prospect in the field of flue gas denitration in the non-electric industry.

title_en: Shaddock peel adsorbent and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of chemistry, in particular to a shaddock peel adsorbent and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the shaddock peel adsorbent comprises the following steps: boiling shaddock peel in water; washing the boiled shaddock peel to be neutral; soaking the washed neutral shaddock peel in 0.1-0.5mol/L calcium chloride solution, and then performing ultrasonic treatment at 65-75deg.C and power of 60-70 Hz; washing the ultrasonic shaddock peel again to be neutral and drying; and finally, crushing the dried shaddock peel, and filtering the crushed shaddock peel by using a 8-80 mesh sieve to obtain the shaddock peel adsorbent. The shaddock peel adsorbent has good adsorption performance on nicotine, can adsorb nicotine in smoke dust, reduces harm to human body and pollution to environment, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: System and method for purifying water body by coupling denitrification of plants, bacteria and algae
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of denitrification and ecological restoration of water bodies, and discloses a system and a method for purifying water bodies by utilizing plant, fungus and algae coupling denitrification. The system comprises a water inlet pipe, a microalgae growth pond, an algae bacteria pond, a water inlet plant pond, a main reaction pond and a water outlet pond which are connected in sequence; the water inlet plant pool, the main reaction pool and the water outlet pool are respectively and independently provided with plants with denitrifying bacteria; the main reaction tank comprises an oxygen eliminating tank, a facultative anaerobic tank and an anoxic tank which are connected in sequence; the main reaction tank is also provided with a bacterial liquid return pipe, and the bacterial liquid return pipe is connected with an inlet of the algae bacterial liquid tank. The system and the method realize natural sustainable supply of the carbon source, have stable operation and high reliability, and have stronger impact load resistance.

title_en: Tobacco discharged high-temperature high-humidity waste gas treatment device and comprehensive treatment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tobacco discharged high-temperature high-humidity waste gas treatment device and a comprehensive treatment method, comprising a water tank, a washing tower, a gas transmission pipe and a tank body, wherein the water tank is arranged at the bottom of the outer wall of the washing tower, the top of the outer wall of the washing tower is provided with a gas pipe in a penetrating mode, the other end of the gas pipe is provided with a box body, and the top of the water tank is provided with a water pump. According to the invention, the water flow in the water tank can be cooled through the arrangement of the refrigerating sheet assembly, the water flow is conveyed into the spray pipe through the water suction pipe and the water delivery pipe through the water pump, and is sprayed out through the atomization spray nozzle, so that the high-temperature and high-humidity waste gas entering the washing tower from the air inlet pipe can be cooled, meanwhile, atomized water drops can remove particles in the waste gas and fall into the sewage pipe at the bottom of the washing tower, and the sprayed water flow can flow into the water tank again through the arrangement of the circulating water inlet pipe and the filter screen, so that the cyclic utilization of the sprayed water flow can be ensured.

title_en: Scrapped cigarette holder filter element and tipping paper separating equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a scrapped cigarette holder filter element and tipping paper separating device, which comprises a stock ordering mechanism, a feeding and cutting mechanism, an extrusion separating mechanism and a blowing recycling mechanism; the material storage sequencing mechanism comprises a feeding box, and a sequencing assembly is arranged in a feeding hopper at the top of the feeding box; the feeding cutting mechanism comprises a feeding guide rail, the feeding guide rail comprises a cutting section and a receiving section, the receiving section of the feeding guide rail stretches into a blanking channel of the feeding box, a receiving opening of the receiving section of the feeding guide rail is used for receiving a cigarette holder falling down from the blanking channel, a cutting assembly is sleeved on the cutting section of the feeding guide rail, and the surface of the cigarette holder in the conveying process is cut through a plurality of cutters of the cutting assembly; the extrusion separation mechanism comprises an extrusion stirring assembly; the blowing recovery mechanism comprises a separation plate and a fan which are arranged in the recovery box, and the inner space of the recovery box is separated into two relatively independent areas through the separation plate. The invention has the advantages that: realizing the high-efficiency separation of tipping paper and filter element of the scrapped filter tip.

title_en: Soil remediation technology based on organic matter pollution treatment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a soil remediation process based on organic matter pollution treatment, which relates to the technical field of soil remediation and comprises the following steps: s1, ridging and blocking; s2, reinforcing the side part; s3, sectional material covering; s4, synchronously digging pits. The multi-layer soil structure that first grade shovel head, second grade shovel head and tertiary shovel head were shoveled combines the reinforcement of the mixed adsorption material of external pressure board to beat to make the lateral part of soil ridge be consolidated by the multilayer and improved the structural strength of soil ridge, and the adsorption material is beaten to the soil ridge side by the multilayer, thereby make soil ridge side multilayer structure mix the adsorption material and can make the lateral part of soil ridge keep apart by the adsorption material, and then reduced the migration of soil ridge internal pollutant, and the holding down plate compacts the mixed adsorption material in the bottom of separating the ditch, the unexpected pollutant gathering that flows into separating the ditch inside has likewise been reduced, later plant the adsorption plant in the hole of digging the shovel, thereby make the adsorption plant can keep apart the adsorption material and the side adsorbs through the soil ridge internal pollutant that multilayer structure consolidates.

title_en: Flocculation reactor capable of flocculating rapidly
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of sewage flocculation treatment, and particularly relates to a flocculation reactor capable of quickly flocculating, which comprises flocculation reaction equipment, wherein the flocculation reaction equipment comprises a base, a plurality of reaction tanks, a plurality of observation cavities, a plurality of sewage pipes and a plurality of drainage pipes; the inside of the reaction tanks is provided with a sewage flocculation mechanism which comprises a motor, a rotating shaft, stirring blades and two flocculant pipes; a plurality of equal fixed mounting in the base in reaction tank, a plurality of observe the chamber respectively fixed mounting in the top of a plurality of reaction tanks, and communicate each other, a plurality of the sewage pipe respectively with the internal connection of a plurality of reaction tanks, a plurality of the drain pipe respectively with the internal connection of a plurality of reaction tanks, motor fixed mounting is in the inner wall of observing the chamber, and the device rocks sewage, intermittent type formula and discharges the flocculating agent through the speed of control stirring sewage about, to promote the flocculation efficiency of sewage greatly.

title_en: Chemical oxidation-chelation method for in-situ remediation of organic matter-heavy metal combined contaminated soil
abstract_en: The invention provides a chemical oxidation-chelation method for in-situ remediation of organic matter-heavy metal composite contaminated soil, which comprises the following steps: s1) crushing the collected organic matter-heavy metal composite polluted soil, and detecting the heavy metal content and the organic pollutant content in the polluted soil; s2) preparing a high-efficiency oxidation-chelation repairing agent with the solid content of 20-50%, wherein the oxidation-chelation repairing agent comprises high-activity oxidizing agents such as sodium percarbonate, sodium percarbonate stabilizer, pH regulator, surfactant and metal chelating agent; s3) continuously turning and throwing the polluted soil to be restored by a forklift, and simultaneously spraying the oxidation-chelation restoration agent solution into the discarded polluted soil by a high-pressure spray gun, and culturing the soil for 15 days; s4) collecting and repairing the soil after soil cultivation, and respectively testing the removal rate of organic pollutants and the chelation rate of heavy metals. The invention has the advantages that: low cost and wide application range, and can simultaneously oxidatively decompose organic pollutants in soil and chelate heavy metals in the soil.

title_en: Deep peak regulation boiler steam temperature adjusting system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power station boiler steam temperature regulation and control, and discloses a deep peak regulation boiler steam temperature regulation system. The deep peak regulation boiler steam temperature regulating system comprises a steam temperature maintenance system, a steam temperature fine adjustment system, a fused salt flow heat exchange system and a tail flue gas utilization system; the steam temperature maintenance system is used for adjusting the temperature of a steam outlet of the final-stage reheater in the load-changing process of the boiler so as to stabilize the normal operation temperature of the final-stage reheater; the steam temperature fine adjustment system is used for adjusting the temperature of a steam outlet of the final-stage reheater in the stabilizing process of the boiler so as to stabilize the normal operation temperature of the final-stage reheater; the molten salt flow heat exchange system is used for storing or releasing heat of steam energy in the steam temperature maintenance system. The invention can ensure that the temperature of the steam outlet of the final-stage reheater is kept stable in the variable load and stable process of the boiler so as to ensure the safe operation of the unit, and can realize the efficient utilization of heat energy so as to improve the thermal efficiency of the unit.

title_en: Active flame-retardant explosion-proof charging pile
abstract_en: The invention discloses an active flame-retardant explosion-proof charging pile, which relates to the technical field of charging piles, comprises a mounting column, the both ends of erection column are fixed mounting respectively and are used for strutting arrangement's mounting base and are used for the mount pad of the inside spare part of installation device, and the inside rotation of mount pad is connected with the roating seat. According to the invention, the device can be rapidly powered off by adopting a multipoint power-off mechanism, so that all parts of the charging pile are always kept in a power-off state in the flame-retardant and explosion-proof process of the device, the safety of the device in use is further improved, in addition, the power-off is realized by adopting a synchronous disconnection mode, so that the device is more rapidly synchronized in power-off treatment, and the device is more safe and stable in use, in addition, the synchronous power-off mechanism also remarkably improves the emergency response speed of the device, provides a more convenient and safe operation environment for subsequent staff intervention treatment, and ensures the high efficiency and safety of the whole operation flow.

title_en: Waste heat recovery device of thermal power plant
abstract_en: The invention discloses a waste heat recovery device of a thermal power plant, which comprises a furnace body, an air inlet pipeline, a waste heat recovery box body, an air outlet pipeline, a purification assembly, a water inlet pipe, a water outlet pipe, a water suction pump, a water delivery pipe, a water storage tank and a filtering assembly, wherein the air outlet at the upper part of the furnace body is connected with the air inlet pipeline, the air outlet of the air inlet pipeline is connected with the waste heat recovery box body, the waste heat recovery box body is used for transferring the heat of high-temperature waste gas to cooling water, one side of the waste heat recovery box body is connected with an air outlet pipeline, an air outlet of the air outlet pipeline is connected with a purification component, the purification component is used for purifying waste gas, a water inlet pipe is arranged above the waste heat recovery box body and is communicated with the interior of the waste heat recovery box body.

title_en: Waste heat recycling system and power generation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a waste heat recycling system and a power generation system, and relates to the technical field of waste heat recycling, wherein the waste heat recycling system comprises a heat conversion box, a circulating module, a purifying module, a water supply module and a controller; the water softener comprises a power generation system blast furnace, a steam generator, a first water supply pipeline and a steam turbine, wherein the steam generator is connected with the blast furnace, one end of the first water supply pipeline is connected with the water softener, the other end of the first water supply pipeline is connected with the steam generator, the air inlet end of the steam turbine is connected with the air outlet end of the steam generator, and one end of the first air inlet pipe, which is far away from the heat conversion box, is connected with the blast furnace. According to the invention, when the heat recovery of the high-temperature flue gas is utilized, the water in the first water tank and the second water tank is alternately heated in the heat conversion box in a circulating way, so that the time heat conversion of the high-temperature flue gas and the water is realized, and the heat conversion efficiency is further improved.

title_en: Reactor for capturing carbon dioxide by air and adsorption reaction bed and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reactor for capturing carbon dioxide by air, an adsorption reaction bed and a method thereof, wherein the reactor comprises an adsorbent regeneration circulation loop, and an adsorption reaction bed, a heating bed and a desorption bed are arranged on the adsorbent regeneration circulation loop along the conveying direction of an adsorbent; the adsorption reaction bed comprises: an inner housing provided with a plurality of first vent holes; the middle shell is sleeved outside the inner shell, a first clearance space is formed between the middle shell and the inner shell, and a plurality of second ventilation holes communicated with the first clearance space are formed in the middle shell; at least one air input pipe communicated with the inner shell; wherein the sorbent particles are capable of flowing from the sorbent inlet into the first interstitial space and toward the sorbent outlet. The invention enables the adsorbent particles to fully contact with the air, thereby fully adsorbing carbon dioxide in the air and realizing the high-efficiency exertion of the adsorption performance of the adsorbent. The invention can ensure the continuity of the reaction and is beneficial to reducing the energy consumption of the reactor.

title_en: Reactor for capturing carbon dioxide by air and adsorption reaction bed and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reactor for capturing carbon dioxide by air, an adsorption reaction bed and a method thereof, wherein the reactor comprises an adsorbent regeneration circulation loop, and an adsorption reaction bed, a heating bed and a desorption bed are arranged on the adsorbent regeneration circulation loop along the conveying direction of an adsorbent; the adsorption reaction bed comprises an inner shell, an intermediate shell, at least one air input pipe and an adsorbent output port, wherein the inner shell is provided with a plurality of first vent holes, the intermediate shell is sleeved outside the inner shell, a first clearance space is arranged between the intermediate shell and the inner shell, the intermediate shell is provided with a plurality of second vent holes communicated with the first clearance space, and the at least one air input pipe is communicated with the inner shell, wherein adsorbent particles can flow into the first clearance space from the adsorbent input port and flow into the adsorbent output port. The invention enables the adsorbent particles to fully contact with the air, thereby fully adsorbing carbon dioxide in the air and realizing the high-efficiency exertion of the adsorption performance of the adsorbent. The invention can ensure the continuity of the reaction and is beneficial to reducing the energy consumption of the reactor.

title_en: Fire monitor working state judging method based on Internet of things cloud platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent fire control management, and discloses a fire control powderman making state discrimination method based on an Internet of things cloud platform, which comprises the following steps: deploying a high-definition camera in a fire monitor working area, and acquiring a field image in real time through the camera; preprocessing the live image acquired in real time through edge computing equipment; transmitting the preprocessed image to an internet of things cloud platform, wherein: carrying out image recognition on the fire monitor through the set convolutional neural network, and extracting the state characteristics of the fire monitor; analyzing the extracted fire monitor characteristics by adopting a long-term and short-term memory network in combination with a time sequence analysis method to generate an analysis result; and comprehensively judging the analysis result and outputting a judging result. According to the invention, through multi-source data fusion and an advanced image processing technology and a time sequence analysis method, the accuracy and the instantaneity of state discrimination of the fire control powderman are remarkably improved.

title_en: Iron-manganese composite filler, preparation method and method for strengthening deep denitrification of low-C/N sewage
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sewage deep denitrification treatment, and discloses a ferro-manganese composite filler, a preparation method and a method for strengthening low-C/N sewage deep denitrification. Calcining iron powder, activated carbon powder, manganese oxide and adhesive at high temperature under anaerobic condition to obtain the iron-manganese composite filler. The sewage is pumped out from a reservoir through a peristaltic pump, enters from a water inlet at the lower part of the artificial wetland filled with the ferro-manganese composite filler, fully reacts in the artificial wetland at 20-22 ℃, has the hydraulic retention time of 12-24h, flows out from a water outlet at the upper part of the artificial wetland, and is discharged out of the treated water body through a water outlet pipe. The method has the advantages that aeration is not needed, the cost is low, the operation is simple, the management is easy, the deep denitrification performance of the constructed wetland on sewage is improved, the removal rate of nitrate nitrogen can reach 96.34% on average, the removal rate of total nitrogen can reach 84.68% on average, and the removal rate of COD can reach 76.80% on average.

title_en: Intelligent automatic distribution system and method based on commercial fire fighting big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent automatic distribution system based on commercial fire fighting big data and a method thereof, which relate to the technical field of fire fighting distribution and comprise a fire fighting resource acquisition module, a fire monitoring module, a fire analysis module, a fire fighting distribution module and a data processing module, the fire control distribution module receives the related information of the fire control resource acquisition module and the fire analysis module, compares and analyzes the information with the commercial fire control database, and selects an optimal distribution scheme, and the fire control distribution module comprises a fire control action route planning unit and a fire control resource distribution unit. According to the invention, the fire resource acquisition module and the fire monitoring module are used for acquiring the fire resource information and the fire information, the fire analysis module is used for analyzing the fire data, the fire distribution module is used for receiving the analysis result and the fire resource information, and the fire control action route planning unit is used for planning the most reasonable route, so that a fire department can quickly arrive at a fire scene, and the loss caused by the fire is reduced.

title_en: Dust-fall type lighting device for subway construction and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dust-fall type lighting device for subway construction and a use method thereof, wherein the dust-fall type lighting device comprises the following components: the dust fall mechanism comprises a vehicle body, an extension pipe, an extension hose, a connecting hose, a moving table, a separation part and a dust fall part, wherein the top of the vehicle body is rotationally connected with a carrying table, a linkage gear ring is sleeved on the outer surface of the carrying table, the connecting hose is inserted into the top of the vehicle body, the extension pipe is inserted into the outer surface of one side of the vehicle body, and the extension hose is inserted into one end of the extension pipe. When the device is used, the device can be conveniently moved to a designated use position through the vehicle body, and then a proper amount of water resources are injected into the vehicle body through the liquid injection joint, so that the water resources can submerge the top of the second liquid separation plate, and then the water resources can be uniformly injected between the two guide bottom plates under the action of the communication port, and at the moment, the driving motor is controlled to start so that the driving motor can drive the fan blades to rotate, and the rotating fan blades can pump out air in the vehicle body through the connecting hose.

title_en: High-efficiency signal amplifier for satellite antenna
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-efficiency signal amplifier for a satellite antenna, and belongs to the field of signal amplifiers. The utility model provides a high-performance signal amplifier for satellite antenna, includes the amplifier casing to and set up the radiating groove in the amplifier casing both sides, still include: the filter box is fixed in the amplifier shell and is used for blocking the air inlet of the heat dissipation groove; the air inlet is formed on the surface of the filter box and is communicated with the air inlet of the heat dissipation groove; the adsorption sponge is arranged in the filter box and is used for adsorbing water vapor in the air; an extrusion assembly; according to the invention, through the arrangement of the adsorption sponge, the adsorption sponge can adsorb the water vapor contained in the gas, so that the water vapor can be prevented from entering the box body, and through the arrangement of the mode, the adsorption treatment of the water vapor is realized, the problem that the short circuit of the amplifier chip is easily influenced when the water vapor enters the box body is solved, and the damage probability of the signal amplifier is further reduced.

title_en: Exhaust emission treatment equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses waste gas emission treatment equipment, which comprises a waste gas purifying cylinder and a cover plate at the upper part of the waste gas purifying cylinder, wherein a partition plate is arranged at the middle lower part in the waste gas purifying cylinder, the lower end of a gas-dust separation cavity is arranged between the inner bottom of the waste gas purifying cylinder and the lower wall of the partition plate, a cavity automatic dust scraping component is arranged in the gas-dust separation cavity, a gas-dust separation filter component is arranged at the inner lower part of the gas-dust separation cavity, a gas pressure spin spray washing component is arranged at the opening at the lower end of the gas-dust separation cavity, and the gas pressure spin spray washing component is arranged at the lower part of the gas-dust separation filter component. The invention belongs to the field of industrial waste gas purification treatment, and particularly relates to a method for filtering dust by using a symmetrical spherical dust filter screen, wherein the dust filter screen on the upper side is used for filtering the dust, and under the condition that the dust filter screen is not dismantled, the dust on the dust filter screen on the lower side is automatically cleaned by using the pressure of filtered gas, and meanwhile, the filtered dust is subjected to environment-friendly treatment, so that the use efficiency is improved, and the influence of the dust on the catalytic activity of a photocatalyst solution is avoided.

title_en: High-efficient catalytic absorption processing apparatus of ethylene oxide waste gas
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of ethylene oxide waste gas treatment devices and discloses an ethylene oxide waste gas efficient catalytic absorption treatment device which comprises a treatment kettle, a buffer tank and a plate heat exchanger, wherein a first pump is arranged on the treatment kettle, the first pump is communicated with a treatment cavity of the treatment kettle through an input pipe, the plate heat exchanger is connected with the buffer tank through a second connecting pipe, and the buffer tank is connected with the first pump on the first treatment kettle through the first connecting pipe.

title_en: Preparation method and water treatment method of COF MXene bacterial cellulose composite material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and a water treatment method of a COF MXene bacterial cellulose composite material, and synthesis of S1 COF nanosheets: s2 MXene nano-sheets are synthesized; s3 BC preparation; s4 BC/COF composite film preparation; s5 COF/MXene/BC composite film preparation method. The composite material with the acid-base synergistic catalytic function, which is prepared by the invention, is applied to the catalytic conversion of glucose to generate the 5-HMF, and the COF/MXene/BC composite film can improve the separation efficiency and reduce the energy consumption, thereby providing an effective solution for solving the problems of water resource and environmental pollution.

title_en: Atomizing nozzle
abstract_en: The application relates to an atomizing spray head, which comprises a shell, a resonator and a liquid outlet pipeline, wherein a deflector is arranged in the shell, an annular gap is formed between the shell and the deflector, an annular resonant tank is arranged between the resonator and the shell, a liquid inlet and a first connecting channel are also arranged on the resonator, the liquid outlet pipeline is arranged on the resonator, a second connecting channel is arranged between the liquid outlet pipeline and the resonator, and the liquid outlet pipeline, the liquid inlet and the first connecting channel are mutually communicated through the second connecting channel.

title_en: Regenerated salt solution generating device, resin softening system, control method and equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a regenerated salt solution generating device, a resin softening system, a control method and equipment, comprising the following steps: the regenerated salt cavity is used for storing regenerated salt, the regenerated salt cavity comprises at least one salt dissolving flow channel, and when liquid passes through the salt dissolving flow channel, the liquid flows in the horizontal direction and dissolves the solid regenerated salt in the flowing direction; if the resin softening system is in a regeneration mode, the regenerated salt cavity immediately generates salt solution with preset concentration, and the salt solution cavity immediately outputs the salt solution to a resin container in the resin softening system. The regenerated salt solution generating device with the transversely arranged salt dissolving flow passages can effectively prolong the salt dissolving passages for generating regenerated salt solution, can immediately generate and output salt solution with a certain concentration, effectively improves the utilization rate of regenerated salt, and simultaneously improves the stability of generating salt solution with a preset concentration in the resin regeneration step.

title_en: Ecological restoration device for water environment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of environmental ecology, and particularly discloses a water environment ecology restoration device, which comprises a floating plate and a bearing block, wherein a lifting mechanism is arranged between the floating plate and the bearing block, the output end of the lifting mechanism is provided with a liquid storage bin for storing restoration liquid, the end bearing of the liquid storage bin is connected with a rotating bin, the liquid storage bin is communicated with the rotating bin, and the lifting mechanism is used for driving the liquid storage bin to move up and down so as to enable the liquid storage bin and the rotating bin to be positioned at different underwater positions; a plurality of evenly distributed liquid spraying mechanisms are arranged on the rotating bin. According to the invention, the repairing liquid can be put into water with different depths for repairing, so that the liquid spraying mechanism rotates, the putting range of the repairing liquid is enlarged, the contact area of the repairing liquid and polluted water is increased, the water generates waves, the repairing liquid is continuously transmitted to a farther position, the repairing effect is improved, the large-area water with different depths can be quickly repaired, and the repairing efficiency is improved.

title_en: Multilayer micropore structure of engine silencer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of engine silencers, in particular to an engine silencer multi-layer micropore structure, which comprises a shell, wherein a plurality of micropore partition boards are arranged on the inner wall of the shell, a filling layer is arranged between every two micropore partition boards, a baffle is arranged on the right side of the shell, a plurality of mounting grooves are formed in the inner wall of the shell, plug-in blocks are plugged in the inner wall of the mounting grooves, a mounting plate is plugged in the left side of the plug-in blocks, and two rubber plug-in blocks are arranged on the left side of the mounting plate; the beneficial effects are as follows: through pulling the spliced pole, operating personnel can be light with baffle and casing separation to simplify the dismouting process, be convenient for maintain micropore baffle and filling layer, in addition, can also adjust the number of piles of micropore baffle according to the demand, and can support the fixture block after the spliced pole resets, thereby ensure the steadiness of baffle installation, utilize the sealing washer to further improve the leakproofness between the two simultaneously, and then promote the result of use and the suitability of engine muffler.

title_en: Heating system and method for cold start boiler
abstract_en: The invention provides a heating system and a heating method for a cold start boiler, wherein an air door device is used for receiving a cold start instruction sent by a second boiler and is communicated with an air inlet end and an air outlet end of the air door device; the high-temperature flue gas fan is utilized to receive a cold start instruction sent by the second boiler, and the high-temperature flue gas exhausted by the first boiler is conveyed to a front furnace arch and a rear furnace arch of the second boiler for heating; and detecting the hearth temperature of the second boiler in real time by using a temperature sensor and sending the hearth temperature to the second boiler, so that the second boiler is started when the duration of the constant hearth temperature reaches the preset duration. In the scheme, the high-temperature flue gas of the adjacent furnace is conveyed to the front arch and the rear arch of the hearth of the starting furnace, and the working medium in the water-cooled wall is heated.

title_en: Acid-regulated platinum-loaded cerium oxide nano material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an acid-regulated platinum-loaded cerium dioxide nano material, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps of loading platinum on a cerium dioxide carrier by adopting an impregnation method to obtain a platinum-loaded cerium dioxide nano material precursor, wherein the platinum content is 1/50-1/200 of the mass of cerium dioxide; acidizing the platinum-loaded cerium oxide nano material precursor to obtain a pretreatment product of the platinum-loaded cerium oxide nano material; the platinum-loaded cerium oxide nano material regulated and controlled by acid is obtained through cleaning, drying and calcining. According to the method, the content of zero-valent Pt on the surface of the catalyst, the proportion of Ce  3+  in Ce ions, active oxygen species and oxygen vacancies are regulated and controlled through acid pretreatment, and the platinum-loaded cerium oxide nano material prepared by the method shows higher activity in a catalytic oxidation test of toluene.

title_en: Short-process wastewater zero-emission treatment process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short-flow wastewater zero-emission treatment process, which relates to the technical field of wastewater treatment, wherein the process dynamically monitors the sludge precipitation amount of a high-density clarifier, adjusts the corresponding dosing amount according to the monitoring result, ensures reasonable monitoring of the high-density clarifier, ensures stable water quality of effluent of the high-density clarifier, timely interrupts the wastewater to enter a subsequent process through analysis of precipitation reasonable values, avoids the risk of fouling caused by wastewater on primary reverse osmosis RO1 and secondary reverse osmosis RO2, completes full precipitation of the wastewater in the high-density clarifier, effectively reduces treatment steps of the subsequent process, and optimizes the wastewater treatment process.

title_en: Wet-type oxidation treatment system for sludge
abstract_en: The invention provides a sludge wet oxidation treatment system which comprises a mixing tank, a heat exchange device, a reactor, a gas-liquid separator and a reflux device. The mixing tank, the heat exchange device, the reactor and the gas-liquid separator are sequentially connected through pipelines, and the reflux device is connected between the gas-liquid separator and the mixing tank and is used for refluxing part of the product into the mixing tank; the heat exchange device is filled with high-pressure gas, provided with a baffle plate and a cleaning device; the outlet of the reactor is provided with an automatic control valve. The invention reduces the concentration of the sludge in the mixing tank by the sludge reflux; high-pressure gas is introduced through the heat exchanger to enhance sludge stirring, the separator is arranged through the heat exchanger to increase the flow rate of the sludge, and the cleaning device is arranged to clean accumulated sludge; the system pressure is stabilized by an automatic control valve. The measures can effectively improve the fluidity of the sludge, avoid sludge deposition, improve the heat exchange effect, have better sludge treatment effect, and simultaneously ensure stable system operation and prolonged operation period.

title_en: Lithium battery disassembly and recovery device
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of lithium battery recovery, in particular to a lithium battery disassembly and recovery device, which comprises a recovery box and supporting legs for supporting the recovery box, wherein the top of the recovery box is communicated with a filtering pipeline, a partition plate is arranged in the recovery box, a clamping device is arranged above the partition plate, one side of the recovery box is provided with a clamping device for guiding the lithium battery to be clamped, and a triggering device, a cutting device and a crushing device are sequentially arranged in the recovery box along the rotation direction of the clamping device.

title_en: Efficient high-salt waste liquid harmless treatment process
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of high-salt waste liquid treatment, and discloses a high-efficiency high-salt waste liquid harmless treatment process, which comprises the following treatment steps: preheating and storing the waste liquid, and sending the preheated waste liquid into a liquid storage tank for storage; ultrasonic atomization is carried out on the preheated waste liquid, and the hot waste liquid in the liquid storage tank is atomized into small liquid drops under the action of an ultrasonic atomization system; evaporating and separating, and delivering atomized droplets into a high-temperature gasification separation chamber to separate water vapor, organic waste gas and salt; oxidative combustion, namely, feeding the vapor separated by gasification and organic waste gas into an oxidative combustion chamber for combustion; and (3) high-temperature carbonization, namely collecting the salt separated in the gasification separation chamber, and sending the salt into a pyrolysis carbonization furnace for high-temperature carbonization to obtain carbonized salt. The invention can effectively carry out innocent treatment on the high-salt waste liquid, can effectively recycle salt in the waste liquid and water resources which can be secondarily utilized, and effectively saves energy consumption.

title_en: Adsorbent for efficiently removing antimony pollution and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an adsorbent for efficiently removing antimony pollution, and a preparation method and application thereof. The invention provides a high-efficiency antimony-pollution-removal adsorbent which is prepared by carrying out pyrolysis treatment on biomass raw materials (rice hulls) with high carbon content to obtain rice hull biochar, carrying Fe  2+  and FeOOH on the surfaces of the rice hull biochar together through infiltration modification of the rice hull biochar by Fe (NO  3 ) 3 ·9H 2  O, feSO4.7H2O and the like, heating and stirring until a solution is stable and drying, and then using potassium permanganate to modify the rice hull biochar to realize iron-strong co-doping.

title_en: Environment-friendly electromagnetic purification system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environment-friendly electromagnetic purification system, and relates to the technical field of electromagnetic purification systems. The invention comprises the following steps: the device comprises a blending box, and a collecting device and a Lorentz force generating device are connected and communicated below the inner wall of the blending box. The invention introduces a cooperative working mechanism of the turbulence effect and the Hall effect, the Hall effect is used for accurately controlling the electromagnetic field to enable charged colloid particles to be gathered near the wall of the fluid, and the turbulence effect is utilized to enable the colloid particles to be gathered and precipitated, so that the silicon dioxide colloid particles in the solution are removed more effectively. The combination of the two effects obviously improves the purity of the final product Fe  2 O 3  and reaches the high standard of manufacturing the soft magnetic ferrite material.

title_en: Textile safety protection textile material flushing device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a textile safety protection textile material flushing device, which relates to the technical field of textile material cleaning and comprises a machine base and a water outlet, wherein the water outlet is arranged on the right side of the machine base, a vertical chute is formed on the right side of the machine base, a transverse chute is formed on the right side of the machine base, input devices are arranged on the front side and the rear side of the machine base, a flushing device is arranged in the machine base, and an output device is arranged on the rear side of the machine base; the cloth roll is quickly installed and disassembled through the input device, particularly when a large amount of cloth rolls or the cloth rolls are frequently washed, a large amount of operation time is saved, the cloth is quickly fixed through the clamping cylinder, the condition that the cloth is required to be wound to a rotating rod through two hands for a plurality of circles is avoided, the cloth can be fixed through the rotating rod of the handle, production efficiency can be greatly improved through quick fixing and winding, and downtime and manual adjustment on a production line are reduced.

title_en: Water purifier 0 ageing technology
abstract_en: The water purifier 0 ageing technology belongs to RO reverse osmosis water purifying equipment, and can realize the double technical effects of drinking after the water purifier is started and effectively protecting RO reverse osmosis membrane. Basic principle: the invention skillfully connects and links the 0 old water control module and the self-contained electric control system of the water purifier to finish the on-off, start-up and stop of the related components of the 0 Chen Shuiji system and the accurate control of the water flow direction and flow, and finally realizes the 0 old water technical effect that the RO reverse osmosis membrane can be drunk after being started up and effectively protected. Technical value: the birth and application of the technology not only solves the problems of high TDS value and poor taste of the first cup of water when the water purifier is started, but also has the advantages of excellent application performance, simplicity, universality, low cost and good effect, can meet the higher design requirements of the water purifier industry, and creates conditions for research, development, manufacture and popularization of the high-quality water purifier.

title_en: Air separation oxygen production water filter equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water filtering device for air separation oxygen production, in particular to the technical field of air separation oxygen production, which comprises a device shell, wherein four corners of the lower end of the device shell are fixedly connected with supporting legs, the front end of the device shell is rotatably connected with a cabinet door, the device is characterized in that a water inlet pipe is fixedly connected to the right part of the upper end of the device shell, oil removing components are arranged on the inner surface of the device shell and the left end and the right end of the device shell together, and a filtering component is arranged below the oil removing components on the inner surface of the device shell. According to the air separation oxygen production water filtering device, through the oil removal component, the water used for oxygen production can gradually adopt a physical and chemical combination mode to perform step-by-step separation and removal operation on grease in the water, meanwhile, grease is cleaned and separated in the process of separating the grease, the burden of a molecular sieve is reduced when oxygen is produced by an oxygen production mechanism, volatilization of the grease is avoided, and the purity and quality of the oxygen are improved.

title_en: Positively charged nanofiltration membrane based on quaternized monomers and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a positively charged nanofiltration membrane based on a quaternized monomer and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of nanofiltration membrane preparation and ion separation. The method comprises the steps of providing a quaternized 1, 4-diazabicyclo [2.2.2] octane, dissolving in water to obtain a water phase monomer solution, adding an organic phase monomer solution containing trimesoyl chloride and normal hexane, immersing a porous basic nanofiltration membrane in the water phase monomer solution, taking out and removing residual solution on the surface of the membrane, immersing in the organic phase monomer solution to perform interfacial polymerization reaction to form a polyamide layer, performing heat treatment, and cooling to obtain the positively charged nanofiltration membrane. The invention can effectively regulate the thickness of the polyamide layer of the nanofiltration membrane according to the concentration of the monomer and the condensation time, and prepares the nanofiltration membrane with positive electricity, and the nanofiltration membrane can improve the water flux and the lithium/magnesium selectivity.

title_en: Pyrolysis gas combustion device and biomass combustion system
abstract_en: The invention provides a pyrolysis gas combustion device and a biomass combustion system. The pyrolysis gas combustion device of the present invention comprises: a combustion furnace having a combustion chamber; the flue gas outlet pipeline is communicated with the combustion cavity; the slag discharging barrel is provided with a slag discharging cavity and a slag discharging port communicated with the slag discharging cavity, and the slag discharging cavity is communicated with the combustion cavity; the combustion assembly comprises a mixing drum, an air pipeline, a gas pipeline and a first combustor, wherein the mixing drum is provided with a mixing cavity, the mixing cavity is communicated with the combustion cavity, the volume of the combustion cavity is larger than that of the mixing cavity, the air pipeline is communicated with the mixing cavity so as to supply oxygen to the mixing cavity, the gas pipeline is communicated with the mixing cavity so as to introduce pyrolysis gas into the mixing cavity, and the first combustor is provided with a first flaming opening which stretches into the mixing cavity. Therefore, the pyrolysis gas combustion device has the advantages of being convenient for oxidation combustion of pyrolysis gas and low in cost.

title_en: Full-flow treatment system and treatment process for waste ionic liquid
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of wastewater treatment, and relates to a waste ionic liquid full-flow treatment system and a treatment process. The invention provides a full-flow treatment system and a full-flow treatment process for waste ionic liquid, which are used for solving the pollution problem of the waste ionic liquid generated in the production process of petrochemical industry refining enterprises, wherein the treatment system comprises a waste liquid treatment system, a dirty oil treatment system, a solid waste treatment system and a tail gas treatment system. The whole-flow pollution control of the treatment process can reduce the environmental pollution risk and the potential safety hazard caused by the mass storage of untreated waste ionic liquid, and simultaneously reduce the pollution risk generated in the treatment process.

title_en: Soil remediation composition, preparation method and application thereof, and soil remediation method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of soil and groundwater pollution remediation, and discloses a soil remediation composition, a preparation method and application thereof, and a soil remediation method, wherein the soil remediation composition comprises a reducing agent, a slow release agent and a dispersing agent; the reducing agent comprises zero-valent iron and other reducing agents, wherein the other reducing agents are ferrous sulfide and/or ferrous disulfide, the slow release agent comprises alkaline silica sol and other slow release agents, the other slow release agents are guar gum, xanthan gum, sodium carboxymethyl cellulose or gelatin, the dispersing agent is at least one of polyepoxysuccinic acid, polyaspartic acid, polyacrylic acid and chitosan, the solid content of the slow release agent is 500-2000 parts by weight relative to 100 parts by weight of the reducing agent, and the solid content of the dispersing agent is 100-1000 parts by weight. The soil remediation composition provided by the invention has a high chlorinated hydrocarbon degradation rate.

title_en: Recovery device for semiconductor stripping liquid
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of semiconductor production, and discloses a recovery device for semiconductor stripping liquid. According to the invention, when the main shaft is driven to rotate by the driving device, the main stirring rod drives the sliding frame to move up and down through the driving, at the moment, the main stirring rod and the auxiliary stirring rod stir the waste liquid in the horizontal direction, the sliding frame stirs the waste liquid in the vertical direction, so that the precipitant and the pH neutralizer in the waste liquid are more uniformly diffused, and meanwhile, in the process of moving the sliding frame up and down, the force exerted by the downward movement of the sliding frame on the waste liquid is larger than the force exerted by the upward movement of the sliding frame, at the moment, the solid in the waste liquid moves along with the movement of the waste liquid to the periphery of the bottom of the cylinder, and then the solid is gradually sunk and enters the slag discharging pipe and is carried out by the spiral blades, so that the filtering speed of the waste liquid is accelerated.

title_en: Flame-retardant mechanism for automobile
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flame-retardant mechanism for an automobile, which comprises a base, a spray pipe, support columns and a driving inner cavity, wherein the directions of the driving inner cavities formed by two groups of adjacent support columns are corresponding, an inlet and an outlet are formed between the two groups of adjacent support columns, the driving assembly comprises a driving rod, a driving base, a driving motor, a flame-retardant cover plate and a temperature detector, a plurality of groups of support columns extending vertically upwards are arranged on the formed base, a wide inlet and outlet for a vehicle to enter can be formed between the two groups of adjacent support columns, the formed inlet and outlet are in sliding connection with the flame-retardant cover plate capable of controlling the opening state of the inlet and the outlet, the inner side surrounded by the whole support column forms a closed space, the fire is effectively prevented from spreading around, meanwhile, the driving rod controlled by the driving motor is rotationally connected to the inner side of the formed support column, the flame-retardant cover plate is further free to move up and down, and the temperature detector and the spray pipe are arranged on the base in a matched manner, and the aim of effectively detecting and realizing fire extinguishment is achieved.

title_en: Garbage storage device for garbage power plant
abstract_en: The invention discloses a garbage storage device for a garbage power plant, which belongs to the technical field of heat recovery devices for waste incineration and comprises a storage box, wherein the storage box is connected with an incinerator through a conveyor I and a conveyor II, the storage box comprises an outer box and an inner box, the inner diameter of the opening end of the top of the inner box is increased to fixedly plug the opening of the top of the outer box, and an interlayer is formed between the outer wall of the inner box and the inner wall of the outer box in a surrounding manner. According to the invention, through the design of the conveyor and the ash barrel, a tubular sealing channel can be formed between the storage box and the incinerator, so that the conveyed garbage can not be exposed to the atmosphere, slag generated in incineration can be conveyed to the ash barrel to heat the stored garbage, the heat contained in the slag is recycled, the garbage is heated and sterilized to avoid deterioration in storage, and the garbage can be preheated to improve the utilization rate of the heat generated by the incineration of the garbage and fuel.

title_en: Pig feed fermentation preparation method with deodorization effect
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of gas separation, in particular to a pig feed fermentation preparation method with a deodorizing effect, which is characterized in that through the arrangement of an activated carbon cylinder with a cylindrical structure and granular fillers in the activated carbon cylinder, the synchronous rotation of a rotating frame is matched, the contact area and the contact frequency of gas and activated carbon are obviously increased, the deodorizing efficiency is improved, through the matched use of a bearing frame and the rotating frame, after the adsorption capacity of the activated carbon is reduced, the activated carbon cylinder can be automatically moved from the rotating frame to the top and naturally falls down onto the bearing frame through gravity, the replacement of the activated carbon cylinder can be realized without manual intervention, and the tedious manual disassembly process in the prior art is avoided in this way, the maintenance efficiency of equipment is obviously improved, and the labor burden of operators is reduced.

title_en: Carbon dioxide absorption system and absorption method
abstract_en: The application provides a carbon dioxide absorption system and an absorption method. The absorption system comprises an absorption tower, a lean-rich liquid heat exchanger, a regeneration tower, an iron ion detector and an iron ion absorber, wherein the absorption tower is used for absorbing carbon dioxide in flue gas to obtain rich amine liquid, the lean-rich liquid heat exchanger is used for exchanging heat between the rich amine liquid and lean amine liquid to obtain hot rich amine liquid and cold lean amine liquid, the regeneration tower is used for removing carbon dioxide in the hot rich amine liquid to obtain lean amine liquid, the iron ion detector is used for detecting the content of iron ions in the cold lean amine liquid, and the iron ion absorber is used for absorbing the iron ions in the cold lean amine liquid. The application is beneficial to reducing the catalytic degradation degree of the two-phase amine absorbent in the operation process by arranging the iron ion detector and the iron ion absorber, thereby being beneficial to improving the operation stability and the operation duration of the absorption system and further being beneficial to improving the absorption efficiency of carbon dioxide.

title_en: Deep stratum CO2Adsorption, sealing and isolation failure self-coupling repairing method
