abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sealing technology, in particular to a method for repairing CO  2  adsorption sealing and isolation failure autotransformer of a deep stratum, which comprises the following steps of S10, spraying a Li salt culture medium and Li-CO  2  sensitive salt-tolerant anaerobic fungi at a position with the thickness of 5 meters on the outer vertical surface of a CO  2  adsorption layer to form an isolation layer technical implementation area, S20, wherein the initial Li salt culture medium contains high-concentration indissolvable Li  2 CO 3 , but the concentrations of water-soluble LiHCO  3  and CO  2  in the isolation layer technical implementation area are too low to meet the growth condition of Li-CO  2  sensitive salt-tolerant anaerobic fungi, S30, when the CO  2  adsorption layer is isolated, a large amount of CO  2  is adsorbed and dissipated, through the spraying layer, the dissipated CO  2  hydrolyzes Li  2 CO 3  into LiHCO  3  and forms diffusion around, the concentration of Li in a liquid phase environment and the concentration of CO  2  are increased simultaneously, and N, P, K and other elements in the Li salt culture medium in a low-lithium salt state are used as supplements, and the method has the advantages of simplicity in operation, low cost and environment protection and high efficiency, and the problem of weakening the geological aging or aging caused by activity or the isolation in an underground CO  2  adsorption storage body is degraded.

title_en: Complex bacterium for degrading and repairing benzo [ a ] pyrene, functional bacterial agent and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composite bacterium for degrading and repairing benzo [ a ] pyrene, a functional bacterial agent and application thereof, wherein the composite bacterium comprises Mycolicibacterium sp.142 and Stenotrophomonas sp.143, and the preservation numbers of the composite bacterium are CCTCC NO: M20221294 and CCTCC NO: M20221295 respectively. The composite bacteria obtained by separation and screening can effectively degrade benzo [ a ] pyrene and various polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons, can rapidly and effectively degrade benzo [ a ] pyrene in an inorganic salt culture medium by more than 90%, can degrade benzo [ a ] pyrene with high concentration in soil by more than 80% in a short time, remarkably improves the degradation effect of a single strain, and effectively solves the problem of harm of residual benzo [ a ] pyrene to soil or water environment, crops and human health.

title_en: Polyaspartic acid composite hydrogel and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of composite hydrogel, in particular to a polyaspartic acid composite hydrogel and a preparation method thereof, the hydrogel takes silane modified polyaspartic acid hydrogel as a matrix, sodium bentonite and dithiocarboxyl modified cellulose are crosslinked, the interpenetrating network structure is formed, has better adsorption capacity and recycling rate than common polyaspartic acid hydrogel, has simple process flow, and is suitable for application in water treatment and the like.

title_en: Textile sewage treatment recovery device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a textile sewage treatment recovery device, which relates to the field of environmental engineering and comprises an A box body, a B box body, a waste outlet and a conveying pipe, wherein a water inlet is fixedly arranged on the front side of the A box body, a water outlet is fixedly arranged on the rear side of the B box body, a rotating motor is arranged on the top of the B box body, a slotted hole is formed in the surface of the B box body, a filtering device and a cleaning device are arranged in the A box body, and a dosing device is arranged in the B box body, wherein a rotating wheel is driven to rotate by a rotating belt through the rotation of a conveying roller in the filtering device, so that impurities are crushed, if the impurities enter treatment equipment without crushing treatment, the load of the equipment is increased, the treatment efficiency is reduced, and the large-size impurities can be decomposed into smaller particles through crushing treatment, thereby being beneficial to improving the efficiency of the subsequent treatment equipment.

title_en: Directional conversion recycling method and system for organic waste liquid
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for directionally converting and recycling organic waste liquid, and belongs to the technical field of organic waste liquid treatment. The method comprises the steps of inputting toxic organic waste liquid into a catalytic oxidation reactor, continuously introducing air, performing catalytic oxidation reaction to obtain pretreated waste liquid, sequentially inputting the pretreated waste liquid into a first anaerobic tower, a stripping tower and a second anaerobic tower for treatment, and introducing methane into the first anaerobic tower, the stripping tower and the second anaerobic tower respectively. The invention reduces the pretreatment time through the catalytic oxidation pretreatment at relatively low temperature and low pressure, reduces the energy consumption and the cost of the catalytic oxidation pretreatment while realizing the detoxification of the high-concentration organic waste liquid, combines the catalytic oxidation pretreatment and the biochemical treatment through the arrangement of the catalytic oxidation reactor, the first anaerobic tower, the stripping tower and the second anaerobic tower, has the advantages of low investment and low operation cost, and is suitable for treating the high-concentration organic waste liquid.

title_en: Membrane bioreactor based on distributed vibration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a membrane bioreactor based on distributed vibration, which relates to the technical field of membrane bioreactors, and is based on the operation principle of the membrane bioreactor, wherein the operation process of a plurality of membrane reactor bodies forms an integral structure, the treatment capacity of the membrane reactor bodies in each independent position is directly fed back by the liquid level change of sewage in a tank body in the integral process, the essence is that a water level analysis system is established, particularly, the treatment capacity of the membrane reactor bodies is fed back by collecting sewage liquid level parameters in three stages of a front stage, a middle stage and a crosslinking stage in real time, the sewage change speed is used as a basis, and a working assembly is additionally arranged in the integral structure, so that each membrane reactor body adopts a circulating continuous replacement process, the sewage treatment process is not interrupted in the integral process, and the integral sewage treatment effect is not directly influenced.

title_en: High-power galvanometer with dustproof mechanism
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of high-power vibrating mirrors, in particular to a high-power vibrating mirror with a dustproof mechanism, which solves the problems that dust cannot be treated in time in the using process of the high-power vibrating mirror, solid matters and flocks on a filter screen are difficult to clean and the service life of the high-power vibrating mirror is influenced in the prior art, and comprises a vibrating mirror main body, a welding head, a mounting part, an exhaust fan and a dustproof cover, wherein the vibrating mirror main body comprises the welding head, the mounting part and the exhaust fan, the welding head can be directly contacted with a processing part, the installation department can be connected with external connecting rod by the bolt fastening, the air discharge fan passes through the bolt mounting on the dust cover, the dust cover fixed cover is established outside the soldered connection, sets up the dust fog passageway in the dust cover, dust fog passageway export just to the air discharge fan direction, through add the dust cover in high-power mirror outside that shakes, comes to concentrate the suction to shake the dust fog of mirror processing in-process of using and handles, keeps the mirror that shakes constantly in the high efficiency and the operational environment clean of in-process.

title_en: Cooling circulating water active carbon filtration equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides cooling circulating water activated carbon filtering equipment, which belongs to the technical field of circulating water filtering and comprises a shell, wherein a water inlet mechanism, a retaining screen plate, a secondary retaining piece, an overflow impurity removing mechanism, an activated carbon adsorption mechanism and a flow guiding mechanism are arranged in the shell, the retaining screen plate is positioned below the water inlet mechanism, the secondary retaining piece comprises an arc-shaped plate and two retaining net hoppers, the middle part of the arc-shaped plate protrudes upwards and is positioned below the retaining screen plate, the two retaining net hoppers are positioned on two sides of the bottom of the arc-shaped plate, the overflow impurity removing mechanism comprises an overflow plate and sponge blocks, the overflow plate comprises an arc-shaped concave section and inclined sections positioned at two ends of the arc-shaped concave section, the sponge blocks are positioned in the arc-shaped concave section, the activated carbon adsorption mechanism is provided with two groups and are respectively positioned on two sides of the bottom of the overflow plate, and the flow guiding mechanism is positioned on the lower part of the overflow plate and is used for guiding cooling circulating water into any water storage tank. The invention can lead the cooling circulating water to be subjected to multistage filtration before reaching the activated carbon, and prolong the replacement period of the activated carbon.

title_en: Energy-saving and environment-friendly tail gas treatment equipment for granulator
abstract_en: The invention discloses tail gas treatment equipment for an energy-saving and environment-friendly granulator, which relates to the technical field of tail gas treatment and comprises a tail gas inlet pipe, a humidifying and cooling device, a powder removing device, a drying assembly, an air suction fan and a spraying device, wherein the spraying device is used for removing harmful gases in gas, the humidifying and cooling device comprises a humidifying tank arranged at the air outlet end of the tail gas inlet pipe, a first spray head for injecting water mist into the humidifying tank, the powder removing device comprises a impurity removing tank arranged at one side of the humidifying tank and communicated with the air outlet end of the humidifying tank, and the driving assembly drives a spiral sheet to move upwards and rotate, and a plurality of scraping assemblies are used for scraping attachments on the surface of the spiral sheet to clean the spiral sheet so as to play a role in preventing the attachments from depositing on the surface of the spiral sheet. Through using the gas after the drying to dry the attachment and the liquid that mixes impurity, can release harmful gas when preventing to clear up drying assembly.

title_en: Kitchen garbage treatment device with multiple barrels
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of kitchen waste treatment, and particularly discloses a multi-bin type kitchen waste treatment device which comprises a shell and a treatment bin arranged in the shell, wherein the treatment bin comprises at least two treatment bins of different types, namely a high-humidity garbage treatment bin, a low-humidity garbage treatment bin and a crushing treatment bin. The kitchen garbage treatment device can realize that a plurality of different types of garbage are put into corresponding types of treatment barrels in the kitchen garbage treatment device to be uniformly and synchronously treated, and the operation treatment process is simpler, more convenient and quicker, and occupies smaller space.

title_en: Flue gas treatment device for simultaneously removing CO and recycling reaction waste heat in denitration
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the field of flue gas treatment technology and provides a flue gas treatment device for simultaneous removal of CO and recovery of reaction waste heat through denitrification. The device comprises a denitrification box and a deoxygenation equipment for flue gas treatment. The denitrification box includes a box body and a partition plate fixed inside the box body and forming a partition, as well as a ventilation groove opened at the upper and lower ends of the partition plate and forming a vertical reciprocating airway between the box body and the partition plate. It can be understood that firstly, by setting a vertical reciprocating airway, the length of the airflow channel can be ensured while controlling the occupied space, thereby ensuring denitrification and heat transfer effects. Secondly, the catalyst solution can be fully mixed with the flue gas through the set spraying component to ensure the treatment effect. Then, in conjunction with the efficient heat transfer of the heat exchange component and the flow guidance of the conveying component, the ventilation groove can be used. Finally, Recycling and utilizing the heat generated by flue gas treatment, And the conveying components also use the flow of catalyst solution as a power source, fully utilizing the power and making the overall device more environmentally friendly.

title_en: Method and system for producing hydrogen by microbial electrolysis for ecological restoration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for producing hydrogen by microbial electrolysis for ecological restoration, which comprise a reaction tank, wherein an installation box is fixedly arranged on one side of the reaction tank, a cathode chamber and an anode chamber are arranged in the reaction tank, a lifting pump is arranged in the installation box, the cathode chamber and the anode chamber are separated by an exchange membrane, so that a water body flows through an anode electrode in a unidirectional way, organic matters in the water body are subjected to oxidative decomposition by electrogenerated bacteria attached to the surface of the anode electrode, the chemical oxygen demand in the water body is reduced, hydrogen ions and electrons are generated at the same time, the hydrogen ions enter the cathode chamber by the exchange membrane, the electrons enter the cathode electrode by an external circuit, and chlorella is used as a biological cathode to receive the hydrogen ions and the electrons in the cathode chamber for sewage treatment, so that the chemical oxygen demand in the water body is further reduced.

title_en: Sewage treatment method and device capable of recycling carbon source
abstract_en: The invention provides a sewage treatment method and device with a recyclable carbon source, and relates to the field of sewage treatment. This sewage treatment plant that carbon source can be retrieved, including the treatment tank, one side of treatment tank upper end is provided with spouts medicine mechanism, spout medicine mechanism including fixing the defeated workbin in treatment tank upper surface one side, the last fixedly connected with impurity pump of defeated workbin, the rear end outer wall fixedly connected with motor box of defeated workbin, the inside of motor box is provided with gear motor, gear motor's output runs through the inside of motor box to defeated workbin and fixedly connected with auger roller. In the invention, the material conveying pipe is placed in the flocculant placing box, the impurity pump is started, the impurity pump conveys the flocculant into the material conveying box, then the speed reducing motor drives the auger roller to rotate, so that the flocculant moves in the material conveying box, a certain amount of flocculant falls down when passing through the blanking hole, and the redundant flocculant is discharged from the discharge hopper, so that the purpose of uniform spraying can be effectively achieved.

title_en: Composite microbial agent and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composite microbial agent and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of microorganisms. The composite microbial inoculum comprises Bacillus sp.BS-K1 and Pseudomonas sp.CN-B1, wherein the preservation number of the Bacillus is CCTCC NO: M20242022, and the preservation number of the Pseudomonas is CCTCC NO: M20242021. The composite microbial inoculum provided by the invention is prepared by compounding probiotics (Bacillus sp.BS-K1) and denitrifying bacteria (Pseudomonas sp.CN-B1) with antibacterial effect, and has excellent denitrification capability and inhibition effect on related pathogenic bacteria in water bodies when being applied to aquaculture water bodies, and can improve the removal efficiency of ammonia nitrogen and nitrite nitrogen in the aquaculture water bodies, reduce the quantity of related pathogenic bacteria and ensure the safety of aquaculture environment.

title_en: Intelligent garbage classification compression recovery device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent garbage classifying, compressing and recycling device, which relates to the technical field of garbage classifying and recycling devices and comprises a shell box body, wherein a garbage feeding hole is formed in the top of the shell box body, a bag breaking mechanism is arranged right below the garbage feeding hole, a screening groove connected with a vibrating mechanism is formed right below the bag breaking mechanism, a deflector wheel is arranged in the screening groove, a main control system is arranged below the screening groove, an ejectable conveying belt is arranged on the left side of the screening groove, a fan, a vacuum sucker group connected with a movable telescopic mechanism and a telescopic mechanism are arranged above the ejectable conveying belt, a compressing mechanism is arranged below the ejectable conveying belt, and the device can fully automatically complete garbage bag breaking, conveying, classifying and compressing, has obvious functions and strong universality for preliminary classification effects, is simple and reasonable in mechanical structure, and has popularization value.

title_en: Polymeric ferric sulfate chloride flocculant for pulping wastewater end and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a polymeric ferric sulfate chloride flocculant for pulping wastewater ends and a preparation method thereof, and the polymeric ferric sulfate chloride flocculant comprises the following steps of adding ferrous sulfate, hydrochloric acid and water into a batching kettle, stirring, transferring into a reaction kettle, stirring, adding a catalyst, adding oxygen for reaction for 150-180 min, introducing steam, and controlling the temperature to be 70-80 ℃; and stopping adding oxygen after the reaction is completed, cooling, and discharging to obtain the polymeric ferric sulfate chloride. According to the invention, hydrochloric acid is added in the production process, ferrous ions are oxidized into ferric ions under the action of a catalyst by using oxygen under the acidic condition, and the ferrous ions contain a large amount of aggregation and cations, so that the method has the advantages of high flocculation precipitation speed, wide applicable pH value range of 5-9, no corrosiveness to pipeline equipment, obvious water purification effect, capability of effectively removing color matters, suspended particles, heavy metal ions, colloid substances, organic matters and the like in water, and greatly reduces the production cost.

title_en: Treatment method of oil extraction wastewater based on solvent extraction
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for treating oil extraction wastewater based on solvent extraction, and belongs to the technical field of oil extraction wastewater treatment. The method comprises the steps of adding an adsorption material into an adsorption device to carry out adsorption treatment on oil extraction wastewater to obtain pretreated oil extraction wastewater, adding an acid regulator into the pretreated oil extraction wastewater obtained in the step one to regulate pH to obtain oil extraction wastewater with pH of 0-6, mixing a phosphorus-oxygen neutral extractant, an amide compound and alcohol to form an extractant, mixing the oil extraction wastewater with pH of 0-6 obtained in the step two with the extractant obtained in the step three, carrying out countercurrent 6-level extraction to combine oil organic matters in the oil extraction wastewater with the extractant to form an extract, and separating the extract from water phase, and reacting the stripping agent with the extract to recycle the organic matters in the oil extraction wastewater. And treating tertiary oil recovery wastewater by a solvent extraction method, and reducing COD in the wastewater to be discharged below the national relevant standard.

title_en: Alginate-based composite aerogel for chromium (III) ion adsorption and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an alginate-based composite aerogel for chromium (III) ion adsorption and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of environment-friendly materials; the composite aerogel is prepared by combining activated carbon converted by waste textiles and ferric oxide additives through carboxymethyl modification and hydrophobic modification alginate and a special process. Compared with the traditional adsorption material, the invention not only overcomes the obstruction of a hydration membrane to the adsorption process, but also improves the adsorption capacity and selectivity, realizes the efficient and rapid removal of chromium (III) ions in wastewater, and has the advantages of simple preparation method, controllable cost, wide application prospect and innovative solution for environmental protection and heavy metal pollution treatment.

title_en: Fire extinguishing device for new energy automobile charging pile
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire extinguishing device of a new energy automobile charging pile, which comprises a storage part for storing heat absorption media, a spraying part for spraying the heat absorption media and a conveying pipe for communicating the storage part and the spraying part, wherein a control valve for controlling the on-off of the conveying pipe is arranged on the conveying pipe, a reaction tank for monitoring the temperature is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the conveying pipe, a piston is in sliding and sealing fit in the reaction tank, a heat absorption expansion material is arranged on one side of the piston along the sliding direction, and the piston is in transmission connection with a valve rod in the control valve. In order to solve some among the prior art fill and set up extinguishing device in the electric pile, when filling the electric pile and break down and take place the fire, be difficult to in time carry out fire extinguishing treatment, make the intensity of a fire grow gradually, enlarge loss of property scope, and increased the problem to the threat of nearby personnel personal safety.

title_en: Carbon dioxide removal control method and device, controller, system and medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a carbon dioxide removal control method and device, a controller, a system and a medium, and belongs to the technical field of carbon emission reduction. The device comprises a reaction cabin, a cabin cover, a first electric valve, a gas conveying device and a carbon dioxide adsorption module, wherein the reaction cabin is provided with an opening, the cabin cover is movably connected with the reaction cabin and used for covering the opening, the first electric valve is connected with the cabin cover and used for controlling the opening or closing of the cabin cover, the gas conveying device is movably connected with the reaction cabin, when the cabin cover is in an open state, the gas conveying device is suspended in the opening, the gas conveying device blows air to the opening to form an air inlet, an air outlet is formed between the edge of the gas conveying device and the edge of the opening, air flows through the carbon dioxide adsorption module from the air inlet and is discharged from the air outlet, and when the cabin cover is in a closed state, the carbon dioxide adsorption module desorbs carbon dioxide. The embodiment of the application can improve the purity of the carbon dioxide gas.

title_en: High-salt wastewater activated carbon adsorption granular sludge regeneration treatment system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-salt wastewater activated carbon adsorption granular sludge regeneration treatment system and a high-salt wastewater activated carbon adsorption granular sludge regeneration treatment method, and relates to the technical field of wastewater treatment, wherein the system comprises an adjusting tank, an activated carbon adsorption tank, a carbon-water separation device, a deep treatment device and a clean water tank which are sequentially connected; the device comprises an activated carbon adsorption tank, a deep treatment device, a carbon-water separation device, a granular sludge regeneration device and a regeneration carbon-water separation device, wherein the activated carbon adsorption tank is used for adsorbing organic matters in high-salt wastewater, the deep treatment device is used for carrying out deep treatment on the residual organic matters and ammonia nitrogen in the wastewater, the carbon-water separation device is sequentially connected with the granular sludge regeneration device and the regeneration carbon-water separation device, the granular sludge regeneration device is used for carrying out regeneration treatment on saturated activated carbon, the regeneration carbon-water separation device is connected back to the activated carbon adsorption tank through a regeneration activated carbon return pipe, is connected back to the deep treatment device through a drainage pipe, and is connected back to the granular sludge regeneration device through a circulating pipe. The invention separates organic matters and salt through activated carbon adsorption, and carries out biological regeneration on the activated carbon saturated by adsorption through granular sludge, thereby realizing low-cost treatment of high-salt water.

title_en: Method and system for controlling chemical blockage of deep reinjection high mineralization mine water in full period
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for controlling chemical blockage of deep reinjection hypersalinity mine water in a full period, wherein the method comprises the following steps of firstly, collecting and detecting a water sample and monitoring basic indexes of the environment; the method comprises the steps of carrying out a simulation test to determine the quality of reinjection water, screening three filtering materials for removing iron ions and manganese ions in reinjection water, determining the optimal proportion, carrying out an indoor test to determine main chemical substances of reinjection blockage, selecting an acid agent, accurately removing chemical precipitation in calculated amount, and fully revealing three root causes of chemical blockage caused by reinjection of the deep water of a hypersalinity mine.

title_en: Tap device and mineral mineralization water purification equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a tap device and mineral water mineralizing and purifying equipment, the tap device comprises a tap main body, a mineralizing filter element and an adsorbing filter element are arranged in the tap main body, a first waterway and a second waterway are arranged in the tap main body, the mineralizing filter element is arranged in the first waterway, the adsorbing filter element is arranged in the second waterway, the tap main body is provided with a water inlet and a water outlet, an electric valve body is arranged in the tap main body and is used for controlling water flow passing through the water inlet to flow through the first waterway or the second waterway to the water outlet, the mineralizing filter element is used for adding proper mineral substances into drinking water, water flow of the second waterway can provide drinkable mineralized water for a user, the adsorbing filter element is used for adsorbing impurities in the water body and removing peculiar smell, namely, water flow of the second waterway can be used as domestic water, the user can switch and control through the electric valve body according to needs, a plurality of taps are not needed, installation and use are relatively convenient, and the tap device is more suitable for upgrading use scenes of the traditional tap.

title_en: Ecological restoration method for slow-flow river channel
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological restoration method for a slow-flow river channel, and relates to the technical field of river restoration. The method comprises the following steps of 1) preparing an ecological restoration carrier, 2) measuring the ecology suitability of river bottom sludge, 3) dividing river channels and 4) restoring the ecology of the river channels. Aiming at the different survival rates of aquatic plants in the moderate and slight pollution slow-flow river, the method divides the aquatic plants into different areas, and uses different ecological management schemes in a targeted manner. The survival rate of the submerged plant seedlings in the treated slow-flow river reach is obviously improved, and about 60% of the area of the river bed is covered by the submerged plant.

title_en: A gas filtration equipment for workshop
abstract_en: The invention discloses gas filtering equipment for a production workshop, which comprises a filter cartridge, wherein an air inlet pipe is fixedly arranged on the periphery of the filter cartridge, an air outlet pipe is arranged at the top of the filter cartridge, a discharge port is arranged at the bottom of the filter cartridge, a primary filter plate is arranged in the filter cartridge, a middle-effect filter plate and a high-effect filter plate are sequentially arranged above the primary filter plate, a fixed pipe is arranged at the bottom of the primary filter plate, cleaning bristles are arranged on the periphery of the fixed pipe, and a driving assembly is arranged below the center of the fixed pipe.

title_en: BHET hydrolase designed based on reverse folding algorithm and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a BHET hydrolase designed based on an inverse folding algorithm and a preparation method thereof, which relate to the technical field of biology, wherein an amino acid sequence is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1, the preparation method comprises the steps of selecting a polyester hydrolase PHL7, learning a protein crystal structure by a deep learning algorithm ProteinMPNN, carrying out three-dimensional structure modeling by utilizing Esmfold, carrying out molecular docking on candidate proteins and BHET, carrying out molecular dynamics simulation, screening out proteins with better binding with a substrate, carrying out expression and purification, and applying the BHET hydrolase in hydrolyzing the BHET. The invention can screen the BHET hydrolase from the candidate sequences generated in large quantities simply, rapidly and efficiently through the screening flow, and expands the source of the BHET hydrolase.

title_en: Test device and method for releasing fission source item in irradiated fuel element
abstract_en: The invention provides a test device and a method for releasing a fission source item in a irradiated fuel element, and relates to the technical field of nuclear safety fission product source item tests. The test device comprises a reaction kettle, a water circulation system and a pressure stabilizing system, wherein the water circulation system comprises a water tank, a water supplementing pump, a pressure stabilizing tank and a preheater which are sequentially connected through pipelines, the preheater is communicated with a feeding end of the reaction kettle, the pressure stabilizing tank is communicated with a discharging end of the reaction kettle, the discharging end of the reaction kettle is also provided with a circulation pump, the pressure stabilizing system comprises a gas steel bottle and a filter which are sequentially connected through pipelines, the filter is respectively communicated with the pressure stabilizing tank and the reaction kettle, an ion exchange bypass and a water condensation bypass are further arranged on a connecting pipeline of the pressure stabilizing tank and the reaction kettle, an ion exchange column is arranged on the ion exchange bypass, and a condenser is arranged on the water condensation bypass. The method can be used for carrying out dynamic source item tests of radionuclides so as to realize the research on the nuclide release behavior of irradiated fuel elements in various element forms.

title_en: Y0.4Sr0.6MnO3Perovskite porous load material and synthesis method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Y  0.4 Sr 0.6 MnO 3  perovskite porous load material, a synthesis method and application thereof, belonging to the field of catalyst materials for synthesizing pyrolysis CO  2  fuel. The invention aims to solve the problems of low stability of catalytic materials, low CO yield and low CO  2  conversion rate in the preparation process of solar thermochemical fuel (two-step method CO  2  catalytic cracking). The method comprises the steps of mixing EDTA and ammonia water solution, adding deionized water, heating in a water bath, magnetically stirring, adding Y (NO  3 ) 3 ·6H 2 O、Mn(NO 3 ) 2 ·4H 2  O and Sr (NO  3 ) 2  powder, adding citric acid monohydrate, adding ammonia water to adjust the pH value, keeping heating and stirring, drying, grinding, calcining, grinding, mixing with deionized water, attaching suspension drops to a SiC porous framework, blowing, and drying.

title_en: Colliery belt transportation straight pump rotary foam dust falling device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine belt conveying straight pump rotary foam dust settling device and method, wherein the device comprises a nozzle, an air inlet pipe, a mixing chamber, a rotary foaming chamber and a diffusion pipe, wherein the upper end of the nozzle is provided with a foam liquid inlet for connecting mixed foam liquid in proportion, the lower end of the nozzle is embedded into the mixing chamber, the air inlet pipe is used for conveying compressed air, one end of the air inlet pipe is communicated into a cavity of the mixing chamber, the mixing chamber is used for fully mixing the foam liquid and the compressed air to form mixed gas liquid, the rotary foaming chamber is connected with the lower end of the mixing chamber, the inner diameter of the rotary foaming chamber is smaller than the inner diameter of the mixing chamber, so that the mixed gas liquid is rotationally foamed, the inner diameter of the inner wall of the diffusion pipe is gradually increased along with the position approaching to the tail end, and the foamed foam is ejected from the tail end of the diffusion pipe. The device simple structure, simple to operate, dust fall is efficient, and can adjust the degree of foaming according to actual scene.

title_en: Alkali regeneration and recycling method for chemical wastewater treatment saturation activity Jiao Shuire
abstract_en: The application provides a chemical wastewater treatment saturated activity Jiao Shuire alkali regeneration and recycling method, and relates to the technical field of water treatment. The method comprises the steps of S1, placing saturated active coke for chemical industrial park wastewater treatment in a hydrothermal reaction kettle, S2, adding an alkali catalyst into the hydrothermal reaction kettle to obtain a solid-liquid mixture, S3, sealing the hydrothermal reaction kettle, heating the solid-liquid mixture to perform hydrothermal catalytic regeneration reaction, S4, discharging regenerated active coke and waste liquid generated in the regeneration process after the regeneration reaction is completed, and S5, flushing and recycling the regenerated active coke, wherein the waste liquid generated in the regeneration process is recycled. The method aims to solve the problems of poor regeneration effect, high carbon loss and high regeneration energy consumption of active coke in the prior art.

title_en: Water quality monitoring and medicament delivery integrated equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of water pollution treatment, in particular to water quality monitoring and medicament delivery integrated equipment, which comprises a treatment tank and a medicament delivery assembly, wherein the medicament delivery assembly is positioned at the inner side of the treatment tank and comprises a delivery tank and a piston, the piston is slidably arranged on the inner wall of the delivery tank, and the medicament delivery assembly extrudes medicament in the delivery tank through the movement of the piston in the delivery tank, so that the medicament is sprayed out from the delivery tank under the action of pressure, and the medicament delivery work is realized. When the liquid medicine is put in, the piston is lifted above the connecting hose, the liquid medicine is extruded by the piston, the liquid medicine is sprayed out of the putting tank through the liquid spraying pipe, different pressures are applied to the liquid medicine through the piston, the distance for spraying the liquid medicine is changed, the liquid medicine is sprayed with different radius distances by taking the putting tank as the center, the putting range of the liquid medicine is increased, the liquid medicine is better mixed with the waste water, and the purification effect on the waste water is promoted.

title_en: A filter edulcoration device for sludge treatment
abstract_en: The invention provides a filtering and impurity removing device for sludge treatment, which belongs to the technical field of sludge impurity removing and comprises a first mounting frame and a second mounting frame, wherein an inner cylinder and an outer cylinder are respectively arranged between the first mounting frame and the second mounting frame, the inner cylinder is positioned in the outer cylinder, driving mechanisms are arranged on the first mounting frame, the inner cylinder and the outer cylinder, a discharging channel is arranged between the first mounting frame and the second mounting frame at the lower side of the outer cylinder, a receiving channel is arranged at one side, far away from the discharging channel, of the second mounting frame, a cleaning plate is arranged between the inner cylinder and the outer cylinder, and a braking mechanism is also arranged in the second mounting frame. The invention solves the problems that the prior sludge is easy to cause mesh blockage after long-term use when being filtered, the solution to the mesh blockage problem of the filter cylinder is mainly to stop for blockage removal or rely on an external mechanical device for blockage removal, and has the defects of inconvenient operation, low efficiency and the like, and is easy to cause secondary pollution discharge and increase the production cost.

title_en: Separable mining carbon neutralization equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mining environment-friendly equipment, in particular to separable mining carbon neutralization equipment. The invention provides separable mining carbon neutralization equipment, which solves the technical problem of poor operation stability of the mining carbon neutralization equipment in the prior art. The separable mining carbon neutralization equipment comprises a front-stage component for separating out carbon dioxide in gas, a rear-stage component for carrying out adsorption treatment on the carbon dioxide separated out by the front-stage component and an air pump, wherein the separation membrane is used for separating the carbon dioxide in the gas, so that the carbon dioxide content in the gas entering the rear-stage component is higher, the impurity content of the gas entering the rear-stage component is low, and the adsorbent can be used for rapidly adsorbing the carbon dioxide, so that the stability of the mining carbon neutralization equipment in the working process is improved, and the treatment efficiency of the gas is improved.

title_en: Industrial waste treatment system and method
abstract_en: The application provides a treatment system and a method for industrial waste, comprising an iron removal treatment device, a purification reaction device, a precipitation reaction device and a carbon fixation treatment device, wherein the iron removal treatment device is used for obtaining industrial waste containing calcium and silicon, the industrial waste is used as a solid extract to be subjected to iron removal treatment to obtain a solid, the purification reaction device is used for obtaining a solid rich in silicon or aluminum and a reaction solution after a selective purification reaction is carried out by adding an alkaline hydroxide solution, the precipitation reaction device is used for obtaining a reaction solution and introducing gas containing carbon dioxide to be subjected to aeration treatment to obtain a mixed precipitate of silica gel and aluminum hydroxide and a carbonate solution, and the carbon fixation treatment device is used for obtaining a carbonate solution and carrying out carbon fixation treatment by adding alkaline and calcium-containing waste residues to obtain a regenerated alkaline hydroxide solution and precipitated calcium carbonate. Compared with the prior art, the application can reduce pollution energy consumption and realize carbon fixation treatment.

title_en: Efficient dephosphorization device for lake water body
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of lake water treatment, and provides a high-efficiency dephosphorization device for a lake water body, which comprises an assembly box capable of floating in a lake, wherein the bottom of the assembly box is provided with a suspension box, the whole device is supported by the buoyancy of the suspension box to float on the water surface of the lake, an assembly frame fixedly arranged on the assembly box, net baskets, filter tanks and filter boxes are symmetrically arranged on the assembly frame, the net baskets are used for planting green plant dephosphorization, the filter boxes are used for containing filter materials to further purify water treated by the filter tanks, and a return pipe fixedly communicated with the filter boxes can discharge the water purified by the filter boxes back to the lake. The efficient dephosphorization device for the lake water body solves the problem that the existing dephosphorization method for the lake water body is low in dephosphorization efficiency when facing high-concentration phosphorus pollution or large-area lakes.

title_en: Device for partially gasifying biomass fluidized bed and coproducing biochar synthetic gas tar and application method
abstract_en: A device for co-producing biochar synthetic gas tar through partial gasification of biomass fluidized bed and a use method thereof are provided, wherein the device gasifies the agricultural and forestry waste in an agricultural and forestry waste biomass feeding device in a low-temperature fluidized bed partial gasification furnace, then carries out solid-gas separation in a first cyclone separator and a second cyclone separator, the produced biochar is collected by a carbon cooling device, then carries out separation of tar through a high-temperature gasification chamber, a waste heat recovery device and a high-temperature dust collector, and finally carries out tar separation by a tar condensing device and an electric tar catcher, and finally carries out delivery to an external methanol synthesis unit through a synthetic gas fan.

title_en: Tail gas unpowered recovery system
abstract_en: The invention provides a tail gas unpowered recovery system which comprises a cryogenic separation cold box, an auxiliary system skid block, an intermediate heat exchanger, a second heat exchange pipeline and an ice machine pipeline, wherein the cryogenic separation cold box is communicated with the auxiliary system skid block through a liquid phase pipeline, a liquid phase product in the cryogenic separation cold box is conveyed to the auxiliary system skid block through the liquid phase pipeline, the intermediate heat exchanger is arranged on the liquid phase pipeline, the liquid phase pipeline is communicated with the first heat exchange pipeline of the intermediate heat exchanger, the second heat exchange pipeline of the intermediate heat exchanger is communicated with the ice machine pipeline, and an ice machine refrigerant enters the intermediate heat exchanger through the ice machine pipeline and exchanges heat with the liquid phase product. The invention solves the problem of high energy consumption of the tail gas unpowered recovery system in the prior art.

title_en: Method for degrading cadmium-polluted soil based on heavy metal passivating agent
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of soil regeneration, in particular to a method for degrading cadmium-polluted soil based on a heavy metal passivating agent, which comprises the following steps of S1, PB-MgAl-LDH preparation, S2, PB-MgAl-LDH magnetic modification, S3, passivating agent preparation and S4, and soil restoration. The pine bark and the magnesium aluminum hydrotalcite at the preferred specific growth position are prepared into solid powder with good specific surface area and adsorption activity through steady-state coprecipitation, the unique interlayer structure after magnetic modification is provided with magnetism, negative charges are easy to generate, the adsorption of cadmium is accelerated for balancing the charges, the effects of lattice diffusion, isomorphous substitution and the like are simultaneously generated, and the solid powder has strong ion exchange capacity and adsorption capacity on cadmium ions.

title_en: Drinking device
abstract_en: The invention discloses drinking equipment which comprises a machine body and a container detachably connected with the machine body, wherein the machine body comprises a sterilizing lamp and a driving mechanism, the container is provided with a through hole and a through hole adjusting mechanism, when the container is separated from the machine body, the through hole adjusting mechanism is positioned at a first position and seals the through hole, when the container is arranged on the machine body, the through hole is opposite to the sterilizing lamp, the driving mechanism drives the through hole adjusting mechanism to be positioned at a second position and expose the through hole, and light rays of the sterilizing lamp can be injected into the container through the through hole. The invention can automatically sterilize the purified water through the opening when the container is mounted on the drinking device, and prevent bacteria and impurities from entering from the opening when the container is taken out for use.

title_en: Synchronous carbon fixation and denitrification method and application
abstract_en: The invention provides a synchronous carbon fixation denitrification method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of solid waste resource utilization. The invention provides a synchronous carbon fixation and denitrification method which comprises the steps of enriching a microorganism group mainly containing hydrogen oxidizing bacteria in soil, enriching a microorganism group mainly containing sulfur oxidizing bacteria in soil, enriching a microorganism group mainly containing methane oxidizing bacteria in soil, mixing and inoculating the methane oxidizing bacteria enrichment flora, the sulfur oxidizing bacteria enrichment flora and the hydrogen oxidizing bacteria enrichment flora into a domestication culture medium for domestication culture, and then inoculating the domestication culture medium containing biogas slurry for synchronous carbon fixation and denitrification. The method of the invention forms a synergistic metabolic system by enriching and screening composite microorganism metabolic groups coexisting with a plurality of microorganism groups mainly comprising methane-oxidizing bacteria. The synergistic metabolism system has H  2  S tolerance, can metabolize methane and carbon dioxide in methane and N, P nutrient substances in methane liquid, and achieves the aim of synchronous carbon fixation and denitrification.

title_en: Battery pack protection device for new energy automobile
abstract_en: The invention discloses a battery pack protection device for a new energy automobile, which relates to the technical field of new energy automobile batteries and comprises a bottom plate, and further comprises coamings arranged on two sides of the bottom plate, wherein an installation assembly is arranged at the top of the coamings, a protection shell is arranged between the coamings, a damping buffer part is fixedly connected between the protection shell and the bottom plate, battery units are arranged in the protection shell, a baffle plate is fixedly connected in the protection shell between the battery units, a protection cover is sleeved outside the battery units, temperature detection assemblies are arranged at two ends of the protection cover, a fixing rod is arranged above the battery units, a fire extinguishing assembly and an auxiliary heat radiating assembly are respectively arranged at two ends of the installation block, a gas collecting pipe is fixedly connected at the bottom of the fixing rod, a one-way gas inlet valve is arranged at the gas inlet end of the gas collecting pipe, the gas collecting pipe extends to the upper part of the installation block, a one-way gas outlet valve is fixedly connected at the top of the gas collecting pipe, and piston assemblies are respectively arranged at two ends of the fixing rod.

title_en: Novel compound enhanced denitrification treatment method and system thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a novel compound enhanced denitrification treatment method and a system thereof, wherein the treatment method comprises the following steps of firstly carrying out primary treatment on sewage to obtain primary treated sewage, then carrying out partial nitrification treatment on the primary treated sewage to convert partial ammonia nitrogen in the primary treated sewage into nitrite nitrogen to form partial nitrified sewage, then carrying out anaerobic ammoxidation treatment on the partial nitrified sewage to generate nitrogen and anaerobic ammoxidation sewage, and carrying out denitrification treatment on the anaerobic ammoxidation sewage to generate nitrogen and denitrification sewage again, thereby realizing denitrification of sewage. The method combines partial nitrification, anaerobic ammoxidation and denitrification technologies, realizes high-efficiency denitrification, and has high total nitrogen removal rate.

title_en: Drainage device for saline-alkali soil treatment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of drainage treatment, and discloses a drainage device for treating saline-alkali soil, which solves the problems that a liquid leakage hole is easy to block, and disassembly and cleaning are too complicated and inconvenient to clean, the method comprises the steps of extracting water after treatment in a liquid guide groove, discharging air at the other end of a liquid storage plate into a magnetic plate through an exhaust pipe, providing stirring power and aeration collecting effect for saline-alkali water treatment, discharging water into the liquid storage groove through a connecting hose, then discharging the water through an annular liquid outlet plate and a spray head, blowing away and scraping impurities by utilizing water spraying and an arc scraping plate, and finally achieving the purposes of conveniently discharging the saline-alkali water, preventing alkali discharge pipe from being blocked and recycling treated water.

title_en: System and method for controlling blockage and scaling of desulfurization demister
abstract_en: A control system and a method for solving blockage and scaling of a desulfurization demister belong to the technical field of limestone-gypsum wet flue gas desulfurization. The invention solves the problem that the demister is blocked and scaled along with long-term operation of the existing desulfurization system. The invention relates to a process water tank, which is connected with a gypsum dehydration system, a pulping system and an absorption tower, wherein an industrial water tank is connected with the gypsum dehydration system and a wastewater system, the gypsum dehydration system is connected with the pulping system, the gypsum dehydration system and the pulping system are connected with the absorption tower, a demister flushing recovery tank is connected to a pipeline connected with the process water tank and a primary absorption tower, the primary absorption tower is connected with a demister flushing recovery tank, the demister flushing recovery tank is connected with the wastewater system, and the demister flushing recovery tank is connected to a pipeline connected with the gypsum dehydration system and the wastewater system. The system and the method for controlling the blockage and scaling of the desulfurization demister have good production and obvious environmental protection benefit, safety benefit and economic benefit.

title_en: Water treatment membrane filtration structure with cleaning function
abstract_en: The application provides a water treatment membrane filtering structure with a cleaning function, which comprises a tank body, wherein two upper shells and two lower shells which are oppositely distributed are respectively and fixedly arranged on the surface of the tank body, the upper shells are connected with a water inlet pipe through a communicating pipe, a baffle plate is in sealing fit with the surface of the tank body, a flow guiding mechanism is arranged in the middle of the baffle plate, an adjusting mechanism is movably sleeved on the surface of a water outlet pipe, and the tank body is arranged at the top of a supporting mechanism. According to the application, the filtering membrane in the tank body is used for separating impurities, and is matched with pipeline redirection, the cleaning of impurities attached to the surface of the membrane is realized by utilizing the impact of water flow, the problem of membrane gap increase caused by overlarge water pressure during back flushing can be solved, the service life and filtering performance of the water treatment membrane are effectively improved, the water flow direction is changed to flow along the surface of the water treatment membrane, and the flow direction is changed by arranging the flow guiding mechanism for changing the water flow direction, so that the cleaning treatment of any position on the surface of the membrane can be realized in the cleaning process, and the service performance of the filtering structure is effectively improved.

title_en: Application of adamantane-1, 3-diamine in preparing reverse osmosis membrane with controllable desalination performance, reverse osmosis membrane, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention provides application of adamantane-1, 3-diamine in preparing a reverse osmosis membrane with controllable desalination performance, a reverse osmosis membrane, a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the field of reverse osmosis membrane preparation. The reverse osmosis membrane with controllable desalination performance comprises a polysulfone ultrafiltration membrane and a polyamide layer arranged on the surface of the polysulfone ultrafiltration membrane, wherein the polyamide layer is formed by carrying out interfacial polymerization on an aqueous phase amine solution and an organic phase acyl chloride solution and then carrying out heat treatment and solidification, and the aqueous phase amine solution contains adamantane-1, 3-diamine. According to the invention, a series of SWRO membranes with the same surface morphology and the same similar permeation flux and different desalination performances are prepared by adding adamantane-1, 3-diamine, so that the diversified requirements of different application scenes can be flexibly met under the condition of not changing the existing water production process and membrane cleaning process, and the overall efficiency and economy of the system are improved.

title_en: Device and method for preparing molded fuel by coupling steam of coal-fired power plant with lignite
abstract_en: The invention provides a device and a method for preparing molded fuel by coupling steam of a coal-fired power plant, wherein the device comprises the following steps: the coal-fired boiler comprises a fluidized bed dryer, a coal mill and a mixer, wherein the heat source of the fluidized bed dryer is steam from a coal-fired power plant, the coal mill grinds dried lignite into coal powder, and the coal powder is sent into the boiler for combustion or the mixer to prepare finished coal. The invention makes full use of the heat of the steam from the coal-fired power plant, reduces the carbon emission of the fuel with unit calorific value, and realizes low carbon emission reduction. The steam is used for heating and drying the lignite, so that the water content of the lignite can be reduced, the heat value is improved, and the higher efficiency of the coal-fired power plant when the lignite is blended is realized. The lignite is ground by the coal mill and conveyed into the mixer to prepare finished coal suitable for outward transportation, so that the transportation cost of the lignite can be reduced.

title_en: Tail gas purification equipment and application thereof in preparation of N, N-dimethylamino ethyl acrylate
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tail gas treatment, in particular to tail gas purifying equipment and application thereof in preparation of N, N-dimethylamino ethyl acrylate, comprising a spray tower and a plurality of groups of spray mechanisms annularly arranged on the spray tower, wherein the spray mechanisms comprise two groups of spray nozzles, two groups of spray nozzles are arranged inside the spray tower, a feed pipe arranged outside the spray tower is connected with the spray nozzles, and one end of the feed pipe far away from the spray nozzles is provided with a discharge opening; the device comprises a feeding pipe, a filter screen plate, a knocking structure, a pumping pressure component and a pumping pressure component, wherein the feeding pipe is arranged in the device, the knocking structure is coaxially connected with the feeding pipe and can move towards a discharge opening to collide the filter screen plate, the pumping pressure component is connected with one end of the feeding pipe far away from the discharge opening and can alternately pump compressed gas towards two groups of feeding pipes and trigger the knocking structure to act before pumping the compressed gas so as to prevent the nozzle from being blocked and influencing the tail gas treatment effect.

title_en: High efficiency clinical medicine inspection smear equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of clinical medicine and discloses high-efficiency clinical medicine examination smear equipment, which comprises a cabinet body, wherein a first base is arranged at the top of the cabinet body, two first slide rails are arranged at the top of the first base at equal intervals, a plurality of clamping beads are arranged at the outer sides of the first slide rails at equal intervals, a clamping mechanism is arranged on one side of the first slide rails in a sliding mode, a clamping assembly is arranged on the other side of the first slide rails in a sliding mode, the front side of the cabinet body is connected with a cabinet door through a hinge, a partition plate is arranged on the inner side of the cabinet body, a drying assembly is arranged on the upper side of the partition plate, and a cleaning mechanism and a filtering mechanism are respectively arranged on the inner bottom wall of the cabinet body. The clamping and smearing mechanism is matched, so that manual operation is reduced, a plurality of glass slides can be processed simultaneously, smearing time is shortened, the internal drying assembly can be dried rapidly, pollution and time waste are avoided, sewage of the glass slides is filtered and cleaned effectively, the environment is protected, and peripheral cleaning of equipment is guaranteed.

title_en: Biomass pyrolysis carbonization system utilizing waste heat of ash slag of combustion furnace
abstract_en: The invention discloses a biomass pyrolysis carbonization system utilizing waste heat of ash residues of a combustion furnace, which comprises the combustion furnace and the pyrolysis carbonization furnace, wherein the pyrolysis carbonization furnace comprises a cylindrical furnace wall, a pyrolysis pipeline is coaxially installed in the furnace wall in a rotating manner, a pyrolysis cavity is formed in the pyrolysis pipeline, a gap between the pyrolysis pipeline and the inner wall of the furnace wall forms an ash residue cavity, an inner conveying screw is fixed on the inner wall of the pyrolysis pipeline, an outer conveying screw is fixed on the outer wall of the pyrolysis pipeline, the rotation direction of the inner conveying screw is opposite to that of the outer conveying screw, ash residues in the ash residue cavity are conveyed from front to back when the pyrolysis pipeline rotates, and biomass in the pyrolysis cavity is conveyed from back to front. The invention adopts the boiler combustion ash as a heat source for pyrolysis and carbonization to realize the pyrolysis of biomass, fully utilizes the waste heat of the ash, and has the effect of supporting combustion of the generated pyrolysis gas on the combustion furnace, thereby also solving the problem that the pyrolysis gas cannot be directly discharged.

title_en: Bisphenol F degradation gene cluster bpf and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bisphenol F degradation gene cluster bpf and application thereof. The invention separates strain DN12, which can degrade BPF and grow with BPF as the only carbon source and energy source. Based on the above, the invention obtains a BPF degradation gene cluster BPF from the strain DN12 by adopting whole genome and comparative transcriptome sequencing analysis. Three different degrading enzymes (two-component oxidase BpfAB, monooxygenase BpfC, hydrolase BpfD) were found in this gene cluster to catalyze the progressive degradation of BPF to produce the simple aromatic ring compound parahydroxybenzoic acid.

title_en: CO (carbon monoxide)2In-situ efficient adsorption coupling conversion dual-function integral material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of adsorption materials, in particular to a double-function integral material for CO  2  in-situ efficient adsorption coupling conversion and a preparation method thereof. The invention adopts a hydrothermal synthesis method based on an in-situ coupling mechanism to prepare a metal and nonmetal multi-doped material in situ, wherein the radius of skeleton metal ions is smaller than that of coupling metal ions, the skeleton metal is uniformly dispersed on a ZSM-5 skeleton, metal oxides are highly dispersed on the surface of the ZSM-5, and more active sites such as oxygen vacancies, acid sites and the like are exposed on the surface of a ZSM-5 matrix.

title_en: CdMoO A4Multi-functional catalyst of @ MWCNT (MWCNT), and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a CdMoO  4  @MWCNT multifunctional catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of environmental pollutant treatment. The preparation method comprises the steps of adding cadmium salt into ethylene glycol to dissolve to obtain a mixed solution, adding multi-wall carbon nanotubes and polyethylene glycol, uniformly stirring, then adding Na  2 MoO 4 ·2H 2  O ethylene glycol solution, and finally performing solvothermal reaction to obtain the CdMoO  4  @MWCNT multifunctional catalyst. The CdMoO  4  @MWCNT multifunctional catalyst disclosed by the invention not only can be used for detecting the concentration of EE2, but also can activate PMS to catalyze and remove EE2, so that seamless connection from monitoring to treatment is realized, and an efficient scheme is provided for comprehensive prevention and control of EE2 pollution. In the application of EE2 detection, the method has high sensitivity, high stability and strong anti-interference performance. The catalyst has the performance of activating PMS to efficiently degrade EE2 in the application of catalyzing and removing EE2 and has strong anti-interference performance.

title_en: Dust filtering workbench for polymer lithium electronic battery production
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of filtering devices, in particular to a dust filtering workbench for polymer lithium electronic battery production, which comprises a shell, wherein a battery processing chamber is formed in the inner wall of the top of the shell, and a dust collecting chamber and a water tank are formed in the inner wall of the shell, which is positioned below the battery processing chamber. According to the invention, the water storage tank is arranged, so that a small amount of water can be received by the water storage tank when the rotary table drives the water storage tank to rotate from the water to the upper limit position, and the water in the water storage tank flows to the filter holes along the backflow grooves under the action of gravity, so that dust blocked in the filter holes is washed, the condition that the filter holes are blocked is further avoided, and meanwhile, when the brush rotates, the water in the backflow grooves can be pulled to the dust collection chamber, so that water drops which are pulled by the brush after the air current carries dust into the dust collection chamber are quickly captured, and the condition of secondary dust emission is avoided.

title_en: Synthesis method of magnetic cobalt ferrite Fenton-like catalyst
abstract_en: The invention provides a synthesis method of a magnetic cobalt ferrite Fenton catalyst, which comprises the following steps of S1, preparing a catalyst raw material, S2, preparing a catalyst solution, S3, preparing and optimizing catalyst crystal precipitation, S4, adjusting and optimizing catalyst stability, S5, converting catalyst solid phase, S6, functionalizing the catalyst, S7, testing the performance of a finished catalyst, sequentially preparing the raw material, preparing the solution, preparing the crystal precipitation, adjusting stability, converting solid phase, functionalizing the catalyst and testing the performance of the catalyst raw material through the seven steps, wherein the catalyst is synthesized by adopting a coprecipitation method and a template method in the preparation process of the crystal precipitation, so that the growth rate and the grain size of the crystal are controlled, the growth direction and the growth rate of the crystal are improved, the functional group and the coating agent with higher stability are introduced into the catalyst through the action of the template, and the surface of the catalyst is protected.

title_en: Dust collector is used in production of graphite carbon material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dust removing device for graphite carbon material production, which relates to the field of graphite carbon material production and solves the problem that the existing dust removing device is easy to cause the blockage of an air suction pipeline, and the dust removing device comprises a device shell and a box body, wherein a graphite rod feed inlet is formed in the outer side of the device shell, an electric hydraulic rod is arranged at the top of the device shell, an electric tool apron is arranged at the bottom end of the electric hydraulic rod, two atomizing nozzles are arranged in the outer side of the device shell, and two water tanks are arranged at the top of the device shell and are in butt joint with the atomizing nozzles through a water suction pump; the powder collecting mechanism is used for collecting graphite dust processed by the atomizing nozzle into the box body, and is arranged on the inner side of the box body; according to the invention, through the powder collecting mechanism, the two atomizing nozzles can carry out dust fall treatment on graphite dust generated during graphite rod processing, and the formed graphite powder slurry can enter the box body along with water flow discharged by the atomizing nozzles, so that the effects of rapid dust removal and blockage prevention are achieved.

title_en: Titanium-loaded microorganism solidified particle water treatment agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a titanium-carrying microorganism curing granule water treatment agent and a preparation method thereof, relating to the technical field of water treatment; the titanium-loaded microorganism curing granule water treatment agent comprises a citric acid and titanium dioxide double-modified adsorbent, a magnetic stripping bentonite-based aerogel material, bacillus subtilis and throwing yeast, wherein active thalli of the bacillus subtilis and the throwing yeast are loaded on the citric acid and titanium dioxide double-modified adsorbent and then form mechanical interlocking with the magnetic stripping bentonite-based aerogel material, so that a pore structure is enriched, adsorption sites are increased, the adsorption capacity of the water treatment agent on heavy metal ions and organic pollutants is enhanced, the curing property of the water treatment agent on microorganisms is also improved, adverse effects of acid-base environment on microorganisms are reduced, and the microorganisms are combined with functional materials to fully exert adsorption and decomposition effects, so that various pollutants in a water body are reduced.

title_en: Device and method for treating blue algae by using aquatic plant water hyacinth
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for treating blue algae by utilizing aquatic plant water hyacinth, and relates to the technical field of water treatment, the device comprises a floating plate and a first fixed plate, wherein the outer side of the floating plate is movably connected with a first servo motor, the outer side of the first servo motor is fixedly connected with a transverse plate, a dragging water hyacinth component is jointly arranged on the floating plate, the first servo motor and the transverse plate, the first servo motor is started to drive a first fluted disc and a second fluted disc to rotate, the first fluted disc and the second fluted disc are simultaneously rotated to pull a first dragging rope and enable the first dragging rope to be wound on the outer sides of a first wire winding device and a second wire winding device, a blue algae gathering component is jointly arranged on the floating plate and the first fixed plate, the second dragging rope is dragged in the horizontal direction by the movement of a baffle, the rotation of a driven shaft drives a second water poking plate to rotate, and the rotation of the first water poking plate and the second water poking plate can gather external blue algae on the upper part of the floating plate.

title_en: Multiple chemical waste gas treatment equipment utilizing biological treatment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of waste gas treatment equipment, and discloses multi-chemical waste gas treatment equipment utilizing biological treatment, which comprises a shell, wherein the circumferential surface of the shell is fixedly connected with supporting legs, and the inner wall of the shell is in through connection with an air outlet pipe; when the waste gas is treated, the waste gas enters the shell through the air inlet pipe, and after the waste gas enters the shell, the waste gas can be purified by microorganisms cultured on the surface of the culture tank, but after long-term purification, the air holes at the bottom of the culture tank can be blocked by dust in the waste gas, so that dust attached to the bottom of the culture tank can be scraped off, excessive dust accumulation is avoided, the purification effect of the microorganisms on the waste gas is influenced, and meanwhile, the culture tank can be knocked, so that the accumulated dust can be well hung off, the cleaning effect of the dust is further enhanced, and the air holes at the bottom of the culture tank are prevented from being blocked, so that the purification effect of the microorganisms on the waste gas is poor.

title_en: Alum form monitoring method based on optical detection and water treatment dosing method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an alum form monitoring method based on optical detection, a water treatment dosing method and a water treatment dosing system, and relates to the technical field of water treatment. The method comprises the steps of carrying out edge detection on absorbance scanning data to obtain alum blossom shape inflection points, recording alum blossom entity boundary position information, determining multi-band measured light source wavelengths based on an alum blossom structure to obtain alum blossom equipotential surface data sets corresponding to different light source wavelengths, taking metal ion hydrate polymerized in an alum blossom core layer as a center according to the alum blossom equipotential surface data sets corresponding to different light source wavelengths, taking an epitaxial extension layer as a segmentation carrier, screening and determining the alum blossom data sets, and further determining equivalent parameters of the alum blossom shape. According to the invention, the alum blossom shape is monitored from the optical absorbance detection angle, so that the analysis accuracy is quicker and more reliable, and the practicability is better.

title_en: Preparation method of catalytic material for removing new pollutants in complex water environment
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a catalytic material for removing new pollutants in a complex water environment, which comprises the following steps of preparing a metal organic framework material in a step 10, preparing ferric oxide particles in the metal organic framework material in a step 20 to obtain a limited-domain iron nano material, and vertically growing molybdenum disulfide nano sheets on the surface of the limited-domain iron nano material in a step 30 to obtain the catalytic material. The preparation method of the catalytic material for removing the new pollutants in the complex water environment provided by the invention has excellent anti-interference capability in the complex water environment, and improves the reaction activity.

title_en: Method for jointly treating heavy metal sewage by microorganisms
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for treating heavy metal sewage by combining microorganisms, which adopts a microorganism-containing treating agent to treat the heavy metal sewage, wherein the microorganism-containing treating agent comprises a microorganism preparation and an adsorbent, the microorganism preparation is bdellovibrio agent, the adsorbent is bentonite-based adsorption particles, heavy metal ions in the sewage can be better removed by adopting the method, the heavy metal pollution degree of the sewage is reduced, the treatment time is obviously shortened, and the sewage treatment efficiency is improved.

title_en: River and lake water ecological treatment equipment and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of lake water ecology, and particularly provides river and lake water ecology treatment equipment and method. This ecological management equipment of river lake water includes floats hose, aquatic green planting cultivation subassembly, link gear and root system cutting module, and the lateral part that floats the hose is equipped with the aeration pipe, and aquatic green planting cultivation subassembly includes the body base and sets up the cultivation dish at body base top, body base flexonics float hose and float on the river lake surface, and aquatic green planting is cultivated and is offered on the subassembly and is link up cultivation dish and body base's planting hole, and link gear is established the drive seat on the aeration pipe including the cover and is connected the actuating lever that drives the drive seat and move for the body base on the drive seat, according to aquatic green growth habit of planting can know, even the saw bit prunes the root system, nevertheless still can guarantee that root system has sufficient length to be located the water bottom to solved the easy overgrowth of plant root system and pricked the bed mud, cause secondary pollution after rotting problem.

title_en: Total heat exchanger and ventilator
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a total heat exchanger and a ventilator having a humidity control function, capable of reducing thermal resistance and performing heat exchange efficiently. The total heat exchanger of the present disclosure includes a heat exchange element having a three-dimensional shape, a humidity control material provided to the heat exchange element, and a cylindrical heat storage unit provided so as to communicate one side and the other side of a blowing direction in which air is blown to the heat exchange element.

title_en: Formaldehyde adsorption treatment device for building construction
