abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of formaldehyde treatment, in particular to a formaldehyde adsorption treatment device for building construction, which comprises an outer cover, wherein the front end of the outer cover is provided with a front cover, the front cover is internally provided with a spring which backwards stretches into the outer cover, two sides of the outer cover are provided with intercommunicated assembly holes, two assembly holes are internally provided with bearings, a rotating shaft is fixed between the two bearings, a self-adjusting wheel is arranged on the rotating shaft, the self-adjusting wheel is positioned at the rear side of a self-adjusting plate, a charging space is formed between the self-adjusting wheel and the self-adjusting plate, the upper side and the lower side of the outer cover are penetrated with purifying pipes, and the front end of each purifying pipe penetrates out of the front cover.

title_en: Recovery integrated device of high oily industrial sludge
abstract_en: The invention discloses a recovery integrated device of high-oil-content industrial sludge, which belongs to the technical field of sludge recovery treatment, wherein sludge in a feeding cylinder is conveyed leftwards through an auger, water can be injected into the feeding cylinder from a plurality of branch pipes by a water guide ring, so that the water can be fully contacted with the sludge, the subsequent oil-water separation effect is facilitated, the sludge can be guided between a first grinding disc and a second grinding disc in the rotating process of the second grinding disc, the sludge can be deeply ground by two abrasive textures in opposite directions in the first grinding disc and the second grinding disc, the particle size of particles in the sludge is reduced, the water is continuously sprayed into the sludge by the branch pipes, the sludge grinding effect is further improved by a water grinding mode, the contact area between the particles in the sludge and the water is increased, the oil layer adsorbed in the sludge can be effectively removed, the oil-solid phase separation effect is improved, and the sludge can reach the recovery standard.

title_en: SCR flue gas denitration system based on ammonium carbamate
abstract_en: The invention discloses an SCR flue gas denitration system based on ammonium carbamate, which comprises a storage bin, a conveying unit, a pyrolysis unit, a pressure stabilizing unit, a drying unit, a filtering unit and an SCR denitration unit, wherein the pyrolysis unit is used for pyrolyzing ammonium carbamate powder to generate mixed gas of ammonia and carbon dioxide, the pressure stabilizing unit is used for stabilizing pressure and cooling the mixed gas, the filtering unit is used for filtering a drying agent in the mixed gas, and the SCR denitration unit is used for receiving the mixed gas exhausted by the filtering unit so as to reduce nitrogen oxides in the flue gas into nitrogen and water. The invention obviously reduces energy consumption and operation cost, solves the problem of low normal temperature stability of the ammonium carbamate, and effectively reduces the adverse effect of ammonia gas carrying moisture and dust generated in the processes of dissolving, dehydrating, filtering and the like of the ammonium carbamate on the denitration process of the catalyst in the subsequent SCR denitration unit.

title_en: Livestock and poultry breeding wastewater treatment device and method based on microbial deodorization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a livestock and poultry breeding wastewater treatment device and method based on microorganism deodorization, wherein the device comprises a treatment tank, a biological cabin, a liquid inlet port, a liquid outlet port and a driving motor, wherein the biological cabin is sequentially provided with first-level to fifth-level implantation areas, each level of implantation is formed by separating a separation disc seat, implantation edges with different microorganism adhesion structures are arranged in the biological cabin, and a multi-level collaborative purification system is formed by combining a rotation-direction turbulent flow guide wheel and a liquid distribution mechanism. Each stage is respectively used for producing acid, producing methane, denitrifying, nitrifying and inhibiting odor of microalgae-spore bacteria terminals, so that the high-efficiency removal of volatile fatty acid, ammonia nitrogen, nitrate and residual odor substances is realized. The device has compact structure and definite partition, has self-disturbance, self-cleaning and terminal illumination enhancement functions, and is suitable for the sectional deodorization and purification treatment of the livestock and poultry cultivation high-load wastewater.

title_en: Low-temperature economizer system and coal power generation equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal-fired thermal power units, in particular to a low-temperature economizer system and coal-fired power generation equipment, which comprise a shell-and-tube heat exchanger and a plurality of groups of plate heat exchangers, wherein the plate heat exchangers are arranged in a flue at the tail part of a boiler and internally provided with heat medium water; the tail flue gas of the boiler is cooled and discharged after heat exchange with heat medium water in the plate heat exchanger, the heat medium water after heat exchange with the flue gas is returned to the plate heat exchanger after heat exchange with the shell heat exchanger, the tail flue gas of the boiler is continuously cooled, a medium in the shell heat exchanger is condensation water, and a soot blower is arranged in a flue at the upstream of the plate heat exchanger and used for removing soot in the plate heat exchanger. The system abandons the traditional H-shaped finned tube or spiral finned tube heat exchange, adopts the plate heat exchanger to cooperate with the shell-and-tube heat exchanger to circulate heat medium water, exchanges heat for flue gas at the tail part of the boiler, and can effectively prevent dust accumulation and blockage and ensure the stable operation of the low-temperature economizer system compared with the traditional H-shaped finned tube or spiral finned tube heat exchange.

title_en: Carbon dioxide conversion system and carbon dioxide conversion method
abstract_en: The application relates to a carbon dioxide conversion system which comprises a first mixing chamber, an electrochemical reactor, a first conversion unit and a second conversion unit, wherein a feeding end of the first mixing chamber is suitable for introducing a reactant to be reacted with water, a discharging end of the first mixing chamber is communicated with a feeding end of the electrochemical reactor, the electrochemical reactor is configured for carrying out a half-water decomposition reaction on the water to generate hydroxyl ions and hydrogen ions and respectively reacts with the reactant to be reacted to generate a first product and a second product based on the generated hydroxyl ions and hydrogen ions, the feeding end of the first conversion unit is communicated with the first discharging end of the electrochemical reactor and is configured for converting the first product generated by the electrochemical reactor, and a feeding end of the second conversion unit is communicated with the second discharging end of the electrochemical reactor and is configured for capturing and converting carbon dioxide into a third product by utilizing the second product generated by the electrochemical reactor.

title_en: Intelligent fire service management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire control management, and discloses an intelligent fire control service management system, which comprises the following components: the system comprises a data acquisition unit, a fusion unit, an adjustment unit, a battery health degree score and a data deviation degree, wherein the data acquisition unit is used for acquiring three basic parameters of environment data, working condition data and battery data of fire-fighting objects in an office building, the data acquisition unit is used for acquiring environment, working condition and battery data of a fire extinguisher, the fusion unit is used for generating a dynamic composite abnormal threshold value, the adjustment unit is used for executing a three-level sampling frequency adjustment mechanism according to the threshold value, the battery health degree score and the data deviation degree, the three-level sampling frequency adjustment mechanism means that when the fire extinguisher is normal in state and low in risk, the sampling frequency can be reduced to reduce battery energy consumption, and when the risk is increased or the battery health degree is reduced, the sampling frequency is increased again to ensure a monitoring effect, the whole system realizes accurate management and control of the battery according to the actual working condition of the fire extinguisher, the waste of energy is avoided, the service life of the battery is prolonged, the cost of frequently replacing the battery is reduced, and the sustainable performance of intelligent fire-fighting management is enhanced.

title_en: Waste gas purifying device for treating atmospheric pollution
abstract_en: The invention provides an exhaust gas purification device for atmospheric pollution treatment, and relates to the field of atmospheric treatment. This an exhaust gas purification device for atmospheric pollution is administered, including shell and the inside filter unit that can rotate relative to the shell of shell, the inside of shell is provided with the parcel in the filter unit outside and can make the filter unit pass through air inlet unit. This an exhaust gas purification device for atmospheric pollution is administered, clean air enters into the inside of keeping in bellows, the blowback process is for opening the baffle and spills the return air inlet, make the sealing block remove under telescopic sleeve A's effect, make partial sealing block overlap with the air outlet, and then can make partial clean air enter into the inside of blowback unit from the return air pipe, carry out the blowback to the filter unit from filter unit's reverse side exhaust gas, the dust of blowback is discharged from the drain, reduce the effective exhaust area of exhaust pipe through control sealing block, thereby can increase the ability of air velocity of flow increase blowback.

title_en: Powder recovery unit that polycrystalline silicon processing was used
abstract_en: The invention relates to a powder recovery device for polysilicon processing, which comprises a recovery box, an external channel I and an external channel II, wherein the external channel I is in butt joint with the upper half section, the external channel II is in butt joint with the lower half section, guide frames are distributed on the inner edge of the recovery box in a mirror image mode, the guide frames are arranged in a pair, frame grids are embedded in the guide frames, bolts are arranged on the guide frames in a telescopic motion mode, a linkage module is arranged in the recovery box, an inner treatment module is arranged on the lower inner edge of the recovery box, and the linkage module is positioned in the middle position of the frame grids and the inner treatment module. This powder recovery unit that polycrystalline silicon processing was used is through the synergism of linkage module and reciprocal unit, and mediation pad and hair pad are reciprocal mediation to frame grid, effectively clear away accumulational powder, ensure that gaseous medium smoothly circulates.

title_en: Integrated catalytic combustion reformer and reforming method
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of solid oxide fuel cells and discloses an integrated catalytic combustion reformer and a reforming method, wherein the catalytic combustion reformer comprises a burner part, a reformer part and a reformer part, wherein the reformer part comprises two porous partition plates fixedly arranged on two sides of an inner shell and a plurality of single-tube structures arranged in parallel, two ends of each single-tube structure are respectively fixed on reserved holes of the two porous partition plates, gaps between all the single-tube structures and the inner shell form a combustion cavity, reforming catalysts are coated in the single-tube structures, the outer walls of the single-tube structures are uniformly coated with the combustion catalysts, the combustion cavity is used for burning mixed combustion gas under the action of the combustion catalysts and providing heat for all the single-tube structures, and the internal cavities of all the single-tube structures are used for absorbing heat by the mixed reforming gas and reforming reaction under the action of the reforming catalysts to obtain hydrogen-rich mixed gas. The catalytic combustion reformer and the reforming method solve the technical problems of low energy utilization rate and increased material cost.

title_en: Shot blasting smoke dust collecting and processing device for sewing machine head casting
abstract_en: The invention provides a shot blasting smoke dust collecting and treating device for sewing machine head casting, which comprises a collecting and treating tower, wherein a supporting frame is welded around the lower end of the collecting and treating tower, a maintenance cover is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the collecting and treating tower through bolts, an air outlet pipeline is welded in the maintenance cover, a sieve plate is fixedly arranged above the inside of the collecting and treating tower through bolts, a water spraying pipe is arranged on the surface of the sieve plate, an assembling pipe is connected with the rear side of the inside of the collecting and treating tower through bolts, the front end of the assembling pipe is in threaded connection with the water spraying pipe, a scattered collecting and paving pipe frame structure is connected with the left end of the collecting and treating tower, and an air inlet scattered square pipe structure is connected with the right side of the collecting and treating tower. According to the invention, through the arrangement of the scattered collection laying pipe frame structure, the dust collection range is increased in the shot blasting machine, so that dust is prevented from drifting into the surrounding environment from the opening of the shot blasting machine when the switch of the shot blasting machine replaces the sewing machine head, thus the pollution to the working environment is prevented, and the safety of the working environment is increased.

title_en: Thermal power generating unit optimal control method under deep peak shaving and related equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal-fired thermal power units, in particular to an optimal control method and relevant equipment for a thermal power unit under deep peak shaving, wherein coal mill combinations and burner arrangements are determined according to loads of the thermal power unit under deep peak shaving, air quantity and pulverized coal fineness of coal mills are calibrated according to different loads, then primary air speed and pulverized coal quantity are calibrated, when the unit is under set load, combustion stability and pollutant emission tests are conducted, total air quantity fed into a furnace is adjusted according to results, oxygen content is reduced in stages, parameters of the coal mills such as ventilation quantity reduction, outlet air temperature reduction and pulverized coal fineness reduction are optimized according to the combustion stability tests, and a denitration system is optimized according to pollutant emission test results.

title_en: Positively charged nanofiltration membrane for rapid extraction of lithium ions and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a positively charged nanofiltration membrane for rapidly extracting lithium ions, which sequentially comprises an organic phase modification layer, a water phase modification layer and an ultrafiltration support layer, wherein the organic phase modification layer, the water phase modification layer and the ultrafiltration support layer are fixedly connected through polymerization reaction. According to the invention, the gamma-cyclodextrin is subjected to quaternization modification, so that the separation factor of magnesium lithium ions can be improved, and the efficient separation of magnesium lithium ions can be realized. The quaternized gamma-cyclodextrin with the weight percent of 0.1 to 0.7 is introduced into the aqueous phase solution, so that the positive charge density of the surface of the membrane can be increased, the interception capability of divalent salt is improved, and the separation effect is improved. Meanwhile, the water flux is not affected, and the treatment efficiency is high.

title_en: A processing apparatus for silicone rubber waste material
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of waste material treatment, in particular to a treatment device for silicon rubber waste material, which adopts the following proposal that the device comprises a box body, wherein the outer wall of one side of the box body is rotationally connected with a feeding cover plate, the top of the box body is connected with a top cover in a threaded way, the inner wall of the box body is provided with a treatment box, the top of the treatment box is fixedly connected with a top box, the top of the top box is fixedly connected with a fourth motor, and the bottom of the fourth motor is fixedly connected with a rotating shaft. According to the invention, through the integrated design of a liquid spraying cleaning mechanism, a liquid nitrogen crushing mechanism, a grinding and thinning mechanism and the like in the treatment box, after the feeding cover plate is opened, silicon rubber waste can be placed in the treatment box, the fourth motor drives the rotating shaft to rotate, the liquid spraying head sprays cleaning liquid to clean the waste, the liquid nitrogen storage box is used for introducing liquid nitrogen into the treatment box through the air inlet pipe to crush the waste at a low temperature, the scraping plate collides with the convex block to drive the treatment box to vibrate and sieve, and the grinding table is matched with the grinding wall to thin particles.

title_en: Method for preparing high-performance electrolyzed water catalyst by roll-to-roll combustion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing a high-performance electrolyzed water catalyst by roll-to-roll combustion, which relates to the technical field of electrolyzed water hydrogen production, and comprises a feeding position, a conveying device, a liquid reservoir, a combustion device and a winding device, wherein the feeding position and the conveying device are arranged on a preparation table, the feeding position comprises a fixed seat, the feeding position, the conveying device, the liquid reservoir, the combustion device and the winding device are arranged in the preparation process of electrode materials, the conveying device conveys the substrate materials, the liquid reservoir enables combustion raw materials required by combustion to be continuously attached to the surface of the substrate materials, the combustion device ignites the combustion raw materials on the surface of the substrate materials, flame is automatically extinguished after all combustion raw materials are combusted, so that the electrode materials are formed, the formed electrode materials are wound by the winding device, the whole preparation process is free from interference of external factors, and the high-quality electrode materials can be prepared in a large scale, and the convenience and the efficiency of the preparation of the electrode materials are improved.

title_en: Low temperature asphalt is portable asphalt mixing plant for stirring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile asphalt mixing station for low-temperature asphalt mixing, which comprises a main box body, wherein a central through groove is formed in the middle of a top plate of the main box body, a feeding hopper is positioned right below the central through groove, the feeding hopper is positioned in the main box body, connecting support seats are fixed at the front part and the rear part of the middle parts of the bottom surfaces of a left side plate and a right side plate of the feeding hopper, and weighing sensors are arranged on the bottom surfaces of the connecting support seats. The air in the main box body is dried, when materials are stirred in the stirring tank, water is not basically generated in stirring, the stirring effect is guaranteed, stones are directly sensed and weighed after being poured into the feeding hopper, the accuracy of feeding quantity is guaranteed, the stones are not required to be individually weighed before feeding, the operation procedures before feeding are reduced, meanwhile, the stones are firstly poured into the asphalt filling tank, the stones are conveyed into the stirring tank through the asphalt conveying pump, continuous conveying can be achieved, the asphalt filling tank can automatically weigh the entering stones, and the early-stage weighing process is omitted.

title_en: SNCR denitration control method and system for automatically adjusting ammonia injection boiler
abstract_en: The invention discloses a boiler SNCR denitration control method and system capable of automatically adjusting ammonia injection, and relates to the technical field of boiler denitration, wherein the boiler SNCR denitration control method comprises a reducing agent supply unit, a multi-stage injection unit, a temperature monitoring network, a flue gas analysis monitoring module and a control unit; the reducing agent supply unit consists of a urea solution storage tank, a high-pressure conveying module and a parallel filtering branch, the multi-stage injection unit comprises a plurality of layers of atomizing spray gun arrays, the temperature monitoring network is provided with a plurality of groups of thermocouple pieces, the flue gas temperature in the boiler can be monitored in real time through a set control system and a set control method, the opening and closing of the atomizing spray guns are controlled through the control system according to the flue gas temperature, the accurate matching of the ammonia injection quantity is realized, the real-time monitoring of the denitration efficiency condition is realized, the waste of urea solution consumption is avoided, the denitration raw material cost is reduced, the automatic regulation of the ammonia injection of the SNCR denitration system of the boiler is realized, and the excessive injection of the urea solution is avoided, and the operation cost is increased.

title_en: Leachate treatment method based on microalgae coupling nitrification process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a leachate treatment method based on microalgae coupling nitrification process, which belongs to the field of wastewater biological treatment and intelligent control, and comprises the steps of constructing initial reaction conditions suitable for microalgae proliferation and nitrification reaction, collecting operation parameters such as ammonia nitrogen concentration, nitrite concentration, dissolved oxygen, temperature, microalgae concentration and the like to form real-time operation data, calculating optimal combination of illumination intensity, carbon source addition rate, circulation ratio and reaction duration based on a weighted multiparameter fitting relation, calling historical data to perform trend analysis when ammonia nitrogen removal rate is continuously lower than a threshold value, dynamically correcting fitting weight, applying correction results to control illumination condition and water inlet and outlet ratio, and updating a fitting model in an incremental learning mode after the operation period is finished to realize continuous optimization of a control strategy.

title_en: Multistage multi-medium wastewater treatment and filtration device and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multistage multi-medium wastewater treatment filtering device and method, and relates to the technical field of wastewater treatment, and the multistage multi-medium wastewater treatment filtering device comprises a stationary processing tank, wherein a plurality of groups of filtering tanks for carrying out level treatment on wastewater are arranged in the processing tank along the circumferential direction, each filtering tank consists of a fixed tank body, a movable tank body and a tank cover, a control rod is arranged in the middle of each filtering tank, a plurality of groups of filtering frames for filtering wastewater are arranged on the control rod at equal intervals, different types of filtering media are filled in the filtering frames, a control piece for controlling the filtering tanks to shake so as to improve the filtering efficiency is arranged at the bottom of each filtering tank, and cleaning pieces for cleaning hardened garbage are arranged at the inner side of each filtering tank. According to the invention, a multistage multi-medium filtering mode is adopted, four groups of filtering tanks are used for sequentially treating wastewater, and filtering frames in each group of filtering tanks are filled with different types of filtering media, so that different pollutants in the wastewater can be effectively removed, and the filtering efficiency and the quality of the treated water are greatly improved.

title_en: Continuous production device and production method for silicon-carbon anode material
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of production of silicon-carbon anode materials, in particular to a continuous production device and a continuous production method for preparing a silicon-carbon anode material by taking porous carbon, silane and hydrocarbon gas as raw materials. The device comprises fluidized beds A1 and B1, storage tanks A2, A4, B2 and B4, cyclone separators A3, B3 and C2 and a heat exchanger C1, and realizes stable fluidization and continuous production of materials through multistage variable-flow fluidized bed design. The method comprises the steps of cracking the porous carbon by silane, embedding silicon, cracking the hydrocarbon gas, coating the carbon by cracking, cooling and separating to finally obtain the silicon-carbon anode material with high capacity and high first coulomb efficiency. The application can obviously improve the adaptability of equipment, prolong the service life, realize high-efficiency continuous production and is suitable for industrial scale application.

title_en: Wave-induced synergistic carbonization sludge treatment device
abstract_en: The invention provides a wave-induced synergistic carbonization sludge treatment device which comprises a furnace main body, wherein a mixing box is arranged above the furnace main body, a centrifugal machine main body is arranged above the mixing box, a cover plate is arranged at the top of the centrifugal machine main body, a microwave device is arranged on one side of the surface of the furnace main body, the disassembly plate is arranged at the center position of the surface of the cover plate, a plurality of ultrasonic vibration rods are arranged in the disassembly plate, a second connecting pipe is connected between the furnace main body and the mixing box, a first connecting pipe is connected between the mixing box and the centrifugal machine main body, a feeding pipe is arranged on the surface of the disassembly plate, a motor is arranged at one end of the furnace main body, and a screw conveyer main body is arranged in the furnace main body. The wave-induced synergistic carbonization sludge treatment device provided by the invention is suitable for different sludge pyrolysis requirements, and pyrolysis gas and solid product waste heat generated by pyrolysis are recycled for a preheating stage, so that the energy utilization rate is improved, and the energy consumption is reduced.

title_en: Target gas capture process and system utilizing supersonic flow
abstract_en: A system for capturing a target condensable gas may include a supersonic condensing nozzle configured to receive a gas stream containing a target condensable gas component and accelerate the gas into a supersonic gas stream, at least one particle injector positioned in the supersonic nozzle for injecting particles to cause the particles to be in the supersonic gas stream whereby target gas condensate forms on a portion of the particles, an expansion device defining a channel having lobes to cause the particle stream containing the target gas condensate to generate an expansion wave to separate the stream into a first flow path having an increased concentration of particles of the target gas condensate therein and a second flow path having a reduced target condensable gas content of the gas, and a diverter having at least a first channel configured to collect the first flow path.

title_en: Processing method and device for flat-buckling wood floor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a processing method and a processing device for a flat-buckling wood floor, and relates to the technical field of wood floor processing, comprising a processing table, wherein the surface of the processing table is provided with a feeding mechanism, a polishing mechanism and a dust removing mechanism; the feeding mechanism comprises two fixing frames, a T-shaped frame is fixedly arranged on the surface of each fixing frame, a first feeding roller and a second feeding roller are respectively arranged on the surfaces of each fixing frame and each T-shaped frame in a rotating mode, and transmission connection is achieved between the first feeding roller and the second feeding roller through a driving synchronous wheel, a driven synchronous wheel and a transmission belt. The invention integrates three functions of feeding, polishing and dedusting, realizes continuous automatic operation of wood floor processing, realizes high-efficiency processing, and greatly improves production efficiency, and ensures the stability and uniformity of the wood floor in the processing process by synchronous transmission of the first feeding roller and the second feeding roller and cooperative work of the first polishing disk and the second polishing disk in the polishing mechanism.

title_en: Waste water treatment device for chemistry experiments
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wastewater treatment, in particular to a wastewater treatment device for chemical experiments, which comprises a standing box, a standing impurity removal component, a water treatment device and a water treatment device, wherein the bottom of the standing box is connected with a protective shell; according to the invention, the solidification component is arranged, the filter plate blocks flocculent precipitate and promotes solidification and adsorption of flocculent precipitate on the surface of the extrusion plate, the water pumping mechanism intensively processes purified wastewater, the electric push rod drives the extrusion disc to separate after separation and solidification, the driving gear is meshed with the toothed ring to trigger the reciprocating screw rod to move, solidified impurities on the adsorption extrusion plate are efficiently removed through reciprocating knocking of the extrusion block and the vibrating block, and the impurities are automatically discharged through the blanking hole, so that complicated manual cleaning is avoided, chemical residues in the wastewater can be independently processed after solidification and separation, and secondary reaction of internal chemical elements after subsequent wastewater addition is avoided, thereby avoiding unnecessary loss.

title_en: Disassembling method and system for retired power battery suitable for echelon utilization
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of batteries, in particular to a disassembly method and a system of retired power batteries suitable for echelon utilization. A disassembling method for retired power battery suitable for echelon utilization includes pretreating battery pack, safety detecting, primarily disassembling to obtain disassembled body, injecting a dispergator into the disassembled body and contacting with heat-conducting structural adhesive to perform sol treatment to obtain a sol treatment body, injecting a cooling medium into a water cooling plate of the sol treatment body to perform freezing treatment to obtain a freezing treatment body, separating the freezing treatment body to separate the water cooling plate from a module, separating battery cells in the module, and performing post-treatment on the battery cells. According to the dismantling method of the retired power battery, through the cooperation of the steps, the efficient dismantling can be realized, the efficient echelon utilization is realized, the method is environment-friendly, the medicament can be recycled, and the integrity and the electrochemical performance of the battery core can be ensured.

title_en: Efficient center precipitation device and method for sewage treatment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-efficiency central sedimentation device and method for sewage treatment, and relates to the technical field of sedimentation tanks. The invention comprises a bottom plate, wherein one side of the upper end surface of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a sediment filter structure, the upper part of an inner cavity of the sediment filter structure is symmetrically and fixedly connected with a diversion separating mechanism, a water distribution structure is fixedly connected between the two diversion separating mechanisms, the inner cavity of the sediment filter structure and the diversion separating mechanism are respectively and fixedly connected with a water collecting structure, one side of the upper end surface of the bottom plate, which is far away from the sediment filter structure, is fixedly connected with a storage structure, the front side and the rear side of the upper end surface of the bottom plate, which are located on the storage structure, are provided with adjusting structures, the lower parts of the inner cavities of the sediment filter structure and the storage structure are provided with discharging structures, one end of each discharging structure, which is far away from the sediment filter structure, is fixedly connected with a flow adjusting structure, in use, the diversion separating mechanism and the water collecting structure are installed and placed, and the inner cavity of a sedimentation tank is separated through a separating cone, so that the mutual separation of sewage and sludge is realized.

title_en: River and lake water body-bottom mud in-situ electric repair system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of environmental engineering construction and discloses an in-situ electric repair system for river and lake water body-bottom mud, which comprises a plurality of electrode pipes, electrodes, a direct current power supply and wires, wherein the number of the electrode pipes is equal to that of the electrodes and is even, each electrode pipe comprises an electrolyte chamber, a clay chamber, a repair chamber, a filter screen, a fixing buckle, a sealing cover, supporting legs and overflow holes, each electrode pipe chamber comprises one or more of the electrolyte chamber, the clay chamber and the repair chamber, the supporting legs are arranged below the electrode pipe, the electrodes are arranged in the electrolyte chamber, one ends of the electrodes are connected with the direct current power supply through the wires, and the supporting legs of the electrode pipes are inserted into a lower horizontal layer.

title_en: Dust collecting equipment for cat litter workshop
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of dust removing equipment, in particular to dust removing equipment for a cat litter production workshop, which comprises a dust removing shell, wherein one side of the dust removing shell is provided with an air inlet, the top of the dust removing shell is provided with a cover plate, and the inside of the dust removing shell is respectively provided with a filter cavity, an air inlet cavity and a dust collecting cavity from top to bottom; when the dust-removing device is used for removing dust from workshops, the driving motor can drive the driving gear to rotate and drive the lower clamping seat to rotate, and when the lower clamping seat rotates, the impeller and the filter screen cylinder are driven to synchronously rotate, and because the filter screen cylinder can also rotate, air entering from the air inlet can be contacted with different surfaces of the filter screen cylinder, the situation of blockage caused by excessive contact of air on one side of the filter screen cylinder can be prevented, meanwhile, centrifugal force can be generated on dust adhered in the filter holes when the filter screen cylinder rotates, and the blockage caused by excessive adhesion of dust to the filter holes can be prevented, and meanwhile, a certain self-cleaning effect can be generated through rotation of the filter screen cylinder.

title_en: Method for improving degradation performance of organic pollutants based on activation of persulfate by using flow-through electrocatalytic film
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving degradation performance of organic pollutants based on a flow-through type electrocatalytic film activated persulfate, the method comprises two steps of preparing a boron nitride electrocatalytic film loaded with bimetallic nano particles and carrying out flow-through degradation reaction. Compared with the traditional mode, the circulation mode provided by the invention realizes the effective coupling of the membrane catalytic system and the traditional electro-active persulfate system, breaks through the limitation of low mass transfer efficiency, and obviously improves the persulfate utilization rate, thereby improving the degradation efficiency of organic pollutants. The flow-through reactor provided by the invention has the advantages of simple structure, strong operability, less loss of catalyst, better stability and wide industrial application prospect, and provides a high-efficiency, economical and sustainable solution for degrading organic pollutants.

title_en: Corrosion and scale inhibition composition, corrosion and scale inhibitor, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of corrosion protection of oil-gas wells and gathering pipelines, and particularly discloses a corrosion and scale inhibition composition, a corrosion and scale inhibitor, a preparation method and application thereof. The corrosion and scale inhibition composition comprises 40-50 parts by weight of mercaptobenzimidazole derivative, 10-20 parts by weight of synergist, 8-15 parts by weight of compounding auxiliary agent, 3-8 parts by weight of surfactant, a proper amount of alkaline pH regulator and a proper amount of solvent. The composition has excellent corrosion inhibition and scale inhibition performances, and meanwhile, each component has good compatibility, the phenomena of precipitation, flocculation and the like are avoided, and the problem of decomposition of active ingredients in use is solved, so that the composition has excellent synergistic effect of stability and corrosion inhibition and scale inhibition.

title_en: Intelligent control method and system for real-time treatment of marine waste gas
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent control method and system for real-time treatment of marine exhaust gas, which are characterized in that vortex intensity extraction and vortex flow characteristic identification are carried out on an exhaust gas component concentration signal through collection of a ship exhaust gas component concentration signal and sea state dynamic parameters, a flow field disturbance coefficient is extracted from the sea state dynamic parameters, an exhaust gas-environment interaction field is constructed, a high-temperature pollution source is tracked and positioned based on the interaction field, a heat propagation path is constructed and an exhaust gas heat flow network is mapped, turbulence analysis is carried out on the heat flow network to identify vortex breaking points, an optimal treatment position is determined, a treatment axis is calibrated, a control parameter chain is recombined based on the treatment axis, a steady-state treatment interval is determined, a self-adaptive adjustment matrix is generated, the adjustment matrix and temperature gradient data are fused to identify a phase-change latent heat zone, condensation release energy is extracted to construct an energy recovery tensor, a gradient treatment scheme is generated, a feedback curve is formed through monitoring execution deviation, and an exhaust gas treatment execution instruction is generated, and continuous and stable operation of marine exhaust gas treatment is ensured.

title_en: Method for preparing core-shell structure organic framework composite material based on dynamic flow field
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for preparing a core-shell structure organic framework composite material based on a dynamic flow field. The invention adopts a mode of circularly extruding the elastic porous nano material in the existing COF and MOF synthesis reactant solution, and introduces an active convection process in the COF and MOF synthesis process to achieve the effects of active mass transfer of the reactant solution and uniformity of the COF and MOF synthesis, and smoothes the surface enrichment of the COF and the MOF caused by the concentration difference of the internal and external solutions. In the liquid phase reaction process, the solution reacts homogeneously to realize core-shell growth, and finally the preparation of COF and MOF is successfully completed on various elastic porous nanometer material substrates, so as to obtain the organic framework composite material with a uniform core-shell structure and high specific surface area. The method has good universality for various nano elastic aerogels and nano elastic sponges, and also has good universality for Schiff base reaction of covalent organic frameworks and deprotonation reaction of metal organic frameworks.

title_en: Internal puncture continuous fire extinguishing device of new energy automobile battery pack
abstract_en: The invention discloses an internal puncture continuous fire extinguishing device of a new energy automobile battery pack, which comprises a battery pack puncture assembly, a water supply mechanism, a spray protector and a temperature sensor, wherein the battery pack puncture assembly comprises a hydraulic ejector rod and a puncture outfit arranged at the power output end of the hydraulic ejector rod, the puncture outfit comprises a flow guide column, a puncture head, a connector I and a connector II, one end of the flow guide column is connected with the hydraulic ejector rod, the other end of the flow guide column is connected with the puncture head, a guide cavity channel is formed in the flow guide column, the connector I and the connector II are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the flow guide column, the water supply mechanism is arranged on the connector I and comprises a water guide pipe, a shunt pipe and a valve, one end of the water guide pipe is connected with the connector I, the connector II is in a sealing state, and the shunt pipe is connected with the water guide pipe, and the valve is respectively provided with two groups and is respectively arranged on the water guide pipe and the shunt pipe. The battery pack puncture fire extinguishing device designed by the invention adopts a puncture mode to inject water or inert gas into the ignition battery pack, so as to achieve the choking fire extinguishing effect on the battery pack thermal runaway battery cells.

title_en: Device and method for treating cultivation wastewater by utilizing microalgae
abstract_en: The invention provides a device and a method for treating cultivation wastewater by utilizing microalgae, and particularly relates to the technical field of wastewater biological treatment, wherein the device comprises a primary sedimentation tank, a pretreatment tank, an anaerobic tank, an aerobic tank and a microalgae reaction tank which are sequentially connected, the outer side of the pretreatment tank is provided with a combustion chamber, the pretreatment tank is connected with an ultrasonic cell disruption instrument, the combustion chamber is connected with the anaerobic tank, and the anaerobic tank is also connected with the microalgae reaction tank; the primary sedimentation tank, the pretreatment tank, the anaerobic tank, the aerobic tank and the microalgae reaction tank are arranged in parallel and side by side, and a material transfer structure is arranged above the primary sedimentation tank, the pretreatment tank, the anaerobic tank, the aerobic tank and the microalgae reaction tank. The device and the method for treating the cultivation wastewater by utilizing the microalgae can treat the livestock and poultry cultivation wastewater by utilizing the microalgae, realize the efficient treatment of the cultivation wastewater, and have the technical characteristics of multiple functions.

title_en: Elevator guide shoe welding positioning equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of elevator guide shoe welding, and particularly relates to elevator guide shoe welding positioning equipment. According to the elevator guide shoe welding positioning equipment, firstly, the plate-shaped positioning groove and the bracket positioning mechanism are used for realizing rapid and accurate positioning of elevator guide shoe parts, manual measurement and scribing are not needed, positioning efficiency is improved, labor intensity is reduced, positioning precision is guaranteed, meanwhile, the welding position of the elevator guide shoe can be flexibly adjusted by means of the driving mechanism, operation is convenient, molten metal can be enabled to fully flow into a welding line, welding firmness and quality are effectively enhanced, in addition, the equipment processes welding smoke through the environment-friendly mechanism, environment-friendly performance can be improved, personnel health is guaranteed, welding defects can be reduced by the welding line timely preheating mechanism, and welding quality and safety of subsequent use of an elevator are further guaranteed.

title_en: Multi-scene water treatment oriented activated carbon filter operation optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical fields of water treatment, automatic control and environmental monitoring, and particularly discloses an activated carbon filter operation optimization method and system for multi-scene water treatment, wherein the method comprises the steps of realizing fine regulation and control on the filter operation state by introducing a multi-dimensional real-time sensing and intelligent diagnosis mechanism; the method comprises the steps of constructing a dynamic correlation matrix between water quality change and pressure difference increment of a filter layer, adopting optimization measures in a targeted manner to ensure that effluent reaches the standard, firstly starting a low-energy consumption microcurrent stimulated activated adsorption site to realize primary recovery of filter material activity, evaluating operation effect in real time, starting high-temperature steam regeneration only when the effect is poor, designing a heterogeneous laminated filter material and combining a water source identification technology to achieve self-adaptive water purification treatment capability, so that the heterogeneous laminated filter material can flexibly cope with polluted water sources with different sources and different characteristics, simultaneously identify water source types, select a better water flow path and ensure that each pollutant can be removed efficiently.

title_en: Spraying dust collector is used in production of glass fibre cotton
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of glass fiber cotton production, and relates to a spray dust collector for glass fiber cotton production, which comprises a mounting shell, wherein an outer rod is welded on the upper surface of the mounting shell, an inner rod is slidably arranged in the outer rod, two supporting frames are fixedly arranged on the outer side surfaces of the inner rod, arc-shaped pipes are fixedly arranged on the outer side surfaces of the two supporting frames, a plurality of end pipes are arranged on the outer side surfaces of the arc-shaped pipes in a penetrating manner, and a protection mechanism for preventing nozzle heads from being blocked is arranged on the outer side surfaces of the end pipes. The spring can prop against the third spacer in the protection mechanism to enable the first sliding rod to slide in the mounting frame, the rubber plug is used for blocking the water outlet of the nozzle, and the mask is used for protecting the periphery of the water outlet of the nozzle, so that the effect of protecting the nozzle when spraying operation is not performed is achieved, and the phenomenon that glass fiber cotton dust is easy to agglomerate to cause the nozzle to be blocked is avoided.

title_en: High-temperature-resistant polyamide composite nanofiltration membrane for water purification and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-temperature-resistant polyamide composite nanofiltration membrane for water purification and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of nanofiltration membrane preparation. According to the invention, the amidated carbon nano tube is loaded on the porous support base film, so that the porous support base film and the polyamide separation layer are stably combined, on the other hand, the polyamide separation layer and the porous support base film can be isolated, the interlayer thermal deformation probability is reduced, the high temperature resistant polyamide composite nanofiltration membrane is not easy to deform, the service life of the high temperature resistant polyamide composite nanofiltration membrane is prolonged, compared with a common amine monomer, the high temperature resistant performance is better, the amidated carbon nano tube is cooperated, and the high temperature resistant performance is further improved.

title_en: Novel wet flue gas desulfurization composite synergistic additive and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel wet flue gas desulfurization composite synergistic additive and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of flue gas desulfurization. The novel wet flue gas desulfurization composite synergistic additive comprises the following raw materials, by weight, 15-25 parts of organic acid, 10-20 parts of organic salt, 5-10 parts of inorganic salt, 4-5 parts of wetting agent, 5-8 parts of moisture absorbent and 5-15 parts of accelerator. The novel wet flue gas desulfurization composite synergistic additive prepared by the invention has good calcium carbonate dissolution rate and calcium sulfite oxidation rate, and has higher desulfurization efficiency.

title_en: Precise sheet metal device for laser processing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a laser processing precision sheet metal device, which belongs to the technical field of sheet metal processing, and comprises a workbench with a cavity inside, wherein one end of the upper surface of the workbench is provided with a cantilever, the lower surface of the cantilever is connected with a laser generator in a sliding manner, the upper surface of the workbench is provided with an adjusting platform, a sheet metal is placed on the adjusting platform and is cut through the laser generator, the bottom surface of the cantilever is symmetrically provided with an air duct, the tail part of the air duct is connected with an air inlet pipe through a tee joint, the air inlet pipe penetrates through the workbench to extend into the cavity inside, a filter barrel is arranged in the cavity of the workbench, the air inlet pipe is connected with the filter barrel, the upper surface of the filter barrel extends outwards to form an air outlet pipe, the tail end of the air outlet pipe is connected with a filter box, and the tail end of the filter box is provided with an exhaust fan. The air channels are symmetrically arranged on the bottom in the cantilever, so that the flue gas generated by cutting can be effectively guided into the filtering system, the efficiency of collecting smoke dust is ensured, and the flue gas generated by cutting the laser generator is filtered twice through the filter vat and the filter box.

title_en: Monitoring flame-retardant embedded protective box for circuit protector
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monitoring flame-retardant embedded protective box for a circuit protector, which relates to the technical field of embedded protective boxes for circuit protectors and comprises a cabinet body, wherein one end face of the cabinet body is opened and hinged with a cabinet door, the bottom end of the cabinet body is fixedly connected with a ventilation box, one end face of the ventilation box is provided with a rectangular through opening, a ventilation assembly is inserted into the rectangular through opening, two sides of the ventilation box are symmetrically provided with a plurality of first wiring holes, the inner wall of each first wiring hole is fixedly connected with a first heat shrinkage pipe which extends into the inner wall of the ventilation box, the inner wall of the cabinet body is attached with a fireproof layer, and four corners of the opposite faces of the inner wall of the cabinet body and the cabinet door are convexly provided with internal thread cylinders; the invention is convenient for air circulation and blocks impurities by matching the ventilation holes of the ventilation plate with the fireproof gauze, improves the heat dissipation efficiency, can realize the function of cooling the circuit protector, and finally solves the problems that the circuit protector is easy to burn, the ventilation holes lack of an effective sealing structure and flames are easy to spread through the wiring holes due to the limited heat dissipation conditions of the existing embedded protection box, and improves the safety.

title_en: Method for preparing hierarchical pore modified zeolite adsorbent by using lithium silicon powder and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of waste gas treatment, and particularly relates to a method for preparing a hierarchical pore modified zeolite adsorbent from lithium silicon powder and application thereof. The method comprises the following steps of grinding, sieving, acid washing, impurity removal, gel crystallization, filtering, washing and zeolite modification. The preparation method has the characteristics of simple process, easy operation and low cost, and the prepared multistage pore modified zeolite is used for adsorbing VOCs, has high adsorption efficiency, can be recycled and further reduces the cost for treating the VOCs.

title_en: Flue gas purification device for butadiene rubber processing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a smoke purification device for butadiene rubber processing, which relates to the technical field of smoke purification and comprises a filter box and a purification box, wherein the filter box is fixedly connected to the top of the purification box, the bottom of the filter box is communicated with the top of the purification box, two sides of the outer wall of the filter box are respectively and correspondingly connected with a smoke inlet pipe and a smoke exhaust pipe, two groups of fixing frames are fixedly and symmetrically arranged in the filter box, two opposite fixing frames are respectively provided with a coarse filter screen and a fine filter screen, cleaning mechanisms are respectively arranged on two sides of the outer walls of the coarse filter screen and the fine filter screen, and a spraying mechanism for spraying smoke is arranged on the inner bottom wall of the filter box.

title_en: Flash vaporization carbonization integrated treatment device for goaf high-salinity wastewater
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flash evaporation carbonization integrated treatment device for goaf high-salt wastewater, and relates to the technical field of carbonization integrated treatment. The device comprises a main body, wherein a moving assembly is arranged outside a rotating shaft, a lifting plate is fixed at the bottom end of the moving assembly, an stirring assembly is arranged at the bottom of the lifting plate, a stirring plate is fixed at the bottom end of the stirring assembly, a cleaning assembly is arranged inside a base, and an opening plate is arranged at the top of a filter plate in an equal angle.

title_en: Dry quenching dust removal desulfurizing agent dosage control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coke production, in particular to a dosage control method of a dry quenching dust removal desulfurizing agent, which comprises the steps of collecting flue gas parameters, agent supply parameters and equipment influence parameters in the dry quenching dust removal desulfurization process based on preset collection frequency, analyzing the flue gas parameters to obtain desulfurization efficiency indexes, analyzing the agent utilization rate of the desulfurization efficiency indexes by combining the agent supply parameters to obtain agent desulfurization utilization rate, calculating a desulfurization efficiency index gap and/or an agent desulfurization utilization rate gap in response to the fact that the desulfurization efficiency index is smaller than a preset efficiency threshold and/or the agent desulfurization utilization rate is smaller than the preset utilization rate threshold, and fusing the agent desulfurization efficiency index gap and/or the agent desulfurization utilization rate gap with the equipment influence parameters in an abnormal amount mode to obtain a desulfurization adjustment parameter feature set, inputting the desulfurization adjustment parameter feature set into a preset agent control parameter adjustment model to obtain agent control parameters, and controlling desulfurization agents in the same. Which can improve the stability and reliability of the desulfurization system.

title_en: CO (carbon monoxide)2Pressure swing adsorption silica gel and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of gas adsorption materials, in particular to CO  2  pressure swing adsorption silica gel, and a preparation method and application thereof. The CO  2  pressure swing adsorption silica gel comprises a multistage pore silica gel carrier, an ionic liquid functional layer and a temperature-sensitive poly-N-isopropyl acrylamide layer are sequentially grafted on the surface of the multistage pore silica gel carrier to form an ionic liquid core-temperature-sensitive shell core-shell structure, and the preparation method comprises three steps of multistage pore silica gel carrier preparation, ionic liquid functional layer grafting and temperature-sensitive poly-N-isopropyl acrylamide layer grafting. The adsorption silica gel prepared by the invention has the characteristics of large adsorption capacity, high adsorption rate and good desorption effect, can be used for CO  2  pressure swing adsorption process under the environment of wide gas humidity range, realizes efficient adsorption and desorption by adjusting the conditions of adsorption and desorption, such as temperature, pressure, gas speed and the like, has excellent cycle stability, can effectively solve the defects of the existing CO  2  adsorption material in practical application, and has good application prospect.

title_en: Contaminated soil restores and uses prosthetic devices based on soil is renovated
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of soil remediation and discloses a contaminated soil restoration device based on soil remediation, which comprises a bracket, a mixing tank arranged on the bracket, a motor arranged on the bracket and a main shaft arranged in the mixing tank, wherein a plurality of groups of stirring mechanisms are axially arranged on the main shaft, each group of stirring mechanisms comprises a plurality of groups of shaft rods which are equidistantly arranged along the circumferential direction of the main shaft, a connecting seat fixed at the end part of the shaft rod and a stirring paddle fixedly connected with the connecting seat, expandable external supporting rods are symmetrically arranged on the side edges of the stirring paddle, a folding area corresponding to the external supporting rods is formed on the stirring paddle, an elastic covering layer connected with the external supporting rods is fixedly connected in the folding area, and a braking piece is also arranged on the stirring paddle in a sliding manner. According to the invention, the stirring mechanism is arranged, so that the stirring mode can be adaptively switched according to the rotating speed of the main shaft, and the problems of single action and uneven mixing of the traditional fixed blades are effectively solved.

title_en: Device and process for enriching xenon in nuclear waste gas by utilizing variable-pressure variable-temperature vacuum adsorption
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a process for enriching xenon in nuclear waste gas by utilizing variable-pressure variable-temperature vacuum adsorption, which belong to the field of engineered xenon recovery and comprise a pretreatment module, a xenon enrichment module, a xenon storage module and a program control valve, wherein one end of the pretreatment module comprises a raw gas compressor, the other end of the raw gas compressor is connected with nuclear fuel waste gas, the other end of the raw gas compressor is connected with a first high-pressure adsorption tower and a first low-pressure regeneration tower which alternately run through a raw gas heat exchanger, an outlet of the pretreatment module is connected with the xenon enrichment module, the xenon enrichment module comprises a buffer tank, an outlet of the pretreatment module is connected with the buffer tank, the outlet of the buffer tank is divided into two paths, one path of the outlet of the buffer tank is connected with the top of a second high-pressure adsorption tower and the top of the second low-pressure regeneration tower which alternately run, the other path of the buffer tank is connected with the second high-pressure adsorption tower and the bottom of the second low-pressure regeneration tower which alternately run through a pretreatment gas heat exchanger, and the outlet of the xenon enrichment module is connected with the xenon storage module, and the program control valve comprises a plurality of valves connected with a pipeline.

title_en: Rice and shrimp co-cropping method in cadmium-polluted paddy field by utilizing sulfate reducing bacteria
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rice and shrimp co-cropping method in a cadmium-polluted paddy field by utilizing sulfate reducing bacteria, which comprises the following steps of 1, spraying diluted SRB microbial inoculum propagation liquid in the cadmium-polluted paddy field to be treated, then enabling the microbial inoculum to be fully contacted with soil in a rotary tillage mode, adding water into the paddy field to a depth of 5-10cm, wherein the cadmium content in the cadmium-polluted paddy field to be treated is 0.40-1.50mg/kg, the pH range of the cadmium-polluted paddy field is 5.5-6.5, 2, monitoring the oxidation-reduction potential of the soil in the paddy field until the oxidation-reduction potential value of the soil is monitored to be below-150 mV in a preset time period, transplanting seedlings, 3, transplanting seedlings of the Australian freshwater lobsters with a body length of 2-5cm after 10-15 days, and 4, harvesting rice and lobsters respectively in a rice maturity period. The invention aims to remarkably reduce the cadmium content in rice and the effectiveness of soil cadmium through a sulfate reducing bacteria and rice and shrimp co-cropping system. The invention is supported by the national emphasis development planning project (2022 YFD 1700103).

title_en: Beam manipulator welding device for high-speed motor train unit of railway passenger car
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rail coaches, in particular to a rail coach high-speed motor train unit beam manipulator welding device, which comprises a welding table main body, wherein a positioning assembly is arranged in the middle of the top of the welding table main body, a fixing frame is fixedly connected to the periphery of the top of the welding table main body, smoking assemblies are arranged on two sides of the top of the fixing frame, two groups of smoking assemblies are connected through a processing assembly, limiting plates are slidably connected to two ends of the fixing frame, the positioning assembly is used for positioning a beam, compared with the traditional mode of manually adjusting a welding origin, the positioning assembly is hydraulically driven to automatically position the beam, the positioning time can be shortened, manual repeated calibration is not needed, the welding assembly efficiency is greatly improved, meanwhile, the rapid cooling of high-temperature smoke in a smoking pipe is realized, the smoke collection rate of a welding area can be improved by negative pressure adsorption, the smoke is prevented from diffusing to a workshop, and the harm to an operator respiratory system is reduced.

title_en: Intelligent multi-mode coupling industrial wastewater treatment system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent multi-mode coupling industrial wastewater treatment system and method, and belongs to the technical field of industrial wastewater treatment. The system comprises a water inlet adjusting unit, a materialization pretreatment unit, at least two biochemical treatment series which are connected in parallel and have different processes, a deep treatment unit, a sludge treatment unit and a dosing system. The intelligent control unit is used for analyzing the water quality and quantity data of the inflow water in real time based on a neural network prediction and fuzzy control algorithm and dynamically regulating and controlling the coupling control subsystem and the dosing system. The invention solves the problems of poor capability of the traditional wastewater treatment system to cope with fluctuation of water quality and water quantity and high energy and medicine consumption in operation, and realizes intelligent switching and optimized operation of treatment modes.

title_en: Battery monomer, top cover assembly, battery device and electric equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a battery monomer, a top cover assembly, a battery device and electric equipment, and relates to the technical field of batteries, wherein the battery monomer comprises a shell and the top cover assembly, the top cover assembly comprises a top cover plate and a lower plastic part, the lower plastic part is connected to one surface of the top cover plate, the lower plastic part is provided with an explosion-proof valve vent hole, a liquid injection through hole and two pole through holes, the area of the lower plastic part except the areas where the explosion-proof valve vent hole, the liquid injection through hole and the two pole through holes are located is a first area, at least part of the first area is provided with a first accommodating groove, the top cover assembly further comprises a sealing plate, the sealing plate is connected to the lower plastic part in a sealing mode and seals the opening of the first accommodating groove, and one side of the sealing plate, which is away from the lower plastic part, is connected with the top cover plate. The battery monomer can extinguish fire or resist flame when thermal runaway occurs, so that the safety performance of the battery monomer is improved.

title_en: Carbon nano tube supported Ni/Zn bimetallic catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a carbon nano tube supported Ni/Zn bimetallic catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof, relating to the technical field of bimetallic catalysts; the preparation method of the carbon nano tube supported Ni/Zn bimetallic catalyst comprises the following steps of firstly preparing a carbon nano tube/Zn precipitate, then preparing the carbon nano tube/Zn/Ni precipitate, and finally placing the prepared carbon nano tube/Zn/Ni precipitate in a muffle furnace, heating and roasting to obtain the carbon nano tube supported Ni/Zn bimetallic catalyst. The carbon nanotube catalyst prepared by the method seals metal particles in pore channels of the carbon nanotubes, and makes the metal particles uniformly dispersed, so that bimetal modification is realized, additional functional sites are given to the carbon nanotubes, and the catalytic activity and stability are improved.

title_en: Waste gas treatment system of industrial adhesive tape production line
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of waste gas treatment and discloses a waste gas treatment system of an industrial adhesive tape production line, which comprises two fixed circular plates, wherein a rotary filter assembly is arranged between the two fixed circular plates, one side of each of the two fixed circular plates is provided with an air inlet treatment assembly, the bottoms of the two fixed circular plates are provided with a bottom collecting assembly, each rotary filter assembly comprises two rotary circular plates symmetrically arranged between the two fixed circular plates, partition plates are arranged between the two rotary circular plates at equal angles, a filter cavity is formed between every two adjacent partition plates, one end of each filter cavity, which is close to the inner side of each rotary circular plate, is provided with a filter arc plate, and the inner side of each rotary circular plate is provided with a gas guide assembly.

title_en: Multipurpose aeration head capable of aerating and adding medicine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water and sewage treatment, in particular to a multipurpose aeration head capable of aerating and dosing, which comprises an upper cover and a base, wherein the upper cover is of a ventilation structure and is covered with a membrane for aerating at the outer side of the upper cover, the upper cover is buckled at the top of the base, an aeration cavity for gas to pass through is reserved between the upper cover and the base, the multipurpose aeration head also comprises an air pipe and a dosing pipe arranged in the air pipe, the air pipe is communicated with the aeration cavity, the dosing pipe is dispersed into a plurality of branch pipes in the aeration cavity, penetrates through the upper cover and extends to the outer side of the upper cover to form a high-level dosing pipe, a low-level dosing pipe communicated with the dosing pipe is arranged in the aeration cavity, a dosing outlet is formed in the upper cover, the upper cover can be lifted relative to the base, and the low-level dosing pipe stops dosing when the upper cover is lowered to the lower level, compared with the prior art, the chemical diffusion rate of a chemical can be ensured to the greatest extent under the premise of avoiding the reaction of the two.

title_en: Method for quantitatively trapping alkali metal vapor by using kaolin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for quantitatively trapping alkali metal vapor by using kaolin. The method comprises the steps of firstly mixing high-purity kaolin with the mass ratio of 20-63 mu m with analytically pure NaCl with the mass ratio of 100 mu m being 2%, 4% and 6%, then placing the mixed sample in a high-temperature reactor with the temperature of 1100 ℃ for reaction, quantitatively capturing gas phase alkali metal by utilizing the chemical adsorption and physical capturing effect of the kaolin on alkali metal vapor, and finally forming stable sodium aluminosilicate mineral. The invention obviously reduces the concentration of alkali metal vapor in the flue gas, improves the trapping efficiency of kaolin on alkali metal to 82%, and effectively relieves the problems of pollution, slagging and corrosion of the heating surface of the boiler.

title_en: Treatment method and treatment device for kitchen waste and wastewater oil removal
abstract_en: The invention relates to a treatment method and a treatment device for kitchen waste wastewater oil removal, comprising the following steps of S1, enabling kitchen waste wastewater to pass through a ceramsite filler area, enabling grease molecules in the kitchen waste wastewater to be coalesced to form grease particles to obtain primary treatment liquid, enabling the filler of the ceramsite filler area to comprise first porous ceramic particles and second porous ceramic particles, wherein the particle size of the first porous ceramic particles and the particle size of the second porous ceramic particles are distributed at 3-15mm, the porosity of the second porous ceramic particles is not lower than 0.4, the particle size difference of the two porous ceramic particles is larger than 2mm, S2, enabling the primary treatment liquid to flow through a runner area to form oil drops and absorb heavy metals to obtain secondary treatment liquid, and S3, enabling the secondary treatment liquid to enter a layering area to conduct oil-water layering, pumping away floating oil, and completing kitchen waste wastewater oil removal treatment. The invention can solve the technical problems that the oil removal technology in the prior art has poor adaptability to kitchen wastewater, is easy to generate blockage, cannot remove oil stably in a high-flow environment and cannot remove heavy metals in kitchen waste water effectively.

title_en: Gasified grey water quality optimization device and optimization method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of pressurized gasification devices and water treatment, and particularly discloses a gasified grey water quality optimization device and an optimization method thereof, wherein the device comprises a flash evaporation system and a sedimentation system, the flash evaporation system comprises a high-pressure flash evaporation tank, a saturated hot water tower, a high-flash condenser and a high-pressure flash evaporation separator, the steam outlet of which is sequentially communicated, the sedimentation system comprises a plurality of sedimentation tanks, and the sedimentation tanks comprise a sedimentation tank body A for removing turbidity and a sedimentation tank body B for removing hardness; the high-pressure flash tank is used for treating black water from the gasification furnace and the washing tower, the liquid outlet of the high-pressure flash tank is communicated with the low-pressure flash tank, the gas outlet of the low-pressure flash tank is communicated with the deaerator, the acid gas condenser and the acid gas separator, and the liquid outlet of the acid gas separator is communicated with the settling tank. The gasification grey water quality optimizing device and the optimizing method thereof have the advantages of reasonable design, simple structure, safety, reliability, convenient use and good popularization and use values.

title_en: Built-in moving bed desulfurization device for vertical boiler system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a built-in moving bed desulfurization device for a vertical boiler system. A plurality of inserted sheet type moving beds are arranged in the middle temperature Duan Shuxiang of the boiler shell, each inserted sheet type moving bed comprises an inverted cone-shaped hollow shell made of a porous plate, at least one pneumatic conveying feeding port is arranged on the shell, the pneumatic conveying feeding port is used for conveying granular desulfurizing agent filler into a ventilation shell, a byproduct discharging screw conveyor is arranged in the inner bottom of the shell, and a discharging pipe is arranged at the bottom of one side of the shell corresponding to the byproduct discharging screw conveyor. The device can be directly arranged in the vertical boiler shell, and only one set of desulfurizing agent storage and transportation circulating discharging system is required to be arranged outside the boiler.

title_en: Efficient purifying and fine desulfurizing agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of desulfurizing agents, in particular to a high-efficiency purifying and fine desulfurizing agent and a preparation method thereof, which comprises the following raw materials: silver nitrate, rare earth cerium-zinc composite oxide, copper/gamma-alumina desulfurizing agent, potassium carbonate, ammonium bicarbonate and sodium carboxymethyl cellulose. The rare earth cerium-zinc composite oxide can preferentially adsorb and concentrate various sulfides in gas through the huge specific surface area, particularly, partial organic sulfur (such as COS) which is difficult to directly remove is initially activated or converted by utilizing the excellent catalytic oxidation capability of cerium, copper/gamma-alumina desulfurizing agent fixes copper species through chemical coordination on the surface of the copper/gamma-alumina desulfurizing agent, and the copper/gamma-alumina desulfurizing agent can perform efficient and irreversible chemical reaction with hydrogen sulfide and activated organic sulfur to generate stable metal sulfide, so that complete removal of sulfur is realized, and the functional connection obviously improves the overall desulfurization precision and sulfur capacity.

title_en: Solvent-resistant ultrafiltration membrane and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of membrane separation, and particularly relates to a solvent-resistant ultrafiltration membrane, and a preparation method and application thereof.
