In order to solve the treatment problems of high energy consumption, large solvent loss, low recovery rate and the like of the organic solvent in the fields of chemical industry, food science, coating technology, pharmacy and the like, the invention prepares the polyimide ultrafiltration membrane with solvent resistance, solves the problem that the ultrafiltration membrane is corroded by the organic solvent in the separation process, and greatly prolongs the service life of the ultrafiltration membrane in use. The crosslinking of the polyimide ultrafiltration membrane and ethylenediamine improves the solvent resistance, and the swelling degree in DMF solution reaches 0.84g/g. The pure water flux reaches 437 kg.m-2.h-1, and the BSA retention rate reaches 86%.

title_en: Vertical flow biological induction dephosphorization system and dephosphorization process
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vertical flow biological induction dephosphorization system and a dephosphorization process, comprising a reactor body, an inner cylinder and an outer cylinder, wherein the inner cylinder and the outer cylinder form an inner reaction cavity and an outer reaction cavity; the device comprises an inner cylinder, a flow guiding device communicated with the axial bottom end of the inner cylinder, an aeration device arranged in the flow guiding device for upward aeration, and a dephosphorization reagent feeding device for crushing particles below the flow guiding device and simultaneously feeding the dephosphorization reagent. Through adding the dephosphorization reagent feeding device, the large-particle-size anaerobic ammonia oxidation particles are crushed, and meanwhile, the dephosphorization reagent is added, the alkaline environment created by hydroxyl is generated by utilizing anaerobic ammonia oxidation reaction, the microorganism is used for promoting a dephosphorization path in a synergistic way, the biological induction crystallization reaction is enhanced, excessive calcium and magnesium ions and phosphate ions in sewage are promoted to carry out crystallization reaction, and the free phosphate ions are converted into phosphorus-containing precipitate, so that the purposes of dephosphorization and phosphorus resource recovery can be realized, the feeding amount of the alkaline reagent in the dephosphorization reagent can be reduced, and considerable economic benefit can be achieved.

title_en: Novel machine stove decoupling system
abstract_en: The invention provides a novel machine furnace decoupling system, and relates to the technical field of thermal power generation. The problems that the complete machine-furnace decoupling cannot be realized by the coal-fired thermal power generator set due to the limitations of the current machine-furnace configuration and materials and the flexibility is poor are solved. The double-station heat-storage type flue gas-molten salt heat-storage system comprises a flue gas-air system, a pulverizing system, a combustion system, a double-station heat-storage system, a molten salt heat-storage system, an SGS system and a turbine power generation system, wherein the double-station heat-storage system comprises an SCO  2  generator, a molten salt-SCO  2  heat exchanger, a flue gas-molten salt heat exchanger and a compressor, the SCO  2  generator, the molten salt-SCO  2  heat exchanger and the compressor are sequentially connected end to end, a flue gas inlet of the SCO  2  generator is connected with the combustion system, a flue gas outlet of the SCO  2  generator is connected with a flue gas inlet of the flue gas-molten salt heat exchanger, and a flue gas outlet of the flue gas-molten salt heat exchanger is connected with the flue gas-air system. The device is mainly used for realizing complete machine furnace decoupling.

title_en: Condensation-proof high-concentration steam-proof optical fiber transmission reading head mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to an anti-condensation and anti-high-concentration water vapor optical fiber transmission reading head mechanism which comprises a reading head shell, an optical fiber correlation device, an inner anti-condensation component, electric heating anti-fog glass and an outer water vapor component, wherein the optical fiber correlation device is arranged in the reading head shell and is used for transmitting and receiving optical signals, the electric heating anti-fog glass is fixed on the front end face of the reading head shell and is arranged corresponding to an optical signal transmitting end and an optical signal receiving end of the optical fiber correlation device and is used for protecting the optical fiber correlation device and preventing surface condensation, the inner anti-condensation component is used for forming dry air flow circulation in the shell and is used for discharging condensation generated in the shell, and the outer water vapor component is used for jetting gas. The invention realizes the internal and external synchronous condensation prevention and high-concentration steam removal, adapts to severe working conditions and can also be used for walking alignment of other equipment.

title_en: Waste battery material recovery method based on plasma chemical vapor deposition technology
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of waste battery material recovery, and provides a waste battery material recovery method based on a plasma chemical vapor deposition technology. Firstly, synthesizing a network compound with a metal chelating function, forming stable combination with an electrode surface active site in subsequent coating deposition, effectively capturing harmful metal ions, secondly, designing a fluorine-containing imidazolyl-quaternary ammonium salt network compound, endowing the fluorine-containing imidazolyl-quaternary ammonium salt network compound with excellent surface passivation and chemical stability, separating an active material from a metal current collector through periodical adjustment of temperature and combining a plasma technology in a stripping process, further extracting and purifying the stripped active powder through acid washing treatment, and endowing the metal surface with good corrosion resistance and reworking performance by combining the fluorine-containing compound and an inorganic silicon-oxygen network deposition process, thereby being suitable for recycling electrode materials in waste batteries and improving the recycling value of related materials.

title_en: Boiler exhaust gas temperature active control system and method based on adjustable smoke flow area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a boiler exhaust gas temperature active control system and method based on adjustable smoke gas flow area, the system comprises a boiler, an air preheater and a control unit, a smoke gas flow area adjusting device is arranged in a smoke gas side flue of the air preheater, the smoke gas flow area adjusting device is in signal connection with the control unit, and the control unit acquires a smoke gas temperature signal of the boiler and compares the smoke gas temperature signal with a preset target temperature; when the exhaust gas temperature is lower than the target temperature, the control unit drives the smoke flow area adjusting device to act, so that the effective flow cross section area of the smoke side flue is reduced. The invention overcomes the technical concern of the reliability of the active intervention of the smoke side by the direct means of actively adjusting the smoke flow area, and fundamentally solves the problems of low-temperature corrosion and blockage of the air preheater under low load.

title_en: Filter element, filter device and fan
abstract_en: The application provides a filter element, a filter device and a fan. The filter element comprises a base material, a protruding part and a catalytic part, wherein at least part of the surfaces of the base material are opposite and parallel, the protruding part is arranged on the base material, so that an airflow channel is formed between the opposite and parallel surfaces, and the catalytic part is arranged on the circumferential surface of the airflow channel. The air flow can pass through the filter element through the air flow channel, so that the wind resistance of the filter device using the filter element is reduced, the influence on the wind speed is reduced, and the working efficiency of the fan can be further ensured. Meanwhile, the catalytic part can decompose and filter harmful substances (such as formaldehyde) in the air so as to ensure the cleanliness and harmlessness of the air flow passing through the filtering device.

title_en: Sludge press filtration system based on automatic operation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sludge press filtration, in particular to a sludge press filtration system based on automatic operation, which acquires a falling track of a filter plate falling according to an image of the filter plate falling through a dynamic monitoring module so as to determine a falling expression length interval of the filter cake falling to a conveying belt; the method comprises the steps of judging whether the filter cake falling process is abnormal or not through a characteristic identification module, constructing a falling state representation vector of the filter cake at each falling position through an abnormality analysis module, determining a filter cake identification state according to a comparison result of the falling state representation vector, automatically adjusting sludge filter pressing through a filter pressing management module, wherein the automatic adjustment comprises the adjustment of pushing parameters of high-pressure medium in a filter plate interlayer, or controlling a flushing unit to perform pressurized flushing on the characteristic marked filter cloth, and further, performing self-adaptive regulation and control on the sludge filter pressing process through dynamic monitoring and analysis of filter cake falling tracks and deviation characteristics to distinguish abnormal sticky attributes, so that the stability of continuous filter pressing of sludge is improved.

title_en: In-situ pyrolysis system and pyrolysis method for waste incineration fly ash
abstract_en: The application discloses a waste incineration fly ash in-situ pyrolysis system and a pyrolysis method thereof. The pyrolysis system comprises an incinerator hearth, an incinerator ash bucket and a heating module, wherein the incinerator ash bucket is communicated with a fly ash bin through a first conveying module, the fly ash bin is communicated with a fly ash pyrolysis channel of a pyrolysis furnace through a second conveying module, the fly ash pyrolysis channel of the pyrolysis furnace is communicated with a high-temperature area of the incinerator hearth, and the heating module is communicated with a heating medium channel of the pyrolysis furnace. The pyrolysis method adopts the pyrolysis system, hot air is sent into a heating medium channel of the pyrolysis furnace, fly ash is sent into a fly ash pyrolysis channel of the pyrolysis furnace, detoxified fly ash and pyrolysis gas are generated after the fly ash is pyrolyzed, the pyrolysis gas enters a high-temperature area of a hearth of the incinerator, and organic pollutants are decomposed at high temperature. The application has the beneficial effects that the fly ash pyrolysis gas is introduced into the incinerator of the garbage incineration plant for combustion and decomposition, and the existing flue gas purification system is utilized for in-situ treatment, so that secondary pollution generated by treating the pyrolysis gas is avoided.

title_en: Mixed landfill solid waste cascade recovery system and method based on solid waste characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mixed landfill solid waste cascade recovery system and method based on solid waste characteristics, and relates to the technical field of mixed landfill solid waste cascade recovery, wherein the system comprises the steps of analyzing equipment performance deviation conditions of industrial recovery equipment; the method comprises the steps of analyzing the data change scale of relevant operation parameters in the process of shifting process performance parameters, judging the shifting state of the process performance parameters in the performance shifting equipment, analyzing the control parameters in the performance shifting equipment under different values, compensating the process performance parameters of the performance shifting equipment to obtain control compensation data of the performance shifting equipment, obtaining solid waste characteristic data of mixed landfill waste, obtaining performance target data of the performance shifting equipment, and carrying out step recovery on the mixed landfill waste by using the performance shifting equipment according to the control compensation data, so that the performance shifting problem of the performance shifting equipment is solved rapidly and accurately, and the efficiency and the precision of step recovery of the mixed landfill waste are improved.

title_en: Spiral surrounding type temperature measuring device for raw coal bucket
abstract_en: The invention provides a spiral surrounding type temperature measuring device for a raw coal bucket, which belongs to the technical field of raw coal bucket temperature measurement of a thermal power plant, can at least partially solve the problems that the traditional temperature measurement is mainly carried out by holding a thermometer by a patrol personnel, delay is easy to cause, accuracy is reduced, the raw coal bucket is provided with a spiral track, a thermometer assembly, a wireless charging assembly and a control module, the spiral track with a slot is arranged, the slot faces away from the opening end of the raw coal bucket and is arranged along the length direction of the track, dust is difficult to accumulate, running resistance of a roller is small, the thermometer is smooth and stable, the spiral track extends from the peripheral surface of the opening end to the peripheral surface of the closed end, the whole height of the raw coal bucket is covered, continuous patrol in the circumferential direction and the height direction is realized, the temperature field is more comprehensive to obtain, and abnormal point positioning is more accurate.

title_en: Synthetic gas purification device, biomass methanol preparation equipment and synthetic gas purification method
abstract_en: The application discloses a synthetic gas purifying device, biomass methanol preparation equipment and a synthetic gas purifying method, and belongs to the technical field of biomass treatment equipment; the heat preservation piece is arranged in the accommodating cavity, the heat preservation piece is provided with a heat preservation cavity, the heat preservation cavity is provided with an opening, the opening is communicated with the accommodating cavity, the synthetic gas nozzle penetrates through the shell and penetrates through one end of the heat preservation piece, which is far away from the opening along the axial direction of the shell, the synthetic gas nozzle is communicated with the heat preservation cavity, the first oxygen nozzle is connected with the shell and penetrates through the heat preservation piece, the first oxygen nozzle is communicated with the heat preservation cavity, and the spraying direction of the first oxygen nozzle is perpendicular to the axial direction and is inclined to the radial direction of the shell. According to the application, the first oxygen nozzle is arranged to introduce oxygen when the temperature in the heat preservation cavity is not high enough, so that the synthesis gas can be reacted with the oxygen for combustion, and the purification effect of the synthesis gas is improved.

title_en: Preparation method and application of rare earth waste magnetic biological carrier based on 3D printing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a rare earth waste magnetic biological carrier based on 3D printing, belonging to the technical field of sewage treatment, the invention introduces rare earth waste into an ABS matrix through 3D printing, the novel biological film carrier with controllable structure, excellent hydrophilicity, surface electrical property and adjustable magnetism is prepared so as to promote the quick film formation and high-efficiency denitrification of microorganisms and realize the dual purposes of improving the sewage treatment performance and recycling the rare earth waste.

title_en: Water purification system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water purifying system, which relates to the technical field of water purifying equipment and comprises a booster pump, a composite filter element, a water purifying tank and a control valve, wherein an inlet of the composite filter element is communicated with an outlet of the booster pump, an inlet of the water purifying tank is communicated with an outlet of the composite filter element, and the control valve is configured to allow fluid to flow into the composite filter element from the booster pump and limit the fluid to flow into the booster pump from the composite filter element. According to the water purifying system provided by the embodiment of the invention, the control valve is used for limiting fluid to flow into the booster pump from the composite filter element, and when the booster pump stops running, air is prevented from entering the composite filter element, so that the possibility of overflow of the water purifying tank is reduced.

title_en: Membrane distillation system and method for pretreatment of aquaculture wastewater by activated sulfite
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wastewater treatment, in particular to a membrane distillation system and a method for activating sulfite to pretreat aquaculture wastewater, wherein the method comprises the following steps of firstly, obtaining the aquaculture wastewater to be treated, adding sulfite into the aquaculture wastewater to be treated, and uniformly stirring to obtain first sewage; and step two, placing the first sewage in an extreme ultraviolet light reaction device, performing extreme ultraviolet light irradiation treatment and synchronous stirring to obtain second sewage, and step three, introducing the second sewage into a direct contact type membrane distillation system for deep treatment and concentration. According to the invention, the far ultraviolet light is used as a high-energy photon source to selectively and efficiently activate the sulfite in the water, and a reaction system taking sulfate radical and hydrated electrons as main factors is constructed under normal temperature and pressure and in the presence of dissolved oxygen, so that the efficient degradation of organic pollutants in the cultivation wastewater and the fundamental inhibition of the membrane pollution potential are realized.

title_en: Flue gas waste heat recovery device of once-through boiler
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of boiler waste heat recovery equipment and discloses a direct-current boiler flue gas waste heat recovery device which comprises a barrel, wherein the bottom end of the barrel is fixedly connected with a drain valve, the top end of the barrel is fixedly connected with a water delivery valve, the interior of the barrel is fixedly connected with a heat exchange tube, one end of the heat exchange tube is fixedly connected with an air inlet tube, a flange is arranged in the middle of the air inlet tube, the interior of the air inlet tube is fixedly connected with a protective sleeve, the interior of the air inlet tube is rotatably connected with a filter bag, the interior of the air inlet tube is rotatably connected with a rotating rod I, the exterior of the rotating rod I is fixedly connected with fan blades, and the exterior of the rotating rod I is fixedly connected with a knocking assembly. The water is discharged into the cylinder body through the water delivery valve, and the filter bag in the air inlet pipe filters the smoke, so that the structure in the heat exchange pipe can be cleaned timely, and the smoke is filtered, and the service life of the device is prolonged.

title_en: Method for manufacturing beauty carbon pen based on lake dredging sediment
abstract_en: The application relates to a method for manufacturing an art carbon pen based on lake dredging sediment, which comprises the following steps of sampling the lake dredging sediment to obtain dredging mud, mixing the dredging mud with biological carbon powder to obtain mixed mud, dehydrating the mixed mud to obtain mud cakes with preset water content, extruding the mud cakes into a penholder-shaped green body, and drying and solidifying until the weight is constant to obtain the art carbon pen. The method successfully converts the sediment traditionally regarded as waste into an art charcoal pen product with commercial value, not only greatly improves the recycling benefit of the sediment, but also opens up a brand new application direction facing the cultural creative industry for the sediment disposal, and reduces the dependence on specific wood and meets the requirement of sustainable development by taking the dredging sediment and the biochar prepared by pyrolysis of submerged plants in lakes or agricultural waste as core raw materials.

title_en: Water treatment agent, preparation method thereof and water treatment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water treatment agent, a preparation method thereof and a water treatment method, wherein the water treatment agent comprises, by mass, 70-95 parts of modified fiber composite aluminum salt, 2-20 parts of hybrid polymeric flocculant and 0.2-7 parts of strong absorbent, wherein the modified fiber composite aluminum salt comprises polyaluminium sulfate, bamboo pulp cellulose and sodium silicate. The technical scheme of the invention solves the problem that the total phosphorus content of the treated water body can not reach the effluent standard.

title_en: Self-contained air water taking and cold dry air preparation system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-contained air water taking and cold dry air preparation system and a method, which belong to the technical field of air water taking and indoor environment regulation and comprise a solar energy supply unit, a condensation water taking unit, an adsorption water taking unit, a cold dry air recycling unit, a water treatment unit, an indoor temperature and humidity regulation unit and a control system; the solar energy supply unit provides clean energy for the system, the condensation water taking unit is coupled with the adsorption water taking unit to produce water, the cold dry air recycling unit is connected with the condensation water taking unit, the adsorption water taking unit and the indoor temperature and humidity adjusting unit, the water treatment unit processes condensate water, and the control system dynamically adjusts the working mode of the system according to sensor data. The self-contained air water taking and cold dry air preparation system and method are adopted to realize energy self-supply, low-cost production of non-potable domestic water, and adapt to residential building scenes, so that the problems of environmental limitation, high energy consumption, high noise and low water production rate in the prior art are solved.

title_en: Composite conditioning module for acid soil heavy metal pollution remediation and time sequence accurate remediation method for acid soil heavy metal pollution
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of soil remediation, and particularly relates to a composite conditioning module for acid soil heavy metal pollution remediation and a time sequence accurate remediation method for acid soil heavy metal pollution. Based on the composite conditioning module, the method for timing sequence accurate restoration of heavy metal pollution of acid soil is characterized in that a first module composition is firstly applied for physical and chemical passivation, heavy metal is initially stabilized and pH is adjusted, a second module composition is applied for organic complexation and structural improvement after 7-10 days, the physical structure of soil is further passivated and improved, microbial agents are inoculated after 3-5 days, good environmental strains created by the preamble can be used for rapid colonization and propagation, and finally super-enriched plants are planted for extraction and removal. The repairing method solves the antagonism problem in multicomponent repairing through accurate time sequence control, and realizes synergy.

title_en: Oxygen-enriched low-temperature CO-SCR denitration catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of denitration catalysts, and discloses an oxygen-enriched low-temperature CO-SCR denitration catalyst with higher denitration efficiency under oxygen-enriched and low-temperature conditions, and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the steps of (1) dissolving a paramagnetic active component precursor, a CO-catalytic component precursor, a carrier precursor and a complexing agent in a solvent, uniformly mixing to obtain a precursor solution, (2) adjusting the pH value of the precursor solution, converting the solution into sol under the condition of heating and stirring, standing and aging to form wet gel, (3) placing the wet gel in a magnetic field environment, drying under the action of the magnetic field to obtain xerogel, (4) calcining the xerogel, introducing an inert atmosphere in the calcining process to perform first-stage heat treatment, switching to a weak oxidizing atmosphere to perform second-stage heat treatment, and cooling to room temperature to obtain the oxygen-enriched low-temperature CO-SCR denitration catalyst.

title_en: Intelligent chemical wastewater purifying treatment equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses intelligent chemical wastewater purification treatment equipment, which relates to the field of chemical wastewater purification and comprises a mixing and stirring structure, wherein a filtering powder spraying structure is fixedly arranged above the mixing and stirring structure, the mixing and stirring structure comprises a temperature control stirring assembly fixedly arranged on a powder spraying assembly, the temperature control stirring assembly comprises a wastewater purification tank with a supporting leg at the bottom, and meanwhile, a discharge hole which is convenient for discharging subsequent purified water is formed on the surface of the wastewater purification tank in a penetrating way. According to the invention, the powder spraying component is arranged, the catalytic powder is sprayed into the conveying pipe in an annular shape when the catalytic powder is extracted and conveyed into the concave ring, so that the catalytic powder is fully contacted with the chemical wastewater passing through the conveying pipe, the catalytic powder is prevented from being only contacted with the surface of the chemical wastewater to participate in the reaction, and meanwhile, the catalytic powder can fully participate in the chemical reaction to purify the chemical wastewater when the catalytic powder is fully mixed and contacted with the chemical wastewater in the conveying process.

title_en: Multistage adsorption control method and system for oil gas treatment device
abstract_en: A multistage adsorption control method and a multistage adsorption control system for an oil gas treatment device relate to the field of industrial Internet. The method comprises the steps of monitoring an oil gas concentration characteristic value of an outlet of a preceding-stage adsorption tank in an adsorption state at present, generating a switching instruction when the oil gas concentration characteristic value meets a preset switching condition, controlling a standby adsorption tank to be connected into an oil gas treatment device in response to the switching instruction so as to replace the functional position of the preceding-stage adsorption tank or a subsequent-stage adsorption tank, leading out purified gas of the outlet of the subsequent-stage adsorption tank before an adsorption passage of the preceding-stage adsorption tank is cut off, reversely introducing the purified gas into a connecting pipeline, closing an inlet valve and an outlet valve of the preceding-stage adsorption tank, and carrying out desorption regeneration on the preceding-stage adsorption tank. By implementing the technical scheme provided by the application, the safety of multistage adsorption control is improved.

title_en: Support bracket for supporting support rod, mounting bracket for mounting diameter reducing pipe of sprinkler on support rod and sprinkler support assembly comprising same
abstract_en: The mounting bracket for mounting the sprinkler reducing pipe on the support rod extending in the first direction comprises a first base, a second base, a fixed lever, a flexible hanging bracket and a fixed hanging bracket, wherein the first base extends in a second direction perpendicular to the first direction and penetrates through the support rod, the second base extends in the second direction and penetrates through the support rod, the support rod rotates relative to the first base and wraps the side face of the sprinkler reducing pipe together with the first base, the fixed lever is combined with the first base to rotate from the second base to wrap the front face of the sprinkler reducing pipe, and a part of the fixed lever is provided with fixed saw teeth, and the flexible hanging bracket is combined with the second base and meshed with the fixed saw teeth when the first base and the second base are combined by the fixed lever.

title_en: Spherical lithium-based CO2Method for preparing adsorbent
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a spherical lithium-based CO  2  adsorbent, which comprises the steps of firstly weighing a lithium source, a sol carrier and a binder according to a proportion under a protective gas atmosphere, mixing with deionized water to obtain precursor slurry, then dripping the precursor slurry into semicircular pits formed by graphite powder, drying, and in the drying process, keeping the original pellet shape of the precursor slurry when dripping into a shaping template due to the surface tension of the graphite powder, and meanwhile draining water from the precursor slurry droplets by virtue of the hydrophobicity of the graphite powder, so that the droplets are dried to form spherical precursor particles, and finally calcining the obtained spherical precursor particles at a high temperature to obtain the spherical lithium-based CO  2  adsorbent. According to the preparation method of the spherical lithium-based CO  2  adsorbent, mechanical force is not needed in the preparation process, the porous structure and the active site of the adsorbent can be reserved to the maximum extent, the preparation energy consumption is reduced, and the problems of low CO  2  trapping efficiency and high cost in a thin carbon source are solved.

title_en: Lattice distortion induced catalyst for catalytic oxidation of acetone and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of integral foam metal catalyst preparation, in particular to a lattice distortion induction type catalyst for catalyzing and oxidizing acetone and a preparation method thereof, comprising the following steps of firstly, selecting and cutting raw materials; step two, acid pretreatment and cleaning, step three, solution configuration, step four, hydrothermal synthesis, step five, washing and drying of the catalyst, and step six, electric heating induction of the catalyst. According to the invention, the lattice distortion induced type integral catalyst for electrothermal synergistic catalytic oxidation of acetone is prepared in a hydrothermal synthesis mode, the regulation and control of active component load and electronic structure are synchronously realized, in the catalytic oxidation of acetone, the energy consumption is remarkably reduced, the problems of catalyst sintering and active center deactivation are relieved, and the activity at low temperature is improved.

title_en: Bi (Bi)2WO6/g-C3N4Heterojunction photocatalyst, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Bi  2 WO 6 /g-C 3 N 4  heterojunction photocatalyst, a preparation method and application thereof. The Bi  2 WO 6 /g-C 3 N 4  heterojunction photocatalyst comprises Bi  2 WO 6  particles and g-C  3 N 4  nano-sheets, wherein Z-type heterojunction is formed between the Bi  2 WO 6  particles and the g-C  3 N 4  nano-sheets. The Bi  2 WO 6 /g-C 3 N 4  (BCN) photocatalyst is synergistically optimized with surface engineering through a heterojunction structure, so that the visible light absorption range is widened, the charge separation efficiency is improved, active sites are enriched, the catalyst has abundant surface hydroxyl groups and oxygen vacancies, and a hierarchical mesoporous structure, the adsorption capacity to ZEN is enhanced, the separation and transfer of photogenerated carriers are promoted, the catalytic reaction dynamics are improved, and compared with single g-C  3 N 4  or Bi  2 WO 6 , the degradation rate of ZEN is respectively improved by 2.51 times and 12.57 times, and the degradation efficiency is up to 99.4%.

title_en: Method for treating wastewater by concentrating coupling technology
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of sewage treatment, and particularly relates to a method for treating wastewater by a concentrating coupling technology. The method is realized by using a concentrating coupling wastewater treatment system, the concentrating coupling wastewater treatment system comprises a sun-tracking concentrating part and an energy supply part, the sun-tracking concentrating part comprises a light sensor, a Fresnel concentrating lens, a fixed plate, a motor, a double-shaft tracking bracket, an LED lamp, a reactor and a tracking controller, and the energy supply part comprises an intelligent solar controller, a storage battery and a solar photovoltaic panel. The invention also utilizes the cooperative coupling of the LED light source irradiation and the sunlight focused by the Fresnel condensing lens to realize the efficient treatment of the wastewater. The method is suitable for removing typical antibiotic pollutants in all-weather and multiple scenes, does not need to add a catalyst, has low running cost, and has good application prospect and practical value.

title_en: Industrial security device with waterproof function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of industrial security and protection, and discloses an industrial security and protection device with a waterproof function, which comprises an outer waterproof end shell, a waterproof isolation structure and a siphon drainage structure, wherein the waterproof isolation structure comprises a waterproof tank, a waterproof membrane, a ventilation membrane, a steel mesh and an isolation sleeve barrel, the waterproof tank is arranged at the bottom of the waterproof isolation structure, the waterproof membrane is fixedly connected above the inner wall of the waterproof tank, the ventilation membrane is fixedly connected below the inner wall of the waterproof tank, the steel mesh is fixedly connected at the bottom of the waterproof tank, the isolation sleeve barrel is fixedly connected above the waterproof tank, the siphon drainage structure comprises a pressure sleeve shell, a water inlet hole, a water suction pipeline and a water storage tank, and the pressure sleeve shell is arranged inside the waterproof tank and has the characteristics of strong practicability, good waterproof effect and capability of preventing moisture and dispersing fog.

title_en: Online single-sphere neutron spectrometer based on thermal neutron detector
abstract_en: The invention relates to an online single-sphere neutron spectrometer based on a thermal neutron detector, which comprises a spherical slowing body, a plurality of detectors and a metal layer, wherein the plurality of detectors are distributed in the spherical slowing body at different depths from the center of the sphere and the center of the sphere of the spherical slowing body, the plurality of detectors are arranged at the same depth, and the metal layer is of a spherical shell structure, is concentric with the spherical slowing body and is positioned between the detectors at different depths. The invention can complete the detection of neutrons in different energy ranges at one time based on the arrangement of a plurality of detectors in the same moderating body, has simple structure, convenient use and lower angular response, can improve the response to high-energy neutrons, improve the detection energy range, ensure the response to neutrons in a low-energy region and is suitable for neutron radiation protection in the fields of medical treatment, nuclear power and aerospace science and technology based on the arrangement of the metal layers between the detector layers in different depths.

title_en: Phosphating wastewater recycling system and method for automobile coating line
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of industrial wastewater treatment and resource utilization in automobile manufacturing, and particularly relates to a phosphating wastewater recycling system and method for an automobile coating line. The system comprises a coagulating sedimentation pretreatment unit, a deep filtration and membrane separation unit, a concentrated water limit concentration unit, an evaporative crystallization and full recycling unit and an intelligent control unit. The system can obtain final products of only phosphorus-containing desiccation crystalline salt (hazardous waste) and industrial ultrapure water. The high-salt concentrated water is reduced by more than 90% through high-pressure reverse osmosis, and MVR evaporation is carried out on the high-power concentrated solution only. Through the 'secondary RO+EDI' fine treatment process, the conductivity of the recycled water is stably maintained at 2-3 mu S/cm, and the water supplementing requirement of a pure water tank before electrophoresis of a cab and a frame coating line is completely met. Meanwhile, the system is provided with perfect chemical Cleaning (CIP) logic, so that the service lives of the RO membrane and the MVR heating pipe can be prolonged obviously.

title_en: Decarbonization device for natural gas treatment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a decarbonization device for natural gas treatment, which comprises a decarbonization tower, wherein the top end of the decarbonization tower is fixedly connected with a drying box, the side end of the decarbonization tower is in through connection with a natural gas input hopper, a communicating pipe is in through connection between the top end of the decarbonization tower and the bottom end of the drying box, the side end of the drying box is in through connection with a natural gas discharge hopper, a spraying system is arranged in the decarbonization tower, the bottom end of the decarbonization tower is in through connection with a liquid discharge hopper, a dewatering piece is arranged in the drying box, and a drying piece is arranged in the drying box.

title_en: Filter device, disassembly method thereof and range hood
abstract_en: The application provides a filtering device, a disassembling method thereof and a range hood, wherein the filtering device comprises a first shell, a second shell and a first shell, wherein the first shell is provided with a containing cavity with a first opening; the filter assembly is detachably arranged in the accommodating cavity and divides the accommodating cavity into a first cavity and a second cavity communicated with the first opening, the filter assembly is configured to filter fluid entering the second cavity from the first opening into the first cavity, the second shell is slidably arranged with the first shell and is provided with the second opening, and when the second shell and the filter assembly are in an assembled state, the second opening is communicated with the first opening, and the second shell at least partially extends into the second cavity and is in butt joint with one side of the filter assembly facing the second cavity. The application can detach and clean the filter assembly, and solves the technical problem of poor cleaning effect on the filter assembly in the prior art.

title_en: X-ray detector structure with variable curvature
abstract_en: The invention provides an X-ray detector structure with variable curvature, which comprises a flexible X-ray detection panel with two flexible surfaces, a rigid limiting block group arranged on the flexible surfaces and an elastic stretchable compression layer filled and wrapped with the rigid limiting block and the flexible X-ray detection panel. The flexible X-ray detection panel is adopted to replace a complex external supporting structure to realize the X-ray detector with variable curvature, and the portability and the application efficiency of the detector are improved while the curvature is variable; the flexible X-ray detection panels with the other two flexible surfaces realize double-sided bending, improve the detection efficiency in dense pipelines and narrow space scenes, and finally, the elastic stretchable compression layer avoids the stretching limit bending of the flexible panel or surface wrinkles from influencing imaging and improves the imaging effect of the X-ray detector.

title_en: Tray structure, absorption tower and flue gas desulfurization system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of absorption towers and discloses a tray structure, an absorption tower and a flue gas desulfurization system, wherein the tray structure comprises a reinforcing ring which is annular and is arranged on the peripheral wall of the absorption tower in a surrounding manner; the suspension cable type tray is suspended in the absorption tower, two ends of the suspension cable type tray are connected with two opposite ends of the reinforcing ring, and the suspension cable type tray is an alloy piece. The suspension cable type tray of the technical scheme of the application occupies space which is only the thickness of the suspension cable type tray, and the whole suspension cable type tray is in a tension state, so that the advantage of high tensile strength of an alloy piece is fully utilized, the sufficient strength of the suspension cable type tray is ensured, the engineering quantity and the installation cost of the suspension cable type tray are greatly reduced, and meanwhile, the suspension cable type tray has a light self structure, and is simple to install, safe and reliable. And the stability of the annular reinforcing ring is fully utilized, so that the safety and reliability of the whole tray structure are ensured.

title_en: Novel ultra-high specific surface area high-efficiency ozone decomposition catalyst and coating process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel ultra-high specific surface area high-efficiency ozone decomposition catalyst and a coating process thereof, relates to the technical field of ozone decomposition, and aims to solve the problem of low ozone decomposition efficiency in the prior art. The catalyst is in the form of suspension, and is prepared by adopting the steps of A1, synthesizing nano manganese dioxide with a nanowire, a nano sheet or an ultrathin nano flower structure by adopting a hydrothermal method or a coprecipitation method, A2, freeze-drying the synthesized nano manganese dioxide to obtain black nano manganese dioxide powder, A3, mixing the nano manganese dioxide powder with deionized water, a binder, a thickening agent and a dispersing agent, and grinding for 12-24 hours by adopting a ball mill or a sand mill to form the stable and uniform catalyst in the form of suspension. The invention has the advantage of realizing efficient ozonolysis.

title_en: Cyclone rising reflux type high-efficiency catalytic oxidation fluidized bed reactor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cyclone rising reflux type high-efficiency catalytic oxidation fluidized bed reactor, and relates to the technical field of water treatment. The device comprises a main body, a flow guiding device, a backflow sedimentation zone, a detection assembly and a detection assembly, wherein a reaction cavity is arranged in the main body, an air outlet is formed in the top of the main body, a water inlet, an air inlet and an oxidant inlet are formed in the bottom of the main body, a plurality of carrier particles are arranged in the reaction cavity, the flow guiding device is arranged in the reaction cavity and used for guiding liquid in the reaction cavity to swirl upwards, the backflow sedimentation zone is arranged on the side wall of the main body, a reaction cavity outlet communicated with the backflow sedimentation zone is formed above the side wall of the main body, a reaction cavity inlet communicated with the backflow sedimentation zone is formed below the side wall of the main body, and a backflow water outlet is formed in the top of the backflow sedimentation zone. The invention can form a stable rotational flow upflow field, so that the catalyst particles are in a good fluidization state, and the contact area of the wastewater, the oxidant and the catalyst surface and the mass transfer efficiency are greatly increased.

title_en: Direct-drive high-temperature molten salt two-stage of coal-fired boiler Heat storage power generation and heat supply peak regulation system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the peak regulation field of coal-fired power plants, in particular to a direct-driven high-temperature molten salt two-stage heat storage, power generation and heat supply peak regulation system and method for a coal-fired boiler, wherein the system comprises a coal-fired boiler unit, a heat-carrying flue gas unit and a flue gas pipeline, wherein the flue gas boiler can generate heat, and the flue gas pipeline allows flue gas to circulate; the system comprises a molten salt heat storage unit, one or more power generation units and a heat supply unit, wherein the molten salt heat storage unit comprises a molten salt storage vessel such as a molten salt tank and a molten salt pipeline allowing molten salt to circulate, the molten salt can exchange heat with flue gas in the flue gas pipeline so as to store heat, the one or more power generation units are used for generating power by utilizing part of the heat stored by the molten salt heat storage unit, the plurality of power generation units can be regulated independently of one another in the case that the power generation unit comprises a plurality of power generation units, and the heat supply unit is used for supplying heat by utilizing part of the heat stored by the molten salt heat storage unit. With this configuration, power generation and heat supply can be realized by coupling the coal-fired boiler and the two-stage molten salt.

title_en: Waste lithium iron phosphate electrode material coupled metal-organic framework derived composite catalyst and preparation and organic pollutant treatment application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a waste lithium iron phosphate electrode material coupling metal-organic framework derived composite catalyst, a preparation method and an application of organic pollutant treatment thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps of mixing pretreated waste lithium iron phosphate electrode material (sLFP) powder with a zinc-based zeolite imidazole framework (ZIF-8) according to a specific mass ratio, and calcining at a high temperature under an inert atmosphere to realize compact coating and coupling of a reconstructed LiFePO  4  phase obtained by pyrolyzing a nitrogen-doped carbon framework pair sLFP derived from the ZIF-8, so as to obtain a novel composite catalyst with high specific surface area, excellent conductivity and rich active sites. The invention realizes the high value-added conversion of the waste electrode material, the Fenton-like reaction system cooperatively constructed by the obtained composite catalyst and the Peroxymonosulfate (PMS) has the degradation rate of more than 98.5 percent on refractory organic pollutants such as Sulfamethoxazole (SMX) and the like at normal temperature, has excellent catalytic stability and the advantage of green integrated treatment of 'treating waste with waste', and has wide engineering application prospect.

title_en: Hydrogen peroxide generating device for ectopic soil remediation and soil remediation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydrogen peroxide generating device and a soil restoration method for restoring ectopic soil, belonging to the technical field of soil restoration, wherein the hydrogen peroxide generating device comprises a reactor and a liquid inlet tank; the reactor is connected with a liquid inlet tank and comprises an end plate, an anode electrode, an anode runner plate, a diaphragm, a cathode plate, a cathode electrode, a gas plate, a cathode electrode, a cathode plate symmetrical plate, a diaphragm, an anode runner plate symmetrical plate, an anode electrode, an anode double-sided plate, an anode runner plate, a diaphragm, a cathode plate, a cathode electrode, a gas plate, a cathode electrode, a cathode plate symmetrical plate, a diaphragm, an anode runner plate symmetrical plate, an anode electrode, an anode plate symmetrical plate and an end plate symmetrical plate which are stacked in sequence. The hydrogen peroxide generating device disclosed by the invention has excellent stability, can accurately adjust the water outlet concentration of hydrogen peroxide according to specific requirements of soil remediation, ensures the remediation effect, and is simple and convenient to operate and remarkably improves the efficiency.

title_en: Sulfur-resistant noble metal-based catalyst, monolithic noble metal catalyst, preparation methods and applications thereof, and treatment method of tail gas of coal gasification device purification unit
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of CO oxidation catalysts, in particular to a sulfur-resistant noble metal-based catalyst, an integral noble metal catalyst, preparation methods and applications thereof, and a treatment method of tail gas of a purification unit of a coal gasification device. The catalyst comprises a carrier, an active component and an auxiliary agent, wherein the active component and the auxiliary agent are loaded on the carrier, the active element in the active component is at least one of noble metal elements, the active metal element in the auxiliary agent is at least one of non-noble metal elements, the metal dispersity in the catalyst is not less than 40%, the active component and part of the auxiliary agent form alloy particles in a sulfur hybridization state, the average particle diameter of the alloy particles is not more than 2.0nm, the atomic number of noble metal in the alloy particles is more than or equal to 70%, and the atomic number of S is more than or equal to 10%. The scheme of the invention can remove CO tail gas generated by various working conditions, has low energy consumption, no secondary pollution, high efficiency and good stability, and is beneficial to the up-to-standard emission of CO and the popularization of CO removal technology.

title_en: Dynamic covalent composite DA@GLM/MFC aerogel material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dynamic covalent composite DA@GLM/MFC aerogel material, a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the field of photothermal conversion materials, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing a partially oxidized MFC cryogel, (2) preparing dopamine hydrochloride modified gallium-based liquid metal DA-GLM nano droplets, (3) dispersing the DA-GLM nano droplets in an ethanol solution, and then soaking the MFC cryogel in the solution to obtain a dynamic covalent composite DA@GLM/MFC aerogel material; the dynamic covalent composite DA@GLM/MFC aerogel material obtained by the invention constructs a dynamic covalent bonding structure by using Schiff base bonds, so that a liquid metal and aerosol composite material with stable bonding is obtained, and the obtained material has excellent photo-thermal performance, high strength and toughness mechanical performance and ultra-stable cycle performance, and can strengthen the adsorption and catalytic degradation capability of salt ions and improve the photo-thermal conversion efficiency through being used as a solar drive interface evaporation material.

title_en: Biochar-based magnetic photocatalytic composite material and high-efficiency photocatalytic water treatment device and method adapting same
abstract_en: The invention discloses a biochar-based magnetic photocatalytic composite material, a high-efficiency photocatalytic water treatment device and a high-efficiency photocatalytic water treatment method adapting the same, wherein the biochar-based magnetic photocatalytic composite material is a ZnFe  2 O 4  and nitrogen co-doped biochar composite material and has visible light catalytic activity and magnetic separation characteristics, and the high-efficiency photocatalytic water treatment device adapting the biochar-based magnetic photocatalytic composite material comprises a cyclone dispersing and photocatalytic reaction unit, a magnetic force enhanced cyclone separation unit and a closed-loop automatic circulation unit which are sequentially connected through pipelines and form a circulation circuit.

title_en: Solid waste treatment equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of waste treatment, in particular to solid waste treatment equipment, which comprises a crusher and a bracket, wherein a box body is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the crusher, two discharging plates are arranged at the bottom of the crusher, a first driving piece is arranged outside the box body, a magnetic suction component is rotatably connected inside the box body, a compression component is fixedly arranged on one side of the box body, a first discharging hole is formed in the box body, a material guiding plate is arranged inside the first discharging hole, a first discharging plate is hinged at the bottom of the compression component, a water storage tank is communicated and fixedly arranged at the bottom of the box body, a first discharging component is arranged at the top of one side of the water storage tank, a second discharging component is arranged at the bottom of the water storage tank, a second driving piece is arranged outside the water storage tank, and a water adding component is arranged below the water storage tank.

title_en: Regenerated positive electrode material with orientation site induced antiferromagnetic coupling, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regenerated positive electrode material of orientation site induced antiferromagnetic coupling, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the regenerated positive electrode material of orientation site induced antiferromagnetic coupling is regenerated nickel cobalt lithium manganate positive electrode material, the crystal structure of the regenerated nickel cobalt lithium manganate positive electrode material contains niobium atoms, wherein the niobium atoms occupy lithium sites in a crystal lattice, and a Nb-O-Ni coordination structure is formed locally. The preparation method comprises the steps of preprocessing a waste nickel cobalt lithium manganate positive electrode material to obtain a positive electrode material intermediate, mixing the positive electrode material intermediate, a lithium source and a niobium source to obtain powder to be sintered, calcining the powder to be sintered at a high temperature, and cooling to obtain the regenerated positive electrode material with orientation site induced antiferromagnetic coupling. The lithium ion battery is applied to a lithium ion battery, and has long-cycle stability.

title_en: Dustproof computer network rack of intelligence humiture management and control
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of computer cabinets, in particular to an intelligent temperature and humidity control dustproof computer network cabinet which comprises a cabinet body and a control assembly, wherein the control assembly comprises an air inlet channel, a plurality of hydrophobic layers, a water absorption sponge layer and a drying cabinet, external air is sucked through the air inlet channel, wet air firstly passes through the plurality of hydrophobic layers to filter large-particle water drops, if dust exists in the air, the water absorption sponge layer can also be used for filtering the air, the filtered air further absorbs moisture in the air, finally the air enters the drying cabinet to thoroughly dry the air, the air is uniformly sprayed into the cabinet body after the drying is finished, then the air in the cabinet body is discharged, and the continuous circulation is carried out, so that the temperature and humidity control can be carried out on the interior of the computer network cabinet, and meanwhile, the dust filtration is carried out on the air entering from the exterior, so that the stable operation of computer equipment in the cabinet is ensured.

title_en: Fineness control process for single coal
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coking, in particular to a fineness control process of single coal, which comprises a feed conveyor, a first communication chute, a first-stage belt feeder, a second communication chute, a first-stage pulverizer, a third communication chute, a first-stage sampler, a second-stage belt feeder, a tail chute, a head chute, a second-stage pulverizer, a fourth communication chute, a second-stage sampler and a discharge conveyor; compared with the traditional coking coal preparation process, the process provided by the invention combines the pre-crusher chamber and the crusher chamber into a whole, and the two-stage crusher chamber is arranged in front of the coal blending unit, so that the traditional coal preparation process is simplified, the flow is shortened, the production management is more centralized, only one crusher chamber is arranged in front of the coal blending, the corridor in front of the second crusher chamber in the conventional process is omitted, the one-time investment cost is obviously reduced, the explosion danger area of the coal preparation system is reduced, and the production safety is improved.

title_en: Ultrathin micro-special motor with good heat dissipation effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultrathin micro-special motor with good heat dissipation effect, and relates to the technical field of micro-special motors. The self-cleaning heat dissipation device comprises a motor main body, wherein an output shaft is arranged at the front end of the motor main body, a heat dissipation shell is fixedly connected to the rear end of the motor main body, a dust screen and a shaking mechanism are arranged at the rear end of the heat dissipation shell, and heat conduction fins penetrate through and are fixedly connected to the front end of the heat dissipation shell.

title_en: Clean air device and clean air system
abstract_en: The invention provides a clean air device and a clean air system having a method for judging filter clogging with both precision and cost. The air cleaning device comprises a filter, and a differential pressure sensor for measuring the pressure difference before and after the filter, wherein the differential pressure sensor is used for measuring the air quantity after the filter, the second life prediction line is generated in a mode that the change rate of the second life prediction line is aligned with the change rate of a first life prediction line related to the wind speed, the first life prediction line is obtained based on the initial value of any one of the air quantity sensor and the differential pressure sensor and the value when the measurement is corrected, the second life prediction line is measured by a sensor different from the sensor used for generating the first life prediction line, and the management of the filter is performed based on the first life prediction line or the second life prediction line.

title_en: Automatic vacuum stabilizing system of cooling plate type siphon feeding pipe of decomposer
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of alumina production, and particularly relates to an automatic vacuum stabilizing system of a cooling plate type siphon feeding pipe of a decomposer, which comprises an automatic siphon vacuumizing mechanism, a gas-liquid separation and automatic discharging mechanism and a valve control mechanism, wherein the mechanisms are connected through pipelines and realize signal linkage, and the top of the siphon is provided with a floating ball liquid level meter, the gas-liquid separator is connected in series on the vacuumizing pipeline, and the components and the valve are in signal linkage to realize automatic control. The invention can synchronously remove free air in the siphon and residual air wrapped by foam, realize closed-loop automatic operation, ensure stable and continuous siphon effect, promote production continuity, adapt to a decomposed mother liquor conveying system which is easy to generate foam, can be directly added on the basis of the existing equipment, and has wide application range.

title_en: Ion regulation-based high-concentration brine treatment and power generation evaporation material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integrated evaporation material for high-concentration brine treatment and power generation based on ion regulation and control, a preparation method thereof and a water treatment and energy collection system, and belongs to the technical field of solar interface evaporation and the like. The material takes polyurethane sponge as a porous framework, a photo-thermal conductive network is constructed by impregnating conductive graphite and sodium alginate suspension, then the photo-thermal conductive network is crosslinked twice by sodium alginate-calcium chloride, and polystyrene sulfonic acid is introduced in the middle for impregnation, so that an ion regulation gel layer containing sulfonate groups is formed, and a three-layer composite structure is formed. The material has simple preparation process and low cost, the evaporation rate of 20wt% sodium chloride solution is more than or equal to 3.6 kg.m  ‑2 ·h ‑1  and no salt crystallization is carried out under 1 sunlight, the open-circuit voltage of more than or equal to 800 mV and the short-circuit current of more than or equal to 600 mu A can be generated, the retention rate of salt ions is more than 99.9%, the high-concentration brine can be efficiently desalted and stably generated, and the material is suitable for large-scale production and application.

title_en: Charging assembly, reaction kettle for hydroxypropyl methyl cellulose production and use method of reaction kettle
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of chemical production, and discloses a feeding component, a reaction kettle for hydroxypropyl methyl cellulose production and a use method thereof, and the invention provides a solution for the escape problem caused by the gas-solid flow field disturbance of the superfine powder raw material when the superfine powder raw material is thrown in by gravity and the fluid problem that the boundary layer sediment in a spiral heat exchange flow channel is difficult to peel; the feeding assembly is provided with a humidifying structure on a discharging disc, a dynamic liquid curtain is constructed by utilizing liquid phase media sprayed obliquely, the aerodynamic diameter of powder particles is increased, turbulent diffusion is restrained from a source, a vibrating structure is arranged, a second arc-shaped plate pushes an arc-shaped rod, rubber balls intermittently strike the discharging disc to damage static friction accumulation of powder, a cleaning structure is arranged on a reaction kettle, a booster pump forms cooling water in a heat preservation water tank into spiral rotating water flow through a conical cylinder spiral liquid guide plate to scour the inner wall of a spiral condensing pipe, and a motor II drives a stirring shaft to drive a cam to superimpose transient pulse pressure waves in a spiral flow field to damage a laminar flow bottom layer.

title_en: Sludge discharge device and method for continuous flow aerobic granular sludge culture
abstract_en: The invention provides a sludge discharge device and a culture method for continuous flow aerobic granular sludge culture, which relate to the technical field of sewage biological treatment, wherein the sludge discharge device comprises a sludge inlet pipe, a multistage sedimentation barrel, a mud guard, a selection valve group, a heavy sludge return pipe and a top overflow pipe; the multistage sedimentation barrel is of a vertically arranged sedimentation structure, sludge with different sedimentation performances is distributed in the barrel body in a layered manner along the height direction under the condition of continuous sludge feeding, one end of a sludge feeding pipe is communicated with an aerobic end section of the biological pond through a sludge feeding port, the other end of the sludge feeding pipe stretches into the multistage sedimentation barrel, a mud baffle is arranged at the front end of a sludge feeding area, the inclination angle between the mud baffle and a horizontal plane is adjustable, a selection valve group is arranged at different height positions of the side wall of the multistage sedimentation barrel and used for discharging sludge corresponding to different sedimentation layers, a heavy sludge return pipe is arranged at the bottom of the multistage sedimentation barrel, and a top overflow pipe is arranged at the top of the multistage sedimentation barrel.

title_en: Device and method for evaluating wet dust settling efficiency of deep well under damp-heat condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for evaluating wet dust fall efficiency under a deep well damp and hot condition, wherein a temperature and humidity regulation module comprises an electric heater, an air-cooled refrigerating unit, an ultrasonic humidifier, a rotary dehumidifier, a temperature sensor and a humidity sensor, a wind speed regulation module comprises a negative pressure fan, an angle-adjustable guide plate, an electric air valve and a wind speed sensor, a spray dust fall module comprises a spray header, a booster water pump, a flow regulating valve, a water tank, a pressure gauge, an electromagnetic flowmeter and a sedimentation tank, and a dust fall efficiency evaluation module comprises an aerosol generator and a large-range dust concentration sensor. According to the invention, dust is generated through the aerosol generator, concentration change is monitored by using the large-range dust concentration sensor arranged along the roadway, the high-temperature and high-humidity extreme environment of the deep mine can be accurately simulated, the dust settling efficiency is automatically calculated by combining the integrated control device, and the integrated and standardized efficiency comparison and evaluation of different dust settling technologies under the same severe environment are realized.

title_en: Biological reaction tank mixed liquid suspended solid concentration control method based on activated sludge mathematical model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a biological reaction tank mixed liquid suspended solid concentration control method based on an activated sludge mathematical model, which comprises the following steps of S1, establishing and calibrating the activated sludge mathematical model, S2, setting a target MLSS concentration value of a biological reaction tank, collecting the MLSS concentration in the biological reaction tank, S3, calculating the current total activated sludge mass according to the MLSS concentration and the effective volume of the biological reaction tank, S4, carrying out simulation prediction on the net growth of activated sludge in the last control period through the activated sludge mathematical model, S5, calculating the target sludge discharge mass of the next control period according to the current total activated sludge mass and the simulation prediction result of the net growth of activated sludge, and S6, determining the sludge discharge flow according to the target sludge discharge mass and the external sludge discharge concentration measured in real time. The invention solves the problems of lag response, low adjustment precision, poor adaptability to water inlet load change and the like in the existing sewage treatment process by an activated sludge method.

title_en: Continuous production system and production method of temperature-control type polymeric ferric chloride flocculant
abstract_en: The invention relates to a temperature control type continuous production system and a production method of a polymeric ferric chloride flocculant, belonging to the technical field of water treatment medicament preparation, wherein the system comprises a raw material pretreatment module, a multistage serial reaction module, a heat exchange module, an automatic control module and a curing storage module; the multistage serial reaction module comprises at least two polymerization reaction kettles which are connected in series, wherein each reaction kettle is provided with an independent temperature control jacket and a temperature sensor, the automatic control module adopts a DCS distributed control system, and the heating or cooling medium flow of the heat exchange module is adjusted in real time according to the feedback of the temperature sensor. According to the invention, through a continuous production mode, precise sectional temperature control, multi-parameter intelligent control and efficient heat exchange design, the problems of low production efficiency, unstable product quality, poor temperature control precision and the like in the prior art are systematically solved, the production technical level of the polymeric ferric chloride flocculant is obviously improved, and the polymeric ferric chloride flocculant has good industrial application prospect and economic benefit.

title_en: Method and system for extracting 8N helium from natural gas
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of helium gas extraction, and discloses a method and a system for extracting 8N helium gas from natural gas. The method comprises the steps of A1, carrying out membrane separation on raw material natural gas to obtain helium-rich natural gas, liquefying the helium-rich natural gas, extracting bubble point gas, A2, carrying out catalytic oxidative dehydrogenation on the bubble point gas to obtain first coarse helium gas, A3, carrying out pressurization, adsorption, primary cryogenic separation and secondary cryogenic separation on the first coarse helium gas in sequence, separating water, methane and nitrogen to obtain second coarse helium gas, and A4, carrying out low-temperature adsorption and adsorption solidification on the second coarse helium gas. The method has short process flow and low cost, and simultaneously the purity of the extracted helium is as high as 99.999999 percent and the recovery rate is high.

title_en: Electric scanning beam emittance measuring device with beam splitting and current intensity measuring functions
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric scanning type beam emittance measuring device with beam splitting and beam intensity measuring functions, which is provided with a beam splitting device and an emittance measuring device which are sequentially arranged along the beam direction, wherein the emittance measuring device is an emittance measuring device with the beam intensity measuring function, the beam splitting device is used for removing impurity particles led out of an ion source from the beam so as to split the target particles, the emittance measuring device is used for measuring the emittance of the split target particles and measuring the beam intensity of the target particles, and the emittance measuring device moves up and down along the direction perpendicular to the beam in the working state to sequentially finish the emittance measurement of each measuring point of the target particle beam and the beam intensity measurement of the target particle beam. The invention solves the problems of measuring the emittance and the duty ratio of specific ions in the mixed beam, and solves the problem that a single device can simultaneously measure two key parameters of emittance and flow intensity.

title_en: Knowledge and data collaborative driven sewage treatment process abnormality monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention provides a knowledge and data collaborative driving sewage treatment process anomaly monitoring method, which relates to the field of sewage treatment process monitoring and specifically comprises the following steps of designing knowledge features and data feature alignment and excavation by using a self-encoder based on the knowledge and operation data of the sewage treatment process mechanism of an activated sludge process, and realizing feature fusion by using a cross attention mechanism; the method comprises the steps of constructing an anomaly monitoring model based on a Gaussian mixture model, designing a feature-model parameter synchronous updating strategy based on an estimated network, designing an anomaly monitoring evaluation index based on an energy function of negative log likelihood probability, and combining a threshold judgment logic to realize accurate monitoring of the anomaly index. The technical scheme of the invention solves the problem that the monitoring method of the sewage treatment process in the prior art is difficult to consider the accuracy and the interpretability of anomaly monitoring.

title_en: Decomposing and recycling method of epoxy resin-based carbon fiber composite material
abstract_en: The invention relates to a good method for decomposing and recycling epoxy resin carbon fiber composite materials, which comprises the steps of blending a carbon fiber plate with alkali liquor, sealing and heating, washing and drying to obtain complete carbon fibers, and separating filtrate to obtain bisphenol A salt compounds. The method can be used for recycling the carbon fibers in the carbon fiber board, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Integrated household sewage treatment system based on MBBR filler
abstract_en: The invention provides an integrated domestic sewage treatment system based on MBBR (moving bed biofilm reactor) filler, which comprises a water inlet unit, an anaerobic tank, an anoxic tank, an aerobic tank, a secondary sedimentation tank, a disinfection tank, a water outlet unit, a sewage backflow unit and a sludge backflow unit which are sequentially connected, wherein an aeration device is arranged at the bottom of the aerobic tank, the aerobic tank is filled with the MBBR filler, the sludge backflow unit is communicated with the secondary sedimentation tank and the anaerobic tank, the sewage backflow unit is communicated with the anoxic tank and the secondary sedimentation tank, the volume of the anaerobic tank is 25-40L, the volume of the anoxic tank is 35-45L, the volume of the aerobic tank is 200-250L, the volume of the secondary sedimentation tank is 15-25L, the volume of the disinfection tank is 15-25L, the dissolved oxygen of the anaerobic tank is less than 0. 0.2 mg/L, the dissolved oxygen of the anoxic tank is 0.2-0.5 mg/L, and the dissolved oxygen of the aerobic tank is 2-4 mg/L. The domestic sewage treatment system has compact structure and stable operation, and is suitable for domestic sewage application scenes with lower population density.

title_en: Composite microbial agent for hexavalent chromium pollution remediation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a compound microbial agent for hexavalent chromium pollution remediation and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of environmental engineering. The composite microbial agent for hexavalent chromium pollution remediation comprises anaerobic bacteria, aerobic bacteria, heavy metal bacteria and a carbon source. The compound microbial agent for hexavalent chromium pollution remediation can keep high activity in a practical complex environment of low temperature and oligonutrition of underground water, quickly reduce hexavalent chromium into trivalent chromium with low toxicity and low mobility, and realize efficient removal of hexavalent chromium. The in-situ restoration method of hexavalent chromium-polluted groundwater can be widely applied to the environmental engineering fields of industrial field legacy pollution control, mine wastewater treatment, agricultural non-point source pollution restoration and the like, and is particularly suitable for in-situ injection-enhanced natural attenuation groundwater restoration technology.

title_en: Triazole modified polyamine polyphosphonic acid type corrosion and scale inhibitor and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a triazole modified polyamine polyphosphonic acid type corrosion and scale inhibitor and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of industrial water treatment and oil and gas field chemicals. The corrosion and scale inhibitor is a triazole modified polyamine polyphosphonic acid type corrosion and scale inhibitor. The preparation method comprises the steps of firstly reacting 1,2, 4-triazole, alpha, omega-dibromoalkane and sodium hydride to prepare a triazole derivative, then mixing the triazole derivative with polyamine monomers to carry out amination grafting reaction to obtain a triazole modified polyamine intermediate, and finally carrying out Mannich phosphine methylation reaction on the triazole modified polyamine intermediate, phosphorous acid and formaldehyde under the condition of acid catalysis to obtain a target product. The invention integrates scale inhibiting groups, corrosion inhibition heterocycles and hydrophobic long chains, and relieves the interface competitive adsorption of the traditional compound medicament on the metal surface.
