The agent has double effects of lattice distortion scale inhibition and compact adsorption film formation corrosion inhibition under the working conditions of high temperature, high salt and high hardness of oil and gas fields, and has long-term and stable protective performance.

title_en: Radioactive source positioning and tracking method and device based on holder
abstract_en: The invention provides a radiation source positioning and tracking method and device based on a holder, and relates to the technical field of radiation source detection and tracking. The method comprises the steps of obtaining detection data of a plurality of crystal detectors when a radiation source in the environment is located and tracked, judging whether the radiation source exists in the environment according to the detection data, determining the relative position relation between the radiation source and the detection center shaft of the main crystal detector according to the detection data when the radiation source exists in the environment, and driving a cradle head according to the relative position relation so that the detection center shaft of the main crystal detector points to the position of the radiation source. Through the intelligent fusion of the polycrystal detector and the rotary holder, the real-time, high-precision and low-cost positioning and tracking of the radioactive source are realized, and visual optical visual confirmation can be provided.

title_en: Concentration and reduction treatment method for antibiotic fungus residues
abstract_en: The invention provides a concentration and reduction treatment method of antibiotic fungus residues, and belongs to the technical field of separation and purification of biopharmaceuticals and recycling of hazardous wastes. The concentration and volume reduction treatment method comprises the following steps of (1) carrying out solid-liquid separation on antibiotic fermentation liquor to obtain wet fungus residues, adding aqueous solution to dilute to obtain feed liquid, and (2) pumping the feed liquid obtained in the step (1) into membrane separation equipment capable of generating shearing force to carry out cross-flow filtration to obtain concentrated solution after volume reduction and separated dialyzate. The concentration reduction method can greatly improve the concentration multiple of the high-fungus concentration erythromycin bacteria residues under the conditions of low energy consumption and low cost, reduce the subsequent treatment volume, reduce the treatment cost and improve the utilization efficiency of solid waste resources. Meanwhile, the concentrated dialysate can be recycled, and the yield of erythromycin products is improved. In addition, the concentrated membrane cleaning scheme can ensure that the membrane flux recovery rate is more than or equal to 96 percent. The invention provides a good operation method for the industrial production of antibiotic products.

title_en: Application of iron complex catalyst in electrochemical catalytic degradation of waste epoxy resin and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of recycling of waste resin, in particular to an application of an iron complex catalyst in electrochemical catalytic degradation of waste epoxy resin and a device thereof, wherein an iron complex of tri (2-picolyl) amine or a derivative thereof is used as a mixed electrolyte of the catalyst, tetrabutylammonium hexafluorophosphate, acetonitrile and water, and under the action of constant voltage, the iron complex is activated in situ to generate a high-valence ferrite intermediate with high oxidation activity. The method utilizes the strong oxidizing capacity of the high-valence ferrite intermediate to selectively break the crosslinking chemical bond (C-N) in the amine curing epoxy resin network, realizes the efficient degradation of the resin matrix and the complete recovery of the reinforced fiber, has the advantages of mild reaction condition, high catalytic efficiency, environment protection, complete fiber recovery and the like, can realize the degradation of the fiber composite material within 15h at 60 ℃, provides a new way for the green recycling of the waste thermosetting composite material, and solves the problems of high recovery difficulty, high cost and low efficiency of the reinforced fiber in the existing amine curing epoxy resin.

title_en: Al (aluminum) alloy3+Crosslinked graphene oxide/MXene composite membrane and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of membrane separation materials, in particular to an Al  3+  crosslinked graphene oxide/MXene composite membrane with high swelling resistance and excellent ion screening performance, and a preparation method and application thereof. The composite membrane is formed by crosslinking GO nano sheets, MXene nano sheets and Al  3+  ions, al  3+  forms an Al-O-C bond and an Al-O-Ti bond with the carboxyl of GO and the terminal oxygen of MXene respectively, and a stable lamellar network is constructed. The preparation method comprises the steps of preparation of MXene and GO dispersion liquid, suction filtration molding of the composite membrane and crosslinking and curing of Al  3+ , and the process is simple and controllable. The composite membrane has excellent swelling resistance, high-efficiency ion screening performance and long-period stability, the pure water flux can reach 1.19L/m 2/h1, and the dissolution rate of Al  3+  is lower than 0.6%. The invention solves the problems of easy swelling and unstable performance of the existing MXene membrane, can be widely applied to the fields of forward osmosis sea water desalination, accurate ion screening and the like, and has important practical application value.

title_en: Water purification system and refrigeration equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a water purifying system and refrigerating equipment, wherein the water purifying system comprises a water tank, a first pipeline, a circulating pipeline and a first purifying piece, wherein the water tank is provided with a water inlet and a water outlet, one end of the first pipeline is communicated with the water outlet, the other end of the first pipeline is used for being connected with water equipment, one end of the circulating pipeline is communicated with the water outlet, the other end of the circulating pipeline is communicated with the water inlet, so that liquid in the water tank flows out from the water outlet and then circulates into the water tank through the circulating pipeline and the water inlet, and the first purifying piece is arranged in the circulating pipeline and is used for purifying the liquid flowing through the circulating pipeline. According to the water purifying system provided by the invention, the liquid in the water tank can form a circulating path among the water tank, the water outlet, the circulating pipeline and the water inlet, and the liquid is purified once through the first purifying piece every time the liquid completes one cycle, so that the problem of water quality reduction caused by long-term standing of the liquid in the water tank can be restrained.

title_en: Guide ring tunnel type filter element
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of filter elements, in particular to a guide ring tunnel type filter element, which comprises a gas-liquid separation filter element, wherein two sides of the horizontal end of the gas-liquid separation filter element are respectively provided with a second semicircular protection pipe fitting, the upper ends of the two second semicircular protection pipe fittings are respectively fixedly provided with a first semicircular protection pipe fitting, the gas-liquid separation filter element is positioned between the two second semicircular protection pipe fittings and the two first semicircular protection pipe fittings, and the two first semicircular protection pipe fittings are respectively provided with an arc-shaped opening. According to the invention, through the cooperation of the two first semicircular protective pipe fittings and the two arc-shaped openings, the coating of the gas-liquid separation filter element can be effectively realized, and meanwhile, through the effect of the filter element sealing ring piece, the electrolyte is ensured to flow directionally through the gas-liquid separation filter element, so that the gas-liquid separation operation can be realized on the second semicircular protective pipe fitting.

title_en: Low-temperature wet oxidation treatment chemical wastewater zero discharge method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of chemical wastewater treatment, and discloses a low-temperature wet oxidation treatment chemical wastewater zero discharge method, which is suitable for high-salt refractory concentrated water produced by reverse osmosis concentration, wherein COD is 500-2000 mg/L, B/C is less than or equal to 0.2, TDS is more than or equal to 30000mg/L, suspended matters and large-particle impurities are removed by pretreatment of wastewater, the suspended matters are not higher than 5mg/L by controlling the water inlet suspension of a catalytic wet oxidation unit through solid-liquid separation, the COD removal rate is not lower than 85% under the conditions of 150-180 ℃ and 0.5-2.2 megapascals, and then the wastewater is concentrated, evaporated and crystallized through a membrane, water production and condensed water recycling, and the recycling of crystalline salt is realized. The method effectively reduces the energy consumption and equipment corrosion risk of wet oxidation reaction, improves the removal efficiency of refractory organics, avoids the deactivation of the catalyst and the blockage of the membrane, can recycle the crystallization salt, has low operation cost, and is suitable for various refractory organic chemical wastewater zero-emission projects.

title_en: Pretreatment method of high-salt organic wastewater
abstract_en: The application discloses a high-salt organic wastewater pretreatment method, and belongs to the field of wastewater treatment. The method comprises the steps of 1, physical pretreatment, 2, biochemical pretreatment, 3, microbial domestication, 4, anoxic electrolytic treatment, 5, aerobic electrolytic treatment and 6, filtering water. The core of the method is that the electro-catalysis strengthening biochemical treatment is carried out, and the biochemical treatment supplements the electro-catalysis effect.

title_en: Preparation method and application of core-shell Ni-HITP@PDA film based on three-dimensional conductive network
abstract_en: A preparation method and application of a core-shell Ni-HITP@PDA film based on a three-dimensional conductive network belong to the technical field of conductive MOF composite film preparation. The invention aims to solve the problems of poor water phase stability and easy blockage of pore channels of the traditional Ni-HITP material. The method comprises the steps of firstly preparing an SP-PDA@PVDF activated film, secondly preparing a PANI@PVDF conductive substrate, thirdly preparing a PPy/PANI@PVDF conductive film, fourthly preparing Ni-HITP@PDA core-shell particles, and fifthly assembling the Ni-HITP@PDA film. The core-shell Ni-HITP@PDA membrane based on the three-dimensional conductive network is used for selectively extracting lithium in salt lake brine with high magnesium-lithium ratio. The stable core-shell structure of the invention ensures the structural integrity of crystals and pore channels in the cyclic process, maintains the exposure of high-selectivity recognition sites, and realizes high adsorption capacity and cyclic stability under high magnesium-lithium ratio.

title_en: Anaerobic pyrolysis furnace for recycling waste batteries
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anaerobic pyrolysis furnace for recycling and processing waste batteries, which relates to the technical field of waste battery pyrolysis and comprises a pyrolysis furnace body, wherein a sealing conveying module is arranged at the outer side of the pyrolysis furnace body, the top of pyrolysis furnace body is provided with exhaust pipe, and one side that sealed transport module was kept away from to the pyrolysis furnace body is provided with the drive module, fixedly connected with drive shaft on the output shaft of drive module. Through the rotatable baffle, can isolate the dead space when little batch waste battery pyrolysis, the stove internal volume that needs the heating is littleer, the intensification is faster, heat preservation power is lower, when filling nitrogen gas, the gaseous volume that needs to replace reduces, replacement time and gas consumption all decline to some extent, can form different effective cavity length in the pyrolysis furnace body after the rotatable baffle upset, make the pyrolysis chamber become by single fixed furnace and have a plurality of furnace, thereby same one pyrolysis furnace can the different loading space forms of fast switch over, the different batch danger waste battery of adaptation burns pyrolysis pretreatment conditions.

abstract_en: The utility model provides a medical medicine cabinet, which comprises a cabinet body, wherein the cabinet body comprises a major arc plate, a cabinet body bottom plate and a cabinet body top cover; the interior of the cabinet body is divided into an upper cavity and a lower cavity by a partition plate, and a rotary medicine rack assembly is arranged in the upper cavity; an ultraviolet irradiation sterilization lamp tube is arranged on the inner side wall of the optimized arc plate; a controller and a deodorizing device are arranged in the lower cavity; the left side of the lower cavity is connected with a lower cabinet door through a hinge. title_en: Novel forest fire prevention water supply vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel forest fire prevention water supply vehicle, which is applied to the field of fire fighting and comprises a chassis, a tank body positioned on the chassis and a fire pump positioned in a storage chamber at the rear part of the tank body, the fire pump is powered by a sandwich power takeoff arranged between an engine and a gearbox, the top of the tank body is provided with a water injection port and a water cannon pump with a shooting range of more than 60 meters, the water cannon pump is connected with the high-pressure water outlet of the fire pump through a high-pressure pipe, and the water inlet of the fire pump is connected with the tank body through a low-pressure pipe, the utility model has the characteristics of compact structure, complete function, excellent cross-country performance, strong trafficability, large power, strong power, large water supply and simple and convenient operation, under an extremely harsh working condition, the fire extinguishing emergency system can smoothly reach an operation area and carry out emergency work, and the capacity of emergency fire extinguishing and dangerous case handling is fully guaranteed when dangerous cases occur.

title_en: Marine polysaccharide waste lye processing apparatus
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of sewage treatment and utilization, in particular to a marine polysaccharide waste lye treatment device, which comprises a rotational flow section, a conical section, a collection section and a clear liquid outlet pipe; the device comprises a cyclone section, a cone section, a collection section, a clear liquid outlet pipe and a clear liquid outlet pipe, wherein the cone section is arranged below the cyclone section and communicated with the cyclone section, the collection section is arranged below the cone section and communicated with the cone section, one end of the clear liquid outlet pipe is arranged inside the cone section, and the other end of the clear liquid outlet pipe penetrates through the top of the cyclone section and is communicated with the outside. The utility model also discloses a water tank and water purification unit.

abstract_en: The utility model provides a sewage treatment system, including coagulating sedimentation tank one, equalizing basin, coagulating sedimentation tank two, hydrolysis-acidification pool, MBR pond, clean water basin, sludge thickening tank, high concentration waste water passes through the sewer pipe and inputs in the coagulating sedimentation tank, coagulating sedimentation tank one with the equalizing basin intercommunication, the equalizing basin with coagulating sedimentation tank two intercommunication, coagulating sedimentation tank two with hydrolysis-acidification pool intercommunication, hydrolysis-acidification pool with MBR pond intercommunication, the MBR pond with clean water basin intercommunication, the external discharge tube in clean water basin, coagulating sedimentation tank one, coagulating sedimentation tank two, hydrolysis-acidification pool all through the mud pipe with sludge thickening tank intercommunication, MBR bottom of the pool portion with hydrolysis-acidification bottom of the pool portion is connected through the sludge return pipe. The utility model relates to a sewage treatment system is applicable to the waste water of various concentrations, the cost is reduced, and waste water treatment is efficient.

abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of fire-fighting equipment. The application range of the integrated proportional mixer is wide, and the flow regulation range is large.

abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of fire-fighting extinguishing device, and discloses a fire-fighting extinguishing device for a worker dormitory, which comprises a bottom plate and a clapboard, wherein a fire-fighting box is fixed on the upper wall of the bottom plate, the interior of the fire-fighting box is separated into a first storage chamber and a second storage chamber through the clapboard, a fire extinguisher is placed in the first storage chamber, a limiting plate is fixed on the bottom of the interior of the second storage chamber, limiting grooves are equidistantly formed on the upper surface wall of the limiting plate, an L-shaped hanging plate is fixed on the upper end of the inner wall of the second storage chamber, a spade is hung on the L-shaped hanging plate, the utility model can effectively avoid the inclined spade from slipping through the matching of the L-shaped hanging plate, the limiting plate and the limiting grooves when the spade is placed, the handle end of the spade is hung on the L-shaped hanging plate, meanwhile, the bottom end of the spade is clamped in the limiting groove, and the inclined spade is fixed and limited up and down simultaneously, thereby improving the placing stability and the aesthetic property of the spade, meanwhile, the defect that the spade slips and damages workers is overcome.

title_en: Printing and dyeing wastewater treatment system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a printing and dyeing wastewater treatment system, include: the device comprises a biological aerated filter, a coagulation reaction tank, a filter tank, an intermediate water tank, a medium filter group, a bag filter group, a precision filter group, a reverse osmosis group, a cleaning water tank, a water production tank, a concentrated water tank, a water collecting tank, a blower, a coagulant dosing tank, a disinfectant dosing tank, a reducing agent dosing tank, a scale inhibitor dosing tank and a pipeline mixer, which are sequentially connected. title_en: Electrical control device of centrifugal motor

title_en: Green's garbage bin
abstract_en: The utility model provides a green environment-friendly garbage can, which belongs to the technical field of garbage cans and comprises a chassis, a can body, a can cover, a water hole, a telescopic column, a fixed plate, a pressing plate, a fixed plate II and a telescopic rod, wherein the top surface of the chassis is fixedly connected with the can body, one side of the bottom end of the chassis is fixedly connected with the fixed plate II, the upper surface of the can body is movably connected with the can cover, one end of the fixed plate II is fixedly connected with the telescopic rod, the top end of the telescopic rod is fixedly connected with the fixed plate, one end of the fixed plate is fixedly connected with the can cover, the telescopic column is embedded and connected on the can cover, one side of the upper surface of the telescopic column is provided with the water hole, the bottom surface of the telescopic column is fixedly connected with the pressing plate, the water hole and the brush are arranged on the pressing plate, so that the garbage can is conveniently inserted on, meanwhile, the waste of the garbage bag is reduced, and the garbage bag is environment-friendly and sanitary.

title_en: Device for treating garbage in ecological mode in urban and rural planning
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device for refuse disposal with ecological mode in urban and rural planning, the power distribution box comprises a box body, be equipped with feed space one and feed space two in the box, fixed mounting has put in seat and plastic bag and puts in the seat on the box, and puts in seat, plastic bag and put in the seat respectively with feed space one, two intercommunications of feed space, the box lower extreme is equipped with the mixing tank, and mixing tank and feed space one and two equal intercommunications of feed space, hinge connection has the sealing door on the lateral wall of mixing tank, install pressure sensor on the diapire of mixing tank, install the compaction structure on the box, fixed mounting has servo motor on the lateral wall of box. title_en: High-salinity wastewater treatment device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a technical field that the waste heat of mill was recycled especially relates to a high salt effluent treatment plant, including high salt water pond and the high salt effluent treatment body of setting in high salt water pond top, high salt effluent treatment body including set up at the tower body of tower body top, set gradually heat transfer core, defroster and the fan in the tower body from the right side to a left side in proper order. abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent circulated air utilization system of low energy consumption, concretely relates to circulated air utilization technology field, including a plurality of tuber pipe festival, tuber pipe festival one end is provided with the fan, fan one side is provided with the filtration bellows, filtration bellows and tuber pipe festival intercommunication, filtration bellows one side is provided with the air inlet, and every two are adjacent all be provided with the link between the tuber pipe festival, link bottom fixed mounting has the connecting air pipe, be provided with coupling mechanism between connecting air pipe and the tuber pipe festival; the connection mechanism includes a connection ring. abstract_en: The utility model discloses a spraying device with a waste gas treatment function for processing a steel member, which comprises a flat plate, a cover plate and a fixed block, wherein a purifying box is arranged on one side of the upper surface of the flat plate, a retainer is arranged at the bottom of the cover plate, a filter element is arranged in the retainer, the retainer is inserted into the purifying box, a waste gas pipe is embedded and arranged on one side of the purifying box, a second fan is embedded and arranged on the waste gas pipe, a combustion tower is arranged at an air outlet of the waste gas pipe, a spraying box is arranged on the other side of the upper surface of the flat plate, a first motor is arranged on one side of the top of the spraying box, a lead screw is rotatably arranged on the first motor and extends into the spraying box, a round hole is formed in a penetrating way in the fixed block, threads are embedded in the round hole, the lead screw is in threaded connection with the fixed block through the threads, and a spraying head is welded on one side of the fixed block, the spraying device has a simple structure, can purify harmful gas generated by spraying and protect the health of workers.

title_en: Free radical active oxygen virus killing air conditioner filter element
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a free radical active oxygen virucidal air conditioner filter element, which comprises an N95 filter layer and a free radical active oxygen material layer which are sequentially arranged; the N95 filter layer is polypropylene PP melt-blown non-woven fabric filter cotton or melt-blown glass fiber; the free radical type active oxygen material layer is formed by grafting a high-molecular free radical type bactericidal active functional group on a melt-blown material; the N95 filtering layer and the free radical type active oxygen material layer are arranged in a sticking mode through adhesive. The filter element of the utility model achieves the filtering effect of N95 mask level, effectively inhibits and kills viruses, such as avian influenza, influenza A and B, SARS, novel coronavirus and other viruses, and can effectively isolate and protect; the virus adsorption effect under the form of spray and aerosol is good; the free radical type active oxygen material layer is added, so that the sterilization and virus killing function is strong, and the health of a human body is effectively protected.

title_en: Activated carbon filter
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of filters, and relates to an activated carbon filter, which comprises a cylinder body, wherein the top of the cylinder body is fixedly connected with a top plate through a mounting bolt, a cavity is formed in the top plate, a bearing is fixedly connected in the cavity, a first rotating shaft penetrates through the bearing, and the top end of the first rotating shaft penetrates through the bearing and is fixedly connected with a driving assembly. Its beneficial effect is, this activated carbon filter, through driving motor work, can drive the driving gear and rotate, rotate with the help of driving gear and driven gear's meshing, can drive lead screw and second pivot pivoted purpose through first pivot, rotate through first pivot, can drive the activated carbon filter section of thick bamboo through the backup pad and rotate the filtration, improve material distribution homogeneity and filtration efficiency, rotate through the lead screw, with the help of the cooperation of slide bar, can drive the activated carbon filter and reciprocate, and then realize that different height carries out filterable purpose, avoid blockking up simultaneously, guarantee filter effect.

title_en: Cracking furnace is used in production of environment-friendly ya keli board convenient to smoke abatement
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an environment-friendly cracking furnace convenient for smoke removal for acrylic plate production, which comprises a support frame and a one-way valve, wherein a bearing is arranged inside the support frame, a cracking furnace body is connected inside the bearing, a motor is arranged above the support frame, the output end of the motor is connected with a transmission shaft, a first chain wheel is fixed on the left side of the transmission shaft, a chain is connected outside the first chain wheel, the other end of the chain is connected with a second chain wheel, a feeding opening is connected above the cracking furnace body, a convex block is fixed outside the feeding opening, the other end of the convex block is connected with a groove, and a cover body is arranged outside the groove. This pyrolysis furnace is used in production of environment-friendly ya keli board convenient to smoke abatement can be with the produced gaseous emission of pyrolysis furnace body internal production through the check valve after setting up, and the filter can carry out the smoke abatement with gas simultaneously and purify, avoids directly discharging into the atmosphere and causes the pollution to the air.

title_en: Foldable temporary fire-fighting water tank
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a foldable temporary fire-fighting water tank, which comprises a fire-fighting water tank main body, wherein the fire-fighting water tank main body comprises a horizontally arranged bottom plate and a fixed frame positioned above the bottom plate, and waterproof cloth is hermetically and circularly connected between the fixed frame and the side of the bottom plate; the two opposite sides of the bottom plate and the fixed frame are connected through a support piece, the support piece comprises a pair of symmetrical connecting plates, the pair of connecting plates are respectively and rotatably connected with the sides of the bottom plate and the fixed frame, and a clamping mechanism capable of vertically fixing the pair of connecting plates is rotatably connected between the pair of connecting plates; the clamping mechanism comprises an installation shell and a clamping ring which are respectively fixed at one end of a pair of connecting plates, the end of the connecting plate is close to one end of the clamping ring, a limiting insertion plate penetrates through the installation shell, and the limiting insertion plate penetrates through the bottom wall of the installation shell and is connected with the clamping ring in an inserting mode. This interim fire water tank of folded cascade, it is rational in infrastructure, be convenient for fold and support fixedly, the practicality is strong, easily promotes.

title_en: Blanking device for rectangular tube defective product processor
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a rectangular pipe is unloader for substandard product processor, relate to the tubular product substandard product processing technology field, it includes the frame and rotates two squeeze rolls that set up in the frame, the actuating mechanism has been set up in the frame simultaneously, be used for driving two squeeze roll antiport, the fixed support frame that is provided with in frame one side, be provided with on the support frame and be used for carrying the steel sheet to the conveying subassembly in the collecting box, one side that the frame was kept away from to the support frame is provided with the base, be provided with the collecting box on the base, be provided with the elastic component between base and the collecting box, this application has the automatic collection steel sheet, the effect of using manpower sparingly and time.

title_en: Pressure type air-float separating device for purifying treatment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a pressure type air-flotation separation device for purification treatment, and relates to the technical field of air-flotation separation devices. This pressure type air supporting separator for purification treatment includes pond and aeration pipe, inside reciprocal lead screw, locating rack, one-way bearing and the filter screen of being provided with of pond, one-way bearing sets firmly inside with the locating rack, the locating rack run through one-way bearing and with one-way bearing fixed connection, filter screen one side fixedly connected with dead lever, dead lever one end fixedly connected with pivot, the pivot runs through the locating rack lateral wall and rotates with the locating rack to be connected, the pond top is provided with drive assembly. This pressure type air supporting separator for purification treatment is favorable to fishing out the inside suspended solid in pond, improves the clearance effect, will be heavier, great suspended solid is discharged, drives the filter screen and carries out the rotation to the angle of adjustment filter screen, the suspended solid that conveniently will drag for is poured, makes the suspended solid flow to guide plate top, thereby discharges.

title_en: Block terminal with fire-retardant function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a distribution box with a flame retardant function, and relates to the technical field of distribution boxes. The fire extinguishing spraying tank comprises a tank body, wherein rail grooves are formed in the tank body, a plurality of fixed cross rods are arranged between the two rail grooves, fixed seats are arranged on the fixed cross rods and are in sliding fit with the fixed cross rods, wiring grooves and wire fixing holes are formed in the fixed seats, a fire extinguishing spraying tank is arranged on a tank door, a solenoid valve is arranged on the fire extinguishing spraying tank, and a temperature detector is connected with the solenoid valve. According to the utility model, the plurality of fixed cross rods are arranged between the two track grooves, so that the number of the cross rods can be increased conveniently according to the number of lines, and the lines can be arranged in order; through the sliding fit between the fixed seat and the fixed cross rod, the fixed plates can be conveniently increased and decreased according to the number of lines, the distance between the lines can be flexibly adjusted, and a fire disaster caused by winding and heating of the lines is avoided; still through set up the spraying can of putting out a fire on the chamber door, when being convenient for take place the conflagration, the block terminal can put out a fire by oneself and avoid a large amount of economic losses.

title_en: Fire extinguishing system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire extinguishing system, and relates to the field of automobile equipment. The fire extinguisher tank is arranged on the vehicle body and is communicated with the injection device, and the injection device is provided with the valve device.

title_en: A sewage treatment system for loading in mixture emulsion explosive production link
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sewage treatment system for a mixed emulsion explosive production link, which comprises a liquid collecting tank, a submerged pump and an oil separating sedimentation tank unit, wherein the oil separating sedimentation tank unit at least comprises a primary oil separating sedimentation tank and a final oil separating sedimentation tank; the filter is connected to an outlet pipeline of the submerged pump, a three-way ball valve is arranged between the filter and the submerged pump, the three-way ball valve is connected with a return pipeline, an outlet of the return pipeline is located at a tank port of the primary oil separation sedimentation tank, and the three-way ball valve is selectively communicated with two ports connected with the filter and the return pipeline respectively. The treatment system has the advantages that after the auxiliary water in the production link of the mixed emulsion explosive is treated by the treatment system, the requirement of cyclic utilization can be met, so that the hidden danger of environmental pollution caused by direct discharge of sewage is eliminated, the treatment link is simple, and the treatment cost is low.

title_en: Sewage treatment plant tail water degree of depth nitrogen and phosphorus removal coupling disinfection system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a deep nitrogen and phosphorus removal coupling disinfection system for tail water of a sewage treatment plant, and belongs to the technical field of environmental engineering. The utility model comprises a sulfur-iron autotrophic denitrification filter tank and ultraviolet-TiO 2 2 functional units in the disinfection tank, tail water of a sewage treatment plant firstly enters the sulfur-iron autotrophic denitrification filter tank, and synchronous and deep nitrogen and phosphorus removal of the tail water is realized through a supporting layer and a filter material layer of the filter tank. Then the outlet water of the filter enters ultraviolet-TiO 2 A disinfection tank passing TiO 2 The ultraviolet light catalysis realizes the effective disinfection of tail water, and simultaneously further removes pollutants difficult to degrade. The system has good effects of denitrification, dephosphorization and disinfection, stable effluent reaching the standard, short reaction time, small occupied area and no need of external additionThe carbon source and the phosphorus removal agent have the advantages of small sludge yield and low operation cost, can meet the development requirements of the sewage treatment industry in China, realizes the purposes of energy conservation and emission reduction of tail water treatment, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Ultrasonic wave sewage treatment retrieval and utilization integrated device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of sewage treatment equipment, in particular to an ultrasonic sewage treatment and recycling integrated device which comprises a grid basket, an oil removal tank, an anaerobic tank, an aerobic tank, an MBR (membrane bioreactor) membrane tank, a clear water disinfection tank and a water storage tank, wherein the outlet of the grid basket is connected with the oil removal tank, the oil removal tank is connected with the anaerobic tank, the anaerobic tank is communicated with the aerobic tank and is arranged side by side with the aerobic tank, the aerobic tank is communicated with the MBR membrane tank, the outlet of the MBR membrane tank is connected with the clear water disinfection tank, the clear water disinfection tank and the MBR membrane tank are arranged on one side of the anaerobic tank and one side of the aerobic tank, and the water storage tank is connected with the clear water disinfection tank.

title_en: Adopt whole denitration system of boiler of SCR denitration
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a boiler whole-course denitration system adopting SCR denitration, which comprises a high-temperature side boiler, a low-temperature side boiler and an air inlet pipe flow adjusting device, wherein the high-temperature side boiler is connected with the high-temperature side denitration device through a high-temperature side denitration front pipe, the high-temperature side denitration device is communicated with the atmosphere through a high-temperature side denitration rear pipe, the low-temperature side boiler is connected with the low-temperature side denitration device through a low-temperature side denitration front pipe, the low-temperature side denitration device is communicated with the atmosphere through a low-temperature side denitration rear pipe, an air inlet pipe is connected between the high-temperature side denitration front pipe and the low-temperature side denitration front pipe, an air return pipe is connected between the low-temperature side denitration rear pipe and the high-temperature side denitration front pipe, an air inlet pipe stop valve is arranged on the air inlet pipe, and an air return pipe stop valve is arranged on the air return pipe, and a rear stop valve is arranged on the low-temperature side denitration rear pipe between the return air pipe and the atmosphere, and the air inlet pipe flow regulating device controls the flow of flue gas in the air inlet pipe. The method can effectively denitrate the boiler flue gas in an ignition stage, a low-load stage and a high-load stage.

title_en: Composite micro-aeration oxygenation water quality improvement ecological treatment system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of ecological treatment for improving water quality of riverways and lakes, in particular to a composite micro-aeration water quality improvement ecological treatment system. The method comprises the following steps of (1) arranging in a water body along the water facing direction: the anaerobic treatment device comprises a grid intercepting area, a micro-nano aeration oxygen-enriched area and a bionic filler area, wherein the micro-nano aeration oxygen-enriched area and the bionic filler area are alternately arranged and mutually spaced, the micro-nano aeration oxygen-enriched area is an aerobic area, each bionic filler area is divided into a front section and a rear section, the front section is a facultative area, and the rear section is an anaerobic area. The utility model aims at restoring the polluted water quality of the river channel and the lake to improve the water quality of the water, in particular to the condition that the river channel, the river bed and the lake bank are over-hardened so that the river channel and the lake lose the self water ecological purification function. The utility model does not need to add any chemical product medicament, has simple operation and maintenance and can effectively improve the water pollution.

title_en: Environment-friendly plastic injection molding machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an environment-friendly plastic injection molding machine, which comprises an injection molding machine body, wherein a transparent cover is hinged at the top end of the back surface of the injection molding machine body, a fixed frame is arranged at the bottom end of the front surface of the transparent cover, a screw rod is rotatably connected at the position of the front surface of the injection molding machine body corresponding to the fixed frame, a nut barrel is sleeved at the outer side of the screw rod through threads, a fan is arranged at one side of the transparent cover, a filter cartridge is arranged at one side of the top surface of the transparent cover far away from the fan, a filter screen cage is arranged in the filter cartridge, through holes are respectively arranged at the positions of the outer side of the transparent cover corresponding to a feed port and a discharge port of the injection molding machine body, a carriage is arranged at the position of the outer side of the transparent cover corresponding to the through holes, the injection molding machine body is separated from the external environment through the transparent cover, and then the fan and the filter screen cage are matched for ventilation and filtration, so that waste gas generated by the injection molding machine body can be cleaned, the pollution of the environment and the harm to the health of workers are reduced, and pull open the apron and can make the injection molding machine body carry out business turn over material, avoid influencing production.

title_en: Safety barrier is used in civil engineering construction
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a safety guardrail for civil engineering construction, relates to the technical field of construction guardrails, and solves the problems that the existing guardrail is simple in structure, and illumination blind areas exist due to the distance problem of street lamps at night, so that the safety guardrail is inconvenient for the passage of construction sections; lack interconnect between the guardrail, the fixed scheduling problem that loses efficacy and lead to of single guardrail appears easily under the bad weather. The lamp post comprises a plurality of guardrail units which are sequentially arranged, connecting pieces are arranged between the adjacent guardrail units, the inner sides of part or all of the connecting pieces are also connected with a fixed seat, a lamp post is fixed in the fixed seat, an illuminating lamp is arranged at the top of the lamp post, and a lamp holder is arranged at the bottom of the lamp post; the top of the guardrail unit is also provided with a plurality of spray heads. The problem of the illumination blind area that construction guardrail leads to is solved, the lodging that appears when having reached the fixed inefficacy of reduction single guardrail injures people even problem.

title_en: High-efficient dust collector is used to coal dust
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an efficient dust removal device for coal dust, which comprises an installation box, a mesh belt assembly line body and a processing equipment body, wherein a feed inlet and a discharge outlet are respectively formed in the left side surface and the right side surface of the installation box, a rectangular air pipe and a rectangular dust collection pipe are respectively embedded in the inner bottom wall and the inner top wall of the installation box, an air outlet nozzle is arranged on the upper surface of the rectangular air pipe, a dust collection opening is formed in the lower surface of the rectangular dust collection pipe, a dust collection box is fixedly installed on the upper surface of the installation box, and the upper surface of the rectangular dust collection pipe is communicated with the interior of the dust collection box through a pipeline. This high-efficient dust collector is used to coal dust, through setting up air pump and rectangle dust absorption pipe, the air current that the air outlet nozzle blew out bloies the surperficial coal of guipure assembly line body, makes the dust on coal surface blow to the position of rectangle dust absorption pipe, inhales the dust of install bin inside through rectangle dust absorption pipe in the dust collecting box under the effect of air pump bleed end to make the device can reach the purpose of removing dust to the coal dust.

title_en: Novel sharp weapon collector
abstract_en: The utility model provides a novel sharp tool collector which comprises a box body and a box cover, wherein the box cover comprises a fixed cover, a sliding cover, a first blade, a second blade and a box sleeve assembly, a throwing opening is formed in the middle of the fixed cover, a first blade fixing part is arranged on the fixed cover on one side of the throwing opening, the first blade is connected to the bottom of the first blade fixing part, a covering part is arranged on one side, opposite to the first blade fixing part, of the fixed cover, the sliding cover is connected above the fixed cover in a sliding mode, the second blade is fixed below the sliding cover, the sliding direction of the sliding cover is perpendicular to the direction of cutting edges of the first blade and the second blade, one end of the box sleeve assembly is connected to the covering part, the other end of the box sleeve assembly is connected to the sliding cover, and the box sleeve assembly can generate elastic force enabling the sliding cover to open the throwing opening. This edge tool box can show and reduce clinical care operating personnel and prick the incidence of hindering, has better simple operation nature and security, improves the operation and experiences, and is economical and practical, avoids the consumption of scissors.

title_en: Thin tube aeration disc
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a thin tube aeration disc, which comprises a tube body and a tube body connecting piece. The pipe body has a plurality of, can adjust the quantity of pipe body according to actual demand, is equipped with the micropore of giving vent to anger of even densely covered on the pipe body, and the bubble that this kind of micropore produced is less, has increased the dissolved oxygen rate in the pond, has avoided the bubble too big and need let in the condition that a large amount of gas increased the dissolved oxygen rate, has reduced the energy consumption of supplying with the oxygen rate in improving the pond. The gas outlet micropores on the tube body are uniformly distributed, the aeration effect is more uniform and sufficient, partial areas do not have oxygen supply, and the phenomenon that partial areas have excessive oxygen supply is avoided, so that the oxygen supply efficiency is greatly improved. The both ends mouth of pipe of each body all communicates air feeder through the body connecting piece, and the both ends mouth of pipe of body is the air inlet, has improved gaseous utilization ratio, has also avoided simultaneously leading to during water gets into the body because of the negative pressure that the gas flow brought.

title_en: Wastewater-free low-pressure reverse osmosis water purifier
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of reverse osmosis water purifiers, and relates to a wastewater-free low-pressure reverse osmosis water purifier which comprises a base, a supporting table and a groove, wherein the supporting table is fixedly connected to the surface of the base, the surface of the supporting table is provided with the groove, the inner wall of the groove is fixedly connected with a first telescopic rod, the surface of the first telescopic rod is sleeved with a damping spring, the right end of the first telescopic rod is fixedly connected with a buffer block, the lower surface of the buffer block is fixedly connected with a first sliding block, and the surface of the base is provided with a first sliding chute. Its beneficial effect is, this no waste water low pressure reverse osmosis water purifier, through the cooperation of buffer block, first telescopic link, damping spring and second slider, when equipment produced vibrations at the function in-process, the box drove the cushion table and moves downwards to drive the buffer block and remove, under the cooperation of first telescopic link, damping spring and second slider, can carry out the shock attenuation to the box, the buffer block can support the box simultaneously, has improved the practicality of device.

title_en: Novel spray tower
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of spray towers, and discloses a novel spray tower which comprises a tower body, wherein a water tank is arranged at the bottom of the tower body, an air inlet is arranged at the bottom of the tower body, an air outlet is arranged at the top of the tower body, a uniform distribution plate is obliquely arranged in the water tank, a scraping column is connected to the uniform distribution plate, a scraping plate is connected to the scraping plate, and a guide sliding chute is arranged on the side wall of the water tank. The utility model has the following advantages and effects: the end part of the uniform distribution plate is connected in the water tank in a sliding manner by the uniform distribution plate which is obliquely arranged in the water tank, and the bottom of the box body is cleaned by the slag scraping plate by driving the uniform distribution plate to slide in the water tank while the gas entering the tower body is uniformly distributed by the uniform distribution plate; the hooks are arranged at the lifting plate openings to position the uniform distribution plates, so that the stability of the arrangement of the uniform distribution plates is improved; threaded connection adjusting nut on the bracing piece of couple has realized the regulation to the equipartition board equipartition effect through rotating the regulation at the angle of inclination of adjusting nut to the equipartition board.

title_en: Integrated domestic sewage treatment device for enhancing denitrification
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an integrated domestic sewage treatment device for enhanced nitrogen removal, and relates to the technical field of sewage treatment. The device can further get rid of total nitrogen when the temperature is lower, guarantees the discharge to reach standard of the play water quality of water when the temperature is lower.

title_en: Novel sewage treatment system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel sewage treatment system which comprises a bottom frame, wherein a treatment box is fixed on one side of the top end of the bottom frame, and an annular aeration pipe is fixed at the bottom end inside the treatment box. This novel sewage treatment system is through after sewage treatment system handles sewage purification emission, can be through inserting outside water pipe with the top of raceway after, and start the switch of second water pump, the second water pump starts to take out the back from the inside of raceway with wasing water, leading-in to the inside of first annular water catch bowl, and after carrying out the intercommunication between with first annular water catch bowl and the second annular water catch bowl by the connecting pipe, wash water will be simultaneously from the multiunit shower nozzle of equidistant setting in first annular water catch bowl and second annular water catch bowl bottom spout and wash the washing in the inside of handling case and settling tank, carry out the automatically cleaning to sewage treatment system inside, the problem of being not convenient for wash the automatically cleaning to sewage treatment system inside has been solved.

title_en: Sludge incineration anti-blocking coal feeding device
abstract_en: Sludge incineration anti-blocking coal feeding device. The belt and the raw coal of the coal yard are mixed according to a certain proportion and then are conveyed to a raw coal bunker, and then are conveyed to a hearth for combustion through a coal pulverizing system. Because the moisture content of the sludge is high, the conditions of coal breakage and the like of a coal feeder are easy to occur in the operation process, and the combustion fluctuation of the boiler is large. The utility model comprises the following components: the coal feeder comprises a raw coal bin (1) and a coal feeder (4), wherein the bottom of the raw coal bin is connected with the coal feeder through a material guiding pipe (8), a belt conveying device (3) is fixed in the coal feeder, one end of the bottom of the coal feeder, which is used for discharging, is provided with a coal dropping hole (5), one end of a feeding material is provided with a cold air pipe (7), and the cold air pipe is provided with a cold air door (6). The utility model is used for sludge incineration anti-blocking coal feeding.

title_en: Dust fall watering device is used in highway construction
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dust-settling watering device for highway construction, which relates to the technical field of dust-settling watering devices and comprises the following components: the water pipe type shower nozzle comprises a main body, wherein the main body comprises a cover plate, the top end of the cover plate is connected with a rotating base, the top end of the rotating base is connected with a water pipe, and one end of the water pipe is provided with a shower nozzle; the fixing mechanism comprises a rotating groove positioned at the top end of the cover plate. According to the utility model, the fixing mechanism is arranged, when the rotating base rotates, the handle is pushed downwards, the handle displacement drives the fixing block to displace out of the fixing groove, the fixing of the rotating base is cancelled, the rotating base is rotated, the handle is loosened after the rotating base is completed, the movable plate is reset under the elastic action of the reset spring, the movable plate is reset to drive the fixing block to displace into the fixing groove, so that the rotating base is fixed, the rotating base is convenient to fix after rotating, and the omnibearing watering and dust-settling operation can be realized through the matching of the parts.

title_en: Protective net for constructional engineering
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a protective net for constructional engineering, which comprises a base, fixing rods, rod inner cavities and a protective net frame, wherein the fixing rods are arranged at the upper part of the base, the rod inner cavities are arranged at the centers of the inner walls of the fixing rods, the protective net frame is arranged between the fixing rods, a water inlet pipe and a water pump are arranged inside the base, a water delivery pipe is arranged at the upper part of the water pump, the water delivery pipe is arranged inside the rod inner cavities of the fixing rods, the top end of the water delivery pipe is connected with a sprinkler pipe, and the sprinkler pipe and a collecting box are arranged between the fixing rods. The working efficiency of the utility model is improved.

title_en: Intelligent protection shell for indoor fire sprinkler of office area
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of fire sprinkler heads, in particular to an intelligent protective shell for an indoor fire sprinkler head in an office area. An intelligent protective shell of a fire-fighting spray header in an office area comprises a mounting disc and a protective cover spliced by blades, wherein the mounting disc is mounted on the fire-fighting spray header; then a winding roller is arranged on the mounting disc, a pulling rope is connected to the winding roller, and the other end of the pulling rope is arranged on the protective cover; and a smoke sensor and a travel switch are arranged on the mounting table. This application can protect the fire sprinkler head through the safety cover, and smoke transducer detects the smog concentration value in the surrounding environment and exceeds the setting value, and the rolling cylinder rotates and withdraws the safety cover is folding, and the fire sprinkler head exposes the watering and puts out a fire.

title_en: Membrane filtering device for placing water outlet weir crest of high-efficiency sedimentation tank
abstract_en: The utility model provides a membrane filtering device for putting a water outlet weir crest of a high-efficiency sedimentation tank into a membrane, which comprises a sedimentation tank and an overflow tank positioned at the output end of the sedimentation tank, wherein a liftable filtering membrane mechanism is arranged between the output end of the sedimentation tank and the input end of the overflow tank and is used for filtering impurities in water in the sedimentation tank. The utility model has simple structure, reasonable design and convenient use, is beneficial to preventing turbid water quality from overflowing when the sedimentation tank is washed, simultaneously, the sedimentation tank does not need to stop water inlet, reduces the water inlet pressure of other sedimentation tanks, and has practicability.

title_en: Filter device with self-cleaning function
abstract_en: A filter device with a self-cleaning function comprises at least two wave-shaped filter screen plates, wherein the two filter screen plates are arranged at intervals from top to bottom, vibration strips are arranged in the intervals at two sides of each wave, and a traction rope transversely penetrates through each wave of the filter screen plates and is fixed with each vibration strip; a motor is arranged on the outer side of the filter screen plate, and a rotating shaft is arranged at the output end of the motor and deviates from the rotating center of the motor; one end of the traction rope is arranged on the rotating shaft, and when the rotating shaft rotates eccentrically, the traction rope can intermittently exert a pulling force to drive the vibration strip to collide with the filter screen plate to generate high-frequency vibration. After the filtering device is used, the self-cleaning function is started, the filtering screen plate is automatically cleaned, the vibration strip is impacted with the filtering screen plate to generate high-frequency vibration, and adsorbed dust or impurities on the filtering screen plate are shaken off, so that the filtering screen plate can be used again, the complex disassembling and washing operation of the filtering screen plate is avoided, and the filtering device can be widely applied to various intelligent air filtering or water filtering equipment.

title_en: Internal grinding machine convenient to clearance abrasive dust
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of internal grinding machines, in particular to an internal grinding machine convenient for cleaning abrasive dust, which comprises a base, wherein a collecting box is fixedly arranged on one side surface of the base, the bottom of one side surface of the collecting box, which is far away from the base, is provided with an integrally formed discharge outlet, the interior of the collecting box is hollow, the bottom surface of the interior of the collecting box is fixedly provided with an exhaust fan, the discharge outlet is communicated with the exhaust fan, an upper surface air outlet of the exhaust fan is fixedly provided with a first filter screen, a sundry box is arranged above the first filter screen, an inclined box integrally formed with the collecting box is arranged above the sundry box, and the interior of the inclined box is hollow; has the advantages that: the effect through the second filter screen enters into the inside of glove compartment, through the effect of first filter screen afterwards, filters bold debris, prevents to damage the air exhauster, and the piece that the air exhauster will absorb finally discharges through the bin outlet, and the staff of being convenient for collects.

title_en: Portable water purifier
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable water purifier, which comprises a water inlet channel and a water outlet channel, and further comprises a raw water cavity communicated with the water inlet channel and a filter cavity communicated with the water outlet channel, wherein the raw water cavity is communicated with the filter cavity, a filter element assembly is arranged in the filter cavity, a pressurizing assembly is arranged in the raw water cavity, the pressurizing assembly comprises a piston mechanism and a driving mechanism which are connected, the driving mechanism is arranged on the water purifier in a penetrating manner on the water purifier, and the driving mechanism drives the piston mechanism to move in the raw water cavity through rotation so as to change the pressure in the raw water cavity, so that the water inlet channel extracts raw water or the water outlet channel discharges purified water. According to the utility model, water purification is realized through the linkage of the driving mechanism and the rotating mechanism in the machine body, and the piston mechanism can reciprocate in the raw water cavity by rotating the driving mechanism by a user, so that the change of the pressure in the raw water cavity by the piston mechanism is realized, and the labor is saved.

title_en: Pollution control is with high-efficient glass steel integration sewage treatment device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-efficiency glass fiber reinforced plastic integrated sewage treatment device for pollution control, which relates to the technical field of sewage treatment and comprises a treatment box, wherein the upper end of the treatment box is fixedly connected with a water inlet pipe, one side in the treatment box is hinged with a filter screen plate, the side wall of the treatment box at one side of the filter screen plate is provided with a treatment port, the outer side wall of the treatment box at one side of the filter screen plate is fixedly connected with a mounting plate, the bottom of the mounting plate is fixedly connected with a mounting seat, the bottom of the mounting seat is rotatably connected with a driving wheel, the driving wheel is rotatably connected with a first driving rod, the bottom of the first driving rod is hinged with a movable rod, one side of the movable rod penetrates through the side wall of the treatment box, extends into the treatment box and is in sliding connection with the treatment box, the movable rod in the treatment box is fixedly connected with a telescopic spring, the top of the telescopic spring is fixedly connected with the filter screen plate, a rotating rod is arranged in the treatment box below the filter screen plate, the stirring blade is fixedly connected to the rotating rod, the device is reasonable in structural principle design, and high in practicability.

title_en: Hydraulic engineering desilting car with categorised function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hydraulic engineering dredging vehicle with a classification function, relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering equipment, and aims to solve the problem that the existing hydraulic engineering dredging vehicle classifies sludge and sewage to cause high difficulty in cleaning the sludge. The sludge and sewage treatment device is novel in structure, and can classify and treat the sludge and the sewage after the sewage and the sludge are intensively pumped out, so that the collection and subsequent treatment of the sludge and the sewage are avoided, the cleaning difficulty of workers is reduced, the cleaning cost is reduced, and the cleaning efficiency is improved.

title_en: Reburnt magnesia slag cleaning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a reburning magnesia slag cleaning device which comprises a base, wherein the left side of the top of the base is fixedly connected with a stirring box, the top of the stirring box is fixedly provided with a first motor, the output end of the first motor is fixedly connected with a stirring rod, the bottom of the stirring rod penetrates through the surface of an inner cavity of the stirring box and is fixedly connected with a stirring blade, the right side of the top of the base is fixedly connected with a fixed column, and the top of the fixed column is fixedly connected with a slag conveying barrel. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the second motor, the threaded rod, the limiting rod, the connecting rod, the universal wheel and the threaded sleeve, the mobility of the machine is increased, manual carrying is not required when the machine is required to be used, the labor force of workers is greatly saved, the effect of adjusting the height is achieved through the arrangement of the air cylinder, the movable rod, the supporting column and the limiting block, and the phenomenon that the height is not matched and cannot be used due to the fact that the height cannot be adjusted is prevented.

title_en: Vacuum rake dryer with smash and spray
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vacuum rake dryer with crushing and spraying functions, which comprises a machine body fixedly arranged on a supporting seat, wherein a driving cavity is formed in the supporting seat, a supporting shaft is rotatably connected in the driving cavity, the upper end of the supporting shaft penetrates through the driving cavity and is fixedly connected with a processing box, and a filter screen is arranged in the processing box. The utility model relates to the technical field of dryers, wherein acid and alkali waste liquid can be filtered through a filter screen, meanwhile, a treatment box can be driven to rotate under the driving of a driving mechanism, so that the acid and alkali waste liquid discharged into the treatment box can fully react with neutralizing liquid added into the treatment box, the acid and alkali waste liquid can be fully neutralized, the temperature of the treatment box is increased due to heat release of the neutralization reaction, and through an arranged regulating and controlling mechanism, each heat dissipation fan can be regulated and controlled to synchronously rotate so as to cooperate with the rotation of the treatment box, and the heat dissipation of the treatment box is accelerated.

title_en: Water source purifier
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a water source purifier. The water inlet of the water discharge hole of the existing small reservoir is not provided with a water purifying device or only provided with a water purifying device in a single-layer fence shape, the structure is simple, and floaters, stones and the like in the reservoir can flow out of the reservoir along with the opening of the gate valve, and can be clamped in a farmland irrigation pipeline and at the gate valve sometimes. In order to overcome the defects in the prior art, the technical scheme adopted by the patent is that the sedimentation tank is combined with a double-layer mesh type filter layer, the filter layer is arranged in the front (upstream direction) of the water inlet, the water passing section area is far larger than that of a water discharging hole of a reservoir, the filter area is increased, water flow is filtered through a double-layer filter screen, and the water consumption for irrigation is ensured while impurities in water are better filtered. The beneficial effects of this patent are that, reduced the harm that aquatic debris brought gate valve, water gauge facility of low reaches, reduced the silt of debris in the pipeline, played water-saving irrigation's economic benefits.

title_en: Waste collecting and treating device based on construction engineering construction
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of construction of constructional engineering, in particular to a waste collecting and treating device based on construction of constructional engineering, which solves the problems that in the prior art, when the construction waste is treated, the waste is treated through a traditional storage box or a direct vehicle transportation mode, and the traditional mode causes a large amount of waste accumulation, not only increases the occupied area of the waste on a construction site, but also is inconvenient for later transportation work. The utility model provides a garbage collection processing apparatus based on after building engineering construction, includes the underframe, and the inboard fixedly connected with box of underframe, the inboard both sides of box all are equipped with the riser, and inboard one side of underframe is rotated and is connected with two-way screw rod. According to the mode provided by the utility model, the vertical plate and the pressing plate are matched with each other, and the side plate and the movable plate are matched with each other for use, so that the waste can be compressed, the occupied space of the waste is greatly reduced, and the transportation work of the waste at the later stage is facilitated.

title_en: Fire control cabinet convenient to take fire-fighting equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire-fighting cabinet convenient for taking fire-fighting equipment, which comprises a fire-fighting device and a lighting device, wherein the lighting device is arranged above the fire-fighting device, the fire-fighting device comprises universal wheels, a fire-fighting cabinet body, a cabinet door, a water pipe disc, a snap ring, escape hammers, clamps, a placing plate, an emergency medicine box, a fire extinguisher fixing groove, a dry powder fire extinguisher and a heat dissipation net, the cabinet door is arranged in front of the fire-fighting cabinet body, the snap ring is arranged in front of the water pipe disc, the escape hammers are arranged on two sides of the snap ring, the clamps are arranged on the outer side of the escape hammers, the emergency medicine box is arranged above the placing plate, and the heat dissipation net is arranged on one side of the dry powder fire extinguisher. The fire extinguishing device can facilitate the quick taking of fire extinguishing equipment, and is provided with the lighting device to provide an emergency lighting function.

title_en: Take waste heat recovery's dry tail gas processing apparatus
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a dry tail gas treatment device with waste heat recovery, which comprises a shell, wherein a material drying and tail gas treatment mechanism is arranged in the shell, a feeding mechanism comprising a feeding hole is arranged at a feeding position at one end of the shell, and a discharging mechanism comprising a discharging hole is arranged at a discharging position at the other end of the shell; the material drying and tail gas treatment mechanism comprises a conveying mechanism and a plurality of tail gas inlets and exhaust ports which are uniformly distributed on the shell, wherein the tail gas inlets are arranged above the conveying mechanism, and the exhaust ports are arranged below the conveying mechanism; a lifting mechanism and a material distributing screw in the feeding mechanism uniformly distribute the materials on the conveying mechanism; and a discharging screw in the discharging mechanism conveys the dried material to the next processing procedure. Filtering the high-temperature tail gas dried in the previous process by using the material on the mesh belt, filtering and recovering the waste heat energy of the dried tail gas, and controlling the content of the particulate matters in the tail gas to be 200mg/Nm 3 The concentration is reduced to 30mg/Nm 3 The content of the compound is less than the content of the compound; the temperature of the flue gas is reduced to 60 ℃ from 125 ℃, meanwhile, the moisture content of the material is reduced by 10%, and the energy is saved and the consumption is reduced.

title_en: Joint cutter for pavement maintenance convenient to use
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a convenient-to-use joint cutter for pavement maintenance, which comprises a pushing handle, wherein the surface of the pushing handle is fixedly connected with a connecting plate block, the surface of the connecting plate block is fixedly provided with an accelerator cable, one end of the connecting plate block is fixedly connected with a water tank, the surface of the water tank is fixedly provided with a water storage port, the surface of the water tank is fixedly provided with a cutting depth crank, the lower surface of the water tank is fixedly connected with a vehicle-mounted frame, the lower surface of the vehicle-mounted frame is fixedly provided with a traveling wheel, the upper surface of the vehicle-mounted frame is fixedly provided with an engine, the upper surface of the engine is fixedly provided with an oil tank, and one side of the oil tank is fixedly provided with a silencer; the utility model discloses a joint cutter for road surface maintenance convenient to use through the cutting guard shield that sets up, protects the external world when using, prevents to cut the piece fracture when cutting ground and causes the injury to the human body, through the baffle that sets up, can block the dust effectively, avoids the great user of dust to inhale the lung and causes the injury to it.

title_en: Green building safety fire control unit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a green building safety fire fighting device which comprises a mounting plate, wherein an adjusting mechanism is mounted on the mounting plate, a protective cover is mounted on the side surface of the mounting plate, the protective cover is of a U-shaped structure, fixed blocks are fixed on a pair of inner walls of the protective cover, a sliding rod is connected onto the fixed blocks in a sliding mode, a movable plate is mounted at the bottom of the sliding rod, a mounting frame is mounted at the top of the movable plate and fixed with the adjusting mechanism, a movable block is mounted at the top of the side surface of the mounting frame, a rotating shaft is rotatably connected inside the mounting frame, mounting seats are fixedly sleeved at two ends of the top of the rotating shaft, and a box body is fixed at the top of the mounting seats. Compared with the prior art, the fire-fighting equipment is convenient to take and use by adjusting the position of the box body, the flexibility of use is very high, the occupied space is small when the fire-fighting equipment is stored, daily collision is effectively avoided, the use cost is reduced, and the use is very flexible.

title_en: Anhydrous raise dust processing apparatus for building engineering
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a waterless raise dust treatment device for constructional engineering, which comprises a filter box; the upper end of rose box left side inner wall has been seted up and has been rotated the groove, the inside horizontal fixed mounting who rotates the groove has the dead lever, the dead lever runs through the left end of fixed frame and rotates with fixed frame to be connected, the inboard level of fixed frame is provided with the filter screen, the left middle part of rose box is provided with the PLC controller, logical groove has been seted up in the upper end of rose box right side inner wall through, the lower extreme horizontal fixed mounting on rose box right side has the fixed plate. According to the utility model, through the combination of the fixing frame and the filter screen, air dust entering the filter box can be filtered, through the combination of the rotating rod, the rotating groove, the pushing block and the pressure sensor, the use condition of the filter screen can be monitored, and through the combination of the electric telescopic rod, the vibrating motor and the vibrating block, the dust on the filter screen can be automatically cleaned.

title_en: Building environment adjusting device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a building environment adjusting device, which comprises a base, wherein a water tank is welded on one side of the upper end surface of the base, a water pumping mechanism is welded in the water tank, an equipment box is welded on the top end of the water tank, lead screws are welded on two sides of the upper end surface of the equipment box in a rotating manner, limiting plates are welded on the top ends of the two lead screws, screw sleeves are connected on the two lead screws in a threaded manner, spray pipes are welded on the two screw sleeves, spray heads are welded on one sides of the inner walls of the two spray pipes, fans are welded on the inner walls of the spray pipes, water flow is scattered into water mist by the fans in the process that the spray heads eject water out of the spray pipes, a speed reduction motor is started by a PLC controller to drive a driving gear to drive a connecting rod to rotate from a driven gear to drive a first bevel gear to be meshed with a second bevel gear, so that the screw sleeves vertically move on the lead screws to drive the two spray pipes to move up and down, the dust settling effect of the building environment adjusting device is greatly improved.

title_en: Drinking water disinfection filter
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a drinking water disinfection filter, which comprises a filter box body, wherein the top of the filter box body is provided with an adaptive top cover, the upper half part of the inner periphery of the filter box body is provided with a lifting filter plate, the top of the lifting filter plate is in threaded connection with an annular hole filter sleeve, the inner periphery of the lifting filter plate, which is positioned in the hole filter sleeve, is in threaded connection with an annular active carbon filter sleeve, the lower half part of the filter box body is provided with a plurality of ultraviolet disinfection lamps for disinfection, the center of the lifting filter plate is provided with an ultrafiltration screen plate, a height adjusting piece for driving the lifting filter plate to move is arranged below the lifting filter plate, and the top cover is provided with a flow collecting piece for sucking liquid. This drinking water disinfection filter not only can reduce and block up, and it is more convenient to change and clear up.

title_en: Energy-saving lamp convenient to maintain
