abstract_en: The utility model discloses an energy-saving lamp convenient to maintain, which comprises a lamp holder, wherein a bulb is arranged on the lamp holder, a chute is formed in the lamp holder, a handle is slidably connected inside the chute, a connecting rod is fixedly connected to the handle and slidably connected with the lamp holder, a limiting rod is slidably sleeved on the outer side of the connecting rod, a first spring is arranged inside the lamp holder and slidably connected with the lamp holder, a lampshade is fixedly connected to the limiting rod and is in contact with the lamp holder, a plurality of ventilation openings are formed in the lampshade, a groove is formed in the lampshade, and a fixing rod is fixedly connected inside the groove. The lampshade is designed, so that the bulb can be protected, the bulb can be prevented from being damaged by collision, the service life of the bulb is prolonged in a phase-changing manner, and the lampshade is convenient to disassemble, so that the inner bulb can be conveniently overhauled and maintained.

title_en: Warm logical water that admits air drenches purification heat sink
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water spray purification cooling device for heating ventilation inlet air, and relates to the technical field of heating ventilation. The heating ventilation air inlet water spraying purification cooling device comprises a cooling box, a spraying assembly and a filtering assembly, wherein an air inlet pipe is fixedly connected to one side of the cooling box and is communicated with the interior of the cooling box. The utility model discloses can take the water of cooling incasement out and spray the processing, the in-process that sprays contacts with the dust in the air, and bring it into the aquatic, play air-purifying's effect, and play the effect of certain cooling to the air, through adding the flocculating agent to cooling incasement, drive the movable plate and filter gauze longitudinal motion, also play certain mixed action, bring the dust into the aquatic when spraying, combine to adsorb with the flocculating agent and form the sediment, when needing to clear up, make movable plate and filter gauze upward movement, make sediment and separation of water, directly open the apron and clear up impurity, make the hydroenergy of cooling incasement use by repeating cycle.

title_en: Novel voltage-variable lightning arrester cabinet for protecting high-voltage electrical appliance
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of electrical cabinets, in particular to a novel voltage-variable lightning arrester cabinet for protecting high-voltage electrical appliances, and the scheme is provided, wherein the novel voltage-variable lightning arrester cabinet comprises a cabinet body, a cabinet door hinged with the cabinet body, an element and a lightning arrester which are fixed in the cabinet body, a fire insulating plate is fixed in the cabinet body and positioned between the element and the lightning arrester, and fire extinguishing assemblies are arranged at positions of the cabinet door opposite to the element and the lightning arrester; the fire extinguishing assembly comprises a mounting plate fixedly connected with the cabinet door and a gear sleeved on the top of the mounting plate in a rotating mode, a fire extinguisher is installed on the top of the gear through a fixing mechanism, and a starting mechanism used for starting the fire extinguisher is arranged in the cabinet door. The fire extinguishing assembly arranged in the fire extinguishing cabinet enables elements in the cabinet body or the lightning arrester to automatically start the fire extinguisher to extinguish fire, improves the fire extinguishing efficiency, does not need manual fire extinguishing, and improves the safety of the lightning arrester cabinet.

title_en: Chloroethylene tail gas condenser defrosting device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a chloroethylene tail gas condenser defrosting device which comprises a brine storage system, a brine defrosting and conveying system, a brine heating system, a tail gas condensing system and a condensing and exhausting system, wherein the brine storage system is connected with the brine defrosting and conveying system; the brine storage system comprises a brine tank body, and a brine inlet and a brine outlet are formed in the brine tank body; the brine defrosting and conveying system comprises a brine pump and a return pipe, wherein an inlet of the brine pump is connected with a brine outlet of the brine tank body through a pipeline, one end of the return pipe is connected with an outlet of the brine pump, and the other end of the return pipe is connected with the brine tank body; the brine heating system comprises a plate heat exchanger, the plate heat exchanger is provided with a hot water inlet, a hot water outlet, a brine inlet and a brine outlet, and the brine inlet of the plate heat exchanger is connected with the brine pump outlet through a pipeline; a first temperature sensor is arranged on a salt water inlet of the plate heat exchanger, a temperature control regulating valve is arranged on a hot water inlet, the first temperature sensor is electrically connected with the temperature control regulating valve, and the opening and closing degree of the temperature control regulating valve is automatically adjusted.

title_en: High-efficient energy-conserving dust device for civil engineering construction
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an efficient and energy-saving dust settling device for civil engineering construction, which belongs to the technical field of civil engineering and comprises a bottom plate, universal wheels are fixedly connected at four corners of the lower surface of the bottom plate, a push rod is fixedly connected at the right side of the upper surface of the bottom plate, a water tank is arranged at the right side of the upper surface of the bottom plate, a control switch is arranged on the front end surface of the water tank, a first water pump is arranged at the top end of the water tank, a water inlet of the first water pump is communicated with the water tank through a first water inlet pipe, a water outlet of the first water pump is communicated with a rotary spray head through a water pipe, the rotary spray head is arranged at the left side of the upper surface of the water tank through a support, a dust settling box is fixedly connected at the left side of the upper surface of the bottom plate, an opening and closing door is movably connected at the front end of the left side of the dust settling box through a hinge, and a dust settling component is arranged in the dust settling box, the dust settling device improves the dust settling efficiency through a dust washing mode and the dust settling box, the dust falling device has good dust falling effect and good practicability.

title_en: Flue gas desulfurization and denitrification reaction device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of garbage treatment, in particular to a flue gas desulfurization and denitrification reaction device, wherein the top of a garbage incinerator is connected with a filtering air inlet pipe A; the filtering air inlet pipe A is connected with a filter cloth dedusting filter box; the other end of the filter cloth dedusting filter box is connected with a filtering air inlet pipe B; the filtering air inlet pipe B is connected to the bottom of the water curtain desulfurization tower; the top of the water curtain desulfurization tower is connected with a filtering air inlet pipe C; the filtering air inlet pipe C is connected with the flue gas dehumidification box; a smoke detector is arranged at the bottom of the smoke dehumidifying box; the smoke detector is connected with the smoke exhaust pipe; an exhaust fan is arranged on the smoke exhaust pipe; a plurality of spray headers A are arranged on the inner wall of the water curtain desulfurizing tower; a support column is arranged in the middle of the water curtain desulfurizing tower; arrange on the support column and be provided with a plurality of shower heads B, solve the poor problem of SOx/NOx control treatment effect among the flue gas treatment process.

title_en: Laboratory ventilation cupboard with high-efficient antibiotic dustproof function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a laboratory ventilation cabinet with efficient antibacterial and dustproof functions, which comprises a box body, wherein mounting rods are fixedly mounted on two sides of an inner cavity of the box body, a fixing block is fixedly mounted in the middle of the surface of each mounting rod, and a fixing groove is formed in the inner side of each fixing block. The rotary disc drives the adsorption columns on the surfaces of the rotary rods to rotate, so that dust and impurities mixed in gas falling into the box body can be effectively adsorbed and purified, an excellent sterilization effect can be achieved, the ventilation opening is convenient for ventilating air inside the box body and the outside, the dust can be effectively prevented from falling into the box body from the ventilation opening in the ventilation process through the arrangement of the dust cover, a user can conveniently take appliances inside the box body through the protective door, and the problem that a common laboratory ventilation cabinet in the market is poor in antibacterial and dustproof effects is solved.

title_en: Electroplating effluent supernatant separating mechanism
abstract_en: The application relates to an electroplating effluent supernatant separating mechanism relates to separating mechanism's technical field, and it includes the separation tank and sets up in overflow hole on the separation tank, the inner wall level of separation tank is fixed with and is located the fender material strip of overflow hole below, the lower extreme inner wall in overflow hole with the upper surface parallel and level of fender material strip. Through setting up the fender material strip, when the supernatant overflowed the striker plate and discharged through the overflow hole, the striker plate can shelter from the flocculation floater to reduce the flocculation floater from overflow hole exhaust risk, make the staff follow-up need not to salvage the flocculation floater as far as possible, and then reduce staff's burden.

title_en: Heat treatment waste heat recovery equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a heat treatment waste heat recovery device, which comprises: a box body; a left containing cavity, a right containing cavity and a filter cavity are respectively arranged in the box body; the bottom of the box body is provided with a left air outlet and a right air outlet corresponding to the left cavity and the right cavity respectively; an air inlet is arranged at the rear end of the box body corresponding to the position of the filter cavity; a filtering device is arranged in the filtering cavity; a plurality of cooling liquid inlet pipes are uniformly distributed at the bottom of the filter cavity of the box body; the end part of the cooling liquid inlet pipe is provided with a left cooling pipe and a right cooling pipe; the left cooling pipe and the right cooling pipe penetrate through the side wall of the filter cavity and are respectively arranged in the left containing cavity and the right containing cavity; a cleaning device is also arranged in the box body; the utility model can effectively improve the heat recovery efficiency and prolong the service life of the cooling pipe.

title_en: Furnace flue gas denitrification denitration and purification device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a denitrification, denitrification and purification device for furnace flue gas, belonging to the technical field of flue gas purification; the smoke abatement SOx/NOx control's effect is poor, lacks detection device, and the problem that water and waste gas mixability are low can be solved, including main part, purifier, detection device arranges the main part top in, and purifier arranges in the main part, the main part is tower-shaped structure, and the choke runs through the main part lateral wall, and the intake pipe is connected to choke one end, and the choke other end extends to in the main part, and the choke intermediate position cross-section is less than both ends cross-section, and the choke both sides set up the fixed block, and the fixed block is arranged in the main part lateral wall, forms fixedly, and the choke bottom sets up into the water and takes over, and SOx/NOx control's is effectual, and is efficient, and water and flue gas mixability height, water can recycle, can detect the tail gas after handling.

title_en: Gas distributor structure of large absorption tower
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gas distributor structure of a large absorption tower, which comprises a sleeve joint part, a shell, a balance block, a liquid through frame, a supporting seat, a fixed point block, a diversion channel, a screwing installation device and a reinforcing plate, wherein the shell of the gas distributor structure is provided with an embedded screwing installation device, a wear-resistant layer is attached to the surface of a first clamping plate, the arc length is matched and has the function of improving the wear resistance of the structure, the first clamping plate and a second clamping plate are combined into a whole through the clamping and embedding sleeve, a hinge shaft is a shaft part which enables two structural parts of the first clamping plate and the second clamping plate to be linked together and to move relatively and can bear and transmit the force borne by the structural parts, the hinge shaft is one of main parts of the structural parts which are mutually linked, the mounting positions of the first clamping plate and the second clamping plate with different thicknesses are rotated and exchanged, and a certain movable gap is reserved when a thin plate loses the tight acting force on the fitting, thereby be convenient for improve the dismouting flexibility of gas distributor structural accessories.

title_en: Piglet incubator
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of livestock breeding, in particular to a piglet incubator, aiming at the problems that the incubator cannot purify air and has poor air exchange effect in the prior art, the incubator comprises a box body, wherein an operation door is installed on the front surface of the box body, a through hole communicated with the box body is formed in the center of the top of the box body, a vertical cylinder is fixedly connected to the top of the box body, the through hole is positioned on the inner side of the vertical cylinder, a cover plate is sleeved on the top of the vertical cylinder in a threaded manner, an activated carbon air filter cylinder is sleeved on the bottom of the cover plate in a threaded manner, and the bottom of the activated carbon air filter cylinder extends to the inner side of the through hole and is spliced with the through hole. The air purifier has the advantages of reasonable structure, stable structure and simple operation, effectively ensures the air purification effect in the insulation can, is convenient for circulating air exchange of the air in the box body, and is easy to popularize and use.

title_en: Multifunctional solubility test ventilation device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional solubility testing ventilation device, and belongs to the field of electronic material production equipment. The device includes the fume hood, and it has test cabinet and locker, has the rack in the test cabinet, and the pipeline is placed to the screen cloth, combustible gas alarm, solvent bucket, test cup and pneumatic agitator, and the screen cloth is placed the pipeline and is run through the bottom of test cabinet and extend to the collecting vessel top that is used for collecting the waste liquid that is located the test cabinet below, and explosion-proof fan and explosion-proof light are installed to the top of test cabinet, still have glass on the test cabinet and move the door and install the stirring timer on the test cabinet outer wall. According to the utility model, the test cabinet with the glass sliding door can be prevented from being exposed to the environment for working when a solubility test is carried out, and the vent can be connected to an exhaust pipeline of a workshop; the combustible gas alarm installed in the test cabinet can adjust the installation height according to the gas density, and the situation that the alarm is not timely is avoided.

title_en: Connecting structure of tractor silencer and exhaust elbow
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a connecting structure of a tractor silencer and an exhaust elbow, which comprises a silencer and the exhaust elbow, wherein one end of the silencer is fixedly welded with a first connecting flange, one end of the exhaust elbow is fixedly welded with a second connecting flange, a sealing mechanism for sealing connection is arranged between the first connecting flange and the second connecting flange, a fixing bolt penetrates through the first connecting flange and the second connecting flange, the bottom end of the fixing bolt is sequentially in threaded connection with a first nut and a second nut, the first nut and the second nut are opposite-top nuts, and the fixing bolt is a fine-tooth bolt; it can realize utilizing the butt nut structure, adopts fine thread bolt and nut simultaneously for the silencer is connected more firmly with the exhaust return bend, has improved joint strength and reliability.

title_en: Heat converter
abstract_en: The utility model provides a heat converter, including heat transfer nest of tubes (1), wind channel (2) and exhaust fan (3), heat transfer nest of tubes (1) level set up in high temperature department directly over the heat source, wind channel (2) input set up in heat transfer nest of tubes (1) top intercommunication the combustion chamber upper surface, wind channel (2) are pressed close to downwards the heat source extends, exhaust fan (3) are connected the export in wind channel. The utility model has the characteristics of strong wind power, enough heat and high heat efficiency, saves the operation cost for users and has good heating effect.

title_en: Air inlet connecting structure of steam pump heating boiler
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an air inlet connecting structure of a steam pump heating boiler, which comprises a primary air duct, a secondary air duct, a heater, a steam turbine exhaust steam outlet, a deaerator exhaust steam outlet, a condensate water collecting device and a boiler flue, wherein the steam turbine exhaust steam outlet is connected with one end of a first pipeline, the other end of the first pipeline is connected with an inlet of a heat exchange pipeline of the heater, the deaerator exhaust steam outlet is connected with one end of a second pipeline, the other end of the second pipeline is connected with the first pipeline, the primary air duct and the secondary air duct are connected with the heater, an outlet of the heat exchange pipeline of the heater is connected with one end of a third pipeline, the other end of the third pipeline is connected with a water inlet of the condensate water collecting device, one end of the circulating pipeline is connected with a water outlet of the condensate water collecting device, the other end of the circulating pipeline is connected with the first pipeline, and waste steam resources which need to be discharged originally are fully utilized to be used as a heating heat source for heating and warming, energy conservation and environmental protection, and improves the economic efficiency.

title_en: Processing dust collecting equipment of calcium carbonate
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a calcium carbonate processing dust removal device, which comprises a smoke inlet pipe, wherein a treatment barrel is arranged at the gas outlet end of the smoke inlet pipe, a smoke outlet pipe is arranged at the outer side of the treatment barrel, an adsorption grid is embedded into the inner side of the treatment barrel, a diversion top cover is arranged at the top end of the adsorption grid, a flow gathering groove plate is connected at the bottom end of the treatment barrel, a water outlet pipe is arranged at the bottom end of the flow gathering groove plate, a diversion cavity is arranged at the inner side of the diversion top cover, a water guide hole is arranged at the bottom end of the diversion top cover, two flow inlet pipe ends are symmetrically connected at the top end of the diversion top cover, so that an external water source enters the inner side of the diversion top cover, smoke dust adsorbed on the surface of the adsorption grid is washed through the diversion cavity and the water guide hole, sewage is discharged through the diversion groove plate and the water outlet pipe, the adsorption grid is cleaned repeatedly, the time waste is reduced, and the treatment cost is further reduced, so as to improve the preparation efficiency of the calcium carbonate and reduce the manufacturing cost.

title_en: Membrane direct filtration filter and zero-medicament short-flow membrane direct filtration system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a membrane direct filtration filter and a zero-medicament short-flow membrane direct filtration system, wherein the membrane direct filtration filter comprises a sludge storage area, a filtration area and a clear liquid area which are sequentially communicated from bottom to top; the filtering area is completely penetrated through the sludge storage area, a partition plate is arranged between the filtering area and the clear liquid area, the membrane module is suspended in the filtering area, the membrane module is formed by assembling a plurality of single ends of filtering membrane pipes, and the filtering area is communicated with the clear liquid area through one end of the assembly of the membrane module; the filtering area or the sludge storage area is provided with a liquid inlet; the sludge storage area is provided with a sludge discharge port; the clear liquid area is provided with a liquid outlet. The filter realizes the functions of sludge storage and mud-water separation through the suspended membrane assembly, can be directly applied to waste liquid which is not pretreated, does not need to add medicament, does not need to carry out combined removal of multiple sections of multi-stage equipment, and achieves the removal effects of three units of coagulating sedimentation, filtering and ultrafiltration.

title_en: Domestic sewage treatment device suitable for rural areas
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a be applicable to rural area domestic sewage treatment device, which comprises a housin, anaerobic tank, filtering ponds and the good oxygen pond of intercommunication are separated into in proper order along the horizontal direction to the casing is inside, the inside in anaerobic tank and good oxygen pond all is equipped with the combination filler, the inside of filtering ponds is equipped with filters the filler, and filters the top of filler and be equipped with the water-locator, be equipped with water inlet and delivery port on the casing, domestic sewage gets into the anaerobic tank from the water inlet, overflows to filtering ponds earlier, is promoted to good oxygen pond again, discharges through the delivery port, the utility model discloses the function is various, is favorable to improving domestic sewage treatment effect, practices thrift area, and simultaneously, whole processing procedure only once promotes, and energy saving consumes, is showing and has reduced the working costs.

title_en: Double-bottle group cabinet type heptafluoropropane fire extinguishing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a double-bottle combined cabinet type heptafluoropropane fire extinguishing device which comprises a cabinet body, wherein a hinge is arranged on the cabinet body, a cabinet door is arranged on the hinge, an observation window is arranged on the cabinet door, a shockproof mechanism is arranged in the cabinet body, a heptafluoropropane fire extinguisher body is arranged on the shockproof mechanism, a pressure gauge is arranged on the heptafluoropropane fire extinguisher body, a container valve is arranged on the heptafluoropropane fire extinguisher body, an electromagnetic driver is arranged on the container valve, a high-pressure hose is arranged on the electromagnetic driver, and a nozzle is arranged on the high-pressure hose. The utility model has the advantages of convenient installation and maintenance, flexible and efficient operation, good fire extinguishing effect and shock resistance.

title_en: Loosening equipment for planting traditional Chinese medicine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of agricultural instruments and discloses soil loosening equipment for planting traditional Chinese medicinal materials, which comprises a control box, wherein hollow slide blocks are respectively and slidably arranged on two sides of an inner cavity of the control box, racks are respectively and fixedly arranged on the front surface and the back surface of the inner cavity of the two hollow slide blocks, a motor is fixedly arranged at the top of the inner cavity of the control box, a first shaft is fixedly arranged at the output end of the motor through a speed reducer, a first bevel gear is fixedly arranged on the outer surface of the first shaft, a second shaft is rotatably arranged on the left side of the inner cavity of the control box and positioned inside the hollow slide blocks, the motor is matched with the first shaft, the first bevel gear and the second bevel gear to drive the second shaft to rotate, the second shaft is matched with a half gear to drive the hollow slide blocks to longitudinally move, the hollow slide blocks are matched with connecting blocks to adjust the soil loosening mechanism penetration depth, and the purpose of flexibly adjusting the soil loosening depth is realized, can meet the requirements of different medicinal materials on the soil loosening depth.

title_en: Ozone disinfection system for swimming pool
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ozone disinfection system for a swimming pool, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein an ozone generator is arranged on the upper part of the inner wall on the right side of a shell, a fan is arranged on the upper part of the inner wall on the left side of the shell, a water-gas mixing box is arranged on the bottom surface inside the shell, the gas outlet end of an air pump is communicated with the water-gas mixing box through an exhaust pipe, a water inlet pipe is arranged on the left side surface of the water-gas mixing box, a motor is arranged on the right side surface of the water-gas mixing box, the output end of the motor penetrates through the water-gas mixing box and is fixedly connected with an air injection pipe, an ozone water pipe is arranged on the upper part of the right side surface of the water-gas mixing box, a winding wheel is arranged on the right side of the upper surface of the bottom plate, an extension pipe is wound on the surface of the winding wheel, the utility model can mix ozone and the water, then disinfect the swimming pool, the disinfection effect is good, an universal locking wheel can conveniently move the bottom plate, and the extension pipe can expand the disinfection range of the swimming pool, the disinfection efficiency of the swimming pool is improved.

title_en: Biological laboratory waste liquid collecting and treating device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a biological laboratory waste liquid collecting and treating device which comprises a waste liquid collecting tank, a fully-sealed heat disinfection tank, a negative pressure pump and a fully-sealed ultraviolet disinfection tank, wherein the heat disinfection tank is arranged in the biological laboratory waste liquid collecting and treating device; the liquid inlet of the heat disinfection tank is used for being connected with a waste liquid pipe for discharging waste liquid in a biological laboratory, the liquid outlet of the heat disinfection tank is connected with the liquid inlet pipe of the ultraviolet disinfection tank through a pipeline, and the negative pressure port at the top of the heat disinfection tank is connected with the air inlet of a negative pressure pump through a pipeline; a PTFE disc-type filter disc for filtering microorganisms is fixedly connected to an exhaust port of the negative pressure pump; and a liquid discharge pipe of the ultraviolet disinfection tank is connected with a liquid inlet end of a waste liquid collecting tank through a pipeline. The utility model can thoroughly kill the microorganisms in the waste liquid of the biological laboratory, and completely eradicates the biological pollution caused by the outflow of the microorganisms in the waste liquid of the biological laboratory.

title_en: Inverter for solar power generation
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of solar power generation, and particularly relates to an inverter for solar power generation, which comprises an inverter body, wherein a refrigerating sheet, a temperature sensor and a control box are arranged in an inner cavity of the inverter body, a heat dissipation port is formed in the side wall of the inverter body, a fan assembly is arranged in a bearing groove, the fan assembly comprises a motor, fan blades are arranged at the output end of the motor, and a dustproof cover is arranged at an opening of the bearing groove, so that the heat dissipation efficiency of the inverter can be increased, the temperature of the inverter is prevented from being too high, and the service life of the inverter is shortened.

title_en: A energy-conserving papaw dust collector in air for building site
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an air energy-saving bubble dust removal device for a building site in the field of building dust removal, which solves the problems of small coverage area, large water consumption and poor catching capacity of the existing dust removal device, and adopts the following technical scheme: the device comprises a starting unmanned aerial vehicle, a foaming component, a liquid storage component and a fountain component, wherein a tubular shaft is fixedly arranged at the center of the bottom of the starting unmanned aerial vehicle, one end of the tubular shaft is connected with the bottom of the starting unmanned aerial vehicle, and the other end of the tubular shaft is fixedly connected with the liquid storage component; the middle part of foaming subassembly passes through the go-between suit on the hollow shaft and can be rotatory around the hollow shaft under power component's drive, and the fountain subassembly sets up in the stock solution subassembly and launches the foaming liquid of storage in the stock solution subassembly aerial, glues foaming liquid when the papaw blade is rotatory to its top, produces the papaw with the help of wind-force when the papaw blade is rotatory to the screw below that starts unmanned aerial vehicle.

title_en: Waste liquid collecting device of dealcoholized formaldehyde absorption tower
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a waste liquid collecting device of a dealcoholized formaldehyde absorption tower, which comprises a tank body, wherein a spherical filter plate is fixedly connected to the inner wall of one side of the tank body, a connecting shaft is movably connected to the inner wall of the bottom of the tank body, one end of the connecting shaft penetrates through the spherical filter plate and is fixedly connected with two arc-shaped scrapers, the arc-shaped scrapers are in contact with the spherical filter plate, one side of each arc-shaped scraper is fixedly connected with an auxiliary scraper, the auxiliary scrapers are in contact with the spherical filter plate, one side of the tank body is fixedly connected with a collecting box, and one side of the tank body is provided with a connecting port. According to the utility model, impurities can be scraped and collected through the matching use of the arc-shaped scraper and the collection box, the collection effect of the device is improved, the self-circulation of the absorption tower can be realized through the matching use of the water pump and the spray head, the use effect of the device is improved, the liquid medicine mixture at the bottom of the tank body can be mixed through the stirring frame, and the mixing effect of the device is improved.

title_en: Denitration control equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a denitration controlgear relates to chemical industry technical field, solves present ammonia spraying amount and is difficult to carry out automatically regulated and leads to the not good technical problem of NOx treatment effect. In the equipment, an outlet of a first flue gas pipeline is communicated with an inlet of a reactor, and an outlet of the reactor is communicated with an inlet of a second flue gas pipeline; an ammonia spraying device, a mixing device and a first flow guide device are sequentially arranged in the first flue gas pipeline along the flow direction of flue gas; the nitrogen oxide detection device comprises at least two samplers, a mixing gas chamber and an analysis device, wherein the at least two samplers are connected with the mixing gas chamber, and the analysis device is connected with the mixing gas chamber; wherein the at least two samplers are arranged in the second flue gas duct. The application provides a denitration controlgear is used for handling nitrogen oxide.

title_en: Intelligent monitoring system for coal mine air shaft
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent monitoring system for a coal mine air shaft, which comprises an air shaft intelligent monitoring center, a pressure fan monitoring subsystem, a main ventilator monitoring subsystem, a downhole water treatment monitoring subsystem, a gas pump monitoring subsystem, a sewage treatment subsystem, a water production workshop subsystem and a video monitoring subsystem. The utility model can realize the centralized remote monitoring and control functions of all sub-system equipment in the air-well area of the coal mine, and can provide basis for data acquisition, production scheduling and decision command of the whole mine, thereby achieving the purposes of reducing personnel and improving efficiency.

title_en: Quick extinguishing device for building engineering technology
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of constructional engineering, in particular to a quick fire extinguishing device for constructional engineering technology. The technical scheme comprises the following steps: mainboard, universal wheel and fixed plate, the fly leaf is installed at the top of mainboard, and the inside swing joint of fly leaf has the shrink board, and the internally mounted of shrink board has the regulating plate, and the base is installed to the bottom of mainboard, and the storage water tank is installed at the top of mainboard, and the water filling port is installed at the top of storage water tank, and the top movable mounting of regulating plate has the spray pipe. According to the utility model, the movable plate is arranged at the top of the main plate, when the device is used, a worker can drive the screw rod to rotate by rotating the rotating wheel, at the moment, the two groups of thread blocks can be driven to move towards the mutually approaching direction, at the moment, the connecting rod can be straightened, at the moment, the lifting plate can be driven to descend, at the moment, the universal wheel can be tightly attached to the ground, at the moment, the device can be moved, and the use convenience of the device is greatly improved.

title_en: Filter equipment is collected to environmental protection waste gas
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an environment-friendly waste gas collecting and filtering device, which relates to the technical field of environment-friendly waste gas collecting equipment and comprises a waste gas collecting and processing mechanism, wherein the waste gas collecting and processing mechanism comprises a filtering structure, a cavity, a suction opening lining and a transparent baffle, the filtering structure, the suction opening lining and the transparent baffle are detachably connected with the cavity, and the waste gas collecting and processing mechanism is fixed with external equipment through screws. The device can be fixed with equipment by screws, so that the collecting and filtering efficiency can be effectively improved, the structure is simple, the inner lining of the suction port is used for improving the collecting efficiency and is convenient to clean, the filtering structure is used for filtering and blocking foreign matters from being sucked in the production and collection process, the replacement is convenient, the collecting stability is kept, meanwhile, double-layer filtering can be realized by two layers of filtering cotton, the transparent baffle can be inserted into the locking groove piece by using the rotating shaft, the visual field of staff in the operation process is ensured, and the transparent baffle can rotate upwards and can be detached to clean pollutants.

title_en: Multistage industrial waste gas dust collecting equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of waste gas dust removal, and discloses multistage industrial waste gas dust removal equipment which comprises a first purification cylinder, a second purification cylinder and a third purification cylinder, wherein hoppers and supports are respectively arranged at the bottom ends of the first purification cylinder, the second purification cylinder and the third purification cylinder, an opening at the top end of the first purification cylinder is communicated with the bottom of an inner cavity of the second purification cylinder through a first branch pipe, a second branch pipe is arranged at an opening at the top end of the second purification cylinder, and the other end of the second branch pipe is inserted into the bottom of the inner cavity of the third purification cylinder from the opening at the top end of the third purification cylinder. The multi-stage waste gas and dust filtering device is simple in overall structure, achieves multi-stage filtering treatment of waste gas and dust through the combined design of the first purifying cylinder, the second purifying cylinder and the third purifying cylinder, is beneficial to reducing dust emission, accordingly improves waste gas dust removal effect, has wide market prospect, and is beneficial to popularization and use.

title_en: Green energy-saving dry-mixed mortar batching device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a green energy-conserving dry-mixed mortar dosing unit, including a batching section of thick bamboo, batching section of thick bamboo bottom surface fixed mounting has the dust collection box, and dust collection box both sides side symmetry intercommunication has the tuber pipe to install the bearing bracket in the tuber pipe, install the fan pivot in the bearing bracket, and the fan pivot is located dust collection box inner chamber one end and installs second bevel gear to the fan pivot is located tuber pipe inner chamber one end and installs the induced air flabellum, batching section of thick bamboo inner chamber central authorities install the axis of rotation, and the axis of rotation is located batching section of thick bamboo inner chamber part and evenly installs a plurality of stirring rake, and the axis of rotation is located dust collection box inner chamber part and installs first bevel gear, first bevel gear and second bevel gear intermeshing. Has the advantages that: the utility model discloses be provided with dust collection box and dust removal filter bag, the dust that produces when preventing the discharging pipe ejection of compact is wafted and is polluted the atmospheric environment in the middle of the atmosphere and cause the influence to workman's health, and this in-process need not to add electronic dust removal mechanism, and is more energy-concerving and environment-protective.

title_en: Catalytic combustion exhaust treatment device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of catalytic combustion waste gas treatment, and discloses a catalytic combustion waste gas treatment device which comprises a spray tower, a dry filter and an active carbon adsorption tower which are mutually communicated, wherein a top pipeline is arranged above the active carbon adsorption tower, and the surface wall of the top pipeline is provided with a top opening and a sealing surface mounting opening, the utility model is provided with the top opening and the sealing surface opening above the top pipeline, and the top opening and the sealing surface mounting opening are provided with sealing elements to seal the top opening and the sealing surface mounting opening in daily use, the gas can normally move through the inside of the top pipeline, when a small range of top pipes are damaged, the pipe is sealed, then the top opening is replaced, the pipe which crosses the damaged part is connected with another top pipe by using an additional pipe, thereby changing the flow position of the gas stream so that the damaged top duct can be repaired without shutting down the apparatus.

title_en: Small-size motor cooling structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cooling structure of a small motor, belonging to the technical field of motors and comprising: a base; the improved motor heat dissipation device is characterized in that a heat dissipation bin is fixedly connected to the top of the base, a motor is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the heat dissipation bin, the power output end of the motor penetrates through and extends out of the heat dissipation bin along the horizontal direction, an airflow bin is fixedly connected to one end of the heat dissipation bin, an electric fan is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the airflow bin, a dust cover is fixedly connected to one end of the airflow bin, an opening is formed in the outer wall of one side of the dust cover, a first filter screen is arranged at the opening, openings are formed in the outer walls of two symmetrical sides of the heat dissipation bin, and second filter screens are arranged at the openings.

title_en: Mechanical pressure relief opening of hot aerosol fire extinguisher
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mechanical pressure relief port of a hot aerosol fire extinguisher, which relates to the technical field of aerosol fire extinguishers and comprises a first mounting block, a second mounting block, a third mounting block and a pressure relief column, wherein an air storage cavity is formed inside the first mounting block, the top of the air storage cavity is fixedly threaded with the pressure relief column, the first mounting block is rotatably provided with the second mounting block through a rotating shaft, a through hole is formed inside the second mounting block, the top of the pressure relief column extends out of the through hole, the top wall of the second mounting block is fixedly provided with the third mounting block, an exhaust hole is formed inside the third mounting block and is communicated with the pressure relief column, the side wall of the pressure relief column is provided with a plurality of pressure relief ports, the pressure relief ports are communicated with side grooves of the first mounting block, a piston is slidably arranged in the side grooves, and the piston is connected with the second mounting block through a pressure relief spring, when abnormal combustion occurs, the second mounting block is flicked to quickly release pressure.

title_en: Medical trash can
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a medical garbage can which comprises an outer barrel, a barrel cover and an inner barrel arranged in the outer barrel; the control device and the travelling mechanism are arranged in the outer barrel, a plurality of power wheels are arranged at the bottom of the outer barrel, and the travelling mechanism is in transmission connection with the power wheels; the drum cover is provided with a sensing mechanism for detecting whether the drum cover needs to be opened or not, one end of the drum cover is hinged with the outer drum, and the other end of the drum cover is detachably connected with the outer drum through a connecting mechanism; the top of the inner barrel is provided with a detection mechanism for detecting whether the inner barrel is full of garbage or not; the medical garbage can comprises the sensing mechanism and the connecting mechanism, and garbage can be thrown in without contacting the medical garbage can; after the inner barrel is filled with the medical waste, the walking mechanism and the power wheel drive the medical waste bin to move to an appointed dumping point, the waste is dumped by appointed workers, the number of times that the medical workers contact the medical waste bin is reduced, and the infection risk is greatly reduced.

title_en: Slag crusher
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of crushers, and particularly discloses a slag crusher; the crushing rotor comprises a main shaft penetrating through the outer shell, a shaft sleeve is sleeved on the main shaft in an inner cavity of the outer shell, key strip grooves are formed in the outer circumferential surface of the main shaft and the inner wall of the shaft sleeve, key strips are inserted in the key strip grooves, a plurality of hammer disks are welded on the outer circumferential surface of the shaft sleeve, and protective iron plates are fixed on the front inner wall and the rear inner wall of the outer shell between the arc-shaped sieve plate and the crushing rotor; the slag crusher disclosed by the utility model can effectively avoid the deformation of the main shaft caused by the crushing rotor in the slag crushing process, prolong the service life of the main shaft, simultaneously has higher deformation resistance of the arc-shaped sieve plate, and effectively avoids the abrasion of the inner wall of the outer shell body caused by the slag crushing process.

title_en: Pellet feed classified screening device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pellet feed grading and screening device which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the upper surface of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a frame body, the inner side wall of the frame body is provided with a chute, a plurality of sliders matched with the chute are clamped in the chute, the left side surface of each slider is fixedly connected with a screen, symmetrical connecting rods are arranged in the frame body, the top end of each connecting rod and the bottom end of each connecting rod are respectively and fixedly connected with the upper surface of the screen and the bottom surface of the screen, and the left side surface of the frame body is provided with a slide way. This pellet feed classified screening device through being provided with the screen cloth, can classify the screening to pellet feed, has solved the device and can't carry out screening categorised problem to pellet feed, through being provided with the spray tube, can spray the dust fall to the framework inside, avoids the device to appear the phenomenon that the floating dust flies upward when classifying the pellet feed screening, has solved the workman and has appeared the impaired problem of respiratory track because of the floating dust.

title_en: Tool set equipment for firemen
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tool collecting device for firemen, which comprises a tool box, wherein the tool box comprises a box body I and a box body II, a chute is formed in the inner wall of the box body I, a through groove is formed in the lower side of the chute, a clamping block I is arranged in the chute, a clamping block II is arranged on one side of the clamping block I, a spring is arranged between the clamping block I and the clamping block II, a threaded hole is formed in the bottom of the clamping block II, a bolt is arranged in the threaded hole, a magic tape is arranged below the chute, and a magic tape is bonded on the magic tape; a movable groove is formed in the second box body, a bidirectional threaded rod is arranged in the movable groove, a positioning block is sleeved on the bidirectional threaded rod, and a fixed box is arranged in the second box body. The novel multifunctional electric axe is convenient to draw and use due to the fact that the clamp blocks I and II are arranged in the novel multifunctional electric axe, the hook and loop fastener clamps long handles such as the axe and the crowbar in a limiting mode, the box bodies II are internally provided with the multilayer box bodies for placing small handles, the multilayer box bodies can be opened simultaneously when the novel multifunctional electric axe is taken, and the novel multifunctional electric axe is convenient and rapid to take.

title_en: Dust remover with coiled vortex pre-collection and fan blade cyclone air distribution
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dust remover with a rolling vortex pre-collection function and a fan blade vortex air distribution function, and relates to the technical field of dust removers. The dust collecting device comprises a dust collecting hopper, wherein a collecting mechanism is arranged in the dust collecting hopper, and a vortex mechanism is arranged on one side of the collecting mechanism; the collecting mechanism comprises a main collecting box, a connecting plate, an air inlet pipe, a plugging block and an expanding opening, wherein the air inlet pipe is arranged on one side of the ash collecting hopper; the vortex mechanism comprises a vortex isolation cover, unpowered fan blades, a connecting shaft, a sleeving shaft, limiting plates and a bearing plate, wherein the top end of the flaring is provided with a plurality of unpowered fan blades, the inner wall of the ash collecting hopper is axisymmetrically provided with two limiting plates, and one side of each limiting plate, which is opposite to the limiting plates, is fixedly connected with the vortex isolation cover. According to the vortex flow field generating device, through the arrangement of the collecting mechanism and the vortex mechanism, the rotating airflow assists a part of gas to flow downwards along the outer side of the vortex isolation cover and then return to the inner side of the vortex isolation cover to form a vortex flow field; the rotating airflow generated by the fan blades is dispersed and separated to the edge of the ash bucket and collected.

title_en: Kitchen garbage odor purification unit
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of gas treatment, in particular to a kitchen waste odor purification treatment device, which comprises a supporting seat; an outer shell and a purification box are arranged on the supporting seat, and a vent pipe is communicated between the outer shell and the purification box; the collecting pipe is rotatably arranged on the inner side of the outer shell, a partition plate is fixedly arranged on the inner side of the collecting pipe, an installation shaft is arranged on the partition plate, and a servo motor for driving the installation shaft to rotate is arranged on the outer shell; a discharge hole is formed in the supporting seat; a fixed pipe is arranged on the lower end face of the supporting seat, a threaded ring is arranged on the outer side of the fixed pipe, a plurality of sliding blocks are arranged on the threaded ring, and annular grooves for the sliding of the sliding blocks are formed in the outer side wall of the fixed pipe; the lower part of the fixed pipe is provided with a collecting box, and the threaded ring is in threaded connection with the upper part of the collecting box. The garbage storage device can prevent a large amount of bacteria and odor generated in garbage from flying into the air, and simultaneously prevent operators from directly observing the stored garbage and avoid generating uncomfortable feeling.

title_en: Small-sized dustproof tool for construction site
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a small dustproof tool for a construction site, which comprises a movable bottom box, wherein a water tank is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the movable bottom box, a concave groove is formed in the upper surface of the water tank, a water pump is fixedly arranged on the inner bottom wall of the concave groove, sliding grooves are formed in the inner walls of two sides of the concave groove, sliding plates are connected to the inner walls of the two sliding grooves in a sliding mode, a bearing is embedded in the upper surface of each sliding plate, a rotating water pipe is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the bearing, a water disc is fixedly arranged at the top end of the rotating water pipe, and a water spray head is arranged on the outer surface of the water disc. This a small-size dustproof instrument for job site through setting up water tank, water pump, sliding plate, sprinkler bead, vertical lead screw and rolling disc, makes this dustproof instrument at the in-process that uses, starts the water pump, makes the water in the water tank automatic carry out water spray dust removal to the scene through the sprinkler bead, has avoided adopting the artifical mode of splashing, has reduced constructor's the amount of labour, has avoided causing the injury to constructor's health simultaneously.

title_en: Oxygen-enriched garbage incineration power generation system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an oxygen-enriched garbage incineration power generation system, which comprises a garbage storage bin, wherein the garbage storage bin is connected with a leachate treatment system, the garbage storage bin and the leachate treatment system are both connected with the garbage incineration system, the garbage incineration system is connected with a waste heat recovery system, the waste heat recovery system and the leachate treatment system are both connected with a flue gas purification system, the waste heat recovery system is also connected with a waste heat power generation system, the waste heat power generation system and the leachate treatment system are both connected with an electrolyzed water hydrogen production system, the electrolyzed water hydrogen production system is respectively connected with a hydrogen storage and transportation system and a secondary air distribution system, and the secondary air distribution system and a primary air distribution system are both connected with the garbage incineration system. The system produces hydrogen through the low-price green power supply generated by waste incineration, improves the industrial benefit of waste incineration, has wide distribution of waste incineration projects, can reduce the hydrogen energy transportation cost, utilizes oxygen generated in the hydrogen production process to carry out oxygen-enriched combustion, improves the heat efficiency and the incineration temperature of waste incineration, and reduces the generation of dioxin.

title_en: Low-background alpha beta measuring instrument
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model discloses a low background alpha beta measuring instrument, which comprises a base with universal wheels, wherein a lower lead chamber is arranged on the base, a shielding chamber is arranged above the lower lead chamber, a plurality of layers of upper lead chambers are arranged above the shielding chamber, a shielding cover is arranged at the top of each upper lead chamber, an object stage is arranged between each shielding chamber and each upper lead chamber, at least one detection hole is arranged on each object stage, a pull-out sample changing device is arranged between each shielding chamber and each object stage, a main probe is arranged in each upper lead chamber, the detection end of each main probe is correspondingly arranged in each detection hole, a positioning hole is arranged on each shielding chamber, a positioning bolt matched with the positioning hole is arranged at the bottom of each object stage, the distances from the positioning hole to the edge of the shielding chamber on the same side with the object stage are the same as those from the positioning bolt to the edge of the shielding chamber on the same side as the object stage, a secondary locking structure is arranged at the position corresponding to the object stage and the shielding chamber, so that the detection holes can be completely corresponding to the main probes even if the object stage is replaced, and the measuring ends are completely overlapped, so that the measuring result is guaranteed.

title_en: Gas-liquid separation mist catcher
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of gas-liquid separators, in particular to a gas-liquid separation mist catcher which comprises a machine body, wherein the top of the machine body is provided with a mist catcher, the mist catcher comprises a lower part of the mist catcher and an upper part of the mist catcher, a fixed mounting mechanism is arranged between the lower part of the mist catcher and the upper part of the mist catcher, gas-liquid separation mechanisms are arranged on the lower part of the mist catcher and the upper part of the mist catcher, and a cleaning mechanism is arranged inside the lower part of the mist catcher; the fixed mounting mechanism comprises connecting plates and bolts, the connecting plates are symmetrically and fixedly connected to the outer parts of two adjacent sides of the lower part and the upper part of the mist catcher, and the two connecting plates on the same side are in threaded connection through the bolts; the gas-liquid separation mechanism comprises an oil-gas-water inlet pipe and a mist catching laminate; according to the utility model, the fan blades are driven by the motor to rotate to generate wind, so that the gas in the mist catcher is blown upwards, the gas is discharged through the mist catching layer plate, the gas outlet and the gas communicating pipe, the gas-liquid separation efficiency is enhanced, a small part of gas can be prevented from flowing into the lower part along with the liquid, and the separation effect is ensured.

title_en: Thing networking garbage classification collection box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an internet of things garbage classification recycling bin which comprises a garbage can located inside a linkage box, wherein the top of the linkage box is fixedly connected with a machine case, and the top of the inner cavity of the machine case is fixedly provided with a motor. This thing networking garbage classification collection box, through stimulate the closing plate left, make the closing plate upset upwards, then drop into rubbish through the dog-house in the inside garbage bin of linkage box, then loosen the closing plate, the closing plate receives gravity upset downwards and triggers second trigger button this moment, the motor starts and triggers board reciprocating motion from top to bottom through the rotation drive of reciprocal lead screw this moment, it can trigger the board fixed if the inside amasss rubbish of garbage bin, the traction plate continues to descend and makes first trigger button triggered by the trigger board this moment, first trigger button triggers and makes two electric telescopic handle stretch out, and carry out spacing fixed through spacing mouthful to the closing plate.

title_en: Multidirectional detection and adjustment device for spark detection alarm device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multidirectional detection and adjustment device for a spark detection alarm device, which comprises a first main pipe; first person in charge one side is provided with first three-way valve, first three-way valve both ends are provided with first branch pipe and second branch pipe, first branch pipe and second branch pipe upper end are provided with the spark detector, the spark detector passes through bolt fixed mounting and puts in first branch pipe and second branch pipe one side, the shower is installed to first branch pipe and second branch pipe upper end, first branch pipe and second branch pipe one end are provided with second three-way valve upside, second three-way valve one side is provided with the second and is responsible for, the motor is installed to first three-way valve and second three-way valve upper end. When the fire extinguishing device is used for extinguishing fire, the motor drives the first three-way valve and the second three-way valve to close the first branch pipe, the fire is extinguished in the first branch pipe through the spraying pipe, the second branch pipe is opened at the moment, dust is conveyed, and dust removal in a workshop is not influenced.

title_en: Chemical storage tank waste gas RTO administers device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a chemical storage tank waste gas RTO treatment device, which relates to the field of comprehensive waste gas treatment and comprises a sewage station dangerous waste storage tank, other waste gas storage tanks and a benzene waste gas storage tank, wherein the sewage station dangerous waste storage tank is connected with a first washing tower, the other waste gas storage tanks are connected to a first air mixing box through a gas-liquid separator, the benzene waste gas storage tank is connected to the first air mixing box through a condensing device, the first air mixing box is connected to a concentration buffer through a second washing tower, the first washing tower and the concentration buffer are respectively connected to a second air mixing box through pipelines, the second air mixing box is sequentially connected with a flame arrester, an RTO burner and a chimney along a waste gas treatment sequence, and the second washing tower is further connected to the chimney through an emergency adsorption tank. The utility model can carry out centralized treatment on the waste gas generated in the chemical production, has high treatment efficiency and good treatment effect, and ensures that the waste gas emission reaches the standard.

title_en: Integrated dosing system capable of being buried
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an integrated type buried dosing system, and belongs to the technical field of mixed dosing devices. title_en: Drying system for air sensitive materials

title_en: Sludge collecting and treating device

This application can get rid of the moisture in the mud to a certain extent, and then has solved still can have the problem of a small amount of moisture in the mud through the filter-pressing processing, shortens the processing time for subsequent sludge drying handles as far as.

title_en: Fire hydrant case convenient to installation fire control accessory
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire hydrant box convenient for installing fire-fighting accessories, which comprises a box body, wherein a fire hydrant, a fire hose reel and an adjustable hose installation mechanism are arranged in the box body, a fire hose is arranged on the adjustable hose installation mechanism, the adjustable hose installation mechanism comprises a support vertical frame, a guide adjusting groove is arranged in the support vertical frame, an adjusting screw rod is rotatably connected in the guide adjusting groove, and the end part of the adjusting screw rod is in transmission connection with an adjusting handle; the utility model discloses a hosepipe installation mechanism with adjustable set up, rotate and adjust the handle and change the distance between fire hose and the box inboard bottom, utilize reset spring to make the gag lever post hug closely on fire hose, then rotate the anticreep telescopic link, fix to fire hose, install and deposit the fire hose of different length to can leave parking space for squirt and other accessories, improve the installation convenience to the fire control accessory.

title_en: Butyl acetate recovery unit
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a butyl acetate retrieves technical field, and discloses a butyl acetate recovery unit, including dividing liquid mechanism, dry filtering mechanism, rabbling mechanism and distillation mechanism, dry filtering mechanism is located the lower extreme that divides liquid mechanism, the rabbling mechanism is located dry filtering mechanism's inside, distillation mechanism is located dry filtering mechanism's right side. This butyl acetate recovery unit, through setting up liquid separating mechanism, let in butyl acetate waste liquid and sodium pentacarbonate hundredth solution among the separating funnel, first flowmeter and second flowmeter detect the flow of butyl acetate waste liquid and sodium pentacarbonate hundredth solution, make the proportion of the two keep at one to one, then wash and the decoloration processing to the butyl acetate waste liquid, can carry out liquid separating decoloration at same device, dry and distillation's work, make operating procedure more simple and convenient, the efficiency of butyl acetate recovery has been improved, also make the various solution proportion of butyl acetate recovery more accurate.

title_en: Outdoor multimedia fire-fighting propaganda cabinet
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of fire control propaganda cabinet technique and specifically relates to a multi-media fire control propaganda cabinet of outdoor use, the intelligent cabinet temperature adjusting device comprises a cabinet body, regulating plate and horizontal pole, cabinet body top is provided with the guard plate, be provided with on the cabinet body the regulating plate, erect the groove on the regulating plate, the arc wall has been seted up to one side of erecting the groove, be provided with the connecting rod on erecting the groove, be provided with first stopper on the connecting rod, the one end of first stopper is provided with the second stopper, be provided with on the arc wall the horizontal pole, be provided with first company's board on the horizontal pole, be provided with the connecting axle on the first company's board, be provided with the second on the connecting axle and link the board, be provided with the handle on the fixed axle, hang and twist the handle and make first company's board and second link board angle take place to deflect and carry out the up-and-down motion along erecting groove and arc wall route to drive the guard plate on the cabinet body and open and be closed.

title_en: PTFE tectorial membrane sack for glass smelting kiln
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a PTFE tectorial membrane sack for glass smelting kiln relates to PTFE tectorial membrane sack technical field, including PTFE tectorial membrane sack body, the one end intercommunication of PTFE tectorial membrane sack body has fixed frame, the internal surface sliding connection of fixed frame has the closing plate, the closing plate is kept away from two spacing springs of one side fixedly connected with of PTFE tectorial membrane sack body, spacing spring with the inner wall fixed connection of fixed frame, the internal connection of fixed frame has the collection subassembly that is used for collecting the dust. The utility model discloses, seal fixed frame through the closing plate, drive through shrink subassembly and collect the subassembly and remove to drive and collect the subassembly and remove to the one end of PTFE tectorial membrane sack, then remove through collecting the subassembly and drive the dust and remove, thereby clear up the dust on PTFE tectorial membrane sack surface, then the dust of clearance passes through the discharge gate and discharges, thereby realizes the clearance to the dust, has improved the life cycle of PTFE tectorial membrane sack, convenient operation.

title_en: Oxygen-enriched ionized water generating device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an oxygen boosting ionized water generating device, include: a small molecule generator and an oxygen generator; the input end of the automatic pump is communicated with the output end of the small molecule generator; the input end of the mixing pump is communicated with the output end of the automatic pump; the input end of the oxygen-enriched ionized water generator is communicated with the output end of the oxygen generator, and the output end of the oxygen-enriched ionized water generator is communicated with the input end of the mixing pump; and the input end of the catalyst is communicated with the output end of the mixing pump, so that the purposes of reducing water molecular groups and improving the oxygen content of water by using irrigation water are achieved.

title_en: Vertical circulating garage
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a vertical garage technical field, and a vertical circulation garage is disclosed, which comprises a vehicle rack, it is connected with the pivot to rotate on the frame, parallel about two pivots, it has drive sprocket and driven sprocket to overlap fixedly respectively in two pivots, frame outside fixed mounting has the motor, the output of motor passes through the reducing gear box and is connected with the epaxial pivot of drive sprocket, the transfer chain has been cup jointed on drive sprocket and the driven sprocket, fixedly connected with backplate on the transfer chain, the one end of backplate is rotated and is connected with the trailer frame, the trailer frame includes tow bar and bracket, the bracket is the U-shaped, bracket connection is on the tow bar, the tow bar rotates to be connected on the backplate. This vertical circulation garage installs smoke sensor on the tow bar, takes place the spontaneous combustion at the car and produces smog, is detected by smoke sensor, makes through the controller that spray the mechanism and spray the car, carries out preliminary putting out a fire and remedy, controls the intensity of a fire to a certain extent at the conflagration initial stage, strives for the time for outside manual work is put out a fire.

title_en: Fire-proof equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a fire protection equipment for carry out conflagration early warning and put out a fire to material conveying pipe, wherein, this fire protection equipment includes: the fire detection probe is arranged on the inner side wall of the material conveying pipe and used for generating a fire alarm signal when detecting that sparks exist in the material conveying pipe; the spraying device comprises a spraying water pump, a water delivery pipe and a nozzle assembly which are communicated, and the nozzle assembly is arranged on the inner side wall of the material delivery pipe and is spaced from the fire detection probe; and the control device is connected with the fire detection probe and the spray water pump, and is used for sending a first control signal to the spray water pump when receiving a fire alarm signal sent by the fire detection probe so as to start the spray water pump to spray cooling water into the material conveying pipe through the water conveying pipe and the nozzle assembly. The application provides a fire-proof equipment can in time detect the conflagration risk in the material conveyer pipe to carry out conflagration early warning, and in time eliminate conflagration hidden danger through spray set, reduce the loss of fire.

title_en: Air cleaner with composite filter element structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an air cleaner with composite filter element structure, including shell and end cover, the internally mounted of end cover has the installation component, transfer line and end cover threaded connection, the bottom rigid coupling of transfer line has the toper piece, the outer wall of toper piece is provided with the ejector pad, the protective case has been cup jointed to the outer wall of ejector pad, the inserted bar has been cup jointed to the inside of protective case, the outer wall of inserted bar cup joints the elastic component, the bottom rigid coupling of transfer line has the closing plate. The utility model relates to an air cleaner technical field, this air cleaner with composite filter structure uses through the cooperation of transfer line, toper piece, ejector pad, protecting crust, inserted bar, elastic component and closing plate etc. inserts the inside of shell with the end cover, and the inserted bar runs through during the protecting crust inserts the inside draw-in groove of shell, and then connects end cover and shell, and is built-in with connection structure, guarantees the level and smooth rule of shell outer wall, and the whole mechanism of being convenient for installs and uses on external equipment.

title_en: Automatic fire-extinguishing high-low voltage power distribution cabinet and fire-extinguishing mechanism thereof
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an automatic fire-extinguishing high-low voltage power distribution cabinet and a fire-extinguishing mechanism thereof, comprising a cabinet body, wherein the cabinet body is internally provided with the fire-extinguishing mechanism, the fire-extinguishing mechanism comprises a vertical mounting column, the upper end of the mounting column is mounted on a top plate of the cabinet body, the lower end of the mounting column is mounted on a bottom plate of the cabinet body, a plurality of positioning sleeves are arranged on the mounting column, the outer wall of each positioning sleeve is provided with a fire-extinguishing agent storage, the fire-extinguishing agent storage is internally provided with an aerosol fire-extinguishing agent particle layer, each fire-extinguishing agent storage is provided with a lead wire, one end of the lead wire is contacted with the aerosol fire-extinguishing agent particle layer, and the other end of the lead wire is fixed in the cabinet body. According to the utility model, the plurality of fire extinguishing agent memories are arranged, each fire extinguishing agent memory is positioned at different heights, each fire extinguishing agent memory is provided with one lead, and the plurality of leads are distributed at different heights, so that when a fire is generated, nearby leads can be initiated more quickly, and the fire extinguishing mechanism can be started more timely to extinguish the fire.

title_en: Waste water recovery system for plastic processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wastewater recovery system for plastic processing, which comprises a first-stage filter tank, a water inlet, a first-stage filter box, a second-stage filter tank, a second-stage filter screen and a distillation chamber, wherein the water inlet is arranged at the top of the first-stage filter tank, the first-stage filter box is installed on a filter box shaft, the second-stage filter screen is installed below a filter tank top plate shaft, an electric heating wire is installed at the bottom of the right side of the second-stage filter tank, a cooling water inlet funnel is installed at the upper part of the right side of the second-stage filter tank, and a cooling water outlet is installed at the tail end of a condensing pipe. The system is provided with two sets of automatic filtering devices and one set of distillation device: the user can carry out twice filtration to the waste water through the filter equipment in one-level rose box and the second grade rose box for granule impurity in the waste water can obtain abundant filtration, and the user can carry out distillation operation to the waste water after the twice filtration, harmful substance that remains in the waste water that like this can thoroughly get rid of, makes the waste water after the plastics processing obtain thorough purification, and is very high-efficient.

title_en: Microbial bacteria field planting biological box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a microbial bacteria field planting biological box, which comprises: the device comprises a box body, wherein at least one partition board is arranged in the box body, the box body is divided into at least two chambers by the at least one partition board, and carriers for attaching microorganism bacteria are put in the chambers; the cover body is removably covered on the box body; at least two side hanging pieces, wherein the two side hanging pieces are connected to two opposite side walls of the box body, and the side hanging pieces are used for hanging floating bodies; the bottom hanging piece is arranged on the bottom plate of the box body and is used for hanging the balancing weight; the bottom plate of the box body, the side plates of the box body, the partition plates and the cover body are densely provided with meshes for the microorganism to diffuse out of the cavity. The microbial bacteria field planting biological box provided by the utility model is provided for a microbial bacteria fixed propagation place, and microbial bacteria are attached to a carrier in a cavity for growth and propagation and are diffused into water through meshes, so that the purposes of eliminating anaerobic bacteria, activating collaterals and purifying water are achieved.

title_en: Dust-proof spiral coal separator
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of coal separators, in particular to a dust-proof spiral coal separator. An anti-dust spiral coal separator comprises a coal separation part and a dust prevention part; the coal separation part comprises a spiral groove, a coal inlet pipe, a coal outlet pipe and a guide plate, wherein the coal inlet pipe and the coal outlet pipe are both communicated with the spiral groove, the coal outlet pipe is communicated with the coal outlet groove, the guide plate is rotationally connected with the coal outlet groove, the dustproof part comprises a shell, an air inlet pipe, a screw rod, a sliding block, a connecting piece, a dust collecting bag, a fixing plate and a screw rod, the coal inlet pipe and the coal outlet pipe penetrate through the shell and are connected with the shell, and the air inlet pipe is communicated with the sliding block.

title_en: Commercial kitchen range flue gas waste heat power generation device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a commercial stove smoke waste heat power generation device, wherein an electric pulse igniter is fixed at the left part of the front end of a shell, a controller is fixed at the right part of the front end of the shell, a thermoelectric power generation module is fixed at the rear part of the shell, a reciprocating zigzag heat conduction pipe is fixed at the left part of the shell, the thermoelectric power generation module penetrates through the rear part of the shell, the heat conduction pipe penetrates through the left part of the shell in the vertical direction, a base is fixed at the top end of the shell, and an exhaust fan is fixed at the top end of the base.
