The utility model absorbs the waste heat generated by flame combustion through the left heat pipe and the right heat pipe and transmits the waste heat to the right part of the thermoelectric power generation module, the rotation of the turbofan is realized through the exhaust fan, so that the air cooling heat dissipation of the rear part of the thermoelectric power generation module is realized, the suction of the flue gas with heat is realized, the flue gas with heat is transmitted to the left part of the thermoelectric power generation module through the heat pipe, and the heating of the front part of the thermoelectric power generation module and the air cooling heat dissipation of the rear part of the turbofan can continuously form a temperature difference.

title_en: Asphalt stirring device for producing modified asphalt waterproof coiled material
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an asphalt stirring device for producing a modified asphalt waterproof coiled material, which belongs to the technical field of asphalt stirring devices and comprises a stirring box and a heating inner tank, wherein the heating inner tank is fixed in the stirring box, a feeding valve port communicated with the heating inner tank is arranged at the upper part of one side of the stirring box, a double-shaft stirring mechanism is fixedly connected to the upper side of the stirring box, two ends of the double-shaft stirring mechanism extend into the heating inner tank, and an electromagnetic heating plate is fixedly connected to the outer side wall of the heating inner tank. According to the utility model, the double-shaft stirring mechanism is arranged to drive the two spiral stirring blades to rotate, so that double-shaft stirring processing can be performed on asphalt materials in the heating inner tank, the stirring effect is better, the smoke purification mechanism can purify smoke, the environment-friendly effect is achieved, the anti-blocking mechanism is arranged, the materials in the heating inner tank can be forcedly discharged from the L-shaped discharge valve pipe, the discharging is stable, and the blocking is prevented.

title_en: Quicklime discharging, screening and dedusting system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a quicklime discharging, screening and dedusting system, which comprises a discharging warehouse (2), a screening discharging device (3) and a washing tower (4), wherein the screening discharging device (3) is arranged in the discharging warehouse (2), the screening discharging device (3) comprises a sieve plate (10) arranged on a feeding hole of the discharging warehouse (2), a conveyor (11) arranged below a discharging end of the sieve plate (10) and a discharging hopper (12) arranged at the discharging end of the conveyor (11), and the quicklime discharging, screening and dedusting system has the advantages that: when the quicklime enters the unloading warehouse, the quicklime is screened through the screen plate, so that the quality of the quicklime is improved, dust generated by screening is sequentially purified through the dust remover and the washing tower, the dust emission is reduced, and the working environment in the unloading warehouse is optimized.

title_en: Nuclear power engineering power distribution cabinet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a nuclear power engineering power distribution cabinet, which relates to the field of power distribution cabinets and comprises a box body, wherein an opening structure is arranged at the upper part of the box body, an absorption box is fixed at the inner side of the opening structure, a sponge block is arranged in the absorption box, an inner separation net is slidably arranged at one side of the sponge block, a frame is fixedly connected with one side of the absorption box, a driving structure is fixed on the frame and used for pushing the inner separation net to slide towards the sponge block, an absorption liquid box is arranged at the top end of the box body and connected with the sponge block in the absorption box through a pipeline, an electric control stop valve is arranged at the middle section of the pipeline, and a liquid discharge pipeline is connected at the bottom end of the absorption box. According to the utility model, through arranging the box body structure with the built-in sponge and push plate structure, the top end and the bottom end of the box body structure are respectively connected with the solution box body structure outside the box body, and the anti-fouling salt spray adsorption assembly is not required to be frequently detached and replaced, so that a long-acting and convenient low-salt spray environment in the position distribution box is realized.

title_en: Deodorization formula fertilizer drying-machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of organic fertilizer processing, in particular to a deodorizing organic fertilizer dryer. The technical proposal comprises: the device comprises a box body, a treatment box and an adjusting plate, wherein one side of the box body is fixedly connected with the heating box, a heating plate is fixedly installed inside the heating box, a first fan is fixedly connected inside the box body, the adjusting plate is installed inside the box body on one side of the first fan through an electric guide rail, supporting columns are movably connected on two sides of the top of the adjusting plate, a placement plate is fixedly installed between the supporting columns, a hollow limiting shell is fixedly connected on the top of the placement plate, the treatment box is fixedly installed on the top of the box body, a ventilation pipe is installed between two sides of the treatment box and the box body, and an activated carbon adsorption block is movably installed inside the treatment box. The device can efficiently and rapidly perform drying and material loading and unloading work through the combination of various structures, and has a deodorizing structure, so that the device is convenient for personnel to use.

title_en: Dust remover for tail gas treatment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dust remover for tail gas treatment, which comprises a cabinet body, wherein an aeration cavity is formed in the inner wall of one side of the cabinet body, a plurality of aeration pipes are uniformly fixed at the bottom of the aeration cavity, a plurality of aeration heads are uniformly fixed at the tops of the aeration pipes, limiting blocks are respectively fixed on the side walls of the two sides of the top end of the aeration cavity, adsorption plates are jointly arranged at the tops of the two limiting blocks, a working cavity is formed in the cabinet body, which is far away from one side of the aeration cavity, a sealing isolation plate is fixed between the working cavity and the aeration cavity, a storage battery is fixed at the bottom of the working cavity, a pumping fan is fixed at the top of the storage battery, and electric energy is supplied to the pumping fan through the storage battery, so that tail gas is collected through the pumping fan and conveyed into the aeration cavity, aeration operation is performed on the tail gas through the aeration pipes and the aeration heads in the aeration cavity, sundries in the tail gas are adsorbed through the adsorption plates, and primary treatment operation on the tail gas is completed.

title_en: Compression heat zero gas consumption drying system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a compression heat zero gas consumption drying system, which belongs to the technical field of gas treatment equipment, and comprises a first drying tower and a second drying tower, wherein a second connecting pipe is communicated with the air inlet end of the first drying tower, a third connecting pipe is communicated with one end of the second connecting pipe, an eighth connecting pipe is communicated with the third connecting pipe, a fourth connecting pipe is communicated with one end of the third connecting pipe, and one end of the fourth connecting pipe is communicated with the second drying tower; the heat generated by compression heat is directly used for regenerating the first drying tower, the regeneration energy is insufficient, a small amount of finished gas is estimated to be subjected to secondary heating regeneration on the second drying tower after being heated by electric heating, so that the residual water content of the adsorbent is reduced, and the part of regenerated gas is directly cooled and separated and then returned to the previous stage of compressor, so that the loss of process gas is avoided.

title_en: Ultrasonic metering device convenient to equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ultrasonic metering device convenient to assemble, which comprises an ultrasonic metering gas meter, wherein a mounting seat and a gas outlet pipe are respectively arranged on two sides of the top end of the ultrasonic metering gas meter, a gas inlet pipe is arranged on the top end of the mounting seat, and a connecting block is arranged on the top end of the gas inlet pipe. According to the utility model, the positioning block is clamped with the positioning groove to position and fix the external pipeline, the gas inlet pipe and the connecting block, the top of the rotating button is higher than the connecting block after the installation, and then the rotating button is rotated for ninety degrees to complete the rapid butt joint installation operation of the pipelines, and simultaneously the anti-slip performance of the rotating button is improved under the action of the anti-slip teeth so as to prevent the pipeline from falling off, and the sealing performance of the connecting part is enhanced through the mutual matching of the sealing ring and the groove.

title_en: A filter collection device for indoor environment detects
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of air detection, in particular to a filtering and collecting device for indoor environment detection, which comprises an air detector main body, wherein an air suction mechanism is arranged on the inner side of the air detector main body, one end of the air suction mechanism is communicated with an air inlet pipe, a filtering ring is sleeved at the upper position outside the air inlet pipe, the top end of the filtering ring is fixedly connected with a fixed table, the top of the fixed table is provided with a driving mechanism, the outer side of one end of the driving mechanism is provided with a connecting assembly, the end part of the connecting assembly is fixedly connected with a mounting plate, one side surface of the mounting plate, which is close to the filtering ring, is fixedly connected with a bristle rubbing plate, and the bristle rubbing plate is attached to the outer surface of the filtering ring.

title_en: Oil mist separation filter
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an oil mist separation filter, which comprises a shell and a filter assembly, wherein the left side of the inside of the shell is provided with the filter assembly, and the right side of the inside of the shell is fixedly provided with a gas-liquid separation filter element; the filter component comprises a baffle, the front fixed mounting of baffle has the fixed plate, the equal fixed mounting in top and bottom of fixed plate left and right sides has the fixture block, embedded groove and four draw-in grooves have been seted up in the front of shell, four the draw-in groove is located the left and right sides of embedded groove, fixed plate and embedded groove looks joint, fixture block and draw-in groove looks joint, the equal fixed mounting of interior roof and interior diapire of shell has second limiting plate and first limiting plate, the upper and lower both ends of baffle are blocked respectively between two second limiting plates and first limiting plate. According to the oil mist separating filter, most oil mist is blocked by the V-shaped plate on the baffle plate, so that the purpose of preventing the filter element from being blocked is achieved.

title_en: Bury formula water treatment pond and intelligent water treatment system
abstract_en: The utility model is applicable to the field of sewage treatment, and provides a buried water treatment tank and an intelligent water treatment system, wherein the water treatment tank comprises a tank body, a filter element, a slag discharging mechanism, a liquid pumping mechanism and a filter element lifting mechanism; the tank body is used for accommodating sewage and is used as a place where the sewage reacts with the water treatment agent; the filter element is arranged in the tank body; the slag discharging mechanism comprises a slag discharging pipe with one end communicated with the bottom of the tank body; the liquid pumping mechanism comprises a liquid pump and a water pumping pipe connected with the liquid pump; the water diversion channel is used for guiding water to be treated into the tank body, and the water diversion channel is arranged in the following way; mode one: the water diversion channel is a water diversion channel, and an outlet of the water diversion channel is communicated with the tank body; mode two: the water diversion channel is a liquid inlet pipe, and a liquid inlet valve is arranged on a liquid supply pipeline of the liquid inlet pipe; the device has the advantages of high automation degree, high water treatment efficiency and lower installation, transportation and manufacturing costs.

title_en: Dust filter for biomass fuel processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dust filter for biomass fuel processing, which relates to the technical field of dust filters and adopts the technical scheme that: the dust filter comprises a base, base top fixed mounting curb plate, the curb plate sets up to the U-shaped, curb plate bilateral symmetry is provided with two, two rotate between the curb plate and connect dust filtration subassembly, dust filtration subassembly includes the pivot, rotate through the bearing between pivot outer wall and the curb plate inner wall and be connected, pivot outer wall fixed mounting cartridge filter, the cartridge filter includes plectane, arc one, arc two, and the utility model is through setting up servo motor drive cartridge filter rotation to jolt biomass fuel inside the cartridge filter through rotating, thereby conveniently make the dust derive from logical groove, filter screen fast, thereby conveniently absorb the dust fast through the dust catcher, improved work efficiency.

title_en: Sewage treatment agent spraying machine for sewage treatment
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of sewage treatment, and particularly relates to a sewage treatment agent spraying machine for sewage treatment, which comprises a fixed box, wherein a movable rod is movably arranged at the top of the fixed box, an installation pipe is fixedly arranged at the top end of the movable rod, a spray head is fixedly arranged on one side of the surface of the installation pipe, a buoyancy cylinder is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the movable rod, a U-shaped plate is fixedly arranged at the top of the inner wall of the fixed box, and the movable rod is movably connected with the U-shaped plate. Because the existence of buoyancy section of thick bamboo, when the inside existence of fixed incasement is full, can make mounting tube and shower nozzle be in the highest point, and after the liquid of starting the water pump with the inside of fixed case is taken out, buoyancy section of thick bamboo can descend gradually along with the liquid level to make the mounting tube slowly descend, just so can realize that the sewage treatment agent that the shower nozzle sprayed from far and near spray in the sedimentation tank on the liquid level of sewage, in order to guarantee that sewage treatment agent can be even spill in the sewage in the sedimentation tank, increased the practicality of device.

title_en: Device for automatically adjusting turbidity of circulating water system of gas cooler
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of converter gas dehydration, and particularly discloses a device for automatically adjusting turbidity of a circulating water system of a gas cooler, which comprises the gas cooler, a cooling tower and a clarifier, wherein the upper part of the gas cooler is provided with a cooling water port, the cooling water port is connected with a cold water tank through a circulating pipeline, a water quality turbidity meter is arranged in the cold water tank, the cold water tank is connected with a cold water outlet of the cooling tower through a circulating pipeline, the lower part of the gas cooler is provided with a hot water outlet, the hot water outlet is connected with a shallow sand filter and the clarifier through a circulating pipeline, the clarifier is provided with a dosing mechanism, a water quality clarifier is quantitatively added into the clarifier, and the clarifier is connected with a hot water inlet of the cooling tower; the utility model realizes automatic dosing and water quality adjustment, does not need manual operation, and is simple and convenient in later maintenance; the operation is simple, safe and reliable, and redundant maintenance operation is not needed; the water quality is regulated and controlled, and the flexible control of the turbidity of the water quality is realized through the control of the dosage according to the actual situation.

title_en: Absorption tower of high concentration formaldehyde solution
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of formaldehyde, in particular to an absorption tower of high-concentration formaldehyde solution, which aims at solving the problems of poor stability and small supporting surface in the prior art, and provides a scheme that the absorption tower comprises the high-concentration formaldehyde solution absorption tower, wherein a bottom box is bolted to the bottom of the high-concentration formaldehyde solution absorption tower; the pinion is all rotated on both sides on the inside top of base box, the bottom bolt of pinion has the main bevel gear, the tooth meshing of main bevel gear has vice bevel gear, the axle center department bolt of vice bevel gear side has the worm, maintenance personnel step on the handrail ladder and maintain high concentration formaldehyde solution absorption tower top, support stability through the steady rest to high concentration formaldehyde solution absorption tower, strengthen high concentration formaldehyde solution absorption tower's stability, meet bad weather or when high concentration formaldehyde solution absorption tower focus is unstable, handrail ladder counter-rotating falls to the ground, support high concentration formaldehyde solution absorption tower, strengthen stability.

title_en: Integrated magnetic coagulation sedimentation water treatment equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses integrated magnetic coagulation sedimentation water treatment equipment, which comprises a box body, wherein a coagulation tank, a loading tank, a flocculation tank, a sedimentation tank, a sludge tank, an equipment room and a dosing room are arranged in the box body; the coagulation tank, the loading tank, the flocculation tank and the sedimentation tank are connected through water holes in the tank body; a magnetic medium reflux pump, a magnetic medium mud pump, flocculation tank dosing equipment and coagulant aid dosing equipment are arranged in the dosing chamber; the upper part of the box body is provided with a flocculation removing machine and a magnetic medium separator corresponding to the sedimentation tank. This integrated magnetism coagulating sedimentation water treatment equipment structural design is reasonable, and inside integrating the integration box with each process unit, through the setting of integration box, compact structure, transportation, emergent use of being more convenient for have avoided the long period work progress of civil engineering, integrate integrated magnetism coagulating sedimentation water treatment equipment box with sludge dewatering system inside simultaneously, make water treatment and sludge treatment effectively combine.

title_en: Sludge dewatering equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses sludge dewatering equipment which comprises a dewatering box, wherein a first supporting seat is fixedly connected to the middle position of the left side of the bottom of the dewatering box, a material conveying opening is formed in the inner wall of the right side of the dewatering box in a penetrating mode, a drying box is fixedly connected to the right side of the dewatering box, and a discharging pipe is formed in the middle position of the left side of the top of the dewatering box in a penetrating mode. According to the utility model, when the sludge enters the dewatering box, due to the transmission of the spiral transmission sheet, the moisture on the sludge falls on the filter plate under the action of centrifugal force and falls into the water outlet pipe below, the water in the sludge is discharged through the water outlet pipe, and when the spiral transmission sheet falls into the inner box through the material conveying port, the sludge can be stirred by the stirring blade, meanwhile, the moisture in the sludge can be quickly dried by the heating plate, the stirring blade is called as sludge decomposition into small blocks, and the sludge can be conveniently carried after the moisture in the sludge is completely dewatered.

title_en: Boiler waste heat recovery structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a boiler waste heat recovery structure in the technical field of waste heat recovery, which comprises a boiler body and an air outlet, wherein one side of the boiler body is provided with the air outlet, one end of the air outlet is provided with a filter box, the filter box and the air outlet are fixed through penetration, the inner side of the filter box is provided with an insulating layer, the inside of the filter box is provided with a filter screen, the filter screen is detachably connected with the filter box, the filter screen is provided with two, the bottom of the filter box is provided with a storage groove, the storage groove is fixedly connected with the filter box, the inside of the storage groove is provided with an electric door, the electric door is in sliding connection with the storage groove, the inside of the storage groove is provided with an electric telescopic rod, and the output end of the electric telescopic rod is fixedly connected with the electric door; through the heat preservation that is equipped with, realized the heat preservation function to the flue gas, reduced thermal heat dissipation, through the electric heater that is equipped with, realized reheating the flue gas to the effectual speed that improves water heating.

title_en: Bellows filter
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a bellows filter, which belongs to the technical field of filters, and comprises a bellows box body, wherein an air supply cavity is provided with an air supply inlet and an air supply outlet, an air exhaust cavity is provided with an air exhaust inlet and an air exhaust outlet, an air supply cavity is internally provided with a paint mist felt filter plate for adsorbing paint particles, a first dust filter and a second dust filter for adsorbing dust, a cooling device and an air supply device, the air supply device is communicated with the air supply outlet, and the air exhaust cavity is internally provided with the air exhaust device which is communicated with the air exhaust outlet.

title_en: Vertical modularized domestic sewage treatment system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a vertical modularized domestic sewage treatment system, which belongs to the field of medium and small-scale emission source sewage treatment equipment, and comprises an anaerobic zone, an anoxic zone, an aerobic carbonization zone, an aerobic nitrification zone and a high-efficiency sedimentation zone, wherein the anaerobic zone is communicated with the anoxic zone, the anoxic zone is communicated with the aerobic carbonization zone, the aerobic carbonization zone is communicated with the aerobic nitrification zone, the aerobic nitrification zone is communicated with the high-efficiency sedimentation zone, a pre-oxygen elimination zone is arranged in the anaerobic zone, the pre-oxygen elimination zone is communicated with the middle part of the anaerobic zone, a water inlet is arranged on one side of the anaerobic zone, the water inlet is connected with the pre-oxygen elimination zone, a water outlet is arranged on one side of the high-efficiency sedimentation zone, an air inlet header pipe is arranged above the anaerobic zone, the anoxic zone, the aerobic carbonization zone, the aerobic nitrification zone and the high-efficiency sedimentation zone, and the air inlet header pipe is connected with an external blower, and the anaerobic zone, the anoxic zone, the aerobic carbonization zone, the aerobic nitrification zone and the high-efficiency sedimentation zone are all arranged into cylindrical tanks. The utility model has high impact load resistance, strong process stability and high total nitrogen removal rate.

title_en: Manual loading device for thermoluminescent dosage box
abstract_en: The utility model mainly relates to the field of ionizing radiation, in particular to a novel manual loading device for a thermoluminescent dosage box, which comprises a main structure and a pulling rod piece, wherein a fixing position for fixing the novel thermoluminescent dosage box is arranged on the base, the fixing position is an L-shaped groove, the L-shaped groove is arranged on the base, one end of the L-shaped groove is an entrance and an exit, the other end of the L-shaped groove is a loading opening, the width of the entrance and the exit of the L-shaped groove is matched with the width of the thermoluminescent dosage box, and the width of the loading groove of the L-shaped groove is matched with the width of an inner shell of the thermoluminescent dosage box. The utility model has the beneficial effects that: the thermal light-emitting dosage box can be easily pulled through the pulling rod piece, the process that a worker pulls through tweezers is avoided, the worker is assisted in the loading process of the thermal light-emitting dosage piece, the labor burden of the worker is reduced, and the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Multifunctional photovoltaic inversion charging integrated cabinet
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of electrical equipment, and particularly relates to a multifunctional photovoltaic inversion charging integrated cabinet, which comprises an inversion charging integrated cabinet, wherein a heat dissipation fan is fixedly arranged at the inner lower part of the inversion charging integrated cabinet, a cooling component is fixedly arranged at the inner lower part of the inversion charging integrated cabinet, the cooling component is positioned above the heat dissipation fan, a cabinet door is movably arranged at the upper part of the front end of the inversion charging integrated cabinet through a hinge, heat dissipation windows are detachably arranged at the upper parts of the left end and the right end of the inversion charging integrated cabinet, the two heat dissipation windows are symmetrically arranged, and protective baffles are fixedly welded at the left end and the right end of the inversion charging integrated cabinet. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the drying agent layer, the air entering the inversion and charging integrated cabinet can be dried, the humid air is prevented from entering the inversion and charging integrated cabinet while the temperature is reduced, the air flow rate in the inversion and charging integrated cabinet is accelerated through the cooling fan, the temperature in the inversion and charging integrated cabinet is reduced through the cold water pipe, the heat dissipation effect is improved, and the practicability is strong.

title_en: Garbage collector with peculiar smell removing function for constructional engineering
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a garbage collector with an peculiar smell removing function for constructional engineering, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the top of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a collecting box, the left side of the collecting box is fixedly connected with a feeding box, the top of the feeding box is fixedly connected with a first motor, the output end of the first motor extends to the inner cavity of the feeding box through a bearing and is fixedly connected with a rotating rod, and the surface of the rotating rod is fixedly connected with a spiral blade. According to the utility model, through the matched use of the bottom plate, the collecting box, the feeding box, the first motor, the rotating rod, the spiral blade, the feeding bin, the placing plate, the filter box, the suction fan, the gas collecting pipe, the fixing plate, the active carbon filter screen, the gas outlet pipe, the fixing block and the fastening piece, the odor removing device has the advantage of removing the odor, and can effectively solve the problems that the existing garbage collector for the construction engineering does not have the function of removing the odor, is easy to pollute the environment and cannot meet the use requirement.

title_en: Centrifugal turbine type acetylene compressor unit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a centrifugal turbine type acetylene compressor unit which comprises a compressor, an intercooler and a aftercooler, wherein the front end and the rear end of the compressor are respectively connected with an air inlet pipe and an air outlet pipe, the air inlet pipe and the air outlet pipe are respectively connected with a front pipeline flame arrester and a rear pipeline flame arrester, one ends of the front pipeline flame arrester and the rear pipeline flame arrester, which are far away from the compressor, are respectively connected with a fire extinguishing pipe, an automatic control quick-opening valve is arranged on the fire extinguishing pipe, a pressure meter I and a temperature meter I are connected onto the air inlet pipe, a pressure meter II and a temperature meter II are connected onto the air outlet pipe, the front pipeline flame arrester is also connected with an acetylene gas pipe, the aftercooler is connected with the rear pipeline flame arrester through a pipeline, and the compressor is connected with the intercooler through a pipeline. The safety performance of the compressor unit is improved through the flame arrester and the fire extinguishing pipe.

title_en: Dustbin and rubbish compressing mechanism thereof
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of garbage recovery, in particular to a garbage can and a garbage compression mechanism thereof. A garbage compression mechanism comprises a driving assembly and a pressing plate assembly connected to the output end of the driving assembly; the method is characterized in that: the pressing plate assembly comprises a top cover and a bottom plate; the top cover comprises a top plate and a coaming plate arranged along the edge of the lower end face of the top plate in a surrounding manner; the outside edge of bottom plate is connected in the bounding wall, and the shaping has many press bars of downwardly protruding on the bottom plate, is formed with the recess between two adjacent press bars, and the notch of recess both sides extends to on the bounding wall. The garbage compression mechanism simplifies the structure of the pressing plate assembly and ensures the compression effect.

title_en: Unitized combined rural household sewage treatment equipment
abstract_en: The application provides unitized combined rural household sewage treatment equipment. Comprising the following steps: the box body is provided with an adjusting unit, a water distribution unit, a treatment unit and a drainage unit which are arranged in the box body; an overflow plate is arranged in the adjusting unit to divide the adjusting unit into an adjusting grid and a water collecting grid positioned outside the adjusting grid, and combined packing is arranged in the adjusting grid; the water distribution unit is communicated with the downstream of the water collecting grid and is used for uniformly distributing sewage in the water collecting grid to the treatment unit; the treatment unit is communicated with the downstream of the water distribution unit, and is detachably and sequentially provided with at least three sewage treatment modules along the sewage flow direction so as to replace and increase and decrease the at least three sewage treatment modules; the drainage unit is used for draining the treated sewage out of the box body. The unitized combined rural household sewage treatment equipment is suitable for the treatment requirements of rural distributed small water quantity, and improves the treatment rate and the treatment effect of rural sewage according to different water quality treatments.

title_en: Gas purifying device of box-type moving bed
abstract_en: The utility model provides a gas purifying device of a box-type moving bed, and relates to the technical field of gas purifying equipment. The purifying device comprises a base, a purifying mechanism and a purifying material replacing mechanism, wherein the purifying mechanism comprises a purifying material filling layer. The purification material replacement mechanism comprises a first replacement mechanism and a second replacement mechanism which are respectively arranged at two axial ends of the purification mechanism, and the first replacement mechanism and the second replacement mechanism comprise a sealing door, a sealing door supporting piece and a first sliding fit part, and the sealing door supporting piece are connected through the first sliding fit part. The cavity containing the purification material in the cylinder body is sealed by the sealing door, and the gas to be treated enters the cylinder body and is discharged after being adsorbed layer by layer, so that the multistage adsorption of the organic waste gas is realized. After the purification material of bottom adsorbs the saturation, can open the sealing door through sealing door support piece and first sliding fit portion, cooperation purification material replacement mechanism takes out old purification material, puts into new purification material, has realized the dynamic fluidized bed absorption of harmful gas, improves purification efficiency.

title_en: Wharf dry powder gun fire extinguishing device with remote display function
abstract_en: The utility model provides a wharf dry powder gun fire extinguishing device with remote display, which comprises: a frame, a dry powder gun body; analog signals are respectively acquired through the first pressure transmitter and the second pressure transmitter, and in a programmable module of a fire water monitor control cabinet, the signals are connected to a duty room communication module through a network cable and then are transmitted back to a central control building optical fiber transceiver through an optical fiber, and finally the signals are connected to an integrated touch screen of the fire control room, so that the pressure function in a real-time monitoring tank is achieved, the problem that the use is influenced due to overlarge pressure in a dry powder monitor body and the death of a valve is effectively prevented, 4 electric contact pressures can be remotely displayed in real time through the integrated touch screen, functions of microcomputer monitoring operation log browsing, historical alarm log checking and the like are realized, and an alarm automatic pop-up function is designed on a touch screen picture, so that reliable safety guarantee is provided for safe production and stable operation of a wharf.

title_en: VOCs tail gas treatment device with filtering capability
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a VOCs tail gas treatment device with a filtering function, which relates to an exhaust or silencing device and belongs to the technical field of purified and nontoxic or other exhaust treatment devices. This VOCs tail gas processing apparatus with filtering capability, including blast pipe and filtration storehouse, the blast pipe sets up in the left and right sides in filtration storehouse, and filtration storehouse's inside sets up to the cavity, and the blast pipe is close to the inside that the filtration storehouse was stretched into to filtration storehouse's one end, and the logical groove has been seted up to filtration storehouse's upper surface, leads to the groove to extend into filtration storehouse's inside, and the inner wall sliding connection who leads to the groove has the active carbon filter, through above-mentioned structure, can effectively make when active carbon filter needs to change for a long time, the staff need not to borrow professional instrument can accomplish the change to active carbon filter, also because the dismantlement and the installation of the device are all comparatively convenient simultaneously, so also very big promotion the efficiency that the active carbon filter was changed to the staff has reduced staff's working strength.

title_en: Vacuum pumping device of reduction furnace
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vacuum pumping device of a reduction furnace, which comprises a water tank, wherein the inner bottom surface of the water tank is fixedly connected with a water pump, the output end of the water pump is fixedly connected with a water pump pipe, one end of the water pump pipe, which is far away from the water pump, is fixedly connected with a connecting pipe, and one end of the connecting pipe, which is far away from the water pump pipe, is provided with a rotary sprinkler head; the air inlet pipe is provided with a pipeline groove in the air inlet pipe, an air distribution pipe is embedded in the pipeline groove, and an air suction nozzle is fixedly connected to the surface of the air distribution pipe. Through the structure, the aspiration pump is used for exhausting gas in the reduction furnace through the air inlet pipe, the gas distribution pipe is used for absorbing the gas in the air inlet pipe through the air suction nozzle, the air exhaust efficiency is effectively increased, the sucked gas is then sprayed out into the air exhaust tank around the periphery of the air exhaust tank through the annular pipe and the air outlet pipe, the rotating sprinkler head is used for spraying water in a rotating manner, the contact area between water and the gas is increased, the gas flows downwards upwards, and the water and the gas are fully and comprehensively reacted, so that the whole working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Dust removing mechanism of polishing machine
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of dust removal of polishing machines, in particular to a dust removal mechanism of a polishing machine, which aims at solving the problems that in the prior art, when the dust removal mechanism is actually used, sundries such as particles still exist in settled air, and the particles are accumulated for a long time to cause the blockage of a filter plate, so that the effect of the filter plate on air filtration is affected and inconvenient use is caused.

title_en: Rotary evaporator with protective structure
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of medical appliances, in particular to a rotary evaporator with a protective structure, which comprises a workbench and a rotary evaporator main body, wherein a heating mechanism is arranged on the workbench, the heating mechanism comprises a heating pot, the surface of the workbench is provided with the heating pot, the upper end of the heating pot is provided with a first annular groove, and the interior of the first annular groove is provided with a protective cover; according to the utility model, through the structural design of the heating mechanism, splash generated by boiling of the water body can be isolated through the mutual matching of the protective cover and the first annular groove, so that the device is safer when in operation, the water vapor and the gas can be dried through the mutual matching of the miniature air pump and the moisture absorption cotton, and the water vapor can be collected, so that the discharged gas is in a dry state.

title_en: Novel titanium alloy chimney anticorrosion structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel titanium alloy chimney anticorrosion structure, which relates to the technical field of chimney anticorrosion and comprises a top cover, wherein a groove is formed in the middle of the top cover, an acid-resistant coating is coated on the inner wall and the outer wall of the groove, a first chimney body is arranged below the groove, a second chimney body is arranged below the first chimney body, the first chimney body and the second chimney body are embedded into a whole through a fixing part, the fixing part comprises a fixing base plate, the fixing base plate is positioned at the bottom of the first chimney body, the fixing base plate is fixedly connected with the first chimney body through a titanium alloy bolt, a hollow screw rod is arranged at the bottom of the fixing base plate, an external thread is arranged on the outer wall of the hollow screw rod, and the acid-resistant coating is coated on the external thread. According to the utility model, the fixing part is used for ensuring that the chimney and the primer and the ceramic shaft layer in the chimney are fixedly connected, so that the fixing defect of the traditional expansion screw is avoided, the normal longitudinal and transverse stress of the chimney can not cause the looseness of the two chimneys, and the tightness is ensured.

title_en: Mutual-reflection and mutual-transmission common-light-source low-power-consumption double-sided display module
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mutually-reflective and mutually-transparent common-light-source low-power-consumption double-sided display module, which relates to the field of double-sided display modules and comprises a protective shell, wherein a front screen display group is arranged on the outer surface of the front end of the protective shell. According to the mutually-inverse and mutually-transparent common-light-source low-power-consumption double-sided display module, the arranged micro fan can help to dissipate heat of the front screen display group and the rear screen display group, power consumption can be reduced, a dampproof cotton layer can play a dampproof role, a dustproof cotton layer in the dampproof cotton layer can play a dustproof role, a hanging pipe can play a role in fixedly mounting a protective shell through the fixing perforation on the extension rod, the extension rod can be prolonged through the connecting threads when in use, the fixing installation is convenient, the hanging and fixing are convenient through the fixing perforation, a wire fixing plate can dredge a circuit connected with the front screen display group and the rear screen display group through the wire groove, the circuit can be clamped and fixed through the clamping adhesive layer, and damage to the circuit can be avoided.

title_en: Dust removing device for dry-mixed mortar transport vehicle
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of dry-mixed mortar and discloses a dust removing device for a dry-mixed mortar transport vehicle, which comprises a cylinder body, wherein a lower seal head is detachably arranged at the lower part of the cylinder body, a first mounting ring is arranged at the bottom end of the cylinder body, a second mounting ring is arranged at the top end of the lower seal head, and the first mounting ring and the second mounting ring are detachably connected through a plurality of groups of fixing components; the fixing assembly comprises a fixing rod, a limiting block arranged at the top end of the fixing rod, a first elastic sheet and a second elastic sheet which are arranged at the bottom end of the fixing rod, and mounting holes for the fixing rod to pass through are formed in the first mounting ring and the second mounting ring, and the width of each mounting hole is smaller than that of the limiting block; the bottom of the first elastic piece is rotationally connected with a first mounting piece, the bottom of the second elastic piece is rotationally connected with a second mounting piece, anti-falling holes are formed in the first mounting piece and the second mounting piece, and an anti-falling rod matched with the anti-falling holes in a clamping mode is arranged on the bottom surface of the second mounting ring. This application has the effect of making things convenient for the fixed subassembly of one-hand dismouting.

title_en: Dust collector of smelting furnace
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dust removing device of a smelting furnace, which relates to the technical field of smelting furnaces and comprises a spray box and a dust removing box, wherein an air inlet pipe is fixedly arranged on the upper wall surface of the spray box, and the upper end of the air inlet pipe penetrates through the upper wall surface of the spray box.

title_en: Cold drier
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a cold dryer, which comprises a recovery processing mechanism, a cold dryer body and a material chamber, wherein the cold dryer body is arranged in the cold dryer body, and the material chamber is arranged at the other side of the recovery processing mechanism; when the material is required to be dried in the actual production and use process, the material can be placed in the material chamber, then the cold dryer body is operated, cold air generated by the cold dryer body is blown into the material chamber through the cold dryer chamber and is dried in a cold way, meanwhile, the guide piece guides cold air after being dried into the shell through an air inlet on the shell, impurities in the cold air are treated through the filter assembly and the adsorption assembly, then the treated cold air enters the cold dryer chamber through an air outlet, and the cold dryer body is recycled, so that the energy consumption is reduced, and pollution to the air caused by scattered and overflowed impurities during the cold drying of the material is avoided.

title_en: A device for smashing maize straw
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device for crushing corn stalks, which comprises a device main body, a feeding frame, a cutting knife, a first crushing roller and a second crushing roller, wherein the first crushing roller is rotatably arranged in the device main body, equidistant first crushing knives are fixed on the outer wall of the first crushing roller, the second crushing roller is rotatably arranged in the device main body on one side of the first crushing roller, equidistant second crushing knives are fixed on the outer wall of the second crushing roller, the cutting knife is arranged in the device main body above the first crushing roller and the first crushing knife, a dust removal box is arranged on one side of the top end of the device main body, the feeding frame is arranged on one side of the device main body, and a feeding conveyor belt is arranged on the top of the feeding frame. The utility model not only ensures that the crushing is more thorough, the crushing efficiency is high, the automatic feeding function is realized, the feeding is smoother, the dust removing function is realized, and the pollution to the processing environment is reduced.

title_en: Sterile wet towel sterilizing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of sterile wet towel production, in particular to a sterile wet towel sterilizing device which can lead liquid medicine into water uniformly by arranging the device, thereby improving the stirring and mixing effects of the liquid medicine; including agitator tank, gear motor, the (mixing) shaft, multiunit stirring leaf and annotate liquid mechanism, gear motor installs on the agitator tank top, agitator tank top right part intercommunication is provided with the manhole, the (mixing) shaft is located the agitator tank inside, the (mixing) shaft top passes agitator tank top and gear motor output shaft, be provided with on the agitator tank and annotate liquid mechanism, annotate liquid mechanism and be connected with the (mixing) shaft, annotate liquid mechanism includes the medical kit, the constant delivery pump, first catheter, two sets of bracing pieces, the annular piece, commentaries on classics piece and second catheter, the bottom of medical kit and constant delivery pump all is connected with agitator tank top left side, second catheter bottom intercommunication is provided with multiunit third catheter, all be provided with multiunit shower nozzle on every group third catheter.

title_en: High concentration fluoride ion waste water treatment device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-concentration fluoride ion wastewater treatment device which comprises an adjusting tank, a first flocculation tank, a first sedimentation tank, a second flocculation tank, a second sedimentation tank, an MBR membrane tank, a temporary storage tank, an active alumina filter, a sludge treatment assembly and a PH adjusting assembly, wherein the adjusting tank is connected with the first flocculation tank through a first conveying assembly, the first flocculation tank, the first sedimentation tank, the second flocculation tank, the second sedimentation tank, the MBR membrane tank and the temporary storage tank are sequentially connected, the temporary storage tank is connected with the input end of the active alumina filter through a high-pressure pump, the output end of the active alumina filter is provided with a drain pipe, the first sedimentation tank and the second sedimentation tank are respectively provided with the PH adjusting assembly, the first sedimentation tank and the second sedimentation tank are respectively provided with the second conveying assembly, and the output end of the second conveying assembly is connected with the sludge treatment assembly. The water treated by the device reaches the discharge standard.

title_en: Heat accumulating type oxidation furnace with anti-blocking function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a heat accumulating type oxidation furnace with an anti-blocking function, which comprises a bottom plate, a heat accumulating oxidation furnace body, a fan and a connecting pipe, wherein an anti-blocking structure is fixedly arranged at the bottom of a chimney, an adjusting structure is fixedly connected to the bottom of the inner wall of a shell, a fixed disc is fixedly connected to the bottom of the surface of the chimney, mounting mechanisms are arranged on the front surface and the back surface of the fixed disc, and collecting assemblies are arranged on the front surface and the back surface of the anti-blocking structure. According to the utility model, the installation mechanism is arranged, so that the installation mechanism can be used for installing the collecting assembly, the collecting assembly can be used for conveniently collecting smoke dust cleaned by the anti-blocking structure, the smoke dust can be prevented from being scattered on the bottom plate, the dust can be conveniently collected, the problem that the dust cleaned by dredging and scattering can be scattered on the bottom plate when the regenerative oxidation furnace is used, the integral attractiveness of equipment is affected, and dust caking is accumulated on the bottom plate due to the fact that the dust is not cleaned timely is solved, so that the collecting and cleaning are difficult is solved.

title_en: Ship ballast water treatment device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a ship ballast water treatment device which comprises a treatment box, a filter assembly, a stirring assembly, a disinfectant adding assembly and a water guide valve, wherein the filter box is arranged above the treatment box through a bracket, the filter assembly is arranged in the filter box, the stirring assembly is arranged in the treatment box, the disinfectant adding assembly is arranged on one side of the treatment box, the water guide valve is communicated between the treatment box and the filter box, and the filter assembly comprises a filter screen inclined plate, a pollution discharge cavity, a telescopic spring, a first filter plate and a second filter plate. The utility model relates to the field of ballast water treatment equipment, in particular to a ship ballast water treatment device which is convenient to clean and high in disinfection efficiency.

title_en: Multifunctional electromechanical integrated fire door
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional electromechanical integrated fire door, which relates to the technical field of fire doors and comprises a fire-proof fire door, wherein the top of the fire-proof fire door is fixedly connected with a starting mechanism, one side below the fire-proof fire door is provided with an induction mechanism, the bottom of the fire-proof fire door is internally provided with a fire extinguishing mechanism, and the bottom of the fire-proof fire door is provided with a fire-proof channel. According to the utility model, the fire extinguishing mechanism can be controlled to be opened when a fire disaster is detected through the sensing mechanism, the fire door is controlled to be automatically closed, the fire door does not need to be manually closed, the fire door can be automatically closed when the fire disaster happens, the fire door is more intelligent and safer, the fire door can be put down and pulled up through the starting mechanism, the fire extinguishing effect can be achieved on two sides of the fire door through the fire extinguishing mechanism without manpower, after the consumption of the fire extinguishing agent of a single fire extinguisher is completed, the next fire extinguisher is rotated to be replaced to continuously spray the fire extinguishing agent for fire extinguishment, the fire extinguishment is more durable, the efficiency is higher, and the fire extinguishing mechanism has a better self-extinguishing function.

title_en: Colliery ventilation appurtenance
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a coal mine ventilation auxiliary tool, and relates to the technical field of ventilation auxiliary tools. The utility model comprises a main pipeline, a rotating rod, a limiting mechanism and a sealing mechanism, wherein the two ends of the main pipeline are respectively provided with a connecting mechanism, the connecting mechanisms are used for connecting the two ends of the main pipeline with a ventilating pipeline, a suction fan is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the main pipeline, a filter plate is arranged in the main pipeline, the limiting mechanism is used for limiting the position of the filter plate in the main pipeline, and a connecting ring is fixedly inserted into the inner wall of the main pipeline. When the air humidifier is used, a user connects two ends of the main pipeline with one ends of the two ventilation pipelines through the connecting mechanism, drives the fan to rotate, blows outside air to the inner wall of the ventilation pipelines, passes through the heating pipe after being filtered by the filter plate, and finally passes through the humidifying ring, and at the moment, the user can humidify the air through the atomizing nozzle.

title_en: Waste gas treatment device for recycling high-temperature waste gas
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of waste gas treatment and discloses a waste gas treatment device for recycling high-temperature waste gas, which comprises a water storage tank, a water inlet pipe, a water outlet pipe, a purification assembly, a fixing device, a high-temperature waste gas utilization mechanism, a water inlet pipe arranged at the top of the water storage tank with a displacement structure, a water outlet pipe arranged at the bottom of the water storage tank, valves arranged on the surfaces of the water outlet pipe and the water inlet pipe, the purification assembly connected with the side surface of the water storage tank, the fixing device arranged on the surface of the purification assembly, the high-temperature waste gas utilization mechanism and the water storage tank connected with each other, and the displacement structure arranged at the bottom of the water storage tank.

title_en: Water tank with self-cleaning function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water tank with a self-cleaning function, which comprises a water tank body, wherein the water tank body is integrated equipment formed by combining and assembling a control tank body and storage equipment, the storage equipment is formed by combining and assembling stainless steel plates, a control cabinet and a pressurized water purifying equipment are arranged in the control tank body, and the control cabinet comprises a controller, a protection circuit, a relay and components related to the controller, the protection circuit, the relay and the components related to the control cabinet, and is electrically connected with the pressurized water purifying equipment. The utility model can reduce the adhesion of the inner wall and the generation of dirt in the water supplementing process of the water tank body by the main pipe arranged in the dendritic pipe network and the matched use of the spray head, and simultaneously adopts the first spray nozzle and the second spray nozzle which are arranged in multiple angles and multiple directions, thereby realizing the cleaning of the inside of the water tank body, reducing the cost and avoiding secondary pollution.

title_en: Vertical boiler ash bucket for inhibiting dust emission
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of boiler ash hoppers and discloses a vertical boiler ash hopper for inhibiting flying dust, which comprises a boiler ash hopper main body, wherein a fixed frame is arranged at the top end of the boiler ash hopper main body, an inserting clamping groove is arranged at the top end of the fixed frame, a buffer mechanism is arranged above the fixed frame, an air filtering mechanism is arranged at the top end of the buffer mechanism, the buffer mechanism comprises a connecting frame, connecting blocks are arranged on the left side and the right side of the connecting frame, inserting connecting rods are arranged at the bottom ends of the connecting blocks, fixed blocks are movably sleeved on the outer walls of the inserting connecting rods, five rotating shafts are arranged in the connecting frame, and six separating blades are arranged on the outer walls of a single rotating shaft.

title_en: Waste gas purifying device capable of purifying in multiple stages
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a waste gas purifying device capable of purifying in multiple stages, which comprises a main body, a purifying box, a controller and a fixing plate, wherein the purifying box is arranged on the outer wall of the main body, the controller is arranged on the inner wall of the purifying box, a plurality of filter screens are arranged on the inner wall of the main body, the fixing plate is arranged on the inner wall of the main body, a motor is arranged on the top wall of the inner part of the main body, and a storage device is arranged on the top of the fixing plate. The utility model can conveniently carry out multistage purification by installing the controller, the storage cavity is provided with a plurality of purifying liquids, when waste gas is required to be purified, the water pump is started, the purifying liquids are pumped out by the water pump, the water outlet pipe is respectively connected with the controller, when the waste gas is purified, the water outlet pipe can drive the winding shaft to rotate by starting the motor, the winding shaft drives the cable to shrink, and simultaneously the cable drives the sealing plate to seal the spraying pipe, so that the types of the spraying purifying liquids are controlled, and the spraying can be simultaneously carried out, thereby realizing the multistage purification function.

title_en: Sewage electro-Fenton treatment device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a sewage electro-Fenton treatment device. An electro-Fenton sewage treatment device, comprising: a reaction tank; the base is arranged below the reaction tank; the aeration assembly is arranged in the reaction tank and is used for treating sewage; the aeration assembly includes: the aeration pump is arranged in the base and is connected with an external power supply; the porous cylinder is arranged in the reaction tank through a mounting frame; through quick electro Fenton reaction, can the pollutant in the quick degradation water, promote hydrogen peroxide output, drive the iron mud through the removal elevating platform and store the storehouse and descend, shift out the base, dismantle iron mud storage storehouse again, further utilize iron mud, reduce wasting of resources and secondary pollution.

title_en: Exhaust tail pipe capable of preventing water from entering after treatment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an exhaust tail pipe for preventing water inflow after post treatment, which relates to the technical field of vehicles and comprises an inner pipe and an outer pipe sleeved on the outer side of the inner pipe, wherein the inner pipe is rotationally connected with the outer pipe through a rotating device, an upper exhaust port of the outer pipe is provided with a lateral opening, the top of the outer pipe is provided with an air guide device, and the bottom of the outer pipe is provided with a drainage device. The upper exhaust port of the outer pipe is provided with a lateral opening, so that rainwater is prevented from falling into the exhaust pipe vertically; through set up wind guiding device at the top of outer tube, and rotate between outer tube and the inner tube and be connected, in the weather of raining and blowing, wind guiding device drives the outer tube under the effect of wind and rotates, prevents that the last gas vent from being in the face of facing the wind, and the wind blows in the rainwater gets into the blast pipe, double-deck protection prevents that the blast pipe from intaking.

title_en: New energy station integrated monitoring management equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses novel energy station comprehensive monitoring management equipment which comprises a base, wherein the top of the base is fixedly connected with a protective shell, a clamping plate is connected onto the base in a sliding manner, one side of the clamping plate is provided with a threaded rod, the threaded rod is connected onto the protective shell in a threaded manner, one side of the clamping plate is provided with a mounting shell, the mounting shell is provided with a connecting groove, a guide rod is arranged in the connecting groove, a limit plate is connected onto the guide rod in a sliding manner, the rear side of the protective shell is provided with a dust screen, one side of the dust screen is provided with a fan, the inner side of the dust screen is provided with a sliding cleaning plate, and the clamping plate and the limit plate are arranged.

title_en: Novel smokeless moxibustion device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of moxibustion, in particular to a novel smokeless moxibustion device, which comprises a rubber pad, wherein a shell is arranged above the rubber pad, a fan bin is arranged on the right side of the shell, a first handle is arranged above the fan bin, a fixed block is arranged above the first handle, a threaded rod is arranged on the right side of the fixed block, a first cover is arranged above the fixed block, a smokeless structure is arranged above the first cover, a ventilation bin is arranged inside the shell, an ash-proof net is arranged inside the ventilation bin, a first through hole is formed in the left side of the ash-proof net, a dust screen is arranged inside the fan bin, a fan blade is arranged on the left side of the dust screen, and a motor is arranged on the left side of the fan blade. The moxibustion device can generate smoke during combustion, the air pump works, the generated smoke is sucked into the air suction pipe through the first filter screen, and ash in the smoke is discharged by the first filter screen.

title_en: Dustproof structure of shaving board cutting machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dustproof structure of a shaving board cutting machine, which comprises a shaving board cutting machine body, wherein a sealing cover is arranged at the top of the shaving board cutting machine body, a collecting box is arranged in the shaving board cutting machine body, a placing block is fixedly connected to the top of the collecting box, and a collecting opening is formed in the top of the collecting box. According to the utility model, the particle board is supported by the placing block, so that the collecting port can fully absorb the wood chips in cutting into the collecting box, the wood chips are conveyed into the collecting box through the fixing pipe, then the filter screen and the filter cloth bag filter the wood chips, so that the wood chips are filtered in the collecting box, air is discharged by the fan, and finally the wood chips in the collecting box are uniformly cleaned after being taken down by the collecting box, thereby having the advantage of being convenient for later cleaning the wood chips, replacing the mode that the wood chips of the existing particle board cutting machine are accumulated in the collecting box, and improving the convenience of later cleaning the wood chips for users.

title_en: Switch installation device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of exchanges, in particular to an exchange installation device, which comprises a support inner plate and an installation assembly, wherein the installation assembly comprises an installation box, a threaded screw rod, a guide rail, two sliding blocks and two clamping plates; the threaded screw rod is rotationally connected with the installation box, the guide rail is fixedly connected with the installation box, the two sliding blocks are respectively fixedly connected with the guide rail and are respectively in threaded connection with the threaded screw rod, and the two clamping plates are respectively fixedly connected with the two sliding blocks; when fixing the switch, place the switch on supporting the inner panel to make the switch be in between two splint, then the staff rotates the screw thread lead screw, and the screw thread lead screw rotates and makes two sliders remove along the guide rail and be close to each other, and two sliders drive two splint and be close to each other, until two splint press from both sides tight fixedly with the switch, thereby can avoid receiving the striking at switch installation device after, the switch takes place to drop and damage from supporting the inner panel.

title_en: Desulfurizing slurry filter device for reducing sundry impact
abstract_en: A desulfurizing slurry filter device for reducing sundry impact. In the prior art, although the impact of sundries on a filter screen can be reduced, in actual operation, because the desulfurization slurry continuously flows, part of sundries are attached to one side of the filter screen along with water flow under the action of the water flow, and the sundries are embedded in gaps of the filter screen, so that the filter screen is easy to be blocked. The composition of the utility model comprises: the filter device comprises a filter device body (2), wherein an injection opening (1) is arranged on one side of the filter device body, an outlet (3) is arranged at the top end of the filter device body, a drain outlet (5) is arranged at the bottom of the filter device body, spray washing units (4) are respectively arranged on two sides of the filter device body, a protruding portion (6) is arranged on the inner wall of the injection opening, a filter screen (7) is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the top end of the filter device body, a control mechanism for controlling the aperture change of the inner wall of the filter screen is arranged on one side of the filter screen, and the control mechanism is arranged at the top end of the filter device body. The utility model relates to a desulfurization slurry filtering device for reducing sundry impact.

title_en: Multistage adsorption oil gas recovery device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of multistage adsorption oil gas recovery, in particular to a multistage adsorption oil gas recovery device which comprises a multistage adsorption oil gas recovery component, wherein a plugging component is arranged in the multistage adsorption oil gas recovery component, and energy dissipation and vibration reduction components are arranged at the front end and the rear end of the multistage adsorption oil gas recovery component; the plugging assembly comprises a supporting frame, an oil gas sensor is arranged on the inner wall of the lower portion of the supporting frame, a motor is arranged on the inner wall of the upper portion of the supporting frame, and a screw rod is connected to the output end of the motor. According to the multistage adsorption oil gas recovery device, through the arrangement of the plugging assembly, oil gas is prevented from being continuously emitted into the air, the alarm button is pressed, the alarm in the movable disc gives out an alarm, workers are reminded to process the oil gas as soon as possible, potential safety hazards are reduced, the energy dissipation and vibration reduction effect is achieved through the arrangement of the energy dissipation and vibration reduction assembly, and the influence of external impact on the main body of the multistage adsorption oil gas recovery device is reduced.

title_en: Ditching machine is planted to tealeaves
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tea planting ditching machine, which comprises a ditching trolley, wherein a lifting type adjustable ditching mechanism comprises a clamping groove which is formed in one side of the ditching trolley, a support frame is arranged on the inner wall of the clamping groove in a clamping manner, one side of the support frame is hinged with a support bar, a ditching shovel is fixedly arranged on one side of the support bar, a first screw hole is formed in the upper edge of one side of the support frame, and second screw holes are formed in one side of the support frame and one side of the support bar. According to the utility model, the electric telescopic rod is started to enable the support frame to move in the clamping groove to adjust the ditching depth in a lifting manner, the fixing bolt penetrates through the two second screw holes to fix the ditching mechanism during ditching, the fixing bolt is screwed to pull out the ditching mechanism when the equipment is required to be carried after ditching is completed, the support bar is rotated to enable the ditching shovel to rotate along with the ditching shovel to be folded at the upper end of the support frame, and then the ditching shovel penetrates through the second screw holes at the upper end of the support bar and the first screw holes at the upper end of the support frame to fix the ditching shovel through the fixing bolt, so that the convenience of using the device is improved.

title_en: Novel hydrogen mixing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel hydrogen mixing device which comprises a hydrogen production device, a first check valve, a first air pressure detection device, a second air pressure detection device, a hydrogen water fusion device, a booster pump, a second check valve, a water outlet pipeline, a water outlet electromagnetic valve, a water pressure detection device and a pressure relief safety valve, wherein the hydrogen production device is fixedly communicated with the bottom of the hydrogen water fusion device through a first pipeline, the first check valve, the first air pressure detection device and the second air pressure detection device are sequentially and fixedly arranged on the first pipeline from left to right, the bottom end of the hydrogen water fusion device is fixedly connected with a water inlet joint, the water inlet joint is fixedly connected with the booster pump through the second pipeline, the second check valve is fixedly connected with the second pipeline, the top end of the hydrogen water fusion device is fixedly connected with a water outlet joint, and one end of the water outlet joint far away from the hydrogen water fusion device is fixedly connected with the water outlet pipeline. The utility model has scientific and reasonable structure, low manufacturing cost and strong practicability.

title_en: Fireproof aluminum alloy door and window
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of aluminum alloy doors and windows, in particular to a fireproof aluminum alloy door and window, which has the function of being capable of comprehensively spraying and fireproof after adjustment, and improves the safety; the fire-proof spray head comprises an aluminum alloy door and window frame, door and window hinges, aluminum alloy door and window pages, a connecting frame, a top plate, a spray head constraint frame, a constraint shaft, a fire-proof spray head, a water guide pipe, a screw sleeve hinge frame, a screw sleeve, a reciprocating motor hinge frame, a reciprocating motor and a screw rod, wherein the left end of the inner side of the aluminum alloy door and window frame is connected with the rear side end of the aluminum alloy door and window pages through the door and window hinges, the middle front side of the top end of the aluminum alloy door and window frame is connected with the bottom end of the connecting frame, the front end of the connecting frame is connected with the rear end of the top plate, the front end of the fire-proof spray head is connected with the rear end of the screw sleeve hinge frame, the screw sleeve is movably connected in the screw sleeve hinge frame, the output end of the reciprocating motor is connected with the top end of the screw rod, and the outer wall of the screw rod is in threaded connection with the inner wall of the screw sleeve.

title_en: Humidity sensor structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a humidity sensor structure, which relates to the technical field of sensors and comprises a sensor main body, wherein one end of the sensor main body is welded with a fixed block, one side of the fixed block is provided with a round hole in a penetrating mode, a humidity sensor is arranged in the round hole, one end of the fixed block is provided with four sliding grooves, one end of the fixed block is provided with four connecting rods, a dustproof filter screen layer is arranged between every two connecting rods, and one end of the sensor main body is provided with an external wiring. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the four dustproof filter screen layers, the dustproof filter screen layers which can be replaced are extracted, the trapezoidal sliding rods at the two ends of the dustproof filter screen layers can slide outwards in the two trapezoidal grooves until the dustproof filter screen layers are separated, and then a new dustproof filter screen layer is replaced, so that unnecessary waste can be avoided, and the accuracy of measurement data of the humidity sensor is ensured, so that the humidity sensor can be normally used for a long time.

title_en: Width adjustable formula tealeaves is planted and is used ditcher device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a width-adjustable ditcher device for tea planting. The width-adjustable ditcher device for tea planting comprises: a ditcher body; the hydraulic rod is fixedly arranged on the ditcher body; the main body frame is hinged to an output rod of the hydraulic rod; the water tank is fixedly arranged on the main body frame; the moving mechanism is arranged on the main body frame and is used for adjusting the width of the tea planting ditcher; the sliding mechanism is arranged in the main body frame and is used for adjusting the width of the tea planting ditcher in cooperation with the moving mechanism. The width-adjustable ditcher device for tea planting has the advantages of being adjustable in width and capable of preventing serious dust emission.

title_en: Dispersion machine with dust-proof structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dispersing machine with a dust raising prevention structure, which comprises a dispersing cylinder, wherein an annular pipe is arranged on the outer wall of the dispersing cylinder, a collecting box is arranged on the side wall of the dispersing cylinder, a fixed pipe is fixedly connected to the side wall of the collecting box, an air suction fan is fixedly connected to the top of the fixed pipe, a connecting pipe is fixedly connected between the air suction fan and the annular pipe, the collecting box is slidably connected with the collecting box on the side wall of the collecting box, a water spraying pipe is fixedly connected to the inside of the collecting box and above the fixed pipe, and the water spraying pipe is connected with an external water source through a water pump, and the dispersing machine has the beneficial effects that: when the dispersing machine works, suction is generated by starting the suction fan, then suction is generated by the suction head through the mutual matching of the connecting pipe and the annular pipe, dust generated during the working of the dispersing machine is adsorbed, then the dust adsorbed by the suction fan is discharged into the collecting box through the fixed pipe, the water pump is started to suck water into the spray pipe to spray out from the plurality of atomizing nozzles, and the atomized water is utilized to carry out dust fall treatment on the adsorbed dust.

title_en: Acetate recovery unit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an acetate recovery device, which relates to the technical field of acetate production and comprises a distillation tank, a water wheel, a filter plate, a feed pipe and a conducting pipe; the filter plate is fixedly arranged in the distillation tank, and the distillation tank is internally divided into a left chamber and a right chamber; the water wheel is rotatably arranged in the left cavity; the bottom end of the feeding pipe is inserted into the left cavity; one end of the conductive pipe is inserted into the right chamber.
