According to the utility model, the water wheels are arranged in the distillation tank, so that the industrial wastewater containing acetate flowing out from the feed pipe can be automatically lifted, the heating area of the wastewater is effectively increased, the heating time of the industrial wastewater containing acetate is shortened, the evaporation of acetate in the wastewater is accelerated, the recovery efficiency of acetate is improved, and meanwhile, the filter screen is arranged, insoluble impurities in the wastewater can be filtered in the left chamber, and the impurity content in the recovered acetate is effectively reduced.

title_en: Floating oil extraction device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a floating oil extraction device which comprises a controller, a floating oil detection part, a suction pump, a conveying pipeline, an oil suction cylinder, a separation part and a suspension frame, wherein the suspension frame is arranged in a sewage tank, the separation part is fixed on the suspension frame, the oil suction cylinder is fixed in the separation part through the suspension frame, one end of the conveying pipeline is connected with the oil suction cylinder, the other end of the conveying pipeline is connected with the suction pump, the floating oil detection part is arranged in the sewage tank and used for detecting the thickness of oil, the controller is respectively connected with the suction pump and the floating oil detection part, and the controller is used for controlling the suction pump to be started and stopped according to the detection result of the floating oil detection part. The utility model can automatically realize higher-efficiency extraction of floating oil, so that reinjection of wastewater is safer and more efficient, thereby solving the problems of high safety risk, low operation efficiency, untimely recovery and the like of the existing manual salvage mode.

title_en: Water purifier
abstract_en: The utility model provides a water purification machine, including the casing, install filtration system in the casing, the booster pump, the solenoid valve of intaking, control unit and be used for the various joints of connection, filtration system includes composite filter core, RO filter core and post-filter core, be equipped with a hot jar in the casing, the pure water exit linkage of post-filter core is two pipelines, wherein first pipeline is connected with hot jar, the delivery port of hot jar is connected with play tap through hot water line, the steam outlet of hot jar is connected with the dense water exit line of RO filter core through the steam line, the second pipeline is normal atmospheric temperature water pipeline, be connected with play tap. The utility model has more reasonable and compact structure, more reasonable waterway design, more convenient connection and large flux, can meet the drinking requirements of hot water and normal-temperature water, and is convenient to mount and dismount and convenient for daily maintenance and filter element replacement.

title_en: Flue gas purification washing tower
abstract_en: The utility model provides a flue gas purification washing tower, which relates to the technical field of waste incineration flue gas purification wet methods. The cooling device and the dehumidifying device of the flue gas purification wet-type washing tower are arranged at the upper part and the lower part of one tower, so that the cooling and dehumidifying functions are enhanced, the deacidification efficiency is improved, and the emission standard of European Union waste incineration pollutants can be reached. The matched facilities are few, the occupied area is small, and the investment, operation and maintenance cost can be saved.

title_en: Automatic cleaning device for glass of operation platform of garbage incineration plant
abstract_en: The utility model provides an automatic cleaning device for operating platform glass of a garbage incineration plant, which comprises a device main body and a dust removing mechanism, wherein the dust removing mechanism comprises a directional plate, a supporting frame, an air leakage valve, a filter bag and a rotary fan.

title_en: Monitoring type enclosure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a monitoring type enclosure, which relates to the field of constructional engineering and comprises a supporting upright post, wherein an enclosure mounting frame is arranged on the outer surface of one side of the supporting upright post. The utility model discloses a monitoring type enclosure, which comprises an inner water pipe baffle, an atomization spray head, a two-way water valve, a mounting shell, a mounting base and a dust monitor, wherein the sectional type monitoring dust fall component comprises the inner water pipe baffle, the atomization spray head, the two-way water valve, the mounting shell, the mounting base and the dust monitor.

title_en: Angle-adjustable ultrafine dry powder extinguishing device with remote starting function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an angle-adjustable ultrafine dry powder extinguishing device with remote starting, which comprises an ultrafine dry powder extinguishing device main body, wherein the ultrafine dry powder extinguishing device main body is arranged on an angle adjusting mechanism, the angle adjusting mechanism comprises adjusting brackets symmetrically arranged on two sides of the ultrafine dry powder extinguishing device and fixing frames which are fixed on two sides of the ultrafine dry powder extinguishing device and correspond to the two adjusting brackets respectively, the fixing frames on the same side comprise a first fixing frame and a second fixing frame, one end of each adjusting bracket is rotationally connected with the first fixing frame, a plurality of adjusting holes are formed in the other end of each adjusting bracket, each adjusting hole is arranged in an arc shape and corresponds to the second fixing frame, each adjusting hole can be locked with the second fixing frame through a screw, and a wireless remote controller is arranged at one end of the ultrafine dry powder extinguishing device main body. The utility model can realize multi-angle adjustment of the superfine dry powder extinguishing device, achieves the long-distance extinguishing effect, has the wireless remote control function, can send and receive remote data signals, and ensures the safety.

title_en: Special device for solid-liquid separation of sewage
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a special device for solid-liquid separation of sewage, which belongs to the technical field of sewage treatment and comprises a precipitation barrel; the utility model has the beneficial effects that the inclined tube filler layer is used for slowing down the water flow in the equipment frame, so that the sedimentation of impurities in sewage is facilitated, the precipitated water is discharged through the water outlet pipe, the impurities in the sewage fall through the dust fall tank and fall to the bottom of the sedimentation tank in the sedimentation tank, the impurities can be accumulated at the bottom of the sedimentation tank, when the impurities are required to be cleaned, the baffle is driven by the output end of the cloth-in motor to rotate on the lower surface of the equipment plate, the baffle and the dust fall tank on the equipment plate are alternately arranged, the baffle is used for blocking the dust fall tank, the underwater drop on the equipment plate is prevented, the impurities and the sewage at the bottom end of the sedimentation tank are discharged through the discharge pipe by opening the valve, the manual cleaning is not required, the trouble and the labor are saved, the sedimentation tank can work normally in the cleaning process, and the sewage treatment efficiency is improved.

title_en: Acid-base waste gas spray tower
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of tail gas treatment, in particular to an acid-base waste gas spray tower, which comprises the following components: the spray tower main body comprises a first connecting frame, a second connecting frame is arranged on the upper portion of the first connecting frame, a filtering frame is fixedly connected between the first connecting frame and the second connecting frame, a water pump is arranged in the first fixing seat, a base plate extends to the bottom of the collecting seat, a second connecting pipe penetrates through the base plate and extends to the inside of the first fixing seat, and a communicating pipe is fixedly connected with the front end of the neutralization box. According to the utility model, the rotary disk drives the plurality of groups of spray heads to rotate, so that the waste gas and the neutralization liquid are conveniently and fully contacted, the tail gas is neutralized, and the neutralization in the first fixing seat is conveniently and circularly conveyed into the neutralization box to neutralize the waste gas through the arrangement of the water pump and the second connecting pipe.

title_en: Dust-proof device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dustproof device, comprising: the dust-proof device comprises a protection dust-proof shell, wherein an efficient filter is fixedly arranged in the protection dust-proof shell, a multi-stage filter assembly is arranged on the front surface of the efficient filter, an exhaust negative pressure assembly is arranged on the back surface of the efficient filter, and a dust collection filter box is arranged between the multi-stage filter assembly and the exhaust negative pressure assembly; the multistage filtering component comprises a plurality of layers of dust filtering plates, wherein the top ends of the plurality of layers of dust filtering plates are fixedly connected with a dust discharging connecting box, and a plurality of connecting grooves are formed in the dust discharging connecting box; a plurality of dust filtering cavities are formed in the top end of the multi-layer dust filtering plate at equal intervals. This dust keeper effectively avoids dust in the air to pile up high-efficient filter surface through the protection shield, cooperates the major diameter granule in the multilayer dust filtration board filtration air simultaneously, avoids major diameter granule to pile up inside the filter core, influences high-efficient filter's normal work, prolongs the operating time of filter core.

title_en: Multistage sewage treatment device for sludge backflow
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of water source treatment equipment and discloses multi-stage sewage treatment equipment for sludge backflow, which comprises a box body, wherein a crushing mechanism is arranged at the top of the box body, an anti-blocking mechanism is arranged in the box body, a treatment mechanism is arranged on one side of the box body, the crushing mechanism comprises a crushing box, the bottom of the crushing box is fixedly connected to the middle side of the top of the box body, the outer walls of two sides of two rotating shafts are respectively connected to the two sides of the crushing box in a rotating mode, and crushing rollers are fixedly connected to the middle side of the outer walls of the rotating shafts. According to the utility model, the crushing mechanism is arranged to crush hard objects or sundries in sewage, so that the later filtering operation is facilitated, the motor is started to drive the transmission gear on the rotating shaft to rotate, so that the two crushing rollers rotate oppositely, the crushing rollers are crushed, and the filter plate is vibrated by the anti-blocking mechanism, so that the filter holes are prevented from being blocked.

title_en: Intelligent garbage can
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent garbage can, which relates to the technical field of intelligent home, and comprises the following components: the garbage can comprises a can body, a garbage can and a garbage can, wherein the can body is provided with an opening and a first accommodating cavity which are communicated with each other, and the opening and the first accommodating cavity are used for accommodating garbage bags; the sealing mechanism comprises a gear driving mechanism, two sliding rails and two push rods, wherein the gear driving mechanism, the two sliding rails and the two push rods are all positioned in the second accommodating cavity, the gear driving mechanism is connected with the two push rods, the two sliding rails are oppositely arranged, the two push rods are arranged between the two sliding rails, the two push rods are oppositely arranged, two ends of each push rod are respectively connected with the two sliding rails in a sliding manner, the push rods are provided with a heat sealing structure, the gear driving mechanism is used for driving the push rods to slide to an open middle area, and the push rods are used for pushing the bag opening of the garbage bag and heat-sealing the bag opening of the garbage bag through the heat sealing structure; and a control module. The utility model can seal the garbage bag and has good sealing effect.

title_en: Tamping coke oven dust collector
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a dust removing device of a tamping coke oven. The gas collecting hood comprises a sealing ring, a first light pipe, a telescopic pipe and a second light pipe, wherein the sealing ring is matched with a carbonization chamber door, the first light pipe is fixedly connected to one side of the sealing ring, which is far away from the carbonization chamber, the telescopic pipe is fixedly connected to one end of the sealing ring, which is far away from the first light pipe, the second light pipe is fixedly connected to one end of the telescopic pipe, which is far away from the one end of the telescopic pipe, and is fixedly connected with the coal charging car, a driving mechanism for driving the telescopic pipe to stretch out and draw back is arranged on the coal charging car, the gas collecting hood comprises a cyclone dust collector, a washing tank and a dust collecting tank, and a gas inlet of the cyclone dust collector is fixedly communicated with the gas collecting hood through a first connecting pipe. The utility model reduces the influence of the dust generated by the carbonization chamber flue gas and the coal charging car on the air in the coal charging process.

title_en: Wear-resistant dedusting filter bag frame
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-wear dedusting filter bag frame which comprises a first frame, a connecting frame and a second frame, wherein a plurality of splicing mechanisms are arranged on the first frame and the connecting frame, a plurality of splicing shafts are arranged on the connecting frame and the second frame, the splicing mechanism on the first frame is connected with the splicing shaft on the connecting frame, and the splicing mechanism on the connecting frame is connected with the splicing shaft on the second frame. Through the cooperation of the splicing mechanism and the splicing shaft, the first frame and the second frame are spliced together conveniently, and the second frame is additionally arranged between the first frame and the second frame conveniently, so that the whole length of the device can be prolonged, the device can adapt to different installation environments, and the installation efficiency is improved; through the inside attenuator that installs additional of base, reduced the holistic rocking of filter bag to can prevent that the filter bag from leading to unable filtration because of too fast wearing and tearing, effectively improve the life of filter bag.

title_en: Distributed photovoltaic management and control equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses distributed photovoltaic control equipment, which relates to the technical field of distributed photovoltaic, and comprises a control equipment main body, wherein an internal element main body is fixedly arranged in the control equipment main body, a first motor is arranged at the upper end of the control equipment main body, a driving gear is fixedly arranged at the output end of the first motor, a driven gear I is meshed with one end of the driving gear, a driven gear II is meshed with the other end of the driving gear, a tooth-missing gear I is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the driven gear I, a tooth-missing gear II is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the driven gear II, and a rack is meshed with one end of the tooth-missing gear I. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the first tooth-lacking gear and the second tooth-lacking gear, the fan can cool each part in the management and control equipment main body, and local overheating of the internal element main body is prevented, so that the normal operation of the internal element main body is ensured, and the service life of the equipment is prolonged.

title_en: Biochemical treatment device of garbage transfer station
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a biochemical treatment device of a garbage transfer station, and relates to the technical field of garbage treatment. Comprising the following steps: a base; the soaking device is fixedly arranged on the base and is used for soaking the garbage by the percolate; the soaking device comprises: the tank body is fixedly arranged on the base; the outer wall of the filter cartridge is rotationally connected with the inner wall of the tank body; and the power assembly is arranged on the tank body and used for rotating the filter cartridge. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the soaking device, garbage is positioned in the filter cartridge, the garbage is soaked by the percolate in the tank body through the filter holes, after the soaking is finished, the garbage and the filter cartridge are rotated through the power assembly, so that centrifugal force is generated, and under the action of the centrifugal force and the filter holes, the percolate adhered to the garbage is reduced, so that most of the percolate can enter the treatment device, and the waste of the percolate is reduced.

title_en: Cloud dust suppression device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of dust suppression equipment, in particular to a cloud dust suppression device, which comprises a base, wherein a water tank is fixedly connected to the base, a water pump is fixedly connected to the base, a water pumping port of the water pump is communicated with the inside of the water tank, a water outlet of the water pump is fixedly communicated with a first water pipe, one end of the first water pipe, which is far away from the water pump, is rotationally connected with a second water pipe, one end of the second water pipe, which is far away from the first water pipe, is fixedly communicated with an atomizing spray pipe, a supporting seat is arranged on the base, a plurality of supporting rods are fixedly connected between the supporting seat and the base, a rotary table is rotationally connected to the supporting seat, a first through hole for the first water pipe to pass through is formed in the middle of the upper surface of the supporting seat, a second through hole for the second water pipe to pass through is formed in the middle of the rotary table, and the outer wall of the second water pipe is fixedly connected with the inner wall of the rotary table at the second through hole. The utility model has the effect of realizing convenient spraying to the two sides and the rear direction of the dust suppression device in the operation process of the dust suppression device.

title_en: Quartz sand ore circulation breaker
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a quartz sand ore circulating crushing device which comprises a crushing box body, wherein a longitudinally distributed partition plate is arranged in the crushing box body, a first crushing box is arranged on the left side of the partition plate, a second crushing box is arranged on the right side of the partition plate, a feed inlet is formed in the top of the first crushing box, a first crushing roller set is arranged at the upper end of the inside of the first crushing box, a sliding plate is arranged below the first crushing roller set, a first guide plate is arranged at the lower end of the inside of the first crushing box, a second crushing roller set is arranged inside the second crushing box, and a second guide plate is arranged in the second crushing box below the second crushing roller. According to the utility model, quartz sand ore can be subjected to secondary circulation crushing through the first crushing roller set and the second crushing roller set, and the ore output of the first crushing is not required to be poured into the crushing box from a new person, so that the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Broken recovery unit of steel scrap
abstract_en: The utility model provides a scrap steel crushing and recycling device, which relates to the field of steel recycling and processing, and comprises a bottom plate and supporting frames positioned at four corners of the bottom plate, wherein a mounting plate is slidably arranged above the bottom plate through supporting components, one end of the bottom plate is provided with a driving component for driving the mounting plate to reciprocate, the mounting plate is provided with a fixed frame, the cross section of the fixed frame is  -shaped, the outer side of the fixed frame is covered with a movable frame, and the inner wall of the lower end of the movable frame is provided with a mounting groove matched with the fixed frame; according to the utility model, the hydraulic oil cylinder pushes the pressing plate to extrude the waste, the waste is compressed into blocks, and the volume of the waste is reduced, so that the waste is convenient to transfer and transport, and meanwhile, the device drives the mounting plate to reciprocate through the driving assembly, so that accumulated waste steel can be flattened, and extrusion work is convenient to carry out.

title_en: Aeration device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of aeration equipment, in particular to an aeration device, which comprises an aeration tank, wherein limit sliding grooves are formed in four sides of the inner wall of the aeration tank, a pressure-resistant plate is movably connected in the aeration tank, limit sliding blocks are fixedly connected to four sides of the side surface of the pressure-resistant plate, an annular drawing frame is fixedly connected to the center of the surface of the aeration tank, and a ventilation frame is fixedly connected to the bottom end of the aeration tank. According to the utility model, through the aeration tank, the limiting sliding groove, the pressure-resistant plate, the limiting sliding block, the annular pumping frame, the counterweight ring frame and the infusion valve, a stable one-layer check can be formed at the liquid level position of aeration liquid, in the actual use process, a worker firstly passes the liquid needing aeration operation through the pressure-resistant plate from the infusion valve of the annular pumping frame to be introduced into the aeration tank, then the liquid in the aeration tank can float the pressure-resistant plate in the aeration tank from the top, and the buoyancy air bag at the bottom of the pressure-resistant plate provides stable buoyancy.

title_en: Crisp persimmon drying device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a crisp persimmon drying device which comprises a first box body, wherein a drying mechanism is arranged on the upper wall surface of the first box body, two pairs of first rectangular fixing blocks are arranged on the lower wall surface of the first box body, a fourth box body is arranged on the lower wall surface of the two pairs of first rectangular fixing blocks, a moving mechanism is arranged in the fourth box body, the first box body is internally provided with a first space, a second space and a third space, a switch mechanism is arranged at the positions, close to the outer wall surface of the first box body, of the first space, the second space and the third space, of the third space, an auxiliary drying mechanism is arranged in the first space, the second space and the third space, the second space rotates through the rotation of a motor driving end, and the second T-shaped cylinder can be driven to move up and down through the rotation of the second rod body, so that the universal wheel can move up and down in the fourth box body, and the fourth box body can be supported by the universal wheel to move conveniently.

title_en: Deodorization filter screen of air purifier
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a deodorizing filter screen of an air purifier, which belongs to the technical field of deodorizing filter screens. Through vertical plug-in design, under the cooperation of location inserted bar and locating hole, make things convenient for dust removal filter screen plate, compound filter screen plate, active carbon filter and HEPA ultrafiltration plywood and rose box to align the installation, and can adjust dust removal filter screen plate, compound filter screen plate, active carbon filter and HEPA ultrafiltration plywood according to the environment needs, can increase also can reduce, and all conveniently take out alone when maintaining, can not influence other subassemblies, the inconvenient function assembly of carrying out according to external environment and single maintenance comparatively inconvenient problem when having solved current air purifier deodorization filter screen when using, great improvement the application range of air purifier deodorization filter screen, and the convenience of equipment when maintaining.

title_en: Drum screen for urban garbage disposal
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rotary screen for urban garbage treatment, which comprises a shell, a rotary screen body, wall pipes, an odor removing box and activated carbon blocks, wherein the rotary screen body is rotatably arranged in the shell, a first screen hole, a second screen hole and a third screen hole are sequentially formed in the surface of the rotary screen body, a rotary driving piece is arranged on one side of the shell, the wall pipes are arranged at the top end of the shell, equidistant air suction pipes are arranged at the bottom ends of the wall pipes, the odor removing box is fixed on one side of the shell, hollow partition plates are fixed in the odor removing cavity, the activated carbon blocks are arranged at the top ends of the hollow partition plates, an induced draft fan is arranged at the top ends of the odor removing box, and a material collecting frame is arranged below the shell. The utility model not only realizes the function of removing peculiar smell, reduces the pollution to air and improves the rotation stability of the rotary screen, but also is convenient for quickly separating sewage.

title_en: Solar sea water desalination and refined salt refining device
abstract_en: A solar sea water desalination and refined salt extraction device comprises a light-transmitting heat-preserving layer, a heat-preserving gap, a photo-thermal layer, a heat conduction layer, a salt water concentrator and a crude salt extractor which are arranged in parallel below the heat conduction layer, wherein the light-transmitting heat-preserving layer, the heat-preserving gap, the photo-thermal layer, the salt water concentrator and the crude salt extractor are tightly stacked from top to bottom. The brine concentrator comprises three parts consisting of the same brine transport line: an evaporation layer, a salt water supply line, a concentrated salt water return line, a condensation collecting tank and a salt water tank. The crude salt extractor comprises three parts consisting of the same water salt transport line: the device comprises an evaporation layer, a salt water supply line, a salt extraction line, a condensation collecting tank, a salt water tank, a refined salt collecting box and a waste liquid tank. The concentrated brine produced by the brine concentrator washes the crude salt solids produced by the crude salt extractor to produce refined salt. In one device, the utility model can separate water and refined salt from the sea water by using solar energy only, and is suitable for the fields of sea water/salt lake desalination, refined salt extraction and the like.

title_en: Desulfurization device flue gas reflux structure for hazardous waste incineration
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a flue gas reflux structure of a desulfurization device for hazardous waste incineration, wherein a flue gas reflux assembly A, a flue gas reflux assembly B and a flue gas reflux assembly C are arranged in a reaction cavity of a desulfurization tower, the flue gas reflux assembly A, the flue gas reflux assembly B and the flue gas reflux assembly C are structurally suitable, the flue gas reflux assembly A comprises a reflux plate and a baffle plate, the baffle plate is arranged at the bottom end of the reflux plate, and a flue gas reflux channel is arranged between the baffle plate and the reflux plate. The flue gas reflux assembly A is provided with a reflux plate with a recess, a spray header is arranged at the recess of the bottom end of the reflux plate, so that the spray header sprays and neutralizes flue gas entering the reflux plate, unreacted flue gas enters a flue gas reflux channel between the reflux plate and a baffle plate, and the flue gas is discharged from an inclined exhaust hole arranged on the reflux plate, so that the reflux flue gas fully reacts with alkaline liquid in a desulfurizing tower, and the flue gas desulfurization quality of a desulfurization device for the hazardous waste incineration flue gas is improved.

title_en: Frame and vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vehicle frame and a vehicle. The frame includes a frame body and a second muffler. The inside of the frame body forms a channel, the frame body is provided with an inlet and an outlet which are communicated with the channel, the inlet is suitable for being connected with an exhaust port of an engine, and the outlet is suitable for being connected with a first silencer; the second muffler is disposed within the passage.

title_en: Waste collection equipment and waste liquid collection and treatment system
abstract_en: A waste collection device and a waste collection treatment system, the waste collection device comprises a trolley butt joint part, wherein the trolley butt joint part forms a matching space; the trolley butt joint part comprises a trolley joint fixing plate, a collecting end joint, a suspension joint and a suspension joint fixing piece, wherein the suspension joint fixing piece is fixed on the trolley joint fixing plate, the collecting end joint is connected with the suspension joint, the suspension joint is mounted on the suspension joint fixing piece in a suspension movable mode, the suspension joint is used for guiding the butt joint end joint of the butt joint equipment to be jointed with the collecting end joint, and the suspension joint fixing piece comprises a positioning part extending into the matching space. In this waste collection equipment and waste liquid collection processing system, because the location portion sets up on the suspension joint mounting, location portion and guide bayonet location back, the floating space of suspension joint and adapting plate and guide bayonet do not have spacing relation, can not restrict the floating space of suspension joint for fault-tolerant space when docking is great, and suspension joint can not block at the butt joint in-process.

title_en: Clean dispensing equipment in view pond
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cleaning and chemical dosing device for a landscape pool, which comprises a fixing pile, wherein a connecting seat is fixedly connected to one side of the fixing pile, a mounting plate is arranged on one side of the connecting seat, a medicine cartridge is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the mounting plate, a medicine hole is formed in the bottom of the medicine cartridge, a medicine outlet pipe is movably connected in the medicine hole and penetrates through the mounting plate, a plurality of nozzles are arranged at the bottom of the medicine outlet pipe, a motor is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the mounting plate, one end of an output shaft of the motor penetrates through the mounting plate and is fixedly connected with a rotating shaft, and a stirring assembly is arranged at the bottom of the rotating shaft. According to the utility model, the liquid medicine can be sprayed widely through the cooperation of the swinging frame and the feeler lever, so that the liquid medicine is uniformly put into each position of the water tank, and the liquid medicine and water can be fully mixed through the rotation of the stirring frame, so that the liquid medicine and the water in the water tank react more fully, and the practicability of the equipment is improved.

title_en: Dust removal cabinet with noise reduction structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dust removing cabinet with a noise reducing structure, which comprises a dust removing cabinet body, wherein a filter assembly is arranged in the dust removing cabinet body, the filter assembly comprises a first filter screen plate with two ends detachably connected to the inner wall of the dust removing cabinet body, the first filter screen plate is internally provided with filter screen holes in a rectangular array mode, a second filter screen plate and a third filter screen plate are movably arranged above and below the first filter screen plate respectively, the second filter screen plate and the third filter screen plate are internally provided with filter screen holes in a rectangular array mode respectively, the second filter screen holes and the third filter screen holes are arranged in a staggered mode relative to the first filter screen holes, and a dredging block which is adaptively inserted into the first filter screen holes is arranged on one side of the upper end face of the third filter screen plate in a rectangular array mode.

title_en: Front end pre-dewatering device of high-voltage discharge type ozone generator
abstract_en: The utility model provides a front-end pre-dewatering device of a high-voltage discharge type ozone generator, and belongs to the technical field of equipment dewatering protection. The front end pre-dewatering device of the high-pressure discharge type ozone generator comprises a supercharger connected with an oxygen supply and gas transmission pipeline, a gas storage unit connected with the supercharger, and a drying and dehumidifying bin connected with the gas storage unit, wherein the drying and dehumidifying bin is respectively connected with two mutually independent decompression chambers through a three-way joint, and the decompression chambers are connected with an air inlet of the high-pressure discharge type ozone generator. The pressurized water removal mode is adopted to remove water in the oxygen supply and gas transmission pipeline, and the water content in the ozone generator can be effectively reduced aiming at the high-voltage discharge type ozone generator suitable for long-time and continuous operation, so that a large amount of water accumulated in the ozone generator under the condition of long-time operation is avoided, and the short circuit burning during the operation of the high-voltage discharge coil is avoided.

title_en: Shelter type household garbage incinerator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a shelter type household garbage incinerator which comprises a supporting block, wherein a hollow rod is movably connected to the inner side of the supporting block, an extension rod is movably connected to the inner side of the hollow rod, a first gear is fixedly connected to one side, away from each other, of the extension rod, a first supporting plate is movably connected to the outer side of the first gear, a second gear is meshed to the upper side of the first gear, and a lifting stud is fixedly connected to the upper side of the second gear. According to the utility model, the lifting stud is arranged, so that the device can be folded, the moving convenience of the device is improved, the air blower is arranged, the residues and the flue gas after combustion can be sucked into the inner side of the dust box, the practicability of the device is improved, the sliding block is arranged, the furnace body can be detached from the first supporting plate when the device needs to be moved, the furnace body can be separated from the device, the transportation is convenient, the moving convenience of the device is improved, and the problem that the moving adjustment of the existing household garbage incinerator is inconvenient is solved.

title_en: Multistage cyclone separator for sewage treatment
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of cyclone separators, in particular to a multi-stage cyclone separator for sewage treatment, which comprises a separating tank, wherein an arc-shaped filtering port is formed in the outer surface of the separating tank, a large-aperture filter screen is fixedly sleeved on the inner wall of the arc-shaped filtering port, an annular separating frame is fixedly sleeved on the outer surface of the separating tank, drain pipes which are symmetrically distributed are fixedly communicated with the inner bottom wall of the annular separating frame, and one end of each drain pipe penetrates through and extends to the lower surface of the annular separating frame. This sewage treatment is with multistage cyclone, through being provided with dual filter equipment at the inner wall of annular separation frame, and dual filter equipment includes annular aperture filter screen, and the outside surface of annular aperture filter screen is fixed cup joint with the inner wall of annular separation frame, has reached and has carried out dual separation filtration to mud, has improved sewage separation quality's effect.

title_en: Lake pollution treatment dosing aerator
abstract_en: The utility model provides a dosing aerator for lake pollution treatment, and relates to the field of sewage treatment equipment. Including mounting bracket and supporting leg, the supporting leg is located the below of mounting bracket and rather than fixed mounting, the top fixed mounting of mounting bracket has the explosive storage box, the below of mounting bracket is provided with elevating system respectively. This lake pollution control adds medicine aeration machine can spray the medicine after mixing to the water through aeration mechanism for mixed medicine sprays through the aeration head and goes out to mix with outside water, and the setting of cooperation elevating system again can realize aeration cylinder and aeration head high regulation, makes things convenient for the aeration head to carry out the aeration in the water of treatment different positions department and sprays the medicine operation after mixing, and then can make things convenient for the staff to administer the pollutant current of different positions department in the water, carries out effectual replenishment to the mixed medicine in the water, is favorable to the abundant degradation of microorganism, improves the effect of treating lake pollution.

title_en: Mud water balance pipe jacking construction mud circulation processing system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a mud-water balance pipe-jacking construction mud circulation treatment system which comprises a circulation mud tank, an adjusting box, a solid-liquid separation system and a water supplementing tank, wherein a vibrating screen for separating mud and sand is arranged in front of the adjusting box, the output of the adjusting box is divided into two paths, one path is connected into the circulation mud tank through a recycling mud pipeline, the other path is connected into the solid-liquid separation system through a waste mud pipeline, the solid-liquid separation system is provided with a flocculation device and a dehydrator, the effluent of the dehydrator is connected into the water supplementing tank through a water recycling pipe, and the water supplementing tank is connected with the circulation mud tank through a water supplementing pipe. The system can be used for mud treatment and circulation of the pipe pushing jack, and can adjust the concentration of circulating mud.

title_en: Be used for outdoor cable feeder pillar
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an outdoor cable branch box, and belongs to the technical field of cable branch boxes. The solar energy storage box comprises a box body, wherein a fixing frame is arranged at the bottom of an inner cavity of the box body, a rubber plate I is arranged on the inner wall of the fixing frame, an L-shaped groove is formed in the inner wall of the fixing frame, an air pump is arranged in a placing cavity, a solar photovoltaic module and a storage battery are arranged at the top of the placing plate, a rain shield plate is arranged at the top of the fixing box, a ventilating fan is arranged on the side wall of a ventilating pipeline, a dehumidifying cylindrical block is clamped inside the ventilating pipeline, a threaded cover plate is further arranged on the side wall of the ventilating pipeline, external air can be adsorbed to carbon dioxide through the dehumidifying cylindrical block by utilizing the ventilating fan, and the inside of the box body is subjected to combined dehumidification by being matched with a drying plate, so that cables with various sizes can be better fixed; when a fire disaster occurs, the smoke sensor can be used for monitoring smoke, the air pump is started when the smoke is monitored, and a plurality of spray heads are used for comprehensively spraying carbon dioxide to extinguish the fire in the box body.

title_en: Special gypsum sedimentation tank of oral cavity dentistry
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gypsum sedimentation tank special for oral and dental department, which comprises a sedimentation tank, a water baffle and a filter screen plate, wherein clamping strips A and B are fixedly connected to the inner walls of the front part and the rear part of the sedimentation tank, clamping grooves are formed in two sides of the water baffle, clamping strips A are matched and clamped in the grooves, clamping grooves are formed in two sides of the filter screen plate, clamping strips B are matched and clamped in the grooves, a sealing strip is adhered to the lower end of the water baffle, a handle A is fixedly connected to the upper end of the water baffle, and a handle B is fixedly connected to the upper end of the filter screen plate. This special gypsum sedimentation tank of oral cavity dentistry is middle waste water through the filter screen board and finally by the drain pipe discharge, the filter screen board specifically comprises the filter screen of outer frame and frame inboard, leaves impurity such as gypsum that will condense inside the sedimentation tank, and pulling handle B can take out the filter screen board, conveniently clears up the impurity of card in the filter screen mesh inside.

title_en: Premixing device for waste oil sludge carbonization
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a waste oil peat premixing device which comprises a base plate, a box body and a combustion box, wherein mounting holes are formed in two ends of the center of the combustion box, rollers are arranged in the mounting holes, a carbonization box is movably arranged on the inner side of the mounting holes, a second rotary driving piece is arranged at the center of one end of the carbonization box, a screw rod is rotatably arranged at the output end of the second rotary driving piece, and a mounting frame is movably arranged at one end of the screw rod. According to the utility model, the driving belt is arranged outside the driving belt pulley and the driven belt pulley, so that the driving belt pulley is driven to rotate by the first rotary driving piece through the rotary shaft, and the carbonization box is driven to rotate by the driving belt and the driven belt pulley, so that the carbonization box rotates along the mounting hole through the roller, the high-temperature carbonization treatment is conveniently carried out on waste oil sludge in the carbonization box, the problems that the carbonization box cannot rotate and is heated unevenly are solved, and the peat efficiency of the waste oil is improved.

title_en: Flat ceramic membrane filtration water purification equipment with high purification purity
abstract_en: The utility model provides a flat ceramic membrane filtration water purification device with high purification purity, and relates to the field of filtration water purification devices. Including the rose box, the inside left and right sides of rose box all is provided with the mounting panel, and the equal fixedly connected with rubber seal of relative one side of two mounting panels fills up, and a plurality of installing ports have all been seted up jointly to the relative one side of two rubber seal and the relative one side of mounting panel, and the inside of two corresponding installing ports is provided with dull and stereotyped ceramic membrane main part jointly, and the feed liquor chamber has been seted up on the right side of rose box. According to the utility model, by arranging the two mounting plates, all the flat ceramic membrane main bodies are conveniently mounted, so that the flat ceramic membrane main bodies can be kept stable, and the inside of the flat ceramic membrane main bodies is washed at all times by adopting a plurality of high-pressure spray heads, so that the inside of the flat ceramic membrane main bodies is cleaner, the service life of the flat ceramic membrane main bodies is prolonged, and the trouble of frequent cleaning of users is reduced.

title_en: High-purity germanium gamma energy spectrometer with sample positioning support
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-purity germanium gamma energy spectrometer with a sample positioning bracket, which comprises a box body, wherein an opening and closing structure is arranged on the surface of the box body and used for controlling opening of a door, a diffraction mechanism is arranged in the box body and comprises a mounting plate, the mounting plate is fixed in the box body, a horizontal component is arranged on the surface of the mounting plate, a driven wheel is rotatably connected to the surface of the mounting plate, and a driving wheel is rotatably connected to the surface of the mounting plate. This high-purity germanium gamma energy spectrometer with sample positioning support is through starter motor and axis of rotation to drive the diffraction pole and rotate and realize inferior circular motion, drive the diffraction pole through the stable removal of gear engagement and rotate at this in-process, the contact of horizontal piece and connection cotton can make the steady water product of diffraction pole place simultaneously, thereby can realize a complete half circumference diffraction cycle, can not appear the problem of angle misalignment.

title_en: Combustion tank bottom switch mechanism of fireplace
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a combustion tank bottom switching mechanism of a fireplace, which is characterized by comprising a furnace body, wherein a combustion tank is arranged in the furnace body, an ash removal tank is arranged below the combustion tank, a rotary side door is arranged on the furnace body, a sealing plate is connected at the bottom of the combustion tank in a sliding manner, and a connecting rod assembly is hinged between the side door and the sealing plate; the connecting rod assembly comprises a first connecting rod hinged with the side door, the other end of the first connecting rod is hinged with a second connecting rod, a rod body of the second connecting rod is sleeved with a rotating shaft, and the rotating shaft is fixed on the furnace body; the other end of the second connecting rod is hinged with a third connecting rod, the other end of the third connecting rod is hinged with a fourth connecting rod, and the other end of the fourth connecting rod is hinged with one end of the sealing plate; the fourth connecting rod is provided with a guide groove, the furnace body is fixedly provided with a guide block sliding in the guide groove, and the opening and closing of the combustion groove bottom is controlled by utilizing the opening and closing of the side door, so that the purpose of cleaning the combustion groove bottom is convenient and sanitary.

title_en: Sewage sludge separating mechanism for sludge treatment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of sewage treatment and discloses a sewage and sludge separation mechanism for sludge treatment, which comprises a base, wherein fixed vertical plates are arranged on the left side and the right side of the top of the base. This sewage sludge separating mechanism of sludge treatment uses by the cooperation that sets up filter unit, by first filter and second filter, can separate sewage that gets off and filter once more, the mud separation in sewage is in the top of first filter and second filter, and then can thoroughly separate sewage and mud, sewage sludge separating mechanism's separation effect has been improved, after sewage sludge separating mechanism uses, the cooperation of rethread two joint axles, two stripper plates and compression spring uses, can take first filter and second filter out from the inside of catchment frame, and then can clear up the mud on first filter and the second filter, avoid its jam filtration pore to influence separating mechanism's use, separating mechanism's suitability has been improved.

title_en: Gas-liquid separation tank for industrial waste treatment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gas-liquid separation tank for industrial waste treatment, which comprises a gas-liquid separation tank main body, wherein a support frame is fixedly arranged on the surface of the gas-liquid separation tank main body, a liquid outlet pipe is fixedly communicated with the bottom surface of the gas-liquid separation tank main body, and the gas-liquid separation tank for industrial waste treatment also comprises a mounting ring which is arranged on the surface of the liquid outlet pipe; and one end of the spring is fixedly connected with the inside of the mounting ring, and the other end of the spring is fixedly connected with a connecting pipe. In the above-mentioned scheme, when the clearance is dismantled to the filter screen, will cup joint the ring at first and carry out vertical migration at the surface of connecting plate, can remove the filter screen to the below of collar this moment, and then make two arc joint boards that filter screen top surface installed remove from the recess of seting up inside the collar, accomplish the dismantlement work to the filter screen promptly, consequently need not with the help of the instrument can dismantle the filter screen, effectively shortened the required time of dismantlement, guarantee the steadiness after its installation to reached the effect that improves the device practicality.

title_en: Aeration cooling cable branch case
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cable branch boxes, in particular to a ventilation and cooling cable branch box, which comprises a cable branch box body, wherein the end face of the cable branch box body is connected with a controller, the bottom of an inner cavity of the cable branch box body is connected with a temperature sensor, opposite side walls of the cable branch box body are connected with a plurality of groups of cooling fans, and the side walls of the cable branch box body and one side of the cooling fans are connected with filter screens.

title_en: UASB anaerobic tower water distribution device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a UASB anaerobic tower water distribution device which comprises a tower body, a water distribution mechanism and an agitation mechanism, wherein the water distribution mechanism comprises a positioning cone plate fixedly arranged at the upper end of the inner wall of the tower body, a positioning pipe is movably arranged in the middle of the inner wall of the positioning cone plate, a splitter plate is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the positioning pipe, the outer wall of the splitter plate is uniformly distributed and fixedly provided with a plurality of curved pipes in a circumference manner, and a supporting pipe is fixedly arranged at the other end of each curved pipe. According to the utility model, the auxiliary gear is driven to rotate by starting the servo motor, the positioning gear is driven to rotate by the connectivity between the auxiliary gear and the positioning gear, and the positioning pipe arranged in the middle of the positioning gear rotates along with the rotation of the positioning gear, so that the splitter plate is driven to rotate, and the support pipe connected by the curved pipe rotates under the cooperation of the auxiliary ring plate to rotationally spray water to the inner wall of the tower body.

title_en: Chip removing device for lathe
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a chip removing device for a lathe, which belongs to the technical field of lathes and comprises an absorption box, wherein a connecting pipe communicated with the absorption box is arranged on the front side surface of the absorption box, an absorption port is arranged at the front end of the connecting pipe, a cleaning part with a hairbrush structure is arranged on the absorption box near the front end, a discharge port is arranged on the lower side surface of the absorption box, a collecting box is arranged on the absorption box below the discharge port, a connecting part with a buckle structure is arranged between the collecting box and the absorption box, an induced draft fan is arranged at the position, which is close to the rear, of the inside of the absorption box, a filter screen is arranged at the position, which is positioned in front of the induced draft fan, of the inside of the absorption box, and the cleaning part moves up and down on the front side surface of the filter screen. Therefore, collected scraps can be cleaned conveniently and rapidly after the scraps are collected by the scraps removing device, the phenomenon of blockage on the scraps removing device is avoided, and the scraps removing efficiency of the scraps removing device is effectively guaranteed.

title_en: Buried SBR equipment
abstract_en: An embodiment of the present utility model provides an embedded SBR apparatus, comprising: a cylinder defining a reaction chamber therein to accommodate sewage to be treated; the aeration mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the reaction cavity and is suitable for aerating sewage, and the aeration amount of the aeration mechanism is configured to be adjustable so as to enable the sewage to be in an anoxic or aerobic condition; a stirring mechanism comprising: the stirring paddle is suspended at the bottom of the cylinder body and is configured to be staggered with the aeration position of the aeration mechanism in the projection in the vertical direction so as to form a channel for accommodating workers to enter the reaction cavity above the aeration position; and the driving part is arranged on the radial outer side of the cylinder body and connected with the driving shaft of the stirring paddle so as to drive the stirring paddle to rotate around the axis of the driving shaft by the radial side of the driving shaft to stir sewage.

title_en: Environment-friendly ecological wastewater deodorizing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of wastewater deodorization and purification, and discloses an environment-friendly ecological wastewater deodorization device which comprises a device base, wherein a deodorization barrel is fixedly arranged at the top of the device base, a driving mounting plate is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the inner wall of the deodorization barrel, a plurality of second leakage holes communicated with a first leakage hole are uniformly formed in the driving mounting plate, a lifting screw is arranged on the driving mounting plate, a threaded pipe is sleeved on the lifting screw through threads, a driving motor is started to drive the lifting screw arranged on a screw support to rotate, the lifting screw drives the threaded pipe to lift upwards through thread transmission, and the threaded pipe is matched with a connecting pipe to drive five leakage plates to lift upwards, so that a filter layer, a filter screen, an active carbon layer, a first deodorization layer and a purification filter element are conveniently brought out of the deodorization barrel, a secondary treatment layer which needs cleaning and replacement can be cleaned and replaced in a targeted manner, and the effect of improving the working efficiency is realized.

title_en: Flue gas recirculation system under deep peak regulation of circulating fluidized bed boiler
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a flue gas recirculation system under deep peak shaving of a circulating fluidized bed boiler, it comprises the following steps: the device comprises a hearth, an air preheater, a tail flue and a hot primary air flue; the hearth comprises an air distribution plate and a smoke outlet, an inlet of the tail flue is communicated with the smoke outlet, and an outlet of the tail flue is communicated with the outside air; the air preheater is arranged in the tail flue, one end of the hot primary air flue is communicated with the air distribution plate, the other end is communicated with an outlet of the air preheater, and an inlet of the air preheater is communicated with the outside air; the circulating assembly comprises a recirculating flue and a flue gas circulating fan, one end of the recirculating flue is communicated with the tail flue, and the other end of the recirculating flue is communicated with the hot primary air flue; the flue gas circulating fan is communicated with the recirculating flue; the flue gas in the tail flue is introduced into the hot primary air duct through the recirculation flue and the flue gas circulating fan to be mixed with the internal primary air, so that the temperature of the mixed flue gas and the temperature of the primary air are higher than the acid dew point, and the air duct and related equipment are prevented from being corroded.

title_en: Rice hull ash collecting device of rice hull combustion furnace convenient to clearance
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of boilers and discloses a rice husk ash collecting device of a rice husk combustion furnace, which is convenient to clean. Through the clearance structure that sets up, utilize the inboard and the outside of burning furnace main part to play spacing effect to slider and lifter for slider and lifter are in the inboard of burning furnace main part and the gliding more stable in the outside, utilize the reciprocal lead screw under the rotation to drive lifter and slider left and right sides reciprocating motion, make the scraper blade follow lifter left and right sides reciprocating motion, utilize the scraper blade to realize the effect of clearance to the top of stove board, avoid burning insufficiently and cause the phenomenon of stove board jam.

title_en: Special gas-liquid mixer for compressed air foam fire extinguishing system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of special gas-liquid mixers for compressed air foam fire extinguishing systems, and discloses a special gas-liquid mixer for a compressed air foam fire extinguishing system, which comprises a foam liquid accumulator tank, wherein the outer part of the foam liquid accumulator tank is fixedly connected with a front base, the back surface of the front base is provided with a rear base, the outer part of the foam liquid accumulator tank is fixedly connected with a front fixing frame, the inner side of a front fixing ring is movably sleeved with a mixing pipeline, the outer part of the mixing pipeline is fixedly connected with a pressure gauge, and the outer part of the mixing pipeline is fixedly connected with a water inlet pipeline; the utility model is beneficial to the direct operation check by using the switch button on the motor box during the daily maintenance through arranging the machine box display, so that whether the instrument works normally or not can be checked through the display, the quick and convenient instrument check is realized, and the problem that the instrument fails when the instrument is used due to long-time placement of the instrument because an operator cannot maintain the instrument is solved.

title_en: Oil removal skimming device for sewage treatment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a deoiling and skimming device for sewage treatment, which comprises: a sewage treatment tank assembly; the sewage treatment tank assembly comprises a base, a sewage treatment tank, a first hydraulic rod, a servo motor, a ball screw, a sliding block, and a drain pipe, wherein the base is arranged, the sewage treatment tank is arranged above the base, the first hydraulic rod is arranged above the base, the servo motor is connected with the first hydraulic rod, the ball screw is connected with the servo motor, the sliding block is arranged on the ball screw, and the drain pipe is connected with the side surface of the sewage treatment tank; an oil removal assembly; the oil removing assembly comprises a second hydraulic rod connected with the sliding block. According to the utility model, through the mutual matching of the sewage treatment tank structure and the oil removal structure, the oil absorption of sewage in the sewage treatment tank is realized by using the oil absorption blanket, the oil absorption can be carried out again by directly scraping the oil into the oil absorption barrel by using the scraping plate after the oil absorption blanket, the manual wringing is not needed, the oil absorption blanket is not needed to be frequently replaced, the time is greatly saved, and the influence of pollution on workers is also reduced.

title_en: Aeration device for urban sewage treatment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an aeration device for urban sewage treatment, which comprises a tank body, wherein the bottom of the right side of the tank body is communicated with an aeration pump, the bottom of the surface of the tank body is fixedly connected with a shell, the right side of the surface of the shell is fixedly connected with a first motor, and the output end of the first motor is fixedly connected with a first stirring shaft. According to the utility model, through the matched use of the tank body, the aeration pump, the shell, the first motor, the first stirring shaft, the first belt pulley, the second stirring shaft, the second belt pulley, the second motor, the rotating rod and the deflector rod, the problem that the sewage is sufficiently stirred by the aeration device, the mixing efficiency of the sewage and oxygen in the air is improved, and the aeration effect is improved because the aeration device for treating the traditional urban sewage can only perform single aeration treatment in the use process and is low in working efficiency and lacks an effective stirring mechanism, so that the sewage aeration progress is slow, thereby reducing the subsequent treatment efficiency.

title_en: Heat accumulating type combustion furnace for VOCs waste gas treatment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a regenerative combustion furnace for VOCs waste gas treatment, which comprises a furnace body, wherein an inlet chamber, an outlet chamber, a regenerative chamber and a combustion chamber are arranged in the furnace body from bottom to top, the sizes of the two ends of the regenerative chamber are the same as those of the inner wall of the furnace body, the middle size of the regenerative chamber is smaller than the sizes of the two ends, a detachable support frame is arranged on the periphery of the regenerative chamber, the support frame is fixed on the furnace body and uniformly arranged around the regenerative chamber, an inner support is arranged at the lower part of the regenerative chamber, and the sizes of the inner support are the same as those of the two ends of the regenerative chamber. The inner concave arrangement is formed in the middle part of the regenerator so as to ensure that the air flow distribution in the furnace is more reasonable, the flow speed of waste gas is accelerated, and the phenomenon that a combustion zone moves downwards is avoided.

title_en: Sewage filter
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sewage filter, which relates to the technical field of sewage treatment and comprises a cover body, wherein the lower end of the cover body is communicated with a cylinder, and the bottom end of the cylinder is rotatably connected with a base; the side wall of the cover body is fixedly provided with a water inlet pipe which is communicated with the outside and extends to the inside of the cylinder body; the water containing frame is fixedly arranged in the barrel, the tail end of the water inlet pipe is communicated with the water containing frame, a plurality of water outlet holes are formed in the surface of the barrel, a rotary rod is rotatably arranged in the water containing frame, the rotary rod penetrates through the bottom end of the water containing frame, and a plurality of stirring rods are fixedly arranged on the surface of the rotary rod; a connecting column is connected between the upper end of the water containing frame and the inside of the upper end of the cylinder; the motor is fixedly arranged on the outer side of the cylinder body, a belt is sleeved on a rotating shaft of the motor, a rolling groove is formed in the rotating rod, and the belt is sleeved on the rolling groove of the rotating rod: solves the problems that the prior preliminary filtering device for partial sewage has insufficient separation of fine sand and stones and larger sand and stones in the sewage, resulting in low efficiency of preliminary filtering of the sewage.

title_en: Feed additive production is with effluent treatment plant
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of wastewater treatment, in particular to a wastewater treatment device for feed additive production, which comprises wastewater treatment equipment, wherein the wastewater treatment equipment comprises an evaporation chamber, a reaction chamber and a filter chamber, the outer surface of the evaporation chamber is provided with the reaction chamber, the bottom of the evaporation chamber is provided with the filter chamber, the top of the evaporation chamber is provided with a water inlet hole, the inside of the evaporation chamber is provided with stirring equipment, the stirring equipment comprises a rotating shaft, the top of the rotating shaft is provided with a working motor, the outer surface of the rotating shaft is provided with a stirring frame, one end of the stirring frame, which is far away from the rotating shaft, is provided with a scraper, and the outer surface of the evaporation chamber is provided with an air suction pump, and the utility model has the advantages that: the waste water in the evaporation chamber is rapidly stirred by stirring equipment, the volatilized dichloromethane is pumped out by an air pump and is introduced into an annular vent pipe, the dichloromethane is fully reacted with the dimethyl diamide in the reaction chamber to finally remove the dichloromethane, and the waste water is introduced into the filtering chamber through a controllable pipeline to be filtered again and finally discharged through a second control valve.

title_en: Power supply device of electric flat car
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an electric flat car power supply device which comprises a storage battery and a mounting shell, wherein a heat radiating device, a protecting device and a filtering device are arranged on the mounting shell, the heat radiating device comprises a mounting frame, a heat radiating fan, an air inlet pipe and an air outlet pipe, the storage battery is arranged in the mounting shell, the mounting frame is fixedly arranged in the mounting shell, the heat radiating fan and the mounting frame are detachably connected through bolts, the air inlet pipe and the air outlet pipe are respectively arranged on two sides of the mounting shell, and the air inlet pipe is arranged on one side close to the heat radiating fan.

title_en: Vending machine refrigerating system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a vending machine refrigerating system, which comprises a box body, wherein the box body is internally provided with a refrigerating system, the refrigerating system comprises an evaporator, an evaporating fan, a compressor, a condenser and a cooling fan, the box body is internally provided with a partition plate, the box body is divided into an inner cavity and an outer cavity by the partition plate, the evaporator and the evaporating fan are arranged in the inner cavity, the back and the bottom of the outer cavity are respectively provided with a filter screen, the compressor, the condenser and the cooling fan are respectively arranged in the outer cavity and are at a certain distance from the back filter screen of the outer cavity, four corners of the bottom of the box body are also provided with a supporting device for suspending the box body, the box body is divided into the inner cavity and the outer cavity, the outer cavity is reasonably provided with the installation positions of all devices, the filter screens are reserved, the box body is suspended by the supporting device, the back and the bottom of the box body are formed into two circulation channels for heat dissipation, the refrigerating system is enhanced, and the cooling system under special conditions is ensured.

title_en: Fire extinguishing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire control, and provides a fire extinguishing device, which comprises: the device comprises a starting device, an inner bin, an outer bin, a first medicament and a cover plate; the starting device is connected with the bottom of the inner bin; the inner chamber is filled with a reaction medicament; the outer bin is sleeved on the outer wall side of the inner bin, and the cover plate covers the outer bin and the open ends of the inner bin; a first medicament is filled between the outer bin and the inner bin. The fire extinguishing device can spray different fire extinguishing substances in multiple stages so as to achieve the effect of thoroughly extinguishing a fire source and preventing re-burning.

title_en: Excrement treatment device for chicken farm
abstract_en: The application provides a chicken farm fecal treatment device relates to chicken raising auxiliary assembly technical field, including conveyer belt structure, collection structure and fog shower nozzle, the conveyer belt structure includes the support, the inboard of support is provided with the belt, the surface of belt is provided with a plurality of access hoppers, the inclined plane department processing in the access hopper outside has a plurality of connection pieces, the collection structure includes the collecting box, one side welding of collecting box is connected with two first hanging arms, the inside of collecting box is provided with the transition board, the bottom assembly type of transition board one side is connected with the filter screen, the inner wall department welding that the collecting box is close to one side of first hanging arm is connected with two backing plates; the technical key points are as follows: through a plurality of collection buckets of fixed surface at the belt, make a plurality of collection buckets end to end, conveniently collect the excrement and urine that drops to the bottom in the chicken coop, when the collection bucket moves to the top of collecting the structure along with the belt, the excrement and urine that conveniently collect the inside collection bucket is to the bottom pouring collection structure.

title_en: Intelligent detection structure of smoke sensor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent detection structure of a smoke sensor, which comprises a mounting plate, wherein a fan is arranged at the top of the mounting plate, an exhaust pipe is arranged at the top of the fan, an exhaust hood is arranged at the bottom of the mounting plate, the smoke sensor is arranged in an inner cavity of the exhaust hood, an adjusting frame is arranged on the outer ring of the exhaust hood, an air inlet notch is formed in the outer ring of the exhaust hood, and an electric push rod is arranged at the bottom of the mounting plate. This smoke sensor's intelligent detection structure, when infrared sensor monitored that the position temperature is higher, electric putter opened and drives the regulation frame and move down and expose the air inlet notch, and limit switch on the air exhauster cover breaks away from the constraint this moment, and the fan begins high-power operation, is inhaled the condition that whether to have the conflagration by smoke sensor in the air exhauster cover from the air inlet notch fast with indoor all around, has realized smoke sensor short-term test's purpose, has solved current smoke sensor and has inhaled the single problem of flue gas detection direction.

title_en: Water hose extension device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water hose extending device, which comprises a female connector detachably connected with one end of a water hose, wherein the female connector comprises an interface and a connecting pipe, and the interface is fixedly connected with one end of the connecting pipe far away from the water hose; install the butterfly valve on taking over, the butterfly valve includes valve clack and valve handle, the valve clack is installed in taking over, just the edge of valve clack is sealed laminating with the inner wall of taking over, the one end of valve handle is located the outside of taking over, just the other end setting of valve handle is in taking over and with the valve clack drive connection. The water hose extending device is arranged through the matching of the female joint and the butterfly valve, when the length of a water hose needs to be extended in the water spraying fire extinguishing process, the water hose can be blocked quickly through the butterfly valve, water is not stopped through the water separator, the length of the water hose can be extended quickly under the condition that the water hose is arranged in disorder, the water separator is not required to run back and forth, the device is convenient to operate, the speed of extending the length of the water hose is improved, and the water hose is more attached to a practical battle.

title_en: Noise reduction and dust removal mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a noise reduction and dust removal mechanism, which belongs to the technical field of noise reduction and dust removal mechanisms and comprises a noise reduction shell, wherein an exhaust pipe is arranged at the upper part of the noise reduction shell, fine noise reduction cotton is arranged in the noise reduction shell, a cylinder body is arranged in the noise reduction shell, a through hole is formed in the inner wall of the cylinder body, a cone is arranged in the cylinder body, an air inlet pipe is arranged at the right part of the noise reduction shell, the air inlet pipe penetrates through the noise reduction shell and the cylinder body and is tangentially connected with the cone, an air outlet pipe is arranged at the upper part of the cone, a dust exhaust pipe is arranged at the bottom of the cone, and a valve is arranged on the dust exhaust pipe. Solves the technical problem that the prior equipment needs to take out the filter screen for dust treatment after dust removal, thereby causing complex operation.

title_en: Water vacuum distillation heating device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of water vacuum distillation, in particular to a water vacuum distillation heating device. It solves the problem of removing waste residue when heating is impossible. The device comprises a box body, wherein a feed inlet is formed in the top end of the box body, a discharge pipe is formed in the bottom of the box body, a discharge valve is arranged on the discharge pipe, a filter screen is arranged on the inner side of the box body, a slag sucking component for adsorbing slag accumulated on the filter screen is arranged in the box body, a heating cylinder is arranged at the bottom of the inner side of the box body, a liquid inlet is formed in the top end of the heating cylinder, the inner end of the discharge pipe is communicated into the heating cylinder, a heater is arranged on the box body, the heating cylinder is made of a conductive material, a controller is further arranged on the outer side of the box body, the heater is electrically connected with the heating cylinder, and the heater is electrically connected with the controller. The utility model can remove waste residue during heating, smoothly discharge liquid in the heating cylinder, prevent heat from heating the waste residue, save electric energy, has good electricity-saving effect, can effectively reduce electric energy loss and enlarge the application range.

title_en: Ash removal device is used in production of power on box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ash removal device for producing an upper electric box body, which relates to the technical field of upper electric box bodies and comprises an ash removal device box body, wherein a movable door is arranged on the outer wall of the front side of the ash removal device box body, a top cover is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the top of the ash removal device box body, a rotating motor is fixedly arranged in an inner cavity of the top cover, the outer wall of an output shaft of the rotating motor penetrates through the inner wall of the middle end of the top of the ash removal device box body, and a turntable is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the top end of the output shaft of the rotating motor.
