According to the utility model, after the movable door is closed, the rotating motor in the top cover is started, so that the rotary table can be driven to rotate, the brush at the bottom of the box top cleaning disc is utilized to clean the top of the electric box body, and the rotary table rotates and simultaneously drives the sponge rotary drum to rotate through the driving motor, so that longer cleaning cotton wires can clean the side surface of the box body rapidly, and the effects of relieving manual ash cleaning pressure, and simultaneously realizing quick and thorough ash cleaning are achieved through a full-automatic ash cleaning method.

title_en: Can dismantle and change filter medium's pet water dispenser filter core
abstract_en: The utility model provides a filter element of a pet water dispenser, which can dismantle and replace filter media, and relates to the technical field of filter elements of pet water dispensers. According to the utility model, through the detachable design of the bottom shell and the upper cover, the structural problem that the key parts are not detachable and replaced in the conventional pet water dispenser filter element can be solved, so that the filter medium can be freely replaced, the effects of reasonably utilizing and maximizing resources are achieved, unnecessary waste is reduced, meanwhile, the pollution to the environment is reduced, the service period is prolonged, the filter element is used more environmentally and effectively, the filtering effect on water can be further improved through the cooperation of various filter mediums, and the drinking water is safer and healthier.

title_en: Acrylonitrile wastewater recovery processing system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of water treatment, in particular to an acrylonitrile wastewater recovery treatment system which comprises an air flotation recovery unit, an oil-water separation unit, a Fenton oxidation unit and a biochemical treatment unit which are connected in sequence; the air floatation recovery unit and the oil-water separation unit are used for recovering slightly soluble oily materials in the acrylonitrile wastewater, and the oil-water separation unit comprises a graphene oil-water separator; the Fenton oxidation unit is used for oxidizing and decomposing part of organic matters which are difficult to biodegrade in the acrylonitrile wastewater into organic matters which are easy to biodegrade, so that the biodegradability of the wastewater is improved; the biochemical treatment unit is used for carrying out biochemical treatment on the wastewater. The system can fully recycle organic matters in the acrylonitrile wastewater after treating the acrylonitrile wastewater, reduce resource waste, and can further carry out advanced treatment on the wastewater after recycling treatment, so that the wastewater is discharged after reaching standards, and the system has the advantages of low energy consumption, simple operation and low running cost.

title_en: Supporting component and filter bag mounting structure of bag-type dust collector
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of adjustability, in particular to a supporting component and a filter bag installation structure of a bag-type dust collector, wherein the supporting component comprises: the filter bag mounting plate is clamped between the plurality of groups of inserted bars, the plurality of groups of inserted bars are uniformly and slidingly connected to the surface of the cross bar, the two ends of the cross bar are rotationally connected with first rotating columns, the first rotating columns are connected with first rotating blocks, the first rotating blocks are slidingly connected to the inside of the vertical rods, the bottoms of the vertical rods are rotationally connected with second rotating columns, the second rotating columns are connected with second rotating blocks, the second rotating blocks are slidingly connected to the inside of the base, the two ends of the base are connected with connecting pieces, and the connecting pieces are connected with connecting rods; the beneficial effects are as follows: according to the support assembly provided by the utility model, the positions of the cross rod and the vertical rod can be quickly adjusted by rotating the first handle and the second handle, so that filter bag mounting plates with various sizes are used, and the cross rod, the vertical rod, the base, the connecting rod and the inserted rod can be independently dismounted respectively, so that the support assembly is more convenient to transport.

title_en: Multipole superimposed dust collector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multipole stacked dust collecting device, which belongs to the technical field of gas dust removal and comprises a mounting plate, wherein the upper surface of the mounting plate is fixedly connected with a box body, a purifying bin and a sterilizing bin are arranged in the box body, the sterilizing bin is arranged on the side surface of the purifying bin, a sliding groove is fixedly connected in the purifying bin, a sliding block penetrates through the sliding groove, the top end of the sliding block is fixedly connected with a dust collector body, the upper surface of the box body is fixedly connected with a blower, and the surface of the blower is fixedly connected with an air duct.

title_en: Implementation monitoring device for fire extinguishment of ship
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of ships, and particularly relates to an implementation monitoring device for fire extinguishment of a ship. The smoke detector senses smoke around the equipment, the camera can be rotated through the second motor, the periphery of the camera equipment is monitored, the monitoring range of the equipment is improved, the dead angle of the monitoring of the equipment is reduced, the fourth connecting plate is pulled, the limiting rod is pulled out of the third connecting plate, the third connecting plate and the smoke detector are detached from the equipment, otherwise, the limiting rod limits the third connecting plate through the elastic force generated by the spring, the operation is simple, the smoke detector is detached, replaced and installed by an operator conveniently, and therefore the working efficiency of the disassembly and the installation of the equipment is improved.

title_en: Water treatment device of industrial circulating water fish and vegetable symbiotic planting and breeding system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water treatment device of a factory circulating water fish and vegetable symbiotic planting and breeding system, which comprises a precipitation unit, a fermentation unit, a filtering overflow pipe, a fertilizer preparation device and a nitrification tank, wherein the lower end of the precipitation unit is cone-shaped, filtering holes are circumferentially distributed on the side edge of the lower end of the filtering overflow pipe, the bottom end of the filtering overflow pipe is connected with the bottom of the precipitation unit through threads, the filtering overflow pipe and the precipitation unit jointly realize the precipitation and filtration of a culture water body, the fermentation unit comprises a fermentation vat, a waste stirrer, a waste partition plate and a liquid collecting tank, the fertilizer preparation device is of a venturi structure, the filtered culture clear water and fermentation liquid are prepared in proportion, a fertilizer liquid outlet of the fertilizer preparation device is connected with the nitrification tank, and the fertilizer liquid is subjected to nitrification and denitrification treatment so as to realize the purification and recycling of the culture water body. The utility model has compact and simple structure and high integration level, can ferment the cultured solid waste in the system and adjust the water and fertilizer, can effectively reduce the labor intensity, improve the water treatment efficiency, and has the advantages of saving cost, improving efficiency, protecting environment and the like.

title_en: Dismounting module
abstract_en: The utility model provides a disassembly and assembly module, which relates to the technical field of fire extinguishing devices and comprises: the connecting piece is connected with the multi-pipe emission module of the modularized multi-pipe fire extinguishing device; the sliding rail is connected to the connecting piece and provided with a limiting clamping groove; the locking seat is used for connecting the sighting device and is provided with a clamping strip matched with the limiting clamping groove; a locking block; wherein, locking seat and latch segment are both cooperateed with the slide rail and can dismantle the connection together. Compared with the original fixed mounting mode of the sighting device, the sighting device can be conveniently and rapidly dismounted through the arrangement of the dismounting module, so that the safety of the sighting device is effectively protected, and the service life of the sighting device is prolonged.

title_en: Environment-friendly water mist dust removal equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses environment-friendly water mist dust removal equipment, and relates to the technical field of dust removal equipment. The utility model comprises a first rack, wherein a first tank body is arranged on the first rack, and a control box is arranged at one end of the first tank body; the second rack is positioned on one side of the first rack, a second tank body is arranged on the second rack, the outer side wall of the second tank body is communicated with and connected with a first connecting pipe, and the first connecting pipe is connected with the control box. According to the utility model, through the first fence, the situation that dust falls on the ground is reduced, the problem that water accumulation can occur on the ground around the dust collecting equipment when the dust collecting equipment is continuously used is solved, the problem of water resource waste is reduced, and the use process of the environment-friendly water mist dust collecting equipment is more convenient.

title_en: Waste gas treatment device for lead recovery of waste lead-acid storage battery
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a waste gas treatment device for recovering lead from a waste lead-acid storage battery, which belongs to the field of waste gas treatment and comprises the following components: two reaction mechanisms; the reaction mechanism comprises a reaction cylinder and a liquid injection assembly; the liquid injection assembly is used for injecting reaction liquid into the reaction cylinder; the reaction cylinder is internally provided with a reaction liquid and a spiral flow passage; the reaction liquids in the two reaction cylinders are respectively acidic and alkaline liquids of two different types; the upper side of the other reaction cylinder is communicated with one end of a tail end purification assembly. The utility model ensures that the waste gas continuously moves in the spiral flow channel, is in mixed contact reaction with the reaction liquid, plays a role in effectively reducing dust and particulate matters in the waste gas, and the fully reacted waste gas is discharged from the tail end of the spiral flow channel; the PH detector can detect the concentration of the internal reaction liquid in real time, when the concentration of the reaction liquid is reduced, the normal concentration reaction liquid is injected into the reaction cylinder by the liquid injection component, so that the reaction liquid in the reaction cylinder is always maintained in a stable range, and the reaction effect of continuous introduction of waste gas is ensured.

title_en: Fire-fighting pressurizing and pressure-stabilizing water supply equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire-fighting pressurizing and pressure-stabilizing water supply device, which belongs to the technical field of fire-fighting devices and aims at solving the problem that the fire-fighting pressurizing and pressure-stabilizing water supply device is difficult to move due to overlarge quality, and the fire-fighting pressurizing and pressure-stabilizing water supply device comprises fixing plates, wherein the fixing plates are respectively fixed at the front and rear parts of the left side of the bottom wall of a bottom plate, an axle is penetrated and rotatably connected in the middle part between the fixing plates, wheels are fixed at the front and rear ends of the axle, a double-head motor is arranged in the middle part of the axle, and the double-head motor is fixed at the left side of the middle part of the bottom wall of the bottom plate; according to the utility model, when the fire-fighting pressurizing and pressure-stabilizing water supply equipment is required to be moved, the double-headed motor is started, the output shaft of the double-headed motor rotates to enable the axle to rotate, so that the left wheel rotates to drive the bottom plate and the upper equipment thereof to move, the electric push rod is started in the moving process, the output end of the electric push rod extends to enable the toothed plate to move back and forth, so that the universal wheel is driven to rotate under the cooperation of the toothed plate and the gear, the moving direction of the water supply equipment is controlled, and the moving difficulty of the water supply equipment is reduced.

title_en: Reverse osmosis water treatment equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses reverse osmosis water treatment equipment, which comprises a base, wherein a supporting rod is fixed on the surface of the base, a top plate is fixed on the surface of the supporting rod, a top cover is fixedly arranged on the inner side surface of the top plate, a sleeve is clamped at the bottom of the top cover, a reverse osmosis filter element is filled in the sleeve, a first guide pipe is arranged on the surface of the top cover, a second guide pipe is arranged at the lower end of the sleeve, a bulge is arranged at the bottom of the first guide pipe, the bulge is inserted on the inner side surface of the second guide pipe, an inner bulge is arranged on the surface of the sleeve, the inner bulge is clamped on the lower end surface of the top cover, an extrusion plate is sleeved outside the supporting rod, the outer surface of the supporting rod is connected with a nut through threads, a top cover and the sleeve are separated, the guide pipes are inserted and installed in a mutually inserting mode during installation, the sleeve is extruded through the bottom extrusion plate, the ascending clamping is fixed, the shell is convenient to detach, and the filter element is convenient to replace.

title_en: Purification device for biochemical effluent of landfill leachate treatment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of landfill leachate treatment equipment, in particular to a purification device for biochemical effluent of landfill leachate treatment, which comprises the following components: the foam separator, the reaction barrel, the sedimentation tank and the disinfection tank are all connected through a conveying pipe, a filter plate is arranged at the upper end of the primary screening solution collecting barrel, a scraper is arranged at the upper end of the filter plate, and an air cylinder is arranged at the input end of the scraper; the filter screen filters bigger impurity and then separates solute or granule in the leachate through the foam separator and carries out secondary treatment to the landfill leachate, and finally the purification of the leachate is accomplished through adding medicine reaction precipitation, so that the dosage of the medicine of a leachate biochemical treatment mechanism is reduced, the operation cost of equipment is reduced, the possibility of blocking a pipeline is reduced by setting a water seepage film and a filter plate to filter the landfill leachate, and the frequency of equipment maintenance dredging is reduced.

title_en: Enameled wire exhaust-gas treatment secondary catalysis heat recovery equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses enameled wire waste gas treatment secondary catalytic heat energy recovery equipment, which comprises a shell, a catalytic mechanism and a consumption reducing mechanism, wherein enameled wire waste gas is introduced into the shell; the catalytic mechanism is arranged in the shell, and the enameled wire waste gas in the shell is heated and catalyzed when the catalytic mechanism works; the waste reduction mechanism is arranged on one side of the shell, the waste reduction mechanism is used for guiding the high-temperature air which is heated and catalyzed by the catalytic mechanism in the shell into the shell again and is close to the catalytic mechanism, and the enameled wire waste gas treatment secondary catalytic heat recovery device replaces the traditional mode of carrying out catalytic heat recovery on waste gas in enameled wire waste gas treatment, so that the problem that the heated and catalyzed high-temperature air cannot be timely recycled in the catalytic process, and the energy consumption is high in the heating and catalytic process is avoided.

title_en: Fire monitoring and early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of oil immersed transformer fire extinguishment and discloses a fire monitoring and early warning device, which comprises an oil immersed transformer and a transformer terminal box fixedly arranged on one side of the oil immersed transformer, wherein a cover plate is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the transformer terminal box, a support mechanism is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the cover plate, a fire detector is arranged at the upper end of the support mechanism, a motion contact of the fire detector is led into the transformer terminal box, the fire detector is used for detecting fire and sending out a fire alarm signal, a mixture of combustible gas leads to a main transformer fire after contacting and rubbing with air, and when the temperature sensing fire detector detects the main transformer fire, the device sends out the main transformer fire signal, combines a heavy gas motion signal and a breaker jump signal, and starts a fire extinguishing program.

title_en: Desulfurizing tower
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a desulfurizing tower. The desulfurizing tower comprises a cylinder body, an upper sealing head and a lower sealing head which are matched with the cylinder body, wherein the upper sealing head and the lower sealing head are respectively connected with two ends of the cylinder body, a gas outlet is formed in the upper sealing head, and a tower kettle liquid outlet is formed in the bottom of the lower sealing head; a gas distributor is arranged in the cylinder body, and a first reaction section is arranged below the gas distributor; a desulfurizing liquid distributor and a reaction section tower plate are arranged in the middle section of the cylinder body above the gas distributor, and the reaction section tower plate and the desulfurizing liquid distributor form a second reaction section in the desulfurizing tower; the upper section of the cylinder body is a washing section, a washing liquid distributor is arranged in the washing section, and a washing section tower plate or filler is filled in the washing section. The device is suitable for wet desulfurization, has high desulfurization efficiency, is not easy to block, and has less desulfurizing liquid carried by the purified gas at the outlet.

title_en: Biomass compression molding fuel boiler soot blower
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a biomass compression molding fuel boiler soot blower, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the left side of the top of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a fuel boiler, the right side of the top of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a filter box, the top of the filter box is fixedly provided with a dust collector, the output end of the dust collector is fixedly connected with a second pipeline, the input end of the dust collector is fixedly connected with a first pipeline, the right side of the filter box is fixedly provided with a first driving motor, and the output end of the first driving motor is fixedly connected with a stirring rod. The utility model belongs to the technical field of boilers, and aims to solve the problems that a soot blower for a biomass compression molding fuel boiler does not have a dust removal function in the prior art, a large amount of dust can escape when the inner cavity of the fuel boiler is subjected to soot blowing, a user can damage the body after inhaling, and the health of the user is greatly endangered. The technical effects achieved are as follows: and (5) dedusting.

title_en: Water purification equipment for water treatment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of water purification equipment and discloses water purification equipment for water treatment, which comprises a bottom plate and a filter screen, wherein the right side of the top of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a filter box, the inside of the front side and the rear side of the bottom of the filter box is provided with an inner groove, the left side of the inner groove is in sliding connection with a compression bar, the right side of the compression bar is rotationally connected with a connecting rod, the other end of the connecting rod is rotationally connected with a connecting rod, the inside of the front side and the rear side of the bottom of the filter box is provided with a sliding groove, the inner wall of the sliding groove is slidingly connected with a sliding block, the inside of the sliding groove is provided with a spring, and the front side and the rear side of the bottom of the filter screen are fixedly connected with a fixed block. According to the utility model, stirring of the water purifying equipment during heating is realized, so that the mixing efficiency is improved, the sterilizing and disinfecting effects are improved, the filter screen is mounted and dismounted, the filter screen is convenient to replace, and the efficiency of the water treatment equipment is improved.

title_en: Automatic sewage treatment equipment for sewage treatment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses automatic sewage treatment equipment for sewage treatment, and relates to the technical field of sewage treatment equipment. The sewage treatment device comprises a treatment box and universal wheels arranged at four corners of the bottom of the treatment box, wherein a sewage pipe is arranged at the top of the outer wall of one side of the treatment box, a drain pipe is arranged at the bottom of the outer wall of the other side of the treatment box, an activated carbon net is arranged at one side of the interior of the treatment box, filter screens are uniformly arranged at intervals along the horizontal direction at one side of the activated carbon net, an air blowing assembly is arranged at the bottom of the outer wall of one side of the treatment box, and a cleaning assembly is arranged at one side of the interior of the treatment box. According to the utility model, the air blowing assembly and the cleaning assembly can drive sewage and chemicals in the treatment box to continuously roll, so that the chemicals are prevented from sinking, the sewage treatment effect and efficiency are improved, and the cleaning brush on the inner wall of the rotating plate is utilized to achieve the purpose of cleaning the surfaces of the filter screen and the activated carbon net, thereby reducing the labor intensity of workers and having high efficiency.

title_en: Double-deck fire prevention curtain
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a double-layer fireproof curtain wall, which comprises a keel, wherein a supporting frame is rotatably connected to the surface of the keel, a slot and a groove are respectively formed in the surface of the supporting frame, double-layer fireproof glass is inserted into the inner wall of the slot, a fixing mechanism is arranged on the inner wall of the groove and comprises a connecting rod which is connected to the inner wall of the groove in a sliding mode, a fixing plate is arranged at one end of the connecting rod, a contraction spring which drives the fixing plate to move inwards is arranged on the surface of the connecting rod, a clamping mechanism is arranged on the surface of the supporting frame, a limiting mechanism is arranged on the inner wall of the supporting frame, the clamping mechanism comprises a cylinder arranged on the side face of the supporting frame, and a compression spring is arranged on the inner wall of the cylinder. Compared with the prior art, the double-layer fireproof curtain wall not only can be quickly assembled and disassembled by arranging the fixing mechanism, the clamping mechanism and the limiting mechanism, but also is simple to operate, easy to operate and free of additional training, and labor and material resources are greatly saved.

title_en: Pig house air filtration epidemic prevention device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pig house air filtration epidemic prevention device, which comprises a main body, wherein one end of the main body is fixedly connected with a ventilation pipe, the outer side surface of the ventilation pipe is fixedly connected with a metal net, one end of the ventilation pipe is fixedly connected with a fan, the other end of the main body is provided with an air outlet, an air deflector is arranged in the air outlet, an efficient filter plate core is arranged in the main body, the upper end of the main body is fixedly connected with a sterilizing liquid tank, one end of the sterilizing liquid tank is fixedly connected with a high-pressure water pump, the high-pressure water pump is connected with a water outlet pipe, an atomization spray nozzle is fixedly connected onto the water outlet pipe, a sewage collecting box is arranged in the main body, a plurality of U-shaped limiting plates are fixedly connected onto the upper end and the lower end of the main body, and a dustproof net and primary filter cotton are arranged in the ventilation pipe. The filter core is fixed through setting up U type limiting plate, threaded rod and grip block to can dismantle the convenient filter core of changing.

title_en: Deodorization purifying and sterilizing box
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of air purification and disinfection, in particular to a deodorizing and purifying disinfection box which comprises a mounting frame, a ventilation box body connected to the mounting frame, a first air filtering component, a high-energy ion generator, a plasma electrostatic device and a second air filtering component which are all contained in the ventilation box body, wherein an air inlet and an air outlet are respectively formed in two ends of the ventilation box body, the air inlet, the first air filtering component, the plasma electrostatic device, the second air filtering component and the air outlet are sequentially communicated along the air discharging direction, indoor air is primarily filtered and purified through the first air filtering component, odor in the air is decomposed by the high-energy ion generator, bacteria and viruses in the air are killed through the plasma electrostatic device, and then the air is further purified through the second air filtering component and then discharged into the atmosphere, so that the requirements of dust removal, deodorization and disinfection are better met, and the assisting odor purification treatment and treatment are realized.

title_en: Calcination purifying spray tower
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of environmental protection equipment, and discloses a roasting purification spray tower which comprises a tower body, wherein a fixed rod is fixedly arranged in the tower body, a flow guide piece is arranged above the fixed rod, the outer sides of the flow guide pieces are spaced from the inner wall of the tower body, and ventilation pipes are spirally wound on the outer sides of the flow guide pieces. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the fixed rod, the guide piece, the vent pipe, the heat absorbing plate, the water storage tank, the drain valve and the water inlet valve, when hot waste gas generated by roasting enters from the bottom of the tower body, the hot waste gas rises through the vent pipe, and the vent pipe is spirally arranged, so that the rising speed of the hot waste gas is slowed down, the heat absorbing plate can fully absorb the heat of the hot waste gas in the vent pipe, and then the heat absorbing plate heats the water in the water storage tank for use, so that the heat in the waste gas can be fully utilized.

title_en: Cement production line sprays dust remover
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of spraying dust removal tools for cement production and discloses a spraying dust remover for a cement production line, which comprises a dust removal box, a mounting frame and a water tank, wherein an exhaust fan is fixedly mounted on the inner wall of the mounting frame, one side of the mounting frame is connected with a dust conveying pipe through bolts, the middle part of the side surface of the dust removal box is connected with a connecting pipe in a penetrating way, the top of the inner side wall of the dust removal box is connected with a clamping block through bolts, and the inner wall of the clamping block is connected with a water conveying pipe for conveying water in a clamping way. This cement manufacture line sprays dust remover, through the setting of installing frame, dust conveying pipe, dust removal case, water tank and play water spray head, install the installing frame in one side of cement manufacture shop wall, carry out the dust fall to the inside dust of dust removal case and handle, be favorable to collecting the dust of workshop inside in unison, be convenient for spray water dust fall to the dust after collecting, improved the efficiency of dust fall, prevent that the inside dust accumulation of workshop from causing the influence to production safety.

title_en: VOCS waste gas treatment device for printing industry
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of VOCS waste gas treatment, and discloses a VOCS waste gas treatment device in the printing industry, which comprises a treatment box and zeolite molecular sieve plates, wherein a plugboard is detachably arranged at the top of the inner wall of the treatment box, and a plurality of groups of zeolite molecular sieve plates are fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the plugboard at equal intervals; according to the utility model, the driving motor drives the first conical gear to drive the second conical gear, so that the penetrating shaft and the peripheral rotary blades can rotate on the surface of the zeolite molecular sieve plate, and the rotary blades can be close to the cleaning brush on the surface of the zeolite molecular sieve plate to clean the surface honeycomb adsorption holes of the zeolite molecular sieve plate, so that impurities blocked by the honeycomb adsorption holes on the surface of the zeolite molecular sieve plate can be scraped, and the blocking of the honeycomb adsorption holes is avoided; the sealing plate, the plugboard and the plurality of groups of zeolite molecular sieve plates in the interior can be taken out from the treatment box integrally by disassembling the fixing bolts on the sealing plate at the top of the plugboard, so that the zeolite molecular sieve plates can be replaced conveniently.

title_en: Air drying device for vibrating screen
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of air drying, and discloses an air drying device for a vibrating screen, which comprises a mounting plate, wherein the top end of the mounting plate is connected with a dust screen through a mounting structure in a clamping way, one end of the mounting plate is fixedly connected with a cleaning structure, two sides of the bottom end of the mounting plate are fixedly connected with mounting frames, and a connecting rod is fixedly connected with the middle position of the bottom end of each mounting frame. This air-drying device for shale shaker can clear up the surface of dust screen through cleaning the structure, avoids dust piece to pile up and influences the air-dry effect, can promote the piece on dust screen surface through the brush cleaner and clear up to one end for the device can remain service condition all the time in the in-process of carrying out the air-drying, avoids causing the damage of fan because of the piece drops, can assist the reset on the brush cleaner position through reset spring, is convenient for carry out the pull clearance repeatedly, can be convenient for carry out the pull through the shape of pull rod, the flexibility when increasing the use.

title_en: Waste water purifying device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wastewater purification device, which comprises a shell, wherein a water inlet hopper is inserted into the inner top of the shell, a filter screen is detachably arranged in the water inlet hopper, a hard pipe is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the water inlet hopper, an adsorption mechanism is arranged below the hard pipe, the adsorption mechanism comprises an adsorption shell, the hard pipe is connected with a connecting port, a plurality of adsorption particles are arranged in the adsorption shell, a water outlet is formed in the bottom of the adsorption shell, a baffle is fixedly arranged at the water outlet, a plurality of water holes are formed in the baffle, a connecting pipe is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the shell, a stirring mechanism is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the connecting pipe, the stirring mechanism comprises a stirring shell, a purifying agent box is arranged at the top of the stirring shell, a water pump is arranged in the purifying agent box, and a plurality of electric spray heads are arranged at the bottom of the transverse pipe.

title_en: Distributed flue gas temperature compensation device
abstract_en: The application discloses a distributed flue gas temperature compensation device, which comprises a furnace body, a flue, a combustor, a fuel supply valve group, a static mixer, a temperature measuring component and a control component, wherein the furnace body is provided with a gas inlet; the furnace body is arranged in the flue, and two ends of the furnace body are respectively fixed with the flue wall plates without independent support; a plurality of hot air discharge holes are uniformly formed on the side wall of the furnace body; the combustion head of the burner extends into the furnace body; the fuel supply valve group is arranged on a feed pipe of the furnace body; the temperature measuring component comprises a sensor for monitoring the temperature of the inlet and the outlet of the flue, and the temperature measuring component and the fuel supply valve group are both in signal connection with the control component; the application realizes a multi-point uniform distribution and distributed exhaust structure through the hot air discharge holes on the furnace body, and further disturbed flow is realized through the static mixer, so that the cold air and the hot air are mixed more fully and uniformly, the temperature deviation condition is avoided, the automatic temperature control is more accurate, and the flue gas temperature compensation device provided by the application has the advantages of simple and reliable structure, accurate temperature control, balanced temperature rise and low installation and construction requirements.

title_en: Spray dust device for building demolition
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of dust fall, and particularly provides a spray dust fall device for building demolition, which comprises a shell, a rotating shaft arranged on the shell, a spray pipe arranged on the rotating shaft and a driving device for driving the rotating shaft, wherein a detected block is arranged on the rotating shaft, a first detection device and a second detection device are arranged on the shell, the first detection device and the second detection device are circumferentially arranged at intervals around the rotating shaft, and a controller for controlling the driving device to drive the detected block to rotate between the first detection device and the second detection device is arranged on the shell. The utility model can realize the oscillating operation in a certain angle by controlling the rotating shaft to drive the spray pipe, and the oscillating angle is adjustable, thereby having the characteristics of low cost, simple operation and stable work.

title_en: Medicament adding device with detection function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a medicament adding device with a detection function, which comprises a machine body, wherein the left end of the machine body is fixedly connected with a monitoring box, the middle part of the machine body is fixedly connected with a power supply box, the right end of the machine body is fixedly connected with a medicament spraying box, the upper end of the medicament spraying box is provided with an electric rotating shaft seat, the upper end of the electric rotating shaft seat is fixedly connected with a pump machine, the output end of the pump machine is fixedly connected with a stretchable hose, the right end of the stretchable hose is fixedly connected with a spray head, and the upper end of the power supply box is fixedly connected with a solar panel.

title_en: Exhaust treatment device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of waste gas treatment, in particular to a device for waste gas treatment, which comprises a base and a dust removing cloth bag, wherein the top of the base is fixedly provided with a connecting seat and a vertical frame, the vertical frames are provided with two groups and are positioned at two sides of the connecting seat, waste gas enters the connecting seat through connecting ports and enters the dust removing cloth bag, dust and impurities are filtered out through the dust removing cloth bag and then discharged to the outer side of the dust removing cloth bag, dust and impurities are easily attached to the dust removing cloth bag, the filtering effect of the dust removing cloth bag is reduced, a power supply of a driving motor is switched on, the driving motor rotates a disc, a deflector rod rotates in a circular shape of the disc and is poked in a chute of a swinging arm, so that the swinging arm repeatedly swings around the connecting position of a fixing frame, and further repeatedly knocks the dust removing cloth bag through side plates at two sides, compared with a back-blowing structure, the efficiency of inertial dust removing is more efficient, and waste gas backflow cannot be caused.

title_en: Spraying support structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a spray bracket structure, which comprises a bracket body, a base and an adjusting mechanism; the base is arranged on the frame body; the adjusting mechanism comprises a clamping part, an abutting part and an adjusting part; the clamping part comprises a first clamping plate and a second clamping plate, the first clamping plate and the second clamping plate are respectively hinged to two sides of the base, and a clamping area for clamping a pipeline is formed between the first clamping plate and the second clamping plate; the abutting part comprises two movable plates and a pushing rod; the movable plates are hinged to one surfaces of the first clamping plate and the second clamping plate, which are opposite to each other, and one ends of the two movable plates, which are far away from the first clamping plate or the second clamping plate, are hinged to the frame body. The bracket for the spray pipe solves the technical problems that in the prior art, the clamping efficiency of the pipe body is low, the mounting and dismounting process is complicated, and the mounting and dismounting efficiency of staff is intangibly reduced.

title_en: Automatic water disinfection device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a water quality automatic disinfection device, which comprises a bottom plate; the top of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a disinfection tank and a detection tank respectively, a water quality detector is arranged above the detection tank, and a transparent panel is arranged on one side of the detection tank; the mounting mechanism is arranged at the top of the detection tank and comprises a mounting seat, connecting rods, limiting plates, connecting blocks and springs, wherein the connecting rods are connected with the inner walls of the mounting seat in a sliding mode, the number of the connecting rods is two, and one end of each connecting rod is fixedly connected with each limiting plate. The automatic water quality sterilizing device solves the problems that the existing automatic water quality sterilizing devices do not have the function of automatically detecting water quality, so that workers are required to sample and then test after water quality sterilization is finished, the operation steps are complicated, and the working efficiency is reduced.

title_en: Waste gas purifying device of cleaning agent production line
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an exhaust gas purification device of a cleaning agent production line, which comprises a purification box and a box door arranged on the purification box, wherein a control panel and a handle rod are arranged on the outer wall of the box door, an exhaust fan is arranged at the top of the purification box, a water collecting box is arranged at the bottom of the inner wall of the purification box, a spray head driven by a driving component is arranged in the purification box, a pump is fixed on the inner wall of the purification box, the water inlet end of the pump penetrates through the purification box, the pump is connected with the spray head through a water pipe, a stirring mechanism connected with the driving component is arranged in the purification box, a drain pipe is arranged on the outer wall of the water collecting box, the driving component comprises a threaded screw rod rotatably arranged in the purification box, and a bidirectional motor with an output shaft coaxially fixed with the threaded screw rod is fixed on the outer wall of the purification box. The utility model combines the sprayed water body and the mixed and stirred water body to perform better adsorption effect on the soluble smell in the cleaning agent.

title_en: Railway photovoltaic ecological cover
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of railway equipment, and particularly relates to a railway photovoltaic ecological cover, which comprises a basic steel frame for covering a railway track, roof boards arranged at the top of the basic steel frame, and sound absorption side wall boards arranged at two sides of the basic steel frame, wherein the roof boards are provided with ventilation openings; the roof panel is provided with a plurality of photovoltaic components in the area except the ventilation openings. According to the utility model, the railway track and the railway vehicle are covered by the ecological cover, so that the railway is isolated from the surrounding environment, and the problems of noise pollution, tail gas pollution, dust pollution and the like of the railway are effectively solved; the photovoltaic component is arranged on the roof board, so that the roof board is safe and stable, and the open and non-shielding environment at two sides of a railway can be fully utilized to carry out photovoltaic power generation, thereby realizing energy conservation and emission reduction; meanwhile, the ventilation opening is formed in the roof board at the top of the ecological cover, so that heat generated during running of a train in the ecological cover can be timely dissipated, and meanwhile, wind pressure generated during running of the train in the ecological cover is timely relieved.

title_en: Water tank disinfectant slow release ware
abstract_en: The utility model provides a slow release device for a water tank disinfectant. The water tank disinfectant slow release device comprises: the assembly frame is arranged on the water tank; the liquid storage tank is used for containing disinfectant for slow release addition and is arranged on the assembly frame; the conveying pipe is used for conveying disinfectant, is rotatably arranged on the assembly frame, and the liquid outlet end of the conveying pipe extends into the water tank; the annular spray pipe is used for spraying disinfectant and is fixedly communicated with the liquid outlet end of the conveying pipe; and the funnel is fixedly communicated with the liquid inlet end of the conveying pipe. The water tank disinfectant slow release device provided by the utility model has the advantages of uniform disinfectant addition and distribution, simpler operation and use and contribution to improving the disinfection effect.

title_en: Water inlet structure of prefabricated pump station
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water inlet structure of a prefabricated pump station, which comprises the following components: the main body water inlet unit comprises a water inlet tank, a front water inlet pipe and a rear water inlet pipe which are respectively arranged at two ends of the water inlet tank and are communicated with the water inlet tank; dirt filter unit, it includes the installing frame that matches with the intake box cross section and fixed connection is at the shutoff lid of installing frame upper end, set up on the intake box with shutoff lid matched breach, and shutoff lid and intake box pass through multiunit evenly distributed's fastening screw fastening connection, install coarse filter screen, active carbon filter layer and millipore filtration membrane side by side in the installing frame, the active carbon filter layer is located between coarse filter screen and the millipore filtration membrane, the coarse filter screen is close to preceding inlet tube setting. The utility model solves the defect that impurities in water are easy to adhere to the water supply pipeline to cause the blockage of the subsequent water supply pipeline in the process of supplying water to users through the prefabricated pump station.

title_en: Hydraulic control system and working machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of hydraulic systems, and provides a hydraulic control system and a working machine. In a hydraulic control system, a two-speed control valve set comprises a speed switching valve and a damping hole. The speed switching valve and the damping hole are mutually connected in parallel and are connected between the oil source and the oil cylinder. The speed switching valve is provided with a high-speed communication position and a low-speed cut-off position. In the state of the high-speed communication position, an oil inlet and an oil outlet of the speed switching valve are communicated with each other, and the oil cylinder is communicated with an oil source through the oil inlet and the oil outlet of the speed switching valve; in the state of the low-speed stop position, an oil inlet and an oil outlet of the speed switching valve are mutually stopped, and the oil cylinder is communicated with an oil source through a damping hole. The working state of the speed switching valve is adjusted by staff according to actual demands, so that the oil cylinder can realize fast motion or slow and stable motion, and the application range of the speed switching valve is more flexible and wider. In addition, the hydro-cylinder can realize little backpressure oil return, and then, can reduce hydraulic control system's overflow heat.

title_en: Goods shelves are sold to hardware products
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of sales shelves, in particular to a hardware sales shelf, which comprises a shelf main body, wherein the shelf main body comprises a container, a movable door in sliding connection with the container, a drying box fixed in the container, a filter screen arranged in the drying box, and an activated carbon filter plate arranged in the drying box, wherein a functional plate is arranged in the movable door. Firstly, a function board is arranged in a movable door and is arranged into a turnover structure, when the display is needed, a tool hanging rod is outwards displayed, when the display is needed, the tool hanging rod is turned over to be stored between the function board and the movable door, attractive appearance is ensured when the display is not needed, meanwhile, a dustproof effect can be achieved, a locking mechanism is used for locking the turned function board, and the locking mechanism has the advantages of stability and convenience; secondly, the filter screen and the activated carbon filter plate are simultaneously arranged in the drying box, and then the dust removing mechanism is arranged for rapidly cleaning and accommodating dust on the filter screen, so that air circulation and filtering effect are ensured.

title_en: Sewage treatment agent sowing device for sewage treatment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sewage treatment agent sowing device for sewage treatment, which comprises a box body, a stirring mechanism, a scraping mechanism and a spraying mechanism, wherein the stirring mechanism comprises a first motor, the upper end of the first motor is provided with a stirring rod, the scraping mechanism comprises a second motor, the output end of the second motor is provided with a threaded screw rod, the surface of the threaded screw rod is in threaded connection with a threaded block, the upper surface of the box body is fixedly connected with a sliding rod, the surface of the sliding rod is in sliding connection with a sliding block, a connecting rod is fixedly connected between the sliding block and the threaded block, and the lower end of the connecting rod is provided with a scraping plate. Through the structure, after the tank body storing the sewage treatment agent is emptied, the inner wall of the tank body which is remained with the effective sewage treatment agent is cleaned, so that the cleaning of the tank body is effectively maintained, inaccurate concentration of the sewage treatment agent and mixing of ingredients caused by the next use are avoided, and the sewage cannot be degraded effectively.

title_en: Landfill leachate handles deodorizing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a landfill leachate treatment deodorizing device, which relates to the technical field of landfill leachate treatment and comprises a placement box body of a component, a cavity arranged in the placement box body, a deodorizing component arranged on one side of the inner wall of the placement box body, a leachate transfer component arranged on the other side of the inner wall of the placement box body, a cooling box arranged at the top of the placement box body and an auxiliary component arranged in the cavity and positioned on the inner wall of the placement box body, wherein the cooling box is arranged on the top of the placement box body; the deodorizing component comprises a deodorizing liquid storage box arranged on the inner wall of the bottom of the placement box body, a booster pump arranged on the inner wall of the bottom of the placement box body and positioned on one side of the deodorizing liquid storage box, and an atomizing nozzle arranged on the inner wall of the placement box body. The utility model increases the deodorizing efficiency of the deodorizing liquid and avoids the problem that the odor can not be treated due to repeated release caused by repeated stirring of the standing percolate.

title_en: Flue gas waste heat utilization device
abstract_en: A flue gas waste heat utilization device mainly comprises: the flue gas distillation reaction kettle, the salinization kettle, the first pipeline, the second pipeline, the third pipeline, the boiler, the cyclone dust collector, the bag dust collector, the first pipeline fan, the wet desulfurization tower, the SCR denitration device, the flue gas cooler, the flue gas pipeline and the second pipeline fan; the flue gas distillation reaction kettle comprises a flue gas inlet, a first electromagnetic valve, a liquid channel, a discharge hole, an inner container, an outer wall, a thermometer, an air outlet, a feed inlet, a flue gas outlet, a second electromagnetic valve, a sandwich body and a third electromagnetic valve; according to the utility model, the waste heat of the boiler flue gas is recycled, and the acetophenone is distilled and dried by utilizing the waste heat of the high-temperature boiler flue gas, so that the production cost can be effectively reduced, and the green production can be realized.

title_en: Mixing arrangement is used in animal remedy powder processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mixing device for veterinary drug powder processing, which belongs to the technical field of material mixing and aims to solve the problems that the existing mixing is long in time consumption and low in efficiency, and when filling or discharging is carried out, the materials are in powder form, so that the problem of overflowing and scattering easily occurs.

title_en: Washing machine with filtering structure for neodymium fluoride processing
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of washing machines, and particularly relates to a washing machine with a filtering structure for processing neodymium fluoride, which comprises a box body, a filtering mechanism and a drying mechanism, wherein the filtering mechanism is arranged in the box body, the upper end of the box body is provided with a box cover, a feeding pipe is fixedly sleeved in the box cover, the upper end of the box cover is fixedly provided with a motor, and the output end of the motor is fixedly connected with a connecting rod.

title_en: Circulation energy-saving water purification equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of pure water filtration, in particular to a circulating energy-saving pure water device, which comprises: an equipment enclosure; a circulating energy-saving water inlet mechanism is arranged in the equipment shell; the circulating energy-saving water inlet mechanism is connected with a pure water circulating and filtering mechanism; the circulating energy-saving water inlet mechanism comprises a water inlet pipe and a pumping pump connected with the water inlet pipe, a rotary drum box is connected with the water discharge end of the pumping pump in a penetrating way, and a one-way bearing is arranged on the inner side of the bottom of the rotary drum box. According to the utility model, the rotating main rotating rod drives the driven rod to rotate, the driven rod rotates to drive the plurality of worms to rotate, the worm rotates to mesh with the worm wheel, so that the worm wheel drives the rotating rod to rotate, the rotating rod rotates in the pure water circulating cylinder to rotate the reverse osmosis pure water filter in the pure water circulating cylinder, impurities in the water source are filtered from different positions of the reverse osmosis pure water filter when the water source passes through the reverse osmosis pure water filter during filtering, and the single position of the reverse osmosis pure water filter is reduced from being blocked by the impurities.

title_en: System for reducing nitrogen in cold rolling acid waste water by using bleaching powder
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of wastewater treatment, and provides a system for reducing nitrogen in cold rolling acidic wastewater by using bleaching powder, which comprises the following steps: a feed assembly; the conveying assembly is communicated with the feeding assembly at one end; the other end of the conveying component is communicated with the reaction component; the reaction assembly includes: one end of the first air shutter is communicated with the discharge end of the conveying assembly; the other end of the first air-stop device is communicated with the feeding end of the air-solid mixer; the conveying fan is communicated with the feeding end of the gas-solid mixer; the cylinder body, gas-solid mixer discharge end and cylinder body intercommunication, through above-mentioned technical scheme, solved the bleaching powder among the correlation technique and be a solid type's powder, be difficult to add even problem.

title_en: Automatic unmanned high-pressure water mist fire extinguishing device
abstract_en: The utility model provides an automatic unmanned high-pressure water mist fire extinguishing device, which comprises a front cover frame combination, wherein a front laser combination is arranged on the left side of the top of the front cover frame combination, a mounting groove is fixedly formed in the right side of the top of the front cover frame combination, a through hole is fixedly formed in the bottom end inside the mounting groove, a mist gun base is arranged at the bottom end inside the mounting groove, a high-pressure water mist fire-fighting lance is arranged on the top of the mist gun base, a communicating water pipe is arranged on the left side of the front cover frame combination, a water delivery mechanism is arranged on the left side of the communicating water pipe, and a water pipe clamp is arranged on the left side of the top of the water delivery mechanism.

title_en: Air catalyst removes aldehyde and removes flavor antibacterial device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an air catalyst formaldehyde-removing odor-removing antibacterial device, which belongs to the technical field of air purification and comprises an air catalyst storage tank body, wherein one side of the outer wall of the air catalyst storage tank body is connected with a supporting block, the top end of the supporting block is provided with two sleeved shaft brackets, and the interior of each sleeved shaft bracket is provided with a linkage assembly; the linkage assembly comprises a linkage rotating shaft arranged in the sleeve joint shaft bracket, and a linkage toothed ring is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the linkage rotating shaft and positioned at one side of the sleeve joint shaft bracket. According to the utility model, the linkage assembly is arranged, the linkage screw rod drives the threaded sleeve joint support block to move upwards along the inside of the exhaust shell, the linkage toothed ring drives the linkage rotating shaft to enable the exhaust shell to rotate downwards, and the linkage toothed ring drives the linkage rotating shaft to enable the exhaust shell to rotate upwards, so that the formaldehyde and odor removal antibacterial effect is realized, and the formaldehyde and odor removal antibacterial effect is better.

title_en: Buffer zone microecological device for water body sewage treatment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a buffer zone microecological device for water body sewage treatment, which comprises a submersible pump assembly, a filter box assembly, a fine filtration water curtain, a solar energy assembly, an electric control cabinet, a water tank assembly, a floating body assembly, a dephosphorization frame and a zigzag water outlet tank. The utility model has the beneficial effects that: the utility model is provided with a submersible pump assembly, a filter box assembly, a fine filtered water curtain, a solar energy assembly and a water tank; the submersible pump assembly is used for taking water from polluted water areas such as river and lake gates through a pump, meanwhile, coarse filtering is carried out on the taken raw water, and the filter tank assembly carries out water quality fine filtering through a reverse osmosis membrane technology; the fine filtered water curtain lifts the filtered water by a waterfall flow, and the water flow is up and down high through the formation of the waterfall, so that the oxygen content in the water is increased; a water tank: the device is used for storing the treated clean water, the tank body is deployed from high to low, the principle of flowing along water is met, and the clean water is purified again through the high-low water tank.

title_en: Purified water centralized water supply device for special medical workshop
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a purified water centralized water supply device for a special medical workshop, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the surface of the bottom plate is respectively provided with a source water tank, a sand filter tank, a carbon filter tank, a precision filter, a temporary storage tank I, a temporary storage tank II and a purified water tank, and the top end of the source water tank is provided with a source water pipe which is communicated with the source water tank. When the water tank is operated at night, the source water tank, the sand filtering tank, the carbon filtering tank and the precise filter are closed, only the water in the temporary storage tank I and the water in the temporary storage tank II are used, the water in the temporary storage tank II is treated through the pure water treatment mechanism, the treated stored water enters the pure water tank, when the water tank is used, the water is disinfected through the disinfection mechanism, enters the ultrafiltration membrane filter for final filtration, and finally filtered pure water is discharged through the water outlet pipe, after the water in the temporary storage tank II is used, the water in the temporary storage tank I is enabled to enter the temporary storage tank II through the secondary treatment mechanism, the steps are repeated, and the pure water lost at night is generated.

title_en: Power distribution cabinet for electrical equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a power distribution cabinet for electrical equipment, relates to the technical field of power distribution cabinets, and aims to solve the problems that in the prior art, light rays are poor at night, when internal elements of the power distribution cabinet are damaged for maintenance, maintenance staff need to hold lighting equipment for illumination, maintenance operation is not carried out by hands of the maintenance staff, and practicality is poor. The cabinet door is rotatably installed on the front end face of the power distribution cabinet body, one side of the power distribution cabinet body is fixedly provided with an illumination box, the inside of the illumination box is provided with a soft rod sleeve, the inside of the soft rod sleeve is provided with a metal soft rod, one end of the metal soft rod is fixedly connected with the illumination box through a screw, the other end of the metal soft rod is fixedly provided with an illuminating lamp, the inside of the illumination box is fixedly provided with a supporting rod, the front end of the illumination box is rotatably provided with a box door, the front end of the box door is provided with a pull groove, and one side of the pull groove is provided with a fluorescent strip.

title_en: Emergency device for side accidents of large passenger car
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a side accident emergency device for a large bus, which comprises a box body, wherein the two sides of the front part of the top end of the box body are respectively provided with a supporting leg and a shielding plate, the bottom end of the box body is provided with a foundation table, the foundation table is fixed on the ground by ground nails, one side of the front end of the box body is rotationally connected with a door, a T-shaped partition plate is arranged in the box body, the partition plate sequentially divides the interior of the box body into a first cavity, a second cavity and a third cavity from top to bottom, the first cavity, the fire extinguisher and the third cavity are respectively used for placing rescue tools, a storage groove is rotationally connected with the front part of the three bottom ends of the cavity for placing the fire extinguisher, the storage groove is connected with the box body through a limiting structure, one side of the box body, which is far away from the door, is provided with a reflecting strip, the other middle part is provided with a fixing groove, and the inside of the fixing groove is provided with a window breaking hammer and is connected through a buckle structure. The utility model has the advantages that: the device is designed, so that when an accident occurs, the device arranged beside the highway can be used for emergency treatment before the ambulance arrives, and the golden time for rescue is striven for.

title_en: Machining dust collector of sheet metal component
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of sheet metal machining, in particular to a processing dust removing device for sheet metal parts, which comprises a dust removing structure, wherein one end of the dust removing structure is clamped with an ash storage structure in a sealing way, one side of the upper surface of the ash storage structure is clamped with a fan structure in a sealing way, the ash storage structure comprises a separation shell, an ash inlet is fixedly arranged at the edge of one side of the upper surface of the separation shell, a detection inlet is fixedly arranged at the opening of the lower end of the ash inlet, an exhaust port is fixedly arranged at the edge of the other side of the upper surface of the separation shell, an ash storage barrel is clamped inside the separation shell, a filter disc is clamped at the opening of the upper end of the ash storage barrel, and an ash inlet clamping groove is penetrated and arranged at the edge of one side of the filter disc. According to the dust collecting device, dust enters the dust storage barrel through the dust inlet and the detection inlet, the air suction opening is communicated with the fan structure, air in the dust storage barrel is continuously extracted, meanwhile, the dust entering the dust storage barrel can be intercepted by the filter disc and is trapped in the dust storage barrel, and meanwhile, the dust storage barrel and the separation shell are mutually clamped and connected, so that the dust collecting device is convenient to assemble and disassemble, and dust cleaning is facilitated.

title_en: Welding set is used in condenser processing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of capacitor processing, in particular to a welding device for capacitor processing, which comprises a working box, wherein a first cavity is formed in the working box, a first motor is fixedly connected to the right side of the inner wall of the first cavity, a threaded screw rod is fixedly connected to the power output end of the first motor, a threaded hole block is connected to the rod wall of the threaded screw rod in a threaded manner, a capacitor welder body is fixedly connected to the surface of the threaded hole block, a second cavity is formed in the working box, a partition plate is fixedly connected to the left side and the right side of the inner wall of the second cavity in a common mode, the welding device for capacitor processing can clamp and fix a capacitor during welding through a series of structures, the capacitor welding quality is prevented from being influenced by capacitor deflection caused by manual fixing, waste gas generated during welding can be sucked and purified, and harm and environmental pollution caused to a human body by waste gas are prevented.

title_en: Environment-friendly flocculant sewage treatment equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of sewage treatment equipment and discloses flocculating agent sewage environment-friendly treatment equipment, which comprises a box body, wherein a discharging box is fixedly connected to the top of the box body, a discharging hopper is fixedly connected to the top of the discharging box, two partition plates are connected to the middle of the discharging box in a sliding manner, a driving assembly is fixedly connected to one side of each partition plate opposite to the other partition plate, a control panel is fixedly connected to the front side of the box body, a water inlet pipe is fixedly connected to one side of the box body, a stirring assembly is rotatably connected to the inside of the box body, a water draining pipe is fixedly connected to one side of the box body, a sedimentation box is fixedly connected to the other end of the water draining pipe, and a collecting groove is connected to the inside of the sedimentation box in a sliding manner. According to the utility model, through the mutual matching of the structures such as the gear, the rack and the like, the baffle plate is driven to slide in the blanking box, so that the speed and the frequency of the flocculating agent throwing can be regulated and controlled, and the problem that the flocculating agent cannot be automatically controlled to be thrown is solved.

title_en: Garbage interception device for sewage treatment tank
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a garbage interception device for a sewage treatment tank, which comprises a belt conveyor, wherein the bottom end of the belt conveyor extends into the sewage tank, a discharge hole at the upper end of the belt conveyor is arranged on the upper side of the ground of the sewage tank, a water inlet cylinder is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the belt conveyor, a pontoon is slidably arranged in the water inlet cylinder, a first motor is fixedly arranged at the upper side of the water inlet cylinder, a rotating shaft of the first motor extends into the pontoon, and a propeller blade is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the rotating shaft of the first motor; the bottom of the belt conveyor is fixedly provided with a diversion pipeline. The device, through set up the screw piece in the section of thick bamboo that intakes, promote sewage to carry to the effluent water sump through the circulating pipe under water far away, let the floated rubbish of surface of water gather together to the section of thick bamboo that intakes, the conveyer belt of belt conveyor has filterable effect, can also salvage the rubbish of collecting simultaneously, makes things convenient for the garbage truck splendid attire to transport, realizes utilizing the convection current guide rubbish of sewage to be close to and intercept the effect of salvaging rubbish.

title_en: High-speed hydraulic motor for agricultural machinery
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of hydraulic motors, and discloses a high-speed hydraulic motor for agricultural machinery, which solves the problem that the service life is influenced due to poor dustproof effect of the existing high-speed hydraulic motor for agricultural machinery, and comprises a hydraulic motor body, wherein the hydraulic motor body is fixedly arranged in a dustproof shell; the hydraulic motor can improve the overall dustproof effect, avoids dust entering the hydraulic motor to influence the service life of the hydraulic motor, and is more suitable for agricultural machinery.

title_en: Portable water purifier convenient to dismantle for field use
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of water purifiers, and discloses a portable water purifier convenient to detach for the field, which comprises a water pumping barrel, wherein a water barrel cover is connected to the top end of the water pumping barrel in a threaded manner, a drawing piston is connected to the middle position of the water barrel cover in a sliding manner, a water pumping pipe is arranged at the bottom end of one side of the water pumping barrel in a clamping manner, a pontoon is fixedly connected to one side of the outer surface of the water pumping pipe, an external filter cylinder is connected to one side of the water pumping pipe in a threaded manner, an internal filter cylinder is fixedly connected to the other side of the water pumping barrel, and a filter core is arranged in the internal filter cylinder. The utility model can be conveniently carried, disassembled and replaced, and can drive the impeller and the scraping plate to rotate through rotational flow generated by pumping water when in use, so that the filter screen is cleaned to avoid blockage, and meanwhile, the pull rod is pulled, so that the wiping cotton cleans the outer surface of the filter element, the blockage rate of the filter element is reduced, the water inlet rate and the filtering efficiency are finally improved, the pulling strength of the pulling piston is reduced, and the replacement period is prolonged.

title_en: UV deodorizing mechanism of oil smoke purification all-in-one
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of UV odor removers and discloses a UV odor removal mechanism of an oil fume purification all-in-one machine, which comprises a lamp tube box and a connecting frame, wherein a control box is fixedly arranged at one end of the lamp tube box, a plurality of heat dissipation ports are formed in the surface of the control box, a plurality of filter plates are fixedly connected to the inner wall of the connecting frame, the filter plates are uniformly distributed on the inner wall of the connecting frame, the filter plates are divided into three groups, shielding plates are movably arranged at one ends of the three groups of filter plates, the surface of the connecting frame is clamped with the inner wall of the lamp tube box, and the dimension specification of the surface of the connecting frame is matched with the dimension specification of the inner wall of the lamp tube box; according to the application, the connecting frame is arranged on the lamp tube box, the plurality of filter plates are arranged on the inner wall of the connecting frame, and the shielding plate is arranged at one end of each filter plate, so that waste gas entering the lamp tube box is shielded by means of the inclined structure of each filter plate, and oil stains and impurities entering the lamp tube box are effectively reduced.

title_en: Waste liquid water-oil separation device of electromagnetic wire drawing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a waste liquid water-oil separation device of electromagnetic wire drawing equipment, which belongs to the technical field of waste liquid treatment and comprises a reaction box, wherein a liquid inlet pipe, a liquid box and a protective shell are arranged at the top of the reaction box; according to the utility model, waste liquid can enter the reaction box through the filter pipe, medicines in the liquid box are sprayed into the reaction box, and the motor drives the stirring blade to rotate, so that the stirring of the waste liquid is realized, the bottom of the filter plate is lapped on the clamping block of the liquid inlet pipe, impurities in the filter pipe are convenient to clean, and the reaction efficiency of the medicines is greatly improved due to the rotation of the stirring blade, so that the practicability of the separation device is greatly improved.

title_en: Power distribution cabinet combined type assembly framework and power distribution cabinet
abstract_en: The utility model provides a combined assembly framework of a power distribution cabinet and the power distribution cabinet, which comprise: the base is provided with first thread blind grooves on four side surfaces; the side cabinet plate is provided with a first threaded through hole at the bottom, and first screws are arranged in the first threaded through hole and the first threaded blind groove in a threaded manner and used for mutually fixing the side cabinet plate and the base; the top plate is provided with a plurality of second threaded through holes, and second screws are arranged in the second threaded through holes and the second threaded blind grooves in a threaded manner and used for mutually fixing the top plate and the side cabinet plate; the bottom of the partition board is embedded in the groove on the top surface of the base; and one end of the placing plate is placed on the positioning plate, and the other end of the placing plate is abutted against the pushing plate. The utility model provides a combined type assembly framework of a power distribution cabinet and the power distribution cabinet, which are simple in structure and easy to assemble.

title_en: Fire extinguishing device for charging cabinet
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a charging cabinet fire extinguishing device, which comprises; the hot aerosol fire extinguisher is arranged in the charging cabinet and is used for automatically extinguishing fire when the charging cabinet starts fire, and one side of the hot aerosol fire extinguisher is provided with an air spraying hole; the baffle piece is arranged on the hot aerosol fire extinguisher in a deflection way and is positioned on the same side with the air spraying hole, and in a normal state, the baffle piece is limited by the limiting structure, so that the baffle piece is attached to the hot aerosol fire extinguisher, after the hot aerosol fire extinguisher sprays air to the baffle piece, the baffle piece is stressed and is limited by the limiting structure and is automatically deflected by the gravity of the baffle piece, wherein the deflection angle of the baffle piece is not more than sixty degrees. According to the charging cabinet fire extinguishing device, after the balance of the baffle piece is destroyed, the baffle piece is separated from the limit structure to be limited and automatically deflected by the gravity of the baffle piece, the baffle piece forms a blocking and guiding surface, so that the sprayed fire extinguishing gas does not continue downwards any more, and the fire extinguishing gas is enabled to be in a fire extinguishing state towards a fire point more quickly.

title_en: Tail gas dust collector is used in mullite production
