abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tail gas dust collector for mullite production, which belongs to the technical field of dust collectors and comprises a mullite production box, wherein the top of the mullite production box is connected with an exhaust pipe, the top of the exhaust pipe is provided with an exhaust pump, the bottom of the exhaust pipe is connected with the top of the dust collection box, the top of the inner side of the dust collection box is connected with two first fixing rods, the bottom ends of the two adjacent first fixing rods are connected with a gas expansion hood, the top of the gas expansion hood is connected with the bottom of the exhaust pipe, the outer wall of one side of the dust collection box is connected with a water suction pump, one side of the water suction pump is connected with a water supply pipe, the top of the water supply pipe is provided with a spraying device, and the spraying device is positioned inside the dust collection box. According to the utility model, the spraying device is arranged, so that the dust removal effect is improved, and meanwhile, the dust removal is carried out on the dead angle position of the dust removal box, so that the dust removal effect is further improved, the working efficiency is improved, the required dust removal time is reduced, and the harm to workers is reduced.

title_en: Dust fall device for building engineering
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of dust fall and discloses a dust fall device for constructional engineering, which comprises a trolley and an installation table, wherein a lifting assembly is arranged in the installation table, a rotating assembly is arranged in the installation table, the right side of the top of the trolley is fixedly connected with a box body, a driving end of a motor is fixedly connected with a rotary table, the periphery of the rotary table is rotationally connected with a connecting shaft, the tops of the connecting shafts are fixedly connected with driven gears, the tops of the connecting shafts are fixedly connected with stirring rods, the top of the inner periphery of the box body is fixedly connected with a transmission gear, the input end of a water pump is fixedly connected with a conveying pipe, the output end of the water pump is fixedly connected with another conveying pipe, and the top of the other conveying pipe is fixedly connected with a spray head. According to the utility model, the dust suppressant and the water are sprayed into the air after being fully stirred in the box body, so that the dust is effectively adhered and inhibited, and the dust suppressant is uniformly distributed in the air after being fully stirred, so that the dust suppression effect is improved.

title_en: Indoor air purification equipment is bred to laying hen
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model provides indoor air purification equipment for laying hen breeding, and relates to the technical field of laying hen breeding. This indoor air purification equipment is bred to laying hen, including the air intake of shell and shell one side seting up, the fan is installed to the inside downside of shell, is located the inside filter that is equipped with of shell of fan upside, and the internally mounted of shell upside air exit has deodorant to store the subassembly, and the upper end of shell is connected with extrusion subassembly, and extrusion subassembly extends to inside deodorant stores the subassembly. According to the utility model, the deodorant is enabled to enter the absorbent cotton through the leak holes formed in the deodorant pipe by connecting the deodorant pipe with the external deodorant, the air filtered by the filter plate and the activated carbon adsorption plate is enabled to be contacted with the deodorant through volatilization of the deodorant in the absorbent cotton, so that peculiar smell in the air is removed, and meanwhile, the rotation of the fan accelerates the flow of the air, so that the smell scattered by the deodorant is dispersed, the air and the deodorant are fully fused, and the peculiar smell removing efficiency is improved.

title_en: Dust removing device for processing aluminum alloy doors and windows
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of door and window processing and discloses an aluminum alloy door and window processing dust removing device which comprises a barrel, wherein a fan is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the barrel, a dust suction pipe is arranged on the surface of the fan, a dust suction cover is fixedly connected to one end of the dust suction pipe away from the fan, a fixing seat is fixedly connected to the outer side wall of the barrel, a telescopic rod is hinged to the inner side wall of the fixing seat, a filter screen is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the barrel, a connecting rod is hinged to the inner side wall of the handle, a push plate is elastically connected to the inner wall of the barrel through a limiting spring, one end of the limiting spring is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the barrel, and the other end of the limiting spring is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the push plate. According to the utility model, when the scraps enter the cylinder, the connecting rod can drive the push plate to move on the inner wall by moving the handle, so that the scraps are extruded, and the occupied space of the scraps in the cylinder is reduced.

title_en: Front-end video access box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a front-end video access box, which relates to the technical field of front-end video access equipment and comprises an access box, wherein a plurality of equipment interfaces are arranged on the access box, a limiting and anti-falling mechanism is arranged on one side of each equipment interface, a heat dissipation mechanism is arranged on the access box, the limiting and anti-falling mechanism comprises a fixed seat, a fixing bolt is arranged on the fixed seat, two guide seats are fixedly connected to the bottom end of the fixed seat, and movable limiting blocks are arranged at the bottoms of the two guide seats. This front end video access box makes two movable stopper separate through pushing the piece of stirring, inserts equipment interface with the joint of front end equipment in, then loosens and stir the piece, and first spring and second spring reset whole for two movable stopper fold again, and it is fixed to carry out spacing to the attach fitting of front end equipment, prevents to receive external force effect and equipment interface separation, effectively improves the stability of connection.

title_en: Catalyst support module
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of desulfurization and denitrification, and discloses a catalyst carrier module, which comprises a cylinder with an opening at the top, wherein a base is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the cylinder, a ring body is arranged at the top of the cylinder, and a filter screen is arranged at the top of the ring body; jacks are formed in the surface of the edge of the top of the cylinder at equal intervals, inserted rods are inserted in the jacks in a sliding mode, and the tops of the inserted rods are fixedly connected with the ring body; this is novel can insert the inserted bar in the jack to make magnet piece adsorb fixed inserted bar, and then fix the ring body at the top of barrel through the inserted bar, with the opening part at the barrel top with the filter screen, at this moment, the filter screen can prevent that the catalyst from breaking away from inside the barrel, and outside contains sulfur and the gas of nitre can pass through filter screen contact catalyst, in order to carry out desulfurization denitration operation, the inserted bar of this module is fixed in the jack through magnet piece, the dismouting of being convenient for, thereby make filter screen and ring body be convenient for the dismouting, and then the personnel of being convenient for change the catalyst, be fit for extensively using widely.

title_en: Normal temperature evaporation water distribution device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a normal temperature evaporation water distribution device, which belongs to the technical field of normal temperature evaporation and comprises a water tank and a water distribution pipe, wherein a pretreatment tank is arranged at the top end of the water tank in a communicating way, a filter screen is detachably connected to the inner wall of the pretreatment tank, a filter frame is connected to the periphery of the filter screen, a support rod is connected to the inner side surface of the filter frame in a threaded way, a connecting screw hole in threaded connection with the support rod is formed in the inner wall of the pretreatment tank, a water inlet pipe is arranged at the side surface of the pretreatment tank in a communicating way, a heating pipe is arranged in the water tank, a drain pipe is arranged at the bottom end of the water tank in a communicating way, a circulating assembly is arranged at the periphery of the water tank in a side surface of the water tank in a communicating way, and the first water pump is communicated with the inlet end of the water distribution pipe. The normal temperature evaporation water distribution device can carry out distribution atomization treatment on raw water, and can carry out filtration and heating pretreatment on the raw water.

title_en: Waste water treatment equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides wastewater treatment equipment, which relates to the technical field of wastewater treatment, and comprises a pipe body, wherein a grid is arranged on the inner wall of the pipe body, a sewage storage box is hinged to the surface of the pipe body, a placing box is arranged in the sewage storage box, an installation groove is formed in the inner wall of the placing box, a flocculation plate is clamped in the installation groove, a through groove is formed in one side, close to the flocculation plate, of the pipe body, sewage passes through the grid when sewage is conveyed in the pipe body, impurities are blocked by the grid, and due to the fact that the grid is obliquely provided with the impurities, the impurities are impacted by the water flow to enter the sewage storage box, and the impurities enter the sewage storage box along with the impurities to contact with the flocculation plate, the flocculation plate increases the flocculation speed of the flocculable substances, part of the sewage enters the sewage storage box to flow outwards along the through groove, the sewage in the sewage storage box is prevented from generating turbulence, the sewage in a subsequent pipeline is not influenced by the influence of the accumulation of the impurities, and the sewage storage box can be taken down to clean the inside, so that the long-term use effect is ensured.

title_en: Sludge synergistic garbage incineration treatment system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sludge synergistic garbage incineration treatment system, which comprises a wet sludge bin mechanism, wherein the wet sludge bin mechanism comprises a bin and a hydraulic bin cover, the bin is used for storing sludge, the top of the bin is provided with a feed inlet, and the hydraulic bin cover is arranged at the feed inlet in a turnover way; the pump group mechanism comprises a double-shaft screw conveyor and a plunger pump, wherein the double-shaft screw conveyor is arranged at the bottom of the storage bin and is used for conveying sludge, and the discharge end of the double-shaft screw conveyor is connected with the plunger pump; the furnace top spray gun mechanism comprises a plurality of sludge spray guns which are respectively arranged at the furnace top of the waste heat furnace, the sludge spray guns are connected with the discharge end of the plunger pump through sludge conveying pipelines, and pipeline film injection devices for lubricating the sludge conveying pipelines and impurity removal devices for intercepting impurities in the sludge conveying pipelines are arranged on the sludge conveying pipelines. The utility model can effectively improve the sludge treatment efficiency, can make up the current situation of insufficient garbage in the household garbage incineration plant, and realizes the terminal treatment of municipal sludge.

title_en: Water purifying equipment for livestock breeding
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a water purifying device for livestock breeding, which comprises a purifying box, a heating box and a water feeding groove, wherein an anti-overflow assembly is arranged in the water feeding groove, the anti-overflow assembly comprises a vertical rod, a traction buckle, a buoyancy plate and an annular sealing ring, the top of the buoyancy plate is fixedly provided with an annular sealing ring, the inside of the annular sealing ring is provided with an annular sealing groove, the vertical rod is fixedly arranged in the water feeding groove, the traction buckle is slidably arranged on the outer surface of the vertical rod, the traction buckle is fixedly arranged on one side of the buoyancy plate, a water diversion pipe is fixedly arranged in the water feeding groove, the annular sealing ring is fixedly arranged at one end of the water diversion pipe, automatic water supply is realized through the water diversion pipe, the traction buckle is driven to vertically ascend under the traction of the vertical rod by the water level ascending through the buoyancy plate, the water outlet pipe mouth of the water diversion pipe is blocked in the annular sealing ring to realize the closing of water source, the water source waste caused by continuous ascent overflow in the water feeding groove is prevented, and the water feeding mode is convenient.

title_en: System for zinc hydrometallurgy electrolyte circulation liquid desorption fluorine and chlorine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of hydrometallurgy, in particular to a system for removing fluorine and chlorine from a zinc hydrometallurgy electrolyte circulating solution, which provides a system for removing only fluorine and chlorine without changing other components of a waste electrolyte, and comprises a concentration tower, a defluorination chlorine circulating tank, a defluorination chlorine tower, an alkaline washing tower and a sodium hydroxide configuration tank communicated with the alkaline washing tower; the concentration tower is communicated with the defluorination chlorine circulation tank; the defluorination chlorine tower is provided with a first spraying device, the first spraying device is connected to a defluorination chlorine circulating tank through a first circulating pump, a hot air inlet is arranged below the first spraying device, a fluorine-chlorine blowing-off port at the top of the defluorination chlorine tower is connected with a flue gas inlet of the alkaline washing tower, and a first reflux port at the bottom of the defluorination chlorine tower is communicated with the defluorination chlorine circulating tank; and a second spraying device is arranged above the flue gas inlet of the alkaline washing tower, the second spraying device is communicated with a second reflux port at the bottom of the tower through a second circulating pump, the liquid outlet of the first circulating pump can be reversed to a finished acid tank, and the liquid outlet of the second circulating pump can be reversed to a sewage outlet.

title_en: Garbage can with three-face wavy bottom
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a garbage can with a three-sided wavy bottom, which comprises a lower can body, wherein an upper can body is arranged on the upper side of the lower can body, a connecting hinge is arranged at the connection part of the back part of the lower can body and the upper can body, and locking components are correspondingly arranged on the other three side walls of the upper can body and the lower can body respectively. The beneficial effects are that: according to the utility model, on one hand, after the locking component is opened, the upper barrel body can be conveniently folded relative to the lower barrel body, so that the opening part at the upper side of the lower barrel body can be directly exposed to the outside, the cleaning height of garbage in the lower barrel body is reduced, so that the garbage stored in the lower barrel body can be conveniently and conveniently cleaned, on the other hand, under the action of the activated carbon screen plate, peculiar smell emitted by the garbage in the garbage can be effectively adsorbed, and the external dispersion of the peculiar smell at the garbage can is reduced, so that the surrounding environment of the garbage can is ensured to be clean.

title_en: Fireproof sealing block suitable for cable trench
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fireproof blocking device suitable for a cable duct, which comprises a fixed fan blade and a turnover fan blade, wherein the fixed fan blade and the turnover fan blade are detachably connected through a middle upright post, the fixed fan blade is used for being fixed on a fireproof partition plate of the cable duct, the turnover fan blade comprises a bolt grid blocking piece and a fixing bolt, and the bolt grid blocking piece is slidably fixed on the turnover fan blade through the fixing bolt. The fireproof sealing block suitable for the cable trench has the advantages of simple structure, reasonable design, good anti-interference and stability, convenient installation and easy replacement, and ensures that the cable is fireproof and safe and is not easy to corrode.

title_en: Dust collector for ventilation system of coal mine well
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of dust removal of ventilation systems of coal mines, in particular to a dust removal device for a ventilation system of a coal mine. Technical problems: in-process that ventilation system removed dust in colliery well can be because producing a large amount of waste gas that contain the dust, and long-term inhalation can influence staff's healthy, filters through simple filtration dust removal mostly, and filtration dust removal's efficiency is lower, and can't adsorb the harmful substance that gets rid of in the waste gas that the colliery well produced, has increased staff's problem of sick risk. The technical scheme is as follows: a dust removing device for a ventilation system of a coal mine comprises a ventilation pipe; the wet type filter device also comprises a primary filter assembly, a wet type filter assembly, an air inlet and a support frame. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the desorption fan, the waste gas in the coal mine is sucked into the ventilation pipe, and the sucked waste gas is discharged into the supporting base through the rotary impeller, so that the large particles in the waste gas are adsorbed, and the burden of a subsequent high-efficiency filter is reduced.

title_en: Built-in water tank purifier for double-stage reverse osmosis cleaning RO (reverse osmosis) membrane
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of water purifiers, and discloses a built-in water tank water purifier for double-stage reverse osmosis cleaning RO (reverse osmosis) membranes, wherein a PP cotton filter element, a front activated carbon filter element, an RO membrane filter element and a rear activated carbon filter element are sequentially arranged between a tap water source and a pure water tank along the downstream direction of water, a first water inlet valve is arranged on a third pipeline of the PP cotton filter element and the front activated carbon filter element, a booster pump is connected on a fourth pipeline between the front activated carbon filter element and the RO membrane filter element, a waste water outlet of the RO membrane filter element is connected with a waste discharge pipeline, and a flushing valve is connected on the waste discharge pipeline; a sixth pipeline is arranged at the bottom of the pure water tank, the other end of the sixth pipeline is connected with a water outlet of the front active carbon filter element, and a second water inlet valve is connected and arranged on the sixth pipeline; and the RO membrane is washed by pure water once every water making is full, and the RO membrane is washed by pure water twice after the water making is full for at least 10 times, so that the problems of scaling on the surface of the RO membrane of the water purifier and reducing the TDS value in the early stage of water making after long-time standby can be solved.

title_en: Construction system of transformer substation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a transformer substation construction system, which relates to the technical field of transformer substation construction and comprises a enclosing baffle for enclosing a construction site and a ventilation dense mesh net arranged on the enclosing baffle for covering the construction site, wherein the ventilation dense mesh net is provided with a plurality of spraying devices for spraying water mist into the construction site; adopt to ventilative mesh net can cover the construction place top, can prevent that the dust that the construction produced from raising outward, can also shelter from sunshine simultaneously, play the effect of cooling, spray set spun water smoke can play the effect of suppressing dust to the construction place simultaneously, reduces the dust in the construction place.

title_en: Natural gas pipeline emptying recovery device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of recovery devices, in particular to a natural gas pipeline emptying recovery device which comprises a motor, a filtering compression device and a water separation component; the filtering compression device is provided with a liquefaction bin, the top of the liquefaction bin is fixedly provided with an air inlet, one side of the liquefaction bin is fixedly provided with a connecting flange, the other side of the connecting flange is fixedly provided with an inlet pipe, one side of the liquefaction bin is fixedly provided with a return pipe, and the other end of the return pipe is fixedly provided with an air pump; the impurity through the filter to natural gas filters, reduces impurity and prevents that impurity from piling up too much and leading to the pipeline to block up, and inside the filtered natural gas reentrant liquefaction storehouse passed through communicating pipe, compressed messenger natural gas changed liquid from gaseous state through the air pump, changed the natural gas of liquid and collected through the fluid-discharge tube, realized carrying out the function that liquefaction was collected natural gas, solved and collected and not possess the problem of convenience when transporting, improved the convenience of collecting.

title_en: Exhaust gas purifying tank with sealing element
abstract_en: The utility model provides an exhaust gas purifying tank with a sealing element, which comprises a purifying tank, wherein a spray ring pipe is arranged on an upper bolt on the inner wall of the purifying tank; a sealing end cover is arranged at the upper end of the purifying tank through bolts; the lower side of the purifying tank is connected with a liquid discharge valve in a threaded manner; the right lower side of the inside of the purifying tank is embedded with an air injection pipe; the upper right side of the inside of the purification tank is embedded with a liquid injection pipe, and the left end of the liquid injection pipe is in threaded connection with the spray ring pipe; the right end of the liquid injection pipe is connected with a one-way valve in a threaded manner; the lower end of the spray ring pipe is connected with a spray header in a threaded manner; the lower part of the inner wall of the purifying tank is provided with a dispersed air outlet pipe frame structure. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the scattered air outlet pipe frame structure, the sprayed absorption liquid is prevented from entering, so that the accumulation influences the work of air outlet of the injection pipe.

title_en: Dehumidification device for warehouse logistics management
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of storage dehumidification devices and discloses a dehumidification device for storage logistics management, which comprises a dehumidification box and a fan, wherein a dehumidification mechanism is arranged in the dehumidification box, the dehumidification mechanism comprises a mounting frame, one end of the mounting frame penetrates through and extends to the interior of the dehumidification box, absorbent cotton is fixedly arranged in the mounting frame, and guide rails for guiding the mounting frame are fixedly arranged on the front side wall and the rear side wall of an inner cavity of the dehumidification box. This dehydrating unit for storage commodity circulation management provides and is provided with dehumidification mechanism, has realized utilizing the motor as the actuating source and through mechanical transmission control lead screw rotation for lead screw surface threaded connection's setting element moves left side, until the locating plate in the setting element withdraws from the inside of installing frame, thereby reaches to relieve the fixed to the installing frame, makes things convenient for the staff to upwards take out the installing frame and absorb water cotton, and then makes things convenient for the staff to change the cotton that absorbs water of saturation, has reduced staff's work load moreover.

title_en: Tail gas treatment device for preparing sulfuric acid of lead-acid storage battery
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of tail gas treatment, and discloses a tail gas treatment device for preparing sulfuric acid of a lead-acid storage battery, which comprises a treatment box, wherein a plurality of fixing plates are arranged in the treatment box, the inside of the treatment box is divided into a plurality of treatment cavities by the fixing plates, spraying pipes are fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the inside of the treatment box and the lower surface of the fixing plates, pump machines are fixedly arranged at water inlet ends of the spraying pipes, the pump machines positioned on the treatment box are connected with a liquid storage box through liquid suction pipes, liquid collecting discs are arranged on the upper surfaces of the fixing plates, outlets of the liquid collecting discs are connected with the pump machines, connecting pipes are arranged between the adjacent treatment cavities, and pressure mechanisms are arranged in the connecting pipes.

title_en: Filter element for activated carbon filter
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a filter element for an activated carbon filter, which comprises a device body, wherein the device body comprises a bottom connection input device, a top connection output device and an activated carbon connection filter element, the three activated carbon connection filter elements are distributed in a transverse equidistant mode, the bottom connection input device is arranged at the bottoms of the three activated carbon connection filter elements, and the top connection output device is arranged at the tops of the three activated carbon connection filter elements; the bottom is connected input device, top and is connected output device and all include concentrated junction housing and main conveyer pipe, concentrated junction housing is equipped with and is the funnel-shaped structure, concentrated junction housing one end is equipped with three and is the little connector that horizontal equidistance mode distributes, little connector inboard is equipped with the screw thread, the main conveyer pipe is installed and is being concentrated the junction housing other end. The device can use a plurality of groups of filter elements to filter water simultaneously, thereby improving the water filtering quantity and also ensuring the water filtering quality.

title_en: Scraped car power battery transfer box
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of logistics transportation and discloses a scraped car power battery transfer box which comprises a main box body, wherein an upper cover plate is arranged at the upper end of the main box body, an alarm is arranged at the position, close to the front, of the center of the upper end face of the upper cover plate, a gas detector is arranged at the position, close to the rear, of the center of the upper end face of the upper cover plate, a gas sensor is arranged at the position, close to the rear, of the center of the lower end face of the gas detector, and the lower end of the gas sensor penetrates through the upper end face of the upper cover plate and is communicated into the main box body. According to the utility model, the fire extinguisher is arranged on the box body to match with the supporting wax column, so that the fire can be extinguished quickly and timely after accidental fire in the battery transportation process, the asbestos fireproof layer is arranged in the same interlayer, the box body outside the fire can be prevented from being burnt through effectively, the gas detector is arranged on the upper cover plate, and a worker can confirm whether harmful gas is in the box body before opening the box, so that the damage to the body caused by gas leakage due to unknowing opening the box is avoided.

title_en: Air box type pulse dust collector
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of dust collectors, and particularly relates to an air box type pulse dust collector which comprises a dust collection box body and an ash bucket integrally formed at the bottom of the dust collection box body, wherein an air inlet pipe is communicated with an air inlet at one side of the dust collection box body, an air guide plate is fixed on the inner wall of the dust collection box body at one side of the air inlet pipe, a mounting plate is fixedly connected to the upper part of the inner side of the dust collection box body, two venturi tubes which are symmetrically distributed are mounted on the mounting plate, and filter bag bodies are fixed at the bottoms of the two venturi tubes through filter bag frames. According to the utility model, the ash removing plate capable of circularly lifting is arranged on the outer side of the filter bag body, so that dust attached to the filter bag body can be removed when the ash removing plate moves, the filter bag is simple, quick and efficient, the ash removing plate is stopped at the upper part of the filter bag body when the filter bag is not used, and the problem that dust on the filter bag of the equipment at present is difficult to clean is solved.

title_en: Combined waste gas treatment device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a combined waste gas treatment device, which belongs to the technical field of waste gas treatment and comprises a vent pipe, wherein a through hole is transversely formed in the middle of the vent pipe, a plurality of filter screens and a plurality of collecting devices are fixedly connected to the inner surface of the lower side of an air inlet end of the vent pipe, a cleaning device is fixedly connected to the outer surface of the upper end of the vent pipe at the upper end of the filter screens, a plurality of adsorbing devices are slidingly connected to the inner surface of the lower end of the middle of the vent pipe, a fixing plate is fixedly connected to the inner surface of an air outlet end of the vent pipe, a plurality of electric fans are fixedly connected to the inner part of the fixing plate, a servo motor is fixedly connected to the outer surface of the upper end of the vent pipe at the upper end of the fixing plate, waste gas is treated more cleanly through the filter screens and the adsorbing devices, large-particle impurities are conveniently cleaned through a tray, the filter screens are conveniently cleaned through the cleaning device, and the inside active carbon and the like are conveniently replaced through the sliding design of the adsorbing devices.

title_en: Denitrification deep bed filter capable of uniformly adding medicines
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a denitrification deep bed filter capable of uniformly adding medicines, which comprises a medicine mixing tank and a filter which are sequentially connected, wherein the medicine mixing tank is provided with a medicine adding box, the top of the medicine adding box is provided with a plurality of medicine conveying pipes, the top ends of the medicine conveying pipes are provided with medicine storage boxes, a pair of stirring rods are arranged in the medicine adding box, the stirring rods are arranged in the horizontal direction and are parallel to each other, the stirring rods are connected with spiral blades, the rotation directions of the spiral blades of different stirring rods are opposite, one side of the medicine adding box is also provided with a motor cavity, the bottom of the medicine adding box is provided with a medicine outlet which can be opened and closed, the cavity opening of the motor cavity is provided with a baffle plate, a pair of driving motors are arranged in the motor cavity, and the stirring rods penetrate through the baffle plate and are correspondingly connected with the driving motors to carry out matched linkage; the spiral blade with opposite rotation directions is rotated, the medicament is pushed to circularly move in the medicament adding box, the medicament is fully mixed and then is put in from the medicament outlet, and the reduction of the primary treatment effect caused by uneven distribution of different medicaments in sewage is avoided.

title_en: Crop incubator constant temperature and humidity device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a constant temperature and humidity device of a crop incubator, which comprises: the device comprises a water storage tank, a temperature and humidity control box, a heating and humidifying component, an axial flow fan, a gas conveying and distributing pipeline and an air outlet grid; the heating and humidifying component is arranged at the top of the water storage tank and is communicated with the water tank; the upper end of the heating and humidifying component is connected with the lower end of the axial flow fan, the upper end of the axial flow fan is communicated with the top of the incubator through a gas conveying and distributing pipeline, and the lower parts of the two sides of the incubator are provided with gas outlet grids; the incubator is internally provided with a temperature and humidity transmitter, the temperature and humidity control box is internally provided with a temperature and humidity controller, and the temperature and humidity transmitter, the heating and humidifying component and the temperature and humidity controller are connected. The device has reduced the probability that pathogenic bacteria got into the incubator, has improved the survival rate of crop seedling, and simultaneously, the air current that gets into can not cause too big fluctuation to the inside temperature of incubator through heating, is favorable to the growth of crops.

title_en: Kiln body exhaust emission purifier
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of gas treatment in a kiln, and discloses a kiln waste gas emission purification device, which comprises a cleaning tank, wherein two fixing blocks are fixedly connected to the upper surface of the cleaning tank, a purification box is fixedly connected between the outer surfaces of two adjacent sides of the two fixing blocks, the inside of the purification box is hollow, a plurality of first sliding grooves communicated with the inside of the purification box are formed in the upper surface of the purification box, a purification mechanism is arranged on the purification box, the cleaning tank is provided with the cleaning mechanism, the kiln waste gas emission purification device is provided with the cleaning mechanism, a rotary rod rotates to synchronously drive a cleaning brush to rotate, the cleaning brush rotates to brush the front side surface and the rear side surface of a filter plate, manual brushing is not needed, the filter plate is not required to be disassembled in the cleaning process, the cleaning is convenient and quick, a plurality of filter plates can be synchronously brushed, the cleaning efficiency is high, and the practicability of the kiln waste gas emission purification device is further improved.

title_en: Explosion-proof safety device convenient for replacing fire-retardant disk
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of pipeline safety, and discloses an anti-detonation safety device convenient for replacing a fire-retardant disk. The fire-retardant device comprises a shell, wherein a buffer space is formed in the shell, an air inlet and an air outlet are formed in two ends of the shell, and a fire-retardant component is fixedly arranged in the shell; the vortex unit comprises a short pipe, wherein the short pipe is communicated with the air inlet and extends to the inside of the shell, and the diameter of the short pipe is smaller than that of the shell. The utility model provides a fire-retarding component with convenient disassembly of a fire-retarding disk, which can realize independent disassembly of the middle fire-retarding disk, and provides an explosion-proof device with simple and reliable device structure, which can replace a mode of using a long conduit to reduce the damage of detonation, greatly reduce the length of the explosion-proof device and save the space and the cost.

title_en: High-altitude fire-fighting device
abstract_en: The application discloses a high-altitude fire extinguishing device, wherein an arm support assembly is arranged in the middle of a turntable in a centering manner, the structure is more stable, the design is more reasonable and compact, the high-altitude fire extinguishing device adopts a special water pipe arrangement scheme, the water pipes are divided into two sections and are respectively arranged on two horizontal sides of the arm support assembly, the height of the whole vehicle can be greatly reduced, the inner diameter of the water pipe is increased, under the condition that the height of the whole vehicle is fixed, if the water pipe is arranged on one side, the water pipe can only use a small inner diameter, because the bending radius of the water pipe is in direct proportion to the inner diameter of the water pipe, the small inner diameter water pipe can not meet the requirements of special working conditions, and in addition, if the water pipe is arranged on one side, the height of the water pipe can be stacked up, so that the total length of the water pipe is limited.

title_en: Auto-parts processing is with testing platform
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of automobile resistance detection and discloses an automobile accessory processing detection platform which comprises a base, wherein an auxiliary assembly is fixedly connected to the middle of the base, a moving assembly is fixedly connected to the top of the base, and a cleaning device is fixedly connected to the rear side of the middle of the base; the auxiliary assembly comprises a servo motor, the servo motor is fixedly connected to the inner bottom of the base, the output end of the servo motor is fixedly connected with a bidirectional threaded rod, the periphery of the bidirectional threaded rod is connected with two threaded blocks in a threaded manner, and the top of each threaded block is fixedly connected with a connecting block. According to the utility model, the automobile aluminum shell resistor can rotate in the detection process by matching the structures such as the worm, the rotating block, the clamping block and the bidirectional threaded rod, so that the scanning detection of multiple surfaces of the automobile aluminum shell resistor is realized, the integrity of the automobile aluminum shell resistor is conveniently confirmed, and the consistency and safety of the production of the automobile aluminum shell resistor are improved.

title_en: Explosion-proof warm air blower
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an explosion-proof warm air blower, which comprises an explosion-proof shell, a mounting groove and a rapid heating mechanism; explosion-proof shell: the middle part of the inner wall of the explosion-proof shell is fixedly connected with a bracket, the front side surface of the bracket is fixedly connected with a fan, a protection net corresponding to the front side and the back side of the fan is arranged at an air outlet at the front side of the explosion-proof shell, and a shutter plate is arranged on the back side surface of the explosion-proof shell through bolts; and (3) a mounting groove: the filter screen quick-release mechanism is arranged in the mounting groove, and the upper end of the filter screen quick-release mechanism extends to the outside of the upper side surface of the explosion-proof housing and is in sliding connection with the upper side surface of the explosion-proof housing; quick heating mechanism: the explosion-proof device is arranged in the explosion-proof shell; wherein: the fan is characterized by further comprising a singlechip, wherein the singlechip is arranged at the upper end of the front side surface of the explosion-proof shell, the input end of the fan is electrically connected with the input end of the singlechip, the explosion-proof fan heater can quickly replace a filter screen without using complicated steps, and meanwhile, the fan is heated more quickly, and the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Horizontal combined reaction tower for blast furnace gas fine desulfurization large-scale packing
abstract_en: The utility model provides a blast furnace gas fine desulfurization large-scale packing horizontal combined reaction tower, which comprises a lower pretreatment tower and an upper adsorption tower, wherein the lower pretreatment tower is arranged below the upper adsorption tower, an adsorption tower inlet is a horn-shaped inlet and is arranged at the bottom of a second tower body, the upper end of a first air outlet of the lower pretreatment tower is connected with the bottom of the adsorption tower inlet of the upper adsorption tower through a knife-type gate valve, a first air inlet is arranged at the right bottom of the first tower body and is divided into four inlets, and a second air outlet is uniformly arranged at the top of the second tower body in four ways; the first inlet air flow baffle plate of the lower pretreatment tower and the second inlet air flow baffle plate of the upper adsorption tower are umbrella-shaped baffle plates with diagonal braces, and vent holes are formed in the first tower grid plate support and the second tower grid plate support. The pretreatment tower and the adsorption tower are combined in an up-down composite mode, so that the occupied area is greatly saved, and the air flow distribution is stable.

title_en: Front bumper lamp with protective structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a front bar lamp with a protective structure, which relates to the field of automobile lamps, and aims at the problems that the existing front bar lamp is easy to collide with objects such as flying stones and the like during running, is easy to damage due to frequent collision, can generate vapor liquefaction on the front bar lamp in a day-night alternating mode and easily affects the use of the front bar lamp. The front bumper lamp is novel in structure, and the front bumper lamp discharges water vapor in the front bumper lamp through the filter port, so that the front bumper lamp is quickly dried in the front bumper lamp, and the front bumper lamp is matched with the damper in the front bumper lamp through the spring, so that the collision force is reduced, and the light-transmitting shell is protected.

title_en: Efficient garbage incineration power generation device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-efficiency garbage incineration power generation device, which belongs to the technical field of incineration power generation, and comprises an incinerator body and a fire grate structure arranged in the incinerator body; the incinerator body is provided with a feed inlet and a discharge outlet; the fire grate structure comprises a bed body, fire grate pieces arranged on the bed body and a cleaning mechanism arranged on the fire grate structure; the cleaning mechanism comprises a cleaning component arranged on the fire grate segment. The utility model cleans the residues on the fire grate segment by the action of the vibration exciter and the brush, the brush takes up dust, particles and the like at the fire grate segment or the air inlet on the fire grate segment, the dust, the particles and the like are extracted through the exhaust pipe, and the residues with certain bonding force with the fire grate segment are loosened by the vibration of the vibration exciter and can be cleaned by the brush, so that the whole process avoids manual cleaning, the cleaning efficiency is high, and compared with manual cleaning, the efficiency of garbage incineration power generation is improved.

title_en: Waste gas treatment device and roller kiln
abstract_en: The utility model provides an exhaust gas treatment device and a roller kiln, and relates to the field of negative electrode material processing. The waste gas treatment device comprises an incineration part and a pipe fitting, wherein the incineration part can receive combustion-supporting gas and smoke exhausted from a heating section of the roller kiln; the combustion-supporting gas at least comprises air; the incineration member is communicated with the heating section through the pipe fitting, and the pipe fitting is configured to enable the temperature of the flue gas flowing into the incineration member from the heating section to be not less than the ignition point of the flue gas. The structural arrangement of the pipe fitting is utilized, so that heat loss in the process of flowing the flue gas from the roller kiln into the incineration piece is reduced, and the temperature of the flue gas flowing into the incineration piece through the pipe fitting is not less than the ignition point; that is, the high-concentration volatile organic compounds VOCs in the flue gas can be self-ignited after being contacted and mixed with air under the condition of higher temperature, or can be self-ignited only by a small amount of natural gas, namely, the high-concentration VOCs are self-ignited in the incineration member, so that the use of the natural gas to incinerate the high-concentration VOCs in the flue gas is reduced, and the carbonization process cost of a single ton of anode material is reduced.

title_en: Dust fall auxiliary device for building intelligent chemical engineering installation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dust fall auxiliary device for building intelligent chemical engineering installation, which comprises an infusion cover, wherein a spray head is arranged on the front side surface of the infusion cover, a rotating frame is rotatably connected to the left side surface and the right side surface of the infusion cover, a water storage tank is connected to the lower side surface of the rotating frame, a rubber hose communicated with the infusion cover is communicated to the upper side surface of the water storage tank, a second rotating motor is arranged on the upper side surface of the water storage tank, a rope winding shaft is arranged on an output shaft of the second rotating motor, a pull rope is wound on the rope winding shaft, the pull rope is connected with the rear side surface of the infusion cover, and a balancing weight for driving the front end of the infusion cover to rotate downwards is arranged at the front end of the infusion cover; the lower side surface of the water storage tank is connected with a rotating assembly for driving the infusion cover to rotate, and the rotating assembly is communicated with the water storage tank; a water tank is arranged below the rotating assembly, and the upper side surface of the water tank is provided with a lifting assembly and a water pump; the utility model has the advantage of being convenient for adjusting the injection angle of the spray head.

title_en: Purifying device for boiler waste gas treatment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a purification device for boiler waste gas treatment, which comprises a first box body, wherein one side of the first box body is fixedly communicated with an air inlet pipe, one end of the first box body, which is positioned at the air inlet pipe, is fixedly communicated with a dust removing cloth bag, the top of the first box body is fixedly communicated with a connecting pipe, one end of the connecting pipe is fixedly communicated with a second box body, the top of the second box body is provided with a spraying assembly, the inner wall of the second box body is provided with a groove, the inside of the groove is detachably provided with a mounting plate, the inside of the mounting plate is provided with a filter screen, one side, which is positioned below the filter screen, of the second box body is fixedly communicated with a liquid inlet pipe, dust particles in the sprayed adsorption liquid are filtered through the filter screen, the adsorption liquid is recycled through a water pump, the adsorption capacity of the adsorption liquid is ensured, and the stability of the device is improved.

title_en: Heat dissipation device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a heat dissipation device, comprising: a first accommodating part, wherein an accommodating space for accommodating the heat exchange medium is formed inside the first accommodating part, and at least an interface is arranged on the first accommodating part and is used for communicating with a circulating channel of the heat exchange medium; a second accommodating member having an accommodating space formed therein for accommodating a heat exchange medium; the plurality of communication components are arranged in parallel between the first accommodating component and the second accommodating component, two ends of each communication component are respectively communicated with the accommodating space and the accommodating space, and each communication component is made of a heat conduction material; the heat dissipation part is arranged on the communication part, and a plurality of heat dissipation surfaces are formed on the heat dissipation part.

title_en: High-efficiency filter diffusion plate with self-cleaning function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of diffusion plates, and discloses a high-efficiency filter diffusion plate with a self-cleaning function, which comprises a diffusion plate body, wherein a self-cleaning mechanism is arranged at the top of the diffusion plate body and comprises a dust collection box which is fixedly connected to the left side of the top of the diffusion plate body, and a guide pipe is fixedly connected to the top of the dust collection box. According to the utility model, the installation frame, the motor, the screw rod, the positioning block, the guide block and the guide cover are matched, so that the dust hood is conveniently and stably driven to move above the diffusion plate, and dust above the diffusion plate is conveniently sucked into the dust collection box through the matching of the guide pipe, the dust collection pump, the telescopic hose, the dust hood and the dust collection channel, so that the dust on the diffusion plate is conveniently cleaned, the cleanliness of the diffusion plate is maintained, the dust is prevented from being attached to the diffusion plate, the condition that the airflow passes through the diffusion plate is influenced, and the diffusion plate is convenient to self-clean.

title_en: Intelligent ignition control device for fire exercise
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent ignition control device for a fire exercise, and belongs to the technical field of fire training. The control unit is connected with an external control cabinet through a general control interface, the control unit is connected with an external upper computer through an Ethernet interface, a signal input end of the control unit is connected with a detection component to obtain a measurement signal of the detection component, an input end and an output end of the detection component are connected with an ignition component through an ignition head interface, the detection component is connected with a relay, when the detection component detects that the ignition component abnormally gives out an alarm, an alarm signal of the detection component is transmitted to the external control cabinet through an isolated relay contact signal, the external control cabinet and the control unit are mutually matched to control the ignition component to start and stop, and meanwhile, the alarm signal is transmitted to the upper computer through an Ethernet communication interface, and the fault is recorded and stored through the upper computer. According to the utility model, the external control cabinet is in communication connection with the detection component, the detection signal of the detection component is obtained, the obtained detection signal is compared with the logic required state, and the whole process of independent ignition start and stop can be completed by matching the control unit with the external control cabinet for adjusting and controlling the ignition component.

title_en: Air conditioner filter with multilayer structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an air conditioner filter with a multilayer structure, which relates to the technical field of air conditioner filters and comprises an air conditioner filter main body, wherein a later installation mechanism is arranged between the air conditioner filter main body and the air conditioner filter main body, so that the technical problems that the filter element is inconvenient to detach and difficult to clean or replace when the air conditioner filter element is cleaned or replaced are solved, a rotating wheel is reversely rotated, then a fixing block can be driven to be separated from a fixing groove through a threaded ring, the fixation of the filter element is relieved, the detachment of the filter element is realized, and the air conditioner filter element is convenient to detach after the air conditioner filter element is used for a long time, and the air conditioner filter element is convenient to clean or replace.

title_en: Dust remover for glass fiber production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a glass fiber production dust remover, which comprises a box body, wherein a sealing limiting assembly is arranged in the box body, the sealing limiting assembly comprises a mounting block, a first limiting chute is formed in the top of the mounting block, a filter plate is fixedly connected to the top of the mounting block, a second limiting chute is formed in one side of the filter plate, a cover plate is fixedly connected to the movable end of an electric telescopic rod, a sealing door plate is fixedly connected to one side of the placing plate, an auxiliary plate is fixedly connected to the bottom of the placing plate, and the movable end of a telescopic cylinder is fixedly connected with the auxiliary plate; this glass fiber produces dust remover is through placing the board and filter and apron and seal door plant's cooperation jointly for with the glass fiber material restriction that dries in the air in certain space, can effectually prevent to be blown indiscriminately by the air current, and receive the material all very swiftly through flexible cylinder blowing.

title_en: Air source heat pump dryer
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of dryers, and provides an air-source heat pump dryer which comprises a dryer main body, wherein the dryer main body is provided with a return air pipeline and an air outlet pipeline, a bottom frame is fixed at the bottom of the dryer main body, a movable supporting component is arranged at the bottom of the dryer main body, an air inlet pipeline is arranged at the air inlet end of the dryer main body, a filtering and cleaning component is arranged outside the air inlet pipeline, the filtering and cleaning component comprises a gas collecting cover, and a butt joint sleeve is arranged on the surface of the gas collecting cover. Through above-mentioned technical scheme, the fan that has solved current air energy heat pump drying-machine among the correlation technique mainly through the air inlet installation blows out the heat of equipment inside from the outlet duct, and the air intake needs to install the filter screen and filters the air current that gets into box inside, prevents that external debris from entering into the inside in stoving room, after long-time use, the filter screen is stopped up easily, need lift it off just can clean it, complex operation needs a large amount of manual times, extravagant cost's problem.

title_en: Ammonia water gasification flue gas desulfurization device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ammonia water gasification flue gas desulfurization device, which comprises a desulfurization box, wherein a filter assembly communicated with the desulfurization box is arranged on the side wall of one end of the desulfurization box, a flue gas inlet pipe is arranged on the filter assembly, an ammonia water tank is arranged on the other side of the desulfurization box, a spray pipe extending into the desulfurization box is arranged in the ammonia water tank, an ammonia pipe extending into the desulfurization box and positioned above the spray pipe is arranged on the ammonia water tank through an ammonia water gasifier, and a mixing assembly positioned above the ammonia pipe is arranged on the side wall of the desulfurization box in a penetrating manner. The utility model has reasonable structural design, can primarily remove sulfur in the flue gas by spraying ammonia water, and further remove sulfur in the flue gas by contacting ammonia gas with the flue gas, and the mixing component stirs the mixed gas of the flue gas and ammonia gas to fully mix and react, so that the reaction time of the ammonia gas and the flue gas can be prolonged by intermittently opening and closing the plugging plate, and further, the sulfur in the flue gas can be fully removed.

title_en: A agitating unit for dirty resourceful treatment of excrement
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of stirring, in particular to a stirring device for recycling feces, which is convenient for a fixed plate and a stirring rod to mix and stir raw materials in different areas of the bottom area of a stirring bin, so that the stirring effect and the stirring efficiency of the device on the materials are improved, and the practicability is improved; the vertical rotation in top of stirring storehouse installs the rotation axis, the bottom slidable mounting of rotation axis has the gag lever post, the bottom fixed mounting of gag lever post has the screw rod, the middle part region of the inside wall of stirring storehouse has a fixed section of thick bamboo through a plurality of support fixed mounting, the middle part region of the inside wall of fixed section of thick bamboo and the middle part region spiral shell dress of screw rod, the bottom fixed mounting of screw rod has the fixed plate, fixed mounting has a plurality of puddlers all around on the lateral wall of fixed plate, the material discharging pipe is installed to the intercommunication on the lateral wall of stirring storehouse, the inlet pipe is installed in the top intercommunication of stirring storehouse, rotatory access door of installing on the lateral wall of stirring storehouse.

title_en: Auxiliary device for ventilation and combustion supporting of boiler
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a ventilation and combustion-supporting auxiliary device for a boiler, which relates to the technical field of ventilation and combustion-supporting of boilers, and comprises a boiler, wherein a bearing assembly is fixedly arranged in the boiler, the surface of the boiler is fixedly provided with a blowing mechanism, the bottom of the boiler is movably provided with a through hole ejection mechanism, and the bottom of the boiler is movably provided with a collecting assembly. According to the utility model, the collecting assembly is arranged, so that dust generated by burning part of combustion matters can be collected, excessive dust accumulation can not occur because the collecting assembly is arranged under the air guide pipe, the port of the air guide pipe is blocked or enters the blower to cause damage because the dust is not cleaned in time, and the reminding cleaning unit is arranged in the collecting box, so that the dust is supported by the supporting plate, the downward movement can be realized by the pressing spring under the influence of weight, and a small amount of dust can be discharged from the dust outlet groove after the dust is moved to a certain position, so that the staff can be timely reminded of cleaning the dust in the air guide pipe.

title_en: Smoke extraction and dust removal device for medium-frequency electric furnace
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a smoke extraction and dust removal device of an intermediate frequency electric furnace, which comprises the following components: the box body is provided with a moving wheel at the bottom, and a box door is arranged on the side wall of the box body; the fan is arranged at the top of the box body, and the output end of the fan is connected with an exhaust pipe; the dust collection assembly is arranged at the top of the box body; the filter assembly is arranged at the inner top of the box body and is connected with the fan. The self-cleaning device can realize self-cleaning of the filter screen cylinder, further does not need to frequently take out, clean or replace the filter screen cylinder, is more convenient to use, can discharge the dust-removed flue gas outdoors, and avoids the influence of the flue gas on the working environment.

title_en: Parallel double-air-duct and dust remover
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a parallel double-air-duct and dust remover, which comprises a mounting plate, wherein two groups of filter boxes are arranged at the upper part of the mounting plate in a penetrating way, air inlet pipes are arranged at the end faces of the two groups of filter boxes in a penetrating way, air outlet pipes are arranged at the rear end faces of the two groups of filter boxes in a penetrating way, a three-way pipe is arranged between the two groups of air outlet pipes, an activated carbon box is arranged at one end part of the three-way pipe, a fan is arranged at the lower part of the activated carbon box, a mounting square pipe is arranged between the two groups of filter boxes in a penetrating way, a water storage box is arranged between the two groups of filter boxes, four groups of support columns are welded at the lower part of the mounting plate, and an electric cabinet is arranged on the side wall of one group of support column. The beneficial effects are that: the utility model adopts the installation square tube, and can remove dust and impurities adsorbed on the outer wall of the filter core through the installation square tube, and can avoid foreign objects from contacting the driving structure, thereby guaranteeing the use safety of the parallel double air channels and the dust remover.

title_en: Indoor formaldehyde purifying box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an indoor formaldehyde purification box which comprises a purification box body, wherein bases are fixedly connected to two sides of the bottom of an inner cavity of the purification box body, a first spring is fixedly connected to the bottom of the inner cavity of the base, and a reset plate is fixedly connected to the top of the first spring. According to the utility model, firstly, when the solid purification block needs to be replaced, a user takes down the cover plate, then pulls the pull rod to move, drives the sliding plate to move through the pull rod, drives the limiting plate to move through the sliding plate, eliminates the limiting pressure of the placing plate after the limiting plate is separated from the surface of the placing plate, simultaneously, automatically resets the first spring, pushes the reset plate to reset through the first spring, pushes the reset rod to reset through the reset plate, pushes the placing plate to reset through the reset rod, pushes the residual solid purification block on the surface to the outside of the purification box body through the placing plate, and then replaces the new solid purification block.

title_en: Full-automatic scale inhibitor adds device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a full-automatic scale inhibitor adding device; the scale inhibitor comprises a raw liquid tank and a scale inhibitor liquid tank, wherein the raw liquid tank is communicated with the scale inhibitor liquid tank through a first pipeline, the first pipeline is also communicated with a first metering pump and a first electric control valve, a diluent liquid tank is communicated with the scale inhibitor liquid tank through a second pipeline, the second pipeline is communicated with a second metering pump and a second electric control valve, the scale inhibitor liquid tank is communicated with a water preparation system through a third pipeline, a raw liquid level meter is arranged in the raw liquid tank, a scale inhibitor liquid level meter is arranged in the scale inhibitor liquid tank, and the third pipeline is communicated with a third metering pump and a third electric control valve; the scale inhibitor liquid level meter is electrically connected with the intelligent control box, the first metering pump, the second metering pump, the first electric control valve and the second electric control valve are electrically connected with the intelligent control box, the intelligent control box is electrically connected with the direct drinking water system control box, and the third metering pump and the third electric control valve are electrically connected with the direct drinking water system control box.

title_en: High-stability building rubbish smashing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-stability construction waste crushing device, which belongs to the technical field of construction, and comprises a base, a placing groove and a shell, wherein the placing groove is arranged in the base, the shell is arranged at the upper end of the base, the high-stability construction waste crushing device has the beneficial effects that when the construction waste crushing device works, under the cooperation of slide bar, spring, sliding sleeve, connecting rod, first connecting seat and second connecting seat for shell lower surface extrusion second connecting seat, under the transmission of connecting rod, the sliding sleeve slides along the slide bar and extrudees the spring, thereby keeps balancing through the horizontal distance of continuous change sliding sleeve, thereby has played fine cushioning effect, can effectually alleviate the problem such as shake and noise, thereby has improved the practicality of device.

title_en: High-efficient anaerobic jar deoxidization device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-efficiency anaerobic tank deoxidizing device, which belongs to the technical field of anaerobic tank equipment and comprises a tank body, a supporting frame, supporting columns, a closing mechanism and an deoxidizing mechanism, wherein the closing mechanism comprises an extending cylinder and an air extracting assembly, the tank body is arranged on the supporting frame, the supporting columns are provided with a plurality of supporting columns which are all arranged on the supporting frame, the extending cylinder is connected with a tank body main body, the extending cylinder is connected with the air extracting assembly, the air extracting assembly is connected with the supporting frame, the deoxidizing mechanism is connected with the air extracting assembly, and the deoxidizing mechanism is arranged on the supporting frame.

title_en: Automatic cleaning start-stop type MBBR water heater
abstract_en: The utility model provides an automatic cleaning and opening-closing type MBBR water device which comprises an anaerobic tank, an aerobic tank and a sedimentation tank, wherein a drain hole is formed between the aerobic tank and the sedimentation tank, and the automatic cleaning and filtering assembly is arranged in the aerobic tank and comprises an upper mounting plate, a speed reducing motor arranged on the upper mounting plate, a rotating shaft connected with the speed reducing motor, a rotary filter screen connected with the rotating shaft, and a scraping plate arranged on one side of the rotary filter screen, wherein the rotary filter screen is tubular, and covers the drain hole. Above-mentioned automatic clear open-close type MBBR water purifier, during the use, the impurity that the rotation type filter screen can avoid the large granule gets into in the sedimentation tank, and gear motor is opened to the rethread interval to drive rotation type filter screen rotation for a period of time, and clear away the fluidized bed filler that adheres to on the rotation type filter screen through the scraper blade, avoid fluidized bed filler to block up rotation type filter screen, and then avoid blockking up the wash port.

title_en: SMBR reactor
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of sewage treatment, and particularly relates to an SMBR reactor, which comprises a box body, wherein a first baffle plate and a second baffle plate are respectively fixed on the inner wall of the box body, a filter plate is connected between the first baffle plate and the box body in a sliding manner, a cleaning mechanism is arranged on the surface of the filter plate, a plurality of inclined plates are fixed between the first baffle plate and the second baffle plate, an SMBR membrane box is arranged between the second baffle plate and the box body, one side of the box body is communicated with a water inlet pipe, the other end of the box body is communicated with a blow-down valve, and one side of the box body is provided with a through groove; according to the utility model, the automatic ejection of the filter plate can be realized through the cooperation of the seal plate and the spring, the seal plate can be quickly fixed by the elastic eye-splice, the filter plate can be conveniently taken out of the equipment, and impurities and dirt on the surface of the filter plate can be conveniently cleaned by the cleaning plate on the surface of the filter plate, so that the cleaning speed and efficiency of the filter plate are greatly improved, and the filter plate is prevented from being blocked when in use.

title_en: Novel but dust removal rubbing crusher
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of lime crushing, in particular to a novel dust-removing crusher, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the top of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a crusher shell, the top of the crusher shell is clamped with a top cover, the bottom of the top cover is fixedly connected with a porous adsorption pad, one side of the crusher shell is provided with a fan, the other side of the crusher shell is fixedly connected with a dust collecting box, and the top of the dust collecting box is rotationally connected with a rotary table; through setting up top cap, porous adsorption pad, the water tank, the suction pump, the flabellum, the shower nozzle, suction pump and dust collection box's cooperation is used, can adsorb the dust at top through porous adsorption pad when smashing lime, collect in blowing dust collection box through the fan simultaneously, then take out shower nozzle department blowout with water through the suction pump, and then make the flabellum rotate and break up into the water smoke with the water column, and then can clear away dust again, improve the comprehensiveness of removing dust, avoid the dust to give off in the air and cause the pollution to the air, make the rubbing crusher environmental protection stronger when using.

title_en: Movable sludge dewatering machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a movable sludge dewatering machine which comprises a dewatering machine body, a plurality of universal wheels, a supporting mechanism and fixing mechanisms, wherein the universal wheels are fixedly connected with the lower surface of the dewatering machine body in a rectangular array, the supporting mechanism is arranged on two sides of the lower surface of the dewatering machine body, and the fixing mechanisms are arranged on two sides of the dewatering machine body. According to the utility model, the movable block and the clamping teeth are driven to vertically move upwards by rotating the screw, the clamping teeth are connected with the gears in a meshed manner, the gears on two sides are driven to rotate, so that the gears drive the supporting block to rotate, the movable rod and the connecting rod are driven to rotate together along with the rotation of the supporting block and the fixed block, the movable rod and the connecting rod rotate to the vertical direction, the nut is screwed upwards on the connecting rod, the top end of the nut is attached to the bottom end of the movable rod, the connecting rod and the movable rod are limited and fixed, the fixed block is extruded downwards, the stability of the supporting block and the fixed block is ensured, and the main body of the dehydrator is ensured to stably work.

title_en: Three-rope type grid dirt remover
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of dirt removers, in particular to a three-rope type grid dirt remover; technical problems: in the using process of the traditional dirt removing machine, the three-rope type grid dirt removing machine is complex in grab bucket structure, and the grab bucket structure is used for frequently salvaging garbage in sewage, so that the problem of convenient dirt removing is inconvenient to realize if equipment fails; the technical scheme is as follows: a three-rope type grid dirt remover comprises a rotating assembly, an auxiliary assembly and a dumping assembly; compared with the traditional dirt separator in the process of using, the three-rope type grid dirt separator is complex in grab structure setting, because the grab structure needs to salvage rubbish in sewage frequently, if equipment breaks down, be unfavorable for overhauling and maintaining to inconvenient convenient dirt removal's of realization problem, this dirt separator is through setting up and is emptyd the structure, and starting drive can drive grab structure and realize going up and down, adjusts grab structure through driving structure, and grab structure rethread is emptyd the structure and is realized rotating, thereby can reach convenient dirt removal's purpose.

title_en: LF urban sludge renewable resource curing agent spraying device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an LF urban sludge renewable resource curing agent spraying device which comprises a trolley, wherein the top end of the trolley is provided with a top plate, the top end of the top plate is provided with a powder tank, the top end of the powder tank is provided with an air pressure tank, one side of the air pressure tank is provided with an air inlet structure, the bottom of the top plate is provided with a battery, one end of the trolley is provided with a control assembly, one ends of the air pressure tank and the air inlet structure are electrically connected with the control assembly, one end of the powder tank is communicated with an air pipe, the tail end of the air pipe is communicated with a spraying frame, a plurality of groups of spray heads are arranged in the spraying frame, the air inlet structure can be driven by the control structure to add high-pressure air into the air pressure tank and convey the high-pressure air to the air tank downwards, and the powder curing agent in the powder tank is sprayed outwards through the air pipe and the spraying frame to cover the surface of sludge, so that the activated effect is achieved, and the powder curing agent is sprayed out along with the high-pressure air.

title_en: Cotton yarn surface fabric storing compartment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cotton spinning fabric storage cabinet which comprises a cabinet body with a single-side opening side, wherein a cabinet door which is opened and closed left and right is arranged on the corresponding opening side of the cabinet body, a supporting shaft is arranged at the bottom of the cabinet body, the supporting shaft is horizontally arranged, the end parts of the supporting shaft are respectively fixed on the left side wall and the right side wall of the cabinet body, a plurality of shaft sleeves are sequentially sleeved on the supporting shaft along the length direction, the shaft sleeves are limitedly arranged on the supporting shaft and are in rotary fit, a supporting plate is fixed on the upper side of the shaft sleeves and used for limitedly supporting a cotton spinning winding drum, and a limiting device is arranged between the supporting plate and the rear side wall of the cabinet body. When the cotton spinning winding drum is installed and stored, the axis of the cotton spinning winding drum is perpendicular to the center of the supporting plate, so that the cotton spinning winding drum stored in the cabinet body is in a vertical state, and the cotton spinning winding drums are prevented from being mutually extruded. When the cotton spinning winding drum is taken, the cabinet door is opened, the cotton spinning winding drum is turned over under the rotation action of the shaft sleeve, the angle of the cotton spinning winding drum is inclined, is convenient for taking.

title_en: Cloth bag dust removing device for boiler
