abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of bag-type dust removal, in particular to a bag-type dust removal device for a boiler, which comprises a bearing support, a dust removal assembly, a reciprocating assembly arranged at the top of the bearing support, and a front-back displacement assembly fixed on the reciprocating assembly, wherein the reciprocating assembly comprises a U-shaped support fixed at the top of the bearing support, a reciprocating screw rod and a pair of guide rods for guiding are arranged between the upper end and the lower end of the U-shaped support through bearings, a gear motor is started, the gear motor drives the reciprocating screw rod to rotate, and because two guide sleeves and a threaded sleeve are fixed on a limiting seat, the limiting seat limits the threaded sleeve and the guide sleeve, at the moment, the rotation of the reciprocating screw rod drives the threaded sleeve and the guide sleeve to axially reciprocate in the up-down direction, and then drives the limiting seat to reciprocate up-down, and further drives a blowing device of the dust removal assembly to perform dust removal operation in the up-down direction inside the bag, and the dust removal effect is better.

title_en: Rainwater collecting and purifying device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of rainwater collection and purification, in particular to a rainwater collection and purification device, which comprises a box body, wherein a filter plate is welded on the inner wall of the box body, a guide plate is welded on the side wall of the filter plate, a screw rod is rotatably arranged on the inner wall of a sliding groove through a bearing, a sliding block is arranged in the sliding groove, a mounting frame is welded on the sliding groove, a hydraulic cylinder is arranged on the mounting frame, a hydraulic rod is connected to the hydraulic cylinder, a brush holder is arranged on the bottom side of the hydraulic rod, a brush is arranged on the brush holder, the mounting frame is driven to move along the sliding block, the brush holder is driven to move by the mounting frame, the brush holder drives the brush to move, the impurity on the filter plate is pushed to move until the brush moves above the guide plate, the impurity is swept onto the guide plate, then the impurity slides along the slope of the guide plate, and finally the filter plate is discharged from a discharge hopper, so that the impurity on the filter plate is efficiently cleaned, the filter effect is improved, and the purification efficiency is improved.

title_en: Cloth bag dust remover
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cloth bag dust collector, which belongs to the field of environmental protection equipment and comprises a dust collector shell, wherein a baffle plate is welded at the top end of the inside of the dust collector shell, a bottom rod is welded at the bottom end of the inside of the dust collector shell, through holes are uniformly formed in the inside of the baffle plate, a cloth bag barrel penetrates through the position of the baffle plate corresponding to the through holes, a framework is embedded in the cloth bag barrel, the cloth bag dust collector also comprises a pulley block, a dust scraping plate and a pull rope, the pulley block comprises a fixed pulley A, a fixed pulley B, a fixed pulley C and a fixed pulley D, the fixed pulley A is arranged in the center of the bottom surface of the baffle plate, the dust scraping plate is newly added in the dust collector shell, is controlled by the pull rope, is nested outside the cloth bag barrel through the dust scraping hole, bristles are fixedly adhered in the dust scraping hole, one ends of the bristles are tightly attached to the outer wall of the cloth bag barrel, and can clean the surface of the cloth bag barrel by manually pulling the bristles in the process of controlling the dust scraping plate to move up and down, so that the cleaning effect is better, and the practicability is higher.

title_en: Wave soldering device for circuit board
abstract_en: The application discloses a wave soldering device for a circuit board, belongs to the technical field of circuit board production, and solves the problem that a filter screen is inconvenient to clean in the prior art. The application comprises a crest welder body, a guide pipe, an air extractor, a filter screen, a driving device, a brush and a dust collector. The waste gas generated in the wave soldering process can be extracted, so that the waste gas is gathered in the guide pipe, and further purification of the waste gas is facilitated. The filter screen can filter the solid impurity in the waste gas, prevents that solid impurity from getting into the air exhauster through the pipe inside and causing the air exhauster trouble. The driving device can drive the filter screen to move along the direction perpendicular to the axis of the guide pipe, so that the filter screen is far away from the guide pipe, the brush can brush off solid impurities on the surface of the filter screen in the horizontal movement process of the filter screen, and the dust collector can timely suck off the solid impurities brushed off by the brush, thereby being convenient and quick.

title_en: Detection device for pipeline drainage effect
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a detection device for a pipeline drainage effect, which comprises a shell, a test structure arranged on the shell, a control device arranged in the shell, a display screen arranged on the surface of the shell, a dehumidifying structure arranged in the shell and a protection structure arranged at the bottom of the shell, wherein the test structure, the display screen and the dehumidifying device are connected with the control device. The utility model tests the stray current of the pipeline by using the test structure, the control device records, stores and analyzes the test result, and the result is displayed on the display screen by the display screen. Meanwhile, a dehumidifying device is arranged in the shell to keep the inside of the shell dry, and a protective structure is arranged at the bottom of the shell, so that when the drainage effect of the pipeline is detected, the protective structure protects the shell from being scratched or soaked in mud water on site, and the detecting device is protected.

title_en: Wire drawing machine that fracture-proof environment-friendly braided bag processing was used
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of environment-friendly woven bag processing wire drawing machines, and provides an anti-breakage environment-friendly woven bag processing wire drawing machine which comprises a communication rod, wherein two sides of the communication rod are symmetrically and fixedly connected with side plates, a cutting die is arranged at the top end of the communication rod, a limiting plate is clamped between the two side plates, the cutting die penetrates through the limiting plate, a cleaning assembly is arranged at the top end of the limiting plate, and comprises a cavity accommodating plate fixedly connected to the top end of the limiting plate.

title_en: Activated carbon biological filter
abstract_en: The application discloses an activated carbon biological filter, and belongs to the technical field of wastewater treatment. The activated carbon biological filter comprises a tank body, an activated carbon filler layer, a water inlet pipe, a water outlet pipe, an aeration pipe, a backwash water pipe, a backwash air pipe and a backwash water outlet pipe, wherein the activated carbon filler layer is arranged in the tank body along the horizontal direction so as to divide the tank body into a first space and a second space from top to bottom, the water inlet end of the water outlet pipe and the water inlet end of the backwash water outlet pipe are arranged in the first space, the water outlet end of the water inlet pipe, the air outlet end of the aeration pipe, the water outlet end of the backwash water pipe and the air outlet end of the backwash air outlet pipe are arranged in the second space, and the height of the water inlet end of the backwash water outlet pipe is lower than that of the water inlet end of the water outlet pipe. By arranging the water inlet pipe of the backwash drain pipe lower than the water inlet end of the water outlet pipe, the waste of water sources in the backwash process is reduced, and the backwash efficiency is improved.

title_en: System for preparing krypton
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rare gas preparation, in particular to a krypton preparation system which comprises an air source, a vacuum container, a krypton collection container and a temperature control assembly, wherein a first-stage adsorption container, a second-stage adsorption container and a third-stage adsorption container are arranged in the vacuum container, the air source, the first-stage adsorption container, the second-stage adsorption container, the third-stage adsorption container and the krypton collection container are sequentially connected, the second-stage adsorption container and the third-stage adsorption container further purify krypton, the air source conveys air to the vacuum container, the krypton collection container collects the prepared krypton, and the temperature control assembly is arranged on one side of the first-stage adsorption container, the second-stage adsorption container and the third-stage adsorption container and controls the temperature of the first-stage adsorption container, the second-stage adsorption container and the third-stage adsorption container. The utility model effectively solves the problem that high-purity krypton is difficult to prepare from air conveniently and stably, and the system has the advantages of simple structure, convenient operation, high safety and convenient preparation process.

title_en: Probiotics slow-release equipment
abstract_en: A probiotic slow release device relates to the technical field of probiotic slow release and comprises a water pipe fixedly arranged, a slow release kettle is fixedly arranged on the side of the water pipe, the slow release kettle is communicated with the water pipe through a feeding component, a spraying component communicated with the feeding component is arranged in the water pipe, the adding metering of probiotics can be changed in real time according to the flow of water in the water pipe through the feeding component, so that probiotics can be uniformly slowly released in the water, probiotics can be uniformly added into flowing water through the spraying component in a dropwise manner, so that the probiotics and the water are uniformly mixed, and the feeding component comprises two feeding cylinders symmetrically arranged along the axial section of the slow release kettle. The utility model solves the problem that the content of probiotics can change along with the change of water flow in the process of releasing probiotics by the traditional probiotics releasing equipment, so that the probiotics releasing is not uniform, and the problem that the probiotics are easily mixed with the water body is easily caused by directly dripping the probiotics into the flowing water body for releasing.

title_en: Novel intelligent garbage pneumatic conveying and delivering station
abstract_en: The utility model provides a novel intelligent garbage pneumatic conveying throwing station, which is based on a garbage pneumatic conveying system, wherein the garbage pneumatic conveying system comprises a pneumatic pipeline for conveying garbage, the pneumatic pipeline is connected with an air inlet, and further comprises a harmful garbage throwing box, a kitchen garbage throwing box, other garbage throwing boxes and recyclable object throwing boxes which are arranged side by side, throwing openings are respectively formed in the harmful garbage throwing box, the kitchen garbage throwing box, the other garbage throwing boxes and the recyclable object throwing box, the kitchen garbage throwing box is connected with the pneumatic pipeline through a first branch pipe, the other garbage throwing boxes are connected with the pneumatic pipeline through a second branch pipe, the garbage pneumatic conveying system is suitable for garbage pneumatic conveying systems, garbage classification throwing is supported, harmful garbage is separated, recyclable objects are convenient to recycle, kitchen garbage and other garbage are independently conveyed through the pneumatic system, the garbage treatment capacity and treatment equipment of the pneumatic system can be reduced, and the treatment cost is lowered.

title_en: Wedge array type silencer with metal shell
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wedge array type muffler with a metal shell, which relates to the technical field of noise elimination and comprises a box body, wherein a non-metal frame is fixedly connected to an inner cavity of the box body, a plurality of supporting rods are fixedly connected to the front end and the rear end of the interior of the box body, conical sleeves are fixedly connected to opposite surfaces of the supporting rods on the front side and the rear side, wedge pore plates are fixedly connected to opposite surfaces of the conical sleeves on the front side and the rear side, a filtering structure is fixedly arranged on the front portion and the rear portion of the box body, a collecting structure is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the filtering structure, and the filtering structure comprises two filter plates and two supports. According to the wedge array type silencer with the metal shell, through the action of the filtering structure, air flow passing through the wedge pore plate can be filtered, smoothness of the air flow passing through the wedge pore plate is guaranteed, sundries in air are prevented from accumulating on holes of the wedge pore plate, blocking is caused, and silencing effect of the silencer is affected.

title_en: Flue gas pretreatment denitrification facility
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a flue gas pretreatment denitration device, which comprises a tripod, wherein a cooling mechanism is arranged on the upper side of the tripod, a fixing mechanism is arranged on the front side of the cooling mechanism, the cooling mechanism comprises a water collecting tank fixedly arranged at the upper side of the tripod, a cooling cylinder is fixedly connected to the upper side of the water collecting tank, a flue inlet is fixedly arranged on the rear side of the cooling cylinder, a flue outlet is fixedly connected to the front side of the cooling cylinder, an air inlet is fixedly arranged on one side of the cooling cylinder, and an air outlet is fixedly connected to the other side of the cooling cylinder. According to the flue gas pretreatment denitration device, heat exchange is carried out between high-temperature flue gas and low-temperature air entering the inner side of the cooling cylinder, meanwhile, water flows are sprayed out through the spray head to cool the circular pipe in a double-layer mode, the flue gas temperature is stably controlled within a proper range, sintering caused by flue gas catalyst particles is avoided, and therefore the service life and activity of a flue gas catalyst are prolonged.

title_en: Water drinking device filtering structure for business car
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a drinking water equipment filtering structure for a business vehicle, which comprises a cabinet body, wherein a faucet is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the cabinet body, a water storage tank is fixedly connected to the inner bottom wall of the cabinet body, a pump body is fixedly arranged on the inner bottom wall of the water storage tank, the output end of the pump body is fixedly communicated with a transmission pipe, one end of the transmission pipe, which is far away from the pump body, sequentially penetrates through the water storage tank and the cabinet body and is fixedly communicated with the input end of the faucet, and the upper surface of the water storage tank is fixedly connected with a filtering box through a support column. The device is through the mutual cooperation of cobblestone layer, quartz sand layer, coke layer and active carbon layer, can make rivers when inside the rose box, utilize the filtration and the absorption of cobblestone layer, quartz sand layer, coke layer and active carbon layer to reach and filter tiny impurity in the rivers, thereby reach the effect of filtering out impurity in the aquatic, through setting up the water storage tank, can be convenient for store the rivers after filtering.

title_en: Environment-friendly electrochemical water treatment equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides environment-friendly electrochemical water treatment equipment, which relates to the technical field of water treatment, and comprises a treatment tank and an auxiliary device, wherein two sides of the treatment tank are fixedly connected with a water inlet pipe and a water outlet pipe respectively, the upper surface of the treatment tank is fixedly connected with a bracket, the bottom of the bracket is fixedly connected with two electrode plates which are symmetrical with each other, the upper surface of the bracket is provided with a cleaning device, the cleaning device comprises a servo motor, the servo motor is fixedly connected with the upper surface of the bracket, the output end of the servo motor is fixedly connected with a screw rod, the arc surface of the screw rod is in threaded connection with a movable plate, two ends of the movable plate are fixedly connected with a cleaning frame by the auxiliary device, and the cleaning frame is sleeved on the surface of the electrode plate.

title_en: Fire extinguishing system of wind generating set and wind driven generator
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of fire protection systems, in particular to a fire protection system of a wind generating set and a wind driven generator. The fire extinguishing system comprises at least two fire extinguishing areas, each fire extinguishing area comprises a smoke detection module, a temperature detection module, a controller module and a fire extinguishing module, wherein the smoke detection module is used for sending an alarm signal to the controller module when the detected smoke information of the fire extinguishing areas reaches a preset smoke threshold value, the temperature detection module is used for sending the alarm signal to the controller module when the detected temperature information of the fire extinguishing areas reaches the preset temperature threshold value, the controller module is used for receiving the alarm signals sent by the smoke detection module and the temperature detection module and sending the fire extinguishing signals to the fire extinguishing module, and the fire extinguishing module is used for acting to spray fire extinguishing agent when the fire extinguishing signals are received. According to the application, the unit is comprehensively monitored by arranging the plurality of areas, and when a fire accident occurs, accurate automatic fire control can be performed aiming at the fire position, so that the fire control accuracy and efficiency are improved.

title_en: Water mist tail end water testing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water mist tail end water testing device which comprises a spray head protection mechanism and a rotating motor arranged on one side of the inside of the spray head protection mechanism, wherein the top of the spray head protection mechanism is provided with a water testing mechanism, the bottom of the water testing mechanism is provided with a water mist spray head, the spray head protection mechanism comprises a spray head protection cover, a spray through hole is formed in the spray head protection cover, a spray fixing ring is fixedly arranged in the middle of the spray through hole, the rotating motor is fixedly arranged on one side of the inside of the spray head protection cover, the output end of the rotating motor is fixedly connected with a driving bevel gear, the top of the driving bevel gear is in meshed connection with a rotating cone ring, the spray head protection cover and a protection baffle plate are arranged to wrap the water mist spray head, meanwhile, the spray through hole in the spray head protection cover is opened through the rotating motor, and impurities in a water inlet pipe can be filtered through a filter pipe and a filter screen by the arrangement of the water testing mechanism.

title_en: Novel kettle structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of household appliances, in particular to a novel kettle structure, which comprises a kettle body, a kettle base and an electrolysis assembly, wherein a water storage cavity is arranged in the kettle body, a water outlet is arranged at the upper end of the kettle body, the kettle base is arranged below the kettle body, and the electrolysis assembly is detachably connected with the bottom of the water storage cavity. The water outlet is used for facilitating a user to pour out the water treated by the electrolysis assembly. The kettle base plays a role in supporting and stabilizing the kettle body. The electrolytic assembly is detachably connected to the bottom of the water storage chamber, which enables a user to conveniently clean and replace the electrolytic assembly. The main function of the electrolysis assembly is to electrolyze the water in the water storage cavity, and hydrogen ions are generated by electrolyzing mineral substances in the water. The existence of hydrogen ions can change the pH value of water and possibly react with other minerals in the water, so that the mineral content in the water is regulated, and the quality of drinking water is improved.

title_en: Unidirectional shrinkage air filtering non-woven fabric and filtering device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a unidirectional shrinkage air filtering non-woven fabric which comprises a pre-filtering layer and a fine filtering layer, wherein the fine filtering layer is fixedly and compositely arranged on the exhaust side of the pre-filtering layer, first shrinkage areas and flattening areas are alternately arranged along the pre-filtering layer in a first direction, the first shrinkage areas are provided with heat shrinkage wrinkles extending along a second direction, and the first direction and the second direction are mutually perpendicular. The unidirectional shrinkage air filtering non-woven fabric is characterized in that the pre-filtering layer is partitioned and arranged, the first shrinkage area is favorable for increasing the effective filtering area and filtering capacity of the pre-filtering layer, particularly when the pre-filtering layer is used for filtering and treating gas with more particles, the flattening area is used for arranging the fold edges of the air non-woven fabric, the integral thickness of the non-woven fabric at the fold points is small, the fiber tension is small, the probability of non-woven fabric breakage caused by friction between the fold points and the outer layer mesh sleeve is favorable for reducing, and the service life of the filtering device is prolonged. The utility model also discloses a filtering device.

title_en: Water-reducing agent sprays recovery tower
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water reducer spray recovery tower which comprises a tower body, a connecting block and a water tank, wherein an inclined plate is arranged in the tower body, a through hole is formed in the center of the surface of the inclined plate, a positioning box is connected to the bottom of the through hole, the connecting block is arranged on the inner side wall of the tower body, the number of the connecting blocks is two, water mist is formed by water through an atomization nozzle to spray water, water reducer particles in tail gas are adsorbed, a first motor drives a driving bevel gear to rotate, driven bevel gears and a filter cylinder are driven to rotate, water accumulated in the filter cylinder is rotated by the filter cylinder and then falls downwards, so that the water reducer particles are stored in the filter cylinder, the second motor controls the threaded rod to reciprocate all the time to spray the tail gas rapidly and evenly, the water can be filtered again through the filter hole, and resource waste is avoided.

title_en: Air duct structure of generator set
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an air duct structure of a generator set, which comprises an engine and a muffler component arranged at one side of the engine, wherein a first air inlet cover and a second air inlet cover are arranged on a muffler shell, a gap between a cylinder cover and an air guide cover, the first air inlet cover and a gap between the muffler shell and one side of a muffler body form a first heat dissipation channel, a gap between a fan blade and the first air guide cover and a gap between the muffler shell and one side of the muffler body form a second heat dissipation channel, when the engine is started, a cooling fan on the engine rotates to form negative pressure, external cold air is sucked into the engine from a pull disc, the cylinder cover is cooled and then enters the first heat dissipation channel, centrifugal force generated by high-speed rotation of the fan blade of a generator sucks air flow near the first air guide cover and the generator into the second heat dissipation channel, and the air flow in the first heat dissipation channel is converged to dissipate heat of the muffler body, and finally the air flow is discharged from one side of the muffler body, so that the heat dissipation effect of the muffler body is improved.

title_en: Trunk type universal laboratory toxin expelling cover
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of toxin expelling covers and provides a trunk-type universal laboratory toxin expelling cover which comprises a shell, a hose and a connecting pipe, wherein the top of the shell and one end of the connecting pipe are fixedly connected with a fixing ring, a fixing device is arranged in the fixing ring and comprises a rotating ring, the rotating ring is rotatably arranged in the fixing ring, four convex blocks uniformly distributed on the circumference are welded on the inner wall of the rotating ring, the rotating ring rotates to drive a protrusion and a connecting rod to move through the arrangement of structures such as a clamping plate and the rotating ring, the horizontal movement of the clamping plate is realized through the limitation of a directional rod, the clamping and the fixing of the hose are realized, the hose is convenient to install and detach, the hose can be conveniently replaced after being damaged, and the hose is more convenient to adjust through the trunk-type hose.

title_en: Computer system integrated cabinet with heat radiation structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a computer system integrated cabinet with a heat radiation structure, which relates to the technical field of computer system integrated cabinets and comprises a cabinet body, wherein the left surface of the cabinet body is fixedly connected with a mounting frame, the inner surface of the mounting frame is inserted with a dustproof net, the left surface of the cabinet body is provided with a vent, the inner wall of the vent is provided with a mounting groove, the inner top of the mounting groove is fixedly connected with a motor, the output end of the motor is fixedly connected with a screw rod, and the outer surface of the screw rod is in threaded connection with a moving block. According to the utility model, under the cooperation of the controller, the motor, the mounting groove, the motor, the screw rod, the moving block, the hairbrush and the reciprocating screw rod, the hairbrush can be made to reciprocate at regular time, the dust screen is cleaned, dust is prevented from being adhered to the dust screen, air can smoothly flow through the ventilation opening, the heat dissipation effect is improved, the problem of overheating inside the cabinet body is avoided, the equipment performance is improved, and the equipment service life is prolonged.

title_en: Sedimentation tank for sewage convenient to clearance
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of sewage sedimentation tanks, and discloses a sedimentation tank for sewage, which comprises a tank body, wherein a frame plate is movably connected to the inner wall of the tank body, a filter plate is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the frame plate, a water guide plate is fixedly connected to the inner bottom wall of the tank body, a drain valve is fixedly arranged on one side of the tank body, and a drain pipe is fixedly connected to one side of the tank body. This sedimentation tank for sewage convenient to clearance through cell body, frame board, handle and the filter plate that set up, can make this sedimentation tank possess the effect of being convenient for the clearance, and the accessible handle is with frame board and filter plate separation cell body after the sewage is precipitated certain time, later to the sewage debris of filter plate filtering clear up can, avoid the cell body bottom to appear debris and the clearance degree of difficulty higher problem that leads to the tiny degree of hole groove of filter plate 4 can carry out abundant filter effect to different sewage, makes very little debris also can be filtered in the sewage, has satisfied people's user demand.

title_en: Vertical ventilator structure of curtain wall
abstract_en: The utility model provides a curtain wall vertical ventilator structure, which realizes quantitative air quantity adjustment. The utility model comprises a ventilator, a shutter mechanism and a control system, wherein the shutter mechanism is arranged at an air inlet of the ventilator and comprises a mounting plate, a transmission rod, shutters, a motor and a rotary table, the mounting plate is fixedly arranged on the ventilator, the shutters are rotatably arranged on the mounting plate, the transmission rod is hinged with the shutters, the motor is arranged on the ventilator, the rotary table is arranged on an output shaft of the motor, the transmission rod is connected with the rotary table, and the control system is connected with the motor.

title_en: Aeration device for aquaculture pond
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an aeration device for an aquaculture pond, which comprises an air inlet main pipe, an oxygen flow regulating switch, connecting hoses and nano aeration pipes, wherein the air inlet main pipe is connected with a plurality of connecting hoses at intervals along the extending direction of a pipeline of the air inlet main pipe, a plurality of baffles are arranged in the nano aeration pipes at intervals, the baffles divide the nano aeration pipes into a plurality of independent non-communicated aeration units, each aeration unit is correspondingly communicated and connected with the air inlet main pipe through one connecting hose, and each connecting hose is connected with one oxygen flow regulating switch. The utility model provides an aeration device for an aquaculture pond, which is characterized in that the oxygen input quantity in a connecting hose close to one side of a fan is reduced through an oxygen flow regulating switch, and the oxygen input quantity in the connecting hose far away from one side of the fan is increased, so that the oxygen flow entering each section of aeration unit is approximately the same, the whole nano aeration pipe is uniformly aerated, the oxygen content at each position in the water body in the aquaculture pond is balanced, and the living environment quality of fish fries is improved.

title_en: Reduction circulation desulfurization device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of desulfurization, in particular to a reduction circulation desulfurization device which comprises a desulfurization tower, wherein the inner wall of the bottom of the desulfurization tower is provided with a box body, the top of the box body is provided with two mounting holes, the two mounting holes are internally provided with control components for controlling alkali liquor in the desulfurization tower to enter the box body, and an aeration component is rotatably arranged at the bottom of the box body and used for injecting air into the alkali liquor in the box body.

title_en: Filtering and classifying type environment-friendly dust removing device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a filtering classification type environment-friendly dust removing device, which relates to the technical field of environment-friendly dust removing, and comprises a dust removing device shell, wherein a supporting plate I is fixedly connected to the inner bottom of the dust removing device shell, a motor I is fixedly connected to one side of the supporting plate I, a connecting rod is fixedly connected to one side of the motor I, one end of the connecting rod is fixedly connected with a sliding block, the inner bottom of the dust removing device shell is fixedly connected with a shell I, a shell II is slidably connected to the shell I, and the sliding block slides in the shell II.

title_en: Device for removing heavy metals from household garbage fly ash
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of household garbage treatment, in particular to a device for removing heavy metals from household garbage fly ash. The heavy metal separating cylinder comprises a heavy metal separating cylinder, a rotating rod and a motor, wherein the rotating rod is rotatably arranged in the heavy metal separating cylinder, the motor is fixedly arranged on one side of the top of the heavy metal separating cylinder, and bevel gears which are matched with each other are fixedly arranged at the top of the heavy metal separating cylinder and the output end of the motor. According to the utility model, the rotating rod, the motor, the bevel gear and the stirring paddle are arranged, the worker adds the incinerated fly ash into the heavy metal separation barrel, then adds the heavy metal capturing agent and the water into the heavy metal separation barrel, and the motor drives the stirring paddle to rotate through the rotating rod and the bevel gear, so that the stirring paddle is used for stirring and mixing the fly ash, the water and the heavy metal capturing agent, thereby the heavy metal is solidified and separated from the fly ash solution, the cost is reduced, and the heavy metal removal efficiency is improved.

title_en: High-efficient flocculation device of waste water
abstract_en: The utility model provides a high-efficiency flocculation device for wastewater. The high-efficient flocculation device of waste water, including the brace table, the top fixedly connected with water tank of brace table, the inside activity of water tank has cup jointed and has accepted the cover, the inside fixed filter sleeve that has cup jointed of accepting the cover, the bottom of water tank is fixed to have cup jointed the drain pipe. The high-efficiency wastewater flocculation device provided by the utility model has the advantages that the air cylinder is arranged, when the flocculation and precipitation of wastewater are finished, the drain pipe is opened, so that water flow in the water tank can be discharged to the outside of the water tank through the receiving cover, the ionized products are promoted to be deposited to the inside of the filter sleeve, and the air cylinder is started at the moment, so that the air cylinder can drive the ionized products to move to the outside of the water tank through the receiving cover, the discharge effect of the ionized products is further achieved, the problem that the working efficiency is reduced when the ionized products are deposited to the inside of the water tank for a long time and are adhered to the surface of the electrode plate again, and the electrode plate is polluted is avoided, and the working efficiency of the flocculation device is greatly improved.

title_en: Ventilation and dust removal device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of ventilation devices and discloses a ventilation and dust removal device which comprises a dust removal box, a bottom cover and a dust removal assembly, wherein a cavity is formed in the dust removal box, an air inlet and an air outlet which are communicated with the cavity are respectively formed in two ends of the dust removal box, a dust removal opening which is communicated with the cavity is formed in the bottom of the dust removal box, the bottom cover is arranged at the dust removal opening, the bottom cover is connected with the dust removal box, the air inlet is communicated with a fan, the dust removal assembly comprises a filter element, a connecting piece and a brush seat, the connecting piece and the brush seat are arranged in the cavity, the end of the connecting piece is far away from the bottom cover, and the brush seat can clean sundries on the filter element. According to the utility model, the connecting piece and the brush seat are driven to move in the cavity through the bottom cover, so that the brush seat can clean sundries on the filter piece, the sundries are discharged through the dust removing port, the filter piece is not required to be detached for cleaning, the disassembly and assembly process of the filter piece is omitted, the operation is simple, the filter piece can be cleaned at any time, and the influence on normal ventilation caused by blockage of the filter piece is avoided.

title_en: High-precision network detection system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a high-precision network detection system, wherein a monitoring camera is used for monitoring the environment in a ship cabin in real time, information between the monitoring camera and a storage module can be interconnected through the arrangement of an exchanger, monitored pictures can be automatically stored in the storage module, a display terminal can check the monitored pictures in real time, a historical picture in the storage module is called, a biological sign recognition device is used for intelligently recognizing personnel in the ship, the characteristics and the position information of the personnel are recognized, later rescue is facilitated, broadcasting equipment can realize broadcasting and shouting of all areas or a certain area, emergency broadcasting information can be timely played under emergency conditions, the playing of music functions is stopped, and the personnel are rapidly guided to be evacuated until the emergency state is relieved. The fire detector can transmit information such as smoke, temperature and the like to the alarm controller, and the alarm controller automatically starts an evacuation mark to guide people to evacuate, so that the safety of people and property is protected.

title_en: High-temperature flue gas filter of biomass power generation boiler
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of electric boiler filtration, in particular to a biomass power generation boiler high-temperature flue gas filter, which comprises a base, wherein the top of the base is fixedly connected with a filter box, the inside of the filter box is fixedly connected with a filter plate, the top of the filter box is provided with a transmission groove, the top of the inner wall of the filter box is rotationally connected with a connecting rod, the top of the connecting rod extends to the inside of the transmission groove and is fixedly connected with an air outlet fan blade, the bottom of the connecting rod is fixedly connected with a cleaning brush, the bottoms of the cleaning brushes are contacted with the top of the filter plate, and through grooves are formed in the top of the inner wall of the filter box at equal intervals. The utility model has the advantages that accumulated particles and dust can be removed, the filtering efficiency is ensured to be maintained at a higher level all the time, the utility model is helpful for continuously reducing pollutants discharged into the atmosphere, the clean filter plate can ensure the stable operation of the flue gas treatment system, the efficiency reduction or failure caused by the blockage of the filtering medium is avoided, and the operation quality and the service efficiency are greatly improved compared with the traditional device.

title_en: Drying device is used in processing of quartz ceramic holds in palm
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a drying device for quartz ceramic support processing, which is applied to the field of stone processing and comprises a base, wherein supporting tables are symmetrically bolted at the top of the base, rotating blocks are arranged in the supporting tables, mounting grooves are symmetrically formed in the top of the base, two supporting tables are arranged at the top of the base, rotating seats are arranged on the supporting tables, a support and a placing basket are arranged on each rotating seat, after one supporting table is covered by a cover body, the quartz ceramic support in the placing basket on the supporting table can be dried, workers can feed and discharge the placing basket on the other supporting table, and after the cover body moves to the top of the other supporting table through the action of a lead screw and a connecting block, the quartz ceramic support at the place is dried, and the drying time wasted by the quartz ceramic support due to feeding and discharging is reduced, so that the practicability is improved.

title_en: Fire extinguisher device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire extinguishers, and discloses a fire extinguisher device. The limiting structure is arranged in the box body, the drawing structure comprises a drawing assembly and a sliding plate, one end of the sliding plate is connected with the drawing assembly, the other end of the sliding plate can be horizontally and slidably connected to the limiting structure, and the drawing ends of all the safety pins are connected with the drawing assembly. When the fire extinguisher is required to be used, the drawing assembly is held by a hand and is pulled outwards to drive the sliding plate to slide back to the limiting structure, the drawing assembly is connected to the drawing end of the safety pin, and in the outwards pulling process of the drawing assembly, all the safety pins are pulled down from the fire extinguisher and then the fire extinguisher is directly taken out for use. Through setting up and drawing the subassembly and can once only pull out the safety pin on all fire extinguishers unified quick, save time to can take out all fire extinguishers in the box fast and put out a fire the operation.

title_en: Broken bag rubbish strutting arrangement
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of garbage bag breaking and garbage classification, and particularly discloses a bag breaking garbage supporting device which comprises a shell framework, wherein a material inlet and a material outlet which are arranged up and down are formed in the shell framework, a bag breaking mechanism and a supporting mechanism are arranged between the material inlet and the material outlet in an overlapped mode from top to bottom, and a supporting unit which is turned down and opened and provided with a plurality of filtering holes is adopted to temporarily support garbage after bag breaking so as to facilitate checking whether a bag in the bag exists or not, so that secondary bag breaking is carried out, and the problem that the bag breaking is incomplete is solved.

title_en: Integrated high-efficiency waste gas purifying device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an integrated high-efficiency waste gas purification device which comprises an auxiliary burner, an oxidation chamber and a preheating chamber, wherein the oxidation chamber is in a thermos bottle shape and is formed by connecting a small straight pipe section, a conical pipe section and a large straight pipe section, the front end of the small straight pipe section is connected with the auxiliary burner for controlling temperature rise in the oxidation chamber, the rear end of the large straight pipe section is connected with the preheating chamber for preheating organic waste gas, a gas distribution chamber is sleeved at the conical pipe section, a plurality of circles of waste gas nozzles for tangentially feeding high-temperature waste gas in the gas distribution chamber into the oxidation chamber are arranged on the conical pipe section, an air inlet is arranged above the preheating chamber, a flue gas outlet is arranged on the right end face of the preheating chamber, and a high-temperature waste gas channel for communicating high Wen Songru with the gas distribution chamber is arranged on the left end face of the preheating chamber. The waste gas is preheated and the flue gas is cooled through the preheating chamber, and the temperature of the oxidation chamber is regulated and controlled by the auxiliary burner. The device has the advantages of simple structure, wide applicable exhaust gas concentration range, high exhaust gas purification efficiency, low investment and operation cost, safety, reliability, high efficiency and energy conservation.

title_en: Dangerous waste intelligent management terminal
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent dangerous waste management terminal which comprises a case, wherein a display screen is fixedly arranged on the case, a heat dissipation opening is formed in the back surface of the case, a fixing frame is arranged in the heat dissipation opening, a dustproof net and two convex strips are fixedly connected in the fixing frame, the two convex strips are positioned on the outer side of the dustproof net, knobs are arranged on two sides of the fixing frame, fixing boxes are arranged on two sides of the heat dissipation opening, the fixing boxes are fixedly connected to the inner wall of the case, a blocking strip for blocking the fixing frame is fixedly connected to one side, close to the heat dissipation opening, of the fixing boxes, and a fixing mechanism for fixing the fixing frame is arranged in the fixing boxes. The utility model has the beneficial effects that dust can be prevented from entering the inside of the case, the influence of the dust on equipment in the case is avoided, the dust screen is conveniently and rapidly detached for cleaning, and the influence of dust blocking the dust screen on the heat dissipation effect is avoided.

title_en: Ash conveying equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of dust treatment, in particular to ash conveying equipment. The dust suction device comprises a dust suction bin, a dust inlet and a dust outlet, wherein the dust suction bin body is of a horizontally arranged cylindrical groove body structure, a dust conveying groove is formed in the bottom of the dust suction bin body along the length direction of the dust suction bin body, a dust outlet is formed in one side of the dust conveying groove, a mud pressing dehydrator is correspondingly arranged below the dust outlet, the dust inlet is formed in one side, away from the dust outlet, of the dust suction bin, a water supply pipe is horizontally arranged in the center of the dust suction bin, and a pair of spray heads are arranged in a circular array of the water supply pipe. The mud conveying trough is internally provided with a spiral sheet, and the spiral sheet is connected with a mud conveying motor at the outer side of the mud conveying trough. The device sprays dust to form wet mud, and then presses the wet mud into blocks through the mud pressing dehydrator, so that dust can be removed, dust can not be attached to the periphery of equipment, and the blocks of wet mud are convenient to transport.

title_en: Fluorine pollutant biodegradation treatment equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses fluorine pollutant biodegradation treatment equipment, which comprises a treatment box, wherein supporting mechanisms are arranged on the left side and the right side of the treatment box, a crushing box, a microorganism feeding hopper and a second motor are fixedly connected to the top of the treatment box respectively, a fluorine pollutant feeding hopper is fixedly connected to the outer side of the crushing box, a first motor is arranged on the top of the crushing box, blades are fixedly connected to the output end of the first motor in a circular shape, when the equipment is used, fluorine pollutants are conveyed into the crushing box through the fluorine pollutant feeding hopper, the fluorine pollutants are crushed by the blades driven by the first motor and then enter the mixing bin, so that mixing between the fluorine pollutants and microorganisms is improved, and then the degradable microorganisms are conveyed into the mixing bin by the microorganism feeding hopper, so that a stirring mechanism consisting of the second motor and stirring blades can be driven to perform mixing treatment on the fluorine pollutants, so that the effect of mixing reaction is achieved.

title_en: Wind generating set tower footing ventilation heat radiation structure
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of tower foundations of wind generating sets, and discloses a ventilation and heat dissipation structure of a tower foundation of a wind generating set, which comprises a heat dissipation opening and a filter screen, wherein the heat dissipation opening is arranged on a tower barrel, the filter screen is installed in the cooling hole through locking device, the top of filter screen is provided with sucking disc anticreep unit and is used for avoiding the filter screen to separate from the cooling hole. According to the utility model, the filter screen is arranged in the heat radiation port through the locking device, and the sucker anti-drop unit is arranged at the same time, so that the filter screen is further stabilized, shaking is prevented, and the operation of the filter screen dismounting process is simple.

title_en: Indoor rack convenient to equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of indoor cabinets and discloses an indoor cabinet convenient to assemble, which comprises a connecting piece, wherein a first mounting groove is formed in the bottom of the connecting piece, a front panel is movably connected to the inner surface of the first mounting groove, a second mounting groove is formed in one side of the connecting piece, a side plate is movably connected to the inner surface of the second mounting groove, a third mounting groove is formed in the top of the connecting piece, a top plate is movably connected to the inner surface of the third mounting groove, a back plate is arranged at the rear end of the bottom of the top plate, a dehumidifying box is arranged on the front surface of the back plate, so that better use experience is provided for users through rapid assembly of the inner cabinet, the waiting installation time is shortened, the inner cabinet can be started to be used more quickly, the installation is simple and convenient, the working efficiency is improved, faults such as circuit short circuits and the like caused by overhigh humidity are avoided, the stability of equipment operation is improved, and the operation efficiency is improved.

title_en: Lower-feeding upper-returning dust removing system of welding workshop
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lower-feeding upper-returning dust removing system of a welding factory, which belongs to the technical field of dust removal and comprises a dust removing main machine, wherein air inlet pipelines are arranged on two sides of the dust removing main machine, an air inlet cylinder is arranged at the lower end of the air inlet pipeline, the air inlet cylinder is adjustable, an air return pipeline is arranged at the upper end of the dust removing main machine, an air return opening is arranged on the air return pipeline, and a cleaning component for cleaning a filter screen on the air return opening is movably arranged on the air return pipeline. The utility model is used for solving the technical problem that the centralized collection and treatment effect of regional welding fume is poor in the prior art, the bottom of the system adopts an adjustable large-air-volume dispersion type air supply barrel to supply air, an upward thrust is given to the fume generated by welding, the original 6-8m suspended fume is pushed to move upwards, and the fume is captured through a grid return air inlet at the top of a travelling crane and enters a dust removal host machine for purification treatment.

title_en: Self-cleaning mechanism and biological filter filtering device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a self-cleaning mechanism and a biological filter filtering device, which comprise a frame, wherein a plurality of groups of connecting pipes are communicated with the inside of the frame, a plurality of groups of air outlet heads are communicated with the surface of each connecting pipe, a first rotating block is fixedly arranged on the front side and the rear side of the bottom of each group of air outlet heads, a plurality of groups of second rotating blocks are fixedly arranged on the surface of each connecting pipe, the first rotating block on the rear side is rotatably arranged through a shaft pin and the second rotating blocks, and a pull rod is fixedly arranged on the right side of the first rotating block on the front side. The utility model has the advantage of self-cleaning the biological tank filter, the pipeline at one end of the frame is connected with the fan, then the fan can be started at the moment, the fan extracts the outside air and conveys the outside air into the frame, the frame conveys the air into the connecting pipe, the air in the connecting pipe is conveyed into the air outlet head, and finally the air outlet head can clean the biological filter tank to be cleaned.

title_en: Dissolved oxygen aeration device of biochemical system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a dissolved oxygen aeration device of a biochemical system, which comprises a bearing plate and an aeration mechanism, wherein the bearing plate is connected with the aeration mechanism, the aeration mechanism is used for oxidizing polluted water, the lower end of the bearing plate is provided with a moving mechanism, and the moving mechanism is used for moving the bearing plate and the aeration mechanism. The rotation that moving mechanism passed through the motor makes the screw rod of connection rotate in the slide, the rotation of screw rod makes the movable block remove, make the movable block that removes can drive the loading board and remove together, make aeration machine also can remove, reduce staff's operation through moving mechanism, it is more convenient laborsaving, umbrella type photovoltaic board on the support frame is with supplying power for the aeration machine, make more comprehensive absorption light energy through umbrella type photovoltaic board's shape, and the availability factor has been improved, threaded connection's double-threaded joint is used for dismantling on the gas-supply pipe, can not exist gas leakage when making the connection through sealed pad.

title_en: Kitchen waste water oil filtering device capable of being quickly disassembled and assembled
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a kitchen wastewater oil filtering device capable of being quickly disassembled and assembled, and belongs to the field of kitchen wastewater treatment. The device comprises an oil filtering pipe, a limiting column, an oil filtering pipe, an oil filtering net, an oil discharging pipe, a clamping piece and a second elastic piece, wherein the limiting column is arranged on the outer wall of the oil filtering pipe, the oil filtering net is fixed at the end part of the oil filtering pipe, the oil discharging pipe is fixed on an oil filtering pool, the inner wall of the oil filtering pipe is provided with a curved groove, a limiting groove and a third groove, the third groove is communicated with the limiting groove, qu Xingcao is communicated with the limiting groove, the clamping piece is positioned in the third groove, the end part of the clamping piece is provided with the second elastic piece, the second elastic piece is fixed in the third groove, and when the oil filtering pipe is screwed into the oil discharging pipe in a rotating mode, the limiting column moves into the limiting groove from the curved groove, and the clamping piece is abutted with the limiting column. When the oil filter is assembled, the oil filter pipe is inserted into the oil drain pipe, and the oil filter pipe is rotated, so that the limit column moves from the curved groove to the limit groove, and vice versa, the operation is simple, the use is convenient, and the cleaning efficiency of the oil filter screen is improved.

title_en: Monitoring device for carbon dioxide geological storage leakage
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of carbon dioxide monitoring, in particular to a monitoring device for geological carbon dioxide sealing leakage, which comprises a base, the top fixedly connected with box of base, one side fixedly connected with spacing subassembly of box, spacing subassembly includes gag lever post, spacing collar and stop screw. According to the utility model, the limiting rod, the limiting ring and the limiting screw are arranged, when the device is used, the limiting ring is supported through the fixing of the limiting rod, the front end of the device is conveniently supported in a limiting manner through the arrangement of the limiting ring, falling is prevented, the limiting ring is driven to fix through the rotation of the limiting screw, the device is more stable, and the connecting pipe, the limiting rod, the limiting ring and the limiting screw are matched for use, so that the effect of conveniently limiting the connecting pipe and supporting the air inlet mechanism is achieved, and the situation that the connecting pipe is difficult to absorb required air due to the fact that the connecting pipe is easy to collapse due to gravity in the use process is avoided, and the detection result is influenced.

title_en: Air conditioner vent panel structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of air conditioning ventilation openings and discloses an air conditioning ventilation opening panel structure which comprises a mounting frame, wherein the front end of the mounting frame is connected with a panel outer frame in a sliding manner, a plurality of grids are connected in the panel outer frame in a rotating manner, two limiting grooves are formed in the left side and the right side of the interior of the panel outer frame, springs are fixedly connected to the inner walls of the limiting grooves, limiting blocks are fixedly connected to the adjacent ends of the springs on the left side and the right side, clamping blocks are fixedly connected to the adjacent ends of the limiting blocks on the left side and the right side, two clamping grooves are formed in the left side and the right side of the interior of the mounting frame, and pull ropes are fixedly connected to the separated ends of the limiting blocks on the left side and the right side. According to the utility model, through the mutual matching of the structures such as the springs, the rotating rods and the like, the panel outer frame can be conveniently installed and detached without tools, so that the labor and time cost can be saved during the maintenance of the panel, and the maintenance cost is reduced.

title_en: Communication engineering data acquisition equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of data acquisition equipment, and discloses communication engineering data acquisition equipment which comprises an acquisition box, wherein a control panel is connected to the front side of the acquisition box, a display screen is connected to the inside of a box cover, anti-collision blocks are connected to the periphery of the lower side of the acquisition box, a dust screen is connected to the rear side of the acquisition box, a plurality of groups of cooling fans are connected to one side of the inside of the acquisition box in a matched manner, an acquisition structure is connected to the inside of the acquisition box, and a connecting structure is connected to the middle parts of two sides of the acquisition box. Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the advantages that the heat dissipation fan and the dust screen are arranged and matched, so that dust in the collection box can be reduced, various modules in the collection box can be dissipated, in addition, the device is provided with the anti-collision block which is isolated from the ground, and the anti-collision block is matched with the heat dissipation fan, so that the device can be effectively prevented from being subjected to ground moisture regain.

title_en: Centralized oil mist collecting system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a centralized oil mist collecting system, wherein one end of a main recycling pipeline is communicated with one end of a plurality of recycling branch pipelines, each recycling branch pipeline is provided with a plurality of connecting pipe interfaces, each connecting pipe interface is respectively connected with one end of a connecting pipe, the other end of each connecting pipe is connected with an oil mist suction port of a stretcher, the oil mist collecting device comprises an outer shell, a filtering device, a fan, an air inlet pipe and an exhaust pipe, the top air outlet of the outer shell is connected with the inlet of the fan, the exhaust pipe is connected with the outlet of the fan, one end of the air inlet pipe is connected with an air inlet of the outer shell, the other end of the main recycling pipeline is communicated with the other end of the air inlet pipe, and the filtering device is arranged in the outer shell. The utility model has higher collection efficiency, can effectively reduce the occupied space of equipment and save the input cost of the equipment. The utility model can effectively clean the collected oil mist air and then discharge the oil mist air, is more environment-friendly, and can recycle waste oil resources.

title_en: Natural plant extract deodorization tank
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of extract processing, and discloses a natural plant extract deodorizing tank, which comprises a tank body, wherein a base plate is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the tank body, a shaft lever is arranged in the tank body, and a gear motor for driving the shaft lever to rotate is fixedly arranged at the top of the tank body. According to the utility model, plant extract powder is added into the tank body, air is blown into the filter box through the air pump, air enters the ventilation cavity through the air inlet after being filtered and dried through the filter element, then is sprayed to the surface of the extract from the air outlet, and finally is discharged from the blow-down pipe, so that the purpose of deodorizing the extract is realized, in the use process of the filter element, the threaded rod is driven by the servo motor to rotate, the connecting plate can be driven to move in the storage box, the position of the core groove is adjusted, the purpose of quickly replacing the filter element is realized, the time delay caused by manually replacing the filter element is reduced, and the deodorizing processing efficiency of the extract is ensured.

title_en: Bio-organic fertilizer dust collection recovery unit
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fertilizer dust recovery, and discloses a biological organic fertilizer dust collecting and recovering device, which comprises a filter box, wherein the outer surface of the filter box is fixedly connected with a supporting plate, and the left side of the filter box is movably provided with a mounting plate. According to the utility model, the air box, the fan, the gas spray head, the second filter screen and the motor are arranged, when the motor operates, the circular shaft drives the gear to start rotating, so that the toothed plate drives the connecting frame and the air box to integrally move leftwards, when the gas spray head moves to the position above the second filter screen, the fan operates to extract external air, so that the air is filtered by the dust filter and then passes through the extraction opening and is pressurized in the fan, and then the pressurized gas can finally pass through the gas inlet and the air box and wash the outer surface of the second filter screen through the gas spray head, so that most fertilizer dust in the holes of the second filter screen is blown into the collecting box.

title_en: Novel control cabinet for VOC waste gas treatment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of VOC waste gas treatment devices and discloses a novel control cabinet for VOC waste gas treatment, which comprises a box body, wherein the top of the box body is fixedly connected with an air drying tower, the top of the air drying tower is fixedly connected with a discharge port, the top of the front end of the box body is slidably connected with an activated carbon filter plate, the top of the front end of the box body is slidably connected with a first filter plate, clamping grooves are formed in both sides of the activated carbon filter plate and the first filter plate, both sides of the box body are rotatably connected with rotating rods, and one side, close to each rotating rod, of each rotating rod is fixedly connected with a driving gear. According to the utility model, the screw rod can drive the clamping block to move under rotation, so that the clamping of the clamping groove can be canceled, the active carbon filter plate and the first filter plate can be detached by pulling the handle, the replacement and cleaning can be performed, and the treatment effect of the active carbon filter plate and the first filter plate on waste gas is ensured.

title_en: Red lead production waste gas cyclic utilization device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a red lead production waste gas recycling device, which belongs to the technical field of waste gas recycling and comprises a red lead production furnace main body, wherein a first bent connecting pipe is communicated with the top of the red lead production furnace main body, the other end of the first bent connecting pipe is communicated with a waste gas treatment barrel main body, one side of the waste gas treatment barrel main body is connected with a water tank, and the other side of the waste gas treatment barrel main body is provided with a cleaning mechanism.

title_en: Mineral products geological survey is with investigation device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a prospecting device for mineral geological investigation, which relates to the technical field of mineral geological investigation equipment, and comprises an outer box and a prospecting mechanism, the combined control of the hydraulic column, the sleeve column, the connecting block and the connecting column is designed, so that the angle adjustment of the exploration mechanism in the four plane directions is realized, and the comprehensiveness and accuracy of exploration are greatly enhanced. Meanwhile, the device is provided with a dedusting and spraying system, and comprises a water tank, a water pump and a spraying head, so that the spraying and dust removal can be carried out on the surrounding environment of exploration, and the working environment is effectively improved. Secondly, utilize motor and mount, the device has realized the rotatory function of exploration sampling tube for when meetting the hard region of mineral geology, can carry out ore cutting sample, promoted the efficiency of investigation by a wide margin. In addition, through intubate, chuck and locating needle, the device has restricted the investigation orientation of exploration sampling tube, ensures that equipment is in safe orientation within range all the time to the accuracy and the security in exploration target area have been ensured.

title_en: Microorganism recovery device and microorganism cleaning system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a microorganism recovery device and a microorganism cleaning system, wherein the microorganism recovery device comprises a container body, a microorganism filtering piece and a storage piece, the container body is arranged at the bottom of oil pollution equipment of the microorganism cleaning system and is used for receiving microorganism mixed liquid dropped from the oil pollution equipment, the microorganism filtering piece is arranged in the container body and is used for dividing the container body into a first containing cavity and a second containing cavity, the storage piece is communicated with the first containing cavity and/or the second containing cavity and is used for storing the microorganism mixed liquid in the first containing cavity or the second containing cavity, and the first containing cavity or the second containing cavity is configured so that the temperature of the first containing cavity or the second containing cavity reaches the aggregation temperature of microorganisms. The utility model not only can recycle the microorganism, but also can separate out and store the microorganism with higher activity.

title_en: Improve hydrogen concentration and carry hydrogen purification device of edulcoration in grades
abstract_en: The utility model provides a hydrogen purification device for improving hydrogen concentration and classifying and removing impurities, which comprises a base, a vertical plate, an air inlet main pipe, a first air outlet pipe with a first control valve, a second air outlet pipe with a second control valve, an air guide pipe, a second air inlet pipe, a first mounting cylinder, a second mounting cylinder, an air outlet main pipe, a third air inlet pipe, a fourth air inlet pipe, a third air outlet pipe, a fourth air outlet pipe, a third mounting cylinder and a fourth mounting cylinder, wherein the left end and the right end of the bottom of the air inlet main pipe are respectively provided with a first air outlet pipe with a first control valve and a second air outlet pipe with a second control valve. According to the hydrogen purification device for improving the hydrogen concentration and classifying and purifying the hydrogen, the basic requirement of purifying the hydrogen can be met, and a user can use one filtering structure to continuously purify the hydrogen when cleaning the other filtering structure, so that the efficiency of purifying the hydrogen is prevented from being influenced.

title_en: Ammonia recovery system in aluminum ash innocent treatment
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of aluminum ash treatment, and discloses an ammonia recovery system in aluminum ash harmless treatment, which comprises a material distribution tank, a reaction tank, a gas-liquid separator and an ammonia absorption tower, wherein a liquid outlet at the bottom of the material distribution tank is connected with a liquid inlet of the reaction tank, a gas outlet at the top of the reaction tank is connected with a gas inlet of the gas-liquid separator, a liquid outlet at the bottom of the reaction tank is connected with a pulp treatment system, a gas outlet of a gas collecting cylinder at the upper part of the gas-liquid separator is connected with a gas inlet of the ammonia absorption tower, an ammonia water outlet at the bottom of the ammonia absorption tower is connected with an ammonia water finished product tank through a first ammonia water pump, an absorbent inlet of the ammonia absorption tower is connected with a chilled water pipe, and a liquid outlet at the bottom of the gas-liquid separator is connected with the ammonia water finished product tank through a second ammonia water pump. The utility model continuously extracts the ammonia water at the bottom of the gas-liquid separator, improves the yield of ammonia water finished products, avoids the cyclic enrichment of harmful components in the aluminum ash, reduces the consumption of absorbent and reduces the operation cost.

title_en: Be used for lithium electricity trade high temperature formula sintered plate dust remover
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-temperature sintered plate dust remover for the lithium battery industry, which comprises a box body, wherein the box body is made of stainless steel, a dust air chamber and a gas purifying chamber are arranged in the box body, the gas purifying chamber is positioned above the dust air chamber, a high-temperature sintered plate is arranged in the dust air chamber, an ash bucket is arranged at the lower part of the dust air chamber, an air inlet is tangentially connected with the ash bucket, a temperature sensor is connected on an air pipe of the air inlet, and a dust butterfly valve is connected below the ash bucket. The temperature sensor is arranged at the air inlet to ensure that the temperature of the flue gas inlet is controllable and the service performance of the sintered plate is protected, the pressure difference sensor is made of stainless steel metal and is connected with a tetrafluoro hose through a metal pipe to ensure the service performance of the high-temperature flue gas, teflon is sprayed on the inner side of the box body to improve the corrosion resistance and wear resistance of equipment, valuable lithium powder is recycled and utilized efficiently, the productivity is improved, the material level sensor and the air vibration device are arranged on the ash bucket side, and the pressure difference sensor has good anti-blocking performance and operates efficiently and stably under the high-temperature condition.

title_en: Automatic seed crystal circulating system of crystallization softening equipment
abstract_en: The application provides an automatic crystal seed circulating system of crystallization softening equipment, and belongs to the field of water treatment equipment. The automatic crystal softening equipment seed crystal circulating system utilizes a particle collecting device to collect particles discharged from a particle discharge port of crystal softening equipment, overflow liquid discharged from an overflow port of a metering barrel and accumulated particles discharged from a discharge valve of the metering barrel, uniformly processes the particles and the liquid discharged from each part, simplifies a processing flow and avoids particle waste, adopts a spiral lifting assembly to be communicated with the bottom of a collecting hopper, and when in operation, solid particles at the bottom of the collecting hopper are gradually lifted upwards, and liquid in the collecting hopper cannot be lifted by the spiral lifting assembly, so that the particles and the liquid are returned to the collecting hopper, the particles are separated from the liquid after concentration, uniform crushing is performed by a pulverizer, and uniform screening is performed by a screening device, so that the particle waste caused by the fact that different systems only screen crushed particles required by themselves is avoided.

title_en: Steam soot blower convenient to fix
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a steam soot blower convenient to fix, which comprises a fixing mechanism and a steam soot blower body arranged on the top side of the fixing mechanism; the fixing mechanism comprises a fixing frame, a fixing disc is fixedly connected to the center position inside the fixing frame, a plurality of grooves are formed in the fixing disc, the number of the grooves is four, the grooves are uniformly distributed in the fixing disc, clamping blocks are slidably connected in the grooves, turntables are attached to the left side and the right side of the fixing frame, which are close to the fixing frame, limiting grooves are symmetrically formed in the center positions inside the two turntables, steel pipes can be fixed quickly through the arrangement of the fixing mechanism, the position of the output end of the steam soot blower body is fixed conveniently, and dust inside a boiler is cleaned through the fact that the driving mechanism drives the nozzle to rotate and advance.

title_en: Real-time electric energy monitoring equipment of data center
abstract_en: The utility model discloses real-time electric energy monitoring equipment for a data center, which comprises the electric energy monitoring equipment, wherein filter screens are inlaid on two sides of the electric energy monitoring equipment, a cover plate is arranged on the surface of the electric energy monitoring equipment, an installation plate is connected with the inner wall of the electric energy monitoring equipment in a sliding manner, and a sliding mechanism is arranged on the surface of the installation plate. The display screen is inlayed on the surface of apron, the surface fixed mounting of mounting panel has monitoring devices, monitoring devices and display screen electric connection. Through the setting of card pole and inserted bar, make the staff only need the pulling push-and-pull rod can take off the apron from electric energy monitoring facilities, only need insert the inserted bar in the slot simultaneously, can accomplish the installation to the apron, and then made things convenient for the staff to install and dismantle the apron, and then made things convenient for the staff to maintain electric energy monitoring facilities, improved staff's work efficiency.

title_en: Safe and environment-friendly gas fire extinguishing device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of fire-fighting facilities, and discloses a safe and environment-friendly gas fire extinguishing device which comprises a protective box and a fire extinguisher, wherein the fire extinguisher is connected with the protective box, the protective box is connected with a first box door, the protective box is connected with a closed frame, the closed frame is rotationally connected with a bidirectional threaded rod, two ends of the bidirectional threaded rod are respectively in threaded connection with clamping plates, the clamping plates are in contact with the inner side wall of the top of the protective box, the bidirectional threaded rod is connected with a driven bevel gear, the protective box is rotationally connected with a rotating rod, the rotating rod is connected with a driving bevel gear and a screwing block, the driving bevel gear is meshed with the driven bevel gear, the rotating rod is connected with a bearing belt, the closed frame is provided with a through hole, the free end of the bearing belt is connected with the first box door.

title_en: Colliery exploitation colliery breaker
