abstract_en: The utility model discloses a coal mine crushing device for coal mine exploitation, which relates to the field of coal mine exploitation and comprises a crusher body, wherein flywheels are arranged on two sides of the crusher body, a driving motor is fixedly arranged at one end of the crusher body, a first belt is arranged between the driving motor and one side of the flywheels, an elongated feeding port is fixedly arranged at a material port of the crusher body, an opposite port is formed in the elongated feeding port, a dust extraction pipe is fixedly arranged on the opposite port, and a dust extraction mechanism and a spraying mechanism are arranged on the dust extraction pipe. According to the coal mining coal mine crushing device, the driving shaft on the belt pulley is driven to rotate after the second belt runs, and the driving shaft drives the movable shaft to rotate under the cooperation of the first bevel gear and the second bevel gear, so that the fan blades rotate in the dust extraction pipe, negative pressure is formed in the dust extraction pipe, pulverized coal in the lengthened feeding port is absorbed, coal blocks are separated from the coal blocks, and the pulverized coal is prevented from drifting into air.

title_en: Power cabinet structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of power supplies and discloses a power cabinet structure which comprises an outer shell, wherein a filter screen is connected inside the outer shell in a sliding manner, a casing is connected inside the filter screen in a sliding manner, a threaded column is connected to the inner wall of the casing in a threaded manner, a knob is fixedly connected to one end of the threaded column, a sliding column is connected to the inner wall of the threaded column in a sliding manner, an inclined plane column is fixedly connected to one end of the sliding column, a first spring is arranged between the inclined plane column and the threaded column, and one end of the first spring is fixedly connected to one side of the outer wall of the inclined plane column. According to the utility model, the knob is rotated to drive the threaded column to rotate, so that the casing is driven to move upwards, and at the moment, the inclined plane column moves upwards, so that the clamping ball is driven to retract inwards, and the clamping ball is smoothly moved out, so that the filter screen is conveniently and rapidly detached, the problem that the filter structure on the surface of the power cabinet is not easy to detach in the prior art is solved, and the flexibility of the power cabinet device is improved.

title_en: Drinking cup structure of filter
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water cup structure of a filter, which comprises a water cup body, wherein the upper end of the water cup body is provided with the filter, a water storage cavity is formed in the water cup body, the lower end of the water cup body is provided with a water discharging mechanism communicated with the water storage cavity, a cavity is arranged in the side wall of the water cup body and is communicated with the water storage cavity, a water level early warning device is arranged in the cavity, a safety valve is further arranged on the side wall of the water cup body, the water level early warning device comprises a floating assembly, a sensing lamp and a sensing switch, the sensing lamp is fixedly arranged outside the side wall of the water cup body, the sensing switch is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the cavity and is electrically connected with the sensing lamp, the floating assembly is arranged in the cavity and moves up and down along with the change of the water level in the cavity, the upper end of the floating assembly is provided with a contact, when the contact is contacted with the trigger end of the sensing switch, the sensing lamp is lightened, a user is reminded of releasing pressure, and the water cup is integrally molded by aluminum die casting.

title_en: Environment-friendly etching waste liquid recovery device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of waste liquid recovery devices, and discloses an environment-friendly etching waste liquid recovery device which comprises a recovery component arranged above a containing component, wherein the recovery component comprises a scraping component, a stirring component and an opening and closing component, the scraping component is used for scraping attached solid particles on the surface of the filtering screen, the stirring component is used for stirring etching waste liquid, the opening and closing component is used for controlling a flow switch of the etching waste liquid, the environment-friendly etching waste liquid recovery device is used for preventing large solid particles remained on the surface of the filtering screen from being blocked and affecting the flow recovery of liquid by arranging the scraping component, waste gas generated after the waste liquid is dissolved is disinfected by arranging a disinfection plate and discharged into air through a pipeline, the air environment quality is protected, and part of harmful gas is decomposed by firstly heating the waste liquid by arranging a heat conducting pipe and a sealing ring.

title_en: Dedusting and filtering mechanism for Raymond mill
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of dust removal of flour mills, in particular to a dust removal and filtration mechanism for a Raymond mill, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the dust removal mechanism is arranged above the bottom plate, and an adjusting mechanism is arranged between the dust removing mechanism and the bottom plate, the dust removing mechanism is provided with a cleaning mechanism in a matching way, and the adjusting mechanism comprises two U-shaped frames. According to the utility model, the fan is started to suck peripheral dust and filter the peripheral dust through the square tube by the main filter screen, water is injected into the guide tube to spray out dust on the main filter screen from the plurality of spray heads and absorb the dust in the air flow, the driving motor is started to drive the rotary table to rotate, so that the clamping blocks drive the plurality of clamping strips to slide back and forth in the adjacent clamping grooves through the moving strips, the plurality of brush plates brush the adjacent main filter screen to avoid the blockage of the main filter screen, and the heights of the two ends of the square tube on the two U-shaped frames can be adjusted, so that the direction and the overall height of the U-shaped frames are adjusted, the direction of air outlet of the fan is adjusted, and the fan is convenient for users to use.

title_en: Coke material adsorption device for flue gas treatment of steelmaking vacuum furnace
abstract_en: The utility model provides a coke adsorption device for flue gas treatment of a steelmaking vacuum furnace, and relates to the technical field of flue gas treatment. The tower comprises supporting legs and a tower body, wherein the supporting legs are arranged below the tower body, the number of the supporting legs is at least three, the middle of the tower body is cylindrical, the top and the bottom of the tower body are conical, the bottom of the tower body is provided with downward liquid discharge holes, the top of the tower body is provided with upward exhaust holes, a first pore plate, a second pore plate and a third pore plate are sequentially arranged in the tower body from top to bottom, the side surface of the tower body is outwards provided with an air inlet hole, the air inlet hole is positioned between the third pore plate and the liquid discharge holes, active coke is stacked on the third pore plate, a spray pipe is arranged above the active coke and is positioned between the second pore plate and the third pore plate, the spray pipe is connected with a water path outside the tower body, and active carbon is stacked on the second pore plate. The coke adsorption device for flue gas treatment of the steelmaking vacuum furnace disclosed by the utility model can be used for multiple purification of flue gas, so that the pollutant content in the flue gas is greatly reduced.

title_en: Flight fire control device of smog is removed to plasma static
abstract_en: The utility model provides a flying fire-fighting device for removing smoke by plasma static electricity, which comprises an aircraft system, a low-temperature plasma dust removal module and a monitoring system, wherein the aircraft system comprises a frame, a flying power device and a flying control system, the flying power device and the flying control system are used for controlling the flying state of the frame, the low-temperature plasma dust removal module is arranged below the aircraft system and comprises a honeycomb static electricity positive and negative electrode dust removal module and dust collection filter screens arranged on the upper side and the lower side of the honeycomb static electricity positive and negative electrode dust removal module and is used for removing dust by the plasma static electricity, and the monitoring system comprises an image acquisition unit, a dust sensor and a temperature sensor and is used for providing field images, ambient temperature and dust concentration data. The flight fire fighting device can realize smoke and dust removal of the high-temperature smoke environment, so that the real-time condition of the field environment can be monitored, and rescue personnel can be conveniently searched and rescued.

title_en: Dust collecting equipment for substrate cleaning
abstract_en: The utility model discloses dust removing equipment for cleaning a substrate, which comprises a fixed frame, wherein a self-locking roller is fixedly connected to the bottom surface of the fixed frame, a dust removing box is fixedly connected to the top surface of the fixed frame, a dust adhering film is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the dust removing box, the dust adhering film is fixedly connected with the top surface of the fixed frame, a switch door assembly is started to place the substrate above a placing frame, compressed air is shunted through an air inlet shunting mechanism and then blown to the lower substrate to remove dust, the dust adhering film is used for blocking and adsorbing the dust, a suction filtering assembly is started to suck the dust through a box cover and a corrugated pipe for filtering and collecting the dust, and when the dust is too much, a locking mechanism is started to separate from a collecting box through a telescopic auxiliary box cover of the corrugated pipe, so that the suction filtering assembly can be taken out for dust cleaning, the aim of automatically cleaning and collecting the dust of the substrate is fulfilled, and the problem that the substrate is easy to be collided and damaged in the process of cleaning the dust manually, and the dust is scattered around to pollute the workshop environment is avoided.

title_en: System for preparing basic chromium sulfate powder by taking chromium electroplating wastewater as raw material
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a system for preparing basic chromium sulfate powder by taking chromium electroplating wastewater as a raw material, which relates to the technical field of chromium electroplating wastewater treatment and comprises a impurity removing device, a reduction device, an enrichment device, an adjustment device and a pulverizing device which are sequentially communicated, wherein the impurity removing device is used for removing impurity metal ions in the chromium electroplating wastewater, the reduction device is used for reducing hexavalent chromium ions in the chromium electroplating wastewater subjected to impurity removal into trivalent chromium ions to form reduced liquid, the enrichment device comprises an enrichment transition type ion exchange column which is used for adsorbing chromium ions in the reduced liquid, a sodium sulfate solution inlet of the enrichment transition type ion exchange column is used for introducing sodium sulfate solution to desorb the enrichment transition type ion exchange column to form chromium sulfate desorption liquid, the adjustment device is used for adjusting the PH value of the chromium sulfate desorption liquid and adjusting the mass ratio of chromium oxide and sodium sulfate in the chromium sulfate desorption liquid, and the pulverizing device is used for concentrating, drying and crushing the adjusted chromium sulfate desorption liquid to form the basic chromium sulfate powder.

title_en: Dust settling equipment for environmental engineering
abstract_en: The utility model discloses dust settling equipment for environmental engineering, which comprises a supporting base, wherein a bogie is arranged at the top of the supporting base, an injection cylinder is hinged at the top of the bogie, an air inlet protecting net is arranged at the end part of the injection cylinder, a fixing ring is arranged at the end part of the injection cylinder, connecting parts for connecting the fixing ring and the air inlet protecting net are symmetrically arranged at the side of the air inlet protecting net, and positioning members for locking the connecting parts are arranged at the side of the fixing ring.

title_en: Clean wardrobe convenient to maintain
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of wardrobes, and discloses a clean wardrobe convenient to maintain, which comprises a wardrobe body, a filtering assembly and a connecting assembly, wherein the wardrobe body comprises a front plate and a bottom plate, the front plate and the bottom plate are relatively and vertically arranged, a pushing plate is arranged in the front plate, one side of the pushing plate, which is far away from the bottom plate, can move towards the bottom plate in a pushing mode, the filtering assembly comprises a filtering net and a fan assembly, the filtering net is arranged at the top of the wardrobe body, a sliding track is arranged on the bottom plate, a pulley is arranged on the sliding track, the fan assembly is connected with the pulley so that the fan assembly can slide along the sliding track in a direction far away from the front plate, and the connecting assembly comprises a buckle and a clamping groove, the buckle is arranged on one side, which is close to the pushing plate, of the fan assembly, and the clamping groove is arranged on the pushing plate corresponding to the buckle. The filter assembly of the clean wardrobe is more convenient to replace and clean.

title_en: Water turbine for mechanical pump-in type proportional mixing device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of mixing arrangement, concretely relates to water turbine for mechanical pump formula proportion mixing arrangement, which comprises a housin, the inside of casing runs through and rotates and install first pivot, the outer wall of first pivot is provided with the impeller, the bottom of casing is fixed with first outlet pipe, one side of casing sets up to link up and is fixed with the second outlet pipe, the other end and the first outlet pipe top one side intercommunication of second outlet pipe, the outer wall of first pivot just is located the casing below and is provided with first helical gear, the inside one side of first outlet pipe runs through and rotates and install the second pivot, the outer wall of second pivot just is located first outlet pipe and is provided with stirring auger, the outer wall of second pivot is provided with the second helical gear with first helical gear meshing, the utility model discloses can carry out twice stirring to foam liquid and fire water and mix, make the mixing effect better, improved the quality of mixed liquid, and then improved its fire extinguishing performance.

title_en: Demister and demisting system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a demister and a demisting system, the demister comprises a barrel body, a flow guide assembly and an oil collecting assembly. The barrel body comprises an inner cavity, a first end and a second end which are oppositely arranged, wherein the first end is an air exhaust end, the flow guide assembly comprises a horn outer shell, a horn inner shell and a plurality of flow guide blades distributed between the horn outer shell and the horn inner shell, the horn outer shell comprises a first small opening and a first large opening, the horn inner shell comprises a second small opening and a second large opening, the first small opening is a mist inlet, the second small opening is closed, the first large opening is connected with the first end, a flow guide channel communicated with the inner cavity is formed between adjacent flow guide blades, the oil collecting assembly comprises an oil collecting shell with an oil collecting cavity and an oil pipe, the oil collecting cavity is communicated with the inner cavity, the flow guide assembly has a good mist removing effect, is simple in structure, does not need to be filtered, the mist removing effect is good, the cost is saved, and the collecting efficiency is improved.

title_en: Environment-friendly dust removing device for pharmaceutical chemical production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cement production and discloses an environment-friendly dust removing device for pharmaceutical and chemical production, which comprises a shell, an inspection window and a filtering component, wherein a cleaning structure is arranged on the surface of the inspection window and comprises a fixed frame, the fixed frame is connected with the surface of the inspection window, the surface of the fixed frame is in threaded connection with a bidirectional bolt, the arc surface of the bidirectional bolt is in sliding connection with a sliding plate, and the surface of the sliding plate is connected with a foam cushion. The surface of the sliding plate is connected with a dropping groove, and the material of the dropping groove is silica gel material. The surface of the foam-rubber cushion is connected with a plurality of brushes, and the brushes are made of terylene materials. The utility model solves the problems that when the filter assembly is required to be replaced, the filter assembly is often inconvenient to be replaced quickly, the normal use of the device is affected, and the working efficiency of the device is further affected.

title_en: Freeze-drying system
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present application provide a freeze drying system. The system comprises a base, at least one heat exchange module, a main air inlet pipeline, a main air outlet pipeline and at least one refrigeration module. The top of the base is provided with a first area and a second area, the second area is positioned at one side of the first area in the first direction, at least one heat exchange module is arranged in the first area and distributed along the second direction, the main inlet pipe and the main outlet pipe are arranged above the at least one heat exchange module and are respectively connected with the air inlet and the air outlet of each heat exchange module, at least one refrigeration module is arranged on the base along the second direction and is connected with the at least one heat exchange module through a refrigerant conveying pipeline, and at least part of structures of each refrigeration module are arranged in the second area. The freeze-drying system is regular in arrangement and compact in layout, and is beneficial to reducing the size and the occupied area of the freeze-drying system.

title_en: Array type LED electronic screen
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of LED electronic screens, in particular to an array type LED electronic screen. The array type LED electronic screen comprises electronic screen units, wherein the array type LED electronic screen is formed by arranging and combining a plurality of electronic screen units with the same specification in a square array mode, each electronic screen unit comprises a single installation frame, a single LED display screen is fixedly embedded into the front end face of each single installation frame, adjacent electronic screen units are connected through an installation cylinder, a plurality of storage pipes which are distributed in an annular mode are arranged in the installation cylinder, and electromagnetic valves are fixedly installed at the positions, facing cylinder openings, of the storage pipes. According to the array type LED electronic screen, each electronic screen unit is mutually independent, if a single electronic screen unit is damaged, the fixing screw can be immediately detached, then the damaged electronic screen unit is removed, and a new electronic screen unit is replaced, so that the array type LED electronic screen is simple and convenient, meanwhile, the damage caused by open fire of the single LED display screen is avoided, and the use safety of the array type LED electronic screen is enhanced.

title_en: Novel ultrathin light metal chassis
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel ultrathin light metal case, which belongs to the technical field of power distribution equipment and comprises a case body made of ultrathin light metal and used for power distribution and control, wherein air outlets which are convenient for heat dissipation inside the case body are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the case body, shielding edges are arranged at the air outlets on the outer side wall of the case body, a plurality of movable plates which are convenient for mounting power control electronic components are connected with threaded rods capable of adjusting various lifting speeds in a threaded manner, one end of each threaded rod is rotationally connected with the inner top wall of the case body, the other end of each threaded rod penetrates through the inner bottom wall of the case body and is connected with an output shaft of a driving motor, a fixing part of the driving motor is connected with a bottom screw of the case body, round rods with smooth outer peripheral sides are connected with the movable plates in a sliding mode, and two ends of each round rod are fixed on the inner wall of the case body. According to the utility model, the distance between the moving plates in the box body can be flexibly adjusted according to actual conditions, and the installation and the use are convenient.

title_en: Waste gas treatment device for plastic rice grain production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an exhaust gas treatment device for plastic rice grain production, which belongs to the technical field of exhaust gas treatment devices and comprises a water tank, wherein a cleaning port is formed in one side of the water tank, a plugging component is arranged at the cleaning port, a treatment cylinder is fixedly arranged at the top of the water tank, the bottom of the treatment cylinder is communicated with the top of the water tank, two groups of filter plates are fixedly arranged in an inner cavity of the treatment cylinder, and an active carbon filler layer is laid at the top of the filter plates.

title_en: NMP gas recovery device
abstract_en: The NMP gas recovery device comprises an air inlet pipe, a front filter box, an air conveying pipe, a rear filter box, an exhaust pipe, a suction device and a waterway system, wherein the air inlet pipe, the front filter box, the air conveying pipe, the rear filter box and the exhaust pipe are sequentially communicated to form an NMP gas recovery channel, the suction device is arranged on the NMP gas recovery channel, the waterway system comprises a water supplementing channel, a rear circulating channel, a water conveying channel, a front circulating channel and a drainage channel, two ends of the rear circulating channel are communicated with the rear filter box, two ends of the front circulating channel are communicated with the front filter box, two ends of the water supplementing channel are respectively connected into the rear circulating channel and the front circulating channel, and the drainage channel is communicated with the front circulating channel. According to the NMP gas recovery device, water supplementing, water circulating and draining operations of two filter tanks can be realized by only adopting one waterway system, so that the device structure can be simplified, the device volume can be reduced, and the requirements of miniaturization and light weight can be met.

title_en: Excrement solid-liquid separation device for livestock breeding
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of solid-liquid separation, in particular to a fecal solid-liquid separation device for livestock breeding, which comprises a separation cylinder, wherein the top of the separation cylinder is inserted with a cylinder cover, the inside of the separation cylinder is rotatably connected with a spiral blade, the outer side of the spiral blade is sleeved with a filtrate cylinder, the end of the spiral She Shuru is fixedly provided with a first motor, and the fecal solid-liquid separation device further comprises a pretreatment mechanism for removing hard particles in the fecal. The second bevel gear is driven to rotate through the second motor so as to drive the first bevel gear to rotate, the first bevel gear rotates to drive the rotating shaft to rotate so as to enable the eccentric wheel and the stirring blade to rotate, the hammer head in the outer side is driven to do eccentric motion in the crushing groove through the eccentric wheel to crush the agglomerated excrement, the screw blade is prevented from being blocked by the agglomerated excrement, the crushed excrement is evenly stirred through the rotation of the stirring blade, the effect of solid-liquid separation of the excrement is improved, hard particles in the stirred excrement are filtered and screened through the filter frame, and damage to separating equipment caused by the hard particles in the excrement is avoided.

title_en: Energy-saving and consumption-reducing system for dehumidifying liquid of wet tower
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of flue gas treatment equipment, in particular to a wet tower dehumidifying liquid energy-saving consumption-reducing system, which consists of four groups of purification structures, wherein each group of purification structures comprises a wet washing tower, a dehumidifying liquid discharge end of the wet washing tower is communicated with a dehumidifying water tank through a dehumidifying liquid discharge pipeline, a dehumidifying liquid circulating pump is communicated with a liquid discharge end of the dehumidifying water tank through a pipeline, a dehumidifying liquid main pipe is communicated with a liquid delivery pipeline of the dehumidifying liquid circulating pump, the dehumidifying liquid main pipe is communicated with dehumidifying liquid delivery pipelines of other three groups of purification structures, and the wet washing tower is communicated with a dehumidifying liquid return main pipe through a dehumidifying liquid discharge branch pipe.

title_en: Dampproofing device of electric cabinet and dampproofing electrical system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a dampproof device of an electric cabinet and a dampproof electric control system, wherein the dampproof device comprises a mounting unit, a storage unit, a first opening unit, a first sealing unit, a second sealing unit, a locking unit and at least one sliding unit; the electric cabinet comprises an electric cabinet, a mounting unit, a first opening unit, a first sealing unit, a second sealing unit, a locking unit and a sliding unit, wherein the mounting unit is arranged on the side part of the electric cabinet, the storage unit is arranged in the mounting unit in a sliding mode and is communicated with the inside of the electric cabinet, the first opening unit is arranged at a first end of the storage unit and is positioned outside the electric cabinet, the first sealing unit is arranged at a second end of the storage unit and is positioned inside the electric cabinet, the second sealing unit is arranged between the first opening unit and the mounting unit and is arranged around the storage unit, the locking unit is detachably connected with the first opening unit, and the sliding unit is connected with the first sealing unit in a sliding mode. The electric cabinet moisture absorption device has the advantages that the problems that the switch in the electric cabinet is easy to be wrongly touched by a user when the electric cabinet moisture absorption device is replaced are solved by arranging the object placing unit capable of sliding along the installation unit.

title_en: Negative pressure suction device of lapping machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a negative pressure suction device of a lapping machine, which comprises a lapping machine body, wherein the surface of the lapping machine body is fixedly connected with a box body, the bottom of an inner cavity of the box body is fixedly provided with a negative pressure fan, and the right side of the negative pressure fan is fixedly connected with an air outlet pipe. According to the utility model, the suction pipe is conveniently driven to absorb air by the negative pressure fan, suction force is conducted into the inner cavity of the negative pressure box, and the suction pipe is driven to absorb flocks on the surface of the compression roller of the lapping machine body due to the influence of the suction force, so that the flocks can be effectively cleaned, later equipment work is facilitated, the sliding plate is conveniently pushed to move by the electric push rod, so that the sliding plate drives the sliding sleeve to move, the connecting rod is driven to push by the sliding sleeve to move, the supporting rod and the cleaning brush are driven to slide on the surface of the filter plate by the connecting rod, the flocks adsorbed on the surface of the filter plate can be effectively cleaned, the flocks are prevented from blocking filter holes on the surface of the filter plate, and the filtering efficiency of the filter plate is improved.

title_en: Reliable oil sludge recycling treatment device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of oil sludge treatment, in particular to a reliable oil sludge recycling treatment device, which comprises a heating tank, wherein a heating box and a stirring mechanism are arranged in the heating tank, one side of the heating box is provided with a mounting box, one side of the mounting box is provided with a mounting groove, the mounting groove is provided with a mounting plate and a side cover, one side of the mounting plate is provided with a chute, the top end of the mounting groove is provided with a positioning groove, a positioning plate is arranged between the side cover and the positioning groove, a positioning mechanism is arranged between the positioning plate and the positioning groove, the side cover is provided with a heat pipe and two fastening boxes, the heat pipe is provided with two heat pipes, the structure ensures the heating uniformity of the oil sludge through the heating box, the matching of a threaded column and the chute and the meshing mechanism of a gear and the side cover can be quickly disassembled through simple operation, the inside of the heating box is directly flushed, and the cleaning efficiency is greatly improved.

title_en: Dust fall type chimney blasting protection network structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dust fall type chimney blasting protective net structure which comprises a guard ring, water bags, a water supply device and a protective net, wherein the water supply device comprises a water supply pipe, a water supply pump and a plurality of water tanks, an intermediate connecting pipe is connected between two adjacent water tanks, one end of the water supply pipe is connected with an external water source, the other end of the water supply pipe is communicated with the water tank positioned at the bottom, the water supply pipe is provided with the water supply pump, the bottom of each water tank is provided with a branch pipe connected with the water bag positioned below the water supply pipe, and a relay pump is arranged between the water tank and the intermediate connecting pipe. The utility model relates to a dust fall type chimney blasting protection net structure, which belongs to the technical field of chimney blasting protection, wherein a water bag is arranged on the inner side of the protection net, water in the water bag is splashed out due to bursting caused by impact force, dust generated by collapse of a chimney is subjected to spray wetting dust removal treatment, the quantity of the dust is reduced, the diffusion range is reduced, and a very good dust fall effect is achieved.

title_en: Foldable forest water sac support
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a foldable forest water bag support, which comprises a folding disassembly mechanism and fixing blocks arranged on the periphery of the bottom of the folding disassembly mechanism, wherein the top of the folding disassembly mechanism is provided with a tensioning mechanism, the top of the tensioning mechanism is fixedly provided with a winding support, the folding disassembly mechanism comprises a folding base, a folding sliding groove is formed in the folding base, a folding sliding rod is fixedly arranged in the folding sliding groove, two ends of the folding sliding rod are symmetrically and slidingly connected with a folding sliding sleeve, the outer side of the folding sliding sleeve is fixedly provided with a folding rotating support, the outer side of the folding rotating support is rotatably connected with a folding rotating rod, and the stability of the whole water bag support can be improved by inserting an adjusting bolt into soil through the characteristic that the adjusting bolt is in threaded connection with the fixing blocks.

title_en: Domestic sewage treatment device of internal circulation biological fluidized bed
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an internal circulation biological fluidized bed domestic sewage treatment device which comprises a reactor, wherein a biological fluidized bed area is arranged in the reactor, a lower internal circulation area and an upper internal circulation area are arranged in the biological fluidized bed area, the lower internal circulation area comprises a central cylinder, the upper internal circulation area comprises a guide cylinder, a guide plate is obliquely arranged on the inner side wall of the reactor downwards, a baffle is arranged at the lower end of the guide cylinder, and a plurality of small holes are formed in the baffle. In the utility model, part of sewage is internally circulated in the lower internal circulation zone, part of sewage flows to the upper internal circulation zone, internal circulation is realized in the upper internal circulation zone, two internal circulation is realized, the sewage flow route is prolonged, the sewage is fully contacted with the biological fluidized bed zone for a long time, and organic matters in the sewage are degraded more thoroughly. The upper connecting valve and the lower connecting valve which are staggered up and down are arranged in the biological fluidization filler in the biological fluidization bed area, so that the flowing direction of sewage is changed, the sewage flows in a staggered way, and the sewage is fully contacted with the biological fluidization filler.

title_en: Quick replacement structure of molecular sieve group of oxygenerator
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of oxygenerators, and discloses a quick replacement structure of a molecular sieve group of an oxygenerator. The installation bin comprises an air inlet duct, an air outlet duct and a clamping groove. When the clamping block is used, after the clamping block moves out of the clamping groove, the mounting seat is pulled outwards, so that the lower end cover, the tank body and the upper end cover can be driven to move out of the mounting bin, and the dismounting work is completed. The mounting seat is pushed inwards, so that the connector can be respectively inserted into the air inlet duct and the air outlet duct. And then the clamping block is inserted into the clamping groove, so that the limiting effect can be achieved, and the installation work is completed. The whole disassembly and assembly process is convenient, the molecular sieve is convenient to replace, and manpower and material resources are saved. In addition, because the mounting seat, the lower end cover, the tank body, the upper end cover and the like are arranged in the independent space inside the mounting bin, the mounting seat, the lower end cover, the tank body and the upper end cover can be prevented from being contacted with other core elements of the oxygenerator in the process of disassembly and assembly, and the risk of damaging other core elements is eliminated.

title_en: Organic gas absorbing device for experiments
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of gas absorption, in particular to an organic gas absorption device for experiments. The experimental organic gas absorbing device comprises a bottle body, wherein a bottle plug is inserted into a bottle opening of the bottle body, an air inlet pipe and an air outlet pipe are fixedly arranged on the bottle plug, the bottom of the air inlet pipe is of a sealing structure, an air outlet hole is formed in the air inlet pipe, a piston column is arranged in the air inlet pipe, a mounting disc is sleeved on the air inlet pipe, an arc-shaped ring is arranged on the outer disc surface of the mounting disc, and an air cavity is formed in the arc-shaped ring. According to the piston column arranged by the experimental organic gas absorbing device, the purpose of preventing reverse suction is achieved, and the exhaust holes are annularly arranged, so that gas is dispersed into a plurality of bubbles to enter the washing liquid, the mixing degree and the contact area of the organic gas and the washing liquid are greatly improved, an arc-shaped air passage is formed by the arc-shaped ring outside the mounting plate and the spherical bottle body, the gas is required to be discharged in an ascending mode along an arc-shaped path, the residence time in the washing liquid is prolonged, and the absorption efficiency is improved.

title_en: Water resource purifying equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses water resource purifying equipment which comprises a filter tank, wherein a filter screen is fixed on the inner wall of the filter tank, a cleaning door is hinged to the right side of the surface of the filter tank, a partition plate is fixed below the inner wall of the filter tank, a protection pipe is fixed at the bottom of the partition plate, a drain valve is communicated with the bottom of the filter tank, a chassis is connected with the surface of the partition plate in a sliding manner, a plurality of water through tanks are arranged on the surface of the chassis, a plurality of mounting pipes are fixed at the top of the chassis, a top plate is fixed on the surface of the mounting pipes, a filter core is arranged inside the mounting pipes, a driving mechanism is arranged below the chassis, a water guide shell is fixed on the inner wall of the filter tank, a conveying pipe is communicated at the bottom of the water guide shell, a multi-stage hydraulic rod is fixed on the surface of the filter tank, and one end of the multi-stage hydraulic rod penetrates into the filter tank and is fixed with a push plate. The utility model has the advantages of automatically cleaning the filter screen and rapidly replacing the filter element.

title_en: Water purifier
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a water purifier. The water purifier comprises a heating tank and a drainage assembly, wherein the heating tank is provided with a water outlet, the water outlet is arranged at the bottom of the heating tank, the drainage assembly is provided with a water inlet, a first drainage outlet and a second drainage outlet, the water inlet is connected with the water outlet, the first drainage outlet is used for supplying water to water using equipment, the second drainage outlet is used for draining water in the heating tank, and the first drainage outlet is perpendicular to the second drainage outlet. The water purifier can completely discharge residual liquid in the heating tank.

title_en: Novel monorail type underwater mud scraper
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel single-rail underwater mud scraper, and belongs to the technical field of sewage treatment. The sewage treatment device comprises a support, a sliding rail, a sliding component and a cleaning component, wherein the support is fixed in a sewage pool, the sliding rail is arranged on the support, the sliding component is arranged on the sliding rail, the sliding component comprises a sliding block, a transverse groove is formed in the sliding block, a groove is formed in the inner wall of the transverse groove, a bearing is matched in the groove, a rotating shaft is matched with an inner ring of the bearing, a cavity is formed in the sliding block, one end of the rotating shaft stretches into the cavity, a transmission gear is matched on the rotating shaft, a mounting hole is formed in the top of the sliding block, a servo motor is arranged in the mounting hole, a motor shaft at the output end of the servo motor stretches into the cavity, a motor gear is matched on the motor shaft at the output end of the servo motor, and the motor gear is matched with the transmission gear. According to the utility model, the sliding assembly slides on the sliding rail above the sewage to drive the scum pipe to clean scum on the water surface, and the mud scraping plate cleans the sludge at the bottom, so that the problem that the accumulated sludge on the rail is easy to block is solved.

title_en: Environment-friendly dedusting filter bag convenient for vibration ash removal
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of dust removing filter bags and discloses an environment-friendly dust removing filter bag convenient for vibration dust removal, which comprises a filter outer barrel and a filter inner barrel arranged in the filter outer barrel, wherein the top end of the filter outer barrel is provided with a mounting disc, the mounting disc is connected with the top end of the filter inner barrel, a cleaning ring is arranged outside the filter outer barrel in a sliding manner, bristles are arranged on the inner side of the cleaning ring, a vibrating box is arranged at the bottom end of the filter inner barrel, and a vibrating motor is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the vibrating box.

title_en: Copper sulfate stirring and dissolving and flue gas absorbing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a copper sulfate stirring dissolving and flue gas absorbing device which comprises a copper sulfate redissolution tank, wherein a top cover is arranged at the top of the copper sulfate redissolution tank, a speed reducer is arranged at the upper center of the top cover, the output end of the speed reducer is connected with a rotating shaft, the bottom of the rotating shaft is connected with a stirring paddle, a material feeding opening and an air suction pipeline are respectively arranged at two sides of the top cover, the material feeding opening and the air suction pipeline are respectively communicated into the copper sulfate redissolution tank, a steam pipeline is laid at the inner bottom of the copper sulfate redissolution tank, the steam pipeline is communicated with an external steam pipeline, and steam nozzles are uniformly distributed on the steam pipeline. The utility model relates to an improvement and promotion of an original square copper sulfate redissolution tank, which is used for manufacturing the copper sulfate redissolution tank with stirring and smoke absorbing functions, reducing the acid mist concentration of an operation site, improving the site operation environment, accelerating the dissolution speed of copper sulfate crystals, saving steam energy and improving the production efficiency.

title_en: Novel anaerobic reactor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel anaerobic reactor, which comprises a main body machine, an input pipe, a sludge cover and a base, wherein the side of the main body machine is fixedly provided with the input pipe, the bottom end of the main body machine is fixedly provided with the base, the surface of the base is provided with the sludge cover, a connecting device is fixedly arranged at the top end of the sludge cover and used for inputting a water source at the top end into the sludge cover again for filtering again, and a replacing device is fixedly arranged on the surface of the base and comprises a fixing ring, a matching groove, a thread groove and a threaded rod.

title_en: Sewage plant tail water filters purifier
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tail water filtering and purifying device of a sewage plant, which comprises a treatment tank, a water distribution component and an air distribution component, wherein the interior of the treatment tank is divided into a water inlet area, an ozone catalytic reaction area, an aerobic oxidation filtering area and a plant area by a support plate, a baffle plate and a water type floating bed which are sequentially arranged from bottom to top, through holes are respectively arranged on the support plate and the baffle plate, the ozone catalytic reaction area is provided with a catalyst layer, the aerobic oxidation filtering area is provided with a filter material layer, the bottom of the treatment tank is provided with a water inlet and an air inlet, the top of the treatment tank is provided with a water outlet, the water distribution component is connected with the water inlet, and the air distribution component is connected with the air inlet. The utility model has simple structure and strong practicability, can remove the drug residue in the tail water, particularly improves the ozone utilization rate by adopting a bottom-up arrangement mode of a tail water treatment assembly line, reduces the occupied area and solves the problem of low ozone utilization rate in the prior art.

title_en: Compound device for processing snakegourd fruit and treating wastewater
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a compound device for processing snakegourd fruit and treating wastewater, which belongs to the technical field of agricultural and forestry mechanical equipment, and comprises a separation box, a crushing box and a wastewater treatment assembly; the separating box is provided with a crushing box, the snakegourd fruit feed liquid crushed by the crushing box enters the separating box for separation, the separating box separates snakegourd fruit seeds, melon pulp and snakegourd fruit processing wastewater, the snakegourd fruit processing wastewater enters a wastewater treatment assembly for treatment, and the wastewater treatment assembly comprises an air flotation treatment tank, a sedimentation tank, an anaerobic tank and a filter tank which are connected in sequence. The device not only can improve the separation efficiency of the snakegourd seeds and the melon pulp, but also can realize the further treatment of the snakegourd processing wastewater, and avoid the environmental pollution caused by the direct discharge of the snakegourd processing wastewater.

title_en: Self-excited jet oscillation muffler
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of noise elimination devices, in particular to a self-excited jet oscillation noise elimination device which comprises a cooling shell, a noise elimination shell arranged on the cooling shell and a noise elimination assembly arranged on the noise elimination shell, wherein the cooling shell comprises a liquid shell cavity, a cooling cavity is arranged in the liquid shell cavity, a liquid inlet and a liquid outlet which are communicated with the cooling cavity are formed in the liquid shell cavity, the noise elimination shell comprises a gas shell cavity arranged in the liquid shell cavity, an air inlet pipe and an air outlet pipe which penetrate through the liquid shell cavity are communicated with the gas shell cavity, and the noise elimination assembly comprises a primary noise elimination pipe arranged on the noise elimination shell, a plurality of air flow oscillators connected with the primary noise elimination pipe and a primary noise elimination plate, and the primary noise elimination plate is provided with a plurality of primary noise elimination holes. And cooling liquid is introduced into the liquid shell cavity through the liquid inlet to fill the liquid shell cavity so as to form a cooling environment for cooling, the silencing assembly is used for silencing gas, and the silencing and cooling of the gas are performed on the basis of compact structure of the silencer.

title_en: Fire control cooling water supply device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire-fighting cooling water supply device, which aims to solve the technical problems that the fire-fighting cooling water system of the existing fire-fighting system has strict requirements on sites and cannot be moved for recycling. The utility model provides a fire-fighting cooling water supply device, which adopts a skid-mounted box structure, a fire-fighting equipment room is arranged in the box, a fire-fighting cooling water pump is arranged in the fire-fighting equipment room, the fire-fighting cooling water supply device comprises a fire-fighting cooling water diesel pump set and a fire-fighting cooling water electric pump, facilities required by a fire-fighting cooling water supply system are integrated in the skid-mounted box, the skid-mounted box is convenient to move and reuse, and through an integrated design, the occupied area and construction investment are reduced, meanwhile, the problems of idle and waste of the facilities of the fire-fighting system are avoided, the fire-fighting cooling water supply device has good site adaptability, can adapt to site requirements of different scales and grades, and is allowed to be reused in different scenes.

title_en: Tubular ceramic oxygen permeable membrane assembly
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a tubular ceramic oxygen permeation membrane component which comprises a metal porous plate, wherein at least two stepped holes are formed in the metal porous plate along the thickness direction of the metal porous plate, the at least two stepped holes are sequentially arranged along the length direction and/or the width direction of the metal porous plate, the stepped holes comprise a first hole and a second hole, the aperture of the first hole is larger than that of the second hole, the metal sleeve is of a hollow stepped structure and comprises a first sleeve and a second sleeve, the wall thickness of the first sleeve is the same as that of the second sleeve, the outer diameter of the first sleeve is larger than that of the second sleeve, the first sleeve is fixedly arranged in the first hole, the second sleeve is fixedly arranged in the second hole, a tubular ceramic oxygen permeation membrane is fixedly arranged in the metal sleeve, and a first rubber ring is arranged between the second sleeve and the tubular ceramic oxygen permeation membrane. The metal sleeve of the tubular ceramic oxygen permeable membrane component and the tubular ceramic oxygen permeable membrane are in sealing connection and fixation through the first rubber ring and the glue injection mode, so that the variable range of the size of the membrane tube is greatly increased.

title_en: Anti-formula grid scrubbing equipment that drags for
abstract_en: The utility model provides anti-drag type grid decontamination equipment, which belongs to the field of grid decontamination and comprises a decontamination machine body, wherein frame guard plates are arranged on two sides of the decontamination machine body, an adjusting mechanism is arranged between the tops of the frame guard plates, and a driving assembly is arranged on the outer side of each frame guard plate. According to the utility model, the cleaning roller is driven to move under the operation of the electric pushing cylinder, if the cleaning roller is required to be far away from the surface of the dirt remover body, the electric pushing cylinder stretches out of the dirt remover body by one end distance to push the cleaning roller to move upwards by one end distance in the adjusting groove, and if the cleaning roller is required to be close to the surface of the dirt remover body, the cleaning roller is pulled downwards only by the shrinkage of the electric pushing cylinder, so that the position of the cleaning roller can be conveniently adjusted when the surface of the dirt remover body is cleaned, and the cleaning roller is suitable for different cleaning requirements and garbage adhesion cleaning with different sizes.

title_en: Automatic wash device of dosing pipeline
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a device for automatically flushing a dosing pipeline, which comprises a dosing tank, a dosing pump, a dosing valve and a main system process water pipeline, wherein the dosing tank is connected with the first end of the dosing pump, the second end of the dosing pump is connected with the first end of the dosing pipeline, the second end of the dosing pipeline is connected with the first end of the dosing valve, and the second end of the dosing valve is connected with the main system process water pipeline. The first end of the bypass valve is connected with the main system process water pipeline, the second end of the bypass valve is connected with the second end of the dosing pipeline, the first end of the dosing pipeline is also connected with the first end of the first flushing and discharging valve, and the second end of the first flushing and discharging valve is also connected with the sewage pool. When the dosing pipeline needs to be flushed, the dosing pump and the dosing valve are closed, the bypass valve and the first flushing and discharging valve are opened, and process water in the process water pipeline of the main system flows into the sewage tank after flowing through the bypass valve, the dosing pipeline and the first flushing and discharging valve. Thus, the process water in the process water pipeline of the main system can be utilized to automatically wash the dosing pipeline.

title_en: Purification device for waste incineration tail gas
abstract_en: The utility model provides a waste incineration tail gas purification device, has solved the dust that produces after the waste incineration and has been led to the fact the sack to remove dust by the sack, and it is very troublesome to change and clear up the sack, and the particulate matter that does not burn completely collects together, can increase the discharge amount of large granule smoke and harmful gas, including the casing, the inside of casing is equipped with the appearance chamber of storing liquid, the left side of appearance chamber is equipped with the combustion chamber, be equipped with the ignition head in the combustion chamber, the lower extreme of combustion chamber is equipped with the gas inlet, be equipped with crooked passageway between upper end and the appearance chamber of combustion chamber, the top of appearance chamber is equipped with the water outlet with casing fixed connection, the right side of water outlet is equipped with the gas outlet with appearance chamber intercommunication, the top of gas outlet communicates with casing fixed connection's pump, this device reduces the discharge amount of large granule smoke and has reduced the trouble of long-term change clearance sack compared with the sack dust removal in the past.

title_en: Water quality regulation and control equipment for microecologics suitable for aquaculture
abstract_en: The utility model discloses water quality regulation and control equipment for aquaculture, which relates to the technical field of aquaculture and comprises a buoyancy ship body, wherein a medicament bin is arranged at the top end of the buoyancy ship body, a rotating shaft is arranged in the medicament bin, fixed discs are arranged at the upper part and the lower part of the rotating shaft, a spiral stirring plate is arranged between the two fixed discs, a plurality of scraping plates are arranged at the bottom end of the fixed disc at the lower part of the rotating shaft, an infusion pipeline is arranged at the bottom end of the medicament bin, the bottom of the infusion pipeline extends out of the bottom of the buoyancy ship body, and medicament spraying ports are arranged at two sides of the infusion pipeline. The utility model has the advantages that by arranging a series of structures, the liquid medicine in the medicament bin is fully stirred and mixed, the liquid medicine is convenient to discharge, the liquid medicine of the microecological preparation is fully stirred, the mixed liquid medicine is evenly injected into the water tank, and the water quality at different positions can be regulated and controlled simultaneously.

title_en: Dust recovery device for mineral-based biochar production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of mineral-based biochar production, in particular to a dust recovery device for mineral-based biochar production, which comprises a dust collection bin, wherein a vibration sieve plate is obliquely arranged in the dust collection bin, a first air suction bin is arranged below the vibration sieve plate, a flange plate is arranged at the top end of a feeding pipe, a first filter plate is arranged in an opening of the second air suction bin and the feeding pipe, a second filter plate is vertically and closely arranged in the filtering bin, dust mixed in the mineral-based biochar in the downward falling process of the mineral-based biochar entering the feeding pipe is sucked into the second air suction bin through the first filter plate, dust scattered in the mineral-based biochar on the vibration sieve plate is sucked into the first air suction bin through holes on the vibration sieve plate, the sucked dust is filtered and adsorbed, and a rotating brush roller sweeps the dust on the side surface of the second filter plate.

title_en: Multilayer hydrogen filtering device capable of being quickly installed and detached
abstract_en: The utility model provides a multilayer hydrogen filtering device capable of being quickly installed and detached, which is characterized in that an air inlet pipe is communicated with the central part of the bottom of a tank body, a spiral guide vane is welded on the inner wall of the air inlet pipe, a tapered cylindrical channel is arranged in the tank body, the caliber of the cylindrical channel is gradually reduced from bottom to top to a filtering layer, a cylindrical channel is arranged in the middle part of the tank body and is connected with the inner wall of the tank body through a longitudinal reinforcing rib, a plurality of layers of filtering layers are installed in the cylindrical channel, each filtering layer comprises a coarse filtering layer, a fine filtering layer and a final filtering layer, active carbon, silica gel and palladium membranes are correspondingly adopted as filtering materials, each layer of filtering layer is fixed through a supporting frame, and the top of the tank body is communicated with an air outlet pipe. The device is a multilayer high-pressure gas filtering device which is fast to install and detach, strong in sealing performance and even in gas flow distribution, can effectively improve the efficiency and reliability of gas filtering, reduces the maintenance cost and ensures the continuity and safety of production.

title_en: Matched dust removing device for producing fused magnesia
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of fused magnesia, in particular to a matched dust removing device for fused magnesia production, which comprises a first connecting pipe, wherein one end of the first connecting pipe is connected with a processing box, the center of the outer wall of the top of the processing box is connected with a second connecting pipe, the other end of the second connecting pipe is connected with a fan, a filter assembly is arranged in the processing box, the first connecting pipe and the outer wall of the connecting pipe are provided with supporting rods, and the filter assembly comprises sliding holes equidistantly formed in the outer wall of one side of the processing box, a fit groove formed in the center of the sliding holes of the processing box, a sliding frame in the fit groove in a sliding mode, and a sliding plate welded on the outer wall of one side of the sliding frame. The interception plate is matched with the filter material to further intercept and adsorb impurities, the sliding frame is pulled out through the sliding plate after the use for a period of time, and the interception plate and the filter material in the sliding frame are taken down to be cleaned or replaced, so that the air is further treated, and the use is convenient.

title_en: Rural domestic sewage purifying equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides rural domestic sewage purification equipment, which relates to the field of rural domestic sewage purification equipment and comprises an integrated treatment assembly, wherein the integrated treatment assembly comprises a grid pond, an adjusting pond, an anaerobic pond, an anoxic pond, an aerobic pond, a sedimentation pond, an equipment box, a sludge pond and a blower, sewage in the adjusting pond is conveyed to the anaerobic pond through a sewage pump, nitrifying liquid in the aerobic pond flows back to the anoxic pond through a pipeline, and the rural domestic sewage purification equipment has the effect of purifying rural domestic sewage by arranging the grid pond, the adjusting pond, the anaerobic pond, the anoxic pond, the aerobic pond, the sedimentation pond, the equipment box, the sludge pond and the blower, can effectively purify domestic sewage through anaerobic reaction, nitrifying liquid denitrification reaction and biodegradation, and can lift nitrifying liquid through the backflow of nitrifying liquid by utilizing the existing aeration equipment, so that the operation cost and the later maintenance cost are reduced, and the rural domestic sewage treatment can be satisfied.

title_en: Incinerator for staged combustion of waste refractory materials
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an incinerator for burning waste refractory materials in a grading manner, which relates to the technical field of incinerators and comprises a first bracket, wherein a first fixing rod is fixedly connected to the front side surface and the rear side surface of the inside of the first bracket, and a second fixing rod is fixedly connected to the left side surface and the right side surface of the inside of the first bracket. According to the utility model, the first motor and the second motor are started firstly by arranging the first crushing wheel and the second crushing wheel, so that the first crushing wheel and the second crushing wheel are driven to rotate in opposite directions, waste refractory materials are crushed under the action of the first crushing wheel and the second crushing wheel, after crushing, the first switch is opened, the crushed waste refractory materials come out of the discharge hole and arrive on the screening plate, the crushing work of the waste refractory materials is finished, the screening plate is arranged, the waste refractory materials can be screened in a screening way, and the waste refractory materials with different sizes enter different incinerator furnaces to be incinerated, so that the waste of incineration resources is prevented.

title_en: Oil-gas separation device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of lubricating equipment, and particularly relates to an oil-gas separation device which comprises an upper box body and a lower box body which are overlapped, wherein a first partition plate is arranged between the upper box body and the lower box body, an oil drain hole and a communicating piece which are communicated with the upper box body and the lower box body are arranged on the first partition plate, an oil suction pipe orifice, an air inlet pipe orifice and an oil drain hole are arranged on the lower box body, an air inlet pipe communicated with the air inlet pipe orifice is arranged in the lower box body, one end of the air inlet pipe, which is far away from the air inlet pipe orifice, is connected with a vacuum generator, the outlet end of the vacuum generator is connected with an oil drain pipe, the oil suction pipe orifice is connected with an oil suction pipe, the oil drain pipe is communicated with the vacuum generator, one end of the oil drain pipe, which is far away from the vacuum generator, is communicated with the communicating piece, an exhaust pipe is arranged on the upper box body, and a second partition plate is arranged in the upper box body at the exhaust pipe. The utility model can recycle the lubricating thin oil leaked from the equipment, thereby improving the working environment and saving the use of the lubricating thin oil.

title_en: Sludge treatment system of marine thickened oil produced water
abstract_en: The utility model provides a sludge treatment system for offshore thickened oil produced water, which aims to solve the problems that in the existing sludge treatment system, the synergistic effect of a vacuum pumping device and a drying device is poor and the sludge drying treatment efficiency is affected; the sludge enters the rake dryer along the wet material inlet, is dried to generate water-oil mixed steam and dry material, the water-oil mixed steam is pumped out through the vacuum pumping module, and the dry material is discharged along the dry material outlet. The three-way structure of the Venturi water injector ensures that the Venturi water injector is not easy to be blocked when vacuumized, can continuously create a vacuum environment for the inside of the rake dryer, and improves the efficiency of sludge drying treatment.

title_en: Dampproofing heat dissipation switch board
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dampproof heat dissipation power distribution cabinet which comprises a cabinet body, wherein a front door is arranged on the front side wall of the cabinet body, power distribution equipment is fixedly connected to the inside of the cabinet body, a PLC (programmable logic controller) is fixedly connected to the right side wall of the inside of the cabinet body, a drying plate is fixedly connected to the inside of the cabinet body, a plurality of air holes are formed in the drying plate and uniformly distributed on the drying plate, a side plate is fixedly connected to the front side wall of the drying plate, the side plate is fixedly connected with the cabinet body, and a drying assembly is arranged in the cabinet body. Through setting up salt bucket, main motor, (mixing) shaft, stirring leaf, air-supply line, exhaust pipe and play tuber pipe, when dispelling the heat, outside air gets into from the air-supply line, after the moisture absorption of the inside industrial salt of salt bucket is dry, is discharged from bottom exhaust pipe, can greatly reduce air humidity to the life of extension desiccator and switch board.

title_en: Unmanned on duty integration coalbed methane dewatering device
abstract_en: The utility model provides an unattended integrated coal bed gas dehydration device, which belongs to the technical field of coal bed gas dehydration, wherein an air inlet of a bypass electric valve is connected with a pressurizing station, an air outlet of the bypass electric valve is connected with an air inlet of a gathering and conveying pipeline, an air inlet of an air inlet electric valve is connected with the pressurizing station, an air outlet of the air inlet electric valve is connected with an air inlet of a pre-filter, an air outlet of the pre-filter is connected with a high-temperature gas inlet of a precooler, a high-temperature gas outlet of the precooler is connected with a gas inlet of a cold dryer, a gas outlet of the cold dryer is connected with a gas inlet of a gas-liquid separator, a gas outlet of the gas-liquid separator is connected with a low-temperature gas inlet of the precooler, a low-temperature gas outlet of the precooler is connected with an air inlet of an air outlet electric valve, and an air outlet of the air outlet electric valve is connected with an air inlet of the gathering and conveying pipeline. According to the utility model, unattended dehydration and dust removal of the coal bed gas can be realized in a limited space, and the quality of the coal bed gas is improved.

title_en: Vertical dust remover
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of dust removal, and discloses a vertical dust remover which comprises a dust removal box, wherein a filter screen plate is fixedly arranged in the dust removal box, a water storage plate is arranged above the filter screen plate and fixedly arranged in the dust removal box, an atomizing nozzle is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the water storage plate, a guide plate is arranged below the filter screen plate and fixedly arranged in the dust removal box, a movable rod is movably arranged on the surface of the guide plate, and a cleaning plate is fixedly arranged on the surface of the movable rod. The device can more effectively capture dust and particles in the air, thereby improving the dust removal efficiency of the dust remover, ensuring the continuous and efficient operation of the dust remover, simultaneously preventing the dust and the particles from excessively accumulating on the filter screen plate, reducing the load of the filter screen, prolonging the service life of the filter screen, reducing the work load of the dust remover, reducing the energy consumption and improving the energy utilization efficiency.

title_en: Sponge city water cyclic utilization device with solid-liquid separation structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sponge urban water recycling device with a solid-liquid separation structure, belongs to the field of water recycling, and solves the problem that the existing rainwater recycling device cannot perform solid-liquid separation. The utility model comprises a shell, wherein a first separation chamber, a first water storage chamber, a transfer chamber and a second water storage chamber are arranged in the shell, the separation chamber and the transfer chamber are both positioned at the upper part of the shell, the first water storage chamber is positioned below the separation chamber, the second water storage chamber is positioned below the transfer chamber, the top of the separation chamber is connected with a water inlet, the separation chamber is communicated with the first water storage chamber through a first filter plate, the first water storage chamber is communicated with the transfer chamber through a lifting assembly, the transfer chamber is communicated with the second water storage chamber through a filter assembly, and the bottom of the second water storage chamber is connected with a water outlet pipe. According to the utility model, the first filter plate is used for preliminarily filtering rainwater to intercept solid impurities, the filter assembly is used for filtering fine impurities and then the filtered impurities enter the second water storage chamber, and finally the clean rainwater is discharged through the water outlet pipe, so that the water outlet quality is high.

title_en: Coke oven coal-charging flue gas filtering device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of coke oven flue gas filtration, and particularly relates to a coke oven coal-charging flue gas filtration device which comprises a device body with a flue gas filtration bin, wherein the flue gas filtration bin is filled with filtration liquid for flue gas filtration, a smoke discharging mechanism for providing flue gas is immersed in the filtration liquid, one end of the smoke discharging mechanism extends to the outside of the device body, the smoke discharging mechanism comprises an air inlet pipe and a coil pipe which are sequentially communicated, the air inlet pipe is arranged at the outside of the device body, the coil pipe is immersed in the filtration liquid, a plurality of communicated branch pipes are longitudinally arranged on the coil pipe, and a separator for separating gas from liquid is arranged at the top of each branch pipe.

title_en: Atmospheric desulfurization device for environmental protection engineering
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of desulfurization devices, and discloses an atmospheric desulfurization device for environmental protection engineering, which comprises a desulfurization tank, wherein the top of the desulfurization tank is connected with a detachable tank cover through a flange, the inner wall of the desulfurization tank is fixedly connected with a mounting frame, the inner wall of the mounting frame is fixedly connected with a desulfurization bin, the top of the detachable tank cover is fixedly connected with a motor, the output end of the motor is fixedly connected with a stirring rod, and the surface of the stirring rod is fixedly connected with a filter plate. This atmosphere desulfurization device that environmental protection engineering was used sets up through the cooperation of motor, puddler, filter and scraper blade, and motor external power source drives puddler and scraper blade when using stirs the desulfurization gas and increases the desulfurization gas velocity of flow and strike off and glue wall impurity, and the filter filters for the desulfurization gas, has played the effect of striking off and gluing wall impurity at desulfurization in-process.

title_en: Dust collector is used in production of aquatic products puffed feed
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of feed production, in particular to a dust removing device for aquatic puffed feed production, which comprises a drying mechanism, a ventilation mechanism and a three-dimensional dust removing mechanism which are sequentially connected. Compared with the prior art, the utility model dries the materials through the drying tank, dust generated by drying flows into the first filtering bin along with the air flow entering from the discharge hole at the bottom of the drying tank under the action of the ventilation mechanism, then flows into the second filtering bin from bottom to top under the action of the cyclone dust removing structure, and clean air is discharged after filtering. Therefore, after dust flows into the first filtering bin and the second filtering bin along with the airflow, the dust can be filtered twice, and particles and dust obtained by filtering can fall into the dust collecting seat through the dust collecting pipeline to be collected. The utility model provides a three-dimensional secondary filtering dust removal form from this, can be on the basis of high-efficient utilization factory building space, synchronous purification dust and carry out effective recycle to the material granule in the dust.

title_en: Tail gas pretreatment system suitable for acetic acid method production chloroacetic acid in-process
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hydrogen chloride removal system suitable for a chloroacetic acid production process by an acetic acid method, and belongs to the technical field of glycine production. The hydrogen chloride removing system comprises a separating kettle, a condenser, a filler absorption tower and an acetyl chloride recovery tank, wherein the separating kettle is connected with a chlorination reaction kettle, the separating kettle is connected with the condenser, the condenser is connected with the separating kettle through a return pipe, a non-condensable gas outlet on the condenser is connected with the filler absorption tower through a non-condensable gas outlet pipe, a vacuum pump is arranged on the non-condensable gas outlet pipe, the filler absorption tower is connected with an acetic acid inlet pipe, a gas phase outlet on the filler absorption tower is connected with a tail gas treatment system, the filler absorption tower is connected with the acetyl chloride recovery tank through an acetyl chloride outlet pipe, the acetyl chloride recovery tank is connected with the chlorination reaction kettle through a recycling pipe, and the acetyl chloride recovery tank is also connected with the filler absorption tower through a circulation pipe. The acetyl chloride in the chloroacetic acid finished product is recovered and reused in the chlorination process, so that the consumption of acetic anhydride as a raw material is reduced, and meanwhile, the loss of liquid ammonia as a raw material in the subsequent ammoniation process is reduced.

title_en: Die cutting structure of lottery ticket printer
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of lottery printing die cutting, in particular to a die cutting structure of a lottery printing machine, which comprises a chassis, wherein a die cutting roller and a pressing roller are arranged on the chassis, a first motor and a second motor are arranged on the outer side of the chassis, a fixing frame is arranged on the outer side of the first motor, a waste treatment mechanism is arranged on the chassis, an electric telescopic rod is arranged on the outer side of the chassis, and the waste treatment mechanism specifically comprises a cutting roller, a waste cutter, a pressing roller and a cutting groove. According to the utility model, the lottery ticket is conveyed forwards between the die cutting roller and the pressing roller through the die cutting roller, the pressing roller, the first motor, the second motor, the die cutting knife and the cutter groove, the die cutting knife cuts the lottery ticket under the action of pressure, the square frame type die cutting knife can directly and completely cut the lottery ticket, the die cutting structure is more suitable for cutting the lottery ticket, and the generated waste material can be directly treated through the waste material treatment mechanism, the cutting roller, the waste material cutting knife, the compression roller and the cutter groove, so that the manpower consumption is reduced.

title_en: Water purifying equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of water purification, in particular to a water purification device, which aims to solve the problem that the use experience of a user is poor due to the risk that water in a water inlet main path easily flows back into a cleaning agent storage component.
