The water purifying equipment comprises a reverse osmosis membrane filter element, a water inlet main path, a cleaning assembly, a booster pump and a cleaning agent protecting component, wherein the cleaning agent storing component is used for storing cleaning agent, the cleaning outlet is communicated with the water inlet main path, the booster pump is arranged on the water inlet main path and is positioned at the upstream end of the cleaning outlet, the cleaning agent protecting component is arranged between the cleaning agent storing component and the cleaning outlet, and the cleaning agent protecting component is arranged to resist the water pressure in the water inlet main path and prevent water in the water inlet main path from flowing back into the cleaning agent storing component. The utility model can prevent water in the water inlet main path from flowing back into the cleaning agent storage component, and can resist the water pressure in the water inlet main path, so that the cleaning agent is kept dry, and the use experience of a user is improved.

title_en: Microorganism organic wastewater treatment device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a microorganism organic wastewater treatment device, which relates to the technical field of wastewater treatment and comprises a base and an aeration tank, wherein an air blower is fixedly arranged on the left side of the upper end of the base, the right side of an air outlet of the air blower is connected with an exhaust branch pipe, the other end of the exhaust branch pipe is connected with a cooling fan cover, the aeration tank is fixed above the cooling fan cover, a first radiating fin and a second radiating fin are sleeved outside the aeration tank in a fit way, an exhaust main pipe is connected above the air outlet of the air blower, the exhaust main pipe is connected with an aeration pipe through a heating tank, the other end of the aeration pipe is connected with an aeration disc, the aeration disc is arranged inside the aeration tank, and a temperature sensor is arranged at the front end of the aeration tank.

title_en: Aeration device for sewage treatment tank
abstract_en: The utility model provides an aeration device for a sewage treatment tank, which comprises the sewage treatment tank, an aeration assembly, a protection mechanism, a driving mechanism and a cleaning mechanism, wherein the aeration assembly is arranged in the sewage treatment tank, the aeration assembly is provided with a plurality of aeration heads which are uniformly distributed at the bottom of the sewage treatment tank, the top ends of the aeration heads are provided with outlets, the protection mechanism is rotatably arranged in the sewage treatment tank, the bottom surface of the protection mechanism covers the outlets of the aeration heads, the driving mechanism provides rotary driving for the protection mechanism, so that the protection mechanism is switched between a horizontal state and a non-horizontal state, and the cleaning mechanism is arranged on the protection mechanism. The protection mechanism is driven to rotate through the driving mechanism, so that the protection mechanism is switched between a horizontal state and a non-horizontal state, after the aeration assembly is stopped, the protection mechanism is adjusted to be horizontal, the outlet at the top end of the aeration head can be covered for protection, dirt is prevented from entering, and the protection mechanism is adjusted to be vertical during normal aeration and does not shield the aeration head.

title_en: Dust fall device for construction
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of building construction, in particular to a dust fall device for building construction, which comprises a vehicle body, a water tank, a water pump, a hose, a spray head and a dust fall mechanism, wherein the water tank is fixedly connected with the surface of the vehicle body, the water pump is fixedly arranged on the surface of the water tank, the hose is fixedly connected with the surface of the water pump, the spray head is fixedly connected with the surface of the hose, the dust fall mechanism is arranged on the surface of the vehicle body, the dust fall mechanism comprises a motor, the motor is fixedly arranged on the surface of the vehicle body, the output end of the motor is fixedly connected with a worm, the inside of the vehicle body is provided with an inner cavity, the surface of the inner cavity is fixedly connected with a bracket, the inner wall of the bracket is rotatably connected with a bidirectional threaded rod, and the surface of the bidirectional threaded rod is fixedly connected with a worm wheel. According to the utility model, by arranging the dust falling mechanism, two groups of spray heads and cleaning brushes which are continuously staggered are utilized to carry out spraying and cleaning operations in a large range, so that the dust falling and removing efficiency is increased, the labor and time are saved, and the convenience of the equipment is effectively improved.

title_en: Compressed air purifying and filtering device of hyperbaric oxygen chamber
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of medical equipment, in particular to a compressed air purifying and filtering device of a hyperbaric oxygen chamber, which aims at solving the problem that the existing compressed air purifying and filtering device of the hyperbaric oxygen chamber cannot clean a filter plate and provides the following scheme that the compressed air purifying and filtering device of the hyperbaric oxygen chamber comprises a main body of the compressed air purifying device of the hyperbaric oxygen chamber; the heating device is arranged at the bottom of the compressed air purifying device main body of the hyperbaric oxygen chamber; the filtering device is arranged on the main body of the compressed air purifying device of the hyperbaric oxygen chamber; the device comprises a filter plate, a screw transmission mechanism, a cleaning device, a fixing device and a fixing device, wherein the filter plate is arranged on the main body of the compressed air purification device of the hyperbaric oxygen chamber.

title_en: Filter element-free pipeline dust removal system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a filter element-free pipeline dust removal system which comprises at least one dust removal pipe assembly, wherein each dust removal pipe assembly comprises a pipe body, a spray head assembly is arranged in each pipe body, the spray head assembly is connected with a water supply system, the pipe body is provided with a sewage drainage port, and the pipe body is connected with a sewage discharge system through the sewage drainage port.

title_en: Salt lake brine evaporation equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses salt lake brine evaporation equipment, and relates to the technical field of brine evaporation. The brine heating and evaporating device comprises an evaporating box, wherein a water filling port is formed in the surface of the evaporating box in a penetrating mode, a motor is fixedly arranged at the top of the evaporating box, a rotating shaft is fixedly arranged at the output shaft of the motor in a penetrating mode, a C-shaped scraping plate is fixedly arranged on the surface of the rotating shaft, one end, far away from the rotating shaft, of the C-shaped scraping plate is attached to the inner wall of the evaporating box, a control valve is arranged at the bottom of the evaporating box, brine is injected into the evaporating box through the water filling port, then the evaporating box is started to heat and evaporate the brine in the evaporating box, the motor is started in the process to enable the output shaft of the evaporating box to drive the rotating shaft to rotate, and then the C-shaped scraping plate is driven to rotate to stir the brine in the evaporating box, so that the brine is heated more uniformly in the evaporating box, the evaporating and crystallizing effects of the brine are improved, and the crystallizing rate of the brine is improved.

title_en: Dust collector for construction waste treatment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the related technical field of garbage disposal, in particular to a dust removing device for construction garbage disposal. This dust collector for construction waste handles, through first motor, two-way screw rod, ball nut seat, the connecting seat, first spliced pole, the swivel mount, the second spliced pole, the connecting block, the elevating socket, stopper and spacing groove's setting, during the dust removal, start first motor, first motor makes two-way screw rod corotation, two ball nut seats remove to the both ends of base simultaneously this moment, two swivel mount rotate simultaneously, rise with the elevating socket, just so can rise with the shower nozzle, the scope that the shower nozzle sprayed has been enlarged, the scope grow of dust removal, the effect of dust removal is very good, let two-way screw rod reversal when needing to drop the elevating socket, ball nut seat removes to the centre of base simultaneously, the swivel mount will rotate and drive the elevating socket decline.

title_en: Integrated switch
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of switches, in particular to an integrated switch, which comprises a box body, wherein a transparent single door is hinged to the front side of the box body, a circular air inlet is formed in the middle of the bottom of the inner wall of the box body, an air flow pipe is arranged at the circular air inlet, a first fan is arranged in the air flow pipe, a transverse partition plate is arranged in the box body, a mounting frame is arranged at the top of the transverse partition plate, an integrated switch body is arranged on the mounting frame, heat dissipation holes are formed in the left side and the right side of the box body, a dust screen is arranged in the heat dissipation holes, and a dust-proof piece is arranged at the bottom of the box body. This integrated form switch through set up the dust screen in the louvre to and the design of the filter screen board in the dust guard, effectively prevents external dust and particle entering machine incasement portion, and this has not only protected the junction of integrated form switch body to avoid the dust adhesion, has still ensured the steady operation of equipment, simultaneously, and the combination of reasonable design's air current pipeline and fan can dispel the heat fast, has avoided local overheated problem.

title_en: Floating adjusting device for oil-water separation
abstract_en: The utility model provides an oil-water separation floating adjusting device, which relates to the technical field of oil-water separation and comprises an oil-water separation tank and an oil pump, wherein an adding pipe is inserted into the top end of the oil-water separation tank, a servo motor is arranged on the left side of the top end of the oil-water separation tank, a driving screw is fixedly arranged on an output shaft of the servo motor, a floating adjusting plate is arranged on the surface of the driving screw, a telescopic hose is arranged in the oil-water separation tank, an oil pumping pipe is arranged at the top end of the telescopic hose, an oil pump is arranged at one end of the oil pumping pipe, and an oil storage tank is fixedly arranged on the left side of the oil-water separation tank. According to the utility model, the transmission screw is driven to rotate by utilizing the rotation of the servo motor, so that the floating adjusting plate is lifted along with the rotation, and the telescopic hose can be lengthened or shortened when the floating adjusting plate is lifted, so that the position of the telescopic hose can be correspondingly adjusted according to the actual position of oil, and the oil can be extracted.

title_en: Reinforced temperature-resistant pressure-resistant sleeve heat exchanger
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a heat exchanger with a reinforced heat-resistant pressure-resistant sleeve, which comprises a heat exchanger main body, a smoke inlet and a smoke outlet, wherein the smoke inlet and the smoke outlet are arranged on two sides of the heat exchanger main body, a radiation cylinder is arranged at the smoke inlet of the smoke inlet in the heat exchanger main body, a reinforcing ring is arranged at the joint of the outer side wall of the radiation cylinder and is used for reinforcing pressure resistance and temperature resistance, the opposite sides of the smoke inlet and the radiation cylinder are fixedly connected through a mole head, so that the welding quantity at the joint can be reduced, the cracking risk of a welding line at the smoke inlet at high temperature is reduced, and a gas flow channel is formed between the inner side wall and the outer side wall of the radiation cylinder.

title_en: Acid-base waste gas diaphragm cooling absorbing device
abstract_en: The utility model provides an acid-base waste gas diaphragm cooling absorption device, which belongs to the technical field of waste gas treatment and comprises a cooling tower main body, wherein the cooling tower main body is composed of an air inlet section, a cooling section, a liquid inlet section and a liquid outlet section which are connected in a detachable and fixed manner from bottom to top, a distributor assembly is arranged between the cooling section and the liquid inlet section and comprises a main pipe and branch pipes, the main pipe is horizontally arranged, a plurality of branch pipes are symmetrically arranged on the side wall of the main pipe, the end parts of the branch pipes are fixedly connected with first flange plates, the branch pipes are symmetrically distributed on two sides of the main pipe, and the end parts of the branch pipes, which are close to the branch pipes, are fixedly connected with second flange plates. According to the utility model, the exhaust gas is cooled before the exhaust gas is subjected to absorption treatment, so that the effect of the exhaust gas treatment can be effectively improved, the emission of harmful substances is reduced, and when the exhaust gas is cooled, water can absorb part of harmful gases in the exhaust gas, so that the use of chemical reagents is reduced.

title_en: High-temperature flue gas cooling incinerator for low-melting-point salt-containing waste liquid
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-temperature flue gas cooling incinerator for low-melting-point salt-containing waste liquid, which comprises a vertical incinerator body and a combustor, wherein an inner cavity of the incinerator body is divided into a combustion chamber positioned at the upper part and a cooling chamber positioned at the lower part, the combustor is arranged at the top of the inner cavity of the incinerator body, a nozzle of the combustor vertically extends downwards to the combustion chamber, a water cooling wall is arranged between the incinerator body and a heat insulation layer at the combustion chamber, a cooling chamber outlet communicated to the outside is arranged on the side wall of the cooling chamber, a circulating flue gas distribution box is arranged in the middle of the incinerator body, and the circulating flue gas distribution box is communicated with the incinerator body through a plurality of flue gas spray pipes. The low-temperature flue gas at the outlet of the dust remover is mixed with the high-temperature flue gas at the outlet of the combustion chamber, so that the temperature of the flue gas is effectively reduced, the low-melting salt is fully condensed, loose ash residues are not easy to adhere to a heating surface, and ash is discharged.

title_en: Oxygenerator convenient to assembly
abstract_en: The utility model discloses oxygen generating equipment convenient to assemble, and belongs to the technical field of oxygen generating equipment. The utility model provides an oxygenerator convenient to assembly, includes the oxygenerator main part, and the top of oxygenerator main part is provided with the touch-control screen, and the position department that the back lateral wall of oxygenerator main part is close to its top is equipped with the bracket that is used for placing the humidification bottle, the below of bracket be equipped with install in power cord grafting port on the lateral wall behind the oxygenerator main part, power cord grafting port is used for pegging graft the power cord, install the setting element on the bracket. When the oxygen generating device is used, particularly when the humidifying bottle is installed, the bottom edge of the humidifying bottle can be extruded to form the inclined part arranged on the limiting elastic sheet, so that the inclined part can drive the limiting part to move downwards and simultaneously drive the I-shaped part to stretch at the bottom of the plugboard, and when the humidifying bottle is completely aligned to the bracket, the inclined part and the limiting part can rapidly realize limiting and fixing of the humidifying bottle under the reverse rebound action of the I-shaped part.

title_en: Kitchen waste grease preliminary working oil-water separation heating tank
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an oil-water separation heating tank for preliminary processing of kitchen waste grease, which comprises a heating tank body, wherein an oil pumping port is arranged at the top end of the heating tank body, a corrugated pipe is arranged below the oil pumping port, a connecting ring is fixedly connected to the outer side of the corrugated pipe, one side of the connecting ring is connected with a movable rod through a connecting plate, one end of the movable rod penetrates through the heating tank body to be connected with the movable plate, a driving motor is fixedly arranged on the movable plate, the output end of the driving motor is connected with a gear through a rotating shaft, and the gear is meshed with a rack.

title_en: Vertical shaft type flocculation mixer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vertical shaft type flocculation stirrer, which relates to the technical field of stirrers and comprises a stirring cylinder, wherein a mixing mechanism is arranged in the stirring cylinder, the mixing mechanism comprises a stirring assembly, a pushing assembly and a driving assembly, the stirring assembly is arranged on the upper side of the inside of the stirring cylinder and comprises a first rotating rod which is rotatably arranged on the top wall of the inside of the stirring cylinder, the first rotating rod is provided with two groups of stirring paddles, the outer wall of the first rotating rod is fixedly connected with the stirring paddles, the pushing assembly is arranged on the lower side of the inside of the stirring cylinder and is used for pushing, extending and stirring materials in the stirring cylinder, and the driving assembly is arranged on the top of the stirring cylinder and is used for driving the first rotating rod to rotate. The problem of in the past vertical shaft type mixer in concrete stirring process, medicament and water mix the back and appear medicament uneven distribution very easily, and the medicament still sinks to the mixer inner chamber lower part easily, causes mixing inefficiency is solved.

title_en: Low-temperature-resistant denitrification and dephosphorization filler device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of sewage treatment, and particularly discloses a low-temperature-resistant denitrification and dephosphorization filler device which comprises a protective shell, wherein a maintenance upper cover is arranged on the upper surface of the protective shell, a driving motor is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the maintenance upper cover, a stirring cylinder is arranged on the lower surface of the maintenance upper cover, and an aerator is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the maintenance upper cover. This low temperature resistant nitrogen and phosphorus removal filler device, the polyurethane foam that protective housing presss from both sides jacket layer and fills has outstanding thermal insulation performance, can effectively reduce the loss of heat in the device, has created a relatively stable living environment for the microorganism, and stable temperature helps keeping the normal metabolism and the growth of microorganism, and then ensures going on smoothly of nitrogen and phosphorus removal reaction, and annular and many vertically stacked heating insulation pipeline, cooperation and the circulating water pipeline that outside hot-water tank links to each other can evenly and high-efficiently heat the device inside.

title_en: Multistage gas-liquid separation and flow guiding device of electrolytic tank for PPS fiber diaphragm
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multistage gas-liquid separation and diversion device of an electrolytic tank for a PPS fiber diaphragm, which relates to the technical field of hydrogen production by electrolyzed water and comprises a tank body, a first supporting plate, an exhaust fan, a first umbrella plate, a liquid inlet pipe, a water inlet pipe, a sprayer, a liquid outlet, an exhaust port and a diversion component, wherein the first supporting plate is arranged on the inner wall of the tank body, the exhaust fan is fixedly connected on the first supporting plate, the lower extreme of first backup pad is provided with first umbrella board, and the upside seamless connection of jar body has the feed liquor pipe, and feed liquor pipe and reposition of redundant personnel subassembly seamless connection, the downside seamless connection of jar body have the inlet tube, are provided with a plurality of sprayers on the inlet tube, the inlet tube is fixed connection with the lower extreme of reposition of redundant personnel subassembly, and the bottom of jar body is provided with the liquid outlet, and the gas vent has been seted up at the top of jar body. The tank body is used as a main body structure of the whole device, and provides installation space and accommodation environment for other components. The first support plate plays a key role in supporting and fixing the exhaust fan, and provides a stable installation platform for the exhaust fan.

title_en: Trough type cultivation and fermentation device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of agricultural engineering, and discloses a trough type cultivation and fermentation device which comprises a cultivation fermentation unit, a seepage recovery unit, a rain and sun shielding unit, a water supply system and a control system. The device comprises a plurality of culture fermentation units, a plurality of seepage recovery units, a plurality of rain and sun shielding units, a water supply system and a control system, wherein the culture fermentation units comprise a culture fermentation tank and a purification box, the seepage recovery units comprise a liquid collecting tank, a liquid return pipe and a liquid collecting tank, the rain and sun shielding units comprise a support frame and a rain and sun shielding plate, the water supply system comprises a water storage tank, a filter, a water pump, a water supply main pipe and a water supply branch pipe, and the control system comprises a controller, a humidity sensor and an electromagnetic valve. The utility model is applied to earthworm cultivation and cultivation material fermentation, can monitor the humidity in the cultivation fermentation tank in real time, automatically adjust water supply, ensure that the humidity is maintained in an optimal range, improve the cultivation efficiency of earthworms and the fermentation effect of the cultivation material, and simultaneously prevent the problems of earthworm escape, soil pollution caused by seepage and environment pollution caused by fermentation gas due to rainwater wetting the cultivation material.

title_en: Electrostatic electronic purification device for effectively removing high-humidity polluted air
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electrostatic electronic purification device for effectively removing high-humidity polluted air, and relates to the technical field of purification devices. The electrostatic electronic purification device for effectively removing high-humidity polluted air comprises a box body, a fixed frame fixedly arranged in the box body, a front filter screen fixedly arranged in the fixed frame, and a filter screen arranged in the fixed frame. This effectively get rid of electrostatic electronic purification device of high humidity contaminated air, through liquid fog centrifugal filter earlier with a large amount of vaporization oil smog, emulsion fog and water fog under liquid fog centrifugal filter effect, liquefaction becomes oil drop or liquid drop inflow liquid guide intracavity, then the tiny particle of relative dryness just can be electrified positive charge by the ionization when passing through electrostatic adsorption filter, thereby guarantee that electrostatic adsorption filter can also high-efficient operation ionization collection and purifying effect under high humidity contaminated air environment, thereby reduce the arc phenomenon and avoid the security risk, reduce the maintenance, improve purification efficiency.

title_en: Separator for positive and negative plates of lithium battery
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of lithium battery recovery, in particular to a separator for positive and negative plates of a lithium battery. The positive and negative pole piece separator for the lithium battery comprises a frame, a pull piece assembly, a pole piece table and two storage boxes, wherein the pull piece assembly comprises a pull piece seat, a positive pole separation roller, a negative pole separation roller, a film separation roller and two air knives, the pull piece seat is fixed on the frame, the pole piece table comprises a base and a placement box, the base is fixed on the frame, the placement box is arranged on the base and is positioned below the pull piece assembly, the placement box is used for placing a lithium battery cell, when the separator is used, the lithium battery cell is placed in the placement box, the lithium battery cell is sequentially wound around the positive pole separation roller, the negative pole separation roller and the film separation roller, the film is continuously pulled upwards, the positive pole piece and the negative pole piece are separated from the films from two sides and respectively fall into the two storage boxes, and the positive pole piece and the negative pole piece adhered on the films are scraped through the air knives, so that the separation of the positive pole piece and the negative pole piece and the film is ensured.

title_en: Filter box for drinking water for pets, drinking water seat and drinking water machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a filter box, a drinking seat and a drinking machine for drinking water for pets, and belongs to the field of drinking water for pets. The filter box is internally provided with a filter space for placing filter materials, the filter space is divided into an upper filter area and a lower filter area by a partition plate which is hollowed, the upper filter area is an open space at the top, a first filter material is paved in the open space and can be separated from the open space, the bottom of the lower filter area is provided with a bottom wall, and a second filter material is paved at the inner side of the bottom wall. The double-layer filtering mode is adopted, so that the filtering cleanliness is effectively ensured, and the first filter material with short energy efficiency is preferably directly placed on the open upper filter layer, so that the filter material is convenient to replace at any time, the whole filter box is not required to be replaced integrally, and the use cost is effectively reduced.

title_en: Superfine grinding system for traditional Chinese medicinal materials
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a traditional Chinese medicine superfine pulverizing system which comprises a frame, a pulverizing main machine, a rotating shaft, inner teeth, air homogenizing blades, a movable fluted disc and a grading impeller, wherein the pulverizing main machine is fixedly arranged on the frame, a pulverizing cavity is arranged in the pulverizing main machine, a feed inlet is formed in the side wall of the pulverizing main machine, a discharge outlet is formed in the upper end face of the pulverizing main machine, the rotating shaft is rotatably arranged in the pulverizing main machine, the inner teeth are fixedly arranged in the pulverizing cavity, the inner teeth are arranged along the inner wall of the pulverizing cavity to form an annular structure, the air homogenizing blades encircle the rotating shaft, the air homogenizing blades are arranged at the bottom of the pulverizing cavity, the movable fluted disc is fixedly sleeved on the rotating shaft, the movable fluted disc is positioned at the upper end of the air homogenizing blades, the grading impeller is fixedly sleeved on the rotating shaft, the grading impeller is positioned at the upper end of the movable fluted disc, and the grading impeller is positioned below the discharge outlet. Compared with the prior art, the utility model pulverizes the traditional Chinese medicinal materials which are extremely difficult to pulverize to the micron level, improves the pulverizing efficiency and pulverizing precision, can regulate and control the pulverizing granularity, and can effectively reduce the energy consumption.

title_en: Sewage treatment multistage sedimentation and dephosphorization integrated device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sewage treatment multistage precipitation and dephosphorization integrated device, and belongs to the technical field of sewage treatment. The utility model adopts the technical scheme that the sewage treatment multistage sedimentation and dephosphorization integrated device comprises a pretreatment tank, an anaerobic treatment tank, an anoxic treatment tank and an aerobic treatment tank which are sequentially communicated; the utility model combines the section change of a connecting pipe and the position optimization of an air inlet pipe to realize efficient aeration and gas-liquid mixing, reduce the use of chemical agents and promote the recovery rate of phosphorus, and simultaneously, the integrated structure reduces the occupied area and the sludge treatment cost, thereby having the advantages of improving the treatment efficiency, reducing the energy consumption, reducing the dependence on the chemical agents, optimizing the aeration effect and promoting the integration degree.

title_en: Cotton filling machine capable of preventing flying cotton
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cotton-fly-preventing cotton-filling machine, which belongs to the technical field of cotton-filling machines and comprises a frame body, wherein a cotton storage box is arranged at the top end of the frame body, a cover plate is arranged above the cotton storage box, a cotton inlet and a stirring motor are arranged on the upper surface of the cover plate, a stirring rod is arranged in the cotton storage box, a control panel is arranged on the outer side surface of the cotton storage box, a cotton filling unit is connected with a cotton outlet below the cotton storage box, and a cotton-fly-preventing unit and a conveying belt are sequentially arranged below the cotton filling unit. According to the anti-flying cotton filling machine, the anti-flying cotton filling unit is arranged, so that the influence of flying cotton on the working environment and operators can be effectively avoided.

title_en: Gas sampling device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of gas sampling, and discloses a gas sampling device which comprises a sampling device body, wherein a bracket is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the sampling device body, a filtering assembly is arranged on the sampling device body and comprises a circular ring mounting plate, and the circular ring mounting plate is fixedly arranged on the sampling device body. This gas sampling device, in order to make the device provide accurate reliable sample for subsequent analysis and detection, through being provided with filter unit, this subassembly cooperation motor passes through the connecting rod and drives power gear and rotate, the internal gear ring meshing on power gear and the cartridge filter, make the cartridge filter slowly rotate, the inboard multiunit filter plate of cartridge filter can preliminary filtration big granule impurity in the gas, install multiunit adsorption plate on the round bar between the filter plate, fine rod and the toper adsorption block of the round bar other end further adsorb tiny particle and harmful substance in the gas, the purity of sample gas has been improved.

title_en: On-line automatic cleaning device for ultrafiltration membrane group
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an on-line automatic cleaning device for an ultrafiltration membrane group, which comprises an ultrafiltration membrane group, wherein one end of the ultrafiltration membrane group is provided with a water inlet and a sewage outlet, the other end of the ultrafiltration membrane group is provided with a concentrated water outlet and a filtered water outlet, the water inlet is provided with a water inlet pipe, the water inlet pipe is provided with a water inlet pump and a water inlet valve, the sewage outlet is provided with a sewage pipe provided with a backwash discharge valve, the filtered water outlet is provided with a filtered water outlet pipe and a backwash water inlet pipe, the filtered water outlet pipe is provided with a chlorine removal component, the backwash water inlet pipe is provided with a backwash valve, the other end of the backwash water inlet pipe is connected with the water inlet pipe, the concentrated water outlet is provided with a concentrated water outlet pipe provided with a concentrated water drain valve, the other end of the concentrated water outlet pipe is connected with the sewage pipe, the air inlet pipe is provided with an air inlet valve, and the other end of the backwash water outlet pipe is connected with the sewage outlet. The utility model can wash out the pollutant deposited in the ultrafiltration membrane group with high efficiency, and effectively remove the chloride ions in the filtered water, and maintain the normal water production capacity of the ultrafiltration membrane group.

title_en: Multistage filtration wastewater recovery device for chemical fiber fabric production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multistage filtering wastewater recovery device for chemical fiber fabric production, which comprises a treatment cylinder, wherein a first treatment assembly is arranged at the upper end of the treatment cylinder, a second treatment assembly is arranged at the bottom end of the treatment cylinder, a controller is arranged at one side of the treatment cylinder, the first treatment assembly and the second treatment assembly are mutually matched, so that pollutants such as dye, auxiliary agent, fiber scraps, heavy metal ions and the like in chemical fiber fabric production wastewater can be effectively removed, the wastewater treatment efficiency is remarkably improved, the pollution to water is reduced, the ecological environment is protected, the device is compact in structure and small in occupied area, the operation cost and the space occupation of a factory are reduced, the efficient wastewater treatment is suitable for being carried out in a limited space, in addition, the device is provided with a detector and a controller, the wastewater treatment effect can be monitored in real time, the adjustment is carried out according to the requirement, the stability and the reliability of the treatment process are ensured, and finally the recycling of the treated water resource is realized through recycling.

title_en: Integrated pipeline flushing pressure testing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of hydraulic pressure, and discloses an integrated pipeline flushing pressure testing device which comprises a box body, a first oil way, a second oil way, a third oil way and a fourth oil way, wherein the input end of the first oil way is connected with the box body, the output end of the first oil way is provided with an oil outlet, the first oil way is provided with a flushing group and a pulse valve, the flushing group is connected with the pulse valve, the output end of the second oil way is connected with the box body, the input end of the second oil way is provided with an oil return port, the second oil way is provided with a deslagging filtering group, the input end of the third oil way is connected with the box body, the output end of the third oil way is connected with the oil outlet, the third oil way is provided with a high-pressure testing group, the input end and the output end of the fourth oil way are connected with the box body, and the fourth oil way is provided with a circulating motor pump group and a reverse osmosis dewatering filtering group which are arranged in series. The utility model integrates the functions of static pressure flushing, pulse flushing, high pressure test and cyclic water removal, and has simple equipment pipeline layout.

title_en: Inspection robot suitable for electric bicycle concentrated parking place
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a patrol robot suitable for a concentrated parking place of an electric bicycle, in particular to the field of patrol equipment of the electric bicycle, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the upper end of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a fence, the upper side of the fence is fixedly connected with a bracket, the electric sliding rail is characterized in that three electric sliding rails are connected to the lower side of the support in height, the inspection robot is slidingly connected to the lower side of the electric sliding rail in the middle of the support, and fire-fighting components are slidingly connected to the lower sides of the electric sliding rails on two sides of the support. According to the inspection robot suitable for the electric bicycle centralized parking place, the designed inspection robot can reciprocate on the upper side of a bicycle shed to monitor electric bicycle illegal charging and fire disaster, manual inspection is replaced, full-day energy monitoring is achieved, and the designed fire-fighting assembly can early warn in advance when the inspection robot monitors hidden hazards such as battery overheat and circuit aging, and the fire extinguisher is moved to a fire starting point to extinguish fire, so that small fire brewing and disaster are avoided.

title_en: Full-automatic reverse osmosis reuse water supply equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses full-automatic reverse osmosis reuse water supply equipment, which comprises a box body, wherein the top of the box body is provided with a filtering mechanism, the lower end of the inside of the box body is fixedly connected with a motor, the output end of the motor is fixedly connected with a stirring shaft, the outer side of the stirring shaft is fixedly connected with stirring blades from top to bottom, the inner side of the box body is fixedly connected with an RO (reverse osmosis) membrane, the lower end of the other side of the box body is fixedly connected with an ultrasonic generator, when the full-automatic reverse osmosis reuse water supply equipment is used, the stirring blades rotate impurity water in the box body through a driving motor, so that the permeation efficiency of reuse water can be improved immediately, and an ultrasonic generator is utilized to drive a transducer to carry out ultrasonic pyrolysis operation on the reuse water in the box body so as to decompose impurities in water, and further, the filtered impurities can be prevented from adhering to the RO reverse osmosis membrane, and normal use of the RO reverse osmosis membrane can be ensured.

title_en: Lighting equipment for electric power facility overhaul
abstract_en: The utility model discloses illumination equipment for electric power facility maintenance, which belongs to the technical field of electric power facility maintenance and comprises a bottom plate, wherein the top of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with an illumination assembly through a supporting mechanism, the illumination assembly comprises a shell, one end of the shell is fixedly connected with a lampshade, lamp discs are fixedly connected between inner walls of the shell, a heat dissipation mechanism is arranged in the shell and comprises a mounting strip fixedly connected between the inner walls of the shell, one side of the mounting strip is fixedly connected with a rotating motor, the output end of the rotating motor is connected with a rotating shaft through a coupling, a plurality of fan blades are fixedly connected onto the rotating shaft, and one end of the shell, which is far away from the lampshade, is fixedly provided with a filter screen. The lamp panel cooling device has the beneficial effects that the rotating motor drives the rotating shaft to drive the fan blades to rotate, so that the gas flowing speed in the shell is accelerated, the lamp panel is cooled conveniently, the filter screen is arranged at the end part of the shell, dust in the gas entering the shell is filtered through the filter screen, and the dust is prevented from adhering to the lamp panel, so that the heat dissipation efficiency of the lamp panel is prevented from being influenced.

title_en: Electronic information anti-interference device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electronic information anti-interference device, which belongs to the technical field of electronic information anti-interference devices and comprises a box body, wherein a box cover is arranged on the box body through bolts, a cross beam is fixedly connected in the box body, temperature detectors are arranged at the front end, the middle end and the tail end of the cross beam, a heat radiating component for directionally radiating elements in the box body is arranged at the top end of the box body, the electronic information anti-interference device collects heat field data in real time through a multi-point temperature detector and longitudinally drives a sliding block based on a double-shaft servo driving system, a first screw rod and a servo motor transversely drive the sliding block to realize two-dimensional positioning of a heat radiating fan, and the two-dimensional positioning of the heat radiating fan can be dynamically tracked by matching with intelligent control of a PLC (programmable logic controller), so that targeted heat radiation is implemented, the heat radiating efficiency is improved, the ineffective power consumption of the fan is reduced, and the problems of heat accumulation and energy consumption waste caused by adopting fixed heat radiation are reduced.

title_en: Green building roofing rainwater recycle device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rainwater recovery, in particular to a green building roof rainwater recovery device which comprises a water tank, a recovery mechanism arranged at one end of the water tank and a drainage mechanism arranged at the other end of the water tank, wherein the recovery mechanism is provided with a shell connected with the water tank, a filtering part provided with a first filter screen is arranged towards the water tank, one end of the shell, which is away from the filtering part, is provided with a liquid collecting part provided with a second filter screen, a collecting structure formed by a plurality of scrapers connected to the inner wall of the shell is rotationally connected with the shell, two adjacent scrapers are clamped with the inner wall of the shell to form a segmented cavity, and one side of the shell is provided with a pressure regulating structure towards the segmented cavity along the rotation direction of the collecting structure. The utility model aims to improve the rainwater recycling efficiency and ensure the rainwater recycling stability.

title_en: Sewage treatment device capable of deodorizing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sewage treatment device capable of deodorizing, and relates to the technical field of sewage treatment. The sewage treatment device capable of deodorizing comprises a sewage treatment box, wherein a water inlet pipe is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the left side of the sewage treatment box, one end of a water outlet pipe is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the right side of the sewage treatment box, a sewage collecting box is fixedly arranged at the other end of the water outlet pipe, a spraying assembly is arranged on the sewage treatment box and used for spraying a deodorizing agent into sewage to be treated, a filtering assembly is arranged at the front end of the sewage treatment box and used for filtering impurities in the sewage, the contact area of the deodorizing agent and the sewage is increased through the design of the spraying assembly, deodorizing efficiency is improved, sewage peculiar smell is effectively reduced, the filtering assembly can intercept impurities with different particle diameters in a grading mode, and the sewage purifying degree is remarkably improved.

title_en: Purification device for circulating cooling water of waste incineration power plant
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of purification devices, in particular to a purification device for circulating cooling water of a waste incineration power plant, which comprises a purification tank, an ultrasonic vibration mechanism, a water inlet mechanism, a water return mechanism and a filter screen, wherein the water inlet mechanism is arranged above the front end of the purification tank, a purification cavity is formed in the purification tank, the ultrasonic vibration mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the purification cavity, a separation cavity is formed in the front end of the purification cavity, and the water return cavity is formed in the rear end of the purification cavity.

title_en: Ozone mixed aeration river course treatment device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of ozone river treatment and discloses an ozone mixed aeration river treatment device, which comprises a floating plate, wherein an ozone generator is fixedly connected to the top of the floating plate, an aeration fan is fixedly connected to the top of the floating plate, a mixed air inlet aeration mechanism is arranged between the aeration fan and the ozone generator, a filtering mechanism is arranged outside the mixed air inlet aeration mechanism, the mixed air inlet aeration mechanism comprises a mixed air inlet assembly and an aeration assembly, a motor I is started through the arranged mixed air inlet aeration mechanism, so that ozone and air are conveyed into an air mixing bin to be mixed, meanwhile, a conical gear IV is synchronously driven to rotate in the rotation process of a limiting column, a conical gear III is further driven to rotate by the conical gear IV, a spiral conveying blade is synchronously driven to rotate by the conical gear III, ozone and air are uniformly mixed, gas turbulence is further forced, and the ozone dissolution rate is improved.

title_en: Sealing device for water treatment filter
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sealing device for a water treatment filter, which relates to the technical field of anaerobic tank sealing devices and comprises a tank body, wherein the left side of the tank body is provided with a mounting opening, the inside of the mounting opening is provided with a sealing cover plate, an opening and closing mechanism is arranged between the tank body and the sealing cover plate, the upper surface and the lower surface of the sealing cover plate are respectively provided with an aeration mechanism and a tank wall cleaning mechanism, the opening and closing mechanism comprises two mounting grooves respectively arranged on the front wall and the inner rear wall of the mounting opening, and the inner walls of the two sides of the front mounting groove are fixedly connected with a slide guide rod. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the opening and closing mechanism, when the tank body is required to be completely opened, the reciprocating screw rod is driven to rotate through the bevel gear under the operation of the motor, and under the conductive action of the guide sliding block and the guide sliding rod, the threaded block can drive the sealing cover plate to move left and right in the installation opening in a directional manner through the rotation of the reciprocating screw rod until the tank body is completely opened due to the left movement of the sealing cover plate, so that convenience is provided for opening and closing the oxidation tank.

title_en: Lifting device for ash removal of dust remover of vacuum refining furnace
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of gas cooling dust collectors of RH vacuum refining furnaces, and discloses a lifting device for dust removal of a dust collector of a vacuum refining furnace, which comprises an ash discharging pipeline device, a corrugated pipe, a sealing ring and the like. A straight pipe joint is arranged at the discharge port at the bottom of the ash discharging pipeline device, the discharge port is connected with an easy-to-discharge expansion joint, and the discharge port of the easy-to-discharge expansion joint is provided with an ash storage tank. The bellows is arranged in the middle of the surface of the conveniently-detached telescopic joint, the conveniently-detached telescopic joint and the surface of the feeding end of the ash storage tank are respectively provided with a first flange, the surface of the conveniently-detached telescopic joint is uniformly provided with an air cylinder, and the output end of the air cylinder is provided with a connecting block and is connected with the first flange above. The sealing ring is arranged on the periphery of the first flange. The device is driven by the air cylinder to enable the first flange to be tightly connected, so that leakage is avoided, the sealing ring and the limiting rail are arranged, the connection stability is improved, sealing is realized, an opening of the ash storage tank can be blocked to prevent dust emission during separation, the maintenance is convenient, and the air leakage point is reduced.

title_en: Multifunctional fire-fighting spray gun
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire-fighting tools, in particular to a multifunctional fire-fighting spray gun, which is hinged between a rod body and a mounting seat and can be locked relatively. The pressing mechanism can press the pressing end of the air injection bottle so that the air injection bottle can spray combustible gas or medicament, and under the condition of spraying the combustible gas, the ignition mechanism can adapt to the required ignition function in a fire attack through the configuration of the igniter.

title_en: Novel negative pressure thermal deoxidization water preparation device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of deoxygenated water preparation, and particularly discloses a novel negative pressure thermal deoxygenated water preparation device which comprises a deoxygenator, a circulating water injection system and a circulating water pump, wherein the circulating water injection system utilizes the Bernoulli principle, when high-speed fluid enters the injection system, a negative pressure area is formed through a nozzle and an expansion chamber, a steam vent is communicated with the expansion negative pressure area, and steam is attracted into the injection system. The circulating water is used as a power source, a low-pressure area is formed when the circulating water passes through a nozzle in the injection system, the emptying steam of the deaerator is pumped into the circulating water through the pipeline connection and is fully mixed with the circulating water to cool and condense into water, so that the circulating water system is supplemented, and meanwhile, when the absolute pressure of the deaerator is reduced from 120kPa to 90kPa by the pumping action of the circulating water injection system, the boiling point of the water is reduced from 104 ℃ to 96 ℃, and a large amount of water consumption and steam energy consumption are saved.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle airborne high-pressure fire extinguishing system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted high-pressure fire extinguishing system, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted high-pressure fire extinguishing system machine-mounted end assembly and an unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted high-pressure fire extinguishing system ground end assembly, wherein machine-mounted end equipment comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle main body, a photoelectric nacelle, a water spraying support, a water spraying pipe, an inclined strut and the like, the ground end equipment comprises a high-pressure water pump, a fire water belt and the like, the photoelectric nacelle and the water spraying support are connected with the unmanned aerial vehicle main body through a quick-release module at the top of the photoelectric nacelle and the water spraying support, the water spraying pipe is in threaded connection with the water spraying support, two ends of the fire water belt are respectively connected with a water inlet of the water spraying support and a water outlet of the high-pressure water pump, and a water inlet of the high-pressure water pump is connected with a water source. Compared with the prior art, the fire extinguishing device has the advantages of simple structure, quick-dismantling connection among all module units, long-time continuous water spraying on the premise of sufficient water source, high-altitude or initial fire extinguishing, high fire extinguishing efficiency, convenient operation, easy transportation, convenient maintenance and replacement and the like.

title_en: Colliery is dust device in pit
abstract_en: The utility model provides a coal mine underground dust falling device, which relates to the technical field of mine dust falling equipment and comprises a supporting frame, wherein a box body is arranged on the supporting frame, the bottom of the box body is connected with a dust collecting hopper, an upper partition plate is arranged in the box body, a cloth bag is arranged below the upper partition plate, an avoidance groove corresponding to the exhaust end of the cloth bag is formed in the upper partition plate, an air inlet is formed in one side of the box body and is positioned below the upper partition plate, a lower partition plate is arranged in the box body and is arranged between the cloth bag and the air inlet, a blowback pipe and a secondary dust removing unit are arranged above the upper partition plate in the box body, a partition plate assembly is further arranged in a region above the upper partition plate in the box body, the partition plate assembly divides the region into an upper chamber and a lower chamber, and the dust concentration in the coal mine underground can be effectively reduced through the arranged secondary dust removing unit, the working environment is improved, and the problem that a cloth bag dust remover in the pit is poor in long-term use effect is effectively solved.

title_en: NMP liquid recovery system
abstract_en: The utility model provides an NMP liquid recovery system, wherein the output end of a drying oven of a coating machine is connected with the input end of a filtering device through a first air supply fan, the output end of the filtering device is connected with one end of a first heat exchange system of a heat exchanger, the other end of the first heat exchange system of the heat exchanger is connected with one end of a regeneration air supply and return device through a first cooling device, the other end of the regeneration air supply and return device is respectively connected with the drying oven of the coating machine, the first cooling device is connected with one end of the regeneration air supply and return device, one end of a second heat exchange system of the heat exchanger is connected with the input end of the drying oven of the coating machine through a first air exhaust fan, and the filtering device is arranged between the first air supply fan and the heat exchanger, and comprises a medium-efficiency filter and a ceramic multi-tube dust remover, so that particles with the particle size of more than 0.1 mu m are effectively intercepted, the blocking risk of a plate heat exchanger is greatly reduced, the fouling is reduced, and the NMP recovery rate is stepwise recovered through the arrangement of the first cooling device and the second cooling device.

title_en: Induction garbage bin
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of garbage cans and discloses an induction garbage can, which comprises a can body and a can cover, wherein one end of the can cover is hinged to the top of the can body, the top of the can cover is hinged to a flip cover, the bottom of the other end of the can cover is fixedly connected with an unlocking module, the inside of the unlocking module is movably connected with a push block, one end of the push block is provided with a lock tongue, one end of the lock tongue is movably connected to the inside of the unlocking module, the other end of the lock tongue is movably connected to the inside of the can body, one side of the limit block is provided with a reset spring, and the push block is pressed to push the lock tongue to move so that one end of the lock tongue is separated from the inside of the unlocking module, thereby unlocking the can cover, one end of the can cover rotates around the top of the can body, and further the top of the can be opened, so that a garbage bag can be conveniently replaced.

title_en: Bottom-fired heating furnace bottom structure radiating by using wall plates
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a bottom structure of a bottom-fired heating furnace radiating by using a wallboard. The air duct system comprises an air distribution shell arranged on a heating furnace bottom plate, an air duct air inlet and an air duct air outlet, wherein a cavity is formed between the air distribution shell and the heating furnace bottom plate, the air duct air outlet is communicated with a combustion air inlet of the burner, a distribution plate unit is arranged in the cavity formed by the air distribution shell and the heating furnace bottom plate, a first air valve is arranged in the air duct air outlet, the air duct system further comprises a filter screen plate arranged at an inlet of the air duct air inlet, and a cleaning device arranged on the air duct air inlet. The utility model can reduce the temperature of the furnace bottom shell, avoid the condition of furnace bottom overheating under the condition of natural windless, recycle heat dissipation loss, improve the working efficiency of the heating furnace, reduce the usage amount of the lining material of the furnace bottom of the radiation section, and reduce the one-time investment and maintenance cost.

title_en: Induction start-stop type classified garbage station
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of garbage recycling devices, in particular to an induction start-stop type classified garbage station, which comprises a garbage booth, a plurality of door plates which are embedded in the side wall of the garbage booth and distributed in a linear array, and garbage cans which are placed in the garbage booth and are used for loading garbage and correspond to the door plates one by one, wherein a window door is arranged in each door plate, each window door comprises a mounting box, the mounting box is detachably connected with the corresponding door plate through two symmetrically distributed mounting assemblies, a baffle curtain for shielding a garbage throwing window, a rotating shaft for winding the baffle curtain and a motor for driving the rotating shaft to rotate, the rotating shaft and the motor are both positioned in the mounting box, the baffle curtain penetrates through the mounting box, and an induction switch for controlling the motor to be started and stopped is arranged on the outer side of each door plate. The induction start-stop type classified garbage station is provided with a start-stop mode of opening and closing a window through rolling and unreeling of the baffle, and the problem that accumulated garbage interferes with the start-stop process of a throwing window is avoided.

title_en: Safe and efficient dry quenching flue gas dust removal system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a safe and efficient dry quenching flue gas dust removal system which comprises a desulfurizer, a dust filter and a bag-type dust remover, wherein the desulfurizer comprises a gas distribution box, a gas inlet box and a reaction box which are sequentially arranged from bottom to top, a plurality of vertical pipes are arranged between the gas inlet box and the reaction box, a central pipe is coaxially arranged at the lower part of each vertical pipe, a spiral guide plate is arranged between each central pipe and each vertical pipe, the lower end of each central pipe penetrates through the gas inlet box and then is communicated with the gas distribution box, a smoke inlet pipe is arranged on the gas inlet box, a smoke feeding pipe is arranged at the bottom of the gas distribution box, a material feeding pipe is arranged on the smoke feeding pipe, gas inlets and gas outlets are respectively arranged at two opposite ends of the dust filter, a plurality of pairs of filter screens are arranged in the dust filter between the gas inlets and the gas outlets at intervals, openings are formed in the dust filter above the filter, the openings are connected with sealing covers through bolts, and the gas outlets are communicated with the bag-type dust remover. In conclusion, the utility model has the advantages of good dust removal effect, high desulfurization efficiency, convenient filter screen replacement, safety and high efficiency.

title_en: Water purifying device capable of retaining mineral substances
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of water purification, in particular to a water purifying device for reserving mineral matters, which comprises a nanofiltration filter core, a reverse osmosis filter core and a rear filter core. After water passes through the nanofiltration filter core, mineral substances enriched with multivalent ions in the concentrated water, the filtered water of the nanofiltration filter core is filtered through the reverse osmosis filter core, the generated filtered water is pure water, and the filtered water of the reverse osmosis filter core and the concentrated water enriched with the mineral substances of the nanofiltration filter core are mixed and filtered through the rear filter core, so that the mineral substance water can be obtained. The water purifying device capable of retaining beneficial elements such as calcium and magnesium in water can retain beneficial elements such as sodium ions, sodium ions are reduced in concentration due to the fact that filtered water of the nanofiltration filter element is filtered by the reverse osmosis filter element, sodium ions are prevented from exceeding standard, bicarbonate concentration can be reduced, and scaling of water after heating is prevented.

title_en: Recovery plant for industrial wastewater sludge
abstract_en: The utility model provides recovery equipment for industrial wastewater and sludge, which relates to the technical field of sewage treatment and comprises a support frame, wherein a first filter pressing belt is arranged at the lower end of the interior of the support frame, a second filter pressing belt is arranged at the upper end of the interior of the support frame, a flushing mechanism is arranged in the middle of the interior of the support frame, and one ends, far away from each other, of the first filter pressing belt and the second filter pressing belt are respectively arranged in the flushing mechanism. When the device works, cleaning water enters the diversion cylinder through the liquid inlet pipe, the impeller is pushed to drive the rotating shaft and the first bevel gear to rotate, then the transmission shaft and the cleaning hair roller are driven to synchronously rotate through the meshing transmission with the second bevel gear, meanwhile, the cleaning water enters the diversion box through the second connecting pipe, the surface of the filter pressing belt is flushed under high pressure by the spray head, the rotating cleaning hair roller can deeply enter the filter pressing belt to filter Kong Guachu refractory impurities, and the cleaning hair roller is matched with the first scraping plate and the second scraping plate to scrape the surface of the filter pressing belt for the second time, so that triple cleaning flows of flushing, brushing and scraping are formed.

title_en: Acetone water absorption system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an acetone water absorption system, including absorption tower T1, circulating pump P1, heat exchanger E2, desorber T2, delivery pump P2, cooler E3, condenser E4, acetone storage tank V1 and delivery pump P3, absorption tower T1 passes through the import of pipe connection circulating pump P1, cooler E1's import and heat exchanger E2's import are connected respectively through the pipeline to circulating pump P1's export, the utility model relates to an acetone water absorption technical field specifically, relates to an acetone water absorption system, and whole device is based on absorption desorption coupling technology, has formed exhaust purification, resource recovery and absorbent multiplexing closed loop system, has realized the cyclic utilization of material, utilizes the desorber to separate out the acetone in the absorbent, stores in the acetone storage tank after the condenser condensation, and the rethread delivery pump sends acetone back between the car and applies mechanically, has realized the recovery recycle of acetone resource.

title_en: Self-cleaning cloth bag dust remover of rice double-roller polishing machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rice polishing equipment, in particular to a self-cleaning cloth bag dust remover of a rice double-roller polishing machine, which comprises a double-roller polishing machine body provided with an air extractor, wherein a cloth bag dust removing mechanism is arranged in front of the double-roller polishing machine body and comprises a base, a cleaning assembly, a plurality of upright rods and a cloth bag, the cloth bag is communicated with the output end of the air extractor through a connecting sleeve, the cleaning assembly comprises a top plate and a rotating motor, the tail end of the output shaft of the rotating motor is coaxially connected with a vertical shaft, and a deflector rod is arranged outside the vertical shaft. This self-cleaning sack cleaner of rice twin-roll burnishing machine through setting up clean subassembly, can drive the poking bar and scrape the sack inner wall at equipment operation in-process, need not extra manual operation and can realize the dust clearance to in time get rid of the dust of sack inner wall adhesion.

title_en: Bag cage for special process of titanium alloy
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of bag cages, and discloses a bag cage for a titanium alloy special process, which comprises a bag cage top ring, wherein a first bag cage is fixed at the bottom end of the bag cage top ring, a second bag cage is sleeved on the outer side surface of the first bag cage, a third bag cage is arranged below the first bag cage and is arranged in the second bag cage, the second bag cage with the radius of an inner ring being the same as the radius of an outer ring of the first bag cage is sleeved on the outer side surface of the first bag cage, and the first bag cage and the second bag cage are clamped together through the clamping ring, and meanwhile, the third bag cage with the same shape as the first bag cage is sleeved inside the second bag cage, so that the clamping ring can clamp the first bag cage, the second bag cage and the third bag cage through the clamping ring, the positions among the bag cages can be flexibly adjusted, and the problem that the length of the bag cage cannot be adjusted more finely in a mode of splicing the bag cages is solved.

title_en: Air cleaner
abstract_en: An air cleaner is provided that may include a main body having at least one cylindrical filter and at least one filter frame that forms a mounting space for the at least one filter; and a cylindrical case coupled to an outside of the main body, the cylindrical case having at least one suction inlet through which air is suctioned toward the at least one filter, so that air may be suctioned in 360-degree directions. If the cylindrical case is opened, the at least one filter may be extracted to the outside in a radial direction from the mounting space, thereby facilitating attachment/detachment of the at least one filter.

title_en: Air filter cleaner processing
abstract_en: An air purifier and a filter cleaner are provided that can use an efficient air- filter cleaning procedure. The air filter can advantageously be placed in its operational position during the cleaning. The filter cleaner is configured to perform mechanical cleaning (409) of the air-filter by making a cleaning5 member contact the surface of the air-filter for a first period of time, and to perform sterilization (411) of the air-filter by applying UV light on the air- filter for a second period of time. Hereby an efficient cleaning of an air-filter can be achieved that removes dust and kills bacteria on the air-filter. The air- filter does not need to be removed during the cleaning and sterilization10 process.

title_en: Predictive tool for monitoring ro and nf membranes
abstract_en: A predictive system for monitoring fouling of membranes of a desalination or water softening plant comprising ultrafiltration (UF) membranes, reverse osmosis (RO) membranes, and/or nanofiltration (NF) membranes, the system including one or more UF skids comprising a plurality of UF units, each UF unit containing therein a plurality of UF membranes; one or more RO/NF skids comprising one or more RO/NF arrays, wherein each of the one or more RO/NF arrays comprises a plurality of RO units, with each RO unit containing therein a plurality of RO membranes, a plurality of NF units, with each NF unit containing therein a plurality of NF membranes; or a combination thereof; UF sensors and/or RO/NF sensors; and a controller comprising a processor in signal communication with the UF sensors and/or the RO/NF sensors.

title_en: Reactor for the treatment of wastewater
abstract_en: Information on abstract not available

title_en: Method and apparatus for separating a synthesis gas by cryogenic distillation
abstract_en: In a process for separating a mixture (3) containing carbon monoxide, hydrogen and carbon dioxide, the mixture cooled in a heat exchanger (9) is contacted by a stream of liquid methanol (13) at a temperature below -50°C to produce carbon dioxide enriched methanol (17) and a carbon dioxide depleted gas (15) relative to the cooled mixture, the carbon dioxide depleted gas is cooled in the heat exchanger and is sent to a separation unit (7) to produce a carbon monoxide enriched stream (18) and a hydrogen enriched stream (19) and the streams enriched in carbon monoxide and hydrogen are heated in the heat exchanger by exchanging heat with the mixture.

title_en: Catalytic fuel tank inerting system
abstract_en: A fuel tank inerting system (200) is disclosed. In addition to a fuel tank (202), the system includes a catalytic reactor (222) with an inlet, an outlet, a reactive flow path between the inlet and the outlet, and a catalyst on the reactive flow path. The catalytic reactor is arranged to receive fuel from the fuel tank (202) and air from an air source, and to react the fuel and air along the reactive flow path to generate an inert gas. The system also includes an inert gas flow path from the catalytic reactor (222) to the fuel tank (202). The system also includes a non-uniform catalyst composition along the reactive flow path.

title_en: Arrangement and method for transferring heat from a wet scrubber to a district heating network
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an arrangement for transferring heat. The arrangement comprises a wet scrubber (101) configured to transfer heat from waste gas to scrubbing liquid, a first heat exchanger (104) having a first side coupled to the wet scrubber (101) and a second side coupled to a return side and a supply side of a district heating network, means for conveying scrubbing liquid from the wet scrubber (101) through the first side of the first heat exchanger (104) to the wet scrubber (101), a heat accumulator (107) containing heat storage liquid, and a second heat exchanger (108) having a first side coupled to a top part and a bottom part of the heat accumulator (107) and a second side coupled to the return side and the supply side of the district heating network. The invention also relates to a method for transferring heat.

title_en: Industrial wastewater treatment system and method for garment finishing, jeans and denim industry
abstract_en: Water reclamation system that comprises a primary module (1) with separation means (291) and a dirty water tank (19), a secondary module (2) with a treatment tank (29), ozone generating means (293), a recirculation circuit (34, 36) and a catalyst filter (37), a tertiary module (3) with filtration means (292), and a treated water tank (62). The system may also comprise a desalination module (4), a turbulence promoter (122) inside the treatment tank (29) and/or water electrical conductivity measuring means for water electrical conductivity control in the treated water tank (62). The water reclamation system has overall measures smaller than 15 meters of length, 4 meters of width or 3 meters of height and the nominal design flow of water to be treated is between 0.5 and 25 m3/h. A corresponding water treatment method is also provided.

title_en: Apparatus for the separate collection of rubbish
abstract_en: An apparatus for the separate collection of rubbish comprises a containing structure (11) provided with an internal compartment (12) in which there are a plurality of rubbish collection containers (13) and at least a first and a second aperture (14a, 14b) for access to the internal compartment (12) from the outside, in order to introduce the rubbish.

title_en: Calibration of an x-ray imaging system
abstract_en: There is provided a calibration phantom for an x-ray imaging system having an x-ray source and an x-ray detector. The calibration phantom (5) comprises a combination of geometric objects (1, 2, 3) of at least three different types and/or compositions including: -a first object (1) located in the middle, comprising a first material; -a plurality of second objects (2) arranged around the periphery of the first object, at least a subset of the second objects comprising a second material different than the first material, wherein the first object is relatively larger than the second objects; -a plurality of third objects (3) arranged around the periphery of the first object and/or around the periphery of at least a subset of the second objects, at least a subset of the third objects comprising a third material different than the first material and the second material, wherein the third objects are relatively smaller than the second objects.

title_en: A filter element for mounting in an air cleaner housing of a vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a filter element for mounting in an air cleaner housing of a vehicle. The filter element comprises a circumferential filtering wall through which air is allowed to enter. The filter element also comprises a first end and an open second end for fluidly connecting the filter element to a turbo. The open second end is located opposite the first end. The circumferential filtering wall extends from the first end towards the open second end. The filter element further comprises a resonator. The entire resonator is encircled by the circumferential filtering wall such that air entering through the circumferential filtering wall passes on the outside of the resonator to and through the open second end.

title_en: Method for recovering metal ions from industrial waste water, and use associated therewith of a complexing agent
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for recovering metal ions from industrial waste water by: - bringing the industrial waste water into contact with siderophores, thereby producing a metal ion-siderophore complex, characterised in that the siderophores are covalently immobilised on a support material by means of a linker, the linker containing a polyethylene glycol chain and said linker having a mass of 2000-3500 Da, and also relates to the use, in this method, of a complexing agent having a support material, on which siderophores are covalently immobilised by means of a linker, the linker containing a polyethylene glycol chain and said linker having a mass of 2000-3500 Da.

title_en: Readout circuit for pixelized electron detector
abstract_en: A method of determining a number of charged particles incident on a detector within a period may include generating a first signal that is based on a charged particle impacting a sensing element of the detector, performing processing using the first signal based on a predetermined characteristic of a charged particle arrival event on the detector, and outputting a count signal based on the processing.

title_en: A pressure swing adsorption process for producing hydrogen and carbon dioxide
abstract_en: A pressure swing adsorption process (PSA) comprising the following steps: feeding an input gas containing H 2 , CO 2  and impurities through a CO 2  adsorbent material in a pressure vessel under a high pressure; withdrawing a first H 2 -rich product gas due to adsorption of CO 2  in the adsorbent material; setting the pressure to an intermediate pressure causing the adsorbent material to release a second gas stream; passing a CO 2 -rich purge stream through the adsorbent material, obtaining a purge gas; setting the pressure to a sub-atmospheric low pressure, so that a CO 2 -rich product gas is released under vacuum by the adsorbent material; re-pressurizing the vessel to said high pressure; said steps being performed cyclically in a pressure vessel or in a plurality of parallel pressure vessels of a multiple vessel setup.
