title_en: Culture systems and methods of using same
abstract_en: Culture systems and methods of using same. The systems include a housing defining an inner space. The inner space includes a headspace and at least a portion of a reservoir. A surface for immobilizing cells is moveable between the headspace and the reservoir. The systems can be used for coculturing methanotrophs and phototrophs for processing biogas and wastewater, particularly from anaerobic digesters.

title_en: Renewable energy use in oil shale retorting
abstract_en: A method of retorting oil shale is provided, comprising: continuously feeding oil shale into a retorting unit; heating the retorting unit using renewable electrical energy; converting the oil-shale kerogen into kerogen oil; conveying a cross-flow sweep gas across a moving bed of the oil shale, to carry the kerogen oil out of the retorting unit; recovering the kerogen oil; and recovering spent oil shale. The combination of electrical heating and cross-flow retorting achieves uniform heating to optimize the production of hydrocarbons. A system for retorting oil shale is also provided, comprising: a retorting unit; an inlet for continuously feeding oil shale; electrical-energy elements within the retorting unit; an inlet for conveying a crossflow sweep gas through the retorting unit; and an outlet for the cross-flow sweep gas carrying the kerogen oil. The principles of the invention may be applied to  ex situ  systems,  in situ  systems, or hybrid systems.

title_en: Battery rack and power storage device
abstract_en: Disclosed is a battery rack for effectively preventing the spread of a fire or heat when the fire or thermal runaway occurs while in use. To achieve the object, the battery rack according to the present disclosure includes a plurality of battery modules arranged in a vertical direction, a rack case including a receiving part having an internal space that is open to a side to receive each of the plurality of battery modules, and a movement part configured to discharge the battery module having a rise in internal temperature above a predetermined temperature, and a tray configured to receive the discharged battery module.

title_en: Synergetic system and method for waste treatment
abstract_en: A synergetic system for waste treatment is provided. The synergetic system includes a waste treatment system configured to perform biological treatment of waste. Additionally, the synergetic system includes a gas purification system configured to purify exhaust gas generated during the biological treatment of the waste. The synergetic system further includes a feeding system configured to feed excess heat from the gas purification system back to the waste treatment system. The waste treatment system is further configured to use the fed back excess heat for the biological treatment of the waste.

title_en: Exhaust after-treatment system for converting nox emissions in exhaust gases from an engine
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an exhaust aftertreatment system, EATS, (20) for converting NOx emissions in exhaust gases from an engine (15). The EATS comprises: a fluid channel (40) for providing a fluid pathway for the exhaust gases; a selective catalytic reduction, SCR, catalyst (32) arranged in the fluid channel, the SCR catalyst being configured to store ammonia; an injector (34) configured to inject a reductant for providing ammonia to the SCR catalyst, the injector being arranged upstream of the SCR catalyst; a fluid flow inducer (56, 58) configured to cause an induced fluid flow in at least a part of the fluid channel when the engine is turned off; and a controlling apparatus (17) configured to precondition the EATS prior to engine start by injecting the reductant into the fluid channel, and transport the reductant into the SCR catalyst by the induced fluid flow to store ammonia in the SCR catalyst.

title_en: Method and apparatus for prolonging continuous operation period of methanol-to-olefins water washing process
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a method and apparatus for prolonging a continuous operation period of a methanol-to-olefins water washing process, and provides a method for prolonging a continuous operation period of a methanol-to-olefins water washing process. The method comprises the following steps: (i) performing micro cyclone treatment on methanol-to-olefins washing water; (ii) delivering the washing water subjected to micro cyclone treatment and oil removal to a fluidized bed separator for treatment; (iii) adjusting the backwash flow to release the intercepted catalyst powder and empty the dirt holding capacity of a pore; (iv) performing three-phase separation on a gas-liquid-solid mixture subjected to backwash, returning the obtained filter media to a particle bed layer, and respectively discharging a backwashing liquid a backwashing gas which comprise a catalyst; and (v) after the backwash is ended, switching the fluidized bed separator to a normal working state, completing the active regeneration of the particle bed layer, and continuing to operate. Also provided is an apparatus for prolonging a continuous operation period of a methanol-to-olefins water washing process.

title_en: Acidic gas adsorbent, structure provided with acidic gas adsorbent, acidic gas adsorption device, acidic gas recovery device, method for producing acidic gas adsorbent, and sheet-like structure
abstract_en: The present invention provides a new acidic gas adsorbent suitable for adsorption of acidic gas. An acidic gas adsorbent 10 of the present invention includes a porous sheet 1 including a polymer P. The polymer P has an amino group. The porous sheet 1 has a three-dimensional network skeleton composed of the polymer P. A structure 15 of the present invention includes the acidic gas adsorbent 10 and an air flow path 14. An acidic gas adsorption device 200 of the present invention includes an adsorption part 221 having a gas inlet 222 and a gas outlet 223. The adsorption part 221 contains the acidic gas adsorbent 10.

title_en: Membrane bioreactor, method of operating a membrane bioreactor, and use of a membrane bioreactor
abstract_en: Membrane bioreactor (2) for treating of sewage that includes a first and second bioreaction vessel (4, 6). The first bioreaction vessel (4) includes a first vessel wall (14) for enclosing an internal first vessel space. The second bioreaction vessel (6) includes a second vessel wall (26) for enclosing an internal second vessel space. The first vessel wall (14) includes a convex first peripheral vessel wall part and a first inner vessel wall part (22). The second vessel wall (26) includes a convex second peripheral vessel wall part and a second inner vessel wall part (30). The first vessel wall (14) and the second vessel wall (26) are mechanically connected to each other by means of a vessel connection structure (90). The vessel connection structure (90) positions the first and second peripheral vessel wall parts relative to each other during the treating of sewage.

title_en: Internal combustion engine
abstract_en: The present invention is directed to an internal combustion engine having at least one cylinder, preferably a large vessel engine with at least one cylinder having an inner diameter of at least 200mm, and to a method for operating an internal combustion engine. The Internal combustion engine (1) having at least one cylinder (2), preferably a large vessel engine with at least one cylinder having an inner diameter of at least 200mm, comprises an LNG supply system (10) having an LNG tank (11) for hosting LNG, preferably at a temperature of below -150°C, and further comprises an exhaust gas cooling system (20). The exhaust gas cooling system (20) has a first cooling stage (21) for cooling down exhaust gas, preferably adapted to use water, for example sea water, as a cooling medium, a second cooling stage (22) for cooling exhaust gas, preferably to a temperature of -100°C to -110°C, arranged downstream the first cooling stage (21) and a third cooling stage (23) for further cooling exhaust gas, preferably to a temperature of -125°C to - 140°C, such that CO 2  is frozen out from the exhaust gas, and frozen CO 2  is separated from residual exhaust gas, arranged downstream the second cooling stage (22). The second cooling stage (22) comprises at least one second stage heat exchanger (32) and the third cooling stage (23) comprises at least one third stage heat exchanger (33). The third cooling stage (23) comprises a first outlet (24) for frozen CO 2  and a second outlet (25) for residual exhaust gas. At least one of the at least one second stage heat exchanger (32) and/or at least one of the at least one third stage heat exchanger (33) are adapted to use cold energy of LNG, preferably released from the LNG tank.

title_en: Underdrain filtered water collection systems with winged screen diffusers
abstract_en: An underdrain filtered water collection system includes: a pair of opposing drainpipes, each drainpipe having a plurality of collection drains; and a diffuser screen. The diffuser screen can slide within an outlet in each of the collection drains. A diffuser screen for a pressure vessel containing filter media includes: a screen pipe; a solid plate coupled to a base of the screen pipe; and a winged diffuser arranged around an outer circumference of the solid plate. The winged diffuser includes a plurality of foldable wings. The screen pipe includes a mesh screen having preconfigured interstices therethrough. Feed water flows through the screen pipe where it is directed by an inner surface of the solid plate to flow in a diffused flow through the interstices of the mesh screen and the wings.

title_en: A process for the nitric oxide abatement through biological treatments
abstract_en: A process for the nitric oxide abatement through biological treatments, which specifically relates to a method for removing NOx gases from a gas stream (4) and comprises: • i) contacting the gas stream (4) with a solvent system which comprises a non-aqueous phase liquid (NAP) that is capable of acting as NOx gas-liquid mass transfer vector; and • ii) subjecting the solvent system of step i) to microbial denitrification, wherein NOx is selected from nitric oxide (NO), nitrogen dioxide (NO 2 ), and a mixture thereof, and the NAP has a molecular weight from 150 to 550 g/mol and a boiling point from 400 to 700 K. It also relates to the use of the NAP for removing NOx gases from a gas stream.

title_en: Method and integrated system for capturing carbon
abstract_en: A method for capturing carbon is provided. The method may comprise a process cycle of: a carbonization process, comprising enriching a feed comprising an aqueous medium with carbon from a carbon dioxide source to form a carbon-rich aqueous medium comprising carbonate ions, and a decarbonization process, comprising removing carbon from the carbon-rich aqueous medium by treating the carbon-rich aqueous medium with a cation capable of forming an insoluble carbonate with the carbonate ions, and removing the insoluble carbonate to form a carbon-deficient aqueous medium; wherein the method comprises carrying out the process cycle for multiple times, with the carbon-deficient aqueous medium of a preceding stage making up the feed for the enriching in a subsequent stage, wherein each of the multiple times uses one or more of (a) a different carbon dioxide source, (b) a different pH, and (c) a different cation.

title_en: Propulsion system for an aircraft
abstract_en: A propulsion system for an aircraft includes a hydrogen fuel system (52) supplying hydrogen fuel to the combustor (30) through a fuel flow path. A condenser (80) extracts water (114) from an exhaust gas flow (55) and includes a plurality of spiral passages (100) disposed within a collector (102). The spiraling passages generate a transverse pressure gradient to direct water (114) out of the exhaust gas flow (55) toward the collector (102).

title_en: High-efficiency advanced oxidation process system and method for reducing disinfection by-products in swimming pool water
abstract_en: An advanced oxidation process (AOP) system for reducing disinfection by-products (DBPs) in swimming pool water. The system comprises an air dryer for removing moisture from ambient air, a feed gas line for transferring the dried air to an UV-based ozone generator, and a treatment conduit with a UV-based ozone generator for treating the swimming pool water. The UV-based ozone generator includes UV lamps emitting UV light to produce ozone and hydroxyl radicals. The treatment conduit receives filtered pool water, treats it with the generated ozone as well as hydroxyl radicals to reduce DBPs below 0.3 ppm, and returns the treated water to the pool. The parallel arrangement of UV lamps in the UV-based ozone generator maximizes ozone production. Flow control valves optimize water flow rate through the treatment conduit. The system efficiently reduces DBPs, improves water quality, and enhances swimmer safety and comfort.

title_en: NOx SENSOR DIAGNOSTICS IN HEAVY-DUTY MOTOR VEHICLE ENGINES
abstract_en: A heavy-duty truck has a diesel engine, an exhaust after-treatment system, and an engine control unit. The exhaust after-treatment system includes a close-coupled selective catalytic reduction system and an underbody selective catalytic reduction system, a first NO x  sensor upstream of the close-coupled selective catalytic reduction system, a second NO x  sensor between the two selective catalytic reduction systems, and a third NO x  sensor downstream of the underbody selective catalytic reduction system. The engine control unit may perform methods allowing intrusive diagnostics to be performed on exhaust gas NO x  sensors using the selective catalytic reduction systems during normal operation of the heavy-duty truck.

title_en: Treatment of biogas by pressure swing adsorption
abstract_en: A process is provided for purification of biogas to produce biomethane. The biogas is treated in a pressure swing adsorption unit to remove carbon dioxide and water. Other impurities including oxygen, hydrogen and carbon monoxide may be removed by an additional adsorption bed. The adsorption beds may be single stage or two-stage VPSA or PSA adsorption beds.

title_en: Exhaust gas purification catalyst
abstract_en: An exhaust gas purification catalyst disclosed herein includes: a catalyst layer 20 including a lower catalyst layer 22 and an upper catalyst layer 24. A lower-layer front portion A containing Pd is provided on the upstream side of the lower catalyst layer 22, and a lower-layer rear portion B containing at least one of Pd and Pt is provided on the downstream side thereof. Further, an upper-layer front portion C containing Rh is provided on the upstream side of the upper catalyst layer 24, and an upper-layer rear portion D containing Rh is provided on the downstream side thereof. The lower-layer front portion A, the lower-layer rear portion B, the upper-layer front portion C, and the upper-layer rear portion D each have individually set CeO 2  content. Furthermore, in this exhaust gas purification catalyst, a NO X  storage layer 30 including a NO X  storage material and Pt is formed closer to the partition wall 14 side than the upper catalyst layer 24 from the standpoint of achieving both three-way performance and NO X  storage performance. As a result, it is possible to provide an exhaust gas purification catalyst that can exhibit adequate purification performance according to the operation state of an internal combustion engine.

title_en: Apparatus and process for steam reforming
abstract_en: An apparatus and process for steam reforming can be configured to produce at least one product with reduced carbon dioxide and/or nitrogen oxide emissions. Some embodiments can be better adapted for retrofitting a pre-existing steam reforming process while other embodiments can be better adapted for use in a newly constructed facility. Embodiments can be configured to utilize a synthetic air oxidant to provide combustion that results in formation of a flue gas having relatively high carbon dioxide concentrations that may also have low nitrogen and low nitrogen oxide concentrations. A control system can be configured for utilization in such embodiments to control the steam reforming process and/or oxidant formation process as well. Some embodiments can also be configured to provide carbon dioxide recovery that can permit recovery of a second product stream comprised of carbon dioxide.

title_en: Method and apparatus for removing aluminum residues from an extrusion die
abstract_en: A method for removing aluminum residues from at least one extrusion die, comprising the steps of: (i) introducing an extrusion die containing aluminum residues into a reaction vessel of an autoclave; (ii) adding to the extrusion die an aqueous solution in the vessel, preheated to a temperature greater than or equal to 80°C, of sodium hydroxide (NaOH) at a concentration comprised between 12% by weight and 30% by weight; wherein the aqueous solution is in a quantity sufficient to allow complete immersion of the extrusion die in the solution; (iii) maintaining in the autoclave vessel a temperature comprised between 85°C and 165°C and a pressure comprised between 100 and 400 kPa, obtaining the conversion of the aluminum residues into sodium aluminate and hydrogen. The invention also relates to an apparatus (1) for removing aluminum residues from at least one extrusion die, comprising: at least one reaction vessel (2) for immersing at least one extrusion die (M) comprising aluminum residues in a bath containing an aqueous solution of NaOH to obtain the conversion of the aluminum residues to sodium aluminate and hydrogen, means (3) for feeding the aqueous solution of NaOH into the reaction vessel (2), and means (4) for heating the aqueous solution of NaOH, which are functionally associated with at least one of the feeding means (3) and the reaction vessel (2).

title_en: Air purification
abstract_en: A filter for air purification, the filter 1 comprises a filter element 10 comprising one or more layers 11, wherein at least one layer is formed from a first porous body comprising titanium dioxide, the filter element further comprising copper 13 and silver 14. The filter 1 may include a frame 12 and the layers may be layers of mesh 11 interwoven with the copper 13 and silver 14. A first side of the filter may be exposed to UV light, of a frequency of 254 nm. The layers are preferably offset with respect to an adjacent layer to provide an irregular hole distribution or tortuous air path through the layers thus providing an increased surface area which is advantageous for trapping bacteria and viruses and provides for photocatalytic oxidation. The filter 1, may be used in conjunction with appliances, such as air purifiers and air conditioning units, where there is movement of natural air passing through the filter element in a single direction.

title_en: Exhaust gas aftertreatment system
abstract_en: An exhaust gas aftertreatment system 100 comprising an introduction conduit 107 is cantered on a conduit centre axis 105. A dosing module 110 is coupled to the introduction conduit and includes an injector 118. The injector is configured to provide a treatment fluid into the introduction conduit and is defined by an injection axis 119. A mixer 136 is disposed within the introduction conduit and includes a mixer body 138. A perforated dividing plate 202 is coupled to the introduction conduit and comprises a perforated dividing plate body 203. The perforated dividing plate is centred on a perforated dividing plate transverse axis (206,fig.14). The perforated dividing plate has a plurality of perforations (208,fig.14) extending through the perforated dividing plate body. The perforations define a perforated area (207,fig.14) which is centred on a perforated area transverse axis (211,fig.14) that is offset from the perforated dividing plate transverse axis.

title_en: Incinerating system
abstract_en: The present invention provides a fuel incinerating system comprising a fuel injector, a multi-stage fuel-air mixing device comprising a plurality of fuel intake tubes stacked vertically and configured to provide annular gaps between one or more of the vertically stacked fuel intake tubes to entrain ambient air to form a fuel-air mixture; and a combustor in communication with the fuel-air mixing device and defining a combustion chamber and in communication with an ignition source. The combustor is configured to impede flow of the fuel-air mixture through the combustion chamber to achieve a desired retention time of the fuel-air mixture within the combustion chamber to achieve substantially complete combustions of the fuel.

title_en: Methane fermentation method of poultry manure, and production method of poultry manure fertilizer
abstract_en: To provide a methane fermentation method capable of stably carrying out methane fermentation of poultry manure using a simple facility, and a production method of a poultry manure fertilizer, capable of producing a poultry manure fertilizer at a low cost from a methane fermentation residue produced by the methane fermentation method, using a simple production process and a simple production facility.SOLUTION: Provided is a method of carrying out methane fermentation of poultry manure by feeding a poultry manure raw material into a horizontal methane fermentation tank 20 from one horizontal end thereof, carrying out methane fermentation of the poultry manure raw material fed thereinto while moving the poultry manure raw material in the horizontal direction in the horizontal methane fermentation tank 20, and discharging a methane fermentation residue from the other horizontal end of the horizontal methane fermentation tank 20, in which the feeding interval and the amount of the poultry manure raw material being fed into the horizontal methane fermentation tank 20 are controlled so as to maintain the ammonia nitrogen concentration in the horizontal fermentation tank 20 at a prescribed value (11000 mg/kg) or lower. The solid poultry manure fertilizer is produced by drying the methane fermentation residue produced by the methane fermentation of poultry manure raw material.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Vehicle and co2 recovery method
abstract_en: To effectively take CO2 absorbed in an absorption agent in a vehicle out of the same.SOLUTION: A vehicle 1 capable of recovering CO2 comprises a CO2 recovery container 20 storing an absorption agent absorbing CO2 in exhaust gas. The vehicle 1 enables the absorption agent to be replaced in a manner that installs a first discharge passage to discharge the absorption agent out of the vehicle 1 and a first supply passage 37 to supply a new absorbing agent to the CO2 recovery container 20 or enables the absorption agent to be taken out of the vehicle 1 in a manner that detaches the existing CO2 recovery container 20 therefrom and attaches a new CO2 recovery container 20 thereto.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Water treatment system and method for improving water treatment system
abstract_en: To provide a water treatment system equipped with an aeration system capable of preventing sludge accumulation at low cost without increasing the scale of the entire system.SOLUTION: A water treatment system includes an aeration device installed on the entire surface of the aeration tank. The aeration device has a combination of a full-width aeration unit with aeration gases distributed over the entire width of the aeration tank and a partial aeration unit with aeration gases distributed over part of the width of the aeration tank, which agitates the bottom of the aeration tank by generating water flow even under the surface where the aeration devices are installed without increasing the overall size of the system, and prevents sludge from accumulating on the bottom of the aeration tank.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method for producing reducing material
abstract_en: To provide a method for producing a reducing material capable of inexpensively producing a reducing material having a high content of a sulfite.SOLUTION: There is provided a method for producing a reducing material which comprises: an adsorption step in which an alkaline slurry containing an alkali compound and water is brought into contact with a raw material gas containing sulfur dioxide to absorb the sulfur dioxide in the alkaline slurry in an absorption section 11a; a reaction step in which an alkali compound and sulfur dioxide are reacted to produce a reducing material slurry containing a sulfite in a reaction section 11b; a circulation process in which the reducing material slurry staying in the reaction section 11b is circulated by the circulation line 12 to the absorption section 11a and the reducing material slurry circulated by the circulation line 12 is sprayed into the absorption section 11a; and a derivation step of deriving the reducing material slurry from the reaction section 11b, wherein the temperature of the reducing material slurry derived in the derivation step is maintained at 70°C or less.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Biological treatment apparatus and biological treatment method
abstract_en: To provide a biological treatment apparatus and a biological treatment method capable of demonstrating excellent nitrification performance for treated water containing 10 vol.ppm or more of methane.SOLUTION: A biological treatment apparatus 1 includes a front aeration tank 10 and a biological nitrification tank 20. The apparatus treats water to be treated containing 10 vol.ppm or more of methane in the front aeration tank 10 and the biological nitrification tank 20 and has a control mechanism for controlling a residence time of the treated water in the front aeration tank 10 to be 0.01-0.5 hours. A biological treatment method using the apparatus 1 is also provided.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method for purifying contaminated soil
abstract_en: To increase the efficiency of purifying contaminants coming off soil particles in contaminated soil.SOLUTION: A method for purifying contaminated soil includes a temperature rise step for raising the temperature of contaminated soil P from room temperature to a first temperature, a temperature control step for controlling the temperature of contaminated soil P to a second temperature that is lower than the first temperature and higher than the room temperature, and a microorganism injection step for injecting the second temperature-controlled contaminated soil P with microorganisms capable of degrading contaminants.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Exhaust gas purification catalyst
abstract_en: To provide a wall-flow-type exhaust gas purification catalyst in which there is a small pressure drop caused by deposition of PM.SOLUTION: There is provided an exhaust gas purification catalyst 1 comprising a catalyst coated filter 2. The catalyst coated filter 2 comprises a filter base material 21 and a catalyst layer 22 provided on a pore wall of the filter base material 21. The exhaust gas purification catalyst 1 has a first end, a second end, a porous partition wall W, a first cell and a second cell. The first cell is closed by the second end, the second cell is closed by the first end and the first cell and the second cell are adjacent through the porous partition wall W. In the porous partition wall W on the surface of the side of the first cell, the ratio SS/S of the total area SS of pores having an opening diameter of less than 40 μm to the total area S of the all pores is 65% or more.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Construction machine
abstract_en: To provide a construction machine capable of easily exchanging a filter provided on a suction side of a suction pipe of an urea water tank.SOLUTION: A sensor unit 28 is inserted into an urea water tank 25. A heating tube 31 of the sensor unit 28 has a vertically extending base portion 31A and a horizontally extending extended portion 31B disposed on a lower end side of the base portion. An opening end portion 29C of an urea water supply pipe 29 is connected to a filter 41 arranged at a position corresponding to the extended portion 31B and extending in the horizontal direction. The extended portion 31B and the base portion 31A are connected via a hose 42 having flexibility. A cover member 51 includes a cover portion 52 that covers the extended portion 31B of the heating tube 31 and the filter 41 from above, and an opening/closing portion 53 provided below the cover portion 52 so as to be opened and closed.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: exhaust system
abstract_en: To provide an exhaust system having excellent exhaust emission control performance.SOLUTION: An exhaust system 1 includes: an exhaust pipe 2 having a main pipe 21 for discharging exhaust gas discharged from an engine 101 and a bypass pipe 22 bypassing the main pipe 21; a catalyst unit 12 interposed on the upstream side of the bypass pipe 22 in the main pipe 21 and having an exhaust emission control catalyst; a plasma reactor 3 interposed on the downstream side of the bypass pipe 22 in the main pipe 21 and decomposing hydrocarbon (HC) included in the exhaust gas; an HC storage device 4 interposed in the bypass pipe 22 and adsorbing and emitting hydrocarbon (HC); a valve 5 for adjusting a flow rate of exhaust gas flowing from the main pipe 21 to the bypass pipe 22; and a control section 6 controlling the valve 5.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method for producing water having reduction potential
abstract_en: To provide reduction water which is different from hydrogen water and has stability.SOLUTION: There are provided a method for producing reduction stock solution which includes a material addition step of adding Kumquat, lemon, ginkgo leaves, Quercus salicina, arrowroot, mugwort, citrus leaves, ice plant and liquor to water, a heating step of heating water after the material addition step, and a normal temperature standing step of allowing the heated water to stand and returning the heated water to normal temperature after the heating step; and a method for producing reduction water which includes a dilution standing step of adding the reduction stock solution produced by the method to water quality improving treatment water which is allowed to stand by adding a porcelain ball and performing treatment and diluting the reduction stock solution, and sufficiently mixing the mixture and allowing the mixture to stand.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Aerobic biological treatment method of organic waste water
abstract_en: To provide inhibition of an increase of filamentous bacteria in an aerobic biological treatment method of organic waste water, in which aeration tanks installed in multiple stages in series are used for aerobic biological treatment by the flotation method.SOLUTION: In an aerobic biological treatment method of organic waste water for treating organic waste water using floating sludge by an aerobic biological treatment device having a plurality of aeration tanks 1 to 4 arranged in series multistage, an aeration amount of a part of aeration tank is reduced when an increase tendency of filamentous bacteria is detected.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Fire extinction body
abstract_en: To provide a fire extinction body that enables replacement timing to be properly grasped in the use of a fire extinguisher with moisture absorbency.SOLUTION: A fire extinction body includes: a fire-extinguishing material that has a support layer, a printing layer provided on either of surfaces of the support layer, and a fire extinguisher-containing layer including a fire extinguisher with moisture absorbency; and a gas-barrier packaging bag for enclosing the fire-extinguishing material. The support layer and the packaging bag have visible light transparency. The printing layer can also be provided on an inner surface facing the support layer of the packaging bag.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Carbon dioxide recovery equipment, and carbon dioxide recovery method
abstract_en: To recover high-concentration carbon dioxide from exhaust gas and furthermore to suppress increase in an installation area and cost of equipment.SOLUTION: Carbon dioxide recovery equipment comprises: an adsorption tower filled with a carbon dioxide absorbing substance; a suction machine which vacuum-suctions the inside of the adsorption tower; a delivery line connected to a delivery port of the suction machine; a carbon dioxide recovery line connected to the delivery line; a recovery gas valve provided in the carbon dioxide recovery line; a non-recovery gas line connected to the delivery line; a non-recovery gas valve provided in the non-recovery gas line; and a control device. The control device closes the recovery gas valve and opens the non-recovery gas valve when the pressure in the adsorption tower is low vacuum on the basis of the predetermined recovery pressure, and closes the non-recovery gas valve and opens the recovery gas valve when the pressure in the adsorption tower is high vacuum on the basis of the recovery pressure.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Water purifier
abstract_en: To provide a water purifier assembled with a communication part and a control part while capable of suppressing an increase in production costs derived from a number of substrates.SOLUTION: In a water purifier for discharging water which has been passed through a consumable material cartridge, a communication part for conducting wireless communication with an RF tag of the consumable material cartridge and a control part for conducting control of the consumable material cartridge based on information obtained by the communication are mounted on one substrate. The water purifier is characterized by that the communication part is arranged in the vicinity of a marginal part of the substrate, the communication part is arranged on a corner part of the substrate, and a display for showing management information relating to the consumable material cartridge formed by the control part is arranged on the substrate.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Sewage purifier and sewage purification method
abstract_en: To provide a sewage purifier and a sewage purification method capable of adequately purifying water in a flowing state.SOLUTION: The sewage purifier has an oyster shell part for purifying sewage, the oyster shell part has oyster shells, the oyster shells are inoculated with biological bacteria, water passes through the oyster shell part at a flow rate of 1 liter per hour or more and 4 liters per hour or less, and the biochemical oxygen demand of the water is 10 milligrams per liter or less.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method and apparatus for amyloid screening
abstract_en: To provide a low-cost device for assessing accumulation of β-amyloid in the brain.SOLUTION: A device (10) for performing an amyloid assessment includes a radiation detector assembly (12) including at least one radiation detector (14). At least one electronic processor (20) is programmed to: detect radiation counts over a data acquisition time interval using the radiation detector assembly; compute at least one current count metric from the detected radiation counts; store the at least one current count metric associated with a current test date in a non-transitory storage medium (26); and determine an amyloid metric based on a comparison of the at least one current count metric with a count metric stored in the non-transitory storage medium associated with an earlier test date.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Exhaust Gas Treatment System with Upstream SCR Catalyst
abstract_en: To provide a system for reducing NOx and N2O emissions from a diesel engine, and a method for using the same.SOLUTION: There is provided a system for treatment of an exhaust gas stream from an engine, the system including: an upstream selective catalytic reduction (SCR) catalyst that receives the exhaust gas stream without any intervening catalyst, a diesel oxidation catalyst (DOC) positioned downstream thereof; a catalyzed soot filter (CSF) positioned downstream of the diesel oxidation catalyst; a second SCR catalyst positioned downstream of the catalyzed soot filter; and an ammonia oxidation (AMOx) catalyst. The present application also describes use of such a system to reduce nitrogen oxides (NOx) and hydrocarbons (HC) in an exhaust gas stream.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1A

title_en: Metal porous sheet roll and member
abstract_en: To provide a metal porous sheet roll that enables energy saving, and a member.SOLUTION: A metal porous sheet roll is obtained by forming a metal porous sheet into a roll. The metal porous sheet is composed of a metal porous body with a three-dimensional mesh structure. The three-dimensional mesh structure includes a plurality of supports, and a node that connects the plurality of the supports. The metal porous body includes a catalyst.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Wastewater treatment device, wastewater treatment method and program
abstract_en: To provide a wastewater treatment device 10 capable of efficiently recovering energy.SOLUTION: The wastewater treatment device 10 includes: a separation and concentration tank 12 for storing wastewater; an oxygen/nitrogen injection unit 16a for supplying oxygen/nitrogen to the wastewater stored in the separation and concentration tank 12; an ORP control device 16 for controlling the oxygen/nitrogen injection unit 16a; an acid/alkali injection unit 17a for supplying acid or alkali to the wastewater stored in the separation and concentration tank 12; and a pH control device 17 for controlling the acid/alkali injection unit 17a. The separation and concentration tank 12 has an FO membrane unit 18, and wastewater containing impurities, dissolved organic matter, and moisture is present on one side of an FO membrane of the FO membrane unit 18, and a draw solution DS is present on the other side of the FO membrane, The ORP control device 16 supplies oxygen and/or nitrogen to the separation and concentration tank 12 in accordance with an oxidation-reduction potential of the wastewater, and the pH control device 17 supplies an acid or alkali as a pH adjuster to the separation and concentration tank 12 in accordance with pH of the wastewater.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method for separating and recovering material from photoelectric conversion element, and method for manufacturing photoelectric conversion element
abstract_en: To provide a new method for easily separating and recovering materials that make up photoelectric conversion elements.SOLUTION: A method for separating and recovering materials from a photoelectric conversion element having a first conductive layer, a power generation layer containing a light absorber, and a second conductive layer made of a porous free-standing sheet containing single-walled carbon nanotubes, laminated in this order on a transparent conductive substrate having a transparent conductive film formed on a light-transmitting substrate, includes a dissolution step of immersing the photoelectric conversion element in a separation solvent to dissolve some of the components of the photoelectric conversion element, thereby disassembling the photoelectric conversion element and recovering the materials.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Garbage collecting vehicle and garbage collecting device
abstract_en: To provide a garbage collecting vehicle that can monitor the vicinity of a garbage inlet and the rear of the vehicle and has few malfunctions.SOLUTION: A garbage collecting vehicle consists of a vehicle body and a garbage collecting device 11 mounted on the vehicle body. The garbage collecting device 11 has a garbage storage box 12 for storing garbage, a loading device 18, and a garbage inlet 17. The loading device 18 operates to send objects that are put into from the garbage inlet 17 so as to load them into the garbage storage box 12. The device has first photographing means 40, second photographing means 42, and a support member 43 for supporting the photographing means. The support member 43 protrudes from the garbage collecting device 11. The first photographing means 40 has an area near the garbage inlet 17 as its photographing area, and the second photographing means 42 has an area behind the vehicle body as its photographing area.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Electrolytic water generator
abstract_en: To provide an electrolytic water generator capable of quickly draining water from a water supply system in a configuration having a trap waterway in the water supply system to an electrolytic cell.SOLUTION: A trap waterway 37 has an upstream vertical flow path section 37b and a downstream vertical flow path section 37c that are continuous at a waterway bottom section 37a, and the downstream vertical flow path section 37c is connected to a water supply system 3 downstream of the trap waterway 37 at a flow path upper end, and the upstream vertical flow path section 37b is connected to the water supply system 3 upstream of the trap waterway 37 at the flow path upper end, and a drainage mechanism 8 has a first drainage section 81 provided at a flow path lowest part of the water supply system 3 upstream of the trap waterway 37, and a second drainage section 82 provided at the waterway bottom section 37a of the trap waterway 37.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Digestion system
abstract_en: To provide a digestion system for controlling a temperature of an inside of a tank.SOLUTION: A digestion system comprises a tank for digestion of excess sludges, a first pipeline for supplying excess sludges to the tank, a first heat exchanger provided in the first pipeline, a second heat exchanger provided in the first pipeline and provided on the downstream side of the first heat exchanger, and a second pipeline that circulates digestion sludges in the tank between the inside and the outside of the tank. The second pipeline communicates the tank with at least any one of an upstream side of the first heat exchanger and an upstream side of the second heat exchanger that is on the downstream side of the first heat exchanger.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Adsorption sheet, corrugated sheet, corrugated laminate, adsorption element, and dehumidifier
abstract_en: An object of the present disclosure is to newly provide an adsorption sheet, a corrugated sheet, a corrugated laminate, an adsorption element, and a dehumidifier.SOLUTION: To provide an adsorption sheet, a corrugated sheet, a corrugated laminate, an adsorption element and a dehumidifier.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Power storage integrated device, power storage extension pack, and power storage facility
abstract_en: To provide a power storage integrated apparatus, a power storage extension pack, and a fire fighting solution in a power storage facility.SOLUTION: A power storage integrated device, comprising an integrated device housing and a first fire extinguishing module 108 provided in the integrated device housing, wherein the integrated device housing comprises a first battery box housing 110 and a heat sink housing 112 that are detachably connected, a first battery module 104 is fixed in the first battery box housing, and an inverter circuit board 106 is fixed in the heat sink housing. The first fire extinguishing module includes a trigger mechanism, a fire extinguishing agent storage and a release mechanism, the trigger mechanism is arranged in a fire extinguishing detection area 120 in the integrated apparatus housing, and generates a trigger signal when the fire extinguishing detection area meets a fire extinguishing trigger condition, the fire extinguishing agent storage is configured to store a fire extinguishing agent, and the release mechanism responds to the trigger signal of the trigger mechanism and releases the fire extinguishing agent to the cavity 150 where the first battery module is located.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Fluid sterilization apparatus
abstract_en: To provide a fluid sterilizer capable of sterilizing and inactivating various bacteria and viruses.SOLUTION: The fluid sterilization device has a plurality of light emitting elements 4 for emitting ultraviolet light and a flow path space where the ultraviolet light emitted by the light emitting elements 4 is incident. The peak wavelengths of the light-emitting elements are not the same, and the combined spectrum obtained by adding the spectra of the light-emitting elements has one peak and a half-width of 20 nm or more.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Processing apparatus for food waste water using food waste dry equipments
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a food wastewater treatment device which uses a surplus treatment capacity of a food waste drying facility to dry to treat food wastewater which is the majority of food waste. The present invention provides a food wastewater treatment device using a food waste drying facility which implements a new form of a food wastewater treatment system capable of improving drying efficiency of food wastewater by treating the food wastewater in a drying manner with a dryer for drying food waste, and inputting the food wastewater after preheating through a heat exchanging process before input of the food wastewater, thereby saving treatment cost required for outsourcing related to treatment of the food wastewater, increasing treatment efficiency while increasing a treatment capacity of the food wastewater, and reducing a loading rate of a deodorizing boiler by reducing a discharging gas volume of the dryer.

title_en: Safe multiple-tap
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a safety multi-tap. More specifically, the present invention relates to an automatic fire extinguishing-type safety multi-tap that extinguishes an early fire. The safety multi-tap according to the present invention comprises: a body having a plurality of terminal hole pairs for plug connection pins; a mount panel coupled to an inner surface of the body and having first and second installation parts; a fire extinguishing stick provided in the first installation part; a connection terminal provided in the second installation part; and a cover coupled to the body. Therefore, the present invention is capable of preventing a detachment of the fire extinguishing stick.

title_en: Circular sludge collector with the function of preventing the collected sludge from coagulation
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to provide a circular sludge collector with a coagulation preventing function of collected sludge capable of efficiently preventing coagulation of sludge collected in a hopper. The circular sludge collector with a coagulation preventing function of collected sludge comprises: a center shaft installed at a treatment tank; a center cage installed at the center shaft; a drive unit to rotate the center shaft; a scraper installed at a bottom end of the center cage; and an exhaust induction device installed at an inner side of the hopper. The exhaust induction device is configured by at least one collecting plate installed at the center cage which is rotated with the center cage in a standing pose inside the hopper to flow sludge corrected in the hopper. The collecting plate is inclined based on a height direction of the center case or is bent in a spiral structure so that the sludge ascends along a surface. A sludge of a coagulation form passes through the collecting plate to be broken or to induce irregular flow of the sludge to form a plurality of through holes for preventing coagulation of the sludge. A plurality of prominences are formed at the through hole to sharply protrude inward of the through hole around the through hole to have a triangle shape to accelerate breaking of the sludge passing through the through hole and are dispersed in a radial direction of the through hole.

title_en: Hose torsion-preventive apparatus for fire hose
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a twisting-preventive connection device for a fire hose, and to a connection device which is installed on at least one side or both sides so as to be rotated in a position at which room hoses are connected to each other such that twisting can be prevented. The connection device comprises: a pipe-shaped inner connection part provided such that the hose to which the connection device is installed is fixed, extending in the direction in which the hose is connected, and inserted to be able to rotate; an outer connection part surrounding the outer periphery of the inner connection part, disposed to be attached and detached by fastening in which connection is performed so as to prevent leakage, and supported so as to prevent the inflow of foreign substances; and a rotating part installed between the inner connection part and the outer connection part, installed to be rotated by sliding in a state of being in contact in the thrust direction which is the axial direction, and provided to rotate in a state overlapping the direction in which the inner connection part is connected thereto and in the direction of the hose of the outer connection part.

title_en: Sprinkler
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a sprinkler that can be used in connection with a pipe upward or downward depending on a water flow detection device. More specifically, in a sprinkler used for fire suppression or agriculture and including a claw body connected to a pipe and a deflector formed on the claw body, the deflector includes: a collision plate having a disk shape with a predetermined diameter and having a coupling member detachably coupled to the claw body to protrude on the upper and lower surfaces thereof and discharge holes radially formed on the outer surface thereof around the coupling member; and a blocking plate made of an elastically resilient material that is detachably coupled to the collision plate by having a fitting port for being fitted and coupled to the discharge hole in shape to protrude on the outer surface thereof.

title_en: Panel-type drum screen with increased dehydration efficiency of impurities
abstract_en: Disclosed is a panel-type drum screen with the increased dehydration efficiency of impurities, in which a drum assembly that filters impurities can be partially replaced, the drum assembly and a drum driving unit are directly connected, thereby having a simple structure, and a dehydration device is disposed separately from a filtration device and disposed at the outside of the filtration device. The panel-type drum screen with the increased dehydration efficiency of impurities comprises: a filtration device configured to filter impurities from sewage water flowing thereinto and discharge sewage from which the impurities are removed to the outside; and a dehydration device which is disposed separately from the filtration device, disposed at the outside of the filtration device, and configured to transport the impurities discharged from the filtration device and flowing thereinto in one direction while compressing the impurities to remove moisture from the impurities.

title_en: Air-cooled grate for incinerator
abstract_en: Disclosed is an air-cooling grate for an incinerator, which includes an anti-wear part and thus has increased durability. The air-cooling grate (100) for an incinerator according to the present invention includes a flow path through a first recessed part (110), a protrusion part (120), and a second recessed part (130). Accordingly, the present invention can facilitate gas circulation, improve the combustibility of the incinerator, and increase the grate's cooling efficiency. In addition, the air-cooling grate for an incinerator additionally includes an anti-wear part (160), so it is possible to prevent a top plate (140) and a through-hole (150) from wearing and thus increase the durability and lifespan of the grate (100). In addition, the air-cooling grate for an incinerator additionally includes a support part (170), so it is possible to prevent the anti-wear part (160) from being separated and enhance the strength of the grate (100).

title_en: deodorizing device for food waste treating apparatus using PTC heater
abstract_en: The present invention is to provide a deodorizing device for a food waste treating apparatus using a PTC heater, which is capable of drying and deodorizing moisture and odor gas generated when treating food waste discharged from a home or the like by the PTC heater and a catalyst. A deodorizing device for a food waste treating apparatus using a PTC heater comprises: a body which includes a first chamber in which an odor gas inlet pipe is formed, a second chamber in which a purified air outlet pipe is formed, and a cover detachably mounted on an opening formed on the front, and is injection-molded with a synthetic resin material; an ultraviolet lamp for sterilizing the introduced odor gas by ultraviolet rays and ozone; a catalyst for neutralizing the odor in the passing odor gas; a heating unit which dries moisture in the odor gas passing through the second chamber, and in which one of a PTC heater, a sheath heater, and a coil heater is used; and a humidity sensor for detecting the humidity of the odor gas passing through the second chamber and transmitting a detection signal to a control unit for controlling the operation of the heating unit.

title_en: Auto cover equipment for loading box of cargo crane
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an automatic cover device for a collection box of a forklift. The automatic cover device for a collection box of a forklift can cover an upper opening part of a collection box by using a cover and can effectively cover both rear opening parts of the collection box in which a boom of the forklift is installed by using an auxiliary cover, thereby stably sealing the opening part of the collection box according to regulations without damaging the appearance.

title_en: Electric fire vehicle
abstract_en: A technical problem of the present invention is to provide an electric fire truck having a compact structure and configured to effectively suppress a fire. The electric fire truck comprises: a water tank mounted on a vehicle body and accommodating fire-extinguishing water therein; a first inlet pipe supplying the fire-extinguishing water from the outside to the water tank; a first inlet control valve provided on the first inlet pipe and controlling opening and closing of the first inlet pipe; a second inlet pipe disposed adjacent to the first inlet pipe and supplying the fire-extinguishing water from the outside to the water tank; a second inlet control valve provided on the second inlet pipe and controlling opening and closing of the second inlet pipe; a fire pump connected to the water tank through a connection pipe and providing a suction force for moving the fire-extinguishing water; a discharge control valve provided on the connection pipe and controlling opening and closing of the connection pipe; a discharge pipe for discharging the fire-extinguishing water supplied from the fire pump to the outside; and a foam supply unit supplying compressed air foam to the fire-extinguishing water moved into the discharge pipe. The electric fire truck according to the present invention can simplify the structure of the electric fire truck by improving a plurality of pipe connection structures.

title_en: Dredging and Treatment System for Sewage Pipes, Digestive Tanks, and Reaservoirs Using Mobile Combined Suction Module
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a sewage sludge dredging and processing system of a sewage pipe, a digestion tank, or a storage tank using a movable complex suction module. The sewage sludge dredging and processing system of a sewage pipe, a digestion tank, or a storage tank using a movable complex suction module is formed in a compact structure to be able to freely move to an alley through picking up a small vehicle, is able to simultaneously perform extraction and cleaning of deposits inside and around a manhole, separates collected sludge and sewage to filter and reuse the sewage, and performs a self-dehydration process and a compression process on solids in a lump to greatly reduce sludge processing costs. In particular, the sewage sludge dredging and processing system includes a primary cyclone dust collection unit (10), a first transfer unit (20), a secondary cyclone dust collection unit (30), a second transfer unit (40), a centrifugal separation unit (50), a filtering unit (60), and a compression unit (70) so that the sludge processing capacity per hour can be greatly improved by rapidly separating solids and sewage by a sludge suction efficiency improvement and centrifugal separation method.

title_en: Smart shredding waste and recyclables disposal device and method based on percussion rotating body
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a waste treatment apparatus for treating waste contained in a volume-based waste disposal bag. More specifically, the present invention relates to a waste treatment apparatus for treating waste contained in a volume-based waste disposal bag comprising a shredder including a first rotary blade and a second rotary blade that rotate to break the volume-based waste bag and crush waste, wherein the shredder has a different shape of a first rotary blade and a second rotary blade.

title_en: Overall processing apparatus of adulteration with supplying function of heated washing water by oil-element sensor
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a comprehensive waste processor, which disperses and supplies the filtrate discharged to a filtrate storage tank after a primary separation of impurities from manure and livestock wastewater by a rotary screen and dehydration of impurities by a screw press to a seed removal screen and a centrifugal separator connected to a cyclone to remove microscopic impurities such as seeds, animal hair, and fine fibers. The residue components discharged from the seed removal screen are reintroduced into a screw press to be dehydrated together with impurities so that the filtrate from which the impurities are finally separated is supplied to a purification facility through a filtrate discharge tank. According to the comprehensive waste processor, an oil sensor for detecting the oil content in a filtrate is installed inside the filtrate storage tank, and a hot water tank with a built-in electric heater is installed inside the filtrate discharge tank or outside the filtrate storage tank or the filtrate discharge tank. By connecting a heating water supply pipe extending from a hot water tank through a supply pump in parallel with a washing water injection pipe disposed on an upper side of the seed removal screen together with a room temperature water supply pipe, when an oil content measurement value detected by the oil sensor is less than a set value, the room temperature water is supplied to the washing water injection pipe. When the measured value exceeds a set value, the heating water heated by the electric heater in the hot water tank is supplied to the washing water injection pipe through an economical switching method. Thus, the cleaning function of the seed removal screen, the removal performance for impurities and the resulting dehydration efficiency of the seed removal screen are kept stable at a high level at all times.

title_en: A Energy Supply System for Fire: FES
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an energy supply system for fire suppression (FES) for an emergency state such as fire suppression by including a commercial power unit and an emergency power unit, and more specifically, to an energy supply system for fire suppression (FES) for an emergency state by including the commercial power unit, the emergency power unit, and a pressure tank and a fire receiving board operating unit for constantly maintaining pressure of the pressure tank and recognizing fire during fire. The FES comprises: an automatic transferring switch which includes a controlling unit for selecting one power unit of the commercial power unit and the emergency power unit; an operating board switch which is driven by the pressure tank and the fire receiving board operating unit; a pump unit which receives power by the power unit selected by the automatic transferring switch and the operating board switch, and supplies water for the fire suppression; a pressure tank unit which compresses the water supplied by the pump unit; and a sprinkler which sprays the water compressed by the pressure tank unit for the fire suppression.

title_en: Fire detection apparatus for using secondary battery cell pressurization test device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire detection apparatus for a secondary cell pressurizing test apparatus, comprising: a main duct installed in parallel to the arrangement direction of secondary battery cells in an apparatus for performing a test by applying pressure and voltage to the secondary battery cells; a plurality of collection tubes provided in the main duct to be arranged in a longitudinal direction, wherein each sucks external air into the main duct; blowing fans installed in the main duct to discharge the air, sucked through each of the collection tubes, through the main duct and an outlet; and smoke sensors detecting smoke from the air discharged through the blowing fans to output a detection signal. According to the present invention, the fire detection apparatus detects, in advance, smoke generated during a pressurization test process for a secondary battery cell like a pressurization short-circuit inspection process of a secondary battery cell to prevent a fire that occurs during a pressurization test process due to a defect in a secondary battery cell in advance, and sucks the air at the shortest distance corresponding to each secondary battery cell and detects a smoke occurrence to detect a fire occurrence rapidly and accurately, thereby preventing damage to properties and human life.

title_en: Catalyst for dechlorination and method for manufacturing thereof
abstract_en: A dechlorination catalyst according to an exemplary embodiment of the present application includes a hydroxyapatite carrier containing Na; and a catalyst component supported on the carrier, wherein the Na content is 2 wt% or more based on the total weight of the carrier.

title_en: System for provention forest fire
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for preventing a forest fire and, more specifically, to a system for preventing a forest fire, capable of extinguishing a forest fire by automatically confirming whether the forest fire breaks out. According to the present invention, the system for preventing a forest fire, for preventing the fire in a forest, includes: a rainwater collecting unit (10) installed in the forest and collecting rainwater; a rainwater storage unit (20) storing the collected rainwater to use the collected rainwater as water for fire-fighting; an extinguishing spray unit (30) connected to the rainwater storage unit (20) and installed to spray the water for fire-fighting to the forest; a spray control unit (40) controlling spray through the extinguishing spray unit (30) of the water for fire-fighting stored in the rainwater storage unit (20); and a control drone unit (50) moving in a predetermined section in the forest and transmitting and receiving a control signal by communicating with the spray control unit (40).

title_en: Filter device of air purifier for fine dust
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a filter device of an air purifier for fine dust, having a simple structure. The filter device utilizes an electrostatic atomization method to convert water into mist to adsorb and remove fine dust and suspended bacteria, while maintaining a particle size of the mist uniform by ensuring that the water pressure within each capillary tube is constant, which results in reduced water consumption and the ability to generate mist without additional structures. For this purpose, in the filter device of the air purifier for fine dust according to the present invention, which is configured to make fine dust and suspended bacteria in the air adhere to a grounding plate in a process in which water supplied to each capillary tube of a capillary tube frame is converted into mist through an electrostatic atomization method and then sprayed onto the grounding plate, the capillary tube frame is provided with capillary tube chambers, each having capillary tubes on both upper and lower sides based on a central passage. Each of the capillary tubes is provided with an annular perimeter wall and a linear guide wall separated from each other, allowing water to be guided to each capillary tube, wherein the guide wall is elongated from an end of the passage to the center thereof, such that the flow rate and velocity of water at the center and the end of the passage of each capillary tube chamber are inversely proportional, thereby maintaining a constant water pressure in each capillary tube.

title_en: Controllable Advanced Decomposition Equipment for Industrial Process-Water Containing Non-biodegradable Organics and In-Organics
abstract_en: A controlled-type non-degradable process water advanced decomposition device of the present invention is composed of multiple stages including an ozone dissolution tank, a hydroxide radical formation tank, and a gas-liquid separation tank, improves economic efficiency by using a conventional high-speed motor instead of an expensive turbo motor in the ozone dissolution tank, achieves smooth mixing by reducing a dead space in the ozone dissolution tank, and maximizes the ozone utilization rate in terms of structural dynamics.

title_en: Food waste treating device using black soldierfly larva
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a food waste origin treatment device using black soldier fly larvae, comprising: a case part where a door is formed on the front; a plurality of tray parts stored and withdrawn from the case part; and a lifting part that sequentially raises and lowers the plurality of tray parts, wherein larvae of black soldier flies and food waste are located inside the tray part, and the food waste is decomposed by the block soldier fly larvae during a lifting process. An objective of the present invention is to provide a way to minimize the cost and time investment incurred by collecting, separating, or moving food waste.

title_en: A Dust collector with improved dust collection efficiency
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a filtration and dust collection device having improved dust collection efficiency, which comprises: a hollow chamber with an inlet hole formed on one side; an inlet portion connected to the inlet hole to serve as a passage through which air to be filtered flows; a discharge portion connected to a discharge hole to serve as a passage through which filtered air is discharged; a conveyor installed at the bottom of the chamber to discharge falling filtered materials; a plurality of bag filter portions installed to be spaced apart from each other on a filter installation portion that is an upper surface of the chamber; a hollow discharge chamber disposed above the filter installation portion and having a discharge hole formed on the other side; and a pulsing portion having a pulsing pipe extending into the discharge chamber and located above the bag filter portions to make the bag filter portions pulse, wherein the top surface of the discharge chamber has a slope portion sloping upward toward the discharge hole. According to the present invention, the air entering the chamber is distributed evenly to prevent excessive flow of air into some bag filter portions and pulsing is performed effectively to increase filtration efficiency.

title_en: Apparatus and method for detecting radioactive ray
abstract_en: According to an embodiment disclosed in the present document, a radiation detection device comprises: a plurality of detectors each acquiring radiation information of an object; a sensor acquiring visualization information related to the object; a length adjustment unit adjusting an interval between the plurality of detectors; and a controller adjusting the interval by controlling the length adjustment unit based on a positional relationship between the object and the plurality of detectors, and generating a three-dimensional image based on the radiation information and the visualization information.

title_en: The test apparatus of valve for the fire extingyisher
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide a test device for a valve for a fire extinguisher, which can test whether the valve for a fire extinguisher can operate normally before being mounted on a fire extinguishing liquid tank. A test device of a valve for a fire extinguisher comprises: a main frame having a mounting hole; an adapter connected from the valve for the fire extinguisher to the mounting hole; a filling means mounted on the main frame; a discharge means having a first silencer and mounted on the main frame; a sensor means for measuring internal pressure of the mounting hole; a locking means; a trigger means capable of being coupled to the valve for the fire extinguisher; and a second silencer mounted on a spray nozzle.

title_en: X-ray detector
abstract_en: The present invention provides an X-ray detector including a substrate having an active region in which a plurality of pixels are arranged and a non-active region around the active region, wherein the pixels include: a pixel electrode; a first capacitor including a first electrode connected to the pixel electrode and formed of a photoconductor, and a second electrode facing the first electrode; a first transistor having a gate electrode connected to the pixel electrode; a second transistor having a source electrode connected to a node between the pixel electrode and the gate electrode of the first transistor; and a third transistor having a drain electrode connected to the source electrode of the first transistor.

title_en: Fire extinguishing system for battery for vehicle
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire suppression device for a battery of an electric vehicle, and more specifically, to a fire suppression device and method capable of effectively suppressing a fire occurring in a battery installed in an electric vehicle. To achieve the purpose, the fire suppression device for a battery of an electric vehicle includes: a fire blanket including an upper portion fixed to a body frame so as to cover a battery mounted on a vehicle from the upper side, and a side portion formed in an edge part of the upper portion to extend downward, wherein the fire blanket covers the battery in which a fire has occurred so as to block oxygen from the battery; a fixing member installed on the fire blanket so as to fix the side portion in a rolled or folded state, and provided to release the side portion fixing state when a fire occurs in the battery; and a weight installed on the side portion and, when the side portion fixed by the fixing member is released, falling and pulling the side portion in the rolled or folded state downward to unfold the side portion so as to cover the periphery of the side of the battery.

title_en: Method for manufacturing hollow fiber type photocatalyst and the hollow fiber type photocatalyst thereby and photocatalyst filter comprising the same
abstract_en: Provided are a method for manufacturing a hollow fiber-type photocatalyst, a hollow fiber-type photocatalyst manufactured thereby, and a photocatalyst filter including the same. the method for manufacturing a hollow fiber-type photocatalyst has photocatalytic activity even in a visible light region by coating nitrogen-doped titanium dioxide powder on an alumina ceramic hollow fiber membrane having a porous structure, and can improve an ammonia gas removal rate with improved performance.

title_en: Rotary damper
abstract_en: The present invention provides a rotary damper that can replace a plurality of dampers and prevent fluid leakage by increasing sealing. The rotary damper includes: an outer frame having first to fourth openings formed therein; a driving shaft that rotates in a first direction or a second direction opposite to the first direction; first to fourth inner frames having at least one through hole formed therein; a first disc plate that extends in the inner side direction of the outer frame; a second disc plate that is connected to the first disc plate by a connecting member; and a sealing member that is made of an elastic material and is joined at a position where the first to fourth inner frames and the first disc plate or the second disc plate come into contact. According to the present invention, the rotary damper can change various fluid movement paths using one damper, thereby reducing the number of dampers compared to the prior art.

title_en: Battery cell test device
abstract_en: Provided is a battery cell test device comprising: a first plate configured to face a first surface of a battery cell and including a receiving space for accommodating an extinguishing material; a second plate configured to face a second surface of the battery cell opposite the first surface; a fastening member connected to the first plate and the second plate; and a cover connected to the first plate and configured to cover the receiving space. The cover may be configured to deform in response to temperature. The extinguishing material may be configured to be delivered to the battery cell when the cover deforms.

title_en: Sewage treatment system using sewage sludge
abstract_en: Provided is a sewage treatment system using sewage sludge, which comprises: an anaerobic tank (120); an anoxic tank (140); an aeration tank (220); a blowing unit (240); an internal return line (280); an internal return pump (300); a settling tank (320); a discharge line (340); a sewage sludge return line (360); a sewage sludge return pump (380); an external transfer line (400); an external transfer pump (420); a rainfall confirmation member (440); a control unit (460); and a concentration measurement sensor (500). According to the present invention, even if a carbon content rate is lowered due to a low load of sewage introduced during rainfall, sewage sludge generated during sewage treatment can be recycled to maintain an appropriate C/P ratio of a bioreactor, thereby replacing an existing separately input external carbon source and increasing treatment efficiency.

title_en: Brake dust collection device
abstract_en: A brake dust collecting device comprises: a caliper brake including a disk rotating together with a wheel and a pair of brake pads disposed on both sides of the disk to be in close contact with or spaced apart from the disk; a housing provided to surround at least a part of the disk; and a filter unit for collecting braking dust generated between the disk and the pair of brake pads. The filter unit includes: a first filter extending along the circumference inside the housing; and a second filter extending in a direction parallel to the circumferential direction of the disk inside the first filter and including at least one curved portion.

title_en: Ammonia Fuel Supply System for a Vessel
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an ammonia fuel supply system for a ship, which minimizes ammonia discharged from a ship by efficiently recovering ammonia from an engine using ammonia as fuel and a fuel supply device. According to the present invention, an ammonia fuel supply system comprises: an absorber absorbing gaseous ammonia in an emission gas into an absorption fluid to control an ammonia concentration of the emission gas before the emission gas containing ammonia is emitted to the atmosphere; and a stripper distilling a rich absorption fluid generated while the absorption fluid absorbs ammonia in the absorber to separate the rich absorption fluid into gaseous ammonia and lean absorption fluid.

title_en: Facilities for carbon dioxide capture and reaction
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a carbon dioxide capture reaction facility. The carbon dioxide capture reaction facility comprises: a combustion gas supply unit for supplying combustion gas; a slag supply unit for supplying a slag reaction solution in which slag and a reaction solution are mixed; a reactor for providing a chamber for a carbonation reaction between the combustion gas and the slag reaction solution; a high concentration slag circulation unit for circulating the high concentration slag reaction solution having undergone the carbonation reaction to be resupplied to the reactor; and a low concentration slag circulation unit for mixing the low concentration slag reaction solution with the high concentration slag reaction solution having undergone the carbonation reaction before having undergone the carbonation reaction.

title_en: Water-lean solvent absorbing carbon dioxide with phase separation and method for capturing carbon dioxide
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a low-water phase-separated carbon dioxide absorbent comprising a polyamine-based compound, an alkoxy alcohol-based compound, and water, and a method for separating carbon dioxide using a phase separation phenomenon caused by carbon dioxide absorption. The low-water phase-separated carbon dioxide absorbent of the present invention separates a single phase absorbent into a phase in which carbon dioxide is concentrated and a phase in which carbon dioxide is lean in the process of absorbing carbon dioxide, and regenerates only the phase in which carbon dioxide is concentrated, thereby significantly reducing renewable energy required for a regeneration process.

title_en: Photocatalyst for capturing and converting CO2 in Air
abstract_en: Disclosed are a photocatalyst for capturing and converting low-concentration carbon dioxide in the atmosphere, and a method for capturing and photo-converting carbon dioxide in the atmosphere using the same. The photocatalyst for capturing and converting carbon dioxide may include bismuth oxyhalide in which one or more metals are supported and which has an oxygen vacancy.

title_en: Preferential CO Oxidation Catalysts and Manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a high-performance selective oxidation (PROX) catalyst for CO reduction and a method for manufacturing the same. Specifically, it relates to a method for manufacturing a PROX catalyst that maintains the high dispersibility and active sites of a precious metal Ru, which is active in the CO removal reaction, and achieves economic feasibility and mass production capabilities, as well as a PROX catalyst exhibiting high conversion rate and selectivity.

title_en: waste fishing net disposal device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for treating a waste fishing net and, more specifically, to an apparatus for treating a waste fishing net, which grinds a waste fishing net and removes foreign substances from bubble water. According to the present invention, the waste fishing net treatment apparatus can effectively remove foreign substances including inorganic substances including salt by crushing the waste fishing net and then washing the waste fishing net in a washing apparatus supplied with bubble water including microbubbles.
